title_en: Foundation pit penetration-vibration combined test device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a foundation pit penetration-vibration combined test device, and relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering disaster simulation. The high-frequency vibration table comprises a test box main body, a high-frequency vibration table, a liftable water level adjusting cabin system, a multi-parameter monitoring system and a control box, wherein the test box main body is arranged at the top end of the high-frequency vibration table, the liftable water level adjusting cabin system and the control box are both positioned on one side of the high-frequency vibration table, one end of the multi-parameter monitoring system is positioned on the test box main body, and the other end of the multi-parameter monitoring system is electrically connected with the control box. The utility model solves the problem that the traditional waterproof detection structure can not simulate the coupling effect of vibration and penetration, can quantitatively analyze the influence rule of construction disturbance on the permeability of soil, and provides theoretical support for foundation pit safety construction.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 18TH BUREAU GROUP THE 4TH ENG CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY 18TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION TRAFFIC OPERATION GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION NORTH CHINA INVEST DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-physical-field coupling cable fire disaster and hot smoke spreading simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster and hot smoke spread simulation method and a fire disaster and hot smoke spread simulation system for a multi-physical field coupling cable. According to the method, a cable electromagnetic field model is constructed through a finite element method, a Fourier heat conduction equation, an Arrhenius pyrolysis model and LES large vortex simulation are combined, trans-scale modeling of electric branch growth dynamics (precision +/-0.01 mm/s) and insulation pyrolysis process (temperature resolution +/-2 ℃) is achieved, local hot spots (such as 280 ℃ critical temperature) before insulation breakdown can be early warned for 10-30 minutes, a system integration parameter input module, a multi-field calculation module, a visual analysis module and an experimental verification module are used, BIM collaborative design is supported, engineering schemes such as small-scale combustion experiment calibration (average error of 10 groups of samples is 3.8%) can be optimized, and the smoke spreading speed is reduced by 42%. The scheme covers multiple scenes such as power, traffic, data centers and the like, and provides a high-precision multi-physical field coupling simulation technology for cable fire risk assessment and safety design.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Operation and maintenance processing method and device based on attack and defense countermeasure fault exercise
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation and maintenance processing method and device based on attack and defense countermeasure fault exercise, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an alarm mechanism to be verified in a production environment, matching faults in a fault library according to the alarm mechanism to be verified, performing exercise and optimization on the alarm mechanism to be verified by using the matched faults to obtain an optimized alarm mechanism, deploying the optimized alarm mechanism to the exercise environment, performing step-by-step exercise verification on a plurality of faults in the fault library according to paths of the test environment, the disaster recovery environment and the production environment, receiving countermeasure exercise requests reported by a defender, sending the countermeasure exercise requests to an attacker, and obtaining monitoring data of an attack and defense countermeasure process when the attacker does not have forenotice to inject specified faults, and performing multiple disc summarization by using the monitoring data. The invention can improve the practicability, reliability and efficiency of operation and maintenance exercise.

title_en: Collaborative operation simulation method, system, equipment and medium under multi-type extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative operation simulation method, a system, equipment and a medium under multi-type extreme weather, which belong to the technical field of disaster treatment and comprise the steps of constructing an extreme weather element state scene set based on a Markov process by collecting basic data of a power system, multi-type extreme weather data and line repair data, and constructing a collaborative operation simulation model by taking a multi-level load linearization utility function as a target and combining various constraint conditions to form a scheme for covering multi-type extreme weather. The invention solves the problems that the traditional extreme weather electric power operation simulation single scene is poor in adaptation, the line fault repair process is ignored, and the operation strategy is conserved and the power supply risk is caused by lack of cooperation.

title_en: Electric motor car thermal runaway analogue means
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thermal runaway simulation device of an electric vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of fire demonstration, and comprises a model and a bearing platform, wherein the model is fixed on the bearing platform and is provided with a simulation component and an interaction component, the model is provided with the simulation component and the interaction component, the simulation component comprises a water mist generator, a vibration motor, a buzzer, an LED lamp and a ducted fan, the simulation component can be used for generating auditory and/or visual effects when the model simulates thermal runaway, the simulation component is arranged on the model, the interaction component comprises a control module and an interaction module, and the control module can control the water mist generator, the vibration motor, the buzzer, the LED lamp and the ducted fan to work. According to the utility model, the simulation assembly is provided with the water mist generator, the vibration motor, the buzzer, the LED lamp and the bypass fan, so that smoke, flash light, flame swing, sound generated by combustion and vibration generated by combustion generated by a battery when a fire disaster occurs can be intuitively simulated, and the simulation is more real.
assignees: GUANGDONG NIKOLA ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mud-rock flow strikes pier analogue means
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of bridge engineering experimental facilities, especially, relate to a mud-rock flow strikes pier analogue means, it includes basin, angle adjusting device, mud-rock flow analogue means, pier module and data acquisition system; the basin includes inclination section and horizontal segment, and mud-rock flow analogue means installs on the inclination section, and pier module installs on horizontal segment and pier module, the utility model discloses can adjust water tank angle, mud-rock flow impact force, velocity of flow and flow mode simultaneously, mud-rock flow path under the different topography conditions of simulation, control mud-rock flow velocity of flow, grain grading and impact force adapt to multiple experimental demand, and pier module adopts modularized design, possess the advantage that can the different shape pier models of quick replacement, be convenient for research the impact resistance of different shape piers, be applicable to mountain bridge engineering design, geological disaster prevention and cure research and teaching experiment, can provide scientific experimental basis for pier impact resistance optimization and disaster prevention and reduction strategy.
assignees: ZHEJIANG EAST CHINA GEOTECHNICAL INVESTIGATION & DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Visual simulation and prediction system for mine ground collapse risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses a visual simulation and prediction system for mine ground collapse risk, which comprises a data acquisition and management module, a data management module and a data management module, wherein the data acquisition and management module is used for acquiring monitoring data and basic data related to the mine ground collapse risk in real time or periodically through a plurality of heterogeneous data sources, and the monitoring data and the basic data are uniformly stored and managed; and the data processing and fusing module is connected with the data acquisition and management module. The invention integrates satellite remote sensing, aviation remote sensing, ground monitoring and geological mining multisource heterogeneous data through the data acquisition and management module, combines the pretreatment, space-time reference registration and feature fusion technologies of the data processing and fusion module, solves the problems of limited ground measurement coverage and high cost of the traditional single technology, and overcomes the defects of weather restriction and insufficient flexibility of aviation photography.
assignees: SICHUAN JIANLU INNOVATION TECH DEVELOPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Flexible protection structure for highway side slope disaster treatment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of civil engineering and discloses a flexible protection structure for managing highway side slope disasters, which comprises an anchor post structure, wherein the anchor post structure comprises a fixed disc, a plurality of groups of fixed posts are fixedly connected to the top surface of the fixed disc, a transmission shaft is rotationally connected between each group of fixed posts, the transmission shaft is in sliding connection with a hook rope, the bottom end of the fixed disc is fixedly connected with an anchor rod, a plurality of elastic resistance increasing devices are fixedly connected to the anchor rod, the bottom end of the anchor rod is fixedly connected with an anchor drill bit, the flexible protection structure further comprises a rope structure, the rope structure is fixedly connected with a transverse supporting rope and a vertical supporting rope, and the transverse supporting rope and the vertical supporting rope are fixedly connected with built-in wire meshes. According to the utility model, highway side slope disaster management is realized, and the elastic resistance increaser, the hook rope and the spring are matched on the anchor post, so that the pressure resistance of the whole structure is assisted, and the stability and durability of the structure are enhanced.

title_en: Method for providing disaster prevention performance information in sewer network performance management system
title_ko: 하수관로 성능관리 시스템에서 하수관로의 방재성능 정보를 제공하는 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시예에 따른 하수관로 성능관리 시스템에서 하수관로의 방재성능 정보를 제공하는 방법은: 소유역 정보 데이터베이스를 구축하는 단계; 개별 하수관로 노드와 링크에 대한 하수관로 정보 데이터베이스를 구축하는 단계; 수방시설물에 대한 수방시설물 정보 데이터베이스를 구축하는 단계; 성능분석 시나리오별 방재성능 정보를 포함하는 방재성능정보 데이터베이스를 구축하는 단계; 및 상기 소유역 정보 데이터베이스, 하수관로 정보 데이터베이스, 수방시설물 정보 데이터베이스 및 방재성능정보 데이터베이스 중 하나 이상을 지리정보시스템(GIS) 환경을 통해 조회 가능하도록 제공하는 단계;를 포함하고, 상기 성능분석 시나리오는 강우량, 기점수위, 강우지속기간 및 빗물받이 차집효율 중 하나 이상에 기초하여 구성될 수 있다.  그 밖의 다양한 실시예가 가능하다.

title_en: Seesaw device, air closing device and air closing system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pneumatic sealing, and particularly relates to a seesaw device, an air closing device and an air closing system. The novel firecracker flat-replacing product provided by the utility model effectively overcomes the defects of the traditional firecrackers and the traditional flat-replacing products, adopts a simple mechanical structure in the steps of inflating and closing after blasting an inflatable object through a brand-new mechanical design, avoids the use of complex electronic elements or chemical agents, greatly reduces the manufacturing cost, is free from complex assembly, is simple and convenient to operate, can be safely used in urban families or indoor scenes, avoids the potential safety hazards of fire disaster, explosion injury and the like caused by the traditional firecrackers, solves the problem of air pollution, has real firecracker setting-off simulation effect, can enable users to reheat the traditional holiday atmosphere, meets the emotion requirements of people on setting off the firecrackers, realizes the organic combination of safety, practicability and cultural inheritance, and has wide market application prospect.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disaster early warning device, which belongs to the technical field of geological equipment and comprises a drilling hole which is arranged on a landslide sliding body and drilled into a sliding bed, wherein a steel strand is arranged in the drilling hole, an anti-drop rod is fixed at the lower end of the steel strand, a thread section is arranged at the lower end of the anti-drop rod, an anti-drop hook is arranged at the upper part of the anti-drop rod, anti-drop concrete is arranged in the drilling hole at the outer side of the upper end of the anti-drop rod, a stone masonry table is arranged at the upper end of the drilling hole, a hydraulic cylinder is fixed at the top of the stone masonry table, a piston is arranged in the hydraulic cylinder, a hydraulic rod is fixed at the lower end of the piston, the lower end of the hydraulic rod is fixed with the steel strand, and a pressure sensor and an oil filling hole are arranged at the lower part of the hydraulic cylinder. According to the utility model, the steel strand is fixed from a plurality of positions, so that the fixing reliability of the steel strand is greatly enhanced, the steel strand is effectively prevented from loosening or falling off, and the accuracy of monitoring data is ensured. And the steel strand wires are conveniently tensioned, and then the pressure sensor is used for detecting the pressure change of hydraulic oil, so that the landslide movement direction is monitored, and disaster early warning is carried out.
assignees: China railway nanning bureau group co ltd

title_en: Gas seepage long rock core clamping system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas seepage long core clamping system, and belongs to the technical field of deep coal seam gas seepage experiments. The system comprises a long core holder, a constant-speed constant-pressure loading device, an air inlet system and an air outlet system. The long core holder can hold single-section or multi-section coal samples with the length not more than 500 mm, an axially distributed external thread structure is adopted to reduce weight and ensure strength, the constant-speed constant-pressure loading device independently controls shaft pressure and confining pressure through double pumps, a built-in temperature control system simulates the temperature of a coal bed, an air inlet system provides stable gas pressure through a pressure regulating valve and a buffer tank, an air outlet system realizes negative pressure extraction through a water ring type vacuum pump, and a sensor is matched for monitoring parameters in real time. The utility model realizes the collaborative simulation of the integral and sectional seepage rules, improves the operation convenience and the parameter control precision, can simulate the gas seepage scene under the real geological condition of the deep coal seam, and provides experimental support for gas disaster prevention and control and resource development.

title_en: Method for establishing tree lodging specification prediction based on historical meteorological data and post-disaster inspection survey of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The method for predicting the tree lodging specification based on historical meteorological data and post-disaster inspection investigation of the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided, historical typhoon data, unmanned aerial vehicle inspection data and geographic information data are integrated to form a comprehensive multi-dimensional data set, multiple influencing factors are deeply analyzed to determine key characteristics, a model is built by an advanced machine learning method of a regression model and a deep learning model, complex data relations are optimized through simulation and optimization, prediction accuracy and reliability are improved, scientific evaluation indexes of accuracy, recall rate, F1 value and mean square error are set, the generalization capability of the model is comprehensively evaluated by adopting a k-fold cross validation technology, and model parameters are finely adjusted by adopting a grid search and random search method, and the constructed real-time monitoring and early warning system and post-disaster response and recovery strategy effectively reduce tree lodging disaster loss and play a positive role in protecting urban greening and ecological environment.
assignees: GUANZHAO INTELLIGENT TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Disaster early warning method and system for overseas crude oil pipeline system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster early warning method and system for an overseas crude oil pipeline system, and belongs to the technical field of pipeline safety. Through the obtained target components and target attributes of the crude oil pipeline system, an equivalent sand table model corresponding to the crude oil pipeline system is correspondingly constructed, rainfall simulation tests are carried out based on the equivalent sand table model, namely rainfall events with different intensities and durations are simulated, the integrity of the pipeline under various heavy rainfall conditions is evaluated, namely the disaster resistance of the crude oil pipeline system is evaluated, early warning information is correspondingly generated when the evaluation result is low, the problem that the current early warning method is too dependent on disaster data and insufficient in advance can be solved, and the reliability and accuracy of the evaluation result are improved.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CHINA NAT OIL AND GAS EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT LTD

title_en: Atmospheric coupling degradation simulation test system for side slope
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and geological disaster prediction, and particularly relates to an atmospheric coupling degradation simulation test system for a side slope, which comprises a side slope model box, a non-uniform thermal radiation field simulation system, a multiphase seepage system, a dynamic stress loading system and a control computing system, wherein the non-uniform thermal radiation field simulation system simulates solar radiation to form a surface temperature difference gradient and a mineral thermal expansion effect, the multiphase seepage system simulates acid rain, snow melt seepage and corrosion reaction, and the dynamic stress loading system accurately simulates crack expansion under the action of seismic waves.
assignees: ZHEJIANG EAST CHINA GEOTECHNICAL INVESTIGATION & DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Combat training control device and system
title_ko: 전투훈련 관제장치 및 전투훈련 관제시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 TVWS통신을 이용하여 훈련장과 지휘통제시의 데이터 통신을 목적으로 한다. 구체적으로 훈련장(A)에 위치하며, 훈련장구(111) 및/또는 훈련장비(112)에 각각 장착되는 마일즈장비(110); 상기 마일즈장비와 무선통신하며, 훈련장에 설치되는 훈련수집전송기(120); 상기 훈련수집전송기와 LAN통신하며, 훈련정보(11)를 저장 및 전송하는 마일즈서버(130); 상기 마일즈서버와 LAN통신하며, 데이터를 저장 및 전송하는 TVWS단말기(210); TVWS기지국(B)에 설치되며, 복수의 TVWS단말기와 통신하는 TVWS서버(220); 지휘통제소(C)에 설치되며, 상기 TVWS서버와 LAN통신하며 데이터를 저장 및 전송하는 지휘통제서버(300);를 포함하는 구성으로 이루어진다.

title_en: Nuclear power plant simulation system including improved field operator training capabilities
title_ko: 개선된 현장운전원 훈련기능을 포함하는 원자력발전소 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_ko: 개선된 현장운전원 훈련기능을 포함하는 원자력발전소 시뮬레이션 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 원자력발전소 시뮬레이션 시스템은, 원자력발전소 전체 계통을 모델링하여 시뮬레이션 서버에서 실행하고, 강사용 훈련지휘실에서 입력된 상황설정값에 의해 초기설정되어 운용되고, 교육생의 현장운전 조작에 대응하는 응답 결과를 출력하는 원전 시뮬레이터; 실제 원자력발전소의 중앙제어실과 동일하게 복제된 구조이고, 교육생의 현장운전 조작을 수용하여 해당 조작 입력값을 원전 시뮬레이터에 전달하는 구조의 교육용 중앙제어실; 상기 교육용 중앙제어실의 외부에 설치되고, 교육생에 의한 현장운전 조작 기능을 포함하고, 교육생에 의해 입력된 현장운전 조작 신호를 원전 시뮬레이터에 전달하며, 별도의 터미널로 작동하여 독립적으로 운용되는 교육용 현장조작반; 및 원자력발전소에서 발생할 수 있는 다수의 상황에 관련한 상황설정값을 저장하고, 교육생을 훈련하는 강사의 입력에 의해 상황설정값을 원전 시뮬레이터에 입력하여 원전 시뮬레이터를 초기설정하며, 원전 시뮬레이터의 응답 결과를 실시간으로 강사에게 출력하는 강사용 훈련지휘실;을 포함하는 것을 구성의 요지로 한다.

title_en: FDS Data-based PINN Simulation for Predicting the Distribution and Flow of Hazardous Gases
title_ko: 유해가스 분포 및 유동 예측을 위한 fds 데이터 기반 pinn 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유해가스 분포 및 유동 예측을 위한 FDS(Fire Dynamics Simulator)데이터 기반 PINN(Physics-informed Neural Networks)시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는, 건물 화재 발생시 3D 모델링 건물의 단면도로 표현된 시뮬레이션 결과 화면 상에서 유해가스의 농도, 분포 및 건물 내부 온도를 시각화하여 시계열 분석이 가능하도록 하며, 유해가스의 유동 예측 분석을 통해 최적의 대피 경로를 확인 할 수 있는 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Descending lfe line location confirmation and usage guidance system
title_ko: 완강기 위치 확인 및 사용 안내 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 완강기 위치 확인 및 사용 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 완강기 위치를 확인시키고 화재시의 대응방법이나 완강기 사용방법 또는 주의사항 등을 안내하여 완강기 사용을 용이하게 하기 위한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 키꽂이 슬롯 내의 키 투입 여부를 감지하여 키 감지 신호를 제어부로 전달하는 키 투입 감지부, 사용자의 버튼 조작에 따라 위치 확인 신호를 발생하여 제어부에 전달하는 완강기 위치 확인부, 각 실내에 비치된 모니터와 스피커 및 화재 수신기에 연결되고 완강기 사용법 안내를 위한 영상정보와 음성정보가 메모리에 미리 저장되며 키 감지 신호를 확인하여 실내 전원을 공급하고 완강기 위치 확인부의 위치 확인 신호를 확인하여 완강기 위치 표시부에 위치 표시 신호를 출력하는 제어부, 및 제어부의 위치 표시 신호에 의해 구동되어 완강기 설치 위치를 표시하는 완강기 위치 표시부를 포함하여, 화재시 또는 훈련시 영상저보와 음성정보로 출력되는 안내방송에 따라 효율적으로 완강기 사용방법을 숙지하여 신속 대피할 수 있게 하거나 불필요한 완강기 사용을 억제하여 자원 낭비를 줄일 수 있게 한다.

title_en: Method and system for determining optimum shelter based on attributes of agent
title_ko: 에이젼트 속성 기반 최적 대피소 결정 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 에이젼트 속성 기반 최적 대피소 결정 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 임의의 지역에 대한 지역 기초 데이터를 획득하고, 지역 기초 데이터에 기초하여 지역 내의 대피자에 대한 에이젼트를 생성하고, 각 에이젼트에 대한 활동 시나리오, 목적지 및 이동경로를 생성하고, 활동 시나리오 및 이동경로에 기초하여 각 에이젼트의 대피유형을 결정하고, 에이젼트의 대피유형 및 위치에 기초하여 에이젼트가 가장 빠르게 대피할 수 있는 최적 대피소를 결정함으로써, 재난 발생 시 임의의 지역 내에 위치하는 각 대피소로 대피하는 인원을 예상할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire control shower nozzle detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire control spray head detection device, which particularly relates to the technical field of fire control spray head detection, and comprises a water tank, wherein the left side and the right side of the water tank are respectively connected with an electric push rod, the tops of a pair of electric push rods are respectively connected with a support frame, the bottoms of a pair of support frames are respectively connected with a placing plate, a plurality of threaded holes are formed in the placing plates, a first shaft rod and a second shaft rod are respectively and rotatably connected to the front side and the rear side of the placing plates in the water tank, the outer sides of the first shaft rod and the second shaft rod are respectively connected with a plurality of stirring blades, a servo motor is started to drive the stirring blades at the two sides of the water tank to synchronously rotate, so that water in the water tank flows, the situation of overhigh or overlow local temperature is avoided, the temperature of the water body is more uniform, the spray head can be subjected to uniform heat transfer, the whole heated actual situation of the spray head in a fire disaster is more accurately simulated, and the accuracy and the reliability of a detection result are improved.

title_en: Inclined building for rescue training
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an angle-adjustable inclined building, and relates to the field of rescue training equipment. The building comprises a building body, a first connecting component and a second connecting component, wherein the building body is arranged on a base, the building body comprises a building body frame with a rectangular frame body and a plurality of floors connected with the building body frame, the first connecting component is arranged on one side of the bottom of the building body frame and is used for realizing movable connection between the building body frame and the base, the second connecting component is arranged between the building body frame and the base and comprises at least one telescopic second connecting piece, and a fixed part of the second connecting piece is connected with the base and a movable part of the second connecting piece is connected with the building body frame. According to the utility model, the inclination angle of the building body is flexibly adjusted through the telescopic second connecting component, multiple inclination states from a few degrees to tens of degrees can be simulated, different inclination degrees of a building in an earthquake are simulated, rescue workers experience building internal environments with different angles in the same facility, related operation skills are practiced, the problems of single training scene and limited effect of the conventional fixed-angle inclined building are solved, and the actual combat capability of the rescue workers for coping with complex disaster scenes is improved.

title_en: Loess slope meteorological geological disaster comprehensive experiment simulation platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a loess slope meteorological geological disaster comprehensive experiment simulation platform, which comprises an angle steel frame, wherein a slope model is arranged in the angle steel frame, distributed optical fiber sensors are arranged in the slope model, the front side of the bottom of the slope model is supported by an adjusting bottom plate, the rear side of the bottom of the slope model is supported by a water filtering tank, the lower part of the adjusting bottom plate is connected with an angle cylinder, the upper part of the adjusting bottom plate is provided with a vibrator, a loading plate driven by a loading cylinder is arranged above the slope model, a spraying plate is arranged above the loading plate, and the platform further comprises a PLC (programmable logic controller) control box for controlling experimental electric elements, wherein the PLC control box is electrically connected with a computer terminal. The utility model can comprehensively study the stability of the slope by multiple factors, including simulating rainfall, loading, vibration and base angle change, has simple structure and convenient operation, ensures the reliability of the loess slope model experiment, and simultaneously adopts a PLC control box, a distributed optical fiber sensor, an optical fiber collector, a high-definition camera and the like to control and record the whole process of the model experiment.

title_en: Intelligent fireproof technology driven by self-circulating water source and forming water curtain protection layer outside building
abstract_en: An intelligent fireproof technology driven by a self-circulating water source and forming a water curtain protection layer outside a building. The exterior wall material of the fireproof quadrangle is a stainless steel plate, and the heat insulation material is a high polymer material with a flame-retardant function. The top of the house is sealed by a solar panel and a heat-insulating and sound-insulating glass skylight, and the center peak can move up and down for ventilation. Four water outlets respectively facing the four directions are arranged at the top, and the flow direction and the flow rate of water are controlled by using an AI intelligent technology. When an external fire happens, water is discharged downwards from the central part of the top, so that a water curtain with four surrounding surfaces or the required direction is formed. Can also be used for landscape or cooling at ordinary times. The water source may be from municipal, well-drilled, or swimming pool. The courtyard building has a central courtyard. Because the water curtain covers the complete building group in the enclosing wall, the central courtyard belongs to a safe area. Pets, horses, etc. may be placed. The invention can completely preserve the building in fire disaster, so that insurance companies are willing to provide fire insurance and charge reasonably for such houses.

title_en: Indoor firework characteristic training facility structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an indoor smoke and fire characteristic training facility structure which comprises a main control chamber, a combustion chamber, a first-layer simulation chamber, a second-layer simulation chamber and a stair, wherein the combustion chamber is longitudinally arranged, the main control chamber is transversely arranged, one end of the main control chamber is communicated with the combustion chamber, the first-layer simulation chamber is parallel to the main control chamber, one end of the second-layer simulation chamber is communicated with the combustion chamber, the second-layer simulation chamber comprises a longitudinal training room and a transverse training room which are mutually communicated, the longitudinal training room corresponds to the upper part of the combustion chamber, the transverse training room corresponds to the upper part of the first-layer simulation chamber, the combustion chamber is respectively communicated with the first-layer simulation chamber and the second-layer simulation chamber through pipelines, a corridor is arranged outside the second-layer simulation chamber, the upper end of the stair is communicated with the corridor, and the periphery of the corridor is provided with a guardrail, and pressure relief window and a safety door are respectively arranged on the sides of the main control chamber, the combustion chamber, the first-layer simulation chamber and the second-layer simulation chamber. The real fire and smoke environment simulation system has the advantages that the real fire and smoke environment of a disaster relief site can be simulated, more complex simulation site layout is provided, more training route choices are provided, and therefore the training effect has a reference value.

title_en: Disaster simulation system for interface stripping between tunnel and ballast bed in complex environment
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of underground engineering, and relates to a disaster simulation system for tunnel and ballast interface stripping in a complex environment, which comprises a simulation box, an excitation loading system, a hydraulic loading system, an optical monitoring system, a digital image system, a test acquisition system and a data processing system, wherein transparent pieces are arranged on two side walls of the simulation box, a tunnel model is arranged in the simulation box, a ballast is paved on the tunnel model, water filling ports are formed in the other two side walls of the simulation box, a water outlet is formed in the bottom of the simulation box, the excitation loading system is arranged at the ballast, the hydraulic loading system is connected with the ballast through a pipeline, the optical monitoring system and the digital image system are arranged outside the simulation box, the test acquisition system is in communication connection with the ballast, and the data processing system is in communication connection with the test acquisition system. The utility model has simple structure and convenient operation, and effectively improves the efficiency and accuracy of the simulation monitoring of the tunnel and the ballast bed load.

title_en: Road engineering investigation system and method based on geographic features
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of road engineering construction, in particular to a road engineering investigation system and method based on geographic features. The method can acquire richer and more comprehensive geographic information by integrating the multi-source geographic data, overcomes the defects of the traditional investigation method, improves the accuracy and reliability of the investigation result, can deeply analyze the influence of the geographic features on the road engineering based on the association model and the numerical simulation technology established by the geographic features, accurately predicts the potential geological disaster risk, provides more prospective decision basis for the design and construction of the road engineering, and enables the investigation result to be displayed more intuitively and vividly by utilizing the visual platform of VR and AR technologies, so that a user can deeply understand the relationship between the geographic features and the road engineering, and the scheme adjustment and decision making are convenient.

title_en: Geological disaster treatment slope support anchor rod reinforcing combination device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of slope support anchor rod reinforcement combination devices, in particular to a slope support anchor rod reinforcement combination device for geological disaster treatment, which comprises a drill bit, an expansion assembly arranged above the drill bit and a connection assembly arranged above the expansion assembly, wherein the expansion assembly comprises a shell, long rods are arranged inside the shell, three groups of same expansion pieces are coaxially and equidistantly arranged outside the long rods, a disc is sleeved at the right end of the shell, the connection assembly comprises a connecting plate, holes are formed in the connecting plate at equal intervals, the drill bit is welded and fixed with the shell, the drill bit is spiral, soil bodies can be crushed more effectively, different drill bits are adapted according to different geological conditions, the long rods rotate to drive three-groove discs to synchronously move, the three-groove discs push column blocks through slotted holes, and then drive connecting rods to move, finally, the expansion pieces rotate around rotating points of the shell, so that the expansion pieces are expanded, friction force between the expansion pieces and the soil bodies is increased, the anchor rods are firmer in the soil bodies, and the anti-pulling capacity is improved.

title_en: Integrated supervision and management system to improve the quality and efficiency of building facilities
title_ko: 건축 설비의 품질 및 효율성 향상을 위한 통합 감리 및 관리 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축 설비의 품질 향상과 효율적인 관리를 위해 설계, 감리, 시공, 운영 및 유지보수 단계에서 활용할 수 있는 통합 감리 및 관리 시스템에 있어서, 전기설비 감리를 수행하기 위한 모듈로서, 전력기술 관리법에 따라 아파트, 공동주택, 공공건물, 플랜트 및 산업시설에 설치되는 태양광 발전, 송전, 배전, 조명설비 등의 전력시설물을 실시간으로 모니터링하고 품질을 평가하며, 전력 손실을 최소화하도록 설계된 전력 최적화 알고리즘을 포함하는 전기설비 모듈; 정보통신설비 감리를 수행하기 위한 모듈로서, 정보통신 공사업법에 따라 구내통신선로, TV 공시청, 홈네트워크 시스템, CCTV, 주차관제, 음향영상설비 등의 설치 및 운영 상태를 분석하고, 전송, 이동통신, 위성통신, 정보망, 항공항만통신 및 철도통신 신호설비의 안정성을 보장하기 위한 통신 품질 개선 알고리즘을 포함하는 정보통신설비 모듈; 소방설비 감리를 수행하기 위한 모듈로서, 소방공사업법에 따라 소화설비, 경보설비, 피난설비, 소화용수설비, 소화활동설비 등의 방화 시스템을 실시간으로 점검하며, 화재 발생 가능성을 사전에 예측하고, 최적의 대응 계획을 제안할 수 있는 방화 시뮬레이션 및 위험도 분석 알고리즘을 포함하는 소방설비 모듈; 상기 전기설비 모듈, 정보통신설비 모듈 및 소방설비 모듈과 연동하여 모든 설계 및 감리 데이터를 통합 관리하며, 시공 단계에서 발생할 수 있는 문제를 사전에 예방할 수 있는 디지털 트윈 기반 시뮬레이션 엔진과, 설계와 감리의 일체화를 통해 시공 품질을 향상시키는 협업 관리 플랫폼을 포함하며, 상기 모듈들이 생성하는 데이터를 중앙 서버에 저장하고 이를 기반으로 유지보수 단계에서 장비 수명을 예측하고, 신속한 문제 해결을 위한 AI 기반 자동 진단 및 추천 시스템을 제공하는 통합 데이터 분석 모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Radiation disaster prevention system considering accidents in small modular reactors
title_ko: 소형모듈형 원자로의 사고를 고려한 방사능 방재 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소형모듈형 원자로의 사고를 고려한 방사능 방재 시스템에 관한 것으로, 원자력 발전소의 사고 발생 시나리오를 도출하는 도출부; 상기 도출부로부터 도출된 시나리오를 분석하는 분석부; 상기 분석부의 분석 결과에 따라 주민보호조치 권고시간을 산출하는 산출부; 상기 권고시간 및 상기 원자력 발전소의 인근 부지 정보를 반영하여 주민소개 양상을 도출하는 주민소개 시물레이션부; 상기 사고 발생 시나리오의 분석 결과 및 도출된 상기 주민소개 양상을 바탕으로 상기 시나리오별 소외 피폭선량을 계산하는 계산부; 및 계산된 상기 소외 피폭선량을 고려하여 방사선비상계획구역(EPZ)을 설정하는 설정부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and system for determining evacuation vulnerable area based on attributes of agent
title_ko: 에이젼트 속성 기반 대피취약지역 결정 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 에이젼트 속성 기반 대피취약지역 결정 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 임의의 지역에 대한 지역 기초 데이터를 획득하고, 지역 기초 데이터에 기초하여 지역 내의 대피자에 대한 에이젼트를 생성하고, 각 에이젼트에 대한 활동 시나리오, 목적지 및 이동경로를 생성하고, 활동 시나리오 및 이동경로에 기초하여 각 에이젼트의 대피유형을 결정하고, 대피유형에 기초하여 임의의 지역의 대피취약구역을 결정함으로써, 구조 자원 우선 배치, 정책 설계, 맞춤형 재난 대응 전략 수립 등에 활용할 수 있다.

title_en: Construction method for controlling stability of tunnel face aiming at water-bearing sandstone stratum tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method for controlling stability of a tunnel face aiming at a water-bearing sandstone stratum tunnel, which comprises the following steps of preliminarily determining a tunnel construction section of a weakly consolidated sandstone stratum by combining earlier geological exploration data, detecting the stratum in front of the tunnel face by adopting a transient electromagnetic method, judging whether a water storage structure exists in front of the tunnel face, acquiring a weakly consolidated sandstone sample by advanced geological drilling, determining the water content omega, the plastic limit omega  P  and the liquid limit omega  L  of the weakly consolidated sandstone sample, judging the type of potential instability disasters of the tunnel face by combining whether the water storage structure exists in front of the tunnel face and the water content omega of the weakly consolidated sandstone sample, and adopting corresponding construction measures aiming at different tunnel face disasters. The invention can ensure the stability of the tunnel face in the whole construction process under the condition of the water-containing weakly cemented sandstone stratum, and avoid the problems of great economic loss, personnel injury and the like caused by disasters such as unstable collapse of the tunnel face, water burst, mud burst and the like in the construction process.

title_en: Rescue training electronic sand table device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electronic sand tables and discloses a rescue training electronic sand table device which comprises a base, wherein a main display screen used for displaying is arranged on the top side of the base, a plurality of secondary display screens are arranged on the outer sides of the periphery of the top of the base, a plurality of groups of seat adjusting assemblies used for supporting the firefighter to sit down and train are arranged on the outer sides of the periphery of the bottom of the base corresponding to the secondary display screens, supporting seats are fixedly arranged at four corners of the base, lifting moving assemblies used for supporting and lifting the base to move conveniently are arranged in the supporting seats, and the rescue training electronic sand table device drives a screw rod to rotate in a sliding block through starting a servo motor, namely the sliding block is driven to slide along the inner wall of a fixed frame, and then the top seat is driven to move synchronously, so that the firefighter can sit down and train exercise, and long-term standing and tired operation of the firefighter is avoided.

title_en: Building collapse rescue training module
abstract_en: A building collapse rescue training module comprises a horizontally placed bottom plate 4, a vertical left side plate 2 and a vertical right side plate 11 are arranged at the left end and the right end of the bottom plate 4 through screws and L-shaped fixing pieces 3, a vertical middle side plate 9 is arranged in the middle of the bottom plate 4 through screws and L-shaped fixing pieces 3, two longer adjusting sliding grooves 8 are vertically arranged on the left end face of the middle side plate 9, a left inclined plate 1 is arranged on the two adjusting sliding grooves 8 through butterfly nuts 7 and hinged connecting pieces 6, two shorter adjusting sliding grooves 8 are vertically arranged on the left end face of the middle side plate 9, and a right inclined plate 10 is arranged on the two adjusting sliding grooves 8 through the butterfly nuts 7 and hinged connecting pieces 6. The utility model has small volume and is movable, can be widely used in the basic-level firefighting rescue station, and meets the daily training requirements of basic-level firefighters. The utility model can be repeatedly built and used, 4 building collapse scenes in partial collapse or complete collapse modes can be molded, and the training modes are more abundant.

title_en: Portable fire control ability training evaluation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable fire fighting capacity training and evaluating device, and belongs to the technical field of fire fighting training devices. The device comprises a display device, a motion capture device and a training evaluation module, wherein the motion capture device is fixed at the front end of the top of the display device, the motion capture device is provided with a mechanical adjusting structure and can flexibly rotate in the horizontal direction, the shooting angle can be adjusted according to a training scene and the actions of firefighters by controlling the motion capture camera, the capturing accuracy of firefighting actions is effectively improved, a reliable data base is provided for accurately identifying the actions of the firefighters, more accurate analysis and instruction of firefighting training are facilitated, and through the cooperative work among the motion capture device, the training evaluation module and the display device, accurate transmission and processing of data are realized, and the training and evaluation effects are improved.

title_en: Simulation analysis method for fire disaster in long and large deep tunnel and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation analysis method and electronic equipment for fire disaster situations in a long and large deep tunnel. The method comprises the steps of constructing a long deep tunnel and BIM models of trains in the long deep tunnel, inputting material properties into the BIM models, importing the BIM models into fire simulation software, setting various fire simulation scenes, operating the fire simulation software to generate analysis simulation results of fire disaster, respectively setting the trains at different safe stop points according to the analysis simulation results, combining different ventilator air volumes and ventilator numbers, rerun the fire simulation software, and analyzing and calculating evacuation results under different conditions. And carrying out true reconstruction on the tunnel composite scene through the BIM model, and carrying out simulation on the occurrence and expansion of fire disaster in the tunnel. By determining the optimal combination of the optimal safe parking position, the air quantity and the opening number of the ventilator, the optimal countermeasures are researched and proposed, the harm degree of fire disaster is reduced, and the safety of passengers is fully ensured.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for constructing scene library
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device and a storage medium for constructing a scene library, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an FDS scene according to a target scene, wherein the target scene comprises a plurality of scenes, simulating the FDS scene to obtain a simulation result, obtaining metadata information of the simulation result, generating a parameter configuration file of the simulation result according to project requirements, extracting and converting the simulation result according to the parameter configuration file to obtain Feather format data corresponding to the target scene, screening and converting the Feather format data according to the metadata information to obtain three-dimensional point cloud data, and constructing the scene library of the target scene by utilizing the three-dimensional point cloud data. The method improves the analysis efficiency and accuracy of the fire explosion scene, and provides powerful support for accident pre-judgment, emergency response and safety evaluation.

title_en: Window board for fire control training tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a window board for a fire-fighting training tower, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting training and comprises a wall body, a laminating plate and a lifting plate, wherein the laminating plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the wall body through bolts, the lifting plate is movably connected to the top of the laminating plate, the front side of the lifting plate is provided with a matching hole, the left side and the right side of the front side of the lifting plate are respectively provided with a pull groove, the inner cavity of the laminating plate is provided with a mounting groove, and the left side and the right side of the inner cavity of the mounting groove are respectively provided with a positioning component. According to the utility model, by arranging the bonding plate, the lifting plate, the positioning assembly and the control assembly, the problems that the heights and the sizes of windowsills of buildings in actual fires are different, the heights of the fixed windowsills cannot be adjusted, a training scene is single, and firefighters are difficult to adapt to diversified actual combat environments are solved, and the adjustment effect is achieved.

title_en: Geological disaster investigation sampling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of geological disaster investigation sampling, in particular to geological disaster investigation sampling equipment. The technical scheme includes that the support plate comprises a support plate, a T-shaped groove is formed in the top surface of the support plate, a vertical plate is arranged in the T-shaped groove, a lifting groove is formed in the front side of the vertical plate, a motor I is arranged on the top surface of the vertical plate, and an output end of the motor I penetrates through the lifting groove and extends to the inside of the lifting groove and is provided with a threaded rod. According to the utility model, the motor I is arranged to the thread plate, the sampling tube can be driven to automatically descend, the motor II is matched to drive the sampling tube to rotate, the drilling and sampling efficiency is improved, the first air cylinder push rod and the push plate are arranged, sampling soil in the sampling tube can be automatically pushed out, the sampling bag is fixed through the clamping strip, the sampling tube is convenient to mount in the sampling soil, the stud is arranged to the moving wheel, the heights of the supporting legs can be independently adjusted, the drilling and sampling device is suitable for the topography of different gradients, the whole drilling and sampling device is convenient to move, and the convenience and practicality of the drilling and sampling device are improved.

title_en: Fire control maze environment trainer
abstract_en: A fire-fighting maze environment training device comprises a first container, a second container, a third container and a fourth container, wherein the side walls of the first container, the second container, the third container and the fourth container are sequentially connected, adjacent side walls of the second container, the third container and the fourth container are removed, the side surfaces of the second container, the third container and the fourth container are communicated, a maze training area is formed, and a movable partition is arranged in the maze training area to construct a maze environment. The rescue route is diversified, the strain capacity of firefighters in unfamiliar environments can be enhanced, and the special container is arranged to provide smoke and heat, so that the movable partition has good light shielding performance, the dense smoke and dark environment of a fire scene can be well restored, and the rescue capacity and psychological adaptability of firefighters can be improved.

title_en: Multi-parameter fusion rock slope landslide monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rock slope landslide monitoring and discloses multi-parameter fusion rock slope landslide monitoring equipment which comprises a slope, a monitoring assembly and a control module, wherein a crack is formed in the slope, the monitoring assembly is arranged in the slope, and the monitoring assembly comprises a fixed point part and a monitoring part I. According to the utility model, the second monitoring part is arranged, the rock mass acoustic monitoring module is arranged along a side slope drill hole, 10-1000Hz acoustic signals generated by rock mass crack expansion are captured in real time, the crack penetration trend is predicted through sound velocity change, meanwhile, the temperature sensor is integrated at a deep node, and the underground water heat exchange abnormality is monitored, so that the defect that the traditional monitoring only depends on parameters such as displacement, stress and the like, and insufficient hydrologic thermodynamic dynamic perception in the rock mass is effectively overcome, the monitoring dimension of the side slope internal physical characteristic is more comprehensive, and the recognition accuracy of potential disaster symptoms is further improved.

title_en: Fine chemical engineering leakage simulation training device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chemical leakage training equipment, in particular to a fine chemical leakage simulation training device. Its technical scheme includes the jar body, and the one end fixed mounting of jar body has the water injection pipe, leaks fixed mounting on the water injection pipe and has the water injection valve, and the one end fixed mounting who leaks jar body has the drain pipe, and fixed mounting has the check valve on the drain pipe that leaks, and the cutting has a plurality of leakage holes on the jar wall of jar body, and the hole blocking bolt is installed to leakage hole department screw thread. The utility model can be used for training multiple types and multiple positions through the multiple leakage holes formed in the tank body, when the leakage of gas is simulated, colored powder is driven into the tank body, and when the leakage condition of the tank body, the pipeline and the flange connection structure occurs, the colored gas leakage can be observed, so that firefighters can perform simulated leakage stopping training on the device, and the capability of the firefighters for handling dangerous chemical leakage accidents is effectively improved.

title_en: Quick solving method for partial differential equation set of heat flow system based on PINN algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick solving method of a partial differential equation set of a heat flow system based on PINN algorithm, which relates to the technical field of simulation of the heat flow system, and the technical scheme is characterized in that an PINN model containing physical information of the heat flow system is constructed, and the partial differential equation set of the heat flow system, boundary conditions and initial conditions thereof are embedded into a loss function of a neural network; selecting a neural network architecture of heat flow system information, calculating the derivative of a partial differential equation set by utilizing an automatic differential technology, constructing a loss function, training parameters of the neural network by using an optimization algorithm to obtain an approximate solution of the partial differential equation set, and verifying and optimizing a PINN model after training. According to the invention, the solution of partial differential equation is directly approximated by the automatic differential capability of the neural network, so that the computational complexity is remarkably reduced, the problem that the traditional numerical method depends on grid division and dimension disasters easily occur in high-dimensional problems is avoided, and a high-efficiency and accurate tool is provided for the design, optimization and safety analysis of the nuclear reactor.

title_en: Low-voltage electricity consumption safety live-action model demonstration system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-voltage electricity consumption safety live-action model demonstration system, which belongs to the technical field of electric power safety demonstration equipment and comprises a model, a simulation unit, an alarm device and an escape route guiding system, wherein the simulation unit comprises a photovoltaic panel module, a charging pile module, an electric vehicle module and a fault simulation unit, the fault simulation unit comprises an atomizer and an LED lamp, the atomizer can generate smoke, the LED lamp can simulate dynamic flame, the simulation unit can simulate fault disasters, and the escape route guiding system comprises an embedded LED lamp belt. According to the utility model, the simulation unit is arranged, and the photovoltaic panel module, the charging pile module, the electric vehicle module and the fault simulation unit in the simulation unit can simulate fault disasters, can convert abstract concepts such as electric energy transmission, fault arc and fire spreading into simulation phenomena which can be perceived by vision, hearing and touch, can intuitively understand fault causes, propagation paths and results, and therefore, the cognition depth and the memory effect are obviously improved.

title_en: Railway tunnel simulation training facility
abstract_en: The application discloses a railway tunnel simulation training facility which comprises a simulation tunnel, a tunnel track, a building steel beam, a rainproof fire-proof shed, an infrared alarm device and image pickup equipment, wherein the tunnel track is arranged in the simulation tunnel, the building steel beam is arranged above the tunnel track, the bottom of the building steel beam is embedded into the ground, the rainproof fire-proof shed covers the exterior of the simulation tunnel, the infrared alarm device comprises an infrared transmitter surrounding a circle of an entrance of the simulation tunnel and an infrared receiver positioned at an exit of the simulation tunnel, and the image pickup equipment is arranged in the simulation tunnel and is used for monitoring training staff. According to the application, through standardized structural design, intelligent monitoring and disaster scene simulation, actual combat exercise requirements of a railway rescue train in a tunnel environment can be met, emergency disposal capacity of rescue teams is improved, and meanwhile, the integrated targets of energy conservation, environmental protection and safety protection are realized.

title_en: Fire experiment combustion wind tunnel device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire experiment combustion wind tunnel device which comprises an air inlet section, an experiment section and an air outlet section which are sequentially and fixedly communicated in the airflow direction, wherein the experiment section comprises a shell, two ends of the shell are rotatably connected with roll shafts, two ends of each roll shaft are fixedly sleeved with I-shaped riding wheels, two sides of each riding wheel are in sliding fit with arc sliding rods, a combustion table is fixedly connected between the free ends of the arc sliding rods, and a plurality of ignition devices are arranged on the combustion table. According to the utility model, the driving gear driven by the motor is meshed with the arc-shaped rack for transmission, and the arc-shaped slide bar is matched with the I-shaped riding wheel guide structure, so that the combustion table can stably slide along the arc-shaped track, the position of a fire source can be dynamically adjusted in the experimental process, the dynamic combustion processes of moving, spreading, expanding and the like of flame along with wind in an actual fire disaster are effectively simulated, and the coincidence degree of experimental working conditions and a real fire scene is remarkably improved.

title_en: Fireproof door closer performance detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of detection devices, and discloses a performance detection device of a fireproof door closer, which comprises a base, a pendulum impact test rack and a door frame wall, wherein the door frame wall is fixedly connected to the top of the base, the pendulum impact test rack is positioned on one side of the door frame wall, a test door is arranged in the door frame of the door frame wall and is fixedly connected through a hinge, an operator rotates a telescopic swing rod to a set height and angle through the control end of the pendulum impact test rack, the pendulum bob main body obtains corresponding potential energy, the telescopic swing rod is released, the pendulum bob main body swings downwards around the rotating shaft under the action of gravity, the test door is impacted through the rubber sleeve at the bottom, after the impact is completed, the closing condition of the test door under the action of the door closer is observed, related data are recorded, the impact of the pendulum bob main body on the test door is simulated, the impact of a person on the fireproof door during the emergency such as fire disaster and the like during the panic escape is simulated, and the accident can be avoided after the accidental impact.

title_en: Rock drill core sampling equipment for geological disaster investigation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sampling, in particular to rock drill core sampling equipment for geological disaster investigation. The device comprises a sampling structure, a sampling structure and a cooling structure, wherein the leveling base is used for ensuring that the sampling structure can always keep a horizontal state in the whole working process, so that sampling errors caused by equipment inclination are effectively avoided by the leveling base, and the cooling structure is used for uniformly spraying cooling liquid to the sampling structure, so that heat generated in the sampling process can be rapidly and effectively reduced. According to the utility model, the base is leveled, and the second bottom plate is kept in a horizontal state by adjusting the plurality of lifting pieces under the condition of uneven ground, so that the sampling structure can vertically and downwards sample. Through cooling structure, can in time spray the coolant liquid at the core drilling in-process, effectively reduce the high temperature that bores section of thick bamboo and rock friction produced to avoided boring section of thick bamboo and worn and torn rapidly because of overheated.

title_en: Fire-fighting evacuation interval on-site detection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire evacuation interval on-site detection system which comprises a laser scanning device, a support mechanism, a driving mechanism, a main control module and a man-machine interaction device, wherein the laser scanning device is used for acquiring distance data, the support mechanism supports and adjusts the angle and the height of the laser scanning device, the driving mechanism drives the laser scanning device to horizontally and vertically rotate so as to comprehensively scan, the main control module is internally provided with a standard database, processes data and builds a three-dimensional model, calculates the minimum interval and carries out standard compliance judgment, the evacuation passing range is simulated and generated, and the man-machine interaction device displays a result and a simulated image and alarms when the time exceeds the limit. The utility model has high integration degree and realizes the rapid, accurate and automatic detection and visual feedback of the fire evacuation interval.

title_en: A disaster response training system that virtually supports various disaster situations
title_ko: 각종 재난 상황을 가상으로 지원하는 재난대응 훈련 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 각종 재난 상황을 가상으로 지원하는 재난대응 훈련 시스템은, 재난유형과 협업에 따른 담당부서 각 담당자의 사건별 대응업무를 각각 순차적으로 입력할 수 있는 인터페이스를 제공하고 입력에 따른 대응업무를 가상적으로 처리하는 훈련 애플리케이션이 설치되는 복수의 담당자 클라이언트와, 재난 발생시 시간의 흐름에 따라 전개되는 연쇄 사건들을 자동으로 나열하고 전체적인 재난의 피해 규모와 난이도에 맞는 가상의 데이터를 상기 복수의 담당자 클라이언트에 제공하는 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF KYUNGWOON UNIV

title_en: Firefighting training fluid and method for making same
abstract_en: A firefighting training fluid (FFTF) comprising a paraffin blend. The blends of paraffins typically have no less than about two carbon atoms and no more than about twelve carbon atoms. The blends of paraffins may possess Reid vapor pressures in the range from about 2 to about 6.5 pounds per square inch. The blends also typically possess an initial boiling point of not less than about 80 degrees Fahrenheit and an end boiling point of not more than about 370 degrees Fahrenheit. The blends burn relatively cleanly and keep emissions of volatile organic compounds, compounds containing sulfur, smoke, particulates, olefins, and aromatics to a minimum. The blend components mixed to create the blends of paraffins are controlled in order to maintain Reid vapor pressure and initial and end boiling points. Oxygenates may be added to an FFTF in order to further reduce smoke emissions.

title_en: Mass casualty, disaster training inflatable manikin and method
abstract_en: A mass casualty disaster training method includes arranging a plurality of manikins to simulate a plurality of victims of a mass casualty disaster scenario; and simulating triage and treatment of the plurality of manikins.

title_en: Device for establishing communications interoperability at an incident site including means for recording crisis incidents
abstract_en: What is provided is recording capability for each of the modules utilized by the first responders and other personnel within the area of the incident, with the stored information at each of the first responders' modules being read out through the ad hoc network, where it can be uploaded to storage. The stored information can be displayed at an incident commander work station in real time to give the incident commander a realistic view of the timeline and the severity of the incident, as well as the response. The use of the ad hoc network permits offloading stored information from each of the first responders' modules so as to free up storage within the modules. By providing storage at every node of the ad hoc network, one has access to a timeline of the actions at the incident as well as redundancy, which enhances the memories and observational skills of the first responders. Incident reporting is made complete due to the fact of all recordings being made available at one node on the temporary ad hoc network from which information reports and analysis can proceed, as well as subsequent training.
assignees: BAE SYS INF & ELECT SYS INTEG

title_en: Gas Chemical disaster accident handling detection training device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a detection training device for handling a gas chemical disaster accident, which is characterized in that the present invention comprises a liquid level instrument, a gas measuring device marked with scales, a gas container, a water fog spray device, a canister, a gas neutralizing container, a liquid separating funnel and a soil containing device which are connected by pipelines, piston switches and tees to form a training system which integrally combines the applications of five common detecting devices (a poisonous gas detecting instrument, a combustible gas detecting instrument, an acid base test instrument, a water quality analytical instrument, a military poison detecting instrument) at gas chemical disaster scenes. The present invention not only responds the relatively independent functional reaction of various devices, but also shows the application processes of different links of the various devices at disaster scenes. The whole system has the advantages of safety, reliability, analogue simulation, clear flowage structure, reasonableness, accuracy and easy operation, and moreover, detection training is carried out under the state of matter by the present invention, and a platform is built between the training and actual combat.

title_en: System for detection and analysis of biological waste spread in an undergarment
abstract_en: Abstract A system for analyzing biological waste in an undergarment includes a mannequin with a simulated skin surface. An evacuation port is formed in the mannequin for eliminating a simulated human excretory product from the mannequin. A plurality of sensors is located about the evacuation port to sense the excretory product as it is eliminated through the evacuation port into an undergarment placed on the mannequin. A computer in communication with the sensors converts the sensed excretory product into a dispersion pattern for analysis.

title_en: Mine natural disaster simulating system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a mine disaster simulating system. Owing to the complicated environment in mine, mine disaster appears from time to time, so that it is very important to perform safety education for avoid mine disaster. The present invention provides one mine disaster simulating system to simulate mine disaster by means of acoustic, optical, electrical, water, smoke and light material measures. The present invention makes it possible to raise the safety consciousness of workers in mine production so as to avoid mine disaster.A

title_en: Simulator system for train fire trainer
title_ko: 열차의 소방 훈련용 시뮬레이터 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 열차의 소방 훈련용 시뮬레이터로서 열차 내부에 실제 화제를 발생 시키고 비취 된 소화기로 화재 부위에 화재를 진화하면 온도센서가 일정시간 동안 주위 온도를 감지하여 화재의 성장을 자동으로 콘트롤 하여 주고 훈련시 열차의 손상을 방지하기 위한 분사노즐에서 물이 분사되어 열차를 보호해준다. 화재가 진압되면 열차 내부 의자 밑에 있는 비상밸브를 잡아당겨서 에어가 빠지면 열차 자동문을 열어서 나가고 지하철 안전 장치인 스크린 도어의 비상문이나 슬라이딩 도어를 열어 열차 내부에서 승강장 쪽으로 대피하는 소방 훈련용 시뮬레이터로서 열차 내부에서의 부주위로 인한 화재 발생시나 원인모를 화재로 인한 피해를 줄이고 열차의 승객이 화재로 인한 실제상황에서 당황하지 않고 화재를 신속히 진압하고 열차 내부에서 승강장으로 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 하기 위한 실제 화재를 재현한 시뮬레이터로서 여러 가지 방법의 훈련을 전 자동으로 제어할 수 있다. 
       
     화재훈련 제어반, 분사노즐, 파이롯 버너, 온도센서, 비상밸브, 소화기, 열차 자동문, 스크린도어, 승강장, 열차

title_en: Manual provision system
abstract_en: A manual provision system is described, which includes an information terminal device, and a server in which manual information pertaining to an article is recorded, the information terminal device and the server connected to each other through a network, the manual information for the article being scanned into the information terminal device from the server through the network so as to allow the manual information to be checked using the information terminal device. The article is a piece of firefighting equipment and the manual information is a hypothetical operation simulation for the firefighting equipment so as to enable learning the manual information by using the information terminal device to operate the hypothetical operation simulation.

title_en: Bioterrorism and disaster response system
abstract_en: Although there is a universal need for training in handling casualties of weapons of mass destruction, a major challenge for delivering such training include the lack of time for over-taxed healthcare professionals and public health personnel to participate. Many of our workforce members work on part-time basis, evening and weekends at other jobs to make ends meet. The availability of courses that meet the needs of our area, limited computer access (either at the workplace or in the homes of our targeted audience) and funding for travel across long distances to attend training are our most serious barriers to carrying out the project. These problems are addressed by offering a multi-platform approach to training, to include a standardized curricula that is available in formats most likely to be used by the trainee (i.e. web-based), a method to evaluate the knowledge learned, and an on-site training scenario to gain experience on how to respond to both just-in-time and real-time disaster situations.

title_en: Manual provision system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a user to learn by experience a method of operating firefighting equipment without using actual firefighting equipment by hypothetically simulating the operation of the firefighting equipment.  <P>SOLUTION: The manual provision system reads manual information through a network to an information terminal device from a server in which the manual information pertaining to an article is recorded and enables a user to confirm the manual information using the information terminal device, and the article is the firefighting equipment and the manual information is a hypothetical operation simulation for the firefighting equipment configured so as to enable the user to learn the manual information by using the information terminal device to operate the hypothetical operation simulation, and thereby the manual provision system enables the user to learn by experience the method of operating the firefighting equipment without using actual firefighting equipment by hypothetically simulating the operation of the firefighting equipment.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Subway disaster accident simulation testing platform
abstract_en: The experiment platform includes experimental solid model of underground in 1:5 large scale, fire source system, ventilation and smoke extraction system, fire detection alarm system, experimental measurement and collection system, and data analytic system. Structure of multistory building of the solid model includes interzone tunnels, platforms, station halls and facility rooms etc. Modularized design is adopted. Fire source system can simulate different scenes of fire, and generate hot smoke gas of fire nigh true. Power and fuming quantity of the fire source system is determined based on theoretical analysis from model similitude. The experiment platform can generate growth curve of different power of fire. The experiment platform is in use for carrying out experimental studies: happening and growing mechanism of fire, and poison gas outspread inside stations of underground as well as control technique. The invention is applicable to different structures of station.

title_en: Calling disaster-tolerant recovery method based on ordered registration
abstract_en: A kind of calling disaster recovery method based on mandated registration, including: 1. When there is voice call operation arrives at the spare mobile switching center simulation, and shift the location information which has no user in the mobile switching center simulation, the system use the compulsory registration of the users, requests the mobile phone to initiate location updating 2. The mobile phone receives the request information from the system which is based on the user's registration and initiates location updating, the message has the current location information of the user; 3. System receives the location updating from the cell phone, renewing the dynamic information of the user according to the current information in the location updating information, gets the current location of the user, then it can call and seek the user according to the gained dynamic information. The invention ensures that the cell phone can updates the current dynamic information in time when it is needed and avoids the shortcomings of fixed sequence location updating. The greatest degree it can avoid the problem that the user can not be called after disaster.

title_en: Disaster prevention information providing device, disaster prevention information providing system, and disaster prevention information distribution device
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily and quickly provide a user with disaster prevention information according to the present situation without excessive arithmetic operation processing when a disaster occurs or occurrence of the disaster is forecasted.  <P>SOLUTION: In a mobile terminal, a plurality of pieces of disaster prevention information generated by simulation under a plurality of forecasted weather conditions are preliminarily stored in the disaster prevention information storage area 17a of a storage part 17. When the user of the mobile terminal inputs the present weather condition by an input part 18, disaster prevention information closest to the input weather condition is selected from the plurality of pieces of stored disaster prevention information and is displayed on a display part 19. The disaster prevention information is divided into base map data and a plurality of pieces of disaster simulation information when being stored. When disaster prevention information is selectively displayed, the base map data and selected disaster simulation information are combined to generate a hazard map.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Gaseous chemical disaster accident treatment detection training apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model provides an investigation-procuratorate training device for handling with the accident caused by gas chemistry disaster, which is characterized in that the utility model comprises a level indicator, a gas-measure apparatus labeled with scale, a gas container, a spray atomizer, a toxicant filtering tank, a gas neutralization container, a rating funnel and a soil vessel, the components are connected by line pipes, plunger switches, triplets to be an one-body training system which fuses five common investigation-procuratorate equipments (a poisonous gas detecting instrument, a fuel gas detecting instrument, an acid-base tester, a water quality analyzer and a military toxic investigation-procuratorate instrument)in places of gas chemistry disaster. The device not only reflects the relatively separate function of all facilities, but also embodies the application process of all equipments in different links in casualty field. The whole system has the advantages of safety and reliability, analog simulation, intelligible flowage structure, rationalization and accuracy and easy utilizing, thereby the investigation-procuratorate training proceeds with the state of substance and a platform is put up between the training and the practice.

title_en: Water-protection coal-mining method using structural key layer as waterproof layer
abstract_en: The water retention coal mining method utilizes a structural key layer being the aquiclude, covering the abilities of hydrogeological exploration, acquiring and modeling the relevant hydrogeological data about the strata, recognizing the structural key layer using mechanics analysis and numerical simulation and choosing the appropriate coal mining method and process parameters through existing conditions. While realizing the protective exploration of water resources, it can prevent water disaster inside the coal mine; Current techniques accumulated in the process of coal mining, like filling, slip casting, can realize reliable protection for structural key layers, based on the conditions of the mining area in selecting mining method, process, support and protective design to realized the final goal of aquiclude coal mining. It can both prevent the damage of water disasters both from the bottom plate and the top plate.

title_en: Natural disasters simulator for pit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a under-mine natural disaster simulation device. Currently, security education for workers through courses or video materials shows little efficiency to avoid under-mine disasters. The device arranges in underground or simulation roadways a disaster simulation device with electric controlled elements and a disaster information conveyor, which are linked to a remote control device. Mining security education is provided through the simulation device by using sound, light, electricity, water, smoke and light materials to inform workers of the whole procedure of disasters and accidents so as to rise people's security awareness and avoid disasters and accidents.

title_en: Debris flow disaster detector based on omnibearing visual range
abstract_en: The omnibearing debris flow disaster check device comprises the water level omnibearing visual sensor monitoring the slope to be checked and rain collector, microprocessor for disaster inspector through video signal, with the said onmibearing visual sensor installed on the top of the groove of the slope and its output connected with the microprocessor, the said rain collecting device composed of water container, tipping bucket with floating mark for showing the water level of the water container, the said microprocessor composed of visual sensor marking module, floating mark location sampling module, rain fall intelligent computation module, simulating debris flow rain intensity computation module, and debris flow pre warning module. It has high precision, sensitivity, low maintenance, reliability and long durability.

title_en: Statistical-deterministic approach to natural disaster prediction
abstract_en: A combined statistical-deterministic approach to methods and systems for assessing risk associated with natural disasters, in particular, hurricane wind risk. One example of a method of predicting wind speed distribution within a predetermined distance from a point of interest includes steps of statistically synthesizing a large plurality of wind storm tracks that pass within a predetermined radius of the point of interest, running a deterministic simulation of wind intensity along each one of the large plurality of wind storm tracks to produce an output representative of wind speed distribution along each track, and using the output to estimate an overall wind speed probability distribution from a combination of the wind speed distributions along each track within the predetermined distance from the point of interest.

title_en: Fire-proof self saving bag
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fireproof self-rescue package comprising a package body (1), in particular a self-rescue appliance location area (2) which is perpendicular to a bottom of the package body (1) and mounted in the package body (1), and at least an interlayer (3) is provided between the location area (2) and the package body (1). The utility model is characterized by convenience, utility, accuracy and the convenience to carry and deposit. Due to the centralized and location storage of facilities against fire hazards and every self-rescue facility is stored respectively in the appointed location area, the fireproof self-rescue package provides great convenience to a client when a fire hazard occurs without delaying the best self-rescue time because the client fails to find proper self-rescue facilities, even though the client can not see, the client can take out facilities fast and exactly, thereby achieving effective rescue effects. The self-rescue package can be utilized not only as a reserve lifesaving facility for households and working units, but also as a firefighting self-rescue training facility.

title_en: Anchor construction method
