abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently construct an anchor for disaster prevention (fall prevention) even in a stratum of loose density where its surface layer easily falls.  <P>SOLUTION: A downhole type excavating device comprises a moving mechanism (a frame, a guide rail and a moving body), an excavating motor provided at the moving mechanism, and a predetermined air hammer drill 6 connected to the excavating motor. In excavating the surface layer b using the downhole type excavating device, a predetermined casing 91 and a screw auger 92 disposed in the casing are connected to the excavating motor of the device to excavate, and when excavating down to a predetermined rock bed stratum, the screw auger 92 is removed while leaving the casing 91. The air hammer drill 6 is mounted to the excavating motor, and further a predetermined downhole means is used to continuously form an excavated hole B. A predetermined tendon C is inserted in the excavated hole B with the surface layer side protected by the casing, and cement milk D is injected to construct the anchor.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Estimating system for ventilation control on fire in a tunnel
title_ko: 터널 내 화재시 환기 제어 평가시스템
abstract_en: A system for evaluation ventilation control of a fire in a tunnel is provided to secure a threshold speed for preventing a back flow of hot air and smoke while securing guideline for evacuation at a initial fire occurring in a longitudinal ventilation tunnel by setting, simulating, and analyzing a fire scenario. The system comprises a central controller(110), fire detectors(100a-100n) linked with the central controller, jet fans(160a-160n), wind velocity sensor(170a-170n), and an alarm part(150). The central controller comprises a vehicle counting module(121), a wind velocity calculating module(123), a wind velocity controlling module(125), and an evacuation operating module(127). The wind velocity calculating module calculates the wind velocity in the tunnel by considering an input value for traffic flow and an operation state of the jet fans. The wind velocity controlling module performs fuzzy reasoning for keeping a target wind velocity by using the current wind velocity of the tunnel and a wind velocity change for a control cycle as control input, and computes a jet fan operation stage.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재시 환기 제어시스템에 관한 것으로 더욱 상세하게는 터널 내 화재시 터널 내의 제연계획에 따른 터널 내 화재시 환기 제어 평가시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 중앙제어부(110);와 이에 연동되는 화재감지부(100a 내지 100n);와 제트팬(160a 내지 160n);과 풍속센서(170a 내지 170n);와 DB(130);와 입출력부(140); 및 경고부(150)로 구성되며, 상기 중앙제어부(110)는 차량수 계산모듈(121), 풍속계산모듈(123), 풍속제어모듈(125) 및 환기시 운전모듈(127)로써 구성되는 터널 내 화재시 환기 제어 시스템을 제공한다. 
       
     화재, 환기, 터널, 알고리즘, 평가
assignees: SHIN HUNG INDUSTRY ACADEMY COO;BUMCHANG ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Estimating method of danger rate for a tunnel fire and estimating system thereof
title_ko: 터널화재 위험도의 예측방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A method and a system for estimating a danger level of a fire in a tunnel are provided to safely construct the tunnel by estimating the risk of the tunnel, as influence on an evacuated person by effect of toxic gas and heat environment in the tunnel fire is quantitatively estimated and displayed as an FED(Fractional Effect Dose) value. A data obtaining module obtains a tunnel fire scenario and data for estimating an accident rate according to the tunnel fire scenario. A congestion length/vehicle quantity analyzing module analyzes a congestion length and the number of vehicles in the tunnel when the fire occurs in the tunnel. An evacuation time measuring module measures evacuation time in evacuating the vehicle. A temperature/toxic gas measuring module measures temperature and a toxic gas concentration in the tunnel. An FED measuring module measures the FED value.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 터널 위험도의 예측방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 터널 화재발생 시나리오 및 이에 따른 사고발생율을 추정하기 위한 단계; 화재발생시 터널내 차량의 정체길이 및 차량수를 분석하는 단계; 차량내 대피자의 대피시간을 측정하는 단계; 터널내 온도 및 유해가스 농도를 측정하는 단계; 및 FED(fractional effective dose) 측정 단계를 포함하는, 터널화재 위험도의 예측방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다.  본 발명의 터널화재 위험도의 예측방법 및 시스템을 사용하면 다양한 터널의 위험도를 정량적으로 평가할 수 있으므로, 안전한 터널구축을 위한 공사 내지는 완공된 터널의 보완하는 활용될 수 있다. 
       
     터널 위험도, 터널화재, FED
assignees: SHIN HUNG INDUSTRY ACADEMY COO;BUMCHANG ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Flameless fire extinguisher training methods and apparatus
abstract_en: Methods and apparatus for use in fire extinguisher training are provided. These methods and apparatus are implemented electronically without the need for an open flame. The training apparatus includes a display having a plurality of light sources adapted to display a varying light pattern simulating a dynamic flame; a sensor adapted to detect a stimulus emitted by one of a fire extinguisher and a fire extinguisher simulator and output a signal corresponding to the detected stimulus; and one or more processors adapted to receive the output from the sensor and vary the light pattern simulating the dynamic flame on the display in response to the stimulus detected by the sensor. The methods and apparatus may be used to train firefighters in the proper use of a fire extinguisher, for example, training in the techniques typically required when suppressing class A, B, C, D, or K type fires.

title_en: Dispersion burner for firefighter training
abstract_en: A firefighting trainer includes a tank for containing a volume of a non-combustible dispersion medium such as water. The water resides within the tank having an upper surface of the water exposed through an open upper end of the tank. A fuel distribution system distributes a combustible fuel into the tank beneath the water surface. An air distribution system distributes an oxygen containing gas (such as air) into the tank beneath the upper water surface. An ignition system ignites a mixture of a vapor of the fuel and the air at the upper surface of the water. A screen covers the open end of the tank and is spaced from the upper surface of the water. The screen has open spaces permitting passage of flame through the screen.

title_en: Apparatus and method for supporting fire fighting spot
title_ko: 소방 현장 지원 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A fire fighting spot supporting device and a method thereof are provided to supply a proper escape way to fire fighters who get lost, by pursuing the positions of the fire fighters in real time, thereby reducing a loss of lives and effectively extinguishing a fire. A fire fighting spot supporting device is composed of a building modeling unit(142) three-dimensionally modeling the building on the basis of the information on the building where a fire breaks out; a sensor information obtaining unit(146) obtaining the information about sensors(102) installed in the building; a simulation unit(144) predicting the state of a fire on the basis of the modeling result and the sensor information; an escape way searching unit(160) searching an escape way on the basis of the modeling result, the sensor information, and the state of the fire; and an escape way guide unit providing information about the escape way to persons who are left in the building, through voice communication.
abstract_ko: 소방 현장 지원 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 이 장치는 화재가 발생한 건물의 건물 정보를 기초로, 상기 건물을 2/3차원으로 모델링하는 건물모델링부; 상기 건물에 설치된 센서에 대한 센서 정보를 획득하는 센서 정보 획득부; 상기 모델링된 결과 및 상기 획득된 센서 정보를 기초로 화재 진행 상태를 예측하는 시뮬레이션부; 및 상기 모델링된 결과, 상기 센서 정보 및 상기 예측된 화재 진행 상태를 기초로 탈출로를 검색하는 탈출로검색부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 화재를 효율적으로 진압할 수 있으며, 화재로 인한 인명 피해를 줄일 수 있다.

title_en: Developing web-based prototype system for disseminating flood prevention information publicly using gis
title_ko: 지아이에스를 이용한 홍수방재정보 제공시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for providing flooding prevention information using a GIS(Geographic Information System) are provided to offer the flooding information to residents and apply to the information for minimizing damage in disasters by constructing a database with rainfall/flooding data, and providing a simulation result and a hazard map representing flooding risk information. An operating/processing module(124) extracts and transmits property data related to geographic information to a client terminal by operating/controlling inquiring modules. A basic/theme map inquiring module(121) extracts the geometric information of a basic/theme map of the inquired area from a geography database. A basin measurement data property inquiring module(122) extracts basin measurement data from a property database. A flooding history inquiring module(123) extracts flooding history information of the area from the property database. A rainfall simulation information inquiring module(125) extracts rainfall simulation information of the area from the property database. A flooding simulation information inquiring module(126) extracts flooding simulation information of the area from the property database. A hazard map inquiring module(127) extracts the hazard map from the property database.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 GIS를 이용한 홍수방재정보 제공시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 대상지역의 기본적인 기본도 및 주제도 관련 데이터를 구축함으로서 지리정보를 속성정보에 반영 가능하게 되며, 다양한 오염원 데이터베이스를 구축함으로서 지역 오염원의 특성 분석이 가능하며 수질 관측 지점 현황 및 유량ㆍ수위 관측소 오염원 현황의 조회를 통해 지역의 수질 및 오염원ㆍ수위 등의 기본 정보를 취득할 수 있고, 강우 자료와 홍수 자료를 데이터베이스화하고 이를 모의한 결과는 물론 작성된 홍수 위험에 관한 정보를 나타내는 Hazard Map을 본 웹서비스를 통해 제공함으로서 홍수가 빈번한 지역의 주요시설 및 주택의 입지 조건을 고려하는 등의 토지이용 분야에 활용함은 물론 대상 지역 주민들의 홍수에 대한 정보 습득과 실제 재난시 피해 최소화를 위한 정보로 활용될 수 있도록 하는 GIS를 이용한 홍수방재정보 제공시스템 및 그 방법을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다. 
     본 발명을 적용하면, 대상지역의 기본도 및 주제도 구축, 대상지역의 다양한 오염원 데이터베이스 구축으로 홍수방재와 별도로 지역 오염원의 특성 분석이 가능하고, 과거 홍수실적정보와 강우모의 및 홍수모의자료를 통해 대상 지역에 홍수 발생 시 정보 취득이 용이하고 Hazard Map의 홍수위험지표와 위험수준을 고려하여 관리기관에서의 해당 지역 관리에 효율적으로 이용 가능하므로, 홍수방재 웹 시스템으로의 기능을 충실히 수행할 수 있는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Advanced augmented reality system and method for firefighter and first responder training
abstract_en: A method for using Augmented Reality (AR), in conjunction with a real or simulated thermal imager. A primary application is to train emergency first responders. Particularly, the system uses a thermal imaging camera (300 in Figure 17) or standard video camera, and tracking system to provide a tracked viewpoint in an AR environment. The augmented portions of the environment can consist of fire, smoke, extinguishing agent, or other emergencies. This allows for inexpensive, flexible, and realistic on-site training of fire fighting, damage control, search and rescue, and other first responder techniques using thermal imaging (380 in Figure 17).
assignees: INFORMATION DECISION TECHNOLOG;EBERSOLE JOHN F;HOBGOOD ANDREW W;EBERSOLE JOHN F JR

title_en: Exercise equipment for fat-control with low noise
title_ko: 저소음 체지방조절 운동기
abstract_en: An exercising device for fat-control with low noise is provided to make a vibration plate do a seesaw motion based on a support shaft coupling portion by using magnetic force to reduce the noise due to the operation of the device. An exercising device for fat-control with low noise includes a vibration plate(10), a support shaft, a base plate, a power device, and a housing(40). At least a couple of permanent magnets are fixed symmetrically on a lower part of right and left circumferential portions of the vibration plate, whose left and right sides vibrate vertically in a seesaw method. The support shaft is fixed, a couple of electromagnets are fixed to correspond to the permanent magnets of the vibration plate, and an elastic portion is fixed on the base plate. The elastic portion prevents the permanent magnets and the electromagnets from being in contact with each other by the seesaw vibration of the vibration plate.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자기력을 이용하여 시소방식으로 진동을 발생시켜 운동효과를 얻을 수 있도록 한 저소음 체지방조절 운동기에 관한 것으로서, 좌·우측 둘레부 하방에 한 쌍 이상의 영구자석이 좌·우 대칭되게 고정되어, 좌·우를 양분하는 지지축 결합부를 기준으로 좌·우측이 시소(seesaw)방식으로 상하 진동하는 진동플레이트; 상기 진동플레이트의 지지축 결합부에 결합되어 진동플레이트의 중심을 지지하는 지지축; 상기 지지축이 고정되고, 상기 진동플레이트의 영구자석과 대응되게 한 쌍 이상의 전자석이 고정되며, 상기 진동플레이트의 시소진동에 의하여 상기 영구자석과 전자석이 접촉하지 못하게 하면서 충격을 흡수하는 탄성부가 고정되는 베이스 플레이트; 상기 전자석에 교류전류를 공급하는 전원장치; 및 상기 지지축, 베이스플레이트 및 전원장치를 내포하는 하우징을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하여 구성되며, 소음으로 인한 폐해를 방지하고, 전체적으로 경량화하며, 마찰로 인한 내구성 악화문제를 해결하고, 전력소모량이 절감되며, 디자인이 자유롭고 제작이 간편한 저소음 체지방조절 운동기를 제공한다. 
       
     진동, 자기력, 진동플레이트, 체지방조절

title_en: Underground fire hazard virtual exercise visualized evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a underground conflagration virtual exercise visible assessment system in computer application technical domain, which is characterized by the following: comprising system management module, expert assessment module and data treating module; setting attribute of user with the system management module; proceeding meter with the expert assessing module through user information of the system management module; marking each assessing factor; submitting to the data treating module; treating the input in expert assessing module with the data treating module; applying fuzzing mathematics; constructing membership grade rectangular array; adopting layer comparative analysis method; resolving and judging rectangular array; proceeding consistency check; adopting defil expert method; treating multidigit of expert assessing result; getting the assessing result. This invention possesses the advantages of quantitative property, scientific property and objectivity, which can further improve underground conflagration emergency response ability.

title_en: Deep rock mass engineering project disaster model experiment method
abstract_en: The test technique of the geomechanics model the important way to research large-scale and complex rock-soil project and model testing technique can realize the real project situation. But at present, the testing periodic of the test technique of the geomechanics model is long, and when changing a kind of parameter each time, we must remake a model test. The model can not be reused, the fee is high, the testing technique is complex, and the research cost is large. This invention raises the conception of physical finite element board material, by the continuous or discontinuous symmetric load mean, according to the field complex geological conditions, adopting different finite element board combination to simulate the condition. After the damaging test, collecting the undamaged definite element material for the next reuse, at the same time, because the size of the element material is too small, it can simulate all kinds of different rock mass. This overcomes the defects of the long testing period and high cost.

title_en: Disaster recovery backup method and apparatus for mobile switching centre simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses mobile exchanging center emulating disaster tolerant back up method and device in CDMA2000 network. Two mobile exchanging centers emulating are connected with one attributive location register emulating, and respectively connected with many media gateways and many base station controllers. One of the two is the main using of which each chain is set as active state to finish each function. Another one is stood by of which each chain is opposite. If it checks out the main one has fault, it will exchange to be the new main. Thus the invention can increase system reliability and disaster tolerant emergency ability.

title_en: Method for realizing mobile terminal called when mobile switching center simulation is abnormal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing mobile terminal called when mobile switching center simulation is abnormal, which makes the mobile terminal below MSCe as called as soon as possible after a certain MSCe is out of order in MSCe disaster-tolerant backup mode, comprising:  detecting the running state of the primary MSCe at fixed time; (b) if the primary MSCe is abnormal, all the mobile terminals registered in the primary MSCe are changed to be registered in the standby MSCe. In the MSCe load sharing mode, after a certain MSCe fails, the mobile terminal below the MSCe is called as soon as possible, which comprises the following steps: (e) if the called party is an outgoing call, the home location register judges whether the MSCe is in failure before sending a routing request message to the MSCe to which the called mobile terminal belongs, if so, executes the next step, otherwise, continues the normal process; (f) the home location register selects the MSCe which normally runs to send the whole network paging message.

title_en: Method for realizing disaster tolerance by mobile switching center simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing disaster recovery by MSCe, which comprises the following steps: connecting a base station controller with a main MSCe and a standby MSCe; detecting whether the primary MSCe fails or not; and when the active MSCe fails, starting the standby MSCe, and switching to the standby MSCe to communicate with the base station controller. The method can realize the backup design of MSCe network element disaster tolerance and improve the network security.

title_en: Self-elevating drilling rig driller control redundant apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drill control redundancy device for self-elevating drilling platform, comprising a first console, a second console, a first PLC and a second PLC. The first console is connected with a PLC and the second PLC, the second console is also connected with the PLC and the second PLC, the fist PLC is connected with a drill equipment controlled by the first PLC, and the second PLC is connected with a pipe equipment controlled the second PLC. The utility model consists of two complete control systems, and the two control system can respectively operate the drilling equipment and the pipe equipment and can also operate opponent drilling equipment and pipe equipment mutually, etc. Therefore, when a control system fails, the other control system can complete temporary or emergency operation, thereby greatly improving the security of equipment control and emergency response capacity in the state of emergency and effectively avoiding equipment or personal injury.

title_en: Geological environment simulating experiment device
abstract_en: The invention provides a geologic environment simulation experiment device, which comprises a machine stand, a water storage tank, a simulation case with its lower reach end hinged with the machine stand, a rainfall case installed at the top of the machine stand, a geologic body simulation cavity in the simulation case, a water supply cavity and a water discharge cavity that are respectively positioned at the upper and lower reach ends of the geologic simulation cavity and are communicated to the geologic body simulation case, a conatant head water level overflow case and a discharge overflow case that are respectively positioned at the external side end of the upper and lower reaches of the simulation case, a conatant head overflow cavity that are respectively communicated to the water storage tank and the water supply cavity via a pipeline and a conatant head overflow backwater cavity that is communicated to the water storage tank via an overflow backwater pipe are positioned in the conatant head water level overflow case; at least three groups of piezometer are mounted vertically on the wall of the simulation cavity; one end of a piezometer hose that is communicated to the bottom of the piezometer passes the a simulation wall and extends into the simulation cavity. Therefore, the invention is able to simulate the formation and control of geologic disaster as well as the rules for the motion of groundwater.

title_en: Evacuation simulation device and method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation simulation device and method capable of selecting an evacuation route for each evacuee.  <P>SOLUTION: An evacuation simulation device 1 predicts a spreading state of harmful materials within a specific area and selects an evacuation route on the basis of the prediction result. The evacuation simulation device 1 includes: a position information database 6 wherein position information of evacuees being within the specific area is stored; an evacuation route database 5 wherein a plurality of evacuation routes within the specific area are stored; and an evacuation route selection part 12 which selects an evacuation route of each evacuee on the basis of position information of respective evacuees stored in the position information database 6 and evacuation routes stored in the evacuation route database 5.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Buoyancy swimming suit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a floatage swimsuit which comprises sleeve bodies and a gasbag, wherein the back between the two sleeve bodies is provided with a sleeve body connecting piece, and the front thereof is provided with frenulums, which is designed into a caliper connected back structure; the gasbag is packaged around the outside of the sleeve bodies, which is in the shape of selenodont, and the gasbag is provided with a gas valve. The utility model has reasonable designed structure, is comfortable to wear, is suitable for various kinds of thrash actions, in particularly to swim novices and long time sports people in water, and can be used for military trainings on water, the military swimming, emergency service and disaster relief and the like. When in use, the gasbag is filled with gas, both arms are sleeved in the sleeve bodies and the sleeve body connecting piece is arranged on the back, and the frenulums are fastened, then offal begins. The utility model is an ideal swimming apparatus, and has a wide market outlook.

title_en: Small-sized fire-fighting propagation car
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a miniature firefighting propagandizing vehicle, which comprises a driver cab, a chassis and a car body with a LED screen, the car body is fixed on the chassis. The utility model is characterized in that the LED screen is arranged on the top of the car body; a computer interactively simulates with a 119 alarm device, a firefight knowledge inquiry device, a control cabinet, a multimedia display window, a circuit overload short circuit experiment platform and a data box arranged on the one side face of the car body through a language recognition; a water hose box, a generator, a cooking fire rescue condition, a liquid crystal television and a spray system, a dousing tank and a spray nozzle demonstration are arranged on the other side face of the car body from left to right in sequence; a folding prompt drop rescue training rack is arranged on the top face of the car body. The utility model has the advantages of good propagandizing effect, flexibility, interest and fairly strong participation, thereby strengthening the propagandizing effect of firefighting knowledge and stimulating the participation passion of a participator, enhancing the understand of the participator to the firefighting knowledge  and improving the firefighting consciousness , integrating various propagandizing ways  as a whole, improving the broadness and the depth of the firefighting propagation obviously  .

title_en: Fire vortex experimental facility
abstract_en: The present invention belongs to the technical field of the fire safety, in particular to a simulating experiment device for inflammation in a disaster. The device consists of a smoke exhaust pipeline, flaming cells, a fuel feeding system and a control system, wherein, the smoke exhaust pipeline comprises a rectangular column shaped casing, which is closely integrated to a base seat to form a rectangular column shaped inner space; the middle of the top has the smoke exhaust pipeline; a lateral wall of the inner space is provided with an air inlet which can be opened or closed; with being respectively arranged on four slider blocks, the flaming cells contact closely by twos when the slider blocks move inwards; the fuel feeding system consists of a fuel container arranged out of the casing and a hosepipe connected with the casing; the control system consists of a single-chip microcomputer and the operation system thereof controlling the feeding of the fuel, the moving of the flaming cells and the switching of an ignition device. In the experiment device, the four flaming cells of the same size are arranged on a plane and can be controlled to move flexibly to form a large flaming cell, therefore, the conditions and the rules for forming fire whirlwinds by flames in a plurality of small flaming cells can be studied, and the fire whirlwind experiment of a single large flaming cell can also be performed.

title_en: Apparatus of training for fire fighting
title_ko: 소방훈련장치
abstract_en: A fire fighting training apparatus is provided to perform training of fire fighting regardless of the place limit by letting persons experience fire fighting trainings for spraying smog by a training fire extinguisher and irradiating an optical signal on the object. A fire fighting simulator comprises plural flat plates(3~5) installed at regular intervals to form plural ventilating paths; plural flame printed cloths(6~8) installed at the ventilating paths between the flat plates, respectively and formed correspondently to the size of flames; a fixing device(12~14) fixing plural flame printed cloths at the ventilating paths; plural shut-off valves(15,16) for opening or closing plural ventilating paths; a blower(31) blowing the air to plural ventilating paths in simulating a fire; and a controller executing a fire simulation by selectively controlling plural shut-off valves correspondently to extinguishment of a fire and generating flames getting smaller according to the extinguishment of a fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방훈련장치에 관한 것으로, 소방 시뮬레이터는 소정 간격으로 설치되어 다수의 송풍로를 형성하는 다수의 평판; 상기 평판 사이의 송풍로에 각각 설치되며, 다수의 불꽃 크기에 각각 대응되는 다수의 불꽃 인쇄천; 상기 다수의 불꽃 인쇄천을 상기 송풍로에 고정하는 고정장치; 상기 다수의 송풍로를 개방 또는 폐쇄하는 다수의 차단밸브; 상기 화재 시뮬레이트시에 상기 다수의 송풍로로 송풍하는 송풍장치; 상기 화재 진화에 대응되게 상기 다수의 차단밸브를 선택적으로 제어하여, 다양한 크기의 불꽃을 시뮬레이팅하는 제어장치로 구성된다. 상기한 본 발명은 소방 훈련을 위해 시뮬레이팅하는 불꽃을 사실적으로 표시하여 소화 훈련자의 소화 욕구 및 성취감을 충족시켜 줄 수 있는 효과가 있다.  
       
     소방훈련장치, 소화

title_en: Communication apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underground communication device, wherein an explosion prevention telephone is arranged at any position inside an underground totally enclosed rescue capsule; a telephone line passes through the drill hole arranged inside the rescue capsule to connects with the outside; moreover, the telephone line is buried under the ground and is connected with a controller arranged inside a mine. When a mine disaster (such as gas explosion, mine flooding and roof fall) occurs, refugees inside the rescue capsule can contact with the outside through the telephone for quick search and rescue.

title_en: Underground heat accumulation system for utilizing season energy serving as emergency water source
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an underground heat accumulation system for air conditioning waste heat, as effective utilization of season energy.  <P>SOLUTION: In this system, a space between a ground surface and 1m of depth therefrom is used as an insulating layer, a soil deeper than the insulating layer is used as a heat accumulation vessel, underground water spray piles are drilled in distributedly to be opened toward four sides in an underground within a heat accumulation range thereof, a well pile assembled with a heat exchanger for the air conditioning waste heat is provided in the central lower part thereof, and a water pipe is provided via a well pump in a midway. Water of a heat transfer medium is heat-exchanged with an air-conditioning waste heat coil provided in a hollow part of the well pile, and is pressure-injected in the spray pile by the well pump. The water fills the soil with saturated water by osmotic pressure, a circulation passage of the water is formed in the soil by a synergetic effect of natural flow-down and suction by the well pile, and heat is transferred into the soil. A storage for a long period is possible together with a large capacity of efficient heat accumulation, natural energy is utilized ideally to use hot waste heat in a summer for heating in a winter and to use cold waste heat in a winter for cooling in a summer. A function as an emergency water source is provided in a disaster, because the soil is filled with the saturated water.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Burn building for training firefighters
abstract_en: A burn building for training firefighters includes a burn room with a ceiling and at least one building entry into the burn room. The burn room has at least one exterior wall where a heat generation unit is mounted, and the heat generation unit is directed into the burn room. A barrier panel in the burn room permits exposing and covering the heat generation unit. The barrier panel is raised and lowered by air operated pistons and cylinders. The heat generation unit is operated from a control panel. A rack is suspended from the ceiling to hold wood pallets which generate smoke when heated to combustion temperature. A light is located at the building entry to indicate when to enter the burn building and the burn room.

title_en: Method to prepare emergency staff
abstract_en: The present invention is a method to teach emergency personal to be prepared when a disaster occurs. The present invention relates to a set of cards worn by a test victim to simulate real injures from a simulated disaster, emergency personal read the set of cards to make sure that they react and act appropriately to treat the simulated victim.

title_en: Self-dumping cone type spiral anchor drill bit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pore-forming equipment of anchor for the foundation pit support, slope support and geological disaster management in the civil engineering construction, in particular to a self-unloading spiral anchor bit comprising a bit and a drill rod. One end of the bit is provided with a conoid guider. On the external circumference surface of the other end of the bit linked with the drill rod, a plurality of splines is in uniform distribution. The bit on one side of the splines is jacketed with an anchor backing plate provided with a strand. On the bit between the anchor backing plate and the splines, a stator is connected and fixed, in which the outer diameter is smaller than that of the anchor backing plate and larger than the inner diameter of the anchor backing plate for the spacing of the anchor backing plate. The strand is in fixed connection on the anchor backing plate through an extruding anchor. The rear end of the bit of the utility model, in which a spline is adopted, is in inserted connection with a key way of the front end of the drill rod through the detachable method. The bit and the drill rod can be freely disassembled. After the pore is formed, the anchor is disposed in the formation along with the bit, and the drill rod can be easily pulled out for the reuse. Therefore, the cost is reduced while the work efficiency is also improved with the streamlining of the construction process.

title_en: Large fire control advertisement car
abstract_en: A large firefighting propaganda car comprises a driving room, a chassis and a carriage which is fixedly mounted on the chassis, characterized in that the carriage is divided into two floors on the limit of 1.6 meters, the upper floor is further divided into a front carriage room and a back carriage room, the two sides of the carriage are respectively provided with a smoke propagation model, a multimedia player, an air pump, a comprehensive inquiring device for firefighting knowledge, a   fire-escaping game of high-rise building, an experiencing device for 119 alarm, a demonstration  platform for kitchen fire, a deflagration test box for fuel, and a sprinkler for electrical fire, the inner potion of the carriage is provided with a locker of a firefighting tent for escaping, a  demonstration experiment platform for the fire caused by cigarette ends, a demonstration experiment platform for the fire caused by electrical appliances, a hose cabinet, a large-screen simulator for extinguishing fire and a staircase which is used to climb a large-screen platform for extinguishing fire. The large firefighting propaganda car strengthens the advertising effect of firefighting knowledge as well as stimulates the participation enthusiasm of participants by attractive participating projects, enhances understanding of firefighting knowledge and increases fire-fighting awareness for participants, integrates various methods for propaganda, thereby obviously improving the strength and depth of fire control propaganda.

title_en: Dry machine for waterproof clothes and rain shoes of fireman
title_ko: 소방관 방화방수복, 방수화 건조기
abstract_en: An Apparatus for drying a fire protection/waterproof clothes and a waterproof shoes for a fire fighter is provided to improve drying efficiency and to discharge moisture from the clothes to the external by installing an upper and a lower maintaining stand for allowing hot air to be supplied to an internal part of the waterproof clothes and forming a discharge port at a rack. An apparatus for drying fire protection/waterproof clothes and waterproof shoes for fire fighters comprises a bottom surface(500), an upper and a lower rack(100,200), an upper and a lower maintaining stand(110,210), and a waterproof shoes/gloves racks(300,400). The bottom surface allows hot air to be supplied from a hot air blowing fan(1) to an internal of a dryer(3) through hot air supplying holes(510). The upper and the lower racks are fixed to a rack(50) place at the interior part of the dryer with regular intervals. An upper and a lower hot air supplying pipe(120,220) are connected with the hot air blowing fan placed at the lower part of the upper and the lower racks. The upper and the lower maintaining stands are connected with the upper and the lower hot air supplying pipes, wherein a plurality of hot air supplying holes are drilled to allow hot air to be supplied. A tongue is standing on the bottom surface. A plurality of discharging pipes(320) are formed at the tongue. The discharging pipes are connected with a discharging fan(70) via a discharging port drilled at the tongue.

title_en: Subway station and tunnel fire disaster prevention system capable of guiding passengers emergency exit
title_ko: 승객 대피경로 안내기능을 갖는 지하철 역사 및 터널화재방재 시스템
abstract_en: A subway station and a tunnel fire disaster prevention system having a passenger emergency exit guide function are provided to minimize the choke of passengers in a tunnel by removing smoke and choking gas caused by a fire in the tunnel. A tunnel fire disaster prevention system having a passenger emergency exit guide function includes a central processing unit(210), a data storage unit(220), a data communication unit(230) and a display unit(240). The central processing unit(210) calculates a smoke prediction path, a passenger exit and a smoke ejection path when a fire occurs in a tunnel, and controls the operation of a ventilator and fire-fighting equipment according to the passenger exit and the smoke ejection path. The data storage unit(220) stores the data processed in the central processing unit(210). The data communication unit(230) transmits and receives data between the tunnel fire disaster prevention system, and a power facility, a signal facility, a communication facility, the ventilator, and the fire-fighting equipment. The display unit(240) displays the state of various facilities installed in the tunnel.

title_en: Fast pipe joining apparatus with pressure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a device which can fast connect pipes and is provided with an mp fast. The device comprises a handwheel, a shaft, a lead screw, a ratchet, a moving bar, a lock cover, a gate valve, a thread head, a catch hoop, a bolt, a cushion, a bit, a transmission shaft, a connecting sleeve, a locknut and a stent. The handwheel is arranged at the top of the stent and connected with the shaft; the shaft is connected with the lead screw and the lead screw is connected with the ratchet provided with the moving rod; one end of the transmission shaft is installed on the bit through the connecting sleeve, the gate valve, the thread head and the catch hoop and the other end on the locknut; the connecting sleeve is connected with the ratchet. The utility model has simple structure and reasonable design; ventilation fan, gas, fuel, water and power do not need cutting off and pressure pipe connecting can be finished fast at any part of the pipe; the utility model has fast speed of pipe connecting and hole drilling, large drilling aperture, high working efficiency, small volume and convenient carrying during underground disaster relief.

title_en: A flood submerging analysis method oriented to a large city disaster demonstration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood-waterlog analysis method for the disaster display in the megalopolis. The method includes the specific steps that a researched flooding area is determined; firstly, a largest possible flooding range is determined, two banks of a river are divided into a left half and a right half for treatment, and the border close to the river is treated as a water inflowing border of the flooding area; secondly, according to the DEM data with the ratio of 1/10000 provided by the State Topographic Administration, the largest possible flooding range is cut out to obtain an area that is the range for the flood analysis research; a required grid model is generated; a floodwater inundation communication algorithm adopts a filling algorithm having seed points. The invention has the advantages that the characteristics of the flood inundation are consistent to the size distribution characteristics of the grid, so adopting the grid can better simulate the inundation characteristics of the flood; a triangle grid model and a polylateral grid model are adopted to better simulate the irregular border.

title_en: Modular building for deployment in disaster regions
abstract_en: A modular building structure is provided. The building structure has a support framework comprising a pair of longitudinally extending beams, a plurality of vertically and transversely extending identical arched ribs spaced apart from one another, a plurality of level one joists coupled at each transverse end to one of the ribs and one of the beams, a plurality of level two joists coupled at each transverse end to one of the ribs at a location above the level one joists, and a plurality of longitudinally extending hat bars coupled to the transverse insides of all of the arched ribs. The hat bars may have a generally trapezoidal cross-section. The beams, arched ribs, level one joists, level two joists, and hat bars are preformed and provided with pre-drilled holes for coupling to other components of the support framework. Methods and kits for building a modular building structure are also provided.

title_en: Salvage vehicle in underground
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an underground safe life-saving device of a mine, namely an underground salvage vehicle, which comprises a closed vehicle casing, wherein the bottom of the vehicle casing is provided with mine car wheels, the front end and the rear end of the car casing are both provided with rotatable conical drilling head, and a hydraulic leg for bidirectional drive which is slanted on the ground is arranged on the bottom portion of the vehicle casing. The conical drilling head is driven to work by an explosion-proof motor in the vehicle casing. The conical drilling head comprises a movable column leg and a hydraulic cylinder, which is controlled by a hydraulic system in the vehicle casing. When the underground salvage vehicle is working, the down-hole salvage vehicle is carried and placed on the front track of a down-hole collapse tunnel, and can walk depending on the hydraulic leg pressing in an inclined direction on the track sleeper, the underground salvage vehicle opens tunnel through drilling the conical drilling head into the collapse tunnel, thereby the down-hole salvage vehicle can pass through water or a collapse tunnel, carry wreckers and return, and the down-hole salvage vehicle realizes salvage through shuttling in the tunnel. The utility model has the advantages of high rescue efficiency, which reduces the loss of mine disaster.

title_en: Method and apparatus to facilitate multi-setting virtual reality experiences
abstract_en: When providing (101) a user a first interactive virtual reality experience via a first virtual setting and upon detecting (102) a need to transition the user to a second interactive virtual reality experience via a second virtual setting (that is different from the first virtual setting), one maintains (103) a reduced presence of the user in the first virtual setting and establishes (104) a full presence of the user in the second virtual setting. By one approach, these virtual settings can comprise, for example, virtual rooms such as, but not limited to, virtual incident command centers to facilitate the handling of public safety services of various kinds and types.

title_en: Frictional heating vacuum-bottle
title_ko: 마찰가열식 보온병
abstract_en: A frictional heating vacuum-bottle is provided to boil water or liquid inside a container by installing a heating element bundle assembled to the lower part of the vacuum bottle to generate heat. A frictional heating vacuum-bottle comprises a vacuum bottle(1), a cap bundle(2), and a heating element bundle(3) assembled to the lower part of the vacuum bottle to generate heat. The vacuum bottle consists of an inner container, an outer container, and a bottom container. The inner container has a cap bundle assembling hole and a cap bundle assembling screw for assembling the cap bundle at the upper part, and a heating element bundle assembling hole and a heating element bundle assembling screw at the lower part, to minimize the transmission of heat by vacuuming an inner space of a dual container formed by the inner and outer containers. The bottom container has three supporting holes to stand the heating element bundle at the lower part stably. The heating element bundle includes a heating element having a recessed part, a screw, a lower o-ring, and a thermometer assembling hole. The heating element inserted into the heating element bundle assembling hole has the recessed part to maximize the transmitting efficiency of heat, the screw for assembling the vacuum bottle, the lower o-ring for shielding water, and the thermometer assembling hole for inserting a bourdon thermometer.

title_en: Emergency consequence assessment tool and method
abstract_en: The Emergency Consequence Assessment Tool (ECAT) is an interactive web-based software tool. ECAT is designed to meet the challenge of assessing health risks and determining what actions need to be taken during a crisis caused by a terrorist attack or natural disaster. ECAT provides instant access to key information and allows its users to conduct rapid analyses. The tool also provides a holistic approach to rapid risk assessment by integrating critical information across many diverse scientific disciplines and is a useful training tool. ECAT allows its users to conduct health risk assessment, risk management, and risk communication. It allows users not only to define the health threats, but also to determine what actions need to be taken to protect the public and first responders, and how best to communicate this information to the public. It evaluates the risks from chemical and biological agents in multiple environments, such as indoors, outdoors and from water contact, including ingestion, inhalation, and dermal exposure. Further, ECAT has the potential to quantify risks to different human subpopulations.

title_en: Target apparatus for simulation fire-extinguishing drill
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To apply an original idea to a control means and a simulation fire point which is a water discharge target of a trainee, more particularly to form the simulation fire point to a plurality of electric drawing images consisting of a central point of the target and peripheral parts and to appropriately subject the divided images to flickering control to enhance the presence feel as a fire scene, and to achieve an improvement in terms of firefighting techniques, such as a water application position, range and time.  <P>SOLUTION: The simulation fire point which is the water discharge target of the trainee is displayed by the electric drawing images. The electric drawing images are divided to the plurality of the center of the target and the peripheral parts thereof. In addition, the target apparatus is equipped with a lighting device to discretely light and to turn off the light of the simulation fire points divided to the plurality, and a water reception sensor having a function to operate by receiving the water discharge from a fire extinguisher for training and to turn off the lighting device under the prescribed conditions.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Interphone system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To perform external input batch broadcasting on the basis of a start signal simulating a control signal transmitted/received from source equipment of batch broadcasting source to destination equipment of batch broadcasting, constituting an interphone system.  <P>SOLUTION: When an audio signal S5 for external input batch broadcasting is externally inputted to an external input section 40 of an external input adapter 4 via an external network 5 with disaster information about, for example, earthquake, tsunami, pyroclastic stream or the like, an adapter CPU 42 that detects the external input controls an audio conversion section 41 to generate an audio signal S5a resulting from converting an audio level of the audio signal externally inputted to the external input section into an audio level required for external input batch broadcasting and can generate a start signal S6, for external input batch broadcasting, simulating a control signal S1 transmitted from a control-room master unit 2 to a controller 6, and it becomes unnecessary for a controller CPU 60 of the controller to recognize that the start signal is a signal from the adapter CPU of the external input adapter.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System, method, and computer-accessible medium for providing a multi-objective evolutionary optimization of agent-based models
abstract_en: Agent-based models (ABMs)/multi-agent systems (MASs) are one of the most widely used modeling-simulation-analysis approaches for understanding the dynamical behavior of complex systems. These models can be often characterized by several parameters with nonlinear interactions which together determine the global system dynamics, usually measured by different conflicting criteria. One problem that can emerge is that of tuning the controllable system parameters at the local level, in order to reach some desirable global behavior. According to one exemplary embodiment t of the present invention, the tuning of an ABM for emergency response planning can be cast as a multi-objective optimization problem (MOOP). Further, the use of multi-objective evolutionary algorithms (MOEAs) and procedures for exploration and optimization of the resultant search space can be utilized. It is possible to employ conventional MOEAs, e.g., the Nondominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) and the Pareto Archived Evolution Strategy (PAES), and their performance can be tested for different pairs of objectives for plan evaluation. In the experimental results, the approximate Pareto front of the non-dominated solutions is effectively obtained. Further, a conflict between the proposed objectives can be seen. Additional robustness analysis may be performed to assist policy-makers in selecting a plan according to higher-level information or criteria which is likely not present in the original problem description.

title_en: System and method for disaster training, simulation, and response
abstract_en: A system for conducting simulations of disaster and hazardous incident responses to assist in the organization, planning, and testing of the response of healthcare and other institutions to such incidents. A series of modules are used to enter personnel resource information into the system, design and create disaster and hazardous incident scenarios, assign personnel to incident command system (ICS) roles, and conduct a simulation with said personnel taking appropriate responsive actions. Personnel may interface with the system through a program creating a dashboard interface. Personnel can access an ICS organization chart, and use it to initiate messages and communications, conduct meetings, take actions, and assign subordinate positions. Personnel can view the status of the response actions in real-time. Standard and custom reports can be created and viewed. The system also can be used to respond to a real incident using the same interface and methods practiced in the simulation.

title_en: Corresponding behavior prediction system and corresponding behavior prediction method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To quickly and accurately execute necessary corresponding behavior in the case of emergency such as a disaster or in the case of training supposing emergency.  <P>SOLUTION: This corresponding behavior prediction system is provided with: a correlation analyzing means 1 for performing the correlation analysis of a notification sentence 5 with a corresponding behavior corresponding to the notification sentence 5; a correlation database 2 acquired by integrating the analysis result of the correlation analyzing means 1 into a database; and a correlation reference means 3 for predicting a corresponding behavior by referring to the correlation database 2 and the new notification sentence 7. The correlation analysis means 1 divides the notification sentence 5 into classes, and defines unique attributes to set up ontology. The attributes includes a keyword group showing the transmitter and receiver of the notification sentence, the corresponding behavior, the candidate of the corresponding behavior, and the correlation of the notification sentence and the corresponding behavior.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System and method for realizing disaster tolerance between SIP servers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system used to realize disaster recovery between SIP servers. The system comprises a third party MSCe SIP server and at least two MSCe SIP servers, wherein MSCe SIP servers in use status and standby status determine whether the current MSCe SIP server is in use status or standby status by means of an SIP OPTIONS method handshake detection mechanism; the MSCe SIP server in use status starts an IP link connected with the third party MSCe SIP server and ensures an accessible link; the MSCe SIP server in standby status closes an IP link connected with the third party MSCe SIP server and ensures an inaccessible link. The invention also discloses a method used to realize disaster recovery between SIP servers. The system and the method, which realize the accessible control and the inaccessible control of a route, ensure that a third party mobile switching center simulated MSCe SIP server maintains transparent without the necessary of seeing the change process of disaster recovery.

title_en: Drilling and cutting device for succor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue drilling and slitting machine, which is composed of a rescue impact drill and a rescue slitting saw. A power supply adopts high power lithium batteries respectively installed inside two battery cases parallel to and vertical to a saw arbor centerline. A high-efficient direct current permanent magnet motor adopts ferrite, rare earth neodymium-iron-boron as permanent-magnet material. The voltage is 6-50V, and the power is 60-200W. A plastic water bottle, a plastic hose and hose tie-ins are installed on the shell body of the circular saw type rescue drilling and slitting saw, and water passages are installed at the center of a saw arbor so as to sprinkle water for a circular saw blade which can be made of soft low-carbon steel plate, the diameter of which is 100-350mm. The rescue drilling and slitting machine can be applied to disaster accidents lacking electricity and fresh water to be used as a rescue tool for drilling and slitting.

title_en: Analog skin sensor for fire disaster emergency protective garment test and test approach thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a skin simulation sensor used for testing special clothes, in particular to a skin simulation sensor used for testing a fire emergency protective suit and a test method thereof, wherein, artificial glass crystals with similar attributes as the skin of the human body are adopted for preparing the skin simulation sensor; a rectangular groove is arranged on the surface of the skin simulation sensor; a T-shaped thermocouple is arranged inside the rectangular groove; a connecting wire of the thermocouple passes through a simulator along the normal direction and then accesses a converter; the measuring end of the thermocouple is glued to the surface of the simulator by utilization of epoxy resin adhesives; the converter is a PCI-MIO-16E-1 data acquisition card (DAQ); a temperature analogue signal which is acquired by the thermocouple is converted into a standard signal by the PCI-MIO-16E-1 data acquisition card (DAQ) and then inputted into a computer. The skin simulation sensor has the advantages of long experimental heat-resisting time, wide range, thermal attributes which are similar to the skin attributes of the human body, and achievement of simulating the heat absorption effect of the skin of the human body.

title_en: Flame proof systematization design method based on monolithic heavy sectional steel structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flameproof systemized design method for a whole-based large-scale steel structure in the civil construction engineering technical field, comprising the following steps that: a safe target and a performance index are set; the number of dangerous fire sources and the fire load of various danger areas are calculated, and fire work conditions are designed according to the number of the dangerous fire sources and the fire load of various danger areas; a geometric model is established in simulation software according to the designed fire work conditions, and the mechanical state of a structural system under the condition of real fire disaster is obtained through numerical simulation; judgment is made according to the numerical simulation result; if the structure fails, the structural design is readjusted and flameproof protection is strengthened; simultaneously, a fire scene is adjusted according to a novel design for design until the whole structure does not fail again; key structural members or the danger areas under all the fire work conditions are identified by adoption of the double control method of stress distinguish and deformation distinguish, and examination is made whether stress and deformation meet the requirements of the safe performance index. The flameproof systemized design method can accurately reflect real stress states of various structural members in the whole structure under natural fire disaster.

title_en: Disaster tolerance rehearsal method, device and server
abstract_en: The embodiment discloses a method for exercising disaster recovery, which comprises the steps that: a disaster recovery machine sends a bit stream request instruction to a generator for asking for obtaining a bit stream of a real call, wherein, the bit stream comprises service call bit stream and an intelligent network signaling used for starting a disaster recovery exercise; after receiving the bit stream, the disaster recovery machine establishes a simulation call and produces a simulation call record of the simulation call; a real call record of the call is obtained from the generator, a comparison between the real call record and the simulation call record is carried out to determine whether the contents thereof are identical, so as to test and verify whether the disaster recovery machine is normal or not. Besides, the embodiment also discloses a disaster recovery machine used for exercising disaster recovery and a generator that can exercise disaster recovery. When starting a disaster recovery exercise, the embodiment does not need an SSP to transmit the intelligent network signaling to the disaster recovery machine, while the disaster recovery machine directly obtains the intelligent network signaling from the generator; therefore, the disaster recovery exercise does not influence the service process of the generator.

title_en: Disaster prevention system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster prevention system for enabling a user to link respective display changes obtained by assuming real fires to confirm the real fires by making simulation of a CRT device cooperate with simulation of a fire receiver.  <P>SOLUTION: The CRT device displays a top view of each floor of a building at which symbols of terminal devices are arranged, changes a display form of a symbol of a terminal device whose state is changed by simulation, also changes the display form of a symbol on the basis of a state information received from a fire receiver, and meanwhile, the fire receiver performs display corresponding to the simulation received from the CRT device.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Analog demonstration instrument of earthquake instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seismograph simulating demonstration instrument, which comprises a tube body, a carved dragon, a movable dragon mouth, a steel ball, a toad, a base seat, a connecting bar and a footplate. The upper end of the connecting bar is connected with the dragon mouth, and the lower end of the connecting bar is connected with the footplate. When the instrument is used, the audience steps on the footplate, then the steel ball borne in the dragon mouth can drop into the toad, after the seismograph feeling the existence of earthquake, the working process can be demonstrated intuitively and clearly, thus the instrument is not only advantageous to the seismograph knowledge education and science popularizing promotion, but also advantageous to the shockproof and disaster reducing knowledge publicizing and popularization and the improving of the shockproof and disaster reducing consciousness of the general public.

title_en: Analog demonstration instrument for internal structure of earthquake instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulating demonstration instrument of the seismograph internal structure, which consists of a supporting frame, a movable dragon mouth, a steel ball, a toad and a swing mechanism. The movable dragon mouth is arranged on the outer side wall of the supporting frame, the toad corresponds with the movable dragon mouth vertically, the swing mechanism is arranged in the supporting frame, and the inside end of the movable dragon mouth is arranged at the close periphery of the swing mechanism. Through the demonstration instrument, and under the participation and simple operation of the audience, the internal structure of the seismograph and the working process after the earthquake existing is felt by the seismograph can be demonstrated intuitively and clearly, thus the instrument is not only advantageous to the seismograph knowledge education and science popularizing promotion, but also advantageous to the shockproof and disaster reducing knowledge publicizing and popularization and the improving of the shockproof and disaster reducing consciousness of the general public.

title_en: Method and device for detecting sand burst leaking destructive performance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detecting method and the device for the destructiveness of sandy soil infiltration collapse, the method comprises the following steps: collecting soil sample to be detected, adopting drilling and sampler for the deep part soil sample; determining the corresponding density and hydraulic slope the sample according to the actually measured head and density of the sampling spot; putting the sample into a bowl whose outlet is funnel shaped, the infiltration collapse sheet of infiltration collapse hole is arranged at the bottom of the funnel, determining the relation between the fluid flow which passes through the funnel and time under the effect of a certain head, and drawing the curve. In the determining process, switching gaskets with different infiltration collapse aperture, when determining according to one gasket with certain aperture, all the sand soil water flow out, which is called the critical point of the infiltration collapse destructiveness, the aperture is ''infiltration collapse destructiveness''; when determining according to one gasket with certain aperture, a part of the sand soil water flow out and stop, which is called the critical point of the infiltration collapse natural cure, the aperture is ''infiltration collapse natural cure aperture''. Adopting the method and combining other criteria geotechnical test, the index parameters ''infiltration collapse destructiveness aperture'' and ''infiltration collapse natural cure aperture'' for appraising the destructiveness of sandy soil infiltration collapse are can be got; the two index parameters can act as the critical parameters for appraising the fatalness of sand soil crushing into mine, which conduces to prevent the security disasters such as sand collapse and water collapse.

title_en: Friction heating element
title_ko: 마찰발열체
abstract_en: A heating device utilizing friction heat is provided to boil water for ramen noodles, coffee, survival food, and emergency food and to warm a human body with maximizing heat generated by friction of materials and using the heating element repeatedly enough for being used numerous times. A heating device utilizing friction heat includes a cylindrical container(1) having various parts assembled in the bottom part of the container to generate heat by friction, a cap(2) for preventing dust from entering the container and preventing heat dissipation from the container, a groove for installing a thermometer to check the heat generated by friction, a thermometer, and a protective cover(9) for protecting the thermometer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 물체의 마찰시 발생하는 열을 이용하여 물을 뜨겁게 함으로서 컵라면, 커피, 군용식량, 비상식량 등의 음식물을 데워 먹거나 체온을 덥히는 용도로 사용할 수 있는 응급편의장치로서 등산이나 야외활동에서 다목적으로 활용될 수가 있으며 재해, 재난, 군사훈련, 비상훈련 등의 특수 상황에서도 소중한 인명을 연장할 수 있는 마찰발열체에 관한 기술이다.

title_en: Linear temperature-sensing fire disaster detector in multiple tube type
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multi-circuit tube linear temperature sensitive fire detector which is characterized in that a detection loop is connected with a collecting block by a universal joint; the two public ends of the collecting block are respectively connected with the input ends of a metal air pump and a pressure sensor; the other end of the pressure sensor is connected with a reference chamber; the pressure sensor is connected with a CPU by a first circuit; the CPU is connected with the output terminal of a multi-circuit signal by a third circuit; the CPU is connected with a linear stepless micro-motor by a second circuit; a pressure simulation generator and the collecting block are arranged on a mounting plate; the mounting plate is fixed in a box body; the utility model can detect the abnormal temperature monitoring and automatic fire-extinguishing system interlocking caused by the reasons of overheating, light and self-ignition of various working devices or matters under a severe atmosphere in an early period; the alarming temperature, the temperature rising speed and the flexibility of the utility model can be adjusted; the load of engineering devices is reduced; while the protection area is increased; the utility model not only saves the device investment, but also saves the manual mounting cost greatly.

title_en: Elevator simulator device and elevator simulation system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve a problem that a user utilizing an elevator cannot deepen an understanding regarding a function and the safety of the elevator, in a conventional lifter disaster simulator and an attraction device.  <P>SOLUTION: An elevator simulator experienced person B gets on a box body 1 directing a virtual space of the elevator, and the control operation simulation travel of the elevator is performed. By varying a vibration device 3, a sound/voice output part 6 and a picture intention display part 8 fit to the control operation simulation travel of the elevator, the elevator simulator experienced person B can feel the motion of the elevator in various kinds of control operations at an arbitrary time in a limited space without getting on an actual elevator. Thereby, the user utilizing the elevator can understand the motion of the elevator when an earthquake, a power failure and a fire are generated, respectively.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Composite linear temperature-sensing fire disaster detector alarming method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined-typed linear temperature-sensing fire detector and an alarming method thereof. The detector includes two bus linear temperature sensing components which are arranged in parallel and shunt-wound NTC simulative linear temperature sensing components and a switching box connected at one end of the linear temperature sensing component. A distance (Lj) between intelligent temperature detecting modules on the bus linear temperature sensing component is greater than 1 meter and is less than or equal to Lmax meter which is the allowed biggest available length when the fire detector individually adopts the NTC simulative linear temperature sensing component under the national standard. The fire detector and the alarming method of the invention arranges the bus linear temperature sensing component provided with the intelligent temperature detecting modules with a distribution density which is greater than 1 meter and the shunt-wound NTC simulative linear temperature sensing components in parallel, and also adopts a detecting box to respectively detect the electrical parameter of the two linear temperature sensing components to trigger the fire alarm according to the electrical parameter so as to effectively solve the contradiction between the sensitivity and reliability and response speed.
assignees: BEIJING SURELAND IND FIRE ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional simulation training facilities of high temperature and thick smoke
abstract_en: A high-temperature dense smoke multifunction simulated training facility comprises a training room, which is characterized in that a training body in a frame structure is provided in the training room, wherein the frame structure is provided with a training simulation channel formed by a metal mesh, the training body is divided into an upper, a middle and a lower layer and is provided with a fuming device, the training room is provided with a hot air blower, a camera and a sound light device. The high-temperature dense smoke multifunction simulated training facility has the advantages that the utility model can simulate the serious conditions of disaster rescue field, measure and improve the ultimate body bearing ability and psychological quality of fireman, thereby improving the operational capability, emergency ability and psychological endurance of fireman for sudden accident at disaster rescue field.

title_en: Analog simulating demonstrator for Richter scale of earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earthquake Richter magnitude simulation demonstrator which comprises a bottom board, an acceleration transducer, an A/D conversion module, a programmable controller and an earthquake Richter magnitude display panel. The acceleration transducer is fixed at the bottom of the bottom board. The acceleration transducer is connected with the A/D conversion module. The A/D conversion module is connected with the programmable controller. Display areas which are respectively corresponding to different Richter magnitudes are arranged on the earthquake Richter magnitude display panel. Display lights are arranged at the back of the display areas. The programmable controller is connected with the display lights. By using the utility model, the earthquake Richter magnitude simulation demonstrator can intuitively and conveniently display the meaning of the earthquake Richter magnitude under the direct participation of audience, is favorable to the popularization of earthquake knowledge and the improvement of quakeproof and disaster reduction consciousness of the public.

title_en: Seismic zone and volcano global distribution simulating demonstration instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an analogue demonstration instrument for the distribution of global seismic belts and volcanoes, comprising a base, a rotational axis, a tellurion and an electronic control circuit. The tellurion is held on the base by the rotational axis. The surface of the tellurion is provided with display elements which are corresponding to the distribution positions of seismic belts and volcanoes. Buttons are arranged on the base or on the periphery of the tellurion. The display elements and the buttons are separately connected with the electronic control circuit. The distribution condition of the seismic belts and volcanoes or the inner structure of the earth can be conveniently and directly demonstrated on the surface of the tellurion by using the demonstration instrument, furthermore which is favorable for the popularity of the earthquake knowledge and improving the sense of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction of the public.

title_en: The vibration sporting goods
title_ko: 진동운동기구
abstract_en: Vibration exercise equipment is provided to allow an exerciser to do a vibration exercise for whole body in addition to the lower body, without necessarily changing a standing pose. Vibration equipment comprises a main body(10) including a drive pulley(3) axially loaded on a motor shaft(2) of a DC motor(1), two driven pulleys(5) of different diameters from each other, being connected to the drive pulley through a belt(4), first and second drive shafts(8',8'') having two eccentric cams(7) axially loaded on either side, and a vibration foot rest(9) reciprocating vertically in a sea-saw manner in response to the rotation of the eccentric cams; and a support standing at the upper portion on the rear side of the main body and having handles on either side of its upper end; and a control panel installed at the upper end of the support and provided with a control button for controlling an operation of the DC motor and a display window for displaying a current control state. Further, a circular disk(17) having a protruded flange(16) in phase or at a 180-degree phase difference with an eccentric portion(6) of the cam is installed at one end of the first drive shaft.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사용자의 근력에 의하지 않고 자체적으로 발생한 진동을 사용자에게 제공하여 운동효과가 발휘되도록 한 진동운동기구에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 진동발판이 양축구동방식의 직류모터의 동력으로 고속회전하는 편심캠에 의해 중심축을 중심으로 좌우 양측이 180도의 위상차를 이루면서 고속으로 상하운동하여 진동을 발생시킬 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 좌우 양측이 동일한 위상에서도 고속으로 상하운동하여 진동을 발생시킬 수 있는 구조를 제공함에 따라, 사용자가 기립한 자세에서 자세의 변화 없이 하체 위주의 진동운동 뿐만 아니라 전신에 대한 진동운동을 행할 수 있게 됨으로써 진동운동의 효과를 증대시킬 수 있는 진동운동기구에 관한 것이다.  
     본 발명에 따르면, 양축구동식의 직류모터의 모터축에 축설된 구동풀리에 벨트를 통해 연결되는 두 개의 종동풀리와 함께 두 개의 편심캠이 한 개씩 좌우 양측에 각각 축설된 구동축이 내부에 설치되고, 상기 구동축에 축설된 편심캠의 회전운동에 의해 좌우 양측이 시소방식으로 상하왕복하여 진동을 발생시키는 진동발판이 상부에 설치된 본체와; 상기 본체의 후측 상부에 기립 설치되고, 상단 양측에 각각 손잡이가 설치된 지지대와; 상기 지지대의 상단에 설치되고, 직류모터의 구동을 제어하기 위한 제어버튼과 현재의 제어상태를 표시하는 표시창이 장치된 제어패널로; 구성된 것에 있어서, 상기 구동축은 중앙을 기준하여 좌우 양측이 이분되어 제1구동축과 제2구동축으로 구성되고, 상기 제1구동축의 일단에 편심캠의 편심부와 동일위상을 갖거나 또는 180도의 위상차를 갖는 각도로 플랜지가 돌설된 원형디스크가 설치되며, 상기 제2구동축의 일단에 상기 플랜지가 걸려 원형디스크와 일체로 회전되게 하는 두 개의 플랜지홈이 편심캠의 편심부와 동일위상과 180도의 위상차를 갖는 양단에 각각 형성된 반원디스크가 설치되고; 상기 두 개의 종동풀리는 각각 서로 다른 직경을 갖는 것으로 구성된 진동운동기구가 제공된다.   
       
     진동운동기구, 직류모터, 편심캠, 시소식, 수직승하강식, 플랜지, 플랜지홈

title_en: Disaster training system
title_ko: 재난체험 교육 시스템
abstract_en: A disaster training system is provided to improve training efficiency in a professional mode by individually measuring an acquisition degree of training and accordingly adjusting a training course. A disaster training system includes a plurality of training rooms. Entrance sensors(22,32,42,52,62a) are installed in the training rooms respectively to determine whether a trainee is an amateur or a professional. The training rooms include an earthquake training room(20) having an earthquake generator(24), a cardiopulmonary resuscitation training room(30) having a human body model, a fire extinguishing training room(40) having a fire generator(46), a demonstration training room(50) having a smoke generator(53), an earth leakage breaker(54), a gas fire generator(56), and an oil fire generator(58), a maze training room(60) having first and second paths(64,66) from an entrance to an exit, and a control room(10) to convert each training room into an amateur mode or a professional mode.
