title_en: Scene pretreatment method for fire disaster simulation
abstract_en: The present invention provides a scene pretreating method used for fire simulation. An axial block collection of a material solid in a scene is calculated in a three-dimensional model and a background gridding in the scene. The material solid comprises geometrical information, physical information and semantic information. The method comprises the steps as follows: the three-dimensional model of the scene is defined with a sorted semanteme; each material solid in the three-dimensional model of the scene is sorted according to the sorted semanteme, then a sample material solid or a sample logic material solid is selected from every sorted sort, and the sample logic material solid comprises the sample material solid; the sample material solid is cut axially in terms of the coordinate direction of the background gridding to obtain the axial block collection of the sample material solid, and axial blocks which do not belong to the sample material solid in the axial block collection are removed; other material solids in the sort of the sample material solid are calculated for the axial block collection. The scene pretreating method has the advantages of good commonality and high efficiency.

title_en: Foldable tent
abstract_en: The utility model provides a folding tent. The tent consists of a bracket and a tarpaulin outside the bracket; a longitudinal rod and another longitudinal rod are arranged on the bracket; the two ends of a cross rod are respectively connected at the upper ends of the two longitudinal rods by a folding joint and a drawing type folding joint; the two sides at the lower part of the longitudinal rod are respectively connected with a side supporting rod by the folding joints; the two sides at the lower part of the another longitudinal rod are respectively connected with another side supporting rod by the folding joint; the two ends of a side cross rod are respectively connected on the upper ends of the two side supporting rods by the folding joint and the drawing type folding joint; the upper parts of the two side supporting rods are respectively connected with a supporting rod and another supporting rod by the folding joints; the lower ends of each supporting rod and the two longitudinal rods are provided with a conical inserting head; the tarpaulin of the tent is fixed together with the bracket, is conveniently mounted, dismounted and carried, can realize complete folding, has a small size, reduces the occupied space, is conveniently carried and transported. Besides, the tarpaulin of the tent is light, is easy to be mounted and fixed and is applicable for travelling, camping, training, disaster preventing and rescuing as well as manufacturing a simple storehouse, garage, etc.

title_en: Rockbolt drilling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a jumbolter, which comprises a chassis provided with a slideway. The slideway is provided with a frame. The frame is provided with a drilling power head; the chassis is provided with a hydraulic system; an oil cylinder arranged in the hydraulic system is fixed on the chassis parallel with the slideway; the piston rod of the oil cylinder is connected with the frame through a connecting piece. The jumbolter is characterized in that the structure of the jumbolter is designed to be reasonable, simple and compact with few parts; the jumbolter is light in weight and just about 100 kilograms, and occupies small floor space of about one square meter; the jumbolter is used conveniently, and operated easily, which just needs one person for operation; an operator can be familiar with the operation through just one-hour study. The jumbolter can be used for support of rock and soil road beds, dam foundations, retaining wall, deep foundation pits, and subterranean works, geological treatment of disasters, strengthening of foundation, correcting errors, cable holes, water pipe holes, gas pipe holes and so on.

title_en: Manual multifunctional breaking device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manual multi-functional breaking machine which belongs to the technical field of breaking machine structure. The manual multi-functional breaking machine is characterized by comprising a plumbing bar, the middle part of the plumbing bar is provided with a protuberant platform, a head part is connected with the lowest end of the plumbing bar, the periphery of the plumbing bar above the platform is sheathed with a hollow slide hammer which can repeatedly slide up and down along the plumbing bar; when in operation, the whole plumbing bar needs not to move, the hollow slide hammer slides up and down along the plumbing bar to generate an impulsive force on the platform arranged at the lower part, thus achieving the purposes of drilling, prying and breaking. The manual multi-functional breaking machine of the invention has the advantages of reasonable structure, simple operation and strong impulsive force; as the head of the breaking machine can be replaced at any time, the breaking machine is applicable to various changeable operating environment and has diversified functions, and particularly applicable to unexpected rescue of emergency rescue and disaster relief.

title_en: Method for retarding human beings natural calamity harm
abstract_en: The mitigation of harms of natural disasters needs the global human and material resources regardless of frontiers, the invention relates to a method for drilling human limited energy dissipation holes at certain positions of the geoid for ensuring the relative stability of the geoid, and the method can play the role of mitigating the natural disasters on the globe.

title_en: Apparatus for making hall of side members
title_ko: 측면 부재에 대한 홀 가공장치
abstract_en: A hole making device is provided to prevent that the malfunction or the industrial disaster of the drill breaks out the day when the drill shakes among the hole aerial work or given is damaged. A hole making device comprises a drill(140) for machining hole; a template(200) including the adapter inlet hole which is attached in the hole processing part and in which the day given of the drill is induced to the hole processing location; a first adapter(400) in which one end is connected in the front-end of the drill; and a second adapter(500) in which the penetration hole in which the day given as described above passes is formed, and as to one end, the protrusion inserted in and fixed and the adapter inlet hole in the first adapter other end part is formed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 각종 구조물의 측면에 드릴을 이용한 홀 가공을 보다 효율적으로 수행할 수 있는 홀 가공장치 관한 것으로서, 구조물에 홀을 가공함에 있어서 홀 간의 간격 및 직각도 조절, 예비홀 가공과 같은 복잡한 사전작업 없이 작업공정을 단순화할 수 있으며, 작업자의 피로도를 예방하여 작업의 효율성을 향상시키고, 기기의 고장이나 산업재해를 예방할 수 있는 홀 가공장치를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
     상기 목적을 달성하기 위해 본 발명은, 구조물의 측면에 드릴을 이용한 홀 가공작업을 수행하기 위한 홀 가공장치로서, 홀 가공용 드릴과, 판상부재로 이루어지며 홀 가공부위에 취부되어 홀 가공위치로 상기 드릴의 드릴 날이 유도되도록 하는 어댑터 삽입구를 구비하는 템플릿과, 중앙에는 상기 드릴 날이 관통하는 관통구멍이 형성되어 있고 일단부가 상기 드릴의 전단부에 체결되는 제1 어댑터와, 상기 템플릿에 체결되며 중앙에는 상기 드릴 날이 관통하는 관통구멍이 형성되어 있고 일단부는 상기 제1 어댑터의 타단부에 체결되며 타단부에는 상기 어댑터 삽입구에 삽입 고정되는 돌출부가 형성된 제2 어댑터를 포함하는 홀 가공장치를 제공한다. 
       
     홀 가공, 드릴, 어댑터, 템플릿

title_en: Method for predicting dynamic risk and vulnerability under fine dimension
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting dynamic risk and vulnerability at fine scale and belongs to the scientific field of global information. The method is mainly characterized in that an optimized Bayesian network is searched from multi-source heterogeneous spatiotemporal data on the basis of a grid format with certain resolution at fine scale; domain knowledge is combined to improve the network; therefore, the uncertain estimation of disaster risk and the vulnerability, namely probability estimation, is carried out. In the method, a nuclear density method is put forward to train a sample according to a sample derivative grid; an optimized discretization method is put forward to discretize continuous variables so as to provide discrete state space input for the network; a simulated annealing optimization algorithm is adopted to search an optimized network structure; and a method of accurate reasoning combined with approximate reasoning to predict the probabilities of risk and the vulnerability is adopted. The method provided by the invention can position the positions of the disaster risk and the vulnerability in real time at the fine spatial scale, estimate the spatial distribution of the risk probability and has important theoretical significance and practical value for improving the effects on the reduction and relief of disaster and building an intelligent public emergency pre-warning system by the state.
assignees: INST GEOG SCI & NR RES CAS

title_en: Method for realizing disaster recovery connection pipe
abstract_en: A method for realizing disaster recovery connection pipes comprises the following steps: 1.1 when a certain mobile switching control simulation is failed, the jurisdiction area of the mobile switching control simulation is taken over by another mobile switching control simulation, the mobile switching control simulation of the jurisdiction area taking over the failed mobile switching control simulation partially limits the jurisdiction area of the mobile switching control simulation, and manages the idle resources in the area of the failed mobile switching control simulation; 1.2, calling the user of the area which is partially limited, and taking over the mobile switching control simulation of the jurisdiction area of the fault mobile switching control simulation to process and remind the user. The invention can fully utilize the resources of mobile switching control simulation, prevent avalanche effect, reduce user complaint and ensure that the system takeover effect is better.

title_en: Tent toilet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a public toilet tent which is temporarily built for emergency, and is provided with a tent frame, wherein, the tent frame is formed by assembling pipes; an enclosing tarpaulin and a roof covering tarpaulin are matched with the tent frame; a squatting pan frame, a squatting urinal assembled in the frame, and a squatting device composed of foot treadles assembled on the upper side of the frame are arranged in the tent frame. The public toilet tent also has the technical proposal that the urinal is hung on the inner side of the enclosing tarpaulin; a urine storing barrel is arranged under the urinal; a stayed cable mechanism composed of a steel wire guy rope and rigging turnbuckles is arranged on the tent frame; a fluorescent belt is arranged on the outer side surface of the enclosing tarpaulin; and a blocking body is arranged on the upper side of the squatting pan frame. The public toilet tent adopts the tent frame formed by assembling the pipes and the squatting pan frame, and matching with the flexible tarpaulin, so as to compose the toilet tent with the characteristics of convenient building and removing, repeatable use, convenient transportation, sanitary use, environmental protection and low configuring cost. The toilet tent is especially applicable to areas bursting with natural disasters, field construction sites and troop field training.

title_en: Buildings automatic extracting method based on digital elevation model
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic building extraction method based on the digital elevation model (DEM). The method includes the steps: (1) pre-processing; (2) vectorization; (3) de-noising; (4) edge simplification; (5) automatic building extraction processing. Compared with the prior art, the complete power supply simulation system established by the invention can provide preconditions for the sudden accident emergent plan design, the logistics system simulation, the natural disaster simulation and emulation in the future.
assignees: SHANGHAI TONGSHENG ENGINEERING CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Fire extinguisher for fire fighting education and training
title_ko: 소방교육용 소화기
abstract_en: A fire extinguisher for fire fighting education is provided to fundamentally eliminate a phenomenon that the check valve is damaged, or the user is injured when the check valve is collided with an object or a user by installing a checking valve on the bottom of a tank to supply or replenish a fire extinguishing agent into the tank. A fire extinguisher for fire fighting education is characterized in that an extension member(10) is formed on the circumference of a bottom face of a tank(6) to secure a housing space(9) under the bottom face of the tank, and a check valve(5) is installed on the bottom face of the tank within the housing space such that the check valve is in communication with the inside of the tank to simply solve a problem that the check valve is damaged by the collision with an object during handling of the fire extinguisher, or an educatee is injured by the protruded check valve since the check valve is protruded to the outside of the tank.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 헤드에 장착되어 탱크 내부의 소화제가 소모될 때 보충 공급하는 체크밸브를 탱크 저면에 설치하여 종래 문제점인 돌출된 체크밸브가 부딪쳐 파손되는 현상을 원천적으로 제거하고, 또한 탱크 저면에 장착된 체크밸브와 연결하는 공급파이프가 탱크 하부 측면으로 삽입되게 하여 소방교육시 소화기를 바르게 세워 위치시킬 수 있도록 하는 소방교육용 소화기에 관한 것으로, 
     이의 구성은 소화용 분말 또는 액체를 헤드에 설치된 체크밸브를 통해 탱크 내부에 공급하고, 상기 헤드에 설치된 레버를 누름조작할 때 토출관 주연부에 형성된 통로를 통해 공기가 그리고 토출관 하부의 입구를 통해 분말 또는 액체가 동시에 배출되어 유로를 경유한 다음 헤드에 설치된 노즐을 통해 외부로 토출되어 화재를 진압하거나 또는 화재진압 시연을 디스플레이하는 소방교육용 소화기에 있어서, 
     상기 탱크 저면에 수납공간을 확보할 수 있도록 탱크 저면 둘레에 연장부재를 형성하고, 상기 체크밸브를 탱크 내부와 연통되게 탱크 저면에 설치하여 수납공간에 위치시키는 것을 특징이다.

title_en: Wireless Emergency Management Application
abstract_en: A system and method for providing a wireless emergency management application that facilitates the identification of persons who have various skills and/or training, thereby allowing the best available person to respond to an emergency or non-emergency situation. Still further, the instant system and method can track the location of specialized equipment, thereby allowing the equipment to be more readily employed when needed. The instant system and method can also wirelessly distribute EAP-related information, such as, without limitation, a role definition and a checklist to be followed in performing the tasks associated with that role, for each responder in a particular emergency response. As the responder responds to the emergency, his or her responses can be transmitted back to a centralized server for dissemination to and coordination with other users.

title_en: Fast and automatically modeling method in large-scale city simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quick automatic modeling method used in the large-scale city simulation, which comprises the following steps: the image quality is improved in a pre-processing stage; the outlines of a road and a building are extracted automatically; seed points of the road and the building are extracted; a network of the road and the building is generated; a three-dimensional city model is established based on an image; materials and textures are applied; the model is tested and optimized. Compared with the prior art, a perfect power supply system simulation system constructed by the quick automatic modeling method can provide precondition to the emergency lash-up plan design, the logistics system simulation, the natural disaster simulating and simulation, etc. in the future.

title_en: Flood disaster prediction system using a gis
title_ko: 지아이에스를 이용한 홍수재해 예측시스템
abstract_en: A flood disaster predicting system using a GIS is provided to construct flood-related information of a particular river valley as a DB, and to link the flood-related information with indirect information such as rainfall, soil property, and drainage information of rivers, in a complex way, thereby previously predicting progression of a flood to reduce damage. A flood overflow model providing module(120) constructs flood overflow information accumulated according to each region and each period, and provides the constructed information. A water gate simulation model providing module(130) constructs information on accumulated water gate opening/shutting data, and provides the information. A landslide technique providing module(140) accumulates landslide information, and provides analysis technique information for landslide progression information.
abstract_ko:

     본 발명을 적용하면, 특정 유역의 홍수관련 정보를 검색할 수 있으며, 해당 유역의 홍수재해평가 및 예측이 가능하고, 기본적인 홍수 관련 정보뿐만 아니라 홍수피해 저감방안으로 제방고, 천변저류 2가지로 분류하여 각각 홍수피해가 어떻게 나타날 수 있는지 시뮬레이션할 수 있으며, 산사태 기법을 통하여 안성천 유역에서 발생할 수 있는 산사태 위험도를 등급별로 확인할 수 있고, 홍수피해가 자주 발생하는 유역의 홍수피해 예방과 홍수피해가 있을 때의 피해 정도를 예측할 수 있게 해주어 홍수피해를 줄일 수 있는 방안을 마련하는데 크게 기여할 수 있다.

title_en: Safe operating and controlling protector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a safety manipulation protection device, which can effectively solve the problems of drilling difficulty and production safety, improve productivity and reduce costs; the technical proposal is that a transparent glass explosion-proof layer is arranged at the lower part of the top of the device; the lower part of the transparent glass explosion-proof layer is arranged on the device body; an air supply valve, a water supply valve and an air discharge valve are arranged inward on the sidewall of the device body; and a closed door is arranged at the front side face of the device body. The utility model is applied to the coal mine underground mine outburst dangerous working face safety manipulation operation, and also used for save-saving in coal and gas outburst or disaster incidents; the safety manipulation protection device is simple in structure, and easy, safe and reliable in operation, which greatly improves the production efficiency and productivity and has obvious social and economic benefits.

title_en: PC safety cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a PC safe case, mode one: comprising a frame, wherein one end of the frame is fixedly connected with a PC original case and another end of the frame is equipped with a safe door; mode two: comprising a front frame of case and a back frame of case fixedly connected with the front frame, and the PC original case is fixedly mounted in the front frame and one end of the back frame of case is connected with the front frame of case and another end is equipped with the safe door. The case frame uses cold-rolling sheet of high quality to effectively prevent the personnel, competition antagonist, business spy maliciously stealing the computer self-information; and uses full package type structure to fully protect the main machine of computer to prevent the main machine from being damaged by other natural disasters such as earthquake. A safe locker uses safe locker with drill prevention and prizing prevention function, with extremely low mutual unlocking rate and a same locker can be used for a plurality of cases, therefore one key can manage all the cases.

title_en: System and method for routing assistance with use of network of bases
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system and method for providing routing information for each person who moves to one's destination in evacuating at disaster or in an evacuation drill.  <P>SOLUTION: In method for routing assistance with use of a network of branch offices in a system, including a server having branch office information database in which to store position information on the network of branch offices and a mobile terminal that can be connected to the server via a network, the mobile terminal in a first branch office among a plurality of branch offices includes a step in which the mobile terminal acquires first branch office identification information for identifying URL information of the server and a first branch office among a large number of branch offices; a step in which the mobile terminal connects to the server, in accordance with the URL information and sends destination specification information for specifying the first branch office identification information and a destination with respect to the server; a step in which the server uses the first branch office identification information, the destination specification information and branch office information database to search for branch office routing information indicating a branch office route from the first branch office to a second branch office near the destination; and a step in which the server sends the branch office routing information to the mobile terminal.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Universal oil feeder
abstract_en: The universal oil feeder is mainly used for military fighters and civil aircrafts, and can also be used for ships and land transportation vehicles, and the universal oil feeder can avoid oil supply faults and accidents and disasters caused by the oil supply faults under various conditions. Such as: when a military fighter is used for fancy performance and flight training, and a civil aircraft encounters airflow, an oil suction pipe in an oil tank is exposed out of the liquid level and sucks a large amount of air when the aircraft jolts and overturns, so that an engine suddenly stalls at a critical moment, and accidents and disasters are caused. In addition, similar faults can be caused or easily caused when the ships sailing at sea encounter storms and the land transportation vehicles travel on rugged roads such as mountain roads, and the universal oil feeder can eliminate the oil supply faults generated under the conditions. The technical scheme of the universal oil feeder is mainly characterized in that the oil feeding fault is eliminated by utilizing the stability of the lead spherical crown under the action of gravity.

title_en: Foundation treatment technology for eliminating loess seismic subsidence of railway and highway bed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadbed treatment technique for eliminating loess dynamic settlement of railroad and public road beds. The technique comprises the following contents: after roadbed treatment, the loess dynamic settlement of railroad and public road beds can be eliminated when the compaction degree of the railroad and public road beds meets conditions that a percentage water content omega is less than omega p which represents the plastic limit of loess, a dry density rho d is more than or equal to 1.63g/cm, an average compaction coefficient is more than or equal to 0.93, and an average extrusion coefficient is more than or equal to 0.95. The technique is to apply long lasting and small amplitude load to a dynamic triaxial apparatus to research the accumulated deformation, dynamic settlement, liquefaction and slippage of the loess of the railroad beds and input the research results into a dynamic numerical model to simulate the whole process of accumulated deformation, damage, settlement and slippage of the loess beds; and to carry out on-site exciter test of a high-speed railway and reasonably illustrate the influence of the long-lasting vibrating load of trains on the accumulated deformation of the loess of the beds. Thus, the technique represents a completely new acknowledge about the principle of loess disasters.

title_en: Foundation treatment technology for eliminating loess liquefaction of railway and highway bed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadbed treatment technique for eliminating the loess liquefaction of railroad and public road beds. The technique is characterized in that: after roadbed treatment, the loess liquefaction of railroad and public road beds can be eliminated when the compaction degree of the railroad and public road beds meets the conditions that a percentage water content omega is saturated water content, a dry density rho d is more than or equal to 1.69g/cm, an average compaction coefficient is more than or equal to 0.94, and an average extrusion coefficient is more than or equal to 0.95. The technique is to apply long lasting and small amplitude load to a dynamic triaxial apparatus to study the accumulated deformation, dynamic settlement, liquefaction and slippage of the loess of the railroad beds and input the study results into a dynamic numerical model to simulate the whole process of accumulated deformation, damage, settlement and slippage of the loess beds; and to carry out on-site exciter test of a high-speed railway and reasonably illustrate the influence of the long-lasting vibrating load of trains on the accumulated deformation of the loess of the beds. Thus, the technique represents a completely new acknowledge about the principle of loess disasters.

title_en: Disaster recovery process simulation device, disaster recovery process simulation method and disaster recovery process simulation program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To beforehand and serially analyze works for recovering lifelines in a disaster, such as an earthquake and a typhoon.  <P>SOLUTION: A local information storage part 120 stores local data 10. An electric power circulation facility information storage part 130 stores electric power circulation facility data 20. A commander simulation part 141, a patrolman simulation part 142, and a recovery person simulation part 143 refer to the local information storage part 120 and the electric power circulation facility information storage part 130, and simulate the works done by a commander, a patrolman, and a recovery person, respectively. The recovery person simulation part 143 simulates moving of the recovery person to a disaster place and command waiting from the commander.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Psychological training machine for fire-fighting rescue
abstract_en: A firefighting rescue psychological training machine comprises a ladder stand and rungs and is characterized in that two sides of the ladder stand are connected in transmission manner with operating chains through drive chain wheels; connection rungs are uniformly distributed on the operating chains, and an electric motor and a speed transforming transmission are arranged in the ladder stand; the speed transforming transmission is connected with the drive chain wheels; and the ladder stand is provided with a photoelectric switch and an indicator lamp. The utility model has the advantage that the operation of the rungs can be controlled; together with the fastness and slowness of the climbing of a trainer, the ladder is controlled so that the operation speed is adjusted. The utility model also has the advantages of simple operation, convenient use, vividness, safety and reliability. The firefighting rescue psychological training machine is a high-tech intelligent training instrument and an ideal training apparatus for professional staff, e.g. a firefighting team, to train professional skills, exercise coordination ability of bodies and improve physical fitness and psychological quality.

title_en: Multifunctional shelf for sport on bed, body-building and disaster prevention
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-disaster and all-purpose framework, through which body-building exercises are carried out on a bed. The framework is a square framework composed of four pairs of upright pillars and connecting rods connected with four pairs of upright pillars up and down, a plurality of bars are respectively installed on the top face and the bottom face of the framework, a plurality of semi-arch-shaped inserting rings are arranged in the openings of the inner side of upper half of each upright pillar, and movable bars are movably inserted into the corresponding inserting rings of two symmetrical upright pillars. The framework has a stable structure, and is used in the bed and on open space as a horizontal bar, a parallel bar, an uneven bars or a ladder stand; various athletic facilities such as a small swing, a sandbag, and the like. are hung on the bars thereof so as to conduct physical exercise; one board is put between two bars so as to serve as a table as well as a lectulum; when a house is collapsed, the framework can effectively prevent a user who lies in the bed with the framework from being harmed, thus protecting life; the framework can keep out wind and rain as a temporary house when covered with plastic cloth outdoors. The framework is a device combined with multifunction such as sleep, body-building exercise, work, entertainment and prevention against earthquake and collapse of the house.

title_en: Manual multifunctional breaking-folding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a manual multi-functional breaking device which belongs to the technical field of breaking device structures. The manual multi-functional breaking device is characterized in that a plumbing bar is arranged, a protruding platform is arranged in the middle of the plumbing bar, and a head part is connected with the bottom of the plumbing bar; a hollow sliding hammer capable of repeatedly slide up and down along the plumbing bar is sleeved on the periphery of the plumbing bar above the platform. When the utility model is in work, the whole plumbing bar does not need to act, only the hollow sliding hammer slides on the plumbing bar up and down to generate impact force on the platform arranged at the lower part so as to achieve the aim of drilling, prying and breaking. The utility model has simple structure, simple and convenient operation and strong impact force, can suit various changeable operation environments due to the head part capable of being randomly changed and has diversified functions, thereby being particularly suitable for the emergency rescue and disaster relief.

title_en: Wind gun
title_ko: 바람 총
abstract_en: A wind gun is provided, which is suitable for initial extinguishment of the forest fire and can extinguish forest fire with few persons. A wind gun is constituted as follows. The wind gun makes the wind generated in the cylinder electric fan go to the front. The wind gun is made in a right screw-type so that the wind can rotate inside the wind gun front to send the wind in a long distance. The power is used by combining 9V motor drill or being connected to a power line of a gasoline weeder.
