title_en: Intelligent automatic control system for household safety security and emergency alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intellectualized automatic control system for family security protection and emergency alarm. The automatic control system takes a family security protection intelligent controller as a core and is connected with other family intelligent security prevention devices. The system comprises the family security protection intelligent controller. The input end of the family security protection intelligent controller is connected with an external cloth defense withdrawing switch, a line type security protection detector, a line type disaster prevention detector, a sleep cloth defense withdrawing switch and a portable radio emergency alarm device, and the output end of the family security protection intelligent controller is connected with an intelligent internet video controller and a remote control actuating device; and the family security protection intelligent controller also carries out bidirectional communication with a unit/outdoor talkback device and a talkback type emergency alarm, thereby the complete simulated intrusion prevention effect is achieved, and the comprehensive requirements of modern families to safety safeguard products are satisfied in aspect of remote alarm, sound dialogue, radio frequency monitoring, convenient operation, and humanized operation.

title_en: Self-heating multipurpose vacuum flask
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional automatic heating thermos which belongs to the field of daily necessities. The multifunctional automatic heating thermos comprises a thermos and a sealed food case, wherein the thermos comprises a thermos body and a thermos lid. The multifunctional automatic heating thermos is characterized in that the inner space of the thermos body is divided into an upper chamber and a lower chamber by a detachable grate, an automatic heating agent bag is placed into the lower chamber, the sealed food case is placed into the upper chamber, a seam exists between the sealed food case and the inner wall of the upper chamber, the thermos lid and the thermos body are hermetically connected, and the thermos lid is provided with a non-return relief valve. The automatic heating agent bag is packaged by plastic, a belt used for tearing off the package is fixed on the automatic heating agent bag, and the other end of the belt extends out of a thermos opening. The utility model adopts the automatic heating principle, does not need a power supply, is convenient for utilization, has the functions of storing water and heating rice and dishes, solves the self processing problem of the food when the user is in traveling or a business trip, and is suitable for army warfare training and disaster relief. The shell is made from alloy, thus, the utility model is firm and portable.

title_en: Movable simulated earthquake escape training house
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a movable earthquake simulation evacuation training room which is characterized by comprising an foldable room, a vibration device, a lift device, a power device and an electric control device, wherein the vibration device is formed by connecting a hydraulic oscillating cylinder to a reciprocal time dupler, the vibration device can be connected with the foldable room, the lift device is composed of a worm nut and a lead screw which are engaged, the vibration device is connected with the lift device, the power device is connected with the lift device and the vibration device, and further, the reciprocal time dupler is formed by connecting a rocker which is connected with the hydraulic oscillating cylinder to a connecting link, connecting the connecting link to a fixed swing link and a connecting link roller. The movable earthquake simulation evacuation training room can simulate transverse wave shock of 4-8 magnitude earthquakes, thereby enabling people to be personally on the scene, further, can simulate damages and self-rescue measures in earthquakes by coordinating with shock of the house and the equipment in the house. The movable earthquake simulation evacuation training room is an integral structure with flexible motion, compact structure, self-aid base and convenient transport, and can realize shock excitation in steady states.

title_en: Safety divider of water extinguisher for fire training
title_ko: 소방교육용 물소화기 안전 분배기
abstract_en: A safety divider of water extinguisher is provided, which enables to shorten the fire fighting training time and reduces the cost due to the movement of facility. A safety divider of water extinguisher comprises: a main pipe(10); an adapter(20) provided with water of water supply and water for extinguishing fires; a manifold(30) which binds the main pipe and adapter in order to make them communicate with each other; a plurality of distribution pipes(50) connected to the water extinguisher; and a measuring unit(60) including the pressure gauge(61) measuring the pressure of the inside.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방교육용 물소화기 안전 분배기에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 옥내, 외 소화전의 상수도 및 소방차의 소화용수를 이용하여 올바른 소화기 사용법을 숙지시키되, 현장 실습교육시 인원에 제한 없이 연속적으로 사용가능한 안전 분배기를 제공하도록, 상기 안전 분배기의 입구에 옥내외 소화전 및 소방차의 수압으로 인한 과도한 압력의 입력을 방지하도록 감압변을 설치하고, 사용중에도 안전 분배기 내부의 압력을 측정하여 일정수위 이상으로 압력이 상승될 경우, 폭발사고 등을 예방하기 위해 안전변을 더 구비하며, 다수개의 교육용 물소화기에 결합가능한 다수개의 배분관을 형성함으로써, 많은 소화전 및 소방차를 구비하지 않고도 다수의 인원이 동시에 안전하게 실습가능하도록 함으로써 시간의 단축으로 인한 소방교육효과를 증대시킬 수 있는 소방교육용 물소화기 안전 분배기에 관한 것이다. 
       
     분배기, 소화전, 소화기, 압력, 안전변, 감압변, 소방교육

title_en: Fireman's safety apparatus and methods of use
abstract_en: A strap for utilization as a safety harness, particularly for use by firefighters is disclosed, wherein the strap comprises an elongated center section with four handles, two at each end extending from the elongated center section approximately opposite each other. The invention discloses a single easily deployable tool and methods which can at least carry S.C.B.A. cylinders and/or other equipment, work as a ladder belt and/or a hose strap, move charged lines, provide an increased search area, work as a hasty harness, work for dragging a victim or firefighter, work easily for Denver drill scenarios, and carry victims or firefighters up or down stairs.

title_en: Fireman's safety apparatus and methods of use
abstract_en: Methods for utilization of a safety harness, particularly for use by firefighters is disclosed, wherein the strap comprises an elongated center section with four handles, two at each end extending from the elongated center section approximately opposite each other. The invention discloses a single easily deployable tool and methods which can at least carry S.C.B.A. cylinders and/or other equipment, work as a ladder belt and/or a hose strap, move charged lines, provide an increased search area, work as a hasty harness, work for dragging a victim or firefighter, work easily for Denver drill scenarios, and carry victims or firefighters up or down stairs.

title_en: Multi-platform target tracking and distribution interactive simulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-platform target tracking and distributed interactive simulation system in the technical field of simulation. The system comprises a target generation module, an aerial sensing platform, an emergency processing platform, a ground control center platform and an HLA distributed interactive simulation module, wherein, the target generation module generates a system tracking object at random; the aerial sensing platform comprises various detecting devices for performing fusion to the detected information and then transmitting the information to the ground control center platform; the ground control center platform integrates all the field information, evaluates the entire field situation and promptly makes an emergency decision; the emergency processing platform receives the information and the commands and realizes target tracking by using airborne equipment; and the HLA distributed interactive simulation module enables the modules to establish an HLA distributed system structure through a distributed network and realizes the multi-information network interconnection. The invention has the advantages of flexibility and extendability, can improve the tracking effect, enhance the visibility of scene demonstration and be widely applied to the fields such as public safety, disaster relief assistance and the like.

title_en: Air pipe linetype difference temperature fire disaster detector
abstract_en: An air tube linear rate-of-rise detector can solve the problems that the interior of an air tube in the prior art can not be communicated with external atmosphere, the leak detection function can not be realized, the automatic analog alarm can not be carried out, the thermal expansion of air can not be simulated, and the prior art can only carry out ignition test on the detection site. The air tube linear rate-of-rise detector is provided with a conversion box and the air tube and characterized in that a control circuit, a linear motion device and an air compression device which is connected with the linear motion device are mounted in the conversion box, the air compression device is respectively communicated with a pressure sensor, an air escape valve and the air tube which are mounted in the conversion box through a connecting pipeline, and the control circuit is respectively connected with the linear motion device and the pressure sensor for controlling the working state of the linear motion device. The air tube linear rate-of-rise detector has the advantages of having the functions of automatic leak detection and automatic analog alarm detection and being capable of realizing the intelligent control.

title_en: Icing jump simulation experiment method for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention provides an iced power transmission line jump simulation test method. A simulation test is carried on a power transmission line segment between two arbitrary adjacent tower poles and two continuous power transmission lines (continuous spans) between continuous adjacent three tower poles on a power electric transmission line. The weight Q of the ice with the thickness of S covered on the power transmission line segment is taken as the total load of the icing test. The total load is divided into ten or five concentrated loads equal to each other q1-q10 and p1-p5; the loads uniformly distributed are applied on the power transmission line to carry out a simulation test on an isolated-span in the following four operating modes: 30 percent of load is discharged; 50 percent of load is discharged; 70 percent of load is discharged; 100 percent of load is discharged; simulation tests are carried out on continuous spans in the following three operating modes: 50 percent of loads on the two spans is discharged; 100 percent of the load on one span is discharged; and no load on the other span is discharged; 100 percent of the loads on the two spans is discharged. The tensions and the sags of the power transmission line loaded and unloaded and the skip value when the power transmission line is unloaded are measured in the seven operating modes. The invention has the advantages that experimental bases close to practical situations are provided for the counter-measures to dispose of and guard against ice disasters of power transmission lines, and the reliability of the theoretical analytic and calculation results is verified.

title_en: Video game-based, immersive, advanced burn care educational module
abstract_en: A video game-based medical simulation is provided. Disclosed embodiments pertain to mass-casualty simulation for burn disaster training. Game-play exercises direct a player through a mass-casualty event where triage management and patient assessment are tested, and then follow the player to a Burn Center where resuscitation through patient monitoring, reassessment, and managing are tested for the critical hours/days of recovery. Complication loops are included in the game system to provide random application of variation in patient response. The complication loops can insert semi-randomness of critical complication occurrences into the game such that patient simulation may vary each time the game is played.

title_en: Water-power fire-fighting detachment device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of firefighting appliances, in particular to a forcible entry tool and fire gun combined device powered by a firefighting pressure water source. A water-driven fire attack and forcible entry device is characterized by comprising a reversing valve, a water turbine, a firefighting spray gun and a rotary saw or a drill bit, wherein the reversing valve comprises a water inlet port and two water outlet ports one of which is connected with the firefighting spray gun and the other of which is connection with the water turbine, and the water turbine is connected with the rotary saw or the drill bit. The device solves the problem that the prior high-efficiency forcible entry tool cannot be arranged on a conventional firefighting vehicle.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INST OF THE

title_en: Emergency response personnel organization method and emergency response processing method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency response personnel organizing method and an emergency response processing method and system thereof, which mainly aim at establishing relevant information of field on-duty personnel and qualified training certificates to adapt to sudden work safety accidents.

title_en: Hazard suppression training simulator and method of training
abstract_en: A training simulator including a housing having a prop portion configured to simulate or evoke an appearance of an object encountered in firefighting activity. The simulator has a sensation emitter coupled to the housing and configured to emit a sensation to simulate or evoke an appearance of a hazardous condition. The simulator further includes a sensor coupled to the housing and configured to detect a simulated or an actual hazardous condition suppressant directed at or applied to the housing, and a controller operatively coupled to the sensor and the sensation emitter.

title_en: Aboveground and underground combined heat injection coal bed gas extraction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for extracting coal bed gas by up-hole and down-hole combination, and relates to the technical field of extracting the coal bed gas (or named as gas). The method can solve the technical problem of pre-extracting the coal bed gas of a coal bed, in particular for a low-permeability coal bed. The method for extracting the coal bed gas by the up-hole and down-hole combination comprises the following steps: carrying out vertical drilling into the coal bed from ground to the coal bed, carrying out an extracting channel in the down hole along the coal bed, and then closing the extracting channel to form a down-hole extracting system; and injecting overheating vapor or overheating water from the ground vertical to the coal bed, displacing the coal bed to flow into the down-hole extracting channel along the coal bed, and then transporting the extracted coal bed gas into a ground coal bed gas system. The method overcomes the deficiency of the prior art, can simply, reliably and efficiently pre-extract the coal bed gas of the coal bed, and in particular for the low-permeability coal bed in large areas, and can basically solve the problems of coal mine gas disasters and the coal bed gas exploitation.

title_en: Infrared beam type fire disaster smoke detector and detecting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared light beam type fire smoke detector and a detection method thereof. The detector comprises a MCU core circuit, a power supply circuit, a clock circuit, a keyboard, a display interface, a local communication circuit, a remote communication circuit, a switching value input circuit, a switching value output circuit, an acousto-optical alarm circuit, an analog signal acquisition module and an infrared transmitting and receiving circuit. The detection method is a fuzzy neural network fire detection algorithm, and a fuzzy neural network model adopts a four-layer structure which respectively represents an input layer, division of a fuzzy subspace of the input variable, division of a fuzzy subspace of the fire occurrence probability U, and an output layer; and the generalization ability of the network is improved through the learning and training of the fuzzy neural network, and the trained fuzzy neural network can accuracy judge the current input. The invention can reduce the failure rate when improving the flexibility of the detector simultaneously, has strong anti-interference ability, and greatly improves the reliability of the fire detection system.

title_en: Simulation system to predict accident severity in 3-d
title_ko: 3차원 재해 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: A 3D disaster prediction simulation system is provided to enable a user to perceive a disastrous situation more easily by realistically expressing the dangerous factors which are predicted in advance, through the 3D graphic. A simulation processor(200) comprises the followings: a receiving module(210) for receiving information from an observing unit(100); a database(240) for pre-storing various information between an observed region and a disaster-predicted region; a simulation module(231) for calculating the flooded degree and overflowing degree on river of the disaster-predicted region based on the information which is collected through the receiving module and pre-stored information; and display unit(232) for displaying the calculated result in the 3D cubic image type.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 3차원 재해 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템에 대한 것으로, 특히 관측지역에 설치되어 강우량, 댐방류량, 유속 및 수위에 대한 정보를 수집하는 다수의 관측부와, 상기 관측부로부터 수신한 정보를 이용하여 재해발생예상지역에 미칠 영향을 시뮬레이션을 통해 계산하고, 상기 계산된 시뮬레이션 결과를 3차원으로 디스플레이하는 시뮬레이션처리부를 포함하는 재해 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템에 대한 것이다.  이러한 본 발명은 상기 관측부를 통하여 다수의 관측지역에 대해 실시간으로 모니터링을 실시함으로써 특정 지역에 발생할 수 있는 위험 요소들을 미리 예측할 수 있고, 이를 단순한 수치가 아니라 3차원 그래픽을 통해 사실적으로 표현함으로써 더욱 용이하게 재해 발생 상황을 파악할 수 있게 한다.  
       
     재해 예측, 시뮬레이션 시스템, 3차원 그래픽

title_en: Deterioration evaluating method of cover material layer
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a deterioration evaluating method of a cover material layer capable of clearly judging the deterioration degree of a refractory cover material layer or the like applied to the inner wall surface or the like of a tunnel and capable of simply judging the deterioration degree in a short time on the spot using a relatively simple measuring jig.  <P>SOLUTION: A lower hole 10 is bored in the refractory cover material layer 2 up to predetermined depth from the surface thereof by a drill or the like and the male screw 11a of a hanging hook 11 is screwed in the lower hole 10 while the hook 13 of a draw load meter 12 is connected to the hook 11b of the hanging hook 11 to be drawn to measure a draw load, that is, the draw strength of the refractory cover material layer 2. The relation between the draw strength and the deterioration degree having a large difference corresponding to the deterioration degree of the refractory cover material layer 2 as compared with compression strength is preliminarily calculated by an experiment or the like and the measured value of the draw load meter 12 is compared and collated with the deterioration degree to judge the deterioration degree of the refractory cover material layer 2. In the disaster caused by the small-scaled fire in the tunnel or the like, the relation between the temperature of the fire and draw strength is used to judge the temperature of the fire.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT
assignees: KAJIMA CORP;TOWA TAIKA KOGYO KK;HORYO SANGYO KK

title_en: City emergency evacuation simulation system based on multi intelligent agent
abstract_en: A city emergency evacuation simulation system based on multi intelligent agent belongs to the complex system simulation in the technical field of computerized emulation and solves the problems of single function of emergency simulation systems of all kinds and lack of intelligence of code of conduct of emergency entity. The system comprise a database module, a communication module, a parameter configuration interface module, a data management module, an intelligent agent generation module, a program execution module, a simulation module, a commanding and decision-making module and an assessment module. The database module comprises a generalized database, a knowledge base and a model base; wherein, the generalized database comprises a dangerous source subdatabase, a resource subdatabase, a foundational geodata subdatabase. The system can establish an efficient intelligent model, describes the precise behavioral process of emergent intelligent agents of all kinds in the state of disasters and emergency from two levels of macroscopy and microcosmic, can custom-make a parameter and expanded intelligent model, has commonality and expansibility, and makes up the shortage and deficiency of the city emergency evacuation simulation study in regionality and comparatively large ranges.

title_en: Self-heating heat pipe
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to heaters, and particularly relates to an internally heating type heat pipe which facilitates the drinking and the use at once and can perform self-heating to milk, wines and liquid beverages in bottles and boxes. The utility model is an approximate test tube-shaped tubular body (1); a vertical reinforcement (5) and a cylindrical bracket (6) are arranged on the inner wall at the lower part of the tubular body; a paper bag filled with calcium oxide (4) is arranged in the bracket; a wafer (7) with holes is arranged at the upper end part of the bracket (6); at least a spike (8) similar to a needle is arranged on the surface of the wafer; and a space capable of accommodating a water bag (3) is reserved between the wafer and an end cover. The utility model has the advantages and remarkable technical effects that: firstly, the heat pipe belongs to the internally heating heat pipes, and the heating heat is completely utilized without loss, so that the heating efficiency is high; secondly, the structure is simple, the manufacture is easy, and the cost is low; thirdly, the application range is wide, and the use is convenient; and fourthly, the heat pipe is used safely and reliably. Furthermore, the product is particularly suitable for field operators and tourists, areas in which the earthquake and the fire disaster happen during embarkation and ride periods, and army camp field training places, frontier guard posts , and places in which polices is on duty .

title_en: Simulation technology of fire and poisonous substance diffusion in building
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problems that simulation by a computer has become a useful means in safety evaluation of a building to occurrence of fire and a poisonous substance and examination of an operation method of safety equipment, however, in a large building in recent years, a wide space in the complicated shape is mixed besides a rectangle sitting-room with the simple shape, evaluation of density distribution is not easy when smoke, the poisonous substance, and heat by the fire occur, namely, a calculation amount becomes huge in the conventional three-dimensional fluid analysis technology, and on the contrary, the complicated shape cannot be coped with practical macro model fluid analysis technology.  <P>SOLUTION: Calculation is efficiently performed by adapting three-dimensional analysis technology to a part required to be simulated in details and adapting the macro model fluid analysis technology to a part for which detailed simulation is unnecessary in consideration of the shape of the building. By an analysis model of a disaster prevention facility in occurrence of the fire and the poisonous substance, its effect is reflected on simulation, and in addition to the case of taking/not taking a measure, an effect like timing of the measure is quantitatively examined.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method and structure for constructing permanent soil-nailed retaining wall by woven fabric bags filled with soil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a structure for constructing a permanent soil-nailed retaining wall by woven fabric bags filled with soil. The invention is characterized in that the soil is firstly taken and filled in woven fabric bags to obtain the woven fabric bags filled with the soil, then the woven fabric bags filled with the soil are arranged for filling to obtain a retaining wall formed by the woven fabric bags filled with the soil; holes are drilled in the retaining wall formed by the woven fabric bags filled with the soil, soil-nailed steel bars and grouting pipes are arranged in the drilled holes, the grouting is carried out by the grouting pipes, and a reinforced concrete surface layer is produced on the outside and the top of the retaining wall formed by the woven fabric bags filled with the soil, thereby obtaining the permanent retaining wall. The invention is applied in emergency repair projects and can carry out the phased construction, the part of forming the retaining wall by the woven fabric bags filled with the soil is firstly constructed, the road traffic is restored, the emergency disaster relief is completed, the grouting, the hole drilling and the concrete surface layer are further constructed after restoring to normal state, and the construction of the permanent retaining wall by the woven fabric bags filled with the soil is finally completed. The project time is short, thereby being capable of meeting the time need of the emergency repair projects. The filling part of the woven fabric bags filled with the soil is taken as an effective component part of the permanent retaining wall and does not need to be removed, thereby saving engineering cost.

title_en: Method for estimating concrete strength of thin-walled structure by using small core sample strength
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating the concrete strength of the thin-walled structure by using the small core sample strength, which belongs to the concrete strength detection of construction projects. The main technical proposal is as follows: a core sample with the diameter of 48mm is drilled from the concrete entity of the thin-walled structure through the cutting and polishing, the compressive strength test is conducted by using an universal material testing machine to obtain a concrete compressive strength value of the small core sample, and the concrete strength of the thin-walled structure is deduced by a correction factor formula. The invention has the advantages of small error and high accuracy, can be applied to the quality control in the construction projects under construction, and the assessment and identification of justice in the existing building and the construction after the disaster.

title_en: Apparatus and method of providing sensory experience of gas explosion by creeping discharge
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an apparatus for providing a sensory experience of gas explosion by creeping discharge, which easily provides an sensory experience of gas explosion and the like caused by creeping discharge, and to provide a method of simulating gas explosion by creeping discharge using the apparatus.  <P>SOLUTION: The apparatus for simulating gas explosion by creeping discharge includes: a pair of electrodes composed of a grounded induction electrode 4 and a discharge electrode 3 arranged in non-contact with the induction electrode 4; an insulation member 5 arranged between the pair of electrodes and producing creeping discharge on its surface; a Van de Graaf generator 2 connected to the discharge electrode 3; and a protection cover 7 which is so arranged as to surround the area wherein the creeping discharge is produced, and through which the inside can be viewed. If a combustible is placed in the area wherein the creeping discharge is produced inside the protection cover 7, the creeping discharge can ignite the combustible. Thus, since the ignition of the combustible by the creeping discharge and the subsequent state of burning/explosion can be viewed through the protection cover 7, a viewer experiences the disaster and the like caused by the creeping discharge and understands well the situation of disasters and the like caused by creeping discharge.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method for calculating strength of structural concrete by strength of core
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating strength of structural concrete by strength of a core, belonging to the concrete strength testing of constructional engineering. The method has the key technical scheme that a core with the diameter of 75 mm is drilled on a structural concrete solid, the core is cut and rubbed down, a universal material tester is used for performing compression test to obtain the concrete compressive strength value of the core, and the structural concrete strength is calculated by a modified coefficient formula. The invention has the advantages of small error and high precision, and can be applied to quality control in construction projects, evaluation and judicial expertise of existed buildings and buildings after disasters.

title_en: Game type virtual reality experience simulator
title_ko: 게임형 가상 현실체험 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: A game type virtual reality experience simulator is provided to allow a user to learn management of a disaster in advance by displaying a danger of accident and disaster to the user. A base(100) supports a virtual reality experience simulator, and a front assembly(200) outputs an image related to a disaster. A rear assembly unit(300) senses the movement of a user while being installed on the other side of the base, and the base comprises a foothold which rotates so that user can mark time. The front assembly unit includes a display unit displaying an image related to a disaster and an interaction unit which is moved according to the movement of the user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각종 재난재해와 관련된 영상을 통해 재난재해의 위력 및 위험성을 인식함과 동시에 재난재해의 대응방법 및 대피요령을 게임을 통해 가상으로 미리 체험하여 숙지할 수 있는 게임형 가상 현실체험 시뮬레이터로서, 가상 현실체험 시뮬레이터를 지면에 지지하는 베이스; 상기 베이스의 일측에 설치되어 재난재해와 관련된 영상을 출력함과 동시에 재난재해와 관련된 효과를 연출하는 전방 조립체 및 상기 베이스의 타측에 설치되어 체험자의 전후진 및 상하좌우에 따른 움직임 신호를 감지하는 후방 조립체를 포함하여, 각종 재난재해의 발생원인, 인명사고 및 경제적 손실을 사전에 예방 및 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Sub-pixel spatial mapping method based on spatial correlation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sub-pixel spatial mapping method based on spatial correlation, which comprises the step of calculating the spatial distribution of a basic component in pixels, namely sub-pixels by utilizing area vector or abundance ratio of mixed pixels and components (end members) of neighbor pixels of the mixed pixels so as to simulate a land feature boundary which is more detailed than that by a common remote sensing classification method. The method has the advantages of wide practicability, high analog simulation and the like, and is suitable for topographical information extraction and topographical data mining work such as target extraction by remote sensing data, monitoring of land resource utilization change, evaluation of environmental pollution, analysis of natural disasters and the like.

title_en: Safety guarantee system of mining production and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a new technology for designing a group of a safety guarantee system and a production equipment system of mining production. One of the technical design which can avoid and reduce the lose of sudden disasters such as mining production gas, water, and the like, comprises the following parts of planning partitioning composite mining, pre-mining gas, multi-way and multi-series air discharging, pipeline preventing, mining passage, self-help room for avoiding disaster, etc. The invention also has an inner-alley passage with the new function of a support frame and a multi-support wheel digging drill, uses a new comprehensive technical design to better avoid and help the sudden disaster of the mining production, and has various good benefits.

title_en: Scientific method for training dogs to exterminating rats
abstract_en: The invention provides a scientific method for training dogs to exterminating rats, which belongs to the technical field of biological (ecological or animal) rat extermination. The method is mainly characterized in that the work for disinfection, sterilization, disease prevention, epidemic prevention and protection needs to be well done in time; the dogs are scientifically cultured, taught and trained to enable the dogs to initiatively attack and kill rats; and scientific harmless treatment needs to be performed on the killed rats. The main application and aim of the method are to innovate a scientific biological (ecological or animal) rat extermination technique which is non-toxic, simple, free from power consumption, low in cost, particularly efficient in rat extermination and capable of enabling the dogs to initiatively attack and kill a large number of rats. The method has the advantages of achieving the aim of scientifically exterminating a large number of rats, greatly contributing to the elimination of rat disasters and benefiting human society.

title_en: Tent shower washroom
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tent shower washroom, which comprises a tent. The tent comprises a frame, roof tent cloth and side tent cloth; a squatting pan and a shower are arranged in the tent, wherein the squatting pan comprises a squatting frame and a square box urinal which is arranged thereunder, and the shower comprises a pedal frame and a shower head which is arranged thereon. The utility model also has the following technical scheme: a urinating device which comprises a urinal hung on the side tent cloth and a urine barrel arranged thereunder is arranged in the tent; a separation curtain is arranged between the squatting pan and the shower; a solar panel is arranged on the roof tent cloth of the tent; and a solar lamp which is matched with the solar panel is arranged in the tent. The utility model has the characteristics of easy pitching and collection, repeated use, sanitary and environment-friendly performance, low building cost and convenient management and use. The tent shower washroom is especially suitable for being used as a temporary emergency sanitary facility for places with sudden natural disasters, field construction sites and field training of armies.

title_en: Earthquake warning maneuver device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of disaster maneuver, in particular to an earthquake warning maneuver device, which facilitates the emergency evacuation drilling and further improves the earthquake maneuver quality. The earthquake warning maneuver device comprises a maneuver controller, and a plurality of earthquake intensity warning devices distributed and fixed on the internal wall body or on the ground in the same region. The maneuver controller is connected with the earthquake intensity warning devices through wired telecommunication or wireless telecommunication. The utility model further utilizes the earthquake intensity monitoring and warning device arranged in the building and used for monitoring whether the earthquake occurs in the district the building located, carries out the earthquake maneuver and has a reasonable structure. The warning of the earthquake intensity monitoring and warning device during the maneuver is the same with the warning generated in the practical earthquake, and the maneuver is vivid, therefore, the earthquake warning maneuver device is frequently utilized for maneuver, and conditioned reflex can be formed in the public; when the earthquake occurs really, the people can quickly avoid danger.

title_en: Urban-evacuation simulation method based on multi-resolution images
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban-evacuation simulation method based on multi-resolution images, which is characterized in that scene modeling is taken as a starting point; urban-evacuation simulation scenes based on the multi-resolution images are established; and the simulation scenes are combined with the prior various methods of simulating human behavior so as to form the evacuation simulation method universal in the filed of urban-evacuation simulation. In the application of the method, on the one hand, evacuation simulation based on the multi-resolution images needs to concretely analyze different urban disaster environments, and correspondingly the concrete process of generating the multi-resolution images is changed according to settings of needed disaster-evaluation fine degree; on the other hand, the method is combined with the prior evacuation simulation method, and the prior people-evacuation decision simulation method is implemented on a scene model of the invention so as toform a complete evacuation simulation system.

title_en: 3 A computer game education tool digital 3D for traffic safety education
title_ko: 교통안전교육 및 생활안전교육을 위한 안전교육용 3차원 디지털 게임 학습기
abstract_ko:
본 고안 물인  <교통안전 및 기타 안전교육을 위한 3D디지털 게임 학습기> 는 본인이 제출하여 실용신안 등록 후 소멸 되었던 교통안전 가상체험 가상 시물레이터(소멸:20-0418851)와 교통안전교육용 입체영상 삼차원 시뮬레이터(소멸:20-0418843)처럼 동영상이 아닌 3D 그래픽 데이터를 게임프로그래밍으로 실시간 동영상 제어방식의 게임 학습기로서 한시적으로 고정된 장소(전시관 등)에 설치하여 특정  장소에서만 3D디지털 체험 학습교육이 가능하게 만들어진 것으로 제한되지 않고 일반 컴퓨터에 소프트웨어와 하드웨어를 연결 하여, 가정, 학교컴퓨터실, 유치원에서도 손 쉽게 컴퓨터 또는 모니터가 부착된 기기에 안전교육 게임 소프트웨어와 하드웨어를 설치하여 학습할 수 있도록 새롭게 고안된 안전교육 전용 게임 학습기이다.내용 면에서는 실제로 3D 가상현실에서 학습 사용자가 3D게임화면에서 선정한  대리캐릭터, 또는 대리운전자를 조종하여 각종 사고 현장(10대 보행자    교통사고 상   황, 조기 운전교육 등) 각종 사고 상황을 안전하게 캐릭터를   조종하면서 학습하고 안전교육게임을 진행하면서 얻은 점수를 토대로, 지금까지 수치화하기 힘들었던 개인의 안전학습 정도를 측정할 수 있고 평가 이수시킬 수 있는 기능이 추가되어 있다.    
     본 고안 물인 3D디지털 게임 학습기는 주로 교통안전교육의 내용으로 구성되며  3D 가상 현실 그래픽과 게임프로그래밍이 결합 된 소프트웨어와 이 그래픽 게임 영상을 조작하기 위한 컴퓨터와 연동 되는 핸들, 그리고 멈춤 ,전진, 등을 구현할  수 있는 기능과 각종 사고상황 학습구성요소를 자유롭게 선택할 수 있는 버튼이 포함된 자동차 기어 형 조작기로 구성된 일반 보급형 최첨단 3D디지털 안전학습 게임기이다.   
     또한 소방 및, 방재 체험 3D게임컨텐츠를 첨가하여  교통안전교육은 물론 다양한 생활안전교육을 게임을 즐기며, 체험하듯이  안전교육을 즐길 수 있도록 고안되었다. 
     
     도로, 건물, 교통신호등, 횡단 보도 등이 포함된 안전교육 3D 가상현실 그래 픽데이터, 게임프로그래밍, 하드웨어프로그래밍, 자동차 형 핸들, 자동차 기어형 게임 조작기, 안전교육 점수부여(게임점수) 후 해당점수 획득하면 안전교육 이수 자격증 부여.

title_en: Cup equipped self generating and heating device
title_ko: 발전 가열식 보온 컵
abstract_en: A warm-keeping cup is provided to heat a drink without additional energy sources such as timber, gasoline, gas and petroleum. A warm-keeping cup comprises the following units. A cap(2) is assembled with the top of a housing(1), which represents a container for drinking water or beverages. The circumferential surface of the joint of the cap and housing has a plurality of sealing projections. The cap includes a steam outlet(4) through which the steams generated from the water or beverage is exhausted to the outside. A heating element with a plurality of heat radiating units is screw-assembled with a heating element assembling hole positioned in the center of the housing. An electric heater is prepared in a heater assembling hole located inside the heating element.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 등산 낚시와 같은 야외활동, 특수목적의 군사훈련, 각종 단체활동, 재난과 같은 비상상황 발생시에 별도의 에너지원 없이 물을 가열하여 생명을 유지할 수 있도록 해주는 발전 가열식 보온 컵에 관한 내용이다.

title_en: The method of simulating the evacuation environment on fire using the translucent eye-patch
title_ko: 화재 피난실험시 불투명 안대를 이용한 화재피난환경 모사(模寫)방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A simulation method of fire evacuation environment using a translucent eye patch in a fire evacuation experiment is provided to perform a fire evacuation experiment without generation of smoke through a smoke generator and a hot-air gun. CONSTITUTION: A simulation method of fire evacuation environment using a translucent eye patch in a fire evacuation experiment performs a visibility inhibition effect without direct smoke generation by wearing a translucent eye patch. A fold of a translucent vinyl material performs a visibility inhibition environment of various smoke densities including an evacuation limit smoke density by using a principle in which transmissivity of a light is reduced according to increase of the number of folded surfaces. A change of exposure through the translucent eye patch according to a distance of a medium is different from exposure due to real smoke. The difference is converted into exposure by the real smoke through relation of the distance and the smoke density about attenuation factor of the light.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재피난실험시 불투명 안대를 사용한 화재피난환경을 모사(模寫)하는 방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 화재시 발생하는 연기에 의한 시각적 장애현상을 빛 투과율을 일정하게 감쇠시키는 반투명 소재를 이용하여 안대를 제작한 후 피험자의 눈 부위에 착용시킴으로써, 화재시 피난자들이 연기입자에 의한 빛의 차폐효과 때문에 투과거리가 저하되어 재실자의 가시거리 또는 표식을 식별할 수 있는 거리가 저하(이하 “시정저해”라 칭함)되는 환경을 직접적인 연기발생 없이 불투명 안대를 사용하여 재현할 수 있도록 하는 화재피난환경 모사(模寫) 방법에 관한 것이다.  
     이를 위하여 본 발명은 화재시 연기로 인한 시정저해환경을 직접적인 연기의 발생 없이 화재피난환경 모사(模寫)하는 것에 있어서, 반투명 비닐 소재를 여러 장 포개어 안대로 제작(이하 “불투명 안대”로 칭함)한 후 피험자에게 착용시킴으로써 화재 피난시 시정저해효과를 구현하고, 불투명 안대를 통한 일률적인 감광의 경우 매질의 거리에 따른 변화가 실제 연기로 인한 감광과는 차이점이 있으나 빛의 세기 변화, 연기농도, 거리의 관계를 통해 실제 연기농도를 나타내는 감광계수 값으로 환산을 하고, 반투명 비닐 소재의 포개는 면의 수가 증가함에 따라 빛의 투과율이 낮아지는 원리를 이용하여 피난한계 연기농도를 포함한 여러 단계의 연기농도를 가지는 화재피난환경을 모사(模寫)할 수 있으며, 화재피난환경 모사(模寫)시 공간의 규모와 형태와 상관없이 일정한 연기농도에 의한 시정저해효과를 유지시킬 수 있도록 고안된 방법이다.

title_en: Nozzle safety training device
abstract_en: A safety device includes a first loop arranged around a handle of a nozzle. A second loop is arranged around a body of the nozzle and adjoins the first loop via a first strip of material. A second strip of material extends across the second loop. A first strip of material includes a fastener for creating a third loop that prevents a bale of the nozzle from being opened. The safety device may include a visual indicator arranged at a free end of the first strip of material for indicating that a firefighting crew maintaining the nozzle has passed inspection and the type of agent the fire hose expels.

title_en: Tent toilet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tent toilet, which comprises a tent, wherein the tent consists of a framework and tent cloth; a urinal and a squatting pan are arranged in the tent; the tent is rectangular at the ridge top; ventilation lighting windows which are fabricated with mesh fabric are arranged on the tent cloth at both sides below the ridge top of the tent; the squatting pan is assembled with an upper frame body, two sector plates and a Y-shaped mandril; the two sector plates are articulated at both sides below the upper frame body; and the Y-shaped mandril is assembled with a return spring. A closestool is also arranged in the tent and comprises a commode chair and a commode pool below the commode chair; a solar panel is arranged on the top surface of the tent; and a solar light which is matched with the solar panel is arranged in the tent. The tent toilet has the characteristics of convenient building and removing, recycled use, convenient transportation, sanitation and environmental friendliness, and low configuration cost, and is particularly applicable to areas with sudden natural disasters, field construction site and field battle training for troops as temporary toilet.

title_en: Physical simulation experiment method and device for monitoring shearing force of seismic fault plane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical simulation experiment method and a physical simulation experiment device for monitoring shearing force of an earthquake-generating fault surface. The shearing force variation process of the undetectable fault plane is deduced by using the measurable disturbance force and the corresponding functional relation, and the advanced and real-time early warning and forecasting of the earthquake disaster are really realized. The whole structure is reasonable in design, convenient to use and vivid in simulation effect.

title_en: Landslide advancing sliding force physical simulation experimental method and device therefor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide advancing sliding force physical simulation experimental method and a device therefor. A stress sensor is utilized to detect the inner stress change of a sliding body on an inclined plane of a sliding bed model, and the curve of the relationship between the magnitudes of the sliding force applied on the sliding body before sliding, in sliding and after sliding and the time can be determined by combining the data of displacement of the sliding body detected by a displacement sensor, so that the value of the curve and the inner stress can be displayed; when in subsection alarm, the detection and the display of the advancing sliding data of the sliding body can be completed, so that the advanced and real-time pre-warning and warning of landslide geological disaster can be really realized. The whole device is reasonable in design and convenient for use, and completely imitates the whole process of landslide for simulate monitoring and information processing; the drawn monitoring curve is authentic, vivid and reliable; an electronic display device can visually and conveniently display the value of the stress, so that the change characteristics of the sliding force in the whole process of landslide can be fully reflected, and the simulation is accurate and vivid.

title_en: Emergency drinking water purifying and processing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an emergency drinking water purifying and processing device, which aims to realize a compact process line, be suitable for the assembly and the vehicle-borne arrangement, and timely provide domestic water and drinking water. The device consists of a preprocessing section, a separating section and a secondary purifying section. The preprocessing section adopts the process that the sterilizing chlorine and the coagulant are measured through a channel according to the pipeline sewage flow and injected into a sewage pipeline; the separating section formed by a cyclone separator is connected with an coagulant outputting pipeline; a coagulant injecting channel is connected with the coagulant outputting pipeline; and the primary purifying water of the cyclone separator is output to a secondary purifying section, that is, the pipeline is connected with a multimedia filter and divided into two branches, wherein one branch is connected with a water tank for domestic consumption, and the other branch is connected with a reverse osmosis apparatus, a sterilizer and a filter for outputting purified water. The technical scheme has the characteristics of short processing art flow, compact pipeline construction and applicability to the vehicle-borne transportation, and can fully meet the requirement of providing purified water under the conditions like natural disasters, large-scale filed works, army field trainings, army battles and the like.
assignees: DANDONG HENGCHENG ENVIRONMENTAL PROT TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Open water training clothing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to open water training clothing which comprises a coat, wherein the coat is formed by a front part and a back part; the front part and the back part are connected at the shoulder sites; the front part is provided with six pockets which are symmetrically arranged on the upper, middle and lower portions respectively left and right; the back part is provided with four pockets which are in symmetrically arranged on the upper and the lower portions respectively left and right; a laminated foamed sheet is arranged inside each pocket and matched with the pocket; two vertical draw strings are arranged on the outside wall of the coat; an adjusting fastener is arranged on each vertical draw string in the position of the lower end of the front part; one or two groups of transverse draw strings are arranged between the front and the back parts; each group of transverse draw strings are tied on the front part through the corresponding string loops; and one end of each group of transverse draw strings is fixedly connected on the lateral edge of the back part and an adjusting insert is arranged at the other end thereof. The open water training clothing has unique function of rescue and self-rescue from stormy wave, swift water, flood disaster and emergency during military marine operation and training, marine police special operation, motor boat training and flyboat training.

title_en: Lower limb rehabilitation medical robot used for paralytic patient
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lower limb rehabilitation medical robot used for a paralytic patient, belonging to the field of rehabilitation medical apparatuses. The lower limb rehabilitation medical robot comprises a base, a lower limb rehabilitation training device and a computer control system. The robot is combined with a rehabilitation science theory and a man-machine cooperation robot principle, integrated with active, passive, power-assisting and master-slave trainings into one body and can be used for carrying out rehabilitation trainings of lower limbs and related joints of the paralytic patient caused by heart cerebrovascular disease, or accidents and natural disasters, and the like. The lower limb rehabilitation medical robot is controlled by a computer and correspondingly provided with a sensor and a safety system, automatically carries out the rehabilitation training under the set procedures and has the characteristics of intelligence, quantification and individuality; the robot can design an optimal motive traction track and plan an intelligent path for different patients at different rehabilitation steps, automatically evaluate the rehabilitation training effect and regulate motion parameters according to actual situations of the patient, thereby realizing the optimal rehabilitation training.

title_en: Method and apparatus for virtual disaster confrontation training program operating
title_ko: 가상 비상 대응 훈련 프로그램을 운영하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method and an apparatus for operating a virtual emergency confrontation training program are provided to simply assemble preset detail training items of the virtual emergency confrontation training program to design a training. CONSTITUTION: A method for operating a virtual emergency confrontation training program comprises the following steps. Specific training scenario information is generated by at least one training item. An authentication request signal about the generated training scenario information is transmitted to at least one manager terminal(100). The specific training scenario information which is completely authenticated according to the authentication request signal is transmitted to at least one participant terminal(300).
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 가상 비상 대응 훈련 프로그램을 운영하는 방법은 특정 훈련 시나리오 정보를 하나 이상의 훈련 항목을 이용하여 생성하는 단계, 상기 생성된 특정 훈련 시나리오 정보에 대한 승인 요청 신호를 하나 이상의 관리자 단말기로 전송하는 단계, 상기 승인 요청 신호에 따라 승인 완료된 상기 특정 훈련 시나리오 정보를 하나 이상의 참가자 단말기로 전송하는 단계, 상기 각 참가자 단말기로부터 상기 특정 훈련 시나리오 정보에 대한 임무 수행 내역 정보를 수신하는 단계, 상기 임무 수행 내역 정보를 상기 관리자 단말기로 전송하여, 상기 임무 수행 내역 정보에 대한 상기 각 참가자 단말기의 훈련 평가 정보를 상기 관리자 단말기로부터 수신하는 단계, 상기 수신된 훈련 평가 정보를 분석하여 훈련 결과 정보를 생성하는 단계 및 상기 생성된 훈련 결과 정보를 상기 각 참가자 단말기로 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.  
       
     가상 훈련, 화재, 유출, 주유소

title_en: Training plan preparation support device, training plan preparation support system, training plan preparation support method, and computer program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a training plan preparation support device capable of efficiently preparing a high quality attached plan list and attachment card excellent in a data attachment balance.  <P>SOLUTION: The training plan preparation support device 1 for supporting to prepare an attached plan list table and attachment card to be used in a role-playing type disaster training exercise includes a database 18 in which subject information showing subjects of situations, attached content information, attached time information, attachment source information, and attachment destination information are registered in each of a plurality of situations about a disaster while associated with one another, a means for respectively generating an attached plan table obtained by collecting the plurality of situations, an attached plan list table in which the plurality of situations are arranged in the order of time series by attached destination and by attached time on the basis of information of database 18 , and an attachment card in each attachment destination and attached time on the basis of information of the database 18, an input device 15 for displaying the generated attached plan table, attached plan list table, or attachment card to receive edition of the database 18, and a printer 16 for outputting the generated attached plan list table and attachment card.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method for estimating temperature of near-surface air from MODIS data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for estimating the temperature of near-surface air near from MODIS data, which can be used for remote sensing application departments, i.e. weather, environmental monitoring, land management, agricultural monitoring, disaster monitoring, and the like. The method comprises three steps: step1: utilizing the near-surface temperature and the emission rate of each pixel of a MODIS data product and the water vapour content value of atmosphere as priori knowledge and input parameters of atmosphere radiation transmission module simulation software MODTRAN4, carrying out forward direction simulation in different areas and seasons aiming at a 29th thermal infrared band, a 31st thermal infrared band and a 32nd thermal infrared band of each pixel of the obtained remote sensing data MODIS and establishing a training and testing database; step2: utilizing a neural network to repeatedly training and testing a training and testing dataset; step3: carrying out back calculation for practical image data of the MODIS to obtain the temperature distribution condition of the air near the earth's surface of an objective area of the earth's surface. The method can be used for weather prognosis, the environmental monitoring, the agricultural monitoring, the disaster monitoring, and the like.
assignees: INST AGRI RESOURCES CAAS;NAT SATELLITE METEOROL CT

title_en: Structure combining fire engine house with training tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a factory-used structure combining a fire engine house with a training tower. The structure comprises a fire engine house (1) and is characterized in that a training tower (2) is arranged nearby the fire engine house (1), and connected with a staircase or a corridor of the fire engine house (1). The factory-used structure combines the fire engine house (1) with the training tower to form an integral overall arrangement, utilizes the connection of the fire engine house and the training tower, saves the land for factory use, and reduces the road-paving area and the pipeline-laying length. As to the fire-fighting operation, the factory-used structure has following advantages: on the one hand, the fire fighters can conveniently pass in and out from the house to the training tower, and the training quality is improved; on the other hand, the fire fighter can climb to the top of the tower for the warning, observe the condition of fire disaster, and find out the reasons causing the fire disaster; and meanwhile, the fire fighters can lift the cleaned training pipelines to a patio in the middle of the interior of the tower for suspension airing.

title_en: Lab control system for firefighting combustion training
abstract_en: A lab control system for firefighting combustion training comprises a gas supply area, a pressure flow area, a combustion area and a control area. The gas supply area comprises a gas bottle, a hand valve and a collecting buffer area, and mixing and buffering of system gas can be finished in the gas supply area. The pressure flow area comprises a pressure reducer, a pressure sensor, an electromagnetic valve general control, a proportion regulator, a redundancy electromagnetic valve, a flow sensor, a combustible gas leakage detector and a temperature sensor, the mixing gas in the gas supply area is decompressed and regulated, and then the gas is transmitted to a combustible gas and air mixing area of the combustion area. The combustion area comprises the combustible gas and air mixing area, a combustion bed, a 3-grade igniting device, a temperature sensor, an oxygen supply device and a combustion gas leakage detector, and the combustion area provides reliable mixing gas for 3-grade combustion and flashover on the combustion bed. The control area controls the pressure flow area and the combustion area. The lab control system for firefighting combustion training can create different real fire environments, ensure the trained firefighters to obtain actual experience of fire scenes and provide a safety guarantee system for the firefighters.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INST MINISTRY OF PUBLIC SECURITY

title_en: Earthquake simulator
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake simulator, which comprises a platform. The earthquake simulator is characterized in that the platform is arranged on a base with a concave-and-convex surface via moving devices on the platform, and the platform is connected with a crank link mechanism which is connected with a power unit. The earthquake simulator can simulate earthquake reality feeling formed after superposing transverse seismic waves and longitudinal seismic waves in earthquakes, people can experience direct feeling in earthquakes vividly, thereby building defending emergency capacity when meeting sudden natural disasters such as earthquakes. The earthquake simulator is particularly favorable for students, through vivid teaching simulation tests, students can learn life, survival and living and set up right values of life, survival and living, thereby making life more significant and valuable. In addition, the earthquake simulator is simple in structure, reliable in performance, vivid in simulation and strong in earthquake reality feeling. Moreover, the transmission components of the earthquake are high in transmission efficiency and save energy.

title_en: A simulation system for experiencing misfortune
title_ko: 재난 체험 모의 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster simulation system is provided to learn environment due to disaster by enabling a user to open a door and behave according to the disaster condition. CONSTITUTION: A disaster simulation system comprises entrance and exit panels(101,102), an earthquake experience section(110), a fire experience section(120), a control section(130), and a connection panel(103). The entrance and exit panel comprises a door(101a,102a) opened and closed for entrance and exit. An earthquake experience section has a panel for an earthquake(111). The panel for an earthquake senses the motion of the user and implements the situation on collapse of a building due to earthquake. The fire experience section has a panel(121) for fire and a panel(122) for smoke emission. The control section has a control panel(131) in which a control panel is installed. The control panel controls the situation by applying power on the panel for earthquake, the panel for the fire and the panel for smoke emission.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Synthesis safety experience simulator
title_ko: 종합 안전체험 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A synthesis safety experience simulator is provided to prevent the cause of disaster generation, life accident and economic loss through virtual experience. CONSTITUTION: An upper case(100) includes a base assembly(110), a rear assembly(120) and a front assembly(130). An experiencing person marks time on the base assembly. The rear assembly senses the right/left/up/down motions of the experiencing person. The front assembly outputs an image related to a disaster and makes an effect related to the disaster. A lower case(200) is installed at a lower part of the upper case to rotate the upper case in left and right directions.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 영상출력부로부터 출력되는 화재, 풍수해 및 지진과 관련된 가상체험 영상을 보면서 각각의 재난상황을 이해하고 재난 속에서 체험자가 올바른 대처요령을 사전에 체험하여 숙지할 수 있는 종합 안전체험 시뮬레이터에 관한 것으로, 체험자가 올라서서 제자리 걸음할 수 있게 하는 베이스 조립체와, 상기 베이스 조립체의 일단에 일체로 기립 설치되어 체험자의 상하 좌우 움직임 신호를 감지하여 출력하는 후방 조립체와, 상기 베이스 조립체의 타단에 일체로 기립 설치되어 재난재해와 관련된 영상을 출력함과 동시에 재난재해와 관련된 효과를 연출하는 전방 조립체를 구비하는 상부 케이스 및 상기 상부 케이스의 하부에 설치되어 상기 상부 케이스를 좌우 회전시키는 하부 케이스를 포함한다.

title_en: Firefighting simulation experiment platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a firefighting simulation experiment platform, which comprises an experiment platform. The experiment platform is respectively provided with a water tank and a blowing channel. The water tank is arranged on the table of the experiment platform. An air inlet of the blowing channel is connected with a blower, and the water tank extends out from an air outlet of the blowing channel. The air outlet of the blowing channel is also provided with a red cloth so that the red cloth can form virtual flame when the blower is blowing. The experiment platform utilizes the blowerto blow the red cloth as the virtual flame, people can use the fire extinguisher to aim at the virtual flame to spray water to put out the fire and at the same time the water falls down into the watertank. The whole structure of the utility model is simple and reasonable, and not only can lead people to experience personally and master the extinguishment skills, but also cannot be limited by highequipment cost, experiment places and the like.

title_en: Earthquake simulator for quakeproof exercise
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake simulator for quakeproof exercise, which comprises a simulation cabin (1), a base platform (9) located under the simulation cabin (1) and a cabin swinging device located between the simulation cabin and the base platform, wherein the cabin swinging device comprises a transversal swinging device and a longitudinal swinging device. title_en: Experence room for guiding the emergency escape
title_ko: 피난 유도 체험장
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 피난 유도 체험장에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 갑작스런 정전이나 화재 등 사고로 인하여 실내 조명을 할 수 없는 위급상황이 발생했을 경우에 당황하지 않고 신속하게 상황에 대처할 수 있는 능력을 배양하여 인명피해를 최소화하기 위한 실전 체험 훈련을 시킬 수 있는 피난 유도 체험장에 관한 것이다.

abstract_ko:
본 고안은 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 고안은, 화재감지 시스템으로부터 화재발생 위치정보를 포함하는 화재발생신호를 수신하는 수신부; 텍스트로 구성되고 편집 가능한 화재방송 시나리오를 적어도 하나 이상 포함하는 시나리오 데이터베이스를 저장하는 저장부; 상기 화재발생 위치정보에 따른 대피경로를 획득하고, 상기 화재발생 위치정보와 상기 획득된 대피경로를 상기 화재발생 시나리오에 반영함으로써 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하는 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부; TTS 엔진을 이용하여 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하는 음성 변환부; 상기 음성 변환부에서 변환된 음성을 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하는 제1 전송부; 화재발생 정보를 소방서로 전송하는 제2 전송부; 및 상기 화재감지 시스템으로부터 상기 화재발생신호를 수신한 경우, 상기 시나리오 데이터베이스를 참조하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 부합하는 화재방송 시나리오를 검색하고, 상기 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부를 제어하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 따라 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하고, 상기 음성 변환부를 제어하여 상기 구성된 화재방송용 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하여 상기 제1 전송부를 통해 상기 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하고, 상기 제2 전송부를 통해 상기 화재발생 정보를 상기 소방서로 전송하는 제어부를 포함하는 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템을 제공한다. 
     
     화재 감지, 화재방송 시나리오, 화재방송용 텍스트, TTS, 구내 방송, 화재발생 정보, 다국어

title_en: High pressure pulsating water-injecting device for preventing coal or rock dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high pressure pulsating water-injecting device for preventing coal or rock dynamic disaster, which comprises a high pressure water supplying system, a pulse pressure water outputting system and a pneumatic frequency adjustment control system, wherein the pulse pressure water outputting system is connected with the high pressure water supplying system and the pneumaticfrequency adjustment control system respectively and is controlled by the pneumatic frequency adjustment control system to impulse-outpour high pressure water supplied by the high pressure water supplying system. By injecting pulse high pressure water into coal beds, i.e., injecting the water with pressure changing periodically, and leading the water to permeate into different crannies and pores,coal mechanical property changes to the utmost, thus being beneficial to exhausting high pressure free gas, reducing the content of the gas in the coal, improving safety factor and lowering or eliminating protruding and impacting hazard of coal beds. The whole pulsating water-injecting device has simple structure, convenient use, reliable operation and good control efficiency, and is especially suitable for being used in hole-drilling and water-infusing processes of various coal beds.

title_en: Ubiquitous guard system and service using helmet-type instrument
title_ko: 헬멧 형 유비쿼터스 안전관리 시스템 및 서비스
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A helmet type ubiquitous safety management system and a service thereof are provided to offer a ubiquitous safety management service by measuring a safety state of a target person and transferring a measurement result through USN(Ubiquitous Sensor Network). CONSTITUTION: Target persons(100) for safety management wear helmet type safety management equipments(200). A training and operation radius(600) is an activity radius of the target persons wearing the safety management equipments. A first monitor uses an armband type monitoring terminal(500). A second monitor(450) performs central safety management in a remote place.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 헬멧 형태의 유비쿼터스 안전관리 시스템을 이용해 대상인(예를 들어 군인, 소방수, 경찰, 공사장 인부 및 헬멧 착용 운동 선수)의 안전 상태를 측정하고 그 결과 또는(그리고) 그에 대한 해석(예를 들어 사고 발생 유무)을 유비쿼터스 센서 네트워크(USN)를 이용하여 감시자의 감시 장비 혹은 중앙 감시시스템 서버에 전달하여, 유비쿼터스 안전관리 서비스를 제공하기 위해 시스템과 그 서비스에 관한 것이다. 
      발명에 해당하는 시스템은 가속도, 심박수, 뇌파, 위치 정보, 온도, 습도 계측이 가능한 센서들의 조합과 지능형 알고리즘을 내장한 계측 장비이며, 그 형태는 대상인이 착용하는 헬멧의 전두부 안쪽에 장착되어 대상인의 이마 부위에서 피부와 접촉되는 형태이다.   
      안전감시 프로그램을 이용한 이벤트 분석(사고 발생 시 경고 신호 발생, 평상시 주기적인 측정)결과를 유비쿼터스 센서 네트워크 기술을 이용하여 전송하며, 사용 환경(훈련시, 일상시, 작전시)에 따라 감시자 및 관리자 등에게 휴대폰을 이용한 문자 메시지나 혹은 전용 단말기를 통한 정보 메세지를 송출하여, 대상인의 상태에 따른 빠른 조치가 가능하도록 하여 그 결과 사망 가능성을 줄이거나 소생률을 향상시킨다. 
       
       헬멧 형태, 안전 관리, 유비쿼터스 센서네트워크(USN), 군인, 소방수, 경찰, 운동선수

title_en: System and method for analyzing effectiveness of distributing emergency supplies in the event of disasters
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method and system in one embodiment estimate the effectiveness of a dispensing plan of emergency supplies during disasters or in like scenarios, by simulating a flow of emergency supplies in a multi-echelon supply chain, dynamics of victims and progression of disaster. title_en: Intelligentized underground ore body stopping ground pressure disaster monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligentized underground ore body stopping ground pressure disaster monitoring system which comprises a monitoring underground chamber arranged in a horizontal underground mined out space; holes are drilled according to certain intervals on the palisades of the peripheral tunnel of the horizontal mined out space at different underground depth, wherein the depth ofthe holes is 5 to 8 meters; different areas are divided, bore holes on the palisades of different areas are internally provided with a sound emitting probe and a peg measuring or wire vibration sensor respectively, and the bore holes are internally filled with cement or anchoring agent for fixation; signal output wires of the sound emitting probe and the peg measuring or wire vibration sensor arerespectively accessed to a sound emitting monitor, a convergence meter and a wire vibration type borehole stressmeter to respectively form a sound emitting monitoring network, a stress monitoring network and a displacement monitoring network; and the sound emitting monitoring network, the stress monitoring network and the displacement monitoring network are respectively connected with an earth surface monitoring station. The system can carry out real-time detection and data processing to the changes of rock stress and displacement as well as tunnel convergence in the underground mined out space, thus realizing forecasting and early warning on collapse of the mined out space.
