title_ko: 터널화재 위험도의 예측시스템
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 터널 위험도의 예측시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 터널 화재발생 시나리오 및 이에 따른 사고발생율을 추정하기 위한 단계; 화재발생시 터널내 차량의 정체길이 및 차량수를 분석하는 단계; 차량내 대피자의 대피시간을 측정하는 단계; 터널내 온도 및 유해가스 농도를 측정하는 단계; 및 FED(fractional effective dose) 측정 단계를 포함하는, 터널화재 위험도의 예측시스템에 관한 것이다.  본 고안의 터널화재 위험도의 예측시스템을 사용하면 다양한 터널의 위험도를 정량적으로 평가할 수 있으므로, 안전한 터널구축을 위한 공사 내지는 완공된 터널의 보완하는 활용될 수 있다. 
       
     터널 위험도, 터널화재, FED

title_en: Exercise equipment for fat-control with low noise
title_ko: 저소음 체지방조절 운동기
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 자기력을 이용하여 시소방식으로 진동을 발생시켜 운동효과를 얻을 수 있도록 한 저소음 체지방조절 운동기에 관한 것으로서, 좌·우측 둘레부 하방에 한 쌍 이상의 영구자석이 좌·우 대칭되게 고정되어, 좌·우를 양분하는 지지축 결합부를 기준으로 좌·우측이 시소(seesaw)방식으로 상하 진동하는 진동플레이트; 상기 진동플레이트의 지지축 결합부에 결합되어 진동플레이트의 중심을 지지하는 지지축; 상기 지지축이 고정되고, 상기 진동플레이트의 영구자석과 대응되게 한 쌍 이상의 전자석이 고정되며, 상기 진동플레이트의 시소진동에 의하여 상기 영구자석과 전자석이 접촉하지 못하게 하면서 충격을 흡수하는 탄성부가 고정되는 베이스 플레이트; 상기 전자석에 교류전류를 공급하는 전원장치; 및 상기 지지축, 베이스플레이트 및 전원장치를 내포하는 하우징을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하여 구성되며, 소음으로 인한 폐해를 방지하고, 전체적으로 경량화하며, 마찰로 인한 내구성 악화문제를 해결하고, 전력소모량이 절감되며, 디자인이 자유롭고 제작이 간편한 저소음 체지방조절 운동기를 제공한다. 
       
     진동, 자기력, 진동플레이트, 체지방조절

title_en: High-level lifesaving device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-level lifesaving device, which enables people to escape when disastrous accidents such as fire disaster and the like happen in high-rise buildings. The high-level lifesaving device comprises a lifesaving hanging basket, a storage battery, a cross beam, a direct current motor for traversing, a gearbox for traversing, a brake for traversing, a direct current motor forvertical lifting, a gearbox and a brake for vertical lifting, a steel cable, a steel cable bobbin and a control switch. The device is usually arranged in a small room at the roof of the high-rise building; and when the fire disaster happens, personnel in the building enters the hanging basket of the small room, a traversing button on the control switch is firstly pressed to move the hanging basketto the outside of the wall, and then a dropping button is pressed to drop the hanging basket so as to achieve the aim of lifesaving. The high-level lifesaving device can be simultaneously used by many people and repeatedly used, is convenient to operate, can be operated by people without special training, and has the advantages of unlimited applicable height, strong wind resisting capacity, safety and reliability.

title_en: Rock burst simulator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rock burst simulator, which comprises a test bench, wherein a table support is arranged on the test bench, and a bearing plate for placing a simulated roadway specimen is arranged on the table support; and a compression plate for loading the simulated roadway specimen is arranged above the bearing plate and is connected with a hydraulic cylinder fixed at the upper part of the test bench, and a transparent isolation protection box for covering the simulated roadway specimen is arranged between the bearing plate and the compression plate. The utility model can simulate the on-site rock burst occurrence process of coal mines, so that the process of rock burst disaster can be visualized, and the length, the width and the height of the specimen can reach up to more than 20 cm respectively; the test scale is large, and the manufacturing cost of the specimen is low; a plurality of groups of specimens can be manufactured, and the test can be repeatable, and the safety is high; and the utility model is suitable for studying the dynamic process of coal-rock burst failure or the rock burst teaching demonstration activity, and has simple structure and good use effect.

title_en: Multi-system for fire simulation based on virtual reality
title_ko: 가상현실 기반의 다중 화재 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A multiple fire simulator based on virtual reality is provided to deal with the fire in a fire field by virtually experiencing and training the fire extinguishment at each firemen team. CONSTITUTION: A simulation terminal(1) includes a display unit(11) and an input and output unit(12). A controller(2) provides a virtual image of a fire field to the simulation terminal connected through a distributor(3) and stores and analyzes the information inputted by a user of the simulation terminal. An operation controller(21) controls the transmission and reception of the fire image and the instruction. A server(22) stores a training scenario and image and sound information comprising the training scenario. An image generator(23) transmits the image to the simulation terminal according to the control of the operation controller.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 현장을 가상으로 구현하고, 이 화재 현장에서 이루어지는 소방관의 각 팀별 대처 방법을 가상으로 체험 훈련하게 함으로서 현실의 화재 현장에서 보다 능동적이고 효율적으로 대처할 수 있게 별별 훈련이 가능하게 한 가상현실 기반의 다중 화재 시뮬레이션 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     이러한 본 발명의 가상현실 기반의 다중 화재 시뮬레이션 시스템은 디스플레이 수단 및 입출력 수단을 구비한 하나 이상의 시뮬레이션단말기와 ; 분배수단을 통해 연결된 하나 이상의 상기 시뮬레이션단말기에 화재 현장의 가상 영상을 제공하고, 시뮬레이션단말기들의 사용자들에 의해 입력된 정보를 저장 및 분석하는 제어기를 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 한다.  
       
     가상현실, 화재, 시뮬레이션, 다중, 단말기

title_en: Simulating and predicting method of urban storm flood
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulating and predicting method of urban storm flood, which comprises the following steps: A. modifying and enabling a storm radial flow management model to accord with a data model of a geographic information system; B. embedding a counting kernel of the storm radial flow management model into the geographic information system by the geographic information system; C. dividing a sub drainage area of an investigating area; D. utilizing the geographic information system to obtain parameters required by each model; E. carrying out analog computation in the geographic information system by the storm radial flow management model; and F. realizing three-dimensional visualization according to a result of the analog computation. The simulating and predicting method of urban storm flood can effectively improve the predicting efficiency of the urban storm flood, realize informatization and numeralization of the urban flood prediction, and provide rapid, accurate and intuitive effective prediction for the location, the depth, the time and the duration of the seeper of the urban storm flood so as to provide decision supports for the disaster prevention and mitigation.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: Monitoring system and monitoring method for ships in typical sections of Three Gorges Reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring system and a monitoring method for ships in typical sections of the Three Gorges Reservoir. The system comprises a ship position acquisition device, a ship position database server, a ship information database server, a three-dimensional monitoring platform and other devices, wherein ship three-dimensional monitoring platform software running on the three-dimensional monitoring platform includes two-dimensional ship monitoring sub-platform software, a two-dimensional electronic navigation channel chart, three-dimensional view coordinated control software and three-dimensional ship monitoring sub-platform software. The method comprises the steps of acquiring and sending ship position information in real time, gathering ship position information in the Reservoir in real time, superposing the ship position information on the two-dimensional electronic navigation channel chart, switching to a three-dimensional mode as needed, and conducting virtual reality simulation on hydrological and meteorological data. Due to three-dimensional simulation of the typical sections and real-time ship position display, motion information of ships passing through the Three Gorges Reservoir can be displayed intuitively and vividly, thus providing technical support and playing an application demonstrative role in the implementation of water transportation emergency response systems in China.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN MARITIME;CHONGQING PORT AND SHIPPING AD

title_en: Dynamic discrete decision simulation system
abstract_en: A system that enables dynamic discrete decision simulation is provided. Simulation has many advantages in modeling complex systems to facilitate decision making. The innovation discloses a system that integrates an agent-based discrete event simulator, a geographic information system, a rule base, and interactive databases in addition to interfaces and other supporting components. The modules can seamlessly communicate with each other by exchanging a progression of data, and by making a series of deductive decisions through embedded algorithms. The integrated system can be applied to disaster management planning and training.

title_en: Simulation experiment device of fire disaster on external wall face of urban building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation experiment device of a fire disaster on an external wall face of an urban building. The device comprises a simulation wall body, a burning closet, a weighing mechanism, a slope board, a ground track, a thermoelectric couple frame and a thermal radiation flux measurement frame, wherein the simulation wall body is in a vertical framework shape; the burning closet is a square box the bottom of which is connected with a weighing support; the weighing mechanism comprises an electronic scale and a movable support; the thermoelectric couple frame is a rectangle framework, and more than 10 thermoelectric couples are distributed on the thermoelectric couple frame; the thermal radiation flux measurement frame is in a cross shape, and one end of the cross-bar thereof is provided with a thermal radiation probe, and the thermal radiation probe is correspondingly located in the door of the burning closet. In the invention, a set of simulation experiment device for researching fire disaster features on the external wall face of the building and a mechanism that the fire disaster features are influenced by a slope is firstly established, with a safe, flexible, convenient and fast sloping degree regulating system, and the experiment device is provided with a complete measurement system for temperature and thermal radiation intensity.
assignees: USTC UNIV SCIENCE TECH CN;BEIJING RES CT OF URBAN SYSTEM

title_en: Neural network method for performing short-term earthquake prediction by using earthquake parameters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network method for performing short-term earthquake prediction by using earthquake parameters, which is a method for predicting earthquakes by using regression analysis and neural network combined technology and comprises: (1) determining a region to be studied; 2) collecting and preprocessing earthquake catalogues; 3) acquiring the earthquake parameters and time varying parameters by using the earthquake catalogues; 4) sorting information; 5) performing regression analysis; 6) performing neural network simulation; and 7) computing earthquake magnitudes of predicted earthquakes. The method has the advantages that: regional short-term earthquake prediction can be realized and the prediction time is no more than 6 months; earthquake magnitude quantization prediction can be realized, the computing result is stable and the prediction precision is high; the maneuverability and practicality are high; and the regional short-term earthquake prediction result can be used to provide service for 'disaster prevention and reduction', and the social and economic benefits are obvious.

title_en: Device, method, and program for creating map of interested area
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily generate hazard assessment information without the need for simulation result of disaster or past disaster information.  <P>SOLUTION: A design map creating section 110 creates a design map 119a wherein roads, mountains, rivers, etc. are colored and shown on the basis of map information 191. A weather information map creating section 120 creates a weather information map 129a wherein weather conditions are colored and shown on the basis of weather information 192. A dangerous place discriminating section 130 discriminates, as a dangerous place 139a, the area which is a colored part of the design map 119a and at the same time a colored part of the weather information map 129a. The dangerous place discriminating section 130 determines a warning color 139b to be applied on the dangerous place 139a on the basis of the combination of colors of the design map 119a and the weather information map 129a. A dangerous place map creating section 140 superposes the design map 119a and the weather information map 129a, and creates a dangerous place map 149a wherein the dangerous place 139a is colored with the warning color 139b.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Emergency response management device and emergency command system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency response management device, which can effectively set up an emergency command platform to offer preplan and action plan supports to emergency commands. The emergency response management device comprises a basic preplan database, an event database, an emergency preplan management module, a true event/training event management module and a communication module, wherein the basic preplan database is used for storing emergency preplan data; the event database is used for storing emergency event action plan data, emergency resource data and plan implementation data; the emergency preplan management module manages the data in the basic preplan database; the true event/training event management module manages the data in the event database; and the communication module is used for communicating with a terminal device and a government emergency management platform. The invention also provides an emergency command system using the emergency response management device; the emergency response management device can assist the establishment, the maintenance and the distribution of the emergency preplan and the action plan of emergencies, and provide command disposals and corresponding plans for various emergencies; and the emergency command system can achieve the creation processes of an automatic emergency preplan and an event disposal plan so as to save the time for emergency command responses.

title_en: Combined drilling tool with drill hole control grouting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a combined drilling tool with a drill hole control grouting device. At present, the method of grouting consolidation is usually adopted in our country, which has the weaknesses of large construction quantity and long construction period, and has lower engineering reliability caused by poor aggregate and slurry retention condition for hydrodynamic condition projects, and is difficult to control the grouting range. The combined drilling tool comprises a drill rod, a drill bit and a casing, wherein a control grouting device is arranged between the drill rod and the drill bit, a high-strength nonwoven slurry protecting bag is arranged between an isolating pipe and the casing, and a power transmission device is arranged between the casing and the drill bit, and is connected on the upper middle portion of the drill rod through an intermediate connector. The combined drilling tool can guarantee the control grouting with quickness and high efficiency to the largest extent for satisfying the grouting rescue and relief works and production restoration requirements of mines, railways, roads, tunnels for water conservancy and laneway projects to the sudden flood and weather disasters with large passage, large flux and high concentration, and reduces the construction cost.
assignees: XI AN INST OF COAL SCIENCE RES INST

title_en: Coupling agent propeller for monitoring stability of underground engineering
abstract_en: The utility model provides a coupling agent propeller for monitoring stability of underground engineering, in particular to the field of stability monitoring equipment for underground engineering. The propeller can drive the coupling agent to be filled in a monitoring drill hole better, and is favorable for better coupling of an acoustic emission probe and the drill hole body so as to increase accuracy of monitor results. The coupling agent propeller comprises a sleeve and a plunger body arranged in the sleeve, the sleeve is a hose, elastic threads used for strengthening and supporting the hose are attached and fixed on the hose, one end of the plunger body is a coupling agent propelling end while the other end thereof is a plunger body propelling end, and the plunger body is inserted into the sleeve through the plunger propelling end. The coupling agent propeller can guarantee monitoring quality, overcomes data distortion caused by human factors, provides accurate data support for predication and forecast of stability monitor for underground engineering, and provides scientific basis for accurately predicating and forecasting geological disasters.

title_en: Automatic simulation method for building disaster evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic simulation method for building disaster evacuation, which comprises the following steps: the arithmetic unit obtains and stores the resultant force of the social force borne by all the evacuation objects according to the received related parameters, obtains the time step by using the maximum resultant force value in the resultant force, and determines the expected speed of the evacuation objects in the time period and the expected position of the evacuation objects after the time period; when the evacuation object is confirmed to advance, the processor updates the position of the evacuation object and updates the speed; when not advancing, only update the speed; when the evacuation object finishes the evacuation in the current building, the process is ended; otherwise, the process is executed circularly. The invention provides an effective method for testing the structural design safety of a building, which can truly reflect the main characteristics of crowd evacuation in an emergency state and effectively verify the evacuation safety of the building.
assignees: INST OF BUILDING FIRE RES CHIN

title_en: High-efficiency portable water pretreatment filter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency portable water pretreatment filter, which comprises a cylinder body and a cylinder cover. The cylinder cover is movably connected with the cylinder body, the bottom of the cylinder body is provided with a sewage discharge connector, the side of the cylinder body is provided with a water inlet connector, the top of the cylinder cover is provided with a water outlet connector and a backwashing water inlet connector, the lower part of the cylinder cover or the upper part of the cylinder body is provided with a horizontal baffle, the horizontal baffle and the top of the cylinder cover form a buffer cavity, a plurality of screen pipes arranged in the cylinder body are arranged on the horizontal baffle through a central connecting pipe on the top of the cylinder body, the outlet of the central connecting pipe is arranged in the buffer cavity between the horizontal baffle and the top of the cylinder cover, and the screen pipes are a plurality of sets of tubular screen pipes. The utility model has the advantages of simple overall structure, light weight, small sizes, convenient operation and use, rapid backwashing of the blocked screen pipes, and high filtering efficiency, and provides a portable filter for the remote and filed operational units, the military field operation training and short-term domestic water supply during the period of the flood disaster, which can be easily and flexibly used and can reach the combined water discharging standards of sand filtration and fine filtration for ordinary water purification through discharging water once.
assignees: HUZHOU DEXIANG ENVIRONMENT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Emergency evacuation room in commercial high-rise building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency evacuation room in a commercial high-rise building, and solves the defect in the prior art that the evacuation time is long, which goes against emergency evacuation. The utility model adopts measures that the emergency evacuation room comprises a slide bar 1, pedals 2, a counterfort 3, a top plate 4, a fire-resistant evacuation door 5, a podium building roof panel 7 and a fire-resistant evacuation door 8; the emergency evacuation room is built on one lateral side of a commercial high-rise building in a integral manner; the height of the emergency evacuation room is the same as that of the commercial high-rise building; the slide bar 1 is connected between the top plate 4 and the podium building roof panel 7; the level of the slide bar 1 is in accordance with that of the floor in each layer; the pedals are connected with the slide bar 1; the fire-resistant evacuation door 5 is arranged on the side wall body at one end on each layer; the pedals 2 are communicated with the fire-resistant evacuation door 5; and the distance between the pedals 2 and the slide bar 1 subjects to a distance through which an escapee can slide down smoothly. The utility model is characterized in that by adopting a vertical path, the speed of emergency evacuation is fast; the structure is simple; the emergency evacuation room is suitable for evacuating a plurality of people, and is suitable for organizing personnel drilling; the reutilization rate of facilities is high; and the maintenance cost is low.
assignees: WUHAN IRON & STEEL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: 'Three-map method' for evaluating ground fissures
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 'three-map method' for evaluating ground fissures, comprising the following steps of: firstly, evaluating and zoning ground fissure risk to form a ground fissure risk zoning map, then evaluating and zoning ground fissure vulnerability to form a ground fissure vulnerability zoning map and finally evaluating and zoning ground fissure hazardness to form a ground fissure hazardness zoning map. The three-map method overcomes the defects that the prior art can not sufficiently reflect the natural and social attributes of disasters and can not comprehensively quantitatively evaluate ground fissure disasters, defines the concept of the geological disaster hazardness for the first time and puts forwards the viewpoint of evaluating the geological disaster hazardness for the first time. The invention provides an indoor similar material physical simulation analog test method for the cause of formation of the ground fissures, researches the structure characteristics and the fractional characteristics of the ground fissures and structure, physiognomy and earthquakes with the nonlinear idea for the first time and applies an artificial neural network (ANN) and geographic information system (GIS) coupling technique to evaluating the ground fissure risk.

title_en: Water bed for teaching skill of floating on water surface with face upward
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 'water bed for teaching the skill of floating on water surface with face upward', which belongs to the technical field of swimming. The 'water bed' is a 2-2.7X0.6-0.8X0.2-0.4m water tank, and three supports capable of supporting the heels, hips and head of a human body and being adjusted up and down according to the height and weight of the human body are arranged at the bottom of the tank. Laying on the 'bed' for exercise, people can master the skill of floating on water surface with face upward safely, easily and quickly and turn over to learn swimming at the same time. The skill can improve the ability of people for surviving water disasters and self rescue. In the fights with the nature, tens of thousands of people die of various water disasters each year. The skill of floating on water surface with face upward is an effective means for people to use to survive the water disasters. Therefore, in various water disasters, people cannot be drowned as long as no other accidents (such as head hitting by hard objects or rocks, body injuries with massive haemorrhage and long-term soaking in icy water).

title_en: Diamond bit and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a diamond bit and a manufacturing method thereof. The diamond bit comprises a work layer of an ordinary diamond bit and PCD sintered bodies which are distributed in the work layer, the PCD sintered bodies are columnar bodies, cuboids or cylinders and are distributed and arranged in a work layer matrix of the diamond bit, and the PCD sintered bodies account for 55-70 percent of the area of a work bottom lip of the diamond bit. The manufacturing method comprises the following steps: columnar PCD sintered bodies are precast by a hot press method; the diamond bit adopts secondary molding, the PCD sintered bodies are positioned in matrix alloy powder of the diamond bit in a graphite mould, and then the diamond bit is sintered by hot-pressing in a medium frequency electric furnace. The problem of difficult selection of the diamond bit aiming at rock stratum is solved. The diamond bit has the characteristics of good broad spectrum, good exposure, high efficiency and long service life. The diamond bit can be widely applied to geologic exploration, petroleum drilling, engineering investigation and geologic disaster control.

title_en: Emergency training exercise method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency training exercise method and a system. The method comprises the following steps: trainees log on an emergency training exercise system by an operation terminal of a training exercise system; the trainees access a training subsystem for basic training; trainees can access an exercise subsystem based on three-dimensional virtual reality and a three-dimensional game engine after passing basic training exams, and can enter the same scene with other various roles under a networking state to take interactive exercises including single-item exercises, combined exercises and/or comprehensive exercises; and an advancing type training process from training to exercise and from low-level personal training to high-level network training is realized, and the emergency response ability of the trainees is gradually improved. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the technical effects of being suitable for safe production and daily training exercise work in the emergency field, promoting exercise relevant personnel to be familiar with the plan, truly showing the interactivity of the exercises, and really playing the effect of training, and the system has strong operability and the like.

title_en: Tsunami motion prediction method based on multi-level interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tsunami motion prediction method based on multi-level interaction, which comprises the following steps: 1) generating a hierarchical grid according to the position of an actual tsunami seismic source, and establishing a corresponding relation between the grid and a spherical coordinate and an interaction influence mechanism of the hierarchical grid; 2) dispersing a tsunami motion equation in a fan-shaped and square combined manner, setting initial conditions and boundary conditions according to actual conditions, and solving a wave equation to calculate the change of tsunami motion flux; 3) setting an initial sea surface height field according to the height of the sea surface, establishing a particle grid interaction mechanism and a particle updating iteration rule during the tsunami movement, and predicting the height of the tsunami through the interaction between the particles and the grid. The method can quickly and vividly predict the tsunami propagation phenomenon, solves the problems that the existing simulation method only focuses on numerical simulation, the simulation result is not visual, the calculation efficiency is too slow and the like, is used in the fields of disaster prevention, tsunami early warning, virtual simulation and the like, and has certain practical value.

title_en: Water-rock acting mechanism tester in simulated reservoir water pressure state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-rock acting mechanism tester in a simulated reservoir water pressure state. The tester comprises a tester shell; the upper part of the shell is provided with a cover plate, while the lower part is provided with a base; a sample bracket is arranged in the shell; the cover plate is provided with a water inlet and a deflating bolt; a pressure air bag is placed in the shell, and the pressure air bag is connected with a pressure control system; and an impeller is arranged on the lower part of the shell and connected with a motor. Simultaneously, the tester is provided with a dynamic and static water control device capable of simulating the disturbance of reservoir water and the dissolving characteristic of rock in the reservoir water pressure state so as to provide an experiment platform for researching the reconstruction principle of large-sized reservoir banks; and meanwhile, the tester also can simulate the disintegration process of the rock in the dynamic water pressure state, further determine the mechanical damage principle of the rock under the dynamic water pressure condition by matching mechanical damage experiment research of the rock, and provide reliable experiment data for reservoir bank protection and geological disaster prediction.

title_en: Snow disaster remote sensing monitoring simulation evaluation method based on disaster reduction small satellite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snow disaster remote sensing monitoring simulation evaluation method based on a disaster reduction small satellite, comprising the following steps: recognize accumulated snow according to the spectral characteristic of the accumulated snow and form accumulated snow remote sensing images data; create a snow disaster case database and a snow disaster statistical database, the snow disaster case database comprises a disaster time, a location hit by the disaster, an accumulated snow day number, a normalized difference vegetation index NDVI, a population number hit by the disaster and a accumulated snow area, the snow disaster statistical database comprises a total precipitation, a highest air temperature, a lowest air temperature, a average daily temperature, a wind speed and a surface temperature; carry out an accumulated snow depth inversion to a recognized accumulated snow, and respectively store the accumulated snow depth into the snow disaster case database and the snow disaster statistical database; carry out simulation evaluation to a snow disaster according to the data in the snow disaster case database and the snow disaster statistical database. A new and high applicability remote sensing data source is provided for snow disaster monitoring in the invention, and the snow disaster remote sensing monitoring simulation evaluation method has a great importance of disaster reduction and disaster relief works for China snow disaster.
assignees: NAT DISASTER REDUCTION MINISTRY OF CIVIL AFFAIRS OF THE PEOPLE S REPUBLIC OF CHINA

title_en: Remote sensing hyperspectral image classification method based on semi-supervised kernel adaptive learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing hyperspectral image classification method based on semi-supervised kernel adaptive learning, relating to a classification method of remote sensing hyperspectral images and solving the problem of low resolution ratio existing in the traditional remote sensing hyperspectral image classification method. The remote sensing hyperspectral image classification method comprises the steps of: judging a labeling form of a hyperspectral image training sample set, acquiring an optimized target function, and then acquiring an optimal parameter or a data dependency kernel parameter; obtaining an optimal kernel function with an invariant structure or a variable structure according to the acquired parameter, further obtaining an optimal semi-supervised classifier, and realizing the classification of the remote sensing hyperspectral images by utilizing the classifier. The invention can accurately classify the end members of the remote hyperspectral images, improves the resolution ratio of the remote sensing hyperspectral images, and can be applied to the technical field of terrain military target reconnaissance, high-efficient warfare striking effect estimation, navy submarine real-time maritime environment monitoring and emergency responses of emergent natural disasters.

title_en: Real fire drilling system for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real fire drilling system for emergency rescue, which comprises a comburant main structure, a combustion device, a control monitoring system, an exhaust fan and a flashover device, wherein the comburant main structure, the combustion device, the exhaust fan and the flashover device are installed in a training room; the exhaust fan is installed above the wall surface of the training room and the upper part of the exhaust fan clings to the ceiling; the control monitoring system is installed in a control room; the control room and the training room are two adjacent rooms; steel plates are additionally installed on the ceiling of the training room; and the combustion device comprises a gas source, a pressure gauge, a gas cylinder hand valve, a decompression device, a tee joint, a combustion tray, an ignition device, a net boom, a blower and the like. The simulated disaster environment comprises real flame and smog which improve the reality sensation of drilling. The real fire drilling system for the emergency rescue has automatic control, no pollution and environment protection, ensures the training safety, and can improve the disaster relief capacity of the rescue personnel in the training environment simulating an actual combat.
assignees: SHANXI HONGAN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Diamond drill bit and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a diamond drill bit and a manufacturing method thereof. The diamond drill bit comprises a working layer of a common diamond drill bit and a sintering body distributed on the working layer. The sintering body is a thermo-stabile polycrystal and comprises square columnar and cylindrical thermo-stabile polycrystals, wherein the square columnar thermo-stabile polycrystals are distributed and arranged on inner and external diameter parts of the working layer of the drill bit, and the cylindrical thermo-stabile polycrystals are distributed and arranged on the part of the working layer of the drill bit close to the center. The manufacturing method for the diamond drill bit comprises that the diamond drill bit is formed by hot pressing and sintering in a medium frequency furnace, wherein the temperature in the sintering process is 985 DEG C, the pressure is 18MPa, the heat preservation time is 6 minutes and the discharge temperature is 800 DEG C. The difficult problem of good drilling effect in a sandy pebble stratum and a hard-crisp-broken rock stratum is solved. The diamond drill bit has the characteristics of high hardness, strong abrasion resistance and long service life, and can be widely applied to geological exploration, petroleum drilling, engineering exploration and governance of geological disasters.

title_en: Safety device of floating drilling platform on sea during typhoon or hurricane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety device of a floating drilling platform on sea during typhoon or hurricane, which comprises an upper riser, a lower riser assembly, a blowout preventer, a lower riser and a buoy floating in the sea, The blowout preventer is set on the buoy; the lower riser is installed at the lower part of the blowout preventer; and the upper riser is arranged on the lower riser assembly which is detachably arranged on the blowout preventer. In the invention, a floating buoy is arranged in the sea, and when typhoon or hurricane comes during deepwater drilling, all it is required to do is to recycle the upper riser and leave the blowout preventer and the lower riser on the buoy after turning off the blowout preventer; therefore, the evacuation time is saved, the load of the platform on sea is reduced, and the deepwater drilling platform can conditionally withdrawal to the safe sea area; and after the typhoon or hurricane leaves, the deepwater drilling platform resumes operations of drilling and sea area exploration, thereby guaranteeing the safety of platform on sea.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;CHINA OILFIELD SERVICES LTD

title_en: Driver training device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driver training device, which comprises a transmission rope and a drive control system for driving the transmission rope to horizontally reciprocally move, wherein the transmission rope is positioned at a high position through a bracket and runs through a practicing path in a driving field; obstacles are suspended on the transmission rope; and the bracket is also provided with damping devices for stabilizing the collided obstacles. The driver training device has the advantages of occupied driving field reduction due to an obstacle suspension mode, improved security and prolonged service life due to the damping devices arranged on the bracket, and great improvement on the emergency response capacity of drivers due to the sudden movement of the obstacles controlled by a coach in on-vehicle training through a remote controller and the greater approximation of conditions to emergencies on actual roads.

title_en: Multi-functional bed
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-functional bed. A hinge or a tightening latch in the middle section of the lower part at one end or both ends of a traditional box-type open plank bed or other beds is connected with an openable or flatwise-laid plate; the lower surface and a supporting frame are in contact connection and form an oblique shape; an angle within 8 degrees to 90 degrees can be manually adjusted; bed legs can be lifted; a vertical plate of a bed head can be folded; the bed can be widened, is connected with a function pillow or a mattress, a waist and neck pillow, a ground mat and has 18 functions including other sleep-promoting compounds, an earthquake alarm setup, and the like; and the multi-functional bed belongs to an original, improved and combined invention and is used for sleep of all natural persons and partial discomfortable persons in homes, hotels and hospitals. The invention can achieve the comfort, relieve the partial discomfort, promote the sleep and increase the indoor oxygen. A user can take physical exercise or beautify body on the bed or at the side of the bed. The multi-functional bed can facilitate a patient to urinate on the bed conveniently, improve the aesthetic feeling, actively give an alarm, automatically give an alarm to wake up people who fall into sound sleep when an earthquake happens, provide a signal for search and rescue after disasters and rescue more survivors during the earthquake or after the earthquake.

title_en: Mine roadway smoke heat simulated training system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine roadway smoke heat simulated training system, which comprises a simulated training subsystem, an environment simulation subsystem, a safety guarantee subsystem and a central control unit, wherein the simulated training subsystem is arranged in a roadway and is divided into a collapse training region, a smoke training region and a blocking training region; the right side inside the roadway is provided with a metal protective guard and a safety channel is isolated on the right side inside the roadway; and the environment simulation subsystem comprises a smoke generating unit and a noise generating unit. The utility model has the advantages that aiming at the characteristics of rescue and relief work, the mine roadway smoke heat simulated training system can fulfill the aim of professionally training the professional rescue workers serving the underground relief work; a basement, a buried shelter and an existing or unused underground shallow-layer roadway in the mining area are utilized for the arrangement of the system structure to improve the mine roadway smoke heat simulated training system into a combined training system which can stimulate part of underground disaster scenes; and the mine roadway smoke heat simulated training system is beneficial to combine the actual operation requirements and assist to carry out related simulated training work.

title_en: Embedding method of combination transducer for early warning and monitoring of water inrush disaster of mines
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an embedding method of a combination transducer for the early warning and monitoring of water inrush disaster of mines. Water trouble in the mines threatens the life safety of miners constantly and is the puzzle of underground mining industry, and researchers who study the prevention and control of the water trouble in the mines do a large number of study practical works over the years to summarize the technology of preventing and controlling water inrush. The embedding method comprises the following steps of: after quartz sand is paved at the bottoms of two or three drill holes in the same drill fossa and is tamped, conveying the drill holes to a hydrochemical transducer, a water-pressure transducer and a temperature transducer, filling medium-coarse sand with a plurality of thicknesses into the upper parts of the drill holes, and filling puddle with a plurality of thicknesses in the drill holes for tamping; injecting cement paste into the drill holes, and then putting a stress transducer into the cement paste; and putting a strain transducer on the upper part of the stress transducer and injecting the cement paste. In the embedding method, a plurality of transducers in different types are arranged in one hole, so that the method for monitoring the water inrush of the mines has the advantages of practicality, low cost, high efficiency and strong innovation.
assignees: XIAN BRANCH OF CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Comprehensive rescue simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a comprehensive rescue simulation training system, which comprises a preparation room, a physical training system, a field disaster environment training system, a medicinal rescue system and a control and monitoring system, wherein the systems are arranged in adjacent rooms built by adopting refractory bricks respectively, each room is provided with an air-tight door and an air-tight window, the air-tight window is provided with a stainless steel shutter, and a full black environment can be created after the shutter is closed; and the physical test system, the field disaster environment training system and the medicinal rescue system are connected with the control and monitoring system respectively and controlled and monitored by the control and monitoring system respectively. The comprehensive rescue simulation training system can comprehensively improve physical and psychological diathesis of rescuers, improve the rescue skills and improve the response capability through simulation training, and can comprehensively simulate a practical training environment.
assignees: SHANXI HONGAN SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Driver emergency response capability training device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driver emergency response capability training device, which comprises a transmission rope and a drive control system, wherein the drive control system drives the transmission rope to horizontally move back and forth; the transmission rope is positioned at a high place through a bracket and spans over a driving practicing route of a driving practicing field; and a barrier is suspended on the transmission rope. The barrier is arranged in a way of suspension so as to reduce the occupation of the driving practicing field. A trainer can remotely control the sudden movement of the barrier when the trainer trains in a vehicle so as to get closer to emergency on a practical road and greatly improve the emergency response capability of a driver.

title_en: Multifunctional rescuing and barrier-breaking robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional rescuing and barrier-breaking robot which is characterized in that a barrier breaking mechanism is arranged in front of a robot body, a shovel mechanism for breaking barriers to walk on as well as carrying and transferring articles is arranged at the rear of the robot body, crawler traveling mechanisms are arranged at two sides below a chassis (32) of the robot body, and an electric control board control unit for controlling the robot to actuate is arranged on the chassis (32); the barrier breaking mechanism is used for breaking barriers by turning the head when the robot meets barriers; the barrier breaking mechanism is provided with two circular saws (19) and two cone drills (22) which are respectively used for achieving the works of breaking barriers respectively under the driving of a motor; and the shovel mechanism is provided with a shovel with lifting and overturning function. The invention can implement functions of breaking barriers, carrying and moving, searching and rescuing, positioning at the real time, loading rescue goods, and the like under the long-distance control in a plurality of sudden disaster accidents and more hostile environments so as to realize fast rescuing and has the advantages of small size, high flexibility, more practical functions, and the like.

title_en: Clean real smoke fire simulator
abstract_en: A simulator for use in firefighting training exercises comprising a fire compartment having a flame; a means for generating a flame; a means for generating smoke into the fire compartment; a control room for controlling the means for generating a flame and the means for generating smoke; a means for expelling the smoke from the fire compartment; a means for oxidizing the smoke; and a stack for releasing the oxidized smoke from the oxidizing means.

title_en: Earthquake disaster simulation diagnostic system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an earthquake disaster simulation diagnostic system that allows for general users who do not have expert knowledge, to readily decide earthquake countermeasures for a server room.  <P>SOLUTION: The diagnostic system includes an earthquake countermeasure DB 106 where information regarding OA floor and information about loaded article are stored, and the system is configured to calculate the earthquake-proof strength of each of the article, according to the earthquake intensity scale specified by the user, and successively increase the specification of each member which should take measures of earthquake-resistance according to the user's specifications; and then, when the allowable bearing force of each earthquake countermeasure member exceeds an acting force generated in each earthquake countermeasure member, calculate the earthquake countermeasure member as a plan to reinforce the countermeasure for the earthquake.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Laboratory icing simulating test method of optical power ground wires (OPGWs)
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system communication, relating to a laboratory icing simulating test method of optical power ground wires (OPGWs), which can simulate and test the performance changes of running lines in various icing thicknesses states in a laboratory. The method carries out an experimental comparative study on the electrical properties, the communication and the mechanical properties of the OPGWs under an icing condition by utilizing a laboratory icing simulating test system, mainly carries out the experimental studies on lightning resistance, short-circuit current, attenuation, tensile strength, stress strain and the like on the OPGWs with different structures, types, technical parameters, materials and the like and then determines a comprehensive solution on resistance of the OPGWs on icing disasters through analyzing test data.

title_en: Multi-floater disc-type spilled-oil tracking buoy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-floater disc-type spilled-oil tracking buoy which comprises a flexible lightweight disc, a small floater on the disc, an electronic device sealing shell and an electronic device in the sealing shell, wherein the disc and the small floater can improve the contact area between the buoy with an oil film and wind and increase the oil film tracking accuracy; the electronic device sealing shell is made of non-metallic materials; the built-in electronic device comprises a positioning module, a communication module and a power supply; the buoy is also provided with a directional reflecting sign and a radar reflective metal sheet which are convenient for maritime search by airplanes and ships. The invention has novel design and special structure and aims at providing position data for oil spill accident emergency response command and decision-making departments, such as ships, oil drilling platforms, and the like to rapidly search spilled-oil on water surface and implement pollution control.
assignees: CHINA WATERBORNE TRANSP RES INST;YUAN YU

title_en: Valley salt tide prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of oceanic disaster monitoring and prewarning, in particular to a valley salt tide prediction method, which comprises the following concrete steps: (11) predicting the radial flow of the valley to be measured to obtain the average daily flow rate, the average monthly flow rate and the average annual flow rate of the radial flow; and (12) using the average daily flow rate, the average monthly flow rate and the average annual flow rate of the radial flow obtained in the step (11) as parameters to be introduced into a three-dimensional water motive power mode for simulating the dynamic state of the salt tide. Through predicting the radial flow of the valley in advance and using the flow rate of the radial flow as the input parameters of the three-dimensional water motive power mode for predicting the dynamic state of the salt tide, the invention solves the technical problem of predicting the occurrence and the degree of the salt tide.

title_en: Multi-purpose glove type tool with eagle claw (three replaceable claws)
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the hardware tool and relates to a multi-purpose glove type tool with an eagle claw. In the invention, protectiveness is combined with the attack and the work efficiency is improved; the unicity protection of the glove is changed and the attack of the eagle claw is strengthened. The invention is applicable to the earthquake, the projection landslide, the hazard collapse, the debris flow, the tunneling, the buried land of the well distortion and the occasion difficultly executed by the mechanical picks and shovels, and can quickly rescue the lives of the people buried in the gravel, stone and slag soil. The multi-purpose glove type tool is a necessary tool for the firefighters and is applied to the wilderness survival, the rock climbing and the climb-up and applied to the field training of soldiers, the digging of the trench from the tunnel and the digging of the weapon pit on the ground. In the plastic shelters of the farmers, the multi-purpose glove type tool is capable of compensating the gaps with seedlings and planting the seeds, tucking up the soil, ditching, loosening the soil and weeding. The multi-purpose glove type tool with the eagle claw consists of an eagle claw finger guard, a tension strap and adhesive cotton gloves (or leather gloves) and the other main parts, and the angle of the eagle claw can be adjusted. The tool is sleeved on the major part of the hand.

title_en: Experimental instrument simulating water-rock interaction mechanism in reservoir water pressure state
abstract_en: An experimental instrument simulating a water-rock interaction mechanism in a reservoir water pressure state comprises an experimental instrument casing. A cover plate is arranged on the upper portion of the casing; a base is arranged on the lower portion of the casing; a test sample bracket is arranged inside the casing; a water inlet and an air bleed bolt are arranged on the cover plate; a pressure air bag arranged inside the casing is connected with a pressure control system; and a fan blade wheel installed on the lower portion of the casing is connected with a motor. The experimental instrument is simultaneously provided with a flowing water control device and a still water control device, can simulate perturbation of reservoir water and the dissolving property of rocks in the reservoir water pressure state, provide an experimental platform for studying a large-scale reservoir bank reconstruction mechanism, simultaneously can simulate the disintegrating process of the rocks in a flowing water pressure state, match with rock mechanics damage experimental study, further explicate a rock mechanics damage mechanism under the condition of flowing water pressure, and provide reliable experimental data for reservoir bank protection and geological disaster prediction.

title_en: Game-type virtual reality experience simulator
title_ko: 게임형 가상 현실체험 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a game-type virtual reality experience simulator capable of recognizing the risk and power of various calamities and disasters through images related to the calamities and the disasters, and at the same time virtually experiencing and becoming familiar with coping methods and evacuation tips against the calamities and the disasters in advance through a game. The game-type virtual reality experiencing simulator comprises: a base which supports the virtual reality experiencing simulator on the ground; a front assembly which is installed on one side of the base, and outputs images related to calamities and disasters and at the same time produces the effect regarding the calamities and the disasters; and a rear assembly which is installed on the other side of the base, and senses movement signals in accordance with forward, backward, up and down, and right and left movements of a user. Thus, the invention can prevent and minimize various calamities and disasters from occurring, fatal accidents, and economic loss.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각종 재난재해와 관련된 영상을 통해 재난재해의 위력 및 위험성을 인식함과 동시에 재난재해의 대응방법 및 대피요령을 게임을 통해 가상으로 미리 체험하여 숙지할 수 있는 게임형 가상 현실체험 시뮬레이터로서, 가상 현실체험 시뮬레이터를 지면에 지지하는 베이스; 상기 베이스의 일측에 설치되어 재난재해와 관련된 영상을 출력함과 동시에 재난재해와 관련된 효과를 연출하는 전방 조립체 및 상기 베이스의 타측에 설치되어 체험자의 전후진 및 상하좌우에 따른 움직임 신호를 감지하는 후방 조립체를 포함하여, 각종 재난재해의 발생원인, 인명사고 및 경제적 손실을 사전에 예방 및 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Earthquake simulator capable of carrying out earthquake drill
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake simulator capable of carrying out an earthquake drill, which comprises a simulating cabin (1), a basic platform (9) and a cabin shaking device, wherein the basic platform (9) is arranged under the simulating cabin (1), and the cabin shaking device is arranged between the simulating cabin and the basic platform. A small shaking device comprises a horizontal shaking device and a longitudinal shaking device. Under the condition of earthquake, the earthquake simulator can help people to understand and learn emergency shock-proof knowledge, improve the abilities of emergency risk avoidance, self-help and self-protection and change adaptability when the earthquake disaster occurs.
assignees: NEW VISION FOR SCIENCE EDUCATION CULTURAL DISSEMINATION ANHUI CO LTD

title_en: Operator education system for preventing electrical accident
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an operator education system of electrical accident experiencing type for providing such education as making an operator engaged in electrical work and maintenance safely experience an activity which causes an electrical accident while at work and danger of electricity.  <P>SOLUTION: The operator education system includes an implement for generating electrical accident, an implement giving disaster effect of electrical accident, and an implement for protection safety measure. When an operator being an educatee takes an action simulating the actual operation to the implement which generates an electrical accident, a simulated electrical accident corresponding to the implement for generating electrical accident occurs, and the operator experiences the disaster effect simulating the actual disaster in a safe state with the implement giving disaster effect of an electrical accident.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
assignees: SYSTEC KK;TOYOTA T & S KENSETSU KK

title_en: Driver training device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a driver training device, which comprises a transmission rope and a driving control system. The driving control system drives the transmission rope to move in a horizontal reciprocating manner. The transmission rope is positioned at a high position and across a driving training path of a driving training field via a support. An obstacle is suspended on the transmission rope, and a damping device further arranged on the support can stabilize the collided obstacle. The driving training device has the advantages of reduced occupied training field area by arranging the obstacle in a suspension manner, and improved safety and prolonged service life of the device by arranging the damping device on the support. Additionally, a trainer can control sudden movement of the obstacle when in attendant training by using remote control to better simulate emergency on actual roads, thereby greatly improving emergency response capacity of a driver.

title_en: Preparation of natural disaster forecasting earthquake kindling animal model
abstract_en: The invention relates to an earthquake kindling animal model preparation method, which comprises the following steps of: collecting animals surviving natural earthquakes or making the animals experience artificial earthquakes, continuing to perform motivation training by using natural aftershocks or artificial aftershocks, rewarding the animals with delicious foods after the training of each time, simultaneously recording outer manifestation parameters (such as bark and the like) of the animals to make the animals sensitive to the shocks, and repeating the same training for multiple times until the animals can perform stable manifestation in response to the shocks. An animal model obtained by the animal model preparation method of the invention can accurately early-warn natural disasters (such as the earthquakes, volcanoes, tsunamis and the like), along with low cost and high accuracy.

title_en: Electrical accident prevention simulator
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an electrical accident prevention simulator for making an operator engaged in electrical work/maintenance understand an activity which causes an electrical accident while at work, an accident phenomenon which happens as a result, the mechanism of accident which causes the phenomenon which is not in sight in an actual accident, and the function of a circuit breaker, a protector, and the like, and safely experience the risk of electricity.  <P>SOLUTION: In an electrical accident prevention simulator, a simulated work screen is prepared on a program on a hierarchically lower layer on the basis of classification such as electric operation classification, disaster classification, and protection measure classification in consideration of examples of electrical accidents to make the operator comprehend the whole aspect of an electrical accident. Further, a mechanism displaying means for displaying not only the result of the accident but also the mechanism of the accident such as where, how, why the accident happens, what results it has, and an attention-attracting means for emphasizing the result are prepared to enable the operator to do necessary simulated work on the screen or do cooperative work with the hardware of an operation board prepared in advance.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
assignees: SYSTEC KK;TOYOTA T & S KENSETSU KK

title_en: Aeolian sand disaster simulating device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aeolian sand disaster simulating device and an aeolian sand disaster simulating method. The simulating device comprises a data acquiring device, a data storing device for storing the data acquired by the data acquiring device, the aeolian sand disaster simulating device and an aeolian sand disaster estimating device; the data storing device comprises a regional basic data module and an aeolian sand disaster basic data module; the aeolian sand disaster simulating device comprises a system base map module and an aeolian sand disaster power simulating module; the system base map module is connected with the regional basic data module; the aeolian sand disaster power simulating module is connected with the aeolian sand disaster basic data module; the aeolian sand disaster simulating device further comprises a superposition operation module which is connected with the system base map module and the aeolian sand disaster power simulating module; and the superposition operation module is connected with the aeolian sand disaster estimating device which is connected with an external output device. The invention can provide the simulation condition of the aeolian sand disaster in real time and, early warn and detect the risk of the aeolian sand disaster.

title_en: Inflatable safe escape device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inflatable safe escape device comprising a parachute, an air bag connected with the parachute, as well as a strut and a rope storing drum which are arranged on a building window, wherein a traction rope is arranged in the rope storing drum; one end of the traction rope is fixedly connected with the rope storing drum, and the other end thereof is connected with the air bag through a switch arranged on the port of the rope storing drum and a rope pulley arranged on a foldable bracket; and the foldable bracket is arranged on the strut. The inflatable safe escape device adopts triple safe designs including the air bag, the traction rope, the parachute and the like, has reliable safety performance and convenience in use and operation, is suitable for various groups of people, does not need special training on users, and can effectively prevent building dropped objects and other secondary disasters.

title_en: Quakeproof and fireproof survival tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a survival device used in severe disasters such as earthquake and fire, in particular to a quakeproof and fireproof survival tank. The technical proposal of the utility model includes that the survival tank comprises a hard housing (1), a tank door (2) and seats (3), wherein, the tank door is arranged on the hard housing and the seats are arranged in the hard housing; the space in the housing is square, the outer surface of the housing is provided with a fireproof coating (4), an emergency lamp (8), a wireless weft transmitter (9), a food box (10), a drug box (11), an oxygen bottle (12), a freshwater bottle (13), a radio (14) and a toolbox (15). The survival tank of the utility model is arranged in a room, people can hide in the survival tank immediately once severe disasters such as earthquake ad fire occur and no time is left for running out, living the survival tank for a long time and waiting for rescue. The utility model has the advantages that the survival tank is suitable for a single person or a family to hide in and wait for rescue when severe disasters like earthquake and fire occur, guaranteeing the life security; after simple training, people can hide in the survival tank in 3-5 minutes and escape from the attack of the disaster.

title_en: Seesaw typed kickboard
title_ko: 시소 방식의 킥보드
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A seesaw-type kick scooter is provided, which is driven with a seesaw motion so as to help fun and effective exercise of a user. CONSTITUTION: A seesaw-type kick scooter comprises a handle shaft(10), a frame(100), a deck(110), a first wire(120), first and second rollers(170,171), a first link member(130), a second link member(140), a second wire(122,124), and first and second directional casters(150). A handle(12) and front wheel(14) are installed in the handle shaft. One end of the frame is connected to one side of the handle shaft. The central part of the deck is hinged on the frame so that the front and rear parts of the deck can be moved up and down like a seesaw. The first wire is connected to the front and rear ends of the deck, and a fixing member(121) is fixed to the middle portion of the first wire. The first and second rollers guide the first wire to the underside of the frame. Both ends of the second wire are connected to the front end of a first body(131) and a first protruding part(132) of the first link member. Both ends of the third wire are connected to the front end of a second body and a second protruding part(142) of the second link member. The first and second directional casters contact the ground and rotate to generate a propulsion force according to the operation of the first and second link members.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시소 방식의 킥보드에 관한 것으로, 좀 더 구체적으로 설명하면 전후방향으로 설치되는 발판부에 두발을 각각 올려 놓고 시소방식으로 교대로 가압하는 경우 후측에 구비되는 방향성 캐스터가 킥보드의 양측으로 출몰되면서 지면을 지치면서 추진되어 사용자의 흥미를 유발할 수 있는 시소 방식의 킥보드를 제공한다. 이와 같은 본 발명에 따른 시소방식의 킥보드를 이용하는 경우 두발을 올려놓고 전후측으로 교대로 체중을 가해 발판을 시소동작을 통해 킥보드를 운행 할 수 있어 킥보드 사용자의 흥미를 유발시킴은 물론, 본 발명은 어느 한발이 지면을 지치지 않고서도 운행이 가능할 뿐만 아니라, 두발을 전후측에 올려 놓고 교대로 발판을 눌러 줌으로서 균형잡힌 운동을 할 수 있다. 
       
     시소, 킥보드

title_en: Industrial angle bracket
title_ko: 산업용 앵글 브라켓트
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An industrial angle bracket is provided to reduce industrial disaster and give the sense of security and safety to operators. CONSTITUTION: An industrial angle bracket uses a main frame(10). The main frame comprises a through hole(11), a sleeve pipe(20), a bracket part(30), a fixing guide pipe(40) and a distance control pipe(50). The through hole drills in order to fix the stage to the sheet form. The sleeve pipe is projected in the top end portion of a main frame upper side to the front. The fixing guide pipe has a distance control fixed hole. A fixing nut is fixed in the opposite location of the distance control fixed hole.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Combined type residential building integrating services of disaster prevention, relaxation and body-building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined type residential building integrating the services of disaster prevention, relaxation and body-building, in particular to a combined type residential building in the existing residential area, which is characterized in that people can quickly escape from the building in case of earthquakes or fires and can overlook the view, breathe fresh air and do physical exercises at ordinary times. The combined type residential building comprises an ornamental building for emergency, which is built on the marginal grassland of a residential building, wherein the ornamental building for emergency is as high as the residential building, with each floor being on the same level with that of the residential building; an emergency door equipped with an active sliding door is arranged on each floor of the residential floor, and the residential building and the ornamental building are communicated via the emergency door on each floor; a small balcony is arranged on each floor of the ornamental building, the small balconies on the adjacent floors are arranged in a staggered manner in the vertical direction and connected by a dual-purpose staircase comprising a slide at one side and steps at the other side; and the lower end of the dual-purpose staircase on the lowest floor is landed on the lawn of the residential area. The residents can be transferred from the residential building to the ornamental building for emergency and finally to the lawn in case of earthquakes or fires; while at ordinary times, the residents can take a walk, enjoy the good view and do physical exercises in the combined type residential building, therefore, the combined type residential building is a novel residential building at present.

title_en: Web-based emergency response exercise management systems and methods thereof
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a method for simulating portions of an emergency response exercise includes generating situational awareness outputs associated with a simulated emergency and sending the situational awareness outputs to a plurality of output devices. Also, the method includes outputting to a user device a plurality of decisions associated with the situational awareness outputs at a decision point, receiving a selection of one of the decisions from the user device, generating new situational awareness outputs based on the selected decision, and repeating the sending, outputting and receiving steps based on the new situational awareness outputs. Other methods, systems, and computer program products are included according to other embodiments of the invention.

title_en: Universal oil suction device
abstract_en: The universal oil extractor is mainly used for military fighters and civil aircrafts, and can also be used for ships and land transportation vehicles, and the universal oil extractor has the function of avoiding oil supply faults and accidents and disasters caused by the oil supply faults under various conditions. Such as: when a military fighter is used for fancy performance and flight training, and a civil aircraft encounters airflow, the liquid level of an oil suction pipe opening in an oil tank is exposed under the states of jolting and overturning, a large amount of air is sucked, and an engine is suddenly flamed out at a critical moment, so that accidents and disasters are caused. In addition, similar failures can also be caused or easily occur when a ship sailing at sea encounters storms and when a land transportation vehicle travels on a rugged road such as a mountain road. The universal oil extractor has the technical scheme that the oil supply fault is eliminated by mainly utilizing the characteristics of the middle rotary oil pipe and the rotary oil suction pipe.

title_en: Tunnel construction disaster planning and preventing response system based on network platform
abstract_en: Disclosed is a tunnel construction disaster planning and preventing response system based on a network platform. The network platform consists of a server and a network terminal, the server comprises a central processing unit, a hard disc, a memory, a chip group, an I/O bus, I/O equipment, a power supply and a wireless communication module, a network operation system and application software are installed in the hard disc, and tunnel construction disaster planning and preventing response system program, engineering data, parameter and planing data base of construction in process are stored in the hard disc. By aid of the tunnel construction disaster planning and preventing response system based on a network platform, normalization and effectiveness of tunnel construction emergency management can be strengthened, scientificalness of tunnel construction emergency management level is increased, blindness of rescue operation in disasters can be reduced, and rescue efficiency is increased, thereby being favorable for designing feasible emergency treatment measures and improving self disaster emergency management capacity effectively as soon as possible after disasters according to actual conditions. The tunnel construction disaster planning and preventing response system based on a network platform can be used for tunnel construction disaster rescue response exercise and emergency rescue.

title_en: Method for inverting atmospheric water vapor content from MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for inverting atmospheric water vapor content from MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) data, which can be applied to the remote sensing application departments, such as meteorology, environment monitoring, land management, crop condition monitoring, disaster monitoring and the like. The method comprises the following three steps of: (1) performing forward simulation to the second, fifth, seventeenth, eighteenth and nineteenth near-infrared bands of acquired remote sensing MODIS data in given areas and seasons and an atmospheric model by using atmospheric radiation transmission simulation software MODTRAN, and establishing a training and test database; (2) repeatedly training and testing the training and test data set by using a neural network; and (3) performing inversion calculation to the MODIS actual image data, and performing actual earth surface verification and application analysis. The atmospheric water vapor inversed product has high precision, strong practicability and relatively simple operation. The method can be applied to the departments of weather forecast, environment monitoring, crop condition monitoring, disaster monitoring and the like.

title_en: Method for inversing soil moisture content from AMSR-E (Advanced Microwave Scanning Radiometer-EOS) data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for inversing soil moisture content from AMSR-E (Advanced Microwave Scanning Radiometer-EOS) data, which can be used for the remote sensing application departments of monitoring weather and environment, managing land, monitoring a drought and a crop growing situation, monitoring disasters, and the like. The method comprises the following four steps of: firstly, simulating the most part of situations on the earth surface and establishing a database by using a theoretical model; secondly, establishing an inverse algorithm by using a simulation database; thirdly, carrying out the inverse calculation of passive microwave data AMSR-E; and fourthly, carrying out proper evaluation, analysis and modification by using observation data of a meteorological department, thereby increasing the precision and the applicability of the algorithm. The method for inversing soil moisture content from the AMSR-E data can be used for the departments of forecasting weather, monitoring environment, agricultural situations and disaster situations, and the like. The microwave radiation frequency arrangement carried by a Fengyun 3 satellite of China is basically similar to the AMSR-E, and the invention can be applied to the Fengyun 3 satellite of China and a microwave radiometer transmitted by China in the future after being modified.

abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system for a disaster prevention drill and a support method for a disaster prevention drill which establish a process as a continuous and predetermined flow from the time when a scenario for the drill is created with live data of an abnormal processing amount from the bases of plant operation to the time when the scenario for the drill is applied to the disaster prevention drill performed at the bases of the disaster prevention drill.  <P>SOLUTION: A support system for a disaster prevention drill 1 includes: the bases of plant operation 10 which sends the live data P of the processing amount from which abnormalities were detected to the outside; the bases of emergency countermeasures 20 which receives the live data P of the processing amount from the bases of plant operation 10 and creates disaster prevention countermeasures as guidelines; the bases of disaster prevention drill 30 which performs simulations of the processing amount of the target plant equipment shown in a registered scenario for a drill and enables the disaster prevention drill corresponding to the abnormalities of the simulation results; and a cooperating means 50 of disaster prevention bases which creates the scenario for the drill using the live data of the processing amount sent from the bases of plant operation 10 to the bases of emergency countermeasures 20 as data for the drill and registers the scenario for the drill at the bases of disaster prevention drill 30.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System and method for predicting corresponding action
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To confirm what kind of action should be taken for disaster prevention in emergency such as a disaster or in training assuming emergency.  <P>SOLUTION: A corresponding action prediction system includes: a natural language analyzing part for dividing, by morpheme, a character string obtained by performing the natural language analysis of a telegraphic message received from a communication network in emergency; a keyword extraction part for extracting a keyword whose appearance frequency is high from the divided character string; and an action prediction part for referring to a database in which the action expected for contact notification and a keyword included in the contact notification are stored in association by phase obtained by dividing typical contact notification by using the keyword as a key to specify the phase of the contact notification, and for outputting the action a correspondence person should make in the specified phase.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Combined sensor monitoring system for prewarning water bursting disaster in mine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a combined sensor monitoring system for prewarning water bursting disaster in a mine. The flood damage in the mine threats the life safety of mining workers at moments, which is also a difficult problem in the mine mining industry; fortunately, after a great deal of research and practical work over the years, researchists for water bursting disaster prevention in the mine summarize the water bursting disaster prevention technology. The combined sensor monitoring system comprises an information processing module, a stress sensor, a strain transducer and a hydrochemistry, water pressure and temperature sensor; and the hydrochemistry, water pressure and temperature sensor, the stress sensor and the strain transducer are arranged in two or three drill holes of the same drilling from down to up in sequence, and are connected with the information processing module through signal transmission wires, respectively. The utility model adopts the method of inserting multiple different types of sensors to one hole, so that the method of monitoring the water bursting disaster in the mine is practical and highly efficient, and has lower cost and stronger innovativeness.
