title_en: Water pollution three-dimensional dynamic evolution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water pollution three-dimensional dynamic evolution method. The invention mainly solves the problem of the way for generating KML by three-dimensional analog simulation and provides a KML and GoogleEarth-based three-dimensional analog evolution method. A system reads a result calculated by a simulation model and related spatial data by using server script language, dynamically generates a KML file in real time, loads the file to a browser GoogleEarth plugin and displays the file or provides a file downloading service for a user to perform local simulation. When the scheme is applied to simulating a water pollution diffusion process in the middle and lower reaches of the Yellow River, the evolution process of pollutants is clear along with time, a platform operation interface is simple and visual, high three-dimensional real experience feeling and timeliness can be achieved, implementation difficulty is small and the requirement on network transmission rate is low. The method provides support for emergency response and emergency decision work to the greatest degree.

title_en: Earthquake disaster site evaluation virtual simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an earthquake disaster site evaluation virtual simulation training system, comprising a data layer, an interface layer, a functional layer and an application layer; wherein the data layer is used for storing and managing bottom data; the interface layer is used for providing a bottom data read-write access interface and a device access interface; the functional layer is used for providing various functional modules for the system; and the application layer is used for scenario generation, scenario edition, data management and virtual disaster site display. The invention has the beneficial effects that: three-dimensional virtual simulation earthquake disaster scene visualization method applies virtual reality technology to three-dimensional graph modelling and management of monomer house earthquake damage module calling mechanism, so as to complete construction of virtual disaster site, and house damage condition and disaster area influence in real earthquake disaster site is mainly simulated.

title_en: Equivalent drilling cuttings weight continuous monitoring device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of the monitoring and prewarning of mine power disasters, in particular to an equivalent drilling cuttings weight monitoring device and an equivalent drilling cuttings weight monitoring method. The method comprises the following steps of: determining the relations among bearing pressure distribution, drilling cuttings weight and drilling stress by using a mine pressure theory, on-site actual measurement and laboratory experiment data; determining a key threshold value among the parameters during rock burst; and prewarning before the rock burst. The monitoring device comprises a pressure monitoring device, an instrument and a transmission line, wherein the pressure monitoring device is embedded into an excavation area; and the instrument and the transmission line are used for transmitting monitored data to the ground. A ground monitoring main machine is used for continuously monitoring the change situation of under-well pressure, so that the rock burst can be prewarned according to the key threshold value. In the device and the method, the defects of dangerous drilling cuttings method and incontinuous monitoring in real time are overcome and the safety and effectiveness of rock burst monitoring are improved.

title_ko: 매뉴얼 제공 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상품의 매뉴얼 정보가 기록된 서버로부터 상기 매뉴얼 정보를 네트워크를 통하여 정보 단말기 장치에 입력하고, 상기 정보 단말기 장치를 이용하여 상기 매뉴얼 정보를 확인할 수 있는 매뉴얼 제공 시스템으로서, 상기 상품이 소방 설비이며, 또한 상기 매뉴얼 정보가 상기 소방 설비의 가상 조작 시뮬레이션이며, 상기 정보 단말기 장치를 이용하여 상기 가상 조작 시뮬레이션을 조작하여 매뉴얼 정보를 학습할 수 있는 구성으로 함으로써, 실제의 소방 설비를 사용하지 않아도, 상기 소방 설비의 조작을 가상적으로 시뮬레이션하여, 상기 소방 설비의 조작 방법을 체험적으로 학습할 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
       
     매뉴얼 제공 시스템, 정보 단말기 장치, 소방 설비, 시뮬레이션

title_en: On-board realtime survival time estimation system and method for ships
title_ko: 탑재형 실시간 선박생존시간 추정시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An on-board real time survival time estimating system in a ship and a method therefor are provided to enable crews to easily estimate survival time to quickly and accurately escape from a ship, thereby minimizing damages in human life and properties. CONSTITUTION: A ship damage input module receives a damage situation of a ship when a ship collides or is sunk. A survival time DB builds individual ship survival time corresponding to each damage scenario in a database. A survival time DB management module searches ship survival time data and a damage scenario matched with a real damage situation from the survival time DB and transmits the data to a real time survival time output module. The survival time output module displays the searched survival time data by the survival time DB management module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박의 충돌 및 좌초 사고 시의 손상시나리오를 사전에 데이터베이스화하고, 이를 바탕으로 실제 사고 발생시 승조원들이 손쉽게 선박의 생존시간을 실시간으로 확인할 수 있도록 지원하는 실시간 선박생존시간 추정시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 선박의 충돌 및 좌초로 인한 사고 발생시 승조원들이 신속하고 정확한 대피를 함으로써 인명적, 재산적 피해를 크게 감소시킬 수 있다. 
       
     선박, 충돌, 좌초, 사고, 생존, 시나리오, 대피

title_en: Experiencing apparatus for fire fightingeducation and training
title_ko: 소방안전교육용 체험장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An experiencing device for a firefighting safety education is provided to easily reproduce a fire field. CONSTITUTION: A plurality of sheets(310) expresses a flame shape. A light emitting member(330) emits light to the plurality of sheets. A blowing unit ventilates a high pressure air in order to wave the plurality of sheets upward. A fog sensing unit(370) senses fog sprayed from an educational fire extinguisher. A controller controls the light emitting member and the blowing unit according to the sensed result of the fog sensing unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방안전교육용 체험장치에 관한 것으로써, 대형사고로 번질 수 있는 화재관련사고에 대한 대처능력을 배양하기 위한 실제와 비슷한 화재현장을 보다 용이하게 재연할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 이를 토대로 실제상황과 유사한 실전에서의 화재진화체험교육을 실질적으로 행함에 따라 화재관련사고를 미연에 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: SUNGJIN HI TECH CO LTD;HOWON UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMY CORP FOUNDATION

title_en: Training apparatus for experiencing fire
title_ko: 화재체험 훈련장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire experience training apparatus is provided to effectively display various information and to implement escape training by including a displaying and concealing type opening part. CONSTITUTION: A fire experience part(100) includes an entrance door(120), a fire experience unit, and an escape door. The entrance door is formed in a main body. A user is able to experience the effects of a firet along the movement path of the fire experience unit. The escape door is formed at the end of the movement path. A displaying and concealing type opening part(200) includes a displaying board, on which experience information and escape information are displayed, and implements an escaping door concealing function.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재체험 훈련장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는, 장소에 상관없이 간편하게 이동하여 편리하게 화재체험 훈련을 수행할 수 있고, 저렴한 비용으로 제작할 수 있고, 구조가 간결, 단순하면서도 화재발생에 따른 체험 및 대피훈련을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 화재체험 훈련장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 화재체험 훈련장치는, 화재 현장을 체험하고 대피요령을 학습할 수 있는 화재체험 훈련장치에 있어서, 육면체 형상을 갖고 내부에 공간이 형성된 본체, 체험자가 진입할 수 있도록 상기 본체에 형성된 출입도어, 상기 본체 내부에 형성되는 이동통로를 따라 화재 현장을 체험할 수 있도록 구성되는 화재체험수단, 및 상기 이동통로의 말단에 체험자가 탈출할 수 있도록 형성된 탈출도어를 포함하는 화재 체험부; 및 체험 훈련시에 펼쳐 화재와 관련한 정보, 체험요령, 대비요령을 게시, 안내하는 게시판의 기능과 상기 탈출도어의 위치를 은폐하는 기능을 수행하고, 운반, 보관 및 이동시에 접어서 부피를 최소화할 수 있도록 힌지부재에 의해 상기 본체에 회동 가능하게 장착되는 게시 및 은폐용 개폐부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 의해, 컨테이너 형태의 이동 가능한 박스 구조로 형성되어 간편하게 이동할 수 있으므로 화재체험 훈련을 장소에 상관없이 편리하게 수행할 수 있는 효과 있다. 그리고, 화재체험 훈련을 위해 별도의 건축물을 건축하지 않더라도 시행할 수 있으므로 소규모 단체나 지자체에서도 저렴한 비용으로 효율적으로 시행할 수 있고, 피체험자들은 원거리의 체험관이나 학습관을 교통수단을 이용하여 찾아갈 필요가 없으므로 체험비용을 절감할 수 있다.

title_en: Real-time prediction numerical method for general scour of river-crossing bridge
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time prediction numerical method for general scour of a river-crossing bridge, belonging to the technical field of computers. The invention especially aims at a dynamic relation between river bed scour and a flood process, adopts a real-time scour evolution simulation equation of the river bed of a bridge crossing river reach in a flood discharge process, considersthe characteristics of a compressed river reach, and realizes numerical simulation and real-time prediction of the state of scour at bridge opening through a computer. The invention can be used in the flood control safety management of highway bridges and railway bridges, realizes real-time mastery of the state of river bed scour during the flood process, and avoids disaster caused by the scour of a large bridge.

title_en: Skinner's macaroni for non-standard workover
abstract_en: A skinner's macaroni for non-standard workover relates to drilling rod manufacturing technical field, specifically to a skinner's macaroni for small-diameter workover, and serves as a construction pipe string for workover in small-diameter bushing. The skinner's macaroni for non-standard workover comprises a bushing body, and a male joint and a female joint connected on both ends of the bushing body respectively, wherein external threads are arranged on the male joint, internal threads are arranged on the female joint, the tooth section of the external threads is of a trapezoid shape, the lower base of the trapezoid is connected to the male joint, one leg of the trapezoid is at a 95 degree angle to the upper base of the trapezoid, the other leg of the trapezoid is at a 115 degree angle to the upper base of the trapezoid, the tooth section of the internal threads is of a trapezoid shape, the upper base of the trapezoid is connected to the female joint, one leg of the trapezoid is at a 95 degree angle to the lower base of the trapezoid, and the other leg of the trapezoid is at a 115 degree angle to the lower base of the trapezoid. The skinner's macaroni for non-standard workover is strong in tension and anti-torsion strength, and can prevent occurrence of underground disasters.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEMICAL;SINOPEC JIANGSU OILFIELD COMPANY

title_en: Design method for distributed hydrological model by using grid as analog unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method for a distributed hydrological model by using a grid as an analog unit, which is called as ESSI for short. The design method comprises the following steps of: obtainment of a distributed parameter: converting vector data into grid data; generalization of a watershed hydrological process: establishing a universal runoff generating type for the grid; design of a runoff generating process: respectively computing the water-quantity distributing condition of each part according to different prior-period soil water conditions; design of a flow collecting process: respectively designing a Muskingum-Cunge method, a delay algorithm and a riverway segmentation Muskingum method for the flow collecting process computation of the model under different conditions; and model development and integration. The invention not only can finish the watershed hydrological process simulation at an arid region and a humid region, but also can realize the short-term flood forecast and the long-term rainfall-runoff process simulation and prediction of a watershed by using modularization and integration ideas as means, thereby providing scientific reference bases for deeply learning about the physical mechanism of water circulation by people, reducing the drought and water-logging disasters and reasonably developing and utilizing water resources.

title_en: Method for designing high-resolution full distributed hydrological model TOPX
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for designing a high-resolution full distributed hydrological model TOPX. The designing method constructs the full distributed hydrological model TOPX with a topographic index dimension conversion mechanism and high resolution by means of a topographic index concept (TOP) of TOPMODEL and a water balance thought (X) of a Xinanjiang model. The method comprises the following steps of: designing a runoff yield process, establishing a hybrid runoff yield scheme, and calculating the runoff yield; and designing a confluence process, performing confluence treatment by adopting an algorithm when a grid water system is stagnated, and acquiring a flow process of a drainage basin outlet by taking the stroke-along transmission loss of runoff into consideration. The TOPX model describes the hydrological process in the semi-humid or semiarid Yishu river basin reasonably, can reflect certain main characteristics of the intrinsic mechanism of the hydrological process, and realizes simulation and prediction of a rainfall-runoff process of the river basin so as to provide scientific reference basis for deeply learning the physical mechanism of the water cycle by the human beings, reducing drought and flood disasters and reasonably developing and utilizing water resources.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating dam-break risk of dammed lake based on negotiable and cooperative work flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and system for evaluating the dam-break risk of a dammed lake based on a negotiable and cooperative work flow, which are used for the negotiable and cooperative evaluation of the dam-break simulation and influence analysis of the dammed lake. The system is characterized in that a distributed frame based on a four-layer system is adopted. The system consists of three parts: a moving Agent, an AgentHost and a cooperative Agent. In the invention, the centralized decision and treatment of disaster negotiation information are accomplished by providing cooperative virtual work environment of multiple point in different places, command and decision makers and related personnel at all levels in different regions can cooperatively communicate to share and exchange disaster information and take part in discussion about the dam-break simulation and the influence analysis of the dammed lake together, and the cooperative analysis and the evaluation of the dam-break risk of the dammed lake are achieved. The invention has the advantages of simple method and high execution efficiency, is suitable for multiple users distributed in different places to carry out negotiable and cooperative evaluation, and can effectively improve the work efficiency of the dam-break risk evaluation of the dammed lake.

title_en: Simulated training and drilling system for mine water gushing-out disaster
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine safety, particularly to a simulated training and drilling system for mine workers and rescue crew, which can enable a person to be personally on the scene, realize human-computer interaction, and evaluate drilling result. To achieve the aim, the utility model adopts a technical scheme that the simulated training and drilling system for mine water gushing-out disaster comprises a main control computer, a 3D circular-screen projecting subsystem, a human-computer interaction subsystem, a synchronous interaction subsystem, a human action detecting subsystem and a human physiology monitoring subsystem, wherein the 3D circular-screen projecting subsystem, the human-computer interaction subsystem, the synchronous interaction subsystem, the human action detecting subsystem and the human physiology monitoring subsystem are electrically connected with the main control computer, respectively. The synchronous interaction subsystem comprises a loudspeaker device and a water spraying device.
assignees: CHONGQING RES INST OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENG GROUP CORP

title_en: Mine fire disaster simulation training and drilling system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine safety, in particular to a fire disaster simulation training and drilling system for mine workers and rescue personnel, which can enable people to feel self participation, achieve man-machine interaction and evaluate drilling results. The aim of the utility model is achieved in the following manner: the mine fire disaster simulation training and drilling system comprises a main control computer, a 3D (three dimensional) circular-screen projection subsystem, a man-machine interaction subsystem, a synchronous interaction subsystem, a human body action detection subsystem and a human body physiology monitoring subsystem, wherein, the 3D circular-screen projection subsystem, the man-machine interaction subsystem, the synchronous interaction subsystem, the human body action detection subsystem and the human body physiology monitoring subsystem are respectively and electrically connected with the main control computer.
assignees: CHONGQING RES INST OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENG GROUP CORP

title_en: Battle system of naval vessel capable of operating mutiple operating mode simultaneously, method thereof, and computer readable medium recording program for performing the method
title_ko: 다중 운용 모드를 동시 운용할 수 있는 함정 전투 시스템 및 그 방법, 그리고 이를 행하는 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 매체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A battle system of a naval vessel capable of operating a multiple operating mode simultaneously, a method thereof, and a computer readable medium recording a program for performing the method are provided to individually set up an operating mode of unit devices arranged at each node and operate the unit device in a multiple operating mode in order to reduce the time taken according to a restart operation of the entire unit devices. CONSTITUTION: An integrated operation control device(310) is prepared in a control device to set up and change an operating modes of plural unit devices. A unit operation control device(320) is prepared in each unit device, and sets up and changes the operating mode of the unit device by controlling the integrated operation control device. The unit device is a sensor-linked device linked with a sensor which senses a target object.
abstract_ko:
다중 운용 모드를 동시 운용할 수 있는 함정 전투 시스템 및 그 방법, 그리고 이를 행하는 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 매체가 개시된다.  복수의 단위 장비를 구비하는 함정 전투 시스템에 있어서, 소정의 지휘 통제 장비에 구비되어 상기 복수의 단위 장비의 운용 모드를 각 단위 장비별로 설정 또는 변경하도록 제어하는 통합 운용 통제 장치와, 상기 복수의 단위 장비 중에서 각 단위 장비마다 구비되고, 구비된 단위 장비의 운용 모드를 상기 통합 운용 통제 장치의 제어에 의해 설정 또는 변경하는 단위 운용 통제 장치를 포함하는 다중 운용 모드를 동시 운용할 수 있는 함정 전투 시스템을 구성한다.  상기와 같은 함정 전투 시스템에 따르면, 하나의 함정 전투 시스템에서 각 노드에 배치되는 단위 장비들의 운용 모드를 개별적으로 설정하여 동시에 다중 운용 모드를 운용할 수 있으므로, 운용 모드 변경을 위한 전체 단위 장비들의 재가동이나 그에 따라 소비되는 시간을 줄일 수 있는 유리한 효과를 가진다.  한편, 모든 단위 장비들이 물리적으로 분리되지 않고 논리적으로 구분된 운용 모드에서 동작되므로, 지휘 통제 장비가 센서 연동 장비나 무장 연동 장비에 대한 통합 운용을 유지할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
       
     함정, 다중 운용 모드, 훈련, 실전, 운용, 노드

title_en: Emergency-rescuing real-fire drilling system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency-rescuing real-fire drilling system, which comprises a comburent main structure, a combustion device, a control monitoring system, an exhauster and a flashover device, and is characterized in that the comburent main structure, the combustion device, the exhauster and the flashover device are installed in a training room, the exhauster is installed on the upper part of the wall surface of the training room, and the upper part of the exhauster is clung to a ceiling; and the control monitoring system is installed in a control room, the control room and the training room are two adjacent rooms, and a steel plate is additionally installed on the ceiling of the training room; the combustion device is provided with a combustion-gas source, a pressure gauge, a gas-bottle manually-operated valve, a decompression device, a tee joint, a combustion disk, an ignition device, a grid, an air blower and the like; and a simulated disaster environment is real flames and smog, and the real sense of drilling is improved. The utility model can be automatically controlled, has no pollution, is environment-friendly, ensures the training safety and can improve the disaster relieving capability of rescue personnel in war-game training environments.
assignees: SHANXI HONGAN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Simulation detection system for surface subsidence of shield tunnel construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical detection, and discloses a simulation detection system for surface subsidence of shield tunnel construction. The system comprises a tunnel construction mechanical modeling module, a geological survey data input module, a tunnel construction parameter management module, a surface subsidence virtual detection module, a memory module and a data processing module, wherein the tunnel construction mechanical modeling module is connected with the surface subsidence virtual detection module and the memory module to transmit construction mechanical model information; the geological survey data input module is connected with the tunnel construction parameter management module to transmit surveyed geological data information; the tunnel construction parameter management module is connected with the surface subsidence virtual detection module and the memory module to transmit construction parameter information; the surface subsidence virtual detection module is connected with the memory module to transmit the surface subsidence virtual detection data information; and the memory module is connected with the data processing module to process stored information and transmit the processed information. Through the system, the surface subsidence can be actively simulated and prevented to realize disaster prevention.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY SHISIJU GROUP CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Method for extracting gas from bedding level fractured well of ground coal seam roof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for extracting gas from a bedding level fractured well of a ground coal seam roof, orderly comprising the following steps: selecting a coal storage layer with the gas content more than 8 m<3>/t; determining fissure zone position generated by extracting the coal layer, taking the rock formation at 3-7 m of the middle lower part of the fissure zone as the level construction layer; determining positions of the well opening and kickoff points according to landing points of the level segment; and realizing large curvature radius increased slanting, wherein the drilling position is parallel to a gate road at a coal stope working surface or vertical to the largest principal stress direction, and the length of the level segment is less than or equal to the strike length of the working surface; the well structure adopts a three-part structure; the level segment can be an uncased hole or a lower sleeve tube which is an emission hole; the level segment is constructed in the selected rock layer; the level segment uses an open hole packer or a sleeve tube packer for performing hydraulic fracture in segments; a drainage and extracting apparatus is arranged for extracting the ground gas by a virtual storage layer; and the negative pressure extracting is exchanged between the middle and last phase, thereby realizing multiple functions of the well. The method in the invention improves the extracting efficiency of the ground drilling well, realizes area outburst elimination, and reduces the gas disasters to the maximum limit.

title_en: Subway comprehensive monitoring simulation experiment system with junction safety monitoring center
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a subway comprehensive monitoring simulation experiment system with a junction safety monitoring center simulation server, which comprises a plurality of line control center simulation servers and the junction safety monitoring center simulation server. Each line control center simulation server is connected with a plurality of station monitoring terminal simulation servers, and the junction safety monitoring center simulation server directly receives information of the station monitoring terminal simulation servers in a one-way manner and directly transmits the received information to an urban rail comprehensive control center simulation server in a one-way manner. The urban rail comprehensive control center simulation server formulates an emergency treatment scheme for a disaster condition according to the information transmitted by the junction safety monitoring center simulation server and transmits control command to a simulation work station of a relevant station according to the formulated scheme.
assignees: BEIJING INST CIVIL ENG & ARCH;BEIJING SIFANG AUTOMATION CO;BEIJING DRAGONSTAR ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional acousto-optic alarm call device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to rescue and call equipment. A multifunctional acousto-optic alarm call device mainly comprises a rectangular body, a cover, an acousto-optic alarm system and a hand drill obstacle-breaking system, wherein the acousto-optic alarm system mainly comprises a hand crank I, a transmission system I, a hand generator, a control chip, an LED (Light Emitting Diode) high-frequency blinking lamp, a high-decibel loudspeaker and a colorful blinking lamp; the hand drill obstacle-breaking system mainly comprises a hand crank II, a transmission system II and a chuck; the acousto-optic alarm system and the hand drill obstacle-breaking system are arranged in the rectangular body; the colorful blinking lamp is arranged on the cover; and the hand crank I and the hand crank II are respectively located at adjacent two sides of the rectangular body. The multifunctional acousto-optic alarm call device is small in volume and light in weight and can help trapped people in sudden disasters such as earthquake and the like to implement self rescue and initiative call.

title_en: Adjustable pitch simulated roof for training firefighters in roof ventilation procedures
abstract_en: An adjustable pitch simulated roof for training firefighters in roof ventilation procedures. The apparatus includes a vertical support structure and a pitched roof portion adjustably connected to the vertical support structure. The pitched roof portion includes an outer frame defining an interior region, a plurality of rafter brackets disposed on the outer frame, a plurality of rafters placed the interior region, and a plurality of roofing sheets covering the rafters so as to form a roof field. A mechanical winch or other adjustment means are provided for rapidly and easily changing the roof pitch, and a locking mechanism locks the roof portion in the selected position. A stationary and a trailer-mounted mobile embodiment are each shown and described.

title_en: System operation training manual (SOTM) comprehensive emergency communication safeguard vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a system operation training manual (SOTM) comprehensive emergency communication safeguard vehicle which is characterized by comprising a sports utility vehicle (SUV) and an SOTM comprehensive emergency communication safeguard system. The SOTM comprehensive emergency communication safeguard system comprises a satellite communication system, a comprehensive mobile communication system, a short-wave communication system, a multi-media command and control center (12), a vehicle-mounted video frequency/audio frequency system, a GPS (global position system)/ big dipper double module positioning system and a voice gateway (16). The SOTM comprehensive emergency communication safeguard vehicle realizes the signaling/media streaming format conversion among different systems such as the honeycomb mobile communication, the digital cluster communication, the short-wave communication and the like, and can support the access of a multimode user terminal to realize the interconnection and the intercommunication between the existing network and the transmission modes such as the satellite, the short wave, the E1, the IP (internet protocol) and the like and realize the networks spanning communication. The requirements of the communication and the command can be met in the emergency rescue and disaster relief filed such as the instantaneity and the effectiveness, the requirements for the command center to realize the remote command control and the communication can be met; and the timely and exact information can be flexibly offered.
assignees: SUN KAISENS BEIJING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Structure for preventing side slope from collapsing and landsliding by removing moisture in soil body
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a structure for preventing a side slope from collapsing and landsliding by removing moisture in a soil body. A plurality of water drain holes are transversely and vertically drilled at intervals by a horizontal drill on a side slope in need of protection, and the holes are internally provided with a plurality of flexible type permeable pipes, so that the moisture in the soil body of the side slope can be effectively removed, the moisture cannot be collected in the soil body, and the collapse and the landslide of the side slope can be avoided in consideration of the internal cause. The structure has the characteristics of simple construction, low cost, good effect and the like, thereby being suitable for the side slope protection in the engineering such as the road, the railway, the water conservancy, the disaster prevention and reduction, etc.

title_en: Impulse wave generation device in analog simulation training exercise system of mine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an impulse wave generation device in an analog simulation training exercise system for mine workers and rescue men, belonging to the technical field of mine safety; the device is used for simulating the impulse wave effect of a mine disaster site. The impulse wave generation device is composed of a guide pipe barrel and an impulse wave generation source device, wherein the guide pipe barrel is provided with an opening on one end, and the impulse wave generation source device is arranged in the guide pipe barrel; the impulse wave generation source device consists of a high pressure air tank and a tank cover opening mechanism; the pouring port of the high pressure air tank faces to the opening end of the guide pipe barrel; the impulse wave generation source device can be an explosive gas tank of which the pouring port faces to the opening end of the guide pipe barrel. The impulse wave generation device in the analog simulation training exercise system of mine is simple in structure, and capable of enabling people to feel as on the scene and intuitively feel the impulse wave in gas and dust explosion disasters and coal-gas outburst disasters.
assignees: CHONGQING BRANCH CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Analog simulation training exercise system for mine outburst disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an analog simulation training exercise system for coal-gas outburst disasters for mine workers and rescue men, belonging to the technical field of mine safety; the system is used for enabling people to feel as on the scene, realizing human-computer interaction and evaluating the exercise results. The analog simulation training exercise system is characterized in that: the analog simulation training exercise system for mine outburst disasters comprises a host control computer, a 3D circular-screen display subsystem, a human-computer interaction subsystem, a synchronous interaction subsystem, a human behavior detecting subsystem and a human physiology monitoring subsystem, wherein the 3D circular-screen display subsystem, the human-computer interaction subsystem, the synchronous interaction subsystem, the human behavior detecting subsystem and the human physiology monitoring subsystem are electrically connected with the host control computer.
assignees: CHONGQING BRANCH CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Analog simulation training and practicing system for mine gas disaster
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine safety, in particular to a simulation training and practicing system for mine workers and draegermen, which enables people to have an immersed on-site sense, can achieve human-computer interaction and interaction and can evaluate the practicing results. In order to achieve the purposes, the analog simulation training and practicing system for a mine gas disaster comprises a main-control computer, a three-dimensional circular-screen projection subsystem, a human-computer interaction subsystem, a synchronous interaction subsystem, a human behavior detection subsystem and a human physiological monitoring subsystem, wherein the three-dimensional projection subsystem, the human-computer interaction subsystem, the synchronous interaction subsystem, the human behavior detection subsystem and the human physiological monitoring subsystem are electrically connected with the main-control computer respectively.
assignees: CHONGQING BRANCH CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Earthquake experience, escape and self-rescue education center
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a training aid, in particular to an earthquake experience, escape and self-rescue education center. The education center comprises an earthquake platform arranged in a house model, a projector, a monitoring camera and a position sensor arranged in the house model, a bedroom model and a simulative beam, wherein a circular screen is arranged on the inner wall of the house model; the projector is used for projecting an earthquake disaster image on the circular screen; a corridor is arranged between the bedroom model and the circular screen; a smoke ejector is arranged under the bedroom model; a sound box and a blue light lamp which simulates earthquake light are arranged under the corridor; and the projector, the monitoring camera, the position sensor, the smoke ejector, the sound box, a picture frame or a pendant lamp, the blue light lamp and the earthquake platform are connected with a control system. By adopting the structure, the education center has the advantages that the earthquake teaching and experience are realized, the simulation of various earthquake effects is realized, the reality sense of the experience is strengthened, the action monitoring is performed to the experience process, and the experience result is comprehensively evaluated, so that the earthquake teaching and experiencing effects are improved.
assignees: CHONGQING OUPAI INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Disaster effect simulation system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster effect simulation system and a method thereof. The system comprises a central control subsystem, a water flow-driven execution subsystem, a landscape simulation subsystem and an audience simulation subsystem, wherein the water flow-driven execution subsystem is used for driving the water to flow along a set route under the control of the central control subsystem according to the set speed; the landscape simulation subsystem is used for simulating the effect of sweeping-down by water under the control of the central control subsystem according to the set action mode; and the audience simulation subsystem collapses under the control of the central control subsystem according to the set mode. Through the execution of the disaster effect simulation system and the method thereof, the simulation performance forms of sound effect, light effect, film and television, special effect and other aspects can be combined to simulate a natural disaster simulation performance form by taking the water as the major destructive power, thereby the new experience can be brought to audiences in terms of visual sense, auditory sense and touch sense, and visitors have the comprehensive mental enjoyment.
assignees: Shenzhen huaqiang intelligent technology co ltd

title_en: Dynamic feedback type tunnel fire intelligent evacuating and rescuing system based on digitizing technique
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic feedback type tunnel fire intelligent evacuating and rescuing system based on a digitizing technique, which comprises a fire condition information acquisition subsystem, a three-dimensional temperature smoke gas field reconstructing subsystem, an emergency evacuation and rescue decision subsystem and a digitalized virtual reality displaying subsystem, wherein the fire condition information acquisition system is used for analyzing and processing temperature data acquired by a fire detector and acquiring fire condition information; the three-dimensional temperature smoke gas field reconstructing subsystem is used for establishing three-dimensional temperature smoke gas field information according to the temperature data and the fire condition information; the emergency evacuation and rescue decision subsystem is used for analyzing and estimating the fire development trend according to real-time information provided by the fire condition information acquisition subsystem and the three-dimensional temperature smoke gas field reconstructing subsystem and dynamically adjusting an evacuation and rescue prediction scheme; and the digitalized virtual reality displaying subsystem is used for virtually and dynamically displaying the fire condition information in a tunnel and a temperature smoke gas field and supporting the real-time roaming on the fire tunnel based on the digitalized virtual reality technology. The dynamic feedback type tunnel fire intelligent evacuating and rescuing system is conductive to the scientific decision of the tunnel fire rescue and overcomes the defects of fixation, framed form, poor real-time property and adaptability, and the like in the present tunnel fire prediction scheme.

title_en: Mine roof disaster analog simulation training and practicing system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine safety, in particular to a simulation training and practicing system for mine workers and ambulance crew, which can bring the mine workers and the ambulance crew to the scene, can realize man-machine interaction and can assess practice results. The technical scheme for realizing the mine roof disaster analog simulation training and practicing system includes that the mine roof disaster analog simulation training and practicing system comprises a master control computer, a 3D (three-dimensional) circular screen projection subsystem, a man-machine interaction subsystem, a synchronous interaction subsystem, a human body behavior detecting subsystem and a human body physiological monitor subsystem, the 3D circular screen projection subsystem, the man-machine interaction subsystem, the synchronous interaction subsystem, the human body behavior detecting subsystem and the human body physiological monitor subsystem are respectively electrically connected with the master control computer, and the synchronous interaction subsystem includes a loudspeaker device and a vibration device.
assignees: CHONGQING INST OF COAL RES INST

title_en: Device for making smoke intended notably for firefighting training exercises.
abstract_en: This device comprises a first container (10) to supply first smoke qualified as warm smoke. It is proposed that heating containers (15, 16,...) be added these having the effect of stratifying the top (50) of the area (3) in which a firefighting exercise is being run. Reference: Figure 1. Application: Firefighting exercises.
assignees: C S T B CT SCIENT ET TECH DU BATIMENT;MORAT SEBASTIEN

title_en: Comprehensive simulation and training system for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a comprehensive simulation and training system for emergency rescue, which comprises a preparation room, a physical training system, a disaster site environment training system, a medical aid system, and a control and monitoring system, wherein the systems are respectively installed in adjacent rooms built by fire-proof bricks; each room is provided with an air tight door and an air tight window; each air tight door is provided with a stainless steel louver, and a completely dark environment is formed after the louver is closed; a physical test system, the disaster site environment training system and the medical air system are respectively connected with the control land monitoring system and are respectively controlled and monitored by the control and monitoring system. The comprehensive simulation and training system for emergency rescue can comprehensively improve the physical and psychological quality, rescuing skill and the response capability of rescuers, and also can compressively simulate actual disaster site environments for training.

title_en: Life information drilling exploration system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a life information drilling exploration system for a mine, comprising a downhole device and a ground device. The downhole device comprises a multimedia video network acquisition module, a temperature-measuring unit, a downhole infrared camera, a microphone, a first SDSL (Symmetric Digital Subscriber Line) data access module and a first intrinsic safety power source, wherein the temperature-measuring unit comprises a thermal resistor and a temperature transmitter, the infrared camera, the microphone, a first SDSL data access module and the temperature-measuring unit are respectively connected with the multimedia video network acquisition module, and the ground device comprises a second SDSL data access module, a COFDM (Coded Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) wireless transmission access module connected with the second SDSL data access module, and a second intrinsic safety power source; and the downhole device and the ground device are connected by adopting a twisted-pair telephone line. After disaster, the downhole device is conveyed to underground through a drilled hole and transmits captured lift information to a ground rescue center in real time.
assignees: XI AN SENLAN TECH AND TRADING CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake emergency treatment drilling platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake emergency treatment drilling platform, which belongs to the field of virtual simulation application software. In recent years, the emergency management departments of the government generally pay attention to performing earthquake emergency drillings, and actual drillings and desktop drillings are widely used. The actual drillings involve a lot of persons, are difficult to organize and have high fund requirement. The picture discussion type desktop drillings cannot provide relatively real earthquake disaster scenes and vivid emergency backgrounds. So, by using a computer virtual reality technology and a network technology, a set of earthquake emergency treatment drilling platform is developed. The platform mainly comprises a scene editor, a director group, a drilling group and an estimation group which are shown in an attached figure in an abstract, wherein the scene editor creates scenes and events; the director group controls the drilling progress and fills information in real time; the drilling group responds to the corresponding events; and the estimation group estimates the drilling conditions. Due to the drilling platform, trainees are immersed in a relatively real earthquake disaster field, so that the presence of the trainees is enhanced, and the emergency treatment capability is improved.

title_en: Seismic disaster relief simulation system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seismic disaster relief simulation system, which comprises a server, a database, an I/O (input/output) device, a router and a plurality of client sides. The server is used for receiving access of each client side through the router and providing corresponding seismic disaster simulation data in the database and access prompt data in the server; the database is used for storing various types of earthquake simulation data; the I/O device is used for controlling the database and inputting various types of seismic disaster simulation data; the router is used for providing routing access between the server and each client side; and the client sides are used for receiving input of a user and displaying the data provided by the server to the user. The system can effectively achieve the seismic disaster simulation and the comprehensive inspection of each emergency department; and the system can be divided into a part for detailed scene modeling and a part for real-time building collapse simulation, and thus the scalability of the system is enhanced.

title_en: Personal Emergency Response System with Alternative Voice Line Capability
abstract_en: A communication system comprises a transmitter, a console in operative communication with the transmitter, an audible communication device and a tone simulator. The transmitter is in operative communication with the console and operative to send a first signal to the console. The console is operatively connected to a communication network and is operative to send a second signal over the communication network to at least two response systems. The console comprises a receiver operative to receive the first signal from the transmitter, a controller operative to compare the first signal from the transmitter with a set of pre-determined values, access a communication network and dial one of the at least two pre-programmed voice line addresses, and a communication interface operative to connect the receiver to a communication network. The audible communication device is coupled to the controller and the communication interface. Each pre-programmed voice line address corresponds to one of the two different response systems. The tone simulator generates a first tone upon connection of a voice line communication to one of the two different response systems and a second tone upon termination of audible communication on the voice line between a user of the communication system and an individual at one of the two different response systems. The first tone signals to the console that the voice line communication has begun, and the second tone signals to the console that the voice line communication has ended.

title_en: Drilled hole probing system for life information
abstract_en: A drilled hole probing system for life information in a mine comprises an underground device and a ground device, wherein the underground device comprises a multimedia video network collecting module, a temperature measuring unit composed of a thermal resistor and a temperature transmitter, an underground infrared camera, a microphone, a first SDSL (symmetric digital subscriber line) data access module and a first intrinsic safe power supply; the underground infrared camera, the microphone, the first SDSL data access module and the temperature measuring unit are connected with the multimedia video network collecting module respectively; the ground device comprises a second SDSL data access module, a COFDM (coded orthogonal frequency division multiplexing) wireless transmission access module connected with the second SDSL data access module and a second intrinsic safe power supply; and the underground device is connected with the ground device through a twist-pair telephone line. The underground device is conveyed through the drilled hole into the mine after a disaster and transmits the life information in real-time to a ground rescue center.
assignees: XI AN SENLAN TECH AND TRADING CO LTD

title_en: Method for constructing large through tower in mountain rock mass and section superposing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a large through tower in mountain rock mass and a section superposing method thereof. The technical scheme adopted is as follows: the construction process comprises the steps of digging a transportation channel, connecting for construction, expanding for construction, strengthening and preburying for construction, and installing for construction. The construction of preburying and irrigating comprises the step of burying the preburied part when irrigating, and the construction of the upper and the lower standard components comprises the step of strengthening the standard component with the preburied part through the method of constructing simultaneously up and down. By using the construction method of the technique, in the construction process, the excavated stone can be output continuously from the transportation channel so that the construction schedule can be quickened and the uncertainty that the stones fall in the course of drilling from down to up is avoided; therefore, the method is safe. The method has the beneficial effects of being small in investment, low in cost, short in construction period, less in influence from disaster, free from the effect of nucleus, safe in constructing process, stable in operating process, easy in confidentiality, easy to start emergency generation system and good in reutilization; besides, multiple processes can run simultaneously in construction.

title_en: Image classification method based on category correlated codebook and classifier voting strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image classification method based on a category correlated codebook and a classifier voting strategy. The method comprises the following steps of: expressing an image as a set of local salient region image blocks by an image data set pre-processing module; generating category correlated codebooks by a category correlated codebook generating module; expressing the image as an image vector by an image vectoring module, and training a classifier between two random categories by selecting the trained image vector and a category tag corresponding to the trained image through a category correlated classifier training module; and finally, determining the category tag of the tested image according to voting results by a classifier-voting-strategy-based tested image classifying module. The category correlated codebook generating module effectively solves the contradiction of dimension disaster caused by over large codebooks and judgment insufficiency caused by over small codebooks; and meanwhile, the category correlated classifier training module also gets rid of the problems caused by sample unbalance in multi-category classification, and the classification performance is improved.

title_en: Image classification method based on cascaded codebook generation
abstract_en: The invention provides an image classification method based on cascaded codebook generation. In the method, a cascaded codebook generation means is adopted, and a sample mapping space is dynamically adjusted according to the change of training samples, so that the training samples are easier to separate to train a classifier based on the current codebook. A test image sequentially passes through each trained classifier; when outputs of all classifiers are positive, a category tab of the image is judged to be positive; or the category tab of the image is judged to be negative. As a cascaded codebook generation method is adopted in the method, the number of dimensions represented by the image is reduced while each turn of codebooks keep stronger discrimination, and the conflict between the diversity of the codebook and the dimension disaster is solved; meanwhile, as the cascaded codebook generation means is adopted in the method, the number of positive samples and the number of negative samples trained in each turn are the same, and the common problem of nonuniform samples in the classification of special categories is ingeniously solved; moreover, the image classification method has an important application value.

title_en: Method for simulating state transition of hot billing (HB) system based on Petri network with inhibitor arcs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for simulating the state transition of a hot billing (HB) system based on a Petri network with inhibitor arcs. The method comprises the following steps of: 1, dividing the state of the HB system into a running state module, an online/offline module and a disaster tolerant module; 2, determining places, transition and distribution conditions of initial tokens of each module; 3, connecting directed arcs according to dependence or function relations between the transition and the places by using each module to form corresponding Petri sub-modules of each module respectively; 4, connecting the Petri sub-modules by using the directed arcs or the inhibitor arcs to form an integral Petri model according to relations among the three modules; and 5, performing control based on a Petri middleware platform, and performing automatic analysis and checking on the integral Petri model obtained by the step 4. By the method, the real-time state of the HB system can be displayed, so that operators and maintainers can instantly know and properly control the processing progress and health degree of the state transition of the HB system.
assignees: SHENZHEN TYDIC INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Detection method for changes of high-resolution remote sensing images
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection method for changes of high-resolution remote sensing images. The method comprises the steps of: S1: extracting multi-scale change characteristics of an image; S2: calculating change detection results of a minimum scale by virtue of partial characteristics of the image and a progressive direct-push support vector machine; and S3: making hierarchical refinement for the change detection results of the minimum scale by adopting the strategy of 'Hierarchical refinement from coarse to fine'. In the method, the changeable scale dependence is reflected by comprehensively utilizing the divisibility of the change characteristic under different scales,  the scale propagation characteristic of the changes is reflected by adopting the multiscale change detection strategy of 'Hierarchical refinement from coarse to fine', the hierarchy of human eyes in observation of the changes is simulated , and the calculating efficiency and robustness are greatly improved. The method can be widely applied to more application systems for disaster detecting, target monitoring, e-map updating and the like.

title_en: Portable explosion-proof booster pump
abstract_en: A portable explosion-proof booster pump comprises a pump body, a motor, a water pump input pipe, firefighting quick joints, a water pump output pipe, a valve, a firefighting high-pressure spray gun and hoses. The water pump input pipe and the water pump output pipe are respectively arranged at two ends of the pump body, the upper portion of the pump body matches with the motor, the outer end of the water pump input pipe is fittingly fixed to the first firefighting quick joint, the water inlet hose is fittingly connected with the first firefighting quick joint, the valve matches with the other firefighting quick joint at the other end of the water inlet hose, the outer end of the water pump output pipe is fittingly fixed to the second firefighting quick joint, the water outlet hose is fittingly connected with the second firefighting quick joint, the firefighting high-pressure spray gun is fittingly connected with the firefighting quick joint of the water outlet hose, an underground alternating-current power port is disposed on one side of the motor, a waterproof battery seat is arranged on the other side of the motor, and a high-voltage lithium battery is fittingly inserted with the battery seat. The portable explosion-proof booster pump is quick in installation, convenient in detachment, firm in structure and convenient to be carried, is explosion-proof, can be used in different tunnels and different sections and under different conditions, is outstanding in effect of underground field and simulated tunnel drilling tests, and is convenient to be popularized and utilized.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG LONGMAY MINING GROUP CO LTD SHUANGYASHAN BRANCH CO LTD RESCUING GROUP

title_en: Firefighting simulation rescue training system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a firefighting and antiterrorism training system, in particular to a firefighting simulation rescue training system, which comprises building walls, and simulation human body models and fire scene simulation devices which are arranged in the building walls, wherein the building walls are movable walls; the fire scene simulation devices are arranged on the movable walls and training monitoring systems are additionally arranged on the movable walls; the simulation human body models are connected with a simulation biological man main monitoring computer; and the training monitoring system comprises a main monitoring computer, the simulation biological man main monitoring computer and a video monitoring computer which are connected with a wireless router. By adopting the structure, the firefighting simulation rescue training system has the advantages that simulation environments are variable, the actual combat abilities of trainees during training can be evaluated and fed back, the reality of training environments is improved, and the training efficiency of the trainees is improved.
assignees: CHONGQING OPEN INFORMATION & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Forcible entry training door system
abstract_en: The present invention relates generally to apparatus for training the art of forcible door entry for emergency personnel such as firefighters and, in particular, a reusable forcible entry door training prop adapted to simulate a locked door and allow individuals to conduct training in forcible entry techniques for different door types and mounting configurations (e.g., opening inward or outward, left hand opening or right hand opening, steel jam or wood jams).

title_en: Intelligent indoor oxygen supply monitor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monitor, in particular to a monitor for monitoring oxygen content indoors, providing oxygen and stopping oxygen supply through intelligent control. The technical problem to be solved is to provide a monitor for monitoring oxygen content indoors, starting oxygen supply and stopping oxygen supply. The invention aims to provide an intelligent indoor oxygen supply monitor. The intelligent indoor oxygen supply monitor comprises an oxygen electrode sensor, a monitor and a shell, wherein an electronic simulation signal acquired by the oxygen electrode sensor is transmitted to the monitor and is used for displaying reading of oxygen content of the indoor air and controlling an oxygen generator and an oxygen releaser to start and stop operation automatically; and the monitor comprises a singlechip, a relay circuit, a light-emitting diode (LED) display, a network module, a direct digital controller (DDC) output/input port, a computer connecting port and a firefighting fire disaster warning signal input port which are arranged in the shell of the monitor. The intelligent indoor oxygen supply monitor aims to realize safety, automation and controllability of 'oxygen supply'.
assignees: SHANGHAI ZHIZHONG CONSTRUCTION INTELLIGENTIZING ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Automatic control rainfall simulation device and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic control rainfall simulation device which simulates artificial rainfall in the maintain disaster reduction and prevention technical research, and a using method to overcome the problems that a rainfall simulation spray device in the prior art cannot be effectively regulated and controlled to simulate different rainfall intensities and the like. The automatic control rainfall simulation device comprises a model groove, a water supply device, a control device and a spray device; the model groove is formed below the spray device; the water supply device and the control device are arranged on the rear part of the model groove; the water supply device comprises a water storage pool and a submersible pump which is arranged in the water storage pool; the control device comprises a main control valve, a secondary control valve and a flow meter; one end of the main control valve is connected with the submersible pump through a main water pipe and the other end of the main control valve is connected with the flow meter; one end of the secondary control valve is connected with the main water pipe and the other end of the secondary control valve is connected with a water return pipe and the water storage pool; one end of the flow meter is connected with the main control valve and the other end of the flow meter is connected with left and right water inlet pipes; the spray device comprises the left and right water inlet pipes, control valves and spray nozzles; the left and right water inlet pipes are connected with the flow meter and are divided into branch paths which have the same number as the rows of the spray nozzles according to the row number of the spray nozzles; the control valve is arranged at the bottom of each branch path; and the upper part of each branch path is provided with the spray nozzle.

title_en: Facility operation training system, facility operation training method and program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an environment for conducting training of various events which actually occur at site in various operations that prevents disasters and operations of a controller at an emergency, or the like, while experiencing the events with the sense of presence.  <P>SOLUTION: A facility operation training system includes a still-image data storage section storing still-image data of apparatus which is to be an object of the operation training; a moving-image data storage section storing moving-image data of the condition for operating various kinds of equipment; a text data storage section for storing text data containing the content of instructions to operators; a plurality of training scenario storage sections wherein the still-image data, or the like, on one stage in the operation training are associated, divided into a plurality of stages, and stored as a training scenario; and an operation training control section for displaying a list of the plurality of training scenarios, reading still-image data, or the like, that correspond to the training scenario that is selected from among the plurality of training scenarios, and creating and outputting output picture data together with an operation input receiving means which receives the operation input.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Connecting and banding device for fire hoses
abstract_en: The utility model provides a connecting and banding device for fire hoses, which is widely applied to fire drill, emergency rescue, disaster relief, rural field irrigation, watering of residential district and the like, and accomplishes connecting and banding work of fire hoses. The connecting and banding device for fire hoses comprises a base, a winding part, a limiting part and a winding-wire supplying part, wherein the winding part is installed on the base, the limiting part is installed on the winding part and fixed on the base through a limiting pull rod, and the winding-wire supplying part is fixed on the base. The winding part and a fire hose connector on a spindle conduct rotary motion to enable winding wires to be wound on the fire hoses through the limiting part. The connecting and banding device for fire hoses is special for the fire hoses, simple in structure, small in volume and convenient to use, enables the connection between the fire hoses and connectors to be firm, ensures banding quality, improves work efficiency, and provides a reliable guarantee for usage of the fire hoses.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEMICAL;HEKOU OIL PRODUCTION PLANT SINOPEC SHENGLI OILFIELD CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine unmanned workface development system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine unmanned workface development system. Around a coal mining machine, a hydraulic bracket and a scraper conveyor, an automatic control system for the three machines, a working condition detection and failure diagnosis system for the three machines, a disaster forecasting system, a coal mining environment safety expert system, a coal mining process intellectualization system, a coal mining simulation system and a decision-making simulation system are designed. The coal mine unmanned workface development system provided by the invention realizes the full automation of the whole highly-automatic coal mine unmanned workface development process by utilizing an industrial control system and a computer system, establishes a virtual model, optimizes processes, and compared with the conventional systems, has the advantages of high automation degree, safety, reliability, high efficiency and the like.
assignees: JIANGSU HEGUANG TIANDI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Automatic demonstration system and realizing method for 3-dimensioinal (3D) visual emergency plan
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic stimulation system and a realizing method for a 3-dimensional (3D) visual emergency plan, and belongs to the technical field of visual plan. The system mainly comprises a script explanation engine module and a 3D stimulation module. The script explanation engine module comprises a script generation module and a script explanation module; the 3D stimulation module comprises a scene route chart edition module, an initial document edition module, a cartoon script configuration module and a stimulation command performing module. The invention comprehensively uses the script explanation technology, the 3D virtual reality technology, the network technology and the voice synthesis technology so that the whole stimulation process can be impressed directly in term of vision by controlling the 3D to stimulate the automatic stimulation process via the script explanation engine; in addition, the stimulation process is added with the voice synthesis technology so that the stimulation process can be shown more vividly, thereby contributing to discovering the disadvantages in the plan and improving the plan; furthermore, the system can fulfill the aim of training the participator and improve the proficiency level and the emergency response capability of emergency personnel.

title_en: Airport fire vehicle driving training device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an airport fire vehicle driving training device, which consists of eight subsidiary systems including a cab system, a firefighting equipment system, a fire monitor operation system, a travelling drive system, a simulated fire monitor system, a simulated front-stage fire monitor system, a computer simulating system and a coach computer system. The eight subsidiary systems are connected to form a network by the aid of a digital I/O (input/output) interface, an analog-digital conversion card, a data acquisition and control system and a PLC (programmable logic controller) and form the training device for simulating operations, such as driving a simulated fire vehicle and fire fighting and the like. A coachee starts from receiving an alarm and drives the simulated fire vehicle to complete integral training processes including cruising, driving to a fire field of an airplane and extinguishing fire by a high-pressure water monitor in a view display screen. Meanwhile, during the training processes, signals of a steering wheel, an accelerator, a brake and extinguisher spaying and the like can be transmitted to the computer simulated system after being acquired by the data acquisition and control system and the PLC, and corresponding measures can be offered. Further, the view display screen outputs vivid extinguisher spraying scenes, and meanwhile, a sound system outputs corresponding sounds.

title_en: Process for creating earthquake disaster simulation in virtual reality environment
abstract_en: A computer-assisted method for creating earthquake engineering based realistic earthquake simulation in immersive virtual reality environment comprises: careful selection of building plan and internal elements on the basis of simulation objective, then selection of a suitable earthquake ground motion data from a pool of pre-recorded or synthetic earthquake data, then designing computer based structural engineering models of buildings and internal elements therein, thereafter, generating earthquake response of the said buildings and the said elements on the basis of earthquake engineering principles, then generating three dimensional (3D) computer models of the said buildings and the said elements and also mapping the said response onto these 3D models thereby producing 3D anirnations, thereafter creating stereoscopic visual and audio renderings of said animations for the immersive virtual reality platform of interest.
assignees: CORE PROJECTS & TECHNOLOGIES LTD;INDIAN INST TECHNOLOGY BOMBAY;SINHA RAVI;PATIL ATUL;SAPRE ASHISH

title_en: Training apparatus using facility monitoring device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To create a training pattern adapted to actual operation of a facility easily by using past result data.SOLUTION: The training apparatus includes: a data processing unit 14 which collects event information indicating the state of a facility, and creates a message character string indicating the state of the facility and additional information including the time of the event and tag information; a statistics message database 11 which stores the message character string and the additional information created in the data processing unit; a statistics message data searching unit 16 which searches the statistics message database for the statistics message data at the time of disaster by inputting a specific key word, and registers the searched statistics message data in a training pattern table; and a training execution unit 18 which reads a training pattern from the training pattern table and generates a simulation event.
assignees: HITACHI LTD;HITACHI INFORMATION & CONTROL SOLUTIONS LTD

title_en: Intelligence lifesaving parachute
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligence lifesaving parachute, which comprises a parachute pack of a built-in parachute pack, a weight loss sensing device installed inside the parachute pack and a power parachute opening device. The weight loss sensing device comprises a triaxial acceleration transducer, a numerical control circuit connected to the triaxial acceleration transducer and an electric control device connected to the numerical control circuit and used for controlling the starting of the power parachute opening device. The power parachute opening device is a compressed gas power parachute opening device or a gunpowder power parachute opening device. The triaxial acceleration transducer is adopted, regardless of what gestures parachuting persons have, acceleration of human body generated at the time of falling can be accurately sensed, and accordingly the power parachute opening device is automatically started through the numerical control circuit to achieve automatic intelligence parachute opening without manual control during the parachute opening process. The intelligence lifesaving parachute is simple in structure, convenient to use and sensitive. The parachuting persons do not have to receive professional training before using the intelligence lifesaving parachute. Safety of the parachuting persons is guaranteed, reliability of the parachute is enhanced, and therefore the intelligence lifesaving parachute can be widely used for escaping a disaster from high buildings or escaping by people who work or climb high above the ground and the like.

title_en: Tank type underground refuge chamber
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of mine safety, in particular to a tank type underground refuge chamber. The tank type underground refuge chamber is characterized by comprising a survival chamber, transitional chambers are disposed on two sides of the survival chamber and communicated with refuge channels, a first isolation door is arranged between each transitional chamber and each refuge channel, a second isolation door is arranged between each transitional chamber and the survival chamber, and one side of the survival chamber is provided with a drill hole and a drill hole channel which directly lead to the ground. The tank type underground refuge chamber is large in service range when in disaster, can hold a great quantity of persons, is low in engineering cost, leads the persons in the chamber to live longer, can guarantee life safety, is convenient for rescue, and provides a guarantee for underground safety production.
assignees: COAL IND JINAN DESIGN & RES CO

title_en: Emergency disaster temporary rapid deployment oil spill reclamation pyramid or pyramid with chute and flotation collar
abstract_en:
The Emergency Disaster Temporary Rapid Deployment Oil Spill Reclamation Pyramid and Pyramid with Chute and Flotation Collar is a totally new concept to the offshore oil industry. Nothing of this unique, new concept has ever been conceived, manufactured or deployed in the history of the offshore oil drilling industry. It is a revolutionary concept that will have a dramatic impact on the problems with the environment, the fish and wildlife, the local and national economy, and the health and welfare of the citizens of the United States from the time of this application into the future. 
     The Emergency Disaster Temporary Rapid Deployment Oil Spill Reclamation Pyramid and Pyramid with Chute and Flotation Collar is a conceptual method of arresting the oil from an off-shore oil spill such as the DEEPWATER HORIZON. It is a containment vessel which when deployed at an off-shore oil spill contains the oil at the site and allows the oil to be suctioned off or float naturally and unrestricted to the top of the pyramid as shown in FIG.  2  and FIG.  3,  or to the surface as shown in FIGS.  5, 6  and  7.  The oil can then be reclaimed by pumping the oil from the reservoir provided by the pyramid or pyramid with chute and flotation collar into an oil reclamation tanker.

title_en: Hazard-Zone Incident Command Training and Certification Systems
abstract_en: Systems designed to train and certify persons to act as at least one responsible person(s) for decision making and management operations as part of an emergency response at incidents that contain at least one hazard zone; such hazard zone defined as any work area which contains a hazard that can injure or kill, for example, burning structures, hazardous material incidents, roadways with active traffic, natural disaster sites, and/or other emergency response scenes.

title_en: Fuzzy simulation system for disaster determination and method thereof
title_ko: 재해 판단을 위한 퍼지 시뮬레이터 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fuzzy simulation system for determining a disaster and a method thereof are provided to improve the reliability of determination by using sensors as backdata for determining a disaster. CONSTITUTION: An input unit(110) receives an input function which establishes a safe state from sensor values, an output function showing the class of the disaster risk, and a rule for inferring the degree of disaster risk. A fuzzy inference unit(130) creates a fuzzy rule based on the input function, the output function, and the inferring rule. A simulator(140) calculates a disaster risk degree by simulating the fuzzy rule. The sensor value comprises information regarding oxygen concentration, oxygen concentration variation, carbon monoxide concentration, temperature, humidity, fire, and smoke.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재해 판단을 위한 퍼지 시뮬레이터 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따르면, 복수의 센서 값에 대하여 각각의 안전상태를 설정하는 입력소속함수, 재해 위험도의 등급을 나타내는 출력소속함수, 복수의 센서에 따른 상기 재해 위험도를 결정하는 추론 규칙을 입력받는 입력부, 입력소속함수, 출력소속함수 및 추론 규칙으로부터 퍼지규칙을 생성하는 퍼지 추론부, 그리고 생성된 퍼지규칙을 시뮬레이션하여 재해 위험도를 산출하는 시뮬레이션부를 포함한다.  이와 같이 본 발명에 의하면 복수개의 센서를 동시에 재해 판단의 근거로 삼음으로써 판정의 오류를 줄였고, 판정의 신뢰도를 높일 수 있다.  또한, 판정 범위 내에 있는 환경에 있어서 화재 가능성, 폭발 가능성, 질식가능성을 동시에 판정 함으로써 재해 상태를 다면적으로 파악할 수 있는 특징이 있다.  그리고, 판정을 위한 규칙을 판정 범위 내에서 이루어지는 작업의 종류, 환경의 특성을 고려하여 목적에 적합한 판정 규칙을 선택할 수 있도록 구성하여 특수한 환경에서의 판정의 신뢰성을 높일 수 있다.  
       
     퍼지, 시뮬레이터, 재해 판단, 소속함수
