title_en: Integrated traffic-management method and system thereof
title_ko: 통합교통관리 방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An integrated traffic managing method and a system thereof are provided to efficiently and optimally perform integrated traffic management. CONSTITUTION: A basic network and end point data collecting unit(210) collects data about a basic network and an end point from a national traffic database. A reference network data collecting unit(220) collects a reference network by a navigation and a new address business standard node/link. A transportation, bicycle, and pedestrian network data collecting unit(230) collects transportation, bicycle, and pedestrian network data. A reference end point data collecting unit(240) collects reference end point data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통합교통관리 방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것으로, 발명은 도로 및 교통수요유발시설 건설에 따른 신규 네트워크 및 기종점 데이터를 기존 네트워크 및 기종점 데이터에 갱신하여 수요를 분석함으로서 요일별, 시간대별 교통수요를 예측하고 이를 통해 통합교통관리를 보다 효율적이며 최적한 상태로 수행할 수 있도록 한다. 또한 실시간으로 수집한 교통량, 속도 등 교통기초데이터와 사고 및 공사 등 이벤트 데이터를 실시간으로 반영한 시뮬레이션 분석을 통해 도출된 대안별 교통영향을 바탕으로 ; 고정식, 감응식 및 연동식 교통신호체계를 구축하고, 이용자에게 교통예측정보를 제공하며, 대중교통 최적노선을 구축함으로서  불필요한 교통정체 현상을 배제하고, 교통영향평가, 환경영향평가, 보행로 및 자전거로 운영방안, 긴급대피효과 분석을 통해 안전과 효율성 측면의 도시내 교통계획의 타당성을 분석함으로서 쾌적하고 효율적인 통행환경 구축과 동시에 교통정체 발생을 억제하여 소음, 탄소 배출을 최소화할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Simulation terminal for disaster prevention system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide the simulation terminal of a disaster prevention system, in which a fire detector performs pulse-communication with a disaster prevention receiving board for confirming a function which assumes that a fire signal or a state signal other than the fire signal has been received from each terminal device of the disaster-prevention receiving board, even when each terminal device is not connected to the disaster prevention system.SOLUTION: The simulation terminal of a disaster prevention system for generating a signal pulse that is a simulation signal equivalent to terminal equipment connected via a signal line to a disaster-prevention receiving board is provided with an input means for inputting pulse width and pulse interval for setting the signal pulse; a signal-pulse generation means for generating a signal pulse, according to the input pulse width and pulse interval; and a signal-pulse transmission means for transmitting the signal pulse generated.

title_en: Ground stabilization method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a ground stabilization method in which an unstable ground can be effectively reinforced by discharging underground water, which is seen as a main factor causing ground disaster, and reinforcing the ground.SOLUTION: A pipe 2 having a water-permeable bag body 3 and a permeable opening 2a is inserted into a drilled hole 1. The bag body 3 is expanded by injecting a consolidation material 6 into the bag body 3 through the pipe 2 so as to fix the pipe 2 in the drilled hole 1. Underground water is discharged from the permeable opening 2a through the pipe 2 to a drain port 2b of the pipe 2 located on the ground surface. The ground is reinforced by the tensile force of the pipe 2. A hole-opened steel pipe is used for the pipe 2 while a bag body comprising a high strength fiber such as an aramid fiber other than a hemp bag is used for the water-permeable bog body 3. A plastic gel, cement grout or the like is used for the consolidation material 6.

title_en: System for managing emergency based on standard operation procedure scenario and method of managing emergency
title_ko: 표준작전절차 시나리오 기반의 재난 및 위기관리시스템과 그 방법
abstract_ko: 표준작전절차 시나리오 기반의 재난 및 위기관리시스템과 그 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 SOP 기반의 재난 및 위기관리시스템은 재난 유형과 그 진행단계에 따라 유관기관과 그 유관기관별로 각 담당자의 임무를 재난처리단계에 따라 단계별로 규정한 표준작전절차(SOP: Standard Operation Procedure) 시나리오를 저장한 SOP 시나리오 데이터베이스와, 유관기관, 유관기관별 보유자원의 목록 및 유관기관별 수신매체에 대한 정보를 포함하는 유관기관정보를 저장한 유관기관 데이터베이스와, 재난신고에 기초하여 작성된 재난유형을 포함한 재난현황정보가 수신되면, 유관기관 데이터베이스에 기초하여 재난발생을 알리는 상황전파메시지를 생성하여 일정한 주기로 유관기관의 수신매체로 전송하며, 전송된 상황전파메시지에 대응하여 유관기관의 단말의 접속여부를 확인하는 재난상황전파서버와, 유관기관의 단말의 접속이 확인되면, SOP 시나리오 데이터베이스에 기초하여 접속된 유관기관의 단말로 각 담당자의 임무를 전송하는 사이버 상황실 서버를 포함한다. 이를 통해 재난발생시 유관기관의 각 담당자가 취해야 할 임무를 재난의 처리단계에 따라 맞춤형으로 각 담당자에게 제공하여 줌으로써, 각 유관기관의 협업에 의해 재난처리를 신속하고 원활하게 할 수 있다.

title_en: Coal rock gas dynamic disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal rock gas dynamic disaster simulation device, which comprises a cylinder body assembly, a pressure relief device and a data monitoring system, wherein the cylinder body assembly comprises a piston rod, an upper cover, a piston, a rubber O-shaped ring for the piston, a cylinder body, a lower cover and the rubber O-shaped ring for the lower cover, wherein a square pressure relief opening is formed in the cylinder body; and the pressure relief device comprises an air compressor, a dynamic pneumatic cylinder, a supporting beam, a bracket, a pressure relief plate, a pressure relief opening sealing plate and a square rubber pad. The coal rock gas dynamic disaster simulation device can simulate dynamic disasters under the conditions of high stress, high gas and different surrounding rocks and is more practical in field engineering.

title_en: Hole distribution method for long-acting extraction of ground coal bed gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hole distribution method for long-acting extraction of ground coal bed gas. The rock stratum deformation characteristic and the gas movement distribution law of a mining area are fully researched in the conventional common gob gas extraction technology, reasonable and effective drilling design is adopted, the service life of an extraction hole is generally short, and most drilled holes are damaged after a working face passes through the holes, so that effective extraction of the ground gob gas cannot be finished. Holes are scientifically and reasonably distributed by determining the density of the ground drilled holes, determining the positions of the holes and determining the positions of final holes. According to the method, work period prolongation and function extension of a coal bed gas extraction well can be realized, and pre-extraction before mining, extraction of the mining area and the gob and continuous gas extraction after the waste is kept in a mine can be finished by one-time project; and underground gas disasters of the mine are effectively prevented, atmospheric environment pollution caused by coal mining is comprehensively lightened, and clean energy is furthest developed.
assignees: XI AN RES INST OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENG GROUP CORP

title_en: Power grid wind damage early warning system based on micro-landform wind field distribution and typhoon superimposed effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid wind damage early warning system based on micro-landform wind field distribution and typhoon superimposed effect, belonging to the field of prevention, reduction and control of natural disaster for a power grid. The power grid wind damage early warning system comprises a weather data acquisition sub-system, a wind damage and wind speed forecasting computer sub-system, a power grid early warning information processing computer sub-system, a power grid wind damage estimation processing computer sub-system and an information issuing sub-system, and each above sub-system is orderly in signal electrical connections. The power grid wind damage early warning system is capable of acquiring timed weather data of meteorological stations in a region covered by the power grid, performing standard pretreatment, then, establishing a gale statistical diagnosis model and a numerical model by means of theory modeling and numerical simulation, analyzing influence degree of the gale on main lines, iron towers and transformer substations, and issuing a related gale early warning information report based on related rules for gale early warning grades, wherein the related rules are specified by the Meteorological Office. And the power grid wind damage early warning system has the advantages of high precision, excellent accuracy, quick real-time response speed and the like, and can provide decision support for gale damage prevention and power grid planning.
assignees: FUJIAN POWER CO LTD;FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method for strengthening mine tailing dam by using 'solidified stone' material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine tailing dams, in particular to a method for strengthening a mine tailing dam by using a 'solidified stone' material. The method comprises the following steps of: mixing the 'solidified stone' and water to prepare slurry for later use; arranging drilling holes on the top of the dam body; drilling downwards to bedrock by using a mine down-the-hole drill; and injecting the slurring to fill the drilling holes by using a slurry pump and by a pressed permeation injection method. After the slurry is solidified, a 'solidified stone' strengthened structure using the drilling hole as a main body and scattering circumferentially to form a root system shape is formed; and according to design of hole arrangement, a plurality of holes are distributed in the dam body, so after the slurry is solidified, the whole strength of the dam body is greatly enhanced, cracks and holes caused by sedimentation, shake or other factors can be blocked, the effects of stabilizing the dam, blocking permeation and preventing leakage are achieved, and the aims of strengthening the tailing dam and preventing dam break disaster are fulfilled.

title_en: Self-rescue descent control device for fire disaster
abstract_en: A self-rescue descent control device for fire disaster is characterized in that two ends of a cylindrical casing are respectively fixedly connected with an end cap, the two end caps are connected with a sleeve through fixing shafts, ends of the side wall of the sleeve are connected with four rotors with cavities through bearings, sliders are disposed in the rotors and are connected with friction sheets through screws, springs are arranged on the peripheries of the friction sheets, retainer rings are arranged at bottom ends of the rotors, and multiple turns of steel wires are wound on the sleeve. The self-rescue descent control device for fire disaster has the advantages that the self-rescue descent control device is a high-rise escape tool utilizing friction force generated from centrifuge force to control speed automatically, overcomes various defects of conventional escape tools, is compact in structure, safe in descending, automatically controllable in descending speed, convenient to use and low in cost, is suitable for general families, can be used for a single user or multiple users repeatedly, and can assist any person without training in advance to escape safely, quickly and successfully.

title_en: Apparatus for exit simulation to urgent cases and method thereof
title_ko: 위급상황을 위한 피난 시뮬레이션 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
위급상황을 위한 피난 시뮬레이션 장치 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 
피난 시뮬레이션 장치는 건물의 구조정보를 기초로 건물을 모델링하여 시각화한 후, 피난자들의 행동특성을 반영한 피난자들의 속성정보를 기초로 시각화된 건물 상에서 피난자들의 대피경로를 찾고, 피난 진행 상태를 예측하는 피난 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 건물의 구조정보와 매칭되는 피난 시뮬레이션 결과 데이터를 생성한다. 당해 장치는 외부 프로그램을 통해 생성되는 화재 시뮬레이션 결과 데이터 중 피난에 영향을 주는 일부를 추출하여 함께 표시할 수 있다. 또한, 사람의 행동특성인 군집현상을 반영하기 위한 다이나믹 플로어 필드의 개념이 채용될 수 있다. 피난 시뮬레이션 과정에서, 최단경로로 탈출하는 경향을 나타내는 기본적인 스태틱 값과 더불어 피난 시 타인에게 의존하여 탈출하는 경향을 나타내는 다이나믹 플로어 필드의 다이나믹 값이 함께 계산되며, 두 가지 값이 모두 반영된 최적의 대피경로가 결정된다. 
이에 따르면, 피난 시 최단경로와 더불어, 사람의 특성을 고려하여 피난모습을 보다 정확히 예측할 수 있다.

title_en: Foldable movable plate house
abstract_en: The utility model provides a foldable movable plate house capable of folding and dropping down side wall plates, comprising a top plate, a front wall plate, a back wall plate, a left wall plate, a right wall plate and a lower fixation frame, wherein the top plate is provided with a flange, a vertical stand, a ridge and a raised key, the front, back wall plates are connected with the vertical stand, the left, right wall plates are connected with the lower fixation plate, the connection is the hinge type connection in which a pivoting rod is mutually inserted into a pivoting hole, the lower end surface of the lower fixation frame is provided with a fixation foot hole for fixing the plate house and the top plate is provided with a drainage channel. The foldable movable plate house has features of simple and reasonable structure, convenience, practicability, realization of split combination connection,  being conveniently turned over, stood and self-locked to form a house and folded and contracted, greatly increased putting-up speed and disassembling speed; saved space usage after being folded, reduced transportation cost, relative high emergency and relative wide adaptability. The foldable movable plate house can adapt for and satisfy the needs of the army camp training, nation disaster relief settlement and mine escape help waiting and other temporary needs of other places.

title_en: Rectangular pressure relief opening pressure plate sealing mechanism of coal or rock gas dynamic disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rectangular pressure relief opening pressure plate sealing mechanism of a coal or rock gas dynamic disaster simulation device, comprising a pressure-bearing plate which is vertically arranged and a square plugging block which is arranged at the back of the pressure-bearing plate, wherein the left side and the right side of the front face of the pressure-bearing plate are respectively provided with an inclined plane; the two inclined planes respectively extend towards the rear directions of the left side and the right side and are respectively in compression joint with a pressure relief plate; and the two pressure relief plates are connected and applies pressure to sealing pressure plates by means of the power of a cylinder so as to achieve the aim of sealing. The rectangular pressure relief opening pressure plate sealing mechanism is a sealing device with a simple structure, a good sealing effect and high bearing capacity and ensures that a coal or rock gas dynamic disaster simulation experiment system is more reliable and convenient.

title_en: Intelligent snake type system for finding and plugging nuclear pollution leakage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent snake type system for finding and plugging nuclear pollution leakage. Long flexible pipes containing aluminum foil, glass fiber and a heating wire are used for conveying fluid, a sprayer provided with a camera or a detecting instrument for leading the way, a plurality of spray pipes with different direction postures are arranged, the fluid is sprayed according to a manual control order to generate a reverse thrust to move or turn the sprayer to find a path to approach a disaster source, then the fluid is sprayed to eliminate the disaster or concrete, sodium silicate, even lead or tin or zinc melt is sprayed to plug the leakage so as to eliminate the nuclear and chemical pollution from the source or plug the oil gas blowout. The sprayer is easy to drill in a protective shell of the disaster source from a crack, then sprays a quick setting substance to automatically stick with the disaster source so that the long flexible pipes and a suspension tow rope can forcibly pull the disaster source out to be treated effectively, or the system can help the Chernobyl to eliminate the nuclear curse. The intelligent snake-type system has light and long main body, can protect people from dangers, can be remotely controlled and can be moved to a preferable work position in cooperation with rope-dragged hydrogen balloon; after the operation, the system is easy to store and transport; and the system is formed by skillfully combining common components, is low in cost and easy for popularization.

title_en: Intelligent forest firefighting mortar system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent forest firefighting mortar system. The intelligent forest firefighting mortar system comprises a firefighting mortar which is connected with a common and control instrument which can intelligently control the firefighting mortar according to fire point information; the common and control instrument is connected with a laser range finder, a weather instrument and a geographic information system (GIS); and the firefighting mortar is arranged on an artillery position holder. On one hand, the intelligent forest firefighting mortar system combines a holder technology and the traditional firefighting mortar, utilizes the common and control instrument to control the artillery position holder according to the fire point information, and automatically endows shooting direction and angle of the horizontal plane and the vertical plane of the firefighting mortar to shorten the shooting time and improve the shooting precision so as to reduce firefighting cost and increase firefighting benefit; on the other hand, the intelligent forest firefighting mortar system has lower technical requirements for operators, can shorten the training period of the operators, and can reduce training cost so as to contribute to popularization and application in the fields of forest firefighting, military and the like.

title_en: Multifunctional stringing pole-erecting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional stringing pole-erecting machine which comprises a power operation vehicle with a walking chassis, wherein the lower part of the walking chassis is provided with walking wheels, the rear part of the walking chassis is provided with a power mechanism and a driving control chamber, the front part of the walking chassis is provided with a rotary support, the power mechanism is in transmission connection with the walking wheels through a transmission shaft under the walking chassis and a transfer case, the power mechanism is in hydraulic transmission connection with the rotary support, a rotary base is arranged on the rotary support, a pole lifting device is rotatably connected to the rotary base, the lower part of the pole lifting device is provided with a drilling mechanism, and the front end and the rear end of the walking chassis are respectively provided with a foldable front support leg and a foldable rear support leg. The multifunction stringing pole-erecting machine is a power grid stringing construction mechanical device integrating drilling and pole erecting, is integrally of an electrohydraulic control mode, is especially suitable for emergence rush repair when a power grid suffers from natural disasters, and is more suitable for environment with larger pole-erecting operation density in rugged and narrow places and places into which construction vehicles can not enter.
assignees: HENAN TRANSMISSION & DISTRIB CO LTD;HENAN EELECTRIC POWER BODA TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Combined tent for military
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined tent for military, which is a tool for camping and residing. Because angle iron of eaves at two sides of a tent frame, the top surface of the tent and a sealing rubber gasket are respectively provided with nine holes by drilling and punching, the angle iron, the tent and the sealing rubber gasket can be combined and connected to form a plurality of tents under the action of bolts and nuts and can be continuously combined and expanded at the left side and the right side of the tent. Joints of the tents are provided with the sealing rubber gaskets, the combined tent does not leak rainwater, and the two tents share one enclosing wall (tarpaulin) and uprights, which save a large quantity of tarpaulin and metal materials for manufacturers. The combined tent has the characteristics of small land occupation area, wind and rainwater resistance, random combination and less quantity of used tent ropes, can be used in army camping, and can also be used for disaster relief and settlement of disaster victims.

title_en: Device and method for monitoring evolution and distribution of mining-induced fracture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and method for monitoring the evolution and distribution of a mining-induced fracture. Generation, evolution and distribution of the mining-induced fracture are monitored through a method of monitoring acoustic wave or vibration generated in fracture of coal or rock. The device mainly comprises an anti-explosion acoustic wave monitor, an anti-explosion power source and a ground monitoring analysis center, wherein the anti-explosion acoustic wave monitor consists of a sonic sensor and a signal conversion and data acquisition instrument; the sonic sensor is arranged on a roadway base plate, an anchor rod tail end or a drill hole; and an acoustic wave or vibration signal monitored by the sonic sensor is collected and processed by the signal conversion and data collection instrument, and is transmitted to the ground monitoring analysis center through an optical fiber port to be subjected to processing, positioning and quantitative analyzing and be labeled on a plane, a cross section or a space diagram according to the position and size, so as to show the position and size of the fracture. The device and method provided by the invention has the beneficial effects of large monitoring range, a large amount of comprehensive monitoring information, high automation degree, strong instantaneity and capability of being applied to monitoring and forecasting the coal rock dynamic disasters, such as rock burst, and outburst and water burst of coal and gas and the like.
assignees: XUZHOU FU AN TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional stringing and poling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional stringing and poling machine which comprises a power operation vehicle with a walking chassis, wherein the lower part of the walking chassis is provided with walking wheels; the rear part of the walking chassis is provided with a power mechanism and a driving and controlling room; the front part of the walking chassis is provided with a slewing bearing; the power mechanism is in drive connection with walking wheels through a transmission shaft and a transfer case below the walking chassis; the power mechanism is in hydraulic drive connection with the slewing bearing; the slewing bearing is provided with a slewing base; the slewing base is connected with a pole lifting device in a rotating mode; the lower part of the pole lifting device is provided with a drilling mechanism; and the front end and the rear end of the walking chassis are respectively provided with foldable front legs and foldable rear legs. The multifunctional stringing and poling machine is mechanical equipment for power grid stringing construction and combines the functions of drilling and poling. The whole machine adopts an electrohydraulic control mode and is especially suitable for emergency repair when the power grid suffers from natural disasters and in the places of rugged and narrow terrain which are difficult for engineering vehicles to enter. The multifunctional stringing and poling machine is more suitable for the environment with larger poling operation density.
assignees: HENAN TRANSMISSION & DISTRIB CO LTD;HENAN ELECTRIC POWER BODA TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Seismic simulation device and aseismatic design
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seismic simulation device, which is designed on the basis of seismic simulation tests, aseismatic simulation tests, abundant theoretical analysis investigation and characteristics. The device is widely applied to seismic research, disaster prevention and teaching. According to an aseismatic design, seismic waves and a building are isolated, and the scheme is theoretically established in the simulation tests and is correct.

title_en: Marine environment quality monitoring system based on Phidgets sensing control
abstract_en: The marine environment quality monitoring system based on Phidgets sensing control comprises Phidgets sensor network terminal nodes, sink nodes, gateway nodes, a background monitoring system and a client; the Phidgets sensor network terminal nodes acquire data through sensor adapters, transmit the data to the gateway nodes in time through self-adaptive routing and multi-hop relay, and the gateway nodes package the data after being collected by the sink nodes, transmit the data to a background database in the background monitoring system and output results by a client side in a bright coordinate mode by utilizing a Gmap technology; the invention adopts Phidgets sensing control, and displays marine environment information through a weir coordinate through a sensor adapter, and has the main innovation points that: 1. simulating a real marine geographic environment. 2. The working mode and method of the traditional marine environment monitoring and evaluation service are simplified. 3. Building a marine environment monitoring database; and (4) issuing analysis forecast and alarm of the marine natural environment and disasters in time, and automatically analyzing marine red tide monitoring indexes.

title_en: Combustion device with smoke and fire effect
abstract_en: A combustion device with a smoke and fire effect comprises a combustion box, an oil supply pipeline and an oil tank. An upper oil collecting tank is connected above a top plate of the combustion box, and oil collecting holes are distributed at the tank bottom of the upper oil collecting tank. At least one combustion unit group which is composed of a filter, a high-pressure oil pump, an S-shaped pipe, an oil jetting nozzle and an ignition needle is arranged inside a casing of the combustion box, an oil inlet of the filter is connected with the oil supply pipeline horizontally extending into the bottom of the combustion box through a connecting pipe, and an oil outlet of the filter is connected with an oil inlet of the high-pressure oil pump. An oil outlet at the upper end of the high-pressure oil pump is connected with the upwards-arranged oil jetting nozzle through the S-shaped pipe, the oil jetting nozzle is arranged in the oil collecting hole of the upper oil collecting tank, and the ignition needle is adjacent to the oil jetting nozzle. The combustion device with the smoke and fire effect can simulate a smoke and fire on-site scene of natural disasters including fire disasters, earthquakes and the like, is convenient to install and operate, safe and reliable in use and suitable for smoke and fire effect forming of large and medium size fire fighting and rescue exercising places and shooting sites and can serve as a stationary type smoke and fire device which is arranged at the corresponding position on the sites.
assignees: BEIJING PUBLIC UTILITY RES INST;BEIJING PUBLIC CAUSE TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Triaxial impact dynamic load and dead load combined tester
abstract_en: A triaxial impact dynamic load and dead load combined tester is suitable for mine impact dynamic force disaster mechanism study and laboratory simulation reproduction, and can realize dynamic and controllable loading of coal samples with different dynamic modes and dead modes combined, simulate various stress wave loading modes of coals, and systematically reproduce the impact phenomenon of coal with true triaxial properties. The tester mainly comprises a dead load pressure device applying dead loading in x, y, and z directions, and structurally includes fixed seats, a steel framework, oil cylinders, pressure heads, a limit disc, a nitrogen cylinder, a hydrogen gun, an impact bar, an input bar, and an output bar. Through adopting the axial dynamic load and dead load devices and ambient pressure, which are combined together, the mechanism of impact destroy on coal due to stress wave impacts such as mineral earthquake is studied, an integral impact mine pressure generating mould under dynamic load and dead load conditions is built, the effect of the resultant force of all affecting factors is studied, and a theoretical foundation is laid for the mine-earthquake-caused impact and the prevention thereof.

title_en: Simulation experience center
title_ko: 시뮬레이션 체험관
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A simulation experience hall deals with a disaster by virtually experiencing the situation of the disaster. CONSTITUTION: A simulation experience hall comprises a waiting room(110), a pre-show room(120), a main show room(140), a simulator(150), and a post show room(170). The waiting room includes a first display which shows an image about a predetermined virtual disaster site. The pre-show room is connected to the waiting room and shows an image, which monitors the predetermined virtual disaster site, through a second display. The main show room shows an image, in which a disaster suppression apparatus is put, through a third display when a virtual disaster is generated in the predetermined virtual disaster site. The simulator is arranged in the main show room and moves with the disaster suppression apparatus after spectators ride. The show room shows a disaster suppressing image through a fourth display in the predetermined virtual disaster site.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 관람객이 시뮬레이션상으로 재난을 진압하는 것을 체험할 수 있는 시뮬레이션 체험관에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 시뮬레이션 체험관은, 가상의 재난 예정 장소에 관한 영상을 상영하는 제1디스플레이가 설치되는 대기룸; 상기 대기룸에 연결되고, 상기 재난 예정 장소를 감시하는 영상을 상영하도록 제2디스플레이가 설치되는 프리쇼룸; 상기 프리쇼룸에 연결되고, 상기 재난 예정 장소에서 가상의 재난이 발생되었을 때에 재난진압장비가 투입되는 영상을 상영하는 제3디스플레이가 설치되는 메인쇼룸; 상기 메인쇼룸에 설치되고, 관람객이 탑승한 후 상기  재난진압장비와 연동하여 움직이는 시뮬레이터; 및 상기 메인쇼룸에 연결되고, 가상의 인물이 재난 발생 장소에서 재난진압장비가 재난을 진압하는 영상을 상영하는 제4디스플레이가 설치되는 포스트쇼룸;을 포함하는 시뮬레이션 체험관을 제공한다.

title_en: Life safe experience system
title_ko: 생활안전체험 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A life safety experience system is provided to reduce the incidence of safety accidents by giving children a taste of the various kinds of the safety accidents and eliminating cause of the generation of the safety accident. CONSTITUTION: A traffic safety experience provides acting knacks when leaking gas and various safety experiences to children. A subway accident safety experience provides the experience about a safety accident which is generated in subway. A descending life line experience provides a method capable of escaping using a descending life line when a fire breaks out. A fire fighting safety experience teaches a method capable of putting out a fire using a fire extinguisher.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생활안전체험 시스템에 관한 것으로서 보다 상세하게는 어린이들에게 실 생활에서 접할 수 있는 가스사고, 전기사고, 교통사고, 천재지변 및 화재사고 등과 같은 다양한 종류의 안전사고에 대하여 그에 따른 행동요령을 각각 체험하면서 안전의식을 고취할 수 있는 생활안전체험 시스템을 발명한 것이다. 
보다 상세하게는 상기 생활안전체험 시스템은 가스안전체험과, 지하철 사고안전체험과, 완강기체험과, 교통안전체험과, 전기안전체험과, 소방안전체험이 선택적으로 실시되어지는 상기 생활안전체험 시스템을 진행하면서 안전에 대한 교육을 어린이들이 직접 체험함으로서 생활하면서 발생가능한 안전사고에 대한 위험상황으로부터 어린이들의 소중한 생명을 보호할 수 있는 체험학습 시스템을 발명한 것이다. 
이에 따라 안전사고의 발생원인을 미연에 제거하여 안전사고의 발생율을 현저히 저하시킴과 동시에 부득이하게 상기 안전사고가 발생하는 경우에도 그에 따른 적절한 대응방안을 본 발명의 생활안전체험 시스템 훈련을 통하여 능동적으로 대처함으로서 안전사고를 초기에 진압하여 또 다른 피해를 예방하여 생명을 보호하고 경제적인 손실을 최소화할 수 있는 매우 우수한 발명이다.

title_en: Fire fighting safe experience system and system
title_ko: 소방안전체험 시스템 및 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire fighting safety experience system and apparatus are provided to help people to rapidly put out a fire by guiding the operation method of a fire extinguisher. CONSTITUTION: A fire video is outputted in a screen which is located in the front side of a body part in a fire image output step. Smoke is sprayed in the screen using a fire extinguisher in a smoke spraying step. The extinguishing of a fire is notified through a smoke sensor which is located in one side of the body part in a fire extinguishing step. A blowing fan is operated in order to eliminate the smoke which is located in the around the body part in a smoke inhalation step. The smoke which is inhaled is eliminated through a filter in a smoke elimination step.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방안전체험 시스템 및 장치에 관한 것으로서 상기와 같은 소방안전체험을 미리 체험학습함으로서 소방화재 발생시에 따른 행동요령을 각각 체험하면서 안전의식을 고취할 수 있는것이다. 
보다 상세하게는 소방화재 발생시에 따른 신속하고 능동적인 훈련을 연습할 수 있도록 스크린을 통하여 다양한 형상의 화재가 실제상황과 동일하게 연출되고 이에 따라 상기 스크린에 비치되어진 소화기를 이용하여 분사함으로서 상기 소화기를 통하여 스크린에 연출되어진 화재를 진압하여 어린들이 신속하게 화재를 진압 할 수 있는 것이다. 
또한, 현장감이 조성되어질 수 있도록 상기 스크린의 영상출력과 함께 스피커를 통하여 다양한 음향이 연출되어져 실제 화재현장에 대한 체험이 가능함으로서 화재발생시에도 당황하지 않고 능동적으로 소화기를 이용하여 화재를 진압할 수 있는 것이다. 
이에 따라 소방화재에 발생에 따른 훈련을 통하여 능동적으로 대처함으로서 화재사고를 초기에 진압하여 생명을 보호하고 경제적인 손실을 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 제공된다.

title_en: System and Method for Casualty Treatment and Evacuation in Response to an Emergency Situation
abstract_en: A system and method for assisting casualties, categorizing survivors, and communicating pertinent casualty and survivor information to external emergency response teams during a crisis situation. A kit may be provided that comprises a variety of emergency medical supplies, instructional casualty treatment information, and a plurality of casualty placards. Able-bodied survivors with no medical training may use the kit and its contents to properly prioritize and provide basic emergency medical assistance to help reduce casualty mortality during a crisis situation. Instructions and method steps contained within each kit teach each user to first fortify a safe haven, attended to casualty bleeding issues, attend to casualty airway issues, place casualties in a recovery position while continually reassuring and reassessing the casualties, and finally notifying or otherwise communicating casualty number and status to emergency responders. Responders may utilize the casualty information to most appropriately formulate and implement their response strategy.

title_en: Simulated test unit and method for slope stability with faulting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulated test unit and method for slope stability with faulting, relating to the technique of rock-soil mechanical test. The test unit is characterized in that: a soil sample in a fault soil model instrument is divided into hanging wall and footwall by the fault surface; a first continuously variable transmission (CVT), a first power transmission system, and a supporting leverage are connected with the hanging wall successively and provide power for displacement to the hanging wall; a second CVT and a second power transmission system are connected with the footwall successively and provide power for displacement to the footwall; a displacement mark, a soil pressure box and a dial indicator are put in the soil sample, and the relative data are recorded. According to the invention, the movement processes of transformation and damage of slope containing fault soil are represented accurately, so that the invention provides a new approach for studying formation mechanism of landslip and other geological disasters under complex geological environmental conditions.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GELOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Fire damage evaluating system and method for simulating individual evacuation behavior and casualty and recording medium thereof
title_ko: 건설 구조물 화재에서 개인별 대피 행동 및 사상자를 시뮬레이션하는 화재 위험 평가 시스템, 화재 위험 평가 방법 및 그 기록 매체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system and a method for evaluating the danger of the fire which simulates personal actions for taking a shelter/losses in the fire of a building construction are provided to quantitively evaluate the dangerousness of the fire by applying the fire characteristics to a shelter space and evaluating the influence which influences to a human body while taking a shelter. CONSTITUTION: An application method applies a fire interpretation result of a fire simulation to a simulation space. A setting method sets a risk level data corresponding to the external environment variable of fire and smoke to a simulation pace per time and location. A unit for taking a shelter(107) starts to take a shelter according to the pattern of taking a shelter in the shortest path of an individual evacuee by receiving the command of starting to take a shelter. If a dangerous level of a threshold value excesses to the process in which the dangerous level is applied to a evacuee corresponding to the incompletion of taking a shelter, unit for distinguishing the losses(108) distinguishes the evacuee to the losses. A storing unit stores a simulation result of an individual and total evacuee.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건설 구조물 화재에서 시간 및 위치별 화연에 영향을 받는 개인의 생태적 특성을 고려하여 개인별 대피 행동 및 사상자를 시뮬레이션하는 시스템, 방법 및 기록 매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 화재 위험 평가 시스템은, 화재 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 시간 및 위치별 화재 진행 정보의 화재 해석 결과를 당해 시뮬레이션 대상 공간에 적용하는 수단; 화재 해석 결과에 의하여 대피자의 사망을 유발하는 화연의 위험도 데이터를 시간 및 위치별 공간에 설정하는 수단; 대피 시작되면, 개별 대피자의 최단 경로상에서, 대피 행동 패턴 및 위험도 데이터를 적용하여 대피 진행하는 수단; 대피 미완료에 해당하는 개별 대피자에게 위험도를 적용하는 과정에서 임계치 위험도를 초과한 경우, 사망자로 판별하는 수단; 개별 대피자 및 전체 대피자의 시뮬레이션 결과를 생성하여 저장하는 수단; 및 화연의 진행 경로, 대피자의 대피 경로, 상기 시뮬레이션 결과가 표시되는 3차원 영상을 재생하고 저장하는 수단을 포함하는 컴퓨터 단말을 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and device for calculating reflectivity of earth surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for calculating the reflectivity of an earth surface, which are used for HJ-1A/B satellites. The method comprises the following steps of: 1) acquiring the optical thickness of atmospheric aerosol by using middle-infrared bands of an HJ-1B charge coupled device (CCD) and an infrared camera on the basis of a dark target method, and acquiring the optical thickness of the atmospheric aerosol by using an HJ-1A large-width quick revisit characteristic on the basis of an invariant target method; 2) calculating a solar zenith angle and a solar azimuth angle and observing the zenith angle and the azimuth angle on the basis of an HJ-1A/binary extensible markup language (BXML) file and image data; 3) simulating radiance Lm on a star through moderate resolution atmospheric transmission (MODTRAN) on the basis of parameters acquired in the steps 1) and 2); 4) establishing an earth surface reflectivity lookup table through the step 3); and 5) calibrating the atmosphere by using the lookup table according to an atmospheric parameter and an image to be calibrated. By the method and the device, the absorbing and scattering performance of the atmosphere on a remote sensing image can be effectively eliminated, the reflectivity of an earth surface target can be recovered, the bottleneck of industry application is eliminated, and the application range of environment disaster reduction moonlet data is further expanded.

title_en: Reference objects and/or facial/body recognition
abstract_en: Five embodiments are disclosed. The first may generate and/or manage reference objects in images. The second may use the reference objects to create 3-D simulations of landscapes, urban settings, architectural models, land management presentations, disaster analysis and/or interactive games. The third may use the reference objects and/or previously presented object schematics to construct provably impartial mug shot folders for law enforcement, alter security processes to support communication of object schematics with a database used to identify people, and/or modify that database to use object schematics. The fourth may access an image with a focal length spread to generate one or more derived images to find the reference images and the items of interest for human facial/body recognition based upon realistic parameters of the reference objects to create/alter the object schematics. The fifth may implement combinations of two or more of the previous four embodiments.

title_en: Shock simulator in mine analogue simulation training drilling system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine safety, more specifically to a shock simulator in a mine analogue simulation training drilling system for mine workers and ambulance members. The shock simulator is characterized by comprising an analogue simulation training drilling bench and at least four cylinders; piston guide rods of the cylinders 5 stand under the analogue simulation training drilling bench 4; the piston guide rods are coated with damping springs; the cylinders 5 stand on the ground; a base plate is also comprised on which the cylinders 5 stand. The shock simulator of the utility model has a simple structure and can produce a vivid situation in which people seem to come to a real situation and can visually feel the shock of gas disasters, protrudent disasters and top board disasters.
assignees: CHONGQING INST OF COAL RES INST

title_en: Full-folding ultramicro multipurpose vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-folding ultramicro multipurpose vehicle which mainly has a box-type folding three-wheel structure. A front pedaling connecting rod is positioned by a movable bracket in a sliding manner; a pull line on the front pedaling connecting rod drives a chain wheel crankshaft arranged above the front pedaling connecting rod; even if a band box on the front part stretches greatly through a head vehicle or a rear wheel lifting structure is dismantled, the vehicle is difficult to turned over; wheels on a base plate of a seat plate are all accommodated into a box, so the vehicle is extremely small and light and is extremely convenient for a user to drag, carry, hold and be stride in a bus or during climbing stairs; the full-folding ultramicro multipurpose vehicle is like an excellent mobile chair, a simple bed, an ultramicro room, a working table and an exercise bike; mobile phones and water cups are within reach; a laterally arranged desktop is instantly hidden or visible; the full-folding ultramicro multipurpose vehicle has a plurality of functions of a weatherability shed, a luggage barrow, wagon for carrying large pieces and a plurality of pieces, storing objects on places of front side, rear side, inner side, outer side and the like, and the like, and serves as a multipurpose super instrument for personal working, studying, resting, preserving health, exercising and preventing disasters; an extremely large number of optimal practical functions are realized by using an extremely small number of resources; the full-folding ultramicro multipurpose vehicle immediately and considerably promotes the excellent development of people and makes people successful in an all-round way, and completely changes the conventional shortcoming of heaviness, simplicity, poor function, low safety and low versatility; therefore, comfortable and attractive paradises on the earth and high-efficiency and convenient individual small environments can be constructed.

title_en: Interactive visual HWME (Hall for Workshop of Metasynthetic Engineering) system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interactive visual HWME (Hall for Workshop of Metasynthetic Engineering) system. The HWME system comprises a first Web server, a second Web server, a first database administration server, a second database administration server, a first argumentation administration server, a second argumentation administration server, a first expert workstation, a second expert workstation, a first data processing workstation and a second data processing workstation. In the HWME system, on the basis of application background of risk management of extreme flood disasters, an HWME platform based on multi-agent group decision is realized and can show a plurality of query characteristic values for climate and rainfall and decision simulation results in combination with rich client-side effect. The invention further discloses a man-machine interaction construction method and a map service implementation method which are used in the interactive visual HWME system.

title_en: A rapid kill and restoration system for blowout wells
abstract_en: Well blowouts, such as happened in the PTTEPAA Montara gas well in the Timor Sea in August 2009 and the BP Macondo oil well in the Gulf of Mexico in April 2010, caused colossal disasters. The existing top kill technique by pumping in kill- weight mud failed. The relief well technique worked, however it was very costly and very late due to drilling the relief well. This invention is a rapid and reliable kill and restoration technique and its implementation system for the well blowout accidents. It uses solid particles to block, suppress and greatly reduce the blowout flow to gain time for repair or replacement of the damaged blowout preventer and other devices, and connection of production pipelines; It then takes out some of the solid particles to restore well production. In such a way, environmental damage is greatly reduced and the well is kept as a valuable production asset. While any shape of solid particles may be used, the ball shape is an optimum for the kill and restoration operation; hence kill balls are the recommended solid particles. The kill procedure is to sequentially release large, medium and small density balls into the blowout well. Balls of different densities can be made of different materials such as lead, iron, stone or rubber and can have a shell cover made of iron, steel or other environmental friendly material. An implementation system for the kill procedure consists of a tubing system, a blower or a pump, a ball injection device and a cage. The transporting fluid can be air, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, oil or other fluid depending on the operation safety assessment in regarding to the specific well blowout situation. The cage mounted on the tubing and sits on top of the well will temporally contain the blown out balls at the early stage of the kill process. Balls in the cage will fall down to the well as the flow is reduced. A technique for taking out some of the balls from the well to restore production is carried out by a tubing system, a pump and a balls storage tank.

title_en: Helium parachute
abstract_en: The invention relates to a helium parachute, which comprises a parachute main body and a helium inflating bag, wherein the helium inflating bag is inlaid on the upper part of the edge of a canopy of the parachute. When disasters break out, the helium parachute is pushed to the outside of a window quickly, helium is inflated to the helium inflating bag, and the parachute is stretched to be suspended in air, so that escapers descend to the ground. The helium parachute has a reasonable structure, is safe, practical and easy to operate, and can be used without special training.

title_en: Beach area predicating method based on Bayesian dynamic model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a predicating method of beach area. The method comprises the following steps of: obtaining Shanghai beach area in the recent 10 years through combination of RS (Remote Sensing), GPS (Global Positioning System) and GIS (Geographic Information System); selecting an initial training set of a Bayesian dynamic model according to the data; calling the model for predication; and comparing a predicating result with an actual value until the predicating result falls within a confidence interval of the actual value. By using the predicating method disclosed by the invention, fine predicating structure is obtained, the predicating accuracy is also improved while data expense is saved, a tool is provided for coastal fishermen to avoid marine disaster in the operation, and contributions are also made to national disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Information disaster simulator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information disaster simulator, which comprises a disaster model, system self-checking equipment, system self-processing equipment and system interaction processing equipment, wherein the establishment of the disaster model is a premise of all types of subsequence work, and all types of the subsequent work are only used for realizing functions of models in the model; by the system self-checking equipment, the system can checks abnormity automatically; the system self-processing equipment takes a measure when a client is disconnected from a processing network; and by the system interaction processing equipment, a server can detect whether the client is abnormal. By the information disaster simulator, a disaster can be simulated timely and important reference information can be supplied to a decider; therefore, influence of a real disaster can be reduced to the maximum extent.

title_en: Trial system for fire-extinguish training
title_ko: 모의 소방훈련 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A trial system for fire-extinguish training is provided to increase an education effect by helping a user to see a real frame through a display unit. CONSTITUTION: A main body(110) is movable, and a monitor is accommodated into the inside of the main body. The monitor displays a moving picture of a fire education. A speaker(130) and an amplifier(140) output an audio signal which is included in the moving picture. A power supply line(161) and a leakage breaker supply power to the main body. A fire extinguisher(170) is arranged in both side of the main body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방재훈련용 모의 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 이동가능하게 구비되며 화재발생시 행동요령과 실제 화재발생 상황이 포함된 동영상을 표시하는 모니터와, 상기 동영상이 상기 모니터에 표시되도록 원격조절하는 셋탑박스와, 상기 동영상에 포함된 경보와 음성을 외부로 출력하는 앰프 및 스피커를  수용하는 본체와; 상기  본체의 양측에 상기 동영상 표시 중에 상기 모니터를 향해 연무를 분사할 수 있게 구비된 복수의 연무소화기를 포함하며, 상기 본체는, 하부영역에 베이스를 구비하고, 상부영역에는 모니터 수용공간을 형성하며, 상기 모니터의 표시화면이 외부로 드러나도록 배치하고, 모니터 수용공간의 뒷면은 볼트로 고정되는 판넬로 밀폐하며, 상기 수용공간의 하부에는 셋탑박스를 배치하되, 상기 셋탑박스의 내측 상부 중앙에는 앰프와 동영상 플레이어를 장착하고, 앰프의 좌우에 각각 스피커를 장착하며, 상기 셋탑박스의 내측 하부 좌우측면 내측에는 방수형 2구 콘센트를 각각 장착하고, 상기 셋탑박스의 내부 좌우측 중 어느 한곳에는 스위치와 전원입력코드를 장착하며, 상기 셋탑박스의 내측 하부 중앙에는 노출형3구 콘센트와 6구형 배분 단자대를 장착하며, 하부 일측에 누전차단기를 장착하여, 하부영역에서 상기 모니터와 셋탑박스로 전원을 공급하는 전원공급라인을 구비하도록 하며, 상기 셋탑박스의 뒷면은 힌지로 연결되는 도어를 형성하여 록킹과 개폐가 가능하도록 하고, 상기 동영상은, 전기, 가스, 불티, 기름 및 불장난 등의 화재발생 요인과 예방요령을 포함하고, 화재발생시 초기 대응방법과 소화기 사용법 및 서로 다른 장소에서 발생된 모의 화재상황을 포함하며, 상기 모의 화재상황 표시시 상기 모니터에 표시되는 화점을 향해 상기 연무소화기가 분사될 경우 상기 모의 화재가 소화되는 것을 포함하여 피교육생이 모니터의 화염발생 지점을 향해 연무소화기로 직접 화재를 진압하는 과정의 반복실습이 가능하도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 의하여 보다 효과적으로 피교육생에게 화재진압요령을 숙지시킬 수 있다.

title_en: High-water pressure, high-stress and automatic-mining mine water disaster comprehensive analog system and test method
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-water pressure, high-stress and automatic-mining mine water disaster comprehensive analog system and a test method, belonging to the technical field of basic research of water prevention and treatment in a mine. The invention mainly relates to a mine water damage comprehensive analog system which is good in leakproofness, and can simulate the mining, reflect the mutual function between a rock mass at a top plate and a base plate and the water, and obtain the change regularity of solid and liquid physical mechanics parameters under the conditions of high water pressure and high vertical stress. By adopting a cylindrical closed test chamber and an automatic mining analog device in the chamber, the system allows the highest water pressure at 3MPa, applies the maximum vertical load at 3MPa, has the test diameter at 1.4m, and has the sample assembly height at 1.4m. The system comprises a model test chamber, a stable high-water pressure (flow) water supply and control device, a mining simulating and controlling device, a multiple interference flow observing device and an assembly observing subsystem of pressure, stress, temperature and PH value. The invention further establishes a test method for automatically simulating the mining of the dynamic sudden water inflow by the top plate and the base plate of the mine under the conditions of high water pressure and high stress and the real-time monitoring.

title_en: Ground stabilization method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a ground stabilization method in which an unstable ground can be effectively reinforced by discharging underground water, which is seen as a main factor causing ground disaster, and reinforcing the ground.SOLUTION: A pipe 2 having a water-permeable bag body 3 and a permeable opening 2a is inserted into a drilled hole 1. The bag body 3 is expanded by injecting a consolidation material 6 into the bag body 3 through the pipe 2 so as to fix the pipe 2 in the drilled hole 1. Underground water is discharged from the permeable opening 2a through the pipe 2 to a drain port 2b of the pipe 2 located on the ground surface. The ground is reinforced by the tensile force of the pipe 2. A hole-opened steel pipe is used for the pipe 2, and a filter for sediment inflow prevention is attached to the permeable opening 2a. A bag body comprising a high strength fiber such as an aramid fiber other than a hemp bag is used for the water-permeable bog body 3, and a plastic gel, cement grout or the like is used for the consolidation material 6.

title_en: Protective device for overwater worker
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protective device for an overwater worker, and relates to a safety protection device. The belt (3) has double-layer structure formed by bonding an inner belt layer (7) and an outer belt layer (8); and an air guide pipe (10) is arranged between the inner belt layer (7) and the outer belt layer (8) between a last belt hole (6) and a belt fastener (4). According to the protective device, the air guide pipe and a plurality of air guide branch pipes arranged in the belt are communicated to form an air bag serving as a life-saving floating body, and a compressed air container supplies an air source, so that the air bag is expanded to generate buoyancy and a water falling person is saved; and the protective device has simple structure, overcomes the defect that the conventional life vest is uncomfortable in hot days, and is suitable for navy, boatmen, persons on water drilling platforms or water disaster relief persons.

title_en: Parking lot smart mobile phone is at alert and Fare Collection System
abstract_en: The present invention is to implement to provide parking lot smart mobile phone at alert and Fare Collection System, change: while vehicle is rapidly popularized, the operative skill of driver (particularly women driver) cannot be synchronous, because various dispute and property loss caused by stopping occur again and again, more have because of driving efficiency not good swiping the card at Entrance and the driver that causes by card horrible disaster till death; Realize: by using unique phone number as storing, be stored in system alert identity supplementary features picture and automobile video frequency in alert identity, carry out digital simulation confirmation, realize zero monetary charge with mobile phone account, ensure into and out of the dual monitoring at road junction, monitoring with two road emergency gate lock system architectures, reach automatically supervisory, the security of lives and properties improving parking lot, each compatibility of parking system data manipulation, the transparency of toll administration.

title_en: Sliding type performance-adjustable shape memory alloy damper
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sliding type performance-adjustable shape memory alloy damper belonging to fields of structure damping control, disaster prevention and reduction and protection. In order to solve the problem of incapability of regulating rigidity and energy consumption capacity of the traditional shape memory alloy damper, the sliding type performance-adjustable shape memory alloy damper comprises shape memory alloy wires arranged on at least one clamp I and at least one clamp II, a runner plate provided with a groove, and a sliding block arranged in the groove; and the runner plate and the sliding block are provided with a plurality of screw holes, the lower end of the clamp I is fixed on the sliding block, and the lower end of the clamp II is fixed on the runner plate. The sliding type performance-adjustable shape memory alloy damper can be mainly used for reset and energy consumption vibration attenuation (shock) after structure deformation, can also be used as a structure member for generating a nonlinear restoring force and can be used in simulation and test research of a structure nonlinear power behavior, and has the advantages of stable performance, simple structure and easiness in disassembly.

title_en: Compressed-air self-rescue device used for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compressed-air self-rescue device used for a coal mine, which belongs to the field of coal mine safety equipment. The compressed-air self-rescue device used for a coal mine comprises a tee-joint pipeline, a solenoid valve, an LED (Light Emitting Diode) alarm lamp, a box body door with an electromagnetic lock, a box body stuck with a high-fluorescence strip, an air supply device, a box chamber provided with a control panel, oronasal masks and the like. The defects existing in the aspects, such as decompressing effect, flow regulation, air purification, noise elimination, use operation and the like, in the traditional device are comprehensively considered and are improved and optimized by the compressed-air self-rescue device. The compressed-air self-rescue device used for a coal mine has the following characteristics that users are easy to find when disasters happen. The compressed-air self-rescue device used for a coal mine has better functions of decompression, flow regulation, purification and noise removal, and a use method is simple. The oronasal masks are used for supplying air to cause personnel to easily observe the situation of a disaster. Five oronasal masks share one set of air supply device, so that the construction cost is low, the use ratio of compressed air is high, and the compressed-air self-rescue device is convenient to popularize and apply and conforms to a training custom that one group contains five people under the shaft. The compressed-air self-rescue device is beautiful to install and conforms to the standardized and intensified requirements of the modern coal mine. The networked communicating and prewarning function of risk avoidance under the shaft can be realized, and the air supply device has corrosion resistance and small possibility of rusting.

title_en: Flood inundation analysis and early warning system for power transmission facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood inundation analysis and early warning system for power transmission facilities. The system is composed of a flood inundation analysis module, a data presentation module, a flood inundation statistic output module, a power transmission facility inundation knowledge base module and a early warning module, can quickly, accurately and scientifically simulate, measure and calculate the flood inundation range around the power transmission facilities and the water depth distribution of the inundated area, and can respectively present the analysis result in two-dimensional and three-dimensional views so as to report the inundation state of the power transmission facilities and early warn the inundation risk of the power transmission facilities, thereby providing important information support and decision basis for flood prevention and disaster mitigation for the power transmission facilities.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;GUANGXI G ENERGY INFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: High-position drilling grouting fire extinguishing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire prevention and extinguishment in a coal mine goaf, in particular to a high-position drilling grouting fire extinguishing technology aiming at spontaneous combustion prevention and control of coal in the goaf, which adopts the following technical scheme: firstly, determining the drilling position: the construction position of the high-position drill hole is selected in a crossheading which is close to a spontaneous combustion dangerous area of a goaf of a working face, the drilling terminal is ensured to be always positioned in a coal seam top plate at the upper part of the spontaneous combustion dangerous area, a group of three drill holes are arranged in a fan shape, every 20 meters of distance drill holes are pushed along with the working face, the next group of drill holes are drilled, the number of the drill holes in each group can be flexibly selected according to the size of the spontaneous combustion dangerous area of the goaf, and the drill hole opening is blocked after the; and secondly, grouting into the drill hole: connecting a group of drill holes, adopting pressure filling, filling composite colloid slurry into the drill holes with low final hole horizontal positions, filling loess slurry into the drill holes with high final hole horizontal positions, slowing down the flowing speed of the yellow slurry by utilizing the viscous and accumulation effects of the composite colloid slurry, and prolonging the detention time of the yellow slurry in a spontaneous combustion high-temperature area. By adopting the method, the range of the spontaneous combustion dangerous area can be effectively controlled, the temperature of the dangerous area is reduced, the concentration of harmful gas is reduced, the disaster situation is controlled, and the elimination of the spontaneous combustion hidden danger of the goaf is accelerated.
assignees: LIANGBAOSI ENERGY CO LTD FEICHENG MINING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mine disaster rescue robot with tunneling function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster rescue robot with tunneling function, comprising a cone-shaped drill head, a cylindrical front body segment and a cylindrical back body segment, wherein the front body segment and the back body segment are connected through a waist part capable of rotating on a plane; the two sides of the front body segment and the back body segment are symmetrically provided with landing legs; the landing legs are connected with the front body segment or the back body segment by a hip joint composed of a revolute pair; the tail end of each landing leg is a curved surface foot; the cone-shaped drill head is fixedly connected to the front end of the front body segment. The invention can adjust lengths of the legs and environment adaptability according to the space. The invention can achieve tunneling function in media like earth mounds and ruins through earth loosening by the drill head and earth stirring by the foot. The robot can be used to assist in dangerous tasks like mine disaster rescue and wilderness exploration.

title_en: Rock landslide hydraulic start indoor simulation test method
abstract_en: A rock landslide hydraulic start indoor simulation test method belongs to the technical field of geological disaster forecasting. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of taking a rock test piece with a real submarine slip surface, taking the submarine slip surface as a boundary, respectively arranging upper and lower rock blocks in a sample frame and a sample box, filling the rock test piece with cement mortar, taking component forces of gravity of a front edge part of a landslide to be simulated on a parallel slip surface and a vertical slip surface as initial values of a transverse load and a vertical load, replacing the actual water pressure of underground water in a slope body on the submarine slip body by reducing a vertical load value acting on the submarine slip surface while keeping the transverse load unchanged, and when the displacement rate of the upper sample frame of the rock test piece and the rock blocks on the upper part of the submarine slip surface solidified in the frame is suddenly increased and continuously increased relative to the submarine slip surface, indicating that the landslide is started, wherein a water head height value equal to the cumulative reduction of the vertical load value at the moment is the starting water head value of the simulated rocky landslide. The method can accurately find the critical sliding state of the rock slope.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY SOUTHWEST RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Slope stability simulation test device under fault action
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slope body stability analogue test device under fault effect relates to ground mechanical test technique. The structure of the test device is as follows: the soil sample in the fault soil model instrument is divided into a fault upper plate and a fault lower plate through a fault surface; the 1 st stepless gearbox, the 1 st power transmission system, the support lever and the upper fault plate are sequentially connected to provide power for displacement of the upper fault plate; the 2 nd stepless gearbox, the 2 nd power transmission system and the fault lower disc are connected in sequence to provide displacement power for the fault lower disc; and a displacement identifier, a soil pressure cell and a dial indicator are arranged in the soil sample, and relevant data are recorded. The utility model discloses can accurately reappear the deformation that contains the fault soil body side slope and destroy the motion process, provide a new solution way for geological disasters' such as landslide, collapse formation mechanism research under the complicated geological environment condition.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOL SCIENCES

title_en: Rotating door type multi-purpose ultraviolet disinfection device
abstract_en: A rotating door type multi-purpose ultraviolet disinfection device is characterized in that by adopting a unique structure formed by a cylindrical closed housing and a rotating door, the space is saved, and the use is convenient; an ultraviolet lamp arranged in a circular arc is not easy to touch, on the inner wall of a cylinder, ultraviolet rays can be reflected to various surfaces of an object to be disinfected, the disinfection is thorough, and the energy consumption is low; when the rotating door is opened or closed, a photic article holding plate is pushed out and in under the drive of a gear wheel, and the object to be disinfected is very convenient to pick and place. The rotating door type multi-purpose ultraviolet disinfection device not only can disinfect such daily necessities as a mobile phone, a mouse and a remote controller quickly, but also can sterilize and disinfect a hairdressing tool, bottled water and such mini-type medical apparatus as a dental drill bit; according to the utility model, a door body pressure induction switch is arranged so as to avoid damage to a human body caused by false operation; the rotating door type multi-purpose ultraviolet disinfection device has a timing function and a music playing function; and by adopting a design of AC/DC power supplies, the rotating door type multi-purpose ultraviolet disinfection device can be used at home and in open fields such as a traditional market, a disaster relief site and a battle field.

title_en: Device for sealing high-pressure slip casting open hole deep hole with preposed expand tube
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to a device for sealing a high-pressure slip casting open hole deep hole with a preposed expand tube. Water plague and gas plague when a water/gas-containing region is exposed can be often encountered in the underground engineering industry production such as mine, railway, road, water conservancy and the like, so as to tremendously threaten the safe production of personal and equipment, so that the engineering needs previous drilling to previously find out geological conditions so as to adopt corresponding measures to avoid the disaster. A core pipe of the device is sequentially covered into a nut, a jacking pipe, a capsule, an expand tube and a guide cone from bottom to top, a first capsule press ring is arranged between the lower end of the capsule and the jacking pipe, a second capsule is arranged between the upper end of the capsule and the expand tube, and the bottom end of the core pipe is connected with a high-pressure valve. The device is unique in structure, the device can be penetrated into a rock mass complete section in a water/gas plague convex drill hole to be plugged by manual work or a drill rig, and the device reliably seals water-prevention rock and embedded rock at the rock mass complete section by a screw propeller, so that the aim of high-pressure grouting can be achieved.
assignees: SHANXI BINZHANG HUJIAHE MINING INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting system for training
title_ko: 교육용 소방 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire-fighting system for training is provided to visually display the operation and structure of all instruments for a fire fighting system by including a floor plan of a specific building, an R-type complex receiver, and a P-type complex receiver in one panel. CONSTITUTION: A fire-fighting system for training comprises a model display unit(211), an R-type complex receiver(221), and a P-type complex receiver(231). The model display unit displays the structure of a specific building in plane and includes the models of fire equipment installed at specific building. The R-type complex receiver is installed in the model display unit. The P-type complex receiver is installed in the model display unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방 교육을 효율적으로 실행할 수 있는 교육용 소방 시스템에 관한 것이다.  본 발명은, 특정 건물의 구조를 평면적으로 보여주며, 상기 특정 건물에 설치된 소방 기기들의 모형들을 구비하는 모형 표시부; 상기 모형 표시부에 설치된 R형 복합 수신기; 및 상기 모형 표시부에 설치된 P형 복합 수신기를 포함하는 패널을 구비하는 교육용 소방 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Evacuation guiding system and method for processing thereof
title_ko: 대피 유도 시스템 및 그 처리 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An evacuation inducement system and processing method thereof are provided to offer optimized evacuation routes to a personal terminal by tracking the location of a user through the personal terminal. CONSTITUTION: A main control unit(102) monitors the location information of a RF(Radio Frequency) reader(150) and the sensing information of a sensor(130) in real time. The main control unit simulates the evacuation route of inner buildings by using the location information of a user and the sensing information. The main control unit creates evacuation information optimized for the current location of the user based on a simulation result. The main control unit provides the evacuation information to a personal terminal(200) in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 RF 통신망과 유비쿼터스 센서 네트워크를 이용하는 대피 유도 시스템 및 그 처리 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 대피 유도 시스템은 복수 개의 센서들로부터 다양한 감지 정보를 받아서 건물에 재해가 발생되는지를 실시간으로 모니터링한다. 개인 단말기는 RFID 태그에 서로 다른 인식 정보를 갖는다. RF 리더기는 개인 단말기의 인식 정보를 판독하고, 개인 단말기들 각각의 위치 정보를 검출한다. 메인 제어부는 화재 해석 프로그램 및 화재 시뮬레이션 프로그램을 구비한다. 센서들과, 개인 단말기 및 메인 제어부는 RF 통신망 또는 유비쿼터스 센서 네트워크(USN)를 통해 연결된다. 이러한 본 발명의 대피 유도 시스템은 재해 발생 시, 사용자의 위치 및 재해 상황을 실시간으로 모니터링하여 개인 단말기를 휴대한 사용자의 위치에 적합한 최적의 대피 경로를 생성한고, 대피 경로를 포함하는 대피 정보를 유비쿼터스 센서 네트워크를 통해 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 사용자의 현재 상황에 적합한 최적의 대피 경로를 개인 단말기에 제공함으로써, 개인 단말기의 사용자는 실시간으로 자신의 상황에 적합한 최적의 대피 경로를 따라 신속히 대피할 수 있다.

title_en: Controlling method for a broadcasting system having a evacuation scenario
title_ko: 대피 시나리오를 갖는 방송시스템의 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A control method of a broadcasting system having an escape scenario is provided to automatically broadcast an escape scenario according to a region which is sensed in a fire place. CONSTITUTION: If the number of fire contact points is one, a broadcasting system performs a general scenario mode(S20,S30). If the number of fire contact points is two, the broadcasting system performs a special scenario mode(S40). In case the scenario mode and a fire place are within the same category, the broadcasting system maintains the scenario mode(S70,S90). The broadcasting system terminates fire escape broadcasting(S110,S160).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재를 비롯한 긴급 상황 발생시 단계별, 상황별 시나리오를 따라 사람들이 신속하고 안전하게 대피하도록 대피방송을 하여 인명피해를 최소화시킬 수 있는 대비 시나리오를 갖는 방송시스템의 제어방법을 제공하는 것이다.  
이를 위해, 본 발명은 화재가 발생한 화재접점을 감지하는 감지단계, 상기 화재접점의 개수를 파악하여 상기 화재접점의 개수가 1개이면 일반 시나리오 모드가 수행되고, 상기 화재접점의 개수가 2개 이상이면 특별 시나리오 모드가 수행되는 대피 시나리오 동작단계, 상기 일반 시나리오 모드와 상기 특별 시나리오 모드 중 어느 하나의 해당 시나리오 모드와 화재발생지역의 상황이 동일성 범주에 있는 경우에는 상기 해당 시나리오 모드를 유지시키는 유지단계가 수행되고, 상기 해당 시나리오 모드와 상기 화재발생지역의 상황이 다른 경우에는 바이패스 시나리오 모드가 수행되는 바이패스 단계가 동작되는 단계, 그리고 상기 화재접점의 개수가 존재하지 않으면 화재대피 방송이 종료되는 종료단계를 포함하는 대피 시나리오를 갖는 방송시스템의 제어방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Earthworm-imitating ground drilling robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an earthworm-imitating ground drilling robot capable of crawling in soil, which structurally comprises a head for drilling soil, a front body section and a rear body section capable of advancing and turning, and a screw rod for internal soil discharging. The body sections are circumferentially and uniformly distributed with 3 supporting feet, and are connected through a pair of lead screw nut mechanisms. Under the drive of the motor, the supporting feet are matched with the screw rod and nut mechanisms, so that the robot can simulate the creeping crawling of earthworms. In addition, the robot is provided with a detection device, a gyroscope and a circuit board, and power and information are transmitted by using a combined cable, so that remote real-time control of workers is facilitated. The invention has the advantages that: the robot is designed by adopting a bionics theory, simulates the earthworm to drill, dig and crawl, has the advantages of high soil drilling efficiency, simple structure, low implementation cost and the like, can realize forward movement and free steering, and is suitable for underground mineral exploration, geological exploration, earthquake, mine disaster rescue and the like.

title_en: Method for efficient shaft coal uncovering in high gas mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to safety production for disaster prevention and control of coal and gas outbursts, and provides a method for efficient shaft coal uncovering in a high gas mine in order to realize safely coal uncovering in a coal and gassy seam. The method comprises the following steps: (1) pre-estimation of coal seam occurrence through drilling holes; (2) item parameter determination and outburst prediction; (3) gas drainage under suction; (4) safely coal uncovering. In the invention, a coal uncovering implementation scheme is strictly and thoroughly prepared, and technical innovations for gas drainage under suction and blasting are made, so that disasters and accidents are prevented as much as possible; further, intensive fan drilled holes are adopted for large area control and efficient extraction of the seam gas, and uniform intensive dot-matrix-distributed blast-holes are adopted for safely coal seam uncovering, so that safely coal uncovering can be realized within a short time.

title_en: Method for extracting coal seam gas through ground fracturing and underground horizontal drill holes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for developing underground coal seam gas, and provides a method for extracting coal seam gas through ground fracturing and underground horizontal drill holes in order to ensure the safety production of a coal shaft and improve the air permeability of the underground drill holes as well as the extraction efficiency of gas. The method comprises the following steps: 1) shaft placing design; 2) ground shaft drilling, as well as ground construction of vertical drill holes or directional drill holes for a mine in areas with roadways and without construction of underground coal seam gas extraction drill holes; 3) hydraulic fracture, namely, conducting hydraulic sand fracture after well completion so as to form high permeable fracture influenced areas; 4) underground horizontal long drill holes, namely, drilling horizontal directional seam gas extraction holes along a main mineable coal seam to form a horizontal drill hole influenced areas; the horizontal drilling hole influenced area is communicated with the fracture influenced area to realize the coal seam gas extraction. Through adopting the method provided by the invention, the hazard of coal mine gas disaster can be eliminated, and the guarantee degree of safety production of the coal mine can be improved at the same.

title_en: Marine disaster early warning expert system based on data mining
abstract_en: The invention provides a marine disaster early warning expert system based on data mining. The system comprises 7 modules including a marine data base, a data mining module, a marine disaster knowledge base, a knowledge acquisition interface, an inference machine, an explanation module and a marine disaster early warning display interface. Marine data are abundant and various, large-scale complicated marine data are simplified and compressed by adopting a fuzzy clustering rough set attribute reduction method, attribute factor information related to the marine disaster is retained to the largest extent, information containing a large amount of knowledge is obtained by using the data mining, the information containing the knowledge is regularly extracted and treated, and then strategy rules capable of predicting the marine disasters are found out. The strategy rules organize and form the marine disaster knowledge base and the inference machine, knowledge rules and data in the knowledge base are used for inference, heuristic method inference and judgment are conducted simulating experts in the marine area, marine disasters are evaluated, levels of the marine disasters are judged, and an explanation program is combined with an early warning threshold value to send out disaster early warning towards users in a simple and visual mode. The system effectively solves problems of shortage of expert early warning and marine knowledge personnel on the marine disasters, and provides new ways and methods for popularizing scientific marine disaster early warning technology.

title_en: Harmful disaster prediction system and method
abstract_en: A kind of system and method for predicting Harmful disaster, mainly comprise: Harmful hazard prediction model module, it comprises geography cellular automata model, artificial nerve network model and multiple agent model, wherein, cellular in geography cellular automata model represents geographic area, and the cellular state had for representing disaster degree and the one or more cellular attributes for representing disaster factor of influence, its state transition rules is obtained by training of human artificial neural networks model, artificial nerve network model be input as disaster factor of influence, export as disaster degree, multiple agent model comprises Mankind action intelligent body, for representing the impact of mankind's activity on cellular state, and harmful organism Plant population change intelligent body, for representing the dynamic evolution process of harmful organism population, the analysis result of intelligent body will merge with current cellular state, thus obtain the current cellular state after upgrading.

title_en: Automatic control simulation system used for land search and rescue training
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic control simulation system used for land search and rescue training, which is characterized by comprising a central command unit, a central data processing unit and a simulation work unit. The central command unit comprises a personal computer (PC) and a configuration software platform. The central data processing unit is composed of a control mode selection switch, a power supply module, a data processor (central processing unit (CPU)), a communication processor, an input/output processor and an interface processor. The simulation work unit comprises a dangerous object detection simulation system, a fire scene simulation system, an aftershock simulation system, an earthquake acousto-optic simulation system and a ruins search and rescue acousto-optic simulation system. Through tight combination of theory and practicality, the automatic control simulation system used for land search and rescue training provides good conditions for solving the existing natural disaster rescue training problems.
assignees: LANZHOU YUANCHUANG ELECTROMECHANICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
