title_en: Multifunctional urban traffic tunnel fire disaster fume diffusion model device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional urban traffic tunnel fire disaster fume diffusion model experimental device which consists of a frequency conversion fan, an arch main tunnel, a branch tunnel, a fume discharge flue, a fire source mobile car, a gradient regulating device and a water sprinkler system; the frequency conversion fan is connected with the front end of the arch main tunnel through a blind plate; the fume discharge flue is connected with the rear end of the arch main tunnel; one end of the main tunnel is fixed on a support frame, and the other end of the main tunnel is supported by a lifting jack so that the gradient of the main tunnel can be adjusted; the mobile car equipped with a combustion cell can slide in the tunnel, thereby changing the position of the fire source; corresponding water spraying quantity can be provided for fire disasters with different fire source powers through controlling the water spraying; when a multiple-passageway tunnel fire disaster experiment is carried out, the branch tunnel and the main tunnel can be connected; and when a special longer tunnel fire disaster experiment is carried out, the arch main tunnel can be lengthened. The device not only can simulate the influences of different gradients, fire source powers, longitudinal ventilation wind speeds and water spraying on fume motion of tunnels, also can simulate multiple-passageway and special longer tunnel fire disasters and has a wide application scope; furthermore, the device is simple in structure, and is convenient to operate.

title_en: Stope face roof water pre-drainage construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to coal mine underwater treatment technology, in particular to a stope face roof water pre-drainage construction method, which solves the technical problem of treatment of a water-bearing bed on a coal seam of a stope face. As the process of stoping on the stope face includes down stoping firstly and up stoping secondly, stope face roof water is drained in advance through roadways beside the stope face before stoping, a drill site chamber and a water bin are constructed at the lowest position of each of the roadways, two drainage pipelines are paved on each of the roadways, an independent drainage system is utilized, drainage holes are drilled in the drill site chamber towards the stope face roof, and water for drilling is led into the water bin through hoses directly and is drained by the drainage system of the roadways. Since roof water is drained in advance, water inflow during the stoping process is reduced effectively, troubles to production of coal mines due to the roof water are eliminated, affection of flood disaster to production is avoided, a safe and comfortable working environment is provided for the stoping operation, and conditions for stability and high yield of the stope face are created.

title_en: Bionic peristaltic pipeline walking mechanism and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bionic peristaltic pipeline walking mechanism and a control method thereof, which are characterized in that the bionic peristaltic pipeline walking mechanism is formed by symmetrically arranging a front body joint radial supporting unit and a rear body joint radial supporting unit at two ends of a middle axial feeding unit; by coordinating the periodic intermittent radial expansion and contraction motion between the radial supporting unit and the inner wall of the pipeline and the periodic intermittent axial expansion and contraction motion of the middle axial feeding unit, the movement gait and the movement law of worm body joints are simulated to crawl and walk in the pipeline. By carrying corresponding tools, the invention can replace manual work to carry out various pipeline operation tasks, can also carry out tasks such as vertical underground mine disaster detection and rescue, and has the advantages of simple and compact structure, stable and reliable operation, easy control, low manufacturing cost, multiple applications and the like.

title_en: K-SVD (K-means singular value decomposition) speckle inhibiting method based on SAR (synthetic aperture radar) image local statistic characteristic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a K-SVD (K-means singular value decomposition) speckle inhibiting method based on SAR (synthetic aperture radar) image local statistic characteristic, mainly solving the problem that detail information such as edge, texture and the like is fuzzy in the traditional speckle inhibiting method. The method is realized in the following processes of: inputting an SAR image, extracting overlapped blocks in the SAR image to obtain an overlapped block vector set; then randomly sampling the overlapped block vector set to obtain a training sample set; carrying out SAR_KSVD dictionary training on a training sample to obtain a final training dictionary; carrying out SAR_OMP sparse coding on the overlapped block vector set under the condition of the final training dictionary to obtain a sparse coding coefficient; and obtaining a speckle inhibited image by utilizing the final training dictionary and the sparse coding coefficient according to the redundant sparse representation image noise inhibiting theory. By applying the method disclosed by the invention, speckle noise in a homogenous region can be effectively inhibited, brightness and edge texture of a target at a strong reflection point can be well maintained to be clear, and the method disclosed by the invention can be applicable to SAR images in the fields such as land resource monitoring, natural disaster analysis and the like.

title_en: Colorized simulating vidicon capable of detecting smog and temperature information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a colorized simulating vidicon capable of detecting smog and temperature information. The colorized simulating vidicon capable of detecting the smog and temperature information comprises a photoelectric conversion module, an image processing module, a microprocessor module, a temperature module, a smog sensing module, an external interface module and a housing. The colorized simulating vidicon capable of detecting the smog and temperature information has a smog sensing function and a temperature detecting function, and can capture video information on a fire disaster site so as to know the on-site fire condition or abnormal condition and can send out warning information when the fire disaster is in an early stage, transmit the warning information through a monitoring video and an RS485 bus remote communication protocol at the first time, trigger a relevant alarm, inform relevant staff and link relevant fire disaster handling equipment to pre-warn the fire condition or the abnormal condition in time so as to reduce the loss to the maximum extent.

title_en: Evacuation plan evaluation system and evacuation plan evaluation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To determine whether or not a more optimum evacuation plan is developed.SOLUTION: A calculation part 602 of the number of persons who require relief calculates the number of persons who require the relief in evacuation based on attribute information on a user of mobile equipment 100. A calculation part 604 of the number of persons by every evacuation destination calculates the number of evacuees who evacuate to homecoming destinations and shelters. A simulation part 606 performs simulation of the case that the evacuees evacuate to the homecoming destinations and the shelters from the respective polygon areas P1-P9 . A score calculation part 607 calculates scores for an evacuation plan based on the number of persons who require the relief, the number of evacuees, and a simulation result.

title_en: Self-propelled earth-boring robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-propelled ground drilling robot, which comprises a drilling system for cutting and conveying soil, a power system for providing movement capacity, and a control system for controlling the drilling system and the power system; the power system is connected with the drilling system through a transmission device, and the control system is in communication connection with the power system and the drilling system. Under the drive of the motor, the robot can realize the advancing and the steering by the pushing of the supporting feet. In addition, the robot is provided with a detection device, a gyroscope and a control circuit board, and a combined cable is used for transmitting power sources and information, so that the robot can be remotely monitored by ground personnel in real time. The robot has simple mechanism and compact structure, is provided with a drill bit and a dumping device, can smoothly drill into the ground and freely advance and turn in soil by utilizing the self-propelled movement, and is suitable for underground mineral exploration, geological exploration, earthquake, mine disaster rescue and the like.

title_en: Construction method of stirring pile and solidifying agent device thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of a stirring pile as well as a drill rod and a solidifying agent conveying device thereof. Two soil solidifying agents which can mutually react or can be mutually influenced can be respectively sprayed in the working procedures of sinking and lifting in the construction of the same stirring pile; and moreover, solidified soil can still be effectively stirred, so that the strength of the stirring pile is quickly enhanced in a short period, and the requirement of special engineering, such as salvage and disaster relief, on time is met. When the same soil solidifying agent is used, the soil solidifying agent can still be sprayed in the processes of sinking and lifting of a stirring pile machine, the solidified soil is effectively stirred, the construction efficiency of a stirring pile with large diameter can be enhanced, and the construction time is saved by approximately a half. The requirements of different soil layers on the form of the soil solidifying agent in a soft-soil foundation with a crust layer and high water content can be met, and the quality of a pile body is enhanced.

title_en: Earthquake house model
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earthquake house model. The earthquake house model comprises a bottom frame, a middle frame, an upper frame, a crankshaft, a left and right swinging mechanism, a front and rear swinging mechanism, a shaking mechanism, a left and right swinging motor, a front and rear swinging motor, a shaking motor, a simulation house and a microcomputer operating platform, wherein the middle frame is connected to the bottom frame in a sliding manner; the upper frame is connected to the middle frame in a sliding manner; the simulation house is arranged above the upper frame; the left and right swinging motor is fixedly arranged on the bottom frame and is connected with the middle frame through the crankshaft and the left and right swinging mechanism; the front and rear swinging motor is fixedly arranged on the middle frame and is connected with the upper frame through the crankshaft and the front and rear swinging mechanism; the shaking motor is fixedly arranged on the middle frame and is connected with the upper frame through the crankshaft and the shaking mechanism; and the microcomputer operating platform drives the upper frame and the simulation house to shake all around through an electric control system. The earthquake house model has the beneficial effects that the earthquake scene can be demonstrated visually, so that when disaster really comes, protective and self-rescue measures can be taken accurately.
assignees: SUZHOU YUKON GRAGON SCIENCE AND EDUCATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Detection device and detection method for fire alarm and linkage control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device and a detection method for a fire alarm and linkage control system, and belongs to the technical field of fire fighting. The device comprises an alarm and linkage controller, an alarm device, a linkage control device, an automatic detection controller, an alarm simulator and a controlled equipment simulator. According to the method, a simulation signal provided by the alarm simulator is controlled by the automatic detection controller to simulate phenomena of smoke, temperature rise, light and the like produced during a fire disaster and simulate manual alarm, so that the alarm function of the alarm device is detected; and whether the linkage control device can receive a linkage control command, output a qualified driving signal, correctly receive a feedback signal and transmit to the alarm and linkage controller is detected through the controlled equipment simulator, a decision is made and a result is output. According to the device and the method, automatic simulation detection of basic functions of the alarm and linkage controller and each input and output component of the conventional fire detection alarm system can be performed.
assignees: NANJING FIRE PROT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NANJING FIRE GROUP ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire alarm and linkage control system with automatic detection function and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire alarm and linkage control system with an automatic detection function and a detection method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fire fighting. The system comprises an alarm device, a linkage control device, an alarm and linkage controller, an alarm simulator and a controlled equipment simulator. According to the method, a simulation signal provided by the alarm simulator is controlled by the alarm and linkage controller to simulate phenomena of smoke, temperature rise, light and the like produced during a fire disaster and simulate the method and signal of manual alarm, so that the alarm function of the alarm device is detected; whether the linkage control device can receive a linkage control command, output a qualified driving signal, correctly receive a feedback signal and transmit to the alarm and linkage controller is detected through the controlled equipment simulator; and finally a decision is made and a result is output by the alarm and linkage controller. According to the device and the method, true automatic simulation detection of basic functions of the alarm and linkage controller and the each conventional input and output component can be performed.
assignees: NANJING FIRE PROT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NANJING FIRE GROUP ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Access control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a service access control method and a service access control system, which are used for solving the technical problems of disaster recovery, poor fault-tolerance performance, low speed in terminal access and visit and the like of an IDC (Internet Data Center), caused when access is realized by adopting a fixed IP (Internet Protocol) or a fixed domain name. A route node information sheet including node information and service state information is established; the service state information of existence of service nodes corresponding to a route trace, access speed and the like is acquired through simulating the service request of a terminal; and the optimal service node is selected for the terminal based on the route node information sheet. By adopting the invention, the optimal service node can be selected for the terminal according to a gateway accessed by the terminal, so that the terminal access and visit speed is improved. According to the invention, through dynamic maintenance of the route node information sheet, some IDC or a plurality of IDCs of which the service is abnormal can be automatically shielded, and the service is switched into the normal IDC, so that disaster recovery of the IDC is realized and the service quality is promoted.

title_en: Water purification multifunctional vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water purification multifunctional vehicle, which comprises an automobile chassis and a carriage, wherein the carriage comprises a front plate, a top plate, a bottom plate, a rear door plate and side plates at two sides, the bottom plate is fixedly arranged on the automobile chassis, the carriage is divided into a living workshop and a water purification device installation workshop through a middle partition plate, the side plates of the living workshop are a left side plate and a right side plate with a door, which are arranged at two sides of the front part of the carriage, and a working platform is arranged in the living workshop; the side plates of the water purification device installation workshop are an upper flanging plate and a lower flanging plate which are arranged on two sides of the rear part of the carriage, and a vehicle-mounted water purification device fixed on the bottom plate is arranged in the water purification device installation workshop. The utility model discloses provide required safe drinking water when can cause the water source to pollute for natural disasters, still can be used to the water source of field work personnel such as army field training, oil field exploration to provide simultaneously.

title_en: LED (Light emitting diode) ultraviolet water treatment equipment with function of torch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses LED (light-emitting diode) ultraviolet water treatment equipment with functions of a torch. The LED ultraviolet water treatment equipment comprises a main body of the water treatment equipment, a water sterilizing module and a torch module, wherein the water sterilizing module is arranged on one end of the main body of the water treatment equipment, and the torch module is arranged on the other end of the main body of the water treatment equipment; and the main body of the water treatment equipment is internally provided with a DC(direct current) power supply, and the water sterilizing module and the torch module are respectively electrically connected with the DC power supply, so that the water sterilizing module and the torch module share the same power supply. The water sterilizing module adopts a UV-LED module which sends short-wave ultraviolet (UVC) (200-280nm) with the strongest sterilizing ability to sterilize water, and the torch module adopts an LED light source with low power consumption. The LED ultraviolet water treatment equipment can effectively sterilize and disinfect water during outdoor travel, mountain climbing, exploration, camping, army field combat training, and disasters of earthquake and tsunami to provide safe and sanitary water for people to drink, and provide a light source and send distress signals in the dark. The LED ultraviolet water treatment equipment has advantages of high efficiency, safety and environmental friendliness.

title_en: On-site detection device for handheld anti-explosion infrared and ultraviolet flame detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an on-site detection device for a handheld anti-explosion infrared and ultraviolet flame detector. The on-site detection device comprises a shell, wherein infrared glass and a light filter are sequentially stacked at the front end in the shell; an ultraviolet, laser and broad-spectrum light source device is arranged on the rear part of the light filter; a light reflection mirror is arranged behind the light source device; a control module connected with the light source device is arranged on the rear part of the light reflection mirror; and a power supply device is arranged on the rear part of the control module and connected with the control module through a lead wire and a switch. The integral on-site detection device consists of a broad-spectrum lamp, an ultraviolet lamp, the parabola light reflection mirror, the light filter, an infrared glass window, a rechargeable battery, the control module and the like and can emit infrared and ultraviolet spectra with certain frequencies. The device can be used as a flame simulator and applied to the technical field of firefighting equipment, in particular to debugging and detection of an infrared flame detector, an ultraviolet flame detector and an infrared and ultraviolet composite flame detector which are mounted on the site.
assignees: SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES INST AUTOMATION

title_en: Intelligent-type multifunctional fire-proof electricity leakage temperature measuring monitoring instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent-type multifunctional fire-proof electricity leakage temperature measuring monitoring instrument which comprises a shell, a zero sequence mutual inductor, a central processing circuit, a rectification amplifying circuit, a voltage sampling circuit, an acousto-optical alarm circuit, a communication circuit, a dual-way silicon controlled output circuit, a self-detection simulation electricity leakage generation circuit and a power supply circuit, wherein the central processing circuit, the rectification amplifying circuit, the voltage sampling circuit, the acousto-optical alarm circuit, the communication circuit, the dual-way silicon controllable output circuit, the self-detection simulation electricity leakage generation circuit and the power supply circuit are installed on a circuit board. The intelligent-type multifunctional fire-proof electricity leakage temperature measuring monitoring instrument provided by the utility model has the advantages that the circuit temperature can be inducted; the overload of the circuit can be monitored; when the overload is overloaded, the power supply is cut off timely, and the fire disaster can be prevented; the intelligent-type multifunctional fire-proof electricity leakage temperature measuring monitoring instrument has electricity leakage, over voltage and under voltage monitoring functions; the communication with an upper computer can be realized; central monitoring is convenient; whether the intelligent-type multifunctional fire-proof electricity leakage temperature measuring monitoring instrument provided by the utility model operates normally is monitored through controlling the simulation leakage electricity by the program; each measuring parameter can be displayed through the buttons on a panel and a liquid crystal display; the alarm value and the protection movement value can be set; full-Chinese-character display and menu-type operation are carried out..
assignees: Jiangxi jingcheng measurement & control co ltd

title_en: Test method for manual simulation of hail shooting disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a test method for manual simulation of a hail shooting disaster, which comprises the following steps of: (1) taking cotton growth period, hail size and hail shooting density as variables to design a hail disaster situation; (2) dividing a test field into a test plot and a check plot; and dividing the test plot according to the situation designed by the step (1); (3) in each cotton growth period, according to the situations designed by taking the hail size and the hail shooting density as variables in step (1), respectively carrying out manual simulation hail shooting impact tests on cotton plants in corresponding test plots, and observing and recording traits of the cotton plants before and after impact in corresponding test plots and check plots; and (4) after completion of a last cotton growth period, observing and recoding yield traits in corresponding test plots and check plots, and processing and analyzing observation data. Through the test method for manual simulation of the hail shooting disaster provided by the invention, the aim of quantitative research of loss caused by hail damage to crops can be reached, so that kernel parameters of kernel disaster, loss and further risk assessment of vulnerability of a bearing body of the hail disaster can be determined.

title_en: Fully-distributed optical fiber sensor in combination of optical fiber Raman frequency shifter and Raman amplifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fully-distributed optical fiber sensor in combination of an optical fiber Raman frequency shifter and a Raman amplifier. After shifting frequency for 13.2 THz by the optical fiber Raman frequency shifter, an optical fiber pulsing laser produces a broad spectrum Raman laser with a 1660nm wave band, wherein the broad spectrum Raman laser is served as the broad spectrum light source of the fully-distributed optical fiber sensor for performing the incidence of a sensing fiber; the deformation and the breaking of the optical fiber can be detected based on the reverse Rayleigh scattering strength ratio of the sensing fiber; the 1550nm wave band produced in the sensing fiber undergoes reverse anti-Stokes Raman scattering and is amplified by the optical fiber Raman amplifier; the temperature information at each section of the optical fiber can be obtained by deducting the influence produced by straining according to the strength ratio of the anti-Stokes Raman scattered light to the Rayleigh scattered light; the inspection on the training and the temperature is out of cross effect; the detection point on the sensing fiber can be located by using an optical time domain reflection technology. The fully-distributed optical fiber sensor is applied to the monitoring of petrochemical pipes, tunnels and large-scale civil engineering within ultra-long range of 100 kilometers, as well as disaster prediction monitoring.

title_en: Simulation method and system for online detection of hydrogen leakage
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation method and a stimulation system used for online detection of hydrogen leakage. The method comprises the steps of: detecting hydrogen storage and hydrogen concentration around a transmitting device in real time; when the hydrogen concentration detected is more than the set threshold value, determining the size and the shape of a crack through a panoramic camera and forming an initial boundary condition to perform system simulation so as to simulate composition of air around the current device and provide distribution situation and flow direction of hydrogen; and with the combination of material attributes of the device, estimating development situation of the crack by calculating a simulation program. The system comprises a cluster simulation computer, a sensor connected with the cluster simulation computer and used for detecting the hydrogen concentration, and the panoramic camera for detecting the crack. The method and the system can be used to position the crack rapidly in real time and provide data such as distribution concentration and flow direction of hydrogen in a field through high speed simulation, so that the method and the system are suitable for remote disaster detection to guide field rescue operation. The method and the system have better practical value and wide application prospect.

title_en: Quick fault-tolerance detection method for monitoring abnormal event by wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quick fault-tolerance detection method for monitoring an abnormal event by a wireless sensor network, and belongs to the technical field of the Internet of things. The sensor network is formed by self-organizing a large number of low-end sensor nodes; each node has finite power energy, communication capacity, calculation capacity and storage capacity and is generally arranged in an unattended severe environment; the possibility that each node makes a mistake is extremely high; and if the node makes a mistake, the network probably misjudges an event in a monitoring region. According to the method, the states of the nodes are adaptively managed by using confidence level, and failed nodes are removed from the sensor network, so that the influence of the failed nodes on abnormal event detection is reduced; and furthermore, a sliding window matching mechanism is used for detecting the change tendency of node monitoring data, so that whether the nodes can detect the abnormal event is forecasted. A simulation test shows that the reliability and the timeliness of detecting the abnormal event are improved, and the method can be widely applied to the fields of safety production monitoring, geological disaster monitoring, environment pollution monitoring and the like.

title_en: Volcanic eruption model
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a volcanic eruption model, which is composed of a base, a volcanic cone and a demonstration device, wherein a crater is arranged on the top of the volcanic cone; a plurality of lava flow strips are paved from the crater to a volcanic foot; the demonstration device comprises a smoke machine, a sounding device, a plurality of instruction lamps and an electric control system; the smoke machine and the sounding device are arranged in the volcanic cone; a smoke spray head is upwardly towards the crater; the instruction lamps are arranged in the lava flow strips; and the smoke machine, the sounding device and the instruction lamps are controlled by the electric control system. Due to smoke, a sound effect and a photoelectric effect through the smoke machine, the sounding device and the plurality of instruction lamps, the volcanic eruption situation is simulated and demonstrated full dynamically and vividly; the spontaneous change generated when a volcano erupts and the influence on the environment and human can be experienced by people; volcano knowledge of people can be increased; and the sense of disaster prevention of people can be increased; therefore, self rescue can be correctly carried out when disasters occur.
assignees: SUZHOU YULONG SCIENT EDUCATION CO LTD

title_en: Large simulation test piece box for multi field coupling coal mine dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large simulation test piece box for a multi field coupling coal mine dynamic disaster, and the large simulation test piece box comprises a box body, wherein the box body is provided with X-directional, Y-directional and Z-directional platens; the front box plate of the box body is provided with an extruded hole; the bottom of the box body is provided with a ventilating steel plate and an air flue; the ventilating steel plate covers the air flue; the inlet of the air flue is provided with an inner plug; the exterior of the left box plate of the box body is fixedly connected with first base plates at intervals; the left box plate is provided with sensor interfaces in the interval between the first base plates; and the sensor interface is provided with a sensor joint. According to the large simulation test piece box, the coal-rock mass gas pressure, the ground stress and the temperature variation as well as the time-spatial revolution rule of the acoustic emission signal of the coal-rock mass before and after the coal mine dynamic disaster happens can be monitored so as to achieve the purposes of researching internal relation among a stress field, a seepage field, a temperature field and a fracture field and the mutually-coupling action mechanism in the coal mine dynamic disaster process so as to more deeply disclose the generation mechanism of the coal mine dynamic disaster, and a theoretical basis is provided for the coal mine dynamic disaster prevention and treatment.

title_en: Multi-field-coupled coal mine dynamic disaster large-scale simulation testing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-field-coupled coal mine dynamic disaster large-scale simulation testing method, which includes the following steps: (1) completing formation and assembly of coal and rock inside a test piece box, connection of sensors and circuits and connection of a gas circuit; (2) placing the test piece box in a pressurizing system at a preset position, pressurizing the test piece box in the X-axis, the Y-axis and the Z-axis; (3) starting a data acquisition system; (4) degassing; (5) charging gas; and (6) outbursting. The method disclosed by the invention can monitor coal and rock gas pressure, ground stress, temperature variation of a coal and rock body as well as space-time evolution law of an acoustic emission signal of the coal and rock body before and after the occurrence of a coal mine dynamic disaster, and achieves the purposes of studying internal relations among a stress field, a seepage field, a temperature field and a fracture field as well as studying mutually coupled action mechanism thereof during the coal mine dynamic disaster, thereby revealing the occurrence mechanism of the coal mine dynamic disaster and providing theoretic base for prevention and control of the coal mine dynamic disaster.

title_en: Large simulation test acoustic emission device for multi field coupling coal mine dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large simulation test acoustic emission device for a multi field coupling coal mine dynamic disaster, and the device comprises a test piece box body, wherein the box body is provided with a probe mounting hole; a plug is welded at one end, which is near the inner cavity of the box body, of the probe mounting hole; one end, which is far away from the box body, of the probe mounting hole is provided with a first bolt in a matching manner; the outer side of the plug is provided with an acoustic source probe; a spring is subjected to press fitting between the acoustic source probe and the end surface of the first bolt; the first bolt is provided with a first axial through hole; a second bolt is arranged in the first axial through hole in a matching manner; the second bolt is provided with a second axial through hole; and a circumscribed lead of the acoustic source probe is led out from the first axial through hole and the second axial through hole. According to the large simulation test acoustic emission device, the time-spatial revolution rule of the acoustic emission signal of the coal-rock mass before and after the coal mine dynamic disaster happens can be monitored so as to achieve the purposes of researching internal relation among a stress field, a seepage field, a temperature field and a fracture field and the mutually-coupling action mechanism in the coal mine dynamic disaster process.

title_en: Multi-field coupling large-sized simulation test system for coal mine dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-field coupling large-sized simulation test system for coal mine dynamic disaster, which comprises a framework and test piece boxes. An X-direction pressure plate, a Y-direction pressure plate and a Z-direction pressure plate are arranged on each test piece box, a protruded opening is disposed on a front box plate of each of box bodies, a ventilating steel plate and an air passage are arranged at the bottom of each box body, sensor interfaces are arranged on each box body, the framework consists of a base, a left upright column and a right upright column are fixed onto the base, a crossbeam is fixed to the upper ends of the left upright column and the right upright column, the test boxes are placed on the base, pressurizing cylinders are disposed on the framework, the quantity and the positions of the pressurizing cylinders correspond to those of Y-direction pressure bars and Z-direction pressure bars, second cushion plates corresponding to second cushion plates are disposed on the left upright column, an additional seat is fixedly connected to the rear end of the base, X-direction pressurizing cylinders are arranged on the additional seat, the quantity and the positions of the X-direction pressurizing cylinders correspond to those of X-direction pressure bars, a counter-force frame is fixedly connected to the front of the base, and a left sliding door and a right sliding door are disposed on the counter-force frame. By the aid of the multi-field coupling large-sized simulation test system, a coal mine dynamic disaster process can be accurately simulated, and a coal mine dynamic disaster causing mechanism can be scientifically researched.

title_en: Large simulation test counter-force rack for multi field coupling coal mine dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large simulation test counter-force rack for a multi field coupling coal mine dynamic disaster, and the large simulation test counter-force rack comprises a bottom plate, wherein the bottom plate is provided with a plurality of bolt connection holes; the rear part of the bottom plate is provided with a vertical plate; the vertical plate is provided with a first opening; the rear part of the vertical plate is fixedly provided with a door frame; the door frame is provided with a second opening opposite to the first opening; the second opening of the door frame is provided with a left sliding door and a right sliding door which can plug the second opening; the left sliding door is connected with a left cylinder; the right sliding door is connected with a right cylinder; a first roller is respectively arranged between the upper part of the front door surfaces of the left sliding door and the right sliding door and the door frame and between the lower part of the front door surfaces and the door frame; a second roller is respectively arranged between the upper side surfaces of the left sliding door and the right sliding door and the door frame and between the lower side surfaces of the left sliding door and the right sliding door and the door frame; and the opposite surfaces of the left sliding door and the right sliding door are respectively provided with a left sealing plate and a right sealing plate. According to the large simulation test counter-force rack, the coal mine dynamic disaster process can be accurately simulated so as to more scientifically research a coal mine dynamic disaster forming mechanism.

title_en: Multipurpose ground pile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multipurpose ground pile which is characterized by comprising a pile body, a drill, a spiral piece and a fixing connecting piece, wherein the drill has an inverted cone shape and extends at the bottom of the pile body; the spiral piece is arranged below the pile body and spirally goes upward for a circle from the bottom periphery of the pile body wall to form a smooth spiral cutting curve; and the fixing connecting piece is arranged above the pile body. The ground pile disclosed by the utility model has a very wide application range in many fields including the foundation of a light structure such as the work shed foundation of a construction site, the pile foundation of a solar panel and the like, the foundation of a temporary structure such as the temporary housing foundation in natural disaster and the like, the foundation of equipment and devices, the fixation of a tent, the foundation of a vegetable greenhouse and the like. The multipurpose ground pile can be used as a temporary foundation or a permanent foundation, has the advantages of little screwing-in resistance and wide application range, is convenient to operate, and can be reused.
assignees: NANTONG WEIXIU PREC MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: Testing and simulating device for fire disasters in narrow and long limited spaces
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a testing and simulating device for fire disasters in narrow and long limited spaces. The testing and simulating device comprises a simulating bin, a first thermocouple unit, a second thermocouple unit, a smoke collecting system and a computerized control system, both the length-to-width ratio and the length-to-height ratio of the simulating bin are 10-8:1, a fire generating device is arranged at one end of the bottom of the simulating bin, the first thermocouple unit, the second thermocouple unit and the smoke collecting system are disposed on a side surface of the simulating bin, the computerized control system is used for acquiring temperature and smoke information in the simulating bin and analyzing data, the first thermocouple unit consists of a plurality of thermocouples positioned close to the top of the bin and arrayed along the horizontal direction of the simulating bin, the second thermocouple unit comprises a plurality of thermocouples arrayed along the height direction of the simulating bin, and the density of the thermocouples of the second thermocouple unit is gradually reduced from top to bottom. The testing and simulating device for researching flashover mechanism of the fire disasters in the narrow and long limited spaces is built for the first time, is provided with a complete temperature measuring system and the smoke collecting system, and is reasonable in structural arrangement and high in testing accuracy.

title_en: Simulation test device for testing on-way ventilation frictional resistance coefficient of curved tunnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation test device for testing an on-way ventilation frictional resistance coefficient of a curved tunnel and belongs to the technical field of ventilation and disaster prevention of a tunnel. The simulation test device is composed of a curve model tunnel and a straight-line model tunnel which are manufactured by an appropriate similarity ratio by sections and are connected, sand paper which is selected according to the similarity ratio, corresponds to the roughness of the wall surface of a prototype tunnel and is adhered to the inner surface of the curve model tunnel, static pressure testing pipes, a rectifying circular pipe with small testing holes, a micro-manometer and a testing air blower controlled by a frequency converter; one end of the curve model tunnel is connected with the straight-line model tunnel and the other end of the straight-line model tunnel is connected with the rectifying circular pipe; the rectifying circular pipe is connected with the testing air blower and the static pressure testing pipes are mounted at two end point positions of the curve model tunnel with the length to be detected; and the rectifying circular pipe is connected with the micro-manometer through an L-shaped pitot tube. The air blower provides testing air quantity, and a static pressure difference value and a dynamic pressure value which are measured are substituted into a formula to calculate the frictional coefficient in the curve model tunnel.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY SOUTHWEST RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Simulation test method of ventilation on-way frictional resistance coefficient of curved tunnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation test method of a ventilation on-way frictional resistance coefficient of a curved tunnel and belongs to the technical field of a tunnel ventilation disaster-preventing technology. The simulation test method comprises the following steps of: selecting an appropriate similarity ratio and manufacturing a curved model tunnel and a straight-line model tunnel for rectification section by section; selecting sand paper as an inner surface of the curved model tunnel; connecting the curved model tunnel with the straight-line model tunnel and a rectifying circular tube; connecting the rectifying circular tube with a test fan; mounting static-pressure test tubes on the curved model tunnel at two end points with the length to be detected; inserting a pitot tube into a small test hole of the rectifying circular tube; externally connecting a micro-manometer; providing a test air quantity by the fan; and substituting a measured static pressure difference value and a dynamic pressure value into a formula to calculate the frictional resistance coefficient in the curved model tunnel. By comparing a result obtained by a simulation test with an actual numerical calculation result, the requirement on acceptable precision in engineering is met.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY SOUTHWEST RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for analyzing structure safety
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a method for analyzing structure safety, and the method uses valid vibration measurement signals to obtain mutual feedbacks for a structural model analysis and a calibrated structural model to simulate a disaster situation to obtain the critical force exertion and deformation scale of a structure. The method is applied to capture the stability index of the structure to analyze the structure safety or applied for a structure safety evaluation or a health monitoring, or even for a structure multi-hazards safety determination.
assignees: LEE WEI-FENG;CHEN CHENG-HSING;LAI YI-CHUN;MEI HSING-TAI;UNIV NAT TAIWAN SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Forcible entry training door system
abstract_en: Apparatus for training the art of forcible door entry for emergency personnel such as firefighters and, in particular, a reusable forcible entry door training apparatus that allows individuals to simulate forcible entry of outward opening metal doors mounted in metal frames.

title_en: Indoor emergency evacuation simulation method for complex building
abstract_en: The invention relates to an indoor emergency evacuation simulation method for a complex building. According to the method disclosed by the invention, a three-dimensional extended hierarchical node relation model (EHI-NRM) of an internal space unit of the complex building is automatically generated, and the update of a dynamic path of a large-scale complex building is supported; an improved cellular automaton model (ICA) can better simulate jam, avoidance, mass-following and other phenomena of a large-scale crowd during the evacuation process; and an optimal evacuation path is searched in real time in the macro-level through an EHI-NRM dynamic path-finding method, and the ICA is applied in the local level for simulating the behavior characteristics of the crowd. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the evacuation simulation of the large-scale crowd in the large-scale complex building is supported, and the method has important application values for ensuring the safety of staff in the building and improving the decision-making capacity of an emergency rescue department.

title_en: Mine refuge vehicle with drilling function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a safety production device for a mine, in particular to a mine refuge vehicle with a drilling function for protecting personal safety in mine disasters. The utility model solves the problems that if a vehicle is pressed by a mine soil layer and cannot communicate with the outside, the health and safety of people in the vehicle are influenced by the lack of oxygen and foods in the vehicle after a long time, and the people in the vehicle cannot communicate with the outside in the prior art. According to the mine refuge vehicle, a base plate in a vehicle body is provided with an inner hydraulic rod with an operating handle; the upper end of the inner hydraulic rod is connected with a drill rod; the drill rod penetrates through a sleeve extending out of the vehicle body; and the sleeve is provided with a clamping device. The mine refuge vehicle can be applied to safety production, and has the advantages of drilling through the soil layer, getting rid of trouble and the like.

title_en: Evaluation method of debris flow disaster risk based on Bayesian network model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an evaluation method of the debris flow disaster risk based on a Bayesian network model. The evaluation method is characterized by comprising the following steps of: determining an evaluation unit; obtaining an evaluation index of the debris flow disaster risk of the evaluation unit by processing an evaluation parameter of the debris flow disaster risk of the evaluation unit; creating a training sample set according to historical data of the debris flow disaster risk in the evaluation unit and the evaluation index; creating the Bayesian network model according to the training sample set; and evaluating the debris flow disaster risk in an area to be evaluated by adopting the Bayesian network model. According to the evaluation method provided by the invention, the Bayesian network model is created by combining the historical data of the debris flow disaster risk in the evaluation unit and the evaluation index, the debris flow disaster risk in the area to be evaluated is evaluated by adopting the Bayesian network model, the accuracy of a debris flow disaster risk evaluation result is greatly increased, and the debris flow disaster risk in the area to be evaluated can be accurately evaluated by adopting the evaluation method.
assignees: INST GEOG SCI & NR RES CAS

title_en: Method for drift- reduction of gyro sensor and system thereof
title_ko: 자이로 센서의 드리프트 감소방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method and a system for reducing a drift of a gyro sensor are provided to enable to decide whether an estimated action is proper or not when a probability density function of a selected action has astringency in which a Gaussian distribution is appeared. CONSTITUTION: A method for reducing a drift of a gyro sensor is as follows. A drift reduction system(100) selects a value of a parameter set based on a probability density function respectively corresponding to each parameter set for a HDR(high data rate) algorithm. N training data sets and the selected value of the parameter set are used for the HDR algorithm. A figure of merit is decided according to an applied result and a compensation value is decided according to the decided figure of merit. A probability density function in which each parameter set corresponds according to the decided compensation value is up dated. A value of a new parameter set is selected based on the updated probability density function. Perform a second step again by using a value of the selected new parameter set.
abstract_ko: 자이로 센서의 드리프트 감소방법 및 그 시스템이 개시된다. 상기 자이로 센서의 드리프트 감소방법은 드리프트 감소 시스템이 HDR(Heuristic Drift Reduction) 알고리즘에 사용할 파라미터 집합들 각각에 대응되는 확률밀도 함수에 기초하여 파라미터 집합의 값을 선택하는 제1단계, N 개의 트레이닝 데이터 세트와 선택된 상기 파라미터 집합의 값을 이용해 HDR 알고리즘을 적용하는 제2단계, 적용된 결과에 따라 성능지수를 판단하고, 판단된 성능지수에 따라 보상 값을 결정하는 제3단계, 결정된 보상 값에 따라 상기 파라미터 집합들 각각에 대응되는 확률밀도 함수를 업데이트 하고, 업데이트 된 확률밀도 함수에 기초하여 새로운 파라미터 집합의 값을 선택하는 제4단계, 및 선택된 상기 새로운 파라미터 집합의 값을 이용하여 상기 제2단계부터 다시 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Universal simulation combustion testing cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model provides a universal simulation combustion testing cabinet, which includes a top cover, a cabinet body and a base plate, wherein a blower is arranged in the top cover to adjust displacement; the base plate and the rear wall of the cabinet body are in screwed connection with a framework, and the size of the space inside the cabinet can be adjusted; and a wind shield is also arranged below the base plate and can be used for adjusting the air inflow. The universal simulation combustion testing cabinet has the benefits that the size can be adjusted to meet testing requirements of samples with different sizes; the moving air capacity is controllable during the testing, the burning performance of a real product under the using environment can be simulated, so that correct burning performance index can be obtained, and loss brought by fire disaster to people can be reduced.

title_en: Three-dimensional dynamic whole-process simulation method for storm surge and flood routing in complex flooding areas
abstract_en: The invention belongs to a field of the visual simulation of a flood routing. Aiming at realizing the three-dimensional dynamic whole-process simulation of the storm surge and the flood routings, the safety management of seawalls, a quick scientific assessment of the storm surge disaster, and the scientific formulation and the implementation of rescue and relief work, the technical scheme provided is the three-dimensional dynamic whole-process simulation of the storm surge and the flood routings, comprising the following steps: (1) establishing three-dimensional mathematical models of the storm surge and the flood routings in complex flooding areas; (2) drawing bathymetric charts of the storm surge and the flood submerging in complex flooding areas (3) dynamically simulating liquid phase flows of the storm surge and the flood routings in complex flooding areas; (4) carrying out the dynamics calculation of the storm surge and the flood routings in complex areas; (5) establishing virtual-real coupling models of the storm surge and the flood routings in complex areas; (6) carrying out the post processing and the visual output of the three-dimensional dynamic whole-process simulation. The method is mainly applied in the three-dimensional dynamic whole-process simulation of the storm surge and the flood.

title_en: Simulator for demonstrating liquefaction of sand
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulator for demonstrating liquefaction of sand, which aims at providing a simulator which has a simple structure and can simulate liquefaction of sand when different levels of earthquake happen, further disseminates the harm of liquefaction of sand and emergency disaster prevention general knowledge, and improves the sense of disaster prevention and reduction. The simulator is technically characterized in that the simulator comprises a building (12) positioned on a sand box (13) provided with sand and water mixture (14); a swinging device is installed below the sand box (13); and the swinging device comprises a stepper motor (1), an eccentric shaft component (2), a swing link component (4), a guide component (5), a sliding component (10) and a circuit combined element device (11). The circuit combined element device (11) comprises a direct current power source, a touch screen single-chip microcomputer and a step driver.
assignees: ANHUI HONGWEI ELECTROMECHANICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: System and method for managing coal mine emergency rescue command information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for managing coal mine emergency rescue command information. The system comprises a coal mine basic information module, a coal mine safety monitoring information module, a map displaying and managing module, a coal mine catastrophe analyzing module, an emergency rescue power module and a catastrophe decision information module. Real-time monitoring and information data update are performed on information of main dangerous sources and hidden dangers under a coal mine by utilizing basic information and monitoring information of the coal mine, an information platform for effectively restraining the damage degree cause by underground sudden accidents is built, and effective and reliable information resources and basic data are provided for analysis and simulation of underground catastrophes by utilizing information before the accidents occur. The system automatically displays the best sheltering lines for underground persons, starts a set emergency response scheme, timely and effectively controls the influence degree of the accidents, and can further effectively provide response time for sheltering and rescue of underground workers and reduce accident loss and casualties to the largest extent.
assignees: CHANGCUN COAL MINING OF SHANXI LUAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROT ENERGY DEV CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Urban dispersion simulation method based on multiresolution chart
abstract_en: The invention relates to an urban dispersion simulation method based on a multiresolution chart. The urban dispersion simulation method is characterized by starting with scene modelling to building an urban dispersion simulation scene based on a multiresolution chart so as to form an universal dispersion simulation method in the urban dispersion simulation field by combining the existing various human behaviour simulation methods. When the method disclosed by the invention is applied, on one hand, dispersion simulation based on the multiresolution chart requires concrete analysis carried out according to different urban disaster environments, and a concrete multiresolutiona chart generative process is changed to some extent by combining setting of fine degree of the required disaster evaluation; on the other hand, the method disclosed by the invention is combined with the existing dispersion simulation method, the existing personnel dispersion decision simulation method is realized onto a scene model in the method disclosed by the invention, and a complete dispersion simulation system is formed.
assignees: SHANGHAI RIPU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Pedestrian evacuation simulation method based on extended BDI (base diffusion isolation) model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pedestrian evacuation simulation method based on an extended BDI (base diffusion isolation) model. The method is based on the extended BDI model, a cellular automaton and a multi-agent technology are adopted, and personnel evacuation in public places in emergency (such as a fire disaster) is simulated according to plane layout of the actual building. According to the method, influence of psychological states of personnel on evacuation is fully considered in a pedestrian simulation process, certain support is given to the spirit factor by virtue of an extended BDI system structure, and the method is more consistent with the reality when being applied to pedestrian simulation with incomplete environmental information. The method disclosed by the invention has a wide application prospect in personnel safety and rapid evacuation simulation research, can test a design scheme or a response scheme and is an economically feasible pedestrian evacuation simulation method.
assignees: SHANGHAI RIPU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent group motion simulation method in virtual scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to and discloses an intelligent group motion simulation method in a virtual scene. In group motion simulation, a control mode of a hierarchical model is used to carry out hierarchical motion simulation on the group. By using the method of the invention, the simulation is performed on the large-scale group motion in the virtual scene and visualization is strong. The invention mainly relates to simulation of a motion field of a lot of intelligent motion groups, which means visualization simulation of the following situations, such as, a school situation of going to the school and going home after the school, large scale military motion, a large scale war scene, opening and closing ceremonies of a large-scale sports meet, a personnel evacuation condition during a disaster, a traffic condition and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI RIPU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake popular science experience vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a simulation earthquake experience device, in particular to an earthquake popular science experience vehicle, which comprises a vehicle body and a compartment, wherein a system control cabinet and a system control computer host are arranged on one side of the compartment; a programmable logic controller (PLC) control tab is arranged in the system control cabinet; an earthquake platform, a stage smog machine, a ceiling pendant lamp, a cross beam, an illumination lamp and a sounder which are controlled by the PLC control tab are arranged in the compartment; and a rolling screen connected with the PLC control tab, a large screen water tank and a stainless steel drain cap which is connected with the large screen water tank are arranged at the front end of the compartment. The earthquake popular science experience vehicle has the advantages that an earthquake simulation effect is improved, experiencers can be monitored and assessed, and the earthquake popular science experience vehicle has the earthquake escape self-rescue experience and the experience of secondary disaster prevention measures of earthquake.
assignees: CHONGQING OPEN INFORMATION & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Oil well improvement system
abstract_en: Two functionally and physically integrated subsystems form a supplemental disaster preventive system for offshore oil wells. A multi-function well subsystem modifies the sea-floor and in-well equipment to provide maintenance access, tools to cap the well, seal/re-seal the well, drill/re-drill the well, kill the well from the top, improve BOP reliability, add BOP functional redundancy, improve the cementing process, incorporate a sea-floor pressure relief/diversion function and improve the well's life cycle safety. A dome top cylindrical sidewall structure encloses the well's sea-floor equipment providing improved structural strength as well as passive protection from natural/human induced disasters. An intrusion detection and response subsystem provides sensing, processing and communication devices to detect, track & classify the 3D aspects of air/surface/sub-surface objects around a specific oil well or group of oil wells and provides the means to evaluate and eliminate threats.

title_en: Method for processing fault and rapidly recovering power supply of important user
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for processing a fault of and rapidly recovering power supply of an important user, belonging to the field of power transmission and distribution. An emergency responding flow comprises the following steps of: determining a dividing principle of the important user; analyzing the configuration of a power supply structure of the important user in a managing range; classifying sources of power grid disasters; describing the type of common power grid faults; determining a programming method of a relative plan to reliably supply power to the important user by a power supply company; investigating and surveying typical example emergency conditions of the important user and analyzing a processing method of the power grid faults; programming a plan for processing the fault of the important user and rapidly recovering the power supply on the basis of the traditional power grid accident processing emergency plan; carrying out emergency plan training at regular time; and carrying out emergency plan drill at regular time. The method disclosed by the invention combines two inspects including a technology measure and an organizational measure, and power supply accidents and influences and loss which are possibly caused by the power supply accidents can be reduced to the greatest extent; and economic society sustainable and stable development and city safety operation are guaranteed. The method disclosed by the invention can be widely applied to the field of the safety operation and the accident processing of a power supply system.

title_en: Expandable distributed system supporting large-scale microscopic traffic simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an expandable distributed system supporting large-scale microscopic traffic simulation, and the system is characterized in that an Agent technology is combined with the high level architecture (HLA) technology, a simulation entity Agent is correspondently generated through a simulation entity generation server according to a traffic flow distribution status model and a traffic entity behavior model, and the simulation entity Agent is included into a corresponding regional management Agent; and each region in the Agent is coordinated. The Agent performs the time synchronic management through a real-time interface (RTI) of the HLA, and evidence can be provided for the evacuation of different traffic disasters, the traffic commanding and establishment and estimation of specification decision through the simulation. Meanwhile, the simulation effect can be displayed in real time through a display module, and the simulation system module is clear and has customizability, expandability and flexibility. By combining the Agent technology with the HLA technology, the distributed simulation system can efficiently and quickly realize the simulation of a microscopic traffic.
assignees: SHANGHAI RIPU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Portable inflatable tent
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable inflatable tent which comprises an inflatable keel and a tent fabric, wherein the inflatable keel is of a triangular prism shaped integral air column structure with a vertical lower portion and a transverse upper portion and is connected with the tent fabric through fixing devices, and an inflating valve is arranged on the lower portion of the inflatable keel and connected with a high-pressure air bottle through an inflating hose. The portable inflatable tent has the advantages of simple structure, small size, light weight, time and labor saving in use, convenience to transport and carry and the like, can be used for field construction, camping training, temporary chambers, sports entertainment, recreation, travel and the like and is particularly applicable to field living of troops during field study, camping, exploration, construction, disaster relief and flood prevention.

title_en: Underground highway tunnel fire disaster experiment simulating device adopting vertical shaft to carry out natural smoke extraction
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground highway tunnel fire disaster experiment simulating device adopting a vertical shaft to carry out natural smoke extraction. The device comprises a main experiment table body and a matched measuring and controlling system. The experiment device serves as a small-sized experiment table which is specially used for carrying out comprehensive system researches on heat release rates, smoke movement, fire disaster detection and putting-out and the like in a fire disaster of an underground highway tunnel adopting the vertical shaft to carry out the natural smoke extraction. On the basis of previous experience, the device disclosed by the invention overcomes the defects of high cost of a full-sized experiment and inaccuracy of a numerical value simulating tool, and also guarantees the repeatability of experiments, thus having great application values on implementing a laboratory scientific research and simulating tests of actual tunnel smoke control, vertical shaft smoke extraction effects, and a detection and putting-out system. Therefore, the device disclosed by the invention has wide application prospect and important actual guiding meanings on the smoke control, the design of the detection and putting-out system, and test evaluation and research of the fire disaster of the underground highway tunnel adopting the vertical shaft to carry out the natural smoke extraction.

title_en: Method for extracting gas of blank zone of working face with large mining length
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for extracting gas of a blank zone of a working face with large mining length. Aiming at the gas prevention and control blank zone in a middle region of the stope working face with the large mining length, a middle bottom-position roadway is creatively adopted to perform orientation drilling and order kerf to a high voltage pulse water jet region of a coal seam to improve air permeability of a large coal seam, and gas converges in the bottom-position roadway along cracked gap channels and then are transported to a gas extracting pump station through pipelines. By means of the method, the drilling and the kerf are performed in the bottom-position roadway of the blank zone of the stope working face with the large mining length through high voltage pulse water jet. By changing pressure and flow of a high-pressure pump and a gas-water-residue separating device, the gas is extracted controllably and orderly, gas content and gas pressure are reduced, power conditions causing outburst of coal and the gas are weakened, local ultra-limitation of the gas is effectively avoided, dangerousness of the outburst of the coal and the gas is eliminated regionally, and disaster is effectively contained.

title_en: Special-effect traumatic injury pill capsule
abstract_en: The invention provides a special-effect traumatic injury pill capsule. The medicine provided by the invention is prepared with a prescription handed down from generations. The medicine is composed of seven valuable Chinese herbal medicines. The Chinese herbal medicines are processed through a special preparation method, such that a Pangongping traumatic injury resurrection pill is obtained. The pill is a medicine for treating traumatic injuries, and can be used internally and externally. The medicine has functions of blood circulation activating, stasis removing, bleeding stopping, pain relieving, astringing, tissue regeneration promoting, and rot removing. When the medicine is used in traumatic injuries, the curative effect can reach the whole body, all the internal and external organs, and all body parts. The medicine has special and fast effect against Qi and blood stagnation, and hematoma caused by Qi stagnation. The medicine has a stasis removing effect. When the medicine is used in bone and muscle injuries, the injuries can be healed in a few days. The medicine has substantial treatment effect against traumatic injuries caused by earthquake disasters, aloft works, mining, exercise sprain, traffic accidents, and fighting and impacting. The medicine is suitable for people of any ages (except pregnant woman). The medicine is a necessary medicine for all populations.

title_en: Simulation confirmation system for elevator function
abstract_en: The simulation confirmation system for elevator function makes it easy and efficient to carry out an inspection after construction of the elevator in the state that both the inspectors and the owners take the lift car. The simulation confirmation system confirms every function of the elevator under normal operation as well as under the control operation when the elevator experiences at least one of such abnormal situation as earthquake, fire disaster, water immersion, and power off in a simulative manner. The simulation confirmation system of the utility model comprises a control apparatus for function confirmation. The control apparatus comprises the following components: an analog signal preservation member for saving the analog signals same as the signals output by the sensor that detects the abnormality, a confirmation function selection member for selecting the functions to be confirmed, and an analog signal output member for outputting the analog signals stored in the analog signal preservation member corresponding to the functions selected in the confirmation function selection member to the control apparatus controlling the operation of the elevator, with the control apparatus for function confirmation being arranged in lift car console inside the lift car as well.

title_en: Relay-style dual-working layer electro-plated diamond bit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a relay-style dual-working layer electro-plated diamond bit. A working layer of the relay-style dual-working layer electro-plated diamond bit comprises an upper working layer (4) and a lower working layer (3), wherein the upper working layer and the lower working layer are separated by upper water ports (2) and lower water ports (1). The standards of the upper working layer and the lower working layer are the same, the quantity of the water ports are equal and the water ports are mutually staggered and uniformly distributed. The upper and the lower working layers and an inner and an outer gauge protecting layers are all made of diamond electroplated layers. The two working layers of the relay-style dual-working layer electro-plated diamond bit is beneficial to improving of the bending strength of the relay-style dual-working layer electro-plated diamond bit. The gauge protection measure is enhanced by using secondary forming, and thus the service life of the relay-style dual-working layer electro-plated diamond bit is greatly prolonged, and the traditional concept that the electro-plated bit can not be used for wire-line coring drilling is changed. The relay-style dual-working layer electro-plated diamond bit can be widely applied to foundation engineering reconnaissance, foundation engineering reinforcement and geological disaster management such as geological prospecting, scientific drilling, and water conservancy and hydropower.
assignees: WUHAN WANBANG LASER DIAMOND TOOLS CO LTD

title_en: Simulator for demonstrating liquefaction of sand
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulator for demonstrating liquefaction of sand, aiming to provide the simulator which is simple in structure and capable of simulating the liquefaction of sand under earthquakes of different levels so as to further propagandize hazards of the liquefaction of sand and common sense of meeting emergencies and preventing disasters, and improve the consciousness of people on preventing and reducing disasters. The utility model has a technological key point that the simulator is characterized in that a building (12) is located on a sand box (13) filled with sand-water mixtures (14), and a shaking device is arranged below the sand box (13) and comprises a stepping motor (1), an eccentric shaft assembly (2), an oscillating bar assembly (4), a guiding assembly (5), a sliding assembly (10), and a circuit combined element device (11), wherein the circuit combined component device (11) is composed of a direct-current power supply, a touch screen singlechip microcomputer and a stepping driver.
assignees: ANHUI HONGWEI ELECTROMECHANICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention and mitigation service platform for urban public buildings
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a disaster prevention and mitigation service platform for urban public buildings. The disaster prevention and mitigation service platform comprises three working platforms, a communication server, two switches, four servers, a router and a network operation platform, wherein the network operation platform is connected with the router, the two switches consist of a core switch and an Intranet switch, the four servers consist of a data center server, an instant messaging server, a virtual reality server and a web server, the core switch is connected with the Intranet switch, the router, the communication server, the virtual reality server and the web server, the Intranet switch is connected with the data center server and the instant messaging server, and the three working platforms consist of a web server working platform, an emergency commanding and watch-keeping working platform and a network database maintenance and management working platform and are connected with the Intranet switch through the Ethernet. The platform disclosed by the utility model can collect various messages related to disaster prevention and mitigation, so as to help fire departments to determine correct rescue decisions in time.

title_en: Sea-water supply system for disaster prevention of burner boom in drill-ships
title_ko: 시추선의 버너 붐 방재용 해수공급장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A seawater supply system for disaster prevention of a burner boom in a drillship is provided to improve cost efficiency by minimizing the equipment of high-capacity pumps. CONSTITUTION: A seawater supply system for disaster prevention of a burner boom in a drillship comprises multiple ballast pumps(BP1,BP2,BP3,BP4), a mud pump(MP), a static pressure regulator(PR), and a pressure control unit(40). The ballast pumps pump seawater. The mud pump is connected to the ballast pumps through ballast seawater supply lines(L1). The static pressure regulator is formed on one side of a main seawater supply line(L3) branched from one side of a mud supply line(L2) connected to the mud pump. The pressure control unit is formed on one side of a branched seawater supply line(L4) which supplies seawater to a seawater spray curtain(11). [Reference numerals] (AA) Exhaust; (BB) Controller
abstract_ko: 시추선의 버너 붐 방재용 해수공급장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 시추선의 버너 붐 방재용 해수공급장치는 버너 붐의 외측으로 해수를 분사하는 해수분사커튼과 버너 붐 상에서 상부로 해수를 분사하는 해수분사노즐 및 선체 구성품을 화염으로부터 보호하기 위한 델루지 노즐로 구성되는 버너 붐 방재설비에 해수를 공급하기 위한 시추선의 버너 붐 방재용 해수공급장치에서, 해수를 펌핑하는 다수의 밸러스트 펌프; 상기 각 밸러스트 펌프와 밸러스트 해수공급라인으로 연결되는 머드 펌프; 상기 머드 펌프에 연결되는 머드공급라인의 일측으로부터 분기되어 상기 해수분사노즐에 연결되는 메인 해수공급라인 상의 일측에 구성되어 상기 메인 해수공급라인 상의 해수의 압력을 일정압으로 제어함과 동시에 맥동을 흡수하는 정압 레귤레이터; 및 상기 정압 레귤레이터 이후의 메인 해수공급라인의 일측으로부터 분기되어 상기 해수분사커튼에 연결되는 분기 해수공급라인 상의 일측에 구성되어 상기 분기 해수공급라인 상의 해수의 압력을 설정압으로 제어하는 압력제어수단을 포함한다.

title_en: Method for controlling mine power capacity source by using region power planning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for controlling a mine power capacity source by using region power planning. The optimal combination of mine design, actual mining and natural environment is achieved, and the problem of passive protection of current mine power is solved. By the aid of the method, results of the region power planning are used, an application method of the region power planning on mines is established, engineering technical schemes are obtained through combination of the region power planning, computer simulation and contrastive analysis are conducted, a best solution in which the ratio of power disasters is the lowest is chosen, the protection is conducted for hazard areas, the application condition of the region power planning is improved, the combination of the region power planning and mineral engineering is achieved, and active protection of mine power disasters is achieved.

title_en: Method for actively and regionally preventing and controlling rock burst in coal mines
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for changing coal seam impact tendentiousness with regional impact prevention as a target. The method comprises the following steps and contents of evaluating and selecting to tunnel a rock gangway in a stable rock stratum; distributing a construction chamber of drilling groups in the rock gangway; installing a drilling machine in the construction chamber; constructing a rock drilling hole; constructing an oblique hole to enable the drilling hole to extend along a coal seam to form a coal seam drilling hole after the rock drilling hole enters the coal seam; and conducting remote fracture operation to enable the coal seam to change into fracture coal bodies to change the coal seam impact tendentiousness after the coal seam drilling hole is constructed. According to anti-impacting design requirements, the steps are repeated, the drilling groups are formed in the coal seam, and the regional coal seam impact tendentiousness is changed, so that rock burst disasters during tunneling and backstopping can be avoided. The method adopts rock gangway construction and drilling, is free of hole collapsing, apt to seal the hole, deep in drilling depth and capable of changing the coal seam impact tendentiousness, conducts gas extraction and improves gas extraction rate.

title_en: Regional emergency traffic evacuation simulation system based on activity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale regional emergency traffic evacuation simulation system based on activities, which comprises a disaster evolution module, a road network construction module, a population and activity generation module, a microscopic traffic simulation module, an animation display module and a statistical analysis module.
