The disaster evolution module is used for providing an influence of a disaster on a road system; the road network construction module is used for constructing a road network and an activity place; the population and activity generation module is used for generating a population evacuation and individual and family escape plan; the microscopic traffic simulation module is used for generating a population evacuation and vehicle movement trajectory; the animation display module is used for displaying a population evacuation and vehicle movement process; and the statistical analysis module is used for statistical analysis of traffic conditions during evacuation. The individual and family escape plan and the destructive effects of disasters on the road network during evacuation are comprehensively considered, the vehicle movement process is described via microscopic traffic simulation, the whole traffic evacuation simulation process is enabled to be more practical, and the assessment of an emergency traffic evacuation plan can be realized effectively.

title_en: Demonstration device and demonstration method for urban public security multi-disaster secondary derivation coupling simulation
abstract_en: A demonstration device and a demonstration method for urban public security multi-disaster secondary derivation coupling simulation belong to the technical field of public security simulation. The demonstration device comprises a dynamic sand table, a projection device and a control system. An urban model is arranged on the dynamic sand table, a movable lift and a vibration instrument are arranged at positions inside the dynamic sand table. A detecting device is arranged on the dynamic sand table, and the projection device is divided into a dynamic sand table projector, a three-dimensional animation projector and a horizontal projection screen. By means of a method based on three-screen linkage by combining a physical model and a virtual three-dimensional image, demonstration of experiments and value simulation results of happening and developing rules under the conditions of urban multiple emergency events and coupling of the events is achieved. Dynamic demonstration of links of disaster field simulation reappearance, monitoring, information delivering, information access, predicting, pre-warning and decision control and the like are achieved. Visual presentation means are provided for the disaster reappearance, risk evaluation, scene deduction, pre-arranged planning practice, education and training and the like.

title_en: Apparatus for testing comprehensive performance of damaging and dismantling tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an apparatus for testing the comprehensive performance of a damaging and dismantling tool, comprising a hydraulic cylinder, a shearing and expanding device and a supporting device, also comprising a strength detection mechanism, a power source mechanism, a simulation mechanism, a strength test interface, a power source interface, and a servo valve, wherein the hydraulic cylinder is connected with the shearing and expanding device and the supporting device, and the shearing and expanding device and the supporting device are respectively connected with the strength test interface and a power source interface through a hand-operated valve. The apparatus employs a simulation mechanism and a servo hydraulic oil cylinder to load an exerted resistance on an expanding device, the shearing and expanding device and the supporting device, and is kept in a dynamic opening process; the power source mechanism provides a power source for an electric pump, an overflow valve and a sensor, etc.; the apparatus is provided with the strength detection mechanism, can perform strength test on a damaging and dismantling tool, and can systematically check the damaging and dismantling tool, thereby increasing control precision, being more accurate in test data, and providing safe and reliable guarantees for firefighting.
assignees: SHENZHEN IVS FLUID CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Water recycling and firefighting training system
abstract_en: A water recycling and firefighting training system for efficiently practicing connecting water hoses between a water storage tank including a fire hydrant and a fire engine. The water recycling and firefighting training system generally includes a frame having wheels, a storage tank mounted to the frame, a fire hydrant mounted proximate the frame, wherein the fire hydrant is fluidly connected to the storage tank, a pump fluidly connected to the storage tank to pump water to the fire hydrant, and at least one intake fluidly connected to the storage tank for inputting water back within the storage tank. The water from the storage tank is circulated between the mobile trailer and a fire engine through a plurality of hoses in a closed-loop configuration.

title_en: Underground ultra-thin virtual protection layer hydraulic coal mining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground ultra-thin virtual protection layer hydraulic coal mining method, comprising the following steps of: drilling and coring to determine the parameters of a coal seam, and selecting the type of ultra-thin virtual protection layer hydraulic coal mining; determining the layer position and the minimum mining thickness of an ultra-thin virtual protection layer; designing a layer-crossing drilling parameter and a hydraulic mining drill bit; performing a hydraulic directional jet parameter design; installing a blowout preventer at an orifice, and executing layer-crossing drilling; performing hydraulic directional jet; stopping the jet in the case that the coal output is very low and the coal output is hardly increased after jet pressure is increased, retreating a drill rod and the drill bit, and inspecting the range of the first hydraulic directional mining; performing pipeline connection to implement pressure-relief gas drainage; inspecting the measure effect of ultra-thin virtual protection layer hydraulic coal mining; and performing a regional outburst elimination verification. The method disclosed by the invention is short in outburst elimination time, low in application engineering cost, relatively simple in process, capable of adequately increasing drainage efficiency, shortening drainage time, enlarging drainage radius, reducing drilling work amount, and eliminating gas disaster to the minimum.

title_en: System and method for monitoring dynamic disaster of coal mine with fiber bragg gratings
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring a dynamic disaster of a coal mine with fiber bragg gratings. According to the system and the method, the fiber bragg gratings (1) are distributed in or on the surface of rod bodies of anchor rods (2); the anchor robs (2) are inserted into two uppers of a roadway of the coal mine or other effective positions by drilling holes; and optical connector (11) capable of being connected with the external are introduced from the tails of the anchor rods (2), and connected with fiber bragg grating network demodulation instruments (5) which are connected to a testing computer (6) to form a testing system for monitoring the dynamic strain. With the adoption of the system and the method disclosed by the invention, the dynamic disaster can be relatively accurately forecasted, and relatively high performance of preventing outside interference can be achieved; and the method is an intrinsic safety testing method.

title_en: Automatic control and simulation system for land search and rescue training
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic control and simulation system for land search and rescue training. The automatic control and simulation system for the land search and the rescue training is characterized by comprising a central command unit, a central data processing unit and a simulation work unit. The central command unit comprises a personal computer (PC) and a configuration software platform. The central data processing unit is composed of a control method selective switch, a power supply module, a central processing unit (CPU), a communication processor, an input-and-output processor and an interface processor. The simulation work unit comprises dangerous material detection simulation system, a fire scene simulation system, an aftershock simulation system, an earthquake acousto-optic simulation system and a ruin search and rescue acousto-optic simulation system. Through tight combination of theory and reality, the automatic control and simulation system for the land search and rescue training is built, and provides good conditions for solving existing natural disaster rescue training problems.
assignees: LANZHOU YUANCHUANG MACHANICAL & ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Large collapse rock blasting method under precise control of digital electronic detonators
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of blasting, and particular relates to a large collapse rock blasting method under precise control of digital electronic detonators. The method includes steps of designing parameters of a hole network and distributing holes; drilling holes by cutting drills; charging and blocking; and networking and detonating. The digital electronic detonators are used for precisely controlling blasting, the hole network is designed to be subjected to detonation in parallel and detonation layer by layer, powder charges on the same layer are detonated from two sides to the center obliquely hole by hole, and millisecond delay of powder charges on different layers is realized according to a sequence from bottom to top in the holes. The implementing scheme of adopting the electronic detonators to detonate during blasting of collapse rocks in complicated environments is determined. According to tests of blasting utilizing the electronic detonators to detonate, the technical method of utilizing the electronic detonators to realize precise delay detonation for improving blasting lumpiness is researched, a guarantee is provided for controlling collapse accumulation range of broken rock after blasting, shocks to surrounding rock are reduced greatly on safety blasting conditions of the collapse rock, and secondary disasters are avoided.
assignees: CHONGQING BLASTING CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;CHONGQING URBAN CONSTRUCTION HOLDINGS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for determining air-leakage rate of oxidized zone of goaf
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for determining air-leakage rate of an oxidized zone of goaf, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine downhole spontaneous combustion disaster prevention. The method includes firstly, determining nitrogen injection flow rate; secondly, burying beam tubes for gas component measurement in the goaf to determine change of concentration of oxygen; thirdly, establishing a numerical computing module, and determining concentration distribution of oxygen in the goaf and the air-leakage rate on the condition without nitrogen injection by a numerical simulation process; fourthly, performing a thermogravimetric experiment to coal samples sampled from the work face, acquiring oxygen concentration on the condition without weight gaining, and serving the oxygen concentration as an inerting fireproof index of the goaf; fifthly, dividing the spontaneous combustion three-zone of the goaf; sixthly, selecting the widest section of the oxidized zone in the goaf, simulating dividing results of the spontaneous combustion three-zone of the goaf to determine the boundary according to a fitted equation of field real-time measured oxygen concentration distribution results, and solving the average oxygen concentration of the section in the oxidized zone; seventhly, determining nitrogen purity in an actual nitrogen injection process of the work face; and eighthly, determining the air-leakage rate of the oxidized zone of the goaf according to a nitrogen injection quantity calculation formula.

title_en: High-rise escape practicing platform and high-rise escape practicing platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-rise escape practicing platform and a high-rise escape practicing method. The platform comprises a practicing environment simulation field, a control system, high-rise emergency escape auxiliary equipment and a firefighting escape knowledge display board, and is additionally provided with a practicing manual of the platform. The practicing environment simulation field is used for truly simulating positions and space of a fire disaster field and a smoke and fire environment; the control system is used for controlling automatic operation and man-machine interaction of firefighting equipment when a fire disaster occurs, guiding escape people and monitoring the integral practicing field and practicing people; the high-rise emergency escape auxiliary equipment is used for assisting the practicing people to escape from a high-rise under special conditions; the escape knowledge display board is used for broadcasting firefighting knowledge mainly including implementation methods of firefighting equipments and escape appliances; and the practicing manual provides a scientific escape demonstration and training method by the aid of the high-rise escape practicing platform.

title_en: Computational simulation method of flow slide catastrophe of rock and soil material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a computational simulation method of a flow slide catastrophe of a rock and soil material, belonging to the technical fields of computational rock and soil mechanics, geologic hazard prevention and control and geologic environment protection. Aiming at the limitation that the conventional grid-based computing method is only suitable for small-deformation analysis, the invention discloses a computational simulation method of an entire flow slide catastrophe process of the rock and soil material based on smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH). According to the method, a Navier-strokes equation is used as a control equation, solid phase and liquid phase of the rock and soil material are described by using a sub-load face Cambridge model and an incompressible fluid constitutive model respectively, porous medium theory and darcy law are introduced to calculate solid-liquid coupling acting force, and a computation model, which considers the full coupling of water and soil, of the flow slide catastrophe of the rock and soil material, is established. According to the computational simulation method, the entire process of large-deformation flow damage of the rock and soil material can be effectively represented, and the fluidization characteristic of the rock and soil material is captured, so that powerful scientific basis is provided for engineering design, engineering construction, disaster prevention and reduction and the like of high-risk areas of the flow slide disaster, and meanwhile, application of the computational rock and soil mechanics in the technical fields of actual engineering construction, geologic hazard prevention and control and the like is forcefully promoted.

title_en: Simulation test device for testing frictional resistance coefficient of curve tunnel ventilation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a simulation test device for testing a frictional resistance coefficient of curve tunnel ventilation and belongs to the technical field of tunnel ventilation disaster prevention. The simulation test device is composed of a curve model tunnel, a straight model tunnel, a piece of sand paper, a static pressure test pipe, a rectifying circular pipe with a test hole, a micro-manometer and a test fan, wherein the curve model tunnel and the straight model tunnel are manufactured by using subsections in similar proportions and are connected with each other; the sand paper is selected according to the similarity ratio, is corresponding to the wall roughness of an original tunnel and is glued to an inner surface of the curve model tunnel; the test fan is controlled by a frequency converter; one end of the curve model tunnel is connected with the straight model tunnel while the other end is connected with the rectifying circular pipe; the rectifying circular pipe is connected with the test fan; the static pressure test pipe is mounted in the positions of two end points having a to-be-tested length of the curve model tunnel; and the rectifying circular pipe is connected with the micro-manometer through an L-shaped pitot tube. Test air quantity is supplied by the test fan and the measured static pressure difference value and dynamic pressure difference value are substituted in a formula so as to calculate and obtain the frictional resistance coefficient in the curve model tunnel.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY SOUTHWEST RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Drilling-milling wall breaking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling-milling wall breaking device which comprises a door-type bracket and longitudinal guide rails arranged inside two supporting beams, wherein the door-type bracket is internally provided with an erection support; two sides of the erection support are provided with sliding blocks matched with the longitudinal guide rails; the erection support is fixedly provided with a main motor; an output shaft positioned at the lower end of the main motor is fixedly provided with a rotary cutter head; four cylindrical cutters, which are uniformly distributed on a same circumference, are arranged on the rotary cutter head; the upper end of the main motor is provided with a manual feeding mechanism for the ascending and descending of the erection support; and the drilling-milling wall breaking device further comprises an electric control part which is composed of a variable-frequency governor, a travel switch, a working state indication lamp and a control circuit and used for controlling the rotary cutter head to alternately rotate positively and reversely according to one fourth cycle. The drilling-milling wall breaking device is simple in structure, less in excavated volume, high in efficiency, less in disturbance quantity, strong in practicability, portability, low cost, simplicity and convenience in operation and the like; and during post-disaster rescue operation, aiming at various dilapidated walls, the drilling-milling wall breaking device can be used for rapidly forming holes into which personnel can enter, and realizing the timely rescue of victims.

title_en: Water mist and foam dust settling device
abstract_en: A water mist and foam dust settling device is particularly suitable for treating dust disasters in underground heading faces of mines. Flying dust generated in an excavation process is settled twice by ejecting water mist and foam, dust generating points can be sufficiently covered, and the purpose of reducing dust hazards is achieved. The foam is generated by a foam generator. The water mist and foam dust settling device comprises the foam generator, a water mist generator, connecting pipelines, a nozzle device and a protective disc, and the foam generator and the water mist generator are connected with the nozzle device by the connecting pipelines. The nozzle device and the protective disc are mounted in a front section of a heading machine, and the foam and the water mist are ejected via the nozzle device to suppress the flying dust. The water mist and foam dust settling device has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in use and installation, high dust settling efficiency and the like, and can be widely used for eliminating coal or rock dust generated during drilling operation in coal and mine industries.
assignees: HEBEI ZHONGGONG CORROSION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Highly-efficient water-driven drilling fire gun
abstract_en: The invention provides a highly-efficient water-driven drilling fire gun which comprises a high-pressure cylinder, a hydroturbine, a driven rotating gun, a driven drill bit, a water injection nozzle, a check valve, a pressure charging valve and a gun-holding handle, wherein the front end of the high-pressure cylinder is communicated with the check valve, the back end of the high-pressure cylinder is communicated with the driven rotating gun, the inner side of the high-pressure cylinder is provided with the hydroturbine communicated with the driven rotating gun, the gun-holding handle is fixed on the outer side of the high-pressure cylinder, the pressure charging valve communicated with the side edge of the high-pressure cylinder is in external connection with a supercharging and medicament apparatus, a through hole at the front end of the driven rotating gun is naturally connected with the water injection nozzle and can cooperate with other fire-fighting water injection arrangement, the water injection nozzle is arranged at the inner side of the front end of the driven rotating gun, and the driven drill bit is arranged at the front end of the driven rotating gun and is in a multi-tooth shape, a spiral shape or a circular cut shape. The highly-efficient water-driven drilling fire gun provided by the invention not only can be used in fire disasters to protect the country and people's lives and properties from loss, but also can be used for synchronous drilling and water spraying and synchronous heat reducing and dust controlling in production and construction at ordinary times. Therefore, the highly-efficient water-driven drilling fire gun has the advantages of excellent design performances, multiple functions, a wide application scope, capacity of drilling-through and fire extinguishing, safety, reliability, speed, convenience, high efficiency, energy saving, environmental protection, low manufacturing and application cost and high comprehensive efficiency in usage.
assignees: LIUZHOU JINGYANG ENERGY SAVING TECHNOLOGY RES DEV CO LTD

title_en: Multipurpose simulator installation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multipurpose simulator installation for emergency response training including a module. A first simulator, able to simulate a first type of situation, is located within or about the module, and a second simulator, able to simulate a different type of situation, is also located within or about the module. In use, the installation can be readily transported by transportation means to a desired location and installed in position ready for use. Trainees can receive training hi a plurality of types of simulated situations within or about the module, and the installation can be readily uninstalled and transported by the transportation means to another desired location for further installation and use. The invention also relates to use of two or more modules and to a method of use.
assignees: SEQR MAN SERVICES PTY LTD;WHARTON GRAHAM BRUCE

title_en: A collapsible tower
abstract_en: The invention relates to a collapsible tower for emergency response training, the collapsible tower including a tower and a collapsing means connected to the tower. The collapsing means is configured to change or move the tower between a substantially erect state and a lowered state. In use the collapsible tower can be used for emergency response training in the erect state and the collapsible tower is more readily stored and or transported in the lowered state. The invention also relates to a method of use of a collapsible tower for emergency response training.
assignees: SEQR MAN SERVICES PTY LTD;WHARTON GRAHAM BRUCE

title_en: Dual-slip-pipe high-rise building firefighting rescuer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dual-slip-pipe high-rise building firefighting rescuer simulating a unique function of a spider and having multiple functions of firefighting and rescuing, which aims at solving the difficulty that the firefighting rescuing cannot be carried out because the existing firefighting rescuing facility cannot reach a high-rise building. The invention adopts the design scheme that a lead rail is arranged outside a wall to guide a lifting cabin to be vertically ascended and descended so as to realize the firefighting rescuing purpose. The dual-slip-pipe high-rise building firefighting rescuer adopts a structure that an outer wall triangular support, connecting pins and steel pipes are ingeniously combined to be installed on the outer wall to form a light and firm lifting cabin lead rail. Double concave-type pulley blocks form a connecting claw which is used for joining the lead rail and a lifting cabin. The lifting cabin is automatically lifted by the driving friction force which is produced by intertwining a single-direction suspension rope and a driver driving wheel which is installed on the lifting cabin and pulling the rope through a ground strainer via a motor. The rescuer is vertically installed at a window of a walking staircase, free from occupying the space of a house, and is not only convenient for firemen to pass, but also convenient for rescuing. The rescuer has advantages that the building structure is not damaged, the safety is good, and worry about the power failure can be avoided. Since the closed cabin is adopted, the old, children, the sick and the disabled can take the cabin to leave. The weight is light, heavy wind can be prevented, and the cost is low.

title_en: Altitude environment simulation test cabin for internal combustion power equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of altitude environment simulation test cabin for internal combustion power equipment, comprise cabin body, this cabin body is divided into normal temperature and pressure district and the altitude environment simulation region for placing Devices to test by partition, described normal temperature and pressure district is provided with the dynamometer machine for detecting Devices to test, be provided with the air supply system be communicated with altitude environment simulation region by supply air line, be provided with the first vacuum system and the second vacuum system that are connected with Devices to test exhausr port and altitude environment simulation region respectively by vacuum line.Altitude environment simulation test cabin for internal combustion power equipment of the present invention can simulate the test condition such as infrabar, height epidemic disaster, and according to testing requirements, experimental enviroment condition is controlled, complete the record to experimental enviroment data and controling parameters and process, video monitoring and record process of the test.

title_en: Multipurpose fire-fighting lifesaving blanket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire fighting, in particular to a multipurpose fire-fighting lifesaving blanket; comprises a blanket body, wherein the blanket body is filled with soft water-absorbing materials; a water inlet hose is arranged in the blanket body, branch hoses connected to all directions of the blanket body are arranged on the water inlet hose, and small water injection holes are formed in the branch hoses; when a fire disaster occurs, the water inlet hose of the blanket body of the utility model can be connected with a water source, water is led to the branch hose through the water inlet hose, the water injection small holes arranged on the branch hose rapidly bring the water into the blanket body, the filled soft water absorption material absorbs the water source led from the water injection small holes, so that the blanket body is filled with the water, and the fire source can be extinguished by the blanket body filled with the water; when the fire can not be extinguished, the escaper can cover the body of the person in batch to prevent the body from being burnt by external flame, and the filter has the function of preventing the smoke from invading the respiratory tract to cause suffocation, and the person can drill the fire scene at the highest speed and rush to a safe area to escape after determining the escape route.

title_en: Simulation music candle and candle holder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a simulation music candle which has the advantages of simulation candle burning effect, simulation candle ignition function and music play function and a candle holder. The upper end of the simulation candle is provided with simulation flame; a lower end face of the simulation candle is provided with a music play circuit board; the music play circuit board is provided with a signal conduction contact or a signal plug rod; and the simulation flame is connected with the music play circuit board by using a wire. The simulation music candle and the candle holder have the advantages that 1, the requirement that a music for offering of incense is played at the time when an incense pillar is inserted, 2, not only indoor air pollution but also outdoor fire disaster are not produced when the simulation candle is ignited, and 3, the structure is simple, the manufacturing cost is low and the candle holder can be repeatedly used.

title_en: Self-traverse evolution-based three-dimensional mining stress-pressure analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-traverse evolution-based three-dimensional mining stress-pressure analysis method which is used for endowing an attribute class and a body structure class to a ground exploration spatial point so as to enable the ground exploration spatial point to carry out self-traverse to search for spatial difference value points of the same type of attribute class to be filled as geologic bodies of the same type. The method comprises the following steps of: (1) data acquisition; (2), geometry obtaining; (3) spline curve processing; and (4) data measurement and calculation processing. According to the self-traverse evolution-based three-dimensional mining stress-pressure analysis method, the design and management problems of water disaster prevention, gob arrangement and exploration process are solved by simulating the occurrence of new crushed zones and the change on rock mass structures caused by the engineering external force relation during mining engineering process, and a user can also endow other traverse attribute classes defined by self to established geologic bodies according to demands. The method has wide use and can be applied to fields such as geology, hydrology, mining and the like needing three-dimensional spatial analysis and resource management.
assignees: BEIJING TDTK TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Practice training device for intelligent firefighting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a practice training device for an intelligent firefighting system. The practice training device comprises a support and further comprises a detector, a fire display plate, a manual alarm button, a fire alarm controller, an input-output module, an elevated water tank, a firefighting water tank, a pressure gauge, a hydraulic alarm bell, a glass ball water spraying nozzle, a wet alarm valve, a firefighting tangential belt, a firefighting pump and a spray pump which are mounted in the support. The practice training device for the intelligent firefighting system has the advantages that devices of the intelligent firefighting system are integrated in a small space, the structure of a real intelligent firefighting system is simulated, and the device can met the requirements of multiple persons on principle learning and operation practice training of the firefighting system can be met for multiple times; practice training of the practice training device for the intelligent firefighting system is available for multiple practical trainees at the same time, and the device is high in directness and convenient to operate; and equipment on demand is provided for universities to set up intelligent practical training courses for majors such as electrical automation, and manual operation capability of students can be improved.

title_en: Method for setting picture collection terminal of dangerous sites based on public network platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for setting a picture collection terminal of dangerous sites based on a public network platform, which comprises the following steps: completing the regulating steps of at least one high-definition video camera; respectively arranging a video signal encoder connected with the output end of simulation video signals of a video camera, a memory card, a digital signal processor, a terminal real-time clock, a terminal power supply, a terminal data bus and a data picture module on a main board of a picture collection terminal; and then respectively connecting the encoder with the memory card, the digital signal processor, the terminal real-time clock, the terminal power supply and the terminal data bus, wherein the terminal data bus is further respectively connected with the digital signal processor, the data picture module and the digital signal processor; the other two ends of the data picture module are respectively connected with the terminal real-time clock and a data storage unit; and the terminal power supply is respectively connected with the video signal encoder, the storage card, the digital signal processor and the terminal real-time clock. The terminal snaps onsite pictures in a JEPG format at a set time interval through a DSP (Digital Signal Processor) microprocessor and a video module set and a wireless communication module, and sends the pictures to a disaster preventing server in the public network through a GPRS (General Packet Radio Service) wireless network.

title_en: Temperature sensing detector on-line detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a temperature sensing detector on-line detection device. An employed technical scheme is that the temperature sensing detector on-line detection device comprises a shell, an installation seat which is in the shell and is used for installing a detector to be detected, a temperature monitoring part used for detecting the temperature in the shell, a temperature rising and temperature adjustment part used for simulating a fire disaster temperature rising condition, and an alarming part used for completing signal feedback, the detector to be detected is connected with the alarming part, and a power supply supplies power for the alarming part. The temperature sensing detector on-line detection device has the advantages that the device is a specialized temperature sensing fire disaster detector detection device, when in use, the temperature detector is placed on the installation seat, and as long as the detector gives an alarm within a set time, it is proved that the detector is qualified. The detection device has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, low cost and fast detection speed, especially the time used by a single detector is effectively shortened, and the device is suitable for the on-line detection of the temperature sensing detector before the detector leaves the factory.
assignees: SHANDONG ZHONGHAI PUBLIC SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Solar energy mobile power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to field of solar energy, especially a kind of solar energy mobile power station.Solar energy mobile power station, comprises, lighting system, vehicle-mounted mobile system and control system, described lighting system, comprise, plane skylight (01), follow the tracks of assembly (02), foot rest system (03), twin pneumatic operated valve B(1), push rod B(2), connect supporting (3), spirit level (4), bearing (5), support spin-block (6), chute and slide block (7), push rod A(8), pneumatic operated valve A(9), " L " frame A(10), helical gear (11), cross frame (12), support bracket bolt (13), assembly seat (14), vernier knob (15), assembly bolt (16), foot rest connects block (17), locking button (18), " L " frame B(19), push rod C(20), reinforce drill rod (20 '), plate body (41) and foot rest (42), described lighting system tool real-time tracking sun optical axis and function that is detachable, combination, described control system is placed in the automobile of vehicle-mounted mobile system, solar energy mobile power station is applicable to military affairs, scientific investigation, nomadic, disaster relief field power and heat supply.

title_en: Mine system model
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine system model. The mine system model is made according to the mine system actual spatial structure by a certain proportion. The mine system model comprises a tunnel model and a facility model. The mine system model is fixed on a pedestal through a plurality of supporting bars. The tunnel model is made by using groove-shaped members. The mine system model further comprises a model instruction nameplate and a compass. The mine system model has a simple structure, the mine system structure is clear and illustrative, and the mine system model can be widely applied to the mine safety production, such as the mine daily production guiding, the mine exercises and drills commanding, mine safety teaching and training, mine emergency disaster rescue commanding, etc.

title_en: Computer-implemented method, program and apparatus for coupling flooding simulation and evacuation simulation in a populated area
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of coupling flooding simulation and evacuation simulation in a populated area, comprising inputting input geometry representing physical structures in a populated area; processing the input geometry to provide modelling geometry; creating a computational fluid dynamics CFD model suitable for CFD analysis from the modelling geometry; creating an evacuation model suitable for population evacuation analysis from the modelling geometry.

title_en: Firefighting training apparatus
abstract_en: A firefighting training apparatus having a trailer capable of being towed by a vehicle; an elevated platform supported above the trailer and presenting a simulated rooftop; and a raising mechanism, the raising mechanism attached between the elevated platform and the trailer, the raising mechanism supporting the elevated platform at a desired pitch.

title_en: Composite fire sensor device based on image for active evacuation and rescue and system using the same
title_ko: 능동적 대피 및 구조를 위한 영상 기반의 복합 화재 감시 장치 및 이를 이용한 영상 기반 화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An image based complex fire sensing device and an image based fire monitoring system using the same are provided to be utilized for evacuation guide and structure based on the number of people distribution data. CONSTITUTION: A camera controller(112) obtains an image from an internal camera module(111a) or an external camera device(111b). An image compressing part(113) encodes the image. A fire sign sensing part(114) senses a fire sign based on the image. A group analyzing part(115) distinguishes the number of people within a group which is acknowledged based on the image. A situation data generating part(116) creates situation data by gather up image data which is encoded, fire sign data, or group data. A communication interface(117a) transfers the situation data to a gateway or receives an evacuation inducing command from the gateway. [Reference numerals] (111a) Internal camera module; (111b) External camera device; (112) Camera controller; (113) Image compressing part; (114) Fire sign sensing part; (1141) Storing part; (115) Group analyzing part; (116) Situation data generating part; (117a) Communication I/F; (117b) Short range communication I/F; (118) Composite sensor controller; (119) Local evacuation inducing processing part
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 화재 감시 시스템은 게이트웨이, 적어도 하나의 복합 화재 감시 장치 및 관제 서버를 포함할 수 있다.  게이트웨이는 상황 데이터를 수신하여 상방 전송하고 대피 유도 명령을 수신하여 하방 전송할 수 있다.  복합 화재 감시 장치는 내장 카메라 모듈 또는 외부 카메라로부터 영상을 취득하는 카메라 제어부, 취득한 영상을 부호화하는 영상 압축부, 영상에 기초하여 화재 징후를 감지하는 화재 징후 감지부, 영상을 기초로 인식된 군집 내에서 사람들의 수를 식별하는 군집 분석부, 부호화된 영상 정보, 화재 징후 정보 또는 군집 정보를 종합하여 상황 데이터를 생성하는 상황 데이터 생성부와, 상황 데이터를 게이트웨이로 상방 전송하거나 게이트웨이로부터 하방 전송되는 대피 유도 명령을 수신하기 위한 통신 인터페이스를 각각 포함할 수 있다.  관제 서버는 게이트웨이를 통해 상방 전송된 상황 데이터들로부터 영상 정보, 화재 징후 정보 또는 군집 정보를 추출하고, 관리자의 지시, 화재 징후 정보 또는 군집 정보에 기초한 정량적 위험 분석(QRA) 내지 대피 시나리오 DB의 참조 결과에 의해 결정되는 대피 시나리오에 따라 대피 유도 명령을 생성하며, 게이트웨이를 통해 대피 유도 명령을 하방 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: Multifunctional flood-fighting blockage rescue boat
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional flood-fighting blockage rescue boat, comprising a boat body and a bogie control cabin. The multifunctional flood-fighting blockage rescue boat is characterized in that a front drilled pile, a middle drilled pile and a rear drilled pile are installed at the front, the middle and the rear of the boat body respectively, and penetrate through the boat body; a front driver, a middle driver and a rear driver are arranged on the boat body, and arranged at the outer sides of the front drilled pile, the middle drilled pile and the rear drilled pile respectively; and flood-intercepting plates capable of moving up and down are arranged at the both sides of the boat body. The technology according to the invention can be used for flood-fighting and closure disaster relief assistance and protecting the country and the lives and the properties of people from loss, and can be used for peacetime production and cargo transportation; and the multifunctional flood-fighting blockage rescue boat has the advantages of being excellent in performance, various in function, rapid in flood-intercepting, safe and reliable, low in production and use costs, and the like, and are extremely obvious in comprehensive economic benefits and social benefits in case of being popularized and used.
assignees: LIUZHOU JINGYANG ENERGY SAVING TECHNOLOGY RES DEV CO LTD

title_en: Demonstration device for urban public security multi-disaster secondary derivation coupling simulation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a demonstration device for urban public security multi-disaster secondary derivation coupling simulation, which belongs to the technical field of public security simulation and comprises three parts, namely a dynamic sand table, a projection unit and a control system. An urban model is arranged on the dynamic sand table. A movable lift and a vibration instrument are arranged inside the dynamic sand table. A detecting unit is arranged on the dynamic sand table. The projection unit is divided into three parts, namely a dynamic sand table projector, a three-dimensional animation projector and a horizontal projection screen. By means of a method based on three-screen linkage by combining a physical model and a virtual three-dimensional image, demonstration of experiments and value simulation results of happening and developing rules under the conditions of urban multiple emergency events and coupling of the events is achieved. Dynamic demonstration of links of disaster field simulation reappearance, monitoring, information delivering, information access, predicting, pre-warning and decision control and the like are achieved. Visual presentation means are provided for the disaster reappearance, risk evaluation, scene deduction, pre-arranged planning practice, education and training and the like.

title_en: Drilling cutting method impact dangerousness detection automation analyzing system and method for coal mines
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coal mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning and particularly relates to a rock burst dangerousness automation analyzing system based on a drilling cutting method. The system comprises a weighing device, a macro phenomenon data collecting device, a data transmission device, a data collecting device and special data processing software. According to the system and the method, based on the drilling cutting method which is a rock burst dangerousness detection method, a modern communication technology, a computer technology and an automation technology are used, the macro phenomena that the pulverized coal quantity per meter is counted, coal guns, crown drills and jamming of drills are recorded are achieved, and intelligentized evaluation of impact dangerousness in drilling areas is achieved. The disadvantages that during a process in which the drilling cutting method is used for determining the impact dangerousness, the dangerousness is high, the workload is heavy and the human factor is large are overcome, and the detection process is safe, intelligent, reliable and relaxing.
assignees: BEIJING ANKE XINGYE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Video analyzing system based on video image analyzing and flame-detecting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire detection device based on video image analysis. The fire detection device comprises an acquiring system for acquiring video images, a video image analyzing system and a fire warning system, wherein the video image analyzing system comprises a video image preprocessing module, a moving target identification module, a flame pixel identification module and a fire disaster judging module. The video image preprocessing module comprises a real camera system, a virtual camera system and a video processing module, wherein the real camera system comprises a real camera, a first drive program module and a first DirectShow assembly, the virtual camera system comprises a virtual camera simulated by utilizing a dispersion shifted fiber (DSF) frame, a second drive program module and a second DirectShow assembly, and the video processing module reads data from the first DirectShow assembly, performs special effect processing of the data and transmits processed data to the virtual camera. The video analyzing system based on the video image analyzing and flame-detecting device has the advantages of being high in flame identification accuracy and wide in application range.
assignees: ZHENJIANG SHIGUWEN INTELLIGENT SYSTEM DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating performance of large space building smoke controlling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating performance of a large space building smoke controlling system and relates to the field of fire safety and fire engineering. The method provided by the invention comprises following steps of (1) installing a smoke controlling system; (2) determining a hot smoke test initial scheme; (3) conducting a numerical simulation to the test scheme, and judging whether the initial scheme is reasonable according to the numerical simulation data or not, if not, re-adjusting the test scheme until the scheme is reasonable; (4) setting up a test platform in the field and conducting the hot smoke test; and (5) obtaining test data and judging the performance of the smoke controlling system according to the test data. The method provided by the invention is mainly used for designing the large space building smoke controlling system and evaluating the working performance, can further be used for judging logic rationality of linkage control of large space building fire fighting system; judging working effects and effectiveness of a fire automatic alarming system, an emergency lighting system, and an evacuation indicating system; and judging smoke control performance of an evacuation exit and security of people evacuation.
assignees: SICHUAN FIRE RES INST OF MINISTRY OF PUBLIC SCURITY

title_en: Multi-target distribution and flight path planning method for multiple rescue helicopters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target distribution and flight path planning method for multiple rescue helicopters, which relates to the technical field of aviation emergency rescue. The method comprises the steps of evaluating aviation rescue task execution feasibility, conducting disaster area map image processing, obtaining a feasibility matrix through the evaluation of the rescue task execution feasibility, taking the feasibility matrix as a coefficient matrix for a solution matrix Xij, solving distribution results according to tasks of different quantities of the rescue helicopters and target points through a Hungary algorithm, obtaining a flight path solution space by extracting a safety zone topological structure by adopting an image processing method and morphological characteristics, obtaining the shortest path in the flight path solution space by a heuristic A* search algorithm, combining the results of multi-target distribution for multiple rescue helicopters, forming an emergency plan for rescue task execution of the helicopters, and calling a Google Earth flight simulation API (Application Program Interface) to demonstrate the emergency rescue plan and making preflight preparation, so as to improve the efficiency and safety of the aviation emergency rescue. The method is simple, the time complexity is low, the flight path planning process is visual, and the result is distinct.

title_en: Tower weak component location method based on finite element dynamic analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tower weak component location method based on finite element dynamic analysis and belongs to the field of online monitoring of disaster prevention and reduction of a power transmission line. The method includes building a three-dimensional simulation model according to a tower structure, utilizing an orthogonal test method to select a load set, simulating all possible dynamic loads in operation of the tower, conducting finite element dynamic calculation, obtaining axial stress ratio of tower components according to simulation results under each load combination and selecting weak components according to the axial stress ratio. The tower weak components can be accurately located by means of the method. The method can be used for online monitoring of disaster prevention and reduction of the power transmission line and is capable of directly conducting effective early warning on effect failure of the tower components.

title_en: A kind of appraisal procedure of section transmission line tower foundation side slope Rainfall Disaster risk
abstract_en: The methods of risk assessment of section transmission line tower foundation side slope Rainfall Disaster: the controlling factor obtaining pole and tower foundation side slope Rainfall Disaster risk, and it is quantized and normalized; With disaster statistics and rainmaking slope erosion test findings for training sample, set up the mapping relations of controlling factor and heavy rain landslide accident rate with modified BP neural network, obtain risk assessment mathematical model; To calculate basis, all fronts side slope mean storm landslide accident rate value of gained for reference value, obtain each side slope relative to heavy rain risk of landslip grade completely, the weight vectors of each section to different risk class side slope number percent is obtained by improvement level analytical calculation program, consider that each risk class side slope is different on the impact of Rainfall Disaster risk, continue to adopt improvement level analytical calculation program computation to obtain different risk class side slope to the weight vectors of Rainfall Disaster, each layer weight vectors synthesis is obtained the risk evaluation result of each section from top to bottom by rear computing machine.

title_en: Emergency power and water supply using solar
abstract_en: The utility model provides an emergency power and water supply using solar and belongs to the fields of achieving electrical power and water supply. The emergency power and water supply using solar comprises a power unit and a water supply, wherein the power unit provides power to storage batteries, an inverter and a water pump using a solar panel and the water supply sends water in water box into a water purification system through the water pump. The water after being purified by the water purification system is sent to the water faucet. When emergency circumstances such as interruption of power and water supply resulting from natural disaster appear, the emergency power and water supply using solar provided people with emergency power and water and provides people in field working, emergency rescue and field military Training with a temporary power and water supply.

title_en: Dynamic real-time monitoring device of pore water osmotic pressure
abstract_en: A dynamic real-time monitoring device of pore water osmotic pressure comprises a grating osmotic pressure sensor and a monitoring instrument. The monitoring instrument comprises a grating wavelength demodulation portion, a microprocessor control portion, a wireless launch portion and a power supply portion. The grating wavelength demodulation portion is connected with the grating osmotic pressure sensor, and optical signals of the grating osmotic pressure sensor are converted into digital signals. The microprocessor control portion is responsible for functions of data acquisition, storage and display. The power supply portion controls each circuit power supply to open and close. The wireless launch portion monitors collected data and sends the data to a control center through a global system for mobile communications (GSM) network. The pore water osmotic pressure dynamic real-time monitoring device achieves automatic monitoring on the pore water osmotic pressure such as drilling holes, dams and pipelines, saves labor cost of labor operation, improves measurement accuracy and accuracy degree, effectively achieves 24-hour all-day monitoring of pore water osmotic pressure situations in a severe environment, and provides data supports for monitoring and early warning of geological disasters.

title_en: Tower pole icing disaster risk prediction method based on safety margin
abstract_en: The invention provides a tower pole icing disaster risk prediction method based on the safety margin. With the method, finite element numerical value simulation and data regression analysis are combined; a finite element method is adopted to build a 1:1 overhead transmission line tower pole coupling model; the main stressed factor of a line under various static conditions is comprehensively considered; simulation calculation is carried out to various operation working conditions of an icing line model; and on the basis, a simulation result is subjected to regression analysis and data fitting by the concept of the safety margin to obtain the safety margin curve of a power transmission tower line system so as to obtain the safety level of the power transmission tower line system. The method disclosed by the invention belongs to the safety evaluation field of the power transmission tower line system, the icing and tower falling risk of the power transmission tower line system can be solved, the safety margin range of the tower line system is given in real time so as to determine the line icing risk level at present, a basis is given for formulating an icing-proof transformation scheme, the formulation principle of the icing-proof transformation scheme is determined, and the operation reliability of the power transmission tower line system is improved.

title_en: Emergency escape biological protection head cover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency escape biological protection head cover which comprises a transparent cover body, a view window, a fixed head belt, a mouth and nose cover, high-efficiency air filters, an interphone and a neck portion fixing ring, wherein the view window and the transparent cover body are integrated in a heat seal mode, and the mouth and nose cover is clamped on the high-efficiency air filters on both sides of a head cover after the transparent cover body is sealed in a heat mode. The interphone is arranged at the front end of the mouth and nose cover, the fixing head belt is connected on both sides of the mouth and nose cover, and the neck portion fixing ring is arranged at the bottom of the transparent cover body in a heat seal mode. The emergent escape biological protection head cover can provide small, portable, safe and comfortable biological protective articles for workers who probably suffer from biological pollution of a hospital for infectious diseases, emergency response, disaster assistance, epidemic prevention, frontier defense safety inspection, and also provide respiratory protection of emergent escape for common people who do not accept professional training in the case of facing sudden biological risk.

title_en: Practical training device of intelligent and automatic fire alarm system for buildings
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of experimental and practical training equipment and particularly relates to a practical training device of an intelligent and automatic fire alarm system for buildings, which comprises a practical training platform, a practical training layer positioned at the upper part of the practical training platform, a medium-density fiber board layer positioned at the middle part of the practical training platform, and a cabinet layer positioned at the lower part of the practical training platform. The practical training device is characterized in that the practical training layer consists of a firefighting linkage module, a firefighting alarm module and a firefighting control center module. The firefighting linkage module is positioned at the middle part of the practical training layer. The firefighting alarm module is positioned on one side of the practical training layer. The firefighting control center module is positioned on the other side of the practical training layer. The back of the practical training platform is provided with a protective cover. According to the technical scheme of the utility model, the practical training device is optimized in size so as to reduce the occupation area thereof. Meanwhile, the integrated training device combines a plurality of subsystem modules together for practical training, with consideration to each of the plurality of subsystems at the same time.
assignees: SHENZHEN SONTAHITEC INDUSTRY DEV CO LTD

title_en: System and method for dynamic simulation of emergency response plans
abstract_en: A method to electronically create, store, validate, exercise with and view dynamic Emergency Response Plans (ERP) is provided. The system employs a local computer-based constructive simulation application ( 100, 200 ) or a server-based constructive simulation tool ( 300 ) that stores all information related to and ERP in a database ( 600 ) in a manner such that it can be visually edited ( 400 ), dynamically shown on screen ( 500 ), stored and transmitted to other users in a self-contained file format ( 600 ), and can be used in a networked exercise ( 550 ) where players can take control of assigned entities within the simulation of the ERP.

title_en: Apparatus for fire extinguishing equipment education simulator
title_ko: 교육용 시뮬레이션 소방설비 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A firefighting facilities simulation system for education is provided to promote understanding of firefighting facilities actually installed on a building and efficient operation on site. CONSTITUTION: A firefighting facilities simulation system for education includes a sprinkler chamber made of a transparent material for the inside to be visible from the outside; wet and dry sprinkler pipes(200,300) of which one end is inserted into a sprinkler chamber, the other end is extended to the outside, and the one end is equipped with a sprinkler; an alarm valve(400) connected to the wet sprinkler pipe; a pre-action valve connected to the dry sprinkler pipe; a booster pump unit(600) pressurizing water into the wet and dry sprinkler pipe; and a control unit(700) equipped with multiple buttons and levers.
abstract_ko: 교육용 시뮬레이션 소방설비 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 교육용 시뮬레이션 소방설비 장치는 실내에 구비되고 스프링 클러의 작동원리에 대한 교육을 위해 소정의 크기로 이루어지며 내부 영역이 투시 가능하도록 투명 재질로 이루어진 스프링 클러 챔버; 일단이 상기 스프링 클러 챔버의 내측으로 삽입 배치되고, 타단이 외측으로 연장되며 단부에 스프링 클러가 구비된 습식 및 건식 스프링 클러 배관; 상기 습식 스프링 클러 배관과 연결된 알람 밸브; 상기 건식 스프링 클러 배관과 연결된 프리액션 밸브; 상기 알람 밸브와 프리액션 밸브의 작동에 따라 상기 습식 및 건식 스프링 클러 배관으로 물을 가압하기 위해 구비된 가압펌프유닛; 및 상기 가압펌프유닛과 알람 밸브 및 프리액션 밸브의 작동 상태를 조절하기 위해 다수개의 버튼 및 레버가 구비된 제어유닛을 포함한다.

title_en: Modularized ship fire-fighting control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ship fire-fighting control system based on a modularized design, and specifically relates to a function control system formed by sub-modules obtained by respectively packaging signal monitoring and processing functions. The system provided by the invention comprises a power supply module, a control module, an input module, a power module, a fan-oil module, and a display module. The control module, the input module, the power module, the fan-oil module, and the display module are connected to a power bus controlled by the power supply module. All modules are connected with a CAN bus, such that a network is formed; the input module is connected with a fire signal detecting device. The power module is connected with an extinguishing gas discharging device, a training gas discharging device, an evacuation alarm device, and an extinguishing discharging alarm device. The fan-oil module is connected with a fan and an oil pump. The display module is connected with a color LCD screen, buttons, and a buzzer. Flexible combination can be adopted according to different fire extinguishing ranges, such that cost can be effectively controlled, and fire control requirements of different ship types can be satisfied.

title_en: Uav training simulator and the real-time simulation method and system for interworking
title_ko: 실시간 무인첩보기 영상 시뮬레이터와 훈련시뮬레이션의 연동 방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A link method of a real-time unmanned spy plane image simulator and a training simulation and a system thereof are provided to uplift a fighting power of a group by solving all limitations for real-time link between a simulation and a simulator. CONSTITUTION: A UAV engine processor(10) comprises a UAV damage processing terminal(11), a troops data for transmitting terminal(12) generating the information of a fixed object and a moving object, and a UAV data receiving terminal(13) for processing the current location information of UAV. A UAV operator(20) transmits information processed in a UAV engine processor to a UAV control processor set through a computer network. A UAV operator controls the direction and angle of a UAV sensor and the screen size which can be zoomed in and out with a control and adjustment device(40) by determining a rule displayed through a UAV control processor. A UAV operator displays information which processes unit information in the screen size by a UAV engine processor on a UAV screen display part and inputs a configuration and connection information connecting with a UAV engine processor by using a setting part(24). An enlarged image display terminal(50) transmits the image of a UAV screen display part through a remote image transmission group and displays the transmitted image. [Reference numerals] (10) UAV system; (100) Main model; (11) Developing a UAV damage processing terminal[citing existing information model logic]; (12) Transmitting GT[corps information] - generating fixed object, moving object information; (13) Receiving UAV information(such as location information); (AA) Command station; (BB) Image communication; (C1,C2,C3) Additional information; (D1,D2,DE) UAV state information; (EE) UAV simulation group
abstract_ko:
시뮬레이터는 실시간에 변화되는 데이터를 수신받고 그 처리를 영상을 통해 훈련자가 판단과 처리를 수행하고, 실시간 처리 결과를 상호 연동되어 있는 시뮬레이터 또는 시뮬레이션에 전송해야 한다.  
이를 위해, 시뮬레이터가 처리하는 데이터만을 재가공하여 부대(객체) 전송에 부하량을 감소시키는 방법을 적용하고, 감지기 범위내의 3차원 지형을  실시간 처리하면서 각종 실제 전투상황과 동일한 요소로 표시 할 수 있는  시스템을 구성한다.  
실시간 데이터 연동을 위해 시뮬레이션에서 처리되는 실시간 부대(객체)단위 정보를 개별 객체단위로 정보처리 버퍼기능을 적용하고, 처리되는 데이터를 시뮬레이터에서 필요한 정보로 재처리하여 시뮬레이터가 필요로 하는 모든 정보를 시뮬레이션으로부터 수신 할 수 있도록 구성한다.  
시뮬레이션 부분에서는 별도의 부대객체의 모든 행위가 실시간 지향이나 이벤트 드리븐 설계로 된 단위 객체의 실시간 묘사를 처리하도록 하고, 지휘반응 시간(부대이동시 준비시간, 방어 시 준비시간 등)이 고려될 수 있도록  실체계와의 연계성을 갖도록 하며, 전장환경은 국지기상 적용이 되어도 해당 비행체의 기상으로 전환하여 적용되어 각종 논리가 적용될 수 있게 한다. 
시스템의 구성으로는  UAV피해처리단과 고정객체 및 이동객체의 정보를 생성하는 부대정보송신단, UAV의 현재 위치정보를 처리하는 UAV정보수신단을 포함하는 UAV엔진처리부를 두고, 상기 UAV엔진처리부에서 처리된 정보를 컴퓨터 네트워크를 통해 설정된 UAV통제처리부로 전송하고, 상기 UAV통제처리부는 표시되는 규칙을 정하여 통제조정기로 UAV감지기의 방향과 각도 및 줌인, 줌아웃한 화면크기를 조절하고, 그 화면크기에 있는 부대정보를 UAV엔진처리부에서 처리한 정보를 UAV화면표시부에 표시하며 환경설정과 UAV엔진처리부와의 접속정보를 입력하는 설정조작부의 UAV운영부을 구성한다.   
또한, UAV화면표시부의 영상만을 원격영상전송단을 통해 외부로 전송하고, 다수의 확대영상표시단을 통해 영상을 표시한다.  
 이를 통해, 실전장에서와 같은 환경으로 묘사되는 부대(객체)정보로 하여금 대부대모델로 워게임만을 진행하고 그 결과로 나온 정보로 상황조치하는 훈련으로만 진행하는 것을 실시간의 영상을 실제 전장에서 운영하는 장비와 동일한 구성과 같이 조작하여 그 결과를 확인하고 이를 훈련에 직접적으로 반영할 수 있게 되었다.  
시뮬레이션과 시뮬레이터간의 실시간 연동에 제한사항을 모두 해결할 수있어 유사한 개발과제에 신기술 지원이 강화되며 각 훈련체계를 연동시키는 기술적 성과와 실전훈련과 동일한 효과를 얻을 수 있어 군의 전투력 증강에도 큰 효과가 있을 것이다.
assignees: REPUBLIC OF KOREA THE ARMY CHIEF OF STAFF

title_en: Well drilling wellhead wearing bush taking out device
abstract_en: Disclosed is a well drilling wellhead wearing bush taking out device. A diversion pipe extends to a square well. A screen pipe is installed on the lower portion of the diversion pipe. A nozzle is installed inside the diversion pipe. The tail end of the nozzle penetrates through out of the diversion pipe and is connected with a buffer pipe which is connected with a high pressure outlet of a slush pump. A fixing device is used for fixing the buffer pipe and the diversion pipe into a whole. The slush pump pumps high pressure slush into the buffer pipe, the slush is ejected at high speed through the nozzle, external voltage of the nozzle is enabled to be lowered, the slush which falls to the ground in the square well can flow to the nozzle, is mixed with the slush ejected through the nozzle, and is supercharged. The slush which falls to the ground and the slush ejected through the nozzle together flow from the diversion pipe to a big circulation pool or a vibration screen. The well drilling wellhead wearing bush taking out device has the advantages of being capable of recovering the slush in the square well without the need of an electric pump, free from problems that sparks are produced when an electric switch is closed or opened, set fire to gas coming out of the square well, and fire disasters or explosions are produced, free from safe accidents, small in the number of adopted equipment, free from moving components when the slush is recovered, long in service life and convenient to use and manage.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEMICAL;YELLOW RIVER DRILLING CO LTD SINOPEC SHENGLI PETROLEUM ADMINISTRATION BUREAU

title_en: Fire disaster fire source position and intensity estimating system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire disaster fire source position and intensity estimating system. The fire disaster fire source position and intensity estimating system comprises multiple sets of estimating devices, wherein each estimating device set is respectively arranged in a sub-area of a region of a building structure, the estimating device comprises multiple monitoring devices and calculation storage devices, the monitoring device is used for detecting environmental parameters and acquiring fire disaster monitoring information, and the calculation storage devices is used for recording static structure information and dynamic structure information, simulating and predicting fire disaster simulation information, carrying out communication with the adjacent calculation storage devices and carrying out partial estimating of the fire source position and intensity in a paired sub-areas of a present area and the adjacent area. The calculation devices of the multiple sub-areas form a distributed network to share the fire disaster monitoring information, the static structure information and the dynamic structure information and cooperatively process full-scale estimation values of the fire source position and intensity. By employing the distributed control structure, calculation efficiency, robustness and expansion capability of the fire source position and intensity estimating system are improved.

title_en: System and method for rapidly predicting and estimating geological disaster surge
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for rapidly predicting and estimating geological disaster surge. The system comprises a pretreatment module, a calculation and analysis module and a post-treatment module; and the method comprises a pretreatment step, a calculation and analysis step and a post-treatment step. The defects that the resource amount required by calculation is large, the time consumption is high and long-range swell propagation and climbing is difficultly simulated in the prior art are overcome, and the reservoir slump surge disaster early warning range and risk management evaluation can be rapidly and reasonably determined.
assignees: YIN YUEPING;HUANG BOLIN;LIU GUANGNING;WANG SHICHANG;CHEN XIAOTING

title_en: Sub-vertical shaft used for shortening ventilation network flow path
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sub-vertical shaft used for shortening a ventilation network flow path. The sub-vertical shaft belongs to the field of colliery ventilating device. The sub-vertical shaft used for shortening ventilation network flow path comprises a vertical shaft (1), a return air inclined shaft (2), an upper layer main roadway (5) and a lower layer main roadway (3). The sub-vertical shaft used for shortening a ventilation network flow path is characterized in that the vertical shaft (1) is communicated with the upper layer main roadway (5) and the lower layer main roadway (3) from an earth surface in a vertical mode. A return air adit (4) is approximately paralleled with a horizontal plane and vertically communicated with the upper layer main roadway (5). A drilling room (10) is arranged on the middle piece of the return air inclined shaft (2) and is paralleled to the return air adit (4). A number one raise shaft (8) and a number two raise shaft (9) are communicated with the drilling room (10) and the return air adit (4) in a vertical mode. The sub-vertical shaft used for shortening a ventilation network flow path optimizes a mine ventilation system, shortens the ventilation network, saves electric charge, and improves the work efficiency of a main fan. The sub-vertical shaft is strong in stability of the ventilation system, and the mine anti-disaster ability is enhanced.
assignees: BUCUN COAL MINE OF ZIBO MINING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Assembly type mining area roadway layout and water gushing-out disaster simulation model
abstract_en: The utility model provides an assembly type mining area roadway layout and water gushing-out disaster simulation model, and relates to a teaching model for the mining major. The simulation model is good in perspectivity, can simulate the mining area roadway layout and the water gushing-out disaster scenes, and improves the learning interest of students. A mining-area upper vehicle yard model, a mining-area middle-upper vehicle yard model, a mining-area middle-lower vehicle yard model, and a mining-area lower vehicle yard model are sequentially from up to bottom connected obliquely; the high water source and pumping equipment are connected via a first pipeline; the pumping equipment and a low water sump are connected via a second pipeline; the low water sump and a lower-track uphill simulation tube are connected via a third pipeline; the lower-track uphill simulation tube and the high water source are connected via a fourth pipeline; a first electrically controlled valve is mounted on the first pipeline; a second electrically controlled valve is mounted on the third pipeline; a third electrically controlled valve is mounted on the fourth pipeline; and water level sensors are respectively mounted on the lower-track uphill simulation tube, the high water source 5 and the low water sump. The assembly type mining area roadway layout and water gushing-out disaster simulation model can be applicable to teaching in the mining major.

title_en: Preventive Activated Sludge Microlife Interpreter
abstract_en: The invention is a portable laboratory instrument that incorporates software designed to record laboratory tests results to analyze the biomass of a Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) using an Activated Sludge Process. The software uses the values entered by the user and its data bank/algorithms to determine the health/age of the biomass. It produces an interpretation of the collected data, and delivers a final set of instructions based on the overall health of the Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP). The final result is delivered using simple instructions and color coded lights for an easy and quick interpretation. Its use does not require extensive training in the field of wastewater treatment. Its purpose is to prevent environmental disasters by detecting current/future biological problems.
assignees: GARCIA JAVIER D CARLO;SMITH TRAVIS WILLIAM

title_en: Dry sorbent injection during steady-state conditions in dry scrubber
title_ko: 건식 세정 장치의 정상-상태 조건 하에서의 건조 흡수제의 분사방법
abstract_ko: 정상-상태 조건 하에서 방출 가스 레벨의 감소방법은 건식 세정 장치의 탈황 시스템용을 개시하고 있다. 건조 수산화 칼슘 분말은 가스 유로에 분사되어 분무 건조 흡수 장치 내에 흐른다. 얻어진 슬러리는 집진기 내에 필터 백에 적층된다. 이것은 연소 공정에서 탈황이 예상보다 일찍 일어날 수 있는 분무 건조 흡수 장치가 달리 작동될 수 있는 것보다 특히 주위 온도에서 냉각 보일러의 시동 중에 저온에서 행해질 수 있다. 보일러의 작동은 다양한 작동 시나리오에 따라 백업, 메이크업, 감소, 또는 증가될 수 있다.

title_en: Cultivation method of millet and soybean
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cultivation method of millet and soybean. The cultivation method of the millet and the soybeans combines a millet soybean strip planting technique, a millet membrane-mulching hole sowing cultivation technique and a soy membrane drilling cultivation technique to form a new planting pattern of high production and high efficiency. The basic method of the cultivation method of the millet and the soybeans is to interplant soybeans in millet membrane-mulching hole sowing strips. The cultivation method of the millet and the soybeans is obvious in production increasing and efficiency increasing effects, and convenient to operate, and all technological procedures can be easily completed with the help of existing agricultural machinery. The cultivation method of the millet and the soybeans can fully utilize natural resources to a large extent, improve the capability of resisting drought and other natural disasters, improve per unit area yield, and guarantee the economic benefit of planting millet and soybean crops of peasants.

title_en: Reconstruction method for water-proof shell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconstruction method for a water-proof shell. The distribution condition of aquifers around an ore body is determined; reconstruction of the water-proof shell is performed in the aquifers; and a complete continuous water-proof key layer is formed around the ore body. The required thickness of a water-proof top plate is calculated in combination with an actual engineering condition and a mechanical principle. Whether damage occurs is judged by simulating water-proof shell stress, plastic zone and settlement distribution condition by utilizing Flac3d under an ore body mining condition. In engineering implementation, detection holes are firstly formed in the aquifers and positions of karst caves and fissures are determined by using a geological survey instrument, connection roadways are constructed in the aquifers around a middle section, and drilling and grouting underground chambers are constructed on parts of the roadway close to the fissures of the aquifers. Grouting holes are rationally arranged in the roadways and the underground chambers and encrypted grouting is performed, and finally, inter-hole CT (Computed Tomography) fluoroscopy is performed to check the grouting and water plugging effect. According to the method, a mine floor mining environment is reconstructed, so that mine floor mining is performed safely and efficiently, and geological disasters are effectively reduced.

title_en: Intelligent dynamic disaster risk detection method for mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the detection and early-warning field of dynamic disaster risk in a mine, in particular to an intelligent risk inspection method which is used for detecting rock burst and coal and gas outburst and is based on the drilling cutting method. The intelligent dynamic disaster risk detection method comprises a drilling cutting acquisition method, a drilling cutting weighing method, a data transmission method, a data recording method and a data processing and risk judging method. The risk inspection method, namely the drilling cutting method, based on the rock burst and coal and gas outburst, adopts the modern communication technology, computer technology and the automation technology to realize the automatic counting of coal powder amount per meter and record the macroscopic phenomena of footage, coal burst, crown drilling, suction drilling, drilling sticking and the like in process of the dynamic disaster risk in the mine, so that the intelligentization of the dynamic disaster risk detection process in the mine is realized. The intelligent detection method overcomes the defects such as high risk, high workload and high artificial factor in the dynamic disaster inspection process in a traditional mine and realizes a safe, intelligent, reliable and comfortable detection process.

title_en: Data disaster tolerance drilling method, data disaster tolerance practice device and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of data disaster tolerance drilling method, data disaster tolerance practice device and system, method includes: after triggering replication task, creating the first checking data, whether described first checking data is correct for verifying after database data to be protected copies to the standby end of calamity; Under described triggering; described database data to be protected and described first checking data are copied to the storage array of the standby end of described calamity; with the duplication result according to described first checking data, verify whether the data copied in the storage array of the standby end of described calamity are described database data to be protected. By the checking data of establishment being copied to together with database data to be protected the standby end of calamity; make the standby end of calamity can know whether database data to be protected is copied correctly the standby end of calamity according to the duplication result of checking data, thus ensure that the accuracy of calamity standby end DR test.

title_en: Mine underground three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine underground three-dimensional model, which comprises a bottom plate. A plurality of supporting plates are arranged on the bottom plate. Underground laneway simulating pieces are arranged among the supporting plates. Planar graphs (such as topographic maps, geological maps, hydrologic maps and the like) can be drawn on the bottom plate of the model. A prospecting line profile map positioned corresponding to the positions of prospecting lines can be selectively scribed on the supporting plates. According to the technical scheme of the utility model, due to the adoption of the mine underground three-dimensional model, the mutual relationships among underground laneways, a prospecting line profile map and a topography and geological map, and information on systems related to the laneways (such as a disaster prevention system, a ventilation system, a hoisting system and the like), can be intuitively reflected. Based on the comprehensive analysis of the related information, people can make more scientific commands and decisions in underground mining, while mine safety accidents are reduced.

title_en: Method for plugging exploratory holes above karst caves
