abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for plugging exploratory holes above karst caves. The method includes the steps of manufacturing a soft cup-shaped plug, placing the plug, preparing cement mortar, grouting the cement mortar by grouting the prepared cement mortar into a drill hole via a mortar guide tube till a bed rock surface, lifting the mortar guide tube while grouting the mortar; lifting up the mortar guide tube after the mortar if fully grouted, enabling the cement mortar to solidify for 30 minutes; detecting quality of the mortar sealed hole via heavy dynamic sounding, changing a tapered dynamic probe to a flat-base probe, continuously hammering for 5 times, recording penetration degree; and sealing the hole by covering a soil layer according to the theory of 'soil for soil, and sand for sand' after the sealed hole is detected to be qualified. The method for plugging the exploratory holes above the karst caves is capable of solving the problem about secondary geological disaster like karst ground depression caused by the exploratory hole, and filling the blank in the field of domestic geotechnical engineering investigation.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST OF SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN AND RES CO LTD;CHANGJIANG GEOTECHNICAL ENGINEERING CORP

title_en: Underground-inflated liquefied foundation treating device and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground-inflated liquefied foundation treating device and a construction method. The underground-inflated liquefied foundation treating device comprises air compressors, inflating tubes, earthquake trigger devices and guide lines. A method for drilling holes includes that the inflating tube are obliquely embedded around a foundation of a building thereon by drilling, the bottom portions of the inflating tubes deeply reach the bottom of a liquefiable soil layer, and inflating holes are reserved on the bottom portions of the inflating tubes which are connected with the air compressors. In case of earthquake, the earthquake trigger devices embedded under the foundation trigger to start the air compressors, air is quickly extracted and compressed into the liquefiable soil layer of the foundation, air bubbles are generated on the liquefiable soil layer, saturation of the liquefiable soil layer is lowered, liquefaction resisting strength of soil mass is increased, increasing of excess pore water pressure in the soil mass during earthquake is reduced, liquefied area of the soil mass is effectively narrowed, and liquefied disasters are avoided. The construction method is simple, low in manufacturing cost, good in liquefaction resisting effect, and particularly applicable to treatment of large-area easy-liquefaction foundations like dikes and wharfs.

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling coalbed rockburst through chemical reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing and controlling coalbed rockburst through chemical reaction, which sequentially comprises the following steps: selecting a coalbed with rockburst disasters and a vitrinite reflectance of less than 0.6%; selecting a certain area in the coalbed to carry out hole drilling; blocking orifices of drilled holes; preparing an alkali solution; pumping the prepared alkali solution into the drilled holes to soak for a period of time; and monitoring in a slight shock, electromagnetic radiation or cuttings drilling mode so as to ensure that the outburst-proneness is eliminated, repeatedly carrying out soaking many times until the outburst-proneness is completely eliminated. Compared with the traditional physical rockburst prevention and control measures, and the traditional rockburst prevention and control measures, the method disclosed by the invention is not only good in rockburst prevention and control effect, but also convenient to construct, high in safety and low in cost, eliminates the outburst-proneness rapidly and thoroughly, avoids the defect that the traditional water injection and absorption speeds are slow, provides a new prevention and control method for low-rank coalbed rockburst, and has a broad application prospect in low-rank coalbeds.

title_en: Method for liquefaction countermeasure construction right below existing structure that enables detached house to be built, and device therefor
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for liquefaction countermeasure construction right below an existing structure that is provided so as to suppress and reduce a liquefaction phenomenon apt to occur on a sand ground etc., in case of an earthquake disaster etc., and a device therefor.SOLUTION: A rod body (1) for drilling that has a through hole (3) along a shaft center (C) is provided with a drilling bit (2) at its tip part, and with a connection part (4) connecting a following connection rod (9) at its rear end part. A plurality of jet nozzles (6) which are inclined at a predetermined angle (θ) to a front-rear direction of the rod body while passing on the shaft center (C) are provided nearby the connection part (4) of the rod body (1), an opening/closing valve (7) for the through hole (3) that comprises a compression spring (7) and a steel ball (7) is provided nearby the drilling bit (2), and a sealing part (1') for a through-hole blocking ball (5) in grout pressing-in is formed between the jet nozzles (6) and opening/closing valve (7).
assignees: TAKATOKU KK;TATSUMI SHOKAI CO LTD;NAMBU GIKO KK

title_en: Cyclone type jetting drill bit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cyclone type jetting drill bit. The drill bit comprises a drill bit body with a hollow cavity, wherein the middle of the end part of the drill bit body is provided with a sampling port communicated with the hollow cavity, the end part of the drill bit body is provided with a cutting tool bit used for drilling and sampling, the position on the wall of the drill bit body, which is close to the cutting tool bit, is provided with an eddy-flow jetting hole communicated with the hollow cavity, and the central line of the eddy-flow jetting hole and the axis of the drill bit body are mutually staggered in the space. According to the cyclone type jetting drill bit disclosed by the invention, coal dust is pressed into a sampling passage by jetting out rotary compressed air so as to achieve the aim of quickly and accurately carrying out the operation of sampling; and moreover, the sampling time can be saved, the sampling time is reduced to about 2 to 5 minutes, the increase of the sampling depth reaches more than 100 meters, the working efficiency and the safety of the sampling of a coal mine are enhanced, and the disaster accident of gas is lowered.
assignees: CHONGQING RES INST OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENG GROUP CORP

title_en: The device of fire-training
title_ko: 소방 훈련용 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus for fire fight training is provided to be able to use a television in a small scale government office, a kindergarten, or a house, thereby being applied to various places. CONSTITUTION: A display(10) includes an input unit connected to the outside and outputs an image or acoustic signal. A fire extinguisher(20) comprises a fog liquid vessel, a sensing unit sensing dispense amount of the fog liquid and a dispense location, and a radio transmission unit. A set top box(30) includes a connecting unit electrically connected to a display, receives a signal generated from a transmission device, and outputs the image or acoustic signal by using a program predetermined by receiving a signal generated from the transmission unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실전과 같은 상황을 연출하여 포그액을 이용하여 화재진압과정을 실습할 수 있는 소방 훈련용 장치에 관련되며, 그 구성의 특징으로서 외부와 연결이 가능한 입력부를 구비하고, 영상 및 음향을 출력하는 디스플레이(10); 상기 포그액을 충전 가능한 포그액통(21)과, 상기 포그액의 분사량과 분사위치를 감지하는 감지수단과, 무선으로 송출하는 송출수단을 구비하는 교육용 소화기(20); 및 상기 디스플레이(10)와 전기적으로 연결되게 연결수단(31)을 구비하고, 상기 송출수단으로부터 발생한 신호를 입력받아 설정된 프로그램에 의해 영상 및 음향신호를 출력하는 셋탑박스(30);를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 따라 본 발명은, 소규모 관공서나 유치원 또는 가정에서 텔레비전 등을 이용할 수 있어 다양한 장소에 구애받지 않고 적용 가능하여 활용성과 호환성 및 이동성이 우수하고, 사용 및 유지관리가 쉽고 편리하면서도 고가의 시뮬레이션 장비가 없이도 누구든지 훈련을 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Multifunctional stretchable recreation vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional stretchable recreation vehicle which comprises a main vehicle body. The main vehicle body comprises a front baffle plate, a rear baffle plate, a baseboard, a roof plate, and two lateral plates. The front baffle plate, rear baffle plate, baseboard, roof plate, and two lateral plates form a cuboid-shaped carriage. Each of the lateral plate comprises a folding roof plate, a folding lateral plate, and a folding baseboard. The hinged end where the folding lateral plate and the folding baseboard are hinged folds away upwards, and the hinged end where the folding roof plate and folding lateral plate are hinged folds away downwards. The multifunctional stretchable recreation vehicle has the advantages of being convenient and easy to stretch due to the foldable design of vehicle body, being capable of increasing usable area, being capable of being used in various regions and different seasons due to good impermeability after stretching out and drawing back of the vehicle body, and being energy-saved and environmental friendly due to the use of solar energy and being applicable to leisure, entertainment and accommodation in outdoor travel. Besides, the multifunctional stretchable recreation vehicle can be used as mobile restaurant in less developed regions, and can be used for transferring pasture for shepherds in pasturing area and for various emergency and disaster relieve, and further can be used as logistical support or commanding car for military training in the field, as life vehicle for field exploration of highway, railway, electric power, mining and daily-used vehicle for field construction.

title_en: Risk assessment method for coal and gas outburst of coal beds
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method for coal and gas outburst of coal beds and belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety. The method is applied to risk assessment of the coal and gas outburst of coal beds of a newly-built or rebuilt coal mine. The method is composed of a coal bed outburst risk leading index method and an influencing factor index calculation method. Leading index factors comprise a dynamical phenomenon in the process of drilling and production in accordance with geology, coal bed gas pressure P, coal bed gas diffusion initial speed DeltaP, coal bed firmness coefficient f and damage types of coal. According to influencing factor indexes of mining conditions, structure types of the coal and industrial analyses, geological conditions, coal bed gas and outburst conditions of adjacent mines, a risk value of coal bed outburst is calculated. By utilization of leading indexes and influencing factor indexes, the value is calculated and foundation data of coal bed outburst risk is judged whether to be comprehensive and reliable or not, scientificity and systematicness of assessment work are improved, foundation is provided for mine project approval, mine design and engineer operation, and the method can instruct prevention and control work of outburst disasters.

title_en: Emergency command system and method
abstract_en: An emergency command system and method is provided. The emergency command system includes an input interface unit, a scene information unit, an emergency status providing unit, a strategy inferring unit, an output interface unit, and a commanding unit; wherein the scene information unit includes at least one set of scene information; the emergency status providing unit receives an alarm signal corresponding to an emergency from a disaster investigation device, and real-time produces real-time scene simulation data according to the alarm signal and a set of scene information in the scene information unit corresponding to the emergency; the strategy inferring unit produces a strategy inference diagram; the output interface unit display the strategy inference diagram; and the commanding unit produces commanding signals based on the strategy data input by the input interface unit, to respond a control signal of the input interface unit, and transmits at least a command signal to at least a terminal device. The invention further provides an emergency command method.
assignees: HON HAI PREC IND CO LTD;HONGFUJIN PREC IND SHENZHEN

title_en: Earthquake precaution evacuation manoeuvre method by using earthquake early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides an earthquake early warning manoeuvre method based on an earthquake early warning system for carrying out of an emergency evacuation manoeuvre. During the manoeuvre, earthquake magnitude and position of an earthquake focus of a simulated earthquake are set through a manoeuvre controlling device. When the manoeuvre starts, earthquake early warning receiving terminals located everywhere receive earthquake early warning signals. An earthquake early warning controlling output device automatically starts voice output equipment, wherein the voice output equipment gives earthquake early warning alarms. Proper risk avoiding measures (if the early warning time received is shorter than risk avoiding time, people hide in near places, if the early warning time received is longer than the risk avoiding time, people withdraw to a safe area quickly) are adopted in different places according to different earthquake early warning alarms received. Various forms of manoeuvres about the distance of the earthquake focus, the earthquake magnitude and the like are carried out by using the method, people receiving the manoeuvres form conditioned reflex and are capable of adopting proper risk avoiding measures according to different earthquake early warning time and intensity of the earthquake.

title_en: 3d scenario recording with weapon effect simulation
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for the three-dimensional scenario recording of the action taking place during training exercises of firefights at close range, in which multiple, synchronized imaging systems (IS), such as video cameras, scanners or the like, are installed for monitoring the training areas, wherein software calculates from the IS recordings a photo-realistic 3D model of the scenario and records the action continuously as a 3D scenario, detects persons, weapons and other items of equipment (for example protective clothing) and further processes and reproduces them with their anatomical, ballistic, material-typical and optical features as an object module in the 3D model, detects the position and orientation of weapons and the firing thereof, calculates the line of flight of projectiles and replicates them in the 3D model, and, in the case of persons hit by projectiles, calculates the effect of the weapon on the basis of the position of the hit, possibly detected protective clothing.

title_en: Mine water disaster treatment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine water disaster treatment method which comprises the following steps of selecting a position of a drilling site, arranging a position of a drill hole on a work face, designing a drill hole track, utilizing a drilling machine to enable a screw motor to be propelled into the drill hole, pouring high-pressure water into the screw motor which drives a drill bit to cut rocks, cutting the rocks, measuring an inclination angle and an azimuth angle of the drill bit at the same time, controlling the drilling direction of the drill bit according to measured data and the drill hole track, forming a water drainage channel after the drill bit reaches a water bearing bed, and draining water in the water bearing bed through the water drainage channel. As the screw motor is utilized for drilling the hole, effects of being deep in the drill hole, low in cost and long in water drainage time can be achieved. Simultaneously, the angles of the drill bit are measured while the hole is drilled, the hole-drilling direction of the drill bit is constantly adjusted, the long distance of drill hole shuttling in the water bearing bed is achieved, and good water drainage effect is achieved.
assignees: SHENHUA GROUP CORP LTD;SHENHUA NINGXIA COAL INDUSTRY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation emergency scheme selection method based on regional emergency evacuation capacity evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evacuation emergency scheme selection method based on regional emergency evacuation capacity evaluation. The evacuation emergency scheme selection method based on the regional emergency evacuation capacity evaluation comprises the following steps: a regional evacuation source set, a meeting point set, a placement point set and an evacuation vehicle set are established, and an evacuation relationship between evacuation sources and meeting points is established according to the established evacuation emergency scheme; a meeting point number of people-time curve is obtained, and the evacuation relationship of meeting point-placement point is established; a running path of an emergency transport unit and an evacuation transport task list of the emergency transport unit are planned; time interval road traffic conditions are generated, evacuation transport task execution is simulated, and regional evacuation process data are recorded; regional evacuation characteristic parameters in the period of time are counted and analyzed after multiple simulations; multi-period regional evacuation characteristic parameters are obtained, and an evacuation capacity evaluation sheet is output; an optimal evacuation emergency scheme is obtained according to the evacuation capacity evaluation sheet. Compared with the prior art, the evacuation emergency scheme selection method based on the regional emergency evacuation capacity evaluation has the advantages of being rapid, effective, capable of providing effective aid decision making for emergency management when emergency incidents occur and the like.

title_en: Geological disaster visualized information system based on geographic information system (GIS)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster visualized information system based on the geographic information system (GIS). The geological disaster visualized information system comprises a server, a switchboard, a router, a firewall and a network client, wherein the switchboard is connected with the server, the router is connected with the switchboard, the firewall is connected with the router, and the network client is connected with the firewall. By means of the geological disaster visualized information system based on the GIS, with the technical support of the three-dimensional GIS, the web geographic information system (WEBGIS) and the like, any flight browsing and data query and analysis with the 'Digital Earth' as the background can be achieved, geological disaster analogue simulation and location query can be carried out, important support is provided for decision-making and command, and the geological disaster visualized information system based on the GIS has a perfect permission management mechanism and can control ranges and contents of data browsed by different users in networks according to permission setting.
assignees: ANHUI HENGYUAN COAL ELECTRICITY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Pneumatic hole-drilling pumping unit
abstract_en: A pneumatic hole-drilling pumping unit comprises a pneumatic drill, an oil inlet pneumatic membrane pump, an oil pumping pneumatic membrane pump and an oil storage barrel. A connecting cover and a rubber sleeve are installed on the pneumatic drill. The connecting cover is connected with an oil inlet end of the oil inlet pneumatic membrane pump through a connecting oil pipe, a first manual ball valve, a three-way connector and a filter. The oil storage barrel is connected with an oil outlet end of the oil inlet pneumatic membrane pump. At the same time, the three-way connector is connected with an oil inlet pipe through a second manual ball valve. The oil storage barrel is also connected with the oil pumping pneumatic membrane pump through ab oil pipe. The pneumatic hole-drilling pumping unit is safe, practical, convenient to operate and capable of effectively preventing fire disasters and protecting safety of equipment and operators.

title_en: Region emergency evacuation process simulation method based on event queue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a region emergency evacuation process simulation method based on event queue. The region emergency evacuation process simulation method based on the event queue comprises the following steps: (1) obtaining region evacuation simulation initial element data and an evacuation transportation task list are obtained; (2) carrying out event lists, stimulation relationship between the events and each event processing procedure in a module according to evacuation transportation task list definition events; (3) sending initialized event information by an evacuation simulation system module, and adding timing sequence event queue; (4) inquiring timing sequence event queue by an event processing module, extracting the newest event in the timing sequence event queue to be carried out according to the relevant event processing procedure, and generating a new event according to the stimulation relationship between the events to add the timing sequence event queue, simultaneously, updating the element data in real time; (5) repeating the step (4) until the timing sequence event queue is empty; (6) recording each element final states by the evacuation simulation system, and finishing the evacuation simulation. Compared with the prior art, the region emergency evacuation process simulation method based on the event queue has the advantages of being fast in simulation speed, high in efficiency, and the like. The requirement of the evacuation of a large-scale passenger train can be met.

title_en: Natural Disaster Forecasting
abstract_en: A method, an apparatus and an article of manufacture for estimating risk of impact of a natural disaster on a populated area. The method includes using dynamic natural disaster modeling information to estimate a spatio-temporal distribution of a parameter of a potential natural disaster, wherein the modeling information is input to an instance of a weather forecast model which computes simulation results for natural disaster parameters for an area at a given time interval and the results produced on each time step within the time interval the estimate of the spatio-temporal distribution, and using static demographic data to estimate risk of impact of the parameter of the natural disaster on a populated area based on the estimated spatio-temporal distribution, wherein the demographic data is overlayed with the estimated spatio-temporal distribution via applying a weight to each populated area based on historical natural disaster incidents and related impact for each area.

title_en: Management system for disaster occurrence of bridge considering deterioration
title_ko: 열화정도를 고려한 교량 재난관리시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bridge disaster management system which considers the degree of deterioration is provided to extract a scenario corresponding to a disaster situation, thereby transmitting the extracted scenario to a bridge manager or the public around the bridge. CONSTITUTION: A disaster factor measurement module(100) measures individual disaster factors. A disaster type determination server(200) determines a disaster type from the combination of extracted disaster factors. A bridge deterioration management server(300) stores a deterioration degree of a bridge. An accumulated disaster information management server(400) accumulatively stores disaster information. A bridge disaster management server(500) transmits a disaster alarm by extracting a scenario corresponding to a disaster situation. [Reference numerals] (210) Disaster factor collecting unit; (220) Single disaster determination unit; (230) Complex disaster determination unit; (240) Connected disaster determination unit; (310) Regional bridge management unit; (320) Seasonal bridge management unit; (330) Deterioration modeling unit; (410) Regional disaster information management unit; (420) Damaged bridge management unit; (510) Disaster standard database; (520) Disaster situation calculation unit; (530) Responding scenario extraction unit; (540) Disaster alarm transmitting unit; (AA,BB,CC,DD,EE) Disaster factor measurement module;
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 교량 재난관리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 교량의 재해를 유발하는 강풍, 지진, 강설 등의 개별적인 재난인자에 의한 단일재난, 다수의 재난인자가 복합적으로 작용하는 복합재난 및 하나의 재난이 다른 재난을 촉발하는 연동재난 등 다양한 재난에 의하여 교량에 미치게 될 영향을 판단함에 있어서, 재난의 종류뿐만 아니라 각 교량의 열화정도와, 각 교량에 누적된 재해정도를 함께 고려하여 해당 교량이 직접적으로 겪게 될 재난상황을 연산한 후, 이와 같이 연산된 재난상황에 대응할 수 있는 대응시나리오를 추출하여 교량관리자나 교량 주변의 일반인들에게 통신망 등으로 전송함으로써, 신속한 대처를 수행할 수 있게 한 열화정도를 고려한 교량 재난관리시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Underground coal seam hydrofracture crack oriented developing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground coal seam hydrofracture crack oriented developing method which comprises the following steps: (1) drilling into a hydrofracture drill hole and oriented drill holes, wherein the number of the hydrofracture drill hole is one, the oriented drill holes are arranged around the circumference circle at intervals, and respectively conducting water jet cutting to the hydrofracture drill hole and all oriented drill holes, wherein water jet cutting is achieved through a high-pressure water jet cutting device; (2) respectively conducting hole sealing to the hydrofracture drill hole and all oriented drill holes; and (3) conducting hydraulic fracturing to the hydrofracture drill hole. According to the underground coal seam hydrofracture crack oriented developing method, secondary disasters of a coal seam top base plate caused by disordered developing of cracks can be avoided, meanwhile, effective stress in the hydrofracture area can be reduced, closing of the cracks is retarded, flow conductivity of the cracks is strengthened, and therefore the purposes of effectively managing gas and efficiently pumping and exploiting the gas can be achieved.

title_en: Inflatable firecracker
abstract_en: Disclosed is an inflatable firecracker capable of making gas cracking sound and simulating cracking sound. At present, air quality is affected by firecrackers, and risks such as fire disasters, personal hurts, building collapse and the like are caused. Therefore, aiming to overcome defects brought by powder firecrackers, the technical scheme of the inflatable firecracker includes that an inflating device is connected with an inflating pipe which inflates an air pipe, the air pipe inflates a barrel of a firecracker tube through an inflating hole, the air pipe and the firecracker tube are connected through a thread, a spring is connected with a sealing cap and a bottom cap, the bottom cap is adhered with a rubber washer, the bottom cap is made of soft-magnetic stainless steel, three to eight magnetic fasteners are fixed at the other end of the firecracker tube, and the other end of the firecracker tube is sealed by the magnetic fasteners, the stainless steel bottom cap and the rubber washer. The inflatable firecracker has the advantages that the inflatable firecracker is simple, low in cost, recyclable, capable of making firecracker sound without generating any pollutants, free of fire disasters, building damages and transport risk and resource-saving and can be used as toys for children.

title_en: Large-scale scene skill training simulation software of business model navigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale scene skill training simulation software of business model navigation. The large-scale scene skill training simulation software of the business model navigation comprises a system layer, a support layer and an application layer. Business models of large-scale scenes concerned about natural disasters, accidents and catastrophes, health, social safety and post career training are built through a business modeling approach, the included various skills are distinguished, defined and described, a simulation software platform provides simulated training for users utilizing the recognized skills, the large-scale scene skill training simulation software of the business model navigation is capable of effectively reducing the difficulty of the skill training, and reducing the  loss caused by the lack of skill training and expanding the range of the skill training.

title_en: Forest fire monitoring and emergency command system based unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A forest fire monitoring and emergency command system based an unmanned aerial vehicle is compose of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a ground station and a command center. Adopted as a data collection tool, the unmanned aerial vehicle, carrying with aerial photography equipment, satellite navigation and positioning equipment, inertial measurement equipment and the like, performs itinerating monitoring on monitoring areas; the ground station sends operation and control instructions to the unmanned aerial vehicle and receives data returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle in a real-time manner, and forwards the data to the command center; the command center processes and identifies aerial photography data to obtain potential fire points and ignited fire points, performs spread simulation and situation analysis, issues information such as fire early warning signals, fire dynamic situation and disaster situation statistical results, performs visualized analysis on personnel evacuation paths, and formulates fire fighting and rescue schemes as well as personnel and material scheduling strategies. The forest fire monitoring and emergency command system based the unmanned aerial vehicle is advantageous in high processing efficiency, low cost and the like.

title_en: Tunnel fire disaster monitoring alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tunnel fire disaster monitoring alarm system. The tunnel fire disaster monitoring alarm system comprises a fire disaster alarm controller and a power supply source and further comprises a tunnel monitoring center computer which is connected and communicated with the fire disaster alarm controller through a first optical transmitter and receiver, optical fiber and a second optical transmitter and receiver, the fire disaster alarm controller is internally integrated with an RS-485 communication circuit module, the fire disaster alarm controller is connected with RS-485 buses which are connected with the RS-485 communication circuit module through a lightning arrester, the RS-485 buses are connected with multiple hand-operated buttons and multiple simulation signal collector modules, the simulation signal collector modules are connected with flame detectors, the power supply source comprises an AC220V source and a 24V source case connected with the AC220V source, the fire disaster alarm controller is connected with the AC220V source, and the multiple flame detectors are respectively connected with the 24V source case. The tunnel fire disaster monitoring alarm system has reasonable design, realizes automatic alarm, can reduce fire disaster loss, realizes 24-hour monitoring and has strong real-time performance.
assignees: XI AN ALL SAFE SCI & TECH CO

title_en: Regional emergency evacuation capability assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a regional emergency evacuation capability assessment system which carries out emergency evacuation capability assessment on an area to be assessed by means of a large vehicle. The assessment system comprises an evacuation demand analysis module, an evacuation resource analysis module, an evacuation simulation and capacity assessment module, an interface setting and analog display module and a storage module, wherein the evacuation demand analysis module is respectively connected with the evacuation resource analysis module and the evacuation simulation and capacity assessment module; the interface setting and analog display module is respectively connected with the evacuation demand analysis module, the evacuation resource analysis module and the evacuation simulation and capacity assessment module; and the storage module is respectively connected with the evacuation demand analysis module, the evacuation resource analysis module, the evacuation simulation and capacity assessment module and the interface setting and analog display module. Compared with the prior art, the regional emergency evacuation capability assessment system has the advantages of direct interface display, simple calculated amount, complete assessment result and the like.

title_en: Iron-art water lily handiwork
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an iron-art water lily handiwork comprising a cylindrical fixing base which is vertically arranged, wherein a plurality of iron lotus petals arranged in at least two layers are arranged at the lower end part of the fixing base in the radial direction; a plurality of iron flower columns are arranged at the upper end part of the fixing base in the radial direction to form a lotus shape; and the upper side of the fixing base is provided with a candle holder for placing a candle. According to the iron-art water lily handiwork disclosed by the utility model, an iron part is used for simulating a water lily and the whole third dimension and the whole texture are strong; when the iron-art water lily handiwork is used for decorating an environment, a grade feeling is high; the iron-art water lily handiwork is attractive and elegant; when the iron-art water lily handiwork is used for decorating, the candle can also be placed, so that the iron-art water lily handiwork is convenient and practical and can be combined with a candle light decoration environment; and meanwhile, an iron material guarantees that fire disasters do not easily happen, a flower column structure guarantees that the candle does not easily fall down, and the shape of a lotus also guarantees that the candle can not be easily blown out by wind and the candle does not fall down to the ground.
assignees: QUANZHOU YILONG ART & CRAFT CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for assisting firefighters during a fire drill by identifying locations of victims, exits, and dangerous areas
abstract_en: Systems and methods for helping a firefighter to identify locations of victim, routes of egress, and dangerous areas during a fire drill are provided. The system's components include a fire jacket, a fire goggle, a communications device with earpiece, a locator, a compass, a temperature sensor, a smoke sensor, a processor and memory. Also provided is a life saving device with locator associated with each of one or more victims. The temperature and smoke sensors are disposed within a building in which the fire drill is to be executed. The memory stores instructions that cause the processor to execute a method that guides a firefighter to a victim and/or exit along the safest and most direct route possible. The route being determined based on feedback from the sensors as well as real-time location data from the locators.

title_en: System for detecting sea-surface wind, using satellite observation, and a method for detecting sea-surface wind
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided that involve obtaining emissivity and reflectivity by the ratio of the radiance temperature versus the sea level temperature as observed by a satellite, and may further calculate two reflectivity values observed or simulated by the vertical or horizontal polarized channels of microwave, and then estimate a surface roughness. Further, illustrative implementations may involve obtaining the regression relation expression between the surface roughness and the wind strength and then detecting the sea-surface wind, using the information observed by the satellite again. As such, the sea-surface wind information can be obtained through satellite observation, and the information can be utilized for preventive activities against disaster including typhoon, the energy industry including wind power and the fishery in quasi-real time.

title_en: Undersea anchoring positioning device for non-riser water pipe undersea mud lifting well drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to an undersea anchoring positioning device for non-riser water pipe undersea mud lifting well drilling. The undersea anchoring positioning device for the non-riser water pipe undersea mud lifting well drilling comprises a running tool, a rapid escaping lifting hook, an inhaul cable, a guide sleeve, an anchor cylinder, an anchor core and the like. When the undersea anchoring positioning device goes into the undersea, the running tool grasps the flange of the upper end of the guide sleeve, when a preset depth is reached, a claw of the running tool opens and releases the guide sleeve. When the device works, the anchor core can slide up and down inside the anchor cylinder in order to compensate the heave movement of a platform. The structure of the bottom end of the anchor core can balance the pressure inside the anchor cylinder and the pressure of the seawater when the anchor core slides. The rapid escaping lifting hook can achieve rapid escape of mud return pipelines and the undersea anchoring positioning device when well drilling is finished or in the process of emergency evacuation. The anchor cylinder and the anchor core both adopt modular designs, and therefore multiple parts can be connected together to be used according to requirements. The undersea anchoring positioning device for the non-riser water pipe undersea mud lifting well drilling can achieve horizontal positioning of undersea equipment. Compared with a common anchoring scheme, the undersea anchoring positioning device for the non-riser water pipe undersea mud lifting well drilling is lower in cost and convenient to operate.

title_en: Mine seism audible-visual alarm circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine seism audible-visual alarm circuit. Domestic coal mines are poor in natural conditions and complex in geologic conditions, Chinese continents are formed by numerous small-type plots in multi-episode convergence, so that major coal fields experience transformation in multiple periods, multiple directions and big intensity, and therefore geologic conditions of the coal fields are complex, and various real disasters accordingly occur. The mine seism audible-visual alarm circuit comprises a power source, a triode transistor VT1, a triode transistor VT2, a speaker, a four-tone simulative sound integrated circuit, wherein one way of the power source is connected with a lighting flashlamp through a resistor R1, a seism detection switch SQ, a unidirectional thyristor, and the other way of the power source is connected with the speaker through the four-tone simulative sound integrated circuit, the triode transistor VT1 and the triode transistor VT2. The mine seism audible-visual alarm circuit is simple in structure and accurate in alarm, and thus workers can be evacuated before a disaster happens.

title_en: Automatic control device of deicing of power cable
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic control device of deicing of a power cable. The device adopts a set of a simulated power cable ice and snow sensor and utilizes the characteristic that the weight of the power cable is increased when snow is deposited or ice is formed; a sensor lever system and a balance detection mercury switch circuit are arranged to control the on-off of a deicing power supply circuit; a combined judging circuit of an AND gate logic system is composed of an environment temperature detection control circuit and the ice and snow sensor, namely the automatic control device of the deicing of the power cable can start a monitoring ready state in a snowing weather and weathers with frozen rain disasters; only if the monitoring ready state is started, a switching signal of the simulated power cable ice and snow sensor has the effect of controlling deicing and heating; and the combined judging circuit of the AND gate logic system can avoid false operation and the unattended reliability is guaranteed. A working power supply of the device is directly taken from a power supply of a power transmission line through a high-voltage power supply transformer; a deicing circuit part is in equipotential connection with a power transmission cable and the like; and the circuit is simple and convenient and the safety is high.

title_en: High-rise escaping device
abstract_en: Disclosed is a high-rise escaping device. When people living in a high-rise come cross a fire disaster occurring below, the people can escape safely by utilizing the high-rise escaping device, and are prevented from being burned to death or smoked to death or falling dead. The high-rise escaping device comprises a hoisting rod assembly (D), a pulley (2), a steel wire (3) and an escape device assembly (T), wherein the hoisting rod assembly (D) is composed of a main hoisting rod (1), an auxiliary hoisting rod (19) and a hinge (20). The escape device assembly (T) is composed of a pipe upper section (7), a pipe lower section (9), a seat plate (10), a hinge (24), a knob (6) and the like, wherein three sleeves (27 and 28 and 31) are arranged inside the pipe upper section (7), the upper sleeve (27) and the lower sleeve (31) are cylinders, a round hole is formed in the middle of each cylinder, the middle sleeve (28) is a tile-shaped half cylinder, parts of the middle portion and two sides of the middle sleeve (28) are cut off, the diameter of the middle sleeve (28) is smaller, a round hole is formed in the center of the middle sleeve (28), round holes are drilled in the middle portion and outer side, two hard springs (29) are installed in the round holes, a soft spring (30) is installed at one side of the round hole at the outer side, a screw rod of the knob (6) is ejected into the other side of the round hole at the outer side, the outer wall of the pipe lower section (9) is welded to the hinge (24), and the hinge (24) is fixedly provided with the seat plate (10). When the high-rise escaping device is used, a person sits on the seat plate (10), the knob (6) is unscrewed, and then the person can slide downwards slowly for escaping.

title_en: System in conjunction with crop cultivation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a crop cultivation simulation game with high reality to users, by executing the game in conjunction with actual crop cultivation.SOLUTION: This system 1 in conjunction with the crop cultivation includes a simulation server 10 for providing a crop cultivation simulation game in conjunction with cultivation in a real agricultural field. The simulation server 10 includes: a cultivation situation recording unit 135 that records, for virtual crops cultivated virtually, a cultivation situation including a yield parameter for determining a yield of the virtual crops; an automatic growth control unit 51 that automatically grows the virtual crops while updating the cultivation situation; a growth correction control unit 52, when receiving information of an occurrence of disaster at the real agricultural field, performing a correction processing for forcibly reducing the yield parameter; and a distribution volume determination unit 55 for determining a distribution volume of the real crops to the user according to the yield parameter.

title_en: Moving body for unmanned running
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To develop a moving body for unmanned running suitable for investigation of a disaster area.SOLUTION: The moving body for unmanned running comprises a machine body 2 and a crawler 5 for running which covers the machine body 2. The machine body 2 internally has a central accommodation part 21 for moving body control, a lower surface of the machine body 2 forms a sliding surface of a crawler belt 53, pulleys 7 are provided in the front and back of the machine body 2, the crawler 5 for running is formed by training the crawler belt 53 over the pulleys 7 provided in the front and back of the machine body 2, and the moving body for unmanned running has an electric motor 9 as a driving source.

title_en: Novel double-layer heating cigarette
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel double-layer heating cigarette comprising a cigarette holder and a cigarette cavity. The cigarette holder and the cigarette cavity are matched with each other. A smoke generator and a heating device used for supplying heat source are arranged in the cigarette cavity. One end of the smoke generator is connected with the cigarette holder, and the other end of the smoke generator is connected with the heating device. The smoke generator comprises a pair of outer-layer smoke generators arranged on the inner wall of the cigarette cavity. The outer-layer smoke generators are arranged symmetrically by taking the central axis of cigarette cavity as a center. An inner-layer smoke generator is arranged between the outer-layer smoke generators. The novel double-layer heating cigarette is free of flaming, flaming of cigarettes can be simulated, harm of cigarette flaming to customers and passive smoking harm to non-smokers are reduced, and fire disasters caused by open fire of the cigarettes can be effectively avoided.
assignees: CHINA TOBACCO HUBEI IND CO LTD;WUHAN HUANGHELOU TECH PARK CO

title_en: Whirlwind type jet drill bit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a whirlwind type jet drill bit which comprises a drill bit body with a hollow cavity. A sample taking opening which is communicated with the hollow cavity is formed in the middle of the end portion of the drill bit body, a cutting tool bit which is used for drilling and sampling is arranged on the end portion of the drill bit, a rotational flow jet hole which is communicated with the hollow cavity is formed in the position, close to the cutting tool bit, of the wall of the drill bit body, and the central line of the rotational flow jet hole and the axial line of the drill bit body are mutually intersected in space. The whirlwind type jet drill bit jets out rotary compressed air to enable slack coal to be pressed into a sampling channel, sampling can be fast and accurately conducted, sampling time can be saved and is saved to be about 2-5minutes, sampling depth is improved to be above 100m, coal sampling working efficiency and safety are improved, and gas disaster accidents are reduced.
assignees: CHIAN COAL SCIENCE & IND GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Expandable polyethylene (EPE) tent and method for combing and connecting tents
abstract_en: The invention provides an expandable polyethylene (EPE) tent and a method for combing and connecting the tents and relates to a roof ridge type EPE tent for army camping, disaster relief and people living, disaster resident settlement housing and drilling construction. The EPE tent belongs to a tent using the EPE as plus materials, and the EPE has the advantages that the EPE is cool in summer and warm in winter, the weight is light, the waterproof effect is realized, the toughness is high, and no toxicity or no odor exists. The left side and the right side of the EPE tent can realize continuous stretching combination, and the EPE tent has the characteristics of firmness, wind resistance, sound isolation, and shock resistance, and paulins and support frames are saved.

title_en: Screw drilling robot with underground detection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a screw drilling robot with an underground detection function. The screw drilling robot comprises a screw drilling system for cutting soil and providing forward power, a steering system for adjusting a drilling direction, a detection system for detecting surrounding environment of the robot, and a control system for processing detection information and regulating and controlling motion, wherein the drilling system is connected with the steering system; the control system is in communication connection with the detection system, the drilling system and the steering system; the robot can freely drill and turn underground, and explores the surrounding environment in real time by utilizing the detection system, so that motion directions are adjusted; and the robot is connected with ground equipment through compound cables, so that energy can be acquired and information can be fed back, and ground crews conveniently carry out remote real-time monitoring. The screw drilling robot with the underground detection function is compact in structure and flexible in movement, can drill in a closed environment under the ground, can detect the surrounding environment and specific objectives, and is suitable for underground exploration and mine disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: A kind of experimental device with physical landslide model
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of experimental device with physical landslide model, comprise: landslide experimental tank, described landslide experimental tank comprises base and four sections of platforms, wherein, described first paragraph platform is positioned on described base, described first paragraph platform, second segment platform, the 3rd section of platform are connected successively with the 4th section of platform, and described first paragraph platform is horizontality, the tilt adjustable joint of second segment platform, the 3rd section of platform and the 4th section of platform.Experimental device with physical landslide model of the present invention has the feature of large scale, sectional type, multifactor, overall process, can landslide disaster chain overall process failure evolvement under real simulation hydrodynamic force risk factor.

title_en: Simulation method of wind-induced disaster whole process of long-span bridge
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation method of a wind-induced disaster whole process of a long-span bridge. The simulation method comprises the steps of making the aerostatic coefficients, an effective instant wind attack angle and the relative wind speed integrally working on an aerodynamic force of a main beam, and then carrying out unsteady correction on self-excited force components in the aerostatic coefficients, the effective instant wind attack angle and the relative wind speed; applying aerodynamic force load to a finite element model for carrying out dynamic-history calculation, and carrying out iteration of torsion base frequency and vertical-curve base frequency in different wind speeds; and judging the steady state of a bridge structure under a certain wind speed according to displacement response. According to the simulation method provided by the invention, the integrated calculation of calm-wind instability, buffering and flutter is realized, the defect of independent calculation in traditional wind vibration calculation is overcome, and the accuracy of bridge wind vibration calculation is increased.

title_en: Power emergency monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power emergency and also relates to a power emergency monitoring method and system. The method disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps of: building a three-dimensional GIS (Geographic Information System) scene of a monitored region; and loading virtual model data of a power transmission and transformation device, building a virtual model of the power transmission and transformation device in the three-dimensional GIS scene by adopting a VR (Virtual Reality) technology, and forming, saving and displaying a power emergency scene. The power emergency monitoring system disclosed by the invention comprises a three-dimensional GIS scene building module and an integration module, wherein the three-dimensional GIS scene building module is used for building the three-dimensional GIS scene of the monitored region; and the integration module is used for loading the virtual model data of the power transmission and transformation device, building the virtual model of the power transmission and transformation device in the three-dimensional GIS scene by adopting the VR technology, and forming, saving and displaying the power emergency scene. In the way, a user can intuitively know information about geographical features of an emergency maintaining environment, the appearance and the geographic position of the power transmission and transformation device, and the like; and more reference data is provided for making an emergency measure, so that the speed of emergency response is increased.

title_en: Technology of construction of urban-rural integration ecological security pattern
abstract_en: On the basic of theories such as landscape ecology and ecological service functions, methods such as a landscape pattern analytical method, an ecosystem service evaluation method and a landscape ecological function network simulation method are adopted, through determining technology of corridor and node positions, a heat island control pattern, a water resource protecting and flood detection pattern and a geological disaster safety protection pattern are overlaid, a critical area (such as an existing large-scale ecological plaque) and a critical node (such as an existing ecological plaque which needs to be reformed or newly built) in an ecological security pattern are judged, a critical position which needs to be ecologically built or adjusted and a sequence are obtained, the degree of importance of critical points can be calculated through plaque important indexes, integration and model optimization of technology of construction of the urban-rural integration ecological security pattern are carried out, and an ecosystem service and urban-rural spatial arrangement are linked.

title_en: Construction structure for treating geological disasters of mud gushing and water burst of karst tunnel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of treatment of geological disasters in tunnel construction, in particular to a construction structure for treating geological disasters of mud gushing and water burst of a karst tunnel. The construction structure for treating the geological disasters of mud gushing and water burst of the karst tunnel resolves the problems of a long construction cycle and high cost of an existing method, and comprises two main tunnel galleries, an automobile transverse gallery, a pedestrian transverse gallery, a temporary construction gallery, and drainage desilting pools, wherein the automobile transverse gallery, the pedestrian transverse gallery and the temporary construction gallery are communicated with the main tunnel galleries, the drainage desilting pools are arranged between the main tunnel galleries at intervals and are lower than the designed elevation of the main tunnel galleries, two ends of each drainage desilting pool are communicated with the corresponding automobile transverse gallery and the temporary construction gallery respectively, a counter-slope sand outlet gallery is arranged at the downstream of each drainage desilting pool, a construction gallery is arranged at the upstream of each drainage desilting pool, and radial drainage pressure-relief drilling holes are circumferentially formed in the inner wall of each drainage desilting pool. The construction structure for treating the geological disasters of mud gushing and water burst of the karst tunnel overcomes the defect that karst gushed mud and water damage the structure of the tunnel and a waterproof and drainage system, has the advantages of being short in construction period, being small in investment, taking effect soon, and being environment-friendly, and has wide popularization value and use value.
assignees: SHAANXI COMM CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for human behavior pattern recognition using affordance-based agent model
title_ko: 어포던스 기반 에이전트 모델을 이용한 인간 행동패턴 인식장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A human behavior pattern recognition device using an affordance based agent model is provided to offer a clue to predict human behavior in which a reproduction experiment is impossible and how to improve a design of environment regarding a result of the behavior. CONSTITUTION: A finite state model supplying unit(100) offers a formalized environment a schema about possibility of human behavior dynamically varying in the environment. An event generation module(200) executes an event on the formalized schema in the finite state model supplying unit. An agent module(300) predicts a behavior pattern of the human regarding the event by interacting adaptive acknowledge information of the human in the dynamic environment and generates a sequence of possible behaviors for achieving a goal. [Reference numerals] (100) Finite state model providing unit; (200) Event generation module; (300) Agent module; (310) Human behavior planner; (320) Environment agent unit; (330) Human agent unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자신의 주위 환경에 대한 인지정보를 바탕으로 목표(goal)를 달성하기 위하여 행하는 인간의 적응적인 행동패턴에 대한 모델링과 시뮬레이션을 통하여 재난 상황과 같이 실험으로는 재현할 수 없는 복잡하고 동적인 인간-환경시스템(human-environment system)에서 인간의 행동을 관찰, 예측, 통제할 수 있는 인간의 인지적 행위유발인자 (affordance) 기반 에이전트 모델을 이용한 인간 행동패턴 인식장치를 제공하는데 있다.
assignees: UNIV INJE IND ACAD COOPERATION;UNIST ACADEMY IND RES CORP

title_en: Apparatus for experience fire fighting
title_ko: 화재진압 체험장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: Equipment for experiencing firefighting is provided to simulate a fire on display apparatus and to practice firefighting with a fire extinguisher unit thereby effectively educating how to extinguish a fire. CONSTITUTION: Equipment for a firefighting experience includes display apparatus which shows the image of a simulated fire, a fire extinguisher unit (20) located in front of the display apparatus and a shooting detection unit (30) which senses the shooting location or a nozzle (23a) direction of the fire extinguisher unit. The display apparatus shows an extinguished fire or a growing fire depending on the signal from the shooting detection unit about the shooting location or the nozzle direction of the extinguisher unit. The shooting detection unit senses the location where particles which are shot from the extinguisher unit colliding with a screen (11) by detecting the movement of the screen.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소화기를 사용하여 화재를 진압하는 방법을 효과적으로 교육할 수 있도록 된 새로운 구조의 화재진압 체험장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 화재진압 체험장치는 디스플레이수단(11,12,13)에 디스플레이된 영상을 이용하여 가상으로 화재를 연출하고, 소화기유닛(20)을 조작하여 화재를 진압하는 연습을 할 수 있으므로, 실재로 불을 피울 필요가 없어서 안전사고가 발생되는 것을 방지할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 사용이 편리한 장점이 있다.

title_en: Method for human behavior pattern recognition using affordance-based agent model
title_ko: 어포던스 기반 에이전트 모델을 이용한 인간 행동패턴 인식방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method for recognizing behavior patterns by using an affordance-based agent model is provided to supply prediction and analysis abilities for efficient system design and management by predicting the behaviors of humans in a reappearance test impossible situation and supplying a single sentry about the improvement of environment design. CONSTITUTION: A schema of a unit space and an environment standardized for expressing and describing the behaviors of humans in a system is provided by using a finite state model methodology and an affordance theory(S10). If an initial event occurs, an agent type of the event is confirmed(S30). If the event is a human agent, the event is executed on the standardized schema based on recognition data about a behavior possible state in the environment. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) Application agent; (CC) Environment agent; (DD,GG,II,KK) No; (EE,HH,LL) Yes; (JJ) Standby; (S10) Provide a standardized schema; (S100) New environment event is generated?; (S20) Generate an initial event; (S30) Agent type?; (S40) Generated event is within a recognition range?; (S50) Establish an execution plan; (S60) Conditions of a behavior induction factor and a behavior performance factor within the recognition range are satisfied?; (S70) Update a position change of a human agent caused by a behavior; (S80) Target state is reached?; (S90) Update an environmental change caused by the laws of physics
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자신의 주위 환경에 대한 인지정보를 바탕으로 목표(goal)를 달성하기 위하여 행하는 인간의 적응적인 행동패턴에 대한 모델링과 시뮬레이션을 통하여 재난 상황과 같이 실험으로는 재현할 수 없는 복잡하고 동적인 인간-환경시스템(human-environment system)에서 인간의 행동을 관찰, 예측, 통제할 수 있는 인간의 인지적 행위유발인자 (affordance) 기반 에이전트 모델을 이용한 인간 행동패턴 인식방법을 제공하는데 있다.
