title_en: Environment-friendly gas extracting method capable of extracting gases and circularly injecting water simultaneously
abstract_en: Provided is an environment-friendly gas extracting method capable of extracting gases and circularly injecting water simultaneously. Presently, in the coal petrography stratum methane gas extracting process, underground water is excessively extracted, accordingly ground surface sinking and underwater level recession happen frequently, leakage of coal petrography methane gases and other toxic and harmful gases are caused, and even major environmental disasters occur. The environment-friendly gas extracting method capable of extracting gases and circularly injecting water simultaneously is characterized in that underground water extracted in the gas extracting process is sent back to the underground, accordingly coal petrography methane gas extracting is performed under drilling water level and gas extracting negative pressure dynamic balance, and environmental destruction is avoided.

title_en: Impact-resistant enamel glass panel capable of being sawn and drilled
abstract_en: An enamel glass panel is formed by bonding enamel with glass cloth. Enamel glass cannot be combusted, so that fire disasters can be reduced; glass cloth is elastic, enamel sheets are also elastic, and the tensile force of glass fiber is greater than the tensile force of metal fiber by multiple times, so that the impact force tensile performance borne by the enamel glass panel can be compared with that of a steel plate; the enamel glass panel is acid-alkali resistant, and can be qualified to be used in acid and alkali occasions; the enamel glass panel has the specific gravity of about 2g/cm<3>, 100m<2> of the enamel plastic glass panel with the thickness of 1mm has the weight of 200kg, and the weight is lower than that of a steel plate by 3 times approximately; glass cloth with the thickness of 0.2mm is less than 1 yuan/m<2>, so that the price of the enamel glass panel is lowered by times, and the economical benefit is high; glass cloth is prepared from silica sands, the technology is much simpler than that of steel making, and placer deposits are rich and are more than iron minerals by thousands of times; a steel plate does not have the properties, so that the enamel glass panel has great advantages in manufacturing compartments, cabins, furniture, workshop laying and construction, external wall decoration and the like when used for replacing a metal plate; and if the enamel glass panel is manufactured into a foamed enamel glass panel, the economical benefit can be improved by multiple times.

title_en: Karst region mine water-exploring water-taking method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a karst region mine water-exploring water-taking method. The method is characterized in that first comprehensive analysis research is performed on geologic structure conditions in mine fields, karst development conditions, a Maokou limestone static water line of a mining area and other hydrogeological conditions, Maokou limestone water occurrence regularity of a local area is summarized, drilling dimensions are designed, drilling is performed on a +1,000-meter position lower than static water level elevation, the position is near to an aquifer, water can automatically flow out of a drilled hole when the water is found after hole drilling, a temporary water sump near the drilled hole is utilized to serve as an intermediate point, and the water is lifted to a ground high-position pool through a pump. According to a karst region mine water-exploring water-taking device, the drilled hole is connected with a steel pipe A (2), a pressure gauge (3) and a gate valve (4) are installed on the steel pipe A (2), the steel pipe A (2) is connected to the temporary water sump (5), the water pump (7) is installed on a steel pipe B (6), and the steel pipe B (6) is connected with the ground high-position pool (8). The novel water-taking method is found under specific geological conditions of the Guizhou area, and new ideas are provided for drought control and disaster relief in southwest areas.
assignees: GUIZHOU NENGFA GAOZHONG MINING CO LTD

title_en: Firefighter individual positioning device and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a firefighter individual positioning device which comprises a wireless monitoring host. The wireless monitoring host is provided with a plurality of wireless positioning sub hosts and a plurality of wireless beacon nodes which are matched with one another. In specific use, firefighters wear the wireless positioning sub hosts to enter a target building, the wireless monitoring host and the wireless beacon nodes comprehensively position the motion states and the environmental factors of disaster relief personnel, and so that disaster relief is guaranteed to be accurate, timely and efficient. The firefighter individual positioning device has the advantages that a three-dimensional simulation urban map is used as a carrier, real-time tracking and positioning of the firefighters are achieved, teammate searching and rescuing, safe exiting guiding and field poison gas alarming are assisted, a visual basis is provided for commanding, decision-making and dispatching of field rescues, and the extinguishment rescue capacity for fire accident rapid processing of firefighting troops is improved.

title_en: Naive-Bayes-based adaptive lightning disaster risk estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a naive-Bayes-based adaptive lightning disaster risk estimation method, and belongs to the technical field of lightning disaster risk estimation. The method comprises the following steps of selecting an evaluation factor; dividing grid areas; training a Bayes classifier to perfect a classifier database by utilizing an evaluation factor value of a grid to which a lightning disaster happens; and analyzing the data of a grid to be evaluated to obtain a lightning disaster grade by using the Bayes classifier. According to the method, the shortcoming that the subjectivity due to the weighting of the evaluation factor in an analytic hierarchy process is considered to be high is overcome; and lightning disaster data is continuously perfected through the Bayes classifier, so that the prediction accuracy is gradually improved along with the increase of sample data.

title_en: Safety assessment method for pressure-bearing equipment after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of safety assessment of pressure-bearing equipment, and particularly relates to a safety assessment method of pressure-bearing equipment after fire based on damage thermal simulation. The method specifically comprises the following steps: performing on-site inspection on hardness and a metallographic phase; obtaining the hardness and metallographic structure critical value by a thermal simulation experiment; comparing the measured value of the hardness and the metallographic phase by field inspection with the critical value and the normal value of the metallographic structure, entering the next step if the measured value of the hardness and the metallographic phase are met, and directly judging waste if the measured value of the hardness and the metallographic phase are not met; performing macroscopic inspection and nondestructive testing: judging the standard exceeding defect; if the standard exceeding defect is not contained, the strength is directly checked; carrying out fracture and fatigue evaluation if the standard exceeding defect is contained; and after the strength check and the fracture and fatigue evaluation are qualified, determining the allowable working conditions, and putting the allowable working conditions into operation again, and if the strength check and the fracture and fatigue evaluation are unqualified, directly judging the waste or maintaining. The method has high evaluation efficiency, and can quickly and effectively evaluate whether the fire-passing pressure-bearing equipment is suitable for use.
assignees: HEFEI GENERAL MACH RES INST;GUANGDONG INST OF SPECIAL EQUIPMENT INSPECTION AND RES

title_en: Urban water disaster risk prediction method based on RBF (radial basis function) neural network-cloud model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban water disaster risk prediction method based on an RBF (radial basis function) neural network-cloud model. The method includes (1) determining evaluation factors, levels and the indicator range under corresponding levels; (2) determining an expectation Ex and an entropy En of the cloud model; (3) determining the weight of each evaluation factor according to measured values of the evaluation factors and the indicator range of each level; (4) training the RBF neural network, finishing model establishment for the RBF neural network, inputting the measured values of the evaluation factors of the cloud model to the trained RBF neural network to perform simulated prediction, and obtaining a prediction value of each evaluation factor; and (5) substituting the prediction value of each evaluation factor to the integrated cloud model to allow the integrated cloud model to calculate corresponding certainty degree of the prediction value of each evaluation factor belonging to each risk level and multiply the corresponding weight to obtain integrated risk level distribution. The urban water disaster risk prediction method is visualized and reliable and strong in operability, and accuracy of prediction is improved.

title_en: Game theory-based optimal escape route generating method for large-scale crowd evacuation
abstract_en: The invention aims to generate an optimal strategy for crowd evacuation by calculating an optimal evacuation strategy and performing analytic statistics fpr a crowd phenomenon, the crowd density trend of each evacuation path and a key path crowd situation during an overall evacuation process on the basis of the optimal evacuation strategy in the process of simulating large-scale crowd evacuation when a disaster happens. The invention provides a game theory-based optimal escape route generating method for large-scale crowd evacuation. By the method, an optimal evacuation scheme is formed by performing quantitative risk analysis on crowdedness degree factors by adopting a Monte Carlo model according to a disaster radiation region range, the distance from the disaster to an emergency exit, the number of safety measures in escape paths, taking the assessed risk results as the input parameters of a revenue function of a path game, and deciding the choice of the evacuation path through a game theory.

title_en: Digital campus building method based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital campus building method based on the virtual reality technology. The digital campus building method comprises the following steps that a, a three-dimensional campus figure is built; b, a planning layout figure is built, c, a function division layout figure is built; d, single building information is collected; e, building structure information is built; f, road information is built; g, pipeline information is collected; h, the classification of buildings in the planning layout is built; i, the classification of the buildings in function divisions is built; j, pipelines are numbered; k, the pipelines are classified; and l, a bird's-eye view path is built. The digital campus building method has the advantages that the clear and visual displaying of a campus on the three-dimensional campus figure is realized, and the campus can be intuitively and vividly known; under the emergency condition such as fire disasters, the building information can be obtained through networks so that the rescuing can be effectively implemented in time; the pipeline information is built, and the defect that the pipelines are damaged through blind digging is avoided; and the walking, the vehicle running and the bird's-eye view automatic tour guide can be realized in the three-dimensional campus figure.

title_en: Production method for graphene film type clothing and multi-purpose helmet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method for grapheme film type clothing and multi-purpose helmet and relates to the technical field of clothing. By means of the production method, the safety of human battle, work and life is safeguarded, and pregnant women and children can be prevented from being damaged by computer electrostatic radiation. The production method is characterized in that the multi-purpose movable extra-light graphene film helmet is fireproof, rainproof, cold-proof, bulletproof, anti-stabbing, anti-beating, sand-preventing, resistant to computer electrostatic radiation and provided with a small air conditioner, a phone Bluetooth earphone and an anti-haze mask inside, except transparent graphene films glued on eye portions, edges of a plurality of inches of low-cost graphene films which are three yuan per gram are drilled by a small diamond drill and sewn into a cloth shape, seams are glued by thick white plastic films and waterproof strong all-purpose adhesives, then, the graphene films are glued on a bulletproof anti-beating helmet frame made of extra-light carbon fiber super steel or other materials and can be glued and sewn into warm-keeping shirts for single wear as well as firefight uniforms, public security clothes, work clothes, military uniforms (super steel plate clothes are worn inside the upper body) and lining cloth of various clothes.

title_en: Advanced drainage method by aid of drilled holes for water-rich rock strata
abstract_en: The invention discloses an advanced drainage method by the aid of drilled holes for water-rich rock strata. The advanced drainage method is characterized in that the advanced drainage drilled holes are formed in a water-rich rock stratum according to a certain density, water inside the rock stratum seeps and is gathered in the drainage drilled holes by the aid of joint fissures of the water-rich rock stratum under the effect of natural pressure difference, the water in the drainage drilled holes is drained by submersible pumps arranged at the bottoms of the drainage drilled holes, natural pressure difference is formed again, water in the water-rich rock stratum is gathered and drained, and the same procedure is repeated until an advanced quick drainage effect is realized for an ore deposit. The advanced drainage method has the advantages that advanced drainage is performed on the water-rich rock stratum by the aid of underground engineering, the method is high in speed and efficiency and low in investment and cost, a labor condition can be improved, water inrush accidents are effectively prevented, the labor production efficiency is improved, a damage effect due to high pressure of the underground water is eliminated, the strength of construction rock is improved, an engineering support load is reduced, and earth pressure disasters such as collapse, roof falling and rib spalling are prevented.

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling water burst of coal mining base board rock stratum on pressure bearing water body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preventing and controlling water burst of a coal mining base board rock stratum, in particular to a method for preventing and controlling water burst of a coal mining base board rack stratum on a pressure bearing water body. The method comprises the following steps that firstly, a coalface is detected; secondly, drill sites are exploited at the two sides of a lead conveying smooth groove and the two sides of a air returning smooth groove respectively so as to perform drilling according to a detected result in the first step; thirdly, slurry filling casing pipes are arranged at drilling openings of lower three belts of the coal layer base board, and a freezing casing pipe is arranged at the bottommost layer section; fourthly, after drilling is finished, slurry is filled into drill holes, the slurry is sequentially filled, starting from the bottom end and going upwards layer by layer, before the slurry is filled into the bottommost layer and in the slurry filling process, liquid nitrogen is used for performing quick-freezing treatment. According to the method for preventing and controlling water burst of the coal mining base board rack stratum on the pressure bearing water body, the principle that the procedures of detection, slurry filling, freezing and digging are sequentially performed is utilized, slurry filling and freezing are respectively performed on the lower three belts sequentially from bottom to top layer by layer, and therefore water disasters in the excavating process of a deep coal layer base board of a complex geological structure can be effectively prevented from happening.

title_en: Fire disaster working condition simulation system for urban railway traffic vehicle station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire disaster working condition simulation system for an urban railway traffic vehicle station. The fire disaster working condition simulation system comprises a fire alarm monitoring subsystem, a signal input interface, a server, a signal output interface and a fire disaster processing subsystem. The signal input interface receives a signal of a fire alarm monitoring subsystem, and the server processes a signal from the signal input interface and sends an instruction to the fire disaster processing subsystem through the signal output interface. Compared with the prior art, the fire disaster working condition simulation system has the advantages of truly restoring a scene, where a fire disaster happens, in the vehicle station by simulating the scene environment and the like.

title_en: Canonical correlation analysis-based skull identity authentication method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for searching a human face corresponding to an unknown skull from a three-dimensional human face model library based on canonical correlation analysis. The method comprises the following steps: respectively processing skulls and human faces in a training sample set to obtain normalized training sample data; respectively performing subspace analysis on the overall skull, the overall human facial skin, and corresponding regions of forehead, eyes, nose and mouth to obtain ten corresponding subspaces; establishing correlation analysis models of the subspace characteristics of the skull and the human face by utilizing the canonical correlation analysis, wherein the correlation analysis models comprise the correlation analysis models of the whole body and the four subspaces; and realizing human face identification of the unknown skull by model fusion. By the method, the identification rate can reach 100 percent; and the method has an important application value in the fields of criminal investigation, disaster investigation and the like.

title_en: Forest aviatic firefighting water fire extinguishing system and method
abstract_en: A forest aviatic firefighting water fire extinguishing system and method belongs to the technical field of forest aviatic firefighting and particularly relates to an assistant decision-making system and method of forest aviatic firefighting water fire extinguishing. According to the forest aviatic firefighting water fire extinguishing system and method, water fire extinguishing is implemented by concentrating the air superiority, GPRS (general packet radio service) is applied to the forest aviatic firefighting, by means of analyzing alarm signals of forest fire, the place of the forest fire is determined, a geographical layer of a fire place, information of positions of forest fire prevention storage reservoirs, water resource distribution information and traffic route distribution information are provided, meanwhile, neighboring air terminal distribution information and fire extinguishing ability of terminals can be corresponding displayed, an optimal flight path is fitted through relevant factors such as fire level, aircraft landing point position and water requirement in the system, and the result is simulated and transmitted to a terminal. Therefore, the condition of aviatic fire extinguishing can be visually displayed in the shortest time, a quick and efficient assistant decision-making function can be achieved, and a novel method and means is provided for improving the fast control and suppressing capacity of forest fires in China.

title_en: Wired remote controlled ejection type electronic firework firecracker
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wired remote controlled ejection type electronic firework firecracker and belongs to the field of electronic technologies. Traditional firework firecrackers use gunpowder, produce a great deal of smoke at explosion time, and not only pollute the air, but also has the defects such as fire disasters and human body hurt. The electronic firework firecracker is ejected into the sky through an ejection barrel composed of a unique designed high-elastic spring controlled by an electromagnet. Electronic recording sound, electronic music and laser patterns are further provided. The brand-new design that a small parachute is used for delaying the acousto-optic effect time of the electronic firework firecracker in the sky is used, so that traditional firework firecracker lift-off dynamic conditions of the traditional firework firecrackers are completely simulated. The smoke-less wired remote controlled ejection type electronic firework firecracker greatly exceeds the traditional firework firecrackers in acoustic-optic function and effect.
assignees: NANTONG TIANDITONG NETWORK ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Wireless remote control launch-type electronic fireworks
abstract_en: The utility model relates to wireless remote control launch-type electronic fireworks, and belongs to the electronic technical field. Traditional fireworks use gunpowder, a great amount of smog is generated when the fireworks explode, air is polluted, and the defects of fire disasters, personal injuries and the like also exist. The wireless remote control launch-type electronic fireworks is uniquely designed, a wireless remote controller is used for controlling an electromagnet, the electromagnet controls a high elastic force spring to form a launch barrel, electronic fireworks are launched to the sky, electronic record sound, electronic music and colorful laser patterns are added, and small parachutes are used for delaying the acousto-optic effect time of the fireworks in the air, the lift-off dynamic state of the traditional fireworks are completely simulated, the acousto-optic effects all greatly exceed the traditional fireworks, and the novel wireless remote control launch-type electronic fireworks generates no smoke.
assignees: NANTONG TIANDITONG NETWORK ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Training frame for training helicopter tower assembling personnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a training frame for training helicopter tower assembling personnel. The training frame comprises tower sections which are sequentially connected from the top to the bottom, an upper transition rod, a lower transition rod, a bottom section and a base, wherein the base is provided with weights. The training frame can be used for improving operation skills, cooperation proficiency and emergency response capabilities of the helicopter tower assembling construction personnel to finally improve the construction efficiency of the helicopter tower assembling construction and ensure the construction safety. Meanwhile, the training frame also has a function of performance test of supporting guide rails of the helicopter tower assembling construction.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Warship and ship fire disaster damage control reasoning, simulation and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warship and ship fire disaster damage control reasoning, simulation and control system. The warship and ship fire disaster damage control reasoning, simulation and control system comprises a main control part, a plurality of cabin sensors, a sensor state detection module, a sensor state prompting module, a manual selecting module, a three-dimensional model marking module, a fire disaster and cabin information displaying module, a data transmitting module, a fire disaster damage control reasoning module and a three-dimensional fire extinguishment analog simulation module. Because fire disaster information is sent to a fire disaster damage control reasoning system to obtain fire extinguishment processing ideas, the warship and ship fire disaster damage control reasoning, simulation and control system helps control personnel to fast make accurate and safe fire extinguishment decisions, and can accordingly reduce unnecessary personnel damages and economic loss due to the situation that the time for fire extinguishment is delayed by the control personnel or the control personnel makes incorrect decisions. Meanwhile, fire extinguishment process analog can be conducted in the three-dimensional fire extinguishment analog simulation module according to the decisions made by the control personnel. Therefore, fire extinguishment training received by the control personnel and cabin personnel when a warship and ship fire disaster happens can be conducted under an analog simulation environment to ensure that the control personnel and the cabinet personnel are very familiar with tasks and operation requirements, and accordingly fire extinguishment efficiency is improved.

title_en: Disaster recovery backup system availability detection method and device
abstract_en: Disclosed is a disaster recovery backup system availability detection method and device. The method includes step 101, acquiring configuration and operation state information of production environments and disaster recovery backup environments of a data center; step 102, extracting information from the acquired configuration and operation state information according to a disaster recovery backup switch high availability model to form production/disaster recovery backup high availability operation indicators; step 103, generating indicator difference by comparing the production/disaster recovery backup high availability operation indicators; step 104, converting the difference into alarm information or generating statistical reports. The disaster recovery backup system availability detection method and device can be used for timely detecting and tracking and solving the problems which are in the production environments and the disaster recovery backup environments and may affect the disaster recovery backup high availability by combining with ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) processes of the data center under the condition of greatly reducing practical exercises for verifying disaster recovery backup switch availability.

title_en: Modeling and simulation capability for resource consumption and consequence management
abstract_en: The present invention regards modeling and simulation (M&S) capability for resource consumption and consequence management. Embodiments of the system assist emergency planners, government officials, medical professionals, academics and others to prepare for disasters and other emergency events requiring mass evacuation or transportation of people. The system can be used for evacuation, flood and fire modeling, terrorist attacks, military logistics, mail and package delivery, urban planning, supply chain modeling, disaster recovery, animal migration, weather patterns and even in modeling the spread of infectious disease. The system of the present invention is highly extensible and scalable.
assignees: RES & INNOVATION CT INC MID ATLANTIC TECHNOLOGY;MID ATLANTIC TECHNOLOGY RES & INNOVATION CT INC

title_en: Design and construction method for disaster prevention measures in underwater tunnel
title_ko: 수저터널의 재난방재 설계 및 시공방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster prevention design of an underwater tunnel, and a construction method thereof are provided to simplify a construction process and to prevent leakage by making and connecting a multi-tube type vertical structure and a mooring support structure on the ground. CONSTITUTION: A disaster prevention design of an underwater tunnel and a construction method thereof comprise the following steps. A mooring support structure is made and assembled on the ground. A tunnel tube connection box and a vertical multi-tube structure are all made on the ground. One structure is completed by assembling the three structures (a mooring support structure, a tunnel tube connection box, and a vertical multi-tube structure). The completed assembly structure is loaded on a ship, and then installed on a destination. [Reference numerals] (AA) Production and assembly process on the ground; (BB) Production of a mooring support structure, a tunnel tube connection box , and a vertical multi-tube structure; (CC) Assembling of three structures(a mooring support structure, a tunnel tube connection box, and a vertical multi-tube structure) on the ground; (DD) Loading of a completely assembled structure on a barge; (EE) Transport and maritime establishing installation process; (FF) Maritime transport of the completely assembled structure to a destination; (GG) Maritime installation of the completely assembled structure by using a crane for areas with low water depth; (HH) Dropping of the completely assembled structure into the sea for establishing installation in areas with high water depth; (II) Foundation, anchoring, and a tunnel tube installation process; (JJ) Fixing work of the established structure such as piling, onsite drilling, and anchoring; (KK) Installation of the tunnel tube which connects the connection box of the completely assembled structure and the mooring support structure; (LL) Waterproofing and sealing of the joint of the connection box and the tunnel tube; (MM) Connection opening of the connection box and the tunnel tube and upper deck installation processes; (NN) Opening and fixing of the gate of the connection box and the tunnel tube; (OO) Installation of a utility deck on the upper part of the vertical multi-tube above water; (PP) Installation of machinery and equipment such as an elevator and a drainage pump in the vertical multi-tube and the connection box; (S-05) Completion of installation in a target area
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수저터널의 시공방법에 관한 것으로, 차량이 통행하는 중공부 단면을 갖는 터널튜브가 수중에서 누수 되거나 파손 및 기타 사고에 의하여 물이 유입되는 경우, 또는 차량에 의하여 발생되는 오수 및 폐수 등에 대하여 이를 집수하여 배수하는 장치이다. 구체적으로 설명하면, 물밑에 설치된 연속하는 터널구조물을 지지 또는 계류하는 구조물(FRAME, 트러스, 자켓 및 인장력 또는 압축력을 받는 부재 등)과 일체로 접속 BOX와 설치하는 단계와; 이를 운송하여 설치장소에서 수직 직립 설치하는 단계와; 거치된 장소에 수저의 지면과 일체화 되도록 기초, 앵커링 및 터널튜브 설치단계와; 접속 BOX와 터널튜브의 접속 개방 및 상부 데크 설치 단계와; 수저 터널 튜브로 유입되는 물과 차량운행 중 발생된 오폐수를 각각 분리하여 모아서 집수하는 단계와; 상기 지지 또는 계류구조물과 함께 설치된 수저터널의 튜브보다 낮은 위치에 설치하도록 하여 중력으로 물과 오폐수가 각각 분리 집수되게 하는 단계와; 상기 집수된 물을 수표면 위로 배출하는 단계 및 수면 위에 설치된 구조물의 데크(Deck)에 설치된 오폐수 정화시설을 통하여 정화된 물을 배출하는 단계를 포함하는 방법을 제공함과 더불어 차량 및 열차 등의 운행과 수저터널의 운영, 관리에 필수적인 전력급전, 계장장치와 제어기기를 포함한 수면위의 데크(Deck) 구조물, 화재 및 사고, 재난 시에 여객의 구조와 화재진압, 구난 등의 공간을 포함하는 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Modeling and verification system for command and control, and operating method thereof
title_ko: 지휘통제 모델 제작 및 검증시스템 및 이의 운용방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A command and control model developing and reviewing system and an operating method thereof analyze the effectiveness of a battle simulation by reviewing the performance of a command and control feature information model and unit feature information models based on a model test unit. CONSTITUTION: A feature modeling unit (S110) models feature information about a command and control feature information model and unit feature information models controlled by the command and control feature information model. A formation modeling unit (S120) models a composition structure for the unit feature information models based on the feature information. The feature information includes status information indicating the current status of the command and control feature information model, duration time information indicating a duration time of the current status, internal status transition information indicating developments of the status of the command and control feature information model over time, and external status transition information indicating developments of the status of the command and control feature information model influenced by data sent by the unit feature information models. [Reference numerals] (S110) Function modeling unit; (S120) Composition modeling unit; (S130) Rule modeling unit; (S140) Model test unit; (S150) Simulation engine unit; (S160) Storage unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 DEVS(Discrete Event System Specification) 기반의 모델을 기초로 하는 국방 시뮬레이션 시스템과 관련한 지휘통제 모델 제작 및 검증시스템 및 이의 운용방법에 있어서, 상기 지휘통제 모델 제작 및 검증시스템은 지휘통제 기능 정보 모델과 상기 지휘통제 기능 정보 모델에 의해 통제되는 복수의 단위 기능 정보 모델의 기능 정보를 모델링하는 기능 모델링부; 및 상기 모델링된 기능 정보를 기초로, 사전에 정해진 지휘통제체제의 우선순위에 의해 상기 복수의 단위 기능 정보 모델들 사이의 결합구조를 모델링하는 구성 모델링부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 의해 본 발명은 지휘통제 모델에 지휘통제체제에 우선순위를 반영한 결합구조를 적용할 수 있어 보다 정확한 시뮬레이션 결과를 얻을 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for oil field united station fire disaster pre-warning system based on video images
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for oil field united station fire disaster pre-warning system based on video images. The system comprises a fire disaster pre-warning management computer and a fire disaster pre-warning controller connected with the fire disaster pre-warning management computer; the input end of the fire disaster pre-warning management computer is connected with a plurality of image type fire disaster detectors arranged in the monitored oil field united station. The method comprises the following steps: 1, acquiring and transmitting video images, 2, pre-processing the video images, 3, extracting characteristics, 4, acquiring a training sample, 5, constructing BP neural network model, 6, training BP neural network model, and 7, recognizing fire disaster and pre-warning. The system and the method have reasonable design, good real-time property, high sensitivity, high accuracy, high effectiveness and reliability, strong anti-jamming capability, strong practicability, good use effect, and high popularization and application values.

title_en: Method for simulating roadway rock burst based on coaction of static load and blast load
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating roadway rock burst based on coaction of a static load and a blast load. The method comprises the following steps of: A, selecting cement mortar and ramming a model in a rock model testing machine, and embedding a pressure sensor, an acceleration sensor and a strain gage in the model body; B, maintaining the model body within 28 days, applying initial crustal stress to the model body by utilizing the rock model testing machine, and testing force and deformation field distribution characteristics of the model body under the action of the static load; C, simulating actual cavern excavation characteristics, and measuring force and deformation field distribution characteristics in the model body after excavation each time; and D, drilling in the model body, mounting explosive cartridges and detonators in the drill bores, filling with loess, and detonating the explosive. By utilizing the method, the occurrence scale and time of deep roadway rock burst can be effectively predicted, damage of rock burst disasters on mine production settings can be reduced, the mine safety production risk is greatly reduced, and the production efficiency of the mine is greatly improved.

title_en: Spiral type reacting device capable of simulating coal spontaneous combustion process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a spiral type reacting device capable of simulating coal spontaneous combustion process. A reacting device for simulating the coal spontaneous combustion process is designed aiming at coal spontaneous combustion tendency of the coal min, the coal spontaneous combustion rule is scientifically mastered and the technical data of the coal spontaneous combustion is mastered so as to provide scientific evidence for preventing and eliminating the coal spontaneous combustion disaster; the device is advanced in design, the mechanical-electrical integration design and a microcomputer processor are used for processing various test numerical values in informationization mode. The device provided by the invention is compact in structure, reasonable in design, fast in simulating test speed, high in efficiency and strong in accuracy; the device provided by the invention is a completely perfect spiral type reacting device capable of simulating coal spontaneous combustion process.
assignees: SHANXI LU AN ENVIRONMENTAL ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Grooved pipeline connecting piece
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a grooved pipeline connecting piece comprising a fixing sleeve, a connecting arm, and a fixing seat. A threaded piece is provided on the fixing sleeve, the bottom of the fixing sleeve is provided with a boss, an annular groove is provided between the fixing sleeve and the boss, and the fixing seat is provided with a bolt hole. The grooved pipeline connecting piece is characterized in that the boss is provided with positioning grooves. When the connecting piece is applied, the positioning grooves are fit with a positioning device of a machining tool, the pipeline connecting piece is fixed on the machining tool so as to machining an internal thread of the threaded piece, the positioning is accurate and firm, the tool and products are firmly combined during machining and fails to rotate due to the rotation of a drill of a tapping machine, thus the deviation between a central axis of the fixing sleeve and a central axis of the threaded piece is reduced, the coaxiality of the fixing sleeve and the threaded piece is guaranteed, the horizontal and vertical arrangements in the pipeline installation are guaranteed, and convenience is provided in the process of firefighting pipeline installation.

title_en: A kind of violent earthquake preparation process based on ground sound detection method and imminent earthquake monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of violent earthquake preparation process based on ground sound detection method and imminent earthquake monitoring system.By being arranged on the sensor array under gun drilling or deep-well, by the ground acoustical signal comprising complete frequency information, strength information, sound bearing information collected, through signal processing module, signal transmission pathway module, store sending module by master control and data and store and be sent to monitoring center; And by power management module ensure system can in lowered in field environment or disaster also can normally work more than 1 month temporarily.This system can at low cost, reliably, unmanned ground, intensive and on a large scale in violent earthquake preparation process and before imminent earthquake acoustic intelligence monitor for a long time.

title_en: Explosion experiment device for unevenly distributed methane gas
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion experiment device for unevenly distributed methane gas. The explosion experiment device includes an explosion experiment pipeline, an ignition system, an automatic control system, a gas distribution instrument, a testing system, a schlieren system and a high-speed photography system. A plurality of simulation laboratories are arranged in the explosion experiment pipeline, the gas distribution instrument is utilized to complete filling of the methane gas with different concentrations into the different laboratories, and under mutual coordination of the ignition system, the testing system, the schlieren system and the high-speed photography system, so that an explosion process of the unevenly distributed methane gas in an underground roadway is simulated. The explosion experiment device has the advantages of real simulation process, accurate parameter measurement and complete image analysis, fully reveals a law of methane gas explosion, lays a foundation for setting explosion suppression measures, and has important guiding significance for cause investigation of underground methane gas explosion accidents, mine personal protection, disaster early warnings and emergency rescue.

title_en: A single firefighter positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a single firefighter positioning device comprising a wireless monitoring host which is provided with a plurality wireless positioning slaves and a plurality of wireless beacon nodes. The wireless positioning slaves and the wireless beacon nodes cooperate with the host. The wireless monitoring host comprises a monitoring device and a wireless center node device. Each wireless positioning slave comprises a first positioning device, a central processing unit device, a three-axis gyroscope sensing device, a height sensing device, a temperature sensing device, a call-for-help device and a wireless terminal node device. Each wireless beacon node comprises a second positioning device, an environmental monitoring device, a landmark display device and a wireless terminal processing device. With a three-dimensional simulation city map as a carrier, the single firefighter positioning device enables real-time tracking and positioning of firefighters, provides assistance for teammate search and rescue, safe quit guidance and on-site toxic gas alarm, provides direct evidence for commanding, decision-making and scheduling of on-site rescue and thus improves fire-fighting and rescue capability in rapid handling of fire accidents of fire forces.

title_en: Water curtain effect lower-glass response characteristic experimental provision in a kind of fire scenario
abstract_en: The present invention discloses water curtain effect lower-glass response characteristic experimental provision in a kind of fire scenario, forms primarily of water system, water curtain sprinkling system, burning things which may cause a fire disaster simulation system, control system, measuring system and water curtain recovery system, by multiple adjustment, after can realizing simulated fire generation, different time unlatching water curtain acts on the protection (destruction) of glass, in temperature-rise period, different glass type is reacted cold water shock, thickness of glass and flatness of edges, shelter width and cover frame material, water curtain form, water curtain position, water curtain angle, discharge pressure, water curtain injection flow, shower nozzle kind, single spraying head (many shower nozzles) can the breadth extreme of cover glass, the research of simulation fire source type and the factor such as heat release rate and distance, in fairly comprehensive consideration fire scenario, water curtain effect lower-glass breaks the influence factor come off.Autonomous Design water curtain generation device in this experimental provision, can be formed evenly water curtain, reduce and spatter water outlet proportion, improve the utilization factor of water.

title_en: Whole-sealing-type dust removing and collecting integrated device used in drilling and deslagging achieved by wind in mine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a whole-sealing-type dust removing and collecting integrated device used in drilling and deslagging achieved by wind in a mine. The device comprises water fog spray nozzles, a drilling rod, a dust collecting box, a transmitting spiral, a motor and mechanical lifting columns. The drilling rod penetrates through the dust collecting box. The positions, above the drilling rod, inside the dust collecting box are provided the water fog spray nozzles. A position, below the drilling rod, inside the dust collecting box is provided with the transmitting spiral. The transmitting spiral is connected with the motor. The bottom of the dust collecting box is provided with the mechanical lifting columns. The device is suitable for outburst gas mines in China, greatly improves production efficiency of high gas mines and coal and gas outburst mines, reduces the probability of gas disasters, improves poor conditions in gas drilling and deslagging achieved by wind in underground construction, meanwhile overcomes the defects of deslagging achieved by water, improves mine gas extraction drilling construction efficiency and gas extraction efficiency, and guarantees safe and efficient production of a work face.

title_en: Automatic escape device from building fire
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic escape device from a building fire. The automatic escape device comprises an escape net ladder, a winding shaft and a motor, wherein the escape net ladder is made of a high-temperature-resisting fire-proof material and is net-shaped, and one end of the escape net ladder is connected with the winding shaft and is wound on the winding shaft; the motor is in transmission connection with the winding shaft and is used for driving the winding shaft to rotate around the axial direction of the winding shaft and wind and unwind the escape net ladder. The device can be installed at the top edge of a building. When the fire occurs, the motor drives the winding shaft to rotate and unwinds the escape net ladder, the end part of the escape net ladder moves to the ground, and the escape net ladder is positioned at the outer wall of the building; an escape person can climb down to the ground through the escape net ladder and quickly escape by utilizing the instinctive climbing ability, and no training is needed. Meanwhile, the escape person can utilize the escape net ladder to transversely climb to avoid ignition points. The escape person is between the escape net ladder and the outer wall of the building during climbing, thus the climbing safety is higher. Firefighters also can utilize the net ladder to climb for rescue and extinguishment.

title_en: Apparatus and method for controlling light, light system
title_ko: 조명을 제어하는 장치 및 방법, 조명 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A device for controlling a lamp, a method, and a lamp system is provided to control an operation of the lamp by using a wireless network in an emergency situation, thereby effectively operating the lamp. CONSTITUTION: A fire sensing unit (110) outputs an emergency signal by sensing fire generation. When the emergency signal is outputted, a control signal generation unit (120) generates a control signal for controlling a lamp according to a disaster scenario of a lamp system. The disaster scenario includes the information for lamps to be turned on/off in a fire situation. A wireless communication unit (130) wirelessly transmits the control signal to one or more wireless devices. A wireless device includes at least one of a wireless dimmer, a wireless switch, a motion sensor, and an illumination sensor. [Reference numerals] (10) Lighting control device; (110) Fire sensing unit; (120) Control signal generation unit; (130) Wireless communication unit; (140) Fire alarm unit
abstract_ko: 조명 시스템의 조명 제어 장치는 긴급 상황에서 비상 신호가 출력된 경우 미리 설정된 방재 시나리오에 따라 조명을 제어하기 위한 제어 신호를 생성하고, 조명의 동작을 제어하는 무선 디바이스에 생성된 제어 신호를 무선으로 전송한다..

title_en: High-altitude slow-descending parachute
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire protection and accident protection rescue devices and equipment, and relates to a high-altitude slow-descending parachute. The high-altitude slow-descending parachute comprises longitudinal parachute partitions, air intake seam strips, an inner-parachute lower opening edge, inner-parachute pull rods, inner-parachute support rods, a parachute top fixing nut, a support rod pivot, an inter-parachute opening, an inner parachute cover, a parachute cover, a parachute edge bag cavity, parachute ropes, an air intake seam, a parachute holding lantern ring, parachute rope fasteners, a parachute rod, a pedal fixing nut, a pedal, a longitudinal spring board, a transverse spring board, an upper spring board fixing nut, a lower spring board fixing nut, a pedal spring, a spring fixing shaft, an inter-parachute cavity, a parachute edge bag wall, an inner-parachute lower cavity and a cushioning structure. The high-altitude slow-descending parachute has the advantages that a principle that great impact force generated during high-altitude falling can be cushioned by means of lowering object falling speed by the parachute and simulating arched spinal appearances of animals such as cats, an escape device is provided for people who are in high-altitude places and cannot quickly leave disaster sites from normal passages when disasters such as fire happen, and the people can be allowed to directly jump down from the high altitude by stepping on the high-altitude slow-descending parachute without life risk.
assignees: CHANGSHU NANJING NORMAL UNIV DEV RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster prediction system and method based on porous media fluid-structure interaction model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological disaster prediction system and method based on a porous media fluid-structure interaction model. The geological disaster prediction system and method based on the porous media fluid-structure interaction model comprises the following steps that geological parameters of a geological area to be predicted are collected; according to the geological characteristics and geological parameters of the geological area to be predicted, a hydrogeology concept model is built; according to the geological disaster type to be predicted and the geological characteristics of the area to be predicted, a finite element method is adopted to convert the hydrogeology concept model into a corresponding three-dimensional underground water mathematic model, and the displacement of the geological area to be predicted and the simulation result of distribution situation of stress along with space and time are obtained; the simulation result is output in the mode of image and/or data characters, and the simulation result is used for describing flowing of water among gap media and the sedimentation situation of underground soil; the occurrence time, the geological range and the forming mechanism of the geological disaster are predicted, and a solution scheme is given. The geological disaster predication system and method based on the porous media fluid-structure interaction model can predict geological disasters such as land subsidence, foundation settlement, landslide, debris flow, operation speed is high and accuracy is good.
assignees: HUBEI THINGO TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Main line manhole emergency simulation system, method, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a main line manhole emergency simulation system, which is simple and is used in a simple method, capable of easily estimating which main line manhole is in risk of overflow even in the case of emergency that, for example, a disaster or the like occurs, a method, and a program.SOLUTION: A main line manhole emergency simulation system includes: input means 10 for inputting a water level of an inflow duct of a sewage treatment plant, or a water level of an inflow duct of a pumping station, or a water level of any main line manhole; calculation means 20 for estimating a water level of filthy water in each main line manhole from the water level of the inflow duct of the sewage treatment plant, or the water level of the inflow duct of the pumping station, or the water level of any main line manhole inputted from the input means 10, and estimating a main line manhole which is in risk of overflow from the estimated water level; and output means 30 for displaying the main line manhole which is in risk of overflow estimated by the calculation means 20.

title_en: Novel coal bed hydraulic broaching safety protection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel coal bed hydraulic broaching safety protection device which comprises a drilling protection pipe, a protection cover, a drainage connection pipe, a gas water slag separation box and an air bag. One end of the drilling protection pipe is provided with a flange in abutting connection with the protection cover, one end of the protection cover clings to a drill rod in a sliding sealing mode, a flange at the other end is in abutting connection with the drilling protection pipe, a gas water slag discharging port is arranged in the middle, and the protection cover is connected with the gas water separation box through the drainage connection pipe. Gas with pressure and sprayed abruptly in a buffering mode and control gas, water and slag can flow to the gas water slag separation box. According to a result of repeated onsite experiments, the device is good in protection effect, capable of effectively preventing methane and coal slag sprayed from a drill hole from impacting operators and devices and the like, meanwhile capable of preventing transfinite methane and other secondary methane disasters, capable of effectively preventing the problems of methane and slag abrupt spraying in the outburst coal bed hydraulic broaching, hydraulic drilling and bed penetration drilling operation processes, capable of preventing secondary methane disasters and applicable to wide popularization and application.

title_en: Spiral reaction device for simulating coal spontaneous combustion process
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a spiral reaction device for simulating a coal spontaneous combustion process, which is used for simulating and designing the coal spontaneous combustion process according to a coal spontaneous combustion tendency condition of the coal mine, so that the coal spontaneous combustion rule is scientifically mastered, and the coal spontaneous combustion technical data is mastered to provide scientific basis for preventing and eliminating the coal spontaneous combustion disasters. According to the spiral reaction device disclosed by the utility model, the design is advanced, an electromechanical integral design is adopted, and a micro computer processor is adopted for carrying out information processing on each test value. Besides, the device is compact in structure, reasonable in design, quick in test simulation speed, high in efficiency and high in accuracy, and therefore, the spiral reaction device has a very ideal spontaneous combustion process simulating effect.
assignees: SHANXI LU AN ENVIRONMENTAL ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Debris flow disaster early monitoring system based on internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow disaster early monitoring system based on the internet of things. The debris flow disaster early monitoring system comprises an internet of things cloud server and a weather center connected with the cloud server through communication. The cloud server is connected with a wireless sensor network through communication. The wireless senor network comprises network nodes, a soil moisture sensor, a soil inner pressure sensor and a locating device. Data detected by the soil moisture sensor, data detected by the soil inner pressure sensor and data detected by the locating device are respectively transmitted to the cloud server though the network nodes. The wireless sensor network is laid in the zone with the requirements for debris flow disaster monitoring, soil is detected through the soil moisture sensor and the soil inner pressure sensor in the wireless sensor network, movement displacement of soil is detected by the locating device, weather data, collected by the weather center, of the surroundings are combined, calculation and simulation of the cloud processor are conducted, therefore, the purposes that a debris flow disaster is monitored in real time and the accuracy is high are achieved.

title_en: Based on transmitting line disaster monitoring and the risk evaluating system of satellite and weather information
abstract_en: The present invention is in order to effectively carry out disaster alarm, it provides a kind of transmitting line disaster monitoring based on satellite and weather information and risk assessment platform. This platform comprises transmitting line geography information sub-platform, satellite Remote sensing data reception sub-platform, data modeling and risk assessment sub-platform, disaster alarm and disposal sub-platform, and supports and operation sub-platform. Described data modeling and risk assessment sub-platform comprise fire prediction of the development trend submodule block, this submodule block adopts the integrated moving average of autoregression to predict the sequential of fire data as time prediction method, Dynamic Recurrent Neural Network is adopted to catch between fire the spatial coherence hidden as space predicting method, carry out the random perturbation of simulated fire again with markov chain model, finally with statistical regression obtain space-time integrated, go predicting the outcome of disturbance.

title_en: Emergent escape risk avoiding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergent escape risk avoiding device through which causalities caused by collapsed buildings or high furniture when the earthquake disaster happens and indoor people escaping from the earthquake can be reduced. The emergent escape risk avoiding device structurally comprises a connecting box formed in a stamping or welding forming mode. A pull rod and a connecting hole connected with a supporting rod are pre-fabricated in the connecting box. The supporting rod with a section of thread is made of round steel, the end of the supporting rod combined with the connecting box is forged into a flat circular shape, and a connecting hole is pre-drilled in the end. The supporting rod is provided with a hinged base matched with a shielding steel plate hinged wedge. A supporting rod with a section of thread is made of round steel, a connecting plate connected with a connecting component is arranged below the supporting rod, and the connecting plate is provided with a connecting hole in a reserved mode. The supporting rods are connected together through a sleeve with a spanner hole to form a support of the emergent escape risk avoiding device. The support is installed on the connecting box through the pull rod with the two ends provided with threads and limiting nuts, the connecting box is further provided with a pulling rod with the two ends provided with threads and limiting nuts, and the pulling rods are fixed through nuts respectively. The connecting component is connected with a support of a shielding steel plate surface in a welding mode. One end of the other connecting component is fixed on the connecting plate of the support on the other side through a hinge pin, and the other end of the other connecting component is fixed in a bolt mode. The shielding steel plate of the emergent escape risk avoiding device is made up of a steel plate, a strip hole is formed in the shielding steel plate in a pre-fabricated mode, a vibration reduction block is arranged at the position where the shielding steel plate is in contact with each support, and the upper portion of the shielding steel plate is provided with the hinged wedge matched with the supporting rod hinged base, and the shielding steel plate is installed on the supporting rod hinged base through a hinge pin.

title_en: Hydrological dynamic monitoring and alarming system for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hydrological dynamic monitoring and alarming system for a coal mine. The system comprises a monitoring computer which is arranged at a control center, wherein the monitoring computer is provided with an RS485 communication interface and a telemetering radio receiver; the RS485 communication interface is respectively connected with a ground monitoring substation used for monitoring the flow of a ground discharge pipeline and an underground monitoring substation used for monitoring underground hydrology through an RS485 bus; and the telemetering radio receiver performs radio communication with a water level telemeter which is used for monitoring a hydrological observing drill hole. The technological content of mines on the aspect of preventing and controlling water disasters is greatly improved; the real-time monitoring and overrun warning management of hydrological parameters in coal mining are realized; mine safety principals can master the mine water level, water temperature and flow data at first time; great significances to guide coal mine safe production and prevent and control water disasters are available; and the production safety of mines is ensured.
assignees: ANHUI HENGYUAN COAL ELECTRICITY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Energy-saving environment-friendly simulation electric firework
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an energy-saving environment-friendly simulation electric firework which is composed of a suspending hole, a shell body, a battery box, a sounder, a remote control receiving window, a sound effect controller, a connecting wire, and a firework flashlight. The battery box, the sounder and the sound effect controller are respectively arranged in the shell body. The remote receiving window is arranged in the shell body. The sounder, the sound effect controller and the remote control receiving window are respectively connected with the battery box. The connecting wire is connected with the sounder. The firework flashlight is arranged on the connecting wire. The suspending hole is formed in the shell body. The energy-saving environment-friendly simulation electric firework is simple in structure, reasonable in design, does not need flame ignition so as to be safe and reliable and eradicate fire disasters and personal harm caused by playing fireworks, is capable of being played as long as a remote control is operated manually, and free of smoke and paper scraps, saves energy, protects the environment, does not pollute the environment, and is safe and convenient to store and transport.

title_en: Safety system of actual fire training device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a safety system of an actual fire training device such that the safety system secures the safety of a trainee to improve the safety firstly if an emergency situation occurs during a training, burning of the training device itself and a damage accident are prevented secondary, and it is easy to achieve the improvement and prevention thirdly.SOLUTION: A safety system 25 makes preparations against an emergency situation such as evacuation in a case of emergency by an actual fire training device 1 which conducts fire-extinguishment disaster preventive training in the presence of thick smoke and hot air to be experienced in. A main body part 2 of the actual fire training device 1 is in a large-sized casing shape to serve as a training booth for the trainee, and provided with a combustion and smoking corner which produces thick smoke and hot air. The safety system 25 is added to the main body part 2 and includes an opening part 26 and a closing body 27 provided to a wall surface. The closing body 27 normally closes the opening part 26, and can open the opening part 26 in a case of emergency.

title_en: Disaster backup information system simulation method based on two places and three centers
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster backup information system simulation method based on two places and three centers. A simulated disaster backup information system is built according actual needs of a user. Disaster information system drilling processes, caused by a disaster, such as fault injection, fault repair, fault detection, data center switching and back-switching, data storage, and data validity verification are realized. Three signal states, namely a normal state, a fault state and a center replaced state exist in the system. System signals are utilized to realize disaster backup flow control, cost is lowered, work efficiency is increased, disaster backup data and production data sharing storage are user at the same time, and space is saved.

title_en: Direct drinking water bag for river water
abstract_en: The invention relates to a direct drinking water bag for river water, and belongs to the technical field of drinking water purification treatment. The technical scheme is as follows: a raw water direct drinking processor is mounted in the water bag; an adsorption unit, a sterilization unit and a filter unit are arranged; a water outlet is provided with a water suction tube; drinking water is sucked out of the water suction tube for drinking by using suction force of a human body; and gas is blown into the bag from the water suction tube by using blowing force of the human body, and water is forced to flow backwards, so that back wash is performed. A soft direct drinking processor has the same functions as those of the raw water direct drinking processor, is an independent drinking water processing tool, can be used in any containers separately, and can also realize direct drinking in rivers, ponds and brooks. The direct drinking water bag has the benefits as follows: turbid water can be clarified, so that a drinking water standard is reached; bacteria which exceed standards in water can be killed, so that the drinking water standard is reached; and the direct drinking water bag has practical values in applications such as vast rural areas with no tap water supply, special periods of earthquake and flood disasters, filed training of troops, frontier sentry post patrols, wars and the like.
assignees: JILIN YOUHAO ENVIRONMENTAL PROT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic priority scenario for fire alarm system and management method based on fire location information in the building
title_ko: 건축물에서의 화재 발생 위치에 기반한 동적 우선순위 시나리오 화재 알림 경보 제공 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides fire alarm for resident safety by solving an alarm problem based on fire and an alarm and a release function to residents by calculating dynamic priority scenario based on the changed location and context information and by notifying the change of the fire to the residents, and the residents can safely move to safe areas by accurately operating voice alarm and visual alarm functions by realizing a cutting-edge technology in a home device which is supplied currently. The home device comprises an alarm device, a wired/wireless communication network, and a management server. The fire alarm is provided to the residents or public areas by realizing a fire location information treatment process in the management server. The present invention, more specifically, relates to the system and the method calculating the dynamic priority setup scenario based on the fire location information and inducing the residents to move to a safe fire escape along with a guide and information based on a current condition by providing the fire alarm to the residents. [Reference numerals] (100) Dynamic priority scenario fire alarm system;(115) Managing monitor;(120) Receiver interlocking protocol unit;(130) Complex server interlocking protocol unit;(140) Fire alarming operating unit;(150) Fire alarming initiating unit;(160) Fire alarming releasing unit;(170) Database system (DBMS);(180) Graphic user interface (GUI);(190) Dynamic fire alarming initiating unit;(200) Complex server;(210) Fire alarming interlocking unit;(300) Wall pad;(320) Voice alarming device;(340) Time alarming device;(400) Fire receiver;(500) Fire detector
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재발생에 의한 경보 알림 문제점을 해결하여 입주자 안전을 위한 화재발생 알림 경보를 제공하는 것으로, 발생한 화재의 변화 상황을 입주자에게 신속히 알리며 화재 발생 위치 및 변화된 위치/상황 정보에 기반한 동적 우선순위 시나리오를 산출하여 이에 따라 동적으로 입주자에게 경보 및 해제를 제공하고, 현재 보급 중인 홈 기기에 첨단 IT 기술을 실현하여 음성경보 및 시각 경보 기능을 적절하게 동작하게 함으로써 입주자들이 안전한 대피를 할 수 있도록 한다. 이를 위해 홈기기, 경보장치, 유/무선 통신 네트워크 및 관리 서버를 구성으로 하고, 관리 서버에 화재 위치정보 처리 프로세스를 구현하여 공동 주거지 역 내 또는 세대 내 입주자에게 신속한 화재 경보가 가능하도록 하는 화재알림 경보를 제공한다. 특히 본 발명에 따른 시스템 및 방법은 화재 발생 위치정보에 기반한 동적 우선순위 설정 시나리오를 산출하고 이에 따른 화재 알림 경보를 제공하여 입주자가 화재 위치와 현재 상황에 맞는 정보와 안내에 따라 안전한 대피로로 이동할 수 있도록 함을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Support system for group training of indoor using mixed reality
title_ko: 융합 현실을 이용한 실내 집단훈련 지원시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor group training support system using mixed reality, and is to provide an indoor training space, wherein a virtual image of each simulated group training scenario is projected on a screen, for a group training participants. For this, one implementation form of the present invention provides a group training support system which includes multiple training units and a group training management server. The multiple training units are activated by a group training initiation signal; project a virtual image about a simulated group training scenario on an indoor screen; recognize a body motion of a trainee and shot location coordinates from gunfire; reflect the body motion and coordinates in the virtual image; individually store the body motion and coordinates in personal training result information of the trainee and in group-wise training result information of a group to which the trainee belongs; and transmit the training result information to an upper level management server. The group training management server receives virtual image information about each of multiple simulated group training scenarios for group training, wherein the virtual image information is configured in advance through an operator terminal, and personal information of each trainee and personal and group-wise training result information which are transmitted from each training unit; stores the information in a database; transmits a group training initiation signal for activating the multiple training units, and a virtual image of each simulated group training scenario to each training unit; and controls group training which is individually performed at each training unit. Therefore, the present invention can solve environmental problems such as fixed facilities, fixed targets, limited scenarios, etc. in a military tactical training process such as counter-terrorism, disaster relief, protest suppression, etc., and improve the effect of training. [Reference numerals] (100,200) Training unit;(300) Group training managing server;(310) Operator terminal
abstract_ko:

title_en: Method and device for simulating ground crack hazards
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and device for analyzing hazards of ground crack activities to substructures of high-speed rails, and belongs to the field of geological disaster analysis. The method comprises the steps of simulating a film effect of a geogrid, identifying the strength relationship between the geogrid and peripheral detritus, judging opening and extrusion between a concrete plate and a peripheral soil body, determining the opening strength and the extrusion strength, and simulating CFG piles on the lower portion of the concrete plate and soil among the CFG piles to respectively bear loads on the upper portions. According to the method and device, consideration is given to the fact that a track, a foundation bed, the geogrid and the CFG composite foundations and the like are made of different materials, simulation computation on models corresponding to different materials is carried out based on a Flac3D numerical value, the accuracy for simulating the hazards of the ground crack activities to the substructures of the high-speed rails is improved, and the problem that the bottom of the concrete plate is hollowed when the ground crack activities are carried out are solved.

title_en: Debris flow disaster-approaching monitoring system based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a debris flow disaster-approaching monitoring system based on the Internet of Things (IOT). The debris flow disaster-approaching monitoring system comprises an IOT cloud server, and a weather center which is in communication connection with the cloud server, wherein the cloud server is in communication connection with a wireless sensor network, the wireless sensor network comprises network nodes, soil moisture sensors, soil internal pressure sensors and positioning devices, and data of the soil moisture sensors, the soil internal pressure sensors and the positioning devices is transmit to the cloud server through the network nodes. By laying the wireless sensor network in areas in need of debris flow monitoring, detecting the soil through the soil moisture sensors and the soil internal pressure sensors in the wireless sensor network, detecting the soil movement displacement through the positioning devices, and combining the ambient weather data acquired by the weather center, the purpose of carrying out real-time and high-precision monitoring on debris flow disasters is achieved through calculation and simulation of a cloud processor.

title_en: Embedded joist pile plate structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an embedded joist pile plate structure which is used for constructing a roadbed in a karst intensively growing zone. The embedded joist pile plate structure comprises drilling pouring piles, reinforced concrete joists and bearing plates. The drilling pouring piles are vertically inserted into a stable rock layer under a karst cave and horizontally and lengthwise distributed within a roadbed body along the roadbed. The reinforced concrete joists horizontally connect the drilling pouring piles along the roadbed body into a whole. Pile bodies on the tops of the drilling pouring piles and vertical main ribs are deeply penetrated into the reinforced concrete joists and are connected with the reinforced concrete joists to form a horizontal whole structure. Vertically-upwards flanking columns are arranged at two ends of each reinforced concrete joist and the bearing plates are connected to the tops of the joists in an overlap mode. The two sides of each bearing plate are arranged on the inner sides of the flanking columns. The roadbed body is filled into the upper portions of the bearing plates in a constructed mode. According to the embedded joist pile plate structure, the bearing plates on the embedded joist pile plate structure are used for transmitting loads of the upper portion to the pile bodies on the lower portion through the concrete joists, and therefore the loads are dissipated into the stable rock layer under the piles. The problem of processing a karst foundation is solved and karst collapse disasters caused by additional loads generated on karst top plates due to soil filling are avoided.

title_en: Mine emergency rescue computer analogue simulation and evaluation system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine emergency rescue computer analogue simulation and evaluation system. The system comprises a client side which is provided with a control module, an upper computer which is provided with a simulation module, a demonstration module for demonstrating a mine accident scene and a programmable center control machine which serves as a master control component. The client side is in mutual information sending and receiving with the upper computer and the programmable center control machine in a wired or wireless manner. The upper computer is connected with the demonstration module through a stereoscopic fuser. The demonstration module and the stereoscopic fuser are connected with the programmable center control machine. The mine emergency rescue computer analogue simulation and evaluation system builds a vivid disaster environment through the virtual reality technology, so that the trainees are like being in the scene, not only emergency rescue actual combat capability can be improved, but also the psychological enduring capacity and equipment service condition of the trainees are tested and evaluated, and meanwhile, danger and waste brought forward by utilizing real equipment to train are reduced.
assignees: FUSHUN FUYUN ANYI LIFESAVING EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Methods and compositions for a multipurpose, lab-on-chip device
abstract_en: Methods and compositions for developing a series of microfluidic, USB-enabled, wireless-enabled, lab-on-chip devices, designed to reduce the chain-of-custody handling of samples between sample acquisition and final reporting of data, to a single individual. These devices provide on-the-spot testing for micro- and nanoscale (molecular) analysis of blood, urine, infectious agents, toxins, measurement of therapeutic drug levels, purity-of-sample testing and presence of contaminants (toxic and non-toxic, volatile and non-volatile); and for the identification of individual components and formal compounds—elemental, biological, organic and inorganic—inclusive of foodstuffs, air, water, soil, oil and gas samples. These devices may be relatively inexpensive, ruggedly designed, lightweight and capable of being employed—depending upon the specific application—by individuals with limited training, in remote and extreme environments and settings: including combat zones, disaster areas, rural communities, tropical/arctic/desert and other inhospitable climates and challenging terrains. The device may be comprised of materials that are reclaimed, are re-usable and are recyclable.

title_en: Sub-pixel drawing method based on vector boundaries
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sub-pixel drawing method based on vector boundaries. The method comprises the steps that the accurate vector boundaries of ground objects in a mixed pixel are extracted by utilizing component (end members) area vectors or abundance of the mixed pixel or an adjacent pixel, then the accurate vector boundaries are converted into grids (sub-pixels) of the specific enlarging scales, and then the sub-pixel drawing of a video is completed. The sub-pixel drawing method based on the vector boundaries has the advantages of being wide in practicability, high in calculation speed, high in simulation precision, and suitable for remote sensing data to carry out the geoscience information extraction and geoscience data mining work such as target extraction, territorial resources surveys, global climate changes, disaster monitoring and disaster situation assessment.
assignees: INST GEOG SCI & NR RES CAS

title_en: Experiment system for simulating deep tunnel blasting induced disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an experiment system for simulating a deep tunnel blasting induced disaster, which relates to the technical field of deep tunnel blasting excavation, and is used for finding the influence of blasting load on original cracking groups of deep surrounding rocks in the neighborhood of tunnels and for providing an evidence of a safe distance between the deep surrounding rocks and the deep tunnels in the neighborhood and an evidence of economic and reasonable support of the deep tunnels.
