The experiment system comprises a test block support, a blasting loading device, a confining pressure loading device, a data acquisition device and a data analysis device, wherein pre-cracks are formed around a simulated deep tunnel on a test block; blast holes for charging explosives are formed in the periphery of the simulated deep tunnel; the blasting loading device is used for detonating the explosives; the confining pressure loading device is used for applying confining pressure to the periphery of the test block; the data acquisition device is used for dynamically acquiring the damage conditions around the simulated deep tunnel; the data analysis device is used for analyzing the acquired damage conditions to acquire influence data of the damage around the simulated deep tunnel caused by the blasting. The experiment system is suitable for a simulation experiment of the deep tunnel blasting induced disaster.

title_en: Firefighter training device
Information processing method, information processing apparatus, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To perform prior and sequential analysis of works for recovering lifelines when disaster, such as an earthquake and a typhoon occurs.SOLUTION: A local information storage part 120 stores local data 10. An electric power distribution facility information storage part 130 stores electric power distribution facility data 20. A commander simulation part 141, a patrolman simulation part 142, and a recovery person simulation part 143 refer to the local information storage part 120 and the electric power distribution facility information storage part 130, and simulate works done by a commander, a patrolman, and a recovery person, respectively. The recovery person simulation part 143 simulates moving of the recovery person to a disaster place and command waiting from the commander.

title_en: Three-dimensional firefighting training and drill evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional firefighting training and drill evaluation method, and mainly aims to solve the problem that in the prior art, the three-dimensional firefighting training and drill evaluation digitization degree is not high. By the adoption of the three-dimensional firefighting training and drill evaluation method, users log in to a three-dimensional firefighting training and drill evaluation platform through networks, and then learning and evaluation of firefighting training and drill are achieved. The three-dimensional firefighting training and drill evaluation platform has the three-dimensional modes of learning, operation and assessment and mainly comprises a firefighting extinguishment basic theory training module, a firefighting equipment operating instruction training module, a representative chemical engineering accident case training module, a chemical engineering accident firefighting emergency drill and evaluation training module and an experimental training environment. According to the technical scheme, a local area network is built by multiple computers, and various interaction modes with training scenes are provided. The three-dimensional firefighting training and drill evaluation method can solve the problem and used for three-dimensional firefighting training and drill evaluation.

title_en: Rapid testing device for fire endurance of fireproof coating of steel structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid testing device for the fire endurance of a fireproof coating of a steel structure. The device comprises a fire endurance testing furnace, a fire endurance testing framework, a sample fixing device, a ventilation drying oven and a temperature measuring thermoelectric couple, wherein after a steel plate base material coated with the fireproof coating is dried and maintained by the ventilation drying oven, the steel plate base material is fixedly mounted in the sample fixing device; in the testing process, the sample fixing device is fixedly arranged on the fire endurance testing framework, the fire endurance testing framework is fixedly arranged on an opening of the fire endurance testing furnace, and the temperature measuring thermoelectric couple is arranged on a non-exposure face of the steel plate base material; the fire endurance testing framework is provided with a plurality of grooves for fixing the sample fixing device. According to the rapid testing device for the fire endurance of the fireproof coating of the steel structure, the testing cost and the testing time are reduced under the condition of simulating a real fire disaster environment to the greatest extent, and the rapid testing of the fireproof coating of the steel structure can be realized.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BUILDING MATERIALS INST LTD COMPANY

title_en: Simulation apparatus for chemical disaster accident
abstract_en: Provided in the utility model is a simulation apparatus for a chemical disaster accident. The simulation apparatus comprises a pedestal with wheels and simulation devices installed at the pedestal with wheels; and the simulation devices are connected with an external air supply source or a liquid supply source by external pipes. A plurality of simulation wound units are arranged on the simulation devices; particularly, the simulation wound units are arranged at the outer walls of the simulation device, are arranged at connection pipes among all the simulation devices, or are arranged at the external pipes for connection of the simulation devices with external devices. With the simulation apparatus, scenes of common chemical disaster accidents with leakage of a container, a tower, a pipeline and a tank and the like during chemical production, storage and transport processes can be simulated; and the simulation apparatus can be applied to training for fire-fighting emergency simulation detection and examination as well as leakage stopping and the like.

title_en: Combined advanced prediction method based on priori form information constraint for tunnel and other underground constructions
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined advanced prediction method based on priori form information constraint for a tunnel and other underground constructions. The method mainly comprises the steps that geological data and drilling data collected in a detection area are analyzed, advanced prediction data collection is conducted on an important high-risk water sudden-flooding area through a land sonar method, a transient electromagnetic method, a geological radar method and an induced polarization method, and determinacy detection result abnormality is used as known priori information; according to an obtain abnormal area, the direction vector and weight of the area are built, a priori information constraint diagonal matrix is formed through assembly, the induced polarization inversion is constrained, and the combined advanced prediction method based on priori form information constraint is achieved. The combined advanced prediction method achieves combined prediction data constraint, significantly suppresses multiplicity, and improves accuracy and reliability of combined advanced prediction. Three-dimensional space form prediction of a water-sudden-flooding disaster source in front of tunnel face, and recognition to the boundary of the water-sudden-flooding disaster source can be achieved particularly.

title_en: Disaster detection system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster detection system which can seek an optical flow in which the vibration component is suppressed, even if vibration is generated due to strong wind or upon occurrence of a diaster such as debris flood, and can avoid the influence of vibration due to strong wind or vibration upon occurrence of a diaster.SOLUTION: A disaster detector 80 previously determines the histogram for each direction and the standard deviation σ1 of an optical flow in normal state, during training period. Subsequently, when the disaster detection system is operating during the monitoring period, the histogram for each direction and the standard deviation σ2 of an optical flow are determined for each frame, from an input image 1001 inputted from a monitor camera 10. The standard deviation σ1 in normal state is compared with the standard deviation σ2 during the monitoring period, and it is examined whether σ2>α×σ1(α:predetermined constant). If the answer is YES, a determination is made that abnormal state has occurred (debris flow is detected).

title_en: Elevator control system and method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an elevator control system or an elevator control method which enable an appropriate evacuation operation of an elevator when a disaster occurs in a building.SOLUTION: In performing evacuation training, highly evaluated operation contents out of evacuation operations executed before are partially changed and an evacuation operation is executed according to the changed contents, the evacuation operation is evaluated based on a measured value of evacuation time by the evacuation operation, and highly evaluated operation contents are shared among a plurality of buildings, by which an appropriate evacuation operation according to the attribute of a building is executed when a disaster occurs.

title_en: Middle or short term forecasting method for landslide time
abstract_en: The invention relates to a middle or short term forecasting method for landslide time. Middle or short term forecast is conducted on landslide by utilizing a computer program, and the landslide and abrupt slide time is forecast. A landslide time middle or short term forecasting polynomial model is established, the model is simple in structure, high in operability, good in simulation effect and capable of achieving landslide real time tracking forecast. The middle or short term forecast is dynamic tracking forecast, in the forecast process, each time new observation data are obtained, a landslide parameter is processed and is substituted into a landslide middle or short term forecasting system for forecast, and each monitoring point can obtain a determined solution. Forecast is performed according to the latest change feature, the middle or short term forecasting method for the landslide time can achieve real-time tracking forecast so as to be accurate and reliable, has high adaptability to the middle or short term forecast, solves the problems of low efficiency, low reliability, complex calculation and the like of the landslide forecast, and can well serve prevention and reduction of natural disasters.

title_en: Foundation cloud atlas classification method based on spatial pyramid random mapping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foundation cloud atlas classification method based on spatial pyramid random mapping. The method comprises the following steps of firstly, extracting local features from each training foundation cloud atlas sample in a denseness sampling manner; then, carrying out dimensionality reduction on each local feature by applying random mapping, and mapping an original high-dimensionality feature set to a low-dimensionality subspace; then, clustering features which are subjected to dimensionality reduction in the low-dimensionality subspace, so as to obtain a codebook; then, dividing a sample image into different areas according to a spatial pyramid model, obtaining area features of the different areas according to the codebook, combining the area features, and taking the combined area features as final feature representation of the sample image; finally, obtaining a classification result of a tested foundation cloud atlas by applying a support vector machine classifier. According to the method, spatial information of the image can be obtained through applying the spatial pyramid model, so that information in the cloud atlas can be better represented; meanwhile, the local features of the image are subjected to dimensionality reduction by adopting random mapping, so that the efficiency of a foundation cloud atlas classification system can be increased, the time expense is reduced, and the dimensionality disaster can be avoided.
assignees: KANJON SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Environment-friendly gas exhaust device capable of exhausting gas and cyclically injecting water
abstract_en: An environment-friendly gas exhaust device capable of exhausting gas and cyclically injecting water is provided. During coal bed gas extraction, as a result of excessive extraction of groundwater, there are often ground surface subsidence and groundwater level decline, leading to leaks of toxic and hazardous gases such as coal bed gas and even causing severe environmental disasters. To solve the problems, we invent the environment-friendly gas exhaust device capable of exhausting gas and cyclically injecting water. The device is characterized in that groundwater extracted during gas extraction is sent back underground, so that the novel device allows coal bed gas extraction to be carried out without damaging the environment while the drilling water level and the negative pressure of gas exhaust are in a dynamic balance.

title_en: Fire extinguishing apparatus for simulation fire training
title_ko: 모의소방훈련용 소화장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire extinguishing equipment for a simulated firefighting training, which shows a fire situation, similar to an actual situation, on a display member and allows for practicing a firefighting process suitable for the produced fire situation. According to the present invention, the fire extinguishing equipment comprises a display member including an image display means which displays a video including fire safety guidelines to be followed in the outbreak of fire and an actual fire situation, and an image input means for displaying the video on the image display means; and a fire hydrant installed under the display member to be able to spray fumes toward the image display means, and including an air supplier for supplying air, a smoke supplier for supplying smoke, a controller for controlling the mixing of the air and smoke supplied by the air supplier and the smoke supplier, respectively, a fire hose controlled by the controller and spraying fumes, which are combined of the air and the smoke, to the image display means, and a power supply for supplying electric power to the display member. [Reference numerals] (110) Image display means; (120) Image input means; (130) Fire extinguishment detection means; (140) Remote controller; (210) Air supplier; (220) Smoke supplier; (221) Heater unit; (222) Pump unit; (223) Heat insulation unit; (230) Controller; (231) Fire hydrant valve; (232) Sensor unit; (240) Fire hose; (250) Power supply; (260) Transportation means
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실전과 같은 화재상황을 디스플레이부재에 연출하고, 연출된 화재상황에 맞는 화재진압과정을 실습할 수 있는 모의소방훈련용 소화장치에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 의하면, 화재발생시 행동요령과 실제 화재발생 상황이 포함된 동영상을 표시하는 영상표시수단과, 상기 영상표시수단에 동영상이 표시되도록 하기 위한 영상입력수단을 포함하는 디스플레이부재; 및 상기 디스플레이부재의 하단에 설치되어 상기 영상표시수단을 향해 연무를 분사할 수 있게 구비되되, 공기를 공급하는 공기공급수단과, 연기를 공급하는 연기공급수단과, 상기 공기공급수단과 상기 연기공급수단에 의해 공급되는 공기와 연기가 혼합되도록 제어하는 제어수단과, 상기 제어수단에 의해 제어되어 공기와 연기가 혼합된 연무가 영상표시수단에 분사되도록 하는 소방호스와, 상기 디스플레이부재에 전원을 공급하는 전원공급수단을 포함하는 소화전;을 포함하는 모의소방훈련용 소화장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Gas and dust mixed explosion simulation testing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas and dust mixed explosion simulation testing device, and belongs to the field of researches on the prevention and control of coalmine disasters. The device consists of a methane gas bottle, a compressed air bottle, pressure reducing valves, electromagnetic valves, flow meters, a tee joint, a dust cavity, valves, a vacuum pump, a simulated roadway, a test rack, an explosion-proof safety valve, an ignition probe, an igniter, pressure sensors, temperature sensors, carbon monoxide sensors, a data acquirer, a high-speed camera, a triangular bracket, a computer, a connecting pipe, connecting lines, a data line and a dust sweeper. According to the device, researches on a mutual promotion relationship between gas explosion and dust explosion and evolution laws about each characteristic parameter of gas and dust mixed explosion can be made, and the device is significant for researches on the prevention and control of extra-serious coalmine disasters and accidents.

title_en: Fire disaster color model and fire disaster flame and smog identification method based on maximum margin criterion
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire disaster color model and a fire disaster flame and smog identification method based on the maximum margin criterion. The method comprises the steps of establishing an image library to serve as a training set, wherein the image library comprises a flame image, a smog image and an interference image; conducting feature vector extraction on the training set by means of the maximum margin criterion to obtain a coefficient matrix and flame and smog features; establishing a K-nearest neighbor node algorithm classifier according to the features; conducting analysis and identification on an image to be detected by means of the classifier obtained from the last step, and sending out a fire disaster alarm signal if yes. According to the fire disaster color model and the fire disaster flame and smog identification method based on the maximum margin criterion, mass data are counted and analyzed with the maximum margin criterion, a most reasonable weight value is calculated, optimal description suitable for flame and smog is obtained, flame, smog and interference can be distinguished effectively, and the fire disaster identification rate can be increased effectively.

title_en: System and method for evacuation action simulation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system and a method for evacuation action simulation which can simulate evacuation action in crowd flow conditions with high accuracy.SOLUTION: A method for evacuation action simulation to simulate action of evacuees, who evacuate from a building or in an outdoor space, with cellular automaton includes following steps of: dividing an indoor or outdoor space into cells; arranging all evacuees as simulation targets in each cell; and determining a next destination cell for each evacuee by each discrete time step on the basis of the local interaction rule with fluid coefficients in crowd flow conditions (especially 1.5/m s by horizontal walking, 1.33/m s by walking on steps) when the density of evacuees is the density of crowd flow conditions.
assignees: KAJIMA CORP;ARMO SEKKEI KK;NAT UNIV YOKOHAMA

title_en: Novel internet-of-things-based fire fighting sprinkler system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel internet-of-things-based fire fighting sprinkler system. A water pump and an air pump are connected with a sprinkling pipeline in a switchable mode. A detection head in a three-way pipe structure is arranged between the sprinkling pipeline and a sprinkle head; two interfaces in the detection head are connected with the sprinkling pipeline and the sprinkle head; a piston is arranged inside a third interface, and an air outlet is formed in the side wall of the piston and is positioned between the piston and the head of the third interface of the detection head; a spring is arranged in the third interface; the piston can overcome the acting force of the spring to move to the other side of the air outlet under push of airflow, so that the air outlet is communicated with the sprinkling pipeline; a closing mechanism used for automatically closing the third interface during a fire disaster is arranged on the detection head. The state of the fire fighting sprinkler system is completely simulated during actual operation by utilizing gases, and simple and accurate detection of the fire fighting sprinkler system which has no influence on the working environment is realized. Moreover, the detection cost of each time is low, the workload is low, the system basically can be started at any time, and the requirement and influence on the working environment are avoided.

title_en: Canopy used for disaster simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a canopy used for disaster simulation. The canopy includes a wall. A ventilation duct is arranged in the upper part of the wall. A row of air-blast nozzles are fixed at the upper end of the wall. The lower ends of the air-blast nozzles are all connected with the ventilation duct. One side of the wall is provided with a 3D screen and the upper part of the wall is provided with a water pipe. The lower end of the water pipe is connected with a row of water nozzles. The canopy used for the disaster simulation has the advantages of being reasonable in structural design, low in cost and convenient to use and the like. The nozzles at the top of the wall spray water down so that panic feelings are generated in experiencers. However, strong wind blasted from the air-blast nozzles forms an air wall which blows away simulation rain near the wall so that the experiencers are protected from being wet by the simulation rain. The strong wind blasted from the air-blast nozzles also blows part of the simulation rain into water vapor which is mixed with the strong wind so that conditions that rain is mixed with a hurricane in a disaster weather is simulated more comprehensively and vividly and thus the experiencers are enabled to experience the scenarios of the hurricane disaster as if the experiencers are personally on the scene under comprehensive safeguard measures.
assignees: WUHU HUAQIANG CULTURE & TECHNOLOGY IND CO LTD

title_en: Pipe structure for fire-fighting water in derrick of drillship
title_ko: 시추선 데릭의 소방수 배관 구조
abstract_en: A firefighting water pipe structure for a derrick of a drillship is disclosed. The firefighting water pipe structure for a derrick of a drillship relates to a firefighting water pipe structure for a derrick which is mounted on a deck of a marine drillship. The firefighting water pipe structure comprises: a horizontal pipe unit which is prepared along a lower structure of a derrick; at least one supply pipe unit which supplies firefighting water to the horizontal pipe unit and is prepared vertically on the deck; and at least one discharge pipe unit which is connected with the horizontal pipe unit and is prepared vertically on the deck. The supply pipe unit and the discharge pipe unit are prepared vertically on the deck along a vertical structure of the derrick in order not to interrupt the movement or operation of a blowout preventor (BOP) or a BOP crane in the lower part of the derrick.
abstract_ko: 시추선 데릭의 소방수 배관 구조가 개시된다. 본 발명의 시추선 데릭의 소방수 배관 구조는, 해상 시추선의 데크에 장착된 데릭(Derrick)의 소방수 배관 구조에 있어서, 데릭의 하부 구조물을 따라 마련되는 수평 관부; 수평 관부에 소방수를 공급하며 데크에 수직으로 마련되는 적어도 하나의 공급 관부; 및 수평 관부에 연결되며 데크에 수직으로 마련되는 적어도 하나의 배출 관부를 포함하되, 공급 관부 및 배출 관부는 데릭의 수직 방향 구조물을 따라 데크에 수직으로 마련됨으로써 데릭의 하부에서 BOP(Blowout preventor) 또는 BOP 크레인의 이동이나 작동을 방해하지 않는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Evacuation device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation device capable of reducing damage of the device itself and protecting evacuees safely, by avoiding direct hit, in particular, of tsunami streams, drifting materials, or the like even in the case of attack thereof and also preventing buoyancy from acting to the device.SOLUTION: An evacuation device includes: a bearing body such as posts and an arch structural body erected on a ground; a frame body mounted to and supported by the bearing body so that it can be utilized as a stage for evacuation with an area allowing many persons to evacuate; and an ascending/descending means connecting the ground and the frame body to each other. The frame body is formed in a cylindrical barrel shape with opening front and rear ends such that it can receive and discharge tsunami streams, which is simulated to attack, to outside.

title_en: Unexpected situation-responsive wide-area training system for nuclear power plant
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve a problem where the personnel needs training for reducing a degree of damage to a minimum in response to an expected situation, considering both a mega-quake and a mega-tsunami, the situation in which the disaster and resultant damage exceeds the assumption made when a manmade structure has been built, even if the assumption is agreeable to people.SOLUTION: Unprecedented natural phenomena and normal climate-limit natural phenomena of a site are generated, and, under a disaster situation generated on the basis of the generated phenomena, a training is conducted by utilizing an off-the-shelf personal computer.

title_en: Mine hydraulic drilling rig monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine hydraulic drilling rig monitoring system. The mine hydraulic drilling rig monitoring system comprises a detection module, a signal acquisition and processing module and a monitoring module. The detection module is used for detecting the rolling angle, pitch angle, azimuth angle, vibration state, carrying state and walking depth of a hydraulic drilling rig and is electrically connected with the signal acquisition and processing module. The signal acquisition and processing module is used for acquiring information of all sensors of the detection module, summarizing, processing and storing the information of all the sensors and sending the information to the monitoring module and is electrically connected with the monitoring module. The monitoring module is used for monitoring position information and the working state of the hydraulic drilling rig in real time according to the data information uploaded by the signal acquisition and processing module. The mine hydraulic drilling rig monitoring system solves the problems that the state of the hydraulic drilling rig can not be well detected or monitored in the prior art, summarization of data is carried out generally through the method of manual record by a single machine and other methods, the hydraulic drilling rig can not be effectively detected or monitored and consequently numerous mine disasters, heavy casualties and heavy economic losses are caused.
assignees: Guizhou panjiang mining machinery co ltd

title_en: A kind of experimental provision of simulating carryall nacelle fire prevention and control mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of experimental provision of simulating carryall nacelle fire prevention and control mechanism, feature increases barrier and fire-fighting equipment at box house, the validity of fire generation and the rule of development and fire-fighting equipment under different condition in passenger car nacelle can be simulated, in appropriate design passenger car nacelle, fire-fighting equipment provides foundation; This device can adjust the shape of barrier, structure, size and position as required, burning things which may cause a fire disaster kind and power, external environment condition etc., and device uses more flexible.Apparatus of the present invention are rational in infrastructure, and the material used is easy to get, stable work in work, simple to operate, can realize operating repeatedly, adapt to large-scale industrial production test needs.

title_en: Simulation test system and monitoring method for disaster of roof water burst and sand inrush induced by coal seam mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test system and monitoring method for a disaster of roof water burst and sand inrush induced by coal seam mining. The simulation test system comprises a bracket, wherein a test bin is arranged inside the bracket; a movable coal-mining simulating dragging plate is arranged at the bottom of the test bin; a water-sand gathering channel obliquely arranged is arranged below the coal-mining simulating dragging plate; a water-sand collecting device is arranged at the outlet of the water-sand gathering channel; the test bin is formed by a bottom plate, a right side wall, a front transparent plate body, a back transparent plate body and the coal-mining simulating dragging plate; a plurality of pore water pressure sensors and a plurality of pressure sensors are arranged inside the test bin. According to the invention, the simulation test for the disaster of the roof water burst and sand inrush induced by coal seam mining is carried out by adopting the technical scheme that the test bin is filled with coal measure strata simulating materials, so as to obtain water-sand inrush parameters of different stratum combinations, therefore, the identification degree of the characteristics of the disaster of operating face water burst and sand inrush induced by coal seam mining is improved.

title_en: Disaster information spatial-temporal database
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster information spatial-temporal database, which comprises three disaster information databases including a disaster current simulation database, a disaster process database and a disaster historical database, wherein a unified coding module carries out layered coding on the received disaster information data, an attribute data management module and a space position management module guide in disaster information attribute data and space position data to the corresponding disaster information database, the disaster information data is transmitted among all disaster information databases through a logic conversion module, a spatial-temporal database index module builds updating index for the disaster information spatial-temporal database according to the time sequence, the logic conversion module and the spatial-temporal database index module form the basis of the disaster information spatial-temporal database, and the preparation is made for the disaster attribute management and maintenance, spatial-temporal logic index conversion and maintenance, statistics data entry, index and spatial-temporal inquiry. The disaster information spatial-temporal database solves the problems of lower work efficiency and high data redundancy during the realization of spatial-temporal data storage, management and historical review.

title_en: Differentiation based power transmission network anti-disaster ability planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differentiation based power transmission network anti-disaster ability planning method which is used for improving an anti-disaster ability of a power transmission network when a meteorological disaster occurs. The differentiation based power transmission network anti-disaster ability planning method comprises the steps of: firstly, developing an IEEE standard based tri-state meteorological condition to obtain a relationship between a fault rate of a power transmission line at different anti-disaster protection levels and the meteorological disaster; obtaining a fragility index and a goal by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation and an optimized load shedding algorithm. The fragility index and a planned construction cost serve as an objective function of multi-goal power transmission network planning; an NSGA-II algorithm is used for obtaining optimal Pareto disaggregation of a power distribution network planning scheme and is used for decision-making in the later period. The verification shows that the provided power distribution network planning method can determine the anti-disaster protection level of each power distribution line exactly, accordingly improves the anti-disaster ability of the power distribution network efficiently when the meteorological disaster occurs, meanwhile reduces line construction cost to the maximum extent and achieves important reference value for the planning of the power distribution network in the environment where meteorological disasters occur frequently.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE POWER ECONOMIC RES INST;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Computer simulation and evaluation system for mine emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a computer simulation and evaluation system for mine emergency rescue. The system comprises a control module operated by a trainee. A simulation module is controlled by the control module to send out a simulated mine accident image and a sound signal; the signal is transmitted to a demonstration module for demonstrating a scene to the trainee; in a scene demonstration process, the simulation module is used for demonstrating scene problems at the same time according to scene contents; the trainee follows demonstration contents and performs corresponding operations and answers through the control module in the viewing process; an evaluation module is arranged in the control module and used for calculating and grading the operations and answers of the trainee. According to the system, a vivid disaster environment is created through a virtual reality technology, and the trainee can be personally on the scene, so that the actual emergency rescue capability can be improved, the psychological enduring capacity of the trainee and the equipment service condition can be tested and evaluated, and danger and waste caused by adopting real equipment for training are reduced.
assignees: FUSHUN FUYUN ANYI LIFESAVING EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: An underground pipe network wireless monitoring positioning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless monitoring positioning system applicable to the field of underground pipe network application. The wireless monitoring positioning system is composes of unknown nodes, beacon nodes, Sink nodes, a host computer, etc. The invention discloses a monitoring node positioning method targeting at a wireless self-organizing network, i.e., a progressive incremental type distance measuring positioning algorithm based on an on-line optimization training relation function, and a process of continuous correction of positioning results through the adoption of a plurality of methods. The invention also discloses an sudden-onset disaster accident source positioning method targeting at underground pipe network application, and the sudden-onset disaster accident source positioning method the comprises a time difference method, a state curve method, a multiparameter combination method, etc., and a plurality of methods are adopted to carry out positioning correction, so that positioning with relatively high precision can be realized. The invention also discloses an energy saving optimization method for a realization process of the above positioning method. Through the adoption of the positioning method of the present invention, functions such as underground pipe network automation intelligentized monitoring early warning and sudden-onset disaster highly efficient reliable positioning can be realized, and the positioning method is also advantaged by being accurate in data, being timely and highly efficiently, being low in energy consumption and low in cost, etc.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY OF MACHINERY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;CHINA PRODUCTIVITY CT FOR MACHINERY

title_en: Large-scale population modeling and simulating method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale population modeling and simulating method. The large-scale population refers to an organic collection of social population constituting a city or a country. The basic thoughts include, microcosmically, defining attributes such as personal age, sex, registered permanent residence, occupation, fortune and the like and dividing people's daily life into finite states such as sleep, diet, work and leisure; macroscopically, organizing the all population according to the hierarchical relation of personal-family-community-town-city-province-country and establishing a knowledge and information spreading mechanism, building resource models of water, grain, soil, mine and the like, and building abstract models of disasters such as drought and flood, earthquake and war. The population initialization is realized on the basis of statistical data, evolution of personal state and behavior is driven by time, and simulation computing is executed by means of parallel processing. The large-scale population modeling and simulating method is a quantitative method for researching on large-scale social problems, is an innovation on the conventional quantitative method, and has high application value to social organization management, system structure optimization and the like.

title_en: Multi-components drilling strain gauge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multi-components drilling strain gauge, learn stress-strain observation technical field with belonging to, can be widely used for the observation of earthquake prediction, geological disaster, mining area safety, urban safety and geodynamic study；This multi-components drilling strain gauge includes that underground probe and ground host machine, probe include ess-strain sensing mechanisms, microdisplacement measurement mechanism, displacement calibrating mechanism and rearmounted attitude reference device；This multi-components drilling strain gauge achieves modularity processing and assembles, and improves the concordance of instrument；Achieve displacement calibrating, improve observed reliability；Achieve rearmounted orientation, simplify apparatus structure, facilitate instrument and use, more conducively the relative analysis of platform net formula observation data.

title_en: Virtual mine risk-taking behavior implementation system and method based on multiple agents
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual mine risk-taking behavior implementation system and method based on multiple agents, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. According to the system and the method, based on a reaction type agent structure, a risk model for the equipment-class or environment-class agents is set up, and related risk factors such as equipment unsafe states and environment unsafe factors in underground accidents are collected and obtained; based on the artificial intelligence method, a miner agent risk-taking behavior model which comprises a perception module, a movement control module, an internal attribute module, an action control module and a cognition module is set up, risk-taking behaviors of persons involved in the underground accidents are simulated, the communication service agent in a virtual mine is set up through information transmission so that interaction and cooperative control among the multiple agents can be achieved, the interaction relation between persons, machines and environment disaster-causing factors in the underground accidents is shown, disaster accidents and site problems are simulated according to the various physical environment conditions and the human behaviors underground the coal mine, and modeling and virtual reality of the risk-taking behaviors of the factors causing the underground accidents are achieved.

title_en: Underground engineering wall surrounding rock disaster non-drilling ultrasonic wave lossless real-time monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground engineering wall surrounding rock disaster non-drilling ultrasonic wave lossless real-time monitoring method which is characterized by comprising a non-metal ultrasonic wave detecting instrument (1), an energy converter (11), a coupling fixing device (4), a main control computer (5) and a sound-light alarm device (6), wherein the transducer (11) is fixed on the surface of a surrounding rock (7) through the coupling fixing device (4), and the transducer (11) is connected with the non-metal ultrasonic wave detecting instrument (1) through an electric cable; the non-metal ultrasonic wave detecting instrument (1) is connected with the main control computer (5); the main control computer (5) is connected with the sound-light alarm device (6). The method disclosed by the invention can be used for monitoring the inside of the surrounding rock (7) by adopting an ultrasonic pulse reflection echo method without drilling the surrounding rock (7), is very simple in coupling process and has the advantages of high detection sensitivity, accuracy in defect positioning, convenience in operation, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Slope simulation test device and test method under coupling effects of rainfall and underground water
abstract_en: Landslide is one of the most serious natural disasters in the present world and seriously affects human life and property and development of economic society. China is one of the countries with the most serious landslide hazards in Asia, even in the world. Landslide draws close attention from the government and geotechnical engineering scholars. Researches show that rainfall is the main reason leading to landslide; the essence of rainfall infiltration of the slope is that attraction of unsaturated zone matrix of the slope is reduced, and the shear strength of slope soil is reduced, resulting in landslide of the slope. The simulation test is an important method for researching the landslide of the slope. The test device for researching slope landslide under the rainfall infiltration condition at present just considers the effect on the landslide caused by rainfall. In fact, slope landslide is the result of interaction of rainfall and level raise of underground water. Therefore, a slope simulation test device considering coupling effects of rainfall infiltration and underground change needs to be researched, and the slope simulation test device has important significance on further illumination of the slope landslide mechanism and prevention of the slope landslide.

title_en: Seismic dynamic centrifugal model test extension analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a seismic dynamic centrifugal model test extension analysis method which aims at researching a seismic destructive mechanism and the disaster prevention and decrease of large-scale projects such as a high earth-rock dam by using an unequal stress small-scale dynamic centrifugal model test. The technical thought is as follows: an equal stress scale test result is obtained by fitting extension through a method that model stress gradually approaches prototype stress by adopting n unequal stress small-scale dynamic centrifugal model tests. The seismic dynamic centrifugal model test extension analysis method provided by the invention can be used for simulating the large-scale project through a relatively small scale and applying the centrifugal machine vibration table to the effective test research of the seismic destructive mechanism and disaster preventing and decreasing measures of large-scale projects such as the high earth-rock dam, a scientific and feasible way is provided for the model test research of the problem of seism of the large-scale projects, which can not be originally carried out, and the reasonability of the effective test result of the seismic destructive mechanism and disaster preventing and decreasing measures of large-scale projects such as the high earth-rock dam can be obviously promoted.

title_en: Device and method for simulating and predicting mountain torrent disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydraulics parameter monitoring device for numerical simulation of mountain torrent disasters and a method for simulating and predicting the evolution process of the mountain torrent disasters. The method comprises the steps that hydrologic data such as rainfall and water level of a monitored zone are collected through a mountain torrent simulation parameter monitoring node device and transmitted to a remote simulation computing terminal in real time, the evolution process of the mountain torrent disasters is calculated circularly on the computing terminal through a grid outflow correcting method, and therefore simulation and prediction with high reliability are achieved. The core calculation steps are that firstly, numerical value discretization treatment is conducted on a mass continuity equation; when the value of the depth of water of a grid is negative, whether M and N are inflow or outflow is judged firstly, and the inflow Qin and the outflow Qout of the grid are calculated; then correction coefficients are calculated; finally, calculation is conducted circularly and repeatedly until all the grids with the water depth of the negative values are collected, and the next time step is conducted. According to the method, the difficult problems that simulating calculation of the mountain torrent disasters is prone to divergence due to the steep terrain in a drainage basin and the rapid change of water flow in a traditional method are solved.

title_en: Fire rescue service robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue service robot applied to field fire rescue, which is characterized by comprising a man-machine intercom system, a 3D (Three-dimensional) visual system, a navigation system, a simulated human body and a remote assistance system which are independently connected with and perform bidirectional data transmission on a data processing module respectively. The fire rescue service robot has the advantages that the fire rescue service robot replaces a fireman rescue manner, realizes robot replaced service, prevents influence on disaster condition alleviation and rescue due to insufficient quantity of firemen, greatly improves the field fire rescue rate and improves a sense of security of people.
assignees: CHENGDU VONXAN AUTOMATION SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: The Forecasting Methodology of many attribute events under wireless senser environment
abstract_en: The Forecasting Methodology of many attribute events under a kind of wireless senser environment, the method is according to the feature of many attribute events stream self, set up many attribute events field, flow of event is converted at equal intervals, for building the training sample file of forecast model, build bidirectional prediction model vertically and horizontally on this basis, many attribute events are predicted, and it is predicted Model Reconstruction adaptively according to the accumulation degree of inaccurate forecast, make prediction more accuracy, the method can be widely used in event-monitoring, natural disaster monitoring and early warning, health supervision, during climatic environment monitoring is applied with prediction etc..

title_en: Inertia toy firefighting truck
abstract_en: An inertia toy firefighting truck comprises a truck body, at least two wheel sets, a driving shaft and an inertia wheel set. At least one wheel set is transmissively connected with the inertia wheel set through the driving shaft. The truck body comprises the components of: a truck chassis, a turntable which is rotatably connected with the truck chassis, a foldable scaling ladder of which the bottom end is longitudinally hinged with the turntable, and a lifting hopper which is connected with the top end of the foldable scaling ladder. The foldable scaling ladder comprises a lower scaling ladder and an upper scaling ladder which is hinged with the top end of the lower scaling ladder. The inertia toy firefighting truck advances or retreats by means of inertia movement of the inertia wheel set without electric energy consumption. The inertia toy firefighting truck has an energy-saving and environment-friendly performance and can realize 360-DEG rotation or lifting of the scaling ladder. Simultaneously when the truck moves or the scaling ladder rotates or lifts, sound of a power machine is generated, thereby realizing more playing modes, high simulation effect, ingenious design, attractive appearance, long inertia driving distance, long service life and higher interest. Therefore more children like the inertia toy firefighting truck.

title_en: Method for controlling high mine pressure of open-air roadway by hydraulic fracturing
abstract_en: A method for controlling high mine pressure of an open-air roadway by hydraulic fracturing comprises the following steps of determining a hard rock stratum of a roof according to a geological information bar chart of a coal face; designing a control drilling hole; respectively controlling abutment supporting pressure and lateral supporting pressure; slotting or slitting in the bottom of the hole after hole drilling construction is finished so as to achieve the purpose of directional fracturing; applying a hydraulic fracturing process; and weakening the hard roof or cutting off the hard roof along a directional fracturing slot of the drilling hole so as to transfer stress or weaken surrounding rock and reduce the lateral supporting pressure and the abutment supporting pressure of the open-air roadway. A weakening zone in the surrounding rock can effectively absorb or weaken impact stress waves; a dynamic disaster of rock burst caused by the reason that the hard roof cracks suddenly is avoided; and large deformation of the open-air roadway is controlled. The method for controlling the high mine pressure of the open-air roadway by hydraulic fracturing is not only applicable to controlling the high mine pressure of the open-air roadway with the coal face with the hard roof, but also is applicable to controlling the high mine pressure of the roadway of which a work face is in tunnelling crossing with a work face of an adjacent roadway during mining. Moreover, the method is simple, effective, safe and reliable, and is low in cost.

title_en: Method for monitoring activity state of underground fault
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for monitoring the activity state of an underground fault, and belongs to the technical field of mining disaster monitoring. The method comprises the steps that an observation chamber is dug in a forward fault footwall or a reverse fault upper wall at first; horizontal medium-length holes are distributed in the observation chamber, the medium-length holes penetrate through the fault surface by a certain distance, and multipoint extensometers are mounted in the medium-length holes; an anchor rod multipoint stress detector, a drilled hole multipoint stress detector and a micro-seismic monitoring system are mounted on the position perpendicular to the fault surface; the displacement changes of the upper wall and the footwall of the fault, the additional tensile stress states of different positions away from the fault surface, additional shear stress states of different positions away from the fault surface, broken positions in the mining activity process and area data information of the fault can be monitored by collecting and processing the data in real time, and then the data are directly transmitted to a ground surface monitoring center. The method can monitor the displacement changes of the upper wall and the footwall of the fault, the states of additional tensile stress of the different positions away from the fault and perpendicular to the fault surface, the states of additional shear stress parallel to the fault surface, and the like in real time.

title_en: End pressure-bearing type rock bolt reamer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an end pressure-bearing type rock bolt reamer which is composed of a down-hole hammer and a basal bed reaming drill bit. The end pressure-bearing type rock bolt reamer is mainly used for rock anchoring, landslip prevention and structure floating prevention in foundation engineering and geological disaster protective engineering. The end pressure-bearing type rock bolt reamer is characterized in that the down-hole hammer is used for enabling the basal bed reaming drill bit to break rocks and open when hitting the bottom, hole bottom reaming is achieved, and the anchoring force of the rock bolt can be substantially improved. The diameter of a reamed hole formed through the end pressure-bearing type rock bolt reamer is 1.25-1.5 times the diameter of an initial hole, manufacturing cost is low, the end pressure-bearing type rock bolt reamer is convenient to assemble and disassemble, practical, simple in operation, recyclable, and long in service life.

title_en: Simulation engine for use in disaster recovery virtualization
abstract_en: An approach is provided for determining disaster recovery capacity. A simulation hypervisor receives streaming metric data, which represents the current production workload of a primary site, from the primary site. The metric data is combined with production data of the backup site by the simulation hypervisor to simulate a recovery event. Using data from the simulating, disaster recovery planning can be performed.

title_en: Inflatable aircraft trainer and method to use
abstract_en: One of the challenges for airports is to provide effective emergency response training in the event of aircraft emergency scenarios. For airports there is the additional expense to provide that training that is typically performed at a remote facility. A portable inflatable training aircraft will provide this training and reduces the cost to the airport management so that the training can be ongoing and effective without interfering with the normal operation of the airport.
assignees: SHAUB SR ROBERT L;NICK MARK;CRAIG ALLEN;RIDDELL ROSS

title_en: Method for comprehensively treating gas in low-air-permeability high-gas-content coal seam group
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for comprehensively treating gas in a low-air-permeability high-gas-content coal seam group and belongs to a coal mine gas treatment method. The method for comprehensively treating gas is based on the pressure relief gas emission law when an upper protective seam is extracted under the condition of the low-air-permeability high-gas-content close-distance coal seam group and a coal and gas simultaneous extraction system of the upper protective seam is established. The method comprises the steps of protective seam gas extraction and protected seam gas extraction. Protective seam gas extraction comprises the steps of protective seam gas extraction, roof high-position drilling site and drilling gas extraction and gas extraction of a reserved-tunnel wall laid-pipe goaf. Protected seam gas extraction is seam gas pre-extraction. Thus, safe and efficient recovery of the upper protective seam under the condition of the low-air-permeability high-gas-content close-distance coal seam group is achieved. The method for extraction is simple, stable, reliable and remarkable in social and economic benefit and has great significance in the improvement in safety and reliability of coal mine gas disaster prevention measures, the coal extraction environment and the safety condition and efficiency of a working face.

title_en: Firefighting testing device special for wind turbine generator system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a firefighting testing device special for a wind turbine generator system. The device consists of an environment simulation control system, a gas sucking smoke sensing fire hazard detection device, a linear temperature sensing fire hazard detection device, an image type fire hazard detection device, suspended type dry powder fire distinguishers, an automatic ignition device, a central control system and a computer, wherein the environment simulation control system comprises an environment experiment room, a high/low temperature simulation device, a dust simulation device and a water spraying device; the linear temperature sensing fire hazard detection device comprises a temperature sensing cable and a micro-computer modulator; and the suspended type dry powder fire distinguishers are uniformly distributed inside a wind turbine generator cabin. According to the device, a real wind turbine generator cabin is adopted, under the condition that severe environments such as severe cold, high temperature areas, wind, sand and rainwater, where the wind turbine generator systems are located, are sufficiently simulated, the fire hazard detection and alarm function and the firefighting function of the firefighting testing device special for wind turbine generation are tested, and the device is high in fidelity of simulation, accurate in data measurement, scientific in testing method, high in automation level and stable and reliable in long-term operation.

title_en: Tape for woody plant
title_ko: 수목용 테이프
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tape for a woody plant including a band formed of a synthetic resin with water repellent function, having a length capable of winding a stem of the woody plant, and allowing a pesticide or a woody plant medicine to be applied to some or all of a portion coming in contact with the stem of the woody plant, a roughness forming portion having any one or both of a plurality of protrusions or grooves formed on one or both sides of the band such that the band has roughness, and providing a channel for both ventilation and draining by the plurality of protrusions or grooves at an overlapped portion, and a plurality of ventilation hole formed in the band by drilling to provide a channel of air for breath of the woody plant. According to the present invention, by bring out an advantage of a synthetic resin based material and ameliorating a disadvantage of the synthetic resin based material, the tape may have excellent waterproof function and ventilation function, be flexible and easy to handle, have a long life, have flame retardancy and insulating function, and have the similar natural beauty to a natural bark. Also, according to the present invention, the use of drug, such as a pesticide may be remarkably reduced, so that risks of poisoning accident and ecosystem disturbance may be minimized, and an efficient prevention of the breeding and extermination may be performed anytime without restriction of time throughout the entire life of a pest, that is, from an egg to an imago, so that by selecting allocation of human resources or pertinent time, the efficient prevention of the breeding and extermination may be performed and a prevention and relief may be also performed. The present invention relates to a tape for a woody plant having the same function to the artificial bark for being suited to the physiology of a tree and protecting a tree from long-term injury, pests, or natural disasters.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 발수기능을 가지는 합성수지재로 이루어지고, 수목의 줄기에 감겨지기 위한 길이를 가지도록 형성되며, 수목의 줄기가 접하는 부분에서 일부 또는 전체에 농약 또는 수목의 치료제가 도포되는 밴드; 상기 밴드의 일면 또는 양면에 돌기와 홈 중 어느 하나 또는 모두가 다수로 형성되어 상기 밴드가 러프니스(roughness)를 가지도록 함으로써 중첩되는 부위에 상기 돌기 또는 상기 홈에 의해 배수 겸 통기를 위한 통로를 제공하도록 하는 러프니스형성부; 및 상기 밴드에 천공에 의해 다수로 형성되어 상기 수목의 호흡을 위한 공기의 통로를 제공하는 통기홀을 포함하는 수목용 테이프에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 합성수지계열 소재의 장점은 살리고, 합성수지계열의 소재가 가지는 미흡한 점들을 개선하여 방수기능이 뛰어나면서도 통기기능을 가지고, 유연하여 다루기 편리하며, 수명이 길고, 난연성과 단열기능이 있으며, 자연수피와 유사한 자연미를 연출할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 농약 등의 약제 사용량을 획기적으로 줄여서, 중독사고 위험과 생태계 교란을 최소화할 수 있으며, 알에서 성충기에 이르기까지 병해충의 전 생애에 걸쳐서 어느 때나 시기에 구애를 받지 않고 방제할 수 있어서, 인력의 배분이나 쾌적한 시기를 택하여 효율적인 방제가 가능하고 예방과 구제를 겸할 수 있다. 
본 발명은 나무의 생리에 알맞고 장기간 외상이나 병해충, 자연재해 등으로부터 나무를 보호하여주는 인공수피와 같은 기능을 가지는 수목용 테이프에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fluid simulation method of 3d numerical analysis using web solution
title_ko: 웹 솔루션을 이용한 삼차원 수치해석 유체 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fluid simulation method with a smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) method. The present invention relates to a 3D numerical analysis fluid simulation method using a web solution comprising a data inputting step for inputting the position information, the topography data, the intensity data of rainfall, the rain amount data, and the flow velocity data of a place where a member is positioned to a modulated platform by connecting a server; a simulation performing step for performing simulation by processing and calculating the data inputted to the server; a processing data calculating step for performing a simulation performing result and the data required by a member on the web and calculating the flow velocity data, a flow rate value, and the rain amount data; and an outputting step for outputting a report after reproducing the processing data or transforming the processing data into a flash file. The present invention is provided to perform the movement of the rainfall in real time by using volume rendering, thereby previously preventing natural disasters. [Reference numerals] (10) Data inputting step; (20) Simulation performing step; (30) Processing data calculating step; (40) Outputting step; (AA) Start; (BB) End
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 파티클 기반 SPH(Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics) 방법에 의한 유체 시뮬레이션 방법에 있어서; 서버에 접속하여 모듈화된 플랫폼에 회원이 위치한 장소의 위치정보, 지형데이터, 강우량 강도, 우량, 유속의 데이터를 입력하는 데이터 입력단계; 상기 서버에 입력된 데이터를 가공·연산하여 시뮬레이션을 구현하는 시뮬레이션 구현단계; 상기 시뮬레이션 구현 결과와 회원이 요구하는 데이터를 웹상에서 유체 및 기체 토사로 시현하고 유속, 유량값 및 홍수량 데이터를 산출하는 가공데이터 산출단계; 및 상기 가공데이터로 동영상으로 재생하거나 플래쉬 파일로 변형 조정 후 보고서를 출력하는 출력단계를 포함하는 웹 솔루션을 이용한 삼차원 수치해석 유체 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이러한 본 발명은 SPH(Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics) 기반 유체 시뮬레이션에서 지형데이터, 강우량 강도, 우량, 유속에 따른 볼륨 렌더링을 이용하여 요구되는 장소에서 강수의 움직임을 실시간으로 구현함으로써 요구되는 장소의 홍수량이나 피해지역을 미리 설정하고 인지하여 대비할 수 있으므로 홍수로 인한 자연재해를 미연에 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: D & F CONSULTING;DONGNAM E& C CO LTD

title_en: Geological prediction method based on inertia measurement parameters
abstract_en: In order to detect ore resources and geological disasters or replace drill bits in time according to the influence of different geological conditions on motion of the drill bits, the invention provides a geological prediction method in a multi-dimensional time sequence segmented mode based on inertia measurement parameters. The method includes the steps that acquired signals are segmented, after the data are compensated, a multi-dimensional time sequence is converted into a one-dimensional time sequence through a multi-parameter ARMA model, and newly-acquired data are substituted into P1 after being processed according to a first segment data calculation geological mode, the matching degree of the data and the geological mode P1 is judged through the Euclidean distance, if the data and the geological mode P1 are matched, it is shown that the drill bits are still in the same geological condition, if the data and the geological mode P1 are partially matched, it is shown that the drill bits enter a geological overlapped region; if the data and the geological mode P1 are not matched at all, it is shown that the drill bits enter a new geological condition, a geological mode P2 is built according to the data, and multiple geological modes P3, P4... Pi are repeatedly calculated in this way; the size and the position of a geological region are calculated by combining position information, and the type of the geological region is predicted by combining instance geological data. The method is simple, easy to achieve and high in reliability, and other sensors do not need to be additionally arranged.

title_en: Method and system for three-dimensional firefighting training and drill assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for three-dimensional firefighting training and drill assessment. The system comprises a data layer and an application layer. The data layer comprises a petrochemical enterprise basic database, a three-dimensional database and an expert knowledge base. The application layer comprises a basic theory training platform, a firefighting device operating instruction training platform, a typical chemical engineering accident case training platform and a chemical engineering accident firefighting emergency drill and assessment training platform. The basic theory training platform is used for firefighting theory learning, answering and scoring; the firefighting device operating instruction training platform is used for three-dimensional visual training of firefighting devices; the typical chemical engineering accident case training platform is used for training on chemical engineering accident cases in history; and the chemical engineering accident firefighting emergency drill and assessment training platform is used for firefighting emergency drill and assessment of an oil refining device, a chemical engineering device and a storage and transportation tank area. According to the system, three-dimensional digitized drill training of post training, the firefighting devices, typical accident training, accident emergency drill and drill assessment is achieved.

title_en: One adopts fragmented rock body water sand migration pilot system and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses one and adopt fragmented rock body water sand migration pilot system and monitoring method, it includes support, it is provided with test cabin on described support, described test cabin includes warehouse and lower warehouse, it has been evenly arranged multiple pressure transducer in described upper warehouse, it is evenly arranged multiple pore water pressure sensor in described lower warehouse, has been equipped with layer of sand in described upper warehouse, in described lower warehouse, is equipped with the sillar layer of different lithology and lumpiness；Moving down with described top board, loose sand and sillar layer are gradually compacted, and described fragility epoxy resin water-stop sheet also moves down, and the point of described crushing rod smashes described fragility epoxy resin water-stop sheet, make described upper warehouse be connected with described lower warehouse.The migration of water sand mixture and simulation test of gushing out can be carried out in fragmented rock body, obtain the water sand parameter of migration of Different Strata combination, improve seam mining induction water burst in face and burst the reliability of sand disaster characteristic identification.

title_en: Underground emergency evacuation virtual crowd simulation method based on multiple intelligent agents
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground emergency evacuation virtual crowd simulation method based on multiple intelligent agents. A virtual mine emergency evacuation crowd simulation frame is built by using the underground emergency evacuation virtual crowd simulation method based on the multiple intelligent agents. The virtual mine emergency evacuation crowd simulation frame is mainly composed of five portions of a crowd simulation engine, a geometric scene simulation engine, a scene database, an event recorder and a human-computer interaction interface. In consideration of different understandings on mine knowledge and different behavior decisions of miners playing different roles when mine disasters occur, a multiple intelligent agent miner crowd emergency evacuation module and a crowd emergency evacuation algorithm for the different roles of the miners such as job foremen, expert miners, common miners and rescuers are built by using the underground emergency evacuation virtual crowd simulation method based on the multiple intelligent agents according to a role theory. The underground emergency evacuation virtual crowd simulation method based on the multiple intelligent agents can simulate true situations of a mine well, has good universality and verisimilitude, and can provide effective technical support for underground security accident analysis and prevention, mine safety training and rescue exercises.

title_en: Signage for virtual experience in disaster prevention drill
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a signage for virtual experience in disaster prevention drill capable of easily providing virtual training while taking advantage of actual experiences of trainers while removing problems in conventional disaster prevention drill using actual open flame.SOLUTION: A signage 1 for virtual experience in disaster prevention drill having a housing which is movably placed on the ground or floor includes at least: an image display section 1b that displays a fire situation mounted on one side face of the housing 1a; water sensor 1d provided to a part of the one side face of the housing for detecting water splayed on the one side face; a control section electrically connected to the image display section 1b and the water sensor 1d to control display content on the image display section; and a power supply section that supplies the power to the image display section, the water sensor and the control section.

title_en: Manipulator for disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manipulator for a disaster rescue robot. The manipulator comprises a power supply, a translational motor, a reducer coupling, a reducer, a mechanical clamp, a mechanical drill, mechanical shears, a camera, a small arm, a small arm connector, a small arm hydraulic rod, a large arm, a large arm connector, a large arm hydraulic rod, a main control plate, a rotary drive bevel gear, a rotary bevel gear, a rotary bevel gear shaft, an electromagnetic clutch, an angle sensor, a rotary small gear, a rotary large gear, a hydraulic pump, and an electromagnetic reversing valve. The manipulator is characterized in that the manipulator can operate in a 360 DEG operating range, two manipulators can operate in a matching manner, the manipulator is provided with three end mechanical hands of the mechanical clamp, the mechanical drill, and the mechanical shears which can be changed for operation in different occasions, operating efficiency of the disaster rescue robot is improved, and the operating range of the disaster rescue robot is expanded.

title_en: Multifunctional multipurpose portable emergency appliance with functions of case, backpack, chair and bed
abstract_en: A multifunctional multipurpose portable emergency appliance with functions of a case, a backpack, a chair and a bed is characterized in that a fixing bracket, upper and lower hollow pipe connecting shafts, a movable head bracket, heightening, lengthening and widening devices in a trolley case or a backpack are integrally connected with the trolley case or the backpack; the fixing bracket smaller than a case body or a backpack body can be justly attached to the trolley case or the backpack; a main pipe of a movable backrest bracket is hollowed for concealing two movable feet and is rotatably connected onto the upper hollow pipe connecting shaft; the movable head bracket can rotate towards right by 180 DEG. When the backpack is formed, the fixing bracket is divided into parts A and B, upper and lower hollow pipes of the part A are larger than the hollow pipes of the part B; the insides of the hollow pipes of the part A are sleeved with the upper and lower hollow pipes of the part B. An emergency bed for people fond of travel, camping or night fishing to take a midday rest or sleep is obtained by combination of a self-carried small tent, and the appliance is also suitable for hospital patient caring, march training in army camping, disaster relief, self-help refuge of victims, migrant workers, field exploration and scientific investigation, and can be taken as a perambulator for a student to sleep and seat for the midday rest after being slightly modified. Based on design creativity of realizing multifunction and the best use of an article, the fixing bracket, and the heightening, lengthening and widening devices, which are attached to the case body or the backpack body and made of high-strength light materials, are arranged in the hollow inside of the trolley case and the backpack by reasonable layout so as to be integrally connected with the trolley case or the backpack, thereby finishing the functions of article placing, the chair, the bed and a simple table.

title_en: Device for simulating harm of activities of ground fissures to high-speed rail bridge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for simulating harm of activities of ground fissures to a high-speed rail bridge, and belongs to the field of geological disaster analysis. The device comprises a lifting system used for controlling lifting of a ground fissure hanging wall and footwall and the lifting speed of a settlement platform and simulating the activities of the ground fissures, a supporting system used for supporting the lifting system to carry out lifting on the ground fissure hanging wall and footwall, and a monitoring system used for monitoring dislocation, deformation and bridge foundation stress characteristics of a high-speed rail bridge model. Changes of stress in the high-speed rail bridge, bridge deformation and damage zone ranges and unstability and interaction between the bridge and a rail are taken into consideration under the action of different activities of the ground fissures, scientific bases are provided for engineering control measures for sections crossing the ground fissures of the high-speed rail bridge, and meanwhile the harm of the ground fissures to the high-speed rail bridge can be more accurately forecasted.

title_en: System and method for testing influences of gas dynamic disasters on mine ventilation network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and method for testing influences of gas dynamic disasters on a mine ventilation network, and belongs to the field of coal mine gas disaster research. The system is composed of an inflation module, a dynamic action module, a simulation pipe network module and a metering module. The inflation module comprises a gas cylinder, an air cylinder, pressure reducing valves, solenoid valves, flow meters, a vacuum pump, an air compressor and valves. The dynamic action module comprises an explosion container, a pressure gauge, an ignition probe, an igniter, a membrane and a draught fan. The simulation pipe network module comprises a simulation pipeline, connecting pipelines, a flange plate, a bolt and nut, a slice and a rubber band. The metering module comprises pressure sensors, a data collecting instrument and a computer. The system and method for testing the influences of the gas dynamic disasters on the mine ventilation network mainly have the advantages that the influences of the gas dynamic disasters on the mine ventilation network are found by learning the spreading characteristics of gas pressure in the pipe network, and support is provided to the prevention of the gas dynamic disasters and rescue after accidents.

title_en: Simulated fire combustion firefighting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulated fire combustion firefighting system. The simulated fire combustion firefighting system comprises a control device, a smoke generation device, a warm wind generation device, a nozzle array device, a lamplight generation device, a sound effect generation device, a pipeline conveying device and an infrared receiving device. The control device is connected with the smoke generation device, the warm wind generation device, the lamplight generation device, the sound effect generation device, the pipeline conveying device and the infrared receiving device, and the pipeline conveying device is connected with the smoke generation device, the warm wind generation device and the nozzle array device. By the adoption of the mode, the simulated fire combustion firefighting system can represent scenes of real fires through sound, images and warm gas and enable people to comprehensively understand and know fire occurrence and fire extinguishing knowledge, and then firefighting indoor drilling can be conveniently developed.

title_en: Mining-induced fractured rock mass water sand migration testing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining-induced fractured rock mass water sand migration testing system which comprises a bracket, a testing chamber is arranged on the bracket and consists of an upper chamber body and a lower chamber body, a plurality of pressure sensors are evenly distributed in the upper chamber body, a plurality of pore water pressure sensors are evenly distributed in the lower chamber body, a sand layer is paved in the upper chamber body, and rock layers with different lithological characters and blackness are paved in the lower chamber body; along with the downward movement of a top plate, a loose sand layer and the rock layers are gradually compacted, a fragile epoxy resin water-stop plate also moves downward, and is smashed by the tip end of a fracturing rod, so that the upper chamber body and the lower chamber body are communicated. The mining-induced fractured rock mass water sand migration testing system can carry out the migration and pouring-out simulation tests of a water-sand mixture in a fractured rock mass, so that the migration parameters of different stratum combinations can be obtained, and the reliability for recognizing the characteristics of gushing water and inrushing sand disasters on the coal mining-induced working surfaces.

title_en: Water gushing-sand pouring disaster simulation test system of coal-seam mining induction top plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water gushing-sand pouring disaster simulation test system of a coal-seam mining induction top plate. The water gushing-sand pouring disaster simulation test system comprises a bracket, wherein a test bin is arranged in the bracket; a movable simulation coal-mining drag plate is arranged on the bottom of the test bin; an inclined water-sand gathering channel is arranged on the lower part of the simulation coal-mining drag plate; a water-sand collecting device is arranged at the outlet of the water-sand gathering channel; the bottom plate, a left side wall, a right side wall, a front transparent plate body, a rear transparent plate body and the simulation coal-mining drag plate form the test bin; and a plurality of pore water pressure sensors and a plurality of pressure sensors are arranged in the test bin. A technical way of feeding coal measure strata simulating materials in the test bin is adopted to carry out a water gushing-sand pouring disaster simulation test onto the coal-seam mining induction top plate to obtain water-sand gushing parameters of different stratum combinations, so that identification degree of water gushing-sand pouring disaster characteristics of a coal-seam mining induction working surface is improved.

title_en: Mobile fire fighting experience museum
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mobile fire fighting experience museum. The mobile fire fighting experience museum comprises a fire fighting propaganda vehicle; the left side inside the compartment of the fire fighting propaganda vehicle is provided with an automatic fire alarm processing and demonstration system; the right side of the compartment is provided with a building smoke simulation system; a left-side cover plate and a right-side cover plate are respectively embedded in places, corresponding to the positions of the above two systems, on the outer side wall of the compartment; upper ends of the left-side cover plate and the right-side cover plate are respectively hinged with the outer side wall of the compartment; telescopic support rods are arranged between the left-side cover plate, the right-side cover plate and the outer side wall of the compartment; and a high-rise building evacuation simulation device is arranged on the outer side wall of the top part and the tail part of the compartment. Through adopting the above structure, perfection of fire protection knowledge of people is enhanced, familiarity and understanding of fire fighting equipment are enhanced, response processes to fire in many situations can be demonstrated and experienced, three-dimensional propaganda of the fire fighting knowledge is realized, people can have first-hand experience on correct escape way in the case of fire, and fire damage is prevented.
assignees: HENAN MA CHE HUNG IND CO LTD

title_en: Rain shade for disaster simulation
