abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rain shade for disaster simulation, which comprises a wall body, wherein the upper part of the wall body is internally provided with a ventilation pipe, and the upper end of the wall body is provided with a row of air-blast nozzles; the lower ends of the air-blast nozzles are communicated with the ventilation pipe; one side of the wall body is provided with a 3D screen, and a water pipe is arranged above the wall body; and the lower end of the water pipe is connected with a row of water spraying nozzles through threads. The rain shade for disaster simulation has the advantages of reasonable structural design, low cost, convenient application and the like, the water spraying nozzles at the top part of the wall body sprays water downwards, so that the experiencers can fell panic, the simulated rainwater is blown away from the wall body nearby through an air wall formed by a strong wind blasted from the air-blast nozzles, the experiencers are protected against getting wet due to the simulated rainwater, a part of the simulated rainwater is blown into vapour by the strong wind blasted from the air-blast nozzles, the vapour is mingled with the strong wind, and the situation that hurricanes are mingled with rainwater in disaster weather is simulated more comprehensively and realistically, so that the experiencers can experience the immersive hurricane disaster scene with comprehensive safeguard measures.
assignees: WUHU HUAQIANG CULTURE TECHNOLOGY INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Emergency response scenario simulators and simulation techniques
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a system includes a signal generator operatively coupleable to one or more detectors; and a controller, the controller being both operably coupled to the signal generator and configured to cause the signal generator to: generate one or more signals each signal being representative of at least one emergency event; and communicate one or more of the generated signal(s) to a detector to which the signal generator is operably coupled. In another embodiment, a method includes: receiving data corresponding to one or more emergency events; generating at least one signal based on the data; and communicating the generated signal(s) to a detector.

title_en: Train operation control system, train operation simulation device, and train operation simulation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a train operation simulator capable of operating even a timetable is not determined in a device for simulating train operation of a railway operation control system.SOLUTION: The train operation control system comprises: a step 510 for updating weather disaster information and human flow information; a step for simulating a physical state; a step 530 for changing a route of a train when an interruption part is generated due to disaster and for creating the route of the train; a step 570 for controlling a signal device on the train route; and a step for recovering a state when deadlock occurs to a normal state and for applying order limitation for preventing recurrence of the deadlock. Thereby, the train route and the order information are automatically set and occurrence of the deadlock is avoided.

title_en: Orientation jetting and fracturing exploitation method for coal bed gas under coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an orientation jetting and fracturing exploitation method for coal bed gas under a coal mine. The method includes the steps that a drilled hole along a coal bed is formed in a top plate or a bottom plate; a fracturing pipe set and a radial perforator are placed in a first perforation position; the hole is sealed; the fracturing pump set and the perforator are connected with corresponding pump sets respectively, and a jet flow channel is formed by the perforator and used for communicating the coal bed and the drilled hole; annular fracturing liquid is injected into the drilled hole in a pressure mode, and meanwhile annular pressure is kept; the coal bed is continuously jetted for preset time so that cracks can be formed on coal bodies and extend in the bottom direction of jetting holes of the coal bed; jetting and fracturing are stopped at the same time, the perforator is moved to a next jetting position to form the jet flow channel, and then fracturing liquid is pressurize and jetted continuously; the steps of independently jetting a rock stratum and pressurizing and jetting the coal bed are repeatedly executed until jetting and fracturing at all positions in the drilled hole is finished, and then the coal bed gas is extracted. The orientation jetting and fracturing exploitation method has the advantages that the trend and the quantity of the cracks are controllable, exploitation efficiency of the coal bed is high, the gas disaster of the mine can be effectively prevented and treated, and economic and social benefits can be improved.
assignees: CHONGQING ENERGY INVEST GROUP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for establishing simplified hydraulic model of urban downward-concave overpass area under different rainstorm situations
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of municipal engineering, and discloses a method for establishing a simplified hydraulic model of an urban downward-concave overpass area under different rainstorm situations. The method comprises the steps that the catchment range of a high-catchment area and a low-catchment area of the urban downward-concave overpass area and a high-precision DEM are determined to serve as earth surface elevation input conditions of the model; the input of a model pipe network is simplified through the rainfall loss form; the waterlogging disaster situation in the urban downward-concave overpass area under the different rainstorm situations is simulated through the computer hydraulic model; an improvement implement scheme is determined according to a model calculation result. The method for establishing the simplified hydraulic model of the urban downward-concave overpass area under the different rainstorm situations is stated, the waterlogging disaster situation in the urban downward-concave overpass area under the different rainstorm situations can be simulated, and a current overpass area designing scheme can be assessed. According to the method, it makes possible that the reason for ponding of a downward-concave overpass is analyzed through the hydraulic model, and a theoretical basis is provided for improving and planning the downward-concave overpass.

title_en: Drainage basin water catchment range manufacturing method based on urban concave downward flyover area DEM
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drainage basin water catchment range manufacturing method based on an urban concave downward flyover area DEM, and belongs to the technical field of municipal engineering. The construction process includes the steps that an initial urban concave downward flyover area water catchment drainage basin DEM is taken as initial input; a two-dimensional Saint-Venant equation is used for perform two-dimensional overland flow model calculation on a flyover area; a single-flow-direction method D8 method based on grid unit flow quantity is defined again to determine grid unit water flow direction; the calculation range is enlarged continuously, trial outsourcing lines are used for urban concave downward flyover area water catchment drainage basin ranges under different rainstorm circumstances; under the different rainstorm circumstances, computer process simulation of the real-time dynamic changes of the urban concave downward flyover area water catchment drainage basin ranges is achieved and is vivid, real, visual and accurate. A waterlogging inundation disaster is frequent in a concave downward flyover, and the method can provide a data basis for building a concave downward flyover improving, planning and designing model, so that the method has very great application prospects.

title_en: Polarization image classification method based on resolution of tensor dimensionality reduction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to technical field of image processing, it is related to polarimetric synthetic aperture radar（Polarimetric Synthetic Aperture Radar,POLSAR）Image processing techniquess, disclose a kind of polarization image classification method based on resolution of tensor dimensionality reduction.The method utilizes polarization data and polarization characteristic moment matrix structure to build a three-dimensional polarization characteristic tensor, obtains low-dimensional characteristic tensor using based on the dimension reduction method of resolution of tensor, chooses training sample and be supported vector machine from low-dimensional characteristic tensor（Support Vector Machine,SVM）Classification, on the basis of not needing to destroy the three-dimensional structure of polarization characteristic tensor and the spatial relationship of neighbor pixel, eliminate the redundancy between characteristic quantity, avoid dimension disaster problem, improve classifying quality well, and improve efficiency and the robustness of algorithm, can apply in the classification of various complexity landform.

title_en: Assistant decision making system for agricultural planting
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an assistant decision making system for agricultural planting. The assistant decision making system for agricultural planting comprises a data processing and decision making system and a display terminal. The data processing and decision making system combines environment data with geographic data of a region and conducts evaluation and calculation. The display terminal classifies and displays evaluation and calculation results of the data processing and decision making system. According to the auxiliary decision making system for agricultural planting, an adopted information platform can integrate a plurality of heterogeneity databases, such as a farming, climate and soil database, and the adopted information platform, the geographic information system and the general circulation model are integrated into a global climate variation decision support system; simulation and analysis are conducted by means of calculation of a cloud platform, and for the topics such as the greenhouse effect, water source management, farmland resource sustainable utilization, agricultural insurance essential data and agricultural disaster loss evaluation, decision-making is assisted.

title_en: Drill bit track display device based on slight shock monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a drill bit track display device based on slight shock monitoring. A slight shock sensor is arranged on a coal rock or a coal wall and connected with a data acquisition instrument. The data acquisition instrument is sequentially connected with a modulator-demodulator I, a modulator-demodulator II and a data processing host. The drill bit track display device can continuously acquire and transmit data of slight shock signals in real time and store the data, wherein the slight shock signals are generated on site; positional relation data of the sensor and drilled holes in an ore body or a laneway are imported, a visualized three-dimensional interface is provided, generated space-time positioning of a drill bit can be displayed dynamically in real time, and a construction effect picture of the drilled holes can be checked. A technician analyzes the effective control range of the drilled holes according to drill hole distribution and then determines effectiveness of measures, as a result, a basis is provided for the decision on whether other measures need to be taken, and technical guarantee is provided for effective prevention and treatment of a gas dynamical disaster.

title_en: Disaster backup system evaluation tool based on disaster simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster backup system evaluation tool based on disaster simulation. In a word, the disaster backup system evaluation tool based on the disaster simulation achieves simulation of various kinds of specific disaster types so as to test availability and effectiveness of a disaster backup system. Under the condition of giving the simulated disaster type and the disaster strength by a user, the tool automatically simulates the influence of the disaster on an information system, important reference information is provided for disaster backup personnel and relevant decision makers, and therefore the disaster backup personnel and relevant decision makers can make the correct measures to reduce losses of the disaster to the units. Meanwhile, the evaluation tool can test the availability and effectiveness of the existing disaster backup system and find shortcomings of the system, so that the system is improved, and it is ensured that the disaster backup system can provide the effective protection and support in a crisis situation.

title_en: A kind of chemical leakage fast prediction alarm emergency response decision-making method
abstract_en: A kind of chemical leakage fast prediction alarm emergency response decision-making method of the present invention, diffusion model simulation is combined with neutral net and gas sensor system, is applied to quick early warning and the aid decision of industrial park poisonous gas leakage, including：Garden risk factors collection, for recognizing all kinds of leakage accidents that may occur；Numerical simulation, the accident to being likely to occur is simulated, and obtains the coverage of pernicious gas；Data screening, according to live part in actual sensor placement extraction and restructuring numerical simulation result；Neural metwork training, is trained using the data after screening to specific neural network model, to obtain the model parameter for particular industry garden and ambient conditions, and uses redundant data Verification；Sensing system is integrated with neural network model, and model is combined with sensor DCS.

title_en: Method for planning reasonable inventory capacity of petrifaction base
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for planning the reasonable inventory capacity of a petrifaction base. The method includes the steps that based on risks, typical pool fire disaster, explosion and poison gas diffusion accidents in the petrifaction base are selected, the occurrence probabilities of the different accidents are integrated to provide the concept of risk equivalent weights to simulate spatial distribution of the inventory risks on the petrifaction base, a petrifaction base safe inventory capacity model based on the risks is built, different harm models are wholly processed, the different accidents are associated in a harm equivalent weight mode, overlaying of the risks of inventory hazardous objects to points in the petrifaction base is achieved, dead regions are marked out, with potential life losses as indexes, a safe inventory capacity value of the petrifaction base is obtained in cooperation with the population density and an area population number, and under the condition that an industrial structure of the petrifaction base is not changed, enlarging planning is carried out on the inventory capacity of the petrifaction base. The safety level of the petrifaction base is scientifically and effectively improved, blind enlarging of the petrifaction base is avoided, and the safety maintenance cost for the petrifaction base is saved.

title_en: Pressurizing system for fire water ring main using drill water
title_ko: 드릴 워터를 이용한 소화 배관의 압력 유지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire-extinguishing water pipe pressure maintaining system using drill water, more specifically, to a fire-extinguishing water pipe pressure maintaining system using drill water, wherein the drill water provided by a drill water system connected to a fire-extinguishing system can maintain a certain level of pressure in the fire-extinguishing water pipe and the fire-extinguishing water is supplied in a swift and reliable manner in case of fire. Costs and efforts for maintenance and system repairing can be reduced by not using jockey pumps and hydrophore tanks which have been a source of problems due to frequent malfunctioning. The fire-extinguishing water pipe pressure maintaining system using drill water according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a pressure-adding line (110) connected to a fire-extinguishing water pipe (210) for providing a fire-extinguishing water pipe with drill water to add water pressure; a drill water tank (120) in which the drill water is stored to be supplied to the pressure-adding line (110); and a pressure-adding pump (130) for providing power for pumping water to provide the fire-extinguishing water pipe (210) with the drill water of the drill water tank (120) via the pressure-adding line (110).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드릴 워터를 이용한 소화 배관의 압력 유지 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 구체적으로는 드릴 워터 시스템과 소방 시스템의 연결에 의해, 드릴 워터 시스템으로부터 공급되는 드릴 워터에 의해 소화 배관에 대한 압력을 지속적으로 유지하도록 하고, 이로 인해 화재시 소화수를 신속하면서도 안정적으로 공급할 수 있도록 하며, 잦은 고장으로 많은 문제를 야기하였던 자키 펌프(jockey pump)와 압력 탱크(hydrophore tank)를 사용하지 않도록 하여, 유지 및 관리에 소요되는 비용과 수고를 줄일 수 있는 드릴 워터를 이용한 소화 배관의 압력 유지 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 드릴 워터를 이용한 소화 배관의 압력 유지 시스템은 상기 소화 배관(210)에 충압을 위한 드릴 워터(drill water)를 공급하기 위해 연결되는 충압 라인(110); 상기 충압 라인(110)에 공급되기 위한 드릴 워터가 저장되는 드릴 워터 탱크(drill water tank; 120); 및 상기 드릴 워터 탱크(120)의 드릴 워터를 상기 충압 라인(110)을 통해서 상기 소화 배관(210)에 공급되도록 펌핑력을 제공하는 충압용 펌프(130)를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire evacuation simulation system based 3d modeling and simulation method
title_ko: 3차원 공간 기반의 화재 피난 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: A fire evacuation simulation system based on three-dimensional space includes a space module authoring space; a fire module drawing fire combustion simulation results; an avatar module moving on the space; and an evacuation module including movement information for an avatar. A simulation method executed by the fire evacuation simulation system is configured to draw fire evacuation results by authoring three-dimensional space, forming spatial topology and executing fire evacuation simulation, based on the results drawn by the fire module, with fire evacuation conditions set. The fire evacuation simulation system based on three-dimensional space and the simulation method can provide a fire simulation open platform, can realize evacuation simulation which meets domestic conditions, and can check an integrated visual evacuation simulation state using the three-dimensional space information.
abstract_ko: 3차원 공간 기반의 화재 피난 시뮬레이션 시스템은 공간을 저작하는 공간 모듈과, 화재 연소 시뮬레이션 결과를 도출하는 화재 모듈과, 공간 내에서 이동하는 아바타 모듈 및 아바타에 대한 이동정보를 포함하는 피난모듈을 포함하고, 그에 의해 실행되는 시뮬레이션 방법은 3차원 공간을 저작하여 공간토폴로지를 형성하고, 화재 피난 조건을 설정한 상태에서 화재 모듈에 의한 결과치에 근거하여 화재 피난 시뮬레이션을 실행함으로써 화재 피난 결과를 도출하도록 구성된다. 이와 같이 구성되는 차원 공간 기반의 화재 피난 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 시뮬레이션 방법에 의하면, 화재 시뮬레이션 오픈 플랫폼을 제공하고, 국내 실정에 부합하는 피난 시뮬레이션의 구현이 가능하며, 3차원 공간정보를 통해 통합적이고 가시적인 피난 시뮬레이션 상태를 확인할 수 있는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Processing method of fire risk element data of fire evacuation simulation program
title_ko: 화재 피난 시뮬레이션 프로그램의 화재 위험요소 데이터 처리 방법
abstract_en: A method for processing fire risk element data used for a fire evacuation simulation program analyzes fire risk element data supported by a fire module and data on evacuation analysis space and, when the information on the evacuation analysis space does not match information on fire space, calculates a correction rate and modifies the information on the evacuation analysis space, and extracts the fire risk element data in order, generates files, corrects the fire risk element data in an integer type, and extracts the fire risk element data in the order of respective spatial coordinates, generating the corrected fire risk element data. The method for processing fire risk element data used for a fire evacuation simulation program according to the present invention as configured above can process fire risk element data in an integer type to significantly reduce processing capacity, thereby enabling fire simulation of a much higher capacity of information.
abstract_ko: 화재 피난 시뮬레이션 프로그램의 화재 위험 요소 데이터 처리 방법은 화재 모듈로부터 지원되는 화재 위험 요소 데이터 및 피난 분석 공간에 대한 데이터를 분석하여, 피난 공간에 대한 정보가 화재 공간에 대한 정보와 불일치할 경우 보정율을 산정하여 피난 공간에 대한 정보를 수정하고, 화재 위험 요소 데이터를 순서대로 추출하여 파일을 생성하고 정수형으로 보정하여 각 공간 좌표의 순서대로 추출함으로써 수정된 화재 위험 요소 데이터를 생성한다. 이와 같이 구성되는 본 발명의 화재 피난 시뮬레이션 프로그램의 화재 위험 요소 데이터 처리 방법에 의하면, 화재 위험 요소 데이터를 정수형으로 가공하여 처리 용량을 대폭 감소시키기 때문에 월등히 많은 용량의 정보에 대한 화재 시뮬레이션이 가능한 이점이 있다.

title_en: A dryin tower for fire hose
title_ko: 다목적 소방호스 건조 타워
abstract_en: Disclosed a multipurpose fire hose drying tower which comprises: a column fixed to the ground, and vertically erected; a cage elevated along a guide rail formed at the column, and having a holder on which a fire hose is held; a driving part supplying power for the elevation of the cage, and installed at the column; a jump platform formed to be integrated with the column, and positioned within the elevation section of the cage elevated by the driving part; a support positioned higher than the jump platform, formed to be integrated with the column, and having a hook on which a descending life line is to be installed; and a ladder formed on the surface of the column so that a user can access to the cage and the jump platform. Therefore, the wet fire hose having water remaining therein is elevated to the upper side of the column after held on the holder of the cage, so that not only the wet fire hose can be quickly dried by being hung down lengthily, but also the rope descending training of a fireman or a test for the descending life line can be performed, and, as a result, the utilization of the fire hose drying tower can be improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다목적 소방호스 건조 타워에 관한 것으로, 지면에 고정되며 수직으로 세워진 기둥과, 상기 기둥에 형성된 가이드 레일을 따라 승강하며 소방호스를 거는 걸이대가 형성된 케이지와, 상기 케이지의 승강에 동력을 제공하는 기둥에 설치된 구동부와, 상기 구동부에 의해 승강하는 케이지의 승강 구간 내에서 기둥과 일체로 형성되는 점프대와, 상기 점프대보다 높은 위치에서 기둥과 일체로 형성되고 완강기가 설치되는 고리가 형성된 지지대 및 상기 케이지와 점프대에 사용자가 접근할 수 있게 기둥의 표면에 형성되는 사다리를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 다목적 소방호스 건조 타워가 개시된다.  이에 따라서, 물기가 남은 젖은 소방호스를 케이지의 걸이대에 걸고 케이지를 기둥의 상부로 상승시킴으로써 젖은 소방호스를 길게 늘어트려 신속하게 건조시킬 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 소방대원의 로프 하강훈련 또는 완강기에 대한 테스트를 실시할 수 있기 때문에 그 활용도가 매우 높다.

title_en: Self-locking tweezers special for fire disaster smog particle collecting
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire disaster smog studying, in particular to a pair of self-locking tweezers special for fire disaster smog particle collecting. The self-locking tweezers comprise a left half tweezers part, a right half tweezers part, a rotating shaft, tweezers front end slots, tweezers front end drilled holes, two-level bending points, handles, a spring and a spring fixing protrusion, wherein the drilled holes with the diameter of 2 mm are formed in the front end of the tweezers, and therefore an effective circular use area with the diameter of 2mm is formed in the center of a carbon supporting film. The carbon supporting film can be taken out and placed conveniently through the tweezers front end slots. The spring is arranged between the tweezers handles, and self-locking of tweezers heads can be achieved. In the scene where smog particles are collected through the carbon supporting film, the self-locking tweezers have superior convenience and the good smog particle collecting effect.

title_en: Charge monitoring device in coal gas migration process and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charge monitoring device in the coal body gas migration process and a monitoring method thereof, belongs to the technical field of coal mine disaster monitoring and relates to the charge monitoring device and the monitoring method of the device. The charge signal change rule of the coal body in the gas migration process under the specific stress state can be quantificationally simulated, meanwhile, a coal body charge oscillation coefficient is provided for being used as an index for distinguishing gas abnormity and stress abnormity, and it is significant in monitoring coal body gas migration charge precursory information. The device comprises a coal body experiment mechanism, a loading system, a tail gas treatment system, a left charge monitoring system and a right charge monitoring system. The coal body experiment mechanism is composed of the coal body, a three-axis pressure chamber, a piston, a pressing plate, a left pressing head and a right pressing head, the loading system comprises a confining pressure system, an axial pressure system and a pore pressure system, and the monitoring method of the charge monitoring device in the coal body gas migration process comprises the following steps of coal body degassing, pressure exerting, background signal testing, test beginning, tail gas treating, and coal body charge oscillation coefficient calculating.

title_en: Urban rail transit emergency evacuation optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban rail transit emergency evacuation optimization method and system. The method comprises the steps that metadata influencing the urban rail transit evacuation are collected, parameter classification storage is conducted on the metadata according to the Agent object type; a simulation model of urban rail transit emergency evacuation is constructed based on the Agent modeling approach by the adoption of the above stored data; analysis is conducted on the influence of evacuation time and artificial system property in the evacuation process on the evacuation result under the situation of an emergency event according to the simulation model of urban rail transit emergency evacuation; assessment and optimization are conducted on the analysis result. The invention further discloses an urban rail transit emergency evacuation optimization system which comprises a data collecting module, a modeling and simulation unit, a dynamic control unit and a simulation result analysis module. The urban rail transit emergency evacuation optimization method and system have the advantages that the intelligent simulation model can be achieved, good expandability is achieved, visual and complete analysis of the evacuation process is achieved, the auxiliary decision-making universality is strong and the like.

title_en: Perforation fracturing permeability-improvement method for high-stress low-porosity coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a perforation fracturing permeability-improvement method for a high-stress low-porosity coal seam, and belongs to the field of disaster prevention and control of mining working faces of coal mines. The method comprises the steps that firstly, coal body mechanical properties are measured, and related technical parameters such as the perforation depth, coal body crack initiation pressure, the fracturing permeability-improvement radius, the separation distance between drilled holes and the separation distance between perforations are determined; then, a coal seam perforation system is installed, and perforation operation is conducted on the coal seam perforation system; after perforation operation is accomplished, a hydraulic fracturing system is installed, fracturing is started, water is injected, and changes of a pressure value are observed until fracturing operation is accomplished. According to the method, a fracturing structure is additionally arranged in a coal body, elastic potential energy of the coal body can be released effectively, and a preparation is made for rock burst prevention and control work of the working faces; meanwhile, high-pressure water can play a good role in moistening the coal seam, the quantity of dust produced during mining of the coal seam is reduced, creation of a good working environment is facilitated, and physical health of underground workers is protected.

title_en: Method for quickly determining permeability of working surface front coal body of underground coal mine in lab
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining permeability of a working surface front coal body of an underground coal mine, and belongs to the field of preventing and controlling disasters of a coal mine excavation working surface. The method comprises the following steps of firstly determining a coal mine mining-induced stress monitoring system on the spot to obtain a mining-induced stress distribution curve of the working surface front coal body, and combining with a working surface advancing speed to draw a changing curve of mining-induced stress of a coal body unit, which is at a certain distance from the front part of the working surface, in a working surface advancing process; encoding an axle stress loading and confining pressure unloading synchronization servo control program by utilizing Visual C++, and introducing in a true three-axis permeability testing system computer controller, so as to simulate a mining-induced stress changing process of the coal body unit having the certain distance with the front part of the working surface along with the advancing of the working surface by utilizing a true three-axis permeability test; finally obtaining a permeability value and the changing rule of the permeability value of the coal body unit along with the advancing of the working surface. According to the method for determining the permeability of the working surface front coal body of the underground coal mine, the permeability of the coal body in front of the tunneling working surface and the stope face can be precisely and quickly determined.

title_en: Test bed device for tunnel excavating and grouting model and application method of device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test bed device for a tunnel excavating and grouting model and an application method of the device. The test bed device comprises a lateral wall, a head cover for providing and loading a crustal stress platform, and a bottom plate arranged at the top of a reinforced concrete support rack, wherein the lateral wall vertically stands on the bottom plate and is connected with the bottom plate; the head cover is arranged at the top of the lateral wall and connected with the lateral wall; the lateral wall is formed by a plurality of model ring units which are stacked together in the vertical direction and sequentially connected; two round holes are formed in tunnel design positions in the diameter directions corresponding to the model ring units; the round holes are plugged by using arc sealing steel plates which are the same as the lateral wall in radian before tunnel excavation; holes are formed in the positions at four corners of the arc sealing steel plates; the arc sealing steel plates are connected with the lateral wall. By adopting the device, the geological disaster generation process and the later grouting reinforcing process in the tunnel excavation process can be continuously and systematically simulated, and the device has the advantages of being high in strength, and convenient to assemble and dismantle by adopting a modular assembling mode.

title_en: Firefighting practical training platform
abstract_en: Provided in the utility model is a firefighting practical training platform comprising a host platform and a human-computer interaction interface connected with the host platform. An attendance registration unit is arranged at the host platform; a counter is arranged at one side of the attendance registration unit; and data from the attendance registration unit and the counter are transmitted and stored to a memory. A pull rod and a button for firefighting practical training are arranged at the host platform; a displacement sensor for measuring the moving distance of the pull rod is arranged at one side of the pull rod; and an opto-isolator unit for carrying out detection by using an opto-isolator input method is arranged at one side of the button. According to the scheme, the provided firefighting practical training platform has the following beneficial effects: a phenomenon of cheating due to utilization of the original sign-in and sign-out method with papers can be avoided; all information of students can be stored in the memory and thus difficulties that the less historical record information content is stored and the historical record information can not be traced during the practical training process can be overcome; and different cooperation of feedback units and alarm units is used, so that the practical training of the students becomes more effective.
assignees: SUZHOU SIDI INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of mine disaster simulated training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mine disaster simulated training system, broadcast intercommunication subsystem, video monitoring subsystem and disaster simulation subsystem including audio network；Audio network broadcast intercommunication subsystem is made up of call center, Relay Server, IP voice frequency terminal and IP network broadcast audio amplifier, IP voice frequency terminal is connected with underground switch by netting twine with IP network broadcast audio amplifier, and call center and Relay Server are connected with ground switch by netting twine；Video monitoring subsystem is made up of video monitoring wall and numeral infrared network camera, and video monitoring wall is connected by netting twine with ground switch, and numeral infrared network camera is connected by netting twine with underground switch；Disaster simulation subsystem is made up of PLC host computer, PLC control cabinet, on the spot/long-distance control cabinet and simulated training system.The present invention can simulate multiple natural natural disaster environment, incorporates training system, and effectively training rescue personnel is for the adaptibility to response of accident.

title_en: Experiment platform for simulation of control over fire smoke at key connection positions of subway station
abstract_en: The invention provides an experiment platform for simulation of control over fire smoke at key connection positions of a subway station. The experiment platform for simulation of control over the fire smoke at the key connection positions of the subway station comprises a simulated station hall layer, a simulated platform layer, a simulated tunnel rail traveling layer, a simulated subway train, a ventilation and smoke discharge system, an air curtain system and a fire parameter measurement system. By the adoption of the experiment platform, study on a series of basic theories such as the flowing characteristics of fire smoke, generated when a fire disaster occurs on a subway station, at the key positions where a platform, a station hall and a tunnel rail traveling area are connected and control mode optimization and engineering practical problems can be conducted; a complete solution to study on the evolvement rule of the characteristic parameters such as the effectiveness of a technology for controlling the fire smoke at the key connection positions of the subway station, the temperature field and the poisonous gas concentration field in the scene that fire disaster occur on subway train fire-prevention parking stations and a subway station platforms is provided.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted rescue lifting system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to coal rescue field, particularly disclose a kind of vehicle-mounted rescue lifting system；Technical problem to be solved there is provided that a kind of response time is short, security performance is high enough and can be greatly enhanced the vehicle-mounted rescue lifting system of personnel's survival rate of taking refuge；Including headstock and automobile chassis, also include hoisting gear system, rescue cabin and wellhead assembly, described hoisting gear system and rescue cabin are fixed on automobile chassis, described hoisting gear system is flexibly connected with rescue cabin and controls rescue cabin and moves up and down in proposing people's boring, described wellhead assembly is arranged on and carries people's drilling orifice, and wellhead assembly proposes people's drilling orifice opening and closing for control；The present invention vehicle-mounted rescue lifting system can accelerate the speed of whole rescue, have only to be opened by car to disaster mine, it becomes possible to by lifting system and rescue cabin from carrying people holes, quickly the personnel of taking refuge rescued, response time is short, it is possible to improve the survival rate of the personnel that take refuge greatly.

title_en: Mine water damage simulation test device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mine water damage simulation test device, including sump and water damage chamber, sump is provided with bidirectional high-pressure water pump, and bidirectional high-pressure water pump is connected with water damage chamber by aqueduct and drainage pipeline.Water damage chamber includes internal retaining chamber and outside leting speeper chamber, is provided with water door between internal retaining chamber and outside leting speeper chamber.Outside leting speeper chamber is provided with hermatic door.Internal retaining chamber and outside leting speeper chamber are respectively disposed with underwater illumination device and the most rotatable high-definition camera.Water door is provided with electrical ball valve dewatering orifice, organic glass observation window and sensor stand.Simple in construction, experimentation cost are low, can carry out the mine water disaster controlling experiment simulations such as underground goaf leting speeper, goaf gushing water, hydrologic monitoring simultaneously.

title_en: Cigarette production system with disaster tolerance function and disaster tolerance exercise method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cigarette production system with the disaster tolerance function and a disaster tolerance exercise method thereof. The cigarette production system is provided with a disaster tolerance database server, a disaster tolerance data storage device and a continuous data protection device. In the production process, production data generated by a production database server are stored in the disaster tolerance data storage device in real time, disaster tolerance data are kept consistent with the production data, and therefore when the production database server breaks down, the production database server can be switched to the disaster tolerance database server to continue production. In the process of disaster tolerance exercise of the cigarette production system, a disaster tolerance exercise scheme is set first, each step in the disaster tolerance exercise scheme is directly executed, and then disaster tolerance exercise can be completed; besides, an executing end and a monitoring end are arranged in each exercise step, and when the monitoring ends discover that abnormal operation occurs when the executing ends execute the corresponding steps, operation of the executing ends can be immediately stopped. Thus, risks occurring in the exercise process are greatly reduced, and the exercise efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Student evacuation simulation training device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a student evacuation simulation training device, particularly relates to an evacuation simulation training device used in emergency situations, and belongs to the field of simulation training. The student evacuation simulation training device is mainly used for self-rescue knowledge spreading and popularizing among students in emergency situations. The virtual environment of an emergency situation is simulated through a computer control system, induction equipment and the like, the students seem to stay in a real crisis scene and learn correct evacuation. The information fusion technology is used in the device, projection information and participating trainee status information obtained through a plurality of sensors are fused, voice prompts are fed back, training is made to be real and effective, and finally training results of participating trainees are provided. The student evacuation simulation training device enables the participating trainees to experience real crisis scenes and experience and learn evacuation skills, and finally can conduct judgment and comment playback on the whole evaluation training process.

title_en: Test bed for testing combustion performance of roof materials
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test bed for testing combustion performance of roof materials. The test bed comprises a simulated eave, a testing platform and a position adjusting device. In a testing process, a test sample is placed on the testing platform, and the position adjusting device is arranged below the testing platform and is used for adjusting the height and the angle of the testing platform to ensure that the upper surface of the test sample and the upper edge of the simulated eave are on a same horizontal plane. The position adjusting device comprises a hoisting device for adjusting the height of the testing platform and an angle adjusting device for adjusting the angle of the testing platform; the hoisting device is arranged below the angle adjusting device. The test bed can be used for testing the combustion performance of roof materials in an actual fire disaster and can be used for really evaluating the fireproof performance of the test sample so as to reduce fire hidden dangers.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BUILDING MATERIALS INST LTD COMPANY

title_en: Water diversion fracture zone height estimating method
abstract_en: The invention provides a water diversion fracture zone height estimating method. The water diversion fracture zone height estimating method comprises the steps of firstly adopting a key layer position judgment method to confirm positions of key layers in overlying rocks by collecting surface drilling columnar information of the working face to be judged according to structural features of an overlying rock layer on a stope under the specific mining conditions; secondarily analyzing the ratios of the key layers to a coal seam separation distance and coal seam mining height to judge whether the key layer breakage gaps are through or not; the judging the development height of a water diversion fracture zone to terminate a bottom boundary of the key layer with non-through crack firstly occurring from bottom to top, and judging that the development height of the water diversion fracture zone extends to a top boundary of a bed rock if the breakage gaps of the existing main key layer in the judgment process is also through. The water diversion fracture zone height estimating method is used for roof water burst disaster prevention and control practice of coal mines, has high practicability, can adapt to the water diversion fracture zone height under different mining thickness conditions and meanwhile can perform judgment on the water diversion fracture zone height abnormal development situation caused by overlying rock key layer structure change.

title_en: Method for designing railway tunnel inclined shaft type emergency exit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for designing a railway tunnel inclined shaft type emergency exit. The method includes the steps of structure setting, data acquisition, analogue simulation and structural design calculation. An evacuation exit is composed of an inclined shaft type structure and comprises a protection door which is connected with a main tunnel and arranged at an entrance, and a gentle slope section and an inclined shaft section of the inclined shaft type structure. The width of the gentle slope section is not less than that of the inclined shaft section, the minimum width D (P) of the protection door is equal to 1.75e<0.025p>, the minimum area A (P) of the gentle slope section is equal to 34e<0.1p>, and the maximum gradient S (a) of the gentle slope section is equal to e<0.18a>. A numerical computation method and model are adopted, the structural design parameters of the safe evacuation emergency channel satisfying personnel of different numbers are acquired, and the parameters also fully reflect the influences of the structure condition of the emergency channel on emergency evacuation of personnel in a tunnel. The invention provides a structural design method of an existing inclined shaft type emergency channel, the structural design method provides a scientific basis for structural design of the inclined shaft type emergency channel, safe reliability of disaster prevention rescue evacuation of the railway tunnel is enhanced, and economy, reasonability, safety and high efficiency are achieved to the maximum degree, and losses are reduced.

title_en: Stress field of the surrounding rock distribution tester and method
abstract_en: A kind of stress field of the surrounding rock distribution tester and method, it is adaptable to roadway workface country rock/coal petrography STRESS VARIATION monitoring is used by underground coal mine.Including stress field of the surrounding rock distribution tester, during test country rock body arrange drilling array, measure optical fiber install in the borehole, will measure optical fiber series connection access optical fiber cable for mine, be connected with optical fibre interrogation instrument, it is achieved optical signal from down-hole to aboveground transmission；Optical signal demodulation is digital signal and transmits to computer and monitor in real time and analyze and process by optical fibre interrogation instrument, provides the measuring method of surrouding rock stress field distribution according to the relation of the relation of Brillouin shift and strain, strain and stress.The design uses single end testing, not necessarily form test loop, reduce monitoring cost and monitoring difficulty, solve current surrouding rock stress monitoring during monitoring point is many, monitoring range is limited, signal transmssion line lays and the problem of system complex, help lend some impetus to the progress of the plant quarantine of the coal rock dynamic disasters such as bump.

title_en: Coal and gas outburst dynamic effect simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal and gas outburst dynamic effect simulation experiment device which comprises a power system, a pipeline system and a dust removal system, wherein the power system comprises a pressure container with a container opening and an outlet device for connecting the container opening with the pipeline system, an explosion venting mechanism for opening the container opening when the container opening is sealed and pressed is arranged in the outlet device, the pipeline system comprises a pipeline assembly and a connecting pipe, the pipeline assembly is a multi-branch structure formed by connecting pipeline units through flanges, each pipeline unit comprises a straight pipe, a first connecting pipe and a second connecting pipe, and each pipeline unit is provided with an observation hole and/or a test hole; the dust removal system comprises an upper box body, a middle box body and a lower box body, wherein the upper box body is provided with a purified gas outlet, the lower box body is provided with a pipeline interface and an openable dust removal port, and the middle box body is internally provided with at least two bag dust removal devices; the invention can more clearly know the disaster-causing mechanism and the occurrence and development rules of the coal and gas outburst and effectively control the coal and gas outburst disasters.

title_en: Power system for coal and gas outburst power effect simulation experiment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system for a coal and gas outburst power effect simulation experiment, which comprises a pressure container for filling simulation experiment materials, wherein the pressure container is fixed on the ground and is provided with a container opening, the pressure container is provided with a container inflation hole and a coal inlet which can be opened and closed, the power system also comprises an outlet device for connecting the container opening and an experiment roadway, and an explosion venting mechanism for opening the container opening when sealing and pressing is arranged in the outlet device; adding coal particles into the pressure container from the coal inlet, filling gas into the gas filling hole of the container, opening the container instantly when the pressure reaches the explosion point of the explosion venting mechanism, communicating the pressure container with the experimental tunnel at the moment, crushing and throwing out the coal, and starting a dynamic effect simulation experiment; the invention has simple structure, is beneficial to more clearly knowing the disaster-causing mechanism and the occurrence and development rules of coal and gas outburst and effectively controlling the coal and gas outburst disasters.

title_en: Transient electromagnetic method ground hole detection method and device
abstract_en: A ground arranges the large transmitting loop totally surrounding the stratum of goal, the power supply produces the primary electromagnetic field, the secondary field of three-component around direct receiving hole in the borehole of bedding in the underground, survey the transient electromagnetic earth hole detection method and apparatus of the disaster-causing body of the latent, realize transmitting and receiving and separate, not merely can avoid the interference of local good electrical conductor, industrial electromagnetic signal and periodic electrical signal of the ground, and can avoid the 'shielding' influence of the stratum surface low resistance layer or low resistance mineralization zone; the receiving device is placed in the drill hole, and complex construction environments outside the hole can be avoided, such as tunneling equipment, anchor rods, anchor nets, transportation equipment, industrial electricity and the like in a coal mine roadway.

title_en: Transformer station's temperature controller pick-up unit
abstract_en: Transformer station of the present invention temperature controller pick-up unit, belongs to the technical field that transformer station's temperature controller detects.A kind of transformer station temperature controller pick-up unit, comprising: aluminium alloy box, guidance panel, two control handles, power source base, switch lamp, temperature controller pedestal, circuit board, two potentiometers; Described guidance panel is placed in aluminium alloy box; Control handle, power source base, switch lamp, temperature controller pedestal are embedded in described guidance panel; Described circuit board, two potentiometers to be built in described aluminium alloy box under guidance panel; Described circuit board is provided with internal circuit, and internal circuit comprises transformer, is connected to the rectifier bridge of transformer secondary end and is connected to the filter capacitor at rectifier bridge two ends.This device volume is little, lightweight, facilitates personnel to carry inbound patrolling and examining; This device by potentiometer can simulated environment epidemic disaster change, achieve humiture can not trigger temperature controller automatically run time, also whether well can judge temperature controller " automatically " function.

title_en: Indoor and outdoor mixed autonomous cruising system and method of aircraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to an indoor and outdoor mixed autonomous cruising system and method of an aircraft. The system is composed of a locus generating and transmitting module, a locus receiving and cruising module, an indoor positioning system and an outdoor global positioning system, wherein the indoor positioning system and the outdoor global positioning system provide reference coordinates. The method comprises the steps including a locus generating and transmitting work flow, a first locus receiving work flow, a second locus receiving work flow and a cruising and control work flow. Due to employment of the system and method, the aircraft can autonomously cruise in indoor environments as an airport, exhibition hall, office building, warehouse, underground parking lot and military training base as well as indoor and outdoor environment mixed places, and can be applied to the field as monitoring and disaster rescue. The system is simple in structure and low in cost; and the method is simple to operate, excellent in performance, and suitable for autonomous cruising of aircrafts in different indoor and outdoor mixed environments.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI;SHANGHAI DIEQUAN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: The points distributing method of a kind of ash tree flower mushroom room Temperature Humidity Sensor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the points distributing method of a kind of ash tree flower mushroom room Temperature Humidity Sensor.The method, first, adopts the mathematics physics model of epidemic disaster field in CFD method establishment corresponding ash tree flower mushroom room; Secondly, consider solar radiation, the factors such as mushroom room condition, carry out numerical simulation to given mushroom room geometric format (territory); Again and, grasp the distribution situation of internal temperature field, mushroom room and moisture field, instruct the preliminary installation of Temperature Humidity Sensor, and design ash tree flower mushroom room humiture observation system; Finally, be analyzed according to the temperature and humidity test data of ash tree flower mushroom room humiture observation system collection and numerical simulation result, determine the point position of Temperature and Humidity in the ash tree flower mushroom room after simplifying, and then determine the Optimizing mode of Temperature Humidity Sensor.The inventive method makes monitoring system can utilize as far as possible few Temperature Humidity Sensor, detects the data of humiture change in reaction mushroom room exactly, required manual labor and testing cost is reduced, and improves diagnosis efficiency.

title_en: A kind of crowd evacuation emulation system based on compound potential energy field
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of crowd evacuation emulation system based on compound potential energy field, system adopts improved potential energy field model, by the potential energy field linear combination by the potential energy field of traditional employing Di Likelei boundary condition and using Nuo Yiman boundary condition, and the local potential energy field solving interpersonal conflict-free problem is added thereto, obtain compound potential energy field, more New Policy in conjunction with pedestrian and the control method to pedestrian's speed, the analogue system of in case of emergency evacuating personnel in different scales scene according to actual scene layout, can be set up.The path planning taking into full account motion unit during crowd simulation is to the impact evacuated, and Potential field method has certain help for solving this influence factor.This system is with a wide range of applications in a large amount of personal securities in different scales scene, rapid evacuation simulation study, the design defect in scene can be searched, assist formulation emergency to carry into execution a plan, be a kind of both economical feasible crowd evacuation emulation system.

title_en: Aircraft cabin firefighting forcible entry training device
abstract_en: An aircraft cabin firefighting forcible entry training device comprises a vertical mounting rack, a cabin, a cabin door, a rotating shaft, a spoke type frame and a plurality of pieces of skin. The two ends of the rotating shaft are connected to the upper portions of the two sides of the rear end of the vertical mounting rack respectively. The cabin is fixed to the rotating shaft through the spoke-type frame arranged in the cabin. The middles of the two side edges of the cabin door are connected to the upper portions of the two sides of the front end of the vertical mounting rack respectively, and the upper corner and the lower corner of each of the two sides of the cabin door are respectively connected to the rear end of the vertical mounting rack located on the same side through a connecting rod. The multiple pieces of skin are fixed to the front end face of the cabin door and the outer circumferential surface of the cabin. According to the aircraft cabin firefighting forcible entry training device, through a hydraulic cylinder, the vertical mounting rack can be supported and the height of the vertical mounting rack can be adjusted; by rotating the cabin by different angles, firefighting forcible entry training demands for different aircraft models and different positions can be met; after the firefighting forcible entry training, only the damaged skin needs to be replaced; the device is flexible, efficient, capable of saving materials and being used for traditional firefighting forcible entry training and firefighting forcible entry training through a fine water mist cutting fire extinguishing gun system and good in training effect.
assignees: TIANJIN HANGJIA AIRPORT EQUIPMENT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for distinguishing position of rockburst risk on deep buried tunnel section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for distinguishing the position of a rockburst risk on a deep buried tunnel section. The method comprises the following steps: A, performing numerical simulation analysis according to the shape of a section, engineering geology, conditions of initial ground stress and an excavation method before tunnel excavation, to be specific, a, performing indoor rock mechanics experiments and parametric inversion; b, confirming a three-dimensional initial ground stress field; c, constructing a geometrical model for three-dimensional numerical calculation according to stratigraphic distribution, geologic construction and the size of the tunnel section; d, implementing numerical calculation and analysis of a tunnel excavation process for the geometrical model; e, analyzing the distributed situation of the local energy release rate on the tunnel section; B, monitoring slight shock in a real-time mode in the tunnel excavation process, to be specific, 1, mounting a sensor at the rear part of a tunnel face; 2, collecting slight shock signals in the process of the micro fracture of rock mass to invert the occurrence position of the micro fracture of surrounding rocks; 3, analyzing the projection distribution of micro fracture events on the tunnel section; C, performing comprehensive evaluation on the distinguished occurrence positions of the rockburst risk. Through the adoption of the method, the occurrence of rockburst disasters is reduced or avoided, and the construction safety and the construction progress are ensured.
assignees: INST OF ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: One method from VIIRS data inversion surface temperature
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of method from NPP VIIRS data acquisition surface temperature, can be meteorological, agricultural drought disaster and the environmental monitoring monitoring suitable surface temperature data of offer.The method overcomes VIIRS sensor not have vapor channel to limit the shortcoming of inversion accuracy, uses the steam data of the MODIS sensor steam data acquisition VIIRS data observation swath that the Aqua satellite operating in sun-synchronous orbit (by intersection point time 13:30) equally carries.The present invention has derived and has been suitable for the Surface Temperature Retrieval algorithm of VIIRS sensor 11um and 12um, utilizes the simulation of atmospheric radiation transmission MODTRAN4 to calculate different atmosphere vapour (0.4 6.0 g/cm 2 , by 0.1 g/cm 2 Step-length increases) VIIRS M15 and the transmitance of M16 passage under content, make corresponding look-up table, by global seismic type (International Geosphere Biosphere Program, IGBP) emissivity of the corresponding atural object of data estimation VIIRS sensor M15 and M16 passage, finally achieves the inverting of surface temperature.VIIRS sensor Surface Temperature Retrieval is studied by the present invention, is conducive to using the smooth transition to VIIRS data of the MODIS data in agricultural environment data monitoring.

title_en: Multi-Agent based virtual coal mine emergency evacuation simulation method and system based on
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-Agent based virtual coal mine emergency evacuation simulation method and system. The multi-Agent based virtual coal mine emergency evacuation simulation system comprises a database module, an information processing central module, a system initialization module, a communication module, an environmental information monitoring module, a data statistics module, an intelligent agent producing module, an intelligent agent extinction module, a learning module, a simulation module and a display module. The database module comprises a comprehensive database, a learning knowledge base and a reasoning database, wherein the comprehensive database comprises a danger source sub-base, a system resource sub-base and an initial configuration resource sub-base. The multi-Agent based virtual coal mine emergency evacuation simulation method and system can provide accurate description on a coal mine environment, a danger source, a specific underground roadway and corresponding facilities in a simulation environment, provide efficient miner refuge behavior simulation, can effectively embody the real situation when disaster occurs underground a coal mine, accordingly provide theoretical guidance and basis for real coal mine emergency evacuation, have universality and expansibility, remedy the localization and overcome the shortcomings of the coal mine emergency evacuation simulation system in a small range.

title_en: A kind of lithium ion battery fire-fighting experiment cabinet carrying automatic alarm and fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of lithium ion battery fire-fighting experiment cabinet carrying automatic alarm and fire extinguishing system, mainly by fire hydrant cabinet main body, automatic alarm system, battery fixing bracket, thermal source analog systems, measure and monitoring system, fire extinguishing system and smoke evacuation system form.By how reconditioning, can realize simulating the sensitivity of dissimilar fire detector after lithium ion battery catches fire (sense cigarette, temperature-sensitive or cigarette temperature are one-piece type etc.) and response characteristic, be applicable to the multiple gases extinguishing chemical of lithium-ion electric Pool fire extinguishing effect (including actual attack time, foamite amount etc.), put out a fire after the research on factors such as the impacts of performance of lithium ion battery of the difference extinguishing chemicals.In the present invention according to fire-fighting cabinet autonomous Design vertical extinguishing chemical release pipeline, after can realizing batteries caught fire, extinguishing chemical is discharged in battery rack in shorter time more fully, substantially reduce attack time and foamite amount, reduce fire extinguishing cost and the damage to lithium ion battery.

title_en: In-hole direct current electric method advanced detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a direct current electric method advanced detection method. Influences of adverse factors in a rear area can be effectively avoided, the signal-to-noise ratio and the resolution capacity to anomalous bodies in stratum media on the periphery of a hole are improved, the detection accuracy rate is improved, current electrodes are fixed behind a roadway construction facing head, steady currents are provided for stratums, a point power source field is built, a change rule of the point power source field is observed along the interior of the stratum drilled hole in front of the facing head, and hidden disaster-caused bodies in front of the roadway construction position are detected. The direct current electric method advanced detection method relates to the multiple current electrodes arranged nearby the roadway construction facing head, a power supply system is formed by the current electrodes and an infinite electrode, and a receiving system composed of receiving electrodes is arranged in the drilled hole. The receiving electrodes are sequentially and movably distributed from a hole opening to the deep portion, potential differences generated when the three current electrodes respectively supply power are received when the receiving electrodes move one time, and the apparent resistivity at the corresponding position can be calculated. The potential differences and the calculated apparent resistivity serve as essential data, the three sets of data are jointly processed, and data bodies capable of being used for geological interpretations are obtained.
assignees: XI AN RES INST OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENG GROUP CORP

title_en: Steel structure fire disaster temperature field inverse presumption method based on displacement forms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steel structure fire disaster temperature field inverse presumption method based on displacement forms. The method comprises the following steps that field investigation is conducted on a steel structure after a fire disaster, the structure is divided into different grids, the geometric center point of each grid is used as a displacement characteristic point, and displacement values of the displacement characteristic points are measured; a finite element calculation model is established; the established finite element calculating model is used for determining a temperature-displacement topological matrix between the temperature change of a structure rod piece in a single grid and displacement of the displacement characteristic points of the other grids; a temperature correction weight matrix is calculated according to the distance relationships between the displacement characteristic points; temperature field inverse iteration presumption is conducted. By means of the steel structure fire disaster temperature field inverse presumption method, temperature field distribution of the steel structure in the fire disaster can be accurately and quantitatively obtained and accurate input conditions is provided for finite element simulation of the steel structure after the fire disaster. The steel structure fire disaster temperature field inverse presumption method is high in result precision, has universality and has wide application prospects in the fields such as performance estimation, repair and reinforcement, disassembly scheme making of steel structures after fire disasters.

title_en: Method for establishing high-rise building personnel evacuation bioluminescence particle swarm optimization algorithm model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a high-rise building personnel evacuation bioluminescence particle swarm optimization algorithm model. Firstly, based on the biological principle in the natural fluorescent family, behaviors of finding mates or foraging in the fluorescent family through luminescence behaviors are simulated, a fire fly swarm algorithm in the fluorescent family serves as a main algorithm, a particle swarm optimization serves as an auxiliary algorithm, evolution operators such as random self-adaptive step size, strong search, weak search, large-scale evacuation are embedded, and the strategy of partial fusion is adopted; then, LPSO convergence analysis authentication is completed from theoretical and experimental simulation; lastly, the high similarity of fluorescence particle swarm optimization algorithm features and personnel evacuation self features is used. According to the method for establishing the high-rise building personnel evacuating bioluminescence particle swarm optimization algorithm model, the dynamic simulation of complex personnel evacuation behaviors under emergent situations is achieved through certain simple rules, and thus a personnel escape route can be made more reasonably, more conveniently and more effectively. Scientific theoretical bases are provided for building performance design, building space personnel emergent evacuation plan making and building safe evacuation performance evaluation.

title_en: Method, device and system for simulation manipulation of nuclear power plant spreading fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulation manipulation of a nuclear power plant spreading fire disaster. The method includes the steps that a device for simulation manipulation of the nuclear power plant spreading fire disaster judges initial positional information of the simulated fire disaster according to obtained simulated fire fault signals and a first alarm signal of a fire disaster detection probe in the initial position is triggered; a main simulator submits first status information of a fire fighting system in the initial position according to the first alarm signal; the device for simulation manipulation of the nuclear power plant spreading fire disaster judges whether the fire fighting system can suppress the simulated fire disaster or not according to the first status information; if the fire fighting system can not suppress the simulated fire disaster, the device for simulation manipulation of the nuclear power plant spreading fire disaster obtains sub region position information of the spreading simulated fire disaster according to a fire disaster spreading route set in advance; a second alarm signal of the fire disaster detection probe in a sub region is triggered. The multipoint fire disaster manipulation technology of simulation manipulation of the spreading fire disaster is achieved. In addition, the invention provides the device and system for simulation manipulation of the nuclear power plant spreading fire disaster.

title_en: Firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on Bluetooth technology
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology. The firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology is composed of an acquisition module, a processing module, a Bluetooth forwarding module and a monitoring end. The acquisition module is connected with the processing module. The Bluetooth forwarding module comprises a Bluetooth transceiver chip and a wireless module, and the wireless module is a WIFI module and/or a mobile communication module. The monitoring end is a device supporting Bluetooth and WIFI. Firefighter vital sign data are acquired and transmitted to the processing module by the acquisition module, the data are packaged and then transmitted to the Bluetooth forwarding module through Bluetooth signals by the processing module, and the firefighter vital sign data are transmitted to the monitoring end by the Bluetooth forwarding module through the WIFI or a communication network. The firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology can be separated from a PC, is high in portability and can expand the range of motion of a monitored firefighter. Through the firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology, the vital sign conditions of firefighters in firefighting rescue and service training can be monitored in real time, and vital sign abnormality warning signs can be given out in time.

title_en: Distributed coal-rock dynamic disaster potential real-time monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed coal-rock dynamic disaster potential real-time monitoring method and system. A plurality of monitoring electrodes are distributed on the surface of a coal-rock gangway or distributed into a drill hole. A potential monitor continuously collects potential signal differences in real time, wherein the potential signal differences are generated by loads of a coal-rock mass. According to distribution and changes of the potential signal differences, the mode that area critical values and dynamic tendency are combined is adopted to conduct real-time early warning on coal-rock dynamic disaster risks and risk areas. According to the distributed coal-rock dynamic disaster potential real-time monitoring method and system, the loads of the coal-rock mass, the deformation breakage degree, the dynamic disaster risk distribution and evolution situations are reflected through distributed monitored potential signals, and the distributed coal-rock dynamic disaster potential real-time monitoring method and system have the advantages of being good in real-time performance and responsiveness, high in anti-jamming capacity and automation degree, higher in practicability and convenient to install.

title_en: Movable firefighting hose rack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a movable firefighting hose rack, and belongs to the field of firefighting appliances. The movable firefighting hose rack is used for laying a hose by a single soldier at high-rise building stairs or places with narrow roads, under training conditions and the like.The movable firefighting hose rack comprises a box body and road wheels which are arranged at the bottom of the box body, wherein a carrying handle is connected to the upper part ofthe box body by a carrying rope, a partition is arranged in the box body, and the partition can move left and right along the framework of the box body. The movable firefighting hose rack provided by the utility model is more flexible and convenient to use, light in weight and small in size, so thatthe movable firefighting hose rack is more suitable for one soldier to carry a plurality of hoses by hands to enter a fire scene to lay the hoses. Compared with the existing hose back rack and trailer, the movable firefighting hose rack is more convenient to move, so that the physical consumption of firemen can be reduced; parts which can be mutually connected are designed outside the box body, so that a plurality of box bodies can be mutually connected, and a big box body can be combined. Besides, the road wheels are designed at the bottom of the box body, so that the movable firefighting hose rack can be used as a trailer.
assignees: KUNMING COMMAND SCHOOL PUBLIC SECURITY FIRE FORCES

title_en: Mine hydraulic drilling rig monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine hydraulic drilling rig monitoring device. The mine hydraulic drilling rig monitoring device comprises a monitoring module, wherein the monitoring module is electrically connected with a signal acquisition processing module and the signal acquisition processing module is electrically connected with a detection module. The mine hydraulic drilling rig monitoring device solves the problems that many mine disasters are caused, very big personal casualties and economic losses are caused and the like due to reasons that the status detection and monitoring of the hydraulic drilling rig in the prior art are very incomplete, data is summarized mostly by adopting methods such as single-machine manual recording method and the hydraulic drilling rig cannot be effectively detected and monitored.
assignees: Guizhou panjiang mining machinery co ltd

title_en: High-spectrum remote sensing image end-member classification method based on Fisher self-adaptive learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-spectrum remote sensing image end-member classifier based on a Fisher data-dependent nucleus learning machine, for solving the problem of low resolution existing in a conventional high-spectrum image end-member classification method. The process is as follows: selecting and determining a marking form of a high-spectrum remote sensing image training sample, obtaining an optimization object function, and then obtaining an optimal parameter or a data-dependent nucleus parameter; and according to the obtained parameter, obtaining an optimal nucleus function of a constant structure of a variable structure and obtaining an optimal Fisher classifier accordingly, such that high-spectrum remote sensing images can be classified by use of the classifier. According to the invention, the end-members of the high-spectrum remote sensing images can be classified accurately, the resolution of the high-spectrum remote sensing images is improved, and the method provided by the invention can be applied to such technical fields as landform military object reconnoitering, high-efficiency war combat effectiveness evaluation, naval submarine real-time marine environment monitoring, and emergency response to emergent natural disasters.

title_en: Drilling and embedding layered electromagnetic-acoustic monitoring device for underground water disasters
abstract_en: Provided is a drilling and embedding layered electromagnetic-acoustic monitoring device for underground water disasters. The structure is characterized in that an installing cavity is arranged in a protective cover and internally provided with a time-domain reflection sensor, acoustic sensors and a flow guide pipe; the flow guide pipe, distributed axially along the protective cover, has the upper end provided with an overflow port and the lower end provided with a flow leakage port; the surface of the protective cover is provided with water sampling ports and sampling ports; the water sampling ports are communicated with the flow guide pipe; the sampling ports are provided with the acoustic sensors; the time-domain reflection sensor is arranged near to the upper end of the protective cover; and the time-domain reflection sensor, the acoustic sensors and an electrically-controlled valve are all eclectically connected with a controller. The drilling and embedding layered electromagnetic-acoustic monitoring device for the underground water disasters has following beneficial effects: in combination with passive monitoring and active monitoring, long-time low-energy operation is achieved by means of the low-energy characteristic of a passive monitoring device; and an active monitoring device is triggered by the passive monitoring device and used for pre-warning detection in a targeted way when problems arise, which avoids problems such as high operating cost and presence of potential safety hazards by adoption of the single active monitoring device.

title_en: Lane-level vehicle navigation for vehicle routing and traffic management
abstract_en: A lane-level vehicle routing and navigation apparatus includes a simulation module that performs microsimulation of individual vehicles in a traffic stream, and a lane-level optimizer that evaluates conditions along the candidate paths from an origin to a destination as determined by the simulation module, and determines recommended lane-level maneuvers along the candidate paths. A link-level optimizer may determines the candidate paths based on link travel times determined by the simulation module. The simulation may be based on real-time traffic condition data. Recommended candidate paths may be provided to delivery or service or emergency response vehicles, or used for evacuation planning, or to route vehicles such as garbage or postal trucks, or snowplows. Corresponding methods also may be used for traffic planning and management, including determining, based on microsimulation, at least one of (a) altered road geometry, (b) altered traffic signal settings, such as traffic signal timing, or (c) road pricing.
