title_en: Numerical Method to determine a system anomaly using as an example:  A Gas Kick detection system.
abstract_en: This numerical method creates a mesh of tracers or indicators within a simulator which help determine what various anomalies may look like in real time applications. In this situation, determining gas kicks while drilling for oil and preventing blowouts: This application will provide more stable dependable message passing, reservoir data from the kick, production facility design criteria, and of course better prevent disasters.

title_en: Self walking type water coal separating machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a self walking type water coal separating machine, which belongs to the technical field of coal mine underground water disaster prevention and control. The invention aims at solving the technical problem to provide the self walking type water coal separating machine with the advantages that the use is convenient and efficient, and in addition, the underground safety is improved. The self walking type water coal separating machine adopts the technical scheme that a walking mechanism is arranged under a machine frame, a water coal dewatering tube is arranged on the machine frame, and comprises a water coal feeding pipe, a water outlet pipe, an outer sleeve, an inner sleeve and a material pushing auger, a plurality of water seeping holes are densely formed in the inner sleeve, the two ends of the inner sleeve are movably sheathed in the outer sleeve through bearings, the material pushing auger is arranged inside the inner sleeve, in addition, one end of the material pushing auger is fixedly arranged in the feeding opening end of the inner sleeve, the feeding opening end of the inner sleeve is communicated with the outside through the water coal feeding pipe provided with a slurry pump, the discharging opening end of the inner sleeve extends out of the outer sleeve and is connected with an output shaft of an electric motor through a gear transmission device, and the lower part of the outer sleeve is communicated with the water outlet pipe. The self walking type water coal separating machine is mainly used for filtering coal slurry discharged during gas and groundwater drilling.

title_en: Method for formulating scheme for fire hazard evacuation of subway station in construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for formulating a scheme for fire hazard evacuation of a subway station in construction. Aiming at temperature and flue gas distribution situations in fire hazard under the condition that construction of only a main structure is completed in the construction process of the subway station and fire-fighting, ventilation and other protection measures are not installed, the method provides reference for personnel evacuation in fire hazard. The method comprises that the temperature and flue gas distribution situations in fire hazard in the construction process of the subway station are confirmed. FDS software is used, modeling is performed according to concrete conditions of the station, and fire sources are arranged at six representative positions of the station body. Flue gas diffusion speed and evacuation channel arriving time after all the positions are on fire are simulated, and change rule of temperature at five evacuation channel ports along with time is also simulated. The method can be widely applied to the construction process, fire hazard generation and development processes of the subway station can be simulated, the temperature and flue gas distribution situations can be confirmed and thus the evacuation scheme can be formulated.

title_en: Rf tag to detect invasion into and withdrawal from base station vicinity, and system using the same
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide: an RF tag to detect invasion into and withdrawal from a base station vicinity, the tag being improved in energy consumption of conventional RF tags and allowing selective use of invasion and withdrawal by detection and use in, for example, an elderly care facility, an emergent arrangement of investigators from a police office, disposal of a suspicious object, and a display strategy of products; and a system usable for an evacuation behavioral analysis in a large scale evacuation training on the assumption of a disaster.SOLUTION: An RF tag according to the present invention stores the presence or absence of a communication with a base station, and uses it for a logical determination to stop a real time handshake communication to save consumption of a secondary battery. The weak radio wave of the base station includes a designation information as a modulated signal to designate either an invasion or a withdrawal to select an invasion detection mode or a withdrawal detection mode from an upper base station. A practical system using the RF tag to detect a position of a movable object is disclosed.

title_en: Method for determining lower open-off cut positions of shallow-buried short-distance goaf-side coal pillars
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining lower open-off cut positions of shallow-buried short-distance goaf-side coal pillars. According to the method, firstly, drillhole column data near the overlying goaf-side coal pillars corresponding to open-off cuts to be arranged is collected; then, according to the collected data, key layer identifying software is adopted for identifying overlying strata key layer positions under the concrete drillhole column conditions; and finally, according to the occurrence conditions of the key layers between an upper coal bed and a lower coal bed, the lower coal bed open-off cut position determination is carried out according to respective corresponding methods. The method provided by the invention is used for roof plate press frame disaster prevention and control practice during the short-distance coal bed repeated exploitation in a coal mine production process, and has high reliability and practicability.

title_en: Novel device for recycling clamped drill rod inside drill hole
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel device for recycling a clamped drill rod inside a drill hole. The novel device is characterized by comprising a basic joint, a horn-shaped end port and a connector, wherein the small diameter end of the horn-shaped end port is connected with the larger diameter end of the basic joint; the connector is connected with the smaller diameter end of the basic joint; an internal thread is arranged at the interior of the basic joint. The novel device is simple in structure and high in practicability, machines and materials in a mine shaft can be fully utilized, and the drill rod and a drill head clamped in the drill hole can be effectively taken out, so that the loss of property is effectively reduced, and meanwhile gas disasters caused by the drill rod clamped in the drill hole are prevented. The drilling efficiency is effectively improved, the loss of manpower and material resources is prevented, and the personal safety of workers and the safety of the mine shaft are ensured. The novel device is suitable for drilling in the mine shaft.
assignees: PINGDINGSHAN TIANAN COAL MINING CO LTD

title_en: Power system for coal and gas outburst power effect simulation experiment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power system for coal and gas outburst power effect simulation experiment, which comprises a pressure container for filling simulation experiment materials, wherein the pressure container is fixed on the ground and is provided with a container opening, the pressure container is provided with a container inflation hole and a coal inlet which can be opened and closed, the power system also comprises an outlet device for connecting the container opening and an experiment tunnel, and an explosion venting mechanism for opening the container opening when being sealed and pressed is arranged in the outlet device; adding coal particles into the pressure container from the coal inlet, filling gas into the gas filling hole of the container, opening the container instantly when the pressure reaches the explosion point of the explosion venting mechanism, communicating the pressure container with the experimental tunnel at the moment, crushing and throwing out the coal, and starting a dynamic effect simulation experiment; the utility model discloses simple structure is favorable to understanding more clearly the coal and gas outburst disaster-causing mechanism and emergence, development law, effective control coal and gas outburst calamity.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Forcible entry training door system
abstract_en: Apparatus for training the art of forcible door entry for emergency personnel such as firefighters and, in particular, a reusable forcible entry door training apparatus that allows individuals to simulate forcible entry of outward opening metal doors mounted in metal frames.

title_en: Experimental simulation device and method for exploiting natural gas hydrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental simulation device and a method for exploiting natural gas hydrate. The experimental simulation device comprises a stable pressure gas/liquid supply module, a reactor, a control module, a data measuring module and a data acquisition and processing module. The method comprises the following steps: discharging unreacted gases in an isobaric manner after the hydrate is generated, subsequently compressing the hydrate into a dense hydrate piece, introducing a CO2 gas from one side of the hydrate piece, reducing the pressure on the other side of the hydrate piece, and thus achieving combination of two natural gas hydrate exploitation methods of CO2 exchange and pressure reduction. The experimental simulation device overcomes the defects that the efficiency is low and the speed is low in natural gas hydrate exploitation in the CO2 exchange mode, overcomes the difficulty that geological disaster can be caused in natural gas hydrate exploitation in the pressure reduction mode, improves the efficacy in natural gas hydrate exploitation, and moreover is simple in structure and low in cost.

title_en: A kind of three-dimensional simulation method and emergency evacuation method for gas leakage diffusion
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of three-dimensional simulation method and emergency evacuation method for gas leakage diffusion, the three-dimensional simulation method includes obtaining the positional information of source of leaks, according to the position of the source of leaks, obtain the meteorological real time data and leakage source strength data of periphery measurement, inquiry is compared with wind field database Wind Field inquiry data in the meteorology real time data, the wind field data of the source of leaks are obtained from wind field database, above-mentioned wind field data and leakage source strength data band are entered into gas diffusion formula, calculates and obtains gas diffusion field data.Above-mentioned three-dimensional simulation method is by establishing wind field database, the wind field data around source of leaks are obtained using the wind field database quick search, the acquisition process of the wind field data is rapidly and efficiently, conventional the step of needing to carry out wind field calculating is deleted, the most fast time three-dimensional simulation field data can be obtained, suitable for the requirement of chemical industrial park under the new situation, industrial enterprise to emergency system.

title_en: Vertical component safety analysis method based on catenary
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical component safety analysis method based on the catenary. The method is characterized in that a refined model and an overall model of a structure are coupled to obtain a numerical model, visual and dynamic numerical simulation can be provided for the collapse type of a high-rise structure, and the development condition of a horizontal component catenary mechanism in the component detaching position is analyzed under a certain accidental condition and disaster condition to carry out anti-continuous-collapse design. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the structure analysis process is simple, working efficiency is high, full and reliable parameters are provided for anti-collapse design of a key component, visual, quantitative and accurate component safety redundancy is obtained, and the method is particularly applicable to safety analysis of anti-collapsing design of the high-rise structure.

title_en: Disaster area environment multi-parameter simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster area environment multi-parameter simulation system which mainly comprises a central control platform, parameter sending equipment and parameter receiving equipment, wherein the central control platform is used for acquiring environmental parameters of the position of the parameter receiving equipment in a simulated disaster area environment, and then the parameter sending equipment is used for sending the acquired environmental parameters to the parameter receiving equipment to be displayed by the parameter receiving equipment, so that the environmental parameters of various disasters can be simulated, and trainees can conveniently perform decision analysis training according to different environmental parameters.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Mining disaster simulated training system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining disaster simulated training system. The mining disaster simulated training system comprises an audio frequency network broadcast intercommunication subsystem, a video monitoring subsystem and a disaster simulated training subsystem, the audio frequency network broadcast intercommunication subsystem is composed of a call center, a relay server, an IP audio frequency terminal and an IP network broadcast sound box, the IP audio frequency terminal and the IP network broadcast sound box are connected with an underground interchanger through network cables, and the call center and the relay server are connected with the underground interchanger through network cables, the video monitoring subsystem is composed of a video monitoring wall and a digital infrared network camera, the video monitoring wall is connected with a ground interchanger through a network cable, and the digital infrared network camera is connected with the underground interchanger through a network cable; and the disaster simulated training subsystem is composed of a PLC host computer, a PLC control cabinet, a local/remote control cabinet and a simulated training system. The mining disaster simulated training system can simulate a plurality of natural disaster environments which are merged into the training system, and rescue personnel are effectively trained on the capability of treating emergencies.

title_en: Excavation working face water disaster early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water disaster preventing system for an excavation working face, in particular to an excavation working face water disaster early warning system, which comprises a pressure sensor and flow rate sensors, wherein the pressure sensor is arranged on a water supply pipeline of a drill pipe, the flow rate sensors are arranged at water bursting point parts of an excavation working face bottom plate and an excavation working face standard water tank, the output end of the pressure sensor is connected with a mining signal processing substation through a CAN (controller area network) bus, the output ends of the flow rate sensors are connected with the mining signal processing substation through the CAN bus, and the mining signal processing substation is connected with a monitoring host for controlling a warning device through the CAN bus. The excavation working face water disaster early warning system can be used for comprehensively, systematically and effectively monitoring the water disaster of the excavation working face in real time, and the accident occurring probability is reduced.

title_en: Coal and gas outburst dynamic effect simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal and gas outburst dynamic effect simulation experiment device, including driving system, pipe-line system and dust pelletizing system, driving system is including opening the exit device that has container open-ended pressure vessel and connect container opening and pipe-line system, be equipped with in the exit device and be used for sealing and opening the explosion venting mechanism of container opening when pressurized, pipe-line system includes pipeline subassembly and connecting pipe, pipeline subassembly is the multi-branch structure that constitutes by the pipe-line unit through flange joint, the pipe-line unit includes straight tube, first connecting pipe and second connecting pipe, be equipped with observation hole and/or test hole on the pipe-line unit; the dust removal system comprises an upper box body, a middle box body and a lower box body, wherein the upper box body is provided with a purified gas outlet, the lower box body is provided with a pipeline interface and an openable dust removal port, and the middle box body is internally provided with at least two bag dust removal devices; utilize the utility model discloses can know coal and gas outburst disaster-causing mechanism and emergence, development law more clearly, effective control coal and gas outburst calamity.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Indoor positioning and condition monitoring system for fire-fighting and rescue personnel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an indoor positioning and condition monitoring system for fire-fighting and rescue personnel, and belongs to the technical field of dead zone positioning. The system consists of an indoor positioning module, a condition monitoring module, an emergent rescue device, and a remote monitoring module, wherein the indoor positioning module, the condition monitoring module and the emergent rescue device are fixed in a terminal which is worn on a rear waist of an operator, so as to achieve the positioning and condition monitoring of the operator. Moreover, the position and condition of the operator are displayed through an upper computer. The surroundings of the operator are simulated by the upper computer, and a route is also drawn. The system provided by the utility model is high in positioning precision, is high in safety, is good in instantaneity, and greatly helps the indoor firefighting and rescue.

title_en: Earthquake magnitude simulating and demonstrating sphere
abstract_en: An earthquake magnitude simulating and demonstrating sphere comprises central spheres and surrounding spheres. The central spheres are connected through a hard connecting rod and are arranged from large diameter to small diameter. A largest sphere is semispherical, and other central spheres are respectively a whole sphere. The surrounding spheres are respectively semispherical and are annularly arranged on a ceiling. The surrounding spheres surround the central spheres. The number of central spheres is five. The five central spheres respectively represent earthquake magnitudes from 4 to 8. The volume ratio between two adjacent spheres of the central spheres is consistent with the ratio between earthquake magnitude released energies which correspond with the spheres. The range lightened by the surrounding spheres represents damage range of the earthquake magnitude which is shown by the central sphere. One layer of illuminant is coated on each central sphere and each surrounding sphere. The earthquake magnitude simulating and demonstrating sphere provided by the utility model has advantages of simple structure, convenient mounting and remarkable space-saving effect. The earthquake magnitude simulating and demonstrating sphere has functions of: displaying differences and destroying ranges of earthquake magnitudes, generating more visible understanding of the people to energy release ratio and intensities of the earthquake magnitudes, and facilitating earthquake-proof and disaster-reducing understanding improvement of the people.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU JINGWEI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and Method for Disaster Evacuation providing Evacuation Simulation
title_ko: 대피시뮬레이션을 제공하는 재난대피 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for minimizing casualties in an indoor space in a disaster such as fire or collapse and, in particular, to a system configuration and a development method for interlocking evacuation simulation data stored in a DB and information on a distribution of occupants in the indoor space, which is detected by using an infrared sensor, visualizing a short evacuation path result, and providing the result. To this end, an embodiment of the method includes the steps of storing people information in each divided space inside a building in real time; inputting arbitrary data values and storing results of executed simulation; extracting simulation results suitable for people distribution information for each DB; and outputting the extracted simulation results. The step of storing people information in each divided space inside a building in real time is performed by checking the people information for each divided space and storing the same in a people DB. The step of inputting arbitrary data values and storing results of executed simulation is performed such that result values with respect to an evacuation path for parameters input to a simulation engine are stored in a simulation DB. The step of extracting simulation results suitable for people distribution information for each DB is performed by matching people distribution information in the people DB and people distribution information in the simulation DB and extracting necessary simulation results. The step of outputting the extracted simulation results is performed by visualizing the matched necessary simulation results to a pedestrian.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실내공간에서 화재, 붕괴 등의 재난에 대하여 인명피해를 최소화 하기 위한 방법 중 하나로 상세하게는 DB에 대피시뮬레이션 수행 데이터와 적외선 센서를 이용한 실내의 실제 재실자 인원분포 정보를 연동하여 화재발생시 보다 빠른 대피경로 결과물을 시각화하여 제공하는 시스템 구성 및 개발 방법에 관한 것이다.  
이러한 목적을 달성하기 위하여 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 실시간으로 건조물 내부에 각 구획공간의 인원정보를 저장하는 단계, 임의로 데이터 값을 입력하여 실행한 시뮬레이션 결과를 저장하는 단계, 각 DB별 인원분포정보에 맞는 시뮬레이션 결과를 추출하는 단계, 추출된 시뮬레이션 결과를 출력하는 단계를 포함한다. 
상기 실시간으로 건조물 내부에 각 구획공간의 인원정보를 저장하는 단계는 상기 각 구획공간별 인원정보를 확인하여 인원DB에 저장한다. 상기 임의로 데이터 값을 입력하여 실행한 시뮬레이션 결과를 저장하는 단계는 시뮬레이션엔진에 입력한 파라미터에 대해서 대피경로에 대한 결과값을 시뮬레이션DB에 저장한다. 상기 각 DB별 인원분포정보에 맞는 시뮬레이션 결과를 추출하는 단계는 인원DB의 인원분포정보와 상기 시뮬레이션DB의 인원분포정보를 매칭하여 필요한 시뮬레이션 결과를 추출한다. 상기 추출된 시뮬레이션 결과를 출력하는 단계는 상기 매칭된 필요한 시뮬레이션 결과를 보행자에게 시각화 한다.

title_en: Decision making system according to volcanic prediction
title_ko: 화산 피해 예측에 따른 의사결정 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a decision making system according to volcano damage prediction, which can reduce damage according to prompt action as to the eruption of a volcano, by performing simulation and monitoring of damage situation of volcanic ash, pyroclastic flow, flood/mudslide, and earthquake according to the time elapsed on the basis of volcano collection information as to a volcanic zone and GIS information of a predicted zone of volcano disaster occurrence, and also can perform rapid action by shortening damage prediction time on the basis of a scenario per kind of volcanic disaster which is constructed in advance. For this, the decision making system according to volcano damage prediction according to the present invention comprises: a database which stores volcanic ash situation, pyroclastic flow situation, flood/mudslide situation, and earthquake situation of a volcano eruption prediction zone, and stores geographic information system (GIS) information of the volcano disaster occurrence prediction zone; a simulation module which calculates the damage situation of volcanic ash, pyroclastic flow, flood/mudslide, and earthquake of the volcano disaster occurrence prediction zone according to the time elapsed on the basis of the collected information and the GIS information of the volcano disaster occurrence prediction zone; a display part for displaying the result calculated through the simulation module by a stereoscopic solid image; and a decison making module for prompt action according to simulation result according to the time elapsed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화산 지역에 대한 화산 수집 정보와 화산 재해 발생 예상지역의 GIS 정보를 토대로 상기 화산 재해 발생 예상지역의 화산재, 화쇄류, 홍수/이류, 및 지진 피해상황을 경과시간에 따라 시뮬레이션 및 모니터링을 실시함으로써, 화산 폭발에 대한 즉각적인 조치에 따른 피해를 경감할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 사전 구축된 화산재해 종류별 시나리오를 기반으로 피해예측 시간을 단축하여 신속한 대응이 가능한 화산 피해 예측에 따른 의사결정 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 상기 본 발명에 따른 화산 피해 예측에 따른 의사결정 시스템은, 화산 폭발 예정 지역의 화산재 상황, 화쇄류 상황, 홍수/이류 상황, 및 지진 상황에 대한 수집 정보가 저장되고, 화산 재해 발생 예상지역의 GIS(geographic information system) 정보가 저장되어 있는 데이터 베이스와; 상기 수집 정보와 상기 화산 재해 발생 예상지역의 GIS 정보를 토대로 상기 화산 재해 발생 예상지역의 화산재, 화쇄류, 홍수/이류, 및 지진 피해상황을 경과시간에 따라 계산하는 시뮬레이션 모듈과; 상기 시뮬레이션모듈을 통해 계산된 결과를 3차원 입체 영상으로 디스플레이하는 디스플레이부와; 상기 경과시간에 따른 시뮬레이션 결과에 따라 대응 조치를 위한 의사 결정 모듈로 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Volcanic disaster response system
title_ko: 화산재해 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a volcanic disaster response system, which can simulate and monitor various volcanic disaster and accident situations, such as volcanic ashes, pyroclastic flows, volcanic mudflows, volcanic floods, volcanic earthquakes, etc. in an area where a volcanic disaster is predicted, in real time, based on collected volcano information regarding a volcanic area and GIS information regarding the area where a volcanic disaster is predicted, and can quickly propagate the damage induced by the volcanic disaster to related agencies and the people and, at the same time, can draw the most similar simulation result, based on real-time measurement and forecast information regarding the eruption of a volcano and a scenario by volcanic disaster types pre-stored in a damage prediction database and can rapidly respond to and take measures to a volcanic disaster occurred. To achieve this, the volcanic disaster response system comprises: an integrated damage prediction module which predicts damage by performing various volcanic disaster simulations; a three-dimensional visualization module which visualizes and displays the simulation result on a three-dimensional space; a decision making support module which supports damage impact assessment, situation control, and a quick reaction based on a damage scenario by volcano types, the simulation result, and data on damage prediction response criteria; and a damage prediction database which stores and manages various data required for the damage prediction simulation and the decision making support.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화산 지역에 대한 화산 수집 정보와 화산 재해 발생 예상지역의 GIS 정보를 토대로 상기 화산 재해 발생 예상지역의 화산재, 화쇄류, 화산성 이류, 화산성 홍수, 및 화산성 지진 등 각종 화산 재해 및 재난 상황을 실시간으로 시뮬레이션 및 모니터링하여 화산재해의 피해 예측 상황을 신속하게 유관기관 및 국민에게 전파함과 동시에, 화산폭발에 대한 실시간의 관측 및 예보정보와 피해예측 데이터베이스에 사전 구축된 화산재해종류별 시나리오를 기반으로 가장 유사한 시뮬레이션 결과를 도출하여 발생한 화산재해에 대해 신속히 대응 및 조치할 수 있는 화산재해 대응 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 상기 화산재해 대응 시스템은, 다양한 화산재해별 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 피해를 예측할 수 있는 통합피해예측 모듈과; 상기 시뮬레이션 결과를 3차원 공간상에 시각적으로 가시화하여 보여주는 3차원 시각화 모듈과; 화산종류별 피해시나리오, 시뮬레이션된 결과 및 피해예측대응기준의 자료를 기반으로 피해영향평가와 상황관리, 긴급대응을 지원하는 의사결정지원모듈과; 피해예측시뮬레이션 및 의사결정지원에 필요한 다양한 자료를 저장 및 관리하는 피해예측 데이터베이스로 이루어짐이 바람직하다.

title_en: System for confirming evacuation headcount and escape time of emergency escape drill situation, and confirming method thereof
title_ko: 비상탈출훈련시 대피 인원수와 탈출시간 확인시스템 및 그 확인방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for identifying an evacuation headcount and escape time during an emergency escape drill, the system including: an emergency situation unit to receive an emergency situation occurrence signal when an emergency situation occurs for an emergency escape drill on a ship; a timer to start counting time after the emergency situation unit receives the emergency situation occurrence signal; an evacuation identification informing unit to receive a headcount of persons evacuated to an emergency escape device from the ship after the timer starts counting time; and a display to receive and display the headcount from the evacuation identification informing unit and to receive and display an elapsed time from the count starting time of the timer by receiving the elapsed time from the timer when receiving the headcount. According to the present invention, when performing the emergency escape drill to prepare for the emergency situation on the ship, the performance of the emergency escape drill can be improved by measuring the performance of the emergency escape drill through identifying the headcount of emergency escaped persons while counting the escape time to contribute to saving lives when an actual emergency occurs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상탈출훈련시 대피 인원수와 탈출시간 확인시스템에 관한 것으로, 선박에서 비상탈출훈련을 위한 비상상황이 발생하는 경우, 비상상황 발생신호를 입력받는 비상상황부; 비상상황부가 비상상황 발생신호를 입력받은 후의 시간을 카운팅하기 시작하는 타이머부; 타이머부가 시간을 카운팅하기 시작한 후, 선박으로부터 비상탈출수단으로 대피한 인원수를 입력받는 대피확인 알림장치; 및 대피확인 알림장치로부터 인원수를 수신하여 디스플레이하고, 인원수를 수신할 때 타이머가 카운팅을 시작한 이후의 경과시간을 타이머로부터 수신하여 디스플레이하는 디스플레이부;를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 선박에서 비상상황을 대비하여 비상탈출훈련을 하는 경우 비상탈출한 인원수를 확인함과 동시에 탈출시간을 카운팅하여 비상탈출훈련의 성능을 측정함으로써, 비상탈출훈련의 성능을 향상시킬 수 있으므로 선박에서 실제 비상상황이 발생할 경우 인명구조에 기여할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of method of manual simulation's plant growth shade wet environment
abstract_en: " a kind of method of manual simulation's plant growth shade wet environment " discloses a kind of method of manual simulation's plant growth shade wet environment.This method is based on steelframe booth, by at the top of greenhouse and both sides install Motorized blind network control canopy in illumination, humidity and temperature in the spray system control canopy being made up of PPR pipe and shower nozzle etc. are set up in greenhouse, temperature of shed and gas concentration lwevel are controlled in the ventilation system that the installation of the middle side part of greenhouse two is made up of gauze and motor-operated fan, with in greenhouse, temperature on the outer a set of Agricultural Environmental Monitoring instrument respectively installed, the contrast of the meteorological datas such as humidity is foundation, using corresponding control light, humidification, cooling, ventilation measure, so as to form a kind of shady wet environment relative to local natural environmental condition with significant difference.Wherein contrasted with meteorological datas such as the epidemic disasters on inside and outside two sets of Agricultural Environmental Monitoring instrument as foundation, be the key of the invention using corresponding control light, humidification coolings, ventilation measure.With this method simulate shady wet environment have the characteristics that Local Adaptation it is wide, suitable for different types of crop with the resistance to wet screening requirements of shade, the resistance to wet breeding efficiency of shade of raising.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted rescue lifting system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of coal rescue, in particular discloses a vehicle-mounted rescue lifting system. The technical problem to be solved is to provide the vehicle-mounted rescue lifting system having the advantages of short response time, high safety performance and largely improved survival rate of sheltering people. The vehicle-mounted rescue lifting system comprises a vehicle head and a vehicle chassis, and further comprises a lifting winch system, a rescue cabin and well head equipment, wherein the lifting winch system and the rescue bin are fixed on the vehicle chassis, and are movably connected; the rescue cabin is controlled to vertically move in a man lifting drill hole; and the well head equipment is arranged in an opening of the man lifting drill hole, and is used for controlling the closing/opening of the opening of the man lifting drill hole. The vehicle-mounted rescue lifting system can quicken the whole rescue speed, and can quickly rescue the sheltering people from the man lifting drill hole through the lifting system and the rescue bin by only driving a vehicle to a disaster mine, so that the response time is short, and the survival rate of the sheltering people can be largely increased.
assignees: SHANXI ZHONGMEI HUAJIN ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Multipoint coal and rock mass stress real-time monitoring device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multipoint coal and rock mass stress real-time monitoring device and method. The device is composed of a plurality of capsule pressure sensors, connection rods, three-way valves, a multichannel monitor, a multichannel control valve, first high-pressure oil pipes, second high-pressure oil pipes, third high-pressure oil pipes, a four high-pressure oil pipe, a high-pressure oil pump and monitoring substations. According to the requirement of a testing scheme, the multiple capsule pressure sensors are arranged in drilled holes, and oil is injected into the capsule pressure sensors through the multi-channel control valve, so that oil pressure inside each capsule pressure sensor reaches the preset pressure, and the capsule pressure sensors and the coal and rock mass are well coupled. Monitoring signals are synchronously collected, converted, stored and displayed through the multichannel monitor or are transferred to a remote monitor center through the monitoring substations. The multipoint coal and rock mass stress real-time monitoring device can be used for coal and rock dynamic disaster monitoring early warning such as coal and rock stress monitoring, mine pressure analysis, rock burst and coal and gas rush, and the stress and changes of the stress of multiple measure points can be measured at the same time in the multiple drilled holes of the coal and rock mass.

title_en: Interaction method based on Anylogic simulation model and GIS (Geographic Information System) environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an interaction method based on an Anylogic simulation model and GIS (Geographic Information System) environment. The interaction method comprises the following steps: determining an Agent state attribute, and defining an Agent behavior to control Agent; creating an Anylogic simulation model, and exporting the Anylogic simulation model in a file mode; uploading the obtained file-mode Anylogic simulation model onto the GIS environment; and under the GIS environment, calling the Anylogic simulation model for simulation through the Agent, and displaying a simulation result under the GIS environment. Under the GIS environment, Agent-based modeling can guarantee that internal information flows and can be dynamically presented in the GIS environment, certain specific Agent in the Agent-based modeling can be subjected to dynamic control so as to provide possibilities for recording and monitoring the specific Agent in real time in an simulation process, and the invention exhibits effectiveness and convenience when the invention is applied to the processes of emergency evacuation and the optimal configuration of resources.

title_en: A kind of gas hydrates deposit mechanical characteristic visual test device
abstract_en: A kind of gas hydrates deposit mechanical characteristic visualization device, belongs to gas hydrates Basic Physical Properties fields of measurement. This device mainly comprises self-pressing type triaxial apparatus main frame, axial loading system, confined pressure control system, back pressure control system, temperature control system, data collecting system and an X ray CT imaging system. Realize the combination of cryogenic high pressure hydrate triaxial apparatus and X ray CT imaging system, can carry out the synchronism detection of gas hydrates deposit both macro and micro mechanical characteristic. This device can be simulated the stress state of actual reservoir, obtain the sedimental macroscopic view of gas hydrates, Micromechanics performance data, the trigger mechanism of the geological disasters such as the submarine landslide to announcement gas hydrates reservoir deformation mechanism and gas hydrate dissociation inducement is significant, and the safety to gas hydrates, high-efficiency mining have important directive function.

title_en: A kind of method for improving storm surge disaster risk profile precision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method for improving storm surge disaster risk profile precision, the described method comprises the following steps：Storm surge disaster scene is built based on condition analysis method；Propose storm surge disaster Three-dimensional Numerical Simulation Method；The big flood for building multi-mode multiple target is taken refuge optimal route selection model；Wherein, the proposition storm surge disaster Three-dimensional Numerical Simulation Method is specially：1) three-dimensional grid model of region landform is set up；2) the SST k ω advance of freshet Three-dimensional Turbulent Flow models of coupling VOF methods are set up；3) based on Three-dimensional simulation result drawing three-dimensional risk map.Invention increases the flowing of flood dynamic realtime and the authenticity and effect of visualization of disaster Annual distribution；The integrity and reasonability of emergency-sheltering system are further improved with the emergency route evacuation model of multi-mode multiple target, calamity emergency prediction scheme is effectively formulated, multiple modules coupling, the storm surge disaster risk analysis system that integrity degree is high, exploitativeness is strong is set up.

title_en: Remote sign monitoring method based on body area network in field battle environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sign monitoring method based on the body area network in a field battle environment. In view of special application background of the field battle environment, compared with the traditional body area network system, the method of the invention collects various sign data via sign sensor nodes and sends the data to a BAN coordinator. The BAN coordinator analyzes the collected data, after the data are fused, multi-hop forwarding is carried out inside the BAN coordinator network until a sink node receives the data, and the data are sent to a background server via a radio station. The method is characterized by being free of support from communication infrastructure, low power consumption, high extendibility, good robustness, in support of remote network management, data fusion, Beidou positioning and the like, and can be widely applied to field battle sign monitoring, field military training, field special industry personnel monitoring, biological monitoring, severe disasters, and other sign monitoring scenes free of support from communication infrastructure or inconvenient to use the communication infrastructure.

title_en: Simulation experiment apparatus for ship fire disaster
abstract_en: Disclosed in the invention is a simulation experiment apparatus for a ship fire disaster. The apparatus comprises an enclosed cabin, an automatic ventilation control mechanism, a fire source combustion system, a smoke monitoring system, and a data acquisition computer. The enclosed cabin is arranged horizontally; and the proportion of the length to the height of the enclosed cabin is a value less than 10:1. A piece of transparent fire-proof glass is arranged at the side of the enclosed cabin; and composite rock wool structures formed in stain steel plates are formed at the top surface and the bottom surface of the enclosed cabin. The automatic ventilation control mechanism arranged above the enclosed cabin is respectively communicated with the two ends of the enclosed cabin. The fire source combustion system is arranged inside the enclosed cabin; and the distance between the fire source combustion system and a blast pipe is in a range of 1 to 3 meters. The smoke monitoring system is arranged in the enclosed cabin. The data acquisition computer is respectively connected with the fire source combustion system and the smoke monitoring system by a multi-channel data acquisition instrument and is also connected with the automatic ventilation control mechanism.

title_en: Connection type universal mat floating on water
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a connection type universal mat which floats even on water for disaster prevention in a natural disaster and for leisure, exercise, and daily life, is used in a variety of amphibious manners, and can be carried in a freely foldable manner with mats being insertable and extractable, and the mats being connectable to each other.SOLUTION: Two foam resin plates (2) with a damage avoiding sheet (8) attached to the surface of a foam resin body (7) is stored in a mat cover (1) and temporarily fixed with a fixing tape (6), each corner part of sides of the mat cover is provided with a connection part (3), and handle parts (5) are provided at a central part of the sides, and connecting strings (4) are provided on a rear face of the mats. title_en: Coal and gas outburst dynamic effect simulation experiment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal and gas outburst dynamic effect simulation experiment method, which is completed according to the following steps: A. prepare coal and gas outburst experimental system, this system is including fixing pressure vessel and the pipe-line system on subaerial, last feed inlet, the hole of aerifing and the sensor hole of being equipped with of pressure vessel is equipped with the protrusion mouth on the pressure vessel, connects on the protrusion mouth and lets out the explosion equipment, lets out the explosion equipment and includes reducing pipe, first and second rupture of membranes, and control chip passes through first sensor reaches whether the pressure that the second sensor surveyed comes the control to reducing pipe and pressure vessel air entrainment. B. And filling the coal particles into the pressure container from the feed inlet. C. And gradually inflating and pressurizing the pressure container and the reducing pipe to control the first rupture disk and the second rupture disk to rupture, so that coal and gas are extruded. The invention furthest ensures the overall experimental effect of the dynamic effect and provides a theoretical basis for the protection and control of the coal and gas outburst disasters of mines.

title_en: Method for dynamic simulation of continuous heavy gas drain diffusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for dynamic simulation of continuous heavy gas drain diffusion. The method based on a slab model includes: inputting known parameters, and initializing relevant parameters according to the known parameters; calculating a maximum influence distance under an ERPGs (emergency response planning guidelines) concentration steady state; generating left borders under a local coordinate system, wherein the left borders include an upwind left border, a downwind left border and a tail-end left border; verifying and correcting boundary points of the left borders; generating right borders according to the calculated boundary points of the left borders; transforming coordinates of the border points of the left borders and the right borders into geographic coordinates; drawing a dynamic simulation GIS design sketch of continuous heavy gas drain diffusion according to the geographic coordinates. By adoption of the method, continuous heavy gas drain diffusion situation under the steady state can be simulated while a time-dependent process of continuous heavy gas drain diffusion can be dynamically simulated.

title_en: A Fire Evacuees' Context- Information Providing Method and A System therefor
title_ko: 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises a CCTV; a flame/smoke sensor; a server which includes a person detection module, a context information module, a fire dynamics simulator (FDS), and a building exodus, receives images from the CCTV, and transmits the context information on evacuees in a building to an emergency operation center; a person characteristic information database which has person detection information, such as person patterns; a building information database which has information on the building, such as the drawing of the building; a detection information database which stores the person detection information by areas in the building; and an emergency operation center which receives the context information from the server in a fire and sends a rescue team to the building.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 대피자의 상황정보를 종합방재 센터의 구조대에게 제공하는 시스템에 있어서, CCTV, 화염/연기 감지 센서,  상기 CCTV의 영상에서 사람을 검출하고 대피자의 수와 위치를 확인하는 사람 검출 모듈, 상기 사람 검출 정보와 상기 센서의 정보를 기반으로 대피자의 상황정보를 생성하는 상황 정보 모듈, 화재의 현상을 가상 모델링하는 시뮬레이션하는 FDS(Fire Dynamics Simulator), 건물 상주 인원들의 대피경로를 계산하는 Building Exodus를 포함하며, 상기 CCTV로부터 영상을 수신 받고 화재시 상기 건축물의 대피자에 대한 상황정보를 종합방재 센터로 전송하는 Server, 상기 사람 패턴과 같은 사람 검출 정보를 가지고 있는 사람 특징 정보 데이터베이스, 상기 건축물의 도면과 같은 건축물의 정보를 가지고 있는 건물 정보 데이터베이스, 상기 사람 검출 모듈에서 검출된 사람 검출 정보를 건축물 내부의 지역별로 저장하는 검출 정보 데이터베이스, 화재시 상기 Server로부터 상황정보를 수신 받고 구조대를 상기 건축물로 보내는 종합방재 센터로 이루어진 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템과,  
상기 CCTV으로부터 영상을 입력받는 영상 입력 단계, 상기 CCTV의 동작여부를 확인하는 CCTV 작동 여부 확인 단계, 상기 CCTV가 동작하지 않을 경우 경보를 제공하는 사람 검출 오류 경보 단계, 사람을 검출하는 사람 검출 단계, 화재가 발생하였는지 확인하는 화재 발생 확인 단계, 평시에 종합 방재 센터로 정보를 전송한 전송 주기를 확인하는 전송 주기 확인 단계, 사람 검출 정보를 상기 검출 정보 데이터베이스에 저장하는 사람 검출 정보 갱신 단계, 화재가 발생한 지역을 확인하고 FDS를 통해 화재 현상, 화재 위험 지역 및 인명 사상 지역 정보를 계산하여 화재 상황 정보를 계산하는 화재 상황 정보 확인 단계, Building Exodus를 통해 인명 가상 대피 정보와 잔류 인원에 대한 정보를 계산하는 화재 인명 정보 확인 단계, 사람 검출 정보와 화재 상황 정보, 화재 인명 정보들을 종합방재 센터로 전송하는 인명 상황 정보 전송 단계로 이루어진 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템 및 방법으로, 기존 건축물의 CCTV를 통해 화재시 대피인원 및 잔류 인원에 대한 상황정보를 획득하기 때문에 종래의 시스템들이 시스템 구축을 위해 생체 신호를 수집하는 센서, 위치 정보를 제공하는 센서, 상기 센서들로부터 정보를 수신 받는 PDA와 같은 장치들로 인해 시스템 구축이 어렵고 시스템 사용이 복잡한 종래의 문제점들을 해결할 수 있으며, 실시간으로 상기 건축물의 대피인원 및 잔류인원들에 대한 가상의 대피 정보를 정확하게 시뮬레이션하고 화재 현상 모델링을 기반으로 화재 상황을 정확하게 시뮬레이션하기 때문에 보다 정확한 인명 구조를 위한 정보의 수집이 가능하며, 상기 시뮬레이션정보, 사람 검출 정보를 실시간으로 종합방재 센터로 전송하여 구조대가 인명을 구조하기 위한 구조 시간의 단축과 정확한 구조를 하는데 효과적이다. 
또한, 평시에도 사람 검출정보를 전송하기 때문에 화재시 본 발명에 의한 시스템이 문제가 발생하게 될 경우 평시에 전송되어진 최근 정보를 기반으로 보다 신속하게 상기 건축물의 구조를 수행할 수 있다는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Calculation Testing apparatus and the calculation method for burn material
title_ko: 화재재료의 성질 산출 시험장치 및 그 산출 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for testing property calculation of combustible material and a calculating method used in the apparatus. Provided are an apparatus for testing property calculation of combustible material which includes a test piece fire generator heating a test piece of combustible material by predetermined energy to generate fire; a physical phenomenon measuring means measuring a physical phenomenon when the test piece is combusted; and a data processor which collects the physical phenomenon data of the test piece measured by the physical phenomenon measuring means to calculate properties of the material in accordance with a property calculation algorithm, and a method of calculating properties of combustible material used in the apparatus. According to the present invention, reliability of fire simulation is improved by securing combustion characteristic data and physical property data of buildings, interior and exterior materials of railroads and vehicles, and combustibles, thereby securing reliability of evaluation of fire hazard and degree of danger for disaster refuge of a building by improving and compensating performance design and performance criteria.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재재료의 성질 산출 시험장치 및 그 성질 산출 방법에 관한 것으로; 화재 발생이 가능한 재료의 시편을 일정한 에너지로 가열시켜 화재를 발생시키는 시편화재발생기와, 시편의 연소시 물리적 현상을 측정하는 물리적 현상 측정수단과, 상기 물리적 현상 측정수단을 통해 측정된 시편의 물리적 현상 데이터를 수집해 화재성질 산출 알고리즘에 따라 재료의 화재성질을 산출하는 데이터처리수단으로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 화재재료의 성질 산출 시험 장치와; 그와 같은 화재재료의 성질 산출 방법을 제공한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 건축물, 철도·차량 내·외장재 및 가연물 등에 대한 연소특성 데이터와 물성 데이터 확보로 화재 시뮬레이션의 신뢰성을 향상하고, 이를 통해 성능설계 성능기준 개선 및 보완을 통한 건축물의 화재 및 피난위험성 평가의 신뢰성 역시 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Colliery dynamic disaster Multi-parameter coupling determinator
abstract_en: Colliery dynamic disaster Multi-parameter coupling determinator, relates to a kind of colliery dynamic disaster determinator.Dynamic disaster generation environment under can realistic simulation coal mine, surrouding rock stress, gas pressure when Accurate Determining dynamic disaster occurs.Two are vertically connected to synchronous loading hydraulic cylinder and high pressure resistant rigidity closed shell upper and lower surface, and two are vertically connected to synchronous loading hydraulic cylinder cylinder bar and the briquetting one being arranged in high pressure resistant rigidity closed shell; Two levels are connected to synchronous loading hydraulic cylinder cylinder body and high pressure resistant rigidity closed shell left and right lateral surface, and two levels are connected to synchronous loading hydraulic cylinder cylinder bar and the briquetting two being arranged in high pressure resistant rigidity closed shell; Two are vertically communicated with two small plunger formula hydraulic cylinder one cylinder bodies by two pipelines one to synchronous loading hydraulic cylinder cylinder body rodless cavity, and two levels are communicated with two small plunger formula hydraulic cylinder two cylinder bodies by two pipelines two to synchronous loading hydraulic cylinder cylinder body rodless cavity.The utility model is for colliery dynamic disaster parametric measurement.

title_en: Partition based multi-police-intelligent-agent task allocation method in RCRSS (Robo Cup Rescue Simulation System)
abstract_en: The invention provides a partition based multi-police-intelligent-agent task allocation method in an RCRSS (Robo Cup Rescue Simulation System). The partition based multi-police-intelligent-agent task allocation method comprises dividing a map into partitions which are not more than the number of policemen, adopting a distance based k-means clustering algorithm, serving the distance as a similarity evaluation index, performing modeling analysis on the rescue simulation environment and obtaining the partitions which are smaller than the number of police intelligent agents and allocating a certain number of policemen in every partition and performing scheduling on the police intelligent agents in a cooperation mode that the static allocation is combined with the dynamic adjustment. According to the partition based multi-police-intelligent-agent task allocation method in the RCRSS, the partition based multi-police-intelligent-agent task allocation method can adapt to multiple complex disaster environments, the task of road block removal is well achieved in the limited time, the cooperation efficiency of the police intelligent agents is improved, and the rescue efficiency of the police intelligent agents is effectively improved.

title_en: Prevention method of shallow-buried steeply-inclined coal seam rock burst
abstract_en: The invention relates to a prevention method of shallow-buried steeply-inclined coal seam rock burst. The prevention method includes following steps: (A) drilling a hole from ground to pre-splitting blasting a terrane or a rock pillar in floor and roof of a coal seam; (B) performing water-injection softening and pressure-releasing blasting to a mined coal seam; (C) after the coal seam being mined, performing deep-hole blasting to the floor and roof of the coal seam so that a hanging arch of the floor and roof is cut in advance and accumulated bending elasticity energy is released; and (D) filling a goaf of a working face with nonflammable objects after the coal seam being mined. In the prevention method, energy of the floor and roof are released through various measurements so that a strong rock burst disaster caused by fractured terrane or the rock pillar in the floor and roof can be prevented well. The method can effectively reduce an apparent intensity of a dynamic disaster during a mining process of a shallow-buried steeply-inclined coal seam and can reduced property loss and danger of worker life.

title_en: A kind of experimental simulation device at oil spilling behavior home to return to, seabed
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the experimental simulation device at oil spilling behavior home to return to, a kind of seabed, including spilled oil simulation system and Ultraluminescence photographic system, described spilled oil simulation system includes the container of two cylindrical simulated seawaters, it is installed on crude oil conical nozzle and the oil-spill dispersant conical nozzle of container bottom, crude oil storage tank, oil-spill dispersant storage tank, and a motor controlling constant temperature circulating water pot；Described Ultraluminescence photographic system includes the controller that program controlled automatic moves up and down, long shortwave switching uv analyzer, photographic system, stepping motors, is jointly installed on programme controlled movable fixture.It is an advantage of the invention that simple in construction, can the behavior home to return to of simulated sea bottom oil spilling easily, research seabed oil spilling conveying Diffusion Law in multimedium marine environment, checking and the technical support of laboratory data are provided for marine burst fire-disaster event early-warning and predicting technology, provide the foundation of science for preferably processing deep-sea oil spilling.

title_en: Combustion testing box and loaded combustion testing method for fireproof cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combustion testing box and a loaded combustion testing method for a fireproof cable. The combustion testing box for the fireproof cable comprises two combustion boxes, racks, fixtures, metal support rings, combustors and blowlamps; the rack, the combustor and the blowlamp are installed in each combustion box; the two fixtures are fixed on each rack and respectively positioned at two ends of the same, and the two metal support rings fixed on the rack are arranged between the two fixtures; the nozzles of each blowlamp are positioned on one side of the corresponding blowlamp; the fixtures and the metal support rings are used for fixing and supporting a cable to be tested; the combustors are positioned below the cable to be tested, and respectively take the shape of a strip. According to the loaded combustion testing method for the fireproof cable, through simulating fire disasters, in the case that the cable is loaded, accrual temperature of a conductor in the waterproof cable is measured, and thereby whether circuit loss reaches the standard in the case that the cable to be tested fires is detected; the testing device is simple in structure, high in safety performance and convenient to operate.
assignees: FAR EAST CABLE CO LTD;NEW FAR EAST CABLE CO LTD;FAR EAST COMPOSITE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: High-density three-dimensional direct-current exploration method for mine excavation roadway
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-density three-dimensional direct-current exploration method for a mine excavation roadway. The method includes the steps: 10, implementing geophysical exploration on a region with water disaster and water inrush threats by M-shaped line layout; 20, deleting data affected by near field effect; 30, establishing a corresponding geophysical forward model; 40, according to the forward model, determining an inversion model, and designating a low-resistance abnormal range; 50, verifying the low-resistance abnormal range by drilling; 60, according to the low-resistance abnormal range and hydrogeological conditions, performing comprehensive analysis on the hydrogeological conditions of the excavation roadway, and making evaluation report. By the method, three-dimensional high-density direct-current electric method mine construction is performed on the excavation roadway, and geophysical exploration is performed on the excavation roadway by means of specific line layout, electrode power supply, measurement and arrangement and the like. Meanwhile, accuracy in geophysical exploration result interpretation is improved by means of different types of geophysical modeling, forward and inversion and the like.

title_en: System and method for supporting training of airport firefighters and other personnel
abstract_en: A method includes generating a graphical user interface for presentation on at least one display device. The graphical user interface includes one or more first screens that display different types of aircraft. The one or more first screens include first controls that allow a user to navigate around both an exterior of each aircraft and an interior of each aircraft within the one or more first screens. The graphical user interface also includes one or more second screens that display at least one airport. The one or more second screens include second controls that allow the user to navigate around each airport within the one or more second screens.

title_en: Rubber sleeping bag type shock absorbing cushion ball allowing person to enter
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a rubber sleeping bag type shock absorbing cushion ball reducing shock received on the human body as much as possible when a person is urgently forced to escape from a disaster site such as for instance, a high-rise building because of the occurrence of accident, natural disaster or man-made arson fire, and unavoidably jumps down from a high place to the ground, and absorbing shock received when contacting a water surface when a falling place is on the water, and having a lifesaving effect to a human life by floating on the water like a floating ring.SOLUTION: A rubber sleeping bag type shock absorbing cushion ball having a shape of a gym ball to be used for training and made of hard crude rubber is formed in a shape of a sleeping bag made of hard rubber with high strength so as to allow the human body to enter, and is made a little larger by making an air chamber in a two-layer structure so as not to require fitting to the size of a user. A person blows from an air intake port in the rubber air chamber or pulls a string or pushes a button so as to instantly swell the whole sleeping bag in a rubber ball shape (elliptic rugby ball shape) like a nitrogen type vehicle shock air bag, and enter thereinto.

title_en: Transient electromagnetic simulated earthquake detection method used for coal mine underground
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection method which is mainly used for coal mine underground detection, in particular to a transient electromagnetic simulated earthquake detection method used for coal mine underground. According to the method, measured data are added for each detection grid, influences caused by environmental factors in a roadway are substantially weakened, the density of detection data passing abnormal bodies is enhanced, and transient field data are converted into virtual wave field data, so that the influence caused by the volume effect of the electromagnetic method is weakened; meanwhile, the advanced fine processing technology of earthquakes is adopted for the method, fine explanation of geological anomalies is facilitated, and the detection accuracy for potential mine water disaster hazards can be remarkably improved.

title_en: Practical training device of fire-fighting spraying system
abstract_en: The invention provides a practical training device of a fire-fighting spraying system. The practical training device of the fire-fighting spraying system comprises a fire disaster signal detection unit, a spraying fire-suppression control unit, a water level and water pressure detection unit, a spraying pipeline power unit, a spraying head control water-spraying unit and a spraying system master control unit. The fire disaster signal detection unit detects switch action signals of fire-fighting pipelines, the spraying fire-suppression control unit controls spraying pipelines to be turned on, the water level and water pressure detection unit detects water level states and water pressure states of the spraying pipelines, the spraying pipeline power unit provides hydrodynamic force for various fire-fighting spraying pipelines, the spraying head control water-spraying unit turns on or off various spraying heads according to the demands, and the spraying system master control unit controls the spraying pipeline power unit and the spraying head control water-spraying unit to be started for operation, receives water level and water pressure monitoring signals produced by the water level and water pressure detection unit and processes the signals to judge whether spraying pipeline fault signals are output or not. The practical training device of the fire-fighting spraying system can simulate an actual working environment for practical teaching of students.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire fighting monitoring detecting devices, it is characterized in that: comprise shell, in shell, be provided with mainboard, mainboard is provided with controller, and the communication module, power module, display device and the warning device that are connected with controller; Described communication module is connected with outside sensor.As a kind of technical scheme of optimization, described communication module is CAN communication module, and CAN communication model calling has current sensor, temperature sensor, cigarette propagated sensation sensor and infrared sensor.The utility model gathers the electricity consumption situation of monitored device by sensor technology, the simulated data that sensor collects by the detector of fire hazard monitoring is converted to actual numerical value by calculating, control program analyzes the state of consumer according to actual numerical value, and the information such as scene temperature, send sound and light alarm information in advance, notify that related personnel eliminates disaster hidden-trouble in advance.

title_en: A kind of in-situ ionic rare earth soaks the method for ore deposit stope preventing land slide
abstract_en: The present invention relates to preventing land slide and construction technology, a kind of method that especially relates to in-situ ionic rare earth and soak ore deposit stope preventing land slide. The present invention includes following steps: (1) slip mass geotechnical engineering investigation, determine the slip mass sliding surface degree of depth: (2) drilling and forming hole; (3) slip casting; (4) bar planting; (5) soak ore deposit fluid injection well with clay packing original place. Governance process of the present invention does not relate to earthwork evacuation engineering, and Engineering does not affect; Sliding surface integral anti-shearing intensity after slip casting improves, and injecting cement paste forms micro-shape stake through sliding surface after bar planting, has improved the skid resistance of Rare-earth Mine side slope; Can thoroughly eliminate the potential safety hazard that in-situ ionic rare earth soaks ore deposit slope of stope and landslide entirety and local buckling. title_en: Utilize the method for similarity searching and improved BP forecast level
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of method using similarity searching and improved BP neural network forecast level, the water level in similar hydrological characteristics month is possessed for 10 years to first five according to the water level of 15 days a few days ago to be predicted and carries out similarity measurement, find out itself and most similar water level period in each year, then using the water level of this most similar water level period of 50 years and latter day as training set, it is predicted using the BP neural network based on genetic algorithm.This method includes data prediction, it is intended to makes up data missing errors etc.；Similarity searching, using dynamic bending distance and sliding window technique, find out the minimum i.e. most like sequence of distance of the water level on the 15th month water level similar to first five 10 years；BP neural network based on genetic algorithm, establish system hierarchy with genetic algorithm and carry out global optimizing, and be predicted using the learning training ability of BP neural network.The present invention can look-ahead water level, provide effective technical support for flood control and disaster relief.

title_en: Fire emergency evacuation simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire emergency evacuation simulation method. On the basis of establishing a real three-dimensional fire scene, researches are made around a vector-field-based global motion planning algorithm to navigate the escape of a plurality of individuals in the fire scene in real time. The method comprises the following steps of calculating a vector-field-based safety field in real time by virtue of the algorithm, constructing a fire-scene-based crowd behavior model in combination of a social force model-based local collision avoiding algorithm, and finally providing fire escape guidance for each escape individual in the scene according to the fire-scene-based crowd behavior model. According to the fire emergency evacuation simulation method, a theoretical basis is provided, the calculation accuracy can be ensured, and verification application is developed under various experimental conditions; the method has the characteristics of low calculation complexity, high simulation effect trueness and the like, and the real-time emergency evacuation of hundreds of escape individuals can be simulated during practical application.

title_en: Actual-measurement comprehensive evaluation method for impact risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses an actual-measurement comprehensive evaluation method for impact risk and belongs to the technical field of rock burst disaster prevention and control. During a stress-relieving and danger-demolition process, the impact risk evaluation for items is performed, namely, the actual measured impact risks of drilling detection, electromagnetic radiation monitoring, micro-seismic monitoring, stress monitoring, drilling hole stress-relieving and local dynamic effect are evaluated, and the item with the most serious risk level is taken as a comprehensive impact risk evaluation result. According to the invention, after the sub-item actual-measurement impact risk and the comprehensive impact risk are judged, the parameters of the monitoring and early warning and the stress-relieving and danger-demolition can be adjusted, so that a rock burst controlling measure is more practical and efficient, the rock burst controlling measure is targeted and the impact risk in the impact risk area is really reduced to the lowest; the effect evaluation can be performed on the pre-assessment for the impact risk implemented at an earlier stage; the pre-assessment method can be revised; the reliability of the pre-assessment is enhanced; a guiding function for making the rock burst controlling measure at the earlier stage is achieved.

title_en: Disaster area environment multi-parameter simulation system and parameter receiving equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disaster area environment multi-parameter analog system and parameter receiving equipment, wherein parameter receiving equipment mainly includes: the wireless receiving module is used for receiving environmental parameters from parameter sending equipment, the microprocessor is used for displaying the environmental parameters received by the wireless receiving module through the display, and the environmental parameters comprise: methane concentration, carbon monoxide concentration, and oxygen concentration; alternatively, the environmental parameters include, in addition to the methane concentration, the carbon monoxide concentration, and the oxygen concentration: and the temperature and/or the humidity display the received environmental parameters through the parameter receiving equipment to simulate various disasters, so that the trainees can conveniently perform decision analysis training according to different environmental parameters.

abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of indoor fire hydrant simulation demonstrating apparatus, for fire demonstration, it discloses high pressure positive blower, hydrant simulation valve, high pressure positive blower is arranged in demonstration box, the exhaust outlet of high pressure positive blower is connected with pipeline, simulation fire hydrant connector, and this pipeline is provided with hydrant simulation valve; Be provided with the trapezoidal air draught window of a combination immediately below the air inlet being positioned at high pressure positive blower in the bottom of demonstration box, this window is connected with the air inlet of high pressure positive blower by pipeline.The utility model has the advantages that rational in infrastructure, handling safety, it can simulate all operations process when hydrant uses truly, for the emulation of demonstration provides environment and condition, people are allowed to leave true and deep memory to fire demonstration, help people skillfully to grasp the ability putting out initial fire disaster, and conveniently can suck dirt bits, sweep the powder of demonstration scene.

title_en: Detection method for linear light beam smoke detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method for a linear light beam smoke detector. For the detection on the linear light beam smoke detector, the fire disaster condition is simulated through two light filters of certain insulation, and the fire disaster response test is conducted on the linear light beam smoke detector. After the light filters shield the detector, people can observe whether the detector makes a response and outputs fire disaster alarm signals within a certain period of time or not and turn on an alarm confirming lamp at the same time. The method is easy, reliable, accurate in test result and high in test efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent fire escaping experiencing system of building firefighting
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent fire escaping experiencing system of building firefighting. The system comprises a main controller, a 433M communication system and a 2.4G communication module, wherein the 433M communication system and the 2.4G communication module form a wireless star topology structure with the main controller as the center. The 433M communication system comprises one or a combination of several of an entrance guard unit, a fuming unit, a fire alarm unit, an emergency lighting unit, a firefighting unit, an escaping article supplying unit, an escaping behavior judging unit, a in-fire-scene personnel judging unit and a in-fire-scene behavior recording unit. Through simulating a real fire scene, an experiencer feels the fire scene vicariously and really learns escaping skills and matters needing attention through some reminding caution on the fire scene; meanwhile, macroscopic statistics and analysis are performed on experiencing behaviors of a lot of experiencers in fire experiencing of firefighting so that a firefighting management organization can make some key measures.

abstract_en: Coal wall flow field in goaf simulation test device and method are put/adopted to a kind of combining, it is adaptable to intends emulation acquisition test data and uses.It includes the test casing being filled with emulation coal seam, below emulation coal seam, place is provided with flow field in goaf pilot system, flow field in goaf pilot system is opened during use, thus simulate coal seam, coal seam goaf and collapse process, and ignited coal seam by flow field in goaf pilot system, and gather the information of flow after coal combustion.Test method is simple, and analog result has directive significance for the understanding fire condition in goaf, gas migration rule and improvement heterogeneous goaf, Gas Disaster.

title_en: Physical simulation method for influences of surface subsidence on subway tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical simulation method for influences of surface subsidence on a subway tunnel, belonging to the field of surface subsidence and disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the following steps: tamping soil layers with a first preset thickness by layers according to a stratum structure; when piling soil to a second preset thickness, putting a pressure water bag into a shallow pit which is matched with the bottom of the pressure water bag in shape and size; based on a gypsum tunnel model at the upper part of the pressure water bag, burying pressure boxes into the top and the bottom of the tunnel and the soil layer at the lower part of the water bag so as to measure stress changes under the pressure water bag and the soil layers at the top and the bottom of the tunnel; sticking a strain gage on the surface of the tunnel so as to measure the stress strain of the tunnel; and arranging displacement meters at the top of the tunnel and on the ground surface so as to measure the displacement settlement amount. According to the physical simulation method, the model tunnel is subjected to strain measurement so that a dynamic change rule of stress and deformation of linings of the subway tunnel is tested and the accuracy of simulating the influences of the surface subsidence on the subway tunnel is improved; and a change rule of the surface subsidence in the subway tunnel under the effect of different settlement amounts is considered.

title_en: Method for partitioning map in RoboCup rescue platform based on cluster and convex hull
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for partitioning a map in a RoboCup rescue platform based on a cluster and a convex hull and belongs to the technical field of robot simulation. For the phenomenon that the perceptual information of a robot in a RoboCup robot rescue intelligent agent simulation platform has the features of locality, relativity and inaccuracy, a method for cognizing map information before an intelligent agent acts and in the acting process is elaborated, and the method comprises the steps of conducting cluster partitioning on map buildings through a K mean value according to distances and conducting dynamic convex set recognition on burning buildings to obtain state estimation on dynamic changing objects. Thus, the cognition of the intelligent agent on the disaster environment is made to be close to the real environment, and powerful support is provided for the upper layer behavior decision making of the intelligent agent.

title_en: Device coiled by fire hose

title_en: Dynamic thermal protection performance testing and evaluating device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic thermal protection performance testing and evaluating device, and belongs to the technical field of occupational safety and health. The dynamic thermal protection performance testing and evaluating device is used for fixing fabric to be tested so as to test the fabric to be tested, and comprises a support, a dynamic human body simulating device arranged on the support and used for fixing the fabric to be tested and promoting the fabric to be tested to deform, and a disaster source and a heat flux sensor which are oppositely arranged on the two sides of the dynamic human body simulating device, and a data acquisition and program control system in signal connection with the heat flux sensor, wherein the dynamic human body simulating device comprises a human body simulator propped against the fabric to be tested and a stretching device at least clamped at one end of the fabric to be tested; the human body simulator comprises a propping wall propped against the fabric to be tested; the propping wall and the disaster source are oppositely arranged on the two sides of the fabric to be tested; the fabric to be tested and the heat flux sensor are oppositely arranged on the two sides of the propping wall; the dynamic thermal protection performance testing and evaluating device further comprises a dynamic air layer changing device for driving the heat flux sensor to move relative to the propping wall.
