title_en: Test device and test method for combustion performance of building thermal insulating photovoltaic components
abstract_en: The invention provides a test device and a test method for combustion performance of building thermal insulating photovoltaic components. The device comprises a test platform, a simulation light source, a circuit control system, a combustion system, a temperature monitoring system and a heat release test system, wherein two building thermal insulating photovoltaic components are vertically arranged on the platform and are perpendicularly connected with each other, the simulation light source provides the components with a light source, the combustion system provides the components with a fire source, the work and the electricity output of a photovoltaic cell panel are controlled by the circuit control system, the temperature control system obtains the temperature rise electric signal of a temperature testing point, converts the signal and records a temperature variation curve, and the heat release test system is used for analyzing the component gas of smoke produced by the combustion of the components and calculating the heat release property parameters. The test device and the test method test the combustion performance of the photovoltaic components in a normal work state and reflect the real combustion process of the photovoltaic components in the work state. Test results have guidance meaning in the studies of material combustion properties and external thermal insulating system structures and technologies and building overall firefighting safety evaluation.

title_en: Multi-agent-based virtual miner safety behavior modeling and emergency simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent-based virtual miner safety behavior modeling and emergency simulation system. The system is characterized by comprising a monitoring layer, an analysis layer, a simulation layer, a decision enforcement layer and a database layer, wherein a communication agent is responsible for communication between every two layers; the monitoring layer consists of various detection agents; the analysis layer consists of a database management module; the simulation layer comprises an ordinary simulation module, a self-defined simulation module and an agent generation module; the decision enforcement layer comprises a commanding module, an enforcement module and an evaluation module; the database layer comprises an integrated database, a model base and a knowledge base. According to the system, an evolution trend during the occurrence of various disasters in a mine and evacuation behaviors of underground miners under a real condition can be simulated in a simulation environment, the system can be extended according to different environments of different mines in a self-defined way, a guiding basis is provided for the underground emergency evacuation of the mines in the real condition, and the safety production efficiency and the scientific management level of a mine environment are greatly improved.

title_en: Universal sensor transceiving method based on Zigbee and serial port
abstract_en: The invention provides a universal sensor transceiving method based on a Zigbee and a serial port. The method adopts a Zigbee transmission mechanism and is used for sending data of a sensor into a Sink node by the Zigbee through a self-organizing network and multiple hop transmission under the condition that the communication facility foundation is not available; the method comprises a data acquisition process, a data transmission process and a control management process; compared with traditional single-point sensor data acquisition, the method is capable of supporting multiple sensors, has the characteristics of self-organizing network obtaining, the function of power management, is good in stability, free from depending on an existing communication network, and capable of supporting network management and data interception, and the like, and thus the universal sensor transceiving method is widely applied to telemedicine, field battle, sudden-onset disasters, military training, personal health care and other monitoring scenes without communication facility support.

title_en: There is the fire-fighting water supply network intelligent inspection system of combat exercise
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting water supply network intelligent inspection system with combat exercise, for realizing automatic detecting without during fire-fighting instruction to waterworks for firefighting, comprise: driver, being connected with the fire pump of described waterworks for firefighting, during for working, driving described fire pump with power frequency total head; Pressure sensor, is arranged on the floor that the hydraulic pressure of the pipe network of described waterworks for firefighting is minimum, for detecting the hydraulic pressure value of the minimum floor of described hydraulic pressure; Switch element, is arranged on the discharge outlet place of the minimum floor of described hydraulic pressure, for opening or closing described discharge outlet; And controller, described controller is connected the duty for controlling described driver with described driver, described controller is connected with described pressure sensor, for gathering the hydraulic pressure value that described pressure sensor detects, described controller is connected with described switch element, opens described discharge outlet for controlling described switch element when described hydraulic pressure value is more than or equal to the hydraulic pressure higher limit prestored.

title_en: Testing system for coal containing methane hybrid dynamic disaster working surface in predicting laboratory
abstract_en: The invention relates to a testing system for a coal containing methane hybrid dynamic disaster working surface in a predicting laboratory. The testing system comprises a loading device, a refilling device, a vacuumizing device, a drilling device and a data acquisition device, wherein the loading device comprises a cylinder body provided with a coal feeding hole, the inner wall of the cylinder body is hermetically connected with a piston in a sliding manner, and one side wall of the tank body is connected with a pressure gauge; one side of the tank body is connected with a three-way valve and is divided into two branches by the three-way valve, one of the branch is connected with the refilling device, and the other branch is connected with the vacuumizing device; one side wall of the tank body is connected with the drilling device which comprises a drill bit, a drill rod, a drilling machine and a mineral power supply which are sequentially connected; the drill rod is provided with an air supplier connected with an air compressor, the drill rod is provided with an axial center hole, and the air compressor is used for enabling pressed air to enter the cylinder body from the axial center hole of the drill rod by the air supplier; the data acquisition device comprises a balance and a simple dust remover arranged on the balance; the drill rod is connected with the simple dust remover through a pipeline. The system is simple in structure, convenient to operate and reasonable in design.

title_en: Evacuation simulation system and providing method thereof
title_ko: 피난 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 그 제공방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an evacuation simulation system capable of simulating an evacuation situation of evacuees when a disaster such as a fire occurs in a building, and a providing method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for providing an evacuation simulation system comprises the steps of: receiving disaster configuration information including spatial information of a disaster space, evacuee information including initial location information of each of the evacuees, and initial disaster occurrence location information; generating initial phase information for the disaster space from the space information; generating disaster location information by unit time, based on the space information and the disaster configuration information; and simulating an evacuation situation by unit time using the generated initial phase information and the received evacuee information as initial conditions. Simulating an evacuation situation by unit time includes generating phase information at a specific unit time by reflecting, in the initial phase information, location information of each evacuee at the specific unit time and disaster location information corresponding to the specific unit time, and generating the location information of each evacuee at a subsequent unit time of the specific unit time, based on the location information of each evacuee at the specific unit time and phase information at the specific unit time.
abstract_ko: 건물 내에 화재 등과 같은 재난이 발생한 경우 대피자들의 대피 상황을 시뮬레이션 할 수 있는 시스템 및 그 제공방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 재난공간의 공간정보, 대피자들 각각의 초기 위치정보를 포함하는 대피자 정보, 및 초기 재난발생위치정보를 포함하는 재난설정정보를 입력 받는 단계, 상기 공간정보로부터 상기 재난공간에 대한 초기 위상정보를 생성하는 단계, 상기 공간정보 및 상기 재난설정정보에 기초하여, 단위시간 별 재난위치정보를 생성하는 단계 및 생성된 상기 초기 위상정보 및 입력된 상기 대피자 정보를 초기 조건으로 하여, 단위시간 별 대피 상황을 시뮬레이션 하는 단계를 포함하되, 상기 단위시간 별 대피 상황을 시뮬레이션 하는 단계는, 특정 단위시간에서의 각 대피자의 위치정보 및 상기 특정 단위시간에 상응하는 재난위치정보를 상기 초기 위상정보에 반영하여, 상기 특정 단위시간에서의 위상정보를 생성하는 단계 및 상기 특정 단위시간에서의 각 대피자의 위치정보 및 상기 특정 단위시간에서의 위상정보에 기초하여, 각 대피자의 상기 특정 단위시간의 다음 단위시간에서의 위치정보를 생성하는 단계를 포함하는 피난 시뮬레이션 시스템 제공 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Hole drilling track measuring device and method based on laser gyroscope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hole drilling track measuring device and a hole drilling track measuring method based on a laser gyroscope, and relates to long-deep hole drilling track measurement in the fields of oil gas extraction, exploration, disaster prevention and treatment and the like. The hole drilling track measuring device based on the laser gyroscope consists of a laser gyroscope module, a main monitoring module, a power supply module, a communication interface and a drilling rod type fixing bracket. The hole drilling track measuring device is mounted between a drill bit and a drilling rod, the inclined angle, the azimuth angle and the position parameters can be measured and recorded in the drilling and withdrawing process in real time, the hole drilling track, the hole drilling depth, the drilling or withdrawing process and the speed parameters can be calculated according to the parameters, the hole drilling track measuring device can be applied to long-deep hole drilling track measurement in the fields of oil gas extraction, exploration, disaster prevention and treatment and the like and has the advantages of high anti-interference property, good stability and high precision.
assignees: XUZHOU FU AN TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Step-into type hidden danger searching science experiencing room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a step-into type hidden danger searching science experiencing room. The step-into type hidden danger searching science experiencing room comprises an experiencing room; an access way of the experiencing room is provided with a door; the step-into type hidden danger searching science experiencing room is characterized in that the side walls and the top wall in the experiencing room are provided with flame projection lamps; four corners of the experiencing room are respectively provided with a water dispenser, a kitchen table, a control cabinet and a flat table; a microwave oven, an electric heater and a natural gas stove are arranged on the kitchen table; an air conditioner is hung above the control cabinet; an electric iron facing downwards and an electric heater are arranged on the flat table; a touch screen is hung to the side wall, facing the access way, of the experiencing room; a plurality of privately and randomly connected sockets are arranged in the middle of the experiencing room; a garbage can is arranged in the middle of the experiencing room. The step-into type hidden danger searching science experiencing room is simple in principle; a plurality of firefighting hidden danger points arranged in the family environment simulated in the experiencing room are searched and perceived by experiencers, fire safety knowledge propagating and educating functions are realized, wide crowds are helped to improve fire safety awareness and increase fire safety knowledge, and the experiencing room has high practical value.
assignees: CHONGQING OPEN INFORMATION & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line icing prediction method based on relevance vector machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system disaster warning, and particularly relates to a power transmission line icing prediction method based on a relevance vector machine. According to the prediction method, according to features of an icing phenomenon, the input quantity and weight index of an icing prediction model are selected and processed in a targeted mode; a power transmission line icing prediction model is built through a relevance vector machine method; training is conducted on the model through sample data, and the model is optimized by the adoption of a quantum particle swarm optimization and a K-fold cross-validation method; the icing thickness and probability distribution of a power transmission line are predicted according to the test data, and correction is further conducted on the model through repeated training to improve prediction accuracy. The prediction method considers the influences, on power transmission line icing, of various factors comprehensively, can predict the icing thickness of the power transmission line precisely and has very high prediction accuracy and generalization ability.

title_en: Method of detecting flood disaster changes through object-level high-resolution SAR (synthetic aperture radar) images
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method of detecting flood disaster changes through object-level high-resolution SAR (synthetic aperture radar) images and aims to solve the problem that a false target possibly existing in an SAR image and similar to a water region in geometrical characteristics and spectral characteristics causes great 'pseudo-changes' and causes difficulty and disturbances to flood disaster change detection. Each time-phase image is subjected to contourlet transform; image noise is suppressed at the premise of keeping image edge characteristics, an optimal decomposition scale is selected through simple sample training, and the position of a mark point in a possible area of a water body is quickly acquired through block histogram statistics, on the optimal decomposition scale. Contour information of the water body is acquired through a mark-point-based watershed segmentation and region merging strategy, and interference of the false target is further eliminated through discrimination rules based on multiple features. Finally, water contours extracted from multiple time-phase images are directly compared according to registration results, and a region having water body changes is obtained.

title_en: A deck of drillship or s/s rig
title_ko: 이동경로를 갖는 시추선의 데크
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a drillship deck having a moving route. The drillship deck is provided to secure a systematic moving route to improve accessibility to work areas by allowing work vehicles to move along a vehicle route formed on the deck to work areas without interference, thereby having convenience in material handling and transportation. The drillship deck having a moving route comprises: a moon pool work area and a riser loading area arranged on a main and an upper deck of a drillship; a vehicle route formed in order for the work vehicles to approach various types of equipment; and an exit route for workers, which is formed on the vehicle route in order for the workers to escape from the vehicle route.

title_en: Security response scenario evaluation system and method based on compartment integrity of nuclear power plants
title_ko: 원자력 발전소의 격실 건전성을 반영한 보안 대응 시나리오 평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a security response scenario evaluation system and a method based on compartment integrity of nuclear power plants. An object of the present invention is to prevent a radiation accident in nuclear power plants from occurring by establishing a response scenario when a compartment is unexpectedly damaged due to an occurrence of a sabotage, which is not introduced when a security plan is established, and performing immediate evaluation with respect to the damage of the compartment and is to immediately confirm whether establishment of a strategy is implemented based on available equipment so that a reactor core or containment building is not damaged when nuclear facilities are damaged due to large-scale natural disaster. According to the present invention for achieving these objects, the security response scenario evaluation system comprises: an information input unit which receives damaged compartment information; an information storage unit which stores arrangement information of buildings and compartments of the nuclear power plants, power facility information, information with respect to installation position, and information of accidents occurring when devices are not available; and a risk evaluation unit which evaluates a risk and the response scenario of the unclear power plants according to the compartment information inputted through the information input unit, based on the information stored in the information storage unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원자력 발전소의 격실 건전성을 반영한 보안 대응 시나리오 평가 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보안 계획 수립 시 상정하지 않았던 사보타주(sabotage) 발생으로 인하여 예상하지 않았던 격실이 손상되었을 경우 그 상황을 반영하여 대응 시나리오를 세우고 그에 대한 즉각적인 평가를 수행하여 사보타주로 인한 원자력 시설물의 방사능 사고를 방지하고, 대규모 자연 재해 등으로 인하여 원자력 시설물이 파손된 경우 가용한 설비를 기반으로 원자로 노심손상 또는 격납건물의 파손 상태에 도달하지 않도록 하는 전략 수립이 이행 가능한지 즉각적으로 확인함에 목적이 있다. 
이러한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명은, 손상된 격실 정보를 입력받는 정보 입력부; 원자력 발전소 건물 및 격실의 배치 정보, 발전 설비 정보 및 설치위치에 관한 정보, 그리고 기기가 이용불능 시 발생되는 사건의 정보를 저장하고 있는 정보 저장부; 및 상기 정보 저장부에 저장된 정보를 바탕으로 상기 정보 입력부를 통해 입력된 격실 정보에 따라, 원자력 발전소의 위험도 및 대응 시나리오를 평가하는 위험도 평가부; 를 포함한다.

title_en: Firefighter training method and device for simulating a flashover in a closed room
abstract_en: The invention relates to a firefighter training method and a device (1) for simulating a flashover in a burning room, said method including the introduction of a first quantity of a first combustible in a gaseous phase into the burning room and subsequently igniting and combusting the first combustible in the gaseous phase in a first step (i). The aim of the invention is to provide an improved firefighter training method and a device (1) for simulating a realistic flashover which meets high safety requirements at the same time. This is achieved in that immediately following or overlapping with step (i) , a quantity of a second combustible which is introduced into the burning room (2) in a fluid aggregate state is ignited in the burning room (2) in a second step (ii) in order to form an ignition cascade of a first combustible introduced in the gaseous aggregate state and a second combustible introduced in the fluidic aggregate state.

title_en: Firefighting education comprehensive examination car
abstract_en: The invention discloses a firefighting education comprehensive examination car. The firefighting education comprehensive examination car comprises a head end and a compartment, the firefighting education comprehensive examination car is characterized in that a projection screen is arranged on the inner wall close to the head end side in the compartment, a short focal projector is fixedly arranged on the top wall of the compartment middle portion directly facing the projection screen, a control cabinet is arranged on one side of the compartment tail, and a server is arranged inside the control cabinet; examination tables and examination chairs are arranged inside the compartment, and all the examination tables are provided with computers; the computers are connected with the server in the control cabinet; a window and an access passageway are arranged on one side wall of the compartment, an upturning door is arranged on the outer side of the window, and a sliding door is arranged on the access passageway. The firefighting education comprehensive examination car is simple in principle and convenient to use, overcomes weaknesses of the firefighting education stadium in the prior art through an improvement on the compartment space, improves efficiency of the firefighting education training, solves the problems that poor mobility of a fixed stadium and non-concentration learning time of participants, tracks and records learning of the participants and is high in practicability.
assignees: CHONGQING OPEN INFORMATION & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Personnel evacuation model based on geometric intelligent agents
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of application of space techniques and provides a personnel evacuation model based on geometric intelligent agents. The personnel evacuation model comprises a physical space submodel, a fire scene influencing factor submodel, a personnel attribute and behavior submodel and a data storage and display submodel. The physical space submodel comprises a physical space exit, obstacles and a building drawing; geometric information of the physical space exit, the obstacles and the building drawing is transmitted to the fire scene influencing factor submodel, the personnel attribute and behavior submodel and the data storage and display submodel. The fire scene influencing factor submodel comprises influence of smoke toxicity upon personnel and transmits a toxic dose of the smoke toxicity to the personnel attribute and behavior submodel. The personnel evacuation model has the advantages that the simulation of an evacuation process helps a designer make visual judgments on advantage and disadvantages of a design scheme, the comparison of exit usage rates helps improve the design scheme, and the designer can optimize the design scheme by multiply simulating different schemes.

title_en: Fire fighting training system with steam/smoke generation
abstract_en: A firefighting training system including a display device configured to display an actual or simulated fire and a sensor configured to detect an actual, simulated or virtual extinguishant that is directed at the display device. The system further includes a smoke or steam generation system configured to provide an output and a controller operatively coupled to the display device, the sensor and the generation system. The controller is configured to control the display of the actual or simulated fire and the output based at least in part upon an output of the sensor.

title_en: Fire fighting training system with integrated extinguishant sensor
abstract_en: A system for developing firefighting skills including a display device configured to display a simulated fire, wherein the display device has a front surface. The system further includes a sensor configured to detect an actual or simulated extinguishant that is directed at the front surface, wherein the sensor is directly coupled to the front surface of the display device.

title_en: Disaster prevention countermeasure system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster prevention countermeasure system for allowing a resident to get involved in the construction of an evacuation route at the occurrence of an earthquake fire, and for obtaining an effect of educating the significance of disaster countermeasures to the resident.SOLUTION: The disaster prevention countermeasure system includes: fire spread simulation means 10 for simulating fire spread situations due to a fire; evacuation simulation means 20 for simulating evacuation situations at the occurrence of the fire; and display means 40 for displaying fire spread situations simulated by the fire spread simulation means 10 and evacuation situations simulated by the evacuation simulation means 20. The evacuation simulation means 20 includes: an evacuation start position setting section 21 for setting an evacuation start position; an evacuation route setting section 23 for setting an evacuation route from the evacuation start position to an evacuation place; an evacuation speed setting section 24 for setting an evacuation speed at which a person passes through the evacuation route; and a set value input section for inputting all or a portion of the evacuation start position, the evacuation route and the evacuation speed.

title_en: Action evocation program and portable terminal device
abstract_en: To provide an action evocation program and a portable terminal device that allow evacuation actions at the generation of a disaster to be done smoothly by evoking evacuation training actions.SOLUTION: The action evocation program makes a computer function as current location acquisition means (current value acquisition unit 32) for acquiring a current location; route display control means (route display controller 33) for displaying a route from the acquired location position to an evacuation place registered in advance; and start display control means (evacuation start information sending unit 35) for displaying, in a start input screen, an input button for inputting action start information to the effect that evacuation training is being started and information on the places to evacuate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Large-mining depth and long-span fully-mechanized top-coal caving face roof sandstone fracture water detecting and preventing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-mining depth and long-span fully-mechanized top-coal caving face roof sandstone fracture water detecting and preventing method. The method comprises the steps of geophysical exploration before mining, drilling inspection, safety evaluation, push-gather monitoring, and comprehensive analysis after mining to determine the law of development and the height of a large-mining depth and long-span working face diversion fissure zone and guide detection and prevention of the working face recovery sandstone fracture water within a well field. The large-mining depth and long-span fully-mechanized top-coal caving face roof sandstone fracture water detecting and preventing method is used for effectively solving the water disaster threat of the large-mining depth and long-span fully-mechanized caving face sandstone fracture water by virtue of geophysical exploration before mining, drilling inspection, safety evaluation, push-gather monitoring, and comprehensive analysis after mining.

title_en: A kind of disaster lifesaving simulated training method and system based on video map
abstract_en: The invention belongs to video map technical field more particularly to a kind of disaster lifesaving simulated training method and system based on video map.The disaster lifesaving simulated training method based on video map includes：Step a：Based on positioning video and GIS, city video map is established；Step b：Disaster video file is selected, localization process is carried out, and add space coordinate to video file, positioning video is made to be played on the video map of city and is corresponded in reality training place；Step c：By augmented reality system plays positioning video, user is entered by wearing augmented reality system in real Training scene, and carries out survival training of taking precautions against natural calamities according to the positioning video of user position and broadcasting.The present invention with reference to augmented reality, simulates various disaster scenes, user is made to carry out survival training in impression on the spot in person, have the strong sense of reality by the broadcasting of positioning video.

title_en: Method for removing psychological disorder for patient by virtual technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for removing psychological disorder for a patient by the virtual technology. The working principle of the method is that a virtual user graph or image is obtained, a virtual user exposes in a virtual reality scene, an electrical-wave signal is acquired from the cerebral cortex of the user as the indirect measurement of the psychological rehabilitation effect; the real scene is changed to induce electric wave of the cerebral cortex of the user to enable the electric wave of the cerebral cortex to enter some state; active suggestions are provided to the user according to the special medical service of psychological rehabilitation for the user, so as to enable the electric wave of the cerebral cortex to be kept in the state all the time, and therefore, the active experience result of the user is improved, and a good way is provided for psychological training and rehabilitation; meanwhile, the motion sensing technology is performed to bring the user the realistic sensation, and thus the user can learn the way to treat a disaster in emergency while accepting psychological rehabilitation.
assignees: NANJING ZHUANCHUANG INTELLECTUAL PATENT SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Virtual experiment platform system and method for crowd evacuation feature testing and drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual experiment platform system and method for crowd evacuation feature testing and drilling, in particular to a virtual experiment platform system used for crowd evacuation feature testing and evacuation drilling and based on a virtual reality technology and a microscopic analogue simulation technology, and relates to the technical field of computer virtual application. According to the virtual experiment platform system and method, the evacuation features of crowds under different scene conditions are tested through construction of a computer virtual environment. The virtual experiment platform method comprises the steps that firstly, a crowd evacuation model is built in a computer visual programming environment; secondly, the operation that movement of a controllable virtual leading actor in the crowd evacuation model is controlled through a computer input device is achieved; finally, various virtual evacuation scenes are achieved by changing the building structures and the visual fields of the crowds in the crowd evacuation model and leading an emergency product in. A testing experiment is conducted on a built virtual experiment platform in a participation mode, the evacuation features of the crowds on different scenes can be tested and analyzed, the virtual experiment platform can be applied to evacuation drilling and training when an emergency happens, and the virtual experiment platform system and method have the advantages that the crowd evacuation feature testing and drilling can be easy and can be repeated.
assignees: SHANGHAI RES INST BUILDING SCIENCES GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Forest firefighting simulated training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest firefighting simulated training system. The forest firefighting simulated training system comprises at least one fire barrier, electronic ignitors, light sensing devices, a control device and a gas supply pipeline, each fire barrier is made of a hollow pipe, the hollow pipe of each fire barrier is communicated with the gas supply pipeline, an output port of the gas supply pipeline is provided with a valve used for controlling fire behavior, and the valve is electrically connected with the control device; a fire barrier gas outlet hole is arranged in the hollow pipe of each fire barrier, the electronic ignitors are arranged at the fire barrier gas outlet holes and are electrically connected with the control device, and the light sensing devices are arranged in the inlet and the outlet of each fire barrier and acquire passing state signals of trainees and transmit to the control device. The forest firefighting simulated training system has the technical advantages of adjustability in fire, remote controllability, safety, reliability and energy saving.

title_en: Novel firefighting is hammered into shape
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Novel firefighting hammer, comprise hammer body and handle, described hammer body is fixedly connected with handle by fixed block, described hammer body one end is provided with tup, described tup inside is connected by spring assembly and hammer body are mutually nested, the described hammer body other end is provided with rake, described hammer body inside is provided with processor and battery, described hammer body top is provided with spherical illumination lamp, described hammer body is provided with temperature inductor, smoke alarm and pressure inductor, described handle is hinged is provided with support adjusting rod, described handle inner is provided with telescopic drive bar.The utility model structure is simple, easy to operate, realize tackling in fire-fighting process different situations occur by arranging rake and the design of tup two ends, can point the direction to fire fighter by arranging illuminating lamp, wrist-watch inside arranges drill bit and strengthens fire fighter's wall of forcing open the door in fire fighting site and bring more ability, and handle adopts iron and steel design can realize the effect that hour of danger plays jack.

title_en: For the negative well well-digging method drained flooded fields
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of negative well well-digging method for draining flooded fields, and comprises the following steps: step one, and drilling well eye is to dark 10��25m, and described well extends downwardly through one or more subsurface formations from ground; Step 2, utilizes water pump outwards to extract water or silt out from borehole bottom, extends to form husky floor infiltration district around borehole bottom; Step 3, in well inner lower tube, the length of described well pipe is consistent with borehole depth, lays well lid at the earth's surface place of well. The present invention is by forming husky floor infiltration district in wellbore, can effectively discharge too much water drainage water, the disadvantageous effect that natural disaster reduction brings, retaining source when described negative well also can be used as arid while controlling flood and draining flooded fields, is suitable for being distributed in countryside away from urban architecture district.

title_en: Two-dimensional physical simulation test system and method for water inrush disaster of deep-buried tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional physical simulation test system for water inrush disasters of a deeply buried tunnel, which comprises a rigid test box, a water pressure servo control system, a vertical loading system, a pressure sensor and a permeation pressure sensor, wherein the rigid test box is of a cubic structure with an opening at the upper part, a high-strength glass plate is arranged on the front side surface of the rigid test box, a reserved tunnel portal is arranged on the high-strength glass plate, rock similar materials are paved inside the rigid test box, a karst cave cavity is buried at a preset position, the pressure stress sensor and the permeation pressure sensor are arranged on the periphery of the karst cave cavity and the tunnel, the karst cave cavity is communicated with the water pressure servo control system through a high-pressure water pipe, and the opening at the upper part of the rigid test box is loaded to a set load value through the. The two-dimensional model test system and the test method thereof have the advantages of simple structure, high strength, high rigidity and good water sealing performance, and can be used for more visually observing the surrounding rock fracture evolution characteristics in the water inrush process of the tunnel.

title_en: Anti-hole-collapse reverse circulation sampling drill bit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-collapse hole reverse circulation sampling drill bit, which comprises a drill bit body and a hollow annular ejector, wherein a cavity is formed in the drill bit body; one end of the drill bit body is respectively provided with an inner layer cutting tool bit, a middle layer cutting tool bit and an outer layer cutting tool bit from inside to outside, a sampling port is arranged at the position of the inner layer cutting tool bit, a clearance groove for deslagging is arranged between the middle layer cutting tool bit and the outer layer cutting tool bit, the annular ejector is fixedly arranged in a cavity of the drill bit body and forms an annular inner cavity with the inner wall of the drill bit body, and the sampling port is communicated with the hollow annular ejector; the drill bit body is correspondingly provided with a jet hole which is communicated with the annular inner cavity; the drill bit is simple in operation process, can quickly and accurately sample in a soft outburst coal seam, saves sampling time, improves sampling depth, coal mine sampling work efficiency and safety, and reduces the occurrence rate of gas disaster accidents.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Closed coring device for testing coal bed methane and rock formation gas contents in surface well drilling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a closed coring device for testing coal bed methane and rock formation gas contents in surface well drilling. The closed coring device comprises a coring inner barrel, a coring drill bit, an outer barrel, a power mechanism and a startup mechanism, wherein the outer barrel sleeves the coring inner barrel; a drill rod joint is arranged at one end of the outer barrel; the coring drill bit is arranged at the other end of the outer barrel; the power mechanism and the startup mechanism are arranged inside the outer barrel. The closed coring device can take a coal (rock) core sample in a fixed-point and closed way, effectively solves the technical problems that after the existing coring equipment takes a coal core, the exposure time of the sample is long, escape of lost gas is serious, content determination on gas (coal bed methane) is not accurate and the like, and further, provides more reliable basic data for coal mine gas disaster control, exploration and exploitation of coal bed methane resources, and the like.
assignees: XI AN RES INST OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENG GROUP CORP

title_en: Vehicle-mounted mining emergency rescuing lifting device suitable for large-diameter drilling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted mining emergency rescuing lifting device suitable for large-diameter drilling. The vehicle-mounted mining emergency rescuing lifting device suitable for large-diameter drilling comprises a special rescuing vehicle, a hoisting winch, a large crane boom, a rescuing winch, a rope guider, a communication cable steel wire rope, a rescuing capsule, a rescuing capsule lifting device, a remote control platform, a posture control platform and a rotary table arranged on the special rescuing vehicle. The hoisting winch is arranged on the rotary table. The big crane boom is connected with the hoisting winch. One end of the communication cable steel wire rope is connected with the hoisting winch. The other end of the communication cable steel wire rope is connected with the rescuing winch after passing through the large crane boom and the rope guider arranged below the large crane boom. The rescuing capsule and the rescuing capsule lifting device are arranged on the rear portion of the special rescuing vehicle. The remote control platform is connected with the lifting winch, the large crane boom, the rescuing winch and the rescuing capsule lifting device. According to the vehicle-mounted mining emergency rescuing lifting device suitable for large-diameter drilling, a chassis special for the rescuing vehicle is adopted, a special crane boom is arranged, the maneuverability is good, rapid movement of the while lifting device can be achieved, the emergency response speed is high, remote rescuing control is achieved, the innovativeness of a system is good, and the integration level is high.
assignees: XI AN RES INST OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENG GROUP CORP

title_en: Mine disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster early warning method. The method comprises the steps that the sound emission signals collected by a sound pick-up are monitored, the generated sound making number is counted, and meanwhile the two characteristic parameter indexes of the initial gushing velocity of drilling gas and the quantity of drilling cuttings are monitored; according to the obtained data, a corresponding variation curve of the sound making number of the sound emission signals, the variation rule of the characteristic parameter indexes and abnormal phenomena is made; the variation condition of the sound making number and the variation condition of the characteristic parameter indexes are observed; according to the characteristic of precursor of the variation of the sound emission signals, prediction and early warning are conducted for abnormal conditions which probably happen to a working face in advance, and the executive condition of the pertinence measures used by the working face is reflected in real time. According to the method, the precursory information before a power phenomenon or a disaster happens in the coal mining process is captured, the sound emission evolution rule before and after the power phenomenon or the disaster happens is analyzed, and the comprehensive identification and early warning are conducted on the power phenomenon or the disaster of coal rack gas of the test working face.
assignees: SUZHOU DELUSEN AUTOMATION SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: One adds coal measure strata fracture seepage simulation test device and method under unloading condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses one and add coal measure strata fracture seepage simulation test device and method under unloading condition, device includes testing tank body, hydraulic pressure control loading system, confined pressure loading system, fissured structure and deformation test system and percolation parameters test system composition.Method uses coal measure strata physical simulation material and the method in large scale concret block structure crack of filling in test tank body, at roof toad, roof water pressure, carry out adding the deformation of coal measure strata large-scale structure crack and seepage flow coupling process physical simulation test under unloading effect under conditions of scalable confined pressure, obtain or quantitative description adds different coarse structure cracks macroscopic deformation under unloading condition, saturated flow and the effect of intercoupling thereof, multiple mechanism and the key parameters such as fracture seepage characteristic sudden change, can effectively recognize and disclose mining induced fissure structure evolution and infiltration pressing characteristic under exploitation perturbation action, will provide fundamental basis with Prevention Technique for further investigation Pitwater disaster mechanism further.

title_en: A kind of sacrifice uses electronics incinerator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of sacrifice electronics incinerator.Comprise electronic identification label read write line, circuit module, playback module and the image image-forming module that can identify electronic identification label.By utilizing electronic identification label, by conjunction with digitlization display imaging technique to the analyzing and processing of its storage data, showing the image/sound corresponding with data results, presenting the sacrifice effect of simulation.Its advantage is to solve owing to burning environmental pollution that article bring, disaster hidden-trouble, and cheap, and can reuse, be convenient to upgrade, be substitutes and complements good in offering a sacrifice to gods or ancestors at present.
assignees: BEIJING LINGZHONG BOTONG TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of coal mine gas disaster many reference amounts multi-measuring point monitoring device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of coal mine gas disaster many reference amounts multi-measuring point monitoring device, it is characterised in that: it includes gas pressure monitoring device, drilling hole stress monitoring device, gas concentration monitoring device, some monitoring sub-stations, a Monitor Sub-Station of Less and a ground based terminal.Gas pressure monitoring device is arranged in the first boring that tunnel is the most a gang of, and drilling hole stress monitoring device is arranged in the second boring that tunnel is the most a gang of, and gas concentration monitoring device hangs and is arranged on back；Gas pressure monitoring device monitors gas pressure signal in real time, and is sent to the first monitoring sub-station；Drilling hole stress monitoring device monitors drilling hole stress signal in real time, and is sent to the second monitoring sub-station；The gas density signal in gas concentration monitoring device real-time monitoring results space, and it is sent to the 3rd monitoring sub-station；Monitoring signal is sent to Monitor Sub-Station of Less by wireless communication technique by first, second, third monitoring sub-station respectively, and all monitoring signals are sent to ground based terminal by optical fiber by Monitor Sub-Station of Less.The present invention can be widely applied to the coal and gas prominent in colliery and the prediction of impulsion pressure.

title_en: Projection-type solar security lighting device of fitness site
abstract_en: The invention relates to a projection-type solar security lighting device integrating monitoring and lighting protection functions of the fitness site. The projection-type solar security lighting device is suitable to outdoor fitness sites and meets Lighting Disaster Preventing Management Method and national related electric safety standard requirements such as HD (high definition) network monitoring integration. The projection-type solar security lighting device comprises a solar cell component, an accumulator and accumulator box unit, an LED light source, a lamp, a solar controller, a lamp pole, a component frame, a rubber jacketed flexible cable, a pre-forming basic part, a waterproof infrared or non-infrared spherical or tubular HD network AIO (all-in-one), a storage hard disk, a monitoring transmitting device, control display equipment and a serial terminal low-voltage lighting arrester. The umbrella-formed lamp is fixed by 360-degree rotation so as to project and light in optimum efficiency. The spherical or tubular HD network AIO is fixed by 360-degree rotation, leading to best shooting. The storage hard disc is applicable to multiple interfaces. The serial terminal low-voltage lighting arrester is adaptable to lighting protection of low-voltage AC-DC (alternating current-direct current) electric equipment. According to the arrangement, personnel condition in the fitness site is easy to learn for managers of fitness site, and exerciser safety is guaranteed in the unwatched fitness site.
assignees: TIANJIN CITY BINHAI DISTR SHUAIXIN TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall type landslide disaster simulation test system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rainfall type landslide disaster simulation test system which comprises a sensor used for measuring various parameters of a selected landslide, wherein the sensor is connected to an upper computer by virtue of a wireless communication network. The rainfall type landslide disaster simulation test system further comprises a power supply system and an automatic rainfall device, wherein the automatic rainfall device comprises a spraying device arranged above the landslide, a water supplying device is connected to the spraying device by virtue of a guide pipe, a control device used for controlling the water spraying amount of the spraying device is arranged between the spraying device and the water supplying device, and the control device is in both-way communication connection with the upper computer by virtue of the wireless communication network. By adopting the scheme, because the rainfall amount, the rainfall intensity and the rainfall time can be set as required, mass data is conveniently acquired, a monitoring system used for reflecting a link between the rainfall and the change of the landslide is established; through obtaining data of changes of various parameters of the landslide in a rainfall process and observing changes of the landslide, and comparing prediction conditions of the monitoring system, whether the prediction of the monitoring system is valid or not relative to the actual condition can be verified.

title_en: Supervise Classification of Gene Expression Data method
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind to supervise Classification of Gene Expression Data method, mainly solves the problems, such as that prior art carries out existing dimension disaster during Classification of Gene Expression Data, loses information and classifier design complexity.Its technical scheme is：1. the diagnostic characteristics vector of training sample is obtained using classification retaining projection method；2. using the diagnostic characteristics vector of training sample, projection matrix is obtained using regression optimization method；3. training sample feature set and test sample feature set are obtained by projection matrix；4. by training sample feature set and test sample feature set, the Classification and Identification of test sample is realized using nearest neighbor classifier.Instant invention overcomes classification retaining projection method to have the problem of Singular Value, over-fitting, improves the accuracy of Classification of Gene Expression Data, available for the tumour identification in bioinformatics and Cancer Classification.

title_en: A kind of protection against and mitigation of earthquake disasters spiel truck
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of protection against and mitigation of earthquake disasters spiel truck, comprise headstock and compartment, its key is: be provided with earthquake experience room in compartment, and the side of earthquake experience room arranges electrical generator, and opposite side is provided with sound control desk and Hydraulic Station; Be provided with vibrations experience platform bottom earthquake experience room, earthquake experience mesa base has shock structure, is provided with the kitchen range top, dining table and chair above vibrations experience platform, and top, earthquake experience room is also provided with collapse beam I and the beam II that collapses; The side in compartment is provided with rolling screen I, rolling screen II and liftable LED screen.The utility model principle is simple, and achieve the basic function that protection against and mitigation of earthquake disasters is experienced, the earthquake magnitude that the data information simulated earthquake example that can provide according to seismological bureau specifies, allows experiencer correctly identify earthquake progression; In addition, the shaking direction tiltable of earthquake experience platform and pitching, create a seismic shock effect true to nature; Meanwhile, experiencer can also experiences simulated fire extinguishing overall process, there is very strong practical value.
assignees: CHONGQING OPEN INFORMATION & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Bottled drinking device is heated with lighter burner
abstract_en: The present invention discloses heats bottled drinking device with lighter burner, it is lighter burner (B) combined heated water bottle (A) water in bottle with a water bottle (A) by PET and one using lighter gas tank (C) supply burning, with up to hot drink.Its structural feature：Water bottle (A) bottom of bottle (2) sets bottoming hole (4) insertion heat conducting pipe (9) or closes convex shape for hat hollow metal pipe (9) admittedly, insert to open to lighter burner (B) pressure with lighter gas tank (C) and lift up (17) and supply gas, the interior water of linkage piezoelectricity (14) sparking (140) ignition burner (13) heating bottle (A) is realized.Solve and supply Combustion Technology with gas box for cigarette lighter, and the defects of the water bottle of existing PET can not heat, expand lighter application.The present invention can be widely used in daily life, parliament, office, tourism, outdoor exploration operation, military training, frontier sentry, the anti-occasion personnel such as disaster relief scene, old man, patient that relieve drink.

title_en: SOP scenario executing system and providing method thereof
title_ko: Sop 시나리오 구동 시스템 및 그 제공방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an standard operating procedure (SOP) scenario executing system, which is capable of easily understanding procedures in case of disaster by visualizing an SOP scenario in the form of a flowchart or the like, and a providing method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an SOP scenario executing system includes: an SOP DB configured to store a first SOP scenario which defines a standard procedure in case of a predetermined first event; a display module configured to display an object corresponding to each of a plurality of unit SOPs included in the first SOP scenario, and the order of the unit SOPs; and a control module configured to perform tasks set to a unit SOP to be performed among the unit SOPs, and to determine a unit SOP to be performed next, based on the order of the unit SOPs, when the unit SOP is completed, wherein when tasks set to each of the unit SOPs are performed by the control module, the display module changes the shape of an object corresponding to the performed unit SOP into a first variant shape, or adds a predetermined first visual effect to a component object corresponding to the performed unit SOP.
abstract_ko: SOP 시나리오를 플로우차트 형태 등으로 가시화하여 재난 발생 시의 대처 절차를 용이하게 파악할 수 있도록 하는 SOP 시나리오 구동 시스템 및 그 제공방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 소정의 제1 이벤트가 발생한 경우의 표준적인 대응절차를 정의한 제1 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 시나리오가 저장된 SOP DB, 상기 제1 SOP 시나리오에 포함된 복수의 단위SOP 각각에 상응하는 오브젝트, 및 각 단위 SOP 간의 선후관계를 디스플레이하는 디스플레이모듈 및 상기 복수의 단위SOP 중 수행될 차례가 된 단위SOP에 설정된 작업을 수행하고, 작업이 수행된 상기 단위SOP가 완료되는 경우 각 단위SOP 간의 선후관계에 기초하여 다음에 수행될 단위SOP를 결정하는 제어모듈을 포함하되, 상기 디스플레이모듈은, 상기 제어모듈에 의해 각 단위 SOP에 설정된 작업이 수행되면, 수행된 상기 단위SOP에 상응하는 오브젝트의 모양을 제1 변형모양으로 변경하거나 수행된 상기 단위SOP에 상응하는 컴포넌트 오브젝트에 소정의 제1시각적 효과를 부가하는 SOP 시나리오 구동 시스템이 제공된다.
assignees: UNE CO LTD;PARK NAM HEE;YEO WOOK HYUN

title_en: Isolation room having independent type-firefighting facility for floating offshore structure
title_ko: 독립식 소방설비를 갖는 부유식 해상구조물의 격리형 룸 구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an isolation room of a floating offshore structure having an independent firefighting facility and, more specifically, to an isolation room of a floating offshore structure having an independent firefighting facility, capable of enhancing the efficiency in firefighting/fire extinguishing aspect and promoting economic efficiency in terms of the configuration as a fire prevention apparatus is configured only for relevant equipment by closely placing and separately dividing devices or equipment with a relatively higher risk of fire in various rooms including an engine room or a working chamber of an offshore structure such as a drillship. According to the present invention, a room or a compartment of the offshore structure having a plurality of rooms including an engine room comprises: a concentrated firefighting room separately divided inside the said room; fire attention equipment installed in the concentrated firefighting room; an air supply duct supplying air to the concentrated firefighting room; and fire extinguishing equipment extinguishing a fire in case of a fire in the concentrated firefighting room.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 독립식 소방설비를 갖는 부유식 해상구조물의 격리형 룸 구조에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 드릴쉽과 같은 해상구조물의 기관실이나 작업실을 포함한 각종 룸에서 상대적으로 화재 위험이 높은 장치나 장비들을 근접 배치하고 격리 구획하여 해당 장비들에 대해서만 화재방지장치를 구성하여 소방/소화적 측면에서 효율성을 향상시키고, 구성적 측면에서 경제성을 도모할 수 있는 독립식 소방설비를 갖는 부유식 해상구조물의 격리형 룸 구조에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 기관실을 포함하는 복수의 룸을 갖는 해상구조물의 룸 또는 컴파트먼트(compartment) 구조에 있어서, 상기 룸 내에서 별도로 구획 형성되는 집중 소방룸, 상기 집중 소방룸에 설치되는 화재주의 관심설비, 상기 집중 소방룸으로 외기를 공급하기 위한 외기 공급 덕트 및 상기 집중 소방룸의 화재 발생 시 화재를 진압하는 소화설비를 포함하는 독립식 소방설비를 갖는 부유식 해상구조물의 격리형 룸 구조가 제공된다.

title_en: Method and system for providing safety information using location information
title_ko: 위치 정보를 이용한 안전 정보 제공 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a system for providing safety information using location information. A safety information providing method performed by a safety information providing system which provides disaster information for a user terminal through a network by being linked with a data server may include the steps of: receiving weather forecasting including disaster information of a surrounding area of a service area where the user terminal belongs from the data server, and then providing the weather forecasting for the user terminal (the disaster information includes instruction according to a disaster); providing evacuation time considering simulation related with the disaster information, if the user terminal selects the evacuation time related with the disaster information; and providing an evacuation route to an evacuation place located around the service area from the service area, if the user terminal selects the evacuation route related with the disaster information.
abstract_ko: 위치 정보를 이용한 안전 정보 제공 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다.  데이터 서버와 연동하여 네트워크를 통해 사용자 단말로 재해 정보를 제공하는 안전 정보 제공 시스템이 수행하는 안전 정보 제공 방법에 있어서, 데이터 서버로부터 사용자 단말이 속한 서비스 지역의 주변 지역의 재해 정보를 포함하는 기상 예보를 수신하여 사용자 단말에 제공하는 단계-재해 정보는 재해에 따른 대처요령을 포함함-; 상기 사용자 단말이 재해 정보와 관련된 대피 시기를 선택하면, 재해 정보와 관련된 시뮬레이션을 고려한 대피 시기를 제공하는 단계; 및 상기 사용자 단말이 재해 정보와 관련된 대피 경로를 선택하면, 서비스 지역에서 서비스 지역 주변에 위치한 대피 장소까지의 대피 경로를 제공하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Imagine fire extinguisher, and stereoscopic 3D-experiencing system of imagine fire extinguisher using the same
title_ko: 가상 소화기 장치, 그리고 이를 이용한 입체 3d 시뮬레이션 가상 소화기 장치 사용 체험 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual fire extinguisher, and a three-dimensional experiencing system of the virtual fire extinguisher using the same. According to a first aspect of the present invention, the virtual fire extinguisher recognizes as an on-state that a safety pin is locked in a circuit of a control board (17) when the safety pin is contacted with all of two bearings (br), which are formed in a vertical direction inside a silicon board (SR) to fix the safety pin, when sensing that the safety pin is removed by a safety coupling sensor (13) by being put on a hinge portion of a handle. The virtual fire extinguisher recognizes as an off-state that the safety pin is separated, in this state, if at least one or more contacts are separated, and transfers recognized information to an interface controller (20) in a short-range wireless communication method.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가상 소화기 장치, 그리고 이를 이용한 입체 3D 시뮬레이션 가상 소화기 장치 사용 체험 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 제 1 측면은, 손잡이의 힌지부에 덧대어져서 안전핀 체결센서(13)에 의한 안전핀 제거 감지시 안전핀을 고정시키기 위한 실리콘 보드(SR) 내부에 수직방향으로 형성된 2개의 베어링(br) 모두에 대한 안전핀의 접촉시 제어보드(17)의 회로에서는 안전핀이 잠겨진 온(ON) 상태로 인식하고, 이 상태에서 적어도 하나 이상 접촉에서 분리되면 안전핀이 분리된 오프(OFF) 상태로 인식하여 인식된 정보를 호스트 인터페이스 컨트롤러(20)로 근거리 무선 통신 방식으로 전송하는 것을 특징으로 하는 가상 소화기 장치를 제공함에 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 제 2 측면은, 손잡이의 힌지부에 덧대어져서 안전핀 체결센서(13)에 의한 안전핀 제거 감지시 안전핀을 고정시키기 위한 실리콘 보드(SR) 내부에 수직방향으로 형성된 2개의 베어링(br) 모두에 대한 안전핀의 접촉시 제어보드(17)의 회로에서는 안전핀이 잠겨진 온(ON) 상태로 인식하고, 이 상태에서 적어도 하나 이상 접촉에서 분리되면 안전핀이 분리된 오프(OFF) 상태로 인식하여 인식된 정보를 호스트 인터페이스 컨트롤러(20)로 근거리 무선 통신 방식으로 전송하는 구성을 각각 갖는 제 1 내지 제 n 가상 소화기 장치(n은 1 이상의 자연수); 및 상기 제 1 내지 제 n 가상 소화기 장치 중 적어도 하나 이상의 가상 소화기 장치로부터 수신된 정보를 해석하여 사용자가 안전핀을 제거했는지, 가상 소화기 장치 각각이 어떤 방향으로 어떤 압력으로 분사하는지를 연산하여, 연산을 반영한 3D 입체 영상 신호를 발생시키며, 각 가상 소화기 장치로부터 수신된 정보에 포함된 각 가상 소화기 장치에 대한 ID 정보를 이용하여, 각 가상 소화기 장치의 노즐의 분사 방향 및 분사 압력 정보를 미리 설정된 시간 동안 수집한 뒤, 사용자 체감 좌표계 연산 모듈(31)에 의한 합성된 좌측 및 우측에 해당하는 3차원 그래픽 정보를 생성하는 호스트 인터페이스 컨트롤러(20);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 가상 소화기 장치를 이용한 입체 3D 시뮬레이션 가상 소화기 장치 사용 체험 시스템을 제공함에 있다.  
이에 의해, 실제 소화기의 구조와 사용법이 같은 유사 가상 소화기 장치를 사용하므로, 사용자가 소화기에 익숙해지고, 가상 소화기 장치 사용법을 익힐 수 있는 효과를 제공한다. 
또한, 본 발명은, 실제와 같은 느낌의 화재 상황을 구현하여 실질적인 소방 훈련이 가능한 효과를 제공한다.  
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 화재를 재연하는 소방 교육에 비해 환경 오염, 폐기물 처리 감소, 비용 절감이 가능한 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: The simulation of Rock And Soil catastrophe and pick-up unit

title_en: CNG Filling Station disaster consequence Forecasting Methodology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of CNG Filling Station disaster consequence Forecasting Methodology, the first step：The background of image is removed using calculus of finite differences；Second step：Binary conversion treatment is carried out to image using automatic threshold method；3rd step：Medium filtering eliminates the various interference noises in image；4th step：The calculating of region area.The present invention uses danger zone modifying factor, so that the result of existing natural gas leaking disaster Consequence Assessment model more tallies with the actual situation.Consider distribution of obstacles and meteorological condition influence, natural gas leaking spread condition is simulated using FLUENT softwares, calculated according to analog result and obtain danger zone modifying factor, existing vaporous cloud blast quantitative evalution model and the quantitative Consequence Assessment models of API pub 581 are modified using the modifying factor so that evaluation result more tallies with the actual situation.

title_en: Mountain fire detection method based on intelligent image analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain fire detection method based on intelligent image analysis. The method includes a training stage and a testing stage. An SLIC method is used for obtaining superpixels of an image. Through the method, pixels of the image can be fast clustered, fitting can be well performed on the edge of a target, after superpixel blocks are obtained, color and texture characteristics of the superpixel blocks are put forward, and mountain fire classification can be performed on the image according to the characteristics. Through a fire disaster detection method based on textures and colors, the position of a mountain fire can be fast and effectively detected, and a precise classification result can be obtained. The superpixels generated through SLLC can be well matched with the edge of the target, and the segmentation effect is ideal. The characteristics used for describing a superpixel area are simple, effective and low in complexity and can meet the instantaneity requirement of mountain fire detection.

title_en: New method for rapid gas drainage technology based on low permeability coal bed gas phase fracturing
abstract_en: Provided is a new method for rapid gas drainage technology based on low permeability coal bed gas phase fracturing. 'High pressure gas fracturing' is adopted as a basic method, the state of the crustal stress of a coal bed is changed, fractures of the coal bed are increased and the gas permeability of the coal bed is improved, gas desorption and release are accelerated, gas pressure and content are reduced, coal and gas outburst dangerousness is remitted, and coal and gas outbursts are prevented from occurring. The method comprises the specific steps that drilling is conducted on the to-be-tapped coal bed of a gas outburst high dangerous working face, a gas phase fracturing rod is put into a hole drilled, the hole drilled is sealed, a high pressure tube is started so that high pressure gas can be released to fracture the coal bed, and the high pressure tube is taken out later. The new method for the rapid gas drainage technology based on the low permeability coal bed gas phase fracturing can be applied to roadway coal tunneling and a working face to prevent the coal and gas outbursts, and can also be applied to the prevention of rock and CO<2> outbursts and mining dynamic disasters such as rock bursts.

title_en: Debris Flow Forecast method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Debris Flow Forecast system and forecasting procedure, including hardware net monitoring system, software network decision-making system and forecast system, mud-rock flow monitoring field is drilled and sampled first, in the monitoring field for meeting mud-rock flow occurrence condition, hardware net monitoring system is set, raininess in domatic is recorded by rainfall gauge real-time on-site, rainfall, signal is sent in material resource displacement by the infrasonic wave generator and electromagnetic wave generator in mesh, software network decision-making system is received by telecommunication means after the data that mud-rock flow monitoring field is transmitted, calculate displacement, with reference to the following rainfall data in weather forecast data, it is compared with alert threshold, forecast information is then sent by forecast system when meeting forecast condition.The invention provides the Debris Flow Forecast system and method for science, comprehensive each item data of mud-rock flow monitoring field sends early warning information before mud-rock flow generation, is that nearby personnel strive for evacuation time, it is to avoid cause heavy losses.

title_en: Gas phase fracturing and fast gas extraction method for low permeability coal bed
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gas phase fracturing and fast gas extraction method for a low permeability coal bed. The method includes the concrete steps that the coal bed to be mined of a working face with high gas outburst danger is drilled, gas phase fracturing rods are placed into drilled holes, the drilled holes are sealed, high-pressure pipes are started to release high-pressure gas to fracture the coal bed, and then the high-pressure pipe is taken out. Gas phase fracturing acts on the original coal bed to form fracture pressure relief rings of the portion, around the drilled holes, of a coal stratum; within the fracture pressure relief ring, the crustal stress state is changed to form a great number of fractures, the permeability is improved substantially, gas is fast desorbed and released, the pressure and the content of the gas are reduced fast, the danger level of coal and gas outburst is relieved, and the comprehensive gas treatment effect is achieved. The method can be applied to fast and efficient extraction of the gas in the coal bed, applied to robbing work to prevent and control coal and gas outburst and applied to preventing rock and CO2 outburst, rock burst and other mining power disasters.

title_en: Method for determining temperature distribution of existing subway station concrete structure in fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining temperature distribution of an existing subway station concrete structure in a fire disaster. The method is characterized in that a flac3d is used to construct heat convection and heat radiation superposed thermal fields except from the concrete structure; according to an objective fact that the properties of materials are different due to different temperatures, material parameters are regulated in real time with temperature rise in a simulating process, so that the simulated results are relatively accurate; changes of the structure thermal fields of three fire sources on set positions are simulated during a period with temperature ranging from 4 DEG C to 1000 DEG C. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a station model, establishing fire disaster thermal fields, setting model parameters, setting thermal field monitoring section and analyzing results. The method can be used for analyzing the concrete structure temperature in a fire disaster process of a complex subway station.

title_en: A kind of coal measure strata structure large scale fracture seepage physical simulation experimental rig
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of coal measure strata structure large scale fracture seepage physical simulation experimental rig, comprise the test tank body be arranged on support; Establish the structure model of soil layer installing earth formation non-hydrophilic analog material additional in tank body, mould impression runs through a prefabricated crack structure, and model is by the stronger plastic film wrapped of water-resisting property, and activity thrust dividing plate is established at model top, and water-stop sheet base is established in bottom; Tank body upper cover establishes the axial Loading Control System of roof water pressure-controlled loading system, top board and side direction confined pressure controlled loading system; Below is communicated with a water sand body collection funnel connected with water sand collecting box; Prefabricated crack structure establishes multiple sensor; Support is established test tank body rotary oil cylinder, test tank body rotary oil cylinder is connected with test body base of tank.To be obtained by this device or quantitative description adds coal measure strata fracture seepage relevant parameter under unloading condition, for further investigation Pitwater disaster mechanism and Prevention Technique provide theoretical foundation.

title_en: Firefighting training unit
abstract_en: A metal container with a combustible liner for use as a portable firefighting training unit. The combustible liner is formed of particle board sections loosely assembled inside the metal container with an opening in the liner in registry with an access opening in the metal container. The unit may be used to demonstrate various phenomena associated with a developing fire including the flammability of unburned products of combustion, hose stream techniques with a spray bottle filled with water, flashover and backdraft.

title_en: Tsunami evacuation guidance support system and program for portable information terminal
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a tsunami evacuation guidance support system useful for crews of rolling stocks or station employees of railroad routes to safely evacuate passengers when a tsunami is expected to occur in association with an earthquake.SOLUTION: A tsunami evacuation guidance support system reads a simulation map corresponding to information about the seismic center, magnitude and a tsunami wave height of an earthquake having newly occurred and a hazard map of a local government, from a database storing simulation maps in which a plurality of tsunami inundation assumed ranges corresponding to assumed conditions of various seismic centers, magnitudes and tsunami wave heights are previously obtained by simulation, by a data processor; sets a map obtained by carrying out a logical sum of the tsunami inundation assumed ranges of the simulation map and the hazard map as the tsunami inundation assumed range; and transmits data in which the tsunami inundation assumed range is shown on a map to an information terminal device present within the tsunami inundation assumed range or in the vicinity thereof.

title_en: Evacuation route provision system, evacuation route provision method, and evacuation route provision program
abstract_en: Provided is an evacuation route provision system with which it is possible to search for an evacuation route with consideration given to the circumstances of disaster-stricken areas and disaster victims, even in case of a communication failure between a server and a mobile terminal device. On the basis of current location information (Gda) etc. transmitted from various mobile terminal devices (20), a server (10) acquires geographic statistical information (Sda) and executes disaster simulation. Information obtained by the server (10) is transmitted, at normal times, to each mobile terminal device (20) as significant information (Mda). The significant information (Mda) is stored in a significant information storage means (250). The mobile terminal device (20) is provided with a disaster information input means for a user to input his/her status or circumstances surrounding the user at the time of occurrence of a disaster. When a disaster occurs, an evacuation route search means (260) searches for the optimum evacuation site and evacuation route for the user on the basis of the current location information (Gda), the significant information (Mda), and information input through the disaster information input means.

title_en: Drilling and blasting robot
abstract_en: A drilling and blasting robot comprises a vehicle body, running devices, a power device, a drilling device, a drill boom, an actuator containing box, an explosive charging device, a plugging device, actuator replacing devices, a driving device, an electric device, a wireless communication device and a remote control device. The drilling and blasting robot has the functions of hole drilling, explosive charging and drill hole plugging, integrates drilling and blasting, and is capable of completing the actions, namely hole drilling, explosive charging and plugging through controlling the remote control device in a remote distance, so that the potential safety hazard and harm to personnel and equipment in emergency rescue work such as road clearing through blasting and flood discharge for a barrier lake through blasting after occurrence of a geological disaster are fundamentally eliminated, and the work efficiency is effectively enhanced.

title_en: Testing method for simulating mechanical behaviors of surrounding underground pipelines in construction of shield tunnel
abstract_en: A testing method for simulating the mechanical behaviors of surrounding underground pipelines in the construction of a shield tunnel belongs to the field of construction protection of tunnel engineering and subway engineering, and aims to solve the problem that displacement of surrounding soil is caused by stratum loss in the construction process of a shield tunnel in a soft soil area, which can change the mechanical behaviors of surrounding underground pipelines or even causes disasters such as pipeline deformation and explosion. The testing method comprises the following steps: similar designing of a shield tunnel, underground pipelines and a stratum system; simulation of a shield tunnel construction process accompanied with stratum loss by virtue of a device for simulating shield tunnel construction accompanied with stratum loss; laying of underground pipeline measuring elements, and data acquisition and analysis; and model laying and mounting. By the testing method provided by the invention, model tests can be performed under various construction conditions, which is of great significance in further understanding the disaster mechanism of the underground pipelines and building a simplified calculation method for the mechanical behaviors of the underground pipelines. The testing method has wide application prospects in the fields of engineering technology research and tunnel engineering construction protection.

title_en: Firefighting cutter with annular drill
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of firefighting equipment, and provides a firefighting cutter with an annular drill. The firefighting cutter with the annular drill comprises a saw blade fixed on the cutter, wherein the front end surface of the saw blade is coaxially provided with the integrated annular drill. At least two through holes are formed in a barrel wall of a barrel drill. A grinding layer is arranged on the outer surface of the barrel wall of the barrel drill. Therefore, the firefighting cutter has a drilling function; and the annular drill enables an object to be drilled to be placed in a cavity of the annular drill, so that the rescued people are prevented from being hurt. Preferred leakage holes allow the cavity of the annular drill to leak the drilled-out part of the drilled object, and the grinding layer can remove burrs at edges of drilled holes. The firefighting cutter with the annular drill is simple in structure and high in practicability.

title_en: Firefighting cutter with detachable ring drills
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of firefighting equipment, and provides a firefighting cutter with detachable ring drills. The firefighting cutter with the detachable ring drills comprises a saw blade fixed on a cutter, wherein the front end surface of the saw blade is coaxially provided with an integrated annular table having holes; at least two holes are symmetrically formed in the annular table; and matched ring drills having clamping columns are clamped in the holes of the annular tables. Therefore, the firefighting cutter has a drilling function, and can be conveniently detached when being not used; and annular drill bits can enable drilled parts to be positioned in cavities thereof without hurting rescued persons. A preferable conical matching relationship can prevent the slip of the annular drills. The firefighting cutter is simple in structure and strong in practicability.

title_en: Flash copy for disaster recovery (DR) testing
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a system includes a processor and logic integrated with and/or executable by the processor, the logic being configured to cause the processor to access a snapshot of data stored on one or more DR clusters within a disaster recovery (DR) family only when the snapshot was made consistent with respect to data on one or more production clusters within the DR family before a time-zero, and perform DR testing using the snapshot, wherein the time-zero represents a time selected to simulate a disaster, wherein the DR family includes one or more DR clusters accessible to a DR host and the one or more production clusters accessible to a production host, and wherein the DR host is configured to replicate data from the one or more production clusters to the one or more DR clusters.

title_en: System for providing evacuation route, method for providing the same, and program for providing the same
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system for providing an evacuation route capable of finding an evacuation route with a disaster area and disaster victims' conditions taken into account even when a communication failure between a server and a portable terminal device occurs.SOLUTION: A server 10 acquires geographical statistical information (Sda) or performs a disaster simulation on the basis of current position information (Gda) sent from a portable terminal device 20. The information received by the server 10 is sent to the portable terminal device 20 as significant information (Mda) during normal times and the significant information (Mda) is stored in significant information storage means 250 in the portable terminal device 20, which includes surrounding situation recognition means 280 for recognizing disaster situations surrounding a portable terminal device user when a disaster occurs.
