abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire simulation system for a large-crosssection immersed tube tunnel. The fire simulation system comprises an experimental oil tray and an oil supplying device, wherein the oil supplying device comprises an oil pool and an oil supplying pump which is used for conveying fuel oil in the oil pool to the experimental oil tray. According to the fire simulation system, a real fire scene is simulated and monitored by adopting a simulated tunnel structure, and a real fire scene of the tunnel is simulated under laboratory conditions, so that the acquisition of real fire data of the tunnel under various conditions is facilitated, disaster avoidance or timely emergency treatment with pertinence is facilitated, and an important theoretical basis is provided for the construction and fire control of the tunnel.

abstract_en: The invention provides a BIM (Building Information Modeling)-based axis labeling method and system. The BIM-based axis labeling method comprises the following steps: simplifying a first BIM into a third BIM, and introducing the third BIM into a mobile terminal; transplanting an axis net in the first BIM into the third BIM of the mobile terminal. title_en: A kind of coal spontaneous combustion token test system

title_en: Superhigh-rise heat pipe system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system capable of: solving problems that waste heat generated as a result of economic and social activities is disposed in the atmosphere or the ocean to cause global crisis as global warming including an issue of CO2 increase, typhoon and tornado occur more frequently to spread disaster as well as the heat island phenomenon, sultry night, and guerrilla rainstorm (local and sudden downpour) in urban areas, and international agreement is achieved for CO2 control but in a deadlock; and capable of satisfying a demand to dispose of an increased amount of heat of the atmosphere into the space to simulate a natural heat circulation while photovoltaic power generation and natural energy are increasingly used.SOLUTION: A heat pipe is installed along with a superhigh-rise building, a heat receiving unit is provided on a ground surface floor and a heat radiation unit is provided on a rooftop of the superhigh-rise building, cold is recovered by a heat cycle of a temperature difference between a ground surface and the sky and ground heat is radiated in the sky with less CO2 and disposed of in the space, thereby reducing atmospheric heat on the ground surface, moderating the weather, and preventing spread of a disaster such as a typhoon or a tornado. For purposes of installing many heat pipe systems in urban areas, controlling a radiation amount, creating an ascending current, and controlling the weather, an institution for supporting the installation is responsible for fundraising.

title_en: Simulation method for fire-training using 3-Dimensional stereo-scopic image generation technique
title_ko: 3d 입체 영상 생성 기술을 이용한 소방 훈련 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: In the present invention, provided is a method for simulating a firefighting training using a three-dimensional stereoscopic image generating technology. For this, according to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for simulating a firefighting training using a three-dimensional stereoscopic image generating technology comprises a three-dimensional stereoscopic image implementing monitor (10), a transparent panel (20), a location chasing camera (30) and an extinguisher (40) with a far infrared laser pointer, wherein the system for simulating a firefighting training using a three-dimensional stereoscopic image generating technology is allowed to check whether users deal with the extinguisher in a right direction according to a fire image implemented in a stereoscopic image by detecting an aiming location of the extinguisher of users.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 3D 입체 영상 생성 기술을 이용한 소방 훈련 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 제 1 측면은, 3D 입체 영상 구현 모니터(10), 투영패널(20), 위치추적 카메라(30), 그리고 적외선 레이저 포인터 구비형 소화기(40)를 포함하는 소방 훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템에 있어서, 3D 입체 영상 구현 모니터(10)는 천장 벽면에 부착하여 상향에서 하향을 향하여 3D 입체 영상을 투영패널(20)로 투사하는 하향 투영 구조로 형성되거나, 바닥면에 부착하여 하향에서 상향을 향하여 3D 입체 영상을 투영패널(20)로 투사하는 상향 투영 구조로 형성되며, 투영패널(20)은 하향 투영 구조의 3D 입체 영상 구현 모니터(10)가 배치시, 적외선 레이저 포인터 구비형 소화기(40)가 위치한 길이 방향(L1)으로 갈수록 높이가 증가 되도록 설치되며, 상향 투영 구조의 3D 입체 영상 구현 모니터(10)가 배치시, 적외선 레이저 포인터 구비형 소화기(40)가 위치한 길이 방향(L1)으로 갈수록 높이가 감소되도록 설치되는 3D 입체 영상 생성 기술을 이용한 소방 훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템을 제공함에 있다.  또한, 본 발명의 제 2 측면은, 3D 입체 영상 구현 모니터(10)가 경사지게 놓인 투영패널(20)로 하향 투사 방식 또는 상향 투사 방식으로 3D 입체 구현 방식의 소방 훈련 시뮬레이션 콘텐츠를 투영하는 제 1 단계; 적외선 레이저 포인터 구비형 소화기(40)가 사용자의 조작에 따라 적외선 레이저 포인터(41)로 투영패널(20)에 투영된 콘텐츠 상의 영역을 지시하고, 물 또는 소화액 분사 수행하는 제 2 단계; 위치추적 카메라(30)가 투영패널(20)에 투영된 영상을 촬상 및 감지부(31)를 통해 수집하고, 수집된 영상에서 적외선 레이저 포인터(41)에 의한 지시 좌표를 연산하는 제 3 단계; 및 위치추적 카메라(30)가 연산된 지시 좌표를 사용자단말(50)로 전송하는 제 4 단계; 를 포함하는 3D 입체 영상 생성 기술을 이용한 소방 훈련 시뮬레이션 방법을 제공함에 있다.  이에 의해, 천장 벽면이나 바닥면에 설치된 모니터에 디스플레이되는 화상이 비스듬히 경사지게 설치된 투명패널을 통해 3D 입체 영상으로 구현되도록 하고, 소화기에 설치된 레이저 포인터에서 나오는 적외선 레이저광이 위치추적 카메라를 통해 검출되면서 사용자의 소화기 조준위치가 검출되어 입체 영상으로 구현되는 화재 영상에 맞추어 사용자가 적절한 방향으로 소화기를 조작하고 있는지를 평가할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.  또한, 본 발명은, 생성된 입체영상은 깊이 값(Z축 값)도 잘 확인되므로, 더욱 현실감 있는 소방 시뮬레이션의 기회 제공이 가능한 효과를 제공한다.  뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 3D 입체영상 생성을 위해 하드웨어적 구성이 단순하여 설치가 용이하며, 소방 시뮬레이션 콘텐츠 제작의 품질을 높임으로써 현실감에 대한 증대가 가능한 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Rockburst grade predicting method based on information vector machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rockburst grade predicting method based on an information vector machine to mainly solve the problem that in the current underground engineering construction process, the rockburst geological disaster prediction effect is not good. A rockburst evaluation index and a grading standard are selected, and domestic and overseas great deep rock engineering rockburst instances are widely collected to establish an abundant training sample library. A cross validation strategy is utilized for training an IVM model with the superior statistics mode recognition performance, accordingly, a nonlinear mapping relation between the rockburst evaluation index and the rockburst grade is established, model initial parameter setting and the training sample library are adjusted according to the training result, and the IVM model predicting the rockburst grade is finally established. By means of the method to predict the rockburst grade, the complex mechanical analysis or calculation is not needed, only the input feature vector of a sample to be predicted needs to be input in the prediction model, and then the prediction value of the rockburst grade can be obtained. The method is economical, efficient and high in prediction precision and has good engineering application prospects.

title_en: Inhabitant evacuation simulation method and system against natural flood, handheld terminal, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of enabling each habitant to participate in an evacuation training according to desired timing without a collective evacuation training, and enabling each habitant to determine the insecurity of an evacuation route.SOLUTION: A management server designates an "insecure altitude" for each predetermined position range on a map. To begin with, the management server reports an "evacuation initiation alarm" which is based on occurrence of an assumed evacuation event, to a handheld terminal. Thereafter, the handheld terminal receives the evacuation initiation alarm, and thereafter regularly transmits a position and altitude measured by positioning means to the management server. Thereafter, the management server changes the insecure altitude on the map according to a time that has elapsed since occurrence of the assumed evacuation event, and determines whether the position and altitude of the handheld terminal have become equal to or smaller than the insecure altitude on the map. Thereafter, if a true determination is made, an "evacuation failure alarm" is transmitted to the handheld terminal. The handheld terminal explicitly notifies the user of the handheld terminal of the "evacuation failure alarm."SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Rescue training system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a rescue training system for determining whether or not rescue of a person needing to be rescued is carried out following an assumed rescue action according to a wide of range disaster situations.SOLUTION: A video means 202 projects a virtual space video for a situation such as a fire, damage to an oil tank or a gas tank in an earthquake, security maintaining measures in an occurrence of a tank lorry rolling, an airplane crash, and in an occurrence of terrorism, defence activities, etc., for violation of territory, or a rescue training for armed fighting, etc. and a rescue training system has a trainee 10 carry out rescue of a wounded person needing to be rescued while viewing virtual space video projected on the video means: an image to be virtually displayed to a video means according to an injured state and an injured portion of the person needing to be rescued; a treatment implementation table registered with treatment content for the person needing to be rescued, and the standard time required for treatment; and determination means for carrying out confirmation of the treatment content for the person needing to be rescued which the trainee implemented and timing of the time for treatment, carrying out comparison of treatment content registered to the treatment implementation table and the standard time, and determining propriety of the training.

title_en: Rail-mounted high-rise escape device
abstract_en: The invention provides a rail-mounted high-rise escape device and belongs to the field of fire protection emergency equipment. The rail-mounted high-rise escape device comprises an escape rail, an escape device, pulleys and a brake device. The escape rail is arranged on outer walls of high-rise floors. The multiple pulleys are arranged at the portions, corresponding to the floors, of the escape rail. The escape rail is provided with a communicated rail chute. The pulleys are matched with the rail chute. The brake device is used for controlling the speed of the pulleys in the escape process. The escape device comprises protective belts and steel cables. The steel cables and the pulleys are provided with matched connecting devices. The protective belts are fixedly connected with the steel cables. Thus, in the emergencies such as a fire disaster, people wear the protective belts, the protective belts are then connected with the pulleys, sliding of the pulleys in the escape rail is controlled, and finally people are landed; operation is easy and convenient, residents can use the escape device simply by slight training, and indoor space is not occupied due to the fact that the whole escape device is arranged on the outer walls.

title_en: Software teaching training classroom arrangement
abstract_en: The invention discloses software teaching training classroom arrangement. A plurality of classrooms and control rooms are included. The classrooms are provided with house numbers respectively. Each classroom comprises a trainer terminal, a plurality of trainee terminals and an alarm device. Each trainee terminal comprises a platform, a projector, an electronic whiteboard and a loudspeaker box. The platforms are located on circular platform bodies. The circular platform bodies are located at the centers of the classrooms. The trainee terminals comprise a plurality of desks and chairs corresponding to one another one by one. The desks are arranged to from two arc-shaped columns. The two arc-shaped columns of desks are located on the two sides of each platform. The chairs are located on the concave surfaces of the two arc-shaped columns of desks. The software teaching training classroom arrangement is reasonable, the distance between trainers and trainees are shortened, timely communication is facilitated, and training efficiency is high; meanwhile, the alarm device is arranged, the time in searching for the specific position of a fire disaster is greatly shortened, and reliable intelligence is provided for the next fire suppression work.

title_en: Simulating device and method for diameter change rule of gas extraction borehole
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control as well as coal-bed gas extraction, and discloses a simulating device and method for a diameter change rule of a gas extraction borehole. The device comprises a true triaxial pressure test device, an optical borehole deformation observation device, a coal mass crack evolution observation device and a main machine. The magnitude of stresses in different directions is changed through the true triaxial pressure test device, and the diameter change rule of coal masses with different strength at different stress states can be researched by the aid of the optical borehole deformation observation device; real-time observation and image shooting can be performed on crack evolution of coal masses around the extraction borehole through a microscope and a camera of the coal mass crack evolution observation device. The device and the method have the important significance in determination of the reasonable gas extraction time and the effective extraction radius as well as optimization of the borehole arrangement manner.

title_en: Testing method for far-mid distance protection layer mining protection range
abstract_en: The invention relates to a testing method for a far-mid distance protection layer mining protection range. The testing method comprises the steps that a transmitting coil is arranged in a mine working face bottom plate signal cable installation groove; primary pulse signals are transmitted in the downhole, and meanwhile, an electromagnetic receiver on the mine ground is used for measuring transient electromagnetic signals at the position corresponding to the ground along trend and tendency lines; the protection range of far-mid distance protection layer mining is accurately determined by adopting a mine-ground large fixed source loop transient electromagnetic method and comparatively analyzing difference of apparent resistivity of a to-be-protected layer before and after protection layer mining, and data basis is provided for arrangement of drainage and drilling and face tunnel layout of the to-be-protected layer. According to the testing method for the far-mid distance protection layer mining protection range, the protection range of a far-mid distance protection layer can be accurately determined; the prevention and treatment effect of a gas disaster is improved; protection layer mining is the most economical and most effective area comprehensive outburst prevention measure; the protection range is an important parameter of protection layer mining; and the testing method has an important significance in ensuring safety production of mines and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Drilling detection method for coal measure stratum structuring, weak area recognition and stratum inversion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to underground drilling detection methods for deep strata and relates to a drilling detection method for coal measure stratum structuring, weak area recognition and stratum inversion. An upward or downward penetrating long borehole is constructed in a mine coal-rock roadway; thrust, rotational speed, torque and drilling speed are recorded and calculated during drilling; energy consumed by drilling unit rock, namely drilling specific energy, is deducted so as to acquire a correspondence between the drilling specific energy and a drilling path; coal-rock seams in the coal measure stratum are different in physical and mechanical property, thus a drilling difficulty difference under equal conditions is high, different drilling ratios correspond to different coal-rock types, and the coal-rock types of different segments of the drilling path are determined accordingly; the drilling ratio on the drilling path can change abruptly, indicating the geological structure conditions. The drilling detection method has the advantages that by accurately controlling occurrence and geological structure conditions of the coal-rock seams of the coal measure stratum, mine coal-rock power, hydropower and gas disasters can be preventively controlled, and gas drainage and water drainage are more specific.

title_en: Perceptual mine internet-of-things model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a perceptual mine internet-of-things model. The perceptual mine internet-of-things model comprises a perceptual and control layer, an information integration and MES (manufacturing execution system) layer and a management decision and application layer, wherein the perceptual and control layer consists of a backbone transmitting network and a perceptual layer network; the information integration and MES layer consists of an information integration network system and an MES and data warehouse platform; and the management decision and application layer is used for setting a mine application system and comprises a production dispatching subsystem, a GIS (geographic information system) and VR (virtual reality) subsystem, a safety information management system, a disaster prevention and treatment system, a transportation and sale management system, a material and equipment management system, an office automation system, a personnel information management system and a system safety management system. By the perceptual mine internet-of-things model, all complex heterogeneous information such as safety production, personnel, equipment and management information of a coal mine can run on a unified network platform, communication and sharing can be carried out under heterogeneous conditions, application systems with different functions can keep contact with one another and orderly run in a coordination manner, and information of independent monitoring systems can be shared.

title_en: The device of simulated sulfuration mineral dust explosion
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of device of simulated sulfuration mineral dust explosion, comprise the high-pressure mini air pump be communicated with successively by pipeline, compressed-air-storing room and body of heater, pipeline between high-pressure mini air pump and compressed-air-storing room is provided with controlled valve, pipeline between compressed-air-storing room and body of heater is provided with solenoid valve, pipeline between solenoid valve and body of heater is provided with specimen holder, furnace interior is provided with furnace chamber, in furnace chamber, paired being provided with is measured thermopair and controls thermopair, compressed-air-storing room is provided with load cell, the utility model is simple, the kind of dust of sulfide ore in energy simulate High-sulphur Mine recovery process, size-grade distribution, shape, specific surface area, concentration, the environment of enclosure space, mine dust flowing law, burning things which may cause a fire disaster intensity and ignition duration, the explosion phenomenon of this device energy intuitive judgment dust of sulfide ore, and record mine dust ignition temperature under given conditions.

title_en: High-efficiency water and electricity driving drill bit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency water and electricity driving drill bit. The high-efficiency water and electricity driving drill bit consists of a high-pressure cylinder, a water turbine, a driving rotating gun, a driving drill bit, a water spraying nozzle, a check valve, a pressure increasing valve and a gun lifting handle, wherein the front end of the high-pressure cylinder is communicated with the check valve, the back end is communicated with the driving rotating gun, the inner side is provided with the water turbine communicated with the driving rotating gun, the outer side is fixed with the gun lifting handle, and the pressure increasing valve communicated to the side edge is externally connected with pressure increasing and medicament devices; a through hole in the front end of the driving rotating gun is matched and connected with the water spraying nozzle, and can be matched and connected with other firefighting control spraying settings; the water spraying nozzle is arranged at the inner side of the front end of the driving rotating gun; and the driving drill bit is arranged at a front port of the driving rotating gun, and takes the shape of multiple teeth, a spiral and a circle. The high-efficiency water and electricity driving drill bit not only can be applied to control fire and avoid calamities so as to protect the life and property safety of the nation and people from being lost, but also can be used for achieving the purpose of synchronously performing the drilling and the water spraying, the cooling and the dust pressurization in usual production construction. Therefore, the high-efficiency water and electricity driving drill bit has the advantages of excellent design performance, multiple functions, wide purposes, drilling through of firefighting spraying agent, safety, reliability, speediness, high efficiency, energy conservation, environmental protection, lower production cost and higher comprehensive use efficiency.

title_en: Ion type rear-earth in-situ leaching landslide test system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of test of geological disaster models and relates to a landslide test system, in particular to an ion type rear-earth in-situ leaching landslide test system. The ion type rear-earth in-situ leaching landslide test system comprises a tank body, a mineral-leaching and liquid-injecting control part which is arranged on the top of the tank body, a displacement monitoring part which is arranged in the tank body, a penetration testing part, and a water outlet device which is distributed on the bottom of the tank body. The ion type rear-earth in-situ leaching landslide test system is high in degree of automation, can be used for performing deformation and fracture tests on a rear-earth mine in-situ leaching landslide under the action of various factors, and has the advantages of being convenient, strong in operability, reproducible and the like; an evolution process and a fracture mechanism of the rear-earth mine in-situ leaching landslide can be disclosed from a macroscopic perspective by regulating the liquid injection amount by regulating the water inlet switch, simulating different practical conditions of rear-earth mine in-situ leaching, testing landslide parameters under different liquid injection conditions and providing reliable test data, so that a theoretical basis is provided for preventing the rear-earth mine in-situ leaching landslide.

title_en: Experiment method for simulating disaster induced by explosion of deep tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experiment method for simulating a disaster induced by explosion of a deep tunnel, relates to the technical field of tunnel explosion and excavation, and aims at understanding influence of explosion load on original cracks of surrounding rocks of an adjacent tunnel, determining the safe distance of the adjacent tunnel and providing basis for supporting the tunnel economically and reasonably. The experiment method comprises that a simulated tunnel is formed at local position of a test block, and a preformed crack is formed at a preset position in the circumference of the simulated tunnel; blast holes are formed at preset positions in the periphery of the simulated tunnel of the test block, and an explosive is mounted in the blast holes; confining pressures are acted on the periphery of the test block; and while the explosive is blasted, the damage state in the periphery of the simulated channel is dynamically collected and analyzed, and the data of influence of explosion on the peripheral damage of the simulated data is obtained. The method is suitable for simulated experiment of disaster induced by explosion of the deep tunnel.

The population dynamic distribution point is obtained by a mobile phone communication data mining method. abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring and calculating intervals between rib sills of a soft foundation energy dissipation type debris flow drainage groove and application. abstract_en: The utility model is a kind of gas diffusion test confined chamber of adjustable meteorologic parameter, by gas transmission pipeline, and floor heating capillary network, airing hole, exhaust fan, humidifying spraying nozzle, heating water pipe, the compositions such as humidification water pipe.Whole device can simulate the gas diffusion test in real space in the changeable space of classics.By the key monitoring point of (the adjustment change of epidemic disaster, wind speed and indoor particulate matter, the adjustment etc. of leak export model) under finding each space environment series of experiments condition, can be the number of times reducing gas leakage diffusion test, also for the reasonable Arrangement of the respective sensor of gas leakage diffusion provides reference, simultaneously, according to flue gas diffusion carry out safe distance preresearch estimates, security protection mode and the safe distance of test point personnel can also be determined.

title_en: A kind of visible model testing device of simulation tunnel gushing water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of visible model testing device of simulation tunnel gushing water, and this device comprises model test box, water tank, high-pressure hydraulic pump, flowmeter, the water yield and stuff loss gathering-device, Digital photographic non-contact measurement system, Osmotic Pressure Automatic Monitoring System and fiber grating displacement monitoring system etc.The characteristic of this test unit is the catastrophe evolutionary process of simulation tunnel gushing water, and can reach the object of the expansion of protrusion-dispelling rock crack and water inrush channel forming process in observation gushing water process directly perceived.This device can the different hydraulic pressure of quantitative examination, different lithology, tunnel gushing water behavior under different preventing tor body thickness, obtain the multi-scenarios method information such as stress field, displacement field and the seepage field in tunnel gushing water process, determine forming process and the form of the lower water inrush channel of Different factor impact, mechanical characteristics in announcement protrusion-dispelling rock mass structure gradually distortion process and Evolution, face prominent criterion for tunnel water bursting disaster and minimum safe thickness analysis method provides effective foundation.

title_en: A decision-making support system for responding to natural disasters rapidly
title_ko: 자연재해에 신속하게 대응하기 위한 의사결정 지원장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a decision-making support system for quickly dealing with natural disasters. According to the embodiment of the present invention, provided is the decision-making support system for quickly dealing with natural disasters which includes a monitoring unit (1) which is connected to an external organization (100) and displays information received from the external organization, a simulation module (2) which displays an item which is similar to a scenario database input condition according to the order of accuracy through a similar scenario algorithm, a disaster situation module (3) which is connected to a GIS database (7) and displays the algorithm result as spatial information through a GIS system, a disaster estimation information statistics/analysis module (4), and a situation handling module (5).

title_en: Search support system and search simulator
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a search support system capable of improving search efficiency.SOLUTION: Provided is a search support system which comprises a first terminal used by the disaster headquarters, an administration device installed in a data center, a second terminal used by a search director, and a third terminal used by each search staff member. The first terminal sends to the administration device search information necessary for search and requests the administration device to send the map data of disaster areas. The administration device sends the requested map data. The first terminal highlights search areas on the received map to prepare a search map and sends it to the administration device. Based on the search information, the administration device prepares search requisites for rescuing victims within seventy two hours in the search areas by a predetermined arithmetic operation and sends the prepared search requisites to the first or second terminal. The administration device receives from the third terminal position information of each search staff member and discovery information about those being searched for and displays the information on the search map. The second terminal receives and displays the search map and the search requisites sent by the administration device. The third terminal sends to the administration device position information acquired by positioning means and discovery information when the search staff member has discovered those being searched for.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of method taking out absciss layer gas and draining slip casting under overlying strata using combined drilling and counterboring
abstract_en: Under a kind of utilization combined drilling and counterboring extraction overlying strata, the method for absciss layer gas and draining slip casting, belongs to prevention and control of mine disaster method.Transportation roadway setting drill site in the preparation face adjacent with stope, inbreak belt construction combined drilling and counterboring is avoided at the position that absciss layer will be generated under stope above goaf overlying strata in advance, this combined drilling and counterboring is made up of the gas pumping pipe of inner sleeve and draining Grouting Pipe, after absciss layer generates, carry out prevention and control of mine disaster by with the next stage：First, using the water in combined drilling and counterboring pump drainage absciss layer；Secondly, after the emptying of absciss layer water, methane gas can have been assembled in absciss layer, using original combined drilling and counterboring extraction absciss layer gas；Finally, after the completion of water and gas exhaust, inject cement mortar in absciss layer again by original combined drilling and counterboring in absciss layer.The method can solve the mine disasters such as water bursting in mine, Gas Outburst (or ejection), bump and subsidence using combined drilling and counterboring, and absciss layer area water and gas pumping rate are high, and slip casting effect is good.

title_en: Blast emergency drilling simulation system and analogy method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of blast emergency drilling simulation system and analogy method, system includes main control computer, PLC control cabinet, environment simulator, personnel positioning apparatus and well-control equipment supervising device, the output switch parameter point and analog output point of described main control computer is connected with PLC control cabinet, and the output end of PLC control cabinet is connected with environment simulator；Main control computer receives the mode of operation signal from well-control equipment supervising device；Described personnel positioning apparatus include multiple active electronic labels, multiple sensors, the network switch.The present invention produces simulated explosion effect by cigarette machine and electronic firecracker, evacuation situation and the site disposal situation that student can accurately be recorded using personnel positioning technology outside the collection of well-control equipment sensor and main control computer monitoring system and ultra broadband room, according to field condition real-time adjustment smog size and explosive state, so as to complete whole emergency drilling.

title_en: The big rope of fire-fighting remote control crosses device
abstract_en: Device, including remote control are crossed the invention discloses a kind of big rope of fire-fighting remote control, also including heart-shaped main body box and side plate box, wherein：Heart-shaped main body box one end sets the waterproof cover that movable unlatching is provided with the outside of shift knob, shift knob；Battery is provided with heart-shaped main body box, a liter machine, relay module group, remote control wiring board, motor control module is hung, remote control wiring board is used for the signal for receiving remote control, motor control module is used to control motor；It is provided with side plate box on the outside of motor, motor and is connected with V-groove pulley；It is of the invention light and handy portable, operator can be advanced on rope bridge or cable wire by the remote control far distance controlled device, retreats, be adjusted with speed, forward and backward, lower section illumination, warning horn, electric brake, a variety of functions such as heavy lift and itself display of regime, can be widely used in large span large space disaster accident rescue site and in fire drill usually.

title_en: Patent literature clustering method
abstract_en: A patent document clustering method comprises the following steps: s1, corpus collection and pretreatment; s2, extracting characteristic words of the clustering analysis corpus; s3, carrying out clustering analysis data patent vector representation based on word vectors; s4, clustering; and S5, evaluating the clustering result. The patent document clustering method comprehensively considers the title and abstract information of the patent document, fully excavates the semantic information implicit in the patent document abstract by utilizing the patent abstract information from different angles, considering the whole information of the patent abstract text and simultaneously considering the information of the attributes and the attribute values in the patent abstract; the hidden information in the large-scale corpus is fully utilized, the large-scale corpus is utilized for feature training, the words are expressed into a vector form with low latitude, and the information in the text is better extracted while the dimensional disaster is avoided; different weights are set, and the title, the abstract and the attribute values of the abstract are fused to obtain good patent clustering effect.

title_en: Mine drilling gas gushing speed rapid determination instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine drilling gas velocity of gushing out rapid determination appearance is applicable to the colliery underground direct rapid determination drilling gas velocity of gushing out that has gas dynamic disaster. The rubber tube measuring device is composed of a rubber tube, two measuring cylinders with air guide ports, a communicating tube, a fixed base, an air guide chamber and a timer. When the gas emission speed of the drill hole is measured, the rubber hose is connected with the drill hole, the switch of the gas guide chamber is closed at the moment, gas is discharged into the atmosphere through the gas guide chamber, when the gas emission speed is measured, the switch of the gas guide chamber is opened, the timer is triggered at the moment, and meanwhile, the gas is not discharged into the atmosphere any more and flows into the measuring cylinder through the gas guide chamber. The timer and the measuring cylinder respectively record the gas emission time and the gas emission volume, so that the gas emission speed in the drilled hole can be quickly determined.

title_en: Electrically-driven portable water purifying machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrically-driven portable water purifying machine. The electrically-driven portable water purifying machine comprises a water purifier shell which is of a box body structure, wherein a self-suction lift pump, a storage battery, a PP filter element, a reverse osmosis membrane filter device, a raw water inlet pipeline, a communication pipeline, a wastewater outlet pipeline and a produced water output pipeline are integrated in the box body structure. According to the electrically-driven portable water purifying machine, the storage battery and the self-suction lift pump are arranged in the water purifier shell, and the PP filter element and the reverse osmosis membrane filter device are highly integrated, so that the purification of drinking water during camp training, border patrol, biochemical detection, special warfare survival, disaster relief, prairie nomadism, field exploration and home travel can be realized; furthermore, being of the box body structure, the water purifier shell is light, convenient, easy to carry, strong in practicability and wide in application range; the portable water purifying machine is simple in structure, complete in functions, easy to manufacture, safe, reliable, energy-saving, environmentally friendly, low in failure rate and convenient to operate, and the cost is lowered.

title_en: Coal mine downhole crawler type drilling and punching integrated equipment
abstract_en: Coal mine downhole crawler type drilling and punching integrated equipment comprises a crawler type hydraulic drilling machine, a high-pressure-resistant sealing drill stem, a drilling and punching dual-purpose drill bit, a high-pressure rotation connector and a high-pressure water pump station, wherein the body of the high-pressure-resistant sealing drill stem penetrates and is fixed in the power head inner hole of the crawler type hydraulic drilling machine, a power head provides rotation speed and torque to the body of the high-pressure-resistant sealing drill stem, one end of the high-pressure-resistant sealing drill stem is connected with the high-pressure water pump station through the high-pressure rotation connector, the high-pressure water pump station provides high-pressure water needed by punching, the other end of the high-pressure-resistant sealing drill stem is connected with the drilling and punching dual-purpose drill bit, and hydraulic operations can be performed after drilling without replacing the drill bit. The coal mine downhole crawler type drilling and punching integrated equipment has the advantages that streamlined operations of coal mine downhole gas pressure relief, drilling and punching can be completed by the equipment, safe and efficient production of outburst mines is guaranteed, coal seam coal and gas outburst danger is eliminated, a regional pre-drainage gas drilling construction period is shortened, coal seam drilling and punching and gas extraction efficiency are increased, and gas disaster prevention and control cost is reduced.

title_en: Building Information Modeling method of building cultural assets
title_ko: 건축 문화재의 건물 정보통합 모델링 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for integrated modeling of building information on architecture cultural assets, which comprises: a three-dimensional scanning step of measuring each element of an architecture cultural asset; and a building information integrated modeling step of completing the outer appearance for each element of the architecture cultural asset by using building information modeling (BIM) and making an application of unique physical properties for each element after the three-dimensional scanning step. Accordingly, the BIM is applied to three-dimensional modeling using three-dimensional scanning information, thereby making possible simulation for an external force such as a fire, a natural disaster, etc. to enable a user to predict the vulnerable parts and come up with countermeasures.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 의한 건축 문화재의 건물 정보통합 모델링 방법은, 건축 문화재의 각 요소를 실측하는 3차원 스캐닝 단계와, 상기 3차원 스캐닝 단계 이후에, 건축 문화재의 각 요소를 건물 정보통합 모델링(BIM; Building Information Modeling)에 의해서 외형을 완성함과 더불어 상기 각 요소의 고유한 물성값을 적용하도록 하는 건물 정보통합 모델링 단계를 포함하여 이루어진다. 
따라서, 3차원 스캐닝 정보를 이용하여 3차원 모델링을 함에 있어서, 건물 정보통합 모델링(BIM; Building Information Modeling)을 적용하므로 화재나 자연재해 등의 외력에 대해서 시뮬레이션이 가능하도록 하여 취약 부분을 예측하여 대응 방안을 세울 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Experimental device simulating fire disaster smoke particle growth
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device simulating fire disaster smoke particle growth; the experimental device includes a smoke box, a conical smoke collecting hood and a bracket; the smoke box is arranged on the bracket and is connected with the conical smoke collecting hood through a smoke tube; a sampling net is hung in the conical smoke collecting hood, an oil tray is arranged below the conical smoke collecting hood, and one side of the oil tray is provided with a thermocouple tree. The experimental device simulating the fire disaster smoke particle growth is provided with the smoke box, sampling rings are randomly hung in the smoke box, smoke particles after condensation agglomeration can be sampled, and the smoke particle morphology is studied.

title_en: Building material smoke density tester
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building material smoke density tester comprising a control cabinet and a burning box; the control cabinet is provided with a displayer, a computer host, an operation panel and an electrical element; the burning box is provided with a smoke exhaust fan, an optical path assembly and a burning assembly; the burning assembly comprises a main burner and a specimen holder; the optical path assembly contains an optical path transmitting terminal and an optical path receiving terminal, the optical path transmitting terminal is provided with a partition glass window, and the optical path receiving terminal is provided with an optical filter; according to the building material smoke density tester, the smoke density value is evaluated by measuring light flux loss caused by light reflection of solid dust in smoke generated by burning a material, smoke production behaviors of the material in an actual fire disaster environment can be better simulated, the smoke production rate of the basic material can be quickly determined, and the fire-proof properties of the material are predicted; the tester is low in cost, high in precision and suitable for quantitative test on smoke production performance of various materials, and can be provided for various material or product manufacturing and research and development departments, inspection departments and scientific research departments to use.
assignees: SUZHOU PHINIX QUALITY TESTING INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Variable-frequency vibration exploitation method of offshore gas hydrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a variable-frequency vibration exploitation method of offshore gas hydrate and belongs to the technical field of offshore resource exploitation. The variable-frequency vibration exploitation method includes steps of drilling a methane gas hydrate reservoir layer via an offshore drilling rig, releasing stress energy to promote decomposing of gas hydrate by a vibrator at the top of a drill pipe, gathering the decomposed methane gas around drilling holes and enabling the methane gas to move upwards along the drill holes by means of natural pressure difference of the hydrate decomposing area and the drill holes; controlling rising speed of the methane gas, and collecting the methane gas from the drill holes to the drilling rig by a collector and storing. By adjusting energy of the vibrator, different frequencies of excitation energy are applied according to different saturation degrees of methane reservoir layers, the vibration energy can be adjusted according to decomposition of the methane gas, and decomposing speed and range of the gas hydrate can be effectively controlled; disasters such as unordered seabed landslide due to changes of depositional conditions are avoided.

title_en: Fire prevention measure bar
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of fire prevention measure bar.Fire prevention measure bar provided by the invention includes drilling part, hollow tube and driving section, the drilling part is arranged on the body first end, the end of body second connects with the driving section output end, the input of the driving section is connected with pneumatic tools, the hole slot for connecting outside in the body is provided with the tube wall of the body, be collectively forming on the inside of the hole slot and the body can supplied gas or fire extinguishing material disengaging goaf passage, the driving section can drive the drilling part to rotate under the dynamic action of the pneumatic tools, so that the fire prevention measure bar drill enters the goaf.The present invention can realize deeper depth of implements when detecting the disaster hidden-trouble of coal mine gob or being put out a fire.

title_en: Underground heat fluid communication abnormal flow monitoring system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of underground heat fluid communication abnormal flow monitoring system, including：Exception monitoring unit, data transfer unit, data receiver and processing unit；The exception monitoring unit, data transfer unit are arranged on monitoring car, and shallow well drilling rig is provided with monitoring car；The shallow well drilling rig is being capable of deep 2 25m of drilling well, the 1m of bore diameter 0.5 portable electric rig；The fields such as the present invention can be used for disaster monitoring and prediction, geothermal energy to reconnoitre, extreme climate and environmental monitoring and prediction, engineering stability evaluation, monitoring and the prediction level of natural calamity can be particularly greatly improved, and fills up domestic and international natural calamity (particularly earthquake) mobile monitoring with hot fluid and its associate the blank of exception integrated forecasting.

title_en: Balanced crowd evacuation method for asymmetric safe passages of public building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a balanced crowd evacuation method for asymmetric safe passages of a public building. Meshing is carried out according to distribution of crowd and barriers in the building, a balanced evacuation adjustment model of safe passages is established via a simulated crowd evacuation model in which congestion factors is introduced, an evacuation scheme which is determined by simulating certain groups of congestion factors based on the simulated model, a training sample and an examination sample of a BP neural network model are obtained, an evacuation scheme optimal model is constructed based on a manual neural network model and a crowd evacuation simulated model, an evacuation scheme which is determined by a group of congestion factors of better effect is screened, personnel evacuation selection areas are divided, people in the same evacuation selection are assigned to evacuate in the same safe passage, and finally a concrete crowd evacuation scheme is made aimed at the building. It is ensured that rapid and safe evacuation can be completed in the building with asymmetric safe passages.

title_en: A kind of pneumatic type fire extinguisher bomb controlled for ground dump and hillock deep burning things which may cause a fire disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of pneumatic type fire extinguisher bomb controlled for ground dump and hillock deep burning things which may cause a fire disaster, relate to coal spontaneous combustion and control fire extinguisher bomb, described pneumatic type fire extinguisher bomb comprises bullet, body and projectile tail, described bullet be fixed with conic ceramic drill bit foremost, conic ceramic drill bit is built-in with pyrostat; Spiral drilling rod is bolted link conic ceramic drill bit; Spiral drilling rod inside adopts glass cement to be fixed with temperature controller, switch and micro power; Pyrostat connects with temperature controller, and temperature controller is connected with switch, and switch one end is connected with built-in miniature power supply, and the other end is connected with the fuse be built in body; Described body is band arc cylinder, and there are 4 little interlayers inside, and 4 little interlayers adopt insulating ceramic and body outer surface to isolate, and body outer surface pig iron suitcase is wrapped up in; Propeller and concussion-fuse are installed in projectile tail.The utility model security of system is reliable, successful, cost are low, efficiency is high, and is easy to control operation.

title_en: Systems and methods to provide kinetic disasters
abstract_en: A system, a non-transitory machine-readable storage medium storing instructions, and a computer-implemented method to cause simulation of a kinetic disaster is provided. A physical interaction with a client device is detected during gameplay of a multiplayer game that includes a virtual environment. The detected physical interaction is analyzed using a user interaction profile. A kinetic disaster simulator is selected based on the analyzing the physical interaction with the user interaction profile. Simulation of a predefined game action is caused within the virtual environment.

title_en: Searching and rescuing grabbing device of game model helicopter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a searching and rescuing grabbing device of a game model helicopter and relates to the searching and rescuing grabbing device. The searching and rescuing grabbing device aims at solving the problems that due to a specific competition field and strict rules, the flexibility of the used searching and rescuing device of the model helicopter is poor in competition, the time consumed in putting substances is long in a substance grabbing process due to the poor flexibility, and the requirement of competition can not be met. A driving gear and a driven gear are both arranged on a landing gear, the driving gear is meshed with the driven gear, a power source module, an information processing module, a first steering engine and a second steering engine are arranged at one end of a rotating arm in sequence, an output shaft of the second steering engine is sleeved with the driving gear, a slide block is arranged on the rotating arm and matched with a slide rail in a sliding mode, an output shaft of a third steering engine is hinged to one end of a rocker arm, the other end of the rocker arm is fixedly connected with a grabbing component, a fourth steering engine is arranged on the rocker arm, and the other end of a rope is connected with an output shaft of the fourth steering engine after surrounding the circumference direction of a soft clamping port for a round. The searching and rescuing grabbing device of the game model helicopter is used in disaster simulation rescue.

title_en: Combined tent support frame unit

The tent is mainly suitable for island fishing, sand beach parties, troops field training, disaster relief, advertising campaigns of associations, enterprises and public institutions, and can be used for sleeping in the open in travelling.

title_en: Volcanic ash dispersion simulation method and system for forecasting volcanic ash disaster
title_ko: 화산재 재해 예측을 위한 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a volcanic ash dispersion simulation method and system for forecasting a volcanic ash disaster. According to the present invention, a volcano ash dispersion simulation analysis terminal (100) generates volcano explosion data for generating a file of a keyhole markup language (KML) type. The volcano ash dispersion simulation analysis terminal (100) performs a volcano ash dispersion simulation modeling. The volcano ash dispersion simulation analysis terminal (100) generates the file of the KML type including location information. The volcano ash dispersion simulation analysis terminal (100) implements volcano attribute information on a user interface screen.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 제 1 측면은, 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 분석 단말기(100)가 화산을 포함하는 지역의 화산 속성 정보를 이용하는 구글어스용 KML(Keyhole Markup Language) 형식 파일 생성을 위한 화산 폭발 정보 자료를 생성하는 제 1 단계; 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 분석 단말기(100)가 화산 폭발 정보를 입력자료로 하는 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 모델링을 수행하는 제 2 단계; 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 분석 단말기(100)가 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 모델링 결과 정보를 이용하여 위치정보를 가지는 KML(Keyhole Markup Language) 형식의 파일을 생성하는 제 3 단계; 및 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 분석 단말기(100)가 KML 형식의 파일에서 화산재 속성 정보를 독출하여 구글어스 상에서 실행하여 입출력부(100a) 상에 유저 인터페이스 화면으로 구현하는 제 4 단계; 를 포함하는 화산재 재해 예측을 위한 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 방법을 제공함에 있다.  
또한, 본 발명의 제 2 측면은, 화산이 포함된 지역에 대한 미리 설정된 값에 해당되는 가로, 세로 및 높이를 갖는 3차원 공간 정보를 이용하여 화산재 이동 및 확산 현상을 분석하기 위한 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 시스템에 있어서, 화산 폭발 속성과 대기환경 조건을 결정하는 화산 속성 정보 입력값을 입출력부(100a)로부터 수신하여 화산 폭발 정보를 생성하는 화산 속성 정보 입력값 구축 모듈(110); 및 화산 속성 정보 입력값 구축 모듈(110)에 의해 구축된 화산 폭발 정보를 이루는 화산 속성 정보 입력값을 오일러리안 확산 방정식을 기반으로 하는 화산재 입자의 거동을 연산하여 화산재 확산 모델링을 수행하는 화산재 확산 모델링 모듈(120); 을 포함하는 화산재 재해 예측을 위한 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 시스템을 제공함에 있다.  
이에 의해, 확산 시뮬레이션 모델의 입력자료로서 필요한 화산 폭발 정보를 화산의 지리적 경위도, 분화구 고도, 화산폭발 규모, 화산재 배출량 등을 입력받은 뒤, 사용자의 요구와 위치정보를 토대로 결정함으로써, 사용자 개인에게 최적화된 모델링 자료를 구축할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 해당 구축된 임의의 화산폭발 지역에 대한 입력 자료를 오일러리안 확산이론에 기반한 화산재의 확산 시뮬레이션 수행을 통하여 특정 지역에 대한 화산재 속성 정보(화산재 광학두께, 입자농도, 침적량 등을 포함)를 제공하는 효과가 있다.   
또한, 본 발명은 사용자가 정의한 화산의 위치와 화산폭발 조건을 토대로 화산재 속성 정보를 지도상에 표출할 수 있는 방식을 제공함으로써, 향후 화산재로 인한 재해에 대해 보다 효율적이고 정확한 대처방안의 수립에 기여하는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Portable lifesaving and escaping protection headgear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable lifesaving and escaping protection headgear, and relates to the field of disaster lifesaving and escaping equipment manufacturing and water sports protection equipment manufacturing. The headgear is suitable for lifesaving and escaping of shipwreck, fire hazards, automobile drowning and personnel slipping drowning, is especially suitable for lifesaving and escaping of automobile drowning, and is also suitable for protection of beginning swimming training, water spots and army soldier river crossing and island capture landing action. The headgear is characterized in that 1 to N hard frame bodies are connected with a waterproof soft and transparent headgear body to form a gas storage cavity, the bottom of the headgear body is provided with a gas guide tube, the gas guide tube is connected with a closeable gas guide hole positioned in the upper portion of the headgear body in order to be opened to the outside, and the lower portion of the headgear body is an elastic waterproof collar body. The contracted portable gas storage cavity isolation protection design of the headgear makes the headgear do not occupy the space, benefits popularization of escaping and lifesaving devices, and also greatly improves the automobile drowning escaping probability of non-swimmers.

title_en: But a kind of coal mine gas extraction pipeline that is used for filters ignition system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of filtration for coal mine gas extraction pipeline to press down ignition system, and comprise the collecting pipe be located in high-order drill site, described collecting pipe presses down firearm by filtration and is connected with extraction pipeline; Described filtration presses down firearm and comprises the tank body that filtered water is housed, and the ullage level of described filtered water is provided with obstruct copper mesh, and the tank body sidepiece be positioned at above obstruct copper mesh offers to add water all presses mouth; The bottom of described tank body is provided with and discharges water except cinder notch, and the side of tank body is provided with air inlet pipe, opposite side is provided with escape pipe, and the air outlet of described air inlet pipe bends downwards and submerges in filtered water, and the air inlet port of described escape pipe is bending upward.But source of the gas is by filtering after the filtered water of firearm, obstruct copper mesh, the dust mixed and broken cash being filtered and eliminate disaster hidden-trouble effect, greatly improve safety and the extraction efficiency of extraction system in source of the gas.

title_en: Coal mass strength distribution characteristic continuous detecting method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mass strength distribution characteristic continuous detecting method and device. The method includes the steps of connecting a short-circuit test element for detecting the torque, drilling pressure and drilling depth of a real-time detection drill bit between the drill bit and a drill stem, recording and storing the detected torque, drilling pressure and time signals of the drill bit through the short-circuit test element, converting the torque, drilling pressure and time signals into vibration signals or electromagnetic signals, transmitting the vibration signals or electromagnetic signals to a signal receiver, conducting analysis through a signal processor to obtain a depth-torque curve and a depth-drilling pressure curve, and conducting comprehensive comparing and analyzing on the real-time curves and information stored in the short-circuit test element to obtain coal mass strength distribution characteristics. By means of the method and device, the current situations that underground coal mine coal mass strength testing complexity is high, advanced detection is difficult, and test results can hardly meet prediction requirements are broken through, the coal mass strength distribution characteristic continuous detection in the drilling process is achieved through drilling information, and the method is easy and convenient to implement, scientific in test principle, accurate in result, intelligent, efficient, advanced and practical and has great application prospects in the technical field of mine dynamic disaster forecasting and early warning.

title_en: Bearing capacity assessment method for timber architecture obtained after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bearing capacity assessment method for timber architecture obtained after the fire disaster. The method comprises the following steps that a detection scheme is determined according to the combustion situation constructed through the fire disaster field timber architecture; probe drilling detecting is carried out on the timber architecture components on the fire disaster field through an impedance instrument, and resistance values of different parts of the timber architecture components, subjected to fire, on the fire disaster field are obtained; a relevance mathematical model between mechanical performance parameters and impedance values of timber is established through the test; part of physical and mechanical performance parameters of the timber, subjected to different fire degrees, of different parts of the timber architecture components are obtained; the rest of unknown mechanical performance parameters of anisotropic materials of the timber are calculated according to the approximate proportion relation between mechanical parameters of the timber; structural modeling and material defining are carried out in Abaqus finite element analysis software, and the bearing capacity of the timber structure obtained after the fire disaster is calculated. The bearing capacity assessment method for the timber architecture obtained after the fire disaster is scientific, objective and accurate.

title_en: Systems and Methods for Catastrophe Mitigation for Deep Water Oil Drilling during Blowout Preventer Failure
abstract_en: Disclosed herein in example embodiments is a simple Drill-Through-Equipment (DTE) system for deep water drilling of oil, to intervene in the event of Blowout Preventer (BOP) failure, and mitigate spill disaster. Example embodiments of systems and methods of failed BOP intervention, and oil spill disaster mitigation disclosed herein may be used to mount a housing within the existing BOP below the blind shear ram, whereby the failed BOP is made accessible just below the blind shear ram through access ports, opening or closing in the housing. Through these ports blowout is diverted, thus protecting the rig. Through these same ports access is granted to the drill pipe allowing external manipulation or cutting of the drill pipe in effort to render the BOP operational. Once this is accomplished, the access ports are closed, and normal BOP and/or drilling operations are resumed. Example embodiments integrate and make use of existing BOP machinery.

title_en: System and method for distribution of sensors for emergency response
abstract_en: A system and method for placement of sensors for sensing hazardous substances released from a plurality of hazard points. A processor identifies a location of a hazard point, a fence line of the plant-site, and a toxic level of concern (LOC) for the hazardous substance. The processor calculates a minimum amount of the hazardous substance (Q) for which a concentration at a centerline of a plume carrying the hazardous substance reaches the toxic LOC at the fenceline, and simulates a release of the hazardous substance in the calculated amount Q from the hazard point. The processor further calculates a pair of sensor locations where the concentration of the plume is equal to the minimum detectable concentration level of sensor based on the simulated release. The pair of sensor locations is then output by the processor.

title_en: Apparatus and Method for Emergency Response Preparedness
abstract_en: An apparatus and method for computer aided emergency response preparedness wherein content of training material and related documentation presented to a client staff member engaged in interactive training is tailored to the client staff member in accordance with information stored in a database characterizing client organizations, client facilities and client staff members. Advantageously, interactive sessions are supported for data collection and training via a communication network such as the Internet. Facilities are provided for interactive creation and modification of content of training material and related documentation and for client account creation by provider specialists whereby credentials are established for enabling interactive sessions by client staff members.

title_en: Server and method for processing virtual traiming data file
title_ko: 서버 및 가상 훈련 데이터 파일의 처리 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for processing a virtual training data file. The processing method is used to process a virtual training data file or replay a data file generated for each trainee or player in 3D virtual fire training by driving a 3D virtual fire training program module installed in a client from a server. The method includes: a process of receiving a storage request regarding the replay data file from the client; and a process of linking a virtual training file header including the 3D virtual fire training identification information executed by each player according to the received storage request and the replay data; and a process of storing the virtual training file header and replay data linked according to the control operation of a file processing module to different track files for the respective players in a database in a distributed manner.
abstract_ko: 가상 훈련 데이터 파일의 처리방법이 개시된다. 이 처리방법은 서버에서 클라이언트에 설치된 3D 가상 소방 훈련 프로그램 모듈을 구동하여, 3D 가상 소방 훈련에서 훈련 참여자(이하, 플레이어) 별로 생성된 가상 훈련 데이터 파일(또는 리플레이 데이터 파일)을 처리하는 방법으로서, 상기 클라이언트로부터 상기 리플레이 데이터 파일의 저장 요청을 수신하는 과정과, 수신된 상기 저장 요청에 따라 각 플레이어가 수행한 3D 가상 소방 훈련의 식별 정보를 포함하는 가상 훈련 파일 헤더와 상기 리플레이 데이터를 연계하는 과정 및 상기 파일 처리 모듈의 제어에 따라 연계된 상기 가상 훈련 파일 헤더와 상기 리플레이 데이터를 각 플레이어별 서로 다른 트랙 파일로 데이터베이스에 분산 저장하는 과정을 포함한다.

title_en: Water and mud outburst test device for tectonic fracture filling structure
abstract_en: A test device for simulating water and mud bursting disasters of a structural fracture filling structure in traffic and hydraulic tunnels comprises a water and mud bursting test device, a water and mud bursting test device and a water and mud bursting test device. The invention discloses a water inrush and mud inrush test device for a structural fracture filling structure, which is characterized by comprising a pressure loading device, an inrush channel simulation device, a water pressure pressurizing and pressure stabilizing device and a data acquisition and analysis device, wherein the pressure loading device is arranged at the top and the bottom of the inrush channel simulation device and provides axial pressure for the inrush channel simulation device; the water pressure pressurizing and stabilizing device is connected with the top of the surging channel simulating device through a water inlet pipe and provides water pressure with stable pressure for the surging channel simulating device; the data acquisition and analysis device is arranged on a water outlet pipe at the bottom of the gushing channel simulation device. The water-bursting and mud-bursting test device for the tectonic fracture filling structure can simulate the migration condition of filler particles with different particle sizes in the water bursting process of the tectonic fracture filling structure.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of huge curtain disaster arenas experiencing system, railcar is taken by user, orbit runs, through viewing platform, viewing platform comprises multiple sub-viewing platform, at the first sub-viewing platform, there is the first shaking device in orbit, railcar can be driven to shake, and on ceiling, there is the second shaking device driving pendent lamp vibrations, user can experience world shake, at the second sub-viewing platform, platform surrounding has blast fan, can blow to railcar, and above platform, be provided with sound equipment, effect sounds can be sent, user is made to experience storm, and on the 3rd sub-viewing platform, comprise projection arrangement, the stunts such as billboard sparkles and billboard collapses and light goes out entirely can be simulated in screen, make user on the spot in person, scene when vivid sense comes by disaster.

title_en: Emergency response desktop exercise module and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency strain table exercise module and an implementation method thereof, the module mainly comprises a scene module, a role module, a resource module and a status module, a test end generates a simulation scene by using the scene module, and then the other modules are further arranged in the scene module to form a complete simulation real environment, so that a tested end carries out medical treatment and rescue exercise of emergency disaster status in the simulation real environment, thereby providing and strengthening the strain capacity of medical treatment and rescue units.

title_en: Evacuation system for drilling rig and method thereof
title_ko: 시추선의 대피 시스템 및 대피 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation system and an evacuation method for a drilling rig. The evacuation system comprises: a plurality of risers connected to each other in the downward direction of the drilling rig, and into which a drilling pipe is inserted; a ram device installed at one of the risers, and for cutting the drilling pipe; and a riser separation device placed at an upper end of the riser in which the ram device is installed. When the drilling pipe is cut by the ram device in case of an emergency situation, the riser separation device is configured to remove the bond with the riser in which the ram device is installed.
abstract_ko: 시추선과 연결된 라이저(Riser)를 분리하는 대피 시스템에 있어서, 상기 시추선의 하향방향으로 연결되고 내부에 시추용 파이프가 삽입된 복수의 라이저와, 상기 복수의 라이저 중 하나에 설치되어 상기 시추용 파이프를 절단하는 램 장치와, 및 상기 램 장치가 설치된 라이저의 상단에 위치한 라이저 분리장치를 포함하되, 비상상황 발생시 상기 램 장치에 의해 상기 시추용 파이프가 절단되면, 상기 라이저 분리장치는 상기 램 장치가 설치된 라이저와 결합을 분리하는 시추선의 대피 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Integrated control system and method for disaster prevention using fluid simulation of three-dimensional numerical analysis
title_ko: 삼차원 수치해석 유체 시뮬레이션을 이용한 재난방지 통합관제 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated control system for disaster prevention using fluid simulation of three-dimensional numerical analysis and a method thereof which comprise: a database system; a three-dimensional fluid simulation system for rendering in real time by using pre-operated and analyzed result data; a result monitoring device for selecting a dangerous section by analyzing and monitoring management sensor data and CCTV image data in real time through an integrated control server, notifying information about the dangerous section to government branches and departments of local governments related to a specific regions, and generating a danger warning; and the integrated control server for performing disaster prevention in a specific region or disaster prevention such as resident evacuation. According to the present invention, the integrated control system for disaster prevention using fluid simulation of three-dimensional numerical analysis and the method thereof enable government branches and related departments of local governments to set the specific region as a dangerous region to warn danger and evacuate residents according to a dangerous level.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 특정지역의 예전부터 누적된 강우데이터, 지형데이터, 구조물데이터, 사전에 연산 및 해석된 결과물데이터, 유체정보와 해석범위에 대한 정보데이터를 입력하여 가공하고 저장하는 데이터베이스시스템; 상기 지형데이터와 구조물데이터에 의해 상기 특정지역의 지형과 구조물을 각각의 삼차원객체로 모델링하고, 합성한 후 유체의 초기조건과 경계조건을 부여하며, 3차원 모델에서의 유체흐름을 수치모의연산하여 수치모의데이터를 생성하고, 생성된 수치모의데이터를 출력하여 형상화하고 실시간으로 렌더링하고, 또한 별도의 프로그램에 의해 수치모의연산한 수치모의데이터, 센서데이터, 사전에 연산 및 해석된 결과물데이터를 이용하여 실시간 렌더링하는 삼차원 유체시뮬레이션시스템; 상기 삼차원 유체시뮬레이션시스템을 통해 삼차원으로 렌더링된 시뮬레이션 결과를 모니터링하여 상기 특정지역의 위험구간을 선정하여 피해정도를 미리 예측하고, 통합관제서버를 통해 관리센서 데이터와 CCTV 영상데이터를 실시간으로 분석 및 모니터링하여 위험구간을 선정하며, 이러한 사실을 상기 특정지역과 관련된 정부기관과 지자체의 부처로 알리고 위험경보를 발생시키는 결과모니터링장치; 및 다수 개의 관리센서와 CCTV를 통해 특정지역의 실시간 데이터가 입력 및 저장되어 통합관제서버로 전달하며, 상기 결과모니터링장치를 통해서 특정지역의 상기 삼차원 피해예측 시뮬레이션 결과를 전달받아 상기 특정지역과 관련된 정부기관과 지자체의 부처로 위험 경보를 발생하여 알려주며 그에 따른 특정지역의 방재나 주민대피와 같은 방재조치가 실질적으로 이루어지도록 유도하는 통합관제서버를 포함하는 삼차원 수치해석 유체 시뮬레이션을 이용한 재난방지 통합관제 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이러한 본 발명은 다수 개의 관리센서나 CCTV에 의해 특정지역의 위치정보, 지형데이터, 우량, 강우량, 유속, 수위의 상태가 실시간 모니터링되거나 동시에 통합관제서버에 데이터로 입력되어서 관리하다가 입력되는 측정 데이터가 미리 설정한 일정수준을 초과하면 그에 맞는 적절한 경보를 발생하고, 또한 센서 데이터 및 기존 수치모의데이터를 이용하여 실사와 같은 표현이 가능하며, CCTV가 관찰하고 있는 특정지역도 역시 실사와 같은 표현으로 객관화가 가능하므로 위험구간 예측시 적절한 경보가 발생가능하고, 이러한 경보를 발생하여 정부기관이나 지자체의 관련 부서로 통보함으로써 정부기관이나 지자체의 관련 부서가 그 특정지역을 위험지역으로 설정하여 위험을 경보하고 위험정도에 따라 주민을 미리 대피시키는 것과 같은 대처방안을 실행하도록 유도하는  효과가 있다.

title_en: Experiential safety training method and system using virtual reality based on game
title_ko: 가상현실을 이용한 게임기반의 체험형 안전교육 방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a game-based experiential safety education method using the virtual reality and a system thereof, and more specifically, to a game-based experiential safety education method using the virtual reality and a system thereof, capable of promoting the experiential learning of standard operation procedures about disaster types by repeatedly learning the procedures through a game; and promoting an ability to cope with a large scale disaster situation. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system includes: a scenario generating module generating a training game including at least one game mission to experience a safety training in a disaster situation; a control module extracting a game mission corresponding to a game request from a user terminal in the training game; and a communications module receiving the game request from the user terminal, and transmitting the game mission to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실을 이용한 게임기반의 체험형 안전교육 방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는, 게임을 통하여 재난유형에 대한 표준작전절차를 반복 학습하여, 표준작전절차의 체화를 도모하고 대규모 재난상황에 대응할 수 있는 대응능력을 고양할 수 있는 가상현실을 이용한 게임 기반의 체험형 안전교육 방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 가상현실을 이용한 게임기반의 체험형 안전교육 시스템은, 재난상황에서 안전훈련을 체험할 수 있는 하나 이상의 게임미션을 포함하는 훈련게임을 생성하는 시나리오생성 모듈; 상기 훈련게임에서 사용자 단말기의 게임요청에 대응하는 게임미션을 추출하는 제어모듈; 및 상기 사용자 단말기로부터 상기 게임요청을 수신하고, 상기 사용자 단말기에 상기 게임미션을 전송하는 통신모듈;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Electromechanical interlocking control method for safe scram of escalator
abstract_en: The invention provides an electromechanical interlocking control method for safe scram of an escalator. According to the method, an escalator steel structure truss, a mechanical transmission system and an electrical dragging system are involved. The method is characterized in that pull switches are arranged on the head and the tail of the escalator steel structure truss, and by utilizing the electromechanical interlocking characteristic of the pull switches, electrical control circuit wires of the pull switches are directly connected to a control loop of the electrical dragging system in series; mechanical interlocking pull ropes are arranged on supporting plates fixed below operating hand belts of the mechanical transmission system. Compared with the prior art, the electromechanical interlocking control method has the beneficial effects that training is not needed, and the dangerous operation that a person bends over or squats to press a scram button is not needed; when human injuries happen in the operation process of the escalator, any person on the escalator can operate the pull switches for emergency response so as to cut off failures in time to prevent accidents; the electromechanical interlocking control method is brand new, safe and reliable.

title_en: Device and method for inducing zonal disintegration of surrounding rock mass by simulating roadway excavation
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and method for inducing zonal disintegration of surrounding rock mass by simulating roadway excavation, and belongs to the fields of rock mechanics, mining engineering, coal mine safety production, photo mechanics and the like. The device comprises a roadway excavation system, a surrounding rock side pressure loading system and an optical observation system. The roadway excavation system is composed of bulk solid which is filled into the roadway in advance, a push head containing a hole, a hydraulic cylinder, an on-off valve, a throttle valve, a hand-operated direction valve, an overflow valve, a hydraulic pump, a filter, a transparent flat plate, a telescopic sleeve and the like; under the action of gravity, the bulk solid drops through the hole of the push head, a hydraulic cylinder upright drives the push head moves upwards at a constant velocity simultaneously, and the roadway excavation simulation is achieved. The surrounding rock side pressure loading system is composed of a side capsule, a shell, a pad box and the like, and side pressure is exerted on a roadway surrounding rock model. According to the device and method for inducing the zonal disintegration of the surrounding rock mass by simulating the roadway excavation, a large number of reliable data can be provided for the mechanism and the research process of the zonal disintegration of the deep roadway surrounding rock mass and disaster prevention and control; the device is compact in structure, convenient to operate and low in manufacturing cost.

title_en: A kind of method of the Combined model forecast water level based on similarity searching
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of method of the Combined model forecast water level based on similarity searching, determine that a few days ago water level related to day to be predicted is used as sequence to be matched by the use of coefficient correlation, a series of water level time serieses dissimilar with sequence to be matched are searched out from historical data based on similarity searching, as the training set of forecast model after it is excluded from original time series.This method mainly includes data prediction, it is intended to the data that fill a vacancy and reparation wrong data etc.；Similarity searching, using dynamic bending distance and fixed sliding window technique, a series of time serieses dissimilar with sequence to be matched are rejected from the historical data in former years；Combination forecasting, there are two basic models：The BP neural network and SVMs of LM algorithm improvements, its shared proportion in current predictive is dynamically adjusted according to prediction performance of each basic model in previous moment using Bayes' theorem.The present invention can realize the high accuracy and requirement of real-time needed for flood control and disaster relief.

title_en: Multifunctional fire test furnace system device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional fire test furnace system device which comprises a heating furnace body, a fuel system, an electronic ignition and control system, a combustion control system, an air supply system, a smoke exhaust system, a smoke characteristic test system, a temperature field and radiant heat flux test system, a furnace chamber and flue pressure test system, a pump-type water-spraying fire extinguishing system, an experiment image acquisition system and a loading device. The fire test furnace can carry out multi-angle experiment simulation on building structure system conditions under the high-temperature fire effect, and can study ignition characteristics, fire propagation characteristics and combustion rules of a building structure system as well as smoke flow characteristics, propagation rules and influencing characteristics and rules of the technique of smoke prevention and evacuation on fire propagation; and the research result can provide reliable theoretical analysis, experimental basis and scientific reference for fire protection performance design of various building structures and building systems.
