Help improving operation quality and efficiency. Especially, be suitable for the preceding treatment of institute, emergency rescue and disaster relief and the field operations surgery of basic unit's mobile medical treatment, emergency call.

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method based on ridge ripple and depth convolutional network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of hyperspectral image classification method based on ridge ripple and depth convolutional network, mainly solves the problems, such as that the prior art is low to classification hyperspectral imagery precision and computation complexity is high.Implementation step is：1. training sample is selected in high spectrum image；2. extract the spectral information and spatial information of training sample；3. combine spectral information and spatial information composition training sample set；4. constructing five layer depth convolutional networks, and design ridge ripple wave filter and network is initialized；5. utilize the neutral net of training sample set training construction；6. pair remaining sample is classified with trained neutral net, image classification is completed.The present invention has the advantages that nicety of grading is high and classification speed is fast, available for weather monitoring, environmental monitoring, urban planning and preventing and reducing natural disasters.

title_en: Pre-stressed anchor cable anchoring section reaming drilling tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a prestressed anchorage cable anchor section reaming drilling tool, this product have the drilling tool base member, the drilling tool base member comprises central drill bit (1), slider reaming drill bit (2) and leading ware (3) at least, it has the spline to lead ware (3) one end, the other end of leading ware (3) passes through constant head tank (4) and cylindric lock (5) and is connected the location with central drill bit (1), slider reaming drill bit (2) are located between leading ware (3) and central drill bit (1) and with the chute clearance fit of central drill bit (1). The product is suitable for broken rock strata below medium-hard (the compressive strength is less than 30 MPa), can realize segmented hole expansion in an anchoring section, is suitable for a drilling process by using an air down-the-hole hammer, and provides a new technical platform for the geological disaster control construction.

title_en: Oil Well Improvement System - Well Monitor & Control Subsystem
abstract_en:
The parent patent—The Oil Well Improvement System—incorporates and integrates several different unique assemblies and subsystems that provides a cost effective disaster preventive system for offshore oil wells while concurrently providing the means to reduce the cost of the drilling processes. 
     The system modifies the sea-floor, in-well and platform equipment and processes. 
     This divisional/continuation-in-part patent—The Well Monitor and Control Subsystem acts in concert with the Oil Well Improvement System to provide the interface and processing means to timely monitor the conditions and forewarn of potentially dangerous well conditions, provide the means to govern modes of operation of numerous new and existing platform, seafloor and in-well functional active devices to negate the impact of blow-outs and further provides the means to significantly improve/reduce the cost & time of the well drilling process.

title_en: Method for preventing landslide and dammed lake disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a method for preventing landslide and dammed lake disasters. The method aims to solve the problem that present geological disasters cause landslide and dammed lakes and endanger personal and property safety. The method for preventing landslide and dammed lake disasters comprises the steps of first surveying distributed position, distribution range, structural features, border conditions and physical and mechanics parameters of landslide, calculating a landslide stability coefficient according to surveyed data; determining possible unstable areas of landslide according to the landslide stability coefficient obtained through calculation, and simulating the unstable dammed lake accumulation range according to the possible unstable areas; and finally arranging an emergency flood discharge channel according to the landslide and dammed lake accumulation range. The method is suitable for preventing the landslide and dammed lake disasters.

title_en: An Emergency Ladder having adjusted leveling part
title_ko: 레벨조절부가 구비된 하향식 피난사다리
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an escape ladder installed in a rectangular opening part penetrated on a concrete floor of a veranda in a multi-household house, such as an apartment house, a villa, or a multipurpose building to urgently evacuate people in emergency, such as a fire. The escape ladder comprises: a box-shaped base body mounted on the inner surface of the opening part; a top cover to open and close the top of the base body; a foldable ladder installed in one side surface of the base body and folded by connecting a predetermined length of multiple bars; a bottom cover to open and close the bottom of the base body whereon the foldable ladder is mounted; and level adjustment parts having a level bracket coupled inside the outer circumference of the base body and a fixing bracket fixed onto a concrete floor inside the level bracket by an anchor bolt and vertically moved to adjust a height by rotating an inserted bolt. The present invention easily adjusts the level of the base body in accordance with the rotation of the bolts using a tool, such as a drill; adjusts the level by vertically sliding a sliding part vertically slid; and safely adjusts the level without shaking as the level brackets and the fixing brackets are vertically moved while being engaged with each other in the vertical movement.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 아파트,빌라나 주상복합과 같은 다가구의 베란다 콘크리트 바닥에 장방형의 개구부가 관통되고, 상기 개구부에 설치되어 화재와 같은 비상시에 긴급대피할 수 있는 피난사다리에 있어서, 상기 개구부에 내측면에 안착되는 박스형상의 베이스본체와, 상기 베이스본체의 상면을 개폐하는 상면덮개와, 상기 베이스본체의 내측 일측면에 설치되며 다수개 정해진 길이의 바형상으로 연결되어 접이되는 접이식사다리와, 상기 베이스본체의 하면을 개폐하여 상면에 상기 접이식사다리가 안착되는 하면덮개와, 상기 베이스본체의 외주면 내측에 결합되는 레벨브라켓과, 상기 레벨브라켓의 내측에서 콘크리트바닥에 앙카볼트로 고정되고 볼트가 삽입되어 회전되면서 높낮이가 조절되도록 상하로 이동되는 고정브라켓으로 이루어진 레벨조절부;로 구성된 것을 특징으로 하여, 드릴과 같은 기구를 이용하여 볼트의 회전에 따라 베이스본체의 레벨을 용이하게 조절할 수 있고, 상하로 슬라이딩되는 슬라이딩부가 연결되어 용이하게 상하로 슬라이딩되면서 레벨을 조절할 수 있고, 레벨브라켓과 고정브라켓이 상하로 이동시 맞물리면서 상하이동되어 흔들림 없이 레벨을 안전하게 조절할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Simulation test system for prevention and control of mine disasters and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test system for prevention and control of mine disasters and an application method thereof. The simulation test system comprises a test rack; the top of the test rack is provided with a vertical loading mechanism; the vertical loading mechanism is provided with a horizontally arranged loading plate; left and right sides of the test rack are both provided with a transverse loading mechanism; the transverse loading mechanisms at the two sides are arranged in a face-to-face manner and both provided with a vertically arranged side plate; the two side plates respectively press left and right sides of the loading plate; the front and rear sides of the test rack are both provided with a panel prepared from a transparent material; the loading plate, the two side plates, the two panels and the bottom of the test rack form an accommodation space used for placing of a sample; and a pressure bag is arranged in simulated coal seam, simulated top board or simulated base plate. The simulation test system is simple and convenient to operate and improves authenticity of simulation test.

title_en: Polari SAR (metric synthetic aperture radar) image variation detection method of wavelet domain polarization distance transformation
abstract_en: The present invention provides a polari SAR (metric synthetic aperture radar) image variation detection method of wavelet domain polarization distance transformation, comprising: performing pre-process operation of the polari SAR images of two time phases, such as denoising, deorientation and the like; extracting partial regions of interesting ground feature types to serve as a training sample; performing polarized distance measurement between the images of the two time phases and the training sample to obtain the polarized distances of the two time phases; performing ratio logarithm transformation of the two polarized distances to construct differential images; performing wavelet multi-resolution decomposition and fusion of the differential images; and performing dual threshold segmentation of the fused differential images to extract an invariant area and two various areas, etc. According to the invention, the variation detection of specific ground feature types in a complex scene may be preferably realized, and the polari SAR image variation detection method of wavelet domain polarization distance transformation, with strong robustness, may be further applicable to the polari SAR image variation detection in the practical applications such as the monitoring of urban variety, or the detection and assessment of disaster situations and the like.

title_en: A kind of rail-road shares shield tunnel Fire Ventilation smoke evacuation analogue experiment installation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Fire Ventilation smoke evacuation experimental simulation device based on the shared double-layer shield tunnel system of rail-road, including laterally smoke evacuation controls and optimized system, simulation fire source system, more characteristic parameters measuring system, fire detecting system and fine water mist fire-extinguishing system in tunnel half；By simulation fire source system simulation burning things which may cause a fire disaster and its generation position, the generation of fire is perceived by fire detecting system and alarm signal is sent, the more characteristic parameters of fire are obtained by more characteristic parameters measuring system, by tunnel half, laterally smoke evacuation control and optimization system carry out smoke evacuation processing to tunnel fire hazard, and the fire intensity of a fire is controlled by fine water mist fire-extinguishing system.The present invention, which can simulate true rail-road and share, occurs fire condition in tunnel, the simulated experiment platform of the comprehensive system researchs such as tunnel fire hazard detection under flue gas control and optimization, complex situations, fire attack control and carbon monoxide Distribution evolution rule is provided, more preferable embodiment is provided so as to occur fire for true the type tunnel and carry out evacuation design.

title_en: Beidou timing type commanding machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Beidou timing type commanding machine. The Beidou timing type commanding machine is composed of an antenna module, a radio frequency module, a baseband processing plate, a time service plate, a display control unit and a power supply module. An output/input end of the antenna module is connected with the host radio frequency module. An output/input end of the radio frequency module is connected with an input/output end of the baseband processing plate. Display output ends of the baseband processing plate are connected with input ends of the display control unit and the time service plate. Output ends of the power supply module are connected with input ends of the baseband processing plate and the radio frequency module. Compared with the prior art, the Beidou timing type commanding machine has the advantages that the positioning precision is high, a plurality of receiving channels are provided, and the time service can be provided, etc; and the Beidou timing type commanding machine can be widely applied to the fields requiring group commanding, war exercises and unified time, such as command scheduling and time unification of a large-scale military exercise and disaster early warning, command scheduling of various vehicles and personnel in civil air defense and time unification of equipment rooms, and time synchronization among mobile base stations and power grids.
assignees: XI AN HANGGUANG SATELLITE MEASUREMENT AND CONTROL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of road network evacuation planning method based on maximum flow rate heat source

title_en: Method for analyzing change of force applied to fractured rock slope along depth under heavy seismic load
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for analyzing change of force applied to a fractured rock slope along depth under a heavy seismic load. The method comprises: a. establishing a fractured-rock-slope equivalent model, and presetting cracks of different angles in the fractured-rock-slope equivalent model; b. inputting simulated seismic waves into the fractured-rock-slope equivalent model; c. according to a force application result of the fractured-rock-slope equivalent model after the simulated seismic waves are input, acquiring an effect of the cracks on an slope internal force under a seismic load. The invention discloses, from a micro perspective, a mechanism in which a rock slope deforms and breaks under a dynamic load, and proposes a new dynamic rock breaking strength criterion based on fracture mechanics, to help propose a reasonable and economical protecting and retaining system, so as to reduce an impact of a broken slope on a surrounding environment in a disaster. According to an analysis method provided by the invention, a standard slope design method is established, and a perfect research foundation and basis are laid for applications in projects such as landslide control, high and steep slope protection, and so on.

title_en: Dynamic operating procedures for emergency response
abstract_en: An occurrence of an emergency event can be detected. Parameters corresponding to performance of a first plurality of tasks performed in accordance with an existing operating procedure in response to the emergency event can be monitored. Based on the parameters a first performance rank for the existing operating procedure can be determined. A dynamic operating procedure comprising a second plurality of tasks can be generated, the dynamic operating procedure configured to define a response to the emergency event. Performance of each of the second plurality of tasks contained in the dynamic operating procedure can be simulated and, based on the simulation, a second performance rank for the first dynamic operating procedure can be determined. title_en: A kind of Fire Ventilation smoke evacuation experimental simulation device contacting tunnel system based on City Underground Transportation
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of Fire Ventilation smoke evacuation experimental simulation device contacting tunnel system based on City Underground Transportation, the experimental simulation device includes simulation fire source device, tunnel longitudinally smoke evacuation control optimization device, fire detecting arrangement, more characteristic parameters measuring device and road gradient in highway tunnel regulating device, wherein, the device is made of four single bore tunnels, simulator placement direction is up north and down south left west and right east, and center is equipped with underground parking garage；And it is equipped with emergency escape door and model automobile in the apparatus；Import jet blower, outlet jet blower, axial flow blower and jet blower, smoke outlet；And several axial flow blowers and jet blower is respectively set with upper end in the tunnel wall of the tunnels mimic device；And the tunnel equipment gradient can be adjusted.Energy simcity underground traffic contact tunnel fire disaster fume characteristic and detection performance of the invention；Research platform is provided to obtain rational Fire Smoke Control scheme and smoke discharging effect in City Underground Transportation contact tunnel.

title_en: Comprehensive evacuation support building with wing
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a foundation pile work technology and a building skeleton work technology for constructing a comprehensive evacuation building as an artificial high platform, in preparation for large-scale natural disasters such as earthquake, tsunami and others caused by global warming.SOLUTION: A comprehensive evacuation building adopts a foundation pile work using a hollow tubular pile driven by a rotary drill and an ALC plate method, and therefore may be completed promptly. The hollow tubular pile driven by a rotary drill comprises a tip part s and an intermediate joining tube r. When the pile is driven from a ground surface p to a bedrock t, soil remains in the hollow part and only the hollow tube is buried deep underground. This eliminates the need for removing a large volume of surplus soil. Together with the ALC plate method that uses ALC plates volume-produced elsewhere, both the construction time and labor may be saved.

title_en: The cast-in-place anchor construction head of bore liquid companding large netting cage and its construction method
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of cast-in-place anchor construction head of bore liquid companding large netting cage reinforced for natural slope or Artificial Side-slope and its construction method.The drilling construction head carry iron wire cylinder mould is after drilling side slope face to set depth, when drill bit is above carried, and can carry out expanded support to neighbouring iron wire cylinder mould by the hydraulic top fastener at head four sides of constructing.So as to greatly increase the anchoring area and reinforcement area of anchoring body, enhance the skid resistance of side slope, avoid due to geological disasters such as slope instability, the mud-rock flows that the reduction of shearing strength inside side slope or external force influence destroy side slope stress equilibrium and caused, improve the stable security of side slope.The present invention makes drilling, slip casting, lay iron wire cylinder mould and expanded support cylinder mould realize integration, can apply to nature soil-slope or newly excavates the Artificial Side-slope filled, improves factor of safety against sliding, reduces geological disaster risk.Its construction method is simple, easy to operate, efficiency high.

title_en: The method of the live danger zone of test creepage type bump immediately
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method that creepage type bump danger zone is tested at scene immediately, it is first in the heading in above-mentioned disaster region occurs for the possibility of delineation, the drilling for two horizontal directions of being constructed to coal body, first drilling installation borehole stressmeter is used to test coal body vertical stress, and second drilling installation coal body creep test system is used to test coal body creep situation；When creep occurs for second drilling, then the region drawn a circle to approve is determined as having the region that creep impact disaster occurs, and creep impact disaster will not occur for the region otherwise drawn a circle to approve.The present invention is according to Creep Mechanics principle, a kind of method that simple, easy scene judges creep bump danger zone is immediately invented, for ultra-deep mine, the intensive mining area in tunnel, soft rock and deep mining mine, the danger zone of creepage type bump can be judged comprehensively, and the danger zone delimitation to creepage type bump has positive role.

A virtual building is designed and constructed in a virtual 3D computer space, and how much a building can endure against several sorts of natural disasters such as earthquake, typhoon, etc. is simulated. Thereby, an optimal alternative construction may be selected and a rational construction plan may be established.

title_en: System and Method for Preparing and Implementing Emergency Response Plans
abstract_en: A system and computer implemented method for implementing an emergency response plan in real time includes the steps of electronically providing an emergency plan flow chart including action items that a user must progress through and complete in real time during an emergency incident, and electronically time stamping the completed action items of the emergency plan flow chart as the user progresses through the emergency plan flow chart during the emergency incident. The user can add notes to the time-stamped competed action items and can save an incident record for the emergency incident record as either an actual emergency incident or a drill.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire disaster early warning method and system. The fire disaster early warning method includes the steps that S1, the fault state of fire extinguishment equipment and the fault state of evacuation equipment in the environment are monitored in real time; S2, the crowd density in the environment is obtained, the successful crowd evacuation probability when a fire disaster occurs is simulated according to the fault state of the fire extinguishment equipment, the fault state of the evacuation equipment and the crowd density; and S3, whether the successful evacuation probability is smaller than a preset probability or not is determined, and if the successful evacuation probability is smaller than the preset probability, fire disaster early warning information is automatically sent. By means of the technical scheme, the crowd escape probability can be determined before the fire disaster occurs, the early warning information is sent in advance, and preventive measures such as measures for limiting people number, opening more entrance and exit passages and the like can be carried out; the problem that people cannot escape timely and casualties are caused when the fire disaster occurs can be avoided; besides, the shortest way can be provided for crowd evacuation, and the people can rapidly escape from the dangerous situation.

title_en: Geological forecasting method for tunnel construction in karst area
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological forecasting method for tunnel construction in a karst area. For tunnel driving of every cycle, the method comprises the steps: 1) performing infrared detection; 2) using a TSP seismic wave detecting instrument to detect; 3) using a geological radar to detect; and 4) using a horizontal drill to detect, and determining that no cave geological disasters exist only when the front rock mass does not contain caves during the four-grade detection process. Moreover, before performing the four-grade detection, a geotechnical engineering software can be used to calculate the risk that the front rock mass for tunnel construction contains caves according to the attribute of physical mechanics of the front rock mass, and the geometrical parameters of the tunnel and the rock mass, and detection of the rock mass with high risk should be focused and detection of the rock mass with low risk is ordinarily performed. The forecasting method is high in accuracy and efficiency, and is low in cost.

title_en: Metro interchange station fire disaster smoke discharge simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metro interchange station fire disaster smoke discharge simulation experiment device which consists of a metro interchange station body model and a smoke discharge system. A station hall layer smoke discharge mechanism is same as a first-floor-underground smoke discharge mechanism in structure, and each smoke discharge mechanism consists of more than three parallel smoke discharge units. Each smoke discharge unit includes more than two straight smoke pipes, more than two m-shaped smoke pipes or more than two n-shaped smoke pipes. A second-floor-underground smoke discharge mechanism comprises more than three L-shaped smoke pipes and more than two smoke pipes in shapes of Chinese characters 'feng'. Carbon monoxide concentration measurement probes, smoke flow speed measurement probes and thermocouples uniformly distributed in a station form a smoke plume flow characteristic parameter measuring mechanism. Fire disaster detection mechanisms are arranged on a ceiling of a metro tunnel. The special metro interchange station fire disaster smoke discharge simulation experiment device can be used for researching smoke optimization control schemes and fire detection characteristics when a metro interchange station fire disaster occurs.

title_en: calamity safe management system, server and method using 3-dimensional scanning
title_ko: 3차원 스캐닝을 활용한 재난 안전 관리 시스템, 서버 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system, a server, and a method for managing safety in a calamity by using 3-dimension (3D) scanning which perform calamity safety management by establishing intelligent 3D figure data for an actual object by using 3D scanning technology. The safety management method according to the present invention comprises the following steps: a 3D scanner performs a 3D scanning on the actual object to acquire 3D data for the actual object; the 3D data acquired by a calamity safety management server is analyzed, converted to intelligent 3D visualization figure data, and stored in a database for actual objects; a member terminal connects to the calamity safety management server through a network, generates a signal requesting at least one among 3D status acknowledgement, accident cause analysis, simulation, defect analysis and deformation analysis, monitoring tracking analysis, enforcement of recovery measures, and provision of service to the public, and transmits the generated request signal; and the calamity safety management server reads the intelligent 3D visualization figure data, and performs at least one among the 3D status acknowledgement, accident cause analysis, simulation, defect analysis and deformation analysis, monitoring tracking analysis, enforcement of recovery measures, and provision of service to the public.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 3차원 스캐닝 기술을 이용하여 실물 대상에 대한 지능형 3차원 입체도면 데이터를 구축하여 재난 안전 관리를 수행하도록 한 3차원 스캐닝을 활용한 재난 안전 관리 시스템, 서버 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 3차원 스캐너가 실물 대상을 3차원 스캐닝하여 실물 대상에 대한 3차원 데이터를 획득하며; 재난 안전 관리 서버가 획득한 3차원 데이터를 분석하여 지능형 3차원 시각화 도면 데이터로 변환시켜 실물 대상별로 데이터베이스에 등록하며; 회원용 단말기가 네트워크를 통해 재난 안전 관리 서버에 접속하여 3D 현황 파악, 사고 원인 분석, 시뮬레이션, 결함 분석 및 변형 분석, 모니터링 추적 분석, 복구 조치, 대국민 서비스 중 적어도 하나 이상을 요청하기 위한 신호를 생성시켜 생성된 요청 신호를 전송하며; 재난 안전 관리 서버가 요청 신호에 따라 지능형 3차원 시각화 도면 데이터를 판독해 3D 현황 파악, 사고 원인 분석, 시뮬레이션, 결함 분석 및 변형 분석, 모니터링 추적 분석, 복구 조치, 대국민 서비스 중 적어도 하나 이상을 수행한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for disaster confrontation training program operating
title_ko: 비상대응 훈련 프로그램 운영방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: A method and a system for operating an emergency training program are disclosed. The method of operating the emergency training program in the system of operating the emergency training program comprises: setting a scenario and measurement index according to emergency situation; selecting specific scenario from the scenario according to the emergency situation depending on training field; operating a simulation in accordance with the selected specific scenario; monitoring training situation according to the simulation; measuring training result by comparing result of the monitoring with the measurement index; and providing feedback based on the training result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비상대응 훈련 프로그램 운영방법 및 그 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명은, 비상대응 훈련 프로그램 운영시스템이 비상대응 훈련 프로그램을 운영하는 방법에 있어서, 비상상황별 시나리오 및 측정지표를 설정하는 단계; 훈련분야에 따라 상기 비상상황별 시나리오에서 특정 시나리오를 선정하는 단계; 상기 선정된 특정 시나리오에 따른 연출상황을 작동하는 단계; 상기 연출상황에 따른 훈련상황을 모니터링하는 단계; 상기 모니터링 결과와 상기 측정지표를 비교하여 훈련성과를 측정하는 단계; 및 상기 훈련성과를 기초로 피드백을 제공하는 단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: A Fire Extinguisher For Education
title_ko: 교육용 소화장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fire extinguisher for training. According to the present invention, the fire extinguisher includes: a fire extinguisher body which has an inner space; a head which is fixed and coupled to the upper part of the fire extinguisher body; an operating lever which is coupled to the head; and a spray pipe which has an end coupled to the head and the other end coupled to a spray pipe cover. The fire extinguisher also includes: a control unit arranged in the fire extinguisher body; a power supply unit which is arranged in the fire extinguisher body and supplies power to the control unit; an LED lamp unit which is arranged in the spray pipe cover and provides a fire extinguishing light by using the power supply from the power supply unit; an operation unit which is arranged in the fire extinguisher and on the lower end of the head and turns the power supply to the LED lamp unit on or off according to the operation of the operating level; and a connection wire which connects the power supply unit, control unit, LED lamp unit, and operation unit respectively. Light from the LED lamp is emitted when a trainee operates the fire extinguisher handle to be used instead of fire extinguishing powder or a fire extinguishing agent such as water in order to perform a fire extinguishing training session in an indoor environment.

title_en: Method for reducing facility in tunnel construction by using drilling hole
title_ko: 천공홀을 이용한 터널 설비 축소방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tunnel construction method. The tunnel construction method comprises: a first facility connection step of installing a facility to supply water, draining water, and supplying power on one end of both tunnel mouths wherein a tunnel is excavated; a first excavation step of excavating a first section, which is a section from the one end, where the facility is installed in the first facility connection step to a penetration unit which is a point in between one end of the tunnel and an other end of the tunnel; a hole drilling step of drilling a through hole penetrating a second section which is a section from the penetration unit of the tunnel to the other end of the tunnel on one side of a surface into which the tunnel is excavated; a second facility connection step of connecting a facility line connected to the facility installed in the first facility connection step to the other end of the tunnel through the through hole formed in the hole drilling step; and a second excavation step of using the facility line connected in the second facility connection step to excavate the second section of the tunnel to penetrate the tunnel.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 터널 시공방법에 관한 것으로 터널이 굴착되는 양 갱구부 중 일단부에 급수, 배수 및 전력공급을 위한 설비가 설치되는 제1 설비연결 단계; 상기 제1 설비연결 단계에서 상기 설비가 설치된 상기 일단부로부터 상기 터널의 일단부 및 타단부 사이의 지점인 관통부까지의 구간인, 제1 구간을 굴착하는 제1 굴착 단계; 상기 터널이 굴착되는 면의 일측에, 상기 터널의 상기 관통부로부터 상기 터널의 상기 타단부까지의 구간인, 제2 구간을 관통하는 관통홀을 천공하는 천공 단계; 상기 제1 설비연결 단계에서 설치된 상기 설비와 연결되는 설비라인을, 상기 천공 단계에서 형성된 상기 관통홀을 통해 상기 터널의 타단부까지 연결하는 제2 설비연결 단계; 및 상기 제2 설비연결 단계에서 연결된 상기 설비라인을 이용하여 상기 터널의 상기 제2 구간을 굴착하여 상기 터널을 관통시키는 제2 굴착 단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire-fighting system of vessel and method for supplying fire water thereof
title_ko: 선박의 소방 시스템 및 이를 이용한 소방수 공급 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting system of a vessel and a method for supplying fire water using the same. The firefighting system of a vessel comprises: a firefighting pipe installed to supply fire water to a plurality of areas; and a plurality of firefighting pumps to supply the fire water of a flow amount and a pressure required for each area to the firefighting pipe. The firefighting system of a vessel and a method for supplying fire water using the same in accordance with the present invention divides a fire case into areas such as a drill floor and a heli-deck to arrange the firefighting pumps to satisfy the flow amount and the pressure of the fire water required for a corresponding area to quickly supply an increased flow amount of the fire water in comparison to a previous flow amount (e.g., twice the previous flow amount) to the corresponding area to satisfy an element of an improved firefighting rule. Power is efficiently supplied to the firefighting pumps to stably operate the firefighting system.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 구역으로 소방수를 공급하도록 설치되는 소방배관; 및 상기 소방배관에 상기 구역 마다 필요로 하는 유량과 압력의 소방수를 각각 공급하도록 다수로 설치되는 소방펌프;를 포함하도록 한 선박의 소방 시스템 및 이를 이용한 소방수 공급 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 선박의 소방 시스템 및 이를 이용한 소방수 공급 방법은 화재 케이스를 드릴 플로어(drill floor)와 헬리 데크(heli-deck) 등과 같은 구역별로 구분하여, 해당 구역 각각에서 요구되는 소방수의 유량 및 압력에 맞도록 소방펌프를 각각 배치함으로써, 기존 대비 증가된 소방수 유량, 예컨대 기존 대비 2배의 소방수 유량을 해당 구역으로 각각 신속하게 공급할 수 있도록 하고, 이로 인해 개선된 소방 룰에 대한 사항을 만족시키도록 할 뿐만 아니라, 소방펌프에 대한 전력공급이 원활하도록 하여 소방 시스템의 안정적인 운영을 가능하도록 한다.

title_en: disaster simulation apparatus
title_ko: 재난상황 연출 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster simulation apparatus for disaster management drill. The disaster simulation apparatus of the present invention comprises: a smoke simulation device generating simulation smoke; a flame simulation device; and a case accommodating the smoke simulation device and the flame simulation device. The smoke simulation device can be a fog machine, whereas the flame simulation device can be one which generates actual or fake flames. The apparatus of the present invention also comprises a controller which controls the smoke simulation device and the flame simulation device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재단대응 훈련을 위한 재난상황 연출 장치에 관한 것이다. 재난상황 연출 장치는 연출 연기를 발생시키는 연기 연출 장치와, 화염 연출 장치와, 연기 연출 장치 및 상기 화염 연출 장치를 수용하는 케이스를 포함한다. 연기 연출 장치는 포그 머신일 수 있다. 화염 연출 장치는 실제 화염을 만드는 장치일 수 있고, 모조 화염을 만드는 장치일 수 있다. 연기 연출 장치와 화염 연출 장치를 제어하는 제어기를 포함한다.

title_en: Method for increasing wetting radius of high-pressure water injection of low-air-permeability coal seams through sectioned pre-splitting
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for increasing the wetting radius of high-pressure water injection of low-air-permeability coal seams through sectioned pre-splitting. The method comprises the steps that a drilling machine drills pre-splitting drill holes with the same depth as high-pressure water injection drill holes in two sides of each original high-pressure water injection drill hole of a pre-mining coal seam of a working face gate roadway, wherein one high-pressure water injection drill hole and the corresponding pre-splitting drill holes in the two sides form a coal seam weakening and permeability-improving unit; the weakening and permeability-improving operation is carried out on one coal seam weakening and permeability-improving unit firstly, a pre-splitting device in the corresponding pre-splitting drill hole is withdrawn after the weakening and permeability-improving operation on the coal seam weakening and permeability-improving unit is completed, and then the weakening and permeability-improving operation is carried out on a next coal seam weakening and permeability-improving unit. By adopting the carbon dioxide phase change splitting technology, the development uniformity of fractures is guaranteed, the wetting radius of high-pressure water injection of coal seams poor in water injection performance can be increased remarkably, and therefore the property of the coal seams is changed, the quantity of generated dust of a work surface is lowered, and the danger of disaster accidents such as coal and gas outburst and rock burst is lowered.

title_en: It is a kind of based on the system self-repairing method drilled automatically and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of based on the system self-repairing method drilled automatically and device, comprising the following steps: A, the automatic rehearsal of log-on data backup report an error, obtain the characteristic information of the mistake；B, according to the characteristic information of the mistake got, database is inquired, finds the solution for solving the mistake；C, solution is executed, mistake is repaired, continues to execute data backup and drill automatically.The present invention provides a kind of system self-repairing method and device based on automatic rehearsal technology, this method and device intelligent and high-efficiency repair experience according to the system of staff, are defined as intelligent database, it is built into the mechanism of being automatically repaired, keeps data disaster tolerance drilling system more intelligence reliable.

title_en: Emergency evacuation simulation plan programming method and emergency evacuation simulation plan programming system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency evacuation simulation plan programming method which comprises the steps of establishing a population dynamic distribution rule database of a dense-population area and a key disaster preventing area; establishing a disaster type database according to different disaster types; correlating the population dynamic distribution rule database with the disaster type database, establishing an emergency evacuation simulation plan knowledge base; and after a disaster occurs, obtaining the emergency evacuation simulation plan with highest population distribution matching degree and highest disaster type matching degree from the emergency evacuation simulation plan knowledge base through real-time population distribution data. The invention further relates to an emergency evacuation simulation plan programming system. The emergency evacuation simulation plan programming method and the emergency evacuation simulation plan programming system have advantages of improving efficiency in an optimal evacuation simulation plan planning process, reducing programming time and obtaining higher practicability.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: Device of training ability of fleing when disaster takes place
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device of training ability of fleing when disaster takes place, relates to the equipment of fleing field, including passway for escaping and training institution, the passway for escaping sets up the ramp, and the ramp both sides set up the handrail, the training institution includes the host computer, eight goes into eight serial ports IO cards, correlation type laser switch sensors and send ware, correlation type laser switch sensor receiver, stereo set, dry ice nebula, mirror surface retroreflecting type laser switch sensor and send ware, mirror surface retroreflecting type laser switch sensor receiver, trains reinforcing user's the respond when the disaster happen suddenly, judgment ability and the ability of fleing, increase user's existence probability through the device to the user.
assignees: ANHUI SUNSHINE SAILING ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Training system for treating disaster using virtual reality and role playing game
title_ko: 가상현실과 rpg을 활용한 재난상황 대처 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a training system for preparing against disaster using virtual reality and RPG, more particularly relates to an effective system for setting various disasters in virtual reality, realizing a training program system for preparing against accident and using the training program system. A variable platform apparatus for a training simulator based on the virtual reality of the present invention comprises: a contents operation unit for managing various training contents corresponding to real working environment and determining a scenario for training contents to be operated by the training simulator based on the virtual reality; an image output unit for providing training contents selected by a user with a stereoscopic image by using an augmented reality technique; a user working tool unit for supporting one or more feedbacks from a visual sense, auditory sense, touch sense and smell sense so that the user can feel the same as in the real working environment according to the scenario of the training contents determined by the contents operation unit, based on a working tool similar to a working tool used in the real world; and a tracking unit for tracking in real time the user and working environment condition and generating input information of the training simulator based on the virtual reality according to the tracking result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실과 RPG을 활용한 재난상황 대처 교육 시스템에 관한 것으로, 각종 재난상황을 가상현실로 설정하고 이에 대하여 안전사고에 대처할 수 있는 교육프로그램 시스템을 구현하고 이를 활용하는 보다 효과적인 시스템에 관한 것이다. 이를 위한 본 발명은 가상현실 기반 훈련 시뮬레이터를 위한 가변형 플랫폼 장치에 관한 것으로서, 실제의 작업환경에 상응하는 다양한 훈련 컨텐츠를 관리하며, 상기 가상현실 기반 훈련 시뮬레이터에서 운영될 훈련 컨텐츠의 시나리오를 결정하는 컨텐츠 운영부; 상기 사용자에 의해 선택된 훈련 컨텐츠를 증강현실 기법을 이용하여 입체영상으로 제시하는 영상 출력부; 실제 작업에서 사용되는 작업 도구와 유사한 작업 도구를 기반으로, 상기 컨텐츠 운영부에서 결정된 훈련 컨텐츠의 시나리오에 따라 사용자가 실제의 작업환경에서 느끼는 감각을 느낄 수 있도록 시각, 청각, 촉각, 및 후각중 하나 이상의 감각 피드백을 지원하는 사용자 작업도구부; 및 사용자 및 작업 환경 상태를 실시간으로 추적하여 상기 가상현실 기반 훈련 시뮬레이터의 입력 정보를 생성하는 트래킹부를 구비하는, 가상현실 기반 훈련 시뮬레이터를 위한 가변형 플랫폼 시스템이다.

title_en: Apparatus for training fire fighting education and evaction guide including fire extinguisher and fireplug simulator
title_ko: 소화기/소화전 시뮬레이터를 포함한 자동 소방교육 훈련 및 피난안내 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic fire fighting education/training and evacuation guidance apparatus including a fire extinguisher/fire hydrant simulator. The automatic fire fighting education/training and evacuation guidance apparatus (10) including the fire extinguisher/fire hydrant simulator (15) according to the present invention comprises a display and sound output unit (11), a program type control unit (12), and a training equipment unit (13), wherein the training equipment unit (13) includes a main body training equipment unit (14) and the fire extinguisher/fire hydrant simulator (15). The main body training equipment unit (14) includes a sensor unit (14-1), which includes a volume measurement sensor (14-1a) and a fire point measurement sensor (14-1b) corresponding to at least one sensor controlled by the program type control unit (12). The fire extinguisher/fire hydrant simulator (15) includes at least one experience training equipment unit (15-1) corresponding to the main body training equipment unit (14). The training equipment unit (13) is used in performing fire fighting education/training using a program script (12-1) executed by the program type control unit (12). Thus, practical fire fighting education effects may be provided by using an unmanned automatic fire education/training simulation. Furthermore, the present invention gives an evaluation function to the fire fighting education/training, thereby performing self-fire fighting education.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소화기/소화전 시뮬레이터를 포함한 자동 소방교육 훈련 및 피난안내 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 디스플레이 및 음향 출력부(11), 프로그램형 제어부(12), 훈련기자재부(13)를 포함하는 소화기/소화전 시뮬레이터를 포함한 자동 소방교육 훈련 및 피난안내 장치(10)에 있어서, 훈련기자재부(13)는, 프로그램형 제어부(12)의 제어를 받는 적어도 하나 이상의 센서에 해당하는 음량 측정 센서(14-1a) 및 화점 측정 센서(14-1b)를 포함하는 센서부(14-1)를 구비한 본체 훈련기자재부(14), 그리고 본체 훈련기자재부(14)와 대응하는 하나 이상의 체험 훈련기자재부(15-1)로 구성된 소화기/소화전 시뮬레이터(15)를 포함하여, 프로그램형 제어부(12)에 의한 프로그램 스크립트(12-1)를 이용한 소방교육 훈련이 수행되는데 사용한다. 
이에 의해, 무인 자동 소방교육 훈련 시뮬레이션을 이용하여 실질적인 소방교육 효과를 제공한다.  
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 소방교육 훈련에 평가 기능을 부여하여 자체적인 소방교육을 실시할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.
assignees: OH UK JIN;JEONG IK HO;SONG HONG SEOB

title_en: Concrete material high temperature splitting testing machine, and high temperature splitting testing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a concrete material high temperature splitting testing machine, and a high temperature splitting testing method. The concrete material high temperature splitting testing machine comprises a loading device used for applying pressure on concrete test pieces, a heating device used for heating the concrete test pieces, and a displacement acquisition device used for measuring splitting deformation of the concrete test pieces. In concrete experiments, artful combination of the heating device and the loading device is realized, and the displacement acquisition device is also used, so that a comprehensive test system which can be used for concrete test piece high temperature splitting testing is formed, synchronous heating and loading is realized, and realistic simulation of the environment of concrete at fire disaster high temperature can be realized; and the results of concrete material tests using the concrete material high temperature splitting testing machine are extremely close to the results of the practical splitting performance of concrete at fire disaster high temperature, so that guarantees are provided for study on high temperature and fire-resistant performance of concrete materials.

title_en: The prevention and controls of coal body impact disaster in a kind of coal mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of prevention and controls of coal body impact disaster in coal mining, it is concretely comprised the following steps：A, coefficient of frictional resistance is determined：Tested by laboratory stick-slip and ratio calculates the coefficient of friction for determining coal body sample and roof and floor rock sample；B, field conduct relevant parameter is determined：Determine that material requested drilling size, depth and the water and Bed for Fine Coal rock dust amount of required injection or other lubriation material amounts measure friction coefficient μ so as to reduce laboratory；C, field conduct：According to experiment and gained situation is calculated, is implemented in coal body back production Qian Liang lanes；D, validity check：It is determined that increase sliding effect and determine to be again carried out increasing sliding measure relevant parameter according to monitoring effect.When roof and floor is to press the relative adjoining rock of coal body can slide, the elasticity reduced in coal body can be gathered, so as to will effectively weaken or eliminate coal body sliding unstability or crush the odds impacted.

title_en: Tester simulating soaking-air drying rock cyclic action of hydro-fluctuation belt of reservoir bank slope
abstract_en: A tester simulating the soaking-air drying rock cyclic action of a hydro-fluctuation belt of a reservoir bank slope comprises a test instrument shell. A cover plate is arranged on the upper portion of the shell, a base is arranged on the lower portion of the shell, the cover plate is provided with a sampling port, a deflating bolt and a water inlet pipe, the base is provided with a water outlet pipe and connected with a water tank, a water circulating system is formed by all the components, a metal water permeable plate sample bracket is arranged in the shell, and a pressure air bag is arranged in the shell and connected with a pressure control system. A temperature control heating device is arranged on the base. A dynamic water circulation control device and a static water circulation control device are arranged at the same time, a soaking-air drying circulating device is arranged, and the rise and fall changes of the water level of a reservoir and the dissolving characteristics and the scouring action of rock in a reservoir water pressure state can be simulated. Due to a simulation experiment, a reliable test data basis can be provided for research on protection of a large reservoir bank slope and geological disaster evaluation and prediction.

title_en: Test system used for simulating a mine explosion-proof wall and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test system used for simulating a mine explosion-proof wall and a test method, and relates to the underground coal mine thermal power disaster prevention and control research field. The test system comprises a tunnel enclosed simulation device. An explosion-proof wall is installed inside the tunnel enclosed simulation device. A gas distribution subsystem mixes gas and air and pumps the mixed gas and air into the tunnel enclosed simulation device. A synchronous control subsystem controls an ignition subsystem to ignite the mixed gases of gas and air and controls a first high-speed camera to record images of the tunnel enclosed simulation device. After gas blast is finished, the synchronous control subsystem controls a transmission-type dynamic caustic test subsystem to record images of the explosion-proof wall. During the gas blast process, a data collection system obtains flame information, pressure information and displacement information of the explosion-proof wall in the tunnel enclosed simulation device. A high-speed photographing subsystem stores, processes and analyzes images recorded by the first high-speed camera and the transmission-type dynamic caustic test subsystem.

title_en: Gas abnormity desorption characteristic test device and method in coal body destruction process
abstract_en: A gas abnormity desorption characteristic test device and method in a coal destruction process comprises a transmission device, a smashing device, an air pressure device, a gas desorption measuring device and an electrical control device; the transmission device comprises a speed regulator and a drive motor; the smashing device comprises a coal sample tank and an impeller positioned in the coal sample tank; the air pressure device comprises an air pressure gauge, a tee valve and a cutoff valve; the gas desorption device comprises a plurality of gas mass flow meters of different ranges; the electrical control device is connected with the gas desorption measuring device. By smashing a coal sample into coal particles of different granularities, a pulverizing process of a coal body in a coal and gas outburst process is simulated, desorption volume and desorption rate of the coal sample under different granularities are measured, a gas abnormity desorption rule in the coal and gas outburst process is tested and a theoretical basis is provided for gas disaster control of a coal mine.

title_en: PCB package library structure and packaging method
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention disclose a PCB package library structure and a packaging method, and solve the technical problem of unsafe hidden dangers caused by the case that due to continuous tin short circuiting of wave soldering, PCB short circuiting is caused and a PCB is burnt out so as to enable a product not to be released on time, and even short circuiting is caused and the PCB is on fire to cause a fire disaster . The PCB package library structure disclosed by the embodiments of the present invention comprises a plurality of drill holes for inserting welding ends or pins of components, wherein a circle of coordinate deviated wave peak bonding pad is arranged on the periphery of each drill hole; and a distance between the wave peak bonding pads between the peripheries of every two adjacent drill holes is not less than 1 mm.

title_en: Portable lifesaving protection headgear of fleing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable lifesaving protection headgear of fleing, involves the disaster lifesaving, flees to equip and makes and water sports protection equipment manufacturing field. Be applicable to the perils of the sea, conflagration, car fall into water, lifesaving that personnel slipped and fell into the water with flee, especially the car falls into water and flees, the lifesaving also is applicable to and begins to learn the swimming training simultaneously, water sports and the soldier of army cross a river, take the protection of landing the action in the island by force. Characterized by: 1 connecting the waterproof soft transparent headgear body to N stereoplasm frame body and constituting the gas storage cavity, there is an air duct headgear body bottom, and the air duct link bit can communicate with each other with the external world in closed air guide hole in headgear body upper portion, and headgear body lower part is the waterproof neck of the elasticity cover body. The beneficial effects are that: shrink portable gas storage cavity isolative protection design, do not account for the space, be favorable to fleing for one's life, life saving equipment's popularization, gas storage cavity head isolative protection's the design of fleing for one's life has in addition improved greatly and to have swum the drowning probability of fleing for one's life of swimmer's automobile.

title_en: Mountain torrents risk analysis system based on unmanned aerial vehicle liDAR technique
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mountain torrents risk analysis system based on unmanned aerial vehicle liDAR technique relates to mountain torrents risk analysis technical field. The utility model discloses an use the unmanned aerial vehicle data acquisition system of lift -launch laser radar scanning apparatus's unmanned aerial vehicle constitution, the point cloud data that to gather and image data pass through the ground satellite station to be transmitted to command center, generate high accuracy DEM achievement fast at command center, high accuracy DOM achievement, three -dimensional model, cross -section profile is indulged in the river course, can reduce artifical field process volume, and the quick drawing and the management of realization flood risk picture, supply further to do flood simulation forecast and the aassessment of disaster statistics, and the working efficiency is raised remarkably, guarantee to accomplish in time more reliably the work of mountain torrents risk analysis.
assignees: CHINA SCIENCES MAPUNIVERSE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power plant accident integrated action system
title_ko: 원전사고 통합 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system which can generally cope with nuclear accidents. An accident scenario is generated by using a variable as the kind and environment of nuclear accidents. An emergency response procedure is established. An emergency response plan for supporting decision making according to the accident scenario is provided. Also, the exposure limitation of the on-site disaster prevention agent is estimated by not only on-site risk assessment but also off-site risk assessment. And then, a workload is set. So, the safety of the on-site disaster prevention agent can be supported.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원전사고에 통합적으로 대응할 수 있는 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 원전사고의 종류 및 환경을 변수로 사고 시나리오를 생성하고 비상대응절차를 수립하며, 사고 시나리오에 따른 의사결정을 지원할 수 있는 비상대응방안을 제공한다. 또한, 소외 위험도 평가뿐만 아니라 소내 위험도 평가를 통해 소내 방재요원의 피폭한계치를 산정하고 작업량을 설정함으로써 소내 방재요원의 안전을 지원할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Underground modular transformation centre that is resistant to disasters and adverse conditions
abstract_en: An underground modular transformation centre that is resistant to disasters and adverse conditions, having a transformer without fins. The tank has electrical connection outlets in the lower lateral zones. This tank is also provided with piping in which holes are drilled, positioned in diametrically opposing points inside the tank, and threading on the external part thereof protruding from the tank. Also provided are threaded casings on the lateral panel of the tank in order to accommodate temperature detectors.

title_en: Disaster recovery system simulation method, program, and simulation apparatus
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make it possible to beforehand simulate server specifications required to implement the virtualization of disaster recovery system configuration and server consolidation rate as well as periods required for system construction, and approximate costs.SOLUTION: A disaster recovery system simulation method comprises: acquiring input information for simulation; specifying, from a storage unit, a template including disaster recovery system configuration information, and period information and cost information required for system construction, on the basis of input targeted recovery time information and targeted recovery time point information; calculating the specifications of the server resources in the disaster recovery system, using the specified template information, the input server resource specifications information of the disaster recovery object system, the average use rates of the server resources, and the input overcommitment rates of the server resources corresponding to server consolidation rates; and outputting the information of the calculated specifications and the template information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Comprehensive tunnel drainage, precipitation and pressure reduction construction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive tunnel drainage, precipitation and pressure reduction construction method, relates to an in-tunnel drainage, ground precipitation and comprehensive pressure reduction construction method for a water and mud burst segment of a tertiary system sand shale tunnel and is mainly designed to solve the problems that an existing tunnel is prone to deformation, collapse and even water burst and mud burst in the tertiary system sand shale construction process. Ground precipitation wells are drilled at the positions, eight meters away from the side lines on the two sides, of a ground-direction positive hole, a flat guide hole is formed near the ground-direction positive hole, a drainage hole is formed in the inclined upper direction of the ground-direction positive hole relative to the flat guide hole, tunnel substrate precipitation wells are drilled in both the substrate of the ground-direction positive hole and the substrate of the flat guide hole, a plurality of inclined drainage holes are formed above the inclined front portion of a vault of the ground-direction positive hole, a positive hole vertical drainage hole is formed above the vault of the ground-direction positive hole, and a flat guide hole vertical drainage hole is further formed above the vault of the flat guide hole. The comprehensive tunnel drainage, precipitation and pressure reduction construction method has the advantages that geological disasters such as collapse, deformation, water burst and mud burst are avoided, and tunnel construction safety can be guaranteed.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 19TH BUREAU GROUP 2ND CO LTD

title_en: Fire passing testing method of shield tunnel segment lining connector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire passing testing method of a shield tunnel segment lining connector. The fire passing testing method comprises the following steps: preparing segments for a fire passing test; establishing a testing platform; and carrying out the fire passing test. By considering that a lining structure of a shield tunnel is formed by splicing the prefabricated segments through bolts, a real shield tunnel lining structure is simulated and then transferred to a laboratory to be subjected to a prototype fire disaster test, so that the reliability of results can be guaranteed, the operation also can be simplified and testing cost is saved.

title_en: Emotion classification model training and textual emotion polarity analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an emotion classification model training and textual emotion polarity analysis method and system. The emotion classification model training method comprises the steps that data are acquired from a corpus so that original data are obtained; the original data are preprocessed so that preprocessed data are obtained; word vectors are extracted from the preprocessed data through a neural network model; the word vectors are fused according to preset fusion rules so that sentence vector characteristics are generated; and an emotion classification model is trained according to the sentence vector characteristics so that the trained emotion classification model is obtained. The neural network model is adopted, the words are expressed by low-dimensional spatial vectors, the low-dimensional spatial word vectors are fused into the sentence vector characteristics according to the preset rules, and the emotion classification model is obtained by certain learning models through training so that word vector dimension can be effectively reduced, the dimensions disaster problem can be avoided, correlative attributes between the words can be mined and vector semantic accuracy can be enhanced.

title_en: Disaster data processing system based on cloud computation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster data processing system based on cloud computation. In order to realize efficient processing of disaster data and effective integration of resources of research institutions, a disaster data processing solution based on a cloud computation technology is designed. Aiming at realizing the scheme, a resource abstraction manner based on a resource pool and a health examination and load balance cooperation mechanism are provided; a project result shows that in a processing process of the disaster data, the cloud computation technology embodies a lot of advantages; the efficiency of distributed parallel computation can be realized and a complicated process of distributed arrangement is also avoided; the computation efficiency of disaster simulation and a response speed of disaster treatment are improved, and available computer resources of scientific research institutions can also be effectively integrated and utilized; meanwhile, the specific practice and application of the cloud computation technology are explored at the same time.
assignees: TIANJIN ACAD FOR INTELLIGENT RECOGNITION TECH

title_en: Firefighting training apparatus
abstract_en: In this firefighting training apparatus in which a gas discharge pipe 4 is immersed in water stored in a storage part 1a of a device body 1, and combustion gas discharged into the water from the gas discharge pipe 4 and floating above the water surface is combusted, a plurality of gas burners 7 are provided in the storage part 1a. Each gas burner 7 is configured such that the height of combustion flame rising from the gas burner 7 is higher than the combustion flame of combustion gas floating on the water surface.

title_en: Large-deformation vane shear rheological test system for simulating debris flow initiation
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-deformation vane shear rheological test system for simulating debris flow initiation. The large-deformation vane shear rheological test system comprises a material source tank, a precipitation system arranged above the material source tank and used for spraying water to the material source tank, a multi-physical-quantity monitoring system arranged in the material source tank, a vane shear rheometer extending into the material source tank to stir material sources in the material source tank as well as a data acquisition and control system connected with the multi-physical-quantity monitoring system and the vane shear rheometer. The large-deformation vane shear rheological test system for simulating debris flow initiation can be applied to a large-deformation shear test of the material sources in an open condition and parametric measurement in a flowing state and is especially applicable to initiation simulation study for geological disasters such as soil landslide, debris flow and the like.

title_en: Building earthquake damage prediction method based on Beidou and vector machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building earthquake damage prediction method based on Beidou and a vector machine and relates to the technical field of building earthquake damage. The prediction method comprises the following steps: 1) obtaining building related information through a Beidou earthquake disaster monitoring system and selecting sample data from the building related information, and carrying out de-dimension and normalization pretreatment on characterization factors and the like of the building sample data; 2) dividing the sample data into training sample data and detection sample data, selecting an appropriate kernel function to carry out LOO-CV cross validation optimizing by adopting a grid search method to obtain model optimal parameters, and carrying out prediction model establishment through LVBSVM software; 3) carrying out model detection; and 4) carrying out earthquake damage forecast evaluation on actual large-area building information data through an optimal model, and carrying out classification and grading. The method improves prediction reliability, accuracy and speed, is easy to operate and is low in labor cost.

title_en: Rescue training system and rescue training result evaluation program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To respond to various training situations using parameters.SOLUTION: Provided is a rescue training system which comprises a monitoring controller, a relay device, a display controller, a disaster simulator, and trainee equipment. The monitoring controller sends a control signal for training to the display controller and the disaster simulator via the relay device. The display controller displays an image signal for training on the screen of the trainee equipment. The disaster simulator sends training implementation information and training situation information to the monitoring controller on the basis of the control signal sent from the monitoring controller.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Inclinometer tube mounting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inclinometer tube mounting device, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring. The inclinometer tube mounting device comprises a base and a stand column, wherein a through hole matched with an inclinometer tube is arranged in the base; the stand column is arranged at one side of the through hole; a clamping mechanism is arranged on the stand column; and the clamping mechanism can be used for clamping the inclinometer. According to the inclinometer tube mounting device, the through hole in the base corresponds to a pre-drilled inclinometer borehole; a clamp handle of the clamping mechanism is fixed on the stand column in a sleeeving mode; the inclinometer tube is clamped by a split type circular-ring-shaped clamp body of the clamping mechanism; the split type circular-ring-shaped clamp body can clamp the inclinometer tube through a spring between the clamp handle and a handle; the handle is loosened for slowly dropping one section of the inclinometer tube and then clamping the inclinometer tube; and one section of the inclinometer tube is spliced above until the inclinometer tube drops to the bottom of the inclinometer borehole. The inclinometer tube mounting device has the advantages of being simple in structure, quick and convenient to operate, can guarantee accuracy and safety in a dropping process of the inclinometer tube, can improve the mounting efficiency of the inclinometer tube, and also can avoid problems such as dropping, bending and the like of the inclinometer tube.

title_en: A kind of the wet type drilling cuttings method test macro and test method of coal mine dynamic disaster
abstract_en: A kind of the wet type drilling cuttings method test macro and test method of coal mine dynamic disaster, belong to coal mine dynamic disaster monitoring device field.It is characterized by comprising the drilling equipments for carrying out wet boring to coal seam, and to the equipment for separating liquid from solid that water, the coal mixtures that drilling equipment drills are separated by solid-liquid separation, the equipment for separating liquid from solid includes power unit and drives the rotating separation mechanism of rotation by power unit.Include the following steps: step a, selectes monitoring region；Step b carries out wet boring；Step c is collected the mixture of coal dust and water；Step d, is separated by solid-liquid separation；Step e weighs and records coal dust weight；Step f, data analysis.In the wet type drilling cuttings method test macro of this coal mine dynamic disaster, even if the natural moisture content in coal seam is higher, drilling cuttings method also can be used, the dynamic disaster degree of danger in coal seam is identified, to eliminate security risk, be conducive to the safety in production of coal mine.

title_en: A kind of monitoring device and method of fault tectonic stress
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of fault tectonic stress monitoring method and monitoring device, wherein the fault tectonic stress monitoring method includes mount stress sensor, prefabricated tomography, applies load, determines tomography buckling critical stress, theoretical value and experiment value comparative analysis and obtain tomography unstable precursors information；The tomography monitor for stress includes tomography analog simulation test platform and tomography strain gauge.The present invention monitors the direct stress and shear stress on fault plane by the strain gauge being installed vertically on fault plane；By building fault mechanics model, functional relation on computed tomography face between direct stress and shear stress and horizontal load and vertical load, analyze the error between experiment value and theoretical value, determine critical stress value during tomography unstability, for the study of fault slip unstability induction dynamic disaster such as rock burst and bump is provided fundamental basis in Geotechnical Engineering and mining engineering subject field and experimental data supports, precursor information is provided to predict and preventing and treating dynamic disaster.

title_en: A kind of inverted pendulum control method based on neural network and intensified learning
abstract_en: A kind of inverted pendulum control method based on neural network and intensified learning of the present invention is related to a kind of neural network and nitrification enhancement, can carry out self study, complete, to the control device of inverted pendulum, to belong to artificial intelligence and control technology field, it is characterised in that：Step 1:Obtain reversible pendulum system model information；Step 2：The status information of inverted pendulum is obtained, neural network is initialized；Step 3：Using training sample SAM, the training to ELM is completed；Step 4：Inverted pendulum is controlled by intensified learning controller；Step 5：Update training sample and BP neural network；Step 6：Check that control result checks whether to meet study end condition, if not satisfied, then being continued cycling through back to step 2.Otherwise terminate algorithm.This method can solve the problems, such as " dimension disaster " that easily occurs in continuous state space, effectively solve the control problem of the nonlinear system with continuous state, have faster renewal speed.

title_en: Dynamic data driven modeling and simulation method for crowd evacuation and transportation behaviors in sudden-onset disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic data driven modeling and simulation method for crowd evacuation and transportation behaviors in a sudden-onset disaster. According to the method, real-time disaster information is acquired by analyzing high resolution remote sensing images, a simulation model of a landslide and other natural disasters is used for outputting virtual data about disaster evolution, a crowd simulation platform describes individual behaviors on a disaster circumstance, and then real-time online modeling of the landslide disaster is achieved. A decision is made for the individual behaviors according to environment information by describing individuals through several different attributes and defining several different environment description attributes. Experiments prove that through the method, better crowd evacuation efficiency and availability are achieved in an actual rescue activity in the landslide and other natural disasters.

title_en: Mining foam fluid material characteristic testing arrangement that prevents putting out a fire
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining foam fluid material characteristic testing arrangement that prevents putting out a fire, including over -and -under type perfusion device, model test frame, filling medium model and monitoring devices, over -and -under type perfusion device is connected with the model test frame, and a hidden high temperature burning things which may cause a fire disaster point and a plurality of soil pressure meter, thermocouple are buried underground in arranging the model test frame in to the filling medium model in the filling medium model, soil pressure meter, thermocouple pass through the wire and link to each other with the outer detecting system of model test frame. The utility model discloses the device only needs to accomplish a simulation experiment, just can accomplish foam fluid prevent the putting out a fire survey of the three index of characteristic simultaneously, including seepage flow law, the characteristic of lowering the temperature and leaking stoppage wind characteristic, greatly reduced measurement experiment device's loaded down with trivial details nature to be equipped with in the device and conceal high temperature burning things which may cause a fire disaster point, can simulate and determine out the cooling effect of foam fluid to concealing the burning things which may cause a fire disaster.

title_en: Using a network bubble across multiple hosts on a disaster recovery site for fire drill testing of a multi-tiered application
abstract_en: A DR site is maintained containing multiple VMs distributed across multiple hosts to which a multi-tiered application can be failed over from a production site. A network bubble is created in which the multi-tiered application can be fire drill tested without conflicting with the production instance. Each VM is cloned, and cloned VMs communicate using private IP addresses. A virtual switch is created on each host, and configured for cloned VM communication. On each host, a virtual router is configured with both a public virtual adapter and a private virtual adapter. The source VMs communicate using public IP addresses over the physical channel, via the external virtual switches on the hosts, and are available for failover from the production site. The cloned VMs communicate using private IP addresses via the virtual switches and private virtual adapters of the virtual routers, thereby forming the network bubble.

title_en: Karst analogue means that sinks

title_en: Layered pre-splitting blasting method for reducing coal mine thick and hard stratum breaking disaster-causing risks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a layered pre-splitting blasting method for reducing coal mine thick and hard stratum breaking disaster-causing risks. The method can reduce coal mine thick and hard roof breaking disaster-causing risks. The method includes the following steps that a stone drift is excavated in a thick and hard stratum covering a coal seam, a plurality of parallel drilled holes are drilled through a drilling device by means of stone drift work space, then the parallel drilled holes are filled with explosives, detonators and other blasting devices, then drilled hole blocking and blasting network connection are conducted, and finally, the explosives are detonated in a simultaneous blasting detonation mode so that pre-cracks can be generated between blast holes. Layered pre-splitting blasting of the thick and hard stratum is achieved by means of the horizontal parallel drilled holes in the simultaneous blasting mode, the technology is simple, operability is high, thick and hard roof harm can be eliminated, and safe production of a coal mine is achieved.

title_en: Sensible fire tranining simulation system
title_ko: 체감형 소방훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an interactive fire drill simulation system. More specifically, the present invention relates to an interactive fire drill simulation system in which a person, who intends to experience fire fighting, uses a fire extinguisher on a fire image outputted on a screen by an image output unit. The interactive fire drill simulation system includes the fire extinguisher having a laser emitting unit for emitting a laser at the fire image; a photographing unit for photographing the image at which the laser is emitted; a control device for controlling, overall, the interactive fire drill simulation system; a hot air blower adjusting the strength of heat according to the size of a flame image displayed on the fire image, and jetting out the heat; and a lighting unit for adjusting brightness according to the size of the flame image.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 체감형 소방훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 영상 출력부가 스크린에 출력하는 화재 영상에 화재 진압을 체험 하고자 하는 체험자가 소화기를 이용한 체감형 소방훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템에 있어서, 화재 영상에 레이져를 조사하기 위한 레이져 조사부가 구비된 소화기, 상기 레이져가 조사된 영상을 촬영하는 촬영부, 체감형 소방훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템의 전반적인 제어를 하는 제어 장치, 상기 화재 영상에 표시된 화염 영상의 크기에 따라서 열기의 세기를 조절하여 분사하는 열풍기 및 상기 화염 영상의 크기에 따라 밝기가 조절 되는 조명부를 포함하는 체감형 소방훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Interaction apparatus for rescue information and method using the same
title_ko: 구조정보 인터랙션 장치 및 이를 이용한 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a rescue information interaction apparatus and a method using the same capable of totally analyzing information of a special disaster site by accurately obtaining the information of the special disaster site and capable of rapidly delivering an accurate command through an unified communication system. The rescue information interaction system comprises: a data obtaining unit to receive situation information of a rescuer for a rescuer measured from a terminal given to a plurality of rescuers, photographed images, and situation information for a rescue target inputted from the terminal and to obtain site information for a rescue site from an external apparatus; a control unit to write a list of the rescue target based on information obtained from the data obtaining unit, to match a rescuable rescuer with a rescue target included in the list based on position information of the rescuer, the position information of the rescue target, and the environmental information included in the situation information obtained from the terminals, and to deliver the situation information of the rescue target matched with the rescuer and a simulation execution result to the rescuer by executing a rescue simulation for each rescuer based on the situation information obtained from the terminals, the photographed image and the site information; and a display unit to display the matching result and the execution result of the control unit.
