title_en: Simulate starting test system of the ditch bed deposit under the mudstone flow disturbance of upstream
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of starting test system for simulating ditch bed deposit under the mudstone flow disturbance of upstream, including material resource case, the artificial rain simulating device being arranged on above material resource case, the upstream mud-rock flow transported simulation device for being arranged on material resource upper box part, the cross wrench shear rheology instrument being connected in material resource case, many physical quantity monitoring systems being arranged in material resource case and the TT＆C system being connected respectively with artificial rain simulating device, upstream mud-rock flow transported simulation device and cross wrench shear rheology instrument and many physical quantity monitoring systems.Starting test system of the simulation ditch bed deposit that the present invention is provided under the mudstone flow disturbance of upstream, can accurate priming and mechanism of the simulation ditch bed deposit under the mudstone flow disturbance of upstream, can reveal that in mud-stone flow disaster forming process along journey erosion.

title_en: Real-time and efficient drainage basin flood routing visual simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time and efficient drainage basin flood routing visual simulation method. The method comprises the steps that grid control sections and nodes are acquired; a river regime fitted curve is determined; an encrypted section is generated; the grid control sections and the encrypted section are processed; a node grid is generated through interpolation; a digital riverway model is generated; section water level data is acquired; a section water level matched with the digital riverway terrain grid is generated through interpolation; submerging lines of a single riverway or tree-shaped river network or annular river network are determined; the topological relation between the riverway submerging lines is built; an inundated area is determined; riverway water flow routing visual display is carried out. According to the method, the flood routing condition of a drainage basin can be displayed efficiently in real time, a continuously changing flood inundation layer can be created, the local or full-area inundated area is stereoscopically observed according to the elevation of the water surface, the superficial area and water storage of flood water surface inundation at a certain elevation can be calculated in real time for a local flood inundation region, the method directly serves drainage basin flood control and disaster reduction, and important theoretical and practical significance is achieved on disaster reduction capacity improving.

title_en: Detachable suction mooring device using the principle of suction and mothod of installing
title_ko: 석션 원리를 이용한 탈부착 가능한 석션 무어링 장치와 그 분리 및 설치 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a detachable suction mooring device using the principle of suction and an installing method thereof capable of securing the safety of floating offshore structures such as offshore plants and preventing damage which can be caused by unpredictable environmental forces in the sea when drilling and producing oil and gases. The present invention is capable of preventing damage to a floating offshore structure since it can be moved to a safe area by separating an upper suction connector connected to the floating offshore structure from a lower suction connector connected to the seabed, if an environmental force is generated predictable by the detachable mooring device, by applying the principle of suction pile anchor of the upper and lower suction connectors. Also, when drilling oil, the present invention uses the principle of suction increasing the operation rate by reducing the limits of production from seashore environments.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 석션 원리를 이용한 탈부착 가능한 석션 무어링 장치와 설치 방법에 관한 것으로, 오일 및 가스의 시추와 생산에 있어, 생산시에는 예측할 수 없는 해양의 환경 외력에 대해 해양플랜트 등의 해양 부유 구조물을 안정성 확보와 피해 방지를 위한 해양 부유 구조물의 무어링 장치와 그 분리 및 설치 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Numerical simulation method for flow slide disaster caused by instability of refuse landfill
abstract_en: The invention relates to an MPS-based numerical simulation method for a flow slide disaster caused by instability of a refuse landfill. For serious pressure vibration of an original MPS method, a source program is improved from three aspects comprising a kernel function, a Poisson pressure equation and free surface discrimination. In order to describe a non-Newtonian rheological characteristic of a flow slide disaster body, a Bingham non-Newtonian fluid constitutive relation is creatively introduced. The concept of equivalent viscosity is set up, the Bingham non-Newtonian fluid constitutive relation is converted into a variable viscosity fluid constitutive relation, and programming is carried out for implementation. An improved MPS method is provided by balancing pressure vibration and introducing the Bingham non-Newtonian fluid constitutive relation. By the method, a dynamic process of flow slide caused by instability of the refuse landfill can be accurately simulated.

Through analogue test, can provide reliable tentation data foundation for the protection of research large reservoir bank slopes and geological disasters evaluation prediction.

title_en: Collection system of radon migration parameter in coal petrography body porous medium
abstract_en: The utility model provides a collection system of radon migration parameter in coal petrography body porous medium, the device include the base, are equipped with migration passageway module on the base, and migration passageway module includes inner tube and outer tube including the sealed migration body of bilayer, migration body, and the inner tube traditional chinese clothing is filled with the coal petrography body, following the axial on the migration body and evenly being equipped with at least one eudiometer, the eudiometer is connected with multichannel survey radon gas chromatograph. The device still includes angel position control module, temperature control module and gas delivery module. The utility model discloses not only can carry out real -time collection to the migration parameter, furthest has simulated the actual environment that the radon moved under the mine moreover, has fully considered the multiple factor that influences the radon migration, ensures that the migration parameter of radon in coal petrography body porous medium of gathering has better science and practicality, has improved the radon method of surveying and has surveyed the detection precision that the coal seam conceals the burning things which may cause a fire disaster position.

title_en: Vehicular reverse osmosis water purification machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicular reverse osmosis water purification machine, include into that power pack, purification unit, medicine wash unit, drainage unit and the control unit, power pack includes booster pump, high -pressure pump, air pump, and purification unit includes milipore filter subassembly, reverse osmosis membrane modulus spare and drinking water ultraviolet disinfector, and the medicine is washed the unit and is included stop valve, pipeline, and the drainage unit includes that pipeline drainage, the drainage of ultrafiltration subassembly, reverse osmosis module drainage, pump memory log raft put, and the control unit includes PLC controller, solenoid valve, pilot lamp, the utility model discloses an energy -efficient milipore filter - reverse osmosis membrane - ultraviolet ray disinfection technique, compact structure, easy operation, mountable improve equipment's in the carriage mobility still has the drainage function simultaneously, has solved the water pollution of depositing during equipment is stopped using, and among the low temperature environment pipeline prevent frostbite and the scheduling problem is stored to the membrane module, the water quality index of producing water accords with the domestic water hygienic standard regulation, the colony that is fit for field work, military training and emergency rescue and disaster relief uses.
assignees: LINYI HI-TECH ZONE LURUN WATER PURIFICATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of combined type sub-interchange smoke diffusion research model device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of combined type sub-interchange smoke diffusion research model devices.Station hall layer module is located at the top layer of model, is attached between station hall layer module, circuit station layer module, circuit station layer module by connecting with two-way building staircase mouth.Ventilation smoke extraction system is mounted on station layer module ceiling, and air hose end installation blast regulator is simultaneously connected with wind turbine.Burning things which may cause a fire disaster/hot cigarette generating means is arranged in station layer module.During burning things which may cause a fire disaster operating mode, food tray is placed on fire-proof board and is sent into model；When setting hot cigarette operating mode, cake burns in smoke stove, and food tray is placed under smoke stove and heats, and flue gas enters smoke air passage feeding model by collecting cigarette fan housing.The present apparatus is set up using modular manner, is simple in structure, dismounting assembling is flexible, can simulate the subway platform of different structure form；Many places burning things which may cause a fire disaster operating mode in station can be simulated simultaneously, be that the fire safety evaluating of large underground transfer stop carries out performance-based assessment and analysis.

title_en: Complex crowd evacuation behavior simulation method based on self-adaption intelligent agent model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex crowd evacuation behavior simulation method based on a self-adaption intelligent agent model. The self-adaption intelligent agent model is adopted for defining four different types of attributes for each intelligent agent and can make escaping routes for each intelligent agent in a self-adaption mode according to the environment change, and therefore the self-adaption intelligent agent model has a better environmental change resisting capability. An ordinary self-adaption intelligent agent model based on a CPU platform can not deal with the complex crowd evacuation problem; a GPGPU multi-thread method based on a CUDA is adopted for developing a parallel simulation algorithm, the parallel computing thought is infused into the algorithm, and the executing efficiency of the self-adaption intelligent agent model is greatly improved while the algorithm effect is kept. Experiments prove that the method has better efficiency and usability in the actual large-scale complex crowd evacuation problem.

title_en: Material combustion experiment device capable of simulating low-pressure environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a material combustion experiment device capable of simulating a low-pressure combustion environment. The material combustion experiment device comprises a sample heating device and a pressure control device. The pressure control device can be used for regulating and controlling different atmospheric pressure environments so that combustion products of materials in different pressure environments are researched; and the device fills the technical blank of related research field, and has important meanings of reducing and controlling highland and high-altitude fire disaster accidents. The influences on changes of environment pressure in a sample combustion process are reduced through a buffering tank so that inner pressure of a quartz tube can keep basically unchanged; and the combustion products in the quartz tube can be sufficiently discharged through an exhausting fan so that gas in the buffering tank and gas in the quartz tube are sufficiently mixed, the concentration of the gases keeps consistent, and furthermore, the testing accuracy is guaranteed. A second sealing door and a thin film are arranged so that the gas pressure in the buffering tank keeps unchanged in a sample collection process, and furthermore, the combustion products can be relatively conveniently and accurately collected and tested.

title_en: Method for simulating complicated cascading failures of power grids under extreme meteorological disaster conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating complicated cascading failures of power grids under extreme meteorological disaster conditions. The method comprises the following steps: reading all the failure set lines, calculating and merging the line lengths, and calculating the total line length; selecting failure lines according to the total line length and correspondingly setting line failures; determining the time lengths and intervals of the failures and randomly generating group-occurring successive failures; setting a simulation termination criterion which comprises a splitting criterion, a power angle instability criterion and a network resolving non-convergence criterion; and carrying out time domain simulation on the generated group-occurring successive failures until a termination condition of the simulation termination criterion is satisfied. According to the method, the conventional large power grid breakdown analysis method which takes load flow calculation and line overload as basic means is expanded, and the time domain simulation of detailed models is considered, so that the disturbance factors and performance characteristics in the blackout evolution process can be reflected more comprehensively.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Emergency commanding platform based on three-dimensional landform and building model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency commanding platform based on a three-dimensional landform and building model. The emergency commanding platform integrates digitization, informatization and network technologies. Through unmanned aerial photography navigation, a satellite remote sensing image and a digital elevation model on a three-dimensional digital map, a high-altitude overlooking scene of an affected area is simulated, and information of macroscopic positions, states, quantities and the like of a landform, roads, materials, infrastructures, rescue equipment, disaster rescue personnel and victims are macroscopically presented. Disaster rescue commanding personnel can visually watch disaster-scene dynamic frames transmitted in real time through a three-dimensional electronic landform and building model graph in a commanding center hall or an on-site commanding car at first time and timely predicts disaster site situation evolution so that disaster relief forces are scientifically deployed and disaster rescue emergency commanding and scheduling are effectively performed.
assignees: TIANJIN ZHONGKE INTELLIGENT IDENTIFICATION IND TECH RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Annular shearing experimental equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention provides annular shearing experimental equipment and a test method, wherein the annular shearing experimental equipment comprises a supporting seat, a shearing box assembly positioned on the supporting seat, and a loading device for applying load to a soil sample in the shearing box assembly, wherein the loading device comprises a vertical vibration loading device and a horizontal shearing vibration loading device, and the annular shearing experimental equipment further comprises a load control device for controlling the vertical vibration loading device and/or the horizontal shearing vibration loading device to load. The vertical vibration loading device and/or the horizontal shearing vibration loading device can apply vibration loads with different frequencies and amplitudes, so that the influence of the dynamic load action on the soil body strength parameters can be favorably researched, the actual stress condition can be more favorably simulated, the stress change, the pore water pressure change, the local damage of the soil body, the liquefaction phenomenon and the like in the soil body shearing test process under the vibration load action can be favorably revealed, and the occurrence and the movement mechanism of geological disasters such as landslides and the like can be further revealed from the mechanical properties.

title_en: Wind vibration simulation method for 220kV power transmission line tower wire coupling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind vibration simulation method of a 220kV power transmission line tower wire coupling system, which comprises the following steps: step 1: establishing a finite element model of a tower line coupling system of the power transmission line; step 2: carrying out shape finding on the power transmission line tower wire coupling system; and step 3: calculating the wind load of the power transmission line tower line coupling system; and 4, step 4: calculating the damping of the tower wire coupling system of the power transmission line; and 5: wind vibration response calculation and data extraction analysis. The invention establishes a fine and accurate finite element model of the coupling system of the power transmission line, and considers the influence of structural damping during wind vibration simulation calculation; the method is suitable for analyzing the wind vibration of the power transmission line in the area with frequent wind damage, and locally reinforcing or early warning the power transmission line on the basis of the analysis so as to reduce the damage of the disaster to the minimum.
assignees: UNIV XIAN JIAOTONG;CHINA SOUTH POWER GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;CSG POWER GRID TECHNOLOGY RES CT

title_en: Disaster prevention training facility
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster prevention training facility having its roof part removed to be set on the ground and a model doll disposed below the roof part and assuming that a rescue object person is locked in a model collapsed house, and capable of cutting a roof board material by a sawtooth, and contributing to heightening of tension feeling or disaster prevention awareness at the time of disaster because the disaster prevention training facility is a model form of a building substantially similar to an actual building.SOLUTION: The disaster prevention training facility includes a base part A, a side wall part B, and a roof part C. The base part includes a square frame member 1. The side wall part includes a pair of side frame members 3 and 3 having four columnar members 2 erected at the four corners of the square frame member of the base part and a cross rail material 2a provided between the columnar members, and four wood side wall plate members 4, 4,.. arranged between the adjacent columnar members. The roof part includes a pair of square-frame shaped roof members 5 and 5 detachable from each other and foldable into gable roof shapes, wood roofboard plate materials 6, 6,.. placed on the respective roof members, and wood roof plate materials 7 and 7 arranged on the roofboard materials.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Sentiment classification method capable of combining Doc2vce with convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention requests to protect a sentiment classification method capable of combining Doc2vce with a convolutional neural network, and effectively combines the Doc2vce with the CNN (Convolutional Neural Network). For characteristic representation, the combination method considers a semantic relationship between words, solves dimensionality disasters and also considers a sequence problem between words. The CNN can make up the deficiencies of a superficial characteristic learning method through learning one deep nonlinear network structure. The representation of input data is expressed in a distributed way, so that powerful characteristic learning capability is shown, characteristic extraction and mode classification can be simultaneously carried out, and two characteristics of the spare connection and the weight sharing of the CNN model can reduce the training parameters of the network, a neural network structure becomes simple and higher in adaptation. Since the Doc2ec and the CNN are combined to process a sentiment classification problem, the accuracy of sentiment classification can be obviously improved.

title_en: Simulation system and method of evacuation crowd behavior based on grid-density-relation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation system and method of an evacuation crowd behavior based on grid-density-relation. The system comprises an evacuation scene model building unit, an evacuation scene global path planning unit, a crowd activity generation unit and a crowd simulation unit, wherein the evacuation scene model building unit is used for extracting characteristics of an evacuation scene according to structural information of the evacuation scene to obtain a three-dimensional model of the evacuation scene; the evacuation scene global path planning unit used for performing global path planning on the evacuation scene according to the three-dimensional model of the evacuation scene, and calculating global paths of all entrances in the evacuation scene; the crowd activity generation unit used for performing crowd grouping according to the quantity of all entrances, a relationship between individuals in the crowd and individual location information in the evacuation scene; and the crowd simulation unit used for calculating the real-time speed of individuals in a simulation process according to a social force model, and in the simulation process, correcting the moving speed of each individual in the same group in real time, so as to keep the advancing consistency of each group, and realize behavior simulation of the evacuation crowd.

title_en: Typhoon disaster assessment system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a typhoon disaster assessment system. The system comprises: a disaster event simulation and intensity calculation module, used for simulating generation of a random typhoon disaster event and calculating a disaster intensity of the random typhoon disaster event; an engineering module, used for establishing a plurality of vulnerability functions targeted at various disaster types and building structure systems and calculating a total loss corresponding to the random typhoon disaster event; and a loss contemplation module, used for converting the total loss corresponding to the random typhoon disaster event into an insurance loss in a preset insurance calculation manner. The system provided by the present invention provides a scientific, practical, complete and secure huge disaster loss contemplation model for huge disaster risk management, and it is especially of important reality significance to make a proposal of performing a quantified pre-assessment on the direct economical loss caused by the typhoon and storm surge.

title_en: Rope corner protection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a firefighting rescue equipment field, concretely relates to rope corner protection device. This rope corner protection device is formed by connecting multiple protection ware flexonics spare in proper order, and the protector includes the round bar and set up the end cover at the round bar both ends that the round bar uses the end cover rotatory as the axle center, the end cover lower part is equipped with the support, is equipped with the protection between this support and separates the fender. The utility model provides a rope corner protection device dependable performance has been solved current rope corner protection device and has been worn and torn greatly and the problem of rope landing, and convenient operation, safe and reliable. Rotatable through the round bar, when using the rope, round bar self rotate can further reduce and the rope between the friction, make the security of fire fighter in put out a fire, speedily carry out rescue work rescue and professional training obtain improving. Separate through the protection and keep off, prevent corner or prominence damage protector when blocking the corner, guarantee to use protection device's security, also can lengthen its service life.
assignees: PUBLICK SECURITY FIRE CONTROL FORCE COMMAND SCHOOL IN KUNMING

title_en: Medical logistic planning software
abstract_en: The present invention is a software, methods, and system for creating and editing a medical logistics simulation model and for presenting the simulation model simulated within a military or disaster relief scenario. A user interface that allows a user to enter and edit platforms and associated attributes for a simulation model. The system runs the simulation model based on user input and historical data stored in databases using the inventive software. The present invention provides an output for allowing a user to view casualty rates, patient streams, and medical requirements or any other desired aspect of the simulation model.
assignees: US OF AMERICAN AS REPRESENTED BY THE SECRETARY OF THE NAVY

title_en: Alloy material for marine drilling platform firefighting system and preparation method of alloy material
abstract_en: The invention provides an alloy material for a marine drilling platform firefighting system and a preparation method of the alloy material. The alloy material is prepared from the following raw materials: C, Mn, P, S, B, Ti, Co, Rh, Si, Cr, Ni, Mo, Ge, La, Er and the balance of Al. The preparation method comprises the following steps of: adding to-be-molten Al, Mn, Ti, Co, Rh, Cr, Ni, Mo, Ge and RE into a vacuum chamber of a water-cooling copper crucible according to a material component ratio, vacuuming, and melting at the sintering temperature of 850-880 DEG C; adding C, P, S, B and Si under a metal melting condition, performing heat preservation, and uniformly stirring; cooling to 600 DEG C under an inert gas pressurizing condition, performing heat preservation, and cooling to the room temperature, thereby obtaining a finished alloy material product for the marine drilling platform firefighting system. The product provided by the invention has good properties of rusting resistance, pressure resistance, high temperature resistance, thermal deformation resistance and light mass.

title_en: Impact-disaster control method for large-dip-angle gas-containing thick coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impact-disaster control method for a large-dip-angle gas-containing thick coal seam. The impact-disaster control method includes the steps of A, arranging gas extraction roadways, wherein the top extraction roadway and the bottom extraction roadway are arranged according to the lithologic characteristics of all layers in a stratum; B, arranging drill holes, wherein the drill holes are formed in a bottom plate of the top extraction roadway and a top plate of the bottom extraction roadway, and water injecting drill holes and gas extraction drill holes are vertically formed in the same vertical sections of the gas extraction roadways at intervals; C, extracting gas and injecting water, wherein after the drill holes are formed, the whole working-face coal seam is continuously subjected to gas extraction; after gas extraction starts, high pressure water is injected into a contact face of the coal seam and the stratum, and water injecting work is sequentially carried out according to the sequence of the water injecting drill holes; D, finishing water injecting, wherein when the water injecting pressure of a first drill hole is suddenly reduced to a low value, or the humidity of extracted gas is obviously reduced, water injecting of the drill hole is stopped, and high-pressure water injecting is continuously carried out through the next water injecting drill hole. The elastic energy in a coal and rock mass can be reduced; in addition, discharging of free-state gas can be promoted, and the content of the free-state gas in coal can be fully decreased.

title_en: Filling mining model after section-wise drilling flat bottom ore removal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mining model, in particular to a filling mining model after section-wise drilling flat bottom ore removal. The mining model comprises an overground part and an underground part, an all tailing bin and a cement bin of an upper part of a mine filling system are connected with a to-be-filled room by a filling pipeline, two filling drill holes are formed in the top of an artificial platform above the to-be-filled room, the filling pipeline is communicated with the to-be-filled room by one of the drill hole, a photoelectric demonstration system is arranged in the to-be-filled room, a ventilation way shaft is arranged on one side of the to-be-filled room and is communicated with an in-mining room and the artificial platform respectively, the in-mining room is in a salvo blasting manner with an upper section in ahead of a lower section, and the room is in a V-shaped structure. With the adoption of the technical scheme, ground pressure management is easy, and sudden-onset disasters occurring in the mining process are effectively controlled; the specific filling process is demonstrated, the specific process from the start to the end of the filling process is demonstrated with a photoelectric combined method.

title_en: Acoustic emission positioning and monitoring device and method for hydraulic fracture field of gas-containing coal body
abstract_en: A device and a method for acoustic emission positioning monitoring of a hydraulic fracture field of a coal body containing gas belong to a device and a method for preventing and controlling coal mine gas disasters and monitoring micro-earthquakes. A monitoring device: the first sealed cavity is internally connected with a second sealed cavity, the two sealed cavities are connected with a ground stress simulation module, the gas adsorption and desorption module is connected with the hydraulic fracturing module and then connected with a plunger of the second sealed cavity, and a sensor of the acoustic emission positioning monitoring module is connected to the wall of the second sealed cavity. The method comprises the following steps: installing an acoustic emission sensor, putting the coal sample into a second sealed cavity, and establishing a space coordinate system; injecting gas into the coal sample to make the coal sample fully adsorb the gas; applying confining pressure and vertical pressure to the coal sample; injecting high-pressure water with a tracing color into the coal body, starting an acoustic emission positioning monitoring system, analyzing a monitored acoustic emission signal, positioning and monitoring a coal body fracture event caused by hydraulic fracture, and realizing real-time monitoring of the evolution of a hydraulic fracture field.

title_en: Multi-node super-long deep part displacement monitoring system based on RS485 bus technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-node super-long deep part displacement monitoring system based on the RS485 bus technology.The multi-mode super-long deep part displacement monitoring system comprises N multi-mode acceleration sensor units, N 485 digital relay control units and a wireless data collecting and transmitting device, wherein N is larger than 1.The acceleration sensor units and the 485 digital relay control units are connected through 485 buses.All point positions and layer positions of deep drilling are subjected to three-dimensional static displacement measurement, N 485 digital relays control the N multi-mode acceleration sensor units in a matched mode to ensure that the current of a power supply circuit can be switched on and switch off in sequence through all the units, the current is transmitted to all acceleration sensors in sequence to the tail end of the whole string of sensors, and thus the 485 buses can be used in sequence.According to the multi-node super-long deep part displacement monitoring system and a monitoring method, deep displacement can be captured for a long term for deformation measurement, installation is easy and convenient, manufacturing cost is low, the monitoring system and the monitoring method are suitable for the situation of China and wide application, and great significance is achieved on monitoring and early-warning of geological disasters.
assignees: BROADVISION ENG CONSULTANTS;BEIJING ZHONGLIZHIYAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster simulation system, vibration input device and virtual damage output device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster simulation system, a vibration input device and a virtual damage output device.SOLUTION: The disaster simulation system for outputting information about damages due to a virtual earthquake to a virtual building includes: a vibration input device 1 including a display part 12 for displaying an image, and an input part 11 for receiving an input showing vibrations to the virtual building due to the virtual earthquake; and a virtual damage output device 2 having an output part 22 for outputting information about damages. The diaster simulation system includes virtual building display means for displaying an image showing the virtual building in the display part 12, strength determination means for determining the strength of vibrations on the basis of the input received by the input part 11, comparison means for comparing vibration strength showing the strength determined by the strength determination means with preset strength reference, and damage output means for outputting information about damages based on a comparison result by the comparison means from the output part 22.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method based on affinity propagation clustering and sparse multiple kernel learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hyperspectral image classification method based on affinity propagation clustering and sparse multiple kernel learning to mainly solve a problem that technologies of the prior art are low in hyperspectral image classification performance. A technical solution is that training samples in all wave bands are used for constructing a kernel matrix set, an affinity propagation method is used for clustering, and a kernel matrix subset which is high in discriminability and low in redundancy is selected; by using the kernel matrix subset which is selected, kernel weight and support vector coefficients can be learned via a sparse-constrained multiple kernel learning method; unknown hyperspectral images can be classified via a learned classifier. According to the hyperspectral image classification method, the multiple kernel learning method is adopted, a plurality kinds of kernels that are different in function and parameter are used, complex hyperspectral data having changeable local distribution can be processed, high-precision hyperspectral image classification results can be obtained, and the hyperspectral image classification method can be applied to discrimination of surface features in the fields of agriculture monitoring, geological exploration, disaster environment assessment and the like.

title_en: I-sop system for hazardous materials handling and incident management
title_ko: 위험물 취급 및 사고 관리 용 동적 상호 자기학습형 인공지능 표준 행동 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an interactive standard operating procedures (I-SOP) system for handling hazardous materials and accident management. The I-SOP system of the present invention comprises: an I-SOP database which collects data of overall handling of disaster accidents and experiences of relevant institution workers, and stores a uniform standard operating procedure prescribed by check lists according to a disaster handling step; a disaster responding process which produces an activity diagram with the type of disasters and the lowest level for each response level; an operating procedure producing unit which produces a fused uniform operating procedure; and an I-SOP producing unit which provides process segments for users in the order granted within each category depending on an input situation in a disaster. The system can implement an I-SOP for handling disasters for each hazardous material on a mobile device, according to a handling record of hazardous materials, a response scenario when the materials leak, and a data access and a use system of material information reserved in institutions.
abstract_ko: 위험물 취급 및 사고 관리 용 동적 상호 자기학습형 인공지능 표준 행동 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 인공지능 표준행동 시스템은 재난사고 처리 전반의 자료들과 관련 기관 종사자들의 경험치에 대한 자료를 수집하여 재난처리단계에 따라 체크리스트별로 규정한 단일 표준행동지침을 저장한 I-SOP 데이터베이스와, 재난의 유형과 대응 단계별 최저 레벨을 활동 도표(Activity Diagram)로 생성하는 재난 대응 프로세스와,  융합된 단일 표준행동지침을 생성하는 행동지침생성부, 및 재난시 입력되는 상황에 따라 각 카테고리 내에서 부여된 순서로 사용자에게 제공하는 I-SOP생성부를 포함하여 구성함으로써, 위험물 취급 방법 기록 및 유출시 대응 시나리오 와 기관 보유 물질정보 데이터 접근과 활용 체계에 따라 위험 물질별 재난사고 대응 I-SOP를 모바일기기에서 구현할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Experience device for simulating escape of people from underground space filled with flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experience device for simulating escape of people from an underground space filled with flood. The experience device comprises a circulation pool a, a circulation pool b, a stair and a bleacher, wherein a drainage conduit is fixed in one side of the circulation pool a; a conduit opening matched with the drainage conduit is formed in the surface of the bleacher, so as to form the U-shaped bleacher; the circulation pool b is positioned above the circulation pool a; an overflowing hole is formed in one side surface of the circulation pool b; the upper end of the stair is fixed at the overflowing hole in one side of the circulation pool b; the lower end of the stair is fixed on the circulation pool a. According to the experience device, a pump circulation system, a water channel, a simulation pathway and the like are adopted to simulate the situation of flood disasters, people can experience flooding impact, various rescue modes under flooding impact conditions can be trained, and rescue facilities can be inspected; the experience device is simple in process control and easy to operate.
assignees: HEFEI PUBLIC SECURITY RES INST OF TSINGHUA UNIV;HEFEI ZEZONG CITY INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Oil pan and fuel gas fire extinguishment demonstration device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oil pan and liquefied gas fire disaster demonstration device and particularly relates to an oil pan and fuel gas fire extinguishment demonstration device. The oil pan and fuel gas fire extinguishment demonstration device comprises a demonstration cabinet, liquefied gas and an ignition device, wherein the demonstration cabinet is divided into upper and lower layers; the liquefied gas is mounted in the lower layer of the demonstration cabinet; a simulated oil pan demonstration opening and a simulated liquefied gas fire breakout demonstration opening are formed in the upper layer of the demonstration cabinet respectively; double doors are arranged on the demonstration cabinet; the ignition device is mounted on the outer side of the upper layer of the demonstration cabinet; an observation window is further mounted on the outer side of the upper layer of the demonstration cabinet; a sealing box is arranged under the simulated oil pan demonstration opening; and a self-extinguishing protection device is mounted in the sealing box. With the adoption of the structure provided by the invention, oil pan and liquefied gas fire disaster demonstration can be adaptive to pot cover fire extinguishment carried out by a pot cover, fire extinguishment carried out by a fire extinguishment blanket and fire extinguishment carried out by a fire extinguisher, and the design is scientific and reasonable. The oil pan and fuel gas fire extinguishment demonstration device is scientific and reasonable, and simple in structural design, and good in use effect, has a very good popularization value, and has a great market economic prospect.
assignees: QINGDAO YIHE HAILI SAFE GUARDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: The simulation test device and its application method of high mountain barrier lake are impacted in snowslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses simulation test devices and its application method that high mountain barrier lake is impacted in a kind of snowslide, snowslide simulation is carried out by model slot and the change hill wash road being provided at its inner portion and current meter, and instantaneous picture information record is carried out to coplanar laser illumination using high-speed camera, particle image velocimeter, automatic digital camera, record the changing rule of avalanche hazards underwater diffusion characteristic and lake surface waveform.The present invention is directed to two laminar flow motion features of snowslide and flow relative impact, consider the influence in changeable slope ramp, it solves conventional snowslide campaign simulation test device and can not carry out underwater two laminar motions simulation, underwater Diffusion Law when snowslide is impacted into river can not be observed, and the water surface waveform variation characteristic the technical issues of, there is important reference value to the impact force and destructive power in river, and the related disaster prevention and mitigation engineering design of guidance to research avalanche hazards.

title_en: Power disaster early warning method based on roadway surrounding rock fracture auxiliary hole monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a power disaster early warning method based on roadway surrounding rock fracture auxiliary hole monitoring, and belongs to the technical field of mining engineering and geotechnical engineering power disaster monitoring and early warning. According to the method, through the arrangement and distribution of auxiliary holes, the roadway surrounding rock fracturing process in the power disaster inoculation and evolution process is shown on the periphery of the auxiliary holes; by using a mode of forming monitoring holes and installing sensors in the monitoring holes, the effective signal attenuation and the construction noise interference are reduced; the hole wall surrounding rock micro fracturing state of the auxiliary holes is directly monitored; the power disaster is monitored in real time. The method overcomes the defect of low accuracy of the monitoring result caused by complicated operation and real-time monitoring incapability of a chip drilling method (performing early warning by aiming at coal mine impact ground pressure) and weak effective signal and strong noise interference of a sound emitting method. The safety and the effectiveness of the mining engineering and geotechnical engineering power disaster monitoring are improved.

title_en: Vehicular hydrogen-storage system fire disaster simulation testing device and testing safety distance determination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicular hydrogen-storage system fire disaster simulation testing device and a testing safety distance determination method. The vehicular hydrogen-storage system fire disaster simulation testing device comprises a gas fuel source, a fire disaster simulation testing table, a safety protection system, and a data acquisition and control system. The gas fuel source is connected with the input end of a one-way valve of the fire disaster simulation testing table through a pipeline, and the output end of the one-way valve is connected with the fire disaster testing table. A support used for arranging the vehicular hydrogen-storage system is arranged above the fire disaster simulation testing table. An air outlet of an assembly valve of the vehicular hydrogen-storage system is connected with the safety protection system. The data acquisition and control system is connected with the gas fuel source, the fire disaster simulation testing table and the safety protection system through data transmission lines. The vehicular hydrogen-storage system fire disaster simulation testing device is reasonable in structural design, and can complete fire disaster simulation test specified by the standard under the condition of safety.
assignees: GUANGDONG INST OF SPECIAL EQUIPMENT INSPECTION

title_en: Power system emergency material demand prediction method based on multiple regressions
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a power system emergency material demand prediction method based on multiple regressions. The method comprises the steps consisting of modeling, normalization processing, multiple regression training, verification and the like. The power system emergency material demand prediction method based on multiple regression integrates factors such as local power grid scale, disaster event characteristics (disaster grade and the like), response grade and the like, builds a mathematics model according to the multiple regression method, obtains influence coefficients of emergency material prediction corresponding to each factor through adoption of historical data training, and rapidly calculates the demand for each emergency material after some disaster event happens through adoption of a prediction model to guide relevant departments to store or purchase materials according to the demand, so that it is ensured that the power network emergency maintenance is smoothly performed, and the fund waste caused by excessive storage or purchasing is avoided.

title_en: Medical logistic planning software
abstract_en: The present invention is a software, methods, and system for creating and editing a medical logistics simulation model and for presenting the simulation model simulated within a military or disaster relief scenario. A user interface that allows a user to enter and edit platforms and associated attributes for a simulation model. The system runs the simulation model based on user input and historical data stored in databases using the inventive software. The present invention provides an output for allowing a user to view casualty rates, patient streams, and medical requirements or any other desired aspect of the simulation model.

title_en: Exquisite high-efficiency, energy-saving and environmental-protection driving drill
abstract_en: An exquisite high-efficiency, energy-saving and environmental-protection driving drill is characterized in that the front end of a high pressure cylinder is connected with an inverted valve, the rear end of the high pressure cylinder is connected with a rotation driving gun, the inner side of the high pressure cylinder is provided with a hydroturbine connected with the rotation driving gun, the outer side of the high pressure cylinder is fixedly provided with a gun carrying handle, a pressure increasing valve connected with the side edge of the high pressure cylinder is connected with a pressure increasing and medicine device, the through hole at the front end of the rotation driving gun is kiss-bonded with a water injection nozzle, and is matched with other firefighting water injection devices, the water injection nozzle is arranged at the inner side of the front end of the rotation driving gun, and the driving drill is arranged at the front port of the rotation driving gun, and has a multi-tooth-shaped, helical or round shape. The exquisite high-efficiency, energy-saving and environmental-protection driving drill can be used for extinguishing fire, protecting national and people's life property safety and avoiding loss, and also can be used for synchronously realizing hole drilling, water injection, heat reducing and dust lowering in usual production construction. The exquisite high-efficiency, energy-saving and environmental-protection driving drill has the advantages of superior design performances, wide multifunctional uses, drilling of firefighting spray agents, high safety, high reliability, fastness, high efficiency, energy saving, environmental protection, low manufacturing cost and extremely high comprehensive use efficiency.
assignees: LIUZHOU JINGYANG ENERGY-SAVING TECH RES DEV CO LTD

title_en: Emergency head ring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergent head ring, including the ring, set up in speaker and signal lamp on the ring, with the microphone that the speaker is connected, and do the battery of speaker, signal lamp and microphone power supply. The utility model discloses a mode that sound, light, electricity combine is arranged in personnel evacuation, location discernment, information transfer, and when emergency took place, the user was through wearing the headring, and accessible microphone carries out clear effectual communication with speaker and other people, transmits correct information, avoids panic. Moreover, the signal lamp on the head ring can improve the identification degree, is also beneficial to commanders to command, optimizes the emergency evacuation path, improves the emergency disposal efficiency and prevents the occurrence of crowding and trampling accidents. The utility model discloses low cost, simple to use need not the training and can correctly use, facilitate promotion and popularization.

title_en: Calculation method for real-time distribution model of icing of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating an icing real-time distribution model of a power transmission line, which comprises the following steps of: real-time meteorological data screening; real-time meteorological data identification; establishing a real-time icing model; calculating the real-time icing thickness of each station; partitioning the icing climate condition; establishing an icing trend calculation model; determining a model recurrence period; correcting the thickness of the ice coating; establishing an icing real-time distribution model; the region real-time ice thickness distribution characteristics and the icing real-time ice thickness deduction result in a final icing real-time ice thickness distribution diagram; the technical problems that in the prior art, an icing trend model of the power transmission line is insufficient in real-time meteorological consideration, the model cannot achieve the precision required by simulating the actual icing condition, the icing information of the power transmission line cannot be mastered in real time, and the power transmission line is guided to work of ice prevention and disaster reduction and the like are solved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTH POWER GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;GUIZHOU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST

title_en: Method for online estimating and pre-warning grid safety accident risk levels
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for online estimating and pre-warning the grid safety accident risk levels, and belongs to the technical field of power system automation. The method comprises the following steps: on the basis of a grid current operation manner provided by an EMS and a control strategy of a second defensive line and a third defensive line, calculating and simulating the action of a control device of the second and third defensive lines through time-domain simulation in allusion to a preconceived fault set of assessments of the second and third defensive lines, so as to obtain a total fault load reduction quantity, a loss user quantity and a voltage loss station quantity; dividing the grid safety accident risk levels of the preconceived faults according to the requirements of ''Regulations on the Emergency Response to and Investigation and Handling of Electric Power Safety Accidents '' and ''Rules for the Investigation of Electric Power Accidents of China Southern Power Grid Company Limited''; and determining the important levels of the faulted equipment according to the accident risk levels. According to the method, the online estimation and pre-warning of the grid safety accident risk levels are realized, a technological foundation is laid for the real-time pre-warning and pre-control of the grid safety accidents.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;NANJING NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: A kind of disaster type tunnelling method in goaf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster type tunnelling method in goaf, it carries out on the basis of back supporting in the existing steel canopy of prior art, steel canopy, forestope and preceding spy drill rod three is organically combined, to realize：In tunneling process, to the advance support of back；In work progress, suspension type forestope is coordinated to carry out top plate gib using preceding spy drill rod, when preferably solving second mining tunnel digging blasting in goaf, to the technical barrier of back effective support；The integrality of driving face top plate is ensure that, the rapidity and security of disaster type tunnelling in goaf is realized, reduces the excavation cost in second mining tunnel.Combination tool used in the present invention is simple in construction, dismount making easy, easy to process, and its practicality is good；Operating cost of the present invention is low, security is good, with good marketing application prospect.

title_en: Simulation training and checking system and method for pipe leakage accidents
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation training and checking system and method for pipe leakage accidents. The system comprises a simulation training module and a checking module. According to different training targets and different training tasks, the simulation training module provides corresponding virtual training scenes and sets corresponding disasters or corresponding sudden accidents in the virtual training scenes to form the virtual drilling environment; a student can conduct operating and training on emergency treatment of the pipe leakage accidents through the virtual drilling environment, and the emergent treatment ability for the pipe leakage accidents can be improved. Checking subjects are selected through the checking module, preset operational checking content and preset theoretical checking content are given, and checking of the theory level and checking of the practical operating level of the student are achieved so that the emergent treatment ability of the student for the pipe leakage accidents can be improved.
assignees: CHINA SPECIAL EQUIPMENT INSPECTION & RES INST

title_en: A kind of double freedom sloping platform walking experience apparatus and its control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of double freedom sloping platform walking experience apparatus and its control method, more particularly to because the accidents such as earthquake cause to build floor tilt or because the effects such as stormy waves and accident cause the experience apparatus of evacuating personnel in the case of ship inclination, belong to experience apparatus field.Include the controller of support frame, travelling platform, hydraulic means, lighting device, supervising device and each device, the platform environment under different tilt conditions can be simulated, make experience personnel just as placing oneself in the midst of experience evacuation process in real crisis scene.The inclination of the invention that whole experience apparatus is realized by hydraulic means, overall structure are simple and reliable.Angle of inclination can be controlled by hydraulic means controller so that experience personnel experience the platform evacuation process of different inclined degrees.It with a variety of heeling conditions of analog platform environment, can distinguish single heel and the trim situation of Walk Simulation platform, heel and trim can also be combined to the composite inclined state for travelling platform.

title_en: Real-time situation model and visual fusion decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time situation model and visual fusion decision method which is applicable to rescue for leakage accidents of hazardous chemical substances. The method comprises the following steps: field environment data of a hazardous chemical substance accident is collected, fluidized and sent to a command center; the command center de-fluidizes the received data to restore the field environment data; the leakage rate of source intensity is calculated; a real-time situation is simulated according to the leakage rate of source intensity, the field environment data and accident terrain data; concentration points of grid computing are used to carry out triangulation difference calculation on the result of situation simulation, the spread movement track of different dangerous areas is rendered according to color gradient, and the maximum accident influence scope is predicted; and the population density in the maximum accident influence scope is calculated, and an optimal rescue evacuation path is evaluated out. The disadvantages of a static data model and the real-time transmission problem caused by shortage of bandwidth resources are overcome, and the accuracy, effectiveness and level of intelligence of emergency rescue are improved effectively.

title_en: Submerged line tracking method for flood evolution simulation in complicated river channel landform area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a submerged line tracking method for flood evolution simulation in a complicated river channel landform area. The submerged line tracking method comprises four process of generating a digital river channel multi-resolution grid segmentation model; modeling and computing a simulation forecast model for a drainage area flood evolution state, wherein the process is operated in parallel with the process of generating the digital river channel multi-resolution grid segmentation model; accurately searching the submerging boundary of the complicated river channel landform; and dynamically identifying a drainage area flood evolution submerged area. The submerged line tracking method performs accurate searching on the submerging boundary of the complicated river channel landform through establishing the digital river channel multi-resolution grid segmentation model and the simulation forecast model, thereby realizing dynamic identification on the drainage area flood evolution submerged area, accurately simulating complicated river channels at various landforms, and quickly simulating a flood submerged area. Quick, accurate and visual forecast on time, water depths and flow and even flow velocity in flood evolution to different river segments are realized. A scientific basis is laid for disaster prevention and mitigation operation before flooding.

title_en: High-dynamic dual-axis angular-rate gyroscope, and error compensation for zero offset and scale factor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-dynamic dual-axis angular-rate gyroscope, and error compensation for the zero offset and scale factor of the gyroscope. The gyroscope comprises a Y-axis sensitive device, a power supply management unit, a Z-axis sensitive device, a gyroscope shell, a gyroscope cover plate, a bottom shock pad, a lateral shock pad, a top isolation pad and an output cable. The high-dynamic dual-axis angular-rate gyroscope is mainly applied to accurate measurement of the transverse and normal angular rates of a carrier in high-dynamic environments like high overload and a high rotating speed, can compensate for the disadvantages of improper operation and proneness to damage of conventional angular-rate gyroscopes in high-dynamic environments, and is capable of inhibiting the disadvantages of great noise and large whole-temperature-range zero drift of conventional angular-rate gyroscopes. The high-dynamic dual-axis angular-rate gyroscope disclosed in the invention has the advantages of adaptability to high-dynamic environments like high overload and a high rotating speed, low noise, small whole-temperature-range zero drift and low signal delay, and can be majorly applied to measurement of the angular rate of a carrier in high-dynamic environments in disaster relief, inclinometry during well drilling, geological exploration, rapid transit, national defense, etc.
assignees: BEIJING INFORMATION SCIENCE AND TECH UNIV

title_en: Exploration and draining method for pressure-bearing karstic water in tunneling process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an exploration and draining method for pressure-bearing karstic water in a tunneling process. The method comprises the steps that a high-pressure-bearing water karstic area is searched for through advanced geological prediction, the karstic area is locked, the boundary range is determined, a tunnel face is closed, and a drilling tool exits; a measuring and control device is designed and manufactured; the position of a hydraulic down-the-hole drill is determined, the angle is adjusted, and a base of the hydraulic down-the-hole drill is reinforced through a ground anchor; the tunnel face is reinforced through a reinforcing mesh in an anchoring and shotcreting mode in advance; a large-diameter drill bit drills out an installation section of the measuring and control device, and the measuring and control device is installed and reinforced; a drill bit with the diameter smaller than the diameter of a brake valve is replaced, and a drill rod passes in the brake valve and a draining pipe to continue to carry out drilling; after a drill bit of the hydraulic down-the-hole drill reaches the pressure-bearing karstic water position, drilling is stopped, and the drilling tool exits; the high-pressure-bearing karstic water is explored and drained through the measuring and control device and the hydraulic down-the-hole drill; the operation is repeatedly carried out till all water is explored and drained. The problems that surrounding rock unstability is caused by high-pressure-bearing karstic water bursting and mud bursting phenomena in the drilling machine tunneling process, and geological disasters are caused are solved.

title_en: Disaster response scenario running system and method for providing same
title_ko: 재난대응 시나리오 구동 시스템 및 그 제공방법
abstract_en: A disaster response scenario running system that visualises a standard operating procedure (SOP) scenario using flow charts and the like so as to be able to easily comprehend a reaction procedure during the occurrence of a disaster, and a method for providing the same are disclosed. According to one aspect of the present invention, the SOP scenario running system comprises: an SOP DB in which a first SOP scenario defining a standard response procedure when a first pre-determined event occurs is stored; objects that respectively correspond to a plurality of unit SOPs included in the first SOP scenario; a display module for displaying the order of the respective unit SOPs; and a control module for performing a task set for a unit SOP that is to be next from among the plurality of unit SOPs, and for determining the unit SOP to be performed next based on the order of the respective unit SOPs if the task performed by the unit SOP is completed, wherein the display module changes the shape of an object corresponding to the performed unit SOP to a first modification shape, or adds a pre-determined visual effect to a component object corresponding to the performed unit SOP if tasks set for the respective unit SOPs are performed by the control module.
abstract_ko: SOP 시나리오를 플로우차트 형태 등으로 가시화하여 재난 발생 시의 대처 절차를 용이하게 파악할 수 있도록 하는 재난대응 시나리오 구동 시스템 및 그 제공방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 소정의 제1 이벤트가 발생한 경우의 표준적인 대응절차를 정의한 제1 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 시나리오가 저장된 SOP DB, 상기 제1 SOP 시나리오에 포함된 복수의 단위SOP 각각에 상응하는 오브젝트, 및 각 단위 SOP 간의 선후관계를 디스플레이하는 디스플레이모듈 및 상기 복수의 단위SOP 중 수행될 차례가 된 단위SOP에 설정된 작업을 수행하고, 작업이 수행된 상기 단위SOP가 완료되는 경우 각 단위SOP 간의 선후관계에 기초하여 다음에 수행될 단위SOP를 결정하는 제어모듈을 포함하되, 상기 디스플레이모듈은, 상기 제어모듈에 의해 각 단위 SOP에 설정된 작업이 수행되면, 수행된 상기 단위SOP에 상응하는 오브젝트의 모양을 제1 변형모양으로 변경하거나 수행된 상기 단위SOP에 상응하는 컴포넌트 오브젝트에 소정의 제1시각적 효과를 부가하는 SOP 시나리오 구동 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Method for controlling abnormal gushing of rock burst inclination coal bed gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for controlling abnormal gushing of rock burst inclination coal bed gas. The method comprises the steps of conducting seismic exploration, conducting geologic survey to predict a burst inclination area and conducting gas extraction when no rock burst inclination exists; the method is characterized in that when rock burst inclination exists, rock burst dangerous areas are further predicted through a drilling cutting method and micro-seismic monitoring, dangerousness of rock burst is determined, when the standard is not reached, rock burst control is conducted, after the standard is reached, gas extraction is conducted, effect verification is conducted through gas extraction, when it is verified that the standard is not reached, gas extraction is continued to be conducted, after the standard is reached, safety protection measures are implemented, then normal production is conducted, and a next cycle process is started. Comprehensive control over rock burst and gas is conducted, the situation that the rock burst critical condition is reduced by coal bed gas desorption and expansion is prevented, the occurrence times and energy of power phenomena in the extraction process are reduced, and compound disasters are controlled.
assignees: SHANDONG TANGKOU COAL MINING CO LTD;SHENYANG INST COAL BRANCH GROUP LTD

title_en: Test method for simulating water and san leakage disasters of underground engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test method for simulating water and san leakage disasters of underground engineering. An apparatus used in the invention comprises a main test box with the bottom being opened; the upper portion of the main test box is provided with a sealing top cover, and the top cover is connected with a detachable pressurization airbag and is fixedly provided with precise pressure regulating valve and a digital display pressure gauge; the lower portion of the main test box is provided with a miniature vibrating wire piezometer and a miniature earth pressure gauge; and the bottom of the main test box is in sealing connection with two L-shaped adjustable baseboards through an elastic sealing gasket and an L-shaped baseboard elastic sealing gasket which are arranged at the lower portion of the main test portion, the two L-shaped adjustable baseboards are connected through screws, and the two L-shaped adjustable baseboards are provided with grooves used for fixing the L-shaped baseboard elastic sealing gasket. The screws are adjusted in the test process to make the seam width is consistent with the open amount of a shield tunnel segment. The critical water and sand leakage open amounts of different soil samples can be obtained.

title_en: Building anti-seismic demonstration table
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building anti-seismic demonstration table which comprises a supporting body. A vibrating table is arranged on the supporting body, a plurality of manually constructed building models are arranged on the surface of the vibrating table, the vibrating table is connected with a frequency converter, the frequency converter is used for adjusting vibration frequencies of the vibrating table and is connected with a master control operation system, the master control operation system is used for integrally controlling the building anti-seismic demonstration table, more than three manually constructed building models are of brick-concrete structures, brick-concrete and ring beam structures and ring beam and constructional column structures, and the vibrating table is made of high-polymer composite materials. The building anti-seismic demonstration table has the advantages that the basic structural models of houses are personally constructed by audiences, the anti-seismic performance of the house models with the different structures on the vibrating table under simulated seismic conditions can be observed, accordingly, visitors can know the anti-seismic significance of farmhouses and basic methods, and the anti-seismic and disaster reduction awareness of the public can be improved.
assignees: TAIZHOU WEIER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rope corner protection device with adjustable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a firefighting rescue equipment field, concretely relates to rope corner protection device with adjustable. This rope corner protection device with adjustable is formed by connecting through flexonics spare the multiple protection ware, and the protector includes the round bar and set up the end cover at the round bar both ends that the round bar uses the end cover rotatory as the axle center, the end cover lower part is equipped with the support, is equipped with the protection between this support and separates the fender, the round bar is the axial telescopic structure, the anti -skid stud can the dismantlement mode be equipped with in the support bottom. This corner protection device dependable performance has been solved current device and has been worn and torn greatly and the problem of rope landing, and convenient operation, and the installation is reliable. Rotatable through the round bar, when using the rope, round bar self rotate can further reduce and the rope between the friction, make the security of fire fighter in put out a fire, speedily carry out rescue work rescue and professional training obtain improving. Can the extension elongation through the round bar, can use at bigger convex surfaces, can prevent rope roll -off protector, increase the security and the working area that use.
assignees: KUNMING COMMAND SCHOOL OF PUBLIC SECURITY FIRE DEV

title_en: firefighter training device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a firefighter training unit for a simulated fire suppression system, the unit comprising: a winding wheel; a user-manipulable nozzle; a hose having two ends connected to the reel and the nozzle, respectively, and partially wound around the reel, wherein rotation of the reel in a first rotational direction enables the hose to be unwound from the reel; a motor configured to drive the reel in a second rotational direction, which allows the hose to be wound onto the reel; one or more devices for providing one or more output signals corresponding to one or more simulated operating conditions of the fire suppression system; and a controller configured to drive the motor in response to the one or more output signals to apply a torque in the second rotational direction to the reel to thereby simulate a force applied to the hose during operation of the fire suppression system.

title_en: Simulation test device and simulation test method for varying-slope river channel impacted by debris flows
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test device and a simulation test method for a varying-slope river channel impacted by debris flows. The impact of the debris flows on the varying-slope river channel is simulated by using a transparent model tank, the varying-slope river channel and a flowmeter in cooperation with a debris flow storage box and a water storage box, wherein the varying-slope river channel and the flowmeter are arranged in the transparent model tank, and the debris flow storage box and the water storage box are arranged outside the transparent model tank. Data collection equipment is used for instantaneously recording the water level and water wave characteristics during debris flow impact. As for the device, according to the two-layer fluid motion characteristic of vertical fluid, the situations of viscous debris flows and water-rock debris flows as well as the influence of the varying-slope river channel are considered, so that the technical problems that in a conventional debris flow motion simulation test device, underwater two-layer fluid motion simulation cannot be conducted, and the underwater diffusion rule when the debris flows impact into the water channel and the waveform change characteristics of the water surface cannot be observed are solved, and the underwater diffusion rule and waveform change rule of the water surface of the water channel in a debris flow disaster can be observed conveniently and directly.

title_ko: 인체동작 수집 및 분석 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a human body motion collection and analysis system. More specifically, the human body motion collection and analysis system is able to attach a plurality of motion sensors on a human body, collect motion information, and apply the collected motion information to each part of a virtual human body model to simulate motions. Accordingly, the human body motion collection and analysis system is able to simulate a motion of a user with a relatively small amount of data, analyze the motion of an injured person in case of an accident or disaster to a device, the cause, estimate an actual motion of the user, and analyze the simulated motion to make a physical analysis of the motion and a musculoskeletal analysis of the actual user. According to the present invention, the human body motion collection and analysis system comprises: a motion sensor module attached to the body parts including joints to measure the motion information including a degree of bending, rolling, pitching, and heading of the joints; a motion information collection module connected to the motion sensor module through a wired or wireless network to collect motion information measured by a motion sensor module; and a motion simulation module which generates a virtual body model, transmits operation information from the motion information collection module, and simulates the motion by applying the received motion information to the virtual body model.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인체동작 수집 및 분석 시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 인체에 복수개의 동작감지 센서를 부착하고 동작정보를 수집한 후 가상의 인체 모델에 이를 부위별로 적용하여 동작을 형상화함으로써 비교적 적은 양의 데이터로 사용자의 동작을 형상화할 수 있고, 사고나 재해가 발생할 경우 사고당시 부상자의 동작에 관한 정보를 분석하여 원인을 도출할 수 있으며, 사용자의 실제 동작을 추정할 수 있고, 형상화된 동작을 분석하여 실제 사용자의 근골격계 분석 및 동작의 물리적 분석이 가능한 인체동작 수집 및 분석 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
이를 위해 본 발명은 관절을 포함한 인체의 부위에 적어도 하나 부착되어 관절의 구부러짐 정도, 롤링(Rolling), 피칭(Pitching), 헤딩(Heading)을 포함한 동작정보를 측정하는 동작감지 센서 모듈; 동작감지 센서 모듈과 유무선 네트워크로 연결되어 동작감지 센서 모듈이 측정한 동작정보를 수집하는 동작정보 수집 모듈; 및 가상의 인체 모델을 생성하고 동작정보 수집 모듈로부터 동작정보를 전송받아 인체 모델에 적용시켜 동작을 형상화하는 동작 형상화 모듈을 포함하는, 인체동작 수집 및 분석 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Noxious gas separator and using method thereof for coalmine shelter chamber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a noxious gas separator and a using method thereof for a coalmine shelter chamber. The separator comprises a protection airtight door arranged at an entrance of the shelter chamber, and a flexible separation door arranged on the inner side of the protection airtight door. The top of the shelter chamber is provided with a drilling hole for positive-pressure air entering. The flexible separation door comprises a frame and a flexible liner arranged in the frame. The flexible liner is provided with a door seam allowing people to pass, and two sides of the door seam are overlapped and connected. When no disaster occurs, the flexible separation door can be opened for carrying of devices. In disasters, the flexible separation door is closed and can stop noxious gas from flowing into a transition chamber when the protection airtight door is opened for people entering seek for shelter. Meanwhile, positive pressure air can flow out through the door seam and moves oppositely to the sheltered people to brush and drive away noxious gas carried by them when the sheltered people enters the shelter chamber through the door seam, therefore, noxious gas can be effectively separated, and the noxious gas separator is simple and effective in structure, almost free of maintenance and low in cost.

title_en: water separator and life raft Separation operating structure
title_ko: 분리 작동구조 교습용 구명벌 및 수압분리기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a life raft for training a separation operating structure and a water pressure separator and, more specifically, relates to a water pressure separator (100), which is divided into an upper frame unit (110), a lower frame unit (120), and a cover plate (130) from the front surface in a separate manner, and provided with a water pressure separator (100) in which the inner side is projected. The life rat for training a separation operating structure and the water pressure separator of the present invention has effects in providing a condition and a base material of the development of a disaster response technique.
abstract_ko:
