title_en: Internet and mobile terminal-based self and mutual medical aid system and emergency response method therefor
abstract_en: An Internet and mobile terminal-based self and mutual medical aid system is disclosed and is characterized by comprising a first aider terminal module, a user terminal module, an emergency doctor terminal module, a 120 emergency platform and a cloud management platform, wherein the user terminal module is connected with the first aider terminal module, the 120 emergency platform and the cloud management platform via the Internet; the first aider terminal module is connected with the user terminal module, the emergency doctor terminal module, the 120 emergency platform and the cloud management platform via the Internet. The Internet and mobile terminal-based self and mutual medical aid system solves problems of insufficient current first training talents and resource waste; the platform is believed to increase usual exercise opportunities for first aiders, and voluntarily organized training and reviewing training are believed to increase greatly.

title_en: Full-section loading device for rocks
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-section loading device for rocks and aims at designing a three-direction dynamic and static combination loading device with a large tonnage. The three-direction dynamic and static combination loading device comprises hydraulic cylinder groups, a feeding part and a gate, wherein the hydraulic cylinder groups are fixedly arranged on the side face and at the top of an outer framework; the feeding part enables the rocks to reach designated loading positions; the gate is used for closing the rocks and is arranged on guide rails. The loading device provided by the invention has a frame type cylinder arrangement structure, can provide a large-tonnage load and is used for performing full-section loading on square rocks; the loading requirement of a physical disaster simulation test of deep rocks is met. A panel at the front end of a cylinder group can ensure that the load always vertically acts on the surface of a model, so that the stress of the model is balanced, and the accuracy and the reliability of model test results are improved.

title_en: Shear wall fire exposure testing device under vertical load effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shear wall fire exposure testing device under the vertical load effect, relates to a fire resistance testing device, and belongs to the technical field of building structure disaster prevention and reduction. The shear wall fire exposure testing device comprises a furnace body, a loading system, an information collection system and a combustion control system. The furnace body is formed by assembling a shear wall component, a furnace side wall and a furnace top cover through bolts and screws. The furnace side wall and the furnace top cover fix zirconium-containing refractory fiber modules to a steel plate by means of stainless steel anchoring parts. The assembling efficiency is high, the modifiability is good, the containment furnace wall can be modified according to different test piece sizes, the repeated utilization factor is high, waste is reduced, a vertical placement shear wall fire resistance test under the axial pressure is achieved, and real working conditions of test pieces can be simulated; an intelligent ratio adjuster and an electric actuator are used for achieving automatic control over the furnace temperature; the shear wall test piece and the furnace wall are combined into the furnace body, one or more shear walls can be synchronously tested, the test data discreteness is lowered, and the purpose of saving energy is achieved.

title_en: Detection device for front stress distribution condition of mining working face
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal seam stress detection device, in particular to a detection device for simultaneously measuring stress distribution conditions in front of a mining working face by measuring stress at different positions in a coal seam drilling hole in front of the mining working face. The automatic sealing device comprises a double-layer cylindrical steel pipe and an outer rubber sleeve, wherein a plurality of stress meters which are uniformly arranged are arranged between the outer rubber sleeve and the double-layer cylindrical steel pipe, cement mortar is filled in a space between the outer rubber sleeve and a hole wall, an upper end opening cylindrical hollow barrel of the stress meter is hydraulically supported and contacted with the inner side of the outer rubber sleeve, a spring which is pushed mutually is arranged in a cavity formed by a lower end opening cylindrical hollow barrel and an upper end opening cylindrical hollow barrel of the stress meter, and a one-way backstop which is adaptive to the spring is arranged in the upper end opening cylindrical hollow barrel. The invention provides a method for evaluating the risk of dynamic disasters in front of the mining working face and the effectiveness of the control measures thereof, and solves the technical problem that the stress of the coal body in front of the mining working face cannot be directly and simultaneously measured at multiple points.

abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of floating type armored concrete production platform, including main platform body, drilling operation system, oil storage and outer defeated system, firefighting monitoring system, living system, utility system, power and accessory system, is characterized in：Main platform body includes hull and anchoring system, hull forms semi-hermetic cuboid by bottom plate and gusset plate, built dryly using armored concrete in cofferdam, hull interior is separated into three layers up and down of each self sealss with armoured concrete slab, bottom is weight coating, intervalve channel layer, the closed cabin storey in upper strata, every layer is separated into several cabins with armoured concrete slab again, then lays one layer of steel construction plate as deck in the top surface of hull；Drilling operation system, firefighting monitoring system, living system, power and accessory system are set above deck；Platform is fixed on required operation area by described anchoring system by anchor chain and several struts, and platform is kept balance and stability to adjust stress by injecting seawater toward each cabin of weight coating.

title_en: Method for preparing corrosion coal and analyzing and testing physical mechanics weakening characteristic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing corrosion coal and analyzing and testing physical mechanics weakening characteristic. The method includes (1) preparing corrosion coal: putting corrosion liquid with pH value of 4-10 into a corrosion case, starting a heater, putting the coal test piece and coal sample with size of 4-60 mesh into the corrosion liquid, performing sealing with a sealant, starting a swirl generator, and waiting 1-60 days; (2) analyzing the mesostructure of the coal test piece and the change of the metallographic structure; and (3) performing uniaxial compression test and gas-containing triaxial compression test for the coal test piece, performing uniaxial compression test after pressing the coal sample to be coal test piece, and testing the change of the mechanical characteristic. The method can be used for improving the working solution to improve the effect of hydraulic permeability improvement measure by means of researching the physical mechanics weakening characteristic of the corrosion coal, provides support for the gas control, can effectively simulate the change of the coal body in the deep mine under the effect of underground drainage, and provides support for the research of the rule of the mine geological disaster in the complicated condition and the prophylaxis and treatment of the mine geological disaster.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Soft Soil Layer landslide disaster simulation experiment method, including step：First, it samples；2nd, landslide disaster simulation test：Simulation test from top to bottom is carried out using N number of landslide disaster to be tested in face of landslide to be tested of tested soil sample, process is as follows：201st, sampling spoon and soil sample clamping are with adding water in soil sample；202nd, shearing test；203rd, solidify liquid instills；204th, soil sample bottom truncation；205th, soil sample support top；206th, truncation at the top of soil sample；207th, soil body sample is taken out in shearing seam；208th, soil body sample following process in shearing seam；209th, electron-microscope scanning；210th, simulation test is carried out using next face to be tested；211st, 2 repetition steps 210 of N complete simulation test procedure；3rd, shearing simulation result of the test sorts.The method of the present invention is simple, reasonable design and using effect are good, can carry out effective, real simulation to the expansion process for the upper shear band that comes down.

title_en: Disaster information cloud computing system and disaster information cloud computing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster information cloud computing system and a disaster information cloud computing method. The computing system comprises a disaster information cloud computing platform, a user terminal and a data transmission network. The disaster information cloud computing platform is designed into a six-layer architecture, and is configured to call a geological model and an analysis model according to disaster information and geological information to complete a disaster information computing and processing, disaster simulation, disaster assessment, warning and forecasting and disaster demonstration process. The six-layer architecture is composed of a hardware resource layer, a uniform resource pool layer, a geological model and analysis model resource pool layer, a disaster simulation model resource pool layer, a disaster visual simulation expression layer, and a management scheduling layer. The system and the method enable users to enjoy professional and fast disaster information processing service, and time, money, manpower and other costs can be saved. The system and the method can be widely applied to all kinds of natural disasters such as landslide, debris flow, collapse, earthquake, flash flood and avalanche.

title_en: Street tree wind-caused damage rapid evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a street tree wind-caused damage rapid evaluation method. A simplified model of street tree wind-caused damage is established, and according to finite element theory, tree materials are hypothesized to be isotropic and uniform, and then material physical parameters of dynamic behaviors affect tree individuals are abstracted. By giving consideration to the different types and the growth conditions of the trees, and the individual shape and character differences of the trees are great, and the material physical parameters of the street tree wind-caused damage model are regarded as the random variables. Davenport spectrum is used to represent input fluctuating wind speed, and a pseudo excitation method is used for street tree wind-caused response fast calculation. A street tree wind-caused damage criterion is defined based on bending strength, and by adopting Monte Carlo simulation, fast evaluation of street tree damage probability under a condition of different wind load levels. The street tree wind-caused damage rapid evaluation method is advantageous in that wind disaster damages on the street trees in the city areas are accurately and effectively predicted, and practical meaning is provided during making of corresponding defense measures.

title_en: Decision making system corresponding to volcanic disaster
title_ko: 화산재해 대응 의사결정 지원 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a decision-making support system for coping with a volcano disaster. A decision-making process of the decision-making support system for coping with a volcano disaster comprises: a simulation module including an algorithm through which a decision maker selects the most similar scenario in a scenario database during a volcanic eruption; a disaster current condition module of showing spatial information through a GIS system by using the result obtained through the algorithm; a module extracting damage estimation information from a disaster prediction and disaster estimation database, and statistically analyzing the same; and a module for the decision maker to establish a response strategy based on a situation response database, thereby quickly and accurately coping with a volcano disaster.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Tsunami flooding prediction system, controller, provision method for tsunami flooding prediction and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To generate disaster information relating to a tsunami flooding prediction in real time after earthquake occurrence while removing human errors and provide the information to a user.SOLUTION: A controller comprises: an acquisition part that acquires a flooding prediction request which is generated in response to earthquake information generated in association with earthquake occurrence and requests a prediction of flooding from tsunami; a verification part that verifies validity of the flooding prediction request; and an instruction part that, when the flooding prediction request is valid, instructs a parallel computer system to execute a tsunami flooding predictive simulation using a script file which includes simulation requirements about the tsunami flooding predictive simulation to be executed for obtaining a flooding prediction result for the flooding prediction request. The parallel computer system secures a resource for finishing the tsunami flooding predictive simulation as prescribed by the simulation requirements within prescribed time, and then executes the tsunami flooding predictive simulation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Nocturnal fire disaster video detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nocturnal fire disaster video detection method. The method includes the following steps that: format conversion is performed on a nocturnal fire disaster video which is recorded under an infrared mode, so that the format of the nocturnal fire disaster video can be converted into an HSV color space from an RGB color space; morphological filtering is performed on the nocturnal fire disaster video; a neural network model is utilized to train the brightness characteristic values of nocturnal flame pixels, and whether pixels in frames belong to suspected flame regions is judged according to a training result; binarization processing is performed on regions satisfying a brightness characteristic threshold value, so that highlight regions can be obtained, and then Canny algorithm is adopted to solve the edges of the highlight regions, and the perimeter and area of the contours of the edges are calculated; the circularity of the highlight regions is calculated; nocturnal flame flicker characteristics are calculated; the frequency of full-screen flicker per second is calculated; and an SVM (support vector machine) classifier is built, and the characteristic values are utilized to classify the highlight regions of a suspected fire. With the method of the invention adopted, videos of the early stage of a fire can be searched, and an object with flames can be directly and accurately located.

title_en: A kind of file classification method based on KNN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of file classification methods based on KNN, are suitable for nuclear safe level software verification and reliability demonstration.File classification method of the invention includes training process processing and test process processing, and training sample data collection is indicated with urtext itself with the two-part information of title all in text.Two DBM models are constructed according to the feature hierarchy structure of text from shallow to deep, the further feature of the high discrimination of low-dimensional and storage are extracted, determines the classification of text to be tested to the calculating bring contribution of similarity with weight appropriate consideration text header during the test.The present invention makes full use of the information of text header, than being significantly improved on classification performance using shallow-layer feature vector as training set, it can reduce storage demand and on-line calculation simultaneously, solves the problems, such as feature vector higher-dimension disaster, the accuracy for improving classification can be used for the rule match in the analysis of safety level software reliability assessment and the foundation in failure mode library.

title_en: Fastfood cup adopting lighter burner
abstract_en: The invention provides a fastfood cup adopting a lighter burner. The fastfood cup adopting the lighter burner is characterized in that a food container provided with a metal sheet bottom (2) is burned through the lighter burner (B) which is used for burning with the gas supplied by a lighter gas box (C). The fastfood cup comprises food in a foldable portable cubic fastfood cup (A). The fastfood cup adopting the lighter burner can solve the defects of a current paper cup type fastfood cup which can be used for making instant noodles or rice and cannot be burned and folded to carry away, and relates to an application technology of supplying gas through the lighter gas box (C) to the burner (B) to burn. The structure of the fastfood cup adopting the lighter burner is characterized in that a fastfood cup body (A) is provided with the metal sheet bottom (2) which can be heated; a lighter pressing groove (6) is formed in the rear surface of a furnace bottom (5) of the lighter burner (B), and a gas discharging valve (13) of the lighter gas box (C) pressed into the lighter pressing groove (6) can be crisscross intersected with a pushing rod (901) of a switch (9); the lighter gas box (C) is free of a lighting and opening system of a one-off plastic lighter, and remains a box body (12), the gas discharging valve (13) which exposes from a box opening plug (121), and a gas discharging adjusting valve (132); a male thread is arranged in a valve nozzle (131). The fastfood cup can be used for cooking foods by burning, and is applicable to travel, exploration, outdoor work, scenes of disaster relief, camping, military training, patients, children and the like.

title_en: Evacuation simulation device, evacuation simulation method, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation simulation device, evacuation simulation method, and program capable of rapidly and appropriately formulating an evacuation plan in accordance with an actual disaster situation.SOLUTION: An evacuation simulation device 100 includes: a first simulation execution unit 110 for deriving, by a first simulation method, a plurality of optimal evacuation route candidates whose evacuation completion time is the shortest; and a second simulation execution unit 120 for selecting, by a second simulation method, an optimal evacuation route whose evacuation completion time is the shortest from the plurality of optimal evacuation route candidates.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of coal and gas prominent experimental rig and method for having supply source of the gas
abstract_en: A kind of coal and gas prominent experimental rig and method for having supply source of the gas, experimental rig includes coal sample tank, the side of coal sample tank is connected with tonifying Qi gas bag, tonifying Qi gas bag is connected to air compressor, the opposite side of coal sample tank is provided with opening, armorplate glass is provided with the inside of opening, pipeline is provided with the outside of opening, pipeline is externally provided with percussion lock, one end of percussion lock is fixed on the outside of pipeline, the other end is provided with percussion tup, percussion tup adheres on armorplate glass, inner-walls of duct interval is provided with multiple pressure sensors and multiple photoelectric sensors, the position of corresponding each photoelectric sensor is provided with light source outside pipeline, passed through between light source and photoelectric sensor provided with transparent panel for light source.Tonifying Qi gas bag make-up gas constantly into coal sample tank, more real simulation coal and gas prominent disaster generating process, pressure sensor can determine gas pressure in pipeline, reflect migration state of the prominent gas in pipeline, and photoelectric sensor and light source can measure the migration position of prominent coal stream.

title_en: A kind of Remote Sensing Target recognition methods
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Remote Sensing Target recognition methods, comprising: you can well imagine in each pixel punishment of the every width training image of training image collection and takes external appearance characteristic；It is orderly semantic right using external appearance characteristic and type the mark construction target-background of training image, and learn to obtain target-background semantic model；It is orderly semantic right using external appearance characteristic and type the mark construction target type of training image, and learn to obtain target type semantic model；Each pixel punishment in test image, which you can well imagine, takes external appearance characteristic；Constructing target-background using the external appearance characteristic of test image, orderly semanteme is right, and the target area in the test image is extracted using the target-background semantic model；It is orderly semantic right to the external appearance characteristic construction target type of test image target area, target type is determined using the target type semantic model.The present invention improves the separability between target and background and different type target, can be widely applied in the numerous areas such as disaster monitoring, target reconnaissance.

title_en: Firefighting Training Unit
abstract_en: A metal container with a combustible liner for use as a portable firefighting training unit. The combustible liner is formed of particle board sections loosely assembled inside the metal container with an opening in the liner in registry with an access opening in the metal container. The unit may be used to demonstrate various phenomena associated with a developing fire including the flammability of unburned products of combustion, hose stream techniques with a spray bottle filled with water, flashover and backdraft.

title_en: Fire extinguisher for training, training system and method for corresponding to disaster based virtual reality using the same
title_ko: 훈련용 소화기 및 이를 이용한 가상 현실 기반의 재난 대응 훈련 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fire extinguisher for training, and a system and a method for training virtual reality-based disaster response using the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system for training virtual reality-based disaster response comprises: a virtual reality generation device for producing a virtual reality fire image, and for updating the produced virtual reality fire image with respect to fire extinguisher operation information; a display device worn by a training participant for receiving the virtual reality fire image from the virtual reality generation device, and for displaying the received virtual reality fire image; and a fire extinguisher for training, for producing fire extinguisher operation information with respect to the operation of the participant, and for transmitting the produced fire extinguisher operation information to the virtual reality generation device.
abstract_ko: 훈련용 소화기 및 이를 이용하는 가상 현실 기반의 재난 대응 훈련 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 가상 현실 기반의 재난 대응 훈련 시스템은, 가상 현실 화재 영상을 생성하고, 생성한 가상 현실 화재 영상을 소화기 동작 정보에 따라 갱신하는 가상 현실 생성 장치, 훈련 참가자가 착용하고, 가상 현실 생성 장치로부터 가상 현실 화재 영상을 수신하며, 수신한 가상 현실 화재 영상을 표시하는 표시 장치; 및 훈련 참가자의 조작에 따라 소화기 동작 정보를 생성하고, 생성한 소화기 동작 정보를 가상 현실 생성 장치로 전송하는 훈련용 소화기를 포함한다.

title_en: Quick releasing device for gas dynamic disaster simulator stand and testing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick releasing device for a gas dynamic disaster simulator stand. The device comprises an outburst cylinder, wherein a plurality of piston barrels are connected to the outburst cylinder, and the total length of the piston barrels is identical with the thickness of a shield coal pillar; the piston barrel at the tail end is connected with a loading pressure relief barrel through a flange structure, and the end, connected with the piston barrel, of the loading pressure relief barrel is connected with an outburst barrel; a piston head is arranged in the loading pressure relief barrel in a sliding and sealing mode, the piston head is connected with a piston rod, and the piston rod stretches out of the free end of the loading pressure relief barrel and is connected with an external power device; a transparent observation window is arranged on the piston barrel connected with the loading pressure relief barrel; each piston barrel is connected with a seepage air outlet pipe. The invention further discloses a testing method adopting the device. The device can simulate coal stress, gas pressure, shield coal pillar influences and gas seepage influences, and therefore the simulation degree of a test is increased. The repeat function of conducting multiple outburst experiments by loading a coal sample once is realized, and working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Simulation experiment device and experiment method for coal mine gas dynamic disaster under simulation environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation experiment device for coal mine gas dynamic disaster under a simulation environment. The device comprises a loading frame, wherein a pneumatic hammer and two Z direction loading hydraulic cylinders are mounted on the loading frame, and a Z direction loading plate is connected between the bottom ends of piston rods of the two Z direction loading hydraulic cylinders; a Y direction guide rail and an X direction guide rail are connected to the bottom of the loading frame; a protruding cylinder body and a Y direction loading hydraulic cylinder are arranged on the Y direction guide rail, and an X direction loading hydraulic cylinder is arranged on an X direction motor trolley; a Z direction loading port is formed in the top of the protruding cylinder body, a Y direction cylinder and an X direction cylinder are connected to the side wall of the protruding cylinder body, and a protruding port is formed in the upper surface of the X direction cylinder; a fourth pipeline with an opened tail end is connected to the X direction cylinder; a vacuum-pumping system and a gas loading system are connected to the protruding cylinder body. The invention further discloses an experiment method using the device, coal mine rock burst, gas flow field, overlaying strata stress and horizontal tectonic stress can be simulated, the experiment simulation degree is improved, and the experiment success rate and the accurate degree are improved.

title_en: Numerical simulation method for coal mine abscission layer water periodical water inrush disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical simulation method for a coal mine abscission layer water periodical water inrush disaster. The method comprises the following steps that a numerical calculation model is established, the whole model is composed of 12 coal rock layers, the fourth layer above a second coal bed is a main sandstone aquifer, and the third mudstone layer is a key waterproof layer; when the key waterproof layer is 20 m, the length of the model in the moving direction is 600 m, the height is 300 m, the model is divided into 65,750 250*263 units, and rock mass only bears gravity stress ad water pressure; according to boundary conditions, the two ends are horizontally restrained, the bottom end is fixed, and the periphery is arranged to be a waterproof boundary. The development process of a water guide fracture is simulated through step-by-step excavation; excavation is started from the position 100 m away from the left side of the moving direction of the model, 400 m is excavated in total with the height of 5 m, 10 m is excavated in each step, and totally 40 steps are included. A computer numerical simulation means is adopted to simulate an abscission layer formation process, and periodicity of the secondary roof abscission layer water disaster is summarized.

title_en: Person evacuation safety evaluation method, device and apparatus in toxic gas leakage accident
abstract_en: The invention provides a person evacuation safety evaluation method in a toxic gas leakage accident. The method comprises steps of: carrying out simulation by using a leakage diffusion model to obtain the space concentration distribution of a toxic gas time series, namely a concentration field; simulating a person evacuation process along a predetermined evacuation path to obtain the spatial position of each evacuation individual at different time; computing the toxicity loads Pc of the evacuation individuals at the predetermined evacuation path; computing the death probabilities Pr of the evacuation individuals according to the toxicity loads Pc and the category of the toxic gas; acquiring the death rate Pd of the evacuation individuals according to the death probabilities Pr and then determining the person evacuation safety degree of predetermined evacuation path according to the death rate Pd of the evacuation individuals. The invention further provides a person evacuation safety area evaluation method in a toxic gas leakage accident and a person evacuation safety evaluation device and apparatus in a toxic gas leakage accident.
assignees: CHINA ACAD OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Coal mine underground concentric casing directional drilling device and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal mine underground concentric casing directional drilling device and a construction method thereof. The coal mine underground concentric casing directional drilling device comprises an external hole protection assembly and a center directional drilling assembly, wherein the external hole protection assembly comprises a hole protection casing; the hole protection casing is connected with a hinging connector through a connector; the front end of the hinging connector is connected with a casing shoe through the connector; and the center directional drilling assembly comprises a center drill pipe, a measurement while drilling nipple, a screw rod drilling tool and a center drill bit. During the drilling construction, the drilling hole track is controlled by regulating the bent head facing direction of the inside screw rod drilling tool; when the drilling is performed to the preset depth, the center drill pipe, the measurement while drilling nipple, the screw rod drilling tool and the center drill bit are lifted out of the hole; the casing is left in the hole to achieve the hole protection effect; then, the drilling tool with the diameter being one level smaller than that of the former drilling tool is fed from a hole opening; and the directional drilling construction is continuously performed until the designed depth is reached. By aiming at complicated stratums such as local crushing stratums and mudstone hole shrinkage stratums under a coal mine, the directional long drilling construction is realized; the problems of gas control and water disaster prevention and control of coal mine underground complicated stratums are solved; and the safe and efficient production of the coal mine is guaranteed.
assignees: XI'AN RES INST OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENG GROUP CORP

title_en: Mountain fire disaster early-warning method for overhead power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain fire disaster early-warning method for an overhead power transmission line. The method comprises the steps of A, acquiring and obtaining mountain fire occurrence information by utilizing a monitoring module, wherein the mountain fire occurrence information comprises combustible material characteristics, a terrain factor and a meteorological factor; B, obtaining a mountain fire influence factor in the mountain fire occurrence information, and establishing a relationship through a random forest model for threshold association between a mountain fire and the mountain fire influence factor of the mountain fire; C, performing time-space process modeling of mountain fire spread through a cellular automaton with the capability of simulating a complicated natural disaster time-space evolution process, and determining a cellular conversion rule of the cellular automaton by adopting the random forest model; and D, predicting a mountain fire spread process through a cellular automaton model, estimating time of the mountain fire spread to the overhead line, and assessing the risk of overhead line shutdown in combination with external disaster information and power grid internal characteristics. The method can assist in more effectively handling power system interlocking faults caused by a natural disaster prediction effect, so that economic and personnel loss of a power grid and power utilization units is reduced.

title_en: Wind hazard risk assessment system and method for responding to climate change
title_ko: 기후 변화 대응을 위한 도시 풍해 위험도 평가 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change. The system and the method for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change is invented for necessity of proper preparation of a national level and management technique as a loss of a life and a loss of a property occur due to an increased wind-related disaster caused by recent climate and environment change. The present invention relates to the IT-based system for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change and, specifically, to a system for assisting a decision maker so that the decision maker rapidly responds, by analyzing a wind hazard in a city region by considering the climate change and displaying an analyzed hazard result on a WEB-GIS-based system. To achieve the purpose of the present invention, the system for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change includes: a) a strong wind hazard factor analyzing module of simulating a wind speed due to typhoon using a moving path and a central air pressure change of the typhoon and statistically analyzing future typhoon by considering the climate change; b) a weakness analyzing module of analyzing weakness of each facility using weakness DB of the facility; c) a wind hazard risk analyzing module calculating a damage probability by each grid and each administrative district using a strong wind hazard factor and strong wind fragility; and d) a wind hazard risk index analyzing module expressing a wind hazard risk index on a unit administrative district by analyzing damage probability information by each region and exposure rate information for preparing for and restoring damage.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 최근 기후 및 환경변화로 인하여 바람관련 재해가 증가하고 이로 인하여 인명손실과 재산상의 손실이 발생함에 따라 국가차원의 적절한 준비와 대응 관리 기술의 필요성으로 고안되었다.  
본 발명은 기후변화 대응을 위한 도시 풍해 위험도 평가 IT 기반 시스템에 대한 것으로, 보다 자세하게는 기후변화를 고려하여 도시지역의 풍해 위험도를 평가하고 평가된 위험도결과를 WEB-GIS기반의 시스템에서 표출하여 의사결정자에게 신속한 대응을 할 수 있도록 보조해주는 시스템에 대한 것이다.  
상기 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명의 기후변화 대응을 위한 도시풍해위험도 평가 시스템은; a) 태풍의 이동경로와 중심기압변화를 이용하여 태풍으로 인한 풍속을 시뮬레이션하고 기후변화를 고려하여 미래태풍을 통계적으로 분석하는 강풍위험요인평가 모듈; b) 시설물의 취약성 DB를 활용하여 각 시설물의 취약성을 평가하는 취약성평가모듈; c) 강풍위험요인과 강풍취약도를 활용하여 격자별,행정구역별 피해확율을 산출하는 풍해위험도평가모듈; d) 지역별 피해확율 정보와 피해에 대비하고 복구할 수 있는 정도인 노출도정보를 분석해서 단위 행정구역에 대한 풍해위험도 지표를 표출하는 풍해위험도지표평가모듈을 그 특징 징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for constructing of respose on disaster based on scenario
title_ko: 시나리오 기반 재난 대응 구축 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system to construct a disaster response based on a scenario. The system to construct a disaster response based on a scenario comprises: a scenario planning unit that a user logs in and configures a simulation environment to simulate a scenario by disaster type; a disaster type-based scenario generation unit to generate a scenario in accordance with the user conditions and the simulation environment configured by the scenario planning unit, wherein the scenario is generated by combining a standard operation procedure (SOP) corresponding to a disaster management step by disaster type, emergency support function and geographic information; a simulation unit to execute a simulation to realize a scenario with respect to the disaster type-based scenario generated by the scenario generation unit, generate an emergency warning along the scenario, distribute response resources in accordance with a crisis situation, manage a command system and recover the disaster situation; a post-event analysis unit to generate user assessment data in accordance with the simulated results, generate and store a report; and a disaster variable introduction unit to search not only analyzed disaster variables but also disaster type-based disaster variables from a variety of internet webpages using a web robot module and provide the searched disaster variables to the scenario generation unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 시나리오 기반 재난 대응 구축 시스템에 대한 것으로, 재난 유형별로 시나리오를 시뮬레이션하기 위해서 사용자가 로그인하고 시뮬레이션 환경을 설정하기 위한 시나리오 플래닝부; 상기 시나리오 플래닝부에 의하여 설정된 사용자 조건과 시뮬레이션 환경에 따라 시나리오를 생성하되, 재난 유형에 따라 재난 처리 단계에 해당하는 표준 운영 절차(SOP)와, 긴급 지원 기능 자원과, 지리 정보를 조합하여 시나리오를 생성하는 재난 유형별 시나리오 생성부; 상기 시나리오 생성부에서 생성된 재난 유형별 시나리오에 대하여 시나리오를 구현하고 상기 시나리오 진행에 따라 위기 발생 경보를 발생하며, 위기 상황에 따른 우선 순위에 따라서 대응 자원을 배분하고 지휘체계를 관리하여 재난 상황을 복구 처리하도록 시뮬레이션을 실행하는 시뮬레이션부; 상기 시뮬레이션 진행결과에 따라서 사용자 평가 자료를 생성하고 결과 보고서를 생성하여 저장하는 사후분석부; 및 조사분석된 재난 변수 뿐만 아니라 웹 로봇모듈에 의하여 다양한 인터넷 사이트로부터 재난 유형별로 재난 변수를 검색하고 상기 검색된 재난 변수를 상기 시나리오 생성부로 제공하는 재난변수 도입부를 포함한다.

title_en: Intelligent 3D Disaster Simulation and Method based on Ontology and Slope
title_ko: 온톨로지와 사면 기반의 지능형 3차원 재난 시뮬레이션 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent 3D disaster simulation based on ontology and a slope, and a method for the same. Situation information is obtained on the basis of a user and is applied to a simulation. When the situation information is constituted, internal situation information includes personal information of a user such as a current location, a current state, a name, and an age. External situation information includes weather, local situation, and a moving means. Service situation information includes a disaster control service and a disaster correspondence guideline. The constituted situation information obtains disaster control service ontology by using an ontology tool. The obtained disaster control service ontology obtains ontology deduction rules by using a deduction engine. Situation information according to the user is obtained by obtaining external situation information from an external information obtaining unit, and a deduction result according to the user is obtained by applying the same to the disaster control ontology deduction rules. Ontology is applied to the simulation, and user-based disaster situation is intelligently simulated. Moreover, the simulation is constituted on the basis of a physical engine, and an internal topography is expressed by using index information of an actually measured topography. The outside thereof is expressed by using a sky box scheme. Disaster situation such as snow, rain, fog, explosion, and fire is expressed through small particles by using a particle scheme. The present invention has been developed by the research funds (14CTAP-C078863-01) for the land and transport technology promotion research project of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.
abstract_ko:
온톨로지와 사면 기반의 지능형 3차원 재난 시뮬레이션 및 방법으로 사용자 중심으로 상황 정보를 획득하여 시뮬레이션에 적용한다. 
상황정보의 구성에서 내부 상황정보는 현재위치, 현재상태, 이름, 나이 등의사용자 개인정보로 구성하고, 외부 상황정보는 날씨, 지역상황, 이동수단 등으로 구성하고, 서비스 상황정보는 재난관리 서비스, 재난 대응 가이드라인 등으로 구성한다. 구성한 상황정보는 온톨로지 툴을 이용하여 재난관리 서비스 온톨로지를 획득한다. 상기에서 획득한 재난관리 서비스 온톨로지는 추론엔진을 이용하여 재난관리 온톨로지 추론 규칙을 획득한다.  
외부 정보 획득부에서 외부 상황정보를 획득하여 사용자에 따른 상황 정보를 획득하고, 재난관리 온톨로지 추론 규칙에 적용하여 사용자에 따른 추론 결과를 획득한다. 온톨로지는 시뮬레이션에 적용하여 사용자 중심의 재난 상황을 지능적으로 시뮬레이션한다. 
또한, 시뮬레이션은 물리엔진 기반으로 구성하며 내부의 지형은 실제 측량된 지형의 인덱스 정보를 이용하여 표현하고, 외부는 Sky Box기법을 사용하여 표현한다. 재난의 표현은 파티클 기법을 이용하여 작은 입자들로 눈, 비, 안개, 폭발, 화재 등의 재난상황을 표현한다.

title_en: Method for controlling disasters by utilizing roof crevice water to weaken main control coal seams and rock strata in situ
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for controlling disasters by utilizing roof crevice water to weaken main control coal seams and rock strata in situ. The method comprises the following steps under the condition of roof crevice water: exploring the spatial distribution and characteristics of the roof crevice water in details by utilizing a physical exploration method, analyzing and studying the content and transport condition of the crevice water, carrying out exploration, verification and sampling to carry out indoor conventional rock mechanics experiments and determining related coefficients; then drilling two rows of water draining drill holes in roofs of a haulage roadway and a tailgate respectively and arranging two fan-shaped drill holes in each drill hole at different angles; and then forming a V-shaped ring slot in all the drill holes at intervals of a certain distance by utilizing a slotting drill and finally carrying out segmented hydraulic fracturing on all the drill holes via a water injection hole packer. The method is simple in construction, avoids various complex measures and processes in traditional blasting construction and has extensive practicability and higher promotion significance.

title_en: Method for collaborative governance of gas and coal spontaneous combustion of fully-mechanized caving face with single thick coal seam
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for collaborative governance of gas and coal spontaneous combustion of a fully-mechanized caving face with a single thick coal seam. The method is suitable for collaborative governance of gas and coal spontaneous combustion disasters of the fully-mechanized caving face with the spontaneous tendency, the single thick coal seam and large gas emission. Macromolecular air leaking stoppage materials are sprayed to air inlet and return gate roadways of the caving face to form an air leaking stoppage system. In the recovery process, high-order drill holes and grouting holes are alternately formed in the air return gate roadway side, and the high-order drill holes and the grouting holes are kept reasonably spaced to form a gas drainage and grouting system. Monitoring and prewarning systems are established at relevant positions of the caving face, the safety state of the caving face is monitored at any time, and all the systems collaboratively work to achieve the purpose of collaborative governance of the gas and coal spontaneous combustion disasters of the fully-mechanized caving face with the single thick coal seam. The method for collaborative governance of gas and coal spontaneous combustion of the fully-mechanized caving face with the single thick coal seam is scientific, effective, simple and easy to carry out, does not delay production, and can guarantee rapid and efficient exploitation of the caving face.

title_en: A kind of coal-field fire heat energy sustainable use and coal fire governing system and method
abstract_en: A kind of coal-field fire heat energy sustainable use and coal fire governing system and method, hold tank, radiator, radiator fan, horizontal drilling, high temperature resistant circulating pump, temperature-difference power generation module, pressure-stabilizing supercharging module, battery and inverter by vacuum liquid and constitute.Primary operational method is to excavate means isolation coal-field fire using machine, horizontal drilling is arranged in independent coal-field fire, heat carrier absorbs flame range heat formation high-temperature heat carrier by horizontal drilling, and entering vacuum liquid appearance tank in the presence of high temperature resistant circulating pump, its bottom temperature-difference power generation module is generated electricity using itself top and bottom ends temperature difference.The system is recycled sustainable utilization heat carrier and extracts coal-field fire heat, electric energy is converted heat into by thermo-electric generation, the wasting of resources is reduced, prevents burning things which may cause a fire disaster to spread while isolating coal-field fire, the double effectses that discarded energy recovery is utilized and coal fire is administered are reached, with wide applicability.

title_en: Industrial safety menagement system and mehtod for building the same
title_ko: 산업 안전 관리 시스템 및 이의 구축 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an industrial safety management system and a method for constructing the same. Provided is the industrial safety management system which includes an environment information collecting device which can integrally collect the environment of a working area, a situation pattern recognition device which recognizes a situation which threatens the safety of a worker based on big data and environment collection information, an experience simulator device for checking a worker state and an alternative type in a dangerous situation, and a danger detection predicting device which predicts the generation of a disaster according to the working area. So, industrial safety education, training and management can be carried out by simulation.

title_en: Fire simulation apparatus and method thereof

abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 실제 건물의 구조 정보에 따라 건물 평면도 상에 구성품 및 소방설비를 시각화하고, 입력된 명령에 따른 상기 건물 평면도 상에 임의의 위치에 화재감지기를 시각화하여 모델링하는 모델링부 및 상기 건물 평면도 상의 임의의 지점에서 화재발생 시뮬레이션 실행 시, 상기 건물 평면도 상에 화재 진행 상태 및 피난자들의 대피 경로를 예측하는 시뮬레이션부를 포함하는 화재 시뮬레이션 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Predicting and maneuvering system of seismic sea wave
title_ko: 지진 해일의 예측 및 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a predicting and responding system for seismic sea wave. The predicting and responding system for seismic sea wave according to the present invention comprises the steps of: establishing a seismic sea wave disaster factor information database (DB); analyzing seismic sea wave countermeasure current conditions in a target area along the East Sea; establishing a geographical database for coastal zones by area; analyzing flooding properties by target area along the East Sea; writing a seismic sea wave flooding prognostic chart by target area along the East Sea; and issuing a warning when a level exceeds a target level of flooding in the prognostic chart. As the only predicting and responding system for seismic sea wave utilizing a virtual scenario in Korea, the predicting and responding system for seismic sea wave according to the present invention can allow users to quickly respond to seismic sea wave through stepwise response procedures and to predict a risky area by analyzing seismic sea wave flooding properties in 43 zones in coastal areas of the East Sea by the magnitude of M7.5, M8.0, M8.5, and M9.0 and by utilizing a flooding prognostic chart. Also, by writing a seismic sea wave flooding prognostic chart for seismic sea wave risky areas, the predicting and responding system for seismic sea wave according to the present invention notifies users of risk information allowing users to precisely and easily determine the danger of seismic sea wave and thus to effectively respond, and to manage a seismic sea wave situation in real time and to make a decision, thereby solving existing problems.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진 해일의 예측 및 대응 시스템에 대한 것으로, 상기한 본 발명의 지진 해일의 예측 및 대응 시스템은; 지진 해일 재해요소 정보 데이터베이스(DB)를 구축하는 단계; 동해안 대상지역의 지진 해일 대책현황을 분석하는 단계; 지역별 연안역 지형 데이터베이스를 구축하는 단계; 동해안 대상지역별 범람특성을 분석하는 단계; 및 동해안 대상지역별 지진 해일 침수 예상도를 작성하는 단계로 구성되고, 상기 침수 예상도에서 일정한 침수 정도를 넘으면 지진 해일 경보를 발령하는 단계로 구성되어 지는 것임을 특징으로 한다. 
상기와 같이 구성되는 본 발명의 지진 해일의 예측 및 대응 시스템은 가상시나리오를 활용한 국내 유일 지진 해일대응 시스템으로 단계별 대응절차를 통해 지진 해일 발생에 대한 신속 대응을 가능하게 하고, M7.5, M8.0, M8.5, M9.0 규모별 동해안 43개 지구의 지진 해일 범람특성의 분석 및 침수 예상도를 활용하여 위험지역의 예측을 가능하고 하고, 또한 지진 해일 위험지역에 대한 지진 해일 침수 예상도를 작성하여 위험정보 알려, 수요자가 지진 해일의 위험성을 정확하고 용이하게 판단할 수 있어 지진 해일에 효과적으로 대응할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 또한 실시간으로 지진 해일 상황을 관리하고 의사결정 지원을 할 수 있게 하여 상기한 종래의 문제점을 해결한다.

title_en: Predicting and managing system of marine disasters thorugh analysing ocean information
title_ko: 실시간 해양정보 분석을 통한 해양재난의 예측 및 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system to predict and manage marine disasters by analyzing marine information in real time. The system to predict and manage marine disasters by analyzing marine information comprises the steps of: visualizing real-time marine information of associated interagency such as the national weather service and a national oceanographic research institute (NORI) by receiving the real-time marine information; collecting and visualizing real-time information about a marine site disaster status such as typhoon, earthquake, and tsunami; analyzing and visualizing the marine area disaster dangerous degree such as the visualized typhoon tsunami and the visualized earthquake tsunami; simulating damages according to the analysis of the marine area disaster dangerous; and providing danger information in real time by determining the disaster dangerous in each marine disaster type when the damage prediction of the damage simulation from the result is arranged to a predetermined value. According to the present invention, the system to predict and manage the marine disaster through the real-time marine information analysis utilizes a marine disaster prediction simulation utilizing real-time typhoon and earthquake information by monitoring the marine disaster by connecting real-time marine information; monitors a disaster site in real time by utilizing a human sensor such as a SNS, a radar, a satellite, and the like; expands usability by connecting the real-time smart disaster situation management system; and enables a decision maker to effectively and accurately determine the dangerous of the marine disaster. The system can effectively respond to the marine disaster, can manage marine disaster situation in real time, and can support a decision making.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실시간 해양정보 분석을 통한 해양재난의 예측 및 관리 시스템에 대한 것으로, 상기한 본 발명의 실시간 해양정보 분석을 통한 해양재난의 예측 및 관리 시스템은; 기상청 및 국립해양조사원과 같은 관련 유관기관의 실시간 해양 정보를 수신하여 이를 가시화하는 단계; 태풍 해일 및 지진 해일과 같은 해안지역 재난상황에 대해 실시간으로 정보를 수집하고 이를 가시화하는 단계; 상기 가시화된 태풍 해일 및 지진 해일과 같은 해안 지역 재난 위험을 분석하고 가시화하는 단계; 상기 해안 지역 재난 위험을 분석에 따른 피해를 시뮬레이터를 통해 시뮬레이션하는 단계; 및 상기 피해 시뮬레이션의 결과 피해 예측이 일정한 수치에 도달하면 해안재난유형별 재난위험을 판단하여 실시간으로 위험정보를 제공하는 단계로 구성되어 지는 것임을 특징으로 한다. 
상기와 같이 구성되는 본 발명의 실시간 해양정보 분석을 통한 해양재난의 예측 및 관리 시스템은 실시간 해양 정보 연계를 통한 모니터링을 하여 실시간 태풍 및 지진 정보를 활용한 해일과 같은 해양 재난 예측 시뮬레이션을 활용하고, SNS와 같은 휴먼 센서, 레이더, 위성 등 첨단정보를 활용하여 실시간 재난 현장 모니터링 및 실시간 스마트 재난상황 관리 체계 연계를 통한 활용성을 확대하여, 판단자가 해양재난의 위험을 정확하고 용이하게 판단할 수 있어 해양재난에 효과적으로 대응할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 또한 실시간으로 해양재난 상황을 관리하고 의사결정 지원을 할 수 있어 상기한 종래의 문제점을 해결한다.

title_en: Safety education system using virtual experience
title_ko: 가상체험 안전교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety education system for virtual experience and, more particularly, to a sensory-type safety education system for a virtual space using a virtual reality treadmill device and a virtual reality head mounted display. The safety education system using virtual experience according to the present invention includes: a virtual experience display device which displays various fields of safety management contents on a screen and is provided in a head display mounted type; and a treadmill input device which is provided in a treadmill type, prevents a safety accident when the system is operated in a state in which the virtual experience display device is mounted, and may immediately receive an input of movement of the user. The safety education system is utilized for education of disaster and safety management centers of schools and government agencies, so that ability to cope with disasters may be improved through repeated education.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가상체험 안전교육 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 가상 현실용 트레드밀 장치와 가상현실 헤드 마운트 디스플레이를 이용한 체감형 가상공간 안전교육 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 가상체험 안전교육 시스템은, 각종 분야의 안전관리 콘텐츠를 화면상에 표시하며, 헤드 디스플레이 마운트 타입으로 구비되는 가상체험 디스플레이 장치; 및 트레드밀 타입으로 구비되며, 상기 가상체험 디스플레이 장치를 착용한 상태에서 동작시 안전사고를 방지하는 한편, 사용자의 움직임을 즉응적으로 입력받는 것이 가능한 트레드밀 입력 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Method for selecting optimal traffic path in urban waterlogging situation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for selecting an optimal traffic path in an urban waterlogging situation. The method comprises the steps of: modeling an urban pipe network and a drainage system in a SWMM; modeling a traffic network in a Matlab, and completing geographic information matching between the Matlab system and the SWMM system; analyzing influence of waterlogging on traffic paths according to a simulation result of the SWMM, and marking blocked road serial numbers in a traffic network model of the Matlab; updating relationship settings among node objects, and adjusting traffic network description; and solving out a shortest path of traffic routes according to a Dijkstra method. The method can reflect the influence of the surface ponding on the optimal path in an urban rainstorm situation more accurately, is fast in query speed and has visible results, can be applied to urban traffic early-warning, forecasting and emergency command system under the condition of a waterlogging disaster, and is of important scientific significance to the planning of urban waterlogging traffic paths.

title_en: Integrated Method and System for Flood Disaster Response
title_ko: 홍수 재난 대응을 위한 통합 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated method and a system for coping with flood disasters and, more specifically to an integrated method and a system for coping with flood disasters which establish a database required for a situation such as flood disasters, evaluate facilities such as a bank, etc. in advance by using the database, and generate beforehand information for visualizing a flood in 3D. According to the present invention, information can be propagated rapidly such that the generated information can be provided quickly. Also, an efficient 3-dimensional geographic information system (GIS) space analysis is performed to enable simulation of a flood. Since various data collected before the flood is standardized in a database, data standardization and expansion can be realized, which improves convenience in using the data and addresses a problem due to non-compatibility between conventional and current systems. And, it is convenient to collect or reprocess new data and manage legacy data. When a new system or a new module is to be included, it can be easily combined or connected organically, which facilitates maintenance of the conventional system. With respect to related parties, a task can be easily performed since there is no need to change a manual when a new system is utilized. The integrated method for coping with a flood disaster comprises a data acquisition step; a facility evaluation step; a bank vulnerability evaluation step; a flood visualization step; a space analysis 3D visualization step; a dynamic presentation step; and an information propagation step.

title_en: Calculation simulation method for soil body large-deformation flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calculation simulation method for soil body large-deformation flow. The method is based on a molecular dynamics (MD) method. In the method, a Newton motion equation is taken as a control equation; a Hertzian type friction formula and a Stokes formula are introduced to describe solid-solid particle interaction and solid-liquid particle interaction respectively; and a solid-liquid coupling soil body large-deformation flow calculation model is built in a process of solving an integral through a Verlet algorithm. Through adoption of the calculation simulation method, a basic dynamics feature and a motion rule of soil body particle complex flow can be presented; the research level of prevention and control of soil body large-deformation flow disasters in China is further perfected and raised; and meanwhile, a certain basis is laid for wide application and popularization of a molecular dynamics calculation method in the soil body large-deformation flow disasters.

The vertical vibration loading device and/or the horizontal shearing vibration loading device can apply vibration loads with different frequencies and amplitudes, so that the influence of the dynamic load action on the soil body strength parameters can be favorably researched, the actual stress condition can be more favorably simulated, the stress change, the pore water pressure change, the local damage of the soil body, the liquefaction phenomenon and the like in the soil body shearing test process under the vibration load action can be favorably revealed, and the occurrence and the movement mechanism of geological disasters such as landslides and the like can be further revealed from the mechanical properties.

title_en: A kind of rock tunneling boring charger
abstract_en: This utility model provides a kind of rock tunneling boring charger, purpose is that design one has large-tonnage three direction coupled static-dynamic loadingi device, including the hydraulic cylinder group being fixedly installed on outside framework side and top, also include: realizing rock and arrive the material loading part specifying loading position and the gate closed by rock, gate is placed on guide rail.Charger of the present utility model has frame-type row's cylinder structure, is provided that large-tonnage load, square shaped rock carry out tunneling boring loading, meets the loading requirement of the physics disaster simulation test of deep rock.The flat board of cylinder group front end can ensure that load acts perpendicularly to model surface all the time, makes model stress equalization, improves accuracy and the reliability of model test result.

title_en: Gas dynamical disaster simulator stand quick release device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of gas dynamical disaster simulator stand quick release device, including prominent cylinder body, prominent cylinder body connects some piston cylinders, and the total length of piston cylinder is identical with the thickness of shielding coal column；The piston cylinder of end is connected by flange arrangement has loading to unload pressure cylinder, loads and unloads the one end that pressure cylinder is connected with piston cylinder and be connected and have protruding cylinder；Loading is unloaded slipper seal in pressure cylinder and is provided with piston head, and piston head connects to be had piston rod, piston rod to stretch out loading to unload the free end of pressure cylinder and connect external dynamic power apparatus；Unload the piston cylinder that pressure cylinder is connected be provided with transparent windows with loading；Each piston cylinder is respectively connected with seepage flow escape pipe.The invention also discloses the test method using said apparatus.This utility model can simulate stress in coal bed, gas pressure, additionally it is possible to the impact of simulation shielding coal column, the impact of simulation gas porous flow, improves the emulator of test.This utility model achieves the repeat function of " fill a coal sample and do repeatedly prominent experiment ", improves work efficiency.

title_en: A kind of fire extinguishing apparatus for demonstrating for chemical laboratory
abstract_en: This utility model relates to teaching experimental equipment technical field, a kind of fire extinguishing apparatus for demonstrating for chemical laboratory, including fire-extinguishing cabinet, H type frame, support bracket, fire suppression bottle assembly, nozzle component and suspension disc, fire-extinguishing cabinet bottom is provided with opening and valve, inside is provided with ignition platform, H type frame is arranged on fire-extinguishing cabinet, top is provided with the support bracket laying fire suppression bottle assembly, fire suppression bottle assembly is provided with relief valve, relief valve is provided with control switch, fire suppression bottle assembly connects nozzle component through the three-way connection (pipe) being provided with electromagnetic valve, electromagnetic valve is electrically connected with corresponding control switch, nozzle component is arranged on to be located in fire-extinguishing cabinet in the suspension disc at top.This utility model reasonable in design, the contrast demonstration to different fire extinguisher fire-fighting functions is realized in single cabinet, image can objectively judge the different fire extinguisher action effect to different burning things which may cause a fire disaster, simple to operate, safe ready, experiment effect is obvious, is particularly suited for the training of chemical laboratory fire extinguishing code.

title_en: A kind of tunnel fire hazard experimental simulation device of burning things which may cause a fire disaster variable-ratio motion
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the tunnel fire hazard experimental simulation device of a kind of burning things which may cause a fire disaster variable-ratio motion, including: tunnel main body, traction power parts and for holding the dolly of simulation fire source, the bottom of tunnel main body is provided with the track moved for dolly, traction power parts include motor and change speed gear box, dolly connects rope, and rope is connected to motor through pulley and change speed gear box；The top board inwall of tunnel main body and/or plate inner wall are provided with the chute being perpendicular to tunnel main body longitudinal axis, and at least one sidewall of tunnel main body can move along chute；Measuring instrument, exhaust blower and ventilation blower it is provided with in tunnel main body.It is many that this utility model can change factor, is suitable for research range wide, comprehensive relatively good.Additionally the operation of this experiment porch also has the advantages such as simple, repeatability is strong.

title_en: Floating type armored concrete production platform
abstract_en: This utility model provides a kind of floating type armored concrete production platform, including main platform body, drilling operation system, oil storage and outer communication system, firefighting monitoring system, living system, utility system, power and aid system, it is characterized in: main platform body includes hull and anchoring system, hull is constituted semi-hermetic cuboid by base plate and gusset plate, use armored concrete to build in cofferdam dryly, hull interior armoured concrete slab is separated into each self-packing upper and lower three layers, bottom is weight coating, intervalve channel layer, the airtight cabin storey in upper strata, every layer is separated into several cabins with armoured concrete slab again, end face at hull lays one layer of steel construction plate as deck again；Drilling operation system, firefighting monitoring system, living system, power and aid system are arranged above deck；Platform is fixed on required operation area by anchor chain and several struts by described anchoring system, and adjusts stress make platform keep balance and stability by injecting sea water toward each cabin of weight coating.

title_en: method for disaster crisis examination and simulating education method therefor
title_ko: 재난위기 인식도 검사방법 및 이를 이용한 재난위기 체험교육방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for examining a degree of recognizing a disaster emergency, and an experiential education method for a disaster emergency based on the method for examining a degree of recognizing a disaster emergency. The method for examining a degree of recognizing a disaster emergency examines an individuals awareness of methods to handle various disaster situations, and increases the level of awareness using materials such as an image, and the like with respect to the individuals level of awareness. Also, the method for examining a degree of recognizing a disaster emergency increases an effect of having an experiential education by setting different levels of experiential education method to allow an individual to acquire how to handle a disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에는 다양한 재난상황의 대처방법에 대한 인식도를 검사하고, 개인의 인식도 수준에 따라서 영상 등의 자료를 이용하여 인식도 수준을 향상시키고, 인식도 수준에 따라서 재난상황에 대한 대처 요령을 습득하기 위한 체험 교육방법의 레벨을 다르게 설정함으로써 체험교육 효과를 향상시키도록 하는 재난위기 인식도 검사방법 및 이를 기반으로 하는 재난위기 체험교육방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Animal crush injury analog platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of animal crush injury analog platform, including control module and execution module；Described execution module includes base, described base is provided with chassis and support, described chassis has pressure transducer, described support is provided with motor, described motor is fixed by screws on described support, and described motor is connected with undercarriage by screw mandrel, it is achieved the lifting of undercarriage, the lower section of described undercarriage is installed with pres planes i.e. briquetting, described pressure transducer and motor and all controls to be connected with described control module；It is an advantage of the current invention that: the crush injury under the disaster environments such as earthquake can be simulated, construct animal crush injury model, provide platform for probing into crush injury mechanism and treatment means further.

title_en: Soft Soil Layer landslide disaster simulation experiment method under a kind of confining pressure state
abstract_en: The invention discloses Soft Soil Layer landslide disaster simulation experiment method under a kind of confining pressure state, including step：First, it samples；2nd, landslide disaster simulation test：201st, soil sample and pressue device clamping are with adding water in soil sample；202nd, shearing test；203rd, solidify liquid instills；204th, soil sample bottom truncation；205th, soil sample support top；206th, truncation at the top of soil sample；207th, soil body sample is taken out in shearing seam；208th, soil body sample following process in shearing seam；209th, electron-microscope scanning；210th, simulation test is carried out using next face to be tested；211st, 2 repetition steps 210 of N complete simulation test procedure；3rd, shearing simulation result of the test sorts.Reasonable design of the present invention and it is easy to operate, using effect is good, can easy, quick obtaining be tested microstructure at shear strength and clipped position at the upper different depth in landslide, so that the expansion process to the upper shear band that comes down under confining pressure state carries out real simulation.

title_en: A kind of application and interpretation method of single sea level pressure of standing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to marine forecasting technical field, relate to a kind of application and interpretation method of single sea level pressure of standing, specifically include following steps: build data base, data prediction, train the learning machine model that transfinites, utilize the model parameter obtained after training the learning machine model that transfinites that the ocean air pressure numerical forecast result of oceanic observation to be measured point is carried out error correction, round-off error is added in original numerical forecast result, obtains releasing of oceanographic observation website sea level pressure numerical forecast to be measured and use result.The present invention releases and can reduce the error between predicted value and actual value by method, improves the accuracy of numerical forecast result, improves work efficiency, for carrying out work of preventing and reducing natural disasters, ensureing that people's property and life security are significant.

title_en: Nuclear power plant training system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a nuclear power plant training system which allows a highly realistic training with an emergency response center and an emergency control room of the actual plant involved.SOLUTION: A training system 10 for a nuclear power plant 50 includes: a monitoring network 18 for transmitting plant data which is input/output at a central control room 51 of the nuclear power plant 50; a simulation calculation part 20 for virtually structuring plant equipment 53 and specific accident support equipment 11 provided in the nuclear power plant 50 and simulating various types of operation states in the set plant so as to generate simulation plant data; a training network 24 for transmitting the simulation plant data; and changeover switches 25a and 25b for connecting at least either an emergency response center 12 or an emergency control room 15 connected to the monitoring network 18 to the training network 24 in the plant training.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Early warning method for high-temperature heat damage of rice
abstract_en: The invention provides a rice high-temperature heat damage early warning method, which comprises the following steps: a) identifying the high temperature resistance of the rice variety; b) respectively establishing a relation curve of the maturing rate of the rice glumes and the temperature and a relation curve of the relative maturing rate of the rice glumes and the days at high temperature; c) collecting temperature data of a planting field day by day, wherein the temperature data comprises a highest temperature, a lowest temperature and an average temperature; d) collecting the data of rice seeding, transplanting and heading stages in different seasons and different planting modes of a planting field; e) simulating the influence of the high-temperature heat damage on the maturing rate of the rice according to the data obtained in the step c) and the data obtained in the step d) and the relation curve obtained in the step b), and performing early warning on the high-temperature heat damage of the rice according to the obtained simulation result. The method provided by the invention can predict the temperature condition of the rice during flowering and the influence of high temperature on rice seed setting, and provides a decision for disaster resistance of rice production and theoretical support for countermeasure measures.

title_en: Calculating bandwidth requirements for a specified recovery point objective
abstract_en: A method, computer system, and a computer program product for calculating bandwidth requirements is provided. The present invention may include receiving a recovery point objective (RPO). The present invention may also include simulating, using a virtual disk, a set of inter-site data transfers between a first data storage controller and a second data storage controller, wherein the second data storage controller is modelled by the virtual disk. The present invention may then include collecting a set of data correlating to a set of bandwidth factors, based on the simulated set of inter-site data transfers. The present invention may further include calculating, using the virtual disk, a bandwidth required for data replication for disaster recovery, based, at least in part, on the set of bandwidth factors and the RPO.

title_en: Experimental method based on heat power disaster multi-parameter temporal-spatial evolution analyzing experiment table
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of experimental method based on heat power disaster multi-parameter temporal-spatial evolution analyzing experiment table, comprising steps of one, determine mine simulated object and build experimental bench device；Two, the air-tightness of experimental bench device is examined；Three, experiment control terminal is initialized；Four, ventilation quantity variation, roof fall position and roof fall degree and flue gas Gas position in the analog module of tunnel are controlled and gushes out speed and obtains mine heat power disaster multi-parameter temporal-spatial evolution process；Five, judge whether gas density and oxygen concentration reach the threshold limit value for causing gas explosion in the analog module of tunnel；Six, cause secondary gas explosion in the analog module of tunnel and analyze heat power disaster multi-parameter change in time and space.Step of the present invention is simple, and flue gas gas generates the variation of rate at analog mine laneway ventilation quantity, roof fall phenomenon and different location, obtains the position for being prone to secondary gas explosion in the analog module of tunnel, analyzes heat power disaster multi-parameter change in time and space.

title_en: A kind of swelled ground is humidified under Condition of Rainfall Infiltration and expands method for numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of swelled ground be humidified under Condition of Rainfall Infiltration and expand method for numerical simulation, use fluid structurecoupling module and work out relevant FISH LISP program LISP, it is achieved during unsaturated seepage, non-saturated region matric suction, Unsaturated Hydraulic Conductivity and soil strength parameter are with the variation relation of moisture content；It is then based on " humidity stress field theory ", according to seepage flow continuous renalreplacementtherapy and the similarity of the equation of heat conduction, derive the equivalency transform relation of thermodynamic parameter and seepage parameters, and use thermodynamics module, it is achieved swelled ground dilatancy process under humidification conditions.The present invention can effectively and all sidedly realize swelled ground be humidified under Condition of Rainfall Infiltration expand overall process numerical computations, thus engineering design, the construction for swelled ground engineering project disaster high-risk area provides effective scientific guidance means, the most effectively promotes the application calculating soil mechanics in technical fields such as Practical Project construction and hazards control.

title_en: A kind of experimental system of coal mine gas from explosion baffling device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the experimental system of a kind of coal mine gas from explosion baffling device, including gas accumulation device, exploding primer device, sensor and data acquisition unit, test pipe, gas explosion secondary disaster baffling device；Test gas is supplied by gas gas cylinder, and Gas-Flow gauge and gas Valve controlling gas accumulation amount, gas accumulation pipeline and test pipe are separated by dividing plate, closed gas valve after gas density reaches test requirements document；Gas explosion in underground coal mines is simulated by the gas in sparker actuation gas aggregation apparatus；Sensor is installed at the test pipe two ends of gas explosion secondary disaster baffling device, data acquisition unit collection simulates the temperature of gas explosion, pressure, flame assay data, and be stored in computer, software analysis test data；Use safety glass to make test pipe, be divided into baffling device test pipe, monitoring section test pipe；This patent is able to verify that the effectiveness of gas explosion baffling device, the defect that display gas explosion baffling device design exists.

title_en: Group evacuation simulation system and method combining artificial bee colony with social force model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group evacuation simulation system and method combining artificial bee colony and social force model, the method includes: acquiring evacuation scene parameters and constructing an evacuation scene three-dimensional model; searching all exits of the evacuation scene in the three-dimensional model; dividing people to be evacuated in an evacuation scene into a plurality of groups according to the relationship between individuals and the positions of the distance outlets, and screening the individuals closest to the positions of the outlets in each group as leaders of each group; taking each exit of the evacuation scene as a food source, taking a leader as a leading bee in the group, and establishing one-to-one mapping with each parameter in the artificial bee colony; and each group executes a parallel artificial bee colony algorithm to dynamically plan the path to move to the outlet under the guidance of the leader. And if the leader reaches the corresponding exit, waiting at the exit until no individual exists in each group, and ending the crowd evacuation simulation. The method improves the simulation efficiency and the utilization rate of the channels in public places, and provides help for real evacuation drilling.

title_en: Fire extinguishing system for simulation firefighting training
title_ko: 교육훈련용 소화시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, the fire extinguishing system for simulation firefighting training comprises: a display member to display guidelines on how to act when a fire occurs and actual situation where a fire occurs; and a hydrant which is installed on the rear surface of the display member to spray water toward the display member. The hydrant comprises: a water spray means which is placed on one side and has a fire hose inside to spray water toward the display member; a water supply means which is placed on the other side and has a water tank to supply water to the water spray means; and an air supply means which is placed on the bottom and supplies air to the water spray means and the water supply means. The air, which is supplied by the air supply means, expands the fire hose of the water spray means, lets air pressure work in the water tank of the water supply means, and discharges the stored water through the fire hose. The present invention aims to provide a fire extinguishing system for simulation firefighting training, which allows a user to practice the process of extinguishing a fire with water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 교육훈련용 소화시스템은, 화재발생시 행동요령과 실재 화재발생 상황을 표시하는 디스플레이부재와, 상기 디스플레이부재의 후면에 설치되어 상기 디스플레이부재를 향해 물을 분사하도록 하는 소화전을 포함하는 교육훈련용 소화시스템에 있어서, 상기 소화전은, 일측에는 상기 디스플레이부재에 물을 분사되도록 소방호스가 내부에 구비된 물분사수단; 타측에는 상기 물분사수단에 공급되도록 물이 저장된 물탱크를 내부에 구비하는 물공급수단; 및 하부에는 상기 물분사수단과 상기 물공급수단에 공기를 공급하는 공기공급수단;을 포함하되, 상기 공기공급수단을 통해 공급된 공기가 상기 물분사수단의 소방호스를 팽창시키면서 물공급수단의 물탱크 내부에 공기압을 작용시켜 저장된 물을 상기 소방호스로 배출시키는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: The real-time display system of fire-fighting environment based on three-dimensional map
