title_en: Safety training facility device using a virtual experience
title_ko: 가상체험 안전교육 시설장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety training facility device using virtual experience, with which various potential accidents can be experienced by means of virtual reality so that trainees safety can be ensured and educational effects can be enhanced based on senses of reality and immersion. The present invention includes: a hands-on output device worn on the head of a trainee, outputting a three-dimensional image for the visual and virtual reality-based realization of a predetermined disaster situation, having built-in acceleration and gyro sensors detecting a movement of the head, and varying the point of view of the three-dimensional image in accordance with the movement of the head; a proximity sensor-embedded input device transmitting a detection signal resulting from the trainees movement to the hands-on output device and varying the disaster situation on the virtual reality; and an administrator terminal providing the virtual reality content for the hands-on output device, generating an accidental variable with respect to the disaster situation by intervening in the virtual reality, and transmitting progress situation information or safety notice information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실제로 발생할 수 있는 각종 안전사고를 가상현실로 체험할 수 있도록 하여 체험자의 안정을 보장하면서도 실질적인 현장감과 몰입감으로 인하여 교육적인 효과를 높일 수 있는 가상체험 안전교육 시설장치에 관한 것으로서, 체험자의 머리에 착용되어 소정의 재난 상황을 시각적 가상현실로 구현하기 위한 입체영상을 출력하며, 상기 머리의 움직임을 감지하는 가속도센서 및 자이로센서가 내장되어 상기 머리의 움직임에 따라 입체영상의 시점을 가변시키는 체험용 출력장치; 근접센서가 내장되어 상기 체험자의 움직임에 따른 감지신호를 상기 체험용 출력장치에 전송하여 상기 가상현실상의 재난 상황을 가변시키는 입력장치; 및 상기 체험용 출력장치에 상기 가상현실 콘텐츠를 제공하며, 상기 가상현실상에 개입하여 상기 재난 상황에 대한 돌발변수를 발생시키고, 진행상황정보 또는 안전숙지사항정보을 전달하는 관리자 단말기;를 포함하는 것을 기술적 요지로 한다.

title_en: Disaster case simulation apparatus
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster case simulation apparatus capable of making a viewer positively thinking of a disaster, ensuring a great effect of planting awareness as a person concerned into the viewer, and contributing to making an accident/disaster remembered and to improving hazard sensitivity of the viewer.SOLUTION: A disaster case simulation apparatus 1 for simulating a disaster case, comprises: a data storage 2 for storing simulation video data 102 on the disaster case in the form of a plurality of video constituent elements 103 corresponding to a title/disaster outline, a site of a disaster, reproduction of the disaster, a timeline until occurrence of the disaster, a cause and countermeasures of the disaster, and a change in an error chain by the countermeasures, respectively; an operation section 3 for performing an operation of selecting any of the plurality of video constituent elements 103; a display section 4 for displaying the selected video constituent element; and a control unit 6 for calling the video constituent element selected by the operation of the operation section 3 from the data storage 2 and displaying the video constituent element on the display section 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: The method that inclination angle, surface, landslide is converted into displacement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method that inclination angle, surface of coming down is converted into displacement, it relates to a kind of landslide monitoring early warning technology.Topographic and geologic condition according to typical landslide disaster, based on landslide model in situ experiment and monitoring measured data, by the relation between angle of inclination, earth's surface during the destroying for times of rainfall simulation slope and actual displacement amount, the method that inclination angle is converted into surface displacement is proposed, and combine concrete Monitoring Data, it is monitored information feedback in time, conversion formula is tested and revises, finally providing a kind of method that inclinometer inclination angle, earth's surface of coming down is converted into displacement.The present invention is by setting up the relation between inclination angle, earth's surface, landslide and displacement, give angle of inclination and be converted into displacement empirical equation, compensate for the deficiency of relation understanding between the inclination angle to the monitoring of earth's surface, landslide and landslide actual displacement, provide science guarantee for Geological Hazards Monitoring comprehensive pre-warning technology decision-making.

title_en: Firefighter's Ladder-Throwing Training Apparatus
abstract_en: A firefighter's ladder-throwing training apparatus (FLTTA) that allows firefighters to train and practice a ladder-throwing technique consisting of grasping a ladder located in a side position and moving the ladder to a front usable position. title_en: Method for detecting glacial ablation based on tracing technique
abstract_en: A method for detecting glacial ablation based on a tracing technique, comprising the following steps: 1. respectively adding different tracer agents of the same concentration to several parts of water and mixing uniformly, and recording the volume and mass of each glacier model, and respectively freezing the several parts of water, with the tracer agents added thereto, from the inside to the outside in layers, so as to establish several glacier models; 2. regulating the environmental factors surrounding the glacier models, collecting water samples that have melted from the glacier models under different environmental factor conditions, and measuring the concentration of each tracer agent in the water samples; and 3. obtaining the quality of the melted water samples, the melting rate and the melting position of different ice layers of the glacier models under different conditions according to the content of tracer agents, and deriving the physical process of actual glacier melting according to the melting rate, the melting quality and the melting position. The process of glacial ablation is simulated by establishing a glacier model, and the ablation speed of an actual glacier is further derived therefrom, in order to facilitate early warning analysis regarding sea level rises and natural glacial disasters.

title_en: Testing device for simulating seepage failure of dam with upper part defects and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a testing device for simulating a seepage failure of a dam with upper part defects and a construction method thereof. The testing device comprises a model tank and a dam model arranged in the model tank. An arch simulative ant channel is formed in the upper part of the dam model. A spherical area is arranged near the position, close to the downstream dam slope, of the simulative ant channel of the dam model, and an artificial sprinkler is arranged above the model tank. A plurality of sets of monitoring sensors are buried near the simulative ant channel in the dam model. The construction method of the testing device comprises the steps that firstly, clay is made into a soil sample, an arch thin pipe is buried on the upper part of the dam model, and tamping is conducted after the soil sample is made higher than the thin pipe through filling; and secondly, the portion, on the periphery of the thin pipe, of the soil sample is excavated to be spherical, the excavated portion of the soil sample is backfilled again to make a clay layer in the spherical area become looser towards the thin pipe, the simulative ant channel is generated by pulling out the pre-buried thin pipe after filling is completed, and the multiple sets of monitoring sensors are arranged along the simulative ant channel. The testing device can be used for studying preferential flow effects of the upper part defects of the homogeneous dam and the disaster-causing mechanism inducing the seepage failure of the homogeneous dam.

abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 시뮬레이션 기반 능동 대응지침 제시가 가능한 사고대응 시스템을 제공한다. 화재 시뮬레이션 기반 능동 대응지침 제시가 가능한 사고대응 시스템은 선박의 거동 특성 및 소화 설비의 위치 정보가 설정되는 화재 시뮬레이션 데이터 베이스 부와, 화재 발생시 화재 시뮬레이션 데이터 베이스 부로부터 화재 진압 경로 및 대피 경로를 산출하는 제 1사고 대응부와, 산출된 화재 진압 경로 및 대피 경로 확보를 위해 소화 설비의 개폐 지침을 산출하는 제 2사고 대응부와, 화재 발생으로 인한 연기 및 열이 설정된 수준 이상을 이루면, 소화 구역 설정 및 대피 지시를 하는 제 3사고 대응부를 포함한다.

title_en: Typhoon early warning system based on power grid geographical information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a typhoon early warning system based on power grid geographical information. The system comprises a positioning system, a monitoring system connected with the positioning system, an evaluation module connected with the monitoring system and a simulation early warning system connected with the evaluation model. The positioning system employs a GIS power grid platform system for performing coordinate positioning on an early warning area and determines a concrete position the early warning area in a map of the GIS power grid platform system according to coordinates; the monitoring system monitors typhoon information in real time and transmits the information to the evaluation model; the evaluation model, according to the information transmitted by the monitoring system, determines typhoon data, establishes a meteorological layer which is used for presenting basic geological data, typhoon path data, hazard-affected body data and disaster-inducing factor data; and the simulation early warning system inputs a fault route and analyzes and predicts a future development trend of a typhoon according to the meteorological layer by use of an SWAT model. The typhoon early warning system based on the power grid geographical information, provided by the invention, gives an early warning of typhoon information so as to reduce damage caused by the typhoon to people to the lowest.

title_en: Machine room smart 3D inspection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic inspection and specifically relates to a machine room smart 3D inspection system. The system comprises an information collection box, a comprehensive monitoring management platform, a 3D simulation server and a display screen. The information collection box, the comprehensive monitoring management platform, the 3D simulation server and the display screen are electrically connected. According to the machine room smart 3D inspection system provided by the invention, the monitoring center effect of the system is the same to the actual effect; both building appearances and operation states of the devices are consistent; according to the products of the system, the 3D virtual reality displaying effect is finished through adoption of a 3D modeling technology and a high-efficiency displaying engine; parameters, states and alarm of various devices in a machine room are displayed centrally through 3D virtual reality products; the long-term objective evaluation can be carried out on the operation condition of the devices; the power supply security can be ensured by replacing space-time point devices appropriately; moreover, the device investment is reduced; the utilization efficiency of the devices is improved; according to the system, the device operation reliability can be improved; and the occurrence of serious accidents such as fire disasters and personnel casualties can be reduced.

title_en: Assessment system and method for vital area identification using probabilistic safety assessment fault tree in nuclear power plant
title_ko: 원자력발전소에서 확률론적 안전성 평가 고장수목을 이용한 핵심구역 평가 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an assessment system for vital area identification, capable of deriving a response scenario when a core is damaged in a nuclear power plant. The assessment system for vital area identification in the nuclear power plant according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a radioactive information verification unit which verifies whether a radioactive material is leaked; an area classifying unit which classifies an area with a core system of the nuclear power plant into a main area and a dangerous area; and a main area analysis unit which analyzes at least one among a natural disaster and a sabotage behavior in the main area through a fault tree. Therefore, the purpose of the present invention is to provide an assessment system for vital area identification using a probabilistic safety assessment fault tree in the nuclear power plant and a method thereof.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원자력발전소에서 노심 손상 시 대응 시나리오를 도출하기 위한 핵심구역 평가 시스템에 관한 것으로, 방사성 물질의 누출 여부를 확인하는 방사성정보확인부, 원자력발전소 노심의 계통이 존재하는 구역을 사보타주의 행위 및 자연재해 중 적어도 하나에 의해, 방사성 물질이 외부로 누출될 수 있는 어느 하나 이상의 계통이 존재하는 주요구역과, 원자력발전소 정지를 초래하는 모든 비정상 사건인 초기 사건이 해결 가능할 수 있도록 방어해야만 하는 어느 하나 이상의 계통이 존재하는 위험구역으로 분류하는 구역분류부 및 주요구역에서의 사보타주의 행위 및 자연재해 중 적어도 하나를 고장수목을 통해 분석하는 주요구역분석부를 포함하며, 위험구역 중 악의적 행위로 인해 초기사건이 발생되어 해당 구역이 손상될 경우, 노심 손상이 야기되는 구역인 핵심구역을 평가하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 또한, 원자력발전소에서 핵심구역 평가 방법에 있어서, 원자력 시설 정보를 마련하는 단계, 원자력 시설 정보를 기초로 노심손상빈도를 계산하고, 계산된 노심손상빈도를 이용하여 방사성 물질의 재고량을 확인하여 방사선 노출 여부를 판단하는 단계, 방사선이 노출되었을 경우, 그 대응 시나리오가 확률론적안전성평가(PSA) 논리 모델인지 여부를 판단하는 단계, 판단을 기초로 사보타주 고장수목으로 변환하는 단계, 사보타주 고장수목을 기초로 방사능 사보타주를 일으키기 위하여 반드시 접근하여야 하는 공격집합과 방사능 사보타주를 방지하기 위하여 보호해야만 하는 방어집합을 판단하는 단계 및 방어집합 중 우선 순위로 핵심구역을 선정하는 단계를 포함하며, 핵심구역을 물리적으로 방호하도록 보강하는 방법은 여기에 선정된 핵심구역을 물리적으로 방호하도록 보강하는 단계를 더 포함하는 것으로 달성된다.

title_en: Fire-resistant calculation method for stainless steel axial compression member
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-resistant calculation method for a stainless steel axial compression member. The method comprises two parts as follows: a calculation method of ultimate bearing capacity of the stainless steel axial compression member at the high temperature and a calculation method of the critical temperature of the stainless steel axial compression member in a fire disaster. As for the stainless steel axial compression member with the known slenderness ratio and the known temperature, the ultimate bearing capacity of the stainless steel axial compression member at the temperature can be calculated; as for the stainless steel axial compression member with the known slenderness ratio and the known load ratio, the critical temperature at which damage happens can be calculated. The calculation formula of mechanical properties, namely, a high-temperature reduction coefficient and an axial compression stability coefficient, of the stainless steel material is determined according to a large quantity of experiment data and finite element numerical simulation. The method for calculating the ultimate bearing capacity of the stainless steel axial compression member at the high temperature is provided, the critical temperature of the stainless steel axial compression member is provided in a form, and requirements of the stainless steel structure for fire-resistant calculation are met.

title_en: Method for reducing disasters of strong mining earthquake in surrounding cities of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing disasters of strong mining earthquake in surrounding cities of a coal mine. The method comprises steps as follows: man-made space is established by tunneling pressure-relief roadways in a coal seam nearby a stopping line close to an urban area, so that energy in a goaf is slowly released to the man-made space; roof blasting is performed on the goaf without sedimentation, the roof is sedimented in a large area, and a buffer zone is formed; a buffer roadway is tunneled at the bottom of a key vibration rock stratum nearby urban fringe or in an adjacent layer below the rock stratum, roadway roof cutting is performed, and then, backward break-tip blast is performed; a water injection hole is drilled underground in the ground close to the urban area, the hope depth reaches below the fourth-generation weathering zone, water is injected to an incompetent bed below the weathering zone, and the incompetent bed is softened and has the closure and vibration wave intensity relieving functions. With the adoption of the measures, the ground pressure energy is substantially released, the strong mining earthquake cannot affect nearby cities, and destructiveness of the strong mining earthquake to ground buildings is reduced.

title_en: Movable Drilling Control Room and Ship having the same

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a movable drilling control room installed on a deck of a marine structure to move as necessary and a vessel having the same. The movable drilling control room is to protect a human life and properties as the drilling control room is safely evacuated, wherein the drilling control room is always exposed to a situation in which a safety problem, such as blowout of a marine resource through a drill pipe, an emergency situation such as fire by harmful gas or explosive leaking, drop of heavy equipment, and a loss of mud, is predicted. The drilling control room can evacuate to a first deck by the moving device.

title_en: Fire simulation method in virtual reality space

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of simulating a fire in a virtual reality space to describe an actual fire situation in the virtual reality space. The method of simulating a fire in a virtual reality comprises the steps of: generating ignitable objects having a specific volume in corresponding locations by selecting one or more objects that can cause a fire in a virtual reality space; setting ignition spots having ignition scores, which are quantitative criteria for ignition conditions under which the fire occurs from the objects corresponding to the generated ignitable objects, and setting location information and direction information between the ignition spots; simulating the fire by setting that at least one arbitrary ignition spot among the set ignition spots satisfies the ignition conditions; increasing a fire score of other neighboring ignition spots every unit time based on the ignition spot that satisfies the ignition conditions according to the location information and the direction information; and simulating the fire using an ignition spot among the neighboring ignition spots, the accumulated fire score of which reaches a corresponding fire score. Therefore, the present invention helps a trainee be well informed on correct tips for handing real-time evacuation and actions by simulating generations and complexion of a fire in real time in a virtual reality space.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a container state detection type breathing air filler which can supply air whose oxygen and nitrogen concentrations are appropriately adjusted to an air respirator container used by a firefighter or a diving sport, etc., and can efficiently discharge air contained in the air respirator container. The present invention provides a container state detection type breathing air filler which, when separating oxygen and nitrogen used in various fields and applications such as firefighters, diving exercise, medical treatment, industrial use, etc., realizes a membrane type oxygen/nitrogen separator, a multistage compression type high pressure compressor operated by a single driving force, a new function integrated type high pressure air filler adopting a control method capable of adjusting the concentration of oxygen or nitrogen at a ratio of 20 to 90% by volume, and the like, thereby the use of one driving force, and leaves a certain amount of air in a container when discharging air contained in an air respirator container, thereby making the interior of the container in a improving the service life of the container and enabling a user to inhale fresh air, and furthermore, when discharging air contained in the air respirator container, measuring corroded powder in the air by using a fine dust sensor located in the air discharge duct to enable the state of the container to be checked, i.e., the degree of corrosion of the container, it is possible to provide the user with information on foreign matters in the container related to safe use of the container, and can prevent in advance an explosion accident or the like of the container which becomes fragile due to title_en: Disaster filed situation change-based people flow evacuation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster filed situation change-based people flow evacuation method. The method includes the following steps that: S1, a people flow evacuation dynamics model is initialized; S2, whether pedestrians exist in a dangerous area is judged, if the pedestrians exist in the dangerous area, a pedestrian is randomly selected from the dangerous area, so that the method enters S3, if the pedestrians do not exist in the dangerous area, a pedestrian with a minimum static field situation value is selected, and the method enters S3; S3, whether eight grids which are adjacent to a grid where the pedestrian is located are occupied is judged, if the eight grids which are adjacent to the grid where the pedestrian is located are occupied, the method returns to S2, otherwise, the method enters S4; S4, the transition probabilities P (x, y) of the pedestrian moving to the eight grids are calculated; and S5, a maximum value is selected from the eight transition probabilities P (x, y) obtained in the step S4, and the pedestrian is moved to a corresponding target grid, and the method returns to S2 until evacuation terminates. Compared with the prior art, the invention can simulate the statuses of people in an emergency disaster scene more effectively, obtain the law of the evacuation behaviors of the peoples more comprehensively and have an important auxiliary effect for improving the evacuation efficiency and safety of the people.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency evacuation passage installed in a slab or a wall dividing each household of an apartment building. More specifically, an objective of the present invention is to drill a hole in a wall where an evacuation passage is not constructed to construct an evacuation passage, and delay evacuation for a prescribed period of time to prevent serious invasion of privacies of different households when an evacuating person evacuates to different households in case of fire. To achieve this objective, the emergency evacuation passage comprises: a hole formed in a wall dividing households; an expandable wall positioned in the hole, and expanded or contracted by a filler filled therein; a support frame to support the expandable wall to allow the expanded expandable wall to be positioned in the hole to close the hole; a cover which fits a side of the support frame corresponding to both sides of the hole; and a first pad positioned between the cover and the expandable wall.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공동주택의 각 세대를 구획하는 벽체 또는 슬라브에 설치되는 비상대피통로에 관한 것으로서, 특히 대피통로가 시공되지 않은 벽체에 구멍을 뚫어 시공 가능하도록 구성되며, 화재 시에 대피자가 타 세대로 대피함에 있어 타 세대원의 심각한 사생활 침해가 발생하지 않도록 일정시간 대피를 지연할 수 있게 구성한 것이다. 
상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 삽입식 비상대피통로는 세대를 구획하는 벽에 형성된 구멍과, 구멍에 위치하며 내부에 채워지는 충진재에 의해 팽창하거나 수축하는 신축벽과, 팽창된 신축벽이 구멍 내부에 위치하여 구멍을 폐쇄하도록 지지하는 지지프레임과, 구멍의 양측에 대응하는 지지프레임의 측부에 정합하는 뚜껑과, 뚜껑과 신축벽의 사이에 위치하는 제1패드를 포함하는 것을 기술적 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Interactive method for simulating mine disaster escape training
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interactive method for simulating mine disaster escape training. An escape training system employed by the interactive method is composed of a piece of virtual reality glasses, an omnibearing VR treadmill, a somatosensory interactive device and a computer. The omnibearing VR treadmill controls a motion of a person model in a virtual reality mine scene according to a moving state of a human body; the somatosensory interactive device carries out human body skeleton tracking and gesture identification to complete correlated interaction operations of the person model in the virtual reality mine scene; and then real-time information of a three-dimensional virtual mine is outputted by the virtual reality glasses, so that a trainee completes virtual reality mine escape training based on omnibearing reality situation simulation. Therefore, a trainer can carry out the operation of accurate reduction of a real fire situation in situ and the training experience is good.

title_en: Thin-layer limestone ground directional drilling horizontal multi-stage branch grouting drill hole
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thin-layer limestone ground directional drilling horizontal multi-stage branch grouting drill hole. The thin-layer limestone ground directional drilling horizontal multi-stage branch grouting drill hole comprises a ground main hole. The ground main hole vertically extends to the underground, penetrates through a vertically-drilled straight hole section of a base rock layer from the ground to the underground and downwards penetrates through an ash consequently-drilled bedding section along a coal bed. A kickoff point is arranged at the end, away from the ground and close to the coal bed, of the straight hole section. Inclined drilling is conducted between the kickoff point and the middle of lime-cement-flyash below the coal bed, so that a directional inclination guide section is formed. The two ends of the directional inclination guide section communicate with the straight hole section and the bedding section correspondingly. The main hole bedding section is divided into a plurality of first and second stage branch holes distributed in a fan shape in the approximately horizontal direction of the bedding section. By adopting the technical scheme, compared with the former conventional water control technology, the safe reliability is greatly improved, deep mining bottom plate limestone water disaster governance is achieved, bottom plate water disaster accidents are avoided, and safety production is ensured.
assignees: HUAIBEI MINING IND CO LTD;XI'AN RES INST OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENG GROUP CORP

title_en: Method for improving shade tolerance of maize inbred lines
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving shade tolerance of maize inbred lines, and belongs to the technical field of maize breeding. Specifically, an inbred line B (as a male parent) with strong shade tolerance and an inbred line A (as a female parent) with weak shade tolerance are used for forming a crossing combination A*B; A is used as a backcross parent under the condition of artificial simulated shading; after backcrossing for two generations, individual plants which have relatively short male and female interval and are similar to the inbred line A are selected under the condition of artificial simulated shading to perform successive inbreeding for three to four generations, so as to improve the shade tolerance of the inbred line A. The method provided by the invention is short in time for improving the inbred line with weak shade tolerance, low in cost and high in efficiency, overcomes a defect that the bred new maize varieties are intolerant to shade, accelerates breeding of maize shade-tolerant varieties, enhances the capability of new maize varieties to resist rainy sparse sunlight disaster, and mitigates disaster losses.

title_en: Metro platform fire emergency hedging, self rescue and safety evacuation command system
abstract_en: The invention provides a metro platform fire emergency hedging, self rescue and safety evacuation command system which comprises a metro platform rapid evacuation platform, a disaster monitoring and sound-light alarm device and a ground emergency command center. A hedging, self rescue and evacuation device on a metro ceiling is in linkage with the disaster monitoring and sound-light alarm device. When the monitoring device monitors that hazardous gas exceeds standards, a metro platform can display the parameters of the gas exceeding standards and give an alarm immediately, escape masks automatically fall off and are dispensed to personnel on the metro platform, an escape mask box door on the side face of a pedestrian path is automatically opened for breathing and communication of personnel in the path, and escape masks can automatically fall off for breathing and communication of passengers in a train. Poison avoiding, breathing and self rescue can be immediately achieved without walking, and poison avoiding and breathing safety indexes on an evacuation passage are provided; a whole-group rapid whole evacuation passage is opened, and personal safety of personnel in the train is ensured; and the online hedging and escape training function for consuming personnel in the train can be achieved through APP. The metro platform fire emergency hedging, self rescue and safety evacuation command system is simple in structure, convenient to install, convenient and fast to use, economical and practical.

title_en: Campus training room management platform
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a campus training room management platform. Through mutual cooperation of a security management system, a background management system, and campus smart cards storing identity information, video monitoring, firefighting monitoring, and automatic management of training rooms can be realized, convenience, security, and rapidness are achieved, technical problems of low opening rate of the training rooms and low resource utilization rate due to locking management of the training rooms and lack of firefighting and monitoring equipment are solved, the demand of too much training operation time for students is met, and the improvement of the professional operation ability for the students can be facilitated. The campus training room management platform comprises the security management system, the background management system, and the campus smart cards storing the identity information.

title_en: Text emotion classification method based on the joint deep learning model
abstract_en: The invention provides a text emotion classification method based on the joint deep learning model which relates to the text emotion classification method. The method is designed with the object of solving the problems with the dimension disaster and sparse data incurred from the existing support vector machine and other shallow layer classification methods. The method comprises: 1) processing each word in the text data; using the word2vec tool to train each processed word in the text data so as to obtain a word vector dictionary; 2) obtaining the matrix M of each sentence; training the matrix M by the LSTM layer and converting it into vector with fixed dimensions; improving the input layer; generating d-dimensional h word vectors with context semantic relations; 3) using a CNN as a trainable characteristic detector to extract characteristics from the d-dimensional h word vectors with context semantic relations; and 4) connecting the extracted characteristics in order; outputting to obtain the probability of each classification wherein the classification with the maximal probability value is the predicated classification. The invention is applied to the natural language processing field.

title_en: Analogue test system is mineed, is filled to deep coal seam strip
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an analogue test system is mineed, is filled to deep coal seam strip relates to evolution of deep rock mass crack and the field of water disaster prevention and cure suddenly. It has been solved among the prior art the rock mass of deep high pressure -bearing coal seam on water exploitation break law, crack evolution characteristic and fill and prevent the basic research who suddenly combines together this major issue not enough relatively. Its testing system includes bearing box, test model, filling system, and test model is located bearing box, and test model includes rock stratum and the coal seam that is arranged in the rock stratum, and the rock stratum is laid by similar material and is formed, is equipped with water seal device around the rock stratum, at the inside a plurality of plastics balls burying a plurality of sensors underground and be equipped with the calcium oxide granule in rock stratum, arrange through a plurality of loading pneumatophores and simulate in the coal seam. The utility model discloses testing system can simulate the difference and adopt and stay ratio, difference to adopt the exploitation of thick coal seam, and still can study the difference and adopt and stay ratio, difference to adopt high seam exploitation back, and the atress and the displacement law of goaf filling houding bottom plate.

title_en: Pneumatic water in colliery and buggy solid -liquid separation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a coal mine equipment technical field, concretely relates to pneumatic water in colliery and buggy solid -liquid separation equipment. It has realized still can using in natural moisture content higher coal seam the drill chip method to distinguish the power disaster danger degree in colliery to eliminate the potential safety hazard, be favorable to the safety in production in colliery. The technical scheme of the utility model including the open shell in upper end, the bottom of shell be provided with pneumatic device, pneumatic device's air -supply line wear to locate the lateral wall of shell, pneumatic device upper portion be provided with the casing that catchments, the uncovered department in upper end of the casing that catchments is provided with sealed lid, the bottom of the casing that catchments is provided with the outlet pipe, the inside of the casing that catchments is provided with rotatable rotatory separable set, the casing that catchments was upwards passed to the axis of rotation of pneumatic device upper end bottom surface with rotate separable set and be connected and drive it at the casing internal rotation that catchments.

title_en: Somatic virtual reality space system
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a somatic virtual reality space system in which a user is capable of responding to an emergency situation. Provided is a somatic virtual reality space system 1, comprising special-purpose software 3 which allows a three-dimensional virtual reality program to be installed, and a user-specific device 4 which is worn by a user and which allows a virtual reality space to be experienced on the basis of the three-dimensional virtual reality program. The user-specific device 4 converts data which is converted into three dimensions in the three-dimensional virtual reality program into a four-dimensional panorama of up-down, left-right, fore-aft, and time, at infinite coordinates, and configures the virtual reality space so as to continuously change in response to the actions of the user. The user-specific device 4 further comprises an emergency response function 10.

title_en: Multi -functional outdoor bag
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi -functional outdoor bag has solved in the field, and the equipment that produces at present the naked light is lighter, match etc. For example, all easy under the environment of humidity unable the use, so the certain difficulty that leads to the fact for outdoor use. title_en: How to install solar panels on buildings
title_ko: 건물에 태양광 패널 설치방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for installing a photovoltaic panel in a building that can be used as a shelter in a fire by installing a photovoltaic panel on a window or a wall of a skyscraper building and a window or a wall of an apartment building, and can grow flowers by putting a flowerpot on the photovoltaic panel. The method comprises: measuring a distance on a left side and a right side of an upper bracket attached on a wall to attach a nut on the wall after inserting a bolt into a hole; and fixing the bolt and nut by drilling a hole.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택 창문이나 벽에 그리고 고층건물 창문이나 벽에 태양광 패널을 설치하여 화재시 대피소로 사용할 수 있으며, 화분을 올려놓고 화초도 재배할 수 있는 건물에 태양광 패널 설치 방법에 관한 것이다

title_ko: 운항 중인 선박에서 실시간 업데이트 가능한 선원 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sailor training system capable of updating educational content in real time when training sailors in a sailing ship. The present invention has the following effects. In other words, it is possible to update template-based training content that standardizes the training content about the emergency response tips for each type of accident, ship operation procedures and the like. It is possible to reduce the amount of data transmitted and received during online education because of an interactive training system. It is possible to provide good-quality education in a sailing ship while reducing the cost of satellite communications. The sailor training system includes a land server, a satellite terminal, and a ship PC.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 운항 중인 선박 환경에서 선원 교육을 할 때 교육컨텐츠의 내용을 실시간으로 업데이트 할 수 있는 선원 교육 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 다음과 같은 효과를 발휘한다. 
즉, 사고 종류별 비상 대응 요령, 선박 업무 절차 등에 대한 교육 콘텐츠를 표준화한 템플릿 기반의 교육 콘텐츠를 실시간으로 업데이트 할 수 있고, 양방향 교육이 가능한 시스템으로 인해, 온라인 교육의 통신시 송수신되는 데이터량을 최소화 함으로써 위성통신비용을 줄이면서도, 운항 중 선박의 환경에서도 양질의 교육을 제공할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Personnel evacuation simulation method and device, aid decision making method and system and emergency platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a personnel evacuation simulation method and device, an aid decision making method and system and an emergency platform. According to the personnel evacuation simulation method, personnel evacuation simulation is performed with a community composed of multiple buildings being a unit. The personnel evacuation simulation method comprises the steps that each building in the community is abstracted into a network node, and evacuation simulation is performed on multiple nodes in the community in parallel; an evacuation process in each node is disintegrated into an evacuation reaction process, a walk process and a congestion process in series, and evacuation time in each node is calculated; a first node with the longest evacuation time is searched for among all the network nodes in the community; and total evacuation time of the whole community is determined according to the evacuation time of the first node. According to the personnel evacuation simulation method and device, personnel evacuation with the community being the unit can be realized, few parameters need to be input, calculation speed is high, and the personnel evacuation simulation method and device can be applied to practical emergency decision making.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;BEIJING GLOBAL SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Damage Control Management System Capable of Realistic Damage Control On Board Training for Naval Ships
title_ko: 실전적 손상통제 함상훈련 기능을 갖춘 함정 손상통제관리시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a vessel damage control management system having a practical damage control on-board training function, which comprises: a damage prediction module predicting damage to a virtual disaster when the virtual disaster is defined; a damage detection sensor virtual regeneration module virtually generating detection data of a damage detection sensor in accordance with damage predicted by a damage prediction module; and a damage control management server generating and displaying damage situation data including a type and a range of damage according to the virtual detection data virtually generated by the damage detection sensor virtual regeneration module.
abstract_ko: 가상 재해가 정의되면, 가상 재해에 대한 손상을 예측하는 손상 예측 모듈,손상 예측 모듈에 의해 예측된 손상에 부합하도록 손상 감지 센서의 감지 데이터를 가상으로 생성하는 손상 감지센서 가상재현 모듈, 및 손상 감지센서 가상재현 모듈에 의해 가상으로 생성된 가상 감지 데이터에 따라서 손상 상황 데이터 - 손상의 종류 및 손상의 범위를 포함 - 를 생성하여 표시하는 손상통제관리 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 실전적 손상통제 함상훈련 기능을 갖춘 함정 손상통제관리시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Method for manufacturing wooden door
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building doors and windows, in particular to a method for manufacturing a wooden door, which comprises the following steps: the filling material preparation step: selecting expanded vermiculite, ammonium polyphosphate, pentaerythritol, melamine, perlite and alum, and uniformly mixing; the manufacturing steps of the door frame are as follows: selecting a steel rectangular pipe, welding the steel rectangular pipe into a door frame, uniformly drilling blind holes on the outer side surface of the door frame, filling filler in the blind holes, then adhering a fixing layer on the outer side surface of the door frame, and plugging the filler in the blind holes; a door body manufacturing step: selecting a steel rectangular pipe, welding the steel rectangular pipe into a metal frame, uniformly drilling blind holes in the side surface of the metal frame, filling filler in the blind holes, selecting wood strips, embedding the wood strips in the side surface of the metal frame, connecting a vertical beam made of a metal material in the middle tenon-and-mortise of the metal frame, and connecting a cross beam made of the metal material between the vertical beam and the metal frame in the tenon-and-mortise manner. The invention provides a method for manufacturing a wooden door, aiming at the technical problem that the existing wooden door is easy to become flame fuel when a fire disaster happens.

title_en: System for predicting development trend of ice disaster on power transmission line
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a system for predicting development trend of ice disaster on power transmission line. The system comprises a simulation system of simulation calculation of ice increase on wires and a database of icing characteristics on power transmission line, the simulation system of simulation calculation of ice increase on wires comprises a parameter recording module, a numerical calculation module, a data classification module, a data output module, and a graphical display module in sequence electrically connected. The system for predicting the development trend of ice disaster on power transmission line utilizes basic geographical information data, historical and meteorological data of power transmission corridor, on the basis of building a numerical simulation model for the process of icing on wires, calculates and analyzes the degree of influence of temperature, wind speed and the diameter of water drop and the like on the strength of ice cover and the rate of local collisions in icing process when over cooling water droplets collide the surface of wires, further completes the prediction of disaster development trend of icing on wires, and derives diagnosis advice and provides reference bases for detecting icing on power transmission line.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Experimental device for studying wind current motion state under various disaster-causing factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device for the wind current motion state under various disaster-causing factors, which comprises an impact power system, an air impact roadway system, a parallel roadway system and a data acquisition and analysis system, and is characterized in that a roadway simulation device and a data acquisition system form the integrated experimental device for studying the wind current motion state under various disaster-causing factors together. The experimental device is mainly applied to studying various disaster-causing factors and different types of roadway wind current catastrophes. The experimental device is novel in design and solves a problem that only the wind current motion state under the action of a single disaster-causing factor is studied before. Process monitoring for the wind current catastrophes is realized through adjustment of the experimental device and application of a monitoring sensor and the data acquisition system, the motion state of the catastrophe wind current can be analyzed, a study is performed on movement laws of different types of catastrophe wind currents, the whole operating process is completed in the same experimental device, and the study for a wind current movement law under various disaster-causing factors is realized.

title_en: Method and system for people evacuation simulation under emergencies
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and system for people evacuation simulation under emergencies. The method comprises the steps of obtaining outlet information in an evacuating scene in real time, taking the center of an outlet as the circle center, performing radiation sending of the outlet information within a first range with a visual range as the radius; causing individuals in the first range to completely receive the outlet information; transmitting the complete outlet information to an area outside the first range; causing the individuals outside the first range to obtain the outlet information through a neighbor individual, wherein the outlet information is spread between individuals in the form of credibility gradually reduced outside the first range; according to the outlet information received by each individual, adopting a social force model to calculate individual speed and direction in real time, and achieving simulation of people evacuation behaviors. According to the method and system for people evacuation simulation under the emergencies, by introducing a transmission mechanism with information loss, the learning of the evacuating environment by the individuals is simulated, and scientific instruction of an emergency safe evacuation plan can be achieved.

title_en: Method and device for testing water spray insulated electrified extinguishment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power fire disaster electrified extinguishment, and discloses a method and device for testing water spray insulated electrified extinguishment so as to guide the development, application and standard establishment of spray electrified extinguishment technologies and equipment. The testing method comprises the steps of setting the occurrence working condition of the water spray through a spray occurrence module, uniting the application working condition of the simulation electrified extinguishment through an experiment simulation electrode and a draught fan and a wind speed control module; measuring the spray drop diameter and concentration of the water spray respectively through a spray drop diameter and concentration measurement module on the spraying path sprayed by the water spray towards the experiment simulation electrode; measuring the breakdown voltage and the leakage current of the water spray respectively under the application working condition of the simulation electrified extinguishment through a breakdown voltage measuring module and a leakage current measuring module; comparing and analyzing the influence of the corresponding occurrence working condition, application working condition and/or water agent categories on the electrified extinguishment ability of the water spray by changing the occurrence working condition and the application working condition of the water spray and any kind or any combination in the water agent categories.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO DISASTER PREVENTION & REDUCTION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;HUNAN XIANGDIAN TRIAL RES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Weak layer-containing defect type side slope sliding indoor simulation device and measurement method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weak layer-containing defect type side slope sliding indoor simulation device and a method. The device comprises a side slope model, an infrared thermal imager, a continuous video camera, an information regulator and a computer, wherein the infrared thermal imager and the continuous video camera are connected with the information regulator respectively; the information regulator is connected with the computer; a side slope model comprises a sliding body, a weak layer, a sliding bed and a base; the sliding bed is mounted on a base; the sliding body cooperates with the sliding bed; the weak layer is positioned between the sliding body and the sliding bed; and a heating plate is arranged on the lower part of the weak layer and connected with a temperature sensor and a temperature controller. In the invention, a side slope model preparation method can subtly reflect the key influence of a weak layer in the side slope on landslide disaster; and in the model test process, the continuous video camera technology and infrared thermal imaging technology are adopted to perform seamless recording of the whole test process, the test recording result is intuitive with large information amount, and the processing, analysis and study of the test result are facilitated.

title_en: Method and system for implementing three-dimensional virtual fire drill on basis of Unity 3D
abstract_en: The invention aims to relate to a method and system for implementing a three-dimensional virtual fire drill on the basis of Unity 3D and effectively solve the technical problems of simulation on a vivid environment, simulation on a dynamic change of a fire behavior and simulation on an escaping personnel damage degree in the background art. A three-dimensional model is established on the basis of real figure and scene data, a fire behavior algorithm for controlling a dynamic change of the fire behavior and smoke is designed, control on the fire behavior and the smoke is implemented by utilizing the algorithm, design can show a blood bar representing a damage degree of a figure character by the fire and the smoke, the damage degree of the figure character is reflected by the dynamic change of the blood bar, a figure damage algorithm of the damage degree of the figure character by the fire and the smoke is designed, and according to the figure damage algorithm, the dynamic variation of the blood bar is controlled by utilizing C# programming. According to the method and system disclosed by the invention, a user can relatively really feel firefighting simulation in a virtual environment, and firefighting skills of the user are increased.

title_en: Mud-rock flow disaster process rapid simulation and visualization analysis method in network environment
abstract_en: The present invention belongs to the geographic information system virtual geographical environment research field, and especially relates to a mud-rock flow disaster simulation and visualization analysis technology. The present invention provides a mud-rock flow disaster process rapid simulation and visualization analysis method in a network environment. The method performs tight integration of the model, the visualization and the analysis and provides a parameter visualization arrangement interface to facilitate obtaining and setting of parameters; and moreover, the mud-rock flow disaster process rapid simulation and visualization analysis method in the network environment employs a parallel optimization method and a scale optimization selection method to greatly improve the accuracy and efficiency of the simulation calculation, the visualization and the analysis of the mud-rock flow disaster, constructs the network service and provides sharing and publishing of the disaster situation information so as to effectively support the emergency disposal of the mud-rock flow disaster.

title_en: Ground surface simulating device and experiment method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are a ground surface simulating device and an experiment method thereof. A sample separation plate is arranged in an experimental box, probers are arranged at the bottom of the experimental box, a rack-gear transmission assembly is arranged on one external side of the experimental box and is connected with a motor, a three-dimensional scanner is arranged on the motor, vibrators are arranged at the lower end of the sample separation plate, and the vibrators, the motor and the three-dimensional scanner are controlled by a computer. Through modeling, probing, scanning and final data analyzing, ground surface settlement data and analyzer rules can be obtained, and scientific bases can be provided for prediction of geological disasters caused by ground surface settlement.

title_en: Train impact model testing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a train impact model testing device. The train impact model testing device is characterized in that the central part of a table board is provided with an I-shaped steel bar for simulating a rail, and a train formation model is installed on the I-shaped steel bar; two sides of the front part of the train formation model are provided with wing plates, and impact cylinders are fixed on the table board right behind the wing plates; the impact cylinders are connected with an air compressor; an angle-adjustable rigid baffle plate which simulates the tunnel side wall is arranged on the table board in front of the train formation model, and the rigid baffle plate is provided with a force transducer; and two laser emitters are installed on the table board at one side of the front part of the I-shaped steel bar, and two laser inductors are correspondingly installed on the table board at the other side. The train impact model testing device can simulate the impact of the train formation to the tunnel side wall at different speeds and different impact angles, the impact force generated when the train derails and impacts a tunnel is obtained, a more accurate and reliable test basis can be provided for the anti-impact design and construction of the tunnel, and therefore the case that the train derails and impacts the tunnel, the tunnel is severely damaged, and secondary disasters such as flood disasters are induced can be avoided, and injuries, deaths and loss caused by accidents can be reduced.

title_en: Power transmission line geological disaster monitoring method using unmanned aerial vehicle to mark images
abstract_en: The invention provides a power transmission line geological disaster monitoring method using an unmanned aerial vehicle to mark images. The method includes the following steps that: the unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to acquire reference power transmission line images and mark the images; k-medoids cluster analysis is performed on the reference power transmission line images, so that a training set is obtained; the unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to acquire target power transmission line images and mark the images; classification detection is performed according to the training set; and a geological disaster site is obtained according to the detection result of the classification detection. Unmanned aerial vehicle power transmission line inspection can effectively and quickly cover areas around a power transmission line, achieve ground feature high resolution, complete image marking, and provide a better data source for geological hazard detection so as to improve the accuracy of geological disaster detection; and real-time image marking can be completed in an unmanned aerial vehicle image acquisition process so as to assist analysis after disaster detection. With the above steps of the method of the invention adopted, power transmission line geological disaster monitoring can be competed fast.

title_en: Mountain fire disaster development tendency simulating and predicting method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountain fire disaster development tendency simulating and predicting method and device. The method comprises the steps of collecting fire scene dynamic data in real time; dynamically processing the fire scene dynamic data; according to the dynamically processed fire scene dynamic data and fire scene static data, adaptively selecting a mountain fire disaster development tendency model from a model library; according to the mountain fire disaster development tendency model, conducting mountain fire spreading simulation; according to a mountain fire spreading simulation result, predicting a mountain fire disaster development tendency. The geographical simulation system theory and dynamic data driven application system DDDAS technological paradigm provides a completely new thought for studies and simulation of a geographical complexity system. A geographical simulation system aims at solving the problem that the analysis ability of a GIS to the geographical spatial system process is week at present and helping predict development directions and evolutionary processes of geographic phenomena and objects; a dynamic data driven application system introduces dynamic measurement data into a simulation process, so that the instantaneity and the dynamic nature of simulation are achieved and the simulation precision is improved.

title_en: A kind of consideration wind pressure relevance and wind speed direction metal Roof disaster caused by a windstorm estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of consideration wind pressure relevances and wind speed direction metal Roof disaster caused by a windstorm estimation method, estimate the charming appearance and behaviour loss of metal structure roof boarding.In calculating process, the external wind pressure of roofing is obtained using POD interpolation；Internal pressure is obtained by simulation；Roof boarding connecting elements internal force is calculated using face method is influenced, and corresponding extreme value internal force is acquired by Gumbel conversion；With Monte Carlo simulation, roof boarding failure probability and integral roofing loss late are estimated, wherein connecting elements internal force correlation is considered by Nataf transformation；By the directionality of wind in view of obtaining the integrated charming appearance and behaviour earthquake loss estimation methodology of metal roofing board in charming appearance and behaviour estimated amount of damage.The method of the present invention carries out the reconstruction of roofing external wind pressure by POD method interpolation, to consider existing relevance between wind pressure, influence of the wind load correlation for roof boarding charming appearance and behaviour loss appraisal is quantified, and at the same time considering that wind pressure relevance and wind speed direction carry out charming appearance and behaviour estimated amount of damage to sheet-metal roofing.

title_en: Method and device for predicting ice coating disaster development trend of electric transmission line
abstract_en: An embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for predicting ice coating disaster development trend of an electric transmission line. The method includes the steps: performing mesh division for a calculation area; performing air flow field calculation based on mesh division to obtain flow field speed distribution; calculating water droplet collision trajectories according to the flow field speed distribution; performing simulation for motion of lead surface water membranes according to the water droplet collision trajectories to obtain ice coating increase quantity; acquiring ice coating surface according to ice coating increase quantity, and constructing an ice coating structure. According to the method and the device, a numerical model of a super-cooling water droplet collision lead in the ice coating process of the lead is compiled based on calculation and research of ice coating theories of the lead, two random feedback water droplet positions are interpolated into mesh nodes by the model, local collision positions of super-cooling water droplets are acquired, and the ice coating process of the lead is simulated.

title_en: A kind of injection increases material molding geotechnical model material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A kind of injection increasing material molding geotechnical model material, is made of the raw material of following mass parts: 60-85 parts of rock-soil material, 15-40 parts of additive, the rock-soil material is micro-nano powder, and the additive can bond rock-soil material, while rock-soil material being enable to flow printing.The invention also includes the preparation methods that injection increases material molding geotechnical model material.Ground simulation material of the invention meets physical and mechanical properties requirement, fidelity is high, method of the invention passes through digitlization 3D model, combining powder injection and slurry injection, realize real-time mixing, the accuracy of simulation is improved, the generation reduction degree of engineering and disaster is promoted, plays an important role to the generation and engineering protection of hazard prediction.

title_en: Deep water shallow layer geological disaster simulation system
abstract_en: The application provides a deep water shallow layer geological disaster simulation system. The system comprises: the system comprises a preselected outdoor experimental site, a preselected simulation stratum and a preselected simulation stratum, wherein the preselected outdoor experimental site is sequentially provided with a first simulation stratum, a simulated stratum containing shallow gas, a simulated stratum containing sand, a simulated stratum containing shallow flow and a second simulation stratum; the signal transmitter is positioned at one end, close to the second simulated stratum, of the preselected outdoor experimental site; the signal receiver is positioned at one end, close to the first simulated stratum, of the preselected outdoor experimental site; a signal transmission and reception control system; one end of the first embedded injection pipeline is positioned in the shallow layer flow simulation stratum, and the other end of the first embedded injection pipeline is connected with a booster pump; one end of the second embedded injection pipeline is positioned in the shallow gas-containing simulated stratum, and the other end of the second embedded injection pipeline is connected with the supercharging air pump; and a compact argillaceous sealing device is arranged at the boundary of the shallow gas-containing simulated formation and the shallow flow-containing simulated formation. By utilizing the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, the matching degree of the simulated deep-water shallow geological disaster simulation system and the actual deep-water shallow geological disaster can be improved.

title_en: The monitoring system of the cruiseway Simulations of Water Waves Due To Landslides based on big data treatment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of monitoring system of the cruiseway Simulations of Water Waves Due To Landslides based on big data treatment, including remote server and monitoring device, the monitoring device includes acquisition module, processor, locating module and communication module, and the monitoring device is arranged at cruiseway monitoring node；The monitoring system of the cruiseway Simulations of Water Waves Due To Landslides based on big data treatment in the present invention, monitoring device is arranged by cruiseway monitoring node, can be with the water surface ripple state of real-time monitoring cruiseway, professional measurement means are combined with big data application, with real-time, high efficiency, the advantages of accuracy, the monitoring and early warning in terms of other geological disasters and Oceanic disasters can be promoted the use of, with researching value higher.

title_en: A kind of method of high pressure water injection prevention and treatment gas and coal dust
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of methods of high pressure water injection prevention and treatment gas and coal dust, it is related to a kind of method of coal-bed flooding prevention and treatment gas and coal dust, steps are as follows: construction concordant extraction borehole is inserted into drainage tube in drilling, and close encapsulation drilling and sealing section starts draining coal seam gas；It regard the second drilling as water injection hole, removes the second extraction pipeline and the second orifice flowmeter connected on the second drainage tube, expansion hole packer is inserted into the second drainage tube；Hole packer will be expanded by high-pressure rubber pipe successively to connect with high pressure valve, water injection manifold meter, high pressure water-injection pump and underground water supplying pipe；Implement coal-bed flooding to the second drilling using high pressure water-injection pump；High pressure valve is closed.This method is alternately arranged implementation coal-bed flooding using note-draining borehole, and the gas drainage amount of adjacent extraction borehole can be improved, and reduces gas emission when digging, improve the water content in coal seam, dust concentration when digging is reduced, improves staff's operating environment, effectively prevents mine gas coal dust disaster.

title_en: Disaster recovery management system and management method based on activity
abstract_en: The invention provides an activity-based disaster recovery management system, which comprises a flow module, a mapping module, a remote access module and a service logic module which are sequentially connected; the flow module is used for defining a business flow model and driving each business logic to execute according to a predefined flow through an activity flow engine; the mapping module is used for recording the mapping relation between each task node in the flow module and specific service logic; the remote access module is used for providing a connection channel for switching the management server to the remote host; the service logic module is used for simulating an administrator to send an operation instruction to the equipment and judging an execution result of the instruction through response information of the equipment or equipment state change. The invention provides an activity-based disaster recovery management method.

title_en: Technique and equipment for preventing coal rock dynamic disaster by coal rock mass impact for mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a technology and equipment for preventing coal-rock dynamic disasters by impact of a coal-rock body for mining. The technique radially integrates a plurality of pneumatic impactor members into a tubular device, radially impacting the borehole wall with the impactor members; the generated high-strength stress wave is transmitted in the coal rock mass and causes tension, compression and shearing damage to the coal rock mass; finally, a fracture network in a certain range around the drill hole is rapidly developed, so that the pressure of the coal rock body is effectively relieved, the gas desorption and seepage are promoted, the gas content of the coal bed is reduced, the stress in the coal body is released, and the coal rock dynamic disasters such as coal and gas outburst and rock burst are prevented.

title_en: A kind of coal mine gob hurricane disaster method for early warning based on goaf pressure monitoring
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of coal mine gob hurricane disaster method for early warning based on goaf pressure monitoring, belongs to coal mining technology field.It includes the steps of determining that some working face thickness value, broken swollen coefficient, the rock mass bulk density of rock mass is obtained by working face drilling rock stratum column data and in conjunction with Mechanics Parameters of Rock Mass test experiments；Step 2: goaf pressure cushion is arranged inside goaf, goaf pressure cushion is connect with pressure transmitter, the signal of pressure transmitter is transmitted through the cable to the data acquisition substation being located in tunnel, obtains goaf pressure value, rock mass can be obtained and be caving height and goaf internal voids Δ；Step 3: tight roof maximum immunity value Smax can be calculated in combination with mechanics of materials formula；Δ and maximum immunity value Smax are compared, are then the goaf hurricane disaster early warning moment as Δ >=0.8Smax.The present invention is based on a kind of simple installation, the goaf pressure monitorings that easy to operate, implementation cost is low to realize to goaf hurricane disaster early warning.

title_en: Million-kilowatt-class nuclear power station emergency data acquisition system
abstract_en: The invention provides a million-kilowatt-class nuclear power station emergency data acquisition system comprising an operation set key data acquisition module, an operation set key data transmission channel, a personnel counting data acquisition module, a personnel counting data transmission channel, an analog machine data acquisition module, an analog machine data transmission channel, a data receiving and processing module and a display module. According to the system, the dedicated transmission channel is set for different data so that reduction of the transmission efficiency caused by format difference of the data can be avoided. Meanwhile, the data acquisition error caused by dispersed physical addresses and different data acquisition modes of all the data sources can also be overcome. The million-kilowatt-class nuclear power station emergency data acquisition system is used for acquisition and monitoring of the operation data of a nuclear power plant, and data input is provided for nucleus emergency drilling, nuclear accident response and result analysis and other systematic work. The availability and the real-time performance of a command system can be greatly enhanced for successful implementation of emergency drilling and accident response of a nuclear power plant emergency command platform, and a powerful technical support platform is also provided for emergency response personnel.

title_en: Surface drilling pre-splitting blasting shallow burying method for room type goaf roof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface drilling pre-splitting blasting shallow burying method for a room type goaf roof and belongs to a roof disaster preventing and controlling method for milling of a short distance coal bed below a shallowly-buried goaf. During long wall milling of the short distance coal bed below the shallowly-buried room type goaf, main roof large-area pressure coming happens easily, the yielding damage happens to a small-size coal column under the fracture load of a main roof, a large-size coal column has an elastic kernel and acts the concentrated stress on a lower coal bed work face hydraulic support, and collapse of a work face inner roof, pushing down of a support, hurricane impacting and other disasters are caused. According to the method, drilling pre-splitting blasting of the roof is performed on the ground, the problems that construction is difficult and the effective distance of drilling is short during forced caving of room penetrating type drilling pre-splitting blasting of the goaf are solved, roof large-area pressure coming, roof collapse, pushing down of the support and other disasters can be effectively prevented, and the method is also applicable to milling of lower coal beds of concentrated coal columns of a shallowly-buried long-wall goaf. The method is simple in implementation process, safe and efficient and has wide applicability.

title_en: Small-caliber drilling combined slide-resistant pile design method based on optimal distance-diameter ratio
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for designing a small-caliber drilling combined slide-resistant pile based on an optimal distance-diameter ratio, which comprises the following steps of: carrying out geotechnical engineering geological investigation on the landslide, determining the arrangement position of the small-caliber combined slide-resistant pile and the parameters of a rock-soil body, calculating the residual sliding force, and setting the diameter of the drilling combined slide-resistant pile; and calculating the optimal distance-diameter ratio of the soil arch effect according to the properties of the landslide rock-soil mass, and determining the distance and the row number between the single piles. The invention utilizes the concept of the optimal distance-diameter ratio and considers the optimal pile spacing of the soil body between the piles to form the soil arch effect, thereby fully utilizing the anti-sliding capability of the soil body between the piles, reducing the structural reinforcement of the pile body and improving the engineering economy; the method adopts experience value to set the pile diameter, utilizes numerical analysis to calculate reasonable distance, calculates and checks reliability through theory, is simple, convenient and feasible, and can be used for emergency treatment design work of sudden landslide disasters.

title_ko: 산사태 토사 재해 시뮬레이션 정보를 제공하기 위한 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system and method for providing landslide soil disaster simulation information. According to the present invention, the system for providing landslide soil disaster simulation information comprises: a moving image acquisition means for acquiring moving images by photographing flow of soil from a soil disaster simulator; a plurality of measurement means for acquiring a measurement value at the time of acquiring the moving image; and an end terminal for receiving and displaying the moving image and the measured value. The end terminal displays the measured value at the same time as the time when the moving image is acquired.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의한 산사태 토사 재해 시뮬레이션 정보를 제공하기 위한 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 산사태 토사 재해 시뮬레이션 정보를 제공하기 위한 시스템은 토사 재해 시뮬레이터로부터 토사의 흐름을 촬영하여 동영상을 획득하는 동영상 획득수단; 상기 동영상을 획득하는 시점에 측정값을 획득하는 다수의 계측수단; 및 상기 획득된 동영상과 측정값을 제공 받아 제공 받은 상기 동영상과 상기 측정값을 표시하되, 상기 동영상을 획득하는 시간과 동일한 시간에 상기 측정값을 표시하는 관리 단말을 포함한다.

title_en: Simulation system based on disaster and interlocking method thereof
title_ko: 재난 기반 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 그 연동 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a simulation system based on disaster, comprising: a disaster corresponding simulator generating fire data of a building; a fire simulator receiving the fire data and generating poisonous gas data using the fire data; and an interlocking device interlocking the disaster corresponding simulator and the fire simulator. The disaster corresponding simulator receives the poisonous gas data through the interlocking device and calculates a degree of body incapacitation of a building occupant using the poisonous gas data. Accordingly, a conversion process in a data file form can be omitted and data interoperability can be improved.
abstract_ko: 재난 기반 시뮬레이션 시스템이 개시된다. 건물의 화재 데이터를 생성하는 재난대응 시뮬레이터; 상기 화재 데이터를 전달받고, 상기 화재 데이터를 이용하여 유독 가스 데이터를 생성하는 화재 시뮬레이터; 및 상기 재난대응 시뮬레이터와 상기 화재 시뮬레이터를 연동시키는 연동장치;를 포함하되, 상기 재난대응 시뮬레이터는 상기 연동장치를 통해 상기 유독 가스 데이터를 전달받고, 상기 유독 가스 데이터를 이용하여 상기 건물 재실자의 신체 무능화 정도를 산출하므로, 데이터 파일 형식의 변환 과정이 생략될 수 있으며, 데이터 상호운용성이 향상될 수 있다.
