title_en: System and Method for Characterizing Weather Pattern of Weather Numerical Modeling Data
title_ko: 기상 수치모델 생산자료의 기상패턴 특징화를 위한 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for a meteorological pattern characterization of a meteorological numeric model which form meteorological numeric model data as a database, strengthen a search, such that a happening of natural disasters can be rapidly predicted with an empirical method. The apparatus comprises: a target area zoned unit which divides an area into zoned area for a pattern characterization in a lattice meteorological model area; a 1D meteorological field vector sequence generating unit which generates a 1D meteorological field vector of 2D/3D meteorological fields; a 1D meteorological field vector sequence DB which uses a meteorological model data DB to build a 1D meteorological field vector sequence database on all data of meteorological models in the past; a meteorological field pattern scenario deriving unit which searches the 1D vector sequence DB to grant a weight value for each area, and classifies and categorizes similar patterns to derive a meteorological field pattern scenario; an observation data comparing unit which compares incidents of natural disasters and observation data; a natural disaster type deriving unit which, on the basis of a comparing result of the observation data comparing unit, derives natural disaster types for each scenario.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기상 수치모델 자료의 DB화 및 검색을 강화하여 신속하게 자연재해 현상의 발생 가능 여부를 경험적인 방법으로 예측할 수 있도록 한 기상 수치모델 생산자료의 기상패턴 특징화를 위한 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 기상 모델 격자 영역에서 패턴 특징화를 위한 영역의 구역화를 수행하는 대상 영역 구역화부;2/3차원 기상장의 1차원 기상장 벡터 시퀀스를 생성하는 1차원 기상장 벡터 시퀀스 생성부;기상 모델 자료 DB를 활용하여 과거 기상 모델의 모든 자료에 대한 1차원 기상장 벡터 시퀀스 데이터베이스를 구축하는 1차원 기상장 벡터 시퀀스 DB;1차원 벡터 시퀀스 DB를 검색하여 영역별 가중치 부여, 유사패턴 분류 및 유사패턴 범주화를 수행하여 기상장 패턴 시나리오를 도출하는 기상장 패턴 시나리오 도출부;과거 자연 재해 발생 사례 및 관측 자료를 비교하는 관측 자료 비교부;관측 자료 비교부의 비교 결과를 기준으로 시나리오별 자연재해 유형을 도출하는 자연재해 유형 도출부;를 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: A kind of severe cold area high-speed railway disaster prevention system analoging detecting device
abstract_en: A kind of severe cold area high-speed railway disaster prevention system analoging detecting device is related to a kind of detection means, more particularly to a kind of severe cold area high-speed railway disaster prevention system analoging detecting device.Severe cold area high-speed railway disaster prevention system analoging detecting device is made up of the part such as governor circuit, keyboard circuit, display circuit, data acquisition circuit, signal output apparatus, usb circuit, power circuit.The present invention can carry out performance detection to sensors such as wind, rain, snow, the signal output of the sensors such as wind, rain, snow can be simulated again and is uploaded, by the display situation for observing monitor terminal, and compared with Expected Results, judge whether the function of high ferro disaster prevention system is normal, be a kind of advanced equipment for ensureing high-speed railway transportation production safety.

title_en: A kind of severe cold area high-speed railway disaster prevention system analoging detecting device
abstract_en: A kind of severe cold area high-speed railway disaster prevention system analoging detecting device, is made up of the part such as governor circuit, keyboard circuit, display circuit, data acquisition circuit, signal output apparatus, usb circuit, power circuit.The signal output of the sensors such as dynamic testing method and simulation test technology, simulation wind, rain, snow is employed, the display situation of monitor terminal is observed, compared with Expected Results, judges whether the function of high ferro disaster prevention system is normal, realize the on-line checking of system.This method directly can be tested and verified to the universality of high ferro disaster prevention system, so as to complete the accuracy to high ferro disaster prevention system, stability and reliability testing.Practical application proves that the device has played important function in high-speed railway disaster prevention safety monitoring system, is a kind of advanced equipment for ensureing high-speed railway transportation production safety.

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method based on recurrent neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of hyperspectral image classification method based on recurrent neural network, mainly solution existing method input feature vector identification is weaker, and local spatial feature extracts insufficient problem, and implementation step includes：1. the spatial texture feature and rarefaction representation feature of high spectrum image are extracted, and to its stacked combination into low-level feature；2. sample local space sequence signature is extracted on low-level feature；3. recurrent neural networks model is built according to local space sequence signature, and using training sample local space sequence signature training recurrent neural networks model parameter；4. the recurrent neural networks model for the input of test sample local space sequence signature being trained, obtains the high-level semantics features of high abstraction, obtains the classification information of test sample.The present invention improves the accuracy of classification hyperspectral imagery using the method for deep learning, can be used for vegetation investigation, and disaster surveillance, cartography and information are obtained.

title_en: Electric network emergency drills key element modeling method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric network emergency rehearsal key element modeling method and device, method includes：Formalized description is carried out to calamity emergency prediction scheme based on Ontology Modeling technology；Generation Disaster Event mathematical model；Electric network emergency rehearsal key element model library is set up according to the Disaster Event mathematical model.Creatively be introduced into Ontology Modeling technology in the modeling of electric network emergency rehearsal by the present invention, key element in for drilling electric network emergency is extracted and modeled, formalized description can be carried out to the existing electric network emergency prediction scheme text write with natural language, be converted to computer it will be appreciated that digital form, and the key element in electric network emergency rehearsal is extracted according to formalized description, it is a kind of important improvement for prior art.

title_en: Maize in Earlier Stage image damage caused by a drought recognition methods based on multi-feature fusion
abstract_en: It is that just the damage caused by a drought situation of plant is judged in the fertility early stage of corn the invention belongs to agricultural disaster identification field, is that the follow-up work of agricultural working personnel is prepared, it is ensured that corn supplies water abundance, normal plants prevents disaster from occurring.Therefore, of the invention, Maize in Earlier Stage image damage caused by a drought recognition methods based on multi-feature fusion, pre-processes to accessed milpa image first, in simulation practical application it is possible that sample situation, as the expansion to original sample collection；Hereafter, sample after sample, change in location after accessed brightness adjustment and original sample collection are incorporated as into new sample set carries out follow-up treatment, concentrate to extract from new samples and include three category features of color, singular value and texture, dimension-reduction treatment, construction feature database are carried out to feature using genetic algorithm；Finally damage caused by a drought is made to milpa as grader from least square method supporting vector machine to recognize.Present invention is mainly applied to agricultural disaster identification occasion.

title_en: A kind of modularization list tunnel multiple movement bodies cold smoke reduced scale cun experimental system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of modularization list tunnel multiple movement bodies cold smoke reduced scale cun experimental system, including tunnel main body, pressure testing system being arranged in tunnel main body etc. and train model, the tunnel main body and train model are assemblied to form by multistage reduced scale cun model experiment standard paragraphs, train model is two to multiple, train model bottom is provided with train motion positions wheel, and the train motion positions wheel is located in track；Cold smoke generator is provided with train model.Present system can not only reduce the danger of experiment by cold smoke generating means simulated fire situation, can also control flue gas flow, be easy to study the Fires Occurred of different scales size, while also solving the problems, such as that burning things which may cause a fire disaster is unstable under motion state.The length of itself is adjusted by adjusting the quantity of tunnel main body standard paragraphs, train length is adjusted by adjusting the quantity of train's body standard paragraphs, so as to simulate different length subway or railway tunnel, the multiple movement bodies fire behavior of different train lengths, flue gas diffusion property and Piston Action Wind Coupling Rule.

title_en: A kind of vertical sound loading tester of coal petrography sample true triaxial
abstract_en: Invention is related to a kind of vertical sound of coal petrography sample true triaxial plus unloading test machine, it is adaptable to reproduce the coal rock dynamic disaster phenomenon such as impulsion pressure, rock burst in underground mine recovery process.Pilot system is made up of three axle loading systems, Measurement and Control System, power loading system.X, Y-axis are respectively equipped with double high frequency sound servoBcylinders of four posts and two post single-piston cylinders, and on the same level platform that can be driven along Z-direction by lift servo mechanism, the wherein direction of Y-axis one is provided with unloading cylinder, realize a face stress fast discharging, Z axis are provided with four post hollow type double piston-rod list servoBcylinders, and configure back springing type displacement transducer, measurement data is fed back in lift servo mechanism, it is ensured that horizontal X, Y-axis loading center meet at all the time a little and central point is constant.High-speed servo cylinder is arranged on Z axis, there is provided power loads source.Testing machine can simulate true triaxial static loading state, Z axis dynamic impact problem stress state, Y-axis fixed rate or the quick stress unloaded state of coal petrography sample.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY;CHANGCHUN RES INST FOR MECH SCIENCE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of Simulations of Water Waves Due To Landslides computational methods
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Simulations of Water Waves Due To Landslides computational methods, reservoir stability slip mass is entered water to swell propagation each stage and is analyzed research as complete unified process, comprised the following steps：Step 1：According to existing landform, water level and slip mass shaped position data, three-dimensional finite element model is set up；Step 2：The interaction of water body, air, slip mass is described using Navier Stokes equations, fluid free surface is accurately caught with improved conservation formula Level Set methods, it is true to simulate generation process of surging, for swell propagation and hazard prediction provide rational precondition；Step 3：Swell propagation process is simulated using the fluid governing equation that is integrated along the depth of water, to surging movement locus and inundated area carries out numerical forecast, evaluation is surged disaster.The present invention not only has great a theory significance and practical value to the prediction of reservoir stability unstable failure and secondary disaster of surging, and numerical simulation to geological disasters such as other similar landslide, mud-rock flow, barrier lakes also has reference.

title_en: Antitheft door fire-fighting detaching analog training device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of antitheft door fire-fighting detaching analog training device, including antitheft door matrix, the antitheft door matrix is arranged on fixed mount；Antitheft door matrix is provided with the visual module of dismountable upper and lower lock point, latch module, shop front module；The shop front module and latch module are used to cutting forcible entry rehearsal；The latch module has two kinds：Opaque lockset combat training module and the visual study module of transparent lockset；The shop front module has two kinds：Opaque shop front combat training module and the visual study module of the transparent shop front.The present invention provides a kind of antitheft door fire-fighting detaching analog training device, simulates real fire-fighting environment, and lifting firefighterses improve training effectiveness, while can reuse, it is to avoid waste for Anti-theft door structure and the understanding of lock point position.Additionally, the device can not only carry out the training of social accident rescue forcible entry, it is also possible to simulate the quick training of forcing open the door of personnel's investigation in home fire.

title_en: The routed husky remote jet of driving face gushing water disturbs grouting method
abstract_en: A kind of routed husky remote jet disturbance grouting method of driving face gushing water, is included in the routed sand of gushing water and transient equilibrium occurs, when husky body no longer flows, drill site is arranged in trouble free service surface construction；Target spot, the target position is selected to should be the roadway position of neighbouring husky passage area of bursting, pierced from drill site to target spot construction；Target spot carries out high-pressure jet using drilling tool and disturbs slip casting, the husky cylindric induration of cement is formed in target spot, pass through the husky cylindric induration composition occlusion induration of multiple cement, it is reliably blocked with forming the tunnel at target spot, quality testing is carried out to the occlusion induration at target spot using the methods of drilling coring experiment, hydraulic pressure applied voltage test in situ, ensures dredging to the safety of tunnel target spot；The present invention can be formed under the conditions of tunnel deposits husky with a certain range, the occluding body of intensity as a result, and Engineering Reliability is high, for emergency work and resumes production, and secondary disaster is prevented to have larger practical value.

title_en: A kind of facade fire disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of facade fire disaster simulation device, its feature includes：Multilayer combustion chamber, simulation side wall, mobile platform, armoured thermocouple probe, thermal radiation flux measuring instrument, thermocouple paster, glass frame, sunlight controlling coated glass, simulation combustible, water-cooled heat-flow meter, axial flow blower, DV video cameras, scalable fire prevention are corniced；Multilayer combustion chamber is formed by stacking for two combustion chambers, and simulation side wall is combined with the wall for being provided with window respectively, forms U-shape structure；Scalable fire prevention is corniced installed in the window top of lower floor's combustion chamber.The present invention can be used to study high-rise building external wall fire spread situation under ambient wind effect, can be used for flame and smoke plume Characteristics of Development and alien invasion fire overflow under research side wall restrictive condition to be involved in upper strata chamber and fire characteristic rule occurs, so as to provide reference in the fire protection design of such building.

title_en: There is the composition of control to moving person OPG under low temperature sleet and snow ice environment
abstract_en: The present invention provides composition of the moving person osteoprotegerin (OPG) with Mutiple Targets regulating and controlling effect under a kind of sleet and snow ice environment to low temperature.Composition provided by the present invention has functions that to raise moving person skeletal muscle and brain tissue OPG expression under low temperature sleet and snow ice environment, can effectively prevent low temperature sleet and snow ice environment-stress and exhausted movemeat it is dual stress caused by bone tissue OPG overexpression, leave the healthy hidden dangers such as osteosclerosis, rheumatoid arthritis after preventing exposure.The present invention can be that low-temperature freezing rain and snow disaster emergency management and rescue troop and the work training crowd's health control of cold area open air provide corresponding product and technical support.

title_en: A kind of underground coal mine continuous screen manages and protects hole method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to Safety of Coal Mine Production technical field, specifically a kind of underground coal mine continuous screen manages and protects hole method.Comprise the following steps：The experimental rig such as rig and the defeated pipe device of screen casing and material are moved into drilling construction place, by continuous screen pipe dish volume on cylindric reel, hole clipping device is installed in continuous screen tube end；In cherry coal construction concordant or layer-through drilling；Stop drilling after drilling to projected depth, the defeated pipe device of screen casing is arranged on rig；By continuous screen casing and the hole clipping device insertion defeated pipe device of screen casing, continuous screen casing is sent into drilling rod using defeated pipe device；Lower screen casing drill bit is opened using continuous screen tube end hole clipping device top, screen casing is fixed on the wall of a borehole；Continuous screen casing is blocked in orifice position, drilling rod is withdrawn；Sealing of hole connection is carried out using major diameter sleeve pipe to take out.The present invention lower screen casing time in cherry coal drilling is short, and efficiency high, screen casing compression strength is big, drilling gas extraction efficiency high, fully improves drilling-draining efficiency, shortens the gas pre-drainage time, eliminates Gas Disaster to greatest extent.

title_en: A kind of coal seam reservoirs transparent agent based on aqueous sodium hypochlorite solution
abstract_en: The invention belongs to Safety of Coal Mine Production technical field, live large-scale promotion application is difficult to solve existing transparent agent, the problems such as the oxygenation efficiency to coal is extremely low at normal temperatures, there is provided a kind of coal seam reservoirs transparent agent based on aqueous sodium hypochlorite solution.It is made up of component A, component B and water, component A is sodium hypochlorite solid or liquor natrii hypochloritis, component B is pH adjusting agent, is hydrochloric acid or sulfuric acid of the concentration less than 10%；Effective chlorine ion concentration is 1% 6% in coal seam reservoirs transparent agent based on aqueous sodium hypochlorite solution, and pH value is 9 13.Increase gas permeability of coal seam, practical work face fast area is taken out in advance.Using the present invention coal is carried out it is anti-reflection after, substantially reduce the gas drainage under suction time；Reduce drilling quantities；Realize the anti-reflection and efficient gas pumping of high methane low permeability coal seam, improve stope, the region gas pre-drainage efficiency of coal roadway stripe, shorten the extraction time, increase drainage radius, reduce drilling quantities, eliminate Gas Disaster to greatest extent.

title_en: A kind of method of the prominent mud Excavation simulation device of gushing water and the prominent mud disaster of simulation gushing water
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of prominent mud Excavation simulation device of gushing water, including base, test cavity, the pressue device and water inlet that pressurize vertically, the test cavity side is provided with two excavation entrances, respectively positioned at the upper and lower sides of test cavity, by the excavation entrance of upside or downside to tunneling in chamber, test cavity is internally provided with Similar Material of Rockmass and the molten chamber of karst, and the Similar Material of Rockmass surrounds the molten chamber of karst；The test cavity is on base, the pressue device is located at test cavity top, water inlet is additionally provided with the test cavity, the method for further relating to be simulated using the device, rigidity of the present invention is big, intensity is high, sealing is preferable, measurement data is accurate, the rule of the prominent mud of gushing water in the Karst Tunnel digging process under the conditions of diverse location, different filling conditions and different pressures can be simulated, the scope of application is broad.

title_en: A kind of Potential of Seabed Under Wave Loading soil body disaster formation simulator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Potential of Seabed Under Wave Loading soil body disasters to form simulator, including bracket, cylinder, piston, air compressor machine, vacuum pump, change-over switch, first pipe, second pipe；Bracket one end is fixed on ship, and the other end is fixed on the height that on cylinder and can adjust cylinder；Equably setting is there are four guide rail on cylinder inboard wall four direction, and equably there are four grooves for setting on outer surface of piston four direction, and when piston is placed in cylinder, four guide rails are mutually engaged with four grooves；The first hole and the second hole are equipped at the top of cylinder, one end of first pipe is connected with the first hole, and the other end is connected with air compressor machine；One end of second pipe is connected with the second hole, and the other end is connected with vacuum pump；Change-over switch is respectively connected with air compressor machine and vacuum pump, is worked for controlling air compressor machine or vacuum pump.Simulator of the invention being capable of the influence of circulating analog wave wave crest and trough positive/negative pressure to sea bed.

title_en: lithium battery residual life prediction method
abstract_en: A lithium battery residual life prediction method relates to a lithium ion battery cycle life prediction technology, and aims to solve the problems that the existing lithium battery residual life prediction method depends on an accurate physical model or a complex signal processing technology, and needs expensive investment, or the existing method is based on a shallow layer structure, so that the performance of fault prediction is limited, and dimension disasters are easily suffered. And obtaining a lithium battery capacity degradation data set according to a charge-discharge cycle, preprocessing the data, constructing a DBN and RVM fusion model, training the DBN model and the RVM model, and predicting the residual life of the lithium battery by adopting the trained DBN and RVM fusion model. The method is suitable for predicting the residual life of the lithium battery.

title_en: A kind of high-spectrum remote sensing terrain classification method based on the learning machine that transfinites
abstract_en: The terrain classification method based on high-spectrum remote sensing that the invention discloses a kind of, the original learning machine network that transfinites is extended to hierarchical Multichannel fusion network, in terms of network training, the global iterative tuning strategy of output Weight Algorithm and deep learning network is solved different from the least-squares algorithm of original EL M network, the present invention is in such a way that Greedy is successively trained, hierarchical network is successively trained, it highly shortened the training time of network, during layer-by-layer training, the training solving model of every layer network adds l 1 Canonical optimizes item, so that parametric solution result is more sparse, reduce over-fitting risk, in terms of network function, single hidden layer ELM network stresses to solve fitting, the classification problem of simple data, and the different levels of the mentioned network model of the present invention realize target data feature learning or Fusion Features, while also inheriting the advantage that the former training speed is fast, generalization ability is strong, be very beneficial for the in-orbit realization of model and adapting to the requirement of emergency response task.

title_en: A kind of prominent flooding disaster emergency evacuation analogy method in colliery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of prominent flooding disaster emergency evacuation analogy method in colliery, according to the prominent flooding disaster emergency evacuation simulation demand in colliery, data acquisition and identification based on Internet of Things, build mine geology environment and underground scene, by permeable point and its relevant information acquisition, tunnel water flow simulation, personnel escape's Behavior modeling and the Intelligent Dynamic route searching of dashing forward, realize that emergency evacuation is simulated.By building geologic body, tunnel, equipment component in VR simulated environment, evacuating personnel, prominent flooding disaster, ground subsidence dynamic phenomenon are portrayed, to observe the disaster environment of surrounding, implement correct escape scheme；Security information platform is built, is drilled for emergency evacuation decision-making and evacuation, evaluated and early warning.Using advanced cutting edge technology method, with colliery, actual conditions are combined, for the preventing and treating of mine disaster, staff training, emergency management and rescue aid decision provide technical platform.

abstract_ko:
본 개선안은 병원이나 기타 관공서의 평면도가 도시된 맵 부재가 준비되고, 이 맵부재에 구역카드, 인물카드, 환자카드 및 시설물카드를 상황에 맞게 신속하게 배치하는 훈련을 반복 시행함으로써 화재, 지진과 같은 자연재해, 전쟁발발 또는 메르스와 같은 전염병 발생과 같은 각종 재난에 철저하게 대비할 수 있도록 한 재난대응 훈련용 시뮬레이션 교구에 관한 것이다. 
본 개선안의 바람직한 일 실시예에 따른 재난대응 훈련용 시뮬레이션 교구는 평면도가 도시되되 출입문, 방, 계단, 구획 등의 구조물이 표시된 맵 부재와, 등급별로 구분 가능하도록 서로 다른 색상으로 표시되며 해당 등급이 부여된 상기 구조물 측에 놓여지는 구역카드와, 직무별로 구분 가능하도록 서로 다른 이미지가 표시되며 해당 직무가 수행되어야 할 상기 구조물 측에 놓여지는 인물카드와, 증상별로 구분 가능하도록 서로 다른 이미지가 표시되며 해당 증상을 갖는 환자가 수용되어야 할 상기 구조물 측에 놓여지는 환자카드와, 목적별로 구분 가능하도록 서로 다른 이미지가 표시되며 해당 목적이 실행되어야 할 상기 구조물 측에 놓여지는 시설물카드가 포함되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and device for acquiring position information of logical partitions in virtual machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for acquiring position information of a logical partition in a virtual machine. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring disk position information of a logical partition in a virtual machine, wherein the disk position information is the position information of a virtual disk corresponding to the logical partition in the virtual machine; matching the disk position information corresponding to the logical partition with at least one piece of simulation disk position information stored in a physical machine or network equipment, wherein the simulation disk position information is a storage path generated after a virtual machine is installed in the physical machine or the network equipment; and under the condition of successful matching, determining the simulated disk position information obtained by matching as the position information of the logical partition in the virtual machine in the physical machine or the network equipment. The invention solves the technical problem of data disaster tolerance hidden trouble caused by difficult identification or easy confusion of the mapping relation between the logic partition and the simulation disk in the related technology.

title_en: A kind of improved underground coal mine combustible combustion characteristic curve assay method
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of improved underground coal mine combustible combustion characteristic curve assay method, measuring principle is that in the reactive tank of the quartz pipe combustion reaction occurs for combustible, air in quartz pipe is supplied by air pump, and by spinner flowmeter control the plume that is produced during its flow, combustible combustion in CO 2 , CO and O 2 Gas is measured by gas sensor, and recorded in notebook computer, the plume temperature of burning things which may cause a fire disaster downwind side is gathered using thermocouple, burning things which may cause a fire disaster downwind side plume ram compression is measured using Pitot tube and single tube inclined differential pressure meter, so as to the flow velocity of indirect determination burning things which may cause a fire disaster downwind side plume, the HRR obtained during combustible combustion is calculated finally according to oxygen consumption principle.The present invention can realize low cost, low energy consumption, the quick, combustion pattern of Accurate Determining underground coal mine combustible, and the theoretical foundation of science is provided for mine fire simulation calculation.

title_en: Tailing dam piping damage scene construction system and method

title_en: Method and system for predicting object-oriented software defects
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting object-oriented software defects, which comprises the following steps: processing the training data set to obtain effective characteristic attributes, and establishing a new training data set according to the effective characteristic attributes; training a Support Vector Machine (SVM) according to the new training data set, and performing parameter optimization through a Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), wherein the parameters comprise: penalty factor and gaussian kernel bandwidth; and performing defect prediction on the prediction data by using an SVM model according to the optimized parameters, and acquiring a prediction result. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the training data set is processed to obtain effective characteristic attributes, and a new training data set is established according to the effective characteristic attributes, so that dimension disaster is effectively avoided, processing cost is reduced, and data processing speed is increased; and the particle swarm optimization PSO is utilized to optimize parameters, and the optimal parameters are selected, so that the accuracy of defect prediction is improved.

title_en: Method for detecting fire influence depth of concrete structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting the depth of fire influence of a concrete structure, which specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring fire scene key information, concrete core drilling and sampling, X-ray chromatography scanning, calculating the area of a concrete block, calculating the area of a coarse aggregate, stripping the area of the coarse aggregate, calculating the area of a defect, calculating the defect rate and calculating the fire influence depth. The method adopts an X-ray tomography method and Vgstudiomax analysis software, and obtains the damage depth of the concrete structure after suffering from fire through accurate measurement of a judgment basis. The core sample is taken from different parts of the concrete structure after fire disaster, so that the fire disaster condition can be directly reflected. In addition, based on the results of the X-ray tomography scan, the damaged depth values can be quantitatively analyzed. title_en: Tunnel structure peeling depth measuring method under fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring the peeling depth of a tunnel structure under a fire disaster, which comprises the steps of lifting out a tunnel structure member after a fire disaster test is finished, pouring cement mortar into a peeling area to restore the cement mortar to the original size, forming grid lines on the surface after the surface of the cement mortar is initially set, vertically inserting the cement mortar into grid line nodes until the cement mortar is abutted against the member body by adopting a measuring drill rod, measuring the peeling depth of the grid line nodes through the length of the measuring drill rod immersed into the cement mortar, recording the peeling depth at corresponding positions of coordinate paper, and connecting points with the same peeling depth on the coordinate paper into a closed curve after the peeling depths of all grid line nodes are recorded at corresponding positions of the coordinate paper to form a contour line peeling depth graph. By utilizing the contour line peeling depth map, the distribution situation of the fire surface peeling can be clearly known, the coordinate and the depth value of the deepest peeling part are not only considered, and the information such as the most serious peeling part is also included, so that the analysis is convenient.

title_en: drainage slow-seepage grouting control process under tunnel roof water-rich crushing condition

title_en: Cross-media retrieval method based on Marangoni-like relevance measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-media retrieval method based on a March-like relevance measurement, which comprises the following steps: inputting a text and image database; dividing the text and the image into a training set and a testing set; extracting features from a training set and a test set of the text and the image to obtain a training feature set and a test feature set; unifying the data of the feature sets of the text and the image into the same subspace; calculating the correlation between the text and the image test set after the text and the image are unified to the same subspace by applying a Mahalanobis-like distance formula; and determining retrieval precision by using the average precision index and the recall rate index according to the class and the Mahalanobis distance of the text and the image. The invention finds the public maximum characteristic subspace of the characteristic data sets of the text and the image through the W-CCA algorithm, and maps the training set and the test set of the text and the image to the characteristic subspace, thereby unifying the data of the characteristic sets of the text and the image to the same subspace, solving the problem of dimension disaster and maximally preserving the maximum characteristic of the original data.

title_en: Simulation method for large-scale crowd dynamic emergency evacuation following optimal-forgetting rule
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for large-scale crowd dynamic emergency evacuation following an optimal-forgetting rule, which comprises the following steps: establishing an evacuation personnel source point set, a relay point set and a safety area point set based on a scene, and establishing a communication relation among personnel, relay points and a safety area according to the actual situation in the evacuation scene; dynamically updating the weight of the evacuation path according to the situation in the scene, searching a multi-constraint local optimal path, and recording the arrival position of evacuation personnel in real time; establishing an evacuation source point set of the time point according to the scene intermediate state, forgetting a path at the previous time, updating an available traveling node, and performing local search again; and repeating the whole routing process until all the personnel reach a safe area. The method effectively solves the problem of difficulty in calculating the optimal evacuation path in the complex scene network, effectively supports the optimal path search of dynamic weight change in a large scale, and has obvious advantages in large-scale crowd evacuation route planning.

title_en: Flapping wing aircraft with three-degree-of-freedom wings
abstract_en: A flapping wing aircraft with three degrees of freedom of wings belongs to the field of bionic flapping wing aircraft. The flapping wing aircraft comprises a left front adjusting and controlling mechanism, a right front adjusting and controlling mechanism, a left rear adjusting and controlling mechanism and a right rear adjusting and controlling mechanism, wherein the left front adjusting and controlling mechanism, the right front adjusting and controlling mechanism, the left rear adjusting and controlling mechanism and the right rear adjusting and controlling mechanism are symmetrically distributed on the left side and the right side of an aircraft body in pairs and can independently move. Under the mutual cooperation of the front regulating mechanism and the rear regulating mechanism, the flapping wing aircraft can highly simulate three motions of flapping, twisting and back-and-forth sweeping of the wings of birds during flying, and provides enough thrust and lift force for the flapping wing aircraft. The flapping wing aircraft is flexible in maneuvering and high in flying efficiency, and if equipment such as map transmission and the like is arranged, the flapping wing aircraft can play an important role in the fields of aerial photography, geographic measurement, traffic duty, military investigation, emergency rescue and disaster relief and the like.

title_en: Ship admittance equipment fault maintenance practical training method and system based on VR technologies
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of ship admittance equipment fault maintenance practical training method based on VR technologies and system.Methods described comprises the following steps：First, ship admittance equipment VR real training base libraries are built；2nd, failture evacuation tree is selected according to the failure of setting, transfers equipment 3 d model library, generate VR fault scenes, show the visualization of 3 d model of failture evacuation tree original state node；3rd, user's practical operation behavior is obtained, is compared with the user behavior side of residing failture evacuation tree current state node, if it matches, then performing step 4；If it does not match, mission failure, into step 5；4th, failure judgement excludes whether tree current state node is final stage state node, in this way, then real training Mission Success and terminates；If not, entering the NextState node for matching user behavior side, and repeat step 3；5th, for the real training task failed in step 3, using multimedia teaching storehouse, related data, and return to step three are pushed to student.

title_en: Text classification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a text classification method, training a text classifier based on a text vector of a training text; constructing a text vector of a text to be detected, inputting the text vector of the text to be detected into a trained text classifier, and classifying the text; the method for obtaining the text vector of the trained text and the text vector of the text to be tested comprises the following steps of 1: preprocessing the labeled text, selecting features, and performing word vector training; step 2: calculating a global vector and a local vector of the text according to the word vector obtained in the step 1; and step 3: and (4) calculating a text vector according to the global vector and the local vector obtained in the step (2). The method effectively overcomes the defects of the existing text classification method, omits the process of manual rule construction compared with a rule method, reduces the risk of dimension disaster compared with a vector space expression method, considers the shallow semantic information of the text, and fully considers the global information and the local information of the text expression compared with a Word2Vec Word vector, so that the classification is more accurate.

title_en: Open-air simulation engineering accumulation body soil erosion and water loss test device

The invention has firm structure, can simultaneously carry out a plurality of water and soil loss tests of the accumulation bodies with the same or different accumulation substances, can simulate the field environment of the field engineering accumulation bodies, meets the field long-term observation requirement, obtains more real test data, and provides basic data for scientific prevention and control of disasters such as artificial water and soil loss, landslide and the like caused by the engineering accumulation bodies, thereby eliminating the damage of the engineering accumulation bodies to the ecological environment.

title_en: Ammunition fire training simulation device

title_en: Apparatus and method for disaster monitoring using unmanned aerial vehicle
title_ko: 무인 항공기를 이용한 재난 감시 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A disaster monitoring apparatus using an unmanned aerial vehicle and a method thereof are presented. According to the present invention, the disaster monitoring apparatus using an unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a communication part, an image data analysis part, a disaster situation prediction part and a disaster situation counteracting part. The communication part transmits a control signal to an unmanned aerial vehicle and receives collection information including at least one among image data, voice data, and sensing data from the unmanned aerial vehicle. The image data analysis part analyzes the image data by at least one among a mechanical learning based-analysis method, an analysis method through combination of a plurality of image data and an analysis method through relation with the sensing data. The disaster situation prediction part applies an analysis result of the image data and weather information received from the outside to a prediction model to generate a prediction result. The disaster situation counteracting part transmits disaster alarm information, which is generated based on a scenario corresponding to the analysis result and the prediction result, to an external integral alarm system or outputs the disaster alarm information.

title_en: Apparatus and method for fire monitoring using unmanned aerial vehicle

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for monitoring a fire using an unmanned aerial vehicle. The apparatus comprises: an information collection unit receiving image data and sensing data from an unmanned aerial vehicle to correspond to an established monitoring operation plan; a fire outbreak determining unit analyzing the image data with at least one analysis method among a mechanical learning-based analysis, a combined analysis of a plurality of image data, and a sensing data associated analysis and determining whether a fire breaks out by using an analysis result; a flight control unit controlling flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle when the outbreak of fire is determined; a fire prevention device applying the image data and the sensing data received from the unmanned aerial vehicle to a prediction model by disaster to generate a prediction result; and a fire situation handling unit transmitting fire alarm information generated based on a response scenario corresponding to the analysis result and the prediction result to an external united alarm system or outputting the fire alarm information.

title_en: Experience device for escape of flooded vehicle
title_ko: 침수된 차량의 탈출을 위한 체험장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides an experiential device for escaping from a sunk vehicle, capable of enabling a user to safely escape from a sunk vehicle in an actual situation by providing an experiential simulation of a vehicle sinking situation. Through the present invention, the user is able to experience a situation, in which the user may open a door of a sunk vehicle if an inflow amount of water flowing into the vehicle is not more than a set amount, while at the same time experiencing a situation in which the user may open the door if water flows into the vehicle more than the set amount. In addition, as the user normally learns and recognizes a situation and information of a sunk vehicle, even if a vehicle is sunk in the sea or river or by a natural disaster, the user is able to escape from the vehicle without being flustered. Moreover, since a camera is installed in front of a main water tank to check the state of the user in real time, the present invention is capable of preventing accidents such as damage to humans by immediately checking the user in the event of an emergency.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차량이 침수된 상황을 모사하여 체험할 수 있도록 함으로써 실제 침수된 차량에 갇혔을 경우 사고없이 안전하게 탈출할 수 있도록 하는 침수된 차량의 탈출을 위한 체험장치를 제공한다. 본 발명은 차량이 침수시 차량 내부로 유입된 물의 유입량이 설정된 양 이하로 유입된 경우 차량의 문을 개방하는 상황을 체험함과 동시에 설정된 양 이상으로 유입된 경우 차량의 문을 개방하는 상황을 체험할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다. 그리고, 평상시 침수 차량에 대한 정보 및 상황을 습득하여 인지하도록 함으로써 차량이 강이나 바다에 추락하거나 천재지변으로 인해 침수되더라도 당황하지 않고, 침착하게 침수된 차량으로부터 탈출하여 사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 또한, 메인수조의 전방에 카메라를 설치하여 체험자의 상태를 실시간으로 확인할 수 있도록 함으로써 체험자가 체험시 위급한 상황에 처했을 경우를 바로 확인할 수 있기 때문에 인명피해를 비롯한 사고를 미연에 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of portable coal rock dynamic disaster electromagnetic radiation monitoring instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of portable coal rock dynamic disaster electromagnetic radiation monitoring instrument, including monitor body, monitor body includes detector antenna, detector bottom plate, four parts of monitor main body and detector top cover；The detector antenna is generally cylindric, and top seal is plastic material, and cabling in the raised floor mouthful aluminium alloy, main body is using foam barrier, built-in brass barrel, bar magnet, copper coil at PVC materials, upper-lower seal mouthful；It is not enough that the present invention overcomes conventional method can not monitor coal and gas prominent in real time by contact prediction, the present invention provides a portable coal rock dynamic disaster electromagnetic radiation monitoring instrument, the monitor realizes noncontact, orientation, region and continuous prediction using electromagnetic radiation technology, it need not be drilled during prediction Gas Outburst disaster, it is easy to operate.Early warning is sent out using critical value alert and dynamic trend of transmitting messages, in real time the stressing conditions of monitoring coal body, so that the possibility of the Gas Outburst that gives warning in advance of high degree.

title_en: A kind of guiding emergency evacuation virtual training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of guiding emergency evacuation virtual training system, belong to Aircraft life-saving technical field.Including computer simulation system and virtual reality system, the artificial intelligence and emulate dummy of cabin atmosphere, airborne equipment and the position of staffing, set of actions and different evacuation paths are provided with computer simulation system；Virtual reality system includes：Eyespot tracker, anaglyph spectacles and display projector；Computer simulation system is connected with display projector, and the information that computer simulation system is emulated is by showing that projector is shown；Eyespot tracker binds the emulate dummy head in the eye position and display projector of participant, and anaglyph spectacles is used for observation and follows the visual angle of emulate dummy to carry out simulated training.The present invention improves participant can experience the visual immersion and telepresenc of height in the process, have very great help to being familiar with environment and the program of withdrawing on machine, training for promotion effect, with good engineering application value.

title_en: A kind of safety education system experiences classroom

title_en: Apparatus and method for assessing disaster damage
title_ko: 재난 피해 예측 장치, 방법 및 재난 피해를 예측하기 위한 프로그램을 저장하는 저장매체.
abstract_en: An disaster damage prediction apparatus according to the present invention can comprise: a sales information extraction module extracting sales information corresponding to a first area for a predetermined period from a first DB; a sales change information generation module generating sales change information on the sales information when a disaster occurs based on disaster simulation information; and a sales information correction module correcting sales change information based on vulnerability information for the first area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명인 재난 피해 예측 장치는 제 1 DB로부터 기설정된 기간 동안의 제 1 지역에 대응하는 매출정보를 추출하는 매출정보추출모듈; 재난 시뮬레이션 정보를 기반으로 재난 발생시 상기 매출정보에 대한 매출변화정보를 생성하는 매출변화정보생성모듈; 및 상기 제 1 지역에 대한 취약성 정보를 기반으로 상기 매출변화정보를 보정하는 매출정보보정모듈;을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Unification system of building automation using Virtual Reality
title_ko: Vr를 이용한 빌딩 자동화 솔루션 통합 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention allows a user to identify information and situation of an FMS, which is a system for effectively supporting maintenance activities of construction, electricity, machinery, building equipment, office automation equipment, and information and communication equipment installed in a building and an SI, which is a system for integrating and managing a plurality of sub-systems to maximize efficiency and safety of the building, through a virtual reality (VR) device without directly visiting the building, thereby enabling the user to quickly handle problems when the problems occur. Accordingly, the system comprises: an FMS server receiving information data with respect to the construction, electricity, machinery, building equipment, office automation equipment, and information and communication equipment from a built database and providing the information data in real-time; an SI server providing information with respect to facility control, power lighting control, CCTV cameras, surrounding control, access control, building guidance, disaster prevention, and parking control; a VR server receiving the information from the FMS server and the SI server and providing the information to the VR device; and the VR device implementing a three-dimensional virtual situation to allow the user to easily identify the information from the VR server and transmitting a control signal to the FMS server and the SI server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빌딩과 같은 건물 내에 설치되어 있는 건축, 전기, 기계, 건축설비, 사무자동화 장비, 정보통신 장비에 대한 유지보수 활동을 효과적으로 지원하기 위한 시스템인 FMS와 건물의 효율성, 안전성을 극대화시킬 수 있도록 다수의 하위 시스템들을 통합하여 관리하기 위한 시스템인 SI에 대한 정보 및 상황을 건물에 직접 방문하지 않더라도 VR장치를 통해 확인하여 문제가 발생할 시 신속히 처리하도록 하는데 그 특징이 있다. 
이를 위해, 구축된 데이터베이스를 통해 제공받고, 건물의 건축, 전기, 기계, 건축설비, 사무자동화 장비, 정보통신 장비에 대한 정보 데이터를 실시간으로 제공하도록 하는 FMS서버와, 설비제어, 전력조명제어, CCTV, 주변관제, 출입통제, 빌딩안내, 방재, 주차관제에 대한 정보를 제공하도록 하는 SI서버와, 상기 FMS서버와 SI서버에서 정보를 제공받아 VR장치로 제공하도록 하는 VR서버와, 상기 VR서버로부터 정보를 사용자가 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 3D 형태의 가상 상황을 구현하고, 상기 FMS서버와 SI서버로 제어신호를 전송할 수 있는 VR장치를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: An exercise system for radiological emergency based on virtual reality
title_ko: 가상현실을 활용한 방사능 방재 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radioactivity prevention drill system using virtual reality. The present invention relates to a radioactivity prevention drill system using virtual reality, which provides drilling environments similar to real situation of complicated disaster such as earthquake or tsunami by applying virtual reality, and also offers outcome of the drill as a user is trained in virtual reality. To this end, the radioactivity prevention drill system using virtual reality comprises: an interface device receiving signals generated based on motion of the user or input from the user; a display part creating virtual reality images and displaying the same; and a virtual reality creation device including a control part correcting the virtual reality images based on the received signals. The control part makes a drill path to be happened for time series through an event tree structure, and provides drilling scenarios which may happen based on combination of success and fail for each event through a logical structure unfolding method.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실을 활용한 방사능 방재 훈련 시스템에 관한 것으로, 가상현실을 활용하여 지진 또는 쓰나미와 같은 복합재난의 실제 상황과 유사한 훈련환경을 제공하고 훈련자가 가상현실 환경 속에서 훈련을 하며 그 훈련의 결과를 제공할 수 있는 가상현실을 활용한 방사능 방재 훈련 시스템에 관한 것이다. 가상현실을 활용한 방사능 방재 훈련 시스템은 훈련자의 동작 또는 훈련자의 입력을 기반으로 발생된 신호를 송신하는 인터페이스 장치와, 가상현실 영상을 생성하여 표시하는 표시부와, 가상현실 영상을 상기 송신된 신호에 따라 수정하는 제어부를 포함하는 가상현실생성 장치를 포함하고, 제어부는, 훈련경로를 사건 수목 구조를 이용하여 시계열별로 이벤트화하고 각 이벤트의 성공과 실패의 조합으로 발생 가능한 훈련 시나리오를 논리구조전개 방법으로 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Airport gas station scene toy packaging structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of airport gas station scene toy packaging structure, it includes box body, base, acousto-optic top plate, pillar, transport toy car, high altitude firefighting toy car, toy fuel charger and toy airplane, box body is provided with transparent position and opaque position, scene decorative layer is pasted with the inwall at opaque position, base is placed on the placement recess of tilting rack provided with toy fuel charger, acousto-optic top plate, transport toy car and high altitude firefighting toy car, toy airplane；The utility model smart structural design, is rationally pasted with scene decorative layer on the inwall at the opaque position of box body, and the pattern consistent with airport gas station scenic themes is printed with the scene decorative layer, show stereoeffect, presentation effect is good, and simulated effect is good, and effectively enhancing is interesting；And acousto-optic top plate has luminous voice effect, airport general knowledge or music are such as played, it is interactive strong, provide more enjoyment for player.

title_en: The Urban Storm Flood disaster alarm method and system of fractal algorithm based on big data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to Urban Storm Flood disaster alarm technical field, and in particular to the Urban Storm Flood disaster alarm method and system of a kind of fractal algorithm based on big data.Its method comprises the following steps：Warning data attribute needed for input；Qualified data are quickly screened in database；Data prediction is carried out to the data being retrieved；Data formation sample set, and the warning data attribute formation training set needed for addition in sample set are selected in the data of pretreatment；Under Hadoop platform, its affiliated disaster loss grade is drawn using Mapreduce combination fractal algorithms；Early warning result is presented to user with visual pattern and disaster prevention measure is provided.This method can not only make correctly predicted to the Urban Storm Flood disaster that future occurs, final to realize correct effective Urban Storm Flood disaster prevention function.Its system then at least includes retrieval module and processing module, so as to provide effective physical platform for the realization of above-mentioned method for early warning.
assignees: ANHUI SUN CREATE ELECTRONIC CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster VR simulative training systems
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of geological disaster VR simulative training systems, including：Wear-type VR user equipmenies and data processing and control module, wherein, the wear-type VR user equipmenies include action collecting unit, visual angle collecting unit, VR display devices and audio playing unit, and the data processing includes data storage cell, touching display screen and data processing unit with control module.This programme can be drilled by the geological disaster of the superpower sense of reality and presence, show the evolution process of geological disaster, improve popular science propaganda and education that awareness of safety and self-saving ability of the rehearsal persons such as student in geological disaster carry out geological disaster emergency danger-avoiding.

title_en: Visual physical simulation test system for coal and gas outburst dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal and gas outburst power disaster-causing visual physical simulation test system, wherein a simulation tunnel pipe network is arranged behind a simulation test bed and is provided with three rows of cross pipe joints, two adjacent cross pipe joints in the same row are connected through a longitudinal square straight pipe, two adjacent cross pipe joints in the same row are connected through a transverse square straight pipe, a high-definition camera is arranged at the top of each cross pipe joint, two ends of each square straight pipe are respectively provided with an axial measurement section, the middle part of each square straight pipe is provided with a lateral pressure measurement section, three pressure sensors, three temperature sensors and two concentration sensors are arranged on the axial measurement section, and three lateral pressure sensors are arranged on the lateral pressure measurement section. The invention can truly simulate the mine tunnel network, has comprehensive data acquisition and can utilize the acquired data to carry out deep research on the disaster-causing mechanism of the coal-gas two-phase flow; the visualization degree is sufficient, and the real migration form of the coal-gas two-phase flow can be clearly reflected.

title_en: The weak cementing rock mass seepage failure area slip casting integrated control method of top of underground
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of weak cementing rock mass seepage failure area slip casting integrated control methods of top of underground, including conjunctive use geological analysis and geophysical exploration about exhausted means, find out and administer area's hydrogeologic condition；Seepage failure, which destroys supporting in section and the zone of influence, to be strengthened；Sluicing decompression-delamination pour slurry resolution design；Sluice decompression drilling construction and delamination pour slurry engineering construction and dynamic adjustment；Sluicing decompression hole high-pressure high-flow blocking in flowing water；Reinforcement surrouding rock deformation monitoring and etc..After the construction of this engineering method, by to weak cementing rock mass reinforcing and high-pressure high-flow water burst block by different level, phase in, it solves the problems, such as that the work harnessing project period is long, easily cause secondary geological disaster, improve slip casting efficiency, create good Social benefit and economic benefit.

title_en: System and method of vehicle telematics simulation and testing
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are a system and method for vehicle telematics testing. The method includes receiving, by a vehicle telematics simulator, a vehicle incident data from a vehicle control unit based on one or more test cases and simulating a physical radio network for transmission of the vehicle incident data. The method includes forwarding the simulated transmission of the vehicle incident data to a telematics server, and receiving an emergency response data from the telematics server, in response to the forwarded simulated transmission of the vehicle incident data. Detecting at least one transmission error in at least one of the simulated transmission of the vehicle incident data to the telematics server and the receipt of the emergency response and displaying the at least one transmission error.

title_en: Automated external defibrillator (aed) with networking training
abstract_en: Method and system for training emergency responders in an emergency response network. The method of the present invention comprises identifying by a central training server and at least one active emergency responder with one or more participation preferences. A query is sent to the at least one identified emergency responder to determine availability of the at least one active emergency responder to a training session. The training session is then provided to the at least one participating emergency responder. A training feedback is then received and analyzed by the central training server. The at least one participating emergency responder's one or more participation preferences is then updated based on the analyzed training feedback. An incentive may also be provided to the participating emergency responder based on the analyzed training feedback.

title_en: A kind of accurate three-dimensional training exercise method of power system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of accurate three-dimensional training exercise method of power system, the equipment of electric field and size, direction and the positional information of component are gathered first；The information collected is recompilated, data interaction and fusion is formed, threedimensional model is produced；Then threedimensional model is subjected to modularization fractionation, obtains size, direction and the position of different parts；According to training needs, each component logic decision instruction is assigned, and then simulate influence of size, direction and the position change of different parts to the electric field；Obtained result is finally generated into encryption information, dedicated platform server is uploaded to.The present invention highly reduces power plant scene using three-dimensional data, realizes the interaction with trainee, and rehearsal is combated a natural disaster in progress.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU;STATE GRID FUJIAN NANPING JIANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;FUZHOU SHIKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;FUJIAN AOTE RUISI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Serious game system and method for correspond to disaster
title_ko: 재난 대응을 위한 기능성 게임 시스템
abstract_ko: 재난 대응을 위한 기능성 게임 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다.  배, 기차 또는 비행기의 재난 상황에 대한 재난 대응 전문가(master key user)의 대응에 따라 전개되는 적어도 하나 이상의 재난 대응 시나리오(correspond to disaster scenario)를 미리 저장하는 재난 대응 클라우드 서버(correspond to disaster cloud server); 상기 재난 대응 클라우드 서버에 저장된 재난 대응 시나리오를 다운로드하여 가상 현실(virtual reality) 상에서 실행하고, 실행된 재난 대응 시나리오상의 재난 상황에 대응하여 상기 재난 대응 전문가의 대응 조치를 입력받고, 입력받은 대응 조치에 따라 상기 재난 대응 시나리오를 전개하는 재난 대응 전문가 단말을 구성한다.  상술한 재난 대응을 위한 기능성 게임 시스템 및 방법에 의하면, 다양한 재난 상황 시나리오를 가상 현실상에서 실행하고 재난 대응 전문가가 적절하게 조치하고 시나리오가 전개되도록 구성됨으로써, 재난 대응 전문가가 매뉴얼대로 대응할 수 있도록 훈련하고 적절한 조치를 신속하고 침착하게 취하는지에 대해 평가할 수 있는 효과가 있다.  또한, 재난 대응 전문가의 체온, 혈압, 맥박 등을 실시간 측정하여 재난 대응 전문가의 위기 대응 능력도 함께 평가하고 위기 대응 역량을 높일 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Disaster prevention alarm simulation and verification system
abstract_en: A disaster prevention alarm simulation and verification system, comprising a data module (1) for recording operation information and results of front-end systems (101, 102, 103). The data module (1) further comprises an evacuation simulation database (15) for storing data related to general evacuation simulation completed by the front-end systems (101, 102, 103); the data module (1) is electrically connected to a calculation module (2), and the calculation module (2) reads a designated database or parameter from the data module (1) and is electrically connected to a verification module (3) used for receiving and testing test vector data of the calculation module (2); the verification module (2) further comprises a compiling unit (32) and a simulation unit (33) used for executing a dynamic evacuation indication parameter guide simulation program; finally, the simulation unit (33) and the evacuation simulation database (15) are electrically connected to a comparison module (4) so as to receive simulation information output from the evacuation simulation database (15) and the simulation unit (33) and perform cross-verification.

title_en: Acoustic emission monitoring and transmission system for engineering rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acoustic emission monitoring and transmitting system for an engineering rock mass, which comprises an acoustic emission sensor and a ground workstation, wherein the acoustic emission sensor is arranged in a drilled hole of the monitored rock mass and transmits a received monitoring signal to the ground workstation through a cable, the acoustic emission sensor consists of an acoustic emission probe, a probe mounting mechanism and a transmitting mechanism, the probe mounting mechanism is provided with the acoustic emission probe and transmits the probe mounting mechanism to a set position in the drilled hole, and the probe mounting mechanism comprises a shell connected with the transmitting mechanism and a probe sleeve used for accommodating the acoustic emission probe. The probe mounting mechanism in the engineering rock acoustic emission monitoring and transmission system solves the problem of effective mounting and coupling of the acoustic emission probe through the mutual matching of the air bag and the spring arranged between the shell and the probe sleeve, ensures the effective coupling of the acoustic emission probe and the wall of the drill hole, and further enhances the monitoring and forecasting reliability of the stability of the mine rock (body) and the dynamic disaster of rock burst.

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method based on NSCT (non-subsampled Contourlet transform) and DCNN (data-to-neural network)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hyperspectral image classification method based on NSCT (non-subsampled Contourlet transform) and DCNN (discrete cosine transformation), which solves the problem that texture details and directional information of a hyperspectral image to be classified cannot be fully mined in the prior art. The invention is realized as follows: inputting a hyperspectral image; performing NSCT transformation; normalizing the transformed three-dimensional block and performing block taking operation; randomly selecting a training, verifying and testing sample set from the sample set; constructing a deep convolutional neural network, and setting network hyper-parameters; training a network; inputting the test sample into a network to obtain an actual classification label, and drawing a ground object classification result graph; and (4) comparing the classification label with the reference label of the test sample to calculate a classification evaluation index, drawing a loss curve graph of the training and verification sample along with the increase of the iteration times, and finishing the ground feature classification. The method reserves more texture details, directivity and spatial information of the hyperspectral image, has more accurate classification, and can be applied to weather, environment monitoring, land utilization, urban planning, disaster prevention and reduction and the like.

title_en: Simulation method and system for emergency evacuation of personnel in subway station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method and a system for emergency evacuation of personnel in a subway station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, building a subway station emergency evacuation simulation scene, and initializing personnel to be evacuated; s2, simulating the perception of the people to be evacuated on the psychological and physiological states and the surrounding environment; s3, establishing a social model containing the psychological and physiological states of the people to be evacuated according to the psychological and physiological states of the people to be evacuated and the perception results of the surrounding environment; s4, establishing a motion path and motion speed decision model of the people to be evacuated according to the social force model containing the psychological and physiological states of the people to be evacuated; and S5, simulating the decision model of the movement path and the movement speed of the people to be evacuated according to a time step method to obtain the movement state of the people to be evacuated and the final simulation result at each simulation moment. The invention can improve the rationality and effectiveness of emergency evacuation measure formulation and implementation.

title_en: A rope overspeed device tensioner is received fast for fire control cross rescue

title_en: Method for improving simulation precision of hydrologic process of non-data high-altitude river basin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the simulation precision of a hydrological process of a data-free high-altitude river basin. The method mainly solves the problem of improving the simulation precision of the hydrologic process in the non-data high-altitude river basin. The method is based on the theoretical basis of hydrologic physical process, similar rules of clinical areas and vertical dissimilarity rules, establishes a parameter transfer relation for distributed hydrologic model (SWAT) parameters of a plurality of groups of Xinjiang mountain areas adjacent to measuring stations, and converts a model parameter set of a reference river basin into a model parameter set of a target river basin according to the parameter transfer relation, so that high-precision simulation of the hydrologic process of the non-data high-altitude river basin is realized. The method is suitable for simulating the hydrologic process of the medium and small river in the non-data high-altitude area, and after the model parameters are localized, the simulation precision of the hydrologic process of the non-data river basin can be improved, thereby being beneficial to monitoring and early warning of the torrential flood and reducing the disaster risk of the torrential flood.

title_en: Polarized SAR image semi-supervised classification method based on random forest composition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-supervised polarimetric SAR image classification method based on random forest composition. The method mainly solves the problems that the prior classification method is insufficient in representing the similarity relation between sample points and does not utilize spatial information. The method comprises the following steps: inputting original data of a polarized SAR image; extracting relevant characteristics of the data to obtain a data set; constructing an initial random forest model; training two classifiers by utilizing two different attribute sample sets for assisting in training a semi-supervised random forest model; optimizing a semi-supervised random forest model; constructing a similar relation graph; constructing a spatial information graph; combining the similarity relation graph and the spatial information graph to obtain a similarity relation matrix between the sample points; the images are classified and the accuracy is calculated. The method utilizes the semi-supervised random forest algorithm to construct a more compatible similarity relation graph and spatial information, and improves the classification accuracy of the polarized SAR image. The method is used for civil and military fields such as geological exploration, emergency rescue and disaster relief, target identification and the like.

title_en: Real-Time Data Acquisition and Recording System Viewer
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) and viewer for mobile assets that includes a data encoder, onboard data manager, and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: Video content analysis system and method for transportation system

The track detection and infrastructure monitoring includes a reinforcement learning component, an object detection and location component, and an obstruction detection component to analyze video data, audio data, vehicle data, weather data, and route/manifest data to determine internal and/or external conditions relating to an the asset. A data acquisition and recording system uploads the data, internal and/or external condition information, object detection information, object location information, and obstruction detection information to a remote memory module and provides streaming video data in real-time to a remotely located user. Remotely located users can view the data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validates the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitors crew performance and safety.

title_en: Hazard potential evaluation method for complex disasters

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a scenario-based hazard potential evaluation method for a big complex disaster, which is improved to display hazard potential evaluation of a big complex disaster on a navigation screen by forming a scenario of an occurrence expectation calculation process by using a hazard map and interdependence calculation for each disaster of a database in a hazard potential evaluation server and using an expert computer of an expert survey for defining interconnectivity between disaster types. To achieve the same, according to the present invention, the hazard potential evaluation server networks with the expert computer (10) of the expert survey for defining the interconnectivity between the disaster types and the database (20) of an existing research material such as an avalanche hazard map, a coastal flooding prognostic chart, and a wind speed probability map. The hazard potential evaluation server individually uses the generation of a natural disaster and social disaster matrix and generation of the map from a hazard map DB (50) for each disaster, from an interdependent database (40) for each disaster in a big complex disaster integrated database system (30). The hazard potential evaluation server selects the disaster in a case in which the interdependence is larger than a preset value in the occurrence expectation calculation process (60) and forms the scenario in accordance with the first disaster. The hazard potential evaluation server classifies the hazard map of a grid unit about a whole country as a result on the disaster forming the scenario and applies the same to the expectation calculation in accordance with the scenario.
