title_en: Method for Management of River Facility through River Diagnosis and System thereof
title_ko: 하천 진단을 통한 하천시설물 관리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a management method and a system thereof to prevent a disaster and improve the efficiency of facility management by diagnosing the situation of a river based on past data including a disaster history of the river, current data including hydrological data, facility data, and inspection data, and prediction data including hydraulic and hydrological modeling and by reflecting the diagnosis in an inspection plan and maintenance plane of a river facility. The river facility management system through river diagnosis comprises: a river status management unit for storing facility operation information and maintenance history information updated from a river facility management DB of a facility operation management unit; a topographical data management unit for collecting river cross-sectional information, river boundary information, DEM information of inside and outside the ground, a river network, a facility location map, and river characteristic information and storing the same according to a spatial information standard format of a GIS server; a river diagnosis unit for performing a diagnosis according to the river status selecting the maintenance and inspection priorities of the facility and a diagnosis according to the scenario through a floodplain, silt and riverbed change model and then storing the same in a river diagnosis integrated DB of an integrated DB server; and the facility operation management unit for establishing a plan based on the river diagnosis result of the river diagnosis unit, storing a result of operation, inspection, and maintenance according to the established plan in the river facility management DB of the integrated DB server, correcting a result of the established plan, and reflecting the corrected result at the next planning.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 하천의 재난이력을 포함한 과거자료와, 수문자료, 시설물 제원 및 점검자료를 포함하는 현황자료, 그리고 수리, 수문 모델링을 포함하는 예측자료를 바탕으로 하천의 상황을 진단한 후 하천시설물의 점검 계획과 보수 계획에 반영함으로써 재난의 예방과 시설물 관리의 업무 효율성을 향상시키기 위한 관리 방법과 그 시스템에 관한 것으로, 하천시설물의 현장에 설치된 계측시설과 운영시설의 점검정보와 보수정보를 현장담당자에 의해 유무선통신망 단말기를 통해 입력된 재해이력정보, 수문정보 및 시설물 운영정보를 실시간으로 수집하여 미들웨어서버의 데이터처리시스템의 알고리즘을 통해 처리한 후 통합DB서버의 하천현황통합DB에 저장하고, 시설물운영관리부의 하천시설물관리DB로부터 업데이트된 시설물 운영정보, 점검 및 보수이력정보를 저장하는 하천현황관리부; 하천단면정보, 하천경계정보, 제내외지의 DEM정보, 하천망도, 시설물 위치도 및 하천 특성 정보를 수집하여 GIS서버의 공간정보 표준포맷에 따라 저장되고, 엔지니어링 워크스테이션(EWS)의 격자생성시스템(MGS)에서 유사 및 하상변동 모형을 수행하기 위한 기본 입력 자료인 계산격자를 생성하여 GIS서버의 지형자료통합DB에 저장하는 지형자료관리부; 상기 하천현황통합DB로부터 설치일자, 구조물 상태평가, 재난자료 및 재난발생예측자료의 4가지 인자를 기반으로 시설물의 보수와 점검 우선도를 선택하는 하천현황에 따른 진단과, 홍수터, 유사 및 하상변동 모형을 통한 시나리오에 따른 진단을 각각 수행한 후 통합DB서버의 하천진단통합DB에 저장하는 하천진단부, 및 상기 하천진단부의 하천진단 결과를 바탕으로 계획을 수립하고 수립된 계획에 따라 운영, 점검, 보수된 결과를 통합DB서버의 하천시설물관리DB에 저장하며 수립된 계획의 결과를 보정한 후 다음 계획 수립 때에 반영하는 시설물운영관리부를 포함하여 이루어진 것이다.

title_en: Fire and smoke control system and method for simulation fire training
title_ko: 소방 훈련용 화염 및 연기 제어 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a fire and smoke control system and a method for a fire drill are provided. The fire and smoke control system for a fire drill comprises: a plurality of spaces distributed in a building having a plurality of floors; one or more opening units opening an adjacent space of the spaces; at least one opening and closing means opening and closing each of the opening units; and a control means controlling opening and closing operation of each of the opening and closing means. The control means, in accordance with a request of a user, allows or restricts at least one of fire and smoke generated in at least one space of the spaces to be transmitted to another space of the spaces.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면, 소방 훈련용 화염 및 연기 제어 시스템에 있어서, 복수 층을 가지는 건물 내에 분포하는 복수의 공간; 상기 복수의 공간 중 인접하는 공간 간을 개방하는 적어도 하나의 개방부; 상기 개방부 각각을 개폐하는 적어도 하나의 개폐 수단; 및 상기 개폐 수단 각각의 개폐 동작을 제어하는 제어 수단을 포함하고, 상기 제어 수단은, 사용자의 요청에 따라, 상기 복수의 공간 중 적어도 한 공간에서 발생하는 화염 및 연기 중 적어도 하나가 상기 복수의 공간 중 다른 공간으로 전달되는 것을 허용 또는 저지하는, 소방 훈련용 화염 및 연기 제어 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Structure for frie drill
title_ko: 소방 훈련용 건조물
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, the present invention relates to a structure for fire drill. According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a structure for fire drill, comprising: a plurality of spaces where at least one of flame or smoke can be formed; at least one opening part opening the space nearby among the plurality of the spaces; and at least one display part displaying information on gas in the atmosphere due to existence of flame and smoke in each of the spaces.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는 소방 훈련용 건조물에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면, 화염 및 연기 중 적어도 하나가 발생할 수 있는 복수의 공간; 상기 복수의 공간 중 인접한 공간 간을 개방하는 적어도 하나의 개방부; 및 상기 복수의 공간 각각에 상기 화염 및 연기의 존재 여부에 따른 대기 내 가스에 관한 정보를 표시하는 적어도 하나의 표시부를 포함하는, 소방 훈련용 건조물을 제공한다.

title_en: Interactive fire safety training simulation system
title_ko: 체감형 소방훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an interactive fire safety training simulation system comprising: a main body; an image output unit that is installed in an upper part of the main body so as to output a fire image onto a screen; a fire extinguisher that has a laser beam emitting unit configured so that a user irradiates the fire image with a laser beam using the laser beam emitting unit; an image capture unit that is formed on the entire surface of the main body, to capture an image of the screen so as to capture an image of the location of the laser beam emitted on the screen; a control unit that is formed inside the main body, and that compares the fire image irradiated onto the screen with the image captured by the image capture unit, and changes the size of the fire included in the fire image and provides the same to the image output unit; and a support unit that is formed between the main body and the image output unit, and that supports the image output unit, wherein the image output unit has a heat release unit configured to release heat generated internally to the outside.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 체감형 소방 훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본체, 본체의 상부에 설치되어 스크린에 화재 영상을 출력하는 영상 출력부, 레이저 빔 조사부가 구비되어 사용자가 화재 영상에 상기 레이저 빔 조사부를 통해 레이저를 조사하는 소화기, 본체의 전면에 형성되어 스크린을 촬영하여 스크린으로 조사된 레이저 빔의 위치를 촬영하는 촬영부, 본체 내부에 형성되어 스크린에 조사된 화재 영상과 촬영부에서 촬영된 영상을 비교하여 화재 영상에 포함된 화염의 크기를 가변하여 상기 영상 출력부에 제공하는 제어부 및 본체와 영상 출력부 사이에 형성되어 영상 출력부를 지지하는 지지부를 포함하되, 영상 출력부는 내부에서 발생된 열을 외부로 방출하도록 열방출부가 형성된 것을 특징으로 하는 체감형 소방훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Disaster monitoring system based on image analysis data of unmanned aerial vehicle
title_ko: 무인항공기 영상분석자료 기반 재난시각화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system (100) to visualize a disaster based on image analysis data of an unmanned aircraft. The system includes: a data storage part (110) receiving and storing disaster anticipation data, climate data, action scenarios by disaster, and images and state data of an unmanned aircraft (an identifier of the unmanned aircraft, flight time, three-dimensional position coordinates, image input time, and an identifier of an image sensor); an unmanned aircraft state data output part (120) receiving and outputting the state data of the unmanned aircraft from the data storage part (110); an image analysis result output part (130) receiving, analyzing, and outputting the images photographed by the unmanned aircraft from the state data output part (120); an action scenario output part (140) outputting an action scenario proper for a disaster by analyzing the images photographed by the unmanned aircraft; a GIS information input and output part (150) displaying mark information on a GIS map; and a visualization output part (160) visualizing the proper action scenario in accordance with the information received from the state data output part (120), the image analysis result output part (130), the action scenario output part (140), and the GIS information input and output part (150).

title_en: Robot mobility test system with collapse simulation
title_ko: 붕괴 상황을 모사한 로봇 주행 시험 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot mobility test system with a collapse simulation. According to the present invention, the robot mobility test system with a collapse simulation comprises: a plurality of sensor modules installed along a plurality of sections of a track sensing a robot moving on the track; a falling module installed in a set point of the track, dropping a falling object based on a control signal; and a control module calculating a time point on which the robot reaches the set point using a position or speed of the robot obtained from the sensing information of the sensor module, and transmitting the control signal generated based on an arrival time to the falling module. The robot mobility test system with a collapse simulation in accordance with the present invention is able to objectively and quantitatively reproduce a collision and avoidance situation with a falling object occurring in a collapse disaster site by dropping the falling object, which simulates an actual collapse situation, to the moving robot; and is able to be utilized to evaluate a performance of a disaster robot.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 붕괴 상황을 모사한 로봇 주행 시험 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 트랙의 복수의 구간을 따라 각각 설치되며 상기 트랙을 주행하는 로봇을 감지하는 복수의 센서 모듈과, 상기 트랙의 설정 지점에 설치되며 제어 신호를 기초로 낙하물을 하강시키는 낙하 모듈, 및 상기 센서 모듈의 감지 정보로부터 획득되는 로봇의 위치 또는 속도를 이용하여 상기 로봇이 상기 설정 지점에 도달하는 시점을 연산하며 상기 도달 시점을 기초로 생성한 상기 제어 신호를 상기 낙하 모듈로 전송하는 제어 모듈을 포함하는 붕괴 상황을 모사한 로봇 주행 시험 시스템을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따른 붕괴 상황을 모사한 로봇 주행 시험 시스템에 따르면, 실제 붕괴 상황을 모사한 낙하물을 주행 중인 로봇을 향해 낙하시켜 붕괴 재난 현장에서 발생하는 낙하물과의 충돌 및 회피 상황을 객관적이고 정량적으로 재현할 수 있으며 재난 로봇의 성능 평가에 활용될 수 있는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Method performed in an autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle for enabling autonomous emergency assistance for communication devices registered in a conventional cellular network, vehicle and device thereof
abstract_en: A method for enabling autonomous emergency assistance for one or more communication devices, CDs, registered in a conventional cellular network. The method is performed in an autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle UAV, and comprises: simulating (S210) a cellular network in a geographic area, wherein the UAV and the one or more CDs have no connectivity to a conventional cellular network; transmitting (S230) an information message in a geographical area, the message comprising an emergency response trigger; receiving (S240) an automatic emergency data response from one or more CDs in the geographic area in response to the transmitted message; and determining (S250) an action based on the received automatic emergency data response. CDs, UAVs, computer programs and computer program products are also presented.

title_en: Virtual reality type fire fighting training system, fire disaster simulator for fire fighting training, fire disaster simulation method for fire fighting training, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a virtual reality type fire fighting training system, a fire disaster simulator for fire fighting training, a fire disaster simulation method for fire fighting training, and a program that are enhanced in fire fighting training effects.SOLUTION: A fire-extinguishing agent trajectory calculator 3117 calculates a trajectory of virtual particles of a virtual fire-extinguishing agent by using: information indicating mass and volume of the virtual particles of the virtual fire-extinguishing agent; information indicating a direction and size of external force acting on the virtual particles of the virtual fire-extinguishing agent; a discharge speed parameter; angle information; and nozzle position information. A determination section 3118 determines whether or not the virtual fire-extinguishing agent has reached a fire origin area, on the basis of the trajectory of the virtual particles of the virtual fire-extinguishing agent. A flame scale calculator 3119 calculates a flame scale parameter according to a determination result of the determination section 3118. A video data generation section 3112 generates novel video data by synthesizing video data and background image data showing flames in a virtual space.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Fire traning system and fire training method using the same
title_ko: 소방 훈련 시스템 및 이를 이용한 소방 훈련 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fire training system and a fire training method using the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the fire training system comprises a display device, a training fire extinguisher, and a content providing device. The display device includes a first gyro sensor, and displays fire training content on a display screen. The training fire extinguisher generates fire extinguisher operation information including spraying direction information depending on an operation of a user. The content providing device provides the content to the display device; and controls the content displayed on the display screen based on a measuring value of the first gyro sensor and the fire extinguisher operation information. The content providing device controls a view point of the content displayed on the display screen based on the measuring value of the first gyro sensor; and controls a position of an aiming point displayed on the display screen based on the measuring value of the first gyro sensor, and the spraying direction information. The present invention improves operation convenience of the user.
abstract_ko: 소방 훈련 시스템 및 이를 이용한 소방 훈련 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 소방 훈련 시스템은, 제1 자이로 센서를 포함하고, 소방 훈련 컨텐츠를 디스플레이 화면 상에 표시하는 디스플레이 장치, 사용자의 조작에 따라 분사 방향 정보를 포함하는 소화기 동작 정보를 생성하는 훈련용 소화기 및 상기 컨텐츠를 상기 디스플레이 장치로 제공하고, 상기 제1 자이로 센서의 측정값 및 상기 소화기 동작 정보에 기초하여, 상기 디스플레이 화면 상에 표시되는 상기 컨텐츠를 제어하는 컨텐츠 제공 장치를 포함하고, 상기 컨텐츠 제공 장치는, 상기 제1 자이로 센서의 측정값에 기초하여 상기 디스플레이 화면 상에 표시되는 상기 컨텐츠의 시점을 제어하고, 상기 제1 자이로 센서의 측정값과 상기 분사 방향 정보에 기초하여 상기 디스플레이 화면상에 표시되는 조준점의 위치를 제어한다.

title_en: A kind of the planning dispositions method and system at management and control center of controlling flood and draining flooded fields

title_en: Online SAR target detection method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of online SAR target detection method based on deep learning, mainly solves the problems, such as that prior art detection performance under complicated SAR scenes is low, its implementation is：1. training sample section is obtained from MiniSAR data sets；2. training sample section is expanded by random translation, with the training sample training after expansion based on end-to-end detection model YOLO in real time；Detect to obtain section to be detected 3. a pair SAR image to be measured carries out DP-CFAR CFAR；4. being detected with the model trained to each section to be detected, testing result is merged into artwork obtains SAR image testing result；5. model is constantly updated with the core set Coreset in the SAR image and Sample Storehouse of online updating, the detection performance of lift scheme.The present invention is improved to the detection performance of target under complicated SAR scenes, available for disaster detection, environment measuring and resource exploration.

abstract_en: The embodiment of the present application discloses the method and device for obtaining information.One embodiment of this method includes：Obtain the description information of pending information and above-mentioned pending information；The historical information of the corresponding foregoing description information of inquiry；Above-mentioned pending information and historical information are imported to the hazard model of training in advance, obtain the disaster probability of happening of corresponding above-mentioned pending information.The embodiment enables hazard model to consider current pending information and historical information simultaneously, obtains accurate disaster probability of happening, is advantageous to improve the degree of accuracy of prediction disaster.

title_en: Device and method for constructing retaining wall in disaster-relief work
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a retaining wall construction in disaster-relief work, which can minimize work of drilling and transporting natural ground on a slope and disassemble and export a formwork without working on the natural ground side.SOLUTION: A concrete formwork 1 and members that are made of steel are mainly used at the site. title_en: LED lamp system having disaster warning and training function
title_ko: 재난경보 및 재난훈련 기능을 구비한 엘이디 조명등 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an LED illumination lamp system having disaster warning and disaster training functions, which, in an illumination area of a building where an LED illumination lamp having an illumination LED group and an emergency LED group arranged on a single substrate is installed, turns on the illumination LED group of the LED illumination lamp to perform illumination at normal time, turns on the emergency LED group of the LED illumination lamp to generate disaster warning when a disaster like a fire or an earthquake occurs, and turns on the emergency LED group of the LED illumination lamp to generate disaster training warning to start disaster training when the training for a disaster like a fire or an earthquake is performed. The present invention can easily build a disaster warning system against a fire or an earthquake while installing the LED illumination lamp in the illumination area of the building and thereby integrate the disaster warning such as fire warning and earthquake warning, and particularly can conveniently monitor and control the disaster warning through an administrator screen displayed on an administrator terminal. The LED illumination lamp system comprises the LED illumination lamp, at least one disaster detector, a relay for an emergency switch, a communication hub, and a disaster management server.

title_en: A kind of Regional Landslide disaster assessment of easy generation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Regional Landslide disaster assessment of easy generation device, it includes：Flood inducing factors determining module, for choosing the Flood inducing factors of rainfall, landforms, the gradient and formation lithology as landslide disaster, and it is divided into five level of risk；Assignment module, for level of risk to be carried out into assignment from one to five；Training module, for using a large amount of district disasters statistics and rain making slope erosion result of the test as training sample, being trained using BP Artificial Neural Networks are improved to neutral net, obtaining the weight coefficient of each Flood inducing factors；Statistical module, for being multiplied the assignment of level of risk corresponding to each Flood inducing factors with weight coefficient to obtain influence value；Evaluation module, summed for determining level of risk corresponding to the Flood inducing factors of target slopes, and by assignment numerical value corresponding to level of risk to judge liability rank.The present invention can be assessed Regional Landslide disaster liability, and strong foundation is provided for the prevention of landslide disaster.

title_en: A kind of building spraying fire-extinguishing system disaster evaluation method based on BIM
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of building spraying fire-extinguishing system disaster evaluation method based on BIM, belongs to civil engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters technical field.This method includes that building is modeled with spray system, the assessment of spraying component earthquake, spray system Performance Evaluation and fire simulate four parts, design building and extinction by automatic sprinkling system are from BIM model to the conversion method of fire numerical model first, then the spraying fire-extinguishing system component disaster evaluation method based on next-generation Performance Design standard FEMA P-58 and structure time-history analysis is proposed, it is further proposed that the appraisal procedure of the spray system extinguishing property based on tree construction, finally in Numerical Simulation on Fire platform FDS, it carries out under impaired spray system and fire disaster simulation under normal spray system.The present invention can provide whole extinguishing property of the spray system after earthquake, and quantify to spray influence of the earthquake to building fire, provide important appraisal tool to reinforce the protection of building earthquake fire.

title_en: Ocean nuclear power platform single point mooring system testing device and its parameter acquiring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of ocean nuclear power platform single point mooring system testing device and its parameter acquiring method, it is related to single point mooring system field, including：The monitoring platform sent for carrying out data processing and instruction；Single point mooring system model；Mooring pylon；Its Test Rig, its Test Rig include：For carrying out the platform simulation system of attitude-simulating on six degree of freedom, platform simulation system is six degree of freedom platform；A pair and two soft just arm systems correspond the joint emergency response system of configuration.The present invention utilizes the posture between the first rope adjusting means, the second rope adjusting means, line guide and bearing pin linkage regulation mooring leg and mooring linking arm, and bearing pin strain gauge can monitor the stressing conditions of mooring leg and mooring linking arm hinged place bearing pin constantly, so as to obtain the separation stress threshold F of mooring leg, mooring linking arm Separation And optimal torque regulation coefficient δ It is optimal 。

title_en: A kind of high validity methods of exhibiting of architecture ensemble earthquake
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of high validity methods of exhibiting of architecture ensemble earthquake, belongs to earthquake disaster simulation electric powder prediction.The present invention carries out the Nonlinear time-history analysis under geological process using Level Multiple Degree of Freedom Structures model to the extensive groups of building in city, obtains the seismic response data (including earthquake damage level, displacement, speed etc.) for building each floor.On this basis, the dynamic and visual of building displacement is realized in three dimentional graph display based on the earthquake data that become more meticulous.Finally, the simulation algorithm of a comprehensive physical engine, graphics engine and time-history analysis is devised, to show the sense of reality physical process of building collapse.The present invention is applied using the real medium-sized city in one, China as example, illustrates architecture ensemble earthquake overall process realisticly.The present invention provides good visualization technique for the virtual earthquake emergency drilling in city.

title_en: Watershed surface runoff confluence simulation method and real-time computing device based on stable water flow field
abstract_en: The invention provides a watershed surface runoff confluence simulation method and a real-time computing device based on a stable water flow field, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, establishing an N-S equation in a grid mode; s2, carrying out water flow mixing simulation in the radial flow confluence model; and S3, iterating the flow field in the flow field by using the flow confluence model obtained in the S2, thereby obtaining a stable flow field. The method can provide auxiliary decision support for rapid simulation and evaluation of rainstorm flood disasters in the drainage basin, and has high application value.

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method of self-encoder based on entropy rate superpixel segmentation
abstract_en: The invention provides a hyperspectral image classification method of an autoencoder based on entropy rate superpixel segmentation, which mainly solves the problem of poor hyperspectral image classification performance. The method comprises the following implementation steps: acquiring a hyperspectral data training sample set and a test sample set; constructing n layers of self-encoder networks; inputting a training sample set, and training an entropy rate superpixel segmentation-based self-encoder network by using a loss function; inputting a test data set, and classifying the hyperspectral images by using a trained self-encoder network based on entropy rate superpixel segmentation. The hyperspectral image classification method based on the entropy rate superpixel segmentation self-encoder considers spatial context neighborhood information, excavates the distribution characteristics of data samples, effectively improves the classification precision of hyperspectral images, and can be used for distinguishing and distinguishing ground objects in the fields of agricultural monitoring, geological exploration, disaster environment assessment and the like.

title_en: Method for quantitatively evaluating landslide disaster risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quantitatively evaluating landslide disaster risk, and belongs to the field of geological disaster risk evaluation. The method is based on RAMMS and GIS, a landslide influence area is used as a research object, the motion process of the landslide is simulated under the support of RAMMS software, the motion characteristic parameters of the landslide are obtained, the landslide pressure parameters are used as landslide danger zone indexes, and the influence range and danger zone map of the landslide are obtained. The invention applies RAMMS to obtain the influence risk range and risk partition calculation of the landslide, and provides a new method for quantitatively evaluating the risk of the landslide influence area.

title_en: Transmission line transient response rapid calculation method based on Chebyshev quasi-spectrum-secondary boundary value coupling method
abstract_en: A transmission line transient response fast calculation method based on a Chebyshev quasi-spectrum-secondary boundary value coupling method is used for calculating a numerical value in a transmission line transient response process, firstly, a quasi-spectrum method which takes a Chebyshev polynomial as a basis function is adopted to disperse a telegraph equation in a spatial domain, and a first-order differential equation set in a time domain is obtained; on the basis, dispersing the differential equation on a time domain by adopting a 2-level 2-order or 3-order boundary value method to obtain a system discrete algebraic equation set; in order to avoid dimension disaster, the algebraic equation is solved by adopting a block tri-diagonal matrix pursuit method to obtain time domain numerical value solutions at each space discrete point. The transmission line transient response rapid calculation method based on the Chebyshev quasi-spectrum-secondary boundary value coupling method has the advantages of high calculation efficiency, short CPU time consumption and good numerical stability on the basis of ensuring the precision, can simulate the transient response process of the transmission line for a long time, and has great practical value for engineering application research of the transmission line.

title_en: System and method for enabling lighting for establishing an evacuation plan
abstract_en: A system and method are disclosed for developing a computational model of the behavior of a building occupant using data acquired from sensor-equipped connected luminaires. These models are then used to develop an optimized evacuation plan for safe and timely egress of occupants without the need for a simulation assessment maneuver.

title_en: A kind of Structural Loess physical model and preparation method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Structural Loess physical model and preparation method, comprises the following steps：Scene obtains and intends carrying out disturbed sample of the experiment undisturbed soil sample with layer, air-dries and is milled to dissipate soil, sieving, forms simulation loess dust；Model casing is made, coarse sands layer, simulation loess dust layer, acupuncture nonwoven geotextiles, layer of sand is laid successively from the bottom to top, the sensor of monitoring needs is embedded on the corresponding position of simulation loess dust layer, hole water pipe is disposed with layer of sand；The soil layer porosity each circulated is calculated according to the simulation loess dust layer thickness change, according to soil layer porosity calculation Na 2 CO 3 The amount of the aqueous solution, pass through 30 addition 0.1g/LNa of the hole water pipe point 2 CO 3 The aqueous solution；Apply boundary condition and influence condition as needed, with the ess-strain changing rule in the synchronously embedded Sensor monitoring soil body, the forming process of the geological disaster such as simulation landslide.Beneficial effects of the present invention make experimental result relatively reliable, credible.

title_en: Fault detection model construction and evaluation method based on SVM
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of cloud, and provides a fault model construction and evaluation method based on an SVM (support vector machine). the method comprises the following steps of selecting a radial basis kernel function (RBF) to construct a Support Vector Machine (SVM) cloud fault prediction model; training a Support Vector Machine (SVM) based on a given cloud sample training set, wherein the training process specifically comprises the following steps: the cloud fault prediction is converted into a quadratic plan with constraint conditions based on a Support Vector Machine (SVM); constructing a decision function based on a quadratic programming solution, wherein the decision function is a hyperplane; and performing fault evaluation on the test sample points based on the hyperplane. Compared with a BP model and an LVQ model, the SVM model can find out a global optimal solution, can avoid dimension disaster, and simultaneously has high convergence rate.

title_en: Mine escape training platform system after a kind of calamity
abstract_en: The present invention discloses mine escape training platform system after a kind of calamity, mainly realizes detector, projection screen, walking analogue means, air blower and sound system by master controller, mine laneway generalized information system, motion sensor, brain and forms.Mine escape training platform system uses virtual reality technology after the calamity of the invention, simulates mine adverse circumstances, by screen simulative display mine laneway, makes trainer's simulation in Minepit environment according to the tunnel Path selection escape direction of grasp.The training platform can effectively train the miner that goes into the well to be familiar with underworkings, train the self-escape ability in environment after calamity, have important application value to the casualties for reducing mine disaster.

title_en: A kind of laser drilling cuts integration and strengthens gas drainage system and method
abstract_en: The present invention, which discloses a kind of laser drilling and cuts integration, strengthens gas drainage system and method.The feature high for China's coal seam gas-bearing capacity, gas permeability is low, and the advantages of being cut by laser high-efficient, high directivity is combined, laser cutting is applied in the efficient extraction of gas of underground coal mine low air permeability coal seam.The system can be realized the institutional operation of drilling and coal seam cutting, significantly improve construction efficiency；And the synergistic effect of release and heat drive can be given full play to, the slot for being cut by laser formation is capable of the confining pressure of effective removal coal body, and induced with laser high temperature action, the temperature of coal body can be significantly improved, reduce the absorption potential of coal-bed gas, promote the fast desorption of coal-bed gas, significantly reduce the gas remainder quantity in coal seam, to realize the gas drainage efficiency for improving low air permeability coal seam and the purpose for effectively preventing low air permeability coal seam Gas Disaster.

title_en: Concrete sample high temperature pulling test device and its fire disaster simulation system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to concrete sample high temperature pulling test device and its fire disaster simulation system, wherein fire disaster simulation system, fire disaster simulation stove including supporting mechanism and on supporting mechanism, fire disaster simulation stove is to be formed by connecting by the big en cylindrical shell of two grades by articulated structure and lockset, en cylindrical shell surrounds the hollow space after fire disaster simulation stove and forms burner hearth for placing concrete tensioning test specimen, en cylindrical shell sets heat mechanism, the joint face of en cylindrical shell forms seam, the middle part of seam expands the deformation measurement seam to be formed and be used for deformation-sensor fixture；Concrete sample high temperature pulling test device includes fire disaster simulation system.The fire disaster simulation system design of the present invention is ingenious, hinge lock construction causes burner hearth opening to remain to make test specimen test section be put into burner hearth when being less than test specimen stand under load section, improves the efficiency of heating surface to test specimen test section, reduces the adverse effect that fire disaster simulation cost and simulated fire are brought to specimen holder fixture and surrounding environment.

title_en: Random simulation method for evaluating reliability of urban water supply pipe network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a random simulation method for evaluating the reliability of an urban water supply network, and belongs to the technical field of anti-seismic safety of urban water supply networks. The invention comprises the following steps: calculating the earthquake damage rate of the pipeline; generating a water supply network seismic damage scene based on Monte Carlo simulation; hydraulic analysis of a low-pressure water supply pipe network based on a step-by-step iteration method; and (5) calculating an anti-seismic reliability index. The method does not need to modify the pipe network system file or write additional codes to solve the hydraulic equation of the low-pressure pipe network, and has the advantages of high calculation efficiency and good stability. The method provides a new idea for water supply pipe network hydraulic simulation and reliability evaluation in earthquake, and has certain guiding significance for post-earthquake disaster relief and repair work.

title_en: One kind carries out flood control emergency response based on intelligent event category and knows method for distinguishing
abstract_en: The present invention provides one kind and knows method for distinguishing based on the progress flood control emergency response of intelligent event category, and it comprises the following steps：Step S1：According to the requirement of prediction scheme emergency response condition, the index automatically generated in system to flood control, windproof, all kinds of different emergency response early warning of taking precautions against drought carries out quantization setting, and sets Parameter Conditions；When response condition is triggered, emergency response early warning is studied and judged automatically；Step S2：Based on prediction scheme and the requirement of related work handbook, emergent responsive measures are carried out by department, temporally, by the structured management of rank, when warning grade generate, by instructing identification technology, the measure that Fast Classification identification responds；Step S3：History of forming file store, statistical analysis, evaluation are carried out according to emergency response feedback, instruct the efficiency of scheduling, accuracy to carry out evaluation analysis to emergency response, generates result, continuous iteration strengthens command recognition capability.The feature extraction that constantly training study is instructed, improves emergency response efficiency.

title_en: A kind of gas prevention spray orifice complexes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of gas prevention spray orifice complexes, the outlet air end connection casing of the air exhauster, the casing is interior to be provided with carbon monoxide alarm, and the bottom of casing is provided with air outlet, and the outside of the casing is provided with switch, and switchs and be electrically connected with air exhauster.The gas prevention spray orifice complexes, transparent shield are socketed with boring gun body, transparent shield is connected with airway tube, airway tube connects air exhauster, once there is gas to release, will be absorbed by transparent shield, enter in casing, detected, will alarm by carbon monoxide alarm, cause the vigilance of worker, worker stops operation immediately, it is acted upon, it is therefore prevented that the generation of disaster, ensure that the life security of worker.Hairbrush is then used to clear up the dust on transparent shield, prevents from influenceing sight, while dust also by respiratory box body, is more beneficial for the health of worker caused by drilling.

title_en: A kind of battery fire safety evaluating experimental system and experimental method using in-situ technique
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of battery fire safety evaluating experimental system and experimental method using in-situ technique, available for simulated battery overheat, overcharge with the Hot disaster event under loaded condition, and guide cell safety to design so as to be better understood from battery Hot disaster characteristic.Experiment porch realizes the mechanical load to the controllable stabilization of battery based on mechanics machine, and pass through the battery charging and discharging system of expansion, battery heating system, realize the over-charging of battery in identical platform, cross thermal condition, and stress, strain, thermal parameters, temperature, pressure, infrared thermal-image data, high speed imaging, the real-time monitoring of gas analysis data are completed using the in-situ technique of the present invention, the security of experimental system is improved using explosion-proof tank.

title_en: Rainfall and traffic vibration synergy slope unstability physical model test device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of rainfall and traffic vibration synergy slope unstability physical model test device, including the model test box that top and side are unlimited, for providing the rainfall simulation unit of rainfall, for exporting the power analogue unit of traffic vibration load, for tracking the monitoring unit and control unit of slope instability process, rainfall simulation unit is located at the top of model test box, power analogue unit is located at the bottom of model test box, rainfall simulation unit, power analogue unit and monitoring unit electrically connect with control unit, the device can simulated rainfall and traffic vibration single effect, reciprocation and coupling slope unstability Evolution, multiple it can also combine the Comparative trail for carrying out slope instability evolutions simultaneously.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows simple in construction, easy to operate, vdiverse in function, the preventing and treating of early warning and engineering for landslide disaster provides certain directive function.

title_en: A kind of ocean disaster method for early warning based on big data
abstract_en: A kind of ocean disaster method for early warning based on big data, described method for early warning are：(1) the distributed network reptile method based on uniformity hash algorithm, marine environment history original index space-time database DRO and marine environment history evaluation index space-time database DEO is obtained；Form data acquisition system Dro (R i (x i1 ,x i2 ,…x ij ),t i ),Deo(E i (y i1 ,y i2 ,…y im ),t i )；(2) standardization of data acquisition system；(3) marine environmental assessment and disaster alarm model are established：(3.1) Dro (R are based on i (x i1 ,x i2 ,…x ij ),t i ),Deo(E i (y i1 ,y i2 ,…y ij ),t i ), establish marine environment gradual change simulation model MS (Dro (R using Kringing methods i ,t i ),Deo(E i ,t i )), and then carry out correlation analysis and the evaluation of Environmental Health level of each index of marine environment, establish health assessment model；(3.2) Dro (R are based on i (x i1 ,x i2 ,…x ij ), t i ),Deo(E i (y i1 ,y i2 ,…y ij ),t i ) big data, based on support vector machines method, early warning is carried out to classification indicators and overall target.

title_en: A kind of building fire intelligent evacuation system
abstract_en: A kind of building fire intelligent evacuation system of the present invention, refer specifically to one kind and be based on fire real-time detection technology, fire trend prediction technology, evacuation analogue technique is integrated, applied to the evacuating personnel Induction Control system under building fire, it is related to building fire intelligent evacuation control technology field.Present system is connected composition with evacuation guiding equipment (4) by auto fire-detection equipment (1), fire Fast simulation module (2), evacuation Fast simulation module (3) through signal transmission system.The present invention is based on fire real-time detection and trend prediction, its possible influence area and crowd can be judged according to building fire truth, and provide the Evacuation Strategies of optimization, guide target group, in time, impacted crowd quickly, is rationally evacuated, the key issue for reducing building fire injures and deaths is solved, can effectively lift structural fire protection level of security, solid technology material base is provided, had important practical significance.

title_en: A kind of antidetonation prevention and the appraisal procedure and device of disaster relief ability
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of appraisal procedure and device for shaking prevention and disaster relief ability, wherein, this method includes：Obtain the geological data of multiple earthquake in history；Using the injures and deaths number after earthquake as explained variable, the density of population of seismic energy, earthquake generation area is built into injures and deaths degree forecast model as explanatory variable, and injures and deaths degree forecast model is trained using the geological data of acquisition；The antidetonation prevention and disaster relief ability of specifying earthquake corresponding region are assessed as the injures and deaths degree forecast model after the data input training of explanatory variable, and based on the injures and deaths number that model obtains using in the geological data of specified earthquake.The embodiment of the present invention builds injures and deaths degree forecast model, and injures and deaths degree forecast model is trained using the geological data of acquisition, realizes and the antidetonation prevention and disaster relief ability of specifying earthquake corresponding region are assessed based on the injures and deaths number that model obtains.

title_en: Lane colony algorithm-based river channel flood flow evolution law simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river course flood flow rate evolution law simulation method based on a wolf pack algorithm, which comprises the following steps of 1: establishing a Masjing root model by taking the minimum error with the actual flow process of the river flood as a target; step 2: calibrating parameters of the Mas Jing root model in the step 1 through a wolf colony algorithm to obtain a flow calculation coefficient when errors of a river channel flood flow simulation process and an actual flow process are minimum; and step 3: and (4) substituting the flow calculation coefficient obtained in the step (2) into the Massjing root model obtained in the step (1) to obtain a calibrated Massjing root model target function. The invention relates to a river channel flood flow rate evolution law simulation method based on a wolf pack algorithm, which is characterized in that a wolf pack algorithm is used for calibrating Masjing root model parameters, the effectiveness, the feasibility and the superiority of the wolf pack algorithm in the determination of flood evolution model parameter rates are discussed, and the method has important practical significance and application value for improving the forecast precision of three flood factors and the flood arrival time and preventing flood disasters.

title_en: A kind of landslide on-Line Monitor Device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of landslide on-Line Monitor Device, and it includes outdoor-monitoring device and prediction meanss：Outdoor-monitoring device includes multiple inclinometers, preprocessor and transmitting antenna, and inclinometer is used for the angle of inclination for monitoring peephole；Preprocessor is used for the coordinate position for recording each inclinometer, obtain and detect the angle of inclination for the peephole that each inclinometer monitors, and when exceeding predetermined threshold at the angle of inclination for detecting any inclinometer, angle of inclination and coordinate position are launched by transmitting antenna；Prediction meanss include reception antenna, data reception module and prediction module, data reception module receives angle of inclination and coordinate position by reception antenna, prediction module is used for the gradient simulation model that slopes are established according to angle of inclination and coordinate position, and gradient simulation model is compared with the original gradient model imported in advance, draw mud-rock flow sensitizing range.The present invention can carry out real-time radio monitoring to mud-rock flow, prevent mud-stone flow disaster.

title_en: A kind of scene type life security training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses scene type life security training system, contingency scene is experienced by immersion and grasps professional escape method, realize and carry out safe teaching training to experiencer in contingency, system includes traffic escape interactive experience system, falling object from high altitude interactive experience system and field of secure interactive experiencing system, family fire hidden danger identification interactive experience system, fire disaster escaping interactive experience system, seismic safety of riding and got fire teaching interaction experiencing system；So as in a manner of immersion, realize the purpose of the teaching of reply potential safety hazard and escape, and then greatly improve adaptibility to response of the people to potential safety hazard in life and the quick-reaction capability to burst accident.

title_en: Power transmission line forest fire distribution evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating forest fire distribution of a power transmission line, which comprises the following steps: collecting and screening fire point data; calculating the fire point density; carrying out interpolation calculation and filling according to fire point density in a grading way; superposing a vegetation map and volcanic hidden danger points in a mountain fire map; and superposing the power transmission lines in the mountain fire map. The invention discloses a fire ice disaster early warning analysis platform which can timely and quickly grasp specific information of fire occurrence by comprehensively monitoring fire conditions around a power transmission line through a satellite and the ground so as to analyze the influence of the fire on the adjacent power transmission line. The information of fire occurrence and the geographic information of the power transmission line are organically combined, the influence of the fire on the power transmission line at a specific position is rapidly and accurately judged, the power grid is reasonably dispatched and adjusted in time through power grid simulation calculation and analysis, and the influence of the power transmission line fault damaged by the fire on industrial and agricultural power and domestic power of people is reduced.

title_en: Short message disaster tolerance backup method, device, system and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short message disaster recovery backup method, a device, a system and related equipment, which are used for realizing that a VoLTE short message is sent by an 2/3G network instead when an IP _ SM _ GW fails, and solving the problem that a VoLTE user cannot receive the short message. The short message disaster recovery backup method comprises the following steps: judging whether an internet protocol short message gateway IP _ SM _ GW fails or not; if yes, simulating the IP _ SM _ GW to send a short message routing information query request to a short message receiver home subscriber server HSS/home location register HLR; and sending the short message to be sent to a receiving party according to the short message routing information carried in the response message returned by the HSS/HLR.

title_en: A kind of liquid nitrogen joint laser alternating hot and cold mash gas extraction system and method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of liquid nitrogen joint laser alternating hot and cold mash gas extraction system and method.Aiming at the problem that liquid nitrogen fracturing coal body thawing time length influences gas drainage efficiency, the basic thought of combined reinforced gas drainage is driven based on fracturing and heat, proposes a kind of liquid nitrogen joint laser alternating hot and cold mash gas extraction system and method.The system can be realized the institutional operation of drilling and coal seam cutting, significantly improve construction efficiency；The synergistic effect that fracturing and heat are driven can be given full play to, pass through first quick-frozen coal body steep temperature rise again, form huge temperature gradient rate of change, cause to generate huge tension-shear tests gradient in coal body, to efficiently fracturing coal body, and induced with laser high temperature action, the temperature of coal body can be significantly improved, reduce the absorption potential of coal-bed gas, promote the fast desorption of coal-bed gas, the gas remainder quantity in coal seam is significantly reduced, to realize the gas drainage efficiency for improving low air permeability coal seam and the purpose for effectively preventing low air permeability coal seam Gas Disaster.

title_en: A kind of Gas Disaster Forecasting Methodology based on K arest neighbors hybrid classifications
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Gas Disaster Forecasting Methodology based on K arest neighbors hybrid classifications, comprise the following steps：Establish Gas Disaster information characteristics database, the data of Gas Disaster information characteristics database are handled using CURE clustering algorithms, data after processing are reached to the purpose of Gas Disaster classification based on K arest neighbors hybrid sorting process, analysis result is showed into coal mining enterprise finally by front-end presentation tool (graphic user interface).The present invention can greatly reduce the data volume of gas training sample set using CURE clustering algorithms, so as to improve calculating speed, and the weights of each attribute of gas are adjusted using neural net method, so as to assign different weights to the different attribute of done contribution of classifying, avoid and cause classification prediction chaotic.

title_en: A kind of underground coal mine image processing method based on deep neural network
abstract_en: A kind of underground coal mine image processing method based on deep neural network, using AlexNet network structure model, eight layers of convolutional neural networks are constructed, the training to network is completed using Tensorflow deep learnings training framework；Then, too high for five class picture quality brightness, brightness is too low, noise is too high, and contrast is too low, the too low image of resolution ratio, using its training and test of the realization to the convolutional neural networks after initial training, to obtain the depth convolutional neural networks that picture quality classification can be achieved；With reference to current ripe image processing method, different types of image processing method is used for the image of different quality type respectively.Present invention is not only the key issue that the detection detection visualization of mine disaster area must solve, and will also be exploited for following China deep coal resources wide scale security and provide stock of knowledge and technical foundation.

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling water damage in deep high-pressure-bearing underwater thick coal seam mining
abstract_en: A deep high-bearing-pressure underwater thick coal seam mining water hazard control method is based on comprehensive analysis of mine geological and hydrogeological conditions and determines a high-bearing-pressure water-bearing stratum deep in a thick coal seam roof. And dividing a coal face roof high-pressure water threat area on the basis of drilling data and thick coal seam mining overburden rock damage rule research. And determining the positions and parameters of a water drainage roadway and a drainage drilling hole according to the coal mining method of the working face of the threat zone, the position of the high-pressure-bearing water-containing layer, the position of the roof separation zone and the like. High confined aquifer water and roof separation water are drained through the drainage water drill hole, and meanwhile, the drainage roadway is used for automatically draining the drill water and the working area water. The hole-roadway combined water disaster prevention and control method realizes systematic comprehensive prevention and control of deep high-pressure-bearing underwater thick coal seam mining from dredging to draining, and provides technical support for coal mine safety production.

title_en: Footrest-cum-standing/raising aid
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a footrest-cum-standing/raising aid which prevents economy class syndrome, helps an aged person having insufficient exercise, mitigates heavy feeling of legs for a person who works on a chair for an extended time, while many people die of economy class syndrome when, in evacuation due to a disaster, people are forced to spend a long time in a narrow place such as a shelter and an automobile.SOLUTION: A rod of a hard light material is bent in an S shape that is long sideways to form a standing/raising aid, with a footrest attached to an upper stage. abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual training (VT) system capable of enabling users to take training on evacuation in case of a fire by using virtual reality. abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Intelligence Simulation of compartment fire simulation Training scene, comprise the following steps：Establish flue-gas temperature model before inside fire flashes over；The curve that flue-gas temperature changes over time is obtained according to flue-gas temperature model, prediction flashes over the time；Establish the burning combination of different fire extinguishing difficulty；The obtained burning combination application for flashing over time and different fire extinguishing difficulty will be predicted to fire field environment.Flue-gas temperature model proposed by the invention, indoor multiple scenes can be predicted flashes over the time, such as office space, hospital, arenas etc., it can predict that starting burning things which may cause a fire disaster flashes over the time in room at diverse location, under the conditions of different combustibles two simultaneously, a variety of fire field environments are provided for fire-fighting simulated training, make training more diversified.

title_en: Garments for Fire Education
title_ko: 소방 교육용 체험복
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an experience suit for fire education, which enables extinguishment of fire to be performed in a play manner by simulating a situation in which clothes are lit up, wherein the experience suit for fire education is intended for an infant or a child in order to improve the knowledge of fire safety education. The present invention aims to provide the experience suit for fire education, which enables a kindergarten or elementary school student to easily understand a method for extinguishing the fire by simulating the situation in which the clothes are lit up in the event of actual fire to enable the students to easily understand the fire extinguishing method in the situation in which the clothes are lit up during the fire safety education.
abstract_ko:

title_en: The mini storehouse of Big Dipper people's air defense
abstract_en: Patent of the present invention is related to a kind of mini storehouse system of Big Dipper people's air defense, it is made up of Anneta module, radio-frequency module, information processing board, mini storehouse, power supply module, compared with prior art, patent of the present invention has the mini storehouse system of Big Dipper people's air defense that Beidou satellite communication, positioning, time service, WIFI communications, GPRS communications, remote monitoring are integrated, in combat exercise, burst fire-disaster, mini storehouse can be opened by big-dipper satellite remote control, materials needed are provided for combat exercise, the disaster relief.Due to providing Beidou satellite communication function, full region can be accomplished, without blind spot remote control.It can be widely applied to the fields such as combat exercise, relief goods storage.

title_en: A kind of Group-occurring landslides volume rapid extracting method based on low latitude unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Group-occurring landslides volume rapid extracting method based on low latitude unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing, unmanned plane oblique photograph is carried out including step 1, to devastated, measurement data is recorded, and the DEM and DOM of Software Create devastated are handled by Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Data；Step 2, DOM and DEM using devastated, extract the border of all landslide disaster points in devastated；Step 3, pass through DEM before the calamity of the peripheral terrain data simulation devastated of each landslide disaster point；Step 4, according to DEM before the DEM of devastated and the calamity simulated, calculate the cumulative volume of Group-occurring landslides in devastated.The Group-occurring landslides volume rapid extracting method based on low latitude unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing of the present invention, on the one hand the precision and operating efficiency of mass-sending property landslide volume measurement can be improved, on the other hand the security of measurement can be improved, the work that can be prevented and reduced natural disasters for mountain area provides scientific basis, is had broad application prospects in disaster prevention decision field.

title_en: A kind of landslide disaster volume rapid extracting method based on three-dimensional laser scanning technique
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of landslide disaster volume rapid extracting method based on three-dimensional laser scanning technique, comprise the following steps：Step 1, by three-dimensional laser scanner landslide scene is scanned, the three-dimensional intensive cloud data of the earth's surface behind collection landslide；Step 2, based on SURFER software buildings come down after earth's surface digital elevation model；Step 3, the earth's surface digital elevation model before landslide is simulated according to the peripheral terrain data that comes down；Step 4, according to the earth's surface digital elevation model behind landslide and landslide before earth's surface digital elevation model, calculate landslide volume.The landslide disaster volume rapid extracting method based on three-dimensional laser scanning technique of the present invention, from three-dimensional laser scanning technique, landslide surface threedimensional model is built by three-dimensional point off density cloud, on the one hand the precision and operating efficiency of landslide volume measurement can be improved, on the other hand the security of measurement can be improved, scientific basis is provided for mountain area work of preventing and reducing natural disasters, is had broad application prospects in disaster prevention decision field.

title_en: A kind of rock mass engineering project dynamic disaster simulation experiment system of large-tonnage
abstract_en: A kind of rock mass engineering project dynamic disaster simulation experiment system of large-tonnage, it is related to the equipment tested the rock mass of large-tonnage, including firm banking, first base, annular frame, second base, loading cylinder up and down and left and right loading cylinder are connected in annular frame, in the front and rear loading cylinder of one side connection of second base, loading cylinder up and down, left and right, which loads cylinder and front and rear loading cylinder, includes static load cylinder barrel, dynamic load cylinder barrel, static load piston rod, dynamic load piston rod, dynamic load cylinder barrel installation cavity and static load rodless cavity are set in static load cylinder barrel, dynamic load cylinder barrel is arranged in dynamic load cylinder barrel installation cavity, static load piston rod is arranged in static load rodless cavity；One end of dynamic load piston rod sets dynamic load piston, and dynamic load piston is arranged in dynamic load cylinder barrel, and the other end of dynamic load piston rod connects replaceable drift after the gland and static load piston rod of dynamic load cylinder barrel；One end that static load cylinder barrel is stretched out in static load piston rod sets mounting flange and loading blocks.Static load loading and dynamic load loading can be achieved, can also carry out simultaneously.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting drill emulates gas bottle device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting drill to emulate gas bottle device, including the external bottle with bottle valve, external bottle bottom sets inflation button switch, the inner bottle being connected by copper tube or steel pipe and magnetic valve with the bottle valve is set in external bottle, alumina silicate insulation quilt is filled between interior external bottle, magnetic valve is connected to four temperature relays by battery, and temperature relay is disposed in parallel with one another, and temperature relay is connected with being arranged on the intraparietal hot energy-storage blocks of outer blank.The utility model can both meet hot drill requirement of the firefighterses to burning liquid gas cylinder, and ensure that the person of firefighterses in the training process was perfectly safe by effectively controlling liquefied gas bottle burning and gas cylinder temperature.

title_en: System for fire drill base on augmented reality and method using the same
title_ko: 증강현실 기반의 화재 대피훈련 시스템 및 이를 이용한 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fire evacuation training system and a method using the same which determine a facility in which a subject stays based on image information around the subject and location information, and use virtual information incorporating the image information around the subject, the location information, and facility information for the facility in which the subject stays to perform fire evacuation training. According to the present invention, the fire evacuation training system based on augmented reality comprises: a subject terminal to acquire subject information including image information for a facility in which a subject stays and real-time location information; a fire evacuation training server to acquire facility information for the facility in which the subject stays based on the acquired subject information, divide the facility whose facility information is acquired into a plurality of areas, and determine at least one area among the plurality of areas to generate augmented reality information to present an occurrence of a virtual fire in the determined area; and an image output device to output an image including the augmented reality information when synchronized with the subject terminal. Accordingly, a fire situation can be experienced for ordinary people including children, and a virtual fire situation can be presented to perform evacuation training in various facilities without a limitation on a place.
abstract_ko: 체험자 주변의 영상정보와 위치정보를 기반으로 체험자가 체류 중인 시설을 판단하고, 체험자 주변의 영상정보와 위치정보와 체험자가 체류 중인 시설에 대한 시설정보를 반영한 가상의 정보를 이용하여 화재 대피훈련을 수행하는 화재 대피훈련 시스템 및 이를 이용한 방법이 개시된다. 본 증강현실 기반의 화재 대피훈련 시스템은 체험자가 체류 중인 시설에 대한 영상정보와 실시간 위치정보가 포함된 체험자 정보가 획득되도록 하는 체험자 단말; 상기 획득된 체험자 정보를 기반으로 상기 체험자가 체류 중인 시설에 대한 시설정보가 획득되도록 하며, 상기 시설정보가 획득된 시설이 복수의 영역으로 분할되되, 상기 복수의 영역 중 적어도 하나의 영역이 결정되어, 상기 결정된 영역에 가상의 화재가 발생된 것으로 연출되도록 하는 증강현실 정보가 생성되도록 하는 화재 대피훈련 서버; 및 상기 체험자 단말과 동기화되면, 상기 증강현실 정보가 포함된 영상이 출력되도록 하는 영상출력장치; 를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 장소에 제한 없이 다양한 시설에서, 어린이들을 포함한 일반인들을 대상으로 화재 상황을 체험할 수 있으며, 가상의 화재 상황을 연출하여 대피훈련을 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of firefighting fire extinguishing robot towards complicated ground environment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of firefighting fire extinguishing robot towards complicated ground environment,Including firefighting fire extinguishing robot device,Manipulate console,Fire water monitor,Fire probes component,Flame automatic aiming component,Water band Automatic-falling component,From spray assemblies,Ambient parameter gathers module,It can ensure or improve the exercise performance and security put out a fire in complicated ground under environment,Improve the load capacity of firefighting fire extinguishing robot,Improve the tensile capacity during dragging fire hose of rear,Obstacle climbing ability,Stair climbing ability and excessively rugged " unilateral bridge " ability in left and right,Ensure that firefighting fire extinguishing robot still is able to motion of advancing when running into flame and itself body or crawler belt being burnt,Fire water monitor interface automatic dropping mechanism is improved to improve successful self-insurance rate when robot is withdrawn,Increase the Automatic-searching flame of firefighting fire extinguishing robot and automatically control the device of fire water monitor aiming,So as to improve the fire-fighting efficiency of robot and automaticity.

title_en: Explosion-proof fire inspection firefighting robot and method of work
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of explosion-proof type fire inspection firefighting robot, come off component, explosion-proof from spraying cooling component including explosion-proof fire inspection firefighting robot mobile chassis, control box, explosion-proof fire water monitor, explosion-proof scouting component, explosion-proof road conditions camera assembly, explosion-proof fire hose, exercise performance and security of the fire inspection firefighting robot under complicated ground and severe disaster environment are improved, improves the explosion-proof capabilities and water resistance of fire inspection firefighting robot；Fire inspection firefighting robot carrying load ability is improved, tensile capacity when rear drags fire hose, obstacle climbing ability, stair climbing ability is improved and crosses rugged " unilateral bridge " ability in left and right；Ensure that fire inspection firefighting robot still is able to motion of advancing when running into flame and itself body or crawler belt being burnt；Successful self-insurance rate when robot is withdrawn is improved, improves the automaticity of robot, expands the scope of application and practicality of fire inspection firefighting robot.

title_en: Underground engineering geological disaster teaching demonstration device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a teaching demonstration device and a teaching demonstration method for geological disasters of underground engineering, comprising a steel plate box with an open top, wherein a simulation box body is arranged in the steel plate box; a vibration control device is arranged between the steel plate box and the simulation box body; the simulation box body is filled with bedrock simulation filler; the device comprises a simulation box body, wherein a side wall of the simulation box body is provided with a strip-shaped groove, a glass plate is arranged on the side wall of the simulation box body, a sedimentation tank, a funnel-shaped groove and a mud water migration channel are arranged above the strip-shaped groove, and a steel wire mesh is arranged between the bottom of the sedimentation tank and the strip-shaped groove; and gypsum blocks are arranged in the strip-shaped grooves. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the method can obviously observe the concrete damage conditions such as deformation displacement collapse, ground subsidence, surface subsidence, water burst and mud burst of a karst area and the like of a rock-soil body when demonstrating the underground engineering geological disaster, and integrally demonstrate the formation and movement process of the underground engineering geological disaster.

title_en: Pipeline safety evaluation method based on strain detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pipeline safety evaluation device and method based on strain detection. The technical scheme is as follows: the pipeline testing device comprises a test bed, a pipeline fixing and axial displacement loading device, a transverse displacement loading device, a pipeline internal pressure loading device and a strain detection and analysis device, wherein the pipeline is installed on the test bed through the pipeline fixing and axial displacement loading device and the transverse displacement loading device, the pipeline internal pressure loading device is arranged on the pipeline, and the pipeline internal pressure loading device is connected with the strain detection and analysis device through a data line for detection and analysis. The beneficial effects are that: the small physical simulation test of the buried pipeline geological disaster under multiple displacement load effects can be carried out, the stress of a pipeline danger point can be determined, and the small physical simulation test is used for safety evaluation of buried oil and gas pipelines under the action of geological disasters such as faults and landslides and provides a basis for safe operation of the buried pipelines; the method has the characteristics of real-time visibility of the test process, simple and efficient detection scheme and the like, is suitable for pipeline model detection demonstration, and can be popularized and applied in engineering.

title_en: Crowd evacuation behavior dynamic prediction simulator and its method of work under a kind of accident to leak the poison gas
abstract_en: The present invention provides crowd evacuation behavior dynamic prediction simulator and its method of work under a kind of accident to leak the poison gas, is related to Environmental security field.With reference to crowd dynamics model and Cellular Automaton Theory, the qualitative and quantitative relationship between the route selection that accident to leak the poison gas scene, diffusion conditions, personnel's individual character etc. are advanced with personnel is determined, establish cellular local motion rule；According to poisonous substance injure model explore generation personnel poisoning, death by accident critical condition and critical condition, establish evacuation speed with suction poison gas dosage the Expression formula that changes；Build personnel's dynamic evacuation model based on Cellular Automaton Theory；A device with visual means simulation burst accident to leak the poison gas safety evacuation is formed using the model, the function such as toxic gas diffusion and human evacuation behavior synchronously simulating, simultaneous display is completed, preferably to aid in escape technical ability when evacuating director's decision-making or helping the correct accident to leak the poison gas of popular grasp.

title_en: A kind of method for testing crack-resistant performance of concrete
abstract_en: A kind of method for testing crack-resistant performance of concrete, concrete raw material is stirred by proportioning, pours into template, keeps test specimen upper surface exposed, the composite produced with simulated environment factor；Temperature sensor is inserted into respectively in the middle part of test specimen in trisection point, and environmental cabinet thermometer hole, humidity sensor is placed in environmental cabinet；Installation displacement sensor in the middle part of test specimen, and fixed with positioning tool, keep its position constant；Corresponding environmental cabinet epidemic disaster and constrained parameters are set in software test interface, true environment is simulated, removes positioning tool after concrete final set, start to test, when 5 is small, pressure is applied to concrete, and measure the displacement data of concrete；The elasticity modulus of concrete different larval instar is calculated according to formula, and crack-resistant performance of concrete index is calculated according to formula.The present invention can test cracking resistance of the concrete under temperature change development condition, produce to grasp mechanical performance of concrete and crack preventing and provide reliable basis.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: A kind of method for measuring concrete surface drying shrinkage stress
abstract_en: A kind of method for measuring concrete surface drying shrinkage stress, concrete is stirred according to proportioning, pours into template, keeps test specimen upper surface exposed, the drying shrinkage produced with simulated environment factor on test specimen influences；Temperature sensor is inserted into respectively in the middle part of test specimen in trisection point, and environmental cabinet thermometer hole, humidity sensor is placed in environmental cabinet；Displacement sensor is installed in the middle part of test specimen, and is fixed with positioning tool, keeps its position constant；The test parameters such as corresponding environmental cabinet epidemic disaster and constrained parameters are set in software test interface, true environment is simulated；Positioning tool is removed after concrete final set, starts to test, measures the drying shrinkage stress data of concrete；Drying shrinkage or bulking factor are calculated according to formula, the drying shrinkage stress development course of concrete is calculated according to formula.The present invention can test surface drying shrinkage stress of the concrete under the conditions of actual environment condition Change and Development, produce to grasp mechanical performance of concrete and crack preventing and provide reliable basis.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: It is a kind of to survey damage identification method using the agricultural insurance of machine learning techniques
abstract_en: The invention belongs to agricultural insurance technical field, a kind of more particularly to the step of surveying damage identification method using the agricultural insurance of machine learning techniques, mainly including field operation sampling, the acquisition of sample data, the training of model, classification remote sensing image, generation disaster-stricken report analyzed, handled using machine learning techniques.The distribution of target crops and distribution area can be evaluated, the disaster-stricken grade formulated according to expert, the disaster-stricken grade of target crops is divided, and whether each grade carries out insurance and is judged, and yield is estimated and setting loss offer data foundation is provided, the advantages of reducing the risk of insurance company, increasing profit.
