title_en: A kind of geological disaster lithotripsy apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of lithotripsy apparatus, more particularly to a kind of geological disaster lithotripsy apparatus.The technical problem to be solved in the present invention is to provide a kind of geological disaster lithotripsy apparatus.In order to solve the above technical problem, the present invention provides such a geological disaster lithotripsy apparatus, includes drill bit, link, first rotating shaft, clutch shaft bearing, the first belt pulley, the first connection belt, second belt pulley etc.；Bottom plate lower part is provided with 3rd bearing, is equipped with the 3rd shaft in 3rd bearing, wheel and second bevel gear is provided with the 3rd shaft, bottom plate left part is provided with link, and link lower part is provided with clutch shaft bearing, first rotating shaft is provided with clutch shaft bearing.Invention achieves the high effect of easy to use, highly practical, work efficiency, the rubble produced in geological disaster can be rapidly completed using this equipment, saves a large amount of manual labors, accelerates the reconstruction after calamity, the dust produced in the course of work is few, reduces influence of the dust to staff.

title_en: Fluid pressure type acoustic monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fluid pressure type acoustic monitoring system, including the acoustic emission sensor being installed in the drilling of monitored rock mass and ground handling station, acoustic emission sensor is made of acoustic emission probe, the probe installing mechanism for installing acoustic emission probe and the transport mechanism for transmitting probe installing mechanism, and probe installing mechanism includes housing, probe sleeve and two sets of piston-cylinder assemblies.The utility model realizes the control to housing and the probe sleeve direction of motion by piston-cylinder assemblies and hydraulic pump, so as to solve the problem that acoustic emission probe is effectively installed and coupled, ensure the efficient coupling of acoustic emission probe and borehole wall, strengthen the monitoring to engineering rock (body) stability and rock burst dynamic disaster and forecast reliability.

title_en: Coupling pressure rock rupture acoustic monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of coupling pressure rock rupture acoustic monitoring system, including the acoustic emission sensor being installed in the drilling of monitored rock mass and ground handling station, acoustic emission sensor is made of acoustic emission probe, the probe installing mechanism for installing acoustic emission probe and the transport mechanism for transmitting probe installing mechanism, and probe installing mechanism includes housing, the probe sleeve being installed in housing, is fixed on the end cap of probe sleeve upper surface and is arranged at the piston-cylinder assemblies at the top of inner walls between end cap.The utility model passes through piston-cylinder assemblies and hydraulic pump, realize the control to housing and the probe sleeve direction of motion, so as to solve the problem that acoustic emission probe is effectively installed and coupled, ensure the efficient coupling of acoustic emission probe and borehole wall, strengthen the monitoring to engineering rock (body) stability and rock burst dynamic disaster and forecast reliability.

title_en: Recovery type scene acoustic emission sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of recovery type scene acoustic emission sensor, including acoustic emission probe, probe installing mechanism and the transport mechanism that the assembly of acoustic emission probe and probe installing mechanism is sent to setting position in the drilling of monitored rock mass；Probe installing mechanism includes housing, probe sleeve, spring spool, spring and fixed pulley assembly, probe sleeve is installed in housing guide cylinder, spring spool is fixed on probe sleeve both sides, it is mounted therein with spring, first rope one end in fixed pulley assembly is connected through being installed on the fixed pulley at the top of inner walls with probe sleeve upper surface end cap.The utility model is cooperated by the first rope and spring being arranged between housing and probe sleeve, can realize the control to the probe sleeve direction of motion, solves the problem that acoustic emission probe is effectively installed and coupled；Ensure the efficient coupling of acoustic emission probe and borehole wall, strengthen the monitoring to mine rock (body) stability and rock burst dynamic disaster and forecast reliability.

title_en: A kind of fire disaster escaping detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire disaster escaping detector.The fire disaster escaping detector is made of support frame and electronic circuit, and the electronic circuit is installed in support frame.The support frame is U-shaped structure, including two pillars of base and left and right, the left and right sidesing pillar are individually fixed in the left and right ends of the base, and the height of two pillars can be adjusted freely.The electronic circuit includes optical signal and circuit, optical signal detecting circuit, relay, warning circuit and power circuit occurs, the top that the optical signal generation circuit is respectively arranged in two pillars in left and right with the optical signal detecting circuit is installed on the base of support frame close to apical position, the relay and warning circuit.The fire disaster escaping detector can be used for the application fields such as fire disaster escaping skills training, and compared with prior art, the fire disaster escaping detector has the advantages that flexible structure, high sensitivity and has a wide range of application.

title_en: A kind of evaluating method and device of clustering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of evaluating method and device of clustering system, the method includes：Step 1, the cluster caller information table of central server is obtained, is included in the cluster caller information table：Invocation target address, Profile Path, disaster tolerance switching time limit；Step 2, A reads configuration file according to the Profile Path, judges whether the invocation target address configures rationally according to configuration file content；When being determined as unreasonable, the first warning information is generated, generation includes the report of accessment and test of first warning information；And/or B judges whether the clustering system completes disaster tolerance switching within the disaster tolerance switching time limit by simulation test；When the clustering system does not complete disaster tolerance switching within the disaster tolerance switching time limit, the second warning information is generated, generation includes the report of accessment and test of second warning information；Step 3, report of accessment and test is exported.

title_en: Decision method and system for investment of urban flood control facility using of climate chang scenarios
title_ko: 기후변화 시나리오를 활용한 홍수방재시설 투자결정 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for making an investment decision for a flood disaster prevention facility using a climate change scenario. The method comprises the following steps: (a) a data collecting unit (100) collects future climate change scenario data, economic element data, and technical element data of a flood disaster prevention facility installation area; (b) a data analysis unit (200) calculates a flood damage amount and a present value of the flood damage amount according to the future climate change scenario data and analyzes economic feasibility to obtain economic feasibility analysis data; and (c) an investment determination unit (300) calculates an expected future profit value based on the obtained economic feasibility analysis data and obtains investment decision information on a flood disaster prevention facility based on the calculated expected future profit value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기후변화 시나리오를 활용한 홍수방재시설 투자결정 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, (a) 데이터 수집부(100)가 홍수방재시설 설치 지역의 미래 기후변화 시나리오 데이터, 경제요소 데이터 및 기술요소 데이터를 수집하는 단계; (b) 데이터 분석부(200)가 미래 기후변화 시나리오 데이터에 따른 홍수 피해액 및 홍수 피해액의 현재가치를 산출하고 경제성을 분석하여 경제성 분석 데이터를 획득하는 단계; 및 (c) 투자 결정부(300)가 획득한 경제성 분석 데이터를 바탕으로 향후 기대이익 값을 산출하고, 산출된 기대이익 값을 기준으로 홍수방재시설에 대한 투자결정 정보를 획득하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Firefighter fitness trainer
abstract_en: A device and method for the performing of fireground training exercises is presented. The device includes a sled having a plurality of runners. Further included is a frame in communication with the sled. The frame is coupled to the sled and defines a structure. A number of simulation exercises are facilitated via the device, such as a ceiling breach simulation device. The ceiling breach simulation device is configured to include a pole having a first end and a second end. The first end pivots about a mount in communication with the sled so as to maintain the point of rotation below the hands of the trainee. In one embodiment the ceiling breach simulation device permits both rotational motion as well as vertical translation of the pole.

title_en: Insertion-type emergency evacuation route equipped with elastic wall
title_ko: 신축벽이 내장된 삽입식 비상대피통로
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency evacuation route installed in a wall or slab dividing households in an apartment building and, particularly, is configured to be constructible by drilling a hole in a wall to which an evacuation route has not been constructed and to be able to delay evacuation for a predetermined time so as not to cause any serious invasion of privacy to the members of a different household when an evacuee evacuates to the different household in case of fire. In order to achieve these purposes, the insertion-type emergency evacuation route according to the present invention comprises: a hole formed in a wall dividing households; an elastic wall positioned in the hole and expanding or contracting by means of a filler filled therein; support frames supporting an expanded elastic wall such that the wall is positioned in and thereby closes the hole; covers fitted around side parts of the support frames corresponding to the sides of the hole; and first pads positioned by filling the spaces between the covers and the elastic wall.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택의 각 세대를 구획하는 벽체 또는 슬라브에 설치되는 비상대피통로에 관한 것으로서, 특히 대피통로가 시공되지 않은 벽체에 구멍을 뚫어 시공 가능하도록 구성되며, 화재 시에 대피자가 타 세대로 대피함에 있어 타 세대원의 심각한 사생활 침해가 발생하지 않도록 일정시간 대피를 지연할 수 있게 구성한 것이다. 상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 삽입식 비상대피통로는 세대를 구획하는 벽에 형성된 구멍과, 구멍에 위치하며 내부에 채워지는 충진재에 의해 팽창하거나 수축하는 신축벽과, 팽창된 신축벽이 구멍 내부에 위치하여 구멍을 폐쇄하도록 지지하는 지지프레임과, 구멍의 양측에 대응하는 지지프레임의 측부에 정합하는 뚜껑과, 뚜껑과 신축벽의 사이에 채워져 위치하는 제1패드를 포함하는 것을 기술적 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Disaster preventer trainning system, portable terminal for trainning disaster preventer and method for operating disaster preventer trainning system
title_ko: 방재요원 훈련 시스템, 방재요원 훈련용 단말기 및 방재요원 훈련 시스템 운용방법
abstract_en: A disaster prevention agent training system according to an embodiment of the present invention may include: a server which generates coefficient data per channel of a radiation detector for each of a plurality of regions; and a portable terminal which transmits its own position information to the server and receives the coefficient data per channel corresponding to the position information from the server. One embodiment of the present invention is to provide radiation detector coefficient data corresponding to the current position of a disaster prevention agent to the disaster prevention agent during the training to improve the training proficiency of the disaster prevention agent.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 방재요원 훈련 시스템은, 복수의 지역별로 방사선검출기의 채널당 계수 데이터를 생성하는 서버와, 서버에 자신의 위치정보를 전송하고 서버로부터 위치정보에 대응되는 지역의 채널당 계수 데이터를 수신하는 휴대용 단말기를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of smog escape experience passage
abstract_en: A kind of smog escape experience passage, including carriage body, in the experience passage being internally provided with through carriage body of carriage body, support plate is equipped with experience one side roof part of vias inner walls, aerosol producer is placed with support plate, emergency light is equipped with the top of experience vias inner walls opposite side, emergency exit indicating lamp is equipped with above two fan fire exit doors in experience passage, evacuation direction indicator light is equipped with the lower part of experience two madial wall of passage, the length direction of lower part edge experience passage of two madial wall of passage is experienced equipped with the light prompt band parallel to carriage body bottom plate, infrared inductor is provided with experience passage madial wall at the top of light prompt band, experience passage madial wall is equipped with alarm.The utility model is using the above structure, real fire-fighting corridor can be simulated, smog can be full of in smog escape experience passage, people pass through experience, escape skill of tension training when fire occurs in smoky environment is full of can be experienced, reaches preferable fire-fighting drill effect.

title_en: A kind of method for measuring concrete early stage elasticity modulus
abstract_en: A kind of method for measuring concrete early stage elasticity modulus, concrete raw material is stirred by corresponding proportioning, pours into accommodating space, forms test specimen, keep test specimen upper surface exposed, the composite produced with simulated environment factor；Temperature sensor is inserted into respectively in the middle part of test specimen in trisection point, and environmental cabinet thermometer hole, humidity sensor is placed in environmental cabinet；Installation displacement sensor in the middle part of test specimen, and fixed with positioning tool, keep its position constant；Corresponding environmental cabinet epidemic disaster and constrained parameters are set in software test interface, true environment is simulated, removes positioning tool after concrete final set, start to test, the payload data of corresponding age is applied according to following table and measures the displacement data of concrete；Strained according to the test specimen measured, the elasticity modulus of concrete different larval instar is calculated according to formula.The present invention can test early stage elasticity modulus of the concrete under the conditions of actual environment condition Change and Development.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: A kind of virtual fire fighting training system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to virtual emergency training equipment field, and in particular to a virtual fire fighting training system.Fire fighting training system of the invention virtual have the advantages that it is interactive it is strong, safe and pollution-free, reusable, cost is low etc..By filling the fire extinguisher of tap water under the driving of compressed air, form fire extinguishing water column, it is injected on the Projection Display glass curtain wall of scene of a fire video, water column position is detected by photosensor arrays, and contrasted with the position of burning things which may cause a fire disaster in the scene of a fire in video, so as to judge to put out a fire, whether position is correct, position and the speed of video playing is further controlled, so as to fulfill virtual fire-extinguishing operations.The virtual extinguishing device of the present invention can meet one and more people experience, for cultivating fire-fighting ability, improve security against fire consciousness, grasp fire extinguishing skill, culture cooperation extinguishing ability, and accumulation fire-extinguishing operations experience has highly important effect.

title_en: A kind of Campus Security emergency drilling management method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of Campus Security emergency drilling management method, including：Rehearsal prepares：Administration school information, school's emergency response operational staff information and emergency drilling prediction scheme are stored in advance in emergency command administrative center, school emergency response operational staff receives emergency drilling prediction scheme information；Rehearsal starts：Emergency command administrative center starts emergency drilling prediction scheme to administration school；Rehearsal process：The personnel for participating in rehearsal evacuate or hide rapidly according to the alarm tone of school broadcasting's system plays and the commander of school emergency response operational staff；Rehearsal terminates：The personnel's number for participating in rehearsal is checked by school emergency response operational staff entire team；Emergency drilling data is uploaded to emergency command administrative center automatically；Rehearsal is summarized：Emergency drilling effect is evaluated, submits emergency drilling record；The present invention realizes that higher level responsible educational institution can start one or start multiple school safety emergency drilling tasks at the same time, and can learn the situation of one or more school safety emergency drillings in time.
assignees: NANJING XUE LI AN EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for earthquake drill base on augmented reality and method using the same
title_ko: 증강현실 기반의 지진 대피훈련 시스템 및 이를 이용한 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an augmented reality-based earthquake evacuation drill system, which determines a facility where a participant is staying based on information on the image and location of the periphery of the participant, and which conducts an earthquake evacuation drill by using virtual information to which the information on the image and location of the periphery of the participant and information on the facility where the participant is staying are reflected, and a method using the system. The augmented reality-based earthquake evacuation drill system of the present invention comprises: a participant terminal obtaining participant information including image information and real-time location information on a facility where a participant is staying; an earthquake evacuation drill server receiving, from the outside, or loading and obtaining, from a pre-stored database, the information on the facility where the participant is staying when detecting the facility where the participant is staying based on the real-time location information included in the obtained participant information, and generating augmented reality information including an image created to display a virtual earthquake generated in the facility from which the facility information has been obtained; an image output device outputting the augmented reality information when being synchronized with the participant terminal; and an experience suit provided as a type of suit wearable on the participant and transmitting a vibration stimulus to the participant′s body when the augmented reality information is outputted through the image output device. Accordingly, ordinary persons including children can experience an earthquake in various facilities without limitations on place and can conduct an evacuation drill under a virtually created earthquake situation.
abstract_ko: 체험자 주변의 영상정보와 위치정보를 기반으로 체험자가 체류 중인 시설을 판단하고, 체험자 주변의 영상정보와 위치정보와 체험자가 체류 중인 시설에 대한 시설정보를 반영한 가상의 정보를 이용하여 지진 대피훈련을 수행하는 지진 대피훈련 시스템 및 이를 이용한 방법이 개시된다. 본 증강현실 기반의 지진 대피훈련 시스템은 체험자가 체류 중인 시설에 대한 영상정보와 실시간 위치정보가 포함된 체험자 정보가 획득되도록 하는 체험자 단말; 상기 획득된 체험자 정보에 포함된 실시간 위치정보를 기반으로 상기 체험자가 체류 중인 시설을 인지하면, 상기 체험자가 체류 중인 시설에 대한 시설정보가 외부로부터 수신되도록 하거나 또는 기저장된 데이터베이스로부터 로딩되어 획득되도록 하며, 상기 시설정보가 획득된 시설에 가상의 지진이 발생된 것으로 연출된 영상이 포함된 증강현실 정보가 생성되도록 하는 지진 대피훈련 서버; 상기 체험자 단말과 동기화되면, 상기 증강현실 정보가 출력되도록 하는 영상출력장치; 및 체험자가 착용 가능한 슈트 타입으로 마련되어, 상기 영상출력장치를 통해 상기 증강현실 정보가 출력되면, 상기 체험자의 신체에 진동 자극이 전달되도록 하는 체험 슈트;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 장소에 제한 없이 다양한 시설에서, 어린이들을 포함한 일반인들을 대상으로 지진 상황을 체험할 수 있으며, 가상의 지진 상황을 연출하여 대피훈련을 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire simulation apparatus and method thereof
title_ko: 화재 시뮬레이션 장치 및 그 동작방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fire simulation apparatus comprising: a modeling unit for visualizing components and firefighting equipment on a building plan according to an actual building structure information and visualizing and modeling a fire detector at an arbitrary position on the building plan according to an input command; and a simulation unit for predicting a progress of the fire and an escape route of evacuees on the building plan when the fire simulation is executed at an arbitrary position on the building plan.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 실제 건물의 구조 정보에 따라 건물 평면도 상에 구성품 및 소방설비를 시각화하고, 입력된 명령에 따른 상기 건물 평면도 상에 임의의 위치에 화재감지기를 시각화하여 모델링하는 모델링부 및 상기 건물 평면도 상의 임의의 지점에서 화재발생 시뮬레이션 실행 시, 상기 건물 평면도 상에 화재 진행 상태 및 피난자들의 대피 경로를 예측하는 시뮬레이션부를 포함하는 화재 시뮬레이션 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Education Apparatus and Method for reporting when Emergency Occurs
title_ko: 응급상황 발생 시에 신고를 위한 교육장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an education apparatus and method for reporting occurrence of emergency, wherein the education apparatus for reporting occurrence of emergency comprises: a display unit displaying an execution screen of an application for training an emergency reporting method; a control unit which displays a main screen including a report button, a disaster situation button, and another menu button on the display unit according to an application execution signal, displays a reporting screen including a keypad when a selection signal for the report button is received on the main screen, and displays a telephone connection screen to a place corresponding to a specific telephone number when the input of a specific telephone number is completed depending on a pointer for guiding the input of the specific telephone number to the keypad; and a memory storing the application, and can be applied to other embodiments.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 응급상황 발생 시에 신고를 위한 교육장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 응급 상황에 대한 신고 방법을 교육하기 위한 어플리케이션의 실행 화면을 표시하는 표시부, 어플리케이션 실행 신호에 따라 신고 버튼, 재난상황 버튼 및 타 메뉴 버튼을 포함하는 메인 화면을 표시부에 표시하고, 메인 화면에서 신고 버튼에 대한 선택신호가 수신되면, 키패드를 포함하는 신고 화면을 표시하고, 키패드에 특정 전화번호의 입력을 유도하는 포인터에 따라 특정 전화번호의 입력이 완료되면 특정 전화번호에 대응하는 장소로의 전화연결 화면을 표시하는 제어부 및 어플리케이션을 저장하는 메모리를 포함할 수 있고, 다른 실시 예로도 적용이 가능하다.
assignees: NEW STAR EDUCATION CO LTD;LEE KYUNG SUK;HUR WAN GYU

title_en: A kind of Novel firefighting Signal sluice valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Novel firefighting Signal sluice valve, including valve body, flashboard, flashboard nut, valve rod, valve deck, gland, handwheel, recoil simulator, valve deck is arranged above valve body, and gland is provided with above valve deck；Flashboard is placed in valve body, and is connected by flashboard nut with valve rod bottom, both form screw thread rotation pair；The other end of valve rod passes through valve deck, and valve stem top is provided with handwheel；Valve deck top is equipped with ring-shaped step, one copper sheathing of ring-shaped step liner, the built-in split annulus of copper sheathing, the middle part annular engagement of split annulus and valve rod.The beneficial effects of the utility model are：Step is equipped with the top of valve deck, step is lined with copper sheathing, can reduce the frictional force that split annulus rotates, and then can reduce the moment of torsion of valve rod rotation, reduction handwheel, the generation of valve rod deformation, improves the reliability of product, extends the service life of product.Gland lower part equally sets a copper sheathing, on the one hand improves the leakproofness of product, another aspect is also for reduction valve rod driving torque.

title_en: Fire disaster escaping experiences room
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to training device, concretely it is fire disaster escaping experience room, including the main house body surrounded by least four side plates and bottom plate, top plate, geosyncline is provided with bottom plate, partition plate is provided with foregoing geosyncline, gap is left between aforementioned separator plate and top plate, warning light is provided with aforementioned gap.Monitoring camera is provided with foregoing corridor, flame lamp and fog machine are additionally provided with foregoing corridor, smog alarm machine is set on the side wall in foregoing corridor；The side in foregoing corridor is provided with green indicating lamp, and the termination in any one foregoing corridor is provided with fire-fighting emergent cabinet.The Fire Training equipment special compared to fire fighter, the fire disaster escaping experience room of the utility model is simple in structure, convenient and practical, is easily received by ordinary populace, can preferably adapt to the fire-fighting disposal ability of general masses, be easy to promote in ordinary people.

title_en: Simulation wire pole rocks fracture presentation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a demonstration device for simulating shaking and breaking of a telegraph pole, which mainly comprises a base, a movable assembly, a telegraph pole assembly, a power assembly and a transmission assembly, wherein the movable assembly is arranged on the base, the telegraph pole assembly is arranged at the upper end of the movable assembly, the transmission assembly is connected with the movable assembly, and the power assembly is arranged below the transmission assembly and drives the transmission assembly to move. The invention reproduces the shaking fracture damage scene of the telegraph pole living facilities, belongs to scientific popularization exhibit equipment, and enriches the content variety of the scientific popularization exhibit; the audience can intuitively feel that the earthquake brings huge damage, and the learning interest of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction is improved.

title_en: New energy power generation station management platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy power generation station management platform, which comprises a host storage layer for providing calculation, storage and disaster recovery resources; and a network communication layer for completing the operation data access of the on-site new energy power plant station and supporting the data transmission and exchange in a wireless and wired mode; and a support software layer for scheduling and expanding the calculation and storage resources of the host storage layer through virtualization software; and, according to different data characteristics, respectively adopting traditional relational database and various NoSQL databases to implement data resource layer for permanent storage and use of various service theme data; the application system layer transmits the new energy electric field data to managers in real time, provides on-line control and station management, and utilizes the data of the data resource layer to carry out fault pre-judgment and diagnosis through data pattern recognition and model training algorithm; and building a user interaction layer of the user interaction channel aiming at different application scenes.

title_en: A kind of disaster monitoring method for early warning based on mountain torrents dynamical evolution simulation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster monitoring method for early warning based on mountain torrents dynamical evolution simulation model, including：According to the natural feature of zoning and consider the position of built hydraulic structure or road, consider the influence of landform, landforms and water conservancy projects factor, make zoning discretization with unstructured grids, non-structural Delaunay triangular mesh subdivision is carried out to survey region, realize the fine grid blocks subdivision of specific region, then water, momentum and concentration balance by the period are established to each unit with finite volume method, ensure its conservativeness, with the calculating of Riemann's approximate solution across the water of unit, the normal direction numerical flux of momentum, ensure computational accuracy.The present invention is innovatively realized to be supported by the mountain flood monitoring and warning of core, risk analysis and risk decision of mountain torrents dynamical evolution simulation model, solves the great difficult problem in the domestic mountain flood prevention fields such as mountain torrents dynamic flooding inundation simulation, evolution emulation, prediction and warning and real-time command scheduling under the severe wild environment in mountain torrents area.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional single chamber fire disaster simulation and the integrated experiment porch of measurement
abstract_en: The present invention, which discloses a kind of multi-functional single chamber fire disaster simulation and the integrated experiment porch of measurement, the experiment porch, to be included：Fire combustion chamber and measurement monitoring room；The fire combustion chamber is separated with the measurement monitoring room by fire separation glass；Burning things which may cause a fire disaster is set to trigger system, water fire-extinguishing system, smoke evacuation and flue gas purification system and sensor assembly in the fire combustion chamber；Controller, data handling system, display device are set in the measurement monitoring room.The present invention sets smoke evacuation and flue gas purification system and water fire-extinguishing system in fire combustion chamber, controller, data handling system, display device are set in measurement monitoring room, above-water method can be carried out at the same time and smoke evacuation purifies, each Parameters variation in monitoring fire disaster simulation scene in real time, realizes the real simulation scene of a fire.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLES ARMED POLICE FORCE ACAD

title_en: A kind of anti-disaster method of coal-bed flooding based on seawater corrosion
abstract_en: The anti-disaster method of a kind of coal-bed flooding based on seawater corrosion disclosed by the invention, including first treat mash gas extraction coal seam drill through radius be 110mm extraction borehole, extraction borehole center cut is into " jujube nucleon bodies ", venthole and water injection hole are being drilled through respectively apart from extraction borehole hole wall top 80mm and lower part 80mm, venthole and water injection hole terminal are connected with extraction borehole " jujube nucleon bodies ", gas pumping pipe is sent to inside extraction borehole, sealed using conventional method for sealing, injection seawater in " jujube nucleon bodies ", when gage pressure declines suddenly, stop water injecting pump, complete seawater injection process.Due to containing mineral matter in the crack in coal seam, seawater has corrosivity, seawater is reacted with coal seam internal mineral matter component, increase the crevice space in coal seam, increase the permeability of gas and seawater, promote coal bed gas extraction, coal-bed gas disaster can be reduced, meanwhile moisture increase in coal seam, dust disaster and coal and gas prominent disaster can be reduced.

title_en: LED Display Fund-raising and alert and Warning System

abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive debris flow disaster reduction method based on a dynamic process and energy spectrum analysis. abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of three-dimensional simulation systems of typhoon disaster monitoring and evaluation, and including supporting layer, data Layer, middle layer, application layer and client layer, supporting layer is used to provide corresponding technical platform；Data Layer is used to acquire typhoon thematic data, geo-spatial data, hazard-affected volume data and disaster prediction scheme data, and form spatial data system；Middle layer is used to handle, and provide basic framework for the application layer spatial data system using Skyline three-dimensional geographic information platforms；Application layer is used for the basic framework that is provided in the middle layer, to treated result the carries out three-dimension GIS displaying of spatial data system, the displaying of meteorological data three-dimensional live, Typhoon Monitoring early warning, typhoon disaster assessment, assessment result visual presentation and faces calamity prediction scheme and issues.The present invention can to save and the commander department at different levels that takes precautions against natural calamities provide accurate real-time information for supporting some decision, to take precautions against natural calamities, the disaster relief commander scientific basis is provided.

title_en: A kind of filling medium true triaxial seepage failure laboratory and test method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to Geotechnical Engineering fields, disclose a kind of filling medium true triaxial seepage failure laboratory and test method, including filling medium, stress loading device, sealing device and tank.The present invention is using stress loading device to the pressure of filling medium, its stress in underground watery fault crushed zone and folder mud fracture belt can effectively be simulated, and pass through sealing device and the water body that flow out from filling medium of tank control storage, so that guarantee test is smoothed out.Filling medium infiltration under the conditions of simulated ground stress, grasp its Percolation Law under the conditions of the rich water of underground, the seepage failure type gushing water cause calamity mechanism under the pregnant calamity pattern of mud of dashing forward is studied for people to be of great significance, appearance of the invention can effectively solve the problem that gushing water mud disaster of dashing forward causes calamity mechanism study problem present in.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to the meteorological disaster technical fields of electric system, it discloses a kind of power grid icing and waves Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium, to mitigate the disaster of waving that grid power transmission circuit is subjected to, improve grid power transmission circuit reply icing and wave the ability of disaster and safely and steadily run level；The present invention initializes the parameter value of limited Boltzmann machine algorithm according to training sample data collection, then repetition learning and undated parameter value, until limited Boltzmann machine algorithm meets the convergence of training sample data collection, and pass through the precision of prediction E for verifying the limited Boltzmann machine algorithm of sample data set verification avg If precision of prediction E avg It is not presetting within precision, is then continuing undated parameter, until meeting precision of prediction；It further establishes the power grid icing based on back-propagation algorithm and waves prediction model, the parameter for finally waving prediction model to power grid icing according to back-propagation algorithm is adjusted, and is obtained icing and waved prediction model.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric shaft partition board fire resistance detection platforms, cube vertical shaft including closing, in terms of vertical shaft front, vertical shaft is provided with a horizontal baffle and vertical shaft is divided into two regions up and down, and horizontal baffle lower zone is divided into two regions in left and right by a vertical clapboard；Vertical clapboard both sides are vertically arranged with a connection silo bottom to the cable testing bridge at top respectively, and forceful electric power cable and weak-current cable are respectively arranged in two cable testing bridges；Temperature sensor and gas detecting system are respectively arranged in three regions separated in vertical shaft by two partition boards；Vertical shaft is internally provided with burning things which may cause a fire disaster system.A kind of the advantages of electric shaft partition board fire resistance detection platform provided by the invention, is：The comprehensive consideration thermal insulation of partition board, integrality, stability, easy to use, partition board is conveniently replaceable with vertical shaft and associated component, and can simulate true scene on fire also can provide fire scenario under a certain specified conditions as needed, have good promotion prospect.

title_en: Integrated control system for urgent response against disaster situations including chemical hazard, and disaster response method using thereof
title_ko: 유해 화학물질을 포함하는 재난상황의 긴급대처를 위한 통합관제 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재난대응 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated control system to urgently respond to a disaster situation including a chemical hazardous substance and a disaster response method using the same. According to the present invention, in a disaster situation, such as a chemical substance leakage accident occurring in a factory and an institution, such as a research center, and the like, where a chemical hazardous substance is handled, the integrated control system to urgently respond to a disaster situation, including a chemical hazardous substance, safely evacuates persons from a disaster area, prevents secondary diffusion of a leaked chemical substance through fast situation propagation and initial response, and supports fast dispatch of a special chemical substance disaster response team based on machine-to-machine (M2M) and Internet of things (IoT). Moreover, through information exchange with related organization, such as a city, a fire station, a chemical rescue team, a resident company, a joint control center, a public health center, a medical institution, a police station, an environmental protection agency, a fire head office (integrated 911 monitoring room), and the like, requiring cooperation in disaster management, a disaster response scenario is able to be improved in an enhanced way. According to the present invention, the integrated control system comprises an initial response control unit, an integrated control unit, and each user terminal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유해 화학물질을 포함하는 재난상황의 긴급대처를 위한 통합관제 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재난대응 방법에 관한 것으로, 유해 화학물질을 다루는 공장, 연구소 등 기관에서 발생하는 화학물질 유출 사고 등의 재난상황에서, 사물통신(M2M, Machine to Machine) 및 사물인터넷(IoT, Internet of Things) 기반의 신속한 상황전파 및 초동대응을 통해 재난지역 내 인명을 안전하게 대피시키고, 유출된 화학물질의 2차 확산을 방지하며 화학물질재난 전문수습반의 빠른 출동을 동시 지원하도록 구성된다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 시, 소방서, 화학구조대, 입주기업, 합동방제센터, 보건소, 소재 의료기관, 경찰서, 환경청, 소방본부, 119종합상황실 등 재난대응에 협조가 필요한 유관기관과의 정보교류를 통해 재난대응 시나리오를 더 향상된 방향으로 개선해나갈 수 있다.

title_en: Experimental apparatus for wall roughness generation in mock-up tunnel
title_ko: 모형 터널내 벽면조도 생성 실험장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an experimental apparatus for generating wall roughness in a mock-up tunnel. More particularly, the present invention includes: a roughness reproducing plate having a plate shape and provided at one end surface thereof with a wall roughness equivalent configuration for simulating wall roughness in an actual tunnel; a roughness reproducing plate holder for pressing and fixing both surfaces at an opposite end portions of the roughness reproducing plate; a holder rotation shaft bar having a circular rod shape, having a length longer than lengths of both sides of the roughness reproducing plate holder, and fixed to an opposite side of the roughness reproducing plate holder while being parallel with the roughness reproducing plate; an upper fixing frame having a table shape which has four supporting legs without a top plate and a connection part for connecting the supporting legs, in which two rotation shaft supporting plates having rotation shaft holes are disposed between the supporting legs so as to face each other; a lower fixing frame having a plate shape and disposed under the upper fixing frame, in which the supporting legs are fixed to the lower fixing frame; and a tunnel mock-up bottom fixing support allowing a wall in a mock-up tunnel to be directed upward, and fixed to an upper surface of the lower fixing frame. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a tunnel ventilation/disaster prevention experiment with a mock-up including a wall roughness effect is performed by forming the wall roughness, which is quantitatively simulated by using a simple mechanism, in the mock-up tunnel.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모형 터널내 벽면조도 생성 실험장치에 대한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 본 발명은 판형이며 실제터널내 벽면 조도를 모사한 벽면조도등가형상이 일측 끝단면에 형성된 조도재현판; 상기 조도재현판의 타측 끝부분 양면을 압착하여 고정하는 조도재현판홀더; 원형봉형상이며 상기  조도재현판홀더 의 양측길이보다 더 길고, 상기  조도재현판홀더 의 타측에, 상기 조도재현판과 나란하게 고정되는 홀더회전축막대; 네 개의 지지다리를 상기 지지다리 사이를 연결하는 연결부를 갖고 상판이 없는 테이블 형상이며, 회전축구멍이 형성된 두 개의 회전축지지판이 서로 마주보도록 상기 지지다리 사이에 배치되는 상부고정프레임; 판형이며 상기 상부고정프레임 하부에 배치되되 상기 지지다리가 고정되는 하부고정프레임; 및 상기 모형터널내 벽면이 위를 향하도록 거치되고 상기 하부고정프레임의 상면에 고정되는  터널모형하부고정지지대 를 포함하며, 상기 조도재현판과 상기 홀더회전축막대는 상기 조도재현판홀더에 고정되고, 상기 홀더회전축막대의 길이방향 양측 끝부분은 상기 회전축구멍에 삽입되어 상기 회전축지지판에 걸침되고, 상기 모형터널이 상기 터널모형하부고정지지대에 거치되어 상기 하부고정프레임의 상면에 고정되되 상기 상부고정프레임의 상기 지지다리가 형성하는 공간내부에 배치되어 상기 조도재현판의 상기 벽면조도등가형상이 형성된 일측 끝단면이 상기 모형터널내 벽면에 인접하고 상기 홀더회전축막대의 중십축의 연직 하방에 상기 모형터널의 중심축이 위치하며 상기 홀더회전축막대가 회전함에 따라서 상기 조도재현판이 회전할 때 상기 벽면조도등가형상과 상기 모형터널내 벽면의 이격거리가 동일하도록 배치되어, 상기 모형터널내 벽면에 벽면조도를 생성하기 위한 도포재를 도포하고, 상기 홀더회전축막대를 회전하여 상기 벽면조도등가형상이 상기 모형터널내 벽면에 벽면조도가 생성되도록 하는 벽면 모형터널내 벽면조도 생성 실험장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for virtual reality training simulation
title_ko: 가상현실 훈련 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual reality training simulation apparatus and a method thereof and, more specifically, to a virtual reality training simulation apparatus and a method thereof, which arrange nodes based on design drawing of a sunken ship and calculate escape time from a current node of a simulated refugee to an escape point node to be applied to a simulation apparatus, thereby being able to perform a simulated training similar to an actual situation through a virtual reality. To this end, the present invention provides the virtual reality training simulation apparatus, which comprises: an instructor unit setting information on the sunken ship, information on an external environment of the sunken ship and a disaster scenario; a ship refuge module unit arranging a space within the sunken space with nodes according to the information on the sunken ship and the disaster scenario, and setting attributes of the simulated refugee to generate data on movement of the simulated refugee in the sunken ship and to calculate a movement speed of the simulated refugee; and a training module unit implementing the simulated training based on the information of the instructor unit and the movement data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실 훈련 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 사고선박의 설계도를 바탕으로 노드를 배치하고, 모의 피난자의 현재 노드에서 탈출구 노드까지의 탈출시간을 산출하여 시뮬레이션 장치에 적용함으로써 실제와 같은 모의 훈련을 가상현실을 통하여 실시할 수 있는 가상현실 훈련 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해 사고선박에 관한 정보, 사고선박의 외부환경에 관한 정보, 및 재난 시나리오를 설정하는 인스트럭터부, 사고선박에 관한 정보와 재난 시나리오에 따라 사고선박 내의 공간을 생성된 노드로 배치하고, 모의 피난자의 속성을 설정함으로써 사고선박 의 모의 피난자의 움직임 데이터를 생성하고, 모의 피난자의 이동속도를 산출하는 선박 피난 모듈부, 및 인스트럭터부의 정보 및 움직임 데이터를 바탕으로 모의훈련을 구현하는 훈련 모듈부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 가상현실 훈련 시뮬레이션 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: After action review apparatus for rescue simulation and control method thereof
title_ko: 구조훈련강평장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an after action review apparatus for rescue simulation which is formed to enable users to have after action review on rescue training based on a virtual training environment that reproduces accident scenes, thereby improving the ability to cope with disaster situations through the close analysis on the rescue training using the after action review. The present invention also relates to an operation method of the after action review apparatus for rescue simulation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사고현장을 재현한 가상의 훈련환경을 기반으로 진행된 구조훈련에 대해서 사후 강평이 가능하도록 구현함으로써, 사후 강평을 통해 구조훈련에 대한 면밀 분석이 가능해지므로 재난 상황 대처 능력을 제고시킬 수 있다. 구조훈련강평장치 및 그 동작 방법을 제안한다.

title_en: Tsunami experience kit
abstract_en: To solve the problems that a conventional tsunami experience device does not allow an individual to experience the force of tsunami because there is only a small number of research facilities domestically due to being a large scale and the necessity for high cost for installation, and that an individual cannot easily experience the force of tsunami through disaster prevention training or the like because the conventional tsunami experience device cannot be carried.SOLUTION: A tsunami experience kit is a kit 1 to be attached to a human body to experience force by which tsunami sweeps the human body, and includes: attachment means 3 for attaching the kit to a leg, weight means 2 connected to the attachment means; elastic bodies 4-1, 4-2, one ends of which are connected to the attachment means or the weight means; and a pulling holding tool 5 for pulling the other ends of the elastic bodies.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of quarrying apparatus and method of continuous exploiting ocean gas hydrate
abstract_en: A kind of quarrying apparatus and method of continuous exploiting ocean gas hydrate, belong to exploitation of gas hydrates field, including marine auxiliary device, the continuous pipe drilling apparatus of binary channels, decomposition and separation device and waste material backfilling apparatus, the present invention is using the continuous pipe of binary channels as drilling rod, it is crushed using the method for directional drilling and high-pressure jet along gas hydrates layer, and slurry mixture is formed, wherein continuously pipe is respectively to return offer channel on high-pressure fluid conveying and slurry mixture to binary channels；Slurry mixture is delivered to decomposition and separation device by the pulp conveying channel inside the continuous pipe of binary channels, and slurry mixture is after decomposition and separation, and natural gas, which is collected, to be used, and liquid debris, solid waste are backfilled to mined out region by the continuous pipe of binary channels.This method has the advantages that drilling one, continuous exploitation, direction are controllable, while liquid debris, solid waste are backfilled in time, reduces the possibility of geological disaster generation.

title_en: Method for extracting gas by combining bidirectional three-dimensional staggered drilling with directional long drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for jointly extracting gas by using bidirectional three-dimensional staggered drilling and oriented long drilling, which comprises the steps of constructing long-distance oriented drilling along a stope face rail crossheading trend in the tunneling process of a stope face roadway under a coal mine, and pre-extracting coal bodies of a stope face transportation crossheading and a backup stope face rail crossheading. Along with the tunneling of the stope face track crossheading, the coal seam gas extraction drill hole is constructed along the trend of the stope face. And during the excavation of the stope face transportation crossheading, plugging the exposed long-distance directional drill hole by using hole sealing materials, and constructing the coal seam gas extraction drill hole along the inclined direction in the stope face transportation crossheading so as to form plane or vertical intersection with the coal seam gas extraction drill hole constructed in the working face track crossheading. The method improves the efficiency of coal mine gas disaster treatment, reduces the construction amount of coal mine underground gas treatment engineering, and has extremely high technology and economy.

title_en: A kind of power emergency based on scene structure drills deduction system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of power emergencies based on scene structure to drill deduction system, should be included based on the power emergency rehearsal deduction system that scene is built：Scene library model construction module, for building scene library model according to natural calamity information, power grid accident information and emergency preplan；Data processing module is drilled, for according to scene library model, generation rehearsal script and the corresponding standard rehearsal result of rehearsal script；Interactive module is sent to user, and obtain counter-measure input by user for that will drill script；Scheduling of resource module, for according to counter-measure, generating emergency resources setting information；Scene drills module, for according to counter-measure and emergency resources setting information, daily record and rehearsal result to be drilled in generation；Evaluation module is drilled, is compared for result will to be drilled with standard rehearsal result, generation rehearsal assessment result.By applying the present invention, the operating of emergency mechanism can be examined, rehearsal expense is reduced, is realized and is repeated to drill and drill assessment, and realize the simulated maneuver of various disaster scenes.
assignees: GLOBAL ENERGY INTERCONNECTION RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of wire examination method and system for simulating escape
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of wire examination method and system for simulating escape, wherein, a wearable device is provided, to be worn on the head of user；The escape place simulated to needs models, and it is stored in wearable device, to show the corresponding virtual scene in escape place in wearable device, and multiple test items are built in virtual scene, multiple test items carry out examination test with for user in virtual scene；Include the following steps：In the operation behavior of the position of each test item capture user in virtual scene；Operation behavior is judged, to judge whether current operation behavior is correct；If judging current operation behavior mistake, error logging preservation is formed；If judging, current operation behavior is correct, forms a correctly record preservation.The advantageous effect of its technical solution is, can targetedly correct the operation behavior of the escape of each user, and user is made more effectively to grasp escape technical ability, reduces the injury that disaster is brought.
assignees: FENG YU EDUCATION TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: The variable simulation experiment platform system of multilane highway tunnel lateral direction fire location

title_en: Polarization SAR image change detection method based on regional information and CNN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polarization SAR image change detection method based on regional information and CNN, which mainly solves the problems of high false alarm rate and inaccurate detection region of the existing change detection technology. The scheme is as follows: 1) performing super-pixel segmentation and combination on the two-time phase PolSAR image; 2) calculating a Wishart likelihood ratio difference graph combined with the spatial information; 3) pre-classifying by using a difference map through an FCM algorithm; 4) extracting training and to-be-classified data according to a pre-classification result; 5) constructing a change detection network CNN; 6) training the CNN by using the training data; 7) and inputting the data to be classified into the trained network to obtain a change detection result, and combining the result with the change class and the unchanged class in the pre-classification result to form a final change detection result. The method avoids errors caused by the inaccuracy of statistical modeling and super-pixel segmentation, and can be used for detecting the movement of the vehicle target and detecting the flood disaster.

The urban fire prevention and fighting method is based on building modeling and personnel moving positioning, combines with the new technologies of the industries such as urban planning, building design, Internet of things and the like, and optimizes the urban fire prevention and fighting process so as to achieve the effects of reducing the casualties of trapped personnel, improving the fire fighting efficiency, popularizing fire fighting knowledge, enhancing fire fighting consciousness and efficiently providing fire prevention education.

Moreover, after the vertical tunnel is formed in such way, a horizontal tunnel is constructed by advancing a horizontal drilling steel pipe in parallel to the ground when the horizontal drilling steep pipe is lowered through the vertical tunnel and is horizontally placed. Thus, an underground structure including the vertical and horizontal tunnels is able to be rapidly constructed without excessive disturbance and unnecessary excessive excavation with respect to the ground in a disastrous or emergency situation.

title_en: Multi-batch dispatching decision method for emergency evacuation vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-batch dispatching decision method for emergency evacuation vehicles, which is used for solving the problem of multi-batch vehicle dispatching under emergency conditions, particularly in the case of emergency vehicles in short supply, so that disaster victims can be evacuated to a designated place quickly and efficiently. The system comprises a data input module, a data calculation processing module and a scheme output module. The data input contains static data: evacuation sites and geographical positions of the parking lot, shortest paths from the parking lot to all the sites, input and storage of the total number and capacity of emergency vehicles and input of real-time data. The data calculation processing module realizes the generation of the vehicle dispatching scheme by constructing a vehicle dispatching mathematical model and utilizing a non-dominated sorting heredity-simulated annealing algorithm. And the scheme output module is used for reprocessing the numerical solution obtained by the system calculation, converting the codes into characters and outputting a corresponding path scheme. The invention is suitable for the field of road traffic emergency management, improves the emergency response speed, and simultaneously makes the emergency vehicle dispatching process more simple, convenient, rapid and effective.
