title_en: Disaster training system and method using virtual reality
title_ko: 가상현실을 이용한 재난훈련 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster training system using virtual reality, comprising: a motion sensing unit provided with sensors and sensing user′s body motion; a motion tracking unit tracking the motion sensed by the motion sensing unit; a control unit storing disaster training content and calculating coordinate values of the motion tracked by the motion tracking unit; a matching unit matching the motion, of which coordinate value is not calculated by the control unit, with simplified motion to be stored as motion data and converting the simplified motion tracked by the motion tracking unit into motion of which coordinate value is not calculated; and an image output unit outputting the disaster training content, the coordinate value calculated by the control unit and the motion data transmitted by the matching unit as an image object, thereby enabling a user to execute safety training against various situations in a limited space. In addition, the present invention has an economic effect of saving costs needed in constructing the same environment with real disaster and calamity situations, and costs of consumable materials used in training. Moreover, the present invention is able to reduce the time for preparing the safety training and time for performing arrangement after training. In addition, the present invention matches motion difficult to be recognized by a camera with specific simple motion to smoothly output an image object such that errors occurring during training can be minimized.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가상현실을 이용한 재난훈련 시스템에 관한 것으로, 센서를 구비하고, 사용자의 신체동작을 감지하는 동작감지부; 상기 동작감지부에서 감지된 동작을 추적하는 동작추적부; 재난훈련 컨텐츠를 저장하고, 상기 동작추적부에서 추적된 동작의 좌표 값을 산출하는 제어부; 상기 제어부에서 좌표 값이 산출되지 않는 동작을 간소화한 동작과 매칭시켜 동작 데이터로 저장하고, 상기 동작추적부에 의해 추적된 상기 간소화된 동작을 상기 좌표 값이 산출되지 않는 동작으로 변환하는 매칭부; 및 상기 재난훈련 컨텐츠와 상기 제어부에서 산출된 좌표 값과 상기 매칭부에서 전송된 동작 데이터를 영상 객체로 출력하는 영상출력부;를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 기술적 특징으로 하여, 제한된 공간에서 다양한 상황에 대한 안전훈련을 실행할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 본 발명은 실제 재난 및 재해 상황과 동일한 환경을 구축하는데 필요한 비용 및 훈련 시에 사용되는 소모성 재료의 비용 등이 절감되는 경제적 효과뿐만 아니라 안전훈련을 준비하기 위한 시간, 훈련 후 정리하는 시간 등이 단축되는 효과도 있다. 
또, 본 발명은 카메라가 인식하기 어려운 동작을 특정 간단한 동작과 매칭하여 영상 개체의 출력을 원활하게 하여 훈련 중에 발생하는 오류를 최소화할 수 있는 효과도 있다.

title_en: Game based disaster safety virtual trainig system using virtual reality
title_ko: 가상현실(vr)을 이용한 게임기반 재난안전 가상체험 훈련시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a game-based disaster safety virtual experience training system using virtual reality (VR), running a system; displaying a disaster type selecting screen in a disaster environment selecting unit, and selecting one among a plurality of disaster types; selecting a disaster situation to be trained in the disaster type selecting screen; selecting a stage of a corresponding disaster situation, and selecting a corresponding item; explaining a corresponding situation; performing game-based training in a selected training environment; and displaying a result and a score when training is completed, and selecting retraining or training completion by evaluating a skill level. The present invention can repeatedly train response methods of various disaster types.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시스템을 실행하면, 재난환경선택부에 재난유형선택화면이 디스플레이 되고 복수개의 재난 유형 중에서 하나를 선택하고, 상기 재난유형선택화면에서 훈련하고자 하는 재난상황을 선택하는 하면, 해당 재난상황의 스테이지를 선택하고 해당 아이템을 선정하면, 해당 상황에 대한 설명을 하고, 선택된 훈련환경 하에서 게임기반 훈련을 수행하여, 훈련을 완수하고 나면 결과 및 점수를 디스플레이하고 숙련도를 평가하여 재훈련 혹은 훈련종료를 할 수 있는 가상현실(VR)을 이용한 게임기반 재난안전 가상체험 훈련시스템이다.

title_en: Simulator with tsc and operating method thereof
title_ko: Tsc 적용 시뮬레이터 및 이의 운용 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a simulator applied in a technical support center (TSC) and an operating method thereof. The simulator operated in a nuclear power plant comprises: a control unit simulating an accident situation in the nuclear power plant by using at least one simulation model simulating operation of each system provided in the nuclear power plant, and generating at least one between test state information and test progress information based on manipulation information of an operator with respect to the accident situation; and a communication unit receiving the manipulation information from an operator device. The communication is able to provide at least one between the test state information and the test progress information to a disaster countermeasure device provided in the nuclear power plant. The present invention is able to enhance practicality of the test using the simulator and enlarge function conditions.
abstract_ko: TSC(Technical Support Center) 적용 시뮬레이터 및 이의 운용 방법을 제공한다.  원자력 발전소에서 운용되는 시뮬레이션 장치는 상기 원자력 발전소에서 구비된 각 계통의 동작을 모의하는 적어도 하나의 시뮬레이션 모델을 이용하여 상기 원자력 발전소에서의 사고 상황을 모의하고, 상기 사고 상황에 대한 운전원의 조작 정보를 기초로 시험 상태 정보 및 시험 진행 정보 중 적어도 하나를 생성하는 제어부 및 운전원 장치로부터 상기 조작 정보를 수신하는 통신부를 포함하되, 상기 통신부는 상기 원자력 발전소에 구비된 방재대응 장치로 상기 시험 상황 정보 및 상기 시험 진행 정보 중 적어도 하나를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for providing disaster training and response instruction based on digital signage and virtual/augmented reality technologies
title_ko: 디지털 사이니지와 가상/증강현실 기술 기반 재난 훈련지시 및 대응지시 제공 시스템과 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing disaster training and response instructions and a method thereof, capable of reducing training costs by overcoming shortcomings of existing disaster training technologies, improving a field sense, and helping disaster response when a disaster situation occurs. According to the system of the present invention, response instructions for response suitable for an actual disaster situation are generated, training instructions for training customized for a virtual disaster situation are generated, and the response and training instructions are provided through an external display means. The system of the present invention comprises: an IoT disaster data collector for collecting actual disaster situation information; a virtual disaster situation generator for generating virtual disaster situation information; and an instruction generator for receiving the actual disaster situation information collected through the IoT disaster data collector, analyzing an actual disaster situation, generating response instructions corresponding to the disaster situation to output the same to an external display means, receiving a virtual disaster situation generated in the virtual disaster situation generator, and generating training instructions corresponding to the virtual disaster situation to output the same to the external display means, wherein the external display means is a digital signage device or a virtual/augmented reality device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존의 재난 훈련 기술의 단점을 극복하여 훈련 비용을 절감하고 현장감을 향상시키며 재난상황 발생시 재난 대응에 도움을 줄 수 있는 재난 대응지시 및 훈련지시를 제공하는 시스템과 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시스템에 따르면, 실제 재난상황에 알맞은 대응을 위한 대응지시를 생성하고 가상 재난상황에 맞춘 훈련을 위한 훈련지시를 생성하여 이들 대응지시 및 훈련지시를 외부의 표시 수단을 통해 제공하는 시스템이 제공된다. 이 시스템은 실제 재난상황 정보를 수집하는 IoT 재난데이터 수집기, 가상의 재난상황 정보를 생성하는 가상 재난상황 생성기, 상기 IoT 재난데이터 수집기를 통해서 수집한 실제 재난상황 정보를 받아 실제 재난상황을 분석하여 재난상황에 상응하는 대응지시를 생성하여 외부의 표시 수단으로 출력하고 상기 가상 재난상황 생성기에서 생성된 가상 재난상황을 받아 이에 상응한 훈련지시를 생성하여 외부의 표시 수단으로 출력하는 지시생성기를 포함한다. 상기 외부의 표시 수단은 디지털 사이니지 기기 또는 가상/증강현실 기기이다.

title_en: System and method for training disaster response operating in internet of things environment
title_ko: 사물인터넷 환경에서 동작하는 재난 대응 훈련 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response training system and a disaster response training method operating in an internet-of-things (IoT) environment. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the disaster response training system comprises: a control command receiving unit to receive a command associated with performance of training from a manager of a control center; a communication unit to transmit and receive a message associated with the performance of the training from a device for training of a trainer positioned at a training site and a device for training of a trainee, and control an operation of a kit for training positioned at the training site in accordance with a performance process of the training; and a data collection unit to acquire sensor data from a plurality of IoT devices arranged at the training site. The disaster response training system controls the device for training of the trainer, the device for training of the trainee, and the kit for training in accordance with a command of the manager to provide the trainee with a simulated disaster situation and induce the trainee to act in accordance with a standard operating procedure (SOP) in response to the simulated disaster situation. Accordingly, a training process for a disaster response is combined with an IoT process to improve training efficiency. Active participation of a trainee is induced and a training manager can dynamically control the training process. A training environment connected to various IoT devices is provided to increase real situation similarity of training to secure utility of training results.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사물인터넷 환경에서 동작하는 재난 대응 훈련 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 재난 대응 훈련 시스템은 관제 센터의 관리자로부터 훈련의 진행에 관련된 명령을 수신하는 제어명령 수신부; 훈련 현장에 위치하는 훈련 담당자의 훈련용 디바이스 및 훈련 대상자의 훈련용 디바이스와 상기 훈련의 진행에 관련된 메시지를 주고 받고, 상기 훈련의 진행 과정에 따라 상기 훈련 현장에 위치하는 훈련용 키트의 동작을 제어하는 통신부; 및 상기 훈련 현장에 배치된 복수의 IoT 디바이스들로부터 센서 데이터를 획득하는 데이터 수집부를 포함하며, 상기 재난 대응 훈련 시스템은 상기 관리자의 명령에 따라 상기 훈련 담당자의 훈련용 디바이스, 상기 훈련 대상자의 훈련용 디바이스 및 상기 훈련용 키트를 제어함으로써, 상기 훈련 대상자에게 모의 재난 상황을 제공하고 상기 훈련 대상자로 하여금 상기 모의 재난 상황에 대응하는 표준작업절차(SOP, Standard Operating Procedure)에 따른 행동을 하도록 유도하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 의하여, 재난 대응에 대한 훈련 과정을 IoT 과정과 접목시킴으로써 훈련 효율을 개선할 수 있고, 훈련 대상자의 능동적인 참여를 유도하고 훈련 관리자가 동적으로 훈련 과정을 제어할 수 있으며, 다양한 IoT 디바이스와 연계된 훈련 환경을 제공함으로써 훈련의 실제 상황 유사도를 높여 훈련 결과의 효용성을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Model experiment device for simulating long-term ground settlement of dense building group area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground long-term settlement model experimental device for simulating a dense building group area affected by operation of a karst cave-underground river-tunnel group, and belongs to the technical field of urban underground engineering disaster prevention and reduction and ground settlement geological disasters. The model experimental device provided by the invention comprises a multi-model combined system, a karst stratum system, a tunnel system, a ground dense building group, an urban underground river water circulation system, a karst cave water circulation system, a data acquisition system, an excitation system and a control system. The influence of the vehicle vibration load on the long-term settlement of the ground when a highway tunnel group and a subway tunnel in a dense building group area are operated together is simulated, the influence of the vehicle vibration load operated by the tunnel group on the long-term settlement of the soil under the action of a city underground river is simulated, and the influence of the vehicle vibration load operated by the tunnel group on the long-term settlement of the soil under the action of a karst cave is simulated; the method has the characteristics of high environment simulation fidelity, accurate experimental data and low experimental cost, and can observe the slow deformation process of the ground long-term settlement in all weather.

title_en: Model experiment device for causing ground long-term settlement in high-concentration area overlapping tunnel operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a model experiment device for simulating long-term ground settlement caused by operation of overlapping tunnels in a high-concentration area under the action of earthquake-rainfall, and belongs to the technical field of urban underground engineering disaster prevention and reduction and ground settlement geological disasters. The model experimental device comprises a rainfall simulation system, an earthquake simulation system, a combined model system, a surface dense building system, soft soil, a boulder group, a sensing system, a tunnel system, a conduction system, a vehicle vibration system and a central control system. The method can simulate the influence of long-term ground settlement caused by the combined environment of rainfall environment, earthquake environment and rainfall and earthquake under the extreme rainfall environment and earthquake disaster environment; the influence of the vibration coupling effect of the vehicle load at any position on the long-term settlement of the soil body in the subway operation of the urban high-concentration area can be simulated, and the method has the characteristics of high environment simulation fidelity, experiment repeatability, unlimited extreme environment limitation in experiments, reliable data, strong operability and the like.

title_en: Method and system for selecting electrified hot air deicing path of power transformation equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid deicing and disaster reduction, and discloses a method and a system for selecting a charged hot air deicing path of a power transformation device and a storage medium, so as to ensure the safety of deicing. The method comprises the following steps: determining at least two alternative deicing paths of the electrified hot air deicing power transformation equipment; constructing an electrified hot air deicing model in one-to-one correspondence to each deicing path, and respectively performing electric field simulation on each electrified hot air deicing model according to the actual icing parameters of the electrified hot air deicing transformer equipment; and comparing the distortion of all electric field simulation results with the electric field of the electrified hot air deicing power transformation equipment in the non-icing state, and selecting a deicing path corresponding to the electric field simulation result with the minimum distortion for deicing.

title_en: Test device and test method for simulating influence of blasting excavation on side slope
abstract_en: The application provides a test device and a test method for simulating the influence of blasting excavation on a side slope, wherein the test device comprises a simulated side slope model, the simulated side slope model is provided with a plurality of step sub-slopes in the height direction, a plurality of blast holes are distributed on the step surface of the step sub-slope at the bottom of the simulated side slope model, each blast hole is filled with explosive charges, and each explosive charge is connected with a detonation device through a digital electronic detonator; the device is characterized in that a prestress loading test device and a measuring device are also arranged for simulating the side slope model. According to the application, the evolution characteristics and rules of the rock slope space-time damage and displacement deformation can be effectively monitored, test data are provided for researching the rock slope space-time damage and displacement deformation evolution mechanism, the dynamic instability mechanism and the disaster early warning method thereof, and scientific basis is provided for safe and smooth implementation of the blasting excavation engineering of the specific rock high-steep slope.

title_en: Simulation method for oil containment boom to intercept offshore oil spill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for intercepting offshore oil spill by an oil containment boom, which comprises the following steps: s1: numerical simulation is carried out on the offshore tidal flow field by adopting a two-dimensional single-layer flow field mathematical model, the two-dimensional single-layer flow field mathematical model is solved, differential decomposition is carried out on the model by using an implicit direction alternation method, and thus the flow speed omega of all calculation grid points (i, j) of the offshore tidal flow field is obtained (i,j) (k) Information and flow direction theta (i,j) (k) Information; s2: establishing a near-shore oil spill motion trajectory prediction scheme based on oil spill expansion, drifting, evaporation and emulsification mathematical models so as to simulate sea surface oil spill trajectories; s3: and designing a collision detection scheme of the bounding box of the three-dimensional oil containment boom model to detect the collision process of the oil spill and the oil containment boom, and judging the influence degree of the oil containment boom on the oil spill diffusion in the scene. Therefore, the method can be applied to an oil spill emergency response system or a marine oil spill simulator, and is beneficial to enhancing the reality sense of oil spill emergency scene simulation of the system and reducing the virtual simulation training cost of oil spill emergency personnel.

title_en: There are overlying densification cap rock hydrate exploitation induced disaster experimental simulation research device and experimental method in a kind of seabed
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of seabeds overlying densification cap rock hydrate exploitation induced disaster experimental simulation research device and experimental method, including air deep water stratum natural environment visual simulation system, gas hydrates note adopt simulation system, temperature control system, control pressurer system, data collecting system and image acquisition system；Reasonable design of the present invention, perfect in shape and function and easy to operate, by experimental method provided by the invention, there can be overlying densification cap rock hydrate exploitation induced disaster to carry out effective simulated operation to seabed, the related data in simulation process is monitored in real time by relevant temperature, pressure and gas concentration sensor, whole Image Acquisition is carried out to simulation process using camera.Safely and efficiently being developed to sea bed gas hydrate has certain guiding value, is of great significance with research to the understanding of the trigger mechanism of the geological environmental disaster thereby resulted in, has extensive popularizing application prospect.

title_en: Deformation prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The present invention provides the Deformation Prediction method and system based on deep learning, are related to landslide monitoring early warning technology field, include being acquired to the monitoring data of landslide monitoring point and obtaining multiple features accordingly；The first input feature vector is determined by carrying out analysis to feature；Model training is carried out using the first input feature vector in each machine learning algorithm, and model verification is carried out using ten folding cross-validation methods, obtains multigroup simulation model；It is evaluated respectively by the prediction effect to simulation model, determines optimal algorithm and hyper parameter；The second input feature vector is adjusted, and is evaluated according to the prediction effect of the second input feature vector of optimal algorithm pair, determines optimal input feature vector；Model training, which is carried out, according to optimal algorithm and optimal input feature vector generates Models Sets；The prediction model under respective conditions is selected in Models Sets and inputs new data, exports predicted value.The present invention can improve accuracy, the reliability predicted landslide disaster, reduce workload, and expand the scope of application.

title_en: The imitative experimental appliance of analysis is deduced for disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of imitative experimental appliances that analysis is deduced for disaster, module is deduced including information collection and feedback module and disaster, the disaster deduces the water tank that module includes upper and lower arrangement and is connected to by gravity pipe, several disaster node simulators and header tank, the disaster node simulator includes node container arranged up and down, gravity sensor and adapter, the node container is connected to by mutation water pipe with the sieve being located on gravity sensor with adapter, several Intelligent ball valves are mounted on the gravity pipe and mutation water pipe, information collection and feedback module are used to obtain data and control the opening and closing of corresponding intrument by having obtained data.The present invention can be with the derivative network of mock disaster, while guaranteeing its stronger universality, to find common problem present in disaster derivation.

title_en: Experimental system and method for simulating high-ground-temperature large-ore-pressure coal rock mass damage spontaneous combustion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural ignition basic experiment tests and discloses an experiment system for simulating the spontaneous combustion of coal rock mass damage under high ground temperature and large mine pressure, which comprises a self-heating program temperature-rising tank; the self-heating program heating tank comprises a tank body, a program heating control device, high-temperature heating rods and an inner and outer heat preservation layer, wherein the top of the tank body is provided with a tank cover which is connected through a flange, 6 high-temperature heating rods are arranged in the tank body, an observation window made of quartz materials is arranged in the middle of the front part and the rear part of the tank body, the top and the bottom of the tank body are provided with air holes, the top is an air outlet, the bottom of the tank body is an air inlet, the middle of the tank body is provided with a first temperature probe and a second temperature probe, and the first probe and the second probe are arranged in. The coal spontaneous combustion disaster simulation device is simple in structural design and strong in operability, can effectively simulate the high ground temperature and the crushing process of the coal rock body under pressure, and provides scientific and reasonable theoretical reference for preventing the coal spontaneous combustion disaster.

title_en: The bath scaled model experimental device of the highly dense area ground long-term settlement in simcity
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of bath scaled model experimental device applied to the highly dense area ground long-term settlement in simcity under train vibration and construction loads coupling condition, belongs to city underground engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters and surface subsidence geological disaster technical field.Bath scaled model experimental device provided by the invention includes built-up pattern system, soil layer system, excitation system, sensor-based system, propulsion system, compression system, the intensive building system of earth's surface, piping lane system, tunnel system.The ground long-term settlement that the bath scaled model experimental device energy quantification accurately simulates highly dense groups of building area metro operation Traffic loading and constructing tunnel load coupling induces；The soil body long-term settlement that the operation of poling corridor induces under the highly dense groups of building area of energy accurate simulation；Have the characteristics that environmental simulation fidelity is high, can round-the-clock observation ground long-term settlement slow deformation process, can ground long-term settlement caused by train is of reciprocating vibration in accurate simulation tunnel, make that experimental data is accurate and reliable, experimental cost is low.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG SIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;SCHOOL OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF XINJIANG UNIV

title_en: Linear energy-gathering cutting device for pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a linear energy-gathering cutting device for a pipeline, and belongs to the field of pipeline explosion cutting; the method is mainly used for solving the technical problem that pipeline cracking cracks are generated when natural gas leakage is simulated in the full-size breaking behavior process of the high-pressure gas transmission pipeline of the natural gas medium. The invention mainly comprises a safety detonator, a booster tube, a clamping assembly, a linear energy-gathering cutter and an installation shell. The linear energy-collecting cutter comprises an energy-collecting cutter shell, a pressing block, a main charge and a linear liner. The invention can cut and form penetrating cracks with the width not less than 10mm, the length not more than 500mm and parallel to the axial direction of the steel pipe on the deep buried gas pipeline through the device. The popularization and application of the method are beneficial to independent development and completion of full-size fracture behavior research of high-pressure gas pipelines and disaster assessment caused by pipeline explosion on the environment in China, dynamic crack extension and crack arrest behavior research of high-steel-grade, high-pressure and large-caliber gas pipelines are realized, and the method has great significance on safety research of ultra-long-distance conveying of the gas pipelines.

title_en: Smoke generation control system for fire training using incomplete combustion

abstract_en: Provided is a smoke generation control system for a fire drill using incomplete combustion. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the smoke generation control system comprises: a combustion unit generating a flame; a smoke delivery unit extending upward from the combustion unit; a lid unit which is spaced apart from an upper side of the smoke delivery unit to prevent external exposure of the flame; an internal temperature sensor unit for measuring a temperature inside the combustion unit; an external temperature sensor unit for measuring the temperature of the outside of the combustion unit; a blowing unit for supplying air into the combustion unit; and a control unit controlling the blowing unit to bring the inside of the combustion unit into an incomplete combustion state.

title_en: Method and system for making training program based on virtual reality

abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to manufacture a training program based on virtual reality which reproduces a real disaster situation. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for manufacturing a training program based on virtual reality comprises a real environment scan unit to scan a real environment and generate virtual reality data; a virtual environment construction unit to construct a three-dimensional virtual reality environment using the virtual reality data, provide a manufacturer with a tool capable of editing the virtual reality data via a user interface to allow the manufacturer to select at least one object for allowing an interaction between a prescribed object and a trainer input during virtual training, and present a disaster situation for the selected object or designate an action set or an animation effect for handling; and a scenario editing unit to generate a disaster handling scenario applying a handling process set in accordance with a disaster type to the three-dimensional virtual reality environment.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 가상현실기반 훈련 프로그램 제작 시스템은 실제 환경을 스캔하여 가상현실 데이터를 생성하는 실제 환경 스캔부와, 가상현실 데이터를 이용하여 3차원 가상현실환경을 구축하고, 사용자 인터페이스를 통해 제작자에게 가상현실 데이터를 편집할 수 있는 툴을 제공하여, 가상훈련 시 소정의 객체와 훈련자 입력 간의 상호 작용이 가능하도록 적어도 하나의 객체를 선정하게 하며, 선정된 객체에 대해 재난 상황을 연출하거나, 대처를 위한 액션집합이나 애니메이션 효과를 지정하게 하는 가상환경 구축부 및 재난유형에 따라 설정된 대처절차를 3차원 가상현실환경에 적용한 재난대처 시나리오를 생성하는 시나리오 편집부를 포함한다.

title_en: Disaster control communication system
title_ko: 재난발생 자동 검지 및 피난 관제 통신 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system. The automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system can detect disasters through double tracks between fire receivers and fire detectors, analyze the communication traffic in a disaster site, and guide a user through an evacuation route. According to the present invention, the automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system includes: multiple fire detectors which are installed in a building in a distributed manner to detect a fire on the site; multiple evacuation lamps being installed in the site to display the evacuation route; multiple CCTVs which are installed on the site to record the disaster situation and transmit the recording to a remote location; the fire receivers which can detect the location of the fire and report and initiate an alarm indicating the occurrence of a fire when the fire detectors sense the fire; on-site control terminals which operate the corresponding CCTVs to receive the on-site images and transmit the on-site images to the disaster control server in the remote location upon receiving the indication that a fire has occurred from the fire receivers as well as controlling the evacuation guide lamps in accordance with preset scenarios to guide the evacuation path; and the disaster control server which analyzes the traffic in the corresponding area to determine the validity of the disaster while storing the received disaster images to a database upon receiving the disaster information from the on-site control terminals as well as transmitting the disaster text to the mobile phones in the corresponding area. The automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system can sense the disaster precisely through the redundant tracks between the fire receivers and fire detectors as well as analyzing the communication traffic in the disaster site to prevent false alarms, thereby responding to disasters quickly.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재수신기와 화재감지기 사이의 이중화된 선로를 통해 재난을 감지하고 재난 현장의 통신 트래픽을 분석하여 신속하게 피난 경로를 안내할 수 있는 재난발생 자동검지 및 피난 관제 통신 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시스템은, 건물에 분산설치되어 현장의 화재를 감지하기 위한 복수의 화재 감지기; 현장에 설치되어 피난 경로를 표시하는 복수의 피난 유도등; 현장에 설치되어 재난상황을 촬영하여 원격지로 전송하기 위한 복수의 CCTV; 상기 화재 감지기로부터 화재가 감지되면, 화재 위치를 판별하여 화재발생을 보고하고 경보하는 화재 수신기; 상기 화재 수신기로부터 화재발생을 수신하면, 해당 CCTV를 작동시켜 현장 영상을 수신받아 원격지의 재난 관제 서버로 전송하고, 미리 설정된 시나리오에 따라 상기 피난 유도등을 제어하여 피난 경로를 안내하는 현장 관제 단말; 및 상기 현장 관제 단말로부터 재난정보가 수신되면, 해당 지역의 트래픽을 분석하여 재난 허위 여부를 판단함과 아울러 수신된 재난 영상을 데이터베이스에 저장하고, 해당 지역의 휴대폰으로 재난문자를 전송하는 재난 관제 서버로 구성된다. 본 발명에 따르면, 화재수신기와 화재 감지기 사이의 이중화된 선로를 통해 재난을 정확하게 감지하고, 재난 현장의 통신 트래픽을 분석하여 오 경보를 방지함으로써 재난에 신속하게 대응할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of quarrying apparatus of continuous exploiting ocean gas hydrate
abstract_en: A kind of quarrying apparatus of continuous exploiting ocean gas hydrate, belong to exploitation of gas hydrates field, including marine auxiliary device, the continuous pipe drilling apparatus of binary channels, decomposition and separation device and waste material backfilling apparatus, the utility model is using the continuous pipe of binary channels as drilling rod, it is crushed along gas hydrates layer using the method for directional drilling and high-pressure jet, and slurry mixture is formed, wherein continuously pipe is respectively to return to provide channel on high-pressure fluid conveying and slurry mixture to binary channels；Slurry mixture is delivered to decomposition and separation device by the pulp conveying channel inside the continuous pipe of binary channels, and slurry mixture is after decomposition and separation, and natural gas, which is collected, to be used, and liquid debris, solid waste are backfilled to mined out region by the continuous pipe of binary channels.The device has the advantages that drilling one, continuous exploitation, direction are controllable, while liquid debris, solid waste being backfilled in time, reduces the possibility of geological disaster generation.

title_en: Group simulation method suitable for emergency evacuation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a group simulation method, which comprises the steps of establishing an information exchange model among groups and marking information; calculating different path cost values by using the information marks and obtaining a minimum cost path; and establishing an individual behavior decision model according to the minimum cost path and selecting a path.

title_en: Typhoon disaster influence assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for evaluating typhoon disaster-causing influence. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining lattice point wind field parameters output by simulating a typhoon wind field by using a mesoscale numerical mode; for each lattice point meeting the preset requirement in the same horizontal plane: calculating destructive force parameters of the grid point, wherein the destructive force parameters comprise any one or more of wind speed space shear quantity, wind speed time shear quantity, wind direction angle space shear quantity and wind direction angle time shear quantity; and based on any one or more of the obtained wind speed space shear variable, wind speed time shear variable, wind direction angle space shear variable and wind direction angle time shear variable of each grid point, and combining the wind speed value, thereby evaluating the typhoon disaster-causing influence. The method can comprehensively and accurately reflect the parameter characteristic difference of the destructive force among all parts in the engineering influenced by the typhoon, and ensures the evaluation accuracy of the typhoon disaster-causing influence.

title_en: A kind of oil-gas pipeline impact disaster simulation experiment porch and application process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of oil-gas pipeline impact disaster simulation experiment porch and application processes.The oil-gas pipeline impacts disaster simulation experiment porch, including fixed system, shock loading system, camera system, data acquisition and analysis system.The fixed system is the arrying main body of the present invention, the shock loading system provides impact energy for the present invention, for the camera system for recording Impact Load in the process of oil-gas pipeline, the data collecting system is used to record the changing rule that simultaneously analyzing oil and gas pipeline is subjected to impact ess-strain after load.The present invention acts on the morphological change characteristics of lower oil-gas pipelines by observing different impact energys; analyze different size impact energy under the conditions of oil-gas pipeline stress, strain evolution features; damage and failure feature and evaluation condition of the oil-gas pipeline under external Impact Load are can get, to take rational oil-gas pipeline safeguard measure to provide theoretical foundation.

title_en: A booth system
title_ko: 소화기 실전연습 체험부스장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a booth apparatus to experience actual training of a fire extinguisher, which allows a user to actually experience usage of the fire extinguisher and photographs an action using the fire extinguisher to appraise a practice based on a firefighting time and a photographed image. According to the present invention, the booth apparatus to experience actual training of a fire extinguisher comprises a firefighting practice body unit including a ventilator installed in each partition on an upper part and a tempered glass sheet formed on an outer wall surface in order to be seen from the outside, wherein a gas firefighting booth and an oil firefighting booth are formed in each partition and a control unit is installed inside the firefighting practice body unit. The gas firefighting booth includes: a gas tank; a main cut-off valve to cut off gas of the gas tank; a gas booster; an auxiliary cut-off valve to cut off gas supplied to the gas booster through a gas supply pipe; a firefighter camera to photograph a state that a firefighter extinguishes fire by using the fire extinguisher; and a booster camera to photograph a fire extinguished state, such that the control unit converts a firefighting time and a use state of the fire extinguisher as a score to display the score on a display unit wherein the use state of the fire extinguisher includes a fire extinguisher injection time and an operation time after detecting fire, and post-treatment after extinguishing the fire, and the like.

title_en: Method for managing bad asset management knowledge based on natural language processing technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an asset management company bad asset management and management method based on natural language processing technology, which comprises two parts of data import in knowledge base construction and keyword extraction based on deep learning and PageRank. A specific word bank and an HMM are used for finding a new word model to perform word segmentation processing on the bad asset management knowledge, so that the accuracy of text word segmentation is improved, and a more complete text word bank is established; the word vectors are trained by a deep learning method, so that the phenomenon of dimension disaster represented by the word vectors can be avoided, the information of the context of words can be fully mined, and the relation between the words can be obtained; based on an improved PageRank algorithm, a topological matrix of word connection is obtained according to a word sequence relation in a specific contract, and cosine values among word vectors are used as connection weights of words, so that not only is the word vector information obtained by training a word bank fully utilized, but also the relative position relation of words in a text is mined, and a powerful theoretical basis is provided.

title_en: Subway tunnel fire experiment simulation device adopting non-straight axis jet fan for mechanical smoke exhaust
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway tunnel fire experiment simulation device adopting a non-straight axis jet fan to mechanically discharge smoke, which comprises an experiment simulation tunnel and a matched measurement and control system; the experimental device is a small-size experiment table which is specially used for carrying out comprehensive systematic study on smoke movement, fire suppression and the like when a subway tunnel adopting a non-straight axis jet fan for ventilation and smoke discharge is in a fire disaster. The method overcomes the defect that full-size experiments are high in cost and inaccurate in numerical simulation tools on the basis of the predecessor, ensures the repeatability of the experiments, and has great application value for developing laboratory scientific researches and actual subway tunnel smoke control, non-straight axis jet fan smoke discharging effect and fire source extinguishing system simulation tests. title_en: Rectangular drilling stress monitoring device and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a rectangular drilling stress monitoring device and a monitoring method. The rectangular drill comprises an outer frame, wherein a forward cutter, an oblique cutter and a central guide cutter are arranged in the outer frame. The rectangular drilling hole stress monitoring meter comprises an upper cover plate, a lower cover plate, a stress sensor and a digital display. The monitoring method comprises the steps of drilling a guide drill hole in advance, drilling a rectangular drill hole and installing a rectangular drill hole stress monitor for monitoring. The monitoring device can effectively overcome the defects of fuzzy test direction and inaccurate test value of the traditional borehole stressometer, can accurately measure the surrounding rock stress value at any angle including the vertical direction and the horizontal direction, and provides more reliable data for the prediction and forecast of the field mine pressure disaster. The device and the implementation method can provide more reliable guarantee for the stress monitoring of the coal mine surrounding rock in China.

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on significance and depth convolution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting SAR image change based on significance and depth convolution network, which mainly solves the problems of low detection precision and weak anti-interference capability in the prior art. The implementation scheme is as follows: after two SAR images in the same area at different moments are preprocessed, carrying out logarithmic ratio operation and normalization to obtain a normalized logarithmic ratio difference graph; extracting the significant features of the difference map to obtain a significant map; thresholding the saliency map, and performing point multiplication on the difference map and the thresholding result to obtain a saliency map; clustering the difference graph to obtain a pre-classification result; selecting training examples from the pre-classification results; constructing a deep convolutional network, and training the network by using a training sample; and (5) carrying out change detection on the SAR image by using the trained network. The method can effectively inhibit the interference of background regional information, improves the accuracy of change detection, and can be used for natural disaster assessment, environmental resource detection and urban modeling planning.

title_en: Method for evaluating resilience of power system under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating restoring force of an electric power system under disasters, which comprises the following steps: 1) determining the type and nature of the disaster; 2) obtaining the type and the related fault probability of the vulnerable component under the disaster; 3) acquiring the running state of the vulnerable equipment in the disaster environment by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation; 4) performing system minimum load shedding calculation based on the direct current optimal power flow; 5) and (5) index calculation and system resistance analysis are carried out. The method can be used for rapidly solving the expected operation state and the robustness of the power system under various natural disasters and artificial disasters, the type and the characteristics of the disasters are considered in the solving process, and the restoring force promotion limiting factors of the system under the disasters can be analyzed, so that the method can be used for providing reference suggestions for disaster prevention planning and construction of the power system.

title_en: workers healthcare system using biological signals based safety menagement woking clothes

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a worker healthcare system using safety management work clothes based on a biological signal. According to the present invention, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal comprises: safety management work clothes (100) based on a biological signal including a sensor for a biological signal and a module; a server (200) receiving and analyzing the biological signal of a user from the safety management work clothes (100) based on the biological signal, wherein the server (200) changes the biological signal to data capable of determining a user′s pattern; and an output device outputting the user′s health state on a screen to enable the user to monitor the health state using the data provided by the server (200). According to the present invention, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can prevent an accident in an industrial field by obtaining the health state based on the biological signal of the worker wearing the safety management work clothes measuring the biological signal. Also, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can prevent an accident by analyzing the state of the worker such as the level of stress, exercise strength, a motion, an action pattern and the like in the server based on big data by using the biological signal such as electrocardiogram, acceleration, and body temperature, which are sensed by the sensor for a biological signal of the safety management work clothes. The worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can provide a continuous personalized healthcare service to the worker. Therefore, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can remarkably increase productivity, promote health, and prevent a disaster.
