본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템은 생체신호용 센서 및 모듈이 내장된 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복(100)과; 상기 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복(100)으로부터 사용자의 생체신호를 전달받아 분석하여 사용자의 패턴을 판단할 수 있는 데이터로 변환하는 서버(200)와; 상기 서버(200)에서 제공받은 데이터를 통해 건강상태를 모니터링 할 수 있도록 화면에 출력하는 출력장치; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 
본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템은 생체신호를 측정하는 안전관리작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.
assignees: UNIV INJE IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: A kind of linear cumulative blasting device of pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of linear cumulative blasting device of pipeline, belongs to pipe explosion cutting field；Be mainly used for solve gas medium the full-scale fracture behaviour in high pressure gas pipeline road during simulate natural gas leakage when pipeline breaking crackle generate technical barrier.The utility model includes mainly safety detonator, detonating primer, clamp assembly, Blasting with Linear Cumulative Cutting Charge in Rock and installation shell.The Blasting with Linear Cumulative Cutting Charge in Rock includes jet cutter shell, briquetting, main charge and linear cavity liner.The utility model can on buried gas pipeline by the device cut formation width not less than 10mm, length no more than 500mm, be parallel to steel pipe it is axial run through type crackle.Its popularization and application are conducive to China and independently carry out and complete the full-scale fracture behaviour research in high pressure gas pipeline road and pipe explosion Disaster Assessment caused by environment, it realizes Hi-grade steel, high pressure, the Dynamic Crack Propagation of heavy caliber air transmission pipeline and crack arrest behavioral study, is of great importance to the safety research of the overlength distance conveying of gas pipeline.
assignees: XIAN WUHUA JUNENG BLASTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of appraisal procedure for predicting the following phase forest fire occurrence risk
abstract_en: A kind of appraisal procedure for predicting the following phase forest fire occurrence risk is related to fire occurrence risk appraisal procedure.The meteorological data of phase carries out model training where phase occurs for the vegetation data of phase front n-th phase, terrain data and forest fire when the present invention is by selecting forest fire to occur, the relationship between above-mentioned data and forest fire occurrence risk is obtained, and the weather forecast data of n-th phase after real-time vegetation data and terrain data and real-time phase are substituted into above-mentioned relation and are assessed.Appraisal procedure of the present invention considers a variety of factors for having inducing action to forest fire, eliminates and only considers that meteorological factor obtains the biased property of assessment result；And due to the innovation of data selection to realize the fire risk assessment of a wide range of, high spatial resolution, and assessment result has predictability, scientific basis can be provided to prevent forest fire, improving prevention system of disaster reduction construction, be conducive to the prevention for instructing forest fire and control work.

title_en: A kind of multiple dimensioned mud-rock flow phenomena simulation method based on object particle method
abstract_en: The multiple dimensioned mud-rock flow phenomena simulation method based on object particle method that the invention discloses a kind of, is related to computer physics field of animation technology, this approach includes the following steps：S1：The Analysis On Multi-scale Features of mud-rock flow liquid phase slurry are simulated based on adaptive substance point methods；S2：Analysis On Multi-scale Features based on adaptive substance point finite element method for simulating mud-rock flow solid phase object；S3：Multiple dimensioned fluid-solid coupling is simulated based on object particle method；S4：Multiple dimensioned Realistic Rendering is carried out to mud-rock flow animation.The present invention solves effective physical model that description mud-stone flow disaster scene a variety of scale features how are constructed during mud-rock flow animation simulation, and establishes the problem of consistency constraint is to realize multiple dimensioned numerical solution and render between different models.The present invention can the sense of reality simulate mudstone flow phenomenon Analysis On Multi-scale Features, generate the mud-rock flow animation with photo grade fidelity, applied for disaster prevention and control, digital entertainment, video display special efficacy etc. and the image data of mudstone flow phenomenon is provided.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Reinforced concrete structure seismic Damage automatic identification based on computer vision and intelligent locating method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of reinforced concrete structure seismic Damage automatic identification based on computer vision and intelligent locating methods, be in order to solve the disadvantage that existing reinforced concrete structure seismic Damage recognition methods needs to provide the camera inside and outside parameter of image taking or needs additional professional measuring apparatus and corresponding intelligent algorithm and propose, including：The image of input is carried out down-sampled, the damage field of the image after down-sampled is marked using rectangle frame according to preset type of impairment, obtains the data for indicating rectangle frame position and size, and label to damage field according to type of impairment；Training set is input in depth convolutional neural networks and is trained；The loss function used in training process is multi-goal optimizing function, and optimization algorithm is the stochastic gradient descent algorithm with momentum；It will be input to trained depth convolutional neural networks after images to be recognized resampling, obtains recognition result.The present invention is suitable for Health Monitoring for Civil Engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters.

title_en: The Simulations of Water Waves Due To Landslides height of adjustable-angle and the monitoring device and method of dynamic pressure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to geological disaster and water conservancy technical field of experiment equipment, more particularly to a kind of Simulations of Water Waves Due To Landslides height of adjustable-angle and the monitoring device and method of dynamic pressure, by using the main tablet of different length, hold the unrestrained tablet fixed point different from Experimental Water Tank be connected, not only make the gradient of main tablet adjustable, and the gradient flexible modulation for holding unrestrained tablet can also be enable, meet the needs of experimental provision changes different gradient, makes the result of experimental simulation closer to reality.Experimental Water Tank is made of transparent organic glass, and wave-height gauge is set in the middle part of water tank, wave height versus time curve of surging is obtained by wave-height gauge, the surge communication process in water tank and the unrestrained High variation surged can be clearly recorded using high-speed camera and wave-height gauge.The present apparatus arranges that pressure sensor is acquired for pressure data also on holding unrestrained tablet, can record experimentation and hold pressure change suffered by unrestrained tablet.Experimental provision equipment is succinct, easy to operate, easy to repair.

title_en: Disaster scenario electronic management system
title_ko: 재난 시나리오 전자관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a management system which creates a response scenario suitable for a disaster item, and an electronic management system for a disaster scenario which evaluates an evaluation standard capable of evaluating whether a scenario by a management system can be practically applied to a disaster item at a site in real time to apply the scenario. The electronic management system for a disaster scenario comprises: a login step (S10) of logging in to a management system; a creating step (S20) of jointly creating a scenario for each disaster type with a logged-in related organization for a disaster response; a checking step (S30) of creating check items for checking training items in accordance with created scenarios; a distribution step (S40) of distributing a smart web using a wireless communication network to an evaluator and a user performing training for the created scenarios and the check items; an information supplying step (S50) of using the distributed smart web to supply information in accordance with a given project to the smart web; a training step (S60) of training for a disaster item scenario and information provided by the smart web; an evaluation step (S80) of allowing the evaluator to check a training state by the smart web in real time to evaluate the training state; and a verifying step (S60) of gathering the evaluation step to input data in accordance with a scenario to verify the data.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난사항에 따른 적절한 대응 시나리오를 작성하는 관리시스템과, 관리시스템에 따른 시나리오가 현장에서 실시간으로 실질적으로 재난사항에서 적용 가능한지를 평가할 수 있는 평가기준을 현장에서 실시간으로 평가하여 이를 적용한 재난 시나리오 전자관리시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 관리시스템에 로그인하는 로그인 단계(S10)와; 로그인한 재난대응을 위한 유관기관과 재난유형별 시나리오를 공동으로 작성하는 작성단계(S20)와; 작성된 시나리오에 따른 훈련사항을 체크하는 체크사항을 작성하는 체크단계(S30)와; 작성된 시나리오 및 평가사항을 훈련을 실시하는 사용자와 평가자에 무선통신망을 이용한 스마트 웹을 배포하는 배포단계(S40)와; 배포된 스마트 웹을 활용하여 주여진 과제에 따른 정보를 스마트 웹으로 제공하는 정보제공단계(S50)와; 스마트 웹에 의해 제공된 재난사항 시나리오 및 정보에 의해 재난사항을 훈련하는 훈련단계(S60)와; 훈련상태를 실시간으로 스마트 웹으로 평가자가 체크하여 평가하는 평가단계(S80)와; 상기 평가단계가 실시간으로 취합되어 시나리오에 따른 자료가 입력되어 이를 확인하는 확인단계(S100);로 이루어짐을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of stratification evacuation emulation optimization method based on artificial fish-swarm algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of stratification evacuation emulation optimization method based on artificial fish-swarm algorithm, and this method includes：Obtain evacuation scene；Network is evacuated according to evacuation scenario building three-dimensional stratification；The space of evacuee can be accommodated by evacuating network acquisition according to three-dimensional stratification, be node by the spatial abstraction for accommodating evacuee, and the channel between each space for accommodating evacuee is abstracted as the side between connecting node；Logic, which is established, according to the syntople between the node and the side evacuates network topological diagram；According to the topological diagram obtain the node total number, the sum of effective edge, node enter number of edges mesh, node goes out number of edges mesh, node serial number, node capacity, node coordinate, node level, evacuating personnel is simulated using artificial fish-swarm algorithm, obtains optimal dispersal plan.

title_en: Method for preventing rock burst by coupling and pressure relief of blast hole and large-diameter drill hole
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing and controlling rock burst by coupling and pressure relief of a blast hole and a large-diameter drill hole, and belongs to the field of rock burst disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the following steps: detecting a stress concentration area; arranging blast holes and large-diameter drill holes in the stress concentration area; and detonating the blast hole. The invention improves the blasting pressure relief effect and obviously reduces stress concentration and impact danger by reasonably configuring the arrangement mode of the blast holes, and is particularly suitable for blasting pressure relief of the coal seam near the roadway.

title_en: The anti-ice cube pressurizing unit of oil drilling platform supporting stake
abstract_en: The invention belongs to petroleum drilling engineering fields, are a kind of anti-ice cube pressurizing units of oil drilling platform supporting stake for improving offshore drilling platform safety in utilization, reducing sea ice disaster degree specifically.It includes being oriented to column casing and self-relocation formula ice-melting structure；It is described be oriented to column casing both ends be located on sea level and sea level under；The self-relocation formula ice-melting structure includes floating block and thawing tank again；The floating block is annular in shape, and the inner wall of the floating block matches with the outer wall for being oriented to column casing, which, which is socketed in, is oriented on column casing, and under outer force effect, floating block can be moved up and down relative to column casing is oriented to；The thawing tank is annular in shape, and the inner wall of the thawing tank and the outer wall of floating block match, and the inner wall of the thawing tank is fixedly connected with the outer wall of floating block；Electric heater is provided on the thawing tank, the electric heater improves the temperature of thawing tank by heating, makes close to the ice melting of thawing tank.

title_en: A kind of petrochemical enterprise fire prevention and monitoring system
abstract_en: A kind of petrochemical enterprise fire prevention of the utility model offer and monitoring system,Sensor is monitored including wireless fire disaster,Audible-visual annunciator,Monitoring camera,Air speed measuring apparatus,Radio network controller and fire monitoring control centre,The input terminal of radio network controller monitors sensor with wireless fire disaster,Monitoring camera is connected with air speed measuring apparatus,The output end of radio network controller is connected with audible-visual annunciator and fire monitoring control centre,Wireless fire disaster monitors sensor distribution and is controllably mounted in inflammable and explosive region,For acquiring fire information and being sent to radio network controller,When fire information reaches the fire information data threshold in radio network controller,Fire monitoring control centre will be sent to and control audible-visual annunciator and send out alarm,Monitoring camera is used for observation site,When confirming generation fire,Air speed measuring apparatus measures wind speed when fire occurs and the fire information received is combined to carry out fire monitoring and simulation trial,Fire is instructed to handle.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP QINGDAO SAFETY ENG INST

title_en: A kind of multi-functional landslide impact strength test platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multi-functional landslide impact strength test platforms, including landslide slot, heaping groove, the supporting and regulating device for being placed in landslide trench bottom, the landslide impact force sensing device being placed in heaping groove at different location, the data acquisition device for being placed in outside test model slot and being connected with landslide impact force sensing device, and it is placed in the rainfall simulator on the slot of landslide；The landslide slot, heaping groove cross dimensions are consistent, are connect for the model of element slot group of 1m*1m by several a length of 1m and internal diameter.The present invention can carry out the multi-functional landslide physical simulation experiments such as rainfall induced landslide Analysis on Mechanism, landslide Rock And Soil deformation monitoring analysis, landslide movement speed monitoring, landslide impact force test analysis, experimental provision is simply secured, it is convenient for disassembly and assembly, combine in the multi-functional reusable test platform of multivariable, it uses, is worthy of popularization suitable for landslide disaster scientific research.

title_en: Earthquake observation system, earthquake observation program, and earthquake observation method
abstract_en:
[Problem] To enable high precision earthquake disaster simulations by analyzing the impact of earthquakes taking altitude position information into account.
[Solution] This earthquake observation system is provided with: multiple altitude notification units 4 which are disposed in a height direction inside a multi-story structure 5 and which notify neighboring mobile terminals of the respective height positions thereof; a plurality of smartphones 1 each provided with a sensor 16 for detecting vibration of the device itself, and each provided with a position information acquiring unit 144 which acquires a current location and attitude of the device itself; an observation control unit 145a which detects the attitude of each smartphone 1 and, on the basis of a continuation time of said attitude, causes the sensor 16 to start detecting vibrations; an information collecting unit 36 which acquires the number of smartphones 1 that have started detecting vibrations, and the respective current positions thereof, and collects the results of the detection by the sensor 16 of each mobile terminal; and a determining unit 37 which, on the basis of the detection results collected by the information collecting unit 36, determines that the vibrations are the result of an earthquake if the number of smartphones 1 bodies that detected the vibrations exceeds a prescribed number.

title_en: Smart evacuation guide system and method using virtual reality and context awareness algorithm
title_ko: 증강 현실 및 상황 인지 알고리즘을 이용한 스마트 대피 유도 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: In the present invention, disclosed are a smart evacuation guide system using augmented reality and a situation recognition algorithm and a method thereof. The smart evacuation guide system comprises: an NFC-based evacuation guide tag which guides installation of a smart evacuation guide application; a LoRa-based evacuation guide sensor which guides installation of the smart evacuation guide application; a disaster evacuee terminal which installs the smart evacuation guide application by contactless communications with an NFC-based evacuation guide tag or the LoRa-based evacuation guide sensor, performs auto-run of the smart evacuation guide application, transmits current location information in real time through the LoRa network by the smart evacuation guide application, outputs an evacuation guide path on a display based on augmented reality, and outputs voice through a speaker; a disaster manager terminal which receives disaster situation information from a disaster manager and transmits the disaster situation information in real time through the LoRa network; a situation recognition server which receives the current location information in real time from the disaster evacuee terminal, receives the disaster situation information in real time from the disaster manager terminal, and performs recognition of a disaster situation in real time based on the disaster situation information and current location information; and an evacuation guide server which generates an optimal evacuation guide path for each disaster evacuee with respect to the current location information as reference based on the recognition of the disaster situation performed in real time by the situation recognition server and transmits the evacuation guide path in real time to the relevant disaster evacuee.
abstract_ko: 증강 현실 및 상황 인지 알고리즘을 이용한 스마트 대피 유도 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 스마트 대피 유도 어플리케이션의 설치를 유도하는 NFC 기반 대피 유도 태그; 스마트 대피 유도 어플리케이션의 설치를 유도하는 로라 기반 대피 유도 센서; NFC 기반 대피 유도 태그 또는 로라 기반 대피 유도 센서와의 비접촉 통신에 의해 스마트 대피 유도 어플리케이션을 설치하고 자동 실행하고, 스마트 대피 유도 어플리케이션에 의해 로라망을 통해 현재 위치 정보를 실시간 송신하고, 로라망을 통해 현재 위치 정보에 기반한 대피 유도 경로를 실시간 수신하고, 대피 유도 경로를 디스플레이 상에서 증강 현실에 기반하여 출력하고 스피커를 통해 음성으로 출력하는 재난 대피자 단말; 재난 관리자로부터 재난 상황 정보를 입력받고 재난 상황 정보를 로라망을 통해 실시간 송신하는 재난 관리자 단말; 재난 대피자 단말로부터 현재 위치 정보를 실시간 수신하고, 재난 관리자 단말로부터 재난 상황 정보를 실시간 수신하고, 재난 상황 정보 및 실시간 현재 위치 정보를 기반으로 재난 상황 인지를 실시간 수행하는 상황 인지 서버; 상황 인지 서버에서 실시간 수행된 재난 상황 인지에 기반하여 현재 위치 정보를 기준으로 각 재난 대피자의 최적의 대피 유도 경로를 실시간 생성하고, 대피 유도 경로를 해당 재난 대피자 단말로 실시간 송신하는 대피 유도 서버를 구성한다.
assignees: UNIV DONG A RES FOUND FOR IND ACAD COOP

title_en: System for editing scenario of simulation action nuclear generating station's disaster
title_ko: 원자력발전소의 재난 대응 모의훈련 시나리오 편집 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for editing a scenario of disaster response simulation training of a nuclear power plant. More specifically, the present invention relates to the system for editing a scenario of disaster response simulation training of a nuclear power plant which conducts various simulation training with respect to emergencies capable of being varied according to a disaster occurring site, a type of disaster, severity of the disaster and a weather condition when conducting disaster response simulation training of a nuclear power plant based on a preset scenario. The system for editing a scenario of disaster response simulation training of a nuclear power plant comprises a simulation device (100), a simulation server (200), and an editing server (300).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원자력발전소의 재난 대응 모의훈련 시나리오 편집 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로는, 미리 설정된 시나리오를 기반으로, 원자력발전소의 재난 대응 모의훈련을 진행하는데 있어서, 재난발생 장소, 재난의 종류, 재난의 심각도 및 기상 조건 등에 따라서 다양하게 달라질 수 있는 비상상황에 대하여, 다양한 모의 훈련이 가능하도록 시나리오 편집이 가능한, 원자력발전소의 재난 대응 모의훈련 시나리오 편집 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of fast fixture device for drilling the drilling rod of super-pressure crevice water
abstract_en: This application provides a kind of fast fixture devices for drilling the drilling rod of super-pressure crevice water, drilling rod is passed through to the drilling rod channel of fastening scratch diskette, during rod boring, if in the case of encountering a small amount of high pressure ground water, fastening block is promoted using propulsion device, so that multiple fastening blocks are clamped fixation to drilling rod, avoiding chisel edge boss, there is a phenomenon where rigidity is stuck with drilling tool；If in the case of encountering a large amount of high pressure waters, middle position recovery can be carried out to drilling rod under the operation of worker, fastening block is promoted using propulsion device simultaneously, it is fixed so that multiple fastening blocks carry out Quick-clamped to drilling rod, removal is carried out to the segment of drillpipe outside fastening scratch diskette again, then water-blocking valve is closed in time, and carry out grouting operation, it reduces removal drilling rod and closes the effective time of water-blocking valve, then subsequent blowout hookup is closed and the work quick joinings such as slip casting, it avoids in the case where prolonged high pressure water acts on, causes the generation of disaster.

title_en: Method for exploiting non-diagenetic natural gas hydrate by utilizing F-shaped well group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for exploiting non-diagenetic natural gas hydrate by utilizing an F-shaped well group, which comprises the following steps: step 1: drilling an inclined well, obliquely drilling from the upper surface of the unstable stratum to a target point A in the stable stratum under the natural gas hydrate reservoir, then setting a casing and cementing to complete the well; step 2: drilling a horizontal well, wherein the horizontal well is provided with a vertical well section, a deflecting well section, an upwarp well section and a horizontal well section, and the vertical well section is positioned on one side of the bottom of the inclined well in the inclined direction; and step 3: performing fracturing sand prevention construction on the horizontal well section, requiring the fracturing fracture to extend into a reservoir, and injecting a chemical sand prevention agent into the fracture and the reservoir; and 4, step 4: closing the inclined shaft and opening the horizontal shaft by using the wellhead, and adopting CO 2 And (4) extracting the natural gas hydrate by a displacement or heat injection or depressurization or mixing method. The invention strengthens the stability and smoothness of the shaft, improves the contact area between the shaft and the reservoir, and enables the phase state transition of the natural gas hydrate to occur in the stable shaft, thereby effectively avoiding the complex accidents and even disasters caused by sand production, uncontrollable phase state transition of the natural gas hydrate and unstable shaft on one hand, and effectively improving the single-well yield and economic benefit of the natural gas hydrate on the other hand.

title_en: Balance expansion full water pressure cutting arrangement for soft or hard stratum
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of balance expansion full water pressure cutting arrangement for soft or hard stratum, belongs to underground engineering Rock And Soil drilling, cutting and underground engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters technical field.The device includes dynamical system, sensor-based system, control system, pressure charging system, balance telescopic system, sludge drainage system, support protection system, pressure piping system, drilling system.Apparatus of the present invention can provide superpower high hydraulic pressure as drilling power source, the accurate different soft or hard stratum of drilling of energy；It is able to achieve quantification control drilling head to cut the drilling power in pan soil layer region and increase in real time, the drilling power in weak soil layer region can be made to keep constant, guarantee stability, the accuracy of entire drilling construction；The drilling power on the energy fast quantificationization feedback soft or hard stratum of drilling face different zones provides Information Assurance to ensure that underground engineering drilling construction does not occur pile position deviation etc..

title_en: Data-driven wisdom crowd evacuating system based on Raspberry Pi and evacuation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of data-driven wisdom crowd evacuating system and evacuation method based on Raspberry Pi, at least two are arranged in the Raspberry Pi controller in crowd evacuation scene, it is configured as sensor node, receive the monitoring instruction that remote control terminal is sent, open listening mode, acquisition crowd's information, and it is sent to remote control terminal；Remote control terminal, it is configured as sending to Raspberry Pi controller and monitors instruction, and receive crowd's information of Raspberry Pi controller transmission, crowd evacuation emulation platform is imported to be emulated, and Scene Semantics is combined to carry out crowd movement's calculating, evacuation path is obtained, is combined obtained evacuation path and model of place to obtain crowd evacuation emulation simulation drawing.The present invention is by arranging that Raspberry Pi controller can be quickly obtained real-time crowd's information, and the real time information and global path navigation obtained using relative velocity obstruction method calculates crowd movement, quick crowd evacuation emulation is realized, to solve the problems, such as that public safety provides timely decision support.

title_en: Multi-exit evacuation method based on predicted time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-outlet evacuation method based on prediction time, which comprises the following steps of providing a prediction evacuation time acquisition formula; secondly, performing global path optimal planning based on A-star algorithm; and thirdly, calculating a formula of the exit evacuation capacity. The invention gives out an evacuation time calculation method for predicting that pedestrians select different exits according to the fact that key factors of people with multiple exits in evacuation are fully considered, wherein the key factors comprise the distance from each pedestrian to an exit, the expected speed of the pedestrians, the total number of the pedestrians corresponding to each exit and different evacuation capabilities of the exits with different widths, and simulation is carried out according to actual scenes. The experimental result shows that compared with the traditional model, the time prediction model provided by the invention can better simulate and predict the evacuation of pedestrians, and can provide effective help for the formulation of an emergency evacuation plan.

title_en: Coal and gas prominent release energy dissipating cooperates with preventing control method with media property transformation
abstract_en: The present invention proposes that a kind of coal and gas prominent release energy dissipating is transformed with media property and cooperates with preventing control method, comprising the following steps: Step 1: detection exceptions area；Step 2: release is anti-reflection；Step 3: grid-connected extraction；Step 4: improving coal mass strength.Beneficial effects of the present invention: forward probe analysis is carried out using Color Drilling TV technology, the microstructure characteristics of coal to extinction coal seam can accurately be grasped, to targetedly formulate the anti-reflection measure of release of differentiation, the blindness of anti-reflection Measure Design and construction is avoided；Not only by anti-reflection the reductions crustal stress of release, increase gas permeability of coal seam can be coal body media property be once transformed, but also for tectonic soft coal area (the prominent region of height), it is aided with the secondary transformation coal body media property of shot process for taking injection macromolecule foaming agent, improve the measure of coal mass strength, it works along both lines, cooperate with prevention and control, thus the generation of the coal and gas prominent disaster in the effective projecting coal bed tectonic soft coal area of prevention and control deep mining.

title_en: The water-retaining method of chemical tendering carbonate rock promotion mining induced fissure selfreparing
abstract_en: The invention discloses the water-retaining methods that a kind of chemical tendering carbonate rock promotes mining induced fissure selfreparing, are suitable for coal mining fwaater resources protection and mine water disaster Prevention Technique field.Confirm that overlying strata water flowing fractured zone links up the distribution information in stratum water-bearing layer and the rock stratum information rich in carbonate rock mineral in production zone；In production zone from earth's surface into the target formation within the scope of the water flowing fractured zone, below the water-bearing layer of stratum rich in carbonate rock mineral construction drill; softening agent is injected into target formation crack by drilling; react softening agent sufficiently with the carbonate rock mineral in target formation; soften carbonate rock; the tensioning crack in rock mass is promoted gradually to be closed under the action of mining stratum stress; its water transmitting ability is reduced, realizes the artificial promotion selfreparing and underground reservoir protection of mining induced fissure.Its step is simple, and effect is reliable, practical.

title_en: Water quality detecting device and the hidden water danger source positioning system of coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of water quality detecting device and the hidden water danger source positioning system of coal mine, is related to the technical field of mine water disaster prevention, which includes：First box body and detector, wherein the bottom of the open top of the first box body, the first box body is equipped with multiple holes that are filled with water, and not connected between multiple holes that are filled with water；Detector includes transducer beam, and transducer beam includes multiple sensors, and a sensor is for being detected a kind of water quality ion of the Kong Zhongshui that is filled with water, and the water quality ion that multiple sensors are detected is different.Water quality detecting device in the utility model can be placed on progress water quality detection at the aperture of drilling, wherein, each water being filled with water in hole is static condition, and the detection between various water quality ions is independent of each other, to alleviate the technical problem that traditional water quality detecting device is relatively low to the accuracy of detection of water quality ion and detection efficiency is poor.

title_en: Non-uniform high-precision curved surface grid water flow quality simulation and visualization method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for simulating and visualizing water quality of water flow of a non-uniform high-precision curved surface grid 1 (ii) a Secondly, for M 1 The mesh unit meeting the terrain gradient change condition and in the key research area is divided and encrypted to generate a layered high-precision curved surface mesh M 2 (ii) a Further, based on M 2 Discrete solving of two-dimensional water flow quality model, M in model calculation 2 The grid units meeting the conditions can be dynamically split and combined according to the water quality change state of the water flow; and finally, performing visual mapping on the water quality state information of the water flow by using the constructed three-dimensional virtual simulation platform to realize the visual simulation of the water quality of the water flow based on the three-dimensional virtual environment. Therefore, a support platform can be provided for flood control and disaster reduction, water environment protection, river growth and implementation of the strictest water resource management system.

title_en: The appraisal procedure of recovery capability after a kind of electric system calamity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of appraisal procedures of recovery capability after electric system calamity：1) clear electric system damage situations, acquisition system recovery scheme；2) repair process of analog line carries out Temporal Sampling using sequential Monte Carlo simulation to faulty line operating status；3) analysis system state carries out the system minimum tangential load based on direct current optimal power flow and calculates；4) it calculates land restoration index, draw recovery curve.Equipment after being destroyed by disaster to electric system using the method for the invention carries out rapid evaluation with load restoration ability, the evaluation process has taken into account the transportational process of disaster relief personnel and disaster relief supplies, and relevant evaluation index can be utilized, the economy of system is restored after analysis calamity response speed, recovery efficiency and recovery, and the desired effect of more different recovery policies can be used for providing reference proposition for the formulation of recovery policy after electric system calamity and calamity mitigation and relief.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Safe mining method for seabed shallow combustible ice
abstract_en: The invention provides a safe exploitation system and method of seabed shallow combustible ice, which are carried out according to the following steps: determining a pre-development block; making a development scheme of combustible ice; distributing a row of 5-6 horizontal well groups; drilling at the location of the horizontal well group; performing slot cutting treatment on the periphery of a shaft after the well drilling is formed; pulling out the drill; displacing completion fluid within the wellbore; injecting water vapor with the temperature of 120-180 ℃ and the pressure of 20-30 MPa into water wells separated from each other in 5-6 horizontal well groups; observing the water mist containing condition in the gas sprayed from the wellhead; igniting; the well head gas is merged into the gas outlet pipeline, and according to the characteristics of submarine topography, geological features, combustible ice reservoir and the like of the hydrate area, the environmental problems and disaster problems caused by methane leakage are avoided from the engineering by reasonable well position arrangement and depressurization scheme.

title_en: Firefighting earthquake-resistant shaking prevention struting supporter concrete fixing structure of anchor bolt protrusion type
title_ko: 앵커볼트 돌출형 소방내진 흔들림방지 버팀대 콘크리트 고정장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a firefighting earthquake-resistant shaking prevention strut concrete fixing device of an anchor bolt protrusion type. The firefighting earthquake-resistant shaking prevention strut concrete fixing device of an anchor bolt protrusion type comprises: a base anchor bolt (10) in which a part is embedded on concrete which is supported and placed by a cast (3), and the remaining part passes through a through hole (3H) formed on the cast (3) and protrudes from an outer surface of the cast (3); and a hanger part (14) provided on the base anchor bolt (10), and hooked to a rebar (2) reinforced for concrete construction. When removing the cast (3), the part of the base anchor bolt (10) is removed from the through hole (3H) of the cast (3) and protrudes from a surface of the concrete. Therefore, the present invention does not need to perforate a slab with a drill to install the anchor bolt on the slab, thereby preventing serious accidents of reducing stability of a building by cutting the rebar embedded in the slab in the process of perforating the slab or generating a short by cutting an electric wire by penetrating an electric wire pipe.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 앵커볼트 돌출형 소방내진 흔들림방지 버팀대 콘크리트 고정장치를 제공하고자 하는 것으로, 본 발명의 구성은 거푸집(3)에 지지되어 타설된 콘트리트에 일부가 매립되고 나머지 일부는 상기 거푸집(3)에 형성된 관통홀(3H)을 통과하여 상기 거푸집(3)의 바깥면으로 돌출되는 베이스 앵커볼트(10); 상기 베이스 앵커볼트(10)에 구비되어 콘크리트 시공을 위해 배근된 철근(2)에 걸려지는 행거부(14);를 포함하며, 상기 거푸집(3)을 제거하면, 상기 베이스 앵커볼트(10)의 일부가 상기 거푸집(3)의 상기 관통홀(3H)로부터 빠져서 상기 콘크리트의 표면에서 돌출되도록 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KIM KYOUNG JIN;STICE AND PEACE ENG & CONSULTING

title_en: System and method for damage prediction of structures
title_ko: 위험 등급 예측 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system and a method for predicting a risk level are disclosed. The system comprises: a node information collecting unit for storing multiple types of node information in a building; a sensor information collecting unit for storing multiple types of sensor information arranged in the building; a mapping unit for matching multiple nodes and multiple sensors; a database generating unit for constructing multiple rule set databases by applying multiple disaster scenarios to an analysis model of the building; and a determining unit for selecting the most similar database to information measured when a disaster actually occurs among the multiple rule sets databases, and determining a disaster situation according to a predefined risk level in the selected database.
abstract_ko: 실시 예는, 건물 내의 복수 개의 노드 정보를 저장하는 노드 정보 수집부; 상기 건물에 배치된 복수 개의 센서 정보를 저장하는 센서 정보 수집부; 상기 복수 개의 노드와 상기 복수 개의 센서를 매칭하는 맵핑부; 상기 건물의 분석 모델에 복수 개의 재난 시나리오를 적용하여 복수 개의 룰셋 데이터 베이스를 구축하는 데이터 베이스 생성부; 및 상기 복수 개의 룰셋 데이터 베이스 중에서 실제 재난 발생시 계측된 정보와 가장 유사한 데이터 베이스를 선택하고, 선택한 데이터 베이스에 미리 정의된 위험 등급에 따라 재난 상황을 판단하는 판단부를 포함하는 위험 등급 예측 시스템 및 방법을 개시한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Lifesaving appliance
abstract_en: A kind of lifesaving appliance includes raft frame, rope and release device, and release device includes force piece, the second snap close piece and controller that are connect with force piece, and controller connects with force piece communication and controls the keying of force piece；Fixing bracket offers the notch being connected to accommodating chamber, and one end of the first snap close piece is connect with rope, and the other end of the first snap close piece stretches into accommodating chamber across notch；Second snap close piece by the first snap close piece blocking and is fixed in notch when being retracted to latched position under force piece drives, and the second snap close piece also pushes away the first snap close piece outside notch when extending out to releasing position under force piece drives.In the utility model in case of emergency, ordinary person can automatically control automatic release of the release device realization to life raft by operation and control device, it is easy to operate, it needs not move through professional training and operation can be completed, saving oneself for passenger strives for the quality time when occurring for disaster waterborne.
assignees: SHENZHEN YUNZHOU INNOVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Centrifugation mud discharge type air pressure pressurization cutting arrangement for soft or hard stratum
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of centrifugation mud discharge type air pressure for soft or hard stratum and pressurizes cutting arrangement, belongs to underground engineering Rock And Soil drilling, cutting and underground engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters technical field.The centrifugation mud discharge type air pressure pressurization cutting arrangement for being used for soft or hard stratum includes spiral centrifugation sludge drainage system, composite drill cutting system, compression system, sensor-based system, water pumping flushing system, skeletal support system.Drilling of the present invention can flexible fast operating when constructing；The present invention carries out drilling work using composite drill cutting system, ensure that the uniformity of the soil body, it is ensured that the soil body is smoothly discharged, and ensure that the quick drilling construction on soft or hard stratum, improves speed of application；The present invention is connect by several spiral centrifugation mud exhausters with several sludge pipes using spiral centrifugation sludge drainage system, and the high speed of landwaste excludes when ensure that soft or hard stratum drilling construction；The present invention does not influence stiffness of structural member and safety not only, but also save material by inlaying high-voltage tube and conduit inside a word linking arm.

title_en: A kind of working face extraction tunnel initating optimization of region method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of working face extraction roadway layout method, scene drills through coal body sample in connection roadway, and production key rock tests block in laboratory, measures rock test block uniaxial compressive strength and elasticity modulus using servo-system；Rock block is made according to similar proportion, and is classified as several groups；Using mining induced stress pilot system, to non-uniform load is applied on each group rock block, circular tunnel circular hole is drilled through in each group rock block different location respectively；Using acoustic emission system and digital speckle system, the extensions path and deformation rule of tracking and positioning crack.Monitoring result is destroyed according to circular hole, determines tunnel the optimum layout position.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows roadway layout design it is more reasonable, it is higher with field condition degree of agreement, all kinds of stope drift active workings disaster accidents can be substantially reduced.

title_en: A kind of Room in Fire movement smoke controlling experiment simulator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Room in Fire to move smoke controlling experiment simulator, including simulation laboratory, simulation laboratory are cuboid structure, and smoke outlet is arranged in one side wall, and door is arranged on another side wall, and simulation laboratory is internally provided with weighing device, burning things which may cause a fire disaster is arranged thereon；The baffle for the sliding that can delay is set on smoke outlet, and position and the size of smoke outlet is adjusted in the movement of baffle；Positive pressure fume extractor is set near outer side of door, the position of setting and angle adjustable, and rotating speed is adjustable；Simulated experiment chamber interior different location is equipped with multiple measurement holders, and different height is equipped with several temperature points on each test bracket, and the position of nearly smoke outlet is equipped with one or several wind speed measuring points；Control system is connect with weighing device, each temperature point, wind speed measuring point, positive pressure fume extractor signal.The present invention is ingenious in design, and directive significance is provided for the setting of positive pressure fume extractor and the self-protection of fire fighters.

title_en: Basin synthetic disaster information processing method and system based on hydrological simulation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of basin synthetic disaster information processing method and system based on hydrological simulation, this method comprises: step 1, construct the Watershed Hydrologic Models of remotely-sensed data driving, step 2, run-off simulation is carried out using the Watershed Hydrologic Models of building, step 3, flood the condition of a disaster information service in basin is provided.The system includes: the Watershed Hydrologic Models construction unit of remotely-sensed data driving, the run-off analogue unit based on Watershed Hydrologic Models, basin synthetic disaster information service offer unit.This method and system can establish the valley water security management model of remotely-sensed data driving well, couple multi-source remote sensing monitoring data and valley water security management model, and using the data of basin history typical case's big flood phase as reference, basin flood the condition of a disaster information service is provided.

title_en: A kind of satellite image analysis method based on convolutional neural networks
abstract_en: A kind of satellite image analysis method based on convolutional neural networks proposed in the present invention, main contents include：Determine case, create training dataset, using data set training and verify, obtains new case information, for new case fine tuning model, its process is, using deep learning, case is first chosen, then establishment and the relevant training dataset of case, and extraction information is concentrated from training data, then the subset of training data is used to detect its ability, trained model is ready for new case, is suitably finely tuned to model further according to practical, the data in remaining case are finally automatically processed by model.The present invention can be used for various disaster management application programs, can carry out semantic segmentation to devastated, draw devastated map, substantially reduce time cost, improve working efficiency；Easily data characteristic can also be finely adjusted to be extended to new field simultaneously.

title_en: A kind of industrial control system information security simulation model and terminal
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of industrial control system information security simulation model and terminal, which includes：Network security emulation module carries out safe compliance detection to the network structure of industrial control system, and safety detection is carried out to the network flow of industrial control system, and, safety detection is carried out to the network host of industrial control system；Network security product emulation module to the function of network security product, tested, obtain testing information, and assesses the degree of conformity of the identification information and test information of network security product by loophole and performance；The O＆M scenarios of the usage scenario and industrial control system of network security training module simulation industry control system, emergency response scene.The model is more professional in terms of the network security emulation to industrial control system, functional diversities, it is applied widely, electric analog system is not relied on, the technical issues of alleviating the existing network security attacks emulation technology to industrial control system there are dependence, limitation and non-professionalities.

title_en: Panic crowd evacuation method based on discrete optimal control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a panic crowd evacuation method based on discrete optimal control. The device is suitable for guiding evacuation of panic people when a disaster occurs, and is mainly used for solving the influence of psychological panic on crowd evacuation. The partial differential equation based on the LWR and Underwood models is established from a macroscopic view, and the escape of people in a fluid mode in a panic state is simulated. The invention combines the LWR model and the Underwood model under the optimal control, can better control the speed in the crowd evacuation process, and verifies that the proposed control has better practical feasibility.

title_en: A kind of experimental provision studied fuel particle under lead base reactor disaster and migrate characteristic
abstract_en: A kind of experimental provision studied fuel particle under lead base reactor disaster and migrate characteristic, the device are the experimental provisions of swarming of the fuel particle in lead bismuth coolant when major accident occurs for lead base reactor；Using stainless steel particle simulation fuel particle, high temperature resistant quartz glass tube simulates coolant flow passages between cluster, the lead bismuth alloy melted in heating tank is pressed into the quartz glass tube of filling stainless steel grain bed by high pressure gas, visual research heats the affecting laws that the factors such as pressure tank, lead bismuth coolant temperature, stainless steel particle size and stainless steel particle bed height carry lead bismuth alloy stainless steel particle flow coagulating property；The present invention provides important experimental provision for the swarming in the coolant channels of fuel particle during lead base reactor disaster core meltdown and the again research of solidification phenomenon.

title_en: City integrated piping lane cable cabin fire disaster simulation method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention provides a kind of city integrated piping lane cable cabin fire disaster simulation method and device, is related to technical field of fire safety.Wherein, the method is by waiting for that the structural parameters of analog synthesis piping lane create piping lane model, the cable model for simulating cable burning is added in the piping lane model further according to the structural parameters of cable to be simulated, and burning things which may cause a fire disaster of the addition for causing the cable mock up ignition, then to the Thermal Parameter of the piping lane model, the combustion characteristics of cable protection layer and the property of fire source of the burning things which may cause a fire disaster are configured in the cable model, it is finally based on the Thermal Parameter of the piping lane model, the property of fire source of the combustion characteristics of cable protection layer and the burning things which may cause a fire disaster carries out fire disaster simulation, obtain the air themperature changed with cable burning time in pipe gallery, smokescope, the fire such as concentration of toxic gases numerical value and fire disaster simulation scene, theoretical foundation is provided for fire-fighting and rescue, considerably reduce the danger of fire rescue.

title_en: Intersection intramural conflict based on battleground degree of occupying clears up simulation method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of, and the intersection intramural conflict based on battleground degree of occupying clears up simulation method, includes the following steps：S1. conflict of qualification area；S2. the kinematic parameter of vehicle is estimated；S3. the time that conflict both sides' vehicle arrives separately at battleground is calculated；S4. judge that whether the vehicle for reaching battleground at first reaches the time of battleground less than the decision-making time, if then entering the decision moment, execute step S5；Otherwise vehicle continues to travel, and then executes step S3；S5. it calculates and reaches the vehicle of battleground at first and reach the time of battleground and leave the time of battleground and another vehicle reaches time of battleground, to judge whether to conflict, if so then execute step S6, otherwise vehicle continues to travel；S6. the degree of occupying for the vehicle for reaching battleground at first is calculated separately；S7. the vehicle based on battleground degree of occupying take the lead decision behavior probabilistic model calculate separately at first reach battleground vehicle probability of taking the lead；Whether the probability of taking the lead for S8. judging to reach the vehicle of battleground at first is more than set threshold value, if then vehicle is taken the lead traveling, otherwise then vehicle evacuation.

title_en: Virtual Reality Based Safety Experience and Education System
title_ko: 가상현실 기반 안전체험 및 교육시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual reality based safety experiencing and educating system to experience a phenomenon by using virtual reality when a life accident such as a fire or a natural disaster such as an earthquake occurs and also to easily learn how to cope with various situations when the natural disaster or the life accident occurs. The virtual reality based safety experiencing and educating system includes: a safety experience hall (10) for allowing a user to experience a disaster situation using the video of a virtual reality; a VR test hall which produces a disaster situation experienced in the safety experience hall (10) by using the video of a virtual reality and testes each survivor in order to overcome disasters or to escape safely through a proper selection in various situations where disasters occur.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가상현실을 이용하여 지진 등의 자연재해 또는 화재를 비롯한 생활 안전사고가 발생할 때 나타나는 현상을 미리 체험해 볼 수 있도록 함과 아울러 자연재해나 생활안전사고가 발생하였을 때 여러 가지 상황에 대응하는 방법을 쉽게 익일 수 있도록 한, 가상현실 기반 안전체험 및 교육시스템에 관한 것으로서, 
가상현실의 동영상을 이용하여 재난상황을 체험할 수 있도록 하는 안전체험관(10)과; 가상현실의 동영상을 이용하여 상기 안전체험관(10)에서 체험한 재난상황을 연출하고 재난시 발생하는 여러 가지 상황에서 각 체험자가 올바른 선택을 통해 재난을 극복하거나 안전하게 탈출할 수 있도록 테스트하는 VR 테스트관(20);을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Safety Experience Apparatus using Virtual Reality
title_ko: 가상현실을 이용한 안전체험기구
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety experience tool using virtual reality capable of enabling a user to experience a phenomenon, which occurs when a natural disaster such as an earthquake or the like, or a life accident such as fire is generated, by using virtual reality in advance; and performing education for a plurality of safety experiences in a school or a public office by enabling the user to experience a disaster situation with a video of the virtual reality. The safety experience tool using virtual reality comprises an experience plate (30), one or more projecting devices (20), a display structure (10), one or more 3D driving devices (40), and a controlling unit (50). A large number of people can stand up on the experience plate (30). One or more projecting devices (20) display a situation which occurs in disaster generation on the video of the virtual reality. The display structure (10) is arranged to surround the experience plate (30) and displays the video generated by the projecting devices (20). One or more 3D driving devices (40) are installed in a lower part of the experience plate (30), and move the experience plate (30) in a 6-axis direction corresponding to the disaster situation. The controlling unit (50) controls the projecting devices (20) and the 3D driving devices (40).
abstract_ko:

title_en: Methods and systems for virtual and augmented reality training for responding to emergency conditions
abstract_en: Method for training a trainee to respond to an emergency response condition such as a sudden cardiac arrest (SCA) including placing the trainee in a virtual reality environment comprising at least one virtual victim having a virtual victim avatar. The method can include causing the virtual victim to manifest symptoms of an SCA. The method can include allowing the trainee to perform, in the virtual reality environment, one or more of cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) on the virtual victim, retrieving an automated external defibrillator (AED), using an AED on the virtual victim, or contacting emergency responders. Additionally, a method of using augmented reality for emergency response training such as CPR. The method allows the integration of a CPR feedback manikin with the AR device such that the holographic blood flow is based on the actual CPR quality being performed on the manikin.

title_en: Slope slip stability discrimination method considering unsaturated zone effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope slip stability discrimination method considering the effect of an unsaturated zone, which specifically comprises the following steps: (1) acquiring morphological characteristic information of a research side slope and corresponding geological and hydrological parameters of a side slope soil body; (2) acquiring an initial condition inside the slope by a segmented point-taking actual measurement method or a slope initial boundary condition simulation method; (3) simulating the subsequent hydrological process inside the slope according to the corresponding change of the boundary condition of the slope under the action of the landslide induction factor, and obtaining the water level line inside the slope at each moment; (4) calculating a real-time slope stability coefficient by using a slope stability safety coefficient calculation formula, and drawing a slope minimum stability safety coefficient change flow line; (5) analyzing the earliest instability time and the corresponding instability area of the side slope according to the change flow line of the minimum stability safety coefficient of the side slope; the method can obtain a more accurate real-time stability safety coefficient calculation result, is used for judging the stability of the side slope and predicting the instability time, and provides a more effective reference model for forecasting and protecting landslide disasters.

title_en: Unsupervised SAR image change detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides an unsupervised SAR image change detection method, which is used for solving the technical problems of low detection accuracy and low calculation efficiency in the prior art. The method comprises the following implementation steps: filtering the two registered time phase SAR images; generating an initial difference map; carrying out significance detection on the initial difference map to obtain a significance difference map; pre-classifying the significance difference graph by using a fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm to obtain candidate training samples and uncertain samples; carrying out equalization processing on the candidate training sample set to obtain a training sample; extracting the intrinsic and uncertain sample characteristics of the training image sample by using a PCA filter; and training a support vector machine by using the training sample characteristics, and classifying the uncertain samples by using the trained support vector machine to obtain a change detection result. The method can improve the accuracy of calculation and detection and reduce the operation time, and can be used for evaluating disasters, predicting the development trend of the disasters, detecting targets, monitoring land coverage and utilization and the like.

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on deep forest
abstract_en: The invention provides a SAR image change detection method based on a deep forest, which mainly solves the problems that the prior art cannot fully obtain useful information from local image blocks, and the detection precision is poor due to the loss of information of edge parts of images. The implementation steps comprise: acquiring an initial SAR image change detection diagram; optimizing the deep forest model; acquiring a training sample data set; acquiring an initial category probability map P; calculating a gradient magnitude graph G and a gradient directional diagram M of the difference graph D; acquiring a final class probability map P2; and acquiring a final SAR image change detection diagram. The optimized deep forest model is used, the input of the model is multi-scale image input, and a final classification probability map is obtained after a gradient amplitude map and a gradient directional diagram of a difference map are calculated, so that the SAR image change detection precision is improved, and the SAR image change detection method can be used in the related fields of SAR image change detection such as environment monitoring, agricultural investigation, disaster relief work and the like.

title_en: Device for simulating influence of shallow air spraying disaster in slope seabed on existing ocean foundation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for simulating the influence of disaster of shallow air spraying in a slope seabed on an existing ocean foundation, which comprises an ocean barrel-shaped foundation, a jack, an air inlet spray pipe and the like; the existing scientific technology can hardly ascertain the propagation path of the pneumatic splitting in the soil body in a large range in the seabed on site, and the existing theory can not accurately predict the possible eruption path. In order to solve the problems, the invention simulates the catastrophe of shallow gas injection in the slope seabed, reproduces the catastrophe process of pneumatic splitting in the actual environment, interprets the catastrophe mechanism of the pneumatic splitting catastrophe based on the catastrophe process, and provides a model technology and an observation means for ascertaining the influence of the shallow gas injection on the existing ocean foundation. Based on the model experimental study of the invention, key scientific and technical support is provided for site selection and safety evaluation of ocean foundations in the future construction process of the large bay area in China.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed material separation and dust fall device and an application scene thereof, wherein the device comprises a multichannel bionic cyclone and an ejector; wherein the multichannel bionic cyclone sequentially comprises an overflow pipe, a cyclone cavity, a shrinkage hopper and a discharge pipe which are mutually and fixedly connected from top to bottom, and bionic non-smooth units are distributed on the inner wall surface of the multichannel bionic cyclone; the upper end of the side wall of the cyclone cavity is provided with an inlet channel; the ejector comprises a nozzle, a mixing chamber, a throat pipe and a diffusion chamber, one end of the nozzle is connected with the high-pressure pump, the other end of the nozzle stretches into the mixing chamber, the mixing chamber is in airtight connection with an overflow pipe, two ends of the throat pipe are respectively in airtight connection with the mixing chamber and the diffusion chamber, and the diffusion chamber is connected with the dust fall box through a pipeline. title_en: Optical remote sensing scene classification method and device based on depth twin residual error network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical remote sensing image classification method based on a depth twin residual error network, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. In the training stage, firstly, feature extraction is carried out on an input remote sensing image pair through two completely same depth residual error networks to respectively obtain feature representations of the input remote sensing image pair, and then the Euclidean distance of the input remote sensing image pair in a feature space is calculated by combining the two feature representations to judge the similarity degree of the input remote sensing image pair. In the testing stage, the input image is subjected to scene classification by using any one of the trained depth residual error networks. The method can be used for carrying out scene classification on large-scale high-resolution remote sensing images, and can play an important role in the fields of natural disaster monitoring and evaluation, urban planning, environment monitoring and the like.
