title_en: Systems and methods to enable continual, memory-bounded learning in artificial intelligence and deep learning continuously operating applications across networked compute edges
title_ko: 네트워크 연산 에지 전반에 걸쳐 연속적으로 애플리케이션을 작동하는 딥 러닝과 인공 지능에서 지속적인 메모리 기반 학습을 가능하게 하는 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Lifelong Deep Neural Network (L-DNN) technology revolutionizes Deep Learning by enabling fast, post-deployment learning without extensive training, heavy computing resources, or massive data storage. It uses a representation-rich, DNN-based subsystem (Module A) with a fast-learning subsystem (Module B) to learn new features quickly without forgetting previously learned features. Compared to a conventional DNN, L-DNN uses much less data to build robust networks, dramatically shorter training time, and learning on-device instead of on servers. It can add new knowledge without re-training or storing data. As a result, an edge device with L-DNN can learn continuously after deployment, eliminating massive costs in data collection and annotation, memory and data storage, and compute power. This fast, local, on-device learning can be used for security, supply chain monitoring, disaster and emergency response, and drone-based inspection of infrastructure and properties, among other applications.
abstract_ko: 평생 심층 신경망(L-DNN) 기술은 광범위한 훈련, 고비용 연산 자원 또는 대용량 데이터 저장 없이, 배치 후 고속 학습을 가능하게 함으로써 딥 러닝을 혁신한다. 이는, 이전에 학습한 특징을 망각하지 않고 새로운 특징을 빠르게 학습하기 위해, 표현 풍부한 DNN 기반 서브시스템(모듈 A)을 고속 학습 서브시스템(모듈 B)과 사용한다. 종래의 DNN과 비교하면, L-DNN은 훨씬 적은 데이터를 사용하여 견고한 네트워크를 구축하고, 훈련 시간을 대폭 단축하고, 서버 대신 장치에서 학습한다. 데이터를 재훈련 또는 저장하지 않고서, 새로운 지식을 추가할 수 있다. 결과적으로, L-DNN을 갖는 에지 장치는, 배치 후 연속적으로 학습할 수 있고, 데이터 수집 및 표지, 메모리 및 데이터 저장, 및 연산 전력에 있어서 비용을 많이 제거한다. 이러한 고속 로컬 장치 학습은 보안, 공급망 모니터링, 재난 및 비상 대응, 기타 애플리케이션 중에서 인프라 및 특성에 대한 드론 기반 검사를 위해 사용될 수 있다.

title_en: Damage preventing method by dangerous material diffusion simulation
title_ko: 위험물질 확산 시뮬레이션에 의한 피해 방지방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a damage prevention method using hazardous substance diffusion simulations utilizing on-site situation information. The damage prevention method can be used to quickly and accurately extract the on-site situation information by using specific methods, develop and provide the diffusion simulations of hazardous substances such as chemical substances, and prevent disaster damage by utilizing the same. The damage prevention method using hazardous substance diffusion simulations can automatically process all processes to be described below by using an on-site situation information DB provided to an operation computer by using a hazard diffusion prediction program installed on the operating computer. The damage prevention method includes: an on-site situation information extracting process of building the DB when various information of the on-site situations from the automatic weather system (AWS) installed in advance is received to the operating computer; a process of analyzing the most similar wind by executing a wind field diffusion analysis operation through using the DB and applying the conversion factor of each property of the hazardous diffusion substances in the realized wind field, and analyzing the diffusion of the hazardous substances; and a process of visually realizing the statistic property information including pollution ranges and location information in accordance with the wind speed and direction while taking the facility and terrain information into account from the leakage and diffusion with respect to the leakage point of the hazardous substances.

title_en: Integrated Dashboard Device and Methods for Military Cyber Penetration Test Training
title_ko: 군 사이버 모의침투 훈련을 위한 통합대시보드 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a mock military cyber penetration test training method in a dashboard device comprises the following steps: a mock penetration testing step of conducting a mock penetration test using a testing tool on a network depending on assigned roles of testers; a test type and information input step of inputting a test type and test information to conduct the test; a test data collection step of collecting individual information collected by the tester in cooperation with the tester; and a collected information normalization step of normalizing collected information according to the content of the test type and test information regarding the collected information. The mock military cyber penetration test training method can be efficient for commanders to control and command in a situation to conduct the mock military cyber penetration to secure safety on defense network and to assess the same.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 통합 대시보드 장치에서의 군 사이버 모의침투 훈련을 위한 방법은, 테스터(testor)들이 역할 분담에 따라 네트워크망에 대해서 테스트 도구를 이용하여 모의침투 테스트를 수행하는 모의침투 테스트 수행 단계; 테스트를 수행하기 위한 테스트 종류 및 테스트 정보를 입력하는 테스트 종류 및 정보 입력 단계; 상기 테스터들과 연동하여 상기 테스터들이 수집한 개별 정보를 수집하는 테스트 데이터 수집 단계; 및 상기 수집된 정보에 대해서 상기 테스트 종류 및 테스트 정보의 내용에 따라서 수집 정보를 정규화하는 수집 정보 정규화 단계를 포함하고, 국방 네트워크망에 대한 안전성을 확보하고 평가하기 위한 군의 사이버 모의침투 작전 환경에서 지휘관의 지휘통제를 수행하는데 효율적일 수 있다.

title_en: Method to provide disaster information by Region
title_ko: 권역별 재난정보 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing disaster information for each area, which is realized to display attribute information according to a data input type standardization and area level, and which is realized to enable a user to see, at a look, changes in information for each area according to time through a simulation function, and more specifically, to a method for providing disaster information for each area, which is configured to upload and display data related to various disasters by using a smart disaster situation management system (which is a computer program) installed in an operating computer. The method for providing disaster information for each area comprises: an upload process in which basic information such as ″a title, a writer, an organization, a purpose of use, and an expression method″ is inputted with disaster information for each area, and in which a data set based on a time is inputted, and a note value as well as a target numerical value for each area is additionally inputted; a management process in which a registered data set list is displayed on a screen to modify and delete content thereof, or to set selected data to be shared so as to share information with another person; a mapping process in which registered user registration information is displayed on a map for each area with the numerical value and a legend; and a simulation display process in which a user can check a change in a screen while a progress bar is moved through a simulation function on a lower end by selecting a written data set for each area and performing continuous viewing.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 데이터 입력 방식 정형화 및 권역 수준에 따라 속성정보를 표출할 수 있도록 구현하고, 시뮬레이션 기능을 통해 시간에 따라 권역별 정보의 변화를 한 눈에 살펴볼 수 있도록 구현한 권역별 재난정보 제공방법에 관한 것으로, 
운영 컴퓨터에 설치된 스마트 재난상황관리시스템(이는 컴퓨터 프로그램임)을 사용하여 각종 재난 관련 데이타를 업로드하여 표출하는 권역별 재난정보 제공방법에 관한 것으로, 먼저 "제목, 작성자, 소속기관, 사용목적, 표출방식"과 같은 기본정보가 권역별 재난정보와 함께 입력되어지되, 시간을 기준으로한 데이터셋이 입력되고 각 지역별로 목적 수치값 뿐만 아니라 비고값이 추가 입력되어지는 업로드 과정과; 등록된 데이터셋 목록을 화면에 띄워 그 내용을 수정 및 삭제하거나, 선택된 데이터에 대해 공유설정해줌으로써 타인과 정보 공유할 수 있도록 하는 관리 과정과; 등록된 사용자 등록정보를 수치값과 범례와 함께 지도상에 권역별로 표출되어지는 매핑 과정과; 작성된 권역별 데이터셋을 선택해서 연속 보기해줌으로써 하단의 시뮬레이션 기능을 통해 진행바가 이동되면서 화면이 변화됨을 확인할 수가 있게되는 시뮬레이션 표출과정으로 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Adaboost-based power transmission line rainstorm disaster risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line rainstorm disaster risk early warning method based on Adaboost, which comprises the following steps: collecting external environmental factors of the power transmission line, classifying the external environmental factors, acquiring meteorological characteristic factors corresponding to various external environmental factors of the power transmission line under a rainstorm disaster, segmenting the power transmission line, and collecting power transmission line information of each segment of the power transmission line; selecting external environmental factors of rainstorm disasters of each section of power transmission line and corresponding meteorological characteristic factors to form a training sample set, and generating a classifier through an Adaboost ensemble learning algorithm; acquiring real-time meteorological characteristic factors as input, and acquiring an early warning output result of the rainstorm disaster of each section of power transmission line and a confidence coefficient margin value through a classifier; calculating the early warning output result of the rainstorm disaster and the confidence coefficient margin value of the whole power transmission line according to the weight proportion linear combination of each section of power transmission line; and outputting the rainstorm disaster risk early warning grade.

title_en: Microseismic signal SMOTE identification method and monitoring system fusing spatial knowledge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microseismic signal SMOTE identification method and a monitoring system fusing spatial knowledge, which realize classification of microseismic signals and further finish more accurate and timely early warning of rock burst disasters. Firstly, carrying out data format conversion and division on microseismic data from an SOS microseismic monitoring system; secondly, determining the spatial correlation of the microseismic signals, and constructing an unbalanced training sample set fusing spatial knowledge; thirdly, determining sampling multiplying power according to the unbalanced rate of the training sample set, and realizing generation of the subclass samples based on SMOTE; and finally, learning the microseismic signal classifier fusing spatial knowledge by adopting a model fusion structure. The method fully utilizes the spatial layout information of the microseismic signals, excavates the homogeneous data with strong correlation, reduces the influence of the irrelevant homogeneous data on the generation of the over-sampled data, improves the classification accuracy and timeliness of the microseismic signal learner, and provides more powerful support for timely and effective early warning of the rock burst disaster.

title_en: Modeling method of large-scale intelligent group autonomous collaboration simulating European 26891bird cluster flight
abstract_en: The invention provides an imitation Europe 26891a large-scale intelligent group autonomous cooperation modeling method for bird cluster flight, which comprises the steps of initializing a population and parameters thereof, setting all agents to take initial positions as individual optimal positions in an initial state, and taking optimal values of 6 or 7 neighbors nearest to the agents as local optimal values; calculating a fitness function, setting neighbor distribution anisotropy around each Agent individual, wherein the nearest 6 or 7 neighbors are isotropic, and the interaction between the Agent individuals depends on topological distance; selecting an update peer, including selecting one of 6 or 7 neighbors that are closest to an Agent as its update peer; defining an interaction relation between the agents; and updating the Agent speed and the Agent position. The invention has very wide application prospect in the fields of military, emergency, industry, medical treatment and the like, such as unmanned aerial vehicle cluster intensive formation, large-scale gathering place crowd emergency evacuation, large-scale robot crowd cooperative operation, disease propagation control and the like.

title_en: A kind of wisdom garden emergency warning system
abstract_en: The present invention is suitable for industrial park contingency management technical field, provides a kind of wisdom garden emergency warning system.The system includes：Server, several sensors, subscriber terminal equipment with data-transformation facility, the subscriber terminal equipment includes enterprise terminal, garden terminal, maintenance terminal, and the server includes personal management module, device management module, administration of the prevention and control module, waste water management module, exhaust gas management module, occupational health management module, waste management module, natural disaster management module, self-test hidden danger management module, special hidden danger management module, fragmentary engineering management module, inspection management module and Training Management module.The present invention establishes a comprehensive industrial park emergency system, improves emergency managerial ability, in recovery process of disposing and deal with problems arising from an accident in the prevention in advance, incident reply, thing of burst accident, complete monitoring and takes the necessary measures.

title_en: Simulate highly dense area ground long-term settlement model test apparatus under complex vibration environment
abstract_en: The present invention provides highly dense area ground long-term settlement model test apparatus under a kind of simulation complex vibration environment, belongs to city underground engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters and surface subsidence geological disaster technical field.Highly dense area ground long-term settlement model test apparatus includes model casing, stratum system, tunnel system, high-speed rail roadbed system, excitation system, sensor-based system, ground intensive building, high-speed rotating system, cavern system under simulation complex vibration environment of the present invention.Ground long-term settlement caused by device energy Whole Process Simulation intensive building area's subway and high-speed rail joint are vibrated；The ground long-term settlement under complex environment under the effect of high speed rotation centrifugal force can precisely be simulated；The existing solution cavity of energy quantification monitoring operation tunnel upper and lower reinforces influence of the front and back to ground long-term settlement, and experimental cost is low, data are reliable.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting simulated training method based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of fire-fighting simulated training method based on virtual reality technology, including：Construct scene of fire virtual scene model library；The virtual scene model library of building is loaded into three-dimensional scenic by combining geographic information, model solid space location information by three-dimensional modeling；By display screen and human-computer interaction, loads the rehearsal simulated scenario and transfer pre-stored disaster relief prediction scheme storehouse；Rehearsal personnel dress the scene that VR equipment shows the rehearsal simulated scenario and tracks the sight track display respective angles of rehearsal personnel；Start to acquire the environmental information of the concrete operations action message of rehearsal personnel, real time status information, location information and surrounding and be shown after handling acquisition information in the rehearsal simulated scenario.Fire-fighting simulated training method provided by the invention based on virtual reality technology is conducive to improve the specific aim and validity of fire drill, and experience sense is strong.
assignees: TELEWAVE INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Clay soil burial survival signal generating device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a clay burial survival signal generating device which comprises a guiding device and a base, wherein the guiding device is fixedly connected with the base; the guiding device comprises a conical drill bit and a driving piece, the driving piece is used for driving the conical drill bit to rotate, drilling threads are arranged on the conical drill bit, the driving piece works, the turning direction of the drilling threads is the same as the turning direction of the driving piece, when the guiding device works in soil, the conical drill bit applies a first axial force to the base to drive the base to move along a guiding direction in the soil, the soil is excavated through the guiding device, then the vertical direction is positioned through a gyroscope, then the direction of the guiding device is adjusted through a turning track, therefore, the whole signal generating device can be ensured to move away from the gravity direction until the whole signal generating device leaves the ground, an illumination sensor detects illumination to rise at the moment, a distress signal can be sent, a distress effect can be played, and disaster victims can be timely found and rescued.

title_en: A kind of switch apparatus for demonstrating of artificial intelligence training
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of switch apparatus for demonstrating of artificial intelligence training, it mainly include deck plate, valve member, control device, the valve member is mounted on deck plate, the valve member middle position is socketed with valve, the valve bottom end is equipped with switch shaft assembly and runs through with valve, switch shaft assembly is linked into control device, and the valve upper end is equipped with the Push And Release that handle is used to switch shaft assembly.The utility model there is introduction visitor can take correct hazard mitigation measure to reduce or avoid to lose in the disasters bring such as earthquake, fire, gas leak, blank of the seismic popular science market on Guan Shuiguan gas simulation demonstrating apparatus is filled up, the period of reset also can control, and next bit spectators is facilitated to drill instruction operation.
assignees: ANHUI NEW HORIZON SCIENCE AND EDUCATION CULTURE CO LTD

title_en: Image change detection method based on depth separable convolutional network
abstract_en: The invention provides an image change detection method based on a depth separable convolution network, which is used for solving the technical problem of low detection accuracy in the existing image change detection method. The method comprises the following implementation steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a training sample set, a verification sample set and a test sample set, constructing a deep separable convolutional network by taking a variant U-Net of a full convolutional network as a basic network, constructing a loss function of the training deep separable convolutional network, training, testing and verifying the deep separable convolutional network, and testing by using the verified finally trained deep separable convolutional network to obtain a change detection result graph. The image feature semantics and structure information extracted by the depth separable convolutional network are rich, the expression capability and the discriminativity of the image are strong, the change detection accuracy is improved, and the method can be used in the technical fields of land cover detection, disaster assessment, video monitoring and the like.

title_en: Method for predicting demand of rail transit passenger flow evacuation in emergency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting the demand of evacuation of rail transit passenger flow in an emergency, which comprises the following steps: 1) acquiring a normal short-time traffic demand sample set according to historical ticket card data of the rail transit automatic toll collection system, and performing multi-step prediction by adopting a mixed prediction model based on principal component analysis on the basis of the normal short-time traffic demand sample set to acquire a normal short-time railway trip demand prediction result; 2) establishing a track traffic network directed graph according to a track traffic network topological relation; 3) distributing the rail transit trips OD to obtain a distribution matrix F; 4) according to the characteristics and prior information of the emergency, a calculation formula of the evacuation demand of each station of the whole network during the event influence period is obtained by combining the prediction result; 5) and (4) acquiring the spatial-temporal evolution of evacuation demands in the period influenced by the emergency by adopting simulation, and acquiring a peak retention value. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of strong operability, strong practicability, direct application, complete method and the like.

title_en: A kind of coal seam high pressure hydrothermal solution resistanceization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of coal seam high pressure hydrothermal solution resistanceization methods, belong to preventing and extinguishing fire of coal mine technical field.It plays concordant drilling in coal seam first, certain density high temperature retardant solution is prepared using high temperature slot, it will be in the concordant drilling in retardant solution high pressure injection coal seam using high-pressure pump, after retardant solution is sufficiently reacted with coal, by concordant drill in retardant solution extraction be discharged into high temperature slot, then to concordant drilling in circulation water filling with draw water, by concordant drill in heat discharge.By the high pressure pressure injection high temperature retardant solution into coal bed drilling, active group of the retardant in high temperature and high pressure environment with coal surface is reacted.The present invention can significantly reduce the quantity of the active group on coal surface, further increase the resistance efficiency of retardant, effectively prevent the generation of coal spontaneous combustion disaster, have wide applicability in the art.

title_en: Tunnel drainage Optimized System Design method is worn under city based on hydraulic model
abstract_en: The invention discloses wear tunnel drainage Optimized System Design method under a kind of city based on hydraulic model：Determine high area and low area's catchment area；High area's high accuracy DEM model is established, low area DEM accurate model is established；Two-dimentional hydraulic model is established；To discharge outlet safety evaluation；Tunnel drainage Optimized System Design.The advantage of the invention is that being fitted using profile of road, the high area DEM model of elevational point encryption technology building high-precision, simultaneously using the genuine accurate DEM model of BIM technology building, the accuracy of two-dimentional overland flow simulation has been significantly greatly increased, tunnel drainage System drainage whole process is worn under by two-dimentional hydraulic model to simulate, it is arranged by different operating conditions, it can determine optimal tunnel drainage system conditions, pass through two-dimentional dynamic analog, the high area of the reflection of system and area drain running situation, by hydraulic model check result feedback to tunnel drainage system design scheme, the science and safety of the design of tunnel drainage system can be improved, improve urban waterlogging Disaster Defense Capability.
assignees: SHANGHAI URBAN CONSTR DESIGN RES INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Optimal path selection system for immersive virtual reality disaster survival rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optimal path selection system for immersive virtual reality disaster survival rescue, which comprises a positioning tracking unit, a negative factor unit, a scene model unit, a path node unit, an artificial intelligence unit, a voice unit, a database unit, a network unit and a three-dimensional engine unit. The selection system is provided with a training platform, the training platform comprises an accident scene selection module and a function module, the function module is divided into a theoretical part and an actual combat part, the theoretical part comprises a perception cognition module and a teaching module, and the actual combat part comprises a simulation exercise module and an examination module. The virtual reality technology and the artificial intelligence are combined to simulate a real disaster scene, the immersive virtual reality technology is used for enabling participants to really feel the nervous atmosphere of a disaster site, and the sensing cognition module, the teaching module, the simulation exercise module and the assessment module are used for carrying out escape training on students, so that the survival rate of the site personnel during disaster outbreak is improved.

title_en: The device that insulator is corroded for simulated environment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of device corroded for simulated environment to insulator, which includes：Chamber；The illumination mechanism being set in chamber, for carrying out the simulation of light environment to the insulator to be measured hung in chamber；The simulation rain making mechanism being set in chamber, is set to the top of insulator to be measured, for carrying out liquid spray to insulator to be measured；The temperature and humidity adjustment mechanism being set in chamber, for adjusting the epidemic disaster in chamber；The salt fog generator being set in chamber, is set to the lower section of insulator to be measured, for carrying out salt mist spray to insulator to be measured.The present invention, which treats to survey insulator and carry out environmental simulation in natural environment by illumination mechanism, simulation rain making mechanism, temperature and humidity adjustment mechanism, salt fog generator, to be included illumination, drenches with rain, the simulation of temperature, humidity, salt fog state, and more accurately analysis insulator is chronically at the agings of adverse circumstances, corrosion condition and counts more accurate data.

title_en: A kind of power grid Rainfall Disaster Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the meteorological disaster technical field of electric system, a kind of power grid Rainfall Disaster Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium are disclosed；To mitigate the Rainfall Disaster that transmission line of electricity is subjected to, ability and the safe and stable operation for improving transmission line of electricity reply Rainfall Disaster are horizontal, achieve the purpose that initiative is strong, degree of intelligence is high, have a wide range of application；The present invention initializes the parameter value of limited Boltzmann machine algorithm according to training sample data collection, repetition learning and undated parameter value, the convergence for meeting training sample data collection to limited Boltzmann machine algorithm verifies the precision of prediction E of limited Boltzmann machine algorithm by verifying sample data set avg If precision of prediction E avg It is not presetting within precision, is then continuing undated parameter, until meeting precision of prediction；The power grid Rainfall Disaster prediction model based on back-propagation algorithm is further established, is finally adjusted according to parameter of the back-propagation algorithm to power grid Rainfall Disaster prediction model, and obtain Rainfall Disaster risk forecast model.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;DISASTER PREVENTION DISASTER MITIGATION CENTER OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of vertical physical model and test method for wearing Landslide Hazards of oil-gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Landslide Hazards to the vertical oil-gas pipeline pipeline damage imitative experimental appliance and test method for wearing arrangement.It includes five part of test model main body mechanism, rainfall mechanism and sampling mechanism, pipeline mechanism and load carrier that the oil-gas pipeline, which is indulged and wears Landslide Hazards physical model,.The present invention passes through the efficient cooperation of test model main body mechanism, rainfall mechanism, sampling mechanism, pipeline mechanism; change rainfall degree to influence the landslide state of slip mass; and then pipeline is simulated under different conditions by the destruction situation of slip mass; failure law of the vertical oil-gas pipeline for wearing arrangement under landslide disaster effect is obtained, so that the selection for the scene protection measure of oil-gas pipeline provides strong support.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;HEBEI BOLU TIANBAO PETROLEUM EQUIPMENT MFG COMPANY LIMITED

title_en: The water-retaining method of ground level directional drilling slip casting closure overlying strata water producing fractures main channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses the water-retaining methods that a kind of ground level directional drilling slip casting blocks overlying strata water producing fractures main channel, are suitable for coal mining fwaater resources protection and mine water disaster Prevention Technique field.The development characteristics information of mining overburden height of water flowing fractured zone under the specific mining conditions of tested region is obtained first, then determines that water flowing fractured zone links up the distribution that stratum water-bearing layer region corresponds to water producing fractures main channel in tested region according to development characteristics information；It finally determines the position of water producing fractures main channel and walks backward, drill from ground construction horizontal orientation and slip casting closure is carried out to water producing fractures main channel, to achieve the purpose that reduce crack water transmitting ability, protection groundwater resources.Its step is simple, and effect is reliable, practical.

title_en: Method and system for analyzing cascading failure risk of power system in lightning disaster weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to an analysis method and a system for cascading failure risks of a power system in lightning disaster weather, wherein the analysis method comprises the following steps: acquiring lightning information of 3 continuous time periods according to the lightning monitoring and positioning system; identifying and dividing lightning partitions, determining the circle center coordinate and radius of each lightning partition, and determining the most possible moving path of the lightning partitions in different periods; predicting the number of lightning falling times and the information of each lightning partition in a future period of time; calculating the lightning trip probability of a line influenced by lightning disaster weather in the power system; simulating cascading failures caused by a disaster-stricken line; and calculating the risk of the cascading failure path and the cascading failure risk of the power system under the weather of the lightning disaster. The method can not only carry out real-time early warning on the cascading failure risk of the electric power system in the lightning disaster weather, but also be used for analyzing and comparing the influence of different operation strategies or different construction schemes on the risk of the electric power system in the lightning disaster weather.

title_en: Experience vehice system for fire fighting safety education
title_ko: 소방 안전교육 체험차량 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fire safety education experiencing vehicle system which enables a large number of experiential educations at one time and enables efficient experience training by changing a structure of the vehicle on which a training system is mounted on a structure suitable for education and training. The system of the present invention comprises: a mobile vehicle; an earthquake experience device; a side monitor device; a monitor storing unit; a monitor storing and taking-out device; and a training control system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 훈련 시스템이 탑재되는 차량의 구조를 교육 훈련에 적합한 구조로 변경하여 한 번에 많은 수의 체험 교육이 가능하고, 효율적인 체험 교육을 수행할 수 있도록 한 소방안전교육 체험차량 시스템을 제공하기 위한 것이다.

title_en: Experience vehice system for fire fighting safety education
title_ko: 소방 안전교육 체험차량 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fire safety education experiencing vehicle system which enables a large number of experiential educations at one time and enables efficient experience training by changing a structure of the vehicle on which a training system is mounted on a structure suitable for education and training. The system of the present invention comprises: a mobile vehicle; a loading box extension unit; an earthquake experience device; a plurality of monitor devices; and a training control system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 훈련 시스템이 탑재되는 차량의 구조를 교육 훈련에 적합한 구조로 변경하여 한 번에 많은 수의 체험 교육이 가능하고, 효율적인 체험 교육을 수행할 수 있도록 한 소방안전교육 체험차량 시스템을 제공하기 위한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of aircraft fire disaster simulation training equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to fire-fighting equipment technical fields, and in particular to a kind of aircraft fire disaster simulation training equipment, including groove body, ignition unit, support adjustment mechanism, trickling fire tube road, model fire tube road and grid pedal；Support adjustment mechanism is fixed on the bottom of groove body；Ignition unit is connect by flange with groove body；Trickling fire tube road and model fire tube road are fixed on groove body；Grid pedal is placed on groove body.The training equipment is designed to multichannel independent gas supply, the flame and intensity of different zones can be simulated respectively, after control valve is opened, propane gas is sprayed from the hole of transfer tube, combustion gas diffusion rises to liquid surface, it is ignited flame ignition on surface, appearance is as liquid fuel overflows and burns above liquid water.This equipment can be extended, kidney-yang for fire-fighting various models in kind, and fiery point accordingly, cooperation trickling fire training or individually training are arranged on fire-fighting mock-up.

title_en: Emergency alert
abstract_en: Described are systems and methods for providing instructions in response to an emergency. An emergency alert system may receive indication of an emergency situation in a building. In response, the emergency alert system may determine personalized emergency response instructions for an occupant of the building based on the location and type of emergency. The emergency alert system may present the personalized emergency response instructions to the occupant and monitor the progress of the occupant in following the instructions. Some aspects relate to performing emergency response drills and monitoring performance of occupants participating in drills.

title_en: Rescue training dummy
abstract_en: The outer skin of the rescue training dummy is configured by interknitting the strip members capable of being connected and released while changing the sizes of rings of the same. Thickness and length of the body part, the arms, and the legs of the dummy can be freely reproduced. With the single rescue training dummy, the rescue training dummy can be configured to have one of different figures, such as a figure of an adult, or a figure of a child. Within the internal space of the rescue training dummy, containers or the like as weight are arranged. Enclosing substances with one of different specific gravity within the containers or the like or changing the number and/or capacity of the containers or the like enables to adjust weight of the dummy Since a device generating sound or the like may be arranged within the dummy, listening information from disaster victims can be performed in the middle of training. Thus, it is possible to contribute toward carrying out training rich in various scenarios.

title_en: Led lighting system with disaster prevention detection and disaster prevention training function, and a method thereof
title_ko: 재난발생 사전 감지 및 재난훈련 기능이 구비된 led 조명 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an LED lighting system with a disaster detection and disaster prevention training function and a method thereof. More particularly, the LED lighting system includes a disaster detection and control device and an LED lighting unit including a plurality of sensors in each office (store) in a building or a predetermined area. It is possible to prevent the occurrence of disaster by analyzing the sensed data collected through the plurality of sensors using a data mining algorithm and a situation recognition analysis algorithm. It is possible to prevent damage caused by fire by generally blocking power when a disaster occurs. It is possible to conduct disaster evacuation drills and minimize casualties at the disaster by quickly evacuating people through the output color, the output light or the output pattern, or the sound output of an LED lighting unit according to a disaster training control signal, a disaster prevention control signal or a disaster occurrence control signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난발생 사전 감지 및 재난훈련 기능이 구비된 LED 조명 시스템, 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는, 빌딩 내부 또는 기설정된 구역 내의 각 사무실(상점)에 다수의 센서를 포함하는 재난감지 및 제어장치 및 LED 조명부를 구비하고, 데이터 마이닝 알고리즘 및 상황인식 분석 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 다수의 센서를 통해 수집된 감지 데이터를 분석함으로써, 사전에 재난발생을 예방할 수 있고, 재난발생시 통상전력을 차단함으로써, 화재로 인한 피해를 최소화할 수 있으며, 재난훈련 제어신호, 재난예방 제어신호 또는 재난발생 제어신호에 따라 상기 LED 조명부의 출력색, 출력광량 또는 출력패턴, 또는 사운드 출력을 통해 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 함으로써, 재난 대피훈련이 가능하고 재난발생시 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있는 재난발생 사전 감지 및 재난훈련 기능이 구비된 LED 조명 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Tsunami forecast method using numerical model and scenario database
title_ko: 수치모형 및 시나리오 데이터베이스를 이용한 지진해일 예측방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tsunami forecast method using a numerical model which can be named as a scientific interpolation for a natural disaster (SIND) to operate a numerical model by setting a reference point (10) in a sea area and assuming a virtual tidal wave under various conditions propagated from the reference point (10), to calculate only a simulation tsunami condition at the reference point (10) without performing a numerical simulation on the entire sea area and the entire terrestrial area when a tsunami actually occurs after building a boat swamped by waves in a terrestrial area calculated by each condition as a scenario database, and to extract the nearest boat swamped by waves from the scenario database by comparing the simulation tsunami condition with a virtual tidal wave condition or to interpolate the simulation tsunami condition to draw a boat swamped by waves as a method for drawing a forecast value based on previously built information without actually simulating a physical phenomenon for analyzing a natural disaster. According to the present invention, the method can predict flood damage to a target terrestrial area with considerable precision only by simulating a partial sea area without simulating the entire sea area and the entire territorial area, thereby promptly alerting and proactively responding to the tsunami when the tsunami occurs so as to reduce damage.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수치모형을 이용한 지진해일 예측방법에 관한 것으로, 해역내 기준점(10)을 설정하고, 기준점(10)에서 전파되는 다양한 조건의 가상해일을 상정하여 수치모형을 가동하며, 조건별로 산출된 육역내 침수선을 시나리오 데이터베이스로 구축한 후, 실제 지진해일 발생시 전체 해역 및 육역에 대한 수치모의를 수행하지 않고 기준점(10)에서의 모의해일 조건만을 산출하고, 이를 가상해일 조건과 대비하여, 가장 근접한 침수선을 시나리오 데이터베이스에서 인출하거나, 이를 보간하여 침수선을 도출하는 것으로, 자연재해를 해석함에 있어서, 물리적 현상을 실제 모의하지 않고, 기 구축된 정보를 기반으로 예측치를 도출하는 방식으로서, SIND(Scientific Interpolation for Natural Disaster)로 명명될 수 있다. 
본 발명을 통하여, 전체 해역 및 육역에 대한 모의 없이 일부 해역에 대한 모의만으로 경보 대상 육역의 침수 피해를 상당한 정밀도로 예측할 수 있으며, 이로써 지진해일 발생시 신속한 경보 및 사전 대처가 가능하여, 피해를 경감할 수 있다.
assignees: HONGIK UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIA COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Real-time route guidance system using public transportation information
title_ko: 대중교통 정보를 이용한 실시간 길안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time navigation system using public transportation information, capable of reducing a time required for reaching a destination. According to the present invention, the real-time navigation system using public transportation information comprises a user terminal and an information providing server. The user terminal comprises: a location setting unit to input departure and destination information; a route selection unit to select one or more pieces of route information reaching a destination, and to transmit a reservation request signal to reserve a ticket when an express bus, a train, and an airplane incapable of getting thereon in real-time are included in the route information; a navigation information popup unit to pop up location information and transit location information of mass transportation during moving to the destination; and a virtual reality (VR) interlocking unit interlocking with a VR substrate to realize output of pop-up or navigation information in the navigation information popup unit. The information providing server comprises: an optimal route providing unit to generate and transmit the route information about the shortest time, transit, and expense for reaching to the destination from a starting point, and to transmit a signal for using a taxi; a reservation processing unit to perform a reservation in accordance with transmission of the reservation request signal; an evacuation guide unit to provide location information about a hospital or a shelter when an emergency situation occurs in the current location of the user terminal; and a server control unit to transmit and receive the signal to and from the user terminal, and to control operation of all components of the information providing server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대중교통 정보를 이용한 실시간 길안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 출발지 정보 및 목적지 정보를 입력하는 위치 설정부와; 상기 목적지까지 도착하는 적어도 하나 이상의 경로 정보를 선택하고, 상기 경로정보에 실시간 탑승이 불가능한 고속버스, 기차, 비행기가 포함된 경우 이에 대한 예매가 가능하도록 예매 신청신호를 전송하는 경로 선택부와; 상기 목적지까지의 이동시 대중교통의 위치 정보 및 환승 위치 정보를 실시간 팝업하는 안내정보 팝업부와; VR 시스템과 연동하여 상기 안내정보 팝업부에서 출력되는 팝업이나, 상기 경로 정보의 출력이 이루어지도록 하는 VR 연동부;를 포함하는 사용자 단말; 및 대중교통 정보와 보행자 도로 정보를 병합하여 출발지에서 목적지까지 도착하기 위한 최단 시간, 최소환승, 최소 비용에 대한 경로 정보를 생성 및 전송하고, 택시 이용 여부에 대한 신호를 전송하는 최적 경로 제공부와; 상기 예매 신청신호의 전송 여부에 따라 예매를 수행하는 예매 처리부와; 상기 사용자 단말이 현재 위치에서 비상 상황이 발생하는 경우, 병원이나 대피소 위치 정보를 제공하는 대피 안내부와; 상기 사용자 단말과의 신호 송수신이 이루어지며, 정보 제공서버의 모든 구성요소들의 구동 여부를 제어하는 서버 제어부;로 이루어지는 정보 제공서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Mine earthquake disaster distinguishing and signal reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for distinguishing mine earthquake disasters and reconstructing signals, which comprises the following steps: receiving mine earthquake data from distributed mine earthquake monitoring nodes in a monitoring area through a high-speed Ethernet by utilizing an edge computing server; representing the mineral seismic data as a sparse matrix; training the sparse matrix through a multiple neural network model and judging a disaster result; and reconstructing the mine earthquake signal through an improved sparsity self-adaptive matching tracking algorithm. According to the invention, the mine earthquake monitoring and inversion method is combined with the deep learning technology, so that the influence of various interferences in the monitoring environment can be greatly reduced, the mine earthquake disaster discrimination and the original mine earthquake signal reconstruction precision are improved, and the inversion result is more accurate.

title_en: Experimental device and method for simulating influence of deep water geological disasters on pipe column strength
abstract_en: The invention relates to an experimental device and method for simulating influence of deep water geological disasters on the strength of a pipe column, which comprises an experimental box, wherein an experimental stratum is arranged in the experimental box, a simulated shaft is arranged in the center of the experimental stratum, the simulated shaft is provided with a pipe sleeve, a well head device and a shaft which are buried in the experimental stratum, a pipeline of the simulated shaft is connected with a pressure pump and a temperature control device, the experimental stratum is respectively connected with a pressure water pump for injecting water and a gas compressor for injecting gas into the experimental stratum through pipelines, the upper end of the shaft is provided with a vibration mechanism for driving the simulated shaft to vibrate, the vibration mechanism is provided with a clamping block clamped at the upper end part of the shaft, and a stress sheet for measuring the vibration. The method can truly simulate the influence of deep water 'three shallow' geological disasters on the strength of the shallow pipe sleeve and analyze the fatigue strength, and meanwhile, the deep water shallow pipe sleeve damage mechanism is obtained and preventive measures are provided through the analysis of experimental results.

title_en: A kind of formula and preparation method thereof of the dedicated antifatigue compound soup beverage of emergency disaster relief personnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of formulas and preparation method thereof of the dedicated antifatigue compound soup beverage of emergency disaster relief personnel, can be used for emergency disaster relief personnel and relieve fatigue and extend the antifatigue time.The soup particle is that main Raw material processing forms by hedgehog fungus extract, northern Chinese caterpillar Fungus extract, Inonotus obliquus extract, ginseng extract, Ganodernaa lucidum extract, Pleurotus nebrodensis extract, Pleurotus eryngii extract, wolfberry fruit extract maltodextrin.The present invention uses vacuum freeze-drying combination room temperature wet-granulation technique to obtain uniform solid particle first, then carries out tabletting and tablet is made.It not only can effectively avoid the destruction of active constituent in raw material, farthest retain its flavor, and facilitate preservation and eat.This product can be not only used for daily exercise person and extend the tired time, it can also be used to which emergency disaster relief personnel's is antifatigue.

title_en: A kind of fire disaster escaping drilling method based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to technical field of virtual reality, specifically a kind of fire disaster escaping drilling method based on virtual reality technology, this method uses VR glasses, and VR glasses include lens body and glasses band；It further include mobile phone, adjustment fixing plate and cleaning unit；Adjustment fixing plate and cleaning unit are equipped with inside the lens body；The number of the adjustment fixing plate is two pieces, and adjustment fixing plate is for being fixed mobile phone；The cleaning unit is symmetric along mobile phone, and cleaning unit is for clearing up mobile phone.Whether there is finger ring according to mobile phone, unit is adjusted, changes the height of adjustment fixing plate, so that clamping is fixed to mobile phone in adjustment fixing plate, avoid VR glasses from causing the shaking of mobile phone when shaking so that the content played relative to user sight and shift；Mobile phone is cleared up by clearing up unit simultaneously, the image quality of mobile phone is improved, to improve user experience.

title_en: Device and method for mounting geophone for monitoring microseism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for mounting a geophone for monitoring microseism, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and prevention, wherein the mounting device comprises a push disc, the middle part of the push disc is provided with a through hole, the top part of the push disc is connected with a connector, the inner wall of the connector is provided with an internal thread, and the connector is connected with an external thread at the lower end of a drill collar through the internal thread during mounting; the bottom of the pushing disc is connected with an ice block, the ice block is of a cylindrical structure, and the outer diameter of the ice block is smaller than that of the pushing disc; a concrete disc is iced in the ice block, the bottom of the concrete disc is connected with a detector and supporting legs, and the length of the supporting legs is larger than that of the detector. The invention also comprises an installation method of the detector, the detector can be stably installed at the bottom of the drill hole in time before the hole collapses, the coupling of the bottom of the detector and the rock mass is ensured, the signal-to-noise ratio of the acquired data is improved, and the device has a simple structure and is convenient to use.

title_en: Tunnel-side slope system experimental rig and method under simulated rainfall geological process
abstract_en: The invention discloses tunnel-side slope system experimental rigs and method under a kind of simulated rainfall geological process, it is characterized in that including artificial rainfall test system, ground water regime, uniform air bag loading system, model test box, geological process platform and test monitoring system；Subjects are placed in the bottom of the uniform air bag loading system, are further applied load by uniform air bag loading system to subjects；The subjects are located in model test box；The artificial rainfall test system is used for simulated rainfall, and water outlet is located on uniform air bag loading system；The geological process platform is located at the bottom of simulation test case.Advantageous effects of the invention: passing through the model test of the device, instability Mechanism under can reveal that tunnel-side slope system rainfall, seepage action of ground water, the earthquake the effects of and its under coupling provides effective foundation for the construction in tunnel, the preventing and reducing natural disasters of side slope, management, prediction.

title_en: Application-level double-active disaster recovery system of cooperative office system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application-level double-active disaster recovery system of a cooperative office system, which comprises: the two disaster recovery centers form a power grid cooperative office system, and the service change data of any one of the two disaster recovery centers is asynchronously copied to an opposite end according to different service data types; any end disaster recovery center system has full service logic and service data, and the capacity of carrying the whole network service after the system is switched is met. The invention can save the maintenance cost of the equipment by adopting a centralized disaster recovery center mode. Because the equipment is reduced, the energy consumption is reduced, the human resource cost is saved, the personnel training cost is reduced, and the disaster recovery management cost is reduced.

title_en: The dynamic isolation determination method for parameter of the easy spontaneous combustion goaf coupling disaster of high methane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of dynamic isolation determination method for parameter for being used for the easy spontaneous combustion goaf coupling disaster of high methane, simulate working face coal seam by numerical simulation of granular flow software first and excavate overall process, obtain the goaf rear porosity regularity of distribution；Obtained porosity parameter is imported into liquid numerical simulation software by compiling data communication program, realize be combineding with each other for two kinds of mature numerical simulation softwares, obtain include three-dimensional pore space rate goaf mathematical model, the numerical simulation for carrying out different mining period flow field in goaf distributions, realizes flow field in goaf and working face mining process dynamics coupling Simulation；By changing goaf model parameter in fluid simulation software, realizes and discontinuous isolated wall is manually set, adjust discontinuous isolated wall parameter, keep goaf oxygen concentration and gas density parameter intersection region minimum, goaf optimal isolation parameter is determined with this.

title_en: For determining the test device and test method of water filling cracks in coal seam internal water pressure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of for determining the test device and test method of water filling cracks in coal seam internal water pressure, belongs to pore water pressure the field of test technology.The technical issues of being unable to test which solve water pressure in water injecting drilling surrounding medium in the prior art.It includes mechanism for testing and indication mechanism, and the inlet opening of several different pore sizes is provided on shell, and cylindrical empty inside the housing is intracavitary to be provided with several partitions, and cavity is divided into several seal chambers by several partitions.The present invention matches the aperture for obtaining inlet opening by mechanism for testing with indication mechanism, using the aperture as intermediate quantity, the water pressure in coal-bed flooding drilling surrounding medium fissured structure is calculated according to the capillary aperture in washburn equation and the relationship between water pressure, to accurately quantitatively be calculated the water pressure inside the surrounding medium that drills during coal-bed flooding, its calculated result improves coal-bed flooding Integrate Natural Disasters Prevention effect and plays an important role for adjusting Coal Seam Infusion Parameter.

title_en: Multirobot disaster based on improved BP searches and rescues method for allocating tasks
abstract_en: The invention discloses the multirobot disasters based on improved BP to search and rescue method for allocating tasks.When auctioneer does not have enough abilities to complete current search and rescue task, the mode that the use of information of the task is broadcasted is distributed to bidder；Bidder responds according to oneself current state；If bidder is idle or can complete search and rescue task, is made to auctioneer and receive the corresponding of this task；Otherwise, bidder, which will not participate in, this time auctions；If auctioneer does not receive bid during entire auction, auction process terminates；Otherwise, these tender prices will be normalized in auctioneer, and then using improved BP, to treated, tender price is trained.The present invention can effectively be such that critical the wounded is preferentially given treatment to, and method has the robustness to robot fault.Computer Simulation demonstrates the training effect of improved BP.

title_en: Burst drilling method on a kind of homogeneous stickiness earth dam for emergency flood fighting rehearsal unrestrained top
abstract_en: It is overflow the invention discloses a kind of homogeneous stickiness earth dam for emergency flood fighting rehearsal and pushes up the drilling method that bursts.Based on a set of dam break model, including earth dam ontology made of being filled as cohesive soil, the earth dam ontology include upstream dam abutment, dam crest and downstream dam abutment, are equipped with the regulating gate for water level to be adjusted in model upstream；It is equipped with cavity layer in the downstream dam abutment bottom of earth dam ontology, fills silty sand ground in cavity layer.Burst model and its drilling method on a kind of homogeneous stickiness earth dam for the motor-driven rehearsal of speedily carrying out rescue work of flood control of the present invention unrestrained top, dam break section innovative design, realize the dam break simulation of " want to burst and just burst " under the conditions of low speed water, the technological difficulties for " wanting to burst " when solving previous model test, especially suitable for the displaying of water and soil coupling during the announcement and dam break of cohesive soil dam breaking mechanism under unrestrained top flow action, while being also equipped with the function that the professional contingent that speedily carries out rescue work motor-driven to flood control carries out the training of dam break disaster.

title_en: Building structure characteristic rapid extraction method and corresponding loss evaluation calculation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid extraction method of building structure characteristics and a corresponding loss evaluation calculation method, wherein the rapid extraction method comprises the steps of obtaining street view images and house structure characteristics corresponding to the street view images as training sets; carrying out deep learning-based house structural characteristic rapid extraction training by using the streetscape images in the training set to generate a house structural characteristic rapid extraction model; utilizing a house structure characteristic rapid extraction model to rapidly extract house structure characteristics of the data to be detected, and obtaining the house structure characteristics; the method can quickly and accurately extract the house structural characteristics, saves manpower, material resources and financial resources, and avoids the semantic gap existing in the traditional image processing method; the building structure loss evaluation calculation method can obtain total loss according to the extracted house structure characteristics, and further provides basis for the planning of disaster insurance rates and the determination of policy service.

title_en: A kind of glade disaster monitoring and method for early warning based on multi-source information data
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of glade disaster monitorings and method for early warning based on multi-source information data, it is monitored in conjunction with the satellite remote sensing images interpretation of different periods, moraine ridge Rock And Soil Penetration Signature and the glacier tongue gradient, glacier and glacier tongue distance, glacier and the displacement of moraine ridge away from glade, glade lake monitoring, weather and hydrologic condition, the numerical model based on above-mentioned multi-source information is established, and each ice-lake breach risk index is normalized, ice-lake breach possibility progress entry evaluation is carried out by intelligent algorithm.To the operating condition that disaster may occur, is calculated by numerical value and carry out ice-lake breach disaster simulation and advance of freshet analysis, and early warning is issued according to simulation calculated result, effectively to organize disaster relief mitigation.The present invention has merged a variety of research methods such as remote sensing image and Interpretation Technology, the hydrology and geology monitoring technology, intelligent algorithm and numerical simulation technology, has many advantages, such as to monitor active time length, can accurately monitor glade disasters danger index and accurate progress glade disaster alarm.
assignees: CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENT RES INST CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Slope stability mechanism study universal model pilot system under the conditions of more seepage flow
abstract_en: The present invention discloses slope stability mechanism study universal model pilot system under the conditions of a kind of more seepage flow, changes the lower seepage of slope classification induced for various Complex Water Environments, realizes different seepage flow conditions by designing three kinds of different boundaries in model equipment.Boundary 1 (rainer) can be used to the lower slope instability of simulated rainfall effect, boundary 2 (water feeding tank and porous glass plate) can be used to simulate side slope rear crack water-filling or rear fixed level change caused by side seepage unstability, boundary 3 (water filling space) can be used to simulate side slope bottom water level and rise or the caused seepage flow unstability from the bottom up of partial pressing's water effect.Three kinds of boundaries both can be used alone, and also can be combined with each other coupling and uses, and realize that various working preferably simulates the variation of side slope surrounding aqueous environment.It according to different Practical Project situations, is simulated by different operating conditions, provides reference to prevent and reduce natural disasters for slope stability.

title_en: Smoke generation control system for fire training with opening and closing for flame suppression
title_ko: 화염 억제를 위한 개폐부를 갖는 소방 훈련용 연기 발생 제어 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a smoke generation control system for firefighting training, which includes a combustion unit for generating a flame, a smoke discharge unit extended to the upper side of the combustion unit, a cover unit separately formed on the upper side of the smoke discharge unit, a ventilation unit for providing wind to the combustion unit, and a control unit for generating an incomplete combustion. The smoke discharge unit includes a plurality of opening and closing units to suppress the flame and discharge smoke. Accordingly, the present invention can perform training for quick evacuation and prevent an accident by suppressing the flame.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시에는, 화염을 발생시키는 연소부, 연소부의 상측으로 연장되는 연기송출부, 연기송출부의 상측에 이격되어 형성되는 덮개부, 연소부로 바람을 제공하는 송풍부, 송풍부를 제어하여 불완전 연소를 발생시키는 제어부를 포함하고, 연기송출부는 복수 개의 개폐부를 포함하여 화염을 억제하며 연기를 내보내는, 소방 훈련용 연기 발생 제어 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: 3D (three-dimensional) fire identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 3D fire identification method and a system. The method comprises the following steps: 1) constructing a virtual digital earth by using a virtual reality technology, and loading a three-dimensional scene in the virtual digital earth; 2) mapping the real-time image of the monitoring video to a three-dimensional space scene to realize the fusion of the monitoring video and the three-dimensional scene; 3) and carrying out diagnosis and analysis on the fire disaster on the monitoring video in the three-dimensional scene so as to find the fire disaster and alarm. Specifically, step 3) adopts a semantic division and semantic fusion method based on CNN characteristics to carry out fire diagnosis and analysis. The invention provides a multi-view, understandable and widely visible video multipoint fusion system for users, and can carry out fire analysis and alarm on the content in the video, thereby realizing emergency facilities for evacuation, evacuation and the like of commanders in real time and realizing visual remote emergency command.

title_en: Extremely frigid zones Mine Geological Disasters warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to extremely frigid zones Mine Geological Disasters monitoring alarm technical fields, more particularly to a kind of extremely frigid zones Mine Geological Disasters warning device, including the multipoint displacement meter being installed in mine slope drilling, and the displacement display instrument and integrated temperature-humidity signal transmitter being fixed on the base by vertical bar, the signal input part of the signal output end access displacement display instrument of multipoint displacement meter, integrated Temperature Humidity Sensor is arranged in the lower end of pedestal, it is displaced the signal input part of the signal output end access electric cabinet of display instrument and integrated temperature-humidity signal transmitter, the external acoustic-optic alarm of the signal output end of electric cabinet and control computer；Extremely frigid zones Mine Geological Disasters warning device structure described in the utility model is simple, is easily assembled to, low in cost, can many places install, when outwash temperature, humidity be higher than critical value, sedimentation and displacement be more than critical value, alarm will issue alarm signal, high reliablity.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of multifunctional interphones, including a host machine casing, host machine casing includes upper housing and the lower case assembled therewith, one piece of PCB circuit main board is set in host machine casing, the top of host machine casing has an interphone antenna, the intercommunication mould group on interphone antenna connection PCB circuit main board；A long distance laser indicator light is arranged side by side in the side of interphone antenna and a far lighting lamp, long distance laser indicator light and far lighting lamp pass through PCB circuit main board and control, and there is a hand generator on right side.Bottom has solar energy to rush battery plate, and there is led display screen in front；The utility model gathers multi -function in integral whole, in addition to being applicable in outdoor travel person, exploration, engineering and geological prospecting or measurement, army Gauss, outward bound training, forest or water conservancy inspection, it is more suitable for earthquake and the frequent area of disaster uses, when earthquake disaster occurs, the holder based on above functions this product must can increase significantly is searched and rescued successful probability.

title_en: Pipeline leakage early warning system and method based on Internet of things and BIM and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline leakage early warning system and method based on the Internet of things and BIM and application thereof. Firstly, building a BIM model, endowing various entity attribute information such as pipelines, surrounding soil bodies, roadbeds and the like in the model, and obtaining a safety design value of each parameter through simulation deduction of analysis software; then, monitoring each entity in real time by using a sensor, and triggering an early warning signal if a monitored value exceeds a safety design value; finally, the danger is eliminated on the spot through accurate positioning. The invention has the following beneficial effects: the early warning information can be effectively issued in time, potential disaster points can be accurately positioned, and real-time monitoring and early warning of pipelines are realized.

title_en: A kind of initial fire disaster fighting drilling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of initial fire disaster fighting drilling systems, including wireless signal transmitting device and initial fire disaster fighting scenario simulation device, the wireless signal transmitting device include handle, magnet sensor, gyro sensor, wireless transmitter module and battery；The initial fire disaster fighting scenario simulation device includes main frame, display screen and the receiving end USB, the initial fire disaster fighting scenario simulation device includes main frame, display screen and the receiving end USB, host is separately connected display screen and the receiving end USB, initial fire disaster fighting drilling system principle of the present invention is concise, easy to use, the operating method of fire extinguisher, Electron fire extinguisher injecting time and true fire extinguisher use unanimously, and can show extinguishing chemical consumption variation when injection, simulation quality is strong.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of 3D oil tank emergency drilling simulation system and analogy methods, it includes tank system, alarm system, communication system, jury rig system, fire-fighting system, rescue system and emergent monitoring system, and the tank system is connect with alarm system and emergent monitoring system respectively；Described communication system one end is connect with alarm system, and the other end is connect with jury rig system；The jury rig system is connect with fire-fighting system and rescue system respectively.Live emergency operation when accident occurs for 3D oil tank emergency drilling system simulation oil of the present invention tank field, position is occurred by alarm system confirmation accident, communication system guarantees that each department contacts in time and adjusts live emergency plan at any time, support is provided by jury rig system for fire-fighting system and rescue system, monitor scene of the accident toxic and harmful gas and combustable gas concentration at any time by emergent monitoring system, for speedily carry out rescue work site disposal and expand warning evacuation foundation is provided.

title_en: A simulator
title_ko: 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: Disclosed is a simulator comprising: a passenger seat installed on a motion base; a motion base driving unit for driving the motion base by 16 degrees of freedom according to driving characteristics of a firefighting vehicle; an experience image providing monitor installed in front of the passenger seat to provide an experience image to be experienced by a passenger who gets on the passenger seat; a first display unit installed in front of the passenger seat to output and provide dashboard information for each model of a firefighting vehicle to be experienced; a second display unit installed around the first display unit to provide a PTO operation panel for each model of the firefighting vehicle to a screen; a model for selecting a model of the firefighting vehicle to be experienced by the passenger; a storage unit for storing simulation motion data for each model of the firefighting vehicle selected in the model, experience image information for each model of the firefighting vehicle, a modeling program to which a vehicle dynamic model with 16 degrees of freedom for each model of the firefighting vehicle is applied, and a modeling program to which a fluid dynamic function for implementing a change in vehicle driving characteristics according to a flow rate change of a firefighting vehicle having a water tank is added; and a control unit for controlling a simulation operation to be performed by executing the modeling program stored in the storage unit according to the model of the firefighting vehicle selected in the model, controlling dashboard information of the selected model to be outputted through the first display unit, and controlling a PTO operation panel of the selected model to be outputted through the second display unit.
abstract_ko: 모션베이스 상에 설치되는 탐승석과, 모션베이스를 소방차량 운행특성에 따라 16자유도 구동시키기 위한 모션 베이스 구동부와, 탑승석의 전방에 설치되어 탐승석에 탑승한 탐승자가 체험할 체험영상을 제공하는 체험영상 제공 모니터와, 탑승석 전방에 설치되어 체험할 소방차의 기종별 계기판 정보가 출력되어 제공되는 제1디스플레이부와, 제1디스플레이부 주변에 설치되어 소방차의 기종별 PTO 조작패널이 화명으로 제공되는 제2디스플레이부와, 탑승자가 체험할 소방차의 기종을 선택하기 위한 기종 와, 기종에서 선택된 소방차 기종별 시뮬레이션 모션데이터와, 소방차 기종별 체험 영상정보, 소방차 기종별 16자유도 차량동력학 모델을 적용한 모델링 프로그램과, 물탱크를 갖는 소방차량의 유량변화에 따른 차량운행 특성의 변화를 구현하기 위한 유체동력학 기능을 추가한 모델링 프로그램이 저장된 저장부 및, 기종 에서 선택된 소방차 기종에 따라 저장부에 저장된 모델링 프로그램을 실행하여 시뮬레이션 동작이 이루어지도록 제어하고, 제1디스플레이부를 통해 선택 기종의 계기판 정보가 출력되도록 하고, 제2디스플레이부를 통해 선택 기종의 PTO 조작패널이 출력되도록 제어하는 제어유닛을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 시뮬레이터가 개시된다.

title_en: Earthquake triggering underwater landslide disaster simulation test platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Earthquake triggering underwater landslide disaster simulation test platforms, it is made of shake table, sink, sedimentation basin, the vibration table of shake table and sink are connected as an entirety, in table vibration, sink will not vibrate therewith, landslide body Model only on vibration table vibrates therewith, then causes to destroy.Because water does not transmit shearing force, shake table size only needs to meet test model size, saves space and cost, is more avoided that the influence that ripples are turned back to experimental phenomena and test result.And the test method of sink is placed on a vibration table, it is difficult to eliminate the water disturbance generated because of sink wall vibrations, the water body of disturbance will form ripples of turning back and act on the body Model of landslide, and model is caused to destroy.

title_en: Dynamic emergency evacuation method for urban rail transit line failure
abstract_en: A dynamic emergency evacuation method for urban rail transit line failure relates to the technical field of rail transit control. The problem of the secondary propagation that leads to the fact the passenger flow is detained in the network to single station evacuation ability limited is solved. Establishing an attribute set and an operation state set of each station in a network; analyzing the passenger flow state of the station; using SAS software to predict subway passenger flow in short time, and simulating the passenger flow arrival process; determining an evacuation starting point and an evacuation finishing point; constructing an emergency state rail public transport collaborative evacuation network; constructing a path dynamic selection model in the end point range; determining an optimal evacuation path; determining the required number and the operation time interval of the emergency buses; determining the distribution rule of the passenger flow to be evacuated reaching the evacuation subway station; according to the rail transit train parameters, the train conveying capacity is determined, the subway station passenger flow is combined, the resource allocation is carried out on the train capacity, and a train operation scheme in an emergency state is formulated. The passenger flow evacuation capacity of a single node is increased, and the network evacuation efficiency is improved.

title_en: A kind of 3D refueling station fire incident emergency drilling simulation system and analogy method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of 3D refueling station fire incident emergency drilling simulation system and analogy methods, mainly solve the problems such as refueling station fire incident emergency training digitized degree is not high, scene fidelity is inadequate.The present invention is by using a kind of 3D refueling station fire incident emergency drilling simulation system and analogy method, user passes through network login system, realize refueling station fire incident emergency drilling and examination, wherein simulation system includes the virtual refueling station yard of 3D, accident setup module, monitoring module, emergency drilling module, examination evaluation module, and analogy method includes that equipment speedily carries out rescue work, guards against the fire incidents emergency drilling steps such as evacuation, personnel's relief.The present invention can be used for refueling station fire incident emergency drilling training, improve employee to fire incident emergency capability.

title_en: Structural loads couple environmental simulation laboratory with weather
abstract_en: The present invention relates to armored concrete experimental apparatus for capability technical fields, are related to structural loads and couple environmental simulation laboratory, including control system, laboratory cabin, mechanical simulation component and natural environment simulation system with weather；Actual weather can be simulated by mechanical simulation component and natural environment simulation system and couples environment, while simulating mechanics and repeating loading effect, by controlling the height epidemic disaster of environment, wind speed, drenching with rain, snowfall, salt fog, ultraviolet radioactive, CO 2 Gas simulates Practical Project environment.Load, corrosion ratio, the durable change process of armored concrete experimental piece are detected in experimentation, research armored concrete couples the gradual destruction mechanism under environment and repeated load effect in weather, provides basic data for theoretical research and engineering practice.
