title_en: Wireless transmitting-receiving equipments for fire-fighting simulated training
abstract_en: The present invention is provided to the wireless transmitting-receiving equipments of fire-fighting simulated training, including the first digital handheld radio station, lithium battery power supply B and the second digital handheld radio station；First digital handheld radio station rear end face is stained with one piece of training detection shell.In the training of fire-fighting analog wireless communication, the firefighters of simulated training hold the first digital handheld radio station to the environmental area stayed alone at one, and fire service instructor then exists together with terminal containing box an environmental area with the firefighters in hand-held first digital handheld radio station nearby, fire service instructor passes through the remote control terminal shell in touching manipulation terminal containing box, to issue instruction, first microprocessor successively transfers starting training detection group according to instruction in order in the training detection shell for adhering to the first digital handheld radio station rear end face, to guarantee in all directions trained operation is communicated wirelessly to firefighters, to guarantee in practical fire-fighting wireless telecommunications, it is not in hiatus, call such as does not make a sound at the fatal errors.

title_en: Mine ventilation system anti-disaster ability evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mine ventilation system anti-disaster ability evaluation method and devices, by obtaining mine ventilation system in the evaluation of estimate of each bottom evaluation index, using the evaluation of estimate of each bottom evaluation index as the input of BP neural network, obtain the anti-disaster ability grade of the mine ventilation system of BP neural network output, wherein, BP neural network is to construct using the different evaluation value of each bottom evaluation index and its corresponding anti-disaster ability grade as sample set by deep learning training.In this programme, by constructing the evaluation model based on BP neural network, overall merit and prediction are carried out to the anti-disaster ability of catastrophe period mine ventilation system, the evaluation method operability is stronger, theoretical foundation is provided to improve reliability, stability and its adaptability to changes of catastrophe period mine ventilation system, it can be further improved the overall support capability of catastrophe period mine ventilation system, to reduce the casualty loss of catastrophe period personnel.
assignees: PINGAN COAL MINING EXPLOITATION ENGINEERING TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV INNER MONGOLIA SCI & TECH;HUAINAN MINING INDUSTRY GROUP

title_en: The classification method of security fields patent text
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of classification methods of security fields patent text, the invention proposes a kind of classification methods of security fields patent text, method includes the following steps: step 1, during Text Pretreatment, the word frequently occurred in patent text is added and deactivates vocabulary, to save memory space, recall precision is improved；Step 2 introduces the Word2Vec model of pre-training, solves the problems, such as dimension disaster caused by conventional method；Step 3 extracts text feature by training shot and long term memory network (Long Short-Term Memory, LSTM) disaggregated model, carries out the classification of security fields patent text；Step 4 assesses classification results using accuracy rate and ROC curve evaluation model.Test proves that: using this method can the patent text preferably to security fields classify, 50,000 patent texts are trained and are tested, the accuracy rate of test set reaches 93.48%.

title_en: Water-rich tunnel karst cave treatment and excavation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a water-rich tunnel karst cave treatment and excavation method, and belongs to the technical field of tunnel engineering construction. According to the method, a diversion tunnel is drilled laterally in the tunnel, a diversion water-stop device is arranged on the side face of the diversion tunnel to conduct diversion and drainage, and grouting anchor rods are arranged to conduct grouting anchoring operation, so that the problem that water gushing and collapse disasters are easily formed when the existing water-rich tunnel meets a karst cave in the excavation process is solved. The method improves the traditional double-side-wall pilot tunnel excavation mode, adopts the improved double-side-wall pilot tunnel method to carry out tunnel excavation construction, is mainly applied to excavation of the water-rich tunnel meeting the karst cave, and effectively solves the problem of water burst collapse of the water-rich tunnel karst cave.

title_en: System for fire fighting education of augmented reality incuding fire extinguisher for education and terminal for driving augmented reality

The fire extinguisher generates operation information in response to user operation. The augmented driving terminal encourages a user′s interest in learning and increases the degree of immersion in the firefighting education by reflecting the operation information on an educational augmented reality simulation image including at least one of a motion tutorial and a step-by-step mission game.

title_en: Multifunctional simulation experiment table for researching spontaneous combustion characteristics of residual coal under action of multiple disaster sources of deep well
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional simulation experiment table for researching spontaneous combustion characteristics of residual coal under the action of multiple disaster sources of a deep well, and relates to the technical field of mine safety engineering. The simulation experiment table comprises a stope structure simulation system, a gas emission control system, a heating control system, a ventilation control system, a deep well mine pressure control system, a data information acquisition and analysis system and a central main control system; the stope structure simulation system is used for simulating the space structure of a stope; the gas emission control system is used for controlling gas emission; the heating control system is used for simulating the geothermal energy of a stope and heating the residual coal in the goaf; the ventilation control system is used for providing wind flow for the simulation stope; the deep well mine pressure control system is used for simulating the pressure of a top plate of a goaf; the multifunctional simulation experiment table for researching the spontaneous combustion characteristic of the residual coal under the action of multiple disaster sources of the deep well, provided by the invention, has the advantages that the simulated spontaneous combustion process of the residual coal in the goaf is high in conformity with the real situation, and the research conclusion and the result are real and reliable.

title_en: A kind of lamp shaking apparatus for demonstrating for simulating earthquake scene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of lamps for simulating earthquake scene to shake apparatus for demonstrating, including fixing seat, mounting plate, swing arm unit, pendent lamp component and installation foot, installation casing is installed at the top of the mounting plate, and fixed column is installed on the mounting plate of installation casing two sides, fixing seat is installed at the top of the fixed column, and there is suspension strop in the top system of fixing seat, the first armed lever is installed on the installation screw rod, and first the bottom of armed lever swing arm unit is installed, the bottom of the swing arm unit is equipped with the second armed lever, and second the bottom end of armed lever pendent lamp component is installed.The utility model is designed reasonably, structure is simple, the speed regulating motor and transmission component of setting, power can be transmitted to movable component, so that swing arm unit upper arm is done horizontal swinging arm movement, swung between the lower arm and upper arm of swing arm unit, pendent lamp component is also and then swung, the type for enriching seismic popular science showpiece fills up showpiece exhibition item vacancy, and the protection against and mitigation of earthquake disasters consciousness of spectators can be improved.

title_en: A kind of fork pipelines gas explosion experimental simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model is a kind of fork pipelines gas explosion experimental simulation device.Belong to Gas Disaster prevention and control field, and in particular to a kind of fork pipelines gas explosion experimental simulation device.Mainly there are air flap, square flange, straight tube, threeway bifurcated pipe, outlet baffle, rubber seal, embedding nut to constitute.Device is made of transparent organic glass, and sealing installation ion probe, thermocouple and pressure sensor, whole system are tightly connected on the measured hole of straight tube；Open venthole, configured methane gas is filled with system by aeration aperture, after detecting that system gas density is stablized with gas detector, closes charge valve, respectively in four different ignition location igniting, observation and analysis explosive flame propagation characteristic in threeway fork pipelines；The fork angle of threeway bifurcated pipe can make according to practical tunnel angle, make experimental provision more similar to reality；Straight tube can be used with the repeatable connection of the threeway bifurcated pipe of different angle.The set fork pipelines gas explosion experimental simulation device compensates for vacancy of the gas explosion experiment without bifurcated pipe, and structure is simple, more similar to downhole branching tunnel, has stronger innovation and practicality.

title_en: A kind of tunnel ventilation smoke evacuation experiment simulator that crosses of ring road direction-agile
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of tunnel ventilation smoke evacuation experiment simulators that crosses of ring road direction-agile, simulator includes fire source device, tunnel environment measuring device, ventilation and exhaust device, smoke movement observation device, the variable tunnel that crosses includes a main tunnel and branch's loop tunnel, it is attached by the ring road of direction-agile, is equipped with evacuating personnel door in the apparatus and simulates the fire source device of tunnel automobile fire；Axial flow blower and jet blower are equipped in main tunnel, the outer wall along main length of tunnel direction is equipped with observation window；Jet blower is equipped in branch's loop tunnel, the outer wall along branch's loop length of tunnel direction is equipped with observation window；The connection ring road in main tunnel and branch's loop tunnel can adjust turn direction according to test demand, cross tunnel Characteristics of Fire Smoke Movement and ventilation smoke exhaust effect can be simulated by having the technical effect that, provide experimental study platform for the similar tunnel fire disaster fume characteristics of motion and Smoke control system design.

title_en: Wave detector mounting device and mounting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detector mounting device and a mounting method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and prevention, wherein the mounting device comprises a pushing disc, the middle part of the pushing disc is provided with a through hole, the top of the pushing disc is connected with a connector, the bottom of the pushing disc is provided with an electric heating pipe, a connecting rod and a spring, the lower end of the connecting rod is connected with a lower wiring terminal, the lower end of the spring is connected with an upper wiring terminal, the lower wiring terminal is contacted with the upper wiring terminal, the electric heating pipe, the lower wiring terminal and the upper wiring terminal are sequentially connected in series through a power line, the pushing disc is connected with an ice block, and the electric heating pipe, the connecting rod. The invention also comprises an installation method of the detector, the detector can be stably installed at the bottom of the drill hole in time before the hole collapses, the coupling of the bottom of the detector and the rock mass is ensured, the signal-to-noise ratio of the acquired data is improved, and the device has a simple structure and is convenient to use.
assignees: CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES;CHONGQING JIZHI CHUANGXIANG IND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: The appraisal procedure of tangent tower stress risk
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of appraisal procedure of tangent tower stress risk, including: modeling procedure carries out finite element dynamics modeling to the tangent tower of transmission line of electricity, obtains the 3-D geometric model of tower line Fourier Series expansion technique；Step is calculated, is calculated separately under different ice covering thickness and different wind speed, a variety of extraneous loads of tangent tower；Simulation process is emulated by applying a variety of extraneous loads based on the 3-D geometric model of the tower line Fourier Series expansion technique, is obtained multiple simulation results；Appraisal procedure obtains the assessment result of stress risk according to the multiple simulation result.The present invention can determine whether degree of risk of the tangent tower in icing, and then obtain mechanical characteristic of the tangent tower when icing disaster occurs under by extraneous load action, when take ice-melt to provide important reference value for operation power department, solves the problems, such as more difficult using score analysis process in the prior art.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;SHAOGUAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: A kind of colliery scene coal sample gas pot
abstract_en: Technical problem to be solved in the utility model is to improve the generation of coal mine gas grade evaluation method and prevention and control Gas Disaster.A kind of colliery scene coal sample gas pot, it is characterized in that including air valve, coal sample lid, coal sample cap bore mouth, heading, hand drill, sampling drilling rod, airline hose, measuring instrument, top spiral, coal sample tank, lower part helical, mucilage binding part, coal sample cylinder, mucilage binding gasket, the coal sample lid is that spiral is connect with jar, and coal sample lid connect composition coal sample tank with jar；The air valve is fixed on airline hose close to coal sample caping end side, and airline hose one end is connected with coal sample caping end, and the other end is connected with measuring instrument；The top spiral is located at coal sample base end, and lower part helical is located at coal sample cylinder top, and the width of top spiral is greater than the height of coal sample cap bore mouth.Have the function of that gas is greatly lowered and overflows dissipate, simplify procedures, reducing equipment loss, there is basic meaning for the correct evaluation and the prevention and control of Gas Disaster of coal mine gas grade.

title_en: The triaxial test equipment of grogs is corroded in a kind of lower measurement of seepage force effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of seepage forces to act on the triaxial test equipment that grogs is corroded in lower measurement, including triaxial pressure system, constant flow osmotic system and seepage inflow erosion grogs measure system；The triaxial pressure system includes triaxial cell；The triaxial cell includes pressure chamber's outer cover, pedestal, Porous Base and upper cover, pressure chamber's outer cover is mounted on the base, the Porous Base is set on pedestal and is located in pressure chamber's outer cover, the upper cover is set to above Porous Base and is located in pressure chamber's outer cover, it is provided with soil sample between upper cover and Porous Base, grogs flow pass is offered on the pedestal.The utility model measures system by setting triaxial pressure system and seepage inflow erosion grogs, ground the sample simulation of erosion and dynamic under seepage force effect is realized to observe, the limitation of soil sample seepage inflow erosion phenomenon can not dynamically be observed by breaching traditional three axle systems, cause calamity mechanism study to provide accurate, effective basic data for the corresponding geological disaster of erosion.

title_en: Mine water disaster relief wellbore bottom hole air pressure maintaining ventilation equipment and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of pressure maintaining ventilation equipment and methods, belong to mine drilling technical field, and in particular to a kind of mine water disaster relief wellbore air pressure maintaining ventilation equipment and method.This method and equipment can solve the leakage problem at any position that drills, and can reliably guarantee that the space of personnel in the pit will not reduce or disappear because of air leakage, it can be ensured that the living space of mine indicator of trapped personnel leads to oxygen deficit problem because of atmosphere draught-free.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Landslide disaster prediction method based on improved Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard prediction method based on an improved Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a landslide body monitoring and early warning system, acquiring initial landslide hazard impact factor data, carrying out standardization processing, extracting by using a PCA algorithm, and screening out main impact factors; dividing the screened main influence factor sample data into a training sample set and a test sample set according to a proportion, and dividing a landslide occurrence grade; then, a landslide prediction model based on improved Bayes is constructed, the landslide occurrence probability after the feature quantity is introduced is calculated through weighting processing, and a closed-loop learning process is added to complete landslide disaster prediction; the method disclosed by the invention is used for weighting the characteristic quantity and outputting the landslide occurrence probability by screening the main influence factors of landslide disasters in an improved Bayes model and adding a closed-loop learning link, so that the fault tolerance rate is increased, and the forecasting precision is improved.

title_en: Evacuation route navigation system based on toxic gas diffusion influence
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evacuation path navigation system based on toxic gas diffusion influence, which comprises a toxic gas leakage data acquisition terminal, a toxic gas diffusion simulation calculation module, an evacuation path calculation module, a path navigation terminal and an information transmission module. The toxic gas leakage data acquisition terminal transmits the acquired toxic gas related data to the toxic gas diffusion analog computation module for resolving, determines an optimal evacuation path from the set point to the placement point, and transmits the optimal evacuation path to the path navigation display terminal, so that the safe and efficient evacuation of people is assisted. The evacuation path navigation system considers the disaster risk and the change of the path, can provide dynamic transfer path decision support for the transfer of the disaster-stricken people, reduces the disaster risk and casualties of people, and avoids blind transfer and disordered evacuation.

title_en: Device and method for testing collapse resistance of fire lower beam-slab structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for testing collapse resistance of a beam-slab structure under a fire disaster, wherein the beam-slab structure in a reinforced concrete frame structure is taken as a research object and is installed on a fire disaster test furnace. In the process of testing the collapse resistance of the structure, corresponding boundary conditions are set for simulating the constraint conditions of the reinforced concrete beam-slab structure and the peripheral structure in the actual structure, and uniform load is applied to the surface of a floor slab at the upper part of the structure, so that the displacement, crack development, in-slab reinforcement stress condition, damage mode and the like of key parts in the reinforced concrete beam-slab structure are observed and recorded, and the continuous collapse resistance of the structure is fully mastered. The device and the method for testing the collapse resistance of the fire disaster underbeam-slab structure can measure the fire resistance limit and the limit bearing capacity of the structure, so that the continuous collapse resistance of the frame structure under the fire disaster can be mastered, and a basis is provided for establishing a corresponding fire resistance design method.

title_en: A kind of video outdoor fire disaster smog real-time detection method based on convolutional neural networks
abstract_en: The invention proposes a kind of video outdoor fire disaster smog real-time detection method based on convolutional neural networks.The present invention collects smog image data set by experiment analog form and creates training set, test set and verifying collection；Automatic marking combination is carried out to training set, test set and verifying collection respectively to manually adjust, and respectively obtains the training set with true tag, test set and verifying collection；To the training set with true tag and verifying collection carry out image rotation processing, Color Channel plus-minus color processing, scaling processing handle after the training set with true tag, verifying collect；Convolutional neural networks parameter is initialized, according to the established convolutional neural networks model of training set training after scaling processing with true tag；Monitored picture image in field to be detected is acquired in real time, by convolutional neural networks model prediction smoke target detection block after training and is optimized；The enhancing of interframe confidence level and reorientation are carried out on the object detection results that convolutional neural networks model provides after training.

title_en: One-hole multipurpose construction method for treating impact and gas disaster of deep-buried coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a one-hole multipurpose construction method for treating impact and gas disasters of a deep-buried coal seam, which comprises the following steps of: determining the distance between drill holes, drilling construction, determining the actual stress concentration zone, drilling hole plugging and gas extraction, fully releasing pressure of a coal bed and injecting water at high pressure. Preferably, the plugging is the first plugging by using an expansion capsule, and the second complete drilling plugging is carried out by using a sealing agent after the coal bed is fully decompressed. The invention can realize the simultaneous treatment of rock burst and gas disaster of a deep-buried coal seam, and efficiently realizes the purposes of one hole with multiple purposes, cost reduction and efficiency improvement by adopting the process links of reasonably determining the distance between drill holes and the length of the drill holes, drilling and pressure relief of a working surface, plugging of two drill holes, gas extraction, water injection and the like. The method is simple and easy to operate, can fully utilize various effects of drilling, and avoids the repeatability and the waste of drilling construction in the prior art.

title_en: Network based reunification management using portable devices
abstract_en: Computing device(s) are configured for managing the reunification of students with parents during an emergency or a drill for a simulated emergency. The reunification of students with guardians may be managed through the operations of various user interfaces (UIs) presented on the device(s). Different UIs may be configured to support different personnel performing different roles in the reunification process. The UIs may include one or more of a student supervisor UI, a location supervisor UI, a runner UI, a guardian greeter UI, a reunification officer UI, or an incident commander UI. The various UIs enable different personnel to track the location and status of individuals, such as students and guardians, during various stages of a reunification process, enable personnel to dynamically update a centralized database with current information regarding the location and status of individuals, and view real time information regarding the location and status of individuals.

title_en: A kind of fire image deep learning mode identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire image deep learning mode identification methods, comprising the following steps: pre-processes to the test sample and training sample of fire image；Design is based on improved GoogleNet deep learning network, main to allow network to automatically extract feature to exclude artificial trace by training；Using further feature training classifier and fire test sample is identified.Image Multiscale convolution converged network is applied in fire image mode identification technology by the present invention, the training effectiveness of network is significantly improved, the precision encountered in method for recognizing fire disaster is efficiently solved and real-time is not ideal enough, the complicated network structure and training time is long and stability and the problems such as poor robustness.Trained network reaches 99.2% in 3 class fire image accuracy of identification.

title_en: Landslide disaster forecasting method based on deep belief network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster forecasting method based on a deep belief network, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a landslide body monitoring and early warning system, collecting a large number of disaster-inducing factors, screening by using an MIV algorithm, and screening out main disaster-inducing factors; carrying out a standardization process on the screened disaster inducing factors, and dividing the disaster inducing factors into a test sample and a training sample according to a specific proportion; then, constructing a landslide hazard forecasting model based on a deep belief network, and setting the landslide hazard forecasting model into a structure consisting of two layers of RBMs and three layers of BP networks; pre-training the RBM by adopting a CD algorithm, and updating network parameters; a genetic algorithm is adopted to supervise, train and learn, and ensure that the DBN network is optimal as a whole; and finally, reconstructing the optimized landslide hazard forecast model, carrying out landslide grade division on the output result, and forecasting the landslide occurrence probability. The method disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the convergence speed is accelerated by extracting the characteristic disaster inducing factors, the situation that the landslide disaster is locally optimal is prevented, and the landslide disaster forecasting precision is improved.

title_en: The Posterior probability distribution calculation method and system of power grid mountain fire disaster failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses the Posterior probability distribution calculation methods and system of a kind of power grid mountain fire disaster failure, this method comprises: counting transmission line forest fire Tripping data under different mountain fire hazardous conditions；Analyze the key element of transmission line malfunction and the quantitative relation of mountain fire tripping；Construct the Failure probability distribution function of transmission line of electricity relevant to multiple Failure probability distribution parameters；The prior probability distribution of each Failure probability distribution parameter is obtained, the independent random number that extracts in prior probability distribution is repeated and is verified with training pattern；And iteration is steady to model；The Posterior probability distribution of power grid mountain fire disaster failure is calculated as sample in multiple groups random number after modulus type is steady.The present invention can quickly obtain transmission line forest fire probability of malfunction Posterior distrbutionp；There is important guiding effect to power grid risk analysis under a wide range of mountain fire disaster.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Wheat drought identification method based on image deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of recognition of wheat abiotic stress, in particular to a wheat drought recognition method. The method comprises the following identification steps: a) performing a wheat drought control test in a greenhouse by adopting a pot experiment method, wherein the drought grades are proper, light drought, medium drought, heavy drought and extra drought; b) continuously acquiring wheat images of different drought levels by using a single lens reflex camera, labeling the wheat images, and randomly dividing a data set into a training set and a testing set; c) extracting image features by using convolution operations of deep convolution network models increment _ V3, Resnet _50 and Resnet _152 which are pre-trained on ImageNet, and training a final classification layer; d) and testing the trained deep learning network by using a test set, and respectively representing the drought stress identification and grading precision by using the drought stress identification accuracy DSI and the drought stress grading accuracy DSC. The method extracts the phenotype characteristics of the wheat by acquiring the digital image of the wheat and utilizing a deep learning method, and identifies and grades drought stress based on a disaster bearing body, so that the method is timely, accurate and lossless, and obtains higher accuracy.

title_en: Typical earthquake disaster information extraction algorithm based on the detection of super-pixel region similitude
abstract_en: The invention discloses the typical earthquake disaster information extraction algorithms detected based on super-pixel region similitude, comprising the following steps: a, divides to obtain super-pixel to original remote sensing image using simple linear Iterative Clustering；B, conspicuousness detection is carried out to the super-pixel that step a is obtained using vision significance algorithm, obtains significant super-pixel；C, the significant super-pixel that amendment step b is obtained, the training sample extracted as well-marked target；D, the feature vector subset of super-pixel and the feature vector subset of training sample are constructed respectively；E, according to characteristics of image to the descriptive power of target, stratification processing is carried out to feature vector subset；F, it is detected by multi-level Regional Similarity, successively time calculate super-pixel respectively is subordinate to angle value to training sample；G, it is subordinate to angle value according to what step f was obtained, calculates degree of membership threshold value using adaptive threshold Da-Jin algorithm, the super-pixel for being less than the degree of membership threshold value is rejected, to finally obtain objective result.

title_en: A kind of Rescue Plan simulative training system based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Rescue Plan simulative training system based on virtual reality, comprising: virtual product model module carries out disaster environment, periphery fire fighting device information simulation for constructing three-dimensional virtual scene model；Forecasting edited module carries out forecasting edited in virtual scene and constitutes prediction scheme database for combining constructed three-dimensional virtual scene model；Prediction scheme memory module, for storing the prediction scheme database；Data input module, for receiving and saving the current event information of user's typing；Prediction scheme extraction module, for being retrieved in prediction scheme database according to the current event information and the matched at least one set of emergency preplan of the current event；Prediction scheme disposes module, for carrying out prediction scheme disposition according to the emergency preplan.Rescue Plan simulative training system experience sense provided by the invention based on virtual reality is strong, is conducive to the specific aim and validity that improve fire drill.

title_en: A method of the simulation test device of research reinforcing side slope effect and determining slope reinforcement scheme
abstract_en: The present invention provides the simulation test devices that slip mass effect is reinforced in a kind of research, it is related to geological disaster modeling techniques field, for lateral interim water supply chamber, external water feeding tank and model casing, not only stable side seepage height of water level can be provided to simulation side slope, seepage flow can also be recorded to the water in simulation side slope by flowmeter, seepage flow is to the water size in simulation side slope, time to rupture and failure mode convenient for judgement simulation slope reinforcement effect before being destroyed by record.Also, simulation test device provided by the invention is simple, good airproof performance, and operation is easy.

title_en: A kind of the crowd behaviour emulation mode and system of the guidance of safe escape mark
abstract_en: The invention discloses the crowd behaviour emulation modes and system of a kind of guidance of safe escape mark.Wherein this method comprises: three-dimensional building object model of the creation to simulating scenes；It determines in three-dimensional building object model and to the corresponding export volume of simulating scenes and outlet port；It marks in three-dimensional building object model and to the corresponding safe escape mark position of simulating scenes；According to export volume, outlet port and safe escape mark position, the road sign point in three-dimensional building object model is preset, and then generate using PRM algorithm and evacuate available all paths, and extra exit is planned that the path tag in direction is regulation unidirectional path；Path beyond extra exit planning direction, labeled as the unidirectional path by extroversion outlet；Import the characteristic of initialization evacuation crowd；Dijkstra's algorithm is used to search out most short best-effort path from regulation unidirectional path for the individual of evacuation crowd；During evacuating crowd movement, crowd evacuation is emulated using RVO Robot dodge strategy.

title_en: A kind of coupling advance of freshet and the modeling of crowd evacuation and analogy method
abstract_en: This patent " a kind of to couple advance of freshet and the modeling of crowd evacuation and analogy method " interacts between the multiple agent model by cellular Automation Model and the crowd evacuation simulation of flood damage environmental simulation, realize advance of freshet-crowd evacuation Coupling method and simulation, it is desirable to provide a kind of method of crowd's mobile behavior prediction in flood damage scene.The variables such as the environmental parameter perceived in Crowds Distribute, flood parameters, crowd's movement are modeled using the modeling method of cellular automata, realize the simulation of flood damage environment dynamic change.The simulation of crowd evacuation is input with the disaster environment parameter of neighborhood grid, is calculated in real time using the method for multiple agent, is finally completed advance of freshet-crowd evacuation Coupling method and simulation.

title_en: The efficient anti-method of deepwater drilling platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of efficient anti-methods of deepwater drilling platform, comprising the following steps: S1, defines anti-mode of the platform under two kinds of positioning states；S2, the clear security area Fang Tai；The calculating of S3, clear T-time；The classification of the evacuating people of S4, clearly anti-；S5, navigation evacuation route selection；S6, platform cannot avoid movement routine selection when Typhoon Tracks completely.The present invention summarizes anti-emergence program of deepwater drilling platform, simultaneously in view of the anti-activity duration of deepwater drilling platform is long, it is easy to be influenced by the real-time movement speed of typhoon, complex situations are easy to happen during meeting with typhoon for deepwater drilling and propose a kind of countermeasure, this method is easy to operate, be easily mastered, can reduce deepwater drilling meet with typhoon during complex situations incidence, can be widely applied in deep water field of oil drilling.

title_en: A kind of shallow coal scam diving leakage causes the division methods of calamity degree
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the division methods that a kind of diving leakage of shallow coal scam causes calamity degree, belong to coal mining protection field, cover water table aquifer leakage cause calamity degree to solve the problems, such as to be unable to judge accurately at present on bank.The present invention is the following steps are included: S1. arranges monitoring point in coal mine work area and embedded long distance water level recorder carries out water level monitoring；S2. ground elevation is monitored, ground settlement is calculated and collects drilling depth data；S3. make drilling depth away from monitoring point distance-ground settlement-SEA LEVEL VARIATION relation curve by monitoring materials；S4. made curve compared with diving does not miss figure, micro- leakage figure and a large amount of leakage figures and is divided into leakage degree；S5. research zoning is further divided into environmental disaster area or Youhao District.Division methods of the present invention are simple and practical; from the angle of ecological protection; targetedly northwest coalfield shallow seated groundwater resource leak and environmental disaster are judged, select to provide foundation for mining area exploitation mode, is of great significance to ecological environmental protection during the coal mining of northwest.

title_en: A kind of natural gas line fire incident hazard analysis method based on danger level
abstract_en: The natural gas line fire incident hazard analysis method based on danger level that the invention discloses a kind of, the accidents such as jet bubble reactor, the scintillation occurred first using FDS fire disaster simulation software simulation natural gas line due to leakage, obtain the thermal radiation flux distributed data around accident point；Secondly, using Crystal Ball risk analysis software the data at different location are fitted with the probability distribution for obtaining thermal radiation flux at the position according to distributed data；Then, by gained probability distribution in conjunction with fire heat radiation probability equation, the distribution situation that the simulation based on Monte Carlo finds out Death probit amount is carried out；Finally, finding out the danger level of corresponding position, the risk in each region of quantitative analysis according to the reversion accumulated probability that random sampling calculates gained Death probit amount.It realizes that fire incident, which occurs, to natural gas line carries out more accurate risk analysis, and advises accordingly to administrative staff, improves safeguard procedures.

title_en: A kind of teaching automobile inlet manifold absolute pressure transducer teaching and actual training device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of teaching automobile inlet manifold absolute pressure transducer teaching and actual training device, including practical traning platform and pedestal, open source single-chip microcontroller is separately installed at the top of the practical traning platform, support device and suggestion device, vacuum evacuation device is installed in support device, the vacuum evacuation device is connected with inlet manifold by bindiny mechanism, this teaching is imparted knowledge to students with automobile inlet manifold absolute pressure transducer and actual training device, electric lifting rod work is controlled by open source single-chip microcontroller, the telescopic end of electric lifting rod drives mounting base to carry out elevating movement, to which the displaying height to practical traning platform is adjusted, servo motor work is controlled by open source single-chip microcontroller, the output shaft of servo motor drives practical traning platform rotation by attachment base, to which the displaying angle of practical traning platform be adjusted, its flexibility is good, it is easy to adjust, it is convenient for teaching.

title_en: A kind of geological disaster monitoring system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of geological disaster monitoring systems based on big data, including monitoring processing system, service processor and receive terminal module, service processor connects reception terminal module in such a way that signal transmits, information transmission includes wire transmission and wireless transmission, monitor processing module transmits connection service processor by data, monitoring processing system includes data collection module, satellite image acquisition module, expert's processing module and simulation model module, mutual data connection between satellite image acquisition module, expert's processing module and simulation model module.The present invention uninterruptedly monitors the easy generation area of geological disaster by acquiring monitoring module, monitoring data is analyzed in time, it timely feedbacks, it allows people to receive the information of related geological disaster in time, really accomplishes uninterruptedly to monitor geological disaster, geological disaster look-ahead, geological disaster prevent in time, reduce the loss of geological disaster bring.
assignees: FUJIAN QIDIAN SPACE TIME DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of unmanned driving system of coal mine roadway and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to coal industry technical fields, more particularly, to a kind of unmanned driving system of coal mine roadway and method, comprising: lock wall system, development machine remote intelligent control system, remote control drilling and support system, escape and transportation system, water and gas drilling system and wireless telecommunications, monitoring and personnel location system are isolated in accident.The present invention can efficiently solve the urgent demand for security of coal mine operation, realize that unmanned hundred meters of solution danger tunnels, catastrophic failure closure, personnel withdraw mechanization, 50% or more can be reduced by mitigating or prevent the big disaster-water of tunnelling five, fire, gas, coal dust and top plate, coal mine personnel injures and deaths.Moreover, the present invention can meet the production requirement of reality well, tunnelling speed is improved, changes digging and connects nervous situation, tunnelling efficiency can be improved 50% -100%, while the present invention can also reduce tunnel into lane cost, increase economic efficiency.

title_en: InSAR technology-based method for determining effective region for early dynamic identification and monitoring of regional landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining an effective region for dynamically identifying and monitoring an early stage of regional landslide based on an InSAR technology, which is used for proposing and establishing a data response relation comprehensive factor of terrain and satellite attitude parameters on the basis of accurately analyzing interaction relations of the terrain factor gradient, the slope direction, the satellite imaging incident angle, the azimuth angle and other attitude parameters aiming at complex terrain characteristics and satellite side-looking imaging characteristics of a landslide disaster-pregnant environment; and the ground local incidence angle of each monitoring point on the ground in the lifting rail mode is accurately calculated and simulated, the ground local incidence angles are classified and analyzed, the mutual influence and change relation between the ground local incidence angles and the interference characteristics of the InSAR technology are analyzed, and an effective monitoring area and an overlapping and shadow area which cannot be effectively monitored are accurately determined, so that the accurate determination of the effective monitoring range of the area landslide identification and monitoring under different complex terrain areas and different satellite side-looking imaging attitude parameters is realized, and the accurate analysis of the early dynamic identification and monitoring of the time sequence InSAR technology area landslide is realized.

title_en: Downburst prediction method based on Doppler radar data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a downburst prediction method based on Doppler radar data, which comprises the following steps: collecting Doppler weather radar data matched with a storm event report of 10 years, identifying convection monomers at all moments, and extracting static characteristics to obtain a convection monomer sequence; matching the convective monomer sequence to a storm event; taking the disaster occurrence time as a time reference point, splitting the convection monomer sequence into a plurality of sample sequence fragment sets; extracting feature sets of the sample sequence fragment set, performing statistical significance test, and searching significant feature sets of positive and negative sample feature sets; performing dimensionality reduction and decoupling on the significance characteristic set through principal component analysis to obtain effective characteristics, and further training a classifier model to obtain a group of classifier models; and (4) combining and applying a classifier model set, and detecting and forecasting downburst. The method can automatically detect the convection monomer generating the downburst and predict the occurrence time and the occurrence place of the downburst.

title_en: A kind of coal seam group multilayer goaf pressure regulation Ventilation simulation analytical equipment and method
abstract_en: A kind of coal seam group multilayer goaf pressure regulation Ventilation simulation analytical equipment and method, belong to prevention and control of mine disaster field.The device includes simulation working face, simulation roof strata, simulates this layer of goaf, simulation top goaf, in which: simulation working face is made of air inlet pipeline, coal mining activity facial canal road, air return lane pipeline, small-sized fan, simulation air regulator, color cigarette release case, wind pressure sensor, oxygen and concentration of sulfur hexafluoride sensor；It simulates this layer of goaf and top goaf is the glass steel box of internal filling transparent glass ball, and be provided with multiple groups oxygen and concentration of sulfur hexafluoride sensor, wind pressure sensor.Gas in simulation working face, this layer of goaf and top goaf is respectively set to different colours, pass through the gas circulation trend observed under various draft types and each sensor real-time monitoring value, the gas passage rate and voltage regulation result of working face and multilayer flow field in goaf qualitative, quantitatively can be analyzed comprehensively, provide parameter guidance for engineering practice.

title_en: Intelligent rainwater system based on runoff simulation and multi-sensor monitoring and operation method
abstract_en: The system comprises a runoff simulation and control host based on GIS, a weather forecast and runoff satellite monitoring server, a distributed small weather station, a facade rain condition monitor, a mobile rainfall radar, an infrared video monitor, an evaporation measuring instrument, a rainwater pipe network flow monitor, a water quality on-line monitor, an air quality monitor, a radar rain monitor, a infiltration area saturation monitor, an accumulation area water level monitor, a shallow groundwater level monitor, a surface runoff monitor, a buoy waterproof unmanned aerial vehicle with speed measurement, an optical fiber temperature sensing system, an optical fiber pressure sensing system, a communication module, an intelligent controller, a rainwater utilization facility water supply point, a high-level rainwater hydroelectric generation module, a submerged conveying pump, a pressurizing infiltration device and the like. According to the invention, scientific early warning and alarming are carried out on the rain and flood disaster according to various parameters, and countermeasures are adopted, so that the disaster risk of the rain and flood disaster in a building area or a building is reduced.

title_en: Large-size salt level communication well group water-soluble cavity-making simulation experiment method
abstract_en: A simulation experiment method for water-soluble cavity construction of a large-size salt level communication well group relates to the technical field of cavity shape expansion rule and control of cavity construction in a thin salt layer area and underground disaster prevention and control. The invention visually simulates the conditions of different water injection flow rates, different stages, oil pad existence, injection and production directions and the like in actual engineering and the development rule of the cavity form, thereby obtaining the optimal production parameters and process for cavity form control in the cavity forming process of water dissolution of the salt rock horizontal communication well assembly, obtaining the underground disaster prevention and control mechanism and technical means and guiding field production.

title_en: A kind of drying and watering cycle true triaxial test system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of drying and watering cycle true triaxial test systems, it loads the first hydraulic power source by true triaxial pressure chamber, axial liquid potential source, the direction x, the direction x loads the second hydraulic power source, the direction y loads the first hydraulic power source, the direction y loads the second hydraulic power source, air charging system, gas-heating apparatus, gas dry cooling device, the first high Accuracy Electronic Balance, emission-control equipment, water tank, the second high Accuracy Electronic Balance, charging pump, computer and forms.The system can realize the different ambient stresses and the simulation of water environment of rock preservation, carry out soft rock and meets the experimental study of water deformation failure, overall process and mechanism that soft rock meets water gradient plasticity theory are disclosed, there is important theory and realistic meaning for engineering safety regulation and disaster prevention.

title_en: Ultra-short-term accurate prediction method for online anti-icing and de-icing of power transmission line
abstract_en: An online anti-icing and de-icing ultra-short-term accurate prediction method for a power transmission line. And predicting on the self-melting ice wire online monitoring equipment. The ice coating weight data is collected on the simulated self-made thermal conductor, and the wind speed and rainfall intensity meteorological data is collected on meteorological observation equipment. The prediction method comprises the steps of data acquisition, parameter constraint model construction, parameter prediction model, icing weight prediction, prediction data reliability judgment and icing thickness increase value prediction. The icing weight prediction is that a liquid-water factor is calculated in a parameter constraint model through the collected simulated homemade heating wire weight increase value, rainfall intensity and average wind speed. And forecasting rainfall intensity, average wind speed and liquid water factor through the parameter forecasting model, and forecasting icing weight and icing thickness through the parameters. The method provides ultra-short-term accurate analysis for the future icing state of the power transmission circuit, provides accurate information for predicting future icing for ice-proof and ice-melting control, and effectively prevents great loss of the power transmission line caused by sudden weather disasters.

title_en: One kind toppling over type avalanche side slope angular distortion alarm
abstract_en: The utility model provide it is a kind of simply can portable topple over type avalanche side slope angular distortion alarm, including twinax cable, metal probe, sheet metal circle and charged warning device, when Dangerous Rock Body is unstable, when lodging, metal probe and sheet metal circle in vertical drilling generate lodging angle and contact, closed circuit is formed with electric wire, alarm system, the warning device of charged will generate alarm, achieve the effect that disaster is warned.Utility model device structure is simple, light small and exquisite, is easy to carry about with one, and making material is simple and easy to get, and installation cost is low, can use in building site existing article to make, facilitates Geological Hazards Monitoring, and liberate manpower, monitoring for protection personnel safety.

title_en: Side wing-vertical combined type multi-dimensional freezing drilling and cutting method for soft and hard stratum
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground engineering rock and soil mass drilling, cutting and underground engineering disaster prevention and reduction, and provides a flank-vertical combined type multidimensional freezing drilling and cutting method for soft and hard strata; the method adopts a side wing-vertical combined drilling and cutting mode, drives the high-strength drill cutting head to longitudinally drill and cut into the stratum by controlling the telescopic arm until the longitudinal drilling and cutting are completed, respectively controls the threaded drill cutting head and the pentagonal drill cutting head to rotationally drill and cut the stratum by controlling the drill cutting head control door, drives the core drill cutting head to rotationally drill and cut into the stratum by utilizing the embedded sliding connection of the outer side of the central rotating shaft and the high-strength hollow central framework, realizes the multi-angle multi-cutter composite drilling and cutting of soft and hard stratum, avoids the problem that the deep hole drilling and cutting construction is easy to deviate in soft and hard uneven stratum such as rock soft soil and the like, and saves the construction cost; the multi-dimensional multi-zone freezing method is adopted in the stratum with water-rich hardness and hardness, the longitudinal and vertical 360-degree all-dimensional freezing of deep hole drilling and cutting construction is realized, the deep hole drilling and cutting is prevented from collapsing, the construction quality is reliable, and the construction safety is ensured.

title_en: A kind of subway escape experience apparatus and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of subway escape experience apparatus, including made according to subway carriage actual size a section compartment, the display equipment simulating subway in the compartment on two sides and shuttling is set, be arranged in the compartment with lantern ring field sound effect equipment, simulation fired equipment, fan, fog machine, car light, the car door with gate anti-pinch equipment, emergency escape lock, control equipment, power supply；Rail side evacuation platform, tunnel emergency exits outside the compartment are set；The display equipment, ring field sound effect equipment, simulation fired equipment, fan, fog machine, gate anti-pinch equipment, power supply are connect with the control equipment；The invention also discloses a kind of subway escape experiential methods.The present invention can simulate true subway failure and scene of saving oneself of escaping, and achieve the purpose that take experiencer metro safety experience education, improve the sense of self-protection and awareness of safety of experiencer's seating subway.
