title_en: A kind of extensive Geological Hazards of debris Fast numerical simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of extensive Geological Hazards of debris Fast numerical simulation method and system, include the following steps: to obtain Geological Hazards of debris terrain data, source area range, elevation and physical and mechanical parameter；Divide extensive Geological Hazards of debris zoning；Thick tessellated mesh condition is judged, and to the roughening of zoning grid, mesh refinement and network；Numerical simulation calculation is carried out to earth's surface disaster dynamic process using numerical simulation software；The calculated result of n zoning is exported, and the calculated result of n zoning is merged into a zoning output；This method is by carrying out region division, grid thickness and structured grid to zoning, to there are material resource, calculative region to carry out fining calculating, there is no material resource, need the area grid calculated roughening, it not only realizes and the large-scale grid that calculates is calculated, and computation rate is improved, realize the Fast simulation calculating to extensive Geological Hazards of debris.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: A kind of landslide emergency repair system based on BIM technology
abstract_en: The landslide emergency repair system based on BIM technology that the present invention relates to a kind of, the emergency repair system includes: front-end information acquisition terminal, for collecting the soil layer information inside landslide, and is uploaded to BIM cloud platform；Data collection process device, the information of the front-end information acquisition terminal is downloaded from BIM cloud platform and is collected to background server, BIM ground speciality platform is equipped in background server, information parameter in sliding surface is input in BIM ground speciality platform, qualitative classification analysis is done to sliding surface information, and according to the soil layer information inside landslide, establish the landslide BIM geological model, and then the safety coefficient of sliding surface is calculated, by being compared with slope project security level table, obtain landslide form mechanism implementations, and then the most dangerous sliding surface is found on the geological model of the landslide BIM and simulates the result of Landslide Deformation destruction, realize the information data flowing between different field related personnel, landslide emergency repair countermeasure can preferably be formulated, foundation is provided, to reduce disaster-stricken loss.

title_en: Ladder elevation experience device
abstract_en: To provide a ladder elevation experience device capable of performing effective training for avoidance of a disaster in work using a ladder.SOLUTION: A ladder 2 is disposed in a standing fashion. A plurality of driving devices are provided. The plurality of driving devices include a first driving device 3 located at one side of the ladder and a second driving device 4 located at the other side of the ladder.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOKYO ELECTRIC POWER CO HOLDINGS INC;NOMURA CO LTD

title_en: A kind of more scene fire disaster simulation escape drilling systems
abstract_en: A kind of more scene fire disaster simulation escape drilling systems, including splicing plate, doorframe, fire disaster simulation device, warning device, controller and simulator of creeping；Several splicing plates are spliced into movable wall body, several movable wall bodies besieged cities enclosure space, one end inlet porting of enclosure space, other end setting outlet side by side；Several splicing plates are spliced into partition wall side by side, and enclosure space in the enclosed space, is divided into several rooms by several partition wall settings；It is provided with doorframe on partition wall, makes to interconnect between each room；Fire disaster simulation device, warning device and simulator of creeping are provided in each room；Controller is provided with outside enclosure space.The case where diversified escape route guarantees that rehearsal personnel will not encounter same rehearsal environment, later rehearsal person's manoeuvre is avoided to be the easy game gone through the motions appearance.

title_en: Two disaggregated model training methods, data classification method and corresponding intrument
abstract_en: The present invention relates to machine learning techniques fields, provide two disaggregated model training methods of one kind, data classification method and corresponding intrument.Wherein, the training sample in training set is structural data, includes at least one discrete type feature in structural data, two disaggregated model training methods include: the number that the different characteristic values of statistical straggling type feature occur in the positive sample of training set；The ratio of the total number of number and positive sample that characteristic value based on discrete type feature occurs, calculates the corresponding encoded radio of characteristic value of discrete type feature；The characteristic value of discrete type feature in training sample is replaced with into corresponding encoded radio；Utilize updated training sample two disaggregated models of training.After discrete type feature in structural data is encoded by the above method, characteristic value is converted into successive value, so as to be properly processed by existing machine learning algorithm, normally for training two disaggregated models.Meanwhile cataloged procedure is simple and efficient, and not will lead to dimension disaster problem.

title_en: Mountain land building toughness evaluation method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain land building toughness evaluation method based on big data, which is characterized in that a toughness influence factor of a building is extracted and normalized; then, according to the house danger identification standard, a calculation method of the resistance performance index of the building is established; selecting a certain number of buildings in a research area as training samples, and training the training samples by using an intelligent algorithm to obtain weights of influence factors of various influence factors on the resistance performance indexes of the deterioration and damage of the buildings; and calculating by adopting the weight to obtain the resistance performance index of the non-sample building in the area to be researched, and using the resistance performance index for evaluating the building toughness of the building in the area to be researched. The method can conveniently and quickly realize the toughness evaluation of the building, has higher evaluation accuracy and evaluation efficiency, can perform early warning on the disasters of the mountain buildings, and provides reference information for the design of the scheme for reinforcing and repairing the building.

title_en: Magnetic force conversion type tool changing drilling and cutting method for soft and hard stratum
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground engineering rock-soil body drilling, cutting and underground engineering disaster prevention and reduction, and provides a magnetic force conversion type tool changing drilling and cutting method for soft and hard strata, wherein when in-hole tool changing operation is carried out, a telescopic controller controls a telescopic rod to retract so as to drive a magnetic block and a first group of drill bit fixing plates to retract together, and when the height position of the other group of drill bit fixing plates is reached, the magnetic conduction function is finished, so that the magnetic block is separated from the first group of drill bit fixing plates; the other group of drill bit fixing plates is vertically superposed with the axis of the magnetic block by controlling the lifting slide bar group to rotate by a certain angle; then the magnetic block is driven to descend; the magnetic connection is realized by controlling the magnetic block and the other group of ferromagnetic drill bit fixing plates, and the replacement of the cutter in the hole is completed. Meanwhile, the variable drilling and cutting can be used for realizing the rapid drilling and cutting construction of soft and hard stratums, and the rapid discharge of rock debris of any stratum is realized through a water pumping and washing system, so that the stratum adaptability of drilling is improved, and the problem of large deviation of hole sites in the drilling construction of the soft and hard stratums is solved.

title_en: The intelligent elevated cutting arrangement of multi-region freezing type for soft or hard stratum
abstract_en: The invention belongs to underground engineering Rock And Soil drilling, cutting and underground engineerings to prevent and reduce natural disasters technical field, more particularly, to a kind of intelligent elevated cutting arrangement of multi-region freezing type for soft or hard stratum；Using multizone independent-lifting formula drilling cutter, being combined with each other different zones drilling cutterhead, realization is independent to be moved up and down, and is realized and is selected rapid changing knife in knife and hole in the hole on any stratum, improve construction speed, has saved construction cost；Drilling method is freezed using freezing type simultaneously, refrigerated brine agent, which is controlled, by freezing controller releases refrigerated brine, and by cryovial as the vertical stretching of cutterhead is injected into stratum to be onstructed, realize the quick freezing drilling of bad ground multi-region domain partitioning, hard-soft heterogeneous ground is avoided in hole the quality accidents such as to collapse because rich water causes, reliable construction quality, it is at low cost；Have the characteristics that water rich strata freeze-over, jelly area's fast selecting, the drilling cutting integration of jelly area, drilling power is uniform, at low cost, pore-forming accuracy is high, drilling is fireballing.

title_en: The haze calamity risk forecast method and system of power transmission and transforming equipment based on Adaboost
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of haze calamity risk forecast method and system of power transmission and transforming equipment based on Adaboost, this method comprises: the haze disaster impact factor for power transmission and transforming equipment is classified, and Meteorological Characteristics factor of the power transmission and transforming equipment under history haze disaster accident is counted according to classification results；According to the power transmission and transforming equipment information being predicted, it selects and the corresponding class of the haze disaster impact factor of power transmission and transforming equipment, and with the Meteorological Characteristics sets of factors under the conditions of history haze disaster accident in such at training sample set, classifier is obtained with the training of Adaboost Ensemble Learning Algorithms；Using forecast data of the power transmission and transforming equipment in the Meteorological Characteristics factor under haze disaster accident as the input of classifier, the value of result and its confidence level is exported by the haze disaster alarm that classifier obtains power transmission and transforming equipment.The present invention is stronger for power transmission and transforming equipment initiative, and degree of intelligence is higher, and application range is wider.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;DISASTER PREVENTION DISASTER MITIGATION CENTER OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: System for total monitoring of fire protection system
title_ko: 소방시설의 통합 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a system capable of integrally and conveniently monitoring an indoor fire protection system by a manager terminal. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system for integrally monitoring a fire protection system comprises one or more processors and one or more memories to store instructions executable by the processors. The system includes: a database unit to classify and store management information of a first fire protection system connected via a network to be controlled by a manager terminal and a second fire protection system to be controlled only by manual control of a manager; a test unit to use the management information of the first and second fire protection system stored in the database unit, and control operation of the first fire protection system in accordance with response information for a plurality of previously stored disaster scenarios; and a monitoring result transmission unit to use whether the first fire protection system operates normally in accordance with a control result of the test unit and the management information of the second fire protection system to transmit a fire protection system monitoring result for each disaster scenario to the manager terminal.
abstract_ko: 실내의 소방시설을 통합적이고 편리하게 관리자 단말에서 모니터링할 수 있는 시스템을 제공하기 위해서, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 소방시설의 통합 모니터링 시스템은, 하나 이상의 프로세서 및 상기 프로세서에서 수행 가능한 명령들을 저장하는 하나 이상의 메모리를 포함하는 소방시설의 통합 모니터링 시스템에 있어서, 시스템은, 모니터링 대상 지역에 포함된 소방시설들 중, 관리자 단말에 의하여 제어 가능하도록 네트워크를 통해 연결된 제1 소방시설과, 관리자의 수동 제어에 의해서만 제어 가능한 제2 소방시설의 관리정보를 구분하여 저장하는 데이터베이스부; 데이터베이스부에 저장된 제1 소방시설 및 제2 소방시설의 관리정보를 이용하며, 기 저장된 복수의 재난 시나리오별 대응 정보에 따라서 제1 소방시설의 동작을 제어하는 테스트부; 및 테스트부의 제어 결과에 따른 제1 소방시설의 정상 동작 여부 및 제2 소방시설의 관리정보를 이용하여, 재난 시나리오별 소방시설의 모니터링 결과를 관리자 단말에 전송하는 모니터링 결과 송출부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer-readable medium for monitoring of conventional market using the three-dimensional map
title_ko: 3차원 안전 지도를 이용한 재래 시장 모니터링 및 관리 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터-판독가능 매체
abstract_en: A monitoring and managing method of a conventional market using a three-dimensional safe map according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a level setting step of setting a risk level with respect to at least one store which constitutes a conventional market from a regulations grade of a framework, wall materials and structure of a conventional market which are received to a user terminal; an evacuation route searching step of searching a route from a location of a user terminal to an evacuation point on the basis of one information among risk level information of a conventional market, attribute information of a route and environmental information when an ignition predicted point is entered though an input means of a user terminal; and an evacuation route providing step of outputting and providing an evacuation route which is selected by an input means of a user terminal among at least one evacuation route which is searched in an evacuation route searching step in a simulation screen of a user terminal. Accordingly, each risk level is set at a plurality of stores which are included in a conventional market and integrated management can be possible, and thus prompt action and management can be performed even if an unexpected accident occurs in a conventional market.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 3차원 안전 지도를 이용한 재래 시장 모니터링 및 관리 방법은, 유저 단말에 수신되는 재래 시장의 골조, 벽재 재질 및 구조에 대한 법규 등급으로부터, 재래 시장을 구성하는 적어도 하나의 상점에 대한 위험 레벨을 설정하는 위험 레벨 설정 단계; 유저 단말의 입력 수단을 통해 발화 예상 지점이 입력될 시, 재래 시장의 위험 레벨 정보, 이동 경로의 속성 정보 및 환경 정보 중 적어도 어느 하나의 정보를 기준으로 유저 단말의 위치로부터 탈출 지점까지의 대피 경로를 탐색하는 대피 경로 탐색 단계; 및 대피 경로 탐색 단계에서 탐색된 적어도 하나의 대피 경로 중 유저 단말의 입력 수단에 의해 선택된 대피 경로를 유저 단말에 시뮬레이션 화면으로 출력하여 제공하는 대피 경로 제공 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 따라 재래 시장에 포함된 복수의 상점들에 각각 위험 레벨을 설정하여 통합적으로 관리할 수 있게 되어 재래 시장 내에 예기치 못한 사고가 발생하더라도 즉각적으로 대응 및 관리할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Intelligent Disaster Countermeasures Training method and system thereof
title_ko: 지능형 재난대응 훈련방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: An intelligent disaster countermeasure training system and method are disclosed. According to an aspect of the present invention, an intelligent disaster countermeasure training system includes a step of displaying a standard operating procedure (SOP), a step of allowing an intelligent disaster countermeasure training system to specify the selection object of any one of the objects included in the SOP flow chart, a step of simulating at least one of an on-site device or a control device corresponding to a mission process so that the intelligent disaster countermeasure training system performs the countermeasure training of a mission process corresponding to a particular selected object. It is possible to perform efficient training.
abstract_ko: 지능형 재난대응 훈련시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 지능형 재난대응 훈련시스템이 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 플로우 차트를 디스플레이하는 단계, 상기 지능형 재난대응 훈련시스템이 상기 SOP 플로우 차트에 포함된 오브젝트들 중 어느 하나의 선택 오브젝트를 특정하는 단계, 상기 지능형 재난대응 훈련시스템이 특정한 상기 선택 오브젝트에 상응하는 임무 프로세스의 대응훈련이 수행되도록 상기 임무 프로세스에 상응하는 현장 기기 또는 관제 기기 중 적어도 하나를 시뮬레이션 하는 단계를 포함하는 지능형 재난대응 훈련방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Experience vehicle system for fire fighting safety education
title_ko: 소방 안전교육 체험차량 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides an experience vehicle for fire-fighting safety education which enables a large number of experiential education at a time by changing the structure of a vehicle on which a training system is mounted to a structure suitable for education and training and enables efficient experience training. The experience vehicle includes a girder frame and a folded light shielding layer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 훈련 시스템이 탑재되는 차량의 구조를 교육 훈련에 적합한 구조로 변경하여 한 번에 많은 수의 체험 교육이 가능하고, 효율적인 체험 교육을 수행할 수 있도록 한 소방안전교육 체험차량 시스템을 제공하기 위한 것이다.

title_en: Gob-side entry retaining working face Y-shaped ventilation pressure regulating disaster prevention method
abstract_en: A gob-side entry retaining working face Y-shaped ventilation pressure regulating disaster prevention method belongs to the field of coal mine disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the following steps: the main air inlet lane and the auxiliary air inlet lane are respectively provided with a PLC (programmable logic controller), a frequency converter, a local ventilator, an air cylinder, an air door and an air speed sensor, and the air quantity of the air inlet lane is automatically regulated and controlled, so that the pressure difference value between the air inlet end and the air return end of the coal mining operation surface is controlled in a minimum range, and primary pressure equalization of the main air inlet lane, the coal mining operation surface and the auxiliary air inlet lane is realized; the return airway is provided with an adjusting air window, a PLC (programmable logic controller), a gas sensor, a carbon monoxide sensor, a wind speed sensor, a pressure measuring drill hole and a pressure difference sensor, the wind pressure of the return airway is automatically adjusted, the wind pressure of each measuring point of the return airway is not lower than that of a goaf, the pressure difference higher than the goaf is controlled in a reasonable range, and secondary pressure equalization of the return airway and the goaf is realized. The method adopts automatic pressure regulation in different areas, achieves the effect of twice pressure equalization of a working face, and can comprehensively prevent and control potential safety hazards such as gas, spontaneous combustion fire and the like of the working face of the gob-side entry retaining.

title_en: Crowd simulation evacuation method and device based on artificial fish-swarm algorithm and target detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of crowd simulation evacuation method and device based on artificial fish-swarm algorithm and target detection, it the described method comprises the following steps: topological map being established according to evacuation scene plan view, wherein node indicates emergency exit, line indicates two outlets, and marks final outlet；Detection and tracking is carried out according to individual of the video data to evacuation crowd, obtains the individual speed of evacuation crowd；Eating speed in shoal of fish influent pH is indicated using the individual speed, the shoal of fish is initialized, food is indicated with the final outlet position of scene, path planning is carried out to evacuation crowd's individual based on artificial fish-swarm algorithm；When the number of evacuation of final outlet is equal to total number of persons, evacuation process terminates, and obtains evacuation path.The present invention identifies slow individual in evacuation, and crowd is instructed to evacuate, to look after the disadvantaged group in evacuation, while improving evacuation efficiency, avoids excessive congestion.

title_en: Water area detection method and device based on visual monitoring of air-based platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting the area of a water area based on visual monitoring of an empty foundation platform, and relates to the technical field of image processing. The device comprises an image collector, a CNN feature extractor, a branching device of a porous convolution network, a feature fusion device, a classifier and an area converter. Firstly, extracting high-level semantic information in a water area picture to be monitored by a convolutional neural network to obtain an output characteristic diagram, and inputting the output characteristic diagram into a porous convolutional network. Then according to the edge information of the image, averaging the hyperspectral information of all pixel points in each area to obtain the expected characteristics of the area; and (3) utilizing a linear SVM classifier training model to classify the sample vectors of the expected characteristics, and finally outputting a classification result to obtain the water area S. And calculating the real area of the water area part according to the legend parameter gamma and the water area S of the original image. The invention has strong robustness, can monitor the change of the real area of the water area part and predict natural disasters.

title_en: Spherical tank fire disaster simulation burner
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to fire-fighting and rescue technical field, in particular to a kind of spherical tank fire disaster simulation burner.Including removable tank body, vibration unit, fuel element, spray unit, simulated explosion unit, temperature and hydraulic feedback unit, control system, wherein fuel element is set to the outside of removable tank body, and the fire for simulating removable tank body burns；Vibration unit is set to the inside of removable tank body, for driving removable tank body to generate vibration, simulates the vibrational state before removable tank body explosion；Simulated explosion unit is set to the inside of removable tank body, for realizing removable tank body blast analogue；Spray unit is for cooling down removable tank body.Utility model device more can really simulate the burning scene of spherical tank fire, and its quality is considerably lighter than the quality of true spherical tank, can be moved by castor, allow to carry out the simulation of spherical tank fire in different training places.

title_en: building monitoring system based on BIM
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of building monitoring system based on BIM, including sequentially connected BIM operation management platform, BIM model component, central processing unit and coordinated control system；Coordinated control system includes that building automation subsystem, automatic fire alarm subsystem, smoke controlling control subsystem, fire-extinguishing apparatus control subsystem and personnel simulate evacuation subsystem；The facility information of coordinated control system is sent to BIM model component by central processing unit；BIM model component adds the facility information in BIM threedimensional model, and is sent to BIM operation management platform；BIM operation management platform stores and shows BIM threedimensional model.In this way user can it is intuitive by BIM threedimensional model, it is detailed obtain coordinated control system facility information, supervision difficulty is reduced, the transparence degree of items of equipment information is improved, keeps fire-fighting and rescue work more intuitive, more efficiently, to guarantee the safe and reasonable operation of Architectural Equipment.
assignees: SUZHOU ANDAXIN TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: The evacuation path guiding system influenced based on toxic gas diffusion
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of toxic gas diffusions to evacuate path guiding system, it includes toxic gas leakage data collection station, toxic gas diffusion simulator, evacuation path resolving module, path navigation terminal and information transmission modular, the toxic gas leakage data collection station includes poisonous gas detecting instrument and information transmission modular a, and the toxic gas diffusion simulator resolves module with the evacuation path and connected by information transmission modular b.The evacuation path guiding system of the utility model considers the disaster-stricken risk and its variation in path, can shift for disaster-stricken crowd and provide dynamic transfer path decision support, reduces the disaster-stricken risk of personnel and injures and deaths, avoids blindly shifting and unordered evacuation.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY OF BUILDING RES LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Steel oil storage tank wall surface damage experiment platform under multi-disaster coupling effect
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a steel oil storage tank wall destruction experiment platform under the coupling effect of multiple disasters relates to a storage tank district conflagration, the experimental platform and the experimental method that experimental research was carried out to neighbouring building (structure) wall destruction to the coupling effect of multiple disasters of explosion. The device comprises a test piece, a bracket, a simulated fragment ejection device, a gas explosion shock wave generating device, a radiant electric heating device and an experimental measurement acquisition system; the radiant electric heating device is hung on the bracket through the hook and is positioned right in front of the test piece; the temperature controller can record temperature data measured by the thermocouple; the simulated fragment ejection device is fixed on the adjustable bracket; the gas explosion shock wave generating device comprises a combustible gas distribution instrument and an explosion venting port; the experimental measurement and acquisition system comprises a data acquisition system, a laser displacement sensor, a high-speed camera, a high-temperature foil type resistance strain gauge and a high-frequency pressure sensor.

title_en: A kind of multichannel crack early-warning apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of multichannel crack early-warning apparatus.The monitor includes: monitoring host, fixed drill rod and alarm；The fixing end that host is set to landslide is monitored, fixed drill rod is set to the sliding end of surface cracks, and alarm is set to residential block；The inside for monitoring host is equipped with pantograph, SMS alarming device and power supply unit；Pantograph is connected with SMS alarming device and alarm respectively；Power supply unit is connected with pantograph, SMS alarming device and crack alarm device respectively；Pantograph is connect by wirerope with fixed drill rod line, and when surface cracks occur to expand and reach setting value, mechanical movement occurs for pantograph, triggers alarm equipment alarm, and crack information is sent on the mobile phone of mass presdiction and disaster prevention observer by SMS alarming device.Using monitoring and warning instrument provided by the utility model, without artificial on duty, fracture intensity and distance limitation not monitored can be paid close attention to the moment.

title_en: A kind of liftable change Sloping Tunnels fire disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of liftable change Sloping Tunnels fire disaster simulation device, is mainly made of four parts, including tunnel main body, longitudinal exhausting system, Combustion Source and mating TT&C system.Tunnel main part, including tunnel frame, support frame, flameproof fabric, tempered glass and glass magnesium board wall surface；Tunnel Ventilation System part, including Frequency Adjustable axial flow blower and screens；Combustion tunnel source part, including combustion boat and tripod；The mating TT&C system part in tunnel, including electronic balance, anemobiagraph, laser emitter, thermocouple and video camera.Simulator experiment consumption is less, and repeatability is strong, can be with the variation of temperature and wind speed in the case of complete detection different gradient and lifting.

title_en: A kind of Seam Mining crack field gas pressure measurement system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Seam Mining crack field gas pressure measurement systems, including visiting receiving apparatus, plugging device and measurement device, receiving apparatus is visited to be mounted in drilling, plugging device is for closing the drilling, visiting receiving apparatus includes the first tube body, second tube body and third tube body, third tube body protrudes into the foot of hole, first tube body is located at the outermost of the drilling, plugging device includes blocking capsule, capsule connecting tube and operating capsule platform, measurement device includes sequentially connected gas pressure table, electron pressure measuring instrument and gas collect and survey instrument, gas pressure table is connect with the front of the first tube body.The present invention can carry out force analysis to Seam Mining crack, and it is marked to position is excavated, to calculate reservoir stress and gas porous flow pressure, and then effective pre- preventing coal mine gas dynamic disaster occurs, and can periodically be recorded, be stored and transmitted to gas pressure data automatically.
assignees: PINGDINGSHAN TIANAN COAL MINING CO LTD;CHINA PINGMEI SHENMA ENERGY CHEMICAL GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Advanced prevention and control method for water damage of working face roof separation layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to an advanced prevention and control method for bed separation water damage, belongs to the technical field of mine safety, and particularly relates to an advanced prevention and control method suitable for bed separation water damage of a roof of a coal mine working face. The working face roof bed separation water disaster advanced control method can combine the characteristics of working face mining conditions, overlying strata structures, hydrogeological conditions containing water-resisting layers and the like, and utilizes underground drill holes to dredge and drop the water level of the water-filled aquifer in the bed separation space; grouting the separation space to drive water, and simultaneously achieving the purpose of thickening the water-resisting layer under the separation space; the technical scheme of beam-shaped drilling targeted detection and amplification is adopted for the formed separation water body, so that the formation of the separation water body can be avoided in the working face extraction process, the scale of the separation water body is reduced, or the large-scale separation water body is intensively detected and amplified, and further the occurrence of separation water damage accidents is avoided.

title_en: SAR image change detection based on more granularities cascade forest model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of SAR image change detections based on more granularities cascade forest model, mainly solve the problems, such as conventional method to the strong dependency of disparity map, implementation is: the multidate SAR image I of given two width registration 1 And I 2 ；To I 1 And I 2 Disparity map I is generated with logarithm ratio operator d ；To I d It extracts class Lis Hartel and levies and be input to trained more granularity cascade forest models, generate two probability graph I 1 And I 0 And with disparity map I d Constitute new feature；Using new feature re -training model, new prediction result is obtained   Kappa coefficient and last Kappa coefficient compare, choose the higher prediction result of coefficient as final variation testing result.The present invention can effectively inhibit influence of the disparity map to final result, improve the accuracy rate of variation detection, can be used for environment measuring and disaster detection.

title_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure based on KPCA-FOA-LSSVM
abstract_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure disclosed by the invention based on KPCA-FOA-LSSVM, initially set up slip mass real-time system for monitoring and pre-warning, the real time data for obtaining monitoring section filters out landslide with core principle component analysis method and major influence factors occurs as input variable after its standardization；Building is based on LSSVM landslide disaster forecasting model；Then parameter optimization is carried out with drosophila algorithm, updates network parameter；The landslide disaster forecasting model optimized is finally reconstructed, output Landslide corresponds to plague grade, completes forecast.Method disclosed by the invention obtains monitoring data by establishing slip mass real-time system for monitoring and pre-warning, training output Landslide in the least square support vector machines model based on drosophila algorithm optimization is utilized after core principle component analysis filters out major influence factors, forecast efficiency is promoted, accuracy is increased.

title_en: Inverted cup type high-water-pressure telescopic composite drilling and cutting device for soft and hard strata
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground engineering rock and soil mass drilling and cutting and underground engineering disaster prevention and reduction, and provides an inverted cup type high-water-pressure telescopic composite drilling and cutting device for soft and hard strata. When drilling and cutting a hard stratum, high-pressure water pressure gathered in a high-pressure water bin is intensively applied to the upper space of the corresponding straight partition plate in the I-shaped pressurizer and is further intensively transmitted to the high-strength spring, and the high-strength spring is further compressed and deformed under the action of the concentrated pressure, so that various drilling and cutting tools at the bottom of the wear-resistant shell are driven to quickly drill and cut the hard stratum, and meanwhile, rock debris in the inverted-cup-shaped mud discharge channel can be discharged out of the pipe at a high speed by utilizing a high-pressure resistant pipe; on the contrary, when the construction is carried out in a soft stratum, the water pressure injected into the high-pressure water sump is reduced, and the water pressure of the high-pressure water sump and the soil pressure of the soft soil stratum are kept at the same level. The device has the characteristics of integration of drilling and cutting, uniform drilling and cutting force, low cost, high hole forming precision and high drilling and cutting speed.

title_en: Magnetic force conversion type intelligent tool changing, drilling and cutting device for soft and hard stratum
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground engineering rock and soil mass drilling, cutting and underground engineering disaster prevention and reduction, and provides a magnetic force conversion type intelligent tool changing drilling and cutting device for soft and hard strata. The device can realize the rapid drilling and cutting construction of soft and hard stratums by using the variable drilling and cutting system, realize the cutting of ultra-hard soil by arranging the central drill bit at the center of the device, realize the drilling and cutting of soft soil, hard soil and homogeneous stratums by arranging a plurality of shell-shaped drill bits and thread type drill bits at intervals at the periphery, realize the rapid discharge of rock debris of any stratum by using the water pumping and flushing system, improve the stratum adaptability of drilling and avoid the problem of large deviation of drilling construction hole sites of the soft and hard stratums.

title_en: The vertical combined type multidimensional of flank-for soft or hard stratum freezes cutting arrangement
abstract_en: The invention belongs to underground engineering Rock And Soil drilling, cutting and underground engineerings to prevent and reduce natural disasters technical field, provide a kind of vertical combined type multidimensional freezing cutting arrangement of the flank-for soft or hard stratum；By the way of the vertical combined type drilling of flank-, the longitudinal direction drilling of high-strength drilling head is driven to protrude into stratum by control telescopic arm until completing longitudinal drilling, door, which is controlled, by drilling head controls threaded bore cutting head and five angular bits cutting head rotation drilling stratum respectively, core drilling head rotary drilling is driven to cut into stratum with embedded be slidably connected of high-strength hollow center framework using on the outside of central rotating shaft, realize the soft or hard stratum of the compound drilling of multi-angle multicutter, it avoids deep hole drilling construction from meeting the problem that the hard-soft heterogeneous grounds such as rock weak soil are easy inclined hole, saves construction cost；Using the method for multidimensional multizone freezing in rich water hard-soft heterogeneous ground, realize that deep hole drilling construction longitudinal direction, vertical 360 degrees omnidirection are freezed, it is ensured that deep hole drilling is not collapsed, and reliable construction quality ensure that construction safety.

title_en: A kind of coal and rock multi- scenarios method integration experimental rig based on drilling cuttings method
abstract_en: A kind of coal and rock multi- scenarios method integration experimental rig based on drilling cuttings method, including true triaxial loading mechanism, gaseous fluid charging assembly, fluid liquid charging assembly, tail gas/discharge of wastewater recycling component, temperature signal collection component, charge signal acquisition component and acoustic emission signal acquisition component；True triaxial loading mechanism includes pressure chamber, four groups of horizontal addload cylinders and loads combination cylinder vertically, wherein the piston rod of one group of horizontal addload cylinder is hollow structure, slack coal conduit is equipped in piston rod center cavity, the inner end of slack coal conduit is equipped with nozzle plug disk, nozzle plug disk is inlaid in pressure head, the outer end of slack coal conduit is fixed with drilling machine, and the drilling rod of drilling machine is located in slack coal conduit；The present invention has the ability for applying true triaxial load, the loaded environment of " three high " state can be provided for coal and rock sample, in slack coal drilling operation can real-time monitoring acquisition stress, sound emission, charge and temperature data, and provide theory and Engineering Guidance for the prediction prevention and treatment of Deep Mine dynamic disaster.

title_en: Phosphine gas fumigates grain various factors coupling under environment and ignites mechanism research experiment platform
abstract_en: It fumigates grain various factors coupling under environment the invention discloses a kind of phosphine gas to ignite mechanism research experiment platform, including the grain containers for containing grain to be measured；Hydrogen phosphide for simulating phosphine fumigation environment prepares generator and phosphine gas effuser；For heating the electric heating plate of grain to be measured；Sparker for igniting；For acquiring thermocouple beam, temperature collecting module, gas sensor group, gas concentration acquisition module, electronic balance, computer and the high-definition camera of grain stacking inside and outside parameter to be measured；Exhaust fume collecting hood, smoke discharging pipe and smoke exhaust fan for smoke evacuation.This experiment porch by regulation to key parameters such as phosphine gas concentration, hot-spot source power, spark ignition power with combine, it discloses phosphine gas in silo and fumigates the grain that various factors coupling effect is lower under environment and ignite mechanism, the global optimization and progress of promotion silo Hot disaster control prece.

title_en: Tunnel-side slope system experimental rig under simulated rainfall geological process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses tunnel-side slope system experimental rigs under a kind of simulated rainfall geological process, characterized in that including artificial rainfall test system, ground water regime, uniform air bag loading system, model test box, geological process platform and test monitoring system；Subjects are placed in the bottom of the uniform air bag loading system, are further applied load by uniform air bag loading system to subjects；The subjects are located in model test box；The artificial rainfall test system is used for simulated rainfall, and water outlet is located on uniform air bag loading system；The geological process platform is located at the bottom of simulation test case.The utility model is achieved the utility model has the advantages that passing through the model test of the device, instability Mechanism under can reveal that tunnel-side slope system rainfall, seepage action of ground water, the earthquake the effects of and its under coupling provides effective foundation for the construction in tunnel, the preventing and reducing natural disasters of side slope, management, prediction.

title_en: A kind of wisdom storm-water system monitored based on Runoff Simulation and multisensor
abstract_en: A kind of wisdom storm-water system monitored based on Runoff Simulation and multisensor, the system includes Runoff Simulation and control host based on GIS, weather forecast and runoff satellite monitoring server, distributed small-sized weather station, facade rain condition monitor, mobile precipitation radar, infrared video monitor, evaporate measuring instrument, Storm Sewer Network flow monitoring instrument, water quality on-line monitoring instrument, air quality monitor, radar rainfall monitoring instrument, the area Xia Shen saturation monitor, accumulation zone water-level instrumentation, shallow groundwater monitor, flow path surface monitor, band tests the speed buoy waterproof unmanned plane, fiber temperature sensing system, fiber-optic pressure sensor system, communication module, intelligent controller, rainwater utilization facility water supply point, high-order rainwater hydroelectric generation module, diving delivery pump, pressurization is lower to seep device etc..The utility model carries out scientific early warning to rain disaster according to various parameters and alarms and use counter-measure, reduces building area or the disaster-stricken risk of building rain disaster.

title_en: A kind of water-level instrumentation of river regulation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of water-level instrumentation of river regulation, is related to river regulation technical field.The water-level instrumentation of the river regulation, including detection case, detection case is hollow structure, the inner cavity of detection case is equipped with measuring instrument, limbers is offered on the left of detection case, and shield is connected on the left of detection case, offers through slot at the top of detection case, seal box is fixedly connected on the right side of detection case, seal box is hollow structure.The water-level instrumentation of the river regulation plays the effect reinforced to monitor by setting seal box, drill bit, blade, screwed pipe, bull stick and turntable; river can not easily damage monitor; facilitate monitoring personnel to check SEA LEVEL VARIATION in time, according to SEA LEVEL VARIATION, makes corresponding measure; effective prevention the condition of a disaster occurs; the property safety of people is protected, structure is simple, easy to operate; without wearing many tools, the fixation to monitor can be reached.
assignees: HARBIN AOSHI WATER TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of massif disaster intelligent monitoring early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of massif disaster intelligent monitoring early warning systems, including signal box, mounting post, auxiliary positioning disk and mounting plate, the mounting post cylinder is equipped with the sensor of array distribution, mounting post surface is equipped with screw thread, mounting post lower end is fixed with drill bit, the auxiliary positioning disk is equipped with screwed pipe, the mounting plate right end is fixed with fixed plate, fixed thread bar is interspersed in fixed plate, fixed thread bar upper end is fixed with handle, signal box left end is equipped with control panel, placed cavity is equipped with inside signal box, processor is placed with inside placed cavity, rechargable power supplies are placed on the right side of processor, lower end is equipped with connecting line on the right side of rechargable power supplies, cradle is connected on the right side of connecting line, signal projector is fixed on signal box.Massif disaster intelligent monitoring early warning system of the present invention, installation letter are answered conveniently, and processor in real-time Data Transmission to computer, will avoid data from being retained in landslide on device and covered in utilization signal projector can not know specific data.

title_en: Simulation method and apparatus for predicting damage in downtown area due to landslide
title_ko: 도심지 토사 재해를 예측하기 위한 시뮬레이션 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A simulation method for predicting a soil disaster in an urban area comprises: a step of receiving terrain data for terrain including a mountain area and an urban area, generating terrain based on the terrain data, receiving structure data for a structure associated with the terrain, and generating a structure on the terrain based on the receiving structure to model terrain to be analyzed; a step of setting a first analysis target area which is at least a portion of the mountain area of the terrain to be analyzed, and a second analysis target area which is at least a portion of the urban area; a step of receiving boundary conditions for the first and second analysis target areas; a step of analyzing the flow of soil and rocks for the first and second analysis target areas based on the boundary conditions; and a step of visualizing the flow of soil and rocks for the first and second analysis target areas. The flow of soil and rocks for the first analysis target area is analyzed by a mountain area analysis solver, and the flow of soil and rocks for the second analysis target area is analyzed by an urban area analysis solver.
abstract_ko: 도심지 토사 재해를 예측하기 위한 시뮬레이션 방법은 산지 영역 및 도심 영역을 포함하는 지형에 대한 지형 데이터를 입력받고, 지형 데이터에 기초하여 지형을 생성하고, 지형에 관한 구조물에 대한 구조물 데이터를 입력받고, 구조물 데이터에 기초하여 지형 상에 구조물을 생성하여 해석 대상 지형을 모델링하는 단계; 해석 대상 지형에서 산지 영역 중 적어도 일부인 제 1 해석 대상 영역 및 도심 영역 중 적어도 일부인 제 2 해석 대상 영역을 설정하는 단계; 제 1 해석 대상 영역 및 제 2 해석 대상 영역에 대하여 경계 조건을 입력받는 단계; 경계 조건에 기초하여 제 1 해석 대상 영역 및 제 2 해석 대상 영역에 대한 토석류의 흐름을 해석하는 단계; 및 제 1 해석 대상 영역 및 제 2 해석 대상 영역에 대한 토석류의 흐름을 가시화하는 단계를 포함하고, 제 1 해석 대상 영역에 대한 토석류의 흐름은 산지 영역 해석 솔버(Solver)에 의해 해석되고, 제 2 해석 대상 영역에 대한 토석류의 흐름은 도심 영역 해석 솔버에 의해 해석될 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA RES INSTITUTE FOR HUMAN SETTLEMENTS;E8IGHT CO LTD;UNIV ULSAN FOUND IND COOP;HONGIK UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIA COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Long-distance tunnel rock burst microseismic monitoring method for TBM (tunnel boring machine) under soft-hard interbed geological condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-distance TBM tunnel rock burst microseismic monitoring method under soft-hard interbed geological conditions, which is characterized in that a hard rock area and a soft rock area in a tunnel are distinguished through geological exploration, hard rock drill holes in the hard rock area are subjected to drill hole shooting, and a microseismic sensor is arranged in the hard rock drill holes of a complete hard rock section in the hard rock area; and installing the micro-seismic monitoring system on the TBM, and communicating the wireless network bridge group with the rock burst micro-seismic monitoring center outside the tunnel. The method better solves the problems of installation and recovery of the microseismic sensor under the soft-hard interbed geological condition, avoids the influence of a soft rock area on receiving the microseismic monitoring signal, overcomes the difficulty that a transmission line of a long-distance tunnel signal is easy to damage, ensures the quality and continuity of microseismic monitoring of the rock burst, and lays a foundation for accurate early warning of the rock burst disaster. The method can be used for the safe excavation of the deep-buried long-distance TBM tunnel engineering under the complex geological condition.

title_en: Fire and explosive disaster environment simulation experiment system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of disaster environment simulation systems, and in particular relates to a fire explosion and poison disaster environment simulation experiment system which comprises an explosion shock wave generating device arranged at one end of a pipeline, a fire high-temperature generating device arranged in the middle of the pipeline and a toxic gas/particle environment generating device, and arranging pipelines at the fire high-temperature generating device and the toxic gas/particle environment generating device as test sections of the simulation experiment system. The invention has the advantages that: the invention provides a composite disaster experimental environment, which simulates the composite disaster environment of shock waves, toxic substances and high temperature by using an explosion shock wave generating device, a fire high-temperature transmitting device and a toxic gas/particle environment generating device on a pipeline, so as to provide guidance for researching the human body injury mechanism and individual protection technical requirements under the fire explosion and toxicity composite disaster environment and selecting proper emergency equipment for hazardous chemicals practitioners, and finally achieve the aim of protecting the life safety of people.

title_en: Landslide monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide monitoring method, which belongs to the field of geological disaster monitoring and is characterized by comprising the following steps of: a. drilling a hole on the landslide body; b. determining the length of the required push-button landslide monitoring device; c. taking out a cylindrical framework, removing the power supply memory, the emitter and the resistance reading meter on the rest cylindrical framework, sequentially connecting the line butt-joint devices in series, and finally screwing the line butt-joint devices and the screw butt-joint end of the standby cylindrical framework; d. putting the button type landslide monitoring device into the drilled hole, and filling dry sand bodies; e. connecting the solar cell panel with a power supply storage; f. when the slope body is displaced, the ITO conductive glass is extruded by the convex metal blocks, the ITO conductive glass is broken to cause the power failure of the transmitting loop, and the receiver loses signals to perform early warning. The whole monitoring method is simple and easy to operate, small displacement is generated by adopting a slope body, the device is extruded to generate early warning, the monitoring accuracy can be effectively improved, the early warning effect is good, and the applicability is strong.

title_en: A kind of covered karst based on discrete element method collapses catastrophe Evolution Simulation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to geological disaster mechanism study fields, it discloses a kind of covered karst based on discrete element method and collapses catastrophe Evolution Simulation method, mechanism is collapsed to covered karst using discrete element numerical method and catastrophe evolutionary process is analyzed, karst collapse overall process is disclosed from microcosmic angle, comprising: crackle is formed, particle peels off, soil cave is formed, soil cave is expanded, coating collapses；It analyzes and covers the displacement of layer soil body particle, the development trend of crackle, situation of change of system out-of-balance force etc. in collapse process, really to reflect that extraneous agent acts on more variation characteristics of lower catastrophe main body (covering layer soil body).The present invention obtains the critical soil cave balance height that covered karst collapses and the critical water flowrate degree that soil cave initially forms with discrete element numerical simulation method, and compared with notional result, analog result can punish for the prospecting of karst collapse geological disaster, work of preventing and reducing natural disasters provides reliable basis.

title_en: High hydraulic pressure Telescopic type composite drill blanking method for soft or hard stratum
abstract_en: The invention belongs to underground engineering Rock And Soil drilling, cutting and underground engineerings to prevent and reduce natural disasters technical field, provide a kind of high hydraulic pressure Telescopic type composite drill blanking method for soft or hard stratum.When drilling hard formation, corresponding word partition panel upper space inside I-shaped pressurizer is applied to by the high-pressure water pressure concentration of high pressure sump cohesion collection, and then it concentrates and passes to high strong spring, high strong spring further compressive deformation in the case where concentrating pressure effect at this time, to drive the quick drilling hard formation of all types of drilling cutters of wear-resistant outer casing bottom, while it can use anti-high-voltage tube and the landwaste high speed in the spoil disposal of falling cup type channel be discharged to outside pipe；Conversely, meeting soft formation construction, then the water pressure in injection high pressure sump is reduced, the soil pressure of the water pressure and soft soil layer that keep high pressure sump is in same level.Apparatus of the present invention have the characteristics that drilling cutting integration, drilling power is uniform, at low cost, pore-forming accuracy is high, drilling is fireballing.

title_en: Ocean platform blasting risk analysis method based on ABC-BRANN model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ocean platform blasting risk analysis method based on an ABC-BRANN model. Establishing an oil gas diffusion and explosion numerical model based on FLACS, and carrying out diffusion simulation in a typical scene; obtaining a diffusion-ABC-BRANN instantaneous predictor by combining an ABC-BRANN coupling algorithm, and predicting a large number of instantaneous gas cloud volume Q9 values; carrying out numerical calculation of a typical explosion scene, and developing an explosion-BRANN predictor by taking the maximum explosion overpressure as a data basis; randomly extracting a diffusion scene combination from a diffusion probability model by means of Latin sampling, taking the diffusion scene combination as the input of a diffusion-ABC-BRANN instantaneous predictor, obtaining instantaneous Q9 and Q6 values, and determining an optimal extraction sample by the convergence analysis of inverse cumulative frequency; and respectively substituting the obtained values Q9 and Q6 into an explosion-BRANN predictor and an explosion probability model to obtain an explosion load surging curve. The method can provide a design accident load value which reflects the blasting scene more truly, the load precision is higher, and the load value can be directly used for the anti-blasting design of the structure and provides support for the anti-blasting and disaster-reducing key structure design of the platform.

title_en: A kind of field crop pest and disease disasters recognition methods based on the full convolutional neural networks of improvement
abstract_en: It is a kind of that first pest and disease damage image is manually marked, is cut based on the field crop pest and disease disasters recognition methods for improving full convolutional neural networks, image will be cut and be divided into training, verifying collection；The operation of data augmentation is carried out to training, verifying collection, is then averaging, then subtracts the mean value of respective pixel position from augmentation training, the input of verifying collection image, then makees disorder processing, forms last augmentation training, verifying collection；Establish improved full convolutional neural networks model, using last augmentation training set image, to improving, full convolutional neural networks model carries out pre-training and second order training obtains final full convolutional neural networks model, collection image is verified to final full convolutional neural networks model evaluation using last augmentation, use full-scale crop leaf image as input, detects disease on the characteristic pattern for the final full convolutional neural networks model output assessed；Present invention recognition accuracy with higher, and reduce required memory and the training time of network model.

title_en: Three-dimensional obstacle avoidance method for earth surface close-range autonomous exploration unmanned aerial vehicle based on preset air route
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional obstacle avoidance method for a surface close-range autonomous exploration unmanned aerial vehicle based on a preset route, which comprises the following steps: when the unmanned aerial vehicle carries out a near-distance autonomous ground surface exploration task, selecting an artificial potential field method as an obstacle avoidance algorithm according to the task requirement; presetting a route for the unmanned aerial vehicle, and establishing a coordinate system from a starting point to a target point in the preset route; an artificial potential field method is improved, and an obstacle avoidance principle is proposed: introducing a line potential field to enable the unmanned aerial vehicle to return to a preset air line again after effectively avoiding the obstacle; the repulsion potential field is improved, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can escape from local minimum points independently; according to the post-disaster scene, constructing an obstacle avoidance scene for the unmanned aerial vehicle to execute the task, and constructing an obstacle scene by approximating the obstacle to a spherical shape; and in the obstacle avoidance scene, performing three-dimensional simulation analysis on the track and the speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle when the unmanned aerial vehicle executes the task, and verifying the feasibility of the method. The unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional obstacle avoidance method based on the preset air route can achieve three-dimensional obstacle avoidance of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the preset air route, the obstacle avoidance process track is smooth, and the speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle is stable.

title_en: Multi-point wave generating equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of wave making equipment, in particular to multi-point wave making equipment which comprises at least two groups of multi-point curve wave making machines, wherein each group of multi-point curve wave making machines are arranged in a straight line, each multi-point curve wave making machine comprises a wave making plate component for pushing water flow to form waves and a driving device for driving the wave making plate component, each wave making plate component is provided with two driving devices, the two driving devices are respectively arranged on one side of the back surface of the wave making plate component, two adjacent wave making plate components are arranged in a straight line and are flexibly connected, the bottom ends of all the wave making plate components are connected with the bottom end of a water pool, and the wave making plate components are pushed by the driving devices so that the water flow can generate the waves to simulate natural disasters such as the ocean.

title_en: Experience device for working on stepladder
abstract_en: To perform effective training for circumventing disasters in work using a stepladder.SOLUTION: An experience device for working on a stepladder includes: a stepladder; a support part for supporting the stepladder to be movable in a shaft rotation including a first shaft in a longitudinal direction of the stepladder and a second shaft in a width direction of the stepladder; and a drive unit capable of independently moving the stepladder supported by the support part in the shaft rotation including the first shaft and the second shaft.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 12
