title_en: System and method for extinguishing fire based on mobile augmented reality
title_ko: 모바일 증강현실 기반 화재 소화 훈련 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile augmented reality-based fire extinguishing training system and method that is capable of setting, simulating, and extinguishing a fire that can occur on the basis of mobile virtual reality or augmented reality. According to the present invention, the mobile augmented reality-based fire extinguishing training system includes: a fire extinguishing information module having a position of a fire, a material of an environment, a flammable material of the fire, a kind of fire extinguisher, and fire extinguishing training information; and a plurality of terminals for receiving the position of the fire, the material of the environment, the flammable material of the fire, the kind of fire extinguisher, and the fire extinguishing training information from the fire extinguishing information module to perform virtual fire extinguishing training, wherein each terminal includes: an environment setting module for scanning a space to set the space as a space of augmented reality or to set a space stored in advance as virtual reality as the set position of fire and receiving the position of the fire, the material of the environment, the flammable material of the fire, and the kind of fire extinguisher from the fire extinguishing information module to display the received result at the position of fire set to the virtual reality; and a training module for locating the fire extinguisher according to the kind thereof according to the set result of the environment setting module and performing training corresponding to the position of fire according to the fire training information, whereby the fire extinguishing training can be more effectively performed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일 가상현실(Virtual Reality) 또는 증강현실에 기반하여 환경에 발생 가능한 화재를 설정 및 시뮬레이션하고 이를 소화하는 것을 훈련하는 모바일 증강현실 기반 화재 소화 훈련 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 화재의 위치, 환경의 재질, 화재의 인화 물질, 소화기의 종류 및 소화훈련 정보를 포함하는 소방정보모듈; 및 상기 소방정보모듈로부터 화재의 위치, 환경의 재질, 화재의 인화 물질, 소화기의 종류 및 소화훈련 정보를 수신받아 가상의 소화훈련을 실행시키는 다수의 단말기;를 포함하고, 상기 단말기는, 공간을 스캔하여 이를 증강현실의 공간으로 설정하거나 또는 가상현실로 기저장된 공간을 설정된 화재 위치를 설정하고 상기 화재의 위치, 환경의 재질, 화재의 인화 물질, 소화기의 종류를 상기 소방정보모듈로부터 수신하여 가상현실로 설정된 화재의 위치에 표시하도록 하는 환경설정모듈; 및 상기 설정된 환경설정모듈에 따라 상기 소화기를 종류에 따라 배치하고 상기 소화훈련 정보에 따라 화재의 위치에 대응하는 훈련을 수행하도록 구성되며 훈련결과를 상기 소방정보모듈로 전송하는 훈련모듈;을 포함하여 구성되어 보다 효과적인 소방훈련이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: System and Method for Managing Spilled Oil Response Support
title_ko: 유출유 방제 지원 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for managing spilled oil response support, which supports response by two-way information exchange for information exchange between a manager, a sea contamination assessment technology (SCAT) expert, a marine spilled oil collector, and a costal volunteer worker and marine collection resources and coastal human resources. The present invention includes a field worker terminal inputting marine response resources and coastal volunteer registration information, provided with pre-instructional information from a response management server, and provided with information necessary for marine and coastal response; a field commander terminal providing work position and work content information during response by using a marine response worker′s and coastal volunteer worker′s field worker terminal and transmitting response situation information, work termination time, and worker and volunteer worker number information to the response management server once the marine response worker and the coastal volunteer worker terminate response; and the response management server performing work assignment information management, response situation management, and work progress management, provides training support and work information, and performing marine response worker and coastal volunteer worker registration processing while exchanging response information with the field worker terminal and the field commander terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 관리자, 해양오염 평가기술(SCAT) 전문가와 해상 유출유 수거 작업자 및 해안의 자원봉사자 간에 정보가 상호 교환되는 양방향 정보 교환을 통하여 방제를 지원하고 해상 회수 자원 및 해안 인적 자원을 관리하는 유출유 방제 지원 관리 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 해상의 방제자원 및 해안의 자원 봉사 등록 정보를 입력하고, 방제 관리 서버로부터 사전 교육 정보를 제공받고, 해상과 해안 방제에 필요한 정보를 제공받는 현장 작업자 단말;방제 작업시에 해상의 방제작업자와 해안의 자원봉사자의 현장 작업자 단말을 이용하여 작업 위치 및 작업 내용에 관한 정보를 제공하고, 해상의 방제작업자와 해안의 자원봉사자가 방제를 마치면 방제 상황 정보, 작업 종료 시간, 작업자 및 자원봉사자 수 정보를 방제 관리 서버로 전송하는 현장 지휘자 단말;상기 현장 작업자 단말 및 현장 지휘자 단말과 방제 정보를 교환하면서, 해상의 방제작업자와 해안의 자원봉사자 등록 처리를 하고, 교육 지원 및 작업 정보를 제공하고, 작업 배치 정보 관리, 방제 상황 관리, 작업 진행 관리를 하는 방제 관리 서버;를 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: A kind of fire disaster simulation based on virtual reality and rescue drilling system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of fire disaster simulation based on virtual reality and rescue drilling system, including field data acquisition module, model library constructs module, sunykatuib analysis module and fire fighting and rescue training module, the field data acquisition module, model library constructs module, sunykatuib analysis module and fire fighting and rescue training module are sequentially connected, the model library building module includes fire spread model, evacuation model and three-dimensional scene models, the sunykatuib analysis module includes site environment sunykatuib analysis unit, fire spread trend analysis unit, danger zone analytical unit and scene temperature prediction distribution unit.Fire disaster simulation provided by the invention based on virtual reality and rescue drilling system are conducive to improve the specific aim and validity of fire drill, and experience sense is strong.
assignees: TELEWAVE INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of true three-dimensional physical model pilot system of the prominent discharge disaster in simulation deep cavern
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of true three-dimensional physical model pilot systems of prominent discharge disaster in simulation deep cavern, including cartridge seal load counterforce device, super-pressure very three-dimensional loading system, SERVO CONTROL Thief zone Water hydraulic static pressure loading system, inclination geological structure manufacturing system, model cavern to excavate system and model comprehensive test analysis system automatically.Cartridge seal loads counterforce device as model test and loads counterforce device and for accommodating model and high-pressure water body, the very three-dimensional loading system of super-pressure carries out the very three-dimensional load of super-pressure, SERVO CONTROL Thief zone Water hydraulic static pressure loading system carries out Thief zone hydraulic pressure and loads automatically, and inclination geological structure manufacturing system, which is used to prepare, includes the architectonic model of inclination；Model cavern excavate automatically system for automatically excavate model cavern, model comprehensive test analysis system automatic collection model-test data simultaneously quick storage.The present invention is with a wide range of applications in terms of water burst geological disaster is dashed forward by simulation water power, traffic, the energy and mine deep cavern.

title_en: A kind of landslide is hydrogeological to monitor geophysical method and device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of monitoring geophysical method of landslide hydrologic condition and devices, belong to Geological Hazards Monitoring field.The device includes landslide surface potential monitoring device, landslide drilling potential monitoring device, control and measuring terminals, earth electric field power supply control power supply, long electrode and its noncontinuous electrode；Wherein long electrode successively penetrates gliding mass, slide strips and slider bed, noncontinuous electrode is disposed about in earth's surface long electrode simultaneously, long electrode and noncontinuous electrode is given to apply artificial electric field respectively using earth electric field power supply unit, if the changes of hydrogeological condition of the weak band on landslide, weak intercalated layer, weak argillization band, shearing changing of the relative positions structural plane will lead to electric field exception, it will be observed that potential change by surface potential monitoring device and landslide drilling potential monitoring device, to realize to landslide deformation and face sliding state carry out predict and landslide disaster early warning, the generation of effective prevention and control Landslide Hazards；The present invention has the characteristics that at low cost, implementation is simple, can be achieved 7x24 hours and continuously monitors.

title_en: A kind of building fire escape drilling system based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of building fire escape drilling system based on virtual reality technology, including student practices module, virtual reality rehearsal module and console module；It includes that wear-type stereoscopic display unit, fire-fighting process practice unit and fire-fighting equipment use unit that the student, which practices module,；The virtual reality rehearsal module includes that three-dimensional scenic construction unit, fire disaster situation display unit and prediction scheme deduce display unit；The console module includes role's setting unit, combat forces deployment unit and command scheduling unit.Building fire escape drilling system provided by the invention based on virtual reality technology, can effectively promote people to the cognitive ability of fire and learn indispensable fire disaster escaping technical ability.
assignees: TELEWAVE INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dense fog identifying system and methods for using them based on machine learning and conventional meteorological observation
abstract_en: Dense fog identifying system based on machine learning and conventional meteorological observation estimates inspection module, interface service module including user interactive module, surface weather observation message processing module, remote sensing data processing module, the dense fog recognition training module based on machine learning, the dense fog estimation block based on machine learning, the visibility rasterizing module based on RBF network, dense fog in PC machine.The application method of dense fog identifying system based on machine learning and conventional meteorological observation carries out real-time monitoring including dense fog of 9 steps to range 1km lattice point, and carries out road closed control based on the mist forecast of regional area group for relevant departments and provide data supporting.The present invention can reduce the huge cost of visibility meter laying, the loss of dense fog (including mist) disaster bring can be reduced by effectively monitoring dense fog (including mist), to greatly ensure that traffic route safety.Based on above-mentioned, so the present invention has a good application prospect.

title_en: Water column only starches two fluid grouting method in a kind of down-hole extra-deep hole drilling
abstract_en: The present invention relates to water columns in a kind of down-hole extra-deep hole drilling only to starch two fluid grouting method, belongs to mine water disaster prevention and control field.Comprising: the step of according to design parameter construction water blockoff inlet well, the step of accurate location of judgement storage conduit pipe, the step of discharge area of estimation storage conduit pipe, the step of calculating projected depth position of the base opening end of second level aperture casing in drilling, the step of tripping in second level aperture casing and sealing, connect simultaneously tripping in double the step of starching Grouting Pipe, sealing device step is installed, the step of double slurry Grouting Pipes and sealing device are dismantled after the step of carrying out grouting for water blocking after being installed and slip casting.It efficiently solves drilling in problems such as water-sensitive strata section undergauge, hole wall collapses, largely shorten the migration distance of mixed serum, it can achieve and inject double slurry mixed serums in the drilling of the down-hole of any depth, closure storage conduit pipe is fast implemented, achievees the purpose that grouting for water blocking.

title_en: House vibration damage matrix curvonic analysis system and method based on earthquake vibration parameters
abstract_en: The invention provides a house vibration damage matrix curvoing analysis method based on earthquake parameters and a corresponding system, which adopts a maximum likelihood estimation method based on the corresponding relation between intensity and earthquake parameters to convert the damage ratio result of correct house vulnerability matrix or actual vibration damage statistics into a double-parameter vulnerability curve, overcomes the defect of the vulnerability curve based on intensity, and particularly provides a simpler way for obtaining the vulnerability curve aiming at the structure types which are difficult to carry out simulated analysis, such as civil engineering, masonry and the like; based on the relation between the intensity and the earthquake motion parameters, the characteristic parameters of the earthquake vulnerability curves of various house structures are given, and basic data can be provided for the house building earthquake damage assessment based on the earthquake motion parameters. The method and the system have high reliability and wide application, and can be used for checking and perfecting the existing vulnerability matrix or curve so as to better serve the fields of quick earthquake disaster assessment, risk assessment, insurance assessment and the like.

title_en: Metering method for jet flow punching coal yield and coal collecting device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a metering method of jet flow punching coal yield and a coal collecting device, wherein the coal collecting device mainly comprises a high-pressure emulsion pump, a blowout prevention sleeve, a gas-water-coal separation box, a coal storage metering cabinet and a gas extraction pipe, wherein two ends of the high-pressure emulsion pump are respectively connected with a pump station water tank and a drilling machine, the blowout prevention sleeve is fixed on the wall of a drilling hole, and the drilling machine, the gas extraction pipe and the gas-water-coal separation box are respectively connected; two layers of drawing type filtering baffle plates are arranged in the gas-water-coal separation box, and a coal storage metering cabinet is arranged at the lower part of the gas-water-coal separation box; according to a certain volume of the coal storage metering cabinet, the mass of the washed pulverized coal in unit time can be calculated by multiplying the density of the precipitated pulverized coal by the volume of the coal storage cabinet; the invention can realize the timely collection of the granular coal and the pulverized coal, improves the metering and counting precision of the coal output, shortens the time for collecting the coal sample and reduces the labor intensity.

title_en: Multi-region freezing type for soft or hard stratum goes up and down drilling method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to underground engineering Rock And Soil drilling, cutting and underground engineerings to prevent and reduce natural disasters technical field, go up and down drilling method more particularly, to a kind of multi-region freezing type for soft or hard stratum；Using multizone independent-lifting formula drilling cutter, being combined with each other different zones drilling cutterhead, realization is independent to be moved up and down, and is realized and is selected rapid changing knife in knife and hole in the hole on any stratum, improve construction speed, has saved construction cost；Drilling method is freezed using freezing type simultaneously, refrigerated brine agent, which is controlled, by freezing controller releases refrigerated brine, and by cryovial as the vertical stretching of cutterhead is injected into stratum to be onstructed, realize the quick freezing drilling of bad ground multi-region domain partitioning, hard-soft heterogeneous ground is avoided in hole the quality accidents such as to collapse because rich water causes, reliable construction quality, it is at low cost；Have the characteristics that water rich strata freeze-over, jelly area's fast selecting, the drilling cutting integration of jelly area, drilling power is uniform, at low cost, pore-forming accuracy is high, drilling is fireballing.

title_en: Avalanche information extraction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an avalanche information extraction method, an avalanche information extraction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining satellite remote sensing image data and unmanned aerial vehicle laser radar point cloud data of a region to be detected, and then obtaining a potential avalanche simulation value of the region to be detected by utilizing a pre-constructed region optimal avalanche simulation model. And then, dividing the probability of the avalanche formation region of the region to be detected according to the potential avalanche analog value to obtain the avalanche disaster level information of the region to be detected. The device is used for executing the method. The embodiment of the invention obtains the information of the area to be detected by using the satellite and the unmanned aerial vehicle, obtains the potential avalanche simulation value corresponding to the area to be detected by using the pre-established area optimal avalanche simulation model, and extracts the avalanche disaster level information of the area to be detected, such as: potential avalanche regions and avalanche motion paths. Because the information that satellite remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicle obtained can be more comprehensive, also improved the accuracy of avalanche information, can carry out avalanche prevention and cure more comprehensively.

title_en: A kind of history meteorological disaster model integrated system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of history meteorological disaster model integrated systems, it include: Automatic meteorology monitoring station, data cell, mathematical model processing unit and Front End Server, the data cell is used to the meteorological data at Automatic meteorology monitoring station being uploaded to data warehouse, the mathematical model processing unit establishes temporal data model for carrying out carry out taxonomic revision to the historical data being stored in data warehouse.The utility model is based on big data processing technique, weather history disaster numerical model is subjected to taxonomic revision, and simulation anticipation is carried out by real time meteorological data, extreme meteorological disaster is given effectively to remind and coping mechanism, construct meteorological disaster monitoring, forecasting and warning and risk assessment DSS, the visualization for realizing the modelling, meteorological disaster data of the automation of risk assessment, the networking of information transmission, information analysis processing, brings most timely, most effective Forecast of Meteorological Disaster function for user.

title_en: A kind of portable sea-bottom shallow geological disaster simulator
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of portable sea-bottom shallow geological disaster simulator, including for simulated sea bottom shallow-layer geologic feature experiment package, for the fluid delivery assembly of the injection experiments fluid into experiment package, and the regulation component for regulation experiment component internal pressure, the gravel for simulating unconsolidated formation is preset in the experiment package, the both ends of the regulation component are connect with experiment package and fluid delivery assembly respectively.The present invention has many advantages, such as the safety of guarantee gas and oil in sea and exploitation, and easy to carry.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RES INST PETROLEUM ENG;UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM BEIJING

title_en: Method for determining unknown goaf range and old goaf residual settlement
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-speed railway geological disasters, and particularly relates to a method for determining the range of an unknown goaf and the residual settlement of an old goaf, which comprises the steps of collecting related data of the goaf, such as the conditions of peripheral coal bed distribution, mining and covering resources, drawing a settlement cloud picture, and determining the range of a suspected goaf; processing the suspected goaf range by adopting a PSP-InSAR deformation measurement technology, preliminarily determining that a goaf exists below the area and drilling if the anomaly of the goaf is also detected by a geophysical prospecting technical means for the suspected goaf area defined by the InSAR deformation measurement technology, and carrying out an indoor physical mechanical test on a sample taken out by drilling to obtain mechanical parameters of each stratum covered on the goaf to prepare for subsequent modeling; and finally, carrying out accurate modeling, and mutually verifying the numerical analysis result and the sedimentation result of the InSAR to finally obtain the influence range and the residual sedimentation of the old goaf.

title_en: Multi-time space scale-based electric power meteorological numerical weather forecast method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for forecasting electric power meteorological values based on multiple time-space scales, which are characterized in that collected multi-source heterogeneous electric power meteorological observation data are fused; and then obtaining a mesoscale numerical weather forecast mode, and finally carrying out probability forecast, weather forecast, short-term forecast and refined forecast on the electric power meteorological elements. The invention is based on fused electric power weather data, takes a mesoscale weather forecast mode as a core, adopts a deep learning method, a real-time four-dimensional data assimilation method, a rapid cyclic updating method, a horizontal grid resolution optimization method, a mode physical parameter disturbance method and a continuous integration method, realizes short-term, fine, probability forecast and weather forecast, can support electric power weather numerical forecast of multiple simulation functions of new energy resource assessment, short-term and ultra-short-term power forecast, disaster early warning of thunder, storm, strong wind and the like, effectively improves the accuracy of weather forecast data, and comprehensively improves the support level of a weather service power grid.

title_en: Electrical fire fault simulation and trace preparation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a set of electric fire fault simulation and trace preparation device, which comprises: the voltage regulating cabinet, the control cabinet and the combustion chamber can simulate common electrical faults such as short circuit, overcurrent, local overheat, underovervoltage and the like of an electrical circuit and equipment, prepare corresponding fire trace material evidence, realize the interconversion among various faults and reproduce real faults; the high-speed measurement of voltage and current can be realized, and the research depth is expanded; the modularized numerical control operation can be realized, and the convenient use is realized; stepless regulation of voltage and current can be realized, and the simulation method is optimized; the flexible arrangement of the combustion scene can be realized, and the method is close to the actual fire disaster; the multistage multiple protection can be realized, and the operation safety is ensured.

title_en: A kind of extensive Landslide Hazards Fast numerical simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of extensive Landslide Hazards Fast numerical simulation method and system, include the following steps: to obtain Landslide Hazards terrain data, source area range, elevation and physical and mechanical parameter；Divide extensive Landslide Hazards zoning；Thick tessellated mesh condition is judged, and to the roughening of zoning grid, mesh refinement and network；Numerical simulation calculation is carried out to earth's surface disaster dynamic process using numerical simulation software；The calculated result of n zoning is exported, and the calculated result of n zoning is merged into a zoning output.This method is by carrying out region division, grid thickness and structured grid to zoning; to there are material resource, calculative region to carry out fining calculating; there is no material resource, need the area grid calculated roughening; it not only realizes and the large-scale grid that calculates is calculated; and computation rate is improved, realize the Fast simulation calculating to extensive Landslide Hazards.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Partitioning method and device, the sprinkling control method of drug of target area
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of partitioning method and devices of target area.Wherein, this method comprises: obtaining the image of target area；Image based on the image recognition model identification object region that training obtains, obtains the density information of at least one of target area target object；Target area is divided according to the density information of at least one target object, obtains at least one connected region.The technical issues of present application addresses as when carrying out pesticide spraying operation using to not only being damaged to the plant not by cordyceps sinensis disaster caused by the sprinkling of entire plant growth area coverage, can also cause to waste, will also result in pollution to soil to pesticide.

title_en: Mine exogenous fire accident virtual emulation and emergency escape training method and system
abstract_en: Mine exogenous fire accident virtual emulation disclosed by the invention and emergency escape training method and system, belong to disaster prevention field.Method of the invention: high resolution numerical simulation and virtual reality technology are utilized, construct the virtual emergency drilling fire scenario of virtual mine exogenous fire, multi-user and virtual scene interaction are realized using input equipment, the virtual emergency drilling of mine exogenous fire is obtained close to the experience of natural fire accident, reaches good emergency drilling and result of training.System of the invention includes mine scene basic parameter according to library module, fire incident numerical simulation module, mine exogenous fire virtual reality basic scene building module, emergency drilling and escape training module, recruitment evaluation module, improves and optimizates module.The present invention has engineering application value in mine exogenous fire rescue training field, is able to ascend the related rescue know-how and escape ability of mine staff, improves the escape efficiency of underground work personnel when mine disaster occurs, reduce casualties.
assignees: CHANGCUN COAL MINE SHANXI LUAN ENV ENERGY DEV CO LTD;BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: Coal mine gas explosion disaster virtual emergency drilling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine gas explosion disaster virtual emergency drilling method and system, and belongs to the field of disaster prevention. The method comprises the following steps: the virtual emergency drilling method includes the steps that a virtual coal mine gas explosion disaster virtual emergency drilling gas explosion scene is built through a virtual reality technology, interaction between multiple users and the virtual scene is achieved through input equipment, experience that the coal mine gas explosion disaster virtual emergency drilling is close to real gas explosion accidents is obtained, and good emergency drilling and training effects are achieved. The system comprises a mine field basic parameter database module, a gas explosion numerical simulation module, a submodule for establishing a coal mine gas explosion disaster virtual reality basic scene, an initialization module, an emergency drilling and escape training module, an effect evaluation module and an improvement optimization module. The invention has better engineering application value in the field of rescue training of gas explosion disasters in coal mines, can improve the related rescue knowledge level and rescue capacity of mine workers, improves the escape and rescue efficiency and reduces the loss.

title_en: A kind of full-scale cabin fire spread and flash over imitative experimental appliance and experimental method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of full-scale cabin fire spread and flashes over imitative experimental appliance, including die body, matched simulated generating device, temperature measurement system and fume extractor.The die body forms simulation cabin by the ratio entity steel construction of 1:1；It is equipped with that model bed one is opened, couch one is opened, small sofa one is opened in cabin, is steel structure model, for conventional furniture in simulating chamber, model bed is located at the left side wall of cabin, and couch is located at rear wall, and small sofa is located at antetheca；The matched simulated generating device includes natural gas supply system and the ignition system that connect with natural gas supply system；The smoke evacuation system is used to for fire smoke being discharged through cabin rear wall gas vent.Inside fire sprawling of the present invention for routine experimentation teaching is tested with phenomena simulation is flashed over, and can carry out teaching demonstration experiment and fire-fighting operation real training, for firefighters, the daily fire fire-fighting technical training of part-time fireman and related practitioner.
assignees: NAVAL UNIVERSITY ENG PLA;ZHEJIANG YANING FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Environmenatl safety education system having the same
title_ko: 화재안전 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire safety training system having a firefighting experience room and a descending fire escape tool experience room. The firefighting experience room includes a fire extinguisher apparatus for training. The fire extinguisher apparatus for training includes: one or more fire extinguishing water supply units supplying the fire extinguishing water at a high pressure; and multiple fire extinguisher units for training which receive the high-pressure fire extinguishing water from the fire extinguishing water supply unit in order to spray the same. Each of the fire extinguisher units includes: a fire extinguisher body with a through internal space; connection pipes inserted in the fire extinguisher body while being connected to high-pressure pipes; spray pipes which are connected to the connection pipes and spray the high-pressure fire extinguishing water supply; heads which are respectively connected to the connection and spray pipes while having opening and closing valves therein; and a driving lever connected to the opening and closing valves of the heads to operate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재진압 체험실과 완강기체험실을 구비하는 화재안전 교육 시스템에 있어서, 상기 화재진압체험실은 물을 분사하도록 하는 교육용 소화 장치를 포함하고, 상기 교육용 소화장치는, 고압의 소화용수를 공급하는 하나 이상의 소화용수 공급부와, 상기 소화용수 공급부로부터 고압의 소화용수를 공급받아 분사할 수 있는 다수의 교육용 소화기를 포함하며, 상기 교육용 소화기는 내부가 관통 형성되는 소화기 몸체와, 상기 소화기 몸체의 내부에 삽입되고 상기 고압 배관과 연결되는 연결 배관과, 상기 연결 배관과 연결되고 고압의 소화용수가 분사되는 분사관과, 상기 연결 배관 및 상기 분사관이 각 연결되고 내부에 개폐밸브를 갖는 헤드와, 상기 헤드의 개폐밸브에 작동 가능하도록 연결된 작동 레버를 포함하는 화재안전 교육 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: CHANGJOIN CO LTD;LEE KYUNG SUK;LEE YOO KYUNG

title_en: Disaster recovery switching drilling system and method based on process scheduling engine technology
abstract_en: The disaster recovery switching drilling system based on the process scheduling engine technology comprises an organization architecture management module, a resource node management module, a plan management module, a switching instance management module, a process engine basic service module, an automatic task execution basic service module, a message reminding basic service module and a system configuration module, wherein the organization architecture management module is used for defining a personnel organization architecture for disaster recovery switching, the resource node management module is used for defining an object related to disaster recovery operation, the plan management module is used for defining the imaging of a plan, the switching instance management module is used for carrying out management control on a plan execution process; the flow engine basic service module automatically calls the automatic task execution basic service module, automatically calls the message reminding basic service module according to the setting, and sends the reminding short message. The invention also discloses a disaster recovery switching drilling method, which solves the problems of complex operation of the conventional system flow arrangement and difficult solidification of drilling results, and adopts a data consistency comparison module to compare and verify data of a production and disaster recovery terminal so as to ensure the availability of disaster recovery data.

title_en: A kind of power grid mountain fire monitoring and pre-alarming method based on geo-synchronous orbit satellite
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of power grid mountain fire monitoring and pre-alarming method based on geo-synchronous orbit satellite, the described method includes: obtaining the remote sensing images of geosynchronous satellite, GIS monitor supervision platform analyzes remote sensing images, after confirming doubtful generation mountain fire the condition of a disaster, first area range scene camera video data are obtained, mountain fire the condition of a disaster is confirmed.Meanwhile the particle algorithm by simulating flame, in conjunction with wind speed and direction data, at the time of calculating mountain fire spreading range in real time, and predict that mountain fire reaches electrical network facilities.The present invention is monitored mountain fire the condition of a disaster by dual validation testing, improves the accuracy of monitoring, while restarting live camera after confirming doubtful mountain fire the condition of a disaster information, reduces the transmission quantity of data.The anticipation for reaching the power grid live moment to fire is realized, the efficiency of rescue is improved.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: A kind of sampler of Accurate Determining coal seam gas-bearing capacity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of samplers of Accurate Determining coal seam gas-bearing capacity, including tool joint, surge drum and sampler barrel, the right end of tool joint is socketed with end cap, the right end of end cap is socketed with surge drum, surge drum and pilot seal set are socketed, pilot seal covers interior sliding sleeve and is connected to sampler barrel, the inner wall of pilot seal set and the outer wall of sampler barrel spline, and it is slidably connected tool joint between keyway by feather key, surge drum and sampler barrel, the right end of sampler barrel is threaded with drill bit, drill bit includes the internal bit body for being equipped with cavity and is arranged in the intracorporal hollow ring injector of drill bit, bit body one end is respectively equipped with internal layer from the inside to the outside, middle layer and outer layer cutter tip.The present invention guarantees the authenticity of gas bearing capacity to the greatest extent, operating process is simple, can it is soft it is projecting coal bed in be fast and accurately sampled, save sample time, improve depth selection and coal mine sampling work efficiency and safety, reduce the incidence of Gas Disaster accident.

title_en: The experimental method of HDPE bellows dynamic response under a kind of simulation earthquake load
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of experimental methods of HDPE bellows dynamic response under simulation earthquake load, the beneficial effects of the practice of the present invention is, disclose HDPE bellows strength change laws under earthquake motive force load action, for solving side slope pipeline engineering Safety production questions, instruct the development of the technologies such as the prevention of earthquake disaster that there is important practical significance and engineer application.

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method based on principal component analysis network and space coordinate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of hyperspectral image classification method based on principal component analysis network and space coordinate mainly solves the problems such as prior art space and complicated or insufficient and big using computation complexity when principal component analysis network progress hyperspectral classification Spectrum Data Fusion.Its scheme realized are as follows: first read the data set of high spectrum image；By data set, spatially piecemeal randomly selects training set and test set again；Then dimensionality reduction, normalization and edge are carried out to spectral information and retains filtering processing；Then space coordinate is expanded and is merged with spectral signature；Then principal component analysis network is trained, trained principal component analysis network is obtained；Test set data are inputted into trained principal component analysis network, obtain the feature vector of each pixel in test set；Finally classification results are obtained using support vector machines.Present invention reduces computation complexities, improve classifying quality, can be applied to resource exploration, forest cover, the target identification in disaster monitoring.

title_en: A kind of method and device constructing prediction of forest fire disaster model
abstract_en: This application provides a kind of method and devices for constructing prediction of forest fire disaster model, this method comprises: the history natural forest fire information and history meteorological data information and vegetation pattern information of acquisition target area；To there are the data records of lacuna to be filtered in the information of acquisition, filtering information is obtained；Filtering information is smoothed using logistic function, obtains smoothing information；Smoothing information is normalized, normalizing information is obtained, history meteorological data normalizing information when history natural forest fire normalizing information occurs with the fire when fire is occurred is corresponding；Using history meteorological data normalizing information and vegetation pattern information as input, using the history natural forest fire normalizing information of history meteorological data normalizing information MAP as output, long mnemonics model in short-term is trained, until the model of training meets pre-set required precision, prediction of forest fire disaster model is obtained.The precision of prediction of risk of forest fire can effectively be promoted.

title_en: Device and method for simulating composite dynamic disaster in coal mine deep mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for simulating a composite dynamic disaster in coal mine deep mining.A dynamic loading module provides power for a high-pressure-resistant sealed cavity module; the high-pressure-resistant sealed cavity module comprises a high-pressure-resistant sealed cavity and a pressure-bearing base; the high-pressure resistant sealed cavity is provided with a lead output end, an input end and an output end; the input end is a vacuumizing end, an inflating end and a sensor connecting end; the output end is connected with a transparent pipeline through an explosion-proof high-speed pneumatic valve, and the upper plane of the transparent pipeline is provided with a gas pressure sensor interface, a temperature sensor interface and a gas concentration sensor interface; an infrared thermal imager and a split high-speed camera are arranged beside the transparent pipeline. The invention is used for carrying out experimental research on the composite dynamic disaster in the deep coal mining, and has important scientific significance and practical value for further analyzing the occurrence mechanism of the composite dynamic disaster, adopting the targeted composite dynamic disaster prediction, early warning and treatment technology and solving the safety problem in the deep coal mining.

title_en: A kind of oil-gas pipeline impact disaster simulation experiment porch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of oil-gas pipelines to impact disaster simulation experiment porch.The oil-gas pipeline impacts disaster simulation experiment porch, including fixed system, shock loading system, camera system, data acquisition and analysis system.The fixed system is the arrying main body of the utility model, the shock loading system provides impact energy for the utility model, the camera system is for recording Impact Load in the process of oil-gas pipeline, and the data collection system is for recording and analyzing the changing rule that oil-gas pipeline is subjected to impact ess-strain after load.The utility model acts on the morphological change characteristics of lower oil-gas pipeline by observing different impact energys; analyze different size impact energy under the conditions of oil-gas pipeline stress, strain evolution features; it can get damage and failure feature and evaluation condition of the oil-gas pipeline under external Impact Load, to take reasonable oil-gas pipeline safeguard measure to provide theoretical foundation.

title_en: The measuring device and method of primary production of phytoplankton based on chlorophyll fluorescence
abstract_en: The invention discloses the measuring devices and method of a kind of primary production of phytoplankton based on chlorophyll fluorescence, under dark conditions, continue 60s or more by simulation light source and irradiates algae sample, using algae to illumination history dependent, monocycle and relaxation fluorescence kinetic profiles in the case where clearance measurement illumination condition is momentarily closed in emulation illumination 50ms, obtain Change of Chlorophyll Fluorescence Kinetics Parameters under photopic conditions, it is induction excitation light source, using photomultiplier tube as fluorescent probe using diode laser matrix, for measuring algae chlorophyll fluorescence kinetics curve；Using crown optical collector, multiband light detector array, underwater photosynthetically active radiation measuring unit is designed, measures natural environment spectrum corresponding with algae Absorption Characteristics.Structure of the invention is compact, small in size, low in energy consumption, can be realized the measurement of primary production of phytoplankton quick in situ, provides a kind of new tool for red tide and the early warning of wawter bloom disaster monitoring, the raw power investigation and assessment of ocean primary.

title_en: Building disaster-affected estimation simulation system and method
abstract_en: To provide a building disaster-affected estimation simulation system that simulates a disaster-affected level of buildings due to earthquakes on the basis of earthquake data about known earthquakes.SOLUTION: A building disaster-affected estimation simulation system 1 comprises: a design building model generation unit 31 that generates a design building model mathematizing a motion of a building 2 being an estimation simulation object due to earthquakes; a known earthquake data acquisition unit 32 that acquires earthquake data about known earthquakes; a distance azimuth setting unit 33 that sets a distance to a location and azimuth where the known earthquake occurs, from the building 2; a ground acceleration calculation unit 34 that calculates ground acceleration in accordance with the distance and azimuth; an earthquake response analysis unit 35 that inputs the ground acceleration calculated by the ground acceleration calculation unit 34 into the design building model, and conducts an earthquake response analysis; and a disaster-affected information calculation unit 36 that calculates disaster-affected information on the building 2, using an earthquake response analysis result and the ground acceleration.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Novel typhoon tracking detection method and system based on aircraft airship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel typhoon tracking detection method and system based on an air airship, and belongs to the field of monitoring and early warning of natural disasters in an air information system. The typhoon tracking detection system comprises a typhoon tracking flight controller, a shipboard wind detection radar, a floating air image sensing node, a weather sensing fixed-point feeder, a shipboard receiver and a high-resolution digital typhoon simulation system, wherein the typhoon tracking flight controller, the shipboard wind detection radar, the floating air image sensing node, the weather sensing fixed-point feeder and the shipboard receiver are carried on an airship, and the high-resolution digital typhoon simulation system is arranged on a ground workstation. The method of the invention utilizes the airship to track the typhoon position, puts sensing nodes into the typhoon according to the needs, collects internal measurement data through the sensor, transmits the internal measurement data back to the ground station through the airship, carries out assimilation simulation on the typhoon, and realizes forecasting and disaster reduction. The invention is not restricted by the foundation, the airship can track and monitor the whole process of typhoon generation, development and extinction over the ocean, and compared with the existing foundation and space-based detection method, the invention has the advantages of long-term sky-staying, wide-area coverage, continuous tracking and real-time data return.

title_en: Information synchronization method and device among load balancing nodes and processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and a processing device for information synchronization among load balancing nodes, which relate to the technical field of communication and comprise the following steps: receiving a message forwarded by the switch, wherein the message comprises a source address, the load balancing node and the switch are in the same available area, and the load balancing node is in communication connection with the switch; distributing a destination address for the message; determining a message forwarding path according to a source address and a destination address; sending a message forwarding path to other load balancing nodes; wherein the other load balancing nodes comprise load balancing nodes belonging to different available areas from the load balancing node. The embodiment of the invention realizes the function of simulating multicast synchronization on the premise of not depending on the switch, can more efficiently carry out load scheduling among clusters, improves disaster tolerance capability, reduces development cost and improves system stability.

title_en: Stress balance and vibration-damping disaster-prevention high pier structure for high and steep side slope of highway and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high bridge pier structure with stress balance and vibration reduction and disaster prevention for a high and steep slope of a highway and a construction method, wherein the prestressed anchor cables (6) eliminate the horizontal thrust action of a slope body on a pile foundation high bridge pier structure arranged in the air; the inner arch tie beam (5) realizes the dispersion of the prestress and the horizontal thrust of the side slope on the action stress of the pile foundation high pier structure; the vibration-damping rubber pads (7) increase the flexibility of the pier structure, and reduce structural failure and side slope disasters of the pile foundation high pier structure and the side slope body caused by vibration. The construction method comprises the following steps: the construction method comprises the following steps of material preparation and manufacturing, pile foundation construction, drilling, inner arch tie beam (5) construction, prestressed anchor cable (6) pouring and tensioning, pier construction and the like, and the construction method is simple. The method has wide application prospect in reinforcing, vibration reducing, disaster preventing and the like of the high and steep side slope pile foundation high pier structure of the traffic infrastructure in the vertical and horizontal regions of the ravine in the mountainous area.

title_en: Simulator system and simulation method for the public evacuation response system during a radiological emergency
title_ko: 방사능 재난 대응 시뮬레이터 시스템 및 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulator system and a simulation method for radiation emergency response and, more specifically, to a simulator system and a simulation method for radiation emergency response capable of predicting an evacuation process of residents during a radioactive disaster using a system dynamics concept. According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is the simulator system comprising a modeling part for storing a numerical model related to the behaviors of the residents in a plurality of events related to the resident protection measure, a setting part for inputting data necessary for calculating the numerical model, and a simulation part for calculating the behaviors of the residents on the basis of the data in the numerical model, and transmitting the calculated result to an external device. The numerical model is a mathematical model which shows a rate of change of the number of residents located within a precautionary protection zone over time. The calculated result is a change in the number of residents located within the precautionary protection zone over time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사능 재난 대응 시뮬레이터 시스템 및 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 시스템 다이내믹스 개념을 활용하여, 방사능 재난 시, 주민 대피 과정을 예측할 수 있는 방사능 재난 대응 시뮬레이터 시스템 및 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시예는 주민 보호 조치에 대한 복수의 이벤트에서 주민의 거동에 관한 수치모델이 저장된 모델링부와, 수치모델의 연산에 필요한 데이터를 입력하는 설정부와, 수치모델에 데이터를 바탕으로 주민의 거동을 연산하고, 연산결과를 외부 장치로 송신하는 시뮬레이션부를 포함하고, 수치모델은 예방적 보호 조치 구역 내에 위치한 주민수의 시간에 대한 변화율을 나타내는 수학적 모델이고, 연산결과는 시간에 따른 예방적 보호 조치 구역 내에 위치한 주민수의 변화인 방사능 재난 대응 시뮬레이터 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Water injection method for coal seam floor fracture in rock burst dangerous area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water injection method for breaking a coal bed bottom plate in a rock burst dangerous area, which effectively solves the problems of blasting and breaking the roadway bottom plate with bottom coal, injecting water into the blasting and breaking roadway bottom plate through an insertion pipe, preventing accident disasters and ensuring the production safety of a coal mine; drilling a determined blasting fracture bottom plate according to the head-on distance after the fully-mechanized excavation time lag of a weak impact dangerous section of the excavation working face and the thickness of the bottom coal of the roadway containing the coal-gangue interaction layer, and alternately drilling pressure relief blasting holes and water injection holes on the bottom plate of the roadway along the trend of the roadway; inserting a pipe into the drilled hole for water injection; and determining the increment of the water content according to the weakening condition of the impact tendency strength of the coal bed by using a measuring instrument according to the relationship between the water content and the impact tendency of the coal. The method is novel and unique, easy to operate and use, high in working efficiency and good in using effect, prevents accidents from happening, and ensures safe production of coal mines.

title_en: Fire image identification method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of image information processing, and discloses a fire disaster image identification method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: collecting smoke pictures and normal pictures in the early period of a fire as a training set and a test set of a convolutional neural network; obtaining dark channel images of each image to form a final training set and a final test set; constructing a convolution neural model whether smoke can be detected; training the neural network to obtain a smoke detection model, and testing and evaluating the performance of the most red model. Compared with the prior art, the method improves the accuracy of smoke detection in a single image by utilizing the dark channel image and the deep learning method, improves the detection speed, and can be practically applied to the fire detection work of cities or forests.

title_en: A kind of power construction maintenance training system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of power construction maintenance training system, at present field of electricity construction exist because the carrying out measures that powers failure, electrical verification, installing are grounded and fence etc. is most basic are not in place and caused by power construction accident.By summarizing existing power construction accident case, carry out the building of power construction case, it include project under construction and the link that disaster may occur in case, it is operated for user, it is final to carry out result judgement, achieve the purpose that carry out carrying out safety education by accident, avoids the generation again of accident.Wherein the building of case enhances the experience feeling of immersion of system by the way of three-dimensional simulation, and wherein power construction accident is summarized by database, and carries out movement decomposition, and case building person is made to complete whole case building by the selection of micromotion.
assignees: ZUNYI HUAZHEN CABLE BRIDGE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of transmission line of electricity heavy rain Prediction of Landslide and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to electrical engineering technical field, disclose a kind of transmission line of electricity heavy rain Prediction of Landslide and system, with can quickly and effectively to landslide prone district may disaster-stricken overhead line structures and equipment carry out analysis prediction；The method comprise the steps that the history heavy rain land slide data of the transmission line of electricity tower bar in acquisition area to be analyzed obtains initial data set, initial data set is divided into training dataset and validation data set；Binary tree computation model is established according to training dataset, and whether effective using validation data set verifying binary tree computation model；Area to be analyzed is obtained in the heavy rain Landslide Prediction data of future time instance, heavy rain Landslide Prediction data are inputted into binary tree computation model, if the output valve of binary tree computation model belongs to first threshold range, judge that the transmission line of electricity tower bar in the area to be analyzed can come down；If the output valve of binary tree computation model belongs to second threshold range, judge that the transmission line of electricity tower bar in the area to be analyzed will not come down.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Optical fiber single-hole layered settlement monitoring device and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical fiber single-hole layered settlement monitoring device, which belongs to the field of geological disaster monitoring and comprises a plurality of cylinders which are connected end to end and are respectively arranged in different depth formations, a plurality of fiber bragg grating sensor arrays respectively arranged on the inner walls of the cylinders, demodulation equipment and a data processing module which are connected with the fiber bragg grating sensor arrays, and a filling medium; the fiber grating sensor array comprises a plurality of fiber grating sensors which are respectively arranged in the cylinder, are connected in series through one fiber and are distributed along the axial direction of the cylinder. The optical fiber single-hole layered settlement monitoring device provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in installation and low monitoring cost. The invention also provides a fiber single-hole layered settlement monitoring method which comprises the steps of drilling an implantation hole, implanting a cylinder into the implantation hole, enabling the cylinder to correspond to each layer one by one, enabling the cylinder to be coupled with a stratum, obtaining a strain signal and processing the strain signal. The optical fiber single-hole layered settlement monitoring method provided by the invention can realize distributed monitoring of settlement of different layers of single holes.

title_en: Simulation experiment device and method for preventing and treating gas and fire symbiotic disaster through biotechnology
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation experiment device and a simulation experiment method for preventing and controlling gas and fire symbiosis disasters by biotechnology, which comprises a gas injection system, a liquid injection system, a gas extraction system and a temperature and pressure measurement system which are respectively connected with a pressure-resistant and heat-insulating experiment box, the gas injection system comprises an oxygen cylinder, a nitrogen cylinder and a methane cylinder which are arranged in parallel, the liquid injection system comprises a biological agent preparation box, the air extraction system comprises a micro air extraction pump and a micro vacuum pump which are respectively communicated with the pressure-resistant heat-insulation experiment box, the micro air extraction pump is connected with a gas chromatograph, the temperature and pressure measuring system comprises a plurality of temperature measuring probes and a temperature tester which are arranged in a pressure-resistant heat-insulation experiment box, and also comprises a pressure sensor which is arranged in the pressure-resistant heat-insulation experiment box, the temperature measuring probe is connected with a temperature tester through a thermal resistance wire bundle, and the temperature tester, the pressure sensor and the gas chromatograph are all connected with a computer analysis system. The device provided by the invention is simple in structure and convenient in data acquisition, and can provide a data basis for other related experimental researches on disaster-causing mechanisms of gas and fire symbiosis disasters.

title_en: A kind of anchoring, pore self-sealing and Sewage treatment casing certainly for cavitation jet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of anchoring, pore self-sealing and Sewage treatment casings certainly for cavitation jet, including housing tube assembly, inner sleeve tube assembly and gland, inner sleeve tube assembly twist-on is in the inside of outer sheath assembly, extend housing tube assembly in the rear end of inner sleeve tube assembly, gland is fixed on the rear end of housing tube assembly, and it is mutually pressed with inner sleeve tube assembly, return flume is provided on the faying face of inner sleeve tube assembly and gland, the water return outlet with return flume connection is provided on gland, water return outlet is connected with sewage recovering system.The present invention it is mountable on the drilling rod of cavitation jet using also can be used alone, it can be realized from anchoring, pore self-sealing, the function of Sewage treatment, effectively prevent secondary disaster caused by Gas Outburst, Sewage treatment, anchoring, pore self-sealing are easy to operate certainly, structure novel is skillfully constructed, and has a good application prospect.

title_en: A kind of experimental provision invading pit shaft for simulating Shallow fluid
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of for simulating the experimental provision of Shallow fluid intrusion pit shaft comprising: casing；Drilling apparatus, the drill bit being connect including the drill string protruded into casing and in casing and with drill string；For driving the driving device of drill string rotating, driving device is set to outside casing and connect with drill string；For injecting the drilling fluid injection device of drilling fluid into drill string, drilling fluid injection device is set to outside casing, and is connect with drill string；For injecting the Shallow fluid injection device of Shallow fluid into casing, Shallow fluid injection device is set to outside casing, and is connected to casing；For detecting the pressure-detecting device of set overpressure, pressure-detecting device and casing connection.Pressure change when boring the operating condition for meeting shallow-layer geological disaster under the utility model energy real simulation drilling condition, and the intrusion of shallow-layer geological disaster fluid can be monitored inside pit shaft.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM BEIJING;CNOOC RES INST CO LTD

title_en: A kind of groups of building fire three-dimensional sprawling analogy method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of groups of building fire three-dimensional sprawling analogy method, belongs to civil engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters technical field.This method initially sets up inside fire progressions model, then establishes three-dimensional fire spread model between building, finally carries out the simulation of groups of building fire spread.Indoors in fire development model, fire development is divided into 4 stages: it is on fire, with a loud crash, sufficiently develop, decay, this 4 stages are described using temperature and heat release rate curve, different types of structure uses different parameters of curve；Three-dimensional fire spread model is made of radiation model, Thermal plume model and ignition condition between building, and wherein heat radiation and the calculating of Thermal plume are based on three-dimensional system of coordinate；The simulation of groups of building fire spread refers to the fire spread situation in conjunction with fire spread modeling groups of building three-dimensional between inside fire progressions model and building.The present invention is contemplated that the influence that dimensional topography spreads building fire, provides sprawling coverage, provides important decision reference for fire rescue and prevention.

title_en: Urban building group seismic response dynamic visualization method based on oblique photography data
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic visualization method for earthquake response of an urban building group based on oblique photography data, and belongs to the technical field of civil engineering. Firstly, preparing data, including city geographic information basic data, building group earthquake power reaction course data and oblique photography aerial photography pictures; then, modeling a three-dimensional live-action model, and accelerating the modeling by using various optimization methods of waypoint sparseness, detail level adjustment and computer cluster assistance; then model singleness and post-processing are carried out, including building model singleness, texture compression and environment model flattening; and finally, realizing the dynamic visualization of the reality sense of the earthquake reaction of the building group by using the three-dimensional live-action model, the urban geographic information basic data and the earthquake dynamic reaction history data of the building group. The method can truly display the earthquake displacement process of the building, can be used for virtual emergency drilling in cities, and provides decision reference for earthquake-proof and disaster-reduction planning, emergency plans and the like.

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and system integrating data driving and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd evacuation simulation method and a system for integrating data driving and reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring real video data, and carrying out crowd tracking according to the video data; group division is carried out on the crowd according to the motion similarity, and path information of each group is obtained; initializing scene information and crowd positions, and dividing the crowd into groups; according to the path information of the group in the video, combining reinforcement learning training optimal strategy to realize path planning of the group in the scene; generating paths of individuals in the groups according to the path information of each group; and performing collision detection among individuals, and performing real-time coupling with crowd motion in video data to realize crowd motion simulation. The invention can simulate the social behavior of the crowd in a dynamic environment realistically, embody the self-organization phenomenon of the crowd, reduce the dependence on real data quantity and provide reference for the establishment of crowd evacuation schemes.

title_en: Intelligent landslide monitoring device and method based on LSTM shot and long term memory network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligent landslide monitoring device and method based on LSTM shot and long term memory network, it is related to landslide monitoring early warning and artificial intelligence field, pass through the different input feature vector value of the acquisition to landslide Historical Monitoring data, such as surface deformation, deep displacement, level of ground water, pore water pressure, seepage velocity, and whether unstability adds data label on landslide, and monitoring data are divided into training set, verifying collection, test set according to a certain percentage；Training set carries out gradient decline training under LSTM network, obtains training pattern；Verifying collection, test set are run in training pattern obtains accuracy rate as a result, by determining model and data set adjustment direction to interpretation of result, obtains the higher monitoring model of accuracy rate by constantly debugging.Present invention combination artificial intelligence optimization's algorithm improves the accuracy for landslide disaster prediction, reduces the cost of landslide disaster monitoring device, in conjunction with the monitoring for being generalized to other classes landslide after transfer learning on a large scale.

title_en: Storage cluster data recovery verification method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storage cluster data recovery verification method and a device, wherein a storage cluster comprises a main node and a plurality of slave nodes; the main node stores cluster effective information; and the master node controls the slave node to simulate the disaster and recover the cluster system, and the data recovery is verified through the effective cluster information before and after the disaster. The invention actively simulates the disaster, recovers the system data, verifies the effective information before and after the disaster, if the information before and after the disaster is consistent, the recovery is successful, and the recovery process of the storage cluster data is available. The invention can effectively verify whether the data recovery process of the storage cluster is available or not, and improve the stability and reliability of the storage system.

title_en: High salt volume removes emergent sewage filtration liquid treatment facility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-salinity mobile emergency sewage leachate treatment device, which comprises: the device comprises a centrifugal filter, a reservoir, a separator, an exchanger, a regulating balance pool, a high-pressure pump and an ultrafiltration system, wherein a raw water inlet, a sewage outlet and a water outlet are formed in the centrifugal filter, the reservoir is arranged at the side end of the centrifugal filter, the separator and the exchanger are arranged at the side end of the reservoir, the regulating balance pool is arranged at the side end of the exchanger, the high-pressure pump is arranged at the side end of the regulating balance pool, the ultrafiltration system is arranged at the side end of the high-pressure pump, combination of all devices is provided, and a small water purification plant is effectively simulated, so that the device can be used for sewage purification in some remote places or disaster areas where natural disasters occur, and areas where water quality is polluted, and an emergency effect is achieved, and the.
assignees: GUANGDONG TAIQUAN ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of flood personnel's dynamic evacuation path analysis method based on cellular automata
abstract_en: Flood personnel's dynamic evacuation path analysis method based on cellular automata that the invention discloses a kind of, the complexity and particularity in path are evacuated for flood process personnel, based on evacuation mechanism of people during flood, the method specifically includes: according to the survey region basic data of collection, typical flood series process is simulated, the flood emergency evacuation scene based on cellular automata is constructed；For the flood series process of simulation, the identification dynamic flood obstacle distribution of flood obstacle judgment rule is formulated；According to the pathfinding Behavior law of people, formulates distance and be superimposed regular and dynamic minimum around line discipline, on the basis of constructing dynamic detour distance field, the flood personnel dynamic of realization evacuates the planning in path.The invention can plan that the dynamic under various flood responsiveness evacuates path, and in combination with the best evacuation time range of flood series process rapid solving diverse geographic location, have important theory and practice meaning for the formulation of flood control and disaster reduction emergency preplan.

title_en: Road high slope landslide hazard early warning method based on evaluation function training
abstract_en: The invention provides a road high slope landslide hazard early warning method based on evaluation function training, and belongs to the field of prediction and research of road high slope landslide hazard. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that road high slope values obtained based on digital elevation model DEM data are analyzed by utilizing returned monitoring data of a high slope with a sensor and topographic and geological information, and a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is constructed to divide landslide disaster grades; establishing a landslide disaster evaluation function related to the position coordinates of the high slope, and evaluating the landslide disaster risk of the high slope without a sensor; and setting a threshold value, and when the landslide risk assessment value is larger than the threshold value, automatically alarming. The method provided by the invention creatively considers the geographical position of the high slope by training and learning the existing data, overcomes the limitations of high cost of slope sensor layout, sensor monitoring information loss and the like in the practical implementation process, and has important significance for research and prediction of road high slope landslide disasters.

title_en: A kind of subway large passenger flow rehearsal simulation training system and method
