title_en: A kind of system and method that simulation deep layer Toppling Deformation is developed and caused disaster
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of system and methods that simulation deep layer Toppling Deformation is developed and caused disaster.The system comprises: geotechnical centrifuge, model casing, side slope model, multiple differential displacement sensors and high-speed camera.The geotechnical centrifuge is connect with the model casing, the model casing is used to provide placement space for the side slope model, the side slope model is placed in the model casing, the multiple differential displacement sensor is installed on the side slope model, and the high-speed camera is installed on the hanging in basket of the geotechnical centrifuge.The present invention is by building model identical with Metamorphic Rockss character in practice, simulate valley trenching effect, it is really natural environment using geotechnical centrifuge model, pass through the centrifugal model test in four stages, simulate the evolution process of deep layer Toppling Deformation, and the data and photo acquired according to differential displacement sensor and high-speed camera finally obtain the key factor and Flood inducing factors of deep layer Toppling Deformation by simulation calculation.

title_en: A kind of down-hole drilling is interior along journey temperature infrared test device and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to, along journey temperature infrared test device and method, be made of carbon fiber pipe, idler wheel, Minitype infrared tester, tester power extending line, protective cover, signal processor, Signal Monitor, signal transmssion line in a kind of down-hole drilling.Idler wheel is installed at first carbon fibre pipe both ends, and Minitype infrared tester is installed on top, and protective cover is installed in outside, and power extending line and signal transmssion line are pierced by inside carbon fiber pipe, signal transmssion line connection signal processor, Signal Monitor.Carbon fiber pipe is slowly pushed into drilling with certain speed, Minitype infrared tester data measured passes through signal transmssion line to signal processor, processed signal is shown by Signal Monitor, reflects the situation of change of temperature in drill hole field, passes through crack situation in the judgement drilling of analysis temperature field.Present invention design is simple, can test along journey crack in down-hole drilling, predict that coal rock dynamic disaster provides a kind of new thinking for underground.

title_en: It is a kind of for monitoring the device of geological disaster
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of for monitoring the device of geological disaster, is related to monitoring technology for geological hazards field.This is used to monitor the device of geological disaster; including device noumenon; the inside of described device ontology is socketed with bull stick; the right end of the bull stick is flexibly connected with the right side of device noumenon inner wall; the left end of the bull stick is flexibly connected by rotor with the output end of first driving device; the outer surface of the first driving device is socketed with protecting box, and the right side of protecting box and the left side of device noumenon are welded, and there are two support rings for the side surface socket of the bull stick.This is used to monitor the device of geological disaster, by being provided with first driving device, support ring, lifter plate, brace, lifting column, movable plate, hinge bar, the second driving device, drill bit and pivoting leaf, adjusting while height increases makes drill bit be inserted into ground, it ensure that the stability of device noumenon, better adaptability prevents device noumenon from toppling over.

title_en: A kind of geological disaster index model construction device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of geological disaster index model construction devices, including L-type pedestal, matte board is equipped on L-type pedestal, basement rock is equipped in matte board upper surface heap, several groups seepage action of ground water channel is equipped in the basement rock, and the webbed underground percolation channel of shape between several groups seepage action of ground water channel, thick seepage channel is equipped between adjacent underground water seepage channel, the basement rock upper surface is equipped with metal barrier net, and shale coating is equipped on basement rock, dominant paths are equipped in shale coating upper surface, and landslide block is equipped on shale coating along the dominant paths, typical mud-rock flow block is equipped in dominant paths highest point；By constructing basic model, specific model is targetedly constructed by specific index factor again to be simulated, simulation process can be more accurately obtained, to adapt to the simulation process of different type geological disaster, provides more acurrate, more targeted analogue data.

title_en: Auxiliary excavation construction method for vertical shaft main tunnel three-dimensional intersection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary excavation construction method for a vertical shaft main hole stereo intersection, which belongs to the technical field of tunnel construction and comprises the steps of applying a pipe shed to the top of a transverse channel for pre-reinforcing when a vertical shaft is constructed downwards to the position below the top of the transverse channel; when a transverse channel is excavated, a grouting hole is drilled in the arch part of the transverse channel, a grouting pipeline is constructed in the grouting hole, and slurry is injected to form a first reinforcing ring; before the transverse channel enters the main tunnel, constructing a pipe shed at the arch part of the main tunnel; and when the main tunnel is excavated, constructing a second reinforcing ring at the arch part of the tunnel by adopting an advanced pre-grouting reinforcing mode. The auxiliary excavation method has a large grouting reinforcement range (5 m above the arch part), and can effectively prevent the generation of adverse geological disasters in the underground excavation construction of the water-rich stratum.
assignees: 1ST ENG CO LTD OF CTEC GROUP;CHINA TIESIJU CIVIL ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A kind of highway threat information recognition methods
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of highway threat information recognition methods, the steps include: 1) to select representative region to establish sample set and tally set according to photo or aerophotograph building ground object sample collection；2) sample data is standardized, then integrates red, green, blue wave band standardization pixel value collection, sample set is divided into training set and test set, constructs threat identification model, calculates error rate；3) picture of information to be extracted or aerophotograph are digitized, and are standardized, then bring standardization result into threat identification model, realize that threat information is extracted.The present invention, which is allowed for, identifies problem using threat information of the threat identification model to photochrome or aerophotograph, its numerical results shows, the threat information of offer is enough assessment Disaster degree, determines that rescue work preparation and formulation emergency plan HSE etc. provide guidance, to the advantageous supplement in the case of the data deficiencies such as remote sensing image, the efficiency that can be improved threat identification plays a significant role in emergency management and rescue decision Rapid Implementation.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS;UNIV SHANDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method based on wavelet kernel local Fisher discriminant analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a hyperspectral image classification method based on wavelet kernel local Fisher discriminant analysis, and relates to the technical field of hyperspectral images. Firstly, reading hyperspectral data as sample data, and normalizing the sample data set; mapping data from a low-dimensional original space to a high-dimensional feature space by adopting a wavelet kernel function; performing feature extraction on the sample data by using a local Fisher discriminant analysis method; dividing the data set after dimensionality reduction into training data and test data, and inputting the training data into an SVM classifier to obtain an optimal parameter value; inputting the test data into a classifier to obtain a classification result; and analyzing and evaluating the classification result. The hyperspectral image classification method based on wavelet kernel local Fisher discriminant analysis provided by the invention obtains a good classification effect, and can be applied to the fields of agricultural monitoring, environmental management, disaster assessment, mineral mapping and the like.

title_en: The Gas explosion burns inversion method and device resolved based on gas drainage system simulation
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Gas explosion burns inversion method and device resolved based on gas drainage system simulation, comprising: establishes system topology according to the node, pipeline and drilling of gas drainage system；System fundamental circuit matrix is generated according to the system topology；According to the fundamental circuit matrix establish simulation resolve mathematical model and using can fast convergence computer simulation derivation algorithm to the simulation resolving mathematical model solve；Mathematical model solving result is resolved according to the simulation and coal seam monitoring gas emission establishes simultaneous equations；It calculates the distribution of drill site coal-bed gas pressure according to the simultaneous equations and is distributed according to the gas pressure and calculate gas bearing capacity.The present invention can be laid out according to gas drainage system and its monitoring data, and analysis and inverting gas drainage under suction state and gas pressure and gas bearing capacity distribution in coal seam, provide theoretical basis for gas drainage dynamic optimization and Gas Disaster early warning and prevention and treatment in real time.
assignees: SHANDONG LIONKING SOFTWARE CO LTD;NATIONAL ENGINEERING RES CENTER FOR GAS CONTROLLING OF PINGAN MINE

title_en: Estuary coast engineering storm surge disaster full power laboratory analog system and its method
abstract_en: Estuary coast engineering storm surge disaster full power laboratory analog system and its method, experimental trough are equipped with wave maker, are additionally provided with air duct, and air duct upstream is equipped with blower.It is all equipped with intake pool and tide box from the outside to the core at the upstream and downstream both ends of experimental trough, two-way pump is equipped between intake pool and tide box；Valve is equipped between tide box and experimental trough.The present invention can overcome the shortcomings of that traditional technology cannot really simulate natural trend apoplexy, tide and wave collective effect effect, this laboratory analog system can real simulation estuary coast Regional Port channel silt become silted up suddenly beach evolution, ocean, water conservancy, harbour, fishery, military engineering structure, hazard scope and safe condition under typhoon storm tide and high seas synergy.Can carry out following test: test power: wind, astronomical tide, storm increase (subtracting) water and typhoon.It generates the wind of specific region and simulates outlet air, simulate storm tide, simulate stormy waves.Integrated " wind+tide+wave " generates system.

title_en: Method for rapidly evaluating crop disaster loss
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for rapidly evaluating disaster damage of crops, which is based on a crop model of a DSSAT system and a G L UE parameter evaluation tool, utilizes historical data of the crops in a disaster area, obtains leaf area indexes and yields of the crops under various scenes based on crop model simulation, further constructs a regression equation, then based on a satellite image of Google Earth Engine (GEE), substitutes the leaf area indexes of each pixel on the satellite image into a linear regression equation, obtains the yield of each pixel, and finally compares the yield of the disaster year in the disaster area with the yield of the last year to obtain relative yield loss.

title_en: Tunnel rich water fault broken zone permeability coefficient in-situ measuring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-situ measuring device for permeability coefficient of a tunnel water-rich fault fracture zone, which comprises an optical fiber, an inner cylinder, an outer cylinder, a base, a drill bit, a pressure transmission cover, a hydraulic system, a top cover, a rocker and a pull rod, wherein the optical fiber is arranged on the inner cylinder; the outer cylinder is arranged outside the inner cylinder, the base is arranged below the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder, the drill bit is arranged at the bottom of the base, and the pressure transmitting cover, the hydraulic system and the top cover are sequentially arranged above the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder from bottom to top; the pull rod is arranged at the top of the top cover, and the rocker is arranged on the side surface of the top cover; the optical fiber comprises two optical fibers which are respectively arranged in the inner barrel. The device is also provided with a cable for electrical connection. The permeability coefficient in-situ measuring device for the tunnel water-rich fault fracture zone provided by the invention is exquisite in design, the inner and outer sampling cylinders are combined with a hydraulic system, the water and soil pressure balance in the soil sampling process is realized, and the reliability of in-situ test is basically ensured; the method has the advantages of accurate and quick measurement, real-time calculation of the permeability coefficient, statistics of the point positions prone to water bursting disasters and provision of reliable bases for prediction and forecast.

title_en: Oil storage tank damage experiment platform and method under fire disaster, explosion and coupling action
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental platform and an experimental method for damage of an oil storage tank under the fire, explosion and coupling actions of the fire and the explosion, which are an experimental platform and an experimental method for analyzing the damage actions related to mechanics and thermodynamics of the storage tank. The device comprises a storage tank model, a bracket, a radiation type electric heating device, an experimental measurement acquisition system and an explosion shock wave generating device; the storage tank model is arranged on the bracket; the radiation type electric heating device is an independent part; the experimental measurement acquisition system comprises a high-speed camera, a foil-type resistance strain gauge, a thermocouple, a pressure sensor, a laser displacement sensor and a data acquisition device; the explosion shock wave generating device comprises a grain, a detonator and a detonator, wherein the grain adopts TNT grain; the upper part of the storage tank model is also provided with a water filling port. The method can be used for experimental study on models with specific geometric shapes and materials, and has universal applicability; the experimental parameters are easy to regulate and control, and the experimental simulation research of explosion occurring at different positions of different oil product liquid filling height conditions of the storage tank is simulated.

title_en: Disaster Countermeasures Training method capable to make training scene and system thereof
title_ko: 훈련 신 생성이 가능한 재난대응 훈련방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster response training method capable of generating new training and a system therefor. According to an aspect of the present invention, a disaster response training method capable of generating new training comprises the steps of: specifying a location of a disaster and the type of disaster by a disaster response training system; generating a training scene that includes at least one training mission corresponding to the disaster type and the location of occurrence specified by the disaster response training system; and simulating the training scene generated by the disaster response training system so that a trainee performs the at least one training mission included in the training scene.
abstract_ko: 훈련 신 생성이 가능한 재난대응 훈련방법 및 이를 위한 시스템이 개시된다. . 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 재난대응 훈련시스템이 재난의 발생위치와 재난종류를 특정하는 단계, 상기 재난대응 훈련시스템이 특정한 상기 재난종류 및 상기 발생위치에 상응하는 적어도 하나의 훈련미션을 포함하는 훈련 신(scene)을 생성하는 단계, 상기 재난대응 훈련시스템이 생성한 상기 훈련 신을 시뮬레이션 하여 훈련자가 상기 훈련 신에 포함된 상기 적어도 하나의 훈련미션을 수행토록 하는 단계를 포함하는 훈련 신 생성이 가능한 재난대응 훈련방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Disaster Countermeasures Training method capable to make training scene and system thereof
title_ko: 훈련 신 생성이 가능한 재난대응 훈련방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster countermeasure training method capable of generating a training scene and a system thereof. According to an aspect of the present invention, the disaster countermeasure training method comprises the following steps. A disaster countermeasure training system specifies a location of a disaster occurrence and a type of disaster. The disaster countermeasure training system generates a training scene including at least one training mission corresponding to the type of the disaster and the location of the disaster occurrence specified by the disaster countermeasure training system. The disaster countermeasure training system simulates the training scene generated by the disaster countermeasure training system and performs the at least one training mission included in the training scene.
abstract_ko: 훈련 신 생성이 가능한 재난대응 훈련방법 및 이를 위한 시스템이 개시된다. . 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 재난대응 훈련시스템이 재난의 발생위치와 재난종류를 특정하는 단계, 상기 재난대응 훈련시스템이 특정한 상기 재난종류 및 상기 발생위치에 상응하는 적어도 하나의 훈련미션을 포함하는 훈련 신(scene)을 생성하는 단계, 상기 재난대응 훈련시스템이 생성한 상기 훈련 신을 시뮬레이션 하여 훈련자가 상기 훈련 신에 포함된 상기 적어도 하나의 훈련미션을 수행토록 하는 단계를 포함하는 훈련 신 생성이 가능한 재난대응 훈련방법이 개시된다.

title_en: A kind of high-resolution electric power method of meteorological forecast based on multi-mode set
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of high-resolution electric power method of meteorological forecast based on multi-mode set, including solar energy electric field weather forecast process and wind power plant electric power weather forecast process；Solar energy electric field weather forecast process includes: that N number of solar-electricity field prediction module based on surface radiation clear sky interpolation and N number of solar-electricity field prediction module based on Mesoscale Numerical Simulation are formed solar-electricity field prediction member set；Right assessment is carried out to solar-electricity field prediction member；It establishes surface radiation field neural network model and carries out forecast value revision.Advantage are as follows: the present invention significantly improves existing electric power weather forecast precision, can effectively promote the accuracy and reliability of the services such as the comprehensive meteorological support of wind power prediction, photovoltaic power generation power prediction, marine wind electric field, power grid meteorological disaster early warning.

title_en: A kind of apparatus for demonstrating for reproducing street lamp shaking when shaking and destroying scene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the apparatus for demonstrating that street lamp shaking when a kind of reproduction shake destroys scene, including vibration rod, hanger bracket and under casing, the inside of the under casing is equipped with variable-frequency motor, power packages case is installed inside the under casing of the variable-frequency motor side, master control circuit board is installed inside under casing above the power packages case, turntable is installed at the top of the under casing, light pole is installed at the top of the turntable, electric telescopic rod is installed at the top of the light pole, vibration rod is installed at the top of the electric telescopic rod, hanger bracket is installed at the top of the vibration rod, the surface of the circle link is equipped with street lamp component.The utility model by be provided with a series of structure make the apparatus for demonstrating can vivid simulation street street lamp shaking destroy scene, spectators, which destroy scene by viewing street street lamp shaking, can experience earthquake zone intuitively come huge destruction, can also improve the learning interest to protection against and mitigation of earthquake disasters knowledge.
assignees: ANHUI NEW HORIZON SCIENCE AND EDUCATION CULTURE CO LTD

title_en: Ground large-range rock stratum pre-splitting area anti-impact method based on up-down combined arrangement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground large-range rock stratum pre-splitting area anti-impact method based on up-down combined arrangement, which comprises the steps of determining a target rock stratum needing to be modified and decompressed in an area with hidden danger of rock burst; determining the hole distribution direction of a horizontal hole in a target rock stratum, and drilling a hole underground; drilling a vertical hole in the middle of a special roadway facing a target stratum from the ground; and performing directional cracking on the horizontal holes after hole distribution. The invention can form a plurality of reticular cracks with different directions and lengths in the rock stratum with good integrity, thereby greatly reducing the overall strength of the rock stratum, reducing the stress distribution of the coal bed with high impact risk below the rock stratum and fundamentally eliminating the serious impact disaster risk during the coal bed mining.

title_en: Road network reliability assessment method, system, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road network reliability evaluation method, which comprises the steps of obtaining geographic space position data, road data and historical geological disaster data of a road section of an area to be evaluated; constructing a road complex network model according to the obtained geospatial position data and road data; constructing disaster situation interference modes of different types according to historical geological disaster data; simulating different types of disaster situation interference modes to attack a road complex network model; and analyzing and calculating the network overall connectivity and the network high-efficiency connectivity of the road complex network model in an initial state and a simulated attack state, and evaluating the reliability of the road section of the area to be evaluated by combining the importance of the road section, the relative reduction rate of the maximum connected subgraph scale and the relative reduction rate of the whole network connection efficiency. The method greatly improves the spatial precision of the risk assessment result, can find out real high-risk areas, and provides reliable basis for road engineering prevention and control planning.

title_en: Composite power disaster drilling cuttings many reference amounts method for evaluating hazard based on AHP
abstract_en: The present invention relates to mine power disaster Prevention Technique fields, a kind of composite power disaster drilling cuttings many reference amounts method for evaluating hazard based on AHP is provided, five kinds of parameters are chosen first, and based on Hierarchy Evaluation model of the AHP building including destination layer, rule layer and solution layer, then range of the every kind of parameter under each initial scale is set, and determine the corresponding initial scale of every kind of parameter in drilling cuttings monitoring information, relative scale is calculated, the first judgment matrix is formed；Then Mode of Level Simple Sequence is carried out, the disaster judgment matrix of every kind of parameter is obtained by Experts consultation method, total hierarchial sorting is carried out again, calculates total ordering values of every kind of dynamic disaster with the specific Disasters Type of determination, calculates the safety coefficient of tested mine finally to determine the danger classes of disaster.The present invention can carry out the overall merit of different kinds of parameters to dynamic disaster especially composite power disaster, determine Disasters Type and danger classes, promote the reliability of monitoring result.

title_en: System and method for building appropriate area in ecological sponge type city
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological sponge type city construction suitable area target accurate identification and efficacy measuring and calculating system and method. The invention serves the accurate identification of the construction and reconstruction target suitable area and the suitable grade target in the whole process from city construction planning to engineering design, city heat island control and city landscaping, and can measure and calculate the effects exerted in the aspects of flood disasters and high-temperature extreme climate events under different city construction and reconstruction scenes. The system comprises a novel city planning design framework for controlling the dual targets of the sponge city and the heat island, realizes refined remote sensing classification and artificial intelligence detection algorithm aiming at accurate identification of ecological sponge city space suitability, and can effectively simulate the effects of city construction and transformation on rainfall flood and extreme high-temperature events.

title_en: A kind of exploitation fluid injection of coal seam hydraulic slotted liner technique is combined with extraction integration prevention and treatment composite power disaster method and matching used wetting agent
abstract_en: A kind of coal seam hydraulic slotted liner technique exploitation fluid injection prevention and treatment composite power disaster method integrated with extraction, include the following steps: the position that liquid injection hole and gas drainage hole are determined in coal seam, it is arranged alternately using a line liquid injection hole and a line gas drainage hole, it determines between liquid injection hole, between gas drainage hole, the distance between liquid injection hole and gas drainage hole, to the fluid injection hole site of above-mentioned determination, gas drainage hole site drills, in each liquid injection hole being drilled, slot is carried out in gas drainage hole, fluid injection pipeline is connect with liquid injection hole respectively, extraction pipeline is connect with drainage holes；Fluid injection operation and extraction operation are carried out simultaneously to coal seam；After using hole packer carry out sealing of hole.It combines, by weight percentage, is made of following raw material: chelating agent 0.5%-5%, wetting agent 0.5%-5%, water 90%-99% with a kind of exploitation fluid injection of coal seam hydraulic slotted liner technique with the extraction integration prevention and treatment matching used wetting agent of composite power disaster method.

title_en: The identification method of cold-resistant sex differernce between a kind of wheat breed
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of identification methods of cold-resistant sex differernce between wheat breed, belong to wheat and combat a natural disaster mitigation technical field.The present invention passes through simulation low temperature stress, it obtains by low temperature stress treated wheat leaf blade, and determine the conductivity of wheat leaf blade leachate, it is calculated from the formula wheat leaf blade relative electrolyte leaching rate, to judge that wheat leaf blade cell leakage changes, and the size changed according to cell leakage, the winter resistance to judge wheat breed are strong and weak.The present invention is applied widely, using laboratory routine equipment, simple and easy, method is reliable, it identifies that the cold resistance of many plant varieties and winter resistance cultivate effect and provides effective means for early stage or optimum period, avoids the disadvantages of growth cycle that crop field is identified is long, condition is not easy to control.

title_en: Device and method for push-out test of wood-concrete composite beam shear connector under fire
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building test devices, in particular to a push-out test device for a wood-concrete composite beam shear connector under a fire disaster, which comprises a fire furnace, a push-out test device and a push-out test device, wherein the fire furnace is used for simulating a fire scene; the self-balancing stand is used for fixing a force application device for applying force to the wood-concrete composite beam to push out the test piece, the position of the wood beam for pushing out the test piece by the wood-concrete composite beam is limited to be unchanged in the force application direction of the force application device, the fixed wood-concrete composite beam push-out test piece is exposed in a simulated fire scene, the force application device applies force to the concrete slab, and the sliding of the connecting piece is tested. The invention can simulate the fire condition more truly to carry out the push-out test and accurately research the performances of the wood-concrete composite beam shear connector, such as the stress mechanism, the failure mode, the shear bearing capacity and the like under the fire. Meanwhile, the invention also provides a test method for the push-out test of the wood-concrete composite beam shear connector under fire.

title_en: A kind of fire disaster simulation device design method and system
abstract_en: A kind of fire disaster simulation device design method and system provided in an embodiment of the present invention.Ingenious combination and application have been carried out to gauge device and control device, so as to dynamic regulation fire source heat release rate and produce cigarette rate, situations such as guaranteeing to obtain the Temperature Distribution under various Fire Conditions, flue gas diffusion more meets reality, provides important theoretical foundation for fire prevention and treatment and evacuating personnel.
assignees: UNIV JILIANG CHINA;ZHEJIANG UNIV URBAN RURAL PLANNING & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of mountain region disaster dynamic panorama analogy method and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of mountain region disaster dynamic panorama analogy method and system, include the following steps: that mountain region disaster data acquire under same viewpoint；The splicing and synthesis of static panorama figure；The generation of mountain region disaster motion process video texture；Both static panorama figure and video texture are combined and generate construction Dynamic Panorama.For this method by combining video texture and panorama sketch, the mountain region disasters deformation process Dynamic Panorama such as construction landslide, mud-rock flow simulates the motion process of mountain region disaster.
assignees: CHINA COMMUNICATION HIGH TECH IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;CHENGDU MOUNTAINOUS ENVIRONMENTAL SAFETY AND DISASTER REDUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Image change detection method based on information transmitting and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention proposes a kind of image change detection methods based on information transmitting and attention mechanism, for solving the low technical problem of accuracy in detection present in conventional images change detecting method.Realize step are as follows: read in image and be normalized, construct training sample set, build the deep neural network model based on information transmitting and attention mechanism, the training parameter of set depth neural network, judge whether the loss function of deep neural network meets iteration stopping condition, to deep neural network can training parameter be updated, utilize trained deep neural network export Image Change Detection result figure.Combining information transmitting of the present invention and attention mechanism, characteristics of image semanteme and the structural information for building deep neural network extraction are abundant, ability to express and discrimination property to image is strong, variation detection accuracy in detection is improved, can be used for the technical fields such as land cover pattern detection, evaluation of disaster, video monitoring.

title_en: Fire disaster emergency equipment detection method, device, mobile terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of fire disaster emergency equipment detection method, device, mobile terminal and storage medium, method includes: to generate fire disaster simulation signal when receiving detection signal, and fire disaster simulation signal is respectively sent to each fire disaster emergency equipment；The current state of each fire disaster emergency equipment is obtained respectively, and judges whether current state is in emergency rating；When determining current state and being not in emergency rating, determine that fire disaster emergency equipment is in malfunction, and obtain the current data information of fire disaster emergency equipment；Obtain the standard data message being locally stored, and standard data message and current data information are compared and analyzed, to determine the fault type of fire disaster emergency equipment, the mode that the present invention is detected by using system signal transmission, to carry out the fault detection of each fire disaster emergency equipment, the detection and investigation of failure are carried out without the mode that personnel detect manually, and then are effectively raised detection efficiency and reduced personnel cost.
assignees: HUNAN HUIBO ELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire disaster escaping is with without electric lift
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire disaster escapings with without electric lift, including cabinet, further including perpendicular rail, magnet case；Perpendicular rail is divided into No.1 and erects rail and No. two perpendicular rails, and No.1 is erected rail and No. two perpendicular rails symmetrically and is each attached on ground；It it is provided with No.1 on front side of cabinet erects rail, rear side and be provided with No. two perpendicular rails, cabinet can be erected in No.1 and be slided above and below between rail and No. two perpendicular rails；Magnet case is fixed on the ground that No.1 is erected between rail and No. two perpendicular rails, and No.1 electromagnet is equipped with inside magnet case.The present invention needs not move through strict professional training, anyone can use；Mitigate probably high sense when high-storey personnel escape, increases the resolute degree of escape personnel, improve escape speed；Cabinet can accommodate more people simultaneously, and decrease speed is fast, and spontaneous electricity does not need external municipal power grid；Preparation can be risen automatically to use next time, not disposable, environmental protection and energy saving.

title_en: Landslide sliding process simulation method without known bottom sliding surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating a landslide sliding process without a known bottom sliding surface, which comprises the following steps of: (1) establishing a continuous medium landslide model, analyzing the stability of the landslide model, and obtaining a displacement cloud picture and a strain rate cloud picture of the landslide model; (2) extracting coordinates of points on a sliding surface in the continuous medium landslide model, deriving a point coordinate file, fitting a corresponding sliding surface, and dividing the model into a sliding bed and a sliding body by using the sliding surface; (3) respectively using continuous media and discontinuous media to simulate a sliding bed and a sliding body to obtain a continuous-discontinuous media landslide model; (4) and carrying out numerical calculation on the continuous-discontinuous medium landslide model to determine the sliding process of the landslide and the accumulation condition of the sliding body. The simulation method solves the problem that the traditional method can not simulate landslide disasters without a known bottom sliding surface, and simultaneously avoids the defects that the single discontinuous medium method is low in calculation speed and the continuous medium method cannot reflect the landslide sliding process and the landslide accumulation condition.

title_en: Method and system for preventing and controlling rock burst disaster by weakening coal body through liquid nitrogen
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for realizing the prevention and control of rock burst disasters by weakening a coal body by using liquid nitrogen, wherein the method comprises the steps of controllably conveying the liquid nitrogen into the coal body at a speed, recovering the liquid nitrogen at an output port, monitoring the stress of the coal body, judging that a liquid nitrogen input port needs to continuously convey the liquid nitrogen if the stress is greater than a set value, and stopping conveying the liquid nitrogen if the stress is not greater than the set value. By adopting the method and the system for preventing and controlling the rock burst disaster by weakening the coal body by using the liquid nitrogen, the liquid nitrogen circulates in the drilling network, so that water in the coal body is changed into ice, the water is cracked after volume expansion, the whole coal body in the pre-mining area is weakened, the impact tendency of the coal body is favorably reduced, the gas concentration in the coal body is reduced by cooling by using the liquid nitrogen, and the safety of a high-gas mine is favorably improved; in addition, the cost is saved by recycling the liquid nitrogen repeatedly, and the system has the advantages of simple structure, simple and convenient operation, lower cost and wider application range.

title_en: Landslide occurrence time prediction method based on mixed Gaussian hidden Markov model
abstract_en: According to the landslide occurrence time prediction method based on the hybrid Gaussian hidden Markov model, firstly, displacement data of a landslide body are collected through a laser displacement sensor arranged on the landslide body, and multi-state division is carried out on the collected displacement data in a time sequence direction; then, training the divided displacement data through a Baum-welch algorithm to obtain a multi-state MOG-HMM model, and marking the divided states; and finally, carrying out current state estimation on displacement data acquired in real time by adopting a Viterbi algorithm, and taking the current estimated state as the input of a Dijkstra algorithm, thereby predicting the occurrence time of landslide. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the current landslide evolution state is deduced according to the displacement data in the landslide evolution process, and the occurrence time of landslide disasters is calculated, so that the robustness performance of a general HMM method in prediction is improved, and the accuracy of geological disaster prediction is improved.

title_en: Fire detection method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire detection method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of collecting flame images of a detection site through different rotary cameras, marking the collected flame images with flames through labelmap software, training a Faster-rnn model by using the marked flame images, finely adjusting parameters of the model to obtain a trained model, inputting the collected images into the trained model, judging as a fire if the probability is more than 80%, outputting the position of the fire, and extinguishing the fire through fire extinguishing equipment. The invention can monitor the monitored area in real time without requiring a person to visit, thereby reducing the labor cost; and when a fire disaster happens, the water spraying gun capable of giving an alarm and adjusting at the first time can intensively extinguish the fire to reduce the loss, and the system has the advantages of timeliness and effectiveness.

title_en: Integrated plan method for emergency exit indicating lights
title_ko: 비상대피 유도방향표시등 통합설계 방법
abstract_en: In a method for integrated designing an emergency evacuation guidance direction indicator, mapping tiles are mapped by dividing a station or a building into an array 1 and an array 2 at each floor and dividing locations where the guidance direction indicator can be located and where the guidance direction indicator cannot be located. For each of the array 1 and the array 2, a distance from a location of the nearest side according to simulated moving is calculated among all areas where the guidance direction indicator from an n floor (n is an integer) can be located. From calculation results of the array 1 and the array 2, the direction of the guidance direction indicator is tentatively set for each of the areas where the guidance direction indicator of the n floor can be located. The direction of the guidance direction indicator is finally set for the n floor by comparing the tentatively set direction of the guidance direction indicator of the array 1 and the array 2. According to the present invention, it is possible to simulate different situations which can occur in a real emergency situation to provide a designer with a variety of information.
abstract_ko: 비상대피 유도방향표시등 통합설계 방법에서, 역사나 건물을 각 층마다 배열 1 및 배열 2로 구분하여, 유도방향표시등이 위치할 수 있는 영역과 위치할 수 없는 영역을 구분하여 매핑타일을 매핑(mapping)한다.  상기 배열 1 및 배열 2 각각에 대하여, 제n 층(n은 정수)의 유도방향표시등이 위치할 수 있는 모든 영역들 중, 최측부 위치로부터 모의이동에 따른 거리를 연산한다.  상기 배열 1 및 배열 2 각각의 연산 결과로부터, 상기 제n 층의 유도방향표시등이 위치할 수 있는 모든 영역들 각각에 대하여 유도방향표시등 방향을 잠정 설정한다.  상기 배열 1 및 배열 2의 잠정 설정된 유도방향표시등 방향을 비교하여, 상기 제n 층에 대하여 상기 유도방향표시등 방향을 최종적으로 설정한다.

title_en: SAR image change detection based on depth capsule network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of SAR image change detections based on depth capsule network structure, and the effective image information for mainly solving the problems, such as that the prior art can not include from the training sample for extracting more useful feature information and acquisition in image is insufficient.Implementation step is: obtaining two SAR experimental images；According to the Pixel Information of experimental image, the difference value of the similarity threshold and pixel between pixel is obtained；It is presorted with KI threshold method to lab diagram, obtains the label of image；According to the label of similarity threshold, the difference value of pixel and image, obtains training label and training sample and capsule network is trained；The network that trains again pair carries out level intensification；Lab diagram is input in depth capsule network, variation testing result figure is obtained.The present invention can obtain more useful feature information from training sample, improve variation detection accuracy, can be used in the SAR image variation detection of environmental monitoring, agricultural investigation and disaster relief work.

title_en: Building Damage assessment drafting method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a kind of building Damage assessment drafting method and systems.This method comprises: to polarimetric synthetic aperture radar SAR data carries out Touzi decomposition before calamity and after calamity；The Touzi decomposed component extracted using full-polarization SAR data after calamity before calamity, the Touzi decomposing alpha in analyzing and training sample area s1 After component calamity with the variation before calamity, and then determine characterization building damage degree evaluation index；Causes are established between the evaluation index and building really damage degree；And the damage scale evaluation figure of different construction zones in whole image is calculated according to the causes.Building Damage assessment drafting method of the present invention and system can be quickly obtained the spatial distribution of building damage degree after disaster generation, provide more accurate information for emergency monitoring after calamity and rescue.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting unmanned plane progress fire disaster target knowledge method for distinguishing
abstract_en: Fire disaster target is carried out the present invention relates to a kind of fire-fighting unmanned plane and knows method for distinguishing, comprising: camera is carried using unmanned plane and acquires testing image；Testing image is imported into convolutional neural networks, obtains convolution characteristic pattern；Before full articulamentum, is handled using convolution characteristic pattern of the RPN to extraction, obtain the characteristic information of candidate frame, i.e. candidate region.The information of comprehensive convolutional layer feature and candidate frame, the coordinate of candidate frame in the input image is mapped in the last layer of convolution characteristic pattern；ROI is handled with minimum circumscribed rectangle algorithm again, makes ROI layers each, obtains fixed-size characteristic pattern, and be connected with subsequent full articulamentum；After full articulamentum, the classification of characteristic pattern is judged and extracted using detection class probability, and position adjustment is carried out to the candidate frame for belonging to a certain feature using device is returned, class probability and frame are returned and carry out joint training, to obtain target area；Finally obtain the target image of fire location.

title_en: A kind of slope stability method of discrimination based on coupling about surface water and ground water model
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of slope stability method of discrimination based on coupling about surface water and ground water model, the following steps are included: establishing side slope water level inside determines model, the SEA LEVEL VARIATION process inside side slope can be simulated according to earth's surface water-level observation data information and coupling about surface water and ground water model；And by actual water level inside local side slope interior moisture content monitoring data and VG Functional Analysis part side slope, correction is compared with analog result；Based on obtained side slope water level inside, Analysis of Slope Stability model is established using intelligent algorithm and simplification form and finds out most dangerous landslide surface, side slope minimum stability coefficient is obtained, judges the stability of side slope.The present invention can go out the change procedure of side slope water level inside according to the observation digital simulation of earth's surface water level and side slope interior moisture content, then assess slope stability；And repeatedly calculated by intelligent algorithm iteration, most dangerous sliding surface is accurately found out, predicts slope instability time and unstability area, forecasts landslide disaster.

title_en: Expansive network control design system
abstract_en: A system for expansive network control comprising: a development engine includes a scenario building engine configured to build an abstracted view of at least one sub-network based on a network inventory; a gamification engine communicating with a user input/output device providing at least one simulated scenario involving a simulated network threat to the user input/output device; and a machine learning engine communicating with the gamification engine, wherein the machine learning engine generates at least one strategy, the machine learning engine capturing the scenario and the user input from the user input/output device; an expansive network control operation engine includes an expansive network control engine communicating with the machine learning engine; an execution engine communicating with the expansive network control engine; a threat detection engine communicating with at least one external threat data source, the at least one external threat data source including at least one of weather, seismic, natural disaster, law enforcement, news and public utility data; wherein the threat detection engine monitors the at least one data source to detect a threat and passes a threat type and an impacted sub-network location for the threat type to the expansive network control engine; wherein the expansive network control engine is configured to retrieve at least one of an available inventory and priority of the impacted sub-network; wherein based on the at least one strategy, the expansive network control engine triggers the execution engine to perform an action to address the threat; an expansive network planning engine includes a simulation engine; the simulation engine configured to trigger an event and record a simulation result of the event; and a spare recommender, wherein the simulation engine communicates the simulation result to the spare recommender and wherein the spare recommender analyzes the simulation result to determine if excessive spares exist.

title_en: Integrated rescue management system based on personal position for ship
title_ko: 선박용 개인위치기반 안전구조 통합관제시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety rescue integrated control system for a ship based on a personal location, which comprises: a tag device for inputting a unique tag to a mobile device of a ship passenger when boarding on a ship; a ship warning system installed in a ship to monitor a disaster situation of the whole ship; an evacuation support device for storing various disaster states in the ship, and storing each evacuation scenario therefor; an integrated control server for inputting and outputting location-based mobile device information, and receiving ship disaster information from the ship warning system; a communication connection network connected to the integrated control server to transmit a ship disaster state, and receiving external evacuation instruction information; and a dashboard installed in an evacuation control center in the ship to output each evacuation information on the passenger and the ship disaster state. According to the present invention, when an internal warning of the ship is input by the ship warning system to the integrated control server, the ship disaster state is determined using the location-based mobile device information and an internal warning state of the ship, and an optimal evacuation scenario is selected to output individual evacuation information to each passenger mobile device. Also, the dash board is operated to display evacuation information and a disaster progress state of the ship, an evacuation state in the ship is transmitted via the communication connection network, and the external evacuation instruction information is received to update entire evacuation information. According to the present invention, the spread of the dangerous situation during evacuation of a passenger is prevented in case of emergency of the ship, an overall instruction action for emergency can be performed, and an external rescue can be effectively performed.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Earthquake evacuation training safety teaching aid

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake evacuation training safety teaching aid which allows infants and children to learn virtually phenomena and characteristics of earthquakes while playing, and to learn the earthquake evacuation training tips as play. The earthquake evacuation training safety teaching aid according to the present invention provides an accurate seismic state by an irregular seismic wave since a bottom diaphragm in which an experimental model is placed operates simultaneously with the vibration in the horizontal direction and in the vertical direction. Therefore, accurate training on earthquakes and training tips for earthquake evacuation can be learned.

title_en: Method and Apparatus For Managing Disaggregated Memory
title_ko: 복합재난 모의를 위한 시나리오 자동생성 방법 및 그에 따른 장치
abstract_en: According to the present specification, provided is a method for automatically generating a scenario for a complex disaster simulation. The methode of the present invention comprises the steps of: analyzing spatiotemporal characteristics in which an individual natural disaster and a social disaster occur and a correlation between the individual natural disaster and the social disaster; generating weight of association that may occur between disasters using the analyzed correlation and spatiotemporal characteristics; generating a disaster occurrence association map using the generated weight of association; and generating a complex disaster scenario based on the generated disaster occurrence association map. When a disaster occurs in a first region, the composite disaster scenario can be automatically generated based on the generated disaster occurrence association map and the spatiotemporal characteristics of the first region.
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 복합재난 모의 시나리오를 자동 생성하는 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 이때, 복합재난 모의 시나리오를 자동으로 생성하는 방법은 개별 자연재난과 사회재난이 발생하는 시공간적 특성 및 개별 자연재난과 사회재난의 상호연관성을 분석하는 단계, 분석된 상호연관성과 시공간적 특성을 이용하여 재난 간 발생 가능한 연계 가중치를 생성하는 단계, 생성된 연계 가중치를 이용하여 재난 발생 연계 지도를 생성하는 단계 및 생성된 재난 발생 연계 지도에 기초하여 복합 재난 시나리오를 생성하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 이때, 제 1 지역에서 재난이 발생하는 경우, 생성된 재난 발생 연계 지도 및 제 1 지역의 시공간적 특성에 기초하여 복합 재난 시나리오가 자동으로 생성될 수 있다.

title_en: Evacuation Time Prediction System using GIS Information and Method thereof
title_ko: Gis 정보를 활용한 피난 시간 예측 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an evacuation time prediction system using GIS information which inputs GIS information such as use, height, area or the like of a building to an evacuation time calculation module to calculate a predicted evacuation time so as to predict an evacuation lead time of people inside the building and, accordingly, provides an evacuation simulation image of the people inside the building to more effectively plan a time for fire-fighting activities when disasters such as an earthquake, a fire and the like occurs, thereby allowing the people inside the building to be quickly evacuated to the outside. In addition, the evacuation time prediction system using GIS information is configured to comprise a GIS providing server, a control server provided at a building, a display on each floor, and a public office server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 GIS 정보를 활용한 피난 시간 예측 시스템에 따르면, 건물의 용도, 높이, 면적 등의 GIS 정보를 피난 시간 계산 모듈에 입력함으로써 예상 피난 시간을 산출하여 건물 내부 사람들의 피난 소요 시간을 미리 예측할 수 있고, 이에 따른 건물 내부 사람들의 피난 시뮬레이션 영상을 제공하여, 지진, 화재 등의 재난이 발생하면 보다 효율적으로 소방 활동을 위한 시간을 계획할 수 있고, 건물 내부 사람들이 신속하게 외부로 피난할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fire control utilizing thermal imaging
abstract_en: A firefighting training device and method for use in training firefighters in the extinguishment of a simulated fire. The system including a burn area disposed in a pit structure. The burn area including a multitude of individual burn zones such that each individual burn zones can support a fire there within. The system further including a control system to control the fire in each individual burn zone and a multitude of thermal imaging devices positioned to monitor the multitude of individual burn zones and to report the temperature of each individual burn zone to the control system.

title_en: A kind of virtual reality disaster Practical training equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of virtual reality disaster Practical training equipments, including shock platforms, virtual vision equipment and computer, the shock platforms and the virtual vision equipment are connected with the computer respectively, and the shock platforms are equipped with safety rope control lock, support frame, motor and platform hull；Support frame as described above includes vertical section and horizontal segment, the vertical section is fixedly connected with the horizontal segment, and support frame as described above is L shape, the vertical section is fixed in the shock platforms, the horizontal segment is equipped with safety rope control lock, and the safety rope control lock moves horizontally on the horizontal segment；The motor is within the platform hull and is located at the shock platforms bottom.The utility model has the advantages that can be with all kinds of natural disasters of full-scope simulation reality and occurred events of public safety, to carry out safety education, structure is simple, is readily transported.

title_en: Scenario based Disaster Prediction System and the Method
title_ko: 시나리오 기반의 재난 확산 예측 방법, 재난 확산 예측 장치 및 재난 확산 예측 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster diffusion prediction method, device, and system for performing complex disaster diffusion prediction. The complex disaster diffusion prediction method according to the present invention comprises the steps of: receiving disaster-related information; applying local characteristics and inter-disaster connectivity to the disaster-related information to generate a disaster-related scenario; performing modeling for each disaster which constitutes the disaster-related scenario; and estimating complex disaster diffusion by integrating the modeling for each disaster. According to an embodiment of the present invention, complex disaster diffusion derived from a single disaster situation can be predicted and provided beforehand in real time. In addition, according to the embodiment of the present invention, a complex disaster situation predicted in real time is confirmed and preparations for a natural disaster or complex disaster are completed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 복합 재난 확산 예측을 수행하는 재난 확산 예측 방법, 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 복합 재난 확산 예측 방법은 재난 관련 정보를 제공 받는 단계, 상기 재난 관련 정보에 해당 지역 특성 및 재난간 연계성을 적용하여, 재난 연계 시나리오를 생성하는 단계, 상기 재난 연계 시나리오를 구성하는 각 재난별 모델링을 수행하는 단계, 및 상기 각 재난별 모델링을 통합하여, 복합 재난 확산을 예측하는 단계를 포함한다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면 단일 재난 상황에서 파생되는 복합 재난확산을 사전에 실시간으로 예측하여 제공하는 것이 가능하게 된다. 또한, 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면 실시간으로 예측된 복합 재난 상황을 확인하고 미리 자연 재난 및 복합 재난에 대비하는 것이 가능하게 된다.

title_en: System for fast recovery of disaster scene using ict and method therefor
title_ko: Ict를 이용한 재난현장 긴급복구 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for fast recovery of a disaster scene using ICT. The system comprises: a disaster management server calculating the amount of damage for each type of disaster, calculating the type and amount of devices meeting a preset recovery measure scenario, and monitoring a real-time location of a preregistered device to transmit device input request information to devices positioned around a disaster scene; and a device terminal generating device input response information corresponding to a received acceptance signal to transmit the device input response information to the disaster management server when the device input request information is received from the disaster management server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 ICT를 이용한 재난현장 긴급복구 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 재난 발생의 유형별 피해액을 산정하고, 기 설정된 복구조치 시나리오에 부합하는 장비의 종류 및 수량을 산출하며, 기 등록된 장비의 실시간 위치를 모니터링하여 재난현장 인근에 위치한 장비들로 장비투입 요청정보를 전송하는 재난관리 서버; 및 재난관리 서버로부터 장비투입 요청정보를 수신하는 경우, 입력받은 수락신호와 대응하는 장비투입 응답정보를 생성하여 상기 재난관리 서버로 전송하는 장비 단말기;를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of dynamic management system of coal mine emergency command information
abstract_en: A kind of dynamic management system of coal mine emergency command information, solution is of the existing technology can not to take effective disaster relief mode in time, endanger worker's life security, the serious problem of property loss.Including mine basic information module, mining safety monitoring information module, map denotation and management module, mine Catastrophe analysis module, emergency management and rescue power module and catastrophe decision information module.Using mine basic information and monitoring information carries out real-time monitoring to down-hole main hazard source, hidden danger information and information data updates, and establishes the information platform of the effectively extent of damage of containment underground burst accident；To utilize the information before its accident, be underground Catastrophe analysis and simulation, reliable information resources and basic data are provided, the influence degree of accident is timely and effectively controlled.

title_en: A kind of building fire of consideration personnel physical influence virtually evacuates training method
abstract_en: The building fire that the present invention provides a kind of consideration personnel physical influence virtually evacuates training method, belongs to civil engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters technical field.This method initially sets up high validity fire hazard virtual evacuation environment, it is ensured that evacuates the reasonability of scene；Then, it realizes that non-controlling role evacuates animation according to personnel evacuation simulation result, constructs more people and evacuate dynamic scene；The physics interaction models of trainer and non-controlling role are finally established, realize simulation of the non-controlling role to trainer's obstruction and collision effect.The present invention can make trainer experience personnel's physical influence (including hinder, collide) in virtual fire hazard environment, to more really simulate the fire evacuation in more human feelings scapes, improve the evacuation capacity of trainer.

title_en: Consider that Earthquake Secondary leaves the road evaluation method of object and fire
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of consideration Earthquake Secondary and leaves the road evaluation method of object and fire, belongs to civil engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters technical field.This method according to Nonlinear time-history analysis and leaves the determining distribution built Earthquake Secondary and leave object of object motion analysis first, then passes through fire Spread Model, simulates fire spread situation caused by building on fire, obtain the coverage of fire；The secondary Spatio-Temporal Evaluation for leaving object and fire and influencing on road is carried out again, obtains influence result of single calamity kind to road；Finally, being superimposed secondary pendant object and influence of fire, comprehensive road evaluation result is provided.The present invention can leave the road ability under object and fire in Earthquake Secondary with predicted city road network, for shake before take precautions against natural calamities transformation and post-earthquake emergency response rescue provide key decision foundation.

title_en: Small coal kiln goaf grouting method based on directional drilling process
abstract_en: A small coal kiln goaf grouting method based on a directional drilling process fully utilizes the advantages of controllable drilling track, high goaf exposing efficiency, strong ground adaptability, small drilling engineering amount, low solid tube material consumption, low labor intensity and the like of a directional drilling technology, and opens up a creative new way for the geological disaster management work of the coal mine goaf. The method horizontally enters the coal bed after the inclined straight section and the deflecting section, the coal pillar continues to drill in the horizontal drilling process, the drill rod is recovered and grouting is carried out when the coal pillar meets a goaf, the hole is swept to the position of the former hole forming along the original drilling track after the filling slurry is solidified to reach the condition of forming the hole again, drilling is continuously carried out in the solidified artificial geologic body, and grouting filling is carried out when the filling slurry enters the goaf again in the hole forming process. Therefore, the invention greatly reduces the engineering quantity and the engineering cost on the premise of ensuring the grouting treatment effect of the small coal kiln goaf, has great innovativeness, wide application range and better market prospect.

title_en: Method for measuring landslide or rock mass deformation in construction excavation
abstract_en: The invention discloses aA method for measuring landslide or rock mass deformation in construction and excavation relates to the field of geological disaster investigation design and prevention and control of side slope engineering. It comprises the following steps: step 1: drilling a first hole in the upper rock mass of the landslide body or the outward-inclined structural plane, and drilling a second hole in the lower rock mass of the sliding bed or the outward-inclined structural plane; step 2: inserting a stylus into the first hole; inserting the scale into the second hole; and step 3: the terrain slope of the near-empty slope at the outlet of the landslide or rock deformation shear is a, the inclination angle of the sliding belt or the camber structural surface is b, and the height between the measuring pin and the bottom of the sliding belt or the camber structural surface is h 1 The height between the measuring needle and the graduated scale is h 2 (ii) a And 4, step 4: the amount of horizontal displacement of the pointer on the scale is recorded every day, and a time-horizontal displacement graph is made. The invention realizes convenient equipment manufacture, simpler installation and feasible and practical method.

title_en: Method for enhancing gas extraction of goaf through flue gas displacement and preventing fire in goaf
abstract_en: A method for enhancing gas extraction in a goaf by flue gas displacement and preventing and treating fire in the goaf is suitable for being used underground in a coal mine. In the stoping process, the rock stratum above the goaf collapses and moves, an annular fissure zone is formed at the position of the caving arch, the gas released in the stoping process is enriched, laying an air injection pipeline on the outer lane side of the air inlet lane and burying the air injection pipeline in the goaf, arranging a drill site on one side of the air return lane, arranging extraction drill holes from the drill site to the caving arch position of the goaf, the method comprises the steps of injecting factory waste flue gas into a goaf through a gas injection pipeline, extracting gas enriched in a fractured zone through an extraction drill hole, utilizing the flue gas to inhibit spontaneous combustion of residual coal in the goaf, utilizing the pressurized injected flue gas to balance the internal pressure of the goaf, weakening air leakage of a working face to the goaf, utilizing flue gas to displace, displace and lift residual coal and gas in surrounding rocks to float upwards to the fractured zone, improving the amount of extracted gas and the concentration of extracted gas in the extraction drill hole, achieving the effects of preventing and treating fire disasters of the goaf and improving the quality of extracted gas.

title_en: Nuclear Accident Emergency drilling method, server-side and client
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Nuclear Accident Emergency drilling method, server-side and client, method includes: role, the scene selection instruction that server-side obtains that client is sent；The rehearsal picture of Nuclear Accident Emergency rehearsal scene is sent to client in real time to show, and multiple intelligent bodies are configured in Nuclear Accident Emergency rehearsal scene and control the movement of intelligent body, and obtains the evacuation route planning information of game role and is supplied to client in real time to instruct game role to be withdrawn；The control command to game role that client is sent is obtained, rehearsal picture is updated according to the control command dynamic.The present invention is based on serious game combination Virtual Simulations, emergency drilling is carried out in the form taught through lively activities, the mode that multiple agent is combined with game role control the two during rehearsal can preferably simulate the behavior of people in nuclear accident scene, and saving practical rehearsal cost and a wide range of nuclear emergency is avoided to drill issuable economic loss, society's fear etc. influences.

title_en: A kind of rail traffic station passenger evacuation method based on pilot
abstract_en: The rail traffic passenger evacuation method based on pilot that the present invention provides a kind of, for solving the problems, such as the empirical of rail traffic station pilot distribution scheme in the prior art.The passenger evacuation method, consider passenger's initial distribution, the guide demand of passenger, the information such as station environment and pilot's synergistic mechanism, propose hybrid double-layer model optimize evacuation during pilot quantity, position and path, quantity and the position of pilot are solved by Maximal covering model, the evacuation path of pilot is determined based on the heuristic of collaborative simulation, reduce evacuation cost, it reduces since passenger is unfamiliar with irrational aspects caused by the environment of station, avoid pilot that passenger is led to select unreasonable path and lead to congestion, to reduce average evacuation time；The evacuation efficiency of passenger under case of emergency is improved, passenger's risk of injury is reduced, reduces casualties situation.

title_en: Water supply network pollution source tracking and positioning method based on user complaint information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water supply network pollution source tracking and positioning method based on user complaint information, which comprises the following steps: s1: generating a pollution matrix by using the position information of the user complaints; s2: judging the similarity among the candidate nodes and dividing the candidate nodes; s3: increasing random complaint lag time and constructing a user complaint sample; s4: and training, verifying and testing the convolutional neural network by using the user complaint sample, and using the convolutional neural network for tracking and positioning the actual pollution source. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the method adopts the user complaint mode identification to locate the pollution source according to the real-time user complaint information after the pollution accident occurs, has good pollution source identification capability for both water source pollution and non-water source pollution, and has certain robustness for uncertainty of the user complaint lag time. In cities where the on-line monitoring equipment of the pipe network water quality is imperfect, the quick positioning of the pollution source position can be realized, the emergency response capability of the cities to the pipe network water quality sudden accidents is enhanced, and the like.

title_en: Flood information remote sensing intelligent acquisition method and device based on machine vision detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood information remote sensing intelligent acquisition method and equipment based on machine vision detection. The method comprises the following steps: visualizing the multi-feature expression of the remote sensing target; carrying out color space conversion and generation of a water body remote sensing chromatic aberration distance image on the visualized remote sensing target image; aiming at the water body remote sensing chromatic aberration distance image, a water body classification characteristic set which can be simultaneously suitable for remote sensing intelligent detection of a flood submerging area is established; aiming at the water body classification characteristic set, performing machine learning by using a training data set to construct a strong classifier; applying a strong classifier to the HSV image color clustering result, and identifying water body categories including a flood inundation area; and integrating the water body identification results before and after the flood to obtain disaster information. The flood information remote sensing intelligent acquisition method and device based on machine vision detection can realize remote sensing intelligent and efficient acquisition of large-range flood situation information.

title_en: True triaxial coal rock mass solid-flow coupling experimental device capable of being instantaneously unloaded
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rock mechanics simulation devices, and particularly relates to a true triaxial coal rock mass solid-flow coupling experimental device capable of instantly unloading. The device comprises: the device comprises a seal cavity, an axial pressure unit, a confining pressure unit, a gas unit and an instant unloading device; according to the invention, the gas unit is added on the basis of the true triaxial testing machine, the gas seepage speed in three stress directions is independently tested through the switch valve, and the gas emission when the instantaneously unloaded sample is unstably damaged can also be tested, so that the mine stoping process of high-stress high gas during coal mine deep mining can be better simulated, and the dynamic disaster mechanism can be researched; the problem that the existing triaxial test system lacks an instantaneous unloading device and cannot simulate the triggering condition of dynamic instantaneous unloading so that the evolution process of coal rock gas dynamic disasters cannot be reproduced in the whole process is solved.

title_en: A kind of intelligent O&M statement similarity matching process based on natural language processing
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent O&M statement similarity matching process based on natural language processing technique, the invention mainly comprises the data processing in construction of knowledge base, the sentence similarities based on deep learning to match two parts.Compared with prior art, advantage and effect are: (1) present invention carries out word segmentation processing to operation management knowledge using specific dictionary and HMM discovery neologisms model, improves the accuracy of text participle, establishes more clean text dictionary；(2) text invention is by deep learning method training term vector, " dimension disaster " phenomenon that can not only indicate to avoid term vector, but also can sufficiently excavate the information of lexicon context, the relationship between available word and word；(3) the sentence vector based on configuration weight, each word important measure can not only be obtained, the information of a vector can also be made to become more to enrich from the combination of term vector, so that matching accuracy rate on the basis of forming sentence vector is ensured using cosine similarity matching algorithm.

title_en: It is a kind of consider non-structural element indoor shake after three-dimensional virtual scene construction method
abstract_en: The present invention provides three-dimensional virtual scene construction method after a kind of indoor shake for considering non-structural element, belongs to civil engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters technical field.This method carries out model construction first and calculates, including structural analysis modeling and three-dimensional scenic modeling, structural earthquake dynamic response time-history analysis based on Building Information Model；Then it carries out non-structural element and destroys judgement, the collapse state judgement of the Earthquake Inertia Force Acting and frictional force calculating including independent non-structural element, the non-structural element based on vulnerability database；Three-dimensional scenic building and visualization are finally carried out, is fallen at random under seismic force effects including ceiling panel, the texture of partition wall execution is replaced, the motion status simulation of independent non-structural element.This method can be constructed with three-dimensional scenic after reasonable, the sense of reality indoor non-structural element shake, can be provided three-dimensional scenic for architecture indoor emergency evacuation and rescue respective fictional rehearsal and be supported, also can be directly used for the relevant teaching of seismic safety and publicity.

title_en: Rolling rock disaster risk assessment method, device and system and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, a system and a storage medium for evaluating risk of a rolling stone disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a stone rolling pregnancy disaster factor in a first preset area range; inputting the rock rolling pregnancy disaster factor into a pre-established statistical model, and acquiring a rock rolling source point and a probability value corresponding to the rock rolling source point; simulating a rock rolling path by using a physical model and taking a rock rolling source point as a starting point; calculating the length of the rock rolling path in a second preset area; and calculating the risk index of the rolling stone disaster in the second preset area according to the search radius, the rolling stone path, the length of the rolling stone path, the number of the rolling stone paths and the probability value corresponding to the rolling stone source point in the rolling stone path.
