abstract_en: The invention belongs to municipal works technical fields, disclose a kind of environment-friendly type municipal works slope reinforcement device, it is provided with fixed wall, before fixed wall is deposited in slip mass, fixed wall is fixed in stable slopes by the way that stake is welded and fixed below fixed wall, a hole is drilled on fixed wall, a fastening bolt is mounted in the hole, one of fastening bolt is embedded in stable slopes, it is poured by reinforced cemented-soil and to form reinforced cemented-soil and pour stake, the other end is installed by welding with fixed jaw on the surface contacted with fixed wall, the other end of fastening bolt is equipped with several fastening zippers by welded connecting and fixes with fixed wall connecting.The environment-friendly type municipal works slope reinforcement device outside slip mass by disposing fixed wall, and fixed wall is connected and fixed with internal stabilization slopes, reaction force is formed when sliding slip mass, prevents slip mass from falling off and the disaster that is formed, reduces the security risk that side slope slides.

title_en: A kind of identification and diaster prevention and control method of remnants absciss layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses the identifications and diaster prevention and control method of a kind of remaining absciss layer, comprising the following steps: according to overlying strata lithology and combinations thereof feature, is based on " combination beam " principle, determines the position of all absciss layers in overlying strata；Identify disastrous absciss layer；Calculate maximum absciss layer amount, the maximum remaining absciss layer amount of disastrous absciss layer；Determine the position of maximum remaining absciss layer；Remaining absciss layer disaster is prevented and treated.Beneficial effects of the present invention: finding absciss layer all in overlying strata by calculating, and to determine disastrous absciss layer, determines maximum remaining absciss layer amount, determine the position of remnants absciss layer, it realizes that the diaster prevention and control to remaining absciss layer works, reduces the generation of disaster, ensure safety of coal mines.And calculating parameter can be found in coal mine technical data archives, without increasing additional workload；Convenience of calculation, field engineering technical staff slightly give training and can grasp.

title_en: Functional game system and method for disaster handling
title_ko: 재난 대응을 위한 기능성 게임 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a functional game system and method for disaster handling. The present invention comprises: a disaster handling cloud server (corresponding to a disaster cloud server) for storing, in advance, at least one disaster handling scenario (corresponding to a disaster scenario) developed according to a disaster handling specialist's (master key user's) handling of a disaster situation of a ship, train or airplane; and a disaster handling specialist terminal for downloading a disaster handling scenario stored in the disaster handling cloud server, executing the downloaded scenario in virtual reality, receiving a countermeasure of the disaster handling specialist in response to a disaster situation in the executed disaster handling scenario, and developing the disaster handling scenario according to the received countermeasure.
abstract_ko: 재난 대응을 위한 기능성 게임 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 배, 기차 또는 비행기의 재난 상황에 대한 재난 대응 전문가(master key user)의 대응에 따라 전개되는 적어도 하나 이상의 재난 대응 시나리오(correspond to disaster scenario)를 미리 저장하는 재난 대응 클라우드 서버(correspond to disaster cloud server); 상기 재난 대응 클라우드 서버에 저장된 재난 대응 시나리오를 다운로드하여 가상 현실(virtual reality) 상에서 실행하고, 실행된 재난 대응 시나리오상의 재난 상황에 대응하여 상기 재난 대응 전문가의 대응 조치를 입력받고, 입력받은 대응 조치에 따라 상기 재난 대응 시나리오를 전개하는 재난 대응 전문가 단말을 구성한다.
assignees: LEE DONG KYU;UNIV DONG A RES FOUND FOR IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Mine water disaster early warning system
abstract_en: The present invention is suitable for monitoring mining technical field, provides a kind of mine water disaster early warning system, comprising: server, micro seismic monitoring device, water level monitoring device, displacement monitoring device and Forewarning Terminal；Micro seismic monitoring device is used to obtain the microseismic signals of the first mine；Water level monitoring device is used to monitor the Drilling Water place value of each drilling of first mine；Displacement monitoring device is used to monitor the displacement information of first mine；Server predicts that the first mine whether there is hidden water dezaster, if so, generating and sending water damage warning information to Forewarning Terminal according to the microseismic signals of the first mine, displacement information and the Drilling Water place value of each drilling.The present invention can timely know microseismic signals, to combine water level and displacement information on the basis of microseism early warning, prediction mine whether there is hidden water dezaster, can either improve the timeliness of water damage early warning, and can be improved the accuracy of water damage early warning.

title_en: Experimental platform and experimental method for simulating coal rock disaster of coal mine stope
abstract_en: The present invention provides an experimental platform for simulating a coal rock disaster of a coal mine extraction, including a base device, a coal simulation device, an immediate roof simulation device, a hydraulic support and a removable impact device. The coal simulation device is fixedly disposed on the base device; the hydraulic support is fixed on the base device and is located at one side of the coal simulation device; the immediate roof simulation device is disposed above the coal simulation device and the hydraulic support; the removable impact device is disposed above the immediate roof simulation device; the immediate roof simulation device is a rectangular frame; the rectangular frame is configured to pave a bulk simulation material and an immediate roof simulation material sequentially from the bottom up; and the removable impact device can impact the immediate roof simulation material and the bulk simulation material.

title_en: Experimental provision for the research of belt conveyer fire disaster simulation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of experimental provisions for the research of belt conveyer fire disaster simulation, including system frame, motor, frequency converter, roller and belt, the motor and roller are arranged on system frame top, motor is connect with roller, the frequency converter is connect with motor, and frequency converter can be covered on roller by motor drive roller speed-changing rotation, the belt, belt one end is fixedly connected with system frame, and the belt other end hangs down naturally and is fixed with weight.The experimental provision for the research of belt conveyer fire disaster simulation is capable of the friction condition and heating factor of each friction point in accurate simulation belt conveyer use process, convenient for analyzing it, consequently facilitating the fire alarm of belt conveyer.
assignees: TIANDI CHANGZHOU AUTOMATION CO;CHANGZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Platforms, systems, and methods for continuous recharging of high power devices utilizing wireless power transmission
abstract_en: Provided herein are wireless energy transfer systems comprising: a vacuum tube device configured to produce a microwave energy; a waveguide configured to receive the microwave energy and wirelessly transmit an alternating current emission having a wavelength through air; and a rectenna configured to wirelessly receive the alternating current emission and convert the alternating current emission to a direct current. The systems are suitable to aid and improve such fields as civil engineering, firefighting, military exercises, photography, mapmaking, surveying, telecommunications, transportation, and delivery

title_en: Device, method applied to the test of major landslip stability three-dimensional physical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of devices applied to the test of major landslip stability three-dimensional physical simulation, method, belong to the experimental test technical field in geological disaster, including frame work platform, model casing, rainfall mechanism, soil water pressure mechanism, displacement image acquisition mechanism, landslide slope control mechanism, automatic data collection analysis institution, soil water pressure mechanism includes earth pressure gauge, pore pressure gauge, volume of water moisture content inductor；Being displaced image acquisition mechanism includes three-dimensional laser scanner, vertical displacement measuring part, horizontal displacement monitoring component；Landslide slope control mechanism includes vertical load control motor, horizontal loading control motor, voltage stabilization and current stabilization digital control meter oil sources pumping plant, control sensor.Invention achieves can accurate simulation prototype seepage field, displacement field, stress field, under the conditions of available difference raininess, land movement of coming down in the effective depth of rainfall infiltration, landslide motion process, pore water pressure and stress field data technical effect.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Risk assessment method for oil and gas pipeline system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method for an oil and gas pipeline system, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a third history oil and gas pipeline accident training set, determining a primary disaster causing factor, a secondary disaster causing factor, a coping index, an evaluation parameter and a corresponding value of each accident, inputting a primary disaster causing factor value into a first neural network model to obtain a first primary evaluation parameter value, inputting a coping index value into a second neural network model to obtain a second primary evaluation parameter value, taking the secondary disaster causing factor value, the first primary evaluation parameter value and the second primary evaluation parameter value as input layers of the neural network, taking the evaluation parameter values as output layers of the neural network, and training to obtain a third neural network model; and predicting the evaluation parameter value by using a third neural network model according to the actual running condition of the pipeline, and calculating a risk value. The invention establishes the relation between the disaster-causing factors, the coping indexes and the evaluation parameters by utilizing the neural network, so that the evaluation is more objective and the evaluation time is short.

title_en: Method for evaluating sliding area of side slope
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of slope stability evaluation and disaster prevention and control, and relates to a slope sliding area evaluation method, which comprises the steps of firstly calculating an initial sliding surface corresponding to a minimum safety coefficient of a slope, and an initial sliding area and an initial dead weight corresponding to the initial sliding surface; then covering possible sliding areas of the side slope, randomly generating a plurality of possible sliding surfaces to simulate the possible sliding areas of the side slope, and calculating the secondary safety coefficient of the possible sliding surfaces; and finally, regarding the feasible sliding surface with the secondary safety coefficient less than or equal to 1 as a secondary failure sliding surface, calculating the area of each secondary failure sliding surface one by one, performing non-repeated accumulation on all secondary failure sliding areas and the initial sliding area, and finally evaluating the sliding area of the slope by using the accumulated value. The error value of the slope sliding area calculated by the method is small, and the consequences caused by slope sliding can be preliminarily evaluated by utilizing the slope sliding area.

title_en: Multi-factor fused MOS storm surge process disaster simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of marine disaster prediction, in particular to a multi-factor MOS storm surge process disaster simulation method, which comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out statistical analysis on historical processes of tropical cyclone storm surge disasters, analyzing characteristic factors of an MOS storm surge model, and establishing the MOS storm surge model; (2) and determining a characteristic factor matrix, taking the characteristic factor matrix as input, and using a support vector machine to learn and train so as to realize the simulation of tropical cyclone storm tide and water increase. The method can optimize the error between the pure numerical prediction and the measured value of the tide level station, and provides a new process simulation thought for the later refined storm surge prediction business.

title_en: A kind of Multifunctional campus emergency alert system and evacuation drilling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Multifunctional campus emergency alert system and evacuation drilling methods, including data processing server, video monitoring apparatus, water quality monitoring system, alarm system, fire-fighting system, personnel location system, fire alarm system, access management system, the communication server, the water quality monitoring system, personnel location system, alarm system, fire-fighting system, fire alarm system, access management system are connect with data processing server respectively, and data processing server is connect with the communication server.Carry out systemic management while promoting every alarm performance according to the present invention, the associated alarm automatic synchronization that is triggered enables many kinds of measures, can quickly handle corresponding situation, make safer campus alarm system.
assignees: YINUO INTELLIGENT SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Come down rainfall simulator and landslide rainfall simulation monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of landslide rainfall simulator and the rainfall simulation monitoring system that comes down, and belongs to geological disaster analogue technique field.A kind of landslide rainfall simulator, including rainfall component, hoistable platform component and adjusting component.Wherein, rainfall component include bracket, water tank, spray main pipe, spray be in charge of, raindrop plate and limit plate.Hoistable platform component includes landslide platform, accumulation platform, lifters, the platform that comes down includes side plate and bottom plate, bottom plate two sides are all connected with side plate, and lifters are set to tilt angle of the bottom plate for regulating base board, and accumulation platform is set to the front end of bottom plate and hinged with bottom plate.Lifters are capable of the tilt angle of regulating base board, can simulate the landslide of different gradient.Adjusting component includes baffle and regulating part, and regulating part is capable of the position of controllable register.It can change the position of baffle by regulating part, the relative distance of baffle and side plate namely change, the landslide of different landslide forms can be simulated.

title_en: Evaluation method
title_ko: 피난 유도물 및 피난 유도원의 배치효율 평가 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for evaluating the efficiency of arrangements of evacuation guidance objects and evacuation guidance agents, which enables an escape time and an escape route, on which people can escape in the shortest possible time, to be derived by placing the evacuation guidance objects and agents strategically throughout a building from which the people are to escape, hereinafter referred to as an escape building. The method for evaluating the efficiency of arrangements of evacuation guidance objects and evacuation guidance agents includes: receiving a blueprint of an escape building from a design module to arrange nodes; setting a disaster type and generating a disaster situation virtually; simulating an escape time and an escape route of a control group of the evacuation guidance agents; computing the escape time and route of the control group of the evacuation guidance agents and recognizing a congested section; setting configurations of the evacuation guidance objects and agents and arranging the evacuation guidance objects and agents based on the nodes to resolve the congestion section; performing a simulation for computing a comparative escape time and a comparative escape route of the evacuation guidance agents; and computing a first evaluation escape time based on the comparative escape time and escape time of the control group and computing an escape route and a congested section for the evacuation guidance agents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 피난 유도물 및 피난 유도원의 배치효율 평가 방법에 관한 것으로서, 피난 유도원 및(또는) 피난 유도물을 대피 구조물의 적재적소에 배치함으로써 피난원이 최단시간에 탈출할 수 있는 탈출시간 및 탈출경로를 도출하는 피난 유도물 및 피난 유도원의 배치효율 평가 방법에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해 설계모듈로부터 피난 구조물의 설계도를 입력받아 노드를 배치하는 단계, 노드를 기준으로 탈출구 배치, 피난원 배치, 재난 구역을 설정하고  재난 종류를 설정하여 재난 상황을 발생시키는 단계, 피난원의 대조군 탈출시간 및 대조군 탈출 경로를 시뮬레이션하는 단계, 피난원의 대조군 탈출시간 및 대조군 탈출 경로를 산출하고, 정체구간을 인식하는 단계, 피난 유도물 및 피난 유도원의 설정요소를 설정하고, 정체구간을 해소하도록 노드를 기준으로 피난 유도물 및 피난 유도원을 배치 적용하는 단계, 피난원의 비교 탈출시간 및 비교 탈출 경로를 산출하도록 시뮬레이션하는 단계, 비교 탈출시간과 대조군 탈출시간을 기초로 1차 평가 탈출시간을 산출하고, 피난원의 탈출 경로 및 정체구간을 산출하는 단계, 1차 평가 탈출시간을 기준으로 피난 유도물의 배치가 관계 법령에 만족되는지 여부를 1차 평가하는 단계, 피난 유도물 및 피난 유도원의 설정요소를 재설정하고, 노드를 기준으로 피난 유도물 및 피난 유도원을 재배치 적용하는 단계, 피난원의 비교 탈출시간 및 비교 탈출 경로를 산출하도록 시뮬레이션함으로써 2차 평가 탈출시간을 재산출하고, 피난원의 전체 탈출 경로 및 정체구간을 재산출하는 단계, 및 2차 평가 탈출시간을 기준으로 피난 유도물의 재배치가 관계 법령에 만족되는지 여부를 2차 평가하고, 1,2차 평가 탈출시간을 토대로 최단 탈출시간 도출 및 정체구간의 해소 여부를 평가하는 것을 특징으로 하는 피난 유도물 및 피난 유도원의 배치효율 평가 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: A kind of disaster area personnel search and rescue and goods and materials put-on method based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The disaster area personnel that the invention discloses a kind of based on unmanned plane search and rescue with goods and materials put-on method, rescue method is the following steps are included: S1: information collection: acquiring topography, environment and the geographical location in disaster area, and carries out confluence analysis to information；S2: determine route: the information according to S1 formulates flight path, and route is input in the controller of unmanned plane；S3: equipment is carried: after the flight path described in the S2 determines, positioning device, picture pick-up device and life detection equipment being loaded on unmanned plane, and is debugged to equipment, it is ensured that the normal operation of equipment；S4: carry out and search and rescue: after the completion of the equipment described in the S3 is carried.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows by summarizing to the information of collection, useless information is eliminated, improves rescue personnel to the extraction rate of information, and be simulated to the launch process of entire goods and materials, ensure that deviation is not too large when goods and materials are launched, and facilitates extraction of the ground staff to goods and materials.
assignees: GUANGZHOU DAOFENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Release device and lifesaving appliance
abstract_en: A kind of release device and lifesaving appliance include that component and controller are held in matrix, release component, top, with Power Component communication connection and control the opening and closing of Power Component；It holds component and can be rotated by Power Component to limit release component so that release component locks the latched position of stay hook in life raft, and turns to and separated with release component so as to discharge the releasing position of stay hook in component release life raft in top.In the present invention in case of emergency, ordinary person can be automatically controlled release component by operation controller and turn to releasing position by latched position, realize the automatic release to life raft, it is easy to operate, needing not move through professional training can be completed operation, and saving oneself for passenger strives for the quality time when occurring for disaster waterborne.

title_en: Movable plank house escape device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of movable plank house escape devices, belong to security against fire field；Solve that second floor personnel when fire occurs for existing movable plank house are not easy to escape, fire-fighting escape device is not fixed complete technical problem.The utility model includes escape bar, and escaping exit made of being surrounded as emergency opening door, protection component is equipped in the middle part of escape bar, and upper end is equipped with tension member, and lower end is equipped with ground anchoring piece.The utility model adapts to existing movable plank house, is not necessarily to a large amount of damaged board house structures installations, installation is easy and solid and reliable, does not influence board house normal use after installation；Component can be with industrialized production, and can be recycled；Function is realized simply, structurally reasonable, economical and practical without excessive use training.When fire occurs, escape door can be opened rapidly out of corridor, and personnel take advantage of a situation downslides from escape bar, and rapidly, safely, emergency capability is strong for evacuation egress.
assignees: ZHEJIANG CONSTRUCTION INVEST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Disaster of mountain massif coast scenario simulation method based on substance point methods
abstract_en: The disaster of mountain massif coast scenario simulation method based on substance point methods that the invention discloses a kind of.It the steps include: that 1) this Disasters is modeled and drawn to landslide in field of Computer Graphics.2) yield surface criterion is improved on the basis of traditional MPM method, introduces modified Cambridge model.3) granular materials based on MPM and the tow-way coupling model of rigid body effect are proposed, so that the native stone interaction during landslide is truer, improve the efficiency of large-scale complex disaster scenario simulation.The present invention solves the problems, such as that in computer graphics, disaster of mountain massif coast scenario simulation lacks, and can simulate the coupling phenomenon of movement between the soil particle in the generating process of landslide, the collision between stone rigid body and soil particle and stone rigid body.

title_en: A kind of intelligence hamster cage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligent hamster cages, including hamster measured body weight system, drinking-water system for measuring quantity, diet system for measuring quantity, epidemic disaster regulating system, Light intensity regulating system, add food system, automatic adds water system, sawdust replacement system, movement measurement system automatically, the present apparatus may be implemented to be automatically replenished food, water, sawdust, automatic measurement hamster dietary amount, amount of drinking water, the amount of exercise of automatic monitoring hamster, temperature, humidity, the intensity of illumination for automatically adjusting hamster cage achieve the purpose that intelligent control, feed hamster meticulously.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle image highway geological disaster identification method based on pre-training DCNN
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of road geological disaster identification, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle image road geological disaster identification method based on pre-trained DCNN, which comprises the following steps: step S1, acquiring unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing images in a road domain range, and preprocessing the images to obtain orthographic images after absolute orientation; step S2, segmenting the preprocessed unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image by adopting a mean shift algorithm considering image texture characteristics; and step S3, taking the segmented unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image data as input data, and applying the input data to the trained road geological disaster recognition model to obtain a road geological disaster recognition result. The unmanned aerial vehicle high-resolution image is adopted, the image is segmented based on the mean shift algorithm considering the textural features, and the segmented image unit is used as the input data of the geological disaster identification model, so that the efficiency of visual interpretation of the existing geological disaster can be effectively improved, and data support is provided for highway field investigation and disaster risk evaluation.

title_en: Water-soil coupling landslide simulation method based on high-order double-sleeve double-phase object particle method
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation method of water-soil coupling landslide based on a high-order double-set double-phase object particle method, which adopts two sets of object dot division to respectively disperse solid soil particles and pore fluid, and adopts a regular background grid to realize the solution of a control equation; under the continuous medium mechanical framework, the establishment of a control equation of a solid-liquid two-phase object particle method for dividing double sets of substances is realized; realizing interaction between solid-liquid two-phase object particles and background grid nodes through a high-order B spline basis function; updating the information such as acceleration, speed and position of the solid-liquid two-phase material point based on the B spline basis function, mapping the calculated node information to the material point, updating the material information of the latest solid-liquid two-phase material point, and finally outputting simulation information. The invention can accurately simulate the large deformation damage process and the water-soil coupling mechanism of the water-soil coupling soil landslide, and provides data support for disaster assessment and prevention of the water-soil coupling soil landslide problem.

title_en: Regional geological disaster susceptibility prediction method and device based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional geological disaster proneness prediction method and device based on machine learning, relates to the field of geological analysis, and aims to solve the technical problem of low prediction precision in the prior art and improve the prediction precision. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring monitoring data of preset acquisition parameters of each single monitoring point of a target area within a preset time period; preprocessing the monitoring data of each single monitoring point to obtain standardized data of each single monitoring point; performing characteristic engineering on the standardized data of each single monitoring point to obtain parameter data for training of each single monitoring point; respectively carrying out monomer index prediction on each monomer monitoring point by using a preset machine learning method based on the parameter data for training of each monomer monitoring point to obtain a monomer prediction result of each monomer monitoring point; and integrating the monomer prediction results of each monomer monitoring point to obtain the regional prediction result of the target region.

title_en: Driving face coal combines control method with gas protrusion and dynamic impact problem disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of driving face coals to combine control method with gas protrusion and dynamic impact problem disaster, by driving face meet head on the concordant being drilled with drilling increase in front of coal body gas permeability and discharge wait dig gas or carbon dioxide gas inside coal body, reduce its concentration；According further to each concordant drilling drilling process in the presence or absence of gas or carbon dioxide it is exceeded, with the presence or absence of coal body dynamic phenomenon or whether have coal dust amount be greater than critical value the case where, determine that driving face meets head on front with the presence or absence of there is a situation where prominent or danger of burst, if it is determined that there is prominent or danger of burst, then by drilling to concordant load explosive carry out unloading pressure by blasting, thus reduce driving face meet head on front occur danger of burst degree；So that concordant drilling achievees the purpose that a Kong Siyong (i.e. release gas, carbon dioxide, monitors gas, gas concentration lwevel, monitors whether that, there are danger of burst, release reduces shock hazard), there is very high application value in driving face in coal mine.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;YAOJIE COAL ELECTRICITY GROUP CO LTD;XUZHOU HONGYI SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of multi-function windtunnel for simulating disaster-ridden evil coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multi-function windtunnel for simulating disaster-ridden evil coupling, including wind-tunnel runner, the wind tunnel fan for generating Background wind is equipped in the wind-tunnel runner, and be additionally provided with terrestrial environment trial zone and water environment trial zone in the wind-tunnel runner；Extreme air-flow simulator is respectively equipped in the terrestrial environment trial zone and water environment trial zone, or the wind-tunnel runner includes straight line test section, the terrestrial environment trial zone and water environment trial zone are arranged in the straight line test section, and the extreme air-flow simulator that can be used for the analogous pole end air-flow in the terrestrial environment trial zone and water environment trial zone simultaneously is equipped in the straight line test section.The multi-function windtunnel of the disaster-ridden evil coupling of simulation of the invention, not only effect of the load under analog terrestrial environment and water environment to building structure, and can with simulant building structure under various single wind field environment really reporting situations and building structure under at least two wind field couplings really reporting situations.

title_en: Bottom plate separation layer rotary jet grouting process and grouting device in operation period of karst tunnel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster management of tunnels and underground engineering, and particularly relates to a bottom plate separation layer rotary jet grouting process and a grouting device in a karst tunnel operation period. The process comprises the following steps: A. physical exploration of a bottom plate separation layer: determining the depth, spatial range and characteristics of a separation layer, and providing a decision basis for the design of a grouting treatment scheme; B. the design of a treatment scheme is as follows: determining a treatment area, and finishing scheme design, wherein the scheme design comprises a slurry parameter, a grouting parameter and a drilling parameter; C. drilling construction: laying hole sites on site according to the scheme design; D. grouting and reinforcing a bottom plate separation layer: and (3) putting the nozzle end of the plate separation layer rotary spraying grouting device into the drill hole, enabling the rotary spray head to be located at the separation layer depth, and then carrying out rotary spraying grouting on the broken surrounding rock and the cavity in the separation layer. The method can realize directional quick setting and grouting and uniform circular diffusion of the grout at the separation layer position, has better reinforcing effect and is not influenced by the gradient of the tunnel and the water storage of the separation layer cavity.

title_en: A kind of parallel emergency evacuation system and its construction method based on ACP
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of parallel emergency evacuation system and its construction method based on ACP, the parallel emergency system include practical evacuating system and artificial evacuating system, and practical evacuating system is for real-time collector distribution, emergency service and evacuation environmental data；Artificial evacuating system is used to design emergency evacuation experiment according to the real data, obtain dispersal plan, and it sends it to practical evacuating system and carries out parallel laboratory test, feedback data in practical evacuating system acquisition experimentation, artificial evacuating system adjusts dispersal plan according to feedback data, the implementation result for verifying dispersal plan, selects final dispersal plan to be supplied to practical evacuating system.Parallel emergency evacuation system and its construction method provided by the invention based on ACP can simulate Fiel's meeting scene and carry out emergency evacuation experiment, its Calculation results can provide technical basis in terms of revision contingency plan, optimization emergency evacuation scheme and Emergency decision for nuclear power plant's emergency organization, have good technical effect.

title_en: The experimental provision and method of integration prevention and treatment coal mine composite power disaster
abstract_en: The experimental provision and method of integration prevention and treatment coal mine composite power disaster, water filling and gas drainage are carried out using same drilling subsection, coal body Burst Tendency and displacement gas are reduced by water filling, gas drainage can also increase coal seam infusion effect when gas pressure in reducing coal body simultaneously, can solve difficult the problem of filling the water of gas pressure height in deep mining, the low coal seam of permeability.The present apparatus has the advantages that water filling and extraction can carry out being interrupted simultaneously and can reciprocally carry out simultaneously, and the effect of the water filling of deep high stress low permeability coal seam is greatly improved, reduces bump Gas Outburst composite power disasters danger.

title_en: Based on water-fine early warning technology of suction stress-secure topical field Loess Landslide
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of based on water-fine early warning technology of suction stress-secure topical field Loess Landslide, innovation realization based on ramp unit, consider the fining early warning technology of loess slope Catastrophe Process and mechanism.By establishing the loess plateau Assessment for Stability of slope universality method using water as core, under the more rainfall intensities of calculating simulation on the basis of the high slope secure topical field in different shelvings, the gradient, slope, construct the threshold value of warning system with slope " failure probability " for criterion, the moisture content response modes of different type ramp unit under different rainfall intensities are proposed, loess plateau slope hidden danger EARLY RECOGNITION and fining early-warning and predicting based on rain factor, as unit of ramp unit are realized by this.The present invention can provide more accurate, real-time technical support for Geological Hazards Monitoring early warning, effectively avoid and reduce geological disaster to people's bring person and property loss.
assignees: XIAN CENTER OF GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CGS

title_en: Compact movable units for recreating and simulating real and controlled fire conditions
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compact movable unit for recreating and simulating real and controlled fire conditions, to teach and train firefighters, industrial workers and every person who needs training on the use and management of fire extinguishers and on techniques for controlling fire and the emergencies deriving from same. The movable unit consists of a cart formed by a structure mounted on a chassis (13), the structure being formed by: two side walls (16); two front doors (15); two rear doors (7); and two areas or chambers, a front chamber (1) and a rear chamber (8) separated by an internal dividing wall (6), wherein gas cylinders (21), corresponding to a fuel tank for generating the fire, and a conventional air accumulator (26) are incorporated into said front chamber (1), and wherein a water tank (9) is disposed in said rear chamber (8). Installed in said water tank is a coil system formed by two independent coils: a first coil (18) connected to the fuel tank and a second coil (17) for injecting air into the water in the tank (9), the second coil (17) having a smaller diameter than the first fuel-emission coil (18) and being submerged at the bottom of the water tank (9), the second coil (17) also having a series of small perforations and being connected by means of a tube to the conventional air accumulator incorporated into the front chamber (1).

title_en: Tropical cyclone forecasting method based on depth target detection and numerical weather forecast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tropical cyclone forecasting method based on depth target detection and numerical weather forecasting, which comprises the following steps of: building a training data set according to a plurality of forecast elements in a tropical cyclone historical record combined historical numerical weather forecast product; training a depth target detection model according to the training data set so as to obtain model parameters, and taking the trained model as a tropical cyclone recognition model; and according to the tropical cyclone identification model, identifying the central position and the scale of the tropical cyclone from a real-time numerical weather forecast product forecast field, and outputting the central position and the scale as a forecast result. The method and the device realize accurate prediction of the path and the scale of the tropical cyclone, and the accurate prediction of the path and the scale of the tropical cyclone plays an important role in preventing and alleviating related disasters.

title_en: Engineering information system based on combination of BIM, MR and 3DP technologies
abstract_en: The invention relates to an engineering information system based on the combination of BIM, MR and 3DP technologies, which is constructed in the following process: step one, building a building model to be analyzed related to engineering step by step in a computer by utilizing a BIM technology, and acquiring information data of the whole life cycle of a building; secondly, recording the information data of the building full life cycle of the building model according to different classifications by using an SQL Server database; the MR equipment is worn on the eyes of a user, display and intelligent analysis are carried out by using the MR technology, a BIM model simulation mode, a holographic projection forming mode and an intelligent analysis mode option are included on a screen of the MR equipment, and different working modes are selected to enter through the MR equipment; and fourthly, connecting the 3D printing equipment with the computer, and printing the BIM model disaster prevention model and the building model by using a 3DP technology. The problems of discontinuous information data transmission, uncoordinated connection, unintelligent analysis, non-visual expression and the like of the full life cycle of the building in the application of the BIM technology are solved.

title_en: A kind of engineering structure seismic design based on displacement method
abstract_en: The present invention by calculate angle of displacement limit value can be fabulous reaction stress and deformation performance, the yield displacement of corresponding displacement angle limit value can be released so that it is determined that demand by damping ratio, its limiting condition for being easiest to impacted link can be reacted in practical structures so that it is determined that whether structure is feasible using assumption value according to the architecture quality of structure and intensity, by calculating the performance capabilities that can be simulated when encountering different degrees of earthquake to the design that different performance level carries out, carry out Properties Control, it is a kind of very reliably method that earthquake is resisted using displacement structure, on the basis of seismic design based on displacement, designer needs receiving behavior of better control structure during coming earthquake, it prevents because of destruction caused by structural degeneration scarce capacity, therefore in later Aseismic Design, we need one kind that can effectively control building Collapse state makes building reach the method for antidetonation peak performance in period phase, reduces disaster expense and improves safety.

title_en: Methods for differentiation of earthquake signal and prediction of earthquake intensity using randomly generated artificial seismic training data for an arbitrary zone
title_ko: 임의 지진구역 대상 무작위 생성 지진학습데이터를 이용한 지진여부판별 방법 및 이에 의한 진도예측 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake determination method using randomly generated seismic learning data for arbitrary seismic zones. The earthquake determination method, an earthquake determination method using an artificial neural network technique, performed by an earthquake intensity prediction system for predicting an earthquake intensity using seismic waves in a target zone, comprises the steps of: collecting past earthquake data of the target zone and deriving seismic wave characteristic data from the collected past earthquake data; performing a pseudo earthquake probability model which reflects the derived seismic wave characteristic data to randomly generate learning data on general vibration and seismic vibration for the target zone; providing the learning data generated through the pseudo earthquake probability model to artificial neural network learning; inputting, if an actual P wave is detected, the P wave to an artificial neural network to determine whether an earthquake occurs; and generating an artificial S wave to estimate a structure′s response through the artificial neural network technique and predicting a damage scale of the structure using the generated artificial S wave to provide an earthquake warning. Therefore, the earthquake determination method of the present invention can be applied to smart seismometers in a house, a building, or the like, to improve the accuracy and reliability of earthquake warnings. The earthquake determination method can be also employed in a structural health monitoring (SHM) technology in construction and civil engineering fields to analyze a seismic impact on a structure. Moreover, the earthquake determination method is applied to a construction site to enable quick early evacuation and facility control in case of a natural disaster on the construction site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 임의 지진구역 대상 무작위 생성 지진학습데이터를 이용한 지진여부판별 방법 에 관한 것으로서, 대상 지역의 지진파를 이용하여 지진 판별 진도를 예측하는 진도예측 시스템에 의해 수행되는 인공신경망 기법을 이용한 지진여부판별 방법에 있어서, 대상 지역의 과거 지진 데이터를 수집하고, 상기 수집된 과거 지진 데이터에서 지진파 특성 데이터를 도출하는 단계; 상기 도출된 지진파 특성 데이터를 반영하여 상기 대상 지역에 대한 일반 진동 및 지진 진동의 학습 데이터를 무작위로 생성하는 의사 진동 확률 모델을 수행하는 단계; 상기 의사진동 확률 모델을 통해 생성된 학습 데이터를 인공 신경망 학습에 제공하는 단계; 실제 P파가 감지되면, 상기 감지된 P파를 상기 인공 신경망에 입력하여 지진 여부를 판별하는 단계; 및 상기 인공 신경망 기법을 통해 구조물 응답 추정을 위해 인공 S파를 생성하고, 상기 생성된 인공 S파를 이용하여 구조물의 피해 규모를 예측하여 지진 경보를 제공하는 단계를 포함한다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 주택이나 건물 등의 스마트 지진계에 적용되어 지진 경보의 정확도와 신뢰도를 향상시킬 수 있고, 건축 및 토목 분야의 구조물 건전성 모니터링(SHM) 기술에 적용되어 구조물의 지진 영향을 분석할 수 있으며, 시공 중인 구조물에도 적용되어 공사 현장에 자연재해 발생 시 신속히 조기 대피 및 조기 설비 제어를 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: smart door system
title_ko: 스마트 도어 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a smart door system, which links a mobile phone and the Internet to a normal door lock, thereby removing a need for pushing numbers, increasing safety, adding a reservation function, and increasing security. To achieve the purpose, the present invention comprises the following components. The smart door system of the present invention divides into two parts. A first part is a locking part locking a door, and a second part is a body commanding locking of the door. The locking part includes: a magnetic object; an electromagnet; and a sensor detecting someone approaching and leaving. The body can be divided into a command unit issuing a command and an input unit inputting the command. The present invention makes it easy to lock and unlock the door without dialing the number or drilling a hole in the door and installing the door lock. Further, the present invention eliminates the concern that a user cannot enter or exit when the power is off, as well as the concern that the power is off, and enables the user to easily open and close the door even when the power is off due to a disaster or the like. Further, the present invention can remotely open the door at peak hours by using a reservation function. Further, the present invention can open and close the door by using biometrics without installing, on the door, a system using biometric technology, as well as the current security system that is easy to penetrate.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 일반적인 도어락에 휴대폰과 인터넷을 연동시켜서 굳이 번호를 누르지 않아도 되고, 안전성을 높이고, 예약 기능을 추가하며, 보안도를 높인 스마트 도어 시스템을 제공함에 목적이 있다. 본 발명은 앞서 본 목적을 달성하기 위하여 다음과 같은 구성을 가진다. 본 발명의 스마트 도어 시스템은 크게 두 가지 부분으로 나뉘는데, 첫 번째는 문을 실제로 잠그는 잠금부이고, 둘째는 문을 잠그도록 명령을 내리는 본체이다. 잠금부는 다시 자성 물체와 그에 붙는 전자석, 그리고 가까워지고 멀어짐을 탐지하는 센서를 포함한다. 그리고 본체는 명령을 내리는 명령부와, 명령을 입력하는 입력부로 나눌 수 있다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 굳이 번호를 누르거나 문에 구멍을 뚫어 도어락을 설치하지 않아도 문을 잠그고 여는 동작을 쉽고 간단하게 하는 효과가 있다. 
또한 본 발명에 따르면, 전류가 끊어져 나가지도 들어오지도 못하는 걱정을 할 필요 없이, 전류가 끊길 걱정을 할 이유도 없고, 재해 등으로 전력이 끊어져도 문을 쉽게 열고 닫을 수 있게 하는 효과가 있다. 
또한 본 발명에 따르면, 예약 기능을 사용하여 자주 들락거리는 시간에 문을 원격에서 열어놓을 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한 본 발명에 따르면, 현재의 뚫리기 쉬운 보안 시스템뿐만이 아닌, 생체 인식 기술을 지닌 시스템을 문에 설치하지 않아도 생체 인식으로 문을 개폐하는 것도 가능하다.
assignees: PARK JIN WOO;PARK JU SUNG;CHOI JI WON

title_en: Controlling apparatus for marine training, and control method thereof
title_ko: 해상훈련관제장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a maritime training control device, and to an operating method thereof. With regard to the marine accident response training, by implementing to control training situations of ships positioned in a maritime training site through an electronic chart-based situation map, the maritime training control device has an excellent effect on the command system training.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해양사고 대응훈련과 관련하여 해상훈련현장에 위치하고 있는 선박들의 훈련상황을 전자 해도 기반의 상황도를 통해서 관제할 수 있도록 구현함으로써, 지휘 체계 훈련에 탁월한 효과를 기대할 수 있는 해상훈련관제장치 및 그 동작 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Integrated test device and method for filling karst cave deposition and tunnel intermittent water and mud inrush disasters
abstract_en: An integrated test device and method for filling karst cave deposition and tunnel intermittent water and mud inrush disasters. The device includes a mixing tank, water tank, water collection tank and plurality of depositing tanks, wherein mixing tank outlet is connected to one end of a pipe, the other end of the pipe extends to one end of the water tank, the plurality of depositing tanks are arranged underwater tank at intervals, the water collection tank is arranged at the water tank's other end, and a detachable baffle is arranged in the water tank and in front of each depositing tank. The deposition and consolidation of filling media and water and mud inrush can be simulated and observed through the setting and cooperation of the plurality of depositing tanks, different working conditions can be simulated by changing the flow rate, sample concentration, particle gradation, depositing height and displacement.

title_en: The method for studying high Rayleigh number fusion pool heat transfer characteristic using improved Finite Volume Method for Air
abstract_en: A method of high Rayleigh number fusion pool heat transfer characteristic being studied using improved Finite Volume Method for Air, key step is as follows: 1, carrying out particle modeling for particular problem, sets particle initial placement；2, according to each particle position grid division；3, after time step Δ t, energy equation is solved using Finite Volume Method for Air；4, the viscosity term and source item in the particle method processing explicit algorithm equation of momentum, estimates particle rapidity and position；5, population density is calculated, pressure Poisson equations are solved；6, the correction value of calculating speed, and calculate speed and position of each particle in layer of lower a period of time；7, calculated result is exported, and wall heat flux density is exported according to the particular problem of solution and melts the phase of intracisternal material.This method has the advantages that particle method accurately captures free surface and simulation Phase-change Problems, computational accuracy with higher again, high Rayleigh number fusion pool heat transfer characteristic can be studied by the method, provide important evidence for nuclear power plant's reactor disaster security feature research.

title_en: A kind of simulated fire demo system for phase configuration Intelligent Fire Detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of simulated fire demo systems for phase configuration Intelligent Fire Detection device, fire disaster simulation system, fire pot experimental system, LED display and electric control box are overcharged including pipeline fire disaster simulation system, electrical cabinet fire disaster simulation system, lithium battery, the pipeline fire disaster simulation system, electrical cabinet fire disaster simulation system, lithium battery overcharge fire disaster simulation system, fire pot experimental system and LED display correspondence and be connected with electric control box.The present invention can simulate a variety of scenes of fire, and using effect is good, and use is safe.
assignees: JIANGSU HONGRAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Navigation method and device for personnel evacuation path
abstract_en: The application provides a personnel evacuation path navigation method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that a fire is detected, determining a simulation scene which is most similar to the fire scene from preset simulation scenes as an optimal simulation scene, determining escape paths of all simulation personnel corresponding to the optimal simulation scene according to a preset corresponding relation to serve as navigation paths of the fire scene, determining escape paths of all real personnel in the fire scene according to the navigation paths of the fire scene, and informing all real personnel of the escape paths of all real personnel. When real people escape according to the escape route sent by the application, casualty conditions in a fire scene can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Wind angle autonomous amplitude controlling type wind turbine
abstract_en: To provide a wind turbine that can generate electricity from the breeze and suppress excessive rotation in the typhoons and other storms, gently rotates even by such a building wind and city area wind as having a wind direction/speed changed suddenly, and has performance superior two times or more, in order to utilize the cool breeze blowing at night and day as local production energy to be able to make use even during the time of disaster.SOLUTION: Hydrodynamic circulation theory gives an angle of attack to the wing in a steady-state fluid and is a concept of measuring a dynamic lift. Based on an amplitude circulation lift-drag curve of a new concept simulating adverse conditions where a wind direction/speed is changed suddenly and reversed, an amplitude circulation type is devised as follows: a wing chord line is preliminarily supported in parallel to a rotational sweep surface and flexibly, and is activated with drag and lift; a large lift is obtained if inclined; the wing angle of attack is reversed by the drag in the adverse wind; and thereby the lift being arranged in the driving direction is obtained. Furthermore, a lift-drag ratio of the wing is increased and a peeling suppression amplitude slit is provided, and thereby a smart symmetric stream line wing for suppressing vortex is developed, and also, a wing angle autonomous amplitude controlling system is invented. As a result, it is superior in starting performance and the lift is always generated in the leading edge direction upon sharp inversion of wind direction, and therefore the need of the inversion yaw control is eliminated in the horizontal axis type wind turbine. Also, a conventional fixed wing type ratio of 1.9 times is achieved in the application trial manufacture evaluation to an omnidirectional vertical axis wind turbine.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: A kind of method of vegetation radiative transfer model inverting forest fire burning earthquake intensity
abstract_en: A method of the vegetation radiative transfer model inverting forest fire burning earthquake intensity based on the layering of trees coverage parameter belongs to remote-sensing inversion technical field.For this method by introducing trees coverage parameter in vegetation radiative transfer model forward simulation and carrying out hierarchy parameters according to its variation range, building is suitable for the look-up table of different trees coverage ranges；Pass through section where inputting trees coverage Remote Sensing Products to determine trees coverage into refutation process rear, so that burning earthquake intensity inverting carries out in the look-up table corresponding to section where trees coverage, to improve the matching degree of burning earthquake intensity and Remote Spectra response curve, it reduces spectrum to obscure on burning earthquake intensity inverting bring influence, and then improves burning earthquake intensity inversion accuracy.The present invention can more true, ground after accurately simulation and inverting fire occur actual conditions, the burning earthquake intensity precision that inverting obtains is higher, and the indicative function of forest management and protection is definitely after the condition of a disaster assessment and calamity after fire occurs.

title_en: A kind of landslide disaster real-time monitoring device
abstract_en: A kind of landslide disaster real-time monitoring device disclosed by the utility model, environmental factor acquisition module including monitoring region is arranged in, the input terminal of the output end signal connection landslide early warning telemetry terminal system of environmental factor acquisition module, the data of acquisition are transferred to landslide telemetering Forewarning Terminal, landslide telemetering Forewarning Terminal is arranged in the slopes of monitoring section, landslide telemetering Forewarning Terminal is internally provided with power module, wireless communication module and alarm module, is equipped with gate inhibition's locking device outside the telemetering Forewarning Terminal that comes down；Coming down, module connects central station to telemetry terminal system by wireless communication, and central station passes through wireless wifi or the connection client of GPRS data.Monitoring device disclosed by the utility model promotes forecast efficiency, increases accuracy inside device after core principle component analysis filters out major influence factors using training output Landslide in the least square support vector machines model based on drosophila algorithm optimization.

title_en: Disaster-ridden kind of coupling grid cascading failure analysis method of power grid and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster-ridden kind of coupling grid cascading failure analysis method of power grid and systems, comprising: obtains power grid primary parameter and electric grid secondary parameter, establishes dynamic power grid system model；External environment data are obtained, dynamic power grid system model is inputted, are judged to obtain if there is external electrical network event of failure under initial grid operation mode since external environment causes the sequence of electric network element failure；Establish power grid mixing differential algebraic equations；Dynamic power grid system model is emulated according to the primary condition of power grid cascading fault simulation analysis and the power grid mixing differential algebraic equations of foundation；When emulation, according to admittance matrix Y bus Judge power grid whether off-the-line, if power grid not off-the-line, continues operation；Judge whether to terminate emulation；Form electric network consecutive failure accident chain；Output emulation data, overall merit power networks risk.The present invention can consider influence of the disaster-ridden kind of coupling cascading failure of relay protection acting characteristic to electric network element.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Come down centrifugal test model casing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to geological disaster centrifugal test fields, and in particular to a kind of landslide centrifugal test model casing.Its underpart tank top is disposed with vertical solenoid valve；The side wall of its underpart water tank is disposed with levels electromagnetic valve；Dismountable baffle is installed on the inner sidewall of upper part cabinet；Stainless steel waterpipe is installed at the top of upper part cabinet, rainfall spray head is installed, and stainless steel waterpipe is connect with water supply device on stainless steel waterpipe, the knob of the intensity of adjustable rainfall is provided on rainfall spray head.Compared with existing model casing, which can be realized the centrifugal test under various working, in mimic water-depth variation, opens horizontal, vertical solenoid valve, the lateral ends of levels electromagnetic valve are connected to water supply device by water pipe, are injected water into slow model casing；In simulated rainfall, precipitation is introduced into bottom lower part water tank by opening vertical solenoid valve, prevents the accumulation of rainwater to the influence of test result, so that experimental condition is more consistent with actual conditions.

title_en: Concrete heat strain detection testing device in a kind of high temperature of fire
abstract_en: The present invention relates to civil engineering material experimental test technical fields, and in particular to concrete heat strain detection testing device in a kind of high temperature of fire, including deformation test frame；The inside of deformation test frame is arranged in fire disaster simulation unit, is used for simulated fire high temperature, the inside of the fire disaster simulation unit is placed with test specimen；Thermal strain test cell, it is divided into the positioning region for limiting test specimen movement and the measurement portion for testing test specimen thermal deformation value, the positioning region and measurement portion are relatively fixed in the deformation test frame framework, and the left and right end portions of the test specimen are in contact with the positioning region and measurement portion respectively；And control unit, for receiving the thermal deformation signal of the thermal strain test cell transmitting and the temperature signal of fire disaster simulation unit transmitting, and realize the control to fire disaster simulation unit.The present invention can accurately test concrete heat in high temperature of fire and strain, and design is reasonable, structure is simple and environmentally-friendly efficiently.

title_en: Concrete heat stress test device in a kind of high temperature of fire
abstract_en: The present invention relates to civil engineering material experimental test technical fields, and in particular to concrete heat stress test device in a kind of high temperature of fire, including loading frame；The inside of the loading frame is arranged in fire disaster simulation unit, is used for simulated fire high temperature；Thermal stress test cell, include the first positioning region, the second positioning region and the measurement portion for testing test specimen heat stress value for compressing test specimen, the test specimen is placed between the first positioning region and the second positioning region, first positioning region is fixed in the loading frame framework, second positioning region is fixedly connected with measurement portion, and the measurement portion is fixed in the loading frame framework opposite with the first positioning region；And control unit, for receiving the thermal stress signal of the thermal stress test cell transmitting and the temperature signal of fire disaster simulation unit transmitting, and realize the control to fire disaster simulation unit.The present invention has rational design, structure is simple and environmentally-friendly efficiently, can accurately test concrete heat stress in high temperature of fire.

title_en: Remote Sensing Target detection method based on convolutional neural networks
abstract_en: The Remote Sensing Target detection method based on convolutional neural networks that the invention discloses a kind of mainly solves the problem of that the prior art cannot identify the remote sensing target of appearance ambiguity well and cannot obtain enough target semantic informations.Implementation step is: 1. acquisition remote sensing images construct data set, and data set is divided into training set and test set；2. constructing network model, which includes feature extraction sub-network, and RPN candidate frame generates network, and contextual information merges sub-network and multi-region feature merges sub-network；3. training set training pattern is used, until the number of iterations of training is equal to preset termination number；4. test image is input in trained model, the result of target detection is obtained.The present invention can strengthen the ability to express of feature, enrich the semantic information of target, make target with more identification, improve the precision of detection, can be used for resource exploration, disaster monitoring and the detection of the Remote Sensing Target of urban planning.

title_en: Urban waterlogging control system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to urban waterlogging control systems, belong to city guard against disaster technical field, including urban waterlogging control system, including control centre, monitoring modular, warning module, memory module, control module and user receiving end, monitoring modular, warning module, memory module, control module and user receiving end are electrically connected with control centre respectively, monitoring modular includes product flood point monitoring, flowing full Monitoring Pinpelines and node overflow monitoring, control module includes pumping plant and gate, lower well is provided at the top of pumping plant, suction pump is fixedly installed on the pumping plant dyke adjacent with river, aqueduct is mounted on the output end and input terminal of suction pump, warning module includes waterlogging analogue simulation system, waterlogging analogue simulation system includes WRF model and SWMM model, the present invention, which can be fully achieved, carries out automatically early warning to urban waterlogging , monitoring, implement hazard mitigation measure, significantly alleviation labour's pressure, while reduce personnel participation degree of danger.
assignees: NANJING XINDA INSTITUTE OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Performance test method and device for simulating unsaturated road base of airport under dynamic and static loads
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance test method and device for simulating an unsaturated road base of an airport under dynamic and static loads. Water is injected into the middle interlayer of the road foundation soil body for many times from the water injection holes on the side wall of the model box to change the water content, load is applied to the road foundation soil body through load applying equipment of the loading device aiming at different water contents, and road foundation performance change under different water contents and load applying conditions is monitored. The nondestructive detection method is equivalent to the method based on airport runway surface engineering, and the deformation and damage mechanism of the runway foundation soil body under the action of different airplane loads is repeatedly simulated and tested through a testing device and a monitoring device, so that the potential disasters of the runway foundation can be timely found, the runway surface damage caused by the disasters of the runway foundation is reduced, the navigability of the airplane is ensured, and a technical basis with strong reference significance is provided for similar airport engineering.

title_en: A kind of fire disaster simulation device for testing fire water monitor
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of fire disaster simulation device for testing fire water monitor, it includes main unit and remote control unit；The main unit includes rack, load-bearing water tank, fuel storage tank, tray for combustion and control system, the load-bearing water tank is installed on rack lower end, the fuel storage tank is installed on frame upper end and connects through the tray for combustion of pipeline and frame top, the lower section that the frame top is located at tray for combustion is equipped with ignition, and the bottom of the rack is equipped with several universal wheels；The control system and remote control unit are wirelessly connected；The structure that it is combined using setting load-bearing water tank with remote control is to overcome prior art device to be easy to happen the defect tumbled, it is avoided that equipment is damaged or contingency, and safety coefficient is high, mobility is good, overall structure is scientific and reasonable, simple and compact, easy to install and use；It is widely used in simulated fire operation and matches.
assignees: HUNAN MENGYUANNING FIRE FIGHTING IND CO LTD

title_en: A kind of multi-source data standardization processing method of integration engineering Geological Achievements
abstract_en: A kind of multi-source data standardization processing method of integration engineering Geological Achievements, comprising: formulate the standard table of strata mutually compatible with surrounding cities STRATIGRAPHIC DIVISION standard；Geographical correction is carried out to exploratory spot distribution map using high-precision orthophotoquad, under the premise of not depending on field operation mapping, the accurate coordinate that is quickly drilled；By way of reporting for each geotechnical engineering investigation and formulating the stratum table of comparisons, automatic, batch stratum standardization is realized；Orthophotoquad, digital elevation model, earth's surface threedimensional model, underground utilities model, underground building object model are combined with engineering geology achievement, really realize the effect of ground, subsurface three-dimensional integrated management.It is verified by project, the present invention fast, STRATIGRAPHIC DIVISION standard strong applicability, integrated data type congruence advantage with data collection arrangement speed, the management level for effectively increasing engineering geology achievement is all of great significance to fields such as urban planning, comparison and choice, disaster preventions.
assignees: JIANGSU PROVINCE SURVEYING & MAPPING ENGINEERING INST

title_en: Early warning method for damage of power transmission line under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for early warning damage of a power transmission line under typhoon disasters. The method comprises the steps of collecting meteorological information, equipment operation information, micro-terrain information and real-time damage information to construct a training set; information quantization, default value processing and standardization processing are carried out on the information in the training set; establishing a power transmission line damage probability hybrid prediction model based on extreme value I type probability distribution, a random forest method and a Monte Carlo method, and calculating damage probability; and calculating risk indexes according to the damage probability, and performing emergency repair after the disaster. The prediction model has stronger adaptability and higher reliability, and can reasonably estimate the needed emergency repair resources from the macroscopic view.

title_en: Mud-rock flow simulation test device and test method for assembled trench
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow simulation test device and a debris flow simulation test method for an assembled trench. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the assembled channel is formed by connecting a plurality of through channels with triangular steps arranged at the inner bottoms and curved channels and is arranged on the liftable support. The high-speed miniature camera embedded in the straight channel, the novel optical fiber sensor embedded in the curved channel and the impact force testing system are connected with the testing processing system through data wires; the invention can be applied to the simulation of debris flows with different ditch shapes, different lengths, different friction degrees and different gradients, the ditch can be repeatedly assembled and utilized, has strong adaptability, realizes the automatic data acquisition and processing of the whole processes of movement, impact and accumulation of the debris flows, has strong time monitoring and anti-interference capability, and provides scientific basis for disaster prevention of the debris flows.

title_en: A kind of pilot system for simulating field waterlogged disaster
abstract_en: The utility model proposes a kind of pilot systems for simulating field waterlogged disaster, tank, control device and the multiple spray heads of the pilot system are sequentially connected, the area Kuang Zai periphery nail has multiple stanchions, puggaree is supported by above multiple stanchions, multiple spray heads are fixed on puggaree, the area Kuang Zai includes color steel plate and plastic lining film, and color steel plate surrounds the area Kuang Zai, and plastic lining film is covered in color steel plate inner wall.The damage or crop failure caused by waterlogging analogy method for solving the prior art mostly uses pot-culture method, it is detached from the practical problem of production, a kind of test facilities system for simulating field waterlogged disaster is provided, by artificially-simulated rainfall amount, duty is counted and crop is made to generate waterlogged disaster, it is practical closer to production, convenient for control, the Decay Law of fertility feature, finds the problem in time when more really reaction crop is by natural calamity, it solves the problems, such as, more representative and convincingness.
assignees: INST SOIL FERTILIZER & ENVIRONMENT RESOURCES HAAS

title_en: Virtual-real combined indoor and outdoor evacuation simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual-real combined indoor and outdoor evacuation simulation method, which specifically comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of S1, positioning through a built-in sensor of a mobile phone according to an evacuation research object area S2, using a GPS and an inertial navigation sensor to assist positioning outdoors, and associating a virtual simulation space and an actual space through the position after the position is obtained S3. The method overcomes the defect of unreal results caused by only using virtual evacuation simulation, solves the difficulty of disaster influence reappearing in a real scene, enhances the experience of reality participation of evacuation personnel through virtual-real fusion, and simultaneously enables the evacuation simulation results to have the high-efficiency characteristic of using massive simulators and the data reliability of using real personnel.

title_en: A kind of simulation experiment method of directional drilling grouting serous fluid diffusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of simulation experiment methods of directional drilling grouting serous fluid diffusion, belong to the technical field of mine water disaster grouting treatment.Its used pilot system includes slip casting experimental bench, branched hole crack simulation system, control system, grouting system and real-time monitoring system, pass through the magnetic-adsorption branched hole crack mold on experimental bench ontology, the transformation that can make experimental bench ontology realization multi-angle by rotary shaft rotation, to realize the simulation of branched hole difference crack type.The present invention can in prefabricated directional drilling different branched holes lay and pitch-row under rock cranny, the slurries Diffusion Law in directional drilling under different angle branched hole can be achieved, different cracks type, roughness, fracture opening under analog branched hole, the research of slurries Diffusion Law under grouting pressure, concentration of slurry, the effect of visualization of slurries diffusion path and range in branch hole can be achieved, extend influence factor for intuitive research directional drilling grouting serous fluid and rule provides safeguard.

title_en: A fireman escape device for forest puts out a fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a firefighter escape device for forest fire extinguishment, which relates to the field of fire-fighting escape and comprises a main supporting plate frame, a telescopic supporting framework and a protective cloth cover, wherein the telescopic supporting framework is arranged on the left side surface of the main supporting plate frame and comprises a supporting framework and a telescopic connecting rod group, the telescopic connecting rod group consists of a connecting rod hinging seat and a connecting rod support, and the protective cloth cover is wrapped outside a plurality of supporting frameworks. According to the invention, the main support plate frame is provided with the telescopic support framework, the protective cloth cover wraps the telescopic support framework, and escape personnel can drill into the protective cloth cover to prevent the escape personnel from being burnt by flame; the multifunctional backpack is pulled by the handle, two rollers at the lower end of the main support plate frame roll with the road surface, the carrying and moving are convenient, the shoulder buckles are used for buckling and then are carried on the shoulders of a carrying person, and the waist belt is tied to the waist of the carrying person, so that the condition that the multifunctional backpack is inconvenient to carry due to forest mountain roads is avoided.

title_en: Double-long-narrow space fire experiment platform for small-size subway tunnel/train carriage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-long and narrow space fire experiment platform for a contracted size subway tunnel/train carriage, which comprises a tunnel unit, a train unit, a track unit, a fire source simulation unit, a longitudinal ventilation unit and a fire parameter measurement unit. Wherein: the tunnel unit adopts an arc-shaped ceiling structure and is located on the ground; the train unit is placed in the tunnel unit, and the movement of the train unit is controlled by the track unit on the ground; the fire source simulation unit is arranged in the train unit and is used for generating fire plumes required by experiments; the longitudinal ventilation unit is arranged at one end of the tunnel unit and is used for providing longitudinal ventilation; the fire parameter measurement unit is used for collecting various parameters in the experiment. The invention overcomes the defects of high cost and inaccurate numerical simulation of full-scale experiments, can develop a series of basic theory researches such as fire plume entrainment characteristics, smoke transportation behaviors and the like when train fires occur in subway tunnels, and has practical guiding significance for fire detection, smoke control and personnel evacuation in the fire scene.

title_en: Drilling well emergency drilling simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of drilling well emergency drilling simulation systems, including three-dimensional emergency management and rescue training and evaluation module, multimedia resource management module and flexible emergency preplan editor module；The three-dimensional emergency management and rescue training and evaluation module include server end module, teaching module and client modules；The multimedia resource management module includes document scene management module and three-dimensional scenic editor module；The flexibility emergency preplan editor module includes prediction scheme memory module, prediction scheme conversion module, prediction scheme step model respective modules and prediction scheme modified module.The present invention realizes the study to contents such as equipment essential information, structure composition, working principle, standard operation and accident analyses by the three-dimensional animation video training courseware of lively image.Student can interact with three-dimensional scenic, realize the disposition of simulated accident site technique, emergency resources deployment scheduling and emergency evacuation route commander, more intuitively simulate the emergency treatment taken when emergent accident occurs.
assignees: CHENGDU ESIMTECH PETROLEUM EQUIPMENT SIMULATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating macro resilience of offshore oil well control equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method and system for evaluating the macro resilience of offshore oil well control equipment. The method for evaluating the macro resilience of offshore oil well control equipment comprises six steps: determining the type and strength of external disaster; calculating the failure rate of components; calculating the recovery rate of the components; modeling the BN for a degradation process; modeling the BN for a maintenance process; and calculating the resilience of the offshore oil well control equipment.
