A system for evaluating the macro resilience of offshore oil well control equipment comprises an external disaster evaluation module, a component failure rate calculation subsystem, a reliability degradation process simulation module, a fault identification module, a component recovery rate calculation module, a reliability recovery process simulation module, a reliability change curve derivation unit and an resilience calculation unit.

title_en: A kind of analogy method of reservoir rock hole crack three-dimensional visualization and gas flowing
abstract_en: The invention discloses the analogy methods that a kind of reservoir rock hole crack three-dimensional visualization and gas flow, including obtaining rock sample model data by carrying out three-D CT scanning to rock sample under force-free state, pass through the 3D printing of processing and 3D printing technique progress rock sample model to scan data；The Physical Experiment of mechanics seepage flow and real-time CT scan under stress are carried out to rock sample and rock sample model respectively, and carry out Numerical Simulation of Seepage on the basis of establishing 3D digital-to-analogue；After the result of comprehensive mechanics seepage flow Physical Experiment and real-time CT scan gas flow numerical simulation as a result, analyze its difference, and push away gas flow equation most suitably used in numerical simulation software by the way that mechanics seepage flow Physical Experiment result is counter.The invention has the advantages that applied widely；With visualization and actualization, it is preferred not only reservoir can to have been carried out in the exploration phase, but also can instruct the formulation of arrangement and method for construction, and can also reduce disaster occurrence probability, promote security development, provide basic data to seek high efficiency method.

title_en: What a kind of grid equipment was efficiently ablated ice necessity sentences knowledge method and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to electrical engineering technical fields, disclose a kind of grid equipment ice-melt necessity sentences knowledge method and system, effectively to excavate ice trouble related data, targetedly calculate ice trouble threat and melted ice necessity, operational efficiency of power grid under the conditions of icing is promoted；The method comprise the steps that choosing the history icing disaster related data in region to be analyzed, is pre-processed history icing disaster related data to obtain initial data set, initial data set is divided into training dataset and validation data set；Binary tree computation model is established, and whether verify binary tree computation model effective；Obtain grid equipment to be analyzed in the following setting time icing disaster related data input binary tree computation model, if the output valve of binary tree computation model belongs to first threshold range, sentence know the grid equipment there is no deicing necessity；If the output valve of binary tree computation model belongs to second threshold range, sentence know the grid equipment have deicing necessity.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: For simulating the experimental provision of subgrade frost heaving disaster
abstract_en: The invention proposes a kind of for simulating the experimental provision of subgrade frost heaving disaster, the experimental provision include concrete substrate, denitrogen device, steel mesh bed course, geotextiles bed course, for nitrogen device, multiple electrically-controlled valves, water supply device, multiple water content sensors, multiple temperature sensors, water content data acquisition device, temperature data acquisition device, bracket and infrared video acquisition device；The method have the benefit that: it proposes a kind of for simulating the experimental provision of subgrade frost heaving disaster, the experimental provision can simulate the physics evolution process of road frost boiling disaster, and corresponding experimental data is got, science decision reference is provided for hazard management.

title_en: For simulating the experimental rig of cavern's negative pressure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of for simulating the experimental rig of cavern's negative pressure, and innovation is: the experimental rig includes organic glass guide channel, rainfall simulator, lifting support, water injection pipe, steel mesh, geotextiles and pressure vacuum ga(u)ge；The method have the benefit that: it proposes a kind of for simulating the experimental rig of cavern's negative pressure, the experimental rig can simulate cavern's negative pressure variation situation under rainfall and underground water drop conditions, enable us to obtain the precise quantification numerical value of cavern's negative pressure, improves the precision of surface collapse Disaster Mechanics analysis.

title_en: A kind of multidimensional fire-fighting data fusion analysis method neural network based
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multidimensional fire-fighting data fusion analysis methods neural network based, include the following steps: step 1, establish with the state parameter of live cigarette sense, the temperature parameter at scene, the temperature warning threshold parameter at scene and the vital signs parameter at scene as input, it take occurrence index as the neural network model of output, and the neural network model of foundation is trained, according to the implicit layer number of training result and the error transfer factor neural network model of actual alarm result, until accuracy rate is not less than desired value；Step 2, with trained neural network model, the condition of a disaster analysis is carried out to the state parameter of the live cigarette sense obtained in real time, the temperature parameter at scene, the temperature warning threshold parameter at scene and the vital signs parameter at scene.Compared with prior art, the present invention obtains the operating condition of field device in time, carries out data analysis convenient for platform.Field condition is judged in time by the video information that infrared photography provides, and can be remotely operated fire extinguisher and be put out a fire.
assignees: NANJING KEGU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rock burst coal seam drilling-cutting-pressing-pumping-injecting multi-disaster cooperative prevention and control method
abstract_en: A coal seam of rock burst 'bore-cut-press-take out-pour' calamity of multiple disaster cooperate prevent and control method, construct several along coal seam bore hole in the coal road sequentially, after the bore hole of the course is constructed to the design position and cut and construct several hydraulic guide slots in the course of withdrawing the bore hole with the high-pressure water jet, then carry on the hole sealing to the bore hole of the course, inject the high-pressure water into the bore hole of the course and carry on the directional hydraulic fracturing; after hydraulic fracturing is finished, connecting the gas extraction system to perform gas extraction according to a conventional method; and when the bedding drill hole is a certain distance away from the working face, removing the extraction pipeline and connecting the extraction pipeline to a coal seam water injection pipe for coal seam water injection, and adding a stopping agent with a certain concentration for coal mine fire prevention into the injected water. The method overcomes the time and space repeatability and the inconsistency of construction departments in the existing rock burst coal seam multiple disaster prevention measures, and realizes the cooperative integrated prevention and control of rock burst, gas, coal dust and coal seam spontaneous combustion of the rock burst coal seam.

title_en: Method for preventing and treating rock burst of roadway by hydraulic roof cutting and roadway retaining
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preventing and treating rock burst of a roadway by hydraulic roof cutting and roadway retaining, which mainly comprises the following steps: tunneling a roadway to circle out a working face mining area, constructing vertical drilling holes in the roadway, putting and adjusting the orientation of a jet device, orienting hydraulic cutting, using the roadway with the cut seam and the cut top as a return airway of the next working face and the like. The method for preventing and controlling the rock burst of the roadway by hydraulic roof cutting and roadway retaining provided by the invention not only can reduce the workload of roadway tunneling and maintenance and reduce the loss of coal resources, but also has important significance for controlling the appearance of the rock burst of an empty roadway, especially the disaster of the rock burst.

title_en: ice plug ice dam and ice water body dielectric constant emergency calibration device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency calibrating device and method for dielectric constants of an ice-filled ice dam and an ice water body, which comprises the following steps: the device comprises an upstream water tank and a downstream water return pool, wherein a nonmetallic water tank is connected between the upstream water tank and the downstream water return pool, and an ice adding device, at least two measuring platforms for placing radars and a water-permeable ice blocking plate are sequentially arranged in the water tank; the measuring platform comprises: the radar platform that just can reciprocate parallel with the water face is equipped with the gauze that the level can go up and down under the radar platform. The method establishes rapid physical simulation of a flow simulation experiment in a laboratory on hydrodynamic conditions of a river reach of the ice-plugged ice dam, riverbed boundary conditions, upstream ice coming and other conditions, provides corresponding basic data such as dielectric constants of the ice-plugged ice dam and an ice water body within two hours, and is used for calculating the thickness of the ice-plugged ice dam after field measurement by an unmanned aerial vehicle, so as to rapidly make a decision for processing the ice-plugged ice dam and reduce disaster loss caused by the ice-plugged ice dam as much as possible.

title_en: A kind of this coal bed gas extraction of underground coal mine drilling integrated apparatus
abstract_en: A kind of this coal bed gas extraction of underground coal mine drilling integrated apparatus, including gas drainage main line, gas connecting tube, drainage connecting pipe and multiple book jacket drainage devices, the lower end of gas source valve is connect with gas connecting tube, and multiple drainage connecting pipe mouths are respectively arranged on the tube wall of drainage connecting pipe upper end.Book jacket drainage device is respectively arranged with multiple gas recirculation holes on guard aperture screen casing wall, sealing cloth bag in front and back is sleeved on hole sealing tube by setting distance respectively, pressure safety valve is installed in grouting pipe between front and back sealing cloth bag, drainage tube threeway is sleeved on hole sealing tube rear end, the lower port of drainage tube threeway is connect with multiple drainage connecting pipe mouths respectively, and extraction valve upper port has gas production to connect nozzle connection with multiple respectively.The utility model structure is simple, novel design, greatly reduces labor intensity, effective to prevent mine gas disaster, improves work efficiency.
assignees: SHANXI MABAO COAL IND CO LTD;SHANXI COAL TRANSP AND MARKETING GROUP CHANGZHI CO LTD;SHANXI GAOHE ENERGY CO LTD;CCTEG SHENYANG RES INST

title_en: Number of Person Prediction System of Building using GIS Information and Method thereof
title_ko: Gis 정보를 활용한 건물의 수용 인원 예측 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to a system for predicting the number of persons to be admitted of a building using GIS information and a method thereof, the number of persons to be admitted is calculated by inputting GIS information such as the use, the height and the surface area of a building so the number of persons in the building can be predicted in advance. By providing an evacuation simulation image of persons in the building, if a disaster such as earthquake or fire occurs, time for firefighting can be planned more effectively and the persons in the building can be rapidly evacuated to the outside.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 GIS 정보를 활용한 건물의 수용 인원 예측 시스템 및 방법에 따르면, 건물의 용도, 높이, 면적 등의 GIS 정보를 수용 인원 계산 모듈에 입력하여 수용 인원을 산출함으로써, 건물 내부의 사람 수를 미리 예측할 수 있고, 이에 따른 건물 내부 사람들의 피난 시뮬레이션 영상을 제공하여, 지진, 화재 등의 재난이 발생하면 보다 효율적으로 소방 활동을 위한 시간을 계획할 수 있고, 건물 내부 사람들이 신속하게 외부로 피난할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fire protection system simulator
title_ko: 소방시설 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: A fire protection facility simulator is provided. The fire protection facility simulator according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a facility display unit installed with a plurality of detection sensors for detecting the fire, a plurality of alarm units for visually and audibly alerting in the event of a fire, a plurality of guide lamps, and a fire alarm controller with a self-diagnosis function to control the alarm unit in case of fire; a plurality of connectors installed at both sides of the fire alarm controller in the facility display unit and connected to wire terminals embedded in the fire alarm controller, and separately installed to be connected to the detection unit the alarm unit, and the guide lamp; a terminal identification unit installed at one side of the plurality of connectors in the facility display unit to display a connection target; a connection socket and a connection terminal provided at one end of a lead wire of any one of the detection unit, the alarm unit, and the guide lamp; an educational connection wire for connecting or disconnecting the plurality of connectors and connection sockets and connection terminals; and a facility model associated with the guide lamp and the alarm unit and installed in the facility display unit.
abstract_ko: 소방시설 시뮬레이터가 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 소방시설 시뮬레이터는 화재 여부를 감지하는 복수의 감지센서, 화재 발생시 시각 및 청각적으로 경보하는 복수의 경보부, 복수의 유도등, 화재 발생시 경보부를 작동하도록 제어하며 자체 진단 기능을 갖는 화재경보 제어기가 설치된 시설표시부; 시설표시부에서 화재경보 제어기의 양측에 설치되어 화재경보 제어기에 내장된 배선단자와 연결되며, 감지부, 경보부 및 유도등에 연결되도록 구분되게 설치되는 복수의 커넥터; 시설표시부에서 복수의 커넥터의 일측에 설치되어 연결대상을 표시하는 단자식별부; 감지부, 경보부 및 유도등 중 어느 하나의 인출선의 일단에 구비되는 접속용 소켓 및 접속단자; 복수의 커넥터와 접속용 소켓 및 접속단자를 연결 또는 해체하기 위한 교육용 연결배선; 및 유도등 및 경보부와 관련되며 시설표시부에 설치되는 시설 모형;을 포함한다.
assignees: NEW STAR EDUCATION CO LTD;HUR WAN GYU;HUR YONG HO;HUR BO YUN;JUNG DO WON

title_en: Head lines visualizer and the observation methods such as diving
abstract_en: The present invention relates to head lines visualizer and a kind of methods implemented using the head lines visualizer such as the diving such as a kind of diving.The present invention establishes the head lines observation experiment systems such as diving in laboratory, using the loose pore media of nature as simulated object, the formation of simulated diving, benefit, diameter, the row feature and hydrodynamic condition etc. of diving, pass through the contour of water table of experimental observation diving during the motion, the distributional pattern of phreatic surface is determined, quickly to grasp the kinematicchain element of each point in seepage flow space.The present invention is distributed for the flow of water on the way, the observation such as size, flow, seepage velocity of the arbitrary point flow of water and measurement provide a set of completely new technological means on seepage flow section.Also in the investigation of region hydrogeology condition, level of ground water resource assessment, engineering construction Groundwater Disasters and negative environment effects problem provide important basic information, have good economical and practical value and application prospect.

title_en: A kind of experimental provision for simulating Karst region karst collapse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of experimental provisions for simulating Karst region karst collapse.Including model casing, the bottom of model casing is simulation solution cavity, is equipped with bottom plate above simulation solution cavity, thin plate is movably equipped in bottom plate, thin plate is equipped with panel hole, and bottom plate is equipped with simulation rock stratum, it simulates and is equipped with karst cave gap in rock stratum, simulate and be equipped with coating in rock stratum top and karst cave gap；The top of the model casing is equipped with earth's surface aquaporin, is equipped with hole in earth's surface aquaporin；The earth's surface aquaporin connects water feed apparatus with simulation solution cavity.The present invention can simulate the growth course of karst collapse under surface water, underground water independent role and its synergy, convenient for observation, the research suitable for geological disaster.

title_en: Smoke diffusion path model device for simulating building indoor fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smoke diffusion path model device for simulating indoor fire of a building, which comprises: the system comprises a smoking device, a house model, a power supply device and a remote control device; the smoke generating device is arranged inside or outside the house model and used for generating and conveying smoke to a designated position of the house model; the house model is used for providing an environment for flue gas diffusion, and comprises: the traction device is used for drawing the elements in the house model to move in multiple directions through the connecting piece so as to change the diffusion path of the smoke; the power supply device is used for supplying electric energy to a motor of the traction device through a power supply line; and the remote control device is used for transmitting a control signal and controlling the motor of the traction device to drive the components of the house model to move in multiple directions so as to enable the smoke to generate different diffusion paths. The device can accurately and visually simulate the diffusion condition of smoke in the building when a fire disaster occurs in the building, and can display the effects of facilities such as a fireproof door and a smoke-proof baffle.

title_en: The change of current becomes the intensity inverting assessment of fire fire source and temperature field prediction method and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of changes of current to become the intensity inverting assessment of fire fire source and temperature field prediction method and system, including following content: 1) establishing the change of current and become fire disaster simulation forward direction computation model；Complete the initialization of data assimilation state vector；2) it carries out the change of current and becomes the calculating of fire disaster simulation forward direction, obtain the data such as fire spread temperature field and export；3) thermocouple and heat-flow meter monitoring data are judged whether there is, if then using the calculated result of step 2 as predicted value by exporting result after data assimilation algorithm and being transferred to step 4；If being otherwise directly transferred to step 4；4) judge whether end simulation process, if then end simulation；If the result for otherwise obtaining step 3, which returns to the change of current, becomes fire disaster simulation forward direction computation model, it is transferred to step 2.The present invention accurately can quickly realize the inverting assessment of exchange rheology fire fire source intensity, and can predict the Temperature Distribution that the change of current becomes during fire spread, become the emergency response of fire for the change of current and decision provides foundation.

title_en: Debris flow channel siltation depth calculation method based on drilling data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow channel siltation depth calculation method based on drilling data, which comprises the following steps of: s1: by analyzing regional geology, earthquake and well drilling data, a basin of geological conditions is screened as an actual geological model, and influence factors for controlling the sedimentation depth of a debris flow channel in the actual geological model are quantized and represented; s2: based on statistical sample data, establishing a quantitative relation between the sedimentation depth of the debris flow channel and the width and the longitudinal slope drop of the debris flow channel, and analyzing the correlation; s3: screening abnormal points before the established calculation model, screening special samples such as a drift debris flow channel at a drilling position, a ditch mouth accumulation area, channel width mutation and the like, and finishing the screening of the sample data; the method solves the problem that the control precision of the debris flow geological disaster and the initiative of dealing with the disaster cannot be improved by the traditional method.

title_en: A kind of coal mine roadway surrouding rock deformation rupture discrimination method based on association rule mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of, and the coal mine roadway surrouding rock deformation based on association rule mining ruptures discrimination method.Firstly, excavating the attribute data of wall rock's level using the genetic neural network planning algorithm of information gain, correlation rule is extracted, constructs rule base；Then, the matching degree between data and rule is calculated based on average fitness formula, training data is mapped to average fitness space；Finally, constructing the surrouding rock deformation Safety check-up model based on distance in average fitness space, the identification ruptured to coal mine roadway surrouding rock deformation is realized.The present invention can excavate the mechanistic information implied in a large amount of wall rock's level data, or the prevention and treatment of the disaster accidents such as fall of ground, bump provides reference frame.

title_en: Experimental rig of the component under long duration load-corrosion-lateral impact load coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of experimental rig of component under long duration load-corrosion-lateral impact load coupling.Described device includes test specimen, and long duration load loading device corrodes case, lateral impact load loading device；Actual loading situation of the real simulation steel core concrete column under disaster-ridden harmful operating condition is simulated by described device.Long duration load and corrosiveness first are applied to test specimen, long duration load is applied to test specimen by the prestressing force that jack tension fining twisted steel generates, test specimen is corroded by corroding case, after to the predetermined time, long duration load loading device and corrosion case are integrally placed under lateral impact load loading device, long duration load loading method is changed into hydraulic oil pump to load with disk spring, then carries out impact test.Test specimen is that dismoutability is connect, it can be achieved that being recycled, saving time and materials with long duration load loading device, corrosion case, lateral impact load loading device.

title_en: Fully mechanized goaf grouting method based on cluster multilateral well directional drilling
abstract_en: A fully mechanized goaf grouting method based on cluster multilateral well directional drilling is applied to fully mechanized goafs with a burial depth of more than 400m, and comprises the following steps: step 1, drilling hole layout, wherein the layout position and the number of cluster type multi-branch directional drilling holes are designed in a treatment area of a fully mechanized goaf; step 2, determining a grouting material, wherein the grouting material consists of cement and fly ash or clay and an accelerating agent; step 3, drilling and grouting a plurality of cluster type multi-branch directional drilling holes; therefore, the invention creatively and flexibly applies the cluster multi-branch directional drilling to the field of geological disaster prevention and control of the fully mechanized goaf, greatly reduces the drilling engineering amount, reduces the consumption, effectively reduces the drilling cost, simultaneously utilizes the advantage of controllable drilling track, enlarges the coverage range and the precision of drilling grouting, avoids repeated drilling work, obviously improves the engineering efficiency and achieves the aim of better goaf treatment.

title_en: Test device, system and method for simulating high-temperature and impact coupling disasters of component
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of test equipment, and particularly relates to a test device for simulating a high-temperature and impact coupling disaster of a component. The device comprises a test furnace, wherein the test furnace can be split along the central line and is connected by a buckle, the left side and the right side of the test furnace are respectively provided with a telescopic lengthened test chamber, the two ends of the test furnace are respectively provided with a test piece filling port, an observation window and a temperature indicator are arranged right in front of the test furnace, the top of the test furnace is provided with an impact loading port, and heating elements are uniformly distributed in the test furnace; the dual-purpose damping support is arranged at the bottom of the test furnace; the drop hammer protection frame is arranged below the impact loading port, can be spliced from two sides and is convenient to disassemble and replace; and the temperature controller is connected with the heating element in the test furnace.

title_en: It is a kind of simulation component by long-term xial feed and impact coupling disaster experimental rig, system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to test equipment technical fields, and in particular to it is a kind of simulation component by long-term xial feed and impact coupling disaster experimental rig, system and method.The present invention includes impact test apparatus, axle power load testing machine and long-term xial feed loading device.Impact test apparatus includes drop hammer tester, test specimen support, test specimen, reaction frame, rigid plate, rigid board support, plain nut and ground bolt screw rod.Wherein drop hammer tester is mainly made of peripheral steelframe, electric hoist loop wheel machine, detacher, hammer body, tup, protective frame of dropping hammer.Axle power loading device includes axial force sensor, groups of springs, hydraulic jack and spring fastening composition.Actual conditions of the component under long-term axle power and impact force coupling can be simulated by the experimental provision.First apply long-term horizontal axis load, holds after lotus reaches certain predetermined time, directly long-term loading device is mounted on impact test apparatus, carries out the test under the coupling under long-term xial feed and impact load.

title_en: Method for extracting gas and preventing and extinguishing fire by using bedding directional drilling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting gas and preventing and extinguishing fire by using bedding directional drilling, belonging to a composite disaster prevention and control method for a coal mine. Drilling a drilling field in an air inlet roadway and an air return roadway of a stope face, then respectively constructing bedding directional drilling holes in coal seams outside the air inlet roadway and the air return roadway in the drilling field, enabling the bedding directional drilling holes to penetrate through coal walls outside the air inlet roadway and the air return roadway, and then performing gas extraction and fire prevention and extinguishing work in a goaf according to the following stages: in the first stage, the bedding directional drilling holes in a drilling field are sequentially utilized in the mining process of a stope face, and gas in a goaf is extracted in a negative pressure mode, so that the gas concentration is prevented from exceeding the limit in the mining process; and in the second stage, injecting fire-extinguishing materials into the goaf by sequentially utilizing the bedding directional drilling to prevent the spontaneous combustion of residual coal in the goaf. The method can realize the purposes of gas extraction and fire prevention and extinguishment by utilizing the bedding directional drilling in the process of exploiting the high-gas easily spontaneous combustion coal bed, is simple and convenient to operate, has high gas extraction rate and good fire prevention and extinguishment effect, and saves the engineering cost.

title_en: System and application method based on meteorological observation, road camera shooting visibility identification
abstract_en: System based on meteorological observation, road camera shooting visibility identification estimates inspection module, interface service module including user interactive module, freeway surveillance and control image data acquiring module, the location information extraction module of highway camera, camera and weather station observation data association module, visibility observation data acquisition module, freeway surveillance and control image and visibility big data analysis module, the visibility recognition training module based on depth convolutional Neural grid, real time job scheduler module, visibility.The present invention is using highway camera shooting data as object, pass through machine learning and artificial intelligence technology, through related software collective effect, road visibility information is automatically extracted from high speed monitoring image, it is able to achieve sudden mist of playing a game and realizes effectively monitoring, monitoring information is provided for road foggy weather passage, increases the utility value of monitoring camera, provides advantageous Information Assurance to reduce the traffic weather disaster that dense fog induces.
assignees: SHANDONG BAISHITONG BIG DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of car networking network security emergency response system and method based on cbr
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the network system security technology areas of car networking, disclose a kind of car networking network security emergency response system and method based on cbr, carry out the representation of knowledge to security incident by SOEKS, and simulate and establish case library；Case is retrieved by introducing structural similarity and attributes similarity by nearest _neighbor retrieval method；Pass through the modification and the complete car networking network security response of study completion to case.Present invention reduces losses brought by car networking network security accident, and timely automated be turned into more acurrate, efficient emergency response measure through the invention.And car networking network data representation is enabled to have unified formalization standard through the invention；It can be directed to similar case, find out emergency response solution, and be used.

title_en: A kind of more scene fire disaster simulation escape drilling systems
abstract_en: A kind of more scene fire disaster simulation escape drilling systems, including splicing plate, doorframe, fire disaster simulation device, warning device, controller and simulator of creeping；Several splicing plates are spliced into movable wall body side by side, and several movable wall bodies surround enclosure space, one end inlet porting of enclosure space, other end setting outlet；Several splicing plates are spliced into partition wall side by side, and enclosure space in the enclosed space, is divided into several rooms by several partition wall settings；It is provided with doorframe on partition wall, makes to interconnect between each room；Fire disaster simulation device, warning device and simulator of creeping are provided in each room；Controller is provided with outside enclosure space.The case where diversified escape route guarantees that rehearsal personnel will not encounter same rehearsal environment, later rehearsal person's manoeuvre is avoided to be the easy game gone through the motions appearance.

title_en: Fire explosion poison disaster environment simulation experiment system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to calamity environmental simulation system field, concretely relates to fire explodes poison calamity environmental simulation experiment system, this simulation experiment system sets up the pipeline of conflagration high temperature generating device and toxic gas/granule environmental generating device department as the experimental section of simulation experiment system including setting up at the explosion shock wave generating device of pipeline one end, setting at the conflagration high temperature generating device and the toxic gas/granule environmental generating device at pipeline middle part. The utility model has the advantages that: the utility model provides a calamity experimental environment of complex nature, the utility model discloses an explosion shock wave generating device, conflagration high temperature emitter, toxic gas/granule environment generating device on the pipeline to simulation shock wave, toxic substance, the compound calamity environment of high temperature for human damage mechanism and individual protection technical demand under the compound calamity environment of research fire explosion poison choose for use suitable emergent equipment for dangerization article practitioner and provide the guidance, finally reach the purpose of protection people life safety.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV;UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: A kind of submarine damage chain disaster simulation method of pipe VR training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of submarines to damage the chain disaster simulation method of pipe VR training system, comprising the following steps: S1 establishes submarine damage pipe event base, and standard corresponding with event each in event base disposes library；S2 establishes event evolution engine, realizes the disposition action situation according to the person of participating in training, develop event new out；S3 is established and new damage can be randomly generated according to submarine system function and spot run affairs the chance event pond of part；The practical disposition of S4 training mode according to selected by user terminal and participant acts, and complete chain disaster simulation is unfolded.Method of the present invention can realize the submarine damage pipe live simulation training of non-default script, greatly strengthen the practicability of submarine damage pipe VR training system, promote the practical effect that damage reformation training is practiced conscientiously.
assignees: QINGDAO HAIKE VIRTUAL REALITY RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Method of providing vehicle refuge information in disaster situation and apparatus therefor
title_ko: 재난 상황에서의 차량 대피정보 제공 방법 및 이를 위한 장치
abstract_en: A method of providing disaster refuge information for an autonomous vehicle and an intelligent device controlling a server. A processor of the vehicle may enable location information of the vehicle to be transmitted to a first server and enable refuge information to be received from the first server. The refuge information may be generated by the first server based on first disaster-related information related to a special weather report, second disaster-related information including shelter-related information, and the location information. The refuge information may include at least one of shelter guidance information, vehicle control information or route resetting information. One or more of the autonomous vehicle, user terminal and server may be associated with an artificial intelligence module, a drone (unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)), a robot, an augmented reality (AR) device, a virtual reality (VR) device, or a device related to 5G service.
abstract_ko: 자율주행 차량을 위한 재난 대피정보 제공방법 및 서버를 제어하는 지능형 디바이스를 개시한다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 자율주행 차량을 위한 재난 대피정보 제공방법은, 차량의 프로세서는, 차량 내부의 무선 통신부를 통해 제 1 서버로 상기 차량의 위치정보를 전송하도록 하고, 상기 제1 서버로부터 대피정보를 수신하도록 할 수 있다. 상기 대피정보는 기상특보와 관련된 제1 재난 관련 정보, 대피소 관련 정보를 포함하는 제2 재난 관련 정보 및 상기 위치 정보에 기초하여, 상기 제1 서버에서 생성될 수 있다. 상기 대피정보는 대피소 안내정보, 차량 제어 정보 또는 경로 재설정 정보 중 적어도 하나를 포함할 수 있다. 이에 따라, 재난 상황에서, 차량 탑승객의 별도의 검색/탐색 절차 없이도 차량 탑승객에게 대피 방법을 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 본 발명의 자율 주행 차량, 사용자 단말기 및 서버 중 하나 이상이 인공 지능(Artificail Intelligenfce) 모듈, 드론(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle, UAV), 로봇, 증강 현실(Augmented Reality, AR) 장치, 가상 현실(virtual reality, VR) 장치, 5G 서비스와 관련된 장치 등과 연계될 수 있다.

title_en: Education Training and Simulation System for Experiencing Earthquake
title_ko: 지진 대처 교육훈련 및 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is an earthquake response training and simulation system configured to realistically simulate, in an experiment site, various types of earthquake situations similar to actual earthquake situations so that it is possible to provide training on responses for when an earthquake occurs, and thus, a user can build coping ability in response to an earthquake while effectively experiencing the actual earthquake situations. The earthquake response training and simulation system comprises: a booth main body divided into an experience area and a management control area; an image display unit installed on one surface of the experience area of the booth main body and configured to output, on a screen, an educational image program for earthquake situations; an earthquake simulator installed on a bottom surface of the experience area of the booth main body and configured to implement actual earthquake waveforms on the bottom surface; a representation supplementary unit configured to represent guidance situations, distinguished into a training step and an experience step, in association with the display unit and the earthquake simulator, wherein the guidance situations are represented in the experience area using sound signals and lighting signals; a training operation unit installed in the experience area of the booth main body and to be locked necessarily by a user during an earthquake generation situation which is the experience step; and a central controller installed on the management control area of the booth main body, including a monitoring means configured to monitor situations in the experience area through a screen and an operation controller operable, by a manager, together with the monitoring means, and comprehensively controlling the image display unit, the earthquake simulator, and the representation supplementary unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 체험 현장 내 지진재난과 유사한 다양한 형태의 지진 발생상황을 실질적으로 재연하면서 지진 발생시 대처방안을 교육훈련하여 실제 지진상황을 효율적으로 체험하면서 사용자의 지진대처능력을 배양함을 제공하도록, 체험영역 및 관리제어영역을 구획하여 구분 형성하는 부스본체와; 상기 부스본체의 체험영역 내 일면에 설치하고, 지진 재난상황에 대한 교육용 영상프로그램을 화면 출력하는 영상디스플레이유닛과; 상기 부스본체 중 체험영역의 바닥면에 설치하고, 바닥면에 실질적인 지진 파형을 구현할 수 있게 구동하는 지진시뮬레이터와; 상기 디스플레이유닛 및 상기 지진시뮬레이터와 연계하여 교육단계 및 체험단계에 따라 구별된 안내상황을 연출하되 상기 체험영역 내 음성신호 및 조명신호로 연출하는 연출보조유닛과; 상기 부스본체의 체험영역 내 설치되고 체험단계인 지진발생상황에서 사용자가 필수적으로 잠금조작할 수 있게 구비하는 훈련조작유닛과; 상기 부스본체의 관리제어영역 내 설치하고, 상기 체험영역 내 상황을 화면으로 모니터링할 수 있는 감시수단과 함께 관리자로부터 조작가능한 조작컨트롤러를 구비하며, 상기 영상디스플레이유닛 및 상기 지진시뮬레이터, 상기 연출보조유닛을 일괄적으로 제어하는 중앙제어기;를 포함하는 지진 대처 교육훈련 및 시뮬레이션 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Three-dimensional geological disaster information model modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional geological disaster information model modeling method, which comprises the following steps: collecting and sorting the related data of the geological disaster information model, and carrying out digital processing on the related data; constructing a three-dimensional geological disaster model; constructing a geological disaster information database based on the data after digital processing; associating the three-dimensional geological disaster model with a geological disaster information database, and establishing a three-dimensional geological disaster information model; wherein, the three-dimensional geological disaster model is constructed by the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional terrain environment model; processing the drilling data; constructing a three-dimensional geological disaster model based on the processed drilling data; the method truly reflects the three-dimensional spatial position and form of the geological disaster, realizes integration and analysis of a large amount of geological disaster multi-source data, and improves the application efficiency and level of the geological disaster model.

title_en: Image change detection method based on deep neural network structure optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image change detection method based on deep neural network structure optimization, which mainly solves the problems of low detection generalization performance and low flexibility in the existing image change detection method. The implementation scheme is as follows: reading in an image, carrying out normalization processing, constructing a training sample set, and coding a deep neural network structure; initializing a population according to a network structure coding mode; searching an optimal network structure by an evolutionary algorithm based on the training sample set; and outputting an image change detection result graph by using the optimal network structure. The invention can efficiently and automatically search the optimal deep neural network structure of a given task based on the search strategy of the evolutionary algorithm, has better effect and robustness in the face of various complex conditions, improves the flexibility of change detection, and can be used for land cover detection, disaster evaluation and video monitoring.

title_en: Precision soil sealing machine for mulch film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mulching film precise soil sealing machine which comprises a transmission system, a soil taking and filtering system, a soil conveying and sealing system and a ground soil distribution profiling system, wherein the transmission system sequentially comprises chain wheels through a gearbox and a shaft, the soil is finely crushed through a soil taking wheel assembly and a soil crushing chain wheel, the soil is conveyed to the middle part of a roller through a soil conveying roller, further fine crushed soil blocks are pushed, the crushed soil is further uniformly pushed to the soil conveying roller through a left side spiral roller and a right side spiral roller, the quantitative crushed soil is guaranteed to fall into a soil outlet due to the action of a soil retaining barrel of the soil conveying roller, the ground profile of a soil guiding groove is guaranteed to be always at a certain height with the ground by the ground profile modeling mechanism, the crushed soil is guaranteed to be uniformly spread at the hole of a plant, the film is sealed at the hole of the seedling, and a simulated disaster is used for receiving the mulching film, so that the purpose of sealing soil is achieved.

title_en: Disaster monitering system based on IoT using things control unit
title_ko: 사물제어유닛을 이용한 IoT기반 재난모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an IoT-based disaster monitoring system using an object control unit. More specifically, the present invention relates to an IoT-based disaster monitoring system using an object control unit, comprising: a sensor unit installed in a building to detect a disaster; a platform server receiving the data measured by the sensor unit through a wireless gateway installed in the building; and a plurality of object control units installed in the building and each incorporating a speaker. The platform server receives the data measured by the sensor unit and location information of a refugee in the building in real time, predicting a situation based on simulation data, transmitting corresponding information to a user terminal of the refugee, and notifying of the information through the object control units.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사물제어유닛을 이용한 IoT기반 재난모니터링 시스템에 대한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 재난모니터링 시스템에 있어서, 건물 내에 설치되어 재난을 감지하는 센서부; 상기 센서부에서 측정된 감지데이터를 건물 내에 설치된 무선게이트웨이를 통해 전송받는 플랫폼 서버; 및 상기 건물 내에 복수로 설치되며 스피커를 내장한 사물제어유닛;을 포함하고, 상기 플랫폼 서버는 상기 센서부에 의해 측정된 측정데이터와, 건물 내의 피난자의 위치정보를 실시간으로 수신하여, 시뮬레이션데이터를 기반으로 상황을 예측하고, 대응정보를 상기 피난자의 사용자단말기에 전송하고, 상기 사물제어유닛을 통해 알리도록 하는 것을 특징으로 하는 사물제어유닛을 이용한 IoT기반 재난모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Education Training and Simulation Apparatus for Experiencing Earthquake
title_ko: 횡파 및 종파 동시 체험용 지진 대처 교육훈련 및 시뮬레이션 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an educating, training, and simulating apparatus in response to an earthquake for simultaneously experiencing transverse waves and longitudinal waves, which represents a substantial earthquake occurring situation of various types similar to an earthquake disaster in an experience site to develop an earthquake responding capacity of a user while efficiently experiencing an actual earthquake situation. The educating, training, and simulating apparatus of the present invention comprises: an experience booth formed with an experience space having a floor on an upper portion thereof; a frame assembly for supporting and fixing the experience booth to be moved, and formed in a multi-layered assembly structure to be moved in a horizontal direction and a vertical inclination direction; and a complex driving unit connected to and installed on the frame assembly, and driven to perform a complex reciprocating motion in the horizontal direction and the vertical inclination direction of the frame assembly. The complex driving unit includes: a driving means fixed to and installed on the frame assembly, and applying rotational power; an eccentric rotation member fixed to be rotated on a rotation shaft of the driving means, and having an eccentric shaft extending from one end thereof; a first crank unit having one end connected and coupled to the eccentric shaft of the eccentric rotation member and the other end connected and coupled to the frame assembly to transfer a moving power in the horizontal direction of the frame assembly; and a second crank unit positioned at one side of the first crank unit, having one end connected and coupled to the eccentric shaft of the eccentric rotation member and the other end connected and coupled to the frame assembly to transfer a moving power in the vertical inclination direction of the frame assembly.

title_en: Simulation training device for subway system fire prevention
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulated training device for preventing fire of a subway system, which comprises a station hall and a platform which are arranged up and down in sequence, and also comprises a fresh air shaft and an exhaust shaft, wherein the fresh air shaft is communicated with the station hall and the platform through an air supply pipeline, a static pressure box is arranged on the air supply pipeline, the air supply pipeline comprises an air supply main pipeline, an air supply pipeline first pipeline and an air supply pipeline second pipeline, and a fresh air fan and a fresh air valve are arranged on the air supply main pipeline; the exhaust shaft is communicated with the station hall and the platform through an exhaust pipeline, the exhaust pipeline comprises an exhaust main pipeline, an exhaust pipeline first branch pipeline and an exhaust pipeline second branch pipeline, and an exhaust fan and an exhaust valve are arranged on the exhaust main pipeline. The first branch pipeline of the air supply pipeline is provided with a first automatic smoke-proof fire-proof valve, and the second branch pipeline of the air supply pipeline is provided with a second automatic smoke-proof fire-proof valve. When a fire disaster occurs, the first automatic smoke-proof fire-proof valve and the second automatic smoke-proof fire-proof valve are internally fused to automatically close the air supply pipeline, so that fresh air input is cut off, and the expansion of the fire disaster is avoided.

title_en: High and steep bank slope stability monitoring system and evaluation method based on microseism technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring and prevention of geological disasters, in particular to a high and steep bank slope stability monitoring system and an evaluation method based on a microseism technology, which comprises a geophone, a data acquisition instrument and acquisition end data transmission equipment, wherein the geophone is used for detecting seismic wave signals, the geophone is placed in a hole with the depth of 20-50 meters in a drilling mode, and the geophone is connected with the data acquisition instrument outside the hole through a cable; by adopting the high and steep bank slope stability monitoring system and the monitoring method provided by the technical scheme of the invention, a regularized exit mechanism is introduced into a long and short term memory model of an iterative neural network, the calculation complexity of different hidden layer units is reduced, the stable state and the development trend of the high and steep bank slope can be comprehensively mastered in real time, the rock mass landslide early warning and risk control level is improved, the strict synchronous data acquisition can be ensured, the rock mass state can be monitored reliably in real time, and the high and steep bank slope stability monitoring system and the monitoring method have higher engineering application value.

title_en: A kind of small size tunnel fire hazard simulation experiment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of small size tunnel fire hazard simulation experiment systems, the small size tunnel fire hazard simulation experiment system structure is simple, installation, easy to operate, at low cost, safe and reliable, environmental pollution is small, it is high to the simulating degree of the fire scenario in true tunnel, for studying burning behavior, the flue gas behavior etc. of fire in tunnel, and there is very strong applicability；Tunnel body interior adds ceramic fibre fire-proof plate fire proofing material, third manually operated door and front side board are respectively flame resistant glass material, first manual door is arranged in the ventilation opening of top plate, the second manually operated door is arranged in the fire source mouth of bottom plate, so that, safety more convenient for tunnel fire disaster fume control and the research of temperature distributing rule.

title_en: Method for inverting outburst main control parameters by using gas emission data in coal seam drilling construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for inverting outburst main control parameters by using gas emission data in coal seam drilling construction, and belongs to the field of coal mine dynamic disaster prediction. The method comprises the following steps: the underground coal mine excavation working face adopts the mode of water slag removal or wind slag removal to carry out gas parameter measurement or gas extraction drilling; by utilizing the reaming effect of the drill bit during drilling, the iron thin tube extends into the drill hole along the hole wall of the drill hole and supplies air to the interior of the drill hole; accurately measuring the pressure difference of two sides of the iron air supply thin pipe by using a digital display type pressure difference sensor, and further calculating the air supply quantity; calculating the gas emission desorption amount of the drilled holes under the conditions of water slag discharge and wind slag discharge by combining the data of gas concentration, wind quantity and the like of the drilled places, wherein the gas emission desorption amount indirectly reflects the difference of the physical and mechanical properties of the coal body; and (4) rapidly predicting and forecasting the gas outburst risk of the drilling site. The method can realize the rapid prediction of the underground outburst risk and provide scientific method and advanced technical support for the safety of mine ventilation gas.

title_en: A kind of commercial building by when density of personnel prediction technique
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of commercial building by when density of personnel prediction technique.Determine 3 kinds of commercial building types, and by investigation, obtain respectively it is practical by when density of personnel.Density of personnel model is established with the superposition of normal distyribution function.Wherein, shopping center, supermarket density of personnel model be respectively the superposition of 2,3 normal distyribution functions；The model of specialty store is the superposition of 2 or 3 normal distyribution functions.The model of foundation includes parameter a 1 ,a 2 ,a 3 ,b 1 ,b 2 ,b 3 ,c 1 ,c 2 ,c 3 , with city factor traffic accessibility T     r   With population grade P     o   It is replaced, with simplified model.It finally found that, a 1 ,b 1 ,c 1 With T     r   Or P     o   In strong correlation, useable linear function representation；a 2 ,b 2 ,c 2 With T     r   、 P     o   Correlation it is not strong, indicated with average value；a 3 With a 1 , b 3 With b 1 , c 3 With c 1 It is respectively in quadratic function relation.A kind of commercial building provided by the invention by when density of personnel prediction technique can serve City-scale and monomer level simulation of energy consumption and safe evacuation system design.

title_en: A kind of civil aircraft multiple faults risk identification assessment calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of civil aircraft multiple faults risk identifications to assess calculation method, including failure risk identification, relationship analysis and proficiency assessment.Failure risk identification, for similar type operation troubles event sets, civil aircraft operation troubles reason is determined from floor manager's guarantee, flight implementation, engineering guarantee, flight training, from human error, airplane fault and environmental impact analysis fault type, the potential fault mode from structural strength, system, power device backward reasoning civil aircraft operational process；Fault relationship is divided into independent failure and relevant fault, carries out Fault Mechanism Analysis for the component that fault mode is serious/disaster, determines independent failure probability by changeing record or fault tree, determines relevant fault probability by Chain of Causation, extension fault tree；Risk level assessment includes probability of happening and severity.The present invention evaluates the potential danger of unit failure in the civil aircraft operation phase, improves engineering maintenance and ensures efficiency, civil aircraft operational safety.

title_en: A kind of anchoring, pore self-sealing and Sewage treatment casing certainly for cavitation jet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of anchoring, pore self-sealing and Sewage treatment casings certainly for cavitation jet, including housing tube assembly, inner sleeve tube assembly and gland, inner sleeve tube assembly twist-on is in the inside of outer sheath assembly, extend housing tube assembly in the rear end of inner sleeve tube assembly, gland is fixed on the rear end of housing tube assembly, and it is mutually pressed with inner sleeve tube assembly, return flume is provided on the faying face of inner sleeve tube assembly and gland, the water return outlet with return flume connection is provided on gland, water return outlet is connected with sewage recovering system.The utility model it is mountable on the drilling rod of cavitation jet using also can be used alone, it can be realized from anchoring, pore self-sealing, the function of Sewage treatment, effectively prevent secondary disaster caused by Gas Outburst, Sewage treatment, anchoring, pore self-sealing are easy to operate certainly, structure novel is skillfully constructed, and has a good application prospect.

title_en: Fire tower with the drying and climb-training function
abstract_en: The subject of the invention is a fire tower with a drying room and climbing facility. The tower was designed for drying fire hoses, firefighting clothes, ropes and as a training facility for learning rescue techniques. The tower is equipped with a climbing facility located outside the tower.The tower consists of a concrete foundation with a steel anchor and two steel segments made by "carg" rolling. The first segment consists of four rolled steel sheets, longitudinally and butt welded to form a uniform block in the form of a cylinder. The lower part of the cylinder attached to the foundation in the form of a footing is equipped with four entry holes with a door made of stainless steel. These holes are used to operate winches and allow air to circulate inside the tower when the door is opened.The second tower segment also consists of four rolled steel sheets, longitudinally and butt welded, forming a uniform block in the form of a cylinder, which is also equipped with a flange allowing the connection of both segments by means of a prestressed connection.

title_en: Flooding prediction evaluation device
abstract_en: To provide a flooding prediction evaluation device capable of quickly predicting flooding disaster of sewerage systems or rivers through meteorological environmental information, and evaluating the prediction.SOLUTION: A rain cloud route prediction device 110 predicts the rain cloud route and precipitation amount for every rain cloud on the basis of meteorological environment information collected by a rainfall measurement instrument. A scenario division part 130 selects a representative rainfall pattern among the predictions, and for the selected representative rainfall pattern, a simulation calculation part 160 calculates temporal change of water levels and flooding regions at a respective point of the sewerage systems or rivers by simulation. An evaluation calculation part 140 calculates disaster scale evaluation values quantitatively showing the disaster scale of the representative rainfall pattern on the basis of the calculated information of the temporal change of the water levels and flooding regions. Then, an interpolation calculation part 150 estimates the disaster scale evaluation values for the rain cloud route and the precipitation amount not selected as the representative rainfall pattern.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Simulation method of isolation switch in power grid topology
abstract_en: A simulation method of an isolation switch in a power grid topology is characterized in that in the operation of a power grid, the isolation switch plays a role of forming an obvious 'breakpoint' in switching operation, is an essential link for forming a safe region in the power grid operation, does not participate in 'arc extinction' of a circuit in breaking or closing, is usually arranged in cooperation with a circuit breaker, and can be considered by the circuit breaker in the construction of a power grid simulation model based on the actual characteristics, so that the power grid simulation model does not include the isolation switch in the topology, but does not influence the realization of a 'five-prevention locking' function of the power grid switching operation of a simulation system due to the consideration of the circuit breaker. The method is characterized in that the problem of dimension disaster caused by isolation switches in the construction of a power grid simulation model is solved according to the actual condition of power grid operation.

title_en: Traffic basic diagram-based evacuation traffic flow distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evacuation vehicle flow distribution method based on a traffic basic diagram, which is suitable for construction of emergency plans of large-scale activities, natural disasters or major accidents and emergency response when an emergency occurs, and particularly relates to an evacuation vehicle flow distribution method based on the traffic basic diagram. And analyzing the map into a Cartesian coordinate system, and determining an evacuation range circle layer according to the evacuation center point by an analysis method. And performing traffic simulation on the road network in the specific area by using a traffic simulation method and a numerical fitting method, and fitting to obtain a traffic basic diagram of the key road sections on the corresponding evacuation circle layer. And after obtaining the basic graph, establishing an unconstrained optimization model, and obtaining the maximum flow of the key road section by derivation. And finally, distributing the probability of selecting the destination for the evacuation traffic flow according to the obtained maximum flow.

title_en: A kind of disaster prevention and danger avoidance park entrance optimization method based on Pathfinder simulation softwares
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of disaster prevention and danger avoidance park entrance optimization method of Pathfinder simulation softwares, which includes: base map generation step；Boundary determines step；Evacuation model forming step；Evacuation personnel's parameter determination；Simulation steps and park entrance efficiency analysis step.Computer Simulation Software is applied to park planning design field for the first time by the present invention, propose a more accurately research method, a degree of effect of visualization is provided for park Disaster Prevention Design, makes the adjustment of science under clearly tale quale convenient for people, preferably keeps away calamity effect to reach.

title_en: Coal mine work area coal seam GIM mathematical model creation method based on BIM
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of coal mine work area coal seam GIM mathematical model creation method based on BIM, scene drilling measured data is handled, utilize BIM modeling tool, edit three-dimensional geometric shapes algorithm, create coal seam GIM mathematical model, accurately reflect the ocurrence of coal seam situation of quasi- mining face, overcome the technological deficiency of existing D CAD drawing technique, solve the problems, such as that coal mine intuitively can not accurately check ocurrence of coal seam situation before working face extraction, improve the precision that coal production design management personnel grasp working face ocurrence of coal seam situation, keep the coal production control to working face more accurate, facilitate and instructs going on smoothly for subsequent actual mining, accomplish the anticipation of prevention in advance to disaster scenarios it.

title_en: Rectangle drilling drilling apparatus and boring method based on fan-shaped drill bit
abstract_en: The rectangle drilling drilling apparatus and boring method that the invention discloses a kind of based on fan-shaped drill bit, it includes hollow drill and drill bit, and the hollow drill is formed by fixedly connecting by guide rod and jointed rod, carries drill bit drilling for straight ahead；Jointed rod plays fixed guide as the connecting rod between guide rod and drilling machine, guide rod, it is ensured that will not bore partially during fan-shaped bit bore；The drill bit is arranged on guide rod lateral wall, and drill bit is realized by the motor power being located in guide rod can drill out rectangle drilling during rotation, the shape of drill bit should ensure that bit.The present invention can creep into rectangle drilling, can effectively install rectangular stress monitoring device, this will lay the foundation to monitor correct stress Evolution, be of great significance to prevention and control mine motive force disaster.

title_en: Construction method for integrally preventing and controlling coal and rock composite disasters through pressure relief, extraction and water injection
abstract_en: A construction method for preventing and controlling coal and rock composite disasters by integrating pressure relief, extraction and water injection comprises the following steps: drilling large-diameter pressure relief holes in shallow parts at certain intervals in upper and lower crossroads of a coal face; sealing the shallow large-diameter pressure relief hole, and then extracting gas; selecting one shallow large-diameter pressure relief hole every other shallow large-diameter pressure relief hole, continuously drilling a deep drill hole, enabling the shallow large-diameter pressure relief hole and the deep drill hole to be staggered front and back, enabling the deep drill hole to be staggered on an upper crossheading and a lower crossheading, and then re-sealing each deep drill hole; forming a group of two adjacent deep drill holes, taking the front one of each group as a gas extraction hole and the rear one as a water injection hole, and simultaneously performing gas extraction and coal rock water injection; and finishing construction after all the deep drill holes finish gas extraction and water injection. The construction method can achieve the best effect by adopting the technology of 'pressure relief, extraction and water injection' integrated prevention and control of rock burst and coal and gas outburst composite power disaster through the mutual intersection and matching of deep gas extraction and water injection.

title_en: It waves and quickly melts ice-coating test platform and its test method under windy conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses waving quickly to melt ice-coating test platform under windy conditions, including artificial climate simulating chamber 1 and waves and melt ice-coating test platform 2；Wave that melt ice-coating test platform 2 include ice-coating test conducting wire, connecting cable, connection conductor, up-flow and measuring system, pressure regulator；Pressure regulator input termination AC power source, output voltage regulator connects up-flow and measuring system input terminal, up-flow and measuring system output end connect conductor input terminal in succession, connection two output ends of conductor are separately connected two connecting cable input terminals, and two connecting cable output ends connect respectively melts ice-coating test wire input end and output end；It connects conductor, two connecting cables and ice-coating test conducting wire and forms a closed circuit；Partial ice-coating test conducting wire is placed in artificial climate simulating chamber 1.This test platform of the present invention and test method can determine in the ice melting current for waving windy conditions lower wire, for the condition that winter conducting wire strong wind freezes, provide technological guidance, reduce the anti-probability given birth to of disaster.

title_en: Pulse earthquake motion simulation method based on earthquake source fault model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pulse earthquake motion simulation method based on a seismic source fault model. The method is based on the pulse earthquake motion database, combines the pulse earthquake motion attenuation rule with the established mountain terrain effect model, can produce pulse earthquake motion time courses according to grids in a research area by means of an earthquake motion simulation technology, uses a pulse quantification method to quantitatively express the pulse earthquake motion, provides an artificial reappearing method of the pulse earthquake motion, provides abundant and reasonable artificial pulse earthquake motion for related research fields, lays a research foundation, and provides data support for the perfection of earthquake-resistant design specifications, the evaluation of disasters after earthquakes and the like.

title_en: A kind of compound dynamic disaster simulation experiment method of mine for considering top plate and influencing
abstract_en: Specific as follows the invention discloses a kind of compound dynamic disaster simulation experiment method of mine that consideration top plate influences: the coal petrography assembly test specimen for being pasted with foil gauge that will be prepared is packed into high-pressure-resistant sealed cavity；The installation and debugging of completion other equipment simultaneously start；It vacuumizes, inflates, load and the air pressure of real-time monitoring cavity, coal and rock respectively strain and characteristics of Acoustic Emission；Moment is destroyed by the valve release of explosion-proof type high speed pneumatic in test specimen, and the power presentation attributes observed in Catastrophe Process is simultaneously analyzed.Invention also provides a kind of compound dynamic disaster simulation experiment systems of mine that consideration top plate influences.System monitoring can be carried out to the compound disaster catastrophe of mine each stage using the present invention provide data supporting simultaneously for the Accurate Analysis in catastrophe each stage, with important theory significance and engineering value, the prediction and prevention and treatment of the mines composite power disaster such as the bump-coal and gas prominent induced deep mining equally have positive effect.

title_en: Rescue aircraft task allocation based on two-stage planning in earthquake rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue aircraft task allocation method (TLP) based on a two-stage planning algorithm in earthquake rescue. The method comprises the following steps: earthquake rescue simulators and two-stage planning rescue algorithms (TLPs). The earthquake rescue simulator simulates the conditions of disaster-stricken personnel in ground medical areas and disaster-stricken areas in earthquakes. The TLP algorithm is used for performing online optimization on task allocation of the rescue aircraft, and comprises three parts, namely rescue task level planning, rescue aircraft level planning and rescue aircraft position allocation. And the first part is used for finishing the clustering of rescue tasks and the task allocation of rescue airplanes. The second part is used for carrying out rescue target sequence planning on each task group and the corresponding rescue aircraft group based on the particle swarm optimization, and the third part is used for carrying out position distribution on each rescue aircraft after the task is completed, so that the rescue work in the next rescue period is facilitated. The TLP algorithm maximizes the total number of successful rescue under the condition that the occurrence of earthquake and aftershock is random and unpredictable, and improves the rescue effect.

title_en: A kind of enigmatic language justice learning method towards multi-angle of view multi-tag data
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of enigmatic language justice learning methods towards multi-angle of view multi-tag data, it include: the input for reading multi-angle of view multi-tag data as preprocessor, then data prediction is carried out, and pre-processed results are input in training aids, study obtains the model after enigmatic language foster son space and training.When prediction does not mark the label of multi-angle of view data, the multi-angle of view data not marked are pre-processed, prediction in trained model is then input to and obtains multi-tag classification.A kind of study for merging multiple Viewing-angle informations and multi-tag classification method are proposed in the present invention, and input feature vector and output multi-tag are mapped in common potential applications subspace.This method is capable of handling dimension disaster problem brought by high dimension sparse data, while merging multi-angle of view information and classifying to multi-tag data.

title_en: A kind of control method of coal mine digging laneway coal rock dynamic disaster
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of control methods of coal mine digging laneway coal rock dynamic disaster, comprising: meet head on front successively construction first drilling and second drilling of the control drilling machine in digging laneway；One piece of steel ball is put into drilling rod to block the apopore of drill bit, and high-pressure hydraulic pump matched with drilling machine is adjusted to default cutting pressure, so that ejector starts rotation and cuts by the jet hole injection liquid on ejector to the second drilling；When the first drilling has liquid outflow, control drilling rod is exited outward from the second drilling up to drilling rod exits the second drilling completely according to default astern speed.The application passes through in advance in boring head men working destressing borehole and to the means of drilling progress hydraulic reaming slotting, greatly improve the discharge space of pressure relief vent, the generation for even being eliminated bump or coal and gas accident as caused by crustal stress or gas stress can be significantly reduced, guarantees the life and property safety of underground operators.

title_en: The branch mark structure and its construction method of ground double-decked slope
abstract_en: The application provides a kind of branch mark structure of ground double-decked slope, the branch mark structure includes drilled pile, binding beam, panel, bottom plate and anchor cable, the drilled pile bottom end is located at good ground, the binding beam is connected between the drilled pile top surface, the panel is connected between the laterally outermost drilled pile side of the side slope, the panel bottom end is connected with the bottom plate intersected with the panel, the anchor cable includes anchoring section and the anchor head that connect with the anchoring section, the anchoring section is located at rock stratum, and the anchor head is located on the panel.The application also provides a kind of construction method of the branch mark structure of ground double-decked slope.Retaining structure good stress performance provided by the present application, stable structure is reliable, can effectively prevent slope instability disaster；Its construction method construction period is short, and side slope disturbance is small, and construction efficiency is high.

title_en: Anti-slide pile suitable for disaster relief temporary arrangement
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of slide-resistant piles, and particularly relates to a slide-resistant pile suitable for temporary arrangement in disaster relief, which comprises a bearing column, a drilling part, a pile body, a slide bar, an A rack, a fixed ring, a fixed cylinder, a stepped ring, a rotating sleeve, a rotating cylinder and the like. The structure cost is low when the unidirectional driving is carried out, and the unidirectional driving device is suitable for batch production. In addition, the anti-slide pile of the invention generates little vibration in the whole pile pressing process, thereby being very beneficial to the pile pressing of the landslide with hard soil and danger. The invention has compact structure, reasonable spatial arrangement and better use effect.

title_en: Closed cabin medium atomization experimental system for simulating ship oil fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medium atomization experiment system in a closed cabin for simulating a ship oil fire disaster, which comprises a simulated closed cabin, a fire source vibration and swing system, a fire source generation system, a medium atomization system, an air temperature control system, an air concentration control system and a pressure control system. According to the experimental system disclosed by the invention, aiming at the condition that oil fires occur in a ship cabin in sailing, the action performance of different fire extinguishing mediums on oil pool fires can be researched, and the test results of temperature characteristics and smoke characteristics are obtained by simulating and adjusting the characteristics of temperature, air concentration, pressure, vibration and the like in the cabin, so that the optimal ship fire extinguishing scheme is obtained.

title_en: The monitoring while drilling system and monitoring while drilling of a kind of deep water geological disaster and recognition methods
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of monitoring while drilling system of deep water geological disaster and monitoring while drilling and recognition methods, the system includes processing module on the well being arranged on workbench at sea, and control transmission module, transient electromagnetic module and sound wave module on drilling rod are set, and processing module is connect with transient electromagnetic module and sound wave module by cable and control transmission module, control transmission module by cable respectively on well；The monitoring while drilling system can not only detect the geological information of shallow-layer in the seawater before drilling well, to determine that borehole position provides information, the region and pit shaft lateral extent that do not drill through before drill bit can also be detected in drilling process, provide guidance in real time for drilling well.Monitoring while drilling and recognition methods of the invention is monitored in front of the drill bit and stratum of near wellbore by increasing the measuring while drilling pipe nipple comprising sound wave and electromagnetic surveying function, emphasis, can effectively detect earth formation and potential geological disaster.
