title_en: A kind of Intelligent fire-fighting detection training facilities
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of Intelligent fire-fighting detection training facilities, it include: multifunctional fire-fighting training tower, platform skeleton (1-1), three main body steel construction frames, simulation window (1-3), floor partition (1-4), climbing training tower (1-5) is watched from a height or a distance by commander to form, top layer is arranged multiple night vision cams (1-6), is multiple to switch (1-7) and training tower top pressure switch (1-8) is penetrated, and multiple pressure switches (1-9) are arranged in bottom；Intelligent Wind Speed instrument (2-1)；The casting of timing language, including loudspeaker carry out real-time broadcasting for the training test macro to firefighters；Control panel system is made of display, voice announcer, combined aural and visual alarm, PLC control chip, ISP high-definition display screen；Real time data push and backstage display system；Field data is transferred to meeting room, realizes remote data transmission, scene view, server storing data information by 4G network system and server.
assignees: SHANZHONG LIDE BEIJING FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for establishing association matrix of wireless base station and regional geographic ground object
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data analysis, and particularly relates to a method for establishing a wireless base station and a regional geographical ground object association matrix. The method comprises the following steps: s1 extracting training data TrainData; s2, extracting feature information from the electronic map, classifying the feature information, and establishing PoiData; s3, carrying out data preprocessing on TrainData, and removing data influencing accuracy; s4 associates TrainData and PoiData through a geographic relationship; s5 establishing a relation matrix R based on training data cp_train (ii) a S6, carrying out Voronoi Diagram division on the base station cell, and establishing a coverage area; s7, expanding the coverage area according to the over-coverage coefficient; s8 calculating the adjoint credibility matrix B of the training matrix region (ii) a S9 establishing a relation matrix R of the district and the ground feature region (ii) a S10 is used for aligning the relation matrix R by adopting a periodic sliding window method region And (6) updating. The invention provides basic data for providing socialized geographic information for the mobile phone user after accurately judging the staying place of the mobile phone user, and provides a basic model for personnel position-based applications of public safety, disaster prevention and reduction, smart cities, marketing and the like.

title_en: Device and method for simulating disaster-causing mechanism of three-dimensional animal cave of homogeneous dam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for simulating a homogeneous dam three-dimensional animal cave disaster-causing mechanism. The drawing adjusting mechanism comprises a slide rail, a slide block and a horizontal drawing driving device; the cave simulation frame comprises a circular ring and at least three straight rods; one ends of all straight rods are uniformly distributed on the end face of the circular ring adjacent to the backwater slope surface along the circumferential direction, and the other ends form vertex non-fixed ends and are embedded in the dam; the simulation of different three-dimensional animal caves is realized by adjusting the included angle between each straight rod and each circular ring; the safety detection mechanism comprises a displacement sensor, an osmometer, a seepage monitoring sensor and an image measurement system. According to the invention, after the dam model reaches the preset centrifugal acceleration, the production simulation of the three-dimensional cave network of the animals such as termites and badgers is realized, the appearance of the animal cave in the running process of the dam is truly reflected, and the disaster-causing process and the disaster-causing mechanism of the dam under the complex hydraulic condition are disclosed.

title_en: A kind of method for building up of wireless base station and line segment type geography atural object incidence matrix
abstract_en: The invention belongs to data analysis technique fields, and in particular to a kind of method for building up of wireless base station and line segment type geography atural object incidence matrix.Include the following steps extraction training data；Terrestrial object information is extracted, is established；Line segment type atural object is segmented；TrainData and PoiData is associated with by geographical relationship；Establish the relational matrix R based on training data cp_train 、R pc_train ；Each radio base station cell is calculated to the coverage strength of each waypoint using propagation model, derives cover probability；Establish all cells to all waypoints cover probability matrix R line_cov ；Calculate the adjoint credible matrix B of training matrix line ；S9 integrates R pc_train 、R line_cov 、B line Three matrixes establish cell-atural object relational matrix R to line segment type atural object line ；S10 is to relational matrix R line It is updated using periodical slip window sampling.The present invention for that will provide socialization geography information for mobile phone user after the stop place of accurate judgement mobile phone user and provide basic data, for public safety, prevent and reduce natural disasters, smart city, the marketing etc. based on personnel positions using providing basic model.

title_en: Method for analyzing disaster reduction effect of different underlying surfaces of city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing disaster reduction effects of different underlying surfaces of a city, which comprises the following steps of 1, simulating a waterlogging evolution process under rainstorm conditions of different reappearance periods by adopting a two-dimensional hydrodynamic numerical model, analyzing waterlogging risk distribution conditions under the current conditions of the city, and constructing a rainstorm waterlogging calculation model; step 2, selecting several under-floor drainage measures at least comprising water permeable pavement, horizontal greenbelt and sunken greenbelt layout, grass planting ditch layout and roof greening according to the current situation of urban land utilization, and analyzing the elastic waterlogging resistance effect of the under-floor drainage measures; step 3, analyzing the combined waterlogging resistance effect of different underlying surface measures; and 4, carrying out cost-benefit comparative analysis on drainage schemes of different underlying surfaces. According to the invention, different types of underlying surfaces are considered on the basis of high-precision terrain, a refined model is established, and the simulation of rainstorm waterlogging is reliably carried out.

title_en: A kind of full-scale cabin fire spread and flash over imitative experimental appliance
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of full-scale cabin fire spread and flashes over imitative experimental appliance, including die body, matched simulated generating device, temperature measurement system and fume extractor.The die body forms simulation cabin by the ratio entity steel construction of 1:1；It is equipped with that model bed one is opened, couch one is opened, small sofa one is opened in cabin, is steel structure model, for conventional furniture in simulating chamber, model bed is located at the left side wall of cabin, and couch is located at rear wall, and small sofa is located at antetheca；The matched simulated generating device includes natural gas supply system and the ignition system that connect with natural gas supply system；The smoke evacuation system is used to for fire smoke being discharged through cabin rear wall gas vent.Inside fire sprawling of the utility model for routine experimentation teaching is tested with phenomena simulation is flashed over, and can carry out teaching demonstration experiment and fire-fighting operation real training, for firefighters, the daily fire fire-fighting technical training of part-time fireman and related practitioner.
assignees: NAVAL UNIVERSITY ENG PLA;ZHEJIANG YANING FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of full-scale cabin is strile-backd imitative experimental appliance
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of full-scale cabin and strile-backs imitative experimental appliance, including die body, matched simulated generating device, TT&C system and fume extractor；Die body forms simulation cabin by the ratio entity steel construction of 1:1；Model locker there are three setting in boiler-plate room, often uses cabinet body for simulated storage room；The matched simulated generating device includes natural gas supply system and the ignition system that connect with natural gas supply system, natural gas supply system passes through gas burner of the indoor natural gas line in cabin by natural gas transportation at three model lockers, and the ignition system includes and the one-to-one igniter of burner；The TT&C system includes the measuring device positioned at cabin ceiling measurement flue-gas temperature；The fume extractor is used to for fire smoke being discharged through cabin rear wall gas vent.The utility model can carry out teaching demonstration experiment and fire-fighting operation real training, in the daily fire fire-fighting technical training for firefighters, part-time fireman and related practitioner.
assignees: NAVAL UNIVERSITY ENG PLA;ZHEJIANG YANING FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Road blocking information extraction method based on deep learning image semantic segmentation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a road blocking image semantic segmentation sample library for full convolution neural network training, which comprises the processes of vectorization, enhancement and standardization of samples; secondly, introducing the type of a classical convolutional neural network and an improvement method of a network structure, and explaining a network implementation method and a training process; and then, performing semantic segmentation on the road surface of the remote sensing image by using the full convolution neural network obtained by training, and on the basis of extracting the undamaged road surface before disaster and the undamaged road surface after disaster, performing a method for judging the road integrity by using the length proportion of the undamaged road before disaster and after disaster. The improved full convolution neural network model has various precision evaluation indexes superior to those of the original full convolution neural network model, is more suitable for the specific problems of detection of undamaged road surfaces and judgment of road integrity after disasters, and can effectively overcome the adverse effect of tree and shadow shielding on road blocking information extraction.

title_en: Numerical analysis method for breaking mechanism of portal fracture rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical analysis method for a breaking mechanism of a door opening-shaped fractured rock mass, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing rock mass models with different working conditions in RFPA software, wherein the rock mass models comprise a complete urban portal rock mass A without cracks, an urban portal rock mass B with prefabricated cracks at the side edge, an urban portal rock mass C with prefabricated cracks at the bottom edge and an urban portal rock mass D with prefabricated cracks at the top arch; s2, inputting basic parameters of rock mass materials, performing numerical simulation on each working condition model by software, and outputting a crack propagation process diagram, an acoustic emission rule diagram and a stress-strain curve corresponding to each working condition model; s3, analyzing and obtaining a breaking mechanism of the urban portal rock mass containing the cracks according to the crack propagation process diagram, the acoustic emission rule diagram and the stress-strain curve. The analysis method can master the breaking mechanism of the rock mass, so that the crack positions are protected in actual engineering, and disasters are prevented.

title_en: Route denial information extraction based on deep learning image classification
abstract_en: The present invention discloses the route denial information extraction based on deep learning image classification, constructs route denial image classification sample database using disaster typical case image, carries out the training of convolutional neural networks, obtain initial convolution neural network model CNNmodel0；After acquisition research area x calamity after image I (x) and road vectors R (x), route denial is detected, sample D to be detected is obtained n (x)；Using trained network C NNmodel0, to sample D to be detected n (x) it carries out the multiple spot route denial detection for increasing test point along the vertical normal direction in road vectors direction: a small amount of road segment segment being selected to generate new training sample data S 1 , network fine tuning is carried out to existing network；The work of route denial classification and Detection is repeated, until testing result reaches required precision.Every precision evaluation index of improved convolutional neural networks model will be better than archetype, be more applicable for the particular problem of disaster area route denial image classification and detection.
assignees: INST REMOTE SENSING & DIGITAL EARTH CAS

title_en: Box type landslide model test system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a box-type landslide model test system which comprises a landslide model box, wherein a model slope body and a water action simulation unit are arranged in the landslide model box; the water action simulation unit comprises a seepage box arranged between a model slope body and a side plate of the landslide model box, and a plurality of seepage holes are formed in the surface of one side, facing the model slope body, of the seepage box; a gabion water distribution layer is also clamped between the seepage box and the model slope body, the gabion water distribution layer is attached to the seepage box and covers all the seepage holes, and the model slope body is attached to the gabion water distribution layer so that water passing through the gabion water distribution layer can permeate into the interior of the model slope body; a plurality of pore water pressure sensors are embedded in the model slope body. The landslide geological disaster mechanism under the action of high water pressure can be simulated accurately through the water action simulation unit under various states, such as irrigation, rainfall, underground water seepage and the like.

title_en: Landslide model test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide model test device which comprises a landslide model box, wherein a model slope body and a freezing and thawing unit are arranged in the landslide model box; the model slope body is piled on the bottom plate of the landslide model box, one side face of the model slope body is used for slope setting and is a free slope face, and the other side faces of the model slope body are limited by the side plates of the landslide model box so that the section of the model slope body vertical to the slope face is in a right trapezoid shape; the freeze-thaw simulation unit comprises a condensation pipe network which corresponds to the slope surface and is buried under the slope surface, and the condensation pipe network is connected with the heat exchange equipment main body outside the landslide model box; a plurality of temperature sensors are also embedded under the slope surface. According to the invention, through the freeze-thaw simulation unit, a test for simulating and researching the influence of seasonal freeze-thaw on landslide geological disasters can be effectively developed, and a test for simulating and researching the influence of freeze-thaw skid promotion on landslide geological disasters under the action of water can be effectively developed by combining the existing rainfall system and the like.

title_en: The double-deck major long tunnel fire emphasis smoke evacuation pilot system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to a kind of double-deck major long tunnel fire emphasis smoke evacuation pilot system of highway and urban road tunnel fire-fighting domain, technical solutions are as follows: tunnel outer wall, independent smokejack, upper layer lane, flyunder, smoke evacuation branch pipe and fume extractor including simulating Practical Project；Side wall is provided between upper layer lane and flyunder and tunnel outer wall；It is separated between independent smokejack and upper layer lane with smoke evacuation plate, top of the upper layer smoke outlet is set on plate of discharging fume；Multiple smoke evacuation branch pipes are close to the inside arranged for interval of tunnel outer wall；The upper end of smoke evacuation branch pipe is connected to independent smokejack, and lower end passes through smoke outlet at the top of the lower layer side being arranged on the side wall of flyunder and is connected to flyunder；Automatic collection sensing element is arranged in tunnel.Its blank for having filled up the existing double-deck major long tunnel fire emphasis smoke evacuation pilot system is a kind of strong operability, convenient for judging smoke evacuation performance quality, accuracy with higher, the pilot system of confidence level.

title_en: Multi-field coupling visual coal and gas delay outburst test device
abstract_en: A multi-field coupling visual coal and gas delay outburst test device is suitable for simulating underground coal and gas delay outburst in a laboratory. The visual box body is made of transparent materials, a loading system, an air source system, a temperature control system, a camera system and a protruding door system are arranged on the visual box body, and the loading system, the air source system, the temperature control system, the camera system and the protruding door system are respectively connected with a data acquisition and control system. The box body coal seam seepage field, the temperature field, the surface fracture field and the outburst coal powder migration track field can be visualized in a multi-field whole process, and a foundation is laid for researching the outburst disaster-causing characteristics of coal and gas and preventing and treating the outburst disaster-causing characteristics.

title_en: Microseismic signal classification method and device based on deep learning and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microseismic signal classification method, a microseismic signal classification device and a storage medium based on deep learning, wherein the classification method comprises the following steps: acquiring a microseismic signal; performing feature extraction on the microseismic signal to obtain an expression feature for representing the microseismic signal, wherein the expression feature is a two-dimensional feature matrix determined based on the sub-frames and time domain and frequency domain features corresponding to the sub-frames; performing classification identification based on the expression characteristics and a classification model for classification, and determining a classification result corresponding to the microseismic signal; the classification model is determined by deep learning training based on training set data. The method can realize automatic and accurate classification of the microseismic signals monitored by the microseismic sensor according to a preset classification model, and is favorable for improving the intelligent level of ground pressure disaster monitoring.

title_en: Systems and methods for training firefighters
abstract_en: Systems and methods for training firefighters and other first responders are provided. The systems include a plurality of sensors configured to detect at least one ambient condition, such as, temperature; a receiver configured to receive the electric signals from the plurality of sensors; and a digital storage device operatively connected to the receiver and adapted to store the electrical signals corresponding to the detected ambient conditions. The data detected by the sensors can be retrieved for later review, analysis, and training. The systems may include at least one video recorder and/or at least one infrared image recorder each configured to detect images that can be stored for later retrieval and a synchronizing device adapted to synchronize the sensor data with the recorded images for later review. Methods of implementing the systems and portable cases enclosing the system are also provided.

title_en: Firefighting training apparatus and method
abstract_en: A firefighting training apparatus includes a tank having a tank outlet and a tank inlet, and a cuboid-shaped receptacle mounted on top of the tank. The receptacle has an open rear side, a closed front side, a planar top side, and a bottom side with a sump connected to the tank inlet. The closed front side has a vertical lower portion and an angled upper portion connected to the top side. A plane containing the angled upper portion forms an acute angle with the top side to help disperse training fluid within the receptacle. A plurality of flow dividers are provided on the closed front side to further disperse training fluid being sprayed through the open rear side into the receptacle. The tank with the open-sided receptacle mounted on top is supported by a mobile trailer to facilitate transporting the training apparatus to a training site.

title_en: Crop disaster situation evaluation method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crop disaster assessment method, a crop disaster assessment device, crop disaster assessment equipment and a computer readable storage medium based on image processing, wherein the crop disaster assessment method comprises the following steps: obtaining a remote sensing image of crops and growth environment parameters of the crops; processing the remote sensing image of the crop to obtain crop characteristics and crop categories; generating a time-varying development variation function of crops of a corresponding category according to the category and the characteristics of the crops; generating a temperature time-varying input function, an illumination time-varying input function and a nutrition time-varying input function of a crop growth environment according to the growth environment parameters of crops; constructing a double parallel feedforward process neural network model based on the function of the crops; generating a crop growth model through input and output training of a double-parallel feedforward process neural network model; and judging whether the current crops are in a disaster state or not based on the states of the crop growth model at different moments. Therefore, the disaster situation of the crops can be accurately judged.

title_en: Landslide monitoring method based on active waveguide acoustic emission
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of landslide monitoring methods based on active waveguide acoustic emission, comprising: the tilt angle of the cabinet for the experimental provision that comes down and ground is adjusted to preset tilt angle；It is banketed in cabinet to be piled into the target gliding mass of preset shape；It is inserted into the first tubular element in target gliding mass, and the first acoustic emission sensor is installed far from one end of target gliding mass in the first tubular element；Formula control propulsive mechanism is changed over time according to preset speed to push target gliding mass；The thrust that propulsive mechanism is applied to target gliding mass is obtained by pressure sensor, and the displacement generated when propulsive mechanism pushes target gliding mass is obtained by displacement sensor, and first acoustic emission signal of the target gliding mass in process of landslides is obtained by the first acoustic emission sensor.By proposing the experimental program of indoor landslide o earth slope sound emission measurement, the mechanism study of the thrust load caused landslide of various modifications process can be carried out, motion process and failure mode with the landslide disaster actually occurred in approximate reduction natural environment can be simulated.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Geological disaster space distribution rule and assessment of easy generation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of geological disaster space distribution rule and assessment of easy generation methods, based on remotely-sensed data and generalized information system, by constructing basic geology model, simulate influence situation of the evaluation factors at different levels to geological disaster, and quantify to be fitted, the weight of each evaluation factor and the space distribution rule of geological disaster are obtained, and liability numerical value is calculated with this；By the above-mentioned means, the present invention is able to solve subjectivity larger problem when evaluation factor weight determines, from the space distribution rule of non-linear angle analytically matter disaster, the liability of objective, accurate ground-to-ground matter disaster is quantitatively evaluated.
assignees: RONGZHI COLLEGE OF CHONGQING TECHNOLOGY AND BUSINESS UNIV

title_en: Construction method for controlling roadway deformation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of roadway surrounding rock control, in particular to a construction method for controlling roadway deformation, which comprises the following steps: a roadway driving and dynamic pressure influence front-stage construction method and a dynamic pressure influence stage construction method such as stoping and the like; the construction method for the roadway excavation and dynamic pressure influence front stage comprises the following steps: drilling a hole in the stress concentration area to form a pressure relief area; performing anchoring support in a surrounding rock area of a shallow layer of the roadway; the construction method for the dynamic pressure influence stage of stoping and the like comprises the following steps: drilling a hole in the area far away from the surface of the roadway to form a pressure relief area; performing grouting modification on surrounding rocks in a region close to the surface of the roadway compared with the pressure relief region; the anchoring support is carried out in the surrounding rock area of the shallow layer of the roadway, multiple measures play a role together, the influence of impact dynamic load on the roadway space is reduced to the maximum extent, the deformation of the roadway is reduced to the maximum extent, the escape space of the roadway after the dynamic disaster is ensured while the risk of the dynamic disasters such as roadway rock burst is reduced, and the casualties of people are reduced.

title_en: A kind of gas flowmeter detects running gear automatically
abstract_en: A kind of gas flowmeter detects running gear automatically.It includes Laboratory Module and control system, and control system includes controller and temperature control modules connected to the controller, humidity control module and flow-control module, and Laboratory Module passes through epidemic disaster in epidemic disaster control module adjusting cabin；The input terminal of flow-control module and gas pipeline connection, for controlling the air flow condition in gas pipeline；Experimental channel connection in the output end and Laboratory Module of gas pipeline, under test gas flowmeter are set on experimental channel.The utility model simulates the epidemic disaster of site environment by Laboratory Module, air flow condition is simulated according to actual use situation, improve the use intensity of gas flowmeter, expose the potential failure of gas flowmeter ahead of time, it solves ahead of time, the reliability for helping to improve gas flowmeter eliminates product incipient fault before listing, prevents flowmeter the problem of sale can largely break down after a period of use.

title_en: Soil slope failure early warning system and method are monitored under a kind of condition of raining
abstract_en: The present invention, which provides, monitors soil slope failure early warning system and method under a kind of condition of raining, be related to construction project analog information technical field.The system include strain, strain gauge, soil pressure cell and built-in analog program computer.Strain, strain gauge and soil pressure cell are arranged in is determined easily unstable failure region and the real time monitoring acquisition soil pressure force value when rainfall duration reaching dangerous duration by Computer Simulation Software in advance.In monitoring process, in computer with the soil slope failure model established according to on-site test result under condition of raining, determine in system up to after dangerous rainfall duration, starting monitoring slight slope danger zone ess-strain value.The system is made of computer simulator analysis of slope safety coefficient and system monitoring slope soil ess-strain the value two parts that complement each other, and is predicted slope under rainfall unstability sliding surface, is played side slope early warning effect.The present invention plays the early warning landslide disaster under condition of raining, provides the guarantee of the security of the lives and property for the people.

title_en: A kind of dynamic alarming method based on secure threshold
abstract_en: The invention proposes a kind of dynamic alarming methods based on secure threshold.According to various physical environmental conditions and human body behavior, dynamic regulation is carried out to secure threshold, the risk behavior intelligent management of accident factors causing disaster is realized, people-machine environmental correclation factors causing disaster construction method, provides technical support for Failure Simulation, analysis, prevention and control in research accident.Avoid deficiency of the traditional means of experiment in terms of risk behavior analysis, provided service has intelligence, enhance the practical value of alarm, technical support is provided for safety hazard analysis, prevention, control, safety management level, reduction safety accident has important practical significance and social value to being promoted.

title_en: Multichannel debris flow impact state tracking simulation system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multichannel debris flow impact state tracking simulation system and an operation method. The multichannel debris flow impact state tracking simulation system and the operation method comprise the following steps: the intelligent power supply comprises a hemisphere, a spherical cover, a main board, a data interface and a charging interface, wherein the hemisphere is matched with the spherical cover, an annular clamping groove is formed in the bottom of the inner surface of the spherical cover, an annular clamping block is fixedly connected to the top of the inner surface of the hemisphere, the annular clamping block is matched with the annular clamping groove, the main board is adhered to the inside of the hemisphere through glue, and the data interface is arranged on one side of the top of the main board. According to the multichannel debris flow impact state tracking simulation system and the operation method, the real debris flow impact data are restored by using a particle simulation method, the motion trail and the motion state of particles in the slurry can be better obtained, and later-period prevention and control and disaster reduction on debris flow disasters are facilitated.

title_en: A kind of planktonic organism partial size spectrum detection method based on SVM
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of planktonic organism partial size spectrum detection method based on SVM, comprising: the image data set of planktonic organism is divided into training sample data collection and test sample data set；The training sample data collection is demarcated, true value image is obtained；Optical-flow Feature vector, gray feature vector and gradient orientation histogram characteristic vector that the training sample data concentrate image are extracted, is combined and normalized；The target value of treated characteristic vector and true value image input svm classifier model is trained, two disaggregated models are obtained；Image in test sample data set is predicted using trained two disaggregated model；The planktonic organism of different-grain diameter size is counted according to the bianry image after prediction segmentation；Generate planktonic organism Size.The invention simplifies the project amount of planktonic organism Size detection, the automatic detection of planktonic organism Size can in real time, be accurately carried out in seabed, to be effectively detected and forecast the disasters such as red tide.

title_en: Coal rock triaxial loading test device and method under condition of simulated tunneling disturbance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal rock triaxial loading test device and method under the condition of simulated tunneling disturbance, and belongs to the technical field of research on seepage damage and destruction characteristics of coal rocks. The invention provides a triaxial loading test device which can simulate the tunneling disturbance action more truly and can be used for visualizing the damage and damage process of a coal rock mass, and meanwhile, the device can be used for realizing the research on the influence of different water pressures, different loading modes and different disturbance actions on the damage and seepage characteristics of the coal rock mass. The method can realize the whole-process monitoring of coal-rock mass crack expansion and the real-time dynamic monitoring of stress change and seepage pressure change in the coal-rock mass under the action of tunneling disturbance, further quantitatively research the seepage damage destruction characteristic of the tunneling disturbance coal-rock mass, make scientific prediction on water inrush of a tunneling working face and reduce the occurrence of water inrush disasters of the tunneling working face.

title_en: Fire fighting training System and The method thereof
title_ko: 화재진압 학습시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a firefighting training system and a method therefor. According to embodiments of the present invention, the firefighting training system comprises a simulation device and a fire extinguisher for training. The fire extinguisher for training includes: a communication unit at a fire extinguisher side transmitting and receiving data to and from the simulation device; a nozzle; a nozzle movement detecting unit detecting a movement of the nozzle to output a displacement value; a handle; a handle detecting unit detecting a distance between an upper handle portion and a lower handle portion of the handle to output an injection signal; a vibration unit provided in the fire extinguisher for training; and a control unit activating the vibration unit when the injection signal is received. The simulation device includes: a display; a main body communication unit transmitting and receiving data to and from the fire extinguisher for training; one or more processors; a memory; and one or more programs stored in the memory and configured to be executed by the one or more processors. According to the present invention, a user is able to easily learn how to use the fire extinguisher and how to extinguish fires.
abstract_ko: 화재진압 학습시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따라 시뮬레이션 기기와 교육용 소화기를 포함하는 화재진압 학습시스템의 상기 교육용 소화기는 상기 시뮬레이션 기기와 데이터를 송수신하는 소화기측 통신부; 노즐; 상기 노즐의 움직임을 감지하여 변위값을 출력하는 노즐움직임 감지부; 손잡이; 상기 손잡이의 윗손잡이와 아랫손잡이의 간격을 감지하여 분사신호를 출력하는 손잡이 감지부; 상기 교육용 소화기 내부에 구비되는 진동부; 및 상기 분사신호를 수신하는 경우 상기 진동부를 활성화시키는 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 시뮬레이션 기기는 디스플레이; 상기 교육용 소화기와 데이터를 송수신하는 본체 통신부; 하나 이상의 프로세서들; 메모리; 및 상기 메모리에 저장되고 상기 하나 이상의 프로세스들에 의해 실행되도록 구성된 하나 이상의 프로그램들을 포함한다.

title_en: Bottom sediment transports in-situ testing device and its application method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of bottom sediments to transport in-situ testing device and its application method, is related to marine geologic disasters and sediment dynamics technical field, and transfer passages are equipped with the close passage that Open Side Down, and the lower ending opening of transfer passages is for being inserted into Seabed sediments；It makes stream device to be arranged on transfer passage, for forming seabed stably stratified flow in the close passage of transfer passages；The top of transfer passages is arranged in reinforcing rib bracket, laying and/or recycling and/or fixing for transfer passages.The invention has the advantages that constructing the annular transfer passages of closed state in situ, the complex environments such as extraneous surface wave is stopped to influence, there is huge advantage than indoor simulation sea bed；It may advantageously facilitate deposit transport process and its mechanism analysis, have important contribution to the dynamic (dynamical) theoretical developments of bottom sediment.

title_en: Data processing method and equipment
abstract_en: A data processing method and device relate to the communication field, and are used for ensuring that a user normally watches TV programs when an IPTV service platform fails, and the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that an RMS remote management system server synchronizes the live broadcast related information of an IPTV network television service platform to the RMS server; the RMS server simulates user terminal equipment to initiate a simulation service request to an IPTV service platform at intervals of a threshold value; when the simulation service request initiated by the RMS server to the IPTV service platform fails, the RMS server executes a first preset operation, so that the user terminal equipment sends the service request to the RMS server when sending the service request; and the RMS server transmits the live broadcast related information to the user terminal equipment after receiving the service request. The embodiment of the application is applied to disaster recovery of the IPTV service platform.

title_en: A kind of Longspan Bridge topology ambiguity three-dimensional rebuilding method based on computer vision
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Longspan Bridge topology ambiguity three-dimensional rebuilding method based on computer vision, belongs to Health Monitoring for Civil Engineering and field of preventing and reducing natural disasters.Automation this method solve the prior art in Longspan Bridge is failed based on 3-dimensional reconstruction, it is still necessary to the problem of artificial modeling and manual intervention.Three-dimensional reconstruction network of the present invention by establishing the CAD data collection of Longspan Bridge and based on computer vision and deep learning, the network can render the parametrization threedimensional model for learning Longspan Bridge in image and three-dimensional point cloud from multi-angle of view；Then the three-dimensional reconstruction network is trained using the data set of foundation, obtains trained model, uses multiple constraint loss function in training process；The image of bridge to be reconstructed and point cloud are finally input to the model of training inclination described in step 3, obtain parametrization three-dimensional reconstruction result.The present invention is suitable for Health Monitoring for Civil Engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters.

title_en: A method of improving forest fire appealing precision of prediction
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of method for improving forest fire appealing precision of prediction, solve the problems, such as that the precision of prior art forest fire appealing prediction is lower.Fire point position or range are monitored as primary condition using the first moment, are spread process with fire disaster simulation system simulated fire, are generated the second moment simulation fire point position or range；Monitoring fire point position and the second moment simulation fire point position generate sprawling regulated value；Fire point position or range are monitored as primary condition using the second moment, are spread process with fire disaster simulation system simulated fire, are weighted with the sprawling regulated value and generate third moment simulation fire point position or range.The fire data of Satellite Remote Sensing is combined with fire disaster simulation system, it is easier to show the whole sprawling an of forest fire, and it is more accurate, can in confine forest fires simulation process because of error propagation caused by fire disaster simulation model itself is assumed or use condition limits.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKE RUIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of temperature sensing and feed back control system, method and purposes of combination virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of temperature sensing of combination virtual reality and feed back control systems, method and purposes, belong to virtual reality device technical field, device includes: head-mounted display, for transmitting image and acoustic information to user, completes vision and sense of hearing interaction；Spatial locator for analyzing determining user the location of in virtual reality space, and adjusts temperature control modules by location information；Temperature control modules, to the temperature in virtual reality space where controlling user.It can be used for fire disaster escaping simulative training system, user is in virtual scene close to fire source, it will be by driven by program temperature control modules, temperature control modules control heating, and maintain firm power, keep constant user's sendible temperature, sendible temperature follows the relationship being inversely proportional with role in virtual scene and fire source distance.

title_en: A kind of fire scenario sunykatuib analysis device and method based on augmented reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire scenario sunykatuib analysis device and method based on augmented reality, belong to augmented reality equipment technical field, augmented reality scene of the invention is formed by following four layers of map overlay: the ambient video of binocular camera acquisition, noxious gas component after the burning of real-time fire scenario 3D model, combustible material is built into the analysis of SLAM algorithm, smog flows in fire；Entire augmented reality device major part function can be realized by smart phone, complete equipment is not needed to buy, user can be allowed to be put into less hardware cost, tool is drilled as a kind of fire disaster escaping, the ingredient of noxious material after augmented reality device of the invention can also show possible combustible in user's surrounding enviroment and burn, and in fire smog flow direction, have stronger moral.

title_en: A kind of Seismic Landslide Hazard quantitative evaluation method based on mechanical model
abstract_en: The Seismic Landslide Hazard quantitative evaluation method based on mechanical model that the invention discloses a kind of.The present invention can be used for the research of the potential complications landslide areas of near Faults, Landslide Hazard Assessment is carried out by the earthquake information of simulation, it determines landslide hazard area, to carry out disaster prevention in advance, and provides addressing foundation for building for house, road, railway etc.；Catastrophe Evaluation of Landslide on Reservoir after the present invention can also be used to shake well is analyzed, and is determined the high-risk region, middle danger area, low danger area on landslide etc., is fast and accurately carried out the disaster relief.

title_en: A kind of mine landslide-proofing ruggedized construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of mine landslide-proofing ruggedized constructions, including retaining wall, the fixation pricker being inserted into mine, the fixed drilling tool has more, fixed pricker is arranged perpendicular to slope surface and/or ground, fixed pricker includes drilling rod and the branch bluff piece and supporting element that are arranged in inside drilling rod, wherein the drilling rod circumference is equipped with the first through hole, branch bluff piece is symmetrically arranged with four, hollow reinforcing pipe nail is provided on the outside of every branch bluff piece, the position of the hollow reinforcing pipe nail is correspondingly arranged with the first through hole, supporting element cross section is cross-shaped structure, support surface has third through hole；The retaining wall is arranged at slope foot, and the connection slope surface of retaining wall and ground are arranged, and massif part, fill concrete inside the fixed pricker are exposed in retaining wall package drilling rod upper end.Landslide-proofing ruggedized construction in mine described in the utility model has firm massif, the geological disasters such as plays the role of pre- landslide-proofing, mud-rock flow, collapses.

title_en: A kind of improved Typhoon Wind Field empirical model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of improved Typhoon Wind Field empirical models, comprising the following steps: is primarily based on typhoon gradient equilibrium equation and obtains gradient wind field；Then the boundary layer model that Arya is proposed is introduced, and it is iteratively solved in two-dimensional grid domain；Finally the complicated result that boundary layer is found out is fitted, has obtained a series of simple analytic expression, can relatively rapid simulate typhoon from the Typhoon Wind Field that any time into extinction whole process occurs.The present invention directly obtains wind field near the ground due to that can be based on typhoon gradient wind field, avoids a large amount of numerical value and calculates, therefore simulation precision improves a lot than planetary boundary layer numerical model.In conclusion the present invention has the characteristics that easy to use, precision is higher and simulation precision is very high, it can be used for typhoon risk analysis and disaster management.

title_en: Real-time flood disaster visualization simulation method based on OpenGL
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time flood disaster visualization simulation method based on OpenGL, which is a multiphase fluid interaction simulation method combining a fluid simulation method based on texture change and a fluid simulation method based on a two-dimensional height field, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly, utilizing the double-buffer technology of OpenGL to realize the evolution of a flood water surface and the rolling effect of a cloud layer in the sky; then, solving particles in all models by using a fluid dynamics equation, and establishing a random process for generating rain and snow particles and controlling irregular movement of the particles; and finally, generating a three-dimensional simulation terrain by using the gray map file, and creating a terrain scene based on the real data. The invention carries out real-time visual simulation based on real terrain data on flood disasters and improves the sense of reality of simulation effect.

title_en: A kind of coastal cities multi-source flood method for numerical simulation based on GIS grid operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of coastal cities multi-source flood method for numerical simulation based on GIS grid operation, this method are equipped with parameter setting module, surface data input module, hydrology multi-boundary Condition input module, the instant analog module of flood numerical value and visualization output module.The setting simulation basic parameter in parameter setting module；It includes terrain data, land type, soil types and pipe network data that the substantially geographical information of survey region is inputted in surface data input module；It includes waterlogging, three kinds of flood and waterlog kinds of seashore storm tide and river flood that multi-source flood sequential file is inputted in hydrology multi-boundary Condition input module；It visualizes output module and output file format classification is set；The starting operation instant analog module of flood numerical value, by instant playback multi-source flood numerical simulation result.The present invention is based on GIS grid operation, disaster scene that simulation and forecast coastal cities multi-source flood is met and discussed.

title_en: Northwest Pacific three-dimensional oil spilling business contingency forecast and assessment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses northwest Pacific three-dimensional oil spilling business contingency forecast and assessment system, system includes that oil spilling information fast processing module, environmental information processing module, oil spilling transport module, oil overflow air slaking module, data assimilation module, DATA PROCESSING IN ENSEMBLE PREDICTION SYSTEM module, geographic information data module, visual analyzing module and System Control Center module；The present invention can be realized the Comparison study for considering the three-dimensional short-term and medium-term and long-term numerical Simulation Prediction of the northwest Pacific sea area deep-sea oil spilling under wave effect and different vertical diffusion schemes；Pre-treatment can be carried out to a variety of oil sources information and oil spilling type and carry out prediction；Forcing field outside oil spilling model can be optimized using site observation date and best interpolation assimilation method in real time, to improve forecast accuracy；It can provide DATA PROCESSING IN ENSEMBLE PREDICTION SYSTEM result；Scientific research and the design of administrative department's contingency response system etc. are prevented and reduced natural disasters with important practical value to marine ecology.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and early warning mine water damage and simulating disaster spreading
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring and early warning mine water damage and simulating disaster spreading. The method is characterized in that based on the characteristics of water damage of a mine which has occurred historically, the water outlet information of 5 areas including a head, a top plate, a bottom plate and two sides of an underground roadway is monitored in real time by connecting the existing mine monitoring camera, and whether the condition of water inrush symptom is generated underground or not is judged in real time; once water inrush symptoms or even water damage occur in the underground, relevant information (such as positions, water inrush amount and the like) of water inrush points can be rapidly identified and timely extracted, the water damage occurrence process can be reproduced in real time through a three-dimensional informatization means, a three-dimensional simulation technology is adopted to deduce the mine water spreading process and the submergence range, the mine water current situation and the personnel and equipment distribution situation are analyzed in a three-dimensional roadway scene, and therefore technical support is provided for planning of personnel escape routes and emergency command and rescue.

title_en: A kind of geological prospecting sampling apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of geological prospecting sampling apparatuses, the geological prospecting sampling apparatus includes: panel (2), fixed frame (1), hydraulic cylinder (3), telescopic rod (4), motor (5), connecting shaft (6) and drill bit (7), the fixed frame (1) is connected to the both ends of the panel (2), the hydraulic cylinder (3) is arranged on the panel (2), the telescopic rod (4) is connected to the lower end of the hydraulic cylinder (3) and through the panel (2), the motor (5) is connected to the lower end of the telescopic rod (4), the connecting shaft (6) is connected to the lower end of the motor (5), the drill bit (7) is connected to the lower end of the connecting shaft (6)；The utility model structure is simple; it is low in cost; automatic degree is high, and the ore that can easily remove acquisition is beaten without wooden mallet, device had not only been protected but also had saved cost; the apparatus structure is secured; stable connection is easy to repair and replacement, use value is very high; a large amount of manpower, material resources and financial resources can be saved, solve the problems, such as to always exist in industry takes mine disaster.

title_en: Method for rapidly measuring effective influence radius of drill hole
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly determining effective influence radius of a drilled hole, which comprises the steps of constructing an emission hole and a detection drilled hole in a coal seam, then respectively arranging an emission source and a detector in the holes, detecting the change rule of the gas pressure of the coal seam at different extraction time by using an accurate CT detection technology, and determining the effective extraction radius of the drilled hole after extracting for a certain time according to the change of the gas pressure of the coal seam, thereby having important significance for reasonably arranging the drilled hole, improving the extraction efficiency, reducing coal and gas outburst disasters and the like; the method is simple, strong in operability, high in measurement speed, good in effect and wide in practicability in the field.

title_en: Attack prediction method, device and system based on QBD attack and defense random evolution game model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of network security, and particularly relates to an attack prediction method, device and system based on a QBD attack and defense random evolution game model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: abstracting an attack and defense evolution process into a simulated life and death process QBD, introducing a learning degree and a noise factor to depict a dynamic evolution track of strategy learning adjustment of attack and defense participants under random disturbance, and constructing a QBD attack and defense random evolution game model; establishing a balance equation of the simulated firefighting, attacking and defending and confrontation process according to the QBD attacking and defending random evolution game model; solving a balance equation to obtain strategy balance probability distribution of the process of simulating living, fighting and defense; and balancing probability distribution according to the strategy to obtain the most threatening attack strategy. The method is closer to the actual attack and defense confrontation scene, takes the random disturbance influence in the attack and defense evolution process into consideration, provides a game model for simulating the attack and defense random evolution, enhances the attack behavior prediction capability, improves the attack prediction accuracy and the model effectiveness, and has important guiding significance for the development of network security technology.

title_en: A kind of safety experience educational system and its method based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of, and the safety based on virtual reality technology experiences educational system, system includes experience apparatus, operating terminal and processing server, the experience apparatus includes VR Helmet Mounted Display, hand motion sensor, foot action sensor and motion capture video camera, and motion capture video camera is used to send position capture laser and shoot the movement of experimenter；Operating terminal is used for user input selection order, the present invention can provide the preferably virtual Fire Mode of experience effect, seismic model and riot mode based on virtual reality for student, and the correct escape step of student can be reminded according to the movement of student and location information in experience of the process, to improve students experience effect and awareness of safety, to improve the reply consciousness of student's the condition of a disaster.
assignees: ANHUI WANXIN YANXUE EDUCATION CO LTD

title_en: The installation method of deep water surface conductor pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of installation methods of deep water surface conductor pipe, comprising the following steps: surface conductor pipe S1, is transported to marine scene by barge；S2, the surface conductor pipe is launched into water and makes it vertically on the mud face of seabed, the surface conductor pipe sinks to being located on the mud face of seabed by its bottom；S3, pile hammer is sent into water by crane, is socketed in the top of the surface conductor pipe；S4, the starting pile hammer hammer the surface conductor pipe in the mud of seabed to reaching preset driving depth.The installation method of deep water surface conductor pipe of the invention, the installation of deep water hydrocarbon field drilling well surface conductor pipe is realized using method is hammered under water, is effectively reduced geological disaster such as shallow-layer stream, shallow gas that construction risk, especially conventional method can not overcome；Compared to conventional method, hammering method under water is the smallest to the soil disturbance of offset well, and without the concern for deep water surface conductor pipe well cementation problem；Installation accuracy is higher and is easier to control.
assignees: CNOOC DEEPWATER DEV LTD;CNOOC ENERGY TECH & SERV LTD

title_en: Comprehensive pipe rack gas pipeline leakage diffusion simulation experiment table under ventilation state
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a comprehensive pipe gallery gas pipeline leakage diffusion simulation experiment table in a ventilation state, which comprises a pipe gallery model pipe, wherein a gas pipeline is arranged in the pipe gallery model pipe, a plurality of leakage points are arranged on the gas pipeline, and the gas pipeline is communicated with a gas supply structure; the top of the pipe gallery model pipe is communicated with a ventilation structure capable of adjusting ventilation working conditions and ventilation times; a plurality of gas sampling devices capable of collecting gas in the pipe gallery model pipe are arranged on the side wall of the pipe gallery model pipe at intervals; the gas sampling device and the gas supply structure are electrically connected with a control part. The utility model can simulate the leakage condition of the gas pipeline in the comprehensive pipe rack under different ventilation times, can automatically sample the leaked gas through the gas sampling device, provides reliable parameters for the leakage diffusion and emergency response fields of the gas pipeline in the comprehensive pipe rack under the ventilation state, effectively improves the operation and maintenance efficiency of the comprehensive pipe rack, and reduces the safety accident rate of the comprehensive pipe rack.

title_en: A kind of Bath Heat-Transfer simulated behavior material, preparation method and applications
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Bath Heat-Transfer simulated behavior materials, it is a kind of three layers of Bath Heat-Transfer simulated behavior material, with the light metal layers in three layers of molten bath in reactor lower head in metal Na simulation major accident, eutectics fused salt LiCl/KCl simulates oxide skin(coating), and metal Sn simulates heavy metal layer.Simulation material of the invention have the characteristics that simple process, be easily achieved, performance is stable and cost is relatively low.Since physical property difference can form natural layering between each component, molten bath top and bottom metal layers in actual response heap are simulated using metal material, the characteristic close of material, the uncertainty that can effectively reduce experimental result, the problem of can be used for reactor disaster mechanism and mitigation strategy experimental study.

title_en: Disaster weather early warning method and automobile AR-HUD system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of automotive electronics, and discloses a disaster weather early warning method and an automobile AR-HUD system. The disaster weather early warning method is applied to an automobile AR-HUD system and comprises the following steps: acquiring a video image in front of an automobile; processing the video image, and extracting the image weather characteristics of the processed video image; inputting the image weather characteristics into a weather type prediction model, and identifying the weather type of the current environment of the automobile, wherein the weather type prediction model is obtained based on deep belief network training; and when the weather type is a disaster weather type, outputting early warning information through the automobile AR-HUD system. The embodiment of the invention improves the safety of automobile driving and reduces the risk of traffic accidents caused by disaster weather.

title_en: Device for firefighting practice
abstract_en: The subject matter of the invention is a device for firefighting practice comprising a hand-held extinguishing device with a nozzle and with a triggering mechanism, further comprising a computer for running a simulation program and an image reproduction unit, wherein a sensing unit with which a change in position, a change in orientation and the speed of movement of the nozzle can be sensed is arranged on the nozzle, and wherein the triggering mechanism has a sensor with which the triggering of the triggering mechanism can be sensed, and wherein the data relating to the movements and the instances of triggering activation, which are acquired by the sensing system and the sensor, can be transmitted to the computer, can be processed by the simulation program which is run on the computer and can be displayed on the image reproduction unit.

title_en: Firefighting simulation experience device
abstract_en: To provide a fire fighting simulation experience device that enables a user to have a simulation experience of a reaction to a fire hose nozzle received during water discharge of a fire hose, and enables the fire hose to be restored to its original length automatically after the simulation experience.SOLUTION: A firefighting simulation experience device includes a hose 2 having bending-resistant rigidity while holding a cross sectional round shape; a nozzle 3 connected to a one end of the hose 2; a flow rate switching mechanism provided to the nozzle 3 for switching water discharge flow rates in a pseudo manner; a pseudo flow rate detector for detecting a switching position of the flow rate switching mechanism; a pneumatic cylinder 6 for applying tensile force in a direction away from an original position X at the other end of the hose; an elastic member 7 for elastically energizing the other end 2a of the hose 2 in a direction to return it to the original position X; and a pneumatic circuit for controlling working air pressure of the pneumatic cylinder 6 to predetermined air pressure corresponding to the switching position of the flow rate switching mechanism according to a detection signal of the pseudo flow rate detector.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Efficient change block training
abstract_en: Snapshot data (e.g., changed blocks) resulting from operation of applications is captured in two forms: (1) in a bitmap that indicates if one or more blocks in a range of blocks has changed, and (2) as the changed block data itself. The changed blocks are sent to a remote disaster recovery location only once per snapshot period. Even through a particular block might have been changed many times during a snapshot period, only the last version of the changed block is sent to the remote disaster recovery location. The fact that a block has been changed can be parsimoniously managed by determining an address space for the source data, dividing the address space into a plurality of ranges, and indicating which blocks if any in a particular range have been changed. Such modification indicators are sent to the disaster recovery location only once per snapshot period.

title_en: Multi-operation load induced ground subsidence prevention and control device for karst cave marsh gas stratum
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ground subsidence prevention and control induced by operation load, and provides a multiple operation load induced ground subsidence prevention and control device for karst cave marsh gas stratum. The method and the device can simulate ground subsidence caused by multiple ground and underground operation loads in high-density areas of cities under different operation conditions, and acquire accurate ground subsidence data so as to effectively prevent and control ground subsidence disasters; the method can simulate the influence of the high-pressure methane stratum containing karst cave on the ground settlement in the subway operation area of the urban high-density area, and can obtain the distribution rule of the high-pressure methane stratum containing karst cave on the ground settlement, so that the risk of subway construction of the high-pressure methane stratum containing karst cave is reduced, and the construction cost is reduced; according to the method and the system, ground subsidence data caused by subway operation in urban high-density areas under different rainfall conditions can be obtained, so that various risks caused by urban subway construction in flood prevention period are reduced, the construction period is saved, and the safety of subway construction is ensured.

title_en: fire drill management system
title_ko: 소방 훈련 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire drill management system capable of generating various fire situations. According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a fire drill management system comprising: a fire drill model providing a fire drill environment to a fire drill participant; a fire drill control unit providing various situations for a fire drill to the fire drill model; and an information display unit displaying information needed for the fire drill to the fire drill participant.

title_en: rescue route and time simulation apparatus using reinforcement learing
title_ko: 강화학습을 통한 재난 구조물의 구조경로 및 구조시간 시뮬레이션 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus of simulating a rescue route and a rescue time of a disaster-occurred structure using reinforcement learning, and more specifically, to an apparatus of simulating a rescue route and a rescue time of a disaster-occurred structure using reinforcement learning, which is configured to perform route search based on a behavior compensation value and an integration compensation value calculated in each search node. To this end, the apparatus of simulating a rescue route and a rescue time of a disaster-occurred structure using reinforcement learning comprises: an environment setting unit of extracting an outer wall of a structure based on a plan view of the structure, and setting an attribute for an agent, an entrance and the structure, respectively, with respect to a disaster which may occur on the agent, the entrance and the structure; a node unit of generating and arranging unit nodes based on the outer wall of a structure and setting an attribute value for each node; a reinforcement learning unit of predicting and determining, when a rescue route is searched based on the unit nodes, a behavior direction of the agent to a neighboring node, and determining whether to perform a search for the rescue route; and a simulation unit of setting a disaster scenario of the structure according to the search for the rescue route, controlling the rescue route to be simulated according to the disaster scenario, and calculating a rescue time according to the rescue route. According to the present invention, it is possible to accurately calculate a rescue route and a rescue time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 강화학습을 통한 재난 구조물의 구조경로 및 구조시간 시뮬레이션 장치에 관한 것으로서, 각 탐색노드에서 산출되는 행동 보상값 및 적산 보상값을 기초로 경로 탐색을 수행하는 강화학습을 통한 재난 구조물의 구조경로 및 구조시간 시뮬레이션 장치에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해 구조물의 평면도를 기초로 구조물의 외곽을 추출하며, 에이전트, 출입구, 구조물에 발생할 수 있는 재난에 대한 각각의 속성을 설정하는 환경 설정부, 구조물의 외곽을 기초로 단위 노드를 생성 및 배치하고, 각 노드에 속성값을 설정하는 노드부, 단위 노드를 기초로 구조경로 탐색시에 인접 노드로의 에이전트의 행동방향을 예측 결정하고, 구조경로의 탐색 진행 여부를 결정하는 강화학습부, 및 구조경로의 탐색에 따른 구조물의 재난 시나리오를 설정하고, 재난 시나리오에 따라 구조경로를 시뮬레이션하도록 제어하며, 구조경로에 따른 구조시간을 산출하는 시뮬레이션부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 강화학습을 통한 재난 구조물의 구조경로 및 구조시간 시뮬레이션 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: The Cutting Robot for the Self Drilling Tunnel
title_ko: 자주 굴착형 절단 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote control robot which uses a robot to cut the ground of a collapsed area by a disaster, an expired structure (S) of a nuclear power plant or an industrial large structure, and cuts the interior of the structure as a mole digs a cave and roams in the ground to move forward in an arbitrary direction while making a tunnel (E). The cutting robot with for dismantling a nuclear power plant comprises: a front body (40) having a plurality of front legs (60) connected to the exterior of a casing; a cutting driving member (80) coupled to a front end of the front body; a forward driving member (70) connected to a rear end of the front body; a rear body (30) connected to the other end of the forward driving member, and provided with a plurality of rear legs (50) connected to the exterior of the casing; and a height adjustment unit (10) to rotate around a folding unit (20) and one end of the rear body. Accordingly, a robot body is divided into a front and a rear for a plurality of legs expandable to an arbitrary length to move in a tunnel of an arbitrary shape and move a cutting torch along a prescribed track, and a means capable of adjusting the length of the bodies is arranged between the two bodies to apply properties of multi-joint insects to a machine.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 로봇을 이용하여 재해로 인한 붕괴지역 지반이나 원자력 발전소의 사용이 완료된 구조물(S) 또는 산업용 대형 구조물을 절단하되 구조물 내부를 두더지가 땅 속에서 굴을 파면서 돌아다니듯이 구조물 내부를 절단하여 터널(E)을 만들면서 임의의 방향으로 전진하는 원격제어 로봇에 관한 기술이다.  
이에 본 발명은 다수의 전면 발(60)이 케이싱의 외부로 연결된 전면 몸체(40), 상기 전면 몸체의 전단에 체결된 절단 구동부재(80), 상기 전면 몸체의 후단에 연결된 전진 구동 부재(70), 상기 전진 구동 부재의 타단에 연결되고, 다수의 후면 발(50)이 케이싱 외부로 연결된 후면 몸체(30), 상기 후면 몸체의 일단과 접이부(20)를 중심으로 회전할 수 있는 높이 조절부(10)를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 하는 원자력 발전소 해체용 절단 로봇에 관한 것이다.  
이를 통하여 임의의 형태의 터널 속에서도 이동 가능하면서 절단 토치(Torch)는 일정한 궤도를 따라 움직일 수 있도록 하기 위하여 임의의 길이로 팽창이 가능한 다수의 발을 로봇 몸체를 전후로 나누어 두 개의 몸체 사이에 몸체의 길이를 조절할 수 있는 수단을 구비하여 다관절 곤충이 이동하는 특성을 기계에 적용하도록 한다.

title_en: A shelter for guiding purposes only of civil defense signs
title_ko: 민방위 대피소 안내용 표시대
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a signboard for guiding a shelter for civil defense and, more specifically, to a signboard for guiding a shelter for civil defense, which is installed near the shelter for civil defense, includes an LED installed therein to be turned on by photovoltaic generation to highlight location thereof, guides the location of the shelter by letters and pictures printed on a front plate and broadcasting from a speaker, and broadcasts a civil defense training situation through the speaker. According to the present invention, the signboard for guiding a shelter for civil defense comprises: a casing unit (10) having pictures (11a) and letters (11b) for indicating a shelter printed on the front plate (11), and having an inclined surface formed on an upper surface; a solar cell (12) mounted on the upper inclined surface of the casing unit (10); a charging battery (13) storing photovoltaic power supplied from the solar cell (12); a switch (14) turning on/off power of the charging battery (13); a sound/light output unit (15) formed with the speaker (15a) and the LED (15b) to output sound and light; a wireless communication unit (16) transmitting/receiving information such as a signal, a code, an image, a sound and the like with an external server through electric waves; and a control unit (17) controlling each part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 민방위 대피소 안내용 표시대에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 민방위 대피소 인근에 설치되는 표시대에는 태양광 발전으로 점등되는 LED가 설치되어 민방위 표시대의 위치를 부각시키는 한편, 전면판에 인쇄된 문자, 그림 및 스피커의 방송에 의하여 대피소의 위치를 안내하고, 스피커를 통해 민방위 훈련상황에 따른 방송을 할 수 있도록 한 발명에 관한 것이다. 
전술한 본 발명의 특징은,  전면판(11)에 대피소 표시용 그림(11a) 및 문자(11b)가 인쇄되고, 상면에는 경사면이 형성된 케이싱부(10);  상기 케이싱부(10)의 상부 경사면에 장착되는 솔라 셀(12);  상기 솔라 셀(12)에서 공급되는 태양열 전원을 저장하는 충전용 배터리(13);   상기 충전용 배터리(13)의 전원을 온(on) 오프(off)시키는 스위치(14);  스피커(15a) 및 LED(15b)로 구성되어 음성을 출력하고, 빛을 발산하는 음성 및 빛 출력부(15);  전파를 통해 외부의 서버와 신호·부호·영상·음성 등의 정보를 교신하는 무선통신부(16) 및 상기 각부들을 제어하는 제어부(17)로 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 민방위 대피소 안내용 표시대에 의하여 달성될 수 있는 것이다.

title_en: Adjustable multifunctional debris flow riverway accumulation disaster range test equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides adjustable multifunctional debris flow river channel accumulation disaster-causing range test equipment which comprises a river channel model device with adjustable width and gradient, a debris flow channel model device, a rainfall simulation device and a water flow velocity control system, wherein the debris flow channel model device is positioned on the right side of the river channel model device, the gradient of a channel is adjustable, the rainfall simulation device comprises a shower nozzle, a water pipe and a first water flow controller which are arranged opposite to the debris flow channel model device, and the rainfall amount can be adjusted; the water flow velocity control system is used for controlling the water flow velocity in the river channel model device. The technical scheme provided by the invention has the beneficial effects that: the comprehensive research of various influence factors related to debris flow river channel accumulation and disaster range is solved, and meanwhile, a plurality of influence factors such as landslide water inflow speed, debris flow water inflow angle, river channel water flow speed, river channel width, river channel two-bank gradient and the like are considered.

title_en: Smoke particle multi-point analysis of test system and its test method for fire disaster simulation

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of amount moving emergency sewage device for treating leachate with high salt, it include: filter centrifugal, reservoir, separator, exchanger, adjustment pond, high-pressure pump, ultrafiltration system, original water inlet is provided on the filter centrifugal, outlet of sewer and water outlet, the filter centrifugal side is provided with reservoir, the side of the reservoir is provided with separator and exchanger, the exchanger side is provided with adjustment pond, the side in the adjustment pond is provided with high-pressure pump, the high-pressure pump side is provided with ultrafiltration system, the combination of each equipment is provided, a small-sized purifying water process factory is effectively simulated, so that the disaster area on some outlying ground or generation natural calamity, the area that water quality is contaminated can also provide the utility model and carry out sewage purification, play the role of emergency, just It is prompt, efficient.

title_en: Virtual fire training simulator
title_ko: 가상 소방훈련 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: A virtual fire training simulator according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises a diffuser (12), a treadmill (20) and special glasses (30). In the virtual fire training simulator, a tester walks or runs on the tread mill but actually stays in a specific area, recognizes a fire in the virtual reality, and extinguishes the fire by finding a fire extinguisher and moving to the fire place. When a fire breaks out in the virtual reality, the virtual fire training simulator provides air including a chilly wind, a warm wind, a sever wind and a smell of burning through the diffuser (12) so the tester realistically feels fire situations with the olfactory sense and goes through fire training.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시한 예에 따른 가상 소방훈련 시뮬레이터는, 디퓨저(12)와 트레드밀(20)과 특수 안경(30)을 포함하여 구성하고, 체험자가 트레이밀(20)에 올라서서 걷고 뛰는 등의 이동을 해동하지만 실제로 특정한 영역 내에 머무르도록 하고, 가상현실 속에서 화재를 인지하고, 소화기를 찾아 화재 장소로 이동하여 화재를 진압하며, 가상현실 속에서 화재가 발생하였을 때에 상기 디퓨저(12)를 통하여 냉풍, 온풍, 열풍, 화재 냄새가 포함된 공기 등을 제공함으로써, 체험자는 체감으로 그리고 후각으로 현실감 있게 화재 상황을 느끼며 소방 훈련에 임할 수 있다.

title_en: Tsunami experience-providing museum
abstract_en: [Problem] It is found extremely beneficial to experience a mild form of simulated tsunami in order to help participants learn the terror of tsunami and obtain prior knowledge on how to respond when being hit by a tsunami. However, such endeavors might carry large risks as some people may undergo psychological or physical trauma or may find even a mild form of tsunami simulation unbearable, leading to falling, a bone fracture, or even death from drowning. So, there has been a need to provide simulated tsunami experience in a harmless environment that protects participants from conceivable risks and dangers. [Solution] If simulated tsunami experience even in a mild form, is to be provided to participants in order to learn about potential difficulties involved in evacuation, a large-scale apparatus is required and a large risk is incurred. Thus, in order to avoid the risks of psychological or physical trauma, falling, a bone fracture, and the like, the present invention provides devices for safely providing a simulated experience. In particular, when it comes to psychological trauma, a decision is initially made as to what experience is to be provided (whether the learning involves simulated tsunami experience using an actual model or is limited to learning using videos or still photographs) after a participant has received a checkup by a physician or a person having knowledge equivalent to that of a physician, and on the basis of that decision, the experience is provided appropriately. In addition, the safety of participants is ensured by the use of two or more layers of safety barriers. Moreover, auxiliary equipment such as a harnesses to be provided from the upper part of a facility will also be made available for evacuation purposes.
