title_en: A kind of source item release inverting and DIFFUSION PREDICTION method based on integrated model of atmospheric diffusion
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of source item release inverting and DIFFUSION PREDICTION method based on integrated model of atmospheric diffusion, comprising steps of step 1, integrated by tri- kinds of model of atmospheric diffusion of CFD, Aermod and Calpuff, the simulation for different scale is calculated；Step 2, the concept based on Plume Emergency Planning Zone, for nuclear power plant, region, near region, i.e. inner region 5km, outskirt 10km are individually modeled using tri- kinds of model of atmospheric diffusion of CFD, Aermod and Calpuff in advance；Step 3 calculates various typical wind fields, under various accident source terms and its release rule and various accident scenarios, and the concentration changing rule for monitoring or simulating at feature locations saves in the database simultaneously；Step 4, when escape of radioactivity accident occurs, according to the concentration changing rule at feature locations, automatic inversion goes out releasing position and accident pattern, and it is based on real-time weather forecast information, dispersal direction, range and the severity for quickly calculating the following pollution assist policymaker to orient publication early warning in advance, and formulate emergency response scheme.

title_en: A kind of quick emergence control method in landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of quick emergence control methods in landslide, belong to landslide control technical field, specific steps are as follows: and it is rapid by Landslide Forecast System or artificial observation discovery mountain deformation first, there is the potential risk for being further development of landslide；It sends special war team to the mountain top portion on hillside opposite, emits novel earth-drilling bomb towards unstable slopes, carry cable wire and Grouting Pipe after bullet；By Grouting Pipe, earth-drilling bomb enters the hole formed after slopes, the enlarged footing that the small-scale explosion of bullet is formed, to hole and enlarged footing injection swelling agent and accelerator, quickly solidification forms anchoring body, anchor pole is formed in conjunction with cable wire, to be finally reached the effect of reinforcing side slope.The present invention speedily carry out rescue work improvement project cost it is low, harnessing project implementation process it is easy to operate rapidly, governance process is not related to earthwork evacuation engineering, can quickly generate consolidation effect.

title_en: High-spatial-resolution automatic prediction method and system for refined atmospheric horizontal visibility
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-spatial-resolution automatic forecasting method and system for fine atmospheric horizontal visibility. Comprehensively analyzing and processing atmospheric numerical mode data and observation data of an automatic meteorological station, and establishing a large data set according to the principle of minimum spatial horizontal distance; inputting a data set into a deep neural network framework, obtaining a nonlinear relation between a forecasting factor and a label after passing through a plurality of hidden layers, continuously adjusting weight through feedback learning of a deep neural network neuron, and training a visibility model capable of distinguishing the overall characteristics of the forecasting factor; and then, the visibility refined forecast with high spatial resolution is obtained by matching with an interpolation method, so that the problems of poor visibility forecast accuracy, low spatial resolution and low automation degree in the prior art are effectively solved, and reliable early warning is provided for local low visibility disasters occurring at sea, inland and ports, and the method is expected to become a powerful tool for forecasting visibility in meteorological stations.

title_en: A kind of earthquake disaster appraisal procedure based on virtual emulation
abstract_en: The earthquake disaster appraisal procedure based on virtual emulation that the invention discloses a kind of is by dummy emulation system, by the building sample for collecting more structural parameters from different places, the simplification of building sample is abstracted as fabric structure schematic diagram, establish the earthquake damage matrix of building sample database, and it carries out curve fitting to the relationship between earthquake intensity and mean damage index, obtain the earthquake intensity of the building sample of different structure form and the relationship of Earthquake hazard index, by every structural parameters to building sample and different earthquake earthquake intensity into row stochastic combination collocation, finally destruction situation of the building sample under Different structural parameters and different earthquake earthquake intensity is simulated in dummy emulation system.A kind of earthquake disaster appraisal procedure based on virtual emulation of the invention, can the destruction situation of building to Different structural parameters under different earthquake earthquake intensity carry out virtual emulation, so that people be allowed to understand earthquake to the anti-seismic performance of the destructive process of building and the building of different configuration.

title_en: A kind of appraisal procedure of the power system component different degree based on restoring force
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power system component different degree appraisal procedures based on restoring force: 1) determining the property of the type and generation of disaster；2) fallible component type and relevant probability of malfunction under disaster are obtained；3) the fault configuration situation of element in system after disaster occurs is obtained using non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation；4) optimal recovery policy model after calamity is established, proposes objective function and constraint condition；5) recovery process after calamity repeatedly simulate and obtain each element reparation moment and be ranked up using the ranking method of Aaron Copland, to obtain component importance sequence.Electric system can be sought in all kinds of natural calamities and the component importance under man-made disaster using the method for the invention, finding process has taken into account Disasters Type and feature.It can provide to refer to for the determination of element Scheme of Strengthening before the formulation and calamity of recovery policy after calamity using the component importance result that this method obtains and build.

title_en: Concrete heat strain detection testing device in a kind of high temperature of fire

title_en: Consider extreme meteorological dynamic power distribution network scope of power outage prediction technique and system

title_en: A kind of appraisal procedure for tunnel fire hazard water curtain gear cigarette heat insulation

title_en: Simulation method for ground settlement induced by multiple operation loads of karst cave methane stratum
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of prevention and control of ground settlement induced by operation load, and provides a simulation method for ground settlement induced by multiple operation loads of a karst cave methane stratum. The method and the device can simultaneously simulate the ground settlement of multiple ground and underground operation loads in the urban high-concentration area under different operation conditions, and acquire accurate ground settlement data so as to effectively prevent and control the ground settlement disasters; the method can simulate the influence of the high-pressure methane stratum containing the karst caves in the subway operation area of the urban high-concentration area on ground settlement, and can obtain the distribution rule of the high-pressure methane stratum containing the karst caves on the ground settlement so as to reduce the risk of carrying out subway construction on the high-pressure methane stratum containing the karst caves and reduce the construction cost; according to the method and the device, the ground settlement data caused by subway operation in the urban high-density area under the condition of different rainfall amounts can be obtained, so that various risks caused by urban subway construction in the flood prevention period are reduced, the construction period is saved, and the safety of subway construction is ensured.

title_en: Evacuation path optimization method based on dust explosion domino disaster-causing risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evacuation path optimization method based on domino disaster causing risks of dust explosion, which belongs to the technical field of path optimization and is characterized in that FreeFta software is utilized to construct an accident tree of dust explosion of a dangerous source, on the basis of obtaining five conditional probabilities of pentagon dust explosion, the FreeFta software is utilized to calculate the possibility F of dust explosion of the dangerous source, then DESC software is utilized to simulate the disaster causing consequence of dust explosion under domino effect, the result of dust explosion disaster causing under domino effect, namely overpressure distribution, is obtained, a Probit model is utilized to calculate the severity S of the result after dust explosion, finally, a quantitative risk value is obtained by utilizing a risk model, and a path with smaller risk is selected by comparing the magnitude of the risk to achieve the purpose of evacuation path optimization. The method reduces the risk of secondary dust explosion injury of the escape crowd, and effectively fills the blank of evacuation path optimization under continuous disaster in dust explosion.

title_en: A kind of wisdom classroom of training of students fire disaster escaping ability
abstract_en: This application discloses the wisdom classrooms of training of students fire disaster escaping ability, comprising: teaching region；Training region；The trained region includes: open fire analogue unit, smoke simulation unit and alarm unit, and the teaching region is equipped with the control switch for switching the open fire analogue unit, smoke simulation unit and the alarm unit.The application is provided with the simulation flame being made of multiple downlights by open fire analogue unit and multiple blowing devices simulate heat wave, and pass through smog pipeline and blower simulation smoke in smoke simulation unit, it is comprehensive simulate fire there is a situation where, and the wisdom classroom of the utility model training of students fire disaster escaping ability is further provided with the teaching region for teaching course, it is combined theoretical with practical, how simulation escapes under closed scene, ensure that student can be with profound understanding, the associative skills of fire disaster escaping ability are grasped comprehensively, analogue simulation allows student being capable of real experiences, has better teaching efficiency.
assignees: SHUIDI SMART TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Disaster drill system and control method for disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To appropriately reproduce an event which may actually occur in a drill.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention drill system 30 includes: a plurality of disaster prevention systems 36 that execute prescribed different processes in an emergency of a plant; and a simulator 34 which calculates simulation plant data simulating the behavior of the plant through a simulation. The plurality of disaster prevention systems 36 can switch between a disaster prevention mode in which they acquire the plant data indicating the behavior of the plant in an emergency of the plant and execute the prescribed processes via an operation of an operator and a drill mode in which they acquire the simulation plant data from the simulator 34 in a drill for responding to the emergency of the plant and execute the prescribed processes via an operation of the operator. The simulator 34 updates the simulation plant data on the basis of the prescribed process of each disaster prevention system 36 in the drill mode, and outputs the updated simulation plant data to the plurality of disaster prevention systems 36.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Method for simultaneous modeling and complexity reduction of bio-crudes for process simulation
title_ko: 공정 모사를 위한 바이오 원유의 동시 모델링 및 복잡성 감소방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for complexity reduction of bio-crudes comprising the following steps: (a) obtaining quantitative and qualitative analysis experimental data for bio-crudes; (b) grouping compounds contained in the bio-crudes according to predetermined criteria based on the experimental data; (c) selecting representative compounds among the compounds belonging to the same group; and (d) reconstituting the bio-crudes to a mixture of the representative compounds. According to the method for complexity reduction of bio-crudes for process simulation, it is possible to minimize the number of the compounds constituting the bio-crudes using only the experimental data and express physical properties of the bio-crudes accurately. Therefore, accurate and efficient process stimulation of the bio-crudes is possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은(a) 바이오 원유(bio-crudes)에 대한 정량 및 정성 분석 실험 데이터를 얻는 단계; (b) 상기 실험 데이터를 기초로 소정의 기준에 따라 바이오 원유 내에 포함된 화합물들을 그룹화하는 단계; (c) 동일한 그룹에 속하는 화합물들 중에서 대표 화합물을 선정하는 단계; 및 (d) 바이오 원유를 상기 대표 화합물의 혼합물로 재구성하는 단계;를 포함하는 바이오 원유의 복잡성 감소방법에 대한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 공정 모사를 위한 바이오 원유의 복잡성 감소방법에 의하면, GC-MS 등을 통해 얻어진 실험 데이터만을 이용해 바이오 원유의 구성 화합물의 개수를 최소화함과 동시에 바이오 원유의 물성을 정확하게 표현할 수 있어, 정확하고 효율적인 바이오 원유 공정 모사가 가능하다.
assignees: NAT UNIV PUKYONG IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Multi-parameter advanced material resource disaster real-time prediction system and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a multi-parameter advanced material resource disaster real-time prediction system which comprises a geological information general survey device, a measurement while drilling device and a multi-source information receiving, counting, interpreting and storing device, wherein the multi-source information receiving, counting, interpreting and storing device is arranged on the bottom surface; the stratum information census device defines a drilling area according to the condition of stratum hidden diseases in the acquired predetermined range area; the measurement while drilling device drills at any preset angle in a drilling area and acquires physical parameters of stratum rock and soil and physical parameters of stratum rock and soil in real time; the multi-source information receiving, counting, interpreting and storing device processes and analyzes physical parameters of stratum rock and soil and physical parameters of stratum rock and soil, and predicts advanced material and disaster while drilling. The invention fully solves the problems of no measurement or key data loss caused by drilling, thereby leading the subsequent operation to be more time-saving and labor-saving.

title_en: A kind of indoor fire-fighting emergency evacuation route analogy method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of methods of the optimal generation and simulation of fire-fighting life-saving route in building.Pre-generatmg is simulated to building internal channel by emulation platform and the escape weight between escape key point and key point is arranged to escape route；The setting and the setting of intensity of a fire situation of fire ignition point after fire occur for simulation；Dynamic analog is carried out to escape route according to the case where fire spread；Best escape route is generated according to existing fire dynamic analog situation and is come out by emulation platform simulative display, compared with prior art, the present invention can be calculated, assess and be simulated according to existing fire condition from the path of software pre-generatmg, quick and feasible information is provided for the selection in fire-fighting life-saving path, improves efficiency and escape and rescue ability of the fire-fighting and rescue in terms of Path selection well.

title_en: The electrical the condition of a disaster simulator of normal pressure
abstract_en: A kind of electrical the condition of a disaster simulator of normal pressure, including failure electrical analog(ue) and cloud control centre, the failure electrical analog(ue) includes spark generator and power supply plug-in strip, the spark generator includes the shell being made of an electrically conducting material, electric component and electric spark generating assembly are equipped in the shell, the electric component is by power supply power supply, the power supply plug-in strip is for the power supply between on-off power supply and electric component, the electric spark generating assembly is by high voltage package, capacitance component is constituted, the high voltage package is electrically connected with electric component, the capacitance component is connected with electrical discharge wire and return wire, the electrical discharge wire has one end exposed, the return wire has one end exposed, the electric component is powered to high voltage package so as to have electric spark between electrical discharge wire exposed end and return wire exposed end.The utility model has the advantages that the electrical the condition of a disaster of energy simulated normal pressure, generates convenient for checking and rating, can remotely control electric spark.

title_en: Poisonous gas leakage the condition of a disaster simulator
abstract_en: The purpose of the utility model is to provide one kind to be able to achieve poisonous gas leakage simulation in order to fire drill, and convenient for the poisonous gas leakage the condition of a disaster simulator of manoeuvre examination.Including steam generation facility, high pressure gas release device, gas color simulator, the high pressure gas release device includes supervisor and several branch pipes, several branch pipes are arranged in parallel and are connected with supervisor, the branch pipe is equipped with gas outlet far from one end of supervisor, the steam generation facility is connected to by steam pipework with the supervisor of high pressure gas release device, the gas color simulator includes LED light group, the branch pipe is set to LED light group outer circumferential, the gas outlet of all branch pipes is respectively positioned on the circumference centered on LED light group, the light-illuminating that gas color simulator is issued is on the sprayed gas in gas outlet, the LED light group is equipped with color adaptation module and lamplight brightness adjustment module, when control valve valve closing, then gas outlet stops jet, LED light is closed.

title_en: Air feeder of gas mask
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas mask air feeder, including epitheca and inferior valve, be equipped with the sealing rubber circle between epitheca and the inferior valve joint edge, the mutual lock of epitheca and inferior valve is connected, it holds cavity and motor wind wheel installation cavity to form the battery, the interval is equipped with a plurality of air intakes on the epitheca, all be stamped the air intake plug in every air intake, in the time of in every air intake plug screw in air intake, all fill up and be equipped with the air intake rubber pad, still be equipped with a knob installation bellying on the epitheca, the tip of knob installation bellying is equipped with a recess, be provided with rotary switch on the recess. The product is mainly applied to the scenes of toxic and harmful gas protection, biochemical environment protection, fire protection, industrial and mining equipment operation, natural disaster rescue and the like. When the mask is worn to do work, the breathing resistance can be rapidly increased along with the increase of the amount of exercise, so that the physical consumption is increased; in a respiratory system, after the special air feeder for the gas mask is used, the comfort of wearing the mask is greatly improved by means of the suction force generated by the air feeder during working.

title_en: Spherical tank fire disaster simulation burner and control method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to spherical tank fire disaster simulation burner and control methods.Method includes simulating the burning scene of fire in spherical tank by Smith- fuzzy-adaptation PID control and to temperature change in the mathematical analysis real-time control spherical tank of spherical tank internal temperature flow.Device includes removable tank body, vibration unit, fuel element, spray unit, simulated explosion unit, temperature and hydraulic feedback unit, control system, and fuel element is set to outside removable tank body, simulates removable tank body fire burning；Vibration unit is set in removable tank body, and removable tank body is driven to generate vibration, vibrational state before simulated explosion；Simulated explosion unit is set in removable tank body, realizes removable tank body blast analogue；Spray unit cools down removable tank body.The present invention more can really simulate the burning scene of spherical tank fire, and its quality is considerably lighter than the quality of true spherical tank, can be moved by castor, it is made to carry out spherical tank fire disaster simulation in different training places.

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on pyramid pooling twin network
abstract_en: The invention provides a SAR image change detection method based on a pyramid pooling twin network, which mainly solves the problem that the result is inaccurate due to the fact that the change detection precision in the traditional method depends on a difference graph. The implementation steps are as follows: 1) Generating a training sample, a test sample and a sample label; 2) Constructing a depth pyramid pooling twin network; 3) Constructing a classification network; 4) Training the deep pyramid pooling twin network and the classification network by using training samples and sample labels to obtain a trained model; 5) And testing the test sample by using the trained model to obtain a change detection result. The invention can avoid using the difference map, effectively solve the influence of the difference map on the change detection result, improve the accuracy of the change detection, and can be used for environment detection and disaster detection.

title_en: Experimental device for simulate electric fault
abstract_en: The invention provides an experimental device for simulating electrical faults, which comprises a box body, wherein a smoke exhaust pipeline switch is arranged at the top of the box body, the box body is connected with a smoke exhaust pipeline through the smoke exhaust pipeline switch, a real-time smoke analyzer is arranged in the smoke exhaust pipeline, the smoke exhaust pipeline is connected with an electric dust collector and a smoke purification device, a variable-angle lifting device, a temperature sensor, a pressure sensor, a smoke collection device, a liquid carbon dioxide sprinkler head, a combustion sample tray and a combustion sample heating device are arranged in the box body. The invention can simulate electrical faults or simulate the preparation of electrical faults caused by fire disaster by using liquid or solid two-phase materials; and the environmental pressure and temperature during the formation of the beads and various smoke components and concentrations can be monitored in the preparation process; the safety performance is higher, and the change of the contact angle, the contact height and the contact wire diameter between wires during the preparation is realized. The design is simple and clear, and no too much manual operation is needed.

title_en: Urban waterlogging simulation analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban waterlogging simulation analysis method, which comprises the following steps: the urban inland inundation simulation system has the advantages of having good urban inland inundation simulation effect, being beneficial to prevention and control of flood disasters and effectively improving urban information early warning capability.

title_en: A kind of barrier lake risk assessment platform
abstract_en: A kind of barrier lake risk assessment platform disclosed by the invention, is specifically implemented according to the following steps: step 1 establishes dimensional topography information module；Step 2 establishes damming body and bursts rapid evaluation module；Step 3, simulation damming body flood due to dam-break evolution fluidised form are to establish advance of freshet module；Step 4 establishes Bayesian network, and the population evacuation that the mathematical model based on Bayesian network calculates output barrier lake downstream residential block leads and the death rate, to complete barrier lake risk assessment.A kind of barrier lake risk assessment platform disclosed by the invention, being capable of quick, qualitative assessment barrier lake risk.

title_en: A kind of earthquake disaster virtual emulation assessment teaching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of earthquake disaster virtual emulations to assess teaching method, comprising the following steps: study relevant operation content, and learning effect is tested；Student is given at random by 3D model is built by dummy emulation system；The building for selecting different architectural modulus obtains the building 3D model of the building under different architectural modulus；Identical earthquake intensity is applied to the building 3D model of different architectural modulus, or different earthquake intensity is applied to the building 3D model of identical architectural modulus, obtains earthquake to the simulation result of the building destruction；Earthquake is observed to the destruction situation of building 3D model, the building 3D model after by eaerthquake damage is observed, analyzed and recorded.A kind of earthquake disaster virtual emulation of the invention assesses teaching method, and student can be allowed to get information about earthquake to the anti-seismic performance of the destructive process of building and the building of different configuration, improve the teaching efficiency of Earthquake Knowledge.

title_en: Simulation demonstration device for soil liquefaction disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation demonstration device for soil liquefaction disasters, which comprises a box body, wherein a soil layer easy to liquefy is filled in the box body; the collapse simulation air bag is arranged in the soil layer, and the collapse simulation air bag is used for assisting in simulating the settlement phenomenon of the soil layer when the soil is liquefied through shrinkage; the water outflow simulation nozzle is arranged inside the soil layer, and water is sprayed in the soil layer through the water outflow simulation nozzle to simulate the sand blasting and water outflow phenomenon of the soil layer when the soil is liquefied; the vibration simulation device is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the box body, and the vibration during soil liquefaction is simulated when the vibration simulation device horizontally shakes. The soil liquefaction demonstration device is reasonable in design, capable of visually demonstrating the macroscopic phenomenon and the main disaster characteristics of soil liquefaction from the macroscopic view, easy to understand, strong in operability, low in demonstration cost, good in demonstration effect, capable of being repeatedly recycled, and strong in repeatability.

title_en: A kind of coal mine evacuation working face self-powered Distributed seismic monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of coal mine evacuation working face self-powered Distributed seismics to monitor system and method.Geophone is mounted in the drilling of wall certain depth and completes the adherent backup of geophone using carbon spring steel wires by the present invention, wave detector and the wall of a borehole is set to realize close-coupled, greatly reduce the difficulty of construction and cost of geophone repeated disassembled and assembled, solves adherent coupled problem when installing in influence of noise and shallow bore hole of the geophone by installation environment, the mechanical vibrational energy of underground coal mine belt support frame is rationally and effectively collected by belt support frame self-power supply device, and it provides energy to the earthquake monitoring system being attached thereto and uses, guarantee that node continuously and effectively works.Solving underground coal mine with lesser cost has cable power supply mode difficult wiring, and battery power supply mode often replaces battery maintenance disadvantage at high cost, is improved the mobility of earthquake monitoring system and adaptability.

title_en: The intelligent distribution network toughness quantitative analysis method of the load containing polymorphic type under dusty wind weather
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the intelligent distribution network toughness quantitative analysis methods of the load containing polymorphic type under dusty wind weather, include the following steps: to simulate dust storm wind field and obtain each point wind speed, the load effect of power distribution network is calculated according to wind speed and direction, respectively obtain distribution network line fault rate and shaft tower failure rate, the failure rate for calculating electric distribution network overhead wire, obtains the scene that power distribution network under extreme weather at a time breaks down；Assign each stage load different weights according to load importance；Whether the system line after judgement is broken down overloads, and implements off-load measure to existing load when circuit overload；Day part load loss is sequentially completed calculating by the load reduction for going out current scene according to weight calculation, and then the average aggregate load of calculated load is cut down, and calculates the toughness index of power distribution network.The present invention preferably solves the problems, such as that electric energy supply pressure is big under dusty wind weather, effectively improves the anti-disaster ability of power distribution network.

title_en: Water-inrush-preventing structure for tunnel construction
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water burst prevention structure for tunnel construction, which is a shallow tunnel passing through a water-rich area; the water burst preventing structure comprises a plurality of drill holes extending downwards into an underground water-containing structure from the earth surface of the tunnel, cooling liquid and refrigeration equipment arranged in the tunnel; a steel pipe communicated with refrigeration equipment is embedded in each drill hole; the freezing device injects a cryogen into the cooling fluid, which is transported through the steel pipe to the water-containing formation. The freezing of the refrigerant input from the earth surface to the downward borehole freezes rock strata and water in the construction range of the tunnel engineering, so that the construction of the tunnel face and the plugging of underground water can be both considered, the purposes of consolidating the underground water and enhancing the rock-soil strength can be achieved, and the construction efficiency is greatly improved. Meanwhile, after the shallow tunnel is excavated, the soil pressure generated by covering soil on the shallow tunnel is borne, so that the technical scheme can reduce the loss of water burst, mud burst and other disasters to personnel and equipment, and ensure the construction safety.

title_en: City utility tunnel personnel access & exit combined material civil air defense protective equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a city utility tunnel personnel access & exit combined material civil air defense protective equipment, including door leaf, door frame, shutting, hinge page or leaf, still include threshold and observation window alive, the door leaf is articulated with the door frame through the hinge page or leaf, the shutting sets up on the door leaf, be provided with the observation window on the door leaf, the door leaf lower part is equipped with detachable threshold alive, is provided with joint strip in the adhesive tape groove of threshold alive, and the threshold alive outside is connected with the angle steel, and the angle steel passes through the bolt and is connected with the passageway terrace; the door leaf is also provided with an embedded pressing plate, and the embedded pressing plate is opposite to the sealing rubber strip; the door leaf is also provided with an embedded part, and the lock, the hinge and the observation window are connected with the embedded part through bolts to realize the fixed connection with the door leaf. It provides high-efficient reliable drill way safeguard measure for utility tunnel engineer access & exit, has improved utility tunnel disaster prevention survivability, has ensured engineering inside personnel and equipment safety.

title_en: Chemical industry park virtual simulation emergency deduction system based on big data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical industry park virtual simulation emergency deduction system based on big data fusion, which comprises: the system comprises a sudden accident disaster factor index construction module, a data fusion module and a virtual simulation emergency deduction module; by means of the virtual reality technology, trainees can place themselves in various complex and sudden environments, and accordingly pertinence training is conducted, and self strain capacity and relevant processing skills are improved.

title_en: Experimental simulation device for fire spread of typical building inverted V-shaped slope roof under effect of environmental wind
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation device for a fire spread experiment of a typical building inverted V-shaped slope roof under the action of environmental wind, which comprises an air supply system, an inverted V-shaped slope roof simulation experiment table and a data acquisition and processing system. The experimental simulation device is a small-size test bed which is specially used for carrying out comprehensive systematic study on the influence of roof angles on flame forms, flame spreading speeds, flame heat flow distribution and flame spreading criteria from a windward slope to a leeward slope on a roof slope when a fire disaster occurs on the upper surface of a typical building inverted V-shaped slope roof under the action of environmental wind. The method has important scientific and application values for developing the research on the fire hazard of the actual typical pitched roof building, and has guiding significance for optimizing the pitched roof building design to reduce the fire hazard thereof.

title_en: Air-water pumping linkage device for guaranteeing safe drilling construction
abstract_en: an air and water pumping linkage device for guaranteeing safe drilling construction can solve the technical problem that gas is easy to leak in the drilling construction process in the prior art to cause disasters. The system comprises an extraction system, an air supply system, a water supply system, a drilling machine cooling system, an orifice dust removal system and a compressed air self-rescue device; the air supply system and the water supply system are provided by an air supply system and a water supply system in the roadway and are conveyed to a drilling construction site through a high-pressure hose connected with the air supply system and the water supply system; then, a water braid is adopted to connect the high-pressure hose and the drill rod, and the air supply system and the water supply system enter the hole through the drill rod; the air supply system, the water supply system and the extraction system are connected by a mechanical connecting rod to realize linkage. According to the embodiment of the invention, after gas is abnormal in the drill hole, the gas in the hole can be pumped and discharged by using the extraction system in the roadway under the condition of ensuring that the gas is not leaked to cause harm, so that the content, the pressure and the like of the gas are reduced to be below a safe horizontal line, and the safe construction is ensured.
assignees: CHINA COAL XINJI ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Self-locking nested deepwater drilling surface conduit and installation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-locking nested deepwater drilling surface conduit and an installation method thereof. The self-locking nested deep water drilling surface layer guide pipe is of a basic structure consisting of a suction pile top cover, a suction pile barrel, an earth plug prevention rib plate, a lower rib plate, an outer guide pipe, a middle guide pipe, an inner guide pipe, a guide pipe plug, a hammer rod guide frame and a guide pipe fixing device. The self-locking nested deep water drilling surface guide pipe and the installation method thereof are designed by combining the suction anchor technology and the underwater piling technology, the surface guide pipes can be installed in batches by a working ship, the operation efficiency is high, the obvious technical and economic advantages are realized, the cylindrical foundation and the nested guide pipe structure can greatly improve the bearing capacity of the guide pipe and effectively solve the problem that shallow geological disasters are easy to occur in deep water drilling, and the self-locking nested deep water drilling surface guide pipe and the installation method thereof are particularly suitable for drilling and exploitation of deep water natural gas hydrates.

title_en: Fire extinguisher practice equipment for fire fight training
title_ko: 소방 훈련용 소화기 실습 장비
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire extinguisher training equipment for a fire drill using a fire extinguisher spraying water instead of fire extinguishing powder and, more specifically, to fire extinguisher training equipment in which first, second, third spaces (11, 12, 13) are formed in front and rear portions by first and second transparent plates of a body portion (10). The first space (11) has an opened front portion to spray water of a fire extinguisher. The second space (12) penetrates the first space (11) to vertically and axially provide a target indicating an ignition point. The third space (13) is provided with a flame reproducing unit (30) which reproduces a fire situation by enabling a flame reproducing film to flutter and pulsate by a blowing force such that red light and blue light are emitted like flames. By accurately hitting the target marking the ignition point in front of the body portion using the water sprayed from the fire extinguisher, the target is knocked down for a certain period to practice extinguishing a fire. The flame reproducing unit creates a real fire situation to provide a safe and realistic feeling of extinguishing a real fire, thereby achieving double practice effects.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화 분말 대신 물을 분사하는 소화기를 이용하여 소방 훈련을 하는 소화기 실습 장비에 관한 것으로, 좀더 상세하게는 몸체부(10)의 제1,2 투명판에 의해 제1,2,3 공간부(11)(12)(13)를 전후로 형성하되, 상기 제1 공간부(11)는 소화기의 물을 분사하도록 전방을 개방되게 형성하고, 제2 공간부(12)는 제1 공간부(11)와 관통 형성하여 발화 지점을 표시하는 타켓을 수직으로 축 설치하며, 제3 공간부(13)에는 불꽃 재현막이 송풍력에 의해 펄럭이며 파동하면서 적,청 색광을 발하여 불꽃과 같이 연출되면서 화재 상황을 재현하는 불꽃 재현부(30)를 설치 구성하므로 소화기에서 분사되는 물로 본체부 전방에서 발화 지점을 표시하는 타켓을 정확히 맞추는 것에 의해 타켓을 일정 시간 넘어뜨려 화재를 진화하도록 실습하되, 불꽃 재현부에 의해 실제 화재 상황을 연출하므로 안전하면서도 실제 화재를 진화하는 듯한 현실감을 갖도록 하기 때문에 실습 효과를 배가하도록 하는데 그 특징이 있다.

title_en: Indoor test platform for simulating marine multiphase load coupling effect
abstract_en: The application provides an indoor test platform for simulating marine multiphase load coupling effect in the technical field of marine load simulation. In the test, the soil tank for placing the soil sample is arranged at the bottom of the middle section of the small wave current water tank, and the water flow and wave action in the small wave current water tank can be controlled and adjusted through a wave current system (mainly comprising a current generator and a wave generator), so that the wave current comprehensive action in the marine environment is realized. Meanwhile, the bottom of the soil tank is provided with two small horizontal vibration tables, the upper part of the soil tank is provided with a plurality of multidirectional power loading devices, and the multidirectional power loading devices can work in cooperation with a wave flow system, so that the simulation of the multi-field coupling effect is realized, and the multidirectional power loading devices can also be used independently to conduct the research on the aspects of earthquakes or power. Compared with the existing test device, the experimental device is simple to operate, occupies a small area, can simulate the marine multiphase load coupling effect, and develops the catastrophe mechanism and the bearing performance evolution of the foundation-soil body system under the multi-disaster effect of the offshore wind power, the offshore platform and the cross-sea bridge in the laboratory.

title_en: Treatment construction method for continuous collapse roof fall of small-section steep slope tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a treatment construction method for continuous collapse roof fall of a small-section inclined tunnel, which comprises the following steps: A. arranging a plurality of rows of supporting arches; B. the single beam structure supporting system and the whole arch structure supporting system formed by the distributed barrier layer, the supporting layer and the protective layer pipe shed are used for blocking the loosened dangerous rock after the blast load disturbance, weakening the gliding impact force and forming a multi-layer buffer protective layer; C. the self-advancing drill pipe capable of being spliced and lengthened and the cone-shaped drill bit with the spiral rotary steel tie overcome the limitation of the limited space of the small-section steep slope tunnel, and improve the rotary drilling force of the drill pipe and the crushing and rock breaking effects; d. the top of the supporting arch frame is provided with an isolation waterproof layer to weaken the softening effect of underground water immersion and ensure the electrical safety of construction in the underground tunnel. The method has the effects of high efficiency, rapidness, safety and reliability on the management of the roof collapse disaster caused by the continuous collapse of the small-section steep slope tunnel, can ensure the normal operation of tunnel blasting excavation, and can accelerate the construction period.

title_en: Production safety accident scene construction and emergency capacity construction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production safety accident scene construction and emergency capacity construction system, which adopts a technical route of scene analysis, task combing and capacity evaluation, and comprises risk management and emergency work management, wherein the risk management and the emergency work management are carried out in a circulating way, and the emergency work management comprises four processes of emergency preparation, emergency response, restoration reconstruction and prevention and disaster reduction. According to the invention, through research and judgment based on a large number of related typical accident cases at home and abroad, the logic chain and the common law of occurrence and development of related major accidents are researched and mastered, the core elements of the scenes are determined, the risk list and the task combing list are listed, a foundation is laid for construction of the related scenes and improvement of emergency capacity, the typical scenes of the typical cases are constructed through quantitative analysis of accident consequences based on mathematical modeling and computer simulation, the related emergency tasks of key nodes of the scenes are determined, and the practicability of construction of production safety scenes is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGZHIAN CO LTD;HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG CHONGQING LIANGJIANG GAS TURBINE POWER GENERATION CO LTD;CHANGCHUN THERMAL POWER PLANT OF HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Roof hydraulic fracturing multi-parameter comprehensive monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a roof hydrofracturing multi-parameter comprehensive monitoring system, which relates to the technical field of mining engineering and solves the technical problems of monitoring the hydrofracturing effect of a roof and determining the fracturing range, wherein the monitoring equipment comprises a drilling stress meter, a bolt and anchor cable dynamometer, a drilling peeping instrument, a roof monitor, a support resistance measuring station, a micro-seismic measuring station and a surrounding rock deformation measuring station, the drilling stress meter is arranged in a stoping roadway, the bolt and anchor cable dynamometer is arranged in the range of 10m around the hydrofracturing position, the drilling peeping instrument comprises a peeping probe, a data acquisition instrument, a displacement inductor, a coil and an extension rod, the development crack state of a drilling hole before and after the hydrofracturing in the hydrofracturing range, the deformation displacement of the roadway, the micro-seismic event, the support resistance and the stress change of the surrounding rock are used for judging the hydrofracturing effect and the fracturing range, and the reliability of the multi-parameter comprehensive monitoring is high, the hydraulic fracturing effect is judged accurately, and the dynamic disaster of the top plate can be avoided to ensure the mining safety.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;INNER MONGOLIA HAOSHENG COAL IND CO LTD;WUSHEN BANNER MENGDA MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent command system for emergency restoration of railway disasters and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent command system for emergency restoration of railway disasters and a using method thereof, belonging to the field of railways, the intelligent command system for emergency restoration of railway disasters and the using method thereof can send real-time scenes of a disaster site to a command control center through a monitoring module and a scanning module, three-dimensional simulation software on the command control center can simulate disaster relief steps, thereby simulating the optimal disaster relief steps, and then the command control center can project the optimal disaster relief steps to a two-state projection screen plate of the disaster site through a projection module, thereby facilitating the real-time command of the disaster relief process of disaster relief personnel, further controlling the condition of expansion of disaster influence caused by improper processing of the disaster relief process to be the lowest, thereby improving the safety of disaster relief efficiency, accelerating the restoration speed of railway traffic, and converting the two states of the two-state projection screen plate, the method and the device can improve the watching of disaster relief personnel on the optimal projection step, and further improve the disaster relief efficiency.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;CHENGDU NUOBIKAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: drilling measuring device and measuring method
abstract_en: the invention relates to a drilling measuring device, which comprises a drilling hole depth measuring device and a drilling track measuring device; the drilling hole depth measuring device and the drilling track measuring device are connected through a measuring line and are respectively used for measuring the drilling hole depth and the drilling track; the drilling hole depth measuring device comprises a retracting unit and a hole depth measuring unit; the drilling track determination device comprises a shell II and a fixing piece which is arranged at the tail of the shell II and used for fixing a measuring line; the measuring line penetrates through the hole depth measuring unit, and two ends of the measuring line are respectively wound on the retracting unit and the fixing piece; the method is beneficial to avoiding misjudgment and potential safety hazard leaving, is beneficial to realizing accurate prediction of underground gas pre-drainage drilling information of the coal mine, is beneficial to improving the gas disaster prevention and control capacity of the mine, is beneficial to improving the extraction efficiency and is beneficial to large-area popularization and use.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: High-voltage electric disaster simulation device
abstract_en: A high-voltage electric disaster simulation device comprises a failure electric simulation device and a cloud control center, the electric fault simulation device comprises an electric spark generation device and a power switch blade, the electric spark generation device comprises a shell made of conductive materials, the electric spark generating device is matched with a radar monitoring device for detecting whether a person is in a detection range, the shell is in ground protection, an electrical component and an electric spark generation component are arranged in the shell, the electric spark generation component consists of a high-voltage pack and a capacitor component, the high-voltage package is electrically connected with the electric assembly, the capacitor assembly is connected with a discharge lead and a loop lead, one end of the discharge wire is exposed, one end of the loop wire is exposed, and the electrical assembly supplies power to the high-voltage package so that electric sparks are generated between the exposed end of the discharge wire and the exposed end of the loop wire. The utility model has the advantages of can simulate the electrical disaster condition of ordinary pressure, be convenient for appraisal, ability remote control electric spark produces.

title_en: Drilling deslagging and oscillation fracturing gas extraction system and method based on nano fluid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling deslagging and hydraulic oscillation fracturing reinforced gas extraction system and method based on a nano fluid. And in the coal body drilling process, the coal rock mass at the front part of the drill bit is wetted with the crushed rock mass by using the hydrophilic nano fluid, so that the fluidity of the coal rock mass is increased, and the smooth slag discharge in the drilling process is ensured. And then, the hydrophobic nano fluid is injected into the coal bed and is attached to the surface of the coal body, so that high-pressure water filtration is prevented, the crack depth is better expanded, the coal body is efficiently cracked under the same water injection pressure, the rapid desorption of coal bed gas is promoted on a large scale, and the good synergistic effect of the nano fluid and hydraulic fracturing is realized. The invention realizes the effect of high-efficiency drilling operation, high-efficiency permeability increase of the coal seam and high-efficiency gas extraction integration, scientifically and efficiently extracts the coal seam gas, and achieves the purpose of effectively preventing and treating the gas disasters of the high-gas and low-permeability coal seam.

title_en: Electric explosion and seismic fracturing cooperated microwave heat drive gas extraction system and method
abstract_en: the invention provides an electric explosion and seismic fracturing coordinated microwave heat drive gas extraction system and method. The system comprises an ultrahigh pressure water jet generation system, an electric explosion fracturing system, a microwave heat injection system and a gas extraction system. When the drill works, the drill clamps the tail end of the insulating sleeve. The head end of the insulating sleeve extends into the gas extraction hole. The input end of a rotary sealing device of the drilling machine is connected with the ultrahigh-pressure water pump through a nano fluid pipeline, and the output end of the rotary sealing device is connected with the tail end of the insulating sleeve. The using method of the system comprises the steps of constructing a gas extraction hole, injecting nano fluid suspension, discharging, heating and the like. The system combines electric fracturing and microwave heat injection, realizes the synergistic effect of coal bed fracturing and heat gas displacement, obviously improves the gas desorption efficiency, achieves the purpose of preventing and controlling gas disasters, and realizes the efficient and safe exploitation of coal resources.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INST SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Parallel multilayer Monte Carlo double-fed asynchronous fan parameter optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a parallel multilayer Monte Carlo double-fed asynchronous fan parameter optimization method, which reduces the time of group intelligent decision through a parallel multilayer simulation system. The method has the technical effects that: the method can realize quick parameter optimization decision and avoid the problem of dimension disaster in the common Monte Carlo method. The method can optimize the parameters of the proportional-integral-derivative controller of the double-fed asynchronous fan.

title_en: Flood storage and detention distinguishing flood distribution method based on complete information dynamic non-cooperative master-slave game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood storage and stagnation distinguishing flood distribution method based on a complete information dynamic non-cooperative master-slave game. And taking the upstream stagnation area as a prior game player to make a decision preferentially, taking the downstream stagnation area as a subordinate game player to act subsequently according to the upstream decision information, and feeding the decision information back to the upstream stagnation area to prompt the upstream stagnation area to adjust the strategy thereof, so that an interactive feedback decision process is formed, multiple rounds are carried out by considering the game, and the two parties maximize the effectiveness thereof through continuous competition and balance. The subordinate gamblers grasp the possible decisions of the leading gamblers, and simultaneously, the leading gamblers completely master the decision behaviors of the subordinate gamblers, thereby realizing flood storage and flood detention and flood distribution. According to the invention, through a non-cooperative game means, interaction and restriction behaviors among all main bodies in flood diversion planning are simulated, a stable Nash equilibrium decision scheme is sought, effective and reasonable flood diversion is realized, flood damage is reduced, and post-disaster reconstruction capability is improved.

title_en: Mine disaster scene simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster scene simulation system and a method, relating to the technical field of mine safety emergency, wherein the system comprises a mine scene model establishing module, a mine disaster scene model generating module, a mine disaster scene simulation module and a mine disaster scene simulation module, wherein the mine scene model establishing module is used for establishing a mine scene model so as to simulate a static scene of a mine and receive mine disaster parameter setting and current system parameter setting; the mine system calculation module is used for calculating dynamic change information of system parameters and dynamic change information of underground environment parameters according to mine disaster parameters and current system parameters; the dynamic display module is used for displaying the dynamic change information of the system parameters and the dynamic change information of the underground environment parameters in the mine scene model so as to simulate a real mine disaster scene. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the simulation training platform can truly simulate the underground complex environment and the scene of dynamic change of disasters, and can provide an immersive, safe and efficient simulation training platform for the trainees, so that the mine workers can obtain the most effective drilling of mine disaster accidents.

title_en: Experimental table for simulating ignition oil product on hot surface of vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laboratory table for simulating ignition oil products on a hot surface of a vehicle, which is used for simulating the phenomenon that the vehicle generates high-temperature ignition gasoline on the hot surface due to braking after running for a long time and mainly solves the problem that the ignition condition and the combustion process of the existing automobile hot surface fire disaster are difficult to judge. The experiment table comprises a lifting heating assembly, a water tank heat-insulating assembly, a wind control assembly and an electric control assembly; the lifting heating assembly comprises a heating device, a support frame, a base mounting frame and a lifting adjusting device, wherein the heating device is arranged on the support frame, the support frame is connected with the lifting adjusting device, and the lifting adjusting device is arranged on the base mounting frame; the water tank heat preservation component comprises a heating water tank and a heat preservation cover; the heat preservation cover is arranged above the device to be tested, and the heating water tank is communicated with the heat preservation cover; the wind control assembly comprises a fan and a wind speed regulator; the fan is arranged on one side of the device to be tested; the electric control assembly is respectively connected with the lifting heating assembly, the water tank heat-insulating assembly and the wind control assembly.

title_en: Forest mountain soil normal position fire analogue test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forest mountain region soil normal position fire analogue test device provides a can measure the test device that the soil physics of the different degree of depth and water nature property index change under the different fire intensity at scene normal position, and test device includes the triplex: the lower part is a detection system, the middle part is a fire simulation system, and the upper part is a rainfall simulation system. The utility model is convenient to install, use and measure, can carry out in-situ burning tests with different burning temperatures and durations and in-situ rainfall simulation tests with different rainfall intensities and durations of soil after burning while ensuring the minimum disturbance of the original soil structure, and realizes real-time measurement of the temperature and the moisture content change in the burning process of different depth soil and the moisture content and the pore water pressure change in the rainfall simulation process of different depth soil after burning; meanwhile, the corresponding parts can be properly disassembled, and the device is convenient to carry and has high popularization value in the aspects of disaster mechanism and prevention and treatment research of the debris flow after fire.

title_en: Multifunctional wind tunnel for simulating multi-disaster coupling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional wind tunnel for simulating multi-disaster coupling, which comprises a wind tunnel flow passage, wherein a wind tunnel fan for generating background wind is arranged in the wind tunnel flow passage, and a land environment test area and a water area environment test area are also arranged in the wind tunnel flow passage; the wind tunnel flow channel comprises a straight line test section, the land environment test area and the water area environment test area are both arranged in the straight line test section, and the straight line test section is internally provided with an extreme airflow simulation device which can be used for simulating the extreme airflow in the land environment test area and the water area environment test area simultaneously. The utility model discloses a multi-functional wind-tunnel of many calamities of simulation coupling not only can simulate the effect of load under land environment and the waters environment to building structure, can simulate building structure's true reflection condition under various single wind field environment moreover to and building structure is the true reflection condition under two kinds at least wind field coupling effects.

title_en: Instrument for testing thermal protection performance of firefighter uniform under human body movement
abstract_en: The invention relates to an instrument for testing the thermal protection performance of a firefighter uniform under human motion, which comprises a main support, a heat source simulator, a fabric sample rack, an air layer simulator, a dynamic sample transmission device and a data acquisition system. The heat source simulator and the sample trolley track are fixed on the main support, the dynamic sample conveying device is arranged on the sample trolley track, the sample trolley is connected with the rotating crankshaft through the connecting rod, the sample trolley can slide left and right, the sample trolley is sequentially provided with a fabric sample rack capable of moving back and forth, a detachable air layer simulator and a detachable sensor base from left to right, the fabric sample rack and each layer of fabric are fixed through full-thread screws and nuts, a water-cooling sensor is arranged in the sensor base and is sequentially connected with a data acquisition card and a computer, the rotating crankshaft is connected with a speed regulating engine through a flywheel, and the left and right movement of the sample trolley can be achieved. The invention can accurately evaluate the thermal protection performance of the fire-fighting suit under the condition of human body movement.

title_en: Disaster prevention business continuation system
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention business continuation system which can achieve a disaster prevention plan that protects employees and can continue a business even in emergency such as disaster in consideration of various matters including their evacuation life after the disaster.SOLUTION: In a disaster prevention business continuation system 1, a central server accessible via Internet from a portable information terminal possessed by an employee and an information terminal device of a business office where the employee works includes at least eight functions including a disaster prevention consultation function 101, a business continuation plan creation function 102, a safety confirmation evacuation guidance function 103, an evacuation training alarm function 104, a bulletin board function 105 for matching support providing business places with support receiving business places, a stockpile automatic retrieve function 106, a bulletin board function 107 for solving problem among employees, and a business continuation plan browsing function 108, and can provide various disaster prevention-related information to the employees and the business places.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Slope-adjustable landslide control experiment platform
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mountain landslide monitoring, a landslide control experiment platform with adjustable slope is related to. The soil of study classification is placed in the holding tank of soil landslide and is simulated actual landslide, adjusts the slope of soil landslide through slope adjusting device, simulates the landslide phenomenon of the mountain body under the different hillside slopes. The soil landslide is divided into an upper landslide and a lower landslide, the upper landslide and the lower landslide are hinged, and the slopes of the two sections of landslides are adjusted through corresponding linear driving pieces, so that a real landslide environment can be better simulated. The influence on the stability of the landslide is obtained by researching the relation between the slope of the landslide and other physical quantities influencing the stability of the landslide, and the method has important significance for improving the prevention and reducing the landslide disaster.

title_en: Multifunctional three-dimensional circulating ecological aquaculture equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological aquaculture equipment of multi-functional three-dimensional circulation, including a plurality of three-dimensional breed casees that stack, its characterized in that is provided with an at least breed space in every breed incasement, has placed the nest in simulation big middle and small shrimp crab cave more than at least one in each breed space. The utility model discloses a set up the nest in the breed space in the big little shrimp crab cave of simulation more than one at least, can let the shrimp crab have a rest in the nest of simulation, make the nest periphery have sufficient bad space again simultaneously and let aquaculture such as shrimp crab perch the place of eating. And moreover, the method can prevent the killing of the offensive organisms and avoid natural disasters, so that the offensive organisms can be cultured in groups, the renting land of the pond is saved, and the culture efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI HANBAO SPECIALIZED PURIFICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground directional drilling for advanced control of multi-disaster-source ore bed mining method
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ground directional drilling for administering multi-disaster source ore deposit exploitation method in advance, including minimum rectangle region, its characterized in that: the outside bilateral symmetry of minimum rectangle region arranges the earth's surface rig, the bottom of earth's surface rig is provided with directional drilling perpendicularly, the utility model discloses in to bottom plate gushing water harm, through arranging the rig on ground, from last aquifer to threatening the safe exploitation of seam down construction drilling, carry out high pressure slip casting solidification after that, absorb and extrude the water in the limestone bed space, reach the purpose that gets into the working face of exploitation such as gas or toxic gas in the water or the coal seam that forms the isolation layer shutoff aquifer simultaneously, to the working face roof, because the exploitation, the coal seam is not hard up, when having solved underground mining, need design construction with it supporting supplementary tunnel system in the pit, its construction process is comparatively loaded down with trivial details, the cost is higher, the time limit for a project is longer, and take place the problem that gushing water bursts the gas easily.

title_en: Multifunctional motor-driven medical service rescue bag
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue package technical field, in particular to a multifunctional mobile medical service rescue package which solves the defects of single function and inconvenient use of a rescue backpack in the prior art, comprising a bag body, braces, waist support and a detachable single package, wherein the front of the bag body is provided with a life support area and an emergency tool area, the inner side of the bag body is provided with a rescue technique area, a disease nursing area and a wound emergency area, the life support area is internally provided with a life support package, the rescue technique area is internally provided with a rescue technique package, the disease nursing area is internally provided with a disease nursing package, the wound emergency area is internally provided with a wound package, the emergency tool package is arranged in the emergency tool area, the rescue package is divided into five functional module packages, is suitable for actual combat and training tasks such as on-site rescue, professional health skill training and examination, disaster rescue and the like, and the externally hung movable single package can be switched and adjusted according to, meet the rescue requirements of different properties.
assignees: GENERAL HOSPITAL OF SOUTHERN THEATER COMMAND OF THE PLA CHINA

title_en: Device applied to three-dimensional physical simulation test of stability of large landslide
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device applied to large-scale landslide stability three-dimensional physical simulation test, which belongs to the technical field of test in geological disasters, and comprises a frame working platform, a model box, a rainfall mechanism, a soil water pressure mechanism, a displacement image acquisition mechanism, a landslide gradient control mechanism and an automatic data acquisition and analysis mechanism, wherein the soil water pressure mechanism comprises a soil pressure gauge, a pore water pressure gauge and a volume water content sensor; the displacement image acquisition mechanism comprises a three-dimensional laser scanner, a vertical displacement measurement component and a horizontal displacement monitoring component; the landslide slope control mechanism comprises a vertical load control motor, a horizontal load control motor, a voltage-stabilizing and current-stabilizing numerical control metering oil source pump station and a control sensor. The utility model discloses reach and to simulate prototype seepage field, displacement field, stress field accurately, can acquire under the different rain-strong conditions, the technical effect of the effective degree of depth, landslide motion in-process landslide soil body displacement, pore water pressure and stress field data that the rainfall infiltrates.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: System and method for identifying fire in video based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for identifying a fire disaster in a video based on a convolutional neural network, which relate to the technical field of deep learning. The part firstly uses OpenCV to carry out frame extraction processing on a target video, carries out preprocessing such as parameter random change and image enhancement on an image to obtain input data of a neural network, then creates a convolutional neural network model LeNet-5 by means of TensorFlow, reads image data in a training set to train the model, carries out persistence on the model which is best represented on a test set, and finally inputs the preprocessed image data into the trained model to carry out recognition, and analyzes and displays the result.

title_en: Fuel cell fault diagnosis method and apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides a fuel cell fault diagnosis method and a fuel cell fault diagnosis device, which are used for obtaining operation parameters of a fuel cell system. And then processing the operation parameters to obtain fault characteristic parameters. And analyzing the fault characteristic parameters to obtain sensitive characteristic parameters. And dividing the sensitive characteristic parameters into a training sample set and a testing sample set, optimizing the classifier by using the training sample set, and performing fault diagnosis on the fuel cell by using the optimized classifier by using the testing sample set. Therefore, the fault diagnosis can be accurately carried out on the fuel cell system, and the problems, even the breakdown, of the fuel cell system and the unpredictable loss and disasters caused by the untimely fault diagnosis of the fuel cell can be avoided.

title_en: Hollow anchor rod with geological detection and anchoring functions and exhaust grouting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hollow anchor rod with geological detection and anchoring functions and an exhaust grouting method thereof, wherein the hollow anchor rod comprises a shell expansion anchor head, an anchor rod, a shell expansion sheet, a shell expansion, a steel plug, a grout stop plug, a grouting pipe, a base plate, a nut and a plug; the exhaust grouting method comprises the following steps: when the hollow anchor rod with the geological detection and anchoring functions is used for a side wall or a part with an anchor hole inclined downwards, the hollow anchor rod with the geological detection and anchoring functions is firstly placed downwards into the anchor hole formed by a drill bit, the shell expansion anchor head is propped against the bottom of the anchor hole, and then, the processes of grouting in the anchor rod and slurry discharge and exhaust of an anchor hole opening are adopted; and (II) when the grouting device is used for the parts of the arch part or the anchor hole which are inclined upwards and have the elevation angle larger than 30 degrees, the grouting process of the grouting pipe at the anchor hole mouth and the grouting and exhausting process of the anchor head of the expanding shell are adopted. The invention has powerful anchoring function, can instantly reach the strength required by tensioning, is convenient and safe to operate, and reduces the safety risk of construction; the anchor head is flexible in opening size, a prediction induction chip is convenient to install, and the function of measuring geological disasters is achieved.

title_en: Hydraulic jet drilling small-radius radial slewing device and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and discloses a hydraulic jet drilling small-radius radial slewing device, wherein the hinge structure is hollow in the axial direction, the hinge structure is a one-way bending hinge, the rear end of the hinge structure is connected to the front end of an inner layer drill pipe through a movable bending joint, the bending direction of the movable bending joint and the slewing direction of the hinge structure are in the same plane, the hinge structure and the inner layer drill pipe are arranged in an outer layer drill pipe, the front end of the hinge structure is hinged with the outer layer drill pipe along the bending direction vertical to the hinge structure, a first drill pipe clamp is used for fixing the outer layer drill pipe and providing continuous forward thrust, and a second drill pipe clamp is used for clamping the inner layer drill pipe and providing continuous forward thrust to drive the hinge structure to radially slew. The device is mainly used for radial rotation in the underground coal seam hydraulic jet horizontal drilling process, and has the advantages of small-size drilling steering, simplicity in operation, easiness in control and the like.

title_en: Fire model and fire simulation method for lithium iron phosphate energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fire protection of new energy lithium iron phosphate energy storage power stations, and particularly relates to a fire model and a fire simulation method of a lithium iron phosphate energy storage power station, which comprise a battery module prefabricated cabin; the battery module frame is arranged in the battery module prefabricated cabin; the battery module is arranged in the battery module frame; the overcharging equipment is positioned outside the prefabricated cabin of the battery module and is connected with the battery module; the short-circuit equipment is positioned outside the prefabricated cabin of the battery module and is connected with the battery module; wherein, the number of the battery modules is 1 or 5 or more than 5, and all the battery modules are in a full charge state; defining 1 battery module as a module-level battery module; defining 5 and more than 5 battery modules as cluster-level battery modules; wherein, the module level battery module is directly arranged in the battery module frame; 5 battery modules in the cluster-level battery modules are arranged in a cross shape, and the rest battery modules are randomly arranged. The fire model and the fire simulation method can truly and effectively simulate the real working condition of the energy storage power station when a fire disaster occurs.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive control method for rock burst and gas composite disaster of thick and hard roof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a comprehensive prevention and control method for a thick and hard roof rock burst and gas composite disaster, and belongs to the technical field of prevention and control of mines and underground engineering. The method adopts large-aperture dense drilling holes to relieve pressure of a coal body, and simultaneously constructs small-aperture gas extraction drilling holes to extract gas from the coal body of a working face; and after a certain time, evaluating the treatment effect of the composite disaster on the working face, and if the evaluation reaches the standard, immediately starting the recovery of the working face. During the stoping period of the working face, adopting top plate advanced presplitting blasting to release pressure of the top plate of the working face; and if the gas concentration of the upper corner is still higher during the stoping period of the working face, adopting a goaf intubation extraction method. The invention can not only reduce the possibility of rock burst, but also effectively reduce the gas content of the working face, reduce the gas emission intensity of the working face during the stoping period, and has extremely high technology and economy.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Video production wizard program and system for disaster response education and training
title_ko: 재난 대응 교육 및 훈련용 영상 제작 마법사 프로그램 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a wizard program for producing a video for disaster response education and training and a system thereof. A method for a user to use the wizard program for producing a video for disaster response education and training and the system thereof comprises: a step that basic information of the user is inputted; a step that introductory video information is edited; a step that disaster education and training clip videos are selected and aligned; a step that images and voice data in each clip video are edited; and a step that the edited videos are played in advance before being stored.
