abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 대응 교육 및 훈련용 영상 제작 마법사 프로그램 및 그 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명은 사용자가 재난 대응 교육 및 훈련용 영상 제작 마법사 프로그램 및 그 시스템을 이용하는 방법에 있어서, 사용자의 기초 정보를 입력하는 단계; 인트로 소개 영상 정보를 편집하는 단계; 재난 교육 및 훈련 클립 영상을 선택하여 나열하는 단계; 각 클립 영상의 이미지와 음성 데이터를 편집하는 단계; 편집된 영상을 미리 보고 저장하는 단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: Explosion suppression experimental equipment for fire disaster of airplane bomb cabin
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion suppression experimental facilities of aircraft bomb compartment conflagration can carry out the experiment of bomb compartment conflagration dynamics research to and carry out aircraft fire protection system's experimental verification. The equipment comprises a cabin body frame, a main bomb cabin, a side bomb cabin, a cabin door, an ammunition dummy piece, an observation window, a pressure relief diaphragm, a lifting point of an upper cover of the main bomb cabin, a cabin door opening mechanism, a working ladder, a blow-off port at the bottom of the cabin body, a spray fire simulator interface, an oil pool fire module, a temperature measuring module, a heat flow measuring module, a pressure measuring module, a gas concentration measuring module, a fire extinguishing agent concentration testing interface and an image shooting module. Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses can be used for studying the capsule fire detection and the technique of putting out a fire, optimize the detection module and the module of putting out a fire that the capsule disposed to and novel detection, put out a fire, the validity of explosion suppression technique using in the aircraft capsule is verified, systematically provides the basis for the fire prevention explosion suppression design in capsule.
assignees: UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA;AVIC TIANJIN AVIATION ELECTRO MECH CO LTD

title_en: Moving water karst channel plugging negative pressure fluid carrying drilling hole feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a move water karst passageway shutoff negative pressure fluid and carry drilling and throw material device relates to mine water disaster curtain slip casting and administers and move water passageway and throw material shutoff technical field. Comprises a channel, a flow supply unit, a feeding unit and a monitoring unit; the channel sequentially comprises a reducing section, a jet flow section, a feeding section, a monitoring section, a bending section and a vertical section from back to front; the inlet of the reducer section is connected with the output pipeline of the flow supply unit; the monitoring unit can collect flow rate and pressure parameters of fluid in the flow supply, feeding and channel in real time, monitor aggregate and fluid conditions in the funnel, judge whether the grouting hole is blocked, and timely regulate and control flow supply and feeding construction parameters according to the blocking condition. The utility model has the characteristics of the slip casting hole can not block up, and it is good to throw material controllability, continuity and homogeneity, improves curtain slip casting engineering water shutoff efficiency of construction and quality by a wide margin, reduces engineering cost, reduces artifical intensity of labour, has considerable economic benefits and social.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Submarine landslide evolution process simulation system and experimental method based on transparent soil rotary water tank
abstract_en: A submarine landslide evolution process simulation system and an experimental method based on a transparent soil rotary water tank belong to the technical field of marine geological disasters and geotechnical engineering experiments, and comprise a rotary water tank system, a transparent soil simulation system and a control and data acquisition system. The rotary water tank system gives different speeds to the sample by controlling the motor, and the closed circular ring structure of the U-section rotary drum tank is used for meeting the requirement that the sliding distance is not limited; the transparent soil simulation system prepares a transparent sample with a tracer stain and a fluid environment similar to the physical and mechanical properties of a real subsoil layer, and realizes three-dimensional whole-course visualization of the inside, the outside and a water-soil interface in the sample evolution process; the control and data acquisition system realizes quantitative monitoring and data extraction in the evolution process through a three-dimensional laser slicing and digital image acquisition method. The experimental system provided by the invention has the advantages of controllable scale, visible evolution process and measurable image data, and can solve the problems that long-distance evolution experiments are difficult to develop, data acquisition is difficult, monitoring pictures are unclear and the like.

title_en: Smart Factory Energy Saving System Using IoT Platform
title_ko: IoT 플랫폼 기술을 활용한 스마트 팩토리의 에너지 절감시스템
abstract_en: The present invention can collectively manage equipment detection, monitoring, crime prevention, and disaster management based on three-dimensional equipment images collected by using a LiDAR sensor, and can increase energy saving efficiency by using a scenario prediction model suitable for the environment of manufacturers. A smart factory energy saving system comprises: a data collecting unit including a three-dimensional facility image generating unit generating a three-dimensional facility image by using a LiDAR sensor, and collecting data through a facility monitoring sensor and an actuator; a data relay unit converting and transmitting a data format of the three-dimensional facility image collected by the data collecting unit, and including a gateway transmitting output signals of the sensor and the actuator; an IoT platform detecting and monitoring field facilities of a manufacturer on the basis of the facility image data converted by a data format converting unit, collectively managing crime prevention and disaster, and setting a scenario prediction model for energy saving according to the reference model of a smart factory suitable for the environment of the manufacturer to integrally manage energy with respect to the field facilities; and an application unit processing indicators and data required for energy management, which are received from the IoT platform, and outputting the same on a screen.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 라이다 센서를 이용하여 수집한 3차원 설비영상을 기반으로 설비 감지, 모니터링, 방범 및 재해 관리를 총괄적으로 관리하고 제조기업의 환경에 맞는 시나리오 예측 모델을 이용하여 에너지 절감 효율을 향상할 수 있다. 
본 발명은 라이다 센서를 이용하여 3차원 설비영상을 생성하는 3차원 설비영상 생성부와, 설비 감시용 센서 및 액츄에이터를 통하여 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부; 상기 데이터 수집부에 의해 수집된 3차원 설비 영상의 데이터 포맷을 변환하여 전달하고, 상기 센서 및 액츄에이터의 출력 신호를 전달하는 게이트웨이를 구비한 데이터 중계부; 상기 데이터 포맷 변환부에 의해 변환된 설비 영상 데이터를 기반으로 제조기업의 현장 설비에 대한 설비 감지 및 모니터링을 수행하고 방범 및 재해 관리를 총괄적으로 관리함과 아울러 제조기업의 환경에 맞는 스마트 팩토리의 참조모델에 따라 에너지 절감을 위한 시나리오 예측 모델을 설정하여 현장 설비에 대하여 통합적으로 에너지를 관리하는 IoT 플랫폼; 및 상기 IoT 플랫폼으로부터 전송받은 에너지 관리에 필요한 지표와 데이터를 가공하여 화면으로 출력하는 어플리케이션부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: GANGNEUNG WONJU NAT UNIV IND ACAD COOP GROUP;WIKEY CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic optimization method for repairing large-area pipeline of post-disaster water supply system
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic optimization method for repairing a large-area pipeline of a post-disaster water supply system, which comprises the following steps: determining a decision variable when repairing starts; determining a repair operation set of all damaged pipelines at the moment; calculating a repair scheme with the optimal time; driving a model to simulate the repairing operation by using the pressure of a water supply network; updating a decision variable; and judging whether a new damaged pipeline appears in the updated decision variables, and repeatedly executing the process until all damaged components are repaired. The invention is an important supplement to the research field of recovery of the post-disaster water supply pipe network, provides an important technical support for quick response and repair of the post-disaster water supply pipe network, and has good popularization and practical engineering application values.

title_en: Fire simulation training device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a fire simulation training device, includes: the device comprises a fire curtain wall, a fuel storage module, a fuel supply module, an ignition module and a control module; the control module is connected with the fuel storage module, the fuel supply module and the ignition module; the fuel storage module includes: gas storage unit and fuel oil storage unit, the fuel supply module includes: a gas supply unit and a fuel supply unit; the fuel gas storage unit is connected with the fuel gas supply unit; the ignition module ignites the liquefied gas supplied by the fuel gas supply unit, the burning liquefied gas ignites the atomized diesel oil supplied by the fuel oil supply unit, and the atomized diesel oil is burnt on the burning surface of the flame curtain wall. Therefore, the mode of firstly igniting the natural gas and then igniting the atomized diesel oil by utilizing the combusted natural gas is adopted, so that the atomized diesel oil is adopted for combustion during combustion, and high-temperature and dense smoke environment is provided when an actual fire disaster occurs.
assignees: BEIJING HUAYU TONGZHOU DYNAMO ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Fire resistance test device for reinforced concrete member
abstract_en: A fire resistance test device for a reinforced concrete member relates to the technical field of underground engineering structure disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a test device for simulating fire response behavior of a reinforced concrete slab and wall combined member of an underground concrete rectangular structure under the action of high temperature. The fire disaster combustion furnace comprises a component, a fire disaster combustion furnace, a fire disaster burner in the furnace and a data acquisition device, wherein the fire disaster combustion furnace is provided with a furnace body. The key technology is that the member is a T-shaped combined member formed by a reinforced concrete slab and a reinforced concrete wall, the member is placed at the upper part of a fire furnace to form a closed hearth, a counter-force loading device is installed above the member, and a boundary restraining device is arranged on the side edge of the member. The utility model has the beneficial effect of having solved among the prior art not considering under the conflagration influence scheduling problem between restraint effect, loading effect and the adjacent component that underground concrete rectangular structure receives.

title_en: Mine disaster escape drilling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster escape drilling system and a method, relating to the technical field of mine safety emergency, wherein the system comprises: the scene setting client is used for setting scene data of disaster escape drilling; the drilling server is used for establishing a mine scene model according to the scene type and calculating dynamic evolution information of the disaster; the at least two participating clients are used for displaying the mine scene model and the dynamic evolution process of the disaster by adopting a virtual simulation technology, and also used for collecting operation information of the participating personnel when the participating personnel drill with the corresponding participating clients and sending the operation information to the drilling server; the drilling server is also used for synchronizing the operation information of each participant on each participant client and the scene setting client. The invention has the beneficial effects that: therefore, the participants can quickly become familiar with the evolution law of the underground environment and the disaster, and the psychological bearing capacity of the participants for dealing with the emergency is exercised, so that the escape efficiency and the escape success rate are improved.
assignees: SHENHUA HOLLYSYS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large-mining-width thick coal seam mining composite grouting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses a large-mining-width thick coal seam mining composite grouting method, which comprises the following steps: distributing drill holes from the ground surface, and enabling the drill holes to penetrate through a plurality of target separation layer areas in overlying strata above the goaf from top to bottom; performing composite grouting filling on the target separation layer areas through drilling holes; and the target separation layer area is a separation layer space below a key layer in the overlying strata above the goaf. According to the composite grouting method for mining the large-mining-width thick coal seam, the grouting filling is carried out on the separation space, the drill hole in the earth surface can only penetrate through the separation space without penetrating through the goaf below, and the drilling engineering amount can be reduced, so that the engineering amount and the engineering cost can be reduced, and the method is more suitable for mining and governing of the large-mining-width thick coal seam; and grouting filling is carried out in a plurality of separation space in overlying strata above the goaf, so that the grouting amount and the grouting-mining ratio can be improved, the requirement of earth surface subsidence reduction is better met, and the grouting efficiency is improved.
assignees: GENERAL PROSPECTING INSTITUTE CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Debris flow easiness prediction method based on GIS (geographic information System) and Logistic regression model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow vulnerability prediction method based on a GIS (geographic information system) and a Logistic regression model, which comprises nine steps of determining an evaluation unit, selecting and processing evaluation parameters, constructing a training sample set, carrying out cluster analysis, carrying out factor analysis, establishing the Logistic regression model, analyzing the Logistic regression model, classifying evaluation results and predicting the vulnerability of debris flow disasters in an area to be evaluated. The method has the advantages of higher evaluation precision and stronger pertinence, and is mainly used for predicting the easiness of the debris flow.

title_en: Disaster response information management system according to the report of disaster occurrence
title_ko: 재난 발생 신고의 수보 정보에 따른 재난 대응 정보 관리 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a responder with a specific and efficient disaster response scenario matched to a disaster situation based on acquired receipt information to efficiently apply an automatic receipt and disaster response system to an existing disaster response institution. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a disaster response information management system according to receipt information of a report of a disaster occurrence is realized by a computing device including one or more processors and one or more memories to store instructions executable by the processors, and comprises: a receipt information generation unit to generate receipt information including at least feature information of a disaster occurrence place and feature information of disaster occurrence properties as information generated by using information inputted via a receipt interface executed and outputted by a receiver terminal including a menu for outputting question information matched to information to be collected to a reporter for a disaster occurrence response when a disaster occurs and inputting answer information for the question information; a response scenario selection unit to use the receipt information generated by the receipt information generation unit to select response scenario information corresponding to the receipt information in response scenario information which is guide information in accordance with the disaster occurrence place and the occurrence properties as guide information supplied to the responder for a previously stored disaster response; and a response information transmission unit to transmit the response scenario information selected by the response scenario selection unit to a responder terminal dispatched a site for a disaster occurrence response.
abstract_ko: 취득된 수보 정보를 바탕으로 대응자에게 재난 상황에 매칭되는 구체적이고 효율적인 재난 대응 시나리오를 제공하여, 자동 수보 및 재난 대응 시스템을 기존의 재난 대응 기관에 효율적으로 적용할 수 있도록 하는 기술을 제공하기 위해 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난 발생 신고의 수보 정보에 따른 재난 대응 정보 관리 시스템은, 하나 이상의 프로세서 및 상기 프로세서에서 수행 가능한 명령들을 저장하는 하나 이상의 메모리를 포함하는 컴퓨팅 장치로 구현되는 재난 발생 신고의 수보 정보에 따른 재난 대응 정보 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난 발생 시 재난 발생 대응을 위해 신고자에게 수집해야 할 정보에 매칭되는 질의 정보의 출력 및 질의 정보에 대한 답변 정보의 입력이 가능한 메뉴가 포함된 수보자 단말에서 실행 및 출력되는 수보 인터페이스를 통해 입력된 정보를 이용하여 생성되는 정보로서, 적어도 재난 발생 장소의 특징 정보 및 재난 발생 속성의 특징 정보를 포함하는 수보 정보를 생성하는 수보 정보 생성부; 수보 정보 생성부에 따라 생성된 수보 정보를 이용하여 기 저장된 재난 대응을 위하여 대응자에게 제공되는 안내 정보로서, 재난 발생 장소 및 발생 속성에 따른 안내 정보인 대응 시나리오 정보 중, 수보 정보에 대응되는 대응 시나리오 정보를 선택하는 대응 시나리오 선택부; 및 대응 시나리오 선택부에 따라서 선택된 대응 시나리오 정보를 재난발생 대응을 위해 현장에 파견된 대응자 단말에 전송하는 대응 정보 전송부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Novel artificial skin
abstract_en: The product aims at the fields of tissue engineering and medical repair, and the fiber membrane artificial skin is manufactured by using a material with high biocompatibility. Is suitable for treating skin injury and chronic ulcer caused by various disaster events at the first time. The product uses the rapid prototyping technology to prepare the artificial skin with a multilayer structure, and the structure and the function can be changed according to specific injury conditions. The bacterial cellulose, PLGA and hyaluronic acid are respectively adopted as raw materials, a real skin structure is simulated, the stability of a wound microenvironment is kept, and the wound dressing not only can be used for solving the problems of skin burn and mechanical injury, but also can be used for treating skin ulcer and difficult healing caused by type II diabetes, liver and kidney dysfunction and the like.

title_en: Underground coal field fire area typical product dynamic precipitation and release simulation experiment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation experiment system for dynamic precipitation and release of typical products in an underground coal field fire area, wherein the simulation experiment device for the dynamic products in the underground coal field fire area is divided into a crack-containing coal seam geological module, a ventilation module, a fire area temperature testing module and a product detection module according to the experiment principle, each module is arranged in an external protective layer, the ventilation module is used for introducing hot air flow and proper oxygen into the fractured coal seam geological module which is designed for air leakage fracture in advance by adding an air inlet lane of a heating zone, the coal seam geological module containing the cracks is connected with the product detection module through the return airway, and the simulation experiment system for analyzing the characteristics of the evolution products of the coal field fire zone is constructed, so that the understanding of the development law of the coal fire is deepened, theoretical support is provided for making fire prevention and extinguishing measures in a targeted manner, and the method has very important significance for coal fire control, disaster prevention and control and the like.

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a crowd evacuation simulation method and a crowd evacuation simulation system, wherein a scene grid is discretized; initializing pedestrian particles; imparting a charge to each grid; the electric charge carried by the moving pedestrian particles is changed and is mapped into a time-varying field, and the density change of different degrees is realized by using the density degree of medium potential lines in the time-varying field to reflect the change of the positions of the pedestrian particles; the improved social force model introduces the attraction of the exit and the attraction of the fellows, and respectively describes the attraction of the exit to the pedestrians and the grouping phenomenon of the pedestrians; and controlling the pedestrian particles to move to the exit by an optimal path by utilizing the time-varying density field and combining with an improved social force model, and continuously updating the crowd density condition in the scene through the change of the density degree of the equipotential lines until the crowd density in the scene and outside the exit is 0 to finish evacuation. The density field is combined with electromagnetism in physics, the density change of people in the scene is reflected by the density change of the equipotential lines, the time and the intuition are more saved, and the evacuation guidance effect is improved.

title_en: Method for predicting rail traffic stream of people through deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to people flow prediction of a traffic center, in particular to a method for predicting rail traffic people flow through deep learning; it comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing data; s2 training a neural network; s3 generates a predicted result: importing the heat flow tensor matrix of the first t moments into a trained neural network model, generating prediction results of the human flow at the last k moments, multiplying the prediction results of the human flow at the last k moments by weather variables, adopting an official weather forecasting department to predict the weather at the last k moments, and assigning values to each weather, namely the weather variables, wherein the weather variables are clear/cloudy, light rain is 0.9, medium rain is 0.7, heavy rain/rain and snow is 0.5, and the disaster weather is 0.3; and (3) carrying out artificial prediction correction on the generated prediction result, namely combining the prediction result with the influence of official weather forecast on the human flow, so that the final prediction result is influenced by the weather forecast and is relatively consistent with real data.

title_en: Microseismic signal identification method based on multi-mode optimization and ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microseismic signal identification method based on multi-mode optimization and ensemble learning, which realizes classification of microseismic signals, thereby completing more accurate and timely early warning of impact ground pressure disasters. Firstly, determining sampling multiplying power according to the unbalanced rate of a microseismic training sample set, and realizing generation of a subclass sample based on SMOTE; secondly, performing extraction for multiple times by adopting a replacement sampling mode to obtain a plurality of sub-training sample sets, and training a plurality of weak classifiers on each sub-training sample set; thirdly, selecting the individual with the optimal classification performance as a final integrated individual according to the classification result on each sub-training sample set; and finally, removing redundant integrated weak classifier individuals by adopting a multi-mode optimization technology, and selecting the optimal weak classifier combination to participate in integration. The invention fully considers the unbalanced characteristic of the microseismic signals, utilizes the multi-modal optimization technology to select the weak classifier individuals, searches for the individuals with large differences to participate in integration, reduces the influence of redundant individuals on the performance of the integrated learner, improves the classification accuracy of the microseismic signals, and provides more powerful support for timely and effective early warning of the rock burst disaster.

title_en: Waterproof backfire early warning device based on tumbler principle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof backfire early warning device based on tumbler principle can increase fire fighter heavy burden, drilling when solving prior art and acquire the backfire parameter and waste time and energy to influence the backfire and judge efficiency and waterproof performance poor problem of fragile backfire parameter check out test set when water spray disaster relief. The utility model comprises a main body of a waterproof backfire early warning device, a gas detection device and a handheld early warning device; the waterproof backfire early warning device main body comprises a hollow shell, a balancing weight, a ventilation bent pipe, an air pump and a waterproof breathable film, wherein the bottom of the outer wall of the ventilation bent pipe is tightly attached to the top of the outer wall of the hollow shell, and the gas detection device is arranged at the inner top of the ventilation bent pipe; the handheld early warning device comprises a single chip microcomputer, a second wireless signal transceiver, a buzzer and a liquid crystal control display screen. The utility model discloses can effectively reduce fire fighter's heavy burden, effectively improve and acquire the efficiency of judging the flashback parameter, waterproof performance is good simultaneously, can effectively protect the electrical equipment who acquires the judgement flashback parameter.

title_en: Applying machine learning algorithms to climate change data and animal species frequency as a learning data: Thousand distance eyes modeling
title_ko: 기후 변화량 데이터와 동물 종 빈도의 학습데이터에 기계학습 알고리즘 적용: 천리안 모델링
abstract_en: The present invention relates to clairvoyant modeling for predicting weather or change of nature from climate data and animal species distribution data, and more particularly, to a method for using merged data of a binomial distribution label and a polynomial distribution predictive secondary value as training data by using a machine learning algorithm to predict natural disaster by quantifying distribution of species since animals have certain patterns. Therefore, the modeling suggests that machine learning for the patterns could be a global project, and quantifies animal senses by making correlations between animals and natural environment into data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기후 데이터와 동물 종 분포 데이터에서 날씨 혹은 자연 변화량 예측 알고리즘 모델링 적용 방법인 천리안(천리밖은 내다보는 눈) 모델링에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 기계학습 알고리즘을 활용하여, 이항식 분포 라벨과 다항식 분포 예측치 보조값을 활용한 병합 데이터를 학습데이터로 활용할 수 있게 하는 방법으로 동물도 일정한 패턴을 그리며, 자연 재해를 예측할 수 있게 종 분포도가 수치화 될 수 있음을 예측하는 연구이다. 그 패턴 기전에 대한 기계학습을 범세계적인 프로젝트로 관철시킬 필요가 있다는 가능성을 시사하고 또한, 동물과 자연환경의 상관관계를 데이터로 만들어 동물적 감각을 단위로 수치화 시키는 모델링 발명이다.

title_en: Method for Providing Inundation Simulation In Coastal Urban Area and Computer Program Therefore
title_ko: 해안도시지역 내 범람 모의방법 및 그를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an inundation simulation method in a coastal urban area and a computer program therefor. The inundation simulation method in a coastal urban area numerically models and provides an inundation phenomenon in the coastal urban area in accordance with a tsunami invasion through application of a finite value method and a well-balanced method by using a shallow water equation as a governing equation so as to more effectively perform evaluation and prediction with regard to a flood disaster generated in coastal and continental urban areas.
abstract_ko: 본 실시예는 천수방정식을 지배방정식으로 하고, 유한체적법과 Well-balanced 기법의 적용을 통해 해일 내습에 따른 해안도시 지역 내 범람현상을 수치적으로 모형화하여 제공함으로써 해안 및 내륙 도시지역에서 발생하는 홍수재해에 대한 평가와 예측이 보다 효율적으로 이루어질 수 있도록 하는 해안도시지역 내 범람 모의방법 및 그를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method and system for managing an emergency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for managing an emergency in cases where there is a need for an evacuation, in a real scenario, or for training or a drill, which controls and optimizes actions aimed at combating disasters and escape routes from environments, keeping the Emergency Posts and Instructions Schedule updated dynamically, addressing the movement and the conditions of people in their work routines, the training certificates that are held, personal assessments of emergencies witnessed or training sessions attended, the condition and availability of group protective equipment, the availability of rescue equipment, whether the vessel is stable, and weather conditions. The system uses a control and monitoring module that communicates with the back-up safety module, authenticated computers and portable modules or modules installed in different environments to advise as to the emergency situation, weather conditions, the stability status of the vessel and modules for interfacing with the people onboard and for carrying out scan searches with cameras in order to detect the presence of people and protective and rescue equipment and the status of escape routes and zones.

title_en: Method for quantifying action degree of flood-causing factors of coastal cities and dividing flood-causing factors
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster prevention and reduction, provides a method for quantifying and dividing disaster-causing factors of flood and disaster reduction of coastal cities, and provides a more detailed scientific basis for flood prevention and disaster reduction of coastal cities. According to the technical scheme, the method comprises the steps of utilizing a flood simulation model to simulate different rainfall-tide level combination scene groups to obtain area submerging ranges under different combination working conditions, evaluating the disaster-causing degree of rainfall and tide levels to different drainage subsystems according to a quantitative method, and carrying out flood-causing factor zoning on each drainage subsystem on the basis. The method is mainly applied to occasions for quantifying the action degree of flood-causing factors of coastal cities.

title_en: High-precision format simulation method for one-dimensional ice-water coupled motion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision format simulation method for one-dimensional ice water coupling motion, and belongs to the field of forecasting of river ice disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining boundary conditions, controlling an equation, uniformly dispersing ice-water coupling motion, calculating surface flux, calculating shallow water wave velocity under the ice-water coupling condition and calculating a high-precision format. The method uniformly disperses ice and hydrodynamic equations into a high-precision Godunov format, calculates the interface flux by adopting an HLL approximate Riemann solution, replaces the average water depth of a section with equivalent water depth, performs piecewise linear reconstruction on basic variables of each unit in space, and improves the precision of the numerical solution to second order integrally by adopting a prediction-correction method in time. The high-precision format simulation method for ice-water coupled motion provided by the invention has higher forecasting precision on the water level and the ice thickness of the riverway in the ice season, particularly, the equivalent water depth method is adopted to replace the average water depth method to calculate the wave velocity of shallow water, the water level forecasting precision can be obviously improved, and the research result has great significance on preventing and controlling the ice disaster of the riverway.
assignees: CHINA WATER NORTHEASTERN INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Distributed modular locomotive intelligent fire prevention and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed modular locomotive intelligent fire prevention and control system, which comprises: a server, a plurality of onboard processors, a plurality of sensors, and a plurality of actuators; the vehicle-mounted processor is used for receiving the environmental parameters sent by the sensors and obtaining the fire disaster grade according to the environmental parameters; receiving the weight correction value sent by the server, recalculating the fire level according to the weight correction value and the current environmental parameter, and controlling the actuator according to the fire level; and the server is used for receiving the environmental parameters and the fire grades sent by the vehicle-mounted processor, storing the environmental parameters and the fire grades, training the BP neural network according to the environmental parameters, the historical environmental parameters, the fire and fire historical data to obtain the weight correction value of the environmental parameters to the fire grades, and sending the weight correction value to the vehicle-mounted processor. The invention improves the accuracy of fire prevention and control and better ensures the operation safety of the locomotive.

title_en: Cloud computing platform-oriented data security emergency drilling method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a data security emergency drilling method and system for a cloud computing platform, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a plan task tree model; constructing a virtual machine exception record model; based on a plan task tree model and a virtual machine abnormal record model, performing data security emergency drilling, wherein the emergency drilling comprises the following steps: configuring a disaster recovery plan; generating a drilling scene; executing and monitoring a plan; and generating a drilling report. Based on the scheme of the application, a user can flexibly create, edit and start a multi-level drilling plan, the drilling environment deployed on the isolation network can keep the consistency with the production environment, the calculation and storage resources can be asymmetrically configured, and meanwhile the capability of switching actual services from the production system to the drilling system is achieved.
assignees: BEIJING HUADIAN TIANREN ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rail transit emergency simulation evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rail transit, and particularly relates to a rail transit emergency simulation method and system. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out simulation based on the basic data to obtain a simulation result; based on the simulation result, calculating and evaluating the emergency response and the operation and maintenance efficiency, wherein the calculating and evaluating the emergency response and the operation and maintenance efficiency comprises the following steps: acquiring emergency response and operation and maintenance efficiency; acquiring an index improvement rate; and (6) carrying out analysis and evaluation. The invention can simultaneously support a plurality of rail transit systems and a plurality of specialties under the condition of a complex network, and can realize the gradual change of a rail transit operation mode from single-mode relatively independent operation to multi-mode comprehensive operation.

title_en: Fire-fighting training exercise method and system based on three-dimensional modeling
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire-fighting training exercise method and a fire-fighting training exercise system based on three-dimensional modeling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a three-dimensional real scene integrated model; s2, performing functional partitioning on each scene in the three-dimensional real scene integrated model according to the industry field and the application of each scene; s3, constructing a three-dimensional fire-fighting role model; s4, constructing a three-dimensional fire disaster model according to the fire disaster simulation requirement; and S5, performing three-dimensional simulation of the fire disaster by using the three-dimensional real scene integrated model, the three-dimensional fire-fighting role model and the three-dimensional fire disaster model, and generating a fire-fighting knowledge model. The system comprises a three-dimensional scene management module, a three-dimensional role management module, a three-dimensional fire disaster management module, a function partition editing module, a three-dimensional fire disaster simulation module and a fire fighting knowledge model management module. The method and the system of the invention combine the actual fire scene with the fire fighting process, improve the fire fighting emergency and treatment level, and have universal and wide application prospect.

title_en: Performance test device for simulating unsaturated roadbed of airport under dynamic and static loads
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a performance test device of a simulated airport unsaturated roadbed under dynamic and static loads, which comprises a model box and a loading device, wherein the model box is a box body with an upper opening and is used for filling unsaturated roadbed soil bodies and roadbed materials in layers, so that the unsaturated roadbed soil bodies and the roadbed materials can keep consistent with the actual engineering of the airport, monitoring equipment for testing parameters required by the roadbed performance can be respectively arranged in each layer of soil body, a water injection hole is arranged in the middle part of the side wall of the model box, and water can be injected into a middle interlayer of the roadbed soil body for multiple times to change the water content of the roadbed soil body; the loading device comprises two sets, each set of loading device comprises a support frame and load applying equipment, the two support frames are arranged in parallel, the two load applying equipment are respectively fixed on the bottom surfaces of the support frames, the two ends of each support frame are respectively detachably fixed on the support plates on the two sides of the opening surface of the model box, the load applying equipment is used for providing layered roadbed soil body compaction load and applying roadbed load, roadbed performance changes under the conditions of different water contents and applied load are monitored, and roadbed hidden disasters are effectively revealed.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH;BEIJING NEW AIRPORT CONSTRUCTION HEADQUARTERS;CHINA AIRPORT CONSTRUCTION GROUP CORP

title_en: Optical remote sensing image water area classification method based on feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for classifying an optical remote sensing image water area based on feature extraction, which mainly solves the problems that the existing water area classification cannot utilize water area global information and has low classification fineness. The method comprises the following implementation steps: training a convolution neural network model for detecting a remote sensing image water area; detecting a test image by using the trained model to obtain a test water area set; extracting a training water area set in the existing data set; respectively marking the communication areas of the test water area set and the training water area set to obtain a test communication area and a training communication area, and respectively extracting the characteristics of the two communication areas to obtain a test characteristic set and a training characteristic set; training a random forest model by using a training feature set; inputting the test feature set into a random forest to obtain an initial classification result; and optimizing the initial classification result by using a constraint rule to obtain a final water classification result. The invention has high classification precision and high calculation speed, and can be used for fishery resource investigation, geological disaster monitoring and homeland resource investigation.

title_en: parallel intelligent emergency cooperation method, system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to  parallel intelligent emergency cooperative methods, systems and electronic equipment, which comprises the steps of establishing an artificial system model based on visual space-time fusion, carrying out personnel group perception and evacuation channel traffic state detection based on cross-video geographical intelligent fusion analysis on a space to be evacuated through the artificial system model, establishing a three-dimensional virtual simulation environment of the space to be evacuated, establishing a multi-intelligent-body evacuation simulation model based on personnel distribution based on historical disaster environment simulation and danger degree situation analysis, carrying out evacuation simulation through the multi-intelligent-body evacuation simulation model, generating an optimal evacuation scheme prediction result, establishing a parallel execution cooperative system based on real-time monitoring and augmented reality visualization for deduction simulation and dynamic evacuation simulation, and generating an optimal evacuation scheme by combining the prediction result of a calculation experiment system.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: Real-time evacuation guide system based on regional field
abstract_en: A real-time evacuation guidance system based on a regional farm, comprising: intelligence information real-time acquisition subsystem, simulation control center and the emergent sparse real-time guidance subsystem of intelligence, wherein: the intelligent information real-time acquisition subsystem acquires information comprehensively and in real time, is connected with the simulation and simulation control center and transmits dynamic information, and the simulation and simulation control center adopts the field technology to perform simulation of personnel evacuation, plans an optimal evacuation route for each person and further generates an evacuation instruction.

title_en: Dam break flood demonstration early warning method and platform based on BIM technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam-break flood demonstration early warning method based on a BIM technology, which specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a three-dimensional solid terrain model and a building model; then calculating dam break development process parameters and dam break flood parameters, and establishing a three-dimensional simulation model of dam break; combining the obtained three-dimensional solid terrain model, the building model, the three-dimensional simulation model of dam break and the particle fluid system to realize the real simulation of the dam break process and the flood evolution; and finally, animation production and rendering are carried out on the simulation process, and a three-dimensional real dam-break flood evolution animation is obtained. The invention also discloses a demonstration early warning platform based on the method. The method can simulate the dam break process and the flood submerging range of the dam, and intuitively know the evacuation of residents and the submerging condition of important buildings when the dam break is faced by utilizing the animation. Aiming at the flood inundation process after the simulated dam break, risk analysis and technical evaluation data are provided for hydraulic engineering construction, design and construction units.

title_en: Different-scale coal fire disaster thermal power process simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for simulating and testing the thermodynamic process of coal fire disasters with different scales, wherein the testing device comprises a physical similarity simulation test bed, a transparent heat insulation cover, a wireless ad hoc network temperature measurement system, a particle radiation monitoring stress state system and a gas monitoring system; the invention can simulate the caving process of the goaf, simulate the coal field fire evolution process, realize the coal field fire and the mine goaf evolution process under different conditions, and realize the real-time monitoring of the distribution of the temperature field, the distribution and development rule of the coal rock cracks and the change rule of the coal rock crack air supply channel in the coal field fire and the mine goaf evolution process through the wireless ad hoc network temperature measuring system, the particle radiation stress monitoring state system and the gas monitoring system.

title_en: Disaster occurrence tracing method based on BIM + GIS fusion technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering, and particularly relates to a deep foundation pit disaster occurrence tracing method based on a BIM + GIS fusion technology, which comprises the specific steps of constructing a GIS + BIM disaster tracing platform; the method comprises the steps that a geological data module, a design data module, a construction data module and a supervision data module are arranged in a GIS + BIM disaster tracing platform, each module is provided with information capable of being called by the GIS + BIM disaster tracing platform, an analysis model module is arranged in the GIS + BIM disaster tracing platform, the GIS + BIM platform calls the information of the geological data module, the design data module, the construction data module and the supervision data module, the disaster reason is traced through simulation calculation, and the traced result and an analysis conclusion form a deep foundation pit disaster tracing report.
assignees: UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGY;SHANDONG BUREAU OF CHINA METALLURGICAL GEOLOGY BUREAU;QINGDAO FIRST MUNICIPAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting coal and gas outburst and secondary disaster danger area range thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting coal and gas outburst and secondary disaster danger area ranges, which belongs to the field of coal and gas disaster prediction and comprises the following steps: dividing the coal and gas outburst disaster-causing range into an impact disaster-causing dangerous area and a secondary disaster dangerous area; determining identification indexes and threshold values of disaster-causing dangerous areas; researching parameters of a mine to be analyzed; obtaining a time-space evolution rule of the disaster-causing danger area identification index through coal and gas outburst dynamic effect simulation and inversion; calculating and verifying a time-space evolution rule highlighting the disaster-causing danger area identification index; and determining the range of dangerous areas of outburst impact disaster, outburst induction gas explosion and outburst induction coal dust explosion. The invention can be used for optimizing the disaster-outburst ventilation capability of the mine and preventing outburst secondary disaster accidents.

title_en: Electric power disaster monitoring and simulating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power disaster monitoring and simulating system, which comprises: disaster monitoring device, electric wire netting controlling means, electric wire netting analytical equipment and dispatch analogue means. The simulation scheduling device has the function of large power grid multistage scheduling combined anti-accident exercise, greatly improves the capability of various levels of power grid scheduling operators for managing power grid operation and processing large power grid accidents in a coordinated manner, and well meets the requirements of extra-high voltage alternating current-direct current interconnected large power grid real-time disaster monitoring and training simulation.

title_en: Subway escaping experience device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a subway escape experience device, which comprises a carriage, display equipment, matched sound effect equipment, simulated firing equipment, a fan, a smoke sprayer, a car lamp, a carriage door with door control anti-pinch equipment, an emergency escape gate, control equipment and a power supply, wherein the carriage is manufactured according to the actual size of a subway carriage; the evacuation platform and the tunnel escape door are arranged on the track side outside the carriage; the display equipment, the surrounding field sound effect equipment, the simulation ignition equipment, the fan, the smoke sprayer, the door control anti-pinch equipment and the power supply are all connected with the control equipment. The device can simulate real subway faults and escape self-rescue scenes, achieves the purpose of safety experience education for experience persons when the experience persons take the subways, and improves self-protection consciousness and safety consciousness of the experience persons when the experience persons take the subways.
assignees: TAIZHOU RUI CHENG AUTOMATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Coal seam fracturing anti-reflection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a coal seam fracturing anti-reflection device belongs to colliery excavation working face calamity prevention and control technical field. The method solves the problem of poor fracturing effect of disaster prevention and control of the existing coal mine excavation working face. The high-pressure hydraulic pump is communicated with the shaft hole, a first side hole, a third side hole and a second side hole are formed in the drill rod, a first sliding sleeve in sliding fit with the drill rod is arranged at the first side hole, a first expansion capsule and a first locking structure are arranged on the first sliding sleeve in a surrounding mode, a first connecting structure used for communicating the first side hole with an inner cavity of the first expansion capsule is arranged on the first sliding sleeve, a second sliding sleeve in sliding fit with the drill rod is arranged at the second side hole, a second expansion capsule and a second locking structure used for fixing the second sliding sleeve are arranged on the second sliding sleeve in a surrounding mode, a second connecting structure used for communicating the second side hole with an inner cavity of the second expansion capsule is arranged on the second sliding sleeve, and a pressure release valve is arranged in the third side hole. The utility model has the advantages of the fracturing is effectual.

title_en: Novel geological disaster bare rock greening treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel naked rock afforestation treatment equipment of geological disasters, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the left side fixedly connected with water tank of box to the right side fixedly connected with of box case that fertilizes, the fixed surface of box is connected with the frame to the bottom of water tank and case that fertilizies all communicates there is the discharging pipe, two the equal fixedly connected with fixed block in surface of discharging pipe to the equal fixedly connected with dead lever in top of two fixed blocks, the utility model relates to an afforestation treatment equipment technical field. This novel geological disasters bare rock afforestation treatment equipment through the fixed surface of box is connected with the frame, and the set is dug a hole, is watered and fertilizes as an organic wholely, makes things convenient for the workman to carry out carrying of instrument, has also facilitated the operation simultaneously, and the operability is stronger, and the bottom through water tank and fertilization case all communicates there is the discharging pipe, can control the position of watering and fertilizeing, and the support column of stability can improve the stability of whole device when drilling.

title_en: A Tank Warfare Training system
title_ko: 전차 교전 훈련시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tank battle training system, comprising a laser reception device, a master communication device, a central communication device, and a control device, which are connected to one another in a wire-based or wireless network. In particular, the tank battle training system comprises: a laser reception device which expresses a battle state between tanks in real-time; a master communication device; a central communication device; and a control device. Accordingly, the present invention provides a system which enables an effective battle training by expressing the battle state between the tanks in real-time through the laser reception device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전차 교전 훈련시스템에 관한 것으로, 레이저 수신장치, 마스터 통신장치, 중앙 통신장치, 관제장치가  유, 무선망으로 연결된 전차 교전 훈련시스템에 있어서, 전차의 전, 후, 좌, 우, 중앙 및 특정 위치에 다수개가 부착되어 상대 전차에서 발사되는 거리측정용 1050nm ∼ 1550nm 파장의 레이저를 거리측정기를 구동하여 해당 레이저를 수신, 분석하여 분석된 레이저를 통해 어느 부위에 상대전차의 레이저가 조준하고 격발여부를 분석하여 마스터 통신장치로 전송하여 전차 상호간의 교전상태를 실시간 표현하는 레이저 수신장치; 상기 레이저 수신장치에서 전송되는 레이저 분석결과를 무선으로 수신하여 연결된 출력부를 통하여 해당 분석된 레이저 데이터의 가. 부를 표시등으로 표시하거나 수신된 레이저 데이터를 중앙 통신장치로 전송하는 마스터 통신장치; 마스터 통신장치에서 전송되는 레이저 수신장치의 수신, 분석결과에 따른 전자 교전 상태정보를 수신하여 전자교전 훈련상황을 실시간 확인할 수 있도록 지휘관이 속한 관제장치로 전송하는 중앙 통신장치; 및 전차 교전 훈련의 전과정을 통제 및 제어하는 통제실에 설치하여 중앙 통신장치에서 전송되는 데이터를 유선으로 수신하여 수신된 데이터를 분석하여 교전훈련 상황을 상호 교전화면을 그래픽을 통하여 전체적으로 표시되도록 구성하여 지휘관에게 실시간으로 제공하고 그 데이터를 데이터베이스화하여 저장하고 이를 보존하는 관제장치;를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: End-to-end mobile robot path navigation simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for simulating end-to-end mobile robot path navigation, which are characterized in that evacuation scene parameter information is set, an evacuation scene model, a character model and a robot model with a camera are established, and the character model and the robot model are led into the evacuation scene model; acquiring mapping relation data between images shot by a robot model in the walking process in an evacuation scene and a steering value, and establishing a data set containing the mapping relation; training and optimizing a convolutional neural network model by using mapping relation data in the data set, and obtaining a steering value by using the optimized convolutional neural network according to input image data to perform path navigation of the mobile robot; according to the method, the original picture is directly used as training data to obtain the turning angle value of the robot leader model, so that path navigation in a strange environment is rapidly achieved, and people can be rapidly led to evacuate.

title_en: Small space experience training facility for simulating rescue after earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a narrow space experience training facility for simulating rescue after earthquake disaster, which comprises a strip foundation under a wall, a narrow space structure, a pipeline experience room and a training tunnel, wherein the strip foundation is arranged under the wall; narrow and small space structures, constructional column and pipeline experience room all install bar foundation upper end under the wall, and narrow and small space structures includes first narrow and small space structures, the narrow and small space structures of second and the narrow and small space structures of third, and first narrow and small space structures, the narrow and small space structures of second and the narrow and small space structures of third all experience the room symmetry about the pipeline and be provided with two and all experience the room intercommunication with the pipeline, the room is experienced to the pipeline is provided with threely. The invention can carry out special training of narrow space traffic, forcible entry, wounded carrying and the like on the premise of ensuring the safety of rescue personnel, further improves the comprehensive rescue capacity of the rescue personnel, reserves larger space in the pipeline experience room, and can build scenes after earthquake, such as classrooms, living rooms, bedrooms and the like.

title_en: System for indoor rainfall simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for indoor rainfall simulation, which comprises a rainfall support device, a hose, a water pipe, a water pump, a test bed positioned below the rainfall support device and a water tank positioned below the test bed, wherein the rainfall support device 1 is a stainless steel frame, three shunt rods arranged in parallel are arranged at the top of the stainless steel frame, a plurality of vertically downward shunt tubes are arranged on the shunt rods, a spray head is arranged at the bottom of each shunt tube, the water inlet end and the water outlet end of the water pump are respectively communicated with the water tank and the shunt tubes through the hose and the water pipe, and a drain pipe communicated with the top of the water tank is arranged at the bottom of the test bed. Compared with the prior art, the invention can carry out geological disaster tests such as landslide, dam break and the like indoors under rainfall conditions in an equal proportion reduction mode, the tests are not influenced by objective factors such as temperature, weather and the like, and meanwhile, the tests can be repeatedly carried out, so that the efficiency is high and the cost is low.

title_en: Four-foot-simulated rescue exploration robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-foot-simulated rescue exploration robot, which comprises a camera device, an adjusting device and four mechanical leg devices which are sequentially connected from top to bottom, the camera device comprises a camera and protective side plates arranged at two sides of the camera, a U-shaped mounting plate is arranged at the bottom of the camera, the U-shaped mounting plate is connected with the protective side plates at two sides through a first rotating shaft, the adjusting device comprises a second rotating shaft, a rotating disc, a protective disc and a lifting platform, the protective side plate of the camera device is arranged above the turntable, the turntable rotates by taking the rotating shaft II as a shaft, the head of the second rotating shaft is positioned between the protective side plates at two sides, the protective disc is arranged below the rotating disc, the lifting platform comprises a lifting platform base and a lifting shaft, the lifting shaft is connected with the protection disc, the bottom of the lifting platform base is further provided with three rotating shafts, and the four mechanical leg devices are respectively connected with the three rotating shafts. The invention can replace manpower to carry out disaster site omnibearing investigation.
assignees: WUXI MAKEBLOCK EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency simulation method for emergency of urban underground comprehensive pipe gallery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency simulation, and particularly relates to an emergency simulation method for an emergency of an urban underground comprehensive pipe gallery. The emergency guidance method for personnel evacuation comprises a parameter setting stage, a simulation platform determining stage, a simulation model establishing stage and a simulation result output stage, and provides a flow of the emergency guidance method for personnel evacuation when an emergency happens in the comprehensive pipe rack. According to the geometric parameters of the building in the comprehensive pipe gallery, the types of persons entering the gallery and basic data including sex, age, weight, walking speed, distance from an exit, calming, tension and panic psychological characteristics in emergency, follower factors and the like and instruction guide coefficients of a communication system, an emergency simulation model is constructed, evacuation behaviors of the persons in the comprehensive pipe gallery are simulated, and an evacuation behavior simulation result of the persons in the emergency is obtained, so that reference is provided for an actual emergency evacuation emergency plan of the persons in the emergency, and the blank that no emergency simulation system or model suitable for the comprehensive pipe gallery exists is made up.
assignees: BEIJING JINGHANG COMPUTING COMMUNICATION RES INST

title_en: Modeling method for supporting third-order tensor machine for aircraft engine fault diagnosis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fault diagnosis of an aircraft engine and provides a modeling method supporting a third-order tensor machine for fault diagnosis of the aircraft engine. Constructing time series data of an aircraft engine into a data form with a third-order tensor structure; under the constructed third-order tensor data, a dual-support third-order tensor model with tensor inner product operation is obtained by using a Lagrange multiplier method; and approximately expressing the inner product operation of the tensor by a Tucker decomposition method of the tensor, and obtaining a pair-supported third-order tensor machine in a tensor Tucker decomposition form. The invention has the advantages that: on one hand, the method avoids the dimension disaster problem which can be met by the data in the training process, on the other hand, the method can keep most of coupling information of the time sequence data of the original aircraft engine and can accurately predict whether the aircraft engine has surge faults in future flight.

title_en: Simulated fire disaster generating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulated fire occurrence device, which comprises an input control circuit for simulating starting or stopping, a fire source simulation circuit for simulating fire source occurrence, a controller, a fire environment simulation circuit for simulating fire environment and a display module; the input control circuit, the fire source simulation circuit, the fire environment simulation circuit and the display module are respectively connected with the controller; the effect is as follows: the fire source simulation circuit and the fire environment simulation circuit are arranged, so that a real fire environment can be realistically simulated, trainees can adapt to and become familiar with the fire scene conditions in the aspects of psychology, vision and the like, and the training effect is improved.

title_en: Fire evacuation system
title_ko: 화재 대피 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire escape education system. The fire escape education system according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: an experience room which is provided with at least one room to produce a virtual fire situation, and a passage section and an emergency exit through which trainees can escape when a fire situation is generated; a fire simulation driving unit installed in the experience room and discharging water vapor into the experience room to simulate smoke during a fire; an alarm driving unit for warning the trainees in the experience room of a fire when the fire situation is generated; a smoke control unit for removing the water vapor discharged to the inside of the experience room when the fire situation is finished; and a control unit which controls the fire simulation driving unit, the alarm driving unit, and the smoke control unit to collectively control the generation and finish of the fire situation in the experience room.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 대피 교육 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 화재 대피 교육 시스템은 가상의 화재 상황을 연출할 수 있는 적어도 하나의 룸을 구비하고, 화재 상황 연출 시 피교육자가 대피 가능한 통로부 및 비상구가 마련된 체험실, 상기 체험실의 내부에 설치되며, 상기 체험실 내부로 수증기를 토출시켜 화재 시의 연기를 모사하여 화재모사 구동부, 상기 화재 상황 연출 시, 상기 체험실 내부의 피교육자에게 화재를 경보 하는 알람 구동부, 상기 화재 상황 연출 종료 시, 상기 체험실 내부로 토출된 수증기를 제거하는 제연 구동부, 상기 화재모사 구동부, 상기 알람 구동부, 상기 제연 구동부 각각의 동작을 제어하여 상기 체험실 내의 화재 상황 연출 및 종료를 통합 관리하는 제어부를 포함한다.
assignees: CHANGJOIN CO LTD;LEE KYUNG SUK;LEE YOO KYUNG

title_en: Device and method for testing gas flow while drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of prevention and control of coal-based stratum gas disasters and discloses a device for testing gas flow while drilling, which comprises a soft bag, a gas drainage tube and an injection tube, wherein the injection tube is communicated with the soft bag and is used for filling gas or liquid into the soft bag; the soft bag is annular, at least one opening is formed in the soft bag, the inner side of the annular shape is matched with the drill rod, the outer side of the annular shape is matched with the drill hole, and the soft bag is used for surrounding the drill rod; one end of the gas drainage tube is communicated with the space to be measured after the soft bag is drilled in a closed mode, and the other end of the gas drainage tube is connected with a gas flow measuring device. Based on the device, the soft bag is surrounded on the drill rod, when the drill bit is driven to the target position, the filler is injected into the soft bag through the injection pipe, and the soft bag is used for sealing a gap between the drill rod and the drill hole; the gas drainage pipe connecting the inside and the outside of the drill hole leads out gas for measurement, so that the integration of drilling and measurement is realized, and the gas flow can be measured under the condition of not withdrawing the drill bit.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 23 BUREAU GROUP NO 3 ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method for determining coal body stress peak area and early warning through multi-parameter measurement while drilling
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining a coal body stress peak area and giving an early warning by multi-parameter measurement while drilling, which relates to the field of mine disaster early warning, and particularly relates to the method for determining the coal body stress peak area and giving an early warning by drilling a plurality of drill holes in a roadway which is not influenced by mining support stress and perpendicular to a coal wall, monitoring the drill rod torque, the drill rod rotating speed and the footage time of unit footage, carrying out weighted average on each monitoring data to obtain a relation curve between the drilling depth and the normal drill rod torque, drill rod rotating speed and footage time of the unit footage, determining the critical values of the drill rod torque, drill rod rotating speed and footage time of the unit footage by combining with the critical indexes of a stress peak area, and determining the range of the drill hole length as the stress peak area and giving an early warning when the drill rod rotating speed of the unit footage is smaller than the corresponding critical values or the drill rod torque. According to the method, the torque, the rotating speed and the footage time of the drill rod are used as monitoring indexes, and the stress peak area can be accurately determined and early-warning is carried out.

title_en: Rainfall-induced soil landslide field simulation test system
abstract_en: The invention provides a rainfall induced soil landslide field simulation test system which comprises a test slope body, a loading device, an artificial rainfall simulation system, a data acquisition system and a water collection system, wherein a water collection area flow simulation device is arranged on a slope top section, the loading device is positioned in front of the water collection area flow simulation device, the artificial rainfall devices are uniformly distributed on the slope surface section, the data acquisition system is positioned inside the slope surface section, water collection channels are all positioned on the slope surface section, a reservoir is positioned in a slope bottom section, and the water collection channels are respectively connected with the reservoir. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention respectively arranges the water collecting area flow simulation device, the loading device, the artificial rainfall device, the water collecting system, the artificial crack excavation and the like on the test slope body to simulate various disaster-causing factors of the soil landslide, and obtains the change data of various parameters in the test process in real time through the data acquisition system, thereby providing a comprehensive, effective and reliable in-situ simulation system for the research of the soil landslide instability mechanism.

title_en: Method and device for predicting track position of mobile user
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for predicting a track position of a mobile user, and belongs to the technical field of data mining processing. According to the invention, a circulating mixed density network comprising an LSTM network and an MDN network is constructed as a prediction model, the prediction model can automatically extract depth features, and the prediction model can be used for learning the motion trend, long-time history information and hidden representative features of a user from the latest trajectory data of the mobile user, so that the prediction of the position coordinates of the user in a period of time in the future is realized. The invention solves the problems of sparsity and dimension disaster faced when predicting continuous position coordinate values, can fully simulate the uncertainty of motion behaviors, and can improve the accuracy of prediction.

title_en: Fire safety control generation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating fire safety control. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: creating a simulated environment of a fire accident site; creating at least one set of target objects in a simulation environment; generating a safety control strategy according to the fire accident occurrence condition by combining the simulation environment and at least one group of target objects, wherein the safety control strategy comprises the following steps: emergency evacuation management strategy and fire-fighting approach strategy; coupling with the control platform according to the safety control strategy, generating safety control rules through counting each simulation training, wherein the safety control rules comprise: daily management rules and fire accident emergency management and control rules; wherein, the fire accident site includes: the place where the fire accident occurs in the port yard. The invention solves the technical problem of low overall fire protection response efficiency caused by the fact that the prior art is mainly based on the traditional mode on the fire protection strategy of the coal wharf storage yard.
assignees: CCCC WATER TRANSP CONSULTANTS CO LTD;HUANENG QIFEIDIAN PORT CO LTD

title_en: Group building earthquake damage extraction method and system based on oblique photography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for extracting earthquake damage of group buildings based on oblique photography, wherein the extraction method comprises the following steps: s1, oblique photography is carried out on the building after the earthquake disaster, and image data are preprocessed to obtain a basic image; s2, generating a real-scene three-dimensional model based on the basic image; s3, selecting an optimal texture image; s4, acquiring feature contour information, and extracting earthquake damage information of the single buildings on the texture images by adopting an object-oriented method based on the optimal texture images and the feature contour information; s5, training the convolutional neural network through sample data to obtain a group building earthquake damage information extraction model; and S6, extracting earthquake damage information of the group buildings in the disaster area based on the earthquake damage information extraction model of the group buildings, and judging the damage level of the group buildings. The method extracts earthquake damage information of the group buildings through the convolutional neural network, and is low in processing complexity and high in processing efficiency.

title_en: Regional bridge risk prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional bridge risk prediction method and a regional bridge risk prediction system, wherein the prediction method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting basic information of all bridges in the area; s2, screening out bridges needing risk prediction based on the basic information; s3, dividing the bridge needing risk prediction into different risk prediction grades according to the basic information of the bridge; different risk prediction grades correspond to different risk prediction periods; s4, preliminarily determining a disaster-causing factor for evaluating bridge collapse; s5, screening the preliminarily determined disaster-causing factors to obtain main disaster-causing factors affecting bridge collapse; s6, training and generating a plurality of bridge collapse risk prediction models based on the main disaster-causing factors; s7, selecting the risk prediction model with the best performance as a final risk prediction model; and S8, performing bridge collapse risk prediction on the bridge to be predicted. The method and the device realize risk prediction of the regional bridge, have low cost, wide coverage and high processing efficiency, and improve the safety of the bridge.

title_en: Simulation device for disaster experience
title_ko: 재난 체험 시뮬레이션 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster experience simulation device. The disaster experience simulation device is configured to be in a small size such that a floor plate vibrates like vibration of an earthquake, and walking in place and changing of body direction interlock with an image on a screen providing a real earthquake environment to control directions. Accordingly, a user experiences the earthquake like occurrence of the earthquake. The device is light and can be movably installed, thereby performing earthquake experience education regardless of place including schools and government offices.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 체험 시뮬레이션 장치에 관한 것으로, 바닥판이 지진발생시 흔들리는 것과 같이 진동되고, 제자리에서 보행하고 몸의 방향을 바꾸는 것에 의해 실제 지진 환경을 제공하는 화면상의 영상과 연동되어 방향이 제어되도록 소형화로 지진 체험 시뮬레이션 장치를 구성함으로써, 지진이 발생되었을 때와 같은 지진 체험을 할 수 있고, 가볍고 이동 설치가 가능하여 학교나 관공서 등 어디서나 지진 체험 교육을 수행할 수 있도록 구성된다.

title_en: Shallow cavity type disaster source fine detection imaging device and method
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a shallow cavity type disaster source fine detection imaging device and method. The device comprises a telescopic probe tube, wherein one end of the probe tube is connected with a detection terminal through a direction driving mechanism, and the other end of the probe tube is connected with a support; a cable penetrates through the probe tube, one end of the cable is connected with the probe terminal, and the other end of the cable is connected with the data processing terminal; the detection terminal comprises a laser point cloud scanning module and a drilling digital imaging module which work synchronously, wherein the laser point cloud scanning module comprises a laser light source with adjustable laser wavelength, and the laser point cloud scanning module is used for adjusting the laser wavelength emitted by the laser light source according to the water containing condition and the water filling environment definition of the cavity disaster source so as to obtain three-dimensional point cloud data of the cavity disaster source and transmit the three-dimensional point cloud data to the data processing terminal; and the drilling digital imaging module is used for synchronously acquiring rock mass images of the rock wall structural plane of the cavity disaster source and transmitting the rock mass images to the data processing terminal.

title_en: Special fire-fighting robot for national defense scientific knowledge training of teenagers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting robot special for teenager national defense scientific knowledge training, which comprises a carrier, a driving mechanism, a fire extinguishing mechanism, a smoke exhaust mechanism, an exploration mechanism, a lifting mechanism and a rescue mechanism, wherein a hood is welded on the upper surface of the carrier, the driving mechanism is fixedly installed at the bottom of an inner cavity of the carrier, the fire extinguishing mechanism is movably installed on the surface of the top of the hood, the smoke exhaust mechanism is installed at the bottom of the fire extinguishing mechanism, the lifting mechanism is arranged on one side of the smoke exhaust mechanism, the top of the lifting mechanism is connected with the fire extinguishing mechanism, the exploration mechanism is embedded on the surface of one side of the hood, and the rescue mechanism is installed at the other end of the inner cavity of the. According to the invention, the fire extinguishing, smoke exhausting and rescue are demonstrated and taught to teenagers, so that the survival rate of trapped people can be improved after a real fire disaster occurs.
assignees: JIANGSU YANXI SHIJI EDUCATION IND PROJECT DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent science popularization equipment based on virtual reality and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent science popularization equipment based on virtual reality, which comprises a protection device, wherein a cabinet is arranged on the protection device, the upper side of the protection device is provided with a wireless charging plate, the upper side of the wireless charging plate is provided with a cavity, and a vent pipe is placed in the cavity; according to the intelligent science popularization equipment based on the virtual reality and the using method thereof, the function of protecting falling VR equipment is achieved, the falling VR equipment is not prone to damage when falling, and troubles are not prone to being brought to tourists; through the arrangement of the water injection device, related rescue is easy to carry out when a fire disaster happens; through the wireless charging setting, the VR equipment is easily charged wirelessly; through the setting of smoke device and lamp pearl, easily carry out the projection to the visitor observes, attracts the visitor.
assignees: TOPOW JIANGSU RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF VIRTUAL REALITY TECH CO LTD;XUZHOU TOPOW INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and providing method for joint training of command and control using 3D augmented reality
title_ko: 3차원 증강현실을 이용한 합동 지휘통제 훈련 시스템 및 제공방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and method for enabling a plurality of participants to participate in joint command and control training on a virtual three-dimensional topographic map provided through three-dimensional augmented reality.
