According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method includes: a step in which a joint command and control training system conducts a pairing procedure for each of a plurality of training equipment units - here, each of the training equipment units includes an augmented reality display device and a mobile terminal -; a step in which the system creates a training sharing manager instance when receiving a request for the creation of new command and control training from a master terminal; a step in which the system registers the training equipment units in the training sharing manager instance when receiving a request for participation in the new command and control training from the mobile terminal included in the training equipment units; and a step in which the system controls augmented reality-based three-dimensional command and control training so that the training can be conducted through the training equipment units registered in the training sharing manager instance.
abstract_ko: 다수의 참여자가 3차원 증강현실을 통해 제공되는 가상의 3차원 지형도 상에서 합동 지휘통제 훈련을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 합동 지휘통제훈련 시스템이, 복수의 훈련 장비 유닛 각각에 대하여, 페어링 과정을 수행하는 단계-여기서, 각각의 상기 훈련 장비는, 증강현실 디스플레이 장치와 모바일 단말을 포함함, 마스터 단말로부터 신규 지휘통제훈련의 생성을 요청받는 경우, 훈련 공유 매니저 인스턴스를 생성하는 단계, 상기 훈련 장치 유닛 포함된 모바일 단말로부터 상기 신규 지휘통제훈련에 대한 참여 요청을 받는 경우 상기 훈련 장비 유닛을 상기 훈련 공유 매니저 인스턴스에 등록하는 단계, 및 상기 훈련 공유 매니저 인스턴스에 등록된 상기 복수의 훈련 장치 유닛을 통해 증강현실 기반의 3차원 지휘통제훈련이 실시되도록 제어하는 단계를 포함하는 합동 지휘통제 훈련 제공방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Emergency simulation system for urban underground comprehensive pipe gallery emergency
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency simulation, and particularly relates to an emergency simulation system for an urban underground comprehensive pipe gallery. The emergency guidance method for personnel evacuation comprises a parameter setting module, a simulation platform determining module, a simulation model building module and a simulation result output module, and provides a flow of the emergency guidance method for personnel evacuation when an emergency happens in the comprehensive pipe rack. According to the geometric parameters of the building in the comprehensive pipe gallery, the types of persons entering the gallery and basic data including sex, age, weight, walking speed, distance from an exit, calming, tension and panic psychological characteristics in emergency, follower factors and the like and instruction guide coefficients of a communication system, an emergency simulation model is constructed, evacuation behaviors of the persons in the comprehensive pipe gallery are simulated, and an evacuation behavior simulation result of the persons in the emergency is obtained, so that reference is provided for an actual emergency evacuation emergency plan of the persons in the emergency, and the blank that no emergency simulation system or model suitable for the comprehensive pipe gallery exists is made up.
assignees: BEIJING JINGHANG COMPUTING COMMUNICATION RES INST

title_en: Method for treating coal mine rock burst and gas composite disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for treating coal mine rock burst and gas composite disasters, which comprises the steps of arranging a process roadway along the middle part of a working face in the tunneling process of a coal mine underground stope roadway, and tunneling the upper and lower crossroads of the process roadway and the stope along the bottom plate of a coal seam and arranging the process roadway and the stope in the coal seam. Large-diameter drill holes are constructed in the upper and lower crossroads of the process roadway and the stope face, so that pressure relief can be performed on the coal body, the gas in the coal body can be discharged, and the gas content of the coal bed is reduced; and constructing an uplink gas extraction drill hole in the lower gate way of the process tunnel and the stope face, and performing gas pre-extraction on the coal body. The invention can release the pressure of the coal body in a large area, reduce the stress of the coal body, perform the reinforced extraction on the coal body, reduce the gas content of the coal bed, effectively prevent and control the rock burst and the gas composite disaster of the mine, reduce the possibility of the occurrence of the rock burst, reduce the gas content of the working face, reduce the gas emission intensity of the working face during the stoping period, and has extremely high technology and economy.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST;CHN ENERGY INVEST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fire simulation test bed for small-size tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-size tunnel fire prevention experiment table which is simple in structure, convenient to install, simple to operate, low in cost, safe, reliable, small in environmental pollution, high in simulation degree of fire scenes of a real tunnel, capable of researching combustion behaviors, smoke behaviors and the like of fire in the tunnel and strong in applicability; inside ceramic fibre PLASTIC LAMINATED fireproof material that adds of tunnel main part, the preceding curb plate is fire prevention glass, in the sealed embedding glass frame, can manually open, is equivalent to the hand door, and the exhaust port of roof links to each other with the fan, is equipped with the track on the bottom plate, places the dolly that can move on the track above that, and the dolly middle part is equipped with the simulation fire disaster, can observe different positions conflagration condition, and this makes the research to tunnel conflagration flue gas control and temperature distribution law more convenient, safety.

title_en: Social force model-based crowd inter-group avoidance and intra-group cooperation model
abstract_en: The crowd simulation research on the pedestrian movement and the interrelation of the pedestrians and the environment is a method for predicting in advance or inspecting afterwards for urban infrastructure planning, large-scale public activity planning, emergency evacuation of emergencies and the like. According to the method, common behaviors of pedestrians in real life such as avoidance, crowding, blockage, attraction and repulsion can be simulated by constructing mechanical models among the pedestrians and the environment, and the movement mode of the pedestrians in the scene can be simulated by combining the particularity of the pedestrians in different scenes. The model adds the avoidance behavior among the groups and the coordination behavior of the secondary groups in the groups, can simulate the avoidance behavior in different environments, and if the secondary groups are forced to be separated in the avoidance process, the different secondary groups can keep central symmetry and keep certain distance beneficial to walking by adding the force of the rear secondary group closing to the front secondary group. On one hand, the current crowd simulation is widely applied to the fields of tourism, fire fighting, buildings and the like, and has extremely high requirements on the quality of the crowd simulation result meeting the reality and being quickly visualized; on the other hand, the model is more consistent with real pedestrian behaviors, and pedestrians with different attributes and special phenomena under scenes can be simulated by adjusting parameters, so that the model has a very high social application value.
assignees: INST REMOTE SENSING & DIGITAL EARTH CAS;JIAXING HETU REMOTE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: River flood discharge early warning method based on hydraulics simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river flood discharge early warning method based on hydraulics simulation, which relates to the field of river flood calculation and early warning, and is characterized in that on the basis of constructing a one-dimensional hydraulics model for a river, according to each section water level sequence obtained by model simulation, flood rising time and flood peak arrival time caused by reservoir drainage and corresponding rising water level and peak water level are automatically identified and extracted. The method is suitable for hydraulic simulation of the river channel and prediction of flood propagation time and magnitude, has universality and simple and easy operation, can calculate the flood propagation process according to the drainage plan of the hydraulic building or hydrologic prediction of the natural river channel, and provides early warning information for disaster prevention and reduction of a downstream area.

title_en: Fire detection method using improved YOLO v3
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire detection method adopting improved YOLO v3, which comprises the following steps: constructing a fire disaster data set with labels and tags; training the modified deep convolutional neural network: modifying the original feature extraction neural network Darknet-53 of YOLO v3, pre-training the modified neural network based on the public data set, reserving the generated pre-training model weight, loading the pre-training model weight on the fire data set, performing secondary training on the modified neural network, and fine-tuning the neural network training parameters until the neural network converges.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method based on improved naive Bayes algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire early warning method based on an improved naive Bayesian algorithm, which comprises the steps of determining fire characteristic attribute items and fire categories; acquiring a plurality of data and fire categories to which the data belong to respectively form a training sample set and a testing sample set, and further performing data preprocessing; according to the data of the training sample set, calculating the prior probability, and calculating the conditional probability after smoothing based on the Laplace smoothing method; acquiring each fire characteristic attribute and a weighting coefficient of the characteristic attribute value, and combining the prior and conditional probability to construct a double-weighted naive Bayes classification model; compensating the prior probability and improving a double-weighted naive Bayes classification model; and importing the data of the test sample set into an improved naive Bayesian classification model for classification to obtain a corresponding fire category. By implementing the method, the problem that the fire early-warning algorithm in the prior art still needs to be improved in terms of accuracy and implementation difficulty is solved, and the fire prediction accuracy is improved.

title_en: Disaster area temporary living wooden house with anti-seismic structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster area temporary living wooden house with an anti-seismic structure, which comprises a base and a cross beam, wherein stand columns are welded around the upper end of the base, slide rails are welded on the tops of the upper ends of the stand columns, a limiting plate is fixed on the tops of the upper ends of the slide rails, slide blocks are movably connected to the outer walls of the upper ends of the slide rails, slide grooves are distributed in the connecting positions of the slide blocks and the slide rails, a rotating arm is arranged at the other end of the slide blocks, a fixing part is distributed at one end, away from the slide blocks, of the rotating arm, the cross beam is welded on the other side. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the base and the stand columns, the base and the stand columns are distributed in a horizontal and vertical manner, the whole base and the stand columns are used as supporting and fixing structures of the device, the stand columns are inserted into the surface of the base through drilling equipment, and the stand columns are placed in a horizontal and vertical manner through measuring equipment, so that the stability of the whole mechanism can be ensured, and the follow-up construction operation can be met.
assignees: HANGZHOU INTERACTIVE ZHIGU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Experimental device for simulating fire behavior of ship deck pool with different inclination angles
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device for simulating pool fire behaviors of ship decks with different inclination angles, and particularly relates to a situation that a deck is in fire disaster when a ship inclines due to external conditions such as sea storms or collision accidents. The simulation system comprises a variable-angle inclined supporting system, a fire source system and a matched data acquisition system, and can simulate fire scenes of a ship deck under the conditions of different inclined angles. The invention adjusts the inclination angle of the device through the rotating shaft structure, and has simple and reliable integral structure and easy operation. On the basis of predecessors, the method overcomes the defects that full-scale experiments are high in cost and numerical simulation tools are not accurate enough, ensures the repeatability of the experiments, and has great application value and guiding significance for developing scientific research of laboratories, preventing ship deck fire under actual inclined conditions and suppressing after the fire occurs.

title_en: Numerical model and scenario based damage prediction method considering the influence diffusion of complex disaster
title_ko: 대형 복합재난 영향 확산을 고려한 수치모형 및 시나리오 기반 피해 예측방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for predicting damage due to a complex disaster including tsunami, flood, etc. by using a numerical model. The method comprises the steps of: setting a reference point (10) in a sea area; operating a wave model by assuming a virtual tsunami having various conditions spread from the reference point (10); building the water level of a river mouth calculated for each condition into a scenario database; calculating only simulated tsunami conditions at the reference point (10) without operating the wave model for the entire sea area and river mouth when an actual tsunami occurs; comparing the simulated tsunami conditions with virtual tsunami conditions to retrieve the nearest river mount water level from the scenario database; and operating a flooding model for floods by using the nearest river mount water level as a boundary condition. Therefore, damaged areas such as inland residential areas can be quickly and accurately predicted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수치모형을 이용하여 해일과 홍수 등이 복합된 복합재난의 피해를 예측하는 방법에 관한 것으로, 해역내 기준점(10)을 설정하고, 기준점(10)에서 전파되는 다양한 조건의 가상해일을 상정하여 파랑모형을 가동하며, 조건별로 산출된 하구(河口) 수위를 시나리오 데이터베이스로 구축한 후, 실제 해일 발생시 전체 해역 및 하구에 대하여 파랑모형을 가동하지 않고 기준점(10)에서의 모의해일 조건만을 산출한 후, 이를 가상해일 조건과 대비하여, 가장 근접한 하구 수위를 시나리오 데이터베이스에서 인출한 후, 이를 경계조건으로 홍수에 대한 범람모형을 가동함으로써, 내륙 주거지 등의 피해구역을 신속하고 정확하게 예측할 수 있도록 한 것이다.
assignees: HONGIK UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIA COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Systems and methods for augmented reality for disaster simulation
abstract_en: An augmented reality (AR) system for generating and displaying a pre-disaster Enhanced Situation Visualization (ESV) is provided. The AR system may include an ESV computing device, a user computing device operated by a user and a reference database. The user computing device may transmit a reference request message to the ESV device, the reference request message including an image and/or GPS location of a property. The ESV computing device may determine the subject of the image is the property, retrieve reference information including peril maps associated with the property from the reference database, and determine situation information specific to the subject. The reference and situation information including a loss estimate may be displayed on the user computing device to provide an ESV of the property. The ESV may be used for insurance-related activities, such as handling, adjusting, and/or generating an insurance policy, premium, and/or discount, and/or generating insurance-related recommendations.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Disaster response system based on digital sop and method thereof
title_ko: Sop 기반 재난재해 대응 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an SOP-based disaster responding system and a method thereof. The SOP-based disaster responding system of the present invention comprises: a management module for defining a resource required for a disaster response as a first resource for a system and a second resource for a human resource; an editing module for defining a first activity and a second activity respectively assigned to the first resource and the second resource, and generating a plurality of S-SOP scenarios in which an execution order of the defined first activity and second activity is defined in accordance with a predetermined time flow of a disaster; and a service module for selecting the S-SOP scenario corresponding to the disaster among the S-SOP scenarios when the disaster occurs, and executing the first activity and the second activity in accordance with the time flow of the disaster.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 의한 SOP 기반 재난재해 대응 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 상기 재난재해 대응 시스템은 재난재해 대응 시 필요한 리소스를 시스템에 대한 제1 리소스와 인적 자원에 대한 제2 리소스로 정의하는 관리 모듈; 상기 제1 리소스와 상기 제2 리소스에 각각 임무를 부여한 제1 액티비티와 제2 액티비티를 정의하고, 상기 정의된 제1 액티비티와 제2 액티비티의 실행 순서를 미리 정해진 재난재해의 시간적 흐름에 따라 정의한 다수의 S-SOP 시나리오를 생성하는 편집 모듈; 및 재난재해 발생 시 상기 다수의 S-SOP 시나리오 중 해당 재난재해에 상응하는 S-SOP 시나리오를 선택하고, 상기 선택된 S-SOP 시나리오를 기초로 재난재해의 시간적 흐름에 따라 상기 제1 액티비티와 상기 제2 액티비티를 실행하는 서비스 모듈을 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Method for predicting residual life of rotating machinery of multilayer bidirectional gate control circulation unit network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for residual life of a rotary machine of a multilayer bidirectional gating circulation unit network, which comprises the steps of collecting vibration signals; constructing a health index; constructing a network training set; constructing a multi-layer bidirectional gating circulation unit network; training a multi-layer bidirectional gating circulation unit network; network testing, estimation of residual life and acquisition of a confidence interval; and (4) predicting and evaluating the residual life. The method combines the advantages of strong feature extraction capability of deep learning, utilizes the neural network of the bidirectional gating circulation unit to carry out regression prediction, and obtains the confidence interval of the residual life by a Bootstrap method. Aiming at the problems that the model precision of a recurrent neural network model is sensitive to the value of the learning rate in the training process, and the prediction performance of the model is influenced by overhigh and overlow, the natural index is utilized to attenuate the learning efficiency to train the neural network efficiently. The method can accurately predict the residual life and the confidence interval of the rotary machine, can greatly reduce expensive unscheduled maintenance, and avoids the occurrence of disasters.

title_en: Image deduction simulation equipment and method for disaster site
abstract_en: The invention provides an image deduction simulation device for a disaster site, which is applied to the disaster site with a walking surface and can be lifted to a proper position as required to acquire images in a visual field range. The image simulation equipment comprises an image acquisition vehicle (10), a lifting component (13), a camera cloud platform (23), an environment temperature and humidity acquisition device, a slam navigation device (202), an acquisition controller (100), a remote simulation processor, a heating or refrigerating device and a humidifying device. The image acquisition vehicle can move on a walking surface and comprises a frame (11) and a rotating part. The frame has a support surface that can be parallel to the walking surface. The rotating part comprises a driving shaft, a pair of traveling wheels (12) and a traveling driving motor. The invention also provides an image deduction simulation method for the disaster site.

title_en: Tunnel water burst and mud burst excavation simulation device and method for simulating water burst and mud burst disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tunnel water-inrush and mud-inrush excavation simulation device which comprises a model frame, an earth stress loading system, a water pressure loading system and an information monitoring system, wherein the model frame is hollow, the upper end of the model frame is provided with an opening, a rock model body is arranged in the model frame and comprises a normal rock body and a fault rock body, both sides of the fault rock body are normal rock bodies, a tunnel excavation opening is formed in the side wall of the model frame, the earth stress loading system is used for providing downward pressure for the rock model body, the water pressure loading system is used for providing water pressure for the rock model body, the information monitoring system comprises a monitoring element and a data acquisition system, transverse monitoring sections are arranged in the normal rock body and the fault rock body in the direction perpendicular to a tunnel, and the monitoring element is buried on the transverse monitoring sections to monitor displacement, soil pressure, osmotic pressure and stress changes in the tunnel excavation process. The invention also provides a method for simulating water and mud bursting disasters by using the device. The water inrush and mud inrush change of the tunnel can be accurately simulated.

title_en: Interactive first-aid training system based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an interactive first aid training system based on a virtual reality technology, which comprises: the character model generating module, the chest compression module, the artificial respiration module, the virtual scene generating module and the action generating module capture the action information of the chest compression module and the artificial respiration module and generate corresponding virtual actions in a scene; a user management module; and a feedback evaluation module. Different scenes are generated by using a virtual reality technology, multi-environment and multi-mode emergency training is performed according to the difference of emergency modes of the different scenes, and the technology of medical staff for pre-hospital emergency is improved; in addition, the blank can be filled, a disaster scene with a hundred percent of reduction degree can be created by utilizing a virtual reality technology, even different types of wounded persons can be made, so that the experiencer can personally feel psychological and physical double sensory impressions brought by the disaster, and the tension and the crisis are increased.

title_en: Inundation simulation program and inundation simulation system
abstract_en: To address such a problem that, although it is general in an inundation simulation to limit locations of dike-breaks in one flood to 0 or 1, actually two or more dikes may be broken in one flood, so that the conventional method can evaluate only a part of a scenario that may occur in the actual flood disaster and scenarios other than that are ignored, however, when locations of dike-breaks are not limited, the number of scenarios increase extremely.SOLUTION: The inundation simulation program includes: a first step of receiving a scenario that, when the number of locations of dike-breaks is defined as i (i is an integer number equal to or more than 1), i-number of dikes are broken; a second step of loading an inundation simulation result of the scenario that the (i-1) number of dikes are broken; a third step of calculating a time when the i-th dike-break point is broken, from the loaded inundation simulation result; and a fourth step of assuming that the calculated time when the i-th dike-break point is broken is a start time, executing the inundation simulation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Fire extinguisher practice equipment for fire fight training
title_ko: 소방 훈련용 소화기 실습 장비
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire extinguisher practice equipment for firefighting training by using a fire extinguisher which sprays water instead of fire extinguishing powder. More specifically, a first, a second, and a third space unit (11, 12, 13) are formed on a front and a rear by a first and a second transparent plate of a body unit (10). The first space unit (11) is formed to have an opened front portion to spray water of a fire extinguisher. The second space unit (12) vertically and axially installs a target formed through the first space unit (11) to display an ignition point. A flame reproducing unit (30) to reproduce a fire situation while a flame reproducing membrane flutters and waves by blowing power and emits red and blue lights to be presented like flames is installed in the third space unit (13). Therefore, practice is carried out to extinguish a fire by toppling a target displaying an ignition point in front of the main body unit for a prescribed period of time by accurately hitting the target with water sprayed from a fire extinguisher. Since a real fire situation is staged by the flame reproducing unit, a safe and realistic sensation is provided as if a real fire is extinguished. Therefore, practice effects are doubled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화 분말 대신 물을 분사하는 소화기를 이용하여 소방 훈련을 하는 소화기 실습 장비에 관한 것으로, 좀더 상세하게는 몸체부(10)의 제1,2 투명판에 의해 제1,2,3 공간부(11)(12)(13)를 전후로 형성하되, 상기 제1 공간부(11)는 소화기의 물을 분사하도록 전방을 개방되게 형성하고, 제2 공간부(12)는 제1 공간부(11)와 관통 형성하여 발화 지점을 표시하는 타켓을 수직으로 축 설치하며, 제3 공간부(13)에는 불꽃 재현막이 송풍력에 의해 펄럭이며 파동하면서 적,청 색광을 발하여 불꽃과 같이 연출되면서 화재 상황을 재현하는 불꽃 재현부(30)를 설치 구성하므로 소화기에서 분사되는 물로 본체부 전방에서 발화 지점을 표시하는 타켓을 정확히 맞추는 것에 의해 타켓을 일정 시간 넘어뜨려 화재를 진화하도록 실습하되, 불꽃 재현부에 의해 실제 화재 상황을 연출하므로 안전하면서도 실제 화재를 진화하는 듯한 현실감을 갖도록 하기 때문에 실습 효과를 배가하도록 하는데 그 특징이 있다.

title_en: Experimental device and experimental method for simulating occurrence process of shallow water flow disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of petroleum exploration equipment, and provides an experimental device and an experimental method for simulating a shallow water flow disaster occurrence process. The experimental device for simulating the occurrence process of the shallow water flow disaster comprises a sample platform (1) for placing a gravel sample and a collection container (2) for collecting gravel discharged from the sample platform (1), wherein the sample platform (1) is connected with a fluid pipeline for injecting fluid into the placed gravel sample, a pressure relief hole (3) is formed in the top of the sample platform (1), and the collection container (2) is connected with the pressure relief hole (3) through a pressure relief pipeline (4). The device can accurately simulate the occurrence process of the shallow water flow disaster, researches the triggering and flowing mechanism of the overpressure sand body in the shallow deep sea, quantitatively analyzes the flowing damage mechanism and damage degree of the shallow water flow disaster, and better predicts and prevents the shallow water flow disaster in the subsequent research.

title_en: Mask-based remote sensing image rotating target detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mask-based remote sensing image rotating target detection method, which aims to reduce the calculated amount of a remote sensing image rotating target detection model and improve the detection precision of the remote sensing image rotating target and comprises the following steps: 1) acquiring a training sample and a test sample; 2) constructing a remote sensing image rotating target detection network model; 3) training a remote sensing image rotating target detection network model by using a training sample; 4) inputting the test sample into the trained remote sensing image rotating target detection network model, and obtaining the prediction category of the remote sensing image rotating target and the coordinates of four vertexes of the rotating boundary box. The method determines the position of the remote sensing image rotating target through the target rotating boundary frame, effectively reduces the calculated amount of a rotating target detection model, enhances the positioning robustness of the rotating target, realizes higher detection precision, and can be used in the fields of resource exploration, natural disaster early warning, urban planning and the like.

title_en: Ship evacuation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an AI-based rescue system (2) for assisting the safe evacuation of a passenger ship upon occurrence of an emergency situation (fire, ship sinking, terrorism, etc.). Real-time simulators (20.2) assist the AI in defining the optimal evacuation plan. Appropriate exit paths are then dynamically communicated to the passengers. The real-time simulators (20.2) base their simulation on pre-simulated scenarios (20.11). The AI-based rescue system (2) also provides detection and assistance to lost passengers.

title_en: Intelligent control type fire-fighting emergency lighting evacuation system with centralized power supply and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centralized power supply intelligent control type fire-fighting emergency lighting evacuation system and a construction method thereof. The system is linked with the original fire alarm device to clarify the fire point, evacuation simulation analysis is carried out through personnel evacuation simulation software, and an optimal dynamic evacuation route is generated in time, so that trapped personnel can actively avoid smoke and fire, judgment is accurately made, and the occurrence of group death and group injury accidents such as blind escape, treading and the like is avoided.
assignees: GUANGDONG NO 1 CONSTR ENG CO LTD

title_en: RFID positioning system and algorithm thereof in fire-fighting training process
abstract_en: An RFID positioning system and an algorithm thereof in a fire fighting training process, and an RFID positioning system and an algorithm thereof. The existing firefighter is in the training process of a firefighter indoor drilling training room, and due to the characteristics of short displacement and high speed, the general RFID positioning system is low in positioning accuracy and high in cost. An RFID positioning system and an algorithm thereof in a fire fighting training process are disclosed, wherein an RFID reader captures nearby RFID cards in the personnel moving process, the serial numbers of the RFID cards are read, a positioning space coordinate code is calculated by adopting an RFID positioning algorithm in the fire fighting training process and is sent to a client, and the client receives the positioning space coordinate code and correspondingly displays the positioning space coordinate code. The fire-fighting training process RFID positioning system and the algorithm thereof have the positioning accuracy of 0.5m, the cost of about 80 percent of that of a common RFID positioning system, and other performances equal to or slightly higher than that of the common RFID positioning system.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF INTELLIGENT MFG HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Claw-shaped leaf splitting device for hail disaster simulation test of corn
abstract_en: The invention discloses a claw type leaf splitting device for a corn hailstone disaster simulation test in the technical field of simulation experiment devices, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein the left wall of the supporting plate is provided with a claw knife, the top wall of the supporting plate is hinged with a hinged plate, the left end of the hinged plate is fixedly provided with a movable plate, the front wall of the movable plate is provided with a corn leaf containing tank, the right end of the hinged plate is fixedly provided with a rope ring, the outer wall of the rope ring is provided with a connecting rope, the bottom wall of the supporting plate is hinged with a movable rod, the hinged part of the supporting plate and the movable rod is provided with a fastening nut, the left outer wall and the right outer wall of the movable rod are respectively and fixedly provided with a push rod and a baffle plate, one end of the connecting rope penetrates through the top wall of the baffle plate, the bottom end of the connecting rope is provided with a pull ring, the influence of the hail disaster on the damage of the corn leaves in different periods on the growth period and the yield of the corn can be simulated and detected.
assignees: INST OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES NO 4 DIVISIONS OF XINJIANG PRODUCTION & CONSTRUCTION CORPS

title_en: Drilling and piling integrated machine for emergency and disaster relief
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of rescue and relief work, in particular to a rescue and relief drilling and pile driving integrated machine, which mainly aims to provide a rescue and relief drilling and pile driving integrated machine, can effectively complete drilling operation and pile driving operation on the same equipment, ensures the timeliness requirement in the rescue and relief work, and provides a rescue and relief drilling and pile driving integrated machine, which comprises an independently arranged guide support frame, wherein a support base is arranged at the lower part of the guide support frame, and a station conversion sliding base is also arranged between the support base and the guide support frame; a station conversion oil cylinder is further arranged at the rear end of the support base, a drilling device is arranged on the outer side of the guide support frame, and a piling device is arranged on the inner side of the guide support frame; the lower part of the guide support frame is also connected with a self-walking device, and the integrated machine with the novel structural design for emergency rescue, relief work, drilling and piling effectively improves the efficiency of emergency work and the emergency response capability in the process of emergency rescue and relief work.

title_en: High-rise building emergency evacuation method and system based on digital twins and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-rise building emergency evacuation method and system based on digital twins and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a digital world twinned with the physical world; analyzing historical personnel evacuation data through the digital world, and predicting personnel space-time distribution data of the physical world according to an analysis result; carrying out evacuation simulation according to the personnel space-time distribution prediction data, and constructing an evacuation plan evaluation model according to an evacuation simulation result; the evacuation plan evaluation model generates at least two evacuation plans according to the personnel space-time distribution prediction data, evaluates the at least two evacuation plans and selects an optimal evacuation plan; and establishing virtual-real fusion and dynamic interaction between the physical world and the digital world by using Socket, and evacuating people in the physical world by using the optimal evacuation plan. The method solves the problems of emergent performance, instability, nonlinearity and uncertainty in the physical world through a virtual-real interaction mode and collaborative evolution.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: Mine disaster event detection method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: A mine disaster event detection method based on a convolutional neural network is suitable for coal mine disaster event detection. The method comprises a model design part and a model training part, wherein the model design part mainly comprises a mixed characteristic input layer and a high-speed iteration cavity convolutional neural network design part, the characteristic input layer with higher fine granularity and semantic property is constructed by mixing input text word-level, character-level and entity characteristic vectors, deep text semantic and structural information are fully mined, a deep model is constructed by stacking DCNN (data-independent neural network) by adopting an iteration method, a global characteristic vector is obtained, the model training efficiency is improved, a model rear-end framework is selected and connected with a Softmax classification layer through a Highway network to optimize the characteristic vector, the problems that the deep network model is easy to be over-fitted and difficult to be converged are solved, and the accuracy of model detection is improved. The method and the device can automatically detect mine disaster events in massive text data, avoid complicated manual construction operation, and provide data support for analysis and early warning of the mine disaster events.

title_en: Detachable portable fast boat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detachable portable express boat which comprises a boat body head, a boat body middle part and a boat body tail part; the tail end of the head of the ship body is detachably connected with the middle part of the ship body; the tail part of the ship body is detachably connected with one end of the middle part of the ship body, which is far away from the head part of the ship body; the head part, the middle part and the tail part of the ship body can be folded through connecting bodies; sealing strips are arranged at the joints of the head part of the ship body, the middle part of the ship body and the tail part of the ship body; the fast ship can be disassembled into three parts, and then the three parts are folded and transported, so that the transportation space is reduced in the transportation process, the transportation quantity is increased, and the lifesaving time is accelerated; the device can be widely applied to flood prevention and disaster relief, water training of teams or individuals, water culture and walking replacement, outdoor fishing, self-driving and traveling and the like.

title_en: Based on VR technique conflagration search and rescue simulation training field
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire disaster search and rescue simulation training field based on VR technology, which comprises a base, a plurality of shock absorbing devices are arranged at the upper end of the base, a movable plate is arranged at the upper end of the shock absorbing devices, a fixed support is arranged at the two sides of the upper end of the movable plate, a protective support is arranged at the upper end of the fixed support, each shock absorbing device comprises a fixed plate, a chute is arranged at the inner side of the fixed plate, a movable frame I is arranged at the upper end of the chute, a movable frame II is arranged at the lower end of the chute, a rack I is arranged at one side of the movable frame I, a rack II is arranged at one side of the movable frame II, a gear is arranged between the rack I and the rack II and at the inner side of the chute, a fixed column I is arranged at the lower end of the movable frame II, a fixed column II is arranged at the, the protective bracket is of a detachable structure, the upper end of the first movable frame is connected with the lower end of the movable plate, and the lower end of the fixed plate is connected with the base.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SHUREN COLLEGE ZHEJIANG SHUREN UNIV

title_en: Model rapid disaster tolerance method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present specification relate to a method, an apparatus, and an electronic device for model fast disaster recovery, where the method includes: calculating the similarity between a first feature vector of a first feature corresponding to a service scene and second feature vectors of other features in the feature knowledge graph to obtain a similarity list of the first feature vector; training the first feature vector as the input of a business model to obtain a first business model; respectively training the second feature vectors as the input of the business models to obtain a plurality of second business models; processing the business by using the first business model, and enabling a plurality of second business models to run synchronously; when the preset characteristics fail, one of the second business models is used for replacing the first business model to process the business; and the plurality of second business models are standby models of the first business model.

title_en: Emergency exercise deduction method, computer storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency exercise deduction method, a computer storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring emergency drilling parameters; forming a three-dimensional disaster scene according to parameters based on a pre-established and maintained library; acquiring actions of each drilling person aiming at a three-dimensional disaster scene; based on a pre-established and maintained library, determining the cooperative influence of each action on the disaster scene, and adjusting the three-dimensional disaster scene based on the cooperative influence; the pre-established library includes: the system comprises a scene knowledge base, a disaster dynamics equation base, an action evolution knowledge base, a collaborative dynamics equation base, a scene risk threshold value base, an action derivative risk base, an example evaluation knowledge base, a resource risk experience base and a conflict condition knowledge base. According to the method provided by the application, the multi-user collaborative exercise based on the simulation scene is realized through the three-dimensional disaster scene.

title_en: Science popularization earthquake alarm demonstration instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a science popularization earthquake alarm demonstration instrument, which comprises a base 1, wherein a two-layer panel 3 is supported in the middle of the base 1 through four springs 8, and a screw rod 20 is arranged in each spring 8; motor assembling and disassembling holes 2 at different positions are arranged below the two-layer panel 3 on the base 1, a motor 13 is arranged in the motor assembling and disassembling hole 2 at a certain position, a rolling bearing 14 is arranged on an output shaft of the motor 13, and a vibrating piece 15 is arranged on the rolling bearing 14; the edge of the two-layer panel 3 is provided with a graduated scale 11, and the two-layer panel 3 is provided with a circular groove 12 for inducing the initial staying of the metal ball. The invention can be used as an alarm device, can also be used for demonstration, and can also be used for researching and analyzing the vibration track of an object. When a simulated earthquake occurs, the alarm is immediately generated, so that the loss degree of the earthquake is reduced, the earthquake alarm is convenient and light, the demonstration functions are various, the earthquake alarm is convenient to use in earthquake science popularization rooms and earthquake science popularization halls of schools, the earthquake alarm principle is better popularized, and the disaster prevention and reduction awareness of the nation is improved.

title_en: Portable emergency operation tent for disaster relief performance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable emergency operation tent for disaster relief exercises, which comprises a tent body, wherein multi-stage telescopic rods are vertically arranged at the positions of the bevel edges inside the tent body one by one, single-hole connecting rings are arranged at the tops of the four multi-stage telescopic rods, a through hole is formed in the center of the top of the tent body, a support tray is arranged at the lower end of the through hole, a threaded rod is vertically cast-welded at the top of the support tray, penetrates through the through hole, is respectively sleeved with an upper compression nut ring body and a lower compression nut ring body at the upper end and the lower end of the through hole, single-hole connecting pieces are cast-welded on the side wall of the outer periphery of the support tray in an equal-dividing manner, and the single-hole connecting pieces and the single-hole connecting rings in the same direction. The operation tent has the advantages of simple structure and convenient assembly, well lightens the working strength of medical care personnel, and simultaneously strives for the treatment time for injured personnel needing first aid.

title_en: Combined urban disaster simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined urban disaster simulation experiment device, which comprises a solid model, a disaster simulation device, a disaster information acquisition device and a transparent display cabinet, wherein the solid model comprises a support component, a plurality of urban function components and a plurality of river components, the support component comprises a plurality of pillars which are uniformly distributed along a water collection tank in a vertical and horizontal manner and a supporting beam which is horizontally erected on an adjacent pillar, and the pillars are detachably connected with the supporting beam; the city functional component comprises a city base and a water collecting tank arranged at the bottom of the city base, wherein the city base is provided with a through hole communicated with the water collecting tank, the city base is erected on a supporting beam which is connected and arranged transversely and longitudinally, and the water collecting tank is communicated with the top of the water collecting tank; the river assembly comprises a river base, a water tank is arranged on the river base along the longitudinal direction of the river base, and the river base is erected on the adjacent supporting beams which are transversely arranged or longitudinally arranged. The utility model discloses can build different solid model fast, have better reduction effect to different structure, the functional partitioning in city.

title_en: Debris flow simulation testing device of assembled channel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mud-rock flow simulation test device of assembled channel, the device include material case, stirring lifting machine, assembled channel, liftable support, impact force test system, accumulation box, data line and test processing system. The utility model has the advantages that: the assembled channel is formed by connecting a plurality of straight channels with triangular steps at the bottom and a plurality of bent channels and is arranged on the liftable support. The high-speed miniature camera embedded in the straight channel, the novel optical fiber sensor embedded in the bent channel and the impact force testing system are connected with the testing processing system through data lines; the utility model discloses can be applied to the simulation of the mud-rock flow of different ditch shapes, different length, different friction degrees, different slopes, but this channel repeated equipment utilization, strong adaptability have realized mud-rock flow motion, striking, pile up the data automatic acquisition and the processing of overall process, monitor constantly, the interference killing feature is strong, provides the scientific foundation for the disaster prevention of mud-rock flow.
assignees: UNIV JILIN;JILIN SIXTH GEOLOGY MINE LOCATING ENG TEAM

title_en: Apparatus and method for fire fighting in hospital based on a Virtual Reality
title_ko: 가상현실 기반의 의료 시설 화재 훈련 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for fire training in medical facilities based on virtual reality. The apparatus comprises: a content providing unit which stores and provides, by each medical facility, fire training content including joint content for guiding a fire fighting process while reproducing a fire situation, medical staff content for sequentially guiding medical device operation procedures and patient evacuation guidance procedures to minimize fire damage, and patient content for guiding fire evacuation procedures corresponding to patient disease levels; a training object confirmation unit which checks medical facilities and user identifications to perform the fire training, and further checks the disease level of a user when the user identification is a patient; a user feedback analysis unit which calculates a user behavior value based on a signal fed back from a virtual reality reproduction device; and a control unit which selects the fire training content of the medical facility confirmed by the training object confirmation unit, when the user identification is a medical staff, sequentially provides the joint content and the medical staff content of the selected fire training content, when the user identification is a patient, sequentially provides the joint content and the patient content of the selected fire training content, compares and analyzes a preset behavior guideline and the user behavior value, and adjusts content provision content according to the comparison and analysis result. The present invention can maximize benefits of fire training.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실 기반의 의료 시설 화재 훈련 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 이는 화재 상황을 재현하면서 화재 진압 절차를 안내하는 공동 컨텐츠, 화재 피해 최소화를 위한 의료 기기 조작 절차와 환자 대피 유도 절차를 순차 안내하는 의료진용 컨텐츠, 환자 질환 정도에 대응되는 화재 대피 절차를 안내하는 환자용 컨텐츠를 포함하는 화재 훈련용 컨텐츠를 의료 시설별로 구분하여 저장 및 제공하는 컨텐츠 제공부; 화재 훈련을 수행할 의료 시설 및 사용자 신분을 확인하되, 상기 사용자 신분이 환자인 경우에는 상기 사용자의 질환 정도를 추가 확인하는 훈련 대상 확인부; 상기 가상현실 재현기기로부터 피드백되는 신호를 기반으로 사용자 행동값을 산출하는 사용자 피드백 분석부; 및 상기 훈련 대상 확인부에 의해 확인된 의료 시설의 화재 훈련용 컨텐츠를 선택한 후, 상기 사용자 신분이 의료진인 경우에는 상기 선택된 화재 훈련용 컨텐츠의 공동 컨텐츠와 상기 의료진용 컨텐츠를 순차 제공하고, 상기 사용자 신분이 환자인 경우에는 상기 선택된 화재 훈련용 컨텐츠의 상기 공동 컨텐츠와 상기 환자용 컨텐츠를 순차 제공하되, 기 설정된 행동 지침과 상기 사용자 행동 값을 비교 분석한 후, 상기 비교 분석 결과에 따라 컨텐츠 제공 내용을 조정하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Model extinguisher for fire education and training drills
title_ko: 소방 교육 훈련용 모형 소화기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguisher for firefighting training. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the model fire extinguisher for firefighting training comprises: a fire extinguisher body in which an internal space is formed; a first hose coupled to one side of the fire extinguisher body and including a first flow path communicating with the internal space; a spray unit disposed at an end of the hose; a handle disposed on an upper surface of the fire extinguisher body and operated by a user; a syringe disposed in the internal space and accommodating a first fluid; a cylinder disposed to be spaced apart from the syringe in the internal space, accommodating a second material, and having a home formed on an upper surface; a connection tube connecting the syringe and the cylinder so that the first fluid can flow; a water tank disposed in the internal space to receive water; a second hose having one end disposed in the water tank and the other end disposed in the hose adjacent to the spray unit, and including a second flow path through which the water flows; and a plunger which is moved up and down by the operation of the handle, and at least a part of which is disposed in the syringe to discharge the first fluid to the connection tube by the plunger′s movement.
abstract_ko: 본 실시예는 소방 훈련용 소화기에 관한 것이다. 일 측면에 따른 소방 훈련용 소화기는, 내부 공간이 형성되는 소화기 본체; 상기 소화기 본체의 일측에 결합되며, 상기 내부 공간과 연통되는 제1유로를 포함하는 제1호스; 상기 호스의 단부에 배치되는 분사구; 상기 소화기 본체의 상면에 배치되며, 사용자에 의해 조작되는 손잡이; 상기 내부 공간에 배치되며, 제1유체가 수용되는 주사기; 기 내부 공간 중 상기 주사기와 이격되게 배치되고, 내부에 제2물질이 수용되며, 상면에 홀이 형성되는 실린더; 상기 제1유체가 유동하도록 상기 주사기와 상기 실린더를 연결하는 연결관; 상기 내부 공간에 배치되며 물을 수용하는 수조; 일단이 상기 수조 내 배치되고 타단이 상기 분사구에 인접한 상기 호스 내 배치되며, 내부에 상기 물이 유동하는 제2유로가 형성되는 제2호스; 및 상기 손잡이의 조작에 따라 상, 하 방향으로 이동하며, 적어도 일부가 상기 주사기 내 배치되어 이동에 따라 상기 제1유체를 상기 연결관으로 배출시키는 플런저 포함한다.

title_en: Crisis response evaluation device, crisis response evaluation method, and crisis response evaluation program
abstract_en: To provide motivation to take a response such as evacuation after informing a user of a crisis.SOLUTION: A crisis response evaluation device 10 estimates content of a crisis that may occur by simulation using observation data acquired from an external device. Then, when the estimated content of the crisis exceeds a predetermined threshold, the crisis response evaluation device 10 notifies a user terminal 1 of a user of an alarm urging the response to the crisis. Thereafter, when acquiring, from the user terminal 1 of the user, the content of the response performed by the user to the crisis, the crisis response evaluation device 10 determines a degree in which the content of the response executes a crisis response plan stored in a storage unit in advance. Then, the crisis response evaluation device 10 evaluates a degree in which the content of the response leads to damage suppression effect related to the crisis based on the determination result. Thereafter, the crisis response evaluation device 10 notifies the user terminal 1 of the user of the evaluation result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Two long and narrow space fire experiment platforms in reduced size subway tunnel/train carriage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a two long and narrow space fire experiment platforms in reduced size subway tunnel/train carriage, including tunnel unit, train unit, track unit, fire source analog unit, vertical ventilation unit, fire parameter measuring unit. Wherein: the tunnel unit adopts an arc ceiling structure and is located on the ground; the train unit is placed in the tunnel unit and is controlled to move by the track unit on the ground; the fire source simulation unit is arranged in the train unit and used for generating fire plumes required by experiments; the longitudinal ventilation unit is arranged at one end of the tunnel unit and is used for providing longitudinal ventilation; the fire parameter measuring unit is used for collecting various parameters in an experiment. The utility model overcomes full-scale experiment is expensive and numerical simulation shortcoming not accurate enough, and the research of a series of basic theories such as fire plume entrainment characteristic and flue gas transport action when taking place the train conflagration in the tunnel of can opening and developing subway has actual guiding meaning to fire detection, flue gas control and personnel evacuation under the scene of a fire.

title_en: Rock soil and environment simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock soil and environment simulation device, which comprises a box body, a turnover device for realizing the inclination of the box body, a supporting device for supporting the box body and a rainfall simulation mechanism, wherein the turnover device is arranged on the box body; the box body comprises a bottom plate, a front plate, a rear plate, a left plate and a right plate which are vertically arranged on the bottom plate respectively; one end of the front plate and one end of the rear plate are fixedly connected with the two ends of the rear plate; the front plate and one end of the rear end, which is far away from the rear plate, are connected with the front plate in a sliding manner; and one ends of the front plate and the rear end, which are far away from the rear plate, are provided with driving mechanisms for opening or closing the box body. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the simulation of natural disasters such as side slope landslide can be effectively realized through the turnover device and the supporting device; the invention is provided with the angle measuring sensor, and the angle measuring sensor can effectively control the turnover device to simulate the angle of the slope according to the set angle; according to the invention, through the displacement sensor and the water content sensor, parameter support can be effectively provided for the test accuracy; the invention has simple structure and strong practicability.

title_en: Remote sensing image yellow river ice detection method based on random forest algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image yellow river ice detection method based on a random forest algorithm, which specifically comprises the following steps: s1: preparing a training sample set A and a sample set B to be detected; s2: processing the training sample set A to form a training sample set C; s3: training a classifier model by using a sample training sample set C; s4: detecting the samples in the sample set B to be detected by using a classifier model to obtain a first classification detection result; s5: selecting an image with a detection error position as an error detection sample, forming a new training sample set E with the image training sample set C, and training a random forest by using the training sample set E to obtain a new classifier model; s6: detecting the image to be detected by using a new classifier model, determining the ice distribution range, and obtaining the final classification result of the image to be detected; the random forest classifier model obtained by the invention can automatically detect new images to be detected, the detection precision and the overall classification precision reach more than 90%, and decision support is provided for disaster reduction and emergency.
assignees: GUANGDONG URBAN & RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Flood dynamic assessment method, device, medium and equipment based on real-scene model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood dynamic assessment method, a flood dynamic assessment device, a flood dynamic assessment medium and flood dynamic assessment equipment based on a real-scene model, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly acquiring land utilization type and social economic data for a flood research area, enclosing a key area in the research area, carrying out real-scene modeling on the key area, carrying out fine classification drawing of the land utilization type data after modeling, and fusing the land utilization type data with the originally acquired land utilization type data of the key area; aiming at the data obtained after fusion, accessing flood water time periods to simulate fruit formation, and performing flood influence analysis and statistics in each time period; and (4) carrying out dynamic analysis and statistics on flood damage loss in each time period according to a set relation curve of water depth and loss rate by combining economic data of the multi-industry. The method realizes the time-interval dynamic output of flood evaluation, and provides powerful technical support for accurate and dynamic flood after-disaster influence and loss evaluation under the condition of real-time flood simulation.

title_en: Animation display method, device and system for sand-dust meteorological disaster data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device and a system for displaying animation of sand-dust meteorological disaster data. The method is applied to the server, and by applying the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the sand and dust disaster data can be three-dimensionally and visually rendered based on the middle layer caching technology of the server and the WEBGL technology of the client. Moreover, when the client-side WEBGL technology is used for displaying the sand disaster data, a plug-in is not required to be independently installed on the client side, and convenience in displaying the sand disaster data can be improved. After the original DST data is obtained, corresponding IDDI data can be obtained through calculation, and corresponding dust intensity data can be obtained according to a random forest model obtained through pre-training, so that when sand disaster data is displayed, the displayed data is the dust intensity data.

title_en: Simulation test device for air-facing instability type landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air-approaching instability type landslide simulation test device, and belongs to the technical field of mountain disaster prevention and control. The simulation test device comprises a main body frame structure, a side baffle, a bottom plate, a rear supporting plate, a bottom supporting structure, a front end rotating plate, a bottom elastic rope, a top rotating shaft, a supporting structure and a guy cable structure. The structural device for simulating the landslide test based on the near-air instability is based on the formation principle of landslide geological disasters, can effectively simulate the near-air instability sliding, and provides a new structural body device for the simulation test of researching the landslide geological disasters in the future. The gap of scientific research on landslide geological disasters in the type can be filled up, and the method has higher scientific research value.

title_en: System for providing simulation based smartfarm education service for smart farm management in virtual environment
title_ko: 스마트팜 운영을 위한 가상환경 시뮬레이션 연동 기반 스마트팜 교육 서비스 제공 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a smart farm education service providing system based on virtual environment simulation interworking for smart farm operation. The present invention includes: a user terminal which outputs a request event for breeding at least one cultivated species in a virtual environment, receives cultivation simulation content corresponding to the request event to select at least one control interface, and outputs a result according to the selection in the cultivation simulation content; and a smart farm education service providing server which includes a big data unit for collecting at least one cultivated species, at least one environment required to breed cultivated species in a smart farm, and control information to build big data, a providing unit for transferring selected cultivation simulation content to the user terminal if one of cultivation simulation contents in the at least one of the pre-stored cultivation simulation contents is selected, a confirming unit for confirming an object of a control interface selected by corresponding to a mission given in the user terminal, and a progress management unit for proceeding to a next mission if the object controlled from the confirming unit and control data are identical to preset object and control data. According to the present invention, it is possible to improve ability to solve problems in a natural disaster situation by randomly providing a natural disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 스마트팜 운영을 위한 가상환경 시뮬레이션 연동 기반 스마트팜 교육 서비스 제공 시스템이 제공되며, 적어도 하나의 재배종을 가상환경에서 생육하기 위한 요청 이벤트를 출력하고, 요청 이벤트에 대응하도록 재배 시뮬레이션 콘텐츠를 수신하여 적어도 하나의 제어 인터페이스를 선택하고, 선택에 따른 결과를 재배 시뮬레이션 콘텐츠에서 출력하는 사용자 단말, 및, 적어도 하나의 재배종 및 재배종을 스마트팜에서 생육하는데 요구되는 적어도 하나의 환경, 제어 정보를 수집하여 빅데이터를 구축하는 빅데이터부, 기 저장된 적어도 하나의 재배 시뮬레이션 콘텐츠 중 어느 하나의 재배 시뮬레이션 콘텐츠가 선택되는 경우, 선택된 재배 시뮬레이션 콘텐츠를 사용자 단말로 전송하는 제공부, 사용자 단말에서 주어진 미션(Mission)에 대응하여 선택된 제어 인터터페이스의 객체를 확인하는 확인부, 확인부에서 제어된 객체와 제어 데이터가 기 설정된 객체 및 제어 데이터와 동일한 경우 다음 미션을 진행하도록 하는 진행관리부를 포함하는 스마트팜 교육 서비스 제공 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Safe door opening and closing movement
title_ko: 안전도어 개폐장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safe door opening/closing device which allows an evacuee to quickly evacuate by automatically and completely opening a door when an emergency situation such as a fire occurs. More specifically, the safe door opening/closing device comprises: a door frame which is fixed and installed on a drilled wall of a building, and has a rectangular frame shape; a door rotatably coupled to the door frame, and arranged to enter through the drilled wall; and a locking setting unit consisting of two parts to be installed on the door frame and the door to face each other to bind the door to the door frame, and allowing an evacuee to easily evacuate by automatically canceling binding by a control signal of a fire detection unit when a fire is detected by the fire detection unit. The locking setting unit includes: a locking member controlled by the fire detection unit to forcibly cancel binding between the door frame and the door; a display member to receive power from the locking member to notify the outside of cancelation of binding of the door frame and the door; and a control unit to receive a control signal of the fire detection unit to control the locking member and the display member, and receive power from an independent power generation unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 등과 같은 비상상황이 발생시에 도어가 자동으로 완전히 개방되어 대피자가 신속하게 대피할 수 있도록 하는 안전도어 개폐장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 건물의 천공된 벽체에 고정설치되는 사각의 틀 형상을 갖는 도어틀과, 상기 도어틀과 회전가능하게 결합하되 천공된 상기 벽체를 통해 출입할 수 있도록 구비되는 도어 및 두 분체로 이루어져 상기 도어틀과 상기 도어에 서로 마주보게 설치되어 상기 도어가 상기 도어틀에 결속될 수 있도록 구비하며, 화재감지부에 의해 화재가 감지되면 상기 화재감지부의 제어신호에 의해 결속이 자동으로 해지되어 대피자가 용이하게 대피할 수 있도록 하는 잠금설정부를 포함하되, 상기 잠금설정부는 상기 화재감지부에 의해 제어되어 상기 도어틀과 상기 도어 간의 결속을 강제로 해지하는 잠금부재, 상기 잠금부재에서 전원을 인가받아 상기 도어틀과 상기 도어의 결속이 해지되었음을 외부에 알려주는 표시부재, 상기 화재감지부의 제어신호를 인가받아 상기 잠금부재와 상기 표시부재를 제어하되 자가발전부에서 전원을 인가받는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Slope protection structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a side slope protective structure is treating vertical a plurality of drilling that are provided with in the side slope of protection, installs the stock in every drilling, and the stock exposes partial horizontal installation on the side slope and has many reinforcement muscle, installs the fixed network on the reinforcement muscle, the vertical setting of fixed network, and the two sides of fixed network are equipped with cement plastering layer. The cement plastering layer and the upper part of the side slope to be protected form a groove, planting soil is filled in the groove, and plants are arranged in the planting soil. The utility model discloses both can prevent that the domatic moral modification of high steep side slope from peeling off, swift current collapse, swift current geological disasters such as slide, can also plant the plant and reach ecological protection, beautify the exposed high steep side slope environment.

title_en: Power distribution network elastic lifting method based on multi-energy coordination in extreme weather
abstract_en: The utility model provides a distribution network elastic lifting method based on multi-energy coordination in extreme weather, which combines the disaster-causing mechanism of extreme weather to the distribution network to simulate the disturbance process; analyzing the vulnerability of the power distribution network element under extreme weather disturbance, and establishing an element fault rate model; generating a probabilistic fault scene of the power distribution network based on a time-varying fault rate curve, and acquiring successive fault positions and fault moments of the power distribution network in a disturbance process; the response process of the comprehensive energy system after the power distribution network fails is simulated, the optimal load reduction strategy of the power distribution network is adopted in the simulation process, the principle that the power distribution network preferentially ensures important load power supply is taken as a target, the power distribution network is supported through multi-energy coordination, and the optimal coordination scheme is determined, so that the elasticity of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: QINGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Portable geological disaster monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable geological disaster monitoring device.A modularized GNSS positioning module, a battery, a communication module and a battery manager are arranged in an equipment box, the equipment box is detachably fixed on a mounting seat, the bottom end of the mounting seat is detachably fixed to a ground drilling pile through a connecting rod, the ground drilling pile comprises a drill rod, fins which incline upwards are arranged on two sides of the drill rod, the top end of the drill rod is screwed with a nut cap, and the nut cap is fixedly connected to the mounting seat through the connecting rod; in the implementation of the invention, the structure is simple, the weight is light, the carrying is easy, and the structure is firm and stable; when the ground drilling pile is installed, the ground drilling pile is driven into a soil layer, the fin is in friction contact with the soil, on one hand, the ground drilling pile is prevented from being pulled out, on the other hand, settlement can be avoided, the structure is simple, the weight is light, the ground drilling pile is easy to carry, and meanwhile, the ground drilling pile is solid and stable enough.

title_en: Small-size outdoor water purifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small-size outdoor water purifier, including water storage storehouse, a water filtering section of thick bamboo and apron, the water storage storehouse is arranged in to a water filtering section of thick bamboo, forms a water storage chamber between water filtering section of thick bamboo outer wall and water storage storehouse inner wall, a water filtering section of thick bamboo includes bottom plate and curb plate, and the curb plate inboard is equipped with first inside lining and second inside lining, and the curb plate has the quartz sand filter material with first inside lining clearance packing, and first inside lining and second inside lining clearance packing have the active carbon filter material, and it has the mesh to gather on curb plate, first inside lining and the second inside lining, a horizontally outlet pipe is connected to the curb plate, and first inside lining and second inside lining and water filtering section of thick bamboo inner chamber intercommunication are passed to outlet pipe one end. The water purifier occupies a small space, simulates the flow of purifying domestic water of a water plant, reduces the flow into one set of equipment, is convenient to transfer and install, can provide reliable water quality, is particularly suitable for local water supply in disaster or water supply of small areas which can not be covered by the water plant, and has great application value.

title_en: Digital simulation map based on graphic coding, navigation system and navigation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital simulation map based on graphic coding, which comprises a map covering roads in a place, and is characterized by further comprising graphic coding devices, wherein one graphic coding device is respectively arranged at each end point of the roads in the place, and the information carried by the graphic coding devices comprises: a place ID for uniquely identifying a place; the graphic code ID is used for uniquely identifying the graphic code device in the site; the channel information is used for defining whether a channel exists in the corresponding direction; and adjacent figure coding information for defining the ID and distance of the adjacent figure coding device on the road corresponding to the direction. Meanwhile, the invention also provides a navigation system and a navigation method using the map. The invention can provide the functions of accurate positioning, active navigation and evacuation guidance for pedestrians without depending on a communication network in specific laminated and staggered indoor and outdoor complex three-dimensional spaces, and has high positioning precision and clear road direction identification.

title_en: Life information drilling detection device
abstract_en: According to the life information drilling detection device provided by the embodiment of the invention, the first controller and the second controller are connected by the high-strength cable, so that communication can be effectively ensured when a mine disaster occurs, and the electromagnetic wave transmitting device and the electromagnetic wave receiving device which are arranged underground can effectively probe vital signs within the working range of the electromagnetic wave transmitting device and the electromagnetic wave receiving device and send probe information to the first controller through the high-strength transmission line so as to be known by workers at the end of the first controller, so that the trapped workers can be rescued in time.
assignees: XIAN SENLAN TECH AND TRADING CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue station site selection and distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for site selection and distribution of emergency rescue stations, which are used for determining relevant information of the emergency rescue stations; according to the related information, an emergency rescue site location and distribution model is constructed, so that on the premise of considering both the waiting time of wounded persons at the disaster-affected points and the time for transporting vehicles of the emergency rescue sites to the disaster-affected points, proper emergency rescue sites are selected to distribute a corresponding number of vehicles to all the disaster-affected points; solving the model by adopting a simulated annealing algorithm nested genetic algorithm; repeatedly solving the model until the average waiting time of the wounded at each disaster-affected point reaches a preset time range; and outputting the site selection and distribution scheme of the emergency rescue stations to determine the distribution relation between the emergency rescue stations and the disaster-affected points and the quantity of vehicles distributed to the disaster-affected points by each emergency rescue station. The invention selects the address corresponding to the emergency rescue station, and comprehensively considers the total cost constraint, the station capacity constraint, the total quantity constraint of emergency rescue vehicles, the availability of the vehicles and the like of the emergency rescue station.

title_en: Three-dimensional hydrodynamic numerical simulation method based on oblique image modeling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of urban flood disaster prevention and reduction, and discloses a three-dimensional hydrodynamic numerical simulation method based on oblique image modeling, which comprises the following steps of: 1) based on multi-view image data automatic modeling, a Geographic Information System (GIS) and a Building Information Model (BIM) are fused to construct a three-dimensional digital city model; 2) constructing a three-dimensional hydrodynamic model on the basis of the model, and applying boundary conditions and initial conditions to the numerical model according to historical disaster statistical data to realize high-precision flood routing numerical simulation in an urban range; 3) carrying out refined urban flood numerical simulation; 4) and carrying out flood risk analysis. According to the flood routing process in the city and the flood routing process in the building, the method can accurately reproduce the formation mechanism of the urban flood waterlogging, so that a basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Avalanche simulation method based on position dynamics
abstract_en: The invention discloses an avalanche scene simulation method based on position dynamics. The method comprises the following steps: 1) initializing attributes of all the vertex particles, predicting and updating the current speed according to the external force, and updating the predicted position according to the time step and the current speed; 2) performing collision detection using the symbolic distance field, updating the position and velocity; 3) iteratively solving the constraint until the constraint condition is converged, and updating the speed according to the corrected position; the invention solves the problem of the simulation loss of the scene of the avalanche disaster in computer graphics, and can quickly simulate the avalanche occurrence process; simulating the movement process of particle flows in different forms such as snow flows, snow blocks and the like through a cohesive force and friction force constraint equation; the coupling phenomenon with rigid bodies such as stone, ground and the like is realized through the symbolic distance field; the simulation efficiency is improved by using a parallel computing framework.

title_en: Oil-immersed transformer fire model and fire simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire disaster model of an oil immersed transformer and a fire disaster simulation method, and relates to the field of fire fighting of oil immersed transformers; the oil immersed transformer fire disaster model comprises a transformer body model, an oil collecting pit model, a fire spraying model, a flowing fire model and a high-voltage bushing explosion fire cracking model which are built around the transformer body model, and the real situation of the oil immersed transformer during the fire disaster is fully reflected through accurately simulating various fire situations which are possibly generated by strictly simulating the entity of the transformer during the fire disaster; and moreover, the fire simulation is carried out through the oil-immersed transformer fire model, and powerful guarantee is provided for verifying the effectiveness of various fire extinguishing systems in extinguishing the oil-immersed transformer fire.

title_en: Deep well soft coal rock burst disaster monitoring and early warning system and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of mine disaster early warning, and provides a deep well soft coal rock burst disaster monitoring and early warning system and an early warning method thereof, wherein a stress sensor for detecting the pressure value of a drill hole and a displacement sensor for detecting the displacement value generated during the deformation of a roadway wall are arranged, three stress early warning signals respectively including a first green early warning signal, a first yellow early warning signal and a first red early warning signal and two preset early warning pressure values respectively including a first early warning pressure value and a second early warning pressure value are also arranged, three displacement early warning signals respectively including a second green early warning signal, a second yellow early warning signal and a second red early warning signal and two preset early warning pressure values respectively including a first early warning pressure value and a second early warning pressure value are also arranged, and a stress early warning index issues corresponding stress early warning according to the displacement values, so that the invention can issue early warning according to the comprehensive data of the drill hole pressure value and the deformation condition of the roadway, the accuracy is higher.

title_en: Coastal nuclear power station marine disaster physical quantity estimation method based on neural network
