abstract_en: A marine disaster causing substance estimation method for a coastal nuclear power station based on a neural network comprises the following steps: forming a marine disaster causing material quantification estimation index system of the coastal nuclear power station; collecting marine disaster sample data of the coastal nuclear power station, and classifying and summarizing the sample data according to a marine disaster mass estimation index system; performing normalization processing on the multi-source heterogeneous data by using a data normalization function to obtain grouped sample data; and constructing a neural network function, performing data iterative training on a plurality of groups of sample data to obtain a marine disaster causing material quantification estimation model of the coastal nuclear power station, predicting future marine disaster causing material quantification data by using the existing plurality of groups of sample data, and comparing the future marine disaster causing material quantification data with an actual result. The method can estimate the marine disaster-causing object in advance through quantification, facilitates the cold source protection department to take effective counter measures aiming at the marine disaster, and improves the working efficiency.
assignees: 719TH RES INST CHINA SHIPBUILDING IND CORP

title_en: Robot path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: Aiming at the problem that the Q-learning algorithm is difficult to perform path planning in a complex environment in reinforcement learning, the feature extraction capability of a deep convolutional neural network is combined with the decision-making capability of reinforcement learning, and an improved algorithm based on the deep reinforcement learning is provided. According to the method, a value function approximation method is used for replacing an action value function in Q-learning, a deep convolution neural network comprising a 4-layer structure is designed, the output of the network replaces a traditional Q value table, and the problem of dimension disaster generated when the Q-learning is large in state space is solved. The simulation experiment is carried out in the grid environment, and the result shows that compared with a Q-learning algorithm, the method can carry out path planning in a complex environment, obtains 87% of recognition rate on a new test set, and has strong generalization capability.
assignees: TIANJIN BONUO INTELLIGENT CREATIVE ROBOTICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-pressure water injection fracturing system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-pressure water injection fracturing system and an operation method thereof, and relates to a high-pressure water pre-fracturing technology for a hard roof, in particular to a technical method for pressing high-pressure water into a coal rock layer in a drilled hole by using a high-pressure water injection pump, and punching the wall of the coal rock hole in the drilled hole by using the high-pressure water to fracture a coal body and a rock body structure so as to generate cracks in the coal rock layer or press an original closed crack to form a new crack. By using the method, the integrity and the integral strength of the top plate are damaged through the processes of hole sealing in a drill hole, high-pressure water injection fracturing and the like, and the complete rock stratum with large thickness is divided into multiple layers, so that the aim of weakening the rock stratum of the top plate is fulfilled. Finally, the problems of a series of dynamic disasters and the like caused by mining of hard and thick coal strata in the coal mining process are solved, and a favorable technical support is provided for further rock burst prevention and control work in the field safety production of coal mines.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL CHEMICAL IND TECH RES INST CO LTD;SHAANXI BINCHANG MENGCUN MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: High-gas tight coal seam pumping and injecting integrated system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pumping and injecting integrated system and a pumping and injecting integrated method for a high-gas compact coal seam, wherein water injection drill holes and fracturing guide drill holes are alternately arranged on a coal seam along the extending direction of a coal seam roadway; performing microwave irradiation heating on the coal seam around the fracturing guide drill hole and simultaneously extracting gas; stopping heating after the gas is extracted to a certain degree, and quickly injecting liquid nitrogen into the fracturing guide drill hole, wherein the coal seam generates cracks due to quick cold shrinkage; finally, injecting water into the coal seam through the water injection drill hole; wherein, the water injection drilling hole is positioned in the fracturing range of the fracturing guide drilling hole. The invention can increase gas extraction and coal seam water injection, and can reduce the amount of water injection engineering, so as to effectively reduce the dynamic disasters which seriously threaten the safe and efficient exploitation of the coal mine in China at present, such as coal and gas outburst, rock burst and the like.

title_en: Simulation training device for fire prevention of subway system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a simulation training set for fire prevention of a subway system, which comprises a station hall and a station platform which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, and further comprises a fresh air well and an exhaust well, wherein the fresh air well is communicated with the station hall and the station platform through an air supply pipeline, the air supply pipeline is provided with a static pressure box and comprises an air supply main pipeline, an air supply pipeline first branch pipeline and an air supply pipeline second branch pipeline, and the air supply main pipeline is provided with a fresh air fan and a fresh air valve; the exhaust shaft is communicated with the station hall and the station platform through an exhaust pipeline, the exhaust pipeline comprises an exhaust main pipeline, a first branch pipeline of the exhaust pipeline and a second branch pipeline of the exhaust pipeline, and an exhaust fan and an exhaust valve are arranged on the exhaust main pipeline. A first automatic smoke-proof fire-proof valve is arranged on the first branch pipeline of the air supply pipeline, and a second automatic smoke-proof fire-proof valve is arranged on the second branch pipeline of the air supply pipeline. When a fire disaster occurs, the first automatic smoke-proof fire-proof valve and the second automatic smoke-proof fire-proof valve are fused inside to automatically close the air supply pipeline, so that the input of fresh air is cut off, and the expansion of the fire disaster is avoided.
assignees: HENAN DAYU ELECTROMECHANICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Subway fire treatment simulation training device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a subway fire treatment simulation training set, including upper station hall, platform, new trend well and exhaust well, the new trend well all communicates with station hall and platform through supply-air duct, is provided with the static pressure case on the supply-air duct, and the supply-air duct includes air supply trunk line, supply-air duct first branch pipeline and supply-air duct second branch pipeline, is equipped with new trend fan and new trend valve on the air supply trunk line; the exhaust shaft is communicated with the station hall and the station platform through exhaust pipelines, each exhaust pipeline comprises an exhaust main pipeline, a first exhaust pipeline branch and a second exhaust pipeline branch, and an exhaust fan and an exhaust valve are arranged on each exhaust main pipeline; a first electric smoke exhaust fire prevention valve is arranged on the first branch pipeline of the air exhaust pipeline, and a second electric smoke exhaust fire prevention valve is arranged on the second branch pipeline of the air exhaust pipeline. When a fire disaster happens, the fresh air fan and the fresh air valve are closed, the exhaust fan and the exhaust valve are opened, smoke in the station hall and the station platform is exhausted, and more escape time is provided for people in the station hall and the station platform.
assignees: HENAN DAYU ELECTROMECHANICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: DEM contact model construction method for reflecting weakening of seepage to rock and soil mass strength
abstract_en: The invention provides a DEM contact model construction method for embodying the weakening of seepage on rock and soil body strength, namely selecting a filling body in a disaster-causing structure to obtain the change rule of the accumulated loss of the filling body along with time and the change rule of the mechanical parameters of the filling body along with the loss of the filling body under the action of seepage; carrying out test simulation, and determining the corresponding each group of mesomechanics parameters in each time period and the relation function of the mesomechanics parameters of the DEM contact model capable of representing the change rule of the macroscopic mechanics parameters of the filling body; embedding each microscopic parameter relation function into the existing particle contact model, developing test simulation, and updating the fracture failure criterion of the contact model according to the corresponding relation of macroscopic intensity when the model is broken, thereby realizing the simulation of the continuous weakening process of the strength of the filling body; and establishing a penetration destruction discrete element calculation model based on an indoor penetration destruction test, and simulating the penetration destruction process of the rock and soil body by adopting the obtained particle contact model and the fracture criterion thereof.

title_en: BIM-based underground space personnel safety evacuation simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a BIM-based underground space personnel safety evacuation simulation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: BIM modeling: acquiring data of an underground space, and importing the data into a BIM to construct a BIM model; and (3) identifying a dangerous source: acquiring monitoring information of each area in the underground space in real time through field monitoring and identifying dangerous cases; and (3) risk evaluation: evaluating the grade of the dangerous case according to a preset dangerous case evaluation method; emergency evacuation simulation: when the grade reaches the preset grade, the preset personnel evacuation method is started to safely evacuate personnel.

title_en: Intelligent detection and evaluation method for natural disaster risk
abstract_en: The invention provides a natural disaster risk intelligent detection and evaluation method and application, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a remote sensing image training and verification data set of the power distribution network tower passage environment; determining a target risk area by establishing a power distribution network tower passage environment multi-risk detection model based on a Yolov3 target detection model; training a power distribution network tower channel environment multi-risk detection model based on a Yolov3 target detection model, and generating a model output result; and detecting and evaluating the risk target by establishing a multi-risk detection and evaluation method based on a Yolov3 target detection model for the intelligent power distribution network tower passage environment, and outputting an evaluation result. The invention can improve the comprehensiveness and accuracy of potential safety hazard investigation.

title_en: Hybrid simulation test method for researching structural wind excitation response
abstract_en: The application provides a method for researching dynamic response under structural wind load by combining numerical simulation and physical test, belonging to the field of structural disaster prevention, in particular to the field of structural wind resistance test research. According to the test method provided by the application, an actual engineering structure is divided into the test substructure (1) and the calculation substructure (2), the test substructure (1) is loaded through the novel wind excitation device (4), the calculation substructure (2) carries out computer numerical simulation through structure analysis software, and interaction is carried out between the test substructure and the calculation substructure through the data exchange system (3), so that the response of the whole structure under external wind excitation is obtained. The method overcomes the defects that the traditional wind tunnel test is difficult to accurately simulate the response of a complex engineering structure under wind load due to size limitation, particularly overcomes the defect of high wind loss test difficulty and the like, breaks through the size limitation of a structural model, reduces test cost, has more ideal simulation effect on the polar wind load, and can meet the requirements of engineering technology and researchers.

title_en: Calculation method for smoke countercurrent length of tunnel lateral key smoke discharging fire
abstract_en: The invention relates to a calculation method of a tunnel lateral key smoke discharge fire smoke countercurrent length, which comprises the following specific steps: determining an influence factor of the smoke countercurrent length L, and establishing a relation between the smoke countercurrent length L and the influence factor; determining basic dimensions, and establishing a dimensional relation between the flue gas countercurrent length L and influencing factors; determining basic physical quantity, obtaining dimensionless items of influence factors according to pi theorem, and deducing a dimensionless calculation formula of the flue gas countercurrent length L; the numerical value of the smoke countercurrent length L of the fire disaster under different working conditions is obtained through numerical simulation, simulation results are drawn into a scatter diagram, and the influence of influencing factors on the smoke countercurrent length L is clear; and carrying out nonlinear fitting on the results to obtain values of all unknown coefficients in the dimensionless relational expression, and further establishing a calculation formula of the dimensionless smoke countercurrent length L. The method has the beneficial effects of being simple, being applicable to different tunnels and providing guidance for fire smoke control and firefighting rescue of the lateral key smoke discharging tunnel.

title_en: Portable extremely-fast cutting device capable of being used for underwater operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable extremely-fast cutting device capable of being used for underwater operation, which comprises a back frame, a bar material placing cylinder, a gas cylinder fixing plate, a gas cylinder locking plate, a gas cylinder fixing base, a foot base, a dividing pin mounting base, a dividing pin, a gas cylinder, a first nameplate, a second nameplate, a backing ring, a foot support, an externally-hung pin, a power supply, a lifting handle, a pressure reducing valve, a gas pipe, a stop valve, a pressure gauge, a cutting gun, a cutting strip and a voltage stabilizer, wherein the high-intensity aluminum alloy is mainly used for preparation, the weight is reduced, the 6.8 liter and 8 liter gas cylinders are universal, the externally-connected gas cylinders with different capacities can be selected according to the workload, the carrying is convenient, only 1-2 people are needed for carrying, the manpower is saved, and; meanwhile, the drilling and cutting can be completed in a very short time, the operation is simple, the grasping is easy, the use is safe, a large amount of rescue and first-aid repair time can be saved, the device is suitable for the rescue and first-aid repair work of accidents such as natural disasters, emergencies, wars and the like, and the device can also be suitable for the field obstacle clearing work in heavy rain weather.
assignees: ARMY ARMORED MILITARY ACAD PLA;SHANGHAI JUNYE PREC ELECTROMECHANICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Grouting reinforcement transformation method for coal seam floor limestone confined aquifer
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal mine water disaster prevention and control, and provides a grouting reinforcement and reconstruction method for a coal bed bottom plate limestone confined aquifer, wherein a grouting reinforcement and reconstruction engineering scheme is designed for the coal bed bottom plate limestone confined aquifer, a grouting reinforcement and reconstruction range is determined, then, drilling plane positions are designed according to a grid method, and drilling holes are uniformly distributed; the drill holes in the drill site are uniformly arranged in an umbrella shape, and the design direction of the drill holes is vertical or oblique to the development direction of the fracture structure and the crack; then, carrying out drilling and grouting engineering construction, arranging a drilling field for drilling and grouting work in the same gate way, arranging a set of drilling and grouting equipment in the same drilling field, continuously carrying out drilling and grouting operation, grouting immediately after one drilling construction is finished, and then constructing another drilling; and finally, carrying out grouting effect inspection and evaluation. The safe, environment-friendly, high-quality and efficient mining of the fully mechanized coal mining face threatened by the water hazard of the coal bed floor limestone confined aquifer is realized by grouting, reinforcing and transforming the coal bed floor limestone confined aquifer.

title_en: Slope geological disaster boundary extraction method for improving watershed algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster information extraction, and discloses a slope geological disaster boundary extraction method for improving a watershed algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1, segmenting the image to be segmented by simulating an immersion watershed algorithm; converting the RGB value of each region pixel obtained after division into a Luv value, and calculating the Luv average value of all pixels in each region as the Luv value of the region; s2, establishing four neighborhood arrays of each region with Luv mean values as region colors, and simultaneously determining a minimum region judgment threshold; s3, finding all the minimum areas; s4, combining the adjacent area and the minimum area through a color difference judgment method until all the minimum areas are combined; and S5, converting the Luv values of all the combined areas into RGB values. The method has obvious advantages in information extraction time, avoids complex post-processing processes, and greatly improves time efficiency.

title_en: Slope geological disaster extraction method of multi-feature auxiliary watershed algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster information extraction, and discloses a slope geological disaster extraction method of a multi-feature auxiliary watershed algorithm, which comprises the following steps: segmenting an image to be segmented by simulating an immersion watershed algorithm, and converting an RGB color space into a Luv color space in the segmented region; searching a minimum area in all the divided areas; traversing all adjacent areas of each tiny area, and combining the adjacent areas and the tiny areas of which the color difference values meet the conditions until all tiny areas are combined; calculating each characteristic factor layer and overlapping the characteristic factor layer with the merged segmentation area; and setting a terrain characteristic threshold, a sensitivity characteristic threshold and a geometric characteristic threshold, and eliminating the areas which do not meet the threshold condition, wherein the rest areas are the extracted slope geological disaster pattern spots. The time efficiency and the accuracy of the slope geological disaster in the extracted experimental area are high, the goodness of fit between the slope disaster boundary and the visual interpretation result is good, the manual intervention in the extraction process is less, and the objectivity is high.

title_en: Regional torrential flood risk prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional torrential flood risk prediction method and a regional torrential flood risk prediction system, wherein the prediction method comprises the following steps: s1, forecasting weather information of all hills in the area based on the meteorological model; s2, screening out hills needing risk prediction based on the weather information; s3, dividing the hills needing risk prediction into different risk prediction grades according to the basic information of the hills; different risk prediction grades correspond to different risk prediction periods; s4, preliminarily determining a disaster-causing factor for mountain torrent evaluation; s5, screening the preliminarily determined disaster-causing factors to obtain main disaster-causing factors affecting the torrential flood; s6, training and generating a plurality of torrential flood risk prediction models based on the main disaster factors; s7, combining the several risk prediction models with the best selectivity to form a final risk prediction model; and S8, performing mountain flood risk prediction on the hill to be predicted. The method and the device realize the risk prediction of the regional hills, have low cost, wide coverage and high processing efficiency, and improve the safety of the hills.

title_en: Multi-target guiding personnel evacuation simulation method and simulation system based on swarm algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cross application of intelligent computing and operational research, and discloses a multi-target guided personnel evacuation simulation method and system based on a swarm algorithm. As can be seen from the results of crowd evacuation simulation in the evacuation scene of a single classroom, the total evacuation time of the invention is faster than that of an evacuation model based on a basic artificial bee colony algorithm, and the total evacuation time is improved by 35.5%. The method provides an idea for evacuation modeling under the condition of multiple obstacles, and provides a beneficial guiding basis for reducing evacuation time, reducing disaster loss and formulating an evacuation strategy.

title_en: Landslide-dam blocking dam-dam break flood disaster chain evolution process simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and engineering geology, and provides a test device and a test method for landslide-dam blocking-dam break flood disaster chain evolution process simulation. The device comprises: a landslide dynamic condition simulation system, a hydrodynamic condition simulation system and a non-contact measurement system. The landslide power condition simulation system can simulate various landslide body materials, landslide speed, width, length and inclination angle of landslide paths; the hydrodynamic condition simulation system can simulate a plurality of hydrodynamic conditions such as water flow, water flow rate, river inclination angle, river bed properties and the like; the non-contact measurement system provided with the test device can realize the non-contact measurement from single contact point measurement to the whole domain, and the measurement method has high precision and is convenient and quick. The invention has simple structure and convenient use, and provides a reliable indoor test simulation device and method for landslide-damming dam-dam break flood disaster chain research.

title_en: Unsupervised image feature extraction and classification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unsupervised image feature extraction and classification method, which comprises the following steps: a: establishing a serial stacked self-encoder network with three hidden layers, and inputting original image data into the self-encoder network after dimension reduction; b: the pre-training network obtains a weight matrix W and an offset b; the method comprises the steps that a greedy algorithm is adopted to train a first hidden layer, then a weight matrix W and an offset b are updated to obtain a first hidden layer characteristic matrix, the first hidden layer characteristic matrix is input, a greedy algorithm is adopted to train a second hidden layer, then the weight matrix W and the offset b are updated again to obtain a second hidden layer characteristic matrix; c: weighting and fusing the characteristics of the first hidden layer characteristic matrix and the second hidden layer characteristic matrix according to the classification precision to obtain a mixed-order characteristic matrix H; d: classifying the mixed order feature matrix H through an SVM classifier to obtain a classification result; e: and obtaining the classification precision A through comparison. The invention has the advantages of alleviating the dimension disaster problem of the high-dimensional image and having high identification precision.

title_en: Urban regional multiscale personnel evacuation simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional multi-scale evacuation simulation method for urban people, which comprises the steps of determining a boundary region for simulating evacuation, acquiring evacuation exit information, building and personnel distribution information, road section space and attribute information and internal size information of a building at the boundary of the region, constructing a regional evacuated space topological structure model, dividing evacuation regions, planning evacuation routes, calculating evacuation time from the interior of the building to the exterior, coupling model evacuation boundary layers, simulating and calculating the regional evacuation, optimizing evacuation region division and evacuation route planning schemes, and outputting the evacuation time of the regional optimized evacuation scheme; based on the classical personnel evacuation theory and the mature cellular automata model, the invention develops and establishes the regional personnel evacuation mesoscopic model and the simulation technology suitable for the cities with large range and multiple scales, and has important theoretical significance and practical value for improving the emergency response capability and the crisis handling capability of the city emergency management department and improving the overall disaster prevention and reduction capability of the cities.

title_en: Outdoor emergency guiding path indicating method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outdoor emergency guiding path indicating method, which comprises the following steps: s10, randomly taking values of all characteristic factors within a reasonable range by using the factors which have great influence on the group evacuation time, including personnel characteristics and path characteristics, and simulating by using an outdoor group evacuation behavior model to obtain the evacuation time; s20, grouping the obtained data, and dividing each group of data into training data (75%) and testing data (25%) through a sketch library spilt function aiming at each group of data; s30, preliminarily judging the relation between the data characteristics and the prediction result, selecting a linear regression prediction method to establish a prediction model, establishing a loss function by adopting a least square method, establishing a model by utilizing python/scimit-leran, establishing an evaluation function by relative errors by adopting a minimum gradient method in the optimization process, obtaining the adaptive relative error weighing values of the models, obtaining a prediction time parameter matrix, and establishing a time prediction model; and S40, analyzing the selection plan of the path based on the outdoor emergency evacuation time prediction model.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;BEIJING HUAXIN YUANJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Gabion fixing construction method
abstract_en: A gabion fixing construction method is suitable for a road slope, can enable a gabion to be more stable, and can further stabilize surrounding soil in natural disasters so as to ensure safety; the construction method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: drilling holes on the slope below the framework of a hollow gabion, wherein the periphery of the hollow gabion is provided with a metal mesh; step two: placing the hollow gabion on a slope, and enabling the skeleton of the hollow gabion to approximately correspond to the upper part of the drilled hole; step three: a steel rope spans the framework; step four: suspending the steel rope into the bore; step five: grouting concrete from the drill hole, and fixing the steel rope in the drill hole after solidification to be integrated with the concrete; step six: finally, filling a stone package in the hollow gabion and combining the hollow gabion and the sloping field into a whole; according to the construction method, the steel rope is combined with concrete in the sloping field, so that the reinforcement effect of combining the gabion with the sloping field is achieved, and the sloping field is prevented from collapsing.

title_en: Coal and gas outburst prediction method based on logistic regression and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal and gas outburst prediction method based on logistic regression and reinforcement learning, which belongs to the technical field of dynamic prediction, and the method fuses LR and Adaboost reinforcement learning to design a coal and gas outburst prediction model, collects multiple influence factor data samples of coal and gas outburst, trains the coal and gas outburst prediction model based on the LR and Adaboost fusion model, and in the process of monitoring coal and gas outburst disasters in real time, if the predicted result of the coal and gas outburst is inconsistent with the fed-back actual result, the sample data is updated by utilizing the real-time data and the corresponding actual result, and carries out training and learning again on the coal and gas outburst prediction model based on the LR and Adaboost fusion model, so that the correction of the coal and gas outburst prediction model is completed. The method provided by the invention can realize rapid, accurate and dynamic prediction of coal and gas outburst prediction.

title_en: Power system dynamic hybrid simulation method and system based on ice wind weather conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic hybrid simulation method and a dynamic hybrid simulation system for an electric power system based on ice wind weather conditions, wherein an ice wind weather and electric power system dynamic interaction influence process and a dynamic evolution process of ice disasters and wind disasters are considered, and electric power system simulation and meteorological system simulation are simultaneously set.

title_en: Bowen disaster information importance weighting classification method based on deep learning and XGboost algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for carrying out weighted classification on importance of disaster information of blog articles based on deep learning and XGboost algorithm, which mainly comprises the following five steps: step (1), receiving social media text data and preprocessing the social media text data; step (2) constructing a disaster word pre-training word vector table for converting social media text data into word vectors; step (3) converting the social media text data preprocessed in the step (1) into word vectors with the dimension d through the word vector table updated in the step (2), and performing information category classification and importance category classification on the social media text data by using an XGboost algorithm; step (4), weighting the information classification result and the alarm classification result of the social media text data to determine the importance of the contained text information; according to the method, an importance weighting function is added on the basis of social media text data, the degree of association between the information category and the alarming is established by dividing the information category and the alarming category of the social media text data, deep learning and an XGboost algorithm are combined for classification, and the information category and the alarming category association are weighted to obtain a final social media text data information importance index. Experimental results show that the information importance classification effect of the social media text data is obviously improved.

title_en: Working face collapse column grouting waterproof treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster treatment, in particular to a working face collapse column grouting waterproof treatment method. The method comprises the following steps: pushing the working surface to cut the hole, and stopping pushing after keeping a safe distance with the collapse column; tunneling two grouting auxiliary roadways and a plurality of grouting drill pits at the positions of the transportation crossheading corresponding to the collapse columns, and tunneling a plurality of corresponding grouting drill pits at the positions of the return air crossheading corresponding to the collapse columns; and constructing inclined grouting drill holes in a grouting auxiliary roadway and a grouting drill hole in the transportation crossheading, constructing inclined grouting drill holes in the grouting drill hole in the return air crossheading, and controlling the final hole positions of all grouting drill holes to be in the water-containing position of the bottom plate between the two bottom plate water-resisting layers of the coal seam. The method is not only suitable for preventing the situation that the water-free water-guiding collapse column is activated to guide water due to mining influence, but also can reinforce the water-guiding collapse column in a multi-layer grouting mode, improve the water-resisting capability of the water-guiding collapse column and ensure that water damage accidents do not occur when the coal face is pushed.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INST SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV HENAN POLYTECHNIC;UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Square combined multi-layer experimental device for simulating crowd flow of zebra fish
abstract_en: The invention discloses a square combined multi-layer experimental device for simulating crowd flow of zebra fish, which comprises a partition plate, a risk avoiding cabin, a light supplementing device, a drain pipe, a support frame, a carbon fiber filter, a water purifying tank, a base, a turbine water pump, a square fish tank, a vibration generator, a water inlet pipe, a hemispherical bell and a spring fixer. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the aspect ratio of the length and width dimensions of the square fish tank and the actual crowd dense building place is 0.08, so that the design of the model is more reasonable and more comparable, the zebra fish which is used for simulating crowd flow is cultivated in the square fish tank, so that the population behavior rules of human beings can be better reflected in emergency evacuation simulation, the water surface is controlled to be about 1cm when the zebra fish is cultivated in the square fish tank, the fish swarm actions are strictly two-dimensional, layering cannot occur, and meanwhile, the influence of refraction effects caused by the water surface depth on observation can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Anti-treading exhibition hall safety education air model
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a prevent trampling exhibition room safety education gas mould. The utility model discloses a prevent trampling exhibition room safety education gas mould, include the gas mould body and be used for carrying out gas filled fan to the gas mould body, the gas mould body includes wall body and roof all around, be provided with the entry and the export that supply the people to pass in and out on the wall body, still be provided with on the gas mould body with fan complex air intake, this internal urgent sparse passageway that extends along gas mould body length direction that is provided with of gas mould. The utility model discloses a prevent trampling exhibition room safety education air model through the scene of promptly fleing when this internal emergency evacuation passageway simulation danger that sets up of air model takes place, the in-process that plays at children realizes trampling safety education to children's prevention to reduce the emergence of trampling the incident when really taking place the earthquake.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU KIDDYSON AMUSEMENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multiple operation load induced ground settlement prevention and control device for karst cave methane stratum
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of prevention and control of ground settlement induced by operation load, and provides a multiple operation load induced ground settlement prevention and control device for a karst cave methane stratum. The method and the device can simultaneously simulate the ground settlement of multiple ground and underground operation loads in the urban high-concentration area under different operation conditions, and acquire accurate ground settlement data so as to effectively prevent and control the ground settlement disasters; the method can simulate the influence of the high-pressure methane stratum containing the karst caves in the subway operation area of the urban high-concentration area on ground settlement, and can obtain the distribution rule of the high-pressure methane stratum containing the karst caves on the ground settlement so as to reduce the risk of carrying out subway construction on the high-pressure methane stratum containing the karst caves and reduce the construction cost; according to the method and the device, the ground settlement data caused by subway operation in the urban high-density area under the condition of different rainfall amounts can be obtained, so that various risks caused by urban subway construction in the flood prevention period are reduced, the construction period is saved, and the safety of subway construction is ensured.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG SIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;HANGZHOU METRO GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power communication fault emergency disposal method based on neural network classification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network classification-based power communication fault emergency disposal method. Obtaining a network management warning text through a power communication network management system, and preprocessing the network management warning text through text word segmentation and character feature extraction so as to extract each piece of network management warning information; obtaining the mark fault type of each alarm by a manual marking method, and dividing the network management alarm information into a network management alarm training set and a network management alarm testing set; taking a network management alarm training set as the input of a neural network, training the neural network by combining with a labeled fault type, and obtaining the trained neural network through training; and applying the trained neural network to a power communication network management system, and providing a corresponding emergency disposal scheme according to the predicted fault type. According to the invention, by introducing the neural network classification model, the power communication fault disposal efficiency is improved, and the emergency response time is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION COMPANY

title_en: Disaster simulation method, computer storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster simulation method, a computer storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring interaction behavior parameters of the drilling participants in a disaster scene; determining a disaster scene according to the interaction behavior parameters based on a pre-established scene knowledge base; determining scene parameters based on disaster scenes and a dynamics equation; and forming a visual scene according to the scene parameters. According to the method provided by the invention, the simulated disaster scene is dynamically generated in real time based on the disaster scene and the interaction behavior of the dynamic equation root, and the real scene is provided for emergency exercise.

title_en: Rainfall-runoff-flooding simulation method based on rainfall and space division
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall-runoff-flooding simulation method based on rainfall and space division, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring initial precipitation data of a basin to be detected, and preprocessing the data to obtain processed precipitation data; s2: carrying out scene division on the rainfall amount of the basin to be tested, and establishing a correlation model of early-stage influence rainfall and rainfall of the basin to be tested; s3: establishing a correlation model of the early-stage influence rainfall and runoff; s4: carrying out space division on the drainage basin to be detected based on the DEM; s5: by utilizing the space division, the runoff-flooding simulation is realized; the method can solve the problem that the runoff change condition is rapidly simulated by rainfall data under the condition that the regional hydrological parameters are missing, and the flood inundation deduction is realized, and has important significance for improving the flood disaster prediction capability.

title_en: Water resource simulation configuration calculation method and water resource configuration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource simulation configuration calculation method, which comprises the following steps: 1) establishing a watershed or regional simulation topographic map; 2) establishing physical matching of the water-requiring object and the water source project through the simulated topographic map; 3) according to the distribution relation of a water system, a water source project and users on the simulated topographic map, taking the upstream, the middle and the downstream of a drainage basin as a system, taking a specific reservoir project, a water-lifting project and a control section as summary nodes, and carrying out three-level optimization according to the project level, the position information and the specific position of a water-requiring object: first-level optimization, wherein water lifting engineering nodes are optimized; second-level optimization, reservoir node optimization; and (3) performing three-level optimization, namely performing area or basin optimization calculation on the configuration scheme of the current situation or the planning horizontal year by taking the basin or the area as a whole. The invention also discloses a water resource configuration method. The method has the advantages of avoiding the real matching error of the engineering supply and demand relation, avoiding the problem of dimension disaster of optimization, and avoiding the phenomenon of mismatching between engineering and water demand caused by the traditional optimization.

title_en: Emergency response practical training system, method and equipment based on VR (virtual reality)
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency response practical training system, method and device based on VR, the system includes: the client is used for storing the login of a client to carry out training; the server end is used for storing a data management platform of the practical training system; the client and the server are connected by a network to realize real-time communication; the teaching module is used for teaching the user the ability of mastering emergency response; the examination module is used for examining whether the user masters the emergency response capability; a VR device. The invention adopts VR technology to construct different virtual reality emergency scenes, realizes an immersive interactive safety production emergency response practical training system for single multi-role training and examination, and is a novel emergency response practical training mode. Comprehensive emergency training across roles and specialties can be supported; the emergency response training system can achieve emergency response training of a single person, different scenes, different emergency types, different emergency response levels, multiple roles and multiple tasks.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD;CHIPONT BEIJING RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF SAFETY PRODUCTION TECH CO LTD;BEIJING SAFETY PRODUCTION TECH SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Three-dimensional hydrophobic active disaster control protection device for coal mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional hydrophobic active disaster control protection device for coal mining, which comprises a center support and first clamping seats symmetrically arranged on the front side and the rear side of the center support, wherein longitudinal connecting pieces are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the center support, telescopic connecting seats are symmetrically arranged on the front end and the rear end of the longitudinal connecting pieces, second clamping seats are symmetrically arranged on the left end and the right end of the telescopic connecting seats, and buffer moving mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the two ends of the bottom of the second clamping seats. According to the invention, through scientific and reasonable structural design, the first clamping seat and the second clamping seat can be adjusted in real time according to the structural sizes of different mechanical equipment, the use safety of the mechanical equipment can be effectively ensured in the whole use process, the service life of the mechanical equipment is greatly prolonged, the normal drilling of the bedding hole and the layering hole is ensured, and the mechanical equipment has good practical and popularization values.

title_en: Method for intercepting gas extracted from directional long drill hole
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of underground gas extraction of coal mines, and particularly relates to a method for extracting gas by intercepting directional long drill holes, which solves the problem that when a coal body covered by the directional long drill holes is subjected to coal roadway tunneling crossheading construction, and when the directional long drill holes are exposed on a tunneling working face, the gas in the directional long drill holes abnormally gushes out to cause gas overrun. The invention comprises the steps of coal seam outburst elimination: s1: directional long drilling construction; s2: pre-extraction; s3: evaluating and analyzing the coal body; after the coal body outburst elimination is finished, the following steps are implemented: s4: tunneling a coal roadway crossheading; s5: analyzing a junction area; s6: ordinary drilling of a roadway is constructed; s7: intercepting extraction; s8: and continuing the coal roadway crossheading. The invention avoids gas in the directional long drill hole from instantly rushing out to the coal roadway crossheading tunnel space due to the exposure of the directional long drill hole during the coal roadway crossheading tunneling, thereby causing gas ejection or gas disaster accidents; the invention can quickly improve the tunneling speed of the roadway and realize the purpose of extracting peripheral coal bodies continuously.

title_en: System and method for disaster prediction and analysis of structures, and a recording medium having computer readable program for executing the method
title_ko: 재난 피해 예측 및 분석 시스템, 방법 및 상기 방법을 실행시키기 위한 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 프로그램을 기록한 기록 매체
abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster damage prediction and analysis system, a method thereof, and a recording medium recording a computer-readable program for executing the method. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the disaster damage prediction and analysis system comprises: a response database construction unit for constructing a response database of a building by applying a plurality of disaster scenarios to a behavior model of the building; a risk information calculation unit for selecting a disaster scenario which best matches actual measured disaster data, and calculating disaster risk analysis information preset by the selected disaster scenario; a measurement value analysis unit which analyzes the actual measured disaster data to calculate disaster risk analysis information; and a disaster damage providing unit for visualizing first disaster risk analysis information calculated by the measurement value analysis unit and second disaster risk analysis information calculated by the risk information calculation unit.
abstract_ko: 실시 예는, 복수의 재난 시나리오를 건축물의 거동모델에 적용하여 상기 건축물의 응답 데이터베이스를 구축하는 응답 데이터베이스 구축부; 실제 계측된 재난 데이터와 가장 매칭되는 재난 시나리오를 선택하고, 선택된 상기 재난 시나리오에 의해 미리 설정된 재난 위험 분석 정보를 산출하는 위험 정보 산출부; 상기 실제 계측된 재난 데이터를 분석하여 재난 위험 분석 정보를 산출하는 계측값 분석부; 및 상기 계측값 분석부에서 산출한 제1 재난 위험 분석 정보 및 상기 위험 정보 산출부에서 산출한 제2 재난 위험 분석 정보를 시각화하는 재난 피해 제공부를 포함하는 재난 피해 예측 및 분석 시스템, 방법 및 상기 방법을 실행시키기 위한 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 프로그램을 기록한 기록 매체를 개시한다.

title_en: Swarm-Based Firefighting Drone and Mass Aerial Drop System and Method
abstract_en: Presently disclosed subject matter integrates a method of using thousands of semi-autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles, herein called drones, to deliver vastly superior amounts of fire retardant over substantially larger and variably-shaped drop patterns. Each drone is able to swap its own batteries with freshly charged batteries and each drone is able to refill its container with water or fire retardant. Once launched, a swarm of drones can perform repeated trips from the water/retardant source to the fire without human involvement other than the high-level tasking of where to drop the retardant. Once a general drop destination and drop pattern shape is designated, the swarm can transport retardant to that location, form itself into the desired drop shape, and deploy retardant. The drone body is designed to be modular so different components can be attached with ease and no special training or knowledge required.

title_en: High-voltage overhead transmission line typhoon disaster prediction method based on classification decision tree
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural disaster prediction of high-voltage transmission lines, and particularly relates to a typhoon disaster prediction method of a high-voltage overhead transmission line based on a classification decision tree. Aiming at the defect that the accuracy of the traditional typhoon disaster prediction method is not high, the invention adopts the following technical scheme: a typhoon disaster prediction method of a high-voltage overhead transmission line based on a classification decision tree comprises the steps of S1, selecting typhoon disaster influence factors of the high-voltage overhead transmission line S2, building a historical typhoon disaster fault point influence factor database of the high-voltage overhead transmission line S3, conducting typhoon disaster prediction model training by adopting the classification decision tree S4, and conducting typhoon disaster prediction by adopting a typhoon disaster prediction model and combining target high-voltage overhead transmission line and typhoon prediction data. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the influence of typhoon disasters on the high-voltage overhead transmission line can be accurately predicted, and therefore the work of disaster prevention and reduction is scientifically guided.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation system and simulation method based on three different behaviors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd evacuation simulation system and a simulation method based on three different behaviors, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises a scene modeling module, a pedestrian information loading module, a crowd behavior modeling module and a result output and analysis module; the method comprises the following steps: (1) establishing an abstract environment and carrying out layout of related facilities; (2) generating safe evacuation crowd, initializing pedestrians, determining pedestrian targets and position information, and setting behavior correlation attributes of the pedestrians; (3) establishing a crowd evacuation behavior model, and driving the pedestrian to move through the behavior decision of the pedestrian; (4) and (3) realizing the simulation result and carrying out correlation analysis on the result. The invention can provide required data support for evacuation research, reveal the evacuation rule of people and find the evacuation bottleneck, thereby having important theoretical significance and practical significance for improving the safety design level of buildings and the evacuation capacity.

title_en: Navigation rescue scheduling optimization method based on rescue efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a navigation rescue scheduling optimization method based on rescue efficiency.A general aircraft is used as a scheduling research object, the load, the flight time and the number of airplanes of the aircraft are used as constraint conditions, and a multi-rescue-point and multi-disaster-point aircraft scheduling optimization model is established by taking the maximization of the rescue efficiency and the minimization of the total flight mileage as targets; solving a scheduling optimization model of the aircraft with multiple rescue points and multiple disaster-affected points by adopting a hybrid genetic simulated annealing algorithm to obtain an optimal navigation rescue scheduling scheme; the hybrid genetic simulated annealing algorithm not only increases the quality of population diversity and solution, but also avoids the premature convergence phenomenon of the genetic algorithm, has better optimization effect on the objective function of the navigation rescue scheduling problem, can meet the rescue requirement of a disaster-affected point to a certain extent by applying the method to the actual rescue work, improves the rescue efficiency, reduces the flight cost, has strong industrial practicability, and is convenient for popularization and use.

title_en: Geological disaster literature knowledge graph construction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster literature knowledge graph construction method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: according to the type of the address disaster, searching a geological disaster related document; according to literature knowledge corpus, adopting a maximum forward matching algorithm to name entity seed back-labeling literature sentences, and constructing a geological disaster name entity recognition template; constructing a geological disaster named entity recognition model; training a geological disaster named entity recognition corpus by using a multi-branch bidirectional gating unit conditional random field model based on deep learning; and predicting the geological disaster named entity according to the geological disaster named entity recognition model, and constructing a geological disaster knowledge graph. By adopting the method, a seed set of the geological disaster named entity is semi-automatically constructed, a recognition corpus of the geological disaster named entity is automatically constructed, the geological disaster named entity in the geological disaster literature is automatically predicted, and reuse and automatic knowledge extraction of the geological disaster literature are effectively improved.

title_en: Experimental platform and experimental method for simulating fire of extra-high voltage converter transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental platform and an experimental method for simulating a fire disaster of an extra-high voltage converter transformer. The platform comprises a transformer system, a heating system and a testing system, wherein the transformer system comprises an oil tank fixed on the steel structure support, an oil conservator connected with the oil tank and a bottom oil pool adjacent to the steel structure support; the heating system comprises an oil tank resistor external circulation heating system, a bottom oil pool resistor heating system, an oil conservator resistor heating system and a temperature control cabinet, and the testing system comprises a temperature sensor, a heat flow sensor, a thermal infrared imager and a high-definition camera; the simulation system can realize the simulation of the actual fire scale, the fire development and spreading process and the fire extinguishing process of the ultra-high voltage converter transformer; respectively realizing the simulation reappearance of the fire with the lifting seat and the full liquid level fire; the fire extinguishing efficiency of different fire extinguishing systems can be contrasted and verified; the fire control system can systematically research the fire characteristics of the fire control system, and provides theoretical basis and technical support for objectively evaluating the actual fire control and extinguishing effects of different fire extinguishing systems.

title_en: Container scheduling method for secondary scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a container scheduling method facing secondary scheduling, which monitors each container, node and service instance on a container cloud platform in real time, acquires instance running state, resource data and affinity characteristics of the containers, monitors scheduling requests for increasing or reducing containers in batch, and gives results on which node the operation of increasing or reducing containers needs to be carried out by adopting strategies of resource balance, affinity satisfaction, service disaster tolerance and the like based on greedy, simulated annealing and genetic algorithms. Aiming at the problems that the default scheduler of the current container cloud platform does not support container deletion operation, does not support batch scheduling and has poor effect on a plurality of scheduling requests in a short period, the invention introduces the resource balancing and service disaster tolerance strategies aiming at the container deletion operation and the batch scheduling optimization algorithm facing the container cloud platform so as to meet the scheduling requirement of a secondary scheduling system and improve the scheduling effect of the platform.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;CHINA MOBILE ONLINE SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Test device for simulating gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disaster and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device for simulating gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disasters and a working method, and the test device comprises a simulation system, a gas migration system and a monitoring and analyzing system, wherein the simulation system is used for simulating a working surface, a roadway and a ventilation system; and then the monitoring and analyzing system can detect the gas concentration and temperature change conditions of each area of the simulated working face in real time under the condition of different ventilation air flow rates, and the distribution change conditions of the area where the gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disasters are easy to occur of the whole simulated working face can be fitted according to the change conditions of the area where the gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disasters are easy to occur under different air flow rates because the gas concentration and the temperature required by the area where the gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disasters are easy to occur are known. Finally, the distribution change condition can provide data support for preventing coal mines from generating gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disasters.

title_en: Emergency regulation and control equipment reliability assessment method and system under disaster causing factor condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating the reliability of emergency control equipment under the condition of disaster causing factors, which integrate artificial intelligent machine learning into a reliability model, improve the accuracy and scientificity of an evaluation result and provide guidance for engineering practice of emergency control technical equipment. The method comprises the following steps: disaster situation feature simulation, namely determining a disaster situation disaster factor distribution rule according to a disaster factor evolution rule of fire, gas explosion and coal rock dynamic, and performing disaster situation simulation; the reliability analysis of the emergency control equipment comprises the steps of analyzing constituent units of the emergency control equipment, determining fault modes, fault reasons and fault influence factors of the constituent units, acquiring probability information of the fault modes, the fault reasons and the fault influence factors of the constituent units by using statistical data, determining logic relations among the fault influence factors, and carrying out the reliability analysis of the emergency control equipment based on a Bayesian network.

title_en: Integration is from net photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of electric power technology, and an integration is from net photovoltaic system is disclosed, the load simulator comprises a case, storage battery and dc-to-ac converter are installed to quick-witted incasement, install master switch and controller on the quick-witted case wall, the machine case is kept away from and is installed the output socket that exchanges on the tank wall of master switch, it has solar panel to articulate through four hinges on the quick-witted case wall in opposite directions, is located movable groove has been seted up to the symmetry on the quick-witted case wall under solar panel, sliding connection has the movable block in the movable groove, be equipped with the screw hole in the movable block, be connected with the threaded rod through two first bearings rotations on the opposite direction. The utility model discloses be convenient for pack up of solar electric power system does not occupy the fixed space of installation, and it accomodates and uses to be convenient for, and can remove the use anytime and anywhere, can extensively be used for the family as stand-by power supply, also can regard as outdoor sports to use power and each disaster area emergency power source.
assignees: HUBEI HONGGUANG NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Straight-through water drainage drilling construction method for coal seam mining under conglomerate aquifer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a straight-through water drainage drilling construction method for mining a coal bed below a water-bearing stratum of glutenite, wherein a first-stage drilling hole is drilled to the top interface of the water-bearing stratum of weakly cemented glutenite, a sleeve is installed, and grouting reinforcement is carried out; drilling a second-stage drilling hole to the bottom interface of the water-bearing layer of the weakly cemented glutenite, and mounting a sieve pipe; drilling a third-stage drilling hole until the third-stage drilling hole is communicated with a roadway top plate formed by an underground coal seam to be mined, installing a sleeve and grouting for reinforcement; the lower casing mouth of the drill hole is connected with a valve through a screw thread to control water drainage. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the traditional construction method of the underground drainage water hole is changed, the direct drainage hole is constructed on the ground and communicated with the underground roadway roof, and water in the roof aquifer is drained through the whole weakly cemented glutenite aquifer, so that the drainage effect is improved, the water inrush risk of the roof aquifer is reduced, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of coal mining and disaster prevention.

title_en: Regional power grid geological disaster forecasting model construction method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional power grid geological disaster forecasting model construction method based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a positive and negative sample set; s2, constructing influence factors; s3, building and training a machine learning model; and S4, model prediction test. According to the power grid geological disaster forecasting method, the sample is directly constructed by the disaster point, each influence factor is constructed in the accurate disaster point coordinate range, and the accuracy and pertinence of the model are improved. By utilizing the machine learning method, the automatic learning of the influence factor characteristics is realized, the model automatically learns and extracts important characteristics, and factor weights are automatically distributed, so that the randomness and the one-sidedness caused by interference are avoided. The method has strong expandability, and the model can be dynamically updated only by providing new influence factors and new disaster samples, so that the accuracy of the model is further improved.

title_en: Disaster evaluation analysis method based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster evaluation and analysis method based on a GIS (geographic information System), which relates to the technical field of geological disaster analysis and evaluation, and comprises the steps of collecting historical meteorological data, geological information basic data and historical geological disaster data of an observation place; preprocessing, namely dividing the data into a training data set and a testing data set; constructing a GIS-based neural network analysis model, training the analysis model, and reversely optimizing model parameters; testing the analysis model and outputting the trained analysis model; acquiring meteorological data and geological data of an observation place in real time, analyzing the meteorological data and the geological data by using a trained analysis model, and outputting a real-time analysis result; the early warning grading model is constructed by utilizing the real-time analysis result, the historical meteorological data, the historical geological disaster data and the geological information basic data, and the early warning grading model outputs the current best early warning measure according to the real-time analysis result.

title_en: Self-adaptive fire disaster model early warning detection method for oil-immersed transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive early warning detection method for a fire model of an oil-immersed transformer, which comprises the steps of inputting marked fault data of each sensor into a sample expansion algorithm to expand negative samples, inputting the expanded negative samples and the same number of positive samples into a convolutional neural network, preprocessing the acquired data of each sensor of the transformer, and inputting the preprocessed data into the convolutional neural network to detect the fire model. The fire model comprises a training module, a signal processing module and a diagnosis module; the training module comprises three parts of fault data processing, fault samples and a convolutional neural network, the signal processing module comprises transformer sensor signal acquisition and preprocessing, and the diagnosis module comprises a trained convolutional neural network module. The invention is based on the neural network, and the parameters of the training and adjusting device for fault data containing grounding current and high-frequency current are used for accurately judging the input of the sensor signal and giving early warning, so that the occurrence of fire is avoided.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Flood risk simulation method under extreme environment of rainstorm, high water level and high tide level
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk simulation method under extreme environments of rainstorm, high water level and high tide level, which comprises the following steps: collecting target data in a target area, and performing compilation processing according to the HOHY2 model data format requirement to lay a data foundation for model construction and verification; constructing a target area one-dimensional flood risk simulation model by using the target data and adopting an HOHY2 model; and (3) carrying out numerical simulation on the submerging water depth of the target area and the urban submerging water depth by utilizing the constructed one-dimensional flood risk simulation model in combination with different typical working conditions to obtain a submerging water depth map of the target area, and determining the high-risk area of the flood disaster in combination with the history and the actual conditions of the area. The method can quickly and accurately simulate flood risk conditions such as the submergence depth of the target area, the flood evolution process, the flood propagation time and the like under different working conditions.

title_en: Construction method and device of fire evacuation simulation model of nursing home
abstract_en: A fire evacuation simulation model construction method and device for a nursing home comprise an initialization stage: the environmental space initialization is to quantize and grid the scene of the nursing home by using a cellular automaton theory; the personnel information initialization is to abstract evacuation personnel into agents and randomly generate the agents in an environment space; sensing: each Agent continuously updates its own information through interaction with the sensory stage and passes the resulting information to the decision stage; decision stage: each Agent makes an evacuation decision according to the fastest evacuation principle by analyzing the self capacity and the environmental condition according to the information acquired in the sensing stage; action stage: each Agent responds to the evacuation decision in the decision stage and moves to the optimal safe escape exit. According to the invention, the evacuation time and path of the old and nursing staff are obtained through simulation and prediction, and scientific basis and corresponding strategy are provided for emergency evacuation plans of the nursing home, escape management of the old and building layout design of the nursing home.

title_en: Rescue vehicle simulation training device and operation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue vehicle simulation training device and an operation method, wherein the rescue vehicle simulation training device comprises a six-degree-of-freedom platform, a display and a controller; a single-row two-entity cab frame of the vehicle is erected on the six-degree-of-freedom platform; the driving operation devices in the driving cabin comprise a seat, an instrument panel, a central control and button, a steering wheel, an accelerator, a brake, a clutch and a gear lever. The rescue vehicle simulation training device can simulate the process of a high-mobility rescue vehicle reaching a disaster site after passing through a complex environment in a mountainous area, can be used for operation simulation training of the high-mobility rescue vehicle, and can also simulate the process of rescue operation carried out by a rescue team after the rescue vehicle moves to the site.

title_en: Novel thing networking is made and is trained platform
abstract_en: A novel Internet of things training station comprises an Internet of things training station body, a three-core power plug, a three-core power socket, a voltage-stabilized power supply, a short message module and a buzzer, and further comprises a water leakage demonstration probe, a fire disaster demonstration probe, a natural gas leakage demonstration probe and a control circuit; the three-core power socket, the stabilized voltage power supply, the short message module, the buzzer and the control circuit are arranged in an element box and connected through a lead, the element box is arranged on the training platform body, and the water leakage demonstration probe, the fire disaster demonstration probe and the natural gas leakage demonstration probe are respectively inserted into the three-core power socket through the three-core power plug. The utility model discloses have all functions of current thing networking teaching platform, because the student can manual operation to can directly perceivedly obtain the work process demonstration of thing networking detection alarm device when simulation leaks, conflagration, natural gas leakage, thereby can reach better learning effect, and can improve mr's teaching efficiency. Based on the above, so this novel application prospect that has.
