title_en: Panoramic teaching device for fire fighting system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a be used for fire extinguishing system panorama teaching device belongs to teaching analogue means technical field. It has solved the not good technical problem of waiting of current fire extinguishing system teaching effect. The teaching device comprises a model base and a house main body fixedly arranged on the model base; the house main body adopts 12 upright posts as a supporting structure, the upright posts are distributed in a 4 x 3 rectangular array, the outer wall of the house main body is made of 8mm transparent acrylic, and the inner wall of the house main body is made of 6mm transparent acrylic; each floor of the house main body is provided with an automatic fire alarm and linkage control system, a fire hydrant system, an automatic water spraying fire extinguishing system, a positive pressure air supply system, a mechanical smoke exhaust system, a fireproof door control system, an emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system, a fire elevator, a non-fire power switching device, a smoke releasing device and a flame simulation generating device. The utility model provides a teaching device can bring better teaching demonstration effect.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUITONG FIRE FIGHTING SECURITY INDUSTRIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: water extinguisher for fire drill
title_ko: 소방훈련용 물 소화기
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 소방훈련용 물 소화기에 관한 것으로서, 특히 별도의 확인수단이 용기에 구비되지 않아도 내부에 수용된 물과 공기의 양을 손쉽게 파악할 수 있어 단시간 내에 용기 내의 물과 공기가 적정 비율을 이루면서 충전이 가능하여 편의성이 증대되도록 내부에 물과 공기가 수용되는 용기; 및 사용자가 파지할 수 있는 손잡이와, 관 형태를 이루며 용기의 길이방향을 따라 용기의 내측에 구비되는 인출관과, 일단에 물이 분사되는 노즐이 구비되고 상기 손잡이의 조작에 따라 타단이 인출관과 연통될 수 있는 호스를 포함하며 용기의 상단에 결합되는 헤드;를 포함하되, 상기 용기는 바닥면으로부터 소정의 높이를 이루는 지점에 물과 공기를 내부로 투입할 수 있는 공급구가 구비되어, 물이 공급구가 구비된 높이까지 용기 내에 수용되고, 공기가 용기 내 나머지 공간에 수용되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Experimental method for simulating crowd flow by using zebra fish
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental method for simulating crowd flow by using zebra fish, which comprises the following steps of selecting simulated animals: selecting experimental animals simulating the flow and evacuation of people; establishing a similar criterion: analyzing morphological characteristics of selected experimental animals and human bodies, and determining characteristic length and similar proportion; building an experimental scene model: designing and building experimental facilities according to similar criteria; determining the height of the water layer: the problem of simulating animal stacking action is solved. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the zebra fish is quite similar to human beings in various characteristics such as sense, reaction, behavior and the like, and can better reflect the group behavior rule of human beings in emergency evacuation simulation; based on the similarity criterion established by the characteristic dimension analysis, the model is more reasonable and comparable in design; by utilizing the characteristics of the living space of the aquatic animals, the phenomenon of overlapping in the evacuation of animal simulation crowd can be effectively overcome.

title_en: Rapid simulation method for multi-point damage of complex building structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a quick simulation method for multi-point damage of a complex building structure, which comprises the steps of establishing a sub-region simplified model for the complex building structure; analyzing the mechanical characteristics of each subregion; establishing a macroscopic description mode of structural damage; carrying out numerical simulation of continuous destruction; sorting and displaying the simulation result of the typical case; summarizing a continuous damaged macro evolution rule; reasonably deducing the damage result under other scenes; establishing a database by using the existing cases; approximate cases are quickly retrieved to guide emergency work. The method is combined with the retrieval technology of the damage case database, and can quickly provide an approximate reference case model for disaster response without starting large-scale mechanical calculation when a disaster occurs.

title_en: River regulation scheme simulation and optimization method
abstract_en: the invention belongs to the technical field of emergency disaster prevention, and particularly relates to a ④ river regulation scheme simulation and optimization method which comprises the steps of ④ river regulation measure and scheme determination, ④ river regulation scheme simulation model construction and verification, ④ river regulation scheme simulation and effect evaluation, and ④ river regulation project optimization scheme determination.

title_en: Intelligent fire fighting system based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention provides a BIM-based intelligent fire fighting system, which comprises a central processing unit, a fire safety detection unit, a data analysis and prediction unit and a fire simulation and personnel evacuation unit, wherein the fire safety detection unit, the data analysis and prediction unit and the fire simulation and personnel evacuation unit are all connected with the central processing unit, and the fire safety detection unit shoots check point image information and transmits the check point image information to the central processing unit to be compared with a standard image to automatically generate a detection report; the data analysis and prediction unit predicts the occurrence frequency of the fire by analyzing the characteristics of the fire data; the fire simulation and personnel evacuation unit carries out fire simulation and personnel evacuation simulation by establishing a BIM (building information modeling) model and an evacuation model.

title_en: Experimental device for be used for simulating slot fire and put out a fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device for simulating groove fire and extinguishing fire, which comprises a base, a groove model, a collecting device, a blast device and a water mist system, wherein the groove model for displaying the groove fire disaster, the collecting device for collecting experimental data in the groove fire generation and development process, the blast device for simulating air flow in a groove and the water mist system for extinguishing the groove fire are arranged on the base. The invention can simulate the combustion spreading process of the groove fire through the groove model, can reappear the change characteristics of the temperature field and the flue gas flow field in the combustion chamber at the upper end of the groove through the flue gas analysis chamber, can also carry out corresponding fire extinguishing simulation experiments aiming at the combustion spreading condition, and has positive effects on the combustion spreading experiments in the groove structure and the corresponding fire field. The invention has complete functions, safety and controllability, and can repeatedly simulate the groove fire spreading and fire extinguishing experiments.

title_en: Surrounding rock damage risk numerical simulation evaluation method based on Mohr-Coulomb criterion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surrounding rock damage risk numerical simulation evaluation method based on Mohr-Coulomb criterion, which comprises the following steps of: (1) configuring an additional variable of the numerical model-damage risk index D; (2) collecting relevant geological information of a mining space to be evaluated; (3) establishing a numerical model according to the acquired information to be evaluated, and performing initial static balance calculation; (4) performing model excavation and solving according to simulation requirements; (5) and outputting an additional variable D to obtain a distribution result of each grade of dangerous areas in the mining space. The indexes given by the numerical simulation method have clear physical significance and strong operability, can quantify damage danger levels, and can provide theoretical basis and guidance for coal and rock disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Method for large sructures safety diagnosis using drone, device and computer readable medium for performing the method
title_ko: 무인비행장치를 이용한 거대구조물 안전진단 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 장치 및 기록매체
abstract_en: A safety diagnosis method of large structures using an unmanned flying device includes the steps of: photographing a city using an unmanned flying device wherein a bridge or a building exists in the city; indexing information of bridge structures that match the information collected on buildings and the information on large structures extracted from images of cities where the bridge or the building exists; evaluating an abnormal movement and residual deformation of bridges or structures to perform a disaster damage simulation for disasters; and deriving a response scenario and mission procedures in case of the disaster for the bridge or building based on simulation results. Accordingly, by overcoming the limit of damage assessment of disasters of large structures by using an unmanned flying device, it is possible to quickly predict secondary accidents such as collapse due to disasters such as earthquakes by securing mastery and golden time of the disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 무인비행장치를 이용한 거대구조물 안전진단 장치는, 무인비행장치를 이용하여 교량 또는 건축물이 존재하는 도시를 촬영하고, 교량 또는 건축물이 존재하는 도시를 촬영한 이미지로부터 추출한 거대구조물에 대한 정보와 건축물에 대해 수집한 정보를 일치하는 교량구조물의 정보와 인덱싱하고, 교량 또는 건축물의 이상거동과 잔류변형을 평가하여 재난에 대한 피해 시뮬레이션을 실시하고, 시뮬레이션 결과를 기초로 하여 해당 교량 또는 건축물에 대한 재난 발생 시 대응 시나리오 및 임무절차를 도출한다. 이에 따라, 거대구조물의 재난에 대한 피해 평가한계를 무인비행장치를 활용하여 극복함으로써 재난 상황의 장악력 및 골든타임 확보를 통해 지진 등의 재난에 대한에 의한 붕괴 등 2차 사고를 신속하게 예측할 수 있다.

title_en: Submarine landslide evolution process simulation system based on transparent soil rotating water tank
abstract_en: A submarine landslide evolution process simulation system based on a transparent soil rotating water tank belongs to the technical field of marine geological disasters and geotechnical engineering experiments and comprises a rotating water tank system, a transparent soil simulation system and a control and data acquisition system. The rotary water tank system gives different speeds to the sample by controlling the motor, and the closed circular ring structure of the rotary drum tank with the U-shaped section is used for meeting the requirement that the sliding distance is not limited; the transparent soil simulation system prepares a transparent sample with a tracing coloring agent and a fluid environment which are similar to the physical and mechanical characteristics of a real seabed soil layer, and realizes three-dimensional whole-process visualization of the inside, the outside and a water-soil interface of the sample evolution process; the control and data acquisition system realizes quantitative monitoring and data extraction in the evolution process by a three-dimensional laser slice and digital image acquisition method. The utility model provides an experimental system scale is controllable, evolution process is visual, image data is measurable, can solve long distance evolution experiment and be difficult to develop, data acquisition difficulty, monitoring picture unclear scheduling problem.

title_en: Typhoon disaster power distribution network tower fault prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting faults of a power distribution network tower in typhoon disasters, wherein real-time collected meteorological station data are input into a trained power distribution network tower fault prediction model based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, so that an output result of the neural network is obtained, and whether the tower has a trip fault or not is predicted; the training sample of the power distribution network tower fault prediction model based on the BP neural network comprises the following steps: selecting partial fault and non-fault samples from the new fault sample set and the non-fault sample set; the new fault sample set is formed by oversampling an original fault sample by adopting an SMOTE method; the new non-fault sample set is formed by undersampling the original non-fault sample by adopting an OSS method; the method can accurately predict the fault tripping of the power distribution network tower in the typhoon disaster occurrence process, can provide reference for typhoon disaster defense such as first-aid repair material allocation, rapid first-aid repair after failure and the like, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Disaster recovery technology for automatic drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster recovery drilling, and discloses a disaster recovery technology for automatic drilling, wherein an actual disaster recovery system is started to realize system and service recovery, a drilling plan is verified by adopting simulation data and simulation service system operation, and the specific process of automatic drilling of disaster recovery is required to be determined before data disaster recovery. According to the disaster recovery technology for automatic drilling, through mutual copying of data, two computers are adopted, mutual influence among the data is reduced, the fact that the recovered data are imported into a brand-new database is guaranteed, accuracy of the data is guaranteed, error conditions caused by data residue problems to disaster recovery drilling are avoided, the disaster recovery drilling has a higher reference value, the processing process of the drilling is a processing process which is highly close to that when a real disaster occurs, the disaster recovery drilling is guaranteed to be capable of playing a role in work, and therefore the disaster recovery automatic drilling plays a reference role in data maintenance.

title_en: Large-scale flood scene simulation early warning interaction method and system based on two-dimensional hydrodynamics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale flood scene simulation early warning interaction method and system based on a two-dimensional hydrodynamics method. 1) Modeling and drawing the disaster phenomenon of large-scale flood. 2) The method for solving the shallow water equation by the semi-Lagrange implicit integration method is applied to flood simulation, large time step is achieved, and volume and momentum conservation correction is carried out. 3) And the application of GPGPU programming is based on a Computer Shader framework, so that large-scale real-time parallel of flood simulation is realized. 4) The self-adaptive mesh surface subdivision technology and the texture tiling technology are introduced, so that the realistic water surface is realized, and the height and flow velocity related information of the flood is effectively transmitted. 5) And solving the problem of water body boundary sawtooth by applying a cubic B spline interpolation mode. 6) A disaster assessment model integrating flood submergence water depth and building types is provided, and building colors are changed in real time according to assessment results to achieve grading early warning. 7) And the real-time interaction in the flood evolution process is supported, and the effect of setting the baffle plate to block the flood is shown.

title_en: Test system and test method for simulating collapse rock to impact wall
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of research on collapse geological disasters, in particular to a test system and a test method for simulating collapse rock to impact a wall body. The system comprises a main support, secondary supports, a rolling stone, a rolling platform and a loaded wall body, wherein the rolling platform comprises an inclined frame and a foldable wood board, one end of the inclined frame is in lap joint with the main support, the other end of the inclined frame vertically abuts against the loaded wall body, the lap joint height of the inclined frame and the main support is adjustable, the bottom of the inclined frame is supported by the secondary supports, a plurality of foldable wood boards are laid on the inclined frame in a splicing manner, a rolling track used for limiting the rolling direction of the rolling stone is laid on the foldable wood boards, the rolling track extends to the loaded wall body from the top end of the inclined frame along the inclined frame, an impact force sensor is arranged on the loaded wall body, and image recorders are arranged on the periphery of the loaded wall body and on. The invention can simulate the slope angle, slope height and slope type adjustment of the slope, and the system is convenient and rapid to install and disassemble, and the simulation working condition is typical and comprehensive.

title_en: Rigid bottom valve device of coal mine main drainage system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of mining equipment, and relates to a rigid bottom valve device of a main drainage system of a coal mine; comprises a steel plate; two steel plates are manufactured by adopting two steel plates with the thickness of 2 cm, the diameter of the steel plate A is 550 mm, 12 bolt holes are drilled in the steel plate A, the eye distance is 515 mm, the diameter of the steel plate B is 485 mm, 11 bolt holes are drilled in the steel plate B, the eye distance is 465mm, and the steel plate A and the steel plate B are fixed on the bottom valve through screws. The utility model has the characteristics of the preparation is convenient, guarantee that main pump normally operates in the pit, reduce drainage system equipment trouble, improve the emergent ability of mine reply floods water disaster, practice thrift accessory cost etc.

title_en: Water treatment system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water purification equipment technical field especially relates to a water treatment system. The water treatment system comprises: the water taking module, the bag filter, the ultrafiltration module, the pressurization module, the precision filter module, the reverse osmosis/nanofiltration module and the first water outlet are sequentially connected; the water taking module is used for receiving a water body; the bag filter is used for filtering the inflowing water body; the ultrafiltration module is used for carrying out ultrafiltration on the inflowing water body; the pressurization module is used for pressurizing the inflowing water body to a preset value; the precise filter module is used for precisely filtering the inflowing water body; the reverse osmosis/nanofiltration module is used for performing reverse osmosis treatment on inflowing water; and the first water outlet is used for discharging the water outlet of the reverse osmosis/nanofiltration module. The utility model provides a water treatment system can use between small-size water dispenser and large-scale integrated device, can realize the large-scale outdoor activities of certain scale, meet an urgent need and rescue a disaster, army's training, field operations etc..
assignees: POTEN ENVIRONMENT GROUP CO LTD;TIANJI ZHANYING BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Health tool
abstract_en: To provide a wearing tool that has a low utilization threshold, can be used comfortably, readily and safely while contributing to reduction in stress and stretching exercises for improving blood stream at home, a shelter in the disaster area, office or in the aircraft.SOLUTION: A health tool emits a moderate crisp sound or generates a click feeling with a body exercise of a user for comfortably appealing to each perceptive factor, thereby associating a monotonous stretching exercise with comfortable continuous repetition.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Onboarding quasi-customers in a disaster zone
abstract_en: A method for securely launching a temporary financial system nested within a permanent financial system, for a locale impacted by a disaster event is provided. The method may include receiving profile-data associated with a new-quasi-user. The method may include storing the profile-data in an account profile. The method may further include analyzing the profile-data. The method may further include authenticating the new-quasi-user based on the analyzing of the profile-data. The method may further include enabling the new-quasi-user, access to a subset of services from the permanent financial system. The enabling may include simulating the temporary financial system to mimic the appearance of the permanent financial system. The method may further include filtering and separating, via a secure information filter, the temporary system from the permanent system thereby limiting the new-quasi-user, access to the permanent financial system.

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing 3D flooding information
title_ko: 3d 침수 정보 표출 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a device and method for showing three-dimensional flooding information. The device for showing three-dimensional flooding information, which provides a three-dimensional flooding disaster information showing service, comprises: an input unit receiving flood level information of a river fluctuated by rainfall and surrounding terrain information of the river, and converting the same into mesh; and a graphic processing unit (GPU) reducing the number of vertices of the mesh corresponding to a changed camera viewpoint to weight-lighten the mesh when the camera viewpoint for a flooding simulation is changed, and processing the weight-lightened mesh in a displayable form.
abstract_ko: 3D 침수 정보 표출 장치 및 방법이 제공된다.  3D 침수 재난정보 표출 서비스를 제공하기 위한 3D 침수 정보 표출 장치는 강우(降雨)에 의해 변동하는 하천의 침수위 정보 및 하천의 주변 지형 정보를 입력받아 메시(Mesh)로 변환하는 입력부와, 침수 시뮬레이션을 위한 카메라 시점이 변경되면, 변경된 카메라 시점에 해당하는 메시의 버텍스 개수를 감소시켜 상기 메시를 경량화하고, 경량화된 메시를 표시가능한 형태로 처리하는 그래픽 프로세싱 유닛(GPU: Graphic Processing Unit)을 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Multipurpose training equipment for fire fighting
title_ko: 소방용 다목적 훈련설비
abstract_en: The present invention relates to multipurpose training equipment for firefighting, and more particularly to multipurpose training equipment for firefighting comprising: a base frame part constituting an overall exterior frame of the equipment; a diving training tank formed inside the base frame part, having an opened upper surface and configured to store water therein; a boat motor inspection training room installed on the other side of the diving training tank in the base frame part with a structure capable of introducing water stored in the diving training tank, and having an inner space for storing water at a predetermined water level. According to the present invention, the equipment enables that fire drills are conducted while reproducing situations similar to or same as real disaster situations, to offer repetitive experiences and learning on various disaster occurrences, and accordingly, to give training for active response in the field where real disaster events occur and for effective initial response to disasters.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 소방용 다목적 훈련설비에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는, 전체 외관 틀을 이루는 베이스 프레임부와, 베이스 프레임부의 내측에는 상면이 개방되고 내부에 물이 저장되는 잠수훈련용 수조와, 베이스 프레임부에는 잠수훈련용 수조에 저장된 물이 공급 가능한 구조로 잠수훈련용 수조의 타측에 설치되고, 내부에 일정 높이의 물이 저장되는 내부 공간이 마련된 보트모터 점검 훈련실을 포함하는 소방용 다목적 훈련설비에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 실제 재난상황과 유사하거나 동일한 상황을 재현하면서 소방훈련을 실시하도록 하여 각종의 재난재해 발생을 미연에 반복 체험 및 습득할 수 있도록 할 수 있고, 이에 따라 실제적인 재난재해 발생 현장에서 상황에 따라 능동적으로 대처할 수 있도록 훈련할 수 있으며, 재난재해의 초기진압에 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 훈련할 수 있다.

title_en: Multipurpose training equipment for fire fighting
title_ko: 소방용 다목적 훈련설비
abstract_en: The present invention relates to multi-purpose firefighting training equipment, and more specifically, to a multi-purpose firefighting training facility which comprises: a base frame unit forming the entire exterior frame; a water tank for diving training formed in an inner side of the base frame, including an opened upper surface, and storing water therein; stairs installed on one side of the water tank for diving training and guiding to an opened upper portion of the water tank for diving training; a manhole rescue training room installed on one side of the water tank for diving training, provided with an inner space having a predetermined height, and including a manhole formed on an upper surface; and a valley life-saving training unit connecting, with each other, a pair of vertical poles corresponding to each other and installed on both ends of an outer side of the base frame unit to face each other, and provided with a wire rope positioned to cross an upper side of the water tank for diving training. According to the present invention, use of the equipment enables users to practice a firefighting training by simulating a disaster situation that is similar or identical to an actual disaster, so that the users can repeatedly experience the occurrence of various disasters, thereby acquiring knowledge to cope with the disasters in advance. Accordingly, the users can be trained to actively cope with a situation at an actual disaster site, and can be trained to effectively carry out initial suppression of the disaster.

title_en: Modeling Method of radioactivity diffusion for radioactivity disaster correspondence training
title_ko: 방사능 재난 대응 훈련을 위한 방사능 확산 모델링 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radiation diffusion modeling method for radiation disaster correspondence training, and more particularly, to a radiation diffusion modeling method for radiation disaster correspondence training that comprises: calculating the type and amount of radioactive materials; calculating the concentration of radioactive materials in the air and the concentration of radioactive materials in a ground surface at a specific point through atmospheric diffusion and a deposition process of released radioactive materials; calculating an exposure dose from the concentration of radioactive materials; and calculating radioactive effects on a human body, thereby performing modeling to predict the diffusion path and exposure dose of radioactive materials.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사능 재난 대응훈련을 위한 방사능 확산 모델링 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 방사성 물질의 종류와 양을 산출하고, 방출된 방사성 물질의 대기확산과 침적과정을 통하여 특정지점에 대한 공기 중에서의 방사성 물질 농도와 지표에서의 방사성 물질 농도를 산출하고, 방사성 물질의 농도로부터 피폭선량을 산출하여 인체에 미치는 방사학적 영향을 산출함으로써, 방사능 물질의 확산 경로 및 피폭선량을 미리 예측 모델링할 수 있는 방사능 재난 대응훈련을 위한 방사능 확산 모델링 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Precise soil sealing machine for mulching film
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a smart volume banking machine of plastic film. The method is characterized in that: a transmission system, a soil taking and screening system, a soil feeding and sealing system and a ground soil distribution profiling system, wherein the transmission system sequentially drives each chain wheel through a gearbox 15 and a shaft 14, wherein, the soil is finely crushed through the soil taking wheel assembly 3 and the soil crushing chain wheel 5, is conveyed to the middle part of the roller through the soil conveying roller 12, has the function of further finely crushing soil blocks, and then, the crushed soil is further evenly pushed to the soil conveying device through the left spiral roller 8 and the right spiral roller 10, because the soil feeding roller 12 is acted by the soil retaining barrel 11, the quantitative soil can fall into the soil outlet and the ground soil distribution profiling mechanism, the ground of the soil guiding groove 9 is profiled, so that the unearthed height of the soil guiding groove 9 is always in a certain height with the ground, soil is crushed and uniformly spread at the hole sowing opening of the plant seedling, the hole sowing opening on the film is sealed, the mulching film is connected by simulating wind disasters, and the purpose of sealing soil is achieved.
assignees: SHIHEZI DEVELOPMENT ZONE HUIZHIYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting coal rock dynamic disasters based on full time domain AE (acoustic emission) features
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting coal and rock dynamic disasters based on full time domain AE (acoustic emission) features, and belongs to the field of coal mine dynamic disaster prediction. The method comprises the following steps: detecting and installing: arranging an acoustic emission probe of an acoustic emission system on a scene and/or equipment of coal and rock mining, digging and drilling, and arranging a gas sensor of a gas monitoring system in the operation range of the coal and rock mining, digging and drilling; monitoring: monitoring the characteristics of an acoustic emission signal detected by an acoustic emission probe from a macroscopic angle in a full time domain through an acoustic emission system, and acquiring gas monitoring data detected by a gas sensor in real time through a gas monitoring system; analyzing and predicting: and performing correlation analysis on the gas monitoring data and the characteristics of the acoustic emission signals, performing inversion or monitoring to obtain stress environment parameters, coal body structure parameters and gas content parameters, and predicting the occurrence of the coal rock dynamic disasters. The invention solves the problem of incomplete acoustic emission noise filtration in the prior art, realizes the prediction and forecast of the coal and rock dynamic disasters, and improves the accuracy of the prediction of the coal and rock dynamic disasters in the mining, excavating and drilling processes.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Calculation method for predicting vertical impact acting force of landslide suffered by submarine pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a computer method for simulating that a submarine pipeline is subjected to landslide vertical impact acting force, which is technically characterized by comprising the following steps: establishing a three-dimensional model of the submarine pipeline subjected to landslide vertical impact acting force; step 2: dividing the three-dimensional model into grids, enabling a control volume which is not repeated to exist around each grid point, and solving a result by using a calculation equation; step 3: determining model parameters according to submarine sediment sampling and testing of a submarine landslide pre-judging area; step 4: the obtained parameters are input into the model established in the step 2, and the invention provides technical reference for prediction of landslide disaster acting force of the submarine pipeline and disaster prevention design.

title_en: National power grid icing disaster prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a national power grid icing disaster prediction method, which relates to the field of machine learning and is used for predicting icing disasters of power towers, power transmission lines and power transmission channels of a national power grid, and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting historical information to form complete historical data, selecting data characteristics by the aid of dry dimensions of the complete historical data, adjusting parameters of a LightGBM model, training the LightGBM model, collecting current information to form complete current data, and predicting ice covering disasters by means of the trained LightGBM model. The method provided by the invention can predict the risk of icing disasters of the power tower pole, the power transmission line and the power transmission channel, and deploy countermeasures in advance.

title_en: Geological environment simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological environment simulation and discloses a geological environment simulation experiment device.A support plate is welded at the upper end of a rack, and a tilting motor is fixed on the rack through a bolt; the rack is connected with the geological simulation box, and the connecting shaft is connected with the tilting motor through a coupler; a water storage tank is arranged in the geological simulation box, a scale is fixed on the lower half part of the geological simulation box through screws, and a pressure measuring pipe is fixed on the inner wall of the geological simulation box through screws; the upper end of the rack is fixed with a vibration motor through a bolt, and the vibration motor is connected with the geological simulation box through a vibration connecting rod; a drain pipe is arranged at the bottom of the geological simulation tank, the other end of the drain pipe is arranged in a water tank, and the water tank is arranged at the bottom of the rack; the upper end of the frame is provided with a precipitation sprinkling plate, the bottom of the frame is provided with a water pump, and the water pump is connected with the precipitation sprinkling plate through a guide pipe; the upper end of the frame is fixed with an artificial heat light source and a rotating fan through bolts. The invention can accurately simulate geological environment and various geological disasters, and is convenient for study and research.

title_en: LSTM-based structural dynamic response prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structure dynamic response prediction method based on LSTM, in the training stage, firstly, the structure response under the extreme load effect is obtained through field actual measurement or finite element calculation, and the LSTM network is simultaneously trained based on a long-time memory method, and after the training is finished, the LSTM network is input according to the field actual loading condition, so that the real-time dynamic response under the extreme load effect of the structure is obtained. The method can efficiently predict the nonlinear dynamic response of the structure under the action of extreme load, and can effectively solve the problem of disaster early warning of the long-term service structure.

title_en: Rapid prediction method for gas explosion shock wave propagation state for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid prediction method for a gas explosion shock wave propagation state for emergency rescue. The method comprises the steps of obtaining big data of propagation states of disaster-causing factors such as gas explosion shock waves and flame propagation near a typical explosion source, a typical straight roadway and a typical roadway intersection by utilizing numerical simulation or an explosion experiment, taking factors influencing the gas explosion shock waves and flame propagation as input nodes of an artificial neural network, taking disaster-causing factors such as pressure, temperature and toxic and harmful gases as output nodes, establishing a rapid prediction model of the gas explosion shock wave propagation state, effectively solving the problems of large time consumption and the like in the processes of numerical simulation modeling, calculation, data analysis and processing and the like, and controlling the prediction of the full wind network propagation state of the explosion shock waves and flame to be completed within 60 seconds under the condition of assuming the known explosion source position and the explosion-participating gas content, thereby greatly meeting the requirements of emergency rescue.

title_en: Geological disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a geological disaster simulator, which comprises a device body, wherein a bearing base plate is arranged at the bottom of the device body, and a convex noise reduction rubber pad is embedded and installed on the end surface of the bottom of the bearing base plate; the middle of the top end face of the bearing base plate is fixedly provided with an up-and-down simulated vibrator through bolts, and the periphery of the simulated vibrator is limited and sleeved with an up-and-down noise reduction cylindrical barrel; the bearing base plate is provided with a cylindrical bearing box in the vertical direction through the periphery of the top, and the top of the cylindrical bearing box is internally provided with a regional separation plate in a limiting way; the transparent protective cover is buckled and arranged on the end face of the top of the cylinder bearing box. The setting of drum bearing box makes things convenient for the regional division board to be spacing to place and separate at the inside simulation area in top, conveniently simulates different geological disaster environment in different regions, makes things convenient for the whole process of carrying on of visual audio-visual understanding geological disaster, makes things convenient for the quick visual geological disaster form of remembering of student.

title_en: Low-voltage electrical safety disaster simulation equipment and detection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low pressure electrical safety calamity analog device and detecting system. The utility model is connected with the central control unit through the arc generation module and the carbonization cable preparation module respectively; the arc generation module comprises a motor, a screw rod, a sliding block, a series arc generation module and a parallel metal cutting wire module; the central control unit controls the motor to drive the lead screw to rotate so as to drive the sliding block to move, so that the series arc generation module generates series arcs or the parallel metal cutting wire module generates parallel arcs, or controls the carbonization cable preparation module to carbonize a wire to be carbonized, and whether the ammeter has an electrical safety monitoring function is detected. Wherein, can simulate the contact failure of single wire, wire by the metal laceration and wire insulation skin ageing respectively through this analog device to detect the electrical safety discernment ability of taking the novel ammeter of electrical safety monitoring function comprehensively.

title_en: Water volume and water pressure detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water volume and water pressure detection device, which comprises a drill bit, wherein a drill hole is formed by drilling through the drill bit, and the drill bit can circulate drilling fluid in the drilling process; the sealing device is connected with the drill bit and is in sealing connection with the drill hole opening, so that a closed space is formed in the drill hole; and the water pipe is connected with the sealing device, is communicated with the closed space and is provided with a water quantity and water pressure detection device. The invention can directly measure the water pressure and water flow of the stratum, more accurately judge the water content condition of surrounding rock in front of the tunnel excavation face, and accordingly, more accurately forecast geological disasters under high water pressure conditions.

title_en: Remote sensing image landslide automatic detection method based on three-dimensional space-channel attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote sensing image landslide automatic detection method based on a three-dimensional space-channel attention mechanism. And manually marking the remote sensing image and cutting a landslide sample to construct a sample library, then training a convolutional neural network based on a three-dimensional space-channel attention mechanism, and learning the characteristics of various landslide examples on the remote sensing image. And carrying out landslide detection on the new remote sensing image by using the trained network model, and realizing automatic and accurate identification of a landslide target on the remote sensing image. The invention has the following advantages: the method has strong robustness, and is more suitable for landslide detection tasks on remote sensing images than an original backbone network and other existing attention methods; for the condition containing various interference factors, the method has better anti-interference capability and can obtain higher identification accuracy; the method can be used for preventing landslide disasters, reconstructing after disasters, updating landslide databases and the like.

title_en: Landslide monitoring experimental device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landslide monitoring experiment device, include: the device comprises a box body, a lifting mechanism, a propelling mechanism, a pressure sensor, a displacement sensor, a first acoustic emission sensor and a first tubular member inserted into a target sliding body. The device simple structure, easy and simple to handle, overall stability is good, and the box is adjustable with the nimble design of realizing experimental condition with the angle of inclination on ground, and the deformation evolution process of lapse formula landslide can be simulated to the mechanics loading system. In addition, the rainfall system is started to simulate the catastrophe process of rainfall type landslide. In addition, a mechanical loading system and a rainfall system can be started simultaneously to perform a coupled disaster-causing experiment of the push type landslide and the rainfall type landslide, the influence of various experimental conditions such as sliding speed, speed loading mode, rainfall intensity, rainfall time, slope inclination angle and the like and different combinations thereof on the landslide development process can be studied subsequently, and a coupled disaster-causing mechanism is explored through experimental data output by various sensors.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Device for monitoring geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a be used for monitoring geological disasters device, including box and monitor, the monitor sets up in the box inner chamber, the box inner chamber is separated for drill bit guard box and instrument control box by the baffle, the box lower extreme is equipped with collapsible moving mechanism, be equipped with drilling mechanism in the drill bit guard box, drill bit guard box lower extreme is equipped with the switch door, on the inner wall of drill bit guard box both ends respectively fixedly connected with pivot, fixedly connected with connects the belt in the drilling mechanism, the belt other end is through fixed linking to each other between pivot and the switch door, be equipped with the supporting mechanism that is used for carrying out the support to the device on the lateral wall of box both ends respectively, be equipped with the monitor in the instrument control box. The utility model discloses compare in current monitoring devices, can provide better stability for the device, avoid environmental change to cause the influence to the monitoring result, the device adopts the solar energy power supply simultaneously, can guarantee that monitoring devices's power supply is sufficient.

title_en: Rescue/Evacuation Self-Testing System For Traction Elevators
abstract_en: A monitoring system for controlling self-testing of a traction elevator includes a self-testing process module in communication with a back-up battery power supply. The self-testing process module includes a processor configured to initiate and control a series of steps for performing measurements of the back-up battery power supply, including measurements of the battery supply during a simulated emergency situation (“rescue/evacuation”). The processor is programmed to initiate testing on a defined schedule and transmit test results to a maintenance system (including remotely-located systems) on a routine basis. The monitoring system also includes a display unit providing visual information regarding the status of self-testing processes and their results and a communications unit for transmitting test results to a remote maintenance controller.

title_en: Intelligent running scheduling system and method for high-speed railway
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent running scheduling system and method for a high-speed railway, wherein the system comprises: the driving integrated information platform is connected with the passenger ticket information system, the PSCADA system and the disaster monitoring system, information collection is achieved, and the information is transmitted to the existing high-speed railway driving scheduling system; the train operation plan automatic adjustment module is used for realizing batch adjustment and automatic adjustment of the operation plan, carrying out constraint detection after adjustment and outputting the operation plan to the existing high-speed railway running scheduling system; the safety card control module expands the autonomous inspection range on the basis of the autonomous machine, realizes fixed access card control, station operation card control and scheduling command card control, and sends the result to the existing high-speed railway running scheduling system; the comprehensive simulation platform is established on the existing high-speed railway traffic scheduling system and used for realizing normal operation drilling, emergency scene simulation drilling and data verification software testing. The scheme improves the transportation efficiency of the high-speed railway and ensures the traffic safety and the operation safety of the high-speed railway.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD SIGNAL & COMM RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;BEIJING HUATIE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;BEIJING RUICHI NATIONAL RAILWAY INTELLIGENT TRANSP SYSTEM ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Least square support third-order tensor machine modeling method for image recognition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of image recognition in artificial intelligence, and provides a least square support third-order tensor modeling method for image recognition, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing an original least square support third-order tensor model under a third-order tensor data structure preprocessed by a picture; secondly, obtaining a linear equation set with a Tucker decomposition form by utilizing a Lagrange multiplier method and a tensor-Tucker decomposition method; and finally, solving the linear equation set and obtaining a least square support third-order tensor machine identification model in a Tucker decomposition form. The least square support third-order tensor machine identification model in the Tucker decomposition form fully considers the natural space relation inside the image data. On one hand, the problems of dimension disasters, huge errors and the like which can be encountered by the image data in the vectorization training process are avoided. And on the other hand, most of core information of the image data is reserved, and the image data of the unknown mark can be accurately identified.

title_en: Simulation test platform for impact-resistant blocking structure of high-position landslide fragment flow
abstract_en: A simulation test platform for an anti-impact blocking structure of a high-order landslide fragment flow relates to the technical field of geological experiments and geological disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the following steps: the device comprises a lifting device (1), a sliding block (2), a first-stage chute support (3), an inclined hydraulic lifting platform (7), an automatic hydraulic lifting platform (8), a protective wall (9), a ground anchor ditch (11), a resistance-reducing recovery pool (12) and a multi-stage chute; the multistage sliding chutes from top to bottom comprise a first-stage sliding chute (4), a second-stage sliding chute (5) and a third-stage sliding chute (6); the invention can be built in the near field, and the ground anchor trench can be provided with test models such as pile forest dams, pile beam dams and the like; the large-scale and even full-scale impact tests of various impact-resistant blocking structures can be realized on the same platform, the test site is not limited by the site environment, the impact-resistant blocking tests and data acquisition can be conveniently and repeatedly carried out, and the cost can be controlled. The invention is additionally provided with a plurality of automatic hydraulic lifting platforms, and can simulate the movement of debris flow under various angle combination working conditions.

title_en: Hydraulic fracturing method for underground deep low-permeability coal reservoir
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydraulic fracturing method for an underground deep low-permeability coal reservoir, belonging to the field of coal mine underground gas disaster treatment and comprising the following steps: s1: constructing a plurality of layer-penetrating drill holes as hydraulic fracturing holes in a bottom suction roadway; circularly injecting water between every two fracturing holes for fracturing to form zipper type fracturing; when in fracturing, according to the sequence of the pad fluid and the displacing fluid, different types of fracturing fluids are used for the pad fluid and the displacing fluid and enter fracturing holes along with the fracturing fluid; s2: constructing a group of directional holes on two sides of the fracturing hole respectively, and arranging a plurality of groups of investigation holes beside the directional holes; s3: after hydraulic fracturing is finished for a period of time, draining water from the fracturing hole for pressure relief, pumping gas out of the fracturing hole, the directional hole and the investigation hole in a networking mode, recording gas pumping concentration and purity, measuring water content and gas content of the investigation hole, and investigating gas pumping up-to-standard conditions and a fracturing influence range. The invention improves the gas extraction efficiency and concentration of the gas drilled hole, shortens the standard reaching time of the gas extraction, and avoids the stress concentration and the roof collapse of the conventional hydraulic fracturing.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Pressure relief method for rock burst coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pressure relief method for a rock burst coal seam, which comprises the following steps: constructing an underground chamber on one side of a stoping roadway, and respectively supporting a top plate and two sides of the underground chamber; and constructing a plurality of long drilling holes parallel to the stoping roadway in the high stress areas on the two sides of the chamber according to preset drilling parameters so as to realize sufficient pressure relief of the high stress areas on the lateral sides of the coal seam roadway with the impact ground pressure, thereby obviously reducing or even eliminating the hidden danger of disaster caused by impact. The pressure relief method for the rock burst coal seam provided by the invention not only can greatly reduce the amount of pressure relief work and has low cost, but also has no damage to a roadway, small influence on production and good pressure relief effect, so that the method has important popularization and application values.

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling rock burst and gas emission in linkage manner of high-length and short-distance drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preventing and controlling rock burst and gas emission by linkage of high-length and short-distance drill holes, which comprises the steps of arranging a process tunnel along the middle part of a working face in the tunneling process of a coal mine underground stope working face tunnel, so that the process tunnel and an upper gate way and a lower gate way of the working face form a U + L-shaped ventilation system, wherein the ventilation system is simpler, more stable and more reliable; the top plate advanced deep hole pre-splitting blasting hole is constructed in the process roadway, pre-splitting blasting is carried out on the coal bed and the top plate of the coal bed by the upper end pre-splitting hole of the upper slope construction working face of the upper gate way and the lower end pre-splitting hole of the lower slope construction working face of the lower gate way, so that the occurrence of rock burst disasters of the working face is prevented, the pre-splitting blasting enables the top plate of the coal bed to generate a large number of secondary fractures, a good channel is further provided for extracting pressure-relief gas in long-distance and short-distance high-position drilling holes constructed in the process roadway and the upper gate way during the stoping period of the working face, the gas emission intensity of the return air corner of the working face.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Virtual reality based disaster education method, device and computer readable medium for performing the method
title_ko: 가상현실 기반 재난 대피 교육 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 장치 및 기록매체
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a virtual reality based disaster evacuation education method comprises: executing a disaster response education game performed in a virtual space composed of a plurality of 3D virtual objects in virtual reality; applying a disaster event for a specific disaster situation to a virtual space at an arbitrary point of time; generating mission information for the disaster event; analyzing the type of 3D virtual object acquired by a user in a process of performing a mission and actions performed by a user based on log data generated in the process of performing the mission information; and calculating a corresponding score for performing the mission information based on an analysis result. According to an aspect of the present invention, an active disaster evacuation education service with improved learning efficiency and immersion can be provided by allowing a user to naturally acquire disaster evacuation abilities through events and missions unexpectedly given to the user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 가상현실 기반 재난 대피 교육 방법은, 복수의 3차원 가상객체로 구성된 가상 공간에서 수행되는 재난 대응 훈련 게임을 가상현실 상에서 실행하고, 특정 재난 상황에 대한 재난 이벤트를 임의의 시점에 가상 공간에 적용하고, 재난 이벤트에 대한 미션 정보를 생성하고, 미션 정보를 수행하는 과정에서 발생되는 로그 데이터를 기초로 미션 수행 과정에서 사용자가 획득한 3차원 가상객체의 종류 및 사용자가 수행한 행동을 분석하며, 분석 결과에 기초하여 미션 정보 수행에 대한 대응 점수를 산출할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for evacuation training and evaluation of nuclear accident using virtual reality and evacuation training and evaluation system of nuclear accident using it
title_ko: 가상현실을 이용한 원전사고 대피 훈련 및 평가방법 및 이를 이용한 원전사고 대피 훈련 및 평가시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual training system. More particularly, the present invention relates to a virtual reality-based nuclear accident evacuation training and evaluation method and a nuclear accident evacuation training and evaluation system using the same. The present invention is to address problems related to existing training systems and methods based on virtual reality. The coverage of most existing virtual reality training systems is limited to content related to evacuation training in the event of general fires or disasters. As a result, the systems are hardly applicable to training and evaluation against nuclear accidents such as fires and earthquakes at nuclear power plants and radioactive leaks. According to the present invention, different training courses are carried out by different training objects. At this time, the training is conducted based on different scenarios depending on, for example, the training objects′ selections, mission success or failure, and responses to unexpected situations. In addition, respective evaluation indices are applied as the training is in progress so that comprehensive evaluation can be conducted with respect to overall training results. As a result, training and evaluation can become more effective and efficient with respect to various cases that may arise from nuclear accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상훈련(virtual traning ; VT) 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 기존의 가상현실 훈련 시스템들은 대부분 일반적인 화재나 재난시의 대피훈련에 관한 내용만이 제시되어 있음으로 인해 원자력 발전소의 화재나 지진 또는 방사능 누출 등과 같은 원전사고에 대비한 훈련 및 평가에 그대로 적용하기는 어려운 한계가 있었던 종래기술의 가상현실을 이용한 훈련시스템 및 방법들의 문제점을 해결하기 위해, 훈련 대상별로 각자 다른 훈련과정을 진행하도록 하고, 이때, 훈련 진행중 훈련대상의 선택이나 미션의 성공 여부 및 돌발상황의 대처 등에 따라 각각 다른 시나리오로 분기하여 훈련이 진행되는 데 더하여, 훈련 진행 과정에 따라 각각의 평가지표를 적용하여 전체적인 훈련결과에 대한 종합적인 평가가 이루어지도록 구성됨으로써, 원전사고시 발생할 수 있는 다양한 경우에 대하여 보다 효과적이고 효율적으로 훈련 및 평가가 이루어질 수 있도록 구성되는 가상현실을 이용한 원전사고 대피 훈련 및 평가방법 및 이를 이용한 원전사고 대피 훈련 및 평가시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Disaster response system based on digital sop and method thereof
title_ko: Sop 시나리오 관리를 위한 재난재해 대응 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster response system for managing a standard operating procedure (SOP) scenario, to provide a proper response procedure corresponding to a disaster situation, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the disaster response system comprises: a management module defining resources required for a response to disasters as a first resource with respect to a system and a second resource with respect to human resources; an editing module defining first and second activities assigning a mission to the first and second resources, respectively, and generating a plurality of S-SOP scenarios defining an execution sequence of the defined first and second activities in accordance with a predetermined temporal flow of the disasters; and a service module selecting the S-SOP scenario corresponding to the corresponding disaster among the plurality of S-SOP scenarios in occurrence of the disasters and executing the first and second activities in accordance with the temporal flow of the disaster based on the selected S-SOP. The management module comprises a resource management unit managing the first and second resources and a scenario management unit generating the S-SOP scenario generated in the editing module and detecting a logical error from an execution condition of the first or second activity of the S-SOP scenario.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 의한 SOP 시나리오 관리를 위한 재난재해 대응 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 상기 재난재해 대응 시스템은 재난재해 대응 시 필요한 리소스를 시스템에 대한 제1 리소스와 인적 자원에 대한 제2 리소스로 정의하는 관리 모듈; 상기 제1 리소스와 상기 제2 리소스에 각각 임무를 부여한 제1 액티비티와 제2 액티비티를 정의하고, 상기 정의된 제1 액티비티와 제2 액티비티의 실행 순서를 미리 정해진 재난재해의 시간적 흐름에 따라 정의한 다수의 S-SOP 시나리오를 생성하는 편집 모듈; 및 재난재해 발생 시 상기 다수의 S-SOP 시나리오 중 해당 재난재해에 상응하는 S-SOP 시나리오를 선택하고, 상기 선택된 S-SOP 시나리오를 기초로 재난재해의 시간적 흐름에 따라 상기 제1 액티비티와 상기 제2 액티비티를 실행하는 서비스 모듈을 포함하고, 상기 관리 모듈은 상기 제1 리소스와 상기 제2 리소스를 관리하는 리소스 관리부와, 상기 편집 모듈에서 생성된 S-SOP 시나리오를 관리하고, 상기 S-SOP 시나리오의 제1 액티비티 또는 제2 액티비티의 실행 조건에 대한 논리적 오류를 검출하는 시나리오 관리부를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Compound exploitation method of natural gas hydrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural gas hydrate compound mining method. The mining method comprises the following steps: arranging a production well, injection wells A and B at a stratum where the natural gas hydrate is to be produced, wherein the injection wells A and B are arranged on two sides of the production well; putting a solid crushing drilling machine and auxiliary equipment into the natural gas hydrate reservoir through a well B, and after drilling to the reservoir, converting the drilling into a drilling mode parallel to a horizontal line and continuing drilling to crush the reservoir; closing the production well, controlling a carbon dioxide control platform, and injecting carbon dioxide into the natural gas hydrate reservoir through the well A; controlling a drilling fluid control platform, and injecting drilling fluid into the natural gas hydrate reservoir through a well B; and opening the production well, and pumping the natural gas generated in the reservoir to the offshore platform. The method utilizes the advantage of good stability of the carbon dioxide hydrate, ensures the stability of the stratum, avoids geological disasters and great decomposition of the hydrate, and effectively improves the yield of the natural gas hydrate by providing favorable reaction conditions through the drilling fluid.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;CNOOC RES INST CO LTD;UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA

title_en: Design method of index type agricultural insurance product and product thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of an exponential agricultural insurance product and a product thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring data required by design of index type agricultural insurance products in a research area; s2: constructing an ideal scene and a simulation disaster scene; s3: localization of the site-level crop growth model is carried out, then the ideal situation and the simulation disaster situation in the step S2 are input into the localized crop growth model, and output data corresponding to each situation of each research site are obtained; s4: calculating the insurance rate of the agricultural insurance product according to the yield loss; s5: selecting a plurality of alternative indexes, forming a composite index, and constructing a vulnerability model reflecting the response between the yield loss rate and the composite index by using the yield loss rate and the composite index of each simulation disaster scene; s6: and determining how to pay according to the vulnerability model and the insurance rate.

title_en: Inundation analysis method based on GIS system, intelligent terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flooding analysis method based on a GIS system, an intelligent terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining topographic data of a pre-analysis area, and loading the topographic data to a GIS system; acquiring a designated analysis area, and forming the analysis area into a surrounding type; setting final height and speed of the GIS system for simulation, and displaying the change process of the analysis area and the submerged area; the rising speed and the final height of the water flow in the simulation process are changed, and the basis of decisions required by the disaster situation is obtained through analysis and estimated. The invention uses graphics technology to visualize the terrain simulation as a model, the submerged water flow simulation as a contour geometrical body, the submerged speed is set as the variation of the water flow simulation, and the variables are used to comprehensively deduce the submerged process and result of the water flow simulation in high-precision terrain.

title_en: Mine fire simulation experiment platform and experiment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine fire simulation experiment platform and an experiment method, wherein the experiment platform comprises an air supply system, a simulation space system, a fire source simulation system and a data collection and feedback system; the ventilation network and the roadway of the experimental platform have internal resistance, aspect ratio and easy inclination angleThe repeatability is strong during adjustment; the wind speed, fuel quality change, temperature, density, pressure and O of various monitoring devices during mine fire 2 And the real-time monitoring of the CO concentration and the smoke spreading condition can be used for researching the mine fire smoke migration rule, the design of the alarming and wind control measures can quickly and effectively prevent the further expansion of the disaster, the optimal scheme of fire suppression and personnel rescue is researched through a contrast experiment, the hazard degree of the accident is reduced, and the method has important guiding significance for mine safety operation.

title_en: Method for reducing ground surface subsidence range of underground mining area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing the surface subsidence range of an underground mining area, which comprises the following steps: 1. acquiring the position of an underground mining working face, the propelling direction and the propelling speed of the working face and the peripheral ground surface subsidence influence range of a projection area of the mining working face; 2, predicting the surface subsidence range and time according to the advancing direction and speed of the working surface, and dividing a tension area and a tension extrusion area in the potential subsidence range; 3. before the time point of surface subsidence, arranging drill holes in the potential tension extrusion area and carrying out controlled blasting or directly digging grooves; 4. after the stage surface subsidence time point comes, the above steps are repeated. The invention utilizes the principle of blasting or grooving the rock-soil body to destroy the rock-soil body structure and block the stress transmission to reduce the tensile stress transmission effect formed from the mining subsidence center to the periphery, thereby achieving the purposes of reducing the subsidence range of the periphery of a mining area and reducing the damage to the peripheral land and structures caused by underground mining and the danger degree of geological disasters of other mining areas.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY;HUAIBEI MINING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Hard top plate comb-shaped long drilling segmented fracturing roadway deformation source treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hard top plate comb-shaped long drilling segmented fracturing roadway deformation source treatment method, which comprises the following steps: s1: selecting the plane position and the section position of a fracturing drill hole; s2: constructing a main hole; s3: fracturing a first section of the main hole; s4: drilling construction of a first branch hole; s5: performing fracturing construction on the first branch hole; s6: fracturing the second section of the main hole; s7: drilling and fracturing construction of a second branch hole; s8: and performing construction according to the steps S6 and S7 until all designed positions of the main hole are subjected to fracturing construction and all branch construction positions are subjected to drilling construction and fracturing construction. The method realizes the accurate control of the position of the hard rock stratum and the drilling of the branch, performs multi-point section-by-section fracturing on the main hole section and the branch, and effectively weakens the position of the hard top plate in advance, thereby avoiding the large-scale deformation disaster of the surrounding rock of the roadway caused by the sudden collapse of the top plate due to the large-area suspended ceiling and the coupling of the strong dynamic load and the ground stress.

title_en: Cold region tunnel linear water-containing zone frost heaving model and preparation and test methods thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of tunnel engineering model tests, in particular to a linear water-containing zone frost heaving model of a tunnel in a cold region and preparation and test methods thereof. The system comprises a frost heaving surrounding rock system, an environment regulation and control system and a frost heaving force data acquisition system; the frost heaving surrounding rock system comprises simulated surrounding rocks, a secondary lining and a frost heaving surrounding rock linear fractured zone, wherein the secondary lining penetrates through the simulated surrounding rocks to be distributed, the frost heaving surrounding rock linear fractured zone is a strip-shaped hole which is arranged on the simulated surrounding rocks and can be filled with water, and the frost heaving surrounding rock linear fractured zone comprises a surrounding rock linear water-containing zone distributed in the simulated surrounding rocks and a lining rear water-containing zone distributed between the simulated surrounding rocks and the secondary lining; the method can objectively reflect the influence of different water storage structures of surrounding rocks on the frost heaving force of the tunnel, and simulate the influence and distribution rule of different linear water containing zone lengths, positions, widths and the like on the frost heaving force of the tunnel under different burial depths and temperature environments through model tests, thereby providing guidance for preventing and controlling the frost heaving disaster of the tunnel in a cold region.

title_en: Device for testing gas flow while drilling
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of coal measure stratum gas disaster prevention and control, and discloses a device for testing gas flow while drilling, which comprises a soft bag, a gas drainage tube, and a filling tube communicated with the soft bag, wherein the soft bag is filled with gas or liquid; the soft bag is annular, at least one opening is formed in the soft bag, the inner side of the annular shape is matched with the drill rod, the outer side of the annular shape is matched with the drill hole, and the soft bag is used for surrounding the drill rod; one end of the gas drainage tube is communicated with the space to be measured after the soft bag is drilled in a closed mode, and the other end of the gas drainage tube is connected with a gas flow measuring device. Based on the device, the soft bag is surrounded on the drill rod, when the drill bit is driven to the target position, the filler is injected into the soft bag through the injection pipe, and the soft bag is used for sealing a gap between the drill rod and the drill hole; the gas drainage pipe connecting the inside and the outside of the drill hole leads out gas for measurement, so that the integration of drilling and measurement is realized, and the gas flow can be measured under the condition of not withdrawing the drill bit.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 23 BUREAU GROUP NO 3 ENG CO LTD

title_en: Disaster response robot, disaster response capability thereof being testable in lvc environment, test server therefor, trainee control terminal for trainee test, and trainee test server therefor
title_ko: Lvc 환경의 재난 대응 능력 테스트가 가능한 재난 대응 로봇 및 테스트 서버와 훈련생 테스트를 위한 훈련생 관제 단말 및 훈련생 테스트 서버
abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster response robot, the disaster response capability thereof being testable in LVC environments, a test server therefor, a trainee control terminal for trainee tests, and a trainee test server therefor. The disaster response robot comprises: a disaster area map receiver module for receiving a virtual disaster area map from a test server for evaluating a disaster response robot's autonomous task performance capability; a disaster area map storage module for storing the virtual disaster area map received by the disaster area map receiver module; a disaster response task receiver module for receiving a disaster response task from the test server; a constructive event receiver module for receiving a constructive event simulating a disaster environment, from the test server during autonomous performance of the disaster response task; and an autonomous disaster response task performance module for autonomously performing the disaster response task received from the disaster response task receiver module, in a live test space on the basis of the virtual disaster area map stored in the disaster area map storage module.
abstract_ko: LVC 환경의 재난 대응 능력 테스트가 가능한 재난 대응 로봇 및 테스트 서버와 훈련생 테스트를 위한 훈련생 관제 단말 및 훈련생 테스트 서버가 개시된다. 재난 대응 로봇의 자율 수행 능력을 평가하기 위한 테스트 서버로부터 재난 현장 가상 맵을 수신하는 재난 현장 맵 수신 모듈; 상기 재난 현장 맵 수신 모듈에서 수신된 재난 현장 가상 맵이 저장되는 재난 현장 맵 저장 모듈; 상기 테스트 서버로부터 재난 대응 임무를 수신하는 재난 대응 임무 수신 모듈; 상기 재난 대응 임무의 자율 수행 중 상기 테스트 서버로부터 재난 환경을 모사하는 컨스트럭티브 이벤트를 수신하는 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 수신 모듈; 상기 재난 현장 맵 저장 모듈에 저장된 재난 현장 가상 맵을 기반으로 라이브 테스트 공간에서 상기 재난 대응 임무 수신 모듈에서 수신된 재난 대응 임무를 자율 수행하는 재난 대응 임무 자율 수행 모듈을 구성한다.

title_en: Mine composite disaster simulation test system and method considering roof influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine composite disaster simulation test system and method considering roof influence, which consists of a power loading module, a high-pressure-resistant sealed cavity module and corresponding monitoring equipment. The test method is as follows: loading the prepared coal-rock composite body test piece stuck with the strain gauge into a high-pressure-resistant sealed cavity; completing the installation and debugging of other equipment and starting; vacuumizing, inflating, loading and monitoring the air pressure of the cavity, the respective strain of the coal rock body and the acoustic emission characteristics in real time; and (3) pressure relief is carried out through the explosion-proof high-speed pneumatic valve at the moment of damage of the test piece, and the power display characteristics in the catastrophe process are observed and analyzed. The invention can carry out system monitoring on each stage of the composite disaster of the mine and simultaneously provide data support for accurate analysis of each stage of the disaster, has important theoretical significance and engineering value, and has positive significance for prediction and prevention of composite dynamic disasters of the mine such as rock burst, coal and gas outburst and the like caused by deep mining.

title_en: Rock fracture mode intelligent detection and identification method based on acoustic emission model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent detection and identification method for a rock fracture mode based on an acoustic emission model, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly arranging an acoustic emission system for testing acoustic emission parameters of a rock cracking process on a rock to be monitored, then inputting target characteristic data into a pre-trained signal recognition model, obtaining the signal recognition model through training of a rock cracking acoustic emission training set in advance, then intelligently recognizing the proportion of tension and shear crack development in the rock cracking process, and finally recognizing that corresponding relations exist between waveform characteristics determined according to the rock cracking acoustic emission signals and rock cracking patterns, so that a series of reliable detection threshold values are provided for quantitatively formulating a rock disaster early warning scheme, and an analysis method is provided for deeply researching and recognizing rock cracking instability precursor signal characteristics.

title_en: Emergency response method for extreme events of complex energy interconnection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency response method for extreme events of a complex energy interconnection system, which comprises the following steps: constructing a complex energy interconnection system structure; decomposing the whole complex energy interconnection system into interactive subsystems based on system dynamics, and establishing a dynamic model inside each subsystem; depicting the dynamic response behavior of the complex energy interconnection system under an extreme event, and establishing a response model; when the complex energy interconnection system encounters an extreme event, the response model automatically makes response decisions and measures to carry out emergency response. The invention decomposes the whole complex energy interconnection system into a plurality of subsystems with interaction by means of a system dynamics model, simulates and analyzes qualitative and quantitative relations among variables, expresses the characteristics of the complex system with multiple main bodies, dynamic coupling and iteration effect, and describes the dynamic response behavior of the complex energy interconnection system under extreme events.

title_en: Construction method of nuclear emergency evacuation outlet selection behavior model based on game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a nuclear emergency evacuation outlet selection behavior model based on a game, which comprises the following steps: (1) Building a GIS background of a game based on a vector map of a nuclear emergency evacuation area, and labeling buildings with different attributes; (2) Generating a nuclear emergency evacuation scene in the constructed game background based on a multi-agent method, displaying alarm information to pedestrians, and prompting the pedestrians to carry out exit selection; (3) Acquiring pedestrian exit selection information and recording characteristic parameters of pedestrians; (4) And analyzing the collected sample data based on the Logit model, and constructing a nuclear emergency evacuation outlet selection behavior model. The method disclosed by the invention can obtain a high-quality nuclear emergency evacuation outlet selection sample and automatically construct a corresponding model, thereby providing good support for nuclear emergency evacuation simulation modeling and evacuation management strategy optimization.

title_en: Lofting platform and measurement system for simulating drilling to trigger overpressure sand body
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil and gas drilling rock physical engineering, in particular to a lofting table and a measuring system for simulating drilling to trigger overpressure sand bodies. The sand body sample includes sand body and prevention of seepage membrane, the sand body stacks gradually the first sand layer admittedly that sets up from bottom to top, the sand layer is fixed to quicksand layer and second, the platform of putting the appearance includes apron subassembly and application of pressure mechanism, application of pressure mechanism is formed with the cavity that holds the sand body sample, application of pressure mechanism establishes to exert pressure to the inner wall of cavity, with the ground stress condition that simulation sand body sample received, the cavity is established to the opening upwards, the apron subassembly is established at the opening side of cavity and is established to compressing tightly the sand layer is fixed to the second through prevention of seepage membrane, the apron subassembly is formed with the water filling port, the water filling port is established to letting in the water injection pipe that is used for carrying out the water injection operation for. The sampling platform for simulating drilling to trigger the overpressure sand body can simulate shallow water flow disasters caused by drilling meeting the overpressure sand body under actual stratum conditions, and is convenient for researching sand body damage and flowing mechanisms caused by the shallow water flow disasters.

title_en: Microseismic signal identification method based on class-optimal Gaussian kernel multi-classification support vector machine
abstract_en: A microseismic signal identification method based on a class-optimal Gaussian kernel multi-classification support vector machine belongs to the field of machine learning and data mining.
