Firstly, dividing microseismic data according to channels and carrying out data format conversion; secondly, extracting the characteristics of each channel data according to the mean value and the variance, combining all channels of the same sample to form new characteristics, and performing characteristic selection on the synthetic data by using a similar optimal Gaussian kernel multi-classification support vector machine to generate a non-equilibrium training sample set after dimension reduction; thirdly, determining undersampling multiplying power according to the unbalanced rate of the training samples, and undersampling the large samples; and finally, constructing a microseismic signal classifier after dimension reduction by adopting a multi-classification support vector machine. The invention can effectively reduce the influence of redundant features on classification; by carrying out dual dimensionality reduction on the channel characteristics and the combination characteristics, the dimensionality of the microseismic signals is effectively reduced, the accuracy and the timeliness of the microseismic signal classifier are improved, and the accuracy of rock burst disaster early warning is increased.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;UNIV CHINA MINING;SHENYANG INST AUTOMATION CAS

title_en: Intelligent emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system teaching training platform for fire-fighting training room
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting training room intelligent emergency lighting and evacuation indication system teaching training platform, which comprises a hydraulic lifting part, wherein the hydraulic lifting part comprises a lifting platform bottom plate, a lifting platform top plate, a hydraulic cylinder, a motor and an oil pump, the hydraulic cylinder, the motor and the oil pump are all arranged on the lifting platform bottom plate, and the lifting platform top plate is arranged on the hydraulic cylinder; teaching demonstration portion, teaching demonstration portion sets up hydraulic pressure lift portion is last, teaching demonstration portion includes stand and emergency lighting and sparse indicating system, emergency lighting and sparse indicating system set up on the stand. The utility model has the advantages of reasonable design, can demonstrate real room intelligent emergency lighting and sparse indicating system operation and the theory of operation of instructing of fire control vividly, improve teaching efficiency and effect.
assignees: SERGEANCY SCHOOL OF THE POLICE FIREFIGHTING ARMY

title_en: Simulation device
abstract_en: To reduce an analysis load when performing simulation for fire disaster of a pole of a CFT structure.SOLUTION: A simulation device 100 performs simulation for the pole of the CFT (Concrete Filled Steel Tube) structure comprising a steel tube and concrete filled in the steel tube. The simulation device 100 performs simulation for the fire disaster occurring at a building containing the pole of the CFT structure on the basis of a CFT pole model representing a pole of the CFT structure modeled as a fiber model, and acquires information on a change of the CFT pole model.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Real fire training system and real fire training method for aircraft
abstract_en: The invention provides an aircraft true fire training system, which comprises an aviation simulator and at least one fire sub-module arranged in, outside and/or around the aviation simulator; the flame sub-module includes a flame ignitor and a combustion feed assembly; the fire submodule is arranged on the inner side of an engine of the aviation simulator and used for simulating a fire disaster at the front part of the engine, and the corresponding pilot and the combustion feed assembly are respectively a first pilot and a first combustion feed assembly; the first combustion feed assembly includes a first fuel feed conduit, a second fuel feed conduit; the first fuel feed pipe extends to the outside of the engine fan, and its feed section is provided with array holes in the circumferential direction; the second fuel feeding pipeline comprises a branch pipe and an annular pipe which are connected, and a display hole is formed in the surface of one side of the annular pipe, which faces the engine fan; or the second fuel feed pipe includes a branch pipe connected to the fuel pipe and an inner wall feed hole opened on an inner wall surface of the engine intake port. The invention can provide real fire training of the aircraft.

title_en: Data preprocessing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data preprocessing method, which relates to the field of machine learning and is used for processing collected data before disaster risk prediction of a power tower, a power transmission line and a power channel of a national power grid, and comprises the following steps: and acquiring historical information to form complete historical data, resampling the complete historical data or selecting data characteristics to obtain a training set. The method provided by the invention processes the acquired data to enable the acquired data to meet the prediction requirement.

title_en: Outdoor emergency guiding time prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outdoor emergency guiding time prediction method, which comprises the following steps: s10, randomly taking values of all characteristic factors within a reasonable range by using the factors which have great influence on the group evacuation time, including personnel characteristics and path characteristics, and simulating by using an outdoor group evacuation behavior model to obtain the evacuation time; s20, grouping the obtained data, and dividing each group of data into training data (75%) and testing data (25%) through a sketch library spilt function aiming at each group of data; s30, preliminarily judging the relation between the data characteristics and the prediction result, selecting a linear regression prediction method to establish a prediction model, establishing a loss function by adopting a least square method, establishing a model by utilizing python/scimit-lern, establishing an evaluation function by relative errors by adopting a minimum gradient method in the optimization process, calculating by utilizing test data to obtain corresponding relative error weighing values, obtaining a prediction time parameter matrix, and establishing a time prediction model.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;BEIJING HUAXIN YUANJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide sensitivity map drawing method based on wavelet packet transformation and support vector machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide sensitivity map drawing method based on wavelet packet transformation and a support vector machine, which comprises the following steps of: from 30m spatial resolution DEM Data sum ASTER Calculating and extracting landslide disaster-causing sensitive factors from visible light near-infrared waveband data of the sensor, and carrying out normalization processing on the landslide disaster-causing sensitive factors; decomposing each landslide sensitivity factor; learning the landslide sensitivity factor characteristics in a supervision mode, inputting the sensitivity factors into the classifier in a progressive mode to obtain a classification result, and outputting a landslide sensitivity factor set; a landslide sensitivity map is generated. Obtaining characteristics capable of representing landslide sensitivity by calculating landslide sensitivity factors; through wavelet packet transformation, the local feature description of the sensitive factors is processed finely; the supervised learning is carried out on the landslide sensitive factor characteristics through the support vector machine, the sample training and testing can be rapidly carried out, and higher training and testing can be obtained under the conditions of small data volume and few samplesThe classification accuracy of (2).

title_en: Simulation Object Symbol Standardization System for Disaster Response Training System
title_ko: 재난대응 훈련체계에 사용되는 모의객체 심벌 표준화시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulation object symbol standardization system used for a disaster response training system and, more specifically, to a simulation object symbol standardization system used for a disaster response training system to perform interlocking during a real radioactive disaster drill and a real fire disaster drill or to simulate various and complex disaster situations in any environment (weather, terrain), thereby enabling field agents in a disaster prevention situation room and from a related organization to fully aware of a task and improve abilities to take measures in such environment and enabling a resident protection activity in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난대응 훈련체계에 사용되는 모의객체 심벌 표준화시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 실제 방사능 방재훈련, 화재 방재훈련시 연동 또는 임의 환경(기상, 지형)에서 다양하고 복합적인 재난 상황을 모의하여, 방재상황실과 유관기관 현장요원에 대한 임무 숙지 및 상황조치 능력 제고와 주민보호 활동을 실시간으로 모의 가능하도록 하기 위한 재난대응 훈련체계에 사용되는 모의객체 심벌 표준화시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A Emergency Exit Training and Ride Facilities
title_ko: 비상탈출 교육 및 놀이기구 시설
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a facility for emergency exit education and riding device and, more specifically, to use an emergency exit system as an educational and riding device facility, wherein the emergency exit system safely lowers an evacuee at a constant speed by a brake apparatus operated by a centrifugal force, a brake apparatus operated by a repulsive force of a magnet, and a brake apparatus reacted in the opposite direction to the gravity of a propeller, which are operated in a high-rise building in an emergency evacuation situation such as a fire, an earthquake, and the like to enable the evacuee to quickly escape from the high-rise building. According to the present invention, most of the existing riding devices installed in a higher floor are weak and do not provide actions in case of a power failure, but the facility of the present invention is a safe education and riding device facility without a separate safety apparatus since the objective of the present invention is to know the emergency exit system well. The educational and riding device facility automatically controls the speed, can be reused, and uses an escape capsule to enable the evacuee to safely escape from the high-rise building through flames or smoke, thereby being essential in real life for people living in an area of the high-rise buildings.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상탈출 교육 및 놀이기구 시설에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 고층건물에서 화재, 지진 등과 같은 비상대피상황 발생 시 원심력으로 조정되는 브레이크 장치와, 자석의 척력으로 브레이크 장치와, 프로펠러의 중력의 역방향으로 작용하는 브레이크 장치에 따라 일정속도로 안전하게 하강하도록 하여 대피자의 안전하고 신속한 탈출을 가능하게 할 수 있는 비상탈출시스템을 이용하여 교육 및 놀이기구로 활용하는 것이다. 
지금까지의 고층에서의 하는 놀이기구는 안전장치가 부실하고, 정전이 되었을 때, 대처가 없는 것이 대부분이었으나, 본 발명은 안전장치가 특별하게 없어도 본 발명이 목적이 비상탈출시스템의 숙지이므로 안전한 교육시설과 놀이기구가 된다. 
본 발명은 자동으로 속도를 제어하고, 재사용이 가능하며, 탈출캡슐을 사용하여 화염이나 연기 속을 통과하여 안전하게 탈출할 수 있는 교육시설이며, 또한 놀이기구이므로, 고충시대에서 사용하는 현실에 반드시 필요한 발명이다.

title_en: Surrogate materials for emergency response training and methods of formation and dispersal
abstract_en: Surrogate materials are in the form of solid particles that include surrogate isotopes, namely, short-lived isotopes selected and formed to serve as surrogates for the radioactive materials of a nuclear fallout without including isotopes that are, or that decay to, biologically or environmentally deleterious and persistent isotopes. The surrogate material may be formed using high-purity reactant material and irradiation and separation techniques that enable tailoring of the isotopes and ratios thereof included in the surrogate material, and the surrogate material may be dispersed, e.g., in a training environment, in solid form.

title_en: Disaster response robot for testing autonomous performance capability in live-virtual-constructive environment and test server for testing the same and test methods thereof
title_ko: Lvc 환경의 재난 대응 능력 테스트가 가능한 재난 대응 로봇 및 테스트 서버와 그 테스트 방법
abstract_en: The present invention includes: a disaster scene map receiving module receiving a virtual map of a disaster scene from a test server for evaluating a disaster response capability of a disaster response robot; a disaster scene map storage module storing the virtual map of the disaster scene received from the disaster scene map receiving module; a disaster response mission receiving module receiving a disaster response mission from the test server; a constructive event receiving module receiving a constructive event simulating a disaster environment from the test server during the autonomous fulfillment of the disaster response mission; and a disaster response mission autonomous-fulfillment module autonomously fulfilling the disaster response mission received from the disaster response mission receiving module in a live test space based on the virtual map of the disaster scene stored in the disaster scene map storage module. The disaster response mission autonomous-fulfillment module is formed to autonomously respond to a live disaster environment on the live test space during the autonomous fulfillment, or autonomously respond to a disaster environment simulated by the constructive event received from the constructive event receiving module during autonomous fulfillment. According to the constitution, as a disaster response robot on an actual live test space is made to recognize a virtual map as well as a live disaster situation, and recognize a virtual disaster situation through a constructive event, an autonomous response capability of the disaster response robot with respect to the disaster situation can be thoroughly evaluated from various angles.
abstract_ko: 재난 대응 로봇의 재난 대응 능력을 평가하기 위한 테스트 서버로부터 재난 현장 가상 맵(virtual map)을 수신하는 재난 현장 맵 수신 모듈; 상기 재난 현장 맵 수신 모듈에서 수신된 재난 현장 가상 맵이 저장되는 재난 현장 맵 저장 모듈; 상기 테스트 서버로부터 재난 대응 임무를 수신하는 재난 대응 임무 수신 모듈; 상기 재난 대응 임무의 자율 수행 중 상기 테스트 서버로부터 재난 환경을 모사하는 컨스트럭티브 이벤트(constructive event)를 수신하는 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 수신 모듈; 상기 재난 현장 맵 저장 모듈에 저장된 재난 현장 가상 맵을 기반으로 라이브(live) 테스트 공간에서 상기 재난 대응 임무 수신 모듈에서 수신된 재난 대응 임무를 자율 수행하는 재난 대응 임무 자율 수행 모듈을 포함하고, 상기 재난 대응 임무 자율 수행 모듈은, 자율 수행 중 상기 라이브 테스트 공간 상의 라이브 재난 환경에 자율 대응하거나 또는 자율 수행 중 상기 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 수신 모듈에서 수신된 컨스트럭티브 이벤트가 모사하는 재난 환경에 자율 대응하도록 구성된다.  위 구성에 의하면, 실제 라이브 테스트 공간 상의 재난 대응 로봇에게 라이브 재난 상황뿐만 아니라 가상 맵을 인지시키고 가상의 재난 상황을 컨스트럭티브 이벤트를 통해 인지시킴으로써, 재난 대응 로봇의 재난 상황에 대한 자율 대응 능력을 다각도로 면밀하게 평가할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Task allocation method for earthquake post-disaster investigation of heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle formation
abstract_en: The invention provides a task allocation method for earthquake post-disaster exploration of heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle formation, and particularly relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, determining relevant information of a survey target needing heterogeneous multi-unmanned aerial vehicle survey, site information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and relevant parameters of the unmanned aerial vehicle; then calculating and storing the Euclidean distance from the station to the exploration target and between the exploration targets; and then establishing a multi-site revisiable team directional problem MD-RTOP model, acquiring an initial task allocation scheme set of the heterogeneous multi-unmanned aerial vehicles for formation and execution of the survey tasks, and finally optimizing by adopting a Hybrid Genetic Simulated Annealing (HGSA) algorithm introducing a segmented splicing and self-adaptive switching mechanism to obtain an optimal task allocation scheme of each unmanned aerial vehicle for visiting the survey target. Based on the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the time for task allocation can be reduced, the effectiveness of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be exerted to the maximum extent, and the completion quality of the investigation task after earthquake disaster can be effectively improved.

title_en: Three-dimensional comprehensive efficient and accurate treatment technical method for coal-oil-gas coexisting mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional comprehensive high-efficiency accurate treatment technical method for a coal-oil-gas coexisting mine, which comprises the following steps of S10, calculating the geological reserves of coal bed gas and surrounding rock oil-gas; s20, establishing a reasonable parameter model of the drilling arrangement; s30: constructing directional long drill holes along the coal bed in the coal bed, and performing staged hydraulic fracturing construction; s40: by means of extraction data monitoring and in combination with parameters such as extraction standard-reaching period and the like, the treatment effect is comprehensively evaluated, and a design basis is provided for a treatment area under similar geological conditions. The comprehensive extraction and control technology of the multi-dimensional surrounding rock oil gas-coal bed gas aiming at coal gas and oil gas coexisting mine disasters is formed, dynamic space-time three-dimensional extraction of mining space disaster gas is realized, the mine excavation and gas extraction efficiency is improved, and the problem of the mine gas disasters is fundamentally solved.

title_en: Experimental device and experimental method for simulating formation of dam from damming dam to dam break
abstract_en: The invention provides an experimental device and an experimental method for simulating the dam break from the formation of a damming dam. The device comprises a water storage tank, a water measuring weir for injecting water into the water storage tank and measuring the upstream inflow flow of the water storage tank, a main tank connected with an outlet of the water storage tank, a branch channel intersected with the side direction of the main tank and a support. The main groove gradient, the branch groove gradient and the connecting plate height are adjustable, the width of a fluid channel of the main groove is adjustable, and the inflow flow and the water surface height are adjustable, so that the process of forming a damming dam by landslide and the process of developing a burst flood under different main groove and branch groove conditions and different branch groove landslide body source magnitude conditions can be simulated more accurately, the disaster chain evolution law of the damming dam can be acquired more comprehensively, the characteristics and the data of the burst water supply characteristics are formed, and the scientificity and the accuracy of research on the forming process of the damming dam and the burst mechanism of the damming dam are improved.

title_en: Device and method for simulating composite dynamic disaster in coal mine deep mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for simulating a composite dynamic disaster in coal mine deep mining, which comprises a test frame, wherein a support frame is arranged on one side of the test frame, a mixture of coal and rock is filled in the test frame, a simulation frame is arranged on the support frame in a sliding manner, a connecting plate is arranged between the simulation frames, a first simulation device and a second simulation device are respectively arranged on the simulation frames, and the first simulation device and the second simulation device can achieve the composite dynamic disaster effect through different impact frequencies and impact degrees; the scheme can simulate the experiment of the motionless vibration frequency and the impact force, achieves different effects in the process of simulating the dynamic disaster, has better simulation effect compared with the traditional technology, and can effectively observe data from different impacts; the device has simple structure and relatively low manufacturing cost, is suitable for market requirements, is relatively easy to obtain materials, and can be used for repeatedly carrying out tests.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle path optimization method for rapid evaluation after earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle path optimization method for rapid evaluation after earthquake disaster, and particularly relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining relevant information of a building needing to be evaluated in a disaster area and relevant information of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles needing to visit the disaster area, and determining the building which can be visited by each unmanned aerial vehicle, so that a variable-income Dolby team orientation problem MU-DTOP-VP model of the multiple unmanned aerial vehicles is established, an initial path planning scheme for executing a rapid evaluation task is obtained by adopting the MU-DTOP-VP model, and the initial path planning scheme is optimized by adopting a simulated annealing algorithm to obtain an optimal path planning scheme for visiting the building. According to the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, under the post-earthquake-disaster scene, various constraint conditions of the unmanned aerial vehicle under various real scenes are considered, and a path for executing a rapid evaluation task is optimized for each unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Building group fire simulation modeling method based on oblique photography and voxels
abstract_en: The invention provides a building group fire simulation modeling method based on oblique photography and voxels, which comprises the following steps: performing a unitization operation by using the oblique photography model of the building group as a data source, and dividing the oblique photography model of the building group into single building oblique photography models; traversing each triangular mesh of the single building oblique photography model, and performing voxelization operation on the triangular mesh to obtain a voxelization model of a building group; and modeling by using the voxel model, establishing a fire numerical simulation model, and endowing the fire numerical simulation model with combustion attributes. The invention utilizes the voxelization method to realize the numerical simulation modeling of the building group obtained by the oblique photography model of the building, quickly establishes the fire numerical model of the building group and further provides the specific process of fire spreading of the building group, thereby not only saving a large amount of workload of manual modeling, but also further obtaining a more precise result of regional fire simulation and providing a basis for more scientific disaster prevention and reduction of post-disaster loss.

title_en: Environment emergency medicine dissolving and dephosphorizing intelligent dosing method and integrated device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent feeding amount method for dissolving and dephosphorizing in an environment emergency, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting the inlet phosphorus content of a water source to be treated, determining the feed-forward feeding amount according to the inlet phosphorus content, then adopting a low-level medicine feeding and high-level stirring water discharging mode to fully mix the medicine and water, collecting the outlet phosphorus content at a water outlet, feeding back to a control system, and obtaining a medicine compensation value by the control system according to the fed-back data through autonomous learning of a machine and training of a model, and using the compensation value for dephosphorizing and dosing control. The method utilizes AI mathematical modeling, adopts a composite controller combining a fuzzy technology and a conventional PID control algorithm, and adopts a feedforward and feedback control strategy to realize automatic control of dephosphorization and chemical addition, thereby reducing the operation cost; the integrated device can realize rapid modular assembly, can adapt to various field conditions, is convenient to move, meets the requirements of on-site rapid construction of environment-friendly river dosing emergency project engineering, has rapid emergency response speed, and saves manpower and material resources.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted multifunctional drilling machine and static sounding integrated platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted multifunctional drilling machine and static sounding integrated platform, and mainly relates to the field of environmental remediation and geological exploration. The utility model provides a vehicular multifunctional drilling machine and static sounding integration platform, includes van, van carriage front end top sets up sample memory cell, sample memory cell below sets up microorganism operation module, van carriage front end sets up control system, van carriage middle part sets up static sounding device, van carriage tail end sets up direct push formula operating system, the van bottom sets up the hydraulic system who suits with static sounding device, direct push formula operating system. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention integrates the collection, storage, circulation, detection, treatment, soil physical parameter test and the like of the soil sample on the same vehicle-mounted platform, improves the efficiency of soil investigation and treatment, and improves the mobility and emergency response capability of the equipment.
assignees: SHANDONG ACADEMY OF ENV SCIENCES CO LTD;NANJING EPROBE ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE AND TECH ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for monitoring mining surrounding rock ground pressure disaster in real time
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time monitoring method and a real-time monitoring device for ground pressure disasters of mining surrounding rocks, wherein in the deep mining process, the method is used for carrying out while-drilling test on the mining surrounding rocks to obtain while-drilling mechanical response quantity to represent stress and intensity distribution of the mining surrounding rocks; optical and temperature sensors are arranged in the drill hole, and the deformation and temperature conditions of the mining surrounding rock in the drill hole are obtained in real time; installing charge and acoustic emission sensors in the same position, and acquiring the charge and acoustic emission events of the mined surrounding rock in real time; meanwhile, microseismic sensors are arranged in the borehole in a same-position mode, and the large-range energy condition of the mining surrounding rock is monitored in real time. The borehole mining surrounding rock apposition test data are transmitted to the roadway and then wirelessly transmitted to the ground receiving platform and the ground receiving platform through the roadway receiving end, so that the data are sorted and analyzed, and the mining surrounding rock earth pressure disaster forecast result is timely published.

title_en: Building fire disaster damage estimation method based on BIM and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a building fire disaster damage estimation method based on BIM and numerical simulation, which comprises the following steps: building information BIM model is established and converted into fire model, and the development condition of fire in the building is simulated by using numerical simulation method; extracting fire simulation data, and performing temperature data integration and smoke data integration; writing the integrated data into an attribute table of a building information model, determining the damage degree of various building components according to the integrated temperature data, and performing fouling area statistics according to the integrated smoke data; determining the damage repair sum of the building component and the smoke contamination repair sum of the building component after the fire according to the damage degree of the component and the counted smoke contamination area; and carrying out visual display of damage of the building components and visual display of economic losses of the building. The method can accurately simulate the fire spreading condition in the building after the fire occurs, give the damage assessment and economic loss estimation which are accurate to the component level, and provide technical support for fire departments, insurance industries and the like.

title_en: Storm surge flood early warning method and system based on long-term and short-term memory network
abstract_en: The invention provides a storm surge flood early warning method based on a long-term and short-term memory network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data and carrying out normalization processing; inputting the data into a long-term and short-term memory network for iterative training to obtain a flood prediction model for predicting the future water level change condition; inputting the current storm event data into a flood prediction model to predict the water level change condition; and if the water level exceeds the preset alarm line, starting the flood fighting emergency plan, otherwise, predicting the position of the waterlogging point and starting the waterlogging emergency plan. The invention also provides a storm surge early warning system, and the storm surge flood early warning method and the system based on the long-short term memory network have the advantages that: a model for forecasting storm tide water level changes is built based on a long-short term memory network algorithm, and derived waterlogging disaster conditions are forecasted based on the SWMM model when the water level does not exceed the flood boundary, so that decision support is provided for early warning and disaster relief work.

title_en: Tower type multifunctional automatic soil body accelerating device for geotechnical centrifugal test
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tower type multifunctional automatic soil body accelerating device for a geotechnical centrifugal test, which comprises: a bottom plate arranged on the centrifuge basket; a mold box disposed on the base plate for simulating fluid-structure interaction; the accelerating device comprises an accelerating channel, a baffle plate and a multifunctional motor, wherein the accelerating channel is vertically arranged, the lower end of the accelerating channel is communicated with the top of the model box, the baffle plate is rotatably arranged in the accelerating channel and used for initially bearing a soil sample, and a motor screw rod of the multifunctional motor controls the opening and closing of the baffle plate; the image acquisition device comprises a high-speed camera and a light source, wherein the high-speed camera is arranged on the bottom plate through a camera frame. Compared with the prior art, the invention not only can restore the high-speed characteristic of the flowing geological disaster of the large deformation soil body, but also has different acceleration levels, is beneficial to researching the influence of the impact speed on a disaster-causing mechanism, can accelerate without the help of external load, and fully utilizes the supergravity centrifugal field built by the centrifugal machine, thereby having good economy and simple and convenient operation.

title_en: Coal mine composite power disaster dynamic effect simulation experiment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine composite power disaster dynamic effect simulation experiment method, on the basis of which a disaster dynamic effect simulation experiment under the participation of power or no power can be developed, and the invention simultaneously provides a sectional type high-pressure-resistant sealing cavity and a T-shaped rigid pressure head with a limiting structure. The cavity upper section part and the middle section replaceable part are both provided with limiting grooves, and the middle section replaceable part is provided with an input end, an output end and an acoustic emission probe mounting groove. The input end is filled with adsorptive gas with set pressure, the limiting switch at the top of the T-shaped rigid pressure head is adjusted to limit and release the pressure head so as to carry out corresponding disaster dynamic effect simulation experiment, and the explosion-proof high-speed pneumatic valve is used for releasing pressure and observing disaster dynamic effect. The invention can be used for carrying out system monitoring on the dynamic effect of composite power disaster, provides data support for accurate analysis of each stage of the disaster, and has important theoretical significance and engineering practical value.

title_en: Dynamic effect simulation experiment method for composite dynamic disaster of deep mining mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic effect simulation experiment method for a composite dynamic disaster of a deep mining mine, which is particularly divided into two dynamic effect simulation experiments, namely, the dynamic effect simulation experiment considering the influence of mining stress and ground stress is developed by adjusting a T-shaped rigid pressure head to an unlocking state for continuous loading, and the dynamic effect simulation experiment considering only gas participation is developed by adjusting the T-shaped rigid pressure head to a limiting state. The method comprises the steps of synchronously monitoring the air pressure change in a high-pressure-resistant sealed cavity in the experimental process, utilizing an explosion-proof high-speed pneumatic valve to quickly release pressure, synchronously recording the air pressure, concentration and temperature at different positions of a transparent pipeline, and recording the infrared imaging and motion characteristics of crushed and thrown particle coal bodies through a thermal infrared imager and a split high-speed camera; and (4) counting the total amount, the geometric characteristics and the distribution characteristics along the transparent pipeline of the crushed and thrown granular coal. The invention can provide data support for the accurate analysis of each stage of catastrophe and has important theoretical significance and engineering value.

title_en: Coal mine composite power disaster dynamic effect simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine composite dynamic disaster dynamic effect simulation experiment device which comprises a sectional type high-pressure-resistant sealing cavity and a T-shaped rigid pressure head with a limiting structure. The sectional type cavity is provided with a limiting groove and is provided with an input end, an output end and an acoustic emission probe mounting groove. The input end is filled with adsorptive gas with set pressure, the limiting switch at the top of the T-shaped rigid pressure head is adjusted to limit and release the T-shaped rigid pressure head, a disaster dynamic effect simulation experiment under the participation of power or no power is carried out by the limiting switch, and the explosion-proof high-speed pneumatic valve is used for releasing pressure and observing the disaster dynamic effect. The invention can be used for carrying out system monitoring on the dynamic effect of composite power disaster, provides data support for accurate analysis of each stage of the disaster, and has important theoretical significance and engineering practical value. The invention has the advantages of exquisite structure, simple and easy experimental operation and low experimental cost.

title_en: Deep mining mine composite dynamic disaster dynamic effect simulation experiment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic effect simulation experiment system for a composite dynamic disaster of a deep mining mine, which comprises a high-pressure-resistant sealed cavity with a limiting groove, a T-shaped rigid pressure head with a limiting structure, an input end, an output end and a corresponding monitoring device, wherein the high-pressure-resistant sealed cavity is used for filling simulation experiment materials. The invention realizes the limitation and the release of the T-shaped rigid pressure head by adjusting the limit switch at the top of the T-shaped rigid pressure head, can develop a power effect simulation experiment with or without power participation by utilizing the limit switch, can develop system monitoring on the power effect of composite power disaster, provides data support for the accurate analysis of each stage of the disaster, and has important theoretical significance and engineering practical value. The invention has the advantages of exquisite structure, simple and easy experimental operation and low experimental cost.

title_en: Ore pressure prediction analysis device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining pressure prediction analysis device, which comprises a cylindrical shell, wherein the front end of the cylindrical shell is provided with a conical end head (bullet shape, better enabling a pressure sensor device to be pushed into a drill hole), the cylindrical shell is provided with a group of pressure sensor mounting holes perpendicular to the central line of the cylindrical shell, and a pressure sensor is fixed in each pressure sensor mounting hole. The powerful capacitor wires are fused by electrifying, so that the stress pieces are fully contacted with the wall of the drilling hole, thus the stress condition of each position can be predicted better, and theoretical guidance is provided for later working face exploitation. The invention overcomes the defects of the original counter, has the advantages of relatively simple structure, simple and flexible operation, low manufacturing cost and the like, is beneficial to arranging monitoring points on a large scale in a mine, plays a role in preventing disasters caused by mine stress burst, and ensures safe and efficient production of the mine.

title_en: Sit-up detection system and method based on human body and skeleton key point identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sit-up detection system and a sit-up detection method based on human body and bone key point identification, wherein the sit-up detection system comprises: the image acquisition module acquires a video image of the testee by adopting a high-definition camera; the image identification module is used for extracting human skeleton key points of the testee in the continuous frames; the action detection module is used for detecting the change condition of an included angle formed by a straight line formed by the waist key point and the shoulder key point and a relative horizontal position of the human skeleton key point of the tested person in the continuous frames to judge whether the tested person lies down or sits up or lies down to sit up; the judging and counting module is used for judging and recording the times of the sit-up of the testee in the testing time; and the data display module is used for displaying the times of the sit-up completed by the testee within the test time. The invention has the advantages of high detection speed and low cost, is suitable for single-person or multi-person detection, and can be applied to sports home operation, exercise detection in an emergency response state and other scenes.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SICHUAN LEJIAN DREAMER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for designing placing position of outdoor emergency guide signboard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for designing the placing position of an outdoor emergency guide signboard, which comprises the following steps: setting a horizontal angle of an outdoor emergency guide mark, wherein the horizontal angle of the outdoor emergency guide mark is an included angle between the projection of the mark on the plane where the road is located and the center line of the road; the width w of the outdoor evacuation path is 1-20 m, d is 0.3-0.5 m, b is 1.0-2.0 m, l BC 、l CD The reading distance value is read according to the outdoor emergency guide identifier, the calculation can be carried out, and the general value range of the horizontal angle of the outdoor emergency guide identifier is as follows: 50 degrees to 85 degrees; based on an interaction mode of evacuation personnel and an outdoor emergency guide identifier, a reading influence domain calculation method for judging the shielding range and the shielding degree is provided, and the method is subjected to simulation verification by utilizing 3dsmax software modeling; based on human factors engineering theory, it is high to provide an outdoor emergent direction signAnd designing a method, and giving a height design suggestion value, namely the middle position is 2.5m, the lower position is 0.7m, and the high position ensures that the elevation angle of the neck joint is not more than 35 degrees within an observation distance.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;BEIJING HUAXIN YUANJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Space-time sequence dividing method for rock burst
abstract_en: The invention provides a space-time sequence dividing method of rock burst, which comprises the steps of determining load natural subareas of all coal walls of a roadway by adopting a drilling cutting method, sequentially dividing all coal walls and roadway areas of the roadway into a plurality of space areas according to the load natural subareas of all coal walls of the roadway and a rock burst load supply area distribution rule, using the space areas as a space sequence of the rock burst, and sequentially dividing a rock burst generation process into a plurality of time stages according to the rock burst generation process rule, and using the time sequence of the rock burst. And corresponding the space sequence and the time sequence of the rock burst to obtain a space-time sequence of the rock burst. The embodiment of the invention can effectively know the time and the target area for restraining the rock burst disaster, thereby obviously improving the accuracy and pertinence of the pressure relief treatment of the rock burst.

title_en: Near-field dynamics method and system for simulating sudden inrush water disaster of tunnel rock mass failure
abstract_en: Disclosed are a near-field dynamics method and system for simulating a sudden inrush water disaster of tunnel rock mass failure, which solve the problems of existing methods in which describing progressive failure features of rock mass under the action of excavation and unloading is difficult and an evolution mechanism of an inrush water channel cannot be revealed, and can effectively describe the formation process of the rock mass failure inrush water channel and a surrounding rock damage and failure mechanism. The technical solution is: discretizing a computing model as matter points, and configuring a virtual boundary layer on an outer side of a boundary of the computing model as an object implemented by a boundary condition; selecting a neighborhood size of the matter points to form a neighborhood matrix of the matter points; enabling the crustal stress to be equivalent to a stress boundary condition of the computing model and karst water pressure to be equivalent to normal pressure, and converting a displacement constraint and a tunnel support into a displacement boundary condition; solving the velocity and displacement of the matter points, determining whether the bonds of all of the matter points satisfy a failure condition, and recording the local damage condition; and after an initial equilibrium calculation is stabilized, using a material point dormancy method to simulate a tunnel construction process.

title_en: Earthquake random event set simulation method considering large earthquake time correlation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of seismic engineering and the field of disaster relief business, and provides a method for simulating a seismic random event set by considering the correlation of seismic time, which comprises the following steps: determining earthquake activity parameters on an earthquake zone and a potential earthquake source region; setting the time length of a random event set seismic sequence; for the potential seismic source region, generating a seismic random event set by seismic grading; obtaining the magnitude, the size and the time of the earthquake by adopting a Poisson process model for the low-magnitude earthquake; obtaining the magnitude, the size and the time of the earthquake by adopting a time correlation process model for the high-magnitude earthquake stage; and integrating the seismic directories of the potential seismic source regions to obtain the seismic directories on the whole seismic zone. The invention creatively provides that the earthquake activity on the earthquake zone integrally meets Poisson distribution (time independent model) in the statistical sense, and simultaneously, the local part of the potential earthquake source zone adopts a large earthquake time related model, so that the integral and the local parts are organically combined, the accuracy and the practicability of the earthquake random event set simulation are greatly improved, and the invention has good application prospect.

title_en: Wisdom fire extinguishing system based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting system based on the Internet of things, wherein an environmental parameter acquisition module acquires environmental parameters in a region to be monitored and feeds back the acquired data to a Personal Computer (PC) in real time, the PC is internally provided with an operating data post-processing system which comprises a data storage module, a fire early warning module, a task track planning module and a visual playback module, and the visual playback module realizes the playback of fire conditions in a three-dimensional simulation mode on the basis of construction drawings of the region to be monitored, the data acquired by the environmental parameter acquisition module and tasks and tracks of a fire-fighting robot and an evacuation robot. The method and the system can quickly find the fire or fire safety hidden danger in the area to be detected and generate a corresponding fire-fighting task, thereby quickly realizing the control and removal of the fire or fire safety hidden danger.
assignees: URUMQI FUDI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;XINJIANG XINFUDI INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD;XINJIANG NEW DEV VOCATIONAL SKILLS TRAINING SCHOOL

title_en: Subway carriage fire control experience device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a subway carriage fire control experiences device, including carriage body, environmental simulation device, scene of a fire analogue means, main control system and operation terminal, environmental simulation device and scene of a fire analogue means pass through communication system respectively with main control system communication connection, and main control system passes through communication system and carriage body own carriage electrical control system communication connection. An operator inputs an operation instruction through an operation terminal and sends the operation instruction to a control host, the control host generates a corresponding environment simulation instruction and a fire scene simulation instruction according to the operation instruction and respectively sends the environment simulation instruction and the fire scene simulation instruction to an environment simulation device and a fire scene simulation device through a communication system, the environment simulation device simulates the external environment of a subway in operation on two sides of a carriage body according to the environment type, and the fire scene simulation device simulates the real fire scene environment in the carriage body according to the occurrence time and the type of a fire disaster. In the whole training process, the control host sends escape prompt information through the carriage electric control system.

title_en: Device for simulating overall process of foundation pit inrush disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device of simulation foundation ditch suddenly gushing catastrophe overall process for soft soil layer suddenly gushes catastrophe overall process under confined water topping and foundation ditch excavation uninstallation combined action when simulating foundation ditch excavation, the device mainly has five module to constitute, wherein includes test module, loading module, constant voltage module, pressurization module, measuring module. The utility model can automatically realize the whole process of excavation and inrush destruction of the foundation pit in the model test; in the test, the controllability adjustment of the bearing water level can be realized, the excavation speed of the foundation pit can be controlled automatically, and different working conditions can be simulated; the utility model discloses the technique is simple, realizes easily.

title_en: Wear-resistant and high-temperature-resistant cable
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wear-resisting high temperature resistant cable, including insulating core, the insulating core in is equipped with the conductor, the surface of conductor is equipped with the insulating layer, the surface of insulating layer is equipped with fire-resistant mica layer, be equipped with fixed connecting rod between the insulating core, and insulating core and fixed connecting rod locate in the fire-resistant filling layer, be equipped with interior fire-retardant layer on the surface of fire-resistant filling layer, be equipped with the signal shielding layer on the surface of interior fire-retardant layer, be equipped with the fine heat insulating zone of glass on the surface of signal shielding layer, be equipped with outer fire-retardant layer on the surface of the fine heat insulating zone of glass, be equipped with fire protection coating on the surface of outer fire-retardant layer, fire protection coating's surface is equipped with the sheath. The utility model has the performances of flame retardance, fire resistance, high temperature resistance and wear resistance, utilizes the wear resistance of the wear-resistant layer, makes the surface of the power cable not easy to wear, can keep electrifying and copper training unblocked when a fire disaster occurs, and provides help for rescue.
assignees: YINGTAN JINHAI WIRE AND CABLE CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive pipe gallery gas pipeline leakage diffusion simulation experiment table under ventilation state
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a comprehensive pipe gallery gas pipeline leakage diffusion simulation experiment table under ventilation state, including pipe gallery model pipe, set up the gas pipeline in the pipe gallery model pipe, set up a plurality of leakage points on the gas pipeline, the gas pipeline communicates with the gas supply structure and sets up; the top of the pipe gallery mould pipe is communicated with a ventilation structure which can adjust the ventilation working condition and the ventilation frequency; a plurality of gas sampling devices capable of collecting gas in the pipe gallery model pipe are arranged on the side wall of the pipe gallery model pipe at intervals; the gas sampling device and the gas supply structure are both electrically connected with a control part. The utility model discloses can realize the simulation of the utility tunnel internal combustion gas pipeline condition of leaking under the number of times of ventilating of difference to the gas of the automatic sampling of accessible gas sampling device leakage, for utility tunnel gas pipeline under the ventilation condition leaks the diffusion and the emergency response field provides reliable parameter, effectively improves utility tunnel fortune dimension efficiency, reduces utility tunnel incident incidence.
assignees: MCC CAPITAL ENG & RES INC LTD

title_en: Platform for on-site escape drilling
abstract_en: A platform for on-site escape drilling comprises a platform main body and is characterized in that the platform main body comprises a base arranged on a vehicle frame, a plurality of drilling tables arranged at the top end of the base and a scissor lift arranged between two adjacent drilling tables and used for lifting the two adjacent drilling tables, wherein the drilling tables are provided with gaps, and the gaps between the two adjacent drilling tables are provided with retractable stairs for people to climb, so that the whole platform main body can be retracted through the arrangement of the base, the drilling tables and the lift, the platform main body is convenient to move, the cooperation of the drilling tables and a vehicle can enter different areas for moving teaching, the internal space structure of the platform main body can be freely changed through the arrangement of a partition plate and a blocking plate, and a driller can perform drilling and escape through the body test of the drilling tables with various space structures, the handling operation capability of disaster sites is improved.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANTING EMERGENCY TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional spade
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of rescue, field operations training, especially, relate to a multi-functional spade, its characterized in that includes the spade pole, passes through bolted connection's pick with this spade pole's head, sets up the spade headstock at the head of spade pole, and the spade face that is connected through rivet and spade headstock sets up at the spade handle of spade pole afterbody, sets up the multi-functional composite set on the spade handle, sets up the tensile stretcher device in the spade pole. The utility model discloses simple structure, design benefit, convenient operation, low cost collects spade, pick, emergent charging, illumination, compass, stretcher in an organic whole, powerful for emergency rescue and relief disaster provide convenient, also for having won valuable time and energy in emergency rescue and relief disaster, let more lives and property obtain the guarantee.

title_en: Expandable residential fire experience vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting experiential vehicle, in particular to an expandable residential fire-fighting experiential vehicle, which comprises a vehicle body, wherein one side of the vehicle body is slidably provided with a drawing box, a rule area, a kitchen simulation area and a living room simulation area are arranged in the drawing box, the vehicle body is equivalent to a channel after the drawing box is drawn out, and a door is arranged between the living room simulation area and the channel; the part of the drawing box positioned at the tail of the vehicle is provided with an opening; a first stair is arranged at the opening of the pull box after the pull box is pulled out; a display screen is arranged on the side wall of the regular area; an operation table is arranged in the kitchen simulation area, and a first smoke generator and a first heater are arranged on the operation table; a second smoke generator and a second heater are arranged in the living room simulation area; flame lamps are arranged in the operating floor and the living room simulation area for illumination; the tail part of the vehicle body is provided with a second stair. Through the sliding arrangement of the drawing box and the vehicle body, the space for experiencing the fire disaster is increased, so that an experiencer can learn and feel the correct escape mode when the fire disaster occurs in person, and the invasion of the fire disaster is avoided.

title_en: Fireman training cap
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a firefighter's training cap, including the cap shell, the front end movable mounting of cap shell has the goggles, the both ends of goggles are located the fixed position of the both sides of cap shell and install the locking knob, the lower extreme rear fixed mounting of cap shell has the fire prevention cloth, the lower extreme the place ahead fixedly connected with magic area of fire prevention cloth, the fixed position that the lower extreme of cap shell is located the place ahead of fire prevention cloth is connected with the elastic webbing, the lower extreme fixedly connected with chin strap of elastic webbing, the inside front end fixed mounting of cap shell has the sweat absorbing area, the equal fixed mounting in both sides surface of sweat absorbing area has the plastic pad, the rear end surface of sweat absorbing area is located the fixed position of the inside of cap shell is connected with the cap hoop, the one end fixedly connected with regulation buckle of cap hoop, the upper end fixed surface of sweat absorbing area is connected with the welt. The utility model discloses can conveniently make the use of standard cap to can improve the result of use that the fire fighter made the standard cap, have the practicality.
assignees: HUBEI YUHE CLOTHES MAKING CO LTD

title_en: Light crawler or wheel type oil tank automatic fire extinguishing crank arm vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire control is speedily carried out rescue work and is rescued disaster equipment technical field, specifically discloses a light-duty track or wheeled oil tank automatic fire extinguishing crank arm car. The utility model has the advantages that: the temporary or special channel arranged on the chassis of the crawler or the wheel type machine and the oil tank area is utilized to remotely or manually drive the crossing tank area cofferdam to approach the oil tank body, the self-assembled oil tank heat insulation breaking machine, the magnetic adsorption type foam drilling gun, the foam hook gun or the foam gun are arranged by utilizing the lifting pipeline crank arm to approach the ignition point of the oil tank, and the fire extinguishing by approaching the oil tank to the maximum extent is realized under the coordination of the water hose of the fire truck. The self-control separation device is utilized to completely separate the self-control separation device from the fire extinguishing equipment in work, and the fire extinguishing equipment with larger flow is adopted to put out fire, so that the fire extinguishing speed is accelerated; the fire extinguishing device can be repeatedly arranged and installed to extinguish fire, the utilization efficiency of the fire extinguishing device is improved, the fire extinguishing device can rapidly escape from dangerous places under the condition of special danger, and the fire extinguishing of the arranged and installed fire extinguishing device is carried out continuously.

title_en: Linkage device of fire control system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire control system aggregate unit for detect and show building fire-fighting equipment operating condition, include: the fire disaster detection device comprises a display mechanism, a fire disaster simulation mechanism, a first induction switch, a second induction switch and a test box; display device installs on building wall outside surface, and each floor outer wall surface of building all is provided with display device, fire-fighting equipment sets up inside the floor, first inductive switch and second inductive switch all set up the side at fire-fighting equipment, first inductive switch is used for detecting fire-fighting equipment operating condition, and pass through wire series connection electric connection with display device, second inductive switch is connected with fire-fighting equipment electricity and links with fire-fighting equipment, fire analog mechanism sets up inside the floor, test box internally mounted has conflagration simulation button switch, fire analog mechanism is connected with conflagration simulation button switch electricity, be used for controlling conflagration analog mechanism, the staff upwards watches downstairs, can find out which specific floor fire-fighting equipment trouble, thereby realize the short-term test maintenance, and convenient and fast operation, and maintenance time is saved.

title_en: Trainee control device for trainee test for disaster response rovot in live-virtual-constructive environment and test methods thereof
title_ko: Lvc 환경의 재난 대응 로봇에 대한 훈련생 테스트를 위한 훈련생 관제 단말 및 훈련생 테스트 서버와 그 테스트 방법
abstract_en: A trainee control device for a trainee test for a disaster response robot in an LVC environment comprises: a disaster site map reception module for receiving a disaster site virtual map from a trainee test server for a trainee test for a disaster response robot; a disaster site map storage module for storing the disaster site virtual map received in the disaster site map reception module; a disaster response mission reception module for receiving a disaster response mission from the trainee test server; a command input module for receiving a command for the disaster response robot on a live test space for performing the disaster response mission received in the disaster response mission reception module, from a trainee in real time; a command transmission module for transmitting the command received in the command input module in real time to the disaster response robot and the trainee test server in real time; a constructive event reception module for receiving, from the trainee test server, a constructive event formed by disaster environment information obtained by simulating a disaster environment; a disaster response mission performance information reception module for receiving disaster response mission performance information of the disaster response robot according to the command, from the disaster response robot in real time; and a display module for displaying the constructive event received in the constructive event reception module in real time, and displaying the disaster response mission performance information received in the mission performance information reception module in real time in order for the trainee to issue a command while watching the disaster response mission performance information.
abstract_ko: 재난 현장 가상 맵(virtual map)을 재난 대응 로봇의 훈련생 테스트를 위한 훈련생 테스트 서버로부터 수신하는 재난 현장 맵 수신 모듈; 상기 재난 현장 맵 수신 모듈에서 수신된 재난 현장 가상 맵이 저장된 재난 현장 맵 저장 모듈; 상기 훈련생 테스트 서버로부터 재난 대응 임무(disaster response mission)을 수신하는 재난 대응 임무 수신 모듈; 상기 재난 대응 임무 수신 모듈에서 수신된 재난 대응 임무를 수행하기 위한 라이브(live) 테스트 공간 상의 재난 대응 로봇에 대한 명령을 훈련생으로부터 실시간 입력받는 명령 입력 모듈; 상기 명령 입력 모듈에서 실시간 입력받은 명령을 상기 재난 대응 로봇 및 상기 훈련생 테스트 서버로 실시간 송신하는 명령 송신 모듈; 상기 훈련생 테스트 서버로부터 재난 환경을 모사하는 재난 환경 정보로 구성되는 컨스트럭티브 이벤트(constructive event)를 수신하는 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 수신 모듈; 상기 재난 대응 로봇으로부터 상기 명령에 따른 상기 재난 대응 로봇의 재난 대응 임무 수행 정보를 실시간 수신하는 재난 대응 임무 수행 정보 수신 모듈; 상기 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 수신 모듈에서 수신된 컨스트럭티브 이벤트를 실시간 표시하고, 상기 훈련생이 보면서 명령을 내릴 수 있도록 상기 임무 수행 정보 수신 모듈에서 수신된 재난 대응 임무 수행 정보를 실시간 표시하는 디스플레이 모듈을 구성한다.

title_en: System for simulating human body sweating based on fire scene condition and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for simulating human body sweating based on fire scene conditions and a working method, wherein the system comprises an artificial environment cabin, a body warming dummy, a motion system, a temperature control system in the cabin, a wind speed simulation system and a control center; the motion system is used for simulating different motion states of a human body, the temperature control system in the cabin is used for simulating the temperature condition of a fire scene, the wind speed simulation system is used for simulating the wind power condition of the fire scene, and the body warming dummy is used for simulating the sweating condition of each actual part of the human body; therefore, the sweat amount and the sweat flow distribution of each part of the thermal manikin can be obtained under the influence of different motion states, different fire scene environment temperatures and different wind power on the distribution and the change of the fire scene environment temperature field, so that data reference is provided for the position arrangement of the sweat absorbing material in the follow-up firefighter uniform, and finally the sweat amount of different parts of the firefighter can be absorbed in time when the firefighter rescues in the fire scene, thereby ensuring the rescue ability of the firefighter.

title_en: Gas extraction standard-reaching equivalent quantitative evaluation method based on liquid CO2 fracturing permeability improvement and phase change driving
abstract_en: The invention provides a method based on CO  2  The liquid fracturing permeability-increasing and phase change driving gas extraction standard-reaching equivalent quantitative evaluation method; the method combines the temporary standard reaching regulations of coal seam extraction to quantitatively represent the equivalent standard reaching radius, the displacement and replacement ratio and the gas displacement efficiency of an engineering test; in addition, the evaluation method organically combines the liquid CO2 pressure injection amount, the equivalent standard radius, the displacement replacement ratio and the gas displacement efficiency together, realizes quantitative evaluation after the liquid CO2 pressure injection (the pressure injection amount is small, the equivalent standard radius can reach, the displacement replacement ratio can reach, and the gas displacement efficiency can reach), not only can provide a basis for the design of the liquid CO2 pressure injection amount and the extraction drill hole spacing in engineering tests, but also can improve gas extraction and reduce mine gas disasters.

title_en: Agent-based indoor emergency evacuation location risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an Agent-based indoor emergency evacuation location risk assessment method, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and intelligent agents. The method comprises the steps that 1) a building plan importing module receives a single-layer building plan, preprocesses the single-layer building plan, outputs the processed building plan and a specific emergency situation, waits for an external command, jumps to 2 if the external command is inserted into a simulated emergency safety event, and jumps to 3 if the external command verifies the safety of the building plan; 2) the emergency event generation module specifies the position of the emergency safety event, changes the state of the grid point at the position of the emergency safety event according to the property of the emergency safety event and adjusts the reward value of the grid point connected with the adjacent grid points; 3) and selecting a deep learning method aiming at the emergency situation, feeding back reasonably designed safety indexes, and outputting the overall safety evaluation indexes of the plane. The method effectively avoids the defect existing when the hidden danger of indoor emergency evacuation is dissolved by artificially establishing the rigidity rule.

title_en: Method for accurately identifying residual coal gas extraction proportion of mining area
abstract_en: A method for accurately identifying the gas extraction ratio of the residual coal in a mining area is suitable for identifying the gas extraction ratio of the residual coal in the mining process of a multi-coal-bed mine. The construction drilling is carried out to collect coal samples of the coal seam, the upper adjacent layer and the lower adjacent layer and desorb gas, investigation holes with different heights from the bottom plate of the coal seam are constructed in a mined-out area behind the working face of the coal seam, mixed gas samples in the mined-out area are collected, components and stable isotope values of the gas components of the mined-out area mixed gas extracted by the desorption holes and the investigation holes of the coal seam, the upper adjacent layer and the lower adjacent layer are tested, and the source proportion of the gas extracted from the residual coal in the mining area is calculated based on isotope ratio definition. The method can accurately identify the proportion of the gas extracted from the residual coal in the mining area. By accurately identifying the gas extraction source of the residual coal in the mining area, a targeted gas extraction process is formulated, the safe and efficient production of a mine is ensured, the disaster prevention and resistance capability of the mine is improved, the gas extraction rate of the residual coal in the mining area is improved, and the economic benefit of the coal mine is improved.

title_en: Building soundness monitoring system
abstract_en: To provide a building soundness monitoring system capable of estimating, in detail, a structural performance of a building after an earthquake.SOLUTION: A building soundness monitoring system 1 includes: a wireless accelerometer 12 that is installed on a tier of the position of the equivalent height in a one-mass system vibration model simulating a building 10, and acquires earthquake information; an arithmetic processing unit 21 for calculating an interlayer deformation angle, which is a relative displacement amount to the ground motion at the position of the equivalent height, using the earthquake information: a seismic intensity calculation unit 22 for calculating the seismic intensity at a building address on the basis of the earthquake information: a structural performance index estimation unit 23 for estimating the disaster degree of the building 10 after the earthquake by compering the interlayer deformation angle to the ground motion with a predetermined threshold; and a display unit 31 for displaying the seismic intensity at the building address and the disaster degree of the building.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Data protection and disaster tolerance teaching training device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a real device of instructing of data protection and calamity tolerance teaching, including bearing the frame, the operation panel, network server, communication gateway, PC computer and intelligent mobile communication terminal, wherein bear the frame and include fossil fragments, main ventilation pipe, supplementary ventilation pipe, ventilation fan, drive switch circuit, a load-bearing room is all kept apart through the baffle to fossil fragments inside that every side of fossil fragments corresponds, fossil fragments up end and operation panel interconnect, drive switch circuit and fossil fragments surface connection, all establish at least one network server and a communication gateway in every load-bearing room, PC computer and intelligent mobile communication terminal encircle and bear the frame axis equipartition at operation panel up end. This novel one side can effectively satisfy a plurality of students' synchro-operation and teacher and guide a plurality of students to carry out the teaching activity simultaneously, and on the other hand can effectively realize carrying out quick data recovery, realizing emulation operations such as the incessant operation of server under unusual states such as proruption equipment trouble.
assignees: NANJING UNARY INFORMATION TECH INC LTD

title_en: Single-hole single-line tunnel single-side flat-guide type rescue station fire disaster model test system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-hole single-line tunnel single-side flat-guide type rescue station fire disaster model test system, which comprises: the tunnel system comprises a main tunnel channel, parallel evacuation channels and a transverse connecting channel, wherein the main tunnel channel is a longitudinal channel, the parallel evacuation channels are arranged on one side of the main tunnel channel in parallel, and the transverse connecting channel is arranged transversely and is vertically communicated with the main tunnel channel and the evacuation channels; the fire source simulation device is arranged in the main tunnel channel; a smoke exhaust duct; and the monitoring device is used for monitoring the flue gas concentration and the flue gas flowing rule in the main tunnel channel, the parallel evacuation channel and the transverse connecting channel. The invention can be assembled in a modularized way, has simple structure, good stability, strong universality and convenient test operation, is easy to assemble, can accurately record and analyze the characteristic parameters such as the flow rule of smoke, a temperature field, a heat radiation value, a ventilation strategy and the like when a fire disaster occurs in the railway tunnel, and has stronger practicability.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Double-hole single-line tunnel encrypted transverse passage type rescue station fire model test system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-hole single-line tunnel encrypted transverse passage type rescue station fire disaster model test system which comprises a tunnel system, a fire source simulation device, a smoke exhaust pipeline and a monitoring device, wherein the tunnel system is provided with a tunnel inlet and a fire source outlet; the tunnel system comprises a main tunnel channel and a transverse connecting channel, wherein the main tunnel channel is two channels which are arranged in parallel, and two ends of the transverse connecting channel are provided with jet fans; two ends of the transverse connecting channel are respectively communicated with the two main tunnel channels and are vertical to the main tunnel channels; the fire source simulation device is arranged in the main tunnel channel; the smoke exhaust pipeline is arranged at the tops of the two main tunnel channels through the fixed flange and communicated with the two main tunnel channels; discharging the smoke in the main tunnel channel along a smoke discharge pipeline through a jet fan; the monitoring devices are arranged in the main tunnel channels and the transverse connecting channels and are used for monitoring the flue gas concentration and the flow rule in the two main tunnel channels and the transverse connecting channels; this scheme can carry out the combination of multiform with different modules, promotes concatenation efficiency, adapts to the experimental demand of different environment.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Icing and icebreaking device for high-voltage line in snow disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a snow disaster high-voltage line icing and icebreaking device, which comprises a telescopic arm, wherein the middle end part of the telescopic arm is provided with an insulating pull rope, and the two ends of the telescopic arm are fixed with an ice-breaking wire-clamping machine, a storage battery is fixedly attached and installed above the inner wall of the ice-breaking wire-clamping machine, the storage battery is electrically connected with the motor at one side below through a circuit, one end of the motor is provided with a drill rod, the drill rod is movably inserted into the striker sleeve and fixedly welded with the ice breaking striker, a support frame is arranged above the inner part of the ice breaking wire clamping machine, an electric vibration machine is fixedly arranged in the supporting frame, a main spherical wire clamping head is arranged in the supporting frame below the electric vibration machine in a sliding way, and an auxiliary spherical wire clamping head I and an auxiliary spherical wire clamping head II are symmetrically arranged at two ends below the main spherical wire clamping head, when the ice block is impacted, a certain force can be ensured, and the short circuit of the motor caused by the fact that the head is impacted by the broken ice is often blocked by the ice block and cannot be impacted out of the maximum stroke can be avoided.

title_en: Method for simulating damming process of barrier lake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-sand coupling simulation method for a damming lake bursting process, which relates to the field of water disaster defense and comprises the steps of describing a damming lake bursting forming and developing process by adopting a complete water-sand coupling control equation, solving the complete water-sand coupling control equation by adopting a finite volume method in a high-precision MUSC L-TVD-H LL C format, reconstructing interface Riemann value variables by using MUSC L to enable the interface Riemann value variables to reach second-order precision, inhibiting numerical oscillation by using a TVD algorithm, calculating Riemann flux by using H LL C, dispersing terrain source items by using a local terrain correction and water depth reconstruction technology, dispersing resistance source items by adopting an implicit method, and processing a gravity collapse simulation bursting process by adopting a simple geometric method.
assignees: CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENT RES INST CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Geological disaster early warning system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and discloses a geological disaster early warning system, which comprises: the system comprises a vibration detection module, a geothermal detection module, a mobile monitoring module, a ground subsidence detection module, a main control module, a geological structure identification module, a disaster model construction module, a judgment module, an early warning module and a display module. According to the invention, through the geological structure recognition module, the proper size parameters can be selected according to different conditions of different areas of the image, so that the geological structure recognition precision is improved; meanwhile, the three-dimensional geological disaster model and the disaster area geological model constructed by the disaster model construction module are constructed based on the interpolated drilling data, so that the occurrence state of the geological disaster in the space can be reflected more truly; the three-dimensional model is connected with the database, and geological disaster information can be edited and inquired.

title_en: Thunderstorm strong wind grading early warning method, system, storage medium and computer program
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of weather forecast, and discloses a thunderstorm strong wind grading early warning method, a system, a storage medium and a computer program, wherein a two-step speed de-blurring method is utilized to perform quality control on the radial speed of radar data; acquiring data of a radial velocity and high wind area, and scanning the high wind data azimuth by azimuth; selecting a strong wind area larger than a set area threshold value; acquiring grid point data of a high wind area with 0.5-degree elevation radial speed exceeding 17m/s within 80km around a radar station; generating a new training sample set by adopting a self-help resampling technology; taking the area percentage of 7-14 level wind in each high wind area as a characteristic; constructing a random forest; model evaluation was performed by 5-fold cross validation.
