The invention can provide the gale early warning landing area and grading early warning information, provides information for the forecaster to issue the early warning, and provides reference for the disaster gale sensitive industry.

title_en: Coal and gas symbiotic disaster prevention and control method based on goaf air leakage field optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal and gas symbiotic disaster prevention and control method based on goaf air leakage field optimization, which comprises the following steps of A, determining a goaf and an overlying strata fracture field distribution range thereof, and further determining a height range of a drilling position; B. determining a reasonable gas extraction mode according to the fracture field distribution range and the existing coal mine geological data; C. determining the distribution condition of a drilling field; D. monitoring the gas concentration and the CO concentration of the working face, and detecting the air leakage speed of the goaf; E. adjusting the extraction negative pressure of an extraction main pipeline and setting gas sensing; F. determining the possibility epsilon of the air leakage speed and the gas concentration to the coexistence of the spontaneous combustion of the coal and the gas explosion; G. according to the determined safety range, obtaining the actual extraction negative pressure of the coal mine; according to the method, reasonable extraction negative pressure of the coal seam is determined by considering the change condition of the flow field of the goaf, so that the goaf air leakage field is optimized, and the purpose of preventing and treating coal and gas symbiotic disasters can be realized while the gas extraction effect is guaranteed.

title_en: System for preventing coal and gas outburst disasters through grouting of hydraulic gas tunnel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a system for hydraulic gas tunnel slip casting prevention and cure coal and gas outburst calamity, this system excavates to the coal seam or gets into the coal seam within range at hydraulic gas tunnel, pour into cement mortar into to the excavation direction through implementing the slip casting drilling at the face, make the weak layering of coal seam gluing together, improve the destruction intensity of coal, form one set of "support arch", and form the separation curtain of excavation space outside coal seam to excavation coal seam space release gas one, reduce coal and gas outburst danger. The system is simple and easy to implement, fast in construction, simple in process, safe, efficient and low in cost, and the gas extraction time can be greatly shortened.
assignees: GUIZHOU WATER CONSERVANCY INVEST GROUP CO LTD;NORTH CHINA INST SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: System and method for preventing disaster of environmental facilities
title_ko: 환경 시설 재난 대응 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an environmental facility disaster response system and a method thereof. The environmental facility disaster response system comprises: an environmental facility sensor for sensing disaster-related risk information of an environmental facility; and a disaster response/recovery server that remotely controls disaster response and disaster recovery by using disaster-related risk information sensed by the environmental facility sensor. According to the environmental facility disaster response system and the method thereof, there is an effect of enabling rapid recovery and normal operation of important environmental facilities by automatically and remotely controlling to perform immediate response and recovery according to a scenario when there is damage to the environmental facilities that are very important to health and security.
abstract_ko: 환경 시설 재난 대응 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다.  환경 시설의 재난 관련 위험 정보를 센싱하는 환경 시설 센서; 상기 환경 시설 센서에서 센싱된 재난 관련 위험 정보를 이용하여 재난 대응 및 재난 복구를 원격 제어하는 재난 대응/복구 서버를 구성한다.  상술한 환경 시설 재난 대응 시스템 및 방법에 의하면, 보건과 보안에 매우 중요 환경 시설들이 재난 피해를 입었을 때 시나리오에 따라 즉각적인 대응과 복구를 수행하도록 자동 원격 제어함으로써, 중요 환경 시설의 빠른 복구와 정상적인 동작이 가능하게 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System for evacuation route calculation and guidance according to predict disasters
title_ko: 재해예측에 따른 대피경로 산출 및 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route searching and guide system based on disaster prediction. According to the present invention, the evacuation route searching and guide system based on disaster prediction comprises: a server including a location information request module, a route detection module, and a route information transmission module; and a client including a location information transmission module and a route information reception module. According to the present invention, an effective evacuation route searching method can be provided.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재해예측에 따른 대피경로 산출 및 안내 시스템 및 방법에 있어서, 기상정보와 연계하여 복합재난 시나리오를 생성하고 이에 따른 재해예상 지역을 생성하여 해당 지역의 거주민 및 유동인구에게 재해예상지역 예측정보를 전달하는 재해정보 전송 시스템에 있어서, 재해예상지역 예측정보가 생성되면 하나 이상의 클라이언트로 GPS 송신요청 신호를 송신하는 위치정보요청모듈, 상기 위치정보요청모듈을 통해 요청된 하나 이상의 클라이언트로부터 위치정보를 수신하면 재해예상지역 내에 위치하는 각 클라이언트의 위치정보를 중심으로 재해예상지역 외에 위치하는 하나 이상의 대피장소까지의 각 경로정보를 서로 비교하여 가장 빠른 시간에 도착할 수 있는 경로정보를 검출하는 경로검출모듈, 및 상기 경로검출모듈에서 검출된 경로정보를 해당 클라이언트로 송신하는 경로정보송신모듈을 포함하는 서버; 및 상기 서버로부터 GPS 송신요청 신호를 수신하면 상기 서버로 GPS를 통해 위치정보를 송신하는 위치정보송신모듈, 및 상기 경로정보송신모듈로부터 경로정보를 수신하면 출력모듈에 출력하는 경로정보수신모듈을 포함하는 클라이언트;를 포함하는 재해예측에 따른 대피경로 산출 및 안내 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 대피경로 생성, 안내 방법 및 이를 이용하는 무선클라이언트 애플리케이션과 관련 응용시스템은 사용자가 위급한 상황에서도 사용자 조건 및 위치를 파악하고, 신속하게 대피경로와 장소를 제공받아 대피할 수 있는 재해예측에 따른 대피경로 산출 및 안내 시스템 및 방법을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Novel portable thoracic closed drainage device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical instruments and discloses a novel portable thoracic closed drainage device.A puncture head and a fixed plate are integrally designed and are connected with one end of a connecting pipe in a gluing way, and the other end of the connecting pipe penetrates into an outer bag and is connected with an anti-reflux device; the anti-reflux device is of a similar duckbill-shaped flat structure with a round top and a flat bottom, the lower part of the outer bag is provided with a flow guide opening, a switch is arranged on the flow guide opening, the device is made of plastic, can be folded, and can be conveniently carried and used for one time when being packed into a small box. The utility model uses the outer bag to replace the chest bottle, so that the volume of the device is reduced, and the carrying is facilitated; the anti-reflux device has the anti-reflux function, can prevent liquid or gas in the outer bag from flowing reversely, has the one-way circulation function, is made of plastic materials, can be folded, has light weight and small volume, is beneficial to carrying, is simple to operate, can be used by personnel for training slightly, is convenient for carrying patients after operation, and can be used for field first aid of battlefields and major disasters.

title_en: Method and device for testing influence of natural gas hydrate decomposition on seabed slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test method and a device for the influence of natural gas hydrate decomposition on a seabed slope in the technical field of marine disaster research, which comprises a methane gas conveying device, a model box and a water vapor conversion device, wherein a high-permeability sand layer is paved at the bottom of the model box, perforated pipes are uniformly paved on the high-permeability sand layer, an inclined test soil sample is paved above the perforated pipes, two ends of each perforated pipe extend out of the model box and are respectively connected with the methane gas conveying device and the water vapor conversion device, by analyzing the action of the decomposed product of the natural gas hydrate on the seabed slope, the damage condition of the actual action is met, the difficulty caused by the limitation of the natural condition of the ocean is solved, the test simulation device is convenient to operate and use, and the test process can be clearly observed and recorded.

title_en: Evacuation path recommendation method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evacuation path recommendation method based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: step one, acquiring weights of different factors in data by using incremental training of an automatic encoder; secondly, distributing weights of different dimensions by using a back propagation optimization data reduction process, and keeping important features in low-dimensional data; step three, visualizing the data by using a 2D scatter diagram after the data reduction is finished, and evaluating the performance together with other dimension reduction methods; designing an evacuation path recommending Markov reward function and a discount factor; designing and realizing refuge path prediction and carrying out visualization; the invention enlarges the range of Markov process application and path design through the cooperation of data reduction and machine learning, so that high-dimensional data from different sources can be subjected to path prediction after processing, and meanwhile, the incremental self-encoder model used simplifies input data and improves the efficiency and precision of the machine learning process.

title_en: Windproof snow shed tunnel construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind and snow prevention shed tunnel construction method, which relates to the field of building construction methods and comprises the following steps of construction preparation, bored pile construction, foundation tie beam construction, frame column construction, frame beam construction, masonry engineering construction, steel corrugated plate installation and safety facility construction, wherein the flow of the bored pile construction of the process steps comprises pile position determination, drilling, hole cleaning and checking, steel reinforcement cage manufacturing and installation, pile foundation concrete pouring and pile body quality detection; the frame beam construction process comprises scaffold erection, reinforcement bar binding, template support, concrete pouring and concrete maintenance; the process of installing the steel corrugated plate comprises the installation of the steel corrugated plate and the installation of the PC endurance plate. The method has the advantages of simple process operation, convenient quality control, quick construction progress and capability of greatly reducing the construction cost, and is suitable for construction of shed tunnel engineering for controlling wind and snow disasters of various levels of roads.
assignees: XINJIANG COMMUNICATIONS CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;XINJIANG HUATIAN ENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Simulation evaluation method for fire disaster control effect of roof breaking and dismantling of wooden suspended foot building
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation evaluation method for a fire disaster control effect of a roof breaking and dismantling of a wooden suspended building, and belongs to the technical field of virtual reality technology and digital simulation. The method comprises the following steps: (1) building a building model and setting parameters; (2) setting working conditions; (3) Slicing, recording heat radiation condition, and evaluating spreading condition; (4) simulating test, and collecting numerical values; (5) evaluation of fire control effect: drawing a graph of the change of the heat release rate of 12 working conditions with time; analyzing and evaluating the influence of the opening or closing condition of the roof on the fire control effect of the suspended building; and analyzing and evaluating the influence of the roof breaking and dismantling time on the effect of controlling the fire disaster of the suspended building. According to the invention, the FDS software is used for establishing a virtual simulation suspended building model, setting various working conditions of roof breaking and dismantling, and evaluating the effect of controlling fire disaster of the wood suspended building roof breaking and dismantling, so that more scientific guidance can be provided for the coping of the fire disaster.

title_en: Traffic tunnel group smoke cross flow research and emergency rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic tunnel group smoke cross flow research and emergency rescue system, which comprises two parts: the system comprises a movable trolley, a tunnel lifting structure, a longitudinal air device, a ceiling centralized smoke exhaust device, a fixed support, a tunnel slide rail, a thermocouple, a smoke detector and the like; and the traffic tunnel group emergency rescue system comprises local parallel tunnels, transverse channels, transverse channel sliding sealing doors, movable sealing walls, water curtains and the like. The system can realize the diffusion and channeling conditions of pollutants in the tunnels with different tunnel intervals, different fire source positions and different height-width ratios and modify rescue evacuation parameters of high-altitude areas under the synergistic effect of different longitudinal wind speeds and ceiling concentrated smoke exhaust speeds between adjacent tunnels at short distance; in addition, the experimental system can be used as a simulation wind tunnel, and the related experiment of the tunnel group with smaller size can be simulated in the system.

title_en: Waterlogging area intelligent analysis system and method based on unmanned aerial vehicle image
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent waterlogging area analysis system based on unmanned aerial vehicle images, which comprises a preprocessing module, a model generating module and an analysis module. An intelligent analysis method of waterlogging area based on unmanned aerial vehicle image comprises S1, reading image data to be processed and preprocessing the image data to generate a sample data set; s2, constructing a deep convolution model, and further training the constructed model by using a sample data set until a standby convolution model is generated; and S3, analyzing the image data to be identified by calling the standby convolution model so as to obtain waterlogging information. The invention improves the capacity of analyzing farmland waterlogging in unmanned aerial vehicle images, can objectively and rapidly monitor the occurrence range and the disaster receiving degree of farmland waterlogging disasters, thereby quantitatively evaluating the loss caused by the waterlogging disasters and providing technical support for post-disaster remediation.

title_en: Fire burning and ventilation control system of spiral tunnel group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire burning and ventilation control system of a spiral tunnel group. The port on the left side of the straight tunnel is provided with a longitudinal ventilation device which can be adjusted according to the required longitudinal wind, and the ventilation direction can be changed. The position of the fire source is also variable, and the fire disaster in a straight tunnel, a spiral tunnel and a connecting transition section can be simulated. The spiral tunnel is composed of tunnel unit sections, the length can be increased or decreased, and the spiral radius can be selected on a tunnel moving platform as required. The inclination angle of the tunnel is adjusted by a jack. Fire smoke enters the concentrated smoke exhaust pipeline through the concentrated smoke exhaust port of the tunnel ceiling and is exhausted by the concentrated smoke exhaust fan arranged at the end port of the pipeline. Through the system simulation, the smoke diffusion parameters of different fire smoke of the spiral tunnel group can be obtained, and the aim of seeking a high-efficiency smoke control method is fulfilled.

title_en: Atmospheric, land and hydrological three-way coupling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for bidirectionally coupling atmosphere, land and hydrology, which comprises the following steps: step 1, improving the runoff yield calculation on the basis of the discretization of the water storage capacity of the watershed; step 2, determining a coupling scale and processing topographic data; step 3, determining a coupling variable and formulating a bidirectional feedback mechanism; step 4, calculating convergence and forecasting flood; the method improves the simulation of the land-air coupling system on the water circulation process, improves the accuracy of land-air coupling flood forecasting, and provides reliable technical support for the defense of the drainage basin flood disasters.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Successive fault online evaluation method based on fault probability and time domain simulation quasi-steady state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault probability and time domain simulation quasi-steady-state-based successive fault online evaluation method, which comprises the steps of generating successive fault sequences according to equipment fault probability or manual designation based on equipment fault probability, fault positions and fault types given by external meteorological disaster evaluation, considering a control protection model of a direct current system, a second three-line defense control strategy, new energy offline protection and an alternating current-direct current equipment protection model for each successive fault sequence according to the sequence of equipment faults, judging a quasi-steady-state operation mode after the equipment faults based on time domain simulation, evaluating safety stability and accident event grade risk, generating quasi-steady-state tide stability calculation data for online safety stability and accident event grade risk evaluation of the subsequent successive equipment faults, and improving the accuracy of the successive fault evaluation. The method provides effective technical support for identifying the high-risk successive fault key links and blocking the evolution of successive faults in the actual power grid operation.

title_en: Equipment that collapses of packing cupboard for fire control training
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire control training is with packing cupboard equipment of collapsing, fire control training is with packing cupboard equipment of collapsing includes first portion and second portion, first portion is provided with the bracing piece, the bracing piece can extend or shorten, the bracing piece with the second portion is mutually supported. When the supporting rod extends to a certain length, the gravity center of the second part leaves the body of the second part, the first part is separated from the second part, the collapse action is completed, the collapse action of the container can be effectively simulated when a fire disaster happens, the simulation training of the collapse of the container lacking in the fire-fighting training is pertinently provided, and the effect and the quality of the fire-fighting training are obviously improved.
assignees: BEIJING BEIAN SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: AI service opening middle platform and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an AI service opening middle station, a method and a computer readable storage medium for realizing the method. The AI service open center is realized based on a container arrangement engine and comprises a service API standardization system, a data standardization processing system, an automatic training optimization system and a project competition system; the service API standardization system, the data standardization processing system, the automatic training optimization system and the project competition system are operated on independent application container engines respectively. The technical scheme of the application solves the problem that the access of the AI service is not uniform, improves the disaster tolerance and stability of the system, and solves the problems of safety, stability, expansibility, usability and the like existing in the opening of the AI service.
assignees: BEIJING ZHINENG GONGCHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large-dip-angle high-gas coal seam adjacent goaf disaster cooperative prevention and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large dip angle high gas coal seam adjacent goaf disaster cooperative prevention and control method, which is mainly used for predicting, reasonably determining air quantity, ventilation form and propulsion speed according to mining conditions and gas emission quantity in the aspect of gas, preferably selecting an extraction method, and efficiently treating gas; in the aspect of coal spontaneous combustion, the spontaneous combustion characteristic of coal is determined through experiments, and a fire prevention method is formulated from two aspects of oxygen control and time control on the basis of gas prevention and control. Meanwhile, in the aspect of disaster prediction, a mathematical physical model is established according to ventilation, extraction and fire prevention, and numerical simulation is carried out to predict the spontaneous combustion dangerous area of the coal, so that the lowest propulsion speed for preventing and controlling natural fire is determined, the ventilation and extraction method is optimized, and fire prevention measures are perfected. In addition, in the aspect of disaster forecast, the index gas is determined through experimental means, the spontaneous combustion degree of the coal body is judged by combining a corresponding monitoring system and an analysis technology, and the oxygen concentration distribution monitored by the beam tube can also verify a numerical simulation result, so that the model parameters are corrected.
assignees: LIUHUANGGOU COAL MINE YANKUANG XINJIANG MINING CO LTD;UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method for synthesizing earthquake motion field by applying support vector machine, principal component analysis and particle swarm optimization in machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a support vector machine and principal component analysis in application machine learningAnd a method for synthesizing the seismic motion field by a particle swarm algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: step one, extracting a seismic motion parent wave from existing domestic seismic motion data by applying a principal component analysis method; step two, establishing a seismic oscillation prediction model by applying a support vector machine algorithm, and verifying the correctness of the model; step three, through the reaction spectrum S of the synthetic earthquake motion  a  (T) reaction spectra S obtained by prediction equation  a   *  (T) is matched, i.e. When S is minimum, a group of coefficients k is obtained  i  I.e. the solution to the synthetic seismic motion. The invention introduces the theory of machine learning into the synthetic earthquake motion method, can retain the original earthquake motion information, avoids the problem that the prior method of applying random earthquake motion simulation may ignore some important earthquake motion information, has good inclusion on the measured data, can better realize the reproduction of earthquake disasters and has good application prospect.

title_en: Comprehensive training equipment for security education training
abstract_en: A security protection education training comprehensive training device relates to the technical field of safety training devices; the front wall is a fixed point training wall, a first portal frame is fixed above the fixed point training wall, first safety guardrails are respectively arranged on two sides of the first portal frame, and the first portal frame is connected with a first rope through a fixed pulley; a window of a building of the simulation building is arranged on the wall on the right side surface, a second portal frame is arranged at the upper end of the wall, second safety guardrails are respectively arranged on two sides of the second portal frame, a second rope is connected to the second portal frame through a fixed pulley, and a first door is arranged on one side of the bottom of the wall; the left side wall is a rock climbing wall, and a third safety guardrail is fixed at the upper end of the rock climbing wall; the upper end of the back wall is fixed with a soft rope rapid-descent portal frame and a pipeline rapid-descent portal frame, and the outer sides of the soft rope rapid-descent portal frame and the pipeline rapid-descent portal frame are respectively fixed with a fourth safety guardrail. The utility model discloses almost included the main disaster prevention and reduction safety training content project in the present society, exert its maximum effect.
assignees: LIANGJIAN KAITUO SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Digital content for ship disaster safety training
title_ko: 선박 재난안전 교육훈련 디지털 콘텐츠
abstract_en: The present invention relates to ship disaster safety education and training digital content and, more particularly, to safety education content using augmented reality and virtual reality reflecting real-time data, statistical data, and setting data. The present invention comprises: a risk prediction module reflecting real-time data of ships in a preset region; a vulnerability determination module reflecting statistical data of ship passage history and accident history in the preset region; a flow visualization module reflecting setting data in which obstacles and marine environments are arbitrarily arranged in the preset region; and an output module comprising a wearable device in which data of the risk prediction module to the flow visualization module is imaged and provided in augmented reality and virtual reality.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박 재난안전 교육훈련 디지털 콘텐츠에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 실시간데이터와 통계데이터 및 설정데이터가 반영된 증강현실과 가상현실을 이용한 안전교육 콘텐츠에 관한 것이다. 
이러한 본 발명은 기설정된 지역의 선박 실시간데이터가 반영된 위험도 예측모듈; 상기 기설정된 지역의 선박 통행이력 및 사고이력 통계데이터가 반영된 취약점 판단모듈; 상기 기설정된 지역에 장애물과 해양환경이 임의 배치되는 설정데이터가 반영된 유동 가시화모듈; 및 상기 위험도 예측모듈 내지 상기 유동 가시화모듈의 데이터가 증강현실 및 가상현실로 이미지화되어 제공되는 웨어러블 기기로 구성된 출력모듈로 이루어진 것을 기술적 요지로 한다.

title_en: An Earthquake Evacuation Training System Using Virtual Reality
title_ko: 가상현실을 이용한 지진대피훈련시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake evacuation training system, and more particularly, to an earthquake evacuation training system using virtual reality, which allows a screen for an earthquake situation to be output through a VR device, transmits vibration, inclination and the like of the earthquake situation output through the VR device to a vibration-type treadmill to simulate the same earthquake situation, and transmits information on a user′s movement on the vibration-type treadmill to a cloud server to be linked to the screen of the VR device, thereby enabling real-like earthquake training in a specific space through virtual reality.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진대피훈련시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 지진 상황에 대한 화면이 VR기기를 통해 출력되고, VR기기를 통해 출력되는 지진 상황의 진동, 기울어짐 등이 진동형 트레드밀로 전달되어 동일하게 발생되도록 하며, 진동형 트레드밀 상의 사용자 움직임에 대한 정보가 클라우드 서버로 전송되어 VR기기 화면에 연동되도록 함으로써, 가상현실을 통해 특정 공간에 대한 실제와 같은 지진 훈련이 가능하도록 하는 가상현실을 이용한 지진대피훈련시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Landslide-damming dam-dam break flood disaster chain evolution process simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and engineering geology, a landslide-damming dam-dam break flood disaster chain evolution process analogue means is provided. The device includes: the system comprises a set of landslide dynamic condition simulation system, a set of hydrodynamic condition simulation system and a set of non-contact measurement system. The landslide dynamic condition simulation system can simulate various landslide body materials, landslide speed, and the width, length and inclination angle of a landslide path; the hydrodynamic condition simulation system can simulate a plurality of hydrodynamic conditions such as water flow, water flow speed, river inclination angle and riverbed property; the non-contact measurement system provided by the test device can realize non-contact measurement from single contact point measurement to universe, and the measurement method is high in precision, convenient and fast. The utility model discloses simple structure, convenient to use provides reliable laboratory test analogue means and method for landslide-damming dam-dam break flood disaster chain research.

title_en: Artificial landscape tree
abstract_en: The utility model provides an artificial landscape tree belongs to view tree technical field, aims at solving current view tree and often receives the influence of plant diseases and insect pests and natural disasters, needs periodic maintenance to maintain, extravagant manpower and materials resource. The tree-shaped tree pruning machine comprises a base, a trunk, branches and branches, wherein the branches are fixedly arranged on the base, the branches are movably arranged on the trunk, and the branches are inserted into the branches; the top of the trunk is fixedly provided with a spherical mounting seat, and the branches are inserted in the spherical mounting seat; the branches are inserted on the branches. The utility model provides an artificial landscape tree, which adopts the structural design of a simulation tree and is provided with branches and paper slips which are installed in a plug-in manner, the shape of the landscape tree can be adjusted according to the requirement, manual trimming is not needed, and the influence of plant diseases and insect pests is avoided; vine plants such as the tiger creepers can be planted around the landscape trees, the landscape trees are used as climbing supports of the vine plants, combination of the simulation trees and the green plants is achieved, and the greening effect is better.

title_en: Debris flow danger level evaluation method and system based on analytic hierarchy process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow danger grade evaluation method and a system based on an analytic hierarchy process, and the technical scheme comprises the following steps: acquiring disaster environment information, and extracting effective data in the disaster environment information; acquiring geological data about disaster causes; carrying out weight calculation on the cause of the debris flow by an analytic hierarchy process, and dividing danger grades; and correspondingly simulating and generating a three-dimensional numerical model according to the risk level, and performing disaster simulation and risk evaluation. The method can accurately and efficiently judge disaster generating conditions and the danger degree, classify the damage degree of the debris flow in advance, simulate the three-dimensional dynamic disaster in a high-risk area, and reduce the loss caused by the debris flow disaster.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION SHANDONG PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVEN;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Near-horizontal pressurized directional drilling equipment and method for complex broken stratum under coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for drilling underground coal mine tunnels, in particular to near-horizontal pressurized directional drilling equipment and method for complex broken stratums in underground coal mines. The method comprises the following steps: the orifice sleeve is used for closing the orifice during construction; the directional drilling tool assembly penetrates through the orifice casing to enter the coal bed during construction, and a unidirectional conducting drilling tool center hole is formed in the directional drilling tool assembly; a throttling pressurization system coupled to a first fluid passage formed between the directional drilling assembly and the orifice casing and configured to recover and input fluid from within the first fluid passage; the invention provides high-pressure flushing fluid into the drill hole and controls the pressure of the flushing fluid, so that the radial additional supporting force of the flushing fluid on the hole wall is greater than the balanced pressure value of the hole wall, the stability of the drill hole is ensured, the problems of volatile and stable damage and high occurrence of safety accidents of the drill hole of a complicated broken stratum are avoided, and the hole forming rate and the construction safety of various near-horizontal geological exploration and disaster prevention drill holes under a coal mine are improved.

title_en: Heating device and method for simulating heat damage of surrounding rock of roadway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating device and a method for simulating heat damage of surrounding rocks of a roadway, wherein the heating device comprises a heating furnace body, an electric heating unit, a control console, a quartz glass tube, a vacuum pump, a sealing valve, a pressure release valve and a vacuum pressure gauge, through holes matched with the outer diameter of the quartz glass tube are formed in two side walls of the heating furnace body, the through holes are blocked by asbestos discs, the electric heating unit comprises a heating wire, a resistance area, a change-over switch and a power supply which are electrically connected, and the resistance area comprises an NTC thermistor and a PTC thermistor which are connected in parallel. By adopting the heating device and the method, on one hand, the rock sample can be heated in non-vacuum, complete vacuum and different vacuum degree states, and on the other hand, the heating curve of the rock sample is ensured to be basically consistent with the real heating curve of the surrounding rock of the roadway when a fire disaster occurs, so that the real thermal damage of the surrounding rock of the roadway after the fire disaster of the coal mine occurs can be simulated.

title_en: Drilling machine for ground disaster investigation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drilling machine for ground disaster investigation, including motor, be equipped with the fixed bolster on motor's the lateral wall, the fixedly connected with drive shaft on motor's the output, two solid fixed rings of fixedly connected with on the lateral wall of motor one end are kept away from to the drive shaft, two a plurality of first pivots that are the symmetry and set up of fixedly connected with between the solid fixed ring. The utility model discloses with the help of buffer spring's elastic force effect, horizontal direction vibrations among the high frequency low amplitude vibrations that the motor during operation produced cushion to at the drilling in-process, the effectual influence that reduces horizontal direction high frequency vibrations to the drilling rod avoids the drilling rod to warp because of receiving the influence of horizontal direction high frequency vibrations and break even in the degree of depth drilling operation, and remains the profitable vertical direction vibrations of drilling.

title_en: Temporary wardrobe for temporary use
title_ko: 임시로 사용하는 간이 옷장
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a temporary wardrobe for temporary use made of corrugated cardboard and quickly assembled for temporary use in a shelter, a polling station, a conference hall, a training camp, an education center, a hospital, a studio, a study room, etc. The temporary wardrobe for temporary use comprises: a corrugated cardboard enclosure (100) wherein one sheet of corrugated cardboard divided into a rear surface (110), a pair of sides (120) connected to the left and right sides of the rear surface (110), a front surface (130) connected to one side of one side (120a) of the pair of sides (120), a contact surface (135) extended from one side of the other side (120b) of the pair of sides (120) in a prescribed width, a pair of first half planes (140) connected to the lower sides of the pair of sides (120), and a pair of second half planes (150) connected to the lower side of the rear surface (110) and the front surface (130) is folded in a prescribed order to form a cuboid shape; and a hanging bar (200) of a bar shape of which both ends are coupled to the pair of sides (120) at a prescribed height.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대피소, 투표소, 회의장, 훈련장, 교육장, 병원, 원룸, 고시원 등에서 신속하게 조립하여 임시로 사용할 수 있는 골판지로 된 임시로 사용하는 간이 옷장으로서, 배면(110), 상기 배면(110)의 좌우측에 연결되는 한 쌍의 측면(120), 상기 한 쌍의 측면(120) 중 한 측면(120a)의 일측에 연결되는 정면(130), 상기 한 쌍의 측면(120) 중 다른 측면(120b)의 일측에서 소정폭으로 연장되는 접면(135), 상기 한 쌍의 측면(120)의 하측에 각각 연결되는 한 쌍의 제1 절반평면(140)과, 상기 정면(130) 및 상기 배면(110)의 하측에 각각 연결되는 한 쌍의 제2 절반평면(150)으로 구획된 1장의 골판지가 일정순서로 접어져 직육면체 형태를 이루는 골판지 함체(100); 및 양단부가 상기 한 쌍의 측면(120)에 일정높이로 결합되는 봉 형상의 걸이대(200);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Data processing method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a data processing method, a device and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic data information and service call link routing data of an application to be processed, wherein the application to be processed comprises one or more application containers; establishing a simulation model according to the basic data information, wherein the simulation model comprises a plurality of node models corresponding to the application containers; and processing the application to be processed according to the simulation model and the service call link routing data. The simulation model is established through the basic data information, the application is processed by utilizing the simulation model and the service call link routing data, large-scale simulation disaster tolerance drilling is performed on the application under the condition of consuming few resources, the practicability is high, the cost of the simulation drilling is low, the simulation disaster tolerance drilling can be performed at a higher frequency, the stability of the online service is ensured, and the accuracy and the reliability of the application processing by the simulation model are improved.

title_en: Test device and test method for simulating three-dimensional bedrock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device for simulating three-dimensional bedrock and a test method thereof, wherein the test device comprises an outer frame, a hoisting mechanism and a molding mechanism, the hoisting mechanism is installed at the top of the outer frame, the molding mechanism is installed below the outer frame in a sliding manner, the hoisting mechanism is detachably connected with an embedded part on the molding mechanism, the test device can be used for preparing the high-precision simulated three-dimensional bedrock, and provides powerful premise foundation conditions for application research in the research fields of geotechnical engineering, hydrogeology, landslide, debris flow and the like for the problems of the relation between an overlying structure and the bedrock and the influence of the form of the bedrock on geological disasters.

title_en: Induction test device for hydrogen bond fracture of loaded coal rock
abstract_en: An induction test device for hydrogen bond fracture of loaded coal rocks belongs to the technical field of coal rock monitoring and accident prevention. The induction test device for hydrogen bond fracture of loaded coal rocks comprises a base and a charge sensor which are arranged inside a transparent vacuum box, an infrared spectrum analyzer and a computer which are arranged outside the transparent vacuum box, wherein the base is provided with a protective shell with holes, the bottom of the transparent vacuum box is provided with a bottom switch port, the bottom switch port is communicated with the infrared spectrum analyzer through a channel, the top end of the charge sensor is provided with a charge probe, and the computer is respectively connected with the transparent vacuum box, the charge sensor and the infrared spectrum analyzer. The induction test device for the hydrogen bond fracture of the loaded coal rock can simulate the pressure state of the deep underground coal rock, can test and analyze coal rock samples macroscopically and microscopically, can quickly and effectively judge the hydrogen bond fracture condition, and provides a theoretical basis for predicting and forecasting mine dynamic disasters.

title_en: Geotechnical engineering landslide model test box
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of model test box, in particular to a geotechnical engineering landslide model test box, which comprises a box body, wherein an electromagnetic shaker is fixedly connected in the box body, the top end of the electromagnetic shaker is fixedly connected with a model chamber, the bottom end of the model chamber is fixedly connected with an upper sleeve block, a spring is fixedly connected in the upper sleeve block, the bottom end of the spring is fixedly connected with a lower sleeve block, the bottom end of the lower sleeve block is fixedly connected in the box body, a support plate is fixedly connected in the box body, and the top end of the support plate is fixedly connected with a first fixed block; the utility model discloses, through the extension that sets up electric putter and shorten and to make the landslide plate use first round pin axle to incline rotatory as the centre of a circle to can adjust the angle of landslide plate, the person of facilitating the use uses, through the vibrations of electromagnetic shaker, drives the lantern bush on the extrusion of model room, thereby drives the lantern bush and removes under the cooperation of extrusion spring, can simulate earthquake disaster to the influence of landslide.

title_en: Fireman training clothes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a firefighter training clothes, which comprises a coat and trousers, wherein the coat consists of two arm parts, two shoulder parts, a collar part and a trunk part, the trousers consist of a waist crotch part and two trouser leg parts, protective pads are sewed on the shoulder parts, anti-skid plates are embedded at the top parts of the protective pads, a first limiting cloth belt is arranged on one side of the arm part far away from the trunk part, a second limiting cloth belt is arranged on one side of the arm part close to the trunk part, an emergency bandage is wound between the first limit cloth belt and the second limit cloth belt, elastic breathable cloth is sewn at the joint of the arm part and the trunk part, waterproof pockets are sewn at two sides of the trunk part, an elastic band is fixedly connected at the bottom of the trunk part, the elastic belt is provided with a plurality of belt loops, a connecting rope penetrates through the belt loops, and the trouser legs are fixedly connected with a first cloth strip and a second cloth strip. The utility model discloses can effectively protect, excellent in use effect reduces the potential safety hazard, and is comfortable and easy to wear.
assignees: HUBEI YUHE CLOTHES MAKING CO LTD

title_en: High-temperature flue gas distribution linkage CA model for personnel evacuation simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature flue gas distribution linkage CA model for personnel evacuation simulation, which comprises the following steps: generating data, namely generating fire information, natural information and personnel information through a data simulation system for simulation and derivation; the data matching is realized by calling the data of the cloud database, comparing and screening the generated data, marking abnormal data, generating a log, then performing data backup, and storing the data backup into the database; data noise reduction is carried out, and data noise reduction processing is carried out on the data; data import, namely packaging and editing the generated and modified data and importing the data into an Agent-CA model; and the CA model generates a high-temperature smoke distribution linkage model based on the Agent-CA model. According to the invention, natural data is added, so that the fire scene data can be better restored, the reliability of the fire scene high-temperature flue gas distribution linkage CA model can be improved, personnel evacuation can be better carried out, the personnel evacuation efficiency is improved, and the manpower and financial loss is reduced.

title_en: Fire disaster identification method and system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire identification method and a fire identification system based on a block chain 1 Segmenting a flame area image from a standard fire image; acquiring video image P sent by each node of block chain 0 Obtaining a negative sample image set U m (ii) a Video image P 0 Spliced image set U formed by splicing with flame area images 2 And is combined with standard fire image U 1 Combining to obtain a positive sample image and a combined image U n (ii) a Constructing a convolutional neural network structure for fire identification, and collecting negative sample images U m And a positive sample image set U n Constructing a training sample and a test sample; modeling convolutional neural networksTypes are stored to the blockchain network. The method breaks through the defect of information isolated island of the traditional fire identification through the block chain network, and realizes the sharing of the training data and the convolutional neural network model, so that the convolutional neural network model has very high stability and robustness, and the accuracy of the fire identification is improved.
assignees: BEIJING TIANYIBAIKANG SCIENCE AND TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power plant typhoon emergency response and early warning device and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nuclear power plant typhoon emergency response and early warning device and a construction method thereof; the nuclear power plant typhoon emergency response and early warning device comprises a nuclear power plant typhoon response total database, a typhoon risk database, a nuclear power plant key sensitive device and structure list, a typhoon vulnerability database, a nuclear power plant wind field fluid simulation analysis module, a nuclear power plant typhoon accident scene analysis and simulation module, a patrol exposure device and missile influence analysis module and a typhoon emergency response action suggestion module; the list output module is used for outputting a primary vulnerable device and structure list with the typhoon intensity exceeding the wind resistance median according to the typhoon intensity and frequency data in the typhoon danger database and the wind resistance median in the typhoon vulnerability database; the nuclear power plant typhoon emergency response and early warning device and the construction method thereof are ingenious in technology and high in practicability.
assignees: SUZHOU NUCLEAR POWER RES INST;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Virtual reality-based one-place two-center cloud disaster recovery backup system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality-based one-place two-center cloud disaster recovery backup system, which comprises: downstream service unit: regularly backing up data through a downstream data protection system, and storing, backing up and protecting front-end data in a unit cloud server; a first center: the downstream service units are connected through private lines, and the data of each downstream service unit are transmitted to a first central protection system for gathering and storing; a second center: and synchronizing the data collected and stored by the first center, and performing disaster tolerance storage. The invention has the advantages that the backup system of the invention greatly improves the security protection level of the enterprise network and practically guarantees the information security. The system and data disaster tolerance safety of medium and small-sized companies can be greatly improved; the backup system of the invention can help small and medium-sized enterprises to deal with extreme network security conditions and can also recover each business system instantly. The actual requirements of most enterprises can be met through strict safety tests.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY ENGINEERING GROUP GANSU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: VR natural disaster scene interaction device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of VR panorama application, in particular to a VR natural disaster scene interaction device which is arranged in an indoor or outdoor open area and comprises VR equipment, a management terminal matched with the VR equipment for application and a display screen used for displaying pictures, wherein the management terminal comprises a single chip microcomputer, a WIFI module, a Bluetooth module, a data storage module, a screen switching module, a decibel tester and a router; the invention simulates the natural disaster scene in VR, and is convenient for users to simulate the environment of the users in VR scene during natural disaster, so as to make timely treatment in future life during natural disaster, and the invention has good market prospect due to the application of blank space in market.
assignees: HIRAIN BEST EMERGENCY SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ad hoc network terminal communication system
abstract_en: The invention is a self-organizing network terminal communication system; be applied to a plurality of communication terminal's ad hoc network interconnection, each communication terminal includes: the signal searching module responds to a first communication request of a user and sends a first pairing code to the coverage area in a ZigBee communication mode; the first pairing code is used for matching with other communication terminals; the signal transmission module is used for receiving the second pairing codes sent by other communication terminals and verifying the second pairing codes, and data transmission is carried out after the verification is successful; the transmission data in the data transmission comprises user identity information stored by the main control module, a live-action map shot by the live-action capture unit and a user real-time altitude; the interconnection of the two communication terminals is realized, so that the intercommunication of peripheral scenes can be realized between each independent terminal in a network-free environment or a jungle exploration and disaster relief environment; the personal safety of each user is guaranteed, a reference system under a blind map is established through a map training unit, and the positions of the communication terminals can be determined.

title_en: Electric cabinet for petroleum drilling equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric cabinets, discloses an electric cabinet for petroleum drilling equipment, and aims to solve the problem that the electric cabinet is damaged due to the existing drilling leakage accident. It includes the bottom plate and is fixed in the mounting panel at bottom plate top, the outside cover of mounting panel is equipped with the inner box rather than pressing the close connection, the cover is equipped with rather than sliding connection's outer container on the lateral wall of inner box, the lateral wall of inner box is fixed with the pneumatic cylinder of inversion, the output of pneumatic cylinder is fixed in on the bottom inner wall of outer container, the top edge of bottom plate is fixed with the riser, install the level appearance on the riser, be equipped with inlet air channel and air-out passageway on the both sides wall of outer container respectively, install the fan that is located inlet air channel one side and be located the play tuber pipe of air-out passageway one side on the both sides wall of inner box respectively, the fan all communicates with the. The invention has good heat dissipation function, and plays a good role in protecting the electric components in the electric cabinet when disasters such as well drilling leakage occur.
assignees: PLATEAU SHANDONG MECH AND ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster model display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster model display device, including the show cupboard, the inside of show cupboard is provided with storing chamber, battery respectively through the division board and places the chamber and place the chamber with the motor, the interior diapire fixedly connected with shock dynamo in chamber is placed to the motor, shock dynamo's output fixedly connected with vibrations show sand table, the glass safety cover has been placed to the upper surface of show cupboard, the solid fixed ring of last fixed surface connection of show cupboard, gu fixed ring's side is provided with the chucking mechanism of chucking glass safety cover. This geological disaster model display device is used for placing the article that simulation geological environment is relevant through setting up vibrations show sand table, through setting up the glass safety cover, can prevent that the article in the in-process vibrations show sand table of simulation vibrations from dropping, through setting up show cupboard, shock dynamo, vibrations show sand table and vibrations spring, can simulate the harm of earthquake to the geology to make whole device have the effect that the simulation earthquake brought danger.

title_en: Multifunctional forcible entry training device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional broken trainer of tearing open, a serial communication port, including the cuboid frame, the side facade of frame cut apart into a plurality of functional areas by crossbeam, upright roof beam, the functional area include that the guardrail is broken to tear the district open, the door body is broken to tear the district open, the board roof beam is broken to tear the district open and is expanded the training district, the door body break open the district and be provided with the burglary-resisting door, be provided with on the burglary-resisting door and break the board open, the expansion training district in vertical or the horizontal fixation be provided with the guide arm, the cover is equipped with one or two clamp plates with matching on the guide arm, the clamp plate respectively with the frame that corresponds, stand and be provided with the spring between roof beam or crossbeam, the spring will clamp plate and spacing portion on the guide arm. In the process of disaster accident rescue, obstacles such as anti-theft doors, windows, window guardrails and the like need to be removed in an emergency. The utility model discloses a broken simulation trainer of tearing open trains according to the actual combat demand to the broken method of tearing open of difference trains.
assignees: TIANJIN JIELIAN ELECTROMECHANICAL EQUIPMENT INSTALLATION TECH CO LTD;SU LIANYING

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling design and construction process of fire protection equipment
title_ko: 소방 방재 설비의 설계 및 시공 공정을 위한 제어 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and apparatus for controlling a design and construction process of firefighting and disaster prevention equipment. A method for controlling a design and construction process of firefighting and disaster prevention equipment according to an embodiment of the present invention, which is based on artificial intelligence, comprises the following steps of: storing a design of a target space scanned by a designer for design of firefighting and disaster prevention equipment; generating a first input signal based on the design; inputting the first input signal to a previously trained convolution neural network in a block chain network; acquiring a first output signal based on an input result; arranging recommendation-optimized firefighting and disaster prevention equipment in the saved design according to recommended design, based on the first output signal; generating a corrected input signal according to a value input by the designer to adjust required firefighting and disaster prevention equipment and the number thereof, based on an arrangement result; arranging corrected firefighting and disaster prevention equipment in the design based on the recommended design and location relationship of each equipment, the location relationship including role overlapping prevention, distance and connection of each firefighting and disaster prevention equipment, based on the corrected input signal; generating a final corrected input signal according to a final input of the designer based on the arranged design; generating a final location determination and training signal of the firefighting and disaster prevention equipment based on the final corrected input signal; and training a convolution neural network based on the training signal.
abstract_ko: 소방 방재 설비의 설계 및 시공 공정을 제어하는 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.  일실시예에 따른 소방 방재 설비의 설계 및 시공 공정의 제어 방법은 인공지능을 기반으로 소방 방재 설비의 설계 및 시공 공정을 제어하는 방법에 있어서, 소방 방재 설비의 설계를 위해 설계자가 스캔한 대상 공간의 설계도를 저장하고, 설계도에 기초하여, 제1 입력 신호를 생성하고, 제1 입력 신호를 블록체인 네트워크 내 미리 학습한 컨벌루션 신경망에 입력하고, 입력 결과에 기초하여, 제1 출력 신호를 획득하고, 제1 출력 신호에 기초하여, 추천 최적화된 소방 방재 설비를 추천 설계에 따라 저장된 설계도 내에 배치하고, 배치 결과에 기초하여, 설계자가 필요한 소방 방재 설비 및 그 수를 조정하기 위해 입력한 값에 따른 수정 입력 신호를 생성하고, 수정 입력 신호에 기초하여, 수정된 소방 방재 설비를 추천 설계 및 각 설비의 위치 관계-위치 관계는 각 소방 방재 설비들의 역할 중첩 방지, 거리 및 연결을 포함함-에 기초하여 설계도 내에 배치하고, 배치된 설계도에 기초하여, 설계자의 최종 입력에 따른 최종 수정 입력 신호를 생성하고, 최종 수정 입력 신호에 기초하여, 소방 방재 설비의 최종 위치 결정 및 학습 신호를 생성하고. 학습 신호에 기초하여, 컨벌루션 신경망을 학습시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Virtual reality based training system for accident response and training method thereof
title_ko: 사고대응 가상현실 기반 훈련 시스템 및 훈련 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for virtual reality-based training for accident response. The system includes: a server storing information on a plant for operator training with respect to an emergency situation at the plant and storing information on the result of the operator training; virtual reality equipment for virtual reality recognition for executing the virtual reality-based operator training; training operation equipment the operator operates for the virtual reality-based training; and a controller calculating a safe path for the operator′s escape from the emergency situation based on the information provided by the server and controlling the operator training along the calculated safe path. The controller is capable of calculating the safe path by reflecting personal disposition information on the operator. According to the present invention, the current location of the operator is used in calculating exits for the minimum distance, the minimum time, and the maximum safety. With the calculation completed, each individual trainee′s physical conditions, motor nerve, and degree of fear are reflected in exit re-calculation for the trainee. As a result, customized evacuation paths for trainees can be presented and their survivability can be enhanced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사고대응 가상현실 기반 훈련 시스템 및 훈련 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 사고대응 가상현실 기반 훈련 시스템은, 플랜트에서의 비상상황에 대해 조업자의 훈련을 위해 상기 플랜트에 대한 정보가 저장되고, 상기 조업자의 훈련결과에 대한 정보가 저장되는 서버; 상기 조업자가 가상현실을 통해 훈련을 수행하기 위해 가상현실을 인식하기 위한 가상현실 장비; 상기 조업자가 가상현실에서 훈련을 위해 조작하는 훈련 조작 장비; 및 상기 서버에서 제공된 정보를 바탕으로, 상기 조업자가 비상상황에서 탈출할 수 있는 안전 경로를 산정하고, 산정된 안전 경로를 따라 상기 조업자에 대한 훈련을 제어하는 컨트롤러를 포함하고, 상기 컨트롤러는, 상기 조업자에 대한 개인 성향 정보를 반영하여 안전 경로를 산정할 수 있다. 본 발명에 의하면, 조업자의 현재위치를 이용하여 최단거리 경로에 따른 출구, 최단시간 경로에 따른 출구 및 최고 안전한 경로에 따른 출구에 대한 산정이 완료된 상태에서, 훈련원 개개인의 신체조건, 운동신경, 공포나 두려움에 대한 정도를 반영하여 훈련원에게 적합한 경로에 따른 출구를 재산정하여 각 훈련원에 대한 맞춤형 피난 경로를 제시하여 생존 가능성을 높일 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Dynamic evacuation guidance system and method
title_ko: 동적 대피 유도 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a dynamic evacuation guidance system includes: an occupant sensing part installed at an entrance for accessing a plurality of individual areas in an indoor space to be formed to sense an occupant passing through the entrance; an operation part formed to operate an evacuation route for the occupant in the indoor space to evacuate to the outside based on personnel count data sensed by the occupant sensing part, and create an evacuation guidance command based on the evacuation route; a display part installed in at least one of the plurality of individual areas to be formed to display an evacuation guidance signal in at least one of visual and acoustic formats based on the evacuation guidance command; and a communication part formed to deliver the personnel count data from the occupant sensing part to the operation part and deliver the evacuation guidance command from the operation part to the display part. The operation part includes an occupant distribution monitoring part formed to monitor occupant distribution in the individual areas in real time based on the personnel count data including information about a moving direction of the occupant passing through the entrance. Therefore, the system is capable of improving the reliability of an evacuation simulation result as well as applying various simulation methods to an actual disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 동적 대피 유도 시스템은, 실내 공간 내의 복수의 개별 구역을 출입하는 출입구에 설치되어, 상기 출입구를 통과하는 재실자를 감지하도록 구성되는 재실자 감지부; 상기 재실자 감지부에서 감지되는 인원 계수 데이터에 기초하여 상기 실내 공간 내부의 재실자가 외부로 대피하기 위한 대피 경로를 연산하고, 상기 대피 경로에 기초하여 대피 유도 명령을 생성하도록 구성되는 연산부; 상기 복수의 개별 구역 중 적어도 하나의 내부에 설치되어, 상기 대피 유도 명령에 의해 시각 및 청각 중 적어도 하나의 형태로 대피 유도 신호를 표출하도록 구성되는 표출부; 및 상기 인원 계수 데이터를 상기 재실자 감지부로부터 상기 연산부로, 상기 대피 유도 명령을 상기 연산부로부터 상기 표출부로 전달하도록 형성되는 통신부를 포함하며, 상기 연산부는, 상기 출입구를 통과하는 재실자의 이동 방향에 대한 정보를 포함하는 상기 인원 계수 데이터에 기초하여 상기 개별 구역 내의 재실자 분포를 실시간으로 모니터링하도록 구성되는 재실자 분포 모니터링부를 포함한다.

title_en: Trigger protection cover of construction machine
title_ko: 건설기계의 트리거 보호커버
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a trigger protective cover of a construction machine, installed in a construction machine such as a concrete pump car, a crane, a drilling machine, a crane, etc., and a specially equipped vehicle such as a fire engine, an aerial vehicle, etc., so that the load point can be increased and the work can be stably performed. More specifically, a new type of the trigger protective cover of a construction machine includes a cover which is installed on the outer surface of a trigger to surround an outer surface of the trigger and which has a stretchable shape. Accordingly, the trigger protective cover can prevent contact of foreign substances such as dust and dirt on the surface of a cylinder constituting the trigger in advance, so as to prevent damage and malfunction of the cylinder and safely protect the trigger.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 콘크리트 펌프카, 크레인, 천공기, 크레인 등과 같은 건설기계 및 소방차, 고소작업차 등과 같은 특장차량에 설치되어 하중점을 넓혀 안정적으로 작업을 수행할 수 있도록 건설기계에 설치되는 트리거에 관한 것으로, 더욱 구체적으로 설명하면, 트리거의 외면을 감싸며 신축 가능한 형태를 갖는 커버를 트리거의 외면에 설치하여 트리거를 구성하는 실린더의 표면에 먼지, 흙과 같은 이물질의 접촉을 미연에 방지할 수 있어 실린더의 손상 및 작동불량을 방지하고 트리거를 안전하게 보호할 수 있는 새로운 형태의 건설기계의 트리거 보호커버에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Somatosensory simulation tracking equipment for disaster scene practical experience system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a body feeling simulation tracking device for a disaster scene practical experience system, which comprises a placing bag and a device body, wherein the inner cavity of the placing bag is provided with the device body, the placing bag passes through a fixed perforated adhesive strong magic tape on a second fixing strap through a first fixing strap, the device body is fixed on the arm or other parts of a user, the structure is simple, the use is convenient, a transparent protective film is arranged on the front surface of the placing bag body, the real-time situation of the device body is convenient to use and observe, a micro camera and a micro microphone are arranged on the front panel of the device body, the micro camera records the situation of the user in real time, the micro microphone collects sound and sends the collected audio to a terminal, a human body induction mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the device body, the situation of a human body is induced, and the audio is transmitted to a human body signal detection module for analysis, meanwhile, the real-time use status of the user is recorded.

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for evaluating danger of regional landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dangerous assessment method, a system, a device and a storage medium for regional landslide, which comprise the steps of obtaining regional basic data of a research region, and obtaining mechanical parameters and rainfall data according to the regional basic data; obtaining groundwater level change data at each moment in the whole rainfall period according to the mechanical parameters and rainfall data by adopting a regional rainfall infiltration numerical simulation method; analyzing the stability of the research area by adopting a limit balance method to obtain landslide occurrence probability and landslide intensity occurrence probability at each moment in a rainfall period; and establishing a dangerous computing formula of landslide disasters according to all landslide occurrence probabilities and all landslide intensity occurrence probabilities in the rainfall period, and obtaining the dangers of the research area according to the dangerous computing formula. According to the method, a risk prediction model based on a rainfall-induced landslide formation mechanism is established, quantitative expression of landslide intensity in landslide risk assessment is realized, and reliability of regional landslide disaster risk assessment is improved.

title_en: Simulation training device for aluminum electrolysis aluminum package and aluminum simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of training teaching aids of colleges and universities, in particular to an aluminum electrolysis aluminum bag simulation training device and an aluminum production simulation method, wherein the aluminum electrolysis aluminum bag simulation training device comprises an aluminum bag, a water cylinder, an aluminum suction pipeline and a siphon assembly, the water cylinder is connected inside the aluminum bag, the siphon assembly is connected on the top surface of an upper shell, the siphon assembly comprises an ejector, an air valve and an air compressor connecting pipe, and the ejector is mainly used for forming an evacuation effect on the low-pressure fluid inlet in the process of injecting gas from the high-pressure fluid inlet and discharging the gas from the fluid outlet, so that the interior of the water cylinder is vacuumized, the volume is proportionally reduced, the internal structure is simplified, and the danger is greatly reduced. The operation process has no harmful gas and dust pollution, can conveniently and visually carry out teaching, obviously improves the learning effect, improves the teaching quality, is carried out at normal temperature, and has high safety coefficient in the operation process.

title_en: Self-locking nested deep water drilling surface conduit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nested formula deep water drilling top layer pipe of auto-lock. The self-locking nested deep water drilling surface layer guide pipe is of a basic structure consisting of a suction pile top cover, a suction pile barrel, an earth plug prevention rib plate, a lower rib plate, an outer guide pipe, a middle guide pipe, an inner guide pipe, a guide pipe plug, a hammer rod guide frame and a guide pipe fixing device. The utility model discloses combine the suction anchor technique and pile technical design auto-lock nested formula deep water drilling top layer pipe under water, can realize the batch installation of top layer pipe by the workboat, the operating efficiency is high, has obvious technique and economic advantage, and the barrel-shaped basis can greatly promote the pipe bearing capacity and effectively solve the deep water drilling and easily take place the difficult problem of shallow layer geological disasters with nested formula pipe structure pattern, especially is suitable for deep water natural gas hydrate to bore and adopts.

title_en: Interactive first-aid training system based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an interactive first aid training system based on virtual reality technique, it includes: the character model generating module, the chest compression module, the artificial respiration module, the virtual scene generating module and the action generating module capture the action information of the chest compression module and the artificial respiration module and generate corresponding virtual actions in a scene; a user management module; and a feedback module. Different scenes are generated by using a virtual reality technology, multi-environment and multi-mode emergency training is performed according to the difference of emergency modes of the different scenes, and the technology of medical staff for pre-hospital emergency is improved; in addition, the blank can be filled, a disaster scene with a hundred percent of reduction degree can be created by utilizing a virtual reality technology, even different types of wounded persons can be made, so that the experiencer can personally feel psychological and physical double sensory impressions brought by the disaster, and the tension and the crisis are increased.

title_en: Evaluation method and system based on LOGISTIC regression model
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method and system based on a Logistic regression model, and belongs to the technical field of models and evaluation. Dividing the area to be evaluated into grids with the same size; acquiring the number of first event points in the grid, and determining whether the grid is a first grid or not and whether surrounding grids are first grids or not according to the number of the first event points in the grid; the first event point corresponds to a first evaluation index; acquiring a first grid evaluation index according to the first evaluation index in the first grid; and calculating the probability of the first event in the evaluation area according to the first grid evaluation index and the Logistic regression model. The method for counting the number and the positions of the event points in the grids is used for determining the properties of each disaster grid, and regression analysis is performed according to the properties, so that the precision of a simulated regression result is improved, the weight information of each evaluation index can be calculated more accurately, and higher evaluation precision is obtained.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: Random forest based geological disaster multi-disaster comprehensive risk evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a random forest based geological disaster multi-disaster comprehensive risk evaluation method, which comprises the following steps of: (1) constructing a geological disaster risk evaluation system; (2) sample selection and risk grading of detailed investigation points based on geological disasters; (3) constructing a random forest model and training a sample; (4) model precision evaluation and index contribution degree calculation; (5) and (5) evaluating the risk of the geological disaster. The method selects the common influence factors of the multiple disaster types of the geological disaster from the multiple disaster visual angles, constructs an index system from the dimensions of danger and vulnerability, avoids subjective empowerment and subjective threshold value determination, and has good adaptability to the comprehensive geological disaster risk evaluation of the multiple disaster types. The evaluation result can reflect the actual disaster risk level of the area. The point-to-surface disaster risk evaluation and spread method provided by the invention can effectively identify the main control factor of the geological disaster risk and scientifically realize the grading and zoning of the regional geological disaster risk.

title_en: Natural disaster situation field inspection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses natural disaster situation field checking equipment which comprises a machine body, wherein an operating platform is arranged above the machine body, a drilling device and a probe for measuring soil moisture are arranged at the lower end of the machine body, the drilling device comprises a drilling motor, the drilling motor is arranged on a movable plate, and the movable plate is in sliding connection with a movable cavity in the machine body; a rotary shaft of the drilling motor is provided with a cone drill bit, and the movable plate is connected with the bottom of the movable cavity through a first telescopic rod; the probe is arranged in the probe cavity, and the bottom of the probe is connected with the bottom of the probe cavity through a second telescopic rod; the probe is electrically connected with a soil moisture tester; the first telescopic link, the second telescopic link, the drilling motor and the soil moisture tester are all electrically connected with the processor. This scheme is used for the moisture detection of natural disasters area soil, and the probe fully contacts with the earth of hole bottom, measures soil moisture. The soil water content condition of the area is directly reflected, a material is provided for drought disaster analysis, and the measurement is accurate.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER ENGINEERING CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Virtual reality-based molten metal operation accident rehearsing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a virtual reality-based molten metal operation accident rehearsal method and a virtual reality-based molten metal operation accident rehearsal system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a virtual scene of molten metal operation based on actual environment information of the molten metal production operation; and setting hidden danger identifications in the constructed virtual scene, and outputting an accident disaster scene according to preset working parameters of the type input by a user at the corresponding hidden danger identifications for the user to observe and perceive. Based on the virtual reality technology, the invention not only can enable the user to roam in the virtual scene to realize immersive virtual interaction, but also can identify accident hidden dangers aiming at typical four types of accidents, and previews the accident scenes with different grades and consequences caused by different hidden dangers according to different input parameters of the user, thereby improving the production safety consciousness level of the user.

title_en: Power distribution network fault assessment and scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating and scheduling power distribution network faults, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing and obtaining a city digital distribution network topological map based on a geographic information system and distribution network construction information; positioning fault point distribution information based on distribution network terminal monitoring data and marketing data; planning a routing inspection path; the unmanned aerial vehicle group shoots images of the routing inspection path and fault points; inputting the shot image into a pre-trained convolutional neural network, and evaluating the disaster situation and the traffic situation to obtain an evaluation result; constructing and obtaining an optimal scheduling model according to a preset strategy; solving the optimal scheduling model by using a simulated annealing algorithm to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme; and implementing scheduling according to the optimal scheduling scheme. The method and the system can quickly locate the fault point and evaluate the disaster situation after the extreme meteorological event occurs, and provide an optimal emergency repair scheduling scheme and an emergency repair progress monitoring function.

title_en: Video monitoring-oriented end-to-end geological disaster automatic identification method, system and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and disaster reduction, and discloses a video monitoring-oriented end-to-end geological disaster automatic identification method, a system and application, wherein a video is input into an H-C3D network to extract features, a 4096-dimensional 3D feature is extracted from each 16 frames, and the features are combined into 32 x 4096-dimensional features according to a time sequence; classifying videos in a weak supervision mode, wherein geological disaster videos are classified into one type, and non-geological disaster videos are classified into one type; building and training a geological disaster classification recognition network R-Net to obtain a training model; judging the early warning level of the geological disaster by converting the characteristics into abnormal scores; extracting 3D features from the video through an H-C3D network, combining the features into 32 x 4096 dimensions according to a time sequence, sending the combined features into a trained R-Net network, and acquiring abnormal scores in real time along with video frames; and dividing the abnormal score into five intervals to obtain the early warning level of the geological disaster. The invention realizes the automatic judgment of the early warning level of the geological disaster.

title_en: Gas extraction and filling collaborative mining method for coal and gas outburst coal seam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mining production equipment, in particular to a coal and gas outburst coal seam gas extraction and filling collaborative mining method, which comprises the following steps: according to the geological conditions of the coal seam and the specifications of industrial standards, the construction of extraction projects above the mined coal seam can be selected, and the construction of extraction projects below the mined coal seam can also be selected; the method can utilize the coal seam gas extraction and filling mining to work cooperatively, reduce the cost of coal and gas outburst coal seam mining, can utilize the drill hole to realize the implementation of gas extraction engineering and filling mining engineering, does not need respective special construction, improves the efficiency of coal mining, particularly for some small and medium-sized enterprises, solves the problem of overlarge investment cost in the early stage of resource mining, reduces the risk of gas disasters, protects the action of surface ecological environment, can save the investment cost of well and roadway engineering, improves the production efficiency of the enterprises, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Data deep fusion image segmentation method for multispectral rescue robot
