abstract_en: The invention provides a data deep fusion image segmentation method for a multispectral rescue robot, which aims to further improve the accuracy of semantic segmentation of images of the rescue robot, improve the accuracy of investigation and analysis of the rescue robot in a disaster scene, and can break away from manual command and control to perform autonomous detection work. The method comprises the following steps: generating a target segmentation training data set; constructing a U-shaped network for identifying single-spectrum single-target image segmentation; establishing an evidence theory-Bayesian two-stage decision fusion model aiming at image semantic segmentation; training to obtain a semantic segmentation model for multi-spectrum data fusion. According to the invention, the evidence theory-Bayesian two-stage decision fusion model aiming at image semantic segmentation is utilized, so that the accuracy, recall rate, accuracy and the like are obviously improved, the robot can autonomously check disaster sites in a complex disaster relief environment, the detection accuracy and efficiency are improved, the labor cost is reduced, the disaster relief time is shortened, and the casualties are reduced.

title_en: Fruit tree age identification method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for identifying the ages of fruit trees, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a resolution satellite image in a key fertility period of the past year according to a climatic feature library, and constructing a resolution normalized vegetation index (NDVI) time sequence image in the key fertility period, wherein the climatic feature library is constructed according to ground feature vector training set data and a multi-temporal high-resolution NDVI time sequence image; cutting the resolution NDVI time sequence image in the key growth period according to the orchard area vector to obtain an orchard area vector of the past year; extracting the vector of the annual orchard area by adopting an unsupervised classification method according to the weather feature library to obtain a binary image of the annual orchard area; and performing a reverse time sequence pixel-by-pixel accumulation algorithm to obtain the orchard tree age. The embodiment of the invention avoids the short plates which cannot consider natural disasters and growth characteristics of fruit trees in the historical period in the single-year image tree age classification, and improves the accuracy and efficiency of tree age monitoring.

title_en: Method for calculating stability of power transmission line landslide mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the stability of a power transmission line landslide body, which comprises the steps of adopting laser to scan a power transmission line area in a three-dimensional manner, obtaining point cloud data of surface information of a measured landslide body and carrying out point cloud simplified filtering processing; establishing a three-dimensional geological model of the landslide body, performing numerical simulation and stability calculation on the landslide body under natural and rainstorm working conditions, calculating a safety coefficient by using an intensity reduction method, obtaining various cloud pictures and curve graphs of stress, strain, displacement and the like according to the safety coefficient of the landslide body, and comprehensively evaluating the state of the single landslide in a line area. According to the method, the safety stability of the single landslide in the line area is evaluated by selecting the average value of the stability coefficient calculated by the landslide body section by combining laser scanning point cloud data and finite element analysis, and the judgment result can be used as a reference basis for line disaster safety prevention and control, so that more powerful technical support is provided for the design and construction of a later power transmission line channel.
assignees: STATE GRID GENERAL AVIATION CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster comprehensive risk dynamic assessment method based on multi-dimensional set information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive risk dynamic evaluation method based on multi-dimensional set information mountain torrent disasters, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, mountain torrent risk assessment based on corrected disaster rainfall; step 2, mountain torrent risk assessment based on water level-flow; step 3, mountain torrent risk assessment based on submergence range, flow velocity and water depth; step 4, determining the risk level of the torrential flood; step 5, dynamically evaluating the risk of torrential flood; and 6, carrying out uncertainty analysis on the mountain torrent risk assessment result. The invention provides a comprehensive risk dynamic assessment method for mountain torrent disasters based on multi-dimensional set information, which is suitable for the mountain torrent risk refined assessment of data-free areas, is more scientific and reliable in assessment index, and provides a more effective decision basis for mountain torrent disaster defense by performing dynamic assessment on the mountain torrent risk based on real-time monitoring data or simulated forecast data of a model.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Test device for simulating gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test device for simulating gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disasters, which comprises a simulation system, a gas migration system and a monitoring and analyzing system, wherein the simulation system is used for simulating a working surface, a roadway and a ventilation system, the gas migration system is used for injecting gas into the simulation working surface, and after the gas migration system reaches a certain gas concentration, the ventilation system is opened and adjusted, so that a simulation pipeline is in different ventilation air flows in different time periods; and then the monitoring and analyzing system can detect the gas concentration and temperature change conditions of each area of the simulated working face in real time under the condition of different ventilation air flow rates, and the distribution change conditions of the area where the gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disasters are easy to occur of the whole simulated working face can be fitted according to the change conditions of the area where the gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disasters are easy to occur under different air flow rates because the gas concentration and the temperature required by the area where the gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disasters are easy to occur are known. Finally, the distribution change condition can provide data support for preventing coal mines from generating gas and coal spontaneous combustion symbiotic disasters.

title_en: Fire safety experience device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire control safety experiences device, including the house model, the house model sets up in the platform of erectting, is provided with and prepares the room, prepares the room and is provided with first emergency exit, and first emergency exit is provided with smoke passage, and the end in the smoke passage is provided with the second emergency exit, and the second emergency exit is provided with the room of catching fire, and the balcony is provided with the companion ladder. Experience personnel can carry out appropriate preparation and test firstly, and enter the first safety door to form a smoke channel, the smoke channel simulates smoke generated along with open fire when a fire disaster occurs, so that the experience personnel can feel the simulation effect of smoke turning around when the fire disaster occurs.
assignees: ANHUI NEWT FIRE EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Rescue/Evacuation Self-Testing System for Traction Elevators
abstract_en: A monitoring system for controlling self-testing of a traction elevator includes a self-testing process module in communication with a three-phase AC back-up battery power supply. The self-testing process module includes a processor configured to initiate and control a series of steps for performing measurements of the three-phase AC back-up battery power supply, including measurements of the battery supply during a simulated emergency situation (“rescue/evacuation”). The processor is programmed to initiate testing on a defined schedule and transmit test results to a maintenance system (including remotely-located systems) on a routine basis. The monitoring system also includes a display unit providing visual information regarding the status of self-testing processes and their results and a communications unit for transmitting test results to a remote maintenance controller.
assignees: REYONOLDS & REYNOLDS ELECTRONICS INC;REYNOLDS & REYNOLDS ELECTRONICS INC

title_en: Coal seam floor disaster simulation device and method
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present specification provide a coal seam floor disaster simulation device and method, including: a simulation box and a control mechanism; the simulation box is used for bearing the test main body, and one side of the simulation box is provided with an observation window; the control mechanism is arranged on one side, opposite to the observation window, of the simulation box and used for controlling the test main body. One or more embodiments of the present disclosure simulate the geological structure mainly encountered in the existing coal mining through different test subjects, simulate the coal mining through a control mechanism, and observe the simulated geological change through an observation window. The whole device has the advantages of simple structure and easy observation, can intuitively and vividly simulate the mechanism of water inrush disaster of the bottom plate in the coal seam mining process, can accurately predict and early warn disasters according to simulation, and is beneficial to rescue and repair after disasters.

title_en: Software fault injection method based on historical defect data mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a software fault injection method based on historical defect data mining, which comprises the following steps: A. querying entity element records of the software; B. inquiring defect data; establishing and storing an incidence relation between the defect and the injection fault type; C. initializing hidden Markov model parameters; training a model by using data to obtain a model with optimal parameters; D. acquiring entity elements contained in software change content; E. substituting the optimal parameter model and the entity elements into a Viterbi algorithm to calculate an optimal possible result; F. and outputting the injection fault type and the associated defect data, and designing a fault injection strategy. The design of the fault injection strategy is driven by the mining and analysis of objective data, testers are guided to inject the defects which most possibly cause the software system to have robustness, fault tolerance, disaster tolerance and high service availability faults into a specific software module, the working efficiency of fault injection is improved, and the working result has higher accuracy and reliability.

title_en: System and method for measuring drilling track while drilling under coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground drilling track measurement system while drilling, which comprises drilling track acquisition equipment for acquiring drilling track parameters and drilling track processing equipment in communication connection with the drilling track acquisition equipment; the drilling track processing equipment is used for receiving the drilling track parameters sent by the drilling track acquisition equipment in real time to form a drilling track curve. A method for measuring a drilling track while drilling in an underground coal mine comprises the following steps: s1, collecting an optical signal output by a fiber bragg grating representing a track parameter by using drilling track collection equipment; s2, the drilling track processing equipment receives the optical signals and converts the optical signals into digital electric signals, and the drilling track processing equipment identifies track parameters and fits the track parameters to form a drilling track curve. The method can measure the construction pore-forming track of the drilling machine in real time while drilling, has simple operation process and accurate and reliable measurement data, is beneficial to improving the pore-forming quality of the drilled hole and improving the mine disaster prevention and control capability level.

title_en: One-hole dual-purpose technology capable of meeting underground pressure relief and hydrogen sulfide treatment requirements
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal production, in particular to a one-hole dual-purpose technology capable of meeting requirements of underground pressure relief and hydrogen sulfide treatment, which comprises a transportation crossheading, a return air crossheading and a measure groove, wherein the return air crossheading is arranged below the transportation crossheading, the transportation crossheading and the return air crossheading are connected through the measure groove, a drill hole is arranged between the transportation crossheading and the return air crossheading, a PVC pipeline is arranged on the inner side of the drill hole, the top end of the return air crossheading is communicated with the PVC pipeline, the outer side of the PVC pipeline is wrapped with a first wrapping layer and a second wrapping layer, a large-diameter drill hole is drilled in a coal seam, hydrogen sulfide adsorption liquid is injected at high pressure, hydrogen sulfide in the coal seam is neutralized, the coal seam is softened, an anti-impact effect is achieved, the large-diameter drill hole has a pressure relief effect, and the two large-diameter drill hole can achieve two effects of pressure relief and, the comprehensive treatment of the disaster is realized, and the cost for treating the disaster is greatly saved.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHENGTONG COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Liquefied petroleum gas bottle sealing failure leakage explosion test system and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquefied petroleum gas cylinder sealing failure leakage explosion test system and a test method, wherein a movable gas cylinder and an ignition device are arranged in a test room, propane gas is loaded in the movable gas cylinder, so that the explosion condition of a natural gas cylinder can be simulated in the whole test room, and meanwhile, in order to monitor the influence generated by explosion, a thermal radiometer, a gas concentration meter and a pressure sensor are arranged in the test room, so that the heat generated at the moment of explosion, the concentration and the pressure of the gas can be monitored; the device simulates the process that the stored medium in the gas cylinder leaks due to the failure of the valve and is exploded after encountering open fire through the electromagnetic valve, forms a mobile gas cylinder disaster-causing physical simulation test and consequence evaluation method, and can provide technical support and tools for mobile gas cylinder risk evaluation and accident investigation; the bolometer, the gas concentration meter and the pressure sensor are simultaneously connected with a data acquisition system outside a test room, so that data can be collected in real time, and detailed and reliable data support is provided for computer simulation and theoretical analysis.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CNPC TUBULAR GOODS RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Gas cooperative control method in pressure relief gas extraction process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas cooperative control method in a pressure relief gas extraction process, which comprises the following steps: firstly, determining a coal bed gas basic parameter and a coal bed spontaneous combustion characteristic parameter by measuring field collected data, a laboratory gas basic parameter and a coal bed spontaneous combustion oxidation performance parameter; secondly, determining spontaneous combustion oxidation mechanisms of the drill holes under different conditions, positions and environmental characteristics of CO generation and occurrence and development rules of the spontaneous combustion oxidation mechanisms; thirdly, according to the temperature, CO and CH measured by the goaf of the working face 4 And O 2 And C 2 H 4 And performing regression analysis to obtain a regression equation, qualitatively and quantitatively analyzing the distribution range of the spontaneous combustion oxidation zone of the residual coal in the working face goaf and the distribution range of the gas concentration zone III according to the mathematical treatment of the regression equation, and determining the area range of the gas and spontaneous combustion composite disaster in the working face goaf under the condition of pressure relief gas extraction of the protected layer. Without affecting the tileThe occurrence of spontaneous combustion disaster accidents of coal around different pressure relief gas extraction drill holes is prevented and controlled on the premise of gas extraction effect, the safe production of a mine is ensured, and the accident rate of the safe production is greatly reduced.

title_en: Indoor crowd evacuation automatic guiding simulation method and system based on RNN
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor crowd evacuation automatic guidance simulation method and system based on RNN, wherein the method comprises the steps of using a differential algorithm to reduce evacuation time as an optimization criterion, optimizing RNN network parameters, and establishing a relation among a real-time evacuation state, a guidance strategy and crowd evacuation time; in the evacuation process, the guidance probability among all navigation points at the current moment is obtained by acquiring crowd distribution density information of all areas in the evacuation process as the input of an RNN (RNN network) and the intermediate state of the network at the moment of front lambda, so that a temporary moving target at the next moment is created for pedestrians at the current moment by utilizing a pseudo-random selection strategy based on roulette, and further, the pedestrian evacuation movement is guided, so that the purpose of reducing crowd evacuation time is achieved; the method starts from congestion which is one of key factors affecting evacuation efficiency, utilizes the RNN to establish a mapping relation between the evacuation crowd distribution probability and the evacuation strategy, can effectively provide effective evacuation assistance for pedestrians unfamiliar with scenes and incapable of acquiring complete evacuation information, and realizes scientific guidance on the safety evacuation plan of crowd in emergency.

title_en: Emergency drilling system
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency exercise system which comprises a user role module, a user positioning module, a target capturing module, a behavior characteristic module, a path planning module, a fire disaster simulation module and an augmented reality display module, wherein the user role module is used for providing at least two role types for users to select, the user positioning module is used for connecting rescue users selecting rescue roles and obtaining positioning information, the target capturing module is used for obtaining the positioning information of the trapped roles and storing a positioning behavior track, the behavior characteristic module is used for obtaining attribute characteristics and behavior characteristics of the trapped roles according to the behavior track, the fire disaster simulation module is used for receiving alarm signals and position information of a fire disaster alarm, obtaining building structure information according to the position information and generating fire disaster simulation data, the path planning module is used for generating path planning data, and the augmented reality display module is used for displaying path planning.

title_en: Construction and application of summer corn lodging type characteristic evaluation model based on growth period days
abstract_en: The invention discloses construction and application of a summer corn lodging type characteristic evaluation model based on the number of days in a growing period, and aims to solve the technical problem that lodging types and proportion thereof which are easy to occur in different growing periods are lack in the prior art. The invention constructs a preliminary lodging type characteristic curve by using lodging disaster local variety regional test data, and respectively establishes a segmented fitting model before and after the male withdrawal period and a comprehensive curve model covering the main development period. The average simulation errors of the piecewise fitting model and the comprehensive curve model are 11.9% and 11.1%. The invention is a foundation for developing lodging disaster research, and provides theoretical support for developing lodging disaster damage assessment, guiding agricultural production decision, making agricultural insurance claim settlement index and the like.

title_en: Power grid geographic information system fusing multi-source information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid geographic information system fusing multi-source information, which comprises a tile map layer, and a power grid information layer, a clean energy information layer, an external environment information layer and a virtual reality information layer which are respectively associated with the tile map layer through geographic positions. The method takes the geographic position as a core, and associates multi-source information such as power grid information, clean energy information, external environment information, virtual reality information and the like through the geographic position, so that various information such as towers, meteorological disasters, clean energy, three-dimensional models of power plants, three-dimensional models of transformer substations and the like are effectively projected onto a power grid map, the scaling operation of a multi-source information layer on the power grid map is supported, and power grid regulation and control personnel are helped to perform whole-network analysis and overall monitoring on power grid risks.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood disaster emergency early warning processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency early warning processing method and system for urban flood disasters, which relate to the technical field of flood control and disaster prevention, and the method comprises the following steps: s1: arranging a rainwater sensor and a water accumulation sensor, and collecting real-time rainfall and water accumulation data of each area; s2: acquiring urban drainage capacity to form dynamic drainage data; s3: establishing a mathematical model to obtain the ratio of rainfall capacity to drainage capacity of each region; s4: judging whether the ratio of the rainwater amount to the drainage capacity is greater than a preset threshold value or not; if so, shunting; otherwise, executing S3; s5: if the current is still larger than the preset threshold value after the current is shunted, an alarm is sent out; otherwise, no alarm is given; s6 simulates a city flood control situation. According to the visualized and intelligent emergency early warning processing method and system for the urban flood disasters, the drainage capacity of an urban pipe network is monitored and evaluated in real time by adopting the mathematical model, and the easily accumulated water area is monitored and shunted in real time, so that the drainage capacity of the urban area is integrally improved, early warning can be timely carried out, and the urban flood damage is effectively reduced.

title_en: SVC-based method and system for automatically generating qualitative graph in earthquake disaster risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for automatically generating a qualitative graph in earthquake disaster risk assessment based on SVC, which comprises the following steps of mapping: s1: first imaging data is acquired based on the system. S2: and normalizing the first imaging data to obtain second imaging data. S3: and constructing matrix points by using the second imaging data to obtain third imaging data. S4: and taking the second imaging data as a training sample, and training the third imaging data to obtain fourth imaging data. S5: the grid is constructed with the fourth imaging data. S6: and carrying out grid vectorization to generate a vector distribution map. The steps are integrated in a programming mode, and an automatic mapping function module in the system is formed. The invention also provides a system for automatically generating the qualitative map in the earthquake disaster risk assessment based on the SVC, and the method is adopted to automatically generate the qualitative map in the earthquake disaster risk assessment so as to assess the earthquake disaster risk. The method of the invention can carry out more reasonable classification on qualitative discrete points, rather than simply carrying out classification by interpolation by using specific numerical values. The mapping process can correct defects of interpolation classification and provide accurate evaluation maps for engineers and other professionals. In addition, the mapping method does not use manual drawing any more, thereby improving the mapping efficiency and precision and reducing the labor cost.

title_en: Claw-shaped leaf splitting device for hail disaster simulation test of corn
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a claw type leaf splitting device for a corn hail disaster simulation test, which belongs to the technical field of simulation experiment devices, and comprises a supporting plate, wherein the left wall of the supporting plate is provided with a claw knife, the top wall of the supporting plate is hinged with a hinged plate, the left end of the hinged plate is fixedly provided with a movable plate, the front wall of the movable plate is provided with a corn leaf containing tank, the right end of the hinged plate is fixedly provided with a rope ring, the outer wall of the rope ring is provided with a connecting rope, the bottom wall of the supporting plate is hinged with a movable rod, the hinged part of the supporting plate and the movable rod is provided with a fastening nut, the left outer wall and the right outer wall of the movable rod are respectively and fixedly provided with a push rod and a baffle, one end of the connecting rope penetrates through the top wall of the baffle, the bottom end of the connecting rope is provided with a pull ring, the influence of the hail disaster on the damage of the corn leaves in different periods on the growth period and the yield of the corn can be simulated and detected.
assignees: INST OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES NO 4 DIVISIONS OF XINJIANG PRODUCTION & CONSTRUCTION CORPS

title_en: Wood split block for children intelligence development
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a children are benefited intelligence and are pieced together with wooden piece, including operation layer and carton, the inside arrangement of operation layer has the digit to change the piece, and is connected with the symbol between the digit changes the piece, the digit changes the piece and is connected through the fixed axle between the piece with the symbol, settle the below of operation layer has the carton, and the front side of carton is fixed with the exit slot, the pen stand is installed to the below of carton, and the top that the pen held in the palm has placed the pen, the below of carton is fixed with the gyro wheel, the stock form has been placed to the inside of carton, changes the total 10 cross sections of piece, is Arabic numeral 0-9 respectively, and the total 4 cross sections of symbol commentaries on classics piece are the addition and subtraction to ride out the symbol respectively. The digital rotating blocks arranged on the wood splicing blocks for the children intelligence development can rotate at will, so that the numbers which rotate to the upper surface at will or the addition, subtraction, multiplication and division symbol rotating blocks can be subjected to arithmetic calculation, the addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of any numbers can be combined at random, and the emergency response capability and the calculation capability of children are exercised.

title_en: Self-learning disaster-avoidance and recovery
abstract_en: A machine-learning mechanism of a disaster-avoidance system trains a knowledgebase to associate characteristics of a data-center component with corresponding degrees of vulnerability to failure and with remedial steps that may be undertaken to avoid failure or to reduce adverse effects of a failure. This training is performed as a function of inferences derived from historical records and from extrinsic information sources. The historical records identify past failures of similar components, component characteristics associated with past failures, and results of remedial procedures undertaken in response to past failures or to previous occurrences of the characteristics. The extrinsic sources identify the current existence of external conditions known to be associated with past failures. When a component's total degree of vulnerability exceeds a predefined threshold value, the system assembles a subset of that component's remedial steps into a remedial procedure and directs downstream modules or administrators to implement the procedure.

title_en: Platform system for joint training of command and control using augmented reality based on 5G network
title_ko: 5g 네트워크 기반 증강현실을 이용한 통합 지휘통제 플랫폼 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated command and control platform system to construct a military training system without spatiotemporal restrictions. According to the present invention, the integrated command and control platform system comprises: a multiple integrated laser engagement system (MILES) equipment worn on each combatant; a wireless image transmission device worn on each combatant to transmit a captured image in real time through a wireless network; a combatant terminal worn on each combatant to perform communications through the wireless network and display information related to a combat operation; a drone observing and capturing a combat operation site in the air; an augmented reality (AR) display device worn on the head of each commander; a commander terminal held by each commander and performing communications through the wireless network; a MILES server checking combat operation information and status information of each combatant based on data received from each MILES equipment; a topology management server analyzing the image captured by the drone to generate three-dimensional topology of the combat operation site, generating related texture and making and providing a common operation situation map based on the generated data; an image server transmitting / receiving a streaming image to / from each wireless image transmission device; and a central server communicating with the MILES server, the topology management server, and the image server, integrally collecting the common operation situation map, a drone observation image, the image captured by the wireless image transmission device of each combatant, and the information related to the combat operation including the location and status information of each combatant, and combat site situation information, which are received through the servers, and providing the collected information to the AR display device and the commander terminal of each commander.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통합 지휘통제 플랫폼 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 각 전투원에게 착용되어 있는 마일즈 장비; 각 전투원에게 착용되어, 촬영된 영상을 무선 네트워크를 통해 실시간으로 송출하기 위한 무선 영상 전송 장치; 각 전투원에게 착용되어, 무선 네트워크를 통해 통신하며, 전투 작전 관련 정보를 디스플레이하기 위한 전투원 단말; 상공에서 전투 작전 현장을 조망하여 촬영하기 위한 드론; 각 지휘관의 두부에 착용되어, 증강현실을 디스플레이하기 위한 증강현실 디스플레이 장치; 각 지휘관이 소지하고, 무선 네트워크를 통해 통신하는 지휘관 단말; 각 마일즈 장비로부터 수신한 데이터를 기반으로 각 전투원의 전투 작전 정보와 상태 정보를 체크하는 마일즈 서버; 상기 드론에서 촬영된 영상을 분석하여 전투 작전 현장의 3차원 지형을 생성하고, 관련 텍스처를 생성하고, 이를 기반으로 공통 작전 상황도를 제작하여 제공하는 지형관리 서버; 각 무선 영상 전송 장치와 스트리밍 영상을 송수신하기 위한 영상 서버; 및 상기 마일즈 서버, 상기 지형관리 서버, 상기 영상 서버와 통신하며, 이를 통해 수신한 공통 작전 상황도, 드론 조망 영상, 각 전투원의 무선 영상 전송 장치에서 촬영된 영상, 각 전투원의 위치 정보, 각 전투원의 상태 정보, 전장 상황 정보를 포함하는 전투 작전 관련 정보를 통합하여 수집하고, 이를 각 지휘관의 증강현실 디스플레이 장치 및 지휘관 단말에 제공하는 중앙 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Mine water disaster treatment device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mine water disaster treatment, in particular to a mine water disaster treatment device and a method, wherein the outer side of a grouting pipe is provided with a plugging mechanism, the plugging mechanism comprises an annular mounting seat, the outer side of the mounting seat is provided with a cylindrical elastic rubber ring, a perfusion cavity is arranged between the mounting seat and the elastic rubber ring, a liquid injection pipe and a liquid outlet pipe which are communicated with the perfusion cavity are fixedly arranged on the mounting seat, valves are respectively arranged on the liquid injection pipe and the liquid outlet pipe, the liquid injection pipe is connected with a wax injection mechanism, and a heating mechanism and a cooling mechanism are arranged in the perfusion cavity; the wax injection mechanism is used for injecting wax into the injection cavity to expand the elastic rubber ring, and the liquid wax is quickly solidified and hardened through the cooling pipe, so that the inner wall of the elastic rubber ring is better supported; after the grouting liquid is solidified, the solidified wax in the pouring cavity is reheated and melted by the heating mechanism, and the melted liquid wax in the pouring cavity is pumped out by the wax pouring mechanism to enable the elastic rubber ring to retract, so that the plugging mechanism can be conveniently taken out from the drilled hole of the mine.

title_en: Hurricane intensity change prediction method based on data mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hurricane intensity change prediction method based on a data mining model, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: acquiring hurricane meteorological data and preprocessing the hurricane meteorological data; step two: finding a suitable classification algorithm and exploring the possibilities of RI-type hurricane classification; step three: putting the data test set into a hurricane intensity prediction model for integrated training; step four: selecting an optimal hurricane intensity prediction model from the ensemble learning according to an evaluation index system; step five: the hurricane wind power classification prediction experiment is carried out 6 hours, 12 hours and 18 hours in the future of the hurricane; the invention establishes a hurricane intensity model with better performance and less complexity and capable of basically and accurately predicting by utilizing a data mining and integrated learning method on a Weka platform, does not depend on meteorology and dynamics knowledge, does not care about a hurricane physical model and a prediction model of formation reasons, ensures the time for timely early warning and planning a disaster relief scheme, enables people to know the arrival of a hurricane in advance, well prepares for prevention and reduces economic loss.

title_en: Chemical disaster accident real-time intervention simulation method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a real-time intervention simulation method and system for chemical disaster accidents, which comprises the steps of pre-burying a disaster, selecting a disaster source location and configuring disaster source parameters; adopting an object-oriented technology to create a disaster accident object; establishing a mechanism model library, wherein mechanism models corresponding to all disaster accident types are stored in the mechanism model library; creating a rendering thread and a triggering thread which are directly controlled by a main program; a thread pool is created that includes computing threads assigned to different disaster incident type objects. The method solves the problems that in the prior art, necessary computing architecture is lacked for large-scale scientific simulation computing required to be presented among disaster fields, disaster causes and ubiquitous structures, and distributed deployment and accelerated computing capability support are weak.
assignees: SUZHOU QIMING KESHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating residual bearing capacity of concrete T-shaped beam by considering influence of fire cracks
abstract_en: A method for calculating residual bearing capacity of a concrete T-shaped beam by considering influence of fire cracks relates to the technical field of methods for calculating bearing capacity of buildings after fire, and comprises the following steps: step 1, calculating the depth and width of a fire crack; step 2, according to the calculation results of the depth and the width of the fire cracks, carrying out simulation calculation on the temperature field of the section of the concrete T-shaped beam with the cracks; and 3, according to the temperature field of the section of the concrete T-shaped beam with the crack, comprehensively influencing factors, calculating the residual bearing capacity of the T-shaped beam after fire disaster, and obtaining a residual bearing capacity prediction simplified formula. The invention discloses a method for calculating residual bearing capacity of a concrete T-shaped beam with cracks after fire disaster, which comprehensively considers the influence of high temperature and cracks on the residual bearing capacity, obtains a simplified calculation formula of the residual bearing capacity of the concrete T-shaped beam after fire disaster considering the influence of cracks, and effectively improves the calculation precision of the residual bearing capacity.

title_en: Emergency aid decision-making system and method applied to petrochemical industry
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency aid decision-making system and method applied to petrochemical industry. According to the invention, an accident simulation result is calculated through a field real-time data environment and an analysis model, and the disaster model comprises combustion simulation, gas leakage simulation and explosion simulation. The invention can provide auxiliary decision-making information for field emergency command for commanders, and help decision-makers to make the most appropriate emergency plan in the shortest time, thereby reducing casualty rate of accident personnel. Meanwhile, decision-making personnel can know various accidents in the actual working process of the petrochemical industry more comprehensively and more specifically.

title_en: Test system for simulating landslide and debris flow disaster chain overall process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test system for simulating the whole process of a landslide and debris flow disaster chain, which comprises a landslide and landslide source area, a landslide accumulation area, a debris flow flowing area and a dust cover, wherein the landslide and landslide source area comprises a landslide simulation platform, a monitoring platform and a viewing platform; the landslide accumulation area is arranged close to the landslide source area, is formed by an underground excavation space structure and is used for bearing a simulated landslide accumulation body; the debris flow flowing area is designed in an L shape, is connected with the landslide accumulation area on the left side, and is connected with the landslide source area and the landslide accumulation area on the upper side and used for simulating the flow of debris flow; and the tail end of the left side of the debris flow flowing area is provided with a reverse L-shaped circulating water filtering and pumping system, and the circulating water filtering and pumping system and the debris flow flowing area form a closed loop for simulating the cyclic utilization of water. The system can simulate the whole process of the large-scale landslide and debris flow disasters, so that the evolution process, the damage mode and the disaster causing mechanism of landslide and debris flow disasters are researched.

title_en: Fire simulation test bed for small-size tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-size tunnel fire simulation test bed which is simple in structure, convenient to install, simple to operate, low in cost, safe, reliable, low in environmental pollution, high in simulation degree of fire scenes of a real tunnel, capable of researching combustion behaviors, smoke behaviors and the like of fire in the tunnel and strong in applicability; inside ceramic fibre PLASTIC LAMINATED fireproof material that adds of tunnel main part, the preceding curb plate is fire prevention glass, in the sealed embedding glass frame, can manually open, is equivalent to the hand door, and the exhaust port of roof links to each other with the fan, is equipped with the track on the bottom plate, places the dolly that can move on the track above that, and the dolly middle part is equipped with the simulation fire disaster, can observe different positions conflagration condition, and this makes the research to tunnel conflagration flue gas control and temperature distribution law more convenient, safety.

title_en: Pore-forming method for horizontal diversion hole of ionic rare earth ore
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pore-forming method of an ionic rare earth ore horizontal diversion hole, aiming at the problems of hole collapse blockage, unsmooth liquid collection and possible potential landslide existing in the horizontal diversion hole in the existing ionic rare earth ore in-situ leaching exploitation process, the invention adopts the improvement of the structure of the horizontal diversion hole in the drilling process to solve the problems, and the specific pore-forming steps comprise: preparing a drilling platform and drilling equipment; a self-discharging drill bit is adopted to drill and pull the porous diversion blind pipe into the horizontal diversion hole, so that the hole wall is effectively supported; the self-discharging drill bit, the traction ring and the multi-hole diversion blind pipe are kept in the hole, and the drill rod is withdrawn; and (4) placing a drainage tube in the blind tube of the orifice to plug the orifice. The method is suitable for the ionic rare earth mine with the easily collapsed and blocked horizontal diversion holes, and is beneficial to improving the liquid collection efficiency of the horizontal diversion holes, reducing the water level of the shallow groundwater of the mountain and reducing geological disasters caused by overhigh water content of local rock and soil.

title_en: Multi-layer gradually-enhanced ground disaster knowledge graph and automatic completion method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-layer gradually enhanced ground disaster knowledge graph and an automatic completion method thereof, which comprises the steps of extracting ground disaster scene elements based on fusion enhancement of multi-sensor observation data, wherein a sensor is used for obtaining a scene element information base with rich space-time information and generating a scene multi-element group graph model with entity nodes and relational connection; the method relates to knowledge representation learning for constructing relationship weight constraint by using a spectrum clustering algorithm thought of a graph convolution neural network, and a knowledge representation learning algorithm for training weighted clustering by using a large number of multi-element graph models is used for completing a knowledge graph, and relates to gradual automatic completion of a ground disaster knowledge graph facing to the problem of missing. The beneficial effects are that: the map model is combined with the map calculation, the structure of data in the ground disaster scene and the knowledge mining are researched, the automatic completion of the ground disaster knowledge map is realized, and the support can be provided for the subsequent analysis of the application knowledge map.
assignees: NUCLEAR INDUSTRY HUZHOU ENGINEERING PROSPECTING INST CO LTD;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Fire condition display system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an AR device, a fire condition display system, a fire search and rescue device and method and a fire prevention exercise method, wherein the AR device comprises a positioning module, a display module and a communication module, the positioning module is used for determining the current position of the device, and the display module displays a building channel structure of a building where the current position is located and the position of the current position in the building channel structure in the AR device according to the current position; the communication module is in wireless connection with monitoring equipment of a building to obtain a plurality of sensing data, and the display module superposes the sensing data in the building channel structure according to the sensing position to display. By combining the AR technology and the 5G communication technology, the invention can master the situation of the fire scene in real time, and reasonably and timely formulate the evacuation or entry route, thereby reducing the casualties when the fire happens.
assignees: UNIV HARBIN ENG;CHINA SHIP DEV & DESIGN CT

title_en: Multi-agent evacuation simulation method and system based on leaders and panic emotions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent evacuation simulation method and system based on leaders and panic, and belongs to the technical field of crowd evacuation. The invention analyzes the attribute and the behavior influencing the evacuation of the individual and abstracts the evacuated individual into Agent. The interaction among different individuals and the interaction among the individuals and the environment are considered, the follower, the panic and the obstacle avoidance angle of the individuals in the crowd are researched, a crowd evacuation model based on multiple agents is established, the crowd evacuation process is simulated more truly, and the crowd evacuation under the emergency condition can be simulated more truly. The invention provides an improved particle swarm algorithm as an individual path selection strategy in an evacuation process. The field of view factor is considered, the evacuation scene in the building is divided into regions, the influence of limited field of view on individual path selection is researched, the global optimal individual selection strategy of the particles is optimized, and the improved particle swarm algorithm is more consistent with the actual situation of crowd evacuation in the building.

title_en: Fire alarm graphic display system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire alarm graphic display system applied to the field of fire safety, which structurally comprises a field monitoring module, a building plane simulation module, a system information module, an alarm module state and a historical information recording module; building plane simulation module carries out building plane's structure drawing according to the building structure that corresponds detection area through building drawing software, and form building plane simulation diagram, building plane simulation diagram carries out the structure setting and the data connection of one-to-one with the fire detection equipment who constitutes on-the-spot monitoring module, and realize showing the state synchronization of fire-fighting equipment, this system has promoted fire control monitoring effect and safe reaction quality, easily realize disaster information's feedback and managers's directly perceived look over, disaster positioning effect and reaction efficiency have been promoted, the region limitation of monitoring operation has been reduced simultaneously, it adjusts and controls to change to realize the overall view more easily, promote regulation quality and relief disaster, the overall arrangement rationality of route of fleing from, further reduced the disaster influence.
assignees: ZHEJIANG TAIYI FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent sponge city flood forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent sponge city flood forecasting method, which belongs to the technical field of city management and comprises the following steps: constructing a plane calculation grid of a research area; determining the time interval of continuous calculation of the hydrodynamic time interval of the hydrology among grids; extracting high-spatial resolution grid elevation and land utilization/coverage information; assigning values to grid precipitation time course data; assigning the grid yield convergence parameter; the grid elevation, land utilization/coverage information, precipitation and yield confluence parameters are used as a model operation database, a hydrologic hydrodynamic theory is integrated, and a hydrologic hydrodynamic model is built by the method; verifying a hydrologic hydrodynamic model; and carrying out drainage basin production confluence and flood disaster forecast based on simulation results of the hydrologic dynamic model. The method can realize the real-time and rapid forecasting of rain and water conditions, the real-time and rapid forecasting of urban flood, intelligent regulation and control of a water system and fine management, so that the urban flood can be treated rapidly and intelligently and flexibly.

title_en: Novel experimental device for simulating debris flow evolution process under complex condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel experimental device for simulating a debris flow evolution process under a complex condition, and belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and mountain disasters. The experimental device comprises a debris flow slurry preparation device, a supporting device, a debris flow slurry containing and lifting device, a groove device and a sedimentation recovery device. The mud-rock flow slurry preparation facilities can prepare the mud-rock flow slurry of different moisture contents, and the mud-rock flow slurry holds and is used for holding and promoting the release mud-rock flow with hoisting device, and trench device can simulate the operating mode of different channel slopes, different bend angles, and the siltation recovery unit can simulate the sludging process of mud-rock flow, and the water sand separator can carry out separation recycle with water sand after the experiment finishes. The invention can complete the evolution process of the slurry of the debris flow with different water contents under the conditions of different channel gradients and different bend angles through the cooperation of all devices, and monitors and records the acquisition of parameters of the debris flow, such as impact, movement, siltation and the like through manual and automatic equipment.
assignees: KUNMING PROSPECTING DESIGN INST OF CHINA NONFERROUS METALS INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Different yardstick coal fire disaster thermodynamic process simulation testing arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulation test device for thermodynamic processes of coal fire disasters with different scales, which comprises a physical similarity simulation test bed, a transparent heat shield, a wireless ad hoc network temperature measurement system, a particle radiation monitoring stress state system and a gas monitoring system; the utility model discloses can simulate the process that collapses in collecting space area, can simulate coal field conflagration evolution process moreover, can realize the coal field conflagration of different conditions and the evolution process in mine collecting space area simultaneously, can realize the distribution of temperature field, the distribution and the development law of coal petrography crack, the real-time supervision of the change law of coal petrography crack air feed passageway to coal field conflagration and mine collecting space area evolution in-process through wireless ad hoc network temperature measurement system, particle radiation monitoring stress state system, gas monitoring system.

title_en: Ancient building lightning protection method based on risk degree identification
abstract_en: The invention provides a lightning protection method for an ancient building based on danger degree identification, and belongs to the technical field of lightning protection of the ancient building. Through utilizing the thunder and lightning electric field performance that is located far away from ancient building place region, obtain the simulation moving path of thunderstorm cloud in advance, observe the simulation moving path of thunderstorm cloud, the probability that the thunderstorm cloud got into or is close to ancient building place region to whether the dangerous degree of thunderstorm takes place in the forecast ancient building place region in advance, according to the dangerous degree grade that obtains, decide whether start ancient building lightning protection plan or carry out lightning protection preparation work in advance. Or when the lightning risk degree of the area where the ancient building is located is larger than the risk degree threshold value, the lightning is released in advance by adopting a method of artificially or actively inducing lightning, the risk of lightning stroke of the ancient building group is reduced, and dangerous accidents such as fire disasters and the like caused by the lightning stroke of the ancient building group are avoided.
assignees: NINGXIA ZHONGKE TIANJI LIGHTING PROT DETECTION CO LTD

title_en: Method for identifying thunderstorm cloud cluster in satellite cloud picture
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying a thunderstorm cloud cluster in a satellite cloud picture, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence application. The invention mainly uses the public satellite cloud picture data set of the Japanese sunflower satellite to compare with the meteorological radar chart used in the thunderstorm early warning at the present stage, and uses the neural network system to learn the characteristics of the thunderstorm cloud group in the satellite cloud picture, thereby achieving the automatic identification of the thunderstorm cloud group in the satellite cloud picture. The method can accurately identify the position and the range of the thunderstorm cloud cluster in the satellite cloud picture, and the identification process is short in application time. Meanwhile, the invention improves the convergence algorithm in the training process of the neural network system, so that the time consumed in the training process of the neural network is reduced, thereby providing effective technical support for the prediction and early warning of meteorological disasters.

title_en: Prevent multistage protector of mountain road landslide
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of natural disaster protection, and discloses a multistage protection device for preventing landslide, which comprises a road main body and a vehicle body, wherein the left side surface of the road main body is fixedly connected with a retaining wall, the right side surface of the road main body is fixedly connected with a slope, the interior of the slope is respectively and alternately provided with a first transverse plate and a second transverse plate, the lower surface of the first transverse plate is fixedly connected with a metal mesh, the other side of the metal mesh is and alternately arranged inside the second transverse plate, the other side of the metal mesh is fixedly connected with a hook, the upper surface of the vehicle body is respectively provided with a driving motor, a material box and a connecting rod, the outer surface of a screw is fixedly connected with a nut, the left side surface of the nut is fixedly connected with a drill pipe, the material box is communicated with the drill pipe through a soft rubber pipe, and the multistage protection device, not only can make soil firm, can also carry out multistage protection when the road landslide.

title_en: Portable IoT Sensor Kit for Smart Safety with Wireless Mesh and Artificial Intelligence
title_ko: 무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a configuration of a device and an artificial intelligence program related to a portable intelligent IoT sensor kit for fire prediction using wireless mesh and AI. Since the reliability of sensor data is very important for an IoT smart sensor used in a fire disaster site, it is safe to construct a wireless mesh sensor network with enhanced connectivity between sensor nodes to increase the reliability of sensor data transmission.
abstract_ko:
국가적으로 큰 문제가 되고 있는 공공 및 민간 다중이용시설 (재래시장, 상가/쇼핑몰, 병원/요양원, 위락시설-극장, 실내놀이시설 등)에서의 화재발생과 유독가스 등의 누출시 발생 할 수 있는 대량 인명손실과 천문학적인 사회적 기회비용의 손해가 빈번히 발생하고 있는데, 이러한 화재 및 가스누출사고 발생시 즉각적인 감지하고 징후를 판단하여 화재 확산의 예측이 가능하여 관련자 및 관련기관에 자동적으로 경보하고 전파하여 인명의 조기구조나 재산손실을 미연에 방지하기 위한 골든 타임을 확보 할 수 있도록 도와주는 (1) 경제적으로 보급이 가능하고  (2)구성 및 운용이 쉬우며 (3)휴대 또는 이동 하여 일반 초보자도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있는 화재 및 가스누출 등의 재난 방재와 사회안전 편익에 도움을 주는 “무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트”에 관한 장치의 구성과  인공지능 프로그램에 관한 것이다 
      화재 재난현장에서 사용되는 사물인터넷(IoT) 스마트 센서는 센서데이터의 신뢰성이 매우 중요하기 때문에 센서데이타의 전송 신뢰도를 향상하기 위하여 센서 노드간에 연결성이 강화된 무선메쉬 센서네트워크를 구성하는 것이 안전하다. 
      아래 대표도 에서 보는 바와 같이, 센서노드는 전원이 인가되는 즉시 인접한 모든 센서노드와 무선메쉬네트워크를 통하여 센서노드 자신의 기기정보와 측정값 등을 모든 센서노드 및 지능형 접속노드에 저전력으로 즉각 전달 가능한 센서네트워크을 구성한다. 
      센서네트워크가 구성되면, 센서노드는 측정한 센서데이터를 종류에 따라서 일정주기 또는 데이터 발생 즉시 다른 센서노드를 통하거나 직접 지능형 접속노드에 전송한다. 
      지능형 접속노드는 센서노드가 전달한 모든 센서데이터를 수신하여 제어부의 데이터베이스에 저장하고 백엔드시스템에 전송한다. 제어부는 데이터베이스에서 센서, 위치 및 노드 정보 데이터를 통하여 화재예측 및 발생 판단을 위한 인공지능 알고리즘을 생성 및 수정한다. 
      지능형 접속노드에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘(216) 및 백엔드시스템에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘은 시간별, 센서별, 종류별 측정 데이터를 기준으로 각 센서의 오차 및 화재 발생 여부를 판단한다. 
     만일 인공지능 알고리즘이 화재 발생 상황이 일어났다고 판단한 경우, 지능형 접속노드(200)는 제어부를 통해 자동경보프로그램에 화재경보를 전달하며 자동경보프로그램은 관리자 등 관련자, 소방서 등 관련부처, 필요한 경우 미리 등록해둔 지자체에 화재 발생 사실과 해당 지능형 접속노드의 실제 위치정보를 전파한다. 
     센서데이타에 의해 화재 감지와 분석, 예측이 가능하기 때문에 센서데이터 오류를 제거하여, 보정하고 정확한 데이터를축적하여, 최적의 예측 알고리즘을 생성하여 활용한다. 
    센서데이타의 유형과 패턴에 따라 보다 정확한 분석을 위해 충분한 데이터를 확보하기 위하여 여 센서노드의 데이터 전송주기와 센서에서 측정되는 센서데이터 수치정보를 증가하여 전송하게하므로서 보다 밀도 있는 시계열 분석이 되도록 하여, 단기간내에 모든 데이터를 수집 분석하여  정확한 시나리오를 예측하고 이에 따른 경보 수준을 판단 한다. 
화재, 가스누출 등의 재난 방재 목적 이외에, 산업현장의 위험작업장, 예를 들면 유해가스 지역의 환경정보 감지 및 알람, 유류저장소, 원전과 같은 방사능 누출 지역, 고로, 사일로 등과 같은 시설파괴시 재해가 예상되는 장소나 기관의 구조물 등에도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있으며, 사회안전을 위한 공공SCO, 예를들면 교량, 도로, SOC구조물 등에서도 사용 할 수 있다.

title_en: Simulation experiment device for external fire disaster of airplane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation experiment device for an external fire disaster of an aircraft, which comprises an experiment table main body, a fire source system and a data measurement system, wherein a cylindrical cabin of the experiment table main body is used for simulating an actual middle cabin section of the aircraft, and the upper end of a supporting frame of the experiment table main body supports the cylindrical cabin and is adjustable in height; the fire source system is used for simulating fire sources with different powers received by all areas outside the aircraft body; the data measurement system comprises a temperature distribution measurement system, a heat radiation flux measurement system and a fire plume and jet measurement system, and is used for measuring the surface temperature distribution condition of the outer part of the cylindrical cabin, the heat radiation flux change condition of different positions of the outer part of the cylindrical cabin and the flame form, fire plume and jet characteristic of the outer part of the cylindrical cabin in the experimental process. The invention can comprehensively study the temperature distribution of the external surface of the airplane, the change rule of heat radiation flux, the flame plume and the jet flow characteristics thereof when different parts of the external part of the airplane body are acted by different power fire sources in a laboratory, and has the advantages of low cost, accurate measurement and the like.

title_en: Electromagnetic wave logging-while-drilling instrument for underground coal mine
abstract_en: The invention provides an electromagnetic wave logging-while-drilling instrument for an underground coal mine, which comprises wellhead equipment and an underground measuring instrument, wherein the underground measuring instrument acquires underground data and transmits the data to the wellhead equipment through a channel; the underground measuring instrument comprises a radio electromagnetic wave transmitting unit, a space track measuring unit, a stratum parameter measuring unit, a water accumulation measuring unit, a gas accumulation measuring unit and a lithium battery unit, and the wellhead equipment comprises a radio electromagnetic wave receiving unit, a data processing instrument, a depth measuring device, a driller display and a computer. The invention can be widely applied to projects such as water disaster prevention and control water drainage directional drilling, coal and gas outburst prevention and control gas extraction directional drilling, coal seam top and bottom plate grouting reinforcement drilling, hidden disaster-causing factor exploration directional drilling and the like, can obviously improve the underground coal mine directional drilling technology and equipment level, and plays a positive role in promoting the safe and efficient production of coal mines.
assignees: FIRST EXPLORATION BUREAU CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Rotary aluminum alloy door and window
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aluminum alloy doors and windows, in particular to a rotary aluminum alloy door and window, which comprises an installation frame body, wherein one side of the installation frame body is provided with an auxiliary frame body, the installation frame body is provided with a slot matched with the auxiliary frame body, the lower end of the auxiliary frame body is rotationally connected with the installation frame body through a first hinge shaft, one side of the auxiliary frame body, which is far away from the installation frame body, is provided with a glass window frame, one side of the glass window frame is rotationally connected with the auxiliary frame body through a second hinge shaft, the other end of the glass window frame is fixedly connected with the auxiliary frame body through a window lock, the cross section of the glass window frame is L-shaped and is embedded into the auxiliary frame body, the upper end of one side; the invention can realize the normal function of the aluminum alloy door and window rotary switch, can facilitate drilling out when fire and other indoor dangerous situations occur, can create an indoor isolation safety platform, is convenient for personnel on high-rise to safely wait for rescue, and has good effect of coping with indoor disasters.

title_en: Smoke diffuser for fire drill and smoke diffusing system comprising it
title_ko: 소방 훈련용 연기 확산장치 및 이를 포함하는 연기 확산시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smoke diffusing device for fire fighting training, capable of reproducing a smoke diffusion phenomenon such as actual smoke in the upper part of a fire fighting training space, and a smoke diffusing system including the same. The smoke diffusing device for fire fighting training according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a smoke generating unit for generating smoke; a smoke mixing unit for generating mixed smoke by mixing the smoke generated by the smoke generating unit with helium gas; and a smoke discharge unit for discharging the smoke mixed in the smoke mixing unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방 훈련 공간의 상층부에 실제의 연기와 같은 연기 확산 현상을 재현할 수 있는 소방 훈련용 연기 확산장치 및 이를 포함하는 연기 확산시스템에 관한 것으로,  
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 소방 훈련용 연기 확산장치는, 
연기를 발생시키는 연기 발생부; 상기 연기 발생부에서 발생된 연기와 헬륨가스를 혼합시켜서 혼합연기를 발생시키는 연기 혼합부; 상기 연기 혼합부에서 혼합된 혼합연기를 배출시키는 연기 배출부를 포함한다.

title_en: Portable IoT Sensor Kit for Smart Safety with Wireless Mesh and Artificial Intelligence
title_ko: 무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable intelligent fire prediction IoT sensor kit using wireless mesh and AI. As soon as power is applied, a sensor node composes a sensor network which can immediately transmit device information, measurement values, or the like of a sensor node itself to all the sensor nodes and intelligent connection nodes at low power through all adjacent sensor nodes and a wireless mesh network. When the sensor network is configured, the sensor node transmits measured sensor data through another sensor node or directly transmits to the intelligent connection node at a certain period or the moment when the data occurs in accordance with types. The intelligent connection node receives all the sensor data transmitted by the sensor node, stores the sensor data in a database of the control unit, and transmits the sensor data to a backend system. The control unit generates and modifies an artificial intelligence algorithm for predicting and determining the occurrence of fire through the sensor, location, and node information data in the database. Since fire detection, analysis, and prediction are possible by the sensor data, sensor data errors are removed, corrected, and accurate data is accumulated, so that an optimal prediction algorithm is generated and utilized.

      지능형 접속노드에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘(216) 및 백엔드시스템에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘은 시간별, 센서별, 종류별 측정 데이터를 기준으로 각 센서의 오차 및 화재 발생 여부를 판단한다. 
     만일 인공지능 알고리즘이 화재 발생 상황이 일어났다고 판단한 경우, 지능형 접속노드(200)는 제어부를 통해 자동경보프로그램에 화재경보를 전달하며 자동경보프로그램은 관리자 등 관련자, 소방서 등 관련부처, 필요한 경우 미리 등록해둔 지자체에 화재 발생 사실과 해당 지능형 접속노드의 실제 위치정보를 전파한다. 
     센서데이타에 의해 화재 감지와 분석, 예측이 가능하기 때문에 센서데이터 오류를 제거하여, 보정하고 정확한 데이터를축적하여, 최적의 예측 알고리즘을 생성하여 활용한다. 
    센서데이타의 유형과 패턴에 따라 보다 정확한 분석을 위해 충분한 데이터를 확보하기 위하여 센서노드의 데이터 전송주기와 센서에서 측정되는 센서데이터 수치정보를 증가하여 전송하게하므로서 보다 밀도 있는 시계열 분석이 되도록 하여, 단기간내에 모든 데이터를 수집 분석하여  정확한 시나리오를 예측하고 이에 따른 경보 수준을 판단 한다. 
화재, 가스누출 등의 재난 방재 목적 이외에, 산업현장의 위험작업장, 예를 들면 유해가스 지역의 환경정보 감지 및 알람, 유류저장소, 원전과 같은 방사능 누출 지역, 고로, 사일로 등과 같은 시설파괴시 재해가 예상되는 장소나 기관의 구조물 등에도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있으며, 사회안전을 위한 공공SOC, 예를들면 교량, 도로, SOC구조물 등에서도 사용 할 수 있다.

title_en: simulator and simulation method for disaster management of skyscraper
title_ko: 초고층건물 재난관리용 시뮬레이터 및 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulator for disaster management of a skyscraper and a simulation method thereof. The simulator for disaster management of a skyscraper comprises: a plurality of camera modules installed at an evacuation route point where two stairs installed on different floors indoors or outdoors meet, and each generating image data by photographing an image; a central monitoring device; and an evacuation route guidance module. The central monitoring device calculates the number of people located at the corresponding evacuation route point of each floor by using the image data transmitted from the camera module. The central monitoring device determines the number of people at a first evacuation route point of a current floor related to a first preliminary evacuation door and the number of people at the first evacuation route point of the evacuation floor corresponding to the first evacuation route point of the current floor, and when the sum of the determined number of people is less than or equal to the set number of people, the first preliminary evacuation door is designated as a final evacuation door, and a plurality of evacuation guide display units related to the final evacuation door are lit and controlled. When the sum of the determined number of people exceeds the set number of people, the first evacuation route point of the evacuation floor is set as a preliminary target evacuation route point, and when there is no obstacle when moving from the current floor to the preliminary target evacuation route point, the first preliminary evacuation door is set as the final evacuation door.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 초고층건물 재난관리용 시뮬레이터 및 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것으로서, 상기 초고층건물 재난관리용 시뮬레이터는 실내 또는 실외의 서로 다른 층에 설치된 두 계단이 만나는 대피 경로 지점에 설치되어 있어 있고 영상을 촬영하여 영상 데이터를 생성하는 각각 생성하는 복수의 카메라 모듈,  중앙 감시 장치, 그리고  대피 경로 안내 모듈을 포함한다.  상기 중앙 감시 장치는 상기 카메라 모듈로부터 전송된 영상 데이터를 이용하여 각 층의 해당 대피 경로 지점에 위치하고 있는 사람의 인원수를 산출하고,  제1 예비 대피 출입문에 관련된 현재 층의 제1 대피 경로 지점의 인원수와 상기 현재 층의 제1 대피 경로 지점과 대응하는 대피 층의 제1 대피 경로 지점의 인원수를 판정하고, 판정된 두 인원수의 합이 설정 인원수 이하이면, 상기 제1 예비 대피 출입물을 최종 대피 출입문을 정하여, 상기 최종 대피 출입문에 관련된 복수의 대피안내 표시부를 점등 제어하고,   판정된 두 인원수의 합이 설정 인원수를 초과하면, 상기 대피 층의 상기 제1 대피 경로 지점을 예비 목표 대피 경로 지점으로 정하고, 상기 현재 층에서 상기 예비 목표 대피 경로 지점으로 이동시 장애물이 존재하지 않는 경우, 상기 제1 예비 대피 출입물을 최종 대피 출입문을 정한다.
assignees: KWANG INT CO LTD;THE CONSILIENCE KNOWLEDGE INST CKI

title_en: Automatic monitoring and early warning device for mine geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic monitoring and early warning device for geological disasters of mines, which comprises a support pillar, a first rope body, a rope climbing assembly, monitoring assemblies and monitoring assemblies, wherein the monitoring assemblies are respectively inserted into drill holes of mine side slopes so as to obtain monitoring data; the two support columns are arranged in a vertically staggered manner, one support column is fixed at the bottom of the side slope, and the other support column is fixed at the top of the side slope; the two support columns are provided with wire winders in a vertically sliding mode, the vertical adjustment of the wire winders can enable the inclination angle formed by the two wire winders to be consistent with the inclination angle of the side slope, and the two wire winders jointly accommodate the same strand I; rope body one is gone up and is adopted to climb the mobilizable control subassembly that is provided with of rope body direction of rope subassembly, the control subassembly can be with the geology change of the supplementary monitoring mine of the landform image of shooing with the contrast observation method.

title_en: Test platform and test method for fusing of hot melt plate of converter transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test platform and a test method for fusing a hot melt plate of a converter transformer, wherein the test platform comprises a test platform main body, a simulated fire source, a simulated valve hall, a matched fire extinguishing system and a matched measurement and control system; the test bed main body comprises a firewall, a hot melt plate and a fixed noise reduction plate; the matched measurement and control system comprises an ignition system, a temperature acquisition system, an image acquisition system and a pressure acquisition system. The method comprises the following steps: oil mass calculation, oil transportation, ignition, observation and recording, fire extinguishing time discrimination, fire extinguishing by a matched fire extinguishing system, flameout discrimination, repeated test and the like. The invention has the advantages that: the device can realize the test of the fusing effect of the hot-melt plates of different types and different arrangement modes in the converter transformer fire scene and the test of whether the external fire protection can effectively extinguish the fire after the hot-melt plates are fused, can realize the evaluation of the effect of the internal different types of fixed fire extinguishing systems and the optimization test of design parameters in the converter transformer fire scene, and can provide a test platform for revealing the mechanism of the converter transformer shielding fire disaster.

title_en: Personnel safety comprehensive guarantee system for ship
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ship safety, and discloses a comprehensive personnel safety guarantee system for a ship, which mainly comprises a decision-making system, an indicating system and a drilling system, wherein each system is executed by different devices according to functions; the decision system is mainly used for information acquisition, risk identification, data processing and instruction signal output; the indicating system mainly provides differentiated evacuation routes for escape route indicator networks distributed on ships according to different risk characteristics under the indication of the decision-making system; the exercise system carries out model simulation and real ship exercise on the set emergency plan, finds weak points in the risk emergency plan and improves the weak points. In order to guarantee the safety of personnel on board in the offshore wind power construction process, the method identifies, prevents and monitors potential risks by an informatization means, and further improves the safety of offshore wind power operation.
assignees: CHINA SHIPBUILDING INDUSTRY CORPORATION TIANJIN OFFSHORE WIND POWER ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire extinguisher simulation teaching device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire extinguisher simulation teaching device, including fire extinguisher and support, this fire extinguisher is provided with a plurality of and installs respectively on the support, the support includes base and bracing piece, and the bracing piece is provided with a plurality of and from left to right is connected with the base in proper order respectively, is provided with the mount on the a plurality of bracing piece respectively, and the fire extinguisher is installed on the mount, and the up end of base still is provided with the shower nozzle overlap joint pole, be provided with a plurality of fixed orifices, a plurality of on the shower nozzle overlap joint pole the fixed orifices sets gradually on the shower nozzle overlap joint pole under to from last respectively, and this fixed orifices is connected with the shower nozzle cooperation of fire extinguisher. The utility model discloses in the bracing piece be provided with a plurality of, and set up to different heights respectively to can place a plurality of fire extinguisher at the height of difference, further cooperate the fixed orifices of different positions, thereby can put out a fire to the different ignition of burning things which may cause a fire disaster, can contrast the condition of putting out a fire.

title_en: Detachable portable fast boat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detachable portable express boat, which comprises a boat body head, a boat body middle part and a boat body tail part; the tail end of the head of the ship body is detachably connected with the middle part of the ship body; the tail part of the ship body is detachably connected with one end of the middle part of the ship body, which is far away from the head part of the ship body; the head part, the middle part and the tail part of the ship body can be folded through connecting bodies; sealing strips are arranged at the joints of the head part of the ship body, the middle part of the ship body and the tail part of the ship body; the fast ship can be disassembled into three parts, and then the three parts are folded and transported, so that the transportation space is reduced in the transportation process, the transportation quantity is increased, and the lifesaving time is accelerated; the device can be widely applied to flood prevention and disaster relief, water training of teams or individuals, water culture and walking replacement, outdoor fishing, self-driving and traveling and the like.

title_en: Double-hole single-line tunnel transverse passage smoke exhaust type rescue station fire disaster model test system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-hole single-line tunnel transverse channel smoke exhaust type rescue station fire disaster model test system which comprises a tunnel system, wherein the tunnel system comprises main tunnel channels and transverse connecting channels, and the transverse connecting channels are transversely arranged between the two main tunnel channels and are vertically communicated with the two main tunnel channels; the fire source simulation device is arranged in the main tunnel channel; the smoke exhaust pipeline is arranged at the top of the transverse connecting channel; the monitoring device is arranged in the main tunnel channel and the transverse connecting channel; the invention can simulate the fire scene in the tunnel, observe, monitor and record test data of the smoke concentration, the smoke flow rule, the temperature field and the heat radiation value in the tunnel, improve the accuracy and the effectiveness of the fire test research of the tunnel, realize the modularized splicing of the main tunnel channel, repeatedly use each module with different functions according to the requirements of different positions, reduce the manufacturing difficulty and improve the splicing efficiency.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: High-resolution remote sensing image classification method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution remote sensing image classification method based on a generation countermeasure network, which comprises the following specific steps: inputting a high-resolution remote sensing image and a standard-like image thereof, and selecting a training sample set and a test sample set on the high-resolution remote sensing image; constructing a mean confusion matrix and corresponding training class pairs, constructing a training sample pair for each training class pair, and synthesizing the training sample pairs to obtain image blocks; building a generation countermeasure network and constructing a generator and a discriminator loss function; inputting image blocks, and alternately training a generator and a discriminator loss function respectively; generating a mixed sample according to the trained generator; adding the mixed sample into a training sample set; and training the deep convolutional neural network according to the new training sample set, inputting the test sample set into the deep convolutional neural network, outputting a prediction class mark, and finishing the classification.
