The invention can effectively improve the classification precision of the classification boundary, and can be used for environmental monitoring, urban planning, disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: System and environment simulation method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion display technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and an environment simulation method based on a multi-source heterogeneous data fusion display technology, wherein the system comprises a vector data fusion display module, an image data fusion display module, a three-dimensional model data fusion display module, a site detection related data fusion display module and a POI module; the environmental simulation method of the system completes simulation of the disaster area field environment through a plurality of steps; the invention focuses on the reconstruction of disaster area sites by utilizing multi-source heterogeneous data simulation, concentrates the data of different sources, different data formats and different storage modes into one scene, uniformly displays the data, and aims at truly restoring the site situation by adopting a three-dimensional and animation rendering display mode, so that the fusion and display of the multi-source heterogeneous data are realized, the complexity of multi-source heterogeneous data utilization is reduced, a decision maker is faced with a data form which is not scattered and abstract any more, and the decision maker can more intuitively understand and judge the site situation in the highly simulated scene.

title_en: SPH inflow boundary processing method based on Riemann invariant
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SPH inflow boundary processing method based on Riemann invariants, which comprises the following steps: step S1: constructing an input particle pool containing SPH particles as an applied inflow boundary, and constructing a particle recovery system; step S2: circulating each inflow boundary, and judging whether each inflow boundary reaches the input particle standard; step S3: performing particle input on an entry domain boundary which reaches an input particle standard, and performing particle input by utilizing a Riemann invariant after judging the flow state; step S4: updating the inflow particle information list, and updating a control list and a control variable in the particle recovery system; step S5: updating a particle action information linked list; step S6: and judging whether each input boundary loop is completed or not. Which enables accurate and efficient simulation of the inflow boundary. The method provides a more effective method for accurately constructing the model of the debris flow development process in the landslide disaster.

title_en: Movable refuge and life saving device for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable refuge and lifesaving device for coal mines, which comprises a lifesaving vehicle, wherein a lifesaving cabin with an opening facing right is arranged in the lifesaving vehicle, a crushing box is fixedly connected to the end surface of the left side of the lifesaving vehicle, a crushing cavity with an opening facing left and facing downward is arranged in the crushing box, a rock crushing power device for providing power for crushing rocks and coal mines is arranged in the crushing cavity, a rock crushing open circuit device is arranged at the left side of the rock crushing power device and is used for crushing the rocks and the coal mines which collapse on the ground in a mine underground passage, a drill bit overload protection device is arranged between the rock crushing open circuit device and the rock crushing power device, and a dust filtering device is arranged at the upper side of the crushing box. The survival rate of personnel in the mine disaster is improved.
assignees: PANAN YECENG COAL MINE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Subway tunnel and station hall fire smoke flow coupling analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flow coupling analysis method for fire smoke in subway tunnels and station halls, which comprises the following steps: 1) the subway tunnel fire ventilation analysis is based on the MFIRE; 2) carrying out numerical simulation on the distribution of the high-temperature smoke flow of the fire in the subway station hall; 3) and simulating and analyzing the flow coupling of the fire smoke of the subway tunnel and the station hall. The invention accurately carries out the personnel evacuation simulation of subway fire, needs to correlate the personnel evacuation simulation with the fire ventilation simulation, constructs an evacuation model capable of reflecting the behavior of personnel evacuees under a reasonable fire situation, effectively brings real-time station and hall personnel density distribution data into the evacuation simulation, and determines the practicability of an evacuation simulation result.

title_en: Urban rail transit simulation platform
abstract_en: The utility model provides an urban rail transit simulation platform, which comprises an infrastructure, an emergency processing system, a disaster prevention alarm fire extinguishing system and an environmental control system; the infrastructure comprises a train track, a shielding door, an escalator and a room for equipment management; the emergency processing system comprises an emergency stop button; the disaster prevention alarm fire extinguishing system comprises a smoke detector, a temperature detector, a fire alarm and a fire extinguishing device; the environmental control system comprises a ventilation device and a refrigeration device. The utility model discloses an urban rail transit simulation platform through the emulation setting to the platform, realizes the driver and the real standard of the strainability of platform service personnel when facing platform incident, can play fine teaching effect, and this simulation platform configuration is simple, multiple functional, can realize the simulation of multiple emergent scene.
assignees: CHENGDU BORUI SHIDAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene smoke and heat evacuation escape practical training equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a real standard equipment of fleing is evacuated to fire scene cigarette heat, affiliated fire control rehearsal device technical field, including the equipment rack, be equipped with gas storage jar in the equipment rack, the equipment rack side is equipped with fire-proof insulating glass, is equipped with the flame generation subassembly that communicates with gas storage jar looks pipeline between fire-proof insulating glass and gas storage jar, and the equipment rack upper end is equipped with the flue gas and makes the subassembly, the flue gas make subassembly and flame generation subassembly between be equipped with heat conduction frame, the flue gas is made the subassembly upper end and is equipped with the flue gas evaporation lid of making subassembly looks bolt-up with the flue gas. The smoke manufacturing component comprises a heating water tank, the upper part of the heating water tank is provided with a water inlet pipe communicated with the heating water tank, and the heating water tank is internally provided with a heating disc which is hermetically nested with the bottom of the heating water tank. The device has the characteristics of simple structure, good simulation effect, sufficient atmosphere rendering and high use safety and stability. The problem of fire scene cigarette heat evacuation real standard effect of fleing poor is solved. And the coordination capability in the process of handling the emergency is improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU LINGCHUANG WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of geological early warning, in particular to a geological disaster early warning device, which comprises a base and a shell, wherein a motor is fixedly arranged in the base, an output shaft of the motor is coaxially and fixedly connected with a driving pulley, driven pulleys are arranged on the periphery of the motor and rotate on the upper surface of the base, through holes are formed in the base below the driven pulleys and the driven pulleys, a strip-shaped groove which is in the same direction as a rotating rod is formed in the upper part of the rotating rod, a steel ball is arranged on the inner hollow side wall of the driven pulley in a rotating manner, and the steel ball is embedded in the groove; the dwang upper portion separately is equipped with the screw thread to the screw thread passes inside the perforation, and the bottom of dwang is provided with the drill bit, and the inside of casing is provided with the battery, battery and motor electric connection. The utility model discloses the advantage: simple structure, convenient operation, it is convenient to remove, and is fixed firm, the facilitate promotion is implemented.

title_en: Portable geological disaster monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable geological disaster monitoring device, a modularized GNSS positioning module, a battery, a communication module and a battery manager are installed in an equipment box, the equipment box is detachably fixed on a mounting seat, the bottom end of the mounting seat is detachably fixed to a ground drilling pile through a connecting rod, the ground drilling pile comprises a drill rod, two sides of the drill rod are provided with fins which incline upwards, the top end of the drill rod is screwed with a nut cap, and the nut cap is fixedly connected to the mounting seat through the connecting rod; in the implementation of the utility model, the structure is simple, the weight is light, the carrying is easy, and simultaneously, the structure is firm and stable enough; when the ground drilling pile is installed, the ground drilling pile is driven into a soil layer, the fin is in friction contact with the soil, on one hand, the ground drilling pile is prevented from being pulled out, on the other hand, settlement can be avoided, the structure is simple, the weight is light, the ground drilling pile is easy to carry, and meanwhile, the ground drilling pile is solid and stable enough.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Simulation test device for air-facing instability type landslide
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an face sky unstability type landslide analogue test device belongs to mountain region calamity prevention and cure technical field. The simulation test device comprises a main body frame structure, a side baffle, a bottom plate, a rear supporting plate, a bottom supporting structure, a front end rotating plate, a bottom elastic rope, a top rotating shaft, a supporting structure and a guy cable structure. The utility model provides a based on face sky unstability type landslide test simulation constructional device is based on the formation principle that landslide geological disasters took place, can effectively simulate face this type of sky unstability slip, provides a new structure device for the simulation experiment of studying landslide geological disasters in the future. The gap of scientific research on landslide geological disasters in the type can be filled up, and the method has higher scientific research value.

title_en: Saliva ice disaster simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drooling ice disaster simulation test device, which comprises a test platform, a water supply device and a refrigerating device, wherein the test platform is used for placing a test model; the water supply device is used for supplying water to the test model; refrigerating plant includes interconnect's evaporimeter, condenser and compressor, the evaporimeter is used for laying the surface of test model, just the surface covering of evaporimeter has insulation construction. The utility model can realize the freezing process of the test model from the outside to the inside by covering the evaporator on the surface of the test model, and accords with the actual temperature change process, thereby truly reflecting the formation process of the sialism ice; the size of the test model can be set at will, and a plurality of sets of refrigerating devices can be adopted to improve the freezing performance, and the applicability and the capability of processing large-scale model tests of the test device are improved.

title_en: Compressed natural gas tank car accident disposal teaching and decision-making assisting system based on VR
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a compressed natural gas tank wagon accident is dealt with teaching and aid decision-making system based on VR, include: a three-dimensional enclosed space comprising side surfaces and a top surface; the VR display equipment is worn on the head of the trainer and used for displaying the virtual tank car; the positioning device is arranged on the side surface and/or the top surface of the three-dimensional closed space and is used for positioning the position of the VR display equipment in the three-dimensional closed space to generate a positioning signal; a hand motion capture device for capturing hand motion and generating a hand motion signal; the upper computer is used for receiving the hand action signals and the positioning signals and sending the hand action signals and the positioning signals to the VR display equipment; wherein, VR display device, positioner, hand motion capture equipment and host computer are equipped with through wireless mode and connect. The device solves the problem that the disaster situation handling scene of tank car accidents cannot be simulated in the prior art.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGDIAN ZHIBO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Equivalent simulation method and system for strength evolution characteristics of rock-soil mass osmotic damage process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of numerical calculation, and particularly relates to an equivalent simulation method and system for strength evolution characteristics of a rock-soil body osmotic damage process. The equivalent simulation method of the rock-soil body osmotic damage process strength evolution characteristics comprises the steps of testing a filling medium in an engineering current disaster structure, obtaining the grain composition of a sample, determining the content of fine grains with the grain size smaller than a preset grain size threshold, obtaining the total mass of simulated fine grain components, and further equating the total mass of the simulated fine grain components to the mass of framework grains; equivalently constructing a discrete element particle model based on the quality and the cementation degree, wherein the adsorption effect of the fine particles with the particle size smaller than a preset particle size threshold is equivalently represented by the cementation degree of the bonding key; simulating and calculating the bonding bond strength gradually weakened along with erosion, and constructing a particle bonding contact model representing the seepage erosion process of the filling medium; and quantitatively representing the change rule of the strength in the erosion process of the filling medium in the disaster-causing structure according to the discrete element particle model and the particle bonding contact model.

title_en: Multi-source data-based spatial grid drought disaster risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a spatial grid drought disaster risk assessment method and system based on multi-source data. Firstly, carrying out grid division on a research area; acquiring multi-source data of a plurality of historical years in a research area; distributing multi-source data of historical years to each grid; calculating drought risk values according to the cell grid data, and establishing a training sample set; training a neural network model by utilizing a training sample set of each grid to obtain a risk prediction model of each grid; the method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource data of a predicted year, distributing the multisource data to each grid, and obtaining unit grid data of each grid in the predicted year; and inputting the cell grid data into a risk prediction model to obtain the drought risk value of each grid in the predicted year. According to the invention, firstly, historical data and short-term observation data are combined, the macroscopic regularity of drought and disaster conditions is determined through the historical data, and the pertinence, the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of an evaluation result are improved through a grid division mode.

title_en: Degradation simulation system and experiment method for bank slope hydro-fluctuation belt of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a deterioration simulation system and an experiment method for a bank slope hydro-fluctuation belt in a reservoir area. The experimental method comprises the following steps: (1) putting a sample into a clamper of a simulation system, and setting various experimental parameters of the simulation system; (2) calculating related parameters such as pore distribution, porosity and the like of the sample by using data acquired by a nuclear magnetic resonance system; (3) transmitting the acoustic signals collected by the optical fiber acoustic wave sensing system to an upper computer for inversion calculation to obtain parameters such as the space position, the fracture time and the fracture energy of the sample fracture; (4) and analyzing the rock degradation process according to the calculated related parameters. The method can acquire key parameters of the rock mass such as pore distribution, porosity, permeability, water saturation, rock fracture position, crack geometric characteristics, pressure, temperature, humidity and the like under different working conditions in real time, and has important significance and practical value for researching a reservoir bank slope hydro-fluctuation belt degradation mechanism and a reservoir bank slope landslide or collapse mechanism.

title_en: Resource pool disaster tolerance drilling method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource pool disaster tolerance drilling method, which comprises the following steps: based on an interface of a cloud platform, acquiring grouping information and fault information of resources in a resource pool of the cloud platform; and triggering disaster tolerance drilling by utilizing a prestored fault instruction based on the grouping information and the fault information. The invention also discloses a resource pool disaster tolerance drilling device and a storage medium.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE SUZHOU SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Neurological cerebral nerve-supplementing treatment bed
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a neurological brain-supplementing nerve treatment bed, which comprises a treatment bed body, wherein electric slide rails are fixedly arranged at the middle parts of the front side and the rear side of the treatment bed body, the upper end of the electric slide rail is movably provided with a support frame through a slide block, the inner side wall of the support frame is fixedly provided with a table-board, the upper end surface of the table-board is fixedly provided with a control device, the front side and the rear side of the inner cavity of the table-board are respectively provided with a second mounting cavity and a first mounting cavity, a bracket is fixedly arranged on the right side of the inner cavity of the second mounting cavity, a straight rod is movably arranged in the middle of the inner cavity of the bracket through a rotating shaft, a second handle plate is fixedly arranged at the right end of the straight rod, a second automatic telescopic rod is fixedly arranged in the middle of the inner cavity wall of the second mounting cavity, this department of neurology brain benefit nerve treatment bed can clap the hand emergency response training to patient, improves patient's reaction rate, the supplementary patient treatment.

title_en: Crowd evacuation method and system based on multi-carrier intelligent guidance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd evacuation method and a system based on multi-carrier intelligent guidance, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of leader evacuation path planning based on reinforcement learning, collaborative guiding strategy based on evacuation identification and a leader and simulation test verification. The system uses the crowd evacuation method of multi-carrier intelligent guidance, and the system comprises the following steps: the intelligent guidance system comprises a data acquisition processing module, an intelligent guidance strategy generation module and a simulation test verification module. Compared with the existing method for designing the evacuation strategy based on experience and trial and error in the research, the method can more effectively improve the crowd evacuation efficiency. Under the intelligent guiding strategy, various guiding modes of the station are configured with greater flexibility, and the operation cost of the station can be reduced on the premise of ensuring effective and safe evacuation.

title_en: Novel intelligent train operation adjusting method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of railway driving dispatching and commanding, and relates to a novel intelligent train operation adjusting method. The method fully utilizes fault information in a disaster prevention alarm monitoring system, temporary speed limit information sent by a driving dispatching desk and train operation diagram information under faults, a minimum operation time division calculation module added in an RBC database is responsible for calculating a train operation curve with minimum energy consumption in the minimum operation time division and the time division requirement of a residual section, the train operation curve is fed back to the driving dispatching desk, an operation situation prediction module predicts the time when each train arrives at a subsequent station, the time, speed and position of the running section are used as optimization targets, then the total late time of the trains on a line is used as the minimum, the train sending sequence and time of each train are determined based on a first-in first-out or reinforcement learning method, offline training is continuously carried out, and training parameters are stored in a model after training is completed and used for intelligent adjustment of the train operation diagram under the influence of the late time to inhibit the late time propagation on the line.

title_en: Intelligent deduction system and method for fire fighting and fire fighting rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent deduction system for fire fighting and fire fighting rescue, which comprises a fire fighting key unit management module, a three-dimensional modeling module and a three-dimensional display module, wherein the three-dimensional modeling module is used for independently building a three-dimensional scene of a fire fighting key unit; the fire fighting equipment information labeling module is used for acquiring fire fighting service data in a three-dimensional scene and labeling fire fighting equipment information in the three-dimensional scene; the fire fighting equipment monitoring integrated module is used for docking various fire fighting equipment monitoring data on a three-dimensional scene, and implementing integrated docking on the fire fighting equipment monitoring data in a Kafka, MQTP, HTTP or JDBC integrated mode; and the intelligent fire control deduction module is used for automatically generating a force scheduling scheme and generating a fire control deduction step on the built key unit three-dimensional scene based on the butted fire-fighting equipment monitoring data and the acquired fire-fighting service data. The invention also provides an intelligent deduction method for fire fighting and fire extinguishing rescue. The invention has the advantages of realizing scene display and data integration, realizing that all levels of firefighters are familiar with key unit conditions, implementing simulation drilling and effectively organizing fire extinguishing and rescuing.

title_en: Rapid fault detection method for integrated navigation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick fault detection method for an integrated navigation system, which comprises five steps: step one, setting a fault detection threshold; collecting system measurement information, Kalman filtering information and variance of the navigation sensor when the navigation sensor is not in fault to form a training set; step three, training a prediction model by using a machine learning method; step four, carrying out online estimation on filtering innovation and variance by using a trained prediction model; constructing a fault detection function; and step six, comparing the fault detection function value with a fault detection threshold to judge whether a fault occurs. The invention has the advantages of rapidly detecting the fault of the integrated navigation system, and particularly has stronger sensitivity to the gradual fault, so that the system can make emergency response to the fault more timely, and the reliability of the whole integrated navigation system is improved.

title_en: Cloth bag type high-rise escape device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloth bag type high-rise escape device, which is characterized in that fireproof cloth is made into a cylindrical long cloth bag, steel rings are arranged at two ends of the cloth bag, four steel wire ropes are uniformly separated from each other in the middle of the cloth bag, the steel wire ropes are embedded into the cloth bag from top to bottom, and an elastic band is arranged in the middle of the circular cloth bag for tightening. The steel ring at the bottom of any standard cloth bag is provided with a connecting buckle, so that the top of the steel ring of the next cloth bag can be quickly clamped, and the cloth bag type escape device can be extended and lengthened at will. The steel ring at the top is provided with a fireproof rope. The height of the floor is predicted before the fireproof cloth bag is used, the number of the fireproof cloth bags which need to be purchased is calculated, the fireproof cloth bags are linked, at least one exercise is done, and then the fireproof cloth bags are stacked in order and placed in a proper place. When a fire disaster happens, the two fireproof ropes at the top are firstly tied firmly, the window is pushed open or broken, the fireproof cloth bag which is supposed to fall on the ground of the building is firstly thrown out until the top, the feet firstly span into the bag opening of the cloth bag, and the cloth bag slowly slides down to escape. If a fire occurs in the downstairs and the cloth bag is roasted for a long time by a big fire, the cloth bag is covered with the fireproof jumpsuits to escape.

title_en: Mine disaster roadway early warning personnel rescue device and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster roadway early warning personnel rescue device, which comprises a rescue box body and rescue supporting plates, wherein the rescue box body is arranged on a track through rollers, movable plate bodies are arranged on two sides of the rescue box body, a power extension device is arranged on the movable plate bodies, the power extension device comprises a telescopic rod, a rotating device is arranged at the front end of the telescopic rod, the rotating device comprises a rotating drill bit rotating motor, the rotating drill bit is arranged at the front end of the rotating motor, the rotating motor is fixedly arranged in a telescopic hole at the front end of the telescopic rod, and the rescue supporting plates are arranged on two sides of a roadway. Greatly improving the survival of personnel and protecting the health and safety of the personnel under the mine.

title_en: Fire disaster occurrence simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire hazard occurrence simulation device, which comprises a support plate, a pull box and a burner, wherein linear track grooves are arranged on two sides of the support plate, the pull box can be slidably arranged in the linear track grooves through rollers, and the burner is hinged on the support plate; the burner is connected with the support plate through a transmission rod, and the burner is rotatably arranged on the support plate; the combustor is provided with an air inlet connector, and the air inlet connector is communicated with the combustor through two branch pipes; the draw box is provided with a clamping piece for positioning; the rotatable burner is arranged to adjust the angle of the burner, so that the fire behavior at different angles can be simulated; simultaneously, through setting up the draw-box to support and seal extension board and combustor through the direction of adjusting the draw-box, thereby improve the portability and the closure of device, be favorable to the maintenance and the maintenance of daily combustor.
assignees: HAINAN TAIHE HONGDING IND CO LTD

title_en: Tailings pond dam burst disaster simulation system and method
abstract_en: A tailings pond dam burst disaster simulation system and method, comprising a host system, a hydraulic system, a precipitation apparatus, a servo control system, and a sensor and electrical system. The host system consists of a rack and a dumping apparatus; a bottom plate (10) and retaining walls (3) are welded together; the front and back sides of the retaining walls (3) are of a hollow structure; a burst outlet (1) is mounted on a left sidewall of the left retaining wall (3); high-strength transparent glass (5) is mounted at hollow positions on the front and back sides of the retaining walls (3). By means of the configuration and use method of the present apparatus, dam burst experimental study for a large tailings pond can be completed under manual control and intervention, comprising: tailings pond dam burst damage space-time evolution rule and disaster-causing mechanism study, tailings pond dam burst prediction and early warning technology study, tailings pond dam burst impact damage rule study, large tailings pond design, accident disaster engineering simulation, etc. The present invention provides technical support for tailings pond dam burst disaster prevention and control, and has strong economical practicability.

title_en: Urban river flood three-dimensional inundation analysis method based on oblique photography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional inundation analysis method for urban river floods based on oblique photography, which comprises the steps of oblique photography aviation flight, ground image control point measurement, hydrological data and human economic data collection and processing, oblique three-dimensional model and high-precision DSM data generation, three-dimensional inundation water surface calculation generation, multi-source data integration and three-dimensional inundation effect display, quantitative analysis of inundation disaster situations and the like. By using the method and the device, the simulation precision of flood inundation of river channels in urban areas can be greatly improved, decision makers can conveniently and rapidly and accurately make flood fighting and disaster relief strategies, the efficiency of flood fighting and disaster relief is improved, time is saved, and further loss is reduced.
assignees: GUIZHOU WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Emergency management objective question automatic generation system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of computers, in particular to an emergency management objective question automatic generation system based on deep learning, which comprises an emergency management article acquisition module for obtaining original data to be analyzed; the article title classification module is used for classifying the types of the titles of the articles in the original data to be analyzed and classifying the types of disasters to which the titles belong; a text content importance ranking module for processing the text according to the classification result obtained by the article title classification module; aiming at articles classified as non-popular science in the article title classification module, establishing a correct candidate answer generation module based on a sequence labeling model of the BERT pre-training language model; and a wrong candidate answer generating module for extracting the questions in the correct candidate answer generating module. The invention automatically generates the emergency examination objective questions based on the emergency management article acquisition module, the article title classification module, the text content importance ranking module, the correct candidate answer generation module and the wrong candidate answer generation module.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a mountain torrent disaster early warning method, device and system and a storage medium. The monitoring data are collected through the monitoring equipment, the overflow flooding analysis result of the current monitoring area and the alarm information are automatically determined through the data processing and analyzing equipment, the problem that in the prior art, the mountain torrent disaster early warning mode depends on manpower more is solved through automatic alarm of the alarm equipment, the purposes of realizing integrated data collection, data analysis and alarm, improving mountain torrent disaster early warning and reducing the labor cost are achieved. The data processing and analyzing equipment analyzes the monitoring data by adopting the torrential flood simulation calculation model, can realize the intellectualization of data analysis, improve the early warning precision and the early warning efficiency, and meet the requirements of accurate and efficient early warning and forecasting of torrential flood.

title_en: Method for estimating water level overrun time in open channel according to actually measured water level change condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating water level overrun time in an open channel according to actually measured water level change conditions, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a simulation model of a channel section; s2, determining the flow rate change rate of the canal section under the unit flow rate based on the simulation model; s3, determining the relation of flow, water level and storage capacity of the channel section based on the simulation model; s4, fitting the actually measured downstream water level change curve, and obtaining upstream change flow according to the actually measured water level change rate obtained by fitting and the unit flow rate lower flow rate change rate of the channel section; and S5, acquiring the estimated downstream water level overrun time according to the upstream variable flow and the flow-water level-storage relation of the channel section. The advantages are that: early warning can be effectively carried out, overflow disasters caused by water level overrun can be prevented, and channels are prevented from being damaged; the method can provide corresponding reference for hydraulic regulation and control of a subsequent channel; compared with the traditional early warning time obtained by only depending on water level monitoring data under unbalanced flow, the calculation result of the method not only improves the precision, but also increases the calculation efficiency.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;ANHUI YINJIANG JIHUAI ENG CO LTD

title_en: Environment adaptability detection system for gas concentration monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment adaptability detection system for gas concentration monitoring equipment, wherein an environment cabin is used for placing the gas concentration monitoring equipment to be detected and providing a single environment state or a composite environment state of high temperature, low temperature, damp and hot, wind, rain and snowfall icing; the gas source module is used for providing gas with set concentration to the environmental chamber; the environment control module is used for controlling the environment state in the environment cabin; and the data analysis module compares the monitoring concentration of the gas concentration monitoring equipment with the set concentration in the environment cabin according to the real-time environment state in the environment cabin, and analyzes the environmental adaptability of the gas concentration monitoring equipment. The invention can simulate different disaster environments and multi-disaster coupling environments, and detect the gas concentration monitoring equipment in different disaster environments and multi-disaster coupling environments so as to evaluate the environmental adaptability of the gas concentration monitoring equipment in different disaster environments and multi-disaster coupling environments.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Simulation method for winter ice condition development process of river channel in data-lacking area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for simulating the development process of ice condition in winter of a canal in a data-lacking area, which comprises the following steps: according to the open channel non-constant flow theory, simulating the water regime development process in the ice-free state, and calibrating the real roughness of the river channel; according to the heat diffusion principle, the water temperature change of the river channel is simulated, and the heat exchange coefficient h of the river channel is calibrated wa 、j wa And k wa (ii) a And the critical Froude number and the maximum Froude number Fr m And determining the development mode of the ice cover and simulating the ice condition evolution process. In addition, according to the invention, the coefficient for reflecting the solar reflectivity is estimated through model calibration according to the difference of the solar reflectivity in different time periods and different ice conditions, so that the solar radiation value of the time average unit area is calculated, and the problem of solar radiation data shortage in ice condition calculation is solved. Therefore, the ice condition development and evolution process of rivers and channels can be accurately calculated under the condition that the calculation data is incomplete, and scientific reference basis is provided for winter regulation, disaster assessment and prevention of northern rivers and channels.

title_en: Rainfall step type landslide hazard early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall step type landslide hazard early warning system and an early warning method, which comprise a geographic exploration module, a weather condition analysis module, a hazard generation module and an early warning module, the geographic exploration module is used for collecting soil property information, resident information and traffic facility information by combining with map information through a network, the weather condition analysis module collects weather information through a network to analyze the generation of the continuous severe weather, the disaster generation module simulates the formation of disasters and judges the disaster grade through the information and data obtained by the analysis of the geographic exploration module and the weather condition analysis module, the early warning module has the function of intelligently early warning the upcoming disaster, the main control noise reduction module internally comprises an operation page sensitive module and a volume reduction module, and the volume reduction module is directly started after the operation page sensitive module is triggered; the method is applied to the purposes of quickly and directly knowing disaster occurrence conditions and disaster grades and not influencing discussion decisions.

title_en: Urban accident disaster evolution simulation and risk prediction early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban accident disaster evolution simulation and risk prediction early warning method, and belongs to the technical field of machine learning. By establishing an urban accident disaster data warehouse fusing multiple types of data and constructing an urban accident disaster evolution simulation and risk prediction early warning machine learning prediction model by using a machine learning method, the rapid and accurate prediction of the accident disaster evolution and the rapid prediction and early warning of the accident disaster risk are realized. The data warehouse integrates urban accident disaster historical data, urban accident disaster experimental data, real-time monitoring data of various sensors and urban accident disaster evolution numerical simulation data with high confidence level. The urban accident disaster evolution numerical simulation data with high confidence level is generated by a numerical simulation model verified by accident disaster historical data or experimental data or generated by a numerical simulation model based on data assimilation technology for fusing the numerical simulation model with the accident historical data or the experimental data, so that the problem of insufficient data quantity of a data warehouse is solved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;UNIV PEOPLES PUBLIC SECURITY CHINA

title_en: Method for quantitatively calculating rainfall induced sea surface stress
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine environment numerical simulation and marine forecast, can also be applied to disaster risk assessment in the field of marine engineering, and particularly relates to a method for calculating rainfall-induced sea surface stress; the method establishes a three-dimensional motion equation of raindrops in an atmospheric turbulence boundary layer by considering various factors such as atmospheric layer junction, wind speed, sea surface roughness, rainfall rate, raindrop particle size distribution and the like, obtains a numerical solution of rainfall-induced sea surface stress through numerical integration, has important reference values for ocean business prediction, ocean engineering and soil loss assessment, and has important scientific and practical significance; meanwhile, the method provided by the invention can be used as a physical process option of an earth system mode, realizes parameterization of a grid physical process of conveying rainfall to ocean energy, and provides a basis for scientific research, thereby deepening cognition and understanding of a momentum exchange process between air interfaces.
assignees: FIRST INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Information Processing System and method for rescue in mountain area using UAS
title_ko: 무인 비행체를 이용한 산악 지역의 구조를 위한 정보 처리 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an information processing system using an unmanned aerial vehicle for rescue in a mountain area and a method thereof. The information processing system comprises: an unmanned aerial vehicle that analyzes image information obtained from at least one camera while flying over an arbitrary area to determine whether the arbitrary area is a disaster area or whether there is a rescuee, and detects the position of the rescuee when it is determined that there is the rescuee; a rescuer terminal that transmits real-time position information of the rescuer; and a control server that receives image information and position information of the rescuee and the real-time position information of the rescuer, sets a rescue route of the rescuer and an evacuation route of the rescuee according to a presorted rescue scenario so that the rescuer and the rescuee can meet each other, provides the rescue route to the rescuer terminal, and provides the evacuation route to the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the control server updates the position information of the rescuee and the position information of the rescuer, correct the rescue route and the evacuation route based on the updated information, and the unmanned aerial vehicle guide flies along the evacuation route.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 비행체를 이용한 산악 지역의 구조를 위한 정보 처리 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 임의의 지역을 비행하면서, 하나 이상의 카메라로부터 획득한 영상 정보를 분석하여 상기 비행지역이 재난 지역인지, 또한 구호자가 존재하는지 여부를 판단하여 재난 지역이고 구호자가 존재한다고 판단하면 상기 구호자의 위치를 검출하는 무인 비행체; 자신의 실시간 위치 정보를 전송하는 구조자 단말; 및 상기 구호자의 영상 정보와 위치정보 및 상기 구조자 단말의 실시간 위치 정보를 수신받아, 미리 저장된 구조 시나리오에 따라 구조자와 구호자가 만날 수 있도록 하는 구조자의 구조 경로 및 구호자의 대피 경로를 설정하고, 상기 구조자 단말에 구조 경로를 제공하고, 상기 무인 비행체에는 대피 경로를 제공하는 관제서버;를 포함하고, 상기 관제서버는 구호자의 위치 정보와 구조자의 위치 정보를 갱신하여 갱신된 정보에 기초하여 구조 경로와 대피 경로를 보정하고, 상기 무인 비행체는 상기 대피 경로에 따라 안내 비행한다.

title_en: Adaptive system for smart boot sequence formation of vms for disaster recovery
abstract_en: One example method includes receiving input concerning a boot order sequence, where the input includes VM metadata, entering a training phase which includes generating a boot sequence rule based on the input, using the boot sequence rule to generate a proposed boot sequence, performing the proposed boot sequence, and gathering information concerning performance of the proposed boot sequence. The gathered information can be used as a basis to generate a modified boot sequence.

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method based on double-branch convolution self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention provides a hyperspectral image classification method based on a double-branch convolution self-encoder, which mainly solves the problem of low classification precision caused by insufficient hyperspectral data feature extraction in the prior art, and comprises the following implementation steps: acquiring a supervised training sample set, a supervised training sample label vector set, an unsupervised training sample set and a test sample set of hyperspectral data; constructing a double-branch convolution self-encoder; performing iterative training on the double-branch convolution self-encoder; and obtaining a hyperspectral image classification result. According to the classification method based on the double-branch convolution self-encoder, feature extraction is performed on hyperspectral data by comprehensively utilizing two modes of unsupervised learning and supervised learning, data information of hyperspectral images is fully considered, classification accuracy of the hyperspectral images is effectively improved, and the classification method can be used for distinguishing and distinguishing ground features in the fields of agricultural monitoring, geological exploration, disaster environment assessment and the like.

title_en: Training method of fire disaster identification network model, fire disaster identification method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a training method of a fire disaster identification network model, a fire disaster identification method and related equipment. The network model training method comprises the following steps: training an countermeasure network model using the training samples; the countermeasure network model is used as a teacher network, the knowledge distillation technology is utilized to train and obtain the embedded network model which is used as an academic network, and the embedded network model is used as a fire disaster recognition network model. The application improves the false alarm prevention capability.

title_en: Building evacuation path generation method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building evacuation path generation method, a system and equipment, which take the influence of entrance of rescue personnel into a building on path flow into consideration, wherein the dynamic flow of the path is formed by the dynamic flow of the personnel to be evacuated in the building and the dynamic flow of the rescue personnel to be entered outside the building together, a building evacuation model is built, whether a public path exists in the feasible evacuation path is judged by determining the feasible evacuation path, and the actual evacuation path and the dynamic flow of the actual evacuation path are determined by the floor with the longest time required by preferential saturation evacuation and the floor with the shortest rescue entrance time; in the process, a real personnel moving scene is simulated through the dynamic flow of the path, so that the situation of congestion and trampling is avoided, the personnel evacuation efficiency is improved, and the technical problem that the influence of the entrance of rescue personnel buildings on the path flow is not considered when the evacuation scheme is manufactured in the prior art, so that the personnel evacuation efficiency is too low is solved.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting auxiliary combat command system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire-fighting auxiliary combat command system which comprises a fire-fighting data one-graph module, a unit three-dimensional scene modeling module, a unit fire-fighting data acquisition module, a unit three-dimensional scene browsing module and an autonomous sand table deduction deployment module, wherein the fire-fighting data one-graph is formed through the synergistic action among the modules. The invention also provides an intelligent fire-fighting auxiliary combat commanding method. The invention adopts advanced computer technology, real scene simulation technology, virtual technology and digital communication technology, fully utilizes three-dimensional modeling, image acquisition, information collection and simulation means, digitalizes and three-dimensionally visualizes the real scene of a large-scale comprehensive market, realizes large-scale scene display and data integration, and provides powerful guarantee for each level of firefighters to be familiar with key unit conditions, implement simulation exercise training and effectively organize fire-fighting rescue.

title_en: Traffic information processing method and device based on extreme weather, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a traffic information processing method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment based on extreme weather, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a meteorological data set and a traffic flow data set of a predetermined area; inputting data in the meteorological data set and the traffic flow data set into a machine learning model, thereby determining traffic flow data at a predetermined time; and determining the traffic recovery capability based on the traffic flow data of the preset time. The method can effectively utilize massive meteorological data, trip data, traffic data and the like to optimize the depth sequence model, simulate and predict the traffic network condition after extreme weather occurs and the recovery performance of the traffic network through the depth sequence model, master the specific condition and the change trend of the urban traffic network before, during and after disasters caused by the extreme weather occur for the urban traffic management department, and can establish a plan for more effective emergency preparation, response and processing.
assignees: BEIJING DIDI INFINITY TECHNOLOGY & DEV CO LTD

title_en: Fire fighting experience system based on mixed reality
title_ko: 혼합현실 기반의 소방 체험 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire fighting experience system. A fire fighting experience system based on mixed reality according to the present invention comprises: a head-mount display (HMD) device that is worn on a head of an experiencer and mixes real images around a user and virtually generated images to display a mixed image; a training aid fire extinguisher device that can wirelessly communicate with the HMD device; and a control computer that can wirelessly communicate with the HMD device and the training aid fire extinguisher device. The training aid extinguisher device includes a discharge unit, wherein the discharge unit includes a posture position detection unit for detecting a posture of the discharge unit. The control computer detects the posture and position of the discharge unit of the training aid fire extinguisher device and generates virtual spray based on the detected posture and position of the discharge unit, wherein the generated virtual spray is delivered to the HMD device, and the HMD device is configured to display the virtual spray to a user by matching the virtual spray to the position of the discharge unit of the training aid device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방 체험 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 혼합현실 기반의 소방 체험 시스템은, 체험자의 머리에 착용되고 사용자 주변의 실사 영상 및 가상으로 생성된 영상을 혼합하여 표시하는 헤드 마운트 디스플레이(HMD) 장치; 헤드 마운트 디스플레이 장치와 무선 통신가능한 교보재 소화기 장치; 및 헤드 마운트 디스플레이 장치와 교보재 소화기와 무선통신가능한 제어 컴퓨터를 포함하고, 교보재 소화기 장치는 배출부를 포함하고, 상기 배출부에는 배출부의 자세를 검출하기 위한 자세위치 검출부를 포함하고, 제어 컴퓨터는 상기 교보재 소화기 장치의 배출부의 자세 및 위치를 검출하고, 검출된 배출부의 자세 및 위치에 기반하여 가상의 분무를 생성하고, 생성된 가상의 분무는 헤드 마운트 디스플레이 장치에 전달되고, 헤드 마운트 디스플레이 장치는 가상의 분무를 교보재 장치의 배출부에 위치 정합하여 가상의 분무를 사용자에게 디스플레이하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Multi-lane highway tunnel transverse fire position variable simulation experiment platform system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a changeable simulation experiment platform system in horizontal conflagration position of multilane highway tunnel, including highway tunnel simulation platform and the test system who is used for simulating the arbitrary horizontal position conflagration of multilane highway tunnel, the simulation burning things which may cause a fire disaster can be along track lateral shifting and fixed, and test system includes fuel quality loss, tunnel interior temperature field, wind speed test system and experimentation image. The utility model discloses can simulate the conflagration that the arbitrary transverse position of multilane highway tunnel takes place, platform section form, fuel type, conflagration scale, surrounding layer heat insulating layer and fire source all set up according to relevant theory apart from the actual tunnel condition such as tunnel bottom plate height, ensure credibility, accuracy, avoid the defect of full-scale conflagration experiment. The utility model discloses still realized the full data record of real-time conflagration process, operation and the sparse development of disaster prevention rescue and perfect to highway tunnel and even railway tunnel have great meaning.

title_en: Fire simulation system for complex ventilation network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire simulation system of a complex ventilation network, which comprises a sub-channel main body, a support frame, a fire source simulation system, a ventilation system and a monitoring system, wherein the sub-channel main body is provided with a plurality of sub-channels; the sub-channel main body is formed by splicing a first sub-channel, a second sub-channel, a third sub-channel, a fourth sub-channel, a fifth sub-channel, a sixth sub-channel and a seventh sub-channel, each sub-channel comprises a top plate, a bottom plate and two side plates, the sub-channels are connected through flanges, and an interlayer between the two flanges is sealed by a sealing pad; the method is convenient to research key discrimination standards of series connection, parallel connection, series-parallel connection, up-going and down-going ventilation control, multiple ignition sources and multi-factor smoke flow key characteristics, smoke flow reverse retreat, wind flow reverse and the like, and provides theoretical support for pre-disaster prevention and post-disaster emergency rescue.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;Tangshan Lunan Tanglong Machinery Factory

title_en: Experimental device for surfactant and magnetization synergism inhibit gas desorption
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device for inhibiting gas desorption by the synergistic effect of a surfactant and magnetization, which mainly comprises 5 parts, and comprises a vacuum degassing system, a high-pressure air charging system, a magnetized water injection system, a coal gas desorption measuring system and a computer control system, wherein magnetized water can be quantitatively injected into an adsorbed gas coal body by the experimental device, the gas desorption can be inhibited by injecting water into a simulated coal mine site in a laboratory, parameters such as gas pressure and the like in the experimental process are monitored in real time, and experimental results can be used for researching the influence rule of the magnetized water on the gas desorption of the coal body, so that scientific basis and theoretical basis are provided for preventing gas disasters.

title_en: Coal mine fire occurrence and rescue simulation device and system based on BIM and VR
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a colliery conflagration takes place and rescue analogue means and system based on BIM and VR, including customer end (1), detection module (2), feedback module (3), sensor (4), VR control module (5), main computer system (6), mine emulation conflagration BIM model (7). The mine simulation fire disaster simulation system is characterized in that the client (1) is connected with the detection module (2), the feedback module (3) and the main computer system (6), the detection module (2) receives a command of the client (1), the command acts on the mine simulation fire disaster BIM model (7) through the sensor (4), the sensor (4) receives a command of the VR control module (5), the command passes through the feedback module (3) to the client (1), and the main computer system (6) presents a simulation result and data information of the mine simulation fire disaster BIM model (7). The utility model discloses the benefit lies in: through a mine simulated fire BIM model and a VR invasion type virtual environment, a fire trend is presented, and information and decision basis are provided for rescue command.
assignees: WUHAN DESIGN & RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENGINEERING GROUP

title_en: System and method for personnel identification for evacuation training
title_ko: 재난 대피용 재실 인원 확인 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a system for checking occupants for disaster evacuation includes: an entrance control server communicate-connecting with a building entrance gate, receiving tagging information of an ID card of a person entering the building entrance gate, and generating a gate entrance log; a card reader which reads the ID card of the evacuee evacuated from the building to recognize a unique identification code when a disaster occurs in a building; and a main server which compares occupancy status information generated by the unique identification code with the gate entrance log received from the entrance control server, and aggregates occupancy, evacuated personnel, and personnel who are not evacuated.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난 대피용 재실 인원 확인 시스템은 건물 출입 게이트(Gate)와 통신 연결되고, 상기 건물 출입 게이트를 출입하는 인원의 아이디(ID) 카드의 태깅(Tagging) 정보를 수신하여 게이트 출입 로그를 생성하는 출입 통제 서버; 건물에서 재난이 발생한 경우, 상기 건물에서 대피한 대피자의 ID 카드를 리딩(Reading)하여 고유 식별 코드를 인식하는 카드 리더기; 및 상기 고유 식별 코드에 의해 생성된 재실 현황 정보와 상기 출입 통제 서버로부터 수신된 게이트 출입 로그를 비교하여 재실 인원, 대피 인원 및 미 대피 인원을 집계하는 메인 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Construction method of fire-fighting equipment
title_ko: 소방설비 시공방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a firefighting equipment construction method. The firefighting equipment construction method according to the present invention comprises the followings steps of: coupling a pipe support bracket unit to a steel beam constructed to receive a load of a building; and connecting and fixing a pipe support unit for supporting a sprinkler pipe to the pipe support bracket unit and the steel beam. The steel beam includes: an upper flange unit extending in the horizontal direction and formed; a web unit formed by being bent in the upper flange unit and extending in the vertical direction; and a lower flange unit coupled to the web unit and extending in the horizontal direction. The pipe support bracket unit includes: a pair of pressing hand units supported by the lower flange unit and disposed to be spaced apart from each other to move in the direction to be approached and spaced apart from each other; and a hand driving unit connected to the pressing hand units and moving the pressing hand units. According to the present invention, the pipe support bracket unit is coupled to the steel beam installed to receive the load of the building, and the pipe support unit supporting the sprinkler pipe is connected to and fixed to the pipe support bracket unit and the steel beam. Therefore, since a ceiling slab does not need to be drilled to install the sprinkler pipe, contamination of a work site can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 소방설비 시공방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 소방설비 시공방법은, 건축물의 하중을 받기 위해 시공되는 강재보에 배관 지지용 브라켓유닛을 결합하는 단계와, 스프링클러용 배관을 지지하는 배관 지지부를 배관 지지용 브라켓유닛과 강재보에 연결하여 고정하는 단계를 포함하며, 강재보는, 가로 방향으로 연장되어 형성되는 상부 플랜지부와, 상부 플랜지부에서 절곡되어 형성되며 세로 방향으로 연장되어 마련되는 웨브부와, 웨브부에 결합되며 가로 방향으로 연장되어 형성되는 하부 플랜지부를 포함하며, 배관 지지용 브라켓유닛은, 하부 플랜지부에 지지되며 상호 이격되어 배치되어 상호 접근 및 이격되는 방향으로 이동 가능한 한 쌍의 가압 핸드부와, 가압 핸드부에 연결되며, 가압 핸드부를 이동시키는 핸드 구동부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 건축물의 하중을 받기 위해 시공되는 강재보에 배관 지지용 브라켓유닛을 결합하고 스프링클러용 배관을 지지하는 배관 지지부를 배관 지지용 브라켓유닛과 강재보에 연결하여 고정함으로써, 스프링클러용 배관의 설치를 위해 천정 슬래브를 천공할 필요가 없어 작업 현장의 오염을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Agricultural insurance survey unmanned aerial vehicle device, rotor and fixed wing unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing application, and discloses an agricultural insurance survey unmanned aerial vehicle device, a rotor wing and a fixed wing unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform, which comprises a server for realizing training, optimization and deployment of an image segmentation model based on deep learning and storing crop survey information; the Internet is connected with the server and used for realizing data communication; the ground control station is connected with the Internet and is used for loading task planning data and an image segmentation model and comprehensively monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle remote control and remote measurement data; the unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the ground control station and used for collecting, dividing and splicing images. The agricultural insurance survey unmanned aerial vehicle device capable of automatically measuring the crop disaster area is developed by taking agricultural insurance survey damage assessment as an application background, taking a server and a ground control station as a basis, taking an unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform as a carrier and taking embedded vision calculation as a core.

title_en: Method for extracting gas and preventing and extinguishing fire by using composite drill hole
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting gas and preventing and extinguishing fire by using a composite drill hole, belonging to a method for preventing and controlling coal mine disasters. Setting a drill site in a top plate or bottom plate rock roadway of a high-gas inflammable coal seam, constructing a composite drill hole in the coal seam, and then performing coal mine disaster prevention and control according to the following stages: firstly, before coal seam mining, the gas in the coal seam is pre-pumped by utilizing a composite drill hole, so that the coal and gas outburst danger of the coal seam is eliminated; secondly, exploiting the coal seam, and extracting gas in a goaf of the exploited layer in a negative pressure mode by utilizing the original composite drill hole; and finally, in the coal seam mining process, injecting nitrogen or high-pressure cement slurry into the goaf of the mining layer by utilizing the original composite drilling hole again, and preventing the spontaneous combustion and ignition of residual coal in the goaf. The method can comprehensively utilize the composite drill hole before and after the high-gas easily spontaneous combustion coal seam is mined to realize the purposes of gas extraction and fire prevention and extinguishing, has high working efficiency and gas extraction rate, has good fire prevention and extinguishing effect, and saves the engineering cost.

title_en: Detection method for fire-fighting suit thermal shock resistance detection device in fire scene environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting thermal shock resistance of a fire-fighting suit in a fire scene environment, wherein the device comprises a test box body, a fire scene environment simulation system, a fire-fighting suit fixing device, an internal environment simulation system and a data display system; the fire scene environment simulation system is used for simulating the temperature field, the pressure field and the gas atmosphere of the fire scene in the test box body; the firefighter uniform fixing device is used for fixing a firefighter uniform sample for testing; the internal environment simulation system is used for simulating the human skin, and an air layer is formed between the internal environment simulation system and the fire-fighting suit sample to simulate the internal environment between the human body and the fire-fighting suit; the data display system is used for monitoring various data acquired in the test process in real time and displaying the data; meanwhile, the computer can analyze the collected data, and finally comprehensively evaluate the thermal shock resistance of the firefighter uniform in a fire scene environment by combining the temperature difference, the pressure difference and the change rate of air permeability along with time, and the evaluation can effectively reflect the actual use effect of the firefighter uniform.

title_en: Multi-agent emergency evacuation simulation model based on GAMA platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent emergency evacuation simulation model based on a GAMA platform, which relates to the technical field of analog simulation emergency evacuation. The invention can analyze and compare safety data such as dangerous source environmental parameters and the like, and can store a drilling scheme.

title_en: Emergency drilling script standardized design method for emergency
abstract_en: Disclosed is a standardized design method for emergency drilling scripts in emergencies. In order to construct an emergency management system and an emergency drilling script program suitable for the national conditions of China. A standardized design method for emergency drilling scripts of emergency events comprises the steps of determining primary elements of an emergency drilling scheme, establishing a structural equation model of the drilling scripts according to an explained structural model, and forming an emergency drilling script element set; based on the key elements obtained in the last step, emergency drilling individual protection, emergency drilling equipment and emergency capacity information are combined, and an emergency drilling script flow is designed, namely: starting a plan, emergency standby, emergency response and emergency termination, and designing an emergency drilling script flow; establishing a Hall model, and qualitatively analyzing the emergency drilling script flow by using the established Hall model; and establishing an AHP-Fuzzy model, and quantitatively evaluating the emergency drilling script flow. The invention realizes high-efficiency emergency rescue capability, greatly reduces casualties caused by accidents, and effectively reduces the damage of emergencies as far as possible.

title_en: Mine water inrush vertical electric source TEM real-time monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine water inrush vertical electric source TEM real-time monitoring system, wherein a transmitting lead AB is placed in a vertical drill hole arranged in the center of a mine area, a transmitter provides step current for the transmitting lead AB and is connected with a central master control system through a signal transmission line, a data acquisition station and three-component magnetic probes are distributed on the ground and in a roadway, a plurality of three-component magnetic probes share one data acquisition station, and the data acquisition station transmits detection data of the three-component magnetic probes to the central master control system through the signal transmission line; the central control system processes and explains the received detection data, forms an apparent resistivity section diagram with the detection data, judges whether the top and bottom plates contain water inrush disaster areas in the front of the roadway excavation of the mining area and the coal seam mining process, determines the transverse and longitudinal positions of the water inrush disaster areas through time-depth conversion if the water inrush disaster areas exist, and dynamically displays the processing results in real time so as to monitor the water inrush condition in the roadway excavation process or the coal seam mining process in real time.

title_en: Air-water pumping linkage device for guaranteeing safe drilling construction
abstract_en: An air and water pumping linkage device for guaranteeing safe drilling construction can solve the technical problem that gas is easy to leak in the drilling construction process in the prior art to cause disasters. The system comprises an extraction system, an air supply system, a water supply system, a drilling machine cooling system, an orifice dust removal system and a compressed air self-rescue device; the air supply system and the water supply system are provided by an air supply system and a water supply system in the roadway and are conveyed to a drilling construction site through a high-pressure hose connected with the air supply system and the water supply system; then, a water braid is adopted to connect the high-pressure hose and the drill rod, and the air supply system and the water supply system enter the hole through the drill rod; the air supply system, the water supply system and the extraction system are connected by a mechanical connecting rod to realize linkage. The embodiment of the utility model provides a can make appear gas unusual back in the drilling, can utilize the interior gas of taking out of tunnel to take out and put to the downthehole gas of hole guaranteeing that it is not leaking under the condition that causes harm, with its content, pressure etc. drop to under the safe horizontal line, guarantee safe construction.
assignees: CHINA COAL XINJI ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Power plant equipment fault early warning method and system based on dual networks
abstract_en: The invention provides a power plant equipment fault early warning method and system based on dual networks, which comprises the following steps: determining working condition parameters of real-time operation of power plant unit equipment; inputting the working condition parameters into the trained double-network model to calculate sample energy corresponding to the working condition parameters; the dual network model includes: a self-encoding network and an estimation network; the self-coding network is used for extracting depth characteristic data of working condition parameters; estimating the distribution probability of the network estimation depth feature data under the Gaussian mixture model, updating the parameters of the Gaussian mixture model based on the distribution probability, and determining the sample energy corresponding to the working condition parameters based on the updated parameters of the Gaussian mixture model; and when the sample energy is greater than the early warning threshold value, the corresponding power plant unit equipment is considered to be in fault. The method can extract the characteristics of the high-dimensional data so as to avoid the dimension disaster problem which is difficult to process by the traditional machine learning method; the time cost of network training and use is reduced without affecting the decoding capability.

title_en: Task scheduling method of mobile edge computing system based on migration and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a task scheduling method of a mobile edge computing system based on migration and reinforcement learning aiming at the task scheduling problem of an edge computing server, and the method comprises the steps of firstly constructing an Actor-Critic network for each server to train the scheduling strategy of the Actor-Critic network; the Actor network determines the action according to the self state, and the criticic network evaluates the action according to the action and the state of all servers. All servers share a criticic network. When a plurality of edge server scheduling strategies are trained by using multi-agent reinforcement learning, a strategy network with the same structure is constructed for the scheduling strategy of each server. These policy networks not only have the same network layer, but also the number of nodes per layer is the same. The strategies are trained by using a centralized training decentralized execution mechanism, so that the dimension disaster problem caused by the excessive number of servers is avoided.
assignees: AEROSPACE OUHUA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Debris flow disaster simulation method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster prevention and control, in particular to a debris flow disaster simulation method, which comprises the steps of obtaining original data of a research area where a debris flow is located, and controlling parameters according to two main effects of the depth of the debris flow and the volume concentration of solid matters: erosion deposition motion state and material exchange in the motion process; the parameters are controlled according to four effects of the flow rate variation: the method comprises the steps of flow acceleration, flow resistance, total water head, momentum exchange caused by erosion and deposition, establishment of a volume conservation algorithm to simulate movement and property change of the debris flow, and prediction of the size and hazard range of the debris flow.

title_en: Physical experiment device for exploring rainfall induced dangerous rock collapse mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a physical experiment device for geological disasters, in particular to a physical experiment device for exploring a rainfall induced dangerous rock body collapse mechanism, which comprises a fractured dangerous rock body to be tested, a dangerous rock body deformation data synchronous acquisition module, a hydraulic gradient regulator, a rotary adjustable rainfall simulation system, a dangerous rock body local data processing module, a small-sized double-in-line signal receiving and transmitting device, a local data receiving center, a full-automatic high-speed camera, rock debris and a rainfall receiving groove, wherein the dangerous rock body deformation data synchronous acquisition module is arranged around the fractured rock body; the gas spring hydraulic support rod used for slope adjustment can actively adjust the local slope where the dangerous rock mass is located; the rotary type adjustable rainfall simulation system can uniformly spray water at multiple angles to simulate the influence of natural rainfall on a dangerous rock collapse mechanism. A mechanism of rainfall-induced collapse of dangerous rock mass is observed by simulating natural rainfall, and relevant data of cracks of the dangerous rock mass are collected, recorded and statistically analyzed.

title_en: Geological disaster model display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster model display device, comprising a base plate, the last fixed surface of bottom plate is connected with the support column, the top fixedly connected with demonstration platform of support column, the rectangle recess has been seted up to the upper surface of demonstration platform, the interior diapire fixedly connected with spliced pole of rectangle recess, the surperficial cover of spliced pole is equipped with the vibrations spring, the top fixedly connected with supporting shoe of vibrations spring, the last fixed surface of supporting shoe is connected with places the platform. This geological disaster model display device through setting up vibrating motor, spliced pole, vibrations spring, placing platform and control panel, the start-up messenger of the vibrating motor of being convenient for places the platform vibrations to utilize the earthquake grade of control panel adjustment simulation, the student can observe the change of sand and soil model and house model, and place the hand and place the piece impression vibrations in the hand, make the student have audio-visual understanding to the harm of earthquake, strengthen the geological disasters education to the student.

title_en: Portable simulated fire-fighting exercise training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable simulated fire-fighting exercise training system, which comprises an equipment outer packing box, a flame scene simulator and a fire extinguisher simulator, wherein the equipment outer packing box consists of an upper cover, a lower cover and a hinge, one sides of the upper cover and the lower cover are movably connected through the hinge, two parts of a safety lock are respectively fixed on the other sides of the upper cover and the lower cover, a cloth pocket is arranged on the inner surface of the upper cover, a main power line and a remote controller of the flame scene simulator are arranged in the cloth pocket, and the flame scene simulator and the fire extinguisher simulator are arranged in the lower cover. The invention embodies the concepts of energy conservation, emission reduction and environmental protection, provides a possibility of simulating a fire extinguishing scene for fire-fighting exercise, plays a positive role in enhancing the fire extinguishing consciousness of the masses and improving the fire extinguishing skills of the masses when a fire disaster occurs, and has the characteristics of convenient operation, safety, reliability, portability, energy conservation and environmental protection, and all equipment can be placed in the equipment external packaging box.

title_en: Experimental device for monitoring whole disaster-causing process of unstability of dispersion accumulating dam
