abstract_en: The invention relates to an experimental device for monitoring the whole disaster-causing process of unstability of a dispersion accumulating dam, and belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering. Comprises a water supply device, a rainfall simulation device, a bracket device, a dam body damage and dam-break debris flow motion experimental device. The water supply device provides required water for experiments, the rainfall simulation device is used for simulating rainfall working conditions, the support device is used for supporting the rainfall simulation device and mounting ultrasonic equipment, and the dam body damage and dam break debris flow motion experiment device is mainly used for completing dam body damage and dam break debris flow (flood) motion process research. The invention can simulate and research the process from dam damage to dam-break debris flow (flood) in downstream river course under rainfall, flood surging and piping conditions, and records parameters such as dam damage degree, dam pore water pressure, dam deformation, dam-break debris flow (flood) impact force, flow velocity and submerged height through automatic monitoring equipment, thereby realizing the research on dam damage and disaster-causing process.

title_en: Barrier dam emergency monitoring and early warning method based on artificial intelligence and BIM
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence and BIM-based emergency monitoring and early warning method for a damming dam, which utilizes a liquid level meter, an inclination angle sensor and an artificial intelligence-based video monitoring device to carry out real-time monitoring; the remote sensing unmanned aerial vehicle directionally acquires data by oblique photography and laser ranging; combining the data collected by the former with the data collected by InSAR and GNSS and guiding the data into a GIS + BIM data processing platform; continuously training the collected data in advance, carrying out contrastive analysis on the model after deep learning, deriving a visual actual model, evaluating the disaster grade after dam break, positioning and displaying the three-dimensional position of the dam defect, simulating the submergence range after dam break, and facilitating quick emergency response and subsequent control of the dam. According to the invention, through the integrated monitoring network of sky, air and ground, the automation, visualization, accuracy and integrated monitoring are realized, the guarantee is provided for the monitoring and early warning of the barrage dam, and the manpower and material resources are saved.

title_en: Water-disaster space-time control drainage control method for roof of coal face
abstract_en: A coal face roof water damage space-time control hydrophobic prevention and control method comprises the following steps: step one: analyzing geology and hydrogeological conditions of the coal face; step two: determining the development height of a water-guiding fracture zone of the coal face; step three: analyzing water gushing sources of water damage of a top plate of the working surface; step four: predicting stable water inflow Q of roof aquifer in stope of working face  Gushing up  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Step five: determining the spatial position of a final hole of the hydrophobic drilling; step six: determining the number of hydrophobic drill holes; step seven: analyzing the water burst rule of the underground drainage drilling hole; step eight: the hydrophobic period of the hydrophobic borehole is determined. Therefore, the application controls the final hole position and the number of the water drainage holes in space, controls the water drainage period of the water drainage holes in time, and realizes the space-time control of the water damage of the roof of the coal face.

title_en: Method for determining horizontal evacuation speed of middle-aged and elderly people in evacuation model
abstract_en: A method for determining the horizontal evacuation speed of middle-aged and elderly people in an evacuation model. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic characteristics of the elderly, including visual acuity VA, sight level, evacuation speed V in a smokeless environment 0 And a minimum evacuation speed V min (ii) a Determining extinction coefficient K when evacuation speed of old people begins to decrease c0 (ii) a Determining extinction coefficient K when evacuation speed of old people is reduced to minimum value c1 (ii) a Carrying out fire simulation on a building needing fire evacuation simulation through PyroSim software to obtain an extinction coefficient of the horizontal height H of the sight of the old at any time of the building, and recording the extinction coefficient as K c (ii) a Will K c 、K c0 And K c1 And after comparison, determining the horizontal evacuation speed V of the old according to a formula. The evacuation speed of the old people in the horizontal direction in the fire disaster determined by the method is closer to the true evacuation speed of the old peopleSpeed, can provide scientific basis for old people's crowd management of fleing and formulate emergent evacuation scheme.

title_en: Forest fire detection method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire detection method based on a neural network for a forest, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image and a target infrared temperature image of a target area; classifying the target image and the target infrared temperature image by using a convolutional neural network classifier obtained by training to obtain a classification result; and obtaining a fire detection result of the target area based on the classification result. Therefore, when a fire disaster occurs in the target area, the target image and the target infrared temperature image both carry fire disaster characteristics and are input into the trained neural network classifier, the classification result can be output, the detection result of the fire disaster occurring in the target area is obtained, the fire disaster expansion of the target area does not need to be waited, the initial fire disaster condition can be timely detected, the detection speed of the fire disaster in the target area is high, the detection is timely, and the detection effect is good.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA 3R INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine-jump-imitating type flame-retardant device based on forest fire prevention, control and disaster reduction technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine-jump-simulating type flame-retardant device based on forest fire prevention, control and disaster reduction technology, which belongs to the field of forest prevention, control and disaster reduction, can play a role of flame retardance, prevent the fire from continuously expanding, reduce the loss caused by fire, bury the device in the ground surface in advance by simulating the mine-jump way, utilize the combustion supporting action of oxygen to break a sealing film, thereby contact a promotion ball with water, utilize the porous structure of the promotion ball and the promotion action of a surfactant to quickly release carbon dioxide in water to generate the eruption effect, so as to prop a shell into the midair, when the shell is in the midair, a fuse ignites hydrogen and oxygen to generate the explosion effect, thereby the flame retardant and the flame-retardant ball are thrown in a fire scene to play a role of flame retardance, the device can be triggered when the fire happens, and the design of the simulated mine-jump type can increase the coverage surface, can prevent the fire from expanding and spreading in time, is more timely and faster than fire extinguishers, and can greatly reduce the fire loss.

title_en: Karst soil cave search positioning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disasters caused by soil cave collapse in karst regions, in particular to a method for searching and positioning a karst soil cave, which comprises the following steps of firstly selecting a working area needing to be subjected to collapse search; then, a spraying route is defined for the selected area, and foaming agent is uniformly sprayed until the content of the foaming agent in the soil body of the earth surface covering layer reaches the designed concentration; observing whether bubbles are continuously generated on the earth surface after rain, marking bubble generation point positions, namely possible development positions of karst soil holes, and finally detecting the bubble generation point positions and adjacent areas in detail by adopting a conventional drilling or geophysical prospecting method to determine detailed characteristics of the soil holes; by adopting the karst soil cave searching and positioning method provided by the technical scheme of the invention, the specific development position of the underground karst soil cave can be detected accurately in a large area and with low cost and easy operation, the karst soil cave detection target area can be obviously reduced, and the bottleneck problem of 'where the soil cave is' in the process of karst collapse monitoring and prevention and control at present is effectively solved.

title_en: Rapid structural dynamic stability assessment system and method based on displacement
title_ko: 동적변위 기반 구조물 긴급 동적위험도 평가시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an emergency dynamic risk assessment system for structures based on dynamic displacement, comprising: a displacement measurement unit for measuring a displacement of a position where a sensor is installed when a movement of the structure occurs from a plurality of sensors installed in the structure; an evacuation determination unit configured to determine whether or not an occupant is evacuated by determining whether at least one displacement value of sensing information of the displacement measurement unit exceeds a design value; a structure status determination unit which selects scenario information by comparing a plurality of displacement values measured by the displacement measurement unit with displacement value information stored in a structure behavior database, and determines a status of the structure using a selected scenario; and a notification unit notifying determination information of the evacuation determination unit and the structure status determination unit. An object of an embodiment is to provide an emergency dynamic risk assessment system and the method for the structure based on the dynamic displacement in which the occupant can evacuate within a short time by analyzing displacement of the structure operated by an external force.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구조물에 복수로 설치되는 센서로부터 상기 구조물의 움직임이 발생하는 경우 상기 센서가 설치된 위치의 변위를 측정하는 변위측정부, 상기 변위측정부의 감지 정보 중 적어도 하나의 변위값이 설계치를 초과하는지 여부를 판단하여 재실자의 대피 여부를 판단하는 대피 여부 판단부, 상기 변위측정부에서 측정된 복수의 변위값과 구조물 거동 데이터 베이스에 저장된 변위값 정보를 비교하여 시나리오정보를 선택하고, 선정된 시나리오를 이용하여 구조물의 상태를 판단하는 구조물 상태 판단부 및 상기 대피 여부 판단부 및 상기 구조물 상태 판단부의 판단 정보를 알리는 알림부를 포함하는 동적변위 기반 구조물 긴급 동적위험도 평가시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH;KOREA INST SCI & TECH INF

title_en: Multimedia remote interactive teaching equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multimedia remote interactive teaching device, which comprises a control terminal and a display screen, wherein the display screen is arranged on the control terminal, the control terminal is connected with a main microphone, a keyboard, a mouse and a projector, and the projector is connected with a remote controller and a projection screen; the system is characterized in that a main transmitter and a main receiver are installed on the control terminal; the main transmitter is connected with a secondary receiver through a transmission signal, and the main receiver is connected with a secondary transmitter through a signal; the secondary receiver is connected with a sound box and a monitor and is used for voice interaction with students and monitoring the movement of the students; the secondary transmitter is connected with an auxiliary microphone and a button and is used for voice interaction with a teacher and remote position confirmation. The multimedia projection video teaching device can simulate disaster escape while performing multimedia projection video teaching, and guides a teacher to remotely interact with students.

title_en: Fire training system
title_ko: 소방 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting training system to provide a user with effective firefighting education. According to the present invention, the firefighting training system comprises: a display device disposed in a predetermined area within a firefighting education facility to display a spatial image; firefighting educational markers disposed on the display device; an image photographing device photographing the display device to generate the spatial image; a local server analyzing the spatial image to identify the firefighting educational marker included in the image and overlapping a marker image corresponding to the firefighting educational marker with the spatial image to generate a firefighting educational image; and a smart device performing an operation corresponding to a control signal of the local server. The display device displays the firefighting educational image when the firefighting educational image is received from the location server. The local server includes a location determination unit determining a user′s location based on WiFi-based triangulation and generates a heating control signal based on the user′s location detected by the location determination unit. The smart device includes a heating helmet, heating innerwear, heating gloves, and heating shoes for providing heat to the user′s body corresponding to the heating control signal provided from the local server. Each of the heating helmet, the heating innerwear, the heating gloves, and the heating shoes increases the intensity of the heat provided to the user′s body as a distance from the display device displaying the firefighting educational image therein becomes closer corresponding to the heating control signal and the local server inserts an effect image into the firefighting educational image corresponding to movement of the smart device in accordance with the user′s operation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 소방 교육 시스템은, 소방 교육 시설 내 소정의 영역에 배치되어 공간 영상을 표시하는 표시 장치와, 상기 표시 장치 상에 배치된 소방 교육용 마커들과, 상기 표시 장치를 촬영하여 상기 공간 영상을 생성하는 영상 촬영장치와, 상기 공간 영상을 분석하여 영상 내 포함된 소방 교육용 마커를 인식하고, 상기 소방 교육용 마커에 대응하는 마커 영상을 상기 공간 영상에 중첩하여 소방 교육 영상을 생성하는 로컬 서버와, 상기 로컬 서버의 제어 신호에 대응하는 동작을 수행하는 스마트 장치를 포함하고, 상기 표시 장치는 상기 로컬 서버로부터 상기 소방 교육 영상을 제공받은 경우 상기 소방 교육 영상을 표시하며, 상기 로컬 서버는 WI-FI 기반의 삼각 측량을 기초로 사용자의 위치를 판단하는 위치 판단부를 더 포함하며, 상기 위치 판단부에 의해 판단된 상기 사용자의 위치를 기초로 발열 제어 신호를 생성하고, 상기 스마트 장치는, 상기 로컬 서버로부터 제공된 발열 제어 신호에 대응하여 상기 사용자의 신체에 열기를 제공하는 발열 헬멧, 발열 내의, 발열 장갑, 및 발열 신발을 포함하고, 상기 발열 헬멧, 발열 내의, 발열 장갑, 및 발열 신발 각각은 상기 발열 제어 신호에 대응하여 상기 소방 교육 영상이 표시된 표시 장치와의 거리가 가까워질수록 상기 사용자의 신체에 제공되는 열기의 세기를 높이고, 상기 로컬 서버는 사용자의 조작에 따른 스마트 장치의 움직임에 대응하여 상기 소방 교육 영상에 효과 영상을 삽입한다.

title_en: Near outburst coal seam rock roadway tunneling, drilling and transporting integrated tunneling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near outburst coal seam rock roadway tunneling, drilling and transporting integrated tunneling method, belongs to the technical field of coal mining, and solves the problems that the single-advancing efficiency of the near outburst coal seam rock roadway tunneling is low, the drilling and disaster control progress is slow, and the like, and innovatively applies a 'tunneling, drilling and transporting' integrated tunneling process and a method. The method changes various defects caused by traditional drilling of the roadway side drilling site, integrates the main procedures of tunneling, drilling and transporting, works in parallel, runs efficiently, improves the single advance of the rock roadway, reduces the engineering quantity, eliminates the hidden danger of a large-section roof, and improves the production preparation quality.

title_en: Landslide land disaster risk zoning map generation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide land disaster risk zoning map generation method, belongs to the technical field of landslide risk prediction and early warning, and solves the problem of low accuracy of the conventional landslide risk prediction method. The method comprises the following steps: identifying landslide ground disaster points and non-disaster stable areas in a research area to obtain a training set image layer and a verification set image layer; acquiring and combining geological-environmental factors related to a plurality of landslide disasters in a research area, and constructing a multi-layer geological-environmental factor data set; training a landslide risk prediction model by taking the constructed data set as an input variable and the training set image layer as a dependent variable, and verifying the trained landslide risk prediction model by using the constructed data set and the verification set image layer to obtain a landslide risk prediction model passing verification; and inputting the constructed data set into the landslide risk prediction model passing the verification, processing to obtain a grid value of each grid in the research area, and drawing a landslide and land disaster risk zoning map of the research area based on the corresponding relation between the grid value and the risk level.

title_en: Model service chain driven environment emergency monitoring and virtual simulation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment emergency monitoring and virtual simulation method and device driven by a model service chain, which belong to the field of remote sensing and geographic information, and specifically comprise the following steps: firstly, building an environment emergency monitoring OGC standardized model sub-service from normal monitoring, disaster warning and emergency response; then, intelligent combination is carried out on the model sub-services based on Web service Business Process Execution Language (BPEL) so as to construct an environment emergency monitoring model service chain; secondly, constructing a virtual simulation module based on a virtual geographic environment technology so as to realize the visualization of an environment emergency monitoring virtual simulation process; and realizing the two-way communication between the model service chain and the virtual simulation module by constructing a message communication mechanism in the model service chain and the virtual geographic environment. The invention drives the environment normal state monitoring and emergency monitoring in a model service chain mode, and drives the three-dimensional synchronous real-time virtual simulation and interaction of the environment monitoring, thereby realizing the automation, the intellectualization, the high efficiency and the virtual visualization of the environment monitoring process.

title_en: Method for monitoring hidden danger of ground collapse of shallow sand layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for monitoring hidden danger of ground collapse of a shallow sand layer, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster detection and monitoring and comprises the following steps: after the hidden danger inspection, a vehicle-mounted three-dimensional ground penetrating radar is adopted to carry out comprehensive general inspection on the suspected hidden danger road section, and the hidden danger distribution is determined; adopting a vehicle-mounted three-dimensional ground penetrating radar, pipeline detection, drilling verification and a three-dimensional laser scanner to carry out detailed investigation on the development degree of the hidden danger, and determining a ground collapse hidden danger monitoring area; carrying out level deformation, water level, soil body layered settlement and ground surface settlement monitoring on an affected area of the ground collapse monitoring area; and monitoring the deformation trend of the ground collapse hidden danger monitoring area in real time by adopting a total station. The invention solves the problems of low accuracy, and difficult popularization and practical application of the existing monitoring method. The invention can accurately monitor and early warn the hidden danger of shallow sand layer ground collapse in multiple stages and at multiple angles, has high applicability and is easy to popularize and apply.
assignees: SHANGHAI GEOLOGICAL & MINERAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG CO LTD

title_en: Flood season climate trend prediction system based on TCN
abstract_en: The invention provides a TCN-based flood season climate trend prediction system which comprises an upper computer, wherein the upper computer is connected with a detection device; the upper computer is used for executing the following steps: acquiring historical data of flood in a flood season; the historical data comprises water level, rainfall, vegetation coverage proportion, geological factors and upstream flood hazard indexes of the area when the flood occurs; establishing a TCN network model for predicting the flood severity of the regional flood season, and training the established TCN network model by using the historical data to obtain a trained TCN network model; and detecting the water level, the vegetation coverage ratio, the geological factors and the upstream flood hazard index in the local area flood season, predicting the rainfall capacity of the local area flood season, and predicting the flood hazard index in the local area flood season by combining the trained TCN network model. The technical scheme provided by the invention can solve the problem that the hazard degree of flood disasters cannot be predicted when the flood disasters are predicted in the flood season in the prior art.

title_en: Power grid disaster situation evaluation method based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid disaster situation evaluation method based on a deep neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical power grid disaster situation scene data for statistical analysis; preprocessing the historical power grid disaster situation scene data, and establishing a rating system by using disaster situation evaluation indexes; constructing a neural network model, and classifying the disaster according to the severity of the disaster to be used as a model for outputting; after the preprocessed sample data is loaded to the neural network model, selecting training parameters to train and learn the neural network model; and acquiring a new power grid scene in real time, inputting the new power grid scene to the trained neural network model, acquiring the disaster situation evaluation grade in real time, and solving the problem that the specific optimization calculation of the existing scene-based disaster situation evaluation optimization model is difficult to solve.

title_en: Pre-disaster rush repair personnel pre-deployment method for improving power grid recovery speed
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-deployment method for pre-disaster rush-repair personnel, which can improve the recovery speed of a power grid, and comprises the following steps: 1) after an upcoming disaster is predicted, combining weather prediction and geographic information of a power grid, obtaining fault probability of each element according to a vulnerability curve of the power grid element, and generating a fault scene under the disaster through time sequence Monte Carlo simulation; 2) acquiring information of a power grid, a repair team and a deployable position, establishing a two-stage random planning model, making a deployment scheme of emergency repair personnel in the first stage, and performing repair and recovery collaborative optimization according to a fault scene in the second stage to minimize power failure loss; 3) and decoupling and solving the two-stage stochastic programming model by a Progressive Hedging (PH) algorithm. The emergency repair personnel are deployed in the key link of the power grid before the upcoming meteorological disaster is predicted, so that the emergency response capability of the power grid after the disaster is improved, the repair of the fault element is accelerated, and a reasonable suggestion is provided for the formulation of the power grid emergency plan.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Numerical simulation method and system for fire disaster of power cabin of urban comprehensive pipe rack
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire numerical simulation method and a fire numerical simulation system for an electric power cabin of an urban comprehensive pipe rack, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a physical model of the electric power cabin of the comprehensive pipe rack only comprising internal cables, and initializing parameter information of the physical model; establishing a fire simulation model according to the physical model, setting a plurality of measuring points and setting fire simulation model parameters; operating a fire simulation model and calculating to obtain a preliminary fire numerical simulation result; and optimizing the preliminary fire numerical simulation result and obtaining an optimized fire numerical simulation result. According to the invention, a physical model of the utility tunnel power cabin and a corresponding fire simulation model are established to obtain a preliminary fire numerical simulation result, and then a genetic optimization algorithm is adopted for optimization to obtain an accurate fire numerical simulation result, so that the spreading rule of fire smoke in the utility tunnel power cabin and the distribution condition of fire parameters after a fire occurs are accurately sensed, a technical basis is provided for the structural design of the utility tunnel power cabin, and a guidance reference is provided for people in a pipe gallery to escape.
assignees: WUHAN MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Population space distribution simulation method and device based on urban inland inundation risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a population space distribution simulation method and a population space distribution simulation device based on urban inland inundation risk assessment, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring and fusing urban building information; establishing a city POI category and population density weight relationship; building-oriented population redistribution; and (5) correcting the population number. Aiming at the conditions that the actual urban waterlogging risk assessment is inaccurate and untimely, the POI data highly related to urban population is adopted to simulate the population space distribution under the building scale, so that the accuracy and efficiency of the urban disaster population assessment in the urban waterlogging disaster are improved.

title_en: Crowd emergency evacuation simulation method based on invasive weed optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a crowd emergency evacuation simulation method based on an invasive weed optimization algorithm, which comprises the steps of firstly extracting the personnel state, the safety site and the evacuation channel 3 indexes of crowd emergency evacuation; and then carrying out emergency evacuation modeling by adopting an invasive weed optimization algorithm, taking the reciprocal of the crowd moving path as a fitness function, and preferentially obtaining an optimal crowd emergency evacuation solution through seed scattering and weed multiple competition. The method adopted by the invention has short evacuation time and high convergence speed.

title_en: Improved landslide and critical-sliding time forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved landslide imminent-slip time forecasting method, which aims at solving the problem that the calculation intervals are not uniform in the conventional landslide time forecasting process, and firstly determines a landslide deformation rate time smooth curve; then, carrying out dimensionless processing on the landslide deformation curve through coordinate transformation, and converting the landslide deformation curve into a tangent angle change curve, so that various landslide deformation curves can be compared under the same tangent angle characteristic; further according to the formula Calculating the speed reciprocal, and further drawing a speed reciprocal time curve; further analyzing the deformation data, taking the deformation data corresponding to the tangent angle of 80-85 degrees as a calculation interval, and analyzing according to a speed inverse prediction model; finally, linear and nonlinear simultaneous simulation is adoptedAnd taking the time corresponding to the time when the reciprocal of the speed is 0 as the predicted landslide occurrence time according to the fitting result, and selecting the result with earlier time as the final judgment. The invention has the advantages of early warning and natural disaster prevention.

title_en: Railway emergency communication system and method based on 5G communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of railway emergency communication, and discloses a railway emergency communication system and a method based on 5G communication, wherein the railway emergency communication system based on 5G communication comprises: the system comprises a railway real-time monitoring module, a railway information acquisition module, a main control module, an accident information acquisition module, an accident positioning module, an emergency scheme acquisition module, a calling module, a scheduling module, an early warning module, an emergency simulation module, a data storage module, a 5G communication module and a display module. According to the emergency scheme acquisition module, the problem that when a railway accident occurs in the prior art, the scientificity of an emergency scheme made by a safety responsible person in a place where the railway accident occurs is limited by the experience of the safety responsible person is solved; meanwhile, the early warning information of the railway network is more intuitively acquired through the early warning module, and guidance is provided for subsequent targeted disaster relief and emergency rescue; the early warning on the operation safety of the railway network is realized, and the operation safety of the railway network is ensured.
assignees: HUNAN TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF RAILWAY HIGH SPEED

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The method comprises the following steps of constructing a simulation environment, and constructing a simulation environment comprising different functional areas, including rooms, corridors, danger points and the like; constructing a deep reinforcement learning model, constructing a neural network conforming to a simulation environment, and compiling processing logic; step three, compiling training logic, communicating the model with the environment, enabling the model to interact with the environment, continuously correcting parameters of the model according to feedback of the environment, and finally converging to calculate the optimal escape path; according to the scheme, the problem of path planning for escape after a disaster is solved by using a deep reinforcement learning method, environment data do not need to be acquired manually, the scheme disclosed by the invention automatically interacts with the environment, and the efficiency of path planning after the disaster and the safety of the planned path are greatly improved.

title_en: Risk assessment method for rockburst in linear engineering investigation stage
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rockburst risk assessment method in a linear engineering exploration stage. The relation between the rock burst and the underground engineering burial depth under the overall trend condition of the line is determined at the initial stage of investigation and design, so that the main burial depth range of high-risk rock burst disasters is determined, and the line and the engineering scheme are reasonably determined. The method comprises the steps of 1) utilizing the maximum horizontal principal stress sigma obtained by the hydrofracturing method of the area along the line H Minimum horizontal principal stress σ h The measured data of (2), developing sigma H 、σ h Simulating a functional relation with the depth H; 2) obtaining the average value R of uniaxial saturated compressive strength of typical hard rock along the line c (ii) a 3) Considering the circular excavation section, calculating the maximum tangential stress sigma of the section θmax A functional relationship that varies with depth H; 4) using the obtained R c And σ θmax Using Hoek criterion rock burst evaluation method, obtaining the variation relation of hard rock burst coefficient L along with depth H in the engineering area, determining the general depth of the high-risk tunnel according to the standard of rock burst risk grade division in the Hoek criterion, and guiding line selection.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD

title_en: Safety monitoring method and device for urban rail transit system
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a safety monitoring method and device for an urban rail transit system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring safety related parameters of a rail transit system; inputting the safety related parameters into a safety risk identification model to obtain the type and the grade of the safety risk; the safety risk identification model is obtained by training through a first preset sample set, the first preset sample set comprises multiple groups of first preset samples, and each group of first preset samples comprises: a security-related parameter; and, a corresponding security risk type and level; determining an emergency response scheme according to the safety risk type and the safety risk level; and sending the emergency response scheme to the terminal equipment of the emergency working group. The technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the disclosure can automatically determine the emergency response scheme based on the safety related parameters and send the emergency response scheme to the terminal equipment of the emergency working group, thereby being beneficial to improving the safety of the urban rail transit system.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD

title_en: Ground disaster monitoring and processing method and device for power transmission line, early warning system and equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power transmission lines, and provides a ground disaster monitoring processing method and device, an early warning system and equipment for the power transmission lines. According to the method and the device, the ground disaster monitoring and processing efficiency of the power transmission line can be improved. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a ground disaster bodily form variable time sequence data set of an area where the power transmission line is located through obtaining remote sensing satellite data of geological disasters of the area, obtaining spatial distribution information of monitoring points of the area through obtaining satellite radar data of the area, inputting the ground disaster bodily form variable time sequence data set, the spatial distribution information and Beidou measurement data into a numerical analysis model through Beidou measurement data obtained through measurement at observation points of the area, carrying out simulation analysis on a deformation process of a ground disaster body of the area where the power transmission line is located, and obtaining ground disaster monitoring information of the area where the power transmission line is located.

title_en: Damage estimation information creation system for disaster control and program for the same system
abstract_en: To provide a damage estimation information creation system for disaster control which enhances disaster response capacity of a society.SOLUTION: A damage estimation information creation system 1 for disaster control which creates damage estimation information includes a damage estimation information creation support computer 2 and a damage estimation information database 21. The damage estimation information database comprises: a basic information database 22 for registering information of an estimated disaster type, a disaster-stricken area, and a training level; a disaster information database 23 for registering estimated disaster information; a database 24 for names of prefectures, cities, towns, and villages; a social damage case database 25; a base name database 26; an in-house damage case database 27; a countermeasure case database 28; and a person name database 29 for registering employee names. The damage estimation information creation support computer includes information generating means 17 for referring to each information and creating the damage estimation information composed of estimated disaster status information, social damage status information, base damage status information, and safety confirmation status information for each employee.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: RESCUE NOW KIKI KANRI KENKYUSHO CO LTD

title_en: Conveying rod assembly, TBM airborne pilot drill visualization device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunneling, and relates to a conveying rod assembly, a TBM airborne pilot drill visualization device and an application method thereof. According to the device, the tunnel face advanced surrounding rock is drilled through a TBM airborne advanced drill; after drilling, pushing the probe and the conveying rod assembly into a TBM advanced drill hole through an advanced drill propulsion system to perform in-hole panoramic imaging, video recording, key part snapshot, drill hole track measurement and the like; the information detected by the probe is processed by an image editing processor in the imaging device host, and the processed result is displayed on a display, so that geological information such as hole wall cracks, cavities, aquifer water outlet positions, fault structures and the like in the full-length range of the TBM advanced drilling hole is obtained. The device and the application method thereof can realize qualitative and quantitative interpretation of surrounding rock lithology, stratum fracture tectonic zone, geological disasters and the like in front of a TBM tunneling face, and provide basis for imaging accurate identification.
assignees: XIAN CHINA RAILWAY ENG EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting emergency-response pipe-pushing thrust for subway tunnel collapse
abstract_en: Provided is a method for predicting the thrust of a pipe in pipe-pushing emergency response when a subway tunnel collapses. Comprised are: determining the height H and the severity γ of a collapse, determining the distance H from the center axis of a push pipe to the bottom of a tunnel 1, determining the horizontal length L of a slid-collapsed body at the central axis of the push pipe according to a geophysical prospecting or exploratory drilling method or estimation method; determining the cohesive force c and the internal friction angle φ of the collapsed body; determining the interface friction between the collapsed body and the outer wall of the push pipe ҭ; determining the number of push pipes m and the number of complete pipes n within the range of the horizontal length L; determining the conventional section length L of the incomplete push pipe within the horizontal length L range3 and expanding the head section length L4; determining the thrust T required for the conventional section1, the thrust required for the expansion section T2, and the required thrust T of the cone3; determining the total thrust T required to push the pipe.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 9 GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Gaussian process method and device for rapidly identifying stability coefficient of sliding karst dangerous rock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Gaussian process method and device for rapidly identifying a stability coefficient of sliding karst dangerous rocks, and mainly solves the problem of reasonably identifying the anti-sliding stability safety coefficient of sliding unstable collapse type dangerous rocks in a karst region. Firstly, selecting 14 characteristic indexes which obviously influence the stability coefficient of the sliding karst dangerous rock; secondly, establishing a machine learning sample set through collection of a plurality of engineering examples and calculation of stability coefficients; then, training and testing a GPR model by adopting a cross validation strategy; further, inputting a new dangerous rock mass to be recognized into the trained GPR model, and directly outputting a recognition result with probability significance of the stability coefficient of the dangerous rock mass to be recognized; and finally, quantitatively evaluating the uncertainty of the identification result. The method can be used for rapidly identifying the stability coefficient of the large-batch slippage type dangerous rock mass in the karst region, and is particularly suitable for geological disaster management or technical personnel application without professional background knowledge and experience of calculation and analysis of the stability of the dangerous rock mass.

title_en: Rainstorm disaster weather risk assessment method, device and equipment based on Flood Area model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster assessment, in particular to a rainstorm disaster weather risk assessment method based on a Flood Area model, which comprises the steps of collecting and arranging data and building a risk database; calculating the surface rainfall through forecast data, radar estimation and rainfall station data; determining the disaster critical precipitation; analyzing the exposure and the vulnerability of the bearing body; combining a risk database, disaster-causing rainfall determination and exposure and vulnerability technologies of a bearing body, and outputting a disaster risk range and distribution diagram and a disaster risk quantitative estimation result through Flood Area simulation; the rainfall forecasting method is based on the Flood Area model, combines numerical values of various forecasting models, forecasting data and statistical analysis of observation data of the automatic meteorological station, utilizes rainfall forecasting data of various mature numerical modes, improves rainstorm monitoring and forecasting capacity, and lays a foundation for evaluation of rainstorm disastrous weather.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD CHARGED OPERATION BRANCH

title_en: Underwater target spot plugging railway tunnel deep vertical shaft water inrush structure and construction method
abstract_en: The underwater target spot is used for plugging the construction and construction method of the railway tunnel deep shaft water inrush, so as to safely and rapidly treat the railway tunnel deep shaft water inrush disaster. Comprises an underground water plugging structure and a targeting grouting reinforcement structure; the underground water sealing structure comprises a broken stone grouting sealing layer, a cement slurry water-stopping layer and a flat-bottom concrete slurry-stopping pad which are sequentially arranged in an annular well wall lining from the slag body in the bottom well upwards, wherein the thickness of the broken stone grouting sealing layer is larger than the height of a burst water bursting mouth. The lower part of the flat-bottom concrete grout stopping pad breaks through the lining of the well wall and is embedded into the rock body. The target grouting reinforcement structure comprises target grouting holes and target grouting reinforcement bodies, wherein the target grouting holes are drilled by taking the top surface of a flat-bottom concrete grouting stop pad as a platform, obliquely downwards penetrate through a well wall lining and enter soft rock bodies around a gushing water ulcer opening, and the target grouting reinforcement bodies are reinforcement bodies formed by pressing cement slurry to the soft rock bodies through the target grouting holes and solidifying the cement slurry.

title_en: 110 and N00 construction method mining working face goaf gas concentration distribution simulation testing device and using method
abstract_en: The invention provides a 110 and N00 working method mining working face goaf gas concentration distribution simulation test device and a use method thereof, wherein the test device comprises a model frame, a roof stress loading device, a gas injection device, a ventilation device and a gas concentration detection device; the invention can simulate the gas concentration distribution rules of the goaf under two different ventilation systems of working face Y-type ventilation under a 110 mining mode and working face Z-type ventilation under an N00 mining mode, can load the goaf caving body, simulate the internal airflow migration and gas migration of the goaf under the loaded condition, monitor the airflow and gas concentrations in the goaf and a roadway through the infrared gas sensor, analyze data through the data processing system to obtain the gas concentration distribution rules in the goaf and the roadway, and simulate the test result to have guiding significance for researching the gas distribution rules of the goaf and controlling the gas disasters under the cut-top pressure relief mining mode.
assignees: UNIV HENAN POLYTECHNIC;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Microwave-assisted pressure relief and support method for deep hard rock engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microwave-assisted pressure relief and support method for deep hard rock engineering, which comprises the steps of firstly supporting the wall surface of an excavated area after engineering excavation; drilling holes on the periphery and behind the rock mass to be excavated by taking the tunnel face as a boundary; introducing microwave radiation energy into the bottom of the drill hole by adopting a microwave waveguide and irradiating a rock mass to induce cracks; injecting a static rock expansion breaking agent into the hole bottom and blocking the hole bottom, so that cracks induced by microwave irradiation develop for the second time, the cracks at the bottoms of adjacent drill holes expand and are communicated with each other to form a breaking zone wrapping the rock mass to be excavated, and releasing the pressure of surrounding rocks through the breaking zone; in order to further maintain the stability of the surrounding rock after stress release, grouting is carried out by utilizing a drill hole, so that the pressure release fracture zone is reformed into an annular reinforcing area under the cementing action of cement. The technology is basically maintained in a quasi-static process in the process of forming the broken zone, avoids secondary power disturbance disasters induced by the traditional blasting pressure release technology, and is favorable for realizing safe and efficient construction of deep hard rock engineering.

title_en: Deep surrounding rock seepage stability analysis device and method under strong power disturbance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep surrounding rock seepage stability analysis device and method under strong power disturbance, which comprises a true triaxial stress loading system for applying true triaxial load to a surrounding rock physical model test piece containing a simulation tunnel, a high-pressure seepage loading mechanism connected with the upper end and the lower end of the true triaxial stress loading system, a true triaxial boundary seepage sealing mechanism sealed at each boundary edge of a square rock physical model test piece and a seepage control and monitoring mechanism. The method can simulate and analyze the change of the permeability characteristic of the surrounding rock under the conditions of three-dimensional stress, high seepage and strong dynamic disturbance load, and judge the potential danger of water inrush and other disaster phenomena.

title_en: Dam break process simulation method caused by seepage damage of tailing pond dam body
abstract_en: A simulation method of a dam break process caused by seepage damage of a dam body of a tailing pond comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out two-dimensional seepage stability analysis on a tailing dam according to dam body material mechanical parameters, upstream and downstream water levels and other information, and preliminarily drawing up a position of a seepage channel; then constructing a numerical model for developing the seepage damage breach of the tailing dam, simulating the development process of the seepage damage breach and determining the critical condition of the collapse of a seepage channel; and finally, simulating the overtopping and bursting process after the collapse of the permeation channel by using fluid mechanics analysis software, thereby realizing the dynamic simulation of the permeation and damage process of the whole tailing pond dam body. The method has the advantages of strong pertinence, low cost, easy operation, good result visualization and the like, can obtain the specific condition of dam break downstream disaster caused by the seepage damage of the dam body of the tailing pond, and provides basis for scientifically and reasonably making the emergency plan of the dam break of the tailing pond and emergency and remedial measures for the government decision-making department and related design units, thereby reducing the loss caused by the dam break of the tailing pond and reducing the accident risk.

title_en: Life information drilling detection device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a life information drilling detection device, adopt the embodiment of the utility model provides a detection device, because first controller adopts the high strength cable to be connected with the second controller, when taking place the mine disaster, can effectual assurance communication, and set up and can effectually explore the vital sign that is located its working range at electromagnetic wave emitter and electromagnetic wave receiving arrangement in the pit, and will explore information and send to first controller through the high strength transmission line, learn with the staff that is located first controller end, in time rescue stranded personnel.
assignees: XIAN SENLAN TECH AND TRADING CO LTD

title_en: Deterioration simulation system for falling zone of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster research, in particular to a reservoir area hydro-fluctuation belt degradation simulation system. The technical scheme simulates the rock mechanical property change of the falling zone rock mass under different water levels, different pressures and different temperature environments, the damage effect of pore water to the rock mass and the deterioration effect of dry-wet circulation to the rock mass, the method is used for improving the ecological restoration capacity and the landscape reconstruction capacity of the bank slope of the reservoir area, reducing the risk of secondary geological disasters in the reservoir area, improving the early warning and forecasting capacity of the geological disasters and guaranteeing the life and property safety of people.

title_en: Hydraulic blasting construction method for weakening overlying hard top plate of coal face
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic blasting construction method for weakening an overlying hard roof on a coal face, which relates to the technical field of coal mines and has the technical scheme that: the method comprises the following steps: s1, determining a target layer for implementing hydraulic blasting; s2, arranging hydraulic blasting fracturing drilling sites; s3, drilling a hydraulic blasting fracturing drill hole; s4, installing a hydraulic blasting assembly; s5, connecting corresponding detonating leads of the hydraulic blasting fracturing drill holes, and weakening the hydraulic blasting of the hard top plate covered on the coal face; and S6, repeating the steps S1 to S5 along with the advancing of the coal face. According to the construction method, the hard top plate covered on the coal face is weakened by adopting a hydraulic blasting method, the energy-gathering pipe, the emulsion explosive and the water bag can be automatically installed in the blast hole by adopting the hydraulic blasting drilling automatic installation device according to the determined weakened target layer, the blasting construction amount is simplified, the blasting construction efficiency is improved, and the disaster control period is shortened.

title_en: Pressure relief method for preventing air leakage and communicating accumulated water in goaf
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a pressure relief method for preventing air leakage and communicating accumulated water in a goaf, relates to the field of coal mine rock burst prevention and control, and comprises the following steps: grasping the width of a section wide coal pillar of a gob-side roadway of a first working face, and determining the width of a plastic zone on the side of a mining area of the wide coal pillar according to the existing monitoring data and a theoretical calculation formula; determining the large-diameter drilling depth of the wide coal pillar according to the width of the section wide coal pillar and the width of the plastic zone; determining a drill hole inclination angle; drilling according to the determined initial position and the end position of the drill hole and the drill hole inclination angle, and extending the drill hole to a coal seam higher than the roadway height in the goaf; after drilling is finished, hole sealing is immediately carried out on the hole opening section; and relieving pressure of the gob side roadway and the coal pillar area by utilizing the drill holes. Through adjusting the drilling position, avoided the pressure relief vent of boring to establish to become the passageway of intercommunication collecting space area and gob entry when carrying out the release, can prevent when the rock burst, prevent to leak out and switch on the geological disasters pressure of old empty water.
assignees: HUANENG QINGYANG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD HETAOYU COAL MINE;CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Wisdom emergency system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wisdom emergency system manages safety cabinet and first processing end through emergent safe high in the clouds in unison, has solved the problem of the communication interrupt that the calamity brought. The safety cabinet is arranged in a grid mode and intelligently managed, so that disaster relief materials go deep into the same line, and the loss of emergency materials is avoided. Through intelligent organization and training of first-line volunteers and alarm persons, the persons participating in disaster relief are organically combined with emergency articles, the disaster relief time is shortened, and the disaster relief effectiveness is improved. The analysis statistics of big data provides the basis for scientific emergency decision.

title_en: BIM-based geological disaster assessment method and device and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological disaster assessment method, a device and a computer readable storage medium based on BIM, which comprises a primary assessment result; the method comprises the steps of acquiring geological parameters of an evaluation area and geological information of the evaluation area, wherein the geological parameters comprise one or more of a geological plan, point data of a stratum interface and a state of a rock body interface; the geological information comprises the type and occurrence area of the geological problem; searching whether a reference model exists in an existing verification record according to geological information; if so, calling the reference model, modifying the reference model according to the geological parameters, and obtaining a new BIM geological model; if not, a new BIM geological model is created according to the geological parameters; acquiring a dynamic simulation instruction for controlling the BIM geological model to execute a simulation action, and recording a simulation process to obtain a simulation record; the simulation record is shown as a reference for correcting the result of one evaluation. The method and the device have the effect of assisting in improving the accuracy of ground disaster assessment.
assignees: CHONGQING 607 ENG SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional mobile monitoring system for sea area hydrate exploitation environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional mobile monitoring system for sea area hydrate exploitation environment, which comprises a mobile monitoring platform and a control unit thereof, wherein the mobile monitoring platform comprises a main cabin body, an environmental parameter monitoring unit, a terrain parameter monitoring unit, a cruise monitoring unit and a sampling unit, wherein the environmental parameter monitoring unit, the terrain parameter monitoring unit, the cruise monitoring unit and the sampling unit are arranged on the main cabin body and are used for monitoring the surrounding environment of a drilling platform and the terrain change; and an anchor system submerged buoy working unit is also arranged at the rear part of the main cabin body and is used for monitoring environmental parameters such as methane content, turbidity abnormality and the like, and the anchor system submerged buoy working unit stays and monitors at any height under the rotation of the winding car. The scheme realizes that parameters such as various environments are monitored in a circumferential direction and a vertical direction in an all-dimensional way by taking each production well as a circle center, avoids the condition that various cables are laid on the seabed or a workstation is built, realizes comprehensive and effective evaluation of the environmental effect of hydrate exploitation activities, pre-warns potential environmental disasters in advance, and provides a scientific evaluation system in the aspect of environment for commercial exploitation of hydrates.

title_en: Converter transformer fire combustion analog simulation experiment device and experiment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a converter transformer fire disaster combustion analog simulation experiment device and an experiment method thereof, wherein the experiment device is designed by adopting a simulation principle similar to a large-scale converter transformer, and is loaded with a temperature acquisition device, so that the problem that the combustion of a real-scale converter transformer cannot be truly simulated by the conventional small-size oil basin combustion is solved, the defects that the experiment phenomenon and the experiment result are not matched with the actual situation due to the fact that the structure of the experiment device is not consistent with the structure of the real-scale converter transformer in the conventional experiment are overcome, the whole combustion phenomenon of the converter transformer under the condition of sleeve explosion combustion of the converter transformer under the experiment condition is simulated, the experiment method is designed based on the experiment device, the combustion temperature, the combustion heat radiation and the infrared heat imaging data in the phenomenon can be monitored in real time, and favorable help is provided for researching the combustion rule of.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Monitoring and early warning experimental device for simulating soil liquefaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction engineering instruments, in particular to a monitoring and early warning experimental device for simulating soil liquefaction, which comprises a box body, a cover plate, a high-pressure water spraying simulation pipeline, a vibration simulation device and a landslide monitoring device, wherein the box body is of a hollow square structure with an opening at the top; the high-pressure water spraying simulation pipeline is arranged in soil of the box body, and a plurality of high-pressure nozzles are arranged on the high-pressure water spraying simulation pipeline; the vibration simulation device is one or a plurality of mutually parallel electromagnetic vibration tables arranged at the bottom of the inner cavity of the box body and can vibrate along the horizontal direction or the vertical direction; the landslide detection device comprises a hydraulic telescopic rod, a computer terminal and an alarm system, wherein the hydraulic telescopic rod is arranged in the middle of the cover plate and is used for being inserted into soil. The soil liquefaction demonstration device is reasonable in design, capable of visually demonstrating the macroscopic phenomenon and the main disaster characteristics of soil liquefaction, convenient to understand, strong in operability, low in demonstration cost, good in demonstration effect, capable of being repeatedly recycled, and strong in repeatability.

title_en: Three-dimensional laser scanning karst water inrush disaster magnitude evaluation test method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional laser scanning karst water inrush disaster magnitude evaluation test method and a device, wherein the geographic information of a target area to be evaluated is obtained by referring to historical data and surveying by using a three-dimensional laser scanner and a ground penetrating radar, simulation tests are respectively carried out in a laboratory and a field according to detection data, a risk evaluation index body is established by comparing the same points of two fields of test data, a risk evaluation model is established by combining index weight, the evaluation accuracy is improved, the karst water inrush disaster magnitude evaluation is rapidly carried out on subsequent tunnel construction by using the risk evaluation model, after karst cave data of the target area to be evaluated are measured, the evaluation report can be rapidly analyzed and calculated and generated through the risk evaluation model, the method is convenient and practical, a CPU processor is in bidirectional remote connection with an expert APP terminal through a wireless transceiving module, and a detection party carries out the karst water inrush disaster magnitude evaluation on the target area to be evaluated, and the experts synchronously modify the evaluation report, so that the accuracy of the evaluation report is improved.

title_en: Vulnerability assessment method for urban public transport system
abstract_en: A vulnerability assessment method of an urban public transportation system comprises the following steps: 1) firstly, a JavaScript API interface at a Web end of a bus website is used for acquiring bus stop and line information and processing data. 2) And modeling the public transportation system by using a Space L method, and giving the information of the station and the line to the node as attributes. 3) And modeling the disaster event according to different characteristics of the disaster event. 4) A new public transport network vulnerability index is provided, which represents the change of network performance. 5) Simulating and verifying the vulnerability of the public transport network under different disaster events, observing and recording the vulnerability index change of the network model in the simulation process, and obtaining the vulnerability assessment. The vulnerability assessment method of the urban public transport system provides support for daily maintenance and management and post-disaster resource allocation of the public transport system.

title_en: Landslide deep integration real-time supervision device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of automatic monitoring of landslide disasters, in particular to a landslide deep integrated real-time monitoring device which comprises an index monitoring column, a data processing box and a power supply unit, wherein the index monitoring column is embedded into the deep part of a landslide body to a slide bed part through a geological drilling hole on the surface of a landslide ground; the data processing box is riveted above the index monitoring column through an I-shaped bearing component, and a measuring line inside the data processing box is connected with the inside of the index monitoring column. The landslide monitoring system can monitor the change of the whole landslide process, is perfectly applicable to both initial-stage micro displacement and middle-and-later-stage horizontal large displacement, has large measurement range and high precision, can realize integrated automatic monitoring, can quickly, real-timely and comprehensively monitor and evaluate the landslide, has strong practicability and has good application prospect.

title_en: Rolling stone track calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating a rolling stone track, which adopts equipment comprising a nine-axis sensor, a wireless communication module and a computer, wherein the nine-axis sensor is installed in dangerous rock of a side slope and is communicated with the computer through the wireless communication module, a digital model of a target side slope is prestored in the computer to obtain a slope surface equation f (x, y), the calculation method comprises the steps of establishing a coordinate system with the dangerous rock as an original point on the side slope, dividing the rolling stone formed by the dangerous rock on the side slope into a sliding stage, a flying stage, a collision and bounce stage and a rolling stage, respectively calculating the displacement and the speed of the rolling stone of each stage, and finally comprehensively calculating the final position of the synthesized rolling stone to finish the calculation of the rolling stone track. The invention can accurately position the position corresponding to each time in the process of starting and falling the rolling stones, and simultaneously uses computer-aided simulation to ensure that the model can quickly and accurately predict the falling stone position so as to reduce the effect of disaster.
assignees: SHANDONG GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING CENTER SHANDONG GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONT

title_en: Coal petrography circulating friction-gas seepage flow coupling test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal petrography friction cycling-gas seepage flow coupling test device combines mining and the relevant on-the-spot actual conditions of rock mechanics, through the design that has recess centre gripping cushion and nested axial loading hydro-cylinder, has solved the problem of the sealed difficulty of device emphatically for the coupling analysis of coal petrography friction cycling and seepage flow problem can be realized. The device comprises a coal-rock circulating friction system, a gas injection and pressurization system and a data real-time acquisition system, can realize simultaneous implementation of circulating friction sliding and gas seepage of coal-rock mass, and utilizes the data real-time acquisition system to monitor and acquire data of a coal-rock circulating friction sliding state and gas migration characteristics, thereby realizing real simulation of coal-rock circulating sliding-gas seepage coupling characteristics, effectively simulating a fault structure or a gas-containing coal-rock circulating friction sliding phenomenon of a through crack, and having important significance for researching a coal and gas outburst mechanism induced by sliding instability and preventing and treating gas disasters.

title_en: Simulation device for inducing loess landslide through small rainfall irrigation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulation device for inducing loess landslide by small rainfall irrigation, which comprises a model box, a rainfall system and an irrigation system, wherein the model box is arranged on a base, the top surface of the model box is open, a spray frame of the rainfall system is arranged above the model box, a water pipe is fixed on the spray frame, and a plurality of atomization spray heads are arranged on the water pipe; a water pipe of an irrigation system is also arranged above the model box, and a water dropper is arranged on the water pipe of the irrigation system; the box antetheca of mold box is detachable baffle, and the front end bottom slope of mold box is provided with the detachable spout, and the front end nestification of spout has the extension groove of telescopic, is equipped with the fluted filter screen on the rear end bottom plate of spout, and the spout below is connected with the triangle-shaped funnel in fluted filter screen department, and the bottom of triangle-shaped funnel is equipped with the header tank. The utility model discloses but the change condition on loess slope under assay rainfall and the irrigation action, the overall process information that the disaster was caused in assay landslide motion, the more comprehensive accurate loess landslide motion that research rainfall and irrigation action caused disaster law.

title_en: Soil landslide disaster space-time intelligent pre-warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a soil landslide disaster space-time intelligent pre-warning method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring landslide disaster point data and non-landslide disaster point data; acquiring a landslide disaster pre-warning factor for intelligent learning according to a cause mechanism and an inducing factor of the landslide disaster; acquiring original data corresponding to pre-warning factors according to the landslide disaster point data and the non-landslide disaster point data; performing spatial analysis on the original data to extract a value of a landslide pre-warning factor for intelligent learning, and constructing a landslide disaster pre-warning sample data set after performing dimensionless processing on the obtained values of the pre-warning factor respectively; an intelligent learning module for landslide disaster pre-warning is built by adopting a stack generalization method of integrated machine learning, and landslide disaster pre-warning sample data sets are input into the intelligent learning module for training and optimization to realize landslide disaster pre-warning. The method has the advantages of high accuracy, low false alarm rate, short calculation time and good real-time performance when landslide prediction is carried out.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY;SICHUAN BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES CHENGDU INST OF HYDROGEOLOGY AND ENGINEERING GEOLOGY

title_en: Sound emission multi-precursor method and device for pulling-shearing dumping type karst dangerous rock instability early warning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sound emission multi-precursor method and device for early warning of pull-shear dumping type karst dangerous rock collapse, and aims to solve the problem of automatic early warning of pull-shear dumping type dangerous rock collapse disasters in a karst area. Firstly, according to the acoustic emission change characteristics immediately before the instability of the dangerous rock, making 4 relation rules of the acoustic emission precursor characteristics and the stability grade of the dangerous rock; then, 4 acoustic emission precursor characteristics of each stage in the dangerous rock instability process are collected from two ways of indoor tests and field examples to serve as a machine learning sample set; and finally, training an information vector machine learning model with excellent adaptability to the complex classification problems by utilizing the training sample set, establishing a nonlinear mapping relation between the acoustic emission precursor characteristics and the dangerous rock stability, further realizing the rapid evaluation of the dangerous rock stability grade in online monitoring, and transmitting the evaluation result to an early warning information receiving terminal of a dangerous rock manager through an early warning device.

title_en: Hydropower station dam break disaster event scene construction and emergency evaluation analysis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station dam break disaster event situation construction and emergency evaluation analysis system, which comprises an environment monitoring module, an environment analysis module, a situation construction module and an emergency plan management module, wherein the environment monitoring module is used for monitoring environment data around a dam; the environment analysis module is used for analyzing the environment data around the dam and judging whether the dam break risk exists; the scene construction module is used for constructing a dam break accident scene according to the analysis result of the environmental data and demonstrating the scene in an augmented reality or virtual reality mode; and the emergency plan management module is used for providing a corresponding emergency plan according to the dam break accident scene. The invention can analyze the whole state and weak links of the current emergency capacity, provides a strategy suggestion, and guides the improvement of an emergency plan, the emergency preparation and the emergency capacity improvement.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG BAOXINGHE WATER POWER CO LTD;SHENZHEN ZHONGZHIAN CO LTD

title_en: Pedestrian evacuation method considering motion characteristics of disabled people
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pedestrian evacuation method considering the movement characteristics of disabled people, which comprises the following steps: step S1, acquiring exit information and internal structure information of the area to be evacuated; step S2, acquiring personnel distribution information and calculating the static field distribution in the area to be evacuated; step S3, acquiring the motion characteristics of various pedestrians through simulation; step S4, calculating the distribution of the dynamic field and the prediction field in the area to be evacuated; s5, obtaining various pedestrian decisions through simulation; step S6, simulating the pedestrian movement path according to the movement module; and step S7, analyzing the preliminary simulation result, and optimizing the personnel decision and evacuation scheme to obtain the optimal evacuation scheme. The invention considers the movement characteristics of disabled people and effectively improves the evacuation efficiency aiming at the evacuation of complex and multi-category people in large public buildings.

title_en: Recyclable and continuous natural gas hydrate exploitation device with desulfurization system and exploitation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for realizing continuous and cyclic exploitation and desulfurization of natural gas hydrate, which are provided with an offshore and excavation system and a hoisting deviceThe system comprises a system, a hydrate decomposition system, a waste backfilling system and a hydrate method natural gas desulfurization system. The method adopts a double-channel continuous pipe as a drill rod, adopts the methods of directional drilling and high-pressure jet flow to crush along a natural gas hydrate layer, and forms a slurry mixture; the slurry mixture is conveyed to a decomposition and separation device through an ore pulp conveying pipeline inside the double-channel continuous pipe, natural gas is collected and used after being desulfurized after the slurry mixture is decomposed and separated, and liquid waste and solid waste are conveyed to a mined area through high-pressure fluid of the double-channel continuous pipe to be backfilled. The method has the advantages of integrated drilling and production, continuous production, controllable direction and removal of H from the collected natural gas  2  S, and meanwhile, the waste is backfilled to the mined-out area, so that the possibility of geological disasters is reduced.

title_en: Engineering structure model test system under environment load coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to an engineering structure model test system under the environment load coupling effect, which comprises: the environment simulation box comprises an environment simulation box and a loading assembly. The environment simulation box is used for placing an engineering structure for simulation test and providing preset environment conditions for the engineering structure. Carry out the test work to engineering structure, place engineering structure in the environmental simulation case, provide predetermined environmental condition for engineering structure by the environmental simulation case, reappear different natural environment factor, meanwhile, carry out vertical and horizontally multidirectional loading in step by the loading subassembly, the loading subassembly will simulate external load and transmit for engineering structure, also can consider different natural environment factor and external load intercoupling simultaneously and to engineering structure's quiet power and dynamic response's influence, simulation test is more true, can realize carrying out experimental study to engineering structure structural performance evolution law and disaster-causing mechanism etc. under environmental load coupling.

title_en: Urban rainstorm waterlogging fine simulation method
