abstract_en: The invention discloses a fine simulation method for urban rainstorm waterlogging, which comprises the following steps: calculating a rainstorm process line of the design surface at each time interval according to the actual measurement data of the rainstorm of the calculated area; extracting elevation points according to the requirements of flood analysis and calculation on the terrain, and checking and correcting the extracted elevation points; filling and leveling the construction pit and the mound in the construction site of the urban area respectively; determining inner and outer boundaries of the calculated region; dividing the calculation area into grids, and performing property division on the land; determining the water pumping and draining capacity; determining the roughness, runoff coefficient, source and sink terms, dry and wet boundaries, calculating time and step length and outputting parameters of the model; and (5) verifying the model. According to the method, a refined model of the urban rainstorm waterlogging is established, various factors influencing the rainstorm waterlogging in the urban area are comprehensively considered, the evolution process of the urban rainstorm waterlogging is analyzed and researched, the disaster management level of the government is favorably improved, and the disaster influence of the urban rainstorm waterlogging is reduced to the greatest extent.

title_en: Reservoir bank water level change and slope angle variable landslide model test device and method under earthquake and rainfall coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for a landslide model with variable water level change and variable slope angle of a reservoir bank under the coupling effect of earthquake and rainfall, belonging to the field of landslide disaster test of side slope engineering, wherein the device comprises a model box, a rainfall system, an electric lifting system and a deformation monitoring system; the model box comprises a bottom plate, front, back, left and right side plates and an inner water permeable plate; the rainfall system comprises a water storage tank, a water pump, a main water supply pipe, an electronic control main valve, a flowmeter, a spray head, a rainfall system bracket and a jack; the electric lifting system comprises a servo motor, a bearing and a belt; the deformation monitoring system includes a three-dimensional laser scanner. The method comprises the following steps: and (3) jacking the rainfall system support to a proper height, filling soil in the model box, then lifting the model box to a specified angle, simulating rainfall working conditions, starting the vibrating table, and monitoring slope deformation by using a three-dimensional laser scanner during a test. The invention realizes the simulation of various rainfall conditions, adjusts the landslide model at any angle, and realizes landslide tests with different dip angles.

title_en: Remote sensing building earthquake damage assessment method and system based on deep learning and cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing building earthquake damage assessment method and system based on deep learning and cloud computing. The method mainly comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of expanding a sample set of buildings and earthquake-damaged buildings before and after an earthquake based on a characteristic image, designing a deep convolution network model suitable for completely collapsed buildings, partially collapsed buildings and complete buildings, automatically acquiring hyper-parameters based on an intelligent body, respectively training the completely collapsed buildings, the partially collapsed buildings and the complete buildings at the cloud, extracting an image disaster area after the earthquake, and marking the disaster damage level of the buildings before the earthquake, completely collapsing the earthquake and counting and drawing the number of the buildings in the partially collapsed area. The disclosed system is oriented to the user requirements of disaster prevention and reduction departments and comprises a user terminal, a network communication base station, a gateway server and a central cloud server. The invention improves the timeliness, the accuracy and the intelligent level of the acquisition and evaluation of the earthquake damage information of the building.

title_en: Gas pressure testing equipment and method for ultra-long drilling coal seam
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal seam gas extraction, and particularly relates to an ultra-long drilling coal seam gas pressure testing device and method. According to the device and the method disclosed by the invention, the gas pressure sensor is connected with the pressure gauge, so that the gas pressure in the pressure measuring air chamber can be monitored in real time through the pressure gauge, and the coal bed gas disaster can be greatly reduced.
assignees: HENAN ENERGY AND CHEMICAL INDUSTRY GROUP RES GENERAL INSTITUTE CO LTD;YONGGUI ENERGY DEV CO LTD XINTIAN COAL MINE

title_en: Earthquake disaster loss prediction and evaluation method and system based on Softmax regression model
abstract_en: A seismic disaster damage prediction and evaluation method and system based on a Softmax regression model relate to the technical field of seismic disaster damage prediction and evaluation, solve the problem of how to improve the accuracy of seismic disaster damage prediction and the training speed, use different seismic disaster damage degree grades as classification labels of the Softmax regression classification model, select past seismic disaster characteristic data for training, and predict the past seismic disaster damage by using the Softmax regression classification model; inputting new earthquake disaster characteristic data and classification labels in a Softmax regression classification model; judging the classification weight of the input data belonging to each earthquake disaster damage degree grade; determining a classification label corresponding to the input data according to the classification weight, thereby determining the damage degree grade of the new earthquake disaster; compared with a Back Propagation (BP) neural network and a Support Vector Machine (SVM), the method has the advantages of stronger capability of distinguishing the earthquake disaster loss, high test precision and short test time.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV;ANHUI THEONE SAFETY TECH CO LTD;HEFEI CITY LIFELINE ENG SAFETY OPERATION MONITORING CENTER

title_en: Extraction method, device, equipment and storage medium of natural disaster event
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for extracting natural disaster events, and relates to the technical field of deep learning. The specific implementation mode of the extraction method of the natural disaster event comprises the following steps: sentence-dividing processing is carried out on the news text to obtain a word vector of each character; inputting the word vector of each character into a pre-training model for training and predicting at the same time, wherein the pre-training model outputs the feature vector of the word vector of each character; creating a trigger word and element extraction model, and using a transfer learning method to take a pre-training model as a word embedding layer of the trigger word and element extraction model; the trigger words and elements of the natural disaster event are extracted from the news text by using the trigger word and element extraction model based on the deep learning method, so that the semantic relevance of the trigger words and the event sentences is greatly enhanced, and the accuracy of the event trigger word extraction and the accuracy of the element extraction are greatly improved.

title_en: Method for evaluating toughness of power distribution network in typhoon weather, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-stage evaluation method, a storage medium and equipment for the toughness of a power distribution network in typhoon weather, wherein when no typhoon disaster occurs, the influence of the typhoon disaster on the power distribution network and the response process of the power distribution network to the typhoon disaster are simulated and analyzed, and the pre-disaster toughness index of the power distribution network is counted and calculated; in the typhoon disaster occurrence process, calculating toughness indexes in the power distribution network disaster according to real-time data returned by the power distribution network data acquisition and monitoring control system; acquiring actual data of emergency response and emergency repair of the power distribution network after the typhoon leaves the environment, and calculating a post-disaster toughness index of the power distribution network; the three-stage toughness level of the power distribution network is quantized, and the pre-disaster firmness degree, the in-disaster resisting capability, the post-disaster recovery efficiency and the comprehensive toughness of the power distribution network for coping with typhoon disasters are quantized. The method can be used for guiding reinforcement of the elements of the power distribution network when no typhoon occurs, emergency control in the process of typhoon disaster and emergency repair and power restoration after typhoon disaster, and provides quantitative basis for system planning, operation scheduling and restoration decision.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Performance detection system and method of UWB radar life detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance detection system and a method of a UWB radar life detection device, wherein the detection system consists of a field simulation device, a position moving device, a life sign simulation device and a movable interference device; placing equipment to be tested on one side of the post-disaster field simulation device, wherein one side is a life signal detection area; the position moving device is arranged in a life signal detection area of the post-disaster field simulation device; the vital sign simulation device is arranged on the position moving device; the movable interference means are arranged in the buried vital signal detection area at random according to reality. When the UWB radar life detection device is detected, the life sign simulation device moves in a life signal detection area, and detection of detection distance, field angle, angle and distance information resolution, multi-target anti-interference capability and dynamic target detection capability is completed. The invention can simulate the actual conditions of different burying depths, burying materials, a plurality of living bodies and micro-moving living bodies, thereby carrying out target two-dimensional detection on the device, having high detection precision and good applicability.

title_en: Portable fire control linkage teaching demonstration platform
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable fire control linkage teaching demonstration platform, this platform includes: the fire-fighting truck comprises a truck body, a power line, an alarm device, a linkage device, a fire-fighting controller, a detection tester and a module box. Wherein the vehicle body is used for teaching demonstration; the fire-fighting controller is used for receiving the alarm signal and sending out a linkage signal; the alarm device comprises a smoke detector, a temperature detector, a manual alarm button and a fire hydrant button. The linkage device comprises an acousto-optic alarm, an emergency lighting lamp, an evacuation indicator light, an automatic water spraying device, a fireproof roller shutter and a fan. The testing device is a probing tester. The utility model provides a teaching demonstration platform removes conveniently, really triggers alarm device, the true action of all kinds of aggregate unit, and the real water spray of shower nozzle realizes cutting the electricity, emergency light lights, reputation alarm, fan start, fire prevention roll up curtain decline demonstration, and the effect is directly perceived, true, can be used to fire extinguishing system teaching and fire control safety training.

title_ko: 실리카 존재 시 pfas의 파괴
abstract_ko: 우리는 실리카의 존재하에 PFAS를 가열하면 놀랍게도 가벼운 조건에서 PFAS의 90% 이상이 파괴되는 것을 발견했다. 실험 결과는 상기 반응이 반응 중 또는 이전 반응에서 생성된 HF에 의해 유발된 것으로 추정되는 석영 글래스의 에칭과 함께 발생함을 보여준다. PFAS를 파괴하는 방법은 PFAS의 제조 또는 활용과 관련된 산업 현장의 농축된 폐기물 용액뿐만 아니라, AFFF 폐기물 저장물 및 소방 훈련장 주변 정화에서 흔히 볼 수 있는 상대적으로 농축된 용액을 처리하는 데 특히 효과적이다.

title_en: Strong convection weather identification algorithm based on convolutional neural network learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster prediction, in particular to a strong convection weather identification algorithm based on convolutional neural network learning, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting a historical weather flow pattern model, then training and learning through the convolutional neural network, and obtaining an identification model for the historical weather flow pattern through training and learning; then adopting a real-time stormy weather flow pattern model through a radar real-time weather image, and identifying the real-time weather flow pattern model through an identification model obtained through training in the step one; judging whether the real-time weather system of the weather flow pattern model identified in the second step is positioned in the monitored key area or not; if yes, outputting a weather flow pattern conforming to the occurrence of geological disasters; if not, continuing to perform real-time identification. According to the method, radar images of strong convective weather are identified in real time, models obtained through convolutional neural network learning training are identified, and different weather models and disaster models in a monitored area can be effectively obtained.

title_en: Rainfall dangerous rock falling simulation device
abstract_en: The invention provides a rainfall induced dangerous rock falling simulation device, which belongs to the field of geological disaster experimental equipment and comprises a test box, a supporting plate, an angle adjusting mechanism, a dangerous rock simulation unit, a rainfall simulation mechanism and a camera; the supporting plate is arranged in the test box; the angle adjusting mechanism is respectively connected with the supporting plate and the test box and is used for adjusting the angle of the supporting plate relative to the bottom plate of the test box; the dangerous rock simulation unit is arranged on the supporting plate and used for simulating a side slope and dangerous rocks; the rainfall simulation mechanism is arranged at the top of the test box and used for simulating rainfall; the camera is arranged in the test box and used for acquiring images of dangerous rock movement. The rainfall dangerous rock falling simulation device provided by the invention can simulate scenes with different slopes and different slope heights under the same rock quality condition, is simple and convenient in adjustment process and easy to operate, can effectively increase the experimental flexibility of the simulation device, can obtain more representative data under the experimental conditions with different slopes, and can further better meet the experimental requirements.

title_en: Side slope rolling stone early warning system based on nine sensors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope rolling stone early warning system based on a nine-axis sensor, which comprises a remote control system, a field data acquisition subsystem and a data transmission subsystem for communication of the field data acquisition subsystem and the field data acquisition subsystem; the remote control system comprises a geographic information subsystem, a rolling stone track calculation subsystem and a model early warning subsystem, wherein the geographic information subsystem is used for storing a digital model of the target slope; the rolling stone track calculation subsystem is used for establishing a rolling stone landslide track calculation model library and calculating the track of the rolling stone according to different initial boundary conditions; the model early warning subsystem is used for predicting a rolling rock falling point according to the triggering of the landslide and the rolling rock track simulated and calculated by the rolling rock track calculation subsystem, judging an influence area by combining a nearby house and a nearby road and sending early warning information; the field data acquisition subsystem comprises nine sensors installed in slope dangerous rocks. According to the invention, the position of the rolling stone can be quickly and accurately positioned through data sent by the nine-axis sensor in real time, and the disaster situation is effectively relieved.
assignees: SHANDONG GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING GENERAL STATION SHANDONG GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION A

title_en: Flood disaster prediction and early warning method based on QR-BC-ELM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster prediction and early warning method based on QR-BC-ELM, which relates to the technical field of flood early warning, considers various flood causes, establishes a flood model based on an extreme learning machine and a geographic information system so as to simulate a flood prone area of a yellow river basin and verify the efficiency and precision advantages of the extreme learning machine relative to an artificial neural network. The learning speed of the improved extreme learning model provided by the invention is 32 times that of the artificial neural network and 1.2 times that of the traditional extreme learning model. Moreover, the noise processing capacity of the orthogonal triangular decomposition extreme learning model and the full-rank decomposition extreme learning model is greatly superior to that of an artificial neural network, and the BC-ELM and the QR-ELM have great advantages in the aspects of prediction precision and prediction efficiency, and are more suitable for selecting a flood forecasting model.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Domestic conflagration automatic alarm device of thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Internet of things household automatic fire alarm device, which comprises an automatic alarm host and a suspension assembly, wherein the lower end of a hook assembly penetrates through an upper connecting sheet and is movably connected with an inner cavity at the upper end of an upright post, the hook component can be directly hung at the upper end of an indoor round column corresponding to the wall body without drilling, the hanging is convenient, the use flexibility of the hook component is improved, the upper screw is in threaded connection with four corners of the upper connecting sheet, the automatic fire alarm device can be arranged at the upper end of the inner side of the house by the upper connecting sheet through the upper screw, when a fire disaster occurs, the device realizes timely alarm, the user can alarm in time, the depth of the lower column groove and the upper column groove is equal to the length of the uppermost end surface and the lowermost end surface of the hook component, can contract the couple subassembly, not only be convenient for go up connection piece and wall fixed mounting, reduce the occupation of land space of hanging the subassembly moreover, portable.

title_en: Natural disaster early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster early warning system which comprises an information acquisition unit, an image processing unit, a prediction model establishing unit, a disaster prediction unit and an early warning unit. The disaster prediction method based on the machine learning is characterized in that the disaster sample data in the sample data set which is formed by quantizing the scene image information shot by the camera and the natural state information detected by the sensor are trained by adopting the machine learning method, then the optimal disaster prediction model is obtained by detecting according to the evaluation index, the disaster prediction can be carried out on the scene transmitted by the information acquisition unit in the disaster prediction model in real time, the sample data is trained by adopting the distributed data processing system which is constructed by a plurality of servers and the calculation host in the prediction model establishing unit, and the distributed data processing system is used for carrying out parallel training on the sample data, so that the efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: CHENGDU CHINA METRO TRACK EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Square combined multi-layer experimental device for simulating crowd flow of zebra fish
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a square combination multiple layer formula experimental apparatus that is used for zebra fish simulation crowd to flow, including partition panel, keep away dangerous cabin, light filling ware, drain pipe, support frame, carbon fiber filter, water purification case, base, turbine suction pump, square fish bowl, shock generator, inlet tube, hemisphere bell and spring fixing ware. The utility model has the advantages that: the length and width dimensions of the square fish tank and the length-width ratio of an actual crowd dense building place are 0.08, so that the model is more reasonable in design and has better comparability, zebra fish used for simulating crowd flowing is cultured in the square fish tank, the crowd behavior rule of human beings can be better reflected in emergency evacuation simulation, the water surface of the square fish tank is controlled to be about 1cm when the zebra fish is cultured, the behavior of the fish crowd is strictly controlled to be two-dimensional, overlapping can not occur, and meanwhile, the influence of the refraction effect caused by the depth of the water surface on observation can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Power grid disaster emergency drilling management system based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid disaster emergency drilling management system based on a deep neural network, which comprises a disaster variable capturing module, a disaster variable capturing module and a disaster section processing module, wherein the disaster variable capturing module is used for capturing the electric quantity change characteristics when a disaster occurs through the historical experience of a disaster section; the scene screening and analyzing module is connected with the disaster variable capturing module, acquires a rule by analyzing the change characteristics of the electrical quantity, and captures a corresponding disaster scene from a plurality of scenes by applying the rule; the disaster self-learning module is connected with the scene screening and analyzing module and is used for screening disaster scenes by adopting a deep neural network algorithm; the evaluation analysis module is connected with the disaster self-learning module and is used for quantitatively evaluating the severity of the power grid disaster by using the screened disaster scene; the emergency management module is connected with the evaluation analysis module, and is used for carrying out power grid disaster emergency drilling management according to the result of quantitative evaluation, so that the problem that the conventional power grid disaster emergency drilling management system is difficult to solve when the specific optimization calculation of the number of numerous disaster scenes is faced is solved.

title_en: Market three-dimensional digital emergency plan drilling system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional digital emergency plan drilling system for a shopping mall, which comprises a scene building module, a facility data acquisition module, a plan making module, a dynamic deduction module and a plan output module, wherein the scene building module builds a 3D scene, a building and fire fighting equipment of the shopping mall and realizes step-by-step visualization; the facility data acquisition module acquires information of indoor and outdoor fire-fighting facilities; the plan making module simulates an event site in a three-dimensional scene to realize the rapid making of a three-dimensional digital plan; the dynamic deduction module automatically plays demonstration in an animation mode, so that a user can conveniently check the deduction process; the plan output module forms the three-dimensional digital plan made by the plan making module into a text plan with the image-text and the standard format. The invention also provides a three-dimensional digital emergency plan practicing method for the shopping mall. The invention has the advantages of realizing large-scale scene display and data integration, and providing powerful guarantee for all levels of firefighters to be familiar with key unit conditions, implement simulation drilling and effectively organize fire-fighting rescue.

title_en: Automatic driving test scene construction method, device and equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for constructing an automatic driving test scene and a readable storage medium, wherein an element scene is extracted from a real traffic scene to establish an element scene description model, a description variable value is selected from an element scene description variable distribution interval, and the description variable is randomly sampled according to the description variable distribution by an importance sampling-based Monte Carlo method to generate a test element scene; the method can directly simulate an actual complex system, effectively solve the problem of result distortion caused by the simplification of the complex system and avoid the problem of dimension disaster that numerical solution errors of high-dimension problems rapidly increase along with the increase of dimensions; by adopting the high-risk scene strengthening generation method, more high-risk scenes are generated with smaller calculation overhead, the number of the high-risk scenes in the generated scenes is effectively increased, the number of the low-risk scenes is reduced, and the testing efficiency is improved.

title_en: River mouth area extreme storm surge water level calculation method based on JPM-OS-Q model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a JPM-OS-Q model-based estuary region extreme storm surge water level calculation method, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a hydrodynamic force numerical model and verifying the reliability of the model; s2, clearly researching main influence factors of the extreme water level of the storm surge in the area, introducing upstream runoff, and establishing a probability model of each driving element; s3, generating astronomical tides based on a Monte Carlo stochastic model, generating typhoon paths changing along with time based on historical typical typhoons and mobile wind field and air pressure field parameters caused by each generated typhoon; and S4, predicting the extremely high water level of the estuary region based on the discrete product-solving joint probability optimization model. The method for calculating the extreme storm surge in the estuary area improves the parameter selection, typhoon path and other settings of the original JPM-OS-Q model, simulates and calculates the extreme storm surge high water level in the high recurrence period of the estuary area, improves the prediction level of the extreme water level, improves the marine disaster prevention and reduction capability, and can be widely applied to the calculation of the extreme storm surge in the estuary area.

title_en: Coal and gas outburst disaster simulation box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation box body which comprises a box body, wherein a preheating structure is arranged in the box body; wherein, preheating structure contains: the device comprises a feeding pipe, a first electromagnetic valve, a placing plate, a plurality of heating pipes with the same structure, a temperature sensor, a display and an exhaust assembly; the invention relates to the technical field of coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation, and solves the problem that coal cannot be preheated firstly in the existing coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method based on attention mechanism and cyclic neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hyperspectral image classification method based on an attention mechanism and a cyclic neural network, which mainly solves the problem of low classification precision caused by insufficient hyperspectral image feature extraction in the prior art. The implementation steps are as follows: (1) constructing a recurrent neural network; (2) generating a training set; (3) training a recurrent neural network; (4) classifying the hyperspectral image to be classified. The invention utilizes the attention proposal module and the processing module to obtain the local area which needs to be focused on by the spatial pixel block of the input hyperspectral image, utilizes the cyclic neural network to extract the spatial-spectral joint characteristics of the hyperspectral image to be classified to obtain the classification result, has the advantage of high classification precision of the hyperspectral image, and can be used for ground object target identification in the fields of resource exploration, forest covering, disaster monitoring and the like.

title_en: Fire-fighting channel safety detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire control channel safety detection method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a fire control channel picture and a reference picture to be detected; inputting the firefighting channel picture to be detected and the reference picture into a pre-trained feature extraction model which ignores illumination change to obtain picture features to be detected and reference picture features; and detecting whether an obstacle exists in the fire fighting access according to the similarity of the picture features to be detected and the reference picture features. According to the fire-fighting channel safety detection method disclosed by the invention, the image features to be detected and the reference image features under the condition of fire-fighting channel safety are extracted by training the feature extraction model which ignores illumination changes in advance, whether obstacles exist in the fire-fighting channel is determined based on the feature similarity, interference caused by the illumination changes is eliminated, and the detection accuracy is greatly improved.

title_en: Internet of things intelligent training room safety management method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety management method and a safety management device for an intelligent training room of the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring room attribute information and practical training equipment information of the first practical training room; inputting the room attribute information and the training equipment information into a training model; obtaining danger level information of the first training room; determining whether to obtain the information of the lessees in the first training room or not according to the danger level information and a first preset condition; and determining whether the intelligent management platform sends safety training information to the lessees or not according to the lessee information and the second preset information. The technical problems that safety precaution consciousness of students is not enough, emergency measures taken by managers for dealing with emergency accidents are not in place, and personnel are untimely to evacuate are solved, safety education of the students is strengthened, emergency measures can be taken for emergency events and hidden dangers, evacuation of the students is organized, early warning is achieved, and loss is reduced.
assignees: JIANGSU VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF BUSINESS;NANTONG ZHIDA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for monitoring three-dimensional surface deformation by fusing multi-source SAR data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring three-dimensional surface deformation by fusing multi-source SAR data. The method is characterized in that multi-source SAR images are fused, namely ASAR and TSX data respectively, wherein the ASAR data have low spatial resolution and weak information description capacity on ground features, but the ASAR data have wide width, and the TSX data have very high spatial resolution and narrow width, so that the fusion of the ASAR and the TSX data is very meaningful for monitoring the ground surface deformation in consideration of the spatial resolution and the area covered by the space, the two images are fused to achieve the purpose of good-bad complementation, the application prospect of InSAR on ground monitoring is expanded, and the cost of ground observation and the technical limit are reduced. On the basis, the deformation model is built for simulation, so that the three-dimensional deformation condition of the earth surface can be better and more intuitively obtained, and suggestions can be effectively provided for preventing geological disasters. Meanwhile, better opinions are provided for the development of the society, which has important significance for the society and people.
assignees: SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST OF GUANGDONG NUCLEAR INDUSTRY GEOLOGY BUREAU

title_en: Fire engineering is with perforating wall drilling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire engineering technical field just discloses a fire engineering is with perforating drilling equipment, including the drilling case, drilling case right side threaded connection has the dwang, the left end of dwang runs through and threaded connection to the inside of drilling case, the left side fixedly connected with registration arm of drilling case, the registration arm right side is linked together with the inside of drilling case. The utility model discloses a, through the motor in the install bin, can drive transmission part when the operation, the toper ring gear is installed to the perforated pipe left end, transmission part's left side and toper ring gear meshing, thereby make the motor can drive the perforated pipe when rotating and rotate, the drilling tooth punches to the wall, control the dwang rotation after that, it punches to drive the perforated pipe and be close to the wall, make the intraductal monoblock wall of perforated can directly separate with the wall, take out by the positioning suction cup again, make the device reach can swiftly the efficient and drill to the wall, but disaster recovery personnel high efficiency accepts the rescue.
assignees: SHANDONG XINKE CONSTRUCTION ENG FIRE FIGHTING ENG CO LTD

title_en: Disaster information Bowen classification method based on integration of BERT (binary-weighted Transmission technology) with bidirectional LSTM and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for classifying blog information about disaster information based on the integration of BERT, bidirectional LSTM and attention mechanism, which is used for solving the problem of temporarily evaluating the importance of social media text information when a disaster comes, and comprises two major stages of training and classification, wherein the training stage comprises the following five steps: preprocessing training data; obtaining a word vector of training data by using a BERT model; extracting the characteristics of the word vector sequence by using a bidirectional LSTM algorithm; weighting by using an attention mechanism to obtain a text-label importance characteristic vector; constructing a feedforward neural network and training; a classification stage, classifying the texts to be classified by utilizing the trained network; the attention mechanism in the training phase is divided into two steps, with the second step of the attention mechanism being used for training only. The method is different from the original text embedding mode, overcomes the problem of scarce short text characteristics, and obviously improves the classification effect.

title_en: Real-time correction calculation method for rolling stone track
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time correction calculation method for a barren rock track, which comprises nine sensors, a wireless communication module and a computer, wherein the nine sensors are installed in side slope dangerous rock and are communicated with the computer through the wireless communication module, a digital model of a target side slope and a plurality of barren rock flying models are prestored in the computer, when the dangerous rock loosens to become barren rock, the nine sensors monitor the barren rock position and speed signals in real time, the computer compares the received barren rock position and speed signals with the plurality of barren rock Dan Fei falling models according to a certain frequency, the closest barren rock flying model is screened according to the comparison result, and then the subsequent track is calculated and predicted by using the barren rock Dan Fei falling model. According to the invention, the position of the rolling stone can be monitored in real time through the nine-axis sensor, and is fed back to the computer for simulation calculation, and which model is adopted for track prediction in the next stage is judged according to the current position and the previous track, so that the effect of disaster situation is reduced.

title_en: Method of Controlling Virtual Reality Control System for chemical accident response training
title_ko: 화학 사고 대응 훈련용 가상 현실 제어 시스템의 제어방법
abstract_en: A control method of a virtual reality control system for chemical accident response training of the present invention comprises: a step of determining whether a user has performed an emergency action step; a step of determining whether the user has performed a leak information identification step after the emergency action step; a step of determining whether the user has performed a transfer pump stopping step after the leak information identification step; a step of determining whether the user has performed a leak containment step after the transfer pump stopping step; a step of determining whether the user has performed a diffusion blocking step after the leak containment step; and a step of determining whether the user has performed a valve blocking step after the diffusion blocking step, wherein whether the valve blocking step is performed may be determined based on the rotation of a simulator corresponding to a valve. Accordingly, disaster training can be conducted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 화학 사고 대응 훈련용 가상 현실 제어 시스템의 제어 방법은, 사용자가 비상조치 단계를 수행하였는지 여부를 판단하는 단계; 상기 비상조치 단계 이후 상기 사용자가 누출정보 식별 단계를 수행하였는지 여부를 판단하는 단계; 상기 누출정보 식별 단계 이후 상기 사용자가 이송펌프 중지 단계를 수행하였는지 여부를 판단하는 단계; 상기 이송펌프 중지 단계 이후 상기 사용자가 누출봉쇄 단계를 수행하였는지 여부를 판단하는 단계; 상기 누출봉쇄 단계 이후 상기 사용자가 확산 차단 단계를 수행하였는지 여부를 판단하는 단계; 및 상기 확산 차단 단계 이후 상기 사용자가 밸브 차단 단계를 수행하였는지 여부를 판단하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 밸브 차단 단계의 수행여부는 밸브와 대응되는 시뮬레이터의 회전에 기초하여 판단될 수 있다.

title_en: Storm surge extreme water level prediction method based on random statistical model and hydrodynamic model coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm surge extreme water level prediction method based on coupling of a random statistical model and a hydrodynamic model, and belongs to the technical field of ocean science and ocean engineering. The method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting hydrological and topographic data in the area, establishing a Delft3D hydrodynamic model and verifying; s2, establishing a main historical typhoon database and a Roche storm surge driving element set; s3, recombining storm surge driving elements based on Monte Carlo; s4, selecting and verifying a proper typhoon field model; and S5, simulating and predicting the extreme high water level based on the storm surge of the typical historical typhoon. The method comprehensively considers the influence of climate change and sea level rise on the extreme water level value, can be used for predicting the extreme water levels in different reappearance periods and numerical forecasting of storm surge, is favorable for preventing and reducing disasters so as to reduce the disaster loss of coastal vulnerable areas, and is favorable for reasonable planning and design.

title_en: BIM-based fire drill method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting, in particular to a BIM-based fire fighting drilling method, which comprises the steps of collecting structural data among different buildings through a three-dimensional scanning device, restoring a matched building structural model according to the data collected by the three-dimensional scanning device through a BIM building system, designing fire fighting evacuation routes according to different building structures on the premise of ensuring personal safety in a safety area near a fire, optimally selecting evacuation parameters of different fire fighting routes, and finally selecting a fire fighting drilling scheme most suitable for the buildings and storing the fire fighting drilling scheme into a BIM database. The invention has scientific structure, time and labor saving and can finally evolve an optimized fire-fighting drilling scheme.
assignees: SHENZHEN CITY FEISHANG ZHONGCHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rock-soil particle damage localization identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying the local damage of rock and soil particles, and relates to the field of research on geotechnical engineering disasters. The method defines a dimensionless particle contact deformation index as a measure index of deformation damage degree, comprehensively considers the particle translation and rotation motion and continuous deformation after contact disconnection, defines a corresponding threshold value and a determining method, judges the region with the deformation index larger than the threshold value as a damage localized region of rock-soil body, and can identify catastrophe damages of various geotechnical engineering such as underground chamber excavation surrounding rock fracture, landslide sliding surface (belt) and the like. The method is simple and practical, has reliable result, is suitable for both rock mass and soil mass, can definitely determine the damage range, and overcomes the defect that the traditional numerical simulation method qualitatively judges the deformation damage localization according to the color depth of the deformation cloud picture.

title_en: Virtualized disk double-active disaster recovery method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a virtualized disk dual-active disaster recovery method, a device and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: starting a virtual machine in a double-activity disaster tolerance mode; when the virtual machine normally runs, simultaneously writing the input and output files of the virtual machine into two disk files of the original virtual machine simulator; when one disk file or the storage pool where the disk file is located has an error, writing the input and output file of the virtual machine into the disk file which has no error; and executing the mirror image of the original quorum equipment simulation layer, and respectively copying the disk files which are not in error to the two disk files below the quorum equipment simulation layer after the mirror image. Based on the method, the invention also provides a virtualized disk dual-active disaster recovery device and a virtualized disk dual-active disaster recovery system. The invention adds double-activity optimization to the virtualized disk on the virtualized platform, so that the ICS provides double-activity disaster tolerance to the disk of the virtual machine on the software level when the ICS does not depend on expensive hardware disk double activities.
assignees: SUZHOU INSPUR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Training material system for measuring fire fighting training, and method for measuring fire fighting training using the system
title_ko: 소방 훈련 평가용 교보재 시스템 및 이를 이용한 소방 훈련 평가 방법
abstract_en: A training aid system for evaluating firefighting training according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an educational fire extinguisher; a training fire generator which generates smoke to simulate a fire situation, provides information on whether or not the education fire extinguisher is normally used based on a spraying material sprayed through the education fire extinguisher, and counts the elapsed time from the time of smoke occurrence to the fire extinguishing time; and an evaluation terminal which evaluates the fire response ability of an experienced person based on information received from the training fire generator and the firefighting training time limit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 소방 훈련 평가용 교보재 시스템은, 교육용 소화기와, 화재 발생 상황을 모의하기 위한 연기를 발생시키고, 교육용 소화기를 통해 분사되는 분사 물질에 기초하여 교육용 소화기의 정상사용여부에 대한 정보를 제공하며, 연기 발생시점으로부터 소화 시간까지 소요되는 경과시간을 카운팅하는 훈련용 화재발생장치 및 훈련용 화재발생 장치로부터 수신되는 정보 및 상기 소방훈련 제한시간에 기초하여 체험자의 화재대응능력을 평가하는 평가 단말을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Virtual Reality Control System for chemical accident response training
title_ko: 화학 사고 대응 훈련용 가상 현실 제어 시스템
abstract_en: A virtual reality control system comprises: a sensing unit emitting light to an object and receiving the light to detect an optical signal; a first display outputting an image to a first user; a second display outputting an image to a second user; and one or more control units controlling at least one of the first display and the second display. The control unit obtains first location information about the first user and second location information about the second user based on the optical signal, and outputs an image including a first area and a second area to the first display based on the first location information. When the location information of the first user is located in the first area, the first user receives the authority of a commander. After the first user receives the authority of the commander, an unexpected situation is given to the second user by the input of the first user, and an image corresponding to a sudden situation is output on the second display based on this. Accordingly, the system can improve the user′s training proficiency.
abstract_ko: 대상체에 광을 조사하고 수신하여 광 신호를 검출하는 센싱부; 제1 사용자에게 영상을 출력하는 제1 디스플레이; 제2 사용자에게 영상을 출력하는 제2 디스플레이; 및 상기 제1 디스플레이 및 제2 디스플레이 중 적어도 하나를 제어하는 적어도 하나 이상의 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는, 상기 광 신호에 기초하여 상기 제1 사용자에 관한 제1 위치 정보 및 상기 제2 사용자에 관한 제2 위치 정보를 획득하고, 상기 제1 위치 정보에 기초하여 상기 제1 디스플레이에 제1 영역 및 제2 영역을 포함하는 영상을 출력하되, 상기 제1 사용자의 위치정보가 상기 제1 영역에 위치하는 경우 상기 제1 사용자는 지휘관의 권한을 부여받고, 상기 제1 사용자가 지휘관의 권한을 부여 받은 이후에 상기 제1 사용자의 입력에 의해 상기 제2 사용자에게 돌발상황이 부여되고, 이에 기초하여 상기 제2 디스플레이에 상기 돌발상황과 대응되는 영상이 출력된다.

title_en: Important power transmission channel disaster monitoring method based on improved cellular automaton of optimized neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an important power transmission channel disaster monitoring method based on an optimized neural network improved cellular automaton, which belongs to the field of important power transmission channel disaster monitoring and comprises the following steps: s1, data acquisition is carried out by monitoring resources, a meteorological department and a power grid meteorological site; s2, storing and preprocessing the data in the step S1; s3, determining a cell state based on an analytic hierarchy process; s4, acquiring an RBF neural network data center by adopting cosine similarity, optimizing weights from an implicit layer to an output layer by adopting an IWD algorithm, improving network accuracy, and training and learning by adopting an RBF neural network model; s5, predicting and evaluating the current monitoring data according to the rule to obtain a cellular state, namely a disaster prediction evaluation level, forming a current overall disaster state level distribution map of the monitoring area, and carrying out targeted inspection on the line passing through the disaster level abnormality and serious area by combining the trend and the topological structure of the important power transmission channel to eliminate the hidden danger of the disaster.

title_en: Disease subtype prediction method, system, device and medium based on small sample
abstract_en: The invention provides a disease subtype prediction method, a system, a device and a medium based on a small sample, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring gene expression data of a first data set; predicting the gene expression data through a prediction model to obtain the disease subtype of the sample to be predicted; the prediction model comprises a sample selection net, a feature selection layer and a meta learner; the method obtains a prediction model for disease subtype prediction through training of a meta-learner, and learns from related clinical tasks through a meta-learning technology to extract valuable information so as to help the model to be well popularized to the prediction task of the disease subtype; in the training process of the prediction model, through the processes of feature selection and sample re-weighting, the problem of dimension disaster is solved by removing noise data in a self-adaptive manner, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of machine learning.

title_en: Natural disaster situation field inspection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a natural disaster situation field check device, which comprises a machine body, wherein an operation platform is arranged above the machine body, a drilling device and a probe for measuring soil moisture are arranged at the lower end of the machine body, the drilling device comprises a drilling motor, the drilling motor is arranged on a movable plate, and the movable plate is connected with a movable cavity in the machine body in a sliding manner; a rotary shaft of the drilling motor is provided with a cone drill bit, and the movable plate is connected with the bottom of the movable cavity through a first telescopic rod; the probe is arranged in the probe cavity, and the bottom of the probe is connected with the bottom of the probe cavity through a second telescopic rod; the probe is electrically connected with a soil moisture tester; the first telescopic link, the second telescopic link, the drilling motor and the soil moisture tester are all electrically connected with the processor. This scheme is used for the moisture detection of natural disasters area soil, and the probe fully contacts with the earth of hole bottom, measures soil moisture. The soil water content condition of the area is directly reflected, a material is provided for drought disaster analysis, and the measurement is accurate.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER ENGINEERING CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Flood risk prediction method based on rainstorm process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk prediction method based on a rainstorm process, which relates to the technical field of flood risk prediction and comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological data of a disaster-stricken flood occurrence period of a to-be-detected area in advance, and acquiring airflow track information of a corresponding period based on a HYSPLIT model; collecting GFS information and using the GFS information as data input information of an initial data field in a WRF mode, and carrying out scale reduction numerical simulation on each counted flood causing and rainstorm process of different types; evaluating flood risks and determining flood risk levels based on the acquired flood risk characteristic information, the flood exposure characteristic information and the social vulnerability characteristic information; and predicting the flood caused by the disaster based on the rainfall rainstorm center and time distribution of the area to be detected, the flood risk level and the occurrence rule of the flood process line. The flood risk evaluation method and the flood risk evaluation device realize flood risk evaluation from multiple angles, not only have high flood prediction precision, but also can carry out observation from the aspect of water vapor, and have high prediction precision and wide adaptability.

title_en: Mechanical property evaluation method and device for T-beam bridge under fire
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge performance evaluation, and discloses a mechanical performance evaluation method of a T-beam bridge under a fire disaster, which comprises the following steps: establishing a finite element model of the T-beam bridge, and carrying out fire layered simulation on the finite element model according to the fire working condition to obtain temperature fields of different virtual layers of the T-beam bridge under the fire; calculating the burning loss degree conversion coefficients of different materials of the T-shaped beam bridge according to the temperature field; and calculating the mechanical property evaluation coefficient of the T-beam bridge according to the burning loss degree conversion coefficient to realize mechanical property evaluation. The invention has the technical effects of good evaluation effect and high efficiency.

title_en: Environment-friendly transformer multi-fire-type simulation system
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power systems, and particularly discloses an environment-friendly transformer multi-fire-type simulation system. The simulation system includes: a transformer housing with an internal coil removed; the sleeve fire module, the overflow fire module and the spray fire module are all arranged in the transformer shell; the oil tank, the oil injection pipeline and the pump set are all arranged outside the transformer shell, and the pump set is used for providing power so as to inject oil in the oil tank into at least one of the sleeve fire module, the overflow fire module and the spray fire module by using the oil injection pipeline; the power supply is used for supplying power to at least one of the sleeve fire module, the overflow fire module and the spray fire module; and the secondary control module is connected with the power supply, the pump set, the sleeve fire module, the overflow fire module and the spray fire module. Therefore, the method for simulating multiple fire types of the environment-friendly large transformer can be provided, a small amount of transformer oil is used for simulating multiple real fires, and a test basis is provided for fire extinguishing mode research.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Wisdom fire control management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire fighting management system, which is provided with a fire fighting training education module, so that the intelligent fire fighting management system can be used for performing science popularization teaching and management on fire fighting theoretical knowledge; by arranging the fire-fighting working system management module, the fire-fighting working system can be scientifically managed; by arranging the fire fighting team management module, the fire fighting team management system can manage the fire fighting team; the fire fighting equipment management module is arranged, so that the fire fighting equipment can be managed; by arranging the fire-fighting monitoring control module, the fire-fighting hidden danger can be monitored and controlled; by arranging the emergency command module, the fire disaster emergency command system can carry out emergency command and dispatch on fire disasters. The fire fighting training education module, the fire fighting working system management module, the fire fighting team management module, the fire fighting equipment management module, the fire fighting monitoring control module and the emergency command module are integrated together, and effective linkage can be realized among the modules.
assignees: SHANGHAI AWSA BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Information prediction method and system based on autonomous evolution learner
abstract_en: The invention provides an information prediction method and system based on an autonomous evolution learner, which can find required data dimensionality for a model and an effective model network structure based on an autonomous training method, automatically complete training of each model, and accelerate the optimization process of various parameters of the model by a method combining autonomous training and heredity. The invention solves the problem of data dimension disaster in information mining by a multi-model training mode.

title_en: New energy scene generation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy scene generation method and a system, which comprises the following steps: constructing a generating network and a judging network, carrying out countermeasure training on the generating network by using a random vector, the judging network and a training sample set of a hidden space, and generating a plurality of new scenes by using the generating network after the countermeasure training; extracting the feature labels of the new scenes; constructing a regression model, and constructing a characteristic axis of a random variable by using the slope of the regression model in a high-dimensional space; orthogonalizing the characteristic axes of the random variables; the method and the system can overcome the problem of dimension disaster in the prior art, avoid the over-fitting problem, and flexibly control the feature distribution of the generated expected scene to generate a specific new energy scene.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle-mounted multifunctional drilling machine and static sounding integrated platform
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-functional rig of vehicular and static sounding integration platform mainly relates to environmental remediation and geological exploration field. The utility model provides a vehicular multifunctional drilling machine and static sounding integration platform, includes van, van carriage front end top sets up sample memory cell, sample memory cell below sets up microorganism operation module, van carriage front end sets up control system, van carriage middle part sets up static sounding device, van carriage tail end sets up direct push formula operating system, the van bottom sets up the hydraulic system who suits with static sounding device, direct push formula operating system. The beneficial effects of the utility model reside in that: the utility model discloses with collection, save, circulation, detection, treatment and soil physical parameter test etc. integration on same vehicular platform of soil sample, improved the efficiency of soil investigation and treatment, improved the mobility and the emergency response ability of equipment.
assignees: SHANDONG ACADEMY OF ENV SCIENCES CO LTD;NANJING YI RUN ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE AND TECH ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Single-hole single-line tunnel single-side flat-guide type rescue station fire disaster model test system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a single-hole single-line tunnel unilateral flat-guide type rescue station fire disaster model test system, include: the tunnel system comprises a main tunnel channel, parallel evacuation channels and a transverse connecting channel, wherein the main tunnel channel is a longitudinal channel, the parallel evacuation channels are arranged on one side of the main tunnel channel in parallel, and the transverse connecting channel is arranged transversely and is vertically communicated with the main tunnel channel and the evacuation channels; the fire source simulation device is arranged in the main tunnel channel; a smoke exhaust duct; and the monitoring device is used for monitoring the flue gas concentration and the flue gas flowing rule in the main tunnel channel, the parallel evacuation channel and the transverse connecting channel. The utility model discloses but the modularization assembly, simple structure, stability is good, easily assembles, and the commonality is strong, and experimental convenient operation can accurately record flue gas flow law, temperature field, heat radiation value and ventilation strategy isoparametric when taking place the conflagration in the analysis railway tunnel, has stronger practicality.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Multi-modal confrontation model training method and device for disaster event detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network information analysis, in particular to a method and a device for training a multi-modal confrontation model for disaster event detection. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining social media data; extracting image features and text features of the social media data; preprocessing image features and text features of the social media data; inputting the preprocessed image features and text features of the social media data into a multi-modal confrontation model, and updating parameter sets of a multi-modal feature extraction unit, an information identification unit and a confrontation training unit. According to the method, the extremely-small game between the multi-modal feature extraction unit and the confrontation training unit is utilized, so that the efficiency and the accuracy of the convolutional neural network model in detecting the disaster event by utilizing social media data are improved.

title_en: Disaster tolerance drilling method, device, equipment and storage medium of disaster tolerance cloud host
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster tolerance drilling method, a device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium of a disaster tolerance cloud host, wherein the disaster tolerance drilling method is applied to the disaster tolerance cloud host of a remote backup site which keeps data synchronization with a main station point cloud host, and comprises the steps of aiming at an input disaster tolerance drilling establishing instruction, establishing a cloud host snapshot of the disaster tolerance cloud host; based on the cloud host snapshot, creating a drilling cloud host with the same network configuration as the main station point cloud host; judging whether the data of the drilling cloud host is consistent with the data of the master station point cloud host at the drilling creating time; if so, judging that the disaster recovery function of the disaster recovery cloud host is normal; if not, judging that the disaster recovery function of the disaster recovery cloud host is abnormal. According to the method and the system, the rehearsal cloud host can be created based on the cloud host snapshot of the disaster recovery cloud host, so that the disaster recovery function can be timely and effectively tested and judged before an accident occurs based on the rehearsal cloud host, the practical usability of the disaster recovery cloud host is guaranteed, and the safety and reliability of system operation are improved.
assignees: BEIJING INSPUR DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster coupling experiment system and method for simulating tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel simulation multi-disaster coupling experiment system, wherein a test piece is placed in the experiment system, the test piece is of a tubular structure and is formed by splicing a plurality of axially aligned whole-ring segments, a gap between two adjacent whole-ring segments is an annular gap, each whole-ring segment is formed by encircling a plurality of arc segments, the gap between two adjacent arc segments is a vertical gap, the adjacent arc segments are connected in series through connecting bolts, the system comprises a counterforce wall, and a pressurizing device is arranged between the test piece and the counterforce wall; the technical problem that experiment data which are in line with reality cannot be obtained through disaster simulation tests for tunnel space in the prior art is solved through the scheme of the invention.

title_en: Mine emergency intelligent management system
abstract_en: A mine emergency intelligent management system utilizes an industrial internet technology to realize integration of monitoring data such as safety monitoring, personnel positioning, mine pressure monitoring, hydrological monitoring and the like and fusion of a scheduling communication system, researches a coal mine accident early warning model through technologies such as big data and edge calculation, dynamically analyzes the safety condition of a coal mine, automatically performs accident early warning, and realizes one-key starting of intelligent early warning and emergency handling processes of coal mine accidents; rapidly notifying the underground person to be removed by voice playing, short message and other modes; based on the technology of one map, underground monitoring data and personnel information such as underground personnel, safety monitoring, videos and the like are displayed on a disaster avoidance route map in real time, a disaster avoidance route is automatically generated according to an accident site, and a rescue route is displayed in an animation simulation mode; the mobile terminal network simulation drill guides post personnel to participate in various emergency accident drills in a role playing mode to achieve the effect of accident emergency drills, and emergency rescue is improved to the levels of digitization, flow, automation and visualization.

title_en: Railway vehicle fire personnel evacuation simulation method and system
abstract_en: According to the method and the system for simulating evacuation of fire personnel of the railway vehicle, the fire state of a vehicle door, the number of passengers and cells occupied by the passengers in an evacuation matrix are obtained; starting evacuation simulation, and determining a middle cell, a neighborhood cell and a transfer matrix for each passenger; determining the fire repulsion strength of the cells; calculating passenger movement probability to obtain a probability transition matrix; selecting the cell corresponding to the maximum moving probability as a new intermediate cell, and iteratively calculating a probability transfer matrix; acquiring iterative computation time consumption when the number of passengers is reduced from the initial number to 0 and final passenger getting-off time consumption; and determining the total evacuation time and outputting. The method comprises the steps of constructing an evacuation matrix for indicating carriage space of the rail vehicle by utilizing a cellular automata theory, acquiring a fire state of a vehicle door, the number of passengers and cells occupied by the passengers in the evacuation matrix, and starting evacuation simulation, so that total evacuation time is obtained, cost is saved, and the total evacuation time corresponding to different working conditions can be quickly obtained.
assignees: CRRC CHANGCHUN RAILWAY VEHICLES CO LTD

title_en: Testing device for influence of natural gas hydrate decomposition on seabed slope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test device for the influence of natural gas hydrate decomposition on a seabed slope, which belongs to the technical field of marine disaster research, and comprises a methane gas conveying device, a model box and a water vapor conversion device, wherein a high-permeability sand layer is laid at the bottom of the model box, a perforated pipe is uniformly laid on the high-permeability sand layer, an inclined test soil sample is laid above the perforated pipe, two ends of the perforated pipe extend out of the model box and are respectively connected with the methane gas conveying device and the water vapor conversion device, the utility model converts the natural gas hydrate in the deep sea into an actual operable controllable variable, by analyzing the action of the decomposed product of the natural gas hydrate on the seabed slope, the damage condition of the actual action is met, the difficulty caused by the limitation of the natural condition of the ocean is solved, and the utility model discloses a test simulation device all is convenient for operate and use, can observe clearly and record experimental process.

title_en: High-speed rail disaster prevention and reduction test system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed rail disaster prevention and reduction test system and a method, wherein the system comprises: the high-speed rail line model comprises a high-speed rail ballasted track model, a high-speed rail ballastless track model, a bridge model and a tunnel model; the vibration simulation device is arranged below the high-speed rail line model and bears the high-speed rail line model; the rainfall simulation device is arranged above the high-speed rail line model; the air outlets of the temperature simulation device are arranged on the periphery of the high-speed rail circuit model; and the control device is used for communicating with the vibration simulation device, the temperature simulation device and the rainfall simulation device. According to the test system and the test method, the high-speed rail line model is established on the vibration simulation device, and the rainfall simulation device and the temperature simulation device are combined to simulate the severe environments of rainfall, dry-wet cycle, severe cold, high temperature, wind disaster, earthquake and the like of the high-speed rail line, so that a comprehensive system is provided for the high-speed rail disaster prevention and reduction research.

title_en: Full-space transient electromagnetic tunnel model experimental device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full space transition electromagnetic tunnel model experimental apparatus, including barrel, lid, the lid nestification is in the barrel, sets up a plurality of screw holes that run through on the bottom plate of barrel, and the downthehole stifled hole device that is provided with of screw, the outer wall of barrel still is provided with the landing leg. A through round hole is formed in the cover body, an inner cylinder is further arranged on the lower portion of the cover body, and the upper peripheral edge of the inner cylinder and the lower peripheral edge of the round hole are fixed in a sealing mode. The diameter of the inner cylinder is equal to that of the round hole. The hole blocking device comprises a plurality of supporting rods and a plurality of screw plugs, the screw plugs are multiple in number, the screw holes are provided with first internal threads, the screw plugs are connected in the screw holes in a screwed mode, first external threads matched with the first internal threads are formed in the supporting rods, and the supporting rods penetrate through the bottom plate and are connected in the screw holes through the first external threads in a screwed mode. The device is utilized to carry out physical simulation experiments, and the corresponding characteristic conditions of the full-space transient electromagnetism of disaster bodies with different types and different space distribution states can be better known.
assignees: CHINA NONFERROUS METALS GUILIN GEOLOGY AND MINING CO LTD

title_en: Regional geological disaster trend prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prediction, in particular to a regional geological disaster trend prediction method, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting the historical data of the geological disaster in the area, and obtaining the basic parameters of the geological disaster, including the type parameter, the level parameter, the spatial distribution parameter and the geological environment parameter before the disaster; s2, training and acquiring a geological disaster trend prediction model/algorithm based on geological disaster type parameters, level parameters, spatial distribution parameters and geological environment parameters before disaster occurrence; and S3, realizing the prediction analysis of the geological disaster in the area according to the current geological environment parameters based on the geological disaster trend prediction model/algorithm. The method can predict the geological disaster occurrence trend of the area in a certain time in the future in advance, and has high accuracy.

title_en: Multi-catastrophe comprehensive simulation test system for tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel multi-disaster comprehensive simulation test system which is characterized in that a comprehensive control unit, a high ground stress simulation unit, a high geothermal simulation unit, a high humidity simulation unit, a water bursting simulation unit, an earthquake disaster simulation unit and a test unit are arranged, the accelerated test evaluation of the long-term service reliability and the safety of tunnel engineering is realized in a laboratory, the damage prediction and the emergency preparation of multi-disaster factors are realized, the disaster factor coverage is complete, the combined working conditions are multiple, the research application is wide, and the like.

title_en: Double-hole single-line tunnel transverse passage smoke exhaust type rescue station fire disaster model test system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-hole single-line tunnel transverse channel smoke exhaust type rescue station fire disaster model test system, which comprises a tunnel system, wherein the tunnel system comprises main tunnel channels and transverse connecting channels, and the transverse connecting channels are transversely arranged between the two main tunnel channels and are vertically communicated with the two main tunnel channels; the fire source simulation device is arranged in the main tunnel channel; the smoke exhaust pipeline is arranged at the top of the transverse connecting channel; the monitoring device is arranged in the main tunnel channel and the transverse connecting channel; the utility model discloses can simulate out the conflagration scene in the tunnel to flue gas concentration, the flue gas law of flowing, temperature field and the heat radiation value of flowing in the tunnel observe, monitor and record test data, improve the accuracy and the validity of the experimental research of tunnel fire, main tunnel passageway can realize the modularization concatenation simultaneously, and each module that has different functions can be used repeatedly according to the demand of different positions, has reduced the manufacturing degree of difficulty, has improved and has assembled efficiency.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Complex narrow space search and rescue comprehensive training device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of searching and rescuing in ruins of buildings caused by disasters such as earthquake, and discloses a comprehensive training device for searching and rescuing in complex narrow space, which comprises a bracket, a connecting chamber connected to the bracket, rescuing channels arranged around the bracket and connected to the connecting chamber, wherein each rescuing channel comprises a first rescuing channel, a second rescuing channel, a third rescuing channel and a fourth rescuing channel, a first narrow space structure connected to the other end of the first rescuing channel, a second narrow space structure connected to the other end of the second rescuing channel, a third narrow space structure connected to the other end of the third rescuing channel, a fourth narrow space structure connected to the other end of the fourth rescuing channel, the application simulates various scenes formed by different searching and rescuing postures and different building materials, and realizes the use targets of meeting different searching and rescuing training, the comprehensive rescue ability of search and rescue personnel training is improved, and the rescue efficiency can be further improved.

title_en: Double-hole single-line tunnel encrypted transverse passage type rescue station fire model test system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-hole single-line tunnel encrypted transverse passage type rescue station fire disaster model test system, which comprises a tunnel system, a fire source simulation device, a smoke exhaust pipeline and a monitoring device; the tunnel system comprises a main tunnel channel and a transverse connecting channel, wherein the main tunnel channel is two channels which are arranged in parallel, and two ends of the transverse connecting channel are provided with jet fans; two ends of the transverse connecting channel are respectively communicated with the two main tunnel channels and are vertical to the main tunnel channels; the fire source simulation device is arranged in the main tunnel channel; the smoke exhaust pipeline is arranged at the tops of the two main tunnel channels through the fixed flange and communicated with the two main tunnel channels; discharging the smoke in the main tunnel channel along a smoke discharge pipeline through a jet fan; the monitoring devices are arranged in the main tunnel channels and the transverse connecting channels and are used for monitoring the flue gas concentration and the flow rule in the two main tunnel channels and the transverse connecting channels; this scheme can carry out the combination of multiform with different modules, promotes concatenation efficiency, adapts to the experimental demand of different environment.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Disk snapshot method, device and medium based on virtualized disk double-active disaster tolerance
abstract_en: The application discloses a virtual disk snapshot method and device based on virtualized disk double-active disaster recovery and a computer readable storage medium. The method is applied to Qemu, the double-active disaster recovery function of the disk is started when the virtual machine is preset to be started, and a snapshot interface is set in an IO copy layer.
