After the virtual machine is started in a double-active mode, a disk snapshot creating or deleting instruction issued by an upper layer can be received in the normal operation process. When a disk snapshot creating instruction is received, creating a virtual snapshot task in an IO replication layer, issuing the same task to each child node of a block device simulation layer, and simultaneously executing the snapshot task by each child node in the IO replication layer suspension IO state; when a disk snapshot deleting instruction is received, a snapshot deleting task is created in the IO replication layer, snapshot files to be deleted corresponding to all the child nodes in the block device simulation layer are searched, the deleting task is simultaneously issued to each child node, and each child node simultaneously executes deleting operation on the snapshot files to be deleted, so that the snapshot of the IO replication layer is realized.

title_en: Reliability calculation method for stability of non-through joint slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability calculation method for the stability of a non-through joint slope, which adopts an intelligent machine learning method to establish a response surface relation between a non-through joint parameter and a slope safety coefficient and realizes the rapid calculation evaluation from the non-through joint parameter to the slope safety coefficient; a non-through joint parameter distribution characteristic evaluation method based on a probability graph method is established, the finite analysis of the statistical result of the non-through joint parameters in the actual engineering is realized, and the actual distribution characteristic function of each parameter is accurately obtained. And (4) realizing the stability evaluation of the non-through joint slope on the whole, namely the slope reliability analysis process. By means of the intelligent machine learning algorithm, the accuracy of the calculation result is improved, the error caused by the conventional artificial subjective evaluation or numerical simulation calculation is avoided, and an accurate evaluation method is provided for slope disaster prevention and treatment.

title_en: Gypsum ore collapse monitoring system and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gypsum mine collapse monitoring system and a construction method thereof, wherein the gypsum mine collapse monitoring system comprises a drilling hole, a monitoring sensor, demodulation equipment, a monitoring platform and a buzzer; a plurality of drill holes are independently arranged at each monitoring position of the goaf; the monitoring sensor is arranged in a drill hole; the demodulation equipment is arranged in a safety area; the demodulation equipment is connected with the monitoring sensor and uploads monitoring data to monitoring software of the monitoring platform so as to send out pre-judgment alarm; the buzzer is arranged at the surface position of the monitoring point and connected with the demodulation equipment; the monitoring sensor comprises a fiber grating displacement meter, a fiber grating osmometer, a geological disaster alarm and a geophone; the buzzer sends out a site alarm according to the signal of the geological disaster alarm; the monitoring sensor monitors multiple parameters of the geology of the goaf, the data acquisition is comprehensive, the omnibearing monitoring is realized, meanwhile, the pre-judgment alarm and the field alarm can help operators to quickly make timely measures aiming at dangerous geological conditions.
assignees: THE FIFTH GEOLOGICAL TEAM OF JIANGSU BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL RESOURCES;SUZHOU NANZEE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Business emergency takeover and drilling system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a business emergency takeover and drilling system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises a production machine and a disaster recovery platform, the production machine is internally provided with a client and a production storage unit, the disaster recovery platform is internally provided with a disaster recovery server and a disaster recovery storage unit, the disaster recovery server and the disaster recovery storage unit are respectively connected with a KVM virtualization platform, the KVM virtualization platform comprises a repair virtual machine and a takeover and drilling virtual machine, and the repair virtual machine is used for automatically repairing a system in a disk to be repaired; the takeover rehearsal virtual machine is used for executing a displacement business operation or a rehearsal operation. Compared with the prior art, the method and the system can carry out automatic configuration on the takeover drilling virtual machine, automatically repair common problems which cause the system to be incapable of being normally started through the built-in repair virtual machine, modify the network by utilizing built-in services after the takeover drilling virtual machine is started, check and repair specified applications, and achieve the purpose of taking over the business conveniently and quickly.

title_en: Method for determining advancing speed of rock burst mine coal face based on mining dynamics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the advancing speed of a rock burst mine coal face based on mining dynamics, which comprises the following steps: firstly, simulating the initial setting of the propulsion speed of a test; secondly, performing a numerical simulation test; thirdly, determining the advancing speed of the coal face based on the loading and unloading action of the mining stress; fourthly, determining the energy of rock burst generated in the coal face propelling process; fifthly, judging whether the energy of the rock burst corresponding to the three propelling speeds exceeds the critical energy value of the occurrence of the rock burst disaster or not; sixthly, resetting the propulsion speed of the simulation test; seventhly, determining the advancing speed of the coal face based on the energy release of the overlying strata structure under the mining stress; and eighthly, determining the reasonable propelling speed of the coal face. The method fully considers the influence of the coal rock mining induced stress on the mine advancing speed, provides a favorable basis for selecting a reasonable advancing speed on site, and can realize safe and efficient mining of coal mines.

title_en: Simulation method for evacuation process of people in fire, evacuation early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating the evacuation process of people under a fire disaster, an evacuation early warning method and a system. The sample is obtained by a simulation method of a personnel evacuation process under the fire, the simulation method comprehensively considers the correlation among building fire spread, structural failure and personnel evacuation in the simulation process, and simulates an evacuation route corresponding to a fire source according to the preset fire source. The evacuation route adopted by the invention is obtained according to the actual simulation condition, the risk uncertainty of fire spread, the resistance uncertainty of structural failure and the environment uncertainty of personnel evacuation are considered, and the real-time evacuation efficiency and the personnel safety under the condition of uncertain structural failure, in particular the safety of fire rescue people, can be improved.

title_en: Digital twin-based disaster guidance system for each floor
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 층별 재난대응시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster guidance system, which simulates evacuation behavior by applying various disaster situation modeling information to a digital twin building with digital twin technology applied to a multi-story building, thereby guiding evacuees to an optimal evacuation route which minimizes loss of life and evacuation time in the event of a disaster. More specifically, the present invention derives evacuation route information according to the situation of each floor of a digital twin building, but converts the evacuation route information for each floor into a DB as standard action procedure (SOP) data, which minimizes congestion by considering spatial information and personnel information for each floor, and when the disaster occurs, the evacuation route information for each floor corresponding to the disaster characteristic value information is matched and outputted to a guide module provided on each floor, thereby inducing the evacuees to accurately and stably recognize the evacuation route which matches the floor on which they are located and to evacuate quickly.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다층 건물에 디지털 트윈 기술을 적용한 디지털 트윈 건물에 다양한 재난상황 모델링정보를 적용하여 대피행동을 시뮬레이션함으로써, 재난 발생 시 인명손실과 대피시간이 최소화된 최적의 대피경로를 대피자들에게 안내하는 재난대응시스템에 관한 것이다. 
보다 구체적으로는 디지털 트윈 건물의 각 층별 상황에 맞게 대피경로정보를 도출하되, 층별 공간정보와 인원정보를 고려하여 몰림 현상 등을 최소화시킨 층별 대피경로정보를 표준행동절차(SOP) 데이터로서 DB화하고, 실제 재난 발생 시 재난 특성치정보에 대응되는 층별 대피경로정보를 각 층에 구비된 안내모듈에 매칭 출력시킴으로써, 대피자들이 자신이 위치한 층과 매칭되는 대피로를 정확하고 안정적으로 인지하여 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 유도하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Radiation Disaster Response Training system
title_ko: 방사능 재난 대응 모의 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radioactive disaster response simulation training system, and more particularly, to a radioactive disaster response simulation training system for providing a simulated disaster response training environment similar to an actual situation in order to minimize radioactive damage to residents in the event of a radioactive leakage accident due to a disaster such as an earthquake or tsunami. According to the present invention, the radioactive disaster response simulation training system comprises: a display unit (100) for training monitoring which displays the progress of a simulated radioactive disaster response training based on a map; a training management server unit (200) which evaluates whether collected situation processing information is the processing in accordance with a transmitted simulation training situation; and a plurality of training group terminals (300) which receive the radioactive disaster training situation from the training management server unit (200), generate situation processing information processed for the received simulation training situation, and provide the situation processing information to the training management server unit (200).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사능 재난 대응 모의 훈련 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 지진 또는 쓰나미와 같은 재난에 의하여 방사능 누출 사고 시, 주민들에 대한 방사능 피해를 최소화할 수 있도록 실제 상황과 유사한 재난 대응 모의 훈련 환경을 제공하기 위한 방사능 재난 대응 모의 훈련 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent fire emergency management system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire emergency management system and a method thereof. The intelligent fire emergency management method comprises the following steps of S1, guiding a user to configure one or more modules of a basic management module, an education and training module, an equipment management module and a site management module by an intelligent fire emergency management system, and S2, guiding the user to enter one or more modules of a double prevention module, an emergency response module, an event management module, an operation management module and a target management module by the intelligent fire emergency management system. The intelligent fire emergency management system and the intelligent fire emergency management method are beneficial to improving the integration degree and the control coverage.

title_en: Method and device for classifying disaster weather satellite cloud pictures
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for classifying a disaster weather satellite cloud picture, wherein under-sampling and over-sampling processing is carried out on an unbalanced satellite cloud picture, and a generated countermeasure network is used for generating samples, so that the over-sampling of the samples replaces the traditional simple copying, and the data generated by the generated countermeasure network can better fit the information such as the distribution probability, the texture characteristic and the like of the original data compared with the data generated by the simple copying, so that the robustness in the model training process can be enhanced; meanwhile, the characteristic information of the original sample with large data volume can be kept to a great extent by the training of the transfer learning, so that when the transfer training is carried out on the data set after the data equalization processing, the precision of the large sample can be reduced as much as possible, and the precision of each small sample is improved.

title_en: Multifunctional emergency bridge-building vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional emergency bridge-building vehicle, which comprises a vehicle body with a car hopper, wherein hoisting equipment is arranged in front of the car hopper, a fixed support is arranged at the rear of the car hopper, a winding drum is placed on the fixed support, a suspension bridge or a floating bridge is wound on the winding drum, and traction mechanisms are arranged at the ends of the suspension bridge and the floating bridge; the drilling device is arranged at the rear end of the car hopper and comprises a supporting rod, a first driving mechanism is arranged at the front end of the supporting rod and drives the supporting rod to extend or contract forwards and backwards, a second driving mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the supporting rod, and a drilling tool is connected below the second driving mechanism. After receiving the rescue information, the invention can quickly drive to a disaster site to quickly bridge a collapsed road surface and a bridge, can quickly bridge a floating bridge road in a short time when encountering a pond, can be long or short, enables personnel and vehicles to continuously move forward, and has simple, flexible and convenient operation, safety and reliability.

title_en: Construction method of coal-bed gas well at critical position
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a coal-bed gas well at a critical position, which comprises the following steps: drilling a coal bed gas horizontal well vertical well body through a directional drilling machine, drilling a drill bit to a position away from the deflecting radius of a roof rock stratum, and leading the drill bit to enter a critical layer at the joint of the roof rock stratum and a coal bed for well cementation; the drilling track is kept in the critical layer for drilling by utilizing the observation drilling cuttings and the while-drilling identification technology, the construction enters a horizontal section for drilling, and the drill bit is not well-fixed during the drilling period; drilling construction is carried out on a horizontal section by utilizing measurement while drilling and guiding drilling technologies, and a large-flow fracturing production increasing measure is adopted after subsection in the drilling process of the horizontal section drilling or drilling is finished; and determining the number of the construction horizontal branch holes by combining the condition of planning a stope face, and drilling the branch horizontal section by using the original straight well body construction. The method utilizes the semi-coal and semi-rock drilling characteristics of the critical layer to avoid the phenomena of drill hole jamming, collapse, hole blocking and the like, and realizes the comprehensive purposes of gas disaster control and energy efficient mining of the soft high-gas coal seam.

title_en: Multifunctional linkage fire extinguishing device and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fire-fighting equipment, relates to a multifunctional skid-mounted linkage emergency fire-fighting rescue device for a fire disaster in a drilling and workover site, and particularly relates to a multifunctional linkage fire-fighting device and a working method thereof. The device comprises a compressor, an explosion-proof box, a gas storage device, an oxygen mask integration and a movable arrangement device, wherein the oxygen mask integration comprises a plurality of air quick interfaces and an oxygen mask, the movable arrangement device comprises a plurality of arrangement carts and a fine water mist isolation cover, and the arrangement carts comprise a cart and foam tanks, clear water tanks and gas cylinders which are arranged on the cart. According to the fire extinguishing device, the fire extinguishing mechanism of the fire extinguishing agent of fine water mist is utilized to extinguish fire through the suffocation effect, the vaporization cooling and the radiation heat blocking effect, the damage to a protected object is small, and the fire extinguishing device has the dual advantages of gas fire extinguishing and water fire extinguishing.

title_en: Fire extinguishing and gas-extinguishing anti-prying linkage fire extinguishing system and working principle thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fire-fighting equipment, relates to a multifunctional skid-mounted linkage emergency fire-fighting rescue device for drilling and repairing a well site to generate a fire disaster, and particularly relates to a fire-extinguishing and pneumatic skid-mounted linkage fire-extinguishing system and a working principle thereof. The device comprises a compressor, an explosion-proof box, a gas storage device, an oxygen mask assembly and a movable arrangement device, wherein the oxygen mask assembly comprises a plurality of air quick interfaces and an oxygen mask, the movable arrangement device comprises a plurality of arrangement trolleys, and the arrangement trolleys comprise trolleys and foam tanks, clean water tanks and gas cylinders arranged on the trolleys. The fire extinguishing and gas prying-resistant linkage fire extinguishing system can form fire extinguishing combinations such as dry foam, positive pressure foam and high-pressure water mist through high-pressure gas and different fire extinguishing agents according to different fire characteristics, and achieves a high-efficiency fire extinguishing effect.
assignees: PUYANG XINGTAI METAL PRODUCTS CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring equipment supporting and fixing framework
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixed framework is supported to geological disaster monitoring facilities belongs to geological disaster monitoring facilities technical field. The geological disaster monitoring equipment supporting and fixing framework comprises a monitoring equipment main body, a mounting frame assembly and a positioning and supporting assembly. The mounting bracket subassembly includes support column, first backup pad, second backup pad, bracing piece and supplementary mounting, the monitoring facilities main part install in support column one side, just support column bottom fixed connection in first backup pad top. The utility model discloses the driving piece drives the pole setting and rotates, and the drill bit of pole setting bottom is drilld soil for the pole setting of second backup pad bottom is whole to be bored into the ground bottom, makes the monitoring facilities main part by firm fixed. The auxiliary fixing piece can play a role in auxiliary fixing, the supporting stability of the monitoring device main body is improved, and the monitoring device can be stably supported and fixed even in a soft foundation geological region.
assignees: SHENZHEN INVESTIGATION & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention training system
abstract_en: To execute disaster prevention training from a wide viewpoint including the inside and the outside of a plant while considering influences of collapses of the plant and buildings or a land form of an area around the plant.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention training system includes: a collapse simulation part for simulating collapses of a plant and buildings or a land form included in an area around the plant on the basis of a disaster prevention training scenario; a driving simulation part for calculating simulation plant data obtained by simulating behaviors of the plant on the basis of the disaster prevent training scenario, information on the collapses of the buildings or the land form simulated by the collapse simulation part, and operations of a simulation operation terminal by a trainer; and a data output part for outputting the information on the collapses of the buildings or the land form simulated by the collapse simulation part, and the simulation plant data calculated by the driving simulation part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Cross-section tunnel flexible isolation structure and engineering rock mass large deformation disaster control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-section tunnel flexible isolation structure and a large deformation disaster control method of an engineering rock mass, wherein the flexible isolation structure comprises a giant NPR anchor cable, a monitoring unit and an acquisition unit, the giant NPR anchor cable comprises a constant resistance body, a constant resistance sleeve and an anchor cable, and the constant resistance body is arranged inside the constant resistance sleeve; the method comprises the steps of S1, directly drilling a hole in a shallow tunnel buried section from the ground surface or excavating a set space region from the ground surface and then arranging NPR anchor cables, excavating a guide hole in a deep tunnel buried section from the inside to the outside of the tunnel, S2, performing support construction on the space region, S3, placing the giant NPR anchor cables after penetrating through a fault, and S4, and anchoring the anchoring sections of the giant NPR anchor cables. According to the invention, the tunnel crossing fault or active fault and other high-activity geological regions are subjected to three-dimensional stitching through the construction of the giant NPR anchor cable, so that the purpose of region locking is achieved, and monitoring-early warning-support integrated control of the tunnel crossing high-activity geological regions is realized.

title_en: Debris flow early warning method and system based on mechanism and machine learning coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow early warning system based on mechanism and machine learning coupling, which comprises a feature vector set unit, a data input unit and a model training unit, wherein the feature vector set unit is used for carrying out feature vector learning; the data input unit is used for inputting the feature vector set unit into the machine learning model; and the model training unit trains the machine learning model by calling a function interface in the machine learning library sklern and performs machine learning model test. Also discloses a debris flow early warning method, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing feature vector sets of the unstable small watershed unit and the stable small watershed unit; s2, selecting a machine learning model based on the data characteristics of the feature vector set, and building a debris flow disaster forecasting model based on a machine learning library sklern with a built-in proper kernel function; and S3, forecasting. The method can effectively improve the forecasting accuracy and reduce the false alarm rate of the model.

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on deep reinforcement learning algorithm
abstract_en: The disclosed crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on deep reinforcement learning algorithm includes: initializing and setting parameters in the evacuation scene simulation model according to the scene information and the crowd parameter information; grouping the crowds and dividing leaders in the groups; each leader selects an optimal exit as an evacuation target, and performs global path planning by using an improved multi-agent depth certainty strategy gradient algorithm to obtain an optimal evacuation path; the common pedestrian in the group follows the leader in the group. A cross entropy method for optimizing strategies and a data pruning algorithm for optimizing samples are introduced on the basis of an original multi-agent depth certainty strategy gradient algorithm, so that the result of the algorithm is optimized, the convergence speed of the algorithm is increased, crowds can be better guided to evacuate, and the evacuation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method and device for identifying seismic waveform and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for identifying seismic waveforms and electronic equipment, wherein the method for identifying the seismic waveforms comprises the following steps: obtaining a seismic waveform data set according to the historical seismic observation data, and preprocessing the seismic waveform data set to obtain a first data set, a second data set, a third data set and a fourth data set; training according to the first data set, the second data set, the third data set and the fourth data set to obtain a first neural network model, a second neural network model, a third neural network model and a fourth neural network model; obtaining a seismic waveform to be identified according to the data of the target seismic event; and identifying the seismic waveform to be identified according to the first neural network model, the second neural network model, the third neural network model and the fourth neural network model to obtain the final comprehensive qualitative probability of the seismic event. The method can quickly and accurately identify the seismic waveform property, and plays an important role in guaranteeing disaster prevention and reduction early warning.

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The disclosed crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on deep reinforcement learning comprise: initializing the constructed evacuation scene simulation model according to the scene information and the crowd parameter information; grouping the crowds, and dividing a leader and a follower of each group; and obtaining the evacuation path of the crowd by adopting a hierarchical path planning method, wherein the leader in the upper-layer group carries out global path planning through an E-MADDPG algorithm to obtain an optimal evacuation path, and the follower in the lower-layer group carries out evacuation along the optimal evacuation path by avoiding obstacles and following the leader. A learning curve and a high-priority experience playback strategy are introduced on the basis of the traditional MADDPG algorithm, an E-MADDPG algorithm is formed, the learning efficiency of the algorithm is improved, a hierarchical path planning method is provided on the basis of the E-MADDPG algorithm and used for planning the evacuation path of people, the path planning time is effectively shortened, people can be guided to evacuate better, and the crowd evacuation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Military emergency shelter
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of military emergency. A plurality of solar automobiles are connected by utilizing the power generation and energy storage principle of the solar automobiles with double hybrid power such as oil electricity, hydrogen electricity and the like, a foldable light-absorbing abrasive plate is unfolded to form a photovoltaic module network matrix, and a mobile off-grid photovoltaic power station is established to provide a power supply for military emergency shelter. The carriage body is used as a military emergency shelter. The multifunctional emergency rescue system is usually used for military training and transportation of military, and is used for emergency measures such as arrangement of ground joint service troops, armed police troops, battle hospitals, field troops and field barracks of maneuvering troops, shelter command parts, shelter hospitals and management and control centers, medical rescue, isolation personnel, military personnel, fighters, rescue personnel and disaster victims in war states, major disaster situations and emergency states. The military emergency shelter has the advantages of maneuverability, independence, battle performance, storage performance, concealment, practicability, safety, confidentiality and reliability.

title_en: Artillery and soldier continuous intelligent combat drilling system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of computer simulation, and particularly relates to an artillery and soldier continuous intelligent combat drilling system based on deep reinforcement learning. The system comprises a task management module, an algorithm decision module and a visual demonstration module. Aiming at the problems of 'dimension disaster', 'human subjective influence', 'rule loophole' and the like existing in methods such as reinforcement learning, matrix countermeasures, influence graph countermeasures, genetic algorithms and genetic fuzzy trees, the invention adopts a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, trains a neural network through the interaction between the deep reinforcement learning algorithm and the environment, and avoids the human subjective influence; no classical sample case is required; the problem of 'dimension disaster' is avoided by adopting a deep neural network. The method has wide application prospect in the fields of tactical research, firepower striking, equipment performance evaluation and the like in artillery and military continuous drilling.

title_en: Memory fault simulation method based on link library injection and memory mapping mode
abstract_en: The invention relates to a memory fault simulation method based on a link library injection and memory mapping mode, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a fault simulator is started on a target server, a Command interface is initialized, a user inputs a fault simulation Command, the fault simulator receives the fault simulation Command and then transmits the Command to a Command Dispatcher, the Command Dispatcher analyzes the fault simulation Command, and a corresponding Command processor is found according to a Command mapping table; and the command processor completes corresponding fault injection according to the corresponding fault simulation command. The memory fault simulation method based on the link library injection and memory mapping mode can simulate the memory fault on the premise of not damaging the memory hardware and is used for verifying the disaster tolerance of software to the memory fault. With non-intrusive transparency, the original hardware need not be corrupted and the original code need not be modified.

title_en: Adaboost-based power transmission line forest fire disaster risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power meteorological disasters, and discloses an Adaboost-based electric transmission line forest fire disaster risk early warning method for realizing prediction and early warning of electric transmission line forest fire disasters at high precision. The method comprises the following steps: dividing the whole predicted power transmission line into M sections in sequence; selecting power transmission line forest fire disaster influence factor classification categories corresponding to the sections according to power transmission line information in each section, recording meteorological characteristic factor information under historical forest fire disaster accident conditions in the categories to form a training sample set, forming a classifier by an Adaboost ensemble learning algorithm, and obtaining a power transmission line forest fire disaster early warning output result and a confidence coefficient margin value in each section through the classifier; and calculating the mountain fire disaster early warning output result and the confidence coefficient margin value of the whole power transmission line according to the weight proportion linear combination of each section, thereby judging to obtain the mountain fire disaster risk early warning grade of the power transmission line.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Icing thickness intelligent early warning method based on meteorological factors
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid disaster prevention and reduction, and discloses an ice coating thickness intelligent early warning method based on meteorological factors, so as to improve the accuracy of ice coating thickness intelligent early warning. The method comprises the following steps: reading micro meteorological monitoring data of a line; converting the monitoring data points into images by using a parallel coordinate algorithm, and converting a matrix formed by multi-dimensional icing meteorological monitoring data into temperature, humidity, a wind deflection angle at the maximum tension and an inclination angle image at the maximum tension by using a parallel coordinate graph; calculating labels of all icing sample data; constructing an icing intelligent early warning convolutional neural network model; training parameters of the intelligent icing early warning model, transmitting the difference between the output of the intelligent icing early warning system and the ideal output backwards to adjust the weight and the deviation of each layer, calculating new output and updating the weight and the deviation again, and circulating until the training termination condition is met; and inputting the acquired latest meteorological data into a trained ice coating intelligent early warning model, and calculating to obtain a corresponding predicted ice coating thickness level.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: System for developing virtual training system for fire prevention
title_ko: 화재재난대응 가상훈련 시스템을 개발하기 위한 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a system for developing a virtual fire/disaster management training system to increase reliability of the virtual fire/disaster management training system. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system comprises: a trainee device displaying a scenario of virtual fire/disaster management training and receiving the trainee′s movement as input; a fire evacuation scenario module providing a virtual training situation in accordance with the scenario of the preset virtual fire/disaster management training through the trainee device; an evaluation module collecting the trainee′s behavior patterns and evaluating the characteristics of each age group through the trainee device and the fire evacuation scenario module; a scenario modification module modifying the scenario of the virtual fire/disaster management training by age group in consideration of an evaluation result; and a database storing a scenario by age group and the trainee′s behavior patterns.
abstract_ko: 화재재난대응 가상훈련 시스템을 개발하기 위한 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 화재재난대응 가상훈련 시스템을 개발하기 위한 시스템은 화재재난대응 가상훈련의 시나리오를 디스플레이하고 훈련자의 움직임을 입력받는 훈련자 디바이스, 기설정된 화재재난대응 가상훈련의 시나리오에 따른 가상훈련 상황을 훈련자 디바이스를 통해 제공하는 화재대피 시나리오 모듈, 훈련자 디바이스 및 화재대피 시나리오 모듈을 통해 훈련자의 행동패턴을 수집하고 연령대별 특징을 평가하는 평가 모듈, 평가 결과를 반영하여 화재재난대응 가상훈련의 시나리오를 연령대별 시나리오로 수정하는 시나리오 수정 모듈, 및 연령대별 시나리오 및 훈련자의 행동패턴이 저장되는 데이터베이스를 포함한다.
assignees: IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION AT NAMSEOUL UNIV

title_en: Method for predicting and simulating congestion of road flow
title_ko: 도로 교통 혼잡도 예측 및 모의 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response training system and, more specifically, to a method for predicting and simulating road traffic congestion performed by a computer (for example, a desktop, a laptop, a tablet PC, and the like) for a disaster response training system. The method for predicting and simulating road traffic congestion comprises: (S100) a step of connecting to a real-time traffic situation information guide server (200) to procure real-time road information including average moving speeds (VC_j) of vehicles actually moving in a simulation traffic zone which is a road zone of an area wherein simulation training is to be carried out in accordance with disaster response training by a traffic congestion guide terminal (100); (S200) a step of predicting average between-vehicle distances (I_jreal) of vehicles moving in the corresponding simulation traffic zone based on the average moving speeds (VC_j) of the vehicles actually moving in the simulation traffic zone as information included in the procured real-time road information by the traffic congestion guide terminal (100); and (S300) a step of predicting and simulating road traffic congestion considering both the vehicles actually moving in the simulation traffic zone and a simulated vehicle based on the predicted average between-vehicle distances (I_jreal) of the vehicles moving in the corresponding simulation traffic zone by the traffic congestion guide terminal (100).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난대응 훈련시스템에 관한 것이며, 더욱 상세히는 재난대응 훈련시스템용 컴퓨터(예컨대, 데스크톱, 노트북, 태블릿 PC 등)에 의해 수행되는 도로 교통 혼잡도 예측 및 모의 방법에 관한 것으로, 교통혼잡도 안내단말(100)에서, 실시간 교통상황정보 안내서버(200)에 접속하여, 재난대응 훈련에 따라 모의 훈련을 실시하고자 하는 지역의 도로 구간인 모의교통구간에서 실제로 이동중인 차량의 평균이동속도(VC j )를 포함하는 실시간 도로정보를 확보하는 단계(S100)와; 교통혼잡도 안내단말(100)에서, 확보된 상기 실시간 도로정보에 포함된 정보로서, 모의교통구간에서 실제 이동중인 차량의 평균이동속도(VC j )를 토대로 해당 모의교통구간에서 이동 중인 차량의 평균 차간거리(I jreal )를 예측하는 단계(S200)와; 교통혼잡도 안내단말(100)에서, 예측된 해당 모의교통구간에서 이동 중인 차량의 평균 차간거리(I jreal )를 토대로 모의교통구간에서 실제 이동중인 차량과 모의하는 차량을 모두 고려한 도로 교통 혼잡도를 예측하고, 모의하는 단계(S300);로 이루어진다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer-readable recording medium for composition of evacuation scenarios in the event of fire in high-rise buildings
title_ko: 초고층 건물의 화재 발생 시 피난 시나리오 구성 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터-판독가능 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for configuring an evacuation scenario in the event of a fire in a high-rise building. The method for configuring the evacuation scenario in the event of the fire in the high-rise building, which is implemented in a computing device including one or more processors and one or more memories to store instructions executable by the processors, includes: a fire occurrence information detection step of detecting a fire occurrence floor based on identification information of a terminal for each floor when receiving a sensing result of a fire detection sensor indicating that a fire has occurred through a terminal for each floor that collects each floor in a high-rise building divided into low-rise, mid-rise, and high-rise areas based on an evacuation safety zone; a floor-by-floor occupants information receiving step of receiving the number of people living in the room confirmed through the terminal by floor; a floor-by-floor arrival time information calculation step of calculating arrival time information for each floor where the number of occupants can reach the ground floor based on evacuation means information previously stored in a database and the received floor-by-floor occupants information; a floor-by-floor evacuation order information generation step of generating evacuation order information for each floor in which the evacuation order for each floor is set, by comparing the floor-by-floor arrival time information, the floor-by-floor occupancy information, and the information on the threshold number of people who can escape through the preset escape zone; and an escape guide information transmission step of transmitting escape guide information to the terminal for each floor according to the evacuation time for each floor included in the evacuation order information for each floor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 초고층 건물의 화재 발생 시 피난 시나리오 구성 방법에 관한 것으로서, 하나 이상의 프로세서 및 프로세서에서 수행 가능한 명령들을 저장하는 하나 이상의 메모리를 포함하는 컴퓨팅 장치에서 구현되는 초고층 건물의 화재 발생 시 피난 시나리오 구성 방법에 있어서, 피난 안전 구역을 기준으로 저층부, 중층부 및 고층부로 구분되는 초고층 빌딩에서 화재가 발생되었음을 나타내는 화재 감지 센서의 센싱 결과를 각 층별로 수집하는 층별 단말을 통해 수신 시, 층별 단말의 식별 정보를 기준으로 화재 발생층을 감지하는 화재 발생 정보 감지 단계; 층별 단말을 통해, 확인된 층별 재실 인원 정보를 수신하는 층별 재실 인원 정보 수신 단계; 데이터베이스에 기 저장된 대피 수단 정보와 수신된 층별 재실 인원 정보를 통해 층별 재실 인원이 지상층까지 도달 가능한 층별 도달 시간 정보를 산출하는 층별 도달 시간 정보 산출 단계; 층별 도달 시간 정보, 층별 재실 인원 정보 및 기 설정된 탈출 구역을 통해 탈출 가능한 탈출 임계 인원 정보를 비교하여 층별 대피 순서가 설정된 층별 대피 순서 정보를 생성하는 층별 대피 순서 정보 생성 단계; 및 층별 대피 순서 정보에 포함된 층별 대피 시점에 따라 층별 단말에 탈출 안내 정보를 전송하는 탈출 안내 정보 전송 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Intelligent control type fire-fighting emergency lighting evacuation system with centralized power supply
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centralized power supply intelligent control type fire emergency lighting evacuation system, including emergency lighting controller, centralized power supply, distribution device, emergency lighting fixtures and fire alarm device, emergency lighting controller is connected with centralized power supply, and centralized power supply and mains connection charge the internal battery simultaneously, and the internal battery is the emergency lighting fixtures power supply under emergency state, and distribution device is connected with centralized power supply, and emergency lighting fixtures is connected with distribution device, and emergency lighting controller controls and the display system in all emergency lighting fixtures, centralized power supply, distribution device's operating condition. The system is linked with the original fire alarm device to clarify the fire point, evacuation simulation analysis is carried out through personnel evacuation simulation software, and an optimal dynamic evacuation route is generated in time, so that trapped personnel can actively avoid smoke and fire, judgment is accurately made, and the occurrence of group death and group injury accidents such as blind escape, treading and the like is avoided.
assignees: GUANGDONG NO 1 CONSTR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Device for detecting thermal shock resistance of fire-fighting suit in fire scene environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for detecting the thermal shock resistance of a fire-fighting suit in a fire scene environment, which comprises a test box body, a fire scene environment simulation system, a fire-fighting suit fixing device, an internal environment simulation system and a data display system; the fire scene environment simulation system is used for simulating a temperature field, a pressure field and a gas atmosphere of a fire scene in the test box body; the firefighter uniform fixing device is used for fixing a firefighter uniform sample to perform a test; the inner environment simulation system is used for simulating human skin, and an air layer is formed between the inner environment simulation system and the firefighter uniform sample to simulate the inner environment between a human body and the firefighter uniform; the data display system is used for monitoring and displaying various data acquired in the test process in real time; meanwhile, the computer can analyze the acquired data, and finally, the thermal shock resistance of the firefighter uniform in the fire scene environment is comprehensively evaluated by combining the temperature difference, the pressure difference and the change rate of the air permeability along with time, and the evaluation can effectively reflect the actual use effect of the firefighter uniform.

title_en: Bionic skin structure
abstract_en: The application relates to a bionic skin structure, which comprises a functional structure and a perception structure, wherein the perception structure is positioned at one side of the functional structure and is electrically connected with the functional structure, the functional structure has an electrostriction function, and when the perception structure generates an electric signal change along with the change of the environment, the functional structure is deformed in response to the change of the electric signal. The application electrically connects the functional structure with electrostriction function with the sensing structure capable of generating electric signal change, thereby simulating the emergency response of skin to environmental change through the expansion and contraction change of the functional structure.

title_en: Electromagnetic transient simulation parameter optimization method based on particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides an electromagnetic transient simulation parameter optimization method based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of power system simulation models. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial electromagnetic transient simulation function; according to the initial electromagnetic transient simulation function, analyzing the track sensitivity of all the parameters; quantifying the sensitivity of the track, sequencing the sensitivity of the track, and selecting a plurality of parameters with higher sensitivity of the track as parameters to be optimized; and based on a PSO algorithm, operating an electromagnetic transient simulation model to obtain optimized electromagnetic transient simulation parameters. The method adopts machine correction simulation model parameters to replace the traditional artificial experience correction, and improves the accuracy of the parameters. And parameters to be optimized are analyzed and screened through the track sensitivity, so that the optimization efficiency is improved. The PSO algorithm is adopted to solve the problem of dimensionality disaster when the number of parameters is large, and the optimization process is simplified.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Numerical simulation method for high-order landslide impact scraping and underlayer converging process
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a numerical simulation method for a high-order landslide impact scraping and underlayer remittance process, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a landslide geometric model and an underlayer geometric model; s2, establishing a lower cushion material model and selecting parameters; s3, carrying out numerical simulation calculation; s4, post-processing of a calculation result; and S5, comparing and analyzing results. The embodiment of the invention provides a numerical simulation method for a high-position landslide impact scraping and underlayer merging process, which adopts an SPH and SDPH calculation method and adopts dynamic contact and a D-P failure criterion as judgment conditions, provides a process for simulating the impact scraping of an underlayer after high-position starting of a slide body and leading the underlayer material to yield and then merge into the slide body, and helps for high-position landslide impact scraping dynamics research, pre-disaster quantitative evaluation and post-disaster scientific rescue.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Monitoring and early warning experimental device for simulating soil liquefaction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction engineering instruments, in particular to a monitoring and early warning experimental device for simulating soil liquefaction, which comprises a box body, a cover plate, a high-pressure water spraying simulation pipeline, a vibration simulation device and a landslide monitoring device, wherein the box body is of a square structure with a hollow top opening; the high-pressure water spraying simulation pipeline is arranged in soil of the box body, and a plurality of high-pressure nozzles are arranged on the high-pressure water spraying simulation pipeline; the vibration simulation device is one or a plurality of mutually parallel electromagnetic vibration tables arranged at the bottom of the inner cavity of the box body and can vibrate along the horizontal direction or the vertical direction; the landslide detection device comprises a hydraulic telescopic rod, a computer terminal and an alarm system, wherein the hydraulic telescopic rod is arranged in the middle of the cover plate and is used for being inserted into soil. The utility model relates to a rationally, can demonstrate soil liquefaction's macroscopic phenomenon and main calamity characteristic directly perceivedly, convenient understanding, maneuverability is strong, and the demonstration is with low costs, and the bandwagon effect is good to can repetitious recycle, repeatability is strong.

title_en: Cyclic participation/experiential multiple-event disaster preventive training system and cyclic participation/experiential multiple-event disaster preventive training method
abstract_en: To provide a cyclic participation/experiential multiple-event disaster preventive training system such that many participants among members forming an organization etc., can experience and master skills of many events such as emergency rescues etc., including cardiopulmonary resuscitation, fire extinguishing, stopping of bleeding, and bone fracture-related treatments to be required in an actual disaster.SOLUTION: A cyclic participation/experiential multiple-event disaster preventive training system 1 includes: explanatory panels 2A, 2B and 2C which have main points of disaster preventive skills for participant described on top surfaces and documents for explanatory narration described on reverse surfaces, and are used by instructors by cardiopulmonary resuscitation training, fire-extinguishing/reporting training, and emergency rescue training; a dummy for cardiopulmonary resuscitation training and an AED (Automated External Defibrillator); fire extinguishers, type 1 fire hydrants, type 2 fire hydrants, and report cards for fire-extinguishing/reporting training; and handling tools consisting of bleeding stop-adaptive towels, plastic bags, bone fracture-adaptive newspaper, magazines, neckties, plastic umbrellas, curing tapes, and plastic bags.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: RESCUE NOW KIKI KANRI KENKYUSHO CO LTD

title_en: Rat robot remote control method and system based on state classification model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rat robot remote control method and system based on a state classification model, and belongs to the technical field of control over novel special robots based on machine learning. The remote control method comprises the following steps: (1) receiving current surrounding environment information and current motion state information of a rat robot; (2) controlling a display module to display a current surrounding environment image and a rat posture three-dimensional model simulated based on the motion state information; (3) based on the motion state information, recognizing the current motion state of the rat robot by using the trained state classification model; (4) and an exception handling step, namely, if the current motion state is an abnormal motion state, the display module displays a state exception prompt and simultaneously cuts off the sending of the control instruction until an operation event aiming at the state exception prompt is detected. The technical scheme is convenient for remote control, can reduce the damage to the rat, and can be widely applied to the fields of terrorism prevention, disaster relief and the like.

title_en: Small-size experimental device for comprehensively simulating stairway fire smoke migration law
abstract_en: The utility model provides an experimental apparatus of small-size comprehensive simulation stairway conflagration flue gas migration law, includes experiment main part, burner, door and window with adjustable draught area, monitoring system and fire extinguishing system. The experiment main body is composed of a wood board coated with high-temperature-resistant dark-colored paint and high-temperature-resistant glass, and a stair way leads to each floor and is connected with a room and a vertical shaft; the door and window with adjustable ventilation area comprises a pulley and a high-temperature-resistant hard plate; a combustion device comprising a basin of inert material and a fuel; the monitoring system comprises carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide and a temperature sensor; the fire-fighting system is a balloon filled with water. The technical effect is that this experimental apparatus is old-fashioned step building structure's simplified model, is the first experimental apparatus that comprehensively simulates the law of walking stair conflagration flue gas migration, and the fire source size, the fire source position that can nimble control conflagration and the vent size of door and window can rationally assess old-fashioned step building conflagration risk, formulate safe preliminary plan and safe evacuation route.

title_en: Method for monitoring damage dynamic height of overburden rock during underground coal seam mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the damage dynamic height of overburden rock in underground coal seam mining, which comprises the following steps: s1, selecting and customizing a mining overburden rock deformation monitoring sensing optical fiber, and calibrating the performance index of the sensing optical fiber; s2, analyzing the coupling effect and deformation coordination of the optical fiber and the rock-soil body, and simultaneously carrying out corresponding optimization on the installation process of the drill hole backfill material and the sensing optical fiber; s3, establishing a coal seam mining overburden rock deformation damage distributed optical fiber monitoring system, and monitoring the underground coal seam mining overburden rock damage dynamic height. The invention establishes a set of dynamic monitoring method for deformation and damage of overlying strata during coal mining based on a distributed optical fiber sensing technology, provides a new method and a new technology for prevention and control of coal development geological disasters, constructs an optical fiber-rock-soil body interface mechanical transmission model by analyzing and sensing optical fiber-surrounding rock deformation consistency, provides a monitoring error range and a correction method, and solves the problem of accurate monitoring of large deformation and discontinuity of rock-soil bodies.

title_en: Apparatus and method for measuring radiation dose rate and corresponding position
title_ko: 위치기반 공간방사선량 측정장치 및 측정방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a position-based spatial radiation dose measuring apparatus and method combine a radiation measuring detector and a position measuring sensor to make an operator to carry it, compile, into a database, radiation dose by position collected by the apparatus proposed in the present invention while performing daily work, and build a three-dimensional (3D) spatial radiation dose map based on the database. The spatial radiation dose map constructed thereby can be used in various fields, such as systematic and efficient safety management of radioactive environment workers, tracking and management of individual exposure dose, calculation of predicted exposure for each work scenario, identification of the optimal evacuation route in case of emergency, and important key factors of digital plant business.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 위치기반 공간방사선량 측정장치 및 방법은 방사선 측정 검출기와 위치측정 센서를 결합하여 작업자에게 휴대시키고 일상 업무를 수행하면서 본 발명에서 제안하는 장치로 수집된 위치별 방사선량을 데이터베이스화 하여 이를 근거로 3차원 공간방사선량 지도를 구축한다. 이렇게 구축된 공간방사선량 지도는 방사성 환경 종사자의 체계적이며 효울적인 안전관리, 개인피폭선량의 추적관리, 작업 시나리오별 예측 피폭량 산출, 비상대응시 최적 대피경로 파악 및 디지털 플랜트 사업의 중요 핵심 인자등 다양한 방면으로 활용 가능하다.
assignees: NUCARE INC;KEPCO ENG & CONSTR CO INC

title_en: Space-time data prediction method capable of directly capturing space-time correlation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time data prediction method capable of directly capturing space-time correlation, which comprises the following steps: preparing data required by the method; constructing a space-time data prediction model capable of directly capturing space-time correlation; training the constructed model to obtain model parameters; and predicting the space-time data by using the trained model. The invention overcomes the defect that the existing space-time data prediction method cannot capture the close space-time correlation in the space-time data, can effectively excavate the space-time characteristics in the space-time data, thereby improving the accuracy of the space-time data prediction task and having very important application value in various fields such as traffic management, disaster prediction and the like.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for predicting power transmission line suffering from rainstorm disaster
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method, a device and equipment for predicting that a power transmission line is subjected to a rainstorm disaster. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the disaster causing factor data of the power transmission line to be predicted, wherein the disaster causing factor data of the power transmission line comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of inputting storm disaster causing factor data of a power transmission line to be predicted into a storm disaster prediction model to obtain the predicted storm disaster condition of the power transmission line to be predicted according to meteorological characteristic element data, power transmission line structure data, geological characteristic element data and historical storm data, wherein the storm disaster risk prediction model is a restricted Boltzmann model obtained by training of the storm disaster causing factor data of multiple groups of power transmission lines. According to the method, the rainstorm disaster condition of the power transmission line to be predicted is comprehensively predicted from the external cause, the internal cause and the historical rainstorm data which affect the power transmission line to be predicted, so that the prediction accuracy is high.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent control method for emergency risk avoidance during fire disaster of underground coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method for emergency risk avoidance during fire disaster of underground coal mine, which comprises the steps of firstly arranging a certain number of CO sensors and CH sensors at fire-prone places of development roadways, preparation roadways and stoping roadways or at mining working faces 4 The sensor, temperature sensor constitutes monitoring and control system, on-line monitoring poisonous and harmful gas concentration and gas temperature index, then at development tunnel, prepare the tunnel, stope tunnel every certain distance corresponds the earth's surface top drilling of position, set up the gate, be connected the lifter with the gate, adopt electronic hoisting device to connect the gate and carry out remote operation, monitor gas at monitoring and control system, when the highest value of temperature, the position takes place for the accurate calamity of judging, start gate control system, directly carry out the gate automatically and descend and seal the calamity region. The method can be applied to underground development roadways, preparation roadways and mining roadways. Is a dictionary for intelligent emergency rescueIn addition, the method has reference significance for rescue of other disaster accidents.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECH & ENGINEERING GROUP INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Be used for geological disasters model display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a display device for geological disaster models, which comprises a supporting frame, wherein a mounting frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting frame, a mounting groove is arranged at the center of the mounting frame, a mounting plate is fixedly connected in the mounting frame through a supporting mechanism, a first telescopic cylinder and a second telescopic cylinder are fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting plate, the first telescopic cylinder and the second telescopic cylinder are both attached to a rubber layer through an ejection mechanism, the mounting plate is driven to vibrate left and right through a trigger mechanism arranged in the mounting frame, the ejection mechanism is enabled to extrude the rubber layer by matching with the motion of the first telescopic cylinder and the second telescopic cylinder, the earthquake is simulated through the change of the rubber layer, the better display is carried out on the sending process of the geological disaster, so that students can better understand the sending process of the geological disaster, and the learning interest of the students is enhanced, the students are willing to learn geological knowledge.
assignees: QINGHAI CHINACOAL GEOLOGY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster surveys sampling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses geological disaster surveying sampling equipment, which comprises a rectangular box body, an extension mechanism and a sampling mechanism, wherein the extension mechanism is arranged on the rectangular box body; the extension mechanism is arranged on the lower surface of the rectangular box body, and the sampling mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the extension mechanism; the sampling mechanism comprises a rotating motor, a hollow pipe, a hollow drill bit and a one-way valve; the rotary motor is arranged at the bottom of the extension mechanism, the hollow pipe is arranged on the lower surface of the driving end of the rotary motor, the hollow drill bit is arranged on the lower surface of the hollow pipe, and the one-way valve is arranged inside the hollow pipe; the extension mechanism can drive the rotating motor to stretch and retract.

title_en: Sea area natural gas hydrate self-entering type solid state fluidization exploitation system and exploitation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sea area natural gas hydrate self-entering solid state fluidization exploitation system and an exploitation method, which comprise a self-entering structure body, wherein a cavity, a jet pipeline and a conveying pipeline are arranged in the self-entering structure body, the peripheral side of the cavity is communicated with the outside through a particle inlet, the lower end of the conveying pipeline is communicated with the cavity, a plurality of jet outlets are formed in the peripheral side of the self-entering structure body, the lower end of the jet pipeline is communicated with the jet outlets, the upper part of the self-entering structure body is provided with the jet inlets communicated with the jet pipeline and the conveying outlets communicated with the conveying pipeline, the jet inlets are connected with a high-pressure water pump and the conveying outlets through pipelines, well drilling is not needed during exploitation, the pipe wall of the self-entering structure body is utilized to replace a well wall, high-pressure water is utilized to impact into a reservoir, the problem of high drilling cost in the traditional exploitation method is solved, the high-efficiency of acquisition is ensured, and solid particle hydrates are collected on the premise of not changing the temperature and pressure of a natural gas hydrate reservoir, and geological disasters possibly caused by hydrate decomposition are avoided.

title_en: Weak supervision learning-based disaster-stricken building rapid positioning evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for rapidly positioning and evaluating a disaster-stricken building based on weak supervised learning, and relates to the field of disaster positioning. The method comprises the following steps: crawling disaster data from the Internet, wherein the disaster data comprises an un-disaster building image and a disaster building image, and labeling two classification labels for the disaster data according to whether a building is in a disaster or not; training a preset deep learning network model according to the marked disaster data to obtain a two-classification model; and partitioning the large scene image to be identified, identifying and positioning the disaster-stricken building of the image block according to the two classification models and a preset identification method to obtain a positioning result, and evaluating the damage degree of the disaster-stricken building. The method is suitable for rapidly positioning the disaster-stricken building of the large-size large-scene image shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle, greatly reduces the workload of the mark and the subjectivity of the mark, can avoid the loss of detail and texture information, has good identification precision, and can accurately identify and position the disaster-stricken building.
assignees: TECH & ENGINEERING CT FOR SPACE UTILIZATION CAS

title_en: Hydrological model segmented screening method suitable for forecasting and early warning of torrential rain, torrential flood and flood in small watershed of mountainous area
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrological model segmented screening method suitable for forecasting and early warning of torrential rain and torrential flood in small watershed of mountainous area, which divides actual measurement flood and flood simulated by adopting a hydrological model into an initial rising section, a steep rising section, a disaster forming section and a water withdrawal section, screens the hydrological model by comparing the calculation results of the hydrological model to the steep rising section and the disaster forming section with the actual measurement flood, fully considers the early catching capacity of the hydrological model to some key disaster early warning moments of the steep rising section, can catch the torrential rain and torrential flood disaster causing moment in advance, can avoid leakage of police, improves the accuracy and reliability of the early warning of the torrential rain and torrential flood disaster in small watershed of mountainous area, and can provide more scientific guidance and technical support for the forecasting and early warning of the torrential rain and torrential flood disaster in small watershed of mountainous area.

title_en: Testing method and device for rock multi-field coupling rheological test under action of dynamic load
abstract_en: The invention discloses a testing method and a testing device for a rock multi-field coupling rheological test under the action of dynamic load, belonging to the fields of rock mechanics, civil engineering and geological disasters; the existing test method and equipment apply instantaneous load to the rock, and the influence of explosion on the rock caused by the instantaneous load cannot be simulated in the simulated working condition. The rock sample is placed in a sample chamber of a triaxial rheological test device, mechanical energy output by a motor is converted into dynamic load continuously applied to the rock sample through two times of hydraulic transmission, and the influence of explosive blast shock waves on the rock is simulated; a load loading mechanism above the sample chamber on the device converts the rotary motion of the motor into linear reciprocating motion, and applies continuous dynamic load to the rock sample by hydraulic transmission through a cylinder body, a power converter and a hydraulic hose connected with the cylinder body and the power converter; the testing method and the testing equipment provided by the invention are convenient and flexible, and are suitable for various test sites.

title_en: Deep learning improved algorithm for cold source disaster-induced disaster prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning improved algorithm for cold source disaster causing disaster prediction, which comprises the following steps: carrying out statistical classification on factors affecting disaster-causing disaster of cold source, and carrying out normalization processing on multi-source heterogeneous data by using a data normalization function to obtain grouped sample data; establishing a deep belief network, adopting a momentum learning rate-based deep belief network improvement algorithm, and combining a plurality of groups of sample data to perform repeated iterative training of model parameters so as to obtain a mapping relation determined between input and output of the deep belief network; and predicting the disaster grade of the cold source disaster causing object. According to the invention, by adopting an improved algorithm of deep learning, the network learning efficiency is effectively improved, the error convergence rate of prediction is reduced, and the problem of prediction of marine disaster caused by non-linearity, time variability and uncertainty is well solved.

title_en: Simulation model and method for evaluating stability of slope vegetation body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation model and a method for evaluating the stability of a slope vegetation body, which comprises a support system for supporting the whole simulation model, wherein the top of the support system is provided with a slope system for simulating a slope environment, a rainfall system for simulating a rainfall environment is arranged right above the slope system, the periphery of the slope system is provided with an evaluation system for recording the damage condition of the slope vegetation body under the action of rainfall and wind load, the slope system, the rainfall system and the evaluation system are connected with a wind supply system for providing wind load in a matching way, the stability of the field slope vegetation body is analyzed and evaluated by recording the damage condition of the simulation model vegetation body and corresponding simulation information such as rainfall and wind load and comparing the simulation information with natural information such as field rainfall and wind load, so as to provide a basis decision for the artificial regulation and control of the field slope vegetation body, thereby reducing the damage disasters caused by instability.

title_en: Method for simulating fault fire of converter valve tower electrical equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster simulation method for a converter valve tower electrical equipment fault, which comprises the following steps: 1) Determining a fire hazard source according to the composition materials and the working mechanism of the converter valve tower; 2) Establishing a physical simulation model of the converter valve tower according to the valve hall CAD graph, and performing approximation processing and simplification to obtain a valve tower simplified model; 3) Setting conventional parameters of various materials related to the valve tower simplified model, and setting a fire source parameter HRR of a fire hazard source to obtain an initial fire source model; 4) Setting a dangerous source ignition point to obtain a fire source model corresponding to the dangerous source ignition point; 5) And carrying out numerical calculation according to the fire source model to obtain the damage range of combustible materials in the valve tower, the change condition of the temperature of each electronic component of the valve tower and the explosion time node of the fire hazard source. According to the method, the extra-high voltage valve hall valve tower is subjected to physical modeling, an initial fire source model of the valve tower is established, and fire simulation is carried out, so that the risk assessment of the valve hall valve tower fire is realized.

title_en: Information structuring method based on accident disaster news
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information structuring method based on accident disaster news, which comprises the steps of crawling news data on preset large portal websites as an initial corpus by using a web crawler; then, an accident disaster extraction model is constructed by using a deep learning method, and the obtained news data sample is used for training the model; and deploying the extraction model into an analysis system, extracting the accident type and the accident element of each piece of news acquired in real time, converting the accident element into a standard format by adopting a matching and searching algorithm, and storing the standard format in a database. According to the method, accident disaster events and related event elements can be automatically and accurately extracted according to massive internet news data, retrieval and analysis are facilitated, and necessary data information is provided for follow-up accident disaster statistics and prevention; and manual searching and screening are not needed, so that the labor cost is greatly reduced, and the method has important big data application and research values.
assignees: HANGZHOU XUJIAN SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-physical-field coupled landslide disaster simulation test device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-physical-field coupled landslide hazard simulation test device which comprises a box body, a vibration simulation mechanism, a rainfall simulation mechanism and an illumination simulation mechanism, wherein the upper end of the box body is open, a landslide body model is arranged in the box body, the vibration simulation mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the box body and is used for driving the box body to vibrate, the rainfall simulation mechanism is used for spraying water to the interior of the box body to simulate rainfall, the illumination simulation mechanism is used for irradiating the box body to simulate sunlight illumination, and water can be added into the box body or drained outwards from the box body to simulate the change of reservoir water level. The test device can test the landslide after coupling the multi-physical-field influence factors of the landslide, can arrange single-factor and double-factor landslide simulation tests under the influence of multiple factors according to test requirements, simulates the coupling relation between physical fields in different environments, and is favorable for qualitative and quantitative research and analysis of landslide evolution mechanisms.
assignees: WUHAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY ZHONGNAN GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOV

title_en: Method and system for evaluating damage risk of 10kV tower under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating damage risk of a 10kV tower under typhoon disaster, which comprises the steps of collecting data of a research area, wherein the data comprises typhoon information, power grid information and geographic information; processing and analyzing data, and establishing an input information data system, wherein the processing and analyzing comprise data preprocessing, classification variable processing, sample balancing, correlation analysis and variable elimination; based on various machine learning algorithms, respectively establishing 10kV pole tower damage risk assessment models under typhoon disasters, training and testing each model, and performing damage risk assessment on 10kV pole towers in a research area; and taking two indexes of goodness-of-fit and time as model evaluation indexes, comparing risk evaluation results of the models, performing comprehensive weighting on the indexes based on an analytic hierarchy process and an entropy weight method, selecting an optimal model, and visualizing the risk evaluation results. The method meets the requirements of optimal model selection under different scenes, and provides actual data support for timely inspection and allocation before disasters.

title_en: Mountain landslide risk monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for monitoring and early warning of landslide risk, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning. The landslide risk early warning method comprises the steps of training a first classifier by building a simulated landslide body scene and acquiring simulated sensing data to obtain an initial micro-motion unit event detection model, then acquiring real sensing data of the real landslide body scene, carrying out enhancement training on the initial micro-motion unit event detection model to obtain a micro-motion unit event detection model, training a second classifier by the acquired fault event data to obtain a fault model, and finally constructing and training a landslide early warning model by combining the micro-motion unit event detection model and the fault model to carry out landslide risk early warning. The method can automatically analyze a large amount of sensor data, more fully apply the data, and improve the reliability and effect of monitoring and early warning of landslide.

title_en: SSA-based standardized noise reduction method and application thereof in flood forecast of mountain drainage basin
abstract_en: A standardized noise reduction method based on SSA and application thereof in flood forecast of mountain drainage basin are applied to the simulation forecast of the flood of the mountain drainage basin field, and the steps are as follows: 1) determining the SSA time series decomposition window length L; 2) identifying important components of the subsequence subjected to SSA decomposition based on correlation analysis, and generating time series data subjected to noise reduction; 3) and establishing a flood forecasting model based on support vector regression, inputting the data after noise reduction as a model, selecting a typical mountain drainage basin for application, and comparing and analyzing flood forecasting results before and after noise reduction. The method considers the influence of noise interference existing in model input data on flood forecasting precision, provides a standardized noise reduction processing method of rainfall and flow time series based on SSA, and improves a single model for flood forecasting. The method is successfully applied to field flood simulation forecast of the drainage basin in the mountain area, effectively improves field flood forecast precision, and provides new support for early warning and forecast of mountain flood disasters.

title_en: Optimized intervention simulation method and system for panic emotion in crowd evacuation
