abstract_en: The method maximizes intervention income by adaptively adjusting the intensity of manual intervention, firstly, the emotional infection process of the crowd is analyzed by establishing an emotional infection model based on random events, the infection trend and recovery trend of the crowd at each moment are quantified by the occurrence intensity of the events, and accordingly, targeted manual intervention can be put into; secondly, in order to accurately quantify the manual intervention, an intervention model based on the Hox process is provided, the intervention intensity can be adaptively adjusted according to the change of the occurrence intensity of the crowd events, and the infection rate and the recovery rate are regulated and controlled in real time to control emotional infection; finally, in order to give consideration to cost and income and input optimal intervention strength, the method converts the cost and the income into a maximum yield problem, and uses an artificial bee colony optimal intervention emotion infection algorithm to obtain an optimal solution.

title_en: Disaster-prevention ventilation test model for jet fan of emergency rescue station at railway tunnel portal
abstract_en: The application provides a railway tunnel portal emergency rescue station jet fan disaster prevention ventilation test model, and relates to the technical field of test models. The railway tunnel portal emergency rescue station jet fan disaster prevention ventilation test model comprises a base, a supporting framework, a skin, a protective door and a jet fan. The outer surface of the supporting framework is coated with the covering, the base, the supporting framework and the covering jointly define a tunnel main tunnel, parallel pilot holes and transverse channels, the tunnel main tunnel and the parallel pilot holes are arranged in parallel, and each transverse channel is used for communicating the tunnel main tunnel with the parallel pilot holes; a protective door is arranged in each transverse channel; at least one of the tunnel main tunnel and the parallel pilot tunnel is provided with a jet fan. The jet fan has characteristics such as efficient, simple to operate, and the ventilation performance of the emergency rescue station of simulation reality that can be more true, and the guard gate can simulate emergency rescue station cross-section change under the actual conditions, can also simulate the condition that the cross channel opened or closed to satisfy the experimental demand of multiple operating mode.

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method in dynamic environment based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a crowd evacuation simulation method in a dynamic environment based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: the crowd is used as a multi-agent system, and for a single pedestrian agent, a deep neural network is adopted to approximate a mapping function from a state to an action and is used as a behavior controller of the agent; the pedestrian agent makes a behavior decision by using the mapping function through observing the dynamic environment state, and takes corresponding action from the action space. In the discrete time series evacuation simulation process, one strategy refers to the probability distribution of the actions of the agent over the time series in a given state. The information feedback of the environment to the agent is embodied as a return value. The goal of the agent is to maximize the expectation of the cumulative reward value, i.e., find the optimal action value function and get the optimal strategy. The invention can realize crowd evacuation simulation under high dynamic environment which is difficult to realize in classical crowd simulation, the simulation effect is closer to the real situation, and the randomness of crowd behavior is enhanced.

title_en: Power facility flood disaster risk assessment method considering reservoir influence
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power facility flood disaster risk assessment method considering reservoir influence, which comprises the following steps: according to precipitation data of a basin where the electric power facility is located, the precipitation intensity and precipitation spatial distribution conditions of the basin in the torrential flood ditches are obtained, and precipitation frequency is calculated by adopting a gunbel extreme method; calculating the flood flow according to the precipitation intensity of the basin where the electric power facility is located and the collected reservoir information; taking flood flow data as an important input field, substituting the important input field with terrain and land utilization data into a rainstorm flood flooding model to simulate a flood flooding evolution process, and obtaining the flooding water depth and area space distribution condition of a basin where the electric power facility is located; according to the flood submerging depth and the flood submerging range of the disaster area, or actually measured hydrological data, simulation precision analysis is carried out on the submerging depth and the submerging area by utilizing the disaster matching rate. According to the method, the influence of the reservoir on the flood of the downstream watershed is considered, and the risk assessment of the rainstorm flood disaster is further and comprehensively carried out.

title_en: Urban storm water disaster simulation prediction device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of prediction unit, especially, be a city torrential rainwater calamity simulation prediction unit, including base, first water catch bowl, second water catch bowl and control box, first water catch bowl is the same with second water catch bowl size and specification, four edge fixedly connected with in the bottom surface of base insert the stake, four edge fixedly connected with fixed columns in the upper surface of base, first water catch bowl fixed connection is in the middle of the upper surface of base. The utility model discloses a set up the time-recorder at the upper surface of chamber door, make its record first water catch bowl collect the time of full water, then count down with this time, because second water catch bowl is the same with first water catch bowl specification, the warning ring of second water catch bowl top is the same with warning water level line height in addition, so fill the time of first water catch bowl, be exactly the time that the torrential rain calamity probably comes, the use of red light and green light in addition for the prediction device is more directly perceived, be worth general application and popularization.
assignees: WUXI DINGLIXIN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mixed spraying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a technical field of simulation blowout device is a mix and make and spout device, and it includes the cross, comes liquid mixing manifold, preventer, last nozzle, lower nozzle, goes up spray tube and lower spray tube, and the fixed intercommunication of the left end mouth of cross has the steam manifold, and the fixed intercommunication of the right-hand member mouth of cross has evacuation manifold, installs lower spray tube in the cross, forms down between the outside of lower spray tube and the cross inner wall and spouts the chamber, the utility model discloses rational in infrastructure and compact, liquid mixing manifold can be used for simulating piping and profit blowout, and the steam manifold can simulate the steam blowout, and evacuation manifold is used for empting the gas or the liquid in this device. Wherein the centrifugal pump can inhale the clear water through remote control, and the blender can mix the dyestuff in clear water and the dye box and form coloured liquid, and the check valve can prevent that clear water from getting into the dye box in, and the flow and the velocity of flow of control liquid can be controlled through remote control to the control valve, and the gate valve controls the flow of vapour through remote control.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;XINJIANG PETROLEUM ADMINISTRATION BUREAU CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional hydrophobic active disaster control protection device for coal seam mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional drainage active disaster control protection device for coal seam mining, which comprises a central support and first clamping seats symmetrically arranged on the front side and the rear side of the central support, wherein longitudinal connecting pieces are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the central support, telescopic connecting seats are symmetrically arranged at the front end and the rear end of each longitudinal connecting piece, second clamping seats are symmetrically arranged at the left end and the right end of each telescopic connecting seat, and buffer moving mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at the two ends of the bottom of each second clamping seat. According to the invention, through scientific and reasonable structural design, the first clamping seat and the second clamping seat can be adjusted in real time according to the structural sizes of different mechanical equipment, the use safety of the mechanical equipment can be effectively ensured in the whole using process, the service life of the mechanical equipment is greatly prolonged, the normal drilling of bedding holes and through holes is ensured, and the device has good practical and popularization values.

title_en: Inclined roadway fire disaster analog simulation test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire analog simulation test device for an inclined roadway. The invention can realize the simulation of fire conditions of different roadways according to the scene, and can realize the change of inclination angles of different roadways by adjusting the installation positions of the supporting square grooves on 2 supports and the insertion positions of the supporting rods; the movable fire pot can realize the arrangement of different positions of a fire source.
assignees: HUAINAN MINING INDUSTRY GROUP;UNIV INNER MONGOLIA SCI & TECH;PINGAN COAL MINING EXPLOITATION ENGINEERING TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on integer reasoning quantification CNN
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SAR image change detection method based on integer reasoning quantification CNN, which comprises the following steps: (1) generating a training set of the source domain SAR image; (2) constructing an integer inference quantization convolution neural network; (3) carrying out analog quantitative training on the integer inference quantitative convolution neural network by utilizing an integer inference quantitative algorithm; (4) and detecting the SAR image to be detected. The invention introduces an integer type reasoning quantification algorithm, converts the characteristic value and the weighted value from 32-bit floating point type data into low-bit integer type data in the training process, reduces the requirement of change detection on computing resources on the premise of not influencing the change detection accuracy, and promotes the application advantage of the change detection algorithm in a general embedded mobile platform. The method can monitor the growth of crops, the planning layout of cities, natural disasters and the like.

title_en: Micro-seismic sensor device for monitoring mine geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microseism sensor device for monitoring of mine geological disasters. The microseism sensor device comprises a microseism sensor, a shell, a signal wire, a forming die and a vibration sensing device. The vibration sensing device is placed in the forming die, and the forming die is filled with the anchoring agent, so that the micro-vibration sensor device can be conveniently fixed on the inner wall of the underground roadway through the anchoring agent without drilling, and time and labor are saved. Furthermore, the device connecting rod of the vibration sensing device is in threaded connection with the shell, so that the shell and the vibration sensor inside the shell can be conveniently detached, the recycling of the sensor is realized, and the microseismic monitoring cost is greatly saved.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INST;SICHUAN INST OF COAL FIELD GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING EXPLORATION AND DESIGNING

title_en: Experimental device for monitoring whole process of instability and disaster of bulk material accumulation dam
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an experimental apparatus of bulk material accumulation dam unstability disaster-causing overall process monitoring belongs to the geotechnical engineering field. The device comprises a water supply device, a rainfall simulation device, a support device and a dam body damage and break debris flow movement experiment device. The water supply device provides required water, the rainfall simulation device is used for simulating rainfall working conditions, the support device is used for supporting the rainfall simulation device and the hanging ultrasonic equipment, and the dam body damage and dam break debris flow movement experiment device is mainly used for completing research on dam body damage and dam break debris flow (flood) movement processes. The utility model discloses can simulate the research under rainfall, flood overtopping, piping condition, tailing dam or homogeneity earth dam destroy the process of dam break mud-rock flow (flood) downstream river course evolution from the dam body to through automatic monitoring facilities record dam body destruction degree, dam body pore water pressure, dam body deformation, dam break mud-rock flow (flood) impact force, velocity of flow and flood height isoparametric, realize destroying and send the research of calamity process to the dam body.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring devices's stabilizing mean
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disasters monitoring devices's stabilizing mean, which comprises a base, the positive both sides of base bottom all communicate there is the front end sleeve, the positive both sides of base bottom and the telescopic internal surface that is located the front end all rotate and be connected with the front end drilling string, the top of front end drilling string runs through the base and extends to the inside of base, the bottom fixedly connected with front end drill bit of front end drilling string, the utility model relates to a geological disasters monitors relevant technical field. This geological disasters monitoring devices's stabilizing mean through the setting of hydraulic pump and deep jack-post for the base can carry out effective stable support under multiple topography, has promoted the application face of base, and the top support sets up with the flange connecting axle, makes the support frame can disassemble and transports, when having reduced the transportation and transporting, consumes a large amount of manpower and materials, and the setting of top support and support bottom column, makes the base can carry out the fixed stay to the device column end.
assignees: NORTHWEST RES INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING INVESTIGATIONS AND DESIGN;CCTEG BEIJING HUAYU ENG CO LTD

title_en: Environment adaptability detection system for gas concentration monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environmental suitability detecting system for gas concentration monitoring equipment, an environmental chamber is used for placing the gas concentration monitoring equipment to be detected and providing a single environmental state or a composite environmental state of high temperature, low temperature, damp and hot, wind, rain and snowfall icing; the gas source module is used for providing gas with set concentration to the environmental chamber; the environment control module is used for controlling the environment state in the environment cabin. The utility model discloses can simulate out different disaster environment and the coupling environment of calamity more to detect gas concentration monitoring facilities under different disaster environment and the coupling environment of calamity more.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Spiral electrode resistivity probe rod and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrical method based spiral electrode resistivity probe rod and a monitoring method thereof. The probe rod structure design provided by the scheme can realize manual screwing in of soil through the design of the threaded electrode after the soil sampler is drilled; after the penetration of the probe rod is finished, the spiral electrode is converted into the annular electrode distributed at equal intervals through the electrode resetting device of the probe rod, so that long-term in-situ observation is finished, the time and the cost for equipment installation are greatly reduced through the design of the device, and the installation efficiency is improved; and the resistivity gradient of the soil can be truly reflected, the further development of the soil in-situ monitoring technology is promoted, and necessary technical and data support is provided for researching the evolution mechanism of seawater invasion and soil salinization and disaster prevention.

title_en: GRU deep learning-based multi-feature factor red tide prediction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GRU deep learning-based multi-feature factor red tide prediction model, which comprises the following steps of: s1, preprocessing the collected monitoring elements to obtain a standardized training sample; s2, analyzing the relevance between the standardized training sample and the red tide by adopting a Pearson correlation coefficient method to obtain a main characteristic influence factor formed by the red tide disaster; s3, forming multi-combination characteristic factors according to the main characteristic influence factors, constructing a GRU prediction model, and training the model through the multi-combination characteristic factors; and S4, evaluating the trained GRU prediction model. The correlation analysis between each element and the red tide is carried out by adopting a Pearson correlation coefficient method to obtain main characteristic influence factors formed by the red tide disasters, the characteristic influence factors with lower correlation degree with the red tide are removed, and a red tide prediction model based on multi-characteristic factor combination is constructed by taking the multi-combination characteristic factors as input variables to form a GRU network red tide prediction model based on the multi-characteristic factors.
assignees: NAT MARINE DATA AND INFORMATION SERVICE

title_en: Emergency evacuation scheme determination method and system for emergency evacuation scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency evacuation scheme determination method and system for an emergency evacuation scene. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a traditional social force model; correcting the traditional social force model by utilizing the attraction between the guide and the pedestrian and the panic factor, and determining the corrected traditional social force model; improving the pedestrian self-driving force in the corrected traditional social force model, and determining the improved pedestrian self-driving force; determining an improved social force model according to the improved self-driving force of the pedestrian and the attraction force between the guider and the pedestrian; and determining an emergency evacuation scheme according to the improved social force model. The invention considers the influence of the attraction of a leader and the psychological state of the pedestrian on the motion process of the pedestrian, provides the simulation of the motion trail of the pedestrian in the emergency evacuation scene, and provides reference for modeling the motion of the pedestrian and formulating an emergency evacuation plan in a public place.

title_en: Simulation system of digestion experience using VR
title_ko: Vr을 이용한 소화체험 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: The preset invention relates to a fire extinguishing experience simulation system using VR, a fire extinguisher for experience, and a fire extinguishing experience (fire extinguisher experience) simulator which uses a training fire extinguisher that mimics a shape of a real fire extinguisher and a head-up display (HMD) through programs, etc., thereby being able to experience firefighting in the same order as in actual firefighting activities indoors.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 VR을 이용한 소화체험 시뮬레이션 시스템, 체험용 소화기 및 프로그램 등에 통해 실제 소화기 모양을 본 뜬 훈련용 소화기와 헤드 업 디스플레이(HMD)를 사용하여 실내에서 실제 소방 활동과 같은 순서로 소방 체험이 가능한 소화 체험(소화기 체험) 시뮬레이터 등에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Disaster early warning method, device, storage medium and device based on satellite monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, in particular to a disaster early warning method, disaster early warning equipment, a disaster early warning storage medium and a disaster early warning device based on satellite monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a real-time monitoring image of a monitoring area through satellite monitoring; acquiring a preset disaster image set through satellite monitoring; performing deep learning training on the initial target monitoring model according to the preset disaster image set to obtain a deep learning disaster monitoring model; and inputting the real-time monitoring image into the deep learning disaster monitoring model, and performing disaster early warning according to an output result. According to the disaster early warning method and system, the disaster monitoring model is obtained through deep learning, specific disasters in a specific area are effectively monitored, and the efficiency and accuracy of disaster early warning are improved.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary decision making system and decision making method for emergency evacuation of large passenger ship
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent auxiliary decision-making platform for emergency evacuation of a large passenger ship, which comprises a data attribute collection module, a machine-computer data interaction module and an emergency plan virtual simulation platform, wherein the emergency plan virtual simulation platform comprises a virtual mapping module, a fire/smoke dynamic simulation module, a man-machine interaction correction module and an intelligent decision-making output module, and the decision-making method comprises the following steps of: the acquisition and transmission of attribute data are realized through the Internet of things technology and/or 5G communication; the simulation of the dynamic variation trend of fire, smoke and toxic gas is realized through CFD simulation software; manually confirming the simulation result through VR simulation; combining GIS technology and system engineering theory, outputting a multi-objective optimized intelligent emergency evacuation scheme; the invention combines artificial intelligence, virtual simulation, digital twin, 5G communication and Internet of things technologies, so that the intelligent control system has the functions of remote identification, intelligent simulation, multiple control and intelligent decision.

title_en: Visual display and evaluation system platform for explosion disasters
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an explosion disaster assessment method, including: establishing an explosion disaster scene physical model for an actual explosion disaster scene based on a plurality of parameter information of the actual explosion disaster scene; generating explosion disaster process simulation data by using a target numerical method and an explosion disaster scene physical model; generating at least a time-varying parameter variation curve of each of the plurality of parameter information and a time-varying parameter three-dimensional variation cloud map of each of the plurality of parameter information based on the explosion disaster process simulation data; simulating and displaying the explosion disaster process at least based on the parameter change curve and the parameter three-dimensional change cloud picture; and acquiring the damage degree of the high temperature to the human body and the damage degree of the overpressure to the human body at least based on the human body high-temperature damage model, the human body overpressure damage model and the explosion disaster process simulation data. The present disclosure also provides an explosion disaster evaluation apparatus, an electronic device, and a readable storage medium.
assignees: BEIJING INST PETROCHEM TECH;UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Flood inundation prediction method based on remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of flood disaster early warning, and provides a flood inundation prediction method based on remote sensing, which specifically comprises the following steps: calculating according to the maximum rain intensity and an upstream flood peak water level conversion model of the region where the target river basin is located to obtain the upstream flood peak water level of the target river basin; predicting the downstream flood peak water level of the target river basin according to the upstream flood peak water level and the downstream flood peak water level prediction model of the target river basin; and predicting the maximum flooding range of the target river basin by adopting a flood filling model. According to the invention, the hydrologic parameter information monitored by remote sensing is utilized to analyze the hydrologic rule of the river, the flood disasters of the middle and small river areas in developing countries or underdeveloped areas which lack hydrologic actual measurement data are further pre-warned according to the hydrologic rule, the hydraulic gradient existing on the upstream and downstream water surfaces of the river reach is fully considered, and the flood inundation simulation prediction under the condition that the flood evolves towards the downstream is facilitated.

title_en: Urban rail transit simulation drilling platform system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an urban rail transit simulation drilling platform system, which comprises a simulation scene and task setting module, a corner drilling module, a drilling instruction interaction module, a drilling disaster situation and process control module, a simulation drilling module, a site observation module, a task recording module and an intelligent judging module, wherein the simulation scene and task setting module at least comprises a disaster situation automatic spreading simulation scene when being executed; when the simulation drilling module is executed, the simulation drilling module at least comprises a disaster automatic spreading simulation scene; and when the intelligent judging module is executed, intelligent judgment is carried out through a water-fire countermeasure algorithm. The platform provided by the invention utilizes modern simulation exercise forms such as simulation scene setting, character-dividing exercise, exercise instruction interaction, exercise disaster condition and process control, simulation exercise, on-site observation, task recording, intelligent judgment and the like, and can effectively perfect urban rail transit simulation exercise.

title_en: Scene construction method and device for natural gas supply interruption emergency
abstract_en: The invention provides a scene construction method and a scene construction device for an emergency of natural gas supply interruption, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a core element constructed in the situation of the natural gas supply interruption emergency; determining a secondary element arranged under the core element; determining emergency scene segments in different development stages according to the core element and the secondary element and the time sequence and the disaster evolution sequence of the events; and constructing the scene of the natural gas supply interruption emergency according to the scene segments of the emergency at different development stages. The scheme is used for combing and defining the scene content of the natural gas supply interruption emergency, so that clear reference and guidance are provided for the establishment of an emergency plan of natural gas supply fluctuation and the establishment of emergency treatment measures for petroleum and petrochemical enterprises, and a solid theoretical basis is provided for the establishment of relevant emergency drills and emergency training teaching materials.

title_en: Forest fire alarm method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire alarm method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: s1: collecting videos and picture data related to forest fires, serializing the video data into pictures, and preprocessing the pictures to form sample data; s2: training a convolution neural network model for identifying the fire by using the sample data; s3: and collecting real-time monitoring video data, inputting the real-time monitoring video data into the convolutional neural network model in the step S2, analyzing whether a fire disaster occurs in real time, and generating alarm information if the fire disaster occurs. According to the method, firstly, a convolutional neural network model is trained through a large amount of positive and negative sample data, so that the model well learns almost all characteristics of fire, and in addition, the convolutional neural network has natural advantages for processing image data, and by combining the two characteristics, the accuracy of the model is ensured, and the accuracy in the data identification process is ensured.
assignees: HANGZHOU XUJIAN SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Aviation teaching simulation cabin for evacuation training
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aviation teaching simulation cabin aiming at evacuation training, which comprises an in-cabin lighting control module, a teaching content display module, a countdown display module, an evacuation focus detection module and a background data analysis module, wherein the in-cabin lighting control module comprises cabin lighting and a ground evacuation lamp, a start key is arranged on an interface of a mobile phone instructor end, the extinction of the cabin lighting and the opening of the ground evacuation lamp which are arranged in the aviation teaching simulation cabin are controlled by the start key, the countdown display module comprises a countdown display interface arranged on a mobile phone student end, the countdown display opening of the mobile phone student end is controlled by the start key arranged on the interface of the mobile phone instructor end, the evacuation focus detection module comprises focus buttons arranged at different parts of the aviation teaching simulation cabin, and the evacuation training simulation effect of the students is comprehensively embodied The teacher teaching aid has the advantages of convenience in operation of the teacher and data support for teaching of the teacher.
assignees: HENAN WANHANG AVIATION DEV CO LTD

title_en: Building damage identification method and device based on machine learning and computing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building damage identification method and device based on machine learning and computing equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a pre-disaster image and a post-disaster image of a target area; inputting the pre-disaster image and the post-disaster image into a first sub-network of a pre-trained building damage identification model; respectively inputting the output results of the first sub-network into a pre-disaster sub-network and a post-disaster sub-network in the building damage identification model; inputting the output results of the pre-disaster sub-network and the post-disaster sub-network into a second sub-network in the building damage identification model; and generating a building damage identification result corresponding to the target area according to the output result of the second sub-network. By adopting the scheme, the building damage identification end to end can be realized, the building damage identification precision is improved, the model parameters can be greatly reduced, the training efficiency is improved, and the overall calculation cost is reduced. Moreover, the scheme is simple and feasible, and is suitable for large-scale application and implementation.

title_en: Disaster recovery corresponding management system
abstract_en: To provide a disaster recovery corresponding management system capable of achieving a disaster recovery corresponding smart city capable of providing a disaster recovery function during disaster.SOLUTION: Managing means 41 manages normal-time and disaster-occurrence-time functions of a view point hotel 21, a lodging house 23, a helicopter take-off and landing field 25, a lodging facility 27, a gymnasium 29, and a rescue dog training facility 31 in a disaster recovery corresponding smart city 11. title_en: Leasing operation system for shared restaurant and community first-aid station, and method therefor
abstract_en: A leasing operation system for a shared restaurant and a community first-aid station, and a method therefor. Said system is composed of an operation management platform A, a shared restaurant and a community first-aid station. The shared restaurant establishes, in a commercial mode of "sharing economy and gig economy", a cafe chantant B operating in an entertainment manner, a chef entrepreneurship show B-1 and a customized sales place platform D, and has no dishes of fixed flavor or cook team. Anyone C can participate in a cooking skill competition and apply for a periodic lease to become an entrepreneurial or part-time cook of the platform, or share a family kitchen restaurant to show the cooking skill by means of the platform and network and sell delicious food for making money and social contact, reducing the costs of eating outside. A chain community first-aid station is established to perform first-aid skill training m for the poor in good health and veterans, and provide disaster prevention, disaster rescue and food delivery and express delivery services F for community residents, changing the traditional passive and low-efficient disaster rescue and sheltering methods. The present project has a wide range of benefits and broad development space of industrial chains.

title_en: Method and device for forecasting flood based on data analyzing
title_ko: 자료해석 기반 침수 예측 방법 및 이를 위한 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for data analysis-based flooding prediction including; a step of predicting a cumulative monthly flow with respect to a drainpipe in a specific area through a nonlinear autoregressive exogenous model (NARX) artificial neural network that has learned cumulative rainfall information and cumulative monthly flow information; a step of deriving 2D flooding map data by applying 2D flooding map data on a rainfall scenario and an actual rainfall to a self organizing map (SOM) artificial neural network; and a step of predicting a flooding range of the specific area based on the cumulative monthly flow and the 2D flooding map data. With the present invention, it is possible to pre-understand a flood pattern through a rainfall-outflow-flooding database and provide basic data for disaster prevention enhancement.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 자료해석 기반 침수 예측 방법은 누적강우량 정보와 누적월류량 정보를 학습한 비선형 자기회귀(NARX: nonlinear autoregressive exogenous model) 인공신경망을 통해 특정 지역의 하수관에 대한 누적월류량을 예측하는 단계; 강우 시나리오 및 실제 강우에 대한 2차원 침수지도 데이터를 자기조직화 지도(SOM: self organizing map) 인공신경망에 적용하여 2차원 침수지도 데이터를 도출하는 단계; 및 상기 누적월류량 및 상기 2차원 침수지도 데이터에 기반하여 상기 특정 지역의 침수 범위를 예측하는 단계를 포함하여 강우-유출-침수 데이터베이스를 통한 홍수 양상의 사전 파악 및 방재성능 향상을 위한 기초자료를 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KOREA WATER RESOURCES CORP;KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Fire training device
title_ko: 소방 농연 훈련장
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire-fighting training ground with dense smoke. According to the present invention, the fire-fighting training ground with dense smoke comprises: a training structure in which a plurality of cells formed in a grid shape are formed by assembling pipes; a foothold unit which constitutes a lower end part of the cells, is coupled to the pipes at a corresponding position, and forms a place that trainees step on and pass through; a shielding unit which is provided on at least one among a plurality of side walls constituting the cells, and shields the corresponding side wall; and a pillar wall unit which is formed in any one cell or the plurality of integrated cells in the training structure, and blocks the trainees not to pass through a corresponding space. According to the present invention, casualties can be reduced.
abstract_ko: 소방 농연 훈련장에 관한 발명이다. 본 발명의 소방 농연 훈련장은, 파이프의 조립으로 격자 형상으로 된 복수의 셀(cell)이 형성되는 훈련 구조체; 상기 셀의 하단부를 이루되 해당 위치의 파이프에 결합하며, 피교육생이 밟고 지나는 자리를 형성하는 발판 유닛; 상기 셀을 이루는 복수의 측벽 중에서 적어도 어느 한 곳에 마련되며, 해당 측벽을 차폐하는 차폐부; 및 상기 훈련 구조체 내의 어느 한 셀 혹은 상기 셀이 통합된 복수의 셀에 형성되며, 해당 공간을 지나지 못하게 차단하는 기둥 벽체부를 포함한다.

title_en: Track traffic operation stage comprehensive information supervision system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rail transit, and particularly relates to a comprehensive information supervision system in a rail transit operation stage, which comprises a wire mesh level comprehensive monitoring module, a rail and contact net intelligent detection module, a vehicle running state monitoring module and a passenger flow detection and early warning module; the network-level comprehensive monitoring module comprises an access platform, a data processing platform, a man-machine interaction platform, a testing system, a network management system, a training system and a disaster recovery backup; the intelligent detection module for the track and the overhead line system comprises a track measurement subsystem, an overhead line system measurement subsystem, a traction drive subsystem and an information comprehensive processing system; the vehicle running state monitoring module comprises trend analysis, state maintenance auxiliary decision and a vehicle running state; the passenger flow detection and early warning module comprises digital passenger flow statistical analysis, analog passenger flow statistical analysis and laser passenger flow statistical analysis. The system solves the problem that the content and the application capability of the existing rail transit operation period information cannot meet the management requirement.
assignees: SHANXI INFORMATION INDUSTRIAL TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological disaster early warning scheme generation method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meteorological disaster early warning scheme generation method based on deep learning, which specifically comprises the following main steps: step 1, acquiring meteorological disaster early warning scheme data; step 2, preprocessing a meteorological disaster early warning scheme data set, and constructing a meteorological disaster early warning scheme sample data set with named entity identification tags, wherein the meteorological disaster early warning scheme is generated by utilizing a deep learning technology, a small amount of texts are extracted and input into a RoBERTA-BilSTM-CRF model for training until convergence, then the rest texts are input into the model for extracting the key entity tags of the meteorological disaster early warning scheme, and template texts are generated; and 3, generating a meteorological disaster early warning scheme by using the GPT-2 model, wherein the model can generate a large amount of meteorological disaster early warning scheme template texts, so that the meteorological disaster early warning scheme database data is expanded, and the accuracy of the output early warning scheme can be effectively improved.
assignees: NANJING MANXING DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Panic group emergency evacuation analysis method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a panic group emergency evacuation analysis method based on big data, which simulates the emergency evacuation scene of a shopping mall through a big data platform, processes the large emergency evacuation data of the shopping mall by using a parallelized ant colony algorithm to obtain the evacuation path selection of escape people with different panic degrees, thereby realizing the combination of a big data technology and a group panic theory, solving the storage and analysis problems of large scale, various structures and low value density of the large emergency evacuation related data of the shopping mall by using the big data technology, processing the emergency evacuation related data of the shopping mall by using the parallelized ant colony algorithm based on MapReduce, quantifying the influence of panic group behaviors on the evacuation efficiency, obtaining the evacuation efficiency change of different panic groups under the escape condition, shortening the processing time, reducing the processing cost and difficulty, thereby realizing the purposes of reasonably utilizing evacuation road sections and effectively evacuating panic groups, finally preventing the occurrence of serious trampling accidents.

title_en: Fire extinguishing training and demonstration device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a training and presentation device put out a fire solves prior art and puts out a fire the not good enough and training show inconvenient technical problem of show authenticity. The utility model comprises a fire occurrence simulation device, a fire extinguisher and a control handle; the fire disaster generation simulation device comprises a flame generator, a fuel tank which is connected with the flame generator through a fuel delivery pipe and internally stores high-pressure propane fuel, a flow control valve arranged on the fuel delivery pipe, and a control box; the control box is internally provided with a microprocessor which is respectively connected with the flame generator and the flow control valve, and the microprocessor is connected with a wireless receiving and transmitting module which is wirelessly connected with the control handle. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure and scientific and reasonable design, convenient to use can cooperate professional knowledge to carry out the on-the-spot show at the training scene, and small and exquisite portable simultaneously, the training person can bear on the back and carry out the show of putting out a fire to the temporary training place.

title_en: System and method for predicting damages of building fire
title_ko: 건축물 화재의 피해 예측 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a system for predicting damage from building fire to minimize damage. The system comprises: a database unit analyzing a scenario related to fire and progress, which can occur in a building, through numerical analysis and storing an analysis result; a sensing unit sensing fire information in an event of fire using multiple sensors installed in the building; a determination unit selecting a scenario by matching the fire information sensed by the sensing unit with the scenario stored in the database unit; and a notification unit notifying a safety manager and an occupant of the building using the information of the determination unit of a level of danger and whether to evacuate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물에서 발생가능한 화재 및 진행에 관한 시나리오를 수치해석을 통해 분석하고 이를 저장하는 데이터베이스부, 건축물에 복수로 설치되는 센서를 이용하여 화재시 화재정보를 감지하는 감지부, 상기 감지부에서 감지되는 화재정보와 상기 데이터베이스부에 저장된 시나리오를 매칭하여 시나리오를 선택하는 판단부 및 상기 판단부의 정보를 이용하여 건축물의 안전관리자 및 재실자에게 위험도 및 대피여부를 알리는 알림부를 포함하는 건축물 화재의 피해 예측 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Fixed knot of geological disasters real-time supervision early warning device constructs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixed structure of a real-time geological disaster monitoring and early warning device, relating to the technical field of monitoring devices; the drilling machine comprises an insertion hole, a fixing rod, a cavity, a through hole, a drill bit and a rotating pressing mechanism, wherein the insertion hole is formed in the ground, the lower end of the fixing rod is inserted into the insertion hole, the cavity is formed in the fixing rod, the through hole is formed in one side of the lower end of the fixing rod, the drill bit is located in the through hole and used for drilling the side wall of the insertion hole, and the rotating. Firstly, drilling a jack on the ground, then inserting the fixing rod, and drilling a drill hole by using a drill bit to prevent the fixing rod from being pulled out.

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method based on scene semantic information under complex indoor structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of crowd evacuation simulation, in particular to a crowd evacuation simulation method based on scene semantic information under a complex indoor structure i Initializing a simulation scene; determining a danger source, and establishing a danger field and an information field by directly transmitting danger signals and indirectly transmitting the danger signals by taking the danger source as a starting point; dividing the pedestrians into different states according to the difference of the information acquired from the dangerous field or the information field, and correcting the expected speed of the pedestrians; adopting a pre-ERRT algorithm model to establish pedestrian evacuation path navigation, and optimizing the evacuation direction in the pedestrian evacuation navigation path to obtain the final path navigation direction; method for introducing pedestriansAnd (4) modifying the social force model under the complex indoor structure according to the mutual affinity and sparseness degree and pedestrian density information, calculating the acceleration of the pedestrian, and performing weighted summation to obtain the direction and the size of the final speed variation. The method can acquire scene semantic information of the complex indoor structure in real time, and improves crowd evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Test device for simulating coal and gas outburst impact disaster-causing effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device for simulating coal and gas outburst impact disaster-causing effect, which comprises: the gas pressure measuring device comprises an experiment box, a gas pressure measuring device and a gas pressure measuring device, wherein a fixed monitoring structure, a sealing structure and a measuring structure are arranged on the experiment box, and an air pressure structure and a gas pressurization structure are arranged on the sealing structure; the invention has the advantages that the experiment box can be independently communicated with different box bodies through the sealing structure, so that the experiment effect is achieved, the fracture pressure of a coal sample is measured through the air pressure structure, the pressure in the experiment box is increased to the coal cracking pressure through the gas pressurization structure, and the injection distance and the destructive power under the cracking pressure are measured through the measurement structure.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Suffocation emergency training system based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an asphyxia emergency training system based on a virtual reality technology, which comprises: virtual simulation scene: adopting MAYA software modeling and UnityD as an engine to manufacture an outdoor emergency simulation working scene, an indoor emergency simulation scene and a disaster state emergency simulation scene; the course auxiliary module: configuring emergency treatment manuals, specifications, treatment flows and the like corresponding to the Helimek self-rescue method and the Helimek infant emergency treatment method, and matching with a logic switch for voice guidance and relevant animation demonstration videos and trigger conditions; the central controller: processing the acquired data and performing logic processing; hardware simulation model: the simulation respiratory tract model which can be used as an input end and the simulation chest cavity model which can be used as an input end and an output end are responsible for collecting data of a user and feeding back pulse data of a saved person in a virtual scene. The teaching effect of the invention is more visual, the use is sanitary, the operation is simple, and the teaching effect is good.
assignees: XUZHOU VR POWER INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;SHANGHAI MINGHUA ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD;TIANJI POWER STATION HUAIHU COAL & POWER CO LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery exercise method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery exercise method, device, equipment and readable storage medium. The method disclosed by the application comprises the following steps: acquiring a task of disaster recovery exercise of an operating original host; determining the type of the task according to the data synchronization condition corresponding to the task; determining exercise data corresponding to the task in the standby site of the original host according to the type; based on the exercise data, an exercise master identical to the original master is created in the standby site, and the exercise master is started to check the availability of the exercise master. The disaster recovery exercise scheme provided by the application does not influence the normal operation of the business on the original host, and because the exercise data required by the disaster recovery exercise are executed based on the data synchronization condition corresponding to the disaster recovery exercise task, manual operation is not needed, so that the disaster recovery exercise efficiency can be improved. Correspondingly, the disaster recovery exercise device, the disaster recovery exercise equipment and the readable storage medium have the technical effects.

title_en: Simulation drilling method for emergency disposal of leakage of liquid oxygen storage tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation drilling method for leakage emergency disposal of a liquid oxygen storage tank, and belongs to the technical field of chemical leakage emergency disposal. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: 1) loading a liquid oxygen leakage scene in the emergency simulation drilling system; 2) simulating liquid oxygen leakage accident management operation; 3) the traditional A-x algorithm is improved and embedded into an emergency simulation drilling system, and escape paths with higher safety are planned for evacuation and evacuation of people; 4) and after the drilling is finished, comprehensively evaluating drilling results. The invention is based on the virtual reality technology, so that the drilling of the emergency treatment of the liquid oxygen leakage of the factory becomes a normalization, thereby not only improving the emergency treatment capability of the staff to the sudden liquid oxygen leakage accident, but also strengthening the drilling mechanism of the emergency treatment of the liquid oxygen leakage, and effectively reducing the economic loss caused by the liquid oxygen leakage accident.

title_en: Experimental method and device for dynamic disaster of rock burst in roadway excavation
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for dynamic disaster experiment of tunnel driving rock burst is characterized in that the experiment method includes an experiment for simulating tunnel driving under normal geological conditions and an experiment for simulating tunnel driving under abnormal geological conditions; both of them comprise (1) preparing a sample; (2) applying a static load to the sample, and simulating the actual stress environment of rock mass around the underground tunneling working face of the coal mine; (3) controlling the motion track of a cutter to simulate tunneling through a computer program, and collecting acoustoelectric and mechanical signals fed back in the tunneling process of a sample; (4) withdrawing the cutter from the sample, and collecting acoustoelectric and mechanical signals fed back in the process of stopping digging the sample; (5) respectively in step 2 and step 3, applying dynamic load, and controlling dynamic loading waveform characteristics and application time parameters by a computer; (6) and changing the form and the strength of the dynamic load waveform until the sample is subjected to impact damage, obtaining the condition criterion of the roadway impact damage and the like. The method can provide theoretical reference and scientific countermeasures for early warning and prevention of coal mine roadway excavation rock burst.

title_en: Method and device for predicting tunnel water inrush disaster, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting a tunnel water inrush disaster, which comprises the following steps of S1, performing radar remote sensing inversion on soil water information: s2, comprehensively interpreting tunnel region fault and joint information by physical prospecting: s3, GIS extracts topographic relief and surface depression information: s4, three-dimensional geological modeling based on drilling data obtains lithology, dip angle, fold, water head and other information: s5, constructing a multi-factor evaluation standard, and carrying out assignment scoring on each influence factor: s6, determining the weight of the evaluation factor by adopting an AHP method: and S7, establishing a GIS evaluation model to predict the sudden water inrush disaster. The method for predicting the tunnel water inrush disaster establishes a scientific, comprehensive and visual tunnel water inrush disaster model, and provides a new technology and a new method for predicting the tunnel water inrush disaster.

title_en: Testing system and method for simulating change in tunnel excavation seepage under complex geological conditions
abstract_en: Disclosed is a testing system for simulating change in tunnel excavation seepage under complex geological conditions; the system comprises a test chamber (1); a ground stress loading unit (2) is arranged on top of the test chamber (1); the test chamber (1) may be internally provided with a test piece, and holes (18) are provided on each side of the circumference of the test chamber (1); some of the holes (18) are used as simulations of tunnel excavation holes; plug heads (8) or hollow plug heads (9) are arranged at some of the holes (18), and the side of the test chamber (1) is provided with a water filling tank (20); the water filling tank (20) is connected to a water inlet hole (21) arranged in the chamber; each of the hollow plug heads (9) and the water filling tank (20) are in communication with a seepage pressure loading unit (3). Also disclosed is a testing method for simulating change in tunnel excavation seepage under complex geological conditions. The system can be used to simulate tunneling in complex geological conditions under different "high ground stress and high water pressure" conditions to study changes in a groundwater seepage field within water barrier rock under the effect of excavation disturbance and high pressure seepage, and then evaluate the hazards of water inrush and mud inrush, providing a basis for engineering disaster prevention and disaster mitigation.

title_en: Experimental simulation device and method for high-temperature oxidation characteristic and ignition/explosion gas of coal
abstract_en: An experimental simulation device and method of high-temperature oxidation characteristic and ignition/explosion gas of coal, the apparatus includes the quantitative proportioning air feeder, burns the reaction furnace, pressure relief protection device, computer automatic monitoring device; putting the coal sample into a combustion reaction furnace, opening each switch, observing the running condition of each parameter, and observing the change of the pressure and flow values; collecting experimental data in real time; if the temperature sensor and the pressure sensor show that the temperature and the pressure in the combustion reaction furnace suddenly rise and are accompanied by violent sounds, the explosion reaction in the combustion furnace is shown, the temperature and the pressure at the moment are recorded as conditions for igniting/exploding gas due to spontaneous combustion of coal, reference is provided for underground on-site air quantity and temperature adjustment, and strong air pressure generated by the reaction is discharged through the lengthened steel pipe and the pressure release valve; the method has the advantages of realizing spontaneous combustion ignition/gas explosion of the coal, truly simulating the occurrence condition of disasters, providing theoretical guidance and reference for preventing and controlling the coupling disasters of spontaneous combustion of the coal and the gas in the mine, and reducing the probability of gas explosion.

title_en: Geological disaster-based underground rock stratum profile analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster-based underground rock stratum profile analysis method. The method comprises the following steps: s1: making a shape point format file; s2: storing geological formation data; s3: storing karst stratum data; s4: leading in a point position map layer and a drilling record point map layer of the exploration engineering; s5: and (5) performing spatial analysis operation. The invention does not need manual drawing, and completely realizes automatic analysis; a user can simply draw a tangent line at any position, and the corresponding analysis algorithm and service are realized by adopting the B/S framework, so that the underground rock stratum profile can be obtained conveniently and quickly.

title_en: Advanced prevention and control method for water damage of fault roof of working face
abstract_en: A method for preventing and treating fault roof water damage of a working face in advance comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: exposing a fault zone on a working face, selecting a proper position on a lower disc of the fault zone for construction, drilling a fault zone section by section, and drilling a water-pressing hole to penetrate through the fault zone, wherein the position of a final hole does not exceed the range boundary of the predicted fault zone; step two: the method comprises the following steps that a double-plug water pressing device is adopted to perform sectional water pressing in a sectional water pressing drill hole of a fault zone, the distance between two sectional water pressing plugs is 5m, water pressing is performed on the front 20m and the rear 20m of the fault zone after the position of the fault zone is determined, and the position of the fault zone and the position of an affected zone of the fault zone are determined; the method is characterized in that the influence range of the fault zone is determined through single-hole exploration and sectional water pressing, and a target area is provided for subsequent drilling; grouting reinforcement is carried out on fault fracture zones within the range of the collapse zone through low grouting drill holes; the water is prevented from flowing into the front of the rack along the fault zone and further disasters caused by high water pressure through advanced interception and pressure relief of the high-level drainage pressure relief drill hole and water burst of the pressure relief fault zone, so that the fault water damage of the top plate is avoided.
assignees: SHAANXI XUNYI QINGGANGPING MINING CO LTD

title_en: Emergency response drills
abstract_en: A school communication system includes: a district server configured to manage at least one communication system located within a district location managed by the district server; a district network configured to communicatively couple the at least one communication system and the district server; and the at least one communication system. The at least one communication system comprises: a network switch configured to integrate communication equipment associated with the district location; and campus controller. The campus controller is configured to: receive an emergency drill configuration from the district server; receive a signal to begin an emergency drill; perform one or more actions in the emergency drill via the network switch; and report that the drill was initiated.

title_en: Evacuation guidance device, and evacuation guidance model learning device
abstract_en: To lead evacuees to evacuate in a manner to minimize risks by taking into account of an evacuation simulation result when a disaster occurs.SOLUTION: An obtainment section 36 of an evacuation guidance device 30 obtains observation information expressing positions or motions of people when a disaster occurs. Then, an evacuation information generation section 38 inputs, on the basis of an evacuation simulation result when the disaster occurs, the observation information obtained by the obtainment section 36, into a trained model to which reinforcement learning has been previously performed by using a count of deaths and a count of injured persons in the disaster of the evacuation simulation as well as a remuneration set in accordance with a time until the evacuation completes, and generates evacuation information which is information relating to an evacuation route when the disaster occurs. And further, a control section 40 controls a display device 42 in accordance with the evacuation information generated by the evacuation information generation section 38.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Device for simulating degradation of hydro-fluctuation belt of bank slope in reservoir area
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disasters prevention and cure field especially relates to a device that is used for reservoir area bank slope falling zone degradation simulation. Including the experimental box and set up in the inside holder that is used for the splendid attire sample of experimental box, the inside of experimental box is equipped with protecting sheathing from outside to inside in order, insulating shielding shell, high degree of consistency permanent magnet, no magnetic aluminum bottom plate, radio frequency coil, glass tempering pipe and set up the holder that is used for splendid attire rock sample at the experimental box middle part, the radio frequency coil winding is on glass tempering pipe, the holder is located the middle part of experimental box, and the holder includes no magnetic glass steel shell, no magnetic glass steel inner shell and holder screw cap, optic fibre evenly is equipped with 4 groups on the outer wall of no magnetic glass steel inner shell. This technical scheme is used for solving traditional rock degradation experimental box and can not gather the parameter variation of rock inside, does not reach the purpose to rock degradation process real time monitoring to and the not accurate problem of experimental result who reachs.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Collapse rock disaster scene reappearing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collapse rock disaster scene reappearing method, which comprises the steps of constructing an integral panoramic three-dimensional model and a local collapse rock three-dimensional model, and extracting topographic and structural surface elements of a collapse rock disaster; taking the geometric surfaces forming the rock rolling body as polygonal surfaces surrounded by a series of vertexes, and establishing a rock rolling block body model; reconstructing a three-dimensional ground surface grid of the collapse rock disaster scene through the ground surface contour line control points and the material properties of the control points, and constructing a sliding bed block system model by utilizing the three-dimensional ground surface grid; and acquiring a triangular mesh of a collapsed body outline and a deterministic structural surface, generating a three-dimensional random joint network in the collapsed body outline by using the geometric elements of the random joint surface, constructing a collapsed block system, acquiring a collapsed rolling stone disaster scene graph, and realizing the simulation of the whole disaster evolution process. The method realizes seamless connection and effective fusion of data of measurement, model and calculation, reproduces the scene evolution process of the collapse rock disaster, and has the advantages of advanced technology, simple and convenient operation and the like.

title_en: Generation method of cable shaft fire state recognition decision tree model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for generating a cable shaft fire disaster state recognition decision tree model, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting a residual current value and a residual voltage value of a cable in a cable shaft, acquiring a resistive residual current component in residual current, and acquiring a fault arc characteristic of the residual voltage; step S2, collecting ultrasonic signals generated by partial discharge in the cable shaft, and positioning according to the ultrasonic signals to determine the size and position of the partial discharge as partial discharge information; step S3, collecting the environmental temperature, the detection point temperature and the smoke concentration in the cable shaft; step S4, evaluating the feature items through a preset rule to generate an evaluation result; and inputting the evaluation result and the input corresponding characteristics as training data into a preset model for training to generate a decision tree model. The invention effectively reduces the precision requirement of the monitoring equipment, and has strong real-time performance, high monitoring effect and high response speed.

title_en: Method and system for forecasting lightning potential of power transmission channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a method and a system for forecasting lightning potential of a power transmission channel, which are used for providing disaster prediction data support for power grid safety risk protection. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological element variable data of a first scale of a power transmission channel; calculating meteorological element variable data of a second scale of the power transmission channel by adopting large vortex simulation; the second dimension is less than the first dimension; under the first scale, calculating a convection stability index and an atmospheric layer junction stability according to a large vortex simulation result; and inputting the convection stability index and the atmospheric layer junction stability into a lightning potential forecasting model to obtain a lightning potential intensity forecasting result.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Disaster simulation device and experimental method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster simulation device and an experiment method, and relates to the field of building structure experiment devices and methods, wherein the technical scheme is characterized by comprising a counter-force pedestal, wherein the counter-force pedestal is a groove-type experiment pedestal; the test bench comprises a groove rail, wherein the groove rail is arranged on two sides of the test bench, a detachable load assembly is further arranged on the groove rail and comprises a support component connected with the groove rail and a load component connected with the support component through bolts, the support component is provided with anchor bolts and a counter-force pedestal, a pressing device for applying pressure to the top of the test piece in the counter-object assembly is connected to the load component, a reaction force is generated after the pressing device acts on the test piece, and the reaction force is transmitted to the counter-force pedestal through the support component.

title_en: Carbon dioxide fire extinguisher rehearsal device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon dioxide fire extinguisher drilling device, which comprises a cooling chamber, wherein a combustion chamber is arranged in the middle of the cooling chamber, at least three support columns are arranged below the cooling chamber, a gas path pipeline communicated with a gas source is arranged at the bottom of the combustion chamber, and a waste liquid chamber is arranged at the bottom of the combustion chamber; this carbon dioxide fire extinguisher rehearsal device through the cooperation of gas circuit pipeline and first valve, uses the natural gas as the burning things which may cause a fire disaster, and not only the ignition is convenient, safe and reliable, and can use repeatedly, and the environmental pollution who produces is less. Through the cooperation of leakage fluid dram, discharge port and waste liquid chamber for carbon dioxide foam in the combustion chamber and in getting into the gas circuit pipeline can be collected smoothly, avoids too much remaining subaerial, causes environmental pollution.

title_en: Mountainous river flood process simulation method of non-material multi-flood-obstacle structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mountainous river flood process simulation method of a non-material multi-flood-obstacle structure, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a one-dimensional hydrodynamic model of the mountain river; step 2: calculating an interval flood process; and step 3: and (5) calibrating and verifying the model. The method for simulating the mountain river flood process of the mountainous river without data and multiple flood-obstructing structures is innovatively provided by constructing a hydrodynamic model, provides reference for solving the flood seeking problem of the mountain river, and has important practical significance for improving the mountain river flood forecasting level and guiding flood recovery, flood control planning and engineering design work after disasters. At present, the method has been successfully used for researching flood control planning schemes in Qijiang district main cities in Chongqing City, flood control planning in she county cities, flood planning in Mey Wen non-controlled intervals in the upstream of Mei public rivers and the like.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Rain and flood disaster process evaluation device and method based on similar theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating a rain and flood disaster process based on a similar theory, which comprises a rainfall facility and a runoff platform; the method comprises the steps of manufacturing rainfall facilities and laying test terrains. The rainfall facility is used for simulating artificial rainfall, the rainfall intensity of each rainfall plate is controlled by manually adjusting and controlling the opening of the valve of the ball valve, and the experimental terrain is modeled by 3D printing, so that the scale height experimental environment required by the experiment is ensured; the surface of the underlying surface platform ensures different roughness and infiltration rates of different land utilization types of the test terrain by adjusting the smoothness and porosity; the invention realizes a rainfall flood disaster process simulation method based on a similar theory, wherein an actual rainfall process (spatial non-uniformity non-uniform rainfall) can be automatically controlled, an experimental terrain is consistent with an actual terrain contrast, and the actual rainfall flood disaster can be predicted and evaluated through the simulation of the rainfall flood disaster in the experiment.

title_en: Modular hydrological simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modular hydrological simulation system which comprises a module library, an expert library, an intelligent algorithm library, a system library, a database and a post-processing function library, wherein the module library is a hydrological process module library constructed aiming at different physical processes in the actual basin runoff producing process; the expert database is a small watershed hydrological simulation expert database constructed on the basis of national mountain torrent disaster investigation and evaluation results and a large number of physical and numerical simulation test results; the intelligent algorithm library comprises an artificial intelligent algorithm module, a data fusion algorithm module and a big data analysis algorithm module; the system library comprises a number format conversion module, a spatial data processing module, a time step length setting module and a calculation control module; and the database manages the data according to the physical meanings corresponding to the input, generation and output of the basin information in the simulation process. The invention realizes the design ideas of system modularization, parameterization, intellectualization, visualization and automation, and improves the calculation stability and the functional flexibility of the simulation system.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Electric power safety training entity simulation system
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power safety training entity simulation system which comprises a support frame, simulation electric power equipment, a smoke sensor, a support rod, a support tube, an adjusting bolt and a support base, wherein the longitudinal lower ends of the support frame are respectively connected to the left end and the right end of the upper part of the simulation electric power equipment through bolts; the left end and the right end of the top of the inner side of the simulation power equipment are both connected with smoke sensors through screws. According to the invention, the fire extinguishing spray row, the cleaning cap, the fire extinguishing nozzle, the rubber hose, the fire extinguishing spray pump, the dry powder fire extinguishing tank and the tank cover are arranged, when a fire disaster occurs in simulation power equipment, smoke monitoring can be carried out through the smoke sensor, real-time information processing can be carried out through the host, dry powder in the dry powder fire extinguishing tank can be sucked out through the fire extinguishing spray pump, the dry powder is pumped into the fire extinguishing spray row through the rubber hose and is sprayed out through the fire extinguishing nozzle, and then fire extinguishing demonstration operation can be carried out, so that more intuitiveness in training and demonstration can be ensured.
assignees: JIANGSU WIZPOWER ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: VR firefighter simulation training assessment system and training method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a VR firefighter simulation training examination system and a training method, wherein the VR firefighter simulation training examination system comprises a somatosensory feedback module, and the somatosensory feedback module comprises a fire-fighting simulation water gun, a force feedback fire hose arranged on the fire-fighting simulation water gun, a VR helmet and a self-heating fire-fighting suit; the fire-fighting simulation water gun comprises a gun body, a handle, a wireless control panel, a laser space locator, a gear adjusting knob, a displacement button and a water gun switch arranged at the adjacent position of the handle. The virtual scene model establishing module is used for establishing various customized virtual fire scenes; the training and examining module is used for providing theoretical teaching knowledge for firemen and carrying out training, examining and managing; and the system server is used for storing and recording the firefighter training and examination data so as to facilitate data query. The invention can be added and combined with fire scenes at will, can be trained repeatedly, truly simulates rescue scenes, and greatly improves the reality and the sense of scene of exercise. The potential safety hazard in the training process is reduced, and the training efficiency is improved.

title_en: Simulator is felt to head protection eminence object fall safety body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a head protection high-altitude falling object safety body sensing simulator, which comprises a body sensing simulator main body, a motor and a head model worn on a helmet, wherein slide rails are symmetrically arranged on the two inner sides of the body sensing simulator main body, a heavy object simulator is connected to the bottom end of the motor and is matched with the slide rails, symmetrical U-shaped fixed blocks are fixedly connected to the two outer sides of the motor, a spring sleeve is arranged in the middle of each U-shaped fixed block, and a threaded rod is connected to the top end of each spring sleeve in a threaded manner; through having installed sucking disc and buffer spring additional, the inside air of sucking disc evacuation adsorbs on the bottom surface, and the position that simulator main part was felt to the body this moment can be fixed, and this easy operation has improved the stability that the simulator main part was felt to the body, and in addition, buffer spring can absorb the impact force, plays the bradyseism effect to reduce the impact force that the simulator main part received, avoid feeling the simulator main part and receive the damage, thereby improve the security that the simulator main part was felt to the body.
assignees: WUXI HANGKONG AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency treatment method for slurry blasting of bottom communicating cavity of precast concrete shear wall
