abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency treatment method for slurry explosion of a communication cavity at the bottom of a precast concrete shear wall, which divides the slurry explosion condition into two states according to the position and the damage degree of a plugging strip, wherein when: when the whole or part of the plugging strip is separated from the inner side of the prefabricated outer wall or any side of the prefabricated inner wall, the operation is carried out according to the following steps: s1, resetting the separated connecting cavity blocking strip to realize effective connection with the non-separated part; s2, selecting at least one point on the reset plugging strip, moving backwards for a set distance and fixing the point on the floor slab, vertically nailing a steel drill bit into the floor slab at the fixed point, inserting a batten between the steel drill bit and the plugging strip, providing counter force at the batten position through the steel drill bit to tightly push the plugging strip, and smearing a proper amount of quick plugging material at two ends of the reset and tightly pushed plugging strip; and S3, performing secondary grouting. The invention can carry out emergency treatment and can quickly recover grouting, thereby improving the working efficiency of a construction site and the capability of emergency response.

title_en: Cascading failure simulation method for thermoelectric coupling system under extremely cold disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascading failure simulation method of a thermoelectric coupling system under an extremely cold disaster, which comprises the following steps: acquiring natural disaster meteorological data and system load data at the time t; calculating the line fault probability based on the Markov state space; randomly switching off the line according to the line fault probability, and updating the network topology of the thermoelectric coupling system; performing thermoelectric coupling load flow calculation based on the updated thermoelectric coupling system, and identifying a power out-of-limit circuit; and disconnecting the power out-of-limit line, updating the network topology of the thermoelectric coupling system, and calculating the load loss of the thermoelectric coupling system at the moment t. The method calculates the line fault probability of the thermoelectric coupling system under the extremely cold disaster based on the Markov state space, identifies the power out-of-limit line based on the power flow calculation, disconnects the fault line and the power out-of-limit line, can calculate the load loss of the thermoelectric coupling system under the disaster, and can simulate the cascading faults of the thermoelectric coupling system in the disaster occurrence process.

title_en: Disaster recovery drilling plan generation method and device of system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for generating a disaster recovery drilling plan of a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a disaster recovery drilling plan generation request is received, determining each application system; generating a request based on a disaster recovery drilling plan, acquiring a standard time feature vector, and acquiring a system time feature vector of each application system; calculating the standard time feature vector and the system time feature vector of each application system respectively to obtain a drilling risk degree vector of each application system; for each application system, generating a disaster backup exercise plan of the application system based on the comprehensive score and exercise risk degree vector of the application system. By applying the invention, when the disaster recovery exercise program of each application system is generated, multiple rounds of communication are not needed to be carried out on each department one by one, so that the time required for generating the disaster recovery exercise program of the system is effectively reduced, the disaster recovery exercise program of each application system can be rapidly generated, and the efficiency of generating the disaster recovery exercise program is improved.

title_en: Electric power emergency command system
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power emergency command system, which comprises: the system comprises a data acquisition module, an emergency preparation module, a monitoring and early warning module and an emergency disposal and rescue module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring power grid data information, disaster information, important activity schedule information and emergency basic information; the emergency preparation module is used for performing structured decomposition on the text plan according to the power grid data information, the disaster information and the emergency basic information to generate an emergency plan and performing training and drilling according to the emergency plan; the monitoring and early warning module is used for creating an emergency early warning event according to the disaster information; and the emergency disposal and rescue module is used for carrying out emergency disposal and rescue according to the current emergency early warning event and the corresponding emergency plan. By implementing the method and the device, the emergency handling capacity is improved, the safe and stable operation of the power grid is practically ensured, the occurrence of power grid accidents is prevented, the loss caused by emergencies is reduced, and the operation of the power grid is quickly recovered.
assignees: GLOBAL ENERGY INTERCONNECTION RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power transmission line ice wind disaster fault type evaluation method based on naive Bayes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a naive Bayes-based method for evaluating ice wind disaster fault types of a power transmission line. The method comprises the following steps of dividing typical ice wind disaster types of the power transmission line; selecting disaster-causing factors of the power transmission line; establishing a naive Bayes model; training a sample based on naive Bayes; and evaluating the type of the ice wind disaster fault of the power transmission line. The method can effectively evaluate the ice wind disaster fault type of the power transmission line under the condition of less fault samples so as to guide the power grid to prevent and reduce the disaster and take corresponding measures pertinently, thereby reducing the economic loss of the power grid.
assignees: WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;NARI GROUP CORP;STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic risk analysis method for hazardous chemical substance fire domino accident under multi-disaster coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic risk analysis method for a hazardous chemical substance fire domino accident under multi-disaster coupling, which comprises the steps of collecting basic information; analyzing the vulnerability of the equipment under the action of natural disasters to determine a possible initial accident scene; analyzing the equipment states at different time steps by using a distribution model of accident parameters; counting the states of the devices appearing at different time steps through Monte Carlo simulation; after all Monte Carlo simulations are completed, the dynamic domino accident probability is calculated. Under the coupling of multiple disasters, the evolution process of the fire domino accident has close time correlation, and the accident risk is larger. By adopting the method, the dynamic risk assessment of the fire domino accident of the large-area chemical equipment can be realized, and important decision support is provided for domino accident prevention and control.

title_en: Three-dimensional point cloud reconstruction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a three-dimensional point cloud reconstruction method, a three-dimensional point cloud reconstruction device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original three-dimensional point cloud of a target object, wherein the original three-dimensional point cloud comprises a first number of points; performing UV expansion on the original three-dimensional point cloud according to a first preset mapping relation to obtain an original UV image; inputting an original UV image into a pre-trained image hyper-resolution model to obtain a target hyper-resolution UV image of a target object, wherein the image hyper-resolution model is a model obtained by training a convolutional neural network according to a preset training set, and the preset training set comprises a sample low-resolution UV image and a sample hyper-resolution UV image of a sample object; and sampling the target hyper-resolution UV image according to a second preset mapping relation to obtain hyper-resolution three-dimensional point cloud of the target object. By applying the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, the problem that disaster is brought to the video memory when the 3D point cloud is subjected to the super-resolution processing is solved.
assignees: BEIJING QIYI CENTURY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Gas concentration prediction method, system, equipment and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a gas concentration prediction method, which comprises the following steps: s1, with time length m 1 Obtaining m sections of gas concentration data as interval units to form a gas concentration data set Carrying out sectional average processing on the gas concentration data group to obtain a gas concentration average value, and carrying out normalization processing on the gas average value to obtain training input data and training output data; s2, training and establishing a BP neural network model based on the training input data and the training output data; s3 optimizing the BP neural network based on improved artificial bee colony algorithmA network model; and S4, substituting the gas concentration average value at the current moment into the optimized BP neural network model in the S3 to obtain the predicted gas concentration average value at the next moment. The gas concentration prediction method provided by the invention can improve the gas concentration prediction precision, thereby providing an accurate assistant decision for emergency response and timely guaranteeing the life and property safety of people.

title_en: Automatic extraction method for emergency response level of emergency plan and responsibility of administrative unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic extraction method for emergency response grade of an emergency plan and responsibility of administrative units, which comprises the following steps: s1: preprocessing the emergency plan, splitting the text content of the emergency plan according to the directory title, and storing the text content of the emergency plan to a database according to the directory title grade; s2: labeling classification categories of the catalog titles processed in the step S1 to form a labeled data set; training the labeled data set, and performing word segmentation, quantization and classification processing; s3: extracting the key information; s4: performing de-duplication splicing processing on the extracted name of the administrative unit, outputting the responsibility of the administrative unit, and performing standardization processing on the extracted entity related to the trigger condition; s5: and acquiring the response grade and the corresponding trigger condition, and outputting an analysis result. The method can extract the emergency response grade in the plan and the trigger conditions corresponding to different grades according to the emergency plan after the templating and standardize the emergency response grade and the trigger conditions.

title_en: Expansion planning method for electric supply and gas comprehensive energy system of flexible lifting city
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of interconnected comprehensive energy system planning, in particular to an expansion planning method for an elastically promoted city commercial power and gas comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps of S1: dividing the city commercial power and gas comprehensive energy system into three disaster-affected grades according to three evaluation indexes; s2: establishing a disaster-affected fault uncertain set of basic elements of the city commercial power and gas comprehensive energy system; s3: establishing an elastically improved city commercial power and gas comprehensive energy system expansion planning robust optimization model; s4, the established robust optimization model has a max-min-max three-layer structure, is transformed and is solved by using a column and constraint algorithm; s5: the method comprises the following steps of (1) carrying out verification and explanation on a model by taking an IEEE33 node electric system and a Belgian 20 node natural gas system as simulation examples, programming the model by using MATLAB language, and calling a CPLEX tool box to solve; the method has more accurate and reasonable result and the aim of improving the system elasticity under the condition of optimal extension planning.

title_en: Simulation test device based on three-dimensional digital earth geological disaster
abstract_en: The utility model provides a simulation test device based on three-dimensional digital earth geological disasters, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the simulation sand table, first telescopic link, the box body, first motor, box top side opening, box bottom side opening, there is the simulation sand table box top, the one end of the first telescopic link of middle part fixed connection of the bottom surface of simulation sand table, the middle part of the other end fixed connection box body top surface of first telescopic link, the first motor of one side fixed mounting of box body inner wall, one side of the one end fixed connection circle box of first motor shaft, the one end of the opposite side fixed connection second telescopic link of box body inner wall, the one end of the first reciprocal lead screw of other end installation of second telescopic link. This device is through the random generation of single variable, and the controller is also flexible at random time control electric telescopic handle, can accomplish the vibrations size of random simulation aftershock, the vibrations duration of aftershock and the vibrations time interval of adjacent both sides aftershock and, can simulate seismic process better, make to present in simulation sandbox earthquake simulation truer.

title_en: Fracture zone dynamic pressure display strength and weakness degree judgment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging the dynamic pressure display strength of a fault area, which comprises the following steps: step one, delineating a fracture region dynamic pressure display region: according to fault occurrence and roadway arrangement, carrying out danger research and judgment and monitoring on areas such as dense roadway groups and dense fault groups, and defining the areas with dynamic pressure danger; step two, equivalent vibration test: in a dynamic pressure dangerous area, dividing a plurality of test areas according to the distribution and the function of a roadway; blasting each test area with equal explosive quantity, wherein blasting parameters and processes are the same; arranging high-precision top and bottom plate dynamic instruments in a roadway around a blasting center, and observing the sinking speed after blasting; step three, dynamic pressure intensity judgment: comparing the observed sinking speed of the top plate by a chart, and judging the dynamic pressure showing strength; and (4) carrying out auxiliary research and judgment by combining the drilling cutting method dynamic phenomenon and the conventional mine pressure data. The method can quickly judge the dynamic pressure intensity and different dynamic pressure distribution characteristics, and has important significance for early warning of tectonic rock burst disasters.

title_en: Slope test system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster simulation tests, in particular to a side slope test system.A groove is formed in one side of the bottom of a transparent box body, which is close to an extrusion device, a water outlet is formed in the side wall of the transparent box body, which corresponds to the groove, and a hose with holes is preset in a side slope model and used for simulating the seepage state of the side slope model; the rainfall device is used for simulating a rainfall state, and the vibration device is used for enabling the slope model to vibrate; the extruding device and the vibrating device are oppositely arranged on the other side of the transparent box body, and the extruding device is used for transversely extruding the side slope model so as to change the cohesive force of the side slope model; the monitoring device monitors the side slope model in an image acquisition mode, processes and analyzes image information, can adjust the adhesive force of the side slope model and the vibration strength of the side slope model according to test requirements, and tests the side slope model under the conditions of vibration, rainfall, high humidity and seepage.

title_en: Device for removing dust and preventing gas from exceeding limit in underground construction drilling and using method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and discloses a device for drilling, dedusting and gas overrun prevention in underground construction. The device can effectively remove dust, can prevent gas from exceeding the limit, and has the advantages of small size, strong adaptability, simple operation, easy cleaning, easy control and the like. The invention also provides a using method of the device for removing dust and preventing gas from exceeding the limit in underground construction drilling.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation and estimation method for meteorological disasters of flue-cured tobacco
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of meteorological monitoring, and particularly relates to a flue-cured tobacco meteorological disaster quantitative evaluation and estimation method which comprises the following steps of carrying out local improvement and application inspection on WOFOST through a flue-cured tobacco observation test, determining available models and parameter configuration, preparing meteorological data, judging whether the meteorological disaster standard is met according to data combined with meteorological industry standard 'flue-cured tobacco meteorological disaster grade', selecting local live weather or forecast weather if the meteorological condition meets the disaster standard, then respectively driving WOFOST flue-cured tobacco growth models according to two meteorological scenes of perennial average-state meteorological conditions to obtain simulation output results under different meteorological conditions, selecting dry matter of leaves in a maturation stage simulated under different conditions as yield evaluation indexes, quantitatively describing the influence of the meteorological disasters on the yield of flue-cured tobacco by yield fluctuation percentages, and formulating grading indexes of qualitative grade evaluation, the method provided by the invention has high quantification level, and the scientificity of early warning and evaluation of the meteorological disasters is improved.
assignees: YUNNAN CLIMATE CENTER YUNNAN ECO METEOROLOGY AND SATELLITE REMOTE SENSING CENTER

title_en: Sampling device for controlling open pit coal mine geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an opencut coal mine geological disasters are administered and are used sampling device, including first backup pad, second backup pad and connecting plate, intermediate position department imbeds and is fixed with the thread bush on the connecting plate, one side of connecting plate is connected with first backup pad, the opposite side of connecting plate is connected with the second backup pad, the inboard of first backup pad and second backup pad all is provided with the slide bar, be provided with the motor between first backup pad and the second backup pad, the both ends of motor all are connected with the connecting rod, the other end of connecting rod is through the sliding sleeve and the slide bar sliding connection that set up, the sliding sleeve overlaps on the slide bar, the sliding sleeve is with the shape size looks adaptation of slide bar, the output of motor is connected with the lead screw, the other end of lead screw passes through the thread bush, the lead screw passes. Has the advantages that: realized reciprocating of sampling tube, and the sampling tube is connected with the lead screw, itself can also rotate when the sampling tube drills into ground sample promptly, makes things convenient for the drilling of sampling tube to go into and take out.
assignees: LI CHONGZHI;GUANGMENG DATA TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Combustion and permeation characteristic test platform for oil pit flame-retardant fire-insulating layer of converter transformer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of power transmission and transformation equipment, in particular to a combustion and permeability characteristic test platform of a converter transformer oil pit flame-retardant fire-proof layer, which comprises a flame-retardant fire-proof layer, a simulation oil pit positioned below the flame-retardant fire-proof layer, an oil tank, an oil collecting tank, a first weighing device and a second weighing device; transformer oil is contained in the oil tank and can flow into the flame-retardant fire-proof layer; the simulated oil pit is arranged on the first weighing device, the bottom of the simulated oil pit is communicated with the oil collecting pool, and the oil collecting pool is arranged on the second weighing device. The utility model has the advantages that: the utility model provides a converter transformer oil hole is fire-retardant to separate fire bed burning and infiltration characteristic test platform can simulate converter transformer oil hole is fire-retardant to separate fire bed conflagration burning scene, realizes that the difference lays the fire-retardant material burning characteristic and the infiltration characteristic research that separates of thickness and particle diameter, still can realize the test of oil pit bottom oil extraction speed.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Convertible spare tyre support of fire rescue car
abstract_en: The utility model provides a convertible spare tire support of fire rescue car, includes: the device comprises a frame body, a rotating arm, an oil cylinder, a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod, wherein the side end of one side of the lower part of the frame body is hinged with one end of the rotating arm, the other end of the rotating arm is provided with a locking screw mechanism for locking and fixing the vehicle-mounted spare tire, the cylinder body end of the oil cylinder is hinged on the frame body, the end of a piston rod is connected with a four-connecting-rod turnover mechanism consisting of the frame body, the rotating arm, the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod, the transportation of the spare tire between a carrying station on a fire rescue vehicle and a dismounting station on the ground is realized through hydraulic driving, the device is convenient for a fireman to easily carry out the tire dismounting operation on the ground, the problems of high dismounting difficulty and high strength caused by the drilling and lying at the bottom of a carriage body or climbing towards the top of the carriage body and manual carrying operation, the replacement efficiency is improved, and the requirement of quick response of disaster relief and emergency rescue is met.
assignees: MUDANJIANG SENTIAN SPECIAL VEHICLE REFITTING CO LTD

title_en: Physical experiment device for exploring rainfall induced dangerous rock collapse mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disaster physical experiment device especially relates to a explore rainfall and induce physical experiment device of dangerous rock mass collapse mechanism, including waiting to experiment there is crack dangerous rock mass, dangerous rock mass deformation data synchronous acquisition module, hydraulic pressure slope regulator, the adjustable rainfall analog system of rotation type, dangerous rock mass local data processing module, small-size biserial cut-in type signal reception transmitter, local data receiving center, full-automatic high-speed camera, ground piece and precipitation receiving tank, dangerous rock mass deformation data synchronous acquisition module encircles and arranges in dangerous rock mass crack periphery; the gas spring hydraulic support rod used for slope adjustment can actively adjust the local slope where the dangerous rock mass is located; the rotary type adjustable rainfall simulation system can uniformly spray water at multiple angles to simulate the influence of natural rainfall on a dangerous rock collapse mechanism. A mechanism of rainfall-induced collapse of dangerous rock mass is observed by simulating natural rainfall, and relevant data of cracks of the dangerous rock mass are collected, recorded and statistically analyzed.

title_en: Deep shaft water inrush structure for blocking railway tunnel at underwater target point
abstract_en: The underwater target blocks the water inrush structure of the deep shaft of the railway tunnel so as to safely and quickly process the water inrush disaster of the deep shaft of the railway tunnel. The device comprises an underground water plugging structure and a targeted grouting reinforcement structure; the underground water plugging structure comprises a gravel grouting plugging layer, a cement paste water stop layer and a flat-bottom concrete grout stop pad which are sequentially arranged upwards from bottom well slag in an annular well wall lining, wherein the thickness of the gravel grouting plugging layer is greater than the height of the burst water breach. The lower part of the flat-bottom concrete grout stopping pad breaks through the lining of the well wall and is embedded into a rock body. The targeted grouting reinforcement structure comprises targeted grouting holes and targeted grouting reinforcement bodies, the targeted grouting holes are drilled by taking the top surface of a flat-bottom concrete grout stop pad as a platform and obliquely downwards penetrate through a well wall lining to enter soft rock bodies around a sudden water burst breach, and the targeted grouting reinforcement bodies are reinforcement bodies formed by pressing and injecting cement grout into the soft rock bodies through the targeted grouting holes and solidifying the cement grout.

title_en: Ground disaster emergency drilling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a ground disaster emergency creeps into device, including rig main part and install the dustproof mechanism in the rig main part, the rig main part includes basal portion, rig and drilling rod, and the rig is installed on the basal portion, and the drilling rod is installed on the rig, dustproof mechanism includes the dust blocking subassembly, and the dust blocking subassembly is including installing the dust tube of keeping away from basal portion one end at the rig, and dust tube length direction sets up along the length direction of rig, and the inside cavity of dust tube just is uncovered along length direction's one end, and the through-hole that supplies the drilling rod to pass is seted up to the dust tube and deviates from open one end. This application has the effect that can reduce the drilling in-process and produce a large amount of raise dusts, cause environmental pollution's possibility.
assignees: CHONGQING 607 ENG SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on emotional infection recurrence model SIRS
abstract_en: The invention provides a crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on a mood infection recurrence model SIRS, which belongs to the technical field of crowd evacuation simulation and determines a mood recurrence infection rule of a virtual space individual; wherein, the types of the virtual space individuals comprise susceptible persons, infected persons and temporary immune persons; establishing a virtual space emotion recurrence infection model according to the emotion recurrence infection rule of the virtual space individual and by combining the mean field theory; and solving the virtual space emotion recurrence infection model by adopting a finite difference method, simulating the virtual space emotion recurrence infection model by combining the WS small world network, calculating the state transition probability of each node in the WS small world network, and determining the state of the node at the next moment according to the state transition probability. The method analyzes the influence of emotion recurrence on the crowd emotion infection process in the virtual space in an emergency state, more truly simulates individual emotion change and crowd movement, and improves the reality of crowd evacuation.

title_en: method and server for providing scenarios for environmental facilities disaster response and supporting reporting
title_ko: 환경시설 재난 대응 시나리오 제공 및 보고서 작성 지원 방법 및 이를 위한 서버
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing disaster response scenarios for environmental facilities and supporting report writing and a server therefor. According to the present technology, the method for providing disaster response scenarios for the environmental facilities and supporting report writing is configured to: receive a current disaster situation input from a manager terminal; search for cases similar to a current disaster situation received in a DB unit in which past disaster response cases for environmental facilities are databased; and provide corresponding response actions performed in the searched similar cases to the manager terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 기술은 환경시설 재난 대응 시나리오 제공 및 보고서 작성 지원 방법 및 이를 위한 서버에 관한 것이다. 본 기술의 환경시설 재난 대응 시나리오 제공 및 보고서 작성 지원 방법은, 현재 재난상황을 관리자 단말기로부터 입력받고, 환경시설에 대한 과거 재난 대응 사례들이 데이터베이스화되어 있는 DB부에서 상기 입력받은 현재 재난상황과 유사한 사례를 탐색하며, 상기 탐색된 유사한 사례에서 수행된 대응조치들을 상기 관리자 단말기에 제공한다.

title_en: BFRP-spiral sleeve valve type composite anchoring system for high-intensity seismic region
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a BFRP-spiral sleeve valve formula composite anchoring system for high intensity seismic region, including spiral sleeve valve formula anchor section, BFRP anchor rope free section, sleeve valve formula slip casting pipe, water injection pipe, connect-end thick liquid device, harmonious damping formula BFRP anchor rope head shock attenuation yield structure and hollow drilling rod, spiral sleeve valve formula anchor section is connected with hollow drilling rod through connecting-end thick liquid device, BFRP anchor rope free section, sleeve valve formula slip casting pipe and water injection pipe's end is passed and is connected-end and advance spiral sleeve valve formula anchor section behind the thick liquid device, and behind the hollow drilling rod was passed to three's head end, BFRP anchor rope free section head end was fixed in BFRP anchor rope head shock attenuation yield structure. The utility model discloses combine BFRP muscle, spiral stake, sleeve valve pipe slip casting worker method three organically, the superior performance of each component of full play spiral sleeve valve formula anchor section, BFRP anchor rope free section, harmonious damping formula BFRP anchor rope head shock attenuation yield structure can effectively solve special soil area limit (smooth) slope geological disasters, has wide application prospect.
assignees: NORTHWEST RES INST CO LTD CREC

title_en: Seismic alerting method and device thereof using application
title_ko: 어플리케이션을 이용한 지진 경보 방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are an earthquake warning method using an application and a device thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the earthquake warning method using an application comprises an earthquake acceleration reception step, an earthquake information generation step, a damage radius information generation step, a user location information acquisition step, an evacuation scenario generation step, and an evacuation scenario providing step. The earthquake warning device using the application may include a program capable of executing the earthquake warning method using the application.
abstract_ko: 어플리케이션을 이용한 지진 경보 방법 및 그 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 어플리케이션을 이용한 지진 경보 방법은 지진 가속도 수신 단계, 지진 정보 생성 단계, 피해 반경 정보 생성 단계, 사용자 위치 정보 획득 단계, 대피 시나리오 생성 단계 및 대피 시나리오 제공 단계를 포함할 수 있으며, 어플리케이션을 이용한 지진 경보 장치는 상기 어플리케이션을 이용한 지진 경보 방법을 실행시킬 수 있는 프로그램을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-logistics robot movement control method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a multi-logistics robot movement control method and device, wherein an action space is constructed according to actions executable by a robot; receiving a terminal position in the task information; planning the moving path of the robot into one or more sub-target positions to form a sub-target position space; obtaining the final value of the network parameter through the value of the network parameter of the training layered reinforcement learning network; the robot is controlled to complete a moving task through the hierarchical reinforcement learning network based on the final numerical value of the network parameter, the problem of dimensionality disaster of a complex problem is solved while the movement control of the mutual cooperation of the multiple logistics robots is realized, and the training efficiency is improved.

title_en: Advanced comprehensive prevention and control method for multiple disaster areas of deep mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an advanced comprehensive control method for a multi-disaster area of a deep mine, which comprises the steps of determining the position of a target rock stratum; constructing a horizontal well on the ground, and starting deflecting from a vertical well to a target rock stratum; then drilling and perforating the target rock stratum, and fracturing after perforation; after the rock stratum fracturing is finished, extending the vertical shaft and deflecting to the central line of the coal seam; performing coal seam hydraulic staged fracturing after reaching the central line of the coal seam; gas is pumped out or water is drained after the hydraulic fracturing is finished; the control method can realize comprehensive regional control of gas, water, coal dust and geothermal heat on the basis of regional rock burst control, realize dual purposes of one well, repeatedly utilize a vertical well section, construct 2L-shaped horizontal wells, reduce the cost of constructing the vertical well, and realize drainage of the whole life cycle of a coal bed and real zero emission of gas by establishing a gas drainage station on the ground.
assignees: SHAANXI BINCHANG MENGCUN MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Landslide process analysis method, process numerical value reconstruction method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide process analysis method, a process numerical reconstruction method and application. The landslide disaster process analysis method provided by the invention is characterized in that an original landslide seismic signal is taken as a basis, IMF (inertial measurement function) principal component signals are extracted, time-frequency spectrum transformation is carried out, and then 5 stages of a landslide process are divided according to frequency energy characteristics of different time periods in the landslide seismic signal. The method extracts the transition stage of the landslide process for the first time. The invention provides an application of a landslide disaster process analysis method in landslide disaster analysis, landslide disaster emergency response scheme design and landslide event mathematical modeling. The invention also provides a landslide process numerical simulation reconstruction method, which is used for carrying out the numerical simulation reconstruction of the landslide process on the basis of the energy data evolution of the landslide seismic signals. And the application of the reconstruction method in landslide disaster analysis and landslide disaster emergency response scheme design. The method improves the abundance degree of landslide disaster basic data and the effectiveness of the disaster prevention and control emergency scheme, and has remarkable social benefit.

title_en: Power failure analysis method and system based on big data feature mining
abstract_en: The invention provides a power failure analysis method and a power failure analysis system based on big data characteristic mining, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power failure information from a data center platform, extracting power failure characteristics, constructing and training a power failure sensitive user model, and analyzing and quantifying the sensitivity of a user to a power failure event according to the power failure characteristics; constructing and training a high-risk power failure event analysis model, quantitatively analyzing the high-risk power failure event according to the characteristics of the high-risk power failure event, generating a high-risk power failure event grade identification rule, and setting a threshold value corresponding to each risk grade; and aggregating planned power failure information and fault power failure information reported by companies in various provinces (cities), discriminating the high-risk power failure event and carrying out early warning according to the high-risk power failure event grade identification rule, sharing the early warning information to a regulation and control command center in real time, and carrying out operation, scheduling, first-aid repair and emergency response. The method has the advantages of real-time reporting of power failure information, accurate analysis to the home, high power failure fault first-aid repair efficiency, high information accuracy, high satisfaction degree of power customers and the like.
assignees: SUZHOU QIXIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode shooting target
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode shooting target which comprises a deformable target plate and a driving mechanism. The deformable target plate has an expanded configuration and a collapsed configuration. The driving mechanism is connected with the deformable target plate to drive the deformable target plate to be mutually switched between the expanded configuration and the contracted configuration. The deformable target plate is expanded in the deployed configuration to provide a firing target. The deformable target plate is retracted in the retracted configuration to conceal the firing target. The invention provides a multi-mode shooting target, which is characterized in that a driving mechanism drives a deformable target plate to be mutually switched between an expanded state and a contracted state, so that a training scene that an enemy actively hides or avoids is simulated, an actual combat effect is created, the emergency response capability of shooting personnel is trained, and the actual combat skill is improved.
assignees: BEIJING XINANTONG SHOOTING RANGE AIMING TECHNICAL CO LTD

title_en: Emergency early warning assessment and decision support system for atmospheric environmental pollution accident
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atmospheric environmental pollution accident emergency early warning evaluation and decision support system, which comprises a prior supervision system, an in-service supervision system and a post supervision system, wherein the prior supervision system is provided with a risk substance early warning module, an emergency drilling module, the in-service supervision system comprises an emergency accident capturing module, an emergency identification module, an emergency command module, an expert consultation module, a simulation prediction and risk evaluation module, an emergency response module, a field survey monitoring module, a state tracking and reporting module, an emergency termination module, all component modules on the early warning evaluation and decision support system are connected into the same network platform, and carry out cooperative work through data transmission among different modules, meanwhile, the risk substance early warning module, the emergency drilling module and the simulation prediction and risk assessment module can also independently operate according to actual needs.
assignees: JIANGSU HUIHUAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method fire drill exercise for rescue rill using VR
title_ko: 가상현실을 이용한 완강기 소방훈련 체험방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for firefighting training for a descending device using virtual reality, wherein a virtual shape chamber goggle is used to enable the descending device to be used during escape training which is usually performed in a firefighting training, and the descending device escape training can be more practically performed during the fire-fighting training by allowing a user to virtually experience the descending device through two handles. According to the fire drill experience method for a descending device using virtual reality formed in a preferred embodiment of the present invention, a method of appropriately using a descending device in case of a fire can be known by using virtual experience, and a training of approaching and escaping from the descending device in case of a fire can be experienced like a game, thereby having an excellent educational effect. According to the present invention, the method for experiencing firefighting using virtual reality comprises: a preparation step in which a main server allows a user to wear googles and handles; a selection step in which a main server displays a fire place setting screen through the googles, and a user moves his or her gaze to select; a program execution step in which a main server executes the training program of a fire place selected in the selection step; and a termination step in which the main server terminates the selection training program.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 본 발명은 가상현실을 이용한 완강기 소방훈련 방법에 관한 것으로, 소방훈련에서 주로 하게 되는 탈출 훈련 중에서 완강기를 사용할 수 있도록 가상형실 고글을 쓰고, 두 개의 핸들을 통해서 가상으로 체험해볼 수 있도록 함으로써 소방훈련 중 완강기 탈출훈련을 보다 실질적으로 할 수 있도록 하는 가상현실을 이용한 완강기 소방훈련방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 바람직한 실시예로 형성된 가상현실을 이용한 완강기 소방훈련 체험방법에 의하면 화재발생시 완강기를 적절히 사용할 수 있는 방법을 가상체험을 이용하여 알 수 있고,  화재발생시 완강기까지 접근해서 탈출할 수 있는 훈련을 게임하듯이 체험할 수 있어서 교육효과가 뛰어난 효과가 발생한다.

title_en: Jellyfish disaster early warning model construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural environment, in particular to a method for constructing a jellyfish disaster early warning model, which comprises the following steps: on-site investigation and observation: carrying out hydrological conventional observation, jellyfish tracking observation and salvaging tasks on the sea area, and carrying out site and indoor controlled tests: through field culture or indoor controlled model test, the biology, ecology mechanism and environment regulation and control mechanism of the target jellyfish in the sea area are deeply researched, and numerical simulation and modeling analysis are carried out: the method is characterized in that high-resolution numerical simulation is carried out on hydrodynamic force and ecological processes of a target sea area by combining field observation data of jellyfish disasters of the target sea area and life history test data of the jellyfish in a laboratory.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA ENV MONITORING CENTER STATE OCEANIC ADMINISTRATION AUTHENTICATION AND INSPECTION CEN

title_en: Window frame with escape handle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a window frame with handle bar for escaping belongs to the technical field of window frame, and it includes the window frame body and installs in the inside casement of window frame body, window frame body fixed mounting is located indoor wall body and is provided with the dead lever and set up in safe escape mechanism on the dead lever on the wall body. When a fire disaster happens to a high-rise building, the high-rise building needs to be separated from the scene in time, and at the moment, people fix the escape rope on the safety escape mechanism and can safely descend to the ground through the escape rope. Dead lever and safe mechanism of fleing all set up in indoorly, and in the time of installation and maintenance, people stand indoor can install and maintain dead lever and safe mechanism of fleing, convenient and fast more. The dead lever sets up indoor, not only can be convenient for install and maintain, but also can make things convenient for people's sunning clothes, and people can also be used for taking exercise, for example the physical exercise of pressing leg etc..
assignees: SHANGHAI HAOYU STAINLESS STEEL CO LTD

title_en: Automatic recognition method for fire passing range and burning degree of forest fire
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic identification method of fire passing range and burning degree of forest fire, which comprises the following steps: acquiring long-time sequence remote sensing images with low cloud coverage rate before disaster, recording the long-time sequence remote sensing images as a remote sensing image sequence before disaster, and calculating the normalized vegetation index of each remote sensing image; performing pixel-by-pixel regression on the normalized vegetation index NDVI of each remote sensing image in the pre-disaster remote sensing image sequence by adopting a least square regression method to obtain a annual-scale vegetation index initial curve of each pixel under the condition of no fire disturbance; obtaining a remote sensing image with low cloud cover rate after the disaster, recording the remote sensing image as the remote sensing image after the disaster, and calculating the normalized vegetation index NDVI of the remote sensing image real (ii) a Based on the vegetation index initial curve, simulating the undisturbed normalized vegetation index NDVI fit (ii) a According to NDVI fit And NDVI real Calculating a forest fire severity index BSI; and determining a segmentation threshold of the forest fire severity index image based on the point location verification data and the BSI of the forest fire so as to identify the fire passing range of the forest fire and divide the burning degree of the forest fire in a grading manner.

title_en: Method for judging coal seam dynamic disaster affected area by non-uniform key layer structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for judging coal seam dynamic disaster influence area by non-uniform key layer structure, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting all existing drilling columnar diagram data in the whole mining area, carrying out key layer judgment on all drilling columnar diagrams, obtaining the thickness H of the key layer of each drilling columnar and the distance D between the key layer and the coal seam, obtaining H and D at any point by distance weighted interpolation on the basis, obtaining the structural characteristics of the non-uniform key layer coated on different working surfaces of the same coal seam, obtaining the coal seam stress P (H, D, L) when the distance L from the working surfaces is obtained under the condition that the thickness H of the key layer coated on the working surfaces and the distance D between the key layer and the coal seam are determined, setting a certain stress concentration coefficient criterion K, and regarding the distance when the criterion is reached as a critical influence distance L  K  The area smaller than this distance is considered to be the coal seam dynamic disaster affected area. The method can provide important basis for the control of the stope dynamic disasters.

title_en: Farm decision support system
title_ko: 영농 의사결정 지원 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a farm decision support system providing farm consulting, farm decision support information service, farming agency farm guide support information service, farm policy decision support information service, and agricultural weather portal service using a professional Internet website. According to the present invention, a user can easily access information via the website comprehensively covering the farm consulting, farm decision support information service, farming agency farm guide support information service, farm policy decision support information service, and agricultural weather portal service. According to the present invention, a user as a newbie farmer can be provided with professional real-time information comprehensively covering crop type, farmland suitable for cultivation, and profit-loss analysis based on output prediction using a crop model. According to the present invention, it is possible to provide growth information, pest prediction information, crop disaster prediction information, and output prediction information service based on farming information (crop type, sowing day, fertilization amount, etc.) of a user who is an established farmer. According to the present invention, farming instructors providing farming guide for farmers can be provided with farm decision support information service provided for farmers based on agricultural weather prediction information. According to the present invention, users in charge of farming policy planning can be provided with farming environment change prediction information based on climate change scenario data and average climate information. According to the present invention, information on farming-related firms can be provided for users.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 영농 의사결정 지원 시스템에 대한 것으로서, 특히, 전문화된 인터넷 웹사이트를 이용한 영농 컨설팅, 영농 의사결정 지원 정보 서비스, 농촌 지도기관 영농지도 지원 정보 서비스, 영농 정책 결정 지원 정보 서비스, 농업 기상 포털 서비스를 제공하는 영농 의사결정 지원 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 영농 컨설팅, 영농 의사결정 지원정보 서비스, 농촌 지도기관 영농지도 지원정보 서비스, 영농정책결정 지원정보 서비스, 농업기상 포털 서비스 등에 관한 전문화된 통합 웹사이트를 통해 사용자가 해당 정보에 쉽게 접근하도록 할 수 있다. 본 발명은 새롭게 농사를 지으려는 사용자에게 작목의 종류 및 품종, 재배에 적합한 농지 조회 및 검토, 그리고 작물 모형을 이용한 생산량 예측을 통하여 손익 분석 등의 전문적인 실시간 정보를 통합적으로 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명은 현재 농사를 짓고 있는 사용자의 농작업 정보(재배 작목, 품종, 파종일, 시비량 등)를 바탕으로 생육정보, 병해충발생예측정보, 농작물 재해 예측정보, 생산량 예측 정보 서비스를 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명은 영농 현장에서 농민을 상대로 영농지도를 하고 있는 영농 지도사들에게 농업기상 예측정보를 바탕으로 농민들에게 제공하는 영농 의사결정 지원정보 서비스 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명은 기후변화 시나리오 자료와 평년 기후정보를 바탕으로 향후 농업 환경 변화에 대한 예측 정보를 영농 정책을 결정하는 사용자들에게 서비스 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명은 사용자에게 농업 연관업체의 정보를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling water damage of mine floor under high-pressure-bearing flowing water condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preventing and controlling water damage of a mine floor under a high-pressure flowing water condition. The invention realizes the prevention and treatment of water damage of the mine floor under the condition of high pressure-bearing flowing water through the ground drilling and directional drilling technologies, and improves the grouting position judgment, the preparation of the grouting material, the grouting process and the control respectively. The multilayer multi-branch perfusion can effectively slow down the flowing water flow velocity, improve the filling rate and the drilling utilization rate, solve the mine floor water disaster that the water inrush point can not be accurately detected, and effectively prevent the mine floor water disaster accident; the method can be used for grouting and filling the rock stratum at the bottom of the goaf by combining the ground drilling technology and the directional drilling technology, and is suitable for various complex geological conditions.

title_en: Upgrade protection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of computer disaster recovery, and discloses an upgrade protection method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: intercepting an upgrade instruction sent to a source computer when the upgrade instruction is detected; acquiring a backup data set of the source computer; performing upgrading exercise through a virtual machine according to the backup data set and the upgrading instruction; and when the exercise result of the upgrade is that the exercise passes, releasing the upgrade instruction. According to the invention, by intercepting the upgrade instruction of the source computer and performing upgrade exercise in the virtual machine according to the backup data and the upgrade instruction of the source computer, whether to release the upgrade action of the source computer is judged according to the result of the upgrade exercise, so that the risk brought by the upgrade of the source computer can be avoided, and the continuity of the service system of the source computer is ensured.

title_en: Light Fire Extinguisher Experience Kit for Education
title_ko: 교육용 빛소화기 체험키트
abstract_en: Provided is an educational fire extinguisher experience kit using light to increase an effect of firefighting training. According to the present invention, the educational fire extinguisher experience kit comprises: a main body unit which includes a main body frame having a panel with a fire generation unit on which a fire situation is drawn, at least one light receiving sensor generating a detection signal when light is received in the fire generation unit, and a plurality of flickering light sources emitting light to the rear surface of the panel to virtually express a fire occurrence situation while being flickered when power is applied, and which is installed vertically on the floor surface; a light fire extinguishing unit which includes a spray tube having at least one light emitting source disposed at a front end to emit sensing light to be sensed by the light receiving sensor when the power is applied, and a fire extinguisher main body connected to the spray tube through a connection hose of a predetermined length and having a power supply unit electrically connected to the light source, thereby emitting the sensing light toward the main body frame during firefighting training; and at least one vibration generation unit which includes at least one vibration generation source electrically connected to the power supply unit to transfer vibration generated when the power is applied to the spray tube and the connecting hose, thereby transferring the vibration to a trainee through the spray tube and the connecting hose gripped by the trainee during the firefighting training.
abstract_ko:
교육용 빛소화기 체험키트를 제공한다.

title_en: Urban Type Earthquake Audio-Visual Education Kit
title_ko: 도시형 지진 시청각 교육 키트
abstract_en: The present invention provides an urban-type audiovisual earthquake education kit which reproduces an actual earthquake disaster situation in a city including natural objects, such as forests and land, buildings, and roads in an audiovisual type to educate an earthquake, so that students efficiently recognize earthquake situations and earthquake response capabilities are cultivated while providing earthquake-related education in various places. According to the present invention, the urban-type audiovisual earthquake education kit comprises: a city model unit including a floor part formed in the shape of a road and land and a three-dimensional (3D) miniature unit movably connected and coupled to form a 3D shape of a building, a forest, and a street lamp on the floor unit; an earthquake simulator supporting the floor unit in the lower part of the city model unit and operated to realize shaking like an actual earthquake waveform in the city model unit; and a kit control unit applying a control signal for operating the earthquake simulator, and controlling the operation of the earthquake simulator by adjusting and setting power and the magnitude of the earthquake.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 임야나 대지와 같은 자연물 및 건물, 도로 등으로 조성된 도시에서의 실제 지진재난상황을 시청각 형태로 교육하게 재연하여 다양한 장소에서의 지진 관련 교육을 도모하면서 지진상황을 효율적으로 인지하고 지진대처능력을 배양함을 제공하도록, 도로 및 대지의 형상으로 형성하는 바닥부와, 상기 바닥부 상에 건물 및 임야, 가로등의 입체적 형상을 이루며 유동 가능하게 연결 결합하는 입체미니어처유닛을 포함하여 구성하는 도시모형부와; 상기 도시모형부의 하부에서 상기 바닥부를 지지하되, 상기 도시모형부에 실질적인 지진 파형과 같은 흔들림을 구현할 수 있게 구동하는 지진시뮬레이터와; 상기 지진시뮬레이터의 구동을 위한 제어신호를 인가하되, 전원 및 지진의 세기를 조작 설정하여 상기 지진시뮬레이터의 구동을 제어하는 키트제어부;를 포함하는 도시형 지진 시청각 교육 키트를 제공한다.

title_en: Disaster prevention/crime prevention satchel
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention/crime prevention satchel with which a child protects personally by easily using a shouldering satchel, in occurrence of emergency in midway going to or getting out of school.SOLUTION: A satchel body 2 is integrally composed by freely detachably superimposing two flaps of a lower flap part 3 and an upper flap part 4 which cover a box-shaped opening part for storing text books, training aids and the like. In a suitable position near a tip end in a rear upper side face of a back pad plate part 2a, a rear top of the lower flap part 3 is provided by sewing or an adhesive, or otherwise by bonding with a metal fixture. Inside near the upper tip of the back pad plate part 2a, a round rod like support arm part is provided by incorporating horizontally and, in the rear side face position of the upper flap part 4 that covers a user's head by readily reversing in emergency, an intermediate rotation part incorporates a rotary shaft part which is a power source for reversing the upper flap part 4. title_en: Geological disaster chain simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster chain simulation test device and a geological disaster chain simulation test method, wherein the geological disaster chain simulation test device comprises a model box, a water injection tank, a pipeline, a lifting device, a rainfall simulation device and a water level changing device; the mold box is a cuboid with a frame structure, the side surface of the mold box is a retaining plate, the bottom surface of the mold box is a bottom plate, one side of the bottom plate is hinged with the side surface of the mold box, the bottom plate can turn over around a hinged shaft, and a lifting device is connected below the bottom plate and is positioned on the ground; the rainfall simulation device is positioned at the top of the model box and comprises a plurality of spray heads facing the interior of the model box; the water level changing device comprises a plurality of water injection pipes, a plurality of through holes are formed in the soil retaining plate and/or the bottom plate, and the water injection pipes are connected in the through holes in a sliding mode; the water injection tank is located the simulation case side, is provided with the water injection pump in the water injection tank, and the water injection pump passes through pipe connection shower nozzle and water injection pipe. The simulation test of simulating the special complex geological structure and various disaster chain types induced by the loess plateau disaster chain can be met.

title_en: Fire disaster identification method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for fire disaster identification, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring collected fire picture data; carrying out fire information labeling on the fire picture data to obtain a labeled data set; creating a first network model for fire picture identification, and training the first network model by adopting the labeled data set; acquiring a depth image acquired by a binocular camera; and carrying out fire identification on the depth image by adopting the first network model. By the embodiment of the invention, the optimization of fire identification is realized, and the identification accuracy is improved.
assignees: ZHUHAI DAHENGQIN TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Water disaster defense decision support system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a water disaster defense decision support system and a method, which comprises the following steps: s1, performing flood situation analysis according to the currently obtained water disaster information; s2, generating one or more scheduling plans according to a flood situation form analysis result and a specified scheduling rule; s3, judging flood control results of the scheduling plans by carrying out simulation on the scheduling plans, and outputting the flood control results of each scheduling plan for decision-makers to select; s4, storing one or more scheduling plans selected by the decision-making personnel, and extracting starting conditions of the scheduling plans; and S5, monitoring all data in real time, starting the corresponding scheduling plans after the starting conditions of the scheduling plans are met, and issuing scheduling tasks to the corresponding application clients. The invention provides a unified platform for processing flood prevention business, and the unified platform is connected with the original government application, is combined with the original application of the government, integrates the originally dispersed flood prevention business system, and provides an efficient working platform for helping each department to collaboratively prevent flood.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JIAXING DIGITAL CITY LABORATORY COMPANY LTD

title_en: Comprehensive judgment method for hydrogen sulfide disaster risk of abandoned oil well in coal mining area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a comprehensive judgment method for the danger of hydrogen sulfide disasters of abandoned oil wells in coal mining areas, and belongs to the field of coal mine safety. The method comprises the following steps: s1: ground area risk judgment: firstly, carrying out investigation and analysis on completion data of a waste oil well to determine the complete condition of the waste oil well; then, surveying the ground position of the oil well, and determining the damage condition and the damage point position of the abandoned oil well; or collecting the gas in the abandoned oil well to perform component detection analysis, determining the gas component in the well completion, and primarily judging the danger of hydrogen sulfide disasters of the abandoned oil well; s2: underground local risk judgment: and judging the danger of the ground area as a abandoned oil well dangerous to the coal mining area, and adopting a downhole drilling method to judge the underground local danger and determine the danger area. The method realizes advanced judgment of the hydrogen sulfide disaster risk of the abandoned oil well in the coal mining area and improves the pertinence of disaster management.

title_en: Surface mine geological disaster monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a surface mine geological disasters monitoring device, including base, detection case and dead lever, the base has the multiunit mounting hole for cuboid structure and upper surface rectangular array, be fixed with the stand on the base, the one end that the base was kept away from to the stand is connected with the detection case of cuboid structure, solar panel is installed to the symmetry on the wide face in both sides of detection case, install the boss on a side end face of detection case, be equipped with two sets of holders on the outer wall of boss, swing joint has the dead lever on the holder, the drill bit is installed for cylinder structure and bottom to the dead lever, annular array has the multiunit air cushion on the outer wall of dead lever, the air cushion is connected with the trachea that sets up at the dead lever inside, the one end that the air cushion was kept away from to the trachea is connected with the air pump. This surface mine geological disasters monitoring device, simple to use, simple to operate has better practicality.

title_en: Emergency evacuation deduction training system for crew cabins
abstract_en: The invention provides a crew cabin emergency evacuation deduction training system which comprises a training terminal, a deduction platform and a management system, wherein the training terminal is connected with the deduction platform and the management system through a network, the deduction platform is provided with a scene training system, training scenes are pushed according to selection of crew members at the training terminal, and the management system stores identity data information of the crew members. The invention separates human-computer voice interaction, scenario deduction and identity information management from each other, enables the crew members to complete the training and the examination of the project through the training terminal through network connection, can ensure that the crew members with different levels can simultaneously train without mutual interference, avoids the objective limitation of fields and equipment, and leads the training to be more efficient and convenient.

title_en: Equipment and method for safe tunneling and disaster early warning of river-crossing high-water-head tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses equipment and a method for safe tunneling and disaster early warning of a river-crossing high-water-head tunnel. The hydraulic stem stretches out and draws back, it rotates along the fixed plate to drive the regulation seat, change and adjust the seat angle of pitch, thereby make the drilling rod drive the drill bit along predetermined angle and creep into, and protection machanism protects the circumstances such as unexpected outage, avoid equipment damage and personnel to damage, when drilling takes place to gush water when drilling, the drilling rod drives the drill bit and withdraws from, change shutoff head, carry out the slip casting that pressurizes through the shutoff head to drilling fast, make mud infiltration drilling inner wall gap, thereby consolidate the shutoff, prevention and elimination gush water calamity.

title_en: Underground disaster processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground disaster treatment method, which comprises the following steps: drilling a measuring borehole in the geological detection area; and step two, carrying a radar: after the drill rod is withdrawn, the drill bit is detached, and the geological radar is carried on the drill rod; thirdly, radar detection: according to the drill rod advancing mode of the drill hole, advancing the drill rod to detect the geological structure around the drill hole; fourthly, disaster judgment: determining the position and range of the geological disaster according to the radar detection data; fifthly, preparing a processing scheme: determining a disaster processing scheme according to the disaster position and range; sixthly, disaster treatment: and carrying out disaster treatment according to the determined disaster treatment scheme. The method has the advantages that the drilling is carried out to measure the drill hole, the drill rod is utilized to carry the geological radar in the drill hole, the geological detection is carried out on the periphery of the drill hole, so as to obtain a geological disaster source in the peripheral area, and then the targeted measures are adopted to eliminate disasters and eliminate hidden dangers, so that the construction safety is ensured.
assignees: CHONGQING ENERGY INVESTMENT GROUP TECH CO LTD;CHONGQING ENERGY INVEST GROUP CO LTD;CHONGQING NENGTOUYU NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Personnel safety comprehensive guarantee system for ship
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ship safety, and discloses a comprehensive personnel safety guarantee system for ships, which mainly comprises a decision-making system, an indicating system and a drilling system, wherein each system is executed by different devices according to functions; the decision system is mainly used for information acquisition, risk identification, data processing and instruction signal output; the indicating system mainly provides differentiated evacuation routes for escape route indicator networks distributed on ships according to different risk characteristics under the indication of the decision-making system; the exercise system carries out model simulation and real ship exercise on the set emergency plan, finds weak points in the risk emergency plan and improves the weak points. The utility model discloses a guarantee marine wind power work progress in-ship personnel's safety carries out the discernment, the prevention and the control of potential risk through the information-based means, further improves the security of marine wind power operation.
assignees: CHINA SHIPBUILDING INDUSTRY CORPORATION TIANJIN OFFSHORE WIND POWER ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: CFD-based power transmission line icing state simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CFD-based power transmission line icing state simulation method, which belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster prevention of a power system and comprises the following steps: establishing a power transmission line wind tunnel model by utilizing computational fluid mechanics simulation software; carrying out grid division on the ice coating area of the power transmission line, and calculating the distribution of the airflow field around the power transmission line; establishing a motion equation of cooling water drops in the air, analyzing and solving a water drop running track, and further obtaining a water drop local impact coefficient; solving the icing quality of the power transmission line; calculating the icing forms of the power transmission line under different time step lengths, determining boundary movement and reconstructing; and analyzing the influence of different factors on the icing form of the power transmission line. The method adopts the computational fluid software to perform mixed grid division, is favorable for presenting true simulation of the icing form of the power transmission line, and simultaneously calculates the motion collision coefficient of the cooling water drops and the freezing coefficient of the control body of the surface unit of the power transmission line, so that the reliability of the change result of the icing form of the power transmission line is high.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Three-dimensional fire-fighting emergency plan method based on workflow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional fire-fighting emergency plan method based on a workflow, which comprises the following steps: and (4) a plan text, and initializing a fire accident simulation scene. And manufacturing the fire-fighting special topic simulation material. And constructing a plan event workflow component, including packaging workflow-driven-based time, and constructing a fire emergency plan template. The method comprises the steps of manufacturing a three-dimensional fire emergency plan, including fire point creation, starting alarm, evacuation route, rescue route, fire hydrant and water source around the fire point display, fire truck placing position and water taking position display, attack route display, water spraying and fire extinguishing. And three-dimensional fire emergency plan deduction simulation, which comprises loading the three-dimensional fire emergency plan, deduction simulation and advancing and retreating. Therefore, the three-dimensional fire-fighting emergency plan method based on the workflow can overcome the defects of the traditional emergency plan which is mainly managed by simple characters, and improves the expression and the association of emergency measures in the aspects of space, logic, information and operability.
assignees: WUHAN JIJIA SHIKONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic landslide disaster-bearing body identification method based on semantic gate and double-temporal LSTM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster-bearing body automatic identification method based on a semantic gate and a double-temporal LSTM, which comprises the steps of data preparation, network structure and parameter setting, comprehensive error calculation, network training and verification, network effect evaluation, landslide and disaster-bearing body prediction and the like. The method can timely and accurately identify the landslide and the disaster-bearing body thereof in the disaster-affected area, further quickly acquire information such as disaster grade, disaster-affected range and the like, and can perform disaster situation evaluation based on the information to guide emergency rescue work after disaster.

title_en: Tunnel entity test field

title_en: Multifunctional environment-friendly sacrifice box
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of environmental protection sacrificial rites articles for use technique and specifically relates to a multi-functional environmental protection sacrificial rites case is disclosed, including box, upper cover, the box with the upper cover articulates together, there is external power supply jack through the fix with screw on the box lateral wall, the inside inlay card of box is fixed with the fixed die carrier of article, the fixed die carrier one corner of article is inlayed and is had switch, the fixed die carrier of article is close to the one end both sides angle of upper cover is rotated and is installed electronic candle, the fixed die carrier middle part of article is rotated and is installed the electronic incence burner, the fixed die carrier other end of article is rotated and is installed the simulation flame device.
