title_en: Planning model platform for installing exhibition hall of comprehensive disaster reduction and relief education training base
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a planning model platform for installing an exhibition hall of a comprehensive disaster reduction and relief education training base, which comprises a model platform, wherein the outer walls of two sides of the model platform are fixedly connected with fixed blocks, elongated slots are all formed, long rods are all arranged in the elongated slots, the upper ends of the long rods all pass through the top walls of the elongated slots and are fixedly connected with first transparent baffle plates, two sides of each first transparent baffle plate are fixedly connected with first connecting blocks through hinges, the first connecting blocks are all provided with jacks, the lower ends of the long rods are all fixedly connected with first slide blocks, the long rods are all provided with a plurality of slots, one side of each elongated slot is provided with a cavity, the utility model platform is convenient to adjust the first transparent baffle plates and the second transparent baffle plates so as to protect a model on the model platform and prevent a person, therefore, the heights of the first transparent baffle and the second transparent baffle can be adjusted, and the model table is prevented from being damaged due to the fact that an overlarge model falls out of the model table to cause loss.

title_en: Test system and method for simulating geological deformation caused by hydrate thermal recovery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrate exploitation test simulation, and particularly relates to a test system and a method for simulating geological deformation caused by hydrate thermal exploitation, aiming at researching the occurrence process of geological disasters in the thermal exploitation process; the system comprises a test cabin body, a stress regulation and control device, a temperature control system, a geological deformation monitoring system and a hydrate mining system, wherein a hydrate layer and an upper cover layer are arranged in the test cabin body, and the upper cover layer is used for simulating a soil body cover layer above the hydrate; the stress regulating and controlling device is used for applying stress; the temperature control system is used for simulating the temperature of the deep sea bottom; the geological deformation monitoring system is used for acquiring deformation information of the optical fiber assembly in real time; the hydrate mining system is used for heating the hydrate layer and collecting decomposed gas hydrate; by the method, mapping data of geological deformation caused by ground stress, mining temperature and mining efficiency can be acquired, and reliable parameter guidance is provided for mining of the hydrate.

title_en: Platform and method for simulating multi-compartment transportation of aerosol in post-treatment fire accident
abstract_en: The invention relates to a platform and a method for simulating multi-compartment transportation of aerosol in post-treatment fire accidents, wherein the platform comprises a multi-compartment simulation system, and the multi-compartment simulation system comprises a compartment main body, an air compressor, an electric heater, a spraying pipeline and a water supply tank; the ventilation simulation system comprises a centrifugal fan, an activated carbon adsorption device and a sub-high efficiency filter; the aerosol generating system comprises aerosol generators with different particle size ranges and an air compressor; a sampling and measurement system comprising a type K thermocouple, a pressure sensor, and an aerosol particle size spectrometer arranged in the multi-compartment simulation system. The platform and the method provided by the invention can simulate conditions such as temperature, pressure and the like under fire accidents, obtain the concentration distribution of the aerosol in multiple compartments, master the transportation rule of the aerosol in a factory building and provide basis for emergency response and emergency decision.

title_en: Water plugging method for grouting transformation of coal seam roof water-bearing stratum
abstract_en: A water plugging method for grouting transformation of a coal seam roof water-bearing stratum specifically comprises the following steps: (1) and stratum exploration: identifying and predicting the disaster-causing hidden danger area by adopting a combined detection method of a ground three-dimensional earthquake and a transient electromagnetic method; (2) and drilling a well: the method comprises the following steps of utilizing a drilling grouting reinforcement device to horizontally drill, sequentially drilling through a ground surface layer, a confined water layer and a coal seam roof, and detecting whether the coal seam roof has cracks or not through a water seepage detection device in the process of drilling the coal seam roof above the coal seam to fully expose an abnormal area; (3) if the coal seam has a hidden danger of top leakage when a crack is detected on the coal seam top plate in the step (2), grouting the coal seam top plate through the drilling grouting reinforcement device, and reinforcing the coal seam top plate; (4) and after grouting is completed, cleaning the interior of the drilling grouting reinforcement device. The method can detect whether the coal seam roof has cracks or not, can be used for grouting and reinforcing the cracks of the coal seam roof, has a cleaning function, and is high in practicability.
assignees: BEIJING DADI GAOKE GEOLOGICAL EXPLOR CO LTD

title_en: Long-distance disaster recovery method for high-availability MySQL
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote disaster recovery method of high-availability MySQL, which comprises a central control area, a data center A and a data center B, wherein a set of MySQL examples of HA is deployed in the data center A, a set of single-node MySQL examples is deployed in the data center B, a high-availability synchronization service Server and a synchronization service Client are deployed in the central control area, the synchronization service Server and the data center A, the synchronization service Client and the data center B are connected through a private network, the synchronization service Server simulates an interaction protocol of MySQL slave, pretends to be MySQL slave, sends a dump protocol to the MySQL master, the MySQL master receives a dump request, starts pushing a binary log to the slave, and the synchronization service Client acquires data to be synchronized from the Server and sends the data to the data center B for backup. The remote disaster recovery method of the high-availability MySQL can realize real-time synchronization with low time delay and even no time delay.

title_en: Evacuation prediction method for passengers in urban rail transit subway carriage
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting evacuation of passengers in urban rail transit subway carriages, which comprises the following steps: 1) constructing a target vehicle door selection model when passengers are evacuated out of a subway carriage based on a fuzzy logic theory, and calculating to obtain a probability value of selecting each vehicle door by the passengers; 2) calculating the moving probability value of the passenger in real time by combining the psychological behavior characteristics of the passenger on the basis of the cellular automaton model, and establishing a moving model for evacuating the passenger out of the subway carriage; 3) and carrying out simulation experiments by adopting the constructed passenger target vehicle door selection model and the constructed movement model, simulating the evacuation condition of passengers in the subway carriage, and predicting the position of an accident point when the subway carriage is in an emergency, the effective utilization width of the vehicle doors of the subway carriage and the influence of the arrangement mode of seats in the carriage on the evacuation of the passengers. The method effectively predicts the evacuation behavior of passengers in the subway carriage in the case of an emergency accident and provides certain auxiliary decision support for the emergency and rapid evacuation of the passengers in the carriage.

title_en: SAA optimization method of power distribution network multi-fault rush-repair model under disaster condition
abstract_en: The application discloses an SAA optimization method of a multi-fault first-aid repair model of a power distribution network under a disaster condition, which comprises the steps of taking an optimization solution in the first-aid repair model as solid particles and taking an objective function as an energy function of the solid; heating the solid to melt, waiting for it to cool in combination with a Metropolis sampling strategy; randomly searching a global optimal solution in an optimal solution space, and repeating the sampling process along with temperature reduction until the global optimal solution is obtained. According to the application, the requirements on the performance of the optimization algorithm under the disaster scene are analyzed, and based on the requirements, the simulated annealing algorithm is selected to solve the power distribution network rush-repair strategy optimization problem, so that the advantages of the calculation speed, stability and optimizing performance of the rush-repair model are improved.

title_en: Power distribution network fault first-aid repair positioning method based on environment dynamic influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault first-aid repair positioning method based on environmental dynamic influence, which comprises the steps of constructing a fault topology model by utilizing a historical power distribution network fault database; taking an external environment dynamic influence factor as a constraint condition, taking a power distribution network fault first-aid repair related parameter as an initial parameter, driving the fault topology model to run in a simulation mode, and outputting a fault characteristic vector; training and parameter optimization are carried out on the LSSVM, accuracy requirements and threshold values are set, and a fault positioning model is output after training is finished; and leading the fault characteristic vector into the fault positioning model for solving to obtain the position of the power distribution network fault to be repaired. According to the method, the formed fault characteristic vector is preliminarily determined, the solution of the positioning model is combined, the position of the fault to be rush-repaired is secondarily determined, the accuracy of the positioning of the rush-repair of the power distribution network fault under the disaster caused by the dynamic influence of the external environment is improved, and the rush-repair efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Firefighting education system using fire extinguisher
title_ko: 폐소화기를 이용한 소방교육시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire fighting education system using a waste fire extinguisher, which provides training in the form of a showcase of fire extinguishers to be used according to the type of fire, and provides indirect experiences according to the type of fire extinguisher, instructions for use, and fire type through video. Accordingly, there is an effect of improving the educational effect while simultaneously experiential and audio-visual education, and enabling three-dimensional education using real cases of fire extinguishers as an example.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재의 유형에 따라 사용되는 소화기의 교육을 쇼케이스 형태로 제공하고, 소화기 종류, 사용설명, 화재 유형에 따른 간접체험을 동영상을 통해 제공하는 폐소화기를 이용한 소방교육시스템에 관한 것이다.  
이에, 체험과 시청각 교육을 병행하면서 교육 효과를 개선하고, 소화기 실사례를 예시로 하여 입체적 교육이 가능하도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: 10kV overhead line simulator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a 10kV overhead line simulator, which comprises a simulator unit and a temperature monitoring unit, wherein the simulator unit comprises a 380V power distribution cabinet, a transformer unit, a neutral point grounding unit, a centralized parameter cabinet, a test bed, a capacitor cabinet unit, a cable terminal cabinet, a fault comprehensive simulator and a main control platform, the temperature monitoring unit comprises an A phase temperature sensor, a B phase temperature sensor, a C phase temperature sensor, a zero line temperature sensor, an audible and visual alarm and a controller, if the temperature data of the A phase line, the B phase line, the C phase line and the zero line collected by the A phase temperature sensor, the B phase temperature sensor, the C phase temperature sensor and the zero line temperature sensor is higher than the safety temperature data of each phase line preset in the controller, the controller controls the audible and visual alarm, the early warning is carried out on teachers and students near the 10kV overhead line simulator before the fire disaster happens to the line due to high temperature, the safety performance of the 10kV overhead line simulation device is improved.
assignees: TIANJIN QINGYUAN HUAYUE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Force Machine
title_ko: 포스머신
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a force machine, and more specifically, to a force machine that allows firefighters to perform a game of hitting a heavy object using a recoilless hammer or to practice hitting so that the firefighters can measure the destructive force that destroys obstacles for fire suppression.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 포스머신에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 소방관이 화재 진압을 위하여 장애물을 파괴하는 파괴력을 측정할 수 있도록 무반동 해머를 이용하여 중량체를 타격하는 시합을 수행하거나 타격 연습을 실시할 수 있도록 한 포스머신에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Firefighter distress device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fireman's ware of calling for help relates to fire-fighting apparatus technical field, including the ware body of calling for help, this internal shell that is equipped with of ware of calling for help, be equipped with power button, talk button, signal transmission device and sound collection device on the shell surface, power button and below are equipped with bee sound chamber and buzzing piece, the shell rear side is equipped with the back lid, it presss from both sides and the cancellation button of reporting to the police to cover to be equipped with the duckbilled on the back, the duckbilled clamp below is equipped with visor and memory card groove, the shell with be equipped with battery and circuit board in the back lid, be equipped with gyroscope, acousto-optic alarm controller, timing device and GPS positioner on the circuit board. The utility model discloses a simple structure through the external alarm audio frequency that transmits of personnel quiescent time, in time informs rescue personnel's rescue, and this calling for help ware still possesses rescue information acquisition function simultaneously, makes things convenient for later stage staff from absorbing experience and training, when having made things convenient for rescue work, has ensured fire fighter's safety again.
assignees: JIANGXI DINGFENG EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Firefighter Training Devices
abstract_en: Firefighter training devices for wall breaches, cutting chains and/or bars and/or performing roof ventilations are disclosed. In some embodiments, the device is a modular firefighter training fixture. In some embodiments, the modular firefighter training fixture includes a cut-training module, a roof module, and/or a horizontal wall module. In some embodiments, the device is a firefighter training tree. In some embodiments the device is a modular partition system.

title_en: Virtual reality environment for catastrophe preparedness and response education
abstract_en: Methods and systems described in this disclosure are directed to rendering audiovisual (A/V) simulation of a disaster situation at a facility by artificially simulating the disaster situation. The disaster situation uses a 3D model of the environment associated with the facility. Embodiments of the disclosed system continuously collect data relating to reactions of one or more users to the simulation model. Upon analyzing the reactions of one or more users to the simulation model, the system provides A/V indicators such as an avatar, a virtual teacher, or a virtual user to provide information for responding to the disaster situation. In some embodiments, the simulation model can be customized based on one or more factors, such as an age of the one or users, a skillset of the one or more users, a geographical location of the facility.

title_en: TBM airborne pilot drill visualization device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of tunneling, and relates to a TBM airborne pilot drill visualization device, which comprises a drilling imaging device, wherein the drilling imaging device is carried on a rock drill of the TBM airborne pilot drill, and the drilling imaging device comprises an imaging device host; the imaging device host is respectively connected with a probe and a display, a conveying rod assembly is installed at the bottom of the probe, the probe extends into a TBM advanced borehole to carry out in-hole panoramic shooting, and an image editing processor in the imaging device host processes borehole image information detected by the probe and displays a processed result on the display. The device realizes qualitative, quantitative interpretation and imaging accurate identification of surrounding rock lithology, stratum fracture tectonic zone, geological disasters and the like of TBM tunneling face advance drilling, and overcomes the defects and limitations that the existing TBM airborne advance drilling machine can only drill holes and can not perform qualitative, quantitative interpretation and imaging accurate identification on the surrounding rock of the drilling machine.
assignees: XIAN CHINA RAILWAY ENG EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Test simulation system and method for engineering pipeline vibration caused by submarine landslide disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test simulation system for engineering pipeline vibration caused by a landslide hazard on the seabed, which comprises a simulated submarine pipeline device, a water environment simulation device, a landslide body motion simulation device and a data monitoring device, wherein the simulated submarine pipeline device comprises a simulated pipeline and a pipeline bracket connected with the simulated pipeline, the water environment simulation device comprises a box body, a simulated seabed surface and a water injection port which are arranged in the box body, the landslide body motion simulation device comprises a chute connected with the simulated seabed surface and a material collector for injecting landslide soil samples into the chute, the data monitoring device comprises a camera and an air pressure sensor, and the simulated pipeline is transversely arranged in the simulated water environment to be impacted by using a simulated landslide body. The invention can realize the test simulation and analysis of the vibration and even torsion problems of the engineering pipeline caused by the submarine landslide disaster, can realize the comprehensive research functions of pipeline stress, flow field, displacement, torsion and related images under different landslide body movement speeds and different pipeline average densities, and has simple device and easy popularization. The invention also discloses a test method of the device.

title_en: Coal rock dynamic disaster simulation test equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal petrography dynamic disaster simulation test equipment, including fixed frame, fixed station and the test box that is located the fixed frame bottom, the fixed station is located one side of fixed frame, be provided with X on the fixed station to load pneumatic cylinder, moving frame, slip track, push the pneumatic cylinder, X is to loading the pneumatic cylinder setting in moving frame, push the pneumatic cylinder and promote moving frame and move along the slip track, the left side of fixed frame is provided with Y to load the pneumatic cylinder, and the right side is provided with Y to bear the pressure head, the upper portion of fixed frame is provided with Z to load the pneumatic cylinder; the testing device is characterized in that a bearing workbench is arranged at the bottom in the fixed frame, the testing box is positioned above the bearing workbench and arranged at the rear end of the movable frame, and an upper cover plate and a lower cover plate are respectively fixed at the top and the bottom of the testing box. The device has high tightness and a plurality of data acquisition points, and can accurately simulate the occurrence of coal rock dynamic disasters.
assignees: QINGDAO QIANKUNXING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating fault probability and reliability of same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power transmission line fault calculation, and particularly relates to a method for calculating fault probability and reliability of a same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line; it comprises the following steps: calculating the fault probability of the same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line by a statistical analysis method; carrying out state simulation on the same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line by a Monte Carlo method; calculating the operation reliability index of the same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line; the method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out statistical analysis on fault probabilities of various natural disasters, then simulating the state of the line based on a Monte Carlo method, and finally calculating the reliability indexes of the line, wherein the reliability indexes comprise three indexes of load loss probability (LOLP), expected value of power shortage (EDNS) and expected value of power shortage (EENS).
assignees: ZHUMADIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Conductor icing forecasting method and system based on middle and small scale mode coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of a power grid, and discloses a wire icing forecasting method and system based on middle and small scale mode coupling. The method comprises the following steps: combining data such as live atmosphere data; simulating and calculating meteorological element data in the future set time of the line region through a mesoscale mode; taking the meteorological element information as an entrance condition and an initial condition of a small-scale mode calculation model; developing a medium and small scale coupling mode interface module, collecting high-precision grid topographic data of a circuit area to be analyzed, inputting the high-precision grid topographic data, inlet conditions, boundary conditions and initial conditions into a medium and small scale coupling mode, and calculating meteorological element data related to micro-terrain icing, wherein the meteorological element data comprises wind speed, temperature, atmospheric pressure, liquid water content in air, water vapor content and the like; and inputting meteorological element data obtained by a medium and small scale coupling mode as wire icing model data to obtain a real-time icing condition prediction result of the area where the electric wire is located.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Automatic adaptation method and system for monitoring service continuity operation
abstract_en: A method and a system for monitoring and automatically adapting the continuous operation of a service relate to the technical field of service continuity and comprise a monitoring subsystem, a data management subsystem, a disaster simulation subsystem, a disaster recovery backup subsystem and an automatically adapting subsystem. The invention monitors each service node through the monitoring subsystem; generating a mirror image data group through a data management subsystem; processing the mirrored data groups by a disaster simulation subsystem; switching the service flow simulating disaster to a backup link through a disaster recovery backup subsystem; the automatic adapter system analyzes the disaster simulation reaction condition, makes service continuity evaluation, realizes the automatic adaptation of the service on the whole, enhances the service continuity performance, reduces the occurrence probability of the service interruption condition and improves the efficiency of processing the service interruption condition.
assignees: EVECOM INFORMATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Mining deviation-preventing drill bit and drilling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining deviation-preventing drill bit and a drilling method, wherein the mining deviation-preventing drill bit comprises a drilling tool connector, a drill bit matrix, a diamond compact drilling tool and a guiding and positioning body; the drilling tool connecting body is cylindrical, and the axis of the drilling tool connecting body is provided with a conical threaded through hole for connecting with a drilling rod; the end part of the drilling tool connecting body is connected with a drill bit matrix, and a positioning guide body mounting hole for mounting a guide positioning body is formed in the axis of the drill bit matrix; the diamond compact drilling tools are provided with three diamond compact drilling tools and are arranged on the drill bit matrix in a surrounding manner; the height of the guiding and positioning body is higher than that of the diamond compact drilling tool. The invention effectively solves the deflection problem in the drilling construction of coal mine disaster treatment such as gas and water damage, and has the function of straight drilling protection.
assignees: SHUNHE COAL MINE OF YONGMEI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Unified backup management system and method based on cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unified backup management system and a method based on a cloud platform, wherein the system comprises: the request processing module is used for receiving a user operation request and transmitting the user operation request to the control module; the message distribution module is used for distributing the user operation request transmitted by the control module to a corresponding cloud platform so as to register to the cloud platform according to the user operation request; the cloud host creation module is used for creating cloud storage and a cloud host on a registered cloud platform according to the control of the control module; the node monitoring installation module is used for installing the node monitoring modules on the local server host and the cloud host after the cloud storage and the cloud host are created and is used for continuously monitoring the corresponding host state; and the control module is used for continuously monitoring the corresponding host state through each node monitoring module and issuing disaster tolerance operation instructions such as data backup, server exercise, full server migration and the like to the corresponding node monitoring module according to user operation.

title_en: Building teaching simulation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of building simulation teaching, concretely relates to building teaching analog device, including demonstration building, show shelf, external power source, thermodetector, smoke detector, fuming can, the mechanism and the oxygen content warning ware generate heat. The demonstration building is placed on the showing stand, and the temperature detector, the smoke generating tank, the heating mechanism and the oxygen content warning device are arranged in the demonstration building. The demonstration building can be assembled in multiple numbers. The smoke pot switch is opened at high temperature. When a fire disaster happens, adjacent buildings can be influenced, the heating mechanism is automatically switched on an external power supply at high temperature, and the temperature in the adjacent demonstration buildings rises. When the oxygen content alarm is opened at high temperature, substances in the oxygen content alarm change to prompt that the oxygen content is reduced. The demonstration building of this scheme can reuse, and the demonstration is convenient.

title_en: Static exploration machine suitable for geological disaster prevention and exploration
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disasters reconnaissance technical field specifically is a quiet spy machine suitable for geological disasters prevention reconnaissance usefulness, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the top welding of base has a set of stand, and the stand does not have sliding connection to have the truss, and the both sides welding of truss has the rack, the top of truss is run through and is equipped with a set of clamping screw, and clamping screw's top has cup jointed fixation nut, clamping screw's bottom welding has the connecting plate, and the bottom center department of connecting plate installs the connecting rod. This device adopts the mode of gear drive rack motion to impress the secret quick-witted drilling rod of quiet spy that is used for exploration geology underground, and the tradition adopts the punching hammer to hit the mode of visiting the borer this application noise little and fast that visits into the degree of depth interval and can control at will, because there is not hard collision only sawtooth meshing transmission, consequently does not have huge noise problem, has solved the noise pollution of traditional quiet spy machine, also brings relative green environment for the construction area, does not have the disturbing citizen phenomenon.

title_en: Soil monitoring device for shallow root crops after flood
abstract_en: The utility model provides a soil monitoring devices of shallow root system crop behind flood disaster mainly includes: inductive probe and central control platform, inductive probe passes through the transmission line with central control platform and is connected, inductive probe includes portable portion and drill bit portion, portable portion passes through connecting rod fixed connection with drill bit portion, is provided with the warning light in the portable portion, the built-in response subassembly of drill bit portion, the response subassembly passes through the transmission line with the information of collecting and conveys to central control platform, central control platform is equipped with storage portion, processing part, energy supply portion and display part. The probe through setting up multiple sensor carries out the monitoring of temperature, humidity, salinity and pH value to the soil after the flood disaster to the portable portion and the drill bit portion that set up convenient dismouting realize quick assembly disassembly, have still set up the warning light in addition and have realized monitoring devices's quick barrier removal and soil abnormity alarm function, rebuild, grab and resume work such as agricultural production and provide complete soil monitoring data basis for the soil after the flood disaster.

title_en: Intelligent security devices
title_ko: 지능형 보안 디바이스
abstract_en: An intelligent security device according to an embodiment of the present specification comprises: a camera; a processor for obtaining movement information of a pedestrian based on the image captured by the camera; and a transceiver for transmitting the motion information to the cloud and receiving instructions executable by the processor from the cloud. The instructions comprise: a first instruction for recognizing field state information based on the motion information, outputting a warning signal when the pedestrian's behavior is determined as a potential criminal behavior state in the recognized on-site state information, and controlling the processor according to the warning signal; and a second instruction for recognizing the field state information based on the motion information, outputting a guide signal when the pedestrian's behavior is determined as a wandering behavior state in the recognized on-site state information, and controlling the processor according to the guide signal. The intelligent security device of the present specification may be associated with an artificial intelligence module, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), a robot, an augmented reality (AR) device, a virtual reality (VR) device, a device related to a 5G service, or the like. Accordingly, the intelligent security device may provide disaster information and safety information.
abstract_ko:
본 명세서의 일실시 예에 따른 지능형 보안 디바이스는 카메라; 상기 카메라에서 촬영된 영상을 기초하여 보행자의 움직임 정보를 획득하는 프로세서; 및 상기 움직임 정보를 클라우드에 전송하고, 상기 클라우드로부터 상기 프로세서에 의해 실행 가능한 명령어를 전송받는 송수신기;를 포함하고, 상기 명령어는, 상기 움직임 정보에 기초하여 현장 상태 정보를 인지하고, 인지된 상기 현장 상태 정보에서 상기 보행자의 행동이 잠재적인 범죄 행동 상태라 판단한 경우, 경고 신호를 출력하고, 상기 경고 신호에 따라 상기 프로세서를 제어할 수 있는 제1 명령어;와 상기 움직임 정보에 기초하여 상기 현장 상태 정보를 인지하고, 인지된 상기 현장 상태 정보에서 상기 보행자의 행동이 방황 행동 상태라 판단한 경우, 안내 신호를 출력하고, 상기 안내 신호에 따라 상기 프로세서를 제어할 수 있는 제2 명령어;를 포함한다.

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method based on multiband entropy rate superpixel segmentation
abstract_en: The invention provides a hyperspectral image classification method based on multiband entropy rate superpixel segmentation, which is used for solving the technical problems of low classification precision and low classification efficiency in the prior art and comprises the following implementation steps: (1) Performing multiband entropy rate superpixel segmentation on the hyperspectral image; (2) acquiring a training set and a test set; (3) training a multi-classification support vector machine classifier; and (4) acquiring a classification result of the hyperspectral image. The hyperspectral image classification method based on multiband entropy rate superpixel segmentation fully utilizes the spectral information of the hyperspectral image ground object target and the spatial distribution information on multiband, thereby effectively improving the classification precision of the hyperspectral image, having higher classification efficiency and being applicable to the fields of disaster monitoring, geological exploration, city planning, agriculture, archaeology and the like.

title_en: Corn pest early warning method based on dynamic grid division
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corn pest early warning method based on dynamic grid division. The corn pest early warning method comprises the following steps: collecting data to obtain original data; preprocessing original data; clustering and dynamically dividing the spatial grids, and outputting an association model of the insect disaster factors and the corn loss; analyzing and deciding the pesticide application quantity and economy to obtain space nutrient data and additional fertilizer data; according to the spatial nutrient data and the additional fertilizer data, the loss of the corn is predicted, and compared and analyzed with the actual loss; and filing the loss data of the current year into a data set, performing the next iteration, and returning to the step I to continue the model training. The invention uses a dynamic grid division method based on a data set obtained by measuring insect disaster core elements under space grid division to carry out rapid and accurate insect disaster dynamic early warning, guides farmers to release pesticides and reduces insect disaster loss to the lowest.

title_en: Tailing dam space distribution identification system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for identifying spatial distribution of a tailing dam, belonging to the technical field of identification and comprising the following steps: constructing a full-element long time sequence data set of the tailing dam; constructing a tailing dam sample database by using the remote sensing image; constructing a deep learning model; training a deep learning model by using a tailing dam sample database to obtain a tailing dam identification model; and identifying the tailing dam by using the tailing dam identification model to finish the identification of the spatial distribution of the tailing dam. The invention can summarize the established and under-construction tailing dam data into the database, not only is the tailing dam data convenient to use, but also the position can be determined according to the database information when flood disasters occur, disaster information such as disaster early warning, tailing dam damage condition identification and the like can be obtained in real time, the invention has important practical application value, and great convenience is provided for people to use water conservancy information.

title_en: Train fire disaster opening fire overflow experimental device and experimental method
abstract_en: The train fire disaster opening fire overflow experimental device and method comprise a carriage main body, an experimental window, a ventilation opening, a measuring assembly and a fire disaster simulation assembly, wherein the experimental window is arranged on the side face of the carriage main body and is configured to be capable of observing the interior of the carriage main body, the ventilation opening is arranged on the experimental window and is configured to be opened when the temperature in the carriage main body reaches a threshold value, the measuring assembly is arranged at the position, corresponding to the ventilation opening, of the outer side of the top of the carriage main body and is configured to be capable of measuring overflow fire parameters overflowed through the ventilation opening, and the fire disaster simulation assembly is arranged in the carriage main body and is configured to be capable of simulating train fire situations. According to one or more embodiments of the specification, the simulated carriage fire environment is established, and the opening fire overflow is caused through the ventilation opening of the experimental window, so that the parameter of the opening fire overflow is measured, the flame overflow mechanism of the window cracking opening fire overflow when a fire disaster occurs in the carriage can be effectively simulated, and further the train fire can be more effectively protected.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography method for post-earthquake emergency
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography method for earthquake-oriented emergency, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a seismic source parameter, simulating a three-dimensional same-seismic deformation field by adopting an okada model according to the seismic source parameter, and dividing disaster-affected grades according to the three-dimensional same-seismic deformation field; superposing and analyzing the three-dimensional same-earthquake deformation field and the vector diagrams of buildings and roads in the disaster area to obtain an aerial photography range; carrying out route layout aiming at the aerial photography range by combining parameters of an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein aerial photography is preferentially carried out on an area with a serious disaster level, a planar ground object aerial photography method is adopted for a building area, and a strip-shaped ground object aerial photography method is adopted for a road area; after the route is obtained, calculating the position of a camera exposure point according to the parameters of the camera carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle and the terrain data in the three-dimensional same-earthquake deformation field; and flying the unmanned aerial vehicle along the air route, and shooting at the position of the camera exposure point by using the camera. The method can obviously improve the aerial photography efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Turbulence fire extinguishing partition experimental device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a turbulent fire extinguishing partition experimental device, which comprises an air box, a connecting plate and a partition plate, wherein the outer end of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the air box, and the inner end of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the outer end of the partition plate. According to the fan blade type vortex flame device, the baffle plate not only plays a role in controlling gas circulation and flow velocity, but also has a role in sealing gas, 2 to 4 kinds of gas can be filled according to the needs of experiments to carry out experiments, experimental diversity is increased, more comparison fire extinguishing performance experiments can be carried out on various fire extinguishing gases under the same condition, three air inlet pipelines are closed, one ventilation pipeline is opened, fire extinguishing gas is introduced, the situation that a scene firefighter can only extinguish a fire on one side due to the limitation of the fire is simulated, the scene fire extinguishing device has guiding significance on scene fire according to experimental data, the gas inlet speed and the air inlet size are dynamically changed, and the observation of characteristic influences on flame structures, flow fields, colors and the like due to the change of the gas flow velocity is completed.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction method and device based on machine learning and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster prediction method and device based on machine learning and electronic equipment, wherein the geological disaster prediction method and device based on machine learning comprise the following steps: acquiring early warning physical parameter combinations for predicting the influence of any type of geological disaster until M days before the current moment to obtain an influence factor vector time sequence; inputting the influence factor vector time sequence into any type of geological disaster prediction model, and outputting a description factor vector time sequence for predicting any type of geological disaster in N days in the future; any prediction model is obtained by training based on any type of disaster sample influence factor vector time sequence and description factor vector time sequence labels, a data set for training and testing is constructed based on historical data processed by the size of a sliding window with the width of M + N before training, and the geological disaster types comprise a mountain landslide type, a mud-rock flow type and a collapse type. The method, the device and the electronic equipment provided by the invention realize the improvement of the accuracy of the geological disaster prediction and guarantee the real-time property of the geological disaster prediction.

title_en: Storm disaster assessment prediction system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storm disaster assessment and prediction, in particular to a storm disaster assessment and prediction system which comprises a server, a pressure sensor, a scattering type turbidity meter and a prediction device, wherein the server is connected with the pressure sensor, the scattering type turbidity meter and the prediction device through a network and is used for carrying out data transmission, the server is used for processing and analyzing data, the pressure sensor is used for sensing leakage conditions of the outer wall of a pipeline and is paved around the pipeline, the scattering type turbidity meter is used for detecting turbidity in water, the prediction device is used for detecting drainage conditions of the pipeline, and the prediction device is used for simulating the drainage effect of a water inlet and is matched with the pressure sensor and the scattering type turbidity meter, so that the assessment and prediction of urban drainage pipelines in storm are realized, and the situation that the urban water inlet cannot be declared after storm is prevented, and the life and property safety of people are ensured.

title_en: Urban road traffic efficiency evaluation method under influence of rainstorm and waterlogging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating urban road traffic efficiency under the influence of rainstorm and waterlogging, which comprises the following steps: constructing a research area waterlogging model; acquiring overflow flow information of an waterlogging point according to the waterlogging model; constructing a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model of a research area according to the overflow flow information of the waterlogging point; acquiring a water accumulation road and water accumulation information by using a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model; constructing a traffic simulation model; evaluating a traffic operation efficiency index under waterlogging according to a traffic simulation model; the invention utilizes multi-model coupling and is based on the knowledge of two subjects of hydraulic engineering and traffic engineering, thereby overcoming the defect that the influence of waterlogging cannot be considered by a single traffic simulation model. The method has important significance for the establishment of waterlogging emergency plans and urban disaster prevention and reduction work of water conservancy departments, traffic departments, municipal departments and the like.

title_en: Emergent signal light utensil of suspension type fire control convenient to dismantle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ceiling type fire-fighting emergency sign lamp convenient to disassemble, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting emergency equipment and comprises a sign lamp body, wherein an installation component is arranged on the top surface of the sign lamp body, the installation component is arranged below a lifting component in a hanging manner, the top surface of the lifting component is fixedly connected to the bottom surface of an installation frame, two ends of the installation frame are welded on a fixing component, and a smoke alarm is arranged on the back surface of the sign lamp body; the marker light body is more convenient to disassemble and assemble, the defect that the marker light body is difficult to disassemble is overcome, convenience of follow-up maintenance is improved, drilling work is not needed, attractiveness is improved while installation efficiency is improved, damage to a wall is avoided, once a fire disaster and other conditions happen, the buzzer is controlled through the single chip microcomputer and is sounded and fed back to the cloud deck server through the wireless receiving and sending module, so that fire fighters can learn the fire disaster place quickly, and fire fighting efficiency is improved.

title_en: Regional landslide early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a regional landslide early warning method and a system, which are characterized by comprising the following contents: 1) carrying out grid division on an area to be detected, and taking a grid unit as a basic early warning unit; 2) acquiring historical geological environment factor characteristic data and historical rainfall factor characteristic data of each basic early warning unit in a region to be tested, and constructing a training sample set; 3) learning and training the constructed training sample set, and preferably selecting a pre-established early warning model; 4) the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time geological environment factor characteristic data and real-time rainfall factor characteristic data of each basic early warning unit of a region to be detected, inputting the real-time geological environment factor characteristic data and the real-time rainfall factor characteristic data into an optimal early warning model, obtaining the probability of landslide disasters of each basic early warning unit of the region to be detected, and carrying out grading early warning.

title_en: Disaster training device for elevator for performing training in case of disaster, and elevator system
abstract_en: Provided is a disaster training device for an elevator, which can adjust the timing of training operation when the elevator starts to generate a disaster according to the situation. A disaster training device for an elevator is provided with: a transmission unit that transmits information; a receiving unit that receives information; and a control unit that causes the transmission unit to transmit, to a terminal of an elevator manager, start promotion information that prompts start of training at the time of occurrence of a disaster, and causes the transmission unit to transmit, to the elevator, training operation start information that starts training operation at the time of occurrence of a disaster when the reception unit receives training start instruction information corresponding to the training start promotion information.
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC BUILDING TECHNO SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Large three-dimensional detachable drilling chip analog simulation experiment device
abstract_en: A large three-dimensional detachable drilling cutting simulation experiment device comprises a detachable counter-force frame, a top hydraulic loading oil cylinder group, a side hydraulic loading oil cylinder group and a rear dynamic loading oil cylinder; the hydraulic loading oil cylinders in the top hydraulic loading oil cylinder group and the side hydraulic loading oil cylinder group can be independently loaded so as to realize the simulation of a crushing area, a plastic area and an elastic area; horizontal dynamic loads are independently applied through the rear dynamic load loading oil cylinder to simulate the influence of dynamic disasters such as mine earthquake and the like on the stress and strain of the coal rock mass, so that the credibility of experimental results is improved; by independent loading of the plurality of hydraulic loading oil cylinders, drilling cutting experiments and drilling pressure relief experiments at the inclined angle of the coal seam can be developed, the outermost side of the loading cushion block extends to the outside of the sample, and the boundary effect can be effectively avoided during loading so as to reduce experimental errors; the whole experimental device forms a three-dimensional structure, ground stress is simulated more accurately, and the accuracy of the drilling cutting and drilling pressure relief similar simulation experiment result is further improved by adopting a large-size sample.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL;SHENHUA XINJIANG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Head-mounted virtual reality equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses head-mounted virtual reality equipment, and relates to the technical field of virtual reality equipment. The intelligent control device comprises a shell and a soft cushion, wherein the soft cushion is arranged on the rear side of the shell, key control equipment is arranged on the upper surface of the shell, a state indicator lamp is arranged on the front edge of the upper surface of the shell, a front wide-angle camera is fixedly mounted at the front end of the shell, and lateral cameras are arranged at the left end and the right end of the shell; through setting up the ground in laser range finder surveys equipment and the environment of locating, obstacles such as wall distance, survey the position of virtual reality equipment, simultaneously compare time-recorder data acquisition speed data according to the distance variation, judge whether the user can bump or fall down, when unusual state appears, through looking around and getting external environment image and simulating the people's eye field of vision for the equipment, cover virtual image, make the user can obtain environmental information at once, and make emergency response, improve the security of virtual reality equipment.

title_en: Mine disaster ruin detection auxiliary rescue equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the ruin rescue related field, in particular to mine disaster ruin detection auxiliary rescue equipment. The mine disaster ruin detection auxiliary rescue equipment comprises a machine body arranged at any position in the mine disaster ruin soil layer, wherein a traveling mechanism is arranged in the machine body, a drilling mechanism is rotatably arranged on one side of the traveling mechanism, the drilling mechanism comprises a drilling box, a drill bit mechanism for drilling is slidably arranged on one side, away from the traveling mechanism, of the drilling box, the drilling box is arranged in the drilling box, and a drilling power mechanism for providing power for the drilling mechanism and controlling steering is arranged in a worm gear cavity. The invention not only can determine the position of the trapped person through the infrared thermal sensing device, but also can find the trapped person and provide rescue goods for the trapped person.

title_en: Geological disaster professional monitoring data acquisition method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster professional monitoring, and provides a geological disaster professional monitoring data acquisition method and system. The method comprises the steps of compensating certain monitoring data which are lacked in the area with limited economic capability through the monitoring data of the peripheral area, and carrying out simulation on the monitoring data of the secondary key position through a prediction algorithm according to the monitoring data of the key position. The method and the device calculate the data missing in the local area through the existing monitoring data of the local area or the areas around the local area aiming at the area with limited economic capability, thereby fully utilizing the existing data under the condition of limited conditions, acquiring the monitoring data of the area as comprehensively as possible and monitoring the geological disasters of the area comprehensively.
assignees: WUHAN DAMENG DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: TBM card-sticking risk prediction method based on numerical value sample and random forest
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TBM card machine risk prediction method based on numerical value samples and random forests, which comprises the following steps: establishing a refined numerical simulation model, and simulating the aging deformation of the surrounding rock based on the creep damage model to realize the simulation of the TBM construction process; setting values of different card machine influence factors in a numerical simulation model, and calculating numerical samples containing different working conditions; establishing a card machine risk judgment index, and calibrating the card machine risk level of the sample; and establishing a random forest model, carrying out model training based on the numerical value sample, and predicting the card machine risk level of the actual construction section by using the trained random forest model. The invention constructs a card machine numerical value sample library based on refined numerical simulation, and solves the problems of few monitoring samples and unbalance in the application of machine learning in engineering; by utilizing the trained random forest model, the risk level of the machine sticking at the actual construction section can be quickly predicted, so that the advanced prevention and control of disasters are guided, and the safe and efficient construction of the TBM is ensured.

title_en: Water purification unit suitable for multiple quality of water
abstract_en: A water purifying apparatus suitable for multiple water qualities is prepared as using timer to control electromagnetic valve to open timely to carry out pollution discharge washing on silt filter and ultrafiltration membrane for preventing silt filter and ultrafiltration membrane from blocking filter unit, using novel filtering mode composed of silt filter, ultrafiltration membrane, RO membrane, post-positioned active carbon and ultraviolet sterilization to fully ensure purified water quality to reach direct drinking standard for fully ensuring drinking safety of people in rural, suburban and factory, scenic region, disaster area and field training areas without municipal tap water supply area, using circuit board to control high-voltage switch, low-voltage switch, The electromagnetic valve and the water pump realize the automatic operation of the equipment and reduce the manual operation.

title_en: Mine disaster escape device
abstract_en: A mine disaster escape device, comprising: the drill bit comprises a shell part, a drill bit part, a supporting and bedding part and a fixing part; the protective cabin is arranged in the shell part to prevent personnel from being injured, and the drill bit part realizes the smashing of soil and stones on the top of the equipment; the supporting and bedding part achieves the functions of supporting the whole equipment and paving sandy soil below the equipment, the fixing part achieves the function of fixing the equipment to a channel in the climbing process of the equipment, the double-shaft motor B drives the bevel gear group with the belt pulley to rotate, the threaded circular tube B drives the threaded conical head rod to slide back and forth, so that the threaded conical head rod fixes the whole equipment to the soil wall, personnel are protected from being injured, and the damage caused by equipment collision is avoided.

title_en: Transformer fault identification method based on kernel function extreme learning machine
abstract_en: The application provides a transformer fault identification method based on a kernel function extreme learning machine, under the operating condition of a transformer, vibration signals are obtained to serve as analysis samples, after the vibration signals are denoised, each frequency energy characteristic value of the vibration signals is obtained based on wavelet packet decomposition and reconstruction, each frequency energy characteristic value is extracted to serve as a fingerprint vector and is divided into two sample sets, namely a training set and a testing set, an optimized kernel function extreme learning machine network model is established, model training is carried out by utilizing the fingerprint vector training set, the testing set is input into the model, an output checking result is analyzed and calculated, the working state of the transformer is obtained, and fault identification of the transformer is achieved. The method solves the problem that the system is abnormal due to dimension disaster, further optimizes and improves the performance of the fault judgment and analysis result, and realizes automatic identification of the abnormal fault of the power transformer.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent management and control system and method suitable for ship fire safety and computer medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent management and control system suitable for ship fire safety, which comprises an application layer, a monitoring layer and a monitoring layer, wherein the application layer provides an information visualization model on a unified digital platform through a plurality of visualization monitoring modes and a plurality of information interaction modes; the service layer performs cloud computing and edge computing through an information visualization model provided by the application layer to realize intelligent sensing, control and auxiliary decision making, and establishes various databases, prediction and simulation models; and the infrastructure is accessed to the unified digital platform, and transmits real-time data to the service layer to perform cloud computing or edge computing to judge the disaster probability and quantify the disaster scale. According to the invention, through the fusion of traditional fire detection and video monitoring, equipment state monitoring and indoor positioning, various intelligent sensing means are provided, the disaster types such as fire and abnormal events are identified, basic data support is provided for disaster sensing and path planning, equipment operation and maintenance monitoring and disaster risk prediction are brought into fire safety management of ships, faults and hidden dangers can be found at early stage, and the accidents can be prevented.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHIP ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT RES INSTITUTE THE 726 RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA SHIPBUILDING INDUSTR

title_en: Three-dimensional virtual emergency alarm drilling system for urban rail station fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire three-dimensional virtual emergency alarm drilling system for urban rail stations, which comprises a three-dimensional modeling unit, a model reorganization module, a fire simulation generation module, a sensitivity detection unit, a model correction unit and a model comparison module, wherein the model reorganization module is used for generating a model; the position and the sensitivity of main emergency alarm facilities in the fire emergency alarm drilling system in the urban station can be detected by the set sensitivity detection unit, the fire emergency alarm drilling system in the urban station can be corrected according to the detection result by the set model correction unit, the three-dimensional correction model of the corrected vectorized data station is applied to the three-dimensional virtual fire emergency alarm drilling system of the urban station, the sensitivity of fire emergency alarm can be improved, various fire states can be simulated by the set fire simulation generation module, and the effectiveness of drilling results can be improved by performing emergency alarm drilling under various fire states.

title_en: Hyperspectral remote sensing image water body inherent attribute inversion method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device and equipment for inverting inherent attributes of a water body of a hyperspectral remote sensing image. Constructing a reconstruction network, wherein the reconstruction network comprises: the system comprises a feature extraction network, a mixed regression network and a water body model, wherein the feature extraction network consists of a convolutional neural network and a cyclic neural network; the mixed regression network and the feature extraction network are mirror images of each other; the characteristic extraction network with the mixed network structure well extracts the spectral characteristics of the original hyperspectral remote sensing water body image, reduces the dimensionality of original data and avoids the unfavorable phenomena of dimensionality disaster and the like; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a prediction result of inherent optical properties of the water body by using a mixed regression network, then realizing physical reconstruction of a hyperspectral image by using a water body model, optimizing network parameters by using a gradient descent method by using a reconstruction error, and performing network training in an unsupervised mode without relation to actual values of the inherent parameters of the water body, thereby improving the generalization capability of the method.

title_en: Hyperspectral image target detection method based on sample mining and background reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hyperspectral image target detection method based on sample mining and background reconstruction, and mainly solves the problem of low target detection precision in the prior art. The scheme is as follows: carrying out coarse detection on the input hyperspectral image, and obtaining a training sample based on a coarse detection result; respectively constructing a generating type confrontation network, a reverse self-encoder network and a self-encoder network, and respectively training the networks by using training samples; calculating a reconstruction error and a preliminary detection result of the self-encoder network reconstruction input hyperspectral image; obtaining an optimized hyperspectral image and a feature map according to the primary detection result, and further realizing second-stage sample mining, network training and target detection to obtain a second-stage detection result; and fusing the primary detection result and the second-stage detection result to obtain a final detection result. The invention can fully utilize background spectrum information, effectively inhibit background interference, improve target detection precision, and can be used for environmental protection, mineral exploration, crop yield estimation and disaster prevention and relief.

title_en: Post-earthquake disaster population rapid space assessment method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a quick space assessment method and a quick space assessment system for post-earthquake disaster population based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining an earthquake influence area according to the earthquake intensity distribution; acquiring historical earthquake disaster population data and earthquake disaster population influence factor values of an earthquake influence area; calculating the historical earthquake disaster population density based on the historical earthquake disaster population data; randomly generating sampling points in the earthquake affected area, and extracting historical earthquake disaster population density values and earthquake disaster population affected factor values at the spatial positions of the sampling points through the sampling points; constructing an earthquake disaster population space evaluation model by using a machine learning method and taking the historical earthquake disaster population density value and the earthquake disaster population influence factor value as training data; calculating the average value of the current administrative area disaster population density according to the spatial range of the administrative area by using an earthquake disaster population space evaluation model; and calculating the post-earthquake disaster population value of the current administrative area according to the average value of the disaster population density of the current administrative area.

title_en: Seawater invasion tide simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seawater invasion tide simulation system, which comprises a water tank, a first water storage tank and a second water storage tank, wherein the middle part of the water tank is provided with a soil layer simulation device, the soil layer simulation device comprises a frame, a water-bearing layer and a water-resisting layer, and a measuring electrode for measuring the concentration of seawater is arranged in each aquifer, the invention uses a soil layer simulation device consisting of a frame, the aquifers and a water-resisting layer to arrange the aquifers in the frame, and each aquifer is separated by a water-resisting layer, so that the soil layer simulation device is closer to the original soil layer, and underground fresh water with different water levels is injected into different second cavities, so that the pressure of each layer of underground fresh water can be controlled, the exchange process between seawater and the underground fresh water in the tidal fluctuation process is simulated, reliable experimental data can be obtained, and support is provided for disaster prevention and reduction in coastal zones.
assignees: FIRST INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Prediction method for maximum value of disaster-causing factors of mine fire disaster
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mine safety, and provides a method for predicting the maximum value of a mine fire disaster factor, which comprises the following steps: step 1: determining a disaster factor and a disaster factor influence factor of the mine fire disaster; step 2: establishing a mine fire numerical simulation model; step 3: obtaining data of maximum values of disaster causing factors under N value combinations of the disaster causing factor influencing factors by adopting a numerical simulation method to obtain a mine fire sample set; step 4: taking the influence factors of all disaster causing factors as input and the maximum value of all disaster causing factors as output, and constructing a mine fire disaster causing factor maximum value prediction model based on MLP; step 5: training and verifying a maximum value prediction model of a mine fire disaster factor to obtain an optimal prediction model; step 6: testing the optimal prediction model; step 7: and predicting the maximum value of the fire disaster factor of the mine to be predicted. The method can realize the rapid prediction of the maximum value of the disaster-causing factors of the mine fire disaster and improve the prediction accuracy and safety.

title_en: Evaluation method for social and economic exposure degree of flood disasters based on climate mode set
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating social and economic exposure degree of flood disasters based on a climate mode set, which comprises the following steps: collecting hydrological, meteorological and underlying surface data of a research area, calibrating a distributed hydrological model of the drainage basin, and extracting output data of a global climate mode; adopting a multivariable deviation correction method to carry out deviation correction on the output data of the global climate mode to obtain a corrected global climate mode weather series; simulating the river submerged depth under the climate change situation by adopting the corrected global climate model weather series driving distributed hydrological model and hydrodynamic model obtained in the step 2; and (4) evaluating population and GDP exposure degree of the flood disaster influenced by climate change based on the simulation result of the step (3) by considering dynamic population and GDP scene of the shared socioeconomic path. The method evaluates the influence of flood events on the social and economic systems under various climatic change situations, and has important scientific significance for future flood risk prediction and loss evaluation.

title_en: Multifunctional three-dimensional wheat seed cultivation frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an farming equipment field discloses a multi-functional three-dimensional wheat seed culture rack, including cultivateing the groove, cultivateing tank bottom four corners and all being connected with the supporting leg, circular recess has all been seted up in cultivation tank top four corners, the cultivation tank top has the bracing piece in the recess in four corners to be connected, it is connected with the apron through four bracing pieces to cultivate the tank top, it is connected with irrigation mechanism, two to cultivate tank one side the common through connection of bracing piece has the spout, the screw thread round hole has been seted up at the spout both ends, the spout is connected with the fastening knob in screw thread round hole department, the bar through-hole has been seted up at the spout middle part, two the spout is. The utility model has the advantages of simple integral structure, easily operation is used, and the brush through sweeping the mechanism simulates strong wind weather and makes wheat seedling lodging, can effectively improve the toughness of later stage wheat straw, makes it possess stronger lodging resistance ability, reduces the injury that strong wind meteorological disaster caused the wheat.
assignees: JIANGSU QIANZHONGLANG AGRICULTURAL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Mining area ecological environment restoration system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mining area ecological environment restoration system, which relates to the field of ecological restoration, and aims to solve the problem that landslide disasters can occur under the rainy condition in the current ecological environment restoration scheme, and the environmental restoration effect is poor, the system comprises a waterproof layer laid on a side slope and a bearing component arranged on the upper side of the waterproof layer, wherein the bearing component comprises a plurality of mutually connected bearing trays, each bearing tray comprises a bottom plate and side plates vertically and fixedly connected at the edge positions of four sides of the bottom plate, the outer side surfaces of the side plates are respectively and fixedly connected with a clamping block, the outer side surfaces of the side plates are provided with clamping grooves, and the two bearing trays are attached to ensure that the clamping blocks are respectively embedded into the corresponding clamping grooves; the bottom plate is respectively provided with a plurality of through holes; a plurality of fixed drill rods are respectively arranged on the bottom plate and penetrate through the bottom plate to be inserted into the side slope; the bearing tray is provided with a soil improvement layer. The utility model discloses have the promotion and carry out prosthetic effect to the ecology, reduce the effect that phenomenons such as landslide appear.
assignees: BEIKUANGCHENG ECOLOGICAL TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing scenarios for supporting decision to respond to environmental facilities disaster
title_ko: 환경시설 재난 대응 의사결정 지원을 위한 시나리오 제공 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing scenarios for supporting decision in response to a disaster in environmental facilities to provide the most optimal response scenario to the disaster and an apparatus thereof. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps of: generating a virtual situation scenario from a DB unit storing past disaster cases for environmental facilities; accessing a storage unit storing one or more countermeasures to be performed in the generated virtual situation scenario to read the stored countermeasures; evaluating, by a simulation unit, whether a countermeasure satisfying a standard required by the environmental facility exists among the read countermeasures; and fixing the countermeasures satisfying an evaluation result as a scenario corresponding to the generated virtual situation scenario to store the same in the storage unit, and generating and storing a new changed countermeasure in the storage unit when the countermeasures are not satisfied on the basis of the evaluation results.
abstract_ko: 본 기술은 환경시설 재난 대응 의사결정 지원을 위한 시나리오 제공 방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 기술의 환경시설 재난 대응 의사결정 지원을 위한 시나리오 제공 방법은, 환경시설에 대한 과거 재난사례가 저장된 DB부로부터 가상의 상황 시나리오를 생성하는 단계; 상기 생성된 가상의 상황 시나리오에서 행할 하나 이상의 대응조치들을 저장하고 있는 저장부에 엑세스하여 상기 저장된 대응조치들을 읽어오는 단계; 상기 읽어온 대응조치들 중 상기 환경시설에서 요구하는 기준을 만족하는 대응조치가 존재하는지를 시뮬레이션부를 통해 평가하는 단계; 및 상기 평가 결과 만족하는 대응조치를 상기 생성된 가상의 상황 시나리오에 대한 대응 시나리오로 지정하여 상기 저장부에 저장되도록 처리하고, 상기 평가 결과 어느 하나도 만족하지 않는 경우 변경된 새로운 대응조치를 생성하여 상기 저장부에 저장되도록 처리하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV KOOKMIN IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Intelligent generation method and system for digital emergency plan of fire accident
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for intelligently generating a digital emergency plan of a fire accident, which comprises the steps of building a bottom layer support database and an application process, and automatically generating a digital emergency plan by analyzing disaster models, resource models, simulation models and rule model data, combining with a built-in judgment process of the system and automatically associating corresponding data from the data; the generated plan is presented and adjusted in real time in a 3D dynamic visual form, and is vivid and three-dimensional and easy to understand.
assignees: BEIJING SHENZHOU ANXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: In-situ soil stabilization hydrological characteristic parameter determination experimental device and experimental method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an in-situ soil stabilization hydrological characteristic parameter measurement experimental device and an experimental method thereof, wherein the experimental device comprises an infiltration system, a water supply system, a power system and a water level control system; the power system provides a power supply for a field test; the water supply system provides a water source for the whole system and monitors the total amount of water used in the test process; the water level control system is used for adjusting the size of a water head, and the infiltration system measures the vertical stable infiltration rate and the infiltration coefficient of the soil body under different water volume conditions. The invention has simple structure and convenient operation, can simulate the runoff of the debris flow source area under different rainfall conditions, can calculate the stable infiltration rate and the permeability coefficient of the soil body of the debris flow source area, provides important data for analyzing the debris flow forming mode, mechanism and disaster scale, provides basic parameters for forecasting the debris flow, and can better serve disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: CHENGDU INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT CAS

title_en: Method and system for forecasting urban drainage basin flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting urban drainage basin flooding, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the rain type space-time distribution of the urban area according to historical data; establishing a flood simulation scene library by simulating parameters under different scenes of the area by utilizing a refined flood model according to the rain type space-time distribution and the river course flood boundary conditions; establishing a rainstorm flood relational expression and an inland inundation simulation relational expression based on simulation data; correcting the acquired rainfall forecast data according to the rainfall type space-time distribution, and dividing different scenes; and performing data matching on the rainstorm flood relation and the waterlogging simulation relation and different scenes, and when the matching degree is greater than preset, using the simulation data in the flood simulation scene library as the information for forecasting the flood of the urban drainage basin. The method can quickly calculate the peak flow and the total flood volume of each node in the forecast period, the positions of the ponding points, the ponding depths, the ponding duration and other information, realizes quick forecast and research and judgment of urban flood disasters, and strives for precious time for flood control and drainage emergency management.
