title_en: Tank field fire emergency response model construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tank field fire emergency response model construction method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: analyzing the priority of emergency actions in the emergency response process of the fire in the tank field and the influence of the emergency actions on the emergency process; s2: defining a time hybrid Petri network for modeling a tank field fire emergency response process; s3: and adding the model constructed in the action priority correction step S2 to obtain a Petri net tank area fire emergency response model. According to the invention, the emergency action priority factor is added in the emergency response process modeling, so that the constructed model can simulate the emergency response process more comprehensively and completely, and the accuracy and the effectiveness of the model are improved.

title_en: Unsupervised hyperspectral image change detection method based on countermeasure learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unsupervised hyperspectral image change detection method based on countermeasure learning, which mainly solves the problems of high false detection rate and low detection precision caused by insufficient training data in the existing supervised technology. The implementation scheme is as follows: 1) Constructing an unsupervised spectrum mapping network based on countermeasure learning, and forming a double-phase spectrum mapping network, 2) inputting double-phase hyperspectral images, and respectively training the double-phase spectrum mapping network; 3) Extracting a spectrum dimension feature map of the trained double-phase hyperspectral image, and carrying out principal component analysis on the spectrum dimension feature map to obtain a double-phase one-dimensional spectrum dimension principal feature map; 4) Sequentially carrying out space feature reinforcement and binarization on the double-time-phase main feature map to obtain a double-time-phase binary map; 5) And obtaining the change detection result of the unsupervised hyperspectral image by calculating the residual error of the double-time-phase binary image. The invention reduces the false detection rate and improves the detection precision, and can be used for land investigation, urban research, disaster detection and evaluation.

title_en: Integrative case is dealt with to acute traumatism
abstract_en: The utility model provides an acute trauma treatment integrated box, which comprises two box bodies, wherein one end of each box body is provided with an opening, the openings of the two box bodies are connected through a hinge and a buckle, and a foldable debridement cart, a liquid medicine box, a consumable box, a medicine box and a tool box are arranged in the two box bodies; the utility model provides an integrative case is dealt with to acute trauma integrates the required surgical equipment of institute's trauma processing, medicine, consumptive material, makes the integrative case of unit is dealt with in the surgery, in disaster rescue or military training, receives the task order "lift the case and walk promptly", need not arrange equipment, medicinal material, consumptive material in order again deliberately, certain medicine or certain consumptive material when avoiding surgery to deal with is omitted, better completion acute trauma when making things convenient for the surgeon to carry out the institute's external task, especially the processing task of acute open trauma.
assignees: The Third Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: Battery pack voltage line sequence detection circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery pack voltage sequence detection circuit which comprises a first switch sub-circuit, a second switch sub-circuit, a voltage division circuit, a light emitting diode and a voltage protection sub-circuit. Through the disclosed battery pack voltage sequence detection circuit, the sequence of the battery module wire harness is detected, whether the connection of the sequence of the wire harness is correct is judged by whether the light emitting diode emits light, and the phenomenon that a fire disaster happens because the battery module and the wire harness in an error state are inserted into a battery management system to simulate the front end is avoided.
assignees: SHANGHAI DU POWER NEW ENERGY TECHNICAL CO LTD;JIANGSU DUPU NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Six-degree-of-freedom airplane land crash emergency evacuation test system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the test technology and provides a six-degree-of-freedom airplane land falling collision emergency evacuation test system and a six-degree-of-freedom airplane land falling collision emergency evacuation test method, so that the test is closer to a real falling collision scene, the truth degree of the emergency evacuation test is improved, and technical support is provided for modeling of an emergency evacuation simulation model. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, a six-degree-of-freedom motion platform simulates pitching and rolling attitude adjustment of an airplane after falling and collision, and a window of a cabin section [6] simulates external scenes of the airplane after accident; step 2, the participants wear the wearable wireless sensor to simulate the emergency evacuation after the airplane has accident, move from the cabin section [6] to the forward boarding door [4] and the on-wing emergency exit [7] and evacuate the airplane through the main slide [3] and the on-wing slide [9 ]; and 3, the wearable wireless sensor sends the physiological state participation and motion trail of the person to be tested, and the physiological state participation and motion trail is sent to a system background through the multi-channel wireless data receiver [3 ].
assignees: XIAN AIRCRAFT DESIGN INST AVIATION IND CORP CHINA

title_en: Oil-immersed transformer oil discharge and injection foam simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil-discharging and foam-injecting simulation test device and method for an oil-immersed transformer, wherein the device comprises a simulation transformer, a control system, an oil-discharging system and a simulation oil-discharging and foam-injecting system, wherein the simulation transformer is respectively connected with the oil-discharging system and the simulation oil-discharging and foam-injecting system through pipelines, the control system is respectively electrically connected with the oil-discharging system and the simulation oil-discharging and foam-injecting system, the control system sends out corresponding control instructions and records related data in the test process, and the oil-discharging system receives the oil-discharging instructions of the control system, executes the instructions and performs oil-discharging operation; the simulated oil drainage and foam injection system receives an oil drainage and foam injection command of the control system and executes the command to drain and inject foam; the invention has the advantages that: the oil discharging and foam injecting system is simulated to simulate the oil discharging and foam injecting condition, the actual condition of the transformer fire disaster is restored, the development rule of the internal fire disaster of the transformer is accurately known, and the quick and low-fire-fighting medium fire-extinguishing system for inhibiting the internal fire is developed.

title_en: Safe exploitation mode for natural gas hydrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe exploitation mode of natural gas hydrate, which adopts the technical scheme that the safe exploitation mode comprises the following steps: pre-development block geological survey; pre-development block well position deployment; the well track is optimized; drilling a first batch of wells at intervals and carrying out depressurization production; after production is finished, abandoning the well, and injecting cement into the well bottom to fill a cavity; drilling a second batch of wells among the first batch of wells and performing depressurization production; and (5) finishing production. According to the geological characteristics of the seabed slope and the distribution characteristics of the natural gas hydrate reservoir, by optimizing well position arrangement, batch drilling production and filling mining cavities, the plastic region through phenomenon of the seabed slope is effectively prevented, engineering disasters, geological disasters and environmental problems such as blowout, seabed landslide, methane leakage and the like are avoided, and stable mining of the natural gas hydrate reservoir under the seabed slope is ensured.

title_en: Jellyfish disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean monitoring and early warning, in particular to an early warning method for jellyfish disasters, which comprises the following steps of establishing a jellyfish drift path prediction model: data collection and arrangement, meteorological mode research and development, marine physical mode research and development: by utilizing a double nesting technology, simulating typical sea area hydrodynamic environment elements, jellyfish physical-ecological model research and development and jellyfish drift path prediction model research and development by adopting an ROMS marine mode, then establishing a jellyfish disaster risk level early warning method, then participating in data integration and system construction, undertaking research and development of a jellyfish disaster drift early warning module, and finally performing operation demonstration. In the invention, a collective forecasting method is independently developed, living habits such as the autonomous movement of jellyfishes and the like are considered, and an external jellyfish emergency drift collective prediction model is considered; according to indexes such as the variety of the disaster jellyfish, the toxicity of the jellyfish, the distribution density of the jellyfish and the like, a jellyfish disaster risk level early warning method is researched.

title_en: Large-scale venue personnel evacuation safety simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an evacuation safety simulation device of personnel in large-scale venue, including simulation sand table base, the inside hydraulic support column that is fixed with of simulation sand table base, fixed surface installs the installation base on the hydraulic support column, fixed surface installs large-scale venue model support frame on the installation base, fixed surface installs the decoration fountain on the simulation sand table base, fixed surface installs the sparse intensive playground of personnel on the simulation fountain one side position simulation sand table base, large-scale venue model support frame and the sparse intensive playground of personnel have the sand table to simulate sparse road surface to be connected between, simulation sand table base upper surface is close to both corners edge rigidity and installs sand table illumination spotlight. A large-scale venue personnel evacuation safety analogue means, the inside passageway condition in understanding venue that can be more detailed, and the model on the sand table can extend out more audio-visual performance inner structure, the sparse scene of the mini personnel of being convenient for.
assignees: SPACE GEOMETRY SHENZHEN DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Submarine landslide evolution process simulation system and experiment method based on transparent soil and rotating tank
abstract_en: A submarine landslide evolution process simulation system and experiment method based on transparent soil and a rotating tank, relating to the technical field of marine geological disasters and geotechnical engineering experiments, and comprising a rotating tank system, a transparent soil simulation system, and a control and data collection system. The rotating tank system sets different speeds for a sample by controlling a motor, and a closed circular ring structure of a U-shaped cross section rotating drum groove satisfies a requirement that a sliding distance is not limited; the transparent soil simulation system prepares a transparent sample having a physical mechanical property similar to that of a real submarine soil layer and having a tracer coloring agent, and a fluid environment, thereby realizing three-dimensional visualization of interior, exterior, and water-soil interface of in the whole sample evolution process; the control and data collection system realizes quantitative monitoring and data extraction of the evolution process by means of three-dimensional laser dicing and digital image collection. The system provided by the present invention is controllable in scale, visual in evolution process, and measurable in image data, and can solve the problems that a long-distance evolution experiment is difficult to carry out, data collection is difficult, and a monitoring picture is not clear.

title_en: Converter transformer fire foam-water mist fire extinguishing experimental system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a converter transformer fire foam-water mist fire extinguishing experimental system which comprises a foam-water mist system, a converter transformer fire system and a detection system, wherein the foam-water mist system is connected with the converter transformer fire system; the converter transformer fire disaster system is used for simulating different kinds of fire disasters such as oil pool fire, flowing fire and the like; the spraying end of the foam-water mist system is positioned above the converter transformer fire system and is used for spraying foam mixed liquid to extinguish fire; the detection system is used for detecting and recording the development conditions of different stages of the fire generated by the converter transformer fire system. The invention carries out experimental research on the process of each stage of the converter flow fire and the generation, development, fierceness, extinguishment and the like of the fire under the action of the foam-water mist fire extinguishing system, discusses the rule and the characteristics of the converter flow fire and tests the effectiveness of the foam-water mist fire extinguishing system.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting command system and method for performing fire-fighting drilling by using same
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fire-fighting command, and provides an intelligent fire-fighting command system and a method for fire-fighting drill by using the same, wherein the intelligent fire-fighting command system comprises: the signal receiving module is used for receiving an alarm signal from the fire control cabinet; the virtual scene application module is used for constructing a peripheral three-dimensional virtual scene model and triggering a virtual scene display window corresponding to the accident position in the three-dimensional virtual scene model through an alarm signal; the fire engine management module is used for carrying out fire rescue deployment according to fire fighting resources actually configured by a local fire brigade, or carrying out cross-regional joint fire drill deployment by combining the fire fighting resources of peripheral fire brigades; and the signal sending module is used for sending the virtual scene related information of the accident scene and the fire-fighting command instruction to the firefighter mobile terminal.
assignees: NAT ENERGY GROUP COAL COKING CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive experiment device for outdoor geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outdoor geological disaster comprehensive experiment device, which belongs to the field of geological disaster simulation tests and comprises a supporting system, a slide way, a stacking area and a measurement and control system; the method is characterized in that the slope, roughness and structure of the slide can be flexibly changed, and the experimental simulation of debris flow, torrential flood and rockfall under different terrain conditions can be realized; the device has reasonable structure, stable working performance and simple operation, can realize repetitive operation, and can simulate the occurrence and development processes of geological disasters such as debris flow, torrential flood, rockfall and the like and the requirements of disaster consequence experimental tests.

title_en: Numerical method for simulating start-up formation, flow development and re-siltation of debris flow
abstract_en: A method for simulating the start-up, development and rebilling of mud-rock flow includes such steps as mapping the mass and momentum at each material point to relative background grid by high-order B-spline, calculating the mass and momentum at nodes of background grid, and calculating the internal force at nodes of background grid And external force Introducing artificial damping force, solving a momentum equation on the background grid nodes, updating the acceleration and the speed of the background grid nodes, mapping the updated speed and the updated acceleration of the background grid nodes back to corresponding material points respectively, updating the speed and the position of each material point, and outputting relevant material information of the required material points; the invention introduces artificial damping force to simulate the mutual friction among particles in the movement process of the debris flow, introduces a solid-liquid conversion constitutive model to accurately simulate the instantaneous movement state of the debris flow, and utilizes a numerical simulation result to simulate the debris flowThe prediction, evaluation and prevention of the stone flow disasters have important significance for preventing or reducing the mud-rock flow from having great significance for the prediction and prevention of the disasters in various engineering fields.

title_en: Urban flood disaster dynamic evaluation method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic urban flood disaster evaluation method based on multi-source data, which comprises the following steps: collecting real-time data; carrying out spatialization treatment; establishing a flood disaster recovery volume data set; simulating a flooding process; simulating population disaster; calculating the traffic speed during rainstorm flood; analyzing the difference; and generating a dynamic evaluation result. The invention fully utilizes the superiority of the big data technology, implements and obtains urban population and traffic conditions based on the web crawler technology, realizes dynamic assessment of flood disaster loss by combining the urban rainfall flood model simulation result through the constructed disaster-bearing body data set, overcomes the defects of difficult acquisition of traditional data and poor space-time resolution, realizes cross research of the big data technology and the urban hydrology field, can capture loss difference of flood-bearing bodies at different time points, and truly reflects the influence of flood disasters on the society. The invention can be combined with any urban rainfall flood model to guide the work of disaster prevention and reduction and enhance the toughness of the city.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Weak consolidated formation water sand bursting simulation test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation test device for water sand bursting of a weakly consolidated formation, which comprises: the device comprises a device body, a water sand bursting observation assembly, a visualization assembly and a water pressure supply assembly; the water sand bursting observation assembly is connected with the device body; the visual assembly is arranged on the outer wall of the device body, and the water pressure supply assembly is arranged at the top of the device body. The invention also provides a weak cemented formation water sand collapse simulation test method using the device, which comprises the following steps: s1 screening sand grains; s2 filling sand; s3, adjusting water pressure for testing; s4, adjusting the width of the water sand bursting channel; s5 replacing sand grains of different sizes. According to the invention, by simulating the structure of the weakly consolidated formation in the test device, the control effect of the sand body particle size, the water pressure and the water sand bursting channel width on the water sand bursting can be quantified, the condition of the water sand bursting can be visually observed, and a basis is provided for prevention and control of water sand bursting disasters.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Test device for simulating stratum loosening to cause pavement collapse
abstract_en: A test device for simulating stratum loosening to cause pavement collapse. The device comprises a sensor support, a main test box, a bottom support, an edge migration channel, an edge movable plate, a jack, a middle migration channel, a middle movable plate, a laser displacement sensor and a loosening size control plate. The invention has the following effects: the movable plate moving up and down controls the stratum loosening under the pavement structure, quantitative research and repeatability tests can be carried out, the sizes of different loosening bodies can be freely controlled, the jack and the movable plate are flexibly disassembled and assembled and are easy to operate, the test device provides visual, controllable and convenient-to-operate test equipment for researching urban road collapse, the test research level of urban road collapse disasters can be improved, and theoretical basis is provided for early warning and prevention of road collapse accidents.

title_en: Spatial similarity geological disaster prediction method based on feature subset coupling model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prediction, and discloses a spatial similarity geological disaster prediction method based on a feature subset coupling model, which comprises the steps of obtaining disaster-causing factors related to geological disasters, carrying out standardized processing on the obtained disaster-causing factors, and making a geological disaster factor map layer; acquiring historical geological disaster points and related data to obtain a disaster point matrix, and making a map; setting the number of member classifiers and the subspace dimension, and generating a feature subset; generating a logic model tree aiming at each generated characteristic subset, adjusting corresponding parameters, calculating to obtain the optimal training result of each subset, and judging the model performance; and a corresponding geological disaster sensitivity map is made, and geological disaster risk prediction is performed according to the geological disaster sensitivity map. The invention reduces the influence of the factors on the prediction result and improves the accuracy of the prediction.
assignees: WUHAN C GEO CLOUDS SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Burying device for monitoring rock and soil disasters
abstract_en: The utility model provides a ground disaster monitoring is with burying device belongs to ground disaster monitoring technology field. This ground calamity monitoring is with burying device includes removal subassembly, drilling subassembly, filler subassembly and presses the material subassembly, the removal subassembly includes first loading board, second loading board, third loading board and a plurality of anchor strut, the drilling subassembly includes elevating system, sleeve and drilling portion, the filler subassembly includes stock guide, two stoppers and storage case, press the material subassembly to include driving piece and briquetting. The utility model discloses a removal subassembly person of facilitating the use mobile device is whole, conveniently removes the device to drilling and the position of burying, in drilling and follow-up refilling the drilling with soil through the drilling subassembly, in filling the drilling with ground calamity monitoring devices through the device that packs, through the soil compaction that the pressure material subassembly will refill, facilitates the use and operates.
assignees: SHENZHEN INVESTIGATION & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Portable assembled gas stove
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable equipment gas-cooker, the load simulator comprises a device body, one side fixedly connected with combustor on equipment body surface, the chamber is placed to the opposite side fixedly connected with gas bottle on equipment body surface, the first hinge of top fixedly connected with of equipment body, the first weather shield of top fixedly connected with of first hinge, one side fixedly connected with second hinge of first weather shield, one side fixedly connected with second weather shield of second hinge. Through the first hinge of design, first weather shield, second hinge, second weather shield, first magnet piece, third hinge, third weather shield, second magnet piece, can effectually prevent wind the processing to the equipment when burning, increase the protective effect of equipment to the burning things which may cause a fire disaster, effectual solved equipment when using, because the burning things which may cause a fire disaster is often blown out by wind, and make the problem that the result of use of equipment descends.
assignees: SHANDONG JINLI KITCHEN EQUIPMENT LTD COMPANY

title_en: Icing and icebreaking device for high-voltage line in snow disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snow disaster high-voltage line icing and icebreaking device, which comprises a telescopic arm, wherein the middle end part of the telescopic arm is provided with an insulating pull rope, and the two ends of the telescopic arm are fixed with an ice-breaking wire-clamping machine, a storage battery is fixedly attached and installed above the inner wall of the ice-breaking wire-clamping machine, the storage battery is electrically connected with the motor at one side below through a circuit, one end of the motor is provided with a drill rod, the drill rod is movably inserted into the striker sleeve and fixedly welded with the ice breaking striker, a support frame is arranged above the inner part of the ice breaking wire clamping machine, an electric vibration machine is fixedly arranged in the supporting frame, a main spherical wire clamping head is arranged in the supporting frame below the electric vibration machine in a sliding way, and an auxiliary spherical wire clamping head I and an auxiliary spherical wire clamping head II are symmetrically arranged at two ends below the main spherical wire clamping head, when the ice block is impacted, a certain force can be ensured, and the short circuit of the motor caused by the fact that the head is impacted by the broken ice is often blocked by the ice block and cannot be impacted out of the maximum stroke can be avoided.

title_en: Soil and stone water tank erosion test device considering seepage
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and hydraulic engineering, and provides a soil and stone water tank erosion test device considering seepage. The device comprises a base, a water tank, a material box, a circulating water supply device and a data monitoring, acquiring and analyzing device. Utilize circulation water supply installation can form circulation rivers in the basin to soil and stone material applys to erode the load in the workbin, the seepage flow mode of different grade type can be simulated through upstream disassembly plate, the low reaches disassembly plate of workbin, seepage flow soil and stone material collecting vat, erode soil and stone material collecting vat and can be used for collecting the soil and stone material that produces under the different stages seepage flow and the scouring action respectively. Compared with the prior art, the device is simple to operate, can develop a scouring characteristic test of soil and stone materials in a laboratory, research the influence of seepage conditions, physical and chemical properties of the soil and stone materials and fluid properties on the scouring characteristic, and provide basic data for dam break mechanism analysis and water-soil interaction research, so that the device can be applied to the fields of water conservancy and hydropower, disaster prevention and reduction and the like.

title_en: Multi-time-sequence image rice yield estimation method based on crop phenological period
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-time sequence image rice yield estimation method based on crop phenological periods, belongs to the technical field of remote sensing technology and crop yield estimation, and aims to solve the problems that the accuracy of inversion results is inaccurate, a model is unstable, and the influence of growth vigor, disasters and soil moisture content is not considered; the method comprises the steps of establishing a rice yield estimation model by adopting a BP neural network algorithm, programming by using matlab2019b and GUI design, performing model training by using vegetation indexes of a rice phenological period, rice growth grade data, rice disaster grade data, soil moisture content data and field production measurement data, establishing an optimal model, performing rice yield estimation by using the optimal model and combining a target area image, and obtaining a target area yield grade distribution grid number. The invention utilizes the remote sensing technology to process satellite image data and extract vegetation indexes, growth vigor, disasters and soil moisture content, inverts the yield of a target area, saves the production cost, further improves the production efficiency and simultaneously achieves the aim of accurately estimating the yield.
assignees: HARBIN SPACE STAR DATA SYSTEM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster loss evaluation method based on entropy weight and BP neural network technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood disaster loss evaluation method based on entropy weight and BP neural network technology, which overcomes the defect that large data analysis for flood disaster loss based on machine learning is not available in the prior art. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring and preprocessing basic data; calculating initial index data of a base layer; setting and training a basic layer BP neural network; acquiring data of a comprehensive layer; calculating the initial index data of the integration layer; setting and training an integrated layer BP neural network; and obtaining the damage evaluation result of the flood disaster to be analyzed. The method analyzes and processes the flood situations through an entropy weight method and a BP neural network, and induces and analyzes data of the flood situations by utilizing big data analysis and combining an artificial intelligence technology.
assignees: HEFEI ZHONGKE JIADIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;ANHUI HENGKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time calculation method for gas extraction parameters of underground coal mine pipe network
abstract_en: A real-time resolving method for gas extraction parameters of underground coal mine pipe network includes the steps of firstly, establishing a point position distribution map of system nodes according to node, pipeline and drilling arrangement of a gas extraction system; then, establishing a pipe network gas extraction parameter calculation model based on a gas flow mass conservation law and an energy conservation equation; and finally substituting the real-time monitoring data of the pipe network sensor, the coal body basic data of the extraction area and the pipe network basic parameters into a pipe network gas extraction parameter calculation model to calculate, so as to realize the calculation data of mixed flow, flow velocity, concentration, pressure and density at other nodes. According to the invention, by collecting the monitoring data of the limited measuring points, the gas extraction parameters of the whole pipe network can be analyzed and calculated in real time, a sufficient data basis is provided for dynamic evaluation of gas extraction and early warning of gas disasters, the construction cost of a monitoring system can be effectively reduced, and the economy of gas extraction is improved.

title_en: BIM technology-based emergency evacuation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation method and device based on a BIM (building information modeling) technology. The actual equipment and the three-dimensional building information model are combined to obtain the actual situation of the dangerous case, and the fire fighters can know the dangerous case from the whole situation in real time through the combination of the Internet of things (actual equipment) and the three-dimensional model (three-dimensional building information model), so that the fire fighters can provide the optimal evacuation scheme for the escape personnel in a short time, and the evacuation efficiency of the escape personnel is improved. Aiming at various emergency situations, the escape routes of the evacuees are simulated to generate emergency plans, so that the firefighters can accurately provide the optimal evacuation scheme for the evacuees, the evacuees can smoothly escape, and the survival probability of the evacuees is improved; according to the actual situation and the emergency plan of the dangerous case, emergency evacuation is carried out on the escape personnel, so that the escape personnel can avoid the place where the dangerous case occurs, and the safety of the escape personnel is improved.
assignees: XIAMEN BUILDING SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;LEIZHI DESIGN GROUP CO LTD;LETS CHENGDU TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Stadium emergency evacuation sign readability evaluation system based on fuzzy theory and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a stadium emergency evacuation sign readability evaluation system based on a fuzzy theory and a control method thereof, wherein the system comprises the following steps: establishing a stadium emergency evacuation identification readability evaluation index system; acquiring experiment data through a virtual reality experiment, and collecting and packing the experiment data; constructing a II-level index fuzzy evaluation index matrix; obtaining I-level index weight vectors through an analytic hierarchy process; calculating and analyzing data obtained by the virtual reality experiment by using a coefficient of variation method to obtain a II-level index weight vector; constructing an I-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation matrix, and synthesizing the weight vector and the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation matrix to obtain a readability evaluation result of the emergency evacuation identification scheme of the stadium; the invention establishes a stadium emergency evacuation identification readability index system, improves the accuracy of stadium emergency evacuation identification readability judgment, is a scientific method for evaluating and predicting the stadium evacuation identification design quality, and provides a basis for guiding the space streamline optimization layout.

title_en: Detection system for surface of marine equipment engineering material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection system for the surface of an engineering material of marine equipment, which can be applied to the surface of related engineering materials used for marine fishery equipment, marine oil and gas field development, marine drilling platforms, cross-sea bridges, submarine tunnels, ship engineering, deep sea exploration, marine power generation equipment and the like to carry out indoor scouring test. The system is used for researching the influence of scouring on the microstructure and mechanical properties of the surface of a material. According to the measured experimental result, the surface can be modified to obtain excellent performance, the service life of the material is expected to be prolonged, and the possibility of serious disasters is reduced; the detection system for the surface of the engineering material of the marine equipment can completely simulate seawater environments with different depths to carry out scouring experiments on the surface of the engineering material to obtain the same experiment results as those under the marine environment, so that the scouring experiments on the surface of the engineering material of the marine equipment can be conveniently carried out in universities, research institutes and enterprises for researching the marine equipment, and the experiment cost is greatly saved.

title_en: A air respirator simulation training equipment for training supplementarily
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air respirator simulation training device for auxiliary training, and belongs to the technical field of simulation training devices. The air respirator simulation training device comprises a model air cylinder, a back support, shoulder straps, a waistband and other parts, the shape of the simulation training device is the same as that of a positive pressure type air respirator, the air cylinder is of a hollow or solid structure, the air cylinder is fixed on the back support, the shoulder straps and the waistband are connected with the back support, an integrated design can be considered, and a firefighter can use the positive pressure type air respirator in daily training with high use frequency, is easy to damage and is difficult to repair after being damaged.

title_en: Device for simulating piping dangerous case of dike in drilling base
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and disaster prevention and reduction, and discloses a device for simulating the piping dangerous situation of an embankment in a drilling base, wherein an inlet is horizontally embedded at the top end of the embankment at a certain distance downwards to penetrate through a water service pipe at the upstream of the embankment, a gate valve well is arranged on the embankment, the water service pipe penetrates through the bottom of the gate valve well, a main control valve is arranged on the water service pipe, and a branch water pipe provided with a standby valve is communicated with the water service pipe between the main control valve at the inner part of the gate valve well and the downstream of the embank; the water service pipe is close to dykes and dams low reaches position and sets up a plurality of export, every export intercommunication main pipeline, and the main pipeline sets up in dykes and dams low reaches drill soil body below, and its end is equipped with the trompil, constitutes the trompil floral tube. Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses a water service pipe and the potential difference of usable upper reaches water level and water service pipe entry realize dykes and dams low reaches piping dangerous situation simulation, and when the upstream is anhydrous moreover, or the flood peak is lower, realize dykes and dams low reaches piping dangerous situation simulation through sluice well and valve control.
assignees: HUAIAN WATER RESOURCES SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Firefighter training assembly
abstract_en: An assembly for burning class A fuels during firefighter training. The assembly has enhanced smoke generating characteristics for simulating a realistic room fire in training exercises. In particular, the assembly is designed with ease of setup and to increase the amount of smoke generated during combustion so that a realistic room fire involving modern housing materials can be simulated.

title_en: Multi-type user-oriented nuclear accident multivariate information visualization method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-type user-oriented nuclear accident multivariate information visualization method and electronic equipment, comprising the following steps of: determining a user type; acquiring nuclear accident multivariate information; acquiring a nuclear accident multivariate information set based on the user type and the nuclear accident multivariate information; performing information analysis and drawing on the nuclear accident multivariate information set to obtain a visual graph; and displaying the visual graph. By establishing a multivariate information set, the invention realizes the visualization integrating the functions of nuclear emergency decision and rescue, public communication, nuclear emergency training and drilling and the like, and solves the problems of delay of the rescue process and the like caused by the difficulty in timely and effectively obtaining related information by different participants in the emergency response process.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD;CHINA NUCLEAR POWER DESIGN CO LTD SHENZHEN;HEFEI INST PHYSICAL SCI CAS

title_en: Crowd evacuation auxiliary decision-making system based on ant colony algorithm and improved social model
abstract_en: The invention provides a crowd evacuation auxiliary decision-making system based on an ant colony algorithm and an improved social model, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring evacuation scene parameters through a shooting device, creating an evacuation scene model in a computer, and classifying different types of pedestrians based on a neural network face recognition system; s2, planning the pedestrian evacuation route with complete evacuation information by using the ant colony algorithm: s3, planning evacuation routes of pedestrians having local evacuation information in consideration of the individual preferences influenced by the crowd behavior, obstacles, walls, etc.; s4, driving the pedestrian to move based on the improved social force model, and simulating the crowd evacuation movement; and S5, predicting and marking the evacuation bottleneck of the pedestrian in the emergency, and reasonably setting a guide mark at the mark to induce the pedestrian to safely reach the exit. The invention can utilize facility resources in an evacuation process in a balanced manner, predict evacuation bottleneck, set a guide sign, reasonably plan a dynamic evacuation path and improve evacuation efficiency.

title_en: City operation safety identification method and system under organization view angle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city operation safety identification method and a system under an organization view angle, which relate to the technical field of city operation safety identification and comprise the steps of establishing a city operation safety identification index system based on investigation data in the field of city operation safety industry; the identification index system comprises a safety development planning identification index, an early warning system identification index, an emergency system identification index, a safety responsibility system identification index, a hidden danger troubleshooting management identification index, a disaster prevention and reduction construction identification index, a rescue and relief capacity identification index, a socialized service system identification index and an education and training identification index; constructing an urban operation safety identification model by adopting an analytic hierarchy process based on an urban operation safety identification index system; calculating an urban operation safety index by adopting a comprehensive identification method based on an urban operation safety identification model; and identifying the urban operation safety state according to the urban operation safety index. The invention can comprehensively and accurately identify the urban operation safety performance.
assignees: SHANGHAI JIANKE ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Natural disaster early warning system and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster early warning system and an early warning method, which comprise the following steps: step S1, the environment portrait construction unit collects the environment data of the target area in real time and establishes an environment portrait data chain for recording and representing the target prediction of each target area to the target disaster; step S2, the prediction model construction unit receives the environment portrait data chain and constructs a disaster prediction model based on the environment portrait data chain. The method and the device perform framing quantization on the environmental logs of the target area and perform key frame extraction on the environmental logs by using the similarity between adjacent frames, so that the important environmental data in the environmental logs are reserved, the dimension of the environmental logs is reduced, the data processing amount of subsequent feature extraction is reduced, and the model training efficiency is improved.
assignees: CHENGDU CHINA METRO TRACK EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Pine wood nematode disaster prediction and forecast method and device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting and forecasting bursaphelenchus xylophilus disaster based on deep learning, wherein the usability and the purity of data are ensured by adopting data preprocessing; data amplification is adopted, training sample scales are increased as much as possible through a data amplifier, data supplement and data conversion data amplification technologies are provided, the most data amplification technologies are image random rotation, cutting, translation, horizontal and vertical turning methods to provide data of different environments for a model, parameters of a deep learning model are updated through an optimizer, results are output through training sets, the deep learning still can learn good and stable classification characteristics, the situation that a deep learning building model is adopted due to the defects of a traditional characteristic extraction method is avoided, the pine wood nematode disaster degree can be effectively reduced through prediction and forecast of pine wood nematode disaster, and effective prevention is further carried out.

title_en: Intelligent pigsty monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent pigsty monitoring system, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent breeding, wherein an infrared temperature sensing camera transmits collected pigsty original image data to a pigsty monitoring platform through a control host, managers label live pig information and breeding environment information on pictures, the pigsty monitoring platform is used for opening AI automatic model training and establishing a matched breeding model, the breeding model verifies whether the breeding state of the pigsty is abnormal or not according to the real-time image data and the real-time environment data, when the breeding state of the pigsty is abnormal, the pigsty monitoring platform sends an alarm prompt to notify the managers and makes a response instruction according to the abnormal type, and the control host regulates the pigsty environment or verifies the live pig condition according to the response instruction. The intelligent pigsty monitoring system disclosed by the invention can be used for monitoring in real time and making adaptive emergency response in time aiming at abnormal emergency types occurring in the breeding process, the monitoring sensitivity of the system is in a reasonable interval, and the response processing process is sensitive and reliable.
assignees: ZHONGNONG YUPIN XIAMEN INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Drainage device, system and method suitable for TBM tunnel induced polarization instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drainage device, a system and a method suitable for a TBM tunnel induced polarization instrument, and the technical scheme is as follows: the water-saving drainage device comprises a drainage pipeline, wherein one end of the drainage pipeline is connected with a drill bit, the drill bit is provided with a water outlet for water to flow in from a water source area, and the other end of the drainage pipeline is used for discharging the water. The tunnel induced polarization detector can be used for detecting the scale and the spatial position of a water source in the TBM excavation process and then discharging the water source through a drainage pipeline with a drill bit and a water outlet, so that the possible water burst disaster can be solved in advance.

title_en: Method for interactive training of disaster medical rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical treatment, and discloses a method for interactive training of disaster medical rescue, which comprises the following steps: 1) through multi-person multi-role control, a plurality of students can simultaneously cooperate to complete one task or different rescue tasks, respectively play rescue workers with different roles, carry a certain number of non-player roles (NPCs) to execute assigned tasks, log in a login module of a client side, and log in a platform management side; 2) and double-clicking the scene module, entering the case selection module, generating a scene model code in the scene module on the resource server, and maintaining the scene model code by the data maintenance model of the platform management end. The state of the illness is marked by color and the corresponding medical staff is distributed. According to the disaster medical rescue interactive training method, the three-dimensional resource library is embedded into a disaster rescue platform background management end, a model code is generated, a case selection button in a client program is triggered, and the three-dimensional resource library of the background management end is called.

title_en: Drilling and piling integrated machine for emergency and disaster relief
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drilling pile all-in-one of rescuing, including base, right angle support, spacing, traction cable and punching motor, one side on base top is fixed with the support frame, and the inside one side of support frame rotates and installs the connecting axle, and one side on connecting axle surface is fixed with the driving gear, and the winding of one side on driving gear surface has drive track, install driving motor on the outer wall of support frame one side, and driving motor's output has power belt through the shaft coupling winding, power belt and connecting axle interconnect, be fixed with the support column on the outer wall of support frame one side. The utility model discloses not only promote the organism flexibility of punching, improve the pile efficiency of all-in-one, still make the organism in same position installation back, can carry out the drilling pile operation of many places to promote the work efficiency of all-in-one, provide the valuable time for the rescue.
assignees: SICHUAN PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Soil collecting equipment for preventing and treating bioenergy natural disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environment detection auxiliary devices, in particular to a soil collecting device for preventing and controlling a biological energy natural disaster, which has simple structure, is convenient to move and operate, and reduces the workload of a user; the bottom plate, the rack, the apparatus further comprises a rotating shaft, the ratchet, the reciprocating rod, a spring, the connecting plate, gu fixed ring and baffle, the bottom plate top is provided with the door template, door template central zone is provided with the mounting hole, the right side wall is provided with the track in the mounting hole, rack right side wall is provided with the spout with track sliding fit, the rack bottom is provided with the mounting panel, the mounting panel bottom is provided with the door type ring, door type ring inside is provided with the motor, the motor output end is provided with the drilling rod, the bottom plate is provided with the transition hole, the drilling rod bottom passes the transition hole, lateral wall and back lateral wall all are provided with the mounting groove that communicates with the.

title_en: Longitudinal ventilation downward gradient adjustable tunnel fire simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tunnel fire simulation experiment device with adjustable longitudinal ventilation downward gradient, which belongs to the fire safety field and comprises a experiment table main body, wherein the bottom of the experiment table main body is fixedly connected with a supporting leg, one side of the supporting leg is fixedly provided with a fan, an air outlet of the fan is fixedly sleeved with an air inlet pipe, one side of the air inlet pipe is fixedly provided with a nozzle, the bottom of an inner cavity of the experiment table main body is provided with a chute, the bottom of the inner cavity of the experiment table main body is provided with a combustion pool, the bottom of the combustion pool is respectively and fixedly provided with four rollers, the top of the inner cavity of the experiment table main body is fixedly provided with a camera, the camera is electrically connected with a controller through a wire, and the controller comprises a; through setting up burning pond, gyro wheel and spout, can ignite or change the burning things which may cause a fire disaster of experiment, the continuous burning of burning things which may cause a fire disaster in the experiment of being convenient for has brought the facility for the change of burning things which may cause a fire disaster in the experiment.

title_en: Temporary suspension structure of tunnel portal warning sign
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a temporary suspension structure of a tunnel portal warning sign, which does not fully consider the position of a cab of a rescue vehicle mainly comprising a large transport vehicle, the effectiveness of night sight induction of a driver of the large transport vehicle and the feasibility of mechanical drilling in emergency warning emergency scenes in the design of the tunnel portal warning sign in some scenes such as road maintenance, natural disaster rescue and the like; the utility model provides a foam board, wherein one end of the foam board is provided with a storage bag and a storage battery, the other end of the foam board is fixedly provided with two nylon ropes, the two nylon ropes are arranged in a cross way, and the end parts of the two nylon ropes, which are far away from the foam board, are respectively provided with a fixed lantern ring; the cystosepiment other end is equipped with a plurality of light, and the installation of being convenient for is dismantled, and portable accomodates, and convenient operation, the suitability is strong.
assignees: GUIZHOU TRANSPORTATION PLANNING SURVEY & DESIGN ACADEME CO LTD

title_en: Tailing pond simulation device
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the fields of geotechnical engineering and disaster prevention and control, and provides a tailing pond simulation device.A pond body simulation assembly is arranged to simulate a tailing pond body, the earthquake simulation assembly is used for generating vibration to simulate the action of an earthquake on the tailing pond body, a precipitation simulation assembly is used for spraying water to the tailing pond body simulation device to simulate the action of precipitation on the tailing pond body, a trench bed simulation assembly is used for simulating the influence of topography and landform on tailing trend when the tailing pond breaks a dam, and a processing device is used for controlling the work of the four assemblies; the invention realizes the effect of creating different natural conditions and different working conditions in one tailing simulation device, and further realizes the effect of simulating the influence of various natural conditions and working conditions on the tailing pond.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction method and system based on solar magnetic field intensity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster prediction method and a geological disaster prediction system based on solar magnetic field intensity, wherein the method comprises the following steps: measuring the intensity of the solar magnetic field in real time; measuring the surface area of the seismic zone, and calculating the volume and gravity of the seismic zone slab; calculating the heat value when the solar magnetic field is cut by the iron ion fluid in a closed loop mode according to the solar magnetic field intensity and the volume of the charged iron ion fluid in the earth core; and predicting the geological disaster according to the heat value, the volume of the seismic plate-carrying block and the gravity. The method can accurately forecast the earthquake, simulate the earthquake and prevent earthquake disasters; the real reasons of the occurrence of the earthquake and volcanic eruption are found; advanced electromagnetism and quantum theory are applied; the theoretical research model of plate motion is more perfect; the calculation model of the plate acting force is more perfect.

title_en: Tropical cyclone full-path simulation method based on random forest algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel tropical cyclone full-path simulation method based on a random forest algorithm. The nonlinear mapping relation of the historical typhoon key information is mined by adopting a random forest algorithm based on machine learning, so that the defect of the fitting capability of linear regression analysis of the traditional full-path simulation method can be effectively avoided. The method establishes a model for the overall information of various paths generated based on cluster analysis, can debug each model to ensure the learning effect, and does not need to divide a computing sea area into grids to perform a large amount of regression analysis. The introduction of the technical means of the random forest algorithm can improve the defect that the parameter calibration of the traditional method has no standard flow to a certain extent. Consistent with the traditional simulation method, the method can also carry out random simulation on tropical cyclone generation, a traveling path, a traveling direction, ocean surface strength development and landing strength attenuation of the whole northwest Pacific area, generate a large number of tropical cyclone paths and strength random event sample sets which accord with the characteristics of historical samples, and quantitatively and finely evaluate typhoon disaster risks in coastal areas in China, so that the problem of insufficient historical samples in local areas is effectively solved, and a foundation is laid for quantitatively and finely evaluating the disaster risks. The method can ensure better accuracy and universality, and can be popularized to other areas for hurricane disaster risk assessment and analysis.

title_en: Intelligent detection, pressure relief, monitoring and early warning integrated machine for deep space engineering disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent detection, pressure relief, monitoring and early warning integrated machine for deep space engineering disasters, which relates to the technical field of mining rock pressure detection, can realize stable and accurate underground and multi-angle drilling pressure relief and detection, accurately predict and forecast the danger and the strength grade of coal mine rock burst, and improve the accuracy and the efficiency of early warning and forecast; this all-in-one includes: the control system is used for controlling the normal work of all the systems of the integrated machine; the power system is used for providing power for other systems of the integrated machine; the advancing system is used for realizing the advancing of the all-in-one machine in the roadway; the drilling system is used for drilling a hole on the rock wall and relieving pressure; the lifting and rotating system is connected with the drilling system and is used for adjusting the position of the drilling system in the vertical direction and the horizontal direction and adjusting the inclination angle of a drilled hole; and the data acquisition and storage system is used for acquiring and storing data. The technical scheme provided by the invention is suitable for the underground detection process.

title_en: Performance simulation test method for vertical air shaft explosion door
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance simulation test method for an explosion vent of a vertical air shaft, and relates to the technical field of explosion vents of vertical air shafts. The testing method includes the steps that gas explosion is simulated through an air blower to impact an explosion-proof door, the high-speed camera is used for recording the processes of opening, pressure relief and automatic reset of the explosion-proof door under impact, and meanwhile, the readings of a pressure sensor, a wind pressure meter and a flow meter are recorded; and after the single group of experiments are finished, the air blower is turned off, all the components are reset and arranged, the air blower is turned on again after the existence of damage is checked, the air volume of the air blower is increased, and the experimental steps are repeated until the explosion door is damaged and leaks air under the impact. The invention can realize the real simulation of the explosion door impacted by gas explosion, the research result can provide design thought and theoretical support for the development of the explosion door, and the invention has important practical significance for improving the mine disaster prevention technical level and reducing the loss of gas explosion disaster to the maximum extent.

title_en: Large-energy-level adjustable impact test platform for high-level debris flow blocking structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an impact test platform with adjustable big energy level that can be used to high-order piece stream retaining structure relates to geological experiment and geological disasters prevention and control field, has add automatic large-tonnage hydraulic jack device, simulates the motion of piece stream under the multiple angle combination operating mode of upper portion first stage, two sections spouts of second stage. The bottom of the uppermost starting chute is also provided with a small-tonnage hydraulic jack so that a sliding block or accumulated particles preset in the starting chute can slide downwards. The rock mass is crushed by collision at the corner of the three-section type chute, and part of rock debris generates larger impact speed based on the momentum conservation theorem to influence the final movement distance and the accumulation state. The invention provides the attached observation stair with the angle changed along with the lifting of the first-stage sliding groove and the second-stage sliding groove when the angle is changed. The platform belongs to a large-scale physical model test platform for high-level remote geological disasters with the largest scale and the most comprehensive functions at home and abroad and variable gradients.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER MINISTRY OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Bidirectional eccentric loading device for bending component in drop hammer impact test
abstract_en: The invention provides a bidirectional eccentric loading device for a bending component in a drop hammer impact test, which belongs to the technical field of component disaster simulation devices and comprises a bidirectional eccentric restraint mechanism, an axial loading mechanism and a drop hammer; the bidirectional eccentric restraint mechanism comprises an upper pressing piece, a lower pressing piece, a force transmission support, a spherical hinge, a rolling shaft and a reaction frame I; the upper pressing piece and the lower pressing piece clamp the force transmission support through the rolling shaft, and the axis of the rolling shaft is vertical to the axis of the structural member; the force transmission support is connected with the end part of the structural component through a spherical hinge, and the spherical hinge and the structural component are eccentrically arranged; the force transmission support of the first bidirectional eccentric restraint mechanism is connected with the reaction frame I, and the force transmission support of the second bidirectional eccentric restraint mechanism is connected with the axial loading mechanism. The invention can realize the boundary condition of the bidirectional bending, reduce the deviation of the boundary condition in the test and the actual structure, and more accurately research the relevant problems of the crashworthiness and the like of the bidirectional bending component under the action of the impact load.

title_en: Tunnel multi-catastrophe comprehensive simulation test system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tunnel multi-catastrophe comprehensive simulation test system, which comprises a comprehensive control unit, a high ground stress simulation unit, a high ground thermal simulation unit, a high humidity simulation unit, a water inrush simulation unit, an earthquake disaster simulation unit and a test unit; the method realizes the accelerated test evaluation of the long-term service reliability and safety of the tunnel engineering in a laboratory, realizes the damage prediction and emergency preparation of multiple disaster factors, and has the characteristics of full coverage of the disaster factors, multiple combined working conditions, wide research application and the like.
assignees: GENERAL ENG RES INST CHINA ACAD ENG PHYSICS

title_en: Demonstration platform for multifunctional mountain disaster demonstration instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a demonstration platform for multi-functional mountain calamity demonstration appearance, the power distribution box comprises a box body, fixed mounting has the baffle between the inner wall of box, the baffle separates the box from a left side to the right side in proper order and collects room and stock solution room, be provided with filtering mechanism on the baffle, install the mounting panel through angle adjustment mechanism on baffle and the box downside inner wall, there is the rectangle frame mounting panel upper surface through the spring mounting, fixed surface installs vibrating motor under the rectangle frame, be provided with the imitation soil layer in the rectangle frame, the last fixed surface of box installs the mounting bracket, be provided with on the mounting bracket and spray the mechanism, it is linked together through extraction mechanism and stock solution room to spray the mechanism. The utility model discloses can carry out the image visual simulation mountain region calamity of multi-angle, multiple form, simple structure, manufacturing cost is lower, can carry out recycle with the water source to the earth that uses in the simulation simultaneously, and use cost is lower.
assignees: HUBEI GEOLOGICAL SURVEY FOUND ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an early warning device technical field especially relates to a geological disaster early warning device, including the equipment bottom plate, dismounting device and upper cover plate, the top through connection of equipment bottom plate has dismounting device, dismounting device is including the threaded rod, the drill bit, the connecting rod, the commentaries on classics board, handle and anti-skidding top support, the top threaded connection of equipment bottom plate has the threaded rod, and the threaded rod runs through in the inside of equipment bottom plate, the bottom middle part fixedly connected with drill bit of threaded rod, the appearance profile of drill bit is the coniform, the top middle part fixedly connected with connecting rod of threaded rod, do not need the reuse to widely stimulate early warning device and take out from soil, not light labour saving and time saving still can not damage early.

title_en: Tailings pond dam break mud evolution simulation method based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing and three-dimensional SPH
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam break mud evolution simulation method of a tailing pond based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing and three-dimensional SPH, belonging to the technical field of mine geotechnical engineering and comprising the steps of delineating an area to be researched of the tailing pond and obtaining a planning scheme of the tailing pond; determining the research range of the evolution of dam-break slurry of the tailing pond; planning an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial survey line; processing the aerial survey data of the unmanned aerial vehicle by using a photogrammetric motion recovery structure algorithm, and reconstructing to obtain a high-resolution ortho-image and topographic data of a digital surface model; exporting topographic data, determining a breach form and establishing a three-dimensional geometric model; testing dam break mud rheological parameters; establishing a dam break mud evolution three-dimensional model based on an SPH algorithm; and compiling the SPH calculation program to realize the parallel operation of the CPU/GPU on the high-performance calculation cluster. The method provides scientific basis for the risk assessment of the dam break disaster of the tailing pond, overcomes the defects of a laboratory simulation method and a traditional grid method, and realizes the quantification and visualization of the risk assessment of the dam break disaster of the tailing pond.

title_en: Method for early warning energy dissipation state and trend of microseism monitoring/acoustic emission fracture source
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for early warning energy dissipation state and trend of a microseismic monitoring/acoustic emission fracture source. The method utilizes the detected parameter information of the mass microseismic monitoring/acoustic emission events to preliminarily judge the macroscopic damage area and the damage degree; then, performing mathematical inversion analysis and interpolation operation on the important damage area and the energy field in the whole research range according to the micro-fracture source event energy dissipation value; and finally, forecasting and early warning the disaster grade of the damaged area according to the energy value and the grading condition of the energy value. The method is utilized to simulate and obtain the fracture form and the severity of the rock mass/stone, obtain the distribution condition of energy of each point in the range of the research object according to the set precision, effectively predict the damage and instability condition of the rock mass/stone through the simulation condition of the energy dissipation field of the micro-fracture source, and provide a new method which is accurate, reliable and visual for researching the energy dissipation condition of the fracture process of the rock mass/stone.

title_en: Oil gas major infrastructure multi-disaster accident coupling three-dimensional simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster accident coupling three-dimensional simulation system for major oil and gas infrastructure, which comprises an accident three-dimensional simulation module, an accident chain evolution prediction module, a model unit and a database module. The accident three-dimensional simulation module and the accident chain evolution prediction module are respectively connected with the model unit and the database module through signals; and the accident three-dimensional simulation module is in signal connection with the accident chain evolution prediction module. On the basis of the existing Natech accident analysis method, a Natech accident multi-disaster coupling link of a major infrastructure for oil and gas storage and transportation is considered, and all potential accident links are identified; in daily management, the probability and the accident consequence of accidents of each unit under the coupling of multiple kinds of disasters are analyzed, and a basis is provided for the reasonable arrangement of safety protection facilities and emergency evacuation drilling; in the emergency rescue stage after the accident occurs, the most probable propagation path and evolution time of the accident under the coupling of multiple kinds of disasters are analyzed, and decision support is provided for the development of emergency rescue actions.

title_en: Training apparatus for practical evaluation of fire alarm equipment
title_ko: 소방경보설비 실무평가 실습장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting alarm equipment practical evaluation practice device which enables evaluation and practice for practitioners in the field of firefighting alarm equipment. The firefighting alarm equipment practical evaluation practice device according to the present invention is a firefighting alarm equipment practical evaluation practice device for performing practical evaluation and practice of fire alarm facilities. A heat sensor (1), a smoke sensor (2), and a transmitter (7) are installed on an equipment board of fire alarm equipment. A plurality of wires connected to one end of the heat sensor (1) and the smoke sensor (2) are respectively connected to tongs (11), and the other end thereof is connected to the transmitter (7). The tongs (11) are detachably coupled to a terminal block (12) on which a plurality of terminals are formed. The terminal block (12) is connected to the heat sensor (1) and the smoke sensor (2). When the tongs (11) are connected to the terminal block (12), the heat sensor (1) and the smoke sensor (2) form a closed loop and are normally driven. When one or more of the tongs (11) are separated from the terminal block (12), the heat sensor (1) and the smoke sensor (2) do not operate normally.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방경보설비 분야의 실무자에 대한 평가 및 실습을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 소방경보설비 실무평가 실습장치에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 소방경보설비 실무평가 실습장치는 소방경보설비의 실무평가 및 실습을 수행하기 위한 소방경보설비 실무평가 실습장치로서, 상기 소방경보설비의 설비보드에는 열감지기(1)와 연기감지기(2) 및 발신기(7)가 설치되고, 상기 열감지기(1)와 연기감지기(2)의 일단에 연결된 복수의 전선이 각각 집게(11)와 연결되고, 타단은 발신기(7)에 연결되며, 상기 집게(11)는 복수의 단자가 형성된 단자대(12)와 착탈가능하게 결합되되,  상기 단자대(12)는 열감지기(1) 및 연기감지기(2)에 연결되어, 집게(11)가 단자대(12)에 연결되는 경우 열감지기(1) 및 연기감지기(2)가 폐루프를 형성하여 정상적으로 구동되고, 집게(11)가 단자대(12)로부터 하나 이상 분리되어 있는 경우 열감지기(1) 및 연기감지기(2)는 정상적으로 구동되지 않도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Pure water preparation system of multi-scene application
abstract_en: A pure water preparation system with multi-scene application belongs to a water treatment system. The device comprises a water inlet unit, a pretreatment unit, an ultrafiltration unit, a reverse osmosis unit, a water supply unit and a cleaning unit. A plurality of water production modules are adopted to adapt to different use scenes. According to different water sources, different water production modules are adopted for preparing the pure water, the basic water quality index of the produced water meets the regulation of the sanitary standard of drinking water, and the water is suitable for groups of field work, army training, emergency rescue and disaster relief.
assignees: CHINA SHIPBUILDING IND GROUP ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting on-the-fly disaster damage based on image
title_ko: 피해 감지 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method of detecting disaster damage includes the steps of: shuffling sample data included in a first sample data set; generating subsets of the first sample data set; and constructing a training data set comprising subsets of the first sample data set and a second sample data set. The present invention provides the method for the detecting disaster damage based on an image.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 피해 감지 방법은, 제 1 샘플 데이터 세트에 포함된 샘플 데이터들을 셔플(shuffle)하는 단계, 상기 제 1 샘플 데이터 세트의 서브세트들을 생성하는 단계, 및 상기 제 1 샘플 데이터 세트의 서브세트들 및 제 2 샘플 데이터 세트를 포함하는 학습 데이터 세트를 구성하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Superhigh speed data generation engine for evaluuating seismic performance, and method for the same
title_ko: 건축물 내진성능 평가를 위한 초고속 데이터생성 엔진 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Provided are an ultrahigh-speed data creation engine for evaluating the seismic performance of a building and a method thereof. Since a data creation engine of a building using machine learning deep-learning is embodied, a database related with the seismic safety of the building for a preparatory response to a potential disaster such as an earthquake or the like is created at an ultrahigh speed to minimize disaster damage to the existing building, and instantly evaluate and handle the condition of the building after the occurrence of the disaster. Moreover, since a hybrid model, in which a nonlinear nonelastic structure information creation model and a dynamic response creation model are combined, is embodied, big data about various disaster scenarios for a building, which cannot secure seismic performance and its relevant data, can be created and the seismic performance of the building can be evaluated fast without separate computer analysis. Moreover, since the engine is easily utilized when a database related with the structural safety of a building is not secured, the engine can be utilized as a data creation engine of a building safety-related pre-management system for minimizing the extent of damage before the occurrence of a disaster, and the engine can also be utilized as a data creation engine for an immediate response system after the occurrence of the disaster.
abstract_ko: 기계학습 딥러닝을 이용한 건축물의 데이터생성 엔진을 구현함으로써, 잠재적으로 발생 가능한 지진 등의 재난에 대한 사전 대응을 위해 건축물의 지진안전과 관련된 데이터베이스를 초고속으로 생성하여 기존 건축물에 대한 재난 피해를 최소화하고, 재난 발생 이후 건축물의 상태를 즉시 평가 및 대응할 수 있고, 또한, 비선형 비탄성 구조정보 생성모델과 동적응답 생성모델을 결합한 하이브리드 모델을 구현함으로써, 내진성능과 관련 데이터가 미확보된 건축물에 대한 다양한 재난시나리오에 대한 빅데이터를 생성하고 별도의 컴퓨터 해석 없이 빠른 속도로 건축물의 내진성능을 평가할 수 있고, 또한, 건축물의 구조안전과 관련된 데이터베이스가 미확보된 경우에 용이하게 활용함으로써, 재난 발생 이전 피해규모 최소화를 위한 건축물 안전관련 사전관리 시스템의 데이터생성 엔진으로 활용할 수 있고, 재난 발생 이후 즉시대응 시스템을 위한 데이터생성 엔진으로도 활용할 수 있는, 건축물 내진성능 평가를 위한 초고속 데이터생성 엔진 및 그 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Method to provide disaster information by Region
title_ko: 지역별 재난정보 표출방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a regional disaster information displaying method.
