The regional disaster information displaying method comprises: an upload process; a management process of providing information to others who are set to be shared in a smart disaster situation management system; a mapping process in which user registration information is displayed by a region on a map together with numerical values and legends; and a simulation expression process that can confirm that a screen is changed according as a progress bar is moved through a simulation function. Therefore, the regional disaster information displaying method enables rapid response to disasters.

title_en: Underground danger-avoiding chamber inspection robot based on brain wave control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot is patrolled and examined to danger chamber in pit based on brain wave control, including automobile body, setting at the anticollision institution of automobile body week side, setting environmental detection sensor group, the setting in the motor explosion-proof box of automobile body on the automobile body, setting be in driving motor module and the control module in the motor explosion-proof box, be used for with the handheld terminal of control module communication and with the EEG signal acquisition device of handheld terminal communication. The utility model discloses a set up EEG signal acquisition device and control patrolling and examining the robot through the brain wave, make the method of controlling of patrolling and examining the robot simpler, reduce the cost of manual training, simultaneously through setting early warning mechanism with buffer gear realizes the duplicate protection to the automobile body, prevents that the person of controlling from controlling the improper harm that causes patrolling and examining the robot, can make and patrol and examine the robot and safely move under the complex environment that mine disaster took place in the pit to the life of robot is patrolled and examined in the extension, personnel's work load is reduced.
assignees: SHAANXI SHAANMEI CAOJIATAN MINING CO LTD;UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Simulation apparatus and method for fire evacuation based on virtual reality
title_ko: 가상현실 기반의 화재 대피 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulation apparatus and method for fire evacuation based on virtual reality. The simulation apparatus for fire evacuation based on virtual reality includes a data collection part for collecting data related to the creation of a fire evacuation scenario including building information and requester (experienced person) information; a scenario creation part for creating a fire and evacuation scenario based on the collected data; and a fire evacuation simulation part for executing a fire evacuation simulation according to the created scenario to provide a virtual reality image in which a fire occurs in a building and the person (experienced person) evacuates. In case of the fire, the evacuation safety can be improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실 기반의 화재 대피 시뮬레이션 기술에 관한 것으로, 가상현실 기반의 화재 대피 시뮬레이션 장치는 건물 정보, 요구조자(체험자) 정보를 포함하는 화재 대피 시나리오 작성과 관련되는 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부, 상기 수집된 데이터에 기초하여 화재 및 대피 시나리오를 작성하는 시나리오 작성부, 및 상기 작성된 시나리오에 따라 화재 대피 시뮬레이션을 실행하여 건물에서 화재가 발생하고 요구조자(체험자)가 대피하는 가상현실 영상을 제공하는 화재 대피 시뮬레이션부를 포함한다.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster power supply recovery method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for recovering power supply of a power distribution network after a disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current state information of a power distribution network system; and acquiring an optimal control strategy of the power distribution network according to the current state information of the power distribution network system and the trained power supply model, wherein the trained power supply model is obtained by training the power supply model through a training sample and a training label. The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for recovering power supply of a power distribution network after a disaster, aiming at uncertainty in a micro-grid system, a power supply model is trained, so that the power supply model can fully learn a plurality of uncertain factors in the micro-grid during training, and the robustness of the method is improved; and by utilizing the trained power supply model, the power supply model does not need to be solved again in different scenes, so that the recovery capability of the power distribution network and the load power supply duration are improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle deployment method for adaptively optimizing network coverage of urban disaster area
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment method for adaptively optimizing network coverage of urban disaster areas, which comprises the following steps: step 1, simulating urban disaster area scenes and constructing a state set of ground mobile user nodes; step 2, recording the position information of the ground mobile user node at each moment obtained in the step 1; and step 3, calculating the optimal coverage of the unmanned aerial vehicle network in the urban disaster area according to the position information of the ground mobile user node at each moment in the step 2, and obtaining an optimal coverage strategy. The method provides emergency network communication for the mobile user nodes in the key areas of the urban disaster area, in the unmanned aerial vehicle network coverage scene of the urban disaster area, the probability of being covered by the unmanned aerial vehicle network is jointly determined by unmanned aerial vehicle clusters for the urban area to be covered, the aim of maximizing the weighted coverage rate of the mobile user nodes in the key areas of the urban area is achieved on the premise of ensuring network connectivity by optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle deployment, and the adaptive coverage algorithm for improving the weighted coverage rate of the unmanned aerial vehicle network and ensuring network connectivity is achieved.

title_en: Soil pressure monitoring station and ground disaster detection early warning system
abstract_en: The application relates to a soil pressure monitoring station and a ground disaster detection early warning system, which comprises a vehicle body, wherein a plurality of moving wheels are arranged on two sides of the vehicle body, and a plurality of positioning pieces for positioning the vehicle body are arranged on the vehicle body; the vehicle body is also provided with a drilling assembly for drilling a hole on the foundation and a detection assembly for burying in the foundation; and the vehicle body is provided with a processor which is electrically connected with the detection assembly and used for outputting detection data generated by the detection assembly. Use the drilling subassembly to beat the hole, then bury the determine module underground in the hole, monitor soil pressure to output test data, because drilling subassembly and determine module all are located the automobile body, consequently when the monitoring position is changed to needs, direct removal automobile body can, convenient and fast. This application has the effect that helps shortening soil pressure monitoring station construction period.
assignees: HUNAN PROVINCE URBAN AND RURAL CONSTRUCTION SURVEY INST

title_en: Hydraulic tunnel excavation supporting structure and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic tunnel excavation supporting structure which comprises a large pipe shed, wherein drilling anchoring piles are arranged on one high side of the tunnel terrain along the extending direction of the tunnel, the drilling anchoring piles are arranged on two sides of a tunnel opening of the tunnel, two ends of an arched guide wall are arranged on the drilling anchoring piles on two sides of the tunnel opening of the tunnel, a plurality of guide steel pipes are arranged on the guide wall, steel flower pipes penetrate through the guide steel pipes and are arranged outside a tunnel excavation contour line, a small guide pipe is anchored at the top of the tunnel arch, a set external insertion angle is formed between the advancing direction of the small guide pipe towards the tunnel and the axis of the tunnel, and the exposed end of the small guide pipe is supported on a steel arch frame. The invention also discloses a construction method of the hydraulic tunnel excavation supporting structure, the tunnel section with poor geological conditions is not required to be excavated greatly, the damage to the natural environment due to open excavation construction is reduced, the problem of transverse collapse caused by the bias of lateral mountain bodies of the tunnel during tunnel excavation is solved, the occurrence of artificial geological disasters is avoided, and other construction operations in the tunnel construction area and the production life of people are not influenced.

title_en: System and method for collecting fire evacuation behavior data of stadium based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gymnasium fire evacuation behavior data collection system based on virtual reality and a collection method thereof. The invention relates to the technical field of building safety and evacuation simulation, which is characterized in that a virtual gymnasium three-dimensional building model is built, and a fire smoke visual scene is simulated in the gymnasium model; acquiring behavior data of experimenters during movement during fire simulation through a behavior data acquisition module, and performing subjective evaluation on movement intensity by using a subjective physical strength scale RPE after the simulation is finished; analyzing the collected behavior data to determine the motion behaviors under different evacuation postures; matching basic information of experimenters, human body posture data, human body motion parameters, fatigue evaluation grade and RPE evaluation data, numbering the data in groups, wherein the numbering also comprises experiment date and experiment sequence, and sealing the data.

title_en: Earthquake experience room for earthquake disaster avoidance learning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an earthquake knowledge technical field just discloses a room is experienced with earthquake to earthquake disaster-avoiding study, experience the room including the earthquake, the bottom movable mounting that the room was experienced to the earthquake has motion platform, motion platform's bottom fixed mounting has the backing plate, the right side fixed mounting of backing plate has the step seat, the top fixed mounting of step seat has the handrail, the inboard of room is experienced and the left side movable mounting who is located the handrail has the door to the earthquake, the sofa has been placed to the left side of door and the inside that is located the room is experienced to the earthquake, the back of sofa is placed and is installed the TV cabinet. This earthquake is kept away disaster and is learned and experience room with earthquake through setting up sofa, TV cabinet, TV, dining table, dining chair, cupboard and kitchen, when the simulation earthquake, can see the removal that furniture put receives earthquake influence to take place for experience person can be cut into the situation that shows in the residence when experiencing the earthquake, thereby reaches the purpose of the situation that shows in the residence when cutting into the body and experiencing the earthquake takes place.
assignees: TAIZHOU PUYUAN VISUAL SIMULATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for quickly detecting and checking wind-water fire hazard points
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring of forestry disasters, and discloses a method and a system for quickly detecting and checking fire hazard points in wind and water areas. Selecting a representative region of the distribution of the wind-water potential hazard points as a test region; collecting ground data and remote sensing data based on the selected test area; constructing a sample data set of a training model by using the collected ground data and the remote sensing data; training and verifying the training model by combining the selected network framework based on the established sample data set of the training model; replacing the test area, and further testing the generalization ability and the applicability of the training model; and collecting high-resolution remote sensing data of other areas, and constructing a wind-water fire hazard point database. The intelligent detection method provided by the invention is simple and universal, has strong transportability, and can provide theoretical reference and scientific basis for automatic positioning and timely early warning of large-area wind-water fire hazard points.
assignees: HUNAN SANXIANGLVGU ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH FORESTRY & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Comprehensive prevention and control system and method for rock burst and gas of coal face
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive control system and a comprehensive control method for rock burst and gas of a coal face, and relates to the technical field of coal mining. The coal face rock burst and gas comprehensive prevention and control system comprises a gas extraction subsystem and a gas blasting subsystem, wherein the gas extraction subsystem comprises a high negative pressure extraction main pipe; the gas blasting subsystem comprises an ignition device, a first communication pipe, a gas conveying pipe, an exhaust pipe and a directional long drill hole arranged in a top plate of the coal face, wherein the directional long drill hole is communicated with the return air roadway and is blocked by a first plug; the first communication pipe is communicated between the directional long drill holes of the high negative pressure extraction main pipe; the ignition end of the ignition device extends into the directional long drill hole; the first end of the gas pipe extends into the directional long drill hole, and the second end of the gas pipe is communicated with the external environment; the first end of the exhaust pipe extends into the directional long drilled hole, and the second end of the exhaust pipe is communicated with the return air roadway. The comprehensive control system for rock burst and gas on the coal face can achieve a good control effect on rock burst and gas disasters.
assignees: HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source gas efficient pre-extraction rapid outburst elimination method in middle-layer residual coal re-mining tunneling process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source gas efficient pre-extraction rapid outburst elimination method in a middle-layer residual coal re-mining tunneling process, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing bedding drill holes and advanced drill holes to extract coal seam gas, and then constructing cross-layer drill holes to extract old goaf gas; the method comprises the steps of firstly determining the maximum dangerousness of an upper layer old goaf, a lower layer old goaf and three gas sources of a coal seam, reasonably extracting, then beginning tunneling a middle remaining coal seam roadway, after tunneling for a certain distance, measuring the gas pressure of the upper layer old goaf, the lower layer old goaf and the middle layer remaining coal, determining the maximum dangerous gas disaster source, then extracting gas, and then circulating the maximum dangerousness determination of the three gas sources, gas extraction and re-tunneling of the roadway until the tunneling of the whole coal seam roadway is completed.

title_en: Accident case scene reproduction method based on three-dimensional webgis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accident case scene reproduction method based on three-dimensional webgis, which comprises the following steps: constructing a 3D map visualization framework; the browser runs the three-dimensional digital earth; deploying geographic information resource service; creating an accident case data table and an accident case node table; dynamically and visually editing the accident case by the Web map; dynamic streaming data presentation with time as axis. According to the accident emergency rescue handling method, the scene picture is marked on the three-dimensional satellite map and stored in a warehouse by the accident case, and finally the scene picture is restored according to the accident case node time sequence, so that the accident emergency rescue handling process of accident occurrence, handling and emergency response ending is realized, and support is provided for accident analysis and summary; meanwhile, an emergency drilling script can be input, and the training work of an emergency rescue team is facilitated.

title_en: Distributed database system and data disaster recovery drilling method
abstract_en: The application discloses a distributed database and a data disaster recovery drilling method, wherein the distributed database comprises a local management node, a local database cluster, a remote management node, a remote drilling database cluster and a remote synchronous database cluster; the local database cluster and the allopatric synchronous database cluster are connected with the local management node; the allopatric drill database cluster is used for: establishing a first connection with the remote management node; and receiving the test service sent by the service layer. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the application can be applied to all multi-place and multi-center environments, the operation capacity and the service processing capacity of the remote computer room in the simulated disaster recovery environment can be tested, and the purpose of data disaster recovery simulation drilling is achieved.

title_en: Terminal device and method for estimating firefighting data
abstract_en: A method for estimating firefighting data includes: obtaining firefighting condition data of a site, wherein the firefighting condition data comprises information on firefighting equipment, information on flammable articles; and estimating firefighting input data and firefighting damage data based on the firefighting condition data using a simulation analysis model, wherein the simulation analysis model is created based on firefighting condition data, firefighting input data and firefighting damage data of different sites.
assignees: FULIAN PREC ELECTRONICS TIANJIN CO LTD

title_en: Space-time twin visualization construction method and system
abstract_en: A space-time twin visualization construction method and a system thereof, wherein the system comprises an operation situation monitoring unit, a multi-space data analysis unit, a multidimensional model construction unit, a visualization reporting unit, an emergency command scheduling unit and a central server. According to the invention, an operation situation monitoring unit, a multi-time space data analysis unit, a multi-dimensional model construction unit and a visual reporting unit are arranged to carry out digital twinning technology and visual construction service operation on corresponding service elements; the digital twin system combines blockchain, artificial intelligence, internet of things, big data, three-dimensional visualization and virtual simulation technologies to comprehensively realize digitization for the development of service elements, reduce the waste of manpower, material resources and money, and create new revenue sources so as to bring great advantages to enterprises; the emergency command scheduling unit is utilized to perform key monitoring on the service elements, and an alarm module is arranged, so that the emergency response efficiency is improved, and the high-efficiency and stable operation of the service elements is ensured.

title_en: Method for calculating residual bearing capacity of T-shaped superposed beam after fire
abstract_en: A method for calculating residual bearing capacity of a T-shaped superposed beam after a fire disaster relates to the technical field of disaster risk assessment, and comprises the following steps of constructing a superposed beam test piece with a T-shaped cross section based on Abaqus finite element analysis software; secondly, performing numerical simulation on the basis of the superposed beam test piece; and step three, obtaining a simplified calculation formula of the residual bearing capacity of the superposed beam after the fire according to the convergence criterion. The invention provides a method for calculating residual bearing capacity of a T-shaped superposed beam after fire, which is based on a method for calculating residual bearing capacity of the superposed beam after fire under the action of thermal coupling and comprehensively considers the temperature, cracks and superposed surface parameters gamma h And the adopted three-dimensional connecting spring considers the bonding slippage of the superposed surface from three directions, and the spring stiffness setting adopts the constitutive relation at high temperature, so that the superposed surface slippage state in the engineering practice is more met, the calculation precision can be effectively improved, and the calculation result has higher reference value.

title_en: Method for improving lump coal rate of coal mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the lump coal rate of coal mining, which comprises the steps of drilling a plurality of drill holes on the working face of a pre-opened coal body, cutting the pre-opened coal body to form a plurality of pre-cracks communicated with the drill holes, wherein the pre-cracks are communicated with one another; and sealing the drill hole close to the pre-crack by using a hole packer, injecting high-pressure water through a central hole of the hole packer, fracturing and releasing the pre-cracked coal body, and pre-cracking the pre-cracked coal body into a blocky coal body. The embodiment of the invention utilizes an orthogonal directional slotting fracturing method, mainly utilizes a drilling machine to drill holes in a pre-mined coal seam to form an orthogonal type fracture zone, and utilizes an effective technical means of hydraulic fracturing by injecting high-pressure water to realize pressure relief and scour prevention on a coal rock mass, thereby not only solving the problem of coal rock dynamic disaster in a working face, but also enabling the pre-mined coal rock mass to be pre-fractured into a blocky structure in advance so as to improve the lump coal rate of a mining working face.

title_en: Gypsum ore deposit monitoring system that sinks
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gypsum mine subsidence monitoring system, which comprises a drilling hole, a monitoring sensor, a demodulation device, a monitoring platform and a buzzer; a plurality of drill holes are independently arranged at each monitoring position of the goaf; the monitoring sensor is arranged in a drill hole; the demodulation equipment is arranged in a safety area; the demodulation equipment is connected with the monitoring sensor and uploads monitoring data to monitoring software of the monitoring platform so as to send out pre-judgment alarm; the buzzer is arranged at the surface position of the monitoring point and connected with the demodulation equipment; the monitoring sensor comprises a fiber grating displacement meter, a fiber grating osmometer, a geological disaster alarm and a geophone; the buzzer sends out a site alarm according to the signal of the geological disaster alarm; the monitoring sensor monitors multiple parameters of the geology of the goaf, the data acquisition is comprehensive, the omnibearing monitoring is realized, meanwhile, the pre-judgment alarm and the field alarm can help operators to quickly make timely measures aiming at dangerous geological conditions.
assignees: THE FIFTH GEOLOGICAL TEAM OF JIANGSU BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL RESOURCES;SUZHOU NANZEE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Triaxial test equipment for measuring eroded soil particles under action of seepage force
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triaxial test device for measuring eroded soil particles under the action of seepage force, which comprises a constant-flow infiltration system, a soil particle migration grading measurement system, a large-range volume pressure control vacuum system and the following components: according to processing analytic system, flow rate infiltration system is connected with soil particle migration hierarchical measurement system and large-scale volume pressure control vacuum system respectively through the pipeline, data processing analytic system includes data acquisition device and computer, flow rate infiltration system, soil particle migration hierarchical measurement system and large-scale volume pressure control vacuum system are connected to data acquisition device through the circuit respectively on, the computer passes through the line connection with data acquisition device. The simulation and dynamic observation of the erosion phenomenon of the soil sample under the action of the specific seepage force are realized, and accurate and effective basic test numbers are provided for the research on the disaster-causing mechanism of the corresponding geological disaster of the erosion phenomenon.

title_en: A cementer for colliery water damage prevention and cure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine water disaster prevention and control, and discloses a grouting device for coal mine water disaster prevention and control, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two sides of the top of the bottom plate are fixedly provided with support columns, the top of each support column is fixedly provided with a top plate, the top of each top plate is fixedly provided with a lifting motor, the top of an output shaft of each lifting motor is fixedly provided with a screw rod, the outer wall of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a nut, the nut is fixedly arranged inside the lifting plate, the lifting motor can drive the lifting plate and a grouting cylinder to descend through the transmission of the screw rod and the nut so that the grouting cylinder goes deep into a ground hole, the driving motor can drive a rotating shaft, a connecting column and a soil loosening auger to rotate through the transmission of a worm gear and a worm, wherein the soil loosening auger can loosen rock-soil bodies below the grouting cylinder, the grouting cylinder can sink conveniently and cannot, has the advantages of convenient drilling into ground pores, uniform grouting and high grouting strength.

title_en: Intelligent disaster operation and maintenance order dispatching method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a method, a device and equipment for disaster intelligent operation and maintenance dispatching, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting alarm data of communication network element equipment; inputting the alarm data into a preset decision tree model to obtain an alarm grade corresponding to the alarm data, wherein the preset decision tree model is obtained by training according to disaster alarm data in a preset historical time period; and sending the alarm work order of the communication network element equipment to a corresponding operation and maintenance terminal according to the alarm grade. The embodiment of the disclosure can automatically carry out operation and maintenance dispatching, does not need to carry out judgment of manual experience, and improves the intellectualization and efficiency of disaster operation and maintenance dispatching.

title_en: Method for extracting gas by directional drilling and hydraulic permeability increasing of coal body in middle of ultra-long working face
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mining. Relates to a method for extracting gas by directional drilling and hydraulic permeability increase of a coal body in the middle of an ultra-long working face, which comprises the following steps: s1, directional long drilling, S2, hydraulic slotting and permeability increasing, S3 and gas extraction. According to the invention, by combining the directional long drilling and hydraulic slotting processes, the hydraulic slotting permeability increase of the coal body in the middle of the ultra-long working face is performed, the air permeability of the coal body in the middle of the ultra-long working face is improved, the permeability increase of the coal layer of the working face is fully covered, the gas of the coal layer of the working face is efficiently pre-pumped, the standard time of the gas pre-pumping of the coal layer of the working face is shortened, the possibility of gas disasters of the ultra-long working face is reduced, and the safety, the high efficiency and the high yield of the ultra-long working face are realized.

title_en: Small-size emergent equipment damages simulation experiment system under calamity effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for simulating and testing a damage mechanism of an emergency resource under the action of a geological disaster, which belongs to the field of safety engineering detection and comprises a test table, a geological disaster simulation system, a man-made climate simulation system, a disaster bearing system and a measurement and control system, wherein the geological disaster simulation system and the disaster bearing system are arranged on the test table, the center line of the man-made climate simulation system is superposed with the center line of a slide way in the geological disaster simulation system and is positioned at the upper part of the slide way, the geological disaster simulation system is connected with the disaster bearing system, and the disaster bearing system is connected with the measurement and control system. The invention overcomes the defect that the performance detection of the emergency resources is incomplete under the actual disaster condition and the multi-disaster coupling condition in the prior art, provides a support for perfecting the performance detection method of the emergency resources, and provides a basic experimental device for researching the damage mechanism of the emergency resources under the actual disaster condition and the multi-disaster coupling condition.

title_en: Emergency crowd evacuation simulation method based on time-space interaction process
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency evacuation simulation method for emergent events and crowds based on a space-time interaction process, which comprises the steps of constructing a space-time interaction mechanism among emergent events, individuals and individuals based on a unified space-time framework; and constructing individual space-time dynamic evacuation behaviors based on space-time interaction mechanism analysis, simulating a crowd evacuation process driven by an emergency by using a social force model, and analyzing evacuation evaluation indexes. The scheme of the invention is simple and convenient to implement, has strong practicability, simulates the crowd evacuation behavior in a complex geographic scene, and the simulation result can provide a reasonable and effective decision reference for emergency evacuation in an emergency; the problem of the practicality that the correlation technique exists is low and practical application is inconvenient is solved, user experience can be improved, avoid great manpower and materials loss, have important market value.

title_en: Multispectral and panchromatic image combined registration and fuzzy kernel estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multispectral and panchromatic image joint registration and fuzzy kernel estimation method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing an image offset learning sub-network and a space and spectrum fuzzy kernel estimation sub-network, and connecting to obtain a multispectral and panchromatic image registration and fuzzy kernel estimation network which can be trained end to end; and constructing a training data set by combining the original panchromatic image and the multispectral image of the remote sensing satellite, and training and optimizing the multispectral image, the panchromatic image registration and the fuzzy kernel estimation network through the training data set to obtain a spatial fuzzy kernel and a spectral fuzzy kernel after training. The invention only utilizes the multispectral image with low spatial resolution and the panchromatic image with high spatial resolution and the spatial spectrum connection thereof which are directly obtained from the satellite, can obtain the registered panchromatic image and the spatial and spectral fuzzy kernel by the unsupervised training and learning, and can be applied to the practical application fields of remote sensing satellite natural disaster monitoring, crop detection, mineral exploration, land resource investigation and the like.

title_en: Flood disaster sensing system and method based on environment simulation and eye movement interaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood disaster sensing system and method based on environment simulation and eye movement interaction, which relate to the technical field of natural disasters and comprise a flood scene simulation module, a flood disaster sensing module and a population individual, wherein the flood scene simulation module is used for constructing and simulating a flood disaster scene and population individuals, and the population individuals comprise avatar individuals and intelligent individual; the visualization and interaction module is used for dynamically loading a flood disaster scene and individual crowds and forming an immersive panoramic effect of the flood disaster scene for a user; the system comprises a user data acquisition module, a data acquisition module and a data acquisition module, wherein the user data acquisition module is used for acquiring eyeball positions, eyeball watching directions and timestamp data of a user, acquiring cognitive data of the user according to the eyeball positions, the eyeball watching directions and the timestamp data, and recording and outputting the cognitive data.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Outdoor emergency response real scene simulation method and system for nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses an off-site emergency response scene simulation method and system for a nuclear power plant, which call a corresponding off-site emergency plan by acquiring an emergency response instruction to be simulated, generate a corresponding four-dimensional off-site emergency scene based on an accident scene identifier to be simulated, execute emergency actions according to the off-site emergency plan in the four-dimensional off-site emergency scene, acquire exercise results, generate a correction plan identifier for the unqualified off-site emergency plan to correct the unqualified off-site emergency plan to form a qualified off-site emergency plan, and prepare a most reliable and effective execution scheme for guiding the evacuation of public and goods and materials when an accident actually occurs.

title_en: Experimental device for simulating and monitoring multi-source all-terrain movement of debris flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to an experimental device for simulating and monitoring multi-source all-terrain movement of debris flow, and belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering experimental devices. The device comprises an animal source supply device, an on-way object source supply device, a multi-degree-of-freedom terrain simulation device, a rainfall simulation device, a debris flow motion monitoring device and the like. The device comprises a material source supply device, a multi-degree-of-freedom terrain simulation device, a rainfall simulation device, a support device and a debris flow motion monitoring device, wherein the material source supply device is used for providing required material sources for experiments, the multi-degree-of-freedom terrain simulation device is used for simulating different terrain conditions, the rainfall simulation device is used for simulating rainfall working conditions, the support device is used for supporting the rainfall simulation device and the hanging monitoring equipment, and the debris flow motion monitoring device is used for. The invention can simulate and research the complete process of debris flow evolution under the conditions of rainfall, source supply, erosion deposition and complex terrain, and record parameters such as substance exchange, flow rate change, flow acceleration and the like through automatic monitoring equipment, thereby realizing the research on the disaster-causing process and predicting the debris flow scale and the hazard range.

title_en: Group evacuation behavior simulation method based on panoramic image modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group evacuation behavior simulation method based on panoramic image modeling, which relates to the technical field of simulation and comprises the following steps: acquiring data in real time by using indoor environment acquisition equipment to acquire indoor panoramic map data of the intelligent building; fusing correction map data by using a BIM building information model of the intelligent building to generate a three-dimensional digital panoramic model; adding all devices of the intelligent building into the panoramic model according to the actual positions; the method comprises the steps that a positioning device is worn on an individual entering the intelligent building, and an individual movement track is obtained; setting individual types and behaviors under the panoramic model based on individual motion tracks, setting a Reward function based on the individual behaviors and the current environment, and then training the individual behavior model by utilizing an A3C reinforcement learning algorithm; when an emergency is simulated under the panoramic model, group evacuation behaviors are simulated by utilizing a plurality of individual behavior models based on individual position data of a real environment to obtain an optimal group evacuation scheme. The invention can improve the safety index of population evacuation.
assignees: SHANDONG NEW GENERATION INFORMATION INDUSTRY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Design method of dosage calculation system under accident condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a design method of a dose calculation system under accident conditions, which can simulate three types of release and atmospheric diffusion: and releasing, burning and exploding by using a common chimney. The calculation system considers the influence of factors such as atmospheric stability, terrain surface roughness, temperature inversion layer, dry deposition, wet deposition and the like on nuclide diffusion, calculates nuclide concentration and ground deposition concentration by using various correction methods based on a Gaussian diffusion model, and calculates air immersion dose, ground irradiation dose, and inhalation dose and total dose of a plurality of age groups at corresponding positions by using dose conversion factors. The invention can provide a series of results for emergency response departments and decision makers quickly and simply to evaluate accidents involving radioactive materials, and can be used for safety analysis of radioactive material handling equipment.

title_en: Target moving device and radar detection system with same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target moving device and a radar detection system with the same, wherein the target moving device comprises a motion simulation component, a first sliding component, a second sliding component and a third sliding component, the motion simulation component is used for simulating the body motion characteristics of disaster victims, the first sliding component is connected with the motion simulation component, the first sliding component is used for driving the motion simulation component to move in a first direction, the second sliding component is connected with the motion simulation component, the second sliding component is used for driving the motion simulation component to move in a second direction, the third sliding component is connected with the motion simulation component, the third sliding assembly is used for driving the motion simulation assembly to move in a third direction, and the first direction, the second direction and the third direction are orthogonal in pairs. The target moving device has the advantages of wide moving range and high testing precision.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Disaster response device and system thereof
title_ko: 재난 대응 관제 장치 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster response control device and a system thereof. According to one embodiment, the disaster response device includes: a communication unit which receives an environmental signal sensed by at least one sensor installed at each site in a remote location; and a control unit which recognizes that a disaster has occurred based on the property of the changed sensing value when the received environmental signal is changed from a first value to a second value exceeding a threshold value, and generates a disaster evacuation scenario map.
abstract_ko: 재난 대응 관제 장치 및 시스템이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따르면, 재난 대응장치는, 원격지의 각 현장에 설치되는 적어도 하나 이상의 센서에서 센싱되는 환경 신호를 수신하는 통신부 및 상기 수신된 환경 신호가 제1 값에서 임계치를 초과하는 제2 값으로 변경되는 경우, 상기 변경된 센싱 값의 속성을 기초로 재난 상황이 발생한 것으로 인식하고, 재난 대피 시나리오맵을 생성하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for training
title_ko: 훈련 장치 및 훈련 방법
abstract_en: A training device is provided. The training device may include: an acquisition unit configured to acquire an actual real-time image captured by an actual robot; and a simulation unit for generating a disaster environment in which virtual disaster information is added to the real-time image. It is possible to provide a robot control environment similar to a real disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 훈련 장치가 제공된다. 상기 훈련 장치는 실제의 로봇이 촬영한 실제의 실시간 영상을 획득하는 획득 유니트; 상기 실시간 영상에 가상의 재난 정보가 추가된 재난 환경을 생성하는 모의 유니트;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Trainee training and evaluating system for disaster response rovot in live-virtual-constructive environment
title_ko: Lvc 환경의 재난 대응 로봇에 대한 훈련생 훈련 및 평가 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a trainee training and evaluation system for a disaster response robot in an LVC environment, which can evaluate ability to operate and control a disaster response robot from various angles. According to the present invention, the trainee training and evaluation system comprises: a disaster site map storage module; a disaster response mission module; a constructive event module; an operation module; a trainee training and evaluation module operated in a training mode or an evaluation mode according to an authentication signal transmitted from the operation module; and a display module.
abstract_ko:
LVC 환경의 재난 대응 로봇에 대한 훈련생 훈련 및 평가 시스템가 개시되어 있다. 본 발명은, 재난 대응 로봇의 훈련생 테스트를 위한 재난 현장 가상 맵이 저장된 재난 현장 맵 저장 모듈; 재난 대응 임무(disaster response mission)가 저장된 재난 대응 임무 모듈; 재난 환경을 모사하는 재난 환경 정보로 구성되는 컨스트럭티브 이벤트(constructive event)가 저장된 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 모듈; 상기 재난 대응 임무 모듈로부터 전달된 재난 대응 임무를 수행하기 위한 라이브(live) 테스트 공간 상의 재난 대응 로봇에 대한 명령을 훈련생으로부터 실시간으로 입력받고, 사용자 인증버튼에 의해 훈련생 또는 평가자 인증 신호를 전달하며, 훈련생으로부터 입력받은 명령을 상기 재난 대응 로봇으로 송신하는 조작 모듈; 상기 조작 모듈로부터 전달된 인증신호에 의해 훈련모드 또는 평가 모드로 동작되는 훈련생 훈련 및 평가 모듈; 상기 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 모듈에서 전달된 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 정보 및 훈련생의 명령에 따른 재난 대응 로봇의 재난 대응 임무 수행 정보를 표시하는 디스플레이 모듈;을 포함하고, 
상기 훈련생 훈련 및 평가모듈이 훈련모드로 동작될 경우에, 평가자 인증 신호를 제공하는 상기 조작 모듈로부터 상기 재난 대응 로봇에 대한 평가자용 조작정보를, 훈련생 인증신호를 제공하는 상기 조작 모듈로 제공하며, 상기 훈련생 훈련 및 평가모듈이 평가모드로 동작될 경우에, 상기 훈련생 인증신호를 제공하는 상기 조작 모듈로부터 상기 재난 대응 로봇에 대한 상기 훈련생의 조작정보를, 상기 평가자 인증신호를 제공하는 조작 모듈로 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Trainee testing and evaluating apparatus for disaster response rovot in live-virtual-constructive environment
title_ko: Lvc 환경의 재난 대응 로봇에 대한 훈련생 테스트 및 평가 장치
abstract_en: A trainee test and evaluation device for a disaster response robot in an LVC environment is disclosed. The device of the present invention includes: a disaster site map storage module; a disaster response mission module; a constructive event module; a command input module; a trainee evaluation module; and a display module. Disaster response mission performance information is disaster response mission performance information of the disaster response robot according to a command received from the trainee in real time. The information is configured to be affected by a live disaster environment on the live test space or to be affected by a constructive event.
abstract_ko:
LVC 환경의 재난 대응 로봇에 대한 훈련생 테스트 및 평가 장치가 개시되어 있다. 본 발명은, 재난 대응 로봇의 훈련생 테스트를 위한 재난 현장 가상 맵이 저장된 재난 현장 맵 저장 모듈; 재난 대응 임무(disaster response mission)가 저장된 재난 대응 임무 모듈; 재난 환경을 모사하는 재난 환경 정보로 구성되는 컨스트럭티브 이벤트(constructive event)가 저장된 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 모듈; 상기 재난 대응 임무 모듈로부터 전달된 재난 대응 임무를 수행하기 위한 라이브(live) 테스트 공간 상의 재난 대응 로봇에 대한 명령을 훈련생으로부터 실시간으로 입력받고, 입력받은 명령을 상기 재난 대응 로봇으로 송신하는 명령 입력 모듈; 상기 명령 입력 모듈을 통해서 상기 훈련생으로부터 실시간으로 입력받은 명령정보 및 상기 명령에 따른 재난 대응 로봇으로부터 수신된 재난 대응 임무 수행 정보를 이용하여 상기 훈련생의 재난 대응 능력을 평가하는 훈련생 평가 모듈; 및 상기 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 모듈에서 전달된 컨스트럭티브 이벤트 정보 및 훈련생의 명령에 따른 재난 대응 로봇의 재난 대응 임무 수행 정보를 표시하고, 상기 재난 대응 로봇이 재난 대응 임무 수행을 완료한 이후, 상기 훈련생 평가 모듈로부터 훈련생의 재난 대응 능력 평가 정보를 전달 받아 표시하는 디스플레이 모듈;을 포함하고, 
상기 재난 대응 임무 수행 정보는, 상기 훈련생으로부터 실시간으로 입력받은 명령에 따른 재난 대응 로봇의 재난 대응 임무 수행 정보로서, 상기 라이브 테스트 공간 상의 라이브(live) 재난 환경에 의해 영향받거나 또는 컨스트럭티브 이벤트(constructive event)에 의해 영향을 받도록 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Remote sensing image small target detection method based on context and cascade structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image small target detection method based on context and a cascade structure, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring a training sample and a test sample; 2) Constructing a remote sensing image small target detection network model; 3) Training a remote sensing image small target detection network model; 4) And acquiring a detection result of the remote sensing image small target. According to the invention, the context module frame is introduced, so that the target area is used for context sensing capability, the problem of difficult small target positioning is effectively solved, the quality of the prediction boundary frame is improved through the cascade structure, higher detection precision is realized, and the method can be used in the fields of resource exploration, natural disaster early warning, city planning, unmanned aerial vehicle target identification and the like.

title_en: Combined prevention and control method for multiple disasters before coal mining on high-gas low-lying island working face
abstract_en: A combined prevention and control method for multiple disasters before mining of a coal seam on a high-gas low-lying island working surface belongs to the technical field of gas control. Digging a drainage roadway in the middle of the coal seam as a multi-disaster prevention and control measure centralized ground, and drilling drainage holes in the water accumulation areas of goafs at two sides to enable the water drainage to reach the standard; meanwhile, pre-gas extraction drill holes before tunneling, the coal seam gas pre-extraction drill holes and the coal seam bedding gas pre-extraction drill holes of the coal seam are respectively constructed at the end of the drainage roadway, the drill sites on two sides and the coal walls on two sides to extract the coal seam gas to reach the standard; and then, the heading and the air return roadway are accelerated, finally, a retreat sectional type filling method is adopted in the drainage roadway, a filling closed wall is built, the drainage roadway is filled by a filling pump, the risks of spontaneous ignition and rock burst are reduced, the disaster prevention and control measures can be centralized and simplified, the coal seam mining period is accelerated while the disaster prevention and control cost is reduced, the economic benefit of the coal mine is greatly improved, and the method has great significance for the safe mining of the coal seam on the working face of the high-gas low-lying island.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;SHAANXI SHAN COAL TONGCHUAN MINING IND CO LTD CHENJIASHAN COAL MINE;JIANGSU TUOHAI COAL MINE DRILLING MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: Simulation experiment device and method for inducing submarine landslide through natural gas hydrate decomposition
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation experiment device and a simulation experiment method for inducing submarine landslide by decomposing natural gas hydrate, relates to the technical field of marine geological disasters and natural gas hydrate exploitation, and realizes dynamic observation of a submarine landslide process. The device comprises a model box body, an air injection system, a landslide system, an observation system and a data acquisition and analysis system, wherein the model box body provides a test platform and is convenient to observe; the data acquisition and analysis system collects monitoring information of the pressure sensor and the high-speed camera. The simulation test device can observe the dynamic process of the hydrate induced submarine landslide, and has the advantages of simple operation, low cost and the like.

title_en: Rainfall type landslide early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rainfall type landslide early warning method and system. And under each early precipitation magnitude, determining a mapping relation between instability probability and rainfall parameters by carrying out numerical simulation on the rainfall infiltration process of the research area, and drawing an I-D threshold early warning curve corresponding to each slope unit under the early precipitation magnitude according to the mapping relation, so that the I-D threshold early warning curve is established without depending on detailed field landslide observation data of the research area, and the method can be suitable for landslide early warning of areas lacking landslide observation data. When landslide early warning is carried out, the slope unit which needs to issue early warning information can be directly determined, so that early warning of the slope unit is achieved, the concrete position where landslide is about to occur can be determined, and the requirement of fine landslide early warning results on disaster reduction is met.

title_en: Goaf water inrush and grouting treatment comprehensive test device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive test device and a method for managing water inrush and grouting in a goaf, which relate to the technical field of disaster management of tunnels and underground engineering and comprise a loading mechanism, a grouting mechanism and a monitoring mechanism, wherein the loading mechanism comprises a pressure applying mechanism, a test silo and a loading piston, the test silo is provided with a cover plate which can detachably plug an opening at one end of the test silo, one end of the loading piston faces to an inner cavity of the test silo, and the pressure applying mechanism drives the loading piston to change the relative position with the test silo and/or change the end surface output water pressure of the loading piston positioned in the silo; the sensor of the monitoring mechanism penetrates through the side wall of the test silo to be arranged inside the test silo, and the output end of the grouting mechanism faces the test silo. Similar materials are adopted, the surrounding rock of the goaf under different geological conditions is simulated through the adjusting strength and the thickness of the similar materials, the stress condition of the surrounding rock of the goaf during actual engineering construction is simulated through water pressure and ground stress loading, and accurate demonstration of water inrush of the goaf under different occurrence conditions is achieved.

title_en: Early warning method for micro-seismic monitoring/acoustic emission fracture source time-space distribution state and trend
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for early warning the time-space distribution state and trend of a microseismic monitoring/acoustic emission fracture source. The method utilizes the detected space position and relative release energy parameter of the microseismic monitoring/acoustic emission event to preliminarily judge the macroscopic damage area and the damage degree; then, simulating to obtain the fracture form and the severity of the rock mass or the ore by establishing a fractal theory box dimension data statistical frame model; acquiring the energy level change condition of a space three-dimensional positioning coordinate and an energy value generated by an acoustic emission or microseismic monitoring event, and locking disaster occurrence areas with different danger levels and forecasting and early warning according to the event number gathering situation and the coordinate point position. The method has more advantages than the traditional two-dimensional analysis in space continuity, has higher calculation efficiency than manual statistical calculation, and has excellent practical effect on analyzing the in-vivo microseismic monitoring/acoustic emission fracture source spatial-temporal evolution rule of the rock mass/rock engineering three-dimensional space, particularly the spatial aggregation degree.

title_en: Dron Simulator
title_ko: 드론 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone simulator. Specifically, the present invention relates to the drone simulator for implementing a business model wherein by using a differentiated SW technology instead of focusing on a drone's H/W and providing, in various fields such as industry, sports, education, service, games, and the like, a content for which a user desires (cluster flight, racing, soccer, military simulation, pesticide spraying, disaster environment rescue, and the like), the present invention is capable of satisfying the needs, and sustaining through periodic developments and updates.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 시뮬레이터에 관한 것으로써, 드론의 H/W에 치중하기보다 차별화된 SW기술을 이용하여 산업·스포츠·교육·서비스·게임 등 다양한 분야에 유저가 원하는 콘텐츠(군집비행, 레이싱, 축구, 군 시뮬레이션, 농약살포, 재난환경 구조 등)를 제공하여 니즈를 충족시키고, 주기적인 개발 및 업데이트를 통해 지속가능한 사업모델을 구현하기 위한 드론 시뮬레이터에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Mobile Base Station for Standalone Wireless Network
title_ko: 단독 무선망을 위한 이동 기지국
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile base station capable of operating a standalone wireless network. The mobile base station, which can operate a long-term evolution (LTE) communication-type standalone wireless network, includes: a communication part for communicating with terminals in accordance with an LTE communication mode; a local evolved packet core (EPC) simulating functions of entities on a core network to enable the operation of the LTE communication-type standalone wireless network; and a processor operatively connected with the communication part and the local EPC. The communication part is mounted on a drone to expand a cell area formed by the mobile base station, the local EPC is mounted on a moving vehicle on the ground or a ship on the sea, some functions of the mobile base station are mounted on the drone to expand the cell area, and inter-terminal communication is provided within a cell of the corresponding mobile base station, thereby providing emergency communication in a disaster area or inter-terminal communication around ships at sea.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 단독 무선망을 운용할 수 있는 이동 기지국에 관한 것으로, LTE(long-term evolution) 통신 방식 단독 무선망 운용이 가능한 이동 기지국은 LTE 통신 방식에 따라 단말들과 통신하기 위한 통신부, LTE 통신 방식의 단독 무선망 운용이 가능하도록 코어 네트워크 상의 엔티티들의 기능을 모사하는 로컬 EPC(evolved packet core) 및 상기 통신부 및 상기 로컬 EPC와 작동적으로 연결되는 프로세서를 포함하되, 상기 이동 기지국이 형성하는 셀 영역을 확장하도록 상기 통신부는 드론에 탑재되고, 상기 로컬 EPC는 지상의 이동 차량 또는 해상의 선박에 탑재될 수 있으며, 이동 기지국의 일부 기능을 드론에 탑재하여 셀 영역을 확장할 수 있고, 해당 이동 기지국의 셀 내에서 단말 간 통신을 제공함으로써 재난 지역 내에서의 긴급 통신 또는 해양에 있는 선박 주변에서의 단말 간 통신을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-disaster-resistant vibration reduction design method suitable for antenna structure of super high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of structural vibration and control of civil engineering subject, and relates to a multi-disaster resistant vibration reduction design method suitable for an antenna structure of a super high-rise building, which comprises the steps of establishing a finite element analysis model of the super high-rise building containing the antenna structure, and selecting and simulating seismic waves and coherent wind load time courses suitable for a target structure; disconnecting the connection part of the super high-rise building main body structure and the antenna structure, arranging a shock insulation rubber support, and determining support parameters through finite element analysis under the action of earthquake and wind load; then, disconnecting the connection part of the antenna and the top layer of the main body structure, connecting the antenna structure and the main body structure by adopting a displacement type damper, and determining the rigidity of the damper through earthquake-resistant and wind-resistant finite element calculation; and carrying out finite element analysis on the whole structure according to the selected shear stiffness of the shock isolation support and the stiffness of the displacement type damper, calculating the vibration damping effect of the antenna structure under the action of wind loads in frequent earthquakes, rare earthquakes and different recurrence periods, and checking whether the shear displacement of the support is smaller than the limit value requirement.

title_en: Multi-disaster toughness evaluation-oriented RC frame structure economic loss rapid evaluation method
abstract_en: A quick evaluation method for economic loss of an RC frame structure for evaluating the multi-disaster toughness aims to solve the problem that the existing method for quickly evaluating the economic loss of the RC frame structure under the action of earthquake-tsunami multi-disaster is lacked. The economic loss evaluation method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a finite element model of a multilayer RC frame structure; secondly, carrying out power time course analysis on the RC frame structure; thirdly, conducting Pushover analysis on the RC frame structure under the action of tsunami force; fourthly, analyzing a collapse vulnerability curve of the RC frame structure under the action of earthquake-tsunami and engineering requirement parameters of the RC frame structure; fifthly, establishing a performance model of the RC frame structure building; sixthly, determining a structure potential collapse mode, and calculating a tsunami strength conversion coefficient; and seventhly, carrying out economic loss evaluation on the structure under the action of the earthquake and tsunami. The method utilizes dynamic time-course analysis to simulate earthquake motion effect and nonlinear static force pushing to simulate tsunami effect, thereby evaluating the economic loss of the structure.

title_en: Multi-scale fire target identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-scale fire target identification method and a system, comprising the following steps: acquiring a training set, wherein the training set is generated by marking fire images; clustering is carried out according to the training set, and a plurality of prior frames are generated; constructing a target detection model, and setting parameters of the target detection model at least according to the prior frame, wherein the target detection model is generated by replacing a CSPDarknet53 trunk feature extraction network in a YOLOv4 algorithm with a MobileNet network; training the target detection model through the training set to generate a fire detection model; and detecting fire disaster through the fire disaster detection model to the input video or image, and judging whether fire disaster is sent or not. The parameter quantity of the fire detection model is greatly simplified, the requirements of embedded equipment and real-time performance can be met, and the video fire detection model has a higher recognition speed for detecting video fire targets.

title_en: Method for reducing natural disaster loss through artificial intervention earthquake
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of geoscience and discloses a method for reducing natural disaster loss through artificial intervention on earthquakes. According to the invention, through drilling and deep burying, explosives are placed near the position of the crust with potential earthquake risk, the explosives are detonated, and the stress and energy accumulated in the crust are released, so that the aims of early prediction and planned occurrence of the earthquake are fulfilled. Avoiding personal casualties and property loss caused by the uncertainty of earthquake. The natural disaster of the earthquake which is originally uncertain and high in loss is made to be interventable and low in loss.
assignees: SHENYANG COMMUNICATION NETWORK SERVICE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent analysis device for coal mine dynamic disaster risk detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coal mine dynamic disaster risk detection and early warning, in particular to an intelligent analysis device for coal mine dynamic disaster risk detection based on a drilling cutting method. The device comprises the following three parts: a first part: a data acquisition section; a second part: a field host portion; and a third part: and special data processing software for coal mine dynamic disaster risk detection. The intelligent detection method is used for intelligently detecting the coal mine dynamic disaster danger based on a drilling cutting method, and realizes the automatic statistics of the coal powder amount per meter, the intelligent judgment of macroscopic phenomena such as coal cannons, top drills, suction drills, stuck drills and the like in the coal mine dynamic disaster danger detection process by applying the modern communication technology, the computer technology, the sensor technology and the automation technology, so that the intelligent evaluation of the impact danger of a drilling area is realized. The defects of high risk, high workload, large human factor and the like in the process of judging impact risk by a drilling cutting method are overcome, and the purposes of safety, intelligence, reliability and easiness in the inspection process are achieved.

title_en: A system for predicting the damage range of a chemical disaster and analyzing the cause
title_ko: 화학재난 피해범위 예측 및 원인 분석 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for predicting a damage range of a chemical disaster and analyzing causes thereof, which when an event of a chemical disaster caused by a large-scale chemical accident occurs, identifies causes of the accident through professional and scientific forensic investigation and analysis, thereby preventing an accident of the same type. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a simulation model using a phenomenological approach (also referred to as an HGSYSTEM model) as a simulation to express results of damage caused by a chemical accident; an HGSYSTEM operating engine for operating the HGSYSTEM model; and a user interface for operating the HGSYSTEM operating engine. The HGSYSTEM model includes: a chemical substance module for providing physical and chemical properties of chemicals used in a diffusion evaluation module of the HGSYSTEM; a short-distance diffusion module for performing diffusion evaluation by leakage momentum; and a long-distance diffusion module for performing wind diffusion evaluation. The HGSYSTEM operating engine includes an input file generator for generating an input file for operating each module of the HGSYSTEM and an output file interpreter for interpreting and converting the result file of each HGSYSTEM module into structured data. The user interface includes: a GIS module for providing a function of outputting a diffusion evaluation output result on a map; a scenario input module for providing a function of inputting factors for operating the diffusion evaluation; and a diffusion evaluation output module for providing a function of expressing the diffusion evaluation results through tables, charts, etc.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 대형화학 사고에 의한 화학재난 발생 시 전문적이고 과학적인 Forensic 조사와 분석을 통해 명확한 사고의 원인을 규명함으로써 동일한 사고를 예방할 수 있도록 하는 화학재난 피해범위 예측 및 원인 분석 시스템에 관한 것으로,  
화학사고 발생에 따른 피해의 결과를 표출하기위한 시뮬레이션으로서, 현상학적 접근방법에 의한 시뮬레이션 모델(HGSYSTEM 모델이라고도 칭함)과; 상기 HGSYSTEM 모델을 구동하기 위한 HGSYSTEM 운영엔진과; 상기 HGSYSTEM 운영엔진을 구동하기 위한 사용자 인터페이스로 구성되는데. 
상기 HGSYSTEM 모델은, HGSYSTEM의 확산평가 모듈에 사용되는 화학물질의 물리화학적 물성치를 제공하기 위한 화학물질 모듈과, 누출 모멘텀에 의한 확산평가를 수행하기 위한 근거리 확산모듈과, 바람에 의한 확산평가를 수행하기 위한 원거리 확산모듈로 구성되고, 
상기 HGSYSTEM 운영엔진은, 상기 HGSYSTEM의 각 모듈을 구동하기 위한 입력파일을 생성하기 위한 입력파일 생성기와, 상기 HGSYSTEM 각 모듈의 결과파일을 해석하여 구조화된 자료로 변환하기 위한 출력파일 해석기로 구성되고, 
상기 사용자 인터페이스는, 확산평가 출력 결과를 지도상에 출력하는 기능을 제공하기 위한 GIS 모듈과, 확산평가를 구동하기 위한 인자를 입력하는 기능을 제공하기 위한 시나리오 입력 모듈과, 확산평가 결과를 표, 차트 등을 통해 표현하는 기능을 제공하기 위한 확산평가 출력 모듈로 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: High-speed train simulation equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of practical training teaching equipment, in particular to high-speed train simulation equipment, which comprises a control module and an execution module which are connected with each other; execution module includes the water purification case unit, installs drainage solenoid valve and is used for gathering on the water purification case unit the first temperature detecting element of temperature in the water purification case unit, control module includes interconnect alarm unit and control unit, first temperature detecting element with drainage solenoid valve all with the control unit is connected to reach when presetting below the temperature value in the water purification case unit through drainage solenoid valve evacuation water tank and control alarm unit warning. The high-speed train simulation equipment provided by the embodiment of the application can simulate the real anti-freezing emptying process of the high-speed train water purifying tank unit, so that a student can truly observe the process and obtain actual experience, and further the purpose of practical training is achieved.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU J&T HI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation chemical industry and scientific research platform
abstract_en: The utility model provides a simulation chemical and scientific research platform, one end of a vault tank water inlet pipeline is communicated with a vault tank simulation tank body; the vault tank stop valve is connected with a vault tank water inlet pipeline; one end of the spherical tank water inlet pipeline is communicated with the spherical tank simulation tank body; the spherical tank stop valve is connected with a spherical tank water inlet pipeline; one end of a liquefied gas tank wagon water inlet pipeline is communicated with the liquefied gas tank wagon simulation wagon body; the liquefied gas tank wagon stop valve is connected with a liquefied gas tank wagon water inlet pipeline; the air inlet of the inflation branch is communicated with the air inlet main pipeline; the air outlet of the inflation branch is connected with the corresponding composite air bottle; the tank car main stop valve is connected with the air inlet main pipeline. The device has the advantages that the device simulates various chemical engineering occasions, chemical leakage processes, and trains firefighters of emergency ability, field leakage plugging ability, field operation tension psychology, introduction of chemical product structures and the like; improve the psychological quality of the fighters, overcome psychological obstacles and improve actual combat skills.
assignees: SHANGHAI INGUARD SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Road traffic geological disaster early warning method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a road traffic geological disaster early warning method, a device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining geological disaster prediction data, carrying out multi-point data fusion on the geological disaster prediction data, and obtaining a prediction data fusion value; taking the regression parameter and the motion average parameter as variables to establish a prediction sequence mathematical model; and importing the prediction data fusion value into a prediction sequence mathematical model with complete training to obtain prediction data, and carrying out disaster early warning according to the prediction data. The road traffic geological disaster early warning method provided by the invention can improve the early warning accuracy of the road traffic geological disaster.

title_en: Important area personnel emergency evacuation system and method based on traffic flow model
abstract_en: The invention provides a traffic flow model-based emergency evacuation system and method for people in key areas, in particular to an emergency early warning and evacuation method for people in key areas, and belongs to the field of road traffic planning; the method aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, a traffic demand simulation process has obvious errors and the prediction time of an existing prediction model is long; the system comprises a real-time people flow monitoring and early warning layer and a scheduling scheme determining layer aiming at traffic demand prediction; real-time people flow monitoring in key areas can be achieved by accessing real-time people flow data, real-time people flow and people flow early warning threshold values are compared, and if the real-time people flow and people flow early warning threshold values exceed the threshold values, a scheduling scheme is triggered. The pedestrian flow early warning threshold value of each key area can be simply constructed Obtaining a decision tree learning model; the invention can process massive historical data and simultaneously support multiple dataThe method has the advantages that the influence of various factors on the travel demand of personnel is reflected more truly by the relevance analysis of the traffic characteristics; the model established based on the decision tree has the characteristics of simple algorithm and accurate prediction.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN TRANSP PLANNING CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Disaster relief manipulator that can prevent collapsing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collapse-preventing disaster relief manipulator which comprises an installation block, a drilling mechanism arranged on the installation block and a manipulator arranged on a rotating mechanism, the manipulator comprises a rotating mechanism for rotating a mechanical shaft, a sliding mechanism for sliding the manipulator, an extrusion mechanism for opening the manipulator, a locking mechanism for stabilizing the manipulator and a drill rod mechanism for protection, the technical scheme provides the disaster relief manipulator which can drill twice and can prevent collapse, the drilling power is provided by the rotation of the driving shaft, the expansion of the manipulator is realized by the movement of the pushing block, the stability of manipulator is realized in the removal through the fixture block, realizes secondary through the rotation that creeps into the pole and creeps into, can guarantee to reduce the possibility of subsiding when creeping into, and personnel can get into and rescue in the manipulator, have improved personnel's security.
assignees: HANGZHOU BINMENG COMMERCE AND TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Slope disaster test simulation equipment capable of coupling mountain fire and rainfall effects
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope disaster test simulation device capable of coupling mountain fire and rainfall effects, which comprises: the device comprises a support device, a geological disaster simulation device, a mountain fire simulation device, a rainfall simulation device and a data acquisition device; the geological disaster simulation device, the mountain fire simulation device and the rainfall simulation device are sequentially arranged on the bracket device at intervals from bottom to top; the data acquisition device is arranged on the support device and can automatically record the mountain fire simulation process of the mountain fire simulation device, the rainfall simulation process of the rainfall simulation device and the soil physical state of the automatic geological disaster simulation device. Through on the bracket device, from bottom to top in proper order the interval set up geological disaster analogue means, mountain fire analogue means and rainfall analogue means to set up the data acquisition device of data acquisition, can be in indoor simulation after the fire and behind the rain slope calamity, not only can simulate a certain disaster factor alone, can also simulate the side slope geological disasters that coupling mountain fire and rainfall combined action caused.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER MINISTRY OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Artificial simulation football court lawn structure
abstract_en: An artificial simulation football field lawn structure solves the problems that the grass filaments of the prior structure are easy to move or even fall off when in use, and simultaneously a base cloth layer arranged on the surface of the grass filaments can be ignited when in use, so that the risk of fire disaster exists and the grass filaments are not beneficial to use, and comprises a soil layer, a drain pipe and a simulation grass layer, wherein a needle punched cloth layer is laid above the soil layer, a gravel layer is filled above the needle punched cloth layer, a coarse sand layer is arranged above the gravel layer, an elastic permeable layer is arranged above the coarse sand layer, a first rubber particle layer is arranged above the elastic permeable layer, a simulation grass layer is laid above the first rubber particle layer, the simulation grass layer comprises a grid with a bottom, compression columns arranged inside the grid, a base cloth layer laid above the grid, and a second rubber particle layer arranged above the base cloth layer, the utility model has novel structure, ingenious design and good fixing effect of the grass filaments, after being fixed, the fixing device is not easy to move in the transverse direction, the longitudinal direction and the axial direction, and meanwhile, a fire disaster cannot happen.
assignees: SHANDONG LINGJUN SPORTS IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Liquefied natural gas leakage diffusion fire integrated experimental platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of liquefied natural gas fire prevention and control, and discloses a liquefied natural gas leakage and diffusion fire integrated experimental platform which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a box body, the top of the box body is provided with an opening and is used for storing liquefied natural gas, a row of scale marks in the vertical direction are engraved on the inner wall of the box body, and an igniter used for igniting the liquefied natural gas in the box body is arranged on the bottom plate; the supporting seat is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, and a sealing plate capable of pressing the top opening of the box body is rotatably connected to the top of the supporting seat. According to the invention, through the box body arranged on the bottom plate, the liquid natural gas is poured into the box body, the amount of the poured liquefied natural gas can be determined by observing the scale marks, and then the liquefied natural gas can be ignited under the action of the igniter so as to carry out a simulation test of combustion when the liquid natural gas leaks and a fire disaster occurs, so that workers can conveniently research the diffusion and combustion characteristics of the liquefied natural gas in the fire disaster.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU RUIQIANG EXPERIMENTAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional coal and gas outburst physical simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional physical simulation device for coal and gas outburst, which is suitable for simulating coal mine underground coal and gas outburst. The device comprises a test cavity, a rotating mechanism, a stress loading system, a gas seepage system, a protruding roadway system and a dust removal system. The device has a simple structure, is convenient to use, can realize the integration of coal body forming, coal body permeability test and coal and gas outburst multiple functions, and can carry out experimental study on the influence rule of different gas pressures, gas bag volumes, different stress states, different coal bed permeability, thickness and inclination angles on the movement of outburst coal powder in a roadway and a disaster causing mechanism under the fluid-solid coupling condition.

title_en: Runoff simulation method and system based on SOM-BPNN model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a runoff simulation method and system based on a SOM-BPNN model, belongs to the technical field of runoff simulation, and aims to capture various features of runoff and improve the runoff simulation precision. The method comprises the following steps: multi-source data acquisition and processing; screening key influence factors; building an SOM neural network clustering model; constructing a SOM-BPNN runoff simulation model; and (4) runoff simulation. The method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out unsupervised clustering on a sample data set by using an SOM model, and constructing a back propagation artificial neural network model according to the clustered sub-sample set to carry out runoff simulation. According to the method, two artificial neural network models are coupled together, the clustered sub-sample set is beneficial to back-propagation of the artificial neural network for multi-aspect feature learning of complex data, the runoff simulation precision of traditional machine learning can be further improved, and effective auxiliary decision means and solid theoretical basis can be provided for watershed water resource planning, flood control, disaster reduction and comprehensive treatment.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Coal sample permeability test and outburst simulation integrated test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal sample permeability test and outburst simulation integrated test method which is suitable for the field of coal safety. The method comprises the steps of coal sample forming, permeability testing, coal and gas outburst and coal dust collection.
