The method is simple to operate, can be used for researching the influence rule test research of the movement of the outburst coal powder in a roadway and a disaster mechanism of the outburst coal powder under different gas pressures, gas bag volumes, different stress states and different coal bed permeability, thickness and inclination angles under the fluid-solid coupling condition, and has important significance for the control of coal and gas outburst.

title_en: Dam remote sensing intelligent detection method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam remote sensing intelligent detection method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: A. collecting dam remote sensing image samples and establishing a dam remote sensing image sample set; B. based on a deep learning model YOLOv3 framework, replacing an original trunk network Darknet53 with a lightweight network ShuffleNet2, training and testing the model to obtain a dam target detection model based on an improved YOLOv 3; C. taking a large-format remote sensing image as input, and performing sliding window segmentation according to a segmentation step length; D. performing dam target detection on the segmented image based on the improved dam target detection model of YOLOv 3; E. and recombining the segmented images into an image with the same size as the original remote sensing image according to the segmentation step length and the confidence coefficient of the detection boundary frame. The method can be used for rapidly and intelligently detecting the dam target on the optical remote sensing image, effectively improves the target interpretation efficiency, and provides high-quality target detection data for disaster emergency management, dam safety risk management and the like.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Underground space fire disaster reduction simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground space fire disaster reduction simulation experiment device which comprises an externally-mounted main frame, a space simulation adjusting assembly, a fire source device, smoke exhaust fan blades and an internal flow dispersing assembly, wherein the space simulation adjusting assembly effectively adjusts the volume of a closed space of the underground fire disaster simulation experiment, so that the inside of the space simulation adjusting assembly is in various geometric space forms; a fire source device penetrates through the end face of one side of the outer mounting main frame and provides a fixed-point fire source for a fire reduction simulation experiment; an inner flow dispersing component is arranged on one side, close to the fire source device, of the inner portion of the outer mounting main frame, and the inner flow dispersing component is used for discharging smoke airflow into the space simulation adjusting component when the fire source device is ignited to generate smoke; and a smoke concentration measuring device is also arranged in the space simulation adjusting assembly.

title_en: An aquatic training and practise cabin for surface and underwater evacuation escape and rescue
abstract_en: The invention related to a multi-purpose training booth designed to improve diving, evacuation, escape and rescue training in both normal and unexpected emergency situations, surface and underwater environments, and practise techniques. The training booth can be used for professional and personal competency training. Underwater technology is designed to be used in educational institutions, diving schools, water rescue, search and evacuation training, and all civil and military institutions and organizations that provide emergency landing training in aircraft water.

title_en: Classification method of syphilis addicts and normal persons based on electroencephalogram signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a classification method of ice-poison addicts and normal persons based on electroencephalogram signals, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting the electroencephalogram signals of the ice-poison addicts and the normal persons when the ice-poison addicts and the normal persons react to a task, preprocessing the collected electroencephalogram signals, and obtaining electroencephalogram characteristics under the reaction task; then, respectively extracting the features of the electroencephalogram to obtain space-time cluster features; then, carrying out average calculation on the voltage/energy values in each space-time cluster in a time dimension and a space dimension so as to obtain a voltage/energy average value of each space-time cluster; training the voltage/energy average value of each cluster to obtain a classifier through a machine learning algorithm; finally, the trained classifier is used for inputting electroencephalogram signals, and the distinction between the ice-toxin addict and the normal person is realized. The invention can accurately judge whether the tested person is addicted to the methamphetamine or not through the electroencephalogram signal, has better robustness and can avoid dimension disaster in the machine learning process.
assignees: XIAOLONG SHENSI XIAMEN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Battery module structure design method based on energy flow analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to a battery module structure design method based on energy flow analysis, which comprises the following steps: acquiring constraint conditions and preset thermal spreading time T of the battery module, and constructing a battery module model; and carrying out thermal spreading simulation analysis on the battery module model in simulation software, if the thermal spreading time T is greater than the preset thermal spreading time T of the battery module, obtaining the optimal battery module model, otherwise, carrying out energy flow analysis, increasing the heat flow path of the single batteries, reducing the heat transfer between the adjacent single batteries, and carrying out thermal spreading simulation analysis again. Compared with the prior art, the battery module model which meets the constraint condition and has longer heat spreading time is found by changing the arrangement mode of the single batteries, the volume constraint and the heat spreading time requirement of the battery module are considered, the obtained battery module model can strive for enough time for fire-fighting measures, and the possibility of disaster accidents is reduced.

title_en: Real scene smoke escape training system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a real-scene smoke escape practical training system, which relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and comprises a training room, wherein the training room is internally provided with a clapboard, the clapboard is welded with the bottom surface in the training house, the side surface of the clapboard is provided with a reinforcing rod which is embedded in the training house, cylinders are arranged in an array manner under the reinforcing rod, the cylinder is connected with the bottom part of the training room through a bolt, the working end of the cylinder is fixed with the bottom part of the reinforcing rod, the top surface array of the reinforcing rod is provided with a road sign lamp, the road sign lamps are connected with the top surface of the reinforcing rod through bolts, the top surface of the reinforcing rod is provided with support rods in an array manner, the support rods are welded with the top surface of the reinforcing rod, the utility model discloses a rescue escape device, including bracing piece, bracing piece top surface, cylinder and road sign lamp, realized reminding for the person of escaping, prevent that smog from too big not finding the correct route of fleing, remind the safe height that the person of escaping flees simultaneously, avoid inhaling a large amount of smog.
assignees: WUHAN HUISHI ZHIXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Short-distance multi-branch sidetrack drilling tool and drilling method for coal mine underground directional hole
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near-distance multi-branch sidetrack drilling tool for a directional hole in a coal mine and a drilling method, wherein the drilling tool comprises a guide drilling tool and a flexible branch drilling tool which can be inserted into the guide drilling tool; a section of positioning groove is arranged on the inner wall of the guide drilling tool, and a guide port for the flexible branch drilling tool to extend out is arranged on the pipe wall of the guide sleeve; the flexible branch drilling tool comprises an inner drilling rod, a positioning joint, a continuous pipe, a bent joint and a spray head which are sequentially connected, wherein the positioning joint comprises a joint pipe body, a positioning key arranged along the radial direction of the joint pipe body and a positioning key adjusting piece used for adjusting the radial position of the positioning key; according to the invention, the branch opening direction can be accurately controlled by adjusting the posture of the guide drilling tool, and sidetracking branch can be carried out along any direction in the radial direction of the drill hole under the guide of the guide drilling tool; and the number and the spacing of the branch holes are not influenced by the reserved branch points, so that the effective lap joint of the branch holes can be ensured, and the blank belt for disaster prevention and control is avoided.

title_en: Test method for simulating landslide to convert landslide into debris flow
abstract_en: A test method for simulating landslide and converting landslide into debris flow comprises the steps of firstly building a test device, drawing a slope of a soil body to be tested and a soil body particle grading characteristic curve, measuring artificial rainfall intensity q and pore water pressure p in the slope body, and defining a debris flow starting criterion: f (theta, Cc, P, q) is 0, and when one point P is positioned on the curved surface Sc, the quasi-mudstone fluid is in a critical starting state; when point P is above the curved surface Sc, the debris flow has started; when the point P is below the curved surface Sc, the quasi-mudstone fluid is in a steady state. The method is rapid, convenient and good in reproducibility, can accurately simulate the change rule of the pore water pressure in the downhill under the action of different soil bodies, different slopes and different rainfall, establishes the critical condition of the starting of the debris flow with the fluctuation characteristic of the pore water pressure, reveals the starting mechanism of the landslide conversion type debris flow, guides the practice, avoids the landslide conversion into the debris flow, and effectively reduces the damage degree and the hazard level of the disaster.

title_en: Coal and gas outburst disaster-causing visual simulation experiment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal and gas outburst disaster-causing visual simulation experiment system, and belongs to the technical field of coal mines. The system comprises a salient source and generation device, a visual simulation roadway and a data monitoring device which are connected in sequence; the projection source and generation device comprises a gas source supplement tank, a projection cavity, a cavity lengthening assembly, a high-pressure gas injection pipe, a clamp, a first rupture disk, a second rupture disk and a blasting device; the protruding cavity and the cavity lengthening assembly are filled with pulverized coal materials and gas, the front end of the protruding cavity is connected with the blasting device, the rear end of the protruding cavity is connected with the gas source supplementing tank, and the gas source supplementing tank uniformly inflates the protruding cavity and the cavity lengthening assembly through a high-pressure gas injection pipe; the first rupture disk and the second rupture disk are fixed by the holder of the blasting device, and the first rupture disk and the second rupture disk realize blasting under certain pressure.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Water disaster and strong mine pressure disaster cooperative treatment method for mining area
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative treatment method for water disaster and strong mine pressure disaster in a mining area, which comprises the following steps: acquiring water accumulation information of the overlying goaf, wherein the water accumulation information comprises a water accumulation position; acquiring an influence treatment horizon of an underlying coal seam; acquiring a drilling hole arrangement mode and a crack scale required by directionally weakening the rock mass towards the direction of the overlying gob according to the position of the accumulated water and the influence treatment layer; constructing a borehole in the middle rock stratum according to the borehole arrangement mode; acquiring shock wave parameter information according to the scale of the cracks required by directionally weakening the rock mass; directionally weakening the rock mass towards the direction of the overlying goaf in the drill hole by using the shock waves corresponding to the shock wave parameter information; and performing segmented hydraulic fracturing in the drill hole, and forming a fracture for weakening the middle rock stratum and a water guide channel for communicating the drill hole with the overlying goaf in the middle rock stratum. The method simultaneously treats the disaster of strong mine pressure and the water accumulation disaster of the goaf, improves the treatment efficiency and is beneficial to the rapid exploitation of the underlying coal seam.
assignees: SHENHUA SHENDONG COAL GROUP CORP LTD;XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Real-time masking method in full-virtual environment based on AR imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time masking method in a full-virtual environment based on AR imaging, which relates to the field of AR and aims to achieve the purpose, the technical scheme of the invention comprises the following steps: on the basis of finishing three-dimensional digital model art processing, a MASK MASK model of a corresponding model is manufactured, and calling logic of the MASK model is compiled, so that the MASK MASK model can remove the image of a virtual model when being called; binding and matching relevant props created in the motion capture software and a rigid body of a simulated human in software to corresponding models and skeletons; the software is accessed with motion capture data and wirelessly transmitted to the AR glasses in real time. The feeling of the wounded is cured on the spot for the trainee, and the problems that the actual environment for disaster on-site cure and the on-site psychological feeling of the trainee cannot be reflected in the traditional emergency training are solved.

title_en: Multi-field coupling test device and method for simulating deep mining Ordovician limestone gushing water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-field coupling test device and method for simulating deep mining Ordovician limestone gushing water, and mainly relates to the field of coal mine goaf disaster prevention and control. The testing method comprises the steps of establishing rock stratum models with different proportions, different structures or different distributions according to actual geological conditions of a coal mine, simulating various conditions such as deep ground stress, bottom plate water pressure, rock stratum temperature and mining disturbance through the testing device, recording various measurement data in the testing process, and generating the bottom plate ash inrush phenomenon and the path of a deep mining coal bed. The testing device provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in maintenance, accurate monitoring data, scientific testing method principle and simplicity and convenience in operation, meets the teaching task and test exploration of the Olympic Grey Water inrush mechanism by simulating and analyzing the characteristics and mechanism of Olympic Grey Water inrush in deep mining, and provides effective testing data for Olympic Grey Water inrush prevention and control and safe mining of coal mines.

title_en: Modular fire-fighting knowledge popularization system suitable for children
abstract_en: The utility model provides a modular fire-fighting knowledge popularization system suitable for children, which comprises a fireman equipment experience and fire-fighting workflow science popularization module, a fireman police-taking simulation experience module, a fire-fighting vehicle body experience module and a virtual fire-fighting experience module; the firefighter equipment experience and fire fighting workflow science popularization module comprises a firefighter equipment display and wearing area and a small firefighter classroom experience area; the fireman alarming simulation experience module comprises a fire-fighting slide bar and a fire-fighting slideway; the fire fighting truck body test module comprises fire fighting truck virtual driving equipment, a fire fighting truck cinema test system, a prop tool box and an equipment cabin; the virtual fire extinguishing experience module comprises a virtual fire extinguishing interactive display screen and a water gun capable of spraying water and emitting infrared light. The utility model discloses a multimedia technology combines the knowledge of each fire module of recreation popular science respectively, experiences the work of fireman through simulation fireman role, and what can be better lets children experience the person systematically knows the knowledge that the fireman daily work is relevant.
assignees: SHANGHAI JUNRONG CULTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster model display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster model display device, including removing the base, be fixed with the bracing piece on removing the base, be provided with on the bracing piece can be clear audio-visual process show that mud-rock flow produced for spectator's show mechanism, this geological disaster model display device, be different from prior art, power and harm that can audio-visual simulation mud-rock flow in the natural disasters, its space and attribute information that show mud-rock flow geological disasters are relevant that can be very nimble make people can be more convenient know the harm that mud-rock flow caused to people's the security of the lives and property, improved the technological effect of show.

title_en: Urban Earthquake Evacuation Simulation Apparatus Based on Graphical User Interface and Method Thereof
title_ko: 그래픽 유저 인터페이스 기반의 도시 지진 대피 시뮬레이션 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present embodiments provides an urban earthquake evacuation simulation method and apparatus that generates road map information according to earthquake damage by using building damage information according to earthquake damage prediction modeling, and applies object movement simulation according to actor-based modeling to the road map information to analyze an evacuation scenario from various perspectives in case of an earthquake, and visualizes shelter expansion and road reinforcement. The urban earthquake evacuation simulation method includes the steps of: outputting citizen behavior information, outputting building damage information, and outputting evacuation road visualization information.
abstract_ko: 본 실시예들은 지진 피해 예측 모델링에 따른 건물 피해 정보를 이용하여 지진 피해에 따른 도로 지도 정보를 생성하고, 도로 지도 정보에서 행위자 기반 모델링에 따른 객체 이동 시뮬레이션을 적용하여 지진 발생시 대피 시나리오를 다각도로 분석하고 대피소 확충 및 도로 보강을 시각화하는 도시 지진 대피 시뮬레이션 방법 및 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Real fire training center facility for refuge training according to smoke movement, and method for smoke spread experiment using the same
title_ko: 연기거동에 따른 피난훈련용 실화재 훈련장 시설물 및 그 연기확산 실험 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a real fire training center facility for refuge training according to smoke behavior, which is capable of performing horizontal smoke spread experiments and vertical smoke spread experiments according to an occurrence of real fire and performing refuge training according to the smoke behavior, and also, implements analysis and demonstration processes through a theory and experiment on the real fire training facility for the refuge training according to the smoke behavior to analyze smoke behavior characteristics in case of building fire, analyze a harmful gas, which is a component of smoke so as to be identified by linking the smoke behavior and refuge influence in more complex fire situations, and also is capable of being used in combination for firefighter education and training, public disaster safety education, and research purpose experiments as a training ground for the refuge training based on the real fire and capable of conducting safety education to the public, such as viewing and experiencing the response situation of the training experiment through transparent tempered glass installed in a front surface of a training experiment building.
abstract_ko: 실화재(Real Fire) 발생에 따른 수평 연기확산 실험 및 수직 연기확산 실험을 수행하고, 연기거동에 따른 피난훈련을 수행할 수 있고, 또한, 연기거동에 따른 피난훈련용 실화재 훈련장 시설물에 대한 이론 및 실험을 통한 분석 및 실증과정을 구현함으로써, 건축물 화재시의 연기거동 특성을 분석하고, 연기의 구성요소인 유해가스의 분석을 통하여 보다 복합적인 화재상황에서의 연기거동과 피난 영향성을 연계시켜 파악할 수 있으며, 또한, 실화재 기반 피난훈련용 훈련장으로서, 소방관 교육훈련, 대국민 재난안전교육 및 연구목적 실험에 복합적으로 활용할 수 있고, 훈련실험동의 전면에 설치되는 투명 강화유리를 통해 훈련실험의 대응상황 관람, 체험 등 대국민 안전교육을 수행할 수 있는, 연기거동에 따른 피난훈련용 실화재 훈련장 시설물 및 그 연기확산 실험 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing firefighting training program based on user-centered design
title_ko: 사용자 중심 설계 기반의 소방 훈련 프로그램 제공 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for providing a firefighting training program based on a user centered design. A method for providing a firefighting training program based on a user centered design according to one embodiment of the present application, may comprise: a step of receiving requirement data with respect to a firefighting training program, and generating an affinity diagram based on the requirement data; and a step of designing a virtual reality-based firefighting training program based on the affinity diagram. According to the present invention, an effect of the firefighting training program can be accurately verified in qualitative and quantitative manners.
abstract_ko: 사용자 중심 설계 기반의 소방 훈련 프로그램 제공 장치 및 방법이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 사용자 중심 설계 기반의 소방 훈련 프로그램 제공 방법은, 소방 훈련 프로그램에 대한 요구 사항 데이터를 수신하여 상기 요구 사항 데이터에 기초한 친화도 다이어그램(Affinity Diagram)을 생성하는 단계 및 상기 친화도 다이어그램에 기초하여 가상현실 기반의 상기 소방 훈련 프로그램을 설계하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV AJOU IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Multi-data-combined landslide morphological structure detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide morphological structure detection method based on multivariate data combination, which belongs to the field of geological information and comprises the steps of surveying the morphology of a slope surface through aerial orthographic images and airborne laser data, identifying the deformation characteristics, damage signs and micro landforms of the surface of a researched area by combining field geological survey and ground surface deformation monitoring (GNSS), obtaining landslide morphological change information, representing the characteristics and identification discontinuity of rock and soil through rock and soil drilling of a selected section and geoelectricity acquisition and analysis, establishing a landslide body geological model and a landform model, and finally, carrying out type analysis on a landslide region by combining the landforms and the geological model to finish landslide morphological structure detection; the method solves the problem that disaster-causing factors are considered from a single angle in the traditional landslide form structure detection.

title_en: Device and method for whole dynamic pregnancy disaster evolution process of deeply-buried rock mass engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for the whole dynamic pregnant disaster evolution process of a deeply buried rock mass engineering, relates to the technical field of ground pressure disaster tests, can provide the composite action of horizontal loading, vertical loading and internal dynamic load disturbance, and improves the accuracy and reliability of simulating the mining environment of deep mining surrounding rocks; the device includes: the test rock frame is used for supporting and fixing a test rock; the horizontal stress applying device is arranged on the side surface of the test rock frame and is used for applying horizontal stress to the test rock; the vertical stress applying device is arranged at the top of the test rock frame and is used for applying vertical stress to the test rock; and the dynamic load device is arranged inside the test rock mass and used for providing dynamic load for the test rock mass. The technical scheme provided by the invention is suitable for the process of ground pressure disaster simulation test.

title_en: Transformer substation safety level analysis method during geomagnetic disturbance change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transformer substation safety level analysis method during geomagnetic disturbance change, which is characterized in that simulation analysis of influence factors including line types, transformer substation grounding resistances and the like is carried out on GIC levels of 34 transformer substations of a Shandong 500kV power grid under the action of various uniform ground electric fields, and the fact that the difference of the GIC levels of the 34 transformer substations is large is obtained, and the fact that the change of GIC distribution is consistent with the change of the direction of the electric field is shown. The maximum GIC level of the transformer substation under the action of a possible electric field is calculated by utilizing the directional sensitivity, and the obtained relative vulnerability index can help to identify the key transformer substation and the weakest transformer substation through the standardized calculation of the maximum GIC level. The method can provide references for GIC disaster prevention and reduction, substation site selection, monitoring equipment installation and the like of the power grid.

title_en: Multi-person interactive evacuation simulation system under multi-disaster coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-people interactive evacuation simulation system under multi-disaster coupling, which comprises: a control end module: the system is used for setting different disaster types, evacuation scenes, the number of evacuated persons and the types of tested persons; setting scene brightness and indicating identification parameters; real-time scene dynamic and three-dimensional evacuation paths output by an execution end are observed in real time; an execution end module: the system is used for planning an evacuation path and can carry out multi-person interactive interaction in evacuation. The system provided by the invention can realize synchronous interactive simulation of multiple persons, also provides more ideas for evacuation research, and can research related problems of team evacuation behaviors including cooperative cooperation, competition and the like. The invention can realize the coupling of multiple kinds of disasters; simulating a plurality of different tested personnel types; various scenarios are implemented. Meanwhile, the time, the evacuation flow rate of the tested person and the three-dimensional evacuation path of the tested person can be output in real time.

title_en: Method for identifying fragile line of electric power system in response to hurricane disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a fragile line of an electric power system for dealing with hurricane disasters, which comprises the following steps of firstly, respectively quantifying the influence of hurricane wind speed and line tide out-of-limit on line fault probability; then, the failure of the power system under an extreme disaster such as hurricane is described as a continuous disturbance process considering the continuous influence of strong wind; then, simulating the faults of the system under the disaster by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method to obtain a large number of cascading fault accident chains; and then constructing a fault association diagram CFGPD under continuous disturbance describing a line fault sequence and loss conditions, and finally providing a fragile line identification mode based on the CFGPD. According to the method, the influence degree of the disaster on the power system is calculated from two dimensions of time and space, and the load loss of the system is greatly reduced by taking corresponding reinforcement measures on the identified fragile line, so that support is provided for disaster prevention.

title_en: Nation safty education certification system and the meotod of cetification system therof
title_ko: 국민안전교육 인증시스템 및 그 인증방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nation safety education certification system and a certification method thereof and, more specifically, to a nation safety education certification system and a certification method thereof, which can provide a safety certification system with respect to six nation safety fields-life safety, natural disaster safety, traffic safety, social infrastructure safety, crime safety, and health safety. These will contribute to social safety by enabling people, who have finished courses of the safety certification system, to achieve certification, and therethrough can be used in employment and marketing. A nation safety education certification system and a certification method thereof in accordance with a desirable embodiment of the present invention force a job seeker, not a general person, to unconditionally achieve the certification because a business owner can employ the job seeker who must achieve the certification, enhance nation safety treatment capability of the people who have the certification because practical education is realized through virtual reality, are very convenient because the business owner only needs to employ people who have the certification without individually offering separate safety education for the employee, and surely guarantee safety in a work environment by enabling the business owner to check a main server to verify the certification of the employee.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 국민안전교육 인증시스템 및 그 인증방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 국민안전 6대분야 즉, 생활안전, 자연재난안전, 교통안전, 사회기반체계안전, 범죄안전, 보건안전 분야에 대한 안전인증시스템을 제공하고, 안전인증시스템을 수료한 사람들이 인증을 받을 수 있도록 하여 사회안전에 이바지하고, 이를 통해서 취업 및 마케팅에 활용할 수 있도록 한 국민안전교육 인증시스템 및 그 인증방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 바람직한 실시예로 형성되는 국민안전교육 인증시스템 및 그 인증방법에 의하면 일반인이 아닌 취업을 준비하는 사람이 이를 반드시 가지고 있어야지 업주가 취업을 시켜 줄 수 있으므로, 무조건 인증을 받아야 하고, 가상현실을 통한 실질적 교육이 이루어지기 때문에 이증서의 발급받은 사람들의 국민안전처리 능력이 향상되며, 업주는 피고용자들에게 별도의 안전교육을 일일이 시킬 필요없이 인증서 있는 사람을 고용하면 되기 때문에 매우 편리하고, 업주는 피고용자들의 인증서 실증여부를 메인서버에서 확인할 수 있어서 업무환경에서의 안전이 확실하게 담보되는 등의 효과가 발생한다.
assignees: NAT FOR SAFETY EDUCATION AND TRAINING INSTITUTE

title_en: Flooding Prediction System
title_ko: 침수 범람 예측 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flooding predicting system comprising: a compound disaster setting unit, which loads compound disaster scenario data and space data; a seawater disaster analyzing unit, which calculates a tide and a storm surge height using an ADCIRC model, and calculates a spectrum of a wave height and a wave period using an unSWAN model to generate seawater prediction information converted to a histogram; a land/marine disaster analyzing unit, which calculates flooding levels depending on tide, tidal wave, and wave overtopping using a FLOW3D model to generate marine inundation prediction information, and calculates flooding levels with respect to tide, tidal wave, wave overtopping, and river and inland flooding using an XP-SWMM model to generate land inundation prediction information; and a flooding prediction unit, which collects the seawater prediction information, the marine inundation prediction information, and the land inundation prediction information to generate real-time flooding prediction information of each typhoon intensity or target sea area. According to the present invention as above, a dynamic flooding simulation is performed by calculating information about the storm surge height and wave due to a typhoon through two-way coupling of the ADCIRC model and the UnSWAN model, a seawater level and a wave overtopping rate are calculated by estimating overflow and wave overtopping depending on a structure shape using the FLOW3D model, and a rainfall runoff and inland inundation simulation is performed depending on a water level and a wave overtopping rate using the XP-SWMM model, thereby having an effect that compound flooding occurrence, which caused by the storm surge height and wave overtopping due to storm, and river flooding and inland inundation due to rainfall, may be predicted.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 침수범람 예측 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 복합재난 시나리오 데이터 및 공간 데이터를 로딩하는 복합재난 설정부; ADCIRC모델을 통해 조석 및 푹풍해일고를 산출하고, unSWAN 모델을 통해 파고 및 파랑 주기에 대한 스펙트럼을 산출하여 히스토그램으로 변환한 해수 예측정보를 생성하는 해수재난 분석부; FLOW3D 모델을 통해 조석, 해일 및 월파에 따른 침수범람 정도를 산출하여 해상침수 예측정보를 생성하고, XP-SWMM 모델을 통해 조석, 해일, 월파, 외수 및 내수에 대한 침수범람 정도를 산출하여 육상침수 예측정보를 생성하는 육해상재난 분석부; 및 해수 예측정보, 해상침수 예측정보 및 육상침수 예측정보를 취합하여 태풍강도 또는 대상해역별로 실시간 침수범람 예측정보를 생성하는 침수범람 예측부를 포함한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, ADCIRC 모형 및 UnSWAN 모형의 2way coupling을 통해 태풍에 의한 해일고 및 파랑정보를 산출하여 동적침수범람모의를 수행하고, FLOW3D 모델을 통해 구조물 형상에 따른 월류 및 월파를 산정을 통해 해수위 및 월파량을 산출하며, XP-SWMM 모델을 통해 수위 및 월파량에 따른 강우유출 및 내수침수모의를 수행함으로써, 폭풍에 의한 해일고 및 월파, 강우에 의한 하천범람 및 내수침수에 의한 복합적인 침수범람 발생을 예측이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Measuring device for deep longitudinal settlement of geological disaster
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a measuring device for geological disasters deep vertically subsides, including setting up the drilling on the landslide, the bottom of drilling extends to the stable ground below the landslide in vivo, and the vertical device main part that is equipped with in the drilling, the device main part includes the outsourcing hose, hangs the hammer, flexible control steel cable and spring, outsourcing hose connection receiving arrangement, hang built-in central authorities of aperture of hammer and flexible inserting frame, flexible control steel cable drives the flexible realization device main part's that the spring control inserted frame is flexible fixed. The flexible steel cable in the outer hose drives the umbrella rib-shaped inserting frame to move along the middle pipe support through the spring to control the umbrella rib-shaped inserting frame to stretch and retract, the umbrella rib-shaped inserting frame is stretched and inserted into a stable rock and soil body in engineering application to fix the device main body, the landslide body slides to drive the device main body to vertically move, and the landslide geological body longitudinal settlement is measured out through the displacement of the outer hose of the drill hole. The utility model provides an among the prior art the device body unstable, irregular slip and be difficult to calculate the landslide body and vertically subside the scheduling problem.

title_en: Landslide and rockfall protection method based on unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide rockfall protection method based on unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography, which comprises large-range slope picture acquisition, unmanned aerial vehicle path planning, dangerous rock or dangerous rock body high-precision picture acquisition, three-dimensional terrain data generation and landslide rockfall simulation without a protective net: utilizing three-dimensional rockfall simulation software to perform landslide simulation analysis under different rockfall parameters, counting rockfall motion characteristic values, preliminarily drafting a plurality of protective net schemes, simulating landslide rockfall with protective nets, comparing the protective net schemes, and determining a final protective net scheme; according to the method, the unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography technology is applied to landslide and rockfall protection design, and compared with the traditional method, the method for acquiring the three-dimensional terrain data is high in flexibility, high in precision and high in point cloud density; the three-dimensional topographic map is generated by using the high-precision pictures acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the conditions of longitude and latitude, gradient, slope direction, disaster scale, threat objects, crack distribution and the like of a research area can be intuitively known, and an intuitive basis is provided for the selection of whether protective measures or protective schemes are set.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG LUDING HYDROPOWER CO LTD;SINOHYDRO BUREAU 5 CO LTD;CHENGDU XINGJING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Regional autonomy capability assessment method for DG-containing power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional autonomy capability assessment method for a DG-containing power distribution network, which relates to the field of power supply and comprises the following steps: (1) inputting basic data of elements such as circuits, protection devices, distributed energy sources and loads in the power distribution network; (2) constructing an extreme wind disaster event model and a disaster influence evaluation model; (3) constructing a distributed energy output and load demand model in the power distribution network; (4) constructing an optimal recovery model of the load node and the system under an extreme wind disaster event to form a corresponding objective function and a constraint condition; (5) and constructing a load and system area autonomous ability index based on the states of the load nodes and the system under the simulation extreme event.

title_en: Self-cooling fire-fighting liquid nitrogen fire-extinguishing electric drill
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric drills, in particular to a self-cooling fire-fighting liquid nitrogen fire-fighting electric drill which comprises a drill body, wherein a handle is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the drill body, a storage battery is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the handle in a buckling mode, and a battery disassembly button and a battery button for controlling the storage battery to be disassembled are arranged on the handle. The fire-fighting hose is suitable for firefighters to carry and can be suitable for most fire scene; can be used for household standby, and is convenient and safe. The liquid nitrogen element is added, so that the fire extinguishing and temperature reducing device can perform temperature reduction treatment while extinguishing fire, reduce the temperature to be below a fire point while extinguishing open fire, and prevent secondary fire. Adopt new-type drill bit, different with the drill bit of current market, adopt the disconnect-type drill bit, can effectually prevent that inside combustible substance and external oxygen from contacting to reach the effect of preventing backflowing.

title_en: Loose confined aquifer permeability coefficient determination method based on coal mine geological drilling
abstract_en: The invention provides a loose confined aquifer permeability coefficient determination method based on geological drilling, which comprises the following steps: collecting geological drilling information and data; determining an influence factor of the permeability coefficient; carrying out correlation analysis and partial correlation analysis on each influence factor and the permeability coefficient obtained by the existing on-site pumping test, and selecting key influence factors; randomly combining the key influence factors, performing multiple linear regression analysis, performing fitting goodness test and equation significance test, and sequencing; determining a target regression equation according to the sequencing result; substituting the existing geological drilling information and data of the coal mine into a target regression equation, and determining the permeability coefficient of the loose confined aquifer. The invention applies the mathematical means to engineering practice, can fully utilize the existing coal mine geological drilling information and data, and provides technical support for researching anisotropy and regional effect of the loose layer permeability coefficient and preventing and controlling hydrogeological disasters such as mine water burst.

title_en: Flow process analysis method for intensity index space variation flow state landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flow process analysis method of an intensity index space variation flow state landslide, which comprises the steps of inputting boundary conditions of the flow state landslide, the geometric dimension of a landslide body and rock and soil body intensity index space variation parameters into a program, initializing the boundary conditions, the geometric dimension of the landslide body and the rock and soil body intensity index space variation parameters, utilizing a Karhunen-Lo e expansion method as a stochastic theory, modeling uncertainty and space propagation of a random variable to generate a random sample of the space variation flow state landslide, carrying out deterministic analysis on the flow process of the flow state landslide based on an SPH method, combining the stochastic theory with an SPH model, carrying out Monte Carlo simulation in the SPH method, and finally carrying out statistical analysis on simulation results of different stochastic examples to obtain a probability statistical rule of flow state landslide sliding distance and sliding speed; the method can evaluate the sliding distance, the sliding speed and the disaster causing range of the landslide under the influence of the spatial variability of the strength parameters.

title_en: Fire simulation processing method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire simulation processing method based on the Internet of things, relates to a security simulation method, and solves the problem that the existing forest fire spreading determination method adopts a single calculation method. The method comprises the steps that a fire scene model carries out three-dimensional space modeling on a forest farm according to vegetation types, terrain trends and real-time wind factors of the forest farm and splits the forest farm into unit blocks with consistent attributes; the fire scene model collects fire spreading factors for each unit block, multivariate linear regression is carried out by a mathematical statistical method according to a plurality of spreading factors, real-time fire spreading factors of the current unit block are collected, a linear regression function of each unit block is fitted, and fire scene model hyperparameters and multivariate curve clusters of the target forest scene are generated. The invention applies a simplified forest fire spreading model and combines the characteristics of forest fire macroscopic diffusion, and can quickly study and judge the development of fire disaster situations.

title_en: Forecaster training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forecaster training system, which comprises the following modules: the database management module can provide subsequent supplement and management functions of the database; the disaster weather query and statistics module is used for providing a data query and display function of specific station number, time and magnitude; the conventional forecast training module can randomly extract data from a database for a trainer to use; the conventional training result storage and query module provides an automatic storage function for the training results of the forecaster each time, and provides query and retrieval functions for the training result records; and the system management module can realize the management of basic configuration information and personnel information and provide a user login use mechanism. The method is helpful for improving the forecast accuracy of forecasters, improving the coverage rate of public weather services and the public satisfaction degree of the weather services, and improving the specialization and scientific level of the weather services.
assignees: LANZHOU CENTRAL METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY LANZHOU DROUGHT ECOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING AND FORECASTING

title_en: Old roof breaking step control method and application thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster prevention and control, and particularly discloses a control method of old roof breaking step distance and application thereof. According to the old roof breaking step distance control method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the connection between the old roof and the boundary protection coal pillar is cut off by designing various drill holes based on the O-X type breaking plane structure of the key layer, so that the old roof is more easily broken after the working face is pushed, the early formation and development of the O-X type breaking plane structure are promoted, the overhanging area is effectively reduced, the initial breaking step distance of the old roof is shortened, the problem that the initial breaking step distance of the old roof is too long mostly exists during the initial mining and initial setting period of the working face in coal mining is solved, and the method has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Typhoon disaster prediction method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The scheme discloses a typhoon disaster prediction method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring topographic data including a target wind power plant and a peripheral area and position coordinate data of a target wind turbine generator in the wind power plant; selecting a basic terrain area for CFD simulation calculation based on the position of the target wind turbine generator in the target wind power plant; selecting a plurality of calculation domain terrains with rectangular horizontal projections, wherein the calculation domain terrains include the basic terrain area for CFD simulation calculation; taking the center of a rectangle obtained by horizontal projection of a basic terrain area as a circle center, and dividing a circumferential space area around the circle center into fan-shaped space areas with equal angles; selecting a fan-shaped space area corresponding to the wind direction of the typhoon incoming flow based on the wind direction center value of the typhoon incoming flow, and determining a calculation domain for carrying out CFD simulation calculation based on the selected fan-shaped space area. The method solves the problem that the boundary conditions of the side surfaces of the calculation domain can not be reasonably set when the wind direction of the incoming flow changes along the height of a single rectangular terrain calculation domain.

title_en: Orifice closing device for preventing mud outburst and water outburst in advance drilling process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an orifice sealing device for preventing mud outburst and water outburst in the advanced drilling process, which comprises a pre-buried orifice pipe, wherein the orifice position of the pre-buried orifice pipe is connected with an advance pipe through a flange, the outer pipe wall of the advance pipe is provided with a delivery pipe, and the delivery pipe is provided with a control valve; a convex ring is arranged on the inner wall of the advance pipe, the convex ring is positioned on one side of the delivery pipe, which is far away from the pre-buried orifice pipe, and a plurality of stacked rubber sealing rings are matched through the convex ring; the utility model discloses can avoid when construction geological disasters section, because take place the condition such as gushing water, suddenly mud, suddenly husky, can not in time the shutoff and cause secondary disaster, for the advanced reinforcement processing of geological disasters section striven for favourable time limit for a project and created favorable processing means. The method is suitable for advanced drilling of any risk underground engineering, and the construction method is simpler and more effective.

title_en: Remote sensing image classification method and device based on co-evolution convolutional neural network learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a remote sensing image classification method based on co-evolution convolutional neural network learning, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. Firstly initializing the same network with a plurality of different optimization methods, simultaneously training the initialized networks, selecting a time interval, selecting the network with highest classification accuracy on a test set after each time interval, storing all parameters of a model, endowing the stored model parameters to the rest networks in collaborative training, carrying out iterative training of the networks, discarding the model parameters with poor performance each time, and inheriting the model parameters with the best performance. Each optimization method fully plays the functions of the optimization method, achieves optimization maximization, improves convergence speed and achieves higher accuracy. The application can classify the scene of the large-scale high-resolution remote sensing image, greatly improves the accuracy of the classification of the remote sensing image, can be used in the fields of natural disaster detection and evaluation, environment monitoring and the like, reduces the misjudgment and decision making, and reduces the loss.

title_en: Emergency rescue sensing network test platform and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue sensing network test platform and a test method thereof, belonging to the technical field of wireless communication and comprising sensor nodes, a coal rock covering device and a mobile device, wherein the sensor nodes comprise fixed sensor nodes and mobile sensor nodes, the fixed sensor nodes are arranged in the coal rock covering device, and the mobile sensor nodes are arranged on the mobile device; the coal rock covering device of the emergency rescue sensing network test platform can simulate the scene that the sensor nodes are covered by coal rocks when the coal mine is subjected to catastrophe, and the mobile device can realize the movement of the sensor nodes and simulate the communication quality among different sensor nodes in a dynamic environment; the test platform can be used for researching the communication capacity of the emergency rescue sensor network node under the disaster condition, and further provides test guidance for the design of the wireless sensor network node and the post-disaster redeployment.

title_en: Distributed time-varying landform unit line-based hilly area small watershed flood forecasting method
abstract_en: A hilly area small watershed flood forecasting method based on distributed time-varying landform unit lines comprises the following steps: 1) carrying out depression filling on a drainage basin Digital Elevation Model (DEM); 2) extracting a distributed time-varying landform unit line considering rainfall intensity and underlying surface distribution characteristics; 3) and (3) combining the distributed time-varying landform unit line with the Xinanjiang model to establish a flood forecasting model, selecting a typical hilly region small drainage basin for application, and checking the practicability of the distributed time-varying landform unit line. The method considers the influence of drainage basin heterogeneity on the convergence nonlinearity of the torrential rain and flood production in the small drainage basin of the hilly area, provides a flow velocity formula considering rainfall intensity and underlying surface distribution characteristics to calculate a spatial distribution flow velocity field, extracts distributed landform unit lines with different rainfall intensities, and improves a flood forecasting model. The method is successfully applied to field flood simulation and forecast of the small watershed of the hilly area, effectively improves field flood forecast precision, and provides a new support for early warning and forecast of mountain flood disasters of the small watershed of the hilly area.

title_en: Method for preventing repeated (tsunami, storm surge, and river) disasters by forces of nature
abstract_en: [Purpose] To provide a technology to prevent repeated river, storm surge, and tsunami disasters by effectively using natural energy through the technology of "sea hollow (UTSURO)". Problem: A river is essentially a water area subject to the energy of flow due to gravity. Sediments flowing from upstream are deposited in the estuary, and in a long time, the river becomes longer, the river bed slope is decreased, the tractive force of the river is reduced, the sediments are deposited in the river channel, and the flood discharge cross-section is reduced, resulting in repeated floods. The present invention addresses the major problem of safely removing (drilling, transporting, and disposing of) huge amounts of sediments naturally deposited in the river channel, ensuring the flood discharge cross-section, and preventing repeated tsunami and storm surge disasters. Solution: In order to prevent repeated river disasters a "sea hollow (UTSURO)" is constructed in the estuary to generate intense tidal currents in a tidal water area of a river. This allows the estuary basin that has been subject to the energy of flow due to gravity to have an increased amount of tidal energy in a downstream part and to have the flow energy in the river redistributed, so that the river bed is dug deeper and the flood discharge capacity is increased, thus preventing repeated river disasters. Also, a bank body of the "sea hollow (UTSURO)" is shared, so that tsunami and storm surges can be reflected and blocked in the coastal sea area, and estuary flooding including tsunami and storm surges entering the estuary is caused to overflow into a run-up water channel constituting the "sea hollow (UTSURO)". Thus, the peaks of the floods are cut, preventing repeated river, storm surge, and tsunami disasters. Selected drawing: FIG. 2

title_en: Water area rescue training facility system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses waters rescue training facility system, concretely relates to waters rescue field, including control module, control module's output is provided with environmental simulation module, torrent and produces module and hydrologic cycle disinfection module. The utility model discloses a set up the training module, environmental simulation module and torrent produce the module, improve fire rescue personnel professional processing ability in real waters rescue task, the emulation simulation training system of specialty can not be restricted by natural environment, can simulate real waters environment and situation in all weather again, and set for and duplicate different hydrology types according to the requirement of training, system global design tightly centers on the fire control tactics, the training subjects, the rescue procedure expandes, ensure to satisfy the demand of actual combat training, the technique of maximum adoption innovation, the up-to-date software technology of make full use of, the thing allies oneself with the science and technology, modern technologies such as emulation science and technology come to realize the disaster simulation optimally, be traditional actual combat fire training service better.
assignees: JIANGSU XINLUOPU TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Hole sealing device for underground roof drilling and hole sealing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hole sealing device for underground roof drilling and a hole sealing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of hole sealing of underground roof drilling, and comprising a roof drilling hole, an orifice sleeve and grouting equipment, wherein the orifice sleeve is embedded in the roof drilling hole, a flange plate is installed on the orifice sleeve, a slurry inlet hole and a slurry return hole are formed in the flange plate, ball valves are arranged on the slurry inlet hole and the slurry return hole, a slurry return pipe is arranged in the orifice sleeve, the upper end and the lower end of the slurry return pipe respectively extend to the top end of the orifice sleeve and the slurry return hole of the flange plate, and the lower port of the slurry return pipe is in sealing connection with the slurry return hole. The invention can realize the full-height visual hole sealing function of the underground top plate drilling hole, realizes the full-height sealing of the drilling hole, thoroughly eliminates the latent threat caused by the poor sealing of the drilling hole to the tunneling of a working face, has higher safety benefit, solves the technical bottleneck which puzzles the drilling hole sealing effect of the underground top plate for a long time, and greatly reduces the cost investment of preventing and controlling the water disaster of the mine.

title_en: Neural network rock burst prediction method based on time sequence data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a neural network rock burst prediction method based on time series data, which comprises the steps of collecting rock burst data through mine data acquisition equipment and carrying out quantization treatment on main influencing factors; normalizing the quantized data and adding random noise; intercepting a quantitative time window by a sliding window method to construct sample data; dividing a training set and a verification set for time window data by a random sampling method; training the established neural network by using training set data, and adjusting network parameters by using verification set to test network performance; and predicting rock burst of the mine by using the trained neural network model to obtain danger early warning information. The method has higher reliability, provides a neural network trained by time series data, solves the problem that rock burst prediction is limited by short-time data, realizes long-term dynamic prediction of rock burst, and can effectively perform rock burst disaster early warning.

title_en: Monitoring method and device of cloud desktop equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cloud computing, and discloses a monitoring method and a monitoring device for cloud desktop equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation data of each device on the cloud desktop according to a preset data acquisition script of each device; inputting the operation data of each device into an abnormal data detection model, and outputting the operation data with abnormality, wherein the abnormal data detection model is obtained by training according to the historical operation data of each device; compared with the existing manual monitoring mode, the method and the system have the advantages that the running data with the abnormity is sent to the client side of the operation and maintenance personnel, the automatic collection and monitoring of the running data of each device on the cloud desktop are realized, and the monitoring efficiency and the real-time performance of emergency response are improved.

title_en: Building structure wind resistance analysis method considering fluid-solid coupling effect under typhoon effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building structure wind resistance analysis method considering fluid-solid coupling effect under typhoon effect, which comprises the following steps: 1) establishing a structure finite element analysis model, and analyzing the natural vibration characteristics of the structure; 2) establishing a regional multi-scale grid nesting model by using a mesoscale meteorological numerical mode WRF, and performing simulation calculation analysis on the three-dimensional typhoon wind field; 3) determining the size of a computational domain in XLow mesh-free fluid analysis software, importing a target building model file and an urban interference building model file, and establishing an urban three-dimensional fluid analysis model; 4) realizing the information coupling of the flow field with small and medium sizes; 5) and (3) defining fluid-solid coupling contact surface information aiming at a finite element model of a target building, setting fluid-solid coupling parameters in XLow software, and carrying out partition-based bidirectional fluid-solid coupling analysis. The method realizes the coupling transmission of the wind effect data information from large-scale weather of the engineering field, medium-scale urban wind environment to small-scale wind effect data information of the building structure, and is favorable for improving the typhoon disaster resistance level of the building structure.

title_en: Rapid pre-reinforcement grouting method for tunnel face excavation of deep-buried high-pressure water-rich tunnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid pre-reinforcement grouting method for excavation of a tunnel face of a deep-buried high-pressure water-rich tunnel, which comprises the following steps: determining surrounding rock parameters of the tunnel, and calculating hole distances according to the surrounding rock parameters; determining a drilling scheme according to the section area of the tunnel; carrying out regional and step-by-step drilling according to a drilling scheme, and stopping drilling when the drilling depth is reached; starting a high-pressure water jet device, cutting a rock mass within the length range of a drilling hole by using high-pressure water of a drilling arm hole, and generating a pre-crack to form a slurry diffusion channel; starting a grouting device, pressing a rock mass into quick initial setting slurry, and realizing quick diffusion of the slurry to an excavation surface by utilizing the pressure difference between the rock mass and the tunnel excavation surface; checking grouting effect, and judging whether the slurry is refilled or not according to the water seepage condition of surrounding rock of the face. The grouting method provided by the invention can realize on-site dynamic regulation and control, fully utilizes the pressure difference between the fracture water and the excavation surface, reasonably optimizes the drilling quantity, shortens the time consumption of labor, saves grouting materials, effectively reduces the occurrence frequency of disasters, and ensures the safe penetration of the high-pressure water-rich tunnel.

title_en: System and method for evaluating fire response and drilling capability of nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for evaluating fire response and drilling capability of a nuclear power plant, wherein the evaluation system comprises an analog simulation model, a fire response demand analysis model, a response and drilling model, a recording unit, an evaluation unit and a dynamic alarm model, and the analog simulation model is used for obtaining fire characteristic parameters and personnel evacuation characteristic parameters; the fire response demand analysis model determines demand data of an evaluation area for responding to fire response; the response and drilling model is used for simulating and comparing the implementation conditions of various rescue behaviors in the fire drilling process; the recording unit is used for recording various data information in the fire response and the drilling process; the evaluation unit is used for evaluating the fire response and the drilling capability and outputting the evaluation result; the dynamic alarm model is used for dynamically evaluating each index of the evaluation result and carrying out real-time early warning. The system and the method for evaluating the fire response and the drilling capability of the nuclear power plant effectively evaluate the emergency processing capability when a fire disaster occurs, so that the system and the method are convenient to deploy in advance.
assignees: SUZHOU NUCLEAR POWER RES INST;LINGAO NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Landslide surge numerical simulation result visualization system combining VR technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide surge numerical simulation result visualization method combining with VR technology, which comprises a landslide surge data system, a data conversion system and a data display system; the landslide surge data system comprises three-dimensional geographic information GIS software and FLOW3D software; the data conversion system comprises 3Ds Max software and UE4 software; the data display system comprises VR equipment and a touch display screen. According to the invention, the environment model is displayed through the VR equipment and the touch display screen, a landslide surge disaster scene is simulated in the VR display equipment, so that an experimenter can conveniently simulate the environment of the experimenter when the landslide surge disaster is in the VR scene, timely treatment is performed when the landslide surge disaster is in future life, and the experimenter can conveniently make timely judgment.

title_en: The disaster response rescuer location prediction system using the artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능을 이용한 재난대응 피구조자 위치예측시스템
abstract_en: The present invention implement a system, which utilizes the characteristic of generating or receiving a frequency signal in a state in which the rescued possesses various sensors using various radio frequencies, when performing positioning, parses the position value of the rescued person through the application of a receiving terminal, so that the parsed frequency data is used to position the rescued, and converts various position values used for positioning of the rescued into tagged data and then predicts a future predictable position, that is, the position of the rescued, through machine learning. According to the present invention, it is possible to derive a predicted position of the rescued in the future by applying the reuse of position data and machine learning.
