본 발명은 다양한 무선주파수를 이용하는 다양한 센서를 피구조자가 소지한 상태에서 주파수 신호를 발생 혹은 수신하는 특성을 이용하여 그 측위를 수행할 때 피 구조자의 위치값을 수신단의 애플리케이션을 통해 파싱 하고, 그 파싱된 주파수 데이터를 이용하여 피 구조자의 위치측위를 하게 된다. 이렇게 피구조자의 측위에 사용되는 다양한 위치 값들을 Tagging된 데이터로 변환 후 기계학습을 통해 미래의 예측 가능한 위치 즉, 피구조자의 위치를 예측하는 시스템을 만드는 것이 본 발명의 핵심 내용으로써 주파수를 발생 혹은 수신하는 피구조자의 센서의 위치측위에서의 파원과 관측자인 수신센서 사이에서 발생하는 주파수 왜곡과 도플러 효과에 의한 오차를 감안하여 피구조자 센서의 미래 위치를 예측하는 시스템을 만드는 것을 목적으로 하며 그 방식은 위치측위에 사용되는 무선신호 데이터를 맵에 매핑하여 그 데이터를 통한 위치값을 Tagging된 데이터로 변환한 후 기계학습을 통해 피구조자의 미래 예측 위치를 산출해내는 방법을 기술한 것이다. 
본 발명에 대해 보다 상세하게 설명을 하면 3차원의 공간에 존재하는 피구조자 즉, 파원을 특정 공간에 위치시킨 후 주파수를 일정한 주기로 방송토록 하고, 구조자를 통해 파원의 위치를 측위 하는 데이터를 얻고, 그 위치데이터를 통해 미래의 그 피구조자가 위치하게 될 위치데이터를 예측하는 방법을 기술한 발명이다. 구체적으로는 피구조자의 현재 위치데이터에 대하여 Tagging하게 되는데 그 Tagging하는 방법이 피구조자 위치측위 알고리즘이며,Tagging된 데이터를 이용하여 예측모형을 구현하는 것이 인공지능 피구조자 위치예측 알고리즘이다. 본 발명에서는 예측가능한 모형의 생성 및 훈련 및 학습 그리고 예측평가 부분을 융합한 것으로써 슈퍼바이즈드 러닝의 추상화와 일반화 모델을 통한 예측 모형으로 저장된 데이터를 좀 더 포괄적 형태와 개념으로 변환하고, 또한 그 저장된 데이터에 숨겨져 있는 패턴을 구체적으로 예측하도록 하는 방식을 표현하는 것이다.  
본 발명을 구체화 하기위해 피구조 대상자의 주파수 인식단계, 피구조자 소유 센서의 3차원 위치값 부여단계, 2차원 센서 위치값으로 변환단계, 2차원 위치값에 대한 예측변수포함단계, 2차원 위치값을 데이터베이스에 저장단계, 머신러닝을 통한 위치 예측값 도출단계, 위치 예측값의 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계, 피구조자 센서의 위치예측값 도출단계, 피구조자 위치 예측값과 실제값 확인단계로 구현할 수 있으며, 
첫 단계인 피구조자로부터 발생되는 주파수의 발생과 인식단계부터 마지막 단계인 피구조자의 위치예측값과 실제 현재 위치값 확인단계를 통해 보다 높은 정확도의 위치예측 값을 계속적으로 도출해내는 과정을 반복함으로써 위치데이터가 많이 쌓이면 쌓일수록 피구조자의 위치예측의 정확도가 높아진다. 이것을 구체화하기 위해 3차원 공간에서 센서네트워크를 형성함으로서 그 공간을 측위를 위한 환경으로 구성하는 것이고, 스캐너를 통해 그 피구조자의 현재 위치를 측위 할 수 있게 된다. 이런 센서네트워크에서 공간의 인식을 3차원 즉, 실제 공간 그 자체로 그대로 2차원 좌표값을 부여하며, 그 2차원 좌표값이 실제 3차원 좌표 값이 되는 것을 증명한다. 이 실제 좌표 값은 본 발명에서 최종적으로 위치예측데이터의 예측 값과 비교되어 미래의 가장 정확성이 높은 예측 값을 다시 채택하여 위치예측의 정확도를 높인다. 구체적으로는 3차원의 큐브로 도출한 큐브는 V0부터 V7까지의 꼭짓점 값으로 함축하여 위치데이터를 표현할 수 있다. 즉, V0,V1,V2,V3,V4,V5,V6,V7이 V0,V1,V2,V3,V6,V7로 데이터 값을 함축할 수 있다. 또한 V0,V1,V2,V3,V6,V7는 다시 V0,V1,V6,V7로 사각형을 형성하며 4개의 값을 가지는 2차원 위치데이터로 변환할 수 있다. 이때 이 위치데이터는 실제 위치데이터가 아닌 실제 센서가 위치한 3차원 좌표값의 전체 큐브 중 피구조자가 포함되어 있는 큐브의 위치데이터가 된다. 이렇게 도출된 큐브의 꼭짓점 값인 V0,V1,V6,V7은 2차원 좌표값에 표시하기 위해 사용되어 지는데, 이것은 본 발명에서 피구조자의 실제 위치인 3차원의 위치값을 2차원의 위치값으로 변환하는 방법에 대한 발명이다. 즉, 3차원의 위치측위값은 큐브의 재 정의를 통해 2차원의 위치값으로 변경된다.  
변경되는 방식은 A=V0,V1,V6,V7 로서 2차원 좌표값에서 A의 값을 지정한다. A의 좌표값은 가로축인 VX와 세로축인 VY가 교차하는 점으로써 A=V0,V1,V6,V7 은 AVX, AVY로 치환할 수 있다. 
즉, V0,V1,V2,V3,V4,V5,V6,V7의 꼭짓점을 갖는 3차원의 큐브가 V0,V1,V6,V7의 꼭짓점을 갖는 2차원의 평면으로 변경되었다. 이 변경된 위치값은 2차원의 평면에서 위치값으로써 도면의 교차점에 좌표로 표시할 수 있다. 2차원 공간의 B의 위치값 V0,V1,V6,V7은 V0,V1,V2,V3,V4,V5,V6,V7의 꼭짓점을 갖는 3차원의 큐브에 속한 위치값을 가지게 된다. 
본 발명에서는 일반적인 좌표값이 교차되는 지점이 아닌 피구조자가 존재하는 큐브를 3차원 좌표값 큐브를 예측 위치값으로 가정할 수 있다. 이것이 위치예측을 위한 2차원과 3차원의 위치측위를 위한 데이터의 전환 알고리즘이다. 
실제로 3차원에 존재하는 피구조자의 위치값을 2차원으로 변환하여 예측데이터를 생성하고 그것을 다시 실제 3차원데이터로 변환하여 실제 위치와 비교하여 실제 위치를 측위 함으로써 위치예측데이터를 쉽게 도출할 수 있다.  
만약 현재의 3차원에서의 피구조자의 위치가 A라는 값을 가진다면 이 피구조자의 향후 위치는 A나 B나 C로 이동할 수 있다는 것이고, 그 이동경로는 기준점인  를 기준으로 설정된  1,  2,  3을 기준으로  A,  B,  C로 그 경로를 예측할 수 있다. 그렇게 이동할 수 있는 기준점과 기준선 그리고 기준경로가 정해져 있으므로 A에서 B 그리고 C로 이동하여 A의 향후 예측위치가 A , B , C중 한곳으로 정해질 수 있음을 반증한다. 
3차원 공간에서 A의 위치가 A, B, C로 변경되는 예측모델은 기준점   와 기준선  1,  2,  3 그리고 기준경로  A,  B,  C 에 예속될 수밖에 없다. 즉,  의 방위각을 갖는 3차원에서 A의 위치이동은 기준점과 기준선 그리고 기준경로에서 벗어날 수 없으므로 그 예측위치 또한 벗어날 수 없다.  
이상과 같이 설정된 기준점과 기준선 그리고 기준경로는 최초 A의 위치측위로부터 시작된다.  
2차원 좌표값에서 기준점과 기준선 그리고 기준경로 및 현재의 위치를 정의한 후 실제 피구조자의 위치를 관측하는 스캐너(스마트폰)에서는 수신 위치데이터를 기준으로 학습을 위한 데이터를 Tagging하는데, 현재의 위치값과 미래의 위치값을 Clustering = > Classification => Decision Tree를 통해 얻어진 데이터는  1,  2,  3 범위 안에 포함되므로, 예측값의 범위 안에 존재하게 된다는 결론을 얻은 부분에 대해서 최종적으로 기계학습을 통한 위치예측을 수행할 수 있다. 
도3의 302그림은 2차원도면위에 존재하는 현재 A의 위치에 존재하는 피구조자의 위치는  Deep Learning을 통해 현재 위치가 A일 경우, A가 아닐 경우, B일 경우, B가 아닐 경우, C일 경우, C가 아닐 경우 의 경우의 케이스를 비 학습데이터를 삽입하여 그것이 위치예측을 위한 기준점  와 근접관계를 형성하는지  A와 근접관계를 형성하는지  B와 근접관계를 형성하는지  C와 근접관계를 형성하는지 판단한다.  ,  A,  B,  C로 부터 얻은 데이터를 기반으로 위치의 이동 범위를 설정할 수 있는 가능성을 
판단하는 있는 기준선인  1,  2,  3를 재 매핑시킴으로써 최종적으로 현재 피구조자의 위치인 A는 주어진 일정시간 후에 V의 값을 가지게 된다. 이 V는 현재 2차원 좌표값에서 X, Y, Z의 위치값을 가지며, 위치와 시간과 주파수 및 측정시점을 기준으로 현재와 과거 그리고 미래를 아우르는 가능성 높은 위치예측값을 도출할 수 있다. 이렇게 도출된 V의 값은 2차원의 V0,V1,V6,V7이므로 도2에서 기술한 것처럼 V0,V1,V2,V3,V4,V5,V6,V7의 꼭짓점을 갖는 3차원의 큐브에 속한 위치값으로 변환된다. 
이상이 본 발명의 두 번째 알고리즘인 인공지능 기계학습의 예측가능한 모형의 생성 및 훈련 및 학습 부분이다.  
서두에서 밝힌바와 같이 본 발명은 위치측위 알고리즘과 인공지능의 학습 및 예측을 융합한 발명이다. 측위알고리즘을 통해 얻어진 데이터에 대하여 데이터 Tagging작업을 수행하고, 그 Tagging된 데이터를 기반으로 어떤 방식으로 학습과 예측모델을 구현해 내는지가 본 발명의 인공지능 예측 알고리즘이다. 
본 발명은 위치데이터의 재사용 및 기계학습을 적용함으로써 향후 피구조자의 예측위치를 도출할 수 있으며, 이 기술은 관찰대상자(노약자, 어린이, 범죄자)의 예상동선과 목적지 추적 및 재난안전 대피기술, 피구조자 탐색기술, 해양수중 어로탐지예측기술, 자율주행차 사고예측기술 또한 공장자동화의 작업위치에 대한 생산성증대 기술까지 광범위하게 활용될 수 있다.

title_en: Real-time intelligent early warning method applied to TBM tunnel rockburst disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time intelligent early warning method applied to TBM tunnel rockburst disasters, which comprises the following steps: constructing a micro-seismic monitoring platform; reducing the dimension to obtain a microseismic data matrix after dimension reduction; clustering microseismic events in the microseismic data matrix after dimension reduction; constructing a precursor microseismic sequence database; establishing a classification regression tree; training a classification regression tree; the invention provides a real-time rock burst disaster intensity early warning method in the tunneling process of a full-face tunnel boring machine, overcomes the problems of low efficiency, inaccurate report, strong subjectivity and experience dependence and the like of the traditional manual method, and has important significance for safe and efficient tunneling of the full-face tunnel boring machine.
assignees: INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Disaster emergency training method based on motion capture positioning and scene simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster emergency training method based on motion capture positioning and scene simulation, which relates to the field of emergency training and comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a virtual disaster scene with the size of 1:1 of the real world in a three-dimensional mode; s2, constructing a virtual prop of the real prop 1:1 in three dimensions; s3, constructing a virtual dummy 1:1 in three dimensions, wherein the virtual dummy needs emergency operation; s4, binding the virtual prop and the rigid body of the dummy and matching the corresponding model and skeleton; and S5, rendering the three-dimensional digital model driven by the motion capture data through a 3D engine, and transmitting the scene data to VR glasses in real time. According to the technical scheme, more accurate virtual scenes and positioning of the props can be obtained through the motion capture camera, so that the simulation training of operators is smoother and more real, the physical and psychological bearing capacity of emergency personnel is trained in advance, and more abundant emergency experience is accumulated.

title_en: Method for mining overburden non-blasting presplitting pressure relief prevention and control dynamic disasters in deep coal seam
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preventing and controlling dynamic disasters by non-blasting presplitting pressure relief of overburden rock in deep coal seam exploitation, which comprises the following steps: drilling inclined holes from the roadway on two sides to the unexplored coal rock mass by utilizing a drilling machine to reach a target level of a top plate of the direct coal seam; preparing a soundless breaking agent SCDA; adding water to stir a silent crushing agent SCDA to prepare SCDA plastic slurry; wrapping the SCDA plastic slurry with a long column-shaped PVDC film; drilling holes for filling PVDC film inclusion of SCDA plastic slurry to a target horizon; plugging in the hole after filling, and installing a drilling hole packer outside the target rock interval in the hole; after the material filling and the drilling plugging are completed, after the soundless breaker SCDA generates full hydration reaction, the expansion effect is generated to crack the rock to release stress, and the non-blasting pre-cracking pressure relief of the coal seam roof is completed. The invention is economical, effective and green, prevents and controls mine dynamic disasters, and provides guarantee for the safe quality production and construction of mining areas.

title_en: Anti-fault-breaking structure of drilling and blasting tunnel for crossing active fault
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnels and underground engineering, in particular to a drilling and blasting tunnel anti-dislocation structure for passing through a movable fault, which comprises a fault crushing zone expanding and digging section, a transition section and a common section, wherein the fault crushing zone expanding and digging section is positioned in a fault crushing zone, the common section is positioned in an upper disc and a lower disc with better lithology, the transition section is positioned between the fault crushing zone expanding and digging section and the common section, deformation joints are arranged on the anti-dislocation structure every other preset length, and water stopping structures are arranged between the joints. The anti-dislocation structure can adapt to the large displacement dislocation of the active fault and greatly reduce the expanding excavation amount; the fault dislocation device can adapt to fault dislocation in any direction, and the situation that the fault dislocation direction is uncertain is guaranteed; the water stopping structure is simple in arrangement; when the fault is dislocated, the secondary lining is not damaged, the stability and the safety of the internal structure of the tunnel are ensured, and the workload of post-disaster repair is small.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating stability of transmission tower under geological disaster condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating stability of a transmission tower under geological disaster conditions, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an influence factor set of a transmission tower, and reducing the influence factor set of the transmission tower; constructing a local linear relation between the actual strength degradation rate of the tower material and the reduced influence factor set of the transmission tower, and calculating the degradation rate of the actual strength of the tower material of the tower by using the local linear relation; according to the degradation rate of the actual strength of the tower material of the tower, the danger grades of the transmission towers are classified; detecting the stress borne by the test rod piece by using a stress meter, and calculating the equivalent stress of the rod piece; according to the equivalent stress of the rod piece, introducing each reduction coefficient to correct the judgment method of the rod piece failure, and obtaining a formula for judging the rod piece failure; and evaluating the stability of the rod. According to the method, the influence condition of geological change on the transmission tower is simulated, so that the influence weight of geological disasters on the stability of the transmission tower is obtained, and a reliable standard is provided for evaluating the stability of the tower on the site.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Device and method for quickly forming high polymer miniature pile under emergency rescue and disaster relief conditions
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering pile foundation and landslide control. The device comprises a pile foundation outer sleeve, an anti-slide pile die and a limiting locking unit, wherein the anti-slide pile die is arranged in the pile foundation outer sleeve in a matching manner, a drill bit is arranged at the lower end of the anti-slide pile die, and a grouting hole is formed in the middle of the anti-slide pile die; the limiting locking unit is used for enabling the pile foundation outer sleeve to be relatively fixed with the anti-slide pile mould in the sinking process, and the anti-slide pile mould can be pulled out upwards and freely relative to the pile foundation outer sleeve. Also discloses a rapid molding method of the high polymer micro-pile under the emergency rescue and disaster relief conditions. The miniature slide-resistant pile retaining structure can be used for emergency reinforcement of the side slope under emergency rescue and disaster relief conditions, is high in forming speed, free of water reaction, economical, durable and convenient in process, and can resist adverse geological influence and reinforce the side slope.

title_en: Disaster recovery system verification method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a disaster recovery system verification method and a disaster recovery system verification device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a disaster recovery drilling instruction, wherein the disaster recovery drilling instruction indicates disaster recovery drilling items; obtaining at least one service case associated with the disaster recovery drilling project, wherein a test value of at least one service data field required by disaster recovery verification is recorded in the service case; aiming at each business case in the at least one business case, obtaining a verification message template related to the business case, and constructing a verification message based on the test value of at least one business data field in the business case and the verification message template to obtain at least one verification message; sending the at least one verification message to a disaster recovery backup system; and obtaining a verification test result of the at least one verification message returned by the disaster recovery backup system. The scheme of the application can carry out the validity and availability verification of the service and the system on the disaster backup system in the bank more conveniently and efficiently.

title_en: Test system and method for simulating deformation and damage of wind-rain weather landslide pile structure system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test system and a test method for simulating deformation and damage of a landslide pile structure system in wind and rain climate, wherein the system comprises the following steps: a model system; a wind and rain simulation system; the wind and rain simulation system comprises a simulation controller, a wind simulation mechanism and a rain simulation mechanism, wherein the simulation controller is respectively connected with the wind simulation mechanism and the rain simulation mechanism, the wind simulation mechanism applies a load matched with the wind and rain requirements to the pile structure, and the rain simulation mechanism applies rainfall matched with the wind and rain requirements to the landslide pile structure system; an image system; a displacement mechanism; a landslide sensor; and, a data acquisition system; the data acquisition system is respectively connected with the displacement mechanism and the landslide sensor. The method realizes multi-azimuth and multi-information detection, more accurately grasps the deformation instability and damage evolution law of the landslide pile structure system on the time scale and the space scale, and has very important theoretical significance and practical value for researching the characteristics of the landslide pile structure system and disclosing the disaster mode and mechanism of the pile structure.

title_en: BIM-based building fire easy ignition point determination method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building fire easy ignition point determination method based on BIM, which comprises the following specific steps: (1) building model construction and optimization; (2) building exterior ambient light environment simulation based on BIM; (3) building periphery wind environment simulation based on BIM; (4) building indoor wind environment simulation based on BIM; (5) BIM-based building fire susceptibility determination strategies. The invention has the advantages that: 1) a method for simulating the peripheral wind environment and the solar radiation of a building is provided; 2) the fire numerical simulation is carried out on the building, so that the rule of smoke spreading in the building and the determination of the critical value which has harmful influence on human bodies are disclosed; 3) the position of the easy ignition point of the building when the fire occurs is scientifically determined, and the disaster is effectively reduced; 4) providing scientific theoretical basis and technical support for preventing fire of buildings.

title_en: Agricultural insurance claim settlement method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an agricultural insurance claim settlement method, including: training a machine learning model based on historical disaster-stricken data; determining the disaster type of the crops based on the real-time remote sensing image and the machine learning model; determining the disaster level of the crop based on the real-time remote sensing image, the machine learning model and the object data stored on the block chain; the method and the device for agricultural insurance claim settlement and the storage medium are used for improving the efficiency of agricultural insurance claim settlement.
assignees: ZALL SMART COMMERCE WUHAN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Manual fire alarm button collision test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a manual fire alarm button collision test device, a heating box is fixedly arranged at the top of a base, a fixed plate and a collision device are arranged in the heating box, a fixing device is arranged in the fixed plate, the collision device comprises an electric push rod, a swing motor box and a collision hammer, a swing motor is arranged, a connecting rod is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the swing motor, and a collision hammer connecting piece is hinged at the tail end of the connecting rod; the heating box is hinged with a box door, the box door is provided with a control box, and the control box is provided with a temperature setting button, a time setting button and a display. Compared with the prior art, the utility model the advantage lie in: the electric push rod can lift the collision hammer, the connecting rod is hinged with the collision hammer connecting piece, the collision hammer is rotatably connected with the collision hammer connecting piece, and collision of heavy objects on a manual fire alarm button from various angles can be simulated; the device is provided with the heating box, simulates the high-temperature environment after the fire disaster occurs, and has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation and good simulation effect.
assignees: SHANDONG HESHUO INTELLIGENT ENG CO LTD

title_en: Experimental device for be used for simulating fire-entry suit smoke pollution
abstract_en: The utility model provides an experimental device for simulating smoke pollution of a fire-entry suit, which comprises a closed box body, wherein a smoke generating mechanism and a pollution mechanism are arranged in the box body, and the pollution mechanism is positioned beside the smoke generating mechanism; the fuming mechanism comprises a sample table for placing a combustion raw material; the pollution mechanism comprises a support and a fabric clamp which is arranged on the support and used for clamping fire-fighting fabric experiment fabric. A experimental apparatus for simulating firefighter uniform smoke pollution, smoke smokes the environment to the firefighter uniform that wears when catching fire in the imitation building, is close with the protection clothing pollution mechanism of putting out a fire of reality, is favorable to preparing the outer surface fabric of protection uniform of putting out a fire, and this experimental apparatus can simulate the pollution of different scene of a fire flue gas to the experiment surface fabric according to combustion material's difference simultaneously.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Remote sensing target detection method based on single-stage full convolution network and multi-feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing target detection method based on a single-stage full convolution network and multi-feature fusion, which mainly solves the problem that the target features of an optical remote sensing image are not fully extracted in the prior art. The implementation scheme is as follows: 1) Respectively extracting mathematical morphology characteristics, linear scale space characteristics and nonlinear scale space characteristics of original data and fusing the three characteristics to obtain a fused characteristic diagram; 2) Dividing the fusion characteristic diagram into a training data set and a test data set, and performing small-target expansion on the training data set; 3) Constructing a target detection network, and training the network on a training data set after target expansion by using a gradient descent algorithm; 4) And testing the test data set by using the trained network to obtain a detection result. The method enhances the contour characteristics and the edge characteristics of the target, is favorable for improving the accuracy of target detection, and can be used for resource exploration, natural disaster assessment and target identification.

title_en: Landslide disaster simulation test device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard simulation test device, which relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring and comprises a test box, a precipitation device, a vibration device, a slope cutting device, an accumulation area device, a monitoring device, a photographic device and a data receiving device, wherein the test box is arranged on the vibration device and used for placing a landslide object source body; the slope cutting device comprises a plurality of automatic slope cutting assemblies which are vertically arranged, and the respective automatic slope cutting assemblies can be slidably arranged on the frame body; the monitoring device comprises an SAA monitoring assembly, a GNSS monitoring assembly, a soil water content monitoring assembly and a pore water pressure monitoring assembly, wherein the SAA monitoring assembly, the soil water content monitoring assembly and the pore water pressure monitoring assembly are all used for being buried at the rear end of the landslide source body, and the GNSS monitoring assembly is used for being arranged on the surface of the rear end of the landslide source body. The device can monitor the starting, migration and accumulation conditions of landslide source bodies under the action of rainfall, vibration, slope cutting independent working conditions and combined working conditions.
assignees: BEIJING INST OF GEOLOGICAL & PROSPECTING ENGINEERING

title_en: Method and system for determining parameters of superfine water mist fire extinguishing system based on FLUENT calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining parameters of a superfine water mist fire extinguishing system based on FLUENT calculation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a combustion model based on a combustion type of the superfine water mist fire extinguishing system when a fire disaster occurs on an installation site; step 2, modeling and meshing are carried out in FLUENT software based on the combustion model, the water mist concentration required for fire extinguishing is determined through simulation calculation, and parameters of the superfine water mist fire extinguishing system to be established are obtained; wherein, the space of the interaction of the superfine water mist and the flame is simplified into a 2D axisymmetric calculation area. The invention simulates the fire extinguishing result of the superfine water mist with different concentrations through FLUENT, and can accurately determine various parameters of the superfine water mist fire extinguishing system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Road torrential flood vulnerability evaluation method based on GIS and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road torrential flood vulnerability evaluation method based on GIS and machine learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, selecting grid cells as basic evaluation units, and determining the size of the grid cells according to the size of the research area; the length and width of the grid unit do not exceed 5 km; s2, establishing an index system for evaluating the vulnerability of the road torrential flood through researching and analyzing the action mechanism of the torrential flood disaster on the road; s3, establishing an SVM model for road torrential flood vulnerability evaluation based on a support vector machine; s4, establishing an SVM training data set and a test data set; s5, training and testing an SVM model; and S6, obtaining the vulnerability evaluation result of the road in the cell according to the exposure degree of the road in the grid cell obtained after calculating the road cost and the disaster reduction force obtained by the SVM model output, and carrying out mapping and analysis. The evaluation method provided by the invention has the advantages of accurate calculation, reliable principle and easy and simple operation process, and can be widely applied to the requirement of road torrential flood vulnerability evaluation.

title_en: Method for preventing and treating dynamic disasters by long-drill-hole subsection fixed-point controlled fracturing
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preventing and treating dynamic disasters by long-drill-hole subsection fixed-point controlled fracturing, and belongs to the technical field of roadway dynamic disaster prevention and treatment. According to the method, a long drill hole is constructed in front of a roadway, pre-slotting is carried out on each fracturing section in the hole according to fracturing design, the fracturing initiation direction is controlled, and the fracturing initiation pressure is reduced. High-precision microseismic monitoring systems are arranged around a roadway in advance before fracturing, the fracturing range and effect are monitored, the fracturing range is controlled in the roadway tunneling surrounding rock stress disturbance range, the problem that the control effect cannot be achieved due to the small fracturing range and the resource waste is caused due to the overlarge fracturing range is avoided. In the process of drilling and fracturing, the staged fracturing distance is adjusted according to the microseismic monitoring result, and the fracturing effect is prevented from being reduced due to overlarge fracturing distance. The method has simple process and obvious effect of preventing and controlling the dynamic disaster, not only can release the elastic energy accumulated in the surrounding rock in advance to reduce the occurrence of the dynamic disaster, but also can prevent the energy accumulation of the surrounding rock in the tunneling process.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH;Shandong energy group co ltd;YANZHOU COAL MINING HEZE ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD ZHAOLOU COAL MINE;HEBEI HAOWEI XUGUANG NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic disaster testing system and method for water and mud inrush caused by deep tunnel crossing active fracture
abstract_en: The utility model provides a deeply buried tunnel passes through active fracture gushing water gushing mud dynamic disaster test system, includes: the middle position in the box body is filled with similar broken materials, and the periphery of the inside of the box body, which is broken, is filled with similar broken materials of the tunnel surrounding rocks of the upper and lower trays; the first end of the box body is provided with a through hole for simulating tunnel excavation, the side part of the box body is provided with a osmotic pressure loading unit, the top of the box body is closed and is provided with a ground stress loading unit, a fracture dislocation unit is arranged in the box body at a position close to the second end of the box body, and a vibration load loading point which is contacted with the earthquake vibration loading unit is arranged at a position close to the first end of the bottom in the box body; the method can simulate the water and mud bursting disaster of the tunnel passing through the active fracture under the water-force coupling condition, research the evolution law of the internal stress, the displacement and the seepage of the water-isolated rock mass and the fracture mechanism of the water-isolated rock mass in the process of the tunnel adjacent to the fracture under the action of fracture dislocation and earthquake vibration, and disclose the disaster pregnancy mode and the disaster causing mechanism.

title_en: Deep goaf double-target-point controlled directional detection and treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a directional detection and treatment method, belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and control of a goaf, and particularly relates to a double-target-point controlled directional detection and treatment method for a deep goaf. According to the method, a small directional drilling field is arranged on the ground, a controlled double-target directional drilling hole is constructed from the ground surface to a bedrock section in a stratum by using a directional drilling machine, a reasonable grouting filling scheme is formulated on the basis of exploring the range, the form and the overburden rock failure characteristics of a goaf caving fracture zone and evaluating the stability of the goaf, grouting filling is performed on residual cavities and cracks between broken rock masses in the goaf caving fracture zone, the deep goaf activation space is thoroughly eliminated, and the grouting effect is effectively improved.

title_en: Method for rapidly extracting bursting flood submerging range
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid extraction method of a burst flood submerging range. In the cloud-free area, constructing an optical image time sequence spectral index, extracting an optimal separation flood index and a threshold value thereof in a crossed flood area according to the spectral index difference before and after the flood crosses the border, and extracting the flood submerging range; in a cloud layer sheltering area, according to the change of the SAR image backscattering coefficients before and after flood crossing, VV and VH polarization data and DEM data are extracted to construct a characteristic set, a training sample is constructed by using cloud-free area data, a cloud layer covering area is used as a prediction sample, and a random forest algorithm is adopted to extract the crossing flood submerging range of the cloud layer sheltering area. The method can rapidly acquire the burst flood submerging range on the premise of not depending on the remote sensing image of the flood peak value, and is favorable for rapid evaluation and emergency response of flood disasters.

title_en: Elastic power distribution network panoramic information visualization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for visualizing panoramic information of an elastic power distribution network, which are used for monitoring system data information in real time, calculating and displaying dynamic elastic indexes of the power distribution network, carrying out fine early warning on the system according to index thresholds and marking risk elements; and (3) simulating extreme disaster weather in an off-line manner, calculating and displaying the comprehensive elasticity score of the power distribution network, sorting the importance of the power distribution network elements, and marking the power distribution network element with the highest importance. The invention reflects the elastic change of the power distribution network through two levels of off-line evaluation, on-line monitoring and the like, and further performs visual display through a panoramic information visualization system, thereby not only guiding an element strengthening scheme and a resource allocation strategy from a planning level, but also assisting workers to perform emergency scheduling and quick recovery from an operation level.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Apple yield prediction method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a prediction method, a prediction device, a storage medium and electronic equipment for apple yield, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be predicted; the data to be predicted comprises disaster sample data in a target time period and weather sample data of each day; inputting the data to be predicted into a yield prediction model to obtain a prediction result of the yield of the apples in the time period to be predicted; the disaster sample data in the target time period and the meteorological sample data in each day are used for predicting the apple yield in the same year in the time period to be predicted; the yield prediction model is obtained by training a plurality of sample data, and each sample data comprises disaster sample data in a preset time period, meteorological sample data of each day and apple yield sample data of the same year as the preset time period. The apple yield prediction method solves the problems that the existing apple yield prediction method is not universal and cannot accurately predict apple yield.
assignees: BEIJING GAGO WORLD TECH CO LTD;INFORMATION CENTER OF THE MINI OF AGRICULTURE AND RURAL AFFAIRS

title_en: Landslide dam break disaster chain evolution process simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landslide dam break disaster chain evolution process analogue means relates to disaster process simulation field. The utility model provides a landslide dam-break disaster chain evolution process analogue means, including the industrial control machine, the base is installed to the industrial control machine rear side, and the pedestal top surface installs elevating system, elevating system opposite side fixed mounting has the conveyer belt, and conveyer belt both sides fixed mounting has the curb plate, the landslide simulator is installed to the lateral wall face in the curb plate, and curb plate rear end face fixed mounting has the pole setting, the post is installed in the rotation of pole setting top, and post outer anchor ring rear side is connected with the rotation closed door, angle adjusting mechanism is installed to conveyer belt right side wall, and angle adjusting mechanism opposite side installs the underframe, the underframe bottom surface rotates and installs the motion gyro wheel, the axle bed is installed in the rotation of conveyer belt right side. The utility model provides a traditional analogue means simulation effect poor, mostly be single analogue means, the problem that the relevant parameter of equipment is difficult to the regulation.

title_en: Brake device of unmanned locomotive
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a brake device of an unmanned locomotive, which comprises a device main body, wherein the device main body comprises a pull rod, a pushing device, a first brake rod, a vacuum booster, a second brake rod, a brake main cylinder and a pedal, the pushing device is arranged above the pull rod, the lower part of the pull rod is connected with the pedal, one side of the pull rod is provided with the first brake rod, one side of the first brake rod is connected with the vacuum booster, one side of the vacuum booster is connected with the second brake rod, and one side of the second brake rod is connected with the brake main cylinder; the pushing device can effectively achieve the braking effect, manual braking can be adopted if automatic braking cannot be achieved under the extreme condition, the safety of personnel in the vehicle is guaranteed to a great extent, disasters are avoided, and meanwhile braking force is simulated through cooperation of the pushing device and the vacuum booster, so that the braking effect is effectively achieved.
assignees: AJ AUTOMATION TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting fault permeability by utilizing natural gamma logging of drill hole
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting fault permeability by utilizing borehole natural gamma logging, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting hydrogeological test and borehole natural gamma-ray logging curve data of the mine and surrounding adjacent mines; s2, calculating permeability coefficients and natural gamma logging values of the stratums of the hydrogeological test section; s3, determining the type of the functional relationship between the formation permeability coefficient and the natural gamma logging data, and establishing a relational expression between the permeability coefficient and the natural gamma logging value; s4, verifying whether the obtained relational expression can accurately reflect the relation between the formation permeability coefficient and the natural gamma logging data; and S5, further combining the collected and counted natural gamma log values of the borehole exposure fault section, and predicting to obtain the fault permeability coefficient. The prediction method is simple and practical, can preliminarily predict the fault permeability at lower cost, and has important significance for preventing and controlling the water disaster of the mine.

title_en: Method for evaluating thermal runaway explosion hazard of battery
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method for evaluating thermal runaway explosion hazard of a battery. In the embodiment of the invention, the battery monomer is arranged in the closed container; triggering the thermal runaway of the battery monomer; after the thermal runaway of the battery monomer is finished, testing the type and the component proportion of combustible gas in the closed container; preparing combustible mixed gas with equal type and equal component proportion according to the type and the component proportion of the combustible gas; charging the combustible mixed gas into the battery system to be tested until reaching a specific percentage of the opening pressure of the explosion-proof valve of the battery system to be tested; igniting the combustible mixed gas in the battery system; and testing the explosion shock wave pressure of the combustible mixed gas. The embodiment of the invention can realize rapid and accurate simulation of the explosion scene of the battery system under the condition of open fire ignition after a large amount of combustible gas is gathered due to thermal runaway of the battery, and can realize artificial and accurate control of the explosion moment, thereby realizing safe and controllable test of the explosion intensity and secondary disasters of the battery system.

title_en: Power equipment fault image recognition disaster investigation system and method based on multiple DCNN networks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power equipment fault image recognition disaster investigation system based on a plurality of DCNN networks, wherein a data set preparation module is used for obtaining an image data set of damaged power equipment and dividing the image data set into a training set and a testing set, and then preprocessing the training set and the testing set; the image feature extraction module extracts global features and local features of the preprocessed training set; the feature fusion module obtains joint features; the classification network training module diagnoses the images in the test set by using the test set and the convolutional neural network of the DCNN which determines the hierarchical structure of the convolutional layer, the full-connection layer and the pooling layer, and confirms the image fault labels of the images in the test set. The invention can solve the problems of low fault detection speed and low accuracy of key components of the post-disaster on-site power equipment in the prior art.

title_en: Geological disaster model display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster model display device, which comprises an installation box, an earthquake driving simulation component, a geological sand table and a driving top cover component, wherein the top inner wall of the installation box is connected with the geological sand table through the earthquake driving simulation component; the bottom inner wall of the mounting box is provided with a mounting plate, sliding blocks are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the outer walls of two sides of the bottom end of the mounting plate, a sliding groove is formed in the inner wall of the bottom end of the mounting box, the bottom end of each sliding block is inserted into the corresponding sliding groove, a spring is fixedly connected to the inner wall of one side of each sliding groove, and a first cam is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the other end of each sliding groove through a rotating shaft; the utility model discloses a setting of seismic drive simulation subassembly can realize the transverse wave earthquake and the earthquake's of longitudinal wave simulation of geology sand table through cam drive, does benefit to the more comprehensive show of geological disasters, and the setting of drive top cap subassembly plays the effect of protection to the geological disasters model, reduces the emergence of destruction problem, has guaranteed the accuracy nature of geological disasters model show.

title_en: Emergency rescue drilling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue drilling system and method, wherein the method comprises a disaster site information acquisition module for acquiring information of a disaster event site; the scene construction module constructs a corresponding disaster event scene model according to the received information of the disaster event scene; the interaction device acquires scene setting information of the disaster event scene model; the emergency processing deduction module generates a disaster development trend result according to the disaster event scene model and the scene setting information; the emergency resource scheduling module generates an emergency resource allocation scheme according to the disaster development trend result; the interaction device acquires deployment information of emergency rescue force according to a disaster development trend result and generates an emergency rescue scheme; the emergency rescue command module generates an emergency rescue command log according to the received emergency resource allocation scheme and the emergency rescue scheme, can effectively improve the authenticity and the degree of contact of the simulated disaster emergency event, and improves the timeliness and the accuracy of emergency rescue.

title_en: Construction method and device of inland waterway digital twin scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for constructing a digital twin scene of a inland waterway, which relate to the technical field of traffic informatization and virtual reality and are used for solving the problems of video fragmentation, multi-source internet-of-things data separation and lack of relevance existing in current inland waterway supervision. The construction method of the inland waterway digital twin scene comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-scale channel scene, fusing multiple paths of videos in three-dimensional real time, and converging and fusing digital asset three-dimensional labels and Internet of things sensing data. The construction method and the construction device for the digital twin scene of the inland waterway are used for digitally creating the digital twin scene of the real inland waterway scene by utilizing the digital twin technology, so that the accurate positioning capability and the emergency response efficiency of intelligent management of the inland waterway are greatly improved.

title_en: Personnel emergency evacuation simulation method considering radioactivity influence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a personnel emergency evacuation simulation method considering radioactive influence, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out scene modeling, then judging personnel evacuation available path areas by considering the influence of radioactive substance distribution, carrying out static path planning, simulating interaction between people and obstacles by adopting a proper personnel behavior model in the personnel evacuation process so as to obtain personnel speed and density data in the whole evacuation process, comprehensively considering radioactive substance distribution, path distance and transit time influence factors, and timely adjusting personnel evacuation paths to realize dynamic path planning. The invention can provide auxiliary tools for making and perfecting the emergency plan with high efficiency, improves the operability of the emergency plan, and has positive effects on reducing the influence of serious accidents of the nuclear power plant on people and the environment.

title_en: Ground station and remote sensing observation rainfall data fusion method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for fusing ground station and remote sensing observation precipitation data, which are used for carrying out spatial downscaling on the remote sensing precipitation data of a first resolution by using a surface-to-point kriging interpolation method to obtain a remote sensing precipitation downscaling result of a second resolution, constructing and training a space-time fusion model for expressing the relation between the precipitation and an auxiliary parameter on the basis of a space-time geography weighted regression method and a space-time kriging interpolation method on the remote sensing precipitation downscaling result of the second resolution, the auxiliary parameter and the ground station precipitation actual measurement data, and adding a precipitation trend estimated value of the second resolution output by the space-time fusion model and a residual estimated value of the second resolution to realize error correction of the remote sensing precipitation downscaling result to obtain a precipitation data product of the second resolution with high precision, wherein the precipitation data product can be applied to hydrologic simulation, Leading-edge researches on climate change, meteorological disasters and the like.
assignees: GUANGZHOU INST OF GEOGRAPHY GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES;SOUTHERN MARINE SCIENCE AND ENG GUANGDONG LABORATORY GUANGZHOU

title_en: Drilling and pipe lowering corrector for major disaster management disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a calamity drilling low tube unscrambler is administered to major disaster, including the connection box, it has cleaning device to peg graft at the middle part of connection box lateral surface, the lateral surface fixedly connected with fixed plate of connection box, the top and the bottom of fixed plate left surface all are provided with the fixed pin. This calamity drilling lower pipe unscrambler is administered to major disasters, move right through control hole oral siphon and drive the iron ring and remove right, make the oral siphon front end remain throughout at the drilling sectional centre of a circle position arrival hole bottom through the steel wire, and then improved down gas control drilling's drainage effect, the outburst elimination effect in coal seam has been strengthened, it remains the gas package to avoid exploring coal drilling to appear, blow the condition that the pseudo-extraction district was taken out in the drilling residue pseudo-of water drilling, the mining safety in mine later stage has been guaranteed, the probability that the mine gas accident takes place has been reduced from the at utmost, and great and profound popularization meaning has.
assignees: YONGCHENG COAL & ELECTRICITY HOLDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall-induced slope geological disaster scene simulation analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall-induced slope geological disaster scene simulation analysis method, which comprises the following steps: reconstructing a three-dimensional model of a slope scene based on oblique photography data to obtain surface contour line data; processing the surface contour control points and establishing a boundary model of the side slope; generating a slope rock-soil mass point set in a boundary model range to realize slope scene simulation; carrying out ground stress balance analysis under the action of self-weight by using a material point method; analyzing historical rainfall data of the slope site to obtain distribution characteristics of rainfall intensity, duration and rainfall; randomly generating water particles above a slope rock-soil body area to realize rainfall scene simulation; by adopting a two-phase material point method, calculating the stress seepage coupling response of the slope rock-soil body under the infiltration condition in time steps, and realizing the analysis of the whole process of the rainfall-induced slope geological disaster evolution; fully considering the infiltration of rainfall in the slope rock-soil body and the surface runoff process; the method has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, advanced technology and high calculation precision.

title_en: Weak cementation strong expansion high water-rich soft rock drainage mining method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mineral exploitation, in particular to a weak cementation strong expansion high water-rich soft rock drainage exploitation method. The dry dredging mining method comprises the following steps: preliminary evaluation before engineering design, pre-evaluation before tunneling, water drainage engineering design, water drainage drilling construction, geophysical exploration, drilling verification, pre-mining evaluation report compilation, working face extraction and post-mining summary. The drainage mining is used as a water disaster source treatment technology, so that sand collapse accidents can be effectively prevented, and the working face is mined in a top plate water-drenching-free state; the old pond has no water inrush after the roof water is drained, the hidden danger of a water flooding reversed loader is eliminated, the coal can be pulled downwards, the width of the working face can be enlarged to more than 300m, and the ten thousand ton tunneling rate is favorably reduced.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA SHANGHAIMIAO MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line galloping early warning method based on Bayes-Adaboost improved algorithm
abstract_en: The application discloses transmission line galloping early warning method based on Bayes-Adaboost improved algorithm, comprising the following steps: and forming a classifier by training a historical galloping fault training set and adopting an Adaboost ensemble learning method, and obtaining a galloping early warning result of the power transmission line through the classifier according to the parameter information of real-time prediction meteorological information and different parameter information of the power transmission line. For newly-increased galloping fault samples, the model is corrected according to a Bayes formula, and meanwhile, related influence parameters of energy accumulation on galloping are added into the model and are reflected by a temperature change rate and a humidity change rate, so that the galloping early warning method based on the Bayes-Adaboost improvement method is formed. According to the invention, the calculation processing of the forecast information of the transmission line galloping meteorological characteristic factors and the related data such as the structural parameters of the transmission line can be realized, and the early warning analysis result of the transmission line galloping disaster in the area is obtained.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;HENAN JIUYU ENPAI ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Urban waterlogging simulation method integrating tracing thinking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban inland inundation simulation method integrating tracing ideas, wherein the method comprises the steps of quantitatively analyzing water quantity relevance among multiple regions of an city by establishing an urban inland inundation model coupled with the tracing ideas, and S1, adopting constant-concentration tracers with different numbers to mark the flow-producing water quantity generated in different regions; s2, establishing a relation between the quality of the tracer and the flow concentration water yield of the drainage subarea according to a substance conservation principle; s3, establishing a relation between tracer transportation and waterlogging flow and distribution according to a mass balance equation; s4, determining a region of interest according to the waterlogging degree; s5, calculating the contribution of different drainage subareas to the waterlogging water of the attention area at any time according to the change process of the waterlogging water quantity of the attention area and the quality change process of each tracer: s6, determining a regional waterlogging prevention and treatment strategy according to the waterlogging contribution of the concerned region; the local urban waterlogging management department performs disaster prevention decision, urban waterlogging emergency management, drainage system planning and the like, and plays a certain guiding and reference role.

title_en: Emotion-fused post-disaster three-level hierarchical simulation system and method based on intelligent agent
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster three-level hierarchical simulation system and method based on fusion emotion of an agent. The invention comprises a database module, an intelligent agent generation module, an environment simulation module, an emotion simulation module, a decision simulation module, an information interaction and simulation module, a visualization module and the like. The multi-agent post-earthquake three-level emotion dynamic selection structure is mixed into an original fully rational agent decision system, so that the refuge behavior of real people after disasters can be more closely followed, the actual situation after the disasters can be more accurately shown, and the accuracy of the whole simulation is improved.

title_en: AI based dangerous situation detection system for mobile crane and work of ground work place yard using analyzing accident cause big data of mobile crane and work of ground work place yard
title_ko: 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 사고원인 분석 빅데이터를 이용한 ai기반 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 위험 탐지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence (AI)-based dangerous situation detection system for a working ground and worker below a mobile crane using accident cause analysis big data of a working ground and worker below a mobile crane and, more specifically, to a system for detecting the risk of a working ground and worker below a mobile crane, which is operated by an AI system and an ultrawide band (UWB) VT sensor and PT sensor system to prevent accidents. According to the present invention, the system comprises: an AI system analyzing mobile crane types and features, mobile crane working environments, disaster cases by the type of disaster including fall, drop, overturning, straying, collapse, electric shock, and collision related to mobile crane works, causes of accidents including defects in lifting objects, booms, car bodies, boarding equipment, and hooks, classification of victims including crane operators, nearby workers, and managers, and causes of accidents including non-compliance with safety rules, defective line hanging works, defective crane equipment, overturning of cranes, defective boarding facilities, defective buckets, and inexperienced work to build big data for each mobile crane type/feature, each mobile crane working environment, each disaster case by disaster type, each accident cause, each victim classification, and each accident cause, and generating and mapping accident response scenarios corresponding to the big data for each classification; and a UWB VT sensor and PT sensor system attached to the mobile crane and a worker or an object.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 사고원인 분석 빅데이터를 이용한 AI기반 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 위험 탐지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 이동식 크레인 종류 및 특징과, 이동식 크레인 작업환경과, 이동식 크레인 작업과 관련한 추락, 낙하, 전도, 협착, 도괴·붕괴, 감전 및 충돌을 포함하는 재해형태별 재해사례와, 인양물, 붐대, 차체, 탑승설비 및 후크 결함을 포함하는 사고유발원인과, 크레인 운전자, 인근 작업자, 관리자를 포함하는 피해자분류와, 안전수칙 미준수, 줄걸이 작업불량, 크레인 장비불량, 크레인 전도, 탑승설비 불량, 버켓불량 및 작업미숙을 포함하는 사고원인을 분석하여 상기 이동식 크레인 종류 및 특징, 이동식 크레인 작업환경, 재해형태별 재해사례, 사고유발원인, 피해자분류, 사고원인별로 분류별 빅데이터화하고, 상기 분류별 빅데이터에 상응하는 안전사고 대응시나리오를 작성 맵핑하여 구축한 인공지능시스템과; 이동식 크레인 및 작업자 또는 사물에 부착된 UWB VT 및 PT센서시스템;을 포함하여 구성되어 상기 인공지능시스템 및 UWB VT센서 및 PT센서 시스템에 의하여 작동되는 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자의 위험을 탐지하기 위한 시스템에 관한 것이다.
