title_en: Fire safety experience device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a device is experienced to fire control safety relates to fire-fighting equipment technical field, has solved people among the prior art and how accomplish not nervous in the conflagration, makes the technical problem of the most favorable selection of fleing for one's life fast. The technical characteristics include a helmet; VR glasses, VR glasses include the glasses body, glasses body and helmet normal running fit to its inside smog ware that is used for simulating the conflagration flue gas that is provided with. The fire escape system has the advantages that a user can feel personally on the scene when experiencing, authenticity is increased, people can be not nervous in a fire disaster through VR simulation, and the beneficial effect of selecting the most beneficial escape of the user is rapidly achieved.
assignees: JILIN SENKE SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mobile standpipe training apparatus
abstract_en: A firefighting training apparatus includes a base having a feed pipe mounted on the base, and one or more standpipes mounted on the feed pipe. Each standpipe can have one or more couplings that are configured to receive a field adjustable pressure reducing valve that is further configured to connect to a firehose or other firefighting equipment. The apparatus is reconfigurable, and various different types of field adjustable pressure reducing valves can be mounted on the standpipe(s) for use in different training exercises or simply to allow firefighter to become familiar with operating the field adjustable pressure reducing valves under training conditions.

title_en: Ancient damming event reconstruction method based on sedimentary-geomorphic evidence chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water disaster prevention, in particular to a reconstruction method of an ancient damming event based on a deposition-landform evidence chain, which comprises the following steps: obtaining data information, analyzing and sorting the data, confirming barrier lake parameters, simulating reconstruction data, and comparing and analyzing to obtain results. The invention provides a practical and effective reconstruction method of an ancient damming event, which can obtain a real and reliable result, comprehensively judges the scale and the age of the ancient damming event from the perspective of a deposition-landform evidence chain by means of multiple evidences, ensures the reliability of a reconstruction result, improves the correct understanding of people on historical disasters, reveals the catastrophe history and the law of major disasters in a long-time sequence of a region, and provides a solid foundation for scientifically predicting the activity trend of future damming disasters and accurately identifying and predicting giant damming events.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: BIM technology-based deep foundation pit disaster visual early warning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building construction, and discloses a BIM technology-based deep foundation pit disaster visual early warning method, which comprises a BIM technology-based deep foundation pit disaster visual early warning technical route and a BIM technology-based deep foundation pit disaster visual early warning research method. The invention effectively achieves the purpose of good visualization and simulation effects of the foundation pit disasters by corresponding technical routes and corresponding research methods, then realizes the research and development of a monitoring point family library by utilizing the BIM technology, and then forms 4D simulation of the model on the dimension of increasing time by matching corresponding modeling software and simulation software, thereby greatly facilitating the subsequent research and investigation so as to adjust and process specific construction work.
assignees: SHANDONG BUREAU OF CHINA METALLURGICAL GEOLOGY BUREAU

title_en: Geological disaster hidden danger sensitivity prediction method based on unsupervised characterization learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological disaster hidden danger sensitivity prediction method based on unsupervised characterization learning, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, extracting data characteristics of a training area; step 2, constructing an unsupervised characterization learning mechanism; step 3, training a ground disaster sensitivity analysis model; and 4, predicting and evaluating the ground disaster sensitivity. The model generation part of the invention is formed by stacking two Boltzmann machines (RBMs) and a de-noising automatic encoding machine (DAE), and is initialized by a layer-by-layer greedy pre-training method. Then, a transfer learning strategy based on an antagonistic mechanism is provided to improve the transferability of the pregnant disaster environment knowledge. And finally, training a universal intermediate model suitable for small sample learning by applying a meta-learning idea based on the two characterization learning processes. Meanwhile, the prediction precision of the small sample learning model is guaranteed during the meta-training process of the model, the accurate and rapid prediction of local regions is realized, and the generalization of the model to a new task scene is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHONGHAIDA SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for CO seepage experiment in loose coal body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CO seepage experiment device in loose coal bodies, which comprises a constant temperature control box and a CO seepage unit, wherein a hydraulic oil supply system and a CO gas supply bottle are arranged outside the constant temperature control box; the CO gas supply bottle is connected with a CO seepage unit in the constant temperature control box through a gas inlet pipe; a metal tube float flowmeter and a differential pressure transmitter are arranged on the outer wall surface of the constant temperature control box, and the metal tube float flowmeter is connected with the CO seepage unit through a first air outlet pipe; the metal tube float flowmeter is also connected with a laser TDLAS type gas detector arranged outside the constant temperature control box through a second gas outlet pipe; the pressure difference transmitter is connected with the CO seepage unit through the air inlet pressure difference pipe and the air outlet pressure difference pipe respectively; the LED pressure display nixie tube and the LED temperature display nixie tube are further included. The seepage flow of CO in the coal body is simulated through the seepage flow system, and a theoretical basis is provided for the early warning of coal fire disasters by CO gas. Methods of use of the device are also provided.

title_en: Multidirectional-adjustment-type shockproof disaster-reduction escape VR simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multidirectional regulation formula's shockproof disaster reduction VR analogue means of fleing, comprising a base plate, bottom plate upper end fixed mounting has first electric cylinder group and second electric cylinder group, the fixed block that is provided with in first electric cylinder group top, the activity of fixed block upper end is provided with the seat, the activity of seat upper end is provided with VR glasses and fixed band, the first ring body of telescopic link upper end fixedly connected with of second electric cylinder group. This multidirectional regulation formula's VR analogue means that flees takes precautions against earthquakes, through setting up first electric cylinder group, first movable rod, first supporting block and second ring body, and the second electric cylinder group, the second movable rod, second supporting block and second ring body, it can realize the ascending and descending of seat in the vertical direction to have realized utilizing two electric cylinder groups, and the slope effect of seat, the house is emptyd when doing benefit to the simulation earthquake, and scenes such as overweight weightlessness, multi-directional regulation has been realized, user's VR experience effect has been improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG HUAPEI EDUCATIONAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Surface deformation prediction method combining InSAR technology and long-term memory neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface time sequence deformation prediction method combining an InSAR technology and a long-time memory neural network, which mainly comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring a surface time sequence deformation result by utilizing an InSAR technology; then, a time sequence data set required by model training is established, and the length of a historical time sequence is determined; secondly, establishing a model, and comparing and analyzing the long-term memory network simulation result with a recurrent neural network and a multilayer perceptron; and finally, simulating and predicting the surface time sequence deformation by using the long-time memory neural network. The method combines the surface time sequence InSAR deformation with the long-time and short-time memory neural network, can be used for assisting decision, early warning and reducing harm, and provides a new idea for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Airplane fire extinguishing training demonstration device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an aircraft fire-extinguishing training demonstration device and method, wherein the demonstration device comprises a demonstration table, latticed coordinates are arranged on the demonstration table, a wind direction simulation mechanism is arranged at the edge of the demonstration table, an aircraft model is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the demonstration table, a plurality of first flame model mechanisms are arranged inside and outside the aircraft model, a second flame model mechanism used for simulating fuel oil leakage fire is arranged on the demonstration table on the lower side of the aircraft model, a plurality of movable fire truck models are further arranged on the demonstration table, a fire extinguishing agent conveying pipeline is arranged on the fire truck model, the fire extinguishing agent conveying pipeline is connected with the fire extinguishing mechanism through a detachable quick plugging mechanism, and a first detection mechanism used for detecting whether the fire extinguishing agent conveying pipeline is connected or not is arranged on the quick plugging mechanism. The invention can simulate and demonstrate the fire catching and the fire disaster of different positions of the airplane, and can be matched with the simulation of the wind direction and the wind power in the scene to carry out fire extinguishing training demonstration, thereby increasing the reality of the demonstration.

title_en: Method and device for preventing vibration and reducing disaster by using petroleum earthquake and drilling data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for preventing earthquake and reducing disaster by using petroleum earthquake and drilling data, belonging to the technical field of petroleum earthquake data application and expansion, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a stratum sequence framework by using the known conditions of the petroleum earthquake and the drilling data, collecting and screening drilling holes and tracing and explaining the earthquake, and researching the stratum spread characteristics of the area; researching the activity period and the evolution process of deep and large fracture to determine the activity characteristics of shallow fracture; and 3, defining the fault development condition extending to the shallowest stratum in the seismic recognition range, performing three-dimensional geological modeling, and more intuitively reflecting the overall spatial structure characteristics. And finally, deploying seismic survey lines along the trend perpendicular to the active fault extending to the ground surface in the three-dimensional geological model according to the fault with activity, the development range of the fault and the region extending to the ground surface fault. The method has the characteristics of greatly reducing the earthquake acquisition cost, eliminating the earthquake prediction blind area, effectively improving the earthquake prediction reliability and the like.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;INST OF GEOPHYSICAL PROSPECTING ZHONGYUAN OIL FIELD BRANCH CHINA PETROCHEMICAL CORPORATION

title_en: Gob-side entry driving method
abstract_en: The invention provides a gob-side entry driving method, which comprises the following steps: drilling to form a liquid injection hole, wherein the bottom end of the liquid injection hole is positioned in the overlying strata above the layer to be mined; injecting high-pressure liquid into the injection hole, wherein the high-pressure liquid can cut off the overburden stratum; and carrying out mining operation on the layer to be mined to form a goaf of the working surface of the upper section and a goaf of the working surface of the lower section, wherein the goaf of the working surface of the upper section and the goaf of the working surface of the lower section are separated by a narrow coal pillar, and the goaf of the working surface of the upper section is positioned below the fracture position of the overlying strata. The gob-side entry driving method provided by the invention can avoid the problems of harming the operation environment and causing secondary disasters.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Rapid structural parameter design method of S-shaped emergency robot based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly designing structural parameters of a snake-shaped emergency robot based on deep reinforcement learning, belongs to the field of structural design of snake-shaped emergency robots, and relates to a method for quickly designing structural parameters of a snake-shaped emergency robot used for disaster search and rescue and based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a snake-shaped emergency robot parameter multi-target planning model, and carrying out Markov modeling aiming at the robot structure parameter multi-target planning problem. Respectively establishing a state space, an action space and a reward function according to a planning problem; then, a reinforcement learning framework is constructed. And finally, training the constructed reinforcement learning network to realize a quick design task of the snake-shaped emergency robot. The invention can quickly and efficiently complete the quick design task of the structural parameters of the S-shaped emergency robot on the premise of ensuring the completion of task indexes, thereby obtaining the structural parameters of the lightweight S-shaped emergency robot with better comprehensive performance.

title_en: Finite particle method-based disaster simulation distributed computing method for building group
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of distributed data processing, and discloses a finite particle method-based architecture group catastrophe simulation distributed computing method, which comprises the following steps: s1, transmitting the data related to the building group structure to the main control node for preparation and starting of distributed computation; s2, the main control node distributes the building group structure related data to the execution process on the slave node in the cluster through the high-speed network; s3, the execution process on the slave node calculates the particle displacement and the unit internal force of the building group structure related data; and S4, the execution process on the slave node submits the calculation result to the master control node, and the master control node updates the resultant force and resultant moment of each mass point in the building group structure. The invention effectively realizes large-scale and high-efficiency earthquake catastrophe simulation calculation of urban building groups by taking a finite particle method as a calculation basis and performing distributed calculation through a computer cluster.

title_en: Lightning protection and disaster reduction VR emergency rescue simulation device with protection alarm function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lightning protection and disaster reduction VR emergency rescue analogue means with protection alarm, including connecting the mount pad, the one end fixed mounting of connecting the mount pad has the erection joint piece, the one end movable mounting of connecting the mount pad has the speaker, the one end movable mounting of speaker has the pilot lamp, the one end movable mounting that the speaker was kept away from to the pilot lamp has control button, the upper end fixed mounting of connecting the mount pad has the protecting crust, movable mounting has the connection mount pad on the connection mount pad, the connection mounting groove has been seted up on the erection joint piece, movable mounting has display device in the connection mounting groove, the outside fixed mounting of connecting the mount pad has the protection strip, the one end fixed mounting of erection joint piece has flexible pad, it has the observation hole to reserve on the flexible pad. This lightning protection and disaster reduction VR emergency rescue analogue means with protection alarm, the work that helps the user to carry out the simulation training that can be better increases the application scope of equipment.
assignees: GUANGDONG HUAPEI EDUCATIONAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Landslide deformation displacement prediction method for improving BP neural network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of neural networks, and discloses a landslide deformation displacement prediction method for an improved BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: collecting landslide training data and constructing a prediction data set; normalizing the prediction data set; establishing a BP neural network model by adopting an ant colony algorithm, and calculating the optimal solution of the BP neural network model; training the BP neural network model by adopting an optimal solution to obtain a landslide prediction model; and correcting the landslide prediction model according to the time error sequence to obtain a prediction result. According to the landslide prediction method and device, based on landslide historical monitoring data, a landslide prediction model is established by improving a BP (back propagation) data network, accurate prediction of landslide disasters is achieved under the condition that multiple influence factors exist and the influence factors show nonlinear changes, monitoring cost and construction cost are reduced through reasonable planning and design, and life and property safety of people is effectively protected.
assignees: JIANGXI NUCLEAR INDUSTRY SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST GROUP CO LTD;JIANGXI MANPU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGSU KEBO SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency evacuation simulation method for personnel in public place
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for emergency evacuation of personnel in public places, which comprises the following steps: firstly, simulating parameter setting of evacuation areas and pedestrians in public places; secondly, establishing a moving model for simulating pedestrians in a static field of the continuous ground field cellular automaton model; thirdly, establishing a moving model for simulating pedestrians in a dynamic field of the continuous ground field cellular automaton model; establishing a model for simulating the moving speed of the pedestrian and updating the position of the simulated pedestrian; fifthly, updating the positions of the simulated pedestrians until evacuation is completed. The method is simple, reasonable in design, accurate and rapid in simulation, can simulate interaction between pedestrians and barriers, can simulate the pedestrians to move in multiple directions and at multiple angles in the evacuation process, and is closer to a real evacuation area.

title_en: Near-shore single-point wave height forecasting method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near-shore single-point sea wave height forecasting method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of: the method comprises the following steps: specifying an area marine hydrological meteorological data set; step two: cleaning and processing the data to obtain effective data and dividing a training set and a testing set; step three: training the model to obtain a trained wave height prediction model; step four: and (4) verifying the accuracy of the sea wave height prediction model and predicting the sea wave height result. According to the method, the wave height of single-point sea waves is predicted by utilizing the self-developed deep learning model, the wave height prediction precision is improved, and the method has important significance for offshore oceanic hydrological weather forecast and disaster reduction; the prediction method is stable and reliable, and the trained model can be directly used in future offshore single-point wave height prediction application, and is simple and convenient to apply.

title_en: System for disaster monitoring and disaster response
title_ko: 재난 감시 및 대응 시스템
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention provides a system for monitoring and responding to a disaster, which remotely controls a facility. The system comprises: a past disaster database for storing past disaster data; a system linkage database linked with another system to store system disaster data including disaster data collected or processed by the other system; an institution-linked database linked with an institution to store institutional disaster data including disaster data collected or processed by the institution; a sensor installed in a facility to sense a physical quantity to generate sensed data; an image collecting device for photographing the facility to generate an image of the facility; and a disaster response system including a collection and analysis unit for receiving and analyzing the past disaster data, the system disaster data, the institutional disaster data, the sensed data, and the image, a calculation and decision-making unit for determining whether a disaster has occurred based on the results of the analysis, and a control unit for transmitting a notification and transmitting a control command to the facility when it is determined that a disaster has occurred. The disaster response device selects, through the control unit, one of a plurality of scenarios according to disaster types and disaster risk levels included in the results of the determination, and generates the notification and the control command according to the selected scenario. Therefore, the system can increase the accuracy of disaster monitoring.

title_en: Disaster Vulnerability Analysis Advanced System and Method by Sea Level Rise
title_ko: 해수면 상승 재해취약성 분석 고도화 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for advancing sea level rise disaster vulnerability analysis, which includes an output unit classifying each space analysis unit into a current vulnerability rating analysis portion and a future vulnerability rating analysis portion and selecting and outputting the lower of the ratings of the respective analysis portions. The current vulnerability rating analysis portion is a current weather exposure analysis portion and a current urban sensitivity analysis portion. The result of each analysis portion is calculated as the average of two ratings using one of first to fourth ratings. The future vulnerability rating analysis portion is a future weather exposure analysis portion and a future urban sensitivity analysis portion. The result of each analysis portion is calculated as the average of two ratings using one of first to fourth ratings. According to the present invention, the unit of disaster vulnerability analysis is advanced to a grid unit (100 meters by 100 meters) at a tally, an annual average maximum tide and an RCP scenario-based tide rise index are reflected for regional disaster characteristic reflection, and analysis of current and future weather exposure indices is also improved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 해수면 상승 재해취약성 분석 고도화 시스템에 있어서, 공간분석 단위별로 현재 취약성 등급 분석부 및 미래 취약성 등급 분석부로 구분하여 각각의 분석부의 등급 중 더 낮은 등급을 선정하여 출력하는 출력부를 포함하되, 상기 현재 취약성 등급 분석부는 현재 기후노출분석부 및 현재 도시민감도 분석부이며 각각의 분석부의 결과는 1~4등급 중 어느 하나로 두 개의 등급을 평균한 등급으로 산출되며, 상기 미래 취약성 등급 분석부는 미래 기후노출분석부 및 미래 도시민감도 분석부이며 각각의 분석부의 결과는 1~4등급 중 어느 하나로 두 개의 등급을 평균한 등급으로 산출되는 것에 특징이 있는 해수면 상승 재해취약성 분석 고도화 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에서는 재해취약성 분석의 분석단위를 집계구에서 격자단위(100m×100m)로 고도화하고, 지역 재해특성이 반영될 수 있도록 연평균 최극조위 및 RCP 시나리오 기반 조위 상승 지표를 반영하고, 현재 및 미래 기후노출 지표들의 분석 방법도 개선한 것에 특징이 있는 해수면 상승 재해취약성 분석 고도화 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: intelligent evacuation guidance simulation system for disaster situation
title_ko: 재난상황을 대비한 지능형 대피 유도 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent evacuation guidance system for guiding an evacuation route for evacuees in preparation for a disaster situation, which prevents a bottleneck phenomenon during evacuation. According to the present invention, an intelligent evacuation guidance method comprises, by the intelligent evacuation guidance system: a first step of checking the number (N) of evacuation groups existing in a distress area and the number (n) of evacuees existing in each evacuation group; a second step of checking the number (M) of escape routes existing in the distress area; a third step of calculating, on assumption that all evacuees belonging to one evacuation group are evacuated through the same escape route, all evacuation routes in which the evacuees of N evacuation groups evacuate to M escape routes; a fourth step of calculating time required for all evacuees to escape to each of the evacuation routes; and a fifth step of selecting an evacuation route having the minimum time required for evacuation as an optimal evacuation route among the evacuation routes.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 재난상황을 대비하여 대피자의 대피 경로를 안내하는 대피 유도 시스템으로서, 상기 대피 유도 시스템에 의해서, 조난지역에 존재하는 대피자 그룹의 수(N)와 각 대피자 그룹에 존재하는 대피자의 수(n)가 파악되는 1단계; 조난지역에 존재하는 탈출구의 수(M)가 파악되는 2단계; 하나의 대피자 그룹에 속하는 대피자 전원은 동일한 탈출구로 탈출한다는 가정하에, N개의 대피자 그룹의 대피자가 M개의 탈출구로 대피하는 모든 대피경로가 산출되는 3단계; 상기 대피경로 각각으로 대피자 전원이 탈출하는데 소요되는 시간이 각각 산출되는 4단계; 및 상기 대피경로 중 탈출에 소요되는 시간이 최소인 대피경로가 최적 대피경로로 선정되는 5단계;를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV SEOUL IND COOP FOUND;IUCF HYU ERICA CAMPUS

title_en: Device for elevator door simulation
title_ko: 엘리베이터 도어 시뮬레이션 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an elevator door simulation apparatus which enables a user to check a structure by separating a car door and a hall door, observe an interworking appearance of the car door and the hall door, observe the front part of the car door and the rear part of the hall door, which are difficult to observe in a real elevator, while the car door is separated from the hall door, and observe an interworking appearance of the parts from various directions. According to the present invention, firefighters who have to manually operate elevator doors in emergency situation can be easily trained and elevator inspectors or elevator managers can learn professional knowledge for manually operating or repairing elevator doors. In addition, since the elevator door simulation apparatus can be moved by a caster wheel without being fixedly installed in a building, the elevator door simulation apparatus can be moved to a training place regardless time and place and training can be carried out. The elevator door simulation apparatus comprises a car door frame, a hall door frame, a car door module, a car door opener, a hall door module, an interlock, and a control panel.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 엘리베이터 도어 시뮬레이션 장치에 관한 것으로서, 카 도어와 홀 도어를 개별적으로 분리하여 구조를 확인할 수 있으며, 카 도어와 홀 도어가 연동되어 작동되는 모습을 쉽게 관찰할 수 있고, 카 도어와 홀 도어를 분리한 상태로 실물 엘리베이터에서는 관찰하기 어려운 카 도어의 전면부 및 홀 도어의 후면부를 관찰할 수 있으며, 이들이 연동되는 모습을 다양한 방향에서 관찰할 수 있다. 
이를 이용하여 긴급상황에서 엘리베이터 도어를 수동으로 조작해야 하는 소방관에게 손쉽게 교육을 실시할 수 있으며, 엘리베이터 점검자나 엘리베이터 관리주체에게 엘리베이터 도어를 수동으로 조작하거나 수리하기 위한 전문적인 지식을 손쉽게 교육할 수 있다. 
아울러 건물에 고정 설치되는 것이 아니라 캐스터휠을 이용하여 이동시킬 수 있으므로, 시간과 장소의 제약 없이 엘리베이터 도어 시뮬레이션 장치를 교육장소로 이동시켜 교육을 실시할 수 있다.

title_en: Control method for simulation system for fire evacuation and computer-readable medium storing the same
title_ko: 화재 대피 시뮬레이션 시스템의 제어방법 및 이를 기록한 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention provides a control method for an evacuation simulation system in preparation for a fire situation inside a building. The control method comprises: a first step of allowing a plurality of speakers to transmit sound in a specific frequency band different from each other in case of a fire; a second step of allowing a server to transmit a message including a predetermined connection link to a user terminal; and a third step of allowing the user terminal to record a sound transmitted from at least one among the plurality of speakers when the connection link is selected. A first location where the user terminal is located is analyzed using the recorded sound data. An evacuation route from the first location to an exit is displayed on the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 건물 내부의 화재 상황을 대비한 대피 시뮬레이션 시스템의 제어방법으로서, 화재발생시 복수개의 스피커가 스피커 별로 서로 다른 특정 주파수 대역의 음향을 송출하는 1단계; 서버가 사용자단말에 미리 정해진 연결 링크를 포함한 메시지를 전송하는 2단계; 및 상기 연결 링크가 선택되면, 상기 사용자단말이 상기 복수개의 스피커 중 적어도 하나의 스피커로부터 송출된 음향을 녹음하는 3단계;를 포함하고, 상기 녹음된 음향 데이터를 이용하여 상기 사용자단말이 위치하는 제1위치를 분석하고, 상기 제1위치에서 출구로 향하는 대피경로를 사용자 단말에 표시하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Convolutional neural network microseismic monitoring waveform identification method based on whole-process visualization
abstract_en: A convolutional neural network microseismic monitoring waveform identification method based on whole-process visualization belongs to the field of intelligent monitoring of rock engineering disasters. The technical scheme is as follows: constructing a data set required by training, and manually marking single-channel data; randomly dividing a waveform data set into a training set, a verification set and a test set; carrying out image scaling, normalization, standardization and graying image preprocessing on the original waveform image; in the Lenet network, a convolution layer is used for replacing a full connection layer, and an activation layer is added; a random gradient descent method is adopted in the model training process, and a batch normalization layer is added; adding an attention mechanism in the model, and visually explaining the process of identifying different waveform types by the model; has the advantages that: the invention realizes the visualization of the whole process, determines that the input size is 50 x 130 and the convolution kernel 5 x 3 is the best improved model frame, the accuracy rate reaches 0.9768, and is improved by 10.18 percent compared with the original model; and noise reduction, drawing and conversion into a time-frequency diagram are not required, and end-to-end classification is realized.

title_en: Coal mine gas disaster advanced prediction method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine gas disaster advanced prediction method based on multi-source information fusion, which comprises the following steps: determining main control factors influencing coal mine gas disaster prediction; performing data analysis, preprocessing and characteristic engineering on the main control factor data based on the occurred coal mine gas disaster and mine real safety monitoring data; carrying out data set segmentation operation on the data, selecting a plurality of classification machine learning models for training, comparing the plurality of models in a full combination mode, ensuring the model prediction effect, and carrying out model selection; and integrating the trained model into a coal mine gas disaster prediction software infrastructure required by the operation model to perform actual coal mine gas disaster prediction activities. The method provided by the invention can effectively predict and forecast the coal mine gas disaster in advance, and takes corresponding preventive measures aiming at the danger degree of the coal mine gas disaster, thereby avoiding the occurrence of the coal mine gas disaster and ensuring the safety of coal mining.

title_en: Steel-concrete interface mechanical property testing device under multiple working conditions in full life cycle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steel-concrete interface mechanical property testing device under multiple working conditions of a full life cycle, which comprises a supporting base component, a normal loading component and a tangential loading component, wherein the supporting base component is used for respectively supporting and fixing a first steel plate and a second steel plate of a steel-concrete test piece to be tested, the normal loading component is used for respectively connecting the first steel plate and the second steel plate, applying normal load to the steel-concrete test piece to be tested and heating an interface of the steel-concrete test piece to be tested, the tangential loading component is used for fixedly connecting the tangential loading component with concrete, and applying tangential load to the steel-concrete test piece to be tested, wherein the tangential load is unidirectional load, repeated load, long-term load and impact load in the full life cycle process of the steel-concrete test piece to be tested. The device has high stability and accuracy, and is suitable for testing the mechanical properties of the steel-concrete interface under various working conditions such as long-term load, repeated action, fire disaster, impact and the like of the full life cycle of the simulation structure.

title_en: Fire monitoring analog system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire monitoring simulation system, which comprises a first cavity, wherein the first cavity is arranged in a top plate of a building and is provided with a downward opening, a bearing barrel is connected in the first cavity in a vertical sliding manner, and the bearing barrel is connected to the upper side surface of the first cavity through a rope; the invention is communicated with the tap water pipe, and the towel is stored in the invention, so that the worker can utilize the wet towel to reduce the suction of harmful gas when a real fire disaster happens, and the invention can spray tap water in a large range after the towel is wetted to reduce the environmental temperature and the dust content, thereby facilitating escape; the invention can calculate and record the evacuation efficiency of the staff when the simulation exercise is carried out, and can improve the evacuation efficiency of the staff by comparing the records.
assignees: JIANGSU NANOU INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster rescue method, equipment and medium based on ultraviolet imaging and image recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue method, equipment and medium based on ultraviolet imaging and image recognition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing model training on the fire data image sample based on an ultraviolet-shining fire data image sample database to obtain a recognition and positioning model; after receiving an image acquisition instruction, acquiring images of a fire scene to generate fire scene image information; performing fitting analysis on the image information of the fire scene through the identification and positioning model; and converting the image information of the fire scene into rescue image information containing specific target categories and positioning thereof according to the fitting analysis result. According to the invention, the influence of self-luminescence of flame is eliminated by 410nm ultraviolet light irradiation and the 410nm optical filter is added in front of the camera, and people or articles to be rescued in fire are imaged through the flame. Meanwhile, an edge computing module or a cloud server with an embedded neural network algorithm is adopted to automatically identify the ultraviolet imaging picture, and identify and position the personnel or articles to be rescued in the fire.
assignees: NANTONG TONGQI AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Demonstration device for adolescent earthquake knowledge science popularization education
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of science popularization teaching device, specifically disclose a presentation device for teenager's earthquake knowledge science popularization education, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the top fixedly connected with slide bar of base, the first motor of top fixedly connected with of base. This presentation device is used in teenager's earthquake knowledge science popularization education, through first motor, longitudinal wave and transverse wave that produce during simulation earthquakes such as second motor, true earthquake wave vibrations effect is pressed close to the vibrations effect simulation effect of bottom surface during the earthquake, through the switching of control panel control electro-magnet, accomplish iron bottom plate model and stand again on the electro-magnet, improve the earthquake demonstration efficiency of device, increase the word description explanation part, the binding means is to the actual conditions simulation of earthquake, the science popularization education effect of improving the device, compare with current ordinary geological disaster model display device, the existing device has earthquake display effect poor, earthquake simulation efficiency is low and the poor problem of science popularization education effect.
assignees: ANHUI KUNKEYUN EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological radar calibration test platform capable of correcting various defects
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological radar calibration test platform capable of correcting various defects, which comprises a test platform, wherein the test platform is provided with a simulation ground, the test platform combines the concrete processes of preliminary bracing, a waterproof board and a secondary lining in tunnel construction, the radar is placed on a measuring line for measurement, the test platform is provided with a primary grid and two lining reinforcing steel bars, the primary grid and the two lining reinforcing steel bars are positioned on a straight line, the test platform comprises common tunnel disasters, the result of the image is output by an analysis instrument, comparing the actual disaster of the test platform, judging the effectiveness of the instrument, providing the disaster at a precise position by the test platform, detecting the test platform by the radar to judge whether the detection position of the radar has deviation, if the radar instrument is intact, the parameter setting of the instrument can be corrected by analyzing the detection result of the test platform.
assignees: HEBEI JIAOTONG VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Testing device and testing method for escaping from underground space by flood along variable-gradient stairs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a test method for escaping from an underground space by flood along a variable-gradient stair, wherein the test device comprises a water supply part, a stair surface runoff simulation part, a human body escape test simulation part and a water outlet part; stair surface runoff simulation portion includes variable slope stair, and variable slope stair include slope and multistage mark time, and every grade is marked time and is all included horizontal footboard and two backup pads, and horizontal footboard passes through height adjusting mechanism to be installed in two backup pads, adjusts the stair slope through the height of adjustment horizontal footboard. According to the invention, water flow is continuously supplied to the stair surface runoff simulating part and the human body escape test simulating part through the water supply part, the human body escape test simulating part is utilized to simulate the difficulty of pedestrians escaping along stairs with different gradients under different submergence degrees, the instability judging standard of the pedestrians escaping along the overflowing stairs when flood invades the urban underground space is analyzed, and decision support is provided for the establishment of a personnel evacuation scheme when the underground space is flooded.

title_en: Method and system for improving toughness of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for improving toughness of a power distribution network, which are used for evaluating importance of power distribution network components in typhoon weather, establishing an element fault rate model under storm action, sampling the state of a wind power generation system by adopting a non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation method, establishing an optimal recovery strategy model and sequencing the importance of the components; acquiring fault conditions when disasters occur, and preferentially recovering elements with high importance according to the determined sequence to realize the improvement of the robustness of the power distribution network; the method comprises the steps of pre-deploying a mobile emergency power generation vehicle before a disaster and performing real-time scheduling after the disaster to form a plurality of micro-grids, establishing an objective function by taking the minimum power failure time of important loads in different scenes as a target, forming an MILP problem by the objective function and constraint conditions, obtaining the real-time distribution condition of the mobile emergency power generation vehicle after the disaster by solving the corresponding problem, and completing the recovery and the promotion of the power distribution network. The method and the device realize the improvement of the robustness of the power distribution network; the fault recovery time of the power distribution network is shortened, and the rapidity of power distribution network recovery is realized.

title_en: Advanced observation method and device based on electric dipole emission in hole
abstract_en: The invention provides an advanced observation method and system based on electric dipole emission in a hole, which are used for carrying out advanced geological analysis on a region to be detected and preliminarily defining the possible existing range of disaster-causing water-containing bodies by combining the existing geological data and the condition of an excavated tunnel; selecting a proper position to be drilled into a drill hole, selecting a junction point of the drill hole and a tunnel face as an origin point to establish a frequency domain induced polarization three-dimensional coordinate system, arranging electric dipoles in the hole in an array mode, arranging receiving electrodes in the tunnel face in an array mode, sequentially collecting all the receiving electrodes to obtain apparent resistivity, and performing data processing analysis according to collected apparent resistivity data to obtain the azimuth and the three-dimensional form of the front disaster-causing water-containing body. The invention can overcome the problem of narrow space in the tunnel, and meanwhile, the emission source is arranged in the drill hole and is closer to the water-containing body in front of the tunnel face, so that more accurate results can be obtained.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;Shandong energy group co ltd

title_en: Tunnel surrounding rock collapse disaster simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tunnel surrounding rock collapse disaster simulation test device and a method, wherein the tunnel surrounding rock collapse disaster simulation test device comprises the following steps: a support: the bracket is provided with a loading piece and is used for applying a confining pressure load to a surrounding rock sample in the bracket; lifting a plate: the lifting driving piece is connected with the lifting driving piece, the lifting driving piece is fixed on the support, and the lifting driving piece can drive the lifting plate to do lifting motion in a lifting seam reserved in the surrounding rock sample, so that the contact area of the lifting plate and a precast block in a surrounding edge sample tunnel is changed, and the tunnel excavation process is simulated; a water supply mechanism: the water tank can be attached to a surrounding rock sample in the support and locked and fixed with the support, the water tank is provided with a water outlet matched with the tunnel, and the water tank can be connected with an external water source through the pump body.

title_en: Halogen-free flame-retardant polyester-cotton fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a halogen-free flame-retardant polyester-cotton fabric and a preparation method thereof, and the halogen-free flame-retardant polyester-cotton fabric is characterized in that: blending high-phosphorus-content flame-retardant polyester fibers and cotton fibers to prepare polyester-cotton fabric, performing flame-retardant treatment on the polyester-cotton fabric by adopting a cotton-used flame-retardant technology to prepare flame-retardant polyester-cotton fabric, padding the flame-retardant polyester-cotton fabric into a silicone oil aqueous solution, and softening and finishing the fabric by using an air softening machine to obtain a halogen-free flame-retardant polyester-cotton fabric; the high-phosphorus-content flame-retardant polyester fiber is prepared by mixing 76.4-82.5% of polyester, 17.4-23.5% of flame retardant and 0.06-0.12% of auxiliary agent in percentage by mass; and melting and extruding the mixed material through a double-screw extruder, and cooling, granulating and melt spinning the mixture to obtain the composite material. The halogen-free flame-retardant polyester-cotton fabric has good performances such as strength, hand feeling and flame retardance, and is particularly suitable for being used as electric protective clothing, firefighter uniform, military training clothes and the like.

title_en: Training method, device, equipment and storage medium for disaster damage recognition model
abstract_en: The invention provides a training method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of a disaster damage identification model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a characteristic diagram of each channel in the disaster damage identification model; acquiring pixel points of each feature map, calculating the pixel average value of each pixel point in each feature map, and taking the pixel average value as the pixel average value of the corresponding feature map; normalizing each characteristic diagram and the pixel average value corresponding to each characteristic diagram respectively to obtain gain parameters of each channel; carrying out standardization processing on each gain parameter to obtain a target weight value of each channel; and inputting the target weight value into the disaster damage identification model to correct the pixel average value of each channel. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the method has the advantages that the characteristic that effective information can be automatically screened out from the picture to be identified is achieved, the characteristic with high effective information intensity can be screened out more effectively, and the accuracy of the disaster damage identification model is improved.

title_en: Laboratory pyrolysis and flue gas collection device and analysis method for fireproof plugging materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for laboratory pyrolysis and smoke collection of fireproof plugging materials and a corresponding smoke quantitative analysis method, wherein the device is used for simulating the generation condition of smoke of the fireproof plugging materials in a fire disaster by changing pyrolysis conditions, collecting the smoke through a cold trap and a gas collection bag, performing qualitative analysis through a liquid chromatography-mass spectrum or a gas chromatography-mass spectrum combined method, and performing quantitative analysis through the liquid chromatography or the gas chromatography. The invention fills the blank of laboratory analysis and research on pyrolysis smoke of the fireproof sealing material to a certain extent, designs a device and a method for simulating quantitative and qualitative analysis of smoke generated by the fireproof sealing material in a fire disaster, and provides a feasible method for qualitative and quantitative analysis of pyrolysis smoke of the fireproof sealing material.

title_en: Test device and method for simulating landslide-debris flow disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a test device for simulating a landslide-debris flow disaster chain, and relates to the technical field of landslide-debris flow disaster chain simulation research; the test device comprises: a test simulation system and a data monitoring system; the test simulation system comprises a simulated accumulation pool, a simulated circulation telescopic tank, a simulated slope assembly, a simulated rainfall assembly and a water tank; the simulated slope component comprises a simulated slope plate, two baffle plates and a jack; the simulated slope plate is obliquely arranged at the top of the water tank; the jack is arranged at the top of the water tank and used for adjusting the inclination angle of the analog slope plate; the two baffle plates are oppositely arranged on the simulated slope plate; the lower end of the simulated circulation telescopic groove is communicated with the simulated accumulation pool, and the upper end of the simulated circulation telescopic groove is communicated with the lower end of the simulated slope plate; the rainfall simulation assembly is arranged on the water tank; the invention also provides a test method of the test device for simulating the landslide-debris flow disaster chain, which can simulate the condition that a slope soil body is unstable under the rainfall condition and the landslide-debris flow disaster chain is generated.

title_en: Rotary pipe pile press-digging machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to construction equipment, in particular to a rotary pipe pile press-digging machine, which comprises a frame and a rack arranged on the frame, wherein the rack is provided with a plurality of rotary pipes which are sequentially connected along a digging direction and a rotary pipe driving mechanism which is arranged on the rack and is used for driving the rotary pipes to rotate; the drill plate device is sleeved in the coil and comprises a drill plate body, a locking mechanism arranged on the drill plate body and used for being locked with the coil, and a hole supporting mechanism arranged on the drill plate body. The coil pipe pile driver overcomes the pain points in the existing hole forming construction method of all large-diameter cast-in-place piles, and is low in energy consumption, low in pollution, high in safety degree and fast in progress in the construction process. The barrier-free construction of the large-diameter cast-in-place pile under the land full-geological condition is realized, and the enhanced type cast-in-place pile can be more used for rapid rescue of mine disasters, water construction and the like.

title_en: Slope groundwater seepage field model test system
abstract_en: The invention provides a side slope underground water seepage field model test system, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster simulation test devices; the side slope groundwater seepage field model test system includes: the system comprises a test box, a rainfall simulation device, a water collecting well and a landslide monitoring device; a simulation slide bed and a simulation slide slope body are arranged in the test box; the simulation slide bed is arranged at the bottom of the test box; the simulated landslide body is obliquely arranged at the top of the simulated slide bed; a baffle is arranged at the lower side of the simulated landslide body; the rainfall simulation device is arranged at the top of the test box; the water collecting well is vertically arranged inside the simulated landslide body; the landslide monitoring device comprises a water level stress monitoring module, an optical fiber strain sensor and a pressure box which are arranged in the simulated landslide body; the pressure box is arranged between the baffle and the inner side wall of the test box, so that the influence of the water collecting well on the stability of a landslide body under the water pumping effect can be simulated, the feasibility and the effectiveness of the water collecting well in landslide control are further researched, and the engineering practice is guided.

title_en: Hard roof strong mine pressure and goaf gas disaster cooperative treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hard roof strong mine pressure and goaf gas disaster cooperative treatment method, which comprises the following steps: designing a fracturing treatment horizon in the top plate according to the mine pressure display characteristics of the working face and the high-position drilling hole pre-layout data; calculating and determining the longitudinal height of a high-position drilling hole in a hole distribution area, and the position and spatial layout of a drilling position of a horizontal section; before stoping of a working face, drilling from a coal seam drilling field to the fracturing treatment layer to form a high-position drilling hole, and adjusting the track angle of the high-position drilling hole to enable the drilling layer of the horizontal section of the high-position drilling hole to be located in the fracturing treatment layer, so that the high-position drilling hole is arranged along the advancing direction of the working face; performing staged fracturing transformation on the horizontal section of the high-position drilled hole by adopting a staged fracturing technology to form a three-dimensional fracture system; and after the staged fracturing transformation is completed, gas extraction is completed through the high-position drill hole. The invention has the advantages of multiple purposes, reduced treatment cost and improved mining efficiency.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Sea natural gas hydrate self-entry type solid fluidization exploitation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sea natural gas hydrate self-entry solid fluidization exploitation system, which comprises a self-entry structure body, wherein a cavity, a jet pipeline and a conveying pipeline are arranged in the self-entry structure body, the periphery of the cavity is communicated with the outside through a particle inlet, the lower end of the conveying pipeline is communicated with the cavity, a plurality of jet outlets are arranged on the periphery of the self-entry structure body, the lower end of the jet pipeline is communicated with the jet outlet, the upper part of the self-entry structure body is provided with a jet inlet communicated with the jet pipeline and a conveying outlet communicated with the conveying pipeline, the jet inlet is connected with a high-pressure water pump through a pipeline, the conveying outlet is connected with a suction pump, drilling is not needed during exploitation, the wall of a well is replaced by the wall of the self-entry structure body, and the self-entry structure body enters a reservoir stratum by high-pressure water impact, so that the problem of high drilling cost in the traditional exploitation method is solved, the efficient exploitation is ensured, and the solid particle hydrate is collected on the premise that the temperature and the pressure of the natural gas hydrate reservoir stratum are not changed, and geological disasters possibly caused by hydrate decomposition are avoided.

title_en: Emergency management simulation training system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency management simulation training system, include: teaching demonstration subassembly, group discussion subassembly and central control subassembly, wherein, teaching demonstration subassembly is including the screen that is used for simulating geological disaster characteristic to and be used for showing geological disaster scene and with the VR glasses that the screen is connected still include the hanging audio amplifier, the hanging audio amplifier with the screen is connected, the group discussion subassembly is used for on-the-spot speech and on-the-spot discussion, central control subassembly is used for controlling on-the-spot light effect, control camera real time monitoring scene, through the form information characteristic of 3D engine virtual geological disaster scene and processing geological disaster respectively. The utility model discloses can effectively promote aspect training ability and effect such as mountain torrent geological disasters emergency management.
assignees: HEBEI INFORMATION ENG SCHOOL HEBEI BRANCH OF CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION METEOROLOGICAL CADR

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disasters monitoring devices belongs to geological disasters monitoring facilities field equipment, including base, casing and monitoring facilities main part, the base bottom evenly is fixed with four universal wheels that have the brake structure, and base central point puts and opens there is through hole, top to be fixed with the casing, is equipped with threaded rod and gag lever post on the base of through hole both sides respectively, and the casing top is equipped with gear motor, and gear motor's output is connected with the inside threaded rod top of casing, and the threaded rod bottom is fixed on the base through the bearing, the internal thread sleeve pipe has been cup jointed to the screw thread on the threaded rod, and the external side of internal thread sleeve pipe is fixed with the backup pad, and the backup pad top is fixed with the drilling rod that rotates motor, bottom and be fixed with corresponding with the through hole. The utility model discloses a geological disasters monitoring devices is convenient for to the maintenance of monitoring facilities main part, even this device also can be fixed by the stable stay in soft basic geology region, guarantees that the monitoring facilities main part can use stably.

title_en: Spatial power outage estimation for natural hazards leveraging optimal synthetic power networks
abstract_en: The following relates generally to calculating estimated power outages during a natural disaster event. In this regard, some embodiments create a synthetic network of a power infrastructure of a geographic area by: determining a location of a power substation; determining a location of a customer; determining a location of a power line linking the power substation to the customer; and determining if the power line is overhead or underground. Some embodiments then use the created synthetic network to simulate an event to calculate the estimated power outages during the event.

title_en: Method for carrying out disaster event simulation based on Latin hypercube sampling method and computer program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster relief business, in particular to a disaster event sampling method based on a Latin hypercube method and a computer program product, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring parameters, sorting, determining a sampling interval value, sampling and disordering; the computer program product of the invention realizes all the steps of the method of the invention when being executed by a processor. The invention improves the sampling accuracy of the small probability event, and the occurrence situation of the simulated huge disaster event is closer to the actual situation.

title_en: Rescue robot escape method based on multi-objective optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot escape method based on multi-objective optimization. The method comprises the steps that a distributed sensing system and an airborne sensor on a rescue robot are used for obtaining data of hazard source information in a post-disaster rescue environment; establishing a mathematical model, obtaining the regional danger degree in the environment model of the rescue robot working under different dangerous source states and distribution, combining the path cost and the risk cost of the dangerous domain, and establishing a comprehensive cost evaluation index; on the basis of the model, a comprehensive cost decision method of a neighborhood expansion process combined with an A Star algorithm is adopted to realize selection of an optimal safe exit target and corresponding path output. The algorithm can well reduce the path length and reduce the risk brought by the danger source in the post-disaster rescue scene on the target selection and the path output in the constructed simulation rescue environment, can be used in the post-disaster rescue scene with the danger source, and can realize the escape route planning when the robot finishes tasks or emergencies.

title_en: Deep learning generalization method for remote sensing image ground surface coverage classification
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel deep learning generalization method for remote sensing image earth surface coverage classification. The method converts the source domain image style into the target domain image style through the first stage style migration, and reduces the data distribution difference between the source domain and the target domain from the pixel level space; and further mapping the source domain distribution to the target domain distribution by a semantic segmentation domain self-adaptive method at the second stage of feature level, thereby enhancing the generalization capability of the semantic segmentation model. The method effectively solves the problems of overlarge data set difference and low model generalization capability in the practical application of the conventional earth surface coverage classification deep learning method. The invention has the following advantages: the method has strong robustness, can adapt to unlabelled image data of different image styles with different scales, can provide a ground surface coverage classification map with precision close to that of supervised training, and has higher application value in the aspects of city planning, map making, disaster response and the like.

title_en: Satellite rapid planning method and system for natural disaster emergency response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite rapid planning method facing natural disaster emergency response, which comprises the steps of establishing a satellite resource database of an in-orbit remote sensing surveying and mapping satellite, and constructing a satellite orbit model according to related parameters; establishing a historical disaster event database, and establishing a historical rehearsal model according to historical data and a risk analysis method; constructing an emergency task unified description model by adopting an ontology idea; matching the emergency task demand with the satellite resource observation capacity, including calculating the space-time parameters of the satellite through a satellite orbit model, comparing and screening the space-time parameters with the corresponding constraint conditions of the emergency task unified description model, and carrying out experience verification through a historical preview model; performing collaborative planning and resource recombination of dynamic tasks by adopting a rapid satellite task planning mode based on a key task priority rule; and constructing a satellite earth coverage calculation model, and carrying out simulation analysis of satellite observation. The invention has excellent practicability and feasibility in disaster monitoring.

title_en: Accident identification method for open channel water delivery system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accident identification method for an open channel water delivery system, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a simulation model of an actual channel; then, using the water plan as an input quantity, and obtaining the gate target opening, the downstream target water level and the target gate passing flow of each channel pool at different moments through simulation calculation of a simulation model; and taking the water level, the gate opening and the passing flow of the front and back of the gate of each channel pond obtained through actual measurement as input quantities, obtaining four judgment indexes of absolute maximum gate opening deviation, maximum water level deviation speed, end state flow increment and end state water level increment by combining with a target value obtained through simulation calculation, and judging whether an accident, an accident type, an accident channel pond and other information occur according to the four judgment indexes. The obtained accident source information provides basis for emergency scheduling, is favorable for quickly starting an emergency plan, reduces adverse impact of accidents, prevents the accidents from further spreading or causing secondary disasters, and is favorable for guaranteeing the structural safety of high-efficiency water supply and canal system or diversion projects.

title_en: Mining method for preventing gas from exceeding limit in initial mining period of group head mining surface of short-distance coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining method for preventing gas from exceeding the limit in the initial mining period of a near-distance coal seam cluster head mining face, which is characterized in that a drilling field of pre-splitting blasting drill holes is arranged on a top plate of a head mining working face, the pre-splitting blasting drill holes sequentially penetrate through rock masses between coal seams and an upper adjacent coal seam from bottom to top, and final holes enter the rock masses at the upper part of the upper adjacent coal seam; filling the presplitting blasting drill hole with the explosive and performing presplitting blasting; and blasting the communicating seam through the energy-gathering effect of the bidirectional energy-gathering pipe after the detonation, and finishing the arrangement of production equipment of a first mining working face after the blasting of the communicating seam is finished. In the initial mining period, the cutting depths of the forward and backward travel coal mining machines are adjusted by controlling the moving distance of the hydraulic support, and the reciprocating circulation is carried out in such a way to finally form an inclined first mining working surface. When the initial pressure is applied, the top plate on the goaf upper part of the first mining working face can collapse one by one according to the cuboid blocks formed by the pre-construction blasting communicating seam, so that the gas disaster accident caused by instantaneous overrun of the first mining working face in the initial mining period due to the whole collapse of the top plate is avoided, and the safe production of a coal mine is ensured.

title_en: Landslide susceptibility evaluation method based on automatic sample selection and surface deformation rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide susceptibility evaluation method based on sample automatic selection and surface deformation rate, which comprises the following steps of: extracting an evaluation factor to obtain the deformation rate of the earth surface; automatically selecting landslide samples and non-landslide samples in different periods; carrying out normalization processing on the evaluation factors by using the selected landslide sample; training an sDAE-RF model by utilizing a landslide sample and a non-landslide sample to obtain initial probability of landslide susceptibility; and correcting the initial probability of the landslide susceptibility by using the deformation rate of the earth surface to obtain a landslide susceptibility evaluation partition map. According to the method, the ground surface deformation rate reflecting the landslide motion state is utilized, so that the evaluation result is more consistent with the actual distribution condition of the regional landslide, the accuracy and the practicability of the evaluation method are improved, and accurate decision-making data are provided for the subsequent landslide disaster risk management.

title_en: Coal and gas outburst simulation experiment device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal and gas outburst simulation experiment device and a method thereof, and relates to the technical field of coal and gas outburst disasters, in particular to a coal and gas outburst simulation experiment device and a method thereof. This coal and gas outburst simulation experiment device can carry out effectual tic to gas through the bleed fan that sets up to gas purifier through the intercommunication purifies the gas after the experiment, avoids giving off the circumstances that the surrounding environment leads to personnel to be poisoned.

title_en: Debris flow disaster prediction method, system, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow disaster prediction method and a system, comprising the following steps: acquiring historical meteorological data and tower line data of a target area, inputting the historical meteorological data and the tower line data serving as training data into a preset SVM classifier forecasting model, and acquiring a second SVM classifier forecasting model; acquiring real-time meteorological data of a target area, inputting the real-time meteorological data into a second SVM classifier forecasting model, judging whether the target area can be subjected to debris flow disasters or not, if so, entering disaster prediction, and if not, ending; inputting historical meteorological data and tower line data into a preset LSTM artificial neural network model to obtain a second LSTM artificial neural network model; and inputting the real-time meteorological data into a second LSTM artificial neural network model, predicting the damage condition of the tower, and making corresponding maintenance measures according to the damage condition of the tower. The debris flow disaster forecasting method can improve the debris flow disaster forecasting accuracy.

title_en: Hydropower station dam break disaster event simulation evaluation analysis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station dam break disaster event simulation evaluation analysis system, which belongs to the technical field of disaster event simulation and comprises an accident case collection module, an accident case analysis module, an environment information acquisition module, an accident evolution module and an emergency drilling information platform module. The accident consequence of the key time-space nodes is constructed based on specific situations, the influence range of the accident and the duration of the corresponding accident situation can be effectively predicted, the effective optimal time window for emergency rescue work and public refuge and escape can be effectively prompted, irreplaceable guiding significance is provided for emergency rescue work of accident main bodies, emergency plan compilation and emergency drilling constructed based on the situations can effectively solve the problems of functional loss and conflict, emergency task main body loss, emergency task program loss, insufficient emergency resource support and the like existing in the current emergency plans of a plurality of enterprises. The emergency preparation and emergency rescue capability of each enterprise for dealing with major emergencies can be effectively improved.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG BAOXINGHE WATER POWER CO LTD;SHENZHEN ZHONGZHIAN CO LTD

title_en: Emergency shelter with modular retractable structure
abstract_en: Following post-disaster needs that should be addressed promptly, timely provision of shelter is a priority because it is effective in post-disaster tolerance. This need is met through an emergency shelter with a retractable structure. A shelter that is lightweight and would be set up with the least number of people, and also has a high setup speed can be applied in all areas with no installation training. Moreover, the advantage of an expandable structure that can be retracted and keep the environment safe is also considered. Also, modular structures make it possible for the units to be incorporated and provide larger spaces suitable for different numbers of people. This point can develop the field related to post-disaster reconstruction and be helpful in resolving pertinent issues.

title_en: Apparatus for fire-training
title_ko: 소방 훈련용 장치
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a device for firefighting training, which is provided to practice a use method of a fire extinguisher by injecting a fire extinguishing agent, comprises: a fire model plate configured to realize different shapes of flames according to operating modes; and a controller changing the operating modes of the fire model plate. The controller is configured with the predetermined number of buttons for changing the operating modes of the fire model plate through manual control of a user or changing the operating modes by an amount of the fire extinguishing agent reaching the fire model plate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 소화약제를 분사하여 소화기 사용법을 실습하는 소방 훈련용 장치에 있어서, 동작 모드에 따라 각기 다른 불꽃의 모습을 재현하도록 구성된 화재 모형판; 및 상기 화재 모형판의 상기 동작 모드를 변경하는 컨트롤러를 포함하고, 상기 컨트롤러는, 사용자의 수동 조작을 통해 상기 화재 모형판의 동작 모드를 변경하거나, 상기 화재 모형판에 도달한 소화약제의 양에 의해 동작 모드가 변경되도록 하기 위한 기 설정된 개수의 버튼으로 구성된다.

title_en: System and method for training action to disaster
title_ko: 재난 대응 훈련 시스템 및 그의 작동 방법
abstract_en: A disaster response training system is disclosed. The system includes a communication unit and at least one processor. The processor initiates a determined disaster response training, maps an electronic device displaying symptom information of a casualty to the casualty during a disaster training, and when emergency state information of the casualty is determined based on the symptom information, transmits the determined emergency state information to the electronic device mapped to the casualty through the communication unit. Accordingly, disaster response capability may be improved.
abstract_ko: 재난 대응 훈련 시스템이 개시된다. 본 시스템은 통신부, 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함한다. 프로세서는 결정된 상기 재난 대응 훈련을 개시하고, 재난 훈련 시에, 사상자의 증상 정보를 표시하는 전자 기기를 상기 사상자에 매핑하며, 상기 증상 정보에 기초하여, 상기 사상자의 위급 상태 정보가 결정되면, 결정된 상기 위급 상태 정보를 상기 통신부를 통해 상기 사상자에 매핑된 상기 전자 기기로 전송할 수 있다. 이에 따라, 재난 대응 능력이 향상될 수 있다.

title_en: Tunnel comprehensive advanced geological forecast intelligent early warning system and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of tunnel geological exploration, in particular to an intelligent early warning system for comprehensive advanced geological forecast of a tunnel and an implementation method thereof, which can actively push bad geological risk information and preventive measures to the site in real time along with the excavation progress in the construction process, can strengthen the application of the site to advanced geological forecast results, and has important significance for reducing the occurrence probability of geological disasters caused by the geological risk of the bad geological body; the prediction management personnel can automatically push the prediction task in advance, so that the corresponding prediction method can be implemented in time according to the actual condition of the scene, the process management of comprehensive advanced geological prediction can be enhanced, the scene personnel can feed back the actual excavation information of the scene to the prediction personnel in real time, the prediction result can be compared and analyzed with the geological condition revealed by the actual excavation, and the method is favorable for continuously and timely summarizing experience teaching and training, and guiding and improving advanced geological prediction work.

title_en: Gas-supplementing coal and gas outburst dynamic effect simulation experiment device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for simulating and testing the dynamic effect of gas-supplemented coal and gas outburst, belonging to the technical field of coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiments; the device comprises a gas supplementing tank, wherein the gas supplementing tank is connected with a gas supplementing pipeline, a one-way valve is arranged on the gas supplementing pipeline, the other end of the gas supplementing pipeline is connected with a gas inlet of an inflating flange, a gas outlet is formed in the inflating flange and is communicated with an inner cavity of a protruding cavity, one end of a protruding cavity body is connected with the inflating flange and is sealed, and the other end of the protruding cavity body is connected with a protruding opening; according to the protruding cavity V 0 Calculating the pressure relief at the actual coal seamVolume V of free gas for participating in outstanding work 2 And the air is filled into the air supply tank, and air is supplied to the protruding cavity through the air supply pipeline and the air supply flange; the problem that the experimental data of the coal and gas outburst effect is inaccurate due to the fact that the conventional coal and gas outburst dynamic effect simulation experimental device and method do not quantitatively analyze gas permeation of a pressure relief area is solved through the simple and easy-to-operate experimental device and method.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Design method of disaster prevention ventilation facility of tunnel portal emergency rescue station
