abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of a disaster prevention ventilation facility of a tunnel portal emergency rescue station, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a first preset parameter, and establishing a railway tunnel portal emergency rescue station model; establishing a fire source model based on train parameters; fitting the railway tunnel portal emergency rescue station model and the fire source model to obtain a disaster prevention ventilation model of the railway tunnel portal emergency rescue station, and performing simulation calculation on second preset parameters based on the disaster prevention ventilation model to obtain a relation calculation formula and a change curve between the second preset parameters; and obtaining a disaster prevention ventilation scheme of the emergency rescue station at the railway tunnel portal based on the relation calculation formula and the change curve. The method can meet the design requirements of disaster prevention ventilation schemes of emergency rescue stations in tunnels with different tunnel portal intervals and tunnel cross-sectional areas, and provides a quick, simple and convenient design method for the ventilation scheme of the emergency rescue station at the railway tunnel portal at present.

title_en: High-low combined presplitting blasting method for hard top plate of coal face in subareas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-low combined presplitting blasting method for hard top plates of a coal face in different areas, which is characterized in that the working face between a cutting hole and a mining stop line is equally divided into a plurality of areas along the advancing direction of the working face, and drilling and coring are adopted for each area to test, so that the thickness and physical mechanical parameters of different layers of strata above the top plates of each area are determined, the position of the hard strata above the top plate of a roadway of each area is further determined, and the vertical distance between the top plate of each hard stratum and the top plate of the roadway and the thickness of the top plate of each hard stratum are obtained; a plurality of blast hole groups are uniformly distributed in the two crossroads in the same partition, and each group of blast holes is arranged from the production side of the roadway top plate of the crossroad to the upper part of the working surface; and determining the construction parameters of each blast hole in each blast hole group, and performing pre-splitting blasting on the hard rock layer above the top plate of each partition roadway, thereby completing the pre-splitting blasting operation of the hard top plate above the working face. Effectively improve the presplitting blasting effect, reduce the power disaster risk that leads to by hard roof.

title_en: Geological disaster chain simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster chain simulation test device, which comprises a model box, a water injection box, a pipeline, a lifting device, a rainfall simulation device and a water level changing device; the mold box is a cuboid with a frame structure, the side surface of the mold box is a retaining plate, the bottom surface of the mold box is a bottom plate, one side of the bottom plate is hinged with the side surface of the mold box, the bottom plate can turn over around a hinged shaft, and a lifting device is connected below the bottom plate and is positioned on the ground; the rainfall simulation device is positioned at the top of the model box and comprises a plurality of spray heads facing the interior of the model box; the water level changing device comprises a plurality of water injection pipes, a plurality of through holes are formed in the soil retaining plate and/or the bottom plate, and the water injection pipes are connected in the through holes in a sliding mode; the water injection tank is located the simulation case side, is provided with the water injection pump in the water injection tank, and the water injection pump passes through pipe connection shower nozzle and water injection pipe. The simulation test of simulating the special complex geological structure and various disaster chain types induced by the loess plateau disaster chain can be met.

title_en: Traffic meteorological disaster assessment method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traffic meteorological disaster assessment method, a device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical meteorological information and historical traffic accident data information; establishing a traffic meteorological disaster prediction model according to the historical meteorological information and the historical traffic accident data information, and training the traffic meteorological disaster prediction model to obtain a trained traffic meteorological disaster prediction model; and re-acquiring historical meteorological information and historical traffic accident data information, inputting the historical meteorological information and the historical traffic accident data information into a trained traffic meteorological disaster prediction model to obtain a traffic accident state vector, and evaluating the traffic meteorological disasters according to the traffic accident state vector. The traffic meteorological disaster assessment method provided by the invention realizes the assessment of the traffic meteorological disaster.

title_en: Method and system for simulating cascading failure of thermoelectric coupling system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for simulating cascading failures of a thermoelectric coupling system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring natural disaster meteorological data and system load data at the time t; calculating the fault probability of the line based on the natural disaster meteorological data, and updating the performance state of the thermoelectric equipment; randomly disconnecting the line based on the fault probability of the line, updating the topological structure of the thermoelectric coupling system network, and determining the current operation mode; performing thermoelectric coupling load flow calculation based on the current operation mode; analyzing the calculation result of the thermoelectric coupling load flow, and counting out the line with out-of-limit power; if no power out-of-limit line exists, counting the total line disconnection condition within the time t, and determining the load loss in the thermoelectric coupling system based on the system load data; and randomly disconnecting the line with the power exceeding the limit with a preset probability, updating the network topology of the system, determining the current operation mode, and then returning to the thermocouple load flow calculation and circulating until the line without the power exceeding the limit.

title_en: Mine disaster rescue double-power-head gas-lift reverse circulation drilling machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster rescue double-power-head gas-lift reverse circulation drilling machine, which belongs to the field of reverse circulation drilling machines. According to the invention, the buffer protection mechanism is arranged, the limiting block is connected with the limiting groove, so that the fixed plate can be contacted with the extrusion rod when the rope is broken or the downward movement speed of the fixed plate is too high, the first partition plate can move downward in the second sliding groove through the second sliding block under the action of the third spring, the first partition plate can extrude the first T-shaped rod, the second T-shaped rod can be extruded into the first hole groove and the second hole groove under the action of the elastic force of the second spring, the first T-shaped rod, the extrusion rod and the fixed plate can be conveniently limited, the potential safety hazard to peripheral personnel can be prevented, and the parts on the equipment can be damaged.
assignees: JIANGSU JINYAYI HEAVY INDUSTRY TECH CO LTD

title_en: A connection structure for collapsible loess side slope support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a connection structure for collapsible loess slope support, which comprises concrete lattice drainage channels arranged in a plurality of rhombuses on the slope surface of a collapsible loess slope; drilling holes at the vertex position of each rhombus, and sequentially anchoring prestressed anchor rods and anti-collapse anchor rods in a layered and staggered manner; the anti-collapse anchor rod comprises a steel wire mesh circular tube, concrete poured in the steel wire mesh circular tube and pseudo-ginseng grey soil for absorbing water in the collapsed loess slope; the length of the concrete poured into the round steel wire mesh pipe is 1/3 of the total length of the round steel wire mesh pipe; the distance between the pseudo-ginseng gray soil injected into the steel wire mesh round pipe and the slope surface of the collapsible loess slope is 10-15 cm. The concrete lattice drainage channel can absorb water in the soil body, reduce the collapsibility of the soil body, form a tie to the concrete lattice drainage channel, avoid the separation of the drainage channel from the slope body and the occurrence of secondary disasters, has simple and firm structure and good strength, can well prevent the sliding of the slope body, and can reduce the collapsibility of the soil body.

title_en: Early identification method for small-basin geological disaster hidden danger points
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for early identifying hidden danger points of geological disasters in a small watershed, which comprises the following steps: (1) Constructing a three-dimensional high-precision digital scene of the geological disaster in a small river basin through a composite high-definition space recognition technology and ground fine investigation; (2) Carrying out recognition research on the space and time distribution rule of the geological disaster in the small river basin by means of an artificial intelligence method; (3) Combining an indoor and outdoor test and a numerical simulation method to construct a geological disaster starting judgment model and a critical judgment index system; (4) And establishing various potential hidden danger interpretation identification marks to form a technical method for early identifying the hidden danger of the geological disaster. According to the invention, through a composite high-definition space recognition technology and an artificial intelligence method, indoor and outdoor tests, disaster starting numerical simulation and the like are combined, early recognition research of geological disaster hidden danger points is carried out on a small river basin, the result can provide theoretical basis for a geological disaster forecasting system, and simultaneously important parameters for treatment engineering planning, design and the like are provided.

title_en: Synchronous optimization method for remote hydropower contract and hydropower station group scheduling rule
abstract_en: The invention provides a synchronous optimization method of a long-term hydroelectric contract and a hydropower station group scheduling rule, which comprises the following steps: constructing a clearing model to simulate daily average spot price; acquiring a historical runoff sequence of the power station and taking the historical runoff sequence and the simulated spot-shipment electricity price as input parameters of a subsequent model; constructing a double-layer optimized dispatching model, optimizing the electric quantity of the hydropower contract by taking the data in the step 2 as input parameters of the double-layer optimized dispatching model and acquiring a deterministic dispatching track of the cascade reservoir group; determining the form of a scheduling rule on the basis of the optimal running track obtained in the step 3; after the form of the scheduling rule is determined, the parameter simulation optimization method is used for synchronously optimizing the scheduling rule parameters and the contract electric quantity of each month. The invention realizes the synchronous optimization of the optimal operation track of the library group and the monthly contract electric quantity, and the model of the invention greatly reduces the calculation difficulty and dimension disaster of methods such as an exhaustion method and the like.

title_en: Landslide displacement prediction model and method based on semantic information driving
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide displacement prediction model based on semantic information driving, which comprises the following construction methods: converting landslide monitoring data into semantic information through feature construction and feature combination to obtain an independent combined sample and a continuous combined sample; dividing a landslide accumulated displacement curve into a gentle stage and an acceleration stage by adopting a sliding window variance algorithm; performing deep semantic feature extraction on the continuous combined sample in the mild stage, and performing deep semantic feature extraction on the single combined sample in the acceleration stage; training the long-term and short-term memory neural network by using deep semantic features of continuous combined samples and single combined samples to obtain a semantic information driven slow stage recognizer and a semantic information driven acceleration stage predictor; and taking the output result of the recognizer as an interactive switch to control the recognizer and the predictor to work cooperatively. The method and the device can solve the problems that the gentle stage and the acceleration stage cannot be distinguished for landslide disaster prediction, and the daily displacement of the acceleration stage cannot be predicted accurately.

title_en: Regional geological disaster trend prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional geological disaster trend prediction method and system, and relates to the field of geological disaster prediction. The regional geological disaster trend prediction method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring geological parameter information of a current region, and then screening in a preset reference terrain library according to the geological parameter information of the current region to obtain reference region information; extracting and training according to historical geological disaster information in the geological parameter information of the current region and historical geological disaster information in the reference region information to obtain a prediction geological disaster trend model; and finally, inputting the geological parameter information of the current region into a geological disaster trend forecasting model to obtain the geological disaster trend information of the current region, and training by adding historical geological disaster information of a reference region to improve the accuracy of the geological disaster trend forecasting model and enable a forecasting result obtained through the model to be more accurate, so that the geological disaster trend of the current region is more accurate.

title_en: Multifunctional integrated animal operating table
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional integrated animal operating table which comprises animal operation components such as a table top, a folding support, a table top extension block, a hook and the like, wherein the table top extension block can be folded and fixed at 0 degree, 90 degrees and 180 degrees. Each part of the animal operating table can be folded, so that the occupied space is reduced, the carrying and the transportation are convenient, the operating table top can be expanded according to the requirement, and the animal operating table is suitable for animals with various body types and sizes; the mesa is the stereoplasm mesa of monoblock integral type, can regard as stereoplasm stretcher to use, and mesa extension piece, couple can and have buffer function's folding support synergism, can effectively avoid the wounded in transport, rescue vehicle transportation because of the secondary damage that reasons such as vibrations lead to, improved the application scope of this animal operating table greatly, be applicable to very much that the traffic is inconvenient such as natural disaster scene is not convenient, the treatment resource is deficient, produce the operation simulation of the first aid environment of wounded in batches.

title_en: Real device of instructing of intelligent engineering of building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building intelligent engineering practical training device, wherein a buffer shock absorption groove is arranged above a base through a connecting base, a buffer plate is arranged in the buffer shock absorption groove through a longitudinal buffer mechanism and a transverse buffer mechanism, a variable frequency vibration motor is arranged above the buffer plate, a lifting bedplate is arranged above the buffer plate through a connecting plate and a lifting driving mechanism, a rotating ring is arranged above the lifting bedplate through the rotating groove, and a variable frequency fan is arranged on one side of the rotating ring through a telescopic rod; the utility model discloses a variable frequency vibration motor and variable frequency fan can be to the building of the real standard of student buildding antidetonation and anti-wind emulation test, increase the student to the cognition of building protection structural feature under the natural disasters, make the study of building system student not confine theoretical knowledge to, the device is inhaled through the buffering and is shaken the influence that the vibrations that the seat mechanism can effectively offset the experiment production caused simultaneously, and the device passes through the adjustable variable frequency fan angle of blowing of swivel becket, the simulation building is at the anti-wind test of equidirectional, the teaching practicality is strong.
assignees: CHUZHOU ZHENGSHAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire extinguishing system simulation building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of teaching models, and discloses a fire-fighting system simulation building, which comprises a building body, wherein an inner laminated plate and a partition wall of the building body are both made of transparent plates or transparent glass, no outer wall is arranged at the periphery of the building body, and a fire alarm linkage host and a fire alarm system, an evacuation emergency lighting system, a positive pressure air supply system, a fire-proof rolling door system, a wet system, a fire hydrant system, a smoke exhaust system and a fire-fighting broadcasting system which are connected with the fire alarm linkage host are arranged in the building body; the utility model provides a pair of fire extinguishing system simulation building can let the audio-visual distribution condition of seeing each fire extinguishing system in the building of student in real teaching of instructing, can trigger the alarm device who satisfies fire control linkage function on the simulation building, and the relative mobile device action in the whole building of demonstration, further lets the student clear fire extinguishing system's warning linkage logical relation.
assignees: CHENGDU XINZHONGAN FIRE VOCATIONAL SKILLS TRAINING SCHOOL

title_en: Urban multipoint circulating emergency evacuation and simulation deduction method based on variable cells
abstract_en: The invention provides a variable cell-based urban multipoint circulating emergency evacuation and simulation deduction method, which comprises the following steps: s1, initializing a traffic evacuation road network, designating a plurality of parking points, evacuation points and safety points, and acquiring traffic states; s2, mapping the actual road network and the evacuation scene to a virtual road network based on a variable cell transmission model; s3, establishing a path selection model of vehicle many-to-many cycle reciprocating evacuation, and modeling to solve parameters; s4, performing real-time simulation rehearsal evaluation on the evacuation path solved under the determined scene in the virtual road network; s5, diagnosing whether an evacuation bottleneck exists according to the simulation result, and outputting an evacuation path and an evaluation index if the evacuation bottleneck does not exist; if so, repeating the steps S2-S4 until the evacuation bottleneck is eliminated or the evacuation target is reached. The invention has strong comprehensiveness, wide applicability and high reliability, and integrates key technologies of vehicle path selection, evacuation control measures, traffic simulation evaluation and the like; the method can adapt to evacuation road networks in different scenes; the reliability of the simulation evaluation is determined through example verification.

title_en: Oil and gas station lightning accident early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a lightning accident early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium for an oil and gas station. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target component information corresponding to an oil and gas station power system; establishing an equivalent circuit model corresponding to the power system according to the target component information and the corresponding connection relation; carrying out a lightning stroke simulation test on the equivalent circuit model to obtain lightning stroke test data; evaluating whether the oil and gas station power system is safe to operate under the lightning condition according to the lightning stroke test data; and if not, generating the lightning accident early warning information of the oil and gas station. According to the method, through the lightning stroke simulation test, a large amount of real lightning disaster data does not need to be collected, the workload is effectively reduced, the working efficiency is improved, the problems of errors, alarm missing and the like caused by manual judgment are avoided, the analysis result is more accurate, and early warning information can be generated to prompt a user to take corresponding preventive measures as soon as possible.

title_en: Emergency generator car configuration method and computer network system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of emergency repair of electrical equipment, and discloses an emergency power generation car configuration method, which comprises the following steps: 1. collecting records of multi-source data cases aiming at historical disaster sites, and selecting and determining a power failure emergency repair correlation factor; 2. determining the optimal emergency power generation vehicle configuration strategy for each case; 3. training a power generation vehicle configuration strategy selection model network based on a multilayer back propagation neural network by using sample data; 4. acquiring real-time data of a disaster site; 5. and inputting the multidimensional information data acquired in real time at the power disaster site into the model to obtain the optimal configuration of the emergency power generation car in real time. The invention also provides a computer network system which comprises an emergency power-generating car configuration module and a processing circuit, wherein the emergency power-generating car configuration module is stored with the power failure emergency repair correlation factor, and the processing circuit can call the emergency power-generating car configuration module to execute the emergency power-generating car configuration method. The method and the system can achieve the real-time acquisition of the optimal power generation vehicle configuration strategy, guide the field emergency command decision and improve the emergency repair efficiency.
assignees: DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Debris flow disaster early warning method and system based on runoff convergence simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a debris flow disaster early warning method and a debris flow disaster early warning system based on runoff confluence simulation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing small watershed division on the early warning area to serve as an early warning basic unit; acquiring a debris flow disaster risk probability background value, runoff confluence water depth and a gully distance factor, and calculating a debris flow disaster early warning result; calculating a background value of the debris flow disaster risk probability and the weight of runoff merging water depth based on historical debris flow disaster point data in the early warning area; and calculating the debris flow disaster early warning result based on the debris flow disaster risk probability background value, the runoff confluence water depth and the gully distance factor within the time to be predicted in the early warning area so as to perform debris flow disaster early warning judgment. The scheme can quickly and accurately early warn debris flow disasters in advance.

title_en: Natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: extracting characteristics of each evaluation index based on an artificial intelligence algorithm to obtain evaluation characteristics; performing model training through a machine learning algorithm according to the evaluation characteristics to obtain an evaluation model; comprehensively considering the connectivity among single disaster species and the vulnerability of a disaster bearing body according to the evaluation model to obtain a comprehensive risk evaluation result; and carrying out risk zoning according to the comprehensive risk assessment result. By implementing the method of the embodiment of the invention, the interpretability of risk assessment is enhanced, the vulnerability and the exposure of the disaster-bearing body are considered, the input information of the model comprises the single disaster type danger, the vulnerability and the disaster-bearing capacity of the disaster-bearing body and the relationship among multiple disaster types, the input information of the model is sufficient, and the relationship and the interaction among disaster-causing factors are considered to be comprehensive.

title_en: Landslide remote sensing information extraction method based on convolutional neural network and classification thermodynamic diagram
abstract_en: The application relates to a landslide remote sensing information extraction method based on a convolutional neural network and a classification thermodynamic diagram, and the landslide scale difference in a high-resolution remote sensing image is large, and the problem of spectrum confusion with other ground objects is serious. The existing landslide scene interpretation method based on the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is difficult to accurately position a landslide boundary, and a large number of samples need to be manually drawn by a pixel-level landslide information extraction method based on the full convolutional neural network (FCN). The application aims at the above problems, and provides a weak supervision landslide disaster information extraction framework by taking category thermodynamic diagrams as bridges: firstly, a classification network model coupling an attention mechanism with multi-level and multi-scale characteristics is designed to learn landslide and non-landslide scenes, and then a high-quality landslide scene classification thermodynamic diagram is obtained; secondly, training a semantic segmentation network by using the pixel-level pseudo labels acquired from the category thermodynamic diagrams, and further realizing high-precision pixel-level landslide disaster information extraction in the remote sensing images.

title_en: Disaster monitoring device
abstract_en: The application provides a disaster monitoring device relates to monitoring technical field, includes: the drill rod and set up in the casing, sensor and the actuating mechanism of drill rod, protect a section of thick bamboo including can enclose at least two flaps that close each other and form the inner chamber, set up the sensor in the inner chamber, alright protect the sensor of inside through protecting a section of thick bamboo (at least two flaps) under the state of enclosing. At least two petals are hinged to the drill rod respectively, the action mechanism is in transmission connection with the at least two petals, and therefore the pile casing can be controlled to be in an open state or a closed state, the sensor can be inserted into a side slope soil layer under the protection of the pile casing and can be conveniently opened after being inserted into the side slope soil layer to collect the side slope soil layer information.
assignees: AERIAL PHOTOGRAMMETRY AND REMOTE SENSING CO LTD;MEIHANG REMOTE SENSING INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Experimental device and experimental method for simulating complete process of superlift burst disaster of tillite lake
abstract_en: The invention provides an experimental device and an experimental method for simulating the whole process of superfall burst disaster of a moraine lake, wherein the experimental device is provided with a six-position two-system for realizing the synchronous measurement of triggering, propagation, superfall, disaster causing, evolution whole life, dynamic parameters, environmental noise vibration signals and imaging parameters in the whole process of the superfall burst disaster of the moraine lake, and comprises a water supply device, a surge triggering device, an energy dissipation device, a buffer device, an experimental water tank main body device, a collection device, a synchronous measurement system and a monitoring system. The simulation method not only can realize the simulation of the whole process of ice collapse-surging-overtopping-disaster forming, but also can observe and research the erosion characteristic of the ice tillite dam in the bursting process, can monitor important parameters such as dynamics, environmental noise and the like in the movement process of a debris flow formed by bursting flood, and mainly fills up the blank of the dynamics mechanism research knowledge of the erosion process of the ice tillite dam body in the current research on the ice lake bursting flood.

title_en: Landslide monitoring and early warning system in mountain canyon region
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses a landslide monitoring and early warning system in a high mountain canyon region, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a meteorological information acquisition module, a geological information acquisition module, an image acquisition module, an unmanned aerial vehicle control module, a central control module, an information analysis module, an early warning region defining module, an inclination measuring module, a model construction module and a landslide early warning module. According to the landslide monitoring and early warning system for the high mountain canyon region, provided by the invention, the meteorological information, the geological information and the image of the high mountain canyon region are collected and then subjected to information analysis processing to obtain a landslide high-risk region, and the landslide high-risk region is used as an early warning region for key monitoring, so that the monitoring cost can be reduced, the early warning difficulty is reduced, and the monitoring effect is good; the slope of the mountain in the area is obtained through analysis of the collected information, then the model of the area is built, landslide early warning is carried out through landslide simulation results, and the method is convenient and rapid to carry out and high in early warning accuracy.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY SOUTHWEST RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for preventing natural disasters in small watershed based on emergency plan visualization and rapid drawing
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for preventing natural disasters of small watersheds based on emergency plan visualization and rapid drawing, which comprises the steps of obtaining various information of the small watersheds; carrying out rapid drawing to form a 3D simulation map; optimizing the 3D simulation map, and presuming the type and possibility of natural disasters to provide a preliminary emergency plan; and adjusting and optimizing the preliminary emergency plan to form a final emergency plan. The 3D simulation map is constructed and optimized through various information of the small watershed, so that the possibility of occurrence of natural disasters in the small watershed area, the occurring area, the type and the time can be automatically calculated, and the prevention efficiency of the natural disasters in the small watershed area is improved; in addition, the 3D simulation map can visually display the deduction process, so that people can visually and clearly observe the regional layout possibly generating natural disasters, hazards generated by the disasters and the like, and the 3D simulation map has reference and auxiliary effects on the prevention of the natural disasters. The problem of how to prevent natural disasters in small watersheds is solved.

title_en: Early warning method for deep mining dangerous area based on stress-drilling cuttings amount gradient
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coal mining, in particular to a stress-drilling cuttings amount gradient-based early warning method for a deep mining dangerous area, which collects data; carrying out mining numerical simulation; calculating stress distribution data along with space and stress distribution data along with time; calculating the unit time drilling cuttings discharge amount and the unit space drilling cuttings discharge amount in the process that the drill bit drills different rock stratum mediums; dividing a stress mutation region; dividing a gas mutation area; after the working face is mined, real-time online stress monitoring is carried out on the area according to the divided dangerous area, a stress field, a gas field and a hydrology field of the monitored area are obtained, and the early warning device is controlled to carry out early warning, so that disasters are reduced. According to the invention, the support structure and the protection structure are simultaneously connected with the surrounding rock in an anchoring manner through the anchor rod structure, so that the mounting firmness of the support structure and the protection structure can be improved, the protection effect is improved, the support protection can be carried out in the tunneling and ore excavation process, and the safety of workers is ensured.

title_en: Bridge wind vibration cross section demonstration device for teaching using 3D printing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a bridge wind engineering field and disaster prevention and reduction technical field, in particular to use bridge wind vibration cross section presentation device for teaching of 3D printing. The device comprises a bridge cross section model, a support, a connecting rope and a wind generating device. The bridge cross section model is used for simulating the cross section shape of a real bridge; the bracket is used for hanging a cross section model of the bridge; the connecting rope is used for connecting the bridge cross section model and the bracket to ensure the suspension posture of the bridge cross section model; the wind generating device is arranged on one side of the support and used for simulating the action of transverse wind encountered by a real bridge. This device can vividly and scientifically show the vibration response of bridge under the effect of transverse wind, and the effect is directly perceived and showing, and the device part is simple and portable and equipment, has the significance to bridge wind engineering teaching.

title_en: Bridge wind vibration presentation device for wood system teaching
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of bridge wind engineering field and disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to bridge wind vibration presentation device is used in wood system teaching. The device comprises a wooden bridge pier, a wooden bridge, a paper bridge deck, glue and wind generating devices. The size of the bridge pier is high, and the bridge pier is used for simulating a giant bridge pier of an actual large-span suspension bridge or a cable-stayed bridge; the bridge is long in size and is used for simulating a steel box girder or a concrete girder of an actual long-span bridge; the paper bridge deck has low rigidity and is used for simulating the bridge deck of an actual bridge paved by asphalt or concrete; the glue is used for bonding the battens and the paper bridge deck; the wind generating device is arranged on one side of the bridge and used for simulating the action of transverse wind encountered by a real bridge. The utility model discloses a bridge wind presentation device that shakes can vividly and scientifically show and stride the vibrations response of bridge under the effect of crosswind greatly, and the effect is directly perceived showing. And the device can be assembled on the teaching site, and the parts are simple and convenient to carry, thereby having important significance for bridge wind engineering teaching.

title_en: Resistivity tomography-based landslide revival simulation device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster simulation, and discloses a device and a method for simulating ancient landslide resurgence based on a resistivity tomography method, wherein the device comprises the following components: a model box; the model comprises an ancient landslide model, a sliding bed, a sliding belt and a sliding body, wherein the ancient landslide model comprises a base, the sliding bed, the sliding belt and the sliding body, the base is fixedly connected with the inner wall of a model box, an inclined plane is formed at the top of the base, the sliding bed is installed on the inclined plane, the sliding belt is laid on the sliding bed, the sliding body is laid on the sliding belt, and a plurality of displacement sensors, soil pressure sensors, pore water pressure sensors and soil moisture sensors are embedded in the sliding body; an artificial rainfall system; a resistivity imaging system comprising a resistivity measurement device, a plurality of electrodes, and an insulating plate; a camera system; and a data processing system. The ancient landslide revival simulation device and method based on the resistivity tomography method can better monitor the water migration and seepage rules in the landslide revival process.

title_en: Landslide debris flow formation evolution simulation method based on rainfall data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide debris flow formation evolution simulation method based on rainfall data, which comprises the following steps of: s1, acquiring rainfall data, runoff generating infiltration parameters, soil types, soil distribution conditions and topographic data of a debris flow source area by using fixed-point monitoring and field tests; s2, obtaining a dynamic model suitable for describing each stage of debris flow motion by analyzing the processes and mechanisms of slope instability caused by rainfall in the mountainous area, debris flow generation, confluence and development; and S3, considering rainfall infiltration, slope body and channel erosion, soil body damage and debris flow movement processes, realizing hydrological simulation and calculation of slope body instability damage caused by rainfall and debris flow convergence and propagation, and disclosing an evolution mechanism of rainfall-landslide-debris flow. The invention considers the processes of rainwater infiltration, surface runoff, channel erosion, soil body destruction and the like, realizes the whole process of debris flow generation and propagation, and realizes the simulation of convergence and propagation, thereby providing an important basis for the prevention and treatment of debris flow disasters.

title_en: Computer method for simulating load response caused by landslide disaster impact on seabed energy pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean engineering disaster prevention and reduction engineering, and discloses a computer method for simulating load response caused when a submarine energy pipeline is impacted by landslide disasters, which comprises the following steps: step 1) establishing a three-dimensional model; s1: performing simulation analysis by adopting commercial computational fluid dynamics software, setting the geometric configuration of a fluid computational domain and an energy pipeline in a software geometric module, and establishing a three-dimensional model for causing load response when the energy pipeline is impacted by landslide disasters; step 2), carrying out mesh division on the three-dimensional model; s1: the computer method for simulating the load response of the submarine energy pipeline under the impact of the landslide disaster is used for clearly and intuitively simulating the complex fluid motion by establishing a three-dimensional model, and the comprehensive evaluation work of the load response of the energy pipeline under the impact of the landslide body is realized by the computer method based on a mixed soil mechanics-fluid mechanics theory framework.

title_en: Geologic body water content test system based on nuclear magnetic resonance sensor and 5G communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geologic body water content testing system based on a nuclear magnetic resonance sensor and 5G communication, which is suitable for real-time monitoring and prevention and control of geologic body water-borne disasters such as side slopes, dams, foundation piles and the like, comprises the nuclear magnetic resonance sensor, is arranged in a geologic body detection drilling hole, consists of a radio frequency module, a receiving module, a control module, a wireless communication module and a lifting module, and can test the water content at different depths around the drilling hole; the 5G base station comprises an uploading module and a downloading module, receives a test instruction from the monitoring platform, transmits the test instruction to the nuclear magnetic resonance sensor and uploads test data of the sensor to the monitoring platform; the monitoring platform comprises a collection module, a data processing module, an early warning module and a communication module, can issue collection instructions to the sensors, analyzes the uploaded test data, obtains three-dimensional distribution and evolution of the water content of the geologic body, and carries out early warning on geological disasters. The system can permanently monitor the water content of the geologic body, identify the premonition of geological disasters and timely pre-warn geological disasters such as landslide and dam break of the mountain.

title_en: Dam and slope stability monitoring and early warning method based on NMR and Beidou remote sensing combined measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam and slope stability monitoring and early warning method based on NMR and Beidou remote sensing joint measurement, and belongs to the field of disaster monitoring and early warning. Building a monitoring center, a side slope monitoring substation and a dam monitoring substation on a dam or a side slope; constructing monitoring drill holes on a side slope and a dam, putting a PVC sleeve pipe close to the hole wall, and putting a miniature nuclear magnetic resonance probe into the PVC sleeve pipe; the miniature nuclear magnetic resonance probe is moved up and down by a lifting controller to acquire nuclear magnetic signals of rock and soil bodies or dam bodies around the drill hole, a Beidou remote sensing system is used for photographing a side slope or a dam in real time, and finally monitoring data are gathered to a monitoring center; the nuclear magnetic data are inverted to obtain water content, permeability and porosity data of a rock-soil body or a dam body, the surface displacement of the slope or the dam body is calculated by comparing the pictures, the data are compared with the database in real time, early warning signals are timely issued when the data are suddenly changed, a plurality of data can be rapidly monitored, the operation is simple, and the accuracy is high.

title_en: Earthquake disaster area remote sensing image interpretation method based on graph transformation knowledge embedding algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster interpretation, in particular to an earthquake disaster area remote sensing image interpretation method based on a graph transformation knowledge embedding algorithm. Acquiring remote sensing image data of an earthquake-stricken area; inputting the remote sensing image data of the earthquake-stricken area into a remote sensing image semantic segmentation model obtained by pre-training; outputting an interpretation result; the pre-training process of the remote sensing image semantic segmentation model comprises the following steps: obtaining a remote sensing image of a research area; constructing an initial remote sensing image semantic segmentation model; training the initial remote sensing image semantic segmentation modelThe method for constructing the initial remote sensing image semantic segmentation model comprises the following steps: computing the original graph structure G of a single sample ori (ii) a Traversing and copying the nodes in the original graph based on the total category number, and obtaining the structure G of the original graph ori Converted into a knowledge hypergraph structure G new (ii) a Carrying out node feature aggregation in a GCN model; and cutting the knowledge hypergraph structure through the classifier to obtain an initial remote sensing image semantic segmentation model.

title_en: U-Net neural network ice lake extraction method combined with self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a U-Net neural network ice lake extraction method combined with a self-attention mechanism, which mainly comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring a remote sensing image of a research area and drawing label data; then, a supervised classification training grid data set is manufactured, a contrast test input waveband is selected, a neural network model is constructed, and effects are contrastively analyzed; and finally, extracting the ice lake in the research area by using the model with the best effect. The invention combines Landsat 8 full-waveband remote sensing data with the U-Net network fused with self attention, can be used for assisting decision, early warning and reducing harm, and provides a new idea for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Post-disaster road extraction method based on dynamic filtering and multi-direction attention fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing image road extraction, in particular to a post-disaster road extraction method based on dynamic filtering and multi-direction attention fusion. The method comprises the steps of collecting remote sensing image data of a research area; inputting the remote sensing influence data into a DCCA network model obtained by pre-training; outputting an extraction result; the pre-training process of the DCCA network model comprises the following steps: collecting remote sensing image data of a research area; processing the remote sensing image data to obtain a data set containing an image and an annotated image; performing direction information attention on the image characteristics through a CCA network model and an RCCA network model, and respectively outputting direction attention information energy and a network extraction result output; respectively training a CCA network model and an RCCA network model by utilizing a data set; and fusing the CCA network model and the RCCA network model based on the direction attention information energy and the network extraction result output respectively output by the CCA network model and the RCCA network model to obtain the DCCA network model.

title_en: Ancient town forest district disaster evolution analysis simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ancient town forest disaster evolution analysis and simulation device, which comprises: the system comprises a supporting and fixing part, a debris flow evolution analysis module and a fire disaster evolution analysis module, wherein the debris flow evolution analysis module and the fire disaster evolution analysis module can be respectively placed on the supporting and fixing part to perform corresponding disaster evolution analysis; the supporting and fixing component comprises a bottom rod, ejector rods, vertical rods, a supporting plate and a supporting plate mounting component, wherein the bottom rod, the ejector rods and the vertical rods are assembled into a frame structure to support the fixing component, the supporting plate is arranged in the middle of the supporting and fixing component, and the gradient of the supporting plate can be flexibly adjusted through the supporting plate mounting component. By arranging the optional debris flow evolution analysis module and the fire disaster evolution analysis module, the simulation device can be used for debris flow disaster simulated evolution analysis and mountain fire disaster simulated evolution analysis.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA AGRI;INNER MONGOLIA LUXING ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine fire video image intelligent recognition device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine fire video image intelligent identification device and a method, wherein the device comprises a plurality of fire video acquisition modules and a monitoring computer connected with the fire video acquisition modules, the fire video acquisition modules comprise cameras, and the cameras are connected with the monitoring computer through a communication module; the method comprises the following steps: firstly, installing a fire video acquisition module and acquiring a video image; secondly, extracting a fire disaster image; thirdly, constructing a fire image sample set; fourthly, training fire images based on a YOLOV5 deep network model; fifthly, defogging treatment is carried out on the fire image collected subsequently; sixthly, extracting the prospect of the subsequently collected fire image; and seventhly, detecting, identifying and alarming mine fire hazard video images in real time. The fire monitoring system can realize real-time monitoring of mine fires, can quickly identify detected flame images, find fire hazards in time and ensure safe production of mines and life safety of workers.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;SHAANXI XIKE ZHIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire training system
title_ko: 소방 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting training system. The firefighting training system includes: a display device placed on a wall of each space divided by a partition in a firefighting training facility to display a firefighting training image about the scene of a fire; firefighting training markers placed on a wall on the display device; an image photographing device photographing the space where the display device is placed to create a space image; a local server recognizing each of the firefighting training markers included in the space image through analysis on the image, leading a marker image corresponding to each of the firefighting training markers and creating the firefighting training image overlapped with the marker image on a position of the firefighting training markers on the display device, creating an effect image in response to the movement of a smart device caused by the control of a user, and reflecting the effect image to the firefighting training image; and the smart device performing an operation corresponding to a control signal of the local server. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing effective firefighting training to users through smart devices.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 소방 교육 시스템은, 소방 교육 시설 내 격벽으로 구획된 공간들 각각의 벽면에 배치되어 화재 현장에 대한 소방 교육 영상을 표시하는 표시 장치와, 상기 표시 장치 상의 벽면에 배치된 소방 교육용 마커들과, 상기 표시 장치가 배치된 공간을 촬영하여 공간 영상을 생성하는 영상 촬영장치과, 상기 공간 영상을 분석하여 영상 내 포함된 소방 교육용 마커들 각각을 인식하고, 각 소방 교육용 마커에 대응하는 마커 영상을 리드하여, 상기 마커 영상을 상기 표시 장치 상의 소방 교육용 마커의 위치에서 중첩시킨 상기 소방 교육 영상을 생성하며, 사용자의 조작에 따른 스마트 장치의 움직임에 대응하여 효과 영상을 생성하고, 상기 효과 영상을 상기 소방 교육 영상에 반영하는 로컬 서버와, 상기 로컬 서버의 제어 신호에 대응하는 동작을 수행하는 스마트 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing firefighting training program using sensor-based virtual firefighting equipment and realistic firefighting training system using the same
title_ko: 센서 기반 가상 소방 도구를 이용한 소방 훈련 프로그램 제공 장치 및 방법과 이를 이용한 실감형 소방 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a firefighting training program providing device using a sensor-based virtual firefighting instrument, a method thereof, and a realistic firefighting training system using the same. The firefighting training program providing device using a sensor-based virtual firefighting instrument according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a receiving part for receiving user manipulation information for a virtual firefighting instrument sensed from a virtual firefighting instrument comprising a user manipulation detection sensor; a calculating unit for generating change information on design elements associated with a virtual reality-based firefighting training program based on the manipulation information; and a reflecting unit for transmitting the firefighting training program in which the change information is reflected to a user terminal. According to the present invention, a training effect can be improved.
abstract_ko: 센서 기반 가상 소방 도구를 이용한 소방 훈련 프로그램 제공 장치 및 방법과 이를 이용한 실감형 소방 훈련 시스템이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 센서 기반 가상 소방 도구를 이용한 소방 훈련 프로그램 제공 장치는 사용자 조작 감지 센서를 포함하는 가상 소방 도구로부터 센싱된 상기 가상 소방 도구에 대한 사용자의 조작 정보를 수신하는 수신부, 상기 조작 정보에 기초하여 가상 현실 기반의 소방 훈련 프로그램과 연계된 설계 요소에 대한 변경 정보를 생성하는 연산부 및 상기 변경 정보가 반영된 상기 소방 훈련 프로그램을 사용자 단말로 전송하는 반영부를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV AJOU IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Digital simulation method and device for large-scale fine terrain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a large-scale fine terrain digital simulation method, which comprises the following steps: performing GIS gridding treatment on the DEM data to obtain DEM gridding data; acquiring the DEM grid corresponding to any typhoon influence area and calculating each site of the typhoon; determining at least one extension range in at least one incoming wind direction and/or vertical wind direction by taking the field point as a reference position; and fitting gradients according to the DEM meshing data included in at least one extension range, and taking the average gradient in the extension range as the gradient of the grid center point of the large-scale refined terrain. The achievement can be used in the fields of wind disaster, rainfall simulation, loss evaluation and the like caused by typhoons in a large-scale space range (such as China universe or global).

title_en: Underground space water marginal disaster early warning method based on nuclear magnetic resonance miniature sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent alarm method for water marginal disasters of an underground space based on a nuclear magnetic resonance miniature sensor, which is suitable for monitoring invisible water sources in the urban underground space. Detecting a main water source distribution area of the formed underground space by adopting a resistivity test method, and acquiring a potential water source position according to the low-resistance distribution characteristic; drilling different surrounding rock cores, and testing core nuclear magnetic signals in a completely dry state by using a low-field nuclear magnetic resonance method; monitoring drill holes with different depths and different angles are drilled in potential water source positions respectively, residual water slag in the drill holes is removed, the drill holes are dried, and low-field nuclear magnetic resonance miniature sensors are fed into the drill holes, so that the spatial distribution evolution of water in the surrounding rock is realized in real time; and constructing an early warning threshold value and a safety evaluation criterion for inducing water damage according to the obtained nuclear magnetic pore characteristics and the water signals, and providing a sufficient data basis for early warning and prevention of water inrush disasters. The method is simple to operate, and intelligent alarm of the potential water margin disasters of the rock stratum can be realized.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;SUZHOU NIUMAG ANALYTICAL INSTR CORPORATION;UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA

title_en: Miniature nuclear magnetic resonance device for measuring water content of geologic body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniature nuclear magnetic resonance device for measuring the water content of a geologic body, which comprises a lifting unit arranged at the inlet of a detection drilling hole, wherein a testing device which is connected with the lifting unit through a protective sleeve and is integrated by a radio frequency unit, a receiving unit, a control unit and a communication unit is arranged in the detection drilling hole; the control unit is in communication connection with the radio frequency unit, the receiving unit, the communication unit and the lifting unit, and the radio frequency unit generates a static magnetic field and a radio frequency magnetic field to polarize pore water; the receiving unit amplifies, filters and A/D converts the echo signals of the pore water; the lifting unit can lift the device to different depths of the drilled hole; the communication unit can download test instructions from the ground upper computer and transmit the test instructions to the control unit, and upload test data stored by the control unit to the upper computer. The device is arranged in a small-diameter geological detection drill hole, the change of the water content of different depths around the geological detection drill hole can be monitored in real time, and accurate information is provided for monitoring and early warning of water-edge disasters.

title_en: Perforation arrangement method for simultaneously pre-splitting lateral roof and trend roof of coal mine roadway
abstract_en: The invention relates to a perforation arrangement method for simultaneously pre-splitting a lateral roof and a trend roof of a coal mine roadway, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: 1) designing a series of drill holes on a top plate of the roadway along the direction of the roadway; 2) for any one of the drill holes, determining the number and the positions of target hard rock stratums according to the lithology and the thickness of the top plate in the drill hole, cutting a crack in each target rock stratum of the drill hole to form a prefabricated crack, and then carrying out directional expansion operation on the prefabricated crack; 3) and repeating the step 2) until the construction, the cutting and the directional expansion of all the drilled holes are completed, and realizing the simultaneous pre-splitting of the lateral roof and the heading roof of the coal mine roadway. The invention has the advantages of large roof cutting range, good effect, accuracy and controllability, can effectively reduce the trend of a coal mine stoping roadway and the overhang length of a lateral roof, reduces the disaster risks of roadway mine pressure, rock burst and the like, and has important popularization and application values.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Directional drilling hydraulic fracturing permeability-increasing device for soft coal seam roof and application method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic fracturing permeability-increasing device for directional drilling of a soft coal seam roof and an application method, and belongs to a coal mine disaster prevention and control method. The directional long drilling holes are constructed in the top plate rock stratum in the coal roadway of the soft coal seam, a fracture network is formed in the top plate rock stratum by utilizing a hydraulic sand adding fracturing technology, fluid pressure is continuously improved to enable fractures to extend into the soft coal seam, the fracture network in the coal seam can be kept not to be closed for a long time due to the influence of a non-homogeneous interface effect on the contact surface of the soft coal seam and the top plate rock stratum, meanwhile, the directional long drilling hole staged fracturing process can be realized through the mutual matching of a packer and a cut-off device, and the fracturing effect is improved. The method can achieve the purposes of releasing the ground stress, increasing the air permeability of the coal seam and strengthening the gas extraction of the soft low-permeability coal seam, has high working efficiency and saves the engineering cost.

title_en: Detection system for surface of marine equipment engineering material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a detection system on marine equipment engineering material surface, it can be applied to marine fishery and equip, marine oil and gas field development, offshore drilling platform, cross sea bridge, submarine tunnel, ship engineering and deep sea exploration, marine power generation equipment etc. and carry out the washing out test in the laboratory on the relevant engineering material surface that uses. The system is used for researching the influence of scouring on the microstructure and mechanical properties of the surface of a material. According to the measured experimental result, the surface can be modified to obtain excellent performance, the service life of the material is expected to be prolonged, and the possibility of serious disasters is reduced; the utility model discloses a sea water environment that the sea was equipped engineering material surface can simulate the different degree of depth completely erodees the experiment to engineering material surface and acquires the experimental result the same under with marine environment, and the experiment is washed away on marine equipment engineering material surface to colleges and universities, institute and the enterprise that research ocean was equipped in convenient the inland, saves its experimental cost greatly.

title_en: Landslide disaster runoff and motion process simulation test equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landslide calamity runoff and motion process simulation test equipment, including the test groove, rainfall simulation mechanism, groundwater water level simulation mechanism, slope runoff collection mechanism, landslide motion collection mechanism and adjustment mechanism, the test groove level sets up, be used for setting up landslide body model in the test groove, rainfall simulation mechanism is used for spraying water in order to simulate rainfall to the test groove, groundwater water level simulation mechanism is used for supplying water for landslide body model with the groundwater of simulating landslide body model, slope runoff collection mechanism is used for collecting the runoff on landslide body model surface, landslide motion collection device is used for collecting the soil body behind the landslide body model landslide, adjustment mechanism is used for driving the test groove and keeps away from its open one end tilting. The test equipment can reveal the rules between the internal and external environmental elements of the slope, rainfall intensity and rock-soil body property of the landslide body and the motion process of the rain water and the slope body.
assignees: WUHAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY ZHONGNAN GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOV

title_en: Multi-physical-field coupled landslide disaster simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landslide calamity analogue test device of many physics field couplings, including box, vibration simulation mechanism, rainfall simulation mechanism and illumination simulation mechanism, the box upper end is uncovered, and its inside is used for setting up landslide body model, vibration simulation mechanism installs the box lower extreme, it is used for the drive the box vibration, rainfall simulation mechanism be used for to the inside trickle of box is in order to simulate the rainfall, illumination simulation mechanism is used for shining the box is in order to simulate sunlight illumination, and can to add water or follow in the box the change of box outside drainage in order to simulate the reservoir water level. The test device can test the landslide after coupling the multi-physical-field influence factors of the landslide, can arrange single-factor and double-factor landslide simulation tests under the influence of multiple factors according to test requirements, simulates the coupling relation between physical fields in different environments, and is favorable for qualitative and quantitative research and analysis of landslide evolution mechanisms.
assignees: WUHAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY ZHONGNAN GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOV

title_en: Crushed material loading device
abstract_en: To provide a technique that enables recovery work, rescue activities, etc., in a place where it is difficult to perform the rescue activities and recovery work by manpower in a case of disaster such as a landslide, a building collapse, etc., caused by an earthquake or heavy rain.SOLUTION: A crushed material loading device has: a device body; three or more legs which are provided on the device body, and can change an attitude of the device body; a drilling device which drills a hole in a structure to be crushed; and a feed device which feeds crushed material as a non-explosive crushed composition into the hole formed in the structure by the drilling device. The at least three legs can be made extensible, and also changeable in angle to the device body so as to not only change the attitude of the device body, but also move the device body.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: UNIV AKITA;NIPPON KOKI KK;SANWA TEKKI CORP

title_en: Disaster level display system and disaster level display device
abstract_en: To improve disaster prevention consciousness of an inhabitant, etc., by having the inhabitant, etc., of a building be always used to an action to be taken in an occurrence of an earthquake by display means displaying the level of the disaster of the building when an earthquake occurs.SOLUTION: A disaster level display system 100 includes measuring means 11 for generating seismic wave data by measuring seismic waves propagated to a building site of a building B, storage means 123 for storing structure information IC regarding a structure of the building B, determination means 121 for determining a level of a disaster which is an extent of the disaster the building B is assumed to have received by the earthquake based on the earthquake data generated by the measuring means 11 and the structure information IC stored by the storage means 123, and display means 12, 3 for displaying the level of the disaster determined by the determination means 121. The storage means 123 further stores simulated seismic wave data D, and the determination means 121 determines a level of a disaster for demonstration based on the simulated seismic wave data D and the structure information IC stored by the storage means 123 when a prescribed instruction is given.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Mine water disaster emergency management method and system
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present specification provide a mine water disaster emergency management method and system, including: according to the mine water disaster accident inoculation, formation, evolution, full life cycle process of disaster and corresponding prevention and control strategies, the method is divided into four stages, including: the method comprises a simulation prediction and prevention countermeasure stage before water damage occurs, a hidden danger investigation monitoring and early warning control stage, a rescue and emergency disposal stage before flooding after water damage occurs and a virtual simulation and design stage of a compound mine drainage scheme after flooding. On the basis, a mine water disaster emergency management system framework is designed, and in an application support environment comprising software and hardware, data processing and decision generation are carried out at each stage in a resource fusion mode. The mine water disaster emergency management system can realize scientific management.

title_en: Simulation device and simulation method for collapse and landslide compound disaster evolution process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation device for a collapse and landslide compound disaster evolution process, which comprises a high-position collapse body tray, a full-angle rotary inclined plane combined structure, an accumulation groove, a manual rainfall simulation system and a camera observation system; the upper end face of the high-position collapse body tray is provided with a baffle plate, a plurality of collapse blocks are arranged on the outer side of the baffle plate, and the lower end face of the high-position collapse body tray is provided with a supporting device with adjustable height; the all-angle rotating inclined plane combined structure comprises a plurality of inclined plane blocks which are hinged with each other, geotechnical cloth used for simulating an actual slope is covered on the inclined plane blocks, a plurality of speed measuring sensors are arranged on the inclined plane blocks, a supporting device capable of adjusting the height is arranged on the lower end face of each inclined plane block, a soil-heap-shaped accumulation sliding slope body is arranged on the all-angle rotating inclined plane combined structure, and a supporting device is arranged on the outer side of the accumulation groove; the method can simulate the shoveling and scraping effect on the slope accumulation body after the high-position collapse body in the high mountain canyon region is started, and the whole process that the wrapped accumulation body slides down and finally enters the river to be accumulated.

title_en: Debris flow monitoring and early warning method based on self-coding single classification model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow monitoring and early warning method based on a self-coding single classification model, which comprises the steps of continuously acquiring a plurality of groups of characteristic data of a certain complex mountain area in a certain normal disaster-free time period through a sensor, and respectively forming a training set and a testing set; preprocessing a training set and a test set, inputting the processed training set to the constructed self-coding single classification model for training, inputting the test set to the trained self-coding single classification model, and further determining an abnormal judgment threshold; and finally, combining the abnormal judgment threshold value, and carrying out debris flow monitoring and early warning through a trained self-coding single classification model.

title_en: RBF neural network-based rural house typhoon disaster estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rural house typhoon disaster estimation method based on a RBF neural network, which comprises the following steps: screening typhoon information which influences the evaluation area; calibrating typhoon key parameters, and determining typhoon wind speed by using a wind field model; acquiring the corresponding premium loss rate of each rural housing of the villages and towns under the influence of each typhoon disaster according to the insurance underwriting and claim settlement data of the rural housing in the evaluation area; establishing a prediction model, substituting the obtained typhoon wind speed data and the obtained quota loss rate data into the prediction model for training to obtain an optimal RBF neural network structure; and predicting the loss rate of the reserves of each village and town under different typhoon wind speeds through a prediction model, and performing village-and-town-level resolution rural house typhoon disaster assessment on the assessment area according to the prediction result. The method can realize rural house typhoon disaster situation pre-evaluation with high resolution at a village-tranquility level by means of public disaster insurance data and the RBF neural network, has reliable evaluation results, and has important significance for preventing and reducing disasters.
assignees: NINGBO KAIHONG ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Rapid generation system and method for shortest escape route in public place
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for quickly generating the shortest escape route in public places, which comprises the following steps: an escape route planning module, an escape route library, an escape environment monitoring module, a lamp indication control module and an escape route generation module, the escape passage is divided and reconnected by the escape path planning module to obtain an escape route with a safety exit, the shortest escape route is generated by comparing the lengths of the escape routes and is sent to an escape route library, so that the escape time is saved, the workload of compiling evacuation plans is reduced, a fire scene is simulated, the shortest escape route is extracted, the smoke concentration detected by all smoke sensors on the route is obtained, the smoke diffusion direction is analyzed, whether the smoke diffusion direction is consistent with the indication direction of the lamp or not is judged through the lamp indication control module, the indication direction of the lamp is adjusted to change an escape route, people are prevented from being evacuated to a place with large smoke, and the probability that the people are damaged and even die due to the smoke is reduced.
assignees: NEAT XIPU FIRE FIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Children's educational toy simulating elevator operation and smoke alarm system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of toys, in particular to a children intelligence-developing toy simulating an elevator operation and smoke alarm system, which aims at the problem of poor teaching performance and provides the following scheme, wherein the toy comprises a toy body, the toy body comprises a master controller, a power supply unit, an elevator operation unit and a smoke alarm unit, and the power supply unit comprises a charging module, a power supply module and the like; the elevator operation unit comprises an elevator internal floor display module, an elevator internal floor input module, an illumination module, a ventilation module, an elevator external floor display module, an elevator external upstairs and downstairs input module and the like; the smoke alarm unit comprises a smoke induction module, an alarm module and the like. The invention enables the children to experience the actual operation through the educational toy, is easy to leave deep impression, and has better teaching significance than oral instruction; the children can learn the knowledge that the children can not smoke in the elevator and the knowledge that the fire disaster can escape and evacuate correctly.
assignees: HANGZHOU BOSHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Strong weather target identification method based on deep convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a strong weather target identification method based on a deep convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps of: collecting a data set; constructing a data set; constructing a model; training and verifying a model; and (5) testing the model. The strong weather target identification method based on the deep convolutional neural network is reasonable in design, can effectively detect individual targets (tornado, hail and thunder) of strong weather in images and videos, and selects the target position and confidence coefficient, has the detection accuracy rate of more than 96% for the strong weather phenomenon in the images, has the omission ratio of 0, can give timely and effective alarms for the strong weather phenomenon in live images, provides powerful live alarm information for first-time decision-making service, and reduces the loss of weather disasters.
assignees: HUBEI METEOROLOGICAL INFORMATION AND TECH SUPPORT CENTER

title_en: Disaster prevention equipment simulation system
abstract_en: To obtain a disaster prevention equipment simulation system capable of performing training of operating disaster prevention equipment without moving an actual machine for disaster prevention equipment.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention equipment simulation system includes a display part for displaying a video, a control part for generating the video to be displayed by the display part, and a first sensor for detecting movement of operation. The control part generates a simulation video obtained by simulating disaster prevention equipment, operation to the disaster prevention equipment, and action of the disaster prevention equipment corresponding to the operation on the basis of detection information of the first sensor.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Hyperspectral monitoring and GIS (geographic information System) coupled torrential flood disaster dynamic risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic risk assessment method for a hyperspectral monitoring and GIS (geographic information system) coupled mountain torrent disaster.
