The method comprises the following steps: constructing a hyperspectral remote sensing technology application system; step two: extracting mountain torrent disaster related information; step three: simulating the evolution and disaster formation process of single disaster species and composite disaster species; step four: constructing a stepwise regression equation; step five: determining an index system of mountain torrent disaster risk degree; step six: obtaining a mountain torrent disaster risk graph and a mountain torrent disaster vulnerability achievement graph; step seven: obtaining a multi-spatial scale mountain torrent disaster risk map after normalization; step eight: and (4) dividing mountain torrent disaster risk regions in specific areas. The method has the advantages of realizing the accuracy, reliability and timeliness of basic data information of the mountain torrent disaster easily-occurring area.

title_en: Airport emergency drilling method and system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of computers, and provides an airport emergency drilling method and system based on digital twins, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring airport operation data, wherein the operation data comprises positions, operation data, signals, coupling relations of all equipment and buildings and quality information reflecting the operation states of the equipment and the buildings; establishing an emergency drilling digital twin model according to airport operation data; the emergency drilling data are input into an emergency drilling digital twin model to obtain an emergency drilling result, the emergency drilling digital twin model is established according to airport operation data, the airport operation data contain a coupling relation and can represent the damaged propagation relation of equipment and a building in an emergency state, the finally obtained emergency drilling result can reflect the space and the time sequence of the propagation of accident disasters, and corresponding countermeasures can be formulated according to the damaged propagation relation.

title_en: Automatic upset sluice with open ice and block dirty function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic turnover sluice gate with ice breaking and trash holding functions, which comprises an ice breaking system and a trash holding system; the ice breaking system comprises a photoelectric sensor, a longitudinal guide rail, a transverse guide rail and an ice breaking drill bit device; the photoelectric sensor comprises a transmitting end and a receiving end, and the transmitting end and the receiving end are oppositely arranged on two sides of the channel; the longitudinal guide rails are arranged on two inner sides of the channel, the transverse guide rails are perpendicular to the longitudinal guide rails and arranged between the two longitudinal guide rails and can move along the longitudinal guide rails, and the ice breaking drill bit device is arranged on the transverse guide rails and can move along the transverse guide rails. The utility model discloses an automatic upset sluice with open ice and block dirty function through setting up the system of opening ice and blocking dirty system, can intercept mud, can open ice again, can overcome the defect that has had various methods of opening ice to solve because the inlet channel that the ice disaster leads to can not normal operating, the power station can not normally work performance benefit scheduling problem, be suitable for the power supply very much, supervise the big remote area of the degree of difficulty.

title_en: Test device for simulating stratum loosening to cause pavement collapse
abstract_en: A test device for simulating stratum loosening to cause pavement collapse. The device comprises a sensor support, a main test box, a bottom support, an edge migration channel, an edge movable plate, a jack, a middle migration channel, a middle movable plate, a laser displacement sensor and a loosening size control plate. The utility model discloses the effect: the movable plate moving up and down controls the stratum loosening under the pavement structure, quantitative research and repeatability tests can be carried out, the sizes of different loosening bodies can be freely controlled, the jack and the movable plate are flexibly disassembled and assembled and are easy to operate, the test device provides visual, controllable and convenient-to-operate test equipment for researching urban road collapse, the test research level of urban road collapse disasters can be improved, and theoretical basis is provided for early warning and prevention of road collapse accidents.

title_en: First strutting arrangement of video surveillance camera for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a screen monitoring camera supporting device for emergency rescue, which comprises a protective box, wherein three supporting rods are fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the protective box, a ground plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of each supporting rod, an inserting drill rod is movably inserted into each ground plate, a cylinder is fixedly arranged in the protective box, a top plate is fixedly arranged at the output end of the cylinder and is positioned above the protective box, a camera body is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the top plate and is positioned between the protective box and the top plate, the screen monitoring camera supporting device for emergency rescue drives the top plate to move downwards through the cylinder and then drives the camera to move downwards and be embedded into a containing groove, the anti-seismic effect of the camera is improved through a foam plate, and when the camera is contained in the containing box, the camera can be effectively protected through the protective box, the containing box and the foam plate, the damage to the camera caused by secondary disasters is avoided, and the protective performance of the camera is greatly improved.
assignees: XIAN TIAN MAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency set electronic indicating device for nuclear power station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergent set electronic indicator for nuclear power station, a serial communication port, including control center system and terminal device, the control center system includes the logic control module who is connected with wireless network connection module, display module, control module respectively, terminal device is including the UI module, the control server that connect gradually, and control server passes through emergent command center network and is connected with the ethernet card, and the ethernet card is through the emergent sign that a plurality of wireless AP hotspots connection corresponds. The utility model discloses use radio signal transmission, can be applied to nuclear power station emergency response or emergent exercise period information prompt, during emergency response, electronic indicating device provides the characters and the map instruction that have the illumination to there are sound and stereo set warning suggestion, provide information such as the rank of emergent set and nearest set point, for the nuclear power station during emergency response or exercise, provide clear information, reduce the time of set.

title_en: Geological disaster landslide and landslide surface drilling and sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disasters landslide drilling sampling device, it includes outer tube assembly and inner tube assembly, outer tube assembly cover is located outside the inner tube assembly, the both ends of outer tube assembly are equipped with bullet card fender head and drill bit respectively, the drill bit includes the body and is located the body and keeps away from the tool bit subassembly of bullet card fender head one end, the tool bit subassembly includes main tool bit and vice tool bit, main tool bit and body structure as an organic whole, and main tool bit is equipped with a plurality ofly along the circumference equidistant of body, the one end that the body was kept away from to main tool bit is equipped with the blade, the blade is the taper along the axle cross-section of body, vice tool bit and main tool bit one-to-one, the setting can be dismantled in main tool bit to the one end of vice tool bit, and the other end of vice tool bit is the blade looks parallel and level of main tool bit. The present application has the following effects: the auxiliary cutter head can be used for trimming the hole bottom drilled by the main cutter head, so that the hole bottom is smoother, the vibration generated by the drill bit in the drilling process is reduced, and the purpose of reducing the disturbance deformation of the rock core is achieved.

title_en: Critical trigger simulation method suitable for rock mass shear fracture in deep coupling state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a critical triggering simulation method suitable for rock mass shearing breakage in a deep coupling state, and relates to the field of deep rock mechanics and fracture mechanics. The method mainly solves the technical problem that the deep rock mass shear fracture calculation cannot be realized in the prior art. The simulation method mainly comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out an indoor water injection shearing test through the steps of sample preparation, test loading scheme determination and the like; secondly, calculating the shearing degradation amount of the rock by using the obtained test data, and determining the critical triggering condition of the rock for shearing fracture; then, introducing corresponding parameters, and correcting the critical strain energy release rate of II-type (shear) crack propagation; and finally, performing calculation verification through a simulation test, comparing the calculated simulation result with the direct shear test result, performing feedback analysis, and correcting the relevant parameters. The method has important scientific significance and application prospect for preventing and treating deep high-pressure water inrush disasters, and further promotes the application of coupled fracture mechanics in the field of coal mines.

title_en: Emergency simulation experience system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency simulation experience system, which comprises at least one hot air unit and a vibration unit, wherein the hot air unit and the vibration unit are respectively arranged at selected positions of an experience space; the hot air unit and the vibration unit are respectively and electrically connected with the control unit; the control unit is used for controlling the heating time, the heating temperature, the air outlet rate and/or the vibration frequency of the vibration unit of the hot air unit; the display unit is arranged in the experience space and worn by the experimenter. The emergency simulation experience system is simple and reasonable in structure, low in manufacturing cost, capable of being used for simulating fire disasters and earthquake disasters to enable users to experience, strong in experience reality sense, capable of not causing any damage to experience personnel, capable of achieving the purpose of real experience on the premise of guaranteeing the safety of the experience personnel, and worthy of being popularized and used in a large area.

title_en: Groundwater level monitoring devices based on geological survey abandonment drilling and sound wave range finding
abstract_en: The application discloses ground water level monitoring devices based on geological survey abandonment drilling and sound wave range finding belongs to geological environment monitoring field, provides a real-time dynamic monitoring devices of ground water level, mainly includes sealed cock board, siren, sound wave distancer and solar power source. This application carries out reuse to the abandonment drilling for geological survey, realizes not only simple and practical but also economic environmental protection to ground water level's dynamic monitoring based on sound wave range finding technique, has certain engineering guidance meaning to geological disasters disaster prevention and disaster reduction and agricultural irrigation.

title_en: Water and sand leakage test equipment and test method under internal erosion action of soil body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water leakage and sand leakage test device and a test method under the action of internal erosion of soil, wherein the test device comprises a water tank, an umbrella-shaped water lowering device, an erosion generation box, a support frame and a water sand collecting box, the water tank is connected with the umbrella-shaped water lowering device through a water inlet pipe, the erosion generation box is arranged right below the umbrella-shaped water lowering device, the erosion generation box is placed on the support frame, a circular leakage opening is formed in the center of the bottom of the erosion generation box, the water sand collecting box is placed in the support frame, and the placement position of the water sand collecting box is located right below the circular leakage opening. According to the invention, soluble particles are doped into the soil in advance, the leakage opening is opened after the particles are dissolved and sandy soil is saturated, the water and sand leakage amount and the soil settlement deformation condition are monitored and recorded, the soil water and sand leakage model test under different erosion conditions is simulated, the change mechanism and the change reason of each parameter in the leakage process are further deeply explored, the corresponding measures for preventing water and sand leakage disasters are provided, and the experimental basis is provided for preventing soil erosion disasters in urban construction.

title_en: Separated geological exploration drilling device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and prevention, in particular to a separated geological detection drilling device which comprises a rotary drum inner shell, a rotary drum outer shell, two locking mechanisms, a drill bit mechanism and a detector, wherein the two locking mechanisms are symmetrically distributed on two sides inside the rotary drum inner shell, the rotary drum inner shell is arranged inside the rotary drum outer shell, the outer side of the rotary drum inner shell is connected with the inner side of the rotary drum outer shell, the detector is arranged at the bottom end of the rotary drum inner shell, two sides of the upper end of the detector are correspondingly detachably connected with the rotary drum inner shell through the locking mechanisms, and the drill bit mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the rotary drum outer shell. The detector is detachably arranged in the drill bit by arranging the locking mechanism, the drill bit directly drives the detector to drill into the ground, and the detector is put down for detection after the drill bit reaches the designated position, so that the detector is prevented from drilling into the drill bit for the second time.
assignees: CHENGDU TIANMA XINGKONG ROBOT RES CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent mine scene oriented digital twin evolution mechanism and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machine vision, computer simulation and Internet of things, and discloses a digital twin evolution mechanism for an intelligent mine scene. The digital twin evolution mechanism and method for the intelligent mine scene are characterized in that a conventional mathematical simulation model is distinguished by a digital twin technology, the digital twin model emphasizes interaction between reality and can be updated and dynamically evolved in real time, so that dynamic real mapping of a physical world is realized, an immersive visualization technology can help a user to know mine disasters more clearly, more thoroughly and more abundantly, a three-dimensional virtual space can be simulated by applying a visual display component based on a 3R interaction technology, physical equipment in an intelligent energy system is displayed in front of the user in an almost real state, and the operation and control of a physical entity, an information network and a simulation model are indirectly realized through the operation and control of a virtual body.
assignees: SINOSTEEL MAANSHAN GENERAL INSTITUTE OF MINING RES CO LTD

title_en: Situation awareness method for transmission line hardware defects under extremely cold disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a situation awareness method for power transmission line hardware defects under extremely cold disasters, which comprises the steps of establishing a first-stage detection model and a second-stage classification model, acquiring a hardware target data set and a defect data set under extremely cold disasters, training the first-stage detection model and the second-stage classification model through the hardware target data set and the defect data set under extremely cold disasters, and cascading the first-stage detection model and the second-stage classification model; inputting the aerial image of the power transmission line to be detected into a trained first-stage detection model to obtain a hardware fitting image and a label, and simultaneously inputting the hardware fitting image and the label into a trained second-stage classification model to obtain the defect condition of the hardware fitting. The situation awareness method for the power transmission line hardware defects under the extremely cold disasters realizes sustainable learning of the model, saves the occupied space of the model, ensures that the model cannot forget old classification tasks while learning new classification tasks, and improves the recognition capability of the model on hardware with different defect degrees.

title_en: Test device and test method for simulating impact of building structure in fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a test method for simulating the impact of a building structure in a fire, wherein a release device is detachably connected with a hammer head and is positioned at the top of the hammer head, the hammer head is respectively connected with a corresponding third sliding rail in a sliding way through two sliding brackets and is positioned between the two sliding brackets, a test furnace is arranged under the hammer head, the fire is simulated by heating a test piece through the test furnace, and then the impact is caused on the test piece through the hammer head, so that the purpose of simulating the impact of the building structure in the fire is achieved. The two division boards are pushed into the frame body, so that the two division boards are closed, when the hammer head falls down, if the test piece is broken, the division boards are above the test furnace and can bear the impact of the test piece and the hammer head, the test furnace is protected, and the safe performance of the test is ensured.

title_en: Model display stand for BIM-based emergency evacuation simulation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a model show stand technical field specifically is a based on BIM is model show stand for emergency evacuation simulation, including the supporting baseplate, the supporting baseplate top is provided with places the platform, it is provided with locking mechanical system to place the platform below, locking mechanical system includes the dead lever, supporting baseplate top middle part fixedly connected with dead lever, and the inside upside of dead lever insert and be equipped with the movable rod, movable rod top fixed connection is on placing platform bottom middle part, and movable rod right side upper portion inserts and be equipped with the gag lever post, and the equal fixedly connected with second butt joint piece in one side that two sets of fixture blocks are close to each other, and second butt joint piece and fixed block mutually support, place the inside six deployment mechanisms that set up of platform. The utility model discloses brought people and when observing, can rotated the device for people observe more comprehensively, and rotate in a flexible way, make to observe very conveniently, increased the practicality of device.
assignees: ANHUI VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF GRAIN ENG

title_en: Water fire extinguisher for fire fighting training
title_ko: 소방훈련용 물 소화기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water fire extinguisher for fire fighting training, comprising a container (100), a head (200), a supply port (300), and a motion valve module (400). According to the water fire extinguisher for fire fighting training, a user can easily recognize the amount of water and air contained inside even if a separate checking means is not provided in the container, so that the water and air in the container can be charged at a proper ratio in a short time and therefore convenience is improved. In particular, the structure of the water fire extinguisher is improved to go through the process of holding and shaking the container in order to activate movement of water through an inlet. Accordingly, a preparation process (fire extinguisher shaking step) for actual use of the fire extinguisher is added as one element of fire fighting training and thus fire fighting training can be performed under the same conditions as the actual fire situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방훈련용 물 소화기에 관련되며, 이는 별도의 확인수단이 용기에 구비되지 않아도 내부에 수용된 물과 공기의 양을 손쉽게 파악할 수 있어 단시간 내에 용기 내의 물과 공기가 적정 비율을 이루면서 충전이 가능하여 편의성이 증대되고, 특히, 흡입구를 통한 물 이동을 활성화하기 위해서는 반드시 용기를 들고 흔드는 과정을 거치도록 구조 개선되어, 실제 소화기 사용에 따른 사전 준비 과정(소화기 흔드는 단계)을 소방훈련 요소로 추가하여 실제 화재상황과 동일한 조건에서 소방훈련을 수행할 수 있도록 용기(100), 헤드(200), 공급구(300), 모션밸브모듈(400)을 포함하여 주요구성으로 한다.

title_en: Family Type Earthquake Audio-Visual Education Kit
title_ko: 가정형 지진 시청각 교육 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a home earthquake audiovisual education kit capable of planning earthquake related education in various places by educating an actual earthquake disaster situation in a home in an audiovisual manner; efficiently recognizing an earthquake situation; and providing cultivation of an earthquake coping capability. The home earthquake audiovisual education kit comprises: a home model unit; an earthquake simulator; and a kit controlling unit. The home model unit includes: an outer model frame which includes a floor and a wall surface having a window to create an interior space in the home; and a miniature unit which forms a shape of furniture and home appliances and is movably connected on the outer model frame. The earthquake simulator supports and fixes the outer model frame in a lower part of the home model unit, and implements a substantial seismic waveform in the home model unit. The kit controlling unit applies a control signal for driving the earthquake simulator and controls the kit by operating and setting power and seismic intensity.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가정 내 실제 지진재난상황을 시청각 형태로 교육하게 재연하여 다양한 장소에서의 지진 관련 교육을 도모하면서 지진상황을 효율적으로 인지하고 지진대처능력을 배양함을 제공하도록, 가정 내 실내공간을 조성하게 마루 및 창을 구비한 벽면을 조성하는 외곽모형프레임과, 가구 및 가전 형상을 이루며 상기 외곽모형프레임 상에 유동 가능하게 연결 결합하는 미니어처유닛을 포함하여 구성하는 가정모형부와; 상기 가정모형부의 하부에서 상기 외곽모형프레임을 지지 고정하고, 상기 가정모형부에 실질적인 지진 파형을 구현할 수 있게 구동하는 지진시뮬레이터와; 상기 지진시뮬레이터의 구동을 위한 제어신호를 인가하되, 전원 및 지진의 세기를 조작 설정하여 제어하는 키트제어부;를 포함하는 가정형 지진 시청각 교육 키트를 제공한다.

title_en: Gas leakage evacuation control method and decision system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety engineering, and discloses a gas leakage evacuation control method and a system, which are applied to enterprises with toxic gas dangerous sources, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a vector map about geographical information of the enterprises; the method comprises the steps of determining real-time meteorological data, obtaining leakage accident source position information, dynamically simulating and displaying the leakage diffusion condition of toxic gas according to enterprise geographic information, the real-time meteorological data and the leakage accident source position information, determining the real-time influence degree of toxic gas on each production device area of an enterprise, and determining personnel evacuation paths corresponding to each production device area in real time according to the parameters. According to the invention, the real-time influence degree of toxic gas leakage on each production device area of an enterprise is determined by combining with real-time meteorological data, and the personnel evacuation path is determined for each production device area by combining with the vector map of the enterprise, so that the personnel evacuation path can be dynamically adjusted in real time, and the on-site personnel can be evacuated through the shortest path more conveniently.

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for rapidly predicting post-earthquake road disaster area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a system and a storage medium for quickly predicting a post-earthquake road disaster area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing a region of interest into a plurality of ramp units; obtaining a training set consisting of landslide units and non-landslide units based on historical seismic landslide distribution data; training based on a training set to obtain a landslide probability evaluation model; using a landslide probability evaluation model to carry out landslide probability evaluation to obtain a dangerous unit; and determining the landslide range of each dangerous unit by using a physical mechanical model to obtain the disaster area prediction result of the post-earthquake road. Compared with the prior art, the landslide probability evaluation model is trained by using a machine learning method to obtain the dangerous unit with higher landslide probability, and then the dangerous unit is researched by using a mechanical model, so that the rapid evaluation of the influence of landslide on the road in the post-earthquake research area and the accurate space positioning of the road disaster situation are realized, the rapid evaluation of a wide area space can be carried out, and a reference is provided for the formulation of earthquake emergency rescue measures.

title_en: Geological disaster risk evaluation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating the risk of a geological disaster, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring road vector data; processing according to the road vector data to obtain DEM data and slope unit vector data of an area where a road vector surface is located; extracting road grade, road distance, road slope cutting strength, road density, spatial relationship between the road and the slope unit and road support state according to the road vector data, the DEM data and the slope unit vector data to obtain road characteristics; integrating the road characteristics, and performing model training to obtain a geological disaster risk evaluation model; and performing geological disaster risk evaluation by using the geological disaster risk evaluation model to obtain an evaluation result. By implementing the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the road characteristics can be more comprehensively and reasonably utilized, so that the precision and accuracy of the geological disaster risk evaluation are improved.

title_en: Dynamic monitoring method for absolute deformation of roadway surrounding rock
abstract_en: A dynamic monitoring method for absolute deformation of roadway surrounding rock comprises the following specific steps: 1) simulating deformation damage values of surrounding rocks of the roadway by using FLAC3D software; 2) making a roadway surrounding rock deformation monitoring scheme; 3) installing a measuring sensor and a positioning sensor inside the surrounding rock of the roadway; 4) and connecting the measuring sensor and the positioning sensor with a top plate online monitoring system, and monitoring and analyzing the deformation of the surrounding rock of the roadway by using the top plate online monitoring system. The method realizes the measurement of the respective absolute deformation of the top plate, the bottom plate and the surrounding rocks of the two sides of the roadway, and the non-contact measurement avoids errors caused by manual measurement; the method is favorable for obtaining more monitoring information of the easily-deformed part of the surrounding rock of the roadway, has good applicability to the roadway with different shapes, lithology, structure and supporting conditions, is favorable for technicians to timely master the deformation dynamic change of the surrounding rock of the underground roadway on the ground, and prevents dynamic disaster accidents such as roof collapse, rock burst and the like in advance.

title_en: Test system for simulating influence of rainfall and underground water level change on filling body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test system for simulating the influence of rainfall and underground water level change on a filling body, this analog system includes earth pillar test device, rainfall controlling means and groundwater level controlling means, wherein: the soil column test device is detachable and comprises a vertical cylindrical soil sample cylinder and a horizontal cuboid soil sample cylinder; the rainfall and underground water control device comprises a peristaltic pump, a rain spray nozzle, a cylindrical barrel for regulating water level and a cylindrical water storage tank; the simulation system can simulate the influence of rainfall and underground water level on the filling soil body by controlling the rainfall and underground water device. The method overcomes the defects of high cost, long period and the like of a field water immersion test, has stable and reliable test results, fills the technical blank that rainfall and underground water level change influence the simulation experiment in a research room on the influence of the fill, and has important significance for researching the occurrence mechanism of the water damage disaster of the fill.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation and intelligent operation and maintenance method for deep underground subway station
abstract_en: A comprehensive evaluation and intelligent operation and maintenance method for deep underground subway stations is characterized by comprising the following steps: step one, establishing a comprehensive evaluation index system of the operation and maintenance state of a deep underground subway station; collecting and constructing a monitoring data sample base and building a neural network based on the index system set in the step one, and adjusting parameters through training to optimize the network; and thirdly, evaluating the current state of the operation and maintenance state of the deep underground subway station and predicting the operation and maintenance state of the deep underground subway station by utilizing a neural network, so that the prediction of the future development situation of the operation and maintenance state of the deep underground subway station can be realized, the time for adjusting and maintaining the deep underground subway station is guided, and the intelligent operation and maintenance and proactive disaster prevention and reduction of the deep underground subway station are realized.

title_en: Comprehensive safety risk evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety risk comprehensive evaluation system and a method, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises a personnel safety risk coefficient module, an environment risk coefficient module, an equipment safety risk coefficient module and a management risk coefficient module, wherein the personnel safety risk coefficient module carries out early warning on operation safety and voice safety; the environmental risk coefficient module carries out the early warning to geological disasters and weather, equipment safety risk coefficient module carries out the early warning to emergency fault and key equipment supercycle, management risk coefficient module carries out the early warning to on-the-spot protection problem, construction protection problem, safety training problem and nonstandard personnel's operation problem. The invention solves the problems that the existing work safety risk management and control capability is poor and early warning is difficult to form in time.
assignees: CHAMPION CHOICE BEIJING ECOMMERCE PTY LTD

title_en: Mountain disaster overall process numerical simulation and dangerous case forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain disaster overall process numerical simulation and dangerous case forecasting method, which comprises the following steps: s1: forecasting high-time and space rainfall in mountainous areas; s2: hydrodynamic process and numerical simulation: establishing a hydrodynamic process model, and solving the hydrodynamic process model; s3: simulating a mountain torrent debris flow disaster movement model and a numerical value; s4: and (4) carrying out disaster risk analysis and dangerous case prediction in the small watershed. According to the method, disaster overall process scene simulation driven by climate forecast results is realized, disaster hazard prediction and risk loss dynamic quantitative evaluation are realized, the current disaster grade forecast is promoted to dangerous case forecast, and accurate disaster prevention and accurate rescue are served.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Hull stress monitoring system using digital twin and prediction method for fatigue fracture of ship
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 선체응력 모니터링 시스템 및 이를 이용한 선박의 피로 파괴 예측 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hull stress monitoring system using a digital twin and a prediction method for fatigue fracture of a ship using the same, which are able to measure the stress of a hull by using one or more stress sensors placed on the hull, measure the corrosion degree of an outer plate of the hull by using an electric conductivity, add an environmental outer force information based on the measured stress and corrosion degree of the hull, and predict the fatigue fracture possibility of the ship after a simulation. Accordingly, the present invention is able to monitor the status of the ship in real time, collect various data in real time, constantly and simultaneously measure the data, make a database with the collected data, make it possible to perform the integrated management in accordance with the measuring point, perform a simulation of the collected data, and notify a user to perform the prevention and repair for a stress on the hull greater than a limit value or a measured region where corrosion occurs so that the user can take an immediate action. In addition, the present invention is able to predict the stress and the corrosion degree on the hull for a planned path for navigation through a simulation, prevent the fatigue fracture such as a crack or a cut which could occur on the hull, prevent a disaster on the sea, and extend the life of the ship.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 트윈을 이용한 선체응력 모니터링 시스템 및 이를 이용한 피로 파괴 예측 방법에 관한 것으로, 선체에 구비된 적어도 하나 이상의 응력 센서를 이용하여 선체의 응력을 측정하고, 전기 전도도를 이용하여 상기 선체의 외판의 부식 정도를 측정하며, 측정된 선체의 응력 및 부식 정도를 기초로 환경외력 정보를 추가하여 시뮬레이션 후 선박의 피로 과괴 가능성을 예측하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이것에 의해, 선박의 상태를 실시간으로 감시하고 각종 데이터를 실시간으로 수집함으로써, 데이터의 연속적이고 동시적인 측정을 할 수 있고, 수집된 데이터를 데이터베이스화하여 측정지점에 따른 통합관리가 가능해지며, 수집된 데이터를 시뮬레이션 함으로써 선체에 가해지는 응력이 한계값 보다 큰 경우나 부식이 일어나고 있는 측정 지역에 대해서 예방 및 수리를 진행할 수 있도록 사용자에게 알림으로 즉각적인 조치가 가능하다. 
또한, 운항 예정 경로에 대하여 선체에 가해질 응력과 부식 정도를 시뮬레이션을 통해 예측하여 선체에 발생할 균열 또는 절단과 같은 피로 파괴를 방지하여, 해난을 방지할 수 있으며 선박의 수명을 연장할 수 있는 효과를 가진다.

title_en: Large-scale cavern water inrush simulation test device and method suitable for high-pressure water-rich karst area
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation test device and a test method suitable for water inrush of a large-scale cavern in a high-pressure water-rich karst area, wherein the test device comprises a lateral restraint system, a ground stress loading system, a water pressure loading system and a data acquisition system; a model is poured in a space surrounded by the lateral restraint system, the ground stress loading system and the ground, and a high-pressure water-rich karst cavity and a cavern are arranged in the model; the ground stress loading system comprises a vertical stress loading system and a horizontal stress loading system which are used for applying vertical stress and horizontal stress to the model respectively, and the hydraulic pressure loading system is used for providing constant pressure water pressure to the high-pressure water-rich karst cavity in the model. The test device provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in operation and better economy, can realize the research on the real evolution law and the water inrush mechanism of the rock mass seepage field under different stress states and different water pressures, and provides a basis for preventing and treating the water inrush disaster of the large underground cavern in the high-pressure water-rich karst area.

title_en: Natural disaster monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster monitoring and early warning method and a system, which receive regional geographical position information, regional environment state information and video monitoring content information; calling regional mountain state information according to the regional geographical position information; detecting the frequency of image quality jitter of the video monitoring content information, if the frequency is greater than a preset threshold value, sending an alarm signal, otherwise, scanning the video monitoring content information and analyzing the weather state of the area; performing disaster simulation analysis on the area according to the mountain state information and the weather state of the area and by combining the environmental state information of the area; whether a disaster occurs or not is judged according to the simulation analysis result, and when the disaster occurs, an early warning signal is sent out, so that whether the natural disaster occurs or not is judged according to the jumping frequency of the information of the video monitoring content, and the situation where the mountain is located can be simulated and analyzed without the natural disaster, so that the natural disaster monitoring result is more accurate.

title_en: Urban traffic operation simulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban traffic operation simulation systems, and provides an urban traffic operation simulation system, which comprises: the traffic facility equipment simulation unit is used for carrying out simulation modeling on the urban traffic facility equipment; the traffic state simulation unit simulates traffic passing conditions and changes of traffic situations; the bus operation simulation unit is used for inputting a bus network planning scheme, a bus operation scheduling scheme, a rescue, emergency evacuation plan and a command scheduling scheme, and simulating, generating and outputting bus operation track data and traffic operation state changes; and the simulation evaluation unit analyzes, calculates and outputs evaluation indexes and evaluation results of the traffic operation condition and the bus operation condition. The invention can simulate the real road network, provide the traffic and public transport operation conditions and provide the traffic planning decision for the manager.

title_en: GIS earthquake simulation shaking table test method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a GIS earthquake simulation shaking table test method, which comprises the following steps: step one, fixing the GIS equipment on an earthquake simulation shaking table, wherein the earthquake simulation shaking table test refers to GB 50260 plus 2013 'earthquake resistance design specification of electric power facilities'; and secondly, acquiring the natural vibration frequency of the GIS equipment by three-way excitation of white noise waves and processing the acceleration response of key parts, respectively inserting a white noise wave unidirectional input before and after each anti-vibration test, and comparing the change of the natural vibration frequency of the GIS equipment after each test to know whether the equipment has structural damage invisible to naked eyes. By the aid of the test method, the dynamic characteristics and the seismic response of the GIS equipment casing can be measured through the earthquake dynamic simulation shaking table test according to given test requirements, and the seismic capacity of the GIS equipment is judged.
assignees: TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER ENG SUPERVISION CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Collapse landslide, surge and river blockage disaster chain generation overall process test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide, surge and river blockage disaster chain generation overall process test device which comprises a landslide test slope panel, a valley test groove with rollers at the bottom, an opposite bank test slope panel, a water storage device and an observation device, wherein geotechnical cloth is laid on the upper surface of the landslide test slope panel, a velocimeter is arranged, and the other end of the valley test groove is hinged with the opposite bank test slope panel; the bottoms of the landslide test slope panel and the opposite bank test slope panel are respectively provided with a telescopic supporting device; the upper end surface of the opposite-bank test slope panel is provided with an opposite-bank sliding body; the water outlet of the water storage device is communicated with the water inlet of the valley test groove, the upper part of the landslide test slope panel is also provided with a landslide body placing and releasing device, and a landslide simulation block assembly is arranged on the landslide body placing and releasing device, so that the process of spreading water surge along a river bank or blocking a river into a dam can be visually observed, and meanwhile, information such as landslide water inlet speed, water surge height, water surge spreading speed and the like can be efficiently obtained.

title_en: Urban flood model construction method based on multi-source rainfall fusion and real-time correction
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for constructing an urban flood model based on multi-source rainfall fusion and real-time correction, which comprises the following steps: establishing a rainfall data set, carrying out downscaling processing by using a downscaling method, and fusing the downscaled rainfall data set based on a Bayesian average method to obtain a rainfall database; constructing a one-dimensional pipe network module, a one-dimensional river network module and a two-dimensional earth surface cross flow model; constructing a one-dimensional-two-dimensional urban rainfall flood coupling model; and inputting the fusion rainfall database into a one-dimensional-two-dimensional urban rainfall flood coupling model to obtain a rainfall simulation value, and correcting the simulation value by using a measured value and a real-time correction technology to generate a correction data sequence. The invention combines the multi-source rainfall input and real-time correction technology on the basis of the traditional urban flood simulation model, expands the theoretical basis of urban hydrology, develops the research approach of the urban hydrology, and can provide theoretical and technical support for urban flood disaster prevention and control decisions.

title_en: Method for evaluating and pre-controlling safety margin of emptying road under urban underground construction scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating and pre-controlling the safety margin of a void road under urban underground construction scene, which comprises the steps of obtaining the detection result of a target underground engineering area and determining the occurrence form of a void in a road subgrade at a construction section; simulating the development process of the cavity under underground construction vibration by using a simulation method, and determining a critical safety distance considering the construction vibration based on the simulated cavity scale and the simulated position; based on the simulated cavity expansion form, the least adverse load working condition of the driving is determined, a road damage criterion is established, the actual bearing capacity of the road in the disaster-critical state is determined, the safety margin of the emptying road is calculated, and then the ground and underground combined pre-control is carried out according to the result. The invention ensures the traffic safety of the upper road network in the tunneling process of the underground engineering.

title_en: Evaluation standard for type of overlying strata in deep-buried stope and thickening and modifying design method for thin bedrock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep-buried stope overlying rock type evaluation standard and a thin bedrock thickening and reforming design method. Then, based on the standard, aiming at the stratum conditions of the ultrathin bedrock and the thin bedrock, a bedrock thickening and modifying design scheme is provided, wherein the design scheme comprises the length, the thickness and the like of a thickening and modifying design area; finally, a design method for thickening and reforming the thin bedrock is provided, a scheme and a construction method for cis-grouting of the multi-horizontal inclined top are provided, parameters such as drilling hole arrangement, grouting materials and the like are designed, active control over stope disaster accidents can be achieved, and disaster accidents caused by control measures in the past passive stope are avoided.

title_en: Strip mine knowledge graph construction method based on genetic algorithm optimization neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses a strip mine knowledge graph construction method based on a genetic algorithm optimized neural network, and belongs to the technical field of strip mine stability assessment. Comprising the following steps: acquiring and processing related data of the strip mine disaster to construct a named entity identification data set; optimizing the existing BERT-BILSTM-CRF model by utilizing a genetic algorithm, and training the optimized BERT-BILSTM-CRF model by utilizing data in a named entity identification data set to obtain a named entity identification model; constructing a relation extraction annotation data set; optimizing the existing BILSTM model by utilizing a genetic algorithm, and training the optimized BILSTM model by utilizing data in a relation extraction labeling data set to obtain a relation extraction model; and sequentially inputting the related data of the strip mine disasters to be extracted into a named entity recognition model and a relation extraction model to extract entity relations to obtain triples, storing the triples into a Neo4j graph database, and constructing a strip mine knowledge graph. The method can give consideration to the context information and can build a high-quality knowledge graph in the field of strip mine stability.

title_en: Mountain fire disaster investigation and identification method based on AI algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain fire disaster investigation and identification method based on AI algorithm, relating to the technical field of fire identification, and comprising the steps of constructing a fire data set, preprocessing data in the fire data set to obtain a training fire data set, a verification fire data set and a test fire data set; constructing a YOLOv5 network model, training the YOLOv5 network model by adopting the training fire data set, and then training through the verification fire data set; identifying the test fire data set through a trained YOLOv5 network model, and identifying that a fire target exists in a test picture; and segmenting the picture of the fire target, and identifying the outline area of the fire in the image in detail by a network so as to obtain a specific fire occurrence area. The fire situation contour is identified more accurately through two times of identification, and powerful data support is provided for rescue and relief workers.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid operation risk situation sensing method for disaster weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid operation risk situation perception method facing to disaster weather. The method is based on a Bayesian network with time-varying wind speed, and a power grid time-varying risk propagation model considering the trend transfer caused by wind speed and disconnection faults is established; solving the running state parameters of the power grid by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method of Latin hypercube sampling and combining an optimal direct current flow model; and constructing a power grid operation risk situation perception index system, and realizing presentation and prediction of line risk situation, load level situation and power grid toughness situation. An effective real-time perception method is provided for the power grid operation risk situation facing to the disaster weather.

title_en: Dangerous rock mass identification method and device based on time-frequency domain kinetic parameters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous rock mass identification method and a device based on time-frequency domain kinetic parameters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring the vibration characteristic parameters of the rock mass to obtain a rock mass vibration curve; calculating the absolute mean value and mean square frequency of vibration based on the vibration curve; training a preset classification recognition model by taking the absolute mean value and the mean square frequency as classification features; classifying the stable rock mass and the dangerous rock mass based on the trained classification recognition model, and acquiring a boundary; and identifying dangerous rock masses based on the boundary according to the corresponding absolute mean value and mean square frequency of the rock masses to be identified. The dangerous rock mass identification technical scheme provided by the invention is suitable for rapid identification of side slope dangerous rock masses, and provides new technical support for better coping with collapse disasters in high-risk areas.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring method, system, terminal and medium based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring method, a system, a terminal and a medium based on the Internet of things, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and have the technical scheme that: generating a geological disaster monitoring signal when the effective accumulated rainfall exceeds a preset accumulated rainfall; collecting remote sensing image information of a target area and calling shallow surface layer type information; identifying and extracting vegetation type and vegetation coverage rate of the target area from the remote sensing image information, and obtaining basic drainage, porosity and scouring coefficient of a shallow surface layer of the target area through simulation analysis; measuring the water seepage depth information of the shallow surface layer in real time, calculating to obtain the total seepage rainfall, and calculating to obtain the total drainage rainfall; and outputting a monitoring and early warning signal when the damage accumulation factor is larger than a preset factor threshold. According to the invention, various factors such as rainfall information, vegetation coverage, topography and topography information, geological information and the like are comprehensively considered, and the effective accumulated rainfall in unit time is calculated, so that the accuracy of geological disaster monitoring can be effectively improved.

title_en: Water disaster micro-seismic early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine water damage, in particular to a water damage micro-seismic early warning method, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring environmental data and vibration data of the mine floor in real time; s2, obtaining a first probability of the potential water inrush danger zone according to the environmental data, obtaining a second probability of the potential water inrush danger zone according to the vibration data, and judging whether the first probability and the second probability are both greater than a probability threshold value: if yes, go to S3; if not, returning to the step S1; s3, collecting the drilling water level value of each drilling hole of the mine and the drainage quantity of the mine; s4, predicting whether the water hazard hidden danger exists in the mine according to the drilling water level value and the water displacement of each drilling hole: if yes, go to S5; if not, returning to the step S3; and S5, generating and sending water damage early warning information. According to the method, when the possibility of water damage of the mine bottom plate is high, whether the water damage hidden danger exists in the mine is predicted according to the drilling water level value and the water discharge of each drilling hole, and the technical problem that a potential water inrush dangerous area is difficult to identify is solved.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Mountain torrent calamity remote monitoring early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a remote monitoring and early warning device for mountain torrent disasters, which comprises a main body component, a monitoring and early warning component and a control component, wherein the monitoring and early warning component is arranged on the inner bottom wall of the main body component, and the control component is arranged on the inner side wall of the main body component; the utility model discloses a water level and rivers that rivers tachymeter and ultrasonic water level appearance can be to the early warning place are monitored, simultaneously the rain gauge can monitor the rainfall, can monitor the concrete conditions of the mud-rock flow in early warning place and torrential flood through vibration sensor and camera cooperation, the rivers tachymeter, the ultrasonic water level appearance, the rain gauge, vibration sensor and camera give the server with the signal transmission who monitors, simulate through the server and calculate, give the external equipment end with early warning information transmission and supply the staff to look over, when the data of server simulation surpassed the numerical value of setting for simultaneously, the short message warning is sent to the control short message alarm, monitoring data is more, the accuracy of this device early warning information has been improved.

title_en: Drilling machine for ground disaster investigation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a ground disaster investigation is with rig, this ground disaster investigation is with rig includes: a drilling machine device body and a temperature adjusting device; the drilling machine device body comprises a base, a vertical plate fixedly connected with the base, a rotating motor in sliding connection with the vertical plate, and a drill rod fixedly connected with the rotating motor; the temperature adjusting device comprises a first box body and a second box body which are fixedly connected with the vertical plate, a heating wire which is fixedly connected with the first box body, a refrigerating piece which is fixedly connected with the second box body, and an air outlet head which is fixedly connected with the first box body and the second box body. The utility model has the advantages that: the purpose of ground disaster investigation can be achieved through the arranged drilling machine device body; through the temperature regulation apparatus who sets up, can build suitable operational environment when this application of outdoor use, provide work efficiency.
assignees: SHENYANG BUILDING MAT GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING SURVEY INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Emergency exit rescue escape device for bridge-connected tunnel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bridge tunnel emergency exit rescue escape device relates to escape device technical field, a bridge tunnel emergency exit rescue escape device, including setting up the guardrail on the bridge in tunnel exit, still be provided with the storage tank on the bridge, there is the sack of fleing in the storage tank, the sack of fleing includes sack ring and sack body, and the port of sack body is fixed the sack ring, the guardrail is provided with the sack ring mounting of fixed sack ring. When a fire disaster happens, the storage box is opened, the escape cloth bag in the storage box is taken out, then the bag mouth ring on the escape cloth bag is fixed on the bag mouth ring fixing piece on the guardrail, the escape cloth bag is fixed, the cloth bag body is thrown under a bridge, escape personnel can drill into the escape cloth bag, then the escape cloth bag descends to the ground and can evacuate to a far place, escape is carried out, and therefore the life safety of the escape personnel is protected.

title_en: Visual device for simulating shield excavation and monitoring tunnel and soil deformation and shield simulation test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual device for simulating shield excavation and monitoring tunnel and soil deformation and a shield simulation test method implemented by adopting the visual device, wherein the visual device comprises: the tunnel excavation device adopts a 3D printing technology to reduce in equal proportion, print and assemble duct pieces, the supporting and adjusting system adopts a supporting platform and a jack to simulate shield excavation, and the hole digging device and the duct piece lining are assembled to simulate shield excavation. The monitoring system in the device adopts an optical fiber strain sensing technology, realizes wireless transmission, automatic processing and visualization of monitoring data, also realizes simulation of a shield crossing process and a tunnel operation process under the action of various working conditions such as different natural environments, geological conditions, construction conditions and the like by adopting a regulating plate and different functional modules, and provides reference for shield crossing optimization construction and tunnel operation safety and emergency response measures.

title_en: Physical test system and method for simulating disaster caused by underground space development
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster causing mechanism and prevention and control of geological disasters, in particular to a physical test system for simulating development and disaster causing of underground space. The device comprises a mounting frame, an upper test box arranged above the mounting frame, a water supply and drainage circulating system arranged at the lower part of the mounting frame, a detection control unit arranged in the upper test box and a climate simulation unit for simulating natural climate change; the upper test box comprises an outer test box for containing water and an inner test box for containing soil, the top of the outer test box is open, a first through hole is formed in the middle of the bottom surface, the upper end of the inner test box is open, and a second through hole is formed in the bottom of the inner test box; the technical scheme can simulate and research the evoked factors, the soil hole evolution and the collapse process of the karst soil hole collective collapse caused by the cluster effect.

title_en: Two-station one-interval fire simulation system for subway
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of public traffic safety, and particularly relates to a fire simulation system for two stations and one interval of a subway. The two subway stations are connected through an interval tunnel, and the ventilating ducts are laid on two sides of the top of the interval tunnel and the like; the temperature sensor is used for acquiring the temperature of each measuring point in the subway station and the regional tunnel in the scene of fire test; the gas component analyzer is used for acquiring the gas concentration of each measuring point in the subway station and the regional tunnel in the scene of fire; the flow velocity sensor is arranged at a stair opening and a communication channel between the station hall layer and the station platform layer, and the data acquisition instrument is used for acquiring the temperature, the flow velocity, the gas composition and the concentration in the fire simulation system and quantitatively analyzing the environmental parameters under various disaster accident scenes. The method can be used for simulation test research under subway fire accidents, can also be used for scene construction, accident recurrence, consequence prediction and study and judgment and the like of subway operation fire accidents, and provides physical entity support for subway fire accident hidden danger investigation and accident investigation.

title_en: Object-oriented land utilization information interpretation method based on dynamic self-attention transducer
abstract_en: The invention provides an object-oriented land utilization information interpretation method based on a dynamic self-attention transducer, which comprises the following steps: obtaining data; preprocessing data; establishing a classification system; making an object mask; manually marking; sample preparation; cutting the data set; constructing a network model; setting super parameters; enhancing data; training a model; and (5) verifying and analyzing. The invention aims to provide an object-oriented method for interpreting land utilization information after earthquake disaster, which designs a visual transducer based on a dynamic self-attention mechanism, can fully utilize excellent global perception capability of the transducer while reducing computation complexity of the transducer, and is responsible for expanding receptive fields, establishing context dependence and global modeling so as to interpret land utilization information of high-resolution remote sensing images.

title_en: Surrounding rock stability test fixture and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surrounding rock stability test fixture and a test method, relates to the technical field of rock mechanics, and mainly aims to simulate the circumferential and radial stress states of surrounding rocks of a roadway under a uniaxial compression condition and provide an important basis for researches such as stability analysis of the surrounding rocks of an underground roadway, rock burst disasters and the like. The surrounding rock stability test clamp comprises a cushion block; the pressing block is arranged opposite to the cushion block; the supporting part is connected between the cushion block and the pressing block, a clamping space is defined by the supporting part, the cushion block and the pressing block, and the clamping space is used for clamping a rock sample; the adjusting block is arranged on the pressing block and opposite to the clamping space, and the thicknesses of the adjusting block at all positions are different.

title_en: Flood detection method based on satellite remote sensing image
abstract_en: A flood detection method based on satellite remote sensing images comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring SAR image data of an area to be detected; step 2, extracting contour features and color features of the flooding SAR image of the area to be detected; step 3, creating a flooding SAR image data set; step 4, training a flood disaster dictionary set and a sparse matrix; and 5, realizing the flood disaster detection based on the SAR image. The method integrates the contour characteristics and the color characteristics of the SAR image, and adds the linear discriminant to the dictionary model, so that the classification of the dictionary model on the flood disaster grade is realized, the early warning on the flood disaster is facilitated, and the regional loss is reduced.

title_en: Meteorological disaster early warning method based on agricultural Internet of things
abstract_en: A meteorological disaster early warning method based on an agricultural Internet of things comprises the following steps: step 1, building an agricultural meteorological disaster sensing layer based on STM32F 407; step 2, setting a network layer communication protocol; step 3, simulating the environmental noise of the data; step 4, extracting crop image features; step 5, training an agricultural meteorological disaster classifier; and 6, embedding the agricultural meteorological disaster classifier based on the BP neural network into a platform layer of the Internet of things, and connecting the agricultural meteorological disaster classifier with a sensing layer through a network layer to obtain the meteorological disaster early warning system of the agricultural Internet of things. The agricultural internet of things-based meteorological disaster early warning method is set up, various agricultural meteorological related data are collected through the sensing layer, the data are transmitted to the platform layer through the network layer, and meanwhile, the BP network agricultural meteorological disaster classification model is embedded into the platform, so that real-time monitoring and early warning are carried out on agricultural meteorological disasters, the crop disaster damage is reduced, and the crop yield is improved.

title_en: Satellite data inversion precipitation method and system based on Huber norm constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite data inversion precipitation method and a system based on Huber norm constraint, the method comprises the steps of collecting satellite infrared bright temperature data and precipitation product data, and identifying whether a field point satellite infrared channel bright temperature has a precipitation signal or not through a K-nearest neighbor algorithm, if not, carrying out field point inversion precipitation assignment to be 0, otherwise, obtaining a field point precipitation signal sample; constructing a precipitation inversion method based on Huber norm constraint, and inverting precipitation for a video field point precipitation signal sample; the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data selection processing module, a precipitation inversion module and a verification and correction module; according to the invention, under the condition of a small sample historical training sample, precipitation is inverted in near real time so as to monitor typhoon or strong convection weather, and the characteristic of fast change of the strong convection weather is met; the invention has certain precision and quality, and has important significance for atmospheric science, hydrological weather, climatology, agriculture, ecological environment, natural disaster prevention and control and the like.

title_en: Urban flood disaster simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an urban flood disaster simulation experiment device, including laboratory bench and experimental model, experimental model is located the top of laboratory bench. The utility model discloses a set up the laboratory bench, the experiment model, the standing groove, fastening device, the cylinder, the fastening block, the control post, canceling release mechanical system, the circular slab, torque spring, the arc piece, square cardboard, the open slot, the round hole, the circular slot, square fixture block and square draw-in groove's cooperation is used, current flood disaster simulation experiment device has been solved, inconvenient user carries on spacingly to the experiment model, easily because the touching striking of external force leads to the experiment model displacement by a wide margin, thereby influence the problem of experimental data accuracy, this city flood disaster simulation experiment device, it is spacing to possess the person of facilitating the use to carry out the experiment model, thereby avoid leading to the experiment model to take place the trend that influences experiment rivers by a wide margin because the external force striking, avoid influencing the advantage of experimental data accuracy.

title_en: A method for spatializing disaster damage history data
title_ko: 재난 피해이력자료를 공간 정보화하기 위한 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for converting disaster damage history data managed in a character form into spatial information, which includes the processes of: 1) inputting disaster damage history information into a program of an operating computer; 2) geocoding the location information (address) of the disaster damage history information and converting the location information into coordinates; 3) confirming a coordinate conversion success rate for the geocoded location information; and 4) constructing and simulating a map port based on map information (business use map for disaster preparation) when the coordinate conversion success rate is greater than or equal to a certain value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 문자형태로 관리되고 있는 재난 피해이력자료를 공간 정보로 변환하기 위한 방법으로서,  풍수해를 포함한 자연재난 관련정보들과, 상기 정보들에 의해 풍수해를 예측하기 위한 프로그램(GIS 기반 통합상황 관리시스템)이 내장된 운영컴퓨터와, 상기 운영컴퓨터와 연결된 시뮬레이션용  모니터로 구성되어진 시스템에서, 상기 프로그램에 의해 다음과 같은 과정으로 수행되는 것을 특징으로 하는 재난 피해이력자료를 공간 정보화하기 위한 방법. 1) 상기 자연재난 관련정보들 중에서, 피해시설 위치정보(주소)가 피해종류 및 피해요인의 정보와 함께 문자로 제공되는 재난 피해이력정보들이, 상기 운영컴퓨터의 프로그램에 입력되는 과정; 2) 상기 재난 피해이력정보들의 위치정보(주소)가, 상기 프로그램에 의해 지오코딩(Geocoding)되어 위도 및 경도의 좌표(x,y)로 변환되는 과정; 3) 상기 2)과정에서 지오코딩(Geocoding)된 재난 피해시설의 위치정보(주소)가 상기 프로그램에 의해, 국토교통부의 행정구역 경계 내 존재하는 비율, 지적도 상 기록된 토지의 지번과 일치하는 비율, 또는 환경부의 토지피복도 중분류 항목(주거지역, 산림지역, 상업지역 등)에 일치하는 비율이 확인됨으로써, 좌표변환 성공율(지오코딩(Geocoding)된 재난 피해시설의 위치와 실제 토지 위치와의 일치율)이 확인되는 과정; 4) 상기 3)과정에서 확인된 좌표변환 성공율이 일정치 이상인 경우, 상기 2)과정에서 지오코딩(Geocoding)된 재난 피해시설의 위치정보(주소)를 사용하여 상기 프로그램에 의해, 피해종류 및 피해요인의 정보와 함께 지도정보 기반의 맵포트(재난대비 업무활용지도)가 구축되고, 상기 모니터에 의해 시뮬레이션되는 과정.

title_en: High-efficient track traffic simulation test platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency rail transit simulation test platform, which relates to the field of rail simulation test and comprises a platform body, wherein the top of the platform body is provided with a first mounting groove, a spray nozzle is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the first mounting groove, the bottom of the platform body is provided with a second mounting groove, and a water tank is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the second mounting groove, when a fire disaster occurs, a heat conducting fin can conduct heat generated when an object burns, then kerosene in the first mounting groove can be heated and expanded, and then an electrode plate II can be jacked up through a floating plate, so that the first electrode plate I and the second electrode plate can be connected and electrified, and a buzzer can be electrified to work, thereby reminding workers, and facilitating the evacuation of the workers in time, thereby avoiding the situation that passengers are choked by smoke, meanwhile, a water pump can extract water in the water tank and then spray out through the spray nozzle, thereby can play the effect of putting out a fire, the function is various.
assignees: SHANDONG HONGYAN ELECTRIC SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Soil sampling equipment for geological disaster treatment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of geological disaster treatment, in particular to a soil sampling device for geological disaster treatment, which comprises a bottom plate; the bottom of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a support column, one end of the support column is fixedly connected with an anti-slip pad, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a shell, the top of the shell is fixedly connected with an electric push rod, and the output end of the electric push rod is fixedly connected with a first connecting plate; through the bottom plate, the support column, the slipmat, the casing, electric putter, the connecting rod, the installation piece, the sample frame, fixed frame, including a motor, an end cap, a controller, and a cover plate, the movable rod, the structural design of drill bit and opening, realized the function of this sampling device sample of being convenient for, solved the problem that general sampling device was not convenient for take a sample, make this sampling device make things convenient for people to do you and take a sample to soil to detect out the fundamental problem of geological disasters, make the pertinence and administer, the work efficiency of this sampling device has been improved, the work of giving people has brought the facility.

title_en: Meteorological disaster defense capability testing device based on scene simulation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field related to scene simulation, and discloses a meteorological disaster defense capability testing device based on scene simulation, which comprises a shell and an access door, a replaceable air port is arranged in the shell, clamping blocks are arranged on both sides of the replaceable air port, meanwhile, one side of the clamping block is provided with a clamping groove, the two sides of the clamping groove are both provided with a first baffle, one side of the first baffle is provided with a first hinge, a second baffle is arranged at the other side of the first hinge, slide rails are arranged at both sides of the second baffle, meanwhile, a pulley is arranged above the sliding rail, a connecting rod is arranged above the pulley, a first limiting block is arranged above the connecting rod, meanwhile, a first limiting groove is formed in one side of the first limiting block, an electric telescopic sleeve rod is arranged below the first limiting groove, and a first fixing bolt is arranged on one side of the electric telescopic sleeve rod. This meteorological disaster defense ability testing arrangement based on situational simulation can effectual test wind-force, is convenient for people's use.

title_en: Test simulation system for engineering pipeline vibration caused by submarine landslide disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sea floor landslide calamity causes experimental simulation system of engineering pipeline vibration, including simulation submarine pipeline device, water environment analogue means, landslide body motion analogue means and data monitoring device, simulation submarine pipeline device includes a simulation pipeline, and with simulation pipe connection's pipeline support, water environment analogue means includes the box, establish simulation sea bed surface and water filling port in the box, landslide body motion analogue means includes the spout of being connected with simulation sea bed surface, injects the tripper of landslide soil sample into in the spout, and data monitoring device includes camera and pneumatics sensor, wherein, the simulation pipeline transversely is established and is strikeed in order to use the simulation landslide body in simulating the water environment. The utility model discloses can realize causing the vibration of engineering pipeline, twist reverse the experimental simulation and the analysis of problem even to the landslide calamity of seabed, can realize pipeline atress, flow field, displacement under different landslide body velocity of motion, the different pipeline average density, twist reverse and the comprehensive research function of relevant image, and install simple easily popularization.

title_en: Mechanical type fire engine removes water tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mechanical fire engine moving water tank, which relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, and comprises a fire engine body, wherein the fire engine body comprises a head body, the tail part of the head body is fixedly provided with an engine body frame, the side frame of the engine body frame is fixedly welded with a buckle seat, the buckle seat is buckled with a buckle, the engine body frame is provided with a water tank mechanism, the inside of the water tank mechanism is provided with an agitating mechanism, the agitating mechanism designed by the utility model can agitate the water body in the water tank body when adding fire-fighting agent, and the manual agitating mode can also play a certain degree of training for the firefighter, the matching mode of the air suction pipe and the air pipe can make the water body in the water tank body generate bubbles to realize rapid mixing, the design can very rapidly complete the mixing of the agent and water when emergently going out on duty, does not affect fire fighting.
assignees: SHANDONG NEW ELECTRICITY ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster power distribution network elasticity assessment method considering fault linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster power distribution network elasticity evaluation method considering fault cascading, which comprises the following steps: step S1, modeling various disaster feature failure rates; step S2, based on sequential Monte Carlo simulation, the time sequence characteristics of the element in the disaster process are reserved, and an element running state model formed by a basic range fault rate and a characteristic fault rate is established; s3, analyzing the nonlinear association degree of the trend state characterization quantity sequences of the lines and the nodes in the N-1 scene set and the N-2 scene set through the gray theory, and establishing a coupling relation between fault scenes; s4, establishing a LLD index, an SEDT index and an economic index which comprehensively consider the load loss degree and the maximum frequency change rate of the active unbalance initial moment to form a weighted elasticity-economic space evaluation system, and carrying out elasticity evaluation by measuring the composite entropy weight Euclidean distance between the scene cluster center and the perfect elasticity point; the fault linkage in the disaster process can be prevented and inhibited, and the elasticity of the power transmission network in extreme weather is improved.
