title_en: Chemical laboratory risk early warning method based on discrete Hopfield neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a chemical laboratory risk early warning method based on a discrete Hopfield neural network for warning the operation condition a of ventilation and illumination equipment 1 The running state a of the temperature and humidity control equipment 2 Operating condition of the circuit system a 3 And the condition of the storage environment of the hazardous chemicals a 4 Chemical preservation of dangerous chemical a 5 Safety inspection condition a of laboratory instruments 6 Safe operation condition a of experimental instrument 7 Safety indicator condition a 8 The running condition a of the fire-proof and explosion-proof equipment 9 Experimental environmental sanitation conditions a 10 Emergency equipment condition a 11 Emergency evacuation channel condition a 12 The actual result is coded and input into the constructed discrete Hopfield neural network, and the risk early warning of a safety condition multi-index evaluation system of a chemical laboratory of colleges and universities is realized by the unchanged characteristic after multiple iterations. The invention solves the problems of simulation, poor mobility and complex construction method of a large amount of data, and realizes intuitive, rapid and accurate risk early warning on the safety condition of a laboratory.

title_en: Big data processing capacity evaluation method suitable for super-computation center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data processing capacity evaluation method suitable for a super-computation center, which comprises the following steps: collecting relevant data of a super-computation center, preprocessing the data, and dividing the preprocessed data into a training set and a test set; normalizing the training set and the test set; constructing a comprehensive evaluation model, and training the comprehensive evaluation model by utilizing the normalized training set and the normalized test set to obtain an optimized comprehensive evaluation model; and performing calculation prediction on the simulated natural disaster by using the optimized comprehensive evaluation model, and evaluating the big data processing capacity of the super-computation center according to a calculation prediction result. The invention can monitor and evaluate the processing capacity of the supercomputing center on the big data in real time, and can ensure that the processing and analyzing capacity can constantly ensure the requirements of social development and the real-time processing and early warning of some emergencies.
assignees: GUIZHOU ZHONGYUN DATA SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster unmanned aerial vehicle image information extraction system
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood disaster unmanned aerial vehicle image information extraction system which is characterized by comprising the following components: unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform: the system is used for regulating and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to collect flood image images and dividing the flood image images into a training set and a testing set; a sample library construction module: the system comprises a training sample library, a search engine and a storage module, wherein the training sample library is used for acquiring a flood disaster image through the Internet and the search engine and integrating the flood disaster image and the training set to construct the training sample library; the deep learning model building module comprises: training sample data of the training sample library through a Yolo algorithm under a Tensorflow framework to generate a deep learning model; flood disaster extraction module: and importing the flood image of the test set into a deep learning model to obtain disaster information.
assignees: TIANJIN COLLEGE UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Method for judging alarm threshold value for water damage microseismic
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine water damage monitoring, in particular to a method for judging an alarm threshold value for water damage microseismic, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring geophysical prospecting data, chemical prospecting data and hydrological data in real time; s2, carrying out fusion processing on the geophysical prospecting data, the chemical prospecting data and the hydrological data to obtain fused data; s3, performing optimization training on the fusion data by adopting a deep learning spatio-temporal sequence prediction algorithm to obtain trained fusion data; s4, on the basis of the trained fusion data, combining static indexes and real-time monitoring dynamic indexes of coal seam water inrush influencing factors to construct an intelligent early warning model for classifying water disaster early warning levels; and S5, classifying the water damage micro-earthquake according to the intelligent early warning model to obtain a water damage micro-earthquake grade, and determining a corresponding alarm threshold according to the water damage micro-earthquake grade. The invention can dynamically adjust the alarm threshold value aiming at different current environments, and solves the technical problem that the alarm threshold value cannot be dynamically adjusted aiming at different current environments.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Submersible pump inclined-horizontal arrangement system applied to underground coal mine disaster-resistant drainage system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a submersible pump inclined-horizontal arrangement system applied to a coal mine underground disaster-resistant drainage system, which comprises a sump, a water distribution roadway, an electric water distribution gate valve, an inclined-horizontal pump well, a submersible pump and a drainage pipeline; wherein, the water sump is connected with the water distribution roadway to form an underground water gushing channel; the electric water distribution gate valve is positioned at the interface of the water distribution roadway and the inclined horizontal type pump well and is connected with a submersible pump arranged in the inclined horizontal type pump well through a drainage pipeline. The utility model provides a be applied to colliery underground disaster resistant drainage system immersible pump form of laying to one side. The underground engineering quantity can be reduced by adopting an inclined horizontal type arrangement process, a drainage pipeline drilling process, a cable drilling arrangement process and a winch chamber arrangement process, and meanwhile, when flood occurs underground, the submersible pump is guaranteed to be started in time, and the working efficiency and the safety can be improved by daily overhauling and maintenance.
assignees: CHINA COAL XIAN DESIGN ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Railway geological disaster monitoring system and method suitable for complex and difficult mountain areas
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster body monitoring, governing and designing, in particular to a railway geological disaster monitoring system and method suitable for complex and hard mountainous areas, and is particularly suitable for complex and large-scale geological disasters and goaf monitoring projects of roads, railways, mines, municipal administration and the like. On the basis of geomechanical analysis and judgment, the invention establishes a life-cycle cost concept aiming at the characteristics of various natural disasters, and is applicable to a new technology for monitoring deep displacement of landslides in complex and difficult mountainous areas. Firstly, the position of a sliding belt of a slope body is researched and judged through geological exploration drilling and coring, secondly, the arrangement of monitoring equipment is determined, and finally, the treatment measures are determined through monitoring analysis. Compared with the traditional rock-soil mass deep monitoring technology, the invention realizes three technical advantages: firstly, full-depth coverage monitoring, secondly, high-precision real-time monitoring is realized, and thirdly, cost is greatly reduced, and multi-point position monitoring joint study and judgment are convenient to realize.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Simulation experiment device and method for measuring and calculating farmland phosphorus migration and conversion ratio
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation experiment device and a method for measuring and calculating farmland phosphorus migration and conversion proportion, wherein the simulation experiment device comprises a carrier, a crop planting environment simulation device and an artificial rainfall simulation device, and the measuring and calculating method comprises the following steps of S1: a theoretical measuring and calculating method is provided, and the measuring and calculating method comprises an independent full-scale measuring algorithm and a point measuring method; s2: carrying out experiment and measurement and calculation through a simulation experiment device; s3: investigating a measuring and calculating result; s4: the calculation method is verified by collecting and detecting the phosphorus content ratio of each component in the farmland ecosystem; s5: and repeating the experiment to obtain the influence of the change of each experimental condition on the migration and conversion ratio of the phosphorus. The method is suitable for obtaining the migration and transformation proportion of the phosphorus in farmland ecosystems of different regions, different terrains and different crops, can provide important reference for research on disaster-affected crop growth and phosphorus pollution in water environment, and provides better support for research on meteorological, hydrological and agricultural mechanisms of the phosphorus.

title_en: Debris flow simulation test device capable of regulating disaster factors
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a debris flow simulation test device capable of regulating disaster factors, and relates to the technical field of civil engineering. The debris flow simulation test device capable of regulating disaster factors comprises a base, a rainwater simulation assembly and a mountain simulation assembly. The upper surface of the base is concave downwards to form a water storage tank; the lower end of the pipe body is communicated with the water outlet end of the pump body, the upper end of the pipe body is communicated with the inside of the spraying box, and the lower surface of the spraying box is provided with spraying holes. The upper end of the slope plate is connected with the edge of the top plate, and the slope plate is arranged right below the spraying box. And the water is sprayed out downwards through the spraying holes to simulate the rainfall condition. The top plate is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the pipe body, the upper end of the slope plate is connected with the edge of the top plate, the slope plate is arranged right below the spray box, debris flow is arranged on the slope plate, the field condition is simulated, the comprehensive research on the physical simulation of debris flow disaster factors is realized, and the applicability is high.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD

title_en: Experimental device for simulating and monitoring multi-source all-terrain movement of debris flow
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an experimental apparatus of simulation and monitoring many sources of debris flow full topography motion belongs to geotechnical engineering experimental apparatus technical field. The device comprises an animal source supply device, an on-way object source supply device, a multi-degree-of-freedom terrain simulation device, a rainfall simulation device, a debris flow motion monitoring device and the like. The device comprises a material source supply device, a multi-degree-of-freedom terrain simulation device, a rainfall simulation device, a support device and a debris flow motion monitoring device, wherein the material source supply device is used for providing required material sources for experiments, the multi-degree-of-freedom terrain simulation device is used for simulating different terrain conditions, the rainfall simulation device is used for simulating rainfall working conditions, the support device is used for supporting the rainfall simulation device and the hanging monitoring equipment, and the debris flow motion monitoring device is used for completing the whole process research of debris flow motion. The utility model discloses can simulate the research under rainfall, thing source supply, erosion deposit, complicated topography condition, the complete process of mud-rock flow evolution to through automatic monitoring facilities record material exchange, velocity of flow change, flow acceleration isoparametric, realize the research to the process of causing a disaster, prediction mud-rock flow scale and harm range.

title_en: Method and device for simulating and predicting pre-disaster fault scene of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for simulating and predicting a pre-disaster fault scene of a power distribution network, comprising the following steps: establishing a power distribution network fault probability model; generating a power distribution network fault scene set according to the preset disaster information and the total number of preset generation scenes; performing topology reconstruction in a power distribution network fault scene set to construct a fault topology reconstruction model; processing to obtain fault loss of each fault scene and scene topology similarity among the fault scenes; clustering fault scenes according to the fault loss to obtain a plurality of first scene clustering results; clustering each first scene clustering result according to the topological similarity to obtain a plurality of second scene clustering results; and obtaining a simulation prediction result of the pre-disaster fault scene of the power distribution network according to the second scene clustering result. And generating scenes according to the disaster forecast information, clustering the scenes by utilizing the fault loss and the topological similarity of the scenes, and providing a basis for optimizing decisions based on the scenes so as to analyze the influence of the disaster on the power distribution network before the disaster.

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network dynamic rush-repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic rush-repair method and a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic rush-repair system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring state information of a post-disaster power distribution network to be dynamically rush-repaired through an environment side; inputting the state information of the post-disaster power distribution network to be dynamically rush-repaired to an intelligent body side comprising a reinforcement learning model, and obtaining a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic rush-repair result output by the intelligent body; the intelligent agent side acquires a reinforcement learning state from the environment side, acts on the power distribution network based on strategy selection actions, receives corresponding rewarding values and the next state for iterative training, and continuously updates network parameters to obtain the reinforcement learning model. The embodiment of the invention realizes the high-efficiency and high-accuracy emergency repair effect of the post-disaster emergency repair of the power distribution network under the conditions of deep coupling of multi-emergency repair team cooperative allocation, emergency repair recovery and power supply transfer and restoration.

title_en: Real-time flame detection method and device based on improved CenterNet
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time flame detection method and a control device based on an improved central Net, which are characterized in that an original central Net model is obtained, the original central Net model is improved into a modified central Net model, and a backbone network and an auxiliary branch of a flame color model are added to the modified central Net model on the basis of the original central Net model; model training is carried out on the modified central Net model based on the previous flame image and corresponding training data so as to obtain a flame detection model; identifying the video to be detected in real time based on the flame detection model, and determining fire hazard level; and performing text alarm or voice alarm based on the fire disaster level.

title_en: Ignition platform and method for fire extinguishing test of true transformer and flame testing system
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a fire test ignition platform, a method and a flame test system for a true transformer, wherein the platform comprises: a true transformer body and a firewall; a firewall with an opening is arranged around the true transformer body; the positions of the installation connecting valve and the oil level gauge of the real-type transformer body are replaced by installation pipelines, the pipelines extend out of the firewall and are folded back to the real-type transformer body from the outside of the firewall, and a pipeline pump and a ball valve are installed on the outer side section of the firewall of the pipeline to control the splashing rate of oil of the real-type transformer body, so that a fire simulation test is performed. The fire disaster simulation system can realize omnibearing simulation of the transformer fire disaster and strive to restore the real fire disaster scene of the operating transformer.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method, system and device for constructing ship early warning model of marine disaster area and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for constructing a ship early warning model in a marine disaster area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: setting a navigation area of a ship at the time t in a plane rectangular coordinate system, and randomly generating n disaster points in the navigation area; dividing n disaster points into k clusters through a spectral clustering algorithm, and sequentially connecting the points in each cluster end to construct a disaster fence; storing the positions of the ships and the disaster points in an R-tree type data structure and establishing an index rule; taking the position of the ship at the time t as a center, starting to execute a ray algorithm on disaster fences corresponding to nodes in the tree from a tree root of an R-tree type data structure so as to judge the position relation of the ship and each disaster fence at the time t; constructing a marine disaster area early warning simulation model based on the position relation, and importing historical navigation data of a ship to generate the marine disaster area early warning model; the route planning and early warning efficiency of the ship in the marine disaster area can be improved.

title_en: Immersive virtual simulation emergency rescue drilling method for fire disaster in coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine emergency rescue, in particular to an immersive virtual simulation emergency rescue drilling method for fire disasters in a coal mine, which comprises the following steps of: generating field data parameters of the underground coal mine; a model establishing step: establishing a three-dimensional model of the underground environment of the coal mine according to the field data parameters; a fire simulation step: generating an intrinsic fire data parameter of the underground coal mine, and performing intrinsic fire simulation according to the field data parameter and the intrinsic fire data parameter to generate a simulation result, wherein the simulation result comprises an influence range of the intrinsic fire; building a fire virtual environment: according to the simulation result, generating the influence range of each time period of the internal fire, constructing a VR virtual environment, and generating user characteristic parameters; simulation emergency rescue drilling steps: and generating initial position data of the user, and performing multi-user simulation emergency rescue drilling. The method can complete relatively real rescue simulation training of rescue workers in the coal mine due to fire.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Multi-field coupling ore drawing vibration simulation experiment device and experiment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-field coupling ore drawing vibration simulation experiment device, which comprises a vibration loading module, an access module and a seepage box, wherein the vibration loading module is used for loading ore drawing vibration; the vibration loading module is positioned at the bottommost part; the access module is arranged on the vibration loading module, the access module is an iron box body, a plurality of accesses are arranged at the bottom of the box body, the front end of each access is a mine outlet, and ores, rocks and loess layers are sequentially arranged above the accesses in the box body; the seepage box is arranged on the access module, and is filled with water and the water pressure is adjustable. The invention can directly simulate the ore rock and loess discharging process of ore drawing by a caving method, can load osmotic water pressure above the ore rock through the seepage box, can simulate blasting construction through the blasting vibration module, can realize the coupling loading of osmotic water pressure and blasting vibration, can better simulate the stress state and the ore rock discharging rule of the ore rock under the combined action of osmotic water pressure, blasting vibration and ground stress in the ore drawing process of mining by the caving method, and provides theoretical guidance for preventing or weakening the water-permeable mud burst disaster of underground mining.

title_en: Flood assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood evaluation method, which is applied on large, medium and small scales respectively and comprises an index system evaluation method and a disaster simulation evaluation method, wherein the index system evaluation method is firstly adopted to carry out initial flood risk evaluation on the large scale, and then the disaster simulation evaluation method is adopted to carry out check and detailed evaluation on the medium and small scales to obtain a final flood evaluation result, the index evaluation method and the disaster simulation method adopted by the invention have respective advantages and disadvantages for flood evaluation on a research area, the index evaluation method can carry out preliminary flood evaluation on the current situation and corresponding data provided by planning, the disaster simulation method can well simulate a hydrologic hydrodynamic process, more accurate evaluation results are obtained through check with historical disasters, and under the conditions of full data and data, the flood risk can be evaluated through the two methods, and check each other, and the flood risk assessment that comes out possesses higher science and systematicness.
assignees: GUANGDONG URBAN & RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Simulated fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulated fire extinguishing system, which comprises a simulated compartment, at least one triple infrared flame detector arranged on a partition board of the simulated compartment, a plurality of simulated fire extinguishing nozzles, a controller and a simulated fire source arranged in the simulated compartment, wherein the controller is electrically connected with the simulated fire extinguishing nozzles and the triple infrared flame detector; the simulation burning things which may cause a fire disaster is by the remote control automobile body, set up automatic subassembly of striking sparks on the remote control automobile body, set up in automatic subassembly of striking sparks and produce the fire end and inside the fire pan that holds solid alcohol and set up in the automatic lid that closes fire of fire pan upper end and constitute, the bottom of fire pan is provided with the strip seam, inside solid alcohol is lighted to automatic subassembly of striking sparks generation flame accessible strip seam. The system can completely simulate the fire extinguishing process, clearly and visually display the product characteristics and advantages, and has high automation degree and strong practicability.

title_en: Fire training props and methods for using fire training props
abstract_en: Fire training props and methods of using fire training props are provided. The props may be suitable for table-top training and include an enclosure; at least one internal panel positioned within the enclosure and defining a plurality of internal volumes within the enclosure; a transparent top panel positioned on the top of the enclosure; at least one side aperture and a side aperture cover in at least one of the sides of the enclosure; and at least one panel aperture having an aperture cover in the at least one internal panel. When a source of visible fluid, for example, smoke, is introduced to the enclosure, a flow of the visible fluid in the enclosure can be monitored by a user through the transparent top panel. Aspects of the invention are uniquely adapted for training firefighters and other first responders on the dynamics of fire, for example, in an engaged structure.

title_en: Network disconnection simulation method and device, electronic equipment and system
abstract_en: The application provides a network disconnection simulation method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a network breaking rule aiming at data to be processed, wherein the network breaking rule is used for indicating that the network breaking simulation is carried out on target data carrying a network breaking identification in the data to be processed; obtaining the target data from the data to be processed; and stopping transmitting the target data to realize the network disconnection simulation. According to the network breaking simulation method, after the network breaking rule aiming at the data to be processed and used for indicating the target data carrying the network breaking identification in the data to be processed to be subjected to network breaking simulation is obtained, the target data can be further obtained from the data to be processed, and the network breaking simulation is carried out aiming at the target data, so that the network breaking simulation can be carried out on the data in a targeted manner, and the fineness of disaster tolerance drilling control on the data is improved.

title_en: Hydraulic power coupling disaster simulation device and method for underground reservoir of inclined stratum
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation device and a simulation method for a hydrodynamic coupling disaster of an underground reservoir of an inclined stratum. The test module comprises a test box and a rock-soil body sample arranged in the test box, wherein a region to be excavated is arranged in the rock-soil body sample, and a water-soluble supporting material and a liquid resource storage region are arranged in the rock-soil body sample and are used for storing liquid solution. The test box is arranged on the vibration module, and the vibration module is suitable for driving the test box, the rock-soil body sample and the liquid resource storage area to vibrate in the horizontal direction and/or the vertical direction. According to the method, the area to be excavated is filled with the supporting material, the supporting material is dissolved in water to simulate the excavation process of a rock-soil body, the liquid resource injection process is simulated by injecting water into the liquid resource storage area, then the vibration module is controlled to be started, the dynamic response information of the rock-soil body sample and the liquid resource storage area is obtained in real time through the monitoring module, and the hydraulic-dynamic coupling disaster analysis is carried out on the inclined stratum underground storage according to the dynamic response information.

title_en: Method for determining high-risk pole tower system according to height difference and span
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a high-risk tower system according to altitude difference and span, which comprises the following steps: step 1, selecting a three-tower two-gear system of the same tower type with different height differences and span ranges under the same voltage grade to construct a three-dimensional simulation model; step 2, applying icing load and wind load to the selected three-tower two-gear system, simulating the stress condition of the tower under different load conditions, and performing finite element mechanical simulation analysis to obtain the mechanical characteristics of the tower; step 3, counting the towers in a high risk state according to the mechanical characteristics of the towers; the method is used for early warning of ice prevention and disaster reduction of the power transmission line, and can determine the towers in the range of the altitude difference and the span which need to be focused aiming at the high risk area, so that the workload is reduced, and the efficiency is improved.

title_en: Semi-supervised meta learning method and device based on task distribution change
abstract_en: The application discloses a semi-supervised meta learning method and device based on task distribution change. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: selecting a plurality of semi-supervised datasets corresponding to different task profiles from a series of varying task profiles; training an identification model through each semi-supervised data set in turn, and determining a first loss between a tag of inputted training data and an actual output obtained by the identification model according to the inputted training data, and a second loss between feature distribution information obtained by the identification model according to a historical semi-supervised data set and feature distribution information obtained according to a current semi-supervised data set; the identification model is updated based on the first loss and the second loss. The method and the device provide a more realistic training environment, and solve the problem of forgetting disaster.

title_en: Test device for simulating structural member suffering fire disaster and explosion coupling disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of member disaster simulation, and particularly relates to a test device for simulating a structural member suffering from fire disaster and explosion coupling disaster. The invention relates to a drop hammer, a movable high-temperature furnace for heating a test piece and an explosive load transfer device for converting a load generated by the drop hammer into uniformly distributed loads; the high-temperature furnace is of a top-opening structure, so that the high-temperature furnace is moved to the position of the test piece to wrap the test piece for heating after the test piece is fixed and fixed, and the test piece is fixed and fixed; the explosion load transfer device comprises a load transfer plate and an air bag, wherein the air bag is arranged at the top of the load transfer plate, and the air bag and the load transfer plate can generate coordinated deformation when being impacted by a drop hammer, so that the energy loss is reduced. The impact force of the drop hammer is converted into uniformly distributed load, and the drop hammer can generate coordinated deformation and reduce energy loss, so that the test that the structural member is subjected to fire and explosion coupled disasters can be simulated more accurately; the full-scale large-section test piece is particularly suitable for full-scale large-section test pieces, and the cost is greatly reduced.

title_en: Perception information integration access system based on city important infrastructure
abstract_en: The invention provides a perception information integration access system based on city important infrastructure, which comprises: a support layer: comprises a basic library and a knowledge library; core service layer: the system comprises a diagnosis center, an emergency dispatching center, a safety center, a data center, a monitoring center, an operation center, a user center and an operation and maintenance center; a data application layer: including a statistical analysis center and a data sharing center. The system acquires various real-time monitoring information based on the technology of the Internet of things, and is based on the MQTT technology, the existing monitoring system data is connected, a holographic digital mapping model is established and maintained through a large data and deep learning multidimensional perception data association analysis algorithm, and intelligent assessment, simulation, real-time early warning and quick response of urban important infrastructure disasters and emergencies are achieved.
assignees: NANJING PAIGUANG SMART PERCEPTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Static exploration machine for geological disaster exploration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quiet machine of exploring for geological disasters reconnaissance, the load simulator comprises a case, the rectangle opening has all been seted up to the both sides outer wall of machine case, and two equal swing joint of rectangle open-ended inner wall have the baffle, the both ends of machine case both sides outer wall all are connected with the gyro wheel through the bearing, the both sides inner wall of machine case has same install bin through the bolt spiro union, and the both sides outer wall of install bin all sets up the opening, two the equal sliding connection of open-ended inner wall has supporting mechanism, install bin bottom inner wall is connected with first gear through the bearing, and first gear drive shaft's one end has cup jointed the second gear, the both sides inner wall of install bin all has the slide bar through the bolt spiro union. The utility model discloses a supporting mechanism's auxiliary stay has improved the stability of quick-witted case, has solved the current problem of quiet quick-witted poor stability of exploring, has improved the flexibility of quiet quick-witted of exploring through setting up of gyro wheel.
assignees: XIAN ZHONGJIAO TONGLI GEOTECHNICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Slope disaster test simulation equipment capable of coupling mountain fire and rainfall effects
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slope disaster test simulation equipment that can coupling mountain fire and rainfall effect, include: the device comprises a support device, a geological disaster simulation device, a mountain fire simulation device, a rainfall simulation device and a data acquisition device; the geological disaster simulation device, the mountain fire simulation device and the rainfall simulation device are sequentially arranged on the bracket device at intervals from bottom to top; the data acquisition device is arranged on the support device and can automatically record the mountain fire simulation process of the mountain fire simulation device, the rainfall simulation process of the rainfall simulation device and the soil physical state of the automatic geological disaster simulation device. Through on the bracket device, from bottom to top in proper order the interval set up geological disaster analogue means, mountain fire analogue means and rainfall analogue means to set up the data acquisition device of data acquisition, can be in indoor simulation after the fire and behind the rain slope calamity, not only can simulate a certain disaster factor alone, can also simulate the side slope geological disasters that coupling mountain fire and rainfall combined action caused.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER MINISTRY OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Experimental device for rape seed selection is cultivated
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an experimental device that rape seed selection was cultivated draws together the artificial containers and articulates in the chamber door of artificial containers one side through the hinge, set up the rectangular channel that supplies light filling subassembly fixed mounting between two parties on the top of artificial containers, two vents that supply dust screen fixed mounting are seted up to the top symmetry of artificial containers, and the position symmetry that the top of artificial containers corresponds the vent is provided with two seal assembly, the top of artificial containers both sides all is provided with wind tubular heater between two parties, and the bottom switch-on of wind tubular heater has the guide duct, the one end fixedly connected with suction fan of guide duct. This experimental apparatus that rape seed selection was cultivated can shine the rape seed to temperature variation has been shortened staff's work load and duty cycle greatly in the simulation, does benefit to the systematic cultivation of rape seed, and the practicality is stronger, still can make its influence of avoiding natural disasters, makes going on smoothly of seed selection work, has reduced the risk.
assignees: HUBEI SILV SEED IND CO LTD

title_en: High temperature monitoring early warning and intelligent cooling management and control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high temperature monitoring early warning and intelligent cooling management and control system, it includes: control module, management and control all-in-one and management and control equipment, and management and control all-in-one internally mounted has monitoring early warning module, and the equal wireless communication of management and control all-in-one and management and control equipment is connected in control module, and management and control equipment includes: pipeline water jet equipment and lift water jet equipment, the utility model discloses a arrange high temperature monitoring early warning and intelligent cooling management and control system in various outdoor sport places such as playground, football court, volleyball court, basketball court and runway of colleges and universities, carry out all-round monitoring to school's sport place, intelligence is opened on the spot management and control device and is cooled down to the management and control place in the early warning forecast, simultaneously the utility model discloses an early warning information covers sport place entirely, student's outdoor exercises can be done high temperature safeguard measure in advance, provides the basis in the aspect of disaster reduction and disaster prevention for local school, government and relevant department, just the utility model discloses a management and control equipment is automatic, can in time reduce the site temperature.

title_en: Method and apparatus for estimating size of damage in the disaster affected areas
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, there may be provided an operation method of a server for estimating the size of damage in disaster affected areas. In this instance, the operation method of the server may include acquiring at least one first disaster image, deriving an affected area from each of the at least one first disaster image, acquiring affected area related information through labeling based on the derived affected area, and training a first learning model using the at least one first disaster image and the affected area related information.

title_en: Method and apparatus for identifying disaster affected areas using disaster prone areas features
abstract_en: An operation method of a server for identifying disaster affected areas. The operation method of the server may include acquiring at least one first disaster image; deriving an affected area from each of the at least one first disaster image and acquiring affected area related information through labeling based on the derived affected area; and training a first learning model using the at least one first disaster image and the affected area related information.

title_en: Multistage energy consumption buffer system, design method and stone blocking wall structure damage monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rock rolling disaster protection, and discloses a multistage energy consumption buffer system, a design method and a rock blocking wall structure damage monitoring method, which are used for improving the impact resistance of a protection project and monitoring the health condition of a rock blocking wall structure in the project operation period. In the initial stage of the construction of the rock rolling protection project, firstly, vegetation is paved on an unstable slope surface; secondly, a stone blocking wall structure is arranged; during the operation of the rolling stone protection project, firstly, carrying out simulation calculation work successively by adopting a numerical simulation means aiming at different working conditions of the stone blocking wall structure impacted by the potential rolling stone disasters, and judging and identifying the vulnerable position and the vulnerable degree of the stone blocking wall structure under the action of the rolling stone impact load by defining damage factors; and then, rapid local detection can be carried out on site according to the vulnerable position and the vulnerable degree data of the stone blocking wall calculated by the numerical simulation software, so that the structural damage degree of the stone blocking wall can be accurately judged. The invention is suitable for health detection of rock rolling protection and protection engineering.

title_en: Regional typhoon disaster rigidity and toughness system dynamics simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional typhoon disaster rigidity and toughness system dynamics simulation method, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of constructing an urban typhoon disaster risk prevention system by using an ISEET analysis framework, wherein the ISEET analysis framework comprises five aspects of institutional (institutional), social (social), economic (economic), environmental (environmental) and technical (technical); risk R may be described as system I, social S, economic EC, environmental EN, and technical T, as follows: r ═ F (I, S, EC, EN, T). The invention has the beneficial effects that: the ISEET analysis framework and the integrated typhoon disaster risk assessment index system based on the ISEET analysis framework, which are created by the invention, introduce more than 30 indexes related to technology, economy, system, society and environment, can comprehensively analyze regional rigidity and toughness, and consider the interrelation among the indexes to analyze the system risk of the city, so as to improve the defense capability of the coastal city typhoon risk and meet the challenge of more systematic risks in the future.

title_en: Emergency evacuation training system for airplane
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airplane emergency evacuation training system which comprises a plurality of interactive devices, an entity model, an integrated processing system and the like. The plurality of interactive devices can be configured on the trainee to detect and collect body shape information and limb action information of the trainee. The solid model is the same as a part of the aircraft component in shape and arrangement position. The integrated processing system is configured to acquire the trainee's body shape information and the limb movement information from the plurality of interactive devices, and provide the trainee with a virtual environment and a real environment for training through the interactive devices.
assignees: COMMERCIAL AIRCRAFT CORP CN;SHANGHAI AIRCRAFT CUSTOMER SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Telescopic geological detection punching device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and prevention, in particular to a telescopic geological detection perforating device which comprises a lifting mechanism, a drill bit mechanism, a connecting inner shell, a connecting outer shell, a telescopic mechanism and a detector, wherein the connecting inner shell is arranged inside the connecting outer shell, the outer sides of two ends of the connecting inner shell are correspondingly and slidably connected with the inner sides of two ends of the connecting outer shell through the telescopic mechanism, the detector is arranged at the bottom end of the connecting inner shell, the drill bit mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the connecting outer shell, the lifting mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the connecting outer shell at intervals, and the upper end of the connecting outer shell is detachably connected with the front end of the lifting mechanism. By arranging the telescopic mechanism, after the drill bit directly drives the detector to drill to a specified underground position, the lifting mechanism lifts the connecting outer shell to ascend and drives the connecting inner shell to descend through the telescopic mechanism, so that the detector is driven to extend out of the connecting outer shell for direct detection.
assignees: CHENGDU TIANMA XINGKONG ROBOT RES CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent modification device for firefighting rescue breathing mask and application method of intelligent modification device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent modification device for a fire rescue breathing mask, which comprises a breathing mask body and modified intelligent hardware, wherein a rescue key and a training key are respectively arranged on the upper side wall, the lower side wall and the left side wall and the right side wall of a start-stop key, the start-stop key is arranged below a lower indicator lamp, the start-stop key is in telecommunication connection with a pressure sensor, the output end of the pressure sensor is in signal connection with the input ends of an upper indicator lamp and a lower indicator lamp respectively, and the output ends of the indicator lamp and the lower indicator lamp are in signal connection with a server through a communication module.

title_en: Active supporting and protecting structure and method for invasion-limited deformation of surrounding rock after tunnel excavation and supporting
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active supporting and protecting structure and method for invasion limit deformation of surrounding rock after tunnel excavation supporting, wherein a permanent steel arch frame and a permanent protective net are arranged in a tunnel, and permanent grout is sprayed on the surface of the permanent protective net; drilling holes are radially and uniformly distributed in the direction perpendicular to the depth direction of the tunnel, one end of each drilling hole is inserted into a tensile sleeve for grouting fixation, and the other end of each drilling hole is fixedly connected with a weldable sleeve joint; in addition, according to the active supporting and protecting method for the invasion limit deformation of the surrounding rock after tunnel excavation and supporting, the reinforcing of the area where the tunnel is prone to collapse is achieved by establishing the permanent active supporting and protecting system. The method converts the passive treatment of the geological disasters of invasion limit and collapse caused by artificial disturbance in the tunnel excavation process into an active support system formed by the tensile sleeve and the steel arch frame connected with the tensile sleeve, has simple structure, convenient construction and high efficiency, and effectively realizes the integral reinforcement stability of the surrounding rock section easy to collapse of the tunnel.
assignees: SHANDONG HI SPEED GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A methods for radiological safety assessment for abnormal scenarios in a radioactive waste disposal facility complex
title_ko: 방사성폐기물 복합처분시설의 비정상 사건에 대한 방사선적 안전성 평가방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radiation safety evaluation method for abnormal events in a complex disposal facility for radioactive waste. A radiation safety evaluation method includes: a radionuclide concentration determination step (S100); a radionuclide leakage amount calculation step (S300); a determination of physical/groundwater change value by earthquake intensity step (S300); a step of calculating an expected exposure dose (S400); and a radiation safety evaluation and result analysis step (S500). Therefore, it is possible to quickly predict radiation effects to determine and operate an appropriate emergency class for a radiation emergency response.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사성폐기물 복합처분시설의 비정상 사건에 대한 방사선적 안전성 평가방법에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 우리나라의 경주 방사성폐기물 처분장 한 부지 내에서 전 세계 최초로 서로 다른 두 처분시설이 운영될 방사성폐기물 복합처분시설에 있어서, 지진 및 폭우와 같은 자연 재해로 인해 방사성폐기물 복합처분시설의 처분시설 설계기준을 초과하는 비정상 사건이 발생하였을 경우 방사선적 영향을 신속하게 예측하여 방사선비상대응을 위한 비상 등급을 결정하는 부지경계에서의 핵종 농도 또는 예상피폭선량을 산정하는 핵심 개념 시나리오를 확립할 수 있도록 하는 것이며, 그 구성은 표층처분시설에 유입된 표층수의 방사성핵종 농도와 불포화대에 유입되는 표층수 양, 포화대에 유입되는 표층수 양과 동굴처분시설을 통과하는 지하수 흐름에  최초 유입되는 시간을 고려한 표층처분시설의 방사성핵종의 동굴처분시설 통과 포화대의 유입량을 결정하는 방사성핵종 농도 결정단계와; 상기 방사성핵종 농도 결정단계에서 결정된 표층처분시설의 방사성핵종의 동굴처분시설 통과 포화대로의 유입량에 의거하여 방사성핵종이 지하 매질을 통과하여 처분시설 부지경계에 농축되는 처분시설경계에서의 방사성핵종 농도를 산출하는 방사성핵종 누출량 산출단계와; 지진의 크기에 따른 처분시설 및 지하매질의 입력자료에 대한 변화값을 결정하고, 지진의 크기에 따른 지하수 변화값을 결정하는 지진강도별 물리적/지하수 변화값 결정단계와; 상기 방사성핵종 농도 산출단계를 통해 산출된 방사성핵종 농도값에 의거하여 방사성핵종에 의한 예상 피폭선량을 산출하는 예상 피폭선량 산출단계와; 상기 지진강도별 물리적/지하수 변화값 결정단계에서 결정된 지진의 크기에 따른 처분시설 및 지하매질의 물리/화학적 변화값 및 지하수 변화값, 상기 방사성핵종 농도 산출단계에서 산출된 처분시설경계에서의 방사성핵종 농도값 및 예상 피폭선량 산출단계에서 산출된 방사성핵종에 의한 예상 피폭선량값을 기설정된 기준값과 각각 비교하여 복합처분시설의 비정상 사건에 대한 방사선적 안전성을 평가하는 방사선적 안전성 평가 및 결과 분석단계로 구성되며; 상기 방사선적 안전성 평가 및 결과 분석단계는 표층처분시설과 동굴처분시설로 구성된 복합처분시설을 대상으로 한 폭우, 지진 등으로 인해 발생된 사건, 방사선원항, 초기 방사성핵종 재고량, 처분시설의 공학적방벽과 지하매질과 같은 천연방벽을 거쳐 생태계로 거치는 방사성핵종의 이동으로 이루어지는 비정상 사건에 따라 처분시스템 변화, 지하수 유로/유속변화 및 핵종 유출량 변화로 구분하여 특성을 평가하고, 그 평가결과에 따라 최종적으로 복합 유출을 통한 방사성핵종의 지하매질 운반 및 생태계 전달로 인해 발생될 수 있는 모델을 설정하고, 설정된 모델에 대한 방사선적 안전성을 분석하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method for providing fire training using augmented reality image
title_ko: 증강현실 이미지를 이용한 소방훈련 제공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a fire drill using augmented reality (AR) images of a fire drill application executed in a learner terminal, which provides a virtual drill for learning operation methods of a fire truck. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps: displaying fire trucks for different uses for vocational training on a screen of a learner terminal; photographing the floor area of a the surrounding space by using a camera module of the learner terminal to display the fire truck selected by the user as an AR image; displaying the selected fire truck as the AR image when a flat land over a predetermined reference area is recognized in the image taken by the camera module; displaying a selectable training method to provide a step-by-step learning method in the selected fire truck; displaying a device used in the learning step of the training method selected by the user in a color distinguished from the surrounding color; when an input corresponding to the operation of each device is received from a user, providing a completion message of the current learning stage and displaying the next learning stage; and when the last learning step of the selected training method is completed, displaying an evaluation table for evaluating performance of the user practicing each learning step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 학습자 단말기에서 실행되는 소방훈련 어플리케이션의 증강현실 이미지를 이용한 소방훈련 제공 방법은, 상기 학습자 단말기의 화면상에 직업 훈련을 위한 서로 다른 용도의 소방차량들을 표시하는 단계와, 사용자에 의해 선택된 소방차량을 증강현실 이미지로 표시하기 위해 상기 학습자 단말기의 카메라 모듈을 이용하여 주변공간의 바닥 영역을 촬영하는 단계와, 상기 카메라 모듈에 의해 촬영된 영상 내 이미지에 일정한 기준 면적 이상의 평지가 인식되는 경우 선택된 소방차량을 증강현실 이미지로 표시하는 단계와, 상기 선택된 소방차량에서 단계적인 학습 방법을 제공하기 위해 선택 가능한 훈련방법을 표시하는 단계와, 상기 사용자에 의해 선택된 훈련방법의 학습단계에서 사용되는 장치를 주변색상과 구분되는 색상으로 표시하는 단계와, 상기 사용자에 의해 각 장치의 조작에 대응되는 입력을 수신받은 경우 현재 학습단계의 완료 메시지를 제공한 후 다음 학습단계를 표시하는 단계와, 선택된 훈련방법의 마지막 학습단계가 완료된 경우 상기 사용자가 각 학습단계를 실습한 성적을 평가한 평가표를 표시한다.

title_en: Experience equipment based on vr simulation public disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vr simulation-based public disaster experience device, which comprises a bottom plate, a controller arranged on the floor, a plurality of lifting rods arranged above the floor, a simulation floor arranged above the lifting rods, and a positioner arranged in the simulation floor, the limiting device for preventing the experiencer from being collided, stepped or falling out of the equipment in the simulation experience is arranged on the outer side of the simulation floor, the effect of preventing the experiencer from being collided, stepped or falling out of the equipment is realized through the limiting device based on the vr simulation public disaster experience equipment, the slope-type protective ring realizes the effect of reminding the experiencer to simulate the edge position of the floor by the touch when the experiencer cannot observe the external environment by wearing the vr glasses so as to prevent the experiencer from going out of the experience range, the effect that collision and experience person step on empty when just avoiding contacting when having realized protecting experience person through elasticity protection network.
assignees: HUNAN GOLDEN EAGLE INT EXHIBITION CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake casualties gathering area assessment method based on unmanned aerial vehicle oblique photography
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earthquake engineering, and particularly relates to an earthquake casualties gathering area assessment method based on unmanned aerial vehicle oblique photography. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle carrying the inclined camera is utilized to collect information of a research area, the geographical position, geological conditions and personnel distribution conditions of the area are combined, earthquake prediction simulation is carried out on buildings of the research area, and casualties are estimated according to the building damage state and basic building information. The casualty hotspots are obtained by performing hotspot analysis on the casualty distribution, so that an casualty aggregation area in the whole area is obtained, and spatial guidance is provided for disaster prevention planning. The invention automatically identifies and extracts the building information and provides technical support for regional building information acquisition. For regional casualties assessment, not only the number of casualties and the spatial distribution caused by a disaster-stricken body are considered, but also a spatial correlation analysis method is introduced to analyze the spatial distribution characteristics of the casualties.

title_en: Three-dimensional simulation method and device in collapse motion process, readable medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geology, in particular to a three-dimensional simulation method and device for a collapse motion process, a readable medium and electronic equipment. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, a slope surface three-dimensional model is constructed through Unity3D, and a collapse disaster scene is constructed; creating a dangerous rock model according to the interpretation result of each dangerous rock in the research area, and performing dangerous rock fine modeling; and setting motion simulation parameters of each rockfall block set, and simulating the collapse motion process of each rockfall block set, so that the collapse motion process of each dangerous rock mass is simulated. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the three-dimensional simulation of the collapse motion process is realized, and the structural characteristics, collision and fragmentation phenomena of the rock mass are considered during simulation.

title_en: Simulation method and related device based on GIS system and model digital modeling
abstract_en: The application discloses a simulation method based on GIS (geographic information system) and model digital modeling and a related device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a mine model through modeling based on digital information stored in a GIS system, wherein the mine model at least comprises a three-dimensional model of a mine, and the three-dimensional model of the mine is used as a preset constraint condition in a simulation process; carrying out digital modeling according to data acquired by sensors of a mine, structural mechanical data of the mine and a three-dimensional model of the mine to obtain a preset simulation model; and inputting data acquired by the sensor of the mine into the preset simulation model to obtain the digital twin mine system. The application solves the technical problem that an effective rescue scheme cannot be obtained in a simulation mode in the current system. The application provides rescue analysis prediction when underground mine disaster occurs based on the digital twin mine system.

title_en: Hydraulic tunnel excavation supporting construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic tunnel excavation supporting construction, including the main pipe canopy, the high one side of tunnel relief is provided with drilling anchor pile along the tunnel extending direction, the entrance to a cave both sides of tunnel are provided with drilling anchor pile, arched direction wall both ends set up on the drilling anchor pile of the entrance to a cave both sides of tunnel, be provided with a plurality of direction steel pipes on the direction wall, the steel flower pipe passes the direction steel pipe setting outside the tunnel excavation profile line, little pipe anchor is established at tunnel arch top, little pipe is the angle of inserting outward of settlement towards tunnel advancing direction and tunnel axis, the end that exposes of little pipe supports on the steel bow member. The utility model discloses need not excavate the relatively poor tunnel section of geological conditions greatly, reduce because of the open cut construction to natural environment's destruction, take place the problem of transversely slumping when solving tunnel side direction massif bias voltage and leading to excavating the tunnel, avoid the emergence of artificial geological disasters, do not influence the production life of other construction operations of tunnel construction area and people.
assignees: CAMCE WHU DESIGN & RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Transfer device of dangerous rock piece
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of geotechnical engineering geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a dangerous rock block transfer device which is fixed on a rock body and comprises a plurality of portal parts and a guiding and transporting part; the portal part consists of two upright posts and a cross beam, the upright posts are arranged in drilled holes formed in a rock body, and the cross beam is fixed on the two upright posts so that a certain space is formed inside the transfer device; the guiding and transporting part consists of a flexible net, a steel wire rope and a bamboo frame plate, and the flexible net is fixed on the door frame part; the steel wire ropes are fixed at four corners of the portal frame part, enter from the portal frame part at the top and extend to the portal frame part at the bottom; the bamboo frame plate is arranged on the flexible net and fixed on the upright posts and the cross beam. The utility model has the channel formed by the flexible net and the bamboo frame plate, and the upright post for fixing the channel, which can absorb most of the impact energy of the rock when transporting the rock, so that the rock is safe and reliable when transporting the rock; and the whole device has simple structure and can be disassembled and reused.
assignees: NANJIANG HYDROLOGY GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING GEOLOGICAL TEAM CHONGQING BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERALS E

title_en: Method for classifying ice-covered micro-topography of power transmission line Louis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for classifying ice-covered microtopography of a power transmission line, which comprises the following steps: collecting regional DEM, a power grid ice area distribution map and regional weather station wind direction observation data; coarse extraction is carried out on the ridge, valley and bealock topography; dividing a threshold according to the TPI index, determining the slope type of the region, and accurately extracting the valley and ridge topography; superposing the extracted valley, ridge, bealock and upgrad topography of the windward slope with the distribution map of the ice region of the power grid, and extracting a topography region in a heavy ice region range of 20mm or more as a micro topography easy to cover ice; extracting the topographic factors of each type of easy-icing topographic region; outputting the micro-terrain type easy to cover ice as a model, taking a terrain factor under the corresponding micro-terrain type as an input layer, performing model training by adopting an XGBoost algorithm, and establishing a micro-terrain classification model general easy to cover ice; the method effectively guides the power transmission line to be covered with ice for inspection in winter and the deployment of anti-icing and deicing facilities, and reduces the risk of ice covering disasters of the power grid.

title_en: Multi-agent scenario planning method under virtual fire scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent path planning method under a virtual fire scene, which comprises the following steps: step 1: establishing a corresponding environment model based on the selected real disaster environment, extracting coordinate information in a scene and generating a three-dimensional scene corresponding to a real scene map; step 2: creating character model skeleton animation, regarding the character model skeleton animation as an intelligent agent, realizing group intelligent agent path planning based on a DQN algorithm, and adjusting a motion path by the intelligent agent according to a corresponding planned path; and step 3: the virtual reality device shows the escape process in an immersive manner, so that the disaster escape exercise effect with low cost and no risk is realized. The invention has the advantages that: the method can simulate various emergency situations after a fire disaster occurs, thereby vividly virtualizing the actions taken by crowds in possible emergency states and providing a brand-new solution for emergency management exercises. Due to the adoption of the computer virtual reality scene mode, the disaster exercise effect with low cost, zero risk, vividness and reliability can be realized.

title_en: Intelligent recognition system for high-consequence region of gas transmission pipeline based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent recognition system for a high-consequence area of a gas transmission pipeline based on edge calculation. The unmanned aerial vehicle cruises along the pipeline from the appointed position at a certain height to take photo by plane, and reduces the height multi-angle shooting ground object information after identifying the high-consequence area. The intelligent system takes unmanned aerial vehicle equipment as a carrier and comprises three deep learning models including ground feature information identification, ground feature region classification and leakage disaster prediction. The unmanned aerial vehicle is fused with a ground gas transmission pipeline sensor to obtain pipeline information, the captured ground feature information is identified by using an airborne Jetson NX and then estimated, and meanwhile, the path dynamic detection towards the periphery is judged through edge calculation by combining an airborne radar Kalman filter. The results are shown on the edge servers. And after the flight is finished and falls, transmitting the data to a cloud server for training an intelligent system model and updating parameters. And after the weight updating is completed, returning the result to the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Mine disaster early warning method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine disaster early warning method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the steps of acquiring initial data in the GIS system; inputting updating data of the GIS system in the process of mine operation into a preset digital twin mine system, wherein the preset digital twin mine system is obtained through modelica digital modeling based on initial data of the GIS system, and the modelica is used for simulating mine disaster based on the preset digital twin mine system; and early warning the possible mine disasters according to the simulation result of the preset digital twin mine system. The technical problem that real-time monitoring and management and control cannot be carried out on mine disaster early warning is solved. Through the application, the safety monitoring and early warning of mine disasters are realized.
assignees: SUZHOU TONGYUAN SOFTWARE & CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide mass identification method based on Laplacian pyramid remote sensing image fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide mass identification method based on Laplacian pyramid remote sensing image fusion, which comprises the following steps: firstly, reconstructing an original remote sensing image by using a Laplacian pyramid fusion module for the extracted local features and global features of the remote sensing image to generate a fusion image; then, a deep learning semantic segmentation model is constructed through a semantic segmentation network; then, respectively marking the place where the landslide disaster happens and the place where the landslide disaster does not happen in the fused image through a picture marking tool to obtain a landslide disaster label picture data set; and finally, training a deep learning semantic segmentation model by using a data set, and storing the model until the loss curve of the model is fitted and the precision of identifying a landslide body in the remote sensing image meets the requirement by modifying the semantic segmentation network structure and adjusting the model parameters. The method is combined with the image fusion model based on the Laplacian pyramid, and effective decision basis can be efficiently and accurately provided for disaster prevention and reduction of landslide disasters.

title_en: Top bracing simulation training device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a top bracing simulation training device, which comprises a base, a first top bracing piece and a second top bracing piece, wherein the base is L-shaped and is provided with a bottom plate and a side plate connected with one end of the top surface of the bottom plate; the first top support is T-shaped and provided with a transverse plate and a vertical plate connected to the bottom surface of the transverse plate, the bottom end of the vertical plate is movably connected to the top surface of the bottom plate through a first connecting piece, and the vertical plate can rotate relative to the bottom plate; the second top supporting piece is in a linear shape and can be movably connected to the top end of the side plate through the second connecting piece, the second top supporting piece can rotate relative to the side plate, and one end of the second top supporting piece can abut against the top surface of the transverse plate. The utility model discloses a shore simulation trainer can simulate disaster back rescue scene to make training personnel can evaluate comprehensively, select the point, stabilize, the operation and equip the operation according to the scene of simulation, thereby promote the ability of trainee through shore the operation implementation rescue comprehensively through the actual combat training mode.
assignees: XINXING JIHUA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Crop disease and pest early warning method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crop disease and pest early warning method, a system, a device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical pest and disease damage information of crops and determining first text content; performing word segmentation processing and semantic analysis on the first text content to obtain a first index data set, and performing feature extraction on the first index data set to obtain a pest and disease damage feature vector; constructing a training data set according to the pest characteristic vector, inputting the training data set into a pre-constructed deep neural network for training to obtain a trained pest prediction model; acquiring meteorological index information and environmental index information of a target area, inputting the meteorological index information and the environmental index information into a pest prediction model, outputting a pest prediction result of the target area, and early warning according to the pest prediction result. The invention reduces the labor cost and the equipment cost, improves the early warning efficiency of plant diseases and insect pests, is convenient for taking corresponding prevention and control measures subsequently, reduces the economic loss, and can be widely applied to the technical field of early warning of crop disasters.
assignees: AIRAG IOT TECH GUANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Urban traffic lifeline construction method and system in extreme stormy weather
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for constructing an urban traffic life line in extreme stormy weather, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out rainstorm waterlogging simulation; removing waterlogging invalid road sections, and carrying out traffic simulation on the reserved effective road network to obtain severely congested road sections; according to the traffic accident data, analyzing black spots of urban road accidents, and obtaining a high-risk road section; combining the results of storm waterlogging simulation, traffic simulation and urban road accident black spot analysis, and identifying an initial traffic life line set; judging whether the traffic life line set meets the expected requirement, if so, outputting the urban traffic life line set in extreme stormwater weather, otherwise, perfecting the water drainage waterlogging prevention facility with the aim of recovering the use function of part of the invalid road sections, and re-identifying the corrected traffic life line set until the corrected traffic life line set meets the requirement. The method and the system are beneficial to identifying and perfecting the life line of the urban traffic and improving the disaster resistance capability of the urban traffic in extreme stormwater weather.

title_en: Subway tunnel train running state disaster coupling simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway tunnel train running state disaster coupling simulation system which comprises a tunnel main body, a train model, a disaster generating system and a test measuring system, wherein the train model is placed on a guide rail at the bottom of the tunnel main body and changes the running speed through a driving device; the disaster occurrence system comprises a fire source and an earthquake simulation device, wherein the fire source is arranged in the train model, the earthquake simulation device comprises a simulation box placed on an earthquake table, a tunnel main body is placed in the simulation box, and a covering soil layer is laid on the upper part of the simulation box; the test testing system comprises a temperature sensor, a gas component analyzer, a flow rate sensor and a pressure sensor. The method is used for simulating by setting parameters such as train running state, earthquake grade and the like, collecting environmental parameters and train running parameters in the tunnel, researching the risk hidden danger under the coupling of fire and earthquake disaster, and providing theoretical and technical support for subway engineering design, train running safety and personnel evacuation.

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network post-earthquake analysis and optimization method based on time delay simulation
abstract_en: A post-earthquake analysis and optimization method for an urban water supply pipe network based on time delay simulation relates to the technical field of safety risk assessment and comprises the following steps: s1: generating a leakage scene after the urban water supply pipe network is shaken: s2: analyzing the water demand space-time characteristics of the urban water consumption node after the earthquake: s3: calculating the delay reliability of the post-earthquake urban water supply node: s4: determining the optimized repair sequence of the damaged pipelines after the earthquake: s5: and (4) optimizing a dispatching model by a post-earthquake pipe network restoration team. The method adopts a Monte Carlo method to simulate a randomly generated earthquake damage scene of the water supply network, determines the time-space change relation of water demand/water consumption of user nodes after the earthquake by combining with the population evacuation rule, analyzes the hydraulic function of the water supply network after the earthquake based on a pressure driving node water distribution model, establishes an optimized model for restoring the functions of the pipe network after the earthquake by considering pipeline repair sequencing and maintenance team dispatching, and determines the restoration strategy of the earthquake damage pipeline in the water supply network.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY;TIANJIN URBAN PLANNING AND DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Cable trench fire monitoring and fire extinguishing simulation device
abstract_en: Cable pit conflagration control and fire extinguishing analogue means for the emergence of conflagration in the cable pit, control and put out a fire and simulate the rehearsal to guide the control of cable in the cable pit and put out a fire. It includes: the bottom of the base is provided with a roller; the fire extinguishing box comprises a box body, a base, a fire extinguishing bomb, a cable, a power supply and a power supply, wherein the box body is arranged at the top of the base, the front wall of the box body is transparent, the left end and the right end of the box body are both open, side doors for sealing are arranged at the left end and the right end of the box body, the top of the box body is provided with the fire extinguishing bomb, and the rear side wall of the box body is provided with the cable; the monitoring unit is arranged at the top of the box body and used for monitoring whether a fire disaster happens in the box body; the ignition unit is arranged in the box body, the ignition unit has the capability of walking along the front-back direction, and an igniter moving up and down is arranged on the ignition unit. The invention can realize the monitoring and fire extinguishing simulation of the cable trench fire, and is beneficial to the research of fire prevention and extinguishment in the cable trench.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI POWER CO LTD CHUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Hyperspectral image classification method based on deep migration learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a hyperspectral image classification method based on deep migration learning, which mainly solves the problem of low classification precision under the condition of small sample training in the prior art, and adopts the following scheme: performing superpixel segmentation on the hyperspectral image by a spatial preprocessing method based on regional clustering to obtain a superpixel block; extracting superpixel block features using a self-encoding network; performing spectral clustering on the characteristics of the super pixel blocks to obtain pseudo labels; training the 3DCNN by using a pseudo label to obtain a pre-training model; constructing a fusion network, transferring the pre-training model parameters into the fusion network, and training the fusion network by using a real label; and classifying the hyperspectral images by using the trained fusion model. The invention adopts an improved hyperspectral pixel clustering mode and a transfer learning method, not only generates a high-quality pseudo label, but also improves the effect of a model after transfer, improves the classification precision of a hyperspectral image, and can be applied to disaster monitoring, geological exploration, urban planning, agriculture and archaeology.

title_en: Migration learning-based polarized SAR time sequence image emergency water body extraction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polarized SAR time sequence image emergency water body extraction method based on transfer learning, which comprises the following steps: filtering the polarized SAR time sequence image; then extracting a representative sample of the image; performing time sequence image mobility evaluation, and dividing a source domain image and a target domain image; then, selecting a sample with a label in a source domain, a sample with high information content in a target domain and a sample without a label in the target domain; labeling the target domain unlabeled samples by using transfer learning, and combining the labeled samples with the high information content samples to obtain a labeled sample set; training a random forest classifier based on the labeled sample set, classifying the images to obtain a water distribution map, and finally combining the water distribution maps of all the images to obtain a time sequence water distribution map. The method can acquire the space-time distribution information of the water body on the earth surface, can obviously reduce the required labor and time cost, and can be used for emergency response of flood disasters.
