assignees: SHENZHEN D & W SPATIAL INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground disaster monitoring and early warning method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a ground disaster monitoring and early warning method, a ground disaster monitoring and early warning device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring monitoring data of a plurality of different sensors arranged on the same side slope; wherein each of the monitoring data comprises rainfall monitoring data and deep displacement monitoring data; inputting each monitoring data into a monitoring model for ground disaster monitoring to obtain all monitoring results; weighting all monitoring results to obtain a final monitoring result; judging whether the final monitoring result is that landslide risk exists or not; if the final monitoring result has a landslide risk, sending an early warning signal to a terminal; the monitoring model is obtained by training a deep forest algorithm by taking monitoring data acquired by a plurality of sensors with landslide type labels and non-landslide type labels as a sample set, and is evaluated by adopting an ROC curve. By implementing the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the accuracy of ground disaster monitoring and early warning can be improved.

title_en: Model simplification-based fire spread simulation acceleration method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for simulating and accelerating fire spreading based on model simplification, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring forest fire point monitoring data and extracting the boundary of a disaster area of the forest fire to obtain the boundary information of the disaster area; determining a speed set of key parameters of a spreading model according to the boundary information of the disaster-stricken area and constructing an initial spreading model; simplifying the initial spreading model to obtain a simplified discrete spreading model; and carrying out dynamic simulation on the disaster area based on the simplified discrete extension model. The system comprises: the system comprises an information extraction module, an initial model construction module, a simplification module and a dynamic simulation module. By using the method and the device, the time for completing dynamic simulation of the disaster area can be reduced under the condition of ensuring the prediction precision. The method and the system for simulating and accelerating fire spreading based on model simplification can be widely applied to the field of geographic information processing.

title_en: Water control box for fireproof rolling shutter door
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water control box for a fireproof rolling door, which comprises a box body, wherein a water supply pipe penetrates through the box body and is fixedly arranged on the inner bottom surface of the box body through a fixing lug, a ball valve is arranged on the water supply pipe, a valve handle is fixedly arranged on the ball valve, a reset assembly for driving the ball valve to recover a closed state is arranged on the left side of the valve handle, and a temperature control release device for controlling the opening of the ball valve through temperature is arranged on the right side of the valve handle. The water supply device is reasonable in structural design, can automatically supply water for the fireproof rolling door when a fire disaster is serious, and can manually start water supply operation under the condition of a lighter fire disaster situation, so that the water supply error situation caused by fire fighting exercises is effectively avoided, meanwhile, the safe and stable water supply for the fireproof rolling door can be effectively realized, in addition, the water supply can be manually closed after the fire disaster situation is over, and the waste of water resources is effectively avoided.
assignees: SHANGHAI GUOYI METAL PRODUCTS CO LTD

title_en: Mountain area natural disasters experiment simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster experiment simulation platforms, in particular to a mountainous area natural disaster experiment simulation platform. A mountainous area natural disaster experiment simulation platform comprises a base, a supporting seat, a pressing plate, a supporting table, a swinging arm, two trigger mechanisms, a trigger seat, a sliding block, a lifting block and a transmission mechanism. Two trigger mechanisms set up respectively in the both sides of supporting seat, and every trigger mechanism includes ejector sleeve, triggers seat and sliding block. The push tube is composed of a supporting part and a friction part, an air channel is arranged in the push tube, and the supporting part is in friction fit with the swing arm along the extending direction of the swing arm through the friction part. The trigger seat is matched with the upper end of the gas path channel in a sliding and sealing manner. The sliding block is configured to move outwards after being lifted by a distance along with the trigger seat, and is disengaged from the pressing plate. The ascending block is matched with the lower end of the gas path channel in a sliding and sealing manner. The transmission mechanism is configured to convert the swing of the swing arm into the upward movement of the lifting block.

title_en: Device and method for simulating transient electromagnetic response of hydraulic fracturing stratum drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for simulating transient electromagnetic response, belongs to the technical field of geophysical exploration physical simulation devices, and particularly relates to a device and a method for simulating transient electromagnetic response of hydraulic fracturing stratum drilling. According to the device and the method, the silica gel cavity is adopted to simulate the fracturing fracture, the simulation result defines the drilling transient electromagnetic detection response characteristics in the hydraulic fracturing fracture stratum with different parameters, and the foundation for evaluating and explaining the drilling transient electromagnetic of the hydraulic fracturing fracture stratum is laid. The method can also be used for establishing a transient electromagnetic interpretation evaluation model of stratum borehole in the fracture zone, and further used for advanced treatment of hard roof disasters and quantitative calculation of gas extraction efficiency.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Demonstration device for simulating house wall vibration damage scene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a demonstration device for simulating house wall vibration damage scene, which comprises a house frame, wherein a crack special effect device, a shaking special effect device and a vibrating special effect device are arranged in the house frame; the crack special effect device comprises a main frame platform mechanism a, a sliding frame platform mechanism and a cylinder transmission mechanism; the special shaking effect device comprises a main frame platform mechanism b, a shaking frame platform mechanism and an electric cylinder transmission mechanism; the special vibrating effect device comprises a main frame platform mechanism c, a vibrating frame platform mechanism and a motor transmission mechanism. Has the advantages that: compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses can more audio-visual show under the earthquake condition, the impaired condition in house improves everybody's the consciousness of taking precautions against earthquakes and reducing disasters, and the utility model has the advantages of volume is controllable, simple structure, the cost is handed over the end.
assignees: ANHUI NEW HORIZON SCIENCE EDUCATION CULTURE CO LTD

title_en: Realistic fire-fighting simulator
title_ko: 실감형 소방훈련 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a realistic fire-fighting simulator which allows a trained person to move a virtual space and perform suppression and response training of virtual fire in complicated and various virtual fire disaster situation in order to provide a training experience similar to real training to a trained person in a virtual contents based fire-fighting. According to one characteristic of the present invention, there is provided a realistic interaction simulator to have the same feeling as real fire-fighting in a virtual fire-fighting when a user wears HMD by providing floor movement possible in a fire disaster situation to trained persons. Feeling possible floor movement similar to a fire disaster situation is provided by reproducing a physical floor movement such as inclination, fall (vertical movement), and shake of a floor as base motion for realistic content experience.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상 콘텐츠 기반 소방훈련에 있어 실제 훈련과 유사한 훈련 경험을 피훈련자에게 주기 위하여 복합적이고 다양한 가상의 화재 재난 상황에서 피훈련자가 가상 공간을 이동하고 가상 화재의 진압 및 대응 훈련이 가능하도록 하는 소방훈련용 가상현실 시뮬레이터에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 한 특징에 따르면, 화재 재난 상황에서 발생 가능한 바닥 움직임을 피훈련자에게 제공하여, HMD를 착용한 가상 소방훈련시 실제 소방 훈련과 동일한 느낌을 갖도록 해 주는 체감형 상호작용 시뮬레이터가 제공된다. 실감 콘텐츠 체험을 위해 바닥의 기울임, 추락(수직이동), 떨림과 같은 물리적인 바닥 움직임을 베이스모션으로 재현하여 화재 재난 상황과 유사한 체감이 가능한 바닥 움직임이 제공된다.

title_en: Mine geological disaster early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine geological disasters early warning device relates to wireless battery charging outfit technical field, and to current geological disasters early warning device when using, owing to often set up a pressure sensor in a drilling, lead to the incompleteness problem of monitoring data, the following scheme is proposed now, and it includes the box, the top fixed mounting of box has the case lid, a plurality of sound holes that are the array setting are seted up to one side of box, the outer wall that the sound hole was kept away from to the box is seted up flutedly, install the humidity monitor in the recess, the model of humidity monitor is BYC10-RHT, the bottom fixed mounting of box has two fixed plates that are the symmetry and set up, two days install the jingle bell device between the fixed plate. The utility model discloses novel structure has solved current geological disaster early warning device when using, owing to often set up a pressure sensor in a drilling, leads to the incomprehensive problem of monitoring data, suitable popularization.
assignees: HUBEI GEOLOGICAL & MINING EXPLOR CO LTD

title_en: Automatic reset bolt device used on earthquake demonstration device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic reset bolt device used on an earthquake demonstration device, which comprises an electromagnet assembly and a bolt assembly, wherein the bolt assembly comprises a limiting assembly, a bolt is arranged in the cavity of the limiting assembly, and the bolt penetrates through the cavity of the limiting assembly; a handle ball is arranged at one end of the bolt far away from the electromagnet assembly; the bolt is provided with a reset assembly, and the reset assembly is arranged in the cavity of the limiting assembly; the limiting assembly is further provided with a cover plate, a proximity switch sensor is fixed on the cover plate and used for sensing a signal when the end face of the bolt is in magnetic end face contact with the electromagnet. Has the advantages that: compared with the prior art, the utility model can lead the object which is easy to collapse in the earthquake demonstration device to be adsorbed on the object with stronger firmness when the earthquake is simulated, and can automatically reset after the demonstration is finished, thereby being convenient for the next visitor to use; and popularizing earthquake knowledge for visitors and enhancing the consciousness of quakeproof and disaster reduction of visitors.
assignees: ANHUI NEW HORIZON SCIENCE EDUCATION CULTURE CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for simulating response plans against nbc hazards and recording medium thereof
title_ko: 화생방 재난 대응 시뮬레이션 방법, 장치 및 기록 매체
abstract_en: One embodiment relates to a simulation method and a simulation device for a CBR emergency response and a recording medium thereof. According to one embodiment, the simulation method for a CBR emergency response comprises the steps of: receiving an input of a scenario including a CBR emergency; executing a simulation based on the input scenario; calculating, when the CBR emergency occurs during the execution of the simulation, a contamination area and contamination concentration distribution caused by the CBR emergency using a governing equation; determining whether an object is contaminated using the calculated contamination area and contamination concentration distribution; and determining, when it is determined that the object is contaminated, whether the contaminated object is neutralized. Accordingly, the present invention has the effect of providing an analysis tool for establishment of effective countermeasures.
abstract_ko: 실시예는 화생방 재난 대응 시뮬레이션 방법, 장치 및 기록 매체에 관한 것으로서, 실시예에 따른 화생방 재난 대응 시뮬레이션 방법은, 화생방 재난을 포함한 시나리오가 입력되는 단계, 상기 입력된 시나리오를 기초로 하여 시뮬레이션을 실행하는 단계, 상기 시뮬레이션의 실행 중에 상기 화생방 재난이 발생한 경우, 상기 화생방 재난에 의한, 오염 영역 및 오염 농도 분포를 지배방정식을 이용하여 산출하는 단계, 상기 산출된, 오염 영역 및 오염 농도 분포를 이용하여, 개체가 오염되었는지 판정하는 단계, 그리고 상기 개체가 오염된 것으로 판정된 경우, 상기 오염된 개체가 무력화되었는지 판단하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Inflatable airbag
abstract_en: The invention relates to an inflatable airbag aimed at restraining impacts from falling bodies, finding application as an inflatable equipment for outdoor or indoor sports, entertainment and training purposes, rescue operations from heights, for individual or collective use.According to present invention the inflatable airbag (1) is equipped with at least one main inflatable chamber (2) with at least one air inlet (2.6) and outlet (2.6), air pressure regulation valve (2.7) and plurarality many perpendicularly fixed inflatable shock absorbing chambers (3), connected in their base to the inflatable main chamber (2), and with at least one protective cover (4). positioned above the shock absorbing air chambers (3), where the shock absorbing chambers (3) have a height of 70-95% of the height of the main chamber (2) and are opened in their base and fixed to the face side of the connecting base - "skirt" (3.3) with a centrally positioned air opening (3.1) with a diameter from 10cm to 25 cm, joined by a movable or fixed fastening between its back and the surface of the main air chamber (2), so that the distance between the shock absorbing chambers (3) is not less than 1cm and not more than 15 cm, and the protective cover (4) is fastened by movable or fixed side parts (5) and/or side skirts (6), connected between themselves by angle connections (5.1) and (6.1), respectively, and is fastened to the main air chamber (2) by an elastic connection.The inflatable airbag developed under this invention has a robust, effective and optimized construction which provides a high absorption level of the falling body energy and a high level of safety. The accurate selection of the elements, their dimensions and material provide a maximum protection from wearing of the inflatable airbag construction and warrant its high level of strength, efficacy and safety during use.The inflatable airbag according to this invention finds application in the construction of facilities for indoor and outdoor sports, entertainment and training activities, including water and any air sports, for security measures during accidents, including rescue and firefighting activities etc.

title_en: Self-drilling type reinforcing system and self-drilling type reinforcing method for soft soil layer
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a self-drilling type reinforcing system and a self-drilling type reinforcing method for a soft soil layer, which relate to the technical field of soil layer drilling and reinforcing, the self-drilling type reinforcing system comprises a main cylinder arranged in a hole on an inclined plane of a side slope of the soft soil layer, an auxiliary cylinder entering the main cylinder through a push rod and a cement mortar layer filled between the inner wall and the outer wall of the main cylinder and between the inner wall and the outer wall of the auxiliary cylinder, wherein the push rod transmits impact force to the auxiliary cylinder along the axial direction of the main cylinder along with the impact force applied to the push rod, a plurality of hollow support legs of the auxiliary cylinder move towards movable openings corresponding to the auxiliary cylinder and radially expand around the main cylinder until the auxiliary cylinder completely drills into the side slope of the soft soil layer, so that the plurality of hollow support legs and the main cylinder of the auxiliary cylinder can apply anchoring force as a root system structure to the side slope of the soft soil layer, and can strengthen the reinforcing effect to the side slope of the soft soil layer under the condition of reducing the number of unit holes, the probability of geological disasters on the side slope of the soft soil layer is reduced.

title_en: Flood disaster risk distribution map drawing method and device based on real-time data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for drawing a flood disaster risk distribution map based on real-time data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data information of an area to be drawn; calculating the rainfall average value of at least one drainage basin of the area to be drawn based on the real-time rainfall data, and judging whether the rainfall average value of at least one drainage basin is larger than a risk threshold value or not; if the average rainfall value of at least one drainage basin is larger than a risk threshold value, cutting the elevation data and the real-time rainfall data corresponding to the at least one drainage basin; inputting elevation data and real-time rainfall data corresponding to at least one drainage basin into a preset cellular automata model to generate submerged water depth data; and rendering a flood risk distribution map of the area to be mapped according to the submerging water depth data. By cutting, a large area can be cut into a plurality of small areas, risk areas are screened out through a threshold value, and then risk area data are led into a cellular automaton to simulate a flood submerging process, so that the calculated amount of a model is greatly reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for preventing and treating rock burst of circular arc section of fully mechanized caving face of steeply inclined coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing and treating rock burst of a circular arc section of a fully mechanized caving face of a steeply inclined coal seam, which specifically comprises the following steps: n top coal blasting drill holes located at the right arc section of the working face lower roadway and n top plate blasting drill holes located on the left side of the lower roadway are arranged on the inclined plane of the lower roadway; determining parameters of top coal blasting drill holes at the arc sections of the lower level tunnel and parameters of top plate blasting drill holes at the left side of the lower level tunnel, determining parameters of blasting drill holes of two sides of the tunnel in the direction of the trend, wherein the right side of the tunnel adopts top coal blasting drill holes and is arranged along the direction of the tunnel, and the left side of the tunnel adopts top plate blasting drill holes; the method for preventing and treating the rock burst of the circular arc section of the fully mechanized caving face of the steeply inclined coal seam has pertinence and practicability, effectively reduces stress concentration static load of a lower gallery coal body, protects a roadway, avoids rock burst disasters, and solves the problem that the clamping stress of the lower gallery coal rock body is too high when the circular arc section of the fully mechanized caving face of the steeply inclined coal seam is mined.

title_en: Emergency evacuation guiding method and device in building
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency evacuation guiding method and device in a building, which comprises the steps that after environmental danger information, crowding degree information and the number of people of key area points of each key area are collected and gathered by a network, an evacuation guiding decision artificial intelligent model is sent to a cloud, decision instructions of the optimal evacuation directions of all key area points are calculated and sent back to the network; and the network issues a corresponding decision instruction to the edge side Internet of things intelligent device group of each key area point. The invention discloses an intelligent emergency evacuation guiding method in a large building based on computer dynamic simulation and a deep neural network, and provides a device for acquiring multi-dimensional environment information and feeding back an optimal evacuation direction by using intelligent Internet of things hardware, so as to solve the problem of intelligent and dynamic emergency evacuation of people in a large public building.

title_en: Deepwater semi-submersible platform mooring tieback installation operation simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deepwater semi-submersible platform mooring tieback installation operation simulation platform, which comprises a comprehensive management and evaluation system, an ROV simulator, a ship dynamic positioning simulator, a visual simulation system, an immersive projection system, a ship semi-physical simulation console, a universal crane seat, a winch simulation system, a mooring dynamics simulation model and a marine environment simulation model. The invention can be used for skill training of operators, improves the operation level and emergency response capability of offshore operators, reduces the skill training cost of operators, can also perform risk analysis through the simulation effect, improves the safety of the operation, and reduces the duration and cost of offshore operation.

title_en: Intelligent photosensitive broadcasting system for intelligent scene type public weather fusion media
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scene type public weather fusion media intelligent photosensitive broadcasting system. The system comprises a sensor unit, a data acquisition unit and a data processing unit, wherein the sensor unit is used for acquiring various meteorological data; the meteorological data server receives various meteorological data sent by the data acquisition controller, analyzes the meteorological data to obtain a meteorological analysis result and sends the meteorological analysis result, and the computer converts the meteorological analysis result into a brightening control instruction; and the brightening drive control module controls the scene type fusion media to be illuminated and played and displays the meteorological analysis result and the popular science propaganda content according to the brightening control instruction. The invention broadcasts the weather live in a real-time dynamic form, performs weather early warning in a three-dimensional simulation form, and performs healthy weather popular science propaganda in an animation form; meanwhile, the system is a weather radar special weather fusion media public weather brightening and broadcasting system, and carries out urban weather multi-disaster comprehensive early warning in the form of sound, light, electricity and animation, so that the aims of popularizing disaster prevention and reduction science popularization knowledge and simultaneously publicizing urban impression are fulfilled.
assignees: NANJING XINDA RUIXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid foreign matter detection method and device based on satellite image deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid foreign matter detection method and device based on satellite image deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring satellite images of a power transmission corridor and/or a transformer substation and peripheral areas thereof; marking foreign matters in the satellite image to generate a marked sample set; dividing the marked samples in the marked sample set to generate a training set and a test set; inputting the training set into a machine learning training model for training; and inputting the satellite image to be detected into the trained training model, and sending early warning information if a foreign body is detected. The method comprises the following steps: the system comprises an acquisition module, a marking module, a dividing module, a training module and an early warning module. The method and the system can find the potential risk of the foreign matters possibly existing in the power grid in time, improve the efficiency of power grid operation and maintenance personnel, perform defense and treatment on corresponding disasters in time, and reduce economic loss caused by untimely hidden trouble investigation.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: High polymer miniature pile rapid forming device under emergency rescue and disaster relief conditions
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering pile foundation and landslide are administered. The device comprises a pile foundation outer sleeve, an anti-slide pile die and a limiting locking unit, wherein the anti-slide pile die is arranged in the pile foundation outer sleeve in a matching manner, a drill bit is arranged at the lower end of the anti-slide pile die, and a grouting hole is formed in the middle of the anti-slide pile die; the limiting locking unit is used for enabling the pile foundation outer sleeve to be relatively fixed with the anti-slide pile mould in the sinking process, and the anti-slide pile mould can be pulled out upwards and freely relative to the pile foundation outer sleeve. The miniature slide-resistant pile retaining structure can be used for emergency reinforcement of the side slope under emergency rescue and disaster relief conditions, is high in forming speed, free of water reaction, economical, durable and convenient in process, and can resist adverse geological influence and reinforce the side slope.

title_en: Method and system for simulating landslide process of seabed
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for simulating a landslide process of a sea bottom, which comprises the following steps: constructing a landslide body particle model after grid-free discretization of a seabed landslide body simulation area, and initializing physical and mechanical parameter values of landslide body particles; constructing a tight branch domain of adjacent particles of the slip mass particles, traversing the slip mass particles in the tight branch domain of the adjacent particles in each time step to obtain a relative motion state among the slip mass particles and a stress tensor state of the slip mass particles, judging a critical state of the slip mass particles according to the relative motion state and selecting a corresponding constitutive equation; and obtaining a prediction-correction cycle result of the solid-liquid boundary density and the pressure according to the constitutive equation, obtaining the density change rate, the stress change rate and the momentum change rate of the landslide body particles, updating the physical and mechanical parameter values of the landslide body particles according to the prediction-correction cycle result, and realizing effective simulation of the sliding and accumulation catastrophe process of the landslide body after the submarine landslide disaster occurs within a set time step.

title_en: SPH simulation display method and system for whole disaster evolution process of submarine landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SPH simulation display method and system for the whole disaster evolution process of a submarine landslide, comprising the following steps: dispersing the calculation areas of the submarine slope body and the seawater into particles with set quantity and different physical state attributes, and endowing the particles with corresponding physical and mechanical parameters; a slip-free boundary layer which is used for combining the repulsive particles and the virtual particles is arranged outside the boundary; applying the gravity and periodic wave action of the infinitely covered seawater to the seawater particles, converting Liu Po acting force and construction acting force applied to the slope body into stress boundary conditions of a slope body particle calculation area, applying the boundary particles consisting of repulsive particles and virtual particles, and simultaneously applying displacement boundary conditions; in each calculation time step, determining the catastrophe evolution stage of the submarine slope, selecting a system constitutive equation set corresponding to the catastrophe evolution stage, and performing calculation and solution in a single time step to finish the updating of the particle physical and mechanical information of a solution domain; and displaying the particle physical and mechanical information of the set time step.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning and state monitoring device and method based on 5G edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire disaster early warning and state monitoring device based on 5G edge calculation. The invention also discloses a monitoring method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining data; data preprocessing: performing outlier and missing value processing, pearson related judgment and normalization processing on the data; dividing thermal imaging data in a traditional intelligent cloud cabinet into a training set, a testing set and a verification set; constructing a multivariable input LSTM neural network model: substituting the verification set data into the model to predict; a true value-predicted value-graph is generated. The monitoring device can quickly receive the alarm prompt when the element parameters are abnormal or faults occur, improve the operation and maintenance efficiency and reduce the distribution network fault rate. The monitoring method can realize the on-line monitoring and prediction of the electrical fire, and greatly reduce the hidden trouble of the electrical fire.

title_en: Disaster monitoring and early warning method for extra-high voltage intensive power transmission channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster monitoring and early warning method for an extra-high voltage intensive power transmission channel, which comprises the following steps: step S1: obtaining multisource remote sensing image data of landform, terrain, roads, buildings and power transmission channels in a certain area through a Beidou satellite and an interference radar; step S2: unifying the multi-source image data to the same coordinate system for spatial registration; step S3: and performing information fusion on the multi-source remote sensing image data after spatial registration, and constructing a three-dimensional visual model of the power transmission line in a certain area by applying AI image recognition, artificial intelligence and refined modeling technologies. Step S4: establishing and training a disaster early warning model according to surface data and historical disaster data; step S5: and performing deformation analysis and suspected disaster point identification on the ground surface area. Based on multi-source data images such as Beidou and interference radar, disaster monitoring of the extra-high voltage intensive power transmission channel is carried out, and the safe operation level of a large power grid is improved through surface area deformation analysis and suspected disaster point identification.
assignees: HUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Secondary hole sealing method for underground coal mine gas drainage borehole
abstract_en: The invention discloses a secondary hole sealing method for underground coal mine gas drainage drilling holes, which comprises the following steps: (1) Adopting a bag type grouting hole packer and a two-plug one-injection hole sealing process to implement first hole sealing and continuous pumping; (2) Selecting a low-concentration gas extraction drill hole from the gas extraction drill hole during gas extraction, and disconnecting a connected gas extraction pipeline; (3) The sealed steel pipe is inserted into the first hole sealing pipe after being connected with the compressed air spinning drill bit, a high-pressure air supply pipeline is connected, and coal cinder in the hole sealing pipe and the drilled hole is cleaned by utilizing the wind pressure spinning drill bit and the high-pressure air blowing; (4) Withdrawing the sealed steel pipe, and plugging a second hole sealing device into the first hole sealing pipe to a designed position; (5) Grouting the secondary hole sealing device to implement secondary hole sealing; (6) And connecting the hole sealing pipe of the second hole sealing device into a gas extraction pipeline for gas extraction. The invention has low engineering cost and relatively simple process, fully improves the drainage efficiency, shortens the drainage time and eliminates the gas disasters to the maximum extent.

title_en: Railway engineering facility rainstorm flood dynamic risk map analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic risk map analysis method for rainstorm and flood of railway engineering facilities, which comprises the steps of quantifying the relative destructive power of flood mainly, researching an evaluation method for flood disaster risk, carrying out comparison statistical analysis on measured values obtained after weighted averaging of rainfall forecast value fields in a weather forecast grid to evaluate the weather forecast accuracy, determining the range of critical rainfall, selecting a proper hydrological model, optimizing and calibrating model parameters by using the rainstorm and flood data of a field, substituting the calibrated parameters into the hydrological model as initial parameters, carrying out calculation to obtain the comparison between the critical rainfall and the critical flow, and distributing early warning levels. According to the method, dynamic flood parameters are input, so that analysis of a flood dynamic evolution process is realized, and the limitation of adopting single static water level simulation in the past is solved; when a disaster occurs, the real-time rainfall information is combined to simulate and predict the flood evolution process, and the flood disaster prediction can be realized.
assignees: BEIJING SEVEN TRILLION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for acquiring simulation result of comprehensive disaster event
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for acquiring a simulation result of a comprehensive disaster event, which comprises the following steps: extracting an internal event identifier and an external event identifier, comparing the internal event identifier with the external event identifier, and identifying the event which is not contained in the internal event identifier and contained in the external event identifier as an external contained event; and using all the external inclusion events and the corresponding occurrence time in the disaster event simulation results of the external disaster event model to form a comprehensive disaster event simulation result. According to the invention, a comprehensive disaster event simulation result is obtained from the internal event model and the external event model, so that the system can calculate the risk loss based on the comprehensive disaster event simulation result, and the business loss result calculated based on the internal model and the external model can be subjected to loss accumulation by adopting a unified risk view.

title_en: Fire detection and identification method, system and fire alarm method based on SSD deep learning network
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire detection and identification method, a fire detection and identification system and a fire alarm method based on an SSD deep learning network, which support multi-type scene training, realize multi-type coverage detection, ensure that the coverage type of a fire hazard identification type is wide enough, improve the traditional channel attention mechanism, adopt an SS-Block attention mechanism, realize the weight from the characteristics, ensure that the effect of the attention mechanism is better, and better promote the performance of the network, improve the traditional connecting network, only receive data of a few layers nearby, ensure that useless parts in a characteristic diagram are not recycled, improve the network performance and reduce the calculation amount. Unlike the sensor which needs to be arranged near the fire disaster area, the fire disaster warning method needs a large number of sensors to realize the early warning and monitoring of large fire disaster, and one camera can cover a large area.

title_en: Method for automatically identifying combustible substances of surface fire model based on field pictures
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for automatically identifying combustibles of a surface fire model based on field pictures. The method comprises the following steps: combustible classification model generation, combustible automatic classification and combustible region map generation. And training a convolutional neural network by inputting the collected data and the marked combustible data to generate a combustible classification model. And classifying different combustible data by the model, outputting corresponding combustible class probability maps, performing color marking and region merging on different combustible classes to generate a complete surface combustible class region map, and overlapping the complete surface combustible class region map with a real surface image to obtain a surface real combustible class region image. The method can realize real-time automatic and intelligent ground surface combustible classification, and can help forest fire experts to quickly predict forest fire spreading time and firing areas when forest fires occur, so that isolation zones are quickly classified when the forest fires occur, evacuation work of surrounding people is well done, and great economic significance and social value are achieved.

title_en: Crowd emergency detection and evacuation method and system based on hydrodynamics
abstract_en: The invention provides a crowd emergency detection and evacuation method and system based on hydrodynamics, belonging to the technical field of crowd evacuation computer simulation, wherein a scene is taken as a whole from the perspective of video monitoring, a particle representation method is introduced to describe crowd flow, the particle flow motion is tracked by adopting a pulse line flow idea based on hydrodynamics, effective clustering characteristics are extracted from the obtained pulse line flow trajectory of a crowd moving target to describe the clustering characteristics of the moving target in the scene, and whether the crowd emergency occurs in the scene is judged according to the characteristic, so that the detection problem under high-density crowds is solved; meanwhile, similarity clustering is continuously carried out on the obtained pulse stream trajectories, and analysis processing is carried out on the clustered team, so that reasonable and effective evacuation of high-density crowds is realized, and the purposes of researching and processing crowd sudden event detection and crowd evacuation problems while applying the pulse stream idea are achieved.

title_en: Self-drilling type side pressure simulation test device and method for natural gas hydrate-containing stratum
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-drilling type side pressure simulation test device and method for a natural gas hydrate-containing stratum, and belongs to the technical field of rock-soil mechanics. The device comprises a reaction kettle, a cutting tool, a mud conveying mechanism and a side pressure testing device, wherein the reaction kettle is used for being filled with a formation simulation substance containing the natural gas hydrate to be tested, the cutting tool is arranged in the reaction kettle and can move up and down relative to the reaction kettle, one end of the mud conveying mechanism is communicated with the reaction kettle and is used for outputting mud obtained by cutting through the cutting tool from the reaction kettle; the side pressure testing device can move to a set depth along with the cutting tool to complete a side pressure testing experiment. The method is realized based on the device. The in-situ test method can be used for directly testing the engineering mechanical parameters of the natural gas hydrate-containing stratum, and has important significance for the stability of the natural gas hydrate-developed stratum and the prevention and treatment of engineering disasters.

title_en: Steel cable prestress loss test device and method in fire
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building structure disaster prevention and reduction, and particularly relates to a steel cable prestress loss test device and a method thereof in a fire disaster, wherein the test device comprises a reaction frame, two cooling devices, a prestress applying device, a test furnace and a data acquisition control system; the reaction frame comprises two cross beams arranged oppositely and two longitudinal beams arranged oppositely; the two cooling devices are respectively arranged on one side of the two cross beams far away from the middle part of the reaction frame; the prestress applying device is arranged on one side of the two cross beams facing to the external environment; reaction frames are arranged around the top of the test furnace; the data acquisition control system comprises a data acquisition system and a control system, and the data acquisition system acquires the force of the prestress applying device and the temperature data in the test furnace; the control system controls the prestress applying device and the test furnace. The invention can simulate the prestress change rule of the steel cable in the whole process of actual fire heating and cooling, further guide the fire-resistant design of the cable supporting structure according to the test data, and improve the fire-resistant safety performance of the structure.

title_en: Flood control and flood fighting practicing method and visual interface thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood control and flood fighting drilling method and a visual interface thereof. The technical scheme adopted by the invention is as follows: a flood control and flood fighting drilling method is characterized by comprising the following steps: acquiring a live-action map of a drilling area, and a water surface line submerging range, an evacuation point, identity information of people to be evacuated, position information of the people to be evacuated and a house range corresponding to the people to be evacuated which are planned in advance; acquiring rescue worker position information in real time; matching the nearest rescue personnel for the personnel to be evacuated based on the position information of the rescue personnel and the position information of the personnel to be evacuated, and sending the identity information and the position information of the personnel to be evacuated and corresponding rescue paths and evacuation routes to the matched rescue personnel; and acquiring the identity information of the people to be evacuated acquired by the registration equipment of the evacuation point, and marking the corresponding people to be evacuated as evacuated.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;ZHEJIANG HUADONG ENGINEERING CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT CO LTD

title_en: Natural disaster emergency simulation drill command system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a natural disasters emergency simulation rehearsal command system, including the inner panel, the downside left end surface mounting of inner panel has the slide rail, and the inside of slide rail is provided with the slider, and the slide rail passes through slider and cardboard interconnect, the lower extreme at the slider is fixed to the cardboard, and the inboard of cardboard and the left side outside interconnect of camera, the lower extreme right side of inner panel is provided with the montant, and the internally mounted of montant has the bull stick, the left end top of movable block is connected with the flat board, and dull and stereotyped upside surface is provided with the layer board, and the inboard of layer board and the right-hand member outside interconnect of camera, the spout has been seted up to the upper end inboard of inner panel, and the inner panel passes through the lower extreme interconnect of spout and baffle, the upper end top inboard of baffle is connected with the stretch cord, and the middle part of stretch-through of stretch cord has the fixed block. This emergent simulation rehearsal command system of natural disasters makes the device can record the result of playing, makes things convenient for operating personnel's observation to the device is easy to assemble dismantlement.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCE COAL MINE DESIGN INST

title_en: Electronic device to verify the disaster spread prediction model
title_ko: 재난 확산 예측 모델을 검증하기 위한 전자 장치
abstract_en: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device includes a virtual disaster spread model simulator, a disaster spread prediction model simulator, a processor and a memory operatively connected with the processor. The memory stores instructions which, when executed, cause the processor to: instruct the virtual disaster spread model simulator to perform a virtual disaster spread simulation for an entire performance time, while instructing the disaster spread prediction model simulator to perform a disaster spread prediction simulation for the entire performance time; receive first result data from the virtual disaster spread model simulator after the completion of a first step time section which is a partial time section of the entire performance time; receive second result data from the disaster spread prediction model simulator after the completion of the first step time section; and compare the second result data based on the first result data. Besides, various embodiments identified through the present specification can be possible. Therefore, the present invention is capable of increasing the reliability of a result of verifying a disaster spread prediction model.
abstract_ko: 전자 장치가 개시된다. 전자 장치는, 가상 재난 확산 모델 시뮬레이터, 재난 확산 예측 모델 시뮬레이터, 프로세서 및 프로세서에 작동적으로(operatively) 연결된 메모리를 포함하고, 메모리는, 실행되었을 때 프로세서로 하여금, 가상 재난 확산 모델 시뮬레이터가 전체 수행 시간 동안 가상 재난 확산 시뮬레이션을 수행하도록 하고, 가상 재난 확산 시뮬레이션과 동시에, 재난 확산 예측 모델 시뮬레이터가 전체 수행 시간 동안 재난 확산 예측 시뮬레이션을 수행하도록 하고, 전체 수행 시간의 일부 시간 구간인 제1 스텝 시간 구간이 완료된 후, 가상 재난 확산 모델 시뮬레이터로부터 제1 결과 데이터를 수신하고, 제1 스텝 시간 구간이 완료된 후, 재난 확산 예측 모델 시뮬레이터로부터 제2 결과 데이터를 수신하고, 제1 결과 데이터에 기반하여, 제2 결과 데이터를 비교하도록 하는 인스트럭션들(instructions)을 저장한다. 이 외에도 명세서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시 예가 가능하다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Serious game system for disaster response education and training
title_ko: 재난대응 교육훈련을 위한 시리어스게임 시스템
abstract_en: A serious game system for disaster response education and training includes: a plurality of responsible clients which provides an interface for sequentially inputting response tasks for each case of each person in charge of each department in charge according to disaster type and collaboration, and a training application which virtually processes the response tasks according to input is installed; and a server which automatically lists chain events which develop over time in an event of a disaster and provides game environment data suitable for the size and difficulty of the overall disaster to the plurality of clients in charge.
abstract_ko: 재난대응 교육훈련을 위한 시리어스게임 시스템은 재난유형과 협업에 따른 담당부서 각 담당자의 사건별 대응업무를 각각 순차적으로 입력할 수 있는 인터페이스를 제공하고 입력에 따른 대응업무를 가상적으로 처리하는 훈련 애플리케이션이 설치되는 복수의 담당자 클라이언트와, 재난 발생시 시간의 흐름에 따라 전개되는 연쇄 사건들을 자동으로 나열하고 전체적인 재난의 피해 규모와 난이도에 맞는 게임환경 데이터를 복수의 담당자 클라이언트에 제공하는 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method of deciding afire-fighting position using construction design information and server performing the same
title_ko: 건축 설계 정보를 이용한 소방 설비 위치 결정 방법 및 이를 실행하는 서버
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of determining the position of a fire-fighting facility using architectural design information and a server performing the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the server for determining the position of the fire-fighting facility using architectural design information comprises: a virtual simulation unit using a design drawing among the architectural design information, generating a virtual simulation space, and randomly placing the fire-fighting facility in the virtual simulation space; a static environmental element generation unit using the architectural design information, and generating a static environmental element applied to the virtual simulation space with the fire-fighting facility; a dynamic environmental element generation unit using the architectural design information, and generating a dynamic environmental element applied to the virtual simulation space with the fire-fighting facility; a fire-fighting facility score calculation unit generating a fire at a specific position of the virtual simulation space by the virtual simulation unit, and monitoring the operation process of the fire-fighting facility placed in the virtual simulation space, and calculating an appropriateness score for each position of the fire-fighting facility; and a fire-fighting facility position determination unit which, when the appropriateness score for each position of the fire-fighting facility is calculated by the fire-fighting facility score calculation unit, determines the position falling under the highest score based on the appropriateness score for each position of the fire-fighting facility as the position of the relevant fire-fighting facility. The present invention aims to provide a method of determining the position of a fire-fighting facility using architectural design information and a server performing the same, which are capable of determining the optimal position for the fire-fighting facility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 건축 설계 정보를 이용한 소방 설비 위치 결정 서버는 건축 설계 정보 중 설계 도면을 이용하여 가상 시뮬레이션 공간을 생성한 후 상기 가상 시뮬레이션 공간 상에 소방 설비를 임의적으로 배치하는 가상 시뮬레이션부, 상기 건축 설계 정보를 이용하여 상기 소방 설비가 배치된 가상 시뮬레이션 공간에 적용되는 정적 환경 요소를 생성하는 정적 환경 요소 생성부, 상기 건축 설계 정보를 이용하여 상기 소방 설비가 배치된 가상 시뮬레이션 공간에 적용되는 동적 환경 요소를 생성하는 동적 환경 요소 생성부, 상기 가상 시뮬레이션부에 의해 가상 시뮬레이션 공간의 특정 위치에 화재를 발생된 후 가상 시뮬레이션 공간 상에 배치된 소방 설비의 동작 과정을 모니터링하여 소방 설비의 위치 별 적합 점수를 산출하는 소방 설비 점수 산출부 및 상기 소방 설비 점수 산출부에 의해 소방 설비의 위치 별 적합 점수가 산출되면, 소방 설비의 위치 별 적합 점수를 기초로 가장 높은 점수에 해당하는 위치를 해당 소방 설비의 위치로 결정하는 소방 설비 위치 결정부를 포함한다.

title_en: Disaster training device and disaster training method
title_ko: 구급대응 도상훈련장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency responding map-based training device in order to effectively respond to various disaster situations, and especially, relates to an emergency responding map-based training device which inputs information on identification information bodies, respectively attached to the inside of a rescuer model in a management terminal and input with identification number information, and rescuer state information in a storage server; stores rescuing activity information such as rescuer classification, first aid, and transport statuses successively in the storage server according to the identification information body information and the rescuer state information; and enables a manager server to access the storage server to evaluate a series of rescuing activity information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각종 재난 상황을 효과적으로 대응하기 위한 구급대응 도상훈련장치에 관한 것으로, 특히 관리자단말기에서 구조자 모형의 내부에 각각 부착되어 식별번호정보가 입력된 식별정보체 정보와 구조자의 상태정보를 저장서버에 입력한 후 저장서버에 입력된 식별정보체 정보와 구조자의 상태정보에 따라 구조자의 분류, 응급처치 및 이송현황 등의 구급활동정보를 순차적으로 저장서버에 저장하여 관리자서버가 저장서버에 접속함으로써, 일련의 구급활동정보를 평가할 수 있는 구급대응 도상훈련장치에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KNL CO LTD;KIM YOUNG JIN;BANG SUNG HWAN;PACK HO JIN

title_en: Disaster simulation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a disaster simulation technical field, in particular to disaster simulation system, including disaster simulation cabin, be provided with the hatch door on the disaster simulation cabin, still include functional module and with the PLC control system that the functional module electricity is connected, PLC control system is connected with data switch, data switch is connected with touch-sensitive screen and computer. The utility model discloses a touch-sensitive screen and computer control input the data switch with the instruction, then give PLC control system, and PLC control system control function module work, the condition at various disasters scene can be simulated to each functional module to can realize the simulation at multiple disasters scene, whole process automation degree is high, alleviates scientific research worker's intensity of labour.

title_en: Coal mine search and rescue robot based on machine vision and motion control
abstract_en: A coal mine search and rescue robot based on machine vision and motion control comprises the following steps that 1, environmental data of the coal mine search and rescue robot are collected; step 2, training a detection model of the people in distress in the mine; step 3, designing a motion control system of the coal mine search and rescue robot: step 4, designing a primary navigation system of the coal mine search and rescue robot; and 5, processing and storing the data, wherein under the actual condition of mine disaster, the communication line is completely destroyed or partially paralyzed, and the communication cannot be used, so that the relevant data collected by the search and rescue robot is packaged by certain grouping, written into the SD card storage module according to the SPI communication protocol and used as the data support of return voyage. The design of the invention enables underground data to be acquired by the robot deep field detection, which is beneficial to the planning and commanding of field rescue, ensures the survival rate of trapped people and reduces unnecessary loss and disasters.

title_en: Community earthquake emergency evacuation space optimization design method based on behavior simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a behavior simulation-based community earthquake emergency evacuation space optimization design method, which comprises the following steps of: s1: constructing a virtual environment analysis model reflecting the real high-density community; s2: establishing an emergency evacuation space analysis model of the post-earthquake high-density community; s3: constructing an emergency evacuation simulation model of the post-earthquake high-density community personnel; s4: optimizing and integrating the layout of the space of the community emergency shelter; s5: establishing a satisfaction degree coverage model of the emergency refuge time of the high-density community; s6: and respectively simulating the dynamic process of emergency evacuation after earthquake of community personnel under the situation of unorganization and organization in the high-density community space, and comparing and verifying the scientificity of division of the responsibility area of the organization evacuation service. The behavior simulation-based community earthquake emergency evacuation space optimization design method can be used for researching emergency evacuation after earthquake of the urban high-density community, optimizing the emergency evacuation space of the high-density community and improving the emergency evacuation and guarantee capability of the high-density community after earthquake.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY;TIANJIN URBAN PLANNING AND DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Detection method for simulating yield strength of steel bar after fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method for simulating the yield strength of a steel bar after a fire disaster. The invention adopts the electromagnetic induction heat treatment technology to heat up, and simulates the actual fire field temperature, on one hand, the heating speed is high, the heat preservation time is long, and the fire field environment can be simulated accurately; a formula with higher precision is established for analysis and calculation, the test result can accurately reflect the yield strength change of the steel bar after the fire occurs, powerful scientific basis is provided for analyzing the change condition of the building when the fire occurs, and test basis is provided for the damage assessment and repair of the steel bar structure after the fire occurs.

title_en: Risk assessment system for hydrological disasters of water burst runoff of mountain railway tunnel
abstract_en: Mountain ridge railway tunnel gushing water runoff hydrogeology calamity risk evaluation system relates to geological disasters risk assessment technical field, the simulation result to runoff discharge simulation technique calculation among the prior art only is the table form, the analysis result degree of accuracy is low, and then influence the construction progress, threaten constructor's safety, still can be to the earth's surface, the problem of underground water system production disturbance, the trend after this application can systematic analysis gushing water and gush out from the tunnel portal, high accuracy reduction gushing water discharges the flow path, thereby all-round true deduction gushing water discharges the scene. In addition, the method for judging the hydrogeological disaster risk level is determined by constructing a star-shaped hierarchical structure-hydrogeological model simulation result superposition analysis function, and the range and the degree of the hydrogeological disaster risk in the tunnel site area caused by the discharge event of the water burst runoff of the tunnel are visually displayed in a runoff hydrogeological disaster risk level rendering graph mode.

title_en: Method and device for sensing damage of equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for sensing damage of equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of safety engineering and information. The injury perception method comprises the following steps: establishing an equipment model for simulating the equipment, and configuring process data, accident data and environment data of the equipment in the equipment model; when any one or more devices cause accident phenomena through respective device models, establishing an accident model for simulating the accident phenomena caused by the device models; acquiring disaster field data generated by triggering the accident model to carry out accident phenomenon simulation; and acquiring the damage condition of the corresponding disaster field to the equipment according to the disaster field data. According to the invention, disaster field calculation is carried out aiming at the accident phenomenon of accident model simulation, so that the equipment can sense the damage of the disaster field, thereby well demonstrating the accident domino phenomenon, perfecting the elements of safety simulation and improving the safety and stability of equipment operation.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP QINGDAO SAFETY ENG INST;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Emergency drilling system and modeling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safety engineering technology and information technology, and provides an emergency drilling system and a modeling method thereof. The modeling method comprises the following steps: constructing an ideal equipment model for simulating the technological process, accident phenomenon and disaster field perception of equipment; when an accident phenomenon is caused by the ideal equipment model, constructing an accident model for simulating the accident phenomenon caused by the ideal equipment model; combining the ideal device model and the accident model to form a risk device model; constructing an emergency drilling model for simulating the emergency drilling process of the equipment based on the emergency drilling data of the equipment; and combining the risk device model and the emergency exercise model to form an emergency exercise system. The emergency drilling system provided by the invention can simulate the technological process, the accident phenomenon, the disaster field perception and the emergency drilling process, and compared with the traditional OTS and EDS, the emergency drilling system promotes the realization of full-element simulation.

title_en: Machine learning device
abstract_en: A machine learning device is provided in a vehicle able to supply electric power to an outside, and includes a processor configured to perform processing relating to training a machine learning model used in the vehicle. The processor is configured to lower an electric power consumption amount in the processing relating to training when acquiring disaster information compared with when not acquiring the disaster information.

title_en: Geological disaster simulation system based on VR technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster simulation system based on VR technology, which comprises a VR earthquake rescue drilling virtual simulation training system, wherein the VR earthquake rescue drilling virtual simulation training system comprises a rescue equipment setting function unit, a rescue equipment list unit, a scene selection unit, a subject setting unit, a ruin feature setting unit, a buried personnel position state unit and a function button unit. This geological disaster analog simulation system based on VR technique, through the setting of scene selection unit, be convenient for be used for selecting different scenes according to the demand, through the setting of subject setting unit, the director personnel select the subject of examining according to the needs of oneself, through the setting of press buried personnel position state unit, the director personnel can set up the state of press buried personnel in press buried personnel position state area, and provide the position point and supply the director personnel to select, the function is comparatively comprehensive, can improve the fidelity of simulation.
assignees: WUHAN XIANGKONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent scoring method, system and storage medium for fire training
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system and a storage medium for intelligent scoring of fire training, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring and storing a fire time threshold value, safety area position information, safety fire posture information, a temperature threshold value, a plurality of fire subjects and firefighter personal information, and generating an ID information table through the firefighter personal information; comparing the identity recognition information input by the firefighter with the firefighter personal information in the ID information table to confirm the firefighter about to perform firefighting training; acquiring fire training videos of firefighters and temperatures of fire source areas in a fire training environment in real time, and processing the fire training videos and the temperatures of the fire source areas to obtain processing results; obtaining and storing objective scores and subjective scores of each firefighter according to the processing results; and calculating and obtaining the final score of the firefighting training of the firefighter according to the objective score and the subjective score of each firefighting subject of the firefighter, and storing the final score. The application has the effect of accurately checking the training results of firefighters as much as possible.

title_en: Cable tunnel fire simulation system
abstract_en: The application provides a cable tunnel fire simulation system. The cable tunnel fire simulation system comprises cable tunnel fire simulation equipment and a cable combustion image acquisition device, wherein the cable tunnel fire simulation equipment comprises a cable tunnel mechanism and a smoke exhaust mechanism, and the smoke exhaust mechanism is in through connection with the cable tunnel mechanism; the outer side wall of the cable tunnel mechanism is of a transparent structure and is used for simulating the cable burning process in the cable tunnel; the smoke exhausting mechanism is used for exhausting smoke generated by burning the cable in the cable tunnel; the cable burning image acquisition device is arranged outside the cable tunnel fire disaster simulation equipment and is used for acquiring cable burning images inside the cable tunnel mechanism through the transparent structure, analyzing data of tunnel cable fires, improving fire extinguishing capability of the tunnel fires and reducing hazards of fire accidents.

title_en: Landslide susceptibility assessment method, landslide susceptibility assessment device, landslide susceptibility assessment equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide susceptibility assessment method, a landslide susceptibility assessment device, landslide susceptibility assessment equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, wherein the landslide susceptibility assessment method comprises the following steps: screening out landslide vulnerability disaster factors of a sample area; combining the landslide vulnerability disaster-causing factors with a landslide sample set acquired from the sample area to obtain a disaster-causing factor-sample set; the method comprises the steps of taking the disaster causing factor-sample set as input data for training, adopting a deep learning mode to obtain an ant colony optimization algorithm-deep belief network model for generating landslide vulnerability results of an area to be evaluated, combining the deep belief network model with the ant colony optimization algorithm to be applied to landslide vulnerability assessment, screening out the landslide vulnerability disaster causing factors of the sample area, and preferably selecting the landslide vulnerability disaster causing factors with weak relevant characteristics, thereby realizing more values of the deep learning model in the application of landslide vulnerability and other disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Emergency disposal simulation ideal equipment modeling method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safety engineering technology and information technology, and provides a method and a device for modeling an ideal emergency disposal simulation device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring process data of equipment, wherein the process data is used for describing the operation condition of materials in the process in the equipment; acquiring accident data of equipment, wherein the accident data is used for describing the change condition of first process data after the equipment has an accident; acquiring disaster field data of the equipment, wherein the disaster field data is used for describing the second process data change condition of the equipment in a disaster field; and constructing an equipment model for describing the technological process, accident phenomenon and disaster field perception of the corresponding equipment based on the acquired technological data, accident data and disaster field data. The invention describes the equipment model from three levels of process data, accident data and disaster influence, so that the elements of the safety simulation not only comprise equipment and accidents, but also comprise disasters caused by the accidents and damages of the disasters to the equipment.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP QINGDAO SAFETY ENG INST;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Modeling method, device and storage medium for emergency treatment simulation risk equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safety engineering technology and information technology, and provides a modeling method, a modeling device and a storage medium for emergency treatment simulation risk equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring process data, accident data and disaster field data of equipment; based on the acquired process data, accident data and disaster field data, an ideal equipment model for describing the process, accident phenomenon and disaster field perception of corresponding equipment is constructed; when an accident phenomenon is caused by the ideal equipment model, constructing an accident model for simulating the accident phenomenon caused by the ideal equipment model; and combining the ideal device model and the accident model to form a risk device model. The risk equipment model comprises an ideal equipment model for describing equipment from three layers of process data, accident data and disaster influence and an accident model which is independent of the ideal equipment model and can be reused, so that elements of safety simulation comprise equipment and accidents and disasters caused by the accidents and damages of the disasters to the equipment.

title_en: Full-element emergency disposal simulation module platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety engineering and information, and provides a full-element emergency disposal simulation module platform. The platform includes: a modeling module for constructing a plurality of simulation models for the plant from the plant data; and the simulation engine module is used for driving the plurality of simulation models to run and interact data in a virtual environment so as to realize corresponding equipment simulation. Wherein the plurality of simulation models comprises: a risk equipment model and an emergency drill model. The risk device model includes: the ideal equipment model is used for simulating the technological process, accident phenomenon and disaster field perception of equipment; and the accident model is used for simulating the accident phenomenon caused by the ideal equipment model. The emergency drilling model is used for simulating an emergency drilling process aiming at accident phenomena of equipment. Compared with the traditional OTS and EDS, the invention can comprise a plurality of simulation elements such as process, chain accident, disaster, rescue, decision and the like, and promotes the realization of full-element simulation.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP QINGDAO SAFETY ENG INST;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Tank area emergency disposal full-factor simulation system and modeling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety engineering and information, and provides a tank area emergency disposal full-factor simulation system and a modeling method thereof. The system comprises: a risky tank model including an ideal tank model for simulating a process, an accident phenomenon, and disaster site awareness of a tank and an accident model for simulating an accident phenomenon caused by the ideal tank model, wherein the ideal tank model is constructed based on process data, accident data, and disaster site data of the tank; and an emergency treatment model, which is constructed based on the emergency treatment data of the storage tank, for simulating a process of emergency treatment for the accident phenomenon of the storage tank. The tank area emergency disposal full-element simulation system constructed by the embodiment of the invention can simulate a process, an accident phenomenon, disaster field perception and an emergency disposal process, so that the safety simulation can comprise a plurality of elements such as a process, a chain accident, a disaster, rescue, a decision and the like, and the realization of the full-element simulation of the tank area is promoted.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP QINGDAO SAFETY ENG INST;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Accident reconstruction system and method for chemical device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safety engineering technology and information technology, and provides an accident reconstruction system and method for a chemical device. The system comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring process data, accident data, disaster field data and emergency disposal data of the chemical device; the modeling module is used for constructing a risk device model of the chemical device based on the process data, the accident data and the disaster field data, constructing an emergency disposal model for simulating an emergency disposal process aiming at the accident phenomenon based on the emergency disposal data, constructing a three-dimensional scene of the chemical device and enabling each constructed model to be simulated in the three-dimensional scene; and the evaluation module is used for acquiring the simulation result of the accident analysis conclusion to be verified reproduced by each model and evaluating the accident analysis conclusion to be verified. The invention utilizes the simulation model to accurately reproduce the accident development process and the emergency disposal process, thereby verifying the accident analysis conclusion.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP QINGDAO SAFETY ENG INST;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Method and device for dynamic calculation of parameters based on ctc simulation training process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dynamic parameter calculation method based on a CTC simulation training procedure and an apparatus thereof. The method includes the following steps: step S<sub>1</sub>: establishing a parameterized multi-branch emergency response procedure template; and step S<sub>2</sub>: performing dynamic parameter calculation and substitution on CTC data by using a combinatorial computational branching method. Compared with the related art, the present invention has the advantages of strong applicability, high real-time performance, and high accuracy.

title_en: Drilling machine for ground disaster investigation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the rig, especially, be a rig for ground disaster investigation, the drilling rod to among the current rig mostly needs a plurality of motor cooperations when driling, thereby make the drilling rod carry out the decurrent motion when carrying out the pivoted, thereby cause the lower problem of utilization ratio of motor, present put forward following scheme, it is including supporting the plectane, the top fixed mounting who supports the plectane has the casing, and the inside of casing is equipped with the lifter plate, and the bottom fixed mounting of lifter plate has the type frame that returns, and the drilling rod is installed in the inside rotation of type frame that returns, and two worms are installed in the inside rotation of lifter plate, and the top both sides of lifter plate all rotate and install the worm wheel, are located the worm and the worm wheel intermeshing of homonymy. The utility model has the advantages of reasonable design, the rotation of threaded rod can drive the movable plate and obtain the motion of vertical direction to the realization carries out the function that freely receive and releases to the universal wheel, thereby improves the use flexibility of device, and the reliability is high.
assignees: WUHAN BUILDING MAT GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIGATION INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for obtaining landslide retaining structure test data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster model experiments, in particular to a device and a method for acquiring landslide retaining structure test data, wherein the device comprises a slide body material, a supporting structure, a slide bed material, an anti-slide pile and a data acquisition mechanism, wherein the slide body material is used for simulating a side slope; the support structure is used for supporting the sliding body material; the sliding bed material is used for simulating bedrock, is arranged on one side of the bottom of the sliding body material and can move to the other side of the sliding body material; the bottom of the slide-resistant pile is fixedly arranged in the slide bed material, and the top of the slide-resistant pile is arranged in the slide body material in a penetrating manner; the data acquisition mechanism is used for acquiring test data of the landslide retaining structure. According to the invention, the slide body material is reversely extruded by the slide-resistant pile model, so that the cost and the construction difficulty are reduced, and the accuracy of the data is ensured by processing the test data.

title_en: Method and system for simulating and predicting front fracture of heading face based on time series model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for simulating and predicting a front crack of a tunneling surface based on a time series model, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical rock mass fracture parameter index data, and respectively constructing different rock mass fracture parameter index time sequences; performing stability judgment on the rock mass fracture parameter index time sequence, and performing differential operation on an unstable sequence to obtain a stable sequence; respectively determining a fracture prediction model based on an autocorrelation function graph and a partial autocorrelation function graph of a stationary sequence of different parameters and a fracture prediction sequence model selection standard, and estimating unknown parameters of the model; and predicting the parameters of the front fracture of the tunneling surface based on the determined fracture prediction model. The scheme can comprehensively and accurately predict the rock body cracks in front of the tunneling surface in advance, and effectively reduces the influence of geological disasters on construction.

title_en: Geomagnetic disturbance-oriented disaster prevention management method and device, storage medium and equipment
