abstract_en: The application discloses a geomagnetic disturbance-oriented disaster prevention management method, a geomagnetic disturbance-oriented disaster prevention management device, a geomagnetic disturbance-oriented disaster prevention management storage medium and geomagnetic induction current samples are calculated according to line induction voltages of all nodes and obtained through simulation based on geomagnetic conductivity data. Based on the respective geomagnetic induction current samples, a probability distribution function of the geomagnetic induction current is determined. And analyzing the bias data to obtain the bias current of the node. And substituting each bias current into the probability distribution function to obtain each actual geomagnetic induction current. And substituting each actual geomagnetic induction current into the magnetic biasing treatment mathematical model to obtain a calculation result output by the magnetic biasing treatment mathematical model. And adjusting the states of all the treatment devices in the power system to ensure that the total number of the treatment devices in the open state is equal to the optimal solution shown by the calculation result, thereby avoiding the excessive treatment devices from participating in the treatment process under the condition of ensuring that the number of the treatment devices participating in the treatment process of the power system meets the treatment requirement.
assignees: MAINTENANCE BRANCH OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;BEIJING TIANHE BENAN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake rescue virtual drilling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake rescue virtual drilling system, which comprises: the earthquake rescue virtual drill comprises a user layer, an application layer, a supporting layer, a data layer and an infrastructure layer, wherein the user layer comprises a command layer and a rescue team member which participate in earthquake rescue virtual drill; the application layer comprises an earthquake rescue drilling scene simulation subsystem, an earthquake rescue drilling scene setting subsystem, an earthquake rescue drilling simulation subsystem and an earthquake rescue drilling efficiency evaluation subsystem, and the butt joint integration among the subsystems is realized through a system interface; the supporting layer comprises an earthquake rescue three-dimensional simulation scene library, an earthquake disaster scene library and an earthquake emergency rescue drilling library; the data resource layer comprises basic data, intermediate data and result data of the whole drilling process; the infrastructure layer includes hardware facilities and software facilities. The reference personnel can realize the whole evolution process of the earthquake disaster from the perspective of earthquake engineering and fully grasp weak links of space and space group earthquake disaster risks.
assignees: XINXING JIHUA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;XINXING CATHAY INT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating diameter of rotary multi-circle conductor for icing monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power, in particular to a method for calculating the diameter of a rotary multi-circular conductor for icing monitoring. The method aims to analyze the icing growth rule of the rotating conductor in the processes of collision, freezing and the like of water drops through numerical simulation, quantify the influence characteristic of each environmental parameter on the icing growth rate of the rotating conductor, provide a reliable method for selecting the diameter of the rotating multi-circle conductor, and provide technical reference for accurately predicting the icing parameters and timely developing the anti-icing and disaster-reducing work of the power grid.

title_en: Dewatering well device based on expansion material and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dewatering well device based on an expansion material, which comprises a well shoe type drill bit, a filtering section, a bag type expansion joint and a well pipe body which are sequentially connected from bottom to top, wherein a sedimentation pipe is arranged in the filtering section, and the bag type expansion joint seals the upper end of the filtering section of the dewatering well, so that the burst of underground water can be prevented. The invention also discloses a construction method of the dewatering well device, which comprises the following steps of firstly, determining the length of each section of structure according to stratum distribution; in the hole forming of the drilling machine, a filtering joint and a bag type expansion joint are assembled in sections and are sunk in place while drilling; the bag type expansion joint can play a role in the well pipe well washing process; after the installation is finished, the water pump can work directly and can be recycled after the use. The invention can be used as an emergency dewatering relief well for foundation pit or tunnel leakage disasters to be applied to the field, and can also be used as a general dewatering well to be matched with engineering; compared with the traditional well forming technology, the invention simplifies the dewatering well device, optimizes the well forming process and saves the time for filling filter materials on site in the well forming process after drilling.

title_en: Disaster risk processing method and device and server
abstract_en: The specification provides a disaster risk processing method, a disaster risk processing device and a server. Based on the method, aiming at a target object arranged in an environmental area such as a polar region, the wind speed data and the snow depth data of the target object can be acquired firstly; determining equivalent static wind load and equivalent dynamic wind load according to the wind speed data; determining snow load according to the snow depth data; processing the equivalent static wind load, the equivalent dynamic wind load and the snow load according to a preset processing rule to obtain a wind and snow combined load; determining a disaster simulation result of the target object by using wind and snow combined load; and determining the disaster risk level of the target object according to the disaster simulation result of the target object. Therefore, the disaster risk level of the target object can be accurately determined, and the damage condition of the wind and snow disaster in the environmental area to the target object is quantified; and performing matched disaster protection processing on the target object based on the disaster risk level so as to protect the equipment safety of the target object.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RES INST PETROLEUM ENG;UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM BEIJING

title_en: Intelligent fire fighting monitoring system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to fire fighting technology correlation, and particularly discloses an intelligent fire fighting monitoring system and method based on the Internet of things, which comprises a fire detection module, a safety simulation module and a rescue simulation module, so that fire detection on floor environment is realized, an evacuation guide route for guiding people to evacuate and an equipment acquisition route for guiding rescue personnel to find equipment for fire extinguishing are generated and output by matching fire detection and position judgment with preset exit mark points and equipment mark points, the capacity of effectively and safely evacuating and quickly responding to extinguish fire when the fire breaks out on floors is effectively improved, the risk of mistakenly entering a dangerous area in the process of evacuating people is reduced, and the emergency efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN ANLIANWEI SAFETY TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Fault rock burst prevention and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault rock burst prevention and treatment system and a fault rock burst prevention and treatment method, the fault rock burst prevention and treatment system comprises a surface soil layer, a rock layer, a coal layer and a high-pressure water injection system, wherein the surface soil layer is positioned at the upper part of the rock layer, the middle part of the rock layer is the coal layer, the coal layer comprises a fault upper disc, a fault lower disc and a fault surface, the fault surface is arranged between the fault upper disc and the fault lower disc, the fault surface is provided with a charging drill hole, the fault upper disc and the fault lower disc are both provided with high-pressure water injection drill holes, the high-pressure water injection system is inserted into the coal layer through the high-pressure water injection drill holes, the high-pressure water injection system comprises a water tank, a metal water injection pipe, a high-pressure water pump, a water stop valve and a sealing assembly, one end of the metal water injection pipe is connected to a water outlet of the water tank, the other end of the metal water injection pipe is sequentially connected with the high-pressure water pump, the water stop valve and the sealing assembly, and the sealing assembly is fixedly connected between the side wall of the metal water injection drill holes; the invention has the advantages of being capable of adapting to high stress areas, breaking in a burst mode and stably preventing and treating rock burst disasters for a long time.

title_en: Rock burst prevention supporting system and method for high-ground-stress fragile surrounding rock tunnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a rock burst prevention support system and method for a high-ground-stress fragile surrounding rock tunnel, which comprises the following steps: the construction method comprises the following steps of (1) jetting a flexible thin spraying layer on a wall surface to be supported after tunnel drilling and blasting construction, an energy-absorbing reinforcing mesh paved on the flexible thin spraying layer, a plurality of energy-absorbing shock-absorbing anchor rods and a secondary lining concrete layer; the energy-absorbing reinforcing mesh is arranged close to the flexible thin spraying layer, the energy-absorbing reinforcing mesh is of a diamond hook mesh structure, reinforcing steel bar frameworks are arranged on the outer side and the diagonal line of the energy-absorbing reinforcing mesh, and the overlapped parts of the reinforcing mesh are fixedly connected through energy-absorbing damping anchor rods and bear the stress of surrounding rocks together; when the energy-absorbing and shock-absorbing anchor rod moves axially relatively, the energy-absorbing part absorbs energy generated by impact of surrounding rocks, the shock-absorbing ring applies surrounding rock pressure to the elastic body, and the elastic body deforms to achieve the shock-absorbing effect; the invention can effectively dissipate strain energy in the rock mass, reduce impact vibration of surrounding rocks, and avoid rock burst disasters from damaging the construction environment and threatening the life safety of personnel.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;SHANDONG HONGYU ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD;UNIV JINAN

title_en: Method for revising inversion error of ground flash strength
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of lightning disaster monitoring and early warning, in particular to a method for revising the inversion error of the ground impact strength. The application provides a method for revising a return impact strength inversion error, which comprises the steps of obtaining ideal lightning current strength under ideal conditions, wherein the ideal conditions are earth curvature infinity and conductivity infinity, establishing a lightning electromagnetic transmission simulation model aiming at actual conditions, carrying out lightning electromagnetic field propagation analysis on a region to be tested according to the lightning electromagnetic transmission simulation model through a two-dimensional time domain finite difference method FDTD to obtain a lightning electromagnetic field propagation attenuation rule of the region to be tested, obtaining an attenuation factor of the lightning electromagnetic field according to the lightning electromagnetic field propagation attenuation rule, revising the ideal lightning current strength according to the attenuation factor to obtain actual conditions of attenuation lightning current strength, and solving the problem that the inverted lightning current strength has larger deviation to a certain extent.

title_en: Power grid equipment risk early warning method and system under flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid equipment risk early warning method and a system under a flood disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time rainfall data and carrying out rainfall runoff simulation based on a preset flood inundation analysis model to obtain a water depth distribution map in the region; calculating the exposure degree of the power grid equipment of a certain grid in the water depth distribution diagram; calculating the vulnerability of the power grid equipment of a certain grid in the water depth distribution diagram; calculating a flood disaster risk value in a certain grid according to the exposure degree of the power grid equipment based on the vulnerability of the power grid equipment, and judging whether the flood disaster risk value is greater than a risk degree threshold value or not; and if the flood disaster risk value is greater than the risk degree threshold value, displaying alarm information at a certain grid position of the water depth distribution map. The method can judge the risk degree of the power grid equipment under the flood disaster based on the flood disaster risk value, helps the power grid management personnel to master the influence of the flood disaster on the power grid equipment in advance, and lays a foundation for timely taking disaster resistance and reduction measures.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NANCHANG

title_en: Airplane test freezing fog and freezing rain environment simulation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a freezing fog and freezing rain environment simulation system for an airplane test, and relates to the technical field of airplane tests. The integrated simulation system comprises: a power supply subsystem for realizing that fog freezing rain is experimental sprays test subsystem and being used for providing power and being located the aircraft laboratory for spraying test subsystem, wherein, the spraying test subsystem includes: the nozzle module, the control module, the power supply subsystem includes: water supply module, air feed module, power module. The invention solves the problems of certain difficulty in integration of the freezing fog and freezing rain functions and low test and actual condition fitting degree, and has the advantages of integration of the freezing fog and freezing rain functions, realization of the freezing fog and freezing rain effect and comparison with the latest freezing fog and freezing rain disaster data.

title_en: Disaster insurance loss simulation method based on aggregation risk data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster insurance loss simulation method based on aggregate risk data, which is characterized in that aggregate risk data is split to obtain space positions and values, and aggregate attribute of split targets is endowed, so that a corresponding aggregate vulnerability curve and residential, commercial and industrial values of the split targets are calculated, and then the total loss of each split point target is obtained by combining the existing earthquake disaster intensity, and then the total loss of all the targets is accumulated to obtain the final aggregate risk data total loss. The invention can quickly generate the target data of the spatial position and the value information distributed in a certain area based on the given aggregation risk data.

title_en: Large-scale true three-dimensional hollow permeable disaster simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale true three-dimensional vacuum water-permeable disaster simulation experiment device, which is provided with an experiment platform, wherein a loading mechanism is fixedly arranged on the experiment platform; an experimental model is arranged in the loading mechanism, a loading assembly is fixedly arranged on the surface of the experimental model, a displacement sensor is arranged at the end part of the loading assembly, and a gravity sensor is arranged between the loading assembly and the experimental model in a propping mode; the experimental platform drives the loading mechanism to simulate the inclination angle of the stratum. Through the displacement sensor of installation, whether displacement and displacement change take place for experimental model in the time of displacement sensor cooperation external equipment real-time supervision is exerting pressure to experimental model to the hydro-cylinder, when taking place displacement change, obtain the pressure data when producing the displacement through gravity sensor, realize large-scale true three-dimensional sky accident that permeates water and reproduce the simulation, provide the scientific basis for the analysis and identification of the accident that permeates water in the sky.

title_en: Method and device for predicting power outage quantity of distribution network users under typhoon disasters
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for predicting the power outage quantity of distribution network users under typhoon disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting environmental data of a target area, preprocessing the environmental data and analyzing the correlation to obtain first data, preprocessing the first data, wherein the preprocessing comprises normalization processing, classification variable processing and dependent variable processing, a prediction model of the power outage quantity of the distribution network users under typhoon disasters based on global variables is built based on a random forest algorithm, the importance of each independent variable is obtained by evaluation, independent variables meeting preset standards are selected from all the independent variables according to the importance to serve as important variables, the important variables are taken as input, a prediction model of the power outage quantity of the distribution network users under typhoon disasters based on the important variables is built, training and testing are carried out on the prediction model of the power outage quantity of the distribution network users under typhoon disasters based on the important variables, and the power outage quantity of the distribution network users under typhoon disasters is output. The application can accurately predict the number of users with power failure of the distribution network users under typhoon disasters through the model.

title_en: Casing and well pipe integrated dewatering well device and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a casing and well pipe integrated dewatering well device which comprises a casing, a well pipe, a filter, a settling pipe and a well shoe type drill bit, wherein the casing comprises a wall protecting section casing and a filtering section casing, the well pipe is arranged in the filtering section casing and is coaxially arranged with the filtering section casing, and the filter is arranged between the well pipe and the filtering section casing. The invention also discloses a construction method of the dewatering well device, firstly, according to the stratum distribution of the survey data, the filtering sections of the dewatering well device are assembled in advance in sequence, the settling pipe is arranged in the well pipe, after the drilling of the drilling machine is completed, the prefabricated dewatering well device is sunk into the hole in sections, and can work directly by matching with a water pump, and can be recycled after being used. The invention can be applied to general engineering dewatering and recharging engineering, and is particularly suitable for the conditions of emergency rescue, dewatering and pressure reduction of foundation pits or tunnels in case of leakage disasters. Compared with the traditional well forming technology, the invention optimizes the well forming process and saves the time for filling filter materials on site in the well forming process after drilling.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 18TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY 12TH BUREAU GR;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Fire-resistant design method for light wood-structure wall
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire-resistant design method for a light wood structure wall, which belongs to the technical field of light wood structure wall design, and is a fire-resistant design method which combines numerical simulation and theoretical calculation and considers the temperature dependence of wood. Firstly, setting the thickness and the size of a gypsum board, a bone column and rock wool of a wood structure wall according to fireproof construction measures, and establishing a two-dimensional model in finite element analysis software; setting corresponding parameters in finite element analysis software, determining initial conditions and boundary conditions, setting fire curves, determining fire time and determining final temperature field distribution of a wall body; then, dividing the bone column into four layers by adopting a stepped model according to the temperature field distribution of the bone column, and determining the strength reduction coefficient of the corresponding layer; then, carrying out checking calculation on the limit state of the bearing capacity after fire disaster according to the stress born by each section of the wall; finally, judging and adjusting the waterproof measures until the bearing capacity is qualified.

title_en: Virtual simulation emergency rescue drilling method for water-permeable disasters on mine excavation working surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine emergency rescue, and particularly discloses a virtual simulation emergency rescue drilling method for water-permeable disasters on a mine excavation working surface. The method comprises the following steps of field collection: collecting basic parameters of various mine models on site, constructing a parameter database, and constructing a scene: establishing a virtual three-dimensional model of a drilling scene of emergency rescue according to basic parameters in a parameter database, and simulating a water permeating step: simulating the complete process of the water-permeable disaster, and the disaster generation step: generating a simulated water-permeable disaster in a drilling scene, and performing rescue drilling: putting rescue workers into a drilling scene, acquiring the behavior of the rescue workers in the drilling scene for rescue drilling, and comprehensively scoring: and giving out comprehensive scores of the rescuers for the water-permeable disaster treatment process according to the behaviors of the rescuers in the drilling scene. Therefore, the problem that the water-permeable disaster drilling exercise effect is poor due to the fact that the difference between the drilling exercise environment and an actual mine is large at present is solved.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Safety management method for mine enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety management method for mine enterprises, which comprises a training system, a double control system and a disaster prevention system; the training system comprises three parts, namely an online security college, an offline ampere center and an online attendance examination system, the online attendance examination system comprises a biological identification system, a human body detection system and an examination system, and the double-control system comprises security risk classification management and control and hidden danger troubleshooting management; the disaster prevention system comprises a personnel positioning system, a monitoring system, an emergency broadcasting system, a communication system and an emergency response system which are all connected with an external dispatching command center. According to the invention, through an online system, an offline system and an attendance system, the safety consciousness of personnel is infused comprehensively, the effectiveness and the long-term property of memory are ensured, the double-control system is combined with intelligent equipment, the hidden danger identification can be carried out quickly by on-site personnel, the risk level is predicted, the personnel can make a decision action quickly through the visualization of disasters, the gold escape time is won, and the production safety is greatly improved.
assignees: LONGYAN LONGAN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based method for evaluating state of overhead line after typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle-based method for evaluating the state of an overhead line after a typhoon disaster, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the inspection defect data of the overhead line over the years; performing statistical analysis on the inspection defect data of the past year by adopting a TF-IDF statistical method to obtain a plurality of defect types, defect specific descriptions corresponding to the defect types and defect severity; constructing a naive Bayes analysis prediction model, and training and learning according to the defect type, the specific description of the defect and the severity of the defect; collecting power transmission line state data through an unmanned aerial vehicle, carrying out data mining on the power transmission line state data and obtaining correlation characteristics; the correlation characteristics are input into a trained naive Bayes analysis prediction model to obtain the actual defect types and the defect severity, a TF-IDF statistical method and the naive Bayes analysis prediction model are combined together, and data acquisition is carried out through an unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the efficiency and the accuracy of defect prediction can be greatly improved.
assignees: HAINAN POWER TRANS & OVERHAUL BRANCH HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Flood forecast model parameter multi-objective optimization method based on long-short-term memory network and NSGA-II algorithm
abstract_en: A flood forecast model multi-objective optimization method based on a long-short time memory network and an NSGA-II algorithm comprises the steps of firstly determining the structure of a long-short time memory LSTM network flood forecast model, dividing collected and tidied study basin scene flood data into a training set and a test set scene, intercepting a front rainfall sequence of each flood to enable the length of an input rainfall sequence of each sample to be equal, and obtaining input rainfall sequences of the training set and the test set samples. Secondly, designing a plurality of objective functions according to the actual demands of flood control protection objects, constructing an LSTM flood forecast model parameter multi-objective optimization framework, nesting forward calculation of the LSTM flood forecast model into the multi-objective optimization framework, and circularly updating and evaluating the model parameter sets to obtain the optimal parameter sets. And finally, inputting the optimal parameter set into an LSTM flood forecast model, and evaluating and analyzing the simulation and forecast effect of the LSTM flood forecast model. The invention can meet the requirement of multi-objective optimization of LSTM flood forecast model parameters in different scenes, and provides a new technical support for mountain torrent disaster forecast and early warning work.

title_en: Flexible city intelligent planning system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flexible city intelligent planning system, a method and a storage medium, wherein the system comprises a data processing subsystem, a city information subsystem, a simulation engine subsystem, an information visualization subsystem and a city planning subsystem, wherein the data processing subsystem receives city information in real time, converts the format to obtain a scene model and transmits the scene model to the city information subsystem, the city information subsystem stores the scene model, the simulation engine subsystem performs disaster simulation and flexible service simulation according to the scene model to obtain a projection model, the information visualization subsystem stratifies the projection model, and the city planning subsystem automatically generates a city planning scheme according to the projection model. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of real-time adjustment of the city information, strong flexibility and the like.

title_en: Method for constructing flexible city knowledge graph based on city element and multi-disaster fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a flexible city knowledge graph based on city elements and multi-disaster fusion, which specifically comprises the following steps: s1, collecting geographic space data, traffic network data and disaster recording yearbook data of a city; s2, performing data processing and knowledge extraction on the data to obtain structured data, semi-structured data and unstructured data for storage; s3, respectively constructing a geographic space knowledge graph, a traffic knowledge graph and a disaster knowledge graph according to structured data, semi-structured data and unstructured data obtained by knowledge extraction, and then carrying out knowledge fusion on a plurality of knowledge graphs to obtain a toughness city knowledge graph; and S4, constructing a front-end visualization platform according to the toughness city knowledge graph, and setting a corresponding basic information platform. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of providing data support for simulation, prediction, deduction and promotion of urban toughness in different states of urban daily risk, disaster emergency and the like.

title_en: Multi-agent learning method based on mean field, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-agent learning method based on a mean field, a storage medium and an electronic device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring feedback information of the current environment of each intelligent agent to each intelligent agent from the intelligent agent simulation environment; storing the data into a data sampling buffer; carrying out average field estimation on the actions of the multiple agents; combining the actions of each agent to generate a combined action space Average field estimation is carried out on the current agent and the joint action space to obtain a virtual average agent The rest agent sets N (j) replacing the bilateral interaction; a strategy learning device of a neural network based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. The method is based on intensificationThe learning solves the practical problems that the multi-agent is difficult to control accurately and adapt to complex environment, and the like, and the mean field estimation is carried out on the actions of the multi-agent based on the mean field theory, so that the problems that the interaction among large-scale multi-agent is complex, the dimensionality disaster is caused, the cluster application cannot be realized, and the like are solved.
assignees: XIAMEN DATAEXA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire simulation experiment device for village ancient building fire induction building group under effect of environmental wind
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire simulation experiment device for a village and old building fire induced building group under the action of environmental wind, which is mainly used for researching the evolution behavior of flame overflowing from an opening and developing outwards after the village and old building fire occurs and the evolution rule and behavior characteristics of building group fire occurrence-development-spread under the action of external environmental wind. The invention comprises an air supply system, a building group model, a fire source system, a quality monitoring system and a matched measurement monitoring system. The device can simulate the fire spreading evolution law of village ancient building groups under the action of different environmental winds, and research and characterize the relevant parameter change of the evolution mechanism. The invention establishes the experimental device model for simulating the fire overflow behavior of the village ancient building group fire disaster opening for the first time, can simulate the fire spread and smoke diffusion behavior of the village ancient building group induced by the village ancient building group fire overflow under the action of environmental wind more truly, and has important reference significance and value for formulating effective village ancient building fire prevention and control, smoke control and reduction methods.

title_en: Digital analog temperature safety monitoring method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a digital simulation temperature safety monitoring method, a device, a system and a storage medium, which can solve the problems that the flame monitoring of the existing incinerator is not in place, and fire disasters are easily caused if the flame temperature is too high. The digital analog temperature safety monitoring method may include: acquiring the flame temperature of the hearth; and under the condition that the flame temperature of the hearth is higher than the preset temperature, sending an early warning temperature simulation instruction to a target mobile terminal, wherein the target mobile terminal is a mobile terminal associated with the hearth, and the early warning temperature simulation instruction is used for controlling a battery management system of the target mobile terminal so as to enable the target mobile terminal to reach the target temperature for fire early warning.
assignees: WUHAN MINGZHENG POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of actual combat earthquake collapse building training facility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a training facility for actual combat earthquake collapse buildings, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring the basis of collapse simulation calculation of the target building, and determining physical engine input; s2, calculating, simulating and visually reproducing the whole process from collapse of the target building to the formation of the ruins by using a finite element method and a building collapse ruin scene simulation technology of a physical engine; s3, through the combination of aftershock simulation and the target building ruin virtual scene, the simulation of the dynamic situation of the training personnel suffering from aftershock in the scene facility training is realized; s4, embedding different typical collapse types in the building collapse simulation facility; designing and manufacturing an execution module of a collapse simulating component according to a collapse mechanism, wherein the execution module is used for realizing the follow-up process of various building components in a target building; s5, forming a script according to the disaster background material and the investigation result which are actually happened, and using the script as the basic data for writing the emergency training course; and S6, carrying out actual combat training of actual combat building collapse.
assignees: XINXING JIHUA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;XINXING CATHAY INT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Forecasting method for delayed cold damage dynamics of cotton
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for dynamically forecasting delayed cold damage of cotton, and belongs to the field of agricultural meteorological disasters. The invention utilizes the cotton functional structure model to dynamically simulate various indexes of the cotton field growth and development day by day, comprehensively considers the influence of weather, climate, management measures and varieties on the cotton growth and development, combines the heat condition with the cotton growth and development condition, and carries out delayed cold damage judgment according to the deviation degree of various indexes and the heat normal year, thereby leading the disaster prediction to be more specific to the detailed process of the crop growth and development. Meanwhile, the disaster prediction is promoted from the monthly prediction to the day-by-day prediction, and a reliable basis can be provided for the cotton production to take measures in time for scientific disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Typhoon virtual simulation experiment teaching system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a typhoon virtual simulation experiment teaching system and a method thereof, which can form a virtual simulation experiment developed in a matching way with a motion mode and can be developed on the internet for simulating typhoon. The invention relates to an atmospheric science professional as an application subject, aiming at cultivating application talents which are proficient in theory and oriented to practice, and aiming at cultivating comprehensive abilities of students, the invention utilizes a 3D technology and a WebGL technology to construct scenes such as cloud layer roaming, typhoon crossing, satellite cloud pictures and the like, thereby realizing 4K high-definition image quality; the students can deeply understand the formation, disappearance and movement process of the typhoon by mastering the basic characteristics, distribution range and theoretical knowledge of different grade division of the typhoon, and can accurately demonstrate the cloud system and the relevant parameters of the atmospheric pressure field temperature field, the weather system and the disaster-causing influence of different stages of the typhoon accompanying.

title_en: tunnel rail fire extinguisher
title_ko: 터널 레일 소화 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tunnel rail fire extinguishing apparatus. An objective of the present invention is to enable a user to quickly extinguish a fire by using a smart phone when the fire occurs in a tunnel. The tunnel rail fire extinguishing apparatus of the present invention comprises: a hose; a camera; a 360° rotation unit; nozzle; a rail; a main body container; a smartphone; a tunnel rail fire extinguishing apparatus icon; a start screen; a basic setting screen; a main screen; a self-authentication screen; a fire extinguisher selection screen; an manipulator description screen; a manipulation screen; and an end screen.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 터널 레일 소화 장치에 관한 것으로서, 사용자가 터널 내 화재 발생시 재빠른 대처를 하여 스마트폰을 이용하여 화재 초기진압을 할 수 있도록 함을 목적으로 한 것이다. 
본 발명은 터널 레일 소화 장치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 터널 레일 소화 장치에 있어서:터널 레일 소화 장치 상부에 소화 용액이 이동할 수 있는 호스,터널 레일 소화 장치 상부에 화재 지점을 보여주는 카메라,터널 레일 소화 장치 중심부에 방향을 조절해주는 360°회전부,터널 레일 소화 장치 상부에 소화용액이 나오는 분사구,터널 레일 소화 장치 하부에 화재 지점까지 이동할 수 있게 구비되는 레일,터널 레일 소화 장치 하부에 소화용액을 담고 있는 본체용기,터널 레일 소화 장치를 실행할 수 있게 구비되는 스마트폰,상기 스마트폰에 사용자가 터널 레일 소화 장치를 실행할 수 있게 터널 레일 소화 장치아이콘,터널 레일 소화 장치 아이콘에 사용자가 터널 레일 소화 장치를 실행할 수 있게 구비되는 시작화면,상기 시작화면에 사용자가 자신이 근무중인 소방지점을 선택하고 인증할 수 있게 구비되는 기본설정화면,상기 기본설정화면에 사용자가 진압하기 또는 내 프로필 보기 또는 연습하기 또는 소화기 관리를 실행할 수 있게 구비되는 메인화면,상기 메인화면에 사용자가 진압하기를 누르면 실행할 수 있게 구비되는 본인인증화면,상기 본인인증화면에 사용자가 본인인증을 실행하면 구비되는 소화기 선택화면,상기 소화기 선택화면에 사용자가 소화기를 선택하면 실행할 수 있게 구비되는 조작기 설명화면,상기 조작기 설정화면에 사용자가 조각하는 방법을 보고 화면 선택하면 실행할 수 있게 구비되는 조작화면, 상기 조작화면을 통해 사용자가 초기진압을 실행하면 구비되는 종료화면으로 구성하는 것을 특징으로 하는 것이다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 사용자가 터널 내 화재 발생시 재빠른 대처를 하여 스마트폰을 이용하여 화재 초기진압을 할 수 있는 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Exploration type earthquake-proof disaster-reducing science popularization education exhibit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a research formula earthquake-proof disaster-reduction science popularization education exhibit, including placing the stand and setting up at the protective frame of placing the stand upper end, still include the vibration subassembly, place the stand upper end and be located and be equipped with the platform of placing in the protective frame, place the bench upper end and install earthquake analogue means, earthquake analogue means includes the floor frame, the floor frame is placed in placing bench upper end both sides and with place the platform fixed connection, each floor frame is divided into the floor region of three equidistance range from the bottom up, the upper end of each floor region all is equipped with the electromagnetic damping device that is used for carrying on the antidetonation test and is controlled by electrically controlled device; what is different from the traditional shockproof and disaster-reducing science popularization education exhibit is that by the device, the shockproof effect difference of high-rise buildings with no damper and when the damper is placed at different positions can be observed, the electromagnetic damping phenomenon is combined with floor earthquake-resistant simulation, the principle of showing inertia, acting force and reacting force to audiences is realized, and the science popularization education is comprehensive and efficient.
assignees: WENZHOU SCIENCE & TECH MUSEUM WENZHOU YOUTH SCIENCE AND TECH CENTER;WENZHOU SENYU MULTIMEDIA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-fire-point simulated ignition combustion device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multi-ignition point simulation ignition combustion device, which comprises a box body, a plurality of ignition points arranged on the top surface of the box body, an ignition device arranged in the center of the top surface, an air supply port arranged on the box body and an oil supply pipeline arranged in the box body and connected with the ignition points and the ignition device; the ignition device comprises a fork pipe arranged in the center of the top plate, a middle pipe arranged in the fork pipe, an atomizing nozzle arranged in the middle pipe jacking pipe and an ignition rod arranged in the fork pipe; the utility model discloses can be effective real imitate out the effect of fire incident, for the firefighter provides more real scene of practising and operating, solved that fuel is extravagant, uncontrollable, polluted environment, flame effect are not good, fuel burning is not abundant, life short scheduling problem, training is with low costs, but and repeatedly usable, and the device installation is simple and convenient simultaneously, and the appearance is pleasing to the eye.

title_en: Geological disaster teaching demonstration device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster teaching presentation device relates to geological survey technical field, has solved when carrying out the explanation of geological disaster, and the demonstration of imparting knowledge to students is carried out to the video mode of current often adoption picture cooperation, but the video mode of picture cooperation, and the knowledge that acquires the teaching content to the student is directly perceived inadequately, and its technical scheme main points are: the demonstration box comprises a base plate, wherein a demonstration box is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the base plate, and a transparent plate is arranged on the front side of the demonstration box; the middle part of the bottom end in the demonstration box is provided with a first electric push rod and a second electric push rod in a staggered manner, a bracket is arranged between the output ends of the first electric push rods, a simulation disc is arranged between the output end of the second electric push rod and the upper surface of the bracket, and the middle part of the lower surface of the simulation disc is provided with vibrating motors arranged at intervals; the geological phenomenon of geological disasters can be vividly demonstrated, so that students can visually acquire teaching contents, and the teaching demonstration of the geological disasters can be smoothly performed.

title_en: Landslide disaster simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landslide disaster simulation test device, which relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring, and comprises a test box, a precipitation device, a vibration device, a slope cutting device, an accumulation area device, a monitoring device, a photographic device and a data receiving device, wherein the test box is arranged on the vibration device and is used for placing landslide object sources; the slope cutting device comprises a plurality of automatic slope cutting assemblies which are vertically arranged, and the respective automatic slope cutting assemblies can be slidably arranged on the frame body; the monitoring device comprises an SAA monitoring assembly, a GNSS monitoring assembly, a soil water content monitoring assembly and a pore water pressure monitoring assembly, wherein the SAA monitoring assembly, the soil water content monitoring assembly and the pore water pressure monitoring assembly are all used for being buried at the rear end of the landslide source body, and the GNSS monitoring assembly is used for being arranged on the surface of the rear end of the landslide source body. The device can monitor the starting, migration and accumulation conditions of landslide source bodies under the action of rainfall, vibration, slope cutting independent working conditions and combined working conditions.
assignees: BEIJING INST OF GEOLOGICAL & PROSPECTING ENGINEERING

title_en: Hydrology drilling bailing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydrology drilling bailing device, it is applied to coal field hydrology drilling probing field, it include the drilling rod and with the one end fixed connection's of drilling rod drill bit, the apopore has been seted up on the drill bit, the fixed sleeve pipe screw head that is equipped with of junction of drill bit and drilling rod, sleeve pipe screw head and the sheathed tube one end fixed connection who encircles in the drilling rod periphery, the sheathed tube inner wall forms annular cavity with the outer wall of drilling rod, the utility model discloses simple structure, economical and practical, hydrology drilling pumping test finishes through the back that exploratory hole drilling sand setting exceeds standard, and the accessible this device realizes easily bailing, improves the experimental quality of drawing water, ensures the authenticity of purpose aquifer pumping test data, effectively suppresses the water disaster that the mine leads to because of the inaccuracy of hydrology geological parameters when guaranteeing probing efficiency of construction and quality.
assignees: GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION INSTITUTE FIRST EXPLORATION BUREAU CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Geological disaster administers engineering and uses soil sample collection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disasters administers engineering and uses soil sample collection system, including gathering the pole, gather the upper end both sides of pole all fixedly connected with handle, the surface of gathering the pole is equipped with the external screw thread, and the downside of gathering the pole is equipped with the drill bit, and the upper end fixedly connected with of drill bit collects the pole, and the left side fixedly connected with surge drum of collecting the pole, the right side sliding connection who collects the pole and be located the surge drum has the closing plate, and the right side of collecting the pole is rotated and is connected with the connecting axle, the utility model discloses can avoid when gathering the pole and withdrawing, the moisture in soil sample and the soil sample drops for the soil sample of collection is more complete.
assignees: QUN AN DA CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Seed constant temperature artificial containers
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seed constant temperature artificial containers, the power distribution box comprises a box body, there is the glass door oral area of box through hinged mounting, the outside fixedly connected with fan of installation shell, the inside of box is located the avris fixedly connected with heater of installation shell, one side fixedly connected with of slider cultivates the box, one side of box lower extreme is provided with the collecting box, the upper end fixedly connected with electronic controller at the box back, the upper end at the box back is located the avris fixedly connected with lamp switch of electronic controller. This seed constant temperature artificial containers utilizes fan wind circulation formula accuse temperature, through electronic controller control and purpose-made heater, heats or refrigeration control to the incasement air, and the simulation natural ecological environment makes the seed be heated more evenly to reach the best budding rate, solved the condition of natural disasters and harmful organism destruction, created the optimal condition for the bud of seed, opened up new way for the scientific development of agricultural.
assignees: QINGDAO ESSIN ELECTRICAL APPLIANCES CO LTD

title_ko: 개인 안전 시스템이 통합된 배지 홀더
abstract_ko: 배지 홀더 또는 유사한 물품에 통합된 개인 비상 통지 시스템이 개시된다. 이것은 사용자가 직장이나 다른 특정 환경에서 소지해야 하지만 그렇지 않은 경우에는 필요하지 않은 배지, 키 카드 또는 기타 유사한 액세스 패스에 부착된 비상 통지 시스템을 사용자가 갖는 것을 가능하게 한다. 또한, 시스템은 작업 영역에서 비상 상황이 검출될 때 다양한 자동화 특징부를 가질 수 있으며, 시스템은 사용자가 현장에, 현장 근처(예를 들어, 소집 구역 또는 집결 지점) 또는 현장 외부 및 안전한 곳에 있을 때를 인식할 수 있다. 이러한 자동화 특징부는 지역 대피에 대한 귀중한 데이터를 얻기 위해 대피 훈련 동안 또한 사용될 수 있다.

title_en: Railway emergency situation deduction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway emergency situation deduction method based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: extracting key scene elements of a railway emergency; performing scene construction, analyzing key scene elements of a railway emergency, researching scene element expression and action mechanism, and expressing key scene element information by using simulation values; constructing a scenario chain in a scenario evolution path of the railway emergency, wherein the scenario chain is a description of the overall development of the railway emergency; constructing a railway emergency scene deduction model based on a convolutional neural network, inputting multi-time sequence scene element information of a scene chain into the railway emergency scene deduction model, and deducting to obtain the accident disaster influence degree. The invention prejudges the evolution direction of the railway emergency by using the convolution neural network based on multi-time sequence input, thereby improving the emergency rescue efficiency and reducing the property loss and the casualties to the greatest extent. Belongs to the technical field of railway emergency management.

title_en: Karst area tunnel water inrush early warning method and system, electronic device and medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a karst region tunnel water inrush early warning method, a system, an electronic device and a medium; wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring karst spring water flow data, drilling water level data and tunnel water inflow data during construction of a target line region corresponding to a tunnel in a karst region; acquiring precipitation data of a tunnel in a karst area, and determining a correlation among karst spring water flow data, drilling water level data, tunnel water inflow data and precipitation data, wherein the correlation comprises a positive correlation and a negative correlation; and carrying out karst region tunnel water inrush early warning according to the size relation and the correlation of the target data and the corresponding preset range, wherein the target data comprise karst spring water flow data, drilling water level data, tunnel water inflow data and precipitation data. The embodiment of the disclosure can perform water inrush early warning on the tunnel in the karst area, guarantee construction safety and avoid disaster caused by water inrush of karst.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating collapse risk of building in fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating building collapse risk during fire, which relates to the field of buildings, and comprises the steps of establishing an equal-proportion three-dimensional model according to actual building data, establishing a fire database, annotating the three-dimensional model, performing fire simulation analysis on basic data such as fire points and fire degrees of the building, performing different assignment, continuously performing repeated tests, establishing a test database, analyzing fire test data, obtaining weak positions of the building, sequencing according to the weak degrees, and evaluating the building fire risk in a step S40, and outputting evaluation. By evaluating and sequencing collapse risks of the building under different fire scenes, important references can be provided for related units, and corresponding protective measures can be gradually taken according to the degree of the risks.

title_en: Ocean-ionosphere dissipation dynamics simulation method, simulation system, equipment and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ocean dynamics, and discloses an ocean-ionosphere dissipation dynamics simulation method, a simulation system, equipment and application. Constructing a high-frequency ground wave radar ocean-ionosphere dissipation system; analyzing the dynamic relation between the ocean subsystem and the ionosphere subsystem according to the change characteristics of entropy in the high-frequency ground wave radar ocean-ionosphere dissipation system, and transferring partial parameters in a frame of the high-frequency ground wave radar ocean-ionosphere dissipation system and a prototype of the long-term and short-term memory network model to an ocean-ionosphere data model in a real environment; and correspondingly adjusting the data model parameters of the ocean-ionosphere data in the real environment after the migration by using the recorded ocean-ionosphere data to obtain early forecast information of the marine natural disasters. The method improves the modeling accuracy under a small sample, thereby effectively revealing the dynamic relationship between the mutation sea state and the ionosphere and providing technical support for early forecasting of natural disasters at sea.

title_en: Cutting slope long-acting drainage structure and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cut slope long-acting drainage structure and a construction method. In nature, rock-soil body side slopes often cause large-scale landslide disasters due to unsmooth drainage of rainfall slope bodies, and engineering safety is seriously affected. The outermost layer of the invention is a high-strength PVC pipe, and the outer wall is provided with a rectangular through hole; the capillary drainage plate is wrapped on the outer surface of the inner PVC pipe and clamped in the longitudinal groove on the inner PVC pipe; during construction, the outer layer PVC pipe is installed into the side slope drill hole, and then the PVC pipe wrapping the capillary drainage plate is inserted into the outer layer PVC pipe. The invention adopts a double-pipe structure form of fixing a high-strength PVC pipe on the outer layer, replacing the capillary drainage plate in the middle and replacing the PVC pipe on the inner layer, fully utilizes the capillary effect and plays a role in long-acting drainage of the side slope.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD

title_en: Comprehensive investigation method for ice lake breaking risk assessment and eigenvalue calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive investigation method for ice lake burst risk assessment and eigenvalue calculation, and relates to the technical field of engineering investigation and ground disaster monitoring. In order to solve the problems of investigation and eigenvalue calculation of a concentrated development area of a glacier in open-line engineering of a traffic corridor, the invention provides a comprehensive investigation method for the evaluation of the burst risk and eigenvalue calculation of the glacier, and the stability of a mother glacier at the rear edge and a ridge end moraine at the front edge of the glacier side is analyzed to predict the change of the storage capacity and the area of the glacier, so that the burst risk of the glacier is comprehensively evaluated. On the basis, three characteristic values of flow velocity, integral impact force and single impact force which move to the position of the traffic lane after the ice lake is broken are calculated by using the traditional rain Hong Fa, a traditional calculation method is verified through RAMMS numerical simulation, and reasonable safety height and engineering protection parameters of bridge and roadbed engineering are provided.

title_en: Automobile rescue assisting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile rescue assisting device, which relates to the field of automobile safety devices and comprises a main controller, an in-automobile detection device, an out-automobile detection device, an on-board server and a cloud end, wherein the in-automobile detection device, the out-automobile detection device, the on-board server and the cloud end are connected with the main controller; the vehicle exterior detection device is placed outside the vehicle roof and used for monitoring the environment outside the vehicle in real time; the vehicle-mounted server is used for storing the reasonable concentration range of the related gas, and mechanical parameters based on the mechanical simulation under the vehicle body structure parameters and the actual impact test; the high in the clouds is arranged in the rescue team, and the high in the clouds passes through communication module and main control unit communication interaction, and the rescue personnel are according to the inside and outside condition evacuation accident highway section traffic of car of high in the clouds feedback and carry corresponding rescue instrument high-efficiently to go to the scene, and the device can also monitor member's in the car dangerous action and potential safety hazard, and the prevention car accident takes place.
assignees: WUXI INTERNET OF THINGS INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Regional evacuation capability assessment method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional evacuation capacity assessment method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein a basic environment physical model is constructed based on regional layout data by acquiring regional layout data and personnel distribution data of a region to be assessed, motion information of each target object in the personnel distribution data is extracted, a plurality of evacuation intelligent bodies are constructed based on the motion information of each target object, evacuation parameters of the evacuation intelligent bodies in evacuation deduction are calculated by utilizing a multi-scenario simulation model according to the basic environment physical model, and the evacuation capacity of the region to be assessed is assessed according to each evacuation parameter to obtain an assessment result. The evacuation deduction and evaluation of various conditions are carried out on the area to be evaluated by utilizing the multi-scenario simulation model, and after the evaluation, the scheme is optimized, so that the problem that a short board which cannot actually observe the decision implementation effect when urban decisions are made in the evacuation aspect in the prior art is solved, and the evacuation planning accuracy of the area is improved.

title_en: Static bending test method and device for post insulator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid disaster prevention, and particularly provides a static bending test method and device for a post insulator, which comprises the following steps: the rod unit is obliquely arranged, and one end of a stay cable and a mass block are connected to the top of the rod unit; the other end of the inhaul cable penetrates through a pulley fixed on the ground, and provides a concentrated force for the other end of the inhaul cable; measuring the bending degree of the rod unit; the angle between the rod unit and the ground, the gravity load of the mass block and the concentrated force are determined based on the wind load and the gravity line load of the support insulator, which are distributed along the axial direction, and the rod unit is an equivalent structure of a parallel structure of the support insulator. The technical scheme provided by the invention solves the problem that a method and a measure for applying equivalent uniformly distributed wind load are lacked when the prior multi-section post insulator static bending test is carried out, and the condition that the wind load is uniformly distributed on the insulator post body can be more accurately simulated in a laboratory.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: High floor method
abstract_en: To protect a house from a flood disaster such as flood by raising an existing wooden house with a simple method.SOLUTION: There is provided a method for raising an existing wooden house by: drilling a plurality of holes for trestle in the foundation under a bedsill; inserting a plurality of H-shaped steels for trestle into the holes for trestle so as to simultaneously support and lift the entire bedsill of the wooden house; constructing a plurality of steel materials for lifting in its corners so as to surround the wooden house; mounting the H-shaped steels for hoisting on each top surface of both right and left ends of the H-shaped steels for lifting; fixing upper flanges of the H-shaped steels for trestle and lower flanges of the H-shaped steels for hoisting with flange fixtures and mounting pulleys on the H-shaped steels for hoisting; mounting pulleys on the upper part of the H-shaped steels for lifting; and winding wire ropes mounted on the pulleys by winding machines.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Urban rail transit road network peak large passenger flow dredging system
abstract_en: The invention provides a system for dredging the peak large passenger flow of an urban rail transit road network. The system comprises a data management server, a data management server and a data management server, wherein the data management server is used for storing and maintaining data related to road networks, passenger flows and evacuation; the passenger flow congestion identification server is used for calculating the space-time congestion bottleneck and congestion category of large passenger flows according to Monte Carlo simulation of passenger flow random occurrence and road network transfer by taking a line network structure and a train operation plan as basic constraints; the dispersion range calculation server is used for calculating a passenger flow control alternative set and a station-jumping alternative set which meet the travel accessibility according to the large passenger flow space-time congestion bottleneck and the congestion category; and the passenger flow dispersion server is used for calculating a passenger flow dispersion scheme through reinforcement learning according to the passenger flow control alternative set and the station-skipping alternative set meeting the travel accessibility and the setting information of the passenger flow dispersion. The method provides technical support for the congestion identification and the collaborative dispersion of the urban rail transit network, and provides support for improving the operation service level of the network and the safety of passengers.

title_en: Coal mine emergency rescue drilling system based on human-computer environment multi-factor cooperation
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine emergency rescue drilling system based on human-computer environment multi-factor cooperation, which comprises: the system comprises a drilling client, a drilling algorithm server and a drilling data server; the method comprises the steps that a drilling client receives disaster parameter information and initialization data which are set externally; the method comprises the steps that a drilling algorithm server receives disaster parameter information and initialization data sent by a drilling client, requests drilling data from the drilling algorithm server, calculates and simulates the running state and disaster occurrence scenes of an underground equipment system according to all acquired information and a plurality of algorithms stored in the drilling algorithm server, and sends the simulated data to the drilling client; and the drilling client displays the simulation site after receiving the simulation data. The invention effectively simulates the development dynamics of coal mine accidents and rescue actions, and the cooperative drilling with participation of multiple roles provides a brand-new mode for emergency rescue drilling.
assignees: GUONENG SHENDONG COAL GROUP CORPORATION LTD;CHINA ENERGY SHENDONG COAL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Transformer fire simulation and fire extinguishing experimental system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power systems, and particularly relates to a transformer fire simulation and fire extinguishing experimental system. The transformer fire simulation and fire extinguishing experimental system comprises a transformer fire simulation device, a measurement module and a fire extinguishing module. The transformer fire simulation device comprises a transformer model and an oil injection pipeline, wherein the transformer model comprises a supporting box body and an oil pool arranged on the supporting box body, a temperature rise component used for heating oil is arranged in the oil pool, and the oil injection pipeline is connected with the oil pool. The measuring module is arranged at the periphery of the transformer fire simulation device and used for measuring combustion data. The fire extinguishing module comprises a fire extinguishing pipeline and a flow supply device connected with the fire extinguishing pipeline, and the fire extinguishing pipeline is arranged on the periphery of the transformer fire simulation device. The test system can simulate the condition of the reduction transformer in fire, regulate and control the initial oil temperature before the fire, and analyze key parameters influencing the fire development and the fire extinguishing effect of the transformer.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network resilience and reliability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the resilience and reliability of a power distribution network, which are used for establishing a reliability model of power distribution system elements and determining the type of the influence of each element fault on each load in the reliability model of the power distribution system elements by using a minimum path method; establishing a fault influence table, simulating the operation of the power distribution system by using a Monte Carlo method, and reconstructing a power distribution system network when a fault occurs; and inquiring the corresponding influence type in the fault influence table, counting the power failure times and the power failure time, and calculating the reliability index according to the power failure times and the power failure time to realize reliability evaluation. The method can recover more loads, reduce the load shedding amount, improve the restoring force of the system after disaster and improve the elasticity of the power system.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Crack identification method, crack identification device, electronic device and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a crack identification method, a crack identification device, electronic equipment and a medium, wherein the crack identification method comprises the following steps: acquiring microseismic monitoring data; determining a clustering result of the microseismic monitoring data based on the microseismic event clustering model; the microseismic event clustering model is obtained by training based on a Gaussian mixture model in advance; and carrying out visual processing on the microseismic monitoring data based on the clustering result to obtain a three-dimensional clustering coordinate graph. The method can automatically identify the cracks, improves the accuracy, and has important guiding significance for researching the mixed crack evolution rule and forecasting and early warning of dynamic disasters.

title_en: Simulated torrent device for rescue training on water surface
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue training is with simulation torrent device based on the surface of water, including the body that has the training passageway, characterized by the body includes following region along length direction: head water injection district, rolling dam training district, torrent are played boat and are waded water training district and afterbody export district, head water injection district is equipped with a set of water pump and slope impact section, rolling dam training district is equipped with along horizontal plane downwardly extending's formula of sinking arc structure, torrent is played boat and is waded water training district and be equipped with the obstacle. The situation of natural river channels when flood disasters and torrents occur is simulated, the training can be carried out without seasonal influence, the water flow is controllable, multiple safety protection measures are arranged, and even if the situation occurs during the training, the water can be cut off in time to ensure the safety; the device is suitable for various training subjects such as torrent boat lifesaving, wading crossing, people getting rid of difficulties, drifting, rope crossing and the like; the existing water source in the water area is utilized, so that the environment is protected and the energy is saved.
assignees: HANGZHOU LIANGYI WATER AND ELECTRICITY INSTALLATION CO LTD

title_en: VR analogue means based on platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a VR simulation device based on a platform, which comprises a platform and a base, wherein both sides of the platform are fixedly connected with support columns, insertion grooves are arranged in the support columns, extension bars are connected in the insertion grooves in a sliding way, an outer ring is fixedly connected between the two extension bars, a door ring is hinged on the outer ring, annular grooves are formed in the inner side walls of the outer ring and the door ring, an inner ring is arranged in the center of the outer ring, a plurality of rolling shafts are rotatably connected on the outer side wall of the inner ring, the rolling shafts roll in the annular grooves, soft pads are fixedly connected at two ends of the inner ring, and the two soft pads are both fixedly connected with binding ropes, the base is fixedly connected with a bracket, the bracket is connected with VR glasses through a lead, the utility model fastens the binding ropes at the two sides to ensure that the soft pads are attached to the waist of a user, thereby fix the waist of user in the inner ring and support, avoid the disaster picture of simulation to cause the user to tumble out of control.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHENNING SEMICONDUCTOR RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Simulation method for mechanical behavior and energy evolution of gas-containing coal-rock combined structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for mechanical behaviors and energy evolution of a gas-containing coal-rock combined structure, which utilizes numerical simulation to study the mechanical behaviors and the dynamic evolution of energy of different coal-rock combined structures, obtains the energy proportion of rock elastic energy in the combined structure according to the maximum value of the respective elastic energy of coal-rock in the combined structure, further clearly determines the energy transmission and the mutual influence mechanism of the coal-rock, and can take targeted top-bottom plate treatment measures according to different influence degrees of the elastic energy of a top plate and a bottom plate on the basis, thereby realizing the accurate prevention and control of mine dynamic disasters under the influence of the elastic energy of the top plate and the bottom plate.

title_en: Sparse LSTM landslide dynamic prediction method based on Cauchy disturbance sparrow optimization
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of landslide prediction, and discloses a sparse LSTM landslide prediction method based on Cauchy disturbance sparrow optimization. Aiming at the fact that shallow landslide is easily affected by rainfall, reservoir water level, natural environment and other external 'small sample' factors, a LSTM model which represents sparseness is established, essential data characteristics of disaster causing factors are extracted, and the disaster causing factor selection space of weak landslide is reduced. Secondly, aiming at the conditions of over-deep sparse LSTM training level and high calculation complexity, designing an SSA model to optimize four super parameters of hidden nerve unit number, learning rate, batch processing number and iteration times in the LSTM; meanwhile, a Cauchy disturbance strategy is designed to develop a global optimal solution region, so that LSTM network structure compactness optimization based on sparse representation is realized, and landslide displacement prediction accuracy is improved. The invention combines the sparse representation capability of small sample landslide data, LSTM dynamic prediction advantage and the compactness optimization of CSSA algorithm to the network structure, and effectively solves the problems of weak prediction capability and high calculation complexity and cost of small sample data in landslide prediction.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for analyzing and monitoring vulnerability fingerprint silence
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for analyzing and monitoring vulnerability fingerprint silence, wherein the method comprises the steps of training a vulnerability script of a vulnerability scanning engine, and detecting vulnerability samples by the trained vulnerability scanning engine according to a user-defined vulnerability framework; after the vulnerability sample detection is completed, training vulnerability conditions by adopting a modeling algorithm and analyzing vulnerability scanning results through self-learning; and (4) adding a network space mapping function to generate an asset report while scanning the vulnerability, and displaying the asset report by adopting a UI (user interface). Based on the method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for analyzing and monitoring the vulnerability fingerprint silence are also provided. The vulnerability framework is customized, the uploading script is written in time for the latest vulnerability to be detected, and the emergency response is timely and accurate. The method aims to reduce internal loopholes, standardize network security behaviors, discover and dispose existing potential safety hazards in advance, greatly improve the network security protection level and discover the attack risk of equipment and a system in time.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-station flood process random simulation method considering historical extreme flood characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction in drainage basins, in particular to a random simulation method for a multi-station flood process considering historical extreme flood characteristics. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-station flood simulation model considering high-order self-cross correlation, generating a multi-station flood simulation sample library, combining historical extreme flood characteristics, generating a flood characteristic sequence set considering historical extreme flood, and obtaining the multi-station simulation flood sequence considering the historical flood characteristics by matching and searching in the multi-station flood simulation sample library according to a main station flood characteristic sequence. The method can solve the problems that the existing random simulation technology is adopted to limit the multi-station flood simulation process due to the reasons of model complexity and the like, most of the problems only consider the low-order correlation characteristics of the flood process of each station, and the high-order autocorrelation and cross-correlation structures among the super-standard flood processes of each station of the river basin are difficult to characterize.

title_en: Skill training lean management method based on data backtracking analysis and fine-grained intention recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of skill training proficiency, and discloses a skill training proficiency management method based on data backtracking analysis and fine-grained intention recognition. According to the skill training lean management method based on data backtracking analysis and fine-grained intention recognition, through reducing disputes and mastering facts, the capability of handling problems is improved, the cooperation of teams is effectively improved, the loss rate of personnel is reduced, the linkage of disasters is cut off through a scientific method, and the capability of preventing and eliminating all potential safety hazards is improved.
assignees: SKILLS TRAINING CENTER STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD
