title_en: Accurate gas disaster prediction method based on drilling multi-element information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gas disaster accurate prediction method based on drilling multi-element information, which belongs to the field of gas disaster prediction and comprises the following steps of S1: monitoring a drilling position or drilling depth L of drilling construction, a drilling machine working condition W, gas flow q, orifice air pressure p, drilling cuttings quantity S, drilling cuttings sorting coefficient r, drilling cuttings color G, carbon monoxide concentration y and orifice gas slag temperature T; s2: determining the drilling position and depth of a drilling machine through the drilling position or the drilling depth or the drilling cuttings amount or the working condition of the drilling machine; s3: grading disasters or risks; s4: gas disaster perspective along the drilling position of the drill hole; s5: working face gas disaster perspective; s6: geological structure and risk perspective of the working face; s7: occurrence and risk perspective of a working face coal seam; s8: working face stress risk perspective; s9: drilling fire risk perspective.

title_en: Fire image detection method, system, equipment and storage medium based on video
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire image detection method, a fire image detection system, fire image detection equipment and a storage medium based on a video, and aims to solve the problem that static and moving objects close to flames are prone to generating false alarm on the basis of ensuring the flame detection effect. Firstly, constructing positive and negative sample data sets, training a convolutional neural network I as a fire detection model to detect whether suspected flames exist in data, and acquiring positive and negative sample classification data sets; judging whether the suspected flame moves or not by utilizing motion detection; and training a convolution nerve II as a flame false alarm classification model according to the positive and negative sample classification data sets to judge whether the suspected flame is false alarm or not, so that the false alarm times are reduced on the premise of ensuring the flame detection effect. When the classification result is false alarm, the next frame image is continuously processed; and when the classification result is flame, indicating that a fire disaster occurs, and immediately informing related personnel. The invention detects whether a fire occurs in real time through video monitoring and marks the position of flame, thereby early warning the occurrence of the fire and reducing the fire hazard.
assignees: HUANENG YANCHENG DAFENG NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST;HUANENG INT ELECTRIC POWER JIANGSU ENERGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;HUANENG INT ELECTRIC POWER JIANGSU ENERGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH

title_en: The method to build and use map library datasets
title_ko: 맵 라이브러리 데이터셋 구축 및 활용방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of constructing and utilizing a map library dataset which can effectively utilize grid-based spatial information by constructing a map library service-based dataset which can be usefully utilized in a typhoon situation. That is, the present invention is a system consisting of an operating computer with a built-in program (GIS-based integrated situation management system) for predicting storm and flood damage based on information related to natural disasters including wind and flood damage, and a simulation monitor connected to the operating computer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 태풍상황에서 유용하게 활용될 수 있는 맵 라이브러리 서비스 기반의 데이터셋을 구축함으로써, 격자 기반의 공간정보를 효과적으로 활용할 수 있도록 하는 맵 라이브러리 데이터셋 구축 및 활용방법에 관한 것이다. 즉, 풍수해를 포함한 자연재난 관련정보들과, 상기 정보들에 의해 풍수해를 예측하기 위한 프로그램(GIS 기반 통합상황 관리시스템)이 내장된 운영컴퓨터와, 상기 운영컴퓨터와 연결된 시뮬레이션용 모니터로 구성되어진 시스템에서, 상기 프로그램에 의해 다음과 같은 과정으로 수행되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 1) 상기 자연재난 관련정보들이, 재난이 발생된 위치정보와 재난유형별 정보가 결합된 상태로 상기 운영컴퓨터의 프로그램에 입력되는 과정; 2) 상기 1)과정에서 입력된 자연재난 관련정보들 중 재난유형별 정보만을 이용하여 상기 프로그램에 의한 재난위험도 평가가 이뤄지도록 하기 위해,  재난유형별 정보들이 상기 프로그램에 의해, 재난의 크기 및 피해발생의 범위를 판별하기 위한 것으로 피해의 직접적 원인이 되는 자연현상에 대한 위해성 정보와, 피해에 노출된 정도 및 범위를 판별하기 위한 것으로 재난으로 인한  피해 대상의 노출성 정보와, 피해를 심화시킬 수 정도 및 범위를 판별하기 위한 것으로 재난 위험 피해의 심화 가능성에 대한 취약성 정보의 세가지(예를 들어,재난위해요소, 노출요소, 태풍심화요소 등)로 대분류되어지고, 대분류된 재난유형별 정보들은 상기 프로그램에 의해 세부화되어 최종 데이터셋인 지표들(하천, 처주지, 도로 교량, 철도 항만 등)로 분류하는데, 이와 같이 세분화된 지표들은 동일 또는 유사한 것이 발생하므로 동일 또는 유사한 것을 묶어서 대표성을 가진 명칭(예를 들어, 공공시설-기타, 공공시설-교통인프러, 사회적특성요소, 지형특성요소 등)으로 중분류되며, 상기 중분류된 대표성을 명칭에 대응되도록 상기 지표들이 소분류되는 과정; 3) 상기 2)과정에서 대,중,소 분류된 자연재난 관련정보들이 상기 프로그램에 의해 각각의 분류에 대한 가중치가 정해지고, 각각의 분류에 대한 가중치를 모두 곱하여 구한 최종가중치를 구하며, 상기 최종가중치들은 상기 대분류된 자연재난 관련정보(위해성정보, 노출성 정보, 취약성 정보)별로 합산되어 각 자연재난 관련정보에 대한 재난위험도로 평가되는 과정; 4) 상기 1)과정에서 입력된 자연재난 관련정보들 중 재난 발생 위치정보만을 이용하여 상기 프로그램에 의해 지오코딩(Geocoding)되어 위도 및 경도의 좌표(x,y)로 변환되는 과정; 5) 상기 4)과정에서 지오코딩(Geocoding)된 재난 발생 위치정보를 사용하여 상기 프로그램에 의해 상기 3)과정에 구한 대분류된 자연재난 관련정보(위해성정보, 노출성 정보, 취약성 정보)별 최종가중치들이 디지털 지도공간에 포인트별 중첩적으로 표출되어 상기 모니터에 의해 시뮬레이션되어지되, 평시에는 상기 2), 3)과정에서 노출성 정보와, 취약성 정보에 대해 대,중,소 분류된 재난유형별 정보들만으로 구한 최종가중치들이 디지털 지도공간에 포인트별 중첩적으로 표출되고, 재해발생시에는 상기 2), 3)과정에서 위해성 정보와, 노출성 정보에 대해 대,중,소 분류된 재난유형별 정보들만으로 구한 최종가중치들이 디지털 지도공간에 포인트별 중첩적으로 표출되며, 재해복구시에는 상기 2), 3)과정에서 노출성 정보와, 취약성 정보에 대해 대,중,소 분류된 재난유형별 정보들만으로 구한 최종가중치들이 디지털 지도공간에 포인트별 중첩적으로 표출되는 과정.

title_en: Grid-based data conversion method for constructing, managing, and utilizing disaster information
title_ko: 재난정보의 구축, 관리, 활용을 위한 격자 기반 데이터 변환방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a grid-based data conversion method for constructing, managing, and utilizing disaster information includes: a metadata information determining process; a lattice transformation process; a standard scoring process; a weight calculation process; and a fusion lattice generating process. Therefore, people can gain intuitive insight by quickly and easily merging a lot of spatial information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 공간정보를 쉽고 빠르게 융합함으로써 사람들에게 직관적인 통찰이 가능하도록 제공하기 위한 재난정보의 격자 기반 데이터 변환방법에 관한 것으로,  
점, 선, 면 등의 다양한 벡터 데이터를 쉽고 빠르게 격자로 변환한 후 융합할 수 있는 기반을 제공함으로써, 향후 쏟아지는 다양한 재난대응 정보들을 활용할 수 있도록 벡터의 격자 변환 기술을 개발하였다.  
즉, 자연재난과 관련된 수많은 정보들과, 상기 정보들에 의해 풍수해를 예측하기 위한 프로그램이 내장된 운영컴퓨터와, 풍수해를 시뮬레이션하기 위한 모니터로 구성되어진 시스템에서, 상기 프로그램에 의해 다음과 같은 과정으로 수행되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
1) 상기 자연재난과 관련된 수많은 정보들이 유입되면 피해시설에 대한 위치정보를 토대로 점,선,면 등의 벡터 유형 별 격자 데이터로 변환하기 위해, 먼저 국가지점번호를 기반으로 격자사양을 정의하는 과정으로서, 격자 기반의 공간정보서비스에서 제공하는 격자사양에 대한 정의, 개념적 모델, 상세사항(원점, 공간적 범위, 좌표참조체계, 구성격자의 크기, 계층구조, 격자셀의 형태/크기/식별자 등) 등의 메타데이터 정보를 결정하는 과정, 
2) 데이터를 공간상에 표현하기 위한 위치정보와 개체 특성을 묘사하기 위한 속성정보로 이루어진 공간데이터들을 격자기반 데이터로 변환하는 과정으로서, 속성정보 측면에서 벡터 데이터를 포인트(point), 폴리라인(polyline), 폴리곤(polygon)의 세 가지 유형별로 격자 변환하기 위해,  포인트(point), 폴리라인(polyline), 폴리곤(polygon)의 대푯값을 결정하되, 먼저 PRIORITY에 의해 결정하고, PRIORITY가 같은 경우에는 METHOD에 따라 결정함으로써, 포인트(point), 폴리라인(polyline), 폴리곤(polygon)을 각각 격자 레스터로 변환하며, 선이나 면 데이터를 격자로 변환하기 위해 중첩되는 격자의 면적에 따라 속성값을 분배하는 면적분배법에 의한 격자변환방법을 함께 사용하는 격자 변환과정과, 
3) 2)과정에서 격자 변환된 데이터를 표준 점수화하는 과정으로서, 원점수(raw score)의 상대적 위치를 확인하기 위해, 어떤 점수와 평균 간의 차이, 즉 편차를 표준편차로 나누어서 변환해줌으로써 Z-Score와 T-Score로 표준화한 값을 할당해주는 표준점수(standard score)화 과정, 
4) 지표 간 상대적 중요도와 각 지표들이 평가 결과에 미치는 영향 정도를 고려하여 3)과정에서 얻은 표준점수에 가중치를 적용해줌으로써 최종 융합 격자를 생성하게되는 가중치 산정과정, 
5) 4)과정에서 얻은 가중치가 적용된 표준점수들을 모두 융합하여 하나의 수치를 도출하는 융합 격자 생성과정.

title_en: A method of plotting spatiotemporal change patterns using grid-based data
title_ko: 격자기반 데이터를 활용한 시공간적 변화 패턴 도시방법
abstract_en: The present invention is to set a schematic standard for optimizing the visibility and readability of map information. Performed in a system comprising an operating computer and a monitor are the steps of: constructing a "map library" dataset; additionally configuring metadata (layer information) for data management; and quickly visualizing trend analysis results on a two-dimensional map.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 기초정보, 태풍정보, 태풍 위험지역 융합정보 구성 지표를 포함한 “맵 라이브러리” 데이터셋, 변환 및 융합격자, 시계열 분석격자에 대해 지도정보의 시인성과 가독성 최적화를 위한 도식기준을 설정하기 위한 것으로, 
자연재난과 관련된 수많은 정보들과, 상기 정보들에 의해 풍수해를 예측하기 위한 프로그램이 내장된 운영컴퓨터와, 풍수해를 시뮬레이션하기 위한 모니터로 구성되어진 시스템에서, 상기 프로그램에 의해 다음과 같은 과정으로 수행되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
1) 상기 자연재난과 관련된 수많은 정보들이 유입되면, 기초정보의 행정경계 정보들, 태풍정보 등의 원천데이터를 선별하여 "맵 라이브러리" 데이터셋을 구성하는 과정으로서, 상기 기초정보의 행정경계 정보들은 그 자체로 활용되는 것이 아니라 주로 다른 레이어와 동시 표출하여 활용되기 위한 것이며, 다른 레이어의 피처들이 어떤 행정구역 내에 포함되는지 확인할 때 주로 이용되기 때문에 레이어 투명도를 0으로 설정하여 다른 레이어의 피쳐들이 가시화될 수 있도록 설정하는 과정, 
2) 상기 "맵 라이브러리" 데이터셋에 대한 점, 선, 면의 벡터정보를 기초 격자 변환하고, 변환된 다수 격자를 하나의 격자로 융합하되, 데이터 관리를 위한 메타데이터(레이어정보)를 추가로 구성하는 과정, 
3) 격자는 시간의 흐름에도 동일한 형태와 면적을 보존하여서 시계열 분석에 효과적이므로, 2)과정에서 변환 및 융합된 격자정보를 시계열 Emerging Hot Spot 기법에 의해 2차원의 공간정보를 시간의 흐름에 따라 3차원의 Space Time Cube로 생성한 후, 각 격자의 시간 경향에 따른 핫스팟, 콜드스팟의 경향성을 여러 패턴으로 시계열 분석한 다음, 각 격자마다 시간의 흐름에 따른 경향성 분석결과를 2차원 지도에 빠르게 가시화하는 과정.

title_en: Time series visualization method of disaster damage history
title_ko: 재난 피해이력 시계열 시각화 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a time-series visualization method for a disaster damage history, which enables even an unprofessional person to easily analyze a special situation, such as a disaster and the like, comprising the processes of: databasing information related to natural disasters; forming databased disaster information in a table form; expressing the radius and a path of a disaster; and calculating the similarity of the disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 피해이력을 시계열로 시각화하는 방법에 관한 것으로,  자연재난과 관련된 정보들과, 상기 정보들에 의해 풍수해를 예측하기 위한 프로그램이 내장된 운영컴퓨터와, 풍수해를 시뮬레이션하기 위한 모니터로 구성되어진 시스템에서, 상기 프로그램에 의해 다음과 같은 과정으로 수행되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 1) 상기 자연재난과 관련된 정보들이 유입되면, 재해연보의 원인별 시군구별 총 피해금액과 복구비 및 시설별 상세 피해금액을 데이터베이스화하되, 피해기간과 원인을 토대로 과거 재난과 연계시켜 작업하는 과정, 2) 상기 데이터베이스화된 재해 정보들이 발생연월, 강도, 크기, 최대풍속, 이동속도, 중심기압, 피해금액과 복구비와 같이, 재난 주요정보와 피해/복구 비로 테이블화되는 과정, 3) 상기 테이블화된 재해 정보들이 지도 위에 매핑됨으로써 지도 표출 창에 재해 반경과 경로가 표출되어지는 과정, 4) 1)과정에서 데이터베이스화된 다수 재해 정보들 중에서 어느 한 재해정보를 기준재난으로 하고, 나머지 재해정보들 중에서 비교재난을 선택하며, 3)과정에서 매핑된 재해 정보들이 상기 기준재난과 비교재난에 대해 지도 상에 함께 표시됨으로써 재난의 유사성이 산정되는데, 상기 재난의 유사성은 기준재난과 비교재난 간의 이동경로, 중심기압, 상륙지점의 조건에 의해 산정되어지되, 재난 간의 이동경로에 의한 유사성 산정 방법은, 재난이 우리나라 경계구역 내 진입 시를 시작지점으로 하고, 우리나라 경계구역를 벗어날 시를 종료지점으로 하며, 기준재난과 비교재난 각각의 시작지점으로부터 종료지점까지의 거리의 총합을 구하고 지점의 총수로 나누어서 평균을 계산하고, 기준재난과 비교재난 간의 평균거리를 내림차순으로 정렬하여 최솟값을 기준으로 유사성이 산정되고, 중심기압의 차이에 의한 유사성 산정방법은, 재난이 우리나라 경계구역 내 진입 시 기준재난과 비교재난 간 중심기압 차이의 절대값을 계산한 후, 계산값을 내림차순으로 정렬하여 최솟값을 기준으로 유사성이 산정되며, 상륙지점의 차이에 의한 유사성 산정방법은, 재난이 우리나라 경계구역 내 진입 여부를 판단하고, 진입한 경우 상륙지점의 시도로 구분하고, 진입하지 않은 경우 서해경로 또는 동해경로로 구분하여 총 세가지로 구분하여 유사성이 산정됨으로써, 기준재난과 비교재난 간의 이동경로, 중심기압, 상륙지점의 조건이 단일 또는 복수 조합에 의해 재난의 유사성이 산정되는 과정.

title_en: Disaster evacuation training and customized advertisement system based on virtual reality, a training method thereof
title_ko: 가상현실 기반의 재난 대피 훈련과 이와 관련된 상품의 맞춤형 광고 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster evacuation training based on virtual reality (VR) capable of training an appropriate response method for a disaster environment, a customized advertisement system for products related thereto, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the customized advertisement system comprises: a user terminal, a storage unit storing data, and a control unit. The control unit includes: a user management module, a disaster situation module; an evaluation module evaluating a user's mission performance status; a safety product management module recommending two or more types of safety products from a safety product database; and an advertisement module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 환경에 대한 적절한 대응 방법을 훈련할 수 있고, 각 재난에 대비한 안전용품에 대한 이해, 그리고 나에게 맞는 재난 관련 상품을 제공하는 광고를 제공하는 가상현실 기반의 재난 대피 훈련과 이와 관련된 상품의 맞춤형 광고 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 가상현실 기반의 재난 대피 훈련과 이와 관련된 상품의 맞춤형 광고 시스템은 사용자 단말기; 데이터가 저장되는 저장부; 및 제어부를 포함하는 것이고, 상기 사용자 단말기는, 전송된 가상 시뮬레이션을 출력하는 디스플레이부; 및 로그인 된 사용자의 동작을 포함하는 임의의 명령을 입력받는 입력부를 포함하고 상기 저장부는, 사용자 정보가 저장된 사용자데이터베이스; 가상의 맵이 저장된 맵데이터베이스; 가상의 재난상황이 저장된 재난상황데이터베이스; 가상의 안전용품이 저장된 안전용품데이터 베이스; 및 광고상품, 광고되는 상품 정보, 광고되는 가상의 안전용품이 저장된 광고상품데이터베이스를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는, 사용자데이터베이스로부터 로그인 된 사용자의 정보를 로드 하고, 상기 사용자데이터베이스를 업데이트 하는 사용자관리모듈; 재난상황데이터베이스로부터 선택된 맵에 적용할 적용할 가상의 재난상황을 선택하고, 상기 맵 위에 로드하고 정해진 미션을 사용자 단말기로 전송하는 재난상황모듈; 사용자 정보, 맵의 종류, 재난의 종류, 사용자의 행동패턴을 포함하는 정보를 임의의 가중치가 적용된 기준에 따라 분석하여 사용자의 미션 수행 상황을 평가하는 평가모듈; 사용자의 미션 수행 상황의 분석결과를 기초로, 가상의 안전용품데이터 베이스에서 2종 이상의 안전용품을 추전하는 안전용품관리모듈; 상기 평가모듈의 평가 점수를 기반으로 광고상품데이터베이스에 저장된 광고 대상 중 광고 상품을 선택하여 사용자 단말기로 상기 광고 상품의 정보를 제공하는 광고모듈;을 포함하는 것일 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for evacuation route guidance of occupants using augmented reality of mobile devices
title_ko: 휴대 기기의 증강현실을 이용한 재실자의 피난 경로 안내 방법 및 이를 위한 시스템
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention provides a system for an evacuation route guidance of occupants using augmented reality of a mobile device, which includes: a portable device carried by an occupant in which an evacuation guidance application is installed to suggest an evacuation route from a current location of the occupant to an evacuation site in case of a disaster; and a server which provides information on a plurality of evacuation routes to the mobile device, wherein the mobile device is configured to: display an evacuation guidance interface by executing an evacuation guidance application; display a captured landscape image in an image display area of the evacuation guidance interface; display any one of the plurality of evacuation routes set based on detailed information related to a type of disaster, user's exercise ability, and personal situation on a map display area of the evacuation guidance interface; and overlap the landscape image on the image display area to display guide information for indicating a direction to move from the current location along the evacuation route displayed on the map display area.
abstract_ko: 실시예는, 재해 발생 시 재실자의 현재 위치에서 피난장소까지의 피난 경로를 제시하기 위한 피난 유도 어플리케이션이 인스톨된 재실자가 휴대한 휴대 기기; 및 상기 휴대 기기로 복수의 피난 경로 정보를 제공하는 서버;를 포함하고, 상기 휴대 기기는 상기 피난 유도 어플리케이션을 실행하여 피난 유도 인터페이스를 표시하고, 상기 휴대 기기는 촬영한 풍경 영상을 상기 피난 유도 인터페이스의 영상 표시 영역에 표시하고, 재해의 종류, 사용자의 운동 능력, 개인 상황과 관련된 세부 정보에 기초하여 설정된 상기 복수의 피난 경로 중 어느 하나를 상기 피난 유도 인터페이스의 지도 표시 영역 상에 표시하고, 상기 휴대 기기는 상기 영상 표시 영역 상에 상기 풍경 영상과 중첩하여 상기 지도 표시 영역 상에 표시된 피난 경로를 따라 현재 위치에서 이동할 방향을 표시하기 위한 가이드 정보를 표시하는 휴대 기기의 증강현실을 이용한 피난 경로 안내하기 위한 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Hydrology water resource sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydrology and water resource sampling device, which comprises an operation cabin, wherein the bottom of the operation cabin is provided with a bottom plate, the bilateral symmetry of the bottom plate is provided with first chutes, the insides of the two sets of first chutes are all provided with first sliding blocks in a sliding manner, the bottoms of the two sets of first sliding blocks are all hinged with hinge rods, the bottoms of the two sets of hinge rods are all hinged with first connecting blocks, the bottoms of the two sets of first connecting blocks are all provided with supporting plates, the bottoms of the two sets of supporting plates are uniformly provided with five sets of ground grabbing teeth, and the tops of the two sets of first connecting blocks penetrate through the inside of the bottom plate and are provided with second threaded rods; the utility model discloses a mutually supporting between first threaded rod, first external screw thread sleeve pipe, drill bit, driving motor, control panel, scale strip and the U type frame can be so that the device can be accurate the degree of depth of record drilling to can make accurate aassessment to the hydrology information here, avoid being attacked by natural disasters.
assignees: XIAMEN JIULIXIN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multipurpose drilling for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multipurpose drilling hole for coal mine, wherein a first drilling hole and a second drilling hole play a role in coal body pressure relief in the early stage of coal mine stoping, and can be networked for pre-pumping before gas mining, and during stoping, high-pressure water is used for punching, and static-pressure water is used for injecting water for keeping, so that water molecules are fully contacted with coal body cracks, the moist coal body is covered in an all-dimensional and three-dimensional manner from top to bottom, the oxidation speed of the coal body is delayed, and the drilling hole plays triple roles of fire prevention and extinguishing hole, pressure relief hole and dustproof hole; after recovery, saline water and yellow mud can be poured into the drill holes, the slurry covers the coal body in the goaf to humidify and cool, isolate oxygen and slow down the oxidation speed of the coal body, the slurry is deposited and then fills the cracks of the coal body to prevent the oxidation of the coal body, and when the goaf has the sign of natural ignition, the high-position drill holes can be used for pouring high-molecular fire prevention and extinguishing materials such as gel and the like, so that the multiple purposes of one hole are realized, the drilling engineering quantity is greatly reduced, the disaster prevention cost of enterprises is greatly reduced, and the economic benefit is obvious.
assignees: SHAANXI BINCHANG MINING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Borehole orifice pipe fixing device for underground exploration
abstract_en: A fixing device for an underground exploration drilling orifice pipe relates to a jig for a coal mine, the original orifice pipe sealing device technology is not closed, the gas pressure and the water pressure are too large to cause the drilling orifice pipe to fall off, so that disasters such as gas, water and the like are abnormally emitted and leaked, and economic loss and safety accidents are caused, the utility model discloses a setting an orifice closing cover and a leakage-proof device at the orifice of the orifice pipe, the orifice closing cover is provided with a monitoring release pipe, a pressure monitoring meter, a pressure connecting pipe, a pressure release pipe and a pressure release valve, when grouting, the pressure change can be detected, and the grouting degree can be reflected, the utility model shortens the grout solidification time, increases the compressive strength, the orifice pipe has strong pressure resistance, has high safety performance without gas and water leakage, and the grouting reinforcement is carried out by adopting the device for rock stratum crack in the underground, the additional construction of grouting is avoided, and the hole is multipurpose, has great economic benefit.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL MINING HANCHENG MINING CO LTD

title_en: Disaster relief tent
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a relief of disaster tent, including the support, four seted up the standing groove in the support, the standing groove is offered in order to place the part, four the standing groove is close to middle part one end and runs through to rotate and is connected with the gear, and the gear rotates through connecting axle and support to be connected, four the meshing of gear side is connected with the rack, and the gear drives the rack and moves, and the rack drives the fixed block and removes, and the fixed block drives the turning block and removes, and the turning block also can rotate at the removal in-process to drive the drill bit and rotate, improve fixed efficiency, guarantee the support and the fixed degree of depth in soil, guaranteed tent support's stability, four rack bottom fixedly connected with fixed block, four the fixed block is kept away from rack one end and is rotated and be connected with the turning block. The utility model discloses a set up fixing device, improved fixed efficiency, guaranteed the stationary stability, convenient operation, simple structure does benefit to the maintenance.
assignees: JINAN HITAC NEW MAT CO LTD

title_en: Underground mine soft rock roadway ground pressure safety early warning monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safety early warning and monitoring method for soft rock roadway ground pressure of an underground mine, and belongs to the technical field of heavy rail ultrasonic flaw detection methods. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: firstly, selecting a soft rock roadway which is very critical to safety production as a key monitoring area, and installing ground pressure monitoring equipment, wherein the ground pressure monitoring is mainly stress and deformation monitoring; then monitoring the pressure of the surrounding rock of the roadway and analyzing data, and monitoring the deformation of the surrounding rock of the roadway and analyzing the data; and finally, carrying out omnibearing remote dynamic monitoring. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the stress monitoring of the soft rock roadway surrounding rock and the deformation monitoring of the surrounding rock are closely linked to carry out comprehensive ground pressure monitoring, so that the continuous acquisition, online identification, intelligent analysis and disaster early warning of the underground mine soft rock roadway ground pressure dynamic information are realized, ground pressure disaster control measures are taken in time according to the monitoring condition, and the major disaster early warning capability of mine safety production is improved; the method has obvious effects of capturing the surrounding rock pressure and deformation rule of the roadway, is beneficial to the implementation of field organization, is economical and feasible, and can also provide reference for the design of a crushing stope bottom structure and a rock drilling chamber deformation monitoring system.
assignees: HEBEI IRON & STEEL GROUP SHAHE ZHONGGUAN IRON ORES CO LTD

title_en: Method for generating three-dimensional mine roadway model and constructing transparent working surface
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of virtual simulation of mines, and relates to a method for generating a three-dimensional mine roadway model and constructing a transparent working surface, which comprises the following steps: collecting modeling information of a roadway system and a transparent working face by using various conventional methods; processing the collected modeling information, and performing standardized and systematic storage by using a database technology; a 'parameterization' modeling method is provided, and a dynamic generation algorithm of a 'roadway and transparent working face' three-dimensional refined model is compiled based on the method; calling mapping and rendering technologies, and processing the constructed three-dimensional space model; an interactive operation function module is researched and developed to realize multi-functional operation display of a multi-level transparent model; optimizing and integrating an algorithm module, and researching and developing a tunnel and transparent working surface space model integrated dynamic reconstruction virtual simulation platform; the method is suitable for efficiently and dynamically constructing the mine roadway system and the transparent working face space refined model under different geological conditions, and provides support for intelligent comprehensive mining, disaster simulation and the like of the coal mine.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH NATIONAL SAFETY TRAINING CENTER OF COAL MINES;UNIV WUHAN SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Landslide cumulus soil and stone mixture water and soil characteristic curve testing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a landslide accumulated soil and stone mixture water and soil characteristic curve testing device, belonging to the landslide disaster prevention and reduction field, which comprises a pressure supply system (1), a pressure chamber (5) and a liquid collection and measurement system (7); the pressure chamber (5) is communicated with the pressure supply system (1) through a pressure pipe (2); a pressure gauge (3) and a pressure regulating valve (4) are arranged on the pressure chamber (5); the bottom of the pressure chamber (5) is communicated with a liquid outlet collecting and measuring system (7) through a liquid guide pipe (9); the utility model discloses can simulate the test to different landslide cumulus soil stone mixture matrix suction, establish certain basis for analysis landslide cumulus soil stone mixture hydrodynamic characteristic.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI;HUANENG GROUP TECH INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue practical training equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides an emergency rescue practical training device, which comprises a practical training box body and a practical training box cover; a fire blanket is laid in the practical training box body, a slot is formed in the side wall of the practical training box body, a plug board is inserted into the slot to divide the practical training box body into a left cavity and a right cavity, and the fire blanket is tightly pressed on the box bottom of the practical training box body; a fire extinguisher is arranged in the left cavity, and a small tool tray is arranged in the right cavity; a self-rescue rope, a compass, an emergency flashlight, an emergency whistle, emergency water and emergency food are arranged in the small tool tray. The device can be used for practical training and practice of emergency rescue, has a set of various practical training tools for emergency rescue, and is convenient to learn and use. And the practicality is stronger, can place this real standard equipment of emergency rescue in obvious position everywhere, when taking place the calamity, the use of can taking by the personnel in a disaster, and the instrument is practical and various, and whole practicality is extremely strong.
assignees: CHONGQING SHENGYUAN HESHUN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A air respirator simulation training equipment for training supplementarily
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air respirator simulation training device for auxiliary training, and belongs to the technical field of simulation training devices. The air respirator simulation training device comprises a model air cylinder, a back support, shoulder straps, a waistband and other parts, the shape of the simulation training device is the same as that of a positive pressure type air respirator, the air cylinder is of a hollow or solid structure, the air cylinder is fixed on the back support, the shoulder straps and the waistband are connected with the back support, an integrated design can be considered, and a firefighter can use the positive pressure type air respirator in daily training with high use frequency, is easy to damage and is difficult to repair after being damaged.

title_en: Geological disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster simulation device, which relates to the technical field of simulation devices and comprises a main body, wherein a protection frame is arranged at the top end of the main body, a top cover is sleeved at the top end of the protection frame, a simulation vibration machine is arranged at the top end of the main body, which is positioned in the protection frame, a rupture plate is arranged at the top end of the simulation vibration machine, and two groups of supporting blocks are arranged at the bottom end of the rupture plate on the inner wall of the protection frame. According to the utility model, the springs, the clamping beads and the supporting blocks are arranged, the breaking plate is vertically pressed downwards, the clamping beads are extruded by two ends of the breaking plate to move outwards until the bottom end of the breaking plate is contacted with the top end of the simulated vibration machine, and meanwhile, the springs push the clamping beads to extend into the grooves formed in two ends of the breaking plate, so that the breaking plate is installed in the protective frame, and then, when the breaking plate is installed, the trouble of using auxiliary tools is not needed, the workload during installation is reduced, and the convenience of the device is improved.
assignees: GUANGXI CHINA COAL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster model display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster model display device, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster display and comprises a base, wherein a coaming is connected to the top end of the base, a double-shaft motor is installed at the position, located on the inner side of the coaming, of the top end of the base, a connecting rod is connected to two ends of the double-shaft motor, an elliptical turntable is connected to one end of the connecting rod, a pushing plate is connected to the inner wall of the coaming, a supporting plate is connected to the top end of the pushing plate, guide rods are connected to two ends of the supporting plate, a guide block is connected to the connecting position of the inner wall of the coaming and the guide rods, a guide groove is formed in the guide block, and a buckle is connected to the position, located on the inner side of the guide groove, of the outer wall of the guide rod. According to the utility model, the guide block, the oval turntable, the buckle, the guide rod and the guide groove are arranged, and the support plate is driven by the oval turntable and the guide block to move transversely and longitudinally, so that the earthquake disaster simulation effect is better realized.
assignees: GUANGXI CHINA COAL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Anti-fault-breaking structure of drilling and blasting tunnel for crossing active fault
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tunnels and underground engineering, in particular to a drilling and blasting tunnel anti-dislocation structure for passing through a movable fault, which comprises a fault crushing zone expanding and digging section, a transition section and a common section, wherein the fault crushing zone expanding and digging section is positioned in a fault crushing zone, the common section is positioned in an upper disc and a lower disc with better lithology, the transition section is positioned between the fault crushing zone expanding and digging section and the common section, deformation joints are arranged on the anti-dislocation structure every other preset length, and water stopping structures are arranged between the joints. The anti-dislocation structure can adapt to the large displacement dislocation of the active fault and greatly reduce the expanding excavation amount; the fault dislocation device can adapt to fault dislocation in any direction, and the situation that the fault dislocation direction is uncertain is guaranteed; the water stopping structure is simple in arrangement; when the fault is dislocated, the secondary lining is not damaged, the stability and the safety of the internal structure of the tunnel are ensured, and the workload of post-disaster repair is small.

title_en: House pillar type goaf stability dynamic evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mining, and provides a room and column type goaf stability dynamic evaluation method and system, which comprise: constructing a first mapping relation between a plurality of groups of calculation data and a plurality of groups of model parameters of the room-and-pillar type goaf; based on a numerical model, obtaining simulation data of the coal pillars of the room-and-pillar type goaf according to the mechanical parameters of the coal rock bodies of the room-and-pillar type goaf in the lower-layer coal fully-mechanized mining dynamic stoping process; and adjusting model parameters of the numerical model according to monitoring data, simulation data and a first mapping relation at a preset monitoring point of the room and pillar type goaf in the lower-layer fully-mechanized coal mining dynamic stoping process so as to dynamically evaluate the stability of the room and pillar type goaf coal pillars. Therefore, the influence of the disturbance of the fully-mechanized mining of the lower coal on the room-and-column coal pillars is considered, and a scientific basis is provided for accurately evaluating the dynamic stability of the room-and-column goaf coal pillars, preventing and treating the suspended ceiling disaster of the large-area room-and-column goaf, constructing and supporting schemes for surrounding rocks of the roadway, and avoiding accidents such as pressing frame and roof dynamic disasters.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH NATIONAL SAFETY TRAINING CENTER OF COAL MINES;Shenmu Energy Bureau;CCTEG CHINA COAL RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Method for extracting and analyzing conditions of underlying surface of small watershed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting and analyzing the underlying surface condition of a small watershed, which comprises the following steps of S small watershed landform feature analysis: analyzing the relation between the small watershed water collection area threshold and the river source density, analyzing the small watershed slope converging form demarcation point, and performing river ratio, river length ratio and area ratio statistical analysis; s2, analyzing infiltration characteristics: processing soil texture data, analyzing lower body characteristics of a small watershed, and calculating soil infiltration influence depth and runoff producing time; s3, small watershed unit feature extraction: and analyzing the unit line by using the relation between the time and the area of the basin, and calculating the convergence time of each point of the basin to the outlet of the basin. The method can analyze the underlying surface condition of the divided national mountain torrent disaster small watershed attribute data set, and provides basic data support for solving the national mountain torrent disaster simulation forecast.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Coal mine multilayer key layer fracture type mine earthquake energy calculation and maximum mine earthquake prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine multilayer key layer fracture type mine earthquake energy calculation and maximum mine earthquake prediction method, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine earthquake prediction. The method comprises the steps of firstly, determining an overlying rock stratum of a coal face according to a drill hole near the face, dividing key layers, and determining the step pitch of the key layer fracture and other parameters; and then, calculating the energy generated when each key layer is fractured according to a mine earthquake energy calculation formula, converting the energy into corresponding Richter earthquake levels, and taking the mine earthquake generated when the largest main key layer is fractured as the predicted maximum mine earthquake in the production process of the working face, so that the establishment of measures for preventing and reducing earthquakes in the actual production process of the mine is guided, and the change of preventing and treating mine earthquake disasters from being passive to active is realized. The method is high in efficiency, economical, safe and targeted, and is suitable for mine earthquake induced by fracture of multiple key layers.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted comprehensive emergency command management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted comprehensive emergency command management system, and particularly relates to the technical field of emergency command management. The invention utilizes the three-dimensional model of the ground disaster in the three-dimensional model database of the ground disaster to demonstrate the ground disaster field in real time, and obtains the geologic body variation parameter of the ground disaster field in real time through the parameter obtaining module to establish the geologic body model closest to the ground disaster field, and then a remotely-located instructor can simulate and apply the treatment measure to the model through the parameter input module and observe the variation of the model under the treatment measure so as to help the instructor to judge the effectiveness of the treatment measure, thereby saving the time for the instructor to consider.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGKE HUAXING EMERGENCY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Skin exposure evaluation model and human health risk evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a skin exposure evaluation model and a human health risk evaluation method, and relates to the technical field of skin exposure dose evaluation and health risk evaluation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a toxic and harmful gas diffusion scene; establishing a skin exposure evaluation model; based on the distribution of concentration fields in the toxic and harmful gas diffusion scene, the skin exposure calculation model is used for realizing numerical simulation and exposure evaluation of the toxic and harmful gas in the external environment entering the human body through the skin. The application provides a coupling evaluation method comprehensively considering environment, clothes and human body, and safety evaluation and health risk prediction of skin exposure risks of dressers in a disaster environment are achieved.

title_en: Virtual earthquake disaster scene optimization method based on earthquake rescue virtual drilling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual earthquake disaster scene optimization method based on an earthquake rescue virtual drilling system, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a primary model; step 2, respectively establishing a macro disaster area model, a search area model and an operation field model according to the primary model by three layers of different detail degrees, wherein the different detail degree models correspond to different drilling tasks, and the earthquake rescue virtual drilling system comprises: an earthquake rescue drilling scene setting subsystem; an earthquake rescue drilling simulation subsystem; an earthquake rescue drilling efficiency evaluation subsystem; the step 1 comprises the following steps: establishing a seismic motion model and simulation according to the earthquake occurrence principle; building damage models and simulation are built according to the intensity and the building earthquake-resistant structure principle; according to the behavioral principle of the emergency, a disaster victim behavior model and simulation are established; establishing a secondary disaster model and simulation according to the earthquake secondary disaster theory; and establishing a department collaborative rescue model and simulation according to the actual earthquake rescue emergency plan.
assignees: XINXING JIHUA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;XINXING CATHAY INT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Distributed virtual simulation earthquake emergency drilling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed virtual simulation earthquake application exercise system, which comprises: the system comprises a seismic environment resource database, an immersion display and interaction subsystem, an escape plan generation subsystem, a modeling and simulation subsystem, a three-dimensional view real-time rendering subsystem, a virtual drilling evaluation subsystem, a virtual drilling recording and playback subsystem and a communication subsystem. The distributed interactive simulation technology and the virtual environment modeling method are used in the earthquake emergency exercise technology, an HLA high-rise system framework structure is used as a standard followed by the distributed interactive simulation, the earthquake disaster scene simulation and the earthquake emergency exercise virtual simulation exercise technology are subjected to necessary technical development of interaction between equipment and objects in the virtual environment, and the feeling and experience of immersing in the equivalent real environment are generated, so that the on-site feeling of a trainee is enhanced, and the quick response and emergency handling capacity of earthquake emergency management personnel are improved.

title_en: Automatic monitoring and early warning method and system for large-area hanging roof disasters in coal mine goaf
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for automatically monitoring and early warning a large-area suspended ceiling disaster in a coal mine goaf, wherein a monitoring and early warning area is determined on the ground according to the relative position relationship between the goaf and a surface building, a detection hole is drilled in the area, the detection hole is drilled into the detection area along the underground, and the detection area is monitored through the detection hole, so that the coal pillar failure between the goafs below the area can be effectively monitored, and the early warning effect is achieved; the method improves the monitoring performance and the early warning performance of the activation of the goaf formed by room-and-pillar type and short-wall type mining, has relatively low cost, adopts automatic endurance and automatic acquisition technology, can be used for a long time, saves the manpower and material resources required to be input, and further improves the production efficiency.
assignees: CHINA COAL XIAN DESIGN ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Method for preventing and treating water and mud bursting disasters of working face
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing and treating water and mud bursting disasters of a working face, which comprises the following steps: and (3) before the working face with water bursting and mud bursting disasters is mined under the preset geological conditions, detecting the water-rich area of the water-bearing layer of the roof, wherein the detection vertical depth is greater than the mining water diversion fissure zone development height. And according to the detected region, constructing a roof plate drill hole to drain water in a water-rich region of the main aquifer. In the drilling construction process, abnormal conditions such as drill sticking, hole collapse and the like are recorded, cores are taken from rock strata in a collapse zone, lithology characteristics are recorded, and the vertical distance between the thick-layer mudstone and a working face top plate is judged. Directional drilling is carried out on two crossheading near a working face in the stoping process, the position of a drilling final hole is located within 6m above a thick mudstone stratum top plate, separation accumulated water is drained through a construction horizontal hole, the distance between horizontal sections is 40m, and the drilling direction is parallel to the direction of the working face. Therefore, the method for preventing and treating the water and mud bursting disasters of the working face greatly reduces the probability of the water and mud bursting disasters and guarantees the safe production of the working face.
assignees: SHAANXI XUNYI QINGGANGPING MINING IND CO LTD;XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Method for detecting and judging risks of water and mud bursting disasters of working face
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting and judging risks of water and mud bursting disasters of a working face, which comprises the following steps: and S1, before the working face with the water bursting and mud bursting disasters under the preset geological conditions is mined, detecting the water-rich area of the water-bearing layer of the top plate, wherein the detection vertical depth is greater than the mining water diversion fissure zone development height. And S2, according to the detected abnormal area, the construction drill hole carries out drilling verification on the geophysical abnormal area of the main aquifer. And S3, recording abnormal conditions such as drill sticking, hole collapse and the like in the drilling construction process, coring a rock stratum in a caving zone, recording lithology characteristics, and recording the water inflow of the drill hole after the drilling construction is finished. And S4, judging and identifying the risk of the water burst and mud burst disaster according to preset conditions. Therefore, the method for detecting and judging risks of water and mud bursting disasters on the working face can judge the risk degree of the water and mud bursting disasters, provides guidance for prediction and forecast of mine disasters, and greatly reduces the threat degree of disasters to life and property.
assignees: SHAANXI XUNYI QINGGANGPING MINING IND CO LTD;XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Deep rock mass rockburst dynamic disaster simulation device and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation device and a test method for deep rock mass rockburst dynamic disasters, which can simulate deep rock mass rockburst states, acquire more accurate data and reduce the occurrence of dynamic disasters. The simulation device of this embodiment, including preceding loader, back loader, left loader, right loader, go up loader and loader down, preceding loader is located the front side of rock simulation sample, and back loader is located the rear side of rock simulation sample, and left loader is located the left side of rock simulation sample, and right loader is located the right side of rock simulation sample, goes up the loader and is located the top of rock simulation sample, and the loader is located the below of rock simulation sample down.

title_en: Method for treating triangular area overhead of end head by hydraulic fracturing of underground coal face of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating a triangular area overhead of an end head by hydraulic fracturing of an underground coal face of a coal mine, and relates to the field of underground coal mining. The safe and efficient crushing of the roof strata of the triangular area of the underground coal face of the coal mine is realized, and roof disasters and gas accidents are effectively prevented. Step one: acquiring the structure and geological conditions of a roof strata structure of a working face and the structural characteristics of a roadway protection coal pillar; step two: a drill is used for cutting a row of drill holes in the stoping roadway to the upper side of the stoping roadway, and the drill holes are divided into fracturing holes and observation holes; step three: performing multistage backward fracturing at the position of a primary fracturing slot in the fracturing hole cut in the second step; step four: and (3) performing multistage backward fracturing at the position of the secondary fracturing slot in the fracturing hole cut in the step two. The end top plate of the underground coal face of the coal mine can be crushed efficiently, the occurrence of top plate disasters and gas accidents can be effectively prevented, and the safe stoping of the face is ensured.

title_en: Method for tunneling large-section rescue channel in collapsed rock and soil by using small-bore drilling machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety engineering, and particularly relates to a method for tunneling a large-section rescue channel in collapsed rock soil by using a small-aperture drilling machine, which comprises the following steps: positioning a guide hole, emergency of an auxiliary hole, shaping peripheral holes, protecting a steel support top and carrying out scraper deslagging. According to the invention, the small-aperture guide hole is utilized to accurately position the place where people are trapped, so that the blindness of rescue is avoided; the construction auxiliary hole is used as an emergency rescue channel, so that precious rescue time is strived for; then, utilizing peripheral hole shaping, steel support top protection and scraper slag tapping to form a final large-section rescue channel; the problem that after a rock-soil collapse disaster occurs, ultra-large rescue equipment is long in expropriation and adjustment time, cannot directly enter a narrow working face and is large in tunneling construction work amount can be effectively solved, and the method has the advantages of being wide in application range, strong in practicability, small in equipment investment, simple in construction organization, small in tunneling construction work amount and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHANGSHA SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Earthquake damage prediction visual evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a visual earthquake damage prediction evaluation system, which comprises: the data layer is used for providing a storage management function of bottom data; the supporting layer is connected with the data layer and is used for providing a read-write access interface for bottom data and an equipment access interface function; and the application layer is connected with the support layer and is used for realizing the simulation evaluation of the earthquake damage prediction result and realizing the visual display of the evaluation result. By establishing the urban earthquake damage prediction basic database, a visual earthquake damage prediction evaluation system is developed, the effect on spatial data management is fully exerted, effective management and visual display of earthquake damage prediction data are realized, and therefore the urban earthquake prevention and disaster reduction capacity is improved.

title_en: Tunnel or deep tunnel mud and water bursting deformation true three-dimensional simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a true three-dimensional simulation device for mud and water bursting deformation of a tunnel or a deep tunnel, which relates to the field of geotechnical engineering and disaster prevention and control, and comprises a tunnel or a deep tunnel simulation component, wherein the tunnel or the deep tunnel simulation component comprises a storage box, a diversion trench, a water draining hole, a chute, a baffle, a rigid model box, a guide frame, a drilling hole, a filter screen and a filter hole, the surface of the rigid model box is provided with a connector, the outer side of the rigid model box is provided with a pressure-stabilizing water supply assembly communicated with the connector, and the periphery of the rigid model box is provided with a loading assembly, a drilling assembly, a monitoring system and a processing device. The method realizes true three-dimensional simulation of mud and water bursting disasters of the deep tunnel under various geological conditions, and realizes simulation of influence effects of different geological conditions on tunnel or deep tunnel construction.

title_en: Device for simulating side slip of canyon debris flow
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for simulating side sliding of canyon debris flow, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the bottom plate is fixed on a test platform through peripheral thread mounting pieces, a debris flow feeding groove and a debris flow collecting groove are respectively arranged on the rear side and the front side of the bottom plate, the debris flow feeding groove is obliquely positioned above the bottom plate, the debris flow collecting groove is arranged below the test platform, a flow blocking assembly and a canyon terrain simulation curtain are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom plate, the flow blocking assembly comprises a main plate with an upward telescopic flow blocking plate and an arc-shaped flow blocking side plate connected with the main plate, the lower part of the inner side of the canyon terrain simulation curtain is fixedly connected with a sliding concave frame, and the rear part of the inner side of the canyon terrain simulation curtain is fixedly connected with an angle and length adjusting assembly. The device can be used for simulating the movement condition of the debris flow in the canyons with different slopes, and helps testers to obtain movement characteristic parameters related to the debris flow, so that theoretical analysis is carried out on debris flow disasters and an early warning model is built.

title_en: Large-energy-level adjustable impact test platform capable of being used for high-level debris flow blocking structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an impact test platform with adjustable big energy level that can be used to high-order piece stream retaining structure relates to geological experiment and geological disasters prevention and control field, has add automatic large-tonnage hydraulic jack device, simulates the motion of piece stream under the multiple angle combination operating mode of upper portion first stage, two sections spouts of second stage. The bottom of the uppermost starting chute is also provided with a small-tonnage hydraulic jack so that a sliding block or accumulated particles preset in the starting chute can slide downwards. The rock mass is crushed by collision at the corner of the three-section type chute, and part of rock debris generates larger impact speed based on the momentum conservation theorem to influence the final movement distance and the accumulation state. The utility model provides the attached observation stair with the angle changed along with the lifting of the first-stage sliding groove and the second-stage sliding groove when the angle is changed. The platform belongs to a large-scale physical model test platform for high-level remote geological disasters with the largest scale and the most comprehensive functions at home and abroad and variable gradients.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER MINISTRY OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Multi-field coupling test device for simulating deep mining Ordovician limestone gushing water
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-field coupling test device for simulating deep mining Ordovician limestone gushing water, and mainly relates to the field of disaster prevention and control of coal mine goafs. The testing method comprises the steps of establishing rock stratum models with different proportions, different structures or different distributions according to actual geological conditions of a coal mine, simulating various conditions such as deep ground stress, bottom plate water pressure, rock stratum temperature and mining disturbance through the testing device, recording various measurement data in the testing process, and generating the bottom plate ash inrush phenomenon and the path of a deep mining coal bed. The test device is simple in structure, convenient to maintain, accurate in monitoring data, scientific in test method principle and simple and convenient to operate, meets teaching tasks and test exploration of the Olympic Grey water inrush mechanism by simulating and analyzing characteristics and mechanism of Olympic Grey water inrush in deep mining, and provides effective test data for prevention and control of Olympic Grey water inrush and safe mining of coal mines.

title_en: Emergent rehearsal system of fire control
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire emergency drilling system, which comprises: the system comprises a three-dimensional modeling unit, a drilling control host, position data acquisition equipment, a VR helmet, a controller, interaction equipment, semi-entity fire-fighting articles and a positioning terminal; the utility model discloses a demonstration device for the fire fighting, including positioning terminal, position data acquisition equipment, drill control host computer, VR helmet, human joint and semi-entity fire articles for use, positioning terminal lays on VR helmet, human joint and semi-entity fire articles for use, position data acquisition equipment lays in the drill place for through with positioning terminal cooperation acquires the spatial position of VR helmet, human joint and semi-entity fire articles for use and sends to drill control host computer, drill control host computer sets up a plurality of controllers for with same virtual scene and the spatial position data transmission who acquires to each controller, mutual equipment has signal connection, each the controller is connected to a VR helmet respectively. The utility model utilizes the virtual reality head-wearing VR glasses display equipment to assist firefighters in collaborative simulation drilling, thereby achieving the effects of assisting the optimization of action plans and improving the fire fighting coordination capability.
assignees: YUNNAN ANHUA DISASTER PREVENTION AND DISASTER REDUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A test furnace for thermal-insulated efficiency test of fire retardant coating
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test furnace for testing the heat insulation efficiency of fireproof paint, which comprises a control box body, an air switch, an alternating current contactor, a variable frequency controller, a transformer, a relay, a furnace body, a heating resistance wire, a temperature sensor, a heating opening and a junction box, wherein the air switch, the alternating current contactor, the variable frequency controller, the transformer and the relay are arranged in the control box body, the furnace body is used for bearing a test object, the heating resistance wire is arranged in the furnace body, the temperature sensor is arranged on the heating opening, and the junction box is arranged on the furnace body and is used for being connected with the temperature sensor. When the device is used, the heating in the furnace is realized through the heating resistance wire, the temperature in the furnace is monitored in real time through the temperature sensor after a tested piece is placed in a heating port, the heating temperature is kept in a temperature range theoretically required through the adjustment of the variable frequency controller, and the actual temperature rise condition of a fire disaster is accurately controlled and simulated; meanwhile, the temperature rise conditions of the front side and the back side of the tested piece are monitored in real time through the temperature sensors, and the accurate test of the heat insulation efficiency of the fireproof coating is realized.

title_en: Environment-friendly disaster relief tent
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly disaster relief tent which comprises a support, tarpaulin and a fixing assembly, wherein the fixing assembly comprises a box body, a ground drilling motor, a screw shaft sleeve rod, a screw shaft, a drill bit, a connecting rod, a limiting block, a guide plate and a limiting groove, the ground drilling motor is installed at the upper end of the box body, the power output end of the ground drilling motor is connected with the power input end of the screw shaft, the lower end of the screw shaft is in threaded connection with the screw shaft sleeve rod, the drill bit is welded at the tail end of the screw shaft sleeve rod, and the connecting rod is fixedly connected to two sides of the screw shaft sleeve rod. This environment-friendly relief of disaster tent is through pressing the electric machine switch that drills into the ground, and the work of the electric machine switch on that drills into the ground drives the screw spindle rotatory then, and the screw spindle loop bar carries out screw-thread fit rotation, drives the drill bit then and rotates and bore ground, and the whole fixed is efficient, and the whole occupation space of the tent after putting up is little.
assignees: ZHEJIANG GOLDENWAY LEISURE GOODS MANUFACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Mountain body slippage detection device for early warning based on geological disaster detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of inclination sensors and discloses a mountain slippage detection device for geological disaster detection and early warning. This mountain body detection device that slides based on geological disasters detects early warning usefulness, the internal damage that prevents that the infiltration of rainwater from leading to inclination sensor causes the data transfer error to appear, the spring carries out spacing fixed when inclination sensor goes wrong through the bracing piece bottom and needs maintenance or need change, the push-and-pull button is pressed manually and the spacing groove is released with the limiting plate, with the manual drilling roof portion of taking off of waterproof board, upwards moving through holding two sets of horizontal adjustment posts takes out inclination sensor and maintains or change.

title_en: Multi-field coupling ore drawing vibration simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-field coupling ore drawing vibration simulation experiment device, which comprises a vibration loading module, an access module and a seepage box, wherein the vibration loading module is used for loading ore drawing vibration; the vibration loading module is positioned at the bottommost part; the access module is arranged on the vibration loading module, the access module is an iron box body, a plurality of accesses are arranged at the bottom of the box body, the front end of each access is a mine outlet, and ores, rocks and loess layers are sequentially arranged above the accesses in the box body; the seepage box is arranged on the access module, and is filled with water and the water pressure is adjustable. The utility model can directly simulate the ore rock and loess discharging process of ore drawing by a caving method, can load osmotic water pressure above the ore rock through the seepage box, can simulate blasting construction through the blasting vibration module, can realize the coupling loading of osmotic water pressure and blasting vibration, can better simulate the stress state and the ore rock discharging rule of the ore rock under the combined action of osmotic water pressure, blasting vibration and ground stress in the ore drawing process of mining by the caving method, and provides theoretical guidance for preventing or weakening the water-permeable mud burst disaster of underground mining.

title_en: Monitoring and coping method for gas leakage of park
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heavy gas leakage emergency rescue, in particular to a monitoring and coping method for gas leakage of a park, which comprises the steps of automatically judging whether monitoring points of risk units in the park are suspected to generate leakage or not when chemical production is carried out in the park; when the suspected leakage of the monitoring point of the risk unit is judged, forcibly displaying an alarm interface; after the leakage is confirmed, displaying the position of the monitoring point of the risk unit and corresponding danger factor information, and acquiring a leakage diffusion pollution simulation distribution map; the method and the system can analyze and acquire the environment sensitive area affected by pollution and the emergency evacuation point not affected by pollution in the park, and determine the emergency evacuation path.
assignees: BEIJING VIREADY SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for analyzing leakage of polluted gas, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heavy gas leakage emergency rescue, in particular to a method and a device for analyzing leakage of polluted gas, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a leakage diffusion pollution simulation distribution map of a polluted gas leakage occurrence place in a park; analyzing and acquiring an environment sensitive area influenced by pollution and an emergency evacuation point not influenced by the pollution in the park according to the leakage diffusion pollution simulation distribution diagram; determining an emergency evacuation path from the environmentally sensitive area affected by the contamination to an emergency evacuation point not affected by the contamination; three shortest routes of time spent in the emergent evacuation route of judgement can make personnel evacuate more swiftly this application, guarantee personnel's safety, and the more scientific and effective emergency work that carries on.
assignees: BEIJING VIREADY SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting remaining service life of aircraft engine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of airborne equipment fault prediction and health management, and particularly relates to a method for predicting the remaining service life of an aircraft engine. The method comprises the following steps: processing data of an original time sequence of the engine to obtain first training data and first test data; constructing a network model mainly comprising two long-short time memory network layers and two full-connection layers, wherein the network model comprises seven layers, the first layer and the third layer are the long-short time memory network layers, the fifth layer and the seventh layer are full-connection layers, and the second layer, the fourth layer and the sixth layer are discarding layers; inputting first training data into the network model to perform network training to obtain a trained network model; and inputting the first test data into the trained network model for testing to obtain the remaining service life value of the engine. The method solves the problems of overfitting and high-dimensional disasters in the aspect of time sequence prediction of the traditional deep learning methods such as BP neural network and support vector machine.
assignees: XIAN AVIATION INST COMPUTING TECH AVIATION IND CORP CHINA LTD

title_en: Virtual simulation system construction method applied to civil airport emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a virtual simulation system construction method applied to civil airport emergency rescue. According to the method, a common airport disaster model is built by using a virtual simulation technology, and a rescue scheme is exercised, so that the rescue capability and the rescue effect in actual operation can be improved. The construction method of the system specifically comprises three parts, namely an airport emergency rescue virtual drilling scene construction theory, airport emergency rescue virtual drilling scheme deduction and airport emergency rescue virtual drilling effect evaluation, and the three parts are integrated together on an airport emergency rescue virtual drilling key technology verification platform. The system can enable the user to generate feeling and experience of being immersed in the real emergency environment, support the user to realize personalized exercise reference based on rescue responsibility division, and provide an airport disaster emergency rescue virtual exercise effect evaluation method to realize dynamic and accurate exercise effect evaluation.

title_en: Disaster monitoring device
abstract_en: The application provides a disaster monitoring device relates to monitoring technical field, includes: the drill rod and set up in the casing, sensor and the actuating mechanism of drill rod, protect a section of thick bamboo including can enclose at least two flaps that close each other and form the inner chamber, set up the sensor in the inner chamber, alright protect the sensor of inside through protecting a section of thick bamboo (at least two flaps) under the state of enclosing. At least two petals are hinged to the drill rod respectively, the action mechanism is in transmission connection with the at least two petals, and therefore the pile casing can be controlled to be in an open state or a closed state, the sensor can be inserted into a side slope soil layer under the protection of the pile casing and can be conveniently opened after being inserted into the side slope soil layer to collect the side slope soil layer information.
assignees: AERIAL PHOTOGRAMMETRY AND REMOTE SENSING CO LTD;MEIHANG REMOTE SENSING INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Teaching device of emulation fire control aerial ladder car
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of teaching auxiliary tools, in particular to a teaching device of a simulated fire-fighting aerial ladder vehicle, which comprises a box body, a control panel, a mounting plate, a data processing module, a storage module, a controller, a driving device and a communication module, wherein the control panel is arranged on the box body; the box body is internally divided into an upper mounting bin A and a lower mounting bin B; a sound amplifying module is arranged in the installation bin A; a ventilation cooling component is arranged in the box body; the mounting plate is connected with the box body, and a placing plate arranged on the mounting plate in a sliding manner is provided with a simulated fire-fighting aerial ladder vehicle body; the driving device is connected with the inner wall of the mounting bin A and is in transmission connection with the placing plate; the control panel connecting box body is provided with a display screen and a key module; the controller, the communication module, the storage module, the data processing module, the key module, the display screen, the driving device and the simulation fire-fighting aerial ladder vehicle body are electrically connected. The utility model can assist the firefighter to quickly master the relevant knowledge of the firefighting aerial ladder vehicle.
assignees: ANHUI KUANGHE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Slope groundwater seepage field model test system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a side slope underground water seepage field model test system, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster simulation test devices; the side slope groundwater seepage field model test system includes: the system comprises a test box, a rainfall simulation device, a water collecting well and a landslide monitoring device; a simulation slide bed and a simulation slide slope body are arranged in the test box; the simulation slide bed is arranged at the bottom of the test box; the simulated landslide body is obliquely arranged at the top of the simulated slide bed; a baffle is arranged at the lower side of the simulated landslide body; the rainfall simulation device is arranged at the top of the test box; the water collecting well is vertically arranged inside the simulated landslide body; the landslide monitoring device comprises a water level stress monitoring module, an optical fiber strain sensor and a pressure box which are arranged in the simulated landslide body; the pressure box is arranged between the baffle and the inner side wall of the test box, so that the influence of the water collecting well on the stability of the landslide body under the water pumping effect can be simulated, the feasibility and the effectiveness of the water collecting well in landslide control can be conveniently researched, and the engineering practice can be guided.

title_en: Real fire simulation flame thrower
abstract_en: A real fire simulation flame thrower relates to the technical field of fire drill equipment; including the flaming device for square, all be equipped with the opening from top to bottom, flaming device front end is provided with control mechanism, installs the singlechip among the control mechanism, and the gas pipe is installed to flaming device left end, and explosion-proof solenoid valve is installed to gas pipe one end, and control mechanism includes: the igniter is arranged on one side of the front end of the flaming device, and the controller controls the ignition of the igniter and controls the opening and closing of the explosion-proof electromagnetic valve. Because the fire extinguisher drill inefficiency of using traditional burning things which may cause a fire disaster, most stop on theoretical study, cause the overwhelming majority of personnel when meetting controllable conflagration, cause huge loss because of can not using the fire extinguisher, thereby the fire extinguisher that makes each place has become the furnishings, be furnished with the start button of preventing accident on through the controller, prevent that the controller from falling to the ground carelessly and can not trigger, can use the singlechip to pass through bluetooth and cell-phone intelligent control pneumatic valve and ignite, make this flaming device realize intelligent control.

title_en: Steel structure socket type inter-column quick connecting device for disaster relief
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel structure socket type inter-column quick connecting device for disaster relief, which comprises a plug-in, a bearing piece and connecting pieces, wherein a group of connecting pieces are symmetrically arranged on the left outer side wall and the right outer side wall of the plug-in and the bearing piece; the insert is fixedly connected with the bearing piece through a connecting piece; the inserting core of the inserting piece is inserted into the installing groove of the bearing piece, the connecting piece is clamped, and the quick socket type connection of the steel structure column is completed by installing the bolt, so that the operation is simple and convenient; the device adopts standardized few components, is simple to install, is simple and convenient to disassemble without damage, can be used for post work after simple training of installers, and is suitable for steel structure buildings which are quickly installed on a low floor; the single component has small weight and flexible transportation mode, greatly accelerates the assembly speed, and can be applied to steel structure houses needing to be quickly installed, such as earthquake-resistant, flood-fighting and other disaster-relief houses; the member has high rigidity, good durability, high recovery rate after disasters and reusability.

title_en: Coal face rock burst and gas comprehensive prevention and control system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a comprehensive control system for rock burst and gas of a coal face, and relates to the technical field of coal mining. The coal face rock burst and gas comprehensive prevention and control system comprises a gas extraction subsystem and a gas blasting subsystem, wherein the gas extraction subsystem comprises a high negative pressure extraction main pipe; the gas blasting subsystem comprises an ignition device, a first communication pipe, a gas conveying pipe, an exhaust pipe and a directional long drill hole arranged in a top plate of the coal face, wherein the directional long drill hole is communicated with the return air roadway and is blocked by a first plug; the first communication pipe is communicated between the directional long drill holes of the high negative pressure extraction main pipe; the ignition end of the ignition device extends into the directional long drill hole; the first end of the gas pipe extends into the directional long drill hole, and the second end of the gas pipe is communicated with the external environment; the first end of the exhaust pipe extends into the directional long drilled hole, and the second end of the exhaust pipe is communicated with the return air roadway. The comprehensive control system for rock burst and gas on the coal face can achieve a good control effect on rock burst and gas disasters.
assignees: HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Vegetation maintenance system
abstract_en: A vegetation maintenance system, comprising a permeable curb (10) provided on at least one side of a road along a road direction; a water guide layer (30) located on the side surface of the permeable curb (10) and provided close to the bottom of the permeable curb (10); a water storage layer (50) provided on the side of the water guide layer (30) away from a road surface and used for storing water; a nutrient layer (70) provided on the side of the water storage layer (50) away from the water guide layer (30) and used for providing water, soil and nutrients needed for the growth of the vegetation; and a vegetation planting groove (90) that penetrates through the water guide layer (30) and the water storage layer (50) and is embedded into the nutrient layer (70), and is used for planting vegetation. The vegetation maintenance system completely simulates a natural mode that "natural rainfalls nourish plants from top to bottom", thus ensuring the healthy growth of plants in an urban environment, fully utilizing rainwater for vegetation irrigation, reducing labor costs, and further effectively preventing the occurrence of water logging on road surfaces and flood disasters.

title_en: Apparatus for temperature control of haptic devices for fire simulation of realistic fire fighting training and method thereof
title_ko: 실감기반 소방훈련의 화재 시뮬레이션을 위한 햅틱 기기의 온도 제어 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A temperature control apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention is a temperature control apparatus of a haptic device including a thermoelectric module including a thermoelectric element, a device unit, and a heat sink. The apparatus comprises: an input unit for receiving an input of a target temperature; a mode setting unit for setting any one driving mode of a low-temperature mode for absorbing heat and a high-temperature mode for dissipating heat according to a comparison result between the target temperature and a preset initial body temperature; a first calculation unit for calculating a first driving current corresponding to the target temperature based on an external temperature or a body temperature of a user according to the set driving mode; a second calculation unit for calculating a second driving current for maintaining the target temperature based on the external temperature or the body temperature of the user according to the set driving mode; and a control unit for applying the first driving current to the thermoelectric module and applies the second driving current to the thermoelectric module. The present invention can stably control the temperature of a haptic device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 온도 제어 장치는 열전 소자, 디바이스부 및 히트싱크를 포함하는 열전 모듈을 포함하는 햅틱 장치의 온도 제어 장치에 있어서, 목표 온도를 입력받는 입력부, 상기 목표 온도와 기 설정된 초기 체온값의 비교 결과에 따라 흡열을 수행하는 저온 모드 및 방열을 수행하는 고온 모드 중 어느 하나의 구동 모드를 설정하는 모드 설정부, 상기 설정된 구동 모드에 따라 외부 온도 또는 사용자의 체온에 기초하여 상기 목표 온도에 대응하는 제1 구동 전류를 산출하는 제1 산출부, 상기 설정된 구동 모드에 따라 상기 외부 온도 또는 상기 사용자의 체온에 기초하여 상기 목표 온도를 유지하기 위한 제2 구동 전류를 산출하는 제2 산출부, 그리고 상기 제1 구동 전류를 상기 열전 모듈에 인가하고, 상기 제2 구동 전류를 상기 열전 모듈에 인가하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Motion capture system for virtual fire fighting and motion capture method using the same
title_ko: 가상 소방 훈련을 위한 모션 캡쳐 시스템 및 이를 이용한 모션 캡쳐 방법
abstract_en: Embodiments are to provide a motion picture system for virtual fire-fighting with high realism and a motion capture method using the same.
