A motion picture system for virtual fire-fighting according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a first position tracker disposed at an object and including a plurality of markers; a second position tracker disposed at a firefighting tools profile and including a plurality of markers; and a motion capture device calculating motion information on a first rigid body corresponding to the first position tracker and motion information on a second rigid body corresponding to the second position tracker based on tracking information generated by sensing light corresponding to the first position tracker and the second position tracker, determining whether or not a first virtual object corresponding to the object collides with a second virtual object corresponding to the firefighting tools profile based on the motion information on the first rigid body and the motion information on the second rigid body, and implementing motions of the first virtual object and the second virtual object based on the collision determination result. The firefighting tools profile has a different shape according to a type of corresponding firefighting tools, and an attached position of the second tracker thereto is different.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 모션 캡쳐 시스템은 대상체에 배치되며, 복수의 마커를 포함하는 제1 위치 트래커; 소방도구 프로파일에 배치되며, 복수의 마커를 포함하는 제2 위치 트래커; 및 상기 제1 위치 트래커 및 상기 제2 위치 트래커에 대응하는 빛을 감지하여 생성된 트래킹 정보에 기초하여 상기 제1 위치 트래커에 대응하는 제1 강체 및 상기 제2 위치 트래커에 대응하는 제2 강체의 모션 정보를 산출하며, 상기 제1 강체 및 상기 제2 강체의 모션 정보에 기초하여 상기 대상체에 대응하는 제1 가상 객체와 상기 소방도구 프로파일에 대응하는 제2 가상 객체의 충돌 여부를 판단하고, 상기 충돌 여부의 판단 결과에 기초하여 상기 제1 가상 객체와 상기 제2 가상 객체의 모션을 구현하는 모션 캡쳐 장치;를 포함하고, 상기 소방도구 프로파일은, 대응하는 소방도구의 종류에 따라 상이한 형상을 가지고 상기 제2 위치 트래커의 부착 위치가 상이하다.

title_en: Waterjet drill for fire suppression apparatus of electric automobile
title_ko: 전기자동차의 화재진압용 워터젯 드릴
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a waterjet drill for fire suppression of an electric vehicle, comprising a drill pipe for drilling a battery case of an electric vehicle in which a fire has occurred by spraying high-pressure water while moving forward and rotating and a driving unit for generating driving power to move the drill pipe forward and backward and rotate the drill pipe forward and backward, so that the battery case of the electric vehicle in which a fire has occurred is drilled and firefighting water or a fire extinguishing agent is injected into the battery case through the drilled hole to extinguish the fire in the electric vehicle.
abstract_ko: 전기자동차의 화재진압용 워터젯 드릴에 관한 것으로, 전진 이동 및 회전 운동하면서 고압수를 분사하여 화재가 발생한 전기자동차의 배터리 케이스를 천공하는 드릴파이프 및 상기 드릴파이프를 전후 방향으로 이동 및 정역 회전시키도록 구동력을 발생하는 구동부를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 화재가 발생한 전기자동차의 배터리 케이스를 천공하고 천공된 구멍을 통해 배터리 케이스 내부로 소방수 또는 소화약제를 주입하여 전기자동차의 화재를 진압할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster safety goods purchase and inspection system using virtual reality and its provision method and advertisement method using the same
title_ko: 가상현실을 이용한 재난안전용품 구매와 점검 시스템 및 그 제공방법과 이를 이용한 맞춤형 광고방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for purchasing and inspecting disaster safety goods using virtual reality, a method for providing the same, and a customized advertisement method using the same. The system includes: a display unit for outputting a transmitted virtual simulation; a storage unit including a user database, a map database, a disaster situation database, a safety goods database, and an advertisement product database; and a control unit, wherein the control unit includes a user management module, a disaster situation module, a safety goods management module, an advertisement module, an installation safety goods management module, and a purchase module. Therefore, disaster safety goods are managed and inspected in an integrated manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실을 이용한 재난안전용품 구매와 점검 시스템 및 그 제공방법과 이를 이용한 맞춤형 광고방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 가상현실을 이용한 재난안전용품 구매와 점검 시스템 및 맞춤형 광고 시스템은 전송된 가상 시뮬레이션을 출력하는 디스플레이부; 및 로그인 된 사용자의 동작을 포함하는 임의의 명령을 입력받는 입력부를 포함하는 사용자 단말기, 사용자 정보가 저장된 사용자데이터베이스; 실제공간을 기반으로 제작되거나, 임의의 공간을 기반으로 제작된 가상의 맵이 저장된 맵데이터베이스; 가상의 재난상황이 저장된 재난상황데이터베이스; 가상의 안전용품이 저장된 안전용품데이터 베이스; 및 광고상품, 광고되는 상품 정보, 광고되는 가상의 안전용품이 저장된 광고상품데이터베이스를 포함하는 저장부, 그리고, 사용자데이터베이스로부터 로그인 된 사용자의 정보를 로드 하고, 상기 사용자데이터베이스를 업데이트 하는 사용자관리모듈; 재난상황데이터베이스로부터 선택된 맵에 적용할 가상의 재난상황을 선택하고, 상기 맵 위에 로드하고 정해진 미션을 사용자 단말기로 전송하는 재난상황모듈; 사용자 정보, 맵의 종류, 재난의 종류, 사용자의 행동패턴을 포함하는 정보를 임의의 가중치가 적용된 기준에 따라 분석하여 사용자의 미션 수행 상황을 평가하는 평가모듈; 사용자의 미션 수행 상황의 분석결과를 기초로, 가상의 안전용품데이터 베이스에서 2종 이상의 안전용품을 추전하는 안전용품관리모듈; 상기 평가모듈의 평가 점수를 기반으로 광고상품데이터베이스에 저장된 광고 대상 중 광고 상품을 선택하여 사용자 단말기로 상기 광고 상품의 정보를 제공하는 광고모듈; 사용자가 구매한 안전용품식별코드를 인식 및 관리하는 설치안전용품관리모듈; 사용자의 상품 구매정보 및 결제를 관리하는 구매모듈;을 포함하는 제어부를 포함하는 것이다.
assignees: UNIV DONG EUI IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Multi-vehicle dynamic evacuation method driven smoothly in short distance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-vehicle dynamic evacuation method driven smoothly in a short distance. In a navigation algorithm based on short-range smoothness assurance, a route search is performed based on an a-algorithm. In the searching process, for the blocked road section, the blocking weight is judged according to the distance from the road section to the vehicle, the real length of the road section is further extended according to the blocking weight to simulate the blocking of the road section, and finally, an optimal path under the current condition can be returned. For multiple vehicle evacuation algorithms based on route diversity. The evacuation sequence of the vehicle is divided mainly by two steps. Step 1: and acquiring a driving path by using a vehicle navigation algorithm ensured by short-distance smoothness. Step 2: according to the route diversity principle, we choose to give priority to planning each time the vehicles with the lowest similarity to the previously evacuated vehicle route. Ensuring that the number of vehicles evacuated in all directions of the road network is relatively uniform.

title_en: Tunnel engineering water-rich disaster-causing structure hydrogeological parameter inversion test system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogeological parameter inversion test system and method for a water-rich disaster-causing structure in tunnel engineering, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a physical simulation model box, a disaster-causing water-containing body structure, similar materials, a heat source tracing and marking system, a water supply tank and a water pump, a constant-temperature water bath pool, a hydraulic stimulation system, a hydraulic monitoring system and a data analysis system. According to the method, advanced drilling construction design is fully utilized, and high-resolution distribution of hydrogeological parameters in front of the tunnel engineering can be obtained by analyzing data information in the construction or experiment process, so that the position and distribution of a disaster-causing structure can be accurately depicted, and the forecast and early warning work of a disaster source in front of the tunnel engineering can be conveniently carried out.

title_en: Emergency drilling practical training system and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency drilling practical training system and a construction method thereof, wherein the construction method comprises the following steps: the emergency drilling training system can enable a plurality of users to simultaneously carry out immersive training drilling and comprehensively evaluate the drilling effect, further can comprehensively improve the emergency response capability of different groups to emergency events, can meet the requirements of emergency command, first-line treatment, disaster field public and other multi-level collaborative emergency drilling, provides a platform for emergency auxiliary decision-making, drilling training and scientific research support from the visual angle of virtual-real integrated display, and comprehensively improves the emergency command capability, team real-time capability and public self-rescue mutual rescue capability.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT SCIENCE AND TECH;CHIPONT BEIJING RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF SAFETY PRODUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-layer inclined coal seam goaf treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer inclined coal seam goaf treatment method, which comprises the following steps: step A: determining a goaf treatment range; and (B) step (B): arranging grouting holes on the ground of the goaf treatment range, wherein two or more grouting holes are arranged along the inclination of the inclined coal seam; step C: preparing grouting material; step D: drilling and grouting cooperation: drilling according to the arranged drilling holes, stopping drilling when the branch Kong Zuantan reaches the first inclined coal seam mining area, and grouting; and after grouting of the first layer of the inclined coal seam goaf is completed and the grouting material is solidified to form a filling body, continuing to drill and penetrate through the filling body to enable the branch holes to enter the next layer of the inclined coal seam goaf, and grouting. The invention can realize safe and rapid filling of the multilayer inclined goaf, is suitable for treating the multilayer inclined coal seam goaf and reduces the risk of geological disasters.

title_en: Multi-robot task allocation method based on HADQN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-robot task allocation method based on HADQN, which comprises the following steps: determining an environmental state and a dynamic exploration factor; according to the environment state and the dynamic exploration factors, an action selection strategy of the robot is formulated; according to the formulated action selection strategy of the robot, the construction and the updating of the track pool are completed; updating an experience pool in the DQN algorithm according to the updated track pool to obtain updated experience pool data; and training and updating parameters of the global estimation value network in the DQN algorithm according to the updated experience pool data, and further performing task planning of the multi-machine task allocation algorithm. The invention solves the dimension disaster problem in the multi-robot multi-task distribution problem under the complex environment, plans the local path while distributing the tasks, and ensures that the robot can avoid the obstacles in the environment and the path selected by the robot is relatively excellent.

title_en: Remote sensing data-based landslide inventory map generation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide survey map generation method based on remote sensing data, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining the remote sensing data of landslide and processing and preparing an input data set for the deep learning model; s2, constructing a LanDCNN model, wherein the model consists of an encoder and a decoder, the encoder is a ResNet-50 framework consisting of 50 convolutional layers, and the decoder is a U-net framework; s3, inputting a training data set, and performing supervision training on the LanDCNN model; s4 inputs a verification data set and a test data set, verifies and tests the LanDCNN model and generates a landslide clearance chart. Based on the method, the landslide survey map can be generated quickly and intelligently by combining remote sensing data, the requirements of the landslide survey map on high-quality personnel are reduced, and the method has important values on evaluation and analysis and landslide disaster prevention after landslide occurs.
assignees: CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES;CHONGQING HUADI ZIHUAN TECH CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Three-dimensional simulation drill deduction method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional simulation drilling deduction method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium. In the process of three-dimensional simulation drilling, on-site drilling is not needed, drilling cost can be greatly reduced, repeated drilling can be realized for many times, and comparison of various rescue schemes can be further realized. In addition, due to the adoption of three-dimensional simulation drilling, all accident scenes can be simulated more truly, and simulation drilling of various disaster scenes is realized. In addition, because the operation instruction is introduced into the drilling deduction process, mutual deduction of user participation can be realized, the user can participate in the responsibility task and the drilling content of the participation role, the user can continue deduction only by mutual operation, and the participation and the execution of the user can be improved.

title_en: Experimental system and simulation method for geological landslide disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to an experiment system and a simulation method for geological landslide disasters. Firstly, adopting a layered shell device, and placing soil and stone materials in the shell device; secondly, a hydraulic device is arranged in the shell device to simulate the earthquake effect. Thirdly, the top and the lower part of the box body are not sealed, the shell separating device is directly exposed out, the hydraulic device and the top soil layer shell isolating device are connected together, and the lower part of the box body is fixed; fourthly, the shell device is wrapped by a box body, and the lower part of the shell device is filled with soil layers and stones to be used as a mountain bottom plain; fifthly, controlling the hydraulic device to load by utilizing a PID control system; sixthly, arranging a protective wall on the built mountain part, and arranging a stress sensor and a strain sensor on the wall; and seventhly, collecting the whole geological landslide simulation process by building a visualization system. The test system device utilizes the simulated geological disaster landslide to explore the influence of stratum motion on the landslide, optimizes protective measures and predicts the geological landslide disaster in advance.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING;ZHENGZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINA UNIV OF GEOSCIENCES BEIJING

title_en: Coal mine water disaster exploration monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal mine water disaster exploration and monitoring device, and relates to the technical field of coal mines. The drilling machine comprises a bottom plate and a detection device, universal wheels are installed at the lower end of the bottom plate, a support frame is installed at the upper end of the bottom plate, a top plate is arranged in the support frame in a clamped mode, a first electric telescopic rod is installed at the lower end of the top plate, and one end of an output shaft of the first electric telescopic rod is connected with a drilling motor. According to the coal mine water damage exploration and monitoring device, the first electric telescopic rod, the drilling motor, the conveying rod and the drill bit are matched with one another, drilling can be conducted, soil excavated in the drilling process can be moved out of the hole through the conveying groove formed in the conveying rod, then the top plate is rotated, the detection device is sent into the hole excavated by the drill bit through the second electric telescopic rod, the detection device can detect the soil humidity at the designated position, and the situation that the deeper soil excavated by the drill bit affects the accuracy of detection data of the detection device is avoided.

title_en: An intelligent fire&occupant safety system and method
abstract_en: The described invention relates to a computer-implemented method for determining fire safety and occupant safety information, comprising: receiving data from a plurality of Appliances, each equipped with thermal sensors, carbon dioxide detectors and real-time voice communication capabilities, arranged within a building and configured to detect locations of elevated temperature and ambient carbon dioxide levels within the building; wherein one or more of said Appliances are arranged to detect elevated temperatures and levels of carbon dioxide indicative of the presence or risk of fire, and one or more of said Appliances are arranged to detect elevated temperatures indicative of body heat and carbon dioxide levels indicative of respiration and therefore the presence of one or more people, and enabling communication between occupants and a remote person to determine any special medical priorities of said occupants; analysing the received data to determine a first location corresponding to the presence or risk of fire and a second location corresponding to the presence of one or more people; using data corresponding to the first and second locations to construct virtual (i.e., computer-generated) dynamic real-time models of the current state of the fire and probabilistic models of the likely physical development of the fire, and by reference to pre-determined policies defining courses of action to be taken in different fire hazard scenarios, communicating and representing data according to the appropriate policy response. Furthermore, proposed firefighting interventions can be sent as data to the processing unit and the impact of such interventions can be included in the probabilistic fire models, enabling real-time simulation of the impact of said proposed interventions and interpretation of the likely results, using machine learning to improve the accuracy of the simulations. In this way, evacuation priorities and firefighting methods can be better targeted and occupants can be more safely evacuated from the building; resulting in reduced injury risk for occupants and firefighters due to enhanced intelligence on the status and likely development of the fire.

title_en: Disaster-causing structure advanced prediction method based on heat source tracing and hydraulic combined chromatography inversion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-causing structure advanced forecasting method based on heat source tracing and hydraulic united chromatography inversion, which adopts a test monitoring arrangement scheme which is closely combined with advanced geological drilling conditions, is related to tunnel (cave) and tunnel bore diameters, is implemented based on advanced geological drilling performed in underground engineering, has universality for various underground engineering, adopts a heat source tracing method which has good application prospect due to convenient monitoring and no pollution, realizes dynamic adjustment of a covariance matrix and a gain matrix of a state forecasting error based on a filtering mode combining smooth low-pass filtering and self-adaptive Kalman filtering, has the capability of tracking a mutation state, effectively avoids filtering divergence, fully utilizes data information obtained by the traditional hydrogeological test, develops hydrogeological united chromatography, can obviously reduce the multiple resolvability of inverse problems, and realizes interpretation of contained disaster-causing structure water-rich non-redundant information, provides theoretical basis for accurately detecting the disaster-causing structure in front of the project in advance.

title_en: Flood disaster water body range detection method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting a water body range of a flood disaster, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a neighborhood log ratio difference map of SAR images of two time phases before and after the flood disaster, carrying out fuzzy clustering segmentation processing on the neighborhood log ratio difference map to obtain an initial water body change detection map, carrying out prediction processing on middle pixels in the initial water body change detection map by using a preset network classifier to obtain target change pixels and target non-change pixels, wherein the preset network classifier comprises a classifier obtained after training an initial classifier of an initial convolutional neural network based on the change pixels and the non-change pixels in the initial water body change detection map, and carrying out updating processing on the initial water body change detection map based on the target change pixels and the target non-change pixels to obtain a target water body change detection map, wherein the middle pixels comprise pixels between change and non-change. The invention can improve the detection precision and the change detection effect of the range of the flood disaster water body.

title_en: Hyperspectral anomaly detection method for generating countermeasure network based on matching pursuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hyperspectral anomaly detection method for generating an countermeasure network based on matching pursuit, which mainly solves the problems of poor detection effect caused by insufficient capability of extracting characteristic information and lack of priori information in the prior art. The implementation scheme is as follows: the method comprises the steps of (1) calculating an abnormal probability matrix of a hyperspectral image by using a KRX algorithm, and setting 1 and 0 of the abnormal probability matrix according to a background threshold value to obtain a presumed label; extracting spectrum vectors with labels of 0 to form a background spectrum vector matrix; according to the spectrum vector matrix, a training sample data set is manufactured, and is input into a depth convolution generation countermeasure network to obtain a pseudo hyperspectral image data set; and carrying out difference on the spectrum vectors of the hyperspectral image and the pseudo hyperspectral image to obtain a residual image, carrying out matching tracking on the residual image, and calculating an abnormal probability value of the residual image to obtain an abnormal detection result. The invention improves the average value of the detection index AUC, has better detection effect, and can be used for mineral exploration, environment monitoring, disaster prediction, accurate agriculture and national defense.

title_en: Mountain area shallow landslide risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountainous area shallow landslide risk assessment method, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring mountain rainfall data, soil strength parameters and terrain data through rainfall station field monitoring and indoor tests; s2, calculating the soil saturation condition by using the rainfall infiltration hydrological geological model, calculating the slope safety coefficient by combining the slope stability physical mechanical model, finally calculating the slope instability probability by using the Monte Carlo simulation method, and drawing the corresponding landslide risk map in the mountain area. The method is based on a physical mechanics control equation, considers the rainfall infiltration and slope stability change process, simultaneously considers the uncertainty of soil body parameters, realizes shallow layer landslide risk assessment under the condition of rainfall in the mountainous area, and provides an important theoretical basis for disaster prevention and reduction and emergency rescue work of geological disasters of landslides in the mountainous area.

title_en: Three-dimensional simulation drilling system and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional simulation drilling system and a construction method thereof, which can realize three-dimensional simulation drilling through the cooperative work among a free configuration platform, a three-dimensional map construction module, a three-dimensional scene management module, a digital script analysis module, a simulation drilling execution subsystem and a simulation drilling module. In the process of three-dimensional simulation drilling, on-site drilling is not needed, drilling cost can be greatly reduced, repeated drilling can be realized for many times, and comparison of various rescue schemes can be realized. In addition, due to the adoption of three-dimensional simulation drilling, all accident scenes can be simulated more truly, and simulation drilling of various disaster scenes can be realized.

title_en: Method for determining insurance rates based on human pricing by virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining rates of personal pricing insurance based on a virtual reality technology, which comprises a virtual scene simulation module and a rate calculation module, wherein the virtual scene simulation module comprises a driving level evaluation module, a driving habit evaluation module and an emergency response evaluation module, the emergency response evaluation module comprises an emergency risk avoiding scene model, an emergency risk avoiding process analysis, an emergency risk avoiding capability evaluation and an emergency risk avoiding loss prediction, and the rate calculation module takes evaluation in the virtual scene simulation as a calculation basis. According to the method for determining the insurance rate based on the virtual reality technology, the virtual reality technology is innovatively adopted to collect actual data such as driving level, driving habits, emergency response and the like of drivers and perform pricing, the smaller the risk of the evaluated person in the virtual reality is, the lower the rate is, positive correlation is formed, and the problem that the existing rate is more frequently used for measuring and calculating the risk rate according to risk factors and group classification of vehicles is solved.

title_en: Microseism event risk classification method considering temporal and spatial characteristics of monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microseismic event risk classification method considering the time-space characteristics of monitoring data, which comprises the steps of establishing different characteristic indexes by considering the time-space characteristics of microseismic monitoring data, then carrying out data imbalance and One-Hot coding processing, using the processed indexes as characteristics, and taking whether dangerous disasters such as rock burst or earth surface vibration occur as labels, and then establishing a risk classification model of microseismic events through a One-dimensional convolutional neural network. The classification method fully utilizes the time-space characteristics of the monitoring data, is quick in training time and good in classification effect, and solves the problems that in most of current researches, the types of the monitoring data are too many in danger classification of microseismic events in mines and the time-space characteristics of the microseismic monitoring data are ignored.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring landslide deformation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for monitoring landslide deformation, which are applied to a deformation monitoring system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: loading a servo force to the test base based on the simulated stress loading subsystem so as to simulate the stress deformation process of the deformation monitoring test model; collecting monitoring data of a monitoring area in the deformation monitoring test model through each monitoring sensor in the sensor network; the deformation image of the deformation monitoring test model is acquired through a camera; and analyzing the monitoring data and the deformation image to determine the deformation rule of the deformation monitoring test model. The embodiment of the invention can acquire multi-azimuth and multi-type monitoring data, and improves the diversity of the monitoring data; in addition, the embodiment of the invention is beneficial to objectively and accurately analyzing the deformation rule of the deformation monitoring test model, and provides technical reference for monitoring and early warning, disaster prevention and reduction and the like of landslide.

title_en: Method and device for predicting mine water disaster spreading process, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting a mine water disaster spreading process, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring mine roadway data; constructing a mine excavation space model according to mine roadway data; constructing a prediction model of the mine water disaster spreading process; and predicting the mine water disaster spreading process according to the simulation result determined by the mine water disaster spreading process prediction model. The physical model test of the mine water disaster spreading process is carried out, the mine roadway network similar model is built, the spreading process of the water disaster in the mine and the flow state characteristics of water inrush are observed through the model test, and a data basis is provided for the verification of a numerical prediction result. The reliability of the numerical prediction model of the mine water disaster spreading process is verified and improved through comparison and correction of test and simulation results. Is beneficial to helping the production mine to adopt an effective mode to control water damage and reduce the well flooding loss caused by the water damage.

title_en: Disaster emergency simulation training system and method for energy supply station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency treatment, and discloses a disaster emergency simulation training system and method for an energy supply station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, setting passenger flow parameters, equipment parameters and disaster parameters in the energy supply station; s2, performing 3D simulation display on each area scene in the energy supply station according to the passenger flow parameters, the equipment parameters and the disaster parameters in the energy supply station; s3, training personnel to perform virtual operation in each area scene in the energy supply station; s4, deducing each area scene in the energy supply station according to the passenger flow parameters, the equipment parameters, the disaster parameters and the virtual operation in the energy supply station; and S5, training scoring is carried out on the training personnel according to the deduction result of each area scene in the energy supply station. The invention has the advantages that: the simulation training system can be used for carrying out simulation training aiming at various natural disasters and combining actual conditions of different energy supply stations so as to improve the emergency handling capacity of workers in the energy supply stations aiming at various natural disasters.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHE PETROLEUM COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY SALES CO LTD

title_en: Emergency knowledge training system based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency knowledge training system based on virtual reality, which comprises: the display, the host, the VR head display and the handle controller; wherein, the host computer is respectively electrically connected with the display, the VR head display and the handle controller; the host comprises a virtual reality emergency knowledge training component, and the emergency knowledge training component is matched with the display, the VR head display and the handle controller to carry out emergency knowledge training after running; the emergency knowledge training component comprises a ruin burying module, a movable escape module and a successful escape prompt module. According to the emergency knowledge training system and method, emergency knowledge is virtually realized through the ruin burying module, the movable escape module and the successful escape prompt module in the emergency knowledge training assembly, and a user is placed in a disaster scene of simulation by matching with physical equipment, so that the interest of learning of the emergency knowledge is improved, and meanwhile, efficient and intelligent emergency knowledge training is realized.
assignees: QINGDAO VIRTUAL REALITY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Unity 3D-based virtual classroom fire evacuation drilling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Unity 3D-based virtual classroom fire evacuation drilling method, which belongs to the technical field of virtual reality and artificial intelligence, and is characterized in that a 3ds Max software is used for establishing a basic model of a fire scene and a character role, various basic actions are added to the character role of a character, and then the character role is led into Unity3D simulation software, and a particle system carried by Unity3D is used for simulating a real scene during fire catching and water fire extinguishing, so that all escape members can fully realize the real experience of fire evacuation. In order to meet the safe escape of teachers and students to the greatest extent, the shortest escape path is planned by adopting an A-algorithm, the corresponding escape path is subjected to smoothing processing, the corresponding weight proportion is added according to the A-algorithm formula to make improvement, the life value function of character roles is set, and whether the safe escape is realized is judged by observing the residual life value indexes of the escape from a round of fire.

title_en: Swarm robot control method based on particle swarm algorithm under rejection environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a swarm robot control method based on a particle swarm algorithm in a rejection environment, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing an attack and defense confrontation scene in a rejection environment, and initializing parameters of a particle swarm algorithm; step 2, the attacking robot detects surrounding environment information through a sensor, acquires situation information of friend and enemy robots, and calculates the position of the enemy territory in real time by using an inertial navigation technology; step 3, constructing a fitness function by the attack robot; step 4, optimizing a fitness function by utilizing a particle swarm algorithm to obtain the optimal occupation of the attacking robot; step 5, moving and attacking the attacking robot; step 6, if any attacking robot enters enemy territory, the task is completed; otherwise, judging whether the maximum operation time is reached, if so, failing the task; otherwise, turning to step 2 to iterate the next time slice. Compared with the prior art, the method avoids global positioning, the control does not need pre-training, and the problem of dimension disaster is solved.

title_en: Geological disaster identification method and device based on remote sensing image and DEM data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster identification method and device based on remote sensing images and DEM data. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a geological disaster remote sensing image sample database; training a deep learning model by using the remote sensing image sample database; obtaining a debris flow disaster area and a non-debris flow disaster area according to the remote sensing image of the area to be detected by using the trained deep learning model; carrying out quantitative statistics on the height and the gradient of each disaster in a non-debris flow disaster area by utilizing DEM data; and obtaining a collapse area and a landslide area by utilizing the integrated learning model according to the obtained statistical data. Therefore, by adopting the scheme provided by the invention, the geological disasters such as collapse, landslide and debris flow can be distinguished with high efficiency, high precision and high robustness. The method solves the limitations of manual field investigation and visual interpretation, and can be applied to large-scale geological disaster investigation.
assignees: CHINA HIGHWAY ENG CONSULTANTS CORP;Zhongzi data co ltd

title_en: Liquid CO2Method for improving coal seam water injection effect by fracturing and permeability increasing
abstract_en: The invention discloses liquid CO 2 The method for improving the coal seam water injection effect by (liquid carbon) fracturing and permeability increasing comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a water injection main drill hole and a plurality of branch drill holes on the advance working face by using a drilling machine, injecting liquid carbon at dynamic pressure, constructing coal rock strain-fracture-temperature monitoring drill holes around the drill holes, monitoring the development condition of a pore fracture network in a fracturing and infiltration increasing area in real time, and connecting a water injection pipeline to perform multi-channel dynamic and static pressure water injection after the liquid carbon injection is finished. Under the multiple actions of liquid carbon low-temperature freezing, phase change self-pressurization and the like, the crack development and communication and pore evolution development of the coal seam are promoted, and a large-range communicated pore crack network is formed, so that the coal seam injectibility and wettability are effectively improved, and the coal seam injectivity is favorably improvedThe water dust reduction efficiency can also reduce the stress concentration of the coal bed, effectively relieve the impact tendency of the coal bed and the outburst danger of coal and gas, and has wide applicability in the fields of mine dust prevention and dynamic disaster prevention.

title_en: Power grid disaster emergency analysis method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid disaster emergency analysis method, a device and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining parameter information of a disaster suffered in a target area, and analyzing a first analysis result of power equipment in the target area based on the parameter information of the disaster and a preset power equipment simulation model; the preset power equipment simulation model is constructed based on basic operation parameters of the power equipment in the target area and the hierarchical relationship among the power equipment. By acquiring the parameter information of the disaster and primarily judging the disaster suffered situation of the disaster suffered area according to the actual disaster information and the preset power equipment simulation model, the statistics of the disaster suffered situation can be completed in the first time, the disaster suffered response time is reduced, the optimal emergency repair time is ensured, the overall damage situation and the development trend in the disaster suffered area are predicted and implemented to reflect the large-scale disaster, and the important support effect is achieved on the power emergency decision.
assignees: GLOBAL ENERGY INTERCONNECTION RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring method based on synthetic aperture radar and point-like sensor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pipeline geological disaster monitoring, and particularly relates to a geological disaster monitoring method based on a synthetic aperture radar and a point sensor. The method comprises the following steps: arranging a synthetic aperture radar and a point sensor in a disaster prone area; collecting historical data and establishing an original database; preprocessing the original data to obtain a synthetic aperture radar image dataset; off-line training is carried out on a pre-designed network, and a trained network model is stored; and acquiring real-time data, preprocessing the real-time data, and performing online monitoring on the geological disaster by using the trained network model. The method has the characteristics of extracting features from an image angle, having low sensitivity to data quality and being capable of accurately early warning the geological disasters of the oil and gas pipeline.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHENENG NATURAL GAS OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: Electric tower design scheme generation method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric tower setting scheme generation method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining the number N of electric towers needing to be set up in the whole domain, setting up a whole domain map model through acquired survey data, S2, determining the setting up position of the electric towers through an optimal searching rule, S3, inputting standard working condition parameters into a working condition model to guide the setting up of an analog electric tower, S4, conducting a robustness test on the set up analog electric towers through a disaster model, guiding the correction of the analog electric towers according to the loss degree of the electric towers, and generating correction parameters, S5, inputting the standard working condition parameters and the correction parameters into a tool library model, and generating a tool list. According to the scheme, the virtual map is built, the building position of the electric tower is determined, the working condition parameters of the electric tower are further corrected through the robustness test of disaster resistance capability of the simulated electric tower after the building is completed, the actual disaster resistance capability of the electric tower is improved, and finally a tool list is generated through a tool library model, so that the construction process is safer and more efficient.

title_en: Anti-hole-collapse reverse circulation sampling drill bit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-collapse hole reverse circulation sampling drill bit which comprises a drill bit body and an annular ejector sleeved in an inner cavity of the drill bit body, wherein an annular air cavity with a sealed front end is formed between the outer circle of the ejector and the inner circle of the drill bit body, the inner cavity of the ejector is communicated with an opening at the front end of the drill bit body, an outer spray hole communicated with the air cavity is formed in the side wall of the drill bit body, and the rear end of the air cavity and the rear end of the ejector are respectively used for being connected with external air supply equipment. The utility model uses compressed air to force the coal dust to be pressed into the sampling port, can achieve rapid and accurate sampling, can obviously save sampling time, improve sampling depth, improve the working efficiency and safety of coal mine sampling, and reduce gas disaster accidents.
assignees: GUIZHOU FAER COAL IND CO LTD;CCTEG CHONGQING RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Water level changing device suitable for model test
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of geological disaster research, and relates to a water level changing device suitable for model tests, which comprises a simulation box, wherein the peripheral side walls of the simulation box are all made of glass, the upper end surface of the simulation box is a stainless steel plate, a plurality of square water outlet pipes are arranged in the simulation box at equal intervals, a plurality of water injection holes are formed in the water outlet pipes, the upper ends of the water outlet pipes penetrate through the upper end surface of the simulation box and are fixedly arranged, sealing plugs are arranged in the water outlet pipes in a sliding mode, an adjusting assembly capable of lifting the sealing plugs is arranged on the upper end surface of the simulation box, water outlet holes are formed in the sealing plugs, a flexible water inlet pipe communicated with the water outlet holes is connected to the upper end surface of each sealing plug, and a main water pipe is connected to the upper end of the water inlet pipe through an auxiliary water pipe. The adjusting component capable of adjusting the water level is arranged in the box body, and the technical effect of adjusting the underground water level according to the simulated requirements is achieved.

title_en: Outdoor emergency disinfection water purifier
abstract_en: The utility model provides a field emergency disinfection water purification device, which comprises: the device comprises a shell, a power supply, a water pump, a UV device and a platinum precious metal electrolysis device. The potential safety hazard of drinking water under emergency conditions is effectively solved; the electric fire-proof outdoor emergency drinking water device can be applied to the outdoor environment without electric fire and incapable of ensuring safe drinking water sources, can radically solve the technical problem of safe drinking water, can quickly, simply and conveniently solve the potential safety hazard caused by microorganisms such as bacteria and viruses, organic compounds such as pesticide, antibiotics, hormone and industrial wastewater pollution, and water source water pollutants such as algal toxins at any time and any place, and can better protect the safety of our country in the field emergency drinking water under the conditions of training, combat readiness, wartime and the like of various military species; the safe drinking water is ensured under the conditions of various disasters, epidemic situations, outdoor activities and the like.
assignees: DTM ENERGY SAVING AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH DALIAN CO LTD

title_en: Navigation rescue scheduling optimization method based on rescue efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a navigation rescue scheduling optimization method based on rescue efficiency, which comprises the following steps: acquiring information of each rescue point and each disaster-affected point; according to the information of the rescue points and the disaster-affected points, establishing an objective function of minimizing the total rescue time, scheduling the aircrafts based on a genetic-simulated annealing hybrid algorithm, and outputting the starting point and the ending point of each aircraft; establishing an objective function for minimizing the total flight mileage according to the starting point and the ending point of the aircraft, and outputting the optimal flight path of each aircraft based on an improved ant colony algorithm; the invention relates to a navigation rescue scheduling optimization method based on rescue efficiency, which is characterized in that a general aircraft is used as a scheduling research object, the load, the flight time and the number of airplanes of the aircraft are used as constraint conditions, and a multi-rescue-point and multi-disaster-point aircraft scheduling optimization model is established by taking the maximization of the rescue efficiency and the minimization of the total flight mileage as targets.

title_en: Crowd emergency evacuation method, system, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a crowd emergency evacuation method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out indoor and outdoor geometric information registration on the indoor BIM scene data model and the outdoor GIS scene data model, and constructing an indoor and outdoor integrated emergency evacuation grid model; acquiring evacuation drilling images of indoor and outdoor scenes, excavating microscopic evacuation behavior characteristics of evacuation crowds from the evacuation drilling images, and establishing a static geometric attribute-macroscopic state-microscopic evacuation behavior characteristic relation library of the indoor and outdoor scenes according to the microscopic evacuation behavior characteristics; constructing an indoor and outdoor integrated emergency evacuation optimization model based on the indoor and outdoor integrated emergency evacuation grid model and a static geometric attribute-macroscopic state-microscopic evacuation behavior characteristic relation library; and solving the indoor and outdoor integrated emergency evacuation model by using an optimization solving algorithm to obtain an optimal dynamic evacuation strategy. The method and the device solve the problem of incompatibility of indoor and outdoor evacuation models, and can greatly improve evacuation efficiency.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS;SHENZHEN ZHILIAN TIME AND SPACE TECH CO LTD;SHENZHEN SHUANGYIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle disaster relief system and method based on deep learning and radar detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle disaster relief system and a method based on deep learning and radar detection, wherein a microwave radar is used for transmitting an electromagnetic wave signal with a certain frequency and a receiving antenna is used for receiving a human body echo signal; radar echo signals of a human body under various different environments are collected, and the diversity of signal waveforms is improved; selecting and processing the received echo signals to obtain required signal waveforms; dividing the acquired effective signal wave bands into a training set and a test set according to a proper proportion; inputting data of all training sets into a convolutional neural network, completing model training on a cloud server, and then detecting whether people are trapped by using the trained models; an unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying a tested radar detection device to detect living body existence information in an environment in real time; the detection device utilizes the WiFi module to transmit the collected environmental echo signals to the server, and a living body detection result is obtained.

title_en: Hydraulic simulation and control system for complex water delivery channel system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic simulation and control system of a complex water delivery canal system, which comprises a water delivery engineering numerical simulation module (10), a water delivery engineering optimization control module (20) and an emergency simulation module (30); the water delivery engineering numerical simulation module (10) is used for establishing water delivery simulation models under various working conditions of reservoir and irrigation area engineering, and displaying model operation parameters and operation results under each working condition in the system through model offline operation calculation; the water delivery project optimization control module (20) realizes the display of various optimization management schemes and the display of calculation results based on the optimization management schemes; the emergency simulation module (30) is used for displaying various emergency management schemes and displaying online simulation of calculation results of offline mathematical models in various emergency situations. Compared with the prior art, the complex water delivery canal system hydraulic simulation and control method disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the system target is set, the project safety of the irrigation area is ensured to the greatest extent, and the disaster risk is reduced.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;CHONGZUO ZUOJIANG DROUGHT CONTROL PROJECT MAN CENTER

title_en: Potential identification method for coal rock mass water inrush danger area under stress and seepage action
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential identification method for a coal rock mass water inrush danger area under the action of stress and seepage, which is suitable for monitoring and early warning of on-site coal rock stratum water inrush disasters. Applying axial stress and water medium seepage action to the samples of the prefabricated water guide channel and the induced cavity, and simulating the inoculation development process of the water inrush disaster of the coal rock mass; simultaneously arranging a plurality of potential measuring points on the surface of the sample, and testing potential signals and seepage parameters of the sample in the deformation and rupture process; and then, performing potential inversion imaging, defining a danger critical value of a potential inversion value based on the membership index, and judging and identifying a water inrush danger area in the sample. The method has high potential inversion result precision, approximately 'lossless' testing process, and can provide a new technical means for monitoring and early warning on-site coal and rock stratum water inrush disasters.

title_en: Fire disaster instance segmentation method based on semi-supervised learning strategy
abstract_en: A fire disaster example segmentation method based on a semi-supervised learning strategy belongs to the field of image processing. Comprising the following steps: the existing example segmentation model is improved, and the model precision is improved by introducing an attention mechanism and a deformable convolution; aiming at the problem that a fire disaster example segmentation task lacks data samples and labels, a semi-supervised learning strategy of an example segmentation model based on a fire disaster scene is provided, color and morphological characteristics of flame and smoke are introduced, confidence screening is carried out on pseudo tags generated in the semi-supervised learning, and precision loss caused by false tags is reduced; aiming at the problems of class imbalance in the data set and precision loss of the semi-supervised learning false labels, the mixed training set is subjected to image enhancement through an improved copy-paste algorithm. The accuracy and generalization of the model are effectively improved. The method solves the defects of low precision and low generalization of the fire scene example segmentation model.

title_en: Preparation method and modulus analysis method of sediment sample containing blocky hydrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a modulus analysis method of a sediment sample containing blocky hydrate, comprising the following steps: simulating bulk natural gas hydrate in reservoir sediments with spherical particles of pure tetrahydrofuran hydrate; the diameter and the quantity ratio of the hydrate spherical particles are simulated equally according to the distribution of the natural gas hydrate at the in-situ soil layer; according to the total volume fraction of the natural gas hydrate at the in-situ soil layer, calculating to obtain the volume fraction of the natural gas hydrate with a certain size, and obtaining the volume fraction of the hydrate spherical particles; calculating the number of hydrate spherical particles with different diameters according to the set target remodelling sample volume and the combination volume fraction; five layers are filled into a triaxial geotechnical sample preparation three-valve mould after mixing and are crushed to reach the target height, so that a target remolded sample is obtained, a triaxial apparatus is used for testing to be similar to the site, and the sample is used for carrying out modulus analysis, so that technical guarantee is provided for developing submarine disasters and protecting the environment of natural gas hydrate.

title_en: Neural network-based building damage assessment method after natural disaster
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of building damage assessment, in particular to a method for assessing building damage after natural disasters based on a neural network. The building damage assessment method comprises the following steps: acquiring a satellite remote sensing image RSI of an area to be evaluated, wherein the satellite remote sensing image RSI comprises a pre-disaster RSI and a post-disaster RSI; establishing an image set, and labeling the image set to obtain a labeled image set; establishing a data set for evaluating the building damage based on the labeled image set; building damage assessment network BDANet is constructed based on the neural network; training the BDANet by using the data set to obtain a building damage assessment model; the building damage assessment model is used for assessing the damage degree of buildings in the area to be assessed so as to solve the problems that in the prior art, huge pixel images need to be processed quickly, building positioning accuracy is low, and building damage assessment accuracy is low.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling water damage area of thick and non-homogeneous sandstone
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preventing and controlling a water disaster area of a huge thick heterogeneous sandstone, which adopts various geophysical prospecting methods, a water inflow amount of a drilling unit and a water-rich property prediction method of an aquifer based on a deposition water control law to jointly determine a water-rich abnormal area, the directional long drilling main hole is designed according to the determination of the water-rich abnormal area and the flow direction of the underground water flow, the reliability of the prediction result of the water-rich property of the coal seam mining roof aquifer is improved, a reliable basis is provided for the arrangement of roof drainage water drilling holes, meanwhile, on the basis of the definition result of the water-rich abnormal area and the height judgment result of the water flowing fractured zone, the invention measures the flow velocity of the underground water and simulates the underground water flow field, directional long drill holes are arranged along the water flowing fractured zone along the direction vertical to the direction of underground water flow, and branch holes are formed in the water-rich abnormal area to drain water on the top plate of the water-rich abnormal area, so that the number of the drill holes is reduced, and the water prevention and control cost of a coal mine is reduced.
assignees: CHINA COAL ENERGY RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Landslide deep displacement monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide deep displacement monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and mainly comprises a plurality of monitoring assemblies which are sequentially connected, wherein each monitoring assembly comprises an installation pipe and a connecting pipe which are connected with each other; the monitoring assembly at the tail position is connected with a guider for drilling. This monitoring devices forms a plurality of monitoring nodes through designing multiunit monitoring subassembly, can effectively increase monitoring range to every monitoring subassembly forms the main part through installation pipe and connecting pipe, and the installation pipe can play the rigidity protection, and the connecting pipe plays the flexonics who has certain intensity, can fine reply the yielding characteristics of geological structure, reaches stable in structure, the difficult purpose of cutting.

title_en: Disaster damage identification method, device, equipment and storage medium based on remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a disaster damage identification method based on remote sensing images, which comprises the following steps: inputting the training remote sensing image set with the enhanced data into a disaster damage recognition model to obtain a disaster damage degree type, counting the number of pixel points in the training remote sensing image under the disaster damage degree type, calculating a first distribution value and a second distribution value corresponding to the disaster damage degree, calculating preset loss weight values of the first distribution value and the second distribution value, carrying out weighted accumulation on the preset loss weight values and the loss values to obtain a final loss value, adjusting the disaster damage recognition model according to the final loss value to obtain a standard disaster damage recognition model, and inputting the remote sensing image to be recognized into the standard disaster damage recognition model to obtain a disaster damage recognition result. In addition, the invention also relates to a block chain technology, and the first distribution value can be stored in a node of the block chain. The invention further provides a disaster damage identification device based on the remote sensing image, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention can improve the disaster damage identification efficiency.

title_en: Regional geological disaster trend prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional geological disaster trend prediction method and system, and relates to the field of data analysis. A regional geological disaster trend prediction method comprises the following steps: acquiring geological disaster parameter information of a target area and historical geological disaster parameter information of the target area; preprocessing geological disaster parameter information of a target area and historical geological disaster parameter information of the target area; training a geological disaster trend prediction model through the preprocessed parameter information; and inputting each sample point in the target area into the geological disaster trend prediction model to obtain a geological disaster trend prediction result of the target area. The accuracy of the prediction model can be guaranteed by obtaining a training set constructed by a large number of samples through the acquired historical data. In addition, the invention also provides a regional geological disaster trend prediction system, which comprises: the device comprises an acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a model training module and a prediction module.

title_en: Tailing pond risk monitoring and early warning system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tailing pond risk monitoring and early warning system based on the Internet of things, which belongs to the technical field of tailing pond safety monitoring and comprises a risk comprehensive monitoring module, a risk intelligent evaluation module, a risk accurate early warning module, a risk trend prediction module and a disaster simulation module; the risk comprehensive monitoring module is used for realizing dynamic comprehensive display of the tailing pond data, acquiring monitoring data and monitoring video data of the tailing pond sensor, wherein the monitoring data comprise rainfall, pond water level, dry beach length, infiltration line, dam surface displacement, dam internal displacement, reservoir geological landslide surface displacement and the like; the monitoring video data comprise monitoring data of overflow wells, beach top ore drawing positions, tail discharge pipelines, downstream slopes of dam bodies, reservoir water level gauges, dry beach benchmarks and the like; and (3) establishing a GIS map of the tailing pond, and inputting the acquired monitoring data and the monitoring video data into the GIS map, so that the point location situation of the internet of things perception of each tailing pond can be controlled in an omnibearing manner through the GIS map.

title_en: Test device, system and method for simulating seismic transverse wave dynamic loading of deep-buried tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device, a system and a method for simulating seismic transverse wave dynamic loading of a deep-buried tunnel, belonging to the technical field of model tests, wherein the test device comprises a base and a model test platform, the model test platform is connected to the base in a sliding manner, and one side of the model test platform is connected with a first loading rod for applying transverse pressure; the bottom of the model test platform is connected with a second loading rod, the second loading rod is connected with the eccentric wheel mechanism to generate vibration and transmit the vibration to the first loading rod, and the first loading rod pushes the model test platform to move horizontally. The method can effectively simulate the earthquake transverse wave simulation dynamic loading process, and can provide basis for the disaster pregnancy mode and the disaster causing mechanism of the deep-buried tunnel according to the detection data.

title_en: Water-rich karst area blasting simulation system and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water-rich karst area blasting simulation system which comprises a simulation sample, a simulation karst cave, a mud injection channel and a water delivery channel, wherein the simulation sample is provided with at least one blast hole, the simulation karst cave is arranged in the simulation sample, the simulation karst cave is respectively connected with one ends of the mud injection channel and the water delivery channel, and the other ends of the mud injection channel and the water delivery channel respectively extend to the surface of the simulation sample. By adopting the technical scheme, the condition of water inrush and mud inrush of the water-rich karst area under high-speed dynamic load operation is simulated, the theory and the test are disclosed, the mechanical characteristics and the evolution rule of the water-rich karst structure in the instantaneous damage process are disclosed, and an effective basis is provided for the research of the mechanism of the water inrush disaster of the tunnel; meanwhile, the structure is simple, and the device is economical and practical.
assignees: MIDDLE ROAD BRIDGE SOUTH CHINA ENG CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting disaster relief three-dimensional simulation drilling system based on space-time big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of three-dimensional imaging, in particular to a fire fighting disaster relief three-dimensional simulation drilling system based on space-time big data. The system comprises a fire fighting disaster relief three-dimensional simulation drilling tool layer and a space-time big data layer, wherein the fire fighting disaster relief three-dimensional simulation drilling tool layer comprises a scene fusion module, a planning analysis module, a model training module, a simulation system module and a three-dimensional simulation module, the space-time big data layer comprises a 3D GIS system module, a BIM model library module, an IOT system module, a CIM intelligent model module and a big data analysis module, the space-time big data layer constructs a three-dimensional environment of a big scene and fuses model training and space data, the space-time big data layer and the fire fighting disaster relief three-dimensional simulation drilling tool layer establish information connection and provide data, and the fire fighting disaster relief three-dimensional simulation drilling tool layer produces three-dimensional simulation scenes for a user to drill and feeds back an analysis result to the user. By utilizing the technology of the Internet of things, favorable reference is provided for the analysis of the real environment of the system, and the formulated scheme has high reliability.
assignees: SHENZHEN SPACEFLIGHT SMART CITY SYSTEM TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Method for constructing river channel water quality model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water environment analysis, in particular to a method for constructing a river channel water quality model; acquiring basic data consisting of river network water system information, hydraulic engineering information, pipe network arrangement information, water quality monitoring data, water level data and rainfall forecast data of a research area; calculating water environment capacity and water pollutant migration data based on the basic data; acquiring water environment capacity and water body pollutant migration data, and performing simulation and emergency response on sudden water pollution events based on the water environment capacity and the water body pollutant migration data to generate simulation results; visualizing the simulation result; and establishing a river water quality model so as to obtain migration and transformation data of the pollutants, performing dynamic time-space simulation on the water pollution sudden accident, forecasting and dynamically displaying the arrival place, time, range, concentration and duration of the pollutants, and striving for the time for emergency measures to deal with, thereby being beneficial to timely and accurately treating the pollutants.
assignees: SHENZHEN WATER AFFAIR SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Test device and test method for simulating engine compartment spray fire
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aerospace engineering, and discloses a test device and a test method for simulating a spray fire disaster of an engine room. The hydraulic oil supply device is used for conveying hydraulic oil, the temperature control device is used for adjusting the temperature of the hydraulic oil, and the pressure regulating device is used for adjusting the pressure of the hydraulic oil; one end of the first branch is connected with an oil outlet of the main road, and the other end of the first branch is connected with an oil inlet of the main road to form a first loop; the first branch is provided with an oil injection device which is arranged in the experiment cabin; one end of the second branch is connected with the oil outlet of the main road, and the other end of the second branch is connected with the oil inlet of the main road to form a second loop; the switching device is used for switching the hydraulic oil to be conveyed between the first loop and the second loop; the igniter is arranged in the experiment cabin; the oil supply device, the temperature control device, the pressure regulating device, the switching device and the igniter are all electrically connected to the control unit.

title_en: Support method of swing type anti-seismic recoverable anchor rod suitable for complex slope support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a support method of a swing type anti-seismic recoverable anchor rod suitable for complex slope support. The slope supporting method comprises the following steps: 1, drilling a hole; 2, installing an anchor; 3 grouting and maintaining; 4, constructing a retaining wall or a surface layer; 5, mounting an anchor head; 6, tensioning and locking. Unsealing after earthquake disasters; the anti-seismic device is reset. The invention effectively solves the problem that the rock-soil body of the side slope collapses and slides off due to the fact that the anchor rod cannot resist earthquake load, damage or anchoring failure occurs in the traditional side slope reinforcing method, provides the side slope supporting method of the swing type earthquake-proof recoverable anchor rod which is advanced in earthquake-proof concept, excellent in earthquake-proof performance, capable of resisting earthquake in a grading manner and capable of recovering for the second time after the earthquake and is suitable for supporting the complex side slope, and has wide application prospect and remarkable economic and social benefits.

title_en: Slope-cutting house-building prediction method
abstract_en: The application discloses a slope-cutting building prediction method which at least comprises the following steps of 1, generating a terrain digital elevation model of a region to be simulated, generating a space line buffer zone model according to a buffer distance, 2, calculating the height difference between the terrain digital elevation model and the space line buffer zone model, and 3, judging whether geological disaster risks exist according to the height difference. The application utilizes the slope-cutting building height difference recognition technology to build a buffer area of a plurality of meters behind a building, acquires the area height difference, judges the occurrence condition of slope-cutting building in the area, provides data for screening of various areas, determines risk level and prevention and control measures, and provides technical support for preventing life and property loss of people caused by geological disasters.

title_en: Intelligent anti-wind system and method for one-key mine fan
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent anti-wind system of a one-key mine fan, which comprises a real-time simulation resolving and analyzing model of a mine ventilation system, a mine anti-wind analyzing and deciding system, a fire disaster identifying system, an alarm system and a mine anti-wind system control platform; the fire disaster recognition system is in signal connection with the real-time simulation resolving and analyzing model of the mine ventilation system, the real-time simulation resolving and analyzing model of the mine ventilation system is in signal connection with the mine anti-wind analysis and decision system, and the mine anti-wind analysis and decision system is in signal connection with the mine anti-wind system control platform. The invention also provides an intelligent one-key mine fan back-wind method, and the intelligent one-key mine fan back-wind system and method can realize full-mine back-wind, regional back-wind or local back-wind according to the fire place of alarm.

title_en: National soil space planning display stand with disaster influence simulation function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a national soil space planning display stand with a disaster influence simulation function, which comprises a main support plate, a support frame, a support plate, a water tank, a left piston cylinder, a right piston cylinder, a water pumping pipe, a water conveying pipe, a lower connecting nozzle, a first electromagnet, a fixed bearing seat, a first shaft, a first bevel gear, a first gear, a rack, a sealing piston, a lower spring, a spraying part and an adjusting part, wherein the support frame is fixed at the bottom end of the main support plate, the support plate is fixed at the bottom of the support frame, the water tank is fixed at the bottom end of the support plate, and two left piston cylinders are fixed at the left part of the top end of the support plate. The invention has the functions of earthquake disaster influence simulation, heavy rainfall disaster simulation, high wind disaster simulation and the like, can control the movement amplitude of the auxiliary supporting disc by controlling the length of the push rod motor extending out of the push rod, and can control the movement frequency of the auxiliary supporting disc by controlling the rotating speed of the first double-shaft motor, thereby realizing the simulation of the transverse vibration of earthquakes of different grades.

title_en: Fire-fighting shell for installing fire-proof roller shutter
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting facilities, and particularly relates to a fire-fighting shell for mounting a fire-proof roller shutter. The utility model comprises the following steps: a water supply pipe is arranged on the inner wall of the fire-fighting shell; the inner wall surface of the water supply pipe is provided with a water spraying groove inclined towards the roller shutter shaft, and the outer wall surface is provided with a drilling platform protruding outwards; the drilling platform is provided with a plurality of through holes communicated with the water spraying grooves, and the through holes and the water spraying grooves are intersected to form nozzles; a water outlet is formed in the lower portion of the fire fighting shell, and the fire-proof curtain cloth penetrates out of the water outlet; when a fire disaster happens, the fireproof curtain cloth automatically falls down, and water is sprayed out from the nozzles and flows down along the two surfaces of the fireproof curtain cloth. According to the utility model, the fireproof rolling curtain is arranged in the fire-fighting shell, so that the influence of strong wind and heat flow on the water spraying of the nozzle towards the rolling curtain shaft can be effectively avoided, the water sprayed out of the nozzle can be just coated on the front side and the back side of the fireproof curtain cloth, the double-side cooling of the fireproof curtain cloth is realized, and the fire-retardant duration of the fireproof curtain cloth is greatly prolonged.
assignees: CHANGZHOU MIRACULOUS CREATIVE DESIGN LTD COMPANY

title_en: A slip casting device for mine geological disasters are administered
abstract_en: The utility model provides a grouting device for treating mine geological disasters, relates to the technical field of grouting devices, and aims to solve the problem that when the existing grouting device is used, a large amount of silt is precipitated at the bottom of a stirring device due to the gravity of the silt, so that the stirring is not uniform; the mounting mechanism is a grouting device body, and a stirring mechanism is mounted in the mounting mechanism; a drilling mechanism is arranged between the adjusting mechanisms; the contact element is positioned at the bottom of the stirring element; the bottom piece is arranged at the bottom of the storage piece. Stirring piece bottom rectangle is protruding through setting up to the slope form, can play the effect of better stirring, and the bottom spare sets up to the round platform shape can make silt to the bottom landing to conical arch through the contact bottom contacts with silt, and then plays the effect of better stirring.

title_en: Self-propelled hollow grouting anchor rod with displacement monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-advancing hollow grouting anchor rod with a displacement monitoring function, which solves the problems that in the process of carrying out engineering treatment on geological disasters, drilling, grouting and installation of a displacement monitoring device cannot be carried out at one time, the displacement monitoring effect and monitoring of underground water of rock-soil bodies are not ideal.
assignees: SICHUAN PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL MINERAL EXPLOR AND DEVELOPMENT BUREAU CHENGDU HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENGINEERIN

title_en: Portable biological identification and analysis device for firefighter combat training
