abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable device for identifying and analyzing war training creatures of firemen, which comprises a main body, wherein a display screen is fixed on the inner side of the main body, supporting seats are symmetrically arranged on the rear side of the main body, placing clamping grooves are symmetrically formed in the rear side of the main body, the supporting seats are clamped into the inner sides of the placing clamping grooves, a fixing groove is formed in one end of each supporting seat, a rotating groove is formed in the bottom end of each placing clamping groove, a rotating block is arranged on the inner side of each rotating groove, and connecting columns are arranged at the top end of each rotating block and the other end of each supporting seat, corresponding to the inner sides of the placing clamping grooves; through spliced pole, rotatory piece, swivelling chute, stopper, the fixed slot of design, improve the fixed connection between original supporting seat and the main part, have certain inconvenient phenomenon when using, make the supporting seat accomodate under the condition of not using to increase the use portability of this device of fire fighter's war training biological identification and analysis.
assignees: XIAN JINMA WISDOM INFORMATION TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Forest fire prevention method, system, equipment and storage medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a forest fire prevention method, a forest fire prevention system, forest fire prevention equipment and a storage medium based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving fire alarm information, wherein the fire alarm information comprises fire source coordinates and an alarm signal for feeding back fire occurrence; acquiring a real-time panoramic image of a forest, and extracting color data in the real-time panoramic image of the forest; forming forest density information according to the comparison of the color data and a preset numerical value, wherein the forest density information comprises a dark color area with the color data larger than the preset numerical value and a light color area with the color data smaller than the preset numerical value; extracting coordinates of the light color area; extracting contour line coordinates in preset topographic data; deleting coordinates in the light color area which are overlapped with the contour line coordinates, and forming interstitial coordinates on the rest coordinates in the light color area; and sequentially connecting the adjacent slot coordinates by taking the fire source coordinates as a center to form a simulation route and sending the simulation route to the intelligent terminal of the firefighter. This application has the effect that the guarantee fire fighter can in time reach the source of a fire and carry out the work of putting out a fire.
assignees: SHANDONG SHANXIANG SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for setting coal bed stress monitoring rock burst critical early warning index value
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of monitoring and early warning of dynamic disasters of mines, in particular to a method for setting a critical early warning index value for monitoring rock burst in coal bed stress monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: 1. manufacturing a cubic coal briquette standard part and a shortened type stress gauge; 2. punching holes in the cubic coal blocks and installing a stress meter; 3. the testing machine applies preloading force to the cubic coal blocks; 4. initially pressurizing the stress meter; 5. testing according to a one-way compression mode and a cyclic loading and unloading mode respectively; 6. analyzing and summarizing the functional relation between the coal body stress and the elastic stage of the borehole stress line, and establishing a functional relation formula; 7. and providing a method for setting and revising indexes of critical early warning values of coal bed stress monitoring rock burst. The invention solves the problems that the existing method for monitoring and early warning rock burst through coal seam drilling stress has no difference between mines and no laboratory theoretical basis, and can not differentially guide a mine to monitor and early warn.
assignees: BEIJING ANKE MINE SAFETY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;HENAN LARGE ENERGY STOCK LTD COMPANY;HONGYANG THREE ORES PRODUCED BY SHENYANG COKING COAL CO LTD

title_en: Precast diamond framed segmental linings concrete units for tunnel shaft
abstract_en: As a vital ventilation channel of a long highway tunnel, the shaft channel plays a vital role in regulating air pressure, ventilation and disaster prevention and rescue. Although there are relatively mature technologies in mining and hydropower industries at home and abroad, the research on shaft construction mainly focuses on improving the mechanisation of shaft construction and how to improve the number of monthly driving meters. However, there is less research on the mechanical characteristics of deep shaft construction of long and deep buried highway tunnels. A Precast Diamond Framed Lining Structure (PDFSL)was invented based on simulations and analyses of Huayingshan tunnel shaft with interlacing surrounding rock grades. This innovation is adopted if there is a need to minimise construction cost, shorten the projection construction period, maintain quality work, reduce environmental impacts and local disruption.

title_en: First responder training equipment
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to the field of equipment for training people, in particular, first responders acting in a critical situation, such as accident, natural disaster, or war.The present invention proposes a system to provide a more realistic simulation of a given scenario, as well as a better assessment of the participant's behavior. For that purpose, it is proposed, in the frame of the present description, a first responder training equipment comprising :- a central processing unit connected with :- a location determination module,- a long-range telecommunication module,- at least one body vital sensor,- at least one indicator,- at least one sensor,- an internal power supply, and wherein the central processing unit comprises a memory storing a program that, while activated, executes a training scenario.

title_en: Tunnel surrounding rock collapse test device under water-rock coupling effect and working method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tunnel surrounding rock collapse test device under the water-rock coupling effect and a working method, and the tunnel surrounding rock collapse test device comprises a rectangular test structure frame, wherein the left side and the right side of the test structure frame are respectively provided with a reservoir and a transverse loading plate, the front side and the rear side of the test structure frame are provided with transparent panels, and the top of the test structure frame is provided with a vertical loading plate; the two sides of the reservoir are respectively provided with a water injection hole and a water baffle plate, and the water injection hole is positioned on the side wall of the test structure frame close to one side of the reservoir; the water baffle plate is arranged opposite to the transverse loading plate. The test body is accommodated in the closed space formed in the test structure frame, the water pressure environment at the excavation position of the tunnel surrounding rock is simulated through the reservoir in the closed space, the tunnel ground stress environment is simulated through loading a stable load on the test body in advance, the tunnel surrounding rock collapse disaster under the water rock coupling effect is simulated after the reservoir and the test body are communicated, and the test process is observed through the transparent panels on the front side and the rear side of the test structure frame in real time.
assignees: FIRST ENGINEERING DEVELOPMENT LTD COMPANY OF CHINA RAILWAY 14 BUREAU GROUP;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Electrode device for monitoring geological disasters, dams and tunnel safety based on resistivity method
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disaster, dam and tunnel safety monitoring electrode device based on a resistivity method, which comprises a tapered threaded electrode, a drilling expansion assembly arranged at the end part of the tapered threaded electrode and a locking adjusting assembly sleeved on the tapered threaded electrode, wherein the drilling expansion assembly comprises a drill pipe and a drill pipe; the end, far away from the drilling expansion assembly, of the conical threaded electrode is connected with a main cable, and the drilling expansion assembly is suitable for drilling the earth surface and is fixed in the earth surface; the locking adjustment assembly is adapted to control the tension between the borehole expansion assembly and the wall of a borehole within the earth's surface. The electrode of this device is higher with the soil coupling nature of target electrode monitoring point, and receives human factor and natural factor to influence lessly, and monitoring precision is higher, and the total cable is walked the line and is buried in the underground, avoids long-term monitoring in-process, and the cable is broken in the mistake touch that electrode tip and cable leak outward lead to, guarantees monitoring data's validity.

title_en: Geological disaster model display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster model display device which comprises a base, wherein a barrel body is arranged at the top end of the base, a platform is arranged at the top end in the barrel body, a plurality of geological models are fixedly mounted at the top of the platform, a bottom plate is arranged in the barrel body and positioned at the lower end of the platform, the outer side of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the inner side of the barrel body, a sleeve is fixedly mounted at the top of the bottom plate, a straight rod is inserted in the sleeve, the upper end of the straight rod is fixedly connected to the center of the lower end of the platform, a first spring is sleeved on the straight rod, and two ends of the first spring are fixedly connected to the platform and the sleeve respectively; according to the invention, a proper amount of water is filled in the barrel body, the barrel body is filled with the water, the water can be selected to flow over a plurality of geological models in the barrel body or the water level is positioned below the plurality of geological models according to the display requirement, and when the water level is reduced to a certain degree, the geological models on the platform are kept in situ under the supporting elasticity of the first spring, so that the whole-process state of the geological models influenced by the water level change during flood disasters is simulated.

title_en: User terminal, disaster prevention system, user terminal program, and cooperation method using user terminal
abstract_en: To provide a user terminal, a disaster prevention system, a user terminal program, and a cooperation method that reduce the burden on staffs in the event of a disaster and enhance the understanding of manuals and the like during training.SOLUTION: In a disaster prevention system, a user terminal 1 includes acquisition means 2 for acquiring disaster information; action display means 3 for acquiring action information 3a from a recording unit 31a and displaying it on a display unit; input acquisition means 4 for acquiring end information 4a acquired by input from a staff and including information on end of the action; transmission means 5 for transmitting the end information to a server 23; and another terminal display means 6 for displaying, on the display unit, another terminal progress information 6c including end information of another user terminal, based on acquisition of end information 4b of another user terminal from the server. The action display means 3 displays next action information on the display unit based on the acquisition of the end information 4b.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Simulation CPR human first aid suit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulated CPR human body first-aid kit, which comprises a human body model and a terminal platform, wherein the human body model is wirelessly connected with the terminal platform; a cardio-pulmonary resuscitation structure is arranged in the human body model, and comprises a pulmonary air bag and air pressure sensor, a respiratory tract trachea and flow sensor, a position sensor, a photoelectric sensor arranged at the position of a pupil and an action sensor for detecting the opening or closing of the respiratory tract trachea; the terminal platform comprises a human body model placing table, a data terminal and a display screen, wherein the air pressure sensor, the flow sensor and the photoelectric sensor are respectively connected with the input end of the data terminal, and the output end of the data terminal is connected with the input end of the display screen. The training condition and the checking process of the trainees can be recorded by the data terminal, the trainees can score according to a unified standard in operation, and the emergency capacity of cardio-pulmonary resuscitation operation of the trainees is improved when disasters and accidents happen.
assignees: YUNNAN YUNNAN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring equipment fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster monitoring equipment fixing device which comprises a bottom plate, a column body, a first fixing plate, a supporting rod, a rotating plate, a telescopic plate, a second fixing plate, an electric box and a sensor, wherein the first fixing plate is arranged on the bottom plate; the bottom end of the column body is provided with a drill bit which can better drill into the ground to fix the column body, the outer ring is provided with a supporting plate and a supporting rod to enable the column body to be more stable, the bottom plate is fixed by the first threaded nail, the bottom plate is more stable, and the whole device is more stable; all the fixing devices can be freely adjusted and disassembled, so that the device is more convenient to carry and transport and is more time-saving and labor-saving to erect; the expansion plate can freely adjust the cylinder angle, lets the device erect under various geological conditions, and the screw nail one can let the device fixed, has ensured whole device's firm and safety.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating earthquake accidents of hydrogen station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating earthquake accidents of a hydrogenation station, which are characterized in that earthquake scene prediction is carried out according to the type, grade and geographical characteristics of the hydrogenation station, the field type and the earthquake characteristics are determined according to earthquake scene prediction results, the peak acceleration of basic earthquake vibration and the characteristic period of the response spectrum of the basic earthquake vibration acceleration are adjusted, and a finite element model of the earthquake accidents of key components of the hydrogenation station is established; according to the finite element model of the earthquake accident, the hydrogen storage container obtains the displacement condition and the stress strain condition of key components in the hydrogenation station in the earthquake process through numerical simulation calculation under the combined action of the internal pressure load and the earthquake load, and the failure condition and the weak position of the key components are analyzed, so that quantitative data support can be provided for structural improvement of the key components of the hydrogenation station, determination of the safety distance between the key components and site selection of the hydrogenation station, secondary disasters caused by fire explosion due to important equipment dumping and pipeline leakage are prevented, the safety risk of the earthquake accident of the hydrogenation station is reduced, and economic loss is reduced.

title_en: Down-placing tool and down-placing method for deep hole cross-fault Newton force NPR anchor cable
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and provides a lowering tool of a deep-hole cross-fault Newtonian force NPR anchor cable, which comprises a hole bottom prestress anchor pulling device and an aboveground nondestructive prestress static jacking and stretching device; the hole bottom prestress anchor pulling device is clamped at one end of an anchor cable and extends into the hole bottom along with a grouting drilling tool; the underground nondestructive prestress static jacking and stretching device is arranged at the orifice to apply prestress on the other end of the anchor cable at the orifice. The invention can realize that the grouting drilling tool is lifted off the well bottom and completes grouting while the anchor cable is clamped into the well bottom to form an anchor clamping mechanism through the hole bottom prestress anchor pulling device. The underground lossless prestress static jacking and stretching device is designed, lossless prestress is applied to the anchor cable before slurry is solidified, so that the anchor cable overcomes dead weight and stress loss, and an optimum cross-fault Newton force NPR anchor cable monitoring environment is formed.
assignees: LIAONING COLORED RECONNAISSANCE AND RES INSTITUTE LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: VR virtual immersion device for people's air defense evacuation drilling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a VR virtual immersion device for people's air defense evacuation drilling, which relates to the technical field of VR virtual immersion and aims at solving the problem that the existing environment cannot be truly simulated, and the VR virtual immersion device comprises a supporting platform, wherein the inner side of the supporting platform is fixedly connected with a driving motor, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a driving gear, one side of the driving gear is meshed with a transmission gear positioned at the inner side of the supporting platform, the inner side of the transmission gear is fixedly sleeved with a transmission rod which is rotatably sleeved with the supporting platform, one side of the transmission gear is meshed with an intermediate gear which is rotatably connected with the inner side of the supporting platform, and the sides of the intermediate gear and the driving gear, which are far away from each other, are meshed with a lifting gear. Simple operation and convenient use.
assignees: SHENYANG SHIBO TIEESCAPING CULTURE DISPLAY ENGINEERING LTD COMPANY

title_en: Multifunctional integrated animal operating table
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional integrated animal operating table which comprises animal operation components such as a table top, a folding support, a table top extension block, a hook and the like, wherein the table top extension block can be folded and fixed at 0 degree, 90 degrees and 180 degrees. Each part of the animal operating table can be folded, so that the occupied space is reduced, the carrying and the transportation are convenient, the operating table top can be expanded according to the requirement, and the animal operating table is suitable for animals with various body types and sizes; the mesa is the stereoplasm mesa of monoblock integral type, can regard as stereoplasm stretcher to use, and mesa extension piece, couple can and have buffer function's folding support synergism, can effectively avoid the wounded in transport, rescue vehicle transportation because of the secondary damage that reasons such as vibrations lead to, improved the application scope of this animal operating table greatly, be applicable to very much that the traffic is inconvenient such as natural disaster scene is not convenient, the treatment resource is deficient, produce the operation simulation of the first aid environment of wounded in batches.
assignees: FIRST AUXILIARY HOSPITAL OF CHINESE PEOPLE LIBERATION ARMY LAND ARMY AND MILITARY UNIV

title_en: Geological disaster model display device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a geological disaster model display device, which relates to the technical field of display devices and comprises a supporting structure, a vibration structure and a display structure, wherein the display structure is fixedly arranged above the vibration structure, the supporting structure is fixedly arranged below the vibration structure, the display structure comprises a supporting bracket, a mounting plate and a glass protection cover, a geological disaster model body is arranged inside the glass protection cover, the mounting plate can be detachably arranged inside the supporting bracket, and the glass protection cover is arranged on the mounting plate; this geological disaster model display device sets up the slip spray tube structure through sliding on the glass safety cover, can spray water to the position of difference on the model according to the structure of model to can simulate out the geological disasters of landslide, mud-rock flow that local rainfall or large tracts of land rainfall lead to, through control flap, carry out on-off control to the shower nozzle on single T type branch pipe, be convenient for realize controlling the flow of water, thereby reach better water spray effect.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JIUYU GEOLOGICAL ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT PLANNING AND DESIGNING LTD COMPANY

title_en: Deep disaster plan intelligent semantic matching method based on FECF
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent semantic matching method for a deep disaster plan based on FECF (field emission control), which is a method for semantic matching of a disaster plan, belongs to the field of natural language processing and deep learning, and is characterized by comprising the following steps of: (1) modeling a disaster plan problem; (2) determining a feature vector of a word; (3) determining vocabulary context coding and implicit state output of a t position; (4) determining attention information of the text; (5) determining a matching score of the two sentences; (6) model training of the sentence is determined. The method effectively solves the problem of long disaster plan matching time, greatly saves the disaster plan matching time, improves the efficiency of the disaster plan, effectively solves the problem of inaccurate semantic matching of the disaster plan text, greatly improves the accuracy of the disaster plan matching, and provides a scientific and effective basis for post-disaster treatment.

title_en: Karst ground analogue test device that sinks
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of geological disaster causing mechanism and prevention and control, in particular to a karst ground collapse simulation test device. The device comprises a mounting rack, an upper test box arranged above the mounting rack, a water supply and drainage circulating system arranged at the lower part of the mounting rack, a detection control unit arranged in the upper test box and a climate simulation unit for simulating natural climate change; the upper test box comprises an external test box for containing water and an internal test box for containing a soil body, the top of the external test box is open, a first through hole is formed in the middle of the bottom surface of the external test box, the upper end of the internal test box is open, a second through hole is formed in the bottom of the internal test box, and micropores are formed in the outer wall of each internal test box; the technical scheme aims to systematically research the induction factors of the karst soil cave collective collapse, the soil cave evolution and collapse process under the action of the clustering effect so as to accurately judge and effectively prevent and treat the essence of karst ground collapse clusters.
assignees: CHONGQING GEOLOGICAL MINERAL RES INSTITUTE;CHONGQING TAOZHONG SCIENCE AND TECH CO

title_en: Medical logistic planning software
abstract_en: The present invention is a software, methods, and system for creating and editing a medical logistics simulation model and for presenting the simulation model simulated within a military or disaster relief scenario. A user interface that allows a user to enter and edit platforms and associated attributes for a simulation model. The system runs the simulation model based on user input and historical data stored in databases using the inventive software. The present invention provides an output for allowing a user to view casualty rates, patient streams, and medical requirements or any other desired aspect of the simulation model.
assignees: THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICAN AS REPRESENTED BY THE SECRETARY OF THE NAVY

title_en: Sky and ground integrated agricultural remote sensing big data system based on wisdom agriculture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sky and land integrated agricultural remote sensing big data system based on intelligent agriculture, which comprises an intelligent agricultural map display and query module, an agricultural soil environment information display module, a remote sensing seedling condition dynamic monitoring module, a growth model simulation analysis module, a soil moisture monitoring module and a meteorological data display and comparison module. The invention has the beneficial effects that: dynamic monitoring data such as crop growth vigor, flood and drought disasters, disease and pest disasters and the like are realized, and the optimized fertilization quantity, the base and top dressing distribution proportion, the fertilization period and the fertilization method of different crops of each fertilization unit are mastered through field experiments; basic parameters such as soil nutrient correction coefficient, soil fertilizer supply capacity, nutrient absorption of different crops, fertilizer utilization rate and the like are found out; and constructing a crop fertilization model, providing a basis for fertilization subareas and fertilizer formulas, and presenting the basis to all levels of governments and agricultural departments in a visual manner to realize the functions of real-time monitoring of global pest and disease occurrence conditions, risk early warning and data analysis.
assignees: ANHUI YIJUST INFORMATION TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Mobile water jet cutting continuous top cutting method for mine
abstract_en: The invention provides a mobile water jet cutting continuous roof cutting method for a mine, and belongs to the technical field of coal mining. The method comprises the steps of firstly analyzing mechanical properties of a top plate through drilling coring, determining water jet parameters, then cutting the top plate in a roadway of a working face along a drilling connection line, simultaneously observing cutting depth and effect by using a deep hole peeping instrument, dynamically adjusting the parameters, finally supporting the top plate after the top cutting is finished, recovering the working face, and processing a recovery roadway of the next working face. The invention can continuously and completely cut the roof, has controllable direction and does not change the physical and chemical properties of the coal rock mass; the material is safe in nature, does not generate harmful substances, and does not induce derived disasters; the method is safe and environment-friendly, high in top cutting speed and high in efficiency, can adapt to top cutting work under various complex conditions, can well solve disasters caused by inherent properties of thick and hard top plates, and has certain safety and economic benefits.

title_en: Experimental system and testing method for simulating storage tank leakage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hazardous chemical substance fire and explosion experiment tests, in particular to an experiment system and a test method for simulating storage tank leakage. The specific technical scheme is as follows: the utility model provides an experimental system that simulation storage tank leaked, is including the storage tank that has heating device, the sealed rupture membrane clamping device who is located explosion venting control appearance bullet that is provided with of open end of storage tank, explosion venting control is provided with the rupture membrane device who corresponds with rupture membrane clamping device in the appearance bullet, the week side of explosion venting control appearance bullet is visual window, and the side is provided with video acquisition device, video acquisition device is including setting up the schlieren appearance in explosion venting control appearance bullet one side, the light source parallel of schlieren appearance passes the visual window of explosion venting control appearance bullet and reflects the image that forms in the camera. The experimental system and the testing method disclosed by the invention are beneficial to preventing and controlling BLEVE accident disasters in relatively closed places such as underground spaces, tunnels and the like and blocking the propagation of BLEVE domino effect.

title_en: Internal and external coupling landslide disaster-causing mechanism analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internal and external coupling landslide disaster-causing mechanism analysis method, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster analysis. Acquiring the landslide surface displacement rate based on InSAR, tracing the change condition of the internal stress of the landslide by adopting FLAC3D simulation, simulating the change condition of the stress and plastic region under the condition of the dead weight of the landslide and under the influence of an external incentive, and coupling the forming and deformation processes of the landslide; according to the method for analyzing the landslide disaster-causing mechanism with the internal and external coupling, the earth surface deformation monitoring and the geological internal stress tracing are combined, the InSAR and the finite difference-based FLAC3D numerical simulation method are coupled, the internal and external force action result in the landslide motion deformation process is monitored, the disaster-causing mechanism analysis is carried out, and a suggestion is provided for further disaster reduction and prevention.

title_en: BIM-based comprehensive community fire emergency plan deduction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive community fire emergency plan deduction method based on combination of BIM and a lightweight three-dimensional engine, which comprises the steps of selecting a comprehensive community building needing to formulate an emergency plan; the method comprises the steps of building a BIM model of a comprehensive community building, calling the BIM model through a lightweight three-dimensional engine to simulate the distribution of fire source points, the distribution of fire smoke and the personnel evacuation situation in the comprehensive community building, formulating an emergency plan according to the simulation result, configuring response logic for the emergency plan, and calling the emergency plan to process by means of the capability of the lightweight three-dimensional engine. According to the invention, the light three-dimensional engine is used for carrying out the smoke simulation and the personnel evacuation simulation of the fire combustion on the solid model, and comparing the simulation results of the smoke simulation and the personnel evacuation simulation, and the method and the device for preparing the plan according to the simulation results have higher intelligent degree and better effect.

title_en: Method for extracting disaster environment features based on AT-EnFCM-SCNN
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster environment feature extraction method based on AT-EnFCM-SCNN, which is a method for extracting features of a disaster environment, belongs to the field of image processing and machine learning, and is characterized by comprising the following steps: (1) determining a multi-scale opening reconstruction of the gradient image; (2) determining a clustering center; (3) calculating the membership degree; (4) determining whether an iteration condition is reached; (5) a loss function of the convolutional neural network is determined. The method effectively solves the problems that the traditional disaster environment image is single in segmentation form and needs a large number of training samples, provides more local spatial information, better improves the pre-segmentation performance, effectively improves the problems of noise interference and excessive segmentation in the traditional disaster identification image processing, overcomes the defect of incomplete target extraction under a single scale, and effectively ensures the correct extraction of a larger global target. The method with high extraction accuracy is provided for the disaster environment information feature extraction domain.

title_en: Visual fire-fighting smoke gun
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting smoke guns, in particular to a visual fire-fighting smoke gun, which aims at solving the problem that the fire disaster happening situation in the real life cannot be better simulated in the prior art and provides the following scheme, the smoke-discharging device comprises a smoke generator, a cigarette holder is arranged at the top of the smoke generator, a working box is arranged outside the cigarette holder, an auxiliary box is arranged on one side of the working box, a smoke-discharging cover is arranged at the top of the working box, a net-shaped heating wire is arranged inside the smoke-discharging cover, and a swing mechanism for driving the smoke-discharging cover to swing is arranged inside the working box. Moreover, the range of smoke emission is further enlarged through the arranged swing mechanism, so that the condition of fire disaster in real life is better simulated.
assignees: HUBEI HUNGMADA SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Natural disaster simulator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a natural disaster simulator, which comprises a fixed platform, an adjusting mechanism and a base, wherein the adjusting mechanism is installed at the top of the fixed platform and consists of a fixed plate, an electric telescopic rod A, a speed regulator, an electric telescopic rod B, an opposite photoelectric sensor A and an opposite photoelectric sensor B, the electric telescopic rod A is installed on the outer side wall of the fixed plate, the opposite photoelectric sensor A is installed at the output end of the electric telescopic rod A, the electric telescopic rod B is installed on the outer side wall of the fixed plate, the opposite photoelectric sensor B is installed at the output end of the electric telescopic rod B, the speed regulator is installed on the outer side wall of the fixed plate, and the output end of the speed regulator is electrically connected with the input end of the electric telescopic rod A. The vibration amplitude can be adjusted through the adjusting mechanism to be suitable for personnel simulation; the object can be prevented from falling off and being damaged from the top of the base through the protection mechanism.
assignees: CHENGDU YUNDAY SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention partition and infection protection partition
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention partition which is excellent in strength, rigidity and workability and can be assembled without tools for exclusive use or expert knowledge, and to provide an infection protection partition capable of restricting occurrence of infection or the like.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention partition 1 is assembled by a plurality of support poles 3 erected in intervals at a circumference four corners of a stay section 2 of a public facility and a plurality of beams 5 detachably installed between upper parts of the plurality of support poles 3 in the disaster. The plurality of support poles 3 and the beams 5 are molded in a hollow shape by a resin content molding material, a plurality of insertion mount holes 4 for the beams 5 are drilled at the upper part of each support pole 3, and an orientation of the plurality of insertion mount holes 4 are orthogonal. An infection protection partition 10 dividing the stay section 2 is stored in the disaster prevention partition 1. The infection protection partition 10 comprises a plurality of column bars 11 erected in intervals, a plurality of beam bars 19 installed between the plurality of column bars 11, and a resin film 22 covering a space divided by the plurality of column bars 11 and the beam bars 19.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Multi-unmanned platform task collaborative planning method and device based on domain knowledge
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for collaborative planning of tasks of a plurality of unmanned platforms based on domain knowledge. The method comprises the following steps: reconnaissance is carried out on a rescue area, and an area where multi-unmanned platform collaborative rescue is carried out in the rescue area is determined; the rescue actions of the unmanned platform are divided into task allocation actions and functional actions, an intelligent agent is adopted to model the unmanned platform aiming at the task allocation actions, and domain knowledge is adopted to model aiming at the functional actions; the method comprises the steps of generating environment information and disaster information through a pre-constructed environment simulator and a pre-constructed disaster simulator, carrying out training on a centralized reinforcement learning model according to the centralized reinforcement learning model constructed by an intelligent agent corresponding to a plurality of unmanned platforms and interaction with the environment information and the disaster information, outputting the trained centralized reinforcement learning model, and then transferring the model to a real disaster environment for collaborative rescue. By adopting the method, the rescue efficiency can be improved.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLE LIBERATION ARMY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: Mathematical twining-based net cage and net damage detection method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a net cage and netting damage detection method, device and storage medium based on a mathematical twining technology, and relates to the technical field of aquiculture engineering and marine engineering disaster prevention and reduction. Firstly, simulating the complete and damaged condition of a fishing net by using an equivalent numerical model of the fishing net to obtain a large amount of simulated sensing data, then using the data for training an artificial neural network, identifying whether the netting is damaged or not by the artificial neural network according to different simulated sensing signals, and finally, rapidly identifying whether the netting is damaged or not by an identification model according to actual sensing data. The invention realizes real-time damage monitoring of the fishing net, saves labor cost, improves detection efficiency, and overcomes the limitation of self or environmental interference of the net.

title_en: Method for evaluating full-life anti-disaster performance of power transmission tower structure by considering wind-induced fatigue effect
abstract_en: A power transmission tower structure full-life anti-multi-disaster performance evaluation method considering wind-induced fatigue effect is characterized by establishing a power transmission tower structure model, selecting and simulating seismic waves and coherent wind load time courses suitable for a structure; collecting actually measured wind speed and wind direction data of the structure, and calculating the occurrence probability and annual duration of different wind speeds and wind directions; simulating and generating wind load time courses of different wind speeds and wind directions according to the measured data, and loading the power transmission tower structure to obtain a structural stress response time course; counting stress circulation of the structural rod piece under the action of wind load, and calculating fatigue accumulated damage of the structural rod piece in unit time; updating material parameters of the structural rod pieces with different life cycles according to fatigue accumulated damage and a material fatigue performance time-varying model of the structural rod pieces, and establishing time-varying finite element models with different life stages considering wind-induced fatigue performance degradation; and evaluating the anti-disaster performance of the model in the whole life cycle, and verifying the influence of the wind-induced fatigue effect on the anti-disaster performance of the structure at different life stages.

title_en: Railway geological disaster monitoring system suitable for complex and difficult mountain areas
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway geological disaster monitoring system suitable for complex and hard mountain areas, which comprises: drilling; the inclinometer tube is arranged in the drill hole; the SAA equipment is used for monitoring a sliding belt area, is arranged in the inclinometer, and is led out of an orifice at the upper part through a cable so as to realize the outward transmission of monitoring data; the fixed inclinometer is arranged in the inclinometer pipe and is positioned above the SAA equipment; the grouting pipe is arranged in the inclinometer in a penetrating way, and radial grouting holes are formed in the pipe wall in the range of 10-20m at the lower part of the grouting pipe; and grouting and curing the gap in the drill hole through a grouting pipe to form a monitoring system. Compared with the traditional rock-soil mass deep monitoring technology, the utility model realizes three technical advantages: firstly, full-depth coverage monitoring, secondly, high-precision real-time monitoring is realized, and thirdly, cost is greatly reduced, and multi-point position monitoring joint study and judgment are convenient to realize.
assignees: RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA RAILWAY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD;CHINESE RAILWAY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE GROUP LIMITED COMPANY;CHINESE NAT RAILWAY GROUP LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Exercise device for presenting fire and explosion scenes and method for performing emergency exercise by using same
abstract_en: The application provides an exercise device for presenting explosion and fire scenes and a method for presenting the exercise scenes by using the exercise device, in particular for firefighting exercise training of rescue workers.

title_en: Multi-Hazard Spatio-Temporal Zone-Based Evacuation Management Platform
abstract_en: Systems and methods providing for zone-based evacuation management. The systems and methods involve allowing a user to select zones from a user interface. The zones properties may be modified by the user. The user may create evacuation pre-plans for selected zones for different types of incidents. Different scenarios may be used in the creation of the plan. The scenarios may use simulation models to determine the affected zones and the rate of spread of the incident. The systems and methods may also generate and send notifications and alerts to the people residing within the affected zones as well as police departments and fire departments with jurisdiction over the affected areas.

title_en: Indoor testing method and device for fire disaster of FAO system station
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor test method and device for fire disaster of a FAO system station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the simulated station fire information is sent to a TIAS system for the TIAS system to process the fire; comparing a processing instruction obtained by performing fire disaster processing on the TIAS system with a target processing instruction; and under the condition that the processing instruction is consistent with the target processing instruction, determining that the fire disaster processing function of the FAO system is normal. According to the method, station fire information is generated through simulation, related functions during testing of station fires of the FAO system in an indoor testing stage are achieved, related problems of control logic and data setting of the FAO system are exposed in advance, on-site debugging testing time is shortened, and train opening operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Transmission line geological disaster analysis method and system based on deformation detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission line geological disaster analysis method and system based on deformation detection, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing application. The method comprises the steps of obtaining tower foundation geological damage degree distribution based on comparison of a plurality of groups of remote sensing images before and after an earthquake, obtaining an earthquake deformation field diagram by adopting differential interference, marking tower foundation geological damage degree distribution, segmenting according to an offset value range and an offset direction to form a sample library, and training a plurality of artificial neural network models; the method comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing images before and after an earthquake, obtaining a deformation field through differential interference, carrying out segmentation based on an offset value and an offset direction, selecting a corresponding artificial neural network model to obtain the foundation geological damage degree of the broken pole tower, and forming distribution of the power transmission line tower foundation geological damage condition. According to the method, the differential interference is adopted to obtain the earthquake deformation field map, the geological damage degree of the foundation of the power transmission line tower is obtained, and the rapid delineation or the accurate evaluation of the earthquake damage degree of the geological disaster range of the foundation of the power transmission line tower is realized.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Weather disaster prediction and model training method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses a weather disaster prediction and model training method, device, equipment and storage medium. According to the weather disaster prediction model training method, weather acre yield data corresponding to each crop acre yield data in the plurality of crop acre yield data are split, effective data in weather data sets corresponding to the plurality of weather acre yield data are determined, and the weather disaster prediction model is trained by the effective data corresponding to each weather data set and the corresponding weather acre yield data.

title_en: Regional grading early warning method for rainfall induced landslide along mountain expressway
abstract_en: The application discloses a regional and hierarchical early warning method for rainfall-induced landslide along a highway in a mountain area, which relates to the technical field of landslide disaster early warning, and the method utilizes a TRIGRS model to simulate the change of transient pore water pressure of each grid unit in a research area along the highway where rainfall is easy to induce landslide in a rainfall infiltration process, and calculates the stability of each grid unit; secondly, using a grid unit as an evaluation unit, and establishing a mathematical function relation between the average rainfall intensity I and the rainfall duration D and the stability of each evaluation unit by using a TRIGRS model so as to reduce the calculation cost of searching a rainfall I-D threshold value and improve the precision of solving the rainfall threshold value; then, solving a rainfall I-D threshold value of each grid unit in the research area to obtain the spatial distribution of the rainfall I-D threshold value; and finally, based on a rainfall threshold space distribution diagram and in combination with real-time rainfall data, a three-level weather early warning scheme of a research area is established, and a guarantee is provided for the safe operation of the expressway.

title_en: Fluid-solid coupling method for depth integral fluid model and block system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual geographic environment research of a geographic information system, and discloses a fluid-solid coupling method of a depth integral fluid model and a block system, wherein an improved 3D DDA model is coupled with a conventional DFS model to determine the internal interaction force of a coupling structure, and when calculating the flow resistance, the flow resistance is equivalently calculated by utilizing the mutual relation between fluid and block movement speed and by dynamically adjusting the ground elevation; the method can realize interaction of the 3D DDA and the DFS, can simulate and analyze the motion evolution process of the debris flow containing any shape polyhedral blocks under the complex three-dimensional terrain condition, is used for evaluating the development evolution process of the debris flow containing large-volume substances (such as the boulders, the block stones, the trees and the like) and is more in line with the real scene of geological disasters of the debris flow.

title_en: Urban building group loss distribution calculation method after earthquake based on monitoring Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city building group loss distribution calculation method after earthquake based on a monitoring Internet of things, belonging to the technical field of earthquake engineering; the method comprises the following steps: collecting the information of each single building in a target city before an earthquake occurs, establishing a data information base of an urban building group, and constructing a numerical simulation model of the urban building group; the method comprises the steps of bringing a monitoring system of public buildings in a target city into the Internet of things, and building a target city monitoring Internet of things; after an earthquake occurs, carrying out earthquake loss calculation simulation on the urban building group according to the actually measured earthquake waves; estimating the earthquake damage degree of the monitored building according to the damage conditions of the internal equipment and the home decoration of the building identified by the monitoring image; and estimating and correcting a numerical simulation result based on the damage degree inferred by the monitoring image, and evaluating the damage states of other unmonitored buildings to obtain the loss distribution of the urban building group after the earthquake. The method can realize the rapid estimation of the earthquake damage distribution of the urban building group after the earthquake occurs, and provides important reference for post-disaster rescue and emergency management.

title_en: True triaxial test method for simulating stress state of boundary rock excavated in underground engineering
abstract_en: A true triaxial test method for simulating the stress state of boundary rocks excavated by underground engineering comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: reforming a pressure-bearing cushion block, and processing a guide chute on the pressure-bearing cushion block; step two: additionally arranging an empty surface oil baffle plate, and processing a guide slide rail on the empty surface oil baffle plate; step three: processing and manufacturing a rock sample; step four: clamping and positioning a rock sample; step five: coating a sealant on a rock sample; step six: drying the sealant; step seven: installing an LVDT displacement sensor and an empty face oil baffle; step eight: and carrying out a true triaxial compression test. The true triaxial test method for simulating the stress state of the boundary rock of the underground engineering excavation considers the single-sided adjacent space in the stress state of the boundary rock of the underground engineering excavation, meets the true triaxial test conditions of five-sided loading and two-rigid-one-soft, can enable the obtained strength characteristic and deformation characteristic of the boundary rock of the underground engineering excavation to be closer to the true value, and provides design parameters and theoretical basis for underground engineering design and disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Method and system for determining spreading characteristics of damage of diamond back moth
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for determining the spreading characteristics of the damage of a diamond back moth, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) Acquiring the gravity center of an early insect source point, and superposing the gravity center of the insect source point and insect pest information; (2) Searching pest areas near the pest points by taking the early pest points as circle centers, and generating a pest information range diagram according to the pest areas; (3) Sequentially judging the Euclidean distance of each insect pest area relative to all insect source points, and determining insect disaster 'group' ranges caused by different insect source points according to the distance minimum principle; (4) According to the method, the multi-time-phase images are calculated to obtain a time sequence set of the spread of the damage of the rigid bamboo moth every month and years in the current year; (5) And calculating related indexes based on the whole group and the gravity center of the group, and determining the spreading path and characteristics of the diamond-back moth in the current year and month and year. The method and the system are favorable for realizing simulation and prediction of the current year month by month and year by year spreading condition of the insect pest on the basis of current year month by month and year by year data.

title_en: Multi-agent evacuation simulation device based on human spanning capability and simulation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent evacuation simulation device based on human crossing capability, which comprises an information extraction module, a calculation analysis module, a communication module and a visualization module, wherein the information extraction module, the calculation analysis module, the communication module and the visualization module are used for different disaster types, evacuation scenes, evacuation people numbers and evacuation people types; the invention analyzes the attribute and the behavior influencing the individual evacuation, considers the interaction among different individuals and between the individuals and the obstacles, provides an obstacle crossing judgment formula as the basis for the individuals to cross the obstacles in the evacuation process, and establishes a corresponding crowd evacuation model. Because the relationship between people and obstacles in the evacuation process can be truly reflected, the method and the device can simulate the crowd evacuation condition under the emergency condition more truly. And discloses a simulation method thereof. The invention can realize evacuation simulation in various scenes and output evacuation routes for evacuating people.

title_en: Replacement grouting fire extinguishing method suitable for deep fire disaster under open-pit mine railway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a replacement grouting fire extinguishing method suitable for deep fire disaster under an open-pit mine railway, which comprises the following steps: determining a target area where fire occurs or fire danger exists; carrying out depth reduction operation on the side face of the railway corresponding to the target area; drilling a target area on the operation surface, and drilling by a drilling machine by adopting a wet method until the drilling depth reaches the target area; injecting a flame-retardant material into the drill hole by using a grouting machine for filling; backfilling to the ground surface height to realize complete sealing. The method can directly take out part of the combustible materials and directly reach the deep part of the fire disaster, thoroughly eliminates the fire disaster in the deep part under the railway line of the open-pit mine from the source, protects the atmospheric environment of the pit, and simultaneously recovers the combustible materials to create economic benefit. The area under the roadbed is not damaged, and the stability and the operation of the railway are not influenced. The application range is wide.
assignees: FUSHING LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANIES OF MINING GROUP

title_en: Simulated fire fighting training method and device for nuclear power station, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear power station fire fighting, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for simulating fire fighting training of a nuclear power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a fire fighting drill instruction for carrying out fire fighting simulation drill on a preset nuclear power station model; the fire drill instruction comprises an area to be extinguished; sending the area to be extinguished to a mobile terminal of a user to be trained so that the user to be trained can determine an extinguishment plan corresponding to the area to be extinguished through the mobile terminal; a user to be trained has a firefighter model in the mobile terminal; acquiring a fire extinguishing advancing image of a firefighter model in real time in the process that a user to be trained controls the firefighter model to extinguish a fire according to a fire extinguishing plan through a mobile terminal; and determining a simulated fire fighting training result of the user to be trained according to the fire fighting advancing image and feeding the result back to the mobile terminal of the user to be trained. The invention improves the efficiency and effectiveness of simulated fire-fighting training.
assignees: GUANGDONG NUCLEAR POWER CO OPERATION LTD COMPANY;LINGNAN NUCLEAR POWER LTD COMPANY;LIDONG NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD;LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY FOR NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION MAN IN DA ASIAN BAY;CHINESE GUANGDONG NUCLEAR GROUP CO LTD;CHINESE GUANGDONG KERNEL ELECTRIC POWER SHARE LTD COMPANY

title_en: Method for predicting stretch bending resistance of slide-in type interface of nodular cast iron sectional pipeline
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the stretch bending resistance of a sliding-in type interface of a nodular cast iron sectional pipeline, which comprises the following steps: step 1, determining nominal sizes of a socket, a spigot and a rubber washer of the nodular cast iron segmental pipeline, and creating a three-dimensional finite element model; step 2, simulating axial drawing and four-node bending pseudo-static force loading tests of the slide-in type interface of the nodular cast iron sectional pipeline based on finite elements, and applying loads and boundary conditions to obtain the axial tensile property and the transverse bending resistance of the interface of the nodular cast iron sectional pipeline; and 3, calculating the bending resistance of the slide-in type interface of the nodular cast iron subsection pipeline with different pipe diameters, and analyzing to obtain a pipe diameter-based prediction model of the bending resistance of the slide-in type interface of the nodular cast iron subsection pipeline. The method can effectively predict the bending resistance of the slide-in type interface of the nodular cast iron segmental pipelines with different pipe diameters, and provides a reference basis for the disaster prevention and reduction design of the long-distance transmission of the buried nodular cast iron segmental pipelines.

title_en: Natural language-based collaborative emergency response SOAR script recommendation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative emergency response SOAR script recommendation method based on natural language, which comprises the following steps: extracting three attributes of people, relation and content from one sentence in the chat content of the battle room, and carrying out data standardization processing; using a text pre-training model BERT as a text encoder, performing distinguishing attention on text contents in a specific use scene, and mapping the text contents into word vectors; constructing a standard script library, and performing mask training on the model by adopting a script step prediction algorithm to ensure that the model digs out potential internal relations of each workflow step in the script; using a collaborative filtering algorithm to perform event correlation degree feature matching, realizing collaborative work of another dimension, and recommending an SOAR script scheme; the scheme has the characteristics of spoken language of chat contents, fragmented information and the like aiming at the battle room, and has the characteristics of rapidly and accurately transferring SOAR script and timely coping with security incidents.
assignees: NANJING CROWDWISHI AND WEI INFORMATION SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Network security emergency response knowledge graph entity alignment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security emergency response knowledge graph entity alignment method, which comprises the following steps: inputting the knowledge graph into a PR module based on a PARIS model for calculation, and outputting a security event entity mapping set and corresponding equivalence probability; selecting a security event entity mapping with high equivalence probability corresponding to the obtained security event entity mapping set as an alignment seed, and inputting the alignment seed into an SE (secure element) module based on an embedded MultiKE model for training; outputting a security event entity embedding and security event entity mapping set obtained by a proximity retrieval algorithm and a similarity score of each corresponding mapping; taking the obtained data as input to perform the next round of calculation; after K iterations, the PR module outputs a security event entity mapping set; according to the scheme, a plurality of different network security emergency response knowledge maps can be fused into a knowledge map process with more comprehensive knowledge and higher correctness.

title_en: Fire prevention training system based on iot
title_ko: IoT 기반의 소방 방재 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an IoT-based fire prevention training system and, more specifically, to a technology which uses a player device including a training fire extinguisher equipped with various sensors, a fire hydrant, a virtual reality (VR) headgear, and the like, and a simulation device acquiring user training status information through a camera and providing fire training content according to various fire environments through a touch screen display, to provide various fire training content to users in real-time in various places and environments, thereby enabling the users to easily learn fire drills for various fire situations and systematically managing and providing training-related information for each user. According to one aspect of the present invention, the IoT-based fire prevention training system comprises: at least one training fire extinguisher device including a body, a handle, a safety pin, and a spray nozzle and equipped with a plurality of sensors; a simulation device interlocked with the training fire extinguisher device wirelessly or through a wire, and providing fire training content information corresponding to fire extinguisher operation information input from the training fire extinguisher device through a display; and a management server wirelessly communicating with the simulation device to receive fire training-related information for each user to store and manage the received information in a database. The simulation device includes a camera, detects the user's approach through the camera and acquires the user's face, movement, and action image information to perform analysis through a preset analysis program on the basis of the acquired image information, thereby generating and providing corresponding fire training content information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 IoT 기반의 소방방재훈련 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 각종 센서가 구비된 훈련용 소화기, 소화전, VR 헤드기어 등을 포함한 플레이어 장치와, 카메라를 통해 사용자의 훈련 상태 정보를 획득하고 각종 화재 환경에 따른 소방 훈련 콘텐츠를 터치스크린 형태의 디스플레이를 통해 제공하는 시뮬레이션 장치를 이용하여, 여러 장소 및 환경에서 사용자에게 각종 소방 훈련 콘텐츠를 실시간으로 제공하여 사용자가 각종 화재 상황에 대한 소방 훈련을 용이하게 습득할 수 있도록 하고 사용자별 훈련 관련 정보를 체계적으로 관리 및 제공할 수 있는 기술에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일측면에 따르면, 몸체, 손잡이, 안전핀 및 분사 노즐을 포함하고, 다수의 센서가 구비되는 적어도 하나 이상의 훈련용 소화기 장치, 상기 훈련용 소화기 장치와 무선 또는 유선으로 연동되며, 상기 훈련용 소화기 장치로부터 입력되는 소화기 동작 정보에 대응하는 소방 훈련 콘텐츠 정보를 디스플레이를 통해 제공하는 시뮬레이션 장치 및 상기 시뮬레이션 장치와 무선 통신하여 사용자별 소방 훈련 관련 정보를 전송받아 데이터베이스에 저장하여 관리하는 관리 서버를 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 시뮬레이션 장치는 카메라를 구비하며, 카메라를 통해 사용자의 접근을 감지하고 사용자의 얼굴, 움직임 및 동작 영상 정보를 획득하여, 획득된 영상 정보를 기초로 기설정된 분석 프로그램을 통해 분석하여 그에 대응하는 소방 훈련 콘텐츠 정보를 생성하여 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Disaster training device and disaster training method
title_ko: 구급대응 도상훈련장치 및 구급대응 도상훈련방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency response map training device and an emergency response map training method for effectively responding to various disaster situations, and in particular, relates to an emergency response map training device and an emergency response map training method, in which a manager terminal inputs information of NFC tags, which are respectively embedded in rescuer models, and rescuer state information in a storage server, then according to the NFC tag information and the rescuer state information input in the storage server, emergency activity information such as rescuer classification, first aid treatment, and transfer statuses are successively stored in the storage server, and a manager server accesses the storage server to evaluate a series of emergency activity information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각종 재난 상황을 효과적으로 대응하기 위한 구급대응 도상훈련장치 및 구급대응 도상훈련방법에 관한 것으로, 특히 관리자단말기에서 구조자 모형의 내부에 각각 내장되어 식별번호정보가 입력된 NFC태그 정보와 구조자의 상태정보를 저장서버에 입력한 후 저장서버에 입력된 NFC태그 정보와 구조자의 상태정보에 따라 구조자의 분류, 응급처치 및 이송현황 등의 구급활동정보를 순차적으로 저장서버에 저장하여 관리자서버가 저장서버에 접속함으로써, 일련의 구급활동정보를 평가할 수 있는 구급대응 도상훈련장치 및 구급대응 도상훈련방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KNL CO LTD;BANG SUNG HWAN;KIM MYUNG SAM

title_en: Apparatus and method for designing bim-linked integrated water pipe system
title_ko: Bim 연계 및 기반 통합 수배관 시스템 설계 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: In accordance with embodiments, a BIM-connected integrated water pipe system design method performed by a computing apparatus includes: a BIM model design step of designing a building with a BIM model; a criterion confirmation step of confirming water pipe application criteria of the BIM model of the designed building; a search step of searching a water pipe system library for water pipe system components satisfying the water pipe application criteria; a design step of designing cooling/heating water pipes, firefighting repair calculation using BIM; a verification step of selecting a pipe diameter and a valve mechanism, and verifying an existing manual drawing; an energy consumption measurement step of applying the searched or verified water pipe system components to the BIM model to measure energy consumption; and a water pipe system component determining step of determining a water pipe system component with the highest energy efficiency among water pipe system components included in the water pipe system library based on the measured energy consumption. Therefore, the present invention is capable of determining an optimal component combination through simulation.
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 컴퓨팅 장치에의해 수행되는 BIM 연계 통합 수배관 시스템 설계 방법으로서, 상기 방법은, 건축물을 BIM 모델로 설계하는 BIM 모델 설계단계, 설계된 건축물의 BIM 모델의 수배관 적용 기준을 확인하는 기준확인단계, 상기 수배관 적용 기준을 만족하는 수배관 시스템 구성요소를 수배관 시스템 라이브러리에서 검색하는 검색단계, BIM을 이용한 냉난방 수배관, 소방 수리계산의 설계 단계; 배관경, 밸브장치류 선정, 기존 수작업된 도면의 검증단계; 검색된 또는 검증된 수배관 시스템 구성요소를 상기 BIM 모델에 적용하여 에너지 소비량을 측정하는 에너지 소비 측정단계, 측정된 에너지 소비량을 기초로 상기 수배관 시스템 라이브러리에 포함된 수배관 시스템 구성요소 중 에너지 효율이 가장 높은 수배관 시스템 구성요소를 결정하는 수배관 시스템 구성요소 결정단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Disaster evacuation control and management system based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 재난 대피 제어 및 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin-based disaster evacuation control and management system, which comprises: a disaster detection device installed in a designated place within a building or facility and using a plurality of sensors to detect the occurrence of a disaster damaging the building or facility; an evacuation control device controlling operations of a plurality of evacuation equipment to safely evacuate people existing in the building or facility according to the occurrence of the disaster detected by the disaster detection device; a terminal location tracking device detecting a radio signal transmitted from at least one user terminal wirelessly communicating within the building or facility to detect location tracking information of each user terminal; and a central control center receiving information on the occurrence of the disaster detected from the disaster detection device and the location tracking information of each user terminal detected from the terminal location tracking device to identify the type and location of the disaster on the basis of disaster prevention management information and evacuation control information for response to each disaster stored in a separate database and the location tracking information of each user terminal, performing a disaster prevention simulation on the basis of a preset digital twin to generate a specific control signal according to disaster prediction result information for the disaster so that the plurality of evacuation equipment equipped in the building or facility operate, and transmitting the control signal to the evacuation control device. Accordingly, when a disaster occurs, an optimal evacuation route for people is predicted and various types of safety-related facilities and related facilities that have already been installed are controlled/regulated, thereby providing an effect of minimizing damage to human life and property.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반의 재난 대피 제어 및 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건물 또는 시설 내의 지정된 장소에 설치되며, 복수의 센서를 이용하여 해당 건물 또는 시설 내의 피해를 줄 수 있는 재난사고 상황의 발생을 감지하는 재난발생 감지장치와, 재난발생 감지장치로부터 감지된 재난사고 상황의 발생에 따라 해당 건물 또는 시설 내에 존재하는 사람들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있도록 복수의 대피장비들의 동작을 제어하는 재난대피 제어장치와, 해당 건물 또는 시설 내에서 무선 통신하는 적어도 하나의 사용자 단말로부터 송출되는 무선신호를 감지하여 각 사용자 단말의 위치 추적정보를 검출하는 단말위치 추적장치와, 재난발생 감지장치로부터 감지된 재난사고 상황의 발생정보 및 단말위치 추적장치로부터 검출된 각 사용자 단말의 위치 추적정보를 제공받아 별도의 데이터베이스(DB)에 기 저장된 재난사고 상황별 대응을 위한 방재관리정보 및 재난대피 제어정보와 함께 각 사용자 단말의 위치 추적정보를 바탕으로 재난사고의 종류 및 발생 위치를 파악함과 아울러 기 설정된 디지털 트윈 기반의 재난사고 방재예측 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 해당 재난사고 상황에 대한 방재예측 결과정보에 따라 해당 건물 또는 시설 내에 구비된 복수의 대피 장비들이 동작되도록 특정의 제어신호를 생성하여 상기 재난대피 제어장치로 전송하는 중앙 관제센터를 포함함으로써, 해당 재난사고 발생 시 사람들의 최적 대피 경로를 예측하고, 여러 종류의 안전 관련 시설물 및 기 설치된 관련 시설물에 대한 제어/통제를 진행하여 인명 및 재산 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Disaster robot training system in mr environment
title_ko: Mr환경에서의 재난 로봇 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: A disaster robot training system in an MR environment according to the present invention relates to a training system in which a robot including a camera and sensor is driven in a training space, and trainees are provided with a virtual environment like a real environment so that the trainees can train. The disaster robot training system in an MR environment includes a scenario module, a mixed environment implementation module, an interaction module, a robot driving module, and a control module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 MR 환경에서의 재난 로봇 훈련 시스템은, 카메라 및 센서를 포함하는 로봇이 훈련 공간에서 구동되며, 실제 환경과 같은 가상의 환경을 훈련생에게 제공하여 훈련생이 훈련하는 훈련 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method for early disaster recovery of environmental facility and system thereof
title_ko: 재난재해로부터 환경시설을 조기에 복구하기 위한 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and system for early recovering environmental facilities from disaster to monitor recovery for each recovery stage. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for early recovering environmental facilities from disaster through an early function recovery program comprises the following steps by an environmental facility: checking damage situation thereof due to a disaster from flow rate data or equipment operation status; checking a failure situation of equipment included therein due to damage caused by the disaster; receiving a recovery scenario from a server on the basis of at least one of the damage situation and the failure situation; performing recovery according to the recovery scenario; performing evaluation of the recovery of the equipment; and when the equipment operates normally, generating a report and storing disaster history and recovery history.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예는 조기기능복구 프로그램을 통해 재난재해로부터 환경시설을 조기에 복구하기 위한 방법에 있어서, 상기 환경시설이 유량데이터 또는 설비가동여부로부터 재난재해로 인한 상기 환경시설의 피해상황을 확인하는 단계; 상기 환경시설이 상기 재난재해로 인한 피해에 의하여 상기 환경시설에 포함된 설비의 고장상황을 확인하는 단계; 상기 환경시설이 상기 피해상황 및 상기 고장상황 중 적어도 하나에 기반하여 복구 시나리오를 서버로부터 수신하는 단계; 상기 환경시설이 상기 복구 시나리오에 따라 상기 설비를 복구하는 단계; 상기 환경시설이 상기 설비의 복구에 대한 평가를 진행하는 단계; 및 상기 설비가 정상으로 동작하면, 상기 환경시설이 보고서를 생성하고 재난재해이력 및 복구이력을 저장하는 단계를 포함하는 재난재해로부터 환경시설을 조기에 복구하기 위한 방법를 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: AE CORP;JANGKANG CO;SUNJIN ENG & ARCHITECTURE CO LTD

title_en: Water inrush and sand bursting water sand migration simulation test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water inrush and sand bursting water sand migration simulation test device and a test method, and belongs to the technical field of coal mining. The device comprises an annular flow passage; the crack simulation unit is arranged at the bottom of the annular flow channel, a plurality of crack channels penetrate from the top to the bottom, and the inside of the annular flow channel is communicated with the outside of the bottom through the crack channels; the water supply unit is used for injecting water into the annular flow channel; a turbine for controlling the velocity of the water flow in the annular flow passage; the monitoring meter is used for monitoring the change of the bottom flow velocity in the annular flow channel; the water sand collecting unit is used for collecting water sand flowing out of the fracture simulation unit; the PIV probe is used for recording the speed of the water sand in the fracture simulation unit; and the terminal is used for carrying out data processing. The invention can more intuitively observe and research the flow law of water inrush and sand inrush water and sand inrush under complex strata, and the obtained research result can help to know the evolution mechanism of water inrush and sand inrush disaster, thereby providing guarantee for coal mine safety mining and underground engineering safety construction.

title_en: Grouting reinforcement method for diversion culvert passing through gravel stratum in high and cold regions and construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a grouting reinforcement method and a construction method for a diversion culvert in a high and cold area to pass through a gravel stratum, which comprises the following steps: arranging grouting holes; drilling a grouting pipe hole; embedding a grouting pipeline through the glutenite layer; and dividing a grouting area and performing partition grouting. The grouting material used for grouting comprises coarse aggregate and an antifreezing agent; the coarse aggregate is 89% of stone, 10% of sandy soil and 1% of soil. The embodiment passes through the gravel stratum to bury the grouting pipeline underground, and special grouting materials are used for partition grouting, so that slurry permeates and diffuses in gravel stratum media, the slurry is effectively filled in the pores of the particle framework, soil gaps of the gravel stratum can be filled, finally, the slurry and the gravel stratum form a relatively homogeneous grouting reinforcement body, the overall mechanical property and the impermeability of the gravel stratum are effectively improved, the surrounding rock strength of the culvert is reinforced, the water-gushing and sand-bursting disasters of the diversion culvert can be prevented, and the construction of the diversion culvert in the later period is favorably and smoothly carried out.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU;QINGHAI 9ZERO 6 PROJECT INVESTIGATION AND DESIGN INSTITUTE LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;QINGHAI PROVINCE ENVIRONMENTAL GEOLOGICAL EXPLOR BUREAU

title_en: Flood disaster damage assessment method and simulation deduction system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood disaster damage assessment method and a simulation deduction system, belonging to the technical field of assessment analysis simulation and comprising the steps of constructing and training a flood deduction neural network model; acquiring and monitoring hydrological characteristic information in real time, and calculating the precipitation of a prediction area; flood deduction is carried out; setting loss evaluation parameters; and (4) loss evaluation calculation. The invention comprehensively utilizes satellite remote sensing and sensors to monitor data, and makes up the problems of complexity of information integration of collected information and insufficient real-time performance; establishing a neural network deduction model, continuously optimizing flood deduction capacity through deep self-learning, adjusting and optimizing network parameters according to land cover data, and improving loss evaluation accuracy; and a Markov chain method is adopted in the precipitation prediction, so that redundant data volume is relieved, and the deduction calculation efficiency is improved.
assignees: NANJING WECHIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-reservoir water situation intelligent forecasting and scheduling model system
