abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-reservoir water condition intelligent forecasting and dispatching model system, which comprises a water condition forecasting subsystem (10), an intelligent dispatching subsystem (20) and a multi-reservoir (30); wherein: the water situation forecasting subsystem (10) at least comprises a forecasting model module (101), a forecasting result display module (102), a forecasting scheme management module (103) and a forecasting scheme comparison analysis module (104); the intelligent scheduling system (20) at least comprises a scheduling scheme generation module (201), a scheduling scheme comparison module (202) and a scheduling scheme simulation and visualization module (203). Compared with the prior art, the method can realize real-time forecasting of the water regime, provides an intelligent scheme for flood control dispatching of each reservoir through model selection, calculation analysis and the like, and provides support for flood control and disaster reduction decisions by integrating the characteristics of informatization, intellectualization, real-time high efficiency and the like.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;CHONGZUZHONGJIANG LEFT RIVER DROUGHT CONTROL PROJECT MAN CENTER

title_en: Wartime air defense system based on city information model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wartime air defense system based on a city information model, which comprises: the system comprises a civil air defense emergency command coordination module, an emergency rescue auxiliary decision support module, an air attack and damage simulation module and an air attack and fight prevention simulation training module; people's air defense emergency command coordination module includes: the system comprises an air attack threat monitoring and early warning unit, a disaster warning unit, a personnel evacuation action coordination unit and an emergency rescue organization command unit; the emergency rescue aid decision support module comprises: a decision command unit and an expert assistant decision unit; the air attack damage simulation module comprises: the system comprises a monitoring and monitoring unit for threatening important economic targets, an explosion point influence range analysis unit and a hazard source influence analysis unit; the invention combines static historical experience with dynamic system analysis and measurement, assists the decision behavior of commanders when an air attack and an emergency occurs, makes the best decision, avoids decision errors, and realizes the decision-making assisting function through an expert decision-making assisting module.
assignees: NANJING RICE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Drilling method for detecting hidden structure of coal face
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine geological disaster prevention and control, and relates to a drilling method for detecting a hidden structure of a coal face; firstly, drawing a contour map of a coal seam top and bottom plate of a coal face; drawing the abnormal region on a contour map; designing a drill hole: under the same distance, the number of the drilling groups in the abnormal area is 2-3 times of the number of the drilling holes outside the abnormal area; preliminarily setting the position, the direction, the final hole position and the horizontal length of each drilled hole; determining the elevation of the final hole as the elevation of the coal seam top and bottom plate at the position; calculating the length and inclination parameters of the drill hole; comparing and analyzing the abnormal positions of all drilling holes and the actual track and peeking of the drilling tracks to determine the abnormal area position of the coal face; the invention effectively improves the drilling efficiency and saves the drilling engineering quantity; different methods are adopted to carry out drilling verification on the normal region and the abnormal region of the working face, so that the accuracy of advanced detection of the hidden geological structure is improved.
assignees: SHANXI COAL TRANSP AND SALE GROUP SHENTAI COAL INDUSTRY LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Island reef water-rich calcareous sandy soil stratum grouting simulation and permeability test device and method
abstract_en: The application aims to solve the technical problem of providing a device and a method for simulating grouting and testing permeability of an island reef water-rich calcareous sandy soil stratum, which can simulate the ground stress of the island reef sandy soil layer and facilitate grouting simulation and permeability coefficient test, and comprises a model test box, a servo stress loading system and a grouting and storing system; the model test box comprises a supporting frame and a sand containing cylinder, wherein the sand containing cylinder is arranged in the supporting frame, the sand containing cylinder is of a hollow cylinder structure with an opening at the upper part, and a plurality of slurry outlet pipes are arranged on the side wall of the sand containing cylinder along the height direction; an axial pressure loading piston plate is matched at the opening of the sand containing cylinder, and a plurality of confining pressure loading rings are arranged on the outer wall of the sand containing cylinder along the height; and a grouting port of the grouting and slurry storage system is communicated with the sand containing cylinder, and the servo stress loading system can control the shaft pressure loading piston plate and the confining pressure loading ring to apply pressure. The application plays an active and scientific engineering reference role in grouting treatment of island bad geological disasters.

title_en: Disaster recovery drilling service processing method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery drilling service processing method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein each transaction category of a disaster recovery drilling system is determined through a transaction initiation channel corresponding to acquired historical transaction data, channel weights are set according to the preset degree of the transaction category, historical transaction data are evaluated based on preset evaluation rules to obtain estimated transaction amount and channel weights to determine drilling influence values, a target drilling window is determined based on the drilling influence values, and a disaster recovery drilling influence analysis report is displayed. According to the scheme, when a plurality of disaster recovery systems are used for organizing drilling at the same time, historical transaction data of the plurality of disaster recovery systems do not need to be manually extracted and analyzed, and the situations of omission, errors and the like caused by manual analysis are avoided. By automatically evaluating service influence caused by service interruption during disaster recovery drilling, effective evaluation of the influence degree of the disaster recovery drilling service is realized, a time window with smaller service influence is automatically recommended for display according to an evaluation result, and efficiency of analyzing drilling service is improved.

title_en: Experimental device for simulating detection of disaster condition after mine disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device for simulating detection of a disaster after a mine disaster, which comprises a simulated mine roadway, an optical fiber, a light source device and a signal processing device, wherein the simulated mine roadway comprises a plurality of horizontal roadways and inclined roadways, and a water filling port and a water outlet are arranged on the horizontal roadway at the lowest position; the optical fiber is arranged on the wall of a roadway of the simulated mine roadway and extends along the simulated mine roadway in a sine wave or triangular wave shape; the horizontal roadway with the lowest position is connected with a water level pipe, the water level pipe and the simulation mine roadway form a communicating vessel structure, and a water level sensor is arranged in the water level pipe. The invention can inject water to the simulated mine tunnel through the water injection port to simulate the flood condition of the underground tunnel, and can verify whether the water level data obtained by a detection system consisting of the optical fiber, the light source device and the signal processing device is correct or not by utilizing the communicating vessel structure consisting of the water level pipe and the simulated tunnel and the detection data of the water level sensor.
assignees: BEIJING JINGTONG KETCH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dedicated temperature-sensitive detector detection device is detected to fire-fighting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire fighting, and particularly relates to a special temperature-sensitive detector detection device for fire fighting equipment detection. The utility model can realize the combustion of the comburent by arranging the fixed box and the combustion box, simulate the scene when the fire disaster happens by utilizing the smoke and the temperature generated after the comburent is combusted, lead the detection result to be more accurate, realize the filtration of the smoke and the dust after the comburent is combusted by arranging the filtering mechanism, avoid the smoke and the dust from being attached to the temperature-sensitive detector to influence the detection of the temperature-sensitive detector, realize the adjustment of the distance between the connecting box and the temperature-sensitive detector by arranging the electric push rod, and control the smoke output amount and the temperature by arranging the control mechanism.

title_en: Geothermal unit and geothermal heating and cooling system for preventing earthquake or disaster using this
title_ko: 지열유닛과 이것을 이용한 방진 방재형 지열 냉난방 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a geothermal unit capable of protecting the geothermal unit from dangerous situations such as earthquakes or disasters and simplifying maintenance of the geothermal unit, and a dustproof disaster prevention type geothermal heating and cooling system using the same. To this end, the geothermal unit comprises: a geothermal heat exchange line forming a path through which a working fluid exchanging heat with geothermal heat of a geothermal hole drilled in the ground surface moves; at least one geothermal heat exchange module immersed in groundwater generating the geothermal heat in the geothermal hole and exchanging the heat between the groundwater and the working fluid in the geothermal hole; and a vibration-proof disaster prevention unit for protecting at least one of the geothermal heat exchange line and the geothermal heat exchange module from a vibration transmitted to the geothermal hole.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진 또는 재난 등과 같은 위험 상황으로부터 지열유닛을 보호하고, 지열유닛의 유지보수를 간편하게 할 수 있는 지열유닛과 이것을 이용한 방진 방재형 지열 냉난방 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해, 지열유닛은 지면에 천공된 지열홀부의 지중열과 열교환되는 작동유체가 이동되는 경로를 형성하는 지열열교환라인과, 지열홀부에서 지중열이 발생되는 지하수에 침지되고 지열홀부에서 지하수와 작동유체가 열교환되는 적어도 하나의 지중열교환모듈 및 지열홀부에 전달되는 진동으로부터 지열열교환라인과 지중열교환모듈 중 적어도 어느 하나를 보호하기 위한 방진방재유닛을 포함한다.
assignees: YEC CO LTD;HONG KYUNG SIK;HONG JEONG SHIK

title_en: System and Method for Virtual Reality-based Human-in-the-loop Experiment
title_ko: 가상 현실 기반 hitl 실험 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and method for an HITL test based on virtual reality for developing a performer-based model reflecting cognitive characteristics of residents in case of wide-area evacuation by using an interactive environment with driving, walking and objects for the movement of subjects in a virtual environment built based on a node-based road network referring to actual road data. The device includes: a simulation implementation processing part building a virtual background environment for scenario implementation by dividing the environment into an outdoor environment, an indoor environment, a road environment, a subject environment and a virtual performer, and then, reflecting an interactive environment with driving, walking and objects for the movement of subjects in the built virtual environment to observe the behavior of the subjects and extract data; and a simulation implementation support part supporting a function of enabling the subjects and an experimenter to check and control VR simulation in accordance with the gradual progress of scenarios by the simulation implementation processing part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실제 도로 데이터를 참고한 노드 기반의 도로망을 중심으로 구축한 가상환경내에서 피험자의 이동을 위한 주행, 보행 및 물체와의 상호작용 환경을 활용하여 광역 소개 시 주민의 인지적 특성이 반영된 행위자 기반 모델 개발을 위한 가상 현실 기반 HITL 실험 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 실외환경, 실내환경, 도로환경, 피험자환경, 가상행위자로 구분하여 시나리오 구현을 위한 가상 배경 환경을 구축하고, 구축한 가상환경내에서 피험자의 이동을 위한 주행, 보행 및 물체와의 상호작용 환경을 반영하여 피험자의 행동 관찰 및 데이터 추출을 수행하는 시뮬레이션 구현 처리부;시뮬레이션 구현 처리부에 의한 시나리오의 단계적 진행에 따라 피험자 및 실험자가 VR 시뮬레이션을 확인 및 조작하는 것을 지원하는 시뮬레이션 구현 지원부;를 포함하는 것이다.
assignees: ULSAN NAT INST SCIENCE & TECH UNIST

title_en: Fire directing system
title_ko: 화재 연출 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire directing system. The disclosed fire directing system comprises: a directed space for directing a fire; a first high-brightness laser irradiator for irradiating a high-brightness laser beam horizontally to an upper part of the directed space; a first fog sprayer which is provided adjacent to the first high-brightness laser irradiator and generates and sprays fog into an irradiation area of a high-brightness laser beam; and a first circulator provided at the rear of the first fog sprayer and blowing the fog. Accordingly, a user can effectively perform a fire simulation experience in a disaster experience center.
abstract_ko: 개시되는 화재 연출 시스템은, 화재를 연출하기 위한 연출공간; 상기 연출공간의 상부에 수평으로 고휘도 레이저빔을 조사하는 제 1 고휘도 레이저조사기; 상기 제 1 고휘도 레이저조사기에 인접하여 구비되며, 상기 고휘도 레이저빔의 조사 영역으로 포그를 생성하여 분사하는 제 1 포그분사기; 및 상기 제 1 포그분사기의 후방에 구비되며, 상기 포그를 송풍시키는 제 1 서큘레이터;를 포함함으로써, 재난 체험장에서 화재 모의 체험을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: A method and system for on-site investigation of a disaster cause using a special vehicle equipped with an unmanned aerial vehicle
title_ko: 무인비행체가 탑재된 특수차량을 이용한 재난원인 현장조사 방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, disclosed are a method and system for conducting an onsite disaster cause investigation using a special vehicle equipped with an unmanned aircraft, capable of collecting and analyzing various types of disaster information by executing a rotary wing UAV investigation based on aerial image acquisition and analysis in the scene of a disaster as well as executing a fixed wing UAV investigation based on wide-area monitoring. The disclosed movable onsite investigation system for a disaster cause investigation includes: an unmanned aircraft executing a rotary wing UAV investigation based on aerial image acquisition and analysis enabling continuous flight above a predetermined spot by producing lift required for flight in accordance with the rotation of a helicopter in the scene of a disaster, as well as executing a fixed wing UAV investigation based on wide-area monitoring enabling flight with energy generated from upper and lower parts of wings located on both sides of a fuselage along with forward thrust; and a disaster investigation special vehicle generating three-dimensional space data by receiving a disaster image in accordance with the rotary wing UAV investigation or a disaster image in accordance with the fixed wing UAV investigation from the unmanned aircraft, and then, reflecting a disaster state to the generated three-dimensional space data and analyzing the data in accordance with analysis techniques including running water analysis, an expected soil erosion area, retaining wall displacement, cross sectional shape extraction and a valley part extraction to assess a disaster risk degree or execute a virtual simulation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 사고 현장에서 항공영상 취득분석 기반의 회전익 UAV 조사를 실행함과 더불어, 광역 모니터링 기반의 고정익 UAV 조사를 실행하여 다양한 재난 정보를 수집분석할 수 있는, 무인비행체가 탑재된 특수차량을 이용한 재난원인 현장조사 방법 및 그 시스템이 개시된다. 
개시된 재난원인 조사를 위한 이동형 현장 조사 시스템은, 재난 사고 현장에서 콥터가 회전함에 따라 비행에 요구되는 양력을 발생시켜 일정 지점에서 지속적으로 비행이 가능한 항공영상 취득분석 기반의 회전익 UAV 조사를 실행함과 더불어, 전진하는 추력과 함께 기체 양쪽에 위치한 날개의 상·하부에서 발생하는 에너지로 비행하는 광역 모니터링 기반의 고정익 UAV 조사를 실행하는 무인 비행 장치; 및 상기 무인 비행 장치로부터 상기 회전익 UAV 조사에 따른 재난 영상이나 상기 고정익 UAV 조사에 따른 재난 영상을 수신하여 3차원 공간 데이터를 생성하고, 생성된 3차원 공간 데이터에 재난 상태를 반영하여 유수분석, 토사유출 예상지역, 옹벽변위, 단면형상 추출, 계곡부 추출을 포함하는 분석 기법에 따라 분석하여 재해 위험도를 평가하거나 가상 시뮬레이션을 실행하는 재난조사 특수차량을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster investigation system based on special vehicle and disaster investigation method using the same
title_ko: 특수차량기반 재난조사시스템 및 이를 활용한 재난조사 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are special vehicle-based disaster investigation system which performs regular monitoring for disaster prevention and risk management in normal times and uses an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to investigate and analyze the cause of the disaster and simulate the cause of the accident when a disaster occurs, and a disaster investigation method using the same. According to the present invention, a disaster investigation special vehicle equipped with a UAV comprises: a UAV acquiring disaster images by photographing a disaster site while flying according to a predetermined flight path and remote navigation control at a disaster site; a UAV landing platform for landing or accommodating the UAV; a PC installed with a program for data processing and analysis including data matching, merging, contour generation, volume and area calculation, and distance and angle calculation for the disaster site; and an analysis server executing three-dimensional (3D) numerical analysis for processing and analyzing observational data of the disaster site or including software (SW) for numerical analysis of flood landslide and sediment runoff, and disaster evacuation simulation analysis to control data acquisition, processing, and display.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 평상 시에 재해 예방 및 위험 관리를 위한 정기적인 모니터링을 수행하고, 재난 사고 시에는 무인 비행체를 이용하여 재난 사고의 원인 조사와 분석, 그리고 사고 원인의 시뮬레이션을 실행하는, 특수차량기반 재난조사시스템 및 이를 활용한 재난조사 방법이 개시된다. 
개시된 무인 비행체 탑재형 재난 조사 특수 차량은, 재난 현장에서 사전 지정된 비행 경로 및 원격 항법 조정에 따라 비행하면서 사고 현장의 모습을 촬영하여 재난 영상을 획득하는 무인 비행체; 상기 무인 비행체를 안착하거나 수용하기 위한 비행체 안착대; 상기 재난 현장에 대한 데이터 정합, 병합, 등고선 생성, 체적 및 면적 계산, 거리 및 각도 계산을 포함한 데이터 처리 및 분석을 위한 프로그램이 설치된 PC; 및 상기 재난 현장의 관측자료 처리분석을 위한 3차원 수치 해석을 실행하거나, 홍수산사태 토사유출 수치해석, 재난대피 모의(simulation) 분석에 관한 소프트웨어(SW)가 탑재되어, 데이터의 취득, 처리, 표출을 제어하는 분석용 서버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Anti-scour method for segmented hydraulic fracturing area of near-vertical huge-thickness coal seam
abstract_en: The invention provides a near-vertical huge thick coal seam subsection hydraulic fracturing area scour prevention method, and belongs to the technical field of rock burst disaster prevention. The method comprises the steps of deepening a main well from a mining level to a fracturing level, wherein the designed depth distance of the fracturing level to the mining level is 100 m; excavating a rock portal from a top rock layer of the coal seam into the mined coal seam at the fracturing level, and excavating a roadway along the coal seam direction to serve as a fracturing drilling construction space; and drilling a hydraulic fracturing drill hole into the coal bed above the tunnel along the coal bed inclination angle in the special tunnel for fracturing, wherein the length of the drill hole is based on the goaf, and the drilling trend interval and the drilling trend subsection interval are designed according to parameters of fracturing equipment and the fracturing height. According to the invention, the coal body at the lower part of the horizontal working face is mined by the segmental hydraulic fracturing, the high elastic energy accumulated by the coal body is released, the stress concentration degree of the bottom coal is reduced, the purpose of preventing and controlling the impact of the bottom coal during the mining of the near-vertical coal seam is achieved, and the safe and efficient mining of the near-vertical coal seam is ensured.
assignees: UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;ZHAOFU COAL MINE OF COAL HEZE ENERGY CO LTD;NORTH CHINA SCIENCE AND TECH COLLEGE;SULFUR DITCH COAL MINE OF YANMINE XINJIANG MINING CO LTD;BEIJING ANKI INDUSTRY SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Super high-rise building construction site safety evacuation system based on building information model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super high-rise building construction site safety evacuation system based on a building information model, which comprises a processor, a display screen and a memory connected with the processor, wherein the memory is stored with an information browsing module and a quick guidance module; the information browsing module comprises a disaster information module and an emergency evacuation information module, and the disaster information module comprises a disaster reading module, a disaster damage information module, a disaster fortification intensity module and a hazard source information module; the rapid guidance module comprises an information input module and a calculation analysis and result output module, and the calculation analysis and result output module carries out escape parameter limitation and hazard source analysis according to the simulation result of the evacuation simulation module and calculates an evacuation simulation curve. When a disaster occurs, according to the actual working condition of the project under construction and the mastering of the same disaster condition in the past, the adaptive evacuation simulation route and evacuation simulation time are quickly simulated for reference, and the user can quickly and accurately determine the evacuation scheme.

title_en: Micro-terrain wind field analysis method and system for nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for analyzing a micro-terrain wind field of a nuclear power plant, which comprise the following steps of S1: establishing a 3D model of the nuclear power plant; s2: determining a CFD (computational fluid dynamics) computational domain of the 3D model of the nuclear power plant; s3: carrying out mesh division on the CFD calculation domain; s4: determining boundary condition parameters of a CFD calculation domain and at least one group of calculation conditions consisting of different boundary condition parameters; s5: and carrying out CFD numerical simulation based on the CFD calculation domain after the grid division and the calculation working condition to obtain the micro-terrain wind field distribution condition of the CFD calculation domain. According to the method, the function of acquiring the actual influence characteristics of the micro-terrain wind field in each local area in a plant area according to the macro wind field information of the nuclear power plant is realized by constructing the nuclear power plant micro-terrain wind field analysis method based on the CFD wind field simulation technology, the risk sensitive area of the nuclear power plant under different typhoon influence conditions is effectively identified, the problem of cognitive loss of the current nuclear power plant to the local wind field in the plant area is solved, and support is provided for typhoon risk identification, typhoon prevention preparation, emergency response and engineering reconstruction.
assignees: SUZHOU THERMAL RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY;GUANGDONG NUCLEAR POWER CO OPERATION LTD COMPANY;CHINESE GUANGDONG NUCLEAR GROUP CO LTD;CHINESE GUANGDONG KERNEL ELECTRIC POWER SHARE LTD COMPANY

title_en: Mountain area storm disaster risk division method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dividing the risk of a mountain storm disaster, belonging to the field of weather disaster prevention and reduction. According to the invention, the simulation of the mountain projection surface wind field is performed by using fluid dynamics CFD simulation software, and the wind speed of each grid intersecting the intersecting line of the mountain projection surface and the ground surface is obtained; reuse of And calculating to obtain a global wind field of the mountain area, and finally, carrying out corresponding risk division according to the established wind disaster risk division index system. The technical method effectively overcomes the defects of the existing method for dividing the risk of the storm disaster in the mountain area, fully considers the influence of the topography of the mountain area on wind field simulation, and reasonably realizes the division of the risk of the storm disaster in the mountain area. The method of the invention is convenient to use and easy to realize.

title_en: Multi-field coupled loess-mudstone landslide hazard simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-field coupled loess-mudstone landslide hazard simulation test device and a method, wherein a rainfall device and a temperature control device are arranged at the upper part of a test box; the bottom of the test box is provided with a mudstone attitude controller, a mudstone simulation layer is arranged above the mudstone attitude controller, and the mudstone attitude controller consists of a thin plate, a steering plate arranged below the thin plate, a hinged support, a telescopic rod and a hydraulic jack; the direction of the thin plate in the space is freely and flexibly adjusted through the steering plate and the hinged support, the posture of different mudstones in the loess-mudstone side slope is simulated, the height of the thin plate is adjusted by matching the telescopic rod and the hydraulic jack, and the position of the mudstone in the loess-mudstone side slope is met. The crack formation and development rules in the loess slope are known, the induction reason and the damage mode of the loess-mudstone landslide are explored, and the loess-mudstone landslide disaster is quantitatively evaluated.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Test platform and test method for simulating fire disaster of extra-high voltage alternating current transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test platform and a test method for simulating a fire disaster of an extra-high voltage alternating current transformer, wherein the test platform comprises a combustion model system, a test oil system, an observation and measurement system and a data acquisition and central control system, and the combustion model system comprises a body variable model, a modulation and change model, an oil collecting pit model, a firewall and a framework column; the test oil system comprises an oil spilling storage tank, an oil storage tank and a heating cabinet; the observation and measurement system comprises a high-definition camera, an infrared imager, a heat flow sensor and a temperature sensor. The method comprises the following steps: installing and debugging a fire extinguishing system, self-checking, cold spraying test, oiling, heating, igniting, forming overflow fire, initially extinguishing fire, discharging oil, checking and recording and resetting the system. The invention has the advantages that: the method can be used for carrying out the test research of the fire fighting full-size model of the extra-high voltage alternating current transformer, obtaining the real and effective test data of the fire disaster of the extra-high voltage alternating current transformer, and proving the main control factors and key parameters of fire fighting.

title_en: Method and system for planning simulation path for evacuation of personnel in subway station under multiple dangerous sources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for planning a simulation path for evacuating personnel in a subway station under multiple dangerous sources, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic data in a subway station; based on basic data in a subway station, gridding the space in the subway station, and determining the initial position of people to be evacuated; acquiring evacuation speed of personnel in each road section and position information of each dangerous source under the disaster condition; establishing a personnel evacuation multi-objective path optimization model based on the initial positions of personnel to be evacuated, the evacuation speed of personnel on each road section and the positions of each dangerous source; solving the multi-objective path optimization model for personnel evacuation to obtain an evacuation path optimization scheme under different control parameters, so as to realize evacuation of personnel to be evacuated. Through proper modification, the multi-target robust model is suitable for providing a path planning scheme for people evacuation in different emergency (fire, toxic substance release, explosion and the like) in the station, and improves the high efficiency and the safety of the subway evacuation system.

title_en: Damping structure of concrete gravity dam in multiple earthquake areas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damping structure of a concrete gravity dam in a multi-earthquake area, wherein at least one row of partition holes which are distributed in an arc shape on the plane and penetrate into bedrock are respectively arranged at positions which are not less than 100m away from the upper and the downstream sides of a dam body of the gravity dam, the partition holes are arranged along the left and the right sides of the dam body, the plane is of a convex mirror shape, the convex faces towards the outer side of the dam body of the gravity dam, the drilling depth of each partition hole is 0.5-0.6 times of the height of the dam, a PVC pipe with the diameter not less than 80% of the partition hole diameter is arranged in each partition hole, the PVC pipe is filled with slag, and two ends of the PVC pipe are plugged with plugs. By utilizing the reflection principle of the convex mirror, the seismic waves meet the arc-shaped partition hole and then are reflected back, and are superposed, neutralized and reduced with the next new seismic wave crest, so that the aim of weakening the seismic wave disasters is fulfilled; in addition, the relatively loose slag in the hole can also weaken the propagation of seismic waves. Compared with other damping methods, the damping device is safe, reliable, economical, reasonable and high in operability, and can effectively prevent the gravity dam from cracking.
assignees: RECLAIMED WATER NORTH SURVEY DESIGN RES LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Comprehensive method for coal seam detection and goaf treatment under complex geological conditions
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal seam detection and goaf treatment comprehensive method under complex geological conditions, which is characterized in that the approximate length direction of a goaf is determined based on the existing geological detection data, then two supplementary detection lines are arranged approximately along the trend to determine the trend range and the caving zone range of the goaf and residual coal pillars, and two determination methods are creatively provided; constructing a second supplementary detection drill hole on the determined residual coal pillar to obtain supplementary detection data of a lower coal seam, so that the problem that the supplementary detection drill hole penetrates through a goaf is solved; determining the caving zone range after mining of the lower coal mine layer based on the supplementary detection result, judging whether the caving zone range is communicated with the upper caving zone or not, giving a grouting and drilling arrangement scheme for disaster control of the upper goaf and the lower goaf according to the judgment result, and using the coal ash and the coal gangue powder obtained by crushing the coal gangue as grouting materials, thereby realizing disaster control of the coal mine goaf and consuming the two solid wastes at the same time.
assignees: THIRD EXPLOR TEAM OF SHANDONG COALFIELD GEOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Integrated test simulation device and simulation method for water disasters in river estuary zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river estuary zone water disaster integrated test simulation device and a simulation method thereof, wherein the simulation device comprises a water tank, a landslide simulation mechanism, a bed load conveying mechanism, a wave generating mechanism, a water supply mechanism, a rainfall mechanism and a detection mechanism; the water tank comprises a first water tank and a second water tank, the first water tank is communicated with the second water tank, the bottom of the first water tank and the bottom of the second water tank are respectively provided with a water flow sensor, the second water tank is internally provided with an artificial slope, the artificial slope is internally provided with a stress and water content sensor, the rainfall mechanism is positioned above the artificial slope, and the water supply mechanism is used for supplying water for the first water tank, the second water tank and the rainfall mechanism; the bed load conveying mechanism is positioned on one side of the first water tank and is used for conveying sand bodies into the first water tank, the wave generating mechanism is arranged in the first water tank or the second water tank and is used for providing waves with different sizes and directions; the landslide simulation mechanism is located on one side of the second water tank and used for simulating a landslide process.

title_en: ENSO diversity prediction method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ENSO diversity forecasting method based on artificial intelligence, which extracts the first three main modes from equatorial Pacific SSTA observation data by using an EOF decomposition method, and projects CMIP6 historical simulation data on the three main modes to obtain three groups of PC values; three groups of PC values are used as forecast values, SSTA of an initial month and Tendency items of sea temperature data are used as input values of training, and a CMIP6 mode is used for training VGG-11; and inputting observation data into the trained model to obtain PC values at three future moments, and combining the PC values with 3 EOF main modes to reconstruct the SSTA space form of the equatorial Pacific region at the future moments. The method improves the forecasting skill of the middle Pacific type Erleno and breaks through the bottleneck of forecasting in the middle Pacific area in the previous dynamic mode. The method improves the forecasting skill of the ENSO, is beneficial to forecasting and early warning of climate disasters, and is beneficial to reducing personnel and property loss.

title_en: Multi-state association infrastructure network elasticity optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network elasticity optimization method for a multi-state association infrastructure, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting the structure and operation information of a related infrastructure network; step 2, establishing an operation strategy optimization model of the associated network; step 3, establishing a two-stage stochastic programming model; step 4, processing the two-stage random programming model into a mixed integer linear programming model; step 5, generating a large number of disaster scenes by using a Monte Carlo simulation method and reducing the number of the generated scenes by using a scene reduction technology; step 6, solving the two-stage random programming model after the linearization treatment by adopting an L-shaped method; and 7, solving the optimal protection strategy of the first-stage associated network and displaying the optimal protection strategy in an image mode. The invention can help a decision maker to seek the optimal protection strategy of the transport node and the link of the associated infrastructure network, improve the overall elasticity and the capacity of meeting the requirement of the associated network to the maximum extent, and reduce the influence of various disaster events.

title_en: Coal seam rock burst prevention and control method based on solution modification effect
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preventing and treating rock burst of a coal seam based on a solution modification effect, and relates to the technical field of safe production of mines. The invention forms a plurality of crack surfaces by constructing and drilling holes at two sides of the transportation crossheading and the return air crossheading and adopting multi-point directional hydraulic fracturing, improves the crack development degree of the coal body and creates crack conditions for injecting the modified solution into the coal body. Meanwhile, after hydraulic fracturing, the modification solution is injected, and the modification solution generates physical and chemical actions with cement between mineral crystals and mineral particles of the coal body, so that a plurality of tiny defects are formed inside the coal body, the elasticity and the energy storage capacity of the coal are integrally reduced, the stress state of the coal body is integrally improved, and the danger of rock burst is reduced. The method provided by the invention is simple to operate and strong in feasibility, and has a good reference function for preventing and treating mine dynamic disasters such as hard coal bed rock burst, coal and gas outburst and the like.

title_en: Mine dynamic disaster classification control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine dynamic disaster classification control method, which comprises the steps that a mine local dynamic disaster is a rock burst, a near-domain dynamic disaster is rock burst, and a far-domain dynamic disaster is a mine earthquake. Aiming at rock burst dynamic disasters, an excavation compensation control method is provided, an anti-impact energy-absorbing material is adopted, the characteristics of high prestress application, constant-resistance energy absorption and high-strength yielding are achieved, and surrounding rock pressure relief control methods such as roadway smooth blasting, coal wall drilling pressure relief, surrounding rock loosening blasting and the like are adopted. Aiming at rock burst and mine earthquake dynamic disasters, a mining compensation control method is provided, and a roof cutting pressure relief control method adopting an impact-resistant energy-absorbing material, blasting presplitting roof cutting, instantaneous spalling roof cutting, dense drilling roof cutting and the like is adopted. And optimizing the design scheme in real time through engineering field monitoring and evaluation. The invention provides a dynamic disaster classification control method, which has important significance for guaranteeing mine safe production.
assignees: CHINESE MINING UNIV BEIJING;BEIJING LIHI SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Firefighter cardio-pulmonary resuscitation skill training system based on mixed reality technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a firefighter cardio-pulmonary resuscitation skill training system based on a mixed reality technology, which comprises a humanoid simulator, MR glasses and a display screen, wherein the MR glasses and the display screen are matched with the humanoid simulator for use; the humanoid simulator comprises a humanoid simulation body, a central control integrated circuit mainboard arranged on the belly of the humanoid simulation body, a pressing plate arranged in the chest part of the humanoid simulation body, a respiratory counter arranged on one side below the pressing plate and connected with the central control integrated circuit mainboard, a lung air bag arranged below the pressing plate and communicated with the respiratory counter, an air passage shutter arranged in the neck part of the humanoid simulation body and communicated with the lung air bag through a hose, and a pupil simulation assembly arranged on the head part of the humanoid simulation body. The utility model can enable the user to more truly train the cardio-pulmonary resuscitation in different scenes through the mixed reality technology, more effectively enable the user to know and learn the knowledge and skill of the cardio-pulmonary resuscitation, and improve the training quality and efficiency.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE PROTECTION RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT

title_en: TRD and surface deep hole half-section grouting combined advanced waterproof curtain construction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunnel water stop construction, and discloses a TRD and surface deep hole half-section grouting combined tunnel advanced water stop curtain construction method which comprises the steps of stratum exploration, positioning measurement pay-off, TRD in-place transverse cutting, TRD transverse withdrawal cutting, cutting box grouting and stirring wall forming, hole protection pipe placing and splicing, grouting hole drilling, pile position coring and hole forming inclination detection, installation and debugging of a grouting device, slurry preparation, stirring and lifting pile forming. The TRD stirring wall and the deep hole grouting pile provided by the invention are combined to reinforce the stratum and perform advanced plugging, so that the disaster-causing influence of groundwater seepage of a water-rich stratum on tunnel surrounding rocks is inhibited; the miscellaneous fill layer is blocked by embedding and splicing the hole protection pipe, so that the pile forming is prevented from being influenced by hole collapse, and the deep hole is reinforced to ensure the smoothness of the grouting hole. Compared with the traditional one-time wall-forming TRD construction method, the method solves the problem that the TRD construction method is easily limited by complex geological conditions, such as a tunnel underpass river, a water-rich broken stratum engineering, an irregular-shaped foundation pit engineering and the like.

title_en: Human body temperature limit resistant reminding device for fire-fighting suit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting appliances, in particular to a human body extreme temperature resistant reminding device for a fire-fighting suit, which comprises a box body, wherein an installation plate is welded at the top of the right side of the box body, and a sleeve is fixedly installed at the bottom of the installation plate; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the box body, the mounting plate, the sleeve, the spring, the movable plate, the connecting rod, the metal pipe, the discharging pipe, the blocking net, the pressing plate, the metal ring, the loudspeaker, the metal sheet and the wiring column, the advantage of timely reminding a firefighter is achieved, and meanwhile, the problems that in the process of rescuing by the firefighter, the firefighter can rescue the accident site at the fastest speed due to the emergency situation on the site, huge amount of exercise can be generated in a short time, the temperature in the firefighter uniform can rise linearly due to the influence of fire, and the change of the body state of the firefighter cannot be found in time in the process of rescuing by the firefighter, so that the life safety of the firefighter is threatened are solved.
assignees: HUAINAN GIANT FIRE ENG CO LTD

title_en: High-altitude falling experience simulation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses high-altitude falling experience simulation equipment which comprises a sound insulation plate, a knocker, an electric shock fence and a VR eye patch, wherein the knocker is fixedly installed on a safety helmet, the lower end of a fixing belt is fixedly connected with a plug-in buckle, a blowing port is fixedly formed in the inner side of the sound insulation plate, a sound power amplifier is arranged in the inner side of the sound insulation plate, a connecting rod is connected in the sound insulation plate, a spring is connected in the connecting rod, the end part of the connecting rod is connected with a testing platform, a lifting rod is installed on the bottom surface of the testing platform, and a lock catch is rotatably connected on the safety belt. The utility model can produce the blowing and sound effects by arranging the blowing port and the sound function amplifier on the sound insulation board, thereby enhancing the experience feeling, and meanwhile, the knocker and the electric shock fence on the safety helmet can continuously make people feel the feeling of being bumped and being in electric shock, and can deeply feel the power of bad natural disasters.
assignees: JIANGSU MISDAOCHENG INTELLIGENCE SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Emergency response training system
abstract_en: A training device system including a mobile phone simulator having a manually carryable housing and a controller positioned in the housing. The simulator includes a touch screen coupled to the housing and operatively coupled to the controller, wherein the touch screen is configured to selectively display a numerical keypad. The simulator further includes a short-range radio transceiver positioned in the housing, wherein the simulator is configured to, in response to proper operation of the numerical keypad by a user, transmit a signal via the transceiver.

title_en: Coal mine composite power disaster prevention and control method based on controllable shock waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine composite power disaster prevention and control method based on controllable shock waves, which comprises the steps of firstly, in the process of tunneling a working face, arranging a plurality of drill holes at the inner side of a rear roadway, and performing controllable shock wave fracturing; meanwhile, drilling cutting amount monitoring points are arranged to periodically monitor the drilling cutting amount on the two sides of the roadway; and determining a critical drilling cuttings amount early warning value of the composite dynamic disaster according to the drilling cuttings amount data of the site where the composite dynamic disaster occurs. And then injecting a high-concentration acetone solution into the drill hole to promote the further development of the coal body fracture, then discharging the solution, and installing a gas extraction pipeline in the drill hole to extract gas. And then injecting low-concentration acetone solution into the coal seam by using the drill hole again. And finally, periodically monitoring the drilling cutting quantity at each position in the whole process of the working face extraction, and enabling the monitored drilling cutting quantity to be always lower than a 0.8-time early warning value by adjusting the concentration of the acetone solution. The invention reduces the risk of composite power disasters and is beneficial to the safe exploitation of the working face.

title_en: Shaft effusion detection method based on depth anomaly detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shaft effusion detection method based on depth anomaly detection, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining SCADA production high-frequency data and reducing the dimension of the SCADA production high-frequency data; then carrying out feature fusion on the SCADA production high-frequency data subjected to dimension reduction, the A2 data and the geological parameter data; secondly, performing data modeling and training by using the fused features, and calculating a prediction error; and finally, calculating a dynamic threshold according to the obtained prediction error, and judging whether the shaft accumulates liquid according to the dynamic threshold. According to the scheme, the SCADA second-level data is used as the characteristics, so that the model only focuses on data fluctuation between days, and the data fluctuation condition within the day is also considered, and more subtle data change can be captured. And the experimental result also proves that the data fluctuation situation in the day can better reflect the concrete actual production situation, and the method of reducing the dimension firstly is adopted in the process of processing the SCADA high-frequency data, so that the data modeling of the service model is better realized, and the occurrence of dimension disaster is also avoided.

title_en: Coal seam fire area treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine disaster treatment technology, in particular to a coal seam fire area treatment method. The method for treating the coal seam fire area comprises the following steps: step one, performing directional drilling construction on coal beds in adjacent unburned zones above and below a coal bed in a combustion zone; constructing a horizontal branch in a drill hole, fracturing to form cracks, simultaneously extracting gas, and injecting a non-combustible material to form a coal bed oxygen inhibition zone; injecting fire extinguishing materials into the crack to reach the fire area to cool and extinguish the fire; and step four, carrying out isolation treatment on the coal seam of the combustion area in the horizontal direction. The advantages are that: the process is simple, the cost is low, and the fire can be efficiently and quickly extinguished.
assignees: MIDDLING COAL LAND HUAHENG HYDROGEOLOGICAL SURVEY LTD COMPANY

title_en: Early warning prevention and control cloud platform safety supervision mobile intelligent terminal system
abstract_en: A safety supervision mobile intelligent terminal system of an early warning, prevention and control cloud platform comprises working condition patterns and a GIS map, wherein the working condition patterns and the GIS map of the early warning, prevention and control cloud platform are constructed in a multi-source heterogeneous mode; identifying working condition patterns through the mobile intelligent terminal and analyzing and processing the working condition patterns according to the analysis model and the data processing module to obtain emergency patterns; visually plotting the emergency pattern on a GIS map for highlighting; according to peripheral information of the highlighted position on the GIS map, an emergency plan is made; the system further comprises a government and enterprise secondary linkage mechanism, and the government and enterprise secondary linkage mechanism synchronously receives the mobile intelligent terminal and the early warning, prevention and control cloud platform information. It can be seen from the above description that the influence range, the influence mode, the duration and the hazard degree of the accident are calculated through quantitative simulation, the GIS map is combined, the accurate calculation of the emergency rescue evacuation path is realized, and meanwhile, two government and enterprise units receive early warning information simultaneously, so that the supervision is more comprehensive.
assignees: NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION COMMUNICATION INDUSTRY SERVICE LTD COMPANY

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method considering system performance influenced duration and water flow velocity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity evaluation method considering the affected time length of system performance and water flow velocity. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a two-dimensional coupling model of urban flooding and dividing grid units; simulating to obtain the surface submerging water depth and the water flow velocity of each grid unit corresponding to the rainfall sequence at each time period; dividing the land utilization type of each grid unit; determining the system performance of each time interval of grid cells of which the land utilization type belongs to non-traffic land; determining the system performance of each time interval of grid cells of which the land utilization type belongs to the traffic land; determining the duration of time for which the system performance of each grid cell is affected; the grid-based elasticity evaluation method is improved, and the time-interval average elasticity of each grid unit is determined. The invention reflects the resistance, adaptation and recovery capability of the urban system to the flood disaster, thereby better realizing the division of the urban flood disaster risk.

title_en: Network resolving method suitable for large building safe evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network resolving algorithm suitable for safe evacuation of a large building, which comprises the following steps: initializing an evacuation network according to the acquired building structure parameters; determining the positions of all personnel in the building, and determining the evacuation paths and the branch directions of all source points by using a shortest path method; solving a full-time people flow rate sequence at the outlets of all source points (including branches branched by people); according to the node connection relation, the flow rate of the inlet stream of the downstream branch of the source point is obtained; solving a sequence of the flow rates of the inflow at the outlet of a branch through the flow rate of the inflow at the inlet of the branch; calculating the flow rate sequence of the inlet stream of all branches at the whole time by taking the time step as a medium; and if the number of people moving to the final node is equal to the number of people in the building, the operation is finished. The invention realizes the personnel evacuation simulation of the complex building.

title_en: Remote sensing building earthquake damage information extraction method based on color-parameter migration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing building earthquake damage information extraction method based on color-parameter migration. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a source domain seismic damage remote sensing image; creating, dividing and expanding enhancement of a source domain sample set; designing a deep convolutional neural network layer deep structure for extracting a complete building after the earthquake and destroying the building; obtaining an optimal layer depth structure model and parameters by using a parameter random initialization mode; acquiring a target domain seismic damage remote sensing image; performing color migration processing on the target domain image; creating, dividing and expanding enhancement of a target domain sample set; training a target domain model by combining the target domain small sample with the optimal source domain model parameters; extracting earthquake damage information of the target domain image building and evaluating the extraction precision and efficiency. The method can reduce the acquisition cost of the traditional deep learning model, improve the precision and efficiency of earthquake damage information extraction, and meet the requirement of earthquake-resistant disaster-reduction departments on quickly and accurately acquiring the post-earthquake disaster damage information.

title_en: Parallel advanced extra-deep geological prediction method under deep-buried long tunnel TBM (tunnel boring machine) construction condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parallel advanced extra-deep geological forecasting method under the TBM construction condition of a deep-buried long tunnel, which comprises the following steps: 1) carrying out geological survey on the deep-buried long tunnel to be constructed, and acquiring geological information including stratum lithology, faults and rock erosion and weathering of the tunnel and surrounding rocks nearby the tunnel; 2) preliminarily judging the position of geological defects needing to be forecasted in advance according to geological survey acquisition information, and determining the arrangement position of advanced drilling holes by combining the length of a TBM (tunnel boring machine), the normal tunneling speed of the tunnel boring machine and the drilling speed of a directional drilling machine; 3) excavating a small directional drilling machine operation ear hole at a side wall at a horizontal distance L from the rear part of the position where geological defects need to be forecasted in advance; 4) and analyzing according to the sequence of rock slag collection and study, drilling observation, in-hole video recording and in-hole test, and forecasting geological defects and hazard degree. The method can accurately forecast the type and the hazard degree of the geological disaster under the condition of basically not influencing the construction efficiency of the TBM.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES INST OF SURVEY CO LTD WUHAN

title_en: Construction method of water-soil coupling type disaster fluid occurrence probability prediction model and debris flow prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a water-soil coupling type disaster fluid occurrence probability prediction model and a debris flow prediction method. The invention provides a construction method of a water-soil coupling type disaster fluid occurrence probability prediction model. According to the method, AEP-represented rainfall and water-soil coupling motion information is utilized, the correlation data of AEP and water-soil mixture volume weight change intervals in disaster scenes are generated by introducing simulation calculation of an I-D curve construction technology to reflect the information, then the information is converted and simplified by means of curve fitting and a graphical tool, and finally the problem that the co-occurrence between AEP and disaster occurrence probability is reflected through a simple geometric analysis relation is achieved, so that a target model is constructed. The invention also provides a debris flow probability measuring and calculating method, a debris flow forecasting method and application of the technical schemes. The invention calculates the disaster fluid occurrence probability by taking the effective precipitation amount at the earlier stage/the rainfall at the earlier stage as the only variable, thereby simplifying the disaster forecast scheme and quantifying the disaster occurrence probability.

title_en: Double-layer evaluation method and system for elastic power distribution network restoring force evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer evaluation method and a double-layer evaluation system for elastic power distribution network restoring force evaluation, which aim at a planning evaluation level, acquire power grid historical disaster information, conduct planning level disaster simulation to generate disaster scenes, aim at an operation evaluation level, predict disaster scenes in real time according to weather and multi-aspect prediction information, conduct disaster scene simulation analysis to obtain a change curve of a power distribution system load in a time interval mode, extract indexes of a maximum load loss ratio, a system load loss time and a system power loss amount of the power distribution system, continuously simulate new disaster scenes for the planning level until scene simulation is finished, count indexes obtained in all scenes to obtain expected index values, and feed back index results to the operation level in real time. The method can be used for planning and evaluating the restoring force of the elastic power distribution network at the running level, and unification of two level evaluation methods is realized.

title_en: Network connectivity verification method of disaster recovery backup system network and related equipment
abstract_en: The network communication verification method and related equipment for the disaster recovery system network, provided by the disclosure, are used for obtaining a first physical subsystem to be verified in the disaster recovery system network, wherein the first physical subsystem comprises a production end host, a disaster recovery end host and a firewall, and the firewall is used for performing network isolation on the production end host and the disaster recovery end host; obtaining a second physical subsystem having a business logic association relation with the first physical subsystem; before the firewall is opened, network communication verification is carried out on the disaster backup end host and the second physical subsystem, and first statistical information is obtained; and after the firewall is opened, performing network connectivity verification on the first physical subsystem and the second physical subsystem through the production end host and the disaster backup end host to obtain second statistical information. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, automatic network connectivity verification is performed on the hosts related to the firewall before and after the firewall is opened, and the disaster recovery drilling efficiency can be improved by using the verified statistical information.

title_en: Bare rock greening treatment equipment for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster bare rock greening treatment device which comprises a water tank, a seed breeding box and a drill bit, wherein a control unit is arranged on the outer surface of the rear end of the water tank, a universal hose is arranged at the side end of the water tank, an irrigation handle is arranged at one end of the universal hose, the seed breeding box is arranged at the lower end of the water tank, a turntable is arranged at the bottom end of the seed breeding box, a first through hole is formed in the turntable, a base is arranged on the outer surface of the seed breeding box, a support rod is arranged at the front end of the base, a rotating motor is arranged at the front end of the support rod, rotating rods are arranged at two ends of the rotating motor, a connecting rod is arranged on the outer surface of the rotating rod, a fixing plate is arranged at the front end of the connecting rod, a second through hole is formed in the middle of the fixing plate, and the drill bit is arranged at the front end of the rotating motor. The water tank and the hose are arranged to conveniently irrigate the vegetation; vegetation seeds can be sowed by arranging the seed cultivating box, so that greening is increased; can carry out the breakage to great bare rock through setting up the drill bit, reduce artificial broken work working strength.
assignees: HUNAN XINMAINLAND ECOLOGICAL CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Water and sand leakage test equipment under soil body internal erosion action
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water leakage and sand leakage test device under the action of internal erosion of a soil body, which comprises a water tank, an umbrella-shaped water lowering device, an erosion generating box, a supporting frame and a water sand collecting box, wherein the water tank is connected with the umbrella-shaped water lowering device through a water inlet pipe, the erosion generating box is arranged right below the umbrella-shaped water lowering device and is placed on the supporting frame, a circular leakage opening is formed in the center of the bottom of the erosion generating box, the water sand collecting box is placed in the supporting frame, and the placing position of the water sand collecting box is located right below the circular leakage opening. According to the utility model, soluble particles are doped into the soil in advance, the leakage opening is opened after the particles are dissolved and sandy soil is saturated, the water and sand leakage amount and the soil settlement deformation condition are monitored and recorded, the soil water and sand leakage model test under different erosion conditions is simulated, the change mechanism and the change reason of each parameter in the leakage process are further deeply explored, the corresponding measures for preventing water and sand leakage disasters are provided, and the experimental basis is provided for preventing soil erosion disasters in urban construction.

title_en: Universal application system automatic disaster recovery drilling method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a universal application system automatic disaster recovery drilling method and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: setting an automatic drilling strategy; acquiring drilling resources according to the authorization information; arranging canvas based on workflow according to the type of an application system and an automatic drilling strategy, calling drilling resources and constructing an automatic drilling workflow; and triggering an automatic drilling workflow to realize disaster recovery drilling. The invention has the capability of uniformly managing various recovery resources and solving the problems of difficult resource recovery and high cost of user preparation and management; and the system supports flexible arrangement of recovery processes of various data, and meets the service and compliance requirements of various application systems of users for automatic disaster recovery and drilling by automatically performing recovery, availability verification, resource cleaning and outputting disaster recovery reports. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of automatically performing recovery drilling, shortening service stop time, reducing cost and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI LOVE NUMBER INFORMATION TECH STOCK LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Urban waterlogging rapid forecasting method based on multi-output machine learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly forecasting urban waterlogging based on a multi-output machine learning algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: according to the data of the existing research area, an urban waterlogging model is constructed; extracting historical rainstorm rainfall time interval distribution information, generating rainstorms with different characteristics, and simulating and constructing a rainstorm waterlogging database through the constructed urban waterlogging model; constructing a multi-output random forest model, training and testing the multi-output random forest model by using a rainstorm waterlogging database with a rainfall factor as an independent variable and a submerging depth as a dependent variable; based on rainfall forecast input conditions, the rapid and real-time forecast of two-dimensional waterlogging submergence is realized through the constructed multi-output random forest model. The method has important significance for early warning and prevention of urban waterlogging disasters, prevention of waterlogging, reduction of disasters and the like, can effectively improve the real-time waterlogging situation forecasting efficiency and precision of high-incidence areas of the waterlogging disasters, and can provide certain guidance for quickly forecasting the waterlogging situations.

title_en: Urban storm waterlogging risk assessment method based on SWMM model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city rainstorm waterlogging risk assessment method based on an SWMM (single-wall-flow-measurement-model), which overcomes the defect that climate change factors cannot be fully considered in a traditional assessment system, and on the basis of comprehensively considering the influence of climate change and urbanization level on city rainstorm waterlogging, the influence of city rainstorm waterlogging disasters in different scenes is quantitatively assessed based on the SWMM, so that the effective simulation of a city rainstorm flood process is realized, the control and prediction of the city rainstorm waterlogging disasters are realized, and the risk management and attribution analysis of the city rainstorm waterlogging disasters are realized; the invention can provide scientific basis for engineering operation and maintenance and emergency decision of management departments.

title_en: Goaf disaster treatment method based on supplementary exploration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a goaf disaster management method based on supplementary exploration, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out supplementary exploration to determine the trend range of an original stoping working face and a section coal pillar in a goaf, simultaneously fitting out the actual subsidence value of the basic roof in the width direction after stoping of the working face based on the positions of the basic roof at the upper part of a caving zone of the supplementary exploration drilling exploration at different positions, then calculating the basic roof theoretical subsidence value, creatively providing the concepts of a goaf stable region and a goaf management region based on the comparison result of the basic roof theoretical subsidence value, namely, providing two grouting drilling arrangement schemes based on the height of the ground stable requirement, greatly improving the drilling construction position precision, reducing the drilling construction quantity and grouting filling quantity, and saving the cost and time.

title_en: Goaf disaster management method based on stratum exploration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a goaf disaster management method based on stratum exploration, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out supplementary exploration to determine the thickness, burial depth, density and mechanical parameters of each stratum, and the positions of key layers, breaking distances, postmining positions and the original thickness of a caving zone rock stratum. Based on basic top positions of supplementary exploration drilling exploration at different positions, fitting out basic top actual sinking values of edge trends, calculating basic top theoretical sinking values, creatively providing a concept of equivalent residual mining height of a goaf based on a difference value of the basic top actual sinking values and the basic top theoretical sinking values, and considering that the goaf does not need full-area processing based on a strip mining concept, and only needs partial processing. Creatively combines the breaking distance and the breaking position of the key layer to determine the position of the grouting area and the grouting filling width, and provides a determination mode of the control layer. Based on the determined grouting drilling arrangement scheme, the drilling construction amount and grouting filling amount can be reduced, and the cost and time are saved.

title_en: Nuclear power plant design benchmark accident emergency diagnosis system and method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear power plant design benchmark accident emergency diagnosis system based on deep learning, which comprises a nuclear power plant monitoring system, a monitoring database connected with a nuclear power plant detection system, a regulation expert database connected with the nuclear power plant detection system, a typical accident database and a machine learning module, the nuclear power plant monitoring system is used for monitoring the operating parameters of the nuclear power plant, the machine learning module is respectively connected with a monitoring database, a regulation expert database and an emergency operation regulation database, the machine learning module is internally provided with an extraction model and a diagnosis model which are composed of a plurality of layers of convolutional neural networks, the machine learning module is used for training a multilayer convolutional neural network by processing data in a regulation expert database, an emergency operation regulation database and a typical accident database, so that an extraction model and a diagnosis model are optimized, and the efficiency of emergency response execution is improved. The invention introduces the machine learning module, realizes the intellectualization of accident diagnosis and greatly improves the efficiency of accident diagnosis.
assignees: SHANGHAI QUEUE FIRST INDUSTRY DEVELOPMENT LTD COMPANY

title_en: Fire-fighting gloves integrating training and fighting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment and electronics, and discloses a pair of fire fighting gloves integrating training and fighting. Meanwhile, the joint of the thumb and the glove is thickened, so that scratch is prevented. The glove has simple structure and convenient movement, and can provide great flexibility for firefighters. Through setting up the insulating layer that absorbs water, can effectively prevent the effect that the heat passed to comfortable layer fast transmission, have a better fire-retardant thermal-insulated effect, prevented effectively that the burn and scald phenomenon from taking place, guaranteed fire fighter's safety, be the ideal protective apparatus that prevents fires and speedily carry out rescue work.

title_en: Water control box for fireproof rolling shutter door
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water control box for a fireproof rolling door, which comprises a box body, wherein a water supply pipe penetrates through the box body and is fixedly arranged on the inner bottom surface of the box body through a fixing lug, a ball valve is arranged on the water supply pipe, a valve handle is fixedly arranged on the ball valve, a reset assembly for driving the ball valve to recover a closed state is arranged on the left side of the valve handle, and a temperature control release device for controlling the opening of the ball valve through temperature is arranged on the right side of the valve handle. The water supply device is reasonable in structural design, can automatically supply water for the fireproof rolling door when a fire disaster is serious, and can manually start water supply operation under the condition of a lighter fire disaster situation, so that the water supply error situation caused by fire fighting exercises is effectively avoided, meanwhile, the safe and stable water supply for the fireproof rolling door can be effectively realized, in addition, the water supply can be manually closed after the fire disaster situation is over, and the waste of water resources is effectively avoided.
assignees: SHANGHAI NAT ART METAL PRODUCT LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Apparatus and method for simulating fire evacuation
title_ko: 화재 대피 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a simulation apparatus. The simulation apparatus may include an evacuation unit which can simulate an evacuation route of occupants existing in a building when fire occurs in the building. According to the present invention, realistic evacuation simulation is possible.
abstract_ko: 시뮬레이션 장치가 제공된다. 상기 시뮬레이션 장치는 건물에 화재 발생시 상기 건물에 존재하는 재실자의 대피 경로를 시뮬레이션하는 대피 유니트;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency vehicle path dynamic optimization method based on intelligent agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geographic information systems, and discloses an intelligent agent-based emergency vehicle path dynamic optimization method. In emergency scenes such as natural disasters and environmental emergencies, road traffic environmental conditions and vehicle conditions are dynamically changed, and collaborative decisions are needed to optimize vehicle scheduling. The method simulates dynamic optimization of a real-time path of an emergency vehicle by using a multi-agent technology, abstracts objects in an emergency scene into a common vehicle agent model VO, an emergency vehicle agent model VE and a road section agent model R, and each agent is an interactive geographic entity in a complex emergency scene. The vehicle intelligent bodies form transfer functions and rules based on a Dijkstra algorithm, a multi-intelligent-body system for real-time dynamic optimization of emergency vehicle paths is constructed through interaction among various intelligent bodies, dynamic optimization of emergency vehicle scheduling is achieved, and a foundation is laid for scientific decision-making.
assignees: GEOGRAPHIC RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF FUJIAN UNIV

title_en: Disaster recovery and backup exercise method and system for network security
abstract_en: The event reporting module generates a service instruction mark ID and sends the service instruction mark ID to the service early warning module, the service early warning module obtains IP address information of an alarm data source through the service instruction mark ID, the IP address information is stored in the service instruction mark ID and a mark database, and then the service instruction mark ID after data updating is sent to the summons staff module; the summons personnel module acquires personnel set information corresponding to the IP address information through the service instruction mark ID, then stores the personnel set data information into a mark database, and sends the service instruction mark ID to the disaster evaluation module; the disaster evaluation module acquires disaster data source information corresponding to the IP address through the service instruction mark ID and analyzes the acquired disaster data source information. The disaster recovery exercise business flow expression of the IT business system is more visual and complete through the scheme.

title_en: Flood forecasting method based on novel general input/output structure and long-short-time memory network
abstract_en: A flood forecasting method based on a novel general input-output structure and a long-short-term memory network. Firstly, analyzing the confluence characteristic according to historical field flood data of a research river basin, and calculating the average confluence time of the research river basin; and secondly, determining the output period number of the LSTM flood forecast model according to the average confluence time of the river basin, and giving the hidden layer number and the hidden layer neuron node number of the LSTM flood forecast model. And then, designing an input-output structure of the novel general LSTM flood forecasting model, inputting a training set and a verification set sample training model, and obtaining the flood forecasting model with different structures and parameters. Finally, comparing and analyzing the performances of the LSTM flood forecast models under different input lengths in a training set and a verification set, determining a final and better LSTM flood forecast model, and evaluating and analyzing the forecast effect of the LSTM flood forecast model in a test set. The invention has strong universality, and the built LSTM flood forecast model can obtain better forecast effect, thereby providing new technical support for flood disaster prevention work of the river basin.

title_en: Coal mine disaster risk prediction method and system based on semantic recognition
