abstract_en: The application provides a coal mine disaster risk prediction method and system based on semantic recognition, wherein the method comprises the following steps of extracting coal mine characteristic data in historical coal mine accident data and coal mine non-accident data as a coal mine risk prediction training set according to a pre-constructed coal mine characteristic extraction model; the method comprises the steps of inputting a coal mine risk prediction training set into a logistic regression model for training to obtain a coal mine risk prediction model, extracting coal mine hidden danger text information and coal mine feature vectors in measuring point data according to a coal mine feature extraction model to serve as coal mine risk evaluation data, and calling the coal mine risk prediction model to conduct risk prediction on the extracted coal mine risk evaluation data. According to the method, fusion of the coal mine text data and the measuring point data is fully considered, a dynamic association relation between the accident risk and hidden danger is established, the hidden danger risk under the coal mine is tracked in real time, the coal mine safety management level and hidden danger disposal efficiency are improved, the accident occurrence key link is blocked, and the accident risk of the coal mine disaster is reduced.

title_en: Emergency path planning method and system combining spatial concentration potential field and toxic load
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency path planning system combining a space concentration potential field and a toxic load, which comprises an information acquisition module, a data analysis module and a route notification module, wherein the information acquisition module comprises a toxic gas leakage alarm, an anemograph and a central management background, and the data analysis module is used for toxic gas diffusion simulation and concentration calculation. The invention belongs to the technical field of safety engineering planning systems, and particularly provides an emergency path planning method and system which are combined with real-time wind field wind direction and wind speed data of a chemical engineering park, calculate the influence range and degree of toxic gas leakage, can effectively inform people in a dangerous area to withdraw first, limit the direction of an emergency evacuation path through the negative direction of a space concentration potential field, improve the convergence rate of an algorithm, determine the optimal emergency evacuation path through replacing the distance with the toxic gas load, and have a practical effect.

title_en: Socialized emergency material inspection and detection method under complex disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting socialized emergency materials in a complex disaster environment, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a socialized emergency material inspection and detection system under a complex disaster environment; s2: implementing a corresponding detection method according to the socialized emergency material detection system under the complex disaster environment; the system for detecting and detecting socialized emergency materials in a complex disaster environment comprises: the system comprises a chemical protective suit inspection and detection index system, an emergency rescue respirator inspection and detection index system, a tent test inspection and detection system, a load disaster environment simulation inspection and detection system and an air cushion bed inspection and detection index system. Also discloses a social emergency material inspection and detection device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium under the complex disaster environment.
assignees: XINGHUA SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT LIMITED COMPANY;XINGHUA GROUP LTD COMPANY

title_en: Geological disaster emergency management and decision system, method and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster emergency management, and discloses a geological disaster emergency management and decision system, a method and a readable storage medium, wherein the geological disaster emergency management and decision system comprises: the pre-disaster prevention system is used for preventing and monitoring geological disasters; the emergency rescue command dispatching system generates an emergency decision; the post-treatment system summarizes the work of sudden geological disaster treatment. The pre-disaster prevention system comprises a geological disaster hidden danger monitoring and early warning subsystem, a ground disaster inspection subsystem, a plan library dynamic management subsystem and an advertising training subsystem; the emergency rescue command and dispatch system comprises a disaster report subsystem, an emergency decision subsystem and an emergency command and dispatch subsystem; the post-treatment system includes a summary evaluation subsystem and a post-disaster reconstruction subsystem. The invention realizes intelligent decision support based on the emergency plan and effectively improves the technological level of emergency decision support of sudden geological disasters.

title_en: Underground low-temperature airtight coal core drilling device and method for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground low-temperature airtight coal core drilling device and method, and belongs to the technical field of coal core drilling. The utility model provides a colliery is airtight coal core in pit bores gets device includes urceolus subassembly, the inside of urceolus subassembly rotates and installs the inner tube subassembly, and the one end fixed mounting of inner tube subassembly has collection subassembly, the one end of inner tube subassembly rotates and installs water supply subassembly, and the one end of inner tube subassembly rotates and installs the cooling subassembly, the one end fixed mounting of urceolus subassembly has the drill bit subassembly, through the liquid nitrogen spout, when using, cool down the cooling to the coal seam, and after the cooling, cut through the drill bit subassembly, and through the path drill bit, make the coal sample enter into the inside of gathering the room, promote upper end ball valve and cut the core ball valve through water supply subassembly, and then carry out low temperature seal to the coal sample, reduce the gas and spill effect, and carry out on-the-spot desorption, conveniently obtain accurate basic data for aspects such as colliery gas content survey, gas disaster management and coal seam gas resource exploration and development.

title_en: Method and system for judging disaster risk level based on rain condition data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for judging disaster risk level based on rain condition data, belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence data analysis, and solves the problem that the wind direction level and trend of future disaster occurrence cannot be effectively predicted in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring rainfall data of each station, and constructing a rainfall accumulation histogram of each station according to a time sequence; inputting the rainfall accumulation histogram into a corresponding current optimal disaster risk grade prediction model, and acquiring disaster prediction risk grade information corresponding to the prediction moment and corresponding probability information; acquiring actual risk grade information at a prediction moment; and when the disaster prediction risk grade information corresponding to the prediction moment is different from the actual risk grade information, training the disaster risk grade prediction model of the site by using the rainfall accumulation histogram labeled by the actual risk grade of the site, and updating the current optimal disaster risk grade prediction model of the site.
assignees: BEIJING COMA MAP SCIENCE AND TECH GROUP STOCK LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Frequency flutter interactive simulation machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a frequency-flutter interactive simulator, which comprises a background plate, a bottom plate, a button, a support rod, a moving frame, a baffle, a first magnet, a second magnet, a belt and a cam, wherein a display screen is installed on the background plate, a power supply bin is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the background plate, an electric shock railing is electrically connected in the power supply bin, a support frame is connected to the electric shock railing, an induction area is fixedly connected to an experience platform, a cone is fixedly connected to the bottom of the experience platform, a steel ball is welded to the bottom of the cone, and the button is arranged on the side face of the experience platform. The simulator can watch severe natural disasters or scenes when the disasters are suffered through the display on the background plate, the real shaking experience of an experiencer is enhanced through the shaking of the cone and the steel ball when the experiencer stands on the experience platform, if current is generated in the range of the electric shock railing, the experiencer is subjected to the touch induction, and the practicability and the experience of the simulator are enhanced.
assignees: JIANGSU MISDAOCHENG INTELLIGENCE SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Information processing method for preventing and treating small coal pillar gas and coal spontaneous combustion composite disasters
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of material preparation, and discloses an information processing method for preventing and treating small coal pillar gas and coal spontaneous combustion composite disasters, which is characterized in that a modern computer-based numerical simulation technology is adopted, FLAC3D numerical simulation software is adopted, dynamic evolution rules of peak stress in the tunneling process and the mining process of a working face at two sides of a small coal pillar are analyzed from the transverse and longitudinal layers respectively, the plastic damage range of the coal pillar is determined, and the dynamic development process and the key damage area of the internal crack of the small coal pillar are deduced on the basis of the dynamic evolution rules. According to the method, the migration rule of gas in the small coal pillar, the working face goaf and the adjacent goaf in the small coal pillar crack development process is simulated by adopting ANSYSHLUENT numerical simulation software, the influence mechanism of the small coal pillar crack development on coal spontaneous combustion and composite disasters is disclosed, and the areas of the coal spontaneous combustion and composite disaster dangerous areas before and after grouting of the small coal pillar and the adjacent goaf are contrastively analyzed.
assignees: SICHUAN COAL DESIGN RES INSTITUTE;NORTH CHINA SCIENCE AND TECH COLLEGE CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Urban disaster early warning method and system based on time sequence multi-dimensional prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city disaster early warning method and system based on time sequence multidimensional prediction, relating to the field of disaster early warning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current disaster related data of a target city; the disaster related data is multidimensional data formed by a plurality of factors related to disaster events; one factor corresponds to one single-dimensional data; each piece of single-dimensional data corresponds to a time sequence; inputting current disaster related data into a city disaster early warning model to obtain a future disaster possibility index of a target city; the future disaster possibility index is used for carrying out disaster early warning on the target city; the urban disaster early warning model is obtained by performing parallel training on a first single-dimensional characterizer, a second single-dimensional characterizer and a multi-dimensional characterizer by adopting historical disaster related data. The invention can predict disaster events, so that managers can shorten rescue time and even suppress disasters, and the loss of manpower and financial resources caused by urban disasters is greatly reduced.

title_en: Historical building fire monitoring method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring a fire disaster of a historical building based on a digital twin technology, wherein the method for monitoring the fire disaster comprises the following steps: building data are received to create a historical building model, and the historical building model is displayed visually; receiving real-time video data obtained by monitoring the historical building, carrying out fire identification on the real-time video data, carrying out visual processing on ignition point information obtained by fire identification, and then simulating and displaying the information in the historical building model; and carrying out influence analysis on the simulated fire condition in the historical building model to obtain a fire influence range, determining an optimal fire fighting route according to the fire influence range and pushing a fire message to a corresponding rescue placement point. The invention analyzes and simulates the fire condition, calculates the optimal rescue scheme through the simulation result, and informs related personnel to process in time, so as to discover the possibility of possibly damaging the historical building in time.
assignees: GUANGZHOU EUCLIDEAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Goaf grouting treatment method for extra-thick coal seam old goaf re-mining
abstract_en: The invention relates to a goaf grouting treatment method for extra-thick coal seam old goaf re-mining. Comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: determining the plane boundary of the re-mining area; step two: calculating and determining a vertical boundary of the re-mining treatment; step three: determining the arrangement mode of ground directional drilling and underground drainage drilling, exploration positions, horizontal intervals, a construction sequence and the requirements of a drilling structure; step four: determining parameters such as grouting materials, pressure, finishing standard, grouting sequence, grouting and drilling matching and the like under different working conditions; step five: and (5) checking and reinforcing the grouting filling effect. The invention effectively solves the problems of water damage, fire zone, harmful gas, broken roof and other multiple disasters, which are faced by the previous irregular mining of the residual coal of the extra-thick coal seam, realizes the good effects of multiple disaster source disaster treatment, space filling and coal rock consolidation in the re-mining zone, and creates the favorable conditions of safe mining for the re-mining of the residual coal of the extra-thick coal seam.
assignees: XIAN INSTITUTE OF RES CO LTD OF MIDDLE COAL INDUSTRY GROUP

title_en: Rock soil slope landslide disaster monitoring and early warning experimental device capable of simulating complex terrain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock-soil slope landslide disaster monitoring and early warning experimental device capable of simulating complex terrain, which is characterized by comprising the following components: the device comprises a base, a bottom groove body, an upper end groove body, a horizon simulator and a bearing groove body; one side of the bottom groove body is hinged with the base, the other side of the bottom groove body is hinged with the upper end groove body, a lifting module is arranged between the bottoms of the bottom groove body and the upper end groove body and the base, the horizon simulator is fixedly arranged on the bottom groove body and the bottom wall in the upper end groove body, and the bearing groove is independently arranged on the outer side of the bottom groove body; the device adds solid-state experimental apparatus and establishes the dynamic adjustment form, including the width is adjustable, the slope is multistage adjustable, the bottom surface is undulant multiple change, through control box intelligent control, in touch display screen department input instruction, compare in traditional experimental groove, can be faster, more convenient, more laborsaving realization experiment within a definite time the topography span transform, promoted the efficiency that the experimental early stage infrastructure was built, also alleviateed experimenter's work burden.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHEJIANG SPECTRUM ENGINEERING TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Disaster situation assessment method and device based on single-temporal image
abstract_en: A disaster situation evaluation method and device based on single-temporal images can be used in the field of disaster situation evaluation or other fields. The method comprises the following steps: performing image enhancement processing twice on the image without the history of the marks to generate a first enhanced image and a second enhanced image; inputting the first and second enhanced images into a preset initial evaluation model for model training to obtain a first training model; inputting the marked historical post-disaster image into a first training model, inputting an output result of the first training model into a preset initial full-connection model for processing, and updating the model according to the output result of the first training model to obtain a disaster situation evaluation model and a trained full-connection model; and inputting the actual post-disaster image into the disaster evaluation model, and inputting the result output by the disaster evaluation model into the trained full-connection model for processing to obtain a disaster evaluation result. The method reduces the dependence on the marked image, effectively extracts the image information, has good real-time performance, timely masters the complex disaster situation and optimizes the rescue resources.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL AND COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA LTD

title_en: Video education system for disaster and safety accident response training based on virtual reality
title_ko: 가상현실 기반의 재난 및 안전사고 대응 훈련을 위한 영상 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a video education system for a disaster and accident response training based on virtual reality, wherein by using a user terminal, a head mount display device (HMD), and the like, the present invention allows people of all ages to enjoy watching various types of virtual reality (VR) videos related to disasters such as fire, storm and flood damage, and earthquake and accidents regarding safety, or to understand the power and risk of each of the disasters and accidents while playing a game, thereby exhibiting an effect of providing experience and training in advance on a response methods and response tips for the disasters and accidents simultaneously anytime and anywhere.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실 기반의 재난 및 안전사고 대응 훈련을 위한 영상 교육 시스템에 관한 것으로, 사용자 단말, 헤드마운트 디스플레이 장치(HMD) 등을 이용하여 남녀노소 누구나 재미있게 화재, 풍수해 및 지진 등 재난 및 안전사고와 관련된 다양한 형태의 각종 가상현실(Virtual Reality, VR) 영상을 보거나 게임을 하면서 각각의 재난 및 안전사고의 위력 및 위험성을 이해함과 동시에 재난 및 안전사고의 대응방법 및 대응요령을 언제 어디서나 사전에 실전 체험과 교육이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fire-fighting simulation system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of fire extinguishing systems, especially, fire control analog system, it includes condition of a fire detection module, warning module and fire alarm controller, wherein: the fire detection module can output a fire signal for representing the occurrence of a fire when the fire occurs; the fire detection module at least comprises a point type temperature-sensitive detector, a point type smoke-sensitive detector, a point type temperature-sensitive detector and a linear beam smoke-sensitive detector; the output end of the fire detection module is connected to the input end of the fire alarm controller, and the fire alarm can control the warning module to warn after receiving the fire signal. The fire disaster detection system has the effect of conveniently finding out fire disaster dangerous cases in time.
assignees: QINGDAI ORIENTAL EDUCATION SCIENCE AND TECH GROUP LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Disaster information filtering method and system based on attention network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster information filtering method based on a graph attention network, which has the characteristics that the graph attention network is used for understanding the correlation between words of posts and corresponding information types, and executable information is obtained by filtering, and the method comprises the following steps: step 1, preprocessing posts in a data set to obtain preprocessed data; step 2, building an information filtering network model; step 3, inputting the preprocessed data into an information filtering network model for training to obtain a trained information filtering network model; and 4, inputting the posts to be classified into the trained information filtering network model to obtain a classification result. The information filtering network comprises a BERT coder, a graph attention network and a relation network. The invention also discloses a disaster information filtering system based on the drawing attention network, which comprises a preprocessing part and an information filtering part.

title_en: Experimental device for measuring influence of pool fire on pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device for measuring influence of a pool fire on a pipeline, which comprises an oil pool system, an oil supply system, a transverse air system and a pipeline simulation system. The oil pool system is used for simulating an oil pool fire disaster, the oil supply system is used for supplying oil to the oil pool system, and an air outlet of the transverse air system is opposite to the oil pool system and is used for simulating the interference of transverse air on the fire of the oil pool system; the pipeline simulation system is used for simulating the thermal radiation heating condition of the pipeline. The experimental device for determining the influence of the pool fire on the pipeline can simulate the influence of the pool fire on the pipeline, and can simulate the pipeline cooling protection situation when different fluids are introduced into the pipeline. In addition, after water is added into the oil pool, the burning oil product can be isolated from the fuel oil of the oil supply system, and the safety performance of the experimental device is improved.

title_en: Geological disaster prevention and control monitoring soil sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster prevention and control monitoring is with soil sampling device relates to geological disaster prevention and control field, and it includes sampling mechanism and the mechanism of impressing, sampling mechanism includes the tubular metal resonator, fixes at the first servo motor that tubular metal resonator top central point put, fixes the pivot in first servo motor output shaft one end through the shaft coupling. When the utility model is used, the helical blade is firstly installed at the bottom of the sleeve, the drill bit is installed at the bottom of the helical blade, the rotating shaft is driven to rotate by the first servo motor, the helical blade and the drill bit are driven to rotate, and the helical blade and the drill bit can be rapidly broken through a soil layer for sampling by the pressing-in mechanism, so that the soil layer with higher compactness is avoided, and the sampling efficiency is improved; after the sample is accomplished, it is rotatory through second servo motor drive threaded rod, drive slider and scraper blade slip, push out helical blade when extruding the soil sample and release the tubular metal resonator to dismantle it, obtain complete soil sample, make things convenient for quick convenient sample of personnel, reduce personnel's labour.
assignees: SHAANXI GEOLOGY 90 8 ENVIRONMENTAL GEOLOGY LTD COMPANY

title_en: True three-dimensional simulation device for mud outburst and water inrush deformation of tunnel or deep tunnel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a true three-dimensional simulation device for mud-outburst and water-inrush deformation of a tunnel or a deep tunnel, which relates to the field of geotechnical engineering and disaster prevention and control and comprises a tunnel or deep tunnel simulation assembly, wherein the tunnel or deep tunnel simulation assembly comprises a storage box, a diversion trench, a water drainage hole, a chute, a baffle, a rigid model box, a guide frame, a drilling hole, a filter screen and a filter hole, a connector is arranged on the surface of the rigid model box, a pressure-stabilizing water supply assembly communicated with the connector is arranged on the outer side of the rigid model box, and a loading assembly, a drilling assembly, a monitoring system and a processing device are arranged on the periphery of the rigid model box. The method realizes true three-dimensional simulation under the combination of various geological conditions or deep roadway mud-outburst and water-inrush disasters, and realizes the simulation of the influence effect of different geological conditions on the construction of the tunnel or the deep roadway.

title_en: Small target fire detection method based on improved YOLO algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision and forest fire prevention, and particularly relates to a small target fire detection method based on an improved YOLO algorithm. Comprising the following steps. S100, establishing a fire disaster data set, and collecting images of fire disasters and smog, including images of flames and smog under different weather and light rays; s200, marking a data set; s300-building an improved YOLO-V3 algorithm frame, S400-pre-training a network, and pre-training the improved YOLO-V3 model through the fire image training data set to obtain prediction frames with different scales. The invention solves the problems of insufficient speed and precision of the traditional YOLO-V3 designed for universal target detection when detecting small targets.

title_en: Method for re-accessing external power supply to nuclear power plant after black start of power grid
abstract_en: The method belongs to the electrical field, and particularly relates to a method for re-accessing an external power supply to a nuclear power plant after black start of a power grid. After suffering serious natural disasters, the power grid is not actually supplied in the black start process, and after the electric energy stored by the storage battery is used up, the equipment in the station cannot be operated and the access of the external power grid power supply cannot be realized. Therefore, a method and a necessary device for re-accessing an external power supply of a nuclear power plant after a black start of a power grid are needed to be provided. The method comprises the following steps: step one: determining the type of a temporary external power supply; step two: determining the capacity of a temporary external power supply; step three: determining an external power supply access mode; step four: connecting an external power supply; step five: putting into a switching station device; step six: and (5) exiting the external power supply. The temporary external power supply switching box is added in the method, so that the temporary external power supply switching-in work is simplified, the working efficiency is improved, and a better emergency plan is provided for emergency exercises of related nuclear power plants which are started in usual time in a black mode.

title_en: Path planning and spectrum resource allocation method and system for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for path planning and spectrum resource allocation of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: simulating ground terminal distribution and hot spot distribution to obtain a plurality of clusters; according to the distance between each unmanned aerial vehicle and each cluster and the number of ground terminals which can be accessed by each unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicles are configured for the ground terminals, and the network coverage rate and the data acquisition efficiency of the emergency communication system are improved by performing cooperative cooperation on network coverage of different disaster areas and the unmanned aerial vehicles on the same layer; based on the interference parameters of other unmanned aerial vehicles and the channel gain between the ground terminals, the data volume currently received by each unmanned aerial vehicle is calculated, and according to the data volume currently received by each unmanned aerial vehicle, the multi-dimensional influence parameters are combined to obtain the maximum arrangement income as a target, the COBSO intelligent algorithm is utilized to distribute frequency resources for each unmanned aerial vehicle, the track of the unmanned aerial vehicle is optimized, the deployment quantity of the unmanned aerial vehicle is optimized, and the utilization rate of limited bandwidth resources and the life cycle of the system are improved.
assignees: TIANWING CLOUD SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Coal rock dynamic disaster prediction method and device based on dust-slag ratio
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal rock dynamic disaster prediction method and a device based on a dust-slag ratio, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, collecting drill cuttings while drilling in the excavation work; step 2, classifying and weighing the drill cuttings according to the particle size of the drill cuttings; step 3, calculating the mass ratio of the drill cuttings with different particle sizes according to the mass of the drill cuttings with different particle sizes weighed in the step 2; and 4, calculating the difference between the mass ratio calculated in the step 3 and the standard mass ratio, taking the change rate of the difference as a mass ratio index, and prejudging the hardness of the front coal/rock according to the mass ratio index. By analyzing the mechanism of disaster occurrence, the method provides that drill cuttings drilled by a drill rod are collected during drilling, the collected drill cuttings are classified and weighed respectively, the mass ratio of the collected drill cuttings to the collected drill cuttings, namely the dust-slag ratio, effectively pre-judges the hardness of the coal bed in front of a working face, and the coal-rock dynamic disaster degree of the coal bed in front is predicted according to the pre-judged new index.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHENGTONG COAL INDUSTRY LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Comprehensive pipe gallery risk identification method and system based on sound signal imaging
abstract_en: The application provides a comprehensive pipe rack risk identification method and system based on voice signal imaging, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting various disaster voice signals in a comprehensive pipe rack as sample voice signals, wherein the sample voice signals are stored in a comprehensive pipe rack voice information disaster library, conducting imaging processing on the sample voice signals to generate voice spectrograms and serve as sample images, conducting detection frame marking on the sample images based on disaster information corresponding to the sample voice signals, training a constructed disaster identification model based on a deep learning target detection algorithm based on the sample images and corresponding marking detection frames to generate a trained target disaster identification model, collecting a current voice signal sequence to be identified of the comprehensive pipe rack, generating a voice spectrogram to be identified, and inputting the voice spectrogram to be identified into the target disaster identification model to output a corresponding disaster identification result. The comprehensive pipe rack risk identification method is perfected, and the timeliness and accuracy of risk identification are improved.

title_en: Hydrogen-doped natural gas pipeline leakage ignition combustion test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a leakage ignition combustion test device for a hydrogen-doped natural gas pipeline, which comprises a gas supply system, a gas control system, a mixed gas tank, an emptying system, an ignition system, a test system and a PLC system, wherein the downstream of the gas supply system is divided into three branches, the three branches can be respectively used for simulating a plurality of different injection fire disaster real scenes including single or mixed fuel injection fires (namely single-path) and double-path injection fire sources, and further, the test pipe sections with different materials are arranged on the downstream middle-path natural gas/hydrogen mixed gas pipeline, so that the compatibility between the natural gas after being doped with hydrogen and the natural gas pipeline in active service and the leakage flow and the integrity research of the injection fire combustion characteristics and heat disasters are realized, and the defects in the prior art can be overcome. At present, the development of the test device is blank in China, and the significance of accelerating the popularization and application of the technology is great.

title_en: Feasibility evaluation method for improving recovery upper limit safety mining of coal seam under near unconsolidated formation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal seam mining feasibility evaluation, in particular to a feasibility evaluation method for improving the safe mining of the upper limit of the stope of a coal seam under a near unconsolidated formation, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of water mining grade division, characteristic analysis of a bedrock weathering zone and a soil-rock contact zone, overlying rock movement damage characteristic analysis, building and analysis of a water sand inrush test model, determination of coal pillar height and prevention and control measures. The drilling data is utilized to analyze and evaluate the hydrographic engineering geological properties and differences of the bottom of the unconsolidated formation and the wind oxidation zone, and the mining fracture distribution characteristic and the water-soil interaction permeation damage characteristic of the sand control protective layer (the bottom of the unconsolidated formation and the wind oxidation zone) are combined to reasonably reserve the height of the coal bed mining safety coal rock pillar, so that the foundation is provided for the work of planning and mining mode selection and the like of a mining area, and the important practical application value is provided for reserving the coal bed mining safety coal rock pillar under the near unconsolidated formation of the mining area, evaluating and preventing water sand disasters.

title_en: Restraint opening type locking landslide evolution instability mechanism simulation test device
abstract_en: The application provides a restraint mouth formula locking type landslide evolution unstability mechanism analogue test device belongs to ground disaster test equipment field, and this restraint mouth formula locking type landslide evolution unstability mechanism analogue test device is including supporting protection machanism, load application mechanism and slope adjustment mechanism, it includes base, counter-force wall and transparent protection casing to support protection machanism, transparent protection casing downside sliding connection in the base upside, load application mechanism includes first servo motor, first lead screw, first slider, first pneumatic cylinder, stressometer and thrust plate, first servo motor transmission connect in first lead screw, first lead screw thread run through in first slider, slope adjustment mechanism includes second pneumatic cylinder, flat board and first slope plate, second pneumatic cylinder lower extreme sliding connection in the base upside, this application can reduce experimental work load, the test efficiency is improved.

title_en: Intelligent fire fighting monitoring method and system based on BIM and Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting monitoring method and system based on BIM and Internet of things technology, which are applied to a monitoring terminal, wherein the monitoring terminal is in communication connection with a fire alarm host, and the fire alarm host is connected with a fire alarm; when alarm information sent by a fire alarm host is received, a BIM application platform is called according to the alarm information; acquiring and displaying a BIM corresponding to a building in which a fire disaster happens currently in the platform; performing path simulation analysis on the BIM according to the current fire position information; and uploading the path simulation analysis result to a fire-fighting system and inputting the fire rescue information of the fire into the BIM for storage. The method is linked with the BIM model, a path simulation analysis result is obtained through simulation analysis in the BIM model according to the alarm information and is used for fire scene rescue, corresponding rescue information is stored in the BIM model after rescue, the rescue information is convenient to call when a fire happens next time, and exchange and sharing of fire rescue information are achieved.
assignees: LTD OF CHONGJIAN KIDNEY WORK GROUP

title_en: IoT-based gas shut-off, control device, and device-specific operation control method for advanced leak detection and the control method thereof
title_ko: IoT 기반의 가스 차단, 제어 장치 및 누출 검지 고도화를 위한 장치 및 이의  운용 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an Internet of things (IoT)-based gas shut-off and control device, a device for advanced leak detection, and an operation control method thereof and, more specifically, to an IoT-based gas shut-off and control device using data on gas leakage, temperature, pressure, valve opening and closing, remaining amount, liquid leakage, and the like, a device for advanced leak detection and for IoT-based and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT)-based gas shut-off and control device, and an operation control method thereof. The IoT-based gas shut-off and control device and the device for advanced leak detection comprises: an advanced leak detection module (strategic control module) for determining a control level suitable for scenarios set in individual and small businesses, gas filling plants, and manufacturing facilities, generating control signals for remote shut-off devices and valves, and transmitting the control signals through a wireless communication module; a sensor fusion module including a plurality of heterogeneous sensors installed in the individual and small business, the gas filling plants, and the manufacturing facilities; a coupling module incorporating a protocol according to transmission and reception of sensor data by the sensor fusion module; a communication board having a communication function capable of securing the security and reliability of the sensor data of the sensor fusion module to wirelessly transmit and receive signals of sensors and blocking devices in remote places, and using various communication methods such as LTE, BLE, NB-IoT, and LoRa depending on communication distances and communication targets; an actuator, which is a driving device of shut-off valves, three-way valves, pressure regulators, and release valves used for gas block and control of the advanced leak detection module; and a power supply unit for supplying power to the components. Therefore, the spread of secondary damage can be prevented through a quick response to large-scale disaster situations.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 IoT 기반의 가스 차단, 제어 장치 및 누출 검지 고도화를 위한 장치 및 이의  운용 제어 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 가스누출, 온도, 압력, 밸브개패, 잔량, 액체누출 등에 대한 데이터를 통해 IoT 기반의 가스 차단, 제어 장치 및 누출 검지 고도화와 사물 인터넷(IoT) 뿐만 아니라 산업용 사물인터넷(IIoT) 기반 가스 차단 및 제어 장치를 위한 장치 및 이의 운용 제어 방법에 관한 것으로서, 개인, 소규모사업장, 가스충전 플랜트 및 제조시설에 설정된 시나리오에 알맞은 제어 수준을 결정하고 원격지 차단 장치 및 밸브에 대한 제어 신호 생성 및 상기 제어 신호를 무선 통신 모듈을 통해 전송하는 누출 검지 고도화 모듈(Strategic control module); 상기 개인, 소규모사업장, 가스충전 및 제조시설에 설치된 복수개의 이종 센서를 포함하는 센서 퓨젼 모듈; 상기 센서 퓨젼 모듈의 센서 데이터 송수신에 따른 프로토콜을 내장한 커플링 모듈; 상기 센서 퓨젼 모듈의 센서 데이터의 보안 및 신뢰성을 확보할 수 있는 통신 기능을 탑재하여 원격지의 센서 및 차단장치의 신호를 무선 송수신하는 기능을 갖고, LTE, BLE, NB-IoT, LoRa 등을 적용함으로써 통신거리 및 통신 대상에 따라 다양한 방식의 통신방식을 적용한 통신 보드(Communication Board);  상기 누출 검지 고도화 모듈의 가스 차단 및 제어에 사용되는 차단밸브, 삼방밸브, 압력조정기, 및 방출밸브의 구동 장치인 액츄에이터; 및 상기 구성들에 전력을 공급하는 파워서플라이 유닛;을 포함한다.

title_en: Counterweight system for trailer mechanized bridge and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a counterweight system for a trailer mechanized bridge and a using method thereof, wherein the counterweight system comprises: two connecting structures and a counterweight mechanism; two lifting rings are arranged on a cross beam at the front end of a trailer chassis of the trailer mechanical bridge; the counterweight mechanism is connected with two lifting rings arranged on a cross beam at the front end of the trailer chassis through two connecting structures. Under the working condition of carrying out emergency operation on an emergency rescue and relief site, the connecting structures comprise fastening tools and fixing hooks, and the counterweight mechanism is a traction headstock; under the daily operating mode of erectting, removing the training of trailer mechanized bridge, connection structure is tight utensil of deciding, and counter weight mechanism is the balancing weight. The invention ensures the provision of the balance moment required in the process of erecting and withdrawing the trailer mechanical bridge and also avoids carrying a large amount of counter weights in the process of emergency rescue and disaster relief transportation.
assignees: CHINESE SHIP HEAVY INDUSTRY GROUP EMERGENCY EARLY WARNING AND RESCUE EQUIPMENT STOCK LTD COMPANY

title_en: Convective disaster-causing strong wind early warning and forecasting method based on space-time network convolution model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for early warning and forecasting of convective disaster-causing strong wind based on a space-time network convolution model, which comprises the following steps: quality control is carried out on the weather radar networking data; interpolating radar data to grid points with equal longitude and latitude of 3km height; sampling and gridding the observation data of the elements of the ground automatic station; constructing an average wind approach forecast data set; training and inspecting the data set; constructing an average wind approach forecasting model based on deep learning; and constructing a relation between the minute-level average wind speed and the instantaneous maximum wind speed through the gust coefficient, and converting the forecast result of the average wind speed into a gust wind speed forecast product. The invention fuses multi-source data based on business requirements, and solves the business problem of business gust kilometer grid nowcasting by utilizing weather radar networking observation and minute-level element observation of a ground automatic station.
assignees: NANJING METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Socialized emergency product inspection and detection index system under complex disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a socialized emergency product inspection and detection index system in a complex disaster environment, which comprises the following steps: the method for establishing the socialized emergency product inspection and detection system under the complex disaster environment comprises the following steps: a socialized emergency equipment inspection and detection system and a socialized emergency facility inspection and detection system; implementing a detection method according to a socialized emergency product detection system in a complex disaster environment; the social emergency equipment inspection and detection system comprises a reliability test, an obstacle crossing performance test, a wading performance and rain test, a cross torsion resistance performance test, a longitudinal stability and braking safety test, a transverse stability test, a longitudinal passing performance test, a traction driving performance test, a preparation area and a cross road. The detection system for the social emergency facilities comprises: the method comprises the following steps of performing failure test on key components of a typical social emergency facility, performing test on key components of a typical social emergency training experience facility and detecting the sound emission source characteristics of the key components of the typical social emergency training facility based on damage forms.
assignees: XINGHUA SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT LIMITED COMPANY;XINGHUA GROUP LTD COMPANY

title_en: Crowd evacuation-based data processing method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a data processing method, a device and electronic equipment based on crowd evacuation, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the following steps: acquiring the number of people on each network node and the passing efficiency of people on each connecting edge in a network graph of a target place; training the initial crowd evacuation model based on the number of people on each network node and the personnel passing efficiency of each connecting edge to obtain a target crowd evacuation model; and determining the crowd evacuation strategy of the target place based on the model parameters in the target crowd evacuation model. According to the method, when the crowd evacuation strategy of the target site is determined, the crowd gathering area is considered as a whole, so that the influence of the mutual influence among individuals in the crowd on the behavior of the whole crowd is avoided, namely, the crowd evacuation strategy is determined in a macroscopic calculation mode, so that the crowd in the target site can be effectively guided to evacuate from the whole, and the crowd evacuation efficiency of the target site in response to an emergency is improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU ZHONGOU SCIENCE AND TECH CO

title_en: Method for constructing basin over-standard flood simulation generator based on transfer learning mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of a basin over-standard flood simulation generator based on a transfer learning mechanism, which comprises the following steps: extracting main and branch streams of a drainage basin to mainly control hydrological stations, and constructing topological structures of a plurality of hydrological stations according to water flow relations; the topology comprises a plurality of levels of nodes; the main function of each node is definite to be basic flow or non-basic flow, and the areas except all the nodes of the hierarchy are regarded as uncontrolled intervals; acquiring an over-standard flood simulation process of the nodes of the highest level based on a typical year; and sequentially calculating the over-standard flood simulation process set of each node of each level according to the level of the topological structure. The method considers the characteristic of strong time-space relevance of multi-site flood in the drainage basin, overcomes the problem of result distortion caused by pure random simulation, is suitable for flood data processing of flood control and disaster reduction management, and can provide rich flood data for major flood management in the drainage basin.

title_en: A intelligent disaster relief scene structure for robot AI education
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent disaster relief scene structure for robot AI education, which comprises a simulation room, an initial detection module, an end point detection module and a voice broadcast module, wherein the simulation room is internally provided with an initial area and an end point area, a to-be-taken part for an intelligent robot to grab is arranged in the initial area, the end point area is provided with a placing point for placing the to-be-taken part, the initial detection module is arranged in the initial area and used for detecting the to-be-taken part in the initial area, the end point detection module is arranged in the end point area and used for detecting the placing point in the end point area, and the voice broadcast module is linked with the initial detection module and the end point detection module. The utility model provides an intelligent disaster relief scene structure for displaying robot AI education.

title_en: Mobile Assist Device Simulator System For The Disabled/Elderly Using Virtual Reality
title_ko: 가상 현실을 이용한 장애인/노인의 이동보조기기 시뮬레이터 시스템
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a mobile assistant device simulator system for the disabled/elderly using virtual reality, comprising: a storage unit which stores at least one of safety education content, driving education content, and disaster situation response content; a content execution unit which selects and executes one of the pieces of content stored in the storage unit; a head mounted display (HMD) which outputs a screen that runs the selected content; a motion simulator device with which a user performs an operation corresponding to the content; and a determination unit which compares an action input from the motion simulator with an action set in the content and converts the comparison result into a score. Accordingly, a user is able to conduct simulation in advance through virtual reality before he or she drives an electric wheelchair, and therefore, the present invention can help a user in driving an actual electric wheelchair.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일실시예는 안전 교육 컨텐츠, 운전 교육 컨텐츠 및 재난 상황 대응 컨텐츠 중 적어도 하나를 저장하는 저장부, 상기 저장부에 저장된 컨텐츠들 중 하나를 선택하여 실행하는 컨텐츠 실행부, 상시 선택된 컨텐츠를 실행하는 화면을 출력하는 HMD(Head Mounted Display), 사용자가 상기 컨텐츠에 상응하여 동작을 수행하는 모션 시뮬레이터 장치 및 상기 모션 시뮬레이터에서 입력되는 수행 동작과 컨텐츠에 설정된 동작을 비교하여 점수로 환산하는 판정부를 포함하는 가상 현실을 이용한 장애인/노인의 이동보조기기 시뮬레이터 시스템에 관한 것으로, 사용자가 전동 휠체어를 운전하기전에 가상 현실을 통해 미리 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 실제 전동 휠체어 운전시 도움을 줄 수 있는 가상 현실을 이용한 장애인/노인의 이동보조기기 시뮬레이터 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Mobile Assist Device Simulation Method For The Disabled/Elderly Using Virtual Reality
title_ko: 가상 현실을 이용한 장애인/노인의 이동보조기기 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a simulation method performed in a system comprising a server, a head mounted display (HMD) and a motion simulator. The method comprises: a content execution step of providing at least one of safety education content, driving education content, and disaster response content stored in the server to the HMD and motion simulator to execute the content; a manipulation signal reception step of receiving a user manipulation signal provided, by the motion simulator, in correspondence with the provided content; a comparison step of comparing the content and the manipulation signal; a score conversion step of adding a score when a value requested at a specific time point of the content and the manipulation signal match, or subtracting a score when the value does not match the manipulation signal and converting the result into a result score; and a performance result providing step of providing the result score to the HMD. According to the present invention, the simulation method enables a user to learn a method to cope with various disaster situations so as to provide the user with capability to safely cope with a disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일실시예는 서버와 HMD(Head Mounted Display; 이하 HMD라 함) 및 모션 시뮬레이터로 이루어진 시스템에서 수행되는 시뮬레이션 방법으로서, 서버에 저장된 안전 교육 컨텐츠, 운전 교육 컨텐츠 및 재난 상황 대응 컨텐츠 중 적어도 하나의 컨텐츠를 상기 HMD 및 모션 시뮬레이터에 제공하여 컨텐츠를 실행하는 컨텐츠 실행 단계, 상기 제공된 컨텐츠에 상응하여 상기 모션 시뮬레이터에서 제공되는 사용자 조작신호를 수신하는 조작신호 수신 단계, 상기 컨텐츠와 상기 조작신호를 비교하는 비교 단계, 상기 컨텐츠의 특정 시점에서 요구하는 값과 상기 조작신호가 일치할 경우 점수를 가산하고, 불일치하는 경우 감산하여 결과점수로 환산하는 점수환산 단계 및 상기 결과점수를 상기 HMD에 제공하는 수행결과 제공 단계를 포함하는 가상 현실을 이용한 장애인/노인의 이동보조기기 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning method for hydrogen-containing fluid disasters of coal seam roof and floor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring and early warning method for a hydrogen-containing fluid disaster of a coal seam top and bottom plate, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a plurality of rock cores of a rock layer of the top and bottom plate, then testing the plurality of rock cores at the position by comprehensively using a low-field nuclear magnetic resonance technology, a high-pressure mercury pressing method and an electrical method instrument, and revealing pore structure distribution and water source space distribution characteristics of the rock layer of the coal seam top and bottom plate from a microscopic level; acquiring the development and energy release process of a top-bottom plate rock stratum damage zone by a micro-seismic online monitoring technology; and inputting the core data of the test means into a BP neural network by adopting a deep learning method for training, so that the BP neural network establishes a data model of the relation between the data of the test means, namely a flow-solid-force coupling model, and thus, after only one of the test means is adopted in the subsequent undetected area and single or a plurality of independent data of the area is obtained and input into the data model, early warning and prompting can be carried out on the condition of the hydrogen-containing fluid of the top and bottom plate rock strata of the undetected area and the disaster inoculation degree.

title_en: Promotion algorithm-based method for mapping easiness of mountain torrents in small watershed of Jiangxi province
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for drawing the easiness of mountain torrents in small watershed of Jiangxi province based on a lifting algorithm, which comprises the following main steps of: s1, preprocessing data: after down-sampling the data, randomly dividing the sample data into a training set, a verification set and a test set as model input, and S2, building a lifting method model: and (3) evaluating the easiness of the mountain torrent disasters by using the data and adopting three promotion algorithms. According to the mountain torrent proneness model, the AdaBoost algorithm, the GBDT algorithm and the XGboost algorithm are adopted to construct the mountain torrent proneness model. And S3, importing the result of the mountain torrent easiness degree of the small watershed into GIS software, and quickly and accurately carrying out mountain torrent easiness evaluation and drawing. The integration algorithm based on the lifting method can effectively combine the water conservancy big data and combine the water conservancy big data with the machine learning algorithm, so that governments and professionals are assisted to carry out accurate spatial analysis work on the small watershed torrential flood problem.

title_en: Multi-storey building fire evacuation guiding system based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-storey building fire evacuation guiding system based on a cellular automaton, which is characterized in that real-time information is acquired through a sensor module and an image acquisition module, then a shortest evacuation path and a potential energy diagram are calculated through an edge calculation module, then an evacuation direction instruction is calculated by using a cellular automaton model and is sent to an intelligent guiding module, and people are guided to escape towards a specified direction. By adopting the fire evacuation guiding system, the evacuation efficiency is improved by simulating and calculating the most appropriate escape route.

title_en: Intelligent telephone traffic disaster tolerance platform building method for emergency telephone traffic switching
abstract_en: The method and the system provide a built-in solution from two aspects of configuration and analysis aiming at three common requirements of artificial telephone traffic, namely IVR navigation, intelligent process response and knowledge base question-answer consultation. In the configuration aspect, a configuration visual page is provided, and multi-level IVR navigation is configured by providing a navigation hierarchical configuration page and configuring different navigation types and navigation contents for 0-9 keys; configuring an intelligent customer service response flow chart in a mode of dragging different types of nodes; and generating a knowledge base by uploading the question-answer knowledge base files of the template and training. In the analysis aspect, a conversation control flow and intention recognition conversation management algorithm module is provided, and conversation analysis and conversation control flows of different node types are standardized to realize the effect on a flow response customer service and IVR navigation module; and (3) realizing analysis training of standard question answering through a basic algorithm model, executing a preset knowledge base circulation flow chart in a call, and performing intention identification by using a similarity algorithm to realize question answering consultation in a knowledge base.
assignees: JIANGSU NUMBER HUNDRED INFORMATION SERVICE LTD COMPANY

title_en: Automatic drilling system, method, electronic device and medium for block-level disaster recovery
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic drilling system, a method, electronic equipment and a medium for block-level disaster recovery, wherein the automatic drilling method for the block-level disaster recovery comprises the following steps: sending the backup folder of the application server to a disaster recovery computing resource pool; the disaster recovery computing resource pool creates a virtual machine based on the backup folder; setting hardware resources of the virtual machine based on an original production environment; detecting the IP address of the application server and the working condition of an application port and obtaining a detection result; judging whether the IP address and the application port are open or not based on the detection result, and if so, outputting a control instruction; and the sandbox application module realizes automatic drilling based on the control instruction. The automatic drilling method of the block-level disaster recovery improves the problem that the ground-level disaster recovery cannot be automatically drilled in a copy mode in the prior art.

title_en: Parameter optimization method and system for analog integrated circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parameter optimization method and a system of an analog integrated circuit, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a circuit structure, performance index requirements, design parameters, a value range and iteration stop conditions of an analog integrated circuit to be parameter optimized; sampling to obtain a training sample set based on the obtained design parameters and the value range thereof; inputting each sample in the training sample set into a circuit simulator for simulation to obtain a corresponding training response set; and iterating based on the training sample set and the training response set to realize parameter optimization of the analog integrated circuit. The invention provides a gradual optimization strategy based on mutual information analysis, which aims at relieving the problem of dimension disasters and enabling an algorithm to have the capability of processing high-dimension optimization problems; in each iteration, only part of design variables are selected for optimization, so that the dimension disaster can be relieved.

title_en: Disaster situation assessment method and device based on multi-temporal images
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster situation evaluation method and device based on multi-temporal images, which can be used in the field of disaster situation evaluation or other fields. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical pre-disaster image and a historical post-disaster image, and inputting the historical pre-disaster image and the historical post-disaster image into a preset initial evaluation model for processing to obtain a disaster situation prediction result; updating the initial evaluation model according to the disaster situation prediction result to obtain a disaster situation evaluation model; and inputting the obtained actual pre-disaster image and the actual post-disaster image into the disaster situation evaluation model for processing to obtain a disaster situation evaluation result. According to the invention, the pre-disaster satellite image and the post-disaster satellite image are used for training the model at the same time, so that the disaster situation evaluation model can effectively extract the difference between the front and the back, the evaluation and prediction accuracy rate of the complex disaster situation is improved, and effective reference is provided for workers.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL AND COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA LTD

title_en: Hole forming construction method for square slide-resistant pile
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a hole forming construction method for a square slide-resistant pile. The method comprises the following steps: s100: pre-formed holes are dug around the designed square anti-slide pile in a rotary mode, and the pre-formed holes are backfilled; s200: a round hole is dug in the middle of the designed square slide-resistant pile in a rotary mode; s300: chiseling the edge of the rotary drilling round hole; s400: making a locking notch and/or making a protective wall. According to the invention, before the circular hole is rotationally dug, the preformed hole is rotationally dug, so that the edge formed after the circular hole is rotationally dug is naturally segmented, the subsequent chiseling is facilitated, and the purposes of improving the working efficiency, shortening the construction period and reducing the cost are achieved.
assignees: SICHUAN PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING RECONNAISSANCE YARD GROUP LTD COMPANY

title_en: VR-based liquefied natural gas tank car accident handling teaching and training method and device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a VR-based liquefied natural gas tank car accident handling teaching and training method, apparatus and device, the method comprising: three modes are provided in the VR field of view, including: basic knowledge teaching, technical and tactical training simulation and comprehensive actual combat scene training; in response to the trainee selecting the technical and tactical training simulation mode, presenting an incident training list including virtual incidents of at least one disaster type; and responding to a target virtual accident selected by a trained person from an accident training list, and giving out a virtual accident scene of the target virtual accident and a standard disposal instruction, wherein the standard disposal instruction is used for training the trained person so that the trained person can process the accident according to the standard disposal instruction in a VR scene.

title_en: Three-dimensional landslide surge test normal physical model for river channel type reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses a normal physical model for a three-dimensional landslide and swell test of a river channel type reservoir, which comprises a wave absorption area, a landslide area, a river channel area and a dam area, wherein the landslide area, the river channel area and the dam area are set by integrating geological map information and hydraulic structure design map information of engineering; the dam area comprises a hydraulic structure with a drainage gate; the landslide area comprises a landslide body similar material and a landslide starting device; a water flow circulating system for simulating real water flow conditions is arranged among the wave absorption area, the landslide area, the river channel area and the dam area, and the water flow circulating system further comprises a data monitoring system for monitoring the whole process of landslide surge generation and propagation. The landslide and swell test physical model is a large-size physical model, is an integral normal model designed based on engineering geological map data and hydraulic structure design map data, can completely reflect the whole process of landslide-river channel-high dam combined action, and can more accurately reflect the disaster phenomenon and data rule of real engineering; the method can be used for establishing a large-scale three-dimensional landslide and surge physical model test aiming at real engineering.

title_en: Method for selecting and accurately controlling horizon of water disaster treatment by coal mine exploration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for selecting and accurately controlling a horizon for exploring and treating water hazards in a coal mine, which comprises the following steps: step 1, analyzing disaster-causing factors of an Ordovician aquifer and selecting a treatment horizon; step 2, establishing a gamma value and a stratum standard section as a horizon discrimination basis in subsequent construction, and collecting and supplementing gamma data in due time; and 3, accurately determining the layer position of the drilling track according to the geological data of the project area and the construction upper picking layer holes acquired in the steps 1 and 2. The method can scientifically and reasonably determine the treatment target interval for exploring and treating the huge and thick aquifer, and can control the accurate position of the drilling track in the designed target interval.
assignees: HEBEI MIDDLE ENERGY PEAK PEAK GROUP LTD COMPANY

title_en: Test device for ultra-high speed chip flow impact simulation under weak Coriolis effect
abstract_en: The invention provides a test device for ultra-high speed chip flow impact simulation under weak Coriolis effect, which comprises an air box group, an electromagnetic valve module, a chute-blocking device, a magnetic floating device, a soil body material box pneumatic acceleration-deceleration device and a pneumatic gate opening and closing device. The invention provides a feasible technical scheme for simulating the impact damage problem of the ultra-high-speed landslide debris flow under the condition of weak centrifugation, well solves the problem of the Coriolis effect in the traditional centrifugal simulation high-speed geological process, can provide support for the research of the impact effect of the structure of the related geological disaster, can also provide contrast for the related problem of the simulation ultra-high-speed geological process under the more complex centrifugal-Coriolis compound environment, and is used for evaluating the influence of the Coriolis effect.

title_en: Ultra-high speed debris flow impact simulation platform and test method under weak Coriolis effect
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultra-high speed debris flow impact simulation platform and method under a weak Coriolis effect. The ultra-high speed debris flow impact simulation platform for the weak Coriolis effect comprises a centrifuge, a test platform and a debris flow impact simulation mechanism. The debris flow impact simulation mechanism comprises an air tank group, an electromagnetic valve module, a sliding chute blocking device, a magnetic floating device, a soil body material box pneumatic accelerating-decelerating device and a gate opening and closing control device. The method includes device performance calibration and impact test simulation. The method well solves the problem of Coriolis effect in the traditional high-speed geological process simulated by centrifugation, can provide support for the research of the impact effect of the structure by related geological disasters, can also provide comparison for the related problems of the superspeed geological process simulated under a more complex centrifugal-Coriolis composite environment, and is used for evaluating the influence of Coriolis effect.

title_en: Determination method for longitudinal fire temperature of snake-shaped curve tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of highway tunnel fire disaster safety, in particular to a method for determining the longitudinal temperature of a fire disaster of a snake-shaped curve tunnel. The purpose is to make up for the blank of the research on the distribution characteristics of the fire temperature field of the current snake-shaped curve tunnel. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a mathematical model of fire temperature diffusion of the snake-shaped curve tunnel, establishing a geometric model of the snake-shaped curve tunnel, and establishing a gas flow model in a space of the snake-shaped curve tunnel; according to the model and the method, carrying out three-dimensional numerical simulation calculation on the distribution of the fire temperature field of the snake-shaped curve tunnel; according to the calculation result, the vault temperature T (x) and the vault maximum temperature T of different longitudinal distances from the fire source are obtained  0  Ratio T (x)/T  0  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the And performing nonlinear fitting through the ratio, and finishing to obtain a calculation formula of the longitudinal temperature of the fire disaster of the snake-shaped tunnel. The invention fills the gap of the current study on the distribution of the fire temperature field of the snake-shaped curve tunnel, and provides scientific basis for the personnel evacuation design and lining fireproof design under the fire of the snake-shaped curve tunnel.

title_en: Fire rescue VR training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue VR training system, which comprises a host, VR equipment and simulated fire fighting equipment, wherein the host is connected with the VR equipment; the VR equipment is connected to the host, is worn by training personnel, and can display a fire disaster and a virtual scene in a fire extinguishing process; the simulated fire fighting equipment is connected to the host, and the host is used for modeling a simulated building and combustible substances in the building, simulating a virtual scene of a fire and simulating a virtual scene of a fire extinguishing process after receiving a fire extinguishing operation signal. By adopting the technical scheme, the fire rescue VR training system is an integrated multifunctional fire-fighting rescue simulation training system based on a virtual reality technology, and in order to simulate the situation of a fire rescue scene more truly, the real-time interaction between the fire development situation and the fire rescue action is realized by simulating the fire accident occurrence development evolution process meeting the physical rules and the influence of the fire rescue action on the fire development.

title_en: Method for classifying small sample pictures based on transfer learning and attention mechanism element learning application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for classifying small sample pictures based on transfer learning and attention mechanism element learning. The method adopts a DenseNet as a feature extractor, the difficulty of a small sample classification task is that the sample size is small, and the feature extractor network adopted by the method adopts a feature reuse method to fully utilize limited pictures. The large-scale data training provides good initialization for the deep network weight, so that meta-learning can be converged quickly under fewer tasks, and the operations keep the trained deep network weight unchanged, thereby avoiding the problem of forgetting a disaster.

title_en: Deep hole anchor rope is transferred centering chuck fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and provides a device for lowering a deep hole anchor cable and centering a chuck, which comprises an annular chuck, wherein a through hole for a drilling tool to pass through is formed in the middle of the annular chuck, and chamfers are arranged on the outer peripheral surface of the annular chuck and the joint of the through hole and the end surface of the annular chuck; the anchor clamping buckle with an outward opening is formed in the outer peripheral face of the annular chuck and penetrates through the annular chuck along the axial direction of the annular chuck to be used for fixedly mounting the anchor cable. The anchor clamping buckle is arranged, so that the anchor cable can be fixedly installed; by arranging the chamfer angle, the anchor cable can be smoothly lowered to the bottom of the well and the drilling tool can be smoothly lifted away from the drilled hole. Therefore, the problems that the anchor cable is easy to be stuck by the well wall in the lowering process of the anchor cable, the drilling tool cannot be lifted away from the drilled hole after being lowered into the well bottom along with the anchor cable and the like in the prior art are solved.
assignees: LIAONING COLORED RECONNAISSANCE AND RES INSTITUTE LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Evacuation simulation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an evacuation simulation method, an evacuation simulation device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: creating a building data list indicating coordinate positions and connection orders of the reference structure objects; determining a building structure matrix corresponding to the building data list and a shortest path potential energy field of each reference structure object to a set evacuation outlet according to the position and the connection sequence of each reference structure object in the building data list; determining the position of the evacuation object at a target moment according to the set evacuation object and each element in the building structure matrix for indicating a walkable area; the evacuation path of the evacuation object is determined according to the position of the evacuation object at the target moment and the shortest path potential energy field so as to carry out evacuation simulation on the evacuation object, therefore, the walking path of the evacuation object in the evacuation process can be truly simulated, the evacuation behavior rule of the evacuation object can be more accurately obtained, and auxiliary support can be provided for emergency evacuation drilling and emergency evacuation plans.
assignees: BEIJING BEICHEN SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake disaster search and rescue equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses earthquake disaster search and rescue equipment, which comprises: the outer shaft tube is vertically embedded in the drilling hole of the earthquake rescue point; the rescue main pipe is coaxially and relatively slidably arranged in the outer shaft pipe, a reel machine device is arranged outside the outer shaft pipe, one end of the rescue main pipe is coiled on the reel machine device, and the rescue main pipe is used for carrying out rescue survey and rescue supply in a disaster region; the expansion positioning assembly is arranged on the outer shaft tube and used for stably embedding the outer shaft tube into a borehole of an earthquake rescue point; the lower extreme of outer central siphon to turn to accurate adjustment subassembly, the setting is in and pulse transmission device, coaxial setting is in be located the rescue in the outer central siphon and be responsible for the outside, pulse transmission device can be responsible for the rescue and provide the pulse transmission effect to the rescue is responsible for and can in time bore soft soil layer and the barrier layer in the calamity territory, and reaches the personnel department of suffering a disaster.

title_en: Watershed water simulation method based on webGIS platform and considering comprehensive utilization requirements
abstract_en: A watershed water simulation method based on a webGIS platform and considering comprehensive utilization requirements comprises the following steps of: editing and managing the layers; step 2: generating a comprehensive scheduling calculation scheme; step 3: performing demonstration of watershed water simulation; step 4: performing disaster loss assessment; the invention aims to provide a watershed water simulation method considering comprehensive utilization requirements of reservoir dispatching, which is used for completing watershed water simulation of a dispatching scheme with comprehensive utilization requirements of multiple aspects such as cascade reservoir flood control, water resources, sediment, emergency, ecology and the like, realizing visual display and deduction of the simulation of a reservoir dispatching process, and facilitating decision making and dispatching scheme evaluation analysis of users.

title_en: Detection method for tent in complex disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting a tent in a complex disaster environment, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining the environmental data range of different types of tents under the complex disaster environment; s2, determining simulated environment data based on the environment data range; and S3, respectively carrying out snow load test, wind resistance test and rain resistance test based on the simulated environment data. A detection device for a tent in a complex disaster environment, which implements a detection method, is characterized by comprising: a experimental environment facility of rain test, snow load test environment facility and anti-wind for placing tent's rotation test platform and the experimental platform top set up, wherein: the test platform is a fixed test platform or a rotary test platform.
assignees: XINGHUA SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT LIMITED COMPANY;XINGHUA GROUP LTD COMPANY

title_en: Coal mine gas dynamic disaster simulation experiment device under simulation environment
