abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine gas dynamic disaster simulation experiment device under a simulation environment, which comprises: the bottom of the inner side of the experimental bin is paved with a bottom plate; the roadway frame is arranged on the bottom plate, one horizontal side of the roadway frame extends out of the experimental bin, and the roadway simulation frame is arranged in the roadway frame; and at least two gas dynamic disaster simulation components arranged on the experimental bin and used for simulating gas dynamic disasters; the placement directions of the gas dynamic disaster simulation components are different from each other, and the heights of the output ends of the gas dynamic disaster simulation components are adjustable.

title_en: Flood classification early warning method based on expressed model
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood classification early warning method based on a expressed model, which comprises the following steps: establishing a simulation scene model in the processing software; calculating to obtain the actual range of the river and the flow function of the river; calculating and obtaining the position of a connecting section required by constructing a river surface; calculating and obtaining the water level elevation of each section point position at a fixed moment based on coordinates by using a flood evolution model; performing defined triangle division on the connection section to form a three-dimensional grid curved surface; simulating time and the water flow direction of flood by using a dynamic texture mapping method; drawing flood; and (5) carrying out hierarchical early warning on the building. By adopting the technical scheme, the flood is efficiently and accurately simulated by a computer, a semi-Lagrange implicit integration method is applied, a volume conservation and momentum conservation law is introduced, an adaptive grid curved surface subdivision technology and a texture tiling technology are introduced, a flood disaster assessment and early warning model is constructed, and the method has important significance in restraining flood spreading and protecting important buildings.

title_en: Geological disaster risk level assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster risk level assessment method and device, which are characterized in that a target assessment area is determined from an assessment area library according to a preset screening rule, a disaster type and a target assessment factor corresponding to the target assessment area are determined according to area description information of the target assessment area, edge computing equipment of the target assessment area is determined based on the disaster type and the target assessment factor corresponding to the target assessment area, the edge computing equipment is used for computing and storing monitoring data corresponding to the disaster type and the target assessment factor, a federal learning frame is built and model training is carried out according to the target assessment factor, a preset training data set, the edge computing equipment and the monitoring data of the edge computing equipment, so that a geological disaster risk level assessment model is obtained, the target assessment area is input into the geological disaster risk level assessment model, and an assessment result of the target assessment area is output. The method combines the federal learning framework and evaluates the result by referring to the current evaluation standard, so that the evaluation result is more authoritative.

title_en: Testing device with locking section landslide river-blocking dam-forming mechanism, control method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of landslide safety assessment, and discloses a test device with a locking section landslide river-plugging dam-forming mechanism, a control method and application, wherein the test device with the locking section landslide river-plugging dam-forming mechanism is provided with a landslide simulation platform which is used for providing a plane for landslide motion and fixing a rock mass for force measurement; a river simulation platform for simulating a river state; and the data acquisition platform is used for recording the experimental pictures of each stage and measuring the flow velocity of the water tank. The landslide simulation platform is provided with a sliding platform and a locking measurement module, and the locking measurement module is installed at the upper end of the sliding platform. The method has important scientific significance for disclosing the dam forming mechanism of the high-position landslide, and can provide scientific basis for the disaster prevention and reduction work of the problem of river blockage of the high-position landslide in the planning, construction and operation of national major projects.

title_en: Assessment method for assessing landslide disaster loss induced by climate change and falling water
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assessment method for assessing landslide disaster loss induced by climate change falling water, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining precipitation thresholds corresponding to all spatial lattice points in a region range with spatial heterogeneity by utilizing a physical process model and considering the spatial heterogeneity of the surface characteristics of all lattice points in the region; and then, combining historical data and climate mode data, optimizing a climate mode, and then simulating an easy-to-occur area and a possible rushing-out and influence area of the landslide by using the model, wherein the influence range simulated by using the method can be better matched with disaster damage grid point data, so that the problem that the climate change situation and landslide influence are difficult to evaluate in landslide disaster evaluation is solved.

title_en: Smart safety-integration control system
title_ko: 스마트 안전 통합 관제 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart safety integrated control method. The method, which is a smart safety integrated control method for a construction site performed by a control part of a smart safety integrated control server, comprises the following steps of: receiving at least one piece of construction information among a digital map, an equipment installation image, a construction environment image, and sensing data in regard to a construction site; mining data of the received construction information to establish a safety-related risk factor analysis scenario and a risk scenario; monitoring whether a disaster occurs in the construction site or whether an accident occurs therein in accordance with one of the established scenarios, and then, generating at least one piece of safety management information among a disaster occurrence notification, an accident notification, and a response guideline in accordance with a monitoring result; and controlling the operation of each facility in the construction site based on the generated safety management information. In accordance with the present invention, the smart safety integrated control method can improve big data-based data standardization system building technology with respect to various types of atypical data produced from the construction site, and can build and predict safety data of the construction site through the systematic classification of various accidents of the construction site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 스마트 안전 통합 관제 방법에 관한 것으로서, 상기 방법은, 스마트 안전 통합 관제 서버의 제어부에 의해서 수행되는 건설 현장의 스마트 안전 통합 관제 방법으로서, 어느 하나의 건설 현장에 대한 디지털 지도, 장비 탑재 영상, 시공 환경 영상 및 센싱 데이터 중 적어도 하나의 건설 정보를 수신하는 단계, 수신된 건설 정보를 데이터 마이닝하여 안전 관련 위험 요인 분석 시나리오 및 위험 시나리오를 수립하는 단계, 생성된 어느 하나의 시나리오에 따라 상기 건설 현장의 재해 발생 여부 또는 안전 사고 발생 여부를 모니터링하고, 모니터링 결과에 따라 재해 발생 알림, 안전 사고 알림 및 대응 지침 중 적어도 하나의 안전 관리 정보를 생성하는 단계 및 생성된 안전 관리 정보를 기초로 상기 건설 현장 내 각 설비의 동작을 제어하는 단계를 포함하도록 구성된다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 건설현장에서 생산되는 다양한 비정형 데이터에 대해 빅데이터 기반의 데이터 정형화 시스템 구축 기술 향상시키고, 건설현장의 다양한 안전사고에 대한 체계적인 분류를 통해 건설현장의 안전 데이터를 구축하고, 예측할 수 있다.

title_en: Wireless control trainer for firefighting training
title_ko: 훈련용 소방 트레이너
abstract_en: In accordance with one embodiment of the present invention, a wireless control firefighting trainer, which is provided to reproduce the scene of a fire for fire suppression training, includes: a travelling part including a wheel part travelling on a floor surface while kept supported by the floor surface, a frame part connected to an upper side of the wheel part and providing a flat installation space, a driving part driving the wheel part while kept placed on an upper side of the rear of the frame part, and a wheel control part changing a direction or a rotation speed of the wheel part in accordance with an inputted signal value; a flame generation part, while kept placed in the installation space, connected with the frame part, and generating flames upward; an extinguishing cover part connected with the frame part, and, while kept placed between the driving part and the flame generation part, moved to a cover position for covering the flame generation part and an opening position for opening the flame generation part; a firefighting part installed in the frame part, and extinguishing the flames generated from the flame generation part; a flame air-blast part formed on the edge of the frame part, and generating an air blast to the installation space; and a wind velocity setting part changing the intensity of the air blast from the flame air-blast part, while kept connected with the flame air-blast part. Therefore, the present invention is capable of preventing a fire-related accident by enabling practical fire suppression training.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 무선제어 소방 트레이너는, 화재진화 훈련을 위하여, 화재현장을 재연하는 훈련용 소방 트레이너에 있어서, 바닥면에 지지된 채 상기 바닥면을 주행하는 바퀴부, 상기 바퀴부에 상측에 연결되며, 편평한 설치공간을 제공하는 프레임부, 상기 프레임부의 후방 상측에 배치된 채, 상기 바퀴부를 구동시키는 구동부 및 입력된 신호값에 따라 상기 바퀴부의 방향 또는 회전속도를 변화시키는 바퀴제어부를 구비하는 주행부, 상기 설치공간에 배치된 채, 상기 프레임부에 연결되며, 상측을 향해 화염을 발생시키는 화염발생부, 상기 프레임부에 연결되되, 상기 구동부와 상기 화염발생부 사이에 배치된 채, 상기 화염발생부를 커버하는 커버위치와 상기 화염발생부를 개방하는 개방위치로 위치 이동되는 소화커버부, 상기 프레임부에 설치되며, 상기 화염발생부로부터 발생된 화염을 소화하는 소화부, 상기 프레임부의 테두리에 형성되며, 상기 설치공간으로 송풍을 발생시키는 화염송풍부 및 상기 화염송풍부에 연결된 채, 상기 화염송풍부에 의한 송풍 세기를 변화시키는 풍속설정부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Haptic interface of fire-fighting nozzle for virtual fire-fighting training and method thereof
title_ko: 가상 소방훈련을 위한 소방 관창 햅틱 인터페이스 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a firefighting nozzle haptic interface for virtual firefighting training and an operating method thereof. In accordance with one embodiment of the present invention, the firefighting nozzle haptic interface comprises: a processor acquiring an input value for controlling virtual reality (VR) content based on a gun-shaped firefighting nozzle controller for virtual firefighting training, providing the input value to the VR content, and providing haptic feedback corresponding to a sprinkling shape of water sprinkled in response to the input value from the VR content; and a memory storing the input value. The input value includes a rotation value of a rotary variable resistor provided in a waterproof lever and a distance value of an infrared distance sensor provided in a nozzle controller. Therefore, the present invention is capable of enabling firefighting training with high efficiency and high immersion.
abstract_ko: 가상 소방훈련을 위한 소방 관창 햅틱 인터페이스 및 그 동작 방법 이 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 소방 관창 인터페이스는 가상 소방훈련을 위한 권총형 소방 관창 컨트롤러를 기반으로 VR(Virtual Reality) 컨텐츠를 제어하기 위한 입력값을 획득하고, 상기 입력값을 상기 VR 컨텐츠로 제공하고, 상기 VR 컨텐츠에서 상기 입력값에 대응하여 분사되는 물의 분사 형태에 상응하게 햅틱 피드백을 제공하는 프로세서; 및 상기 입력값을 저장하는 메모리를 포함하고, 상기 입력값은 방수 레버에 구비된 회전형 가변저항의 회전값 및 노즐 조절기에 구비된 적외선 거리센서의 거리값을 포함한다.

title_en: Multi-target fire scene temperature prediction method based on distributed optical fiber temperature measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target fire scene temperature prediction method based on distributed optical fiber temperature measurement, which comprises three parts of building a space fire scene temperature database, acquiring actual fire scene temperature data and predicting the multi-target fire scene temperature, and specifically comprises the following steps: in the space fire scene temperature database building part, according to the building type and related scene of the targets, collecting different space sizes and ventilation opening sizes of the building types of the targets so as to build a building space information model; then FDS simulation is carried out; extracting area and plane temperature data related to personnel evacuation, fire hazard and structural safety from a simulation result, and establishing a space fire scene temperature database after integration to provide a data base for multi-target temperature prediction of a fire scene; determining the real-time air temperature at the ceiling height and the human body characteristic height range in the actual fire scene temperature data acquisition part; in the multi-target temperature prediction part of the fire scene, the multi-target temperature prediction model is established, so that early warning, monitoring and feedback of the whole process of the fire scene are realized.

title_en: Fireman body function assessment method, medium, equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, medium, equipment and system for evaluating body functions of firefighters, which are used for completing daily training of firefighters with different characteristics, setting random stimulus and obtaining feedback, and completing acquisition of static and dynamic body functions of firefighters by using a human body function perception detection device, so as to realize tracking of the body functions of firefighters under any characteristic and finally obtain dynamic evaluation of the body functions of any firefighters. The invention enables the physical function assessment of the firefighter to be more scientific, the assessment standard to be more in accordance with objective rules, the invention is suitable for the actual situation of the firefighter at present, meets the scientific and authoritative assessment requirements of the firefighter, provides powerful guarantee for the fight safety of the firefighter in the fire fighting mission, not only fully knows the physical function situation of the firefighter, but also plays an active role in stimulating the physical training of the firefighter, helps the firefighter to better solve the difficulties encountered in the rescue mission, obtains ideal fire rescue effect, and reduces the loss and injury caused by disaster.

title_en: BIM-based constructor evacuation route selection method and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a BIM-based constructor evacuation route selection method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a BIM (building information modeling) model of a construction site in a target period; acquiring constructor parameters in a target period, and importing the constructor parameters into a BIM (building information modeling) model to obtain an evacuation model; respectively determining various evacuation routes in all existing evacuation routes in an evacuation model as initial evacuation routes according to the types of the dangerous events; and performing simulation on the determined multiple initial evacuation routes to obtain multiple simulation results respectively corresponding to the multiple initial evacuation routes, and taking the initial evacuation route corresponding to one simulation result as a target evacuation route. There is also provided a computer apparatus for performing the BIM-based constructor evacuation route selection method described above. The BIM technology is adopted, so that the reliability and the accuracy of simulation are improved; in addition, aiming at the centralized selection of the key areas, the computing resources are saved, the cost is low, and the efficiency is high.
assignees: SOUTH IF SCIENCE AND TECH CHONGQING GROUP LIMITED COMPANY;ZISHEN CHONGQING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY;SOUTH IF INTELLIGENT MAN CHONGQING BIG DATA LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Equipment disaster accident prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting equipment disaster accidents, which comprises the following steps: (1) Collecting a historical case of power transmission line accidents under natural disasters; (2) Constructing an ontology model of a natural disaster knowledge graph of the power grid; (3) Constructing a historical power grid natural disaster knowledge graph based on the historical cases and the ontology model; (4) Obtaining a low-dimensional embedded vector representation of each entity in a natural disaster knowledge graph of a historical power grid by adopting a self-attention network bi-directional compiling representation model, wherein the low-dimensional embedded vector representation of all the entities in each historical case forms a feature matrix of the historical case; (5) Constructing a graph convolution neural network, and training the feature matrix of each historical case by taking the feature matrix of each historical case as the input of the graph convolution neural network to obtain model parameters of an accident probability prediction model; (6) When the prediction is carried out, the feature matrix of the case to be predicted is input into a trained graph convolution neural network, so that the occurrence probability of different accident types can be obtained.

title_en: Investment decision-making auxiliary analysis method of large-screen simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an investment decision auxiliary analysis method of a large-screen-end simulation system, which comprises an auxiliary decision support system and an investment decision auxiliary analysis method, wherein the auxiliary decision support system consists of a military industry core capability construction decision support system, a military industry supply chain safety controllable and emergency response decision support system, a military industry strategic planning major problem decision support system, a military and civil science and technology industry fusion development decision support system, a military industry investment decision support system and a project evaluation system; the core capacity of the military enterprise is displayed through the large screen end, meanwhile, the enterprise meeting the screening condition is comprehensively ranked, during the period, through the side key point of decision, the enterprise meeting the project investment can be contrastively analyzed, the final comprehensive evaluation is obtained, and meanwhile, a decision maker can learn the specific information of the side key point of decision through the ranking analysis of each item, so that the effect of comprehensively and visually knowing the specific information of ranking evaluation is achieved.
assignees: STATE DEFENSE SCIENCE AND TECH INDUSTRY BUREAU MILITARY PROJECT AUDITING CENTER;CHINESE INFORMATION COMMUNICATION RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Method and system for providing adaptive SOP according to emergent situation during SOP training
title_ko: 훈련 중 상황에 따른 적응적 sop 제공방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: A method and a system for providing an adaptive standard operation procedure (SOP) according to situations during training are disclosed. A method for providing an adaptive SOP according to situations during training according to an aspect of the present invention includes the steps of: storing an SOP performed in the event of a disaster by an adaptive SOP providing the SOP, which is a response procedure in case of a disaster; receiving, by the adaptive SOP providing system, emergency situation occurrence information about an emergency situation during disaster situation response training according to the SOP; and determining training progress information including information on whether or not to continue the response training, whether or not to modify the SOP when the response training is continued, or a modified SOP when the SOP is modified on the basis of the emergency situation occurrence information received by the adaptive SOP providing system. The step of determining training progress information including information on whether or not to continue the response training, whether or not to modify the SOP when the response training is continued, or a modified SOP when the SOP is modified on the basis of the emergency situation occurrence information received by the adaptive SOP providing system includes a step of determining, by the adaptive SOP providing system, the training progress information on the basis of the attribute of the emergency situation, wherein the attribute includes whether or not the emergency situation is a virtual/real situation or the type of the emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 훈련 중 상황에 따른 적응적 SOP 제공방법 및 그 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 훈련 중 상황에 따른 적응적 SOP 제공방법은 재난시의 대응절차인 SOP(Standard Operation Procedure)를 제공하는 적응적 SOP 제공시스템이 재난 발생 시에 수행되는 SOP를 저장하는 단계, 상기 적응적 SOP 제공시스템이 상기 SOP에 따른 재난상황의 대응훈련 중에 돌발상황에 대한 돌발상황 발생정보를 입력받는 단계, 상기 적응적 SOP 제공시스템이 입력받은 상기 돌발상황 발생정보에 기초하여 상기 대응훈련의 지속여부, 상기 대응훈련을 지속할 경우의 상기 SOP의 수정여부, 또는 상기 SOP의 수정시의 수정 SOP에 대한 정보를 포함하는 훈련진행정보를 결정하는 단계를 포함하며, 상기 적응적 SOP 제공시스템이 입력받은 상기 돌발상황 발생정보에 기초하여 상기 대응훈련의 지속여부, 상기 대응훈련을 지속할 경우의 상기 SOP의 수정여부, 또는 상기 SOP의 수정시의 수정 SOP에 대한 정보를 포함하는 훈련진행정보를 결정하는 단계는, 상기 적응적 SOP 제공시스템이 상기 돌발상황의 속성-상기 속성은 상기 돌발상황이 가상/실제상황인지 여부 또는 돌발상황의 종류를 포함함-에 기초하여 상기 훈련진행정보를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UNE CO LTD;PARK NAM HEE;YEO WOOK HYUN

title_en: Formula of jettisoninging GNSS monitoring facilities
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of geological disaster monitoring, and particularly relates to a throwing type GNSS monitoring device which comprises a device main body, a flange and a fixing unit; the flange is arranged at the bottom end of the equipment main body; the fixing unit is arranged at the bottom end of the equipment main body; the fixing unit comprises a bolt fixing column, a first nut, a ground drilling anchor rod and an installation mechanism; the utility model adopts modularized splicing, can be assembled when leaving factory, and can be independently transported to a monitoring place for use, thereby being beneficial to long-distance transportation.
assignees: SHENZHEN BEIDOU CLOUD INFORMATION TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Ocean passenger ship personnel emergency evacuation path planning algorithm based on virtual nodes
abstract_en: The invention provides a planning algorithm for personnel emergency evacuation paths of ocean-going passenger vessels based on virtual nodes, which solves the problems of balanced personnel exit distribution under the condition of a plurality of exits in the passenger vessel evacuation process and simulation of the ordered evacuation process. Because the passenger ship has a plurality of symmetrical outlets, the efficiency of adopting the straight line distance to judge the straight line is low, and the problem of low path quality is easily caused. According to the invention, based on the node network map, virtual nodes are introduced on the basis of the original map node network, the nodes are connected with all outlets, the virtual nodes are used as target nodes, all outlets are used as intermediate nodes, algorithm searching is performed, the searching time of the algorithm is reduced, on the basis, the problem of uneven personnel distribution is solved, the virtual nodes are dynamically updated, and the problem of uneven personnel distribution of multiple outlets is further solved. And finally, constructing a social force model based on a guiding path, simulating the evacuation process of the crowd, and dynamically reflecting the evacuation track of the personnel to effectively guide the evacuation.

title_en: Snake-shaped curve highway tunnel fire simulation test platform system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire safety of highway tunnels, in particular to a snake-shaped curve highway tunnel fire simulation test platform system. The method is used for researching the distribution rule of the temperature field in the tunnel when a fire disaster occurs at a typical fire disaster position, the smoke diffusion characteristic and the corresponding disaster prevention control method. The system comprises: the system comprises a snake-shaped curve highway tunnel model, a fire longitudinal ventilation system and a test system; the fire longitudinal ventilation system provides longitudinal ventilation conditions for the snake-shaped curve highway tunnel model; the testing system is arranged around the snake-shaped curve road tunnel model and used for collecting some relevant data. Through a large amount of data obtained by real-time monitoring, on one hand, the diffusion characteristics of fire smoke of the snake-shaped curve tunnel and corresponding disaster prevention control measures can be visually analyzed, on the other hand, important data bases and scientific supports can be provided for follow-up evacuation design of fire personnel, arrangement of smoke prevention and exhaust structures of the tunnel and the like, and the method has great guiding significance for fire suppression and personnel evacuation of the tunnel.
assignees: SOUTHWEST TRAFFIC UNIV;SICHUAN PROVINCE INST OF TRAFFIC RECONNAISSANCE AND DESIGN LTD

title_en: Geological disaster displacement monitoring device based on geological analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological detection devices, in particular to a geological disaster displacement monitoring device based on geological analysis, which comprises a circular shell, the top of the circular shell is provided with a group of circular fixing plates, the top of each circular fixing plate is provided with a plurality of groups of monitoring assemblies, the centers of the monitoring assemblies are provided with a group of driving assemblies, the drilling assembly is arranged below the monitoring assembly, the device can monitor different depths and different positions of the geology to be detected in real time under the action of the monitoring assembly, and the device can drill the geology under the action of the stabilizing assemblies, the device can be kept stable, the device is prevented from shifting during drilling, and the device can be fixed through the drill pipe, so that the device is prevented from moving in the monitoring process, and the monitoring result is more accurate.

title_en: Light sensing receiver
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting drilling equipment, and particularly discloses a light sensing receiver which comprises a bottom plate, a simulation box arranged on the bottom plate and a controller arranged in the simulation box, wherein a plurality of LED lamps, fans and alarms for simulating fire disaster are arranged in the simulation box, a plurality of through grooves are formed in the top of the simulation box, a baffle is further arranged on the side wall of the top of the simulation box, a detection groove is formed in the outer wall of the baffle, a light sensor capable of detecting appointed light is further arranged in the detection groove, a plurality of water passing grooves are uniformly formed in the side wall of the simulation box, a collection box communicated with the water passing grooves is arranged in the simulation box, a pressure sensor is arranged between the collection box and the bottom of the simulation box, and the LED lamps, the fans, the alarms, the light sensors and the pressure sensor are all electrically connected with the controller.
assignees: NANCHANG HONGCHENG YIDA SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Treatment method for hypoxia problem in short-distance coal seam group stoping process
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for treating a hypoxia problem in a short-distance coal seam group extraction process, belongs to the technical field of underground disaster prevention and control, and comprises the following steps of arranging a drilling site at a return air side for drilling: the upper drill hole is arranged at the lower part of the upper adjacent coal seam goaf and is used for intercepting the hypoxic gas which is leaked to a stoping area from the upper goaf; the top drill hole is arranged at the upper part of a top plate at the air return side of the main coal mining layer and is used for extracting low-oxygen gas at the air return side and the upper corner area of the stope face; and the lower drill hole is arranged at the lower part of the bottom plate of the working face and is used for pumping the low-oxygen gas which is adjacent to the coal seam and flows to a stoping area. On the basis of analyzing the characteristics and the source rules of the low-oxygen gas in the upper corner area and the return air side area of the working face, a large-diameter directional drilling construction technology is applied, the drilling arrangement mode is optimized, the extraction parameters of different types of drilled holes are adjusted, the accurate extraction of the large-diameter drilled holes to the gas of different sources of the working face is realized, and the low-oxygen problem in the working face extraction process is efficiently solved.
assignees: LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY OF SHANXI SHANXI COAL GROUP TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Mobile fire escape training device and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile fire escape training device and a control method, comprises a movable box body device, a running belt device, a multi-surface display system device and a hot air blower device. The user finishes learning in the mobile box body device, the multi-face display system device generates a fire scene with multiple faces looking around, the user performs simulated fire emergency response escape training according to the scene, the user stands on the running belt device to walk or run, the fire scene moves along with the movement of the running belt device, the hot air blower device blows hot air in a fire escape passing area of the user, and the user finally escapes from a dangerous area according to different routes of the fire. The mobile fire escape training device and the control method are simple in structure, flexible in operation and movement, and capable of enabling a user to learn how to escape in emergency, especially in high-rise fire and immersive experience in a sudden fire scene, meanwhile, the user can learn while running, physical exercise and learning are combined, learning of fire escape is achieved effectively and vividly, and more interactive, interesting and sporty learning experience is provided for people.

title_en: BP neural network-based power distribution network extreme disaster power outage prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention of power grids, and particularly relates to a power failure prediction method and system under extreme disasters of a power distribution network based on a BP neural network. The prediction method comprises the following steps of obtaining body parameters, extreme disaster types, weather parameters, running state parameters and power failure time after faults occur according to a power distribution network extreme disaster history fault sample library, collecting weather parameters and running state parameters which do not occur under the same body parameters under the extreme disasters, carrying out numerical pretreatment on all the parameters and integrating the parameters into a training sample library, training the power failure probability and the power failure time of the training sample library by adopting a BP neural network method, and establishing a power failure prediction model under the power distribution network extreme disasters based on the BP neural network. The method and the system realize the prediction of the power failure probability and the power failure duration of the power distribution network under extreme disasters, and are suitable for disaster prevention and disaster reduction of the power distribution network under various complex extreme disasters.

title_en: High-prestress energy absorption control design method for coal mine dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-prestress energy absorption control design method for coal mine dynamic disasters, and relates to the technical field of underground engineering safety. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring while-drilling parameters and performance parameters of a target support member in the drilling process of the surrounding rock of the roadway; determining surrounding rock accumulated energy corresponding to the unit length of the roadway according to the while-drilling parameters; determining the minimum energy absorption amount of the target supporting member according to the performance parameters; and determining design parameters of the target supporting member in the unit length of the roadway according to the surrounding rock accumulated energy corresponding to the unit length of the roadway, the minimum energy absorption amount of the target supporting member, the energy absorption amounts of other supporting members in the unit length of the roadway stored in advance, a preset safety coefficient, preset critical energy for the occurrence of the dynamic disaster and a preset supporting length of the section of the roadway. The invention can reduce the risk of coal mine dynamic disaster.
assignees: CHINESE MINING UNIV BEIJING;BEIJING LIHI SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety emergency management command and dispatch system
abstract_en: The invention provides a safety emergency management commanding and dispatching system, which comprises: the system management platform is used for judging whether the user account can acquire the system authority and managing the corresponding user account; the system comprises a pre-investigation platform, a pre-investigation monitoring platform and a pre-investigation monitoring platform, wherein the pre-investigation platform is used for acquiring and analyzing a statistical result of daily guard and sending an early warning instruction based on the analysis result; the resource management platform is used for collecting emergency resource information and combining the emergency resource information with the geographic information platform to obtain a resource management result; the emergency decision platform is used for generating an optimal dispatching scheme and a field dispatching instruction when the early warning instruction or the alarm instruction is received; the multi-disk evaluation platform is used for determining corresponding emergency whole-process data based on the monitoring video, performing multi-disk drilling based on the emergency whole-process data and generating an emergency command disposal evaluation report table based on the result of the multi-disk drilling; the method is used for realizing situation control, dynamic perception, disaster situation accurate decision, visual dynamic display of emergency resources and emergency reply simulation of dangerous situations.
assignees: CHINESE SAFETY PRODUCTION SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE;ADVANCED RES AND REPAIR COLLEGE OF STATE DRUG ADMINISTRATION STATE DRUG ADMINISTRATION SAFETY EMERGE;JIANGXI PROVINCE EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Tent snow load detection device and detection method under complex disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting tent snow load in a complex disaster environment, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining the type of the tent in the complex disaster environment; s2, performing a tent snow load simulation test in a complex disaster environment, and determining stress conditions under different combined loads; and S3, detecting different tent snow loads according to the types, and determining the snow loads capable of being borne by the tent according to comparison with the stress conditions under different combined loads. Also disclosed are a detection device for the tent snow load in a complex disaster environment, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium.
assignees: XINGHUA SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT LIMITED COMPANY;XINGHUA GROUP LTD COMPANY

title_en: Tunnel damage assessment method under fire disaster-explosion based on particle method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating tunnel damage under fire-explosion based on a particle method. The method includes the steps of simulating an explosion effect after a fire in a tunnel by using a material point method program, considering a high-temperature effect of the fire in the tunnel by reducing the compression strength and the elastic modulus of a concrete lining structure, establishing the material point method program on the basis of the simulation, introducing HJC constitutive models to a material point method source program, simulating large deformation and dynamic response of concrete under the action of fire-explosion impact, outputting a structural damage factor cloud picture of the tunnel structure after the explosion disaster, drawing a damage degree grade picture of the tunnel structure under the fire-explosion, determining the damage degree grade of the tunnel structure under the fire-explosion according to the damage factor cloud picture, providing theoretical support for determining key indexes of the fire-explosion interlocking type disaster, and providing support for emergency response of facility interlocking type disasters on an underground basis.

title_en: Path correction method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a path correction method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which relate to the technical field of virtual reality and comprise the steps of establishing a navigation grid for an evacuation scene and planning a global path of people to be evacuated; extracting path key points, and correcting local evacuation routes according to the road section length and pedestrian density; calculating the moving speed and direction; moving to a target point, and carrying out route re-correction when environmental change occurs; until the safe exit is reached, a corrected path is obtained. On one hand, the navigation grid is utilized to update and embody the state change of the station personnel to the dynamic obstacle, and the response of the passenger to the interactive virtual environment is embodied; on the other hand, a road section evaluation function of the path and the density is established, a passenger carries out route adjustment according to the environmental information in the view field range, and the movement process fully considers the panic factors and the influence of other pedestrians to carry out dynamic adjustment of the movement speed and the movement direction.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for verifying recovery point target of double-activity disaster recovery system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for verifying a recovery point target of a double-activity disaster recovery system, which are used for solving the technical problems of efficiency and universality of PRO verification of the recovery point target of the double-activity disaster recovery system. The method comprises the steps of recording service data into a storage system through script simulation on a selected virtual machine VM, detecting the accessibility of the selected VM continuously at an arbitration node, simulating host machine or site faults to enable the system to realize fault transfer of the selected VM, and verifying whether a double-activity disaster recovery system PRO meets the requirement or not by analyzing and comparing the last timestamp written in the selected VM before fault transfer and the timestamp of the last accessibility detection result recorded by the arbitration node before the selected VM transfers. The technical scheme of the invention does not need to pay attention to the underlying storage technology, can cover the scene of sudden occurrence of the fault in the process of writing the service data by the virtual machine, is simple and easy to use, and has certain universality.
assignees: XINHUA THREE BIG DATA TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Emergency plan desktop deduction system for emergency
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency plan desktop deduction system for an emergency, which comprises a deduction device, wherein the deduction device is provided with a deduction software platform; wherein, deduction software platform includes: the basic information management module, the guiding module, the deduction module and the evaluation module; the basic information management module is used for receiving input information input by a user and calling corresponding emergency events and emergency plans from the database according to the input information; the guiding and adjusting module is used for receiving first event information input by a user after desktop deduction begins, and loading an event cause of an emergency; the deduction module is used for receiving a first response operation input by a user according to the requirement of the emergency plan and directly responding to the cause of the event; and the evaluation module is used for determining the response score value of the response. Through the method and the device, the user can intuitively acquire the effectiveness of self emergency response operation, the emergency response capability of emergency personnel is improved, and the effect of emergency desktop drilling is enhanced.
assignees: BEIJING HUAIYUAN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guiding evacuation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guide evacuation system and method, and belongs to the technical field of virtual simulation. The invention senses the environment by setting the number and the initial position of the robots, intelligently searches and rescues the indoor trapped people in disaster situations, collects the real-time three-dimensional image data of the scene, makes decision analysis and transmits the surrounding environment information to the scene rescue personnel in time. The evacuation method provided by the invention adopts the robot to perform simulation training, relies on a virtual reality technology, optimizes the evacuation path through an improved path planning algorithm, creates a more realistic evacuation environment and character reconstruction model, improves the evacuation efficiency, and can better simulate the real evacuation process, thereby providing references for effectively reducing casualties in personnel evacuation and establishing an optimal rescue scheme, having certain practical guiding significance, and being worth popularizing and using.

title_en: Emergency command center safety informationized early warning method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an emergency command center safety informationization early warning method and system, belonging to the technical field of emergency commands. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a displayed map; acquiring environmental information of a detection point on the map, and determining current fire spreading condition simulation data of the detection point according to the environmental information and the fire spreading speed corresponding to the area where the detection point is located; determining the current required number of firefighters corresponding to the current fire spreading condition simulation data based on a preset firefighter number demand model; and determining the number of reserved firemen early warning persons according to the number of the firemen currently needed. The safety information early warning method and system for the emergency command center can simulate the fire spreading condition, estimate the fire grade and reduce possible disasters caused by fire.
assignees: ANHUI SUTONG INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Power distribution network strong wind disaster early warning method based on PCA model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid disaster prevention, and particularly relates to a power distribution network storm disaster early warning method based on a PCA model, which comprises the following steps of acquiring body parameters, refined meteorological parameters and running state parameters when faults occur according to a historical fault sample library to form a training sample set; fitting the outage duration of a training sample set by adopting a multiple regression method, establishing a power outage duration prediction model based on multiple regression, obtaining main components of related multiple parameters in the multiple regression training process by adopting a PCA model, extracting the main component parameters, establishing a power outage duration prediction model of the power distribution network disaster damage based on PCA, carrying out SVM classification on the power outage duration of the power distribution network disaster damage, and early warning the power distribution network disaster damage based on the prediction model and the SVM classification obtained by training. The early warning method of the invention realizes the early warning of the disaster damage of the strong wind based on the statistical method, and is suitable for disaster prevention and disaster reduction of the power distribution network with complex conditions.

title_en: Engineering management platform based on BIM technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM technology-based engineering management platform, which comprises a building module, a monitoring module, an age assessment scale, a maintenance module, a disaster simulation module, a display module, a maintenance module, a budget module and a partition module, wherein the building module is used for building a building; the building module is used for building a building model according to the actual building information; the building information can be obtained by a building contractor; the monitoring module is used for monitoring a local area of the building, transmitting the local area to the building module in real time, and checking the local area by clicking a corresponding area on the building model; the age assessment module is used for analyzing the service life of the building according to the data provided by the building model; and the troubleshooting module is used for troubleshooting various problems which can occur to the building. On the building model with building live-action transmission through monitoring module, when needs, can easily observe the vulnerable region of those buildings and the region of originally inconvenient looking over, so can in time discover the problem that the building exists, practice thrift the manual detection cost, improve the management efficiency.

title_en: Personnel evacuation time prediction method and device, storage medium and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of personnel evacuation data processing, and particularly relates to a personnel evacuation time prediction method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a terminal device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring scene data of a target evacuation scene; processing scene data of the target evacuation scene by using a preset evacuation time prediction model to obtain personnel evacuation time in the target evacuation scene; the evacuation time prediction model is a neural network model obtained through training of a preset evacuation data set, the evacuation data set comprises evacuation samples respectively corresponding to various preset designated evacuation scenes, and each evacuation sample comprises scene data of one designated evacuation scene and corresponding personnel evacuation time. By the method and the device, the accurate mapping relation between the scene data and the personnel evacuation time is established in the model, the higher accuracy is kept, the calculated amount is greatly reduced, and the calculation time is shortened.

title_en: BIM-based fire emergency plan deduction method for subway station
abstract_en: The invention provides a BIM-based subway station fire emergency plan deduction method, which comprises the following steps: selecting a subway station building needing to make an emergency plan; building a BIM model of the subway station building; calling the BIM model to simulate the distribution of fire source points, the distribution of fire smoke and the personnel evacuation condition in the subway station building; formulating the emergency plan according to a simulation result, and configuring a response logic for the emergency plan; and when the fire hazard meets the preset condition, calling the emergency plan for processing. The method for deducing the fire emergency plan of the subway station establishes a three-dimensional parameterized entity information model of a subway station building based on the BIM technology, performs smoke simulation and personnel evacuation simulation of fire combustion on the entity model, compares simulation results of the smoke simulation and the personnel evacuation simulation, and formulates the plan according to the simulation results, so that the method has higher intelligent degree and better effect.
assignees: GUANGZHOU INST OF SUBWAY DESIGN LTD COMPANY

title_en: Target layering double-perception domain-based reinforcement learning unmanned vehicle path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target layered double-perception domain-based unmanned vehicle path planning method for reinforcement learning, which fully considers the dynamic constraint of unmanned vehicles; reducing the dimension of the map area by setting a sub-target level; enabling the sub-target layer to be positioned in the middle of the safety zone through a target layering method; the method comprises the steps that observation input is reduced by setting a double perception domain comprising an obstacle perception domain and a target discovery domain, and obstacle perception and target discovery are decoupled separately; and the unmanned vehicle route planning based on the deep reinforcement learning of the target layered double perception domains is realized. The method can be suitable for maps with different dimensions, avoids dimension disaster in training, has high calculation efficiency and strong applicability, and can meet the actual requirement of real-time path planning.

title_en: Crop lodging unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a crop lodging unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring method and device, comprising the following steps: determining unmanned aerial vehicle images of target crops in a target plot; acquiring a target vegetation index and target texture characteristics of a target plot according to the target crop unmanned aerial vehicle image; inputting the target vegetation index and the target texture feature into a lodging grade classification model, and determining the lodging grade of the target crop in the target plot output by the lodging grade classification model; the lodging grade classification model is obtained based on sample vegetation indexes, sample texture features and sample lodging grade training corresponding to the sample vegetation indexes and the sample texture features. According to the crop lodging unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring method and device, the vegetation index and the textural features of the target plot are determined by the unmanned aerial vehicle, rapid extraction of the plot scale crop lodging disaster severity grade can be achieved, and reliable information support is provided for supporting of agricultural disaster relief technologies, improvement of corn varieties and rapid settlement of agricultural insurance.
assignees: INFORMATION TECH RESEARCH CENTER OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY ACADEMY OF SCIENCES IN

title_en: Evaluation method for hail impact resistance of tower-type solar heliostat structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating hail impact resistance of a tower-type solar heliostat structure, which comprises the steps of acquiring historical hail recording information acquired by each ground meteorological station, and calculating hail intensity indexes corresponding to the historical hail recording information based on preset evaluation index factors; performing hail disaster risk assessment based on each hail intensity index to generate a hail disaster risk assessment result; and constructing a limited element model of the hail impact heliostat, and simulating and calculating the numerical value of the hail impact heliostat in a target area in the limited element model of the hail impact heliostat according to the evaluation result of the hail disaster danger to obtain the heliostat structure recommendation parameters. According to the method, numerical simulation of hail impact on the heliostat is carried out, structural parameters of the heliostat can be reasonably recommended according to evaluation results of different dangerous areas, so that hail disaster risks can be effectively avoided during operation of the heliostat, and normal and stable use of the heliostat is guaranteed.

title_en: Positive fault blasting method for fully mechanized excavation face through hard rock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-mechanized excavation face hard rock positive fault blasting method, which comprises the following steps: s1, intercepting effective stress cloud charts of the numerical model at different moments according to the numerical simulation calculation result, and carrying out comparative analysis; s2, constructing a coal rock model to carry out a blasting simulation experiment; s3, calculating the structural zone control range according to the positive fault fall; s4, arranging energy-gathering blasting holes and control holes on the fault working face according to blasting specifications; s5, arranging the energy gathering direction of the energy gathering blasting; s6, filling the energy-gathered cartridges into the blast holes to realize directional blasting; s7, adopting a positive charging mode to charge; and S8, blasting and weakening hard rock to finish the tunneling of the fully mechanized excavating machine. The invention can safely and quickly burst the hard rock normal fault, preferentially burst the hard rock in an energy-gathered blasting mode in the normal fault construction area, has good rock mass weakening and roadway supporting effect, effectively solves the problem of dynamic disasters such as instability of surrounding rock caused by common blasting disturbance and the like, and enables roadway tunneling to be safely and efficiently carried out.

title_en: Tunnel surrounding rock pressure arch calculation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel surrounding rock pressure arch calculation method and system, comprising the steps of constructing a discontinuous calculation model, setting fixed points, loading points, monitoring points, joint parameters, hole parameters and ground stress parameter information of the calculation model according to actual conditions of a simulation project, constructing the discontinuous calculation model, carrying out discontinuous deformation calculation analysis, simulating surrounding rock block deformation and a movement process after tunnel excavation is completed based on a discontinuous deformation analysis method, selecting stress map key points to draw a scatter diagram, analyzing tunnel surrounding rock stress distribution characteristics after tunnel surrounding rock is stabilized, selecting upper and lower boundary key points in the stress map, drawing the scatter diagram, carrying out curve fitting and correction, and determining the range of a tunnel pressure arch through pressure arch boundary lines at the upper and lower edges. The pressure arch range formed by the collapse of the tunnel in discontinuous geological environments such as the broken belt is more accurately determined, so that the design of the tunnel structure and the adoption of engineering measures are more reasonable, and a basis is provided for the prevention and control of the collapse disasters of the surrounding rocks of the tunnel.

title_en: Fire disaster video smoke identification method based on time-space domain double channels
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire disaster video smoke identification method based on time-space domain two-channel, which comprises the following steps: collecting and making a smoke data set containing cloud and fog interference; building a static characteristic extraction network and a dynamic characteristic extraction network, and fusing and connecting the static characteristic extraction network and the dynamic characteristic extraction network to construct a video smoke identification network model; training the video smoke recognition network model by using a smoke data set to obtain an optimized video smoke recognition network model; the optimized network model is utilized to process the smoke video collected in real time, the static feature extraction network extracts the static features of the image in a space domain, the dynamic feature extraction network extracts the dynamic features of the video in a time domain, the static features and the dynamic features are fused to generate smoke features, and the smoke features are identified to judge whether smoke exists. The invention has higher accuracy and recall rate and lower false alarm rate, and can effectively identify and early warn the smoke in real time.

title_en: Visible light image and infrared image fusion method based on radiation characteristic inversion
abstract_en: A visible light image and infrared image fusion method based on radiation characteristic inversion belongs to the technical field of optical image processing, and specifically comprises the following steps of firstly utilizing multispectral visible light image inversion to calculate the total spectral reflection characteristic of ground objects in a scene, secondly utilizing infrared image inversion to calculate the thermal radiation characteristic of the ground objects in the scene, thirdly fusing the total spectral reflection characteristic of the ground objects and the thermal radiation characteristic of the ground objects to obtain a high-resolution infrared scene, reconstructing the infrared image through full-link simulation, and fourthly establishing a degradation relation between a real high-resolution infrared image and an actual measurement low-resolution infrared image, and correcting a reconstruction simulation result by utilizing the actual measurement infrared image to obtain a high-fidelity high-resolution infrared image. The invention can provide high-resolution image data for surface analysis, environment monitoring, disaster prevention and control and the like, and simultaneously provides characteristic prior and data input for research of related detection and identification methods.

title_en: Industrial fire accident simulation system based on virtual reality and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial fire accident simulation system based on virtual reality and a using method thereof, the system comprises a simulation escape device, VR equipment and a controller, wherein the VR equipment is worn on a user body to enable the user to be in a scene of a simulated working fire accident, the simulation escape device comprises a fixed field, a plurality of splicing boxes are arranged inside the fixed field, electronic doors are arranged around the splicing boxes, according to any training scene selected by a user in VR equipment, a plurality of splicing boxes are driven to move in a fixed field, and an escape channel matched with the selected training scene is constructed by opening and closing an electronic door, the invention enters a simulated escape channel formed by splicing a plurality of splicing boxes through an entrance and an exit of the user, and the VR equipment is utilized to simulate the industrial fire accident scene, the creeping forward gesture of the user is detected through the infrared emitter and the infrared sensor, so that an environment for learning the processing experience when a fire disaster occurs is provided for the user.
assignees: NINGXIAAN LETTER ENGINEERING DESIGN LTD COMPANY

title_en: Estimation method for expected and actual escape direction deflection angle under fire background of public place
abstract_en: The expected movement direction in the original social force model is improved by using the calculated off angle, so that the actual movement track of pedestrian evacuation when the fire disaster occurs is realized. The method comprises the following steps: formulating pedestrian evacuation rules and giving out the definition of the deflection angle of the expected movement direction and the actual evacuation movement direction of the pedestrians caused by panic emotion; determining a key factor affecting the deflection angle; acquiring internal structure information and exit information of an area to be evacuated; acquiring basic information and distribution information of personnel in an area to be evacuated; acquiring the dangerous degree of a fire disaster occurrence area; generalized entropy function calculation; calculating a deviation angle; and determining the actual moving direction of the pedestrians, and finally performing simulation. The method realizes the true motion trail of pedestrian evacuation when fire disaster occurs, can provide decision support for pedestrian evacuation simulation, and has certain reference value for more complete simulation of evacuation situations and evacuation management in the crowd evacuation process.

title_en: Agricultural disaster monitoring method and system based on satellite remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for monitoring agricultural disasters based on satellite remote sensing images, which comprises the following steps: (1) a first image is obtained, wherein each pixel point of the first image is an n-dimensional vector [ f1, f2, f3,. talka., fn ], and each value in the vector corresponds to a band1, a band2, a band3, … and a band; (2) determining the number of categories, namely determining the number h of categories to be generated; (3) a first model training step, wherein each pixel point in a first image is input into a Gaussian mixture model GMM to be trained to obtain a second image, and each pixel of the second image is assigned with a pixel value, wherein the pixel value is in a category from 1 to h; the method has the advantages that places suspected of diseases and insect pests in the satellite images can be found quickly, agricultural personnel can mark the places with the diseases and insect pests on the images quickly only by simple selection, workload of people is reduced to a great extent, omission is not prone to occurring, and a technical basis is provided for accurate management of agriculture.
assignees: SHANDONG ORIGIN INFORMATION TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Water-rich karst area blasting simulation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water-rich karst area blasting simulation system, which comprises a simulation sample, a simulation karst cave, a mud injection channel and a water delivery channel, wherein the simulation sample is provided with at least one blast hole; when the karst cave inner cavity is filled with the mud-water mixture, the mud injection channel is filled with closed concrete for isolating the karst cave inner cavity from the outside. By adopting the technical scheme, the condition of water inrush and mud inrush of the water-rich karst area under high-speed dynamic load operation is simulated, the theory and the test are disclosed, the mechanical characteristics and the evolution rule of the water-rich karst structure in the instantaneous damage process are disclosed, and an effective basis is provided for the research of the mechanism of the water inrush disaster of the tunnel; meanwhile, the structure is simple, and the device is economical and practical.
assignees: MIDDLE ROAD BRIDGE SOUTH CHINA ENG CO LTD

title_en: Disaster responding system and method thereof
title_ko: 재난 관리 시스템 및 제어 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a disaster management system. The disaster management system includes a server storing a list of standard operation procedures (SOP) by institution and a terminal device. The server generates a training scenario for a disaster type and disaster situation, transmits information on the SOP corresponding to the generated training scenario, and receives processing data from the terminal device to store training history information including the generated training scenario, the transmitted information on the SOP, and the received processing data.
abstract_ko: 재난 관리 시스템이 개시된다. 본 재난 관리 시스템은 조직별로 SOP(Standard Operation Procedures) 리스트를 저장하는 서버, 및 단말 장치를 포함하고, 서버는, 재난 유형 및 재난 상황에 대한 훈련 시나리오를 생성하고, 생성된 훈련 시나리오에 대응되는 SOP에 대한 정보를 단말 장치에 전송하고, 단말 장치에서의 처리 데이터를 수신하여 생성된 훈련 시나리오, 전송된 SOP에 대한 정보 및 수신한 처리 데이터를 포함하는 훈련 이력 정보를 저장한다.

title_en: system for Wireless control for firefighting trainer
title_ko: 소방 트레이너의 무선제어 시스템
abstract_en: In accordance with one embodiment of the present invention, a wireless control system for a firefighting trainer includes: a driving part driving wheels while kept placed on an upper side of the rear of a frame part; a wheel control part changing a direction or the rotation speed of the wheels in accordance with an inputted signal value; a wind velocity setting part formed on the edge of the frame part, and changing the intensity of an air blast from a flame air blast part, while kept connected with the flame air blast part generating an air blast to an installation space; a natural wind measurement part measuring the wind direction and velocity of natural wind, while kept installed in the frame part; and a main control part controlling the wheel control part, the wind velocity setting part and a flame generation part generating flames, based on a measurement value measured by the natural wind measurement part. Therefore, the present invention is capable of preventing an accident related to a fire by conducting fire suppression experience training.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 소방 트레이너의 무선제어 시스템은, 프레임부의 후방 상측에 배치된 채, 바퀴를 구동시키는 구동부 및 입력된 신호값에 따라 상기 바퀴의 방향 또는 회전속도를 변화시키는 바퀴제어부, 프레임부의 테두리에 형성되며, 상기 설치공간으로 송풍을 발생시키는 화염송풍부에 연결된 채, 상기 화염송풍부에 의한 송풍 세기를 변화시키는 풍속설정부, 상기 프레임부에 설치된 채, 자연풍의 풍향 및 풍속을 측정하는 자연풍측정부 및 상기 자연풍측정부에 의해 측정된 측정값을 기초로 상기 바퀴제어부, 상기 풍속설정부 및 화염을 발생시키는 화염발생부를 제어하는 메인제어부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System for evaluating performance of disaster response system using boundary value by using expert evaluation
title_ko: 전문가 평가를 이용하여 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for evaluating the performance of a disaster response system. The system of the present invention includes a disaster response system and a performance evaluation device. The disaster response system includes: a data collection unit collecting disaster data including past disaster data, institutional disaster data collected or processed by an institution, and environmental facility disaster data measured at an environmental facility; and a system control unit generating a disaster situation propagation plan and a disaster response plan by disaster type from the past disaster data, the institutional disaster data, and the environmental facility disaster data, generating a disaster manual by matching the disaster type, the disaster situation propagation plan, and the disaster response plan and manualizing the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan, performing decision making corresponding to the disaster type when the disaster type is input, and outputting the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan in accordance with the disaster manual included in the decision making. The performance evaluation device includes: an input control unit inputting an input value including the disaster type to the disaster response system; an output control unit receiving an output value including disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan from the disaster response system; an evaluation input unit receiving a scenario result generated by applying the input value to a disaster response scenario; and an evaluation determination unit evaluating the accuracy of the decision making by comparison between disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan included in the output value and the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan included in the scenario result.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예는 과거재난데이터, 기관이 수집 또는 처리한 기관재난데이터 및 환경시설에서 측정된 환경시설재난데이터를 포함하는 재난데이터를 수집하는 데이터수집부와, 상기 과거재난데이터, 상기 기관재난데이터 및 상기 환경시설재난데이터로부터 재난유형에 따른 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안을 생성하고, 상기 재난유형, 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 매칭시킴으로써 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 매뉴얼화하여 재난매뉴얼을 생성하고, 상기 재난유형을 입력받으면 상기 재난유형에 대응하는 의사결정을 수행하며, 상기 의사결정에 포함된 상기 재난매뉴얼에 따라 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 출력하는 시스템제어부를 포함하는 재난대응시스템; 및 상기 재난유형을 포함하는 입력값을 재난대응시스템에 입력시키는 입력제어부, 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 포함하는 출력값을 상기 재난대응시스템으로부터 수신하는 출력제어부, 상기 입력값이 재난 대응 시나리오에 적용되어 생성된 시나리오결과를 수신하는 평가입력부, 상기 출력값에 포함된 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안과 상기 시나리오결과에 포함된 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안을 비교하여 의사결정의 정확도를 평가하는 평가판단부를 포함하는 성능평가장치를 포함하는 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for acquiring influence degree of urban factors on inland inundation disaster loss
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for acquiring the influence degree of urban elements on waterlogging disaster loss, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a hierarchical Bayesian network structure under the scale of a city domain and a block, and respectively corresponding the structure in the ontology model of the influence mechanism of the city elements on the waterlogging disaster to the hierarchical Bayesian network structure; performing parameter learning training on the hierarchical Bayesian network structure by adopting a parameter learning algorithm to obtain the conditional probability of each node; and carrying out sensitivity analysis on each node according to the conditional probability of each node in the hierarchical Bayesian network structure so as to quantify the influence degree of the urban elements on the waterlogging disaster loss. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the influence degree of the urban elements on the loss of the waterlogging disaster can be quantized, so that on one hand, the influence degree of each urban element on the loss of the waterlogging disaster can be visually observed by people, and on the other hand, a quantitative evaluation basis can be provided when the loss degree of the waterlogging disaster is evaluated.

title_en: Method and device for preventing and treating bank landslide
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a device for preventing and controlling reservoir bank landslide, which comprises a plurality of anchor rods arranged on a landslide body, wherein the anchor rods are arranged side by side and are arranged in drill holes, the tops of the anchor rods extend out of the landslide body, the tops of the anchor rods are respectively connected with a baffle through telescopic rod assemblies, the baffle is parallel to the anchor rods and is positioned obliquely above the anchor rods, the telescopic rod assemblies are telescopic and are used for forming extrusion forces in opposite directions between the baffle and the anchor rods, gaps are formed between the side surfaces of the anchor rods and the inner wall of the drill holes, and concrete layers are arranged in the gaps, so that the device has the beneficial effects of effectively guiding surface water to flow out and keeping the anchor rods stable.

title_en: Smooth blasting construction method for gas tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smooth blasting construction method for a gas tunnel. Drilling, charging, detonating network connection, blasting, deslagging and risk elimination; drilling blast holes on the tunnel face, wherein the blast holes comprise cut holes, auxiliary holes and peripheral holes; the cut hole is arranged at the center of the tunnel face, the peripheral holes are arranged along the cut contour line, and the auxiliary holes are arranged between the cut hole and the peripheral holes; the cut holes and the auxiliary holes are arranged in a continuous charging mode, the charging of the peripheral holes is carried out according to multi-cycle interval charging of explosives and water stemming, the detonating network is connected in parallel by adopting safe detonating cord clusters, and a digital electric detonator is arranged at the center of each section or at least every 20 blast holes at intervals; according to the invention, the digital electric detonator is arranged outside the hole, so that the connection quality can be checked, the limitation of the maximum section position is eliminated, the clay stemming is used for plugging and inhibiting explosive gas from rushing out of a gun orifice, the blasting quality is influenced, and gas disasters are avoided; the method can effectively control the over-under excavation of the surrounding rock, reduce the unit consumption of explosive, save the production cost and ensure safer initiation.
assignees: CHINESE WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER SEVENTH ENGINEERING BUREAU LTD COMPANY

title_en: Coal mine dynamic disaster simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine dynamic disaster simulation system and a coal mine dynamic disaster simulation method, wherein the system comprises a main body device, a dynamic loading device, a top-cutting energy release device, an energy absorption control device and an intelligent monitoring system, the main body device comprises a model body, a roadway, a coal face, a roadway top plate and a coal face top plate are arranged in the model body, the dynamic loading device comprises a near-domain impact assembly and a far-domain impact assembly, the near-domain impact assembly, the top-cutting energy release device and the energy absorption control device are all arranged in the model body, the far-domain impact assembly is arranged on the outer side of the model body, the top-cutting energy release device is used for cutting off the coal face top plate, the energy absorption control device is used for supporting the roadway, and the intelligent monitoring system is used for monitoring the dynamic loading device, the top-cutting energy release device and the energy absorption control device. The invention can realize automatic and intelligent control and simulation, and truly restore the coal mine field dynamic disaster occurrence process.

title_en: Construction method and application of high-voltage switch cabinet fault fire extinguishing agent consumption prediction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a high-voltage switch cabinet fault fire extinguishing agent consumption prediction model and application thereof. Obtaining the ignition time t   Ignition of fire   of the fault point ignition and the extinguishing time t   Extinguishing device   of the fire source after the gas extinguishing agent is applied by simulating various typical fault defect modes; the fire extinguishing system determines the amount of fire extinguishing agent L required to extinguish the fire source based on the extinguishing time; and (3) obtaining the association relation between the fault point ignition duration delta t   continuous and continuous  ＝(t  Presetting  -t  Ignition of fire  ) and the required fire extinguishing agent consumption L by presetting different flow adding time t   Presetting   by the flow adding system, and establishing a unitary linear regression piecewise prediction model of the fire extinguishing agent consumption and the ignition duration. The invention solves the problems that typical fault defects of the high-voltage switch cabinet cause rare disaster characteristic parameters and the consumption of different fire extinguishing agents can not be evaluated on line in real time.

title_en: Method for cooperative treatment of gas passing fault of fully mechanized caving face and spontaneous combustion of coal
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine gas and coal spontaneous combustion coupling prevention and control, and discloses a method for cooperatively preventing and controlling gas and coal spontaneous combustion in a goaf passing through a fault on a fully mechanized coal mining face, which is suitable for cooperative treatment of goaf gas and coal spontaneous combustion disasters in a process of passing through the fault on the fully mechanized coal mining face with spontaneous combustion tendency and large gas emission. During the fault passing period, arranging a goaf buried pipe at the side of the return airway and arranging a high-position drill hole in the fault area to extract gas; forming a leaking stoppage air system by plugging an air inlet tunnel and an air return tunnel on a working face, arranging a grouting pipeline at the air return tunnel side, and arranging an inert gas injection pipeline in a machine tunnel and a coal remaining area of an intermittent layer of the working face; gas monitoring pipelines are arranged at upper corners of the working face, the goaf and the racks, gas is collected from the gas monitoring pipelines for analysis, and measures such as gas extraction, nitrogen injection, grouting, liquid state CO2 injection and the like are taken according to analysis results to cooperatively control the fault gas passing and coal spontaneous combustion disasters of the fully mechanized caving face.
assignees: HUAIBEI MINING CO LTD;UNIV ANHUI SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Multi-micro-grid system collaborative optimization method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
