The invention utilizes Thiessen polygon theory to determine a target rainfall station and a weather station, and collects historical rainfall data of the rainfall station, historical flow data of a reservoir and historical environmental observation data of the weather station in advance, wherein the historical environmental observation data comprise air temperature, wind direction and wind speed; carrying out negative value correction and resampling on pre-acquired data, and considering the hysteresis cycle influence of rainfall on the warehouse-in flow; and (3) integrating three data information sources of warehousing flow, rainfall and environmental parameters, training a gating circulation unit network model optimized based on a genetic algorithm by using normalized data, and inputting multi-source data generated in the latest time period into the model to predict the reservoir inflow in the future time period. The method solves the problems of poor GRU model performance and slow convergence rate caused by the disaster of the input characteristic dimension existing in the long-term hydrologic data time sequence, and realizes rapid and accurate prediction of the reservoir inflow in the future period.

title_en: Method for acquiring flood disaster information from social media
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for acquiring flood disaster information from social media, which is realized based on a Selenium automation tool and a YOLO v5 convolution neural network, and comprises the following steps: (1) utilizing a Selenium automation tool to simulate login to obtain character and picture data when a flood disaster happens; (2) based on the acquired flood picture data, identifying key objects and key parts in the flood by adopting a YOLO v5 convolutional neural network; (3) and converting the recognition result of the flood character information and the image information into the water level depth according to a preset standard. According to the method, the efficiency and the accuracy of identifying the anti-crawler effect and the YOLO v5 convolutional neural network in the automatic webpage simulation of the Selenium are considered, and more flood data except for a conventional hydrological site are obtained through social media platforms such as microblogs, so that an accurate hydrological model can be better established.

title_en: Precise danger-eliminating and yield-increasing method for huge thick coal seam based on directional drilling advanced high-pressure water injection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise danger-eliminating and yield-increasing method for a huge thick coal seam based on directional drilling advanced high-pressure water injection, which comprises the following steps: 1. pressure relief tunneling construction of a roadway; 2. dividing the pressure relief stoping construction section of the stoping working face of the separated coal seam; 3. performing advanced water injection and pressure relief construction on a pressure relief stoping construction section; 4. measuring impact risk of the current pressure relief stoping construction section; 5. performing supplementary pressure relief on the current pressure relief stoping construction section; 6. carrying out stoping construction on the current pressure relief stoping construction section; 7. and correcting the long-distance directional advanced pressure relief drilling hole group of the next pressure relief stoping construction section and implementing advanced water injection pressure relief stoping construction. The method ensures that the tunnel section in the strong impact tendency huge thick coal seam is always tunneled in the semi-enclosed water injection pressure relief area, thereby being beneficial to improving the tunnelling speed and preventing the occurrence of rock burst disasters; meanwhile, the water injection softening and pressure relief of the top coal seam are realized, and the purposes of pressure relief and impact prevention are achieved; in addition, the caving performance of top coal can be improved, and the coal yield can be increased.

title_en: Firefighter tracking monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a firefighter tracking monitoring system and method. The system comprises: the environment data acquisition unit comprises an image acquisition module and an environment measurement module; the fireman data acquisition unit comprises a physiological data acquisition module for acquiring the physiological data of the fireman and a dynamic data acquisition module for acquiring the movement information of the fireman; the data transmission unit sends out the emergency rescue field environment information acquired by the environment data acquisition unit and the firefighter physiological data information and the firefighter motion information acquired by the firefighter data acquisition unit; the data processing unit receives and processes the emergency rescue site environment information, the firefighter physiological data information and the firefighter motion information sent by the data transmission unit; the field simulation unit acquires the emergency rescue field environment information, the firefighter physiological data information and the firefighter motion information processed by the data processing unit, and the field environment 3D model is constructed and displays the firefighter positioning position, the physiological state and the motion trail in the field environment 3D model.

title_en: Method for treating rock burst of hard roof of coal mine tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating rock burst of a hard roof of a coal mine roadway, which comprises the following steps: firstly, determining the position of an area to be relieved; secondly, collecting the original apparent resistivity of the area to be subjected to pressure relief before pressure relief; thirdly, pressure relief is carried out on the area to be relieved; measuring the average development height of the internal cracks of the pressure-relief area after pressure relief; fifthly, judging the pressure relief impact risk level of the area to be relieved; sixthly, adjusting the aperture of the pressure relief drill hole in the area to be subjected to pressure relief and carrying out pressure relief again; seventhly, supplementing and relieving pressure for the area to be relieved; and eighthly, finishing pressure relief of the area to be subjected to pressure relief. The rock burst treatment method adopted by the invention can perform high-pressure hydraulic fracturing on the area to be subjected to pressure relief, enables the average development height of cracks in the area to be subjected to pressure relief to cover the whole area to be subjected to pressure relief, effectively performs fracturing weakening on the area to be subjected to pressure relief, promotes a coal seam hard top plate to collapse in time, effectively treats rock burst disasters caused by the coal seam hard top plate, has a good treatment effect, and is convenient to popularize and use.
assignees: STATE GRID ENERGY XINJIANG ZHUNDONG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD;UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Large-dip-angle large-mining-height stope coal wall mining dynamic behavior evolution rule research method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for researching coal wall mining dynamics behavior evolution rules of a large-dip-angle large-mining-height stope, which comprises the steps of constructing numerical models of different mining conditions by adopting numerical calculation and carrying out excavation calculation, preliminarily defining dynamic change rules of mechanical environments of coal walls in different areas with different trends of working surfaces and different trends of the working surfaces, paving and excavating a physical similarity simulation experiment method, carrying out partition trend physical similarity model of the same mining conditions by the numerical calculation, determining the coal wall bearing environment evolution rules of different areas in the stope under the coupling effect of dip angles and interlayer effects by comprehensive numerical calculation results, carrying out multi-path mechanical property test and step-by-step partition loading physical similarity material experiment, and systematically researching the coal wall mining dynamics behavior evolution rules of the large-mining-height stope. The method can reflect dynamic change conditions of the coal wall bearing environment, changes the deformation displacement of the coal wall under different bearing paths, changes the internal structure state, and other mechanical response behavior evolution rules, and provides scientific guidance for disaster prevention and control of the coal wall of the large-dip-angle large-mining-height stope.

title_en: Power grid disaster early warning system based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid disaster early warning system based on cloud computing, relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, and solves the technical problems that the existing scheme cannot accurately early warn power grid disasters and early warning results cannot be visually displayed; the system comprises a cloud platform, a region division module, a data center module, a model establishment module, an early warning analysis module, a global monitoring module and a data storage module; the invention is provided with the area division module, the minimum disaster monitoring area is provided by the area division module, and the accuracy of the disaster prediction of the power distribution network can be ensured; the invention is provided with the model establishing module which trains the artificial intelligence model through the standard data training set to obtain the early warning analysis model which can accurately finish the early warning of the disaster, thereby ensuring the early warning precision of the power grid disaster; the early warning analysis module is arranged, so that accurate early warning of power grid disasters can be realized, and prediction results can be visually displayed.

title_en: Emergency disaster prevention management system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency disaster prevention management system, which comprises: the monitoring module is arranged in a pre-trained target mine and used for monitoring the mine shaft environmental parameters of the target mine; the processing module is connected with the monitoring module and used for determining whether a fire hazard accident exists in the target mine or not according to the shaft environment parameters; responding to the fire hazard accident existing in the target mine, and determining a mine fire emergency plan corresponding to the mine environmental parameters according to the mine environmental parameters; and the display module is connected with the processing module and used for displaying an emergency escape scheme corresponding to the mine emergency plan according to the mine fire emergency plan and guiding escape when a fire disaster actually occurs in the target mine. Therefore, real-time monitoring and dynamic simulation of mine fires can be realized, and a favorable reference is provided for timely making danger avoiding planning under a catastrophe condition.

title_en: Lightweight high-strength firewall system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a light-weight high-strength firewall system which comprises a firewall door plate, wherein a galvanized steel frame is arranged inside the firewall door plate, heat insulation plates are arranged on two opposite sides of the galvanized steel frame, a composite plate is arranged outside the heat insulation plates, the galvanized steel frame, the heat insulation plates and the composite plate are fastened and connected through a plurality of self-tapping self-drilling screws, and the distance between every two adjacent self-tapping self-drilling screws is not more than 300 mm. The lightweight high-strength firewall system can replace the traditional reinforced concrete wall, provides fireproof isolation for adjacent building areas, ensures the operability of equipment in fire, meets the requirement of trafficability of evacuation routes, has the functions of earthquake resistance, impact resistance, fire prevention and the like, has a stable structure, occupies a small space, saves energy, reduces cost, is beneficial to developing and expanding a larger design space of a design institute, and has a wider application prospect.

title_en: Intelligent decision-making method for underground drainage pipe network maintenance based on MOP-DL
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent decision-making method for maintaining an underground drainage pipe network based on MOP-DL, which comprises the steps of obtaining the functional disease condition of the drainage pipe network and the regional flood disaster loss condition, constructing a multi-objective planning model for maintaining the underground drainage pipe network by taking a multi-objective module as a constraint condition, solving the multi-objective planning model by a multi-objective group search algorithm module based on covariance evolution and chaos search to obtain a functional disease condition sample set of the drainage pipe network with a maintenance decision label, inputting the functional disease condition sample set of the drainage pipe network with the maintenance decision label into a deep learning module, and repeatedly performing iterative training on the self by the deep learning module by utilizing the parameters of a quantitative loss function of the functional disease condition sample set of the drainage pipe network with the maintenance decision label, and outputting a maintenance decision result. The method disclosed by the invention is accurate in fitting the disaster loss of the urban waterlogged area under the influence of the functional diseases, the economic benefit of maintenance decision is accurate in quantification, and the reliability of the maintenance decision result of the drainage pipe network is high.

title_en: Flood disaster prediction and early warning method based on DA-SSL
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster prediction and early warning method based on DA-SSL, which comprises the steps of obtaining an initial sample of urban pipe network diseases, inputting the initial sample of the urban pipe network diseases to an improved PCSWMM model, outputting a pipe network functional disease sample set with waterlogging result labels by the improved PCSWMM model, expanding the initial sample of the urban pipe network diseases to obtain a labeled sample set with waterlogging result labels after expansion, carrying out information difference measurement of the labeled sample set with/without labels by utilizing cross entropy, randomly generating a non-labeled sample set without waterlogging result labels, inputting the labeled sample set and the non-labeled sample set to the improved PCSWMM model, and carrying out repeated training on the improved PCSWMM model to obtain urban waterlogging area results of different pipe network functional disease conditions. By adopting the invention, the overflow capacity and the flow velocity distribution of the drainage pipe network under the influence of functional diseases can be accurately fitted, and the waterlogging early warning result is very accurate and reliable.

title_en: Tropical unstable wave early warning method and device based on space-time cross-scale attention fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for early warning tropical unstable waves based on spatio-temporal cross-scale attention fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting multi-scale spatial data into a corresponding branch network to calculate a characteristic graph under a corresponding scale, and calculating regularization loss; realizing cross-scale space graph fusion of the multi-scale feature graph by using a bilateral local attention mechanism, generating a global feature description graph, calculating prediction loss, and jointly using the prediction loss and the regularization loss for optimization training of a neural network; predicting the sea surface temperature at the time T based on the optimally trained neural network, selecting K time data before the time T to input into the optimally trained neural network, wherein the output of the optimally trained neural network is a predicted value of the tropical unstable wave, and drawing a space-time image of the tropical unstable wave by associating the predicted value with coordinates to realize early warning of the tropical unstable wave. The device comprises: a processor and a memory. The invention can effectively early warn the unstable waves of the tropical zone and reduce natural disasters.

title_en: Dam piling and breaking simulation device for tailing pond
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dam-piling and-breaking simulation device for a tailing pond, which is used for solving the problem that a dam-piling and-breaking physical simulation device in the prior art is difficult to simulate dam-breaking of the tailing pond under various natural conditions and different working conditions. The method comprises the following steps: the system comprises an earthquake simulation system, a reservoir body simulation assembly, a rainfall simulation system and an information acquisition system, and can simulate extreme conditions such as earthquake, heavy rainfall, flood overtopping, seepage failure and the like, and situations of coupling of various disasters; through model tests and numerical research, the evolution process and the disaster forming characteristics of the tailings pond under different conditions are explored, the disaster resistance characteristics of different dam body structures are known through reconstructing different dam bodies, the influence of factors such as the reservoir capacity, the material characteristics, the structural form, the extreme conditions and the surrounding topography of the tailings pond on the disaster forming mode of the tailings pond is revealed, a theoretical basis is provided for heightening and protecting the tailings dam, and the method has important significance for researching the fine-grained high tailings pond.

title_en: Pedestrian attribute recognition model training method and device based on incremental learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a pedestrian attribute recognition model training method and device based on incremental learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a pedestrian attribute identification data set for incremental learning, and determining a task learning sequence; training an initial pedestrian attribute recognition model by using a training sample in an initial task; updating the representative samples in the training data cache pool and the cache models in the model cache pool; repeatedly executing the following steps until all tasks in the data set are learned, and obtaining a pedestrian attribute identification model; determining a prediction model and a model to be trained according to a cache model in the model cache pool; predicting all training samples of the current task based on a prediction model to obtain an updated current task; and training the model to be trained according to the representative sample and the updated training sample in the current task to obtain a first target model. The invention effectively improves the accuracy of the pedestrian attribute identification model in identifying the existing attributes in the incremental learning process and relieves the problem of forgetting disaster.

title_en: Device and method for measuring strength performance change of soil under lightning impulse action
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for measuring the strength performance change of a soil body under the action of lightning impulse and a measuring method thereof. The device can well simulate the mechanical strength change of soil caused by lightning impulse, thereby providing reference for exploring the soil thunder and lightning disaster mechanism.

title_en: Torrential flood monitoring and early warning system at immersion experience visual angle and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a torrential flood monitoring and early warning system under an immersion experience visual angle and an implementation method thereof. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that: the system can provide real-time technical support for mountain torrent defense in mountain torrent disaster dangerous areas, can calculate in real time, can also perform virtual reality experience, can calculate mountain torrent disasters in advance and send out early warning, conducts real-time command through the flood prevention and drought control command system, and has a good prevention effect.

title_en: Data processing method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a data processing method, a data processing device and data processing equipment, which are used for reducing the dimension of high-dimensional load data of a user so as to solve the problem of dimension disaster. The method in the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: acquiring initial load data of a target user, wherein the initial load data comprises load data of an initial dimension; acquiring a target self-encoder trained by a plurality of training samples, wherein the target self-encoder comprises an encoder consisting of N convolutional layers and M pooling layers; each training sample comprises historical load data of an initial dimension and historical load data of a target dimension, the initial dimension is larger than the target dimension, and the target self-encoder saves dimension reduction rules of the initial dimension to the target dimension; and inputting the initial load data to the target self-encoder so that the target self-encoder reduces the dimension of the load data of the initial dimension into the load data of the target dimension according to the dimension reduction rule.
assignees: SHENZHEN INSTITUTE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND ROBOTICS FOR SOC

title_en: Virtual learning system and method based on cloud server
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual learning system and a virtual learning method based on a cloud server, wherein the system comprises a main control unit, a fire detection unit, a fire extinguishing unit and a wireless communication unit, the main control unit is also electrically connected with a power management unit, and the wireless communication unit is in wireless communication connection with the cloud server; the system further comprises a virtual head-mounted device, wherein the virtual head-mounted device is in wireless communication connection with the cloud server; the fire detection unit is used for detecting fire in the power consumption simulation device and transmitting a corresponding fire signal to the main control unit, and the main control unit is used for controlling the fire extinguishing unit, the wireless communication unit and the power management unit according to the fire signal. After the electric simulation device is put into use, whether a fire disaster happens to the electric simulation device can be automatically detected, when the fire disaster happens, the fire can be extinguished through the fire extinguishing unit, meanwhile, a fire signal is transmitted to the cloud server, and the virtual head-mounted equipment can know the fire from the cloud server and display the fire in real time so as to increase electricity utilization safety learning.
assignees: QINGDAO VIRTUAL REALITY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and device for predicting power failure probability of power distribution network under natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, and discloses a method, a system and a device for predicting power failure probability of a power distribution network under natural disasters. According to the method, each user electric meter in a region to be detected is clustered by adopting a fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm, a power grid topological model is established according to obtained membership information between each user electric meter and each power distribution substation, important nodes are selected from the power grid topological model for storage, a power distribution network planning model is further obtained, and power failure simulation is carried out on the power distribution network planning model based on a vulnerability curve so as to obtain the power failure probability of user loads corresponding to each user electric meter under each natural disaster scene. The invention combines the advantages of a statistical model and a vulnerability assessment model, only utilizes the basic power distribution network data to generate the comprehensive power system layout of the measured area, and utilizes the vulnerability curve to simulate the power failure probability of a single building under the dangerous load level, thereby realizing the power failure estimation of the building level and simultaneously improving the efficiency and the precision of the power failure probability prediction.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Drilling cuttings measurement while drilling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drill cutting measurement while drilling device, and belongs to the technical field of drilling. The device comprises a slag receiving box body, a lower drainage filter screen, an upper drainage filter screen, an opening and closing device, a control valve and a weighing device. The drilling cuttings while-drilling measuring device introduces drilling cuttings, water and other slag bodies discharged in the drilling construction process into the slag receiving box body through a drilling orifice gas-slag separator or other drainage devices; the slag receiving box body discharges most of water or other liquid in the slag body through the lower drainage filter screen and the upper drainage filter screen; the opening and closing device opens the slag receiving box body from the bottom according to the instruction of the control valve and removes slag in the box body; the metering device measures the weight of slag in the slag receiving box body in real time, measures the amount of drilling cuttings generated in drilling construction per meter by combining with a control valve instruction, and realizes the measurement of the drilling cuttings while drilling. The method can be widely applied to prediction of coal rock dynamic disasters such as mine rock burst, coal and gas outburst and the like, and is also an important support for coal rock geological drilling technology.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Highway tunnel fire disaster growth period parameter identification and prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for identifying and predicting fire growth period parameters of a road tunnel, which comprises the following steps: s1, selecting a fire source model for the long-term increase of the tunnel fire; s2, determining parameters of the fire source model of the tunnel fire growth period; s3, establishing a tunnel fire growth period FDS numerical simulation model and setting working conditions; s4, establishing a tunnel fire growth period observation database; s5, labeling and normalizing data of the tunnel fire growth period; s6, establishing an LSTM neural network model for identifying and predicting the tunnel fire source growth period parameters; s7, carrying out LSTM neural network model training of tunnel fire source long-term parameter identification and prediction; and S8, identifying the tunnel fire source growth period parameters and analyzing the prediction performance. The method solves the problems that the existing tunnel fire prediction means cannot fully analyze and utilize a large amount of data generated by various monitoring devices in the tunnel under the fire working condition, cannot identify fire source information in time and predict the growth situation of the fire source information, and cannot provide decision-making service for personnel safety evacuation and fire rescue.

title_en: Indoor simulator for mountain torrent disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of mountain torrent simulation devices, in particular to an indoor simulation device for mountain torrent disasters, which comprises an L-shaped plate, wherein a plurality of groups of laminates are superposed above the L-shaped plate, the flat surface of the L-shaped plate and the laminates as well as the laminates are in sliding connection through adaptive chutes and sliding blocks, the sliding blocks are elastically connected with the inner wall of the chutes through springs, and the vertical plate surface of the L-shaped plate is provided with a stretching mechanism for connecting the laminates.

title_en: Personnel evacuation simulation method based on fire of mail steamer and road section capacity limitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a personnel evacuation model based on fire of a cruise ship and road section capacity limitation and a simulation method, wherein a three-dimensional model of the cruise ship is converted into an evacuation network through model data of the cruise ship; the evacuation network comprises a node set, a set of road sections and a set of lengths and widths of all the road sections; adding attributes to each node and each road section according to the evacuation characteristics of people in the fire; defining the attribute and the numerical range of personnel, wherein the personnel zone bit is used for distinguishing continuous walking and stopping advancing; calculating the danger degree of the road section where the personnel are located, wherein the higher the danger degree is, the higher the personnel evacuation priority is; calculating a personnel evacuation path; calculating the personnel moving speed of all road sections in real time by determining the relation between the crowd density and the personnel moving speed; and setting the maximum personnel capacity of the road section, and judging whether all the personnel continuously move or not according to the personnel evacuation priority. The invention can accurately simulate the emergency evacuation of a fire scene and provide powerful support for formulating a reasonable evacuation plan.

title_en: Improved walking block emergency simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved walking block emergency simulation method which comprises the steps of carrying out data preprocessing on road network vectors of a walking block to generate an undirected graph, carrying out individual feature classification on human bodies corresponding to the walking block based on a preset theory, determining nerve response intensity of different individuals according to the distance between the human bodies of the walking block and combining the classified individual features, constructing intelligent individual speed functions based on the nerve response intensity and the undirected graph, defining the panic ratio aiming at the individual features of different classifications, constructing a corresponding path evacuation model based on the intelligent individual speed functions, constructing path evacuation models corresponding to the individual features, carrying out shortest path search and acquiring a shortest time state sequence, and carrying out emergency evacuation simulation in virtual scenes constructed in the walking block based on search results and acquisition results. The emergency evacuation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multidimensional full-scale high-position landslide motion intelligent simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multidimensional full-scale high-position landslide motion intelligent simulation system, and belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and control. In the system, a sliding source area of a simulation platform is used for simulating that a sliding body material is filled in a ground material box, lifted to a preset height and then placed at a high starting point of a circulation area; the circulation area is arranged between the sliding source area and the accumulation area and used for realizing the simulation of the sliding motion with different inclination angles and lengths and simulating the collision, disintegration and acceleration effects of a sliding body in the sliding motion, the high-position starting point is connected with the sliding source area, and the low-position end point is connected with the accumulation area; the accumulation area is used for simulating a sliding body accumulation process; the monitoring area is used for monitoring the landslide motion process; the control center is used for setting controllable parameters of the landslide source area, the circulation area and the accumulation area, collecting monitoring data of the monitoring area and analyzing the simulated landslide motion. The invention provides a full-scale and multi-dimensional simulation environment, realizes three-dimensional terrain state simulation, and accurately records dynamic data of high-order landslide motion.

title_en: Method for evaluating prevention and control effects of karst water damage in deep mining
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating a karst water damage prevention effect of deep mining, which is based on a traditional geophysical exploration technology and MapGIS system data interpolation mask processing technology to verify the prevention effect through sequence fusion. Firstly, carrying out qualitative evaluation on an aquifer subjected to ground directional near-horizontal drilling grouting reconstruction based on physical quantities such as permeability coefficient, permeability and the like of a reconstruction target layer, secondly, analyzing and processing grouting parameters of each coordinate point by utilizing a MapGIS system to obtain a grouting effect special subject partition evaluation chart, simultaneously carrying out double-chart data mask processing on the basis of a visual resistivity low-resistance abnormal region evaluation chart obtained by mining electric method investigation to obtain an abnormal region superposition analysis evaluation chart, and finally obtaining a deep mining karst water damage prevention and control effect comprehensive evaluation chart and providing a specific step of eliminating an abnormal region before mining. The invention can provide scientific theoretical basis for preventing and controlling karst water damage in deep coal resource exploitation and can effectively avoid accidents of water bursting and disaster causing in deep exploitation.

title_en: Multi-physical-field monitoring data collaborative fusion engineering disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an engineering disaster early warning method and system based on collaborative fusion of multi-physical-field monitoring data, and belongs to the field of hydraulic engineering disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-sensor real-time monitoring data of a potential dangerous part of an engineering structure, preprocessing the multi-sensor real-time monitoring data, normalizing the multi-physical-field monitoring time sequence data, and constructing a normalized sample matrix; analyzing the sensitivity of each physical field monitoring index to the engineering safety state by adopting a multivariate statistical method, and guiding the initialization training of the long-short term memory network according to the sensitivity to the engineering safety state to obtain the output result of the long-short term memory network; and inputting the output result of the long-term and short-term memory network as evidence, obtaining basic probability assignment of each early warning grade after fusion according to an evidence theory fusion rule of Chebyshev distance improvement, and determining the disaster danger grade of the potential danger part of the engineering structure by adopting a decision method of basic probability assignment. By adopting the method and the system, the early warning precision of the engineering disaster can be improved.

title_en: High-speed railway roadbed settlement prediction and early warning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed railway subgrade settlement predicting and early warning method based on deep learning, relates to the technical field of geological disaster predicting and early warning, aims to realize more accurate subgrade settlement predicting and early warning under a complex natural environment, and comprises the steps of obtaining data measured by a monitoring sensor; carrying out data preprocessing on data measured by a monitoring sensor to obtain a complete and smooth data set; establishing a high-speed railway subgrade settlement prediction model, dividing a complete and smooth data set into a training set and a test set, and putting the training set into the model for training to obtain a parameter matrix of the model; testing the trained high-speed railway roadbed settlement prediction model through a test set; performing precision evaluation on the prediction model according to the test result; judging the predicted settlement data through an early warning model and giving a corresponding early warning result; the invention has the advantages of accurate prediction and timeliness.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device with InSAR technique
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster early warning device with InSAR technology, which comprises a box body, wherein the top surface of the box body is rotatably connected with an early warning device main body, the inner top surface of the box body is rotatably connected with four vertical rods, and the lower ends of the four vertical rods are fixedly connected with drill rods; the chain wheel type vertical bar conveying device is characterized in that four chain wheels and a chain are arranged in the box body, a shaft lever penetrates through the left side face of the box body and is connected with the box body in a rotating mode, a first bevel gear is installed at the left end of the shaft lever, a second bevel gear is connected to the first bevel gear in a meshing mode, and the second bevel gear is fixedly sleeved on a vertical bar. When the device is used, the first bevel gear is driven to rotate by rotating the shaft lever, the first bevel gear is further driven to rotate by meshing, the second bevel gear is further driven to rotate, one vertical rod is further driven to rotate, the other three vertical rods are further driven to rotate through the chain wheel and the chain, the four drill rods are further driven to simultaneously rotate, and the four drill rods are further driven to drill into the ground, so that the device is fixed on the ground.
assignees: QINGHAI NONFERROUS GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE

title_en: Emergency response linkage method and system based on multi-objective optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency response linkage method and system based on a multi-objective optimization method, which comprises the following steps: s1, dividing the region, and identifying the dangerous source in the region and initially judging the accident demand; s2, establishing a multi-target emergency material management model considering before and after disaster; s3, sharing data, and storing the model result in the S2 in a block chain; s4, realizing linkage of emergency resources and emergency power in the enterprise and a third party by data sharing based on the block chain technology; the database security of the emergency response linkage mechanism is optimized by depending on a block chain technology, and the data tamper-resistant capability is improved so as to improve the data security; more parameters in the accident occurrence process are considered based on the multi-objective optimization method, so that the accident simulation is closer to the actual situation, and the simulation effectiveness is improved; the solving process selects various algorithms according to model difficulty, so that the problem that the solving result is unreliable due to a single algorithm is avoided, and the process is easier to program and realize.

title_en: CO seepage experimental apparatus in loose coal body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a CO seepage experiment device in loose coal bodies, which comprises a seepage cylinder constant temperature control box and a CO seepage unit, wherein a hydraulic oil supply system and a CO air supply bottle are arranged outside the constant temperature control box; the CO gas supply bottle is connected with a CO seepage unit in the constant temperature control box through a gas inlet pipe; a metal tube float flowmeter and a differential pressure transmitter are arranged on the outer wall surface of the constant temperature control box, and the metal tube float flowmeter is connected with the CO seepage unit through a first air outlet pipe; the metal tube float flowmeter is also connected with a laser TDLAS type gas detector arranged outside the constant temperature control box through a second gas outlet pipe; the pressure difference transmitter is connected with the CO seepage unit through the air inlet pressure difference pipe and the air outlet pressure difference pipe respectively; the LED pressure display nixie tube and the LED temperature display nixie tube are further included. The seepage flow of CO in the coal body is simulated through the seepage flow system, and a theoretical basis is provided for the early warning of coal fire disasters by CO gas.

title_en: Integration system for waterworks pipe asset management utilizing web applications
title_ko: 웹 어플리케이션을 활용한 상수관로 안전관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water pipe safety management system using a web application, which diagnoses and evaluates the stability of facilities through precise diagnosis and operation support of facilities based on water pipe information among underground facilities to utilize a web application which provides reference material to maintenance priorities through disaster situation simulation results.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하시설물 중 상수관로 정보를 기반으로 시설물의 운영지원 및 정밀진단을 통한 시설물의 안정성을 진단. 평가하여, 재해 상황 시뮬레이션 결과를 통해 정비 우선순위에 참고 자료를 제공하는 웹 어플리케이션을 활용한 상수관로 안전관리 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Disaster monitoring response System based on IoT Wireless Network
title_ko: ＩｏＴ 무선네트워크 기반 화재 감시 대응시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire monitoring response system based on an Internet of Things (IoT) wireless network and, more particularly, to a fire monitoring response system based on an IoT wireless network, which comprises: a sensing unit installed inside a building, sensing at least one among heat, smoke, carbon monoxide (CO), flame, humidity, and outlet arc, and having an IoT communication chip embedded therein; a wireless gateway for wireless reception, which is installed inside the building, which receives measurement data measured from the sensing unit and information on a location of an evacuee in the building, and which receives CCTV image data in the building; a platform server receiving the measurement data, the location information, and the image data in real time from the wireless gateway, predicting a situation based on simulation data, transmitting response information to a user terminal of the evacuee, and controlling that the situation to be notified through an IoT control unit; and an IoT control unit installed in several places inside the building and embedded with a speaker, a housing, and a display unit displaying an optimal route or an indicator to guide the optimal route. According to the present invention, information for predicting damage due to a disaster is provided in order to mitigate damage caused by the disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 IoT 무선네트워크 기반 화재 감시 대응시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 건물 내에 설치되어, 열, 연기, CO, 불꼿, 습도, 콘센트 아크 중 적어도 어느 하나를 감지하고, IoT통신칩이 내장된 감지부; 건물 내에 설치되며, 감지부에서 측정된 측정데이터와, 건물 내 피난자의 위치정보를 수신하여, 건물 내 CCTV 영상데이터를 수신하는 와이어리스 수신용 무선게이트웨이; 상기 무선게이트웨이로부터 상기  측정데이터와, 상기 위치정보, 상기 영상데이터를 실시간으로 수신하여, 시뮬레이션데이터를 기반으로 상황을 예측하고, 대응정보를 상기 피난자의 사용자단말기에 전송하고, 상기 사물제어유닛을 통해 알리도록 제어하는 플랫폼 서버; 및 상기 건물 내에 복수로 설치되며,  스피커와, 하우징과, 최적경로 또는 최적경로를 안내하기 위한 표시자가 디스플레이되는 디스플레이부를 내장한 사물제어유닛;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 IoT 무선네트워크 기반 화재 감시 대응시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fire-fighting equipment analyzing system
title_ko: 소방시설 평가 시스템
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention relate to a firefighting facility evaluation system. According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is the firefighting facility evaluation system comprising: an evacuation model determination part that determines an evacuation model through an evacuation influencing factor; a fire scenario model determination part that determines a fire scenario model considering a building characteristic; and a verification part that verifies an appropriateness of the evacuation model in the fire scenario model. Therefore, the present invention is capable of securing a fire safety resilience capability.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예들은 소방시설 평가 시스템에 관한 것이다.  본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면, 피난영향인자를 통해 피난 모델을 결정하는 피난모델 결정부; 건축물 특성을 고려한 화재 시나리오 모델을 결정하는 화재시나리오 모델 결정부; 및 상기 화재 시나리오 모델에서의 상기 피난 모델의 적정성을 검증하는 검증부;를 포함하는, 소방시설 평가 시스템에 제공된다.

title_en: High-steep soil landslide reinforcement method based on embedded top miniature pile group
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-steep soil landslide reinforcement method based on a top-embedded miniature pile group, and belongs to the field of landslide disaster prevention. The method comprises the steps of obtaining landslide dimensions, determining construction positions of embedded top micro pile groups, determining combination forms of the embedded top micro pile groups and row and column distances, determining residual sliding force of the landslide at the positions of all rows of micro piles, calculating pile diameters, pile lengths, reinforcement amounts and related parameters of connecting beams of all rows of embedded top micro piles according to the residual sliding force of the landslide and the row and column distances, drilling holes, installing reinforcement and carrying out concrete grouting to form micro pile groups consisting of the micro piles and the connecting beams, and reinforcing the high-steep soil landslide by penetrating through the top surfaces, the sliding bodies and the sliding surfaces of the micro piles to the sliding beds. The invention has small construction site and high construction speed, and can quickly stop sliding; the residual sliding force of the sliding slope at the rear edge of the sliding slope is resisted through the bending and shearing resistance of the miniature pile, and meanwhile, the rock-soil property of the sliding belt is effectively improved, and the high and steep soil landslide is effectively reinforced.

title_en: Wind-blowing snow test system and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-blowing snow test testing system and a testing method thereof, belonging to the field of snow engineering and civil disaster prevention and reduction engineering. The automatic collecting and placing and high-precision three-dimensional measurement of the snowfall particles during the wind-blown snow test are realized; the device and the method can realize graded controllable snowfall simulation, array type scanning acquisition of three-dimensional snow morphology and continuous monitoring of snow quality transportation, and provide a systematic testing device and a systematic testing method for researching wind-induced snow drift tests under various snowfall conditions.

title_en: Device and method for measuring permeability of coal rock under condition of simulating rock burst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for measuring coal rock permeability under the condition of simulating rock burst, wherein the device comprises a main body loading system, a gas supply system, a flow and stress strain monitoring system and a computer; the method comprises the steps of firstly, preparing an experiment; step two, performing a coal sample adsorption experiment; step three, carrying out seepage experiment under static load; step four, carrying out seepage experiments under dynamic load; and step five, analyzing results. The coal mine axial compression and confining pressure test device has the advantages that the structural design is reasonable, the method steps are simple and convenient, the unidirectional loading test of axial compression and confining pressure and the composite disturbance loading test of axial compression and confining pressure can be conveniently carried out on a coal sample through the confining pressure servo actuator and the dynamic and static servo actuators, the damage condition of coal rock under impact ground pressure can be conveniently simulated, the change of the gas permeability of the coal rock can be obtained, the problem that the rapid change of the coal rock permeability is difficult to monitor and prevent under the existing deep-field mine impact ground pressure disaster can be solved, and the smooth operation of the safe production work of a coal mine can be ensured.

title_en: Underground structure secondary fire disaster simulation test device based on shaking table simulation earthquake load
abstract_en: The invention discloses a secondary fire simulation test device for an underground structure based on a vibration table for simulating earthquake load, which comprises a vibration table and a model box, wherein the model box is arranged above the vibration table, the interior of the model box simulates the underground structure, the underground structure comprises an underground building area and an underground pipe gallery area, the underground pipe gallery area comprises a soil layer and a tunnel model buried in the soil layer, a plurality of groups of first fire simulation components are buried in the tunnel model, a plurality of groups of second fire simulation components are buried in the soil layer, a plurality of third fire simulation fire sources are arranged in the underground building area, at least one controller is buried in the underground pipe gallery area, the controller is connected with an external power supply, and the first fire simulation components, the second fire simulation components and the third fire simulation sources are respectively connected with a controller through wires. The test device simulates earthquake influence through the vibrating table, and simulates the conditions of secondary fire and fire spread caused by the earthquake influence.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on big data and image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on big data and image recognition, which belongs to the technical field of computers, and is characterized in that big data analysis is carried out through historical disaster images filed by the existing professionals, so that an image change key dimension trend of disaster occurrence and an image database of critical disaster occurrence are obtained; the method and the system have the advantages that various preconditions of disaster occurrence under various scenes are obtained based on big data analysis, the data are more accurate, a disaster critical big database is created, the site conditions and the threshold value of the disaster can be calculated in a closed loop mode, the data comparison is automatic, the efficiency is higher, the accuracy is higher, the threshold value can be automatically updated in a closed loop mode, and various disasters can be tracked and simulated. Under certain condition judgment, the disaster occurrence can be early-warned and forecasted in real time.
assignees: BEIJING ZHIXIANG BEIDOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster real-time online monitoring and alarming method based on 5G and Beidou communication intelligent self-switching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster real-time online monitoring and alarming method based on 5G and Beidou communication intelligent self-switching, which is characterized in that real-time data in multiple aspects are collected through a control terminal in cooperation with a 5G network and a Beidou communication module, position data, height data, image data, geological change data in each time period and meteorological data in the area are respectively collected and stored, an image identification module and an image operation module are utilized in cooperation with a data calculation module to compare the real-time change data with historical data and calculate in real time, if a geological disaster situation occurs, an early warning model monitors abnormity, and an alarming module is matched to transmit alarming information to the control terminal and a database server at the same time. According to the method, the turning points of the accelerated deformation stage and the rapid deformation stage of each image geological disaster are determined to obtain corresponding monitoring and early warning values, and repeated training is performed to eliminate geological changes and abnormal change values in a normal range, so that the risk warning accuracy of the geological disasters can be effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING ZHIXIANG BEIDOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Experimental device for be used for simulating gliding of rock block
abstract_en: The invention relates to an experimental device for simulating the sliding of a rock block, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control. The device comprises a rock block sliding platform with a variable angle, a sliding panel and an object accommodating adjusting device; the sliding panel is arranged on the variable-angle rock block sliding platform; the variable-angle rock block sliding platform comprises a first panel, a second panel and a first angle adjusting device, wherein the first panel and the second panel are oppositely arranged, and the first angle adjusting device is arranged between the first panel and the second panel. The object-placing adjusting device comprises lateral baffles arranged on two sides of a rock, a shaft arranged in the lateral baffles, a ball bearing arranged on the shaft and a cushion cover arranged at two ends of the ball bearing. The invention can fully simulate the conditions of the attitude, the surface form, the opening degree and the filling degree of the structural surface in the rock block body and judge the motion states of the rock block body sliding along the plane and the wedge body sliding along the double surfaces under the multi-parameter action of the structural surface.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning method and system for seawater invasion to underground water
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for monitoring and early warning of seawater invasion to underground water, and relates to the field of underground water management and engineering. A monitoring and early warning method for seawater invasion to underground water comprises the following steps: establishing an unsaturated underground water flow and heat flow transmission model, and drawing distribution coordinates of underground water level and seawater intrusion monitoring points; carrying out discrete analysis on the distribution coordinates of the seawater intrusion monitoring points and the change time of the underground water level so as to determine the seawater intrusion range in the detection area; performing model training on the unsaturated underground water flow and heat flow transmission model by using an RNN (neural network), establishing a prediction model, and calculating the seawater intrusion probability of the distribution coordinates of each seawater intrusion monitoring point; and calculating the seawater intrusion early warning level of the distribution coordinate of each seawater intrusion monitoring point according to the seawater intrusion probability of the distribution coordinate of each seawater intrusion monitoring point. The method can predict and early warn the tendency that the underground water suffers from seawater invasion disasters.

title_en: Test simulation method and system for dumping disaster in high slope digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a test simulation method for dumping disasters in a high slope digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of arranging a simulation system, completely aligning cracks between a high-level disaster body parent rock part and a dumping deformation part, and filling gas into an air bag; the method comprises the steps of taking initial photos of a high-level disaster body parent rock part and a high-level disaster body dumping deformation part, discharging preset proportion of gas in an air bag, taking real-time photos of the high-level disaster body parent rock part and the dumping deformation part, repeating the steps of three and four until the high-level disaster body dumping deformation part falls off from an inclined supporting plate, and taking the taken initial photos and the real-time photos as machine learning materials. Therefore, the method constructs a test system for realizing the dumping instability of the slope disaster body, and realizes the simulation of the dumping disaster in the digital twin technology of the high slope. The application also discloses a test simulation system for dumping disasters in the high slope digital twin technology.

title_en: Underground hole roadway transient electromagnetic probe capable of being self-adaptively centered
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transient electromagnetic probe capable of being self-adaptively centered for an underground hole and roadway, relates to the technical field of underground water body detection, and solves the problems that when the diameter of a drilled hole is larger than the diameter of the probe, the probe cannot be centered in the hole, the detection accuracy of the probe is further influenced, and the detection of coal mine disaster-causing water bodies is not facilitated, and the technical scheme is characterized in that: the ABS elastic piece detection device comprises a detection rod, wherein an electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) assembly is fixedly installed at the upper end of the detection rod, a protective cover is sleeved outside the upper end of the detection rod, a top cone head is fixedly installed at one end, away from the detection rod, of the protective cover, installation grooves are formed in the outer ring surface of the detection rod at intervals, uniformly distributed positioning holes are respectively formed in the detection rod through the upper end and the lower end of each installation groove, and ABS elastic pieces are respectively installed at the two ends, through the positioning holes, of the detection rod; when the electromagnetic probe enters the drill holes with different apertures, the probe is always positioned in the middle of the drill hole, so that the disaster water body can be conveniently detected, and the detection accuracy is improved.
assignees: Huajin coking coal co ltd;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Monitoring alarm equipment for detecting coal mine geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model provides a monitoring alarm device for detecting coal mine geological disasters, which relates to the technical field of monitoring alarm and is used for solving the problems that the fixing effect of the monitoring alarm device is poor, the physical consumption is increased during pit digging, the original structure of a soil layer is greatly damaged, and the monitoring of the monitoring alarm device on the coal mine geological disasters is influenced, and comprises a frame, wherein a first clamping block and a second clamping block are respectively clamped on the inner wall of the bottom of the frame, a perforating drill bit is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the first clamping block, the perforating drill bit is driven to rotate by the arranged perforating drill bit, a conical column, a driving gear, a driven gear, a motor, a hollow column and a handrail, so that the perforating drill bit and the conical column are rotated and inserted into the coal mine geology, the whole device is conveniently and quickly fixed, the device is stably and vertically inserted into the coal mine geology by the arrangement of the handrail, and the pit digging is not needed, original structure destruction of soil layer is little for monitoring alarm device is accurate to colliery geological disasters' monitoring.

title_en: Emergency evacuation slide device for prefabricated house
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergent evacuation slide device of activity board house, including the slide, the slide includes the suit at least three steel cylinder slide section together, the slide is installed on braced frame, and the top fixed connection of first order slide section is provided with the trigger switch subassembly on the braced frame, the trigger switch subassembly includes the fixed pin and has the button of push rod, sets up a fixed orifices on the braced frame that is higher than slide mounted position, and in the fixed orifices was packed into to the fixed pin from the one end of fixed orifices, the front end of push rod was packed into the fixed orifices from the other end of fixed orifices in, the length of push rod was greater than the degree of depth of fixed orifices, the end of terminal slide section is passed through the rope and is connected the fixed pin. The utility model is used for safely and rapidly evacuating personnel in the temporary prefabricated house, has high evacuation efficiency, can be used only by being installed outside a building, and occupies less building space; has no physical requirement on the evacuees and can be mastered without training.
assignees: CHINA CHEMICAL ENG SECOND CONSTRUCTION CORPORATION

title_en: Method for determining position of forest fire ignition point by sampling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining the position of a forest fire by a sampling method, which integrates regional data to be researched, and forms a grid data set by a grid mode, wherein the data mainly comprises three types, namely: terrain data, meteorological data, combustible data; then acquiring a fire spreading boundary of the research area to form a vector polygon; traversing each grid data in the fire disaster area, spreading fire disaster according to the existing forest fire model, and comparing the simulation result with an actual boundary; the higher the overlap ratio, the greater the probability that the wire mesh is a fire. The method can quickly and effectively determine the position of the fire source by simulating and spreading each grid and comparing the simulated spread with the actual boundary.

title_en: Industrial robot disassembly sequence planning method considering product part failure characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for planning a disassembly sequence of an industrial robot by considering the failure characteristics of product parts, which comprises the following steps: constructing an incidence relation model of the disassembly time of the product failure part to other parts facing the disassembly process; establishing a disassembly information model; constructing an environment model facing to the problem of the planning of the disassembly sequence of the industrial robot, and determining the mapping relation between each element and the planning model of the disassembly sequence; constructing a double-layer network structure of a decision network and a target network, introducing an experience playback mechanism, and training a neural network to obtain a better network model; and finally, acquiring an optimal disassembly sequence of the disassembled product through a decision network model obtained by deep reinforcement learning. The invention considers the influence relation of the part failure characteristics on the product disassembling process, discloses a deep reinforcement learning method for solving the problem of planning the disassembling sequence of the industrial robot, solves the problem of dimension disaster when the state space is large, and is beneficial to improving the efficiency of the industrial robot in disassembling waste products.

title_en: Evacuation exit setting method and device in crowd emergency evacuation scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for setting evacuation exits in crowd emergency evacuation scenes, and relates to the technical field of evacuation simulation. The method comprises the following specific steps: constructing a simulation model based on a social force model, and acquiring behavior parameters of the evacuated crowd in an emergency evacuation scene by a numerical approximation method by taking actual trajectory data of the individuals in the evacuated crowd in a specific emergency evacuation scene as reference; setting an evacuation exit set, constructing an evacuation exit decision integer planning scheme, and acquiring the total evacuation cost of evacuation exits in the emergency evacuation scene according to the simulation model; and taking reduction of the total evacuation cost as an optimization target, constructing an emergency evacuation optimization model according to constraint conditions, and solving the emergency evacuation optimization model to obtain a recommended evacuation exit decision integer planning scheme. The evacuation exit decision making method and the system improve the evacuation efficiency by obtaining the behavior parameters to obtain the crowd behavior characteristics and optimizing the evacuation exit decision making scheme.

title_en: Simulation method for simulating cascading failure state of power grid under typhoon disaster effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for simulating a power grid cascading failure state under the typhoon disaster action, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a circulating wind field model and a traveling wind field model of typhoon according to a typhoon data set, then establishing a typhoon space-time distribution model, then drawing a power grid element vulnerability curve to obtain the damage probability of the power grid element under different wind speeds, abstracting a working state set of the power grid element into a Markov state, and constructing a state transfer model of a power system to generate a failure power grid element set of the power system at different moments under the typhoon action; the invention considers the space-time characteristics of typhoon disasters, combines the vulnerability analysis of power grid elements, provides a power grid fault sampling simulation method, can realize the real-time prediction of the fault state of each element and partition of the power grid, accurately simulates the influence of extreme typhoons on the power grid, provides an effective reference basis for the normal operation and the real-time maintenance of the power grid in disasters, and is suitable for wide popularization and use.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Multi-source information fusion intelligent early warning method and device for coal and gas outburst
abstract_en: The application discloses multisource information fusion intelligent early warning method and device for coal and gas outburst, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out advanced detection on the gas geological abnormal body based on drilling and in-hole geophysical prospecting, and calculating an advanced detection characteristic index according to the geological abnormal type and the advanced distance; real-time monitoring is carried out on the ground stress and the coal bed gas based on the microseismic signals and the gas emission data, and real-time monitoring characteristic indexes are calculated according to the microseismic event rate, the microseismic signal duration time, the microseismic signal amplitude, the microseismic signal peak frequency and the gas emission; measuring coal bed gas while drilling, and calculating a detection characteristic index while drilling; performing fusion analysis on the multi-source heterogeneous data to determine a comprehensive early warning danger index; and after the early warning threshold value is determined based on big data and machine learning, comparing the early warning threshold value with the comprehensive early warning danger index, and executing corresponding early warning. The method can comprehensively monitor a plurality of key disaster causing factors, accurately identify the danger level of coal and gas outburst and facilitate early warning in time.

title_en: Sugarcane multi-disaster meteorological disaster early warning method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sugarcane multi-disaster meteorological disaster early warning method with multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, which comprises the following steps: step S1, collecting a large amount of sugarcane meteorological disaster multi-source heterogeneous data, including news data, meteorological disaster data, historical meteorological data, weather forecast data and satellite remote sensing image data; step S2, aiming at multi-source heterogeneous data with different structures, different feature extraction mechanisms are adopted to extract data features; and step S3, constructing a graph neural network multi-source heterogeneous data fusion generation network, taking the extracted features as input, taking the real sugarcane meteorological disaster information condition as a label, and training the network to obtain a prediction model for predicting the sugarcane meteorological disasters. The invention establishes a multi-disaster prediction model through the graph neural network, and carries out nonlinear transformation after node information is gathered before prediction, thereby increasing the expression capability of the model and improving the prediction precision.

title_en: Coal seam floor water inrush identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal seam floor water inrush identification method, which is characterized in that a stress simplified model of a coal seam floor is established based on a semi-infinite theory, and based on the stress simplified model, the total floor stress component of the coal seam floor is obtained according to the depth of a coal seam, rock stratum parameters, advance support pressure, original rock stress, floor gravity and pressure-bearing water pressure, so that the reliability of identifying a water inrush channel of the coal seam floor is improved. In addition, the identification result is verified by adopting numerical simulation, and the water inrush danger area of the water inrush channel is determined based on the verification result and combined with microseismic monitoring, so that the advantages of three methods of identifying the water inrush channel based on rock stratum parameters, numerical simulation and microseismic monitoring can be effectively fused, the identification accuracy of the water inrush danger area is improved, and a reliable basis is provided for preventing and treating water inrush disasters of a coal seam floor.
assignees: SHENHUA SHENDONG COAL GROUP CORP LTD;NAT INST CLEAN & LOW CARBON ENERGY;CHN ENERGY INVEST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of social media disaster effective information detection model
abstract_en: The application provides a method for constructing a social media disaster effective information detection model, which is used for extracting the theme information of a short text through CRFTM, and then fusing the theme information to train the BERT model on detecting disaster effectiveness, so that the training cost is reduced, the detection precision of the model is improved, and the detection performance of the model is remarkably improved. The method comprises the steps of obtaining user release information on a target social media platform, extracting subject information in the user release information through CRFTM, merging short texts in the user release information into a pseudo document with longer text length through CRFTM in the extraction processing process, extracting the subject information from the pseudo document through combination of word vectors and word related knowledge, and training a BERT model to identify disaster effective information in input data by taking the subject information as training data, wherein the disaster effective information refers to information helpful for responding to specific disaster events.

title_en: Method, device, storage medium and equipment for predicting price of financial derivatives
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a storage medium and equipment for predicting the price of a financial derivative. The prediction method comprises the following steps: dividing the acquired financial derivative transaction history data set into a disaster-free transaction data set and a plurality of types of disaster transaction data sets according to the time sequence and the disaster type; training a disaster-free transaction data set as a training sample to obtain a disaster-free prediction submodel, sequentially training each type of disaster transaction data set as a training sample to obtain a disaster-containing prediction submodel, and forming a total prediction model by the disaster-free prediction submodel and a plurality of disaster-containing prediction models; and inputting the data to be predicted acquired in real time into the total prediction model to obtain a price prediction sequence result of the financial derivatives. The original data set is divided and then corresponding prediction models are trained respectively, so that the problem of sparsity of disaster data is effectively solved, meanwhile, the original data set is not simplified, more information is reserved, and the prediction accuracy is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: Fire risk assessment method, system, terminal equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire risk assessment method, a fire risk assessment system, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the fire risk assessment method comprises the following steps: constructing a fire risk structural equation model, training the fire risk structural equation model to obtain a model output parameter, displaying the model output parameter through a knowledge graph, and obtaining a path coefficient in the model output parameter; acquiring a dynamic fire development influence parameter, and determining fire development trend probability through a dynamic Bayesian network based on the dynamic fire development influence parameter and the path coefficient; and obtaining a dynamic fire evaluation network based on the fire evolution trend probability, a preset dynamic fire evaluation index system and preset expert knowledge, so as to quantitatively evaluate the risk of the fire through the dynamic fire evaluation network. The invention can improve the evaluation efficiency when the risk evaluation is carried out on the dynamic fire disaster.

title_en: CART decision tree fire disaster image recognition method based on optimal combination of color features
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CART decision tree fire disaster image recognition method based on an optimal combination of color features, which comprises the following steps: constructing a fire image and a non-fire image sample set, and randomly dividing the fire image and the non-fire image sample set into a training sample set and a test sample set; extracting color characteristics of a fire and non-fire sample library based on Lab, RGB, HSV three color modes; searching optimal characteristics based on the fine decision tree under a Lab, RGB, HSV color mode to obtain an optimal characteristic combination set; training the CART decision tree model based on the obtained optimal feature combination set and the training sample set to obtain an optimal CART decision tree model; and inputting the test sample set into an optimal CART decision tree model to finish the identification of the fire image. The fire image recognition method based on the CART decision tree fusion of the fire image color features has higher accuracy in the fire image recognition, has obviously better effect than other decision tree methods, can better represent the image fire types, and provides a method foundation for fire accident prevention.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for identifying fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for identifying a fire target, which relate to the field of target detection and comprise the following steps: acquiring a plurality of fire images containing smoke or flame, and labeling the smoke or flame in the fire images to generate training samples; establishing an initial model based on a YOLO network structure, and configuring parameters; in the initial model, a compression and excitation network module is arranged after convolution, and weight distribution is carried out on the image after convolution on channel dimension; setting a convolution block attention module behind the convolution block, so that the image passing through the convolution block passes through the channel attention module and the space attention module in sequence to perform weight distribution on the channel dimension and the space dimension respectively again; training the initial model by adopting the training sample to obtain a target model for identifying smoke or flame; the method comprises the steps of collecting a real-time image, adopting a target model to carry out target identification on the real-time image, obtaining a target result, and solving the problem that the existing image processing-based fire disaster prevention is poor in precision and slow in finding.
assignees: ZHAOTONG LIANGFENGTAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent marine disaster monitoring system and method based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine disaster intelligent monitoring system and method based on data analysis, and belongs to the technical field of deep learning.
