The method is characterized by constructing a sea wave prediction model based on an LSTM algorithm, deepening a network structure, improving the algorithm, inputting historical ocean monitoring data for repeated iterative training, outputting the prediction model with the maximum mAP value, establishing the accuracy of a prediction model evaluation mechanism, and outputting and judging disaster loss possibly caused by sea waves; the invention builds the prediction of sea waves, improves the prevention and the response capability of ocean disasters, and makes public service of ocean pre-alarming well, is different from the model building in a numerical prediction method which needs a complex model, builds the prediction of the sea waves macroscopically, builds the prediction model based on the LSTM network, does not need to pay attention to how the factors influencing the sea waves act on the sea waves, helps to analyze the generation reason of the sea waves on the basis of a high-precision sea wave prediction model, and realizes the intelligent evaluation and intelligent control of the sea wave disasters.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ACADEMY OF MARINE SCIENCES ZHEJIANG OCEAN TECH SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Power system elasticity evaluation method considering cascading failure evolution under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system elasticity evaluation method considering cascading failure evolution under typhoon disasters, and relates to the field of power system analysis. The method comprises the steps of generating a fault scene through a power transmission line fault model under a typhoon disaster; utilizing a cascading failure evolution model based on short and long time scales to simulate cascading failures and an evolution process thereof of a power system caused by transient stability and thermal stability problems; and (4) evaluating the elasticity index value of the power system according to the system performance condition by combining a power system recovery model and adopting a sequential Monte Carlo simulation method. Compared with the electric power system elastic evaluation method without considering cascading failure evolution, the method can effectively simulate the initial failure condition and cascading failure evolution process caused by typhoon disasters, is more comprehensive and objective in describing the failure scene and closer to the actual failure development condition of the electric power system under the typhoon disasters, so that the elastic evaluation result is more accurate, and is beneficial to accurately evaluating the ability of the electric power system to cope with the typhoon disasters by power grid operators and formulating a targeted recovery strategy.

title_en: Drought disaster weather prediction method based on semi-supervised integrated learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semi-supervised and integrated learning, in particular to a drought disaster weather prediction method based on semi-supervised and integrated learning, which constructs a dynamic selection sample data algorithm in a self-training based semi-supervised learning algorithm, sample data can be dynamically selected according to confidence level of model in the process of training samples for label-free data prediction, and model training efficiency is effectively improved while higher accuracy is ensured. The selective integrated learning pruning algorithm based on target maximization cuckoo optimization can meet the precision of the base learners and the difference between the base learners to the greatest extent, adopts multiple angles to carry out selective integration, has better generalization performance, and has higher algorithm operation efficiency and model precision. The method can be used for predicting the dry and arid disaster weather in the meteorological field.

title_en: Double-layer water damage treatment method based on regional treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer water disaster treatment method based on regional treatment, which comprises the following steps: step A), analyzing the hydrogeological conditions of the treatment area: starting from the analysis of parameters of aquifers of a treatment region, analyzing belonged conditions of hydrogeological conditions of the treatment region on the premise that a coal mining layer is threatened by a coal-series thin limestone aquifer and has hidden hydrogeological conditions of a vertical water diversion channel; step B), a treatment scheme arrangement technical method based on the ground area treatment technology comprises the following steps: corresponding hole distribution modes are set according to hydrogeological conditions of different conditions, and the threat of an Ordovician limestone aquifer and a coal-series thin-layer limestone aquifer to mining is thoroughly removed. The invention creatively solves the technical problem of close-range double-layer water disaster control of the mine with complex hydrogeological conditions by adopting the drilling arrangement technical method.
assignees: JIZHONG ENERGY FENGFENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Deep learning-based railway roadbed fender equipment service state evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based method for evaluating service state of railway roadbed retaining equipment, and relates to the technical field of intelligent evaluation of railway roadbed engineering disasters. The method comprises the steps of collecting service state images of railway subgrade protective equipment in an evaluation area of multi-source roads; classifying the damage types; carrying out impurity removal treatment on the acquired service state image of the railway roadbed shielding equipment, and training a railway roadbed shielding equipment damage type recognition network model to carry out damage type recognition; clustering the identified damage types of the railway roadbed shielding equipment, and calculating the damage disease occupancy of the railway roadbed shielding equipment with various damage types; calculating the damage degree grade score of the railway roadbed shielding equipment; calculating the damage weight of the railway roadbed retaining equipment; and evaluating the service state of the railway roadbed shielding equipment. The invention has the advantages of high detection speed and high detection precision, can more easily meet the requirement of real-time property, and has higher robustness and expandability.

title_en: Aerial image-based personnel evacuation simulation method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a personnel evacuation simulation method, a system and equipment based on aerial images, and relates to the technical field of personnel evacuation simulation. The method comprises the following steps: extracting scenes of different space types from the aerial image according to the image scene characteristics to obtain a first image representing the scenes of different space types by different colors; discretizing the first image through a preset rectangle to obtain a second image formed by a plurality of cell spaces; determining the space attribute of each cellular space according to a preset color rule, wherein the space attribute comprises a walking space and a non-walking space; establishing a pedestrian motion field simulating pedestrians under a cellular automaton model based on a walking space and a non-walking space; according to the pedestrian movement rule, the pedestrian evacuation simulation is carried out by utilizing the pedestrian motion field, the personnel evacuation time is recorded, the personnel evacuation time can be quickly and accurately obtained, and quick and effective evacuation guide can be provided for personnel evacuation in real life.

title_en: Water tank device for simulating debris flow starting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a basin device that simulation mud-rock flow started relates to natural disasters research technical field, and in the current simulation mud-rock flow start-up process, because the basin width is fixed, the slope rate is fixed, often can't simulate the width of mud-rock flow, side thing source supply condition, can only simulate one section or both ends to the different slope rates of channel simultaneously, and can not simulate the problem of the simulation condition of the different channel environment of syllogic, the scheme as follows is put forward now, including support frame one, the top of support frame one is fixed with the water tank, the right side of water tank is fixed with channel one, the right side of channel one articulates there is channel two, the right side of channel two articulates there is channel three. The utility model discloses a can simulate different channel slope rates, the condition of syllogic can simulate different sides simultaneously and supply the condition of (different side slope rates), and the water tank in supporting upper reaches in addition can simulate the start-up, the motion and the process of piling up of mud-rock flow.

title_en: Immersive natural disaster simulation experience device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an immersive natural disaster simulation experience device, which comprises an experience room, a flood disaster simulation room, an ice disaster simulation room, a flood experience pool, a debris flow experience pool, flood disaster weather simulation equipment and ice disaster weather simulation equipment; the flood weather simulation equipment comprises a first fan, a first water sprayer, a second fan, a second water sprayer, a strobe light and a first sound box; the ice disaster weather simulation equipment comprises a third fan, a refrigerator, a third water sprayer and a second sound box; the weather of blowing, raining, lightning and thunder when can simulate flood through first fan, first sprinkler, strobe light and first stereo set and take place can simulate the weather of blowing, raining, lightning and thunder when the mud-rock flow takes place through second fan, second sprinkler, strobe light and first stereo set, through third fan, refrigerator, third sprinkler and second stereo set, can simulate the weather of blowing, low temperature, rain and thunder when the ice disaster takes place.
assignees: SHENZHEN NIGULA ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning method and a geological disaster monitoring and early warning system, which comprise the following steps: establishing a landslide model; setting a second monitoring point group on the landslide model; loading the landslide model to the landslide body instability, and recording a second data group; forming a time course data set; training a neural network model by taking the instability of a landslide body as a constraint condition to generate an early warning model; and taking the data monitored by the first monitoring point group as a first data group, and inputting the first data group into an early warning model to monitor and early warn the target landslide. According to the landslide prediction method, through modeling analysis on the landslide, the situation of the landslide body after the preset time is predicted in a deep learning mode, sufficient coping time can be strived before the landslide is unstable, schemes such as reinforcement and evacuation can be effectively realized, and risks brought by geological disasters are reduced.

title_en: Generalized interpolation object particle method-based subway tunnel explosion accident hazard evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the hazard of an explosion accident of a subway tunnel based on a generalized interpolation material point method. The method utilizes a generalized interpolation material dot method to carry out explicit dynamic solution on a three-dimensional model of a subway tunnel structure and surrounding rock-soil bodies under the action of explosion. And finally, quantitatively calculating the model response under the explosion action, and obtaining the subareas of the personnel injury grade and the structure injury grade according to the overpressure calculation result and the injury factor calculation result, thereby quantitatively evaluating the hazard of the explosion accident. The method makes up the defects of the traditional experience-based qualitative evaluation, overcomes the numerical difficulty of the traditional finite element simulation method caused by grid distortion during explosion simulation, provides a set of feasible quantitative evaluation method for harmfulness, has a certain practical application value, has a positive propulsion effect on the formulation of a special emergency plan, and has a guiding significance on post-disaster first-aid repair and later-stage recovery work.

title_en: High polymer grouting emergency disposal equipment and method for water inrush and mud inrush of tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses high polymer grouting emergency treatment equipment and a method for water inrush and mud inrush in tunnels, wherein the equipment comprises: the device comprises a drilling machine, a high polymer grouting machine, a power system, an auxiliary system and a central control system, so that continuous automation of drilling, proportioning and grouting of the high polymer is realized. The method has the characteristics of high construction speed, simplicity in operation and flexibility, and can be used for quickly repairing water and mud bursting disasters of the tunnel, shortening the construction period of tunnel construction under complex geological conditions, reducing the construction cost and prolonging the service life of the tunnel. The invention can rapidly plug the tunnel with water inrush and mud inrush, fully improve the treatment capability and the service life of the water inrush and mud inrush disaster in tunnel construction and tunnel operation, and generate remarkable economic and social benefits.
assignees: SHANXI COMMUNICATION SCIENCE AND TECH R & D CO LTD

title_en: Project backup and recovery technology based on reading booth system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of backup, and discloses a project backup and recovery technology based on a reading kiosk system, wherein a backup script is executed in a manual or timing task mode, and the contents of backup data of the reading kiosk system are mainly three types: the system comprises data of a database, project codes and audio/video picture data, wherein the database mainly uses a Mysql relational database management system. The method has the advantages that the high availability and disaster recoverability of the system are improved, when the data system crashes, the data backup can be quickly found for recovery, the optimal scheme with the minimum cost of data recovery is provided, compared with the traditional scheme that a client or a technician simulates the client to refill data or upload data, the scheme is low in cost, project business can be quickly recovered normally, and manpower, material resources and time are saved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU YOUGU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent analysis method and system for atmospheric quality of industrial park
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent analysis method for the atmospheric quality of an industrial park, which comprises the steps of determining the industrial park and an analysis time period; acquiring the concentration, the discharge position, the discharge amount and the chemical composition of pollutants monitored by all preset monitoring points in an industrial park in an analysis time period so as to draw a change curve of monitoring data; acquiring meteorological data, and processing the meteorological data by combining the concentration, the discharge position, the discharge amount and the chemical composition of pollutants at each monitoring point through a pre-trained atmospheric diffusion model to obtain a pollution source diffusion simulation curve; and comparing the pollution source diffusion simulation curve with the change curve of the monitoring data, and iterating to obtain a pollution source diffusion rule so as to calculate the actual emission and the source of the extra emission of each monitoring point. By implementing the method, the VOCs pollution source tracing of the park can be realized, and the intelligent data analysis can be performed from the perspective of industrial park treatment measures, so that the support on scenes such as key pollutant forecast early warning, emergency evacuation aid decision making, comprehensive treatment and the like can be realized.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SOS TECH CO LTD;UNIV WENZHOU

title_en: SUMO simulation-based vehicle evacuation scheme generation and visualization method
abstract_en: A SUMO simulation-based vehicle evacuation scheme generation and visualization method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a road network required by simulation, adjusting road network parameters to be consistent with the real world, and setting initial parameters of an evacuation environment; secondly, reading road network data, screening, classifying and generating a data object; then generating an evacuation path according to different calculation methods; then generating a vehicle path file according to the evacuation path; finally, the simulation flow of vehicle evacuation is visually displayed by means of the SUMO and the browser, and real-time simulation details can be inquired and simulation results can be viewed. The invention can utilize the road network parameters closer to the real world, consider more evacuation influence factors such as waiting time and generate the evacuation path of the vehicle by a plurality of methods; and the details of the vehicle simulation are visualized, queried in real time and queried as a result by means of the SUMO and the browser.

title_en: Interactive practical training platform for VR (virtual reality) in accident disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accident disaster scene VR interactive practical training platform which comprises a storage cabinet body and a protective frame, wherein the top surface of the storage cabinet body is open, the protective frame is vertically fixed on the edge of the top surface of the storage cabinet body, supporting shafts are transversely and rotatably connected to the middle parts of two sides of the protective frame, the supporting shafts are transversely coaxial, a display platform body capable of transversely overturning is fixed between the supporting shafts, the display platform body is horizontally arranged, and the periphery of the display platform body is not in contact with the protective frame. Has the advantages that: according to the indoor VR display scene component and the outdoor VR display scene component, which are used for displaying an indoor accident disaster scene and an outdoor accident disaster scene are respectively and integrally arranged on the top surface and the bottom surface of the display platform body, so that the indoor accident disaster scene and the outdoor accident disaster scene are obviously distinguished and separated, the simulation training confusion caused by the mixing of the indoor accident disaster scene and the outdoor accident disaster scene is avoided, and the simulation training effect of the accident disaster scene is favorably improved.
assignees: ZHONG AN TAI SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dam break flow interface tracking method based on SOLA-VOF
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster simulation, and discloses a dam break flow interface tracking method based on SOLA-VOF (system-object oriented architecture), which comprises a SOLA-VOF algorithm, wherein the SOLA-VOF algorithm comprises the following steps: firstly, a control equation is set, dam break flow is set to be two-dimensional incompressible laminar flow, and the adopted control equation is as follows: continuity equation: the invention adopts an improved SOLA-VOF method to simulate the evolution process of a dam-break flow interface and analyzes the interface tension and wall adhesionThe effect of interfacial flow. The contrast analysis can obtain, (1) the improved donor-acceptor algorithm can improve the calculation precision, effectively reduce the trivial fluid impurities on the interface and smooth the interface curve; (2) the dam break flow process simulated by the algorithm is well matched with the literature result; (3) the interfacial tension has an inhibiting effect on the flow and slows down the extension of the fluid; (4) the better the wetting of the fluid with the wall, the better the fluid flow ductility.

title_en: Mining-induced high-level fractured space grouting repair method
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a mining-induced high-level fractured space grouting repair method, comprising: collecting in a mining area a coal mining interval of roofing breaking and a coal mining thickness; determining the position of a primary key stratum; determining the fracture form of the primary key stratum, delimiting a water guide fissure area, and, by using a horizontal directional drilling mode, carrying out horizontal drilling along a rock stratum above the primary key stratum and along a rock stratum below the primary key stratum; arranging grouting holes in an area where a bed separation has not been formed in a high-level bed separation zone, starting grouting by a ground grouting station, pumping large slurry particles to the high-level bed separation, plugging, by means of grouting pressure, lower bed separation fissures of the primary key stratum and lower fissures of the primary key stratum, pumping fine particles to a fissure-zone bed separation, and, by means of slurry pressure, plugging upper fissures of the primary key stratum; first grouting the bed separation, and, after the bed separation is grouted, continuing the advance of a working face; and repeating the above steps until the mining is finished. The method of the present invention is reliable and highly practical, and can reduce the probability of occurrence and the extent of harm of a water disaster and a gas disaster for coal mining in the mining area.

title_en: Tunnel fire advanced prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting a fire disaster in a tunnel in advance, which comprises the following steps: establishing a fire model, and acquiring fire data under different working conditions according to the fire model; processing fire data under different working conditions, and establishing a fire database according to the processed fire data under different working conditions; establishing a fire prediction model, and dividing fire data under different working conditions in a fire database into a training set, a verification set and a test set so as to train the fire prediction model according to the training set and the verification set to obtain a trained fire prediction model; inputting the test set into a trained fire prediction module to obtain prediction data; establishing a data assimilation model, and performing data fusion on the prediction data and the real-time observation data according to the data assimilation model so as to correct the prediction data and obtain the optimal state estimation of the real-time fire; therefore, the method can be used for predicting the tunnel fire in advance, so that the real-time performance and the accuracy of the prediction of the tunnel fire are improved.

title_en: Slope deformation monitor and method for rapid layout and release in high mountain canyon region
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope deformation monitor and a method for rapid arrangement and release in a high mountain canyon region, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring equipment. The technical problems that a landslide deformation monitor is poor in monitoring precision and real-time dynamic performance are solved. The technical scheme is as follows: the monitor comprises a battery box, a fixing groove, a sliding rod, a sliding sleeve, a plurality of pin rods, a plurality of solar panels, a plurality of blades, a buffer gasket, a GPS chip, a plurality of barbs and a drill bit; the monitoring method comprises the following steps: s1, equipment configuration; s2, preparing for monitoring; s3, arranging a monitor; s4, sampling by a monitor; s5, issuing an early warning; and S6, recovering the monitoring device. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention has the characteristics of convenient operation, convenient carrying, energy conservation, environmental protection, wide application and recycling.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Three-dimensional scene catastrophe monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional scene catastrophe monitoring and early warning method, which comprises the following steps: based on an improved seed region growing algorithm, carrying out segmentation processing on an original image to obtain a segmented original image; training a pre-constructed debris flow image recognition model according to the segmented original image to obtain a trained debris flow image recognition model; performing laser scanning on the monitoring area once every preset time period to obtain point cloud data of the current moment, and positioning the point cloud data based on a GNSS navigation system and an inertial navigation system to obtain standard laser point cloud data; obtaining an initial DEM based on standard laser point cloud data; filtering the initial DEM to obtain a final DEM; and carrying out geological disaster monitoring on the monitoring area by utilizing the trained debris flow image recognition model and the final DEM. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the monitoring and early warning of three-dimensional scene catastrophe can be realized, and the cost is reduced while the precision is improved.

title_en: Post-disaster crop yield value estimation method based on reinforcement learning of given agricultural disaster data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster crop yield value estimation method based on reinforcement learning of given agricultural disaster data, which is based on an original data set formed by historical meteorological agricultural disaster data and historical environmental information data, and comprises an agricultural disaster occurrence probability model, a simulated crop growth model, a multi-layer perceptron model and a primary post-disaster crop yield value estimation model; the invention provides an agricultural yield heterogeneous prediction network with environmental information coding aiming at the passage of harvest seasons, which is based on the Q learning algorithm, by combining the relevance among an environmental feature vector set, a historical weather agricultural disaster data dynamic variable and a historical environmental information data static variable, a dynamic static weather and agricultural associated data grouping data feature.

title_en: Slope disaster test simulation equipment capable of coupling mountain fire and rainfall effects
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope disaster test simulation device capable of coupling mountain fire and rainfall in the technical field of slope protection and geological disaster prevention, which comprises a movable trolley, a conveying and positioning device, a box body, a camera, a heating and spraying device, a forward and reverse speed regulating motor, a first transmission shaft, a measuring cup, a second transmission shaft, a first spline shaft spline sleeve component, a first electric mortise lock, a corrugated pipe and a manual telescopic rod, wherein a vegetable layer and a soil layer are respectively filled in the upper part and the lower part of the inner cavity of the box body, soil body state collecting instruments are respectively inserted in different depth positions of the soil layer, the flow and the direction of water spray are changed, the slope disaster under the strong wind environment is simulated, the distance between flame and the box body is changed to adjust the temperature, the slope disaster caused by the mountain fire is simulated, the device not only can singly simulate a certain disaster causing factor, but also can simulate the slope geological disaster caused by the coupling mountain fire and the rainfall together, the box body is convenient to move and carry, the position of the whole box body can be changed at will, and the box body is creative.
assignees: CHENGDU RUISIDA ENG DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Landslide and debris flow disaster rescue training scene simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide and debris flow disaster rescue training scene simulation system which comprises a mud-water spraying subsystem, a mud recovery subsystem and a training facility subsystem; the mud-water spraying subsystem is used for spraying mud and clear water to simulate a real environment, the mud recovery subsystem is used for recovering and recycling the mud, and the training facility subsystem is used for training rescue workers. The invention can restore real scene rescue, improve the rescue ability of search and rescue personnel in environments such as silt, mud and the like, and simultaneously can recycle the mud to avoid waste.

title_en: Firefighter training efficiency evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a firefighter training efficiency evaluation method, which comprises the following steps of firstly, acquiring corresponding human factor parameters of a firefighter to be evaluated through a wireless sensor; the human factor parameters comprise electrocardiosignals, myoelectric signals, pulse signals and respiratory signals; denoising the acquired human factor parameters by using flexible analytic wavelet transform FAWT and goblet sea squirt algorithm SSA; analyzing the signal time domain after denoising processing, and extracting a corresponding characteristic value; the extracted characteristic values comprise six characteristic values of a rectification average value, a variance, a form factor, a peak factor, skewness and kurtosis; and (4) calculating the training efficiency evaluation value of the firefighter to be evaluated by using the BP neural network according to the characteristic value extracted in the step (3), and giving a training suggestion according to the evaluation value. The method and the system combine the human factors engineering with the signal denoising, the data dimension reduction and other technologies, and solve the problem that the training efficiency of the firemen is difficult to evaluate.

title_en: Ground settlement modeling method based on near-field dynamics theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground settlement modeling method based on a near-field dynamics theory, belonging to the technical field of urban geological disaster simulation and prediction; the ground settlement research is combined with a near field dynamics theory newly proposed in the field of mechanics, a model of the near field dynamics theory is established on the basis of an integral equation, the problem of failure definition at discontinuous positions of objects is effectively avoided, space discontinuous structures such as fracture breakage and the like become a part of the model, and under the condition of not increasing additional function definition, the ground settlement, crack and collapse problems caused by effective stress change of a stratum after underground water exploitation are described by a unified equation; according to the method, a regional ground settlement numerical model containing spatial discontinuity phenomena such as cracks and subsidence is established under a unified framework, data support is provided for urban ground settlement simulation prediction and disaster prevention, and the phenomena of ground cracks and ground subsidence possibly occurring along with ground settlement evolution can be predicted and recognized under the condition of lacking prior knowledge.

title_en: Method for preventing upper corner gas from exceeding limit in source-dividing and flow-stopping three-dimensional extraction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mine gas disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a method for preventing upper corner gas from exceeding limit by adopting source-division intercepting three-dimensional extraction. S100, mining a stoping face and a next adjacent stoping face in a mining coal seam, and arranging an air inlet roadway of the next adjacent stoping face on one side of an air return roadway close to the stoping face; s200, constructing coal pillar penetrating gas extraction drill holes at intervals along the direction of the stope face in the air intake roadway of the next adjacent stope face; s300, drilling a top plate into an overlying coal seam at a high-position kilometer length in an air inlet roadway construction of the next adjacent stope face; s400, drilling a lower kilometer long hole in an air inlet roadway construction bottom plate of the next adjacent stope face into a lower coal seam; s500, pre-pumping gas in an overlying coal seam and a lower coal seam through a top plate high-position kilometer long drill hole and a bottom plate low-position kilometer long drill hole; s600, arranging coal pillar penetrating gas extraction drill holes on the face, close to one side of the stope face, of the air inlet roadway of the next adjacent stope face.

title_en: B737 airplane water evacuation practical training method based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a B737 airplane water evacuation practical training method based on a virtual reality technology, which is implemented based on an airplane water evacuation practical training system, wherein the system comprises a server, VR glasses and a VR handle; the following VR scenes are preset in the server: the method comprises the following steps of (1) carrying out an onboard evacuation scene, a water escape scene and a shipboard preparation scene, wherein training items are preset in each scene; the method comprises the following steps: after trainees sequentially complete all training items in one scene according to the guidance of the server by means of the VR glasses and the VR handle, the server automatically switches to the next scene in sequence, and after all training items in the last scene are completed, training is finished; the switching sequence of the VR scenes in the server is as follows: an onboard evacuation scene, a water escape scene and a shipboard preparation scene. The invention can be used for carrying out the water evacuation training of the airplane, and can obviously reduce the overall training cost of the airline company while obtaining good training effect.

title_en: Rural building slope cutting design method
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method for building a slope in a rural area, which comprises the steps of carrying out an indoor test after soil is taken on site to obtain rock-soil body parameters, carrying out different values on a plurality of parameters in the slope cutting parameters respectively, combining the parameters of the slope cutting parameters, and calculating slope cutting stability coefficients and potential sliding areas under various parameter combinations based on Geostodio simulation according to the rock-soil body parameters; obtaining a fitting formula of a slope cutting stability coefficient and a slope cutting parameter and a fitting formula of a potential sliding area and the slope cutting parameter through multivariate fitting; and obtaining the house design safety distance according to a slope cutting type landslide disaster movement distance formula based on the potential sliding area. The technical scheme provided by the invention has the beneficial effects that: the method is characterized in that physical and mechanical parameters of rock and soil mass in a research area are determined by adopting an indoor test, the tangent slope stability coefficient and the potential sliding area under different parameter combinations are calculated based on Geostudio simulation and multivariate nonlinear fitting, and the design method of the rural house building tangent slope scheme is provided by combining the movement distance of the tangent slope type landslide.

title_en: Mechanical equipment hierarchical fault diagnosis method based on self-adaptive hierarchical clustering and Subset
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of predicting mechanical faults by utilizing big data, in particular to a mechanical equipment hierarchical fault diagnosis method based on self-adaptive hierarchical clustering and Subset, which selects training samples without fault degree division under different fault types as input of the self-adaptive hierarchical clustering, adopts the self-adaptive hierarchical clustering to perform cluster analysis on the training samples without fault degree division under different fault types, and takes a clustering result of the fault types obtained according to vibration signals of mechanical equipment as an output result; the method comprises the steps of training different fault types, establishing SubDAE models according to fault degree classification, pre-training and integral fine tuning to accurately position fault points, improving the intelligence of the method, optimizing the use of features, simplifying feature sets, avoiding dimension disasters, reducing calculation load and improving the efficiency of fault diagnosis.

title_en: TOPSIS-based multi-rotor aircraft flight strategy real-time decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TOPSIS-based real-time decision method for a flight strategy of a multi-rotor aircraft, which belongs to the cross technical field of control engineering and management, and specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, simulating different types of faults based on an unmanned aerial vehicle flight simulation platform, injecting the faults into the flight states of the multi-rotor aircraft, collecting flight data under each fault condition in real time, and establishing a state evaluation information source; then, a state evaluation information source is utilized, a multi-rotor aircraft fault grade classification model is constructed based on a random forest algorithm, and fault types are divided into three grades of disaster, danger and slight; finally, constructing a multi-rotor aircraft real-time attribute decision model considering real-time environment and flight state of the multi-rotor aircraft for the multi-rotor aircraft with the fault type of danger or disaster; according to the method, the capability of solving the problems in the real-time state by different strategies is sequenced according to a sequencing method approaching to an ideal solution, so that flight decisions of the multi-rotor aircraft under different fault conditions are realized, and the flight safety is guaranteed.

title_en: Soil detection device for drought disaster general investigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil detection device for drought disaster general investigation, and belongs to the technical field of soil detection. A soil detection device for drought disaster general investigation comprises a drill bit, wherein a detection cylinder is arranged at the top of the drill bit, a soil detection mechanism is arranged in the detection cylinder, a mounting opening is formed in the detection cylinder, baffles are symmetrically arranged on the mounting opening, one end of each baffle is rotatably connected with the side wall of the mounting opening, and the soil detection mechanism is positioned on the inner side of the baffle; according to the invention, the drill bit is arranged at the bottom of the detection cylinder, when the detection cylinder is used for detecting soil in arid soil, the drill bit can be utilized to crush the arid soil, and meanwhile, the baffle plate on the detection cylinder is utilized to protect the soil detection mechanism in the detection cylinder, so that the trouble of taking out the soil for detection is avoided, and meanwhile, the soil detection mechanism is prevented from being damaged when the detection cylinder is used for extending into the soil.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF WATER RESOURCES FOR PASTERAL AREA MINI OF WATER RESOURCES

title_en: Debris flow easiness prediction method based on information quantity and random forest
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow easiness prediction method based on information quantity and random forests, which comprises the following steps: s100: selecting an influence factor aiming at a region to be predicted; s200: calculating the information quantity value of each influence factor according to an information quantity principle, and dividing the area to be predicted into different disaster risk grades; s300: determining the weight of each influence factor according to the information quantity value of each influence factor; s400: randomly generating non-debris flow points which are equal to the historical debris flow from the low incidence area and the lower incidence area; s500: combining the non-debris flow points and the historical debris flow points, and training a random forest to obtain a debris flow proneness model; s600: and dividing the area to be predicted into grid units based on the GIS, inputting each grid unit into the debris flow susceptibility model to obtain the debris flow susceptibility value of each grid unit, and thus dividing the disaster risk level of the area to be predicted again. The invention can improve the debris flow prediction accuracy; the practicability can be improved by combining with GIS.
assignees: CHENGLI ZHIYUAN TECH CHENGDU CO LTD

title_en: Storm surge risk assessment and disaster reduction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm surge risk assessment and disaster reduction method, which comprises the steps of carrying out multi-parameter acquisition on marine water quality, hydrology, weather and time-space information through online multi-parameter acquisition equipment, and carrying out gridding storage on acquired multi-parameter marine data; selecting surface feature types which are easily affected by ocean storm surge and sea wave to extract surface feature information, and obtaining a vector diagram of an area affected by the storm surge and the sea wave; the method comprises the steps of introducing a multi-source remote sensing image and a vector diagram of an affected area of storm surge and sea wave into a gridding storage model, superposing the multi-source remote sensing image and the vector diagram under the same coordinate system, and then carrying out multi-scale segmentation according to preset grid resolution to obtain a plurality of grid subregion images with longitude and latitude coordinates in the affected area; preprocessing the multi-parameter ocean data and the grid sub-region image by adopting a normalization method, and performing iterative training and verification in an RPN neural network model. The invention realizes the efficient evaluation of storm and tidal wind and the refined early warning, and reduces the prediction error.

title_en: Drilling method suitable for hydraulic slotting of cross-layer drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drilling method suitable for hydraulic slotting of cross-layer drilling, which belongs to the technical field of drilling exploitation and comprises the following steps: s1, calculating the position and depth of the drilled hole in real time according to the geological sudden change position and type of the target drilled hole in the horizontal drilling section, extending the hydraulic cutting seam drill bit into the drilled hole after the drilled hole reaches the designed depth, and judging the position and depth of the drilled hole in real time in the drilling process, so that the geological sudden change area in the drilling position can be avoided, disasters are reduced, and the safety performance of drilling operation is greatly improved; s2, starting a water pump, and performing hydraulic slotting after the pressure is stable; and S3, analyzing the coal outlet condition of the drill hole opening, continuing to go deep until no coal dust is gushed out of the hole opening, closing the water pump after hydraulic slotting of the drill hole coal section is completed, reaming the drill hole coal section by utilizing the cutting action of high-pressure water jet, increasing the exposure area of coal bodies in the hole, manufacturing cracks, improving the air permeability of a coal seam, and improving the gas extraction effect.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Method and system for evaluating vulnerability of wind disaster of vertical overlock metal roof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating vulnerability of a vertical overlock metal roof, which take a Monte Carlo simulation method as a probability analysis method to conduct vulnerability research on the metal roof, conduct random simulation through random sampling, acquire a large number of samples through a finite element model analysis method, then conduct simulation calculation on the samples, and obtaining the mean value and the logarithmic standard deviation of the sample, quantifying the performance level according to the sample data to obtain a damage parameter so as to establish a probability function of vulnerability to wind disasters, and finally fitting the probability function of vulnerability to wind disasters established under different wind speeds by combining the capacity demand ratio to obtain a final fitting function. According to the assessment method disclosed by the invention, the probability change rule of the roof system along with different performance levels of extreme wind pressure can be intuitively seen, and the probability of reaching different performance levels under the action of wind pressure with different polarity values is obtained, so that the assessment of the vulnerability of the vertical overlooking metal roof under different wind speeds can be completed.

title_en: Construction method for directional kilometer drilling under multi-disaster coupling condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of directional kilometer drilling under a multi-disaster coupling condition, which belongs to the technical field of directional drilling and comprises the following specific steps of S1, setting up a drilling platform, namely, leveling the ground through a bulldozer, setting up the drilling platform on the ground and matching with a corresponding structure to ensure the stability of a subsequent drilling process, S2, measuring the drilling in real time, namely, installing an ultrasonic hole forming quality detector near a drill bit, and continuously drilling the drilling position through the drill bit, wherein the ultrasonic hole forming quality detector can detect the hole diameter of the drilling in real time and upload the detected hole diameter to the terminal display of staff, and S3, paving a reinforced pipeline, namely, installing the reinforced pipeline in the drilling in a way of being perpendicular to the ground. According to the construction method for directional kilometer drilling under the multi-disaster coupling condition, the safety degree in the construction process is higher, and the structural strength of the drilling is higher.

title_en: Water inrush disaster evolution simulation method and related equipment based on mine water control area
abstract_en: The application provides a water bursting situation evolution simulation method and related equipment based on a mine water control area. Then, topological factors of the mine mining space are calculated, and the mine mining space is divided into a plurality of mutually-disjoint water control areas according to the topological factors. Then, the water accumulation amount of each water control area is calculated. And finally, simulating the evolution process of the mine water disaster based on the known water bursting points and the accumulated water quantity of all water control areas. By simulating the evolution process of the mine water disaster, the submerged range is determined according to the accumulated water inrush quantity and the accumulated water accumulation quantity of each water control area, the disaster spreading time is estimated, and the emergency rescue and treatment decision is guided. According to different water bursting conditions, the disaster evolution process of the mine water disaster is calculated rapidly and accurately, a basis is provided for emergency plan design, emergency drilling, rescue and disposal, and the method has strong operability.

title_en: Comprehensive simulation experiment platform and experiment method for fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive simulation experiment platform and an experiment method for fire disaster, comprising a building main body, a retaining wall and a calorimetric system, wherein the building main body is provided with a plurality of layers, and each layer comprises a combustion chamber; an image acquisition device I and a temperature measuring device are arranged in the combustion chamber; selecting one of the walls of the combustion chamber as a test wall, wherein a window is arranged on the test wall, and sealing or adjusting the size of the window is realized by additionally installing a fireproof plate; the retaining wall is two-sided, and mobilizable setting is in the test wall body outside, with test wall body cooperation simulation U type or L type building facade structure, calorimetric system is used for monitoring conflagration heat release rate. The comprehensive simulation experiment platform and the experiment method for the fire disaster can not only singly simulate an indoor bombing scene, a fire overflow burning scene and a building outer facade fire spreading scene, but also comprehensively simulate transition development processes among the three fire scenes, and monitor real-time change conditions of heat release rates under different experiment working conditions.

title_en: Geological disaster landslide and landslide surface drilling and sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster landslide and landslide surface drilling sampling device in the technical field of soil sampling, which comprises a loading plate, wherein a moving wheel is arranged below the loading plate, a lifting box is arranged above the loading plate, a first motor is arranged on the lifting box, a lead screw is arranged inside the loading plate, a moving plate and a lower pressing rod are arranged on the lead screw, a drill bit and a second motor are arranged below the lower pressing rod, the lower pressing rod is provided with a lower pressing rod, the first motor drives the lead screw to rotate, a moving block is driven to move downwards, the lower pressing rod and the drill bit move downwards, the second motor drives the drill bit to rotate, the drilling machine drills into the ground, when the proper depth is reached, a handle is rotated, a rotating sleeve is driven to rotate, a threaded rod is driven to move downwards, a straight tooth plate drives a driven gear to rotate, a rolling shaft is driven to emit a connecting rope, the lower pressing rod is separated from the connecting rope, the lower pressing rod is driven by the first motor to ascend, a deep layer of earth falls into a collecting tank, and the lifting is carried out along with the lifting, so that the sampling is conveniently and quickly carried out by the staff.

title_en: Virtual fire response education evaluation system and method using mixed reality
title_ko: 혼합 현실을 이용한 가상 화재 대응 교육 평가 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a virtual fire response training evaluation system and method using mixed reality to enable a user to be interested in training and repeatedly perform the training. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the virtual fire response training evaluation system comprises: a virtual fire scenario generate device determining a virtual fire area and a scenario difficulty level by using a user terminal to generate a virtual fire scenario; a virtual fire scenario execution information generation device generating fire extinguishing information of a user to the virtual fire scenario by controlling a virtual fire extinguishing device or generating evacuation information of the user to generate scenario execution information including the fire extinguishing information or the evacuation information; and a virtual fire scenario evaluation device analyzing the scenario execution information to evaluate a response result of the user to the virtual fire scenario, and reflecting an evaluation result to a personalized difficulty level or outputting training information on evaluation items below standards to perform the user's training. The virtual fire scenario generation device includes: a scenario area processing unit using the user terminal to acquire an external image and using the acquired external image to set a virtual fire area; a scenario difficulty management unit using difficulty level change information including personalized difficulty level information and fire difficulty level information to determine a virtual fire difficulty level which is a difficulty level of the virtual fire scenario; and a virtual fire scenario generation unit determining a virtual fire mode, which is a mode of the virtual fire scenario, a fire environment, and an optimal fire response path to generate the virtual fire scenario.
abstract_ko: 혼합 현실을 이용한 가상 화재 대응 교육 평가 시스템 및 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 혼합 현실을 이용한 가상 화재 대응 교육 평가 시스템은, 사용자 단말기를 이용하여 가상 화재 영역 및 시나리오 난이도를 결정하여 가상 화재 시나리오를 생성하도록 형성되는 가상 화재 시나리오 생성 장치; 가상 소화 장치를 제어하여 상기 가상 화재 시나리오에 대한 사용자의 진압 정보를 생성하거나 상기 사용자의 대피 정보를 생성하여 상기 진압 정보 또는 상기 대피 정보를 포함하는 시나리오 수행 정보를 생성하도록 형성되는 가상 화재 시나리오 수행 정보 생성 장치; 및 상기 시나리오 수행 정보를 분석하여 상기 사용자의 상기 가상 화재 시나리오에 대한 대응 결과를 평가하고, 평가 결과를 개인화 난이도에 반영하거나 기준 이하 평가 항목에 대한 교육 정보를 출력하여 상기 사용자의 교육을 수행하도록 형성되는 가상 화재 시나리오 평가 장치;를 포함하며, 상기 가상 화재 시나리오 생성 장치는, 상기 사용자 단말기를 이용하여 외부 영상을 획득하고, 획득한 상기 외부 영상을 이용하여 가상 화재 영역을 설정하도록 형성되는 시나리오 영역 처리부; 개인별 난이도 정보 및 화재 난이도 정보를 포함하는 난이도 변동 정보를 이용하여 상기 가상 화재 시나리오의 난이도인 가상 화재 난이도를 결정하도록 형성되는 시나리오 난이도 관리부; 및 상기 가상 화재 시나리오의 모드인 가상 화재 모드, 화재 환경 및 최적 화재 대응 경로를 결정하여 상기 가상 화재 시나리오를 생성하도록 형성되는 가상 화재 시나리오 생성부;를 포함하도록 형성된다.
