According to an embodiment of the present invention, the virtual fire response training evaluation system comprises: a virtual fire scenario generate device determining a virtual fire area and a scenario difficulty level by using a user terminal to generate a virtual fire scenario; a virtual fire scenario execution information generation device generating fire extinguishing information of a user to the virtual fire scenario by controlling a virtual fire extinguishing device or generating evacuation information of the user to generate scenario execution information including the fire extinguishing information or the evacuation information; and a virtual fire scenario evaluation device analyzing the scenario execution information to evaluate a response result of the user to the virtual fire scenario and reflecting an evaluation result to a personalized difficulty level or outputting training information on evaluation items below standards to perform the user's training. The virtual fire scenario generation device includes: a scenario performance information acquisition unit receiving and analyzing scenario execution information to acquire the fire extinguishing information and the evacuation information; a scenario execution information evaluation unit using evaluation criterion information to evaluate the scenario execution information and generate an evaluation result; and a scenario response information processing unit reflecting the evaluation result for each individual after the end of the virtual fire scenario, and outputting training information to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 혼합 현실을 이용한 가상 화재 대응 교육 평가 시스템 및 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 혼합 현실을 이용한 가상 화재 대응 교육 평가 시스템은, 사용자 단말기를 이용하여 가상 화재 영역 및 시나리오 난이도를 결정하여 가상 화재 시나리오를 생성하도록 형성되는 가상 화재 시나리오 생성 장치; 가상 소화 장치를 제어하여 상기 가상 화재 시나리오에 대한 사용자의 진압 정보를 생성하거나 상기 사용자의 대피 정보를 생성하여 상기 진압 정보 또는 상기 대피 정보를 포함하는 시나리오 수행 정보를 생성하도록 형성되는 가상 화재 시나리오 수행 정보 생성 장치; 및 상기 시나리오 수행 정보를 분석하여 상기 사용자의 상기 가상 화재 시나리오에 대한 대응 결과를 평가하고, 평가 결과를 개인화 난이도에 반영하거나 기준 이하 평가 항목에 대한 교육 정보를 출력하여 상기 사용자의 교육을 수행하도록 형성되는 가상 화재 시나리오 평가 장치;를 포함하며, 상기 가상 화재 시나리오 평가 장치는, 상기 시나리오 수행 정보를 전달 받아 분석하여 상기 진압 정보 및 상기 대피 정보를 획득하도록 형성되는 시나리오 수행 정보 획득부; 평가 기준 정보를 이용하여 상기 시나리오 수행 정보를 평가하여 상기 평가 결과를 생성하도록 형성되는 시나리오 수행 정보 평가부; 및 상기 가상 화재 시나리오 종료 후 개인별 상기 평가 결과를 반영하고 상기 교육 정보를 상기 사용자 단말기에 출력하도록 형성되는 시나리오 대응 정보 처리부;를 포함하도록 형성된다.
assignees: UNIV CHUNG ANG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Fireman fire scene behavior recognition model construction method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for constructing a fire scene behavior recognition model of a firefighter, and relates to the technical field of fire data analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring firefighter sign data and movement state data acquired by the firefighter in a scene of a fire, and dividing the firefighter sign data and the movement state data into a training data set and a testing data set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out normalization processing on each data of a first sample data set in a training data set and a second sample data set in a test data set, carrying out feature mining on each data of the first sample data set and the second sample data set after normalization processing to select N features with the largest variance change, wherein N is a positive integer, inputting the first sample data set and the second sample data set corresponding to the first label data set, the second label data set and the N features into a gradient lifting tree for training and testing to obtain a fire behavior recognition model of a fire fighter. By means of the model, the behavior and state of the firefighter in the fire can be identified.

title_en: Landslide detection early warning device and method suitable for fault-containing rock slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering geology disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a landslide detection early warning device and method suitable for a fault rock-containing side slope; including adjusting part, monitoring subassembly and early warning subassembly, adjusting part includes display controller and flexible room, monitoring subassembly includes spring chamber and detector, the spring chamber includes two second shells, two springs, two first cushions, two second cushions and two control levers, through detector detection analysis rock stratum lower section trend and inclination, flexible room adjustment spring chamber, make spring chamber and rock stratum lower section be the same trend and inclination, and monitor the deformation volume of spring through the detector, the deformation of display controller with the spring simulates the deformation of rock stratum lower floor, and calculate rock stratum rate of sliding, thereby to the monitoring that the fault of rock matter side slope slided, solve the problem that current early warning device can not observe the trend of fault well.

title_en: Urban multi-disaster coupling analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for coupling analysis of urban multiple disasters, which comprises the steps of collecting multiple disasters data, establishing a disaster model, predicting accident chaining, simulating accident simulation, evaluating disaster accidents, analyzing results and suggesting, wherein the collected data are specifically subdivided into information such as building information, environmental temperature, air pressure, vibration and the like, and the information is added according to actual conditions, so that in the process of the multiple disasters coupling analysis, the analysis and prediction of causes can be more effectively carried out according to multiple information, the follow-up prevention measure is formulated and helped, the multiple disasters model is established, the accident chaining prediction and simulation are carried out, the analysis of on-site disaster situations and the follow-up accompanying secondary disaster prediction and analysis are effectively helped when analysts acquire multiple concurrent disasters, the types and data quantity of data acquisition are effectively improved, and the multiple disasters coupling simulation can be more intuitively carried out, the analysis and prediction of the subsequent secondary disasters are realized, and the accuracy of evaluation and analysis is improved.

title_en: Emergency repair method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency repair method under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a disaster area of a power grid according to typhoon monitoring information in a first stage before the disaster, collecting meteorological data, distribution network data, geographic data and other data of the disaster area, calculating line fault probability based on the collected data, establishing a temporary allocation center site selection model according to the fault probability and the position, and solving to obtain a temporary allocation center position. And then, a post-disaster broken line scene is generated by utilizing a Monte Carlo simulation and synchronous back-up scene reduction method in the post-disaster stage, a post-disaster distribution network emergency repair restoration optimization model is established based on the post-disaster broken line scene, and the model is solved to obtain a post-disaster area distribution network emergency repair restoration optimization strategy, so that rapid emergency repair restoration of the distribution network fault under typhoon disasters is realized.

title_en: Fire escape route guidance system based on fire simulation and IoT sensor fusion
title_ko: 화재 시뮬레이션 및 사물 인터넷 센서 융합 기반의 화재 대피로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a fire escape route guidance system based on fire simulation and IoT sensor convergence, which includes: a plurality of sensor units which is disposed in each area inside the building to detect carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, fine dust, temperature, and smoke; a fire receiving unit which monitors whether a fire occurs and the location of a fire based on detection data detected by the plurality of sensor units; and a data server which calculates the fire propagation speed for each space by driving a fire simulator based on the data on the internal structure of the building stored in advance and the detection data received from the fire receiving unit.
abstract_ko: 화재 시뮬레이션 및 사물 인터넷 센서 융합 기반의 화재 대피로 안내 시스템은 건축물 내부의 각 영역마다 배치되어 이산화탄소, 일산화탄소, 미세먼지, 온도 및 연기를 감지하는 복수의 센서부와, 복수의 센서부에서 감지한 감지 데이터를 토대로 화재발생 여부 및 화재발생 위치를 모니터링 하는 화재 수신부와, 미리 저장된 건축물의 내부구조에 대한 데이터와 화재 수신부로부터 수신된 감지 데이터를 토대로 화재 시뮬레이터를 구동하여, 공간별 화재 전파속도를 산출하는 데이터 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Geological disaster landslide and landslide surface drilling and sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disasters landslide drilling sampling device, including the horizontal work case, the bottom fixedly connected with of horizontal work case removes the buffering subassembly, it includes vertical pole to remove the buffering subassembly, the bottom fixedly connected with limiting plate of vertical pole, the surface cover of vertical pole is equipped with the accessory plate, one side fixedly connected with power roll wheel of accessory plate bottom, the surface cover of vertical pole is equipped with buffer spring, buffer spring's top and the bottom fixed connection of accessory plate, the utility model relates to a drilling sample technical field. This geological disasters landslide surface drilling sampling device, the device can be at the external equipment pull down or walk at the working face by oneself to the device is from taking buffer spring, and the vibration when can effectively reduce the removal avoids the vibration to cause the injury to device internal plant, and the device is simple relatively to be structured simultaneously, easily walks after stopping, and the staff carries out quick maintenance to it.
assignees: WUHAN DAYE GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT PROT CO LTD

title_en: Advanced directional pressure relief construction system for tunneling of tunnel of huge thick coal seam
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a huge thick coal seam tunnelling is with directional release construction system in advance, including setting up the directional leading high-pressure water injection drilling of first long distance and two symmetries setting of second long distance at two sides in the big lane of branch coal seam and drilling the hole at the directional leading high-pressure water injection of second long distance under the big lane bottom of branch coal seam to and drill site and high-pressure water injection mechanism. The utility model discloses a set up the directional leading high-pressure water injection drilling of first long distance under the big lane bottom in coal seam of branch, two groups in the big lane in coal seam of branch set up the directional leading high-pressure water injection drilling of second long distance, and to the directional leading high-pressure water injection drilling of first long distance and the directional leading high-pressure water injection drilling of second long distance in high pressure water injection, realize realizing the double coupling release in the big lane week side in coal seam of branch, make the big lane in coal seam of branch in the huge thick coal seam of strong impact tendency tunnel tunnelling in the pressure relief area all the time, can appropriate improvement tunnelling speed, and prevent effectively that the big lane in coal seam of branch from tunnelling the emergence of in-process rock burst disaster accident.
assignees: CHN ENERGY GUOYUAN POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ENERGY XINJIANG ZHUNDONG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD

title_en: High-precision 3-dimension data conversion automation method for virtual environment establishment
title_ko: 가상환경 구축을 위한 고정밀 3d 데이터 변환 자동화 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high-precision 3D data conversion automation method for virtual environment establishment. The high-precision 3D data conversion automation method for virtual environment establishment includes the steps of: performing data conversion; performing vector data classification and extraction functions; and performing a terrain tile generating function. The virtual environment of a drone simulator can be automatically switched through a virtual environment production tool that can utilize spatial information data provided by public institutions.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가상환경 구축을 위한 고정밀 3D 데이터 변환 자동화 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 가상환경 구축을 위한 고정밀 3D 데이터 변환 자동화 방법으로서, (1) 공공기관에서 배포하는 항공사진, DEM, DSM, 벡터 데이터, 건물모델 데이터를 포함하는 공간 정보에 대해 임포트(Import) 기능, 좌표계 변환 기능, 영역 추출 및 해상도 변경 기능, 3D 모델 변환 메타 데이터 생성 기능의 데이터 변환을 수행하는 단계; (2) 상기 단계 (1)의 데이터 변환 수행 단계 후, 실감 영상을 위한 벡터 데이터 분류 및 추출 기능을 수행하는 단계; 및 (3) 상기 단계 (2)의 벡터 데이터 분류 및 추출 기능 수행 단계 후, 3D 영상 가시화를 위한 지형 타일 생성 기능을 수행하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 가상환경 구축을 위한 고정밀 3D 데이터 변환 자동화 방법에 따르면, 공공기관에서 배포하는 항공사진, DEM, DSM, 벡터 데이터, 건물모델 데이터를 포함하는 공간 정보에 대해 임포트(Import) 기능, 좌표계 변환 기능, 영역 추출 및 해상도 변경 기능, 3D 모델 변환 메타 데이터 생성 기능의 데이터 변환을 수행하는 단계와, 데이터 변환 수행 단계 후, 실감 영상을 위한 벡터 데이터 분류 및 추출 기능을 수행하는 단계와, 벡터 데이터 분류 및 추출 기능 수행 단계 후, 3D 영상 가시화를 위한 지형 타일 생성 기능을 수행하는 단계를 포함하여 구성함으로써, 공공기관에서 제공하는 공간 정보 데이터를 활용할 수 있는 가상환경 제작 도구를 통해 드론 시뮬레이터의 가상환경을 자동으로 전환할 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 가상환경 구축을 위한 고정밀 3D 데이터 변환 자동화 방법에 따르면, 가상환경 제작 도구를 통해 공공기관에서 제공하는 공간 정보 데이터를 활용하여 드론 시뮬레이터의 가상환경을 자동으로 전환할 수 있도록 함으로써, 저고도에서 운용되는 드론의 특성을 반영한 드론 시뮬레이터용 가상환경의 효율적 구성이 가능하고, 근접 항공사진, DEM, DSM, 벡터 데이터 등의 자료를 3D 영상으로 자동 전환함에 따른 드론 시뮬레이터용 가상환경의 구축 효율성이 더욱 향상될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명의 가상환경 구축을 위한 고정밀 3D 데이터 변환 자동화 방법에 따르면, 가상환경 제작 도구를 통해 공공기관에서 제공하는 공간 정보 데이터를 활용하여 드론 시뮬레이터의 가상환경을 자동으로 전환할 수 있도록 함으로써, 드론 시뮬레이터의 가상환경의 구현을 통한 물류 운송, 재난 안전, 농업 등의 드론 활용 분야 확대가 가능하며, 도심지역이나 인구 밀집 지역에서의 드론의 서비스 확대가 가능하도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Octahedral side slope disaster simulation test system and method with variable gradient and slope height
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rock-soil body kinematics tests, and discloses a variable-gradient and high-gradient octahedral side slope disaster simulation test system and a variable-gradient and high-gradient octahedral side slope disaster simulation test method. The experimental platform can provide experimental platforms in eight directions, and after the experimental patterns are put on the experimental platform, different motion characteristics of slope disaster experiments in eight different directions can be studied simultaneously under the action of earthquake load. And the experimental platform can realize the adjustment of gradient and slope height simultaneously, thereby realizing one-to-multi-purpose of the experimental platform and improving the utilization rate of the experimental device. Experimental patterns or experimental devices such as experimental sliding blocks, piles, model boxes and the like can be placed on experimental platforms in eight different directions according to experimental requirements.

title_en: Intelligent planning method for emergency evacuation space of urban community
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent planning method for an emergency evacuation space of an urban community, belonging to the technical field of intelligent planning of emergency evacuation spaces and comprising the following steps: acquiring geographic information, community resident behavior characteristic information, community space information and disaster information of a community emergency evacuation planning area, and constructing a community base model of the planning area; constructing a community disaster prevention space simulation model; simulating a free evacuation scene of residents and obtaining an evacuation simulation result; adjusting the community disaster prevention space simulation model according to the evacuation simulation result, and re-planning the evacuation scheme to obtain an optimal evacuation scheme; constructing a community safety toughness evaluation system; evaluating the optimal evacuation scheme by using a community safety and toughness evaluation system to obtain an evaluation result of the optimal scheme; obtaining an emergency evacuation space planning scheme of the urban community; the invention solves the problems that the current community emergency evacuation space planning is difficult to realize accurately customizing, fast calculating, reasonable layout and high-efficiency visual.

title_en: Fault simulation method, device, system and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a fault simulation method, a device, a system and a medium, which can be applied to the field of network security or the field of finance. Be applied to chaos engineering experiment platform, include: establishing a fault library according to the fault injection type and the fault parameters, importing system information and automatic script information of a service full link, configuring fault parameters and experiment operation parameters according to a detected link object, injecting each fault in the fault library into the detected link object, and starting a chaotic engineering experiment to realize fault simulation. Therefore, random fault injection can be carried out on the tested link on the platform, chaotic engineering experiments are carried out, and the fault boundary of the system can be effectively explored and the disaster recovery capability of the system can be verified when the full link system deals with various fault scenes.

title_en: Method for analyzing characteristics of variation trend and periodic variation of water volume reducible in flood season
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing the characteristics of the variation trend and the periodic variation of the amount of water which can be reduced in a flood season, which provides important data guarantee for early warning planning in the flood season; extracting the water reducing data, analyzing the precipitation of the station data in the flood season by a principal component analysis method, a Pearson correlation analysis method and a spatial clustering method, selecting a precipitation period typical region, and performing annual change analysis, spatial change analysis, periodic change rule analysis and the like on the precipitation period typical region; establishing a prediction model, training by using the existing data, generating prediction data, carrying out error test on the prediction model, establishing the prediction model by using the original data, and carrying out periodic prediction on rainfall variation in the area where the flood disaster frequently occurs; the method can effectively and quickly detect the periodic variation characteristics of the water-reducing quantity in a certain area, predict the variation trend of the water-reducing quantity, and effectively prevent flood disasters and the like.

title_en: Geological exploration equipment for preventing and treating geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of geological exploration, in particular to geological exploration and exploration equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters, which comprises an exploration mechanism and a protection mechanism, wherein the protection mechanism comprises a protection box, a protection frame, a protection plate and a positioning unit, the positioning unit comprises a positioning block, a positioning cylinder, two positioning springs, a positioning rope and a positioning ring, one end of the exploration mechanism is fixed in the protection box, the other end of the exploration mechanism passes through the bottom wall of the protection box, the protection frame is fixed on the side surface of the protection box, the protection plate is connected with the protection frame in a sliding way, and is abutted against the protection box, the positioning cylinder is fixed on the outer side surface of the protection box, the two positioning springs are fixedly connected with the inner bottom surface of the positioning cylinder and the positioning block, the positioning block slides in the positioning cylinder, and butt guard box and protection shield, location rope fixed connection locating piece and holding ring, the utility model provides an among the prior art the probing device of geological drilling exploration equipment receive external object's striking can reduce life's problem easily when removing.
assignees: GUIZHOU 109 GEOLOGY AND MINERAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating emergency escape and evacuation time of personnel under ship water inflow condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating personnel emergency escape and evacuation time under the condition of ship water inflow. Step 1: based on CFD, simulating water inflow of the ship, acquiring a ship body movement angle, and providing data for subsequent calculation, wherein the ship body movement angle is roll and pitch; step 2: and (3) calculating the emergency escape and evacuation time of the personnel under the condition of water inflow based on the data in the step (1). The invention is used for solving the problem that the damage water inflow of the ship has influence on the emergency escape and evacuation time of personnel.

title_en: Construction method of segment pointer interaction model and social sensing disaster monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a segment pointer interaction model and a social sensing disaster monitoring method, wherein the construction method of the segment pointer interaction model comprises the following steps: acquiring a training text set; inputting the training text into an entity perception coding layer to obtain semantic representation of the training text; inputting the semantic representation of the training text into a pointer network detection layer to obtain the starting interval representation and the ending interval representation of each word in the training text; inputting the starting interval representation and the ending interval representation into an interval interaction perception layer, and performing feature interaction on the starting interval representation and the ending interval representation by the interval interaction perception layer to obtain a starting category label and an ending category label after the feature interaction; and generating a corresponding starting category list and a corresponding terminating category list based on the starting category label and the terminating category label, and decoding based on the starting category list and the terminating category list to obtain the disaster event trigger word. The invention can realize effective and rapid event detection.

title_en: Side plate height design method of cable tunnel fireproof partition plate
abstract_en: The side plate height design method of the cable tunnel fireproof partition plate obtains the specific size of a power cable tunnel, the interlayer spacing and width of a power cable support and the voltage grade and sectional area of various power cables; acquiring the heat release rate and the combustion product content of each type of power cable; establishing a power cable tunnel fire simulation model; the method comprises the steps of calculating and setting maximum ignition power through electrical parameters when a power cable line short-circuit fault causes a fire disaster, setting side plate heights of different fireproof partition plates, respectively considering the condition of the fire disaster caused by each power cable short-circuit fault to simulate, obtaining the surface temperature of an outer protective layer of a protected power cable, finally comparing the surface temperature with the tolerance temperature of the outer protective layer, obtaining the side plate height when the critical tolerance temperature is reached, and determining the minimum side plate height by considering a safety margin coefficient. The method calculates and obtains the minimum height of the side plate of the fireproof partition plate required by the power cable tunnel under different voltage classes, different sections and different arrangements, and realizes the optimal design.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant test system and method for radiation shielding module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature resistance test system and method for a radiation shielding module, which comprise a latticed space cabin steel structure, a shielding module, a thermocouple, a heating device, a fire disaster simulation device and a control system, wherein the side wall observation holes are formed in the latticed space cabin steel structure, the shielding module is arranged on the inner wall of a cabin steel structure and comprises a protective layer for shielding radiation, the thermocouple is paved in the protective layer and is in data interaction with a data acquisition device, the heating device is arranged on the outer side of the cabin steel structure and is in contact heat conduction with the cabin steel structure, the fire disaster simulation device is arranged on the inner side of the cabin steel structure, and fire disaster environments of different levels are simulated by adjusting the distance and the combustion degree between the heating device and the inner wall of the cabin steel structure. And adjusting the power and the temperature of the heating device, simulating different break accident working conditions, starting the fire simulation device, and controlling the flame size to simulate different cabin fire environments. The method can be used for simulating high-temperature environments under different break accidents, analyzing and evaluating the heat-resistant safety of the shielding module.

title_en: Disaster recovery backup construction method and device, bank core system and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery construction method and device, a bank core system and a medium, and relates to the technical field of disaster recovery. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target data and a virtual tape library, wherein the virtual tape library comprises a virtual drive and a virtual tape, the virtual tape is obtained through file simulation, the target data is backed up to the virtual tape through the virtual drive, and the target data is backed up to target equipment through remote mirror images of the virtual tape so as to realize remote disaster recovery of the target data. The method can carry out disaster recovery construction only by using the virtual tape library, is convenient for disaster recovery construction of small and medium-scale enterprise cores, realizes multiple backups of target data through the virtual tape library, ensures the reliability of the data, and finally simulates the virtual tape in the virtual tape library through files, thereby facilitating data transmission and backup and meeting the disaster recovery construction requirements of the small and medium-scale enterprise cores.

title_en: Disaster smoke simulation test box based on augmented reality technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster smoke simulation, and particularly relates to a disaster smoke simulation test box based on an augmented reality technology, which comprises a box body; a cover plate is hinged to the box body; a smoke detector is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the cover plate; a display screen is fixedly connected to the cover plate; the bottom end of the cover plate is fixedly connected with a first electric push rod; the bottom end of the first electric push rod is fixedly connected with a second electric push rod; a position fixing plate is fixedly connected to the side end of the second electric push rod; a motor is fixedly connected inside the position-fixing plate; the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod; can make the brush cleaner laminate on smoke detector through electric putter and No. two electric putter, thereby the output of motor makes the brush cleaner rotate, and the rotation of brush cleaner can be to the surperficial cleaning of smoke detector, can reduce the smoke and dust and adsorb on smoke detector's surface to reduce the working strength that the smoke and dust cleaned, and the detection achievement that the smoke and dust accumulation is too much influence smoke detector.
assignees: CSSC JIUJIANG DAZHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned plane single building investigation path planning method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a single building investigation path planning method, device, equipment and medium of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprise the steps of obtaining a single building structure to be surveyed, carrying out background grid processing on the single building structure to generate a plurality of points to be surveyed, which are needed to be reached by the unmanned aerial vehicle, carrying out distance calculation on each point to be surveyed to generate a plurality of stuck points, wherein the stuck points are points to be surveyed when the nearest distance from the building entity is not more than a preset distance value, carrying out space coding processing on coordinates of each stuck point to generate an initial gene, enabling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the stuck point to generate a section of effective gene, integrating each effective gene section into a complete effective gene section, integrating the initial gene section into each complete effective gene section, and carrying out genetic algorithm and simulated annealing algorithm operation on the initial gene to generate the investigation path. In addition, can't use current unmanned aerial vehicle reconnaissance scheme to survey the task of reconnaissance in the monomer building disaster takes place and after the end, all have certain influence to reconnaissance personnel's safety and reconnaissance task's the going on.

title_en: Roadway support-surrounding rock filling synergistic method for local rock burst resistance of mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadway support-surrounding rock filling cooperative method for local rock burst resistance of a mine, and relates to the technical field of coal mine roadway support. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, drilling a pressure relief drill hole in the middle of two sides of a roadway, arranging a drill hole stress meter at the tail end of the pressure relief drill hole, monitoring whether the roadway of the section is damaged by rock burst or not through the drill hole stress meter, and if the disaster of the rock burst exists, arranging the pressure relief drill hole above the roadway; then primary supporting is carried out on the roadway surrounding rock through the anchor rod; non-Newtonian fluid is injected into the cavity through the liquid injection hole until the cavity is full, the continuously injected non-Newtonian fluid flows into pressure relief drill holes around the surrounding rock of the roadway, after the non-Newtonian fluid is filled into the pressure relief drill holes, the cavity and the non-Newtonian fluid in the pressure relief drill holes form an integral structure, and when the roadway deforms, the pressure relief drill holes and the non-Newtonian fluid in the cavity jointly play a role in yielding and deforming. The method can be used for supporting the roadway or the area with the rock burst.

title_en: Flood emergency rescue method and virtual command system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood emergency rescue method and a virtual command system based on a digital twin technology, which specifically comprise the following steps: s1, collecting relevant data of each river channel and the periphery of the river channel, wherein the relevant data comprises the height of a river bed, the type of the river channel, the width of the river channel and the cross section shape of the river channel; the invention relates to the technical field of aircraft simulation deduction platform support. According to the flood disaster emergency rescue method and the virtual command system based on the digital twin technology, by combining the specific characteristics of flood disasters, including strong burstiness, short rescue time and the like, a virtual command system frame is constructed, the frame mainly comprises seven modules, namely a physical module, a theoretical module, a task editor, a model editor, a driving engine, an aircraft performance evaluation module and a reinforcement learning module, and the seven modules are scientifically and reasonably arranged, so that command decision-making personnel can efficiently make emergency rescue decisions without professional flood disaster knowledge and can master rescue conditions in real time.

title_en: Outdoor street earthquake experience platform
abstract_en: The utility model provides an outdoor street earthquake experience platform, which belongs to the technical field of earthquake simulation equipment and comprises a bearing platform, wherein the bearing platform also comprises an installation platform, a protection mechanism and a driving mechanism; the protection mechanisms are distributed on the mounting platform in an array; the driving mechanism is installed below the installation platform and comprises a bottom plate, a sliding piece and a driving piece, a plurality of limiting grooves are formed in the bottom plate, each limiting groove is fixedly connected with a guide rail, the sliding piece can slide on the guide rail, two connecting plates are symmetrically welded on one side of the bottom plate, the driving piece is arranged between the two connecting plates, the sense of participation of an experiencer is enhanced, the experiencer can experience the power of a earthquake disaster, accordingly, the experiencer is improved to worry about the nature, and an emergency danger avoiding method which is required to be possessed when the earthquake disaster occurs is known.
assignees: SHANDONG GOLDON DIGITAL CREATIVE CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall simulation device for monitoring meteorological disasters of high-speed rail
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rainfall simulation device for monitoring meteorological disasters of high-speed rail, wherein, the device includes controller, water tower, raceway, water pump, governing valve, pressure sensor, at least 4 electromagnetism valves and at least 4 shower nozzle groups, and the water pump includes first water inlet and first delivery port, and the governing valve includes second water inlet and second delivery port, and each electromagnetism valve group includes third inlet and third delivery port; the water outlet of the water tower is connected with the first water inlet through a first water conveying pipe section, the first water outlet is connected with the second water inlet through a second water conveying pipe section, the second water outlet is connected with the third water inlet through a third water conveying pipe section, and for each spray head group, the water inlet of the spray head group is arranged on the third water outlet. The application provides a simulated rainfall device for high-speed railway meteorological disaster monitoring carries water to the controlling means back by the rainfall shower nozzle output from the raceway through the water pump to realize the simulated rainfall.
assignees: BEIJING SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA RAILWAY BEIJING GROUP CO LTD;XI AN XINHUIZE MEASUREMENT AND CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automobile multi-disaster coupling science popularization device based on wind tunnel structure and schlieren imaging technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile multi-disaster coupling science popularization device based on a wind tunnel structure and a schlieren imaging technology, which comprises a rectangular backflow type wind tunnel flow passage, wherein a wind tunnel fan is arranged in a power section, and transverse circulation wind is generated in the wind tunnel flow passage; the first direct-current section is provided with a heat exchanger for heating or cooling the transverse circulation wind in the wind tunnel flow passage; the experimental section is provided with a schlieren imaging device, a point light source is adopted to emit light and irradiate on the concave mirror, the concave mirror reflects the emitted light of the point light source, and the reflected light is converged at one point; the tool tip of the blade is positioned at the convergence point of the reflected light rays, and half light spots of the reflected light rays at the convergence point are cut off; the camera is positioned behind the blade and receives reflected light rays passing over the edge of the tool tip of the blade; the automobile model is placed in the experimental section and is positioned between the point light source and the concave mirror. The utility model discloses a wind-tunnel structure and schlieren imaging technique carry out visual simulation with the multiple disasters coupling environment that the car faces.
assignees: GSAFETY CLOUD SERVICE TECH CO LTD;BEIJING GLOBAL SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological derivative disaster comprehensive risk assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of meteorological derivative disaster prevention and control, in particular to a meteorological derivative disaster comprehensive risk assessment system. The device comprises an experiment cabin, a supporting platform, a supporting component, a supporting layer, a simulation layer and an environment element simulation module. The supporting platform is arranged at the bottom of the experimental cabin, and the supporting assemblies are distributed along the supporting platform in an array mode. The supporting layer is made of flexible materials and is supported by the supporting component. The simulation layer is arranged on the supporting layer and used for simulating the earth surface environment. The environment element simulation module comprises an illumination simulation unit, a temperature control unit, a humidity control unit, a precipitation simulation unit, a wind direction-wind power simulation unit and an air pressure simulation unit. The method can predict the occurrence probability of the mountain fire and the development and spreading trend after the occurrence in a prospective manner, so that the method is used for planning a mountain fire blocking scheme and a blocking route in advance, and has guiding significance for reducing the threat and the disaster loss after the occurrence of the mountain fire.
assignees: BEIJING WANYUN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Coal and gas outburst simulation experiment method considering influence of elastic energy of surrounding rock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal and gas outburst simulation experiment method considering the influence of elastic energy of surrounding rocks, which comprises seven steps of filling molded coal with set strength into a cavity, calculating the elastic energy of the surrounding rocks, determining the deformation amount required to be applied by an elastic component in an elastic energy storage module according to the elastic energy, starting a hydraulic propulsion module, controlling by using an intelligent control module, displaying the deformation amount of the elastic component in the elastic energy storage module by using a digital display module to enable the deformation amount to reach the value set in the second step, filling gas with set pressure after vacuumizing and fully adsorbing, filling gas into a gas filling chamber to enable a rupture disk to be burst and induced to be outburst, synchronously detecting all parameters, collecting data, preparing the next experiment, analyzing and summarizing the experiment, and the like. The method is ingenious in design and simple and convenient, and has positive significance for deeply researching coal rock gas dynamic disasters under the influence of surrounding rock elastic energy.

title_en: Foam-water movable fire extinguishing integrated device applied to petroleum drilling operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foam-water movable fire extinguishing integrated device applied to petroleum drilling operation, which is sequentially integrated with a water tank, a foam tank, a control box and a fire pump set. The water tank and the foam tank are both connected with the fire pump set, the components are integrated on the bottom pry, and the bottom of the bottom pry is also provided with a rotating mechanism. Flange pipe connections are arranged between the water tank and the fire pump set and between the foam tank and the fire pump set, and flexible connecting valves are detachably arranged between the flange pipes which are symmetrically connected. The fire extinguishing integrated device can realize the conversion of foam, water or foam-water mixed fire extinguishing modes, is mainly used for extinguishing fire disasters of drilling equipment in the petroleum drilling operation process, and can also provide foam-water treatment for fire-fighting hidden dangers of other parts through the device. Meanwhile, the device can effectively overcome the impact influence, ensure smooth fire extinguishing operation, ensure long-term use in petroleum drilling operation and effectively reduce the failure rate and the maintenance cost.
assignees: SHAANXI ANJIEXUN FIRE TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Pseudo-unchanged cross transfer site screening method for marine water-based satellite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for screening a pseudo-unchanged cross transfer site of a marine water-based satellite, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a set of site screening index system; the influence of atmospheric instability on the satellite signals on the top of the atmosphere is simulated and cleared by utilizing radiation transmission; then analyzing the influence of the space-time instability of the ocean optical characteristics on the satellite signals on the top of the atmosphere; according to the method, an evaluation standard system (CSM) of a site screening system is established, meteorological indexes, optical indexes and other index performances are calculated by collecting evaluation index influence factor data, and the final evaluation standard CSM is obtained by averaging according to the index performances. Evaluating the global ocean as the PICS through CSM index scoring condition, and selecting the global ocean ideal PICS; meanwhile, the method is used as a pseudo-unchanged cross transfer field of the marine water color satellite, can evaluate the quality of the detection data of the marine water color satellite, ensures the accuracy of the data of the marine water color satellite, and has wide and profound effects on researches such as marine ecological environment monitoring, marine disaster effect monitoring and evaluation and the like.

title_en: Method for evaluating and managing risk of slope-cutting landslide hazard in rural house building
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating and managing risk of landslide hazard in slope cutting during building of rural areas, which comprises the steps of calculating stability coefficients of grid unit bodies at different depths in an area through a TRIGRS model, obtaining an area damage probability distribution map by combining a Monte Carlo method, converting the grid units into slope units by using an ArcGIS platform to obtain an area risk distribution map, and determining whether building is allowed in the area according to risk; dividing the cut slope into a soil cut slope and a rock-soil mixed cut slope, calculating a cut slope stability coefficient and a potential sliding area under different parameter combinations based on Geostudio simulation, and determining whether to allow the cut slope according to the cut slope stability coefficient; obtaining a house design safety distance based on the potential sliding area; after a slope cutting design scheme is selected, evaluating slope cutting risks according to the safety evaluation standard of the slope cutting stability coefficient, and adopting corresponding prevention and control schemes according to different risk levels; all information is stored in the digitizing platform. The contents in the aspect of geological disaster prevention and control are systematically considered for the scientific site selection of rural house building.

title_en: Design method of rural house building slope cutting prevention and control engineering scheme
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method of a rural house building slope-cutting control engineering scheme, which combines parameters of slope-cutting parameters and calculates slope-cutting stability coefficients and potential sliding areas under each parameter combination based on Geostudio simulation; mixing rock and soil, cutting a slope, obtaining a slope cutting stability coefficient formula according to the stress condition of a soil body by using a rigid body limit balance method, and comparing and verifying the accuracy of the formula with the slope cutting stability coefficient obtained based on Geostudio simulation calculation; obtaining a house design safety distance according to a slope-cutting type landslide disaster movement distance formula; and evaluating the cut slope risk according to the safety evaluation standard of the cut slope stability coefficient, and adopting a corresponding control scheme aiming at different risk grades. The technical scheme provided by the invention has the beneficial effects that: the stability coefficient is calculated through Geostudio simulation and a mechanical model by considering the combination of different slope cutting types and slope cutting modes, a reasonable excavation area is provided, and the design of control engineering schemes under different slope cutting conditions is provided for rural house building slope cutting.

title_en: Network security protection safety method and system based on unit cell
abstract_en: A network safety protection safety method and system based on unit includes: the method and the system are characterized by comprising the steps of vulnerability scanning, baseline inspection, network and safety equipment inspection, full-flow threat analysis, intranet asset discovery, emergency response, emergency drilling, penetration testing, safety operation and maintenance, risk assessment, information system level protection assessment, internet threat detection and active response. By actively evaluating risks, the risk is prevented in the bud, the distributed scanning system can comprehensively evaluate the services once when the services are on line, meanwhile, the service change condition is monitored every day, the introduced new risk problem is analyzed, and the rapid perception of risk change is realized.

title_en: NMR in-situ ultrahigh dynamic and static cooperative loading test device and application method
abstract_en: The invention provides an NMR (nuclear magnetic resonance) in-situ ultrahigh dynamic and static cooperative loading test device, which is characterized in that a dynamic load mechanism, a static load mechanism and a three-axis mechanism are tightly matched, dynamic and static load and seepage disasters caused by underground resource development are simulated under the monitoring of an external mechanism control and monitoring mechanism, a test sample dynamic and static load environment is restored in situ, and multi-source multi-parameter disaster information is captured on line.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY;HEFEI COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL SCIENCE CENTER ENERGY RES INSTITUTE ANHUI ENERGY LABORATORY

title_en: Engineering rock mass dynamics simulation test system and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engineering rock dynamics simulation test system and a test method thereof, which comprises a main body bearing module, a dynamic sealing module, a dynamic and static loading module, a gas-liquid filling module, a temperature control and heat preservation module, a drilling, excavating, mining and supporting module and a multi-physical field information sensing module, can truly simulate various rock dynamics disasters of deep engineering, the device can be used as a simulation test instrument and a platform for researches on dynamic disaster influence factors, evolution mechanisms, precursor responses, prediction early warning, prevention and control technologies and the like of various engineering rocks such as rock dynamics, rock burst, coal and gas outburst, water inrush and the like, a test system is suitable for various engineering rock models, multi-scale evolution process experiments, multi-information accurate tests, coupling analysis and the like, can be used as basic test equipment for researches on engineering rock dynamics, engineering rock dynamics behaviors and mechanisms, and can be used as basic test equipment for breaking through the difficult problems of rock dynamics experiment researches and theoretical analysis.

title_en: Collapse and slide monitoring device, method, terminal, equipment and medium based on tablet feedback
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster data monitoring, and discloses a collapse and slide monitoring device, method, terminal, equipment and medium based on satellite slide feedback. Delineating the selected geological disaster investigation range in the satellite film, and on the basis, laying a landslide monitoring device based on satellite film feedback on site; monitoring deformation and stress in slope evolution, feeding real-time data back to an indoor satellite film interpretation terminal, repeatedly training an established learning model, and establishing a relation between migration elements of a field slope and pixel changes in a satellite film; and monitoring and early warning the on-site landslide hazard based on a safety threshold value set by pre-programming. The invention carries out system monitoring on information of stratum lithology, geological structure, surface scouring, meteorology, underground water and the like of the disaster, gives typical characteristics of the disaster point to be monitored from the angle of engineering geology, fuses the characteristics into specific indexes such as strain, stress and the like, and establishes the relation between the deformation and stress indexes and the pixel change in the satellite film.
assignees: Zhongzi data co ltd;CHINA HIGHWAY ENG CONSULTANTS CORP;CCCC ROAD AND BRIDGE INSPECTION MAINTENANCE CO LTD;CHECSC HIGHWAY MAINTENANCE AND TEST TECH CO LTD

title_en: Municipal drainage pipeline defect simulation experiment device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a municipal drainage pipeline defect simulation experiment device and method, wherein the device comprises a pipeline support, a pipeline support foot pad, a gradient adjustment support, a water inlet tank, an experiment straight-through pipeline, an experiment three-way pipeline, an electric control valve, an experiment pipeline outlet, a drainage hose, a pipeline clamp, a water storage tank, a pipeline ultrasonic liquid level meter, a water pump, a water inlet valve, a water inlet pipe, a water inlet tank drain valve, a water inlet tank drain pipe, an evacuation valve, an evacuation pipe, a water pump water return valve, a water pump water return pipe, a flowmeter, a central control tank, a water inlet tank liquid level meter, a water storage tank liquid level meter, a pipeline pressure liquid level meter, a pipeline gradient sensor and a defect simulation pipeline. The municipal drainage pipeline defect simulation experiment method realized by the device has the advantages of large size, high automation degree, complete simulation parameters and the like, is favorable for exploring the influence of the drainage pipeline defect on the pipeline hydraulic conditions, and provides scientific basis for checking the drainage pipeline network hydraulic model parameters.

title_en: Landslide physical model test method capable of adjusting sliding surface sliding resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide physical model test method capable of adjusting sliding surface sliding resistance, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster model tests; the method comprises the following steps: installing a landslide physical model, and adjusting the preset slope angle of the supporting plate; drawing a slope surface line, a layer surface line, a sliding surface line and a lubricating layer surface line on the model box body according to a specific test design; an electric heating plate is arranged above the supporting plate and is connected with a power controller; filling a thermosensitive lubricating layer above the supporting plate until the lubricating layer is on the line, covering the electric heating plate, filling the proportioned simulated landslide body in layers, and arranging a displacement sensor and a stress sensor; and starting the heating control system and the data acquisition system for testing. The invention solves the defects and limitations of the existing landslide model test in the active traction at the front end or the loading and pushing at the rear end of the landslide, can effectively regulate the anti-sliding force of each section of the sliding surface in a grading way, and more truly and accurately realize the sliding type, traction type and integral type landslide model test.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Geological disaster administers and uses side slope rig
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disasters are administered and are used side slope drilling machine belongs to the technical field of rig equipment. The rack comprises a frame body, the fixed two racks that are provided with in support body top, two rack parallel arrangement, the one end sliding connection at support body top has the bracket, other end fixedly connected with mount, fixed mounting has the power holder that is used for the centre gripping and rotates the drilling rod on the bracket, power holder both sides all are equipped with the power walking ware, the power walking ware is used for removing with rack toothing and drive bracket, power walking ware and bracket fixed connection, it has the through-hole that supplies the drilling rod to pass through to open on the mount, one side fixed mounting that the support body is close to the mount end has the hoist. The utility model provides a low scheduling problem of efficiency of construction that prior art side slope drainage drilling equipment exists.

title_en: Microseism event risk analysis method based on attention mechanism and clustering algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microseismic event risk analysis method based on an attention mechanism and a clustering algorithm, belongs to the field of dangerous disasters such as mine rock burst and the like, and sequentially comprises the step of selecting the time interval between the microseismic event of the time and the microseismic event of the last time Time sequence concentration Q     T    Spatial intensity D Energy of this microseismic event E And energy concentration Q     E    Is an analytical feature; establishing a data set containing analysis characteristic data and danger label data; clustering the data set by using a k-means algorithm; selecting a clustering center as a representative vector; the risk of the microseismic event is determined based on an attention mechanism. Solve the problem ofThe method can analyze the danger of the microseismic event without any training and provide help for the analysis and the prevention of dangerous events in mines such as rock burst and the like.

title_en: Coal mine microseismic signal identification and classification method based on model experiment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning of mining engineering, in particular to a coal mine microseismic signal identification and classification method based on model experiment, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of simulating conditions of a rock mass under the action of impact load, rock mass fracture, pore rock mass simulation grouting, rock mass slippage and the like in an experiment, summarizing influence factors excited by micro-seismic signals, acquiring the micro-seismic signals, identifying change characteristics and rules of the corresponding micro-seismic signals under different inducement states, obtaining various micro-seismic signal samples of a plurality of coal mines, collecting engineering information related to the micro-seismic signals, establishing a micro-seismic signal data set, and forming a micro-seismic signal type division standard; acquiring microseismic signals before and during stoping of a working face, and carrying out engineering screening on the microseismic signals by a professional according to microseismic signal type division standards before the analysis of dynamic parameters of a seismic source to determine excitation inducement of the microseismic signals, and carrying out identification and classification to realize early warning.

title_en: Microseismic event risk analysis method based on Transformer and self-supervision algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for analyzing the risk of a microseismic event based on a Transformer and an automatic supervision algorithm, which belongs to the field of dangerous disasters such as mine rock burst and the like, and sequentially comprises the steps of selecting the time interval, the time sequence concentration and the space concentration of the microseismic event at this time and the microseismic event at the last time, wherein the energy and the energy concentration of the microseismic event at this time are analysis characteristics; establishing a non-labeled data set and a labeled data set; constructing a basic deep learning model; performing mask processing on the analysis characteristic data, establishing a pre-training model of an auto-supervision algorithm and training by using a label-free data set; establishing a fine tuning model; transferring the weight of the trained basic deep learning model to a fine tuning model, and training by using a labeled data set; and carrying out risk analysis on the microseismic event. The method can be used for training the pre-training model by fully utilizing the micro-seismic monitoring data without the danger labels on a large scale, and training the fine-tuning model by utilizing the micro-seismic monitoring data with the danger labels on a small scale, so that the data utilization degree is high, and the danger analysis is accurate.

title_en: Fire detection tube fire extinguishing performance evaluation method for live-line operation electrical control cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire detection tube fire extinguishing performance evaluation method for an electrical control cabinet in live-line operation, which comprises the steps of simulating a fire scene of the electrical control cabinet in live-line operation through a solid, collecting test data in fire extinguishing tests of different fire detection tube fire extinguishing devices, selecting six evaluation elements of fire extinguishing discharge amount, flame extinguishing time, fire scene cooling rate, post-disaster burning loss rate, anti-recrudescence performance and live equipment operation state to construct a corresponding weight distribution system, and finally completing comprehensive evaluation of fire extinguishing performance of the fire detection tubes by means of scoring and sorting. The invention has the advantages that: the real fire scene in the electrified electrical cabinet and the starting, spraying and extinguishing process of the fire detecting tube fire extinguishing device are reproduced; and a comprehensive evaluation system of fire extinguishing effectiveness and reliability of the fire detecting tube is formed by fire extinguishing spraying time, flame extinguishing time, fire scene cooling rate, post-disaster burning loss rate, flammability and the hexagonal surface of the operation state of the electrified equipment, so that the fire extinguishing performance of the fire detecting tube fire extinguishing device in a specific space of the electric cabinet under the electrified operation is scientifically and objectively compared, and the optimal design and selection of engineering application are realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI TUNNEL ENGINEERING & RAIL TRANSIT DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Water disaster treatment method and construction method for water-rich limestone aquifer of roof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating water disaster of a water-rich limestone aquifer of a roof and a construction method, wherein the method for quickly treating the water disaster of the water-rich limestone aquifer of the roof comprises the following steps: arranging a treatment boundary around a target area to be treated, wherein the plane projection distance between the treatment boundary and the target area is at least R meters, and R is the slurry diffusion radius of the treatment area; distributing boundary plugging hole groups along the treatment boundary and the extension direction thereof; and arranging an internal treatment hole group in an area surrounded by the treatment boundary, wherein the internal treatment hole group is overlapped and/or crossed with the treatment boundary. The invention uses the directional ground drill to block the boundary and reform the inside in the treatment area to achieve the purpose of rapidly treating the aquifer of the water-rich limestone of the roof, and the drainage of the roof water is difficult to solve the problems of stronger water-rich property of the aquifer and large supply amount.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Urban rainfall waterlogging grading early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a urban rainfall waterlogging grading early warning method, which comprises the following steps: classifying the samples into front-bias rainfall and rear-bias rainfall according to the positions of the rain peaks; calculating a risk angle value of front-bias rainfall and rear-bias rainfall; introducing each scene rainfall sample into an urban flood simulation model, obtaining an overflow volume process line graph and an overflow depth process line graph, and adding the rainfall process line to the overflow depth process line graph; dividing a rainfall early warning overflow critical depth threshold into a plurality of grades according to disaster-causing ponding depth; adding different critical depth thresholds to an overflow depth process line graph, wherein the abscissa of the overflow depth process line graph, the intersection point of the overflow depth process line graph and the accumulated rainfall process line intersection point are respectively the rainfall critical rainfall occurrence time and the critical overflow occurrence time; substituting the critical rainfall occurrence time and the critical overflow occurrence time into a preset early warning formula to obtain rainfall early warning and release time. By adopting the invention, the early warning time is more accurate.

title_en: Coal mine underground working face digital transparent geological technical method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground working face digital transparent geological technical method, which comprises the following steps: the working face utilizes geological technical means such as drilling, geophysical prospecting and the like to check the geological and hydrogeological conditions of the working face; collecting and researching ground geophysical prospecting and drilling geological data; researching geological data of an underground tunneling section map; researching a comprehensive geophysical prospecting result of a design working face; pertinently laying a working surface 'pair of through holes'; establishing a digital model architecture of a working face; pre-treating a hidden disaster-causing structure; the method is characterized in that geological parameters such as the distribution range and the distribution condition of the breccia on the working face, the thickness of a coal bed, the stability of the coal bed, the inclination angle of the coal bed, faults and ruffles in the working face and the like are digitally constructed, drilling results are analyzed in a comprehensive influence area of the faults and the breccia uncovered in a roadway, the results are processed by a digital technical means, the working face can be well guided to carry out extraction at a proper position, and the faults are pre-judged by a digital geological technology. The coal mine working face digital transparent geological technical system digitalizes the geological condition of the working face in sections to construct a working face digital model, so that the geological parameters and the structural condition in the coal seam, the top bottom plate of the coal seam of the working face are more visual and clear, and the safe and efficient stoping of the working face is directly guided.
assignees: XUZHOU DATUN ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Water conservancy monitoring and disaster deduction method based on digital twin
abstract_en: A water conservancy monitoring and disaster deduction method based on digital twins comprises the following steps: 1) modeling water conservancy site landforms by using a three-dimensional model tool according to actual demands, carrying out fine modeling on water conservancy monitoring equipment, and introducing the water conservancy monitoring equipment into an illusion engine, so as to construct a vivid reservoir site model; 2) acquiring sensing data acquired by water conservancy monitoring equipment at a water conservancy station by using a database; 3) establishing a twin model and a deduction model of the water conservancy monitoring equipment, and mapping real sensor data of the water conservancy monitoring equipment into the water conservancy monitoring equipment model through data mapping; 4) according to the actual conditions of the water conservancy sites, a water conservancy site simulation scene is quickly constructed, and corresponding water conservancy monitoring and disaster deduction work of the water conservancy sites is completed.

title_en: Island working surface grouting scour prevention stoping method based on multistage divergent type directional well
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of island working surface safety recovery, in particular to an island working surface grouting anti-scour recovery method based on a multistage divergent directional well, which comprises the following specific steps of: s1: drilling positioning and drill mounting: s2: drilling a hole in a vertical well-opening section; s3: a directional drilling process of positive circulation rotary drilling is adopted; s4: drilling a water flowing crack with three well sections; s5: drilling to a grouting target interval, and completing the hole forming of each stage of the branch well with a water guiding fracture zone three-well interval: s6: after grouting, drilling holes, and cleaning the drilled hole walls; s7: grouting and filling: s8: forming a safe and stable section; s9: and (5) detecting after construction, and comprehensively evaluating the filling and grouting quality. The invention solves the problem that the island working face is threatened by rock burst disasters in the recovery process, and the designed anti-impact technology based on the multistage divergent branch directional drilling grouting can effectively improve the working face stress environment, reduce the pressure and prevent impact, and realize the safe and efficient recovery of the island working face.
assignees: CCTEG ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD;CCTEG XINRONG TECH INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;CCTEG CYCLE INDUSTRY RES INSTITUTE SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: High-simulation amphibious crocodile-like robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-simulation amphibious crocodile-simulated robot, which comprises a trunk, and a head, a tail and four limbs which are movably connected to the trunk; the crocodile robot comprises a body, a control main board and a floating and sinking adjusting device, wherein the control main board is used for controlling the movement of the crocodile robot, and the floating and sinking adjusting device comprises a floating and sinking driving motor, a driving wheel, a driven wheel, a synchronous belt and a sliding rail; the driving wheel is connected to the driving motor that floats and sinks, and the hold-in range is around passing through the driving wheel and from the driving wheel, and synchronous pulley is synchronous rotation along head to afterbody from the driving wheel along with the driving wheel, and the hold-in range is equipped with the balancing weight, and slide rail parallel arrangement is in the below of hold-in range, and the slide rail is equipped with the slider, and the balancing weight is connected fixedly with the slider. After the robot is adopted, the real crocodile can be approached to a greater extent from the aspects of motion mechanism and shape, amphibious free switching is realized, and tasks such as disaster prevention and rescue, biological observation and sampling, field environment detection, underwater pipeline inspection, agricultural production and the like in an amphibious environment are completed.

title_en: Real fire generation simulation system for fire-fighting training of nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a real fire generation simulation system for fire-fighting training of a nuclear power plant, which comprises a control center, a simulation system and a control center, wherein the control center is used for generating corresponding simulation instructions according to input control instructions and real-time simulation states, and respectively controlling the simulation states according to the simulation instructions to realize real fire simulation of the fire-fighting training of the nuclear power plant; the smoke and heat simulation unit is used for simulating the rescue training environment of dense smoke, high temperature and various complex obstacles under the fire environment according to the corresponding simulation instruction; the real fire simulation unit is used for simulating real fire rescue environments with various combustion states according to corresponding simulation instructions; and the rescue simulation unit is used for simulating rescue escape paths under different simulation environments according to the corresponding simulation instructions to realize corresponding rescue training or escape training. The invention meets the training requirements of various types and different difficulty training subjects of full-time firefighters and nuclear power enterprise employees, and improves the nuclear power fire fighting actual combat training efficiency and the training level.
assignees: LIAONING HONGYANHE NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Subway fault emergency evacuation drilling model
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergent sparse rehearsal model of subway trouble belongs to sparse rehearsal field, including portable sand table case, the inside movable mounting of portable sand table case has the sand table subassembly, the lower surface center department fixed mounting of sand table subassembly has the rotation extension board. A emergent evacuation rehearsal model of subway trouble, the sand table subassembly is rotating the certain angle internal rotation in seat surface and being the tilt state through rotating the extension board, the article that make things convenient for the activity to place on the sand table subassembly are directly accomodate to the chamber of accomodating of portable sand table case along the inclined plane landing, through the sand table subassembly that sets up, bearing structure and water conservancy diversion swash plate, when wasing the sand table subassembly, the convenient washing liquid of the sand table subassembly of tilt state flows away, improve the situation of traditional sand table subassembly because of the exhibition flat and surperficial hydrops, cooperate the water conservancy diversion swash plate that the inside slope of portable sand table case set up, can make things convenient for follow-up to empty the processing to the washing liquid in the portable sand table case.

title_en: Evacuation planning apparatus, method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a technology for formulating an evacuation plan in case of a disaster and for disaster prevention activity with high accuracy.SOLUTION: An evacuation planning apparatus 10 includes: a data holding unit which holds a spatial model 12 of an area where an evacuation route for persons exists; an allocation setting unit 21 which allocates an evacuation behavior model 16 to each of identifiers 17 of the persons who are likely to stay in the area; a person arrangement setting unit 22 which sets arrangement of persons who stay in the area 20 when a disaster occurs; a reflection unit 25 which causes a disaster scenario 11 to be reflected in the spatial model 12; and an evacuation behavior simulation unit 27 which simulates evacuation behavior of persons on the basis of a state of the spatial model 12, position data of the other identifiers, and the evacuation behavior model 16.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: Synchronous generator set custom modeling and initialization method based on PSCAD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PSCAD (power system computer aided design) -based synchronous generator set custom modeling and initialization method, which relates to the technical field of electromagnetic transient simulation and comprises the following implementation processes: converting a mathematical model of the synchronous generator into a state space expression, drawing a system structure diagram of an electrical model according to the state space expression, and performing custom modeling; carrying out custom modeling on a control system of the synchronous generator, namely an excitation system, a prime motor and a speed regulator thereof to obtain a custom-modeled synchronous generator set model; and dividing the synchronous generator set model into an electromagnetic transient state and an electromechanical transient state, and respectively initializing. The problem of dimension disaster caused by the fact that the order of a mathematical model of a PSCAD software self-contained synchronous generator is too high when a multi-machine power system is subjected to electromagnetic transient simulation is solved; the provided initialization method suitable for the synchronous generator set model avoids the situation that a plurality of generators are directly put into operation according to the actual characteristics of the generators, and the system is difficult to stabilize or even cannot achieve stability.

title_en: Experimental device and experimental method for simulating burst type debris flow river blockage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to an experimental device for simulating a debris flow to block a river, and particularly relates to an experimental device and an experimental method for simulating a burst type debris flow to block a main flow. Comprises a reservoir, a main branch water tank connected with the reservoir, a bracket and a fixed boundary. The slope and the width of the main branch flume are adjustable, the flow and the intersection angle of the main branch are adjustable, and the number, the volume and the shape of the damming bodies in the branch are controllable, so that the damming of the damming bodies and the movement evolution and the process of blockage of the mud-rock flow under different main branch conditions and different branch damming body scenes can be simulated more accurately, the forming mechanism and the dynamic evolution mechanism of the burst type mud-rock flow river blockage disaster chain, particularly the burst type mud-rock flow river blockage mechanism, can be explored scientifically beneficially, and the rationality and the systematicness of the research on the burst type mud-rock flow river blockage disaster chain are improved.

title_en: Optimization method for dam break disaster risk avoiding transfer scheme of tailing pond
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster risk management of a tailing pond, in particular to an optimization method of a dam break disaster risk avoiding transfer scheme of the tailing pond, which comprises the following steps: step S1, simulating the evolution process of the dam break tailing flow; step S2, planning the risk avoidance transfer optimal route; and step S3, dynamically simulating the risk avoidance transfer process. According to the method, the time-varying characteristic of dam break tailing flow is considered, dynamic simulation of the risk group risk avoiding transfer process is realized on the basis of the optimal risk avoiding transfer path, the position relation between risk groups and the tailing flow in the risk avoiding transfer process is disclosed, the latest evacuation starting time capable of ensuring that the risk groups can safely finish risk avoiding transfer is obtained, and a theoretical basis is provided for safety completion of risk avoiding transfer of residents in the downstream of a tailing pond.

title_en: Landslide surge simulation method based on SPH far-near field coupling calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge simulation method based on SPH far and near field coupling calculation, which comprises the following steps of: (1) establishing an SPH near-field landslide and surge calculation model; (2) carrying out SPH near-field landslide surge calculation; (3) extracting the speed of motion of a sliding body, the first wave height and the opposite bank wave height in the SPH near-field landslide surge; (4) establishing a far-field landslide and surge calculation model; (5) determining the input of surge in the far field landslide surge calculation model by calibrating the opposite bank wave height of the far field model based on the first wave height obtained by the SPH near field landslide surge calculation model; (6) calculating far-field surge to obtain surge far-field propagation characteristics; (7) and extracting the maximum wave height of each measuring point in the far-field landslide and surge calculation model, drawing a distribution cloud picture of the maximum wave height of the surge, and determining the disaster influence range.
