The method solves the problems that the parameters of rock-soil mass materials are difficult to accurately determine in landslide surge simulation calculation and the boundary generated by surge is difficult to accurately input.

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on global dynamic convolution neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an SAR image change detection method based on a global dynamic convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of carrying out difference analysis on two multi-temporal SAR images captured in the same geographic area to obtain a difference map; pre-classifying the difference map, and constructing a training data set and a test data set; and training a global dynamic convolution neural network model by using the training data set, and testing by using the test data set so as to obtain a multi-temporal SAR image change detection result of the whole same geographic area. According to the scheme, a two-stage mixed sample data enhancement method is adopted to increase the number of data sets when a training data set is constructed, and the diversity and reliability of samples are ensured; meanwhile, the performance of a convolutional neural network is improved by adopting a global dynamic convolution mode, and the robustness and generalization capability of SAR image change detection on noise are improved; the digital image processing and deep learning technology are combined, and the method has important significance in the fields of national defense and military reconnaissance, natural environment monitoring, natural disaster monitoring, urban land planning and the like.

title_en: Gas extraction method for uniformly increasing permeability of complex geological structure coal seam by cutting and pressing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal seam gas extraction, and discloses a cutting pressure uniform permeability-increasing gas extraction method for a coal seam with a complex geological structure, which comprises the following steps of: finding out a main geological structure of the coal bed on the mine geological structure map, and determining a geological structure range according to geology marked on the mine geological structure map; arranging hydraulic slotting drill hole sites at intervals in a coal seam controlled by a geological structure; aiming at the characteristics of complex coal seam geological structure and low air permeability of China, the invention realizes high efficiency and uniform permeability increase of the coal seam with the complex geological structure, and improves the gas extraction efficiency of the coal seam with the complex geological structure, thereby realizing the purpose of effectively preventing and controlling gas disasters of the coal seam with the complex geological structure; in addition, the method for identifying the coal bed gas monitoring abnormal data avoids the influence of the existence of the monitoring abnormal value on the rule extraction, the subsequent processing and the analysis application of the coal bed gas monitoring data sequence, and the method is packaged into a monitoring system to avoid the false alarm phenomenon caused by the monitoring abnormality.

title_en: Geological disaster meteorological risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster weather risk early warning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the potential of a geological unit; constructing a training set based on the accumulated rainfall, the live rainfall, the geological disaster category, and the potential of the geocellular over a first time period; training a geological disaster meteorological risk early warning model based on the training set; and calling the trained early warning model for prediction processing based on the accumulated rainfall, the forecast rainfall and the potentiality of the geological unit in a second time period to obtain the early warning level of the geological unit. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the forecasting method and the forecasting device realize forecasting of the geological disaster meteorological risk early warning by combining with the future rainfall working condition under the condition of considering geological environment background and live rainfall, reduce artificial dependence and improve the fineness of the geological disaster meteorological risk early warning.

title_en: Intelligent urban waterlogging disaster real-time prediction early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a smart real-time urban waterlogging disaster forecasting and early warning system and a smart real-time urban waterlogging disaster forecasting and early warning method, which belong to the technical field of urban waterlogging forecasting and early warning, wherein vehicle information is collected through an urban waterlogging model system platform, and specifically the vehicle information is H1 information of the distance between an engine air inlet and a flat ground; establishing a database V (h) by collecting the change height h of the water level of the vehicle head when the vehicle runs at a constant speed and wades into the waterlogging area at different vehicle speeds V in multiple experiments; the actual predicted water level height is H = H  Real time  + delta H + H, comparing and judging the actually predicted water level height H with H1, and when H is less than H  1  When the current time is passed. According to the invention, the information acquisition is carried out by simulating the actually measured vehicle to run at a constant speed at different speeds at the head water level change height h in the waterlogging area to establish a database, so that the maximum limit height h is obtained, and finally the limit speed V for the vehicle to pass by wading can be obtained by matching the database, so that the arrival time of the vehicle can be more accurately predicted, and a basis is provided for high-precision traffic path planning.
assignees: GUANGDONG GUANGYU SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: emergency response training system using virtual reality contents
title_ko: Vr 콘텐츠를 활용한 긴급 구조 대응 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency rescue response training system using VR contents. The emergency rescue response training system using VR contents according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a communication unit communicating with a user VR electronic device; a storage unit storing information on VR contents, event groups, and trainee groups; and a control unit controlling the communication unit and the storage unit. The control unit performs: a step (a) in which the control unit transmits an event message to a user VR electronic device of a trainee group corresponding to any one event group among the event groups; a step (b) in which the control unit transmits VR contents and a mission assignment message corresponding to an initial event to the user VR electronic device; a step (c) in which the control unit receives information on user's execution of a mission of the mission assignment message from the VR electronic device; and a step (d) in which, when the user completes performing the mission, the control unit transmits the next mission assignment message or transmits an event message to the user VR electronic device of the trainee group corresponding to the next event group. The present invention can increase the training effect by using VR contents.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 VR 콘텐츠를 활용한 긴급 구조 대응 훈련 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명의 실시 예를 따르는 VR 콘텐츠를 활용한 긴급 구조 대응 훈련 시스템은, 사용자 VR 전자기기와 통신을 수행하는 통신부; VR 콘텐츠, 이벤트 그룹 및 훈련자 그룹에 대한 정보를 저장하는 저장부; 및 상기 통신부와 저장부를 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는 아래의 방법을 수행한다. 
(a) 상기 제어부가 상기 이벤트 그룹 중 어느 하나의 이벤트 그룹에 해당하는 훈련자 그룹의 사용자 VR 전자기기에 이벤트 메시지를 송신하는 단계; (b) 상기 제어부가 상기 사용자 VR 전자기기에 이벤트 초기에 해당하는 VR 콘텐츠 및 임무부여 메시지를 송신하든 단계; (c) 상기 제어부가 상기 VR 전자기기로부터 사용자가 상기 임무부여 메시지메의 임무 수행에 대한 정보를 수신하는 단계; 및 (d) 사용자가 상기 임무 수행을 완료한 경우 다음 임무부여 메시지를 송신하거나 다음 이벤트 그룹에 해당하는 훈련자 그룹의 사용자 VR 전자기기에 이벤트 메시지를 송신하는 단계.

title_en: Simulation test apparatus for fire protection sprinkler equipment and method thereof
title_ko: 소방용 스프링클러 모의 시험 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulation test apparatus for a firefighting sprinkler and a method thereof. The simulation test apparatus for a firefighting sprinkler has various types of simple sprinkler devices installed on a device mount. The device mount includes: a frame for forming a body; and first and second support panels installed on the frame. The simple sprinkler devices include various firefighting system parts installed on the first and second support panels to demonstrate the working state of a sprinkler head. The simple sprinkler devices include water tanks, pumps, pressure gauges, valves, piping, detectors, alarms, receivers, control panels, and the like. Therefore, the simulation test apparatus has the simple sprinkler devices installed on the device mount so that students majoring in firefighting use the simple sprinkler devices to plan, design, manufacture, test, and evaluate the simple sprinkler devices in an educational field, thereby providing opportunities for the students to design, manufacture, and demonstrate the simple sprinkler devices, being immediately applied to practice in future, and greatly help to understand the importance of firefighting.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방용 스프링클러 모의 시험 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 소방용 스프링클러 모의 시험 장치는 기구물 거치대에 다양한 형태의 간이 스프링클러 설비를 설치한다. 기구물 거치대는 몸체를 형성하는 프레임과 프레임에 설치되는 제1 및 제2 지지 패널을 포함한다. 간이 스프링클러 설비는 제1 및 제2 지지 패널에 설치되어 스프링클러 헤드의 작동 상태를 시연할 수 있는 다양한 소방 설비 부품들을 포함한다. 간이 스프링클러 설비에는 수조, 펌프, 압력계, 밸브, 배관, 감지기, 경보기, 수신기 및 제어반 등을 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 기구물 거치대에 간이 스프링클러 설비를 설치하여 교육 현장에서 소방을 전공으로 하는 학생들에게 간이 스프링클러 설비를 기획, 설계, 제작, 시험 및 평가하는데 활용하여 학생들로 하여금 직접 간이 스프링클러 설비를 설계 및 제작하여 시연해 볼 수 있는 기회를 제공하고, 향후 실무에 즉시 적용할 수 있으며, 소방의 중요성을 이해하는데 큰 도움을 줄 수 있다.

title_en: Open and close assembly for fire hydrant valve and thereof manufacturing method
title_ko: 소화전밸브용 개폐뭉치 및 그 제조방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an opening and closing assembly for a fire hydrant valve and a manufacturing method thereof. When manufacturing a rod (R), a lifting screw part (R20) inserted into a hollow cap (C) and rotated forward and backward is formed in a detachable lifting body (R21), which is a separate part. A through hole (R21a) is drilled in the detachable lifting body (R21), a rod (R10) is inserted thereinto, and the detachable lifting body and the rod are mutually fixed and simply integral by, for example, welding or key fixing. In manufacturing the rod (R), the diameter of the rod (R10) is accurately provided in advance to be a diameter suitable for firefighting safety standards, for example, 13 mm. Therefore, the opening and closing assembly can ensure productivity by thoroughly eliminating waste of material that occurs in a process of providing a cylindrical rod having a diameter of 13 mm or more as in an existing technique to form the lifting screw part (R20) and reducing the diameter of the cylindrical rod by turning or rolling.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 로드(R)를 제작할 때 중공형캡(C)에 끼워져 정역회전되는 승강나사부(R20)를 별도의 부품인 착탈승강체(R21)에 형성함과 동시에 이 착탈승강체(R21)에 쓰루홀(R21a)을 뚫어 봉(R10)이 끼워지도록 한 후 상호간의 고정, 예를 들어 용접 또는 키 고정 등으로 간단히 일체화되도록 하여, 로드(R)를 제작함에 있어서 봉(R10)의 직경을 소방안전의 규격에 적합한 직경, 예를 들어 13㎜로 미리 정확하게 마련토록 하여 승강나사부(R20)를 형성하기 위하여 종래 기술과 같이 13㎜ 이상의 직경을 가진 원기둥형봉을 마련한 후 선반가공 또는 로링가공으로 원기둥형봉의 직경을 줄이는 공정에서 발생하는 소재 낭비를 철저하게 없애 생산성을 보장토록 한 소화전밸브용 개폐뭉치 및 그 제조방법에 관한 발명이다.

title_en: Mine waste reservoir accident potential and risk evolution method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evolving accident potential and risk of a tailing pond, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic data, online monitoring data, video monitoring data and three-dimensional oblique photography data of a target tailing pond, calling geological disaster data, meteorological data and high-precision satellite remote sensing data of a geographical area where the target tailing pond is located, carrying out macro hidden danger and risk analysis on the target tailing pond based on the data to acquire a comprehensive analysis result, carrying out dam break accident simulation on the target tailing pond according to the analysis result and the data, and visually displaying the simulation result. The safety of the target tailing pond can be comprehensively evaluated by comprehensively evaluating the macro hidden danger and the risk of the target tailing pond, the evaluation accuracy is improved, the forecasting and early warning are effectively carried out by taking the external uncontrollable factors into consideration, and the practicability is improved.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY SAFETY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;JIANGXI PROVINCIAL ACADEMY OF EMERGENCY MAN SCIENCES

title_en: Test method for realizing disaster simulation of collapse of soil body at lower part of buried pipeline
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of buried pipeline disaster monitoring and pipeline safety assessment, and provides a test method for realizing the simulation of a soil collapse disaster at the lower part of a buried pipeline. According to the application, the repeatability of the test and simulation in the application can be improved, the stability and reliability of the simulation result of the test method are improved, and the prediction of the relatively stable actual collapse disaster condition is facilitated. The application has reasonable design, better repeatability, higher simulation reliability and stronger applicability, and is suitable for large-scale popularization.

title_en: Sea air interaction analysis method in typhoon rapid enhancement process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing interaction of sea air in a typhoon rapid enhancement process. The method comprises the following steps: simulating the process from typhoon generation to landing by using a mesoscale WRF mode, and acquiring the evolution characteristics of simulated wind speed, path and sea level air pressure along with time; estimating the center position of the typhoon at each moment by using the lowest air pressure of the center in the tropical cyclone data, and comprehensively analyzing the tropical cyclone strength by combining the maximum wind speed of the lowest grid point and the lowest air pressure of the center; carrying out comparative analysis on sea surface temperature, sea level height abnormity and sea surface salinity in the typhoon rapid enhancement process to obtain an ocean internal reaction in the typhoon rapid enhancement process, wherein the typhoon rapid enhancement process is a process for rapidly enhancing the tropical cyclone strength; and analyzing the movement of the atmosphere on the sea surface in the typhoon rapid enhancement process according to the simulated sea level horizontal wind speed. The method has certain reference value in the aspects of forecasting the rapid enhancement process of offshore typhoon and preventing and reducing typhoon disaster.

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery drilling data early warning method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based distributed disaster recovery exercise data early warning method and system, wherein if a local edge node does not train a model, a central early warning model is uploaded to a local area for training, a local edge node server receives the central early warning model and then carries out associated data analysis and classification aggregation, a local prior probability, a local condition probability, a local adjustment factor and a local posterior probability are calculated and then input into the central early warning model for training to obtain an optimal disaster recovery exercise occurrence warning probability, data of the optimal disaster recovery exercise occurrence warning probability of each area are submitted to a central server to update the central early warning model, a headquarter exercise result database is updated, updated indexes after each training are stored, and a new round of model training is executed again by a central server program, so that the whole process is completed. According to the invention, disaster recovery drilling is taken as a main line, history drilling data is taken as an analysis basis, and artificial intelligence is introduced to replace artificial experience to replace an early warning model, so that the labor cost is greatly reduced.

title_en: Deep coal mining multi-measure comprehensive disaster prevention method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-measure comprehensive disaster prevention method for deep coal mining, which comprises the following steps: 1) determining a working face of a coal bed with a rock burst danger tendency in a key area for preventing rock burst; 2) drilling a hole in the middle of the height of the working face of the coal seam, performing hydraulic slotting, then injecting water into the coal seam, and plugging after the water injection is finished; 3) mining a coal seam self-releasing protective layer: mining at the bottom of the roadway along the roadway direction by adopting a coal planer coal cutter and the like, wherein the mining shape is a cuboid open slot along the roadway direction, and the wet waste rock is accumulated and filled into the cuboid open slot while mining; 4) when the coal seam is stoped, the coal mining machine is lifted to a height higher than the protective layer, so that the protective layer of the gangue is prevented from being collected. The comprehensive disaster prevention method adopts measures of coal seam water injection and coal seam mining self-liberation protective layers, can effectively prevent and control rock burst and spontaneous combustion ignition composite disasters, and improves the safety of coal mine operation.

title_en: Topic-guided remote sensing image subtitle generation method based on Transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a subtitle of a remote sensing image of a Transformer based on theme guidance, which mainly solves the problems that the description generated in the prior art is single and the semantic information in the image cannot be accurately represented. The implementation scheme is as follows: constructing a theme encoder consisting of a Transformer and a theme vector, and pre-training on the classification data set; building a semantic decoder which is formed by cascading a random mask layer, an embedded layer, a Transformer decoder and a soft-max layer; connecting a theme encoder with a semantic decoder to obtain a remote sensing image subtitle generation network; setting training parameters, and iteratively training a remote sensing image subtitle generation network by using a standard RSICD data set; and generating a caption description by using the trained remote sensing image caption generation network. The invention improves the diversity and the accuracy of the generation description, and can be used for ground feature image retrieval, disaster prediction and image understanding.

title_en: Earthquake warning method using application and apparatus therefor
title_ko: 어플리케이션을 이용한 지진 경보 방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are an earthquake warning method using an application and an apparatus therefor. The earthquake warning method using an application, according to an embodiment of the present invention, may comprise an earthquake acceleration reception step, an earthquake information generation step, a damage radius information generation step, a user location information acquisition step, an evacuation scenario generation step, and an evacuation scenario provision step, and the earthquake warning apparatus using an application may comprise a program for executing the earthquake warning method using an application.
abstract_ko: 어플리케이션을 이용한 지진 경보 방법 및 그 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 어플리케이션을 이용한 지진 경보 방법은 지진 가속도 수신 단계, 지진 정보 생성 단계, 피해 반경 정보 생성 단계, 사용자 위치 정보 획득 단계, 대피 시나리오 생성 단계 및 대피 시나리오 제공 단계를 포함할 수 있으며, 어플리케이션을 이용한 지진 경보 장치는 상기 어플리케이션을 이용한 지진 경보 방법을 실행시킬 수 있는 프로그램을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Ultra-high voltage converter station valve hall fireproof blocking member detection platform and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection platform for fireproof blocking components of an extra-high voltage converter station valve hall, which comprises a simulation bin with an open side, a sample frame arranged on the open side of the simulation bin, and an angle adjusting and stabilizing unit for adjusting the angle of the simulation bin, wherein the sample frame is provided with fireproof blocking components matched with the open side of the simulation bin, three sides of the simulation bin are respectively provided with a plurality of combustion tube holes, and a combustor is penetrated in each combustion tube hole; the angle adjustment stabilizing unit comprises a rotary telescopic mechanism for pulling the simulation bin to rotate and a supporting telescopic piece for supporting the bottom of the simulation bin. The invention also provides a detection method of the fireproof blocking member. The invention has the advantages that: the simulated bin can be heated up quickly by arranging the combustors in the simulated bin, the temperature rise characteristic of the fire disaster in the valve hall of the extra-high voltage converter station is simulated, the performance of the fireproof blocking member is detected, the angle of the simulated bin is regulated by the angle regulating and stabilizing unit, and the detection under different angles is realized.

title_en: Digital twin-based watershed monitoring and early warning method and simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based watershed monitoring and early warning method and a simulation platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time watershed monitoring data, transmitting the real-time watershed monitoring data to a pre-constructed three-dimensional model, and building a three-dimensional virtual simulation watershed scene with synchronous data according to the three-dimensional model; a three-dimensional virtual simulation watershed is simulated and demonstrated based on a digital twin technology and a visual large screen; obtaining real-time early warning data through a pre-constructed early warning system based on the real-time watershed monitoring data, and judging and analyzing the danger degree of the real-time early warning data to obtain a solution corresponding to the danger degree; and carrying out scheme analysis by combining a solution corresponding to the danger degree and a simulation demonstration three-dimensional virtual simulation basin to obtain a final decision scheme corresponding to the danger degree. The invention can realize scene simulation, improve early warning efficiency, early warn in time and reduce hazard of disasters.
assignees: HUNAN XIANGYINHE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Slope stability test device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope stability test device which comprises a model box, a slope model, a reservoir water model, a spray head, a data acquisition assembly and terminal equipment, wherein the slope model and the reservoir water model are both arranged in the model box, the reservoir water model is connected with the slope model, the spray head is arranged on the model box and positioned above the slope model, the pressure of the spray head is adjustable, the data acquisition assembly is arranged on the model box to acquire test data in the model box and upload the test data to the terminal equipment, and the terminal equipment is used for analyzing the test data. According to the slope stability test device provided by the embodiment of the invention, the slope model under the combined action of rainfall and reservoir water is simulated by arranging the spray head and the reservoir water model, the stability test of the slope model can be carried out, the acquired test data is beneficial to the prevention and control work of landslide disasters in a reservoir area, and the stability of the slope in the reservoir area is improved.

title_en: Real-time dynamic planning algorithm for large-scale tourist emergency evacuation line in scenic spot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dynamic emergency route planning, and discloses a scenic spot large-scale tourist emergency route dynamic planning algorithm, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the elevation, the tourist position, the length, the width and the gradient of each path of each node in the network; calculating crowd density, evacuation speed and evacuation time of each path; and (3) determining an optimal evacuation route based on a Dijkstra algorithm, evacuating the route for a time interval, updating the real-time position of the tourist, and repeating the steps 2 and 3 until the evacuation is completed. The invention has the following advantages: the time distance is adopted, so that the situation that the ascending and descending slopes cannot be described by adopting the space distance is avoided; dynamically updating the evacuation route, and effectively solving the situation that partial road congestion is possibly caused by generating a static evacuation route by Dijkstra algorithm; obtaining more practical simulation evacuation speed according to road characteristics, crowd density and the like; the simulation result can provide the optimal evacuation scheme for tourists in the scenic spot. The evacuation scheme provided by the algorithm can effectively relieve congestion, reduce evacuation time and improve evacuation efficiency in emergency.

title_en: Fire fighter high altitude psychology adaptability training system based on VR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a VR-based high-altitude psychological adaptability training system for firefighters, which comprises: the UI module is used for displaying a basic theory and used for enabling a manager to log in the system for the firefighter who has left a stroke and is trained to select subjects and difficulty; the scene management module is used for adding and deleting training subjects and training scenes; the high-altitude training module is used for acquiring a virtual scene and a model of a corresponding high-altitude training subject according to the selection instruction and acquiring training data of the trained firefighters through the interactive handle; and the evaluation module is used for analyzing the acquired training data, judging whether the trained firefighter passes the training and generates a corresponding training report, and jumping to a corresponding training scene interactive interface according to a judgment result. The invention simulates scenes of different high-altitude psychological adaptability training subjects based on the virtual reality technology, improves the psychological adaptability capability of the trained firefighter under the high-altitude condition, can ensure the safety of the trained firefighter, and can improve the high-altitude training efficiency in emergency rescue training.

title_en: Enhanced perception experience platform and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enhanced perception experience platform and a using method thereof, wherein the platform comprises a platform main body, a dynamic platform, a heat source system, a wind power system, a smoke olfaction system, a lighting system, an electric shock system, a display, an electroencephalogram acquisition terminal, a heart rate acquisition terminal and a control system; the earthquake disaster can be simulated through the dynamic platform and the display, the fire disaster can be simulated through the heat source system, the smoke olfaction system, the lighting system and the display, the typhoon disaster can be simulated through the wind power system and the display, the electric shock disaster can be simulated through the electric shock system and the display, the method has good immersion and reality of experience, can flexibly combine the simulation of four disasters, namely the fire disaster, the earthquake disaster, the typhoon disaster and the electric shock disaster, meets various experience requirements, and can acquire relevant data of an experiencer through the electroencephalogram acquisition terminal and the heart rate acquisition terminal to serve as a basis for scientific judgment and analysis.
assignees: SHENZHEN NIGULA ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for preventing and treating burst disaster of high-water-pressure-permeability complex geological tunnel
abstract_en: A method for preventing and treating sudden surge disasters of a tunnel with high water pressure infiltration complex geology comprises the following steps: (1) obtaining the prediction of the water inrush situation of the surrounding rock and the early warning forecast; (2) drilling sparse holes and reinforced holes in a high water pressure infiltration complex geological region; (3) a drainage tube is inserted into each dredging hole, a plurality of rows of discharge pipes arranged along the direction transverse to the depth direction of the tunnel are arranged on the inner wall of the tunnel, and the drainage tubes are communicated with the corresponding discharge pipes; (4) pouring grouting liquid into the reinforcing holes; (5) detachably arranging an absorption structure layer on the discharge pipe; (6) and checking the control effect of the sudden surge disaster to ensure that the construction effect is achieved. The prevention and control method disclosed by the invention adopts dredging and blocking co-treatment, can improve the normative and feasibility of the prevention and control of the sudden-gushing disaster of the high-water-pressure-permeability complex geological tunnel, effectively ensures the treatment effect, and reduces the possibility of the subsequent sudden-gushing disaster.
assignees: BEIJING NO 4 MUNICIPAL CONSTR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Extreme seismic region intensity evaluation method and system, electronic device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: An earthquake region intensity evaluation method, an earthquake region intensity evaluation system, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium belong to the technical field of earthquake disaster evaluation, and the method comprises the following steps: expanding the data samples by adding an artificial disturbance method, so that the quantities of the various types of data samples after expansion are equivalent; normalizing the data in the data sample and inputting the normalized data into a width learning network for training; and normalizing the data to be predicted, and inputting the data into the trained width learning network to obtain an intensity prediction result. The invention also discloses an earthquake region intensity evaluation system, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium. Under the conditions of unbalanced data types and insufficient samples, the method provided by the invention expands the data samples in a mode of artificial disturbance, and alleviates the problems of unbalanced data types and insufficient samples. Simulation proves that compared with the traditional model-based method, the intensity prediction accuracy is improved by the evaluation method.

title_en: Scene simulation method, device, storage medium and system for post-disaster recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scene simulation method, a scene simulation device, a storage medium and a scene simulation system for post-disaster recovery. The post-disaster economic recovery is planned and managed by the disaster dynamic computable general equilibrium model constructed on the basis of the computable general equilibrium model, the model parameter group and the social accounting matrix table, so that the multi-scene simulation and the optimal distribution mode judgment of post-disaster economic recovery investment and distribution are realized, the time for formulating the post-disaster economic recovery scheme can be shortened, and the efficiency of post-disaster economic recovery planning is improved; furthermore, the scene simulation method, the scene simulation device, the storage medium and the scene simulation system disclosed by the invention also establish various post-disaster economic recovery input distribution scenes, quantify the cascading effect of different industries, and overcome the defect of single post-disaster economic recovery input distribution mode, thereby further improving the efficiency and the recovery level of post-disaster economic recovery planning.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Mine engineering disaster modeling method based on RQD (rock core of drill hole)
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine engineering disaster modeling method based on a drill core RQD, and relates to the technical field of mine geological modeling. Firstly, according to a mine engineering work exploration drilling core, establishing a drilling core RQD database, further obtaining RQD sample data, and simultaneously converting the RQD sample data which do not meet normal distribution into normal distribution; then, according to the RQD sample data, performing variation function modeling to determine the space structure of the RQD sample data; finally, according to the spatial structure of the RQD sample data, combining the spatial positions of the engineering exploration drilling holes and the mine engineering, constructing an RQD block model, coloring the RQD block model, adding engineering geometric constraints, and completing the modeling of mine engineering disasters; the method fully considers the internal variation characteristics of the RQD data, realizes the quality disclosure and visualization of the engineering rock mass, and achieves the visualization and prevention and control of mine engineering disasters.

title_en: Method for detecting and monitoring temperature of mine goaf based on magnetic method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting and monitoring the temperature of a mine goaf based on a magnetic method, which comprises the steps of firstly, pre-embedding a magnetic target of the coal seam goaf at a fixed point, and secondly, establishing a magnetic target distribution model; step three, laying a measuring net on the ground, monitoring magnetic parameters through magnetic detection equipment, step four, converting the magnetic parameters into temperature data and judging whether a fire disaster occurs, and step five, taking measures aiming at the judgment result of the step four; the invention utilizes the characteristic that the magnetic susceptibility and the temperature of the magnet are in a linear relation, obtains the temperature change of the position of the magnetic target by monitoring the magnetic susceptibility of the distributed magnetic target in real time, takes precautionary measures in time, and can more accurately detect the position of a fire source and determine the influence range when a fire happens, so that the fire prevention measures such as drilling, grouting, nitrogen injection and the like on a fire point are more targeted.

title_en: Preparation method of high-strength high-temperature-resistant numerical control drill bit
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-strength high-temperature-resistant numerical control drill bit. The numerical control drill bit is prepared by adopting a metal powder smelting method, the toughness and the impact resistance of the steel body are improved by adding manganese and titanium, the metal powder is shaped by the binder, the internal defects and shrinkage of the drill bit in the sintering process are reduced, and no residue is left after sintering. The active ingredients in the manganese powder can avoid fire disaster caused by doping manganese powder, and the safety of the process is improved. And electroplating and diamond inlaying treatment is carried out on the drill bit of the numerical control drill bit, so that the drilling performance of the drill bit is improved. The effective components in the electroplating solution can efficiently embed diamond and a drill bit, so that the uniformity of metal element deposition is improved, and the electroplated metal piece is brighter. The protective agent improves the stability of the electroplating solution in a complexing mode, inhibits the phenomenon of hydrogen embrittlement, simultaneously 'guides' metal atoms to deposit at the defect part of the drill bit, fills the defect left by the binder after sintering, and improves the shock resistance of the drill bit.

title_en: Intelligent forecasting system for west boundary flow
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent forecasting system for a west boundary stream, which comprises the following components: the acquisition module is used for acquiring temperature data and salinity data in the air; the processing module is connected with the acquisition module and used for carrying out fusion processing on the temperature data and the salinity data to obtain a fusion data set; the model building module is connected with the processing module and is used for training the initial west boundary flow intelligent forecasting model based on the fusion data set to obtain a trained west boundary flow intelligent forecasting model; and inputting the fusion data set acquired in real time into the trained western boundary flow intelligent forecasting model, and carrying out intelligent forecasting on the western boundary flow. The application realizes the advanced prediction of the west boundary flow by establishing the west boundary flow intelligent prediction model, can remind the region affected by the west boundary flow of timely taking defensive measures, reduces meteorological disasters and reduces fishery loss.

title_en: Earthquake simulation tool for log cabin proportion model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake simulation, in particular to an earthquake simulation tool of a log cabin proportion model, which simulates the damage of secondary disasters such as collapse, ground cracks and the like caused by an earthquake to a log cabin and has good earthquake simulation effect; comprises a horizontal vibration table and a longitudinal vibration table; still including soil receiving plate, the spliced pole, the simulation dish, two fly leafs, the extension spring, lead screw and padlock mechanism, vertical vibration platform is installed on horizontal vibration platform, soil receiving plate and a plurality of spliced pole are installed on vertical vibration platform, the simulation dish is installed on a plurality of spliced poles, the spout slidable mounting of lateral wall about with through the front and back slot of simulation dish respectively in 05 in the inner of two fly leafs, all be provided with padlock mechanism on the outer wall about the inner of two fly leafs, the outer end and the simulation dish of a fly leaf are connected respectively at the both ends of extension spring, the simulation dish of another fly leaf is connected respectively at the both ends of lead screw, extension spring and lead screw are located the left and right sides of simulation dish respectively.
assignees: HUBEI SAAREMAA TIMBER STRUCTURE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Rapidly constructible emergency shelter with internal suspended bases
abstract_en: Millions of people yearly become homeless due to natural disasters. Incidents such as earthquakes and floods can cause a lot of damages and homelessness to a large number of people. So, the timely provision of shelter is a priority. This need is met through a lightweight emergency shelter with a high setup speed that can be applied in all areas with no installation training. Furthermore, a modular shelter with the least material waste in its assembling procedure can influence retaining the environment. This matter can have a significant impact on conserving vital resources. This issue can develop the field of post-disaster reconstruction and help resolve related difficulties.

title_en: Mine sand collapse disaster sand source layer position comprehensive judgment and identification method based on sand multi-source characteristic parameters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for comprehensively judging and identifying a sand source layer of a mine sand collapse disaster, and relates to the technical field of mine underground safety production. Collecting samples of loose sand layers deposited in different geological times of the surface drilling of the mine and samples of underground collapsed sand; screening out drilling samples with different granularity characteristic parameter evaluation grades; screening out drilling samples with different deposition environments; keeping a drilling sample with the frequency difference of the appearance of various morphological characteristics on the surface of the quartz particles smaller than 10%; and (4) positioning the layer position and the burial depth of the underground sand bursting source in a targeted manner through the reserved drilling sample. Compared with the traditional technical method, the method for comprehensively judging and identifying the sand source layer position of the mine sand collapse disaster integrates more data, the judgment result is more accurate and efficient, and the method has an important guiding function for pertinently carrying out rescue, treatment and re-mining work after the mine sand collapse accident.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY;YANMEI WANFU ENERGY CO LTD;YANKUANG ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: High-stability drilling equipment for water disaster emission in coal mining area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drilling equipment, in particular to high-stability drilling equipment for water disaster emission in coal mining areas, which comprises a drill rod, a drill bit and a quick-connecting piece, wherein a plurality of tooth sockets are formed in the outer wall of the drill rod, the drill bit is arranged at the head of the drill rod, the quick-connecting piece is arranged at the tail of the drill rod, a plurality of cambered plates are arranged around the drill rod, two extrusion wheels are rotationally arranged in the cambered plates, and teeth are arranged on the circumferential outer walls of the extrusion wheels; through the structure that adopts drilling rod, bow-shaped board and extrusion wheel to carry out drilling work, can reduce the drilling rod and creep into the influence of vibration phenomenon to conveyor motor, the propulsive force of the rotation moment of torsion conversion of conveyor motor into the drilling rod is conveniently simultaneously, improve equipment life to a plurality of drilling rod lug connections advance work through the extrusion wheel, can effectively shorten the middle transition time of equipment during operation, improve drilling speed greatly, improve work efficiency.
assignees: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH CO LTD OF SHANXI COAL TRANSP & SALES GROUP

title_en: Simulation method capable of simulating safe evacuation of crowd in intelligent town
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation method capable of simulating safe evacuation of intelligent township crowd. The crowd evacuation simulation method comprises the steps of constructing a crowd evacuation mobile model of an intelligent town, formulating different safety evacuation strategies according to factors influencing evacuation efficiency, and respectively carrying out crowd evacuation simulation through the different safety evacuation strategies by utilizing the crowd evacuation mobile model. The system provided by the invention can simulate the people flow condition in a real town, simulate and preview emergency evacuation events, and provide theoretical basis for the town operators to optimize the crowd safety management scheme through data calculation, so that the intelligent town 'high efficiency, high income and high safety' integrated stable operation is promoted. The method can simulate the people flow condition in the actual town, simulate and preview the emergency evacuation event, and provide theoretical basis for the town operators to optimize the crowd safety management scheme, thereby promoting the high-efficiency, high-income and high-safety integrated stable operation of the intelligent town.

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for information physical fusion power transmission network under ice disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity evaluation method of an information physical fusion power transmission network under ice disasters, which aims at the power transmission network with OPGW as the only communication medium, firstly establishes an information physical fusion power transmission network model, then fully considers the information physical fusion characteristics of the fault, response and maintenance processes of the power transmission network, and finally evaluates the elasticity capability of the information physical fusion power transmission network under ice disasters through a Monte Carlo method. The invention analyzes the coupling characteristics of the information network and the physical network in the stages of 'response in disaster' and 'recovery after disaster', and simulates the further aggravation process of the information network fault on the physical network fault and the influence of the information network maintenance on the physical network. The method overcomes the defect of considering the single physical dimension, can more accurately reflect the fault and recovery characteristics of the power transmission network under the ice disaster, quantitatively evaluates the elasticity of the power transmission network for power engineering personnel, researches the elasticity improvement strategies in three stages of pre-disaster resistance, response during disaster and post-disaster recovery, and provides effective evaluation theoretical support.

title_en: Multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of traffic network planning, which aims at the collaborative planning requirement of a regional multi-traffic network system to construct a multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method, and mainly comprises the following steps: (1) constructing a multi-mode traffic network; (2) calculating crowd movement demand based on big data; (3) various network simulation attack methods for different disasters/accidents; (4) various traffic flow distribution methods facing different requirements; (5) and calculating the robustness of the multi-mode traffic network based on a multi-layer network model. Based on the steps, the mutual dependency among different traffic network systems can be considered, the comprehensive robustness and the vulnerability of the large-area multi-type traffic network system can be effectively measured, potential vulnerable components are further excavated, the cooperative planning of the large-area multi-traffic network system is expected to be guided, and the high-robustness and high-efficiency comprehensive traffic network system is established.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: Side slope sampling device and method with anti-sinking function for geological disaster treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a side slope sampling device with an anti-sinking function for geological disaster management and a method thereof, and relates to the technical field of side slope sampling. By arranging the positioning mechanism, the situation that the four anchoring columns are difficult to drill downwards when contacting with stones and the device is inclined due to difficult anchoring is avoided, and the sampling precision of the device on the side slope is improved; by arranging the fixing mechanism, the device is prevented from toppling during sampling, the stability of the device is improved, an operator is prevented from pressing the sampling barrel downwards, the labor intensity of the operator is reduced, and the sampling efficiency of the device is improved; through setting up sampling mechanism, avoided the in-process side slope sample at the sample bucket that resets from wherein scattering, improved the precision of side slope sample, improved the sampling efficiency of this device to the side slope simultaneously.
assignees: QINGDAO GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE QINGDAO GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION DEVELOPMENT BUREAU

title_en: MTInSAR landslide monitoring method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of geological disaster prevention, and discloses a method, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring MTInSAR landslide, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring SAR image data of a landslide area to be monitored, and preprocessing the image data; establishing a PS monitoring network and a DS monitoring network according to the processed image data; acquiring MTInSAR observation data of a landslide area to be monitored by using a PS monitoring network and a DS monitoring network, wherein the MTInSAR observation data comprise an LOS (LoS) direction deformation observation value and slope elevation information; identifying atmospheric delay components in the LOS deformation observation value by adopting an independent component analysis and periodic analysis method; separating the atmospheric delay component from the LOS deformation observation value to obtain LOS deformation data after atmospheric correction; LOS directional deformation data is simulated as deformation in the direction of a slope using terrain and satellite orbit parameters. Therefore, the atmospheric automatic correction with high space-time resolution can be effectively finished without depending on an external weather model or meteorological data, the MTInSAR slope monitoring precision is improved, and landslide early warning and disaster prevention and control are facilitated.
assignees: SHENZHEN RESEARCH INSTITUTE THE CHINESE UNIV OF HONG KONG

title_en: Accurate pressure relief and gas extraction strengthening method for low-permeability outburst dangerous coal seam area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for accurately releasing pressure and strengthening gas extraction in a low-permeability outburst dangerous coal seam area, which comprises the following steps: arranging a micro-seismic sensor according to the space position of the low-permeability outburst dangerous coal seam, and monitoring micro-seismic events of the low-permeability coal seam of the outburst mine, wherein the micro-seismic events comprise an active micro-seismic event and a passive micro-seismic event; inversely calculating the wave velocity distribution of the longitudinal waves of the shock waves based on the microseismic event positioning result and the microseismic arrival time data; dividing a coal seam compact zone and a loosening and crushing zone according to the wave velocity distribution of longitudinal waves of the vibration waves; arranging single-row directional drilling holes on a top bottom plate near a coal seam compact zone or corresponding to a special gas extraction roadway; after the directional drilling construction is finished, grouting, sealing holes and connecting hydraulic fracturing equipment; fracturing by using hydraulic fracturing equipment, and discharging water and releasing pressure after fracturing is finished; and drilling extraction drill holes in the coal seam compact zone to extract gas. The method can accurately determine the site and range of pressure relief and gas extraction reinforcement by adopting reinforcement measures, and realize accurate and efficient prevention and control of coal and gas outburst disasters.
assignees: BEIJING UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY;XUZHOU MINDA INFORMATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for fire fighting practice, and control method thereof
title_ko: 소방훈련 브리핑장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire fighting training briefing device for supporting the virtual space-based fire fighting training briefing using a mixed reality (MR) device, and an operating method thereof. The fire fighting training briefing supporting device may include a confirmation unit, a setting unit, and a processing unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 혼합현실(MR, Mixed Reality) 기기를 이용한 가상 공간 기반의 소방훈련 브리핑을 지원하기 위한 소방훈련 브리핑장치 및 그 동작 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: NAVIWORKS CO LTD;UNIV JEONJU IND UNIV COOP

title_en: Marine safety Augmented Reality education and training system
title_ko: 해양안전 ar 교육훈련시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system that repeatedly performs education and training through maritime safety augmented reality contents depicting disaster situations. The system includes: an AR device (10) for outputting augmented reality content for maritime safety education, which is worn by a trainee (L) in a specific space and implemented in augmented reality in a marine disaster situation; an ear microphone (30) that wirelessly transmits information such as the progress of augmented reality content for marine safety education in conjunction with an AR device while also being worn by an educator in a specific space; an education means (40) having augmented reality contents for maritime safety education to implement marine disaster situations in augmented reality on the display of the AR device; and an augmented reality platform (50) that enables linkage with AR devices and means of education and supports the entire system for maritime safety education service. According to the present invention, through AR contents for maritime safety education that virtually depict various types of maritime disaster situations, an environment in which education and coping training are repeatedly performed is established. As the present invention allows educators to communicate in real time, education and training are possible through augmented reality on how to respond to marine disasters. Also, behavioral training and repetitive training are possible with trainees' practical sense of presence. It is possible to significantly improve the achievement of maritime safety education. By implementing various disaster situations in augmented reality, it is possible to carry out coping strategies according to survival swimming and distress.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난상황을 묘사한 해양안전 증강현실 콘텐츠를 통해 교육과 훈련을 반복 수행하는 시스템으로서, 특정 공간에서 피교육생(L)에게 착용토록 하고, 해양 재난상황을 증강현실로 구현한 해양안전 교육용 증강현실 콘텐츠를 출력하는 AR 디바이스(10); 특정 공간에서 교육자도 착용한 상태에서 AR 디바이스와 연동하여 해양안전 교육용 증강현실 콘텐츠의 진행상황 등의 정보를 무선으로 전달하는 이어마이크(30); AR 디바이스의 디스플레이에 해양 재난상황을 증강현실로 구현하도록 해양안전 교육용 증강현실 콘텐츠를 구비하는 교육수단(40); 및 AR 디바이스와 교육수단에 연동하도록 하고, 해양안전 교육서비스를 위한 전체 시스템을 지원하는 증강현실 플랫폼(50)을 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.
이러한 본 발명에 의하면, 여러 형태의 해양 재난상황을 가상으로 묘사한 해양안전 교육용 AR콘텐츠를 통해 교육과 대처훈련을 반복 수행하는 환경을 구축하는 한편, 교육자 간에 실시간으로 의사를 전달할 수 있도록 함에 따라 해양 재난상황에 따른 행동 대처요령을 증강현실을 통해 교육과 훈련이 가능함과 동시에 피교육생의 실질적 현장감 등으로 행동요령 교육과 반복훈련이 가능해져 해양안전교육의 성취도를 크게 향상시키고, 여러 재난상황을 증강현실로 구현하도록 하여 생존수영 · 조난 등에 따른 대처요령을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 효과를 제공한다.
assignees: SHIN HYUN SIL;KANG CHIL SE;CHO HYUN JUN

title_en: Intergrated control system for supporting disasters accident
title_ko: 재난 현장 통합 관제 시스템
abstract_en: An integrated control system for a disaster site according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a plurality of robots which are put into a disaster site to acquire disaster site information and transmit the information; a reception module which receives pieces of information transmitted from the plurality of robots, respectively; a control module which classifies, based on a pre-input scenario, each information received from the reception module into general situation information and emergency situation information including one or more pieces of information on whether there is a fire in the disaster site, whether a victim has been found, whether the robots can move, whether the robots can perform its mission, or whether an escape route has been found; an information implementation module in which the information transmitted from the control module is implemented independently so that the information can be distinguished from one another and which applies an identification function to the emergency situation information to call a controller's attention upon receiving the emergency situation information from the control module so that the emergency situation information is implemented to be distinguished from the general situation information. According to the present invention, the system can help a controller to quickly recognize important disaster information when the important disaster information occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난 현장 통합 관제 시스템은 재난 현장에 투입되어 상기 재난 현장 정보를 취득하고, 그 정보를 전송하는 복수 개의 로봇; 상기 복수 개의 로봇으로부터 전송받은 각각의 정보를 수신하는 수신 모듈; 기입력된 시나리오를 기초로 상기 수신 모듈로부터 전송받은 각각의 정보를 일반 상황 정보와, 재난 현장의 화재 발생 여부, 요구조자 발견 여부, 로봇의 이동 가능 여부, 로봇의 임무 수행 가능 여부, 탈출 경로 발견 여부 중 어느 하나 이상을 포함하는 비상 상황 정보로 구분하는 제어 모듈; 및 상기 제어 모듈로부터 전송받은 각각의 정보가 서로 구분될 수 있도록 독립적으로 구현하고, 상기 제어 모듈로부터 상기 비상 상황 정보를 전송받으면, 관제자의 주의를 환기할 수 있도록 상기 비상 상황 정보에 식별 기능을 부여하여 상기 일반 상황 정보와 식별 가능하게 구현하는 정보 구현 모듈;을 포함한다.

title_en: Escape cabin for family in fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to an escape cabin for family use in a fire disaster, which comprises a hoisting mechanism and an escape cabin body, wherein a steel wire rope is arranged between the hoisting mechanism and the escape cabin body for connection, and the escape cabin body comprises an outer supporting mechanism and an inner supporting mechanism; the outer supporting mechanism comprises an upper ring seat, a lower ring seat and a plurality of arc supporting rods which are hinged between the upper ring seat and the lower ring seat in a circumferential direction; the inner supporting mechanism comprises two groups of inner supporting units and a safety belt which is elastically connected between the two groups of inner supporting units, each group of inner supporting units comprises a shaft sleeve seat and a connecting rod hinged between the shaft sleeve seat and each supporting rod, and the shaft sleeve seats of the two groups of inner supporting units are elastically connected with the middle parts of the upper ring seat and the lower ring seat in a sliding manner through pressure springs; the upper ends and the lower ends of the two corresponding stay bars are respectively provided with a fixed seat, and the two connecting rods of each group of inner stay units are hinged with the stay bars through the fixed seats. The invention is foldable, easy to store, space-saving and convenient to operate, and can be used for carrying out simulated escape training.

title_en: Landslide hazard early warning method and device based on big data analysis and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide hazard early warning method, a landslide hazard early warning device and electronic equipment based on big data analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: processing first landslide monitoring data in a landslide disaster big data sample library through a preset data cleaning strategy and a preset monitoring index conversion strategy to obtain a first landslide early warning index; removing the first landslide early warning index with higher correlation degree through a Pearson correlation coefficient formula, obtaining a second landslide early warning index, segmenting a sub-sample database according to the landslide sample type, carrying out neural network model training, and obtaining a trained landslide monitoring and early warning model corresponding to each landslide sample type; and selecting a landslide monitoring and early warning model according to the type of the area to be detected, and acquiring the landslide hazard early warning grade of the area to be detected. The landslide early warning model can be established based on big data analysis, data such as landslide sample types are integrated, the pertinence of the landslide early warning model is enhanced, and the early warning accuracy is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN NORTHDOO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and device and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of crowd simulation and provides a crowd evacuation simulation method, a device and terminal equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a scene model; the method comprises the steps of constructing a pedestrian model and an attacker model based on a scene model, wherein the pedestrian model comprises pedestrian motion rules, the attacker model comprises attacker motion rules, constructing an interaction model based on the pedestrian model and the attacker model, wherein the interaction model comprises a plurality of interaction modes which can be mutually converted, and carrying out crowd evacuation simulation based on the scene model, the pedestrian model, the attacker model and the interaction model. The application can simulate the crowd evacuation movement in terrorist attack more truly, provides data support and scientific basis for construction and management of public places, and is used for reducing the casualties of the crowd in terrorist attack.

title_en: Surge simulation method and system based on landslide body motion model and mesh-free SPH
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surge simulation method and system based on a landslide body motion model and a mesh-free SPH (sinusoidal pulse height), which comprises the steps of calculating the slip time of the landslide body motion model and the slip speed and the slip distance at each moment to obtain the motion process of a landslide body on water and/or under water; constructing an SPH surge fluid particle expression and a control equation of water body motion under the impact of a landslide body, and constructing a discretized SPH surge numerical calculation model; carrying out iterative solution on the SPH surge numerical calculation model to obtain physical and mechanical parameters of the water body and a propagation motion process of the water body at each moment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out imaging processing on the movement process of a landslide body and the propagation movement process of a water body to obtain the simulated evolution process of the surge of the landslide body at each moment, further quickly determining a disaster area possibly caused by surge and climbing, and providing a more comprehensive and accurate scientific basis for real-time forecasting and prevention of the landslide surge.

title_en: Subway station fire personnel evacuation simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway station fire personnel evacuation simulation method and system, which belong to the technical field of rail transit, and are combined with a grid-Boltzmann sub-grid model obtained by a large vortex simulation method, a barrier bypass simulation model and a smoke diffusion model to construct and obtain a grid-Boltzmann fire model, a sensory model, a psychological model and a physiological model are constructed based on the grid-Boltzmann fire model, a personnel evacuation model is constructed and obtained by combining a social force model, and the grid-Boltzmann fire model and the personnel evacuation model are combined to realize real-time evacuation simulation of fire smoke by evacuated personnel. The invention realizes the substantial fusion of the fire smoke evolution and the personnel evacuation process, simulates the interaction effect of the fire smoke evolution and the personnel evacuation process, better restores the actual fire scene and provides a certain help for engineering practice.

title_en: Kriging-based power transmission tower structure wind disaster vulnerability modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Kriging-based power transmission tower structure wind damage vulnerability modeling method, which comprises the steps of taking the average strength of a wind field, a wind direction angle and a power transmission line span as basic parameters, taking a tower-line structure design wind load calculation method as a basis, combining Kriging equivalent technology and a big data analysis algorithm, solving a wind resistance surface of a power transmission tower structure, constructing a self-adaptive equivalent modeling process of the wind resistance surface of the power transmission tower, carrying out power transmission tower wind induced vulnerability calculation by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation on the basis, establishing a four-dimensional vulnerability model of the failure probability of the power transmission tower structure with respect to wind speed, the wind direction angle and a horizontal span, and realizing high-dimensional vulnerability calculation and evaluation of the power transmission tower structure under the combined influence of the space-time change of the wind field and the space distribution of the power transmission line.

title_en: Real-time forest fire spreading simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of virtual reality technology and fire prevention and control, in particular to a real-time forest fire spreading simulation method and system. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target forest; acquiring relevant information of the target forest through a remote sensing satellite and ground communication equipment; obtaining overall fire spreading information by using the related information; setting a prediction time length; predicting a change in fire climate information and a change in fire fuel information within the predicted time period; and obtaining the whole fire spreading situation according to the change, and simultaneously carrying out real-time simulation on the fire spreading situation. The method combines and maps meteorological factors, topographic factors and fuel factors closely related to the forest fire and the fire condition, thereby accurately and quickly simulating the spreading condition of the fire, not only providing decision support for fire departments to put out the forest fire, but also having great significance and effect on forest disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Dam break disaster prevention and control method for tailing pond
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dam break disaster prevention and control of a tailing pond, in particular to a dam break disaster prevention and control method of a tailing pond. The method comprises the following steps: performing dam break numerical simulation on the tailing pond under a first working condition; determining the numerical range of each dam break prevention and control facility parameter; combining different values within the numerical range of each parameter in the second step to form multiple different working conditions, and performing dam break numerical simulation on each working condition; determining the optimal dam break prevention and control facility parameters as a second working condition; carrying out a large-scale physical model test, comparing and analyzing a dam break physical model test result and a numerical simulation calculation result, and selecting an optimal working condition; under the optimal working condition, a drainage groove is arranged at the upstream of important facilities of the tailing dam. The prevention and control method provided by the invention can systematically reduce the downstream disasters caused by dam break of the tailing pond, and realize comprehensive prevention and control of dam break mud and sand flow blocking, storage interception, ladder pond energy dissipation, guidance and risk avoidance and the like.
assignees: BGRIMM TECH GROUP CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Disaster chain management and control coping method, system, terminal equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster chain management and control coping method, a disaster chain management and control coping system, terminal equipment and a disaster chain management and control coping medium, wherein the disaster chain management and control coping system comprises the following steps: visualizing an accident evolution process in a complex disaster chain to obtain an accident process timeline; taking accident prevention measures as initial conditions of numerical simulation input, checking the vulnerability of a disaster-bearing body, searching for major risks and defects, and constructing a prevention preparation check line for preventing disasters and expanding consequences; when a preset preventive safety barrier fails, determining an emergency disposal measure line corresponding to the current disaster accident; when a preset response type safety barrier is invalid, acquiring accident consequences caused by a current disaster accident, and quantizing the accident consequences to obtain an accident consequence quantization line; according to the four lines, the capability requirements and gaps of risk prevention and emergency treatment are quantified, and scientific coping and key link decision are supported by data. The method and the device can realize accurate analysis based on parallel time-course lines and improve the prevention and response efficiency of the complex disaster chain.

title_en: Foam-water movable fire extinguishing integrated device applied to petroleum drilling operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a be applied to portable integrated device that puts out a fire of foam-water of oil drilling operation, it is integrated with water pitcher, foam tank, control box and fire pump package in proper order. The water tank and the foam tank are both connected with the fire pump set, the components are integrated on the bottom pry, and the bottom of the bottom pry is also provided with a rotating mechanism. Flange pipe connections are arranged between the water tank and the fire pump set and between the foam tank and the fire pump set, and flexible connecting valves are detachably arranged between the flange pipes which are symmetrically connected. The fire extinguishing integrated device can realize the conversion of foam, water or foam-water mixed fire extinguishing modes, is mainly used for extinguishing fire disasters of drilling equipment in the petroleum drilling operation process, and can also provide foam-water treatment for fire-fighting hidden dangers of other parts through the device. Meanwhile, the device can effectively overcome the impact influence, ensure smooth fire extinguishing operation, ensure long-term use in petroleum drilling operation and effectively reduce the failure rate and the maintenance cost.
assignees: SHAANXI ANJIEXUN FIRE TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for acquiring characteristic parameters of efficient filter under fire condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for acquiring characteristic parameters of a high-efficiency filter under the condition of fire; organic substances are combusted in a combustion chamber, generated high-temperature smoke contains a large amount of aerosol, and the research on relevant parameters of the failure state of the high-efficiency filter under the condition that fire disasters occur in nuclear facilities is simulated; a corresponding nuclear accident high-efficiency filter simulation experiment system is established to carry out efficiency research of the high-efficiency filter under the condition of a nuclear accident, the actual environment of the high-efficiency filter is considered for research, the experiment process is controlled in a targeted mode, the relevant characteristics of the high-efficiency filter under the condition of the nuclear accident under the specific situation are researched, relevant parameters are obtained, a more appropriate nuclear facility fire situation is provided for estimation of a nuclear accident release source item, and a good data foundation is laid.

title_en: Cable trench fire simulation and cover plate structure stability measurement system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable trench fire simulation and cover plate structure stability measurement system and a method, wherein the system comprises a cable trench body, a cover plate bracket, a support frame, a cable carrier, a combustion device, a water mist device and a blower device; the size of the inner cavity of the cable trench body is adjustable, and the cover plate bracket is used for supporting the cable trench cover plate and installing the aerosol fire extinguisher; the cable carrier comprises cable clamps for clamping cables with different diameters, and the distance between the cable clamps is adjustable; the combustion device is used for igniting the cable on the cable carrier; the water mist device is used for adjusting the humidity of the cable duct body; the blower device is used for blowing fresh air into the cable trench body. The invention mainly researches the cable burning rate and the influence on the cover plate structure when a fire disaster occurs in the cable trench under different environmental factors, different cable arrangement modes and different ventilation conditions, and provides reference for the fire protection design of the cable trench.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster simulation cabin for ship and warship
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire disaster simulation cabin of a ship and a naval vessel, which belongs to the technical field of fire disaster simulation and comprises an oil pool and a bearing plate, wherein the bearing plate is positioned below the oil pool, an elastic component and pushing components are arranged on the bearing plate, the number of the pushing components is not less than three, the pushing components support the oil pool in the vertical direction, and vertical pushing force is applied to the oil pool to generate shaking; the elastic component is used for being matched with the pushing component to shake the oil pool with different intensities, the set quantity of the elastic component is the same as that of the pushing component, and the application has the effect of researching fire burning characteristics of the liquid in the ship engine room under different shaking intensities.

title_en: Model test device and test method for landslide debris flow impact disaster bearing body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model test device and a test method for landslide debris flow impact disaster-bearing body. And manufacturing a landslide debris flow wedge body and a disaster bearing body model, wherein the hydraulic jack is used for adjusting the gradient of the wedge body and playing a supporting role. The device is opposite to a conventional chute simulation landslide debris flow impact disaster bearing body test, and a transmission control device is used for driving a disaster bearing body model to impact a landslide debris flow front edge wedge body model according to the principle that interaction forces among objects are equal in magnitude. The invention has simple structure, easy operation and convenient arrangement of sensors and data acquisition; the shape parameters, particle size composition and distribution, pore parameters and the like of the wedge at the front edge of the landslide debris flow can be effectively controlled; the model test of the landslide debris flow impact disaster-bearing body under different parameters such as the gradient of the wedge-shaped body, the impact speed and the impact direction can be carried out.

title_en: Earthquake disaster deduction method and system based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality-based earthquake disaster deduction method and system, and relates to the field of disaster deduction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring earthquake drilling application information; modeling is carried out based on the earthquake drilling scene information, and earthquake drilling three-dimensional scene information is obtained; extracting elements of the drill scene to obtain element information of the drill scene; determining earthquake simulation parameters according to the earthquake application information, and calling and calibrating an earthquake disaster prediction model by using the earthquake simulation parameters; inputting the drilling scene element information and the earthquake simulation parameters into a calibration earthquake disaster prediction model to obtain earthquake disaster prediction parameter information; and performing scene deduction on the earthquake disaster prediction parameter information based on the virtual reality technology, and performing earthquake prevention management according to the deduction result. The earthquake disaster deduction method has the advantages that the accuracy of earthquake disaster deduction is improved, the earthquake disaster deduction effect and quality are improved, and further the technical effects of strong effectiveness, high accuracy, prevention management and the like are carried out on the earthquake disasters.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Supporting method for high-stress broken roadway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supporting method for a high-stress broken roadway, and relates to the field of supporting of roadways. The method comprises the steps of paving a metal net on the surface of a roadway immediately after the roadway is excavated, installing anchor rods and anchor cables on holes of the paved metal net, anchoring by adopting resin anchoring agents at the end parts of the anchor rods and the anchor cables, stirring and reinforcing the resin anchoring agents at the opposite end parts of an anchor rod drilling machine, adding a hollow cement anchoring agent which is soaked in water on the installed anchor rods and anchor cables, tightly attaching the position of the hollow cement anchoring agent to the resin anchoring agent, tamping the hollow cement anchoring agent by adopting a percussion drill to enable the anchor rods and the anchor cables to form a full-length anchoring structure, installing a supporting plate and a nut device at the tail parts of the anchor rods, fastening by adopting the supporting plate and a rigging device at the tail parts of the anchor cables, and jointly forming the full-length anchoring supporting structure of the anchor net cable. The invention enables the roadway surrounding rock to form a composite arch structure, eliminates various disasters caused by high stress, and thoroughly improves the stability of the high stress broken surrounding rock mass.

title_en: Landslide disaster early warning method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
