abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide hazard early warning method, a landslide hazard early warning device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which relate to the technical field of landslide hazard early warning, and comprise the steps of obtaining first information, calculating second information, constructing a virtual side slope model according to the obtained first information, and obtaining landslide information through simulation calculation; constructing a neural network model according to the first information and the second information, and obtaining the information of the predicted landslide according to the neural network model; and grading the potential landslide of the side slope according to the predicted landslide information to obtain the landslide early warning grade. The method calculates the speed and the acceleration of the shallow layer of the side slope and the change of the dip angle between points through the data of the monitoring points, and has simple calculation and easy realization; and through the prediction of the neural network model, the specific time of landslide formation and the size of the landslide occurring volume are combined to give an early warning, so that casualties and economic losses can be effectively and accurately avoided.

title_en: Few vegetation hydropower station side slope high position geological disaster body dumping destruction test simulation device
abstract_en: The application discloses a simulation device for a collapse failure test of a side slope high-position geological disaster body of a hydropower station with less vegetation, which comprises a supporting part, wherein the supporting part comprises a first supporting surface for placing disaster body mother rocks and a second supporting surface for placing the collapse deformation part of the disaster body, the surface of the second supporting surface is provided with a simulated side slope surface material, an inflatable part is arranged between the collapse deformation part of the disaster body and the second supporting surface, the collapse deformation part of the disaster body is gradually separated from the disaster body mother rocks and falls down along with the discharge of gas in the inflatable part, the simulation device also comprises a shooting part for shooting pictures of the collapse deformation part of the disaster body in various states, the simulation of the whole collapse deformation failure process of the side slope high-position geological disaster body of the hydropower station can be realized by the device, particularly, the simulation and the test of the micro deformation of a high-position rock body during the period from the disturbance to the rolling down can generate high-position disaster bodies of different landslide situations, the method is used for mechanism research, and image recognition and learning are realized by capturing displacement and deformation of the high-order disaster body.
assignees: HUANENG GANSU HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Monte Carlo algorithm-based power distribution network toughness evaluation method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network toughness evaluation method based on a Monte Carlo algorithm under typhoon disasters, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a typhoon field model by taking the maximum wind speed radius as a boundary according to the rule that the wind speed is distributed in a vortex shape under typhoon disasters; s2: according to the mechanical effect of the power distribution network element under the typhoon disaster, a power distribution network element fault probability model based on the mechanical load effect theory is established; s3: obtaining fault probability data through a fault probability model, and determining a random fault scene of the power distribution network element by using Monte Carlo method simulation; s4: calculating to obtain a toughness evaluation index value by taking the difference integral of the total load and the operation load under the typhoon disaster as a toughness evaluation index of the power distribution network; the method provided by the invention only needs to consider the influence of the distribution network elements on the load points of the distribution network, can effectively solve the problem of calculated amount caused by excessive elements in the system, is suitable for large-scale distribution network toughness evaluation calculation, and has good comprehensiveness and operability for distribution network toughness evaluation.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Seabed groove three-dimensional form prediction method considering dynamic bottoming effect of mooring line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seabed groove three-dimensional form prediction method considering dynamic bottoming effect of a mooring line, which comprises the following steps: step 1) acquiring a soil body range swept by the mooring line in a cycle by simulating the stress of the mooring line at the middle-soil section and the middle-water section, and acquiring a stable mooring line state and a stress state after multiple cycles; and 2) calculating to obtain a maximum transverse displacement point and a deepest transverse displacement point of the mooring line based on the stable mooring line state, returning the two points to the step 1) for calculation again, and obtaining the final stable groove profile through repeated iteration. The method of the invention considers the transverse movement of the anchoring line, is used for describing the outline of the field groove and can also be used for describing the outline of the engineering three-dimensional groove in detail, and can provide important basis for preventing and controlling the disaster of the field groove.

title_en: Resistance-increasing energy-absorbing anchor rod
abstract_en: A resistance-increasing energy-absorbing anchor rod comprises a first-stage anchoring element, a second-stage anchoring element, a third-stage anchoring element, a resistance-increasing energy-absorbing element, a rod body, a nut and a tray; the first-stage anchoring element, the second-stage anchoring element, the resistance-increasing energy-absorbing element and the third-stage anchoring element are sequentially arranged at the drilling insertion end of the rod body; the second-stage anchoring element is fixedly matched with the rod body through a nut; the third-stage anchoring element is in limit fit with the rod body through a nut. According to the invention, the second-stage and third-stage anchoring elements are matched with the resistance-increasing energy-absorbing elements, so that the support requirements of various severe working conditions can be met; the resistance-increasing energy-absorbing element can greatly improve the deformation capacity of the anchor rod while ensuring high anchoring force so as to adapt to disasters such as large deformation of high-stress rock mass, rock burst and the like; the coupling effect between the anchoring agent and the rod body is relieved, the interface strength relation of the anchor rod is established, and the purposes of both the structure resistance-increasing sliding and the large deformation of the rod body material are achieved; the invention also has the characteristics of simple structure, convenient use and low price.

title_en: Ecological seawall disaster prevention and reduction efficiency analysis method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the water conservancy engineering technology, and discloses an ecological seawall disaster prevention and reduction efficiency analysis method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out seawall ecology on the target seawall; establishing three-dimensional space fluid power for the target ecological seawall; performing wave climbing simulation of the embankment body and wave overtopping simulation of the embankment top to obtain an overtopping amount index; calculating the shear stress at the bottom of the wave current of the target ecological seawall, establishing a sediment movement model, and calculating the transport capacity of the sediment suspended load sediment and the transport capacity of the pushed load sediment by using the sediment movement model; calculating a coastal bed surface change index according to the sediment transport amount and the transport amount of the transport mass sediment, and determining a beach development index before the dam of the target ecological seawall according to the coastal bed surface change index; and calculating the disaster prevention and reduction efficiency level of the target ecological seawall according to the wave-crossing amount index and the beach upcoating development index before the seawall. The invention also provides an ecological seawall disaster prevention and reduction efficiency analysis device, electronic equipment and a medium. The invention can improve the efficiency of the ecological seawall in disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Network security emergency response knowledge graph relation extraction method based on comparison learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security emergency response knowledge graph relation extraction method based on contrast learning, which comprises the following steps of: preparing a network security emergency response text set, wherein the network security emergency response text set comprises a plurality of network security emergency response sentences, and each sentence comprises two entities and an entity relationship; marking each network security emergency response sentence, and inputting the sentence into a connection encoder and a decoder to obtain a primary prediction relation vector; generating a plurality of negative samples to generate corresponding negative sample relation vectors; generating a positive sample relation vector by generating a positive sample; and continuously optimizing the preliminary prediction relation vector in the training process, enabling the distance between the preliminary prediction relation vector and the negative sample relation vector to be longer, enabling the distance between the preliminary prediction relation vector and the positive sample relation vector to be shorter, obtaining an accurate prediction relation vector, and inputting the prediction relation vector into a pre-trained relation classifier to obtain the predicted relation.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGZHIWEI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground directional drilling for advanced control of multi-disaster-source ore bed mining method
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ground directional drilling for administering multi-disaster source ore deposit exploitation method in advance, include: protection component, protection component protects a section of thick bamboo and seals a section of thick bamboo including propping up, prop up and protect a section of thick bamboo and ground directional drilling inner wall cooperation and peg graft, ground directional drilling top inner wall pegs graft with sealing a section of thick bamboo outer wall cooperation, prop up and protect a section of thick bamboo inner wall fastening installation and be used for propping up a reinforced locking lever subassembly of section of thick bamboo, ground directional drilling inner wall is evenly seted up and is drawn to one side drilling, draw drilling and level ground contained angle to be 15 to one side, the utility model discloses a set up arc-shaped base and lock at the locking lever tip and detain the cooperation and use, conveniently detain the tip through arc-shaped base extrusion locking to make locking detain and expand by reaming seam department under arc-shaped base extrusion, thereby conveniently make locking detain the joint after the expansion draw drilling inner wall to one side, conveniently improve the fastening nature of locking lever installation, improved the performance of strutting to ground directional drilling.
assignees: SHANXI WENLONG ZHONGMEI HUANNENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel fire simulation experiment device under natural rainfall environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel fire simulation experiment device in a natural rainfall environment, and aims to simulate the combustion and smoke characteristics of tunnel fires in rainfall environments with different intensities. Therefore, the tunnel fire simulation experiment device in the natural rainfall environment comprises a tunnel model, a fire source simulation system, a fuming simulation system, a rainfall simulation system and a data acquisition system, wherein the fire source system is used for simulating a fire source when a tunnel is in fire; the smoke generation simulation system is used for simulating smoke released when a fire disaster occurs in the tunnel; the rainfall simulation system is used for simulating the natural rainfall working condition when a tunnel is in fire, and the data acquisition system is used for acquiring data of the combustion form change of a fire source in the tunnel model, the movement track of a smoke layer, the temperature of each measuring point, the air flow speed, the air pressure and the smoke concentration. Furthermore, the system can be matched with a fan system to simulate the fire burning characteristics and smoke flow movement characteristics of the tunnel in a more complex wind and rain coupling environment.

title_en: Portable evacuation guiding system based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable evacuation guiding system based on cloud computing. The communication positioning terminal uploads positioning data and audio data described by onsite voice of a leader to a decision terminal deployed at the cloud end through a communication module in the terminal. The decision terminal analyzes the site description audio uploaded by the communication positioning terminal into emergency description parameters, inputs the emergency description parameters into evacuation simulation software, and the evacuation route planning software generates an evacuation optimized route by calling the evacuation simulation software and issues the route through the communication module. The portable guide terminal acquires a control scheme issued by the decision terminal; the portable guide terminal is provided with a handle and a suspension ear, and the guide point position can be dynamically adjusted according to actual requirements. According to the invention, the scheme has the characteristics of high flexibility and strong operability, and has positive significance for ensuring the orderly evacuation of personnel in the dense places and avoiding secondary accidents caused by inefficient evacuation.

title_en: Fire resistance limit calculation method for T-shaped superposed beam under fire disaster
abstract_en: A fire resistance limit calculation method under a T-shaped laminated beam fire disaster relates to the technical field of safety risk assessment and comprises the steps of thermal-force coupling analysis, prediction and judgment of crack cracking width and height, simulation of influences of different parameters on the limit of T-shaped lamination Liang Naihuo, fitting of T-shaped lamination Liang Naihuo limit formulas under different working conditions by adopting SPSS data analysis software, and verification of accuracy through test values and simulation values. The invention provides a fire resistance limit calculation method under a T-shaped superposed beam fire disaster, which aims to determine the influence of different factors on the T-shaped superposed Liang Naihuo limit under the fire disaster, and comprises the factors of the thickness C of a concrete protection layer, the load holding level L  r , the superposition parameter D  h , the friction coefficient F  h  and the like, and the fire resistance limit of a test piece is determined by combining the factors.

title_en: River basin flood disaster planning method based on hybrid model
abstract_en: The invention provides a river basin flood disaster planning method based on a hybrid model, which comprises water level prediction model training, model application and planning optimization; constructing a drainage basin flood disaster risk coefficient in the model application process, calculating the coefficient based on a drainage basin water level prediction model, and adopting population density and land utilization type near each measuring point of the drainage basin as evaluation indexes when the vulnerability analysis of a disaster-bearing body is carried out in the construction process of the drainage basin flood disaster risk coefficient, wherein the weight of each land utilization type is determined by using an expert evaluation method; the method can minimize the risk coefficient of flood disasters in the river basin and output a plurality of optimal plans with larger difference.

title_en: Three-dimensional analog simulation device and method for inducing coal seam overlying strata water inrush by fault activation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional similarity simulation device for inducing water inrush of a overburden bed separation layer of a coal seam by fault activation under the mining action, which simulates the size of the coal seam by adopting the size of a wood block, is arranged on a bottom sliding support system, and draws a sliding support shaft to take out the wood block to simulate the coal seam mining, thereby overcoming the problem of difficulty in mining the coal seam in a three-dimensional similarity simulation experiment; a loading system with the load changing along with the depth and the horizontal direction is arranged outside the simulated rock layer to simulate the influence of the ground stress in the horizontal direction on the abscission layer development and the fault activation; the inclined sealing plastic film bags which are communicated with the horizontal sealing plastic film bags in a crossing mode are additionally arranged among the simulated rock layers, the overlying strata abscission layer development rule and the fault activation rule are analyzed through the flow change of water flowing into and flowing out of the sealing plastic films and the data change of the miniature soil pressure box, the physical process of actual abscission layer water filling and the physical process of water inrush disasters of the abscission layer water along the fault are researched according to the actual proportion, and the water inrush disaster forecast is achieved.

title_en: Flood disaster deduction method and system based on digital twin simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood disaster deduction method and a system based on a digital twin simulation platform, which relate to the field of digital simulation platforms and comprise the following steps: defining a flood disaster monitoring area with multiple elements to be monitored; traversing the multielement elements to be monitored in a flood disaster monitoring area to obtain a multielement element distribution area list; traversing the multi-element distribution area list through a remote sensing monitoring platform to extract the landform features and obtain landform feature information; traversing the multi-element distribution area list through the unmanned aerial vehicle image exploration array to obtain multi-element characteristic information; traversing the multi-element distribution area list according to the landform characteristic information to generate a landform simulation result; inputting the characteristic information of the multiple elements into a landform simulation result to generate a multiple element distribution simulation result; and obtaining a flood simulation data set, and inputting a multielement element distribution simulation result to carry out disaster evaluation so as to generate a flood disaster deduction result. Solves the technical problem of lack of assessment on the development trend of flood disasters.

title_en: AC/DC hybrid power distribution network fault recovery method under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AC/DC hybrid power distribution network recovery method under extreme disasters, which comprises the steps of establishing a time sequence process considering fault restoration by taking the minimum system loss load and the minimum line active power network loss as objective functions, rapidly deploying a mobile emergency power supply after an accident and carrying out a model for carrying out cooperative reconstruction of an AC/DC part of the AC/DC hybrid power distribution network in real time, and solving under a given constraint condition to obtain a mobile emergency power supply deployment and switching action time sequence scheme for minimizing the system loss load and the minimum line active power network loss; according to the method, the process of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network after being affected by the extreme event is divided into a plurality of time intervals, and the recovery of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network under the extreme disaster is realized by simulating the time sequence restoration of the fault and the time sequence reconstruction of the network.

title_en: Lightning drop zone prediction method based on grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightning drop zone prediction method based on grids, which comprises the following steps: constructing a lightning grid image by taking point position data of lightning as a reference; constructing a lightning data set by using the lightning raster image; the lightning falling zone model training and prediction based on deep learning is characterized in that the lightning falling zone approach prediction method based on grids can further solve the problem of lightning falling zone prediction by autonomously learning spatial laws implicit in data by combining lightning falling zone grid data with a deep learning method. On one hand, effective decision support can be rapidly and finely provided for disaster reduction and prevention of meteorological disasters, and good social and economic effects are achieved; on the other hand, a new method basis can be provided for disaster reduction and prevention of meteorological lightning disasters.

title_en: Safety trusteeship service method based on knowledge graph and domain adaptation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe hosting service method based on knowledge graph and domain adaptation, comprising the following steps: inputting the prepared network emergency response knowledge graph set into a knowledge graph redundancy processing module, removing redundant features in different knowledge graphs, extracting features with high correlation, and using the processed features as a source domain of a server side; training a network security event inference model by using a source domain at a server side, and broadcasting parameters of the trained network security event inference model to each client side; each client takes the network security log file as a target domain, different source domain-target domain pairs are established for different clients, and a network security event inference model of the client is trained; after the training of the network security event inference model of the client is finished, the client uploads the parameters of the reinforced inference module in the local network security event inference model to the server; the method has the characteristic of effectively improving the processing efficiency of the network security events.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGZHIWEI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire Safety Education System using Authentic Virtual Reality
title_ko: 실감가상현실(avr)을 이용한 소방안전 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire safety education system using realistic virtual reality (AVR), comprising: a VR device centered on audio-visual; fire safety education contents; an electric lamp that heats the air; an electric fan that creates and supplies wind; a frame that fixes the electric lamp and electric fan; a power cutoff module; and a controller. The present invention focuses on the expansion of the tactile sense, so that the users can feel not only the audio-visual sense in the virtual reality space, but also the tactile sense, such as the temperature of a hot flame and wind to learn as if in a real environment. In a virtual situation where a fire occurs, because the heat lamp in front operates and enables the users to feel the heat, the users can feel a sense of reality as if being in a fire site. Through the present invention, there is a remarkable effect of improving the learning effect for users to experience learning by feeling and acting directly in an environment like a real site.

title_en: Entry window for firefighter
title_ko: 소방관 진입창호
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an entry window for firefighters, which can be easily opened without breakage for escape training or inspection, thereby reducing maintenance cost. An entry window for firefighters according to one embodiment of the present invention, which is an entry window for firefighters, installed in a building, comprises: a window frame installed in an opening of the building; a window configured to open or close the window frame; a locking unit comprising an electromagnet installed on the window frame and a metal member installed on the window at a position facing the electromagnet, and fixing the window to the window frame; and a control unit connected to the electromagnet through a wire and supplying power to the electromagnet, wherein when a fire occurs in the building, the control unit can cut off the power supplied to the electromagnet to release the state in which the window is fixed to the window frame.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방관 진입창호에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 소방관 진입창호는 건축물에 설치되는 소방관 진입창호로, 상기 건축물의 개구부에 설치되는 창틀; 상기 창틀을 개방 또는 폐쇄하는 창; 상기 창틀에 설치되는 전자석과, 상기 전자석에 마주보는 위치에서 상기 창에 설치되는 금속부재로 이루어지고 상기 창을 상기 창틀에 고정시키는 잠금부; 및 상기 전자석에 전선을 통해 연결되고 상기 전자석에 전원을 공급하는 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 건축물에 화재 발생시, 상기 제어부는 상기 전자석으로 공급되는 전원을 차단하여 상기 창이 상기 창틀에 고정된 상태를 해제시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Active mobile emergency training simulator
abstract_en: A mobile emergency training simulator including a movable simulation structure. The structure includes a plurality of rooms, including a simulator control room; at least one training room; and at least one emergency-simulating or disaster-simulating mechanism configured to simulate at least one of: a natural disaster; a man-made disaster, a medical emergency.

title_en: Debris flow intersection area simulation method and system based on multiple grid method
abstract_en: The invention provides a debris flow intersection area simulation method and system based on a multiple grid method, and relates to the technical field of multiphase flow simulation. The invention introduces a multi-grid technology on the basis of simulating the debris flow intersection area by the existing MAC method, accelerates the solving process, and can well simulate the intersection form and water level distribution of the debris flow and the main flow by the simulation result so as to be further used in the field of debris flow disaster prevention and control. Through multiple grid technology, the algorithm is higher in calculation efficiency and faster in convergence, is more suitable for large-scale grid calculation solving, is more efficient and shorter in consumed time for simulation of debris flow intersection areas compared with the traditional MAC solving technology, and is beneficial to large-scale grid calculation solving.
assignees: CHENGDU GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY SOUTHWEST GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH IN

title_en: Urban waterlogging prediction method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inland inundation flood prevention, and discloses an urban inland inundation forecasting method based on big data, which comprises the following steps of collecting data, establishing a database, collecting basic geographic information, hydrology and flood data, social and economic data, inland inundation disaster data in the past period, structure data, engineering scheduling data and the like of a target city, collecting inland inundation data of the city in the past year, wherein the inland inundation data comprises rainfall forecast and actually measured rainfall, inland inundation time and spatial distribution, inundation depth, inundation range and the like in the past year, and establishing inland inundation big data of the city; the model generalization specifically comprises the generalization of the underlying surface of the region, the generalization of source facilities, the generalization of pipe networks and the generalization of rivers and lakes; calibrating parameters and simulating a target city model; establishing a multi-model and coupling; establishing a hydrological model; establishing an urban inland inundation model based on a big data algorithm; early warning analysis; the method can simulate the target urban water flow state stably and accurately in real time, thereby providing solid system support for prediction and early warning of the method.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LIUCHUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Frozen soil thawing and sinking risk assessment method and device combining dynamic deformation and static index
abstract_en: The invention provides a frozen soil thawing and sinking risk assessment method and device combining dynamic deformation and static indexes, according to the method, on the basis of a traditional static risk assessment index simulation result, a risk assessment index combining surface dynamic deformation information and static simulation information is provided. The frozen earth surface deformation information is obtained by interferometric SAR (InSAR) inversion, a static index simulation result is obtained through a thawing index, a risk division index and an allowable bearing capacity index, and the static index and the dynamic deformation are combined through a hierarchical analysis method to obtain a multi-factor index considering the frozen earth freezing and thawing change state. According to the invention, the multi-factor index is verified by utilizing the evaluation result of the existing index and the frozen earth surface deformation data of the research area, and the method has certain reference significance for the permafrost thawing and settlement disaster evaluation work along the infrastructure of the frozen earth area.

title_en: Characterization measurement method for urban public service disaster toughness
abstract_en: A method for measuring the toughness of public service in city includes such steps as building the urban space composite network of living-service-traffic under normal state based on urban road network, removing the invalid road segments and functional nodes under different intensity disasters by means of disaster simulation, building the damaged urban space composite network of living-service-traffic, calculating the public service level of resident at each living node, forming the performance model of urban space network, calculating the variation rate of public service level, drawing the relation curve between said variation rate and disaster intensity, and measuring the toughness of public service in city. According to the invention, the change of public service can be obtained by residents, the dynamic evolution of the supply and demand matching performance of the urban public service under the cooperation of a plurality of systems is represented, the urban public service disaster toughness measurement model is established, and a technical tool is provided for enhancing the urban toughness level in planning practice.

title_en: Intelligent safety monitoring system for outdoor construction site and working method
abstract_en: The system comprises a face acquisition module, a cloud processing module, a video acquisition module, a central processing module, a wireless transmission module and an alarm module. Firstly, a system administrator compares and logs in a safety monitoring system through facial recognition with an authorized face database established at a cloud end, and starts the monitoring system; secondly, the system center processing module calls a monitoring camera to acquire real-time construction site information, and performs matching monitoring with a safety helmet and a firework model established by training; and finally, if the situation that the personnel do not wear the safety helmet or a fire disaster happens is monitored, the alarm module is activated to carry out voice prompt or trigger an alarm system, and meanwhile, short message prompt is carried out on the security management personnel. The invention judges whether the user has the authority to enter the safety monitoring system through face recognition, designs a pre-alarm system aiming at safety helmet wearing and fire according to potential safety hazards possibly existing in the field aiming at the characteristics of outdoor construction scenes, can effectively prevent the occurrence of dangers in outdoor construction sites, and ensures the safety of personnel and property.

title_en: Rock burst mine roadway thick-layer bottom coal gangue inclusion blasting cracking combined pressure relief method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock burst mine roadway thick-layer bottom coal gangue blast cracking combined pressure relief method, which comprises the following steps: averagely dividing a region containing gangue of thick-layer bottom coal of a mine roadway into n stages; selecting a measuring point in each stage, and performing lithology measurement on a mine roadway bottom plate to obtain the gangue inclusion lithology and the gangue inclusion thickness of thick-layer bottom coal in each stage; dividing the region containing the gangue into different region grades; respectively formulating large-diameter drilling pressure relief scheme parameters and coal seam blasting pressure relief scheme parameters of different grade areas based on the area grades; and formulating large-diameter drilling and coal bed blasting pressure relief construction procedures in different grade areas based on the large-diameter drilling pressure relief scheme parameters and the coal bed blasting pressure relief scheme parameters to realize combined pressure relief of roadway thick-layer bottom coal gangue inclusion blasting cracking. The pressure relief effect of the rock burst mine roadway thick-layer bottom coal gangue inclusion region is effectively improved, the impact dynamic disaster risk caused by insufficient pressure relief force due to gangue inclusion is reduced, and the life safety factor of underground workers is improved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY;YIQI BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA ZHONGTAI ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Road collapse test system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a road collapse test system and method, which comprises a water collecting tank, a model box body, a circulating load device, an image monitoring device, an isobaric water tank, a rainfall device, a plurality of pipelines, a quality monitoring device and a disease hydraulic device, wherein the water collecting tank is used for providing circulation of rainwater and pipeline water and collecting pipeline drainage, a plurality of pipelines are buried in the model box body to realize pavement of road stratum, stratum pipelines and pavement, the circulating load device is used for providing circulating load of the pavement, the image monitoring device is used for recording road deformation in the whole test process, the isobaric water tank is used for providing pipeline water for the pipelines, the rainfall device is used for providing rainfall simulation, the quality monitoring device is used for recording quality change of the model box body, and the disease hydraulic device is used for carrying out disease type arrangement in the model box body. The invention realizes the simulation test of various environmental conditions of urban roads, makes up for the unilateral performance of the traditional single environmental model test, and improves the accuracy and reliability of the pregnant disaster development characteristic record of the seepage pipeline.

title_en: Geological identification method and system based on remote sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological identification method and system based on a remote sensing technology, and relates to the technical field of geological identification. The method comprises the steps of acquiring a plane map and geological data by adopting a remote sensor, wherein the geological data is determined by means of reflected light radiation values, measuring by means of a laser range finder in a rotating scanning mode for establishing a three-dimensional model, and simulating the height shape of a mountain or other geological environment by utilizing three-dimensional modeling. And mapping the plane map on the three-dimensional model, so that geological prospecting staff can predict and analyze mineral exploitation or geological disasters more conveniently according to geological environment and geological mineral distribution conditions.

title_en: Supercritical CO 2 Physical experiment system and simulation method for reducing size of geothermal exploitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses supercritical CO  2  A physical experiment system for geothermal exploitation with reduced scale comprises S-CO  2  Production system, S-CO  2  Temperature and pressure control system, small-scale geothermal simulation system and S-CO  2  Recovery system, S-CO  2  The device comprises a pressure and temperature measuring system, a rock physical and mechanical property testing system and a safety protection system; the mixed numerical simulation method comprises the following steps: using small-scale physical experiment systems, in differentSurrounding rock pressure, reservoir temperature, injected S-CO  2  Performing experiments under the conditions of temperature and flow rate; respectively carrying out physical and mechanical property measurement tests on the rock sample before and after the test to obtain small-scale physical test data, and analyzing the physical and mechanical parameter changes of the rock sample before and after the test; and inputting the physical and mechanical parameters of the tested rock sample into the small-scale numerical model, analyzing and calibrating by the automatic parameter calibration system to obtain the physical and mechanical parameters of the rock sample, inputting the physical and mechanical parameters into the large-scale numerical model, and analyzing the exploitation efficiency, dynamic disasters and feasibility under different thermal reservoir conditions, flow rates and pressures under engineering scales.

title_en: Method for analyzing characteristic quantity of drought and waterlogging emergency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing characteristic quantity of drought and waterlogging tight-turning events. The method comprises the steps of collecting precipitation data, calculating SWAP index, extracting intensity and duration characteristics, checking whether time sequences of the two characteristics have consistency, sometimes adopting probability distribution model fitting, evaluating by using SBC and AIC criteria, otherwise adopting generalized accumulation model fitting, finally obtaining an edge distribution function of intensity and duration, then adopting Copula function likelihood ratio method to check consistency of the two edge distribution functions, further adopting Copula joint distribution function simulation with constant parameters or time variation to obtain a joint distribution function of the two characteristics, finally calculating joint reproduction period of duration and intensity or 'and' according to the joint distribution function, and adopting the most probable combination method to calculate joint design value of duration and intensity, wherein the design value is a risk threshold. The invention can evaluate the risk of the characteristic value of the drought and waterlogging emergency in time, and has very important significance for analyzing and preventing drought and waterlogging emergency disasters.

title_en: Multi-person collaborative VR drilling system for emergency rescue of coal mine disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of VR equipment application, and particularly discloses a multi-person collaborative VR exercise system for emergency rescue of coal mine disasters, which comprises a master control end, a user end and a plurality of slave control ends, wherein the master control end is used for receiving personnel tags sent by the user end and generating formation information according to the personnel tags; determining a scene model according to the formation information, generating task information based on the scene model, and sending the task information and the scene model to a user side; receiving the correction records and the corrected operation information sent by each user side, and generating an operation table containing the correction records; wherein, the operation table contains personnel tag items; and evaluating the users corresponding to the user terminals based on the operation table. The invention generates a layered scene model, provides visual sense of reality for the staff by means of VR equipment, greatly improves psychological quality and rescue capability of the staff, has extremely high actual value and can be popularized to other fields.

title_en: Regional rainstorm disaster risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rainstorm disaster pre-evaluation, in particular to a regional rainstorm disaster risk evaluation method. assignees: HENAN CLIMATE CENTER HENAN CLIMATE TRANSFER MONITORING AND EVALUATION CENTER

title_en: Fault diagnosis method based on complementary set kurtosis index and relevant vector machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis method based on a complementary set kurtosis index and a related vector machine, which comprises the steps of simulating fault data acquisition of a building electrical experiment platform MA2067, data preprocessing based on complementary set empirical mode decomposition and a mutual mean kurtosis index, and identification and diagnosis of a multi-core related vector machine. The building electrical experiment platform MA2067 simulates fault data acquisition, selects an electrical comprehensive tester Eurotest61557 for testing and obtains fault data; complementary set empirical mode decomposition and mutual mean kurtosis index combined data preprocessing is used for processing fault resistance data collected by a tester, and noise reduction and modal overlap avoidance are carried out; and (4) obtaining probability output and diagnosis of the fault data after the training processing of the multi-core multi-classification correlation vector machine. The invention can quickly and accurately detect the fault position and type of the building electrical system, thereby reducing the occurrence of non-natural disasters such as building group fires and the like caused by system faults and ensuring the basic life safety of citizens.

title_en: Simulation equipment for arch tunnel fire test
abstract_en: The invention discloses simulation equipment for an arch tunnel fire test in the technical field of arch tunnel fire tests, which comprises a fixed base, wherein the top of the fixed base is fixedly connected with a simulation tunnel, the front side of the simulation tunnel is provided with a moving trolley, a moving mechanism for driving the moving trolley to move in the tunnel is arranged in the simulation tunnel, the moving trolley is used for containing fire source materials, and the bottom of the moving trolley is provided with a discharge valve; according to the invention, when a fire disaster simulation test is carried out in the tunnel, the simulated tunnel, the movable trolley is matched with the water spraying mechanism, the extinguishing mechanism, the recovery mechanism and the conveying mechanism, so that the tested fire source materials can be automatically and continuously extinguished in the test process, and the fire disaster simulation test device can be used for multiple times, thereby greatly saving the simulation cost, timely extinguishing the fire source materials, avoiding damaging the simulated tunnel, avoiding personnel participation, and being convenient and quick.

title_en: Device and method for testing disaster-causing evolution of cavity collapse hidden danger in whole process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for testing disaster-causing evolution of a cavity collapse hidden danger in the whole process, belongs to the technical field of road collapse hidden danger simulation tests, can accurately position space coordinates of a cavity, enables simulation materials not to influence the disaster-causing evolution rule of the cavity, and is beneficial to objectively disclosing a cavity collapse mechanism; the device includes: the model box unit is used as a mould for preparing a test model; the position control unit is used for realizing accurate adjustment of position coordinates of the cavity in the model from the X axis direction, the Y axis direction and the Z axis direction; a form control unit for controlling the form of the object, for achieving expansion and elimination of the void preparation; when in use, S1, determining parameters of a physical similarity test model; s2, adjusting the position coordinates of the cavity in the model from the X-axis direction, the Y-axis direction and the Z-axis direction according to the determined parameters; s3, injecting first gas into the cavity preparation piece to expand the cavity preparation piece; s4, preparing a test model by filling and paving a model material; and S5, injecting a second gas into the cavity preparation piece to be dissolved.

title_en: Device and method for testing mechanical properties of transformer substation framework column under simulated fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for testing the mechanical property of a transformer substation framework column under a simulated fire, wherein a sleeve is sleeved at the top of the transformer substation framework column to form entity surfaces at the left side and the right side; the restraint frame clamps the solid surfaces on two sides of the sleeve; the measuring system comprises a displacement sensor, a temperature sensor and an upper computer. The fire experiment furnace comprises a furnace chamber, the fixed base is positioned in the furnace chamber, and the top of the transformer substation framework column penetrates through the top of the furnace chamber and is positioned outside the furnace chamber. The test device provided by the invention is simple to manufacture, convenient to assemble, capable of welding each component on site and convenient to transport. The restraint condition of the top in the practical application scene of the simulation framework column is realized through the restraint frame, the influence test of the vertical force on the framework column is completed, and meanwhile, the load is applied and the component is prevented from moving laterally. The design of the set provides the point of application of force for the restraint frame, need not to change transformer substation framework post self structure, improves the truth of test. The column body of the transformer substation framework column is arranged in the experimental furnace, so that the heating condition of the lower half part of the framework column in a fire disaster can be truly simulated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and system for evaluating vulnerability of immovable cultural relics under rainstorm disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the vulnerability of immovable cultural relics under a rainstorm disaster, and relates to the technical field of evaluation of the vulnerability of immovable cultural relics. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target cultural relic vulnerability assessment index parameters; the vulnerability assessment index parameters comprise the age of the cultural relics, the disaster-suffered strength of the cultural relics, the material quality of the cultural relics, the stability degree of the cultural relics and the disaster-suffered part of the cultural relics; inputting the target cultural relic vulnerability assessment index parameter into an immovable cultural relic vulnerability assessment model to obtain the vulnerability of the target cultural relic; the immovable cultural relic vulnerability assessment model is a neural network model obtained by training by taking sample cultural relic vulnerability assessment index parameters as input and taking the vulnerability of the sample cultural relic as output. The vulnerability of the immovable cultural relics is evaluated by selecting a vulnerability evaluation method of machine learning, so that errors caused by subjective conditions during vulnerability evaluation are reduced.

title_en: Evaluation method for hail disaster of crops
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster assessment, in particular to a crop hail disaster assessment method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-stage remote sensing data of crops before and after hailstone disaster, constructing various vegetation indexes such as normalized vegetation index (NDVI), ratio Vegetation Index (RVI), enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI), difference Vegetation Index (DVI) and normalized rededge index (NDRE), calculating differences of the vegetation indexes before and after the disaster to select an optimal time phase, combining field survey sample data, utilizing four machine learning models such as logistic regression, decision tree, random forest and gradient lifting decision tree, training to obtain an optimal evaluation model, and further evaluating the crop hailstone disaster. The invention fully considers the self-repairing capability of the post-disaster crops in different growth periods, can objectively evaluate the range and degree of the influence of the hailstone disaster, and greatly improves the precision of the evaluation of the remote sensing hailstone disaster.
assignees: BEIJING SHANGDE ZHIHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hospital emergency evacuation guiding method, device, equipment and medium based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hospital emergency evacuation guiding method based on the Internet of things, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the personnel condition in a hospital in real time, wherein the personnel condition in the hospital comprises the personnel position information and the personnel attribute information in the hospital of each personnel; generating personnel moving prediction data within a preset time period according to the personnel attribute information and the corresponding personnel in-hospital position information, and acquiring a personnel congestion prediction position according to the personnel moving prediction data; simulating an in-hospital evacuation guidance route corresponding to each floor according to the personnel congestion prediction position to form an evacuation guidance data group; and when the emergency evacuation instruction is acquired, acquiring the emergency situation type, acquiring a personnel guide route from the evacuation guide data group according to the emergency situation type, and sending and correspondingly displaying the personnel guide route to each evacuation guide terminal installed in each floor. This application has the effect that promotes under the complex building structure's of large-scale comprehensive hospital the effect of the sparse efficiency of personnel.
assignees: GUANGDONG SHENAN CONSTRUCTION TECH CO LTD;SHANGHAI INSTALLATION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Pedestrian simulation model construction method of traffic hub, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: A pedestrian simulation model construction method of a traffic hub, electronic equipment and a storage medium belong to the technical field of microscopic traffic simulation. The method aims to solve the problems that the current passenger flow evacuation pressure is increased and the current situation of complex station facilities cannot be simulated accurately. The method comprises the following steps: collecting and sorting spatial data; and (3) dividing a pedestrian simulation area: dividing a pedestrian simulation area into three layers of areas, namely a ground area, an underground area and a peripheral extension area according to the functional layout of the comprehensive transportation junction; building pedestrian areas in a layered mode; constructing a facility equipment model: arranging facility equipment such as a gate, a counter and a security check based on the facility equipment layout scheme, and communicating layers through slopes, stairs, escalators, vertical elevators and the like; laying a pedestrian tissue streamline; calibrating and checking key parameters; and (3) pedestrian simulation operation evaluation: evaluating and analyzing the passenger flow carrying capacity of different areas, and identifying the facilities with poor service level and the passenger flow bottleneck. The invention is beneficial to comprehensively analyzing and optimizing the passenger flow distribution scheme of the comprehensive transportation hub.

title_en: Simulation human body model for disaster rescue simulation drilling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulation manikin for disaster rescue simulation drilling, including model body and liquid supply system, the liquid supply system inlays establishes in the inside of model body, the head, belly and the four limbs of model body all are provided with the simulation system of bleeding, the one end and the liquid supply system of simulation system of bleeding are fixed to be communicated, the chest of model body inlays and is equipped with heart rate analog system, pumps the emulation blood pump in the storage storehouse after the micropump starts inside the liquid supply system, and after the solenoid valve was opened when simulating drilling, the end of relevant position flowed the emulation blood, and then simulated human injured's sight, medical personnel carried out corresponding processing according to different bleeding positions, improved emulation effect; after blood flows out of the corresponding part, the controller sends corresponding sound through the voice system to inform medical personnel that the corresponding part is injured, and the reality of simulation exercise is improved.
assignees: The Third Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: Method for extracting enteromorpha in multi-feature integrated learning dual-polarization SAR image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting enteromorpha from multi-feature integrated learning dual-polarized SAR images, and belongs to the technical field of ocean remote sensing detection. The method comprises the following steps: data preprocessing, extracting 24 texture and polarization characteristics, and performing characteristic optimization by utilizing three algorithms of integrated random forest, jeffries-Matusita distance and Pearson correlation coefficient; randomly grouping preferred features, and performing LDA feature transformation on each group of features by hierarchically sampling the enteromorpha and the seawater sample point set; and constructing and training an enteromorpha multi-feature set classification model, importing the test image into the trained model, judging the classification of the sample points and extracting the enteromorpha. The method provided by the invention is scientific and reasonable, comprehensively considers the advantages of enteromorpha in microwave remote sensing monitoring, considers the evaluation angle of various feature selection algorithms on feature importance, optimizes the ensemble learning method, can improve the extraction precision of enteromorpha to a certain extent, and realizes the all-day monitoring of enteromorpha disasters.

title_en: Self-configurable firefighter location and environment detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-configurable firefighter positioning and environment detecting method and system, which comprises the following steps: step 1, the equipment is in a sleep mode; step 2, the equipment is switched into a working state from a sleep mode; step 3, respectively calculating position data by the micro inertial navigation system and the satellite navigation system; step 4, the central processing unit acquires environmental data by using the sensing detection module; step 5, acquiring equipment information and firefighter identity identification information; step 6, the positioning equipment and the identity identification information of the firemen, the fusion positioning position data and the fire fighting site environment detection data are broadcasted and sent out through the wireless communication module; and 7, continuously and intelligently detecting and configuring the peripheral sensing detection module/equipment by the equipment in the working mode. The invention can realize non-inductive use, and firemen do not need to manually operate each device on a task site, thereby reducing the workload, and also do not need to carry out additional training on the firemen, thereby reducing the use cost and difficulty.
assignees: JIANGSU DEYIJIA SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Oil tank boiling-over fire early warning method based on micro-explosion noise identification model
abstract_en: The invention provides an oil tank fire disaster boiling-over early warning method based on a micro-explosion noise identification model, which aims to solve the problem that micro-explosion noise in an oil tank fire disaster boiling-over precursor stage cannot be accurately identified under the influence of noisy environmental sound in a real fire scene. The method comprises the following steps: in the training stage, taking a target sound event, other sound events and environmental background sounds including splashing sounds of a high-pressure faucet as samples, respectively extracting Mel characteristics of the three types of audio signals, inputting the Mel characteristics into a neural network, and training to obtain an identification model of micro-explosion noise in noisy environmental sounds; in the recognition stage, preprocessing the on-site collected audio, then carrying out audio noise reduction, and inputting the audio characteristics into a trained recognition model to obtain the occurrence time of micro-explosion noise; in the early warning stage, calculating a real-time OFN value (micro-explosion noise emission frequency) according to the occurrence time of micro-explosion noise, judging the precursor stage of boiling over and the occurrence of the boiling over through an OFN threshold value, and finally realizing early warning of oil tank boiling over fire.

title_en: Hybrid disaster recovery scene switching method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for switching a mixed disaster tolerance scene, which comprise the following steps: determining a scene type; selecting a plurality of target disaster recovery systems, and acquiring a target operation process and each process node contained in the target operation process; constructing a node dependency relationship; determining virtual nodes, real nodes and the operation mode of each real node in a target operation flow; acquiring a switching control table of a single disaster recovery system, and determining real nodes associated with flow nodes of the single system; setting switching logic between the real nodes and the single system process nodes based on the operation modes and operation contents of the real nodes; and in the process of executing the target operation flow, switching each single system flow node to execute the operation of each real node based on the switching logic and the node dependency relationship. By applying the method, the mixed disaster tolerance scene can reuse the result of the single disaster recovery system, repeated configuration is not needed, and the switching drilling can be dynamically executed by introducing the switching flow of the single disaster recovery system according to the system range related to the switching drilling and adopting modes of aggregation, integration and the like.

title_en: Multi-disaster integrated prevention and control method for island outburst coal seam strong and weak coupling structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster integrated prevention and control method for a strong and weak coupling structure of an island outburst coal seam, which comprises the steps of firstly arranging a bottom plate lane on a lower overlying strata layer below a coal seam of an island working face, integrating multi-disaster integrated prevention and control measures into the bottom plate lane, continuously draining accumulated water in goafs on two sides of the island working face, drilling a gas extraction separation hole in a coal pillar adjacent to the goaf after the completion, cutting off a channel through which gas rushes to the coal lane from the goaf, and simultaneously injecting high-strength cement slurry into two sides of the coal lane to strengthen the strength of a coal body so as to reduce the deformation of the coal lane; because the phenomenon of rock burst of an island working surface roadway is serious, after grouting reinforcement is carried out on a coal seam, a strong and weak coupling structure is formed by a grouting reinforcement area and raw coal, and the deformation of the coal roadway can be effectively reduced by coupling the strong resistance effect of the strong structure and the wave absorption and energy absorption effect of the weak structure. In addition, a three-dimensional gas extraction seam network is constructed by adopting the gas extraction directional long drill hole and the gas extraction cross-layer drill hole in the bottom plate roadway, so that the gas extraction in the pre-excavated coal roadway area can reach the standard safely and efficiently.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY;SHAANXI SHAN COAL TONGCHUAN MINING IND CO LTD CHENJIASHAN COAL MINE

title_en: Centrifugal model test device and method for simulating large-scale ground fissure formation evolution process
abstract_en: The invention provides a centrifugal model test device and method for simulating a large-scale ground fissure formation evolution process, and belongs to the field of geological disaster simulation. According to the method, a box body is filled according to a scheme, and soil body models of an upper wall, a lower wall and a fault fracture zone are constructed; after the soil body in the box body is soaked to be saturated, hanging the soil body into a centrifuge basket; the method comprises the steps of loading step by step after a centrifugal machine is started, keeping constant-speed rotation after a preset value is reached, carrying out remote water level lifting regulation and control simulation after initial settlement in a box body is stable, monitoring pore water pressure, soil body model displacement, real-time deformation and damage conditions of the soil body model and the running state of the centrifugal machine in the process of centrifugation and water level change, and analyzing the formed evolution difference change and the interference or reversal effect of water level rising on evolution after water level is reduced in different pumping modes according to monitoring results; and analyzing the change rule of the displacement field of different types of hydrogeological structures under the stress driving action. The method accurately restores the large-scale ground fissure formation evolution process and provides scientific basis for disaster risk prevention and control.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Running state evaluation method and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a running state evaluation method and system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: predicting the total business data amount and transaction increment information of future time according to the historical business data amount and business change condition of the system; according to the predicted total business data amount and transaction increment information, combining with the resource information of the current system to obtain the running state index parameter of the system; determining the running state of the system according to the running state index parameter of the system; therefore, the system operation state can be simulated and predicted in advance through calculation of corresponding operation index parameters, early warning is carried out before the system operation pressure appears, and emergency response processing is carried out through modes of dynamic scheduling and expansion of system resources, plan adjustment of database execution and the like, so that stable operation of the system is ensured.

title_en: Enhancer prediction model training method, enhancer prediction model recognition method, and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enhancer prediction model training method which comprises the steps of obtaining a sample set of an enhancer sequence, extracting sequence features of the sample set according to a feature extraction algorithm to obtain a sequence feature set, fusing and optimizing the sequence feature set to obtain an optimized feature set, and importing the optimized feature set into a classifier for training to obtain an enhancer prediction model. The method solves the technical problems that the existing prediction enhancer cannot be targeted and the accuracy of the training model is low, by the method, the advantages of feature extraction can be fully achieved, the problem of overfitting of dimension disasters and the model is avoided, the robustness of the model is improved after the model is guided into a classifier for training, and the accuracy of identifying the enhancer and the strength thereof is remarkably improved.

title_en: Micro-seismic sensor device for monitoring mine geological disasters
abstract_en: The application provides a microseismic sensor device for monitoring mine geological disasters, and belongs to the technical field of mine geological monitoring. This a slight shock sensor device for monitoring of mine geological disasters, including shells assembly, sensor body and lid subassembly, shells assembly includes casing, slide, threaded rod, lagging and coupling mechanism, the fixed cover of lagging is located on the casing, the slide slides and locates in the casing. Through setting up the casing, the slide slides and locates in the casing, installs the threaded rod on the slide simultaneously for be connected with this body coupling of sensor, the slide passes through coupling mechanism to be fixed in the casing, lid subassembly realizes sealed casing, thereby the realization sets up sensor body and casing integration, the casing is then installed in the drilling of excavating in advance, thereby can realize arranging the sensor body in the rock mass, lid subassembly and coupling mechanism are detachable construction simultaneously, are convenient for take out the sensor body from the casing.
assignees: SICHUAN SHUANGYUAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mouthpiece for the reducing the volume of the saxophone
title_ko: 섹소폰의 음량 감소용 마우스피스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mouthpiece structure and a volume reduction method, which can reduce the volume of a saxophone, a woodwind instrument. In the present invention, provided is a method for reducing the volume of a saxophone in such a way that when vibration of a reed coupled to a mouthpiece generates a natural resonance frequency, an internal adjusting plate reduces the amplitude of air columnar vibration. Accordingly, the present invention provides a mouthpiece capable of reducing the volume of a saxophone, which is difficult to play and select a practice place due to the loud volume which is a characteristic of the instrument, thereby providing convenience in performance and practice and contributing to the popularization of saxophones and the revitalization of related businesses.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 목관악기인 색소폰의 음량을 작게 조절할 수 있는 마우스피스의 구조와 음량의 감소방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에서는, 마우스피스에 결합된 리드의 떨림이 고유 공진주파수를 발생시키면 내부에 배치된 본 발명의 조절판이 기주진동의 진폭을 감소시키는 방법으로 색소폰의 음량을 작게 조절하는 방법을 제공한다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 관악기의 특징인 커다란 음량 때문에 연주와 연습장소의 선택이 어려운 색소폰의 음량을 작게 조절할 수 있는 마우스피스를 제공하여 연주와 연습의 편의를 제공하고 색소폰의 대중화와 관련업의 활성화에 도움을 주기 위한 목적을 가지고 있다.

title_en: Method for performing fault prediction and Pod scheduling based on k8s combined disaster recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a k8 s-based disaster recovery drilling fault prediction and Pod scheduling combined method, which comprises the steps of establishing a k8 s-based central scheduling cluster on a central cluster management server in a network, and establishing a Node in each local subnet in the network; a Master creates a backup Node in a non-central designated subnet in a network, deploys data collection service Pod, and sends a request to the Master to acquire Pod exercise data of each Node participating in disaster backup exercise; selecting different model data analysis modes, constructing and training a Markov chain model, and obtaining the probability of possible failure of each step of the next k8s cluster disaster recovery drilling; and storing the training result of the Markov chain model and the data participating in the analysis. The technical problem that the management requirement of the k8 s-crossing cluster cannot be met by a host management k8s cluster mode is solved, and the flexibility of Pod scheduling is improved.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Non-invasive marrow cavity forceps holder and forceps holder type double-shaft traction reduction external fixing frame
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical instruments, in particular to a non-invasive marrow cavity forceps holder and a forceps holder type double-shaft traction reduction external fixing frame. The first spicule and the second spicule of the non-invasive marrow cavity clamp are distributed on two sides of the upper limb or the lower limb of the patient and are coaxial; the locking assembly is connected with the first clamping arm and the second clamping arm so as to limit the relative movement between the first clamping arm and the second clamping arm. This non-invasive marrow cavity forceps holder and pincers formula biax pull external fixation frame that resets easy operation is swift, operating time obviously shortens than traditional external fixation frame, do not use too many auxiliary instrument such as electric drill, do not pass through the marrow cavity, thereby can furthest's the infection of avoiding the fracture, and non-invasive marrow cavity pincers formula biax pulls the fixed position that the counterpoint of external fixation frame later stage adjustable fracture of resetting, can pressurize the multi-functional application of pulling, be convenient for more crowd's injury and public disaster cause the treatment of fracture, effectively reduce disability rate, and increase treatment efficiency and success rate.
assignees: SHANGHAI HEIYAN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD;UNIV PEKING PEOPLES HOSPITAL

title_en: General accurate experimental research hail emitter of hail calamity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a general precise test research hail emitting device for hail disasters, which comprises a support frame, an emitting casing pipe and an emitting string; the support frame is of a truss structure, the launching sleeve comprises two semicircular pipes, a support is arranged on the inner wall of each semicircular pipe, and the section of each support is in a wedge shape with a small upper part and a big lower part; the two semicircular pipes are arranged on the support frame, the inner wall surfaces of the two semicircular pipes are oppositely arranged, the axes of the two semicircular pipes are parallel, and a gap is reserved between the two semicircular pipes; the two ends of the transmitting string are arranged on the supporting frame, and the transmitting string penetrates through the gap between the two semicircular pipes. The invention has simple structure and low cost; the transmitting casing pipe is vertically arranged, hailstones in the transmitting casing pipe are accurately transmitted through the transmitting string, the transmitting track of the hailstones is consistent with the motion track of natural hailstones, the actual motion track of the hailstones can be accurately simulated, and the structure obtained through experiments is more accurate.

title_en: Geological disaster deduction method and system based on digital twin simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster deduction method and a system based on a digital twin simulation platform, and relates to the field of geological disaster correlation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: connecting a data acquisition device to obtain geological component information and ground building information, and generating geological modeling data and building modeling data; inputting the geological modeling data and the building modeling data into a digital twin simulation platform for modeling to obtain a regional modeling result; acquiring a video data set according to the video acquisition device; according to the video data set, matching the region modeling result to perform modeling optimization, and obtaining an optimized modeling result; and taking the optimized modeling result as a deduction model, and taking a preset disaster deduction library as an input variable to obtain a deduction result database for dangerous identification. The method solves the technical problems of inaccurate geologic modeling means and low deduction efficiency, and achieves the effects of improving modeling accuracy and deduction efficiency by adopting a digital twin simulation platform to perform geologic modeling.

title_en: System fault tolerance test method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of computer technologies, and in particular, to a system fault tolerance testing method, an electronic device, and a storage medium. According to the system fault tolerance test method, functional characteristic type information and a disaster simulation program are acquired firstly, then a cloud platform system to be tested is subjected to hierarchical division based on the functional characteristic type information to obtain a cloud system hierarchical model corresponding to the cloud platform system, further, a data disaster environment is simulated in the cloud system hierarchical model based on the disaster simulation program, and finally fault tolerance test is performed on the cloud system hierarchical model in the data disaster environment to obtain fault tolerance indexes corresponding to the cloud platform system. According to the system fault tolerance test method provided by the embodiment of the application, the cloud platform system is subjected to data disaster simulation based on the cloud system hierarchical model, so that the fault tolerance index of the cloud platform system is obtained through fault tolerance test, and the fault tolerance index of the cloud platform system can be measured more accurately.

title_en: Flood disaster rapid forecasting method based on physical process numerical model and K nearest neighbor algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster rapid forecasting method based on a physical process numerical model and a K nearest neighbor algorithm, which comprises the steps of obtaining basic geographic hydrological data; establishing a hydrokinetic numerical model based on a physical process; constructing design rainfall data; constructing rainstorm flood incident data; performing flood routing data integration; extracting rainfall characteristic parameters and carrying out correlation analysis; dividing a training set, a verification set and a test set; building a rapid forecasting model based on a K nearest neighbor algorithm for training; testing the performance of the model; outputting the final model; flood forecasting is carried out. The method utilizes a numerical model and a K nearest neighbor algorithm to realize the rapid forecast of the flood disaster in the drainage basin.

title_en: TBM scale model suitable for crossing broken two shield TBM blade disc card machine simulation in area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a TBM scale model suitable for broken tape cutter chuck analogue test is crossed to two shield TBM. The TBM scale model comprises a TBM cutter head shield, a propelling device, a torsion power device, a slag discharging device and a supporting and guiding device. The torsion power device comprises a servo motor, a torque sensor and a main shaft, the main shaft is a hollow steel pipe, and the front end of the main shaft is connected with the cutter head to provide rotary rock breaking torque for the cutter head. The utility model discloses according to real two shield TBM machine dimensions and power parameter, strictly according to similar theory, set for model size and power parameter. The utility model discloses can truly reflect TBM and cross broken tape machine response characteristic. And calculating actual engineering TBM construction parameters according to the obtained experimental data and the similarity ratio, thereby providing early warning for the TBM over-crushing belt cutter chuck machine disaster. The utility model discloses will provide powerful instrument for the research of two shield TBM crossing broken zone blade disc card machine mechanisms of fault, cross broken zone tunnelling construction decision-making and provide the foundation to TBM.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG;HUANENG GROUP TECH INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Starfish disaster early warning method and system
