abstract_en: The invention discloses a starfish disaster early warning method and a starfish disaster early warning system, which adopt a starfish disaster early warning model to predict whether a starfish disaster event will occur in the future in a target sea area according to real-time acquired field synchronous observation data, wherein the starfish disaster early warning model is obtained by training a historical starfish disaster field observation data set and the water quality parameter data with higher correlation, and the starfish disaster early warning model considers various factors with higher correlation water quality parameter data and is constructed on the basis of multi-dimensional data formed by various factors. The method can predict and early warn the outbreak events of the starfish disaster in the multi-outbreak sea area of the starfish disaster, so that managers can shorten the response time and even stop the occurrence of the starfish disaster in advance, and the economic loss of an ocean pasture or the ecological loss of coral reefs caused by the outbreak of the starfish disaster are greatly reduced.

title_en: Social and economic exposure degree estimation method for drought, waterlogging and sudden turning event under climate change
abstract_en: The application discloses a socioeconomic exposure degree estimation method for drought, waterlogging and sudden turning events under climate change. In the technical scheme, the latest global climate mode set and multivariate deviation correction are combined, the meteorological hydrographic process of future scenes is simulated, the riverway submerging water depth is simulated through a distributed hydrographic model and a CaMa-Flood hydrodynamic model, the future land water reserves and drought events are simulated through a land mode, the dynamic population and GDP scenes sharing social economic paths are further considered, and therefore the socioeconomic exposure degree of drought and Flood rush-turn events influenced by climate change is scientifically evaluated. The method has important scientific significance for risk prediction and loss evaluation of drought and flood disasters in the future, and provides certain theoretical reference and technical basis for further evaluation of environmental and disaster effects caused by global system evolution.

title_en: Portable fire-suppression explosion-suppression fire gun and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a portable fire-suppression explosion-suppression fire gun which comprises a base, a main handle, an auxiliary handle, a bearing shell, a transmission shaft, a rotary joint, a conveying pipe, a composite operation drill bit, a fire-fighting medium storage bottle, a pressure-regulating pump and a driving battery pack, wherein the end face of the base is connected with the main handle and the auxiliary handle, the upper end faces of the main handle and the auxiliary handle are respectively connected with the bearing shell, embedded in the bearing shell, the rear end face is communicated with the conveying pipe through the rotary joint, the front end face is communicated with the composite operation drill bit, and the conveying pipe is communicated with the fire-fighting medium storage bottle through the pressure-regulating pump. The using method comprises three steps of equipment prefabrication and fire rescue operation. On one hand, the invention has simple equipment structure, good universality and convenient carrying and use, and can effectively meet the operation requirements of various firefighting rescue environments; on the other hand, the method can realize the rapid detection and identification of the condition or state of the closed environment in the fire-fighting and rescue operation, and realize the efficient combustion-inhibiting and explosion-inhibiting operation on the sealed environment under the condition of keeping the environment sealing, thereby greatly improving the safety of the fire-fighting and rescue operation.

title_en: Potential landslide volume estimation method fusing multisource SAR data
abstract_en: The invention provides a potential landslide volume estimation method fusing multisource SAR data, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control safety, and comprises the following steps: inSAR deformation monitoring, sliding surface determination and landslide volume estimation. The InSAR deformation monitoring comprises SAR data acquisition, deformation monitoring and landslide boundary determination; the sliding surface is determined by an Okada elastic dislocation model, and the determined content comprises the position and the form of the sliding surface; the landslide volume estimation is calculated from the integral. According to the invention, the position, the shape and the size of the sliding surface are obtained, the sliding depth is combined, the volume of the potential sliding is calculated by utilizing the plane, the square quantity of the potential sliding body is accurately judged, and the data support is provided for the subsequent sliding disaster prediction methods such as numerical simulation and the like, so that the method has a good application value.

title_en: Multi-disaster directional long-drilling single-hole multi-effect active area cooperative control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-disaster directional long-drilling single-hole multi-effect active area cooperative control method which comprises the steps of determining a disaster control layer, determining a main hole arrangement layer of a fracturing drill hole, arranging a double-comb-shaped drill hole according to the main hole arrangement layer, enabling an uplink branch hole of the double-comb-shaped drill hole to extend upwards to the disaster control layer located at the uppermost part, enabling a downlink branch hole to extend downwards to the spontaneous combustion disaster control coal layer, constructing the double-comb-shaped drill hole, and conveying fracturing equipment into the double-comb-shaped drill hole to conduct layered partition fracturing after construction of the double-comb-shaped drill hole is completed. By adopting the method, the mutual influence of different treatment modes can be avoided, the multi-disaster coupling cooperative source treatment is realized, and the treatment cost is reduced.

title_en: Energy-gathered blasting pressure-relief permeability-increasing method for top plate of soft coal seam in reverse fault structural area
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-gathered blasting pressure-relief permeability-increasing method for a soft coal seam roof in a reverse fault structure area, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the distribution characteristics of stress fields in a reverse fault structure area under a coal mine, acquiring the coal rock mass in the reverse fault structure area to perform mechanical experiments, establishing a roof energy-gathered blasting coal rock mass fracture mechanical model according to the mechanical experiment results, determining the energy gathering direction of energy-gathered blasting and the functional relation between a blasting crushing area, a fracture area and the stress field according to the mechanical model, performing soft coal seam roof energy-gathered blasting simulation experiments, formulating an application scheme of soft coal seam roof energy-gathered blasting site according to the simulation experiment results, and performing directional energy-gathered blasting on a hard roof rock stratum in the reverse fault structure area. The method can solve the problem of danger of coal rock gas dynamic disasters in the loose and soft coal seam in the reverse fault structural area.

title_en: Method and system for dividing dangerous area of buried pipeline leakage erosion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for dividing a dangerous area of buried pipeline leakage erosion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a geological generalization model; converting the generalized model into a simulation model; monitoring each unit grid in the simulation model and tracking the stress state of each unit grid; when the stress state meets the maximum elastic limit condition, deleting the unit grid, and simultaneously creating discrete particle units; continuously repeating the deleting and the creating so that the discrete unit particles are contacted with each other to form a particle cluster; monitoring a simulation model comprising the particle clusters, and analyzing a potential instability process; and partitioning the dangerous area of the leakage erosion of the buried pipeline according to the influence range of the simulation model after collapse to obtain areas with different dangerous degrees. The method makes up the one-sidedness of the structure deduction of the traditional single model, improves the reliability of the disaster-recovery development structural characteristics of the leakage pipeline, and has the advantages of simple operation, strong engineering applicability and high calculation precision.

title_en: Working face overlying strata separation layer water damage advanced prevention and control method based on gangue grouting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a working face overlying strata water disaster advanced control method based on gangue grouting, and belongs to the field of mine water disaster control. Collecting the exploration data of the working face, predicting the height of a water-guiding fracture zone of the working face, judging the position of a separation layer threatening the working face exploitation, determining a replenishing aquifer threatening the separation layer of the working face, grouting the replenishing aquifer by utilizing a ground directional drilling, reducing the permeability of the aquifer, reducing the replenishing amount of the aquifer to the separation layer space during the working face exploitation, prolonging the replenishing time, and further achieving the purpose of preventing and controlling the water damage of the working face separation layer. The method has simple steps and low construction cost, can effectively prevent the occurrence of water burst accidents of the underground separation layer, solves the problem of difficult treatment of partial mine gangue, and has more obvious advantages in cost and effect along with the exploitation of deep coal seams.

title_en: Drilling equipment for comprehensive study and judgment of tunnel surrounding rock and study and judgment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunnel surrounding rock construction, and particularly relates to a drilling device for comprehensive study and judgment of tunnel surrounding rock and a study and judgment method. According to the drilling equipment and the studying and judging method for comprehensive studying and judging of the tunnel surrounding rock, the tunnel is comprehensively studied and judged in sections by three tunnel advance geological prediction methods of arranging a geological radar, a high-definition camera and a drill bit for advance drilling, the geological condition of each section of the tunnel is relatively accurately known, the corresponding support type and the corresponding excavation method are determined, the tunnel face is guaranteed to be smoothly tunneled, the unfavorable geologic body is always in a controllable state, the occurrence probability of geological disasters is reduced, the safety of tunnel engineering constructors and equipment is guaranteed, and the economic benefit is further improved.

title_en: Tunnel post-disaster damage early warning method and system based on dynamic deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel post-disaster damage early warning method and system based on dynamic deep learning, which comprises the following steps: step 1: collecting the post-disaster information of the existing tunnel sample; and 2, step: training a softmax classifier for evaluating the post-disaster damage level of the tunnel; and 3, step 3: collecting key index data, training and updating an LSTM deep learning model for predicting the development trend of the key indexes after the disaster in real time; and 4, step 4: predicting the development trend of the key indexes after the disaster by adopting an LSTM model, and evaluating the damage level of the tunnel system at the future time by adopting a softmax classifier according to the key index value at the future time and the design parameters of the tunnel structure; and 5: if any key index exceeds a certain threshold or the tunnel system reaches a certain damage level, outputting corresponding alarm information and residual rescue time, otherwise, exiting. The method can predict the damage development trend of the tunnel system after the disaster in advance, and provide guidance for efficient rescue of the tunnel after the disaster.

title_en: Estimation of distribution network recovery after disaster
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and computer programs are presented for estimating recovery of a distribution network after a disaster. One method includes an operation for generating a synthetic distribution network based on locations of substations in a geographical area. Further, the method includes operations for estimating damages to the synthetic distribution network based on disaster data, and for performing a simulation to estimate how the synthetic distribution network is repaired. The output of the simulation includes information on a lifeline recovery timeline for each building in the geographical area. Further, the method includes presenting, in a user interface, the recovery timeline for one or more buildings.

title_en: Internet of things-based personnel-intensive region security risk monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security risk monitoring, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring security risks of a person dense region based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring the total number of persons in a building, the number of persons in each floor and the number of persons in each floor room, acquiring building structure information, generating a real-time distribution situation, acquiring the information of the persons in the third-party building, constructing a building person distribution diagram according to the information of the persons in the third-party building and the building structure information, constructing a disaster simulation analysis model, analyzing to obtain a building real-time initial disaster estimation level, acquiring environment monitoring indexes of a building entrance, a building entrance and a building exit and each floor room by using terminal equipment, and setting a threshold and a weight to obtain the building real-time disaster level; the problem of at present monitoring the security risk of the dense region of people is incomplete is solved, and a standard processing scheme is matched in time, so that casualties are reduced.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Slope body disastrous deformation stage identification method and landslide risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope disaster deformation stage identification method and a landslide risk early warning method. Aiming at the defect that the prior art can not forecast and early warn landslide risk by using short-duration slope body displacement data, the method for identifying the disastrous deformation stage of the slope body associates the deformation displacement change of the slope body with the disastrous property of the landslide, establishes the landslide stage concept with disaster significance, and provides disaster information support for a displacement data analysis scheme. The sample set construction method for the landslide early warning machine learning prediction model is characterized in that measurement data of a hidden danger slope body are used as training data, a day interval of a catastrophic deformation stage is established and used as data set duration, 3 dimensional features are extracted, landslide early warning grades are used as classification labels to construct feature vectors, and the input and output problems of landslide early warning machine learning prediction model training are solved. The landslide risk early warning method fully utilizes the displacement data of the slope body collected by the existing hidden danger slope body monitoring system to realize the technical problem of forecasting and early warning landslide risk by utilizing the displacement data of the slope body with short duration.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIST

title_en: Novel geological disaster bare rock greening treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for a afforestation treatment equipment field, concretely relates to novel geological disaster bare rock afforestation treatment equipment, it includes the rock drill that is used for cutting the bare rock, the liquid reserve tank that provides the restoration liquid for the rock drill and the hose that is used for connecting the rock drill and the liquid reserve tank; the rock drill comprises a shell, a liquid distribution assembly and a crushing assembly, wherein the crushing assembly penetrates through the liquid distribution assembly. Run through the broken subassembly that sets up and join in marriage the liquid subassembly and can carry the restoration liquid to the deep rock base that the drill bit top was right in the breakage for the restoration of restoration liquid is effectual, and influence range is big, has removed simultaneously from to distribute and has consumeed the inconvenient part of a large amount of manpowers.

title_en: Disaster training and warning transmission system using metaverse
title_ko: 메타버스를 이용한 재난훈련 및 경보전달 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster training and warning transmission system comprising: a disaster management server (30) for collecting and updating disaster information; a manager portable terminal (40) carried by a manager managing the disaster management server (30); and a metaverse server (20) for allowing disaster training and warning transmission to be performed in a three-dimensional virtual world of a predetermined region by using a metaverse in a state of being connected through an information and communication network (10) to an ordinary person portable terminal (50) carried by an ordinary person, wherein the metaverse server (20) implements, in the three-dimensional virtual world, disaster training based on disaster information stored in the disaster management server (30), and transmits a disaster warning to the manager portable terminal (40) and the ordinary person portable terminal (50) to check a process in which the manager and the ordinary person respond to a disaster situation in the three-dimensional virtual world through the manager portable terminal (40) and the ordinary person portable terminal (50).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 재난정보를 수집하여 갱신하는 재난관리 서버(30), 상기 재난관리 서버(30)를 관리하는 관리자가 휴대하는 관리자 휴대단말(40), 및 일반인이 휴대하는 일반인 휴대단말(50)과 정보통신망(10)을 통해 접속된 상태에서 메타버스를 이용하여 재난훈련 및 경보전달이 일정 지역의 3차원 가상세계에서 수행되도록 하는 메타버스 서버(20)를 구비하는 재난훈련 및 경보전달 시스템으로서, 상기 메타버스 서버(20)는 상기 재난관리 서버(30)에 저장된 재난정보를 기반으로 하는 재난훈련을 3차원 가상세계로 구현하고 상기 관리자 휴대단말(40)과 상기 일반인 휴대단말(50)로 재난경보를 전달하여 관리자와 일반인이 관리자 휴대단말(40)과 일반인 휴대단말(50)을 통해 3차원 가상세계에서 재난상황에 대응하는 과정을 체크하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Rotary drilling structure provided with sound insulation cover and used for reducing noise
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a be provided with sound insulation cover and be used for rotary drilling of noise reduction to bore structure, bore the body including digging soon, dig soon and bore the body including the drilling rod, power device, dig soon and bore, the drilling tool, the power device bottom all around with sound insulation cover top fixed connection, the sound insulation cover is flexible barrel structure, its both ends opening, sound insulation cover bottom fixedly connected with sound insulation cover stock ring, sound insulation cover stock ring size is greater than and protects a section of thick bamboo, the vertical highly more than or equal to the vertical distance of power device bottom to ground surface of sound insulation cover. Through be provided with the sound proof cover on digging soon and bore can effectively reduce to dig soon and bore the noise when creeping into and slag tap and spread, reduce construction noise to resident's influence near to can guarantee the continuous construction pore-forming of pile foundation, improve the construction progress, reduce the risk of disasters such as pile foundation hole collapse, practice thrift the cost, facility use simple to operate is swift moreover.
assignees: GUIZHOU DATONG ROAD AND BRIDGE ENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Test method for simulating plant wave elimination based on plant crown void
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological simulation models, and particularly relates to a test method for simulating plant wave elimination based on plant crown void volume. The model tree disclosed by the invention reveals the correlation between the void fraction and the wave-absorbing rate, proves that the void fraction is a key parameter of plant simulation, obviously improves the simulation precision of the wave-absorbing rate of plants, improves the disaster prevention and reduction evaluation effect of the wave-absorbing of coastal plants, and provides a technical foundation for the construction of disaster prevention seawalls.

title_en: Flue hole-opening pipe-connecting method for injecting flue gas of power plant into goaf for disaster prevention and sealing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flue hole connecting pipe method for injecting flue gas into a goaf for disaster prevention and sealing in a power plant, which comprises the following specific steps of: determining the relation between the mine fireproof injected smoke intensity and the mine yield according to the relation between the mine fireproof injected nitrogen intensity and the mine yield, and calculating the pore diameter of a gas taking hole according to the relation between the smoke gas taking amount and the on-way resistance of a pipeline and by combining the process requirements; s2, selecting a horizontal flue wall between the desulfurizing tower and the exhaust chimney as an opening section; s3: according to the calculation result of the aperture of the air taking hole, drilling an air taking hole from outside to inside by using a drilling machine in a mode of being vertical to the wall surface of the horizontal flue, and welding a short section at the position of the air taking hole; s4: the wall surface of the flue is coated with more than or equal to 5 layers of glass flakes in a lining rubber-flake alternating mode; s5: multilayer coating reinforcement is adopted near the inner root weld joint; the amount of the extracted flue gas can be adjusted according to the oxygen concentration in the flue gas, the flue gas can be safely extracted, the emission of the flue gas is effectively reduced, and spontaneous combustion of coal in a goaf is prevented.

title_en: Audio-visual cooperation based winged insect tracking and identifying method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for tracing and identifying winged insects based on audio-visual cooperation, which relate to the technical field of winged insect tracing and aim to solve the problem that the prevention and control of harmful winged insects are always a troublesome challenge, especially for greenhouse and greenhouse planting, if a small amount of sporadic insects enter a greenhouse and cannot be timely driven away and captured, the reproductive capacity of the insects can enable the small amount of insects to quickly become an insect disaster, and further huge loss is brought to farmers; the TCN network designed by the invention can effectively extract the characteristics of time sequence data, and has better robustness and recognition rate compared with manually selected characteristics or a traditional machine learning method; compared with the traditional non-machine learning method, the method drives the TCN network to perform feature learning through the training data, and avoids incomplete data information utilization caused by an artificial feature screening process.
assignees: DUT ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE INST DALIAN;DALIAN SAITING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Extreme rainfall numerical simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extreme precipitation numerical simulation method and system, comprising the following steps: acquiring daily precipitation of each station in a research period and a research basin; determining the day-to-day precipitation of the research basin by utilizing a Thiessen polygon method according to the day-to-day precipitation; determining a time period corresponding to extreme rainfall according to the daily rainfall, and recording as an extreme rainfall time period to be simulated; and constructing an extreme precipitation model of the extreme precipitation period to be simulated by utilizing the high-resolution regional climate mode. The extreme precipitation numerical simulation method and the extreme precipitation numerical simulation system can obtain the most representative extreme precipitation time period to be simulated and can simulate the extreme precipitation by using an accurate model, so that the precipitation mechanism researched according to the model is accurate and representative, and powerful reference is provided for subsequent waterlogging prevention and disaster reduction.

title_en: High-efficiency slope modeling method suitable for physical point method simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency slope modeling method suitable for physical point method simulation, which relates to the field of geological disaster numerical simulation, and comprises the following steps: (1) acquiring a slope model digital image; (2) processing the slope model digital image: converting the digital image into a pixel matrix by color filling and gray scale processing; (3) carrying out material particle method dispersion on the slope model: converting the pixel matrix into a material point method model corresponding to the actual model size according to different gray values; (4) setting material parameters of the slope model; and (5) simulating a substance point method. The method introduces a digital image processing technology into the material point method for modeling for the first time, thereby providing an efficient, stable, simple and feasible modeling method, remarkably improving the modeling efficiency and quality of the material point method, promoting the wide application of the material point method in the field of large deformation analysis of the landslide of the rock and soil, and further providing a scientific basis for accurately predicting the landslide disaster degree and the protection design.

title_en: Immune capacity prediction method for small and micro enterprises to deal with emergencies
abstract_en: The invention provides an immunity prediction method for small and micro enterprises to deal with emergencies, which relates to the technical field of big data, comprises two parts of data set making and immunity grade prediction, and specifically comprises the following steps: feature extraction: selecting enterprise indexes, and selecting high-relevance indexes after screening; data annotation: calculating immunity levels including epidemic situation immunity levels and natural disaster immunity levels, and respectively constructing an epidemic situation immunity data set and a natural disaster immunity data set; and constructing an immunity grade model, and performing model training by combining the epidemic situation immunity data set and the natural disaster immunity data set. The immunity prediction method provided by the invention uses various traditional machine learning and deep learning algorithms, proves the feasibility of predicting the immunity of the small and micro enterprises for emergencies from the power perspective, and obtains an immunity prediction model suitable for weak relevant data through experiments.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL

title_en: Direct current method testing and evaluating method for stability of underground roadway support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct current method testing and evaluating method for underground roadway support stability, which comprises the following steps: before a roadway is developed and supported, uniformly arranging a plurality of measuring lines around the roadway, and testing the resistivity information of the original structure of the surrounding rock before supporting; drilling a surrounding rock resistivity abnormal area, and determining geological information such as identification of cracks, water content and the like; taking the resistivity information of the original structure of the surrounding rock as a background, periodically testing the resistivity information of the surrounding rock according to a preset period after the roadway is supported, and calculating the resistivity gradient and the resistivity change rate of the surrounding rock; and evaluating the stability of the roadway structure based on the resistivity test and the drilling result. According to the technical scheme, the resistivity condition of the roadway is tested through a direct current method to obtain surrounding rock structure information, hidden geological defects of the roadway surrounding rock can be identified, the stability of the surrounding rock is evaluated, the possibility of roadway disaster inoculation process is well predicted, and therefore the accuracy of roadway stability evaluation is improved.
assignees: XIXIU BRANCH OF YONGGUI ENERGY DEV CO LTD;BEIJING UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Combined pressure relief method for head-on explosion rupture hole of rock burst mine tunneling roadway
abstract_en: The application discloses a combined pressure relief method for a head-on explosion rupture hole of a rock burst mine tunneling roadway, which comprises the following steps: s1, dividing a roadway into areas with different dangerous grades along the tunneling direction of the roadway; s2, collecting the head-on stress peak positions of the tunneling tunnels in areas with different dangerous grades; s3, formulating large-diameter drilling holes and coal seam blasting pressure relief parameters of areas with different dangerous grades; s4, performing large-diameter drilling pressure relief on the head of the tunneling roadway, and then performing blasting pressure relief on the head-on coal seam to realize combined pressure relief of the large-diameter drilling caused by the head-on blasting of the roadway. The method effectively improves the pressure relief timeliness of the heading roadway of the rock burst mine, reduces the impact power disaster risk caused by slow pressure relief timeliness, and improves the life safety coefficient of underground staff.

title_en: Watershed distributed hydrologic simulation method considering soil regulation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river basin distributed hydrologic simulation method considering soil regulation modes, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining different soil regulation modes in a river basin, S2, calculating influence effect values of the different soil regulation modes on soil moisture in the river basin, S3, constructing calculation formulas of influence values of the different soil regulation modes on soil storage capacity, S4, correcting the calculation formulas of the influence values of the different soil regulation modes on the soil storage capacity, and inputting the corrected calculation formulas into a WEP model. The invention contributes to evaluating the influence of the construction of the river basin soil regulation measures on the surface runoff of the river basin and the effective precipitation and other water circulation factors, reducing drought and waterlogging disasters, improving the risk resistance capability and promoting the conservation of water and soil and the sustainable development of agriculture.

title_en: Operation panel of simulation earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an operating platform for simulating earthquake disasters, which belongs to the technical field of medical experimental equipment and comprises an operating platform and a generating device for simulating a plurality of physical and chemical injury factors of the earthquake disasters, wherein an extruding device is arranged above the operating platform; a seismic wave generator is arranged in the operating platform; a laser flashing lamp is arranged above the operating platform; the iron plate and/or the wood plate can be placed on the operating platform. The utility model discloses simulation earthquake disaster's operation panel of example, this operation panel can simulate multiple factor of causing injury, include: fear and mental trauma caused by earthquake waves, crush injury and crush syndrome caused by crush of collapsed buildings, hunger and dehydration caused by long-term crush, body temperature loss and hypothermia caused by long-term crush, and multiple injury-causing factors can be subjected to superposition tests, so that the method has important significance for researching earthquake injury-causing mechanism and medical mechanism.
assignees: The Third Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: Drone simulation system
title_ko: 드론 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: A drone simulation system is disclosed. According to one aspect of the present invention, the drone stimulation system includes: a user terminal equipped with an application providing a simulation screen for drone piloting practice; a display device displaying the simulation screen; and a drone controller receiving a drone control signal transmitted to the user terminal. The application serves to select one of a plurality of scenarios including a drone pilot license, reconnaissance search, firefighting drone, agricultural drone, and drone racing through the drone controller, and provides a simulation screen for drone piloting practice corresponding to the selected scenario, wherein a drone image implemented on the simulation screen for drone piloting practice is controlled according to the drone control signal of the drone controller. Various scenarios can be provided.
abstract_ko: 드론 시뮬레이션 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 드론 조종 연습용 시뮬레이션 화면을 제공하는 어플리케이션이 탑재되는 사용자 단말기; 상기 시뮬레이션 화면을 디스플레이 하는 디스플레이 장치; 및 상기 사용자 단말기에 전송되는 드론 조작 신호를 입력 받는 드론 조종기를 포함하고, 상기 어플리케이션은 상기 드론 조종기를 통해 드론 조종면허, 정찰 탐색, 소방 드론, 농업 드론 및 드론 레이싱을 포함하는 복수의 시나리오 중 하나의 시나리오를 선택하도록 서비스하고, 선택된 시나리오에 상응하는 드론 조종 연습용 시뮬레이션 화면을 제공하고, 드론 조종 연습용 시뮬레이션 화면 상에 구현되는 드론 영상이 상기 드론 조종기의 드론 조작 신호에 따라 조종되게 하는 것을 특징으로 하는 드론 시뮬레이션 시스템이 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Geological disaster alarm device based on internet
abstract_en: The utility model provides a geological disaster alarm device based on internet, this drilling equipment include the base, and the roof-rack of fixed mounting in the base top to and set up the movable rod at the roof-rack middle part, wherein: an installation rod is fixedly connected below the base, a roller is arranged at the bottom end of the installation rod, a first support rod is connected to the inner side of the bottom of the installation rod, a connecting rod is arranged between the first support rod and the second support rod, an adjusting rod is arranged inside the connecting rod, and a pressing plate is arranged on the outer side below the base; the middle part of roof-rack is provided with the mounting panel, install the drilling equipment body on the mounting panel, the left side of mounting panel is provided with the tight pulley, the outside winding of tight pulley has the driving chain, the front end fixedly connected with of tight pulley rotates the handle. This geological disaster alarm device based on internet is convenient for fix, makes things convenient for the stable brill of drill bit to move, and the drilling rig of being convenient for removes.
assignees: CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY 119 PROSPECTING TEAM

title_en: Evacuation route simulation device using machine learning and learning method
title_ko: 머신 러닝을 활용한 피난 경로 시뮬레이션 장치 및 학습 방법
abstract_en: A simulation device according to the present invention can be used to determine whether an appropriate evacuation safety design has been made in an actual building or a design stage by applying digital twin technology, and to provide a more appropriate evacuation safety design through simulation. The simulation device includes a first module and a second module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 시뮬레이션 장치는, 디지털 트윈 기술을 적용하여 실제 건물 또는 설계단계에서 적절한 피난 안전 설계가 되었는지 판단하고, 시뮬레이션을 통해 보다 적절한 피난 안전 설계를 제공하는데 이용될 수 있다.

title_en: Semantic segmentation method and system for disaster video data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semantic segmentation method and a semantic segmentation system for disaster video data, and relates to the field of image semantic segmentation. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of establishing a training data set comprising disaster scenes, carrying out preliminary processing on disaster video data according to a semantic segmentation network and the data set to obtain an initial semantic segmentation result, carrying out automatic correction on the initial semantic segmentation result according to an automatic correction algorithm to obtain a corrected semantic segmentation result of the disaster video data, and carrying out rapid, accurate and less manual intervention on segmentation by the semantic segmentation algorithm of the scheme, so that correction of the initial semantic segmentation result can be completed in an unsupervised mode, thereby rapidly obtaining ground object information meeting the requirement of disaster emergency rescue precision.

title_en: Characterization method for water-rich rock stratum fracture structure-seepage characteristic interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a characterization method of water-rich rock stratum fracture structure-seepage characteristic interaction, which comprises the steps of researching physical properties and microstructure characteristics of a field water-rich rock stratum; analyzing fractal characteristics of a rock mass, and establishing a fluid coupling model; the influence of different microstructures and environments on water seepage development is explored; the method is based on the complex network theory, and combines the rock mass permeability theory of the porous distribution structure characteristic to construct a quantitative analysis model of the fracture structure of the water-rich rock mass. And further simulating to obtain the influence of the water-rich stratum structure and the mechanical environment with different parameters on rock mass leakage. The method provides a foundation for researching the development and the damage of the water-rich rock mass and optimally designing a disaster prevention scheme for penetrating through the water-rich rock mass tunnel.

title_en: Smart grid false data injection attack detection method based on signal processing and data reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a false data injection attack detection method of a smart power grid based on signal processing and data reduction, which can be used in a power system state estimation link, and firstly uses Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) technology to extract state quantity behavior characteristics to generate high-dimensional characteristic vectors; secondly, the high-dimensional feature vectors are reduced by using an Improved Extreme Learning Machine (IELM) to shorten the detector training time and avoid 'dimension disaster'; and finally, training a Long Short term memory network (LSTM) by using the newly generated low-dimensional feature vector to generate a false data injection attack detector of the smart grid. In the process, the newly generated low-dimensional feature vectors are stored in a database as an extended data set to continuously optimize the detector. The invention aims to provide a real-time and accurate detection method for false data injection attack of a smart power grid, and the safe and stable operation of a power system is ensured.

title_en: A presentation device for among flood control disaster reduction hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a demonstration device for flood control and disaster reduction hydraulic engineering, which comprises a base, wherein the cross section of the base is of a concave structure, and four corners of the top of the base are provided with jacks; insert rods are arranged in the four groups of the insert holes in an embedded mode, a top plate is arranged at the top of the insert rods, object placing plates are arranged on the front surface, the back surface and the outer walls of the two sides of the top plate, sliding grooves are formed in the tops of the object placing plates in a penetrating mode, sliding blocks are arranged in the sliding grooves in a sliding mode, storage boxes are arranged at the bottoms of the sliding blocks, and fan boxes are arranged on the surfaces, close to each other, of the four groups of the storage boxes in an embedded mode; and a micro blower is arranged in the fan box. According to the invention, the base, the sliding groove, the sliding block and the fan box are arranged, the micro blower in the fan box is started, and the sliding block is pushed, so that the storage box is driven to move along the sliding groove, the aim of adjusting the wind direction can be further achieved, and convenience can be provided for subsequent simulation demonstration operation to a certain extent.
assignees: HENAN YUBEI SURVEY AND DESIGN INST OF WATER CONSERVANCY CO LTD

title_en: System and method for dynamic WEB penetration testing target range
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for dynamic WEB penetration testing of a target range. The target drone deployment module is used for deploying the penetration testing machine, the plate jump machine and the target drone through a virtualization technology. The artificial intelligence defense module is used for simulating defense behaviors of a defense party in a WEB penetration test, such as malicious flow monitoring, log analysis and the like, and making corresponding safety emergency response. The invention utilizes the technologies of text clustering, behavior simulation and the like in artificial intelligence and simulates the defense through AI, so that the WEB penetration test target range is more fit for the confrontation and exercise environment in actual network attack and defense.
assignees: NANJING MENGCAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon disaster risk assessment method, system and storage medium based on power grid area division
abstract_en: Collecting data in a typhoon environment, including meteorological data, power grid data and disaster condition data, carrying out data analysis, spatial interpolation and data correction on the data by using a GIS technology, and superposing an electric network area distribution map; the method comprises the steps of establishing a typhoon disaster-causing wind field model, establishing a theoretical model of the failure probability of power grid equipment in a disaster area, training actual failure data of the power grid equipment and typhoon wind field information in the disaster area, establishing an actual model of the failure probability of the regional power grid equipment, determining a parameter K of the failure probability model of the power grid equipment, and checking a failure probability curve of the power grid equipment. The method solves the quantitative assessment problem of the typhoon disaster risk of the power grid area, and realizes the unification of the generalized disaster damage probability and the mechanical disaster damage probability of the equipment of the power grid area.

title_en: Real person CS system based on ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of real person CS simulation, in particular to a real person CS system based on an ad hoc network. The system comprises a weapon control system, a data acquisition and communication subsystem and a comprehensive evaluation and judgment subsystem. In the invention, the comprehensive evaluation and judgment subsystem realizes remote intelligent gun control, provides intelligent technical support for scenes such as remote intelligent gun management, intelligent gun positioning, gun checking, gun anti-theft, gun anti-loss, gun management and control and the like, overcomes the defects that a laser irradiation receiver is easy to be shielded, a laser irradiation system is easy to lose effectiveness in a short distance and the like, is closer to actual combat, fully absorbs advanced communication technology, is designed by combining the requirements of near combat and night actual combat, is innovated, developed and researched from aspects such as battlefield environment simulation, effective command communication, real simulation combat, real-time data acquisition and the like, and can meet the requirements of real people CS, public security, armed police, army sub-team tactical combat training and evaluation, natural disasters, unmanned area emergency communication, data acquisition, reconnaissance and the like.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG BINGJIATANG HIGH TECH CO LTD;WANG DONGHUA

title_en: Water supply network disaster simulation system construction method and system based on three-dimensional GIS model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water supply network disaster simulation system construction method based on a three-dimensional GIS model, which comprises the following steps: acquiring three-dimensional GIS models and position information of pipe network distribution of a three-dimensional GIS model server, built-in sensors of the pipe network, pipe network valves, water meters and motors; establishing a three-dimensional GIS model of a pipe network disaster scene according to the pipe network disaster scene needing simulation; controlling a sensor, a valve, a motor and a water meter in the three-dimensional GIS model of the pipe network disaster scene to simulate water supply pipe network disaster events, and simulating a rescue process in the three-dimensional GIS model of the pipe network disaster scene; and evaluating the simulation result of the water supply network disaster event, and judging a suspected fault point. The invention realizes the simulation of the disaster event of the pipe network based on the three-dimensional GIS model server, simulates the rescue process, carries out effect evaluation to find the operation defects of the pipe network and equipment in advance, forms an emergency plan at the same time, prevents the traditional method from depending on manual experience and subjective judgment, and reduces the disposal time.
assignees: NANJING NANYOU INST OF INFORMATION TEACHNOVATION CO LTD

title_en: Test system and method for simulating dam break caused by water surge of landslide body
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster research, and discloses a test system and a method for simulating dam break caused by water surge of a landslide body, wherein the system comprises a support, a material box, a slide way platform, a water tank and a water tank, wherein the material box is used for loading a landslide body simulation material, the slide way platform is used for simulating a landslide, the water tank is used for simulating a damming lake, the water tank is used for simulating a river channel and internally provided with a stacked damming dam simulation body, on one hand, a lifting mechanism used for lifting the top end of the slide way platform is arranged on the support, the bottom end of the slide way platform is hinged with the lap joint end part of the water tank, on the other hand, the material box is slidably arranged on the slide way platform, a retractable winder is arranged at the top end of the slide way platform, and a pull wire of the retractable winder is connected with the material box, so that the problem that the sliding distance of the simulated landslide body and the inclination angle of the simulated landslide cannot be flexibly adjusted by the conventional simulation test device can be solved.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method for predicting motion of landslide mass by using three-dimensional particle flow method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of landslide, in particular to a method for predicting landslide body motion. A method for predicting the movement of a gliding mass using a three-dimensional particle flow method, comprising the steps of: 1) macro and micro parameter calibration of particle flow calculation, 2) three-dimensional geological slide bed model establishment and live-action space model interaction and display technology, and 3) landslide particle flow simulation, landslide mass disaster range inversion analysis and live-action achievement display. By adopting a cross-subject new method, the real scene space technology is applied to the display of the disaster-causing range of the landslide body, the scene information is obtained through the unmanned aerial vehicle image, the landslide scene real scene space model is generated by applying the oblique photography technology, and the disaster scene is more intuitively restored in a three-dimensional form. Meanwhile, the landslide disaster monitoring and prevention and control technical support is accurately and visually provided by digitally and three-dimensionally displaying the landslide disaster range prediction result through on-line editing of the live-action model and coupling and interaction of the numerical calculation result and the live-action space model.

title_en: Mechanical property testing device for transformer substation framework column under simulated fire
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mechanical property testing device for a transformer substation framework column under a simulated fire, a sleeve is sleeved at the top of the transformer substation framework column to form solid surfaces at the left side and the right side; the restraint frame clamps the solid surfaces on two sides of the sleeve; the measuring system comprises a displacement sensor, a temperature sensor and an upper computer. The fire experiment furnace comprises a furnace chamber, the fixed base is positioned in the furnace chamber, and the top of the transformer substation framework column penetrates through the top of the furnace chamber and is positioned outside the furnace chamber. The utility model relates to a test device simple manufacture, the equipment is convenient, can each subassembly field weld, convenient transportation. The restraint condition of the top in the practical application scene of the simulation framework column is realized through the restraint frame, the influence test of the vertical force on the framework column is completed, and meanwhile, the load is applied and the component is prevented from moving laterally. The design of the set provides the point of application of force for the restraint frame, need not to change transformer substation framework post self structure, improves the truth of test. The column body of the transformer substation framework column is arranged in the experimental furnace, so that the heating condition of the lower half part of the framework column in a fire disaster can be truly simulated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fire simulation device for mechanical property test of transformer substation framework column
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mechanical property test fire simulation device for a transformer substation framework column, which comprises a fire experiment furnace, wherein the fire experiment furnace comprises a furnace chamber, and the top of the furnace chamber is provided with a gap for the top of the transformer substation framework column to pass through; the gap is sealed by adopting a fireproof material. The column body of the transformer substation framework column is arranged in the experimental furnace, so that the heating condition of the lower half part of the framework column in a fire disaster can be truly simulated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Communication coverage method and related equipment based on multi-agent maximum entropy reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The application provides a post-disaster communication coverage method based on multi-agent maximum entropy reinforcement learning and related equipment. The method comprises the steps of recovering ground communication service for users after disasters in a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle base station hybrid networking mode, providing a distributed clustering-track layered air coverage optimization structure, realizing large-scale user clustering with high load efficiency and high balance by a distributed k-sum algorithm at the bottom layer, and optimizing the flight tracks of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle base stations by a distributed training-distributed execution MASAC neural network by combining clustering results at the upper layer, so that the communication interruption probability of the network is reduced, and the air coverage optimization of large-scale users after disasters is realized. Under the assistance of the integrated learning technology, the MASAC algorithm solves the problems of unstable multi-agent training environment and poor algorithm convergence stability caused by deterministic strategy gradient, and finally achieves the beneficial effect of reducing the communication interruption probability of the emergency communication network.

title_en: Power grid toughness evaluation and differentiation planning method under extreme typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a differentiated planning technology of a power system, in particular to a method for evaluating toughness and differentially planning a power grid under an extreme typhoon disaster, which specifically comprises the following steps: constructing a Batts wind field model to simulate typhoon disasters, constructing a power grid line fault recovery model and considering power grid toughness evaluation indexes of important load power supply; and constructing a power grid differentiated planning two-stage optimization model by taking the power grid toughness improvement return rate as a target function, and solving by adopting an improved PSO algorithm to obtain a protection grade differentiated strengthening scheme of the power grid transmission line. The method can effectively improve the toughness of the power grid and the supporting capacity of the toughness resources, and simultaneously saves the investment scale. The method has great significance for enhancing the disaster resistance of the power grid and guaranteeing the safe and reliable operation of the power grid under serious natural disasters. Meanwhile, reference is provided for a power grid planning department to formulate a differential planning scheme, so that the disaster resistance of the power grid is improved, and the social power utilization safety is guaranteed.

title_en: Anchoring device for preventing landslide geological disasters and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anchoring device for preventing landslide geological disasters, which comprises an anchor rod body, wherein one end of the anchor rod body is fixedly connected with a conical tip drill bit, one end of the anchor rod body, which is far away from the tip drill bit, is provided with a vertical channel, the inner surface of the vertical channel is assembled with a sliding inner rod in a sliding manner, and the inside of the sliding inner rod is provided with a first cavity; the anchor rod body is drilled into a side slope by a constructor through mechanical equipment, the sliding inner rod moves downwards in a knocking mode, the clamping column extrudes the two positioning sleeves, the two positioning sleeves are elastically deformed until the plurality of convex hulls are clamped into the corresponding grooves respectively, and the like. The invention can increase the connection firmness and the connection strength between the anchor rod body and the side slope, replaces the traditional side slope anchoring mode and ensures the reinforcing effect on the side slope.

title_en: Method for detecting influence of climate change and human activity on flow of dead water and attributing influence
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting and attributing influence of climate change and human activities on the flow of dead water, which comprises the steps of collecting runoff index observation data representing low flow and influence factor data thereof, preprocessing, detecting runoff trend by adopting a Sen's slope inspection method, simulating runoffs by using a machine learning support vector machine model, evaluating the performance of the support vector machine model, comparing the simulated runoff with actual runoff, the simulated runoff trend with actual runoff trend, removing trend of the time sequence of the influence factor through a control experiment and a sensitivity experiment, quantitatively identifying the specific contribution of the influence factor to the runoff, and calculating the influence factor contribution by introducing a full differential unfolding method based on multiple linear regression. The invention can quantitatively identify the influence of climate change and human activity on global water shortage, is helpful for scientifically understanding the action process of climate change and human activity on global drought evolution, and can provide theoretical reference for global water resource management and flood drought disaster assessment.

title_en: Method for preventing and treating water burst and mud burst of tunnel in syncline water-rich zone
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preventing and treating water burst and mud burst of a tunnel in an inclined rich water zone, which comprises the following steps: manufacturing a catheter; before blasting and excavating the tunnel, performing hole site lofting in the setting range of the water stop layer; drilling holes based on hole positions, wherein the distance and the direction of the drilling holes are designed according to the setting parameters of the guide pipe; preparing a grouting material; and (4) installing a guide pipe, grouting for advanced reinforcement, and forming a water stop layer in an elastic deformation area after the surrounding rock is excavated. The invention has the advantages that the water stopping layer can carry out blasting excavation aiming at the problem that the thickness of the water resisting layer of the syncline karst water-rich belt exceeds half of the maximum excavation span of the tunnel and is less than the maximum excavation span of the tunnel, and then water gushing and mud gushing are induced by high-pressure water under the action of blasting, thereby effectively preventing the occurrence of water gushing and mud gushing disasters, and the invention realizes quick grouting through three conduit hole sites to form the water stopping layer, thereby improving the grouting efficiency.
assignees: GUIZHOU ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD;GUIZHOU PROVINCE HIGHWAY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel surrounding rock stability discontinuous deformation analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for analyzing the discontinuous deformation of tunnel surrounding rock stability, which are used for emitting seismic wave signals to generate an emission phenomenon at discontinuous structural surfaces such as a fault and analyzing the geometrical parameters of a rock structural surface and the physical and mechanical parameters of rocks according to reflected signals; constructing a three-dimensional discontinuous numerical calculation model according to analysis requirements, and adding a rock mass structural plane into the calculation model according to the obtained geometric parameters; simulating the deformation and movement process of the surrounding rock blocks after tunnel excavation is completed, monitoring the vertical displacement of each block in real time, and dividing the blocks with the vertical displacement larger than a set value into collapsed blocks, otherwise, the blocks are safe blocks; and predicting and analyzing a high-risk area of the disaster of block collapse of surrounding rocks in front of the tunnel face based on the simulation result. The method integrates seismic wave detection data, and can realize the prediction and analysis of the collapse disaster of the surrounding rock mass in front of the tunnel face.

title_en: Simulation device for deformation and damage test of mine dam in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation device for a deformation and damage test of a mine dam in extreme weather, which comprises a mine dam earth-rock model box device and is characterized in that: be equipped with artifical rainfall simulation device on the tailings dam earth and rock model case device, tailings dam earth and rock model case device one side is equipped with monitoring devices, is equipped with the tailings dam earth and rock model in the tailings dam earth and rock model case device, is equipped with the organic glass case outside the tailings dam earth and rock model case device, and tailings dam earth and rock model case device one side is equipped with runoff collection device, is equipped with filter equipment on the runoff collection device, and monitoring devices is high-speed camera, and organic glass roof portion and left side all are equipped with the opening. The invention has the advantages that: the monitoring device is used for replacing direct observation, the characteristics of deformation and damage can be supplemented through infiltration depth, seepage line change and the loss weight of fine soil and stone particles along with surface runoff, and reference and scientific basis are provided for disaster prevention and reduction and safety management of different tailing dams.

title_en: Remote sensing image small sample scene classification method based on multi-scale double-flow architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image small sample scene classification method based on a multi-scale double-flow architecture, which mainly solves the problems that image discrimination in the prior art has information loss and is easily influenced by complex background of a remote sensing image and severe change of object scale. The scheme is as follows: acquiring a data set for data preprocessing; randomly sampling the preprocessed data set to generate a support set and a query set for training, verifying and testing; constructing an integral double-flow network consisting of a global flow network, a local flow network and a key area positioning module; defining loss functions of global flow and local flow, training and verifying the whole double-flow network to obtain an optimal network model; and classifying the test samples by using the optimal network model to obtain a scene classification result. The method reduces the loss of the discrimination information of the remote sensing image, avoids the influence of the severe change of the complex background and the object scale on the scene classification, improves the classification precision, and can be used for natural disaster detection, urban planning, environment monitoring and vegetation investigation.

title_en: Method for evaluating impact resistance of roadway support
abstract_en: A method for evaluating the impact resistance of roadway support comprises the steps of collecting mine earthquake waveform signals induced in mining production by a micro-earthquake monitoring system, recording and storing the mine earthquake waveform signals, selecting a credible channel with clear waveform and easy marking from the recorded and stored signals, determining the position of an earthquake source and the spatial position relation between the earthquake source and a roadway by a P-wave arrival time analysis method, calculating mine earthquake energy, selecting waveform signals with larger energy near the roadway, and establishing a roadway disaster-causing model; establishing a numerical model according with the actual condition by adopting a numerical simulation method; determining the maximum PPV value of the roadway capable of resisting impact through different applied dynamic load amplitudes; and drawing a PPV distribution isoline cloud chart according to the established roadway disaster causing model and the critical PPV value determined by numerical simulation, and evaluating the impact resistance of the roadway support system. The method can accurately evaluate the rock burst resistance of the roadway support system, and determine the maximum energy which can be resisted by the roadway at different distances from the seismic source to the roadway.
assignees: ZHONGTIAN HECHUANG ENERGY CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Fire safety carrying box
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire control safety carries case, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the case lid of cooperation on the box, the box inner chamber mainly divide into cavity and last cavity down, is used for holding electrical element in the cavity down, and electrical element's operating switch installs at the box outer wall, goes up the cavity and is used for holding fire-fighting equipment, is provided with the spool in the cavity down, is provided with four micro horn in spool the place ahead, and spool rear end fixed connection is lateral wall behind the box, and every micro horn is one through an independent shift knob of connection of electric lines, lateral wall before the box of four micro horn front end card. Adopt the utility model discloses, can install four independent miniature loudspeaker at least at the box inner chamber to dispose independent shift knob, thereby be favorable to the commander in the firefighter's combat training process to select and send whistle signal according to the demand is quick.
assignees: TONGJIA FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CHONGQING CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster drilling and sampling device with detection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disasters are with drilling sampling device with detect function, include: the shell, the outside bottom of shell is provided with the universal wheel, the outer end of gag lever post is installed and is examined test table, and the inner of examining test table is connected with the guide rod, and the second motor, it is installed inside on the shell, and the inside upper end of shell is connected with detection mechanism, the lower extreme of second motor is connected with rotatory subassembly, and just the lower extreme of rotatory subassembly installs the stopper, the lower extreme of stopper is provided with electric telescopic handle, and electric telescopic handle's lower extreme is connected with the drilling motor, the material pole is installed to drilling motor lower extreme, and the material pole lower extreme of stocking is connected with the drill bit. This geological disasters are with drilling sampling device with detect function, it can realize geological disasters and with the regulation of drilling sampling device detection device height, can realize geological disasters simultaneously with the regulation of drilling sampling device position, reduces and uses the limitation.

title_en: Dynamic aggregation modeling method considering internal voltage distribution characteristics of permanent magnet wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic polymerization modeling method considering internal voltage distribution characteristics of a permanent magnet wind power plant, which mainly comprises the following steps: (1) Carrying out dynamic polymerization on parameters of the permanent magnet wind turbine generator, wherein the parameters comprise wind turbine capacity, blade radius, pole pair number, shafting parameters, inductance, capacitance, resistance, transformer parameters and control parameters; (2) Dynamically polymerizing parameters of a cable current collecting line in the permanent magnet wind power plant; (3) Performing mathematical modeling on the voltage of an internal node of the permanent magnet wind power plant; by means of dynamic aggregation modeling of the wind power plant, the problem of computational dimension disaster caused by a large number of electric element models due to the fact that models of a plurality of wind power generation sets and a power grid are accurately modeled in the traditional simulation is solved, meanwhile, transient and steady-state characteristics of internal and external dynamic characteristics of the wind power plant under different input conditions are kept by the dynamic aggregation modeling method, and accuracy of dynamic simulation analysis is achieved.

title_en: Method for simulating diffusion of fire smoke in building and emergency scheme calling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for fire smoke diffusion in a building and an emergency scheme calling method, wherein a three-dimensional model constructed based on a target building in advance is obtained, a non-uniform computational grid is generated, and a complex topological computational space segmentation and synthesis method is established; and calculating to obtain wind speed, smoke concentration and turbulence diffusion characteristic parameters of the internal and external spaces of the building, further obtaining a time-space distribution simulation result of smoke diffusion when a fire disaster occurs, forming a plan library, finally realizing the comparison of the real-time scene of the fire disaster and the big data of the simulation plan library and generating an emergency decision consultation scheme in real time. The advantages are that: the method has the innovative technical advantages of high reduction degree, high reliability and three-dimensional numerical simulation based on fluid motion and diffusion, and has obvious advantages for fire evaluation and escape rescue of high-rise buildings and composite building complexes with complex internal and external structures which are newly built in cities in recent years.

title_en: Building damage classification method based on post-disaster unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building damage classification method based on post-disaster unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing images, which comprises the steps of obtaining post-disaster unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing images and preprocessing the images; building a building damage classification network model and training; the network model comprises a feature coding module and a classification module, wherein the feature coding module comprises a plurality of convolution blocks with attention mechanisms, which are sequentially connected and used for carrying out feature coding on the remote sensing image of the unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain a feature coding image, the classification module comprises a global feature extraction module, a context feature extraction module and a classifier, the global feature extraction module is used for carrying out global feature extraction on the feature coding image, the context feature extraction module is used for carrying out context feature extraction on the feature coding image, and the classifier is used for classifying image features fusing global features and context features; and carrying out damage classification and identification on the acquired remote sensing image of the unmanned aerial vehicle after the disaster by using the trained building damage classification network model.

title_en: Auxiliary decision support method and system for personnel safety evacuation of offshore oil and gas platform in typhoon period
abstract_en: A method and a system for assisting decision support of personnel safety evacuation of an offshore oil and gas platform in a typhoon period comprise the following steps: data acquisition and preprocessing; typhoon risk assessment and safety window period calculation; evaluating the carrying capacity of the helicopter; simulating simulation of a personnel evacuation scheme and optimizing resource allocation; optimizing visual human-computer interaction resource allocation; evaluating the channel recovery time; and generating a scheme report. The method has the advantages that aiming at the typhoon-period evacuation requirements of offshore oil and gas platform personnel, platform risk grade is dynamically evaluated and the safe evacuation window period is calculated on the basis of typhoon forecast data, the offshore oil and gas platform evacuation sequence is optimized, meanwhile, digital simulation is carried out by combining the carrying capacity of emergency resources such as helicopters, the personnel evacuation effect is evaluated, the resource allocation is dynamically optimized and adjusted, manual tuning and real-time platform evacuation effect feedback can be carried out on the basis of a visual man-machine interaction interface, the effect optimization of the offshore oil and gas platform personnel evacuation scheme is realized, the platform evacuation risk is reduced, and the platform evacuation efficiency is improved.
assignees: CNOOC ENERTECH SAFETY & ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CO

title_en: Big data simulation disaster risk model system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prediction, in particular to a huge disaster risk model system and a huge disaster risk model method for big data simulation, wherein the huge disaster risk model system comprises a disaster module, a vulnerability module, a spatial correlation module and a financial module; the earthquake ground monitoring system adopts the latest attenuation model and the calculation formula to calculate earthquake ground, selects the latest Vs30 information at the target site as the judgment basis of the site category, estimates the attenuation earthquake ground at the target site, has small error, utilizes the financial module to quickly generate an insurance claim scheme according to loss, is convenient for quick claim of insurance companies, and analyzes and calculates the calculated data by the effective analysis module and the application verification module, thereby ensuring the accuracy of system prediction, and simultaneously analyzes the data and log files when the system is used by the statistical analysis module, and is convenient for the system to update the vulnerability in time.
assignees: ZHONGZHEN KEJIAN GUANGDONG DISASTER PREVENTION AND MITIGATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Light-duty integrated heat, water, power and displacement multi-parameter landslide hazard monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring devices, in particular to a light landslide hazard monitoring device integrating heat, water, force and displacement with multiple parameters. The invention effectively solves the problem that the common monitoring equipment adopts commercial power for power supply, and the commercial power is very easy to be interrupted and cannot be continuously monitored in the heavy rain and other disaster weather; the monitoring end passes through waterproof case whole encapsulation, can install the monitoring end of landslide detector on the fixture on the slope body surface that awaits measuring, not only need not excavate or complicated construction such as drilling can use, and the detection module of a monitoring end supports multi-parameter sensor simultaneously, can carry out accurate monitoring under this kind of abominable environment of tibetan railway of Sichuan, has increased the ease for use of equipment and has reduced use cost moreover.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY ERYUAN ENG GROUP

title_en: River bed load transfer characteristic determination method, device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a river bed load transfer characteristic determining method, a river bed load transfer characteristic determining device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium, and relates to the technical field of engineering. The method comprises the steps of performing fast Fourier transform on sound pressure signals of a microphone array to obtain a sound pressure matrix in a frequency domain, performing cross-spectrum operation based on the sound pressure matrix to obtain a cross-spectrum matrix, selecting a sound propagation model based on each scanning grid point j on the surface of a monitoring sensing plate as a virtual sound source point according to an aerodynamic theory to determine sound signals monitored by any microphone, scanning each grid point, calculating an analog sound signal self-spectrum to determine a sound source holographic image of a bed load shock wave, simulating sound source intensity to obtain a bed load space position, and obtaining bed load particle size component information through a calibration function relation. Namely, the method can accurately determine the migration characteristics of the bed load and becomes an important support for quantifying the disaster prevention and reduction work of the mountain river.

title_en: Multi-type combined transportation emergency management system for spent fuel
