abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-type combined transportation emergency management system for spent fuel, which comprises a plan management subsystem, an emergency resource management subsystem, a deduction and discussion subsystem, a script editing subsystem, a simulation and exercise subsystem and a system management subsystem, wherein the plan management subsystem is used for managing emergency plans; the emergency resource management subsystem is used for managing emergency resources; the deduction and discussion subsystem is used for deduction and evaluation of the emergency plan; the script editing subsystem is used for managing the script of the emergency plan; the simulation and drilling subsystem is used for performing simulation drilling on the emergency plan; the system management subsystem is used for managing the user and the system log of the multi-type spent fuel combined transportation emergency management system. The multiple type combined transportation emergency management system for the spent fuel improves emergency response and management level in the spent fuel transportation process.
assignees: CGNPC URANIUM RESOURCES CO LTD;CHINA NUCLEAR POWER INST CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster recovery method and device for electric-gas energy system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster recovery method, a device and a storage medium of an electric-gas energy system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing an objective function by taking the minimum loss load of the operation of an electric-gas energy system as an optimized scheduling target, wherein the electric-gas energy system comprises an electric power system and a natural gas system; constructing natural gas system constraint conditions, electric power system constraint conditions and electric-gas system coupling constraint conditions; constructing a post-disaster recovery mathematical model according to the objective function, the natural gas constraint condition, the electric power system constraint condition and the electric-gas system coupling constraint condition; and carrying out nonlinear constraint linearization on the post-disaster recovery mathematical model, and carrying out simulation analysis on the nonlinear constraint linearized mathematical model to obtain an optimal scheduling strategy for the electric-gas energy system with the minimum load loss in a preset time period after the disaster. The invention can effectively improve the overall recovery efficiency of the energy system.

title_en: Method and device for identifying fragile line of power transmission network under ice disaster and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for identifying a fragile line of a power transmission network under ice disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the ice coating thickness of each line in the power transmission network under ice disasters; determining the fault probability of each line according to the thickness of each ice coating; on the basis of the fault probability of each line, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to obtain a plurality of line cascading fault accident chains, and constructing a cascading fault incidence matrix according to the line cascading fault accident chains; wherein each element in the cascading failure incidence matrix is: the associated weight of the fault line corresponding to the element and another fault line; determining the node weight degree of each line according to the cascading failure incidence matrix; and taking the first M lines with the maximum node weight degrees as fragile lines. By implementing the method, the fragile line in the power transmission network under ice disasters can be effectively identified.

title_en: Elevator is experienced to safety
abstract_en: The utility model provides a safe elevator of experiencing belongs to elevator analogue means technical field. This elevator is experienced safely, including elevator portal frame and elevator car, electronic jar promotes elevator car and rises, enable visitor's visual angle and the overweight experience of health impression and feel, electronic jar up-and-down motion, it rocks from top to bottom to drive elevator car, let visitor experience the disaster and come the back, produce harm to the elevator, make the visitor produce the fear that the elevator is about to fall and feel, the car top is held to the electro-magnet, electronic jar pole returns and contracts, the car is hung on the portal frame, electro-magnet demagnetization release car, the car falls suddenly, bring the experience that weightlessness falls for the visitor, run the in-process through simulation elevator and meet the earthquake, various trouble of elevator when the non-artificial resistance disaster such as conflagration, the experience when making the passenger that is located elevator car inside experience different elevator trouble.
assignees: SHANDONG GOLDON DIGITAL CREATIVE CO LTD

title_en: Landslide early warning method based on XGB and Catboost dual tree lifting algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide early warning method based on XGB and Catboost dual tree lifting algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring historical geological factor characteristic data and historical rainfall characteristic data of an area to be detected; s2: preprocessing data to construct a data sample set; s3: establishing an XGB model and a Catboost model; s4: training the XGB model and the Catboost model, wherein the Catboost model is trained based on the data sample set and the predicted pore water pressure data set of the XGB model; s5: and acquiring real-time geological factor characteristic data and real-time rainfall characteristic data of the area to be detected, and inputting the data into the XGB model and the Catboost model to obtain a critical FOS value of landslide instability. S6: and obtaining an early warning level according to a preset threshold value of the critical FOS value for landslide instability. According to the method, the XGB and CatBOost dual lifting tree algorithm early warning frame is built, and the pore water pressure of a slope body is predicted in near real time, so that accurate and efficient landslide disaster early warning is kept in the rainfall-induced landslide evolution process under a lower input condition.

title_en: Large-thickness-difference coal seam mining similar simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-thickness-difference coal seam mining similarity simulation test device which comprises a similarity simulation experiment table, a hydraulic loading device, a control device and a test analysis device, wherein the similarity simulation experiment table is used for carrying out similarity simulation on coal seams; the analog simulation experiment table comprises a top beam, channel steel, a support column and a base; the hydraulic loading device comprises an axial loading assembly, a lateral fixing assembly and a power source; the power source is electrically connected with the control device; the test analysis device comprises a test component and an analysis component; the test component is electrically connected with the analysis component; the test assembly is pre-buried in the rock stratum. The large-thickness-difference coal seam mining simulation test adopts a method combining model establishment and numerical simulation analysis, and carries out systematic research on deformation and damage characteristics of surrounding rocks of large-thickness-difference coal seams and ground surface subsidence rules from the perspective of engineering mechanics, so that the research result has important practical significance for protecting against mountain mining damage and geological disasters of mine environment.

title_en: Simulation method for pedestrian intelligent body movement and emergency evacuation and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a simulation method for pedestrian intelligent body movement and emergency evacuation, a computer readable storage medium and computer equipment, comprising the following steps: identifying the pedestrian motion state in the building scene according to the acquired monitoring videos of the monitoring video point positions in the current building scene, and updating the pedestrian individual parameters, the pedestrian motion parameters and the initialization data of the pedestrian motion behavior of the current building scene; constructing a space model and a pedestrian intelligent body according to a current building scene, synchronizing the position coordinates of the pedestrian intelligent body in the space model, and synchronizing the position coordinates of the pedestrian intelligent body in the space model; and updating the real-time position coordinates of the pedestrian intelligent body to obtain the predicted movement track or evacuation track of the pedestrian intelligent body. The crowd excessive gathering early warning and emergency evacuation prediction can be achieved.

title_en: Goaf coal spontaneous combustion prevention and control method during production stopping period of working face of coal seam easy to spontaneous combustion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a goaf coal spontaneous combustion prevention and control method during production stoppage of a working face of an easy spontaneous combustion coal seam. The method comprises the following steps: firstly dividing the working face into three disaster prevention and control sections A1, A2 and A3 according to the inclined length when the working face stops production; in the sections A1 and A3, adopting measures such as hanging concrete canvas at the air inlet (return) corner, constructing high-level measures of drilling holes to the goaf behind the support, injecting high water retention flue gas foam and cooling flue gas inert gas of a power plant, injecting expansion curing foam from a gap between the supports to the goaf, hanging flame retardant air duct cloth to wrap the support and the like; and in the section A2, inserting a light-weight curing filling material into the gap between the brackets and injecting the light-weight curing filling material into the rear of the goaf to form the plugging wall. Aiming at the characteristic that the coal spontaneous combustion disasters in all areas have different dangerous degrees in the production stopping period of the working face of the easy spontaneous combustion coal seam, the invention provides a sectional control method with cooperation of multiple measures, and the control efficiency and the effectiveness of the coal spontaneous combustion disasters are obviously improved.

title_en: Flood disaster emergency risk avoiding and material real-time allocation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent decision, in particular to an emergency risk avoiding and material real-time allocation method for flood disasters. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring original sampling data; constructing a flood simulation model; generating dynamic simulation process data of flood according to the flood simulation model; generating a maximum flood submerging water depth grid map according to the flood dynamic simulation process data; constructing a rapid and intelligent flood inundation prediction model according to the maximum flood inundation water depth grid map, and generating simulation process data of flood inundation; generating disaster-affected data according to the flooding simulation process data; generating danger-avoiding transfer real-time data and scheduling decision data according to the disaster-suffered data; constructing a material allocation model according to risk avoidance transfer real-time analysis and scheduling decision analysis, and generating material allocation real-time data and scheduling decision data according to the material allocation model; the method takes flood simulation, flood real-time prediction, risk avoiding transfer analysis and material allocation analysis as core technical processes to support flood emergency flood control decisions.

title_en: Risk assessment method and device for comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method and a risk assessment device for an integrated energy system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an optimal load reduction model by taking the minimized total weighted load loss as a target function; constructing an expected accident set, selecting an expected accident state from the expected accident set, simulating and repairing the expected accident state, and obtaining the overhaul completion time of the accident state; obtaining an expected accident state safety index by solving the optimal load reduction model, and synthesizing a disaster state curve of the energy system according to the overhaul completion time and the expected accident state safety index; calculating a risk index of the comprehensive energy system according to the safety index of the expected accident state; and combining the disaster state curve and the risk indexes of the comprehensive energy system to obtain a risk evaluation result of the comprehensive energy system. The method can effectively improve the accuracy of the risk assessment of the comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Three-dimensional pressure relief method during coal rock layer penetrating period of tunneling roadway of rock burst mine
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional pressure relief method during coal rock crossing of a tunneling roadway of a rock burst mine, which comprises the following steps of: s1, dividing roadway layer penetrating types according to a roadway tunneling design drawing; s2, respectively carrying out surrounding rock drilling coring measurement on different roadway layer penetrating types, and determining the surrounding rock attribute of the tunneling roadway; s3, dividing the non-excavated part of the tunneling roadway along the tunneling direction of the roadway into areas with different pressure relief grades based on surrounding rock attributes; s4, formulating three-dimensional pressure relief scheme parameters of areas with different pressure relief grades of the tunneling roadway; s5, three-dimensional pressure relief is carried out for multiple times, and three-dimensional pressure relief is achieved during the tunneling of coal and rock layers of the tunnel. The application effectively improves the pressure relief effect during the coal rock layer penetrating period of the tunneling roadway of the rock burst mine, reduces the structural stress concentration phenomenon caused by coal rock medium conversion, further reduces the impact power disaster risk caused by the structural stress, and improves the life safety coefficient of underground tunneling roadway workers.

title_en: System for Providing training contents to strengthen response capabilities for fire fighting activity on-scene commander
title_ko: 소방활동 현장지휘관 대응역량 강화를 위한 훈련 콘텐츠 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing a training content for strengthening response capability of a firefighting field commander, which allows a field commander to train for conducting firefighting activities for each fire type through a simulation to strengthen firefighting response capability. The system for providing a training content for strengthening response capability of a firefighting field commander according to the present invention is a system that provides a simulation training content to strengthen response capability of a firefighting field commander, comprising: a scenario editing server (100) that edits a training scenario of a fire situation for each fire type and implements a simulation training content such that a field commander can perform educational training through a personal terminal; a learning management system (LMS) server (200) that evaluates and manages a training result of the field commander who performs training with the personal terminal through the simulation training content implemented by the scenario editing server (100); and a training evaluation database server (300) that stores and manages data generated through the scenario editing server (100) and the LMS server (200), wherein the system is provided to improve the fire response capability of the field commander.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 현장지휘관이 화재유형별로 소방활동을 지휘하는 훈련을 시뮬레이션을 통해 수행하여 소방활동 대응역량을 강화할 수 있도록 하는 소방활동 현장지휘관 대응역량 강화를 위한 훈련 콘텐츠 제공 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 소방활동 현장지휘관 대응역량 강화를 위한 훈련 콘텐츠 제공 시스템은 소방활동 현장지휘관의 대응역량 강화를 위해 시뮬레이션 훈련 콘텐츠를 제공하는 시스템으로서, 현장지휘관이 개인 단말기를 통해 교육 훈련을 할 수 있도록 화재유형별 화재상황의 훈련 시나리오를 편집하여 시뮬레이션 훈련 콘텐츠를 구현하는 시나리오 편집 서버(100)와; 상기 시나리오 편집 서버(100)에 의해 구현된 시뮬레이션 훈련 콘텐츠를 통하여 개인 단말기로 훈련을 수행하는 현장지휘관의 훈련 결과를 평가 관리하는 LMS(Learning Management System) 서버(200)와; 상기 시나리오 편집 서버(100) 및 LMS 서버(200)를 통하여 생성되는 데이터를 저장하고 관리하는 훈련 평가 데이터베이스 서버(300);를 포함하여 이루어져 현장지휘관의 화재 대응능력을 향상시킬 수 있도록 제공된다.

title_en: Concrete member anti-impact reinforcing structure with self-sensing function and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The application provides a concrete member anti-impact reinforcing structure with a self-sensing function and a manufacturing method thereof, and the concrete member anti-impact reinforcing structure comprises the following steps: marking a laying path on the surface of the beam body, and drilling a hole on the beam body; the anchoring part is fixed on the hole of the beam concrete through an expansion bolt, the anchoring part is provided with a connecting hole, and the longitudinal strain strip passes through the connecting hole and is lapped on the anchoring part; adhering the optical fiber line to the beam surface of the beam body along the drawn laying path; the method comprises the following steps of firstly pasting a longitudinal strain strip, pasting the longitudinal strain strip along the axial direction of a beam body and coating an optical fiber line, then pasting a transverse strain strip, pasting a plurality of circles of the transverse strain strip along the radial direction of the beam body and coating the longitudinal strain strip. The reinforcing scheme can effectively improve the ductility and the impact resistance of the reinforced concrete member and can realize the real-time perception of the occurrence of the impact disaster and the damage degree; in addition, the optical fiber line can monitor the structural state of the beam body in real time by measuring the strain value of the beam body.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning method and system based on multivariate data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses a monitoring and early warning method based on multivariate data fusion, which comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional slope numerical model; setting a sensor to collect slope monitoring point data, and erecting a camera to collect geological information to perform three-dimensional image recognition; carrying out inversion correction on each item of acquired data; inputting rainfall in real time for analysis and processing, and outputting a displacement result A; establishing a three-dimensional monitoring model by using the three-dimensional image recognition data, and calculating a displacement result B of the moving area; judging whether the displacement similarity of the three-dimensional slope model meets the requirement or not, and if so, predicting the slope deformation; and carrying out early warning and forecasting according to the displacement tangent angle, defining a warning stage, and carrying out warning and reminding on residents. The invention integrates field monitoring data, numerical simulation data and image identification data, and can carry out point-surface-body type monitoring, evolution mechanism analysis, three-dimensional model visualization, damage trend prediction and early warning on landslides.

title_en: Emergency evacuation slide for training airplane
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation slide for a training airplane, which relates to the technical field of airplane equipment and comprises an air supply device, a first slide body and a second slide body, wherein the air supply device is separated from a cabin door of the airplane and is provided with an air storage tank and a vent pipeline; the controller is electrically connected with the first valve body and the second valve body and is used for opening based on the second valve body so as to control the first valve body to communicate the air storage tank and the ventilation pipeline; the slide way assembly is detachably mounted on a cabin door of the airplane and comprises an inflatable slide way and a pre-positioning pull rod, the inflatable slide way is connected with the pre-positioning pull rod, the inflatable slide way is communicated with a second end of the ventilation pipeline, and the pre-positioning pull rod is in transmission connection with a second valve body. The emergency evacuation slide for the training airplane has the advantages of reasonable structure, low cost and good simulation effect of real airplane, and has important application value in training of airplane units and ground emergency rescue personnel in airports.
assignees: CIVIL AVIATION MAN INSTITUTE OF CHINA

title_en: Dual-fireproof bus duct
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of bus ducts, and particularly relates to a double-fireproof bus duct which comprises: the device comprises a bus duct outer frame, an air supply mechanism, an internal fire extinguishing mechanism and a plugging control mechanism; a cavity is drilled in the bus duct outer frame, and heat exchange water is filled in the cavity; the gas supply mechanism comprises a support frame, sodium bicarbonate solution is filled in the support frame, a plurality of fixed sleeve covers are arranged above the support frame, storage tanks are arranged in the fixed sleeve covers, polypropylene films are fixed on the storage tanks, and aluminum sulfate powder is filled between the polypropylene films and the storage tanks; the internal fire extinguishing mechanism comprises a storage box, a locking groove is formed in the storage box, and a sliding shielding plate is arranged in the locking groove; the plugging control mechanism is used for blocking the discharge of heat exchange water, so that the effect of extinguishing the external fire of the bus duct outer frame is achieved. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the corresponding mechanisms of the bus duct, the bus duct can be quickly extinguished when a fire disaster happens outside or inside the bus duct, so that the probability of power supply interruption is reduced and personnel are prevented from being injured.
assignees: JIANGSU LESHI ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Relay unmanned aerial vehicle applied to urban natural disasters
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle, specifically disclose a relay unmanned aerial vehicle when being applied to city natural disasters, the reciprocating impact tunnel drilling machine comprises a machine body, the bottom fixed mounting of fuselage has the support, the bottom fixedly connected with bearing plate of support, there is the multilayer rubber pad bottom of bearing plate through buffer gear swing joint, the spacing section of thick bamboo of top fixedly connected with of multilayer rubber pad, the inside of a spacing section of thick bamboo is provided with shock attenuation gasbag. This be applied to relay unmanned aerial vehicle when city natural disasters, in the twinkling of an eye that multilayer rubber pad and ground contacted, the fuselage can receive the reverse impact force of certain degree, and accessible buffer gear cushions the impact force, and then forms a reverse buffer power to the fuselage through the support, and the cooperation gag lever post slides from top to bottom in spacing section of thick bamboo for whole unmanned aerial vehicle's buffering shock attenuation goes on under safe effectual environment, in order to reach the effect of the inside accurate spare part of protection fuselage.
assignees: HUNAN ZIYOUFEI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation training and evaluation system for fire fighting activity on-scene command system
title_ko: 소방활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 및 평가 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulation training and evaluation system for a fire-fighting activity on-scene command system, which performs training, wherein an on-scene commander commands a fire-fighting activity for each fire type, through a simulation to evaluate and manage the same. According to the present invention, the simulation training and evaluation system for a fire-fighting activity on-scene command system, which enables a fire-fighting commander to perform the fire-fighting activity on-scene command system through a personal terminal and receive evaluation, includes: a scenario editing server (100) which edits a training scenario of a fire situation for each fire type to implement simulation training content, so that the on-scene commander can get education training through the personal terminal; a learning management system (LMS) server (200) which evaluates and manages a training result of the on-scene commander performing training through the personal terminal through the simulation training content implemented by the scenario editing server (100); and a training evaluation database server (300) which stores and manages data generated through the scenario editing server (100) and the LMS server (200). The LMS sever (200) is interconnected with the training evaluation database server (200) to be able to be interconnected with simulation training content for each fire type of the fire-fighting activity on-scene command system. Training content and user information are provided to be able to be modified and deleted through a web.

title_en: Emergency command and dispatch system for emergency
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency response management device which can effectively build an emergency command platform and provide plan and action scheme support for emergency command, and comprises a basic plan database for storing emergency plan data; the event database is used for storing emergency event action scheme data, emergency resource data and scheme execution data; the emergency plan management module is used for managing data in the basic plan database; the real event/drill event management module is used for managing data in the event database; the communication module is used for communicating with the terminal equipment and the government emergency management platform; the invention also provides an emergency command system using the emergency response management equipment; the emergency response management equipment can assist in establishing, maintaining and distributing emergency plans and action schemes of emergency events and provide command, disposal and response schemes for various emergency events; the automatic emergency plan and event disposal plan creating process can be realized, and the time for emergency command reaction is saved.

title_en: Precipitation prediction method and device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The utility model provides a precipitation prediction method based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technologies of image recognition, video analysis and deep learning, and can be applied to smart cities and meteorological disaster early warning scenes. The training method of the precipitation prediction model comprises the following steps: acquiring training data; constructing a neural network model comprising a first encoder, a second encoder and a first decoder; based on the neural network model and the radar echo data observed at multiple moments, obtaining time-interval predicted precipitation data corresponding to each time-interval observed precipitation data; and calculating a first loss function value based on the time-interval observation precipitation data and the time-interval prediction precipitation data, and adjusting parameters of the neural network model according to the first loss function value to obtain a precipitation prediction model. The precipitation prediction method based on artificial intelligence comprises the following steps: acquiring radar echo data to be processed; and inputting radar echo data to be processed into a precipitation prediction model, and predicting precipitation data according to the time output by the precipitation prediction model to obtain a precipitation prediction result.
assignees: BEIJING BAIDU NETCOM SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring and early warning system for waterlogging disasters of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monitoring and early warning system for waterlogging disasters of a transformer substation, which comprises the following steps: step S1: acquiring high-precision and high-resolution ground surface elevation grid data in a transformer substation by adopting a three-dimensional laser scanning technology; step S2: building a transformer substation water level-reservoir capacity curve by combining different frequency precipitation data of a transformer substation area; and step S3: building a transformer substation waterlogging algorithm model by combining the drainage capacity in the substation; and step S4: according to the real-time rainfall observation data, the waterlogging depths generated in different areas in the transformer substation can be calculated in real time; step S5: according to the rainfall real-time observation data, the expected drainage time of different areas in the transformer substation can be calculated in real time; step S6: the BIM modeling and the three-dimensional simulation modeling are combined to perform dynamic display, so that an early warning effect is achieved; the method has the advantages of timely early warning of waterlogging, dynamic early warning of waterlogging prevention and improvement of the management level of drainage and waterlogging prevention work.
assignees: EHV COMPANY OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: High-prestress constant-resistance coupling supporting method for soft rock roadway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-prestress constant-resistance coupling supporting method for a soft rock roadway, which belongs to the technical field of roadway surrounding rock supporting and comprises the following steps: tunneling a roadway, performing primary guniting sealing on a section, and paving a reinforcing mesh; drilling a hole in the surrounding rock, installing an anchor rope to be matched with a steel strip support, and arranging a top anchor rope support perpendicular to the tunneling direction of the roadway; the short NPR anchor cable is matched with a steel belt to carry out primary coupling support, and primary concrete spraying is carried out; then, matching the long NPR anchor cable with a steel belt for supporting construction, performing tunnel bottom excavation, pouring the bottom and performing mine pressure observation; carrying out re-spraying of concrete, carrying out permanent support and spraying of concrete again; and setting a long-term monitoring point to monitor the surrounding rock deformation and the axial force of the NPR anchor cable for a long time. According to the coupling between the NPR anchor cables and the surrounding rock and the coupling between the long NPR anchor cables and the short NPR anchor cables, the deformation of the surrounding rock is limited, the strength coupling and the rigidity coupling are realized, and the effective control of the large deformation disaster of the surrounding rock of the soft rock roadway is realized.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning method and system for building fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring and early warning of building fire, which comprises the following steps: simulating the environmental parameters and the fire-fighting equipment state parameters corresponding to various buildings, and analyzing the simulation result to obtain fire disaster factor tables corresponding to various buildings; collecting historical image data of various buildings and constructing a building scene recognition model; identifying a target building according to the building scene identification model to obtain a corresponding building type and determine a corresponding fire disaster factor table; monitoring field parameters in a target building in real time; according to the method and the system, the simulation from the normal range to the early warning range is carried out on the fire related data of various buildings, effective basis is provided for the real occurrence reason of the fire, the accuracy of fire judgment is improved, and professionals can acquire accurate information so as to accurately judge the fire position.
assignees: ARIC DALIAN SAFETY TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Single-track overhead district evacuation rescue test system based on VR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-rail elevated district evacuation rescue test system based on VR. The single-track rescue evacuation scheme has high on-site drilling cost and uncontrollable risk, and cannot cover vast passenger groups. The invention combines the virtual reality technology, reproduces the emergency situation of the straddle monorail in distress in the elevated area, and considers the influence of crowd evacuation characteristics on the evacuation behavior of passengers in the monorail carriage under the emergency situation; the psychological factors of evacuated people are considered in the personnel evacuation model, and the reality of evacuation simulation in the single-track emergency scene is improved. Meanwhile, visualization of each single-track evacuation rescue scheme is achieved, a single-track carriage identifier and a voice resource library are established, a user can feel personally on the scene through an emergency scene and the voice resource library, behavior data of passengers are collected from multiple angles, and dimensionality and reliability of the behavior data are enriched. The method can be used for providing suggestions for the comparison and optimization of the monorail rescue evacuation scheme and assisting monorail rescue emergency drilling and training.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD

title_en: Method for obtaining geological disaster early warning key parameter prediction value based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction, in particular to a method for obtaining a predicted value of a geological disaster early warning key parameter based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, combing monitoring parameters of a target geological disaster hidden danger point in a geological disaster early warning system; s2, acquiring historical data of monitoring parameters of the target geological disaster hidden danger points; s3, dividing all monitoring parameters into a first type of monitoring parameters and a second type of monitoring parameters; and S4, establishing a data set for machine learning based on the historical data of the monitoring parameters of the target geological disaster hidden danger points, taking the historical data or the real-time data of the first type of monitoring parameters as input, taking the real-time data of the second type of monitoring parameters as output, and training and predicting through a machine learning algorithm to obtain a predicted value of the geological disaster early warning key parameters. The invention solves the technical problem that the failure rate of the geological disaster early warning system is difficult to reduce.
assignees: CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Drainage basin management method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a basin management method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining Beidou data, remote sensing data and Internet of things data of a hydropower station basin, and constructing a basin database; the method comprises the steps of carrying out digital mapping on hydropower station watershed through various engines based on a watershed database to generate a corresponding digital twin watershed, obtaining a watershed service, and carrying out service simulation in the digital twin watershed through a watershed service association algorithm, wherein the watershed service is one or more of gate control previewing, regional inundation analysis, watershed ground disaster early warning and dam stress early warning. According to the invention, based on various kinds of perception data of the hydropower station basin processed by various kinds of engines, the accurate and intelligent construction of the digital twin basin is realized, meanwhile, various basin services are simulated in the digital twin basin through various algorithms, and the management efficiency and emergency command capacity of the hydropower station basin are improved.

title_en: Transportation rescue scheduling method for dangerous goods based on traffic big data
abstract_en: The application provides a dangerous goods transportation rescue scheduling method based on traffic big data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring information of a disaster-prone area and determining disaster distribution characteristics; adopting an event tree analysis method to calculate the risk index of each area, specifically comprising the steps of constructing an event tree according to disaster statistical data, quantitatively analyzing the event tree and calculating the risk index of each area; analyzing the video monitoring videos of all road sections and calculating the traffic flow and the average speed of each time period under different weather conditions; constructing a cellular automata model to simulate the traffic flow of all road sections under different weather conditions in each time period; the method comprises the steps of parking the rescue vehicle according to the weather condition and providing an optimal scheduling scheme, and specifically comprises the steps of parking the rescue vehicle according to the weather condition and providing the optimal scheduling scheme of the rescue vehicle when a disaster happens.

title_en: Charge induction monitoring probe returning device for non-contact coal rock drilling inner wall
abstract_en: The invention provides a charge induction monitoring probe return device for a non-contact coal rock drilling inner wall, and relates to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster monitoring. The device comprises a supporting bracket, two fixed pedestals, a driving rod and a limiting belt; the two fixed pedestals are welded with the support bracket groove into a whole, the charge induction monitoring probe is arranged in the support bracket groove, and the front end and the rear end of the charge induction monitoring probe are outside the support bracket groove; one end of the driving rod is arranged in the bracket body, the other end of the driving rod is exposed, and the outer surface of the exposed end is provided with external threads, so that the driving rod can be prolonged according to the drilling depth of the coal rock; the limit belt is sleeved on the support groove through a limit rivet and used for fixing the charge induction monitoring probe. Meanwhile, the device also comprises a wheel connecting shaft, a wheel, a positioning pin and a limiting belt fastening block, wherein the wheel connecting shaft, the wheel and the positioning pin are arranged on the fixed pedestal, and the limiting belt fastening block is used for clamping a limiting belt. The device can help the charge induction probe to realize the stable monitoring of non-contact coal petrography cuttings, strengthens anti-interference, improves the rate of accuracy of discerning tunnel coal petrography danger charge signal.

title_en: Simulation method of landslide-river blockage-surge disaster chain based on DEM-CFD coupling calculation
abstract_en: A landslide-river blockage-surge disaster chain simulation method based on DEM-CFD coupling calculation belongs to the field of landslide and river blockage disaster evolution mechanism analysis and disaster prevention and reduction numerical simulation analysis. The landslide-river blockage-surge disaster chain simulation method calculates the landslide-river coupling effect through a local average DEM-CFD coupling numerical method, realizes the surge liquid level evolution tracking by combining a VOF (virtual object function) model, establishes a new porosity calculation method through a virtual sphere model and meets the requirement of actual terrain modeling. The invention adopts a DEM-CFD coupling simulation method to accurately describe a fluid-solid coupling mechanism, and fully considers the influence of the fluid environment on the migration and accumulation process of the landslide body; by introducing the VOF model into the local average DEM-CFD coupling method, the modeling of river water environment and air can be realized, the free liquid level evolution of a river can be tracked, and the propagation process of driving surge by simulating landslide is further realized; the virtual ball is constructed based on the real particles, so that the high-resolution mesh generation requirement of a three-dimensional model can be met, and the real case simulation of landslide-river blockage-surge disaster chains can be realized.

title_en: System access switching method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a system access switching method and device, and relates to the technical field of data access. The system access switching method comprises the following steps: receiving a plurality of disaster recovery drilling plan documents from a first terminal, and updating the drilling time period of one disaster recovery drilling plan document when the drilling time periods of any two disaster recovery drilling plan documents are detected to be overlapped and the identification of a system to be drilled of one disaster recovery drilling plan document is the identification of a system mutually exclusive to the identification of the system to be drilled in the other disaster recovery drilling plan document, so that the drilling time periods of the two disaster recovery drilling plan documents are not overlapped; when the current moment reaches any drilling time period, the access address of the system to be drilled in the corresponding disaster recovery drilling plan document is switched from the first access address to the second access address, so that the second terminal accesses the system to be drilled through the second access address, and data loss or system faults are avoided.

title_en: Distributed database disaster recovery testing method and system and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data disaster recovery, and provides a distributed database disaster recovery testing method, a distributed database disaster recovery testing system and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: submitting a transaction to a database master cluster in the data operation process of the simulated financial service; recording the global tracking number of the transaction and the timestamp when the transaction is successfully submitted; performing database disaster recovery backup switching after a fault is injected into a database main cluster, and recording a timestamp during the disaster recovery backup switching and a timestamp during the successful disaster recovery backup switching; and calculating a recovery point target of the distributed database according to the recorded global tracking number of the transaction and the timestamp when the transaction is successfully submitted, and calculating a recovery time target of the distributed database according to the recorded timestamp when the disaster recovery switching is performed and the recorded timestamp when the disaster recovery switching is successfully performed. The method and the device adopt a unified mode to obtain the time stamps required by calculating the RPO and the RTO, the obtained RPO and RTO indexes have accuracy and uniformity, and transverse comparison can be carried out between different distributed databases.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORP;CCB FINTECH CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional simulation system based on karst water and soil coupling effect that sinks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional simulation system based on karst collapse water-soil coupling effect, which relates to the field of information processing and solves the technical problem that the karst collapse simulation data is low in precision, and the adopted technical scheme is as follows: a three-dimensional simulation system based on karst collapse water-soil coupling effect comprises a central processing unit, a data processing module, an action command identification module, a man-machine operation module, a karst collapse detection module, an alarm display module, a remote wireless communication interface and a three-dimensional simulation module. The invention carries out centralized processing on various parameters in karst collapse based on big data analysis technology, and the system platform adopts advanced computer network technology, database technology, geographic information system and information three-dimensional visualization technology to establish a data structure suitable for a karst collapse space hierarchy system and a three-dimensional simulation system structure convenient for continuous updating and development, thereby greatly improving the precision of karst collapse simulation data and providing scientific basis for disaster prevention and relief commands.

title_en: Multi-scene control switch
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-scene control switch, relates to the switch correlation field, including the switch seat, be equipped with control panel on the switch seat, be equipped with scene control system among the control panel, be equipped with central data processor, wireless transmission module, removal end APP, intelligent trigger module, light switch module, fire alarm ware, door and window sensor, calamity alarm ware and pronunciation receiving and releasing unit among the scene control system, be equipped with conflagration trigger unit among the intelligent trigger module, break through trigger unit and natural disasters trigger unit, through opening and closing of indoor light is controlled to pronunciation trigger unit to adjust into different modes, such as film mode, bright mode etc. the homeowner can also pass through intelligent environment simulation unit sets up different light effects manually to save and become a mode, the cooperation intelligent trigger module is in order to deal with multiple life condition, has strengthened the suitability of switch greatly.
assignees: HANGZHOU RONGTAI INTERNET OF THINGS DEV CO LTD

title_en: Novel screw pile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel screw pile, including hollow drill bit body, the drill bit body lower extreme is equipped with drill bit point and discharge opening, and the drill bit body periphery sets up the external screw thread, and the drill bit body periphery is equipped with the location structure who fixes a position with the rig cooperation to cause the screw pile to squeeze into soil through the rotation, location structure is two at least, and two location structures are arranged according to dividing along drill bit body circumference, and this location structure is located drill bit upper portion, every location structure is the nut, the nut includes the screw hole, nut and drill bit lateral wall fixed connection, the utility model discloses be provided with the upper portion of screw pile can with the nut and the screw hole of rig cooperation location, not only can make things convenient for the construction operation more, make the screw pile squeeze into soil through the rotation in, can pass the screw hole through the bolt again and fix installation main part and screw pile, change the regulation, the precision improves, and the assembly is nimble simple and convenient, and work efficiency height, and the tightness improves, resists natural disasters ability and cost reduction.

title_en: Method, device, terminal and storage medium for synthesizing microscopic data of community resident population
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a terminal and a storage medium for synthesizing community resident population microscopic data. The prediction of urban community scale population socioeconomic performance information is realized, data information support is provided for application scenes such as public facilities site selection, traffic simulation, disaster prevention resource allocation and the like, and the promotion of urban fine treatment is promoted.

title_en: Simulation deduction method and system for urban infrastructure multi-disaster species-chain coupling accident
abstract_en: The application discloses a simulation deduction method and a system for urban infrastructure multi-disaster species-chain coupling accident, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on a pre-constructed urban infrastructure typical accident simulation deduction knowledge base, forming a chain generation coupling accident evolution diagram through node association; monitoring target infrastructure actually running in service in a city in real time, and acquiring real-time Internet of things monitoring data and emergency treatment condition feedback; therefore, at the corresponding node of the evolution path of the chain coupling accident evolution diagram, the consequence state of the corresponding node event is output in the library; simulation and scenario deduction of the whole process of the urban infrastructure multi-disaster chain coupling accident are continuously promoted until a subsequent event cannot be triggered, and a complete accident evolution path and corresponding probability and consequence evaluation information are output. Therefore, the technical problems that simulation precision and difficulty in large-scale popularization and application cannot be considered in the related technology, and effective infrastructure accident simulation and evaluation are difficult to achieve are solved.

title_en: Numerical simulation and evaluation method for water intake entrainment mechanism of offshore power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of infrastructure of water intake projects of coastal power plants, in particular to a numerical simulation and evaluation method of a water intake entrainment mechanism of an offshore power plant, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining marine organisms and marine garbage types corresponding to water intaking entrainment disasters of an offshore power plant, utilizing the marine organisms and the marine garbage types as characteristic disaster causing objects, evaluating according to the quantity of control mass points entering a water intaking open drain door of the offshore power plant and the quantity of surface area mass points entering the water intaking open drain door of the offshore power plant to obtain an optimal anti-entrainment water intaking scheme of the offshore power plant, researching hydraulic characteristics of the disaster causing objects by adopting an indoor water tank experiment, judging the water following movement characteristics of the disaster causing objects, and effectively judging high risk positions and ranges of the disaster causing objects which are easy to cause entrainment disasters aiming at local proliferation type disaster causing objects.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Portable emergency evacuation signal device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of fire rescue site and daily training auxiliary machinery, in particular to a portable emergency evacuation signal device; the signal box is a cavity body with a sealing cover arranged at the top, the sealing cover and the cavity body are connected through a lock catch, a strap hook is arranged on the side wall of the signal box, a storage battery accommodating groove is arranged in the cavity body, an air pump accommodating groove and a high-pitch air horn accommodating groove are arranged in the storage battery accommodating groove, an air pump is arranged in the air pump accommodating groove, a high-pitch air horn is arranged in the high-pitch air horn accommodating groove, a controller is arranged on the inner side wall of the signal box, the controller is connected with a control switch arranged on the outer side wall of the signal box, the air pump is electrically connected with the storage battery, the air pump and the storage battery are both electrically connected with the controller, the air inlet end of the air pump is connected with an air inlet pipeline, the air outlet end is connected with the high-pitch air horn through an air outlet pipeline, and the air outlet of the high-pitch air horn extends out of the side wall of the signal box; is convenient to carry and can generate loud alarm sound.

title_en: Micro-seismic sensor device for monitoring mine geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a microseism sensor device for monitoring of mine geological disasters of seismic detection equipment technical field, include body, cable, accomodate cover, communicating pipe, handle, cable-penetrating hole, communications stack, drive unit, holding pin, be equipped with an down tube on the down tube. Through setting up a plurality of bracers, when the bracer is driven its radial outside towards accomodating the cover by drive unit, can make the bracer prop tightly in the drilling outside, and then install accomodating the cover, when dismantling the body, drive unit drive bracer reverse swing, make the bracer can cancel to support the state tight in the drilling, and then be convenient for will accomodate cover and body and smoothly take out from drilling, through setting up the fastening pin, the communications between arm and inclined can drive the fastening pin and remove when the swing, make the fastening pin support the outer wall of body tightly, and then support the body firmly tightly and install in accomodating the cover, avoid in the use, the body produces not hard up phenomenon, and then produce the influence to detecting the precision.
assignees: ZHUMEI EARTHQUAKE SUPPORT TECH YANTAI CO LTD

title_en: Fire alarm demonstration training device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire alarm demonstration training set, including box, lifter plate, show board, guide bar, lead screw and motor. According to the scheme, the supporting rods are clamped with the limiting grooves to well support the cover plate, and fire-fighting equipment can be prevented from being displayed on the cover plate; the display board can be moved out and stored by controlling the forward and reverse rotation of the motor through the control panel, and the firefighting equipment on the display board can be subjected to dustproof protection after the cover plate is covered; when simulating fire alarm, press the fire alarm button, conflagration audible-visual annunciator sends out the police dispatch newspaper, and the warning escapes, and fire control emergency lighting device and evacuation indicator lamp start can guide the conflagration route of fleing to can audio-visually show fire alarm equipment how to move and operate. The utility model relates to a fire safety equipment technical field specifically provides a fire alarm demonstration training set.
assignees: SHANDONG BROTHER FIRE SAFETY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation calculation model suitable for typical ground facility failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation calculation model suitable for typical ground facility failure, which is characterized in that a target is divided into a plurality of levels of sub-targets according to the characteristics of the target, a judgment matrix of a hierarchical structure model is constructed from top to bottom by adopting an improved analytic hierarchy process, the weight of the sub-targets of the same level and the same type to the sub-target of the upper layer is calculated, the damage results of disasters obtained by theoretical analysis, numerical simulation and supplementary test, which are acted on the sub-targets, are combined to determine the final damage effect of the sub-targets, the damage effect is evaluated according to a damage criterion, and the overall damage effect of the target is calculated by adopting a comprehensive judgment process. The method has the advantages of capability of accurately and efficiently calculating the overall damage effect of the target, small calculation amount and the like; the method can be used for evaluating the overall damage effect of the target under the action of a single disaster, can also be used for evaluating the damage effect of the target under the coupling action of multiple disasters, and realizes accurate and efficient evaluation and calculation of the overall damage effect of the complex target under the action of single and multiple disasters.
assignees: SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ENG DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery drilling data optimization and early warning method based on data warehouse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed disaster recovery drilling data optimization and early warning method based on a data warehouse, which comprises the following steps: deploying a real-time data warehouse based on an iceberg data lake technology in a central server, performing online and offline management on data in a Flink and Spark stream data form, and calculating the occupancy rate of a process pool in real time; the distributed training central early warning model preferentially carries out cross-local privacy disaster recovery drilling data operation when the occupancy rate of the process pool is lower than a set value, so that real-time tracking capture of memory abnormity and early warning based on the central early warning model are realized; and submitting the training results of the models of all the places to a central server to update a headquarter drilling result database, storing the drilling result after each training and storing the privacy data into a real-time data warehouse. The invention can effectively overcome the problem of model deviation and reduce the calculation complexity.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for predicting short-term flood events of drainage basin and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting a short-term flood event of a drainage basin and terminal equipment, wherein the prediction method comprises the following steps: collecting observation station data for downloading water circulation key variables, wherein the water circulation key variables comprise rainfall, evapotranspiration and runoff; acquiring rainfall data, evapotranspiration data and interpolated runoff data in a research period; adopting a super-threshold sampling technology to identify the runoff data; performing regression simulation on the runoff of the flood occurring time period based on the hydrological model and the deep learning model; verifying the model precision by adopting a leave-one-out cross verification method; and respectively comparing the accuracy of the verification set of the verification model by adopting the Klin-ancient-Tower efficiency index and the Nash correlation coefficient, and selecting the optimal model result as the simulation result of the watershed flood event. According to the method, the multi-model is used for simulating the flood incidents of the drainage basin, the optimal prediction results are compared, and technical support is provided for the early warning research of the flood disaster forecast of the drainage basin.

title_en: Multi-source multi-layer data fusion method applied to crop phenotype parameter inversion
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source multi-layer data fusion method applied to crop phenotype parameter inversion, which comprises the following specific steps of extracting characteristic information of crop leaf and canopy dimensions by utilizing hyperspectral data to construct a characteristic vector for subsequent fusion modeling; the invention extracts the characteristic vector from the information obtained by different sensors, applies a three-layer improved fusion method, substitutes the data into different machine learning algorithms for training and verification, and finally outputs the final result by using an integrated learning algorithm, thereby not only ensuring the accuracy, but also preventing overfitting, greatly improving the stability and precision of crop phenotype parameter monitoring and diagnosis, providing agricultural condition monitoring service for farmers, and providing technical support for disaster prevention and control and production cultivation of crops.

title_en: Urban network toughness assessment method and system considering sudden disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city network toughness assessment method and system considering sudden disaster influence, belonging to the technical field of regional space toughness analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a physical network and a functional network to form an urban network; calculating the element flow intensity carried by cities and road sections in the urban network before disaster; superposing the space distribution data of the sudden disasters on the urban network, and calculating the element flow intensity borne by cities and road sections in the urban network at the time of the disasters; and (5) evaluating the structural toughness and the functional toughness of the urban network before and at the time of disaster, and calculating to obtain the comprehensive toughness of the urban network. The method can simulate the stepwise change process of the urban network from the pre-disaster to the disaster, identify the road sections interrupted by the disaster and the cities with functional failures, respectively calculate the structural toughness and the functional toughness of the urban network before the disaster and at the disaster, fill the blank of urban network toughness evaluation research oriented to sudden disasters, and have guiding significance for urban network development planning in areas such as urban groups, urban rings and the like.

title_en: Mine multi-disaster linkage simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster simulation, in particular to a mine multi-disaster linkage simulation system and method. The system comprises a master control end and an analog end, wherein the master control end is connected with the analog end through a network, and the master control end comprises a type selection module and an analog control module; the type selection module is used for selecting disaster types and initiating disaster simulation; the simulation control module is preset with disaster parameters of different disaster types and used for sending control instructions corresponding to the disaster parameters to the simulation end according to the selected disaster types, wherein the disaster parameters comprise disaster scenes and environment parameters; the simulation end comprises an environment simulation module and a parameter simulation module; the environment simulation module is used for simulating a disaster scene according to the control command; and the parameter simulation module is used for displaying and alarming the environmental parameters according to the control instruction. The simulation system can simulate various mine disasters, so that trainees can really feel the scene of the disasters.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Test device and test method for simulating landslide caused by river dynamic erosion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a test method for simulating river dynamic erosion to cause landslide, wherein the test device comprises a water source supply device, a simulated slope scouring device and a monitoring device, wherein the water source supply device comprises a reservoir and a water injection tank; the water injection tank is communicated with the reservoir through a water passing pipeline, and the analog slope scouring device is arranged on one side of the reservoir; the simulated slope scouring device comprises a slope model and a water tank; the slope model is placed in the water tank; the bottom of the water tank is provided with a water filling port and a water outlet; the water filling port is connected with the water filling tank through a water passing pipeline; the water outlet is communicated to the reservoir through a pipeline; the water tank is arranged on the water tank base; the monitoring device is arranged on the slope model; the dynamic erosion early warning method can effectively simulate the movement process of slope deformation and damage after the dynamic erosion of the river, determine the soil condition and the hydrodynamic condition of disasters such as landslide and debris flow under the dynamic erosion of the river, and provide the early warning threshold of the landslide and debris flow disasters caused by the dynamic erosion of the river, thereby being beneficial to the prevention of the geological disasters.

title_en: Coal mining process roof separation layer water filling source simulation device and experiment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a roof separation layer water filling water source simulation device and an experimental method in a coal mining process, belonging to the technical field of physical simulation of similar materials of water inrush disasters of coal mines, and comprising similar materials of aquifers and a water supply assembly; the aquifer similar material is rectangular; the water supply assembly is embedded in the similar material of the aquifer and comprises a water inlet pipe, a water outlet pipe, a branch water supply pipe and a branch pipe head; the branch water supply pipes are arranged at equal intervals, and the strength of the branch water supply pipes is lower than that of similar materials of the aquifer; the two branch pipe heads are respectively arranged at the two ends of the branch water supply pipe, and the two ends of each branch water supply pipe are respectively connected with the branch pipe heads in a sealing way; the water inlet pipe and the water outlet pipe are respectively connected with the two branch pipe heads in a sealing way, and the water inlet pipe and the water outlet pipe extend out of the similar materials of the aquifer. After the roof separation space is formed, the invention can realize automatic water filling of the space to simulate water source convergence, and the condition that the water source leaks through other ways can not happen.

title_en: Agricultural disaster information remote sensing extraction loss evaluation method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural disaster information remote sensing extraction loss assessment method based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of crop disaster situation assessment. The invention comprises the following steps: shooting remote sensing images of crops in a plurality of areas before and after a disaster; acquiring an NDVI interpolation graph before and after a disaster, extracting disaster features of the interpolation graph and training a disaster identification module; carrying out remote sensing image acquisition on crops, and determining a crop area to be investigated; the method comprises the steps of inputting a crop area to be investigated into a disaster recognition module, outputting a predicted disaster trend by the disaster recognition module, and evaluating the grade of the disaster on remote sensing image data.

title_en: Determination method of landslide surge equivalent calculation parameters under action of earthquake power
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining landslide and surge equivalent calculation parameters under the action of earthquake power, which establishes a corresponding relation from an original parameter to an equivalent parameter based on an equivalent relation between landslide limit balance states corresponding to the action of earthquake power and the action of no earthquake power so as to determine the landslide and surge equivalent calculation parameters under the action of earthquake power. The method has the advantages that the earthquake power action is equivalent to weakening of mechanical parameters, the flow is simple, the operability is high, the problem that the earthquake power action is difficult to apply in the existing landslide surge numerical simulation process can be effectively solved, and then the surge disaster condition under the earthquake power action can be effectively prevented.

title_en: Method for constructing morphology parameter prediction model and morphology parameter measurement method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for constructing a morphology parameter prediction model and a method for measuring morphology parameters, wherein the construction method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a measurement spectrum and morphology parameters of each standard design structure on a plurality of standard sample pieces, conducting wavelength separation sampling on each measurement spectrum to obtain a plurality of isolated sampling spectra, constructing a first model based on each isolated sampling spectrum and corresponding actual morphology parameters, constructing a second model based on predicted morphology parameters and actual morphology parameters output by the first model, constructing a morphology parameter prediction model by the first model and the second model, and predicting the morphology parameters of the sample pieces to be tested based on the prediction model. The method disclosed by the invention applies the traditional machine learning model to the field of optical precision measurement, and completes the optimization of the prediction model by processing and expanding samples for wavelength splitting of measured spectrum data, thereby effectively preventing overfitting in the training process, avoiding dimension disaster and effectively improving the robustness of the structure parameters calculated by the spectrum.
assignees: SHANGHAI PRECISION MEASUREMENT SEMICONDUCTOR TECH INC

title_en: Dynamic and static coupling multifunctional model test system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of model tests and discloses a dynamic and static coupling multifunctional model test system which comprises a counter-force bearing subsystem, a dynamic and static loading subsystem, a variable stiffness fault activation subsystem and a high-precision monitoring subsystem. The device can carry out true triaxial model boundary energy storage and dynamic and static loading, instantaneous bidirectional fault activation, multi-parameter data parallel acquisition and real-time fusion through dynamic and static partition, energy storage loading, variable stiffness supporting, bidirectional sliding and monitoring analysis, and realizes efficient real simulation of fault sliding. And equipment support is provided for researching various underground engineering disaster occurrence mechanisms under dynamic and static coupling loads.

title_en: System for rapidly detecting state information of underground trapped personnel due to mine disaster and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine safety, in particular to a system and a method for quickly detecting state information of underground trapped personnel in a mine disaster; the system comprises the existing communication optical cable arranged under the coal mine, and also comprises an optical fiber junction box, an optical fiber distributed acoustic sensing system, a measurement and control and data processing system, a display screen and a sound recovery system; the invention applies the high-performance optical fiber distributed acoustic wave sensing technology and the wavelet denoising algorithm to the rapid detection and positioning of the state information of the underground trapped personnel caused by mine disasters, in the detection system, only the optical cable is arranged under the mine, but the optical cable is a passive device, so that the optical cable cannot fail due to disasters or secondary disasters, the communication optical cable can be directly laid under the existing coal mine under the condition of not drilling life rescue holes, the rapid detection of a metric-grade high-spatial resolution, high sensitivity and full-coverage disaster area is realized, and the trapped personnel and the moving situation in the disaster area can be detected and positioned in real time.

title_en: Geological disaster risk evaluation method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a machine learning-based geological disaster risk evaluation method, which comprises the following steps of S1, selecting an area to be evaluated and acquiring a geological disaster risk evaluation factor; s2, preprocessing each geological disaster risk evaluation factor data of the area to be evaluated; s3, selecting a historical geological disaster point as a positive sample, determining a buffer area of the positive sample, selecting a negative sample outside the buffer area, and constructing a sample set; s4, modeling by using various algorithms, and selecting a training model according to the evaluation index of the performance of each model; and S5, predicting the area to be evaluated, making a predicted success rate curve, and evaluating the area to be detected according to the slope of the success rate curve. According to the method, the spatial distribution is determined by carrying out statistical analysis on the positive samples, the sampling spatial range of the negative samples is guaranteed, and the accuracy of the geological disaster risk evaluation is improved by selecting the prediction model through multi-model multi-index evaluation.
assignees: SHAANXI SATELLITE APPLICATION TECH CENTER OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Coal mine tunnel fault sliding rock burst simulation test system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of coal mine model tests, provides a fault sliding type rock burst simulation test system for a coal mine tunnel, and solves the problem that the existing model test equipment cannot meet fault sliding type rock burst simulation. The system can realize real simulation of fault sliding rock burst and accurate capture of precursor information through a gas-liquid composite loading device, a superposition loading device, a fault locking device, a fault activating device, a double-layer mechanical antifriction device and a three-dimensional fault sliding monitoring device. The technical scheme includes that the method comprises the steps of applying ground stress of a model body in different directions, enabling upper disc segments and lower disc segments of faults to slide, judging whether the faults slide according to data monitored by a high-precision monitoring module, and starting a fault activation actuating device if the faults do not slide, and applying cyclic dynamic load to the model body until the faults slide and a roadway is subjected to rock burst. The invention provides a scientific instrument and a research platform for revealing the fault slip type rock burst generation mechanism of the coal mine tunnel and establishing a disaster early warning prevention and control system.

title_en: Rapid identification method for high-steep slope dangerous rock mass based on unmanned plane LiDAR simulated ground flight
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid identification method of high-steep slope dangerous rock mass based on unmanned aerial vehicle LiDAR simulated ground flight, which comprises the steps of carrying out measurement flight operation on a target slope area through an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a camera and a LiDAR system, establishing a DOM image model of a slope to filter calculated LiDAR point cloud data, combining point cloud perspective projection of the DOM image to carry out primary interpretation and identification of a disaster mass, extracting typical geometric features corresponding to roughness index, gradient index and structural surface attitude information on the basis of the ground point cloud after filtering treatment, superposing the geometric features on the corresponding slope DOM image, and identifying the dangerous rock mass in a man-machine interaction mode through obtaining the slope DOM image of a rock slope and key geometric feature parameters based on the point cloud model. The roughness index and the gradient index are introduced to reduce the recognition difficulty, so that the recognition of dangerous rock mass by man-machine interaction is facilitated, and the accuracy and the efficiency of recognizing the dangerous rock mass are improved.

title_en: Resistivity-based water seepage rock mass electrical anisotropy numerical simulation method
