abstract_en: The invention provides a resistivity-based method for simulating the electrical anisotropy numerical value of a water seepage rock mass, which comprises the following steps: performing rock mass exploration on the water seepage rock mass to obtain a water seepage rock mass model, and setting a resistivity monitoring point based on the water seepage rock mass model to obtain the resistivity of the resistivity monitoring point; determining an electrical anisotropy value of the water seepage rock mass model based on the resistivity monitoring point and the resistivity; determining the structural characteristics of each water seepage rock mass based on the water seepage rock mass model, and determining the relationship between the electrical anisotropy and the structural characteristics by using a numerical simulation method; the correlation degree between the structural characteristics of the water seepage rock mass model and the electric anisotropy value is determined, the structure of the water seepage rock mass can be predicted after the electric anisotropy value is determined, and the water seepage rock mass can be timely responded according to the prediction result, so that disasters are avoided.

title_en: Transformer fault diagnosis method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transformer fault diagnosis method, a transformer fault diagnosis device and a storage medium. The method adopts the mixed mutual information method to select the characteristic attribute with stronger correlation with the transformer fault from the attributes, and obtains the labeled training sample set and the unlabeled training sample set for training the mapping relation between the transformer fault type and the characteristic attribute according to the selected characteristic attribute, wherein the dimensionality of the samples in the labeled training sample set and the unlabeled training sample set is greatly reduced, and the dimensionality disaster is avoided. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a label training sample set and a label-free training sample set, performing semi-supervised collaborative training to obtain two classifiers containing mapping relations between label values and characteristic attributes, inputting data of a transformer to be analyzed to the two classifiers obtained finally, and obtaining a failure analysis result according to classification mean values generated by the two classifiers.

title_en: Anchoring device for preventing landslide geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of printing machine rollers, in particular to an anchoring device for preventing landslide geological disasters, which comprises an anchoring pipe, wherein a plurality of transverse threaded holes are formed in the side wall of the lower end of the anchoring pipe in a surrounding manner by using the circle center; according to the invention, the anchoring assembly is adopted to cooperate with the guide pipe, the threaded pipe, the universal connecting rod set, the threaded connecting rod, the anchoring rod and the drill bit to realize that the threaded pipe is positioned in the guide pipe to rotate, so that the universal connecting rod set is driven to rotate, further the anchoring rod and the drill bit are rotated, and the anchoring rod is in threaded connection with the threaded hole in the inner wall of the anchoring pipe to realize that the drill bit is rotationally pushed, so that the length of the anchoring rod can be flexibly adjusted, the gripping force in the slope surface of the anchoring rod is increased, the stability of the anchoring device is ensured, and the problems that the anchoring pipe is extruded from the anchoring hole due to slow displacement of a landslide and the anchoring effect is invalid are avoided.

title_en: Data center disaster tolerance processing system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a data center disaster tolerance processing system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises a disaster tolerance emergency network, a disaster tolerance simulation subsystem, a disaster tolerance coordination subsystem and a disaster tolerance execution subsystem; the disaster recovery emergency network comprises a main sharing terminal, a standby data center and a main data center; the main data center is provided with a main data storage area and a mirror image storage area; the mirror image storage area is used for storing the mirror image of the data in the main data storage area and generating a duty data packet to be sent to the main sharing terminal; the disaster recovery simulation subsystem is used for simulating disaster transmission conditions; the disaster recovery coordination subsystem is used for coordinating backup and deletion of data; the disaster recovery execution subsystem is used for executing the transmission of data among the storage areas. Compared with the prior art, the mirror image data packet is established in the main data center, the real-time situation of the main sharing terminal is obtained through simulation, when disaster tolerance occurs, a corresponding strategy can be formulated to send out data in an optimal mode, and loss of data in the disaster tolerance process is reduced.
assignees: LIANTONG GUANGDONG IND INTERNET CO LTD

title_en: Deep-buried coal seam gas disaster treatment is with adopting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an extraction device for treating gas disasters of deep-buried coal seams, which comprises a supporting base, wherein a drilling hole collecting device is arranged on the supporting base; the borehole collection device includes: the device comprises a fixed support, a square fixed frame, a driven wheel, a round frame, a first transmission belt, a belt wheel, an auxiliary wheel, a transmission wheel, a second transmission belt, a driving motor, a rotary fixer, a telescopic rotating shaft, a driven bevel gear, a drill bit, a driving bevel gear and a pumping assembly; the utility model relates to a gas drainage technical field, the beneficial effect of present case is: through drilling collection device, it is single to have solved general functionality, only a very function, and is difficult for relatively changing, does not generally have collection device, and the gas of taking out is difficult to utilize, and most directly discharges, causes the damage to the environment, is chain drive mostly, and the structure is complicated, needs some accessories, and the cost is higher, the scheduling problem breaks down easily in the course of the work.
assignees: TAIAN LITUO DRILLING ENG CO LTD

title_en: Incident response simulation and learning system
abstract_en: A method of simulating an emergency response training scenario to users in different locations, including customizing a scenario, initiating a game state having a threat level and a time remaining, assigning a role to each of a plurality of users wherein each of the users uses a device, assigning digital assets within the scenario to each of the users, displaying an introduction sequence, initiating an incident and simultaneously notifying a first group of at least two users, logging and scoring a chosen response from the possible responses compared to a scoring system, updating the game state whereby the threat level is raised or lowered and the time remaining is increased or decreased, triggering another event to at least two of the plurality of users, and communicating a score calculated in the logging and scoring step to at least one user on one of the at least one client device.

title_en: Hydropower station monitoring alarm event intelligent identification method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station monitoring alarm event intelligent recognition method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of collecting hydropower station monitoring historical data, cleaning the hydropower station monitoring historical data to obtain a pure data set, constructing a user dictionary and a stop word list according to alarm information, performing word segmentation, stop word removal and word stem processing on the data set based on the user dictionary and the stop word list, and training by utilizing a natural language processing technology to obtain word vectors of all linguistic data; and formulating a knowledge rule, constructing an event sample library, inputting the event sample library into a bidirectional long-short term memory network classification model for training to obtain a deep learning model capable of finishing autonomous intelligent identification of the alarm event, wherein the output of the model is an event identification result. The invention can realize automatic intelligent judgment of accident second level, reduce the safety risk of dispatching connection, reduce the probability of missed judgment or misjudgment of fault alarm signals, improve the emergency response speed and improve the safety dispatching level of a centralized control center and the automation and intelligence level of a supporting system thereof.
assignees: YALONG RIVER HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Real-time calculation method for displacement of key node of fire collapse early warning of single-layer factory building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time calculation method for displacement of a fire collapse early warning key node of a single-layer factory building, which comprises the following steps: establishing a numerical model of a single-layer factory building; acquiring single-layer factory building fire response data of the whole fire process through numerical simulation; analyzing to obtain time-course curves of all key node displacements and time-course curves of all component temperatures in the whole fire disaster process, and constructing a data set; constructing and training a deep learning agent model based on a cyclic neural network and a fully-connected neural network; and when a fire disaster occurs, a final agent model obtained through training is applied to obtain a real-time course curve of the displacement of the key node which is difficult to measure. Compared with the prior art, the method can rapidly calculate the key node displacement data which is difficult to directly measure for the single-layer factory building in the actual fire scene and is directly related to the collapse state, and breaks through the challenges that the key node displacement data is difficult to directly measure in the fire scene in the building fire collapse early warning theory and method.

title_en: Full-automatic telescopic sensor arrangement device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-automatic telescopic sensor arrangement device and a method, wherein the device comprises a cylindrical fixed shell, an opening at one end of the cylindrical fixed shell is connected with a baffle, a telescopic rod is arranged on the inner surface of the baffle and extends into the cylindrical fixed shell, and a pressure sensor is arranged on the telescopic rod; the outer edge of the baffle is provided with a controller for controlling the telescopic rod to change the length; the cylindrical fixed shell can be placed in a drill hole along the axis direction, the length of the telescopic rod is controlled by the controller, a sensor placed in the cylindrical fixed shell and at the top of the telescopic rod is jacked into the deep part of the drill hole, and the controller is configured to stop acting when the detection value of the pressure sensor reaches a set value. The method can be used for quickly arranging the sensors in the underground engineering construction process such as tunnel construction and the like, collecting the geomechanical information in the surrounding rock, researching the mechanics, collapse and surrounding rock deformation rules in the construction process, and is favorable for safe construction and disaster early warning of actual engineering.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster cooperative attack and defense countermeasure decision-making method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cooperative attack and defense countermeasure decision-making method for an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and solves the problem of dimension disaster when a large-scale unmanned aerial vehicle cluster attacks and defends against an enemy unmanned aerial vehicle in the prior art, and the problem of poor convergence effect and poor generalization capability. The unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is divided into a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicle groups, an unmanned aerial vehicle working space is established based on a bionic hunting mechanism, and a diversified rewarding function in an unmanned aerial vehicle attack and defense countermeasure task is added; training a policy network of a smaller-scale unmanned panel. The invention can avoid the problem of dimension disaster caused by direct training of large-scale unmanned aerial vehicle clusters, and improve the expansibility of the number of clusters and the success rate of attack and defense countermeasure tasks.

title_en: Water jet cutting method of parallel layer directional plane slot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water jet cutting method of a bedding directional plane slot, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine disasters. The method comprises the following steps: calculating and determining the width and the number of each segment cutting unit; calculating and determining the working pressure of the water jet cut by each section; constructing bedding drilling holes in a coal seam roadway; adjusting the direction of a water jet nozzle of the slotting device to a set direction; starting a high-pressure pump to form high-pressure water jet, and regulating the pressure to a set pressure value; dragging the drill rod to move outwards for a distance, and horizontally moving the water jet in the drill hole to cut the coal body to form a slot with depth; regulating the pressure of the high-pressure pump, opening a water outlet at the front end of the slotting machine, rotating the drill rod to drill holes and remove slag, and gradually pushing the drill rod to an initial cutting position; repeating the steps for n times until the cutting depth reaches the design value. The invention solves the problems of hole blocking and drill sticking in the implementation process of directional planar slot cutting by the conventional lancing method, and increases the cutting success rate of the parallel directional planar slot and the effective pressure relief range of drilling.

title_en: Reconnaissance system with road side slope geological disaster warning function
abstract_en: The application discloses reconnaissance system who possesses road slope geological disasters warning relates to road reconnaissance technical field, which comprises a housing, the top fixed mounting of casing has the warning sign, the inner wall middle-end fixed mounting of casing has first motor, the output fixed mounting of first motor has the reconnaissance drill bit, the inner wall both sides fixed mounting of casing has the second motor. Through being provided with the warning sign in the top of casing, can provide the effect of warning at the in-process that the casing realized the reconnaissance, avoid vehicle and non-staff to miss the construction site, lead to possibly causing the emergence of incident, and when reconnaissance is carried out in the position of road side slope, because the road unevenness, can lead to the stability of reconnaissance and accuracy relatively poor, adjust the position of stabilizer blade, can insert the road through landing leg and the stabilizer blade that can freely adjust, guarantee the stability of casing at the in-process of reconnaissance, utilize the warning sign to realize the effect of warning simultaneously.
assignees: ZHUHAI COMMUNICATION SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Simulation device for effect of various geological disasters of embankment model
abstract_en: The application discloses a simulation device for various geological disaster actions of a embankment model. The simulation device comprises a test box, a debris flow torrent simulation mechanism, an earthquake simulation mechanism and a test and test mechanism; a embankment model is placed in the test box, and the test box is fixed on the earthquake simulation mechanism; the debris flow mountain torrent mechanism comprises a material box, a water inlet trough, a water outlet trough, a soil and water collecting box and a hydraulic lifting cylinder, wherein the material box is connected with the water inlet trough, the hydraulic lifting cylinder is arranged at the bottoms of the material box and the water inlet trough, the angles of the water trough are adjusted through different oil inlet amounts, the water inlet trough and the water outlet trough are connected with a model test box, and the water outlet trough is connected with the soil and water collecting box; the earthquake simulation system comprises a table top, a slide rail layer and a base layer, wherein the slide rail adopts an I-shaped slide rail and is connected with the base layer through an oil cylinder; the test system comprises an accelerometer, a soil pressure box, a pore pressure meter, a moisture sensor, a flow rate meter, a displacement meter and photographic equipment. The device controls the earthquake type by simulating the actual earthquake action, collects the model parameters after the earthquake, can simulate the influence of secondary disasters after the earthquake on the embankment structure, and explores the stabilizing effect of the embankment structure under the combined action of different geological disaster working conditions.

title_en: Early warning method, system, medium and equipment for hidden danger of flood break of constructed lake
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning, and particularly relates to a method, a system, a medium and equipment for early warning hidden dangers of overflowing and dam break of a constructed lake. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, obtaining a remote sensing image of each preset construction lake on a plateau; step 2, analyzing and processing each lake remote sensing image with a preset structure, and screening out at least one target structure lake with a disaster condition; step 3, determining the type of the climate zone of any target construction lake; step 4, determining the simulated annual predicted water volume increment of the target construction lake based on the type; and 5, determining the overflow dam break probability of the target construction lake based on the predicted water volume increment in the simulated year, and generating early warning information according to the overflow dam break probability. The invention can achieve the effect of comprehensively giving out early warning information by combining complex conditions such as environmental geology, climate change and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING;AERO GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY AND REMOTE SENSING CENTER FOR NATURAL RESOURCES OF CHINA

title_en: Tunnel face collapse risk level assessment and prevention method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating and preventing collapse risk level of tunnel face, which is characterized in that 'prevention' is realized by fully considering multi-source geological information such as ground stress, lithology, rock integrity, underground water, structure and the like, the collapse risk level can be initially evaluated in a reconnaissance stage through analysis of the information, the initial evaluation result can be corrected according to the deformation conditions of geophysical prospecting, drilling and surrounding rock due to more information grasped in a construction link, corresponding construction and supporting measures are selected according to the collapse risk level evaluation results in the reconnaissance and construction stage, the probability of collapse disaster can be reduced to the lowest possible, and even if collapse occurs after certain measures are taken, the collapse risk level can be processed with the minimum cost, so that the cost can be saved to the greatest extent, and the safety is ensured.

title_en: Method, device, and program that use artificial intelligence to estimate information required for evacuation action in event of tsunami disaster
abstract_en: To provide a method, a device, and a program for estimating information required by a person who need support in an event of a tsunami disaster to take an evacuation action in an event of the tsunami disaster.SOLUTION: A machine learning method comprises a learning step in which an evacuation unit learns a machine learning model for estimating information required for evacuation behavior in an event of a tsunami disaster, based on learning data 4 which includes data on a human element of an evacuation unit and data on a geographical element of a tsunami evacuation drill, while the learning data 4 relates to a past tsunami evacuation drill in which the evacuation unit is a person who requires support 99 when the disaster occurs and a support person who supports the evacuation behavior of the person who requires support 99.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Hybrid Motion Capture Position Switching Method for Virtual Fire Drill
title_ko: 가상 소방훈련을 위한 하이브리드 모션 캡쳐 위치 전환 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hybrid motion capture position switching method in a hybrid motion capture system, which adjusts the size and ratio between an actual human body and a human body model, and when optical position tracking fails, switches to a motion sensor-based position tracking to continuously track the position of the human body. The hybrid motion capture position switching method according to the present invention, which takes a picture of a marker attached to a rigid body worn on a human's head through optical position measurement to detect position movement, analyzes a signal of a plurality of motion sensors attached to the human body through sensor-based motion capture to detect the movement of the human body, and merges the detected position information and movement information of the human body to realize a human body model in a virtual space, comprises: a step of calibrating the size and ratio of the human body model to the actual human body size by using Z-axis position information of the rigid body detected through the marker; and a step of, in a case that the position of the human body cannot be tracked through the optical position tracking, tracking the position shift of the human body through lower limb joint walking by using motion sensor data acquired through sensor-type motion capture through positioning switch to realize the position shift of the human body model. Accordingly, the present invention is provided to give body tracking constant continuity.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 하이브리드 모션 캡쳐 시스템에서 실제 인체 크기와 인체 모델 간의 크기 및 비율을 정합하고, 광학식 위치 추적이 실패할 경우 모션센서 방식의 위치 추적으로 전환하여 인체의 위치를 계속 추적할 수 있도록 하는 하이브리드 모션 캡쳐 위치 전환 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 하이브리드 모션 캡쳐 위치 전환 방법은 광학식 위치측정을 통하여 인체의 머리에 착용된 강체에 부착된 마커를 촬영하여 위치 이동을 파악하고, 센서식 모션캡쳐를 통해 인체에 부착된 복수의 모션센서의 신호를 분석하여 인체의 움직임을 파악하여, 파악되는 인체의 위치 정보와 움직임 정보를 융합하여 가상 공간의 인체 모델을 구현하는 하이브리드 모션캡쳐 방법에 있어서, 상기 마커를 통해 파악되는 강체의 Z축 위치정보를 이용하여 인체 모델의 크기 및 비율을 실제 인체 크기로 보정하는 단계와; 광학식 위치추적을 통해 인체의 위치를 추적할 수 없는 경우, 포지셔닝 전환을 통해 센서식 모션캡쳐를 통해 획득되는 모션센서 데이터를 이용하여 하지 관절 보행을 통해 인체의 위치 이동을 추적하여, 인체 모델의 위치 이동을 구현하는 단계;를 포함하여 이루어져, 인체 추적에 끊임없는 연속성을 부여할 수 있도록 제공된다.
assignees: CORESENSE CO LTD;UNIV JEONJU IND UNIV COOP

title_en: How to reduce the drill recalibration rate
title_ko: 드릴재보정율감소방법
abstract_en: The present invention has the following features. The present invention relates to a method for reducing a drill recompensation rate which comprises: a PTH guide processing step; a PTH guide recognition step of recognizing the PTH guide; an inner layer pad guide generation step of generating an inner layer pad guide by processing the inner layer pad after the PTH guide recognition step; and a guide resetting step of recognizing the inner layer pad guide and resetting the guide for processing a product. Therefore, the present invention is capable of reducing the drill recompensation rate.

title_en: Sense-based training space system for advanced fire fighting training system
title_ko: 첨단소방훈련체계를 위한 실감기반 훈련공간 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an experience-based training space system for an advanced firefighting training system, which combines a motion capture system combining optical motion capture equipment and sensor-type motion capture equipment with a technology of experiencing five senses, such as smell, vibration, and temperature, for an advanced firefighting training system. According to the present invention, the experience-based training space system provides a training space for firefighting and comprises: a training space experience device (100) installed in a space where firefighting drills are conducted to provide an experience-based training environment including lighting, sound, heat, smell, and vibration to trainees performing the firefighting drills; and a firefighting training server (200) controlling and managing operation of the training space experience device (100) and detecting and monitoring the location and motion of a trainee performing training in the training space experience device (100). Accordingly, the experience-based training space system for an advanced firefighting training system is provided to implement a fire situation realistically to increase firefighting drill efficiency.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 첨단소방훈련체게를 위해 광학식 모션 캡쳐 장비와 센서식 모션 캡쳐 장비를 융합한 모션 캡쳐 시스템과 냄새, 진동, 온도 등의 오감체험 기술을 결합한 첨단소방훈련체계를 위한 실감기반 훈련공간 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 실감기반 훈련공간 시스템은 소방 훈련을 위해 훈련 공간을 제공하는 시스템으로서, 소방 훈련을 실시하는 공간에 설치되어, 소방 훈련을 실시하는 훈련자에게 조명, 음향, 열기, 냄새, 진동을 포함하는 실감 기반의 훈련 환경을 제공하는 훈련공간 실감장치(100)와; 상기 훈련공간 실감장치(100)의 동작을 제어하고 관리하며, 훈련공간 실감장치(100)에서 훈련을 실시하는 훈련자의 위치 및 모션을 파악하여 모니터링 하는 소방훈련 서버(200);를 포함하여 이루어져, 화재 상황을 보다 현실감 있게 구현하여 소방 훈련 효율을 높일 수 있도록 제공된다.
assignees: CORESENSE CO LTD;UNIV JEONJU IND UNIV COOP

title_en: Hard shell inclusion stress meter and monitoring system for three-dimensional stress of underground engineering
abstract_en: The application relates to a hard shell inclusion stress gauge and monitoring system of three-dimensional stress of underground works, hard shell inclusion stress gauge includes: the elastic cylinder body is installed in a drilling hole of the underground engineering, and at least three groups of strain flowers are arranged on the inner wall of the cylinder body of the elastic cylinder body at equal intervals along the circumferential direction. The method can precisely measure the strain value and the variable of each group of strain flower through the data acquisition and transmission module, calculate the three-dimensional stress of the underground engineering, realize the dynamic long-term monitoring of the three-dimensional stress evolution process under the complex environment of the underground engineering, truly reflect the real-time state, the spatial distribution and the evolution process of the three-dimensional stress in the rock mass, provide in-situ basic data for the early warning and the control of engineering disasters, and solve the problem that the long-term dynamic monitoring of the three-dimensional stress can not be realized in the past.

title_en: Carbon-based portable mask for emergency disaster evacuation
title_ko: 긴급재난 대피용 휴대형 탄소기반 마스크
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable carbon-based mask for emergency evacuation. More particularly, the present invention relates to a portable carbon-based mask for emergency evacuation, which is made in the form of a mask often worn in everyday life so as to be worn without separate training, includes a nose wing and a chin wing for application of an adhesive at a part where the mask comes into contact with a face to increase the adhesiveness of the mask, and can completely prevent outside air from entering without passing through a filter unit. The mask comprises a discharge unit capable of discharging air exhaled by a wearer to the outside while the wearer is wearing the mask, thereby maintaining close contact between the wearer and the mask. The mask also includes a reflector on the upper part of the nose wing so that rescuers can easily find the mask wearer and the wearer can be rescued without making a special rescue request.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 긴급재난 대피용 휴대형 탄소기반 마스크에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 일상생활에서 자주 착용하는 마스크 형태로 제작되어 별도의 교육 없이도 착용할 수 있고, 코 날개와 턱 날개를 포함하여 마스크가 얼굴에 접촉되는 부위에 점착제를 도포하여 마스크의 접착성을 높이고 외기의 공기가 필터부를 통하지 않고 유입되는 것을 완벽하게 방지할 수 있으며, 마스크를 착용한 상태에서 착용자가 내쉬는 공기를 외부로 배출할 수 있는 배출부를 마련하여 착용자와 마스크의 밀착도를 유지할 수 있고, 구조 요원이 마스크 착용자를 쉽게 찾을 수 있도록 코 날개 상부에 반사판을 배치하여 별다른 구조요청을 하지 않더라도 구조될 수 있는 긴급재난 대피용 휴대형 탄소기반 마스크에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Side slope drilling machine for geological disaster treatment and pipe insertion construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a slope drilling machine for geological disaster management and a pipe inserting construction method, wherein the slope drilling machine for geological disaster management comprises a rack, and a first movable frame and a second movable frame which can move back and forth relative to the rack are connected to the rack; the first movable frame is provided with a power gyrator, the power gyrator drives a hollow short joint to gyrate, and the short joint can be selectively connected with a guide drill rod, a pipe jacking device for jacking a water-permeable steel sleeve or a filling tool for filling sand and stone filter materials into the water-permeable steel sleeve; the end part of the guide drill rod extends to the outer side of the second movable frame, the outer end part of the guide drill rod can be selectively connected with a guide drill bit or a screw motor, the guide drill bit and the screw motor are both provided with probe cavities, and probe rods of the guide instrument are placed in the probe cavities of the guide drill bit or the screw motor. The slope drilling machine is used for inserting the pipe of the drain pipe, so that the soil layer and the interference are small, the guiding hole forming performance is good, and the slope drilling machine can drill accurately to reach the designed depth.

title_en: Real-time monitoring method for dynamic stress change of surrounding rock of roadway
abstract_en: A real-time monitoring method for roadway surrounding rock stress dynamic change comprises the following steps: firstly, drilling holes in a working face roadway area needing surrounding rock stress monitoring; assembling surrounding rock stress monitoring equipment; thirdly, sending surrounding rock stress monitoring equipment into the drill hole; fourthly, connecting the surrounding rock stress monitoring equipment with the data acquisition unit through signals, calibrating and starting monitoring; and fifthly, monitoring the stress change trend and the distribution range of the surrounding rocks of the roadway in real time through a data acquisition unit, early warning the rock burst, and dynamically processing the surrounding rocks of the roadway by taking certain pressure relief measures in time. The invention can accurately monitor and real-timely monitor the stress condition of the surrounding rock of the roadway, improve the monitoring strength to the maximum extent, dynamically process the surrounding rock of the roadway by taking certain pressure relief measures in time, reduce the occurrence of dynamic disasters such as rock burst and the like, and reduce the cost of the monitoring equipment because the surrounding rock stress monitoring equipment can be repeatedly used.

title_en: Business continuation plan support system
abstract_en: To provide a business continuation plan support system that prolongs a maintenance period of facility functions by efficiently using resources in disasters.SOLUTION: A business continuation plan support system 1 has functions of automatically switching an operation mode of equipment devices from a normal mode to a disaster mode when a central monitoring device 4 detects the occurrence of a disaster; extending a maintenance period of the equipment devices by limiting the supply of the equipment to highly important equipment devices and supply areas; and estimating the remaining time that equipment can supply by simulation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Slope dangerous stone removing device for disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a calamity danger stone clearing device is used in disaster prevention and cure of danger stone clearing equipment technical field, including clearing device main part and drill bit main part base, the fixed dismantlement buckle switch that is equipped with in bottom of the lateral wall of clearing device main part, just the fixed main part maintenance buckle board that is equipped with in the middle of the left and right sides wall of clearing device main part, the utility model relates to a rationally, the use of device mainly is to hold the clearing device handle, then presses the start switch button of front end to can make the main part function, the drill bit driver who utilizes the front end drives the rotation of drill bit, thereby realize the breakage to danger stone, and for the ease of maintenance and change battery etc. of device, be equipped with dismantlement buckle switch, main part maintenance buckle board and battery change slide damper that charges, for the convenience of operation, on outdoor domatic, just abandon traditional wired power supply, adopt battery powered.

title_en: Urban waterlogging risk forecasting method based on raininess-raininess characteristic parameter combined distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forecasting urban waterlogging risk based on raininess-raininess characteristic parameter joint distribution, which comprises the following steps: (1) Selecting a certain field of historical disaster-causing rainfall events, calculating rainfall parameters of the historical disaster-causing rainfall events, and counting rainfall intensity parameters; (2) dividing historical disaster-causing rainfall events into multiple rain types; (3) training a waterlogging prediction model according to different rainfall types; (4) Constructing rain intensity-rain type characteristic parameter combined distribution by using the two rain intensity parameters and the two rain intensity parameters; (5) Acquiring a predicted value of a rain intensity parameter by using a weather forecast event, and acquiring conditional probability distribution of the rain type characteristic parameter by combining rain intensity-rain type characteristic parameter joint distribution; (6) Calculating the conditional probability of various rainfall types of future rainfall events; (7) calculating the risks of various types of rain of future rainfall events; (8) calculating the expected risk of waterlogging for the future rainfall event. The method and the system can improve the accuracy of urban waterlogging risk prediction caused by medium-long-term rainfall events.
assignees: POWERCHINA ROADBRIDGE GROUP CO LTD;POWERCHINA GROUP ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Rock damage prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rock damage prediction method and a system, which are characterized in that a strain distribution image of a rock sample is acquired when the rock sample is subjected to a rock compression test by using a DIC technology, a data set is formed by selecting a strain distribution diagram with a strain value between 0 and a preset value and a strain distribution diagram with a peak value damaged from the strain distribution image, the data set is divided into a training set and a testing set, a PreRNN ++ prediction model is built, the training set is used for training the model, the testing set is used for evaluating the trained model, when the evaluation result meets the preset requirement, a trained model is obtained, the trained model is used for predicting the image with the peak value damaged on the rock sample to be detected, and the axial deformation is calculated according to the predicted graph, so that the damage energy and the damage time are estimated. The invention makes a certain technical accumulation for the subsequent prediction of heavy natural disasters, in particular the prediction of the instability and damage of surrounding rocks.

title_en: Collapse and rock fall test simulation device based on vibration signal analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collapse and rockfall test simulation device based on vibration signal analysis, which comprises a fixed bearing system, a panel component, a material release device, a data monitoring device and a main control computer device, can perform collapse and rockfall tests under working conditions such as different slope gradients, dangerous rock falling heights, falling positions, collapse object material characteristics and motion path roughness, and simultaneously considers the influence of multiple working conditions on rock collapse, rockfall disaster kinematics processes, dynamics characteristics and vibration signal characteristics. The method has the advantages of large target parameter adjusting range, simple adjusting process and small operation difficulty, overcomes the defects of long on-site monitoring time and high cost in the prior art, has wide popularization and application values, and provides technical precaution and scientific basis for dynamic-dependent vibration wave mechanism research of the collapsed rockfall, monitoring early warning of the collapsed rockfall disaster and risk analysis by cooperatively monitoring and recording the vibration acceleration signal and the dynamic pressure signal through the vibration acceleration sensor.

title_en: High-aroma identification method based on target detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of target detection, in particular to a high-aroma identification method based on target detection, which comprises the steps of collecting video image information through a camera, preprocessing the video image information to obtain a training set and a verification set; performing data enhancement, normalization and dimension adjustment on the training set to obtain calculation data; inputting the calculated data into an image pyramid to obtain semantic features, and adding the semantic features into an attention mechanism to obtain feedback weights; training and verifying the network model through the feedback weight, the training set and the verification set to obtain a target detection network model; the invention discloses a method for detecting incense burning in a fire disaster, which comprises the steps of inputting online incense burning data into a target detection network model for training to obtain a detection result, and solving the problem that the height of an incense candle during burning cannot be judged, so that the incense candle collapses or breaks and then falls onto surrounding articles to cause a fire disaster.

title_en: Method and device for determining emergency evacuation path planning scheme of railway passenger station
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for determining a planning scheme of an emergency evacuation path of a railway passenger station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an emergency evacuation scene and a group to be evacuated of a railway passenger station; and inputting the emergency evacuation scene, the group to be evacuated and the target constraint condition into a railway passenger station emergency evacuation model to obtain an in-station evacuation route planning scheme output by the railway passenger station emergency evacuation model. According to the method and the device for determining the railway passenger station emergency evacuation path planning scheme, the railway passenger station emergency evacuation model is obtained through emergency evacuation basic data, emergency situation types, in-station personnel composition data, evacuation group classification and people flow speed training, the influence of the evacuation group types and the people flow speed on evacuation paths is considered, the occurrence probability of trampling or crowding events is reduced, and the crowd evacuation efficiency is improved.
assignees: CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITE

title_en: Method and device for generating output curve of wind power plant under typhoon disaster in simulation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a wind power plant output curve in a typhoon disaster in a simulation manner, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out wind power plant type evaluation on all wind power plants to be evaluated by acquiring and based on typhoon data to obtain a wind power plant type corresponding to each wind power plant to be evaluated; acquiring a wind power output mode sequence corresponding to each wind power plant to be evaluated from a pre-constructed model sequence sample library according to the typhoon data and the type of the wind power plant; and according to the wind power output mode sequence, randomly selecting a corresponding wind power curve basic form segment from a pre-constructed wind power curve basic form segment library so as to obtain a wind power output curve of each evaluation wind power plant based on the wind power curve basic form segment. Compared with the prior art, the technical scheme of the invention can accurately simulate the wind power output curves of the wind power plants in different areas during typhoon.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Volume-adjustable air supply device in coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a volume-adjustable gas source supply device in a coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiment, which comprises a gas supply tank and a gas supply pipeline, wherein a hydraulic propulsion module, an intelligent control module and a digital display module are sequentially arranged at the rear end of the gas supply tank, a piston is arranged at the front end of the hydraulic propulsion module, the intelligent control module controls the piston of the hydraulic propulsion module to advance and displays the piston by means of the digital display module, the gas supply tank is a hollow cylinder and is provided with an input interface and an output interface which are respectively connected with a gas cylinder and the gas supply pipeline, the gas supply pipeline is connected with a protruding cavity, the protruding cavity comprises a protruding cavity body and a protruding port and is a hollow cylinder, the gas supply pipeline is provided with an intelligent regulation and control module for regulating and dynamically monitoring the gas supply amount and the gas supply rate, and when the set gas supply amount is reached, the intelligent regulation and control module closes the gas supply pipeline to complete gas supply. The invention also provides an air source supply method. The method fully considers the participation of the desorbed gas of the pressure-relief coal around the protruding holes, and has positive significance.

title_en: Marine target detection system based on Springboot frame
abstract_en: With the increasing of ocean development activities and the increasing of ocean strategic position, the improvement of ocean monitoring and situation awareness capabilities has become an important research topic. The invention relates to a marine target detection system based on a SpringBoot framework. The ocean target detection task is functionally analyzed based on core back-end architectures of a Model layer, a Controller layer, a Service layer and a Mapper layer, the system is divided into three functional modules of data management, model management and target monitoring, and meanwhile, service updating and expanding are facilitated. The system user can select an individualized target detection algorithm and a training model according to different ocean target detection application scenes, and a service customized target detection strategy is realized. The invention can be widely applied to the target detection tasks of ocean scenes such as sea island exploration, sea safety monitoring, emergency search and rescue, disaster prevention and reduction and the like.

title_en: Water gushing and water bursting test system for water-rich tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of tunnel engineering geological disaster model tests, in particular to a water gushing and water bursting test system for a water-rich tunnel. The invention can quantitatively control different water-rich conditions of the fault through the hydraulic loading device, simultaneously adjust different rainfall intensities, and simulate the water gushing and water bursting conditions of the tunnel crossing the water-rich fault under different hydraulic conditions and rainfall conditions; the rainfall intensity can be quantitatively controlled through the high-pressure pump and the flowmeter, different rainfall intensities are simulated, the influence of different rainfall intensities on the distribution of tunnel underground water is analyzed, and the problems of water burst and water inrush under different hydraulic conditions and different rainfall intensities are effectively simulated.
assignees: CHANGAN UNIV;POLY CHANGDA ENG CO LTD

title_en: Flood early warning method of U-net variant neural network based on radar image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood warning method of a U-net variant neural network based on radar images, which comprises the following steps of A, obtaining color radar pictures of a monitoring area and converting the color radar pictures into gray pictures so as to establish a training data set and a test data set, B, establishing a U-net variant neural network model, C, obtaining a trained U-net variant neural network model by using the training data set, D, obtaining radar images of the monitoring area by using the test data set, E, carrying out quality assessment by using the radar images to obtain performance analysis results of the U-net variant neural network, F, optimizing the U-net variant neural network model according to the performance analysis results, G, carrying out flood warning by using the color radar pictures according to the optimized U-net variant neural network model. The method can be used for improving the accuracy of flood disaster early warning by capturing the nonlinear event capability of the easily acquired radar image in the flood disaster early warning.

title_en: Disaster scene ground feature damage evaluation method for offline training-online learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster scene ground feature damage evaluation method based on an offline training-online learning framework, which is used for rapidly and accurately evaluating ground feature damage of a multi-disaster scene and supporting disaster emergency response application. The method solves the problem that the traditional damage evaluation model cannot simultaneously have end-to-end training, reasoning and target consistency prediction by continuously aligning the statistical feature distribution of the model in the unknown region and the unknown disaster data through an offline training-online learning framework, solving the problem of distribution drift caused by the unknown region and the unknown disaster, designing an end-to-end multitasking pre-disaster feature extraction and post-disaster damage evaluation depth network model, and differentially integrating the pre-disaster feature region extraction and post-disaster feature damage evaluation. The method can solve the problems that the existing model is difficult to generalize to unknown areas, unknown disaster types, inconsistent evaluation target semantics and the like, and effectively supports accurate quick emergency response of the minute-scale urban disasters.

title_en: Remote sensing disaster scene mapping method based on hierarchical dense architecture search
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote sensing disaster scene drawing method based on hierarchical dense architecture search, which is used for surface coverage drawing and damage evaluation of complex multi-disaster scenes and assists disaster emergency correspondence and decision. The method comprises the steps of designing a high-efficiency hierarchical dense architecture search framework, combining the existing various depth encoders in a search stage, adaptively optimizing architecture parameters of a multi-scale dense decoder to meet the requirement of high-efficiency fusion of various disaster-affected features of a current scene, preferentially decoding an optimal decoding architecture through breadth, and combining the decoding structure obtained by searching through migrating depth encoder model parameters in a training stage to realize high-efficiency model training. The invention can solve the problems of high network architecture design difficulty, high time cost and the like of complex disaster scenes, does not need to manually design a deep interpretation architecture, and can realize high-efficiency full automation from data to interpretation results in the face of various disasters or other complex scenes.

title_en: Power transmission line forest fire detection method, early warning method and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid power transmission line forest fire prevention, and discloses a power transmission line forest fire detection method, an early warning method and an early warning system, wherein historical image data are obtained, and the definition variable quantity of the historical image data is detected according to the time dimension, so that a first image area with smoke, which meets a first condition, in the historical image data is obtained; determining a smoke starting point range in the first image area; acquiring an external influence factor of the place where the historical image data is located, and acquiring a relational data set of the smoke starting point range and the external influence factor; training the relation data set as an input training parameter of a neural network model to obtain a mountain fire recognition model; and inputting image data acquired in real time into the mountain fire recognition model to recognize whether mountain fire occurs, and immediately sending out early warning of fire disaster when smoke is judged to be from the mountain fire. The invention can more accurately identify whether smoke is caused by mountain fire.
assignees: LIANSHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Characteristic transformation and extraction system based on public health data acquisition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feature conversion and extraction system based on public health data acquisition, which comprises the following stages: the method comprises a data preparation stage, a characteristic engineering stage and a model evaluation and evaluation stage, wherein the characteristic engineering stage comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing data classified in diabetes follow-up scene data; s2, firstly, determining the characteristics of a large number of missing values in partial data, and eliminating the characteristics on the premise that the characteristics cannot influence a reliability judgment result; s3, sensitivity of partial machine learning algorithms is achieved according to missing values of input data, and the missing values are processed according to different machine learning algorithms; the method has the advantages of reducing the dimension of data, simplifying a data model, improving the interpretability of the model, shortening the time required by model training, reducing the overfitting risk of the model and avoiding dimension disasters.
assignees: SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL CENTER FOR DISEASE CONTROL & PREVENTION

title_en: Uncertainty quantification method for multi-dimensional parameters in electrical impedance imaging technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for solving the problem of uncertainty quantification of multi-dimensional parameters in an electrical impedance imaging technology. The method comprises the steps of firstly training a deep neural network to construct a substitution model of an original uncertain system, then analyzing and quantifying uncertain parameters based on the deep neural network substitution model and combining a univariate dimension reduction method, and finally obtaining distribution of uncertain output. And compared to the baseline method, the performance of the method of the invention was evaluated. The result shows that the method has high calculation precision and can accurately quantify the uncertainty of output; when the uncertainty dimensionality of the parameters is increased, the uncertainty quantification problem of the high-dimensional parameters can be effectively solved, the dimensionality disaster is relieved, the method is not limited by the interaction between variables, and the calculation cost is effectively reduced. In addition, the method can also be applied to the uncertainty system quantification in other complex fields.

title_en: Nuclear accident action decision method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a nuclear accident action decision method, a nuclear accident action decision device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of acquiring nuclear accident simulation data, wherein the nuclear accident simulation data comprises release source information, diffusion result information and environmental factor information at different time points on a nuclear accident simulation time line; sequentially taking time points on a nuclear accident simulation time line as time points of a current prediction step, and acquiring position information of a disaster-affected object in the current prediction step; acquiring action decision information of the current prediction step based on the position information and release source information, diffusion result information and environmental factor information at a time point corresponding to the current prediction step; and generating action decision information of the disaster-suffering object in the nuclear accident according to the action decision information of all the prediction steps, realizing dynamic decision action prediction, and providing dynamic decision support for the situations of multiple disaster-suffering objects and dynamic changes of decision events in the nuclear accident.

title_en: Power transmission line seismic loss assessment method based on GIS fuzzy analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GIS fuzzy analysis-based power transmission line seismic loss evaluation method, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: establishing an importance function of the transmission line corridor equipment; carrying out refined space simulation; acquiring the visual number of the geological influence factors of the power transmission line corridor after the earthquake; the conventional rasterization method represents data of each layer and acquires an information matrix of power transmission equipment which is possibly influenced in a power grid system; determining a membership function; and calculating the influence degree of the geological disaster on the regional power transmission line. According to the method for evaluating the earthquake loss of the power transmission line, provided by the invention, through the correlation analysis of historical earthquake disasters and the influence of power transmission equipment, the dynamic disaster evaluation is carried out by combining the real-time tide data of the power transmission line, and the auxiliary decision support for the emergency disaster relief of the power grid can be provided.

title_en: Large deformation area and local grouting method for high-stress tunnel fractured rock mass
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geotechnical engineering, and discloses a method for grouting large deformation areas and local parts of fractured rocks of a high-stress tunnel, which comprises two links of area grouting and local grouting, wherein the area grouting process comprises the following steps: spraying a double-liquid quick setting material on the palm surface; constructing grouting holes in the rock mass in front of the palm surfaces; inserting a grouting pipe into the grouting hole and sealing the hole; injecting common cement paste into the fractured rock mass in front of the tunnel face; the local grouting process comprises the following steps: after the rock mass is excavated, judging the part of the surrounding rock where deformation and fracture are more prominent; drilling at the deformed protruding part, and installing a grouting component; after the stress adjustment is finished, injecting a double-liquid quick-setting material with a low water-cement ratio into the shallow surrounding rock; and after the grouting pressure of the shallow layer surrounding rock reaches the bursting pressure of the bursting valve, the bursting valve is opened, and the double-liquid retarder with high cement ratio is injected into the deep layer surrounding rock. The technical scheme provided by the invention can effectively inhibit the occurrence of large deformation disasters of fractured rock masses of high-stress tunnels.

title_en: Simulation experiment device for urban flood disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a be used for city flood disaster simulation experiment device, including simulation platform and spraying adjusting device. The utility model discloses a spray adjusting device has been set up, under the inside regulating assembly that establishes of shell moves, the connecting rod can drive the synchronous rotation of rear side action wheel, and then the action wheel, the belt with can cooperate the transmission from the driving wheel, make the spray tube that is connected from the driving wheel middle part, carry out intermittent type rotation regulation thereupon, realize spraying the angle change, when the simulation rainwater slopes, flood disaster situation, thereby reached intermittent type regulation spray tube and sprayed the angle, further acquire flood disaster analog data's advantage, and relative spacing subassembly has been set up from the driving wheel front side, under guide arm and spring leaf cooperation, it can drive upper end middle part ball to accept the board, with along with spray tube intermittent type pivoted spacing ring cooperation, it is spacing to carry out spray tube intermittent type pivoted, avoid the skew phenomenon to appear in the spray tube, thereby it is spacing to have reached spray tube intermittent type regulation, guarantee follow-up testing process's advantage.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Urban drainage monitoring system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a drainage system monitoring field discloses a urban drainage monitoring system based on unmanned aerial vehicle, include an urban drainage monitoring system based on unmanned aerial vehicle, including image video data, water level monitoring sensor, rainfall monitoring sensor, road surface cross slope, image video data is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, the unmanned aerial vehicle main part is connected with flood image data set, hydrology data and urban camera drainage data, flood image data set, hydrology data and urban camera drainage data are connected with the water level and predict early warning module, the water level predicts early warning module and is connected with ARM processor module. The utility model discloses in, the urban drainage monitoring system based on unmanned aerial vehicle that proposes adopts the coastal urban waterlogging disaster prevention scheme based on the tracer method to study to and the urban waterlogging numerical simulation based on TELEMAC-2D and SWMM model, can be in the future when collecting the flood data set that has more marks, explore more advanced and cheap model.

title_en: Test system for simulating dam break caused by water surge of collapse slide body
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disasters research technical field discloses a test system for simulating landslide body is gone into water and is swashed and cause dam break, including support, material case, slide platform, water tank and basin, wherein, the material case is used for loading landslide body simulation material, the slide platform is used for simulating the landslide, the water tank is used for simulating the damming lake, the basin is used for simulating the riverway and embeds the damming dam simulation body of piling up, on the one hand through set up the elevating system who is used for lift slide platform top on the support, and make the bottom of slide platform is articulated the overlap joint tip of water tank, on the other hand through with material case slidable ground sets up on the slide platform to be equipped with on slide platform top and can receive and release the winder, and make the connection of acting as go-between of receiving and releasing winder the material case can solve the problem that current simulation test device can not adjust the slip distance of simulation landslide body and the inclination of simulation landslide in a flexible way.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Escape Experience Simulation Devices and Methods in a Ship Crash
title_ko: 선박 충돌 시 탈출체험 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to ship collision escape experience simulation device and method implemented similarly to an actual situation in which a ship collides at sea so that an experiencer can directly or indirectly experience an accident caused by an actual ship collision and directly experience and learn the situation in which it is possible to escape outside the ship. Experiencers directly or indirectly board a model experience center similar to an actual ship, and take safety education through realistic videos and various driving experiences (ship navigation course, collision experience). The purpose is to provide a comprehensive safety education environment with storytelling in the field of ship safety through safety training on boarding and disembarking ships, safety training on boarding ships, how to respond in case of emergency situations involving ship collisions, and safe escape experiences. In order to achieve the purpose, the present invention provides '3D simulation content', 'hydraulic cylinder drive device and solid foundation base as a ship driving device', 'evacuation broadcast' inside the ship, and a physical 'experience space' to escape through risk factors that may occur on the ship. The present invention provides an evacuation zone where those who have boarded the ship can escape safely without panic immediately after being stranded in the event of a ship collision, which provides practical help in providing advance awareness training for maritime safety accidents and preventing fatal accidents, and promotes awareness of ship safety.
abstract_ko:
기계금속 : 선박충돌 시 탈출체험 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법 
{Escape Experience Simulation Devices and Methods in a Ship Crash} 
(1) 기술분야 
- 본 발명은 본 발명은 선박이 해상에서 충돌된 실제 상황과 유사하게 구현되어 체험자가 실제 선박 충돌로 인한 사고 에 대해 직간접적으로 체험하고, 선박 외부로 탈출할 수 있는 상황을 직접 체험 학습 할 수 있도록 선박 충돌 탈출체험 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
(2) 해결 하고자하는 과제수단 
- 체험자가 직간접적으로 실제 선박과 같은 모형체험관에 탑승하여, 실감형 영상을 통한 안전교육과 다양한 구동 체험(선박 항해과정, 충돌체험)을 제공 합니다. 
- 선박 승하차 안전교육, 선박 향해전 탑승 안전교육, 선박 충돌한 비상시 대응법과 안전한 탈출 체험등을 통해, 선박안전 부문의 스토리텔링이 있는 종합적인 안전교육 환경을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
(3) 과제의 해결수단 
- 본 발명은 상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위하여, 선박에서 발생할 수 있는 위험요소를 통해 '3D 시뮬레이션 콘텐츠' 와 '선박 구동장치로 유압실린더 구동장치와 견고한 기초 베이스' 와 선박 실내 '대피 방송' 과 선박탈출 물리적 '체험공간' 구현 한다. 
(4) 효과 
본 발명은 선박 충돌 시 좌초 즉시 탑승 체험자가 당황하지 않고 안전하게 탈출할 수 있는 대피 탈출 존을 제공하여 해상 안전사고의 사전 인지 교육과 인명 재해사고로 사전 예방하는 데 실질 도움과 선박 안전인식을 고취하는 데 효과가 있다.

title_en: Simulation methods for evacuation in a Massive Disaster
title_ko: 대규모 재난대피 시뮬레이션 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a large-scale disaster evacuation simulation. The method for providing a large-scale disaster evacuation simulation, according to the present invention, comprises the processes of: creating a basic scenario; simulating disaster spread results for the basic scenario; simulating a transportation network for the basic scenario; carry out a simulation in which the disaster spread results and the transportation network simulation are combined; and searching for aid stations within a danger range and connecting the transportation network to the aid stations. Therefore, a systematic evacuation plan can be established based on quantitative analysis results.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난유형별 피해특성을 반영하고 대규모 재난대피 상황을 모사하여 시각적 검토와 연산을 통한 정량적 분석을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 시뮬레이션 제공방법에 관한 것으로, 
대피 계획 수립 및 점검을 지원할 수 있는 시스템을 개발하여 방사능재난, 화학사고, 풍수해, 지진 등 다양한 재난유형의 피해예측 정보를 기반으로 대규모의 도시 단위 복합재난상황 대응이 가능한 체계를 마련할 수 있도록 하는 대규모 재난대피 시뮬레이션 제공방법에 관한 것이다. 
즉, 행정구역에 대한 지도, 도로, 환승시설, 구호소, 인구 등의 재난관련 정적정보와, 기상상태, 교통상황 등의 재난관련 동적정보가 시뮬레이션 모델 통합 데이터베이스로 유입되면, 데이터베이스 수집연계시스템에 의해 아카이빙된 DB/Metadata는 File 및 Meta 데이터로 매쉬업(Mash-up)되어 저장되고, 이와 같이 수집등록 체계에 따라 메타데이터 추출 및 정규화된 데이터들은 컴퓨터로 보내져서 재난대피 시나리오에 의한 시뮬레이션 프로그램이 실행됨에 따라 매크로 기반의 시뮬레이션 분석이 이루어지고, 시뮬레이션 분석의 결과물은 타 시나리오와의 대비를 위해 평가결과 데이터베이스에 저장되는 한편, 모니터를 통해 GIS 표출되어 디스플레이되도록 구성된 대규모 재난대피 시뮬레이션 제공방법에 있어서, 
컴퓨터에 내장된 시뮬레이션 프로그램에서는, 상기 시뮬레이션 모델 통합 데이터베이스 모델로 부터 유입된 재난정보들에 의해 재난유형이 설정되어 기본 시나리오가 만들어지는 과정과, 
기본 시나리오에 대한 재난 확산결과가 시뮬레이션되는 과정과, 
기본 시나리오에 대한 교통 네트워크를 시뮬레이션되는 과정과, 
상기  재난 확산결과와 교통 네트워크 시뮬레이션이 결합된 상태로 시뮬레이션되는 과정과, 
위험범위 내의 구호소를 검색하고 위험범위 내 인구에 대해 교통 네트워크를 상기 구호소로 연결하는 과정으로 진행되고, 
상기 모니터에서는 시뮬레이션 분석의 결과물이 GIS 표출되어 디스플레이되는데, 상기 재난 확산결과에 대해서는 거시적 모델(Macroscopic Model)로 표시되고 교통 네트워크에 대해서는 미시적 모델(Microscopic Model)로 표시되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: system for spraying fluid over a wide area using drones
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 광역 유체 살포시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wide area fluid spraying system using a drone, which comprises: a fluid supply tank which is mounted on a vehicle for high-pressure water spray, disinfection, or firefighting to store, pressurize, pump, and discharge fluid; a fluid transfer unit which is a flexible pipe having an internal flow path for transferring the fluid, and has one side coupled to a fluid supply tank through a coupling member and the other side diverging into a plurality of branch pipes; a nozzle part which has a plurality of spray nozzles installed at an end of each branch hose of the fluid transfer unit and opened and closed by control signals of a remote controller to discharge the fluid transferred from the fluid transfer unit to the outside due to the opening and closing of each spray nozzle according to control signals of a drone; and the drone which includes a propeller for generating thrust, a landing gear for protecting a body of the drone during take-off/landing of the drone, and a flight control unit for controlling flight, communicates wirelessly with a main control device of a control center, a remote control device, or another paired drone, and perform independent manual flight or autonomous flight depending on the control signals from the main control device of the control center or the remote control device, or a pre-set flight scenario while sharing real-time location information, and controls the fluid spray of the nozzle part depending on the control signals from the flight control unit. The wide area fluid spraying system allows continuous, uniform, and rapid spraying of fluid over a wide area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론을 이용한 광역 유체 살포시스템에 관한 것으로, 고압 살수용 또는 방역용 또는 소방용 차량에 탑재되어 유체를 저장하고 가압 펌핑 및 토출하는 유체공급탱크, 내부 유로를 형성하여 유체를 이송하는 유연배관으로서 일측은 결합부재를 통해 유체공급탱크에 결합되고 타측은 분기되어 복수 개의 분기배관이 형성되는 유체이송부, 유체이송부의 각 분기배관의 종단부에 연설되며 원격제어장치의 제어신호에 의해 개폐되는 복수 개의 분사노즐을 구비하여 드론의 제어신호에 따라 각 분사노즐의 개폐하여 유체이송부에서 이송되는 유체를 외부로 분사하는 노즐부, 추진력 발생을 위한 프로펠러와 드론 이/착륙시 몸체 보호를 위한 랜딩기어 및 비행 제어를 위한 비행 제어부를 구비하여 관제센터의 주제어장치 또는 원격제어장치 또는 자신과 짝을 이루는 타 드론과 무선 통신하고 실시간 위치 정보를 공유하면서 관제센터의 주제어장치 또는 원격제어장치에 의한 제어신호 또는 기설정된 비행 시나리오에 따라 독립적으로 수동비행 또는 자율비행을 수행하며 비행 제어부의 제어신호로 노즐부의 유체 분사를 제어하는 드론을 포함하여, 연속적이면서도 균일하고 신속하게 유체를 광역에서 다량 살포할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: Tertiary safe back-fire relief system is carried to colliery low concentration gas power station gas
abstract_en: The utility model provides a gas transmission three-level safe fire-retardant bleeding system of a coal mine low-concentration gas power station, belonging to the technical field of gas transmission safe fire-retardant bleeding; the problems of pump station overpressure and unit inlet pressure fluctuation caused by single diffusion of the conventional low-concentration gas power station gas safety conveying system are solved; the system comprises a primary wet-type overpressure bleeding and emergency evacuation bleeding system, a secondary gas main pipe tail end pressure stabilizing adjustment bleeding system and a tertiary unit gas inlet branch pipe shutdown maintenance and replacement bleeding system, wherein a water seal fire-retardant system is arranged at a pump station gas reserved interface, and three explosion-blocking, explosion-simulating and explosion-releasing systems with different principles are arranged on a gas conveying main pipe; the gas extraction pump station can be prevented from overpressure accidents, the gas inlet pressure of the gas generator set can be stabilized, and meanwhile, emergency evacuation and replacement are performed when a single or multiple gas generator sets are stopped for maintenance or have faults, so that the safety and reliability of the whole gas supply system are guaranteed.
assignees: COAL INDUSTRY TAIYUAN DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fire extinguishing agent for seawater-resistant training
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seawater-resistant fire extinguishing agent for training, which consists of the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 2-25% of surfactant, 1-3% of preservative, 1-3% of stabilizing agent and the balance of water, wherein the surfactant is selected from one or two of amphoteric surfactant and nonionic surfactant and one or two of anionic surfactant and cationic surfactant, and the surfactant is degradable and has salt resistance. The seawater-resistant fire extinguishing agent for training can use seawater as a diluent and also can use fresh water as a diluent, has good foaming effect, and ensures the foaming effect and simultaneously has short accumulation time of foam after being sprayed; the raw materials are all degradable and environment-friendly, are environment-friendly and free from peculiar smell, can be defoamed within 1 hour after being used, can be degraded within 20 days after being discharged, do not cause pollution to water and soil, have a fire extinguishing effect, and can be used for extinguishing A-type and B-type fire disasters.

title_en: Basic emergency management mobile intelligent series platform and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency management, and discloses a basic emergency management mobile intelligent series platform and equipment, which comprise a primary management platform, a secondary management platform and a tertiary management platform which are communicated with each other; the first-level management platform, the second-level management platform and the third-level management platform are all provided with a scene monitoring system, a command communication system, a rescue management system, a propaganda warning system and a post-disaster disposal management system; the scene monitoring system is used for monitoring and collecting disaster accident information; the rescue management system is used for comprehensively counting and updating rescue reserve information of each block of the base layer; the command communication system is used for intelligently managing disaster accidents and commanding rescue; the propaganda warning system is used for commanding personnel to conduct propaganda plan drilling; the post-disaster treatment management system is used for performing post-disaster damage assessment and generating post-disaster reconstruction suggestions. The invention can provide a dynamic, reliable and systematic intelligent emergency management scheme, and achieves a better emergency management effect.

title_en: Construction process for guiding and entering tunnel in tunnel outlet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pilot tunnel entrance construction process in a tunnel exit, which comprises the following steps: s1, excavating a section profile and lofting; s2, pre-supporting a small conduit and grouting; s3, excavating and primary supporting of the middle pilot tunnel: adopting a step method construction and annular excavation to leave a core soil method to excavate a pilot tunnel along the extension direction of the tunnel, and forming a primary support structure at the vault of the pilot tunnel, wherein the excavation method mainly adopts mechanical excavation and is assisted by a drilling and blasting method, and top support comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly spraying concrete, embedding prestressed long anchor rods, hanging reinforcing mesh, installing steel arch frames, and spraying concrete to the designed thickness. The construction process effectively reduces the difficulty and potential safety hazards of tunnel construction, improves the engineering quality, reduces the occurrence of common quality problems, and can effectively avoid various disasters such as cracking, block falling, arch frame deformation, inverted arch bottom bulging, collapse and roof collapse of the supporting layer.

title_en: Emergency rescue method for multi-terminal cooperative remote guidance rescue
abstract_en: An emergency rescue method for multi-terminal cooperative remote guidance rescue is characterized in that an emergency response service supply terminal is formed by organizing an amateur volunteer end rescuer under a professional end director remote video guide line on a line, and a platform end machine learning AI model dynamically analyzes and predicts the occurrence probability of an emergency event by using real-time data and provides support for an emergency event processing optimization scheme to form a professional end, a professional end and a platform end multi-terminal cooperative emergency rescue response and emergency rescue providing mode. The method comprises the steps of networking and modeling preparation before emergency events are sent out, real-time resource matching, dispatching task confirmation, remote video guidance and multi-end cooperative work are carried out during the sending out; after the incident, evaluating, summarizing and preventing, improving the practice training, accurately perfecting the model and optimizing the resource layout; the intelligent medicine box wristwatch is used for predicting emergency demands of individual demand terminals, reminding self rescue or assisting help seeking; still provide an intelligence emergency equipment station, provide emergency equipment and article for supporting multi-end collaborative emergency rescue.

title_en: Multi-person collaborative fire-fighting training method and system based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual reality-based multi-person collaborative fire training method and a virtual reality-based multi-person collaborative fire training system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing feature extraction on the filtered motion capture data to obtain each joint matching point of the human body; smoothing the matching points of each joint of the human body to obtain smoothed joint matching points; performing action matching by using the smoothed joint matching points and a preset firefighting character model to obtain a firefighting character virtual model; and completing fire drill in the multi-person collaborative fire training system by using the virtual model of the fire fighting character. According to the invention, the filtered motion capture data and the firefighting character model are subjected to motion matching to obtain the firefighting character virtual model, so that the firefighting character virtual model can make the real motion of a user in a multi-user collaborative firefighting training system with low delay, the digitization of firefighting training is realized, the training cost is reduced, and the firefighting rescue skills and command decision capability of firefighters are improved.

title_en: Multi-class fire early warning data distributed training and local fire extinguishing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-class fire early warning data distributed training and local fire extinguishing method, which comprises the following steps: the main detector collects data when a fire disaster occurs; the fire-fighting controller wirelessly transmits data to an edge server, and a fire judgment model is established on the edge server and distributed training is carried out; when the trained fire judgment model is not obtained by the edge server, the fire fighting controller judges the fire through the fire judgment threshold table, the fire point detected by the main detector is taken as the circle center, the control valve of the spray head is opened, and fire judgment parameters are sent to surrounding detectors; and when the edge server obtains the trained fire judgment model, respectively judging the fire on all the detectors and the edge server according to the optimal division point to obtain fire judgment parameters. The invention also discloses a multi-class fire early warning data distributed training and local fire extinguishing system. The invention can protect the disaster object to the maximum extent and save the fire extinguishing agent on the premise of high-efficiency and accurate fire extinguishing.
assignees: BENGBU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Slope trailing edge crack early warning method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
