abstract_en: The invention provides a slope trailing edge crack early warning method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which relate to the technical field of slope safety assessment and comprise the steps of obtaining trailing edge crack data of a slope at different moments to construct a first data set; acquiring slope information, constructing a three-dimensional slope model based on the slope information, and acquiring trailing edge crack data of the three-dimensional slope model at different moments to construct a second data set; constructing a sample data group from the first data group and the second data group, and training and testing a neural network model by using the sample data group to obtain a trailing edge crack index prediction model; obtaining slope information at the current moment, and predicting to obtain trailing edge crack data at the current moment; and calculating a slope early warning index based on the trailing edge crack data at the current moment so as to obtain a slope early warning grade. The method can accurately warn landslide disasters which may occur on the side slope according to the development degree and the development rule of cracks of different side slopes.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring sampling drilling device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a geological disasters monitoring sample drilling equipment belongs to the geological detection field. This geological disasters monitoring sample drilling equipment includes base, supporting component, drilling rod and drill bit. The supporting component comprises a supporting plate and a lifting piece, the lower end of the lifting piece is connected with the base, and the upper end of the lifting piece is connected with the supporting plate. The sleeve is connected with a fastener, a motor is fixed at the upper end of the supporting plate, and a driving shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the upper end of the rotating rod; adjust the lift piece and drive the backup pad and reciprocate, bull stick and sleeve pipe plug-in connection to the fastener through setting up is locked the bull stick and is fixed with bushing junction, is convenient for extend or shorten length, and the simple operation, and then the control drill bit bores into underground degree of depth, and is rotatory through addding the motor drive bull stick, uses manpower sparingly, and drilling is swift, improves work efficiency, and the shrink of being convenient for when not using reduces the volume, makes convenient to carry.
assignees: JIANGSU SHENZHU INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Venous transfusion nursing training device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nursing, a real device of instructing of venous transfusion nursing is disclosed, including simulation arm mechanism, the downside of simulation arm mechanism is provided with supporting mechanism, simulation arm mechanism is including simulation arm body and connecting tube, the centre of connecting tube is provided with the evacuation pump, the one end of connecting tube is provided with the second connecting block, the simulation arm body is including simulation skin and simulation subcutaneous tissue. The utility model discloses open the evacuation pump and can make evacuation pump work, evacuation pump work makes and connects the second connecting block section and form the negative pressure on the connecting tube to make the intravascular negative pressure that forms of simulation, when medical personnel prick the transfusion needle through simulation skin when on the simulation blood vessel, when medical personnel prick the position, the liquid medicine can be through in the inside negative pressure drainage of simulation blood vessel to the connecting tube, derives through the evacuation pump again, has made things convenient for medical personnel to carry out the real standard greatly.

title_en: Test simulation device for monitoring toppling damage image of high slope geological disaster body
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a calamity body is emptyd and is destroyed simulation field to a test simulation device that is used for high slope geological disasters body to emptys and destroys image monitoring is disclosed, including horizontal support board, tilt support board and lifting unit, the one end at tilt support board top is articulated with horizontal support board, and horizontal support board is used for placing high-order calamity body mother rock part, and lifting unit sets up in tilt support board's below, and tilt support board's up end is provided with the ice-cube trough, and the ice-cube trough is provided with the ice-cube, and the ice-cube is used for supporting the calamity body and emptys the deformation part. Can simulate different high slope slopes and calamity body angle, calamity body topple over drive arrangement and adopt the ice-cube, and the ice-cube melts the process naturally and is continuous and not have artificial interference for the dangerous rock mass that simulates topples over the process of destruction truer and more continuous, thereby has higher simulation degree, and simulation repeatability is strong, and the actual environment of high slope calamity body is laminated more to the simulated environment, makes the simulation test data more accurate.

title_en: Dangerous goods disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dangerous goods calamity analogue means, including jar external packing device, gas leakage device, fire signal device, liquid leakage device, camera, battery, base and handheld terminal. The utility model discloses a device true simulation dangerous goods calamity takes place the scene, the software and hardware combines together, the hand-held terminal both can watch rescue site work in real time, but the different calamity scene of transform is put to the external packing of random control jar again, in the rehearsal in-process with the vision, the sense of hearing, the sense of touch information in time transmits for emergency rescue personnel, first scene when simulating dangerous goods calamity completely and taking place, provide immersive emergency rescue for the user and experience, the purpose of emergency rehearsal has both been reached, reduce the harm that brings at rehearsal in-process maloperation, can also regard as science popularization instrument simultaneously, make rehearsal personnel know dangerous goods calamity rescue knowledge better.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH CHINA RAILWAY WUHAN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Waterproof equipment for mine disaster rescue drilling
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the mine rescue technique and specifically relates to a mine disaster rescue drilling waterproof equipment is related to, the installation structure comprises a sleeve, the sleeve pipe is used for forming the ground drilling of underground mine, sheathed tube outside cover is equipped with the expansion capsule, the expansion capsule accessible lets in fluid and exhaust fluid realization inflation and shrink, and the clearance between drilling inner wall and the sleeve pipe is plugged up in the inflation, prevents that groundwater from flowing into in the mine, the expansion capsule is established in the position that is close to the drilling bottom. The utility model discloses an establish inflation capsule cover and be close to drilling bottom position in the sleeve pipe outside, let in highly-compressed air to inflation capsule for inflation capsule inflation and with drilling inner wall zonulae occludens, prevent that groundwater from gushing into the mine in, avoid threatening the survival space of stranded personnel in the shaft bottom, improve the success rate of rescue.
assignees: CHINA COAL GEOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for monitoring galloping of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission line safety prevention and control, and particularly provides a power transmission line galloping monitoring method and device, aiming at solving the technical problem that the galloping phenomenon of a power transmission line when the galloping amplitude is small and the frequency is high cannot be recorded. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological factor data, micro-geographic factor data and line information of a prediction period; inputting the meteorological factor data, the micro-geographic factor data and the line information of the prediction time period as a pre-trained machine learning model, and acquiring a prediction time period power transmission line galloping coefficient output by the pre-trained machine learning model; the pre-trained machine learning model is obtained based on historical meteorological factor data, micro-geographic factor data, line information and power transmission line galloping coefficient training. According to the scheme, the early prediction and early warning of the icing galloping of the power transmission line are realized, and the security defense measures of the power transmission line for dealing with the galloping disasters are improved, so that the disaster accidents caused by the galloping are reduced or eliminated.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Simulation experiment method for coal and gas outburst disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation experiment method for coal and gas outburst disaster, which comprises the steps of integral design of an air source supply device, determination of required supply air quantity, intelligent monitoring of the supply air quantity, intelligent regulation and control of air supply rate, simulation experiment for coal and gas outburst disaster and the like. According to the invention, the effect of desorption gas in the protrusion in a pressure relief area which flows towards the protrusion coal body under the action of gas pressure gradient and throws work on the coal body is fully considered, and meanwhile, the relevant quantitative research on the protrusion effect of the desorption gas of the pressure relief coal body around the protrusion hole is further carried out. The invention also provides a matched experimental device, has exquisite design, simple and convenient experimental method, easy operation and good implementation, can further promote the understanding of the coal and gas outburst mechanism, and has important theoretical significance.

title_en: Offshore ecological environment numerical forecasting method and system
abstract_en: An offshore ecological environment numerical forecasting method, comprising: collecting various ocean related data to obtain satellite remote sensing sea surface temperature, chlorophyll a concentration, observation data and other ocean data, and making a driving field, an open boundary and an initial field by using the related data; the physical mode and the ecological mode are optimized according to the optimized parameter scheme of each sea area, the physical mode and the ecological mode are coupled by using a driving field, an open boundary and an initial field, a data assimilation correction mode initial field is developed to obtain a physical mode simulation forecast result and an ecological mode simulation forecast result, interpolation layering, marine disasters and environment analysis, inspection and filing are carried out to obtain a static forecast map, an explanation application analysis result and a verification and filing result, the offshore ecological environment with environmental differences and model uniformity can be more comprehensively and pertinently depicted, the offshore ecological environment comprises a nitrogen, phosphorus, silicon, oxygen and carbon multisource biological geochemical cycle process (particularly phosphorus cycle), and the detail degree of the depiction of the offshore ecological environment is improved.

title_en: Fire engineering emergency lighting and evacuation indication skill training and identification device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire engineering emergency lighting and evacuation indicating skill training and identifying device, which is characterized in that when the device is used, a PDU power socket is opened, a fire emergency lighting controller and a fire emergency lighting centralized power box are electrified, and students control the fire safety exit marker lamp, a fire direction indicating lamp, a fire emergency double-head lighting lamp and a fire emergency wall lamp through control keys on a door leaf of the fire emergency lighting controller, so that the principle demonstration of a real fire engineering emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system can be performed, the device can also be used as professional skill training or training equipment of the related professions of the fire industry and schools for operation training such as equipment installation and system debugging, the device is helpful for training professional skills meeting the requirements of fire posts, the cut employment rate is improved, and the fire system is used correctly.
assignees: XIAN GREAT ELECTRONIC IND CO LTD

title_en: Landslide stability intelligent dynamic prediction method based on multisource monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control methods, in particular to an intelligent dynamic landslide stability prediction method based on multi-source monitoring data, which comprises the steps of obtaining geological background conditions, physical parameters and historical monitoring data, and establishing a numerical model through a numerical simulation means based on the obtained data; setting boundary conditions of a landslide numerical simulation process, performing numerical analysis calculation to obtain the change of a seepage field and a stress field of a target landslide hidden danger point history, and calculating to obtain stability coefficients of different time phases of the target landslide hidden danger point by combining a landslide stability calculation method; forming a data set for training and verifying an input machine learning model, training, verifying and testing a basic machine learning model, and generating a training set and a testing set; and selecting the base learner for integrated learning, obtaining a learning stacking model with optimal performance, and obtaining a stability coefficient. The invention realizes real-time, efficient and accurate prediction of landslide stability and provides support for landslide disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for generating basin flood beach disaster relief scheme based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for generating a basin flood beach disaster relief scheme based on digital twins. The method comprises the following steps: determining a corresponding flood plain area in the flow field based on a digital twin simulation model; determining a disaster risk level corresponding to the flood plain area based on the flood plain area water flow corresponding to the flood plain area; and determining a disaster relief scheme corresponding to the flood plain area based on the disaster risk level corresponding to the flood plain area through the digital twin simulation model. The method and the device solve the technical problem that the flood beach disaster relief scheme cannot be quickly and accurately generated based on the real-time condition in the related technology.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine gas explosion risk prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine gas explosion risk prediction method, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting all basic information data of coal mines in a target range; s2, screening objects needing risk prediction based on coal mine basic information data; s3, carrying out preliminary assessment on the coal mine gas explosion risk level according to the coal mine basic information data, and determining risk prediction frequency according to a risk preliminary assessment result; s4, initially establishing a gas explosion disaster-causing index system; s5, cleaning disaster-causing indexes, and establishing a key disaster-causing index system; s6, training a machine learning risk prediction model based on the key disaster causing index data; s7, evaluating performance of the risk prediction model, and determining an adopted prediction model; s8, carrying out gas explosion risk prediction on the risk prediction target mine by adopting a high-performance prediction model. The invention can predict the risk of coal mine gas explosion, realize high practicability, low cost and high efficiency, and improve the safety of the gas coal mine production process.

title_en: Detachable movable numerical control drilling and milling device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a detachable movable type numerical control drilling and milling device which comprises a fixed base, an X-axis movable sliding table, a Y-axis movable sliding table, a Z-axis movable sliding table and a control system, wherein the X-axis movable sliding table is arranged on the fixed base; the fixed base comprises a supporting seat and a magnetic device, and the magnetic device is used for adsorbing the supporting seat on a processing workpiece; the X-axis moving sliding table is used for realizing displacement in the X-axis direction relative to the fixed base; the Y-axis moving sliding table is used for realizing displacement in the Y-axis direction relative to the X-axis moving sliding table; the Z-axis moving sliding table is used for realizing the displacement in the Z-axis direction relative to the Y-axis moving sliding table; and the control system processes the workpiece according to the set program according to the input workpiece parameters. The detachable movable numerical control drilling and milling device provided by the embodiment can be moved to the outdoor to complete the drilling, tapping and other processing of large-sized workpieces, is convenient for various enterprises to use, and can deal with special conditions such as sudden disaster rescue or military field operation equipment maintenance.
assignees: TAIAN JIUHE INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Rock test piece triaxial loading fracture whole-course multi-physical-field testing device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rock test piece triaxial loading fracture whole-course multi-physical field testing device and a method, wherein the device comprises: support device, acoustic emission device, electrode device, fiber grating device etc.. The test of the deformation of the rock test piece, the electrical parameters of the damage process, the acoustic emission signals and the deformation amount under the conventional triaxial loading condition is realized, and the parameter representation of the test piece from the local size to the whole size and from the microscopic view to the macroscopic damage evolution process is refined. Especially, the introduction of the fiber bragg grating greatly improves the testing precision of the deformation of the rock test piece. The simulation method realizes the simulation of a high stress environment within kilometers, further represents the deformation and fracture conditions of the rock test piece through the geophysical parameter test, has great help for understanding the deep rock mechanical fracture mechanism, and simultaneously provides help for dynamic test and disaster prevention and control of deep rock engineering.

title_en: Slope softening area prediction method, system and equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system and a device for predicting a slope softened area and a readable storage medium, which relate to the field of slope geological disaster prevention and control and comprise the steps of establishing a three-dimensional slope model, and adding data of the softened area in the three-dimensional slope model to obtain crack data in a three-dimensional slope; generating a data sample according to the data of the softening region and the crack data, and constructing a training set and a testing set required by a neural network model; building a neural network model, and training and testing the neural network model by using the training set and the testing set to obtain a slope softening area prediction model; and inputting the crack data of the side slope to be predicted into the prediction model of the side slope softening area, and predicting to obtain the data of the softening area. The method is used for solving the technical problem that the position of the softening area of the slope slip belt cannot be predicted by the conventional slope prediction method, so that effective help cannot be provided for preventing the slope.

title_en: Gas source supply regulation and control method for coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air supply regulation and control method for a coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiment, and relates to determination of air supply amount and regulation and control of air supply rate. The gas supplementing tank is externally connected with an input end and an output end, the input end is connected with the gas cylinder, the output end is used for supplementing gas to the protruding cavity, the output end is connected with the intelligent control module to control and dynamically monitor the gas supplementing amount and the gas supplementing speed, when the set gas supplementing amount is reached, the intelligent control module closes the output end, and gas supplementing is completed. The invention also provides a method for determining the set air supplement amount. The invention fully considers the action of gas desorption of the pressure-relief coal around the outburst hole on the outburst, and has positive significance for deeply researching the coal and gas outburst dynamic disaster effect and improving the understanding of the coal and gas outburst mechanism.

title_en: Dynamic smoke detection method based on video
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic smoke detection method based on a video, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a smoke training set and labeling, inputting images and corresponding labeling files in the smoke training set into a smoke static detection algorithm for training, inputting a video stream to be detected, which is acquired by a camera, into a trained smoke static detection algorithm to obtain a smoke detection frame, and screening the smoke target detection frame by using a non-maximum suppression algorithm based on a soft boundary; predicting the tracks of the smoke target through Kalman filtering, and performing IOU matching; obtaining a smoke target matching result through a Hungarian algorithm; drawing the smoke detection frame subjected to dynamic smoke detection screening on a corresponding video frame, and marking the prediction category information of the detection frame in the upper left corner area of the smoke detection frame. The invention can detect the smoke condition in real time when a fire disaster occurs, accurately detect and position the smoke and realize the real-time early warning function on the fire disaster.

title_en: Extraction borehole control range blank zone analysis method based on three-dimensional space
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a method for analyzing a blank zone in an extraction drill hole control range based on a three-dimensional space. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring position information of all drilling coal finding points and coal stopping points in the evaluation unit; constructing a three-dimensional coal bed according to the position information, constructing a three-dimensional extraction range model of the coal section according to the extraction radius of the drilled hole, and taking the sum of the three-dimensional extraction range models of all the coal sections as a drilling hole control range; and a coal section is formed between the single-drilling-hole coal observing point and the coal stopping point, and the blank zone of the drilling hole control range is determined by processing the three-dimensional coal bed and the drilling hole control range. Compared with the traditional analysis by means of a manual plan view, the method for determining the blank zone of the drilling control range can display the analysis result more three-dimensionally, visually and accurately; a data base is provided for blank band analysis by means of various automatic systems; the accurate positioning of the drilling blank belt and the automatic calculation of the coal volume can be realized.
assignees: GUANGLI TECH CO LTD;YONGMEI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Flink-based distributed disaster recovery drilling thread pool optimization and adaptation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed disaster recovery drilling thread pool optimization and adaptation method based on a Flink, the distributed data convergence is comprehensively adopted, and the edge nodes in each local network are utilized to train the central model, so that the central training model is optimized, and the training load of the central model is greatly reduced. The method comprises the steps of taking a Flink as a main calculation engine of a disaster recovery drilling data warehouse to solve a key link in a distributed disaster recovery drilling solution, storing local and cross-local privacy data and solving the adaptation problem between calculation engines through thread pool optimization and scheduling, combining a plurality of calculation optimization operation chains through special shared Slot characteristics of a thread pool constructed by the Flink, and simultaneously providing an optimal balance point between monitoring indexes of resource expense, infrastructure and performance expense mapping of each link of a central early warning model prediction operation chain constructed by artificial intelligence.

title_en: Construction method of three-dimensional scene of overhead transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a three-dimensional scene of an overhead transmission line, which relates to the technical field of overhead transmission lines and comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring data required by construction of a three-dimensional scene of an overhead transmission line; s2: preprocessing the acquired data; s3: carrying out three-dimensional modeling on a virtual scene of the overhead transmission line; s4: optimizing a virtual scene three-dimensional model of the overhead transmission line; according to the construction method of the overhead transmission line three-dimensional scene, disaster simulation can be carried out on the overhead transmission line, the constructed virtual disaster scene is obtained and then loaded to the overhead transmission line three-dimensional scene, and then the influence of disasters in the overhead transmission line three-dimensional scene on parts of the overhead transmission line is calculated through an influence model of disaster data on the overhead transmission line, so that the constructed overhead transmission line three-dimensional scene can simulate the influence of disasters on the overhead transmission line, and the constructed overhead transmission line three-dimensional scene can meet design requirements.

title_en: Risk assessment method for territorial space planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the risk of a national-soil space planning, which relates to the technical field of the national-soil space planning, and comprises the following steps of S1, researching the climate, topographic and topographic conditions, natural resource endowments such as water and soil, ecological environment capacity and other space background characteristics of a national-soil space planning region, analyzing the space matching relationship of a natural geographic pattern, population distribution and regional economic layout, and determining the maximum reasonable scale and the suitable space of agricultural production and urban construction; and S2, combining the trends of urbanization development, population distribution, economic development, technological progress, climate change and the like. The evaluation method of the invention identifies potential risks possibly faced in the aspects of ecological protection, natural disasters, homeland security and disease disasters, carries out scene simulation analysis, and then establishes a risk model according to the scene simulation analysis result, so that the risk disaster type and the disaster prevention and reduction target which need to be considered in the homeland space planning can be effectively determined, and early warning and guidance for the homeland space planning can be facilitated.

title_en: Method for determining gas supplementing amount required in coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the gas supplementing quantity required in a coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiment, which comprises the steps of calculating the equivalent radius of a outburst coal body, calculating the equivalent radius of a pressure relief area coal body except a outburst cavity, calculating the volume of the pressure relief area coal body except the outburst cavity, and obtaining the gas volume participating in outburst work of the pressure relief area by combining the coal seam gas pressure and the porosity of a coal layer on the basis, namely the gas supplementing quantity required in the coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiment. The invention gives the basis of determining the gas supplementing quantity on the premise of fully considering the action of the gas desorbed by the pressure-relief coal body around the outburst hole on the outburst, so that the research on the coal and gas disaster-causing simulation experiment is more complete, the research on the coal and gas outburst dynamic effect can be further deepened, and the understanding on the coal and gas outburst mechanism is further promoted from the perspective of the physical simulation experiment.

title_en: Subway station emergency response scheme optimization method and system under fire disaster condition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire emergency command, and particularly discloses a subway station emergency response scheme optimization method and system under fire conditions. The method comprises the steps of constructing a hierarchical timing color Petri net model to simulate different scenes of subway fire emergency response by using CPN Tools, constructing a multi-target optimization model of subway station fire emergency response by taking minimum emergency response time and minimum firefighter number as targets, solving the multi-target optimization model by using a Skyline Operator algorithm on the basis of a simulation data set to obtain a pareto front, and obtaining an optimal subway station emergency response scheme by using a fuzzy ideal point method. The method can synchronously optimize the time control and resource allocation of the subway station fire emergency response, and provide scientific guidance for real-time decision making of the subway fire emergency response.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning method for power transmission line pole tower under landslide geological disaster effect
abstract_en: A power transmission line pole tower monitoring and early warning method under the action of landslide geological disasters comprises the following steps: s1, analyzing a tower foundation deformation damage mode under the landslide action, and carrying out generalized classification on the damage mode; s2, drawing up a pole and tower foundation failure judgment criterion under the landslide action according to the current regulation standard and a numerical simulation method; s3, adopting an RTK real-time differential positioning monitoring mode to arrange an RTK reference station and a GNSS monitoring station by the aid of the tower foundation stability online monitoring and early warning system based on the GNSS, and accessing monitoring data to a network platform through a 4G network; s4, determining early warning thresholds corresponding to different deformation failure modes of the tower foundation based on the tower foundation failure judgment criterion and the monitoring index; and S5, realizing the functions of multi-task network communication, information management and tower foundation stability early warning and forecasting under the landslide geological disaster. According to the method, the deformation mode of the tower foundation under the landslide effect is fully considered, the early warning threshold value is closer to the current deformation state of the tower, and the damage degree of the tower is more comprehensively reflected.
assignees: POWERCHINA JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER DESIGNING INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Detection simulation device for fire disaster early warning
abstract_en: The application discloses detection simulation device of fire disaster early warning, the device includes fire disaster simulation device and early warning detection device, fire disaster simulation device includes the battery case, a plurality of baffles, the relief valve, electric heating element and temperature sensor, early warning detection device is including inhaling the sampling pipe and being connected in the detection host computer that inhales the sampling pipe, it is the position of first default distance to inhale the sampling pipe to be fixed in apart from fire disaster simulation device, when fire disaster simulation device's inside generates heat and its internal pressure exceeds the default pressure threshold value, the relief valve is opened in order to release the heat release particle, the detection host computer is through the heat release ion that inhales the sampling pipe and gathers, whether there is the conflagration hidden danger in the environment of analysis place. Therefore, the pyroelectric ions generated by heating are emitted through the safety valve through heating of the electric heating assembly, early fire disaster of the electric power equipment is simulated with high sensitivity, the pyroelectric ions in the ambient air are collected by utilizing the air suction sampling tube, and the hidden danger condition of the fire disaster is analyzed, so that the electric power system is effectively protected.

title_en: Safety risk assessment method for dam break destructiveness of tailing pond
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating safety risk aiming at dam break destructiveness of a tailing pond, which comprises the following steps: preliminarily researching the dam-break disaster characteristic of the tailing pond and the rheological characteristic of debris flow after dam break, and constructing an impact action risk evaluation system aiming at bridge engineering by combining a finite element simulation technology; determining assessment dimensions for systematically assessing the destructive effect of dam break debris flow of the tailing pond on adjacent constructions by combining a two-dimensional cloud model theory, namely dam break risk probability and dam break disaster severity; the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining weight through information entropy based on two dimensions, then generating an evaluation cloud picture by combining a reverse cloud model, generating left and right semi-clouds by combining a standard cloud model, finally judging the similarity of the evaluation cloud and the standard cloud through cloud similarity, and combining the similarity with the weight to obtain the dam break destructive safety level of each tailing pond. The method has accurate risk evaluation result and scientific evaluation process, and is suitable for performing systematic damage risk evaluation on dam break of the tailing pond.

title_en: Bedding drilling directional hydraulic kerf pressure relief and reflection increase method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mining. The method comprises dividing a coal seam into a plurality of grooving areas along the coal seam inclination direction, and supporting coal pillars at intervals between adjacent grooving areas; adopting ultrahigh-pressure bidirectional symmetrical water jet flow in each grooving region to directionally cut a plurality of slits by utilizing the water jet flow along the inclined direction of the coal seam, and reserving a spacing coal pillar between adjacent slits for supporting; all the slots form a plurality of pressure relief surfaces which are distributed in a layered manner; under the action of the overlying strata, the interval coal pillars are damaged, the coal body is integrally deformed gradually along the pressure release surface, the stress transfer is realized, and the air permeability is increased. The invention utilizes the ultra-high pressure bilateral symmetry Shui Sheliu to horizontally cut the layering with the height of 4-6 cm along the coal seam to form the pressure relief slot, realizes the overall uniform pressure relief and permeability increase in the coal seam in the slot cutting area, improves the gas extraction effect of the drilling holes, breaks through the limitation that the protective layer is not adopted for pressure relief of the coal seam without the protective layer and the first extraction protruding coal seam, and enriches the gas disaster management means of the coal mine.

title_en: Model device for simulating urban waterlogging road drainage mode under typhoon flood disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a model device of city waterlogging road drainage mode under simulation typhoon flood disaster includes at least: the urban road simulation box is internally provided with a simulation road panel and a combined drainage mechanism, and the combined drainage mechanism is used for simulating drainage modes and drainage efficiencies of the urban road under the conditions of at least different rainfall intensities, different drainage port distributions and different drainage pipeline blockage; the controllable rainfall mechanism is used for simulating a rainfall process and controlling the rainfall intensity in the test process; and the optical image acquisition mechanism is used for acquiring an optical image for simulating urban waterlogging road ponding. The model device establishes a scale model of urban road flood water accumulation and drainage coupling working conditions under a rainstorm environment, acquires the drainage mode and drainage efficiency of the urban road drainage system by simulating conditions such as different rainfall intensities, different drainage port distribution, different drainage pipeline blocking conditions and the like, and meets visual observation, is simple in structure, easy to operate and suitable for repeated tests.
assignees: XIAOREN HANGZHOU DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Deep lamellar surrounding rock large deformation active control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep lamellar surrounding rock large-deformation active control method and a deep lamellar surrounding rock large-deformation active control device, wherein the active control method comprises the following steps of: and (2) performing construction drilling on the tunnel surrounding rock by clinging to the tunnel face, then adding an active control device containing a sleeve, a high-strength prestressed anchor rod, a resin anchoring agent and a grouting device into the drilled hole, applying pretightening force to the anchor rod after the resin anchoring agent has certain strength, and performing lagging grouting on the surrounding rock through the grouting device after the stress adjustment is finished, wherein the high-strength prestressed anchor rod and the grouting device are inserted into the sleeve with a hole on the side face. The active control device or method can effectively reduce the fracture depth and degree of the deep engineering lamellar soft rock and effectively inhibit the occurrence of large deformation disasters.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Deep rock mass dynamic performance test system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep rock mass dynamic performance test system and method, and belongs to the field of deep rock mass test devices. The system comprises a test main body frame, a combined limiting device, a composite dynamic and static loading module, a high-precision monitoring module, an intelligent loading control module and a data storage module. The test main body frame is used for installing the composite dynamic and static loading module, placing the combined limiting device and providing restraint counter force. The combined limiting device is used for clamping a test object. Any dynamic and static type gas-liquid composite cylinder in the composite dynamic and static loading module can simulate different dynamic disasters so as to load and quickly unload a test object. The high-precision monitoring module is used for monitoring test process data. The intelligent loading control module controls the loading mode. The data storage module is used for storing and processing data. The system can simulate the situation of composite dynamic disasters under different working conditions in a laboratory according to the geological conditions of field engineering.

title_en: Large-deformation subarea bolting-grouting supporting device and method for fractured rock mass of high-stress tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geotechnical engineering, and discloses a large-deformation subarea bolting-grouting support device and method for a fractured rock mass of a high-stress tunnel. The high-strength prestressed anchor rod member comprises an anchor rod, an expansion anchoring agent, a decoupling material, a grouting device, a reverse anti-skid device and the like. The grouting device comprises a shallow grouting steel pipe, a deep grouting steel pipe and a grout stop valve, wherein the grouting steel pipe is arranged in the drill hole side by side with the anchor rod. The technical scheme provided by the invention can effectively inhibit the occurrence of large deformation disasters of the fractured rock mass.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Sea wave disaster risk assessment and division method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sea wave disaster risk assessment and division method and system, and relates to the technical field of natural disaster assessment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring and collecting basic data and historical observation data of a target area according to wave disaster evaluation and zoning requirements; carrying out sea wave element characteristic value statistics and space-time distribution characteristic analysis according to historical observation data to obtain corresponding statistical data and characteristic data; constructing and using hourly historical typhoon and wave data sets as simulation results; respectively calculating the annual average occurrence frequency and the proportion frequency of the four-level disastrous wave heights on each lattice point according to the simulation result; and performing risk assessment and zoning on the sea wave disaster in the target area according to the simulation result to obtain target sea wave disaster danger grade assessment data and target sea wave disaster danger zoning data. The invention can carry out efficient and accurate sea wave disaster assessment and division, and provides favorable support for ocean disaster prevention and reduction; and effective data reference can be provided for ocean construction.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA SEA FORECAST CENTER OF STATE OCEANIC ADMINISTRATION GUANGZHOU OCEAN FORECAST STATION OF

title_en: Large power grid static security risk analysis method based on dense power transmission channel disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power grids, and provides a large grid static security risk analysis method based on a dense power transmission channel disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining disaster data and historical fault data of key equipment of the dense power transmission channel of the large grid; risk pre-judgment is carried out according to the disaster data and the historical fault data, and a risk N-m fault set of the power grid is constructed according to a pre-judgment result; based on the risk N-m fault set, carrying out power grid safe operation risk feature mining under the equipment fault probability; risk quantitative grading is carried out through power grid operation trend analysis, a risk evaluation system is established by combining risk characteristic mining, and operation risk strategy multi-objective optimization, error analysis and model correction are carried out through the risk evaluation system. The online simulation calculation process of analyzing the real-time data of the power system is used for verifying the safety of the operation mode of the steady-state power system after an accident so as to improve the vigilance of operators or take measures in advance.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;CHIZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ANHUI JIYUAN SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Stress simulation device for building structure design
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a atress analogue means for building structure design, including atress analog mechanism, typhoon analog mechanism, earthquake analog mechanism, fan motor and earthquake analog motor, atress analog mechanism is including putting the thing dish, the bottom bilateral symmetry of putting the thing dish installs the vibrations spring, the bottom fixed mounting of vibrations spring has atress movable support, the top fixed mounting of atress movable support has vibration platform, vibration platform and the equal threaded connection in middle part of putting the thing dish have fixed knob, two rotate between the fixed knob and be connected with the atress bracing piece, the shock attenuation sliding sleeve is installed to vibration platform's bottom symmetry, the utility model discloses a set up the simulation that atress analog mechanism carries out the atress to the natural disasters that the building probably exists to realize the improvement on the building design, come interim at natural disasters, the building can keep off the atress influence that natural disasters brought, can guarantee people's life safety.

title_en: Network-level disaster recovery drilling method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a network-level disaster recovery drilling method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium, wherein a wireless standby network connection is established between a target node and a main center and a standby center in a multi-domain name mode, the standby wireless network connection is in a long-life mode, and the domain name priority of the main center is higher than that of the standby center, and the method comprises the following steps: responding to the disaster recovery drilling request, and disconnecting the wireless standby network connection; responding to the first terminal connection information of the main center, verifying whether a target node is successfully accessed to the wireless standby network based on the domain name of the main center, and if not, acquiring second terminal connection information of the standby center; and verifying whether the target node is successfully accessed to the standby network based on the domain name of the standby center based on the second terminal connection information. By the method, the problems that the network disaster recovery drilling process is complex, the cost is high and normal service operation is influenced can be effectively solved, and the effectiveness in the disaster recovery network verification process is improved.

title_en: Power transmission line maintenance sequence optimization decision method under extreme ice and snow disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission line maintenance sequence optimization decision method under extreme ice and snow disasters, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: according to the extreme ice and snow disaster meteorological characteristics, an extreme ice and snow disaster meteorological model which comprehensively considers instantaneous wind and icing gravity borne by the line from the double-layer angle of time and space is constructed, the influence condition of the line is calculated by combining a power transmission network, and the line breakage and outage probability is simulated; determining a fault scene set based on a Monte Carlo state sampling method and in combination with the line outage probability, and realizing system toughness evaluation by using a toughness evaluation index according to system response and recovery conditions; and carrying out optimization decision on the maintenance sequence of the power transmission line under the extreme ice and snow disaster, comparing and analyzing the maintenance sequence with the maintenance effect according to the line breakage sequence, and analyzing the influence of the maintenance sequence optimization decision method of the power transmission line on the toughness of the system by comparing the evaluation result of the toughness of the power system. Has the advantages of scientific and reasonable structure, strong applicability and good effect.
assignees: STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEAST DIANLI

title_en: Disaster recovery drilling method and device for business processing and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for disaster recovery drilling of business processing and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of disaster recovery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of drilling nodes, and establishing a mapping relation between the drilling nodes and one or more service groups, wherein the service groups comprise one or more drilling services; respectively sending a drilling indication message to the drilling nodes, wherein the drilling indication message carries the mapping relation and is used for indicating the drilling nodes to process corresponding drilling services based on the mapping relation; and responding to the service processing information of the plurality of drilling nodes to generate drilling data, wherein the service processing information is obtained by processing corresponding drilling services by the plurality of drilling nodes. By the method, automatic large-scale business-level drilling can be realized, the drilling efficiency is effectively improved, and the drilling cost is reduced.

title_en: Falling rock impact force non-contact type reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rockfall impact force non-contact reconstruction method and a rockfall impact force non-contact reconstruction system, which relate to the field of intelligent monitoring of geological disaster protection structures, and comprise the following steps: collecting a whole-process moving image sequence of the rockfall impact protection net; inputting the rockfall motion image sequence into a rockfall motion track prediction model, and outputting a rockfall track corresponding to the rockfall motion image sequence; the rockfall motion trajectory prediction model is obtained by utilizing deep neural network training; the rockfall trajectory is a motion trajectory of rockfall falling to the protective net until the rockfall falls to the protective net; and reconstructing the dynamic impact force of the rockfall impact protection net according to the rockfall track and the rockfall impact angle in each rockfall motion image. The invention overcomes the problem that the contact sensing technology is easy to be damaged by falling rocks and reduces the monitoring difficulty.

title_en: Control method of air conditioner, storage medium and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and particularly provides a control method of an air conditioner, a storage medium and the air conditioner, aiming at solving the problems that in the prior art, a circuit is burnt out and even a fire disaster is caused due to the fact that a house lizard, a young mouse and the like are drilled into an indoor unit or an outdoor unit to cause short circuits of a computer board, an electric device and the like. To this end, the control method of the present invention includes: whether living objects exist in the indoor electric appliance box and the outdoor electric appliance box is detected through the first detection assembly and the second detection assembly respectively; and selectively cutting off the power supply of the indoor unit and/or the outdoor unit according to the detection results of the first detection assembly and the second detection assembly. According to the invention, whether the power supplies of the indoor unit and the outdoor unit are cut off is determined according to the detection results of the first detection assembly and the second detection assembly, so that the situations that a circuit is burnt out and even a fire disaster is caused due to short circuit of a computer board, an electric device and the like caused by that live objects such as geckos, young mice and the like enter the indoor unit and the outdoor unit can be effectively avoided, and the safety of the air conditioner is improved.
assignees: QINGDAO HAIER AIR CONDITIONER;QINGDAO HAIER AIR CONDITIONER ELECTRIC CO LTD;HAIER SMART HOME CO LTD

title_en: Marine ranch disaster decision method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine ranch disaster decision method based on reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps: the interactive environment module constructs a virtual pasture sea area of the marine pasture; the disaster judgment module judges whether a disaster occurs in the marine ranch, and the action space module is used for outputting a feedback result by adopting a preset post-disaster action on the sea area of the virtual ranch; the decision module outputs preliminary decision data; the disaster judgment module judges whether the marine ranch disaster is finished or not and outputs a judgment result; the reward updating module calculates a reward value; after being corrected, the data are sequentially input into a parameter optimization module and a decision module for updating and optimizing; repeatedly acquiring a disaster judgment module and a decision module after training; and the disaster judgment module judges that disasters happen to the marine ranch, the trained decision module outputs monitoring decision data, and the decision is made for the marine ranch with the disasters according to the monitoring decision data. The method and the system can improve the accuracy and flexibility of marine ranch disaster decision, solve the problems of laggard risk disaster decision technology and the like, and improve the management and control efficiency.

title_en: Water-containing soil buried environment multi-source search and rescue equipment test dummy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test dummy system for multisource search and rescue equipment in a buried environment containing water and soil, which is formed by matching a main dummy body and a dummy vital sign simulation system arranged in the dummy body, wherein the dummy vital sign simulation system comprises a central control unit, a power supply unit, a breathing unit, a whole body temperature unit, an acoustic unit, a vibration unit, a trace gas secretion unit and a breathing thorax movement unit; the scheme provided by the invention has the characteristics of simulating dynamic respiration, typical expiration, gas secretion, sound, vibration, body temperature and the like of a human body under various life states under disaster conditions, has strong environmental adaptability and comprehensive simulation capability, and can meet the requirement of comprehensive efficiency test of water-bearing life search and rescue equipment.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Experience system suitable for children natural disaster science popularization and coping knowledge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an experience system suitable for children natural disaster science popularization and coping knowledge, which comprises an experience room, a disaster cinema room, a flood disaster coping experience device, a street wading coping and strong wind experiencing device, an earthquake coping experience device and an emergency experience device, wherein one side of the disaster cinema room is provided with a door; a chair, a cinema equipment room, a projection wall and a sound-absorbing soft bag are arranged in the disaster cinema room; the flood disaster coping experience device comprises a door opening, a window type modeling multimedia interactive game board, a soft package platform, a rubber-coated railing, first graffiti floor cement and a step arranged at the top of the first graffiti floor cement, wherein the door opening is formed in the inner wall of an experience room and is communicated with a disaster cinema room; the street wading coping and strong wind experience device comprises a display wall and a fan equipment box which are arranged oppositely; the earthquake coping experience device comprises a two-dimensional earthquake simulation platform; the first aid experience device comprises an ambulance model and a display and first aid equipment which are arranged in the ambulance model.
assignees: SHANGHAI JUNRONG CULTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Surface water dynamic simulation parallelization method based on pipeline network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface water dynamic simulation parallelization method based on a pipeline network, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a water flow path from a water flow source point to a drainage basin outlet, simplifying a three-dimensional surface into a one-dimensional pipeline network, then improving a classical Manning formula by using terrain parameters to estimate the flow rate of each water flow path, simulating the surface confluence by combining preset travel time, and finally parallelizing a flow rate estimation function and a surface confluence simulation function by using parallel calculation, thereby obtaining the high-precision and high-efficiency surface water dynamic simulation parallelization method. The invention considers the influence of the topography parameters on the runoff speed in the dynamic simulation of the surface water, applies the parallel technology CUDA to the dynamic simulation field of the surface water, improves the instant response efficiency of the dynamic simulation of the surface water on the premise of ensuring the accuracy of the dynamic simulation algorithm of the surface water, and lays a foundation for scientific homeland planning, water resource management and natural disaster response countermeasures.

title_en: Emergency public event emotion infection simulation method based on improved SIRS model
abstract_en: A sudden public event emotion infection simulation method based on an improved SIRS model provides a function for quantifying pedestrian panic emotion, and a related time-varying parameter calculation method for panic emotion infection of a crowd based on an infectious disease infection mechanism. The method comprises the steps of carrying out three-dimensional simulation modeling on a public place with sudden accidents by using computer simulation software, providing an emotion function for quantifying pedestrian risk perception, randomly setting emotion values of pedestrians to be evacuated, dividing emotion states according to pedestrian risk perception degrees, determining a time-varying parameter calculation method related to panic emotion infection of a crowd, establishing a SIRS state transfer relation considering the risk perception and self emotion adjustment of the pedestrians, determining evacuation speed of the pedestrians under the emotion infection, and carrying out simulation.

title_en: Life detector training device
abstract_en: The life detector training device comprises a storage box in which training articles can be placed, wherein a first detection opening is formed in the front side wall of the storage box and used for a life detector to penetrate through. The storage box simulates a collapsed building, and the detection port of the storage box simulates a hole at the collapsed position of the building; training articles such as dolls or buns are placed in the storage box to simulate persons trapped at collapsed positions of a building. The fire fighter holds the holding rod of life detection instrument, lets hold the terminal end of rod and stretch into the storage box through the detection mouth of storage box in, utilizes and installs the life detection instrument who holds the terminal end of rod and surveys, differentiatees out the shape whether has hidden article and incasement article in the incasement according to the detection result, practices to use life detection instrument with this mode. The firefighter does not need to go to a professional rescue training base, and can practice the use of the life detection instrument only by using the life detection instrument training device to simulate a collapsed building in which trapped people are buried, so that the firefighter can practice the use of the life detection instrument conveniently.
assignees: LiaoJie;ZHANG XIN;ROO SHING CO LTD;ZENG WU;HWANG GI;POK SANG BANG

title_en: Underwater optical disaster-causing biological recognition method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for identifying underwater optical disaster organisms. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data of different underwater pictures, and labeling disaster-causing organisms; constructing and training a teacher neural network based on the underwater picture data; generating a student neural network through the teacher neural network, and training the student neural network through an output result of the teacher neural network; and predicting and classifying disaster-causing organisms corresponding to the picture data on the underwater picture data according to the student neural network. The invention realizes the portability of equipment operation by utilizing the light-weight student YOLO network. The technical problem that small equipment is difficult to deploy strong hardware to meet the performance requirement of a complex network is solved. And the network can identify objects under different scales more easily by adopting a multi-dimensional feature extraction mode. And modifying the detection head of the network structure to enable each pixel point of the characteristic diagram to correspond to at least two prediction results in the prediction process, so that the recognition rate when the underwater creatures are overlapped is improved.

title_en: Disaster recovery system testing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for testing a disaster recovery system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. One embodiment of the method comprises: responding to the switching test instruction, calling a service scene simulation program, and sending service simulation data; acquiring a second system corresponding to the first system to trigger a system switching instruction, wherein the second system and the first system are disaster backup systems; inquiring a first service data table associated with a service scene in a second system so as to write service data into the first service data table and store the service data; acquiring a second service data table corresponding to the first service data table in the first system to call a preset calculation component and calculate the similarity between the first service data table and the second service data table; and determining the switching test result of the first system and the second system based on the similarity. The implementation method can solve the problems that the manual testing method is high in cost and low in efficiency due to the fact that service processing types are complex and tedious in many scenes.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORP;CCB FINTECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-based watershed flood beach disaster risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based method and a digital twin-based device for evaluating risks of flood area flood beach disasters, and relates to the technical field of evaluation of simulation disaster risks of flood area flood beach. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical hydrological information and real-time hydrological information of a drainage basin; processing historical hydrological information based on a digital twin simulation model to obtain N flood plain point positions of a drainage basin; determining the risk probability of the N overflowing beach point positions with overflowing beach disasters based on the water level overflowing beach influence factors of the N overflowing beach point positions; determining target flood plain point positions according to the risk probability to generate corresponding flood plain paths, and determining flood plain time corresponding to each target flood plain point position based on real-time hydrologic information; and evaluating the flood beach disaster risk level of the drainage basin based on the flood beach path, the flood beach time and the facility information corresponding to the flood beach path. The method solves the technical problem that the prior art cannot accurately evaluate the flood beach disaster risk level of the drainage basin.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG HYDROLOGY AND WATER RESOURCES BUREAU

title_en: Real-time risk probability calculation method for domino accident of fire disaster in chemical storage tank area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time risk probability calculation method of domino accidents of fire disaster in a chemical storage tank area, which relates to the technical field of fire risk assessment in the chemical storage tank area, and is characterized in that basic data related to a chemical storage tank is obtained, then the vulnerability parameters of the chemical storage tank are calculated, monte Carlo simulation is carried out by setting simulation parameters, so that a failed chemical storage tank is determined, the time and space synergistic effect are not considered, and the incident heat radiation intensity, theoretical failure time and equivalent heat radiation flux of the residual chemical storage tank are respectively calculated; and (3) respectively calculating the cooperative theoretical failure time, probability unit value, accident upgrading probability and time-varying failure probability of the chemical storage tank by considering the time and space cooperative effect, carrying out multiple simulation, and counting the occurrence frequency of each accident scenario to obtain the accident scenario probability and the failure time and time-varying failure probability of the storage tank under the cooperative effect, thereby realizing the function of real-time probability calculation.

title_en: Mine tailing pond disaster early warning method based on air-space-ground integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine tailing pond disaster early warning method based on air-space-ground integration, which comprises the following steps of: obtaining specific position, type and size information of the mine tailing pond through a remote sensing satellite; adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle shooting technology to obtain a landform image data image of the mine tailing pond; constructing a classification model, downloading a landform data image as a training set, inputting the landform data image into the classification model, and training to obtain a landform classification model output classification result of the mine tailing pond; carrying out structural stability data acquisition on the mine tailing pond with the land crack image landform, and selecting 6 influence factors as parameters influencing the stability performance of the mine tailing pond; constructing and training a BP neural network; inputting the stable performance parameters into the trained BP neural network to obtain a prediction safety coefficient; and when the safety coefficient of the tailing pond reaches a threshold range, early warning is sent out. The invention can effectively acquire the parameter data of the tailing pond by using a machine learning method, and can timely and effectively early warn the risks of the tailing pond.
assignees: SICHUAN COAL MINE SAFETY SUPERVISION BUREAU SAFETY TECH CENTER;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Mine robot integrating disaster prevention, reduction and rescue and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine robot integrating disaster prevention, disaster reduction and rescue, which comprises crawler wheels, a support frame positioned above the crawler wheels, an intelligent control system positioned on the support frame, a water spraying device and a drilling device, wherein a micro-seismic monitoring device, an explosion-proof motor, an explosion-proof storage battery and the water spraying device are arranged on the support frame I, an explosion-proof camera and the drilling device are arranged on the support frame II, a support rod and a safety rope are arranged on the support frame III, the intelligent control system, a positioning system, an infrared detector, a gas concentration sensor, a CO concentration sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor and a dust concentration sensor are arranged on the support frame IV, and the crawler wheels are symmetrically arranged below the support frame. The invention discloses a robot integrating disaster prevention, disaster reduction and rescue for mines, which has the advantages of multiple functions, wide application range and strong comprehensive performance, is suitable for disaster prevention, disaster reduction and post-disaster rescue of mines, is also suitable for post-disaster rescue of other accidents, and can well guarantee the safety of rescuers.

title_en: Deep disaster and control three-dimensional simulation test system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep disaster and control three-dimensional simulation test system and a method, belonging to the technical field of deep rock dynamic disaster simulation, wherein the system comprises a frame component, an automatic proportioning subsystem, a model body preparation subsystem, a transfer device, a comprehensive loading and unloading subsystem, a tunneling support subsystem and an intelligent monitoring device, wherein the automatic proportioning subsystem mixes a plurality of raw materials to form proportioning materials; the model body preparation subsystem is used for preparing a model body; the comprehensive loading and unloading subsystem is used for comprehensively loading the model body transported by the transporting device; the tunneling support subsystem is used for performing tunneling support simulation on the model body; the intelligent monitoring device comprises an imaging assembly and a controller, wherein the controller is used for monitoring the automatic proportioning subsystem, the model body preparation subsystem, the transfer device, the comprehensive loading and unloading subsystem, the tunneling support subsystem and the imaging assembly. The invention can realize the integrated comprehensive simulation of model body manufacturing, loading, excavation, supporting, monitoring and analysis.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;BEIJING LI YAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster simulation method and device based on two-dimensional prediction and multi-scale grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction in civil engineering, in particular to a fire simulation method and device based on two-dimensional prediction and multi-scale grids, wherein the fire simulation method based on the two-dimensional prediction and the multi-scale grids comprises the following steps: importing building group data, and obtaining a building group two-dimensional model according to the building group data; carrying out three-dimensional modeling according to the building group two-dimensional model to obtain a building group three-dimensional model; based on the building group two-dimensional model, estimating a two-dimensional fire spread range according to a fire spread mechanism and historical fire statistics data; obtaining a target building group three-dimensional model based on the building group three-dimensional model according to the two-dimensional fire spread range; and carrying out efficient three-dimensional fire simulation of the building group based on the target building group three-dimensional model. The invention can finish the fine fire simulation of the building group in a short time based on two-dimensional prediction and variable multi-scale grids and combined with the three-dimensional model of the building group.

title_en: Urban road and tunnel entrance flooding and disaster individual identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for identifying urban road and tunnel entrance flooding and disaster-suffered individuals, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1: collecting videos of urban road ponding conditions and normal conditions for preprocessing to obtain a sample set 1, and preprocessing videos containing vehicles and pedestrians under the two conditions to obtain a sample set 2; step S2: inputting the sample set 1 into an urban road flooding monitoring model for training, and detecting whether road flooding occurs or not; and step S3: inputting the sample set 2 into a disaster individual monitoring model for training, and identifying whether a disaster vehicle or a pedestrian exists; and step S4: and cascading the trained urban road flooding monitoring model and the trained individual disaster monitoring model, and starting the individual disaster monitoring model to monitor whether the urban road flooding monitoring model has the disaster vehicles and pedestrians when the prediction result of the urban road flooding monitoring model indicates that the urban road flooding occurs. The method provided by the invention can monitor the urban flooding and disaster individual conditions in real time and send out early warning.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: MTS equipment wall body antidetonation auxiliary device of angularly adjustable
abstract_en: The invention provides an angle-adjustable MTS equipment wall anti-seismic accessory device, belongs to the technical field of natural disaster simulation, and solves the problem that the ground angle cannot be simulated when an MTS equipment wall anti-seismic body is used for carrying out anti-seismic simulation on a wall at present, and simultaneously solves the problem that splash is generated when the wall collapses and dust is generated by the wall collapse to influence the safety of workers in the anti-seismic simulation of the wall. This MTS equipment wall body antidetonation auxiliary device of angularly adjustable, including MTS equipment wall body antidetonation body, all be fixed with the hydraulic stem around MTS equipment wall body antidetonation body top. When the earthquake-proof wall is used, workers can simulate the earthquake condition of the wall on the ground at different angles by using the built-in equipment, can avoid the safety of the workers from being damaged by waste residues splashed by the collapse of the wall, and can treat dust generated by the collapse by using the dust collection mechanism and the spraying mechanism.

title_en: Improved disaster news three-factor extraction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved disaster news three-factor extraction method. The method comprises the following steps: constructing and training a BILSTM-based element classification model, a disaster topic classification model and a named entity recognition model; carrying out data preprocessing on the disaster news text; determining the disaster theme of the preprocessed disaster news text by using a disaster theme classification model; determining three elements of the preprocessed disaster news text by using an element classification model; and extracting time and place entities from the region by using the element entity identification model to obtain the time and place of the disaster.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Subway station flood prevention emergency plan deduction method based on station simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway station flood prevention emergency plan deduction method based on station simulation, which is characterized in that a subway station building needing emergency plan formulation is selected, a 3D simulation model of the selected subway station building is built based on MassMotion, the built 3D simulation model is called to simulate the distribution of accumulated water points, the accumulated water area, the water level height, the calling of flood prevention goods and materials and the personnel evacuation condition in the subway station building, a flood prevention emergency plan is formulated according to the simulation result, response logic is configured for the flood prevention emergency plan, and the flood prevention emergency plan is called to be processed when the accumulated water time meets the preset condition.
assignees: NANJING PANDA ELECTRONICS CO;NANJING PANDA INF IND CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster image recognition method based on color feature mutual information quantity
