abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire image recognition method based on color feature mutual information, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a fire image and a non-fire image library based on real scene shooting and a forest fire image library, simultaneously extracting Lab, RGB, HSV image color cast factors and variances under three color modes to serve as color feature information, secondly, performing color feature combination optimization based on the mutual information, taking the optimized color combination features as input data, and finally, performing recognition model training based on 160 layers of single hidden layer full-connection networks, and simultaneously optimizing training model parameters to complete fire image recognition. Compared with the traditional fire image recognition color features, the invention selects the color cast factors and variances based on Lab, RGB, HSV color modes as the color features, and simultaneously, in order to better reduce the calculation cost caused by multiple inputs, the invention also performs feature selection based on the mutual information quantity, thereby well reducing the redundancy degree of input data.

title_en: Flood inundation area extraction method based on decision-level data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood inundation area extraction method based on decision-level data fusion. The method comprises the steps of combining image wave bands of Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 in a training set, inputting the combined image wave bands into a deep neural network, training to obtain a plurality of water body extraction models, respectively screening out models with highest extraction precision for non-cloud-mist covered non-water body areas, non-cloud-mist covered water body areas and cloud-mist covered areas by calculating the water body extraction precision of each model in a test set, finally fusing the extraction results of the three models in disaster areas by using a decision tree to obtain pre-disaster and post-disaster water body areas, and subtracting the pre-disaster water body range from the post-disaster water body range to obtain a flood inundation area of a research area. The method has the advantages that the image difference between the cloud-free and cloud-free conditions is fully considered, the cloud and cloud-free areas are extracted by using different models, and the extraction results are fused by using the decision tree, so that the water extraction precision of the cloud-free areas is ensured, and the water extracted by the cloud and cloud areas is more complete.

title_en: Ground disaster sample AI identification labeling method and system based on expert scoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground disaster sample AI identification labeling method and system based on an expert scoring system, comprising the following steps of S1, obtaining ground disaster sample data, weighting the ground disaster sample data, obtaining an initial weight sample, training the initial weight sample to obtain an identification model, S2, identifying and labeling the labeled ground disaster sample data and the unlabeled ground disaster sample data in the ground disaster sample data based on the identification model, S3, evaluating the ground disaster sample data after identification labeling based on the expert scoring system, weighting the evaluation result to obtain the weight sample, selecting a qualified weight sample, and leading the qualified weight sample into a sample library, S4, retraining the identification model according to the weight sample, and conducting identification labeling again on the unqualified weight sample, S5, returning to S3 until the ground disaster sample data is completely led into the sample library to finish identification labeling.

title_en: Tunnel structure disaster detection early warning model test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tunnel structure disaster detection early warning model test device, which comprises a model box, a model tunnel, a pressurizing unit and a data acquisition unit, wherein the model box is provided with a pressure sensor; the model tunnel is arranged in the model box, and simulated soil is filled between the inner wall of the model box and the outer wall of the model tunnel; the pressurizing unit comprises clamping plates, reinforcing steel bars and ropes, wherein the clamping plates surround the periphery of the model tunnel to form a ring shape, two adjacent clamping plates are mutually embedded and connected through teeth arranged at the end parts, the reinforcing steel bars are arranged at the end parts of the clamping plates, one ends of the ropes are fixed on the reinforcing steel bars at the end parts of the clamping plates, the other ends of the ropes penetrate through the model box to be connected with the traction device, the ropes are drawn, the ropes pull the clamping plates surrounding the ring shape to shrink, and the model tunnel is pressurized through simulated soil; the data acquisition unit comprises potentiometers and pressure testers, the potentiometers are arranged on the inner wall and the outer wall of the model tunnel, and the pressure testers are arranged between the clamping plate and the model tunnel and on the outer wall of the model tunnel; the device can simulate various complex stress working conditions.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;CCCC TUNNEL BRIDGE NANJING TECH CO LTD;CCCC INFRASTRUCTURE MAINTENANCE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of composite agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring index system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a composite agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring index system, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining a RICE agricultural meteorological observation station, determining process variables such as LAI, overground biomass, nitrogen accumulation and the like by using RICE observation data of 5-6 years of continuous planting, and realizing simulation of a CERES-RICE model on yield and grain protein content; s2, constructing a rice quality prediction model based on spectrum-statistics; s3, after the DSSAT model is subjected to localized parameter adjustment and remote sensing data and the crop model are assimilated, introducing time series crop growth remote sensing data based on a GIS technology, and calling the crop model by utilizing Matlab to realize refined simulation of the regional scale; s4, based on the step S3, establishing a composite agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring index system according to the time-space distribution rule of major composite disasters; the method stabilizes the status of national important grain production bases, prevents agricultural disasters, stabilizes the yield and increases the yield, and provides technical support for guaranteeing grain safety.
assignees: CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION SHENYANG INST OF ATMOSPHERIC ENVIRONMENT

title_en: Experimental device for simulating spontaneous combustion of residual coal in goaf of coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulation coal mine goaf remains coal spontaneous combustion experimental apparatus, including the laboratory bench, be equipped with coal sample preprocessing unit, coal sample reaction unit and gas chromatograph on test table face respectively, coal sample reaction unit includes air pump, support and establishes the coal sample reaction box on the support, is equipped with the case lid at the top of coal sample reaction box, and the inner wall winding at coal sample reaction box has the heater strip, and the heater strip is connected with the temperature controller electricity of establishing at the outside of coal sample reaction box, is equipped with the net section in the inside of coal sample reaction box, is equipped with temperature sensor in the sectional bottom of net, and temperature sensor is connected with the temperature controller electricity, is equipped with first through-hole in the bottom of coal sample reaction box, and the air pump passes through the pipeline and is connected with first through-hole, is equipped with the second through-hole on the case lid, and gas chromatograph passes through pipeline and second through-hole connection. The device can simulate the spontaneous combustion process of the remaining coal truly, and provides scientific basis for preventing and treating coal fire disasters.
assignees: GUONENG SHENDONG COAL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Rainstorm flood disaster simulation system based on multi-agent interaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rainstorm flood disaster simulation system based on multi-agent interaction, which comprises: a precipitation agent configured to: generating a rainfall output result of the area to be simulated according to the received rainfall parameters; a grid agent configured to: receiving elevation data of an area to be simulated, and outputting water level parameters of the earth surface of the area to be simulated according to a rainfall output result of the rainfall agent; a GIS agent configured to: and receiving the urban GIS information of the area to be simulated, and calculating the water flow on the earth surface of the area to be simulated according to the water level parameters output by the grid intelligent body to obtain a disaster affected result. Compared with the prior art, the intelligent agent interaction method has the advantages that intelligent agent interaction is applied to disaster simulation, and multi-parameter custom input of precipitation data is supported, model output is diversified, and the like.

title_en: Semi-supervised learning deep cut valley intelligent identification method based on remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image-based intelligent recognition method for deep river valley through semi-supervised learning, which belongs to the technical field of image processing and comprises the following steps: step S1: selecting a satellite remote sensing image and Digital Elevation Model (DEM) data of a multi-scene covered deep cut river valley landform, and establishing an intelligent recognition data set of the deep cut river valley landform; step S2: constructing a deep convolutional neural network coding model by using a ResNet50 algorithm structure, a channel and a space attention mechanism based on a deep learning coding principle; and step S3: constructing an auxiliary decoder model under the intelligent recognition main decoder and the characteristic disturbance function of the deep river valley based on the semi-supervised learning and decoding theory; and step S4: and constructing and training an intelligent recognition model of the deep cut river valley, and carrying out intelligent recognition on the deep cut river valley by using the intelligent recognition model of the optimal deep cut river valley. The method can accurately identify the landform of the deep cut river valley under a small amount of label sample data, and realize the rapid general survey of geological disasters in complex and difficult mountain areas.

title_en: Physical simulation method for research on water intake entrainment effect of offshore power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean engineering, in particular to a physical simulation method for researching water intaking and entrainment effects of offshore power plants, which comprises the following steps: obtaining marine organisms and marine garbage types corresponding to water intake entrainment disasters of an offshore power plant, and obtaining outbreak characteristics and high-frequency outbreak positions of the characteristic disaster-causing objects by using the marine organisms and the marine garbage types as characteristic disaster-causing objects; carrying out physical experiments on hydraulic characteristic parameters such as density, starting flow velocity, sedimentation velocity and water motion coefficients of the characteristic disaster causing object, establishing an integral normal hydrodynamic physical model containing the researched power plant water taking project and the surrounding sea area thereof, simultaneously considering the comprehensive action of tide, waves and open channel water taking in the model, and selecting the entity model characteristic disaster causing object meeting the similarity of the density, the starting flow velocity, the sedimentation velocity and the water motion coefficients, so that the entity model characteristic disaster causing object can accurately reflect the real motion characteristic and the track of the characteristic disaster causing object.

title_en: Urban flooding citizen support service provision system
title_ko: 도심지 침수 시민지원 서비스 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an urban flooding citizen support service provision system, which allows flooding prediction and prevention to be made through predictive simulation for risky areas where human life and property damage are concerned when flooding occurs in an urban area, but can minimize damage to citizens in the event of flooding through evacuation/detour route guidance linked to local traffic conditions and rapid real-time situation propagation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도심지에 침수 발생시 인명 및 재산피해가 우려되는 위험지역을 대상으로 예측 시뮬레이션을 통해 침수 예측과 예방이 이루어지도록 하되, 지역의 교통상황과 연계한 대피·우회 경로 안내 및 신속한 실시간 상황전파를 통해 침수 발생 시 시민의 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 도심지 침수 시민지원 서비스 제공 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Mine water disaster rescue borehole bottom air pressure maintaining ventilation device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine drilling, in particular to a hole bottom air pressure maintaining and ventilating device for mine water disaster rescue drilling, which comprises a drill rod, wherein the drill rod is hollow, a channel for communicating the space of underground trapped personnel with the ground is formed, and the channel can be opened and closed through a valve; an expansion capsule is arranged on the outer side of the drill rod, and the expansion capsule can realize expansion and contraction through introducing gas and exhausting gas; the expansion capsule is arranged at a position close to the bottom of the drill hole, an air inlet pipe is arranged at a position, on the ground, of the drill rod, the air inlet pipe is connected with a fan, and an exhaust pipe penetrating through the expansion capsule is arranged between the drill rod and the hole wall. And a nutrient solution input port is integrally formed with the air inlet pipe and is connected with a nutrient solution pump so as to convey nutrient solution to underground personnel. The invention also provides a method for pressure maintaining and ventilation of air at the hole bottom of the mine water disaster rescue drill hole.
assignees: CHINA COAL GEOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Vulnerability model construction method suitable for wind power tower structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a vulnerability model applicable to a wind power tower structure. The method comprises the steps of establishing a finite element model of a wind power tower structure, judging the type of disasters to be considered according to the geographic position and basic form of the model, simulating load time courses corresponding to the disasters to be considered, carrying out damage level on each part of the wind power tower, defining quantization indexes corresponding to each damage level, carrying out calculation analysis on the quantization indexes in finite element numerical simulation, carrying out nonlinear power time course analysis and incremental power analysis based on the finite element model and the simulated load time courses, constructing a fragility model, determining a loss ratio probability distribution model corresponding to the performance level of each part of the wind power tower, and establishing a vulnerability model based on the fragility model and the loss ratio probability model or the loss ratio constant value of each part of the wind power tower. The method aims at the vulnerability assessment of the wind power tower structure, and fills the gap in the technical field of the current wind power tower disaster risk assessment.

title_en: Structural engineering disaster prevention performance evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating disaster prevention performance of structural engineering, which relate to the technical field of engineering evaluation, and the method comprises the following steps: performing three-dimensional modeling based on the structural engineering region image set and structural engineering material information to obtain a structural engineering three-dimensional scene model; determining disaster simulation parameters according to the engineering application information; calling an identification disaster prevention performance evaluation model based on the disaster simulation parameters; inputting the structural engineering three-dimensional scene model and the disaster simulation parameters into the identification disaster prevention performance evaluation model to obtain a structural engineering disaster prevention performance coefficient; and carrying out disaster prevention management on the structural engineering based on the structural engineering disaster prevention performance coefficient. The method achieves the technical effects that the structural engineering disaster prevention condition is simulated and evaluated by constructing the disaster prevention performance evaluation model, the result of the disaster prevention performance evaluation is more comprehensive and accurate, the disaster prevention effect of the structural engineering is improved, and the use quality of the structural engineering is further ensured.

title_en: Construction method, device and processing equipment for transparent geological model of coal mine
abstract_en: The application provides a construction method, a device and processing equipment for a transparent geological model of a coal mine, which are used for constructing the transparent geological model of the coal mine and a matched geomechanical information three-dimensional visualization system thereof, wherein the transparent geological model of the coal mine can be called, displayed, stored and subjected to curve analysis in real time, so that the transparent geological model of the coal mine is beneficial to accurate prevention and treatment of deep mining disasters in practical application. The application provides a method for constructing a transparent geological model of a coal mine, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that processing equipment builds a database of a target coal mine area, wherein the database comprises a surrounding rock mechanical parameter database and a ground stress database; the processing equipment builds a three-dimensional model of the target coal mine area, wherein the three-dimensional model comprises a three-dimensional drilling model and a three-dimensional geological model; the processing equipment constructs a coal mine transparent geological model of a target coal mine area and a geomechanical information three-dimensional visualization system matched with the coal mine transparent geological model on the basis of the database and the three-dimensional model.

title_en: Non-rotating down-the-hole hammer drill and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-rotating down-the-hole hammer drill which comprises a guide frame, a cluster down-the-hole hammer, a swing driving device and the like. The guide frame guides the drilling direction, the swing driving device drives the cluster down-the-hole hammer to swing linearly and symmetrically, and the down-the-hole hammer impacts ground rock chiseling. The invention overcomes the defects that the prior foundation drilling machine bit rotating technical scheme has complex and heavy structure, too small rotating moment, difficult sealing, easy abrasion and incapability of drilling ultra-deep and ultra-large well holes. The invention has the advantages of simple, reliable and durable equipment structure and high drilling speed, is suitable for working under water pressure with over 10 meters of super-large diameter and kilometer-level depth, can drill rectangular and round well holes, and can be applied to underground continuous wall slot milling machines, vertical shaft drilling machines, vertical shaft heading machines, mine disaster emergency rescue drilling machines and submersible drilling machines. The invention also discloses a using method of the non-rotating down-the-hole hammer drill.
assignees: WUHAN TONGTUXIN ROAD AND BRIDGE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Emergency logistics flow multitask scheme on-line adjustment method, device, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a multitask scheme on-line adjustment method, device, terminal and medium in urgent logistics. The method comprises the following steps: determining initial emergency logistics multitask scheme data according to disaster situations and traffic network resources; under the disaster condition, channel damage data and node damage data are obtained; determining affected tasks in the initial emergency logistics multitask scheme data according to the channel damage data and the node damage data; optimizing and adjusting the affected tasks according to a simulated annealing algorithm to obtain optimized emergency logistics multitask scheme data; and replacing the initial emergency logistics multitask scheme data with the optimized emergency logistics multitask scheme data. The method can well solve the problem of on-line adjustment of the multi-task scheme under the emergency material flow, and has the advantages of simple steps, clear results and easy operation.

title_en: High-yield high-disease-resistance modular culture box for konjak breeding
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modular incubator for propagation of high-yield and high-disease-resistance konjak, which comprises a box body, wherein the upper surface of the box body is provided with a water tank, the surface of the water tank is communicated with a connecting pipe, and the connecting pipe extends to the interior of the box body; the partition plate is positioned inside the box body, and the box body is divided into a plurality of culture chambers through the partition plate; the outer surface of the culture pot is sleeved with a residual water pot, and the bottom of the culture pot is provided with a water control hole; the fan is located at the top end of the box body, an air pipe is fixedly connected to the output end of the fan, and the air pipe is communicated with the inside of the box body. Through above structure, can make unnecessary moisture control out through surplus basin to when the evaporation, make moisture get into through accuse water hole and cultivate the basin, replenish moisture, reduce and add water number of times and frequency, and through tuber pipe simulation disaster, make the konjaku prick the root firm.
assignees: HUIZE SHUNLEI AGRICULTURAL DEV CO LTD

title_en: Smart Respirator for fireman
title_ko: 소방관용 스마트 공기호흡기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart respirator for a firefighter using a sensor and communication technology for detecting respiration, which not only quickly detects whether a firefighter is in a dangerous state, but also has very high accuracy. In addition, the smart respirator for a firefighter is much more inexpensive than conventional wearable devices for a firefighter, and has convenience of being easily combined and used without replacing or drilling a hole in the existing mask.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 호흡을 감지하는 센서 및 통신기술을 이용한 소방관용 스마트 공기호흡기에 관한 것으로 소방관의 위험상태 여부를 빨리 감지할 뿐만 아니라 정확도가 매우 높고, 종래의 소방관용 웨어러블 기기보다 훨씬 저렴하면서도 기존 마스크를 교체하거나 구멍을 뚫지 않고도 쉽게 결합하여 사용할 수 있는 편리성을 갖춘 스마트 공기호흡기에 관한 발명이다.

title_en: Design method of indoor fire-fighting map based on space cognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method of an indoor fire-fighting map based on spatial cognition, and relates to the field of fire-fighting safety. The method for designing the indoor fire-fighting map based on space cognition specifically comprises the following steps of building a S1.BIM model, integrating S2.GIS data, expressing indoor space division S3, expressing fire-fighting thematic factors S4, designing the fire-fighting map S5, planning an evacuation route S6, constructing an auxiliary management system S7, simulating a fire simulation experiment S8, and making an emergency treatment plan S9. The BIM model is converted into the 3DTiles data format of the three-dimensional GIS conforming to the OGC standard through semantic extraction and geometric conversion, and meanwhile, the data mapping is established through the database, so that the BIM data are integrated completely, the rendering strength of the model is greatly reduced, the data stability is improved, and the effective dynamic route is provided for the evacuation of firefighters in indoor rescue operation through different map elements designed by attribute characteristics and the cognitive characteristics of firefighters, so that the life safety of the personnel is greatly ensured.

title_en: Method for determining spatial line position of shallow natural gas railway in oil-gas-containing zone
abstract_en: A method for determining the spatial line position of a shallow natural gas railway in an oil-gas-containing area is used for ensuring that railway engineering passes through an area with lower disaster risk level, greatly reducing line selection cost, saving investigation period and realizing the economical efficiency and rationality of the engineering to the greatest extent. The method comprises the steps of arranging a controlled geological cross section when a line passes through an oil-gas-containing area, filling stratum structures and geological structures on the controlled geological cross section according to regional geology, geotexture adjustment and oil-gas field exploration production and drilling engineering data, dividing the shallow natural gas cross section of the oil-gas-containing area into a gas generation layer, a gas storage layer and a cover layer, and bypassing the high-risk gas storage layer and the extremely high-risk gas generation layer through coordination of space line bit plane position adjustment and space line bit vertical section position adjustment so that a railway tunnel passes through the medium-low-risk cover layer and avoids oil-gas drilling and deep large faults for a certain distance.

title_en: Power distribution network elasticity evaluation method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network elasticity evaluation method, which is applied to the technical field of power systems and comprises the following steps: acquiring historical and current power distribution network information and disaster information and power distribution network elasticity indexes, wherein the power distribution network elasticity indexes comprise time level indexes and source network load reservoir level indexes; simulating historical and current power distribution network information and disaster information to obtain a functional curve graph; and calculating the elasticity index of the power distribution network according to the functional curve graph, historical power distribution network information and disaster information in the current period, and determining the elasticity level of the power distribution network. According to the method, the multi-time scale distribution network elasticity index considering the source network load storage is constructed, so that the elasticity level of the distribution network under the disaster can be comprehensively and effectively evaluated, and guidance can be provided for the improvement of the elasticity level of the distribution network under the disaster. In addition, the invention also provides a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which also have the beneficial effects.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HUADIAN EQUIPMENT TESTING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method for water inrush disaster of tunnel in water-rich complex stratum
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method of a water inrush disaster of a tunnel in a water-rich complex stratum, which comprises the following steps of: simulating a tunnel excavation process by using finite element software MIDAS GTS NX and a fluid-solid coupling principle to study the influence of different underground water levels, elastic modulus and forepoling grouting on the stability of surrounding rocks by using a controlled variable method and carrying out risk grade evaluation on the water inrush disaster in the Qingdao area by improving a RBF neural network based on gray associated PAM; the method can effectively reduce the sample dimension, reduce the operation difficulty of iteration while keeping the noise elimination of the original structure of the data, avoid the problems that the traditional model needs manual adjustment and the iteration speed is slow by the PAM clustering and gradient descent method, improve the risk prevention capability of professional technicians in tunnel or underground engineering construction, and provide effective help for the prevention and treatment of sudden water gushing in Qingdao subway tunnel construction.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP;UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGICAL;NO 5 ENG CORPORATION OF CHINA RAILWAY 19 BUREAU GROUP

title_en: Crowd emergency evacuation simulation method based on composite routing structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a crowd emergency evacuation simulation method based on a composite routing structure, which comprises the following steps: selecting a target emergency evacuation outlet for the crowd to be dismissed based on a pre-established topological map; determining an optimal path from the initial position of the crowd to be untwined to a target emergency evacuation exit based on the topological map; iteratively calculating the target position of each pedestrian in the crowd to be dismissed at the next moment based on the pre-established grid map and the optimal path; and simulating the moving track of each pedestrian in the crowd to be untwined. The scheme comprehensively calculates the macroscopic, medium and microscopic three-level routes, has the characteristics of strong adaptability and high efficiency, can assist venue managers to formulate, optimize and evaluate emergency evacuation schemes, and effectively reduces the life and property loss of venue population under emergency conditions.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Single landslide early warning and forecasting method based on space-time combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single landslide early warning and forecasting method based on space-time union, and relates to the technical field of landslide early warning, wherein a time forecasting model is used for exploring an internal mechanism of landslide evolution and forecasting landslide failure time according to landslide monitoring data, so that landslide prevention and control and crowd evacuation work are carried out; the space forecasting model is used for simulating the space distribution of the soil parameters after acquiring the real soil parameter space distribution data, and further acquiring the sliding distance of the landslide and the exceeding probability curve of the sliding distance by a large deformation calculation method so as to achieve the purpose of really forecasting the sliding distance after the landslide occurs; according to the method, the monomer landslide is early-warned and forecasted by adopting the joint forecasting of the time scale and the space scale; the natural disaster early warning mechanism and the landslide evolution space-time characteristics are fully considered, and key early warning work such as landslide failure time early warning and landslide influence range can be effectively carried out.

title_en: Slope inclination angle monitoring device and slope safety coefficient calculation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope inclination angle monitoring device and a slope safety coefficient calculation method, which relate to the technical field of mountain disaster prevention and control and comprise the steps of acquiring slope data, establishing a three-dimensional model based on the slope data, simulating second parameter information of each through surface in all sliding states on the three-dimensional model, obtaining simulated inclination angle values of all the through surfaces in a simulated mode, establishing a relation network of the simulated inclination angle values and the second parameter information, determining the sliding state and the second parameter information of the slope through surface corresponding to the actual inclination angle values according to the simulated inclination angle values after the actual inclination angle values are obtained through measurement, and calculating the safety coefficient of the slope through surface corresponding to the actual inclination angle values.

title_en: Movable type disaster psychological behavior training device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a movable type disaster psychological behavior training device, which comprises a mobile device, a disaster psychological behavior training channel, a training background environment simulation device and a control system; the mobile device is a splicing mobile box body, and the mobile box bodies are respectively provided with independent control systems; the disaster psychological behavior training channel is arranged in a training room of the mobile device and is obtained by splicing the cage bodies; the training background environment simulation device comprises smoke simulation equipment, thermal simulation equipment, noise simulation equipment and light simulation equipment, wherein the control system is installed in the control room, displays control information in real time and controls the operation of controlled equipment comprising the training background environment simulation device. The training device can also comprise an obstacle simulation device, a stepping tracking device, a monitoring device and a safety guarantee device, can realize a movable training device, is real in training environment, increases the diversity and complexity of training forms, and improves the training experience.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE INST METROLOGY & MEASUREMENT TECH

title_en: High altitude climbing trainer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of high altitude climbing training technique and specifically relates to a high altitude climbing trainer, include the bar body that mainly comprises horizontal bar and two supports, two install on the support the horizontal bar, still be equipped with on the bar body the horizontal bar with landing training mechanism who connects between the support, landing training mechanism includes two connectors, two connecting tubes, two sets of landing subassemblies and two sets of block subassemblies, the equal fixedly connected with in horizontal bar both ends the connector, the connector is kept away from one side of horizontal bar is equipped with connecting tube, training reaction capability and training keep the vigilance of health, still strengthen the explosive power of health, can carry out the adaptability training of stage nature, the increase degree of difficulty gradually, improve the training effect of device for when high altitude danger takes place, not only form muscle memory, improve personnel's emergency response and handling situation through the training, improve personnel's operation's viability.

title_en: Mine roof water damage monitoring method based on induced polarization method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a mine roof water disaster monitoring method and related equipment based on an induced polarization method, and provides two drilling modes according to the development position of a water-flowing fractured zone on a mine roof: when the water flowing fractured zone grows to the ground, one side of the mine roof close to the ground is selected for vertical drilling, so that the monitoring accuracy is ensured, and meanwhile, the electrode strings distributed in the drilled holes can more easily avoid a caving zone in the mine roof, the drilling difficulty is reduced, and the drilling cost is saved; when the water-flowing fractured zone does not develop to the ground, the side, close to the working face, of the mine roof is drilled at a certain inclined angle, the electrode string can enter the water-flowing fractured zone when the drilling depth is shallow, the electrode string can acquire accurate monitoring data, the drilling depth is reduced, the drilling difficulty is reduced, and the drilling cost is saved. And then, the apparent resistivity and the apparent polarizability of the surrounding rock of the mine roof are monitored in real time through the electrode strings, so that the water inrush condition of the coal seam roof is rapidly and accurately monitored.

title_en: Gas extraction cross-layer drill hole three-dimensional space coordinate calculation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a gas extraction cross-layer drill hole three-dimensional space coordinate calculation method. The three-dimensional space coordinate of the position to be measured is calculated according to the three-dimensional space coordinate of the hole opening position and the third connecting line parameter between the hole opening position and the point to be measured. The three-dimensional space drilling coordinate calculated based on the method can greatly reduce the workload of technicians; the automatic drawing of the drilling map through the coordinate conversion has high accuracy, realizes the informatization of the drilling in the three-dimensional space, and provides a data base for business applications such as blank band analysis based on the three-dimensional space information of the drilling.
assignees: GUANGLI TECH CO LTD;YONGMEI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Newton force monitoring and early warning method for fault monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a Newton force monitoring and early warning method for fault monitoring, which comprises the following steps of 1, excavating an ear hole on the side wall of a tunnel, drilling from the ear hole to a fault, penetrating the fault, 2, installing an anchor cable in the drill hole, 3, grouting in the drill hole until the grouting of the hole is compact, 4, sequentially installing a sensor, a constant resistor and a lockset at the end part of the anchor cable extending out of the drill hole, tensioning the anchor cable and locking the lockset, 5, monitoring the force change condition of the anchor cable in real time, and if the stress of the anchor cable changes steadily, indicating that the anchor cable is relatively stable, and if the stress of the anchor cable drops suddenly, indicating that disaster occurs. The method and the device have the advantages that the Newton force change condition which cannot be measured in faults is indirectly calculated through direct measurement of a monitorable artificial mechanical system (anchor cable), the Newton force is measured, and therefore accurate monitoring and early warning of earthquake catastrophe are achieved.

title_en: Evaluation method and system for spatial scene layout design
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method and system for spatial scene layout design. The method comprises the following steps: simulating the emergency evacuation process of the crowd in the space scene based on the group perception evacuation model to obtain a group evacuation process simulation result; the group perception evacuation model is obtained by constructing a preset object space index method and a group random model based on a preset perception evacuation model and a preset group evacuation model; and evaluating the layout design in the space scene based on the simulation result of the group evacuation process, and determining an evacuation bottleneck region in the space scene. The evaluation method for the layout design of the space scene, provided by the invention, can consider the influence of the group on the emergency evacuation process, and effectively improve the evaluation efficiency and accuracy of the layout setting and the emergency plan design in the space scene, so that the evacuation bottleneck area is quickly determined.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES;ZHEJIANG CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCE SPACE INFORMATION TECH APPLICATION CENTER

title_en: Mine rescue team member evaluation system that entries
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of psychological measurement, in particular to a mine rescue team member attendance evaluation system which comprises a data acquisition module, a psychological measurement module, a score statistics module and a data analysis module. According to the invention, professional talents suitable for mine rescue careers are screened according to the comprehensive assessment conclusion of the tested person, the physical signs and the psychological characteristics of the screened tested person have high relevance with the career characteristics of mine rescue, so that the personnel can adapt to mine rescue daily training and simulated actual combat drilling after entering the job, in addition, the influence on mine rescue work due to excessive stress reaction in a dangerous underground safety accident rescue environment is avoided, simultaneously, the post-disaster psychological health recovery process can be accelerated, and the psychological trauma of rescue finger fighters is avoided.

title_en: Riverbed change simulation deduction method, device and equipment based on three-dimensional scene model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional scene model-based riverbed change simulation deduction method, a three-dimensional scene model-based riverbed change simulation deduction device and riverbed change simulation deduction equipment, and relates to the field of digital twins in a drainage basin, wherein the simulation deduction method comprises the following steps: collecting basin data of a target basin, establishing a three-dimensional scene model based on the basin data, performing riverbed change deduction by using the three-dimensional scene model based on river sand sediment deposition change data established by hydrologic data monitoring information, and adjusting a riverbed height parameter in the three-dimensional scene model according to sediment deposition parameters in the river sand sediment deposition change data under the condition of performing the riverbed change deduction. The invention solves the technical problem that the disaster cannot be early warned in time because a three-dimensional scene model capable of dynamically deducing the change of the riverbed cannot be established in the related technology.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG HYDROLOGY AND WATER RESOURCES BUREAU OF YELLOW RIVER CONSERVANCY COMMISSION

title_en: Geological parameter real-time sensing method based on geological and equipment coupling simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological parameter real-time sensing method based on geological and equipment coupling simulation, which comprises the steps of outputting a state operation parameter through a component coupling simulation model, taking the corresponding geological parameter as a working condition set, constructing a database, simultaneously establishing a geological surrounding rock grade prediction model, inputting the operation state parameter of equipment into the geological surrounding rock grade prediction model in real time, predicting surrounding rock grade, and screening the working condition set in the database according to the collected operation state parameter and the predicted surrounding rock grade to obtain the predicted geological parameter. The method is simple and quick, can quickly acquire the geological conditions of the current equipment, effectively avoid geological disasters such as water and mud bursting, collapse, large deformation and the like, and greatly shortens the construction period.

title_en: Method for rapidly analyzing damage and disaster distribution of building after destructive earthquake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly analyzing damage and disaster distribution of a building after a destructive earthquake. The method comprises the following steps: 1) In the stage of establishing an image data set of the earthquake-damaged building, firstly, classifying and normalizing the earthquake damage types of the earthquake-damaged building, and then generating an image data set of the earthquake-damaged building with a label; 2) In the model training stage, firstly determining a neural network model, then determining a training strategy, and training and evaluating the neural network model by using an earthquake damage building image data set; 3) And identifying the damaged building picture collected by the emergency information service system by using the trained neural network model, extracting geographic coordinate data of the picture, and generating a disaster situation distribution map of the damaged building by combining the identified damaged type and geographic coordinate of the building. The method can make the traditional earthquake disaster situation collecting system more intelligent and automatic, and save manpower, material resources and financial resources.

title_en: Urban waterlogging point prediction method and system based on twin model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a twin model-based urban waterlogging point prediction method and a twin model-based urban waterlogging point prediction system, which are used for collecting multi-source space-time big data, wherein the multi-source space-time big data comprises LiDAR data, remote sensing image data, underground pipe network data, meteorological data and related statistical data; establishing an overground and underground integrated twin scene, wherein the overground and underground integrated twin scene comprises the steps of manufacturing a high-precision elevation model of an overground part, acquiring a land utilization type, and establishing a drainage pipe network system of an underground part; training model parameters of a research area by using long-time sequence historical rainstorm data, and simulating urban waterlogging conditions under different rainstorm reappearance period conditions to obtain approximate distribution of waterlogging-prone points; accessing relevant real-time dynamic information, adjusting and optimizing, realizing accurate prediction and positioning of waterlogging points, and calculating the submerging range and the submerging depth; and constructing a risk evaluation system of the urban waterlogging-prone area, and predicting the urban waterlogging point risk. The method effectively improves the efficiency and precision of urban waterlogging point prediction, and provides decision basis for ponding transformation, sponge urban construction, disaster emergency rescue and the like.

title_en: Method for solving problem of suspended roof of end head of underground fully-mechanized coal mining face of coal mine by rod type hydraulic splitting machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for solving the problem of roof suspension of an underground fully-mechanized mining working face of a coal mine by a bar-type hydraulic splitting machine, which belongs to the field of coal mining and is technically characterized in that roof cutting drilling parameters and hydraulic splitting parameters are designed according to roof rock formation lithology, occurrence conditions, mechanical parameters, roadway support conditions, roof pressing conditions, working face engineering geological conditions and the like, splitting sections in the drilling are determined, then the drilling is grouped, splitting bars are installed in the drilling in groups, and multistage backward fracturing is carried out. Finally, taking out the splitting rod, observing the splitting effect, and further optimizing the splitting parameters. According to the application, the rock is split according to the mechanical property of the rock roof, so that the strength of the roof is reduced, and therefore, when a working face is recovered to a certain position, the roof collapses in time, the suspension distance is reduced, the condition of gas aggregation is improved, and the method is economical and practical, effectively prevents roof disasters and gas accidents, and ensures safe production.

title_en: 10kV flood and ice disaster prevention simulation line device and method in karst region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 10kV flood and ice disaster prevention circuit simulation device and method in a karst region, and the device comprises a high-voltage circuit, a low-voltage circuit, a 1# transformer, a 2# transformer and a pond, wherein the 1# transformer is arranged at one end of a strip-shaped pond, the 1# transformer is arranged on a remote mountain slope, one branch of the high-voltage circuit led out by the 1# transformer crosses the pond and is connected to an electric pole at the other end, the other branch crosses a lawn and is connected to the 1# transformer through a plurality of electric poles, the starting point of the low-voltage circuit is connected to one branch of the high-voltage circuit at the other end of the pond, and the low-voltage circuit adopts a fort laid beside the lawn, is directly buried under the lawn and is buried under a drainage ditch. The invention can simulate the scene of the ice and dry disasters, carry out on-site simulation on the ice and dry disasters in advance, improve the simulation proficiency, know and feel the weather obstacle elimination in a special environment in advance, improve the efficiency of actual combat obstacle elimination and the maintenance efficiency, and greatly reduce the construction danger degree.

title_en: Earthquake simulation demonstration device convenient to carry
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable earthquake simulation demonstration device, wherein an upper frame platform mechanism and a lower frame platform mechanism are connected through a guide rail group; the lower frame platform mechanism is provided with a synchronous rotating mechanism, and the synchronous rotating mechanism is connected with an inner connecting rod; the inner connecting rod is connected with a hinge on the upper frame platform mechanism through a pin shaft; the hinge is positioned on the adjacent surface of the upper frame platform mechanism and the lower frame platform mechanism. Through demonstrating the exhibit model, the different exhibit earthquake models are experienced, the ground surface is irregularly bumped left and right when moving to the crust, the propagation speed in the crust when the demonstration earthquake occurs is simulated, the ground surface is shaken left and right, and the destructiveness is strong. The earthquake-proof device can enable audiences to intuitively feel the occurrence frequency of the earthquake in the process of earthquake, so that the audiences can better know the earthquake, and the consciousness of disaster prevention and reduction of people is enhanced. The utility model discloses can make the visitor the exact knowledge of mastering earthquake disaster, play an active role to saving life and protecting property safety.
assignees: ANHUI NEW HORIZON SCIENCE AND EDUCATION CULTURAL CO LTD

title_en: Landslide hazard automatic identification method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster identification, in particular to a landslide disaster automatic identification method and system based on deep learning, which are used for solving the problems of complex identification flow, low efficiency, unobvious landslide specific area range extraction and the like in the prior art, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a remote sensing image containing landslide; preprocessing the remote sensing image to obtain preprocessed data; dividing the preprocessed data into a preparation training set, a verification set and a test set according to a dividing proportion; performing data expansion on the preparation training set to obtain a training set; training a convolutional neural network by using the training set, the verification set and the test set, wherein P ReLu is used for replacing ReLu as an activation function in the convolutional neural network, and the convolutional neural network comprises a K-Net+PSP-Net network model; and identifying landslide disasters by using the trained convolutional neural network.

title_en: Natural disaster detection device and prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster detection device and a natural disaster prediction method, which comprise an operation core, a positioning communication module and a power supply module, wherein the operation core is connected with a plurality of sensors through a sensor bus and is connected with a camera through a video bus, and the operation core adopts a field programmable gate array to program to form a BP neural network module, a data storage module, a sensor data processing module and a video signal processing module. Firstly, training the weight values of the data of each sensor unit corresponding to different disasters, and then inputting the current detection data and the weight matrix to calculate whether the disasters happen or not. According to the disaster detection device, the high integration of the operation circuit enables the disaster detection device to have detection capability and operation capability, and the disaster prediction function is performed when training is completed; emergency data is transmitted to several nearest detection devices before the devices themselves are disabled from a destructive disaster to avoid loss of critical data.

title_en: Power failure duration prediction method, system, equipment and medium under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for predicting the power failure duration time under typhoon disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out grid division on the target area to obtain a grid set of the target area; respectively obtaining historical typhoon disaster multi-source heterogeneous data corresponding to each grid in a grid set, and constructing a corresponding typhoon disaster prediction data set; training and screening a preset number of machine learning models according to a typhoon disaster multi-source heterogeneous data set to obtain an optimal prediction model; and acquiring typhoon disaster data to be analyzed in the target area, and acquiring a corresponding power failure duration prediction result according to the typhoon disaster data to be analyzed and the optimal prediction model. The method provided by the invention can be used for guaranteeing the accuracy of power failure duration prediction under the typhoon disaster based on various aspects such as data collection, data processing and model screening, providing a reliable basis for a power grid disaster prevention and reduction department to make a disaster prevention and reduction strategy aiming at the typhoon disaster, and having higher application value and important practical significance.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Volcanic disaster demonstration platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a technical field of the general teaching, especially, relate to a volcanic disaster demonstration platform, it includes volcanic simulation basin, pass the gas subassembly, a display component, level sensor, pass gas subassembly and volcanic simulation basin intercommunication, level sensor sets up a lateral wall at volcanic simulation basin, display component is connected with the level sensor electricity, another lateral wall of volcanic simulation basin is transparent curb plate, visitor's ability visual simulation basin inside situation, volcanic simulation basin bottom is provided with the valve inside that prevents rivers from going out, pass in the subassembly passes through the valve inside with gas pump income volcanic simulation basin, gaseous entering aquatic gassing, the volcanic eruption is simulated in the bubble come-up, the shock of liquid level is aroused in the bubble come-up, level sensor senses the change of liquid level and conveys the liquid level change signal to display component, display component plays the video about the disaster, the process and the harm that demonstrate the volcanic eruption have directly perceived.
assignees: SHANGHAI GENSHENG EXHIBITION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Tsunami disaster demonstration exhibition stand
abstract_en: The application relates to education presentation device field especially relates to a tsunami calamity demonstration stand, and its technical scheme main points lie in: the sea wave simulating device comprises a display, a water tank, an interaction device, a wave making device and a controller, wherein the water tank is used for containing liquid for simulating sea waves, the interaction device is installed on the water tank, the wave making device is installed inside the water tank and connected with the interaction device, the display is installed above the water tank, the display is electrically connected with the controller and used for playing tsunami display videos, a trigger device used for triggering the controller to start the display is further installed inside the water tank, and the trigger device is electrically connected with the controller. The beneficial effect of this application does: the interactivity is strong.
assignees: SHANGHAI GENSHENG EXHIBITION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Avalanche disaster demonstration exhibition stand for civil defense education
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of civil defense education technique and specifically relates to avalanche calamity demonstration stand for civil defense education, it includes the board, the front of board is provided with the all-in-one, be provided with microphone and avalanche simulation subassembly on the board, avalanche simulation subassembly includes cavity, vibrator and diaphragm, the cavity is the slope setting, the upper surface of cavity is provided with the observation board that is transparent setting, the vibrator with the diaphragm all install in inside the cavity, the diaphragm is located the top of vibrator, the upper surface of diaphragm is laid there is the gravel, electricity is connected between microphone, all-in-one and the vibrator; the avalanche phenomenon display method has the advantage of improving the richness of avalanche phenomenon display contents.
assignees: SHANGHAI GENSHENG EXHIBITION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Gale disaster demonstration exhibition stand for civil defense education
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a civil defense education is with strong wind calamity demonstration stand, including the stand, be provided with the air outlet that is used for the different wind-force of air current simulation of blowout different speeds on the stand, the air outlet is connected with the hair-dryer, be provided with on the stand and be used for control the hair-dryer blows out the carousel of wind-force size, be provided with the gear district of the different gear wind speeds of sign on the carousel, be provided with the display screen that is used for showing the outdoor scene picture under the corresponding wind-force on the stand. The utility model provides an air outlet and display screen combine together, and air outlet blowout air current simulation wind-force, the wind disaster outdoor scene picture under the corresponding wind-force of simultaneous display screen show for spectator can enough experience the size and the change of wind-force, can more audio-visually watch the wind disaster picture again, makes the better effect of experience effect.
assignees: SHANGHAI GENSHENG EXHIBITION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power grid risk early warning method and system under typhoon disaster based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid risk early warning method and system under a typhoon disaster based on multi-source data fusion, wherein grid division of time dimension and space dimension is carried out on data in a power grid risk early warning data set under the typhoon disaster, and different types of data are matched according to the grid division to obtain power grid, geography and meteorological data of each grid; analyzing the vulnerability of each grid power grid element, establishing a vulnerability curve of each grid internal element, calculating a Coprind score according to the vulnerability curve, and establishing a gridding risk early warning data set by combining the Coprind score with gridding data; training a power grid risk early warning model based on a regression decision tree; and inputting typhoon forecast data into the trained power grid risk early warning model to obtain the power grid fault forecast number, so as to realize power grid risk early warning. The method can accurately predict the number of the faults of the power grid equipment under the typhoon disaster, effectively improve the coping capability of the power grid to the typhoon disaster and reduce the economic loss.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD;NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Landslide disaster real-time monitoring and early warning system and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster real-time monitoring and early warning system and device, which comprise a landslide early warning platform, wherein the landslide early warning platform comprises an image generation unit, an abnormal transmission unit, a key monitoring unit and an early warning comparison unit, the image generation unit is used for generating three-dimensional displayed geomorphic information according to a remote sensing image, generating a corresponding grid and then carrying out coordinate recording on a grid intersection point, and the image generation unit is in butt joint with the abnormal transmission unit. This landslide disaster real-time supervision early warning system and device adds through carrying out the grid to satellite remote sensing image, carries out landform surface information simulation, through the mode that the coordinate is compared, selects unusual region, and handling strength is little, utilizes the mode of artifical screening to get rid of obvious wrong unusual region, carries out key unusual mark, when further reducing the system automation and handling the degree of difficulty, has realized the high-efficient accurate judgement of landslide disaster prediction.

title_en: Method for judging transient power angle stability of power system and related device thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a related device for judging the transient power angle stability of a power system, wherein a generator of an original generator graph in the power system is taken as a node, and node clustering is carried out based on edge weights among the nodes to obtain a reduced-dimension graph; mapping the state characteristics of the nodes in the original generator graph into the state characteristics of the nodes in the graph after dimensionality reduction through dimensionality reduction mapping; the graph after dimension reduction and the state characteristics thereof are taken as the input of the graph attention force neural network, and the stability judgment result is output; the state characteristics comprise the voltage amplitude of a generator bus, the voltage phase angle, the active power output, the reactive power output, the power angle of a generator, the voltage at the generator terminal of the generator, the alternating current bus voltage of a converter station and the direct current of the converter station, and the technical problems that the dimension disaster is caused by excessive input characteristics and model parameters due to the fact that the system scale is large and the number of related nodes is large, and the input characteristics of all lines and unit input models are extracted, the model training cost is high, the training difficulty is high, the generalization capability is poor, and then the stability judgment result is influenced are solved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Training and actual combat system for realizing network security attack and defense
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training and actual combat system for realizing network security attack and defense, which comprises a management unit, an attack and defense exercise platform, a WEB attack system, a security protection system, an intrusion monitoring system, a threat assessment system, an attack and defense situation display module and an emergency response handling unit. This training and actual combat system of network security attack and defense realizes, adopt the aggressor server to control WEB attack system to attack the target of preventing the exercise platform and carry out the vulnerability attack through the aggressor user, prevent that the user of defending the side adopts preventing the defending the server to control the target of safety protection system to attack preventing the exercise platform and protect this moment, the invasion monitoring system that comes to show the monitoring to network attack and defense scene state through setting up and attack and defense situation show module, come to in time appraise the attack and defense system through threatening the evaluation system, the hidden risk item that obtains network security existence through attacking and defending the actual combat summary, and then can realize database update and network security system optimization.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating operation reliability of power system under heavy rainfall
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method for the operation reliability of an electric power system under heavy rainfall, aiming at solving the problem that the conventional electric power operation and maintenance lacks the risk perception capability under the consideration of extreme heavy rainfall, and the evaluation method comprises the following steps: acquiring running state data of the power system under heavy rainfall; sampling the running state of the power system by a Monte Carlo simulation method; analyzing the running state of the sampled power system based on a direct current load flow optimal load shedding algorithm; the evaluation index of the operation reliability of the power system is calculated, the evaluation of the operation reliability of the power system under strong rainfall is realized, the risk perception capability of the power system under extreme weather conditions is improved, the decision of the disaster prevention and relief scheduling work of the power system is assisted, the influence of the strong rainfall and waterlogging disasters on the power system and the impact of the strong rainfall and waterlogging disasters on the society are effectively coped and reduced, and the efficient and orderly power scheduling and disaster reduction and relief under extreme disasters are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Method and system for evaluating design rationality of emergency evacuation indicator system
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method and system for the design rationality of an emergency evacuation indicator system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring dynamic perception data by combining an eye tracker and virtual reality equipment; extracting the behavior characteristics and the perception parameters of the crowd perception emergency evacuation indicator from the dynamic perception data, and constructing the behavior characteristics and the perception parameters into a crowd behavior model to obtain a crowd perception evacuation behavior model; simulating crowd evacuation behaviors based on the crowd sensing evacuation behavior model to obtain a crowd evacuation behavior simulation result; and evaluating the emergency evacuation indicator system based on the crowd evacuation behavior simulation result to obtain an evaluation result of the indication efficiency of the emergency evacuation indicator system. The method for evaluating the design rationality of the emergency evacuation indicating mark system can effectively improve the efficiency and robustness of the evaluation of the emergency evacuation indicating mark system, thereby quickly reflecting the indication effectiveness of different emergency evacuation indicating mark systems.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES;ZHEJIANG CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCE SPACE INFORMATION TECH APPLICATION CENTER

title_en: Rescue device of drill cylinder for disaster relief and obstacle removal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling barrel rescue device for disaster relief and barrier removal, which comprises a base, wherein a crawler-type movable wheel is arranged on the lower surface of the base, a turntable is arranged on the upper surface of the base, a main hydraulic cylinder is arranged on the upper surface of the turntable, a cross arm is arranged at the upper end of a piston rod of the main hydraulic cylinder, a rotating motor is arranged in the cross arm, a drilling barrel bottom is arranged on an output shaft of the rotating motor, and by arranging an outer barrel, an inner barrel and a plurality of small cylinders, saw teeth at the left end of the small cylinders can synchronously rotate when the drilling barrel bottom drives the outer barrel and the inner barrel to rotate, obstacles are broken, a rescue channel is cleared, the left ends of the small cylinders are respectively driven to retract inwards by a linkage hinge rod, the obstacles are cut and separated by the aid of drilling barrel saw teeth, the outer barrel and the inner barrel are detachably connected with the drilling barrel bottom and separated from the drilling barrel bottom after the cutting is finished, and the obstacles and rescue workers can be conveyed out or cleared out of the rescue channel.

title_en: Rapid well drilling device and method with filter tube and inner core drill rod separable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid well drilling device and method with separable filter tubes and inner core drill rods, and relates to a dewatering well device. The invention adopts the rapid well drilling device based on the steel pipe casing, thereby simplifying the traditional well construction process; such as filter material filling, capping and the like, shortens the time of well construction, and wins precious rescue time for effectively treating leakage disasters.

title_en: Natural disaster insurance prediction processing method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system and electronic equipment for predicting and processing natural disaster insurance, which relate to the technical field of insurance business processing, and can fully utilize business association between geographic data and power grid data, associate asset information, geographic information, accident information and meteorological information related to the data by utilizing a natural disaster risk prediction model, obtain a corresponding natural disaster risk prediction index and further complete the prediction and processing process of the natural disaster insurance; in an actual scene, the natural disaster risk prediction model can be obtained through Lasso regression model training, and compared with a model used in the prior art, the model is simple in structure and higher in prediction processing precision of natural disaster insurance.

title_en: Test device for simulating impact and hysteresis coupling effect of structural member
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-disaster coupling simulation of structural members, in particular to a test device for simulating impact and hysteresis coupling action of a structural member. The device comprises a vertical impact assembly, a low-cycle reciprocating load loading assembly comprising an MTS actuator, an axial loading assembly, a constraint assembly, a clamping assembly and a test piece, wherein the test piece is axially arranged along the horizontal direction; the upper end of the MTS actuator is fixedly connected with the side wall of the test piece, and the lower end of the MTS actuator is fixedly connected with the side wall of the cross beam; the restraint subassembly all includes fixed ear seat and restraint ear seat, fixed pin axle, cross locating plate, and the cross locating plate is installed in the cross locating hole of fixed pin axle and is corresponding to install the fixed connection who realizes fixed ear seat and restraint ear seat behind the constant head tank. The structure can truly simulate the actual stress condition of the component under the impact and hysteresis effects.
assignees: SHANXI 2ND CONSTR GROUP CO LTD;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: A digital twin system for predicting response of structures to natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a computer-based digital twin system for predicting the response of a structure (200) to natural disasters. Accordingly, it is characterized in that it comprises a plurality of structure sensors (210) to detect at least one structure parameter of the multiple components; at least one environmental sensor (220) to measure at least one environmental parameter; an information processing device (100) configured to receive the signals generated regarding the measurements made by the said environmental sensor (220) and the said structure sensors (210); the said information processing device (100) comprises an information processing device (100) configured to access a virtual structure model (500) of the structure (200) and simulate the responses of the components of the said structure (200) in the real world according to the said structure parameters and environmental parameters in the said virtual structure model (500); the said information processing device (100) is configured to access a trained machine learning model using the environmental parameter measurements and the structure parameters measurements at the time these parameters are measured; to apply the test environment parameter values, which are in magnitude measured when the natural disaster occurs and are predetermined, to the machine learning model as input and to determine the damage status of the structure (200) according to the response structure parameters of the machine learning model to this and to simulate the response structure parameters in the virtual structure model (500).

title_en: A emulation squirt for fire fighter's training
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a simulation water gun for firefighter training, which can be connected with a fire hose and comprises a nozzle section, a connecting section and a clamping section, wherein the connecting section is a hollow cylinder, and one end of the connecting section is integrally connected with the other end of the short cylinder of the nozzle section; the joint section is solid cylindricality and its one end and the other end body coupling of linkage segment, and the periphery side integrated into one piece of joint section has a plurality of annular bosss and can dismantle the joint through a plurality of bosss and the bayonet socket of fire hose and be connected. The utility model discloses a nozzle section, linkage segment and the joint section of a body coupling, the fire-fighting lance of profile modeling fire fighter's in-service use for the daily training of fire fighter, in reinforcing fire fighter's physical stamina, can increase adaptability and the rescue ability of fire fighter at the in-process of actually going out police, short cylinder one can prevent simultaneously that hand and emulation squirt from breaking away from, improves the security of emulation squirt fire control training.
assignees: SHANDONG HENGZHENG SPORTS GOODS CO LTD

title_en: Free-standing portable firefighting training apparatus
abstract_en: A simulated roof firefighting training apparatus includes a rectangular frame having first and second side members and bottom and top members attached to the first and second side members to form a roof area, each of the bottom and top members including spaced apart rafter supports on inner faces thereof, first and second lifting arms having first ends pivotally mounted to first ends of the first and second side members at an intermediate positions along their lengths, first and second vertical supports attached, respectively, to the first and second side members at positions proximate to the bottom member of the frame, raising mechanisms pivotally mounted between the side members and the first lifting arms, respectively, and fixed vertical supports attached to side members or the top member at positions proximate to a second end of the side members.

title_en: Method of providing optimal evacuation route informaiotn on disaster and system therefor
title_ko: 재난 최적 대피 경로 정보 제공 방법 및 그를 위한 시스템
abstract_en: A method of providing optimal evacuation route information in the event of a disaster by a computing device according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a step of performing an evacuation simulation for the first space and storing the results; a step of deriving an evacuation route based on a result of performing an evacuation simulation for the stored first space; a step of receiving building space information about real space; a step of performing evacuation simulation learning by applying the derived evacuation route to the real space; a step of deriving and storing an optimal evacuation route based on the evacuation simulation learning results for the real space; and a step of transmitting the stored optimal evacuation route to each rescuer terminal or a predetermined display device when the disaster situation occurs.
