abstract_ko: 본 발명의　일실시예에　따른 컴퓨팅 디바이스에 의해 재난 상황 발생시 최적 대피 경로 정보 제공 방법은, 제1 공간에 대하여 대피 시뮬레이션 수행 및 결과를 저장하는 단계, 상기 저장된 제1 공간에 대한 대피 시뮬레이션 수행 결과에 기초하여 대피 경로를 도출하는 단계, 실 공간에 대한 건축물 공간 정보를 수신하는 단계, 상기 실 공간에 대하여 상기 도출한 대피 경로를 적용하여 대피 시뮬레이션 학습을 수행하는 단계, 상기 실 공간에 대한 대피 시뮬레이션 학습 결과에 기초하여 최적 대피 경로를 도출하고 저장하는 단계 및 상기 저장된 최적 대피 경로를 상기 재난 상황 발생 시 각 요구조자 단말 또는 미리 정해진 디스플레이 장치에 전송하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: KIM KI SUNG;INDUSTRIAL COOPERATION FOUNDATION HALLA UNIV

title_en: Flood disaster simulation prediction device based on VR
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flood disaster simulation prediction device based on VR, including the simulation base with set up in the inside simulation platform of simulation base, fixedly connected with servo motor in the simulation base, servo motor's the terminal fixedly connected with cam of output shaft, the lower extreme of simulation platform is equipped with the lug with cam looks butt, be equipped with slewing mechanism between simulation base and the simulation platform, the upper end of simulation platform is fixed with the platform of predicting, be equipped with the prediction groove in the platform of predicting, it predicts the glasses to be equipped with VR in the groove of predicting, establish fixed establishment between VR prediction glasses and the prediction platform, be fixed with the bearing board on the lateral wall of simulation base. This flood disaster simulation prediction device based on VR has guaranteed the protection to VR glasses, and the user has guaranteed experience person and has been on the scene when experiencing virtual environment through wearing VR glasses, has also guaranteed experience person's security simultaneously.

title_en: Machine-learning-based load balancing for cloud-based disaster recovery apparatuses, processes and systems
abstract_en: The Machine-Learning-Based Load Balancing for Cloud-Based Disaster Recovery Apparatuses, Processes and Systems (“MLLB”) transforms workload agent installation request, AWCD training request, NWCD training request, asset workload classification request, node workload classification request, asset virtualization request inputs via MLLB components into workload agent installation response, AWCD training response, NWCD training response, asset workload classification response, node workload classification response, asset virtualization response outputs. An asset virtualization request datastructure is obtained. A set of asset workload classification labels for the asset determined using an asset workload classification datastructure is retrieved. A set of node workload classification labels for each node in a set of available compute nodes determined using a node workload classification datastructure is retrieved. A set of compatible candidate compute nodes is determined using a set of capacity threshold rules. A virtual machine corresponding to the asset is instantiated on a selected candidate compute node.

title_en: Predicting and mamaging system of coastal change through analysing ocean information and method thoreof
title_ko: 연안관리 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 이를 이용한 연안 변화 예측 방법
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention provides a system and method, wherein the system collects information occurring on a coast at regular intervals, inputs the collected coastal information to a coastline change estimation model, which is a machine learning-based learning model, to predict changes in the coastline, and predicts and simulates disasters which may occur at the coast according to the predicted coastline change.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 예는 일정 간격마다 연안에서 발생하는 정보를 수집하고, 수집한 연안의 정보를 머신 러닝 기반의 학습 모델인 해안선 변화 추정 모델에 입력하여 해안선의 변화를 예측하고, 예측한 해안선 변화에 따른 연안에서 발생 가능한 재해를 예측하여 시뮬레이션할 수 있는 시스템 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Outburst coal seam group mine gas extraction and effect evaluation system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas control, and discloses a system and equipment for extracting and evaluating the effect of gas in a outburst coal seam group mine, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a mine information acquisition module, a coal seam characteristic analysis module, a coal seam gas parameter acquisition module, a central control module, a gas-solid coupling model construction module, a coal seam group three-dimensional model construction module, a simulation module, a danger assessment module, an extraction method determination module, a gas extraction module, a monitoring module and an effect evaluation module. The method carries out simulation of multiple extraction methods by constructing the three-dimensional model and the gas-solid coupling model, comprehensively and objectively compares the multiple extraction methods and determines the optimal extraction method, and is favorable for improving the control effect of coal and gas outburst disasters; the invention carries out effect evaluation from many aspects of safety, efficiency and result, has high evaluation efficiency, comprehensive and accurate evaluation result and can truly reflect the effect of gas control.

title_en: Tunnel performance comprehensive experiment platform and method under multi-field coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive experiment platform and an experiment method for tunnel performance under the action of multi-field coupling, wherein the experiment platform comprises a bearing platform, a multi-scene multi-target simulation system, a rear matching system and a data acquisition and early warning unit, wherein the multi-scene multi-target simulation system, the rear matching system and the data acquisition and early warning unit are arranged on the bearing platform; the multi-scene multi-target simulation system comprises a multi-scene multi-target simulation box, a water pressure and circulation control unit, a multi-scene intelligent temperature control unit, a loading device and a multi-scene control unit; the multi-scene control unit realizes simulation experiments of the tunnel structure and the surrounding rock environment model in the multi-scene multi-target simulation box under the multi-field coupling effect of different temperature environments, water environments and load parameters; the method can realize the simulation of complex geology and severe environments such as a low-temperature scene, a high-temperature scene, a karst tunnel water environment, a river-crossing sea tunnel water environment, a rich water environment, a high water pressure environment, a drainage system crystallization environment, a water disaster early warning environment and the like, and provides important reference for the actual tunnel engineering design.

title_en: Three-blocking one-injection low-temperature epoxypropane high-efficiency gasification fracturing permeability-increasing device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-block one-injection low-temperature epoxypropane high-efficiency gasification fracturing permeability-increasing device and method, which comprises five functions of high-efficiency hole sealing, kong Zu dust cleaning, high-efficiency heating, automatic control, safety and reliability, adopts a three-block one-injection + slip technology to seal the newly-formed cracks around a drilling hole, leads the newly-formed cracks to artificially induce coal seam gas to flow directionally, utilizes epoxypropane to generate high-pressure low-temperature gas fracturing coal seam, the low-temperature propylene oxide is injected into the fracturing holes to enable the low-temperature propylene oxide to be heated and gasified, so that high-pressure gas can be uniformly distributed in the coal bed after entering the coal body, and the crack development, expansion and penetration in the coal body are promoted, so that the air permeability of the coal bed is uniformly increased, the purpose of high-efficiency fracturing and permeability improvement is finally realized, and the problem of serious disasters caused by gas overrun is solved.

title_en: Treatment method for road landslide and rockfall of fractured rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a treatment method of road landslide and rockfall of fractured rock mass, which comprises the following steps: acquiring landslide parameters and rockfall parameters; setting a safety factor, and designing relevant parameters of the slide piles, the anchor cables and the shed tunnel; cutting the slope according to the side slope line of the landslide; drilling anchor cable holes at the slope toe of the landslide, lowering steel strands, pouring cement paste, and reserving anchor cables at the hole openings; excavating anti-slide pile holes; binding an anti-slide pile reinforcement cage, respectively lowering the anti-slide pile reinforcement cage to the hole bottom of the anti-slide pile hole, and continuously injecting concrete; erecting a soil retaining plate; excavating a column foundation hole, mounting a template, and injecting concrete for maintenance; constructing a connecting column; binding steel bars on a top plate of the shed tunnel, installing a template, and injecting concrete for curing; filling a pebble layer on the backer side of the anti-slide pile, and embedding a drain pipe; covering the filling slope surface line with clay, and filling a clay covering layer on the top of the shed tunnel; and (5) constructing a road surface and a drainage ditch. The invention can achieve the purpose of preventing and controlling landslide and rockfall of the high and steep fractured rock mass and has the property of disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF EXPLORATION TECH OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Fire and smoke prevention and discharge test platform for simulating typical flat structure of passenger liner
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire and smoke prevention and discharge test platform for simulating a typical flat structure place of a mail steamer, which comprises a simulation cabin, a fire source system, a smoke prevention and discharge system and a fire parameter measurement system, wherein the inner wall of the simulation cabin is provided with a fire prevention structure, and the side wall of the simulation cabin is provided with a fire prevention evacuation door and a fire prevention observation window; the fire source system is arranged in the simulation cabin; the smoke prevention and exhaust system comprises a cabin top smoke exhaust system, a cabin side wall bottom air supplementing system, a smoke blocking vertical wall and a control system; the fire parameter measuring system is arranged in the simulation cabin; the test platform can simulate the cabin structure and the fire scene of the actual typical flat structure of the mail steamer, measure various fire parameters, realize the research on the fire smoke spreading control effect of smoke prevention measures, mechanical ventilation and smoke discharge measures and the coupling mode of the smoke prevention and smoke discharge measures, and analyze the positions, the number, the area and the ventilation volume of ventilation openings of mechanical smoke discharge, the height of a smoke blocking vertical wall and the influence of the coupling effect of the smoke prevention and smoke discharge on smoke.

title_en: Geological disaster identification and evolution intelligent perception early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster identification and evolution intelligent perception early warning system and a method, belonging to the field of geological disaster monitoring early warning, wherein the intelligent perception early warning system comprises a monitoring perception subsystem, a disaster discrimination subsystem, an intelligent early warning subsystem and an AI disaster relief subsystem, and can realize data information acquisition, preprocessing, storage and transmission of three levels of sky-ground, perform intelligent simulation analysis on data to obtain a risk assessment quantitative index system and risk grade, construct a real-time early warning model according to the risk assessment quantitative index system and the risk grade to obtain a corresponding early warning threshold value, and divide early warning risk grades to perform early warning information push of different grades; and carrying out disaster condition blind estimation intelligent pre-judgment, emergency life line intelligent optimization and intelligent driving robot assisted evacuation according to the early warning information. The intelligent sensing and monitoring system can realize intelligent sensing and monitoring of the geological disaster, and carry out intelligent judgment, identification and early warning on the formation and evolution mechanism of the geological disaster, and carry out intelligent evacuation and rescue in the technical modes of AI artificial intelligence, internet of things and the like.

title_en: Fire-extinguishing tactical sand table for petroleum storage tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-extinguishing tactical sand table for a petroleum storage tank, which relates to the field of fire safety teaching aids and comprises the following components: the sand table tray comprises a sand table tray surface and a plurality of simulation oil tanks, wherein the simulation oil tanks comprise an intact vault tank, an intact outer floating roof tank, an intact inner floating roof tank, an oil tank with an inward bent tank wall, an inner floating roof tank with a curled floating disc and an oil tank with accessories, the outer wall of the intact outer floating roof tank is provided with a plurality of hooks in a surrounding manner, the periphery of the floating disc of the intact outer floating roof tank is uniformly and uniformly connected with a plurality of traction ropes, and the traction ropes penetrate through a top tank opening of the intact outer floating roof tank and are connected with the hooks; according to the invention, the cognition degree of a commander on whether the tank body is damaged or not can be improved, the internal structures and corresponding accessories of various oil tanks can be known, the knowledge storage of the commander is improved, the inclination angle of the floating plate can be adjusted, the situation that the floating plate is inclined at different angles in a real fire disaster can be simulated, and the teaching effect is further improved.

title_en: Indoor pedestrian flow evacuation control method and system, electronic device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor pedestrian flow evacuation control method, an indoor pedestrian flow evacuation control system, electronic equipment and an indoor pedestrian flow evacuation control medium, and relates to the field of pedestrian evacuation, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a state equation and a measurement equation of outlet pedestrian density and a BP neural network for identifying a state function and an observation function and performing offline iterative training; solving a state function and an observation function according to the weight values of all layers in the BP neural network; predicting pedestrian flow evacuation density according to the solved function, and constructing an error online neural network for correcting a predicted value; and when the data state is abnormal, calculating the sum of the pedestrian flow evacuation density prediction value and the prediction error value as a pedestrian flow evacuation density prediction improvement value, and performing indoor pedestrian flow evacuation control according to the improvement value. The method can still ensure the accuracy of pedestrian flow evacuation density prediction under the condition of performance reduction or damage of the sensor, thereby improving the pedestrian flow evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Metal mine deep mining design method based on ore body characteristics and mining ground pressure response
abstract_en: The invention provides a metal mine deep mining design method based on ore body characteristics and mining ground pressure response, and relates to the technical field of metal mine mining design. The method comprises the steps of obtaining deep geological cores of metal ores through engineering exploration drilling holes, conducting geological logging on the geological cores obtained through the engineering exploration drilling holes, exploring geological conditions of ore deposits, designing a mining method from five aspects of construction of a three-dimensional visual engineering geological disaster model of a mining area, selection of the mining method, determination of stope arrangement form and structural parameters, optimization of stoping sequence and design of filling body strength and supporting structure parameters on the basis of fully exploring the geological conditions of the ore deposits, and guaranteeing mining ground pressure balance and mining engineering stability in the mining process so as to achieve the purpose of safe and efficient mining. The method fully considers the influence of the rock mass and the mining ground pressure on the design of the mining method, ensures the mining ground pressure balance and the stability of the mining engineering in the mining process, and can realize the purpose of safe and efficient mining.

title_en: Artificial intelligence and swarm intelligence method and system in simulated environments for autonomous drones and robots for suppression of forest fires
abstract_en: A new artificial intelligence and swarm intelligence method and system in simulated environments for autonomous drones and robots for suppression of forest fires, which foresees the simulation of swarm intelligence models in simulated environment for autonomous drones and robots for suppression of forest fires, performing the analysis of forest fires based on data and information on real time conditions or historical data, of a burning area, transforming same into a simulation environment to obtain a better strategy for firefighting, based on virtual reality environments for digital land, with a mixture of real and virtual images, using satellite/aerial images and combined maps of virtual reality, augmented and mixed. Thus, providing improvements and higher efficacy in combatting forest fires.

title_en: Fire characteristic discrimination model training method and system and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training method, a system and related equipment of a fire disaster feature resolution model, wherein the training method comprises the following steps: establishing a flame sample data set, wherein a partial image has a flame picture and a false flame picture; marking a first target area with flame characteristics in the image, cutting the first target area from the original image, and forming a positive sample classification data set by the cut image of the first target area; inputting the flame sample data set into a trained first fire detection model, wherein the first fire detection model is used for detecting flame characteristics in the flame sample data set, marking a second target area with false flame characteristics in an image of a false positive output result, cutting the second target area from an original image, and forming a negative sample classification data set by the cut image of the second target area; and training a second fire detection model based on the positive sample classification data set and the negative sample classification data set, and taking the second fire detection model as a fire characteristic distinguishing model.
assignees: HAINAYUN WULIAN TECH CO LTD;QINGDAO HAINAYUN INTELLIGENT SYSTEM CO LTD;QINGDAO AIDIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Upper limb structure for vehicle collision test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle collision tests, in particular to an upper limb structure for the vehicle collision test, which comprises a shoulder part; an upper arm assembly having one end disposed on the shoulder member; a forearm assembly having one end disposed on the upper arm assembly; a hand assembly disposed on the other end of the forearm assembly; the five finger assemblies are arranged at the other end of the hand assembly, and are combined with the hand assembly to form a hand shape; the driving assembly is arranged on the hand assembly and can drive the finger assembly to move relative to the hand assembly so as to realize the bending and stretching of the finger assembly. The invention can carry out active response and simulate the emergency response action taken by the hands in the vehicle collision environment of the driver, thereby facilitating the analysis of the damage mechanism.
assignees: SUZHOU AUTOMOTIVE RESEARCH INSTITUTE TSINGHUA UNIV XIANGCHENG

title_en: Urban waterlogging prediction method based on LSTM neural network
abstract_en: The application provides an urban waterlogging prediction method based on an LSTM neural network, which comprises the following steps: collecting accumulated water depth of a plurality of accumulated water points in a city, height difference between a drainage outlet and a river channel or a lake, rainfall of the area of the accumulated water points and environmental data of the accumulated water points in each historical rainfall process; constructing a mathematical relation between the accumulated water quantity of the accumulated water point and the accumulated water depth, and calculating the confluence water quantity of the accumulated water point in the ith sampling period; constructing a confluent water quantity prediction model based on an LSTM neural network, initializing model parameters, and training the model; and collecting real-time data and environmental data of the point to be predicted, inputting the real-time data and the environmental data into the trained LSTM neural network model to predict the confluence water amount, and calculating the depth of the ponding water of the point to be predicted according to the confluence water amount and the environmental data. According to the method and the device, the accuracy of the ponding depth prediction is improved by predicting the ponding point catchment water flow and calculating the ponding point displacement under different conditions, and support is provided for the fields of urban flood control, disaster reduction and the like.

title_en: Forest disaster twinning mapping method based on multi-body cooperative sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest disaster twinning mapping method based on multi-body collaborative perception, which comprises the following steps: s1, selecting a typical forest fire, acquiring a forest fire scene under a real scene by using a color camera, searching a data set from the network, and establishing a forest fire data set; s2, expanding a forest fire data set through image preprocessing operation; s3, establishing a forest fire detection model based on a convolutional neural network; s4, dividing the data set into a training set, a verification set and a test set, carrying out model training by using the training set and the verification set, and storing the training weight of the model after the expected precision is achieved; and S5, identifying the forest fire images in the test set by using the trained model. According to the invention, manpower and material resources are greatly reduced, and the speed and the precision of the model recognition image are improved.

title_en: Safety education system using AR and VR
title_ko: Ar,vr을 이용한 안전교육시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a game-based experiential safety education method and system using virtual reality, and more specifically, to a game-based experiential safety education method and system using virtual reality that can promote standard operating procedures and enhance response capabilities to respond to large-scale disaster situations by repeatedly learning standard operating procedures for disaster types through games. The game-based experiential safety education system using virtual reality, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises: a scenario creation module that generates a training game comprising one or more game missions that allow users to experience safety training in a disaster situation; a control module that extracts a game mission corresponding to a game request from a user terminal from the training game; and a communication module that receives the game request from the user terminal and transmits the game mission to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실을 이용한 게임기반의 체험형 안전교육 방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는,게임을 통하여 재난유형에 대한 표준작전절차를 반복 학습하여, 표준작전절차의 체화를 도모하고 대규모 재난상황에 대응할 수 있는 대응능력을 고양할 수 있는 가상현실을 이용한 게임 기반의 체험형 안전교육 방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 가상현실을 이용한 게임기반의 체험형 안전교육 시스템은, 재난상황에서 안전훈련을 체험할 수 있는 하나 이상의 게임미션을 포함하는 훈련게임을 생성하는 시나리오생성 모듈; 상기 훈련게임에서 사용자 단말기의 게임요청에 대응하는 게임미션을 추출하는 제어모듈; 및 상기 사용자 단말기로부터 상기 게임요청을 수신하고, 상기 사용자 단말기에 상기 게임미션을 전송하는 통신모듈;를 포함하는것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Test system and test method capable of testing vibration in water
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a test system and a test method capable of testing vibration in water. The test system comprises a test device, a fire-fighting module, a test module and a data module; the test method comprises the following steps: step one, designing a test scheme; step two, screening the reliability of the test sample; step three, mounting a testing device; step four, establishing a test environment; step five, loading the vibration road spectrum scheme into a vibration rack control program; step six, the data module enters a working state; step seven, starting a wading vibration test; step eight, analyzing and processing the test data in real time by the data module; treating the power battery system; and step ten, uploading the data to a cloud for storage. The invention can make emergency response according to thermal runaway and other safety conditions in the vibration process, and solves the problems that the test method is lack of automobile simulation wading road surface driving and the analysis of the vibration data of the battery assembly in water.

title_en: Service continuity testing method and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of executing a continuous pressure sending test case corresponding to a target test scene if a test request of the target test scene of a tested system initiated by a target person is received, simulating a continuous sending test case corresponding to the target test scene by a simulator, continuously sending a request to the tested system through a correlation system of the tested system under the target test scene, and/or uploading a file, switching the tested system from a production end to a disaster recovery end or from a multi-center to a designated center after the tested system stably operates, switching the tested system from the disaster recovery end to the production end or from the designated center to the multi-center after the tested system successfully switches and stably operates, generating a test report of the tested system based on the monitored test data after the tested system successfully switches and stably operates, judging whether the service processing capacity of the tested system before and after switching meets the requirements based on the test report, and feeding back successful test information if the service processing capacity of the tested system meets the requirements.

title_en: Flood disaster emergency rescue management method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency rescue management method, device, equipment and storage medium for flood disasters. The method comprises the following steps: respectively collecting high-risk vehicles, vehicle insurance data, vehicle key gathering place information point data, traffic network data, emergency vehicle maintenance point data and DEM data in the current city, and simulating a flood inundation map in a set historical reproduction period by using a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model; based on a flood flooding map and traffic network data, calculating the space accessibility between urban emergency public services and vehicle key gathering places under the flood disaster situation by using a shortest path algorithm, calculating the capacity of each emergency vehicle maintenance point for high-risk vehicles, and formulating an emergency rescue scheme for the high-risk vehicles according to the space accessibility, the capacity and vehicle insurance data. The urban public service emergency rescue scheme under the influence of the urban flood disaster can be formulated, and the rescue speed is improved.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method and system for sponge city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for intelligently monitoring a sponge city, wherein the technical scheme of the invention utilizes a cellular automaton model to simulate and deduce the rainwater absorption condition of the sponge city in the future time, sets a water absorption area in the city as seed cells, utilizes city construction activities, water absorption capacity and weather conditions as influence factors of the cellular automaton model, and can accurately deduce the rainwater absorption condition of the sponge city in the future time through the continuous development of tissue cells in a tissue development mode so as to send out an early warning signal; the disaster early warning can not be carried out in advance by solving the existing manual prejudgment, the timeliness is lacked, the manual prejudgment mode is lacked in accuracy and efficiency, the technical problem that effective help can not be provided for the monitoring of the smart sponge city is solved, the manual prejudgment strategy under the traditional mode is replaced, early warning disasters can be carried out on the smart sponge city in advance, and the timeliness, the accuracy and the efficiency of monitoring the smart sponge city are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JIAHUI LANDSCAPING CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on mixed convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SAR image change detection method based on mixed convolution, which mainly solves the problems that the prior art is difficult to extract global information of an image and a reliable label training network is lacked under the condition of no labeling label, and the method comprises the following steps of constructing three-channel input and initial labels; building a graph convolution enhanced convolution network GECN formed by cascading a feature extraction module, a progressive fusion module and a label updating module, training by using three channel input and label pairs GECN, and inputting tested SAR images to a trained GECN to obtain a change detection result. The method and the device acquire the multiscale characteristics of local and global information of the SAR image through the characteristic extraction module, improve the characteristic extraction capability of GECN networks, acquire more reliable tag training GECN networks through the tag updating module, improve the generalization performance of GECN networks, and can be used for urban planning layout, natural disaster assessment and military dynamic reconnaissance.

title_en: KL-VMD-based overhead line lightning stroke fault identification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power transmission lines, in particular to a KL-VMD-based lightning stroke fault identification method for an overhead line, which comprises the following steps: building an overhead line model, and simulating a shielding failure scene, a counterattack scene and a short circuit scene; carrying out conversion decoupling on the three-phase voltage to obtain a zero modulus component, a first linear modulus component and a second linear modulus component; and performing KL-VMD decomposition on the zero-mode voltage and the change rate thereof, constructing a lightning stroke recognition criterion according to different transient energy ratios, and recognizing the lightning stroke fault of the overhead line. Under the condition that the problems of modal aliasing and the like exist in signal decomposition, the number of decomposition layers and a penalty factor can be automatically optimized by adopting KL-VMD, the transient characteristic quantity can be effectively extracted, and the method has good adaptivity in fault signal decomposition; the method can still accurately distinguish the short-circuit fault and the lightning stroke under the conditions of different lightning current amplitudes, distances and initial phase angles, has higher reliability, and can provide reference for line fault identification.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Geological disaster assessment method and device based on digital numerical integration
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a geological disaster assessment method and device based on digital and numerical integration. The geological disaster assessment method based on digital numerical integration provided by the embodiment of the invention has the advantages that the data of the three-dimensional geological model is simply and conveniently applied to the numerical simulation processing process, and the strong EVS is combinedThree-dimensional geological modeling capability and FLAC  3D  The numerical simulation has strong calculation capability, so that the evaluation on the geological disasters is simpler, more convenient and more accurate.

title_en: Transportable aircraft fire rescue real fire practical training equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transportable aircraft fire rescue real fire practical training device which comprises a trailer and a fire simulation aircraft, wherein the fire simulation aircraft is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the trailer and comprises a nose, a fuselage, a tail, wings, wing engines, a tail engine, a landing gear, a fuselage cabin door, a cab, a cabin, cabin seats, a cabin luggage rack, a cargo hold and a cargo door. Compared with the traditional fixed aircraft fire rescue real fire practical training equipment, the device can be transported to an airport needing fire-fighting training or other units with training requirements in the using process through the matched arrangement of the trailer, the fire simulation aircraft, the crawling ladder, the truck head, the supporting rod and the emergency gate, and each part of the paramedics do not need to intensively go to a training base for training, so that the traveling and lodging cost of the paramedics is saved, and the training cost is reduced; and because the training is carried out locally, the airport firefighters can collectively participate in the training, and the effect of team battle training is realized.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHEN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: High slope stability monitoring method and system based on BIM technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high slope stability monitoring method and system based on BIM technology, which changes the traditional high slope monitoring method or means, applies BIM technology to high slope monitoring in a fusion way, and carries out staged monitoring according to the dynamic feedback correction theoretical calculation result of the monitoring result, thereby achieving the purposes of early warning and prevention and having the advantages of visual visualization of monitoring information, accurate simulation result and early disaster prevention.

title_en: FLUENT-EDEM coupling model-based water blocking body construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water blocking body construction method based on FLUENT-EDEM coupling model, which models water flow and aggregate particles respectively by adopting different theories, can efficiently depict the motion state of each aggregate particle in the water flow, displays the migration dynamic state of the whole water blocking body aggregate particle group in real time, and realizes quantitative calculation and prediction of the water blocking body construction process; the method can carry out simulation calculation before the water inrush disaster happens in the mine, carry out classification modeling calculation on possible construction schemes by carrying out advanced analysis on various water inrush disaster conditions, further form a water blocking body construction optimization scheme database, and can be quickly taken and utilized when the water inrush disaster happens; therefore, the method has the advantages of high calculation precision, low cost, dynamic visualization and the like, can acquire key data or evolution rules which cannot be directly acquired in field or indoor tests in real time, reduces potential risks of experience-dominated engineering construction, and improves the technical and scientific properties of the construction scheme of the hidden water damage control engineering.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Railway three-dimensional geological route selection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway three-dimensional geological route selection method and a system, which relate to the technical field of traffic route planning and comprise the steps of obtaining engineering geological information of a railway route area needing to be designed, and carrying out three-dimensional visual modeling on a geological entity to obtain a three-dimensional geological BIM model; extracting unfavorable geological information from the three-dimensional geological BIM, and constructing a unfavorable geological disaster prediction BIM according to the extracted unfavorable geological information; carrying out dynamic simulation analysis on the unfavorable geological disaster prediction BIM model by utilizing finite element numerical simulation, and establishing a geological disaster model; superposing the geological disaster model and the unfavorable geological disaster prediction BIM model to obtain a geological disaster risk evaluation model; and carrying out danger judgment on the geology in the railway line by using the geological disaster danger evaluation model, and carrying out railway line position design according to a judgment result. The invention solves the problem that underground geological disasters are difficult to predict and analyze, and improves the design efficiency of the line and the overall safety of the line.

title_en: Multifunctional pipe gallery fire experiment model and visual early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional pipe gallery fire experiment model, which is divided into a left pipe gallery and a right pipe gallery, wherein the left pipe gallery is provided with a wind speed adjusting device and a wind speed sensor; the right side piping lane sets up fire source analogue means and temperature sensor, and temperature sensor is used for detecting right side piping lane temperature and sends the temperature value that detects to control module, and the top of right side piping lane is provided with sliding guide, and fire source analogue means removes along sliding guide. The invention is used for simulating pipe gallery fires under different working conditions, and has the advantages of low cost and simple and flexible experiment; through the inside sliding guide and the electric lift platform that set up of experiment model, realize the arbitrary removal of burning things which may cause a fire disaster and temperature sensor at piping lane model inner space, furthest restores real piping lane fire scene.

title_en: Wing-body fusion (BWB) passenger plane emergency evacuation simulation analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation analysis method for emergent evacuation of a wing-body fusion (BWB) passenger plane, which comprises the following steps: constructing an emergency accident situation and risk evolution model of the passenger plane, determining an emergency evacuation simulation experiment working condition, and building a simulation environment; establishing a BWB passenger plane three-dimensional model, importing the BWB passenger plane three-dimensional model into analog simulation software, establishing a BWB passenger plane personnel emergency evacuation live-action module, and establishing a personnel emergency evacuation behavior model by utilizing the analog simulation software; based on a simulation environment, a BWB passenger plane personnel emergency evacuation live-action module and a personnel emergency evacuation behavior model, carrying out BWB passenger plane personnel emergency evacuation simulation, and obtaining risk factors and weak links existing in the BWB passenger plane personnel emergency evacuation process. The invention provides a convenient, rapid, low-investment and high-feasibility method for carrying out verification analysis on the related layout design of a novel future BWB passenger plane, and providing data support for the related design of the passenger plane.

title_en: Fire smoke flame image identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire smoke flame image recognition method, which comprises the steps of establishing a fire smoke flame image dataset; improving the YOLOv5s model to obtain a fire identification model for identifying a fire smoke flame image; performing data enhancement on the fire smoke flame image, and inputting the fire smoke flame image subjected to data enhancement into a fire recognition model for training to obtain a trained fire recognition model; and inputting the fire smoke flame image into the trained fire recognition model to obtain a recognition result of the fire smoke flame image. According to the invention, the early-stage fire smoke flame image is accurately and efficiently identified when a fire disaster occurs through the fire disaster identification model.

title_en: Power communication inferior ring network topology identification method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a convolutional neural network-based power communication inferior ring network topology identification method. And randomly generating a ring network topology on the background map to form a ring network image. According to the network survivability principle, the quality of the looped network image is marked manually. Repeating the above process to generate a CNN training data set meeting the requirement; and then, the looped network image data is used as input, the looped network topology quality index is used as output, and a CNN model is constructed. Training a CNN model and meeting the precision requirement; and finally, giving any looped network image, and recognizing the power communication inferior looped network topology by using the trained CNN model. The invention is beneficial to the power communication operation management department, optimizes and designs the ring network topology structure, reduces the network operation risk and improves the disaster resistance capability of the power communication service.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Landslide risk point classification method based on multi-modal decision fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide risk point classification method based on multi-mode decision fusion, which mainly solves the problem that the existing method cannot obtain information contained in digital elevation data from a small number of sample conditions, so that the landslide risk point classification precision is improved unstably. The method comprises the steps of extracting a digital elevation model corresponding to a high-resolution remote sensing image to be detected, dividing the extracted digital elevation model according to a flat land and a mountain land, training the high-resolution remote sensing image according to whether the high-resolution remote sensing image contains landslide risk points, training the digital elevation model according to whether the high-resolution remote sensing image is a mountain land or a flat land, distinguishing whether a sample to be detected is the landslide risk points by using a high-resolution remote sensing image classification model, and screening a high-resolution remote sensing image classification result by using a terrain classification result of the digital elevation model classification model to obtain a final classification result. The method improves the classification precision of landslide risk point detection, and can be used for geological disaster detection and early warning.

title_en: Method for filling drill hole casing deep pipe cutting by using drilling machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining under non-coal mine mountainous regions and geological disaster treatment, in particular to a method for filling, drilling and casing deep pipe cutting by using a drilling machine. The invention comprises the following steps: s1, constructing and drilling, S2, formulating a filling scheme, S3, controlling filling construction and filling height of an empty area, S4, manufacturing a drill rod cutter, S5, cutting a pipe, S6, filling operation and sealing the newly found empty area. The structure of the drill rod cutter is newly designed, three times of cutting are carried out, the sleeve is broken into two sections, and the sleeve is guaranteed to be smoothly separated; the drill is used for cutting the deep part of the filling sleeve, the filling sleeve is successfully cut off from the middle part, a new drill hole is not required to be constructed again, and one filling drill hole is used for filling an upper empty area and a lower empty area; the construction engineering quantity and the engineering investment are reduced, the construction period is shortened, the construction efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the production cost is also reduced.

title_en: Aggregation model replication at a disaster recovery site
abstract_en: An approach is provided in which the approach establishes a connection between a first data site and a second data site. The first data site executes a first aggregation model that includes multiple first machine learning models and the second data site executes a second aggregation model that includes multiple second machine learning models. The approach detects, at the first data site, a change of data in a selected one of multiple first training data buckets corresponding to a selected one of the multiple first machine learning models. The approach sends the change of data from the first data site to the second data site, and replicates at the second data site, one of multiple second data buckets corresponding to a selected one of the multiple second machine learning models based on the change of data.

title_en: Earthquake economic loss evaluation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for evaluating economic loss of earthquake, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after the earthquake occurs, carrying out numerical simulation on the earthquake to obtain an intensity distribution numerical value of the earthquake; according to population distribution data of earthquake occurrence places, performing spatial integration on population distribution data in different intensity ranges to obtain population exposure numbers in different intensity distribution numerical ranges; inputting the population exposure number and the per capita fixed assets of the earthquake occurrence area in different intensity distribution numerical ranges into a regional economic loss evaluation model, and evaluating to obtain an economic loss evaluation value of the earthquake occurrence area; the regional economic loss assessment model is constructed on the basis of an earthquake disaster database, a regional sub-region and a provincial fixed asset database. The scheme can rapidly evaluate the economic loss range, the mathematical expected value and the spatial distribution after the earthquake occurs, and the evaluation result is more accurate.

title_en: Ground simulation experiment method for near-earth asteroid entering effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protection of asteroid in the near field, in particular to a ground simulation experiment method for the entering effect of asteroid in the near field. According to the invention, the ionization explosion of the atmosphere layer at different incidence angles of the asteroid is realized through a relatively real experiment for simulating the process that the asteroid enters the atmosphere layer at an ultrahigh speed and impacts the earth, and the impact effect and the evolution process of the ocean and the land under the gravity environment are simulated, so that the technical problem that the asteroid can not impact an ocean target in the current horizontal light gas gun is solved, the dynamic response process that the asteroid impacts the water surface and the land and is influenced by the gravity can be simulated in a laboratory, and the monitoring and quantitative analysis of the whole upper and lower regions of a horizontal plane (ground plane) are realized. According to the method and the device, the phenomenon and the process that asteroid enters the atmosphere to impact the earth can be truly simulated, and a basis is provided for disaster assessment and coping and disposal strategy formulation.

title_en: Visual shearing system and method for simulating fault mud character degradation under freeze-thaw disturbance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual shearing system for simulating fault mud property degradation under freeze-thaw disturbance, which comprises a control device, a CT imaging device, an explosion vibration wave loading device, a freeze-thaw box and a variable-angle shearing device, wherein the variable-angle shearing device is arranged in the freeze-thaw box, the freeze-thaw box is arranged on the explosion vibration wave loading device, and the explosion vibration wave loading device is arranged on a rotary table of the CT imaging device. The CT imaging device is used for performing transparent and digital representation on the structural degradation of the fault mud, the application of vibration wave disturbance and freeze-thaw loading environment is realized through the blasting vibration wave loading device and the freeze-thaw box, the shear test is performed through the variable-angle shearing device, the shear strength parameters of samples with different freeze-thaw-disturbance effects are obtained, and reliable mechanical data are provided for prevention and control of mining disasters in rock mass engineering in cold regions.
assignees: BEIJING UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Remote evacuation guidance system, land evacuation guidance system, inboard evacuation guidance system, and remote evacuation guidance method
abstract_en: To provide an evacuation guidance system that performs evacuation guidance for a passenger on a ship from land.SOLUTION: A remote evacuation guidance system comprises: a plurality of types of sensors provided at a plurality of positions inboard; an evacuation guidance device provided inboard; and a land evacuation guidance system provided on land. In the land evacuation guidance system, sensor information detected by a sensor is acquired, and an inboard situation is reproduced such that the situation can be virtually simulated on the basis of the sensor information, an evacuation route is set on the basis of the represented inboard situation, evacuation guidance instruction information for guiding evacuation of passengers along the evacuation route is generated, and the evacuation guidance instruction information is transmitted to the onboard evacuation guidance device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Power battery monitoring protection method and system based on deep learning and nitrogen protection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power lithium batteries of new energy automobiles, in particular to a power battery monitoring and protecting method and system based on deep learning and nitrogen protection. According to the invention, nitrogen protection is applied to the safety protection of the power lithium battery of the new energy automobile, so that fire disaster is prevented, and the safety performance of the power lithium battery of the new energy automobile in the running process is improved. The invention detects the oxygen concentration, the air pressure, the temperature and the humidity of the battery box where the battery is positioned, and timely carries out the nitrogen charging operation, so that the battery is in an environment without combustion and explosion conditions. Based on historical detection data, the invention constructs a neural network to perform model training so as to predict the battery state, can prepare for nitrogen production and nitrogen storage in advance, ensures the normal operation of nitrogen charging, and further provides safety.

title_en: Analysis method for influence factors of roof elastic energy contribution rate during coal disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method of influence factors of a roof elastic energy contribution rate during coal catastrophe, which comprises the following specific steps: acquiring the gas pressure of a coal bed; acquiring the thicknesses of a coal seam and a top plate according to the drilling histogram; coring on site, processing into a standard test piece, and respectively obtaining the elastic modulus of the top plate and the coal containing gas through an indoor mechanical test; substituting the elastic modulus and the thickness of the obtained roof and the coal containing gas into a calculation formula to obtain the elastic energy contribution rate of the roof; and respectively setting the same thickness ratio and different elastic modulus ratios and the same elastic modulus ratio and different thickness ratios to analyze the influence of the elastic energy contribution rate of the top plate. The method provided by the invention fully considers the roof elastic energy effect in the coal rock gas dynamic disaster, analyzes the influence factors of the elastic energy contribution rate, has important theoretical significance and engineering actual value, and has positive significance for the prediction and prevention of mine composite dynamic disasters such as rock burst-coal and gas outburst and the like induced by mining.

title_en: Method and system for real-time flood forecasting and flood simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood prediction informatization, in particular to a method and a system for real-time flood forecasting and flood simulation. Receiving water and rain condition data and rainfall forecast data, wherein the rainfall forecast data comprises rainfall forecast data and hydrological site information; generating site forecast and interval inflow forecast according to the water and rain condition data and the rainfall forecast data, wherein the site forecast comprises reservoir site forecast results; generating a reservoir dispatching rule according to a reservoir site forecast result of the site forecast; calculating through reservoir flood regulation calculation according to reservoir dispatching rules, and constructing flood evolution data; and analyzing according to the flood building evolution data and the interval inflow forecast, building a hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling flood model, performing model calculation, and generating flood evolution simulation data. The invention provides a method and a system for forecasting and simulating flood in real time, which simulate the water regime in real time through water conservancy numerical simulation and water conservancy informatization so as to predict the disaster condition of the flood.
assignees: HUIZHOU HYDROLOGY BRANCH OF GUANGDONG HYDROLOGY BUREAU

title_en: Ship personnel evacuation evaluation method based on simulation software
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship personnel evacuation evaluation method based on simulation software, which comprises the steps of establishing a geometric model by using the simulation software based on a regional structure arrangement drawing of each deck of a target ship, establishing a character model by using the simulation software based on ages, moving speeds, initial positions and reaction time of crew members and passengers on the target ship, establishing an evacuation scene model, setting a gathering station and an evacuation route, combining the geometric model, the character model and the evacuation scene model to form an evacuation model, executing simulated evacuation and calculating total evacuation time. The evacuation model is formed by establishing the geometric model, the character model and the scene model, and the evaluation of the personnel evacuation condition in the ship under the emergency condition is realized by executing the simulation calculation of the total evacuation time and the evaluation.

title_en: Lining internal water vapor migration blocking model under fire disaster high temperature and experimental method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lining internal water vapor migration blocking model at a high temperature of a fire and an experimental method thereof. The model consists of a test block, a control and data collecting device and a high-temperature combustion furnace, wherein the test block is a concrete cube component, three groups of steam pressure test tubes are arranged in a pre-buried mode at intervals in the center, vertical thin steel plates are arranged in a pre-buried mode 10cm inside each side wall, and the distance between the bottom of each steel plate and the bottom surface of the test block is 2cm. The invention sets up the high temperature resistant and waterproof sheet steel in the concrete test block, has blocked the inside steam horizontal migration of the test block, make the steam can only ooze along the thickness direction of the concrete, simulate and obtain the migration condition of the steam when the actual tunnel fires, have guaranteed the rationality and accuracy of the measuring result.

title_en: Optimization method based on design space reduction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of multi-disciplinary optimization design of aircrafts, and discloses an optimization method based on design space reduction. The method comprises the following steps: s1, generation and pretreatment of a sample set: starting from an initial pneumatic shape, performing disturbance sampling on design variables by using any test design method to generate a large number of pneumatic shapes and calculate corresponding target functions, and performing label classification processing on a sample set consisting of the design variables and the corresponding target functions to obtain a training set of a decision tree; s2, establishing a CART algorithm-based decision tree: the decision tree classifies the sample labels based on the Gini coefficient, the internal nodes are optimal division points based on the Gini coefficient, and the leaf nodes are target function value labels; s3, extracting design knowledge according to the decision tree: the design space is reduced by layering the design variables and determining the reasonable value range of the design variables. The invention solves the problem that the prior optimization algorithm causes dimension disaster due to the sparsity of the samples. The method is suitable for optimizing the design space of the advanced aircraft.
assignees: AEROSPACE TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINA AERODYNAMICS RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER

title_en: Device for simulating fire extinguishment and reburning of storage tanks with different liquid levels
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for simulating fire extinguishing and re-burning processes of storage tanks with different liquid levels, which comprises: the fire extinguishing system comprises a combustion simulator, a gas supply device, a fire extinguishing device, a combustion control device, a circulation supply device and a monitoring device. The upper part of the combustion simulator is open, and is internally provided with a nonflammable liquid layer, which is further divided into a water layer and a nonflammable oil layer and is used for simulating an actual oil layer. The gas supply device is used for introducing combustible gas from the bottom of the combustion simulator, and simulating the fire disaster of the full liquid level of the storage tank after ignition. The fire extinguishing device can spray foam to extinguish fire, the foam is spread on the surface of the liquid layer, and the surface of the non-combustible liquid layer is cooled. The combustion control device measures the temperature change of the surface of the non-combustible liquid layer, controls the gas inlet rate, and realizes the fire extinguishing and re-combustion process. The circulation supply device can realize the circulation utilization of the non-combustible liquid layer. The monitoring device can monitor the covering process and flame state information of the fire extinguishing agent. The device provided by the invention can simulate the fire and re-combustion processes of the storage tanks with different liquid levels and provide guidance for fire extinguishment of the storage tanks.

title_en: Method for selecting pressure relief measures according to pressure relief drilling deformation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for selecting pressure relief measures according to a pressure relief drilling deformation mode, and belongs to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster prevention and control. According to the method, measures such as micro-vibration and surrounding rock deformation are assisted according to the deformation mode of the constructed large-diameter pressure relief drilling, an impact force source is judged, and reasonable pressure relief measures are selected; avoiding rock burst disasters caused by unreasonable judgment of impact force sources or pressure relief modes. Meanwhile, the method can avoid unnecessary pressure relief measures, saves unnecessary labor force and is used for targeted pressure relief measure construction. In addition, the method successfully judges the impact force source in case application, and ensures the safe stope of the working face.

title_en: Protective clothing performance detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protective clothing, and discloses a protective clothing performance detection method, which comprises the following steps: collecting information, collecting Internet data, shooting video clip images when a fire disaster occurs in a transformer substation and the like; simulating a scene of a transformer substation fire; performing model performance detection on a dummy wearing protective clothing placed in a simulated transformer substation fire scene; and (5) counting the detection result. The invention not only can avoid error judgment of the protective clothing caused by deviation of the detection result when the protective clothing is detected, and improves the detection accuracy of the protective clothing, but also can make the simulation scene of the fire disaster of the transformer substation more real, improves the detection effect of the protective clothing, can detect the full-scale performance of the protective clothing, and improves the use safety of the protective clothing.

title_en: Human body bionic device for simulating disaster site search and rescue training
abstract_en: The invention relates to a human body bionic device for simulating disaster site search and rescue training, which comprises an embedded system, a remote communication system, a power supply, a radar signal simulation system, an optical signal simulation system, a human body temperature simulation system, an audio signal system, a vibration signal system and a bionic simulation device control system. The bionic simulation device control system receives externally input bionic parameters and forwards the bionic parameters to the embedded system through the remote communication system; the bionic parameters comprise heart rate, respiratory rate, body surface temperature, sound intensity, light intensity and human body shaking frequency; the embedded system generates control signals and sends the control signals to each module to simulate the heart beating and respiration, brightness, body temperature, calling for help and moan sound and shake of a human body.

title_en: Horizontal drainage hole drilling tool for landslide and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a horizontal drainage hole drilling tool for landslide and a construction method thereof, wherein the drilling tool consists of a self-dropping drill bit, a wall protection drill rod and a traction rope, and is characterized in that after the self-dropping drill bit and the wall protection drill rod are drilled for hole formation, the self-dropping drill bit is separated from the wall protection drill rod, a processed drainage pipe is installed in the hole along the wall protection drill rod, and then the wall protection drill rod is withdrawn. The construction method comprises the following steps: measuring fixed points → drilling tool processing → drilling machine in place → drilling hole forming → cleaning dregs → drill bit breaking away → drainage pipe installation → withdrawing the retaining wall drill rod → plugging the drainage pipe. The invention solves the problem that the water drain pipe cannot be installed in place due to hole collapse or deflection of the horizontal water drain hole under the condition of long distance or weak stratum, and improves the drainage effect of the horizontal water drain hole in disaster prevention and control.
assignees: THE FIFTH GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION INST OF HENAN BUREAU OF GEO EXPLORATION & MINERAL DEVELOPMENT

title_en: Fire-fighting risk assessment early-warning method and system based on shopping mall and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting risk assessment early-warning method, a fire-fighting risk assessment early-warning system and electronic equipment based on a market, which belong to the technical field of market fire-fighting assessment and comprise the following steps: collecting arrangement information in a market, and acquiring an evacuation risk coefficient according to the arrangement information in the market; constructing a mall panoramic simulation training picture according to arrangement information in the mall and evacuation risk coefficients; carrying out fire-fighting evacuation simulation of the shopping mall by combining the panoramic simulation training chart of the shopping mall and the passenger flow volume of each shop; judging fire safety risk assessment early warning categories of all store positions of a mall according to a fire evacuation simulation result of the mall; and generating early warning information by combining the fire safety risk assessment early warning category of each shop position and the shop risk spreading grade. The evacuation risk is more accurately predicted, the risk of the shop is well combined with the position of the shop, the reasonability of the positions of all shops in a market is judged, and the fire-fighting management arrangement of the shop by the market is facilitated, so that the potential safety hazard of the shop is reduced.
assignees: GUANGDONG GUANGYU SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A system for performing service steering using real-time triggering in the event of a major disaster and a terminal therefor
title_ko: 실시간 트리거링을 활용한 서비스 스티어링을 수행하기 위한 시스템 및 이를 위한 단말
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for performing service steering comprises: a base station configured to report the number of simultaneous access terminals when a terminal attempts a first type of voice service connection; and a steering device configured to determine whether the number of simultaneous access terminals exceeds a threshold value of a maximum accommodation capacity criterion set according to a steering scenario and configured to transmit a fallback triggering request message to the base station to trigger a fallback procedure for providing a second type of voice service connection when the threshold value is exceeded as a determination result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 서비스 스티어링을 수행하기 위한 시스템은 단말이 제1 종의 음성 서비스 연결을 시도하면, 동시 접속 단말의 수를 리포트하는 기지국과, 상기 동시 접속 단말의 수가 스티어링 시나리오에 따라 설정된 최대 수용 용량 기준의 임계치를 초과하는지 여부를 판별하고, 상기 판별 결과, 상기 임계치를 초과하면, 제2 종의 음성 서비스 연결을 제공하는 폴백 프로시저를 트리거하도록 하는 폴백트리거링요청 메시지를 상기 기지국으로 전달하는 스티어링장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Mine disaster emergency simulation method and system based on augmented reality
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine disaster emergency simulation method and system based on augmented reality, and relates to the technical field of mine disaster emergency rescue. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring terrain three-dimensional data and environment data of a roadway; generating a tunnel simulation scene by adopting an augmented reality technology based on terrain three-dimensional data and environmental data; when the environmental data exceed a preset threshold value, carrying out disaster early warning; carrying out mine disaster development and evolution prediction, and carrying out an analog simulation process of a mine disaster emergency scene in a roadway simulation scene; and forecasting an emergency plan based on the simulation process. According to the method and the system, the simulation scene is built by adopting the augmented reality technology, meanwhile, the disaster development trend is predicted according to the environmental data, and the simulation scene is displayed, so that the complexity of building a real object scene is avoided, the prediction capability of disaster development is improved, and the emergency plan is convenient to construct and adjust better.

title_en: Real-time monitoring method and system for river flood prevention
abstract_en: A real-time monitoring method and a system for river flood prevention belong to the technical field of computer vision application. Comprising the following steps: presetting a rule for acquiring river channel videos; training an image segmentation model by using a river channel video in a normal period of flood prevention; calculating the position relationship between the river and the river bank in the normal period of flood prevention; setting an early warning waterline and an alarm waterline in a target scene; obtaining a river mask and a background mask of a current scene; judging whether the minimum circumscribed rectangle of the river mask intersects with the early warning waterline and the warning waterline or not so as to judge whether the river water level is abnormal or not; obtaining visible light video which only keeps river; obtaining river flow rate in normal period of flood prevention 、 Setting an early warning flow rate and an alarm flow rate; and (3) judging whether flood occurs or not or whether flood is possible to occur or not by combining the river flow rate and the river water level. According to the invention, the position relation between the river and the river bank is calculated through a segmentation algorithm, the river flow rate is calculated through an optical flow method, and the automatic early warning and alarm of flood disasters are realized by combining the water level height.

title_en: Oil spill tracing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for tracing to source of spilled oil, which relate to the field of disaster monitoring and comprise the following steps: constructing a historical wind field correction network model based on the self-attention time convolution network, and constructing a training data set based on historical wind field data; the training data set comprises a wind field pair sequence at historical time; inputting the historical wind field pair sequence into a historical wind field correction network model for correction, training a historical wind field correction network model by using the corrected historical wind field data and a preset loss function; inputting the historical wind field data to be corrected into the trained model to obtain the target corrected historical wind field data; based on target corrected historical wind field data and determining a corresponding oil spill traceability value result. The data characteristics of the historical wind field can be effectively extracted through the self-attention time convolution network, so that the historical wind field is corrected, the accuracy of the historical wind field is improved, the oil spill tracing is conducted, and the accurate oil spill tracing result is obtained.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA;QINGDAO ZHONGSHIDA TECH EDUCATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Section wide coal pillar anti-lock drilling hydraulic slotting accurate pressure relief method under high stress state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a section wide coal pillar anti-lock drilling hydraulic seam cutting accurate pressure relief method in a high stress state, which comprises the following specific steps: dividing roadway impact dangerous areas, determining the arrangement direction of drill holes, implementing small-aperture pressure relief drilling, implementing single ultrahigh-pressure hydraulic slotting drilling and implementing a plurality of groups of ultrahigh-pressure hydraulic slotting drilling in sequence; the method uses the protective layer mining principle for reference, and forms a pressure relief area by implementing two rows of bedding dense small-aperture pressure relief drilling holes on the wide coal pillar in the high ground stress state, and can effectively avoid hole collapse and drill embracing by implementing ultrahigh-pressure hydraulic seam drilling in the area, and realizes high-efficiency and accurate pressure relief of hydraulic seam cutting operation by dividing three zones of the wide coal pillar in the area, and simultaneously retains the bearing capacity of the coal pillar, can effectively prevent and control rock burst disasters, reduces roadway deformation and improves the safety and economic benefits of mines.

title_en: Method for controlling heterogeneous collapse of hard rock stratum top plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling uneven collapse of a hard rock layer top plate, and relates to the technical field of coal safety production. The method comprises the following steps: calculating the step distance of the initial pressure and the periodic pressure of the working surface; arranging a drilling field of the plasma pre-splitting drilling hole according to the pressure step pitch, and injecting high-pressure water into the pre-splitting drilling hole; switching on a power supply, converting electric energy into impact energy under the action of a plasma device, and fracturing a hard rock stratum around a drill hole; carrying out stoping operation on the working face, adjusting the cutting depth of the coal mining machine to form an inclined mining working face, and enabling a top plate of the goaf to form a fan-shaped suspended roof when pushing mining is carried out to the first incoming pressure; and after the coal is pushed to a stopping line, the cutting depth of the coal mining machine is adjusted again, so that the working face is perpendicular to the transportation roadway and the return airway, and the residual coal resources on the working face are mined. The method reduces the pressure intensity, and avoids rock burst caused by the whole collapse of the goaf roof and gas disaster accidents caused by the instantaneous overrun of the working face gas.

title_en: Highway side slope monitoring and early warning system and equipment based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway side slope monitoring and early warning system and equipment based on digital twinning. The system comprises: the system comprises a physical entity module, a virtual model module, a service module, a twin data module and a connection module. The real-time state of the highway side slope is efficiently reflected through the virtual digital twin body, the simulation of the whole catastrophe process, the early warning information publication and the prevention and control decision pre-modeling planning are realized, the visualization of the whole catastrophe evolution process of the three-dimensional highway side slope can be realized, the risk prediction precision of the side slope disaster is improved, and the risk prevention and control level of the highway side slope engineering is obviously improved.

title_en: Tunnel 'fire-evacuation' coupling calculation method based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tunnel fire-evacuation coupling calculation method based on cellular automata, which comprises the following steps: step 1, generating a two-dimensional random cellular automaton model with grids according to a movable space of evacuated people in a tunnel digital model, and predicting a fire scene by using relevant numerical simulation software to generate fire scene information; step 2, generating the moving state of the evacuated people according to personal motion parameters, a mobile network selection rule, environmental factors, social influence and a cooperation mode game rule; step 3, coupling the two-dimensional random cellular automata model with fire scene information; step 4, coupling the movement state of the evacuated persons and the fire scene information and the change of each grid node of the two-dimensional random cellular automata model; step 5, finishing the movement of the evacuation personnel and judging the movement state of the evacuation personnel; and 6, outputting the evacuation time and the evolution of the evacuation space of the crowd evacuation personnel, and calculating the total evacuation time and the evacuation success rate.

title_en: Crowd real-time evacuation simulation method based on computer vision
