abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd real-time evacuation simulation method based on computer vision, which comprises the specific steps of collecting human images, creating a human data set, training yolov human detection models by using the human data set, obtaining a camera RTSP video stream, inputting the RTSP video stream into the yolov human detection models to identify human beings and obtain pixel coordinates, carrying out three-dimensional space positioning through monocular machine vision to convert the human pixel coordinates into world coordinates, extracting the characteristics of an evacuation scene, establishing a two-dimensional cellular automaton evacuation model of the evacuation scene, and placing human beings into grids of the cellular automaton evacuation model through the world coordinates to carry out real-time evacuation simulation, thereby realizing simulation of the crowd evacuation process. According to the invention, real-time analysis can be performed according to the actual distribution of personnel and the disaster situation of the emergency scene, and an evacuation strategy is generated in real time, so that management personnel can be helped to carry out evacuation management, and further scientific guidance on emergency safety evacuation plans is realized.

title_en: Early warning protective equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning protection device, which comprises: the transformer cabinet comprises a transformer cabinet main body, a trigger mechanism and a quick cooling mechanism; a plurality of uniformly distributed heat dissipation holes are drilled in the power transformation cabinet main body, and a plurality of early warning lamps are installed on the power transformation cabinet main body; the trigger mechanism is arranged in the main body of the transformer cabinet and comprises a support plate, a trigger cavity is formed in the support plate in a chiseled mode, a sliding contact sleeve is arranged in the trigger cavity, and a first trigger rod and a second trigger rod are arranged on one side of the sliding contact sleeve; on the transformer cabinet main part was located to the fast cooling mechanism, fast cooling mechanism included the liquid nitrogen bucket, was connected with a pair of fluid-discharge tube on the liquid nitrogen bucket, installed the automatically controlled valve on the fluid-discharge tube. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the corresponding mechanism of the power transformation cabinet, the traditional fan can not meet the requirement of timely starting the early warning protection device when the power transformation cabinet dissipates heat, so that not only can workers be timely reminded, but also the internal temperature of the power transformation cabinet can be quickly reduced, and further, a fire disaster is not easily caused and the workers are not easily injured.
assignees: SUZHOU LANKE NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water flow speed detection training device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water velocity detects trainer, including water tank, water pump and the first pipe that tests the speed, the water pump is intake and is held the intercommunication water tank, goes out the first near-end that tests the speed of water end intercommunication, and the first pipe distal end that tests the speed sprays water, and it has first mouthful of water supply velocity detection instrument that tests the speed to stretch into intraductal the measuring the speed to open on the first pipe wall that tests the speed pipe. The firefighter uses the utility model discloses the water velocity is surveyed to the water velocity and training device alright exercise and survey the water velocity, need not to drive to river location. The firefighter only needs to fill water into the water tank, then starts the water pump, and the water pump is taken out the water in the water tank and is pumped toward the first pipe that tests the speed, and water is through the first pipe blowout that tests the speed, just so simulate out the rivers in the first pipe that tests the speed, and the firefighter just can stretch into the intraductal velocity of flow of detecting water that tests the speed through the first mouth that tests the speed with rivers velocity detection instrument.
assignees: ZHANG XIN;LIAO JIE;LU SHICHENG;HUANG QI;ZENG WU;Bu Xiangbang

title_en: Landslide deep continuous pressure testing structure and landslide multi-physical-field monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geological disasters monitors, concretely relates to landslide deep part continuous pressure test structure, many physical field monitoring devices of landslide. The continuous pressure test structure of deep portion of landslide includes: deep continuous pressure test structure of landslide, its characterized in that includes: at least one pressure monitoring module; the pressure monitoring module includes: the inner cavity of the cylindrical shell is divided into a sealing section and filtering sections positioned at two ends of the sealing section; the pore water pressure gauge is positioned in the sealing section; the water through holes are formed in the side wall of the cylindrical shell; the stress sensors are positioned on the outer side of the cylindrical shell; wherein the joint line of the pore water pressure gauge is arranged along the inner side of the side wall of the cylindrical shell; the signal transmission line of the stress sensor penetrates through the water through hole inwards and is arranged along the inner side of the side wall of the cylindrical shell, so that damage to the signal transmission line during testing of the stress of the deep part of the landslide can be avoided, and the stress sensor is particularly suitable for continuously monitoring the drilling stress and the pore water pressure in the deep part of the vertical landslide.

title_en: Tunnel outburst prevention layer thickness calculation method and water outburst blocking method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel outburst prevention layer thickness calculation method and a water outburst blocking method, and particularly relates to the technical field of water-rich tunnel construction. The method specifically comprises the following steps: a tunnel outburst prevention layer thickness calculation method comprises the steps of firstly, building an outburst prevention layer mechanical model, namely a circular plate mechanical model; aiming at the circular plate mechanical model, determining the pressure p of karst water to the circular plate mechanical model and the tensile strength sigma of the circular plate mechanical model  t  Transverse bending moment M  r  Longitudinal bending moment M  θ  And a radius R; according to the known parameters, calculating the shearing force Q applied to the circular plate mechanical model  r  (ii) a Then substituted into shear force Q  r  The critical thickness T of the outburst prevention layer and the safety thickness T of the outburst prevention layer are calculated and determined  o  (ii) a Such asThe computing method calculates to obtain the anti-bump layer safety thickness T  o  The method is applied to a construction method of hole drilling. The calculation method ensures the safety of the tunnel in the karst area and effectively prevents karst geological disasters such as water inrush and mud inrush; the water inrush plugging method has the advantages of short length of the pore channel during drilling, easy pore forming and higher economic benefit.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 23TH BUREAU GROUP 1ST ENG CO LTD

title_en: Smoke volume calculation method of semi-closed submerged arc furnace based on fire simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calculation method for measuring and calculating the smoke quantity of a large semi-closed submerged arc furnace by adopting a fire model thought, which comprises the steps of obtaining the average fire load density in unit time when the semi-closed submerged arc furnace is subjected to furnace tamping and material bundling operation after smoldering, obtaining the theoretical time of complete combustion of CO released during the furnace tamping and material bundling operation of the semi-closed submerged arc furnace and reducing agent with the furnace mouth participating in combustion, and obtaining the maximum heat release rate in the bombing stage after the furnace tamping and material bundling operation of the semi-closed submerged arc furnace by calculation, thus obtaining the smoke volume flow of the semi-closed submerged arc furnace. The method combines production operation to select the worst working condition of the semi-closed submerged arc furnace and the condition of generating the maximum fire heat release rate in the fire disaster stage to be fitted, so as to obtain the smoke volume multiple relation between the worst working condition of the semi-closed submerged arc furnace and the stable and continuous production condition, thereby obtaining the maximum smoke volume flow of the semi-closed submerged arc furnace and providing a preferential reference for reasonably selecting the smoke volume of the semi-closed submerged arc furnace by using an air excess coefficient method.

title_en: Non-rotating down-the-hole hammer drill
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a irrotational down-the-hole hammer drill, the drill comprises leading truck, the down-the-hole hammer tied in a bundle, swing drive arrangement. The guide frame guides the drilling direction, the swing driving device drives the cluster down-the-hole hammer to swing linearly and symmetrically, and the down-the-hole hammer impacts and crushes rock soil. The utility model overcomes among the rotatory technical scheme of current ground drilling rig drill bit, the structure is complicated heavy, and rotation torque is too little, is difficult to seal, and easy wearing and tearing can not drill into the shortcoming of ultra-deep super large wellhole. The utility model has the advantages of equipment structure is simple reliable durable, and rate of drilling is very fast, adapts to work under super large diameter more than 10 meters and the kilometer level degree of depth water pressure, can bore rectangle, circular wellhole, and technical scheme can be applied to secret continuous wall slot milling machine, shaft rig, shaft entry driving machine, mine disaster emergency rescue rig and dive rig.
assignees: WUHAN TONGTUXIN ROAD AND BRIDGE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Portable self-inflating emergency tent
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable emergent tent of aerifing certainly belongs to disaster rescue equipment technical field. The combined storage box in the portable self-inflating emergency tent is formed by mutually splicing detachable plate components, and a tent main body, a folding or retractable supporting rod and a multifunctional module are placed in the combined storage box; the tent main body is a self-inflating expansion type tent, and the folding or contraction type supporting rod is used for supporting the expanded tent main body; the power supply module is power supply equipment. The utility model discloses it is complicated to constitute the component to traditional tent, and operating procedure is loaded down with trivial details, and needs professional technical ability and training just can accomplish the problem of skilled equipment, provides portable from aerifing emergent tent, and this portable from aerifing emergent tent simple structure can be convenient open and pack up, very big when having made things convenient for the calamity to take place various crowds' use.

title_en: Multi-disaster coupling effect test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multiple disaster coupling effect test device, which comprises a vibration table component (20) and a control component, wherein the multiple disaster coupling effect test device (1) also comprises a model box system (30), a rainfall component (40) and/or a flood component (50); the mold box system (30) includes a laminar shear box (31), the laminar shear box (31) being disposed on the vibratory table assembly (20); the rainfall assembly (40) and/or the flood assembly (5) comprise a water tank (2) and a water pump (3), wherein the water pump (3) pumps water in the water tank (2) out through a rainfall opening (42) to simulate rain and/or simulates flood through a flood opening (51) to be injected into the model box system (30). The multi-disaster coupling effect test device can simulate earthquake fluctuation, flood, rainfall, dam damage and the like at the same time, and is compact and reasonable in structure arrangement and convenient to control.

title_en: Multi-level urban waterlogging coupling simulation method considering climate elements
abstract_en: The invention provides a multilevel urban waterlogging coupling simulation method considering climate elements, which aims to couple a climate module, a surface production convergence module and a pipe network convergence module so as to completely and accurately simulate and forecast the urban waterlogging process from multiple levels, and comprises the following steps: acquiring climate data of a target area; calculating the spatial rainfall distribution condition by using the dotted data of the rainfall station; modeling the urban surface production convergence process by adopting a hydrographic hydrodynamic model based on grid data; calculating the surface production confluence; and calculating the convergence of the rainwater pipe network and the coupling water depth. The invention combines GIS theory and technology, deeply analyzes the coupling model principles of multiple modules such as geographical climate factors, surface overflow calculation, pipe network convergence calculation and the like, and more accurately describes the space-time evolution characteristics of real urban rainstorm and waterlogging disaster events by establishing a scientific and reasonable model structure.

title_en: Disaster recovery exercise method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a disaster recovery exercise method, device, equipment and storage medium, in particular to the technical field of data storage. The method comprises the following steps: creating a target virtual volume in a target virtual machine; the mapping relation exists between the target virtual volume and the first data backup and between the target virtual volume and the second data backup; the second data backup is a data backup stored in a mirror image mode for target data in the disaster recovery site; the target virtual machine sends a read/write request to the target virtual volume, and sends the read/write request to at least one of the first data backup and the second data backup to obtain a read/write result; and the target virtual volume returns the read/write result to the target virtual machine to complete disaster recovery exercise. The scheme ensures the data storage efficiency of the disaster recovery node and the I/O performance in the disaster recovery exercise process, thereby ensuring the disaster recovery exercise efficiency.

title_en: Gas simulation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire control simulation training control, in particular to a gas simulation method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the gas simulation method comprises responding to input operation of a user, the input operation is used for representing first gas data input by the user, and the first gas data comprises first gas and first gas concentration; transmitting the first gas data to a plurality of transmitters, such that the plurality of transmitters simulate the first gas data; receiving second gas data sent by a gas detector; judging whether the first gas data and the second gas data meet preset conditions or not; if the first gas data and the second gas data meet the preset conditions, displaying a simulation success message of the first gas data to the user through a display screen, so that a firefighter can perform gas simulation training in the first gas data. The application is beneficial to improving the safety of gas simulation training.

title_en: Method and device for processing rock mass image
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to a method and a device for processing a rock mass image, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of rock mass images, labeling jointed rock mass images and rock mass background images included in each rock mass image, training the improved semantic segmentation model by using the labeled plurality of rock mass images, and performing segmentation prediction on the newly acquired rock mass image by using the trained semantic segmentation model, so that the prediction results of jointed information and background information included in the newly acquired rock mass image can be obtained, a worker can know the jointed information of a certain terrain in time, the possibility of geological disasters is analyzed by means of the jointed information, and the prediction accuracy of disaster geological protection is improved well.

title_en: Air source supplying method for coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air source supplying method for a coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiment, which comprises the steps of calculating theoretical maximum air supply, reversely calculating the required air supply volume according to the air supply, starting an air source supplying device to adjust the air source supplying device to reach the set volume, filling gas with set pressure into the air source supplying device with the set volume, filling the gas with the same pressure into an outburst cavity, fully adsorbing the gas, performing the coal and gas outburst disaster-causing simulation experiment and the like. The invention also provides an air source supply device for the coal and gas outburst disaster simulation experiment, which is exquisite in design and simple and convenient to operate. The invention further provides the relevant quantitative research on the outburst effect of the pressure-relief coal body desorption gas around the outburst hole, and has positive significance for further improving the understanding of the outburst mechanism of the coal and the gas.

title_en: Test device and test method for researching influence of extreme rainfall on diversion channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test device and a test method for researching influence of extreme rainfall on a diversion channel, which comprises the following steps: the channel filling box is filled with a channel model, the channel model comprises two side channel slopes and a channel lining plate positioned between the two side channel slopes, and one side of the channel model, which is close to the first drainage hole, is filled with a drainage body; the rainfall simulation component simulates a channel rainfall scene; a channel water supply assembly simulating a channel water supply scene; the underground water supply assembly is positioned on one side of the simulation box and comprises an underground water storage tank, and water in the underground water storage tank permeates into the channel model through the water permeable holes so as to simulate underground water; and the sensor component is embedded in the channel model to collect the channel bottom, the channel slope pore water pressure and the channel slope displacement. The influence of water, underground water level and rainfall in the channel on the channel is considered, and the method has important significance for further clarifying the channel and channel slope catastrophe mechanism and disaster prevention and control under the extreme rainfall working condition.

title_en: Sudden geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on Beidou multi-frequency information perception
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, in particular to a sudden geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on Beidou multi-frequency information sensing, which comprises monitoring terminal equipment: 4 sets of big dipper GNSS receiver (radio satellite system)/2 sets of autonomous simulation deformation platform equipment (set), the real-time transmission equipment of data, energy supply equipment, storage calculation display device, other accessories, rear end data processing software: sudden geological disaster monitoring and early warning system based on Beidou multi-frequency information perception. According to the invention, through the Beidou data received in real time, the research on the influence rule of satellite orbit motion on the multi-frequency phase observation value is carried out, and the estimation model for eliminating or weakening the multi-frequency observation difference caused by satellite motion is inverted, so that a reliable means can be provided for the real-time monitoring and early warning of major geological disasters in multiple environments.

title_en: Building disaster relief planning system based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building disaster rescue planning system based on BIM, which belongs to the technical field of building fire safety and comprises a building BIM module, an Internet of things sensor acquisition module and a video acquisition module, wherein the building BIM module is used for providing a building information model, namely BIM, the Internet of things sensor acquisition module is used for acquiring environmental information in a building in real time, the video acquisition module is used for acquiring video image information in the building in real time, the system further comprises a disaster analysis module, a virtual reality display module and a disaster command scheduling module, the disaster analysis module is used for analyzing information of the building BIM module, the Internet of things sensor acquisition module and the video acquisition module and pre-judging a disaster development trend, the virtual reality display module is used for displaying results of the disaster analysis module, and the disaster command scheduling module is used for issuing command scheduling information.

title_en: Power distribution system damage and restoration dynamic process assessment method under extreme event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution system damage and restoration dynamic process assessment method under an extreme event, which solves the defects of the prior art and comprises the following steps of S1, determining relevant parameters of the power distribution system and extreme event disaster information, specifically S101, determining network topology parameters of the power distribution system, wherein the parameters comprise line information, user information and power supply information, S102, determining disturbance intensity and duration of the extreme event, S103, determining failure rate of elements of the power distribution system and restoration rate of failed elements in the restoration process according to disturbance intensity and element vulnerability curves of the extreme event, S2, simulating the failure process of the power distribution system, S3, simulating the restoration process of the power distribution system, S4, repeating the steps of S2 and S3 for a plurality of times until the curves converge, S5, and calculating reliability indexes according to the obtained element damage curves, user damage curves, element restoration curves and user restoration curves.

title_en: Comprehensive performance evaluation method of communication network based on comprehensive fuzzy evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication network comprehensive efficiency evaluation method based on comprehensive fuzzy evaluation, and belongs to the field of communication network comprehensive efficiency evaluation. The invention constructs three indexes of communication capacity, disaster recovery capacity and guarantee capacity as a criterion layer index for measuring the comprehensive efficiency of the communication network, selects objective quantitative index as an information layer index, applies an omnet network simulation software to simulate the communication network or obtains information layer index data through expert scoring, quantizes evaluation index through a fuzzy membership function, and calculates the comprehensive efficiency of the communication network by combining a weight matrix determined by an expert. The invention realizes systematic and specific data communication network comprehensive efficiency evaluation of the communication network through a fuzzy theory, and the evaluation result is more objective and accurate.
assignees: NO 54 INST CN ELECT SCI & TECH

title_en: Safety rule extraction and optimization method for toughness improvement of urban energy system
abstract_en: The application relates to a safety rule extraction and optimization method for improving toughness of an urban energy system, which comprises the following steps: calculating the toughness index of the urban energy system, and constructing a double-layer optimization model of the urban energy system; modeling the dynamic characteristics of a power electronic link of the urban energy system; modeling the dynamic characteristics of a multi-energy network of the urban energy system; the method comprises the steps of constructing a two-stage toughness operation model of the urban energy system under a disaster event based on a power electronic link dynamic characteristic model and a multi-energy network dynamic characteristic model, converting the two-stage toughness model of the urban energy system under the disaster event into mixed integer linear constraint based on a preset sparse weight inclined decision tree model, and embedding a double-layer optimization model of the urban energy system to obtain an optimized operation simulation result under the mixed integer linear constraint. Therefore, the safety rule with the advantages of simple form, strong interpretability and strong operability is provided, the solving efficiency can be obviously improved, and the method has obvious innovation and good application value.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Demand response dynamic optimization method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: A demand response dynamic optimization method based on reinforcement learning comprises the following steps: 1) Establishing a demand response model of an electricity vendor and a user; 2) Establishing a dynamic optimization gain function of the electricity selling merchant by establishing the context of a user comfort cost function; 3) Determining the response load of the user by using a demand response revenue function of the user; 4) Converting a revenue function of the current demand response of the electricity vendor into an immediate reward function; 5) Adopting a BP neural network to construct a Q function of reinforcement learning, and adopting an iteration method to train the BP neural network until the Q function is converged; 6) And inputting the current state based on the BP neural network obtained by training, so as to obtain the optimal response load. The invention solves the problem of dimension disaster caused by overlarge state and action space through the method.
assignees: LIAONING DONGKE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line icing monitoring method based on infrared image processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission line icing monitoring method based on infrared image processing, which is technically characterized by comprising the following steps of: acquiring infrared images of corresponding lines which are easy to cover ice by an infrared image acquisition device; the information processing station receives the infrared image acquired by the infrared image acquisition device, inputs the infrared image into a trained infrared image super-resolution reconstruction training model based on the improved SRGAN model, and obtains a line conductor infrared image with a more obvious boundary; comparing the infrared image with improved resolution with the infrared image of the line conductor in the non-icing state, and calculating the icing shape and the icing thickness of the line conductor; and if the icing shape and the icing thickness exceed the safe icing threshold value, related information is sent to the information interaction center, and the monitoring function of the icing of the power transmission line is realized. The invention has reasonable design, can effectively monitor and early warn the icing condition of the power transmission line, prevents the icing disaster of the power transmission line and ensures the operation reliability of the power transmission line.
assignees: STATE GRID JILINSHENG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Inclined fault FSI super-shear earthquake risk estimation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster risk assessment, and discloses an FSI (fault tolerant indicator) super-shear earthquake risk estimation method for an inclined fault, which simulates fault fracture propagation under different sliding angles and determines a sliding angle threshold value for generating FSI super-shear fracture; evaluating the orientation generated by the FSI super-shear fracture according to the asymmetry of the FSI super-shear fracture on the inclined fault; calculating low-frequency peak velocity PGV under different scenes, judging the relation between PGV distribution and fault direction, and evaluating the seismic oscillation distribution range of the upper disc of the inclined fault; and judging the influence of the relative relation between the sliding direction of the upper disc and the fracture propagation direction on the earthquake motion strength so as to guide an earthquake hazard evaluation strategy.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RES INSTITUTE UESTC HUZHOU

title_en: Indoor fire source loading method for simulating real fire disaster of underground tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor fire source loading method for simulating real fire of an underground tunnel, which comprises the steps of S1, processing cuboid test rock blocks, S2, selecting the rock blocks as bases, placing the test rock blocks above the two bases at a left-right interval to form a similar 'delta' structure, S3, arranging heating grooves in the space separated from the bottom surfaces of the test rock blocks between the two bases, S4, spraying fireproof materials along the intersection gaps of the bottoms of the left side wall and the right side wall of the test rock blocks and the two bases and along the intersection gaps of the bottoms of the front wall and the rear wall of the test rock blocks and the heating grooves, S5, placing combustion materials in the heating grooves and loading the damage of the open fire sources, S6, extinguishing the open fire sources, and performing post-treatment on the test rock blocks. The single-side open fire loading of the rock blocks under laboratory scale can be effectively realized, the single-side open fire loading is closer to the condition that the single side wall of the surrounding rock is affected by fire in practice, and the rock open fire damage of the real fire of the underground tunnel is more reasonable and visual to simulate and research by using the single-side open fire loading device.

title_en: Firefighter is with wearing formula cardiopulmonary detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses wearable heart-lung detection equipment for firefighters, and relates to the field of physical function detection. The invention provides wearable cardiopulmonary detection equipment, which enables a fireman to perform cardiopulmonary detection processing during training and task execution, further reflects the real-time condition of cardiopulmonary data during actual training and task execution of the fireman, improves the cardiopulmonary detection effect, enlarges the application range of the cardiopulmonary detection equipment, provides various using modes for the cardiopulmonary detection of the fireman, can enable the cardiopulmonary detection equipment to be always in contact with the cardiopulmonary skin of the fireman during the activity of the fireman, and further can detect the cardiopulmonary of the fireman in real time.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;HANGZHOU WANCHAO MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster-responsible human powered generation system
abstract_en: To aim to play a role in carbon neutrality by providing a charging environment by means of a human power capable of responding to a long-term power failure, and simultaneously, by converting a human kinetic energy into an electric energy, in view of the problem in which: in a modern society where electric devices using secondary batteries, such as smartphones, are indispensable in lives, there may be the occurrence of long-term power failure due to a natural disaster, causing the increase of troubles such as not being able to obtain information due to not being able to charge smartphones.SOLUTION: Residents who evacuate to a refuge shelter during a natural disaster often spend their time in a fixed posture, to become tend to lack of exercise. The present invention compensates a lack of exercise and provides a charging environment for smartphones and the like. The present invention provides an environment in which a generator with a low impedance is mounted on a health bike being an exercise equipment for relieving lack of exercise, and the generated output is charged to a large-capacitance capacitor capable of being removed and moved and capable of being quickly charged, to enable long-term charging of a secondary battery used for a smartphone and the like in a short time exercise by using the large-capacitance capacitor.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Diversion test simulation device for treating water gushing and mud bursting of tunnel
abstract_en: The application provides a tunnel gushes water and gushes mud punishment reposition of redundant personnel experimental simulation device belongs to tunnel engineering technical field, and this tunnel gushes water and gushes mud punishment reposition of redundant personnel experimental simulation device includes ground fracture subassembly and water layer broken subassembly. The hydraulic injection pipe continuously injects water to the water layer sponge, the continuous expansion of the water layer sponge extrudes peripheral soil layers, the peripheral cracks of the high-pressure water layer in the rock soil continuously develop, the lifting cylinder is matched to control the grid frame to fall down to cut the soil layers, the development of the cracks of the high-pressure water layer in the rock soil on one side of the tunnel is accelerated, the damage to the impermeable layer of the tunnel is simulated under the action of hydrostatic pressure and the action of strong water pressure, and therefore the water and mud bursting disasters in the tunnel are induced. And (3) researching the critical state of water and mud bursting of the tunnel under the fracture zone, analyzing the influence factors and characteristics of the water and mud bursting of the tunnel, and providing a certain theory for the safe construction of the tunnel. Provides a certain guide for the related research of the disaster-causing mechanism and disaster control of the water and mud gushing of the tunnel.

title_en: Crowd emergency evacuation robot model based on confrontation reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention aims at the problems of path planning and intelligent decision making of the crowd evacuation robot. By modeling the fire environment of a multi-storey building, the building has a perfect building structure and a fire development mode. An intelligent agent behavior model used for simulating limited visual field and having no prior knowledge on building construction is designed by combining crowd behaviors, and the evacuation robot is trained based on a multi-intelligent agent post credit allocation reinforcement learning algorithm. Meanwhile, an antagonistic fire source generator agent is realized and used for deciding the generation position of the next fire source in a fire scene, modeling optimization is finally carried out on the robot behavior by combining an antagonistic reinforcement learning method, a generator-solver mode is formed, and an agent decision model with the optimal evacuation crowd effect is obtained through repeated iterative training.

title_en: Simulated internal floating roof tank fire practical training device
abstract_en: The application relates to a simulated internal floating roof tank fire practical training device, which relates to the field of dangerous chemical emergency rescue practical training, and comprises a base, wherein a control cabinet for controlling electric elements and an internal floating roof tank simulation tank body are fixedly arranged on the base, and a first fire point and a second fire point are arranged on the internal floating roof tank simulation tank body; the first fire point is used for simulating a fire disaster caused by leakage of the sealing ring of the inner floating roof tank; the second fire point is used for simulating a running motion fire disaster caused by tank leakage. The application has the effects of increasing the types of simulated fires of the simulated internal floating roof tank fire practical training device and improving the universality of the device.

title_en: Model training method, waterlogging prediction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a model training method, a waterlogging prediction device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of disaster risk assessment. The model training method comprises the following steps: constructing a data set corresponding to ponding points and non-ponding points according to historical data of an area to be evaluated; and training the initial model based on the data set to obtain a target model. The waterlogging forecasting method comprises the following steps: acquiring detection data of each grid point in a region to be evaluated; processing the detection data according to the target model to obtain a waterlogging prediction result of the area to be evaluated; wherein the target model is generated according to a model training method. According to the method and the device, the corresponding data set is constructed through the actual situation of the water accumulation points in the region so as to train the model, so that the trained target model can directly evaluate and predict the risk of urban waterlogging according to the detection data, the complexity and the calculated amount in prediction are effectively reduced, and the efficiency in prediction is improved.

title_en: Space layout simulation system and method of emergency rescue network based on augmented reality
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of emergency rescue, and discloses a space layout simulation system and method of an emergency rescue network based on augmented reality, which comprises an emergency rescue system, a simulation modeling system, an augmented reality system and a data statistics system, wherein the emergency rescue system is set for an operation mode, a rescue mode, related preconditions and the like of an emergency model; after the parameters are set, modeling an emergency model, entering an operation main interface, quickly constructing a simulation model, and reflecting an emergency simulation scene to a sand table in real time; after the emergency model normally operates, a required statistical module set is imported into the data statistical system, disaster and rescue situation data are counted, the operation situation of the emergency model is quantitatively reflected in real time, and relevant emergency decisions are made based on the disaster and rescue situation data. The invention introduces an augmented reality technology into a simulation process, sets code blocks and sliders in the system, quickly constructs a spatial layout simulation system of a rescue network, and realizes the virtual-real interactive fusion of disaster environment and rescue situation.

title_en: Internet-based regional emergency response one-key group call alarm system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Internet-based regional emergency response one-key group call alarm system, which relates to the technical field of emergency response and comprises the following components: the emergency response module is used for accident emergency internal alarm, accident emergency external alarm, peripheral enterprise emergency early warning and industrial park rescue team alarm; and the emergency rescue team module is used for managing emergency team members and performing emergency training management. The invention can be installed on mobile terminal mobile phones, is convenient to operate and is suitable for enterprises and industrial parks; through a one-key group calling function, (1) an accident emergency internal alarm is started, and the system automatically searches the information of emergency team members and carries out network telephone calling simultaneously so that the emergency team members can respond quickly; (2) Starting an industrial park rescue team alarm, automatically searching park emergency team member information by the system, and calling by a network telephone at the same time so as to facilitate quick response of the park emergency team member; (3) And starting a one-key early warning function, and receiving information early warning by related personnel of adjacent enterprises so as to make emergency response work.
assignees: SHENZHEN ANCHUANG MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Digital flood prevention drought resistance scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital flood control drought resistance scheduling method and a digital flood control drought resistance scheduling system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1: collecting flood-prevention drought-resistant scheduling data and preprocessing; step S2: setting a label for the acquired flood control drought resistance scheduling information; step S3: splitting flood control drought resistance scheduling information to obtain one or more scheduling means; step S4: setting input monitoring data and output monitoring data; step S5: training a scheduling means model; step S6: and obtaining a flood control drought resistance scheduling strategy applicable to the current site. The invention relies on big data analysis technology to integrate and normalize the business process of the existing flood control drought control plan uniformly, and collect and electronize relevant key information; and the standardized flow process based on a dispatching means is realized, and the working efficiency of flood and drought disaster defense is improved.

title_en: Double-layer power distribution network toughness evaluation method and system considering disaster response and recovery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of toughness evaluation of distribution networks, and particularly discloses a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a double-layer distribution network by considering disaster response and recovery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical ice disaster, power distribution network structure and equipment information of a power distribution network to be evaluated; constructing a double-layer multi-dimension index system of a toughness planning layer and an operation layer of the power distribution network; sampling a fault line by adopting a Monte Carlo method to obtain a fault scene, and screening a typical fault scene based on scene information entropy; adopting a minimum cut load model and an optimal line rush-repair sequence model based on the load importance degree to realize the whole process simulation of a typical fault scene and generate a system performance change curve; and respectively calculating comprehensive evaluation values of the toughness of the power distribution network of the planning layer and the running layer according to the system performance change curve and the structure and equipment information of the power distribution network, and evaluating the toughness of the power distribution network. The toughness evaluation index system of the double-layer distribution network avoids repeated quantitative calculation of the toughness index value.

title_en: Dynamic disturbance testing machine system and method for simulating slope instability of open stope in cold region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic disturbance testing machine system and method for simulating slope instability of an open-pit stope in a cold region, belongs to the technical field of cold region engineering rock mass instability model tests, and comprises a base, a control device, a visual freeze-thaw environment box, a loading device, a rainfall humidifying device, an image acquisition device and a distributed optical fiber monitoring device. The dynamic disturbance testing machine system and the method for simulating the instability of the side slope of the open-pit stope in the cold region are used for revealing the instability process of the physical model of the side slope of the stope under the coupling action of rainfall process, freeze-thaw cycle environment and blasting seismic wave, the image acquisition device is used for acquiring the instability full time sequence images of the side slope under different disaster-causing environments, and the distributed optical fiber mechanism is embedded in the physical model of the side slope of the stope and used for acquiring the physical parameters of the side slope at different positions under different loading environments, so that a theoretical basis is provided for establishing the physical prediction model of the instability of the side slope of the open-pit stope under the mining disturbance action.
assignees: BEIJING UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Crowd gathering identification method and system under unmanned plane angle and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a crowd gathering identification method and system under the angle of an unmanned aerial vehicle and application thereof, and the method comprises the following steps: s00, acquiring multi-frame target images as training image data, and marking the position of each head in the training image to obtain a crowd head position label; s10, clustering the head position labels of the crowd to generate a clustering center point in each frame of training image as label data; s20, training by using the label data and the training image data to obtain a crowd central point algorithm network; s30, estimating cluster center points of the crowd of the video image frame to be detected through a crowd center point algorithm network; and S40, calculating coordinate differences of clustering center points in different video image frames to be detected, and classifying and matching to obtain the track and the movement direction of the crowd. The present application is more practical because it can provide better crowd behavioral analysis for disaster event prevention.

title_en: Disaster reacting and management system based on digital twin and artificial intelligent
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 및 인공지능 기반의 재난 대응 및 운영 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response and operation system based on digital twin and artificial intelligence. The disaster response and operation system comprises: a disaster occurrence detection device; a sensor information collection device; a disaster environment simulation device; and an artificial intelligence learning device. According to the present invention, damage to life and property can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 및 인공지능 기반의 재난 대응 및 운영 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건축물 내/외부의 지정된 장소에 설치되며, 복수의 감지센서를 이용하여 해당 건축물의 내/외부에 피해를 줄 수 있는 재난사고 상황의 발생을 감지하는 재난발생 감지장치와, 재난발생 감지장치에 구비된 각 감지센서로부터 기 설정된 감지센서 고유식별정보를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 해당 건축물 내/외부의 층별 및 위치별로 각 감지센서 고유식별정보를 그룹화화여 감지센서 그룹화 ID를 생성하고, 상기 생성된 감지센서 그룹화 ID와 각 감지센서로부터 감지된 현재의 각 센싱 정보를 전송하는 센서정보 취합장치와, 재난 또는 비재난 상황에서 센서정보 취합장치로부터 전송된 감지센서 그룹화 ID와 각 감지센서로부터 감지된 현재의 각 센싱 정보를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 관리자의 선택에 따라 생성된 가상의 재난환경에 대하여 해당 건축물의 디지털 트윈 환경에서 기 설정된 디지털 트윈 기반의 가상 재난환경 시뮬레이션을 단계별로 수행하는 재난환경 시뮬레이션 장치와, 재난환경 시뮬레이션 장치로부터 수행되는 각 단계에서 생성되는 시뮬레이션 결과정보를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 기 설정된 인공지능(AI) 기반의 기계 학습방법을 통해 해당 관리자의 선택에 따라 생성된 가상의 재난환경에 대한 재난발생 예측 또는 시계열적 재난확산 예측을 학습하여, 해당 관리자의 선택에 따라 생성된 가상의 재난환경에 대한 재난발생 예측정보 또는 시계열적 재난확산 예측정보를 생성하기 위한 인공지능 학습모델을 구축하는 인공지능 학습장치를 포함함으로써, 해당 재난사고 발생 시 사람들의 최적 대피 경로를 예측하고, 여러 종류의 안전 관련 시설물 및 기 설치된 관련 시설물에 대한 제어/통제를 진행하여 인명 및 재산 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation system and fault diagnosis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic power generation system and a fault diagnosis method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of groups of inverter temperatures, environment temperatures, irradiance and photovoltaic backboard temperatures, carrying out standardization processing, inputting the inverter temperatures, the environment temperatures, the irradiance and the photovoltaic backboard temperatures into a first model and a second model to carry out cross training, obtaining a first prediction model and a second prediction model, calculating data of a current photovoltaic power generation system, and judging whether a fault exists. The invention has the beneficial effects that: according to the photovoltaic power generation system, the faults can be identified even if the corresponding change conditions do not reach the overhigh voltage or temperature, and an early prevention effect is achieved, so that further severe conditions such as fire disasters are reduced, and the safety of the photovoltaic power generation system is improved.
assignees: BOTENG SHUKE HANGZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Accurate drilling rig is used in regional water disaster prevention and cure of coal mining
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mining auxiliary devices, in particular to an accurate drilling device for preventing and treating water damage in a coal mining area, which comprises a vehicle body, a drilling assembly and a cleaning assembly, wherein the drilling assembly and the cleaning assembly are both arranged on the vehicle body, the drilling assembly further comprises a lifting column, the bottom end of the lifting column is in threaded connection with a drill rod body, the cleaning assembly further comprises an annular sleeve, the annular sleeve is positioned right below the lifting column and coaxial with the lifting column, a cross is rotatably arranged on the circumferential outer wall of the annular sleeve, and a flushing assembly is arranged on each branch of the cross. In the process that the drill rod body moves upwards to return to the initial position, the flushing assembly is used for flushing mud dirt on the circumferential outer wall of the drill rod body, the circumferential outer wall of the drill rod body can be automatically cleaned when the drill rod body is recovered, the automation degree is high, the labor intensity of workers is effectively reduced, trouble and labor are saved, and the working efficiency is high.
assignees: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH CO LTD OF SHANXI COAL TRANSP & SALES GROUP

title_en: One-stop disaster recovery platform system
title_ko: 원스톱 재해복구 플랫폼 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an one-stop disaster recovery platform system, which provides recovery estimates and recovery simulations through on-site confirmation when damage occurs in a building due to various disasters such as fire, to help decision-making, and supports smooth damage recovery by selecting a recovery company, proceeding with restoration work, and processing insurance work in one stop. The one-stop disaster recovery platform system includes a database, a request module, a judgment module, an estimate module, a recovery support module, and a cost processing module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물에 화재 등 다양한 재해로 인한 피해 발생시 현장확인을 통한 복구견적 및 복구 시뮬레이션을 제공하여 의사결정을 돕고, 복구업체의 선정 및 복구작업의 진행과 보험업무처리를 원스톱으로 진행하여 원활한 피해회복을 지원하는 원스톱 재해복구 플랫폼 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Power distribution terminal optimal configuration method considering extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution terminal optimal configuration method considering extreme weather, which comprises the following steps: generating a typical fault scene under extreme weather through Monte Carlo simulation and scene clustering; constructing a quantification system of power failure loss in a large-scale fault scene of a power distribution system; establishing a power distribution terminal configuration model with the minimum weighted annual power failure loss cost under various typical fault scenes; solving a power distribution terminal configuration model by using a self-adaptive improved bat algorithm; and obtaining the configuration position and type of the power distribution terminal with the minimum weighted annual power failure loss, and outputting a power distribution terminal configuration result. According to the method, the operation condition of the power distribution network in extreme weather is considered, the power distribution terminal planning considering the economy and the reliability is realized by improving the power failure loss quantification method considering the recovery fault of the power distribution terminal, and the extreme disaster coping capability of the power distribution system is further effectively improved.

title_en: Cascade reservoir group burst risk analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing the burst risk of a cascade reservoir group, which can determine the outer envelope line of a burst disaster space and a death area of the cascade reservoir group, know the situation of the burst dam in time and distribute risk early warning when the burst dam occurs, provide support for a downstream organization to take early warning and emergency risk avoiding action and further reduce or avoid unnecessary life loss and property loss. Through determining the envelope and the danger subarea, the relevant data and information are quickly and visually simulated and analyzed, so that the resident evacuation plan can be accurately formulated, the evacuation route can be reasonably arranged, the emergency plan can be perfected, the emergency efficiency can be improved, and the technical support can be provided for the flood emergency management.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: In-flight adaptation and emergency evacuation training with 4D,VR
title_ko: 4d,vr을 이용한 기내 적응 및 비상대피훈련
abstract_en: The present invention relates to in-flight adaptation and emergency evacuation training using 4D and VR, which enables a program operator to proceed smoothly by operating an in-flight adaptation experience and emergency evacuation training reception site (DB server), enables a motion detection and tracking unit to measure the completion of a program of experiencers, enables a control unit to perform normal operation on the program, enables a video output unit to allow participants to check the program through VR and 4D screens, and enables a simulator DB server to convert a data format into a form that can be recognized by a VR engine. According to the present invention, provided is an effect of solving the problem that people with transportation disabilities, such as physically disabled people or children, have difficulties to understand and adapt to actual situations.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 4D,VR을 이용한 기내 적응 및 비상대피훈련에 관한 것으로서 기내 적응체험 및 비상대피 훈련 접수 사이트 운영(DB서버)에 의하여 프로그램 운영자가 원활한 진행을 할 수 있게 하고, 동작감지 및 추적부에 의하여 체험자들의 프로그램 이수도를 측정할 수 있게 하고, 제어부에 의하여 프로그램의 정상적 운영을 위해 하고, 영상 출력부에 의하여 프로그램의 VR과 4D 화면을 통해 참여자가 확인할 수 있게 하고, 시뮬레이터 DB 서버에 의하여 VR 엔진 인식 가능한 형태로 데이터 포멧을 변환할 수 있게 하고, 훈련결과 DB 서버에 의하여 DB에 저장된 훈련결과 데이터를 정리할 수 있게 하고, 데이터 수집부에 의하여 프로그램의 체험자들의 이수도, 개인별 성공률 등을 종합적으로 평가할 수 있게 하고, 시나리오 작성부에 의하여 체험자의 성향과 재난의 유형에 따라 프로그램을 선택할 수 있게 하고, 시뮬레이션 결과 분석부에 의하여 체험자의 프로그램 이수도가 떨어지는 부분을 잡아내고 나은 상황을 설정할 수 있게  함으로써 지체 장애인이나 어린이와 같은 교통 약자들이 이해하고 실제상황에 적용하기 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 지체 장애인이나 어린이와 같은 교통 약자들이 이해하고 실제상황에 적용하기 어려운 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 기내 비상 대피 훈련 에 있어서 기내 난기류 상황을 미리 체험하고 학습할 수 있게 난기류와 같은 강도의 흔들림을 재연한 4D장치, 좀 더 실감나게 기내 상황을 체험하고 교통약자들이 실제 기내에 탑승 했을 때 빠르게 적응 할 수 있게 기내 탑승 순서와 상황을 시뮬레이션한 영상을 제작하여 장치와 연결한 VR장치, 프로그램 운영자가 원활한 진행을 할 수 있게 주최사 사이트에서 '신청-신청자 정보 수집-프로그램 참여 및 완수-기내 적응체험 및 비상대피교육이수증 발급' 절차를 밟는한 기내 적응체험 및 비상대피 훈련 접수 사이트 운영(DB서버), 체험차들이 본 프로그램을 각종 응급 훈련 키트 등으로 참여할 수 있게  안전 구조물, 필요 물품 등이 구비해  형성한 훈련장, 체험자들의 프로그램 이수도를 측정할 수 있게 센서를 구비하고, 사용자의 신체동작을 감지하RH 상기 동작감지부에서 감지된 동작을 추적한 동작감지 및 추적부, 프로그램의 정상적 운영을 위해 상기 동작추적부에서 추적된 동작의 좌표 값을 산출하고 ,상기 제어부에서 좌표 값이 산출되지 않는 동작을 간소화한 동작과 매칭시켜 동작 데이터로 저장하고, 상기 동작추적부에 의해 추적된 상기 간소화된 동작을 상기 좌표 값이 산출되지 않는 동작으로 변환한 제어부, 프로그램의 VR과 4D 화면을 통해 참여자가 확인할 수 있게 훈련 컨텐츠와 상기 제어부에서 산출된 좌표 값과 상기 매칭부에서 전송된 동작 데이터를 영상 객체로 출력한 영상 출력부, VR 엔진 인식 가능한 형태로 데이터 포멧을 변환할 수 있게 해석 모델 및 지배 방정식을 선정하여 해석 결과를 도출한 시뮬레이터 DB 서버, DB에 저장된 훈련결과 데이터를 정리할 수 있게 각 회원별 개인정보와 상황을 파악하여 저장한 훈련결과 DB 서버, 프로그램의 체험자들의 이수도, 개인별 성공률 등을 종합적으로 평가할 수 있게 데이터를 수집하고 보관해 프로그램의 원활한 운영을 일끌어내도록한 데이터 수집부, 체험자의 성향과 재난의 유형에 따라 프로그램을 선택할 수 있게 가상현실 기반의 화재 대피 시뮬레이션 장치는 건물 정보, 요구조자(체험자) 정보를 포함을 활용해 상기 수집된 데이터에 기초하여 화재 및 대피 시나리오를 작성한 시나리오 작성부, 체험자의 프로그램 이수도가 떨어지는 부분을 잡아내고 나은 상황을 설정할 수 있게  대피 시뮬레이션을 실행하여 건물에서 화재가 발생하고 요구조자(체험자)가 대피하는 가상현실 영상을 제공해  반복훈련까지 연결한 시뮬레이션 결과 분석부, 인식하기 어려운 동작을 특정 간단한 동작과 매칭하여 영상 개체의 출력을 원활히 진행할 수 있게  훈련 중에 발생하는 오류를 최소화할 수 있는 효과한 카메라로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 기내 적응체험 및 비상대피 훈련 접수 사이트 운영(DB서버)에 의하여 프로그램 운영자가 원활한 진행을 할 수 있게 하고, 동작감지 및 추적부에 의하여 체험자들의 프로그램 이수도를 측정할 수 있게 하고, 제어부에 의하여 프로그램의 정상적 운영을 위해 하고, 영상 출력부에 의하여 프로그램의 VR과 4D 화면을 통해 참여자가 확인할 수 있게 하고, 시뮬레이터 DB 서버에 의하여 VR 엔진 인식 가능한 형태로 데이터 포멧을 변환할 수 있게 하고, 훈련결과 DB 서버에 의하여 DB에 저장된 훈련결과 데이터를 정리할 수 있게 하고, 데이터 수집부에 의하여 프로그램의 체험자들의 이수도, 개인별 성공률 등을 종합적으로 평가할 수 있게 하고, 시나리오 작성부에 의하여 체험자의 성향과 재난의 유형에 따라 프로그램을 선택할 수 있게 하고, 시뮬레이션 결과 분석부에 의하여 체험자의 프로그램 이수도가 떨어지는 부분을 잡아내고 나은 상황을 설정할 수 있게  함으로써 지체 장애인이나 어린이와 같은 교통 약자들이 이해하고 실제상황에 적용하기 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 지체 장애인이나 어린이와 같은 교통 약자들이 이해하고 실제상황에 적용하기 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing evacuation simulation of buildings
title_ko: 건물의 대피 시뮬레이션 제공 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing an evacuation simulation of a building, which comprises the steps of: obtaining building data related to the structure of a building; obtaining types of non-disabled and disabled people present in the building, and determining occupant data related to behavioral attributes of the disabled and non-disabled people; performing an evacuation simulation for a disaster situation based on the building data and the occupant data; and outputting the results of the simulation on a display screen.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 건물의 대피 시뮬레이션 제공 방법에 관한 것으로서, 상기 방법은, 건물의 구조와 관련된 건물 데이터를 획득하는 단계, 상기 건물에 존재하는 비장애인 및 장애인 유형을 획득하고, 상기 장애인 및 비장애인의 행동 속성과 관련된 재실자 데이터를 결정하는 단계, 상기 건물 데이터 및 상기 재실자 데이터를 기초로 재난 상황에 대한 대피 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 단계 및 상기 시뮬레이션의 결과를 디스플레이 화면에 출력하는 단계를 포함하도록 구성된다.
assignees: KOREA INSTITUTE OF BUILDING ENERGY TECH

title_en: Indoor fire evolution prediction method based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a deep neural network-based indoor fire evolution prediction method, device, electronic device and storage medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: building FDS-based fire evolution simulation, completing the setting of physical model data and key parameters of a fire evolution model, and building simulation data and fitting data of a preset fire scene; generating a temperature field map based on a preset first deep neural network model and a preset second deep neural network model by taking the simulation data as input; and when a fire disaster occurs, receiving field information, generating a predicted temperature field map based on the preset deep neural network model according to the field information, and completing prediction of fire disaster evolution. According to the method, the two-stage deep neural network is designed to carry out high-precision reconstruction on the input vector, and the simulation data of the field model is fitted, so that the real-time performance and the accuracy of fire evolution prediction are improved.

title_en: Dynamic and static load complex environment crack rock body mechanical response simulation test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating the mechanical response of a crack rock body in a complex environment with dynamic and static loads, which comprises the following steps: step one, sample preparation; step two, preparing a multi-field coupling coal rock mass dynamic disaster prevention and control technology simulation system for installation; step three, applying true triaxial stress; step four, preparation and inspection before the dynamic load is used; step five, carrying out seepage test; heating the rock mass sample by using an electric heating pipe; step seven, carrying out a dynamic load test; step eight, detection and adjustment; step nine, replacing the rock mass sample; step ten, repeating the step four to the step eight; step eleven, performing other tests in the same group; step twelve, the test is finished. Through different acting force loading in the length direction and the action of graded dynamic load, the triaxial stress state of an underground reservoir and the mechanical response rule of fractured rock mass in the temperature, stress and seepage coupling environment under dynamic and static load can be simulated more truly.
assignees: PINGDINGSHAN TIANAN COAL MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING;CHINA PINGMEI SHENMA HOLDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mine disaster escape simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster escape simulation system and method. The method comprises the following steps: the system comprises a mine data acquisition module, a mine disaster simulation module and an escape route planning module; the mine disaster simulation system comprises a mine disaster simulation module, a mine data acquisition module, a mine disaster simulation module and a mine disaster simulation module, wherein the mine disaster simulation module is connected with the mine disaster simulation module and used for acquiring mine environment data of each area in a mine and sending the mine environment data to the mine disaster simulation module; the mine disaster simulation module is connected with the escape route planning module and used for setting mine disaster parameters and displaying simulated diffusion information of harmful gas according to mine environment data; and the escape route planning module is used for determining a first escape route according to the simulated diffusion information and the position information of the mine personnel and displaying the first escape route. By the technical scheme, the mine personnel can be quickly guided to select the optimal escape route when a disaster happens, so that the problem that the life safety of the mine personnel is threatened is solved.
assignees: NANJING BESTWAY INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Early warning structure for monitoring urban environment geological disaster hidden danger
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of early warning structures, and discloses an early warning structure for monitoring urban environment geological disaster hidden dangers, wherein a sensor monitors stress change data of a soil body and feeds the stress change data back to a control center, and the control center analyzes the stress change data and carries out early warning; the outer drilling barrel can directly drill into a soil body at the monitoring position, and the fixing plate is fixed at the monitoring position and is relatively fixed with the outer drilling barrel, so that the outer drilling barrel is fixed; the outer drill pipe seals the hollow opening through the plugging block in the drilling process, the moving rod is arranged in the outer pipe cavity and abuts against the plugging block to move downwards to the accommodating section, so that the sensor on the lateral elastic block penetrates through the hollow opening and is exposed in the soil body, the stress change data of the soil body can be monitored, the whole construction and installation process is convenient, grooves do not need to be excavated, the construction efficiency is high, and the sensor is convenient to maintain or replace.
assignees: SHENZHEN GONGKAN GEOTECHNICAL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise risk assessment method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an enterprise risk assessment method, an enterprise risk assessment device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining enterprise inherent risk information, enterprise safety management level information, enterprise accident handling capability information and disaster-bearing carrier information of a target enterprise at the current moment, simulating accident consequence information caused by the occurrence of accidents of the target enterprise at the current moment through an accident simulation model, determining a first risk value of the target enterprise according to the enterprise inherent risk information and the disaster-bearing carrier information, determining a second risk value of the target enterprise according to the accident consequence information, determining a first anti-risk value of the target enterprise according to the enterprise safety management level information, determining a second anti-risk value of the target enterprise according to the enterprise accident handling capability information, and calculating the enterprise safety risk value of the target enterprise according to the first risk value, the second risk value, the first anti-risk value and the second anti-risk value. By the method, timeliness of enterprise risk assessment is improved.

title_en: Rainfall station abnormal data detection method based on space-time elements
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall station abnormal data detection method based on space-time elements, which comprises the following steps: s1, evaluating space abnormality: s2, evaluating time sequence abnormality: s3, supervised learning: selecting historical normal rainfall station data and abnormal rainfall station data, constructing a training set, taking a space abnormal evaluation score and a time sequence abnormal evaluation score as sample characteristics, and carrying out model training on the training set according to abnormal results of the normal rainfall data and the abnormal rainfall data to obtain a final rainfall data supervision learning model; s4, abnormal data detection: calculating a space abnormal evaluation score and a time sequence abnormal evaluation score of the rainfall station to be measured at a certain moment, and inputting rainfall data supervision learning model to obtain an abnormal evaluation result of the rainfall station to be measured at a certain moment. The method for detecting the abnormal data of the rainfall station improves the accuracy and the interpretability of the detection of the abnormal data of the rainfall station, and provides effective support for quality control of ground observation rainfall data and disaster prevention and reduction work.

title_en: Rescue scene simulation method, device and equipment based on behavior tree
abstract_en: The invention provides a rescue scene simulation method, device and equipment based on a behavior tree, which are used for solving the technical problems of lower simulation level of disaster rescue scenes and poorer disaster prevention capability in the related technology; the method comprises the steps of determining a calculation model of a scene based on scene information, wherein the calculation model is used for simulating the state of the rescue scene according to the scene information, generating a plurality of disaster-causing factor agents and a plurality of rescue force agents based on the scene information and the calculation model, configuring a behavior tree for the disaster-causing factor agents and the rescue force agents, and simulating the rescue scene.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning device and a using method thereof, which mainly relate to the technical field of geological disaster early warning and comprise a platform frame, wherein the platform frame is detachably arranged on a top layer frame, an electrode assembly is arranged on the top layer frame, a water level detection instrument and a vibration detection instrument are also fixedly arranged on the top layer frame, a middle layer frame is arranged below the top layer frame in a sliding way, a long side rod and a short side rod are fixedly arranged on the middle layer frame, a telescopic assembly is arranged on the middle layer frame in a sliding way, the telescopic assembly is hinged with a lifting ring, and a bottom layer frame is arranged below the middle layer frame in a sliding way; a spiral drill bit is rotatably arranged on the top layer frame, a leakage hole is formed in the spiral drill bit, an inner pipe is arranged in the spiral drill bit, and an inner hole is formed in the inner pipe; the sensing assembly is fixedly installed on the spiral drilling head, and the limiting assembly is arranged on the spiral drilling head; the invention can be drilled below the ground surface to monitor the water level below the ground surface and can also monitor the earthquake sense underground.
assignees: HENAN NONFERROUS ENG SURVEY CO LTD

title_en: Multistage mountain region disaster chain analogue test device
abstract_en: The invention provides a multistage mountain disaster chain simulation test device which comprises a lifting hopper, a water supply pipeline, two storage bins, two sections of test grooves and a alluvial platform. The device can simulate single disasters such as debris flow/mountain torrents/debris flow and three-level to four-level mountain disaster chain processes such as debris flow/landslide/ice collapse-dammed lake-burst flood, dammed lake-burst flood and the like through a two-stage experimental tank and a surge platform, can monitor parameters such as impact force, flow velocity, groove/quay wall pressure, lateral erosion force and the like of fluid/solid matters in the four-level disaster chain processes of static rotation/little rotation/fast rotation in the disaster chain generating motion and conversion process, researches motion conversion mechanisms such as energy, heat, momentum and the like in each process of the mountain disaster chain and disaster formation mechanisms such as impact, silting, burying and the like causing disasters, can test disaster reduction methods of broken chains, governing projects such as blocking, drainage, energy discharge and the like and related prevention and control effects, and achieves the purpose of preventing and reducing disasters.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Hydrologic data anomaly identification and repair method based on federal learning framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrological data anomaly detection and repair method based on a federal learning framework, which comprises a model training process and an identification repair process, wherein the model training process comprises the following steps of firstly preprocessing training hydrological data and carrying out anomaly processing, secondly building the federal learning framework, initializing model parameters by a server and sending a global model to each client, starting to learn local data characteristics after the client receives the model, extracting context information by the model by using a bidirectional LSTM with an attention mechanism, simultaneously optimizing anomaly detection and data repair functions in an anti-learning mode, and finally updating the model function through iterative interaction between the client and the server. According to the method, on the premise that the hydrological telemetering data privacy is protected, the anomaly identification and repair are carried out simultaneously, so that support is provided for improving hydrological forecasting performance and reducing loss caused by uncertain disasters.

title_en: Physical simulation method for hydraulically communicating and exploiting heavy oil reservoir by VHSD (very high-Density digital) vertical well and horizontal well
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical simulation method for hydraulic communication exploitation of a heavy oil reservoir by a VHSD (very high-speed gas-insulated switchgear) vertical well and a horizontal well, which comprises the following steps: step one, preparing a test material; simulating stratum pressing; step three, equipment connection; step four, preparing a multi-field coupling coal rock mass dynamic disaster prevention and control technology simulation system for installation; loading a preset ground stress value; step six, hydraulic capacity expansion of the oil sand reservoir; seventhly, researching the influence of the ground stress anisotropy; step eight, researching the influence of temporary VHSD blocking and capacity expansion; ninthly, researching the influence of the vertical well and horizontal well distance on communication; step ten, finishing the test. The large-size heavy oil reservoir simulation exploitation can be carried out, the simulation process is more real and reliable, and the automation degree is high.

title_en: Multi-feature optimization based method for rapidly and dynamically monitoring Sentinel-1 data in flood
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing images and discloses a method for rapidly and dynamically monitoring a flood disaster by using Sentiel-1 data based on multi-feature optimization, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out RefineLee filtering, dB image conversion and other processing on the Sentiel-1A data to obtain SAR images before, during and after the disaster; then, constructing a flood sample library by a manual interpretation method, wherein the flood sample library comprises training samples and verification samples; the method includes the steps that differences of water bodies and non-water bodies in texture features, index features and topographic features are researched aiming at influences of paddy field shadows and mountain shadow on water body extraction results in complex surface environments; then, a SEATH algorithm is selected to optimize the characteristics of the characteristics, so that a random forest water body extraction model is constructed, and high-precision pre-disaster, in-disaster and post-disaster water body extraction is realized; finally, disaster situations are analyzed through superposition analysis and geographic statistics. The flood information acquisition system can realize flood information acquisition in large-scale complex environments with high precision and fast, and has important significance for flood situation early warning, fast response and risk prevention and control.
assignees: BEIJING DBLUE SPACE REMOTE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: BDI model-based flood scene emergency evacuation simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood scene emergency evacuation simulation method and system based on a BDI model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a flood simulation model; performing logic simulation on the flood simulation model, and recording simulation result data at each time step; performing visual display on simulation result data in real time in the simulation process; the method comprises the following steps of constructing a flood simulation model, wherein the constructing of the flood simulation model comprises the steps of constructing an urban space scene, constructing a main body and constructing a precipitation variation and flood diffusion model; logic simulation includes simulating the activities of subjects within the flood simulation model, emotional infections between subjects, and the behavior patterns of subjects at different emotional levels. Compared with the prior art, the method and the system support the simulation of the psychology and behavior mode of the disaster-stricken population, save the complex data arrangement and simulation program development work for researchers, improve the working efficiency, and help related workers to conveniently and efficiently master the psychology and the behavior of the disaster-stricken population.

title_en: Public health management system for processing trace source of cash microorganism data of financial system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a public health management system for processing trace sources of cash microorganism data of a financial system. The system comprises: recording the date and the geographic position of each banknote when the banknote flows back; acquiring a long-time circulation characteristic descriptor and a short-time circulation characteristic descriptor of each paper money; obtaining a geographical circulation range index, a reflux stability index and an activity rating index of each banknote; obtaining a microorganism characteristic descriptor of each paper currency; obtaining a public health event, obtaining a plurality of circulation modes by using clustering, obtaining general microorganism feature descriptors of each circulation mode, obtaining an adjusted public health event, obtaining a token Q corresponding to each record, obtaining an LOF value according to each cash situation feature, reducing the illusion phenomenon of LLM training based on the proportion of Dropout obtaining the token Q, and inputting the token Q and a plurality of guide sentences into the LLM to obtain an emergency response scheme.

title_en: Flame combustion device and test system for hot-rolled H-shaped steel weldability test
