abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flame combustion device and a flame combustion system for a hot-rolled H-shaped steel welding property test, which belong to the field of hot-rolled H-shaped steel welding property tests, and comprise a cylindrical combustion box body formed by buckling two groups of semi-cylindrical combustion box bodies and more than two burner assemblies uniformly distributed on the outer circumferential side wall of the cylindrical combustion box body; an accommodating space for accommodating the I-shaped steel member is formed at the position of the middle axis of the cylindrical combustion box body. The cylindrical combustion box formed by buckling the two groups of semi-cylindrical combustion box bodies is arranged on the side face of the I-shaped steel component, enough space is reserved for the design of the fixing and moving assembly of the hot-rolled H-shaped steel on the upper and lower parts of the I-shaped steel component under the condition that a large heat exchange area is reserved between the two groups of semi-cylindrical combustion box bodies and the I-shaped steel component, so that the welding test of the structural component in the fire disaster environment can be simulated during an earthquake, the position design of the structure of the flame combustion device on the I-shaped steel component is simple and reasonable, and the operability is strong.
assignees: HEBEI XINDA IRON & STEEL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Interactive experience device for simulating tunnel fire collapse
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an interactive experience device for simulating tunnel fire collapse, which comprises an experience shed for simulating tunnel shape and a control cabinet arranged outside the experience shed, wherein an inlet gate is arranged at the inlet of the experience shed, a simulated falling rock, a smoke sensor, an alarm indicator light and a monitoring camera are arranged at the top of the experience shed, active sound columns and fans are arranged at two sides in the experience shed, and a smoke machine and an escape channel are arranged on the ground of the experience shed. The utility model has simple structure, reasonable design and convenient realization, can be effectively used in the interactive experience of simulating the collapse of the tunnel fire disaster, enables tunnel constructors to know the tunnel escape knowledge, improves the safety precaution consciousness, enhances the self-protection capability, has good use effect and is convenient to popularize and use.
assignees: SHAANXI ALADDIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Server, method and computer program for managing power quality
title_ko: 전력 품질을 관리하는 서버, 방법 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention provides a server for managing power quality, which comprises: a voltage data acquiring unit for acquiring a plurality of voltage data from a plurality of voltage sensors installed near a power supply device and a power distribution device which constitute a power system; a simulation unit which simulates power quality based on whether harmonics occur and the degree of voltage drop; and a diagnostic unit which diagnoses whether an abnormality in the power quality occurs based on the results of the simulation, wherein the simulation unit comprises: a harmonic generation determination unit which determines whether harmonics are generated through a first power quality prediction engine based on the first voltage data measured at an input terminal of the power supply device among the plurality of voltage data; and a voltage drop detection unit which detects the degree of voltage drop through a third power quality prediction engine based on third voltage data measured at an output terminal of the power distribution device. The simulation unit functions as an environment of a deep reinforcement learning model, and the diagnosis unit functions as an agent of the deep reinforcement learning model. The agent is given state information including power quality prediction data predicted through the deep reinforcement learning model, and the agent takes action to detect whether the abnormality in the power quality occurs based on the state information so as to satisfy a preset reward function. The present invention can minimize the downtime of a computer room due to electrical disasters.
abstract_ko: 전력 품질을 관리하는 서버는 전력 시스템을 구성하는 전원 공급 장치 및 전원 분배 장치 부근에 설치된 복수의 전압 센서로부터 복수의 전압 데이터를 획득하는 전압 데이터 획득부, 상기 복수의 전압 데이터 중 상기 전원 공급 장치의 입력단에서 측정된 제 1 전압 데이터에 기초하여 제 1 전력 품질 예측 엔진을 통해 고조파 발생 여부를 판단하는 고조파 발생 판단부 및 상기 전원 분배 장치의 출력단에서 측정된 제 3 전압 데이터에 기초하여 제 3 전력 품질 예측 엔진을 통해 전압 강하 정도를 검출하는 전압 강하 검출부를 포함하고, 상기 고조파 발생 여부 및 상기 전압 강하 정도에 기초하여 전력 품질을 시뮬레이션하는 시뮬레이션부 및 상기 시뮬레이션의 결과에 기초하여 상기 전력 품질에 대한 이상 발생 여부를 진단하는 진단부를 포함하고, 상기 시뮬레이션부는 심층 강화학습 모델의 환경(Environment)으로 기능하고, 상기 진단부는 상기 심층 강화학습 모델의 에이전트(Agent)로 기능하고, 상기 에이전트로 상기 심층 강화학습 모델을 통해 예측된 전력 품질 예측 데이터를 포함하는 상태(State) 정보가 주어지고, 상기 에이전트는 기설정된 리워드(Reward) 함수를 만족하도록 상기 상태 정보에 기초하여 상기 전력 품질에 대한 이상 발생 여부를 감지하도록 행동(Action)한다.

title_en: Dynamic visualization method and device for earthquake disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to a dynamic visualization method and device for earthquake disasters. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining point cloud initial data of a building and a scene of a target area, obtaining shaking displacement data of the building, wherein the shaking displacement data simulate earthquake excitation of the building and the scene, performing voxel downsampling and point cloud segmentation and extraction processing on the point cloud initial data, determining ground point clouds and point clouds corresponding to each building, updating coordinate values of each point of the point clouds corresponding to each building at the current moment in real time according to the shaking displacement data of the building, rendering the coordinate values of each point of the ground point clouds and the point clouds corresponding to each building at the current moment in real time, and generating a dynamic visual image for display. Therefore, the regional building earthquake hazard scene can be more truly and intuitively presented, and the visual effect is improved.

title_en: Device and method for measuring artificial lung tidal volume curve for air breathing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial lung tidal volume curve measuring device and method for an air breathing machine, comprising a variable capacity type pressure measuring device, a bracket which is arranged below the variable capacity type pressure measuring device and plays a supporting role, an air supply device which is arranged at one side of the variable capacity type pressure measuring device, a test head die which is arranged at the other side of the variable capacity type pressure measuring device and is used for conducting air flow, an artificial lung which is arranged below the test head die and is used for simulating human lung breathing, a driving motor and a controller for collecting data, and a display for visualizing a collection result. The measurer only needs to record the values of the pressure sensors of the variable capacity type pressure measuring device before and after the valve is opened. The invention can accurately measure the bellows type artificial lung tidal volume curve, realize accurate control of tidal volume of the motor, further ensure detection of the positive pressure type air breathing machine and avoid occurrence of casualties of firefighters caused by false detection of the positive pressure type air breathing machine.

title_en: Mine external factor fire monitoring method with visible light visual characteristics fused
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine external factor fire monitoring method with visible light visual characteristics fused, which mainly comprises the following steps: a visible light camera is installed at the optimal position of the area to be monitored of the mine; dividing a fire disaster area by adopting an improved seed area growth algorithm; calculating static characteristics and dynamic characteristics of a fire area, and establishing a fire sample data set and an identification model; respectively training and testing an identification model; the mine fire monitoring system monitors whether a mine external fire exists or not in real time through the identification model; when the presence is identified, a fire alarm is activated. The mine external fire monitoring method can overcome the problems of the existing monitoring method, and can improve the identification speed, accuracy and reliability of early fire on the basis of realizing underground large-area monitoring, thereby meeting the actual requirements of coal mine safety production.

title_en: Attached lifting scaffold monitoring simulation application system based on BIM technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an attached lifting scaffold monitoring simulation application system based on a BIM technology, and belongs to the field of construction engineering auxiliary facilities. The system comprises a safety monitoring module, a cloud processing module, a BIM cooperative platform, an emergency response module and an intelligent video monitoring module, wherein a climbing frame safety analysis model is established in advance through a BIM technology, the climbing frame safety monitoring module and the emergency response module are subjected to simulation arrangement in advance, and the system is connected to the BIM cooperative platform to monitor the safety condition of a climbing frame on site in real time; the system not only can timely monitor the stress change of the climbing frame, but also has the safety analysis functions of identifying whether climbing frame operators have the climbing action, identifying whether climbing frames have the action of piling up bordered materials and the like. According to the invention, the security condition of the climbing frame is previewed and early-warned intuitively through the BIM three-dimensional model, so that the manual consumption is greatly reduced, the monitoring accuracy is improved, and the security of the climbing frame construction stage is enhanced.

title_en: Main body model for multi-field coupling coal rock mass dynamic disaster prevention and control simulation test
abstract_en: The invention discloses a main body model for a multi-field coupling coal rock mass dynamic disaster prevention and control simulation test, which comprises a main body high-pressure cavity module and a test piece box module, wherein the outer shell of the main body high-pressure cavity module adopts a high-pressure closed pressure bin structure of an outer circle and an inner circle surrounded by a circular ring, a left circular end cover and a right circular end cover combined bolt, a front cushion block, a rear cushion block, an upper cushion block and a lower cushion block are respectively arranged on the front, the rear, the upper cushion block and the lower cushion block on the inner wall of the circular ring, the front cushion block, the rear cushion block, the upper cushion block and the lower cushion block are surrounded into a rectangular cavity for the test piece box module to be put in, a row of lifters are arranged at the left and the right of the top of the lower cushion block at intervals, and can protrude out of the lower cushion block and sink into the lower cushion block; a plurality of heating pipes and temperature control probes are installed on the upper pressing plate, the front pressing plate, the bottom plate and the rear side plate through holes, and a plurality of ultrasonic probes are installed on the upper pressing plate, the front pressing plate, the left pressing plate, the bottom plate, the rear side plate and the right side plate through holes. The method has the advantages of stronger bearing capacity, better reliability and sealing performance, more convenient operation and capability of meeting the requirements of multi-field coupling coal-rock mass dynamic disaster prevention and control simulation tests.

title_en: Network selection method considering priority and link stability in emergency communication network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network selection method considering priority and link stability in an emergency communication network. Aiming at the damage of ground communication infrastructure caused by natural disasters, the communication demands of disaster area users are increased sharply, and network resources are tense. A self-adaptive network selection method is provided for solving the problems of high call drop rate and high access failure rate caused by unstable network access. The method specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, giving priority to users according to service types, comparing the user priorities, and selecting users with high priorities to access the network preferentially. Second, defining the link stability index and quality index in combination with the degree of loading presents an adaptive network selection algorithm based on improved TOPSIS. And screening out the target network with highest satisfaction under the current environment for the user. Finally, the simulation result shows that the network selection method can effectively reduce the average blocking rate and the access failure rate of the network while effectively reducing the call drop rate of the user terminal accessing the network, and fully utilizes the resources of the heterogeneous wireless network.

title_en: Landslide time prediction method based on APSO-HMM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide time prediction method based on APSO-HMM, which comprises the following steps: step 1, preprocessing collected landslide full-period displacement data, and carrying out multi-state division on the collected displacement data in a time sequence direction; step 2, training the landslide displacement data with the divided states by using a Baum-welch algorithm, optimizing hidden Markov model parameters by adopting a self-adaptive particle swarm with disturbance factors, and training and constructing a landslide evolution state model APSO-HMM; and 3, performing state decoding on the real-time acquired data by using a Viterbi algorithm by using the landslide evolution state model to obtain a state sequence corresponding to the time sequence, and taking the current estimated state as the input of a Dijkstra algorithm, so that the possible occurrence time of landslide is pre-judged. The invention optimizes the initial parameters of the hidden Markov model. By utilizing the optimal path algorithm, the landslide disaster occurrence time can be accurately predicted.

title_en: Method for treating water damage caused by blocking-proof drilling drainage of accumulated water in mine goaf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating water damage caused by blocking-preventing drilling and drainage of accumulated water in a goaf of a mine, which is characterized in that the accumulated water in the goaf is treated through a dynamic supply source and a static water storage space according to geological conditions, occurrence conditions of a overlying rock aquifer and a water barrier, mining overlying rock crack development conditions and exploration results of an electric method and geophysical prospecting, so that a systematic complete goaf water damage treatment method is formed; the goaf ponding water disaster treatment scheme comprising the three parts of an isolation scheme design, a plugging water bursting point and a hydrophobic water pressure is provided, so that the replenishing effect of a dynamic replenishing source on goaf ponding is blocked; the water pressure is reduced by dredging and lowering the water-bearing layer of the top and bottom boards through the top board penetrating waterproof hole and the bottom board penetrating waterproof hole, so that the water filling amount and the water bursting danger are reduced; the technical problems of large workload and potential safety hazard caused by untimely drainage in the goaf drainage technology are solved.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Reliability assessment method for distribution network under ice disaster by considering various flexible resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability evaluation method of an ice disaster power distribution network considering various flexible resources, which comprises the following steps: the influence of ice disasters on the power transmission line in the power distribution network is evaluated, and a state-dependent power transmission line operation reliability model of the power distribution network under the ice disasters is established; calculating reliability parameters of each power transmission line in the power distribution network under the ice disaster; generating a power transmission line fault state scene set; for each fault scene, running an optimal load shedding model of the power distribution network considering various flexible resources; obtaining a reliability evaluation index of the distribution network under ice disaster; according to the reliability evaluation method for the ice disaster distribution network considering various flexible resources, which is provided by the invention, the operational reliability model of the element of the ice disaster distribution network is built, the element fault scene of the distribution network is formed, the operational simulation of the distribution network considering various flexible resources in multiple scenes is carried out, the reliability evaluation index of the ice disaster distribution network is obtained, and finally the reliability evaluation of the ice disaster distribution network considering various flexible resources is realized.

title_en: Gaseous and dust explosion shock wave generation experimental device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gaseous and dust state explosion shock wave generation experimental device, which comprises a precursor detonation component, a diaphragm component, a driven propagation pipeline and a gas path module, wherein the front end of the precursor detonation component is connected with the gas path module, the rear end of the precursor detonation component is provided with the diaphragm component, and the rear end of the diaphragm component is provided with the driven propagation pipeline; the invention can simulate the limited explosion environment of combustible gas and dust tiny particles by arranging the gas and dust state explosion shock wave generating device, thereby simulating the experimental environment of impacting individual protective equipment by gas or dust explosion shock waves, providing a new device for researching the explosion-proof performance of the protective equipment, testing the shock wave acting on the impact overpressure value of the individual protective equipment under different explosion environments by the testing system, providing references for personnel engaged in dangerous chemicals industry, firefighters, explosive-handling personnel and the like, and achieving the purpose of protecting the life safety of people.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Risk avoidance evaluation simulation method and system for high-density crowd in natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk avoidance evaluation simulation method and a system for high-density crowd in natural disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing and obtaining a frame simulation model; calculating dynamic force fields, namely calculating the dynamic force fields inside the same kind of particles and among different kinds of particles, and determining the stress of an individual according to the change of the dynamic force fields; determining a convex polygon set required to pass through by an optimal path of an individual according to a plurality of three-dimensional planes, and determining a global path; scanning is carried out in the alternative target area until the minimum angle without shielding is found out, so as to confirm the local path; according to the stress of the individual, the position of the individual, the stress of the fluid, the position of the fluid, the global path of the individual and the local path of the individual, a model rendering scene is obtained by combining the fluid type, and risk avoidance evaluation is carried out based on the model rendering scene. The invention can accurately position particle movement to realize accurate and efficient detection effect on dangerous watershed.

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for power distribution network containing distributed energy sources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution system elasticity assessment method containing distributed energy, which comprises the steps of firstly adopting Gumbel probability distribution to generate disaster scenes; then randomly sampling the element fault state according to the vulnerability equation, and dividing the network state based on a graph searching algorithm; then establishing an island micro-grid optimization problem based on mixed integer programming, taking the minimum total cost of load shedding compensation and distributed energy running cost as an objective function, and taking reactive power and voltage control problems into consideration to carry out linearization treatment on alternating current power flow; and finally, considering time-varying characteristics of the distributed renewable energy output and the load demand, adopting non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation to simulate, recording the load state under each disaster simulation, and calculating to obtain the elasticity evaluation indexes of the node level and the system level. According to the invention, a set of complete elastic evaluation index system is established by considering various uncertainty factors, so that the defending and recovering capabilities of the distribution network system to extreme events are quantified.
assignees: HUANGGANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network anti-seismic toughness comprehensive calculation method considering water quality and water quantity indexes
abstract_en: A comprehensive calculation method for the earthquake-resistant toughness of an urban water supply pipe network taking water quality and water quantity indexes into consideration belongs to the field of water supply pipe network earthquake-resistant performance evaluation. The method comprises the following steps: probability P of pipeline shock hazard  f  Is calculated; pipeline lineConfirming the post-earthquake state; determining the area of a leakage hole of a leakage pipeline; establishing a pipe network hydraulic model of the earthquake damage scene; simulating a pipe network post-earthquake recovery process, and adopting a pipeline dynamic importance ranking method to collect the pipeline water source distance to determine the post-earthquake recovery sequence; establishing a hydraulic power and water quality model of a pipe network in the post-earthquake recovery process; calculating the anti-seismic toughness; and (5) calculating the mean value of the anti-seismic toughness. According to the method, the water quality index is incorporated into the evaluation index of the anti-service performance of the urban water supply network, and the anti-seismic toughness of the urban water supply network is comprehensively calculated; the method for integrating the pipeline water source distances by adopting the pipeline dynamic importance sorting method is adopted to determine the post-earthquake repair order, so that the determined pipeline repair order is more reasonable; the water supply toughness evaluation index disclosed by the invention can comprehensively reflect the post-earthquake anti-seismic toughness, the hydraulic power and water quality change characteristics and the relative difference of a pipe network, considers the uncertainty of pipeline damage under an earthquake scene and the uncertainty of leakage type of a leakage pipeline, and generates a sufficient number of random earthquake damage scenes through Monte Carlo simulation. Has guiding significance for post-earthquake disaster relief and repair work.

title_en: Data analysis and early warning method based on distributed disaster recovery drilling scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data analysis and early warning method based on a distributed disaster recovery drilling scene, which comprises the following steps: step one: training a central early warning model in a distributed manner and carrying out privacy data aggregation; step two: the first step of data is put into a model for training, a local disaster backup exercise early warning model is obtained through training, the disaster backup exercise early warning model data of each place are submitted to a central server for updating the disaster backup exercise early warning model, a headquarter exercise result database is updated, and updated indexes after each training are stored; meanwhile, updating the service identifier and storing the service identifier into a database to serve as an initial service identifier of the next disaster backup scene of the same type, and commanding the central server program to execute new model training again, so that the whole process is completed, and the probability of a real disaster in the training process of disaster backup exercise is obtained. The invention can effectively overcome the problem of model deviation and reduce the calculation complexity.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM SHUZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Lightning disaster identification method and system based on numerical simulation and cope parameters
abstract_en: The invention provides a lightning disaster identification method and a lightning disaster identification system based on numerical simulation and cope parameters, comprising the following steps: acquiring lightning stroke disaster information to be identified, and acquiring corresponding CAPE parameters according to the lightning stroke disaster information to be identified; inputting the CAPE parameters into a pre-established multiple regression model, and determining the lightning stroke position; the multiple regression model is constructed by taking CAPE parameters obtained by historical lightning disaster information as input, performing numerical simulation calculation based on the CAPE parameters, and taking identified lightning disaster information as output. According to the method, the historical CAPE parameters are obtained through collected historical lightning strike disaster information to construct a multiple regression model, and the lightning strike position can be identified, so that the method has remarkable application value in improving the lightning strike fault early warning capability of the power grid.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional layered mark measuring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional layered mark measuring method, and mainly relates to the field of monitoring of ground subsidence geological disasters. A multifunctional layering mark measuring method comprises the following steps: step one: determining a planned ground subsidence layering bottoming layer according to regional geological background conditions, analyzing the burial distribution characteristics of a bottoming aquifer, and determining a groundwater monitoring aquifer; step two: and constructing a layered standard hole by adopting a geological drilling method, drilling to a layered standard bottom layer, performing full Kong Wutan well logging, finding out the spatial distribution rule of stratum lithology revealed by drilling, and determining the top and bottom interface burial depths of each main water-bearing layer. The invention has the beneficial effects that: according to the construction method for integrating the ground subsidence layering mark and the underground water monitoring hole, the damage of the construction of the monitoring hole to the geological environment is reduced, good economic benefits are achieved, the construction cost of the ground subsidence monitoring facility is reduced, and convenience is brought to the layering mark hole and the underground water monitoring.

title_en: Test method for roof collapse of goaf of coal bed under disturbance stress
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test method for roof collapse of a goaf of a coal seam under disturbance stress, which comprises the following steps: step one, preparing a sample; step two, preparing a simulation system for the dynamic disaster prevention and control technology of the multi-field coupling coal rock mass; thirdly, applying true triaxial prestress; applying true triaxial mining stress; step five, starting a high-speed camera; visually monitoring and recording the whole loading process; and step six, ending the test. The simulation of the natural collapse of the goaf roof with large size can be carried out, the simulation process is more real and reliable, and the visual monitoring of the whole natural collapse process of the goaf roof can be realized.

title_en: Aviation medical emergency rescue training evaluation system based on brain electricity
abstract_en: The invention provides an electroencephalogram-based aviation medical emergency rescue training evaluation system, which comprises the following components: the electroencephalogram signal acquisition and processing module is used for acquiring electroencephalogram signals of the simulation VR rescue scene of the participant at the stimulus source; the deep learning module adopts a TSreception multi-scale convolutional neural network model and comprises a dynamic time layer, an asymmetric space layer, a high-order fusion layer and a classifier; the aviation medical emergency rescue simulation module is used for completing semi-physical simulation training; the training effect evaluation module is used for inhibiting the overfitting problem and increasing the generalization performance of the network by using two loss entropies to replace a single cross entropy loss in label smoothing. The invention carries out electroencephalogram emotion classification through a deep learning network; the generalization performance of deep learning is improved, emotion of the training personnel can be better classified and evaluated, and the training personnel is helped to adapt to the severe on-board environment and the disaster site group death group injury environment.

title_en: Intelligent protection system for individual fire fighters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, in particular to a fire-fighting individual intelligent protection system, wherein a mobile server can establish a three-dimensional model, can receive information of fire-fighting individual equipment through a mobile command system, simulate the track of a firefighter in the three-dimensional model through the received position information and store the track, and can display the position of the firefighter.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC ZHONGYUAN OILFIELD PUGUANG BRANCH

title_en: Forest fire protection control system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire protection control system based on big data, relates to the technical field of forest fire protection, and solves the technical problems that the prior art cannot continuously and effectively protect forest fires, and high-efficiency and accurate scheduling of firefighters is difficult to realize, so that the optimal protection time of the forest fires is missed; according to the invention, fire extinguishing process simulation is carried out on the fire evaluation model according to a personnel scheduling sequence and a set period, and fire personnel scheduling and fire protection are carried out according to simulation results; the invention can combine environmental influence factors and firefighters to continuously monitor the trend of forest fires, and provides accurate and efficient guidance for fire protection; according to the invention, the personnel scheduling sequence is set according to the maneuvering distance between the firefighters and the monitoring area, the forest fire extinguishing process is simulated in sequence according to the personnel scheduling period in the personnel scheduling sequence, the fire trend under human intervention can be continuously mastered, and a data base is provided for efficient scheduling of firefighters.
assignees: FENGYANG COUNTY BAIYUNSHAN STATE OWNED FOREST FARM

title_en: High-speed bidirectional tunnel simulation model
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-speed bidirectional tunnel simulation model, which relates to the technical field of tunnel models, and particularly comprises a base, wherein a tunnel shell is arranged at the top of the base and made of transparent materials, a tunnel door is arranged at both ends of the tunnel shell, the bottom of the tunnel door is contacted with the base, vertical plates are symmetrically arranged at both ends of the top of the base, a U-shaped limiting block is arranged at one side of the vertical plate, which is close to the tunnel door, both sides of the tunnel door are arranged between the U-shaped limiting blocks, an emergency mechanism is arranged in the tunnel shell, and the emergency mechanism comprises a plurality of fire-fighting nozzle models which are equidistantly arranged on the inner surface of the tunnel shell. According to the method, after the tunnel shell and the tunnel portal are detached from the base, traffic accident scenes are arranged at the positions corresponding to the tunnel shell, so that the model can be used for learning and mastering the mode methods and notes of the handling flows of the firefighting power, the vehicle stopping and the like when the expressway or the tunnel is rescue, and the using effect is improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU LANYI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide hazard automatic identification method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard automatic identification method based on a convolutional neural network, which relates to the field of geological hazard identification and comprises the following steps: establishing a landslide interpretation database, taking a landslide area in an image as a positive sample and taking a non-landslide area in the image as a negative sample; constructing and training a multipath PSPNet network by adopting positive and negative samples to obtain a trained multipath PSPNet network; and identifying the target image by adopting the trained multipath PSPNet network, and taking the output result of the trained multipath PSPNet network as a landslide disaster identification result to complete automatic landslide disaster identification. The landslide identification method and the landslide identification system improve landslide identification precision, effectively improve landslide identification capacity, can provide landslide disaster identification target areas for geological disaster specialists, and can effectively improve regional landslide disaster investigation efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Tropical cyclone center positioning and strength fixing method based on mask deep learning
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a tropical cyclone center positioning and strength fixing method based on mask deep learning, which is applied to the technical field of satellite remote sensing monitoring disasters. Preprocessing an acquired static satellite atmospheric window area channel remote sensing image, a water vapor absorption band channel remote sensing image and a multi-source satellite fused sea surface wind field image, and manufacturing a training sample label; inputting a training sample label, adjusting parameters, performing iterative training until the model converges and no fitting is exceeded, and constructing a training model based on maskrnn deep learning; positioning and strength fixing prediction of tropical cyclone center; and correcting the prediction results of a plurality of tropical cyclone clouds according to the tropical cyclone history path at the previous moment, or eliminating the non-tropical cyclone clouds which are incorrectly identified, and performing precision evaluation. In this way, the tropical cyclone cloud system identification, the central positioning prediction and the tropical cyclone strength prediction can be realized at one time, and the accuracy of central positioning and strength determination of the whole development stage of the eye-free tropical cyclone cloud system is improved.
assignees: GEOVIS WEITIANXIN BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pavement collapse identification detection method based on YOLOv5 network model
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of computer image detection and identification, and provides a pavement collapse identification and detection method based on a YOLOv5 network model. The purpose is to provide a solution to the problem that when the sample size is too large, the real-time identification function cannot be achieved if the model is not processed timely. The main scheme includes obtaining the underground plane scanning image including time sequence features and the section real-time waveform image including time sequence features; carrying out circle area on the plane scanning image to obtain an area screening image A; obtaining a region screening diagram B of the section real-time waveform diagram by using a buffer scanning region-main scanning region-buffer scanning region structure; forming a data pair according to the time sequence characteristics by using the region screening diagram A and the region screening diagram B; after labeling each data pair with a geological disaster type label, dividing a test set and a training set; training the YOLOv5 model through the training set and the testing set; and acquiring a geological radar map in real time, processing the geological radar map into data pairs, and sending the data pairs into a trained YOLOv5 model to perform geological disaster category identification.
assignees: QINGHAI PROVINCE ARCHITECTURAL SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: System for providing interactive disaster safe education contents based on metaverse
title_ko: 메타버스 기반의 인터랙티브 재난안전교육 콘텐츠 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing interactive disaster safety education content based on metaverse. The system for providing interactive disaster safety education content comprises: a content provision device; a first feedback output device; a second feedback output device; and a content control device. Therefore, the present invention enables practical experience and training in advance on disaster and safety accident response methods and response tips anytime, anywhere.

title_en: Apparatus for providing interactive disaster safe education contents based on metaverse
title_ko: 메타버스 기반의 인터랙티브 재난안전교육 콘텐츠 제공장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to device for providing interactive disaster safety educational content based on metaverse, which can provide different disaster safety educational content, comprising: a user input module for outputting a specific input signal; a content scenario construction module; a content configuring module; a content display module for displaying disaster problem solution content on a display screen; and a content control module for operating operations of the user input module, the content scenario construction module, the content configuring module, and the content display module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 메타버스 기반의 인터랙티브 재난안전교육 콘텐츠 제공장치에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 조작에 의한 특정 입력신호를 출력하는 사용자 입력모듈과, 복수개의 재난유형에 상응하는 재난안전교육 콘텐츠 시나리오를 구축하는 콘텐츠 시나리오 구축모듈과, 콘텐츠 시나리오 구축모듈로부터 구축된 각 재난유형에 상응하는 재난안전교육 콘텐츠 시나리오에 따라 이루어진 현실세계의 재난환경 콘텐츠, 각 재난유형별 재난문제상황 콘텐츠, 및 각 재난문제상황 콘텐츠에 상응하는 재난문제해결방안 콘텐츠를 각 재난유형별로 데이터베이스화하여 저장하는 콘텐츠 구성모듈과, 콘텐츠 구성모듈로부터 구성된 현실세계의 재난환경 콘텐츠, 각 재난유형별 재난문제상황 콘텐츠 및 이에 상응하는 재난문제해결방안 콘텐츠를 디스플레이 화면에 표시하는 콘텐츠 표시모듈과, 사용자 입력모듈로부터 출력된 특정 입력신호에 의해 해당 사용자의 선택 재난유형에 상응하는 재난안전교육 콘텐츠 시나리오를 기반으로 기 설정된 메타버스 공간상에 해당 사용자의 아바타와 함께 현실세계의 재난환경 콘텐츠를 비롯하여 해당 재난환경 콘텐츠의 재난문제상황 콘텐츠 및 이에 상응하는 재난문제해결방안 콘텐츠를 디스플레이 화면에 재생 및 표시되도록 사용자 입력모듈, 콘텐츠 시나리오 구축모듈, 콘텐츠 구성모듈, 및 콘텐츠 표시모듈의 동작을 제어하는 콘텐츠 제어모듈을 포함함으로써, 각각의 재난 및 안전사고의 위력 및 위험성을 이해함과 동시에 재난 및 안전사고의 대응방법 및 대응요령을 언제 어디서나 사전에 실전 체험과 교육이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Three-dimensional loading structure of ultra-large deep engineering disaster physical simulation facility
abstract_en: A three-dimensional loading structure of an ultra-large deep engineering disaster physical simulation facility comprises a horizontal and vertical ultra-large reaction frame, an ultra-long stroke lifting locking hydraulic cylinder, five groups of array distributed hydraulic actuator groups and a group of line distributed hydraulic actuator groups; the horizontal ultra-large counter-force frame adopts a frame structure formed by splicing eight sections of arched beams and winding prestressed carbon fibers, the vertical ultra-large counter-force frame adopts a double-beam four-column pre-tightening force frame structure, five groups of array distributed hydraulic actuator sets are distributed around the horizontal ultra-large counter-force frame and at the top of the vertical ultra-large counter-force frame, and the linear array distributed hydraulic actuator sets are positioned at the middle of the bottom of the vertical ultra-large counter-force frame; the single hydraulic actuators at the centers of the five groups of array distributed hydraulic actuators are all through hydraulic actuators; the circumference of the horizontal ultra-large counter-force frame is uniformly provided with four excavation pore channels, and the center of the counter-force top plate of the vertical ultra-large counter-force frame is provided with a drilling pore channel.

title_en: Anti-impact method for artificial liberation layer of newly-built mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing a newly-built mine from rushing by an artificial liberation layer, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining a target rock stratum where an artificial liberation layer is located above a stratum area with rock burst hidden danger; s2, carrying out numerical simulation and theoretical analysis on the artificial liberation layer and the equivalent coal seam exploitation thereof to obtain stress sigma of the liberation layer under the equivalent coal seam exploitation  lib  And stress sigma of the released layer under artificial release layer mining  art  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the S3, according to sigma  lib  Sum sigma  art  Defining an equivalent stress relief coefficient xi, and dividing and judging the thickness and coverage of the artificial relief layer in the target rock stratum according to the equivalent stress relief coefficient xi; s4, establishing an artificial liberation layer judging model according to the division judgment of the thickness and coverage area of the artificial liberation layer, arranging a ground fracturing well according to the model, and performing drilling and fracturing operations; s is S5. After the artificial liberation layer operation is completed, a low-stress condition area is formed in the mine construction area, and the construction of the rock burst mine is carried out. The invention reduces or avoids rock burst disasters during well construction.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method for landslide range of earthquake-induced area
abstract_en: The application provides an evaluation method for landslide range of an earthquake induction area, which relates to the field of earthquake disaster evaluation and comprises the following steps: performing unit division on the area affected by the earthquake; classifying each unit into a potential landslide area and a non-landslide area according to the historical post-earthquake landslide data, so as to form an area to be detected; determining characteristic influence factors of landslide of an earthquake-induced area; after an earthquake occurs, respectively selecting landslide unit samples and non-landslide unit samples in a region to be detected to form training samples; constructing a machine learning model based on the characteristic influence factors and training samples, and performing model training; and evaluating landslide conditions of the region to be tested after the earthquake by using the machine learning model after training. The evaluation method can improve the prediction efficiency of the influence range of earthquake-induced landslide under the condition of meeting the prediction precision, and provides decision basis for related institutions to quickly formulate post-disaster rescue schemes, evaluate post-disaster loss and compile disaster area reconstruction schemes.

title_en: Anti-impact method for artificial liberation layer of tunneling roadway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing a drift of an artificial liberation layer of a tunneling roadway, which comprises the following steps: determining a target rock stratum where an artificial liberation layer is located above a stratum area with rock burst hidden danger; numerical simulation and theoretical analysis are carried out on the artificial liberation layer and the equivalent coal seam exploitation thereof to obtain the stress sigma of the liberation layer under the equivalent coal seam exploitation  lib  And stress sigma of the released layer under artificial release layer mining  art  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the According to sigma  lib  Sum sigma  art  Defining an equivalent stress relief coefficient xi, and dividing and judging the artificial relief layer thickness and coverage area in the target rock stratum; establishing an artificial liberation layer judging model according to the division judgment of the thickness and coverage of the artificial liberation layer, arranging a ground fracturing well according to the model, and performing drilling and fracturing operations; and the coverage area of the width of the artificial liberation layer correspondingly covers the boundary of each side of the roadway by 30-50m, and then the roadway tunneling operation is carried out. The invention greatly reducesAnd the occurrence probability of rock burst disasters during roadway tunneling is reduced.

title_en: Power transmission line ice flash early warning method and system based on power grid account and support vector machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid account and support vector machine-based transmission line ice flash early warning method, which relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power systems and comprises the following steps: aiming at the historical transmission line ice flashing accidents recorded in the power grid system, collecting the historical transmission line ice flashing accident information and collecting relevant power grid account data of the line before the historical transmission line ice flashing accident time point; carrying out data preprocessing on the collected historical power transmission line ice flash accident information and the power grid historical ledger data to obtain a normalized sample data set; establishing a support vector machine training model, and training by using normalized sample data; performing precision evaluation on the vector machine model, and establishing a global optimal prediction model; the trained support vector machine model is used for the ice flash early warning of the power transmission line. The invention also provides a power transmission line ice flash early warning system based on the power grid standing book and the support vector machine. The invention can well realize the ice flash early warning of the power transmission line through the support vector machine.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Upper cover type closed interchange smoke discharging model test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an upper cover type closed interchange smoke discharge model test device, and belongs to the field of fire test models. The model main body structure is reconstructed based on an actual model, and the interior of the model main body structure sequentially comprises a vehicle inlet, a toll plaza, a ramp and a vehicle outlet along the vehicle movement direction; the vehicle inlet section is provided with an air supply fan; the model main body is provided with a simulated fire source system, the simulated fire source system comprises a heating system and a smoke generating system, and smoke generated by the smoke generating system is heated by the heating system and then diffused so as to simulate a fire scene; the model main body is provided with a temperature measurement system, a temperature acquisition system, a wind speed test system and a smoke spreading observation system. The invention can better simulate the ventilation and smoke discharge conditions during the actual tunnel fire, and the simulation can realize rapid personnel evacuation and rescue while controlling the spreading of smoke, and has important engineering significance on the influence on the surrounding road network and the structural functions to the minimum.
assignees: GUANGDONG PROVINCIAL HIGHWAY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Stadium fire evacuation risk assessment method based on numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stadium fire evacuation risk assessment method based on numerical simulation, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: establishing a digital model according to the gymnasium building structure; setting fire parameters according to the digital model to form a virtual fire scene; acquiring information of personnel to be evacuated, and generating an evacuation scheme based on the digital model; in the virtual fire scene, carrying out evacuation risk assessment on the personnel to be evacuated according to the evacuation scheme; the system and the method can evaluate the evacuation risk distribution of audience in different stand areas under the fire disaster of the stadium, and provide data support for evacuation optimization design of stand areas with higher evacuation risk levels.
assignees: EAST CHINA CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Disaster condition geographic text classification method based on topology data analysis enhancement
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geospatial information processing, and particularly relates to a disaster situation geographical text classification method based on topology data analysis and enhancement, which is used for collecting original data to obtain related geographical disaster situation text data, then manually marking reference classified text data categories, then segmenting words through a jieba library in python, converting texts into vectors through a Word2Vec library, and carrying out data processing on the obtained vectors: and processing the word vector block by adopting a topological data analysis method. Training is carried out by using machine learning models such as a neural network and the like to obtain a training model for predicting the category of the target text. The invention innovatively introduces a topological data analysis method, improves a neural network and other traditional machine learning methods, and provides a disaster situation geographic text classification method based on topological data analysis enhancement.

title_en: High-speed subway train carriage and train bottom fire simulation system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed subway train carriage and train bottom fire simulation system and a control method thereof, wherein the system comprises a subway tunnel model, a subway train model, a fire source simulation system, a data acquisition system, a power system and a controller; the subway tunnel model and the subway train model are connected in a splicing mode to realize through connection of different lengths of the models; the three fire source simulation systems can simulate train carriage fire, train bottom cable fire and high-power electric appliance fire; the data acquisition system is used for acquiring fire characteristic parameters; the power system uses a synchronous belt transmission unit, and the synchronous belt pulls the subway train model to move at a high speed on the roller V-shaped guide rail; the controller performs overall control of the analog system. The invention can simulate the condition of fire disaster of the carriage and the bottom of the high-speed subway train, can shoot the bottom fire of the train at a certain speed, and is used for researching multi-source information systems such as flame form, smoke spreading, toxic and harmful gas concentration distribution evolution law and the like, thereby providing reference for preventing and controlling the fire disaster of the subway train.

title_en: Emergency rescue strategy generation method and device for coal mine gas accident
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for generating an emergency rescue strategy for coal mine gas accidents, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the gas accident existing in the current underground environment, and acquiring the coal attribute parameters and the environment parameters of the current underground environment; performing visual simulation based on the coal attribute parameters and the environment parameters to obtain three-dimensional visual gas parameters and multi-dimensional roadway parameters, wherein the roadway parameters at least comprise roadway heights; acquiring accident disaster information based on the gas parameters, and acquiring a target disaster avoidance route and emergency resource scheduling information based on the accident disaster information and the multidimensional roadway parameters; and generating an emergency rescue strategy based on the target disaster avoidance route and the emergency resource scheduling information. The system and the method can meet urgent requirements of coal mine emergency rescue in practicality, scientificity and real-time, and improve timeliness and accuracy of emergency rescue of coal mine gas accidents and safety of underground coal mine work.

title_en: Multi-target collaborative planning method and equipment for source network and charge storage of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target collaborative planning method and equipment for source network charge storage of a power distribution network, relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, and particularly relates to the multi-target collaborative planning method and equipment for source network charge storage of the power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: s1: and acquiring power distribution network source network load storage planning data with adjustable load. According to the power distribution network source network charge storage multi-target collaborative planning method and equipment, a construction virtual power distribution network model is built in a construction virtual three-dimensional model according to a scheme set of power distribution network source network charge storage multi-target collaborative planning, accident and disaster samples are loaded into the construction virtual power distribution network model, the running state of the construction virtual power distribution network model is analyzed, the scheme set of power distribution network source network charge storage multi-target collaborative planning is adjusted according to the running state of the construction virtual power distribution network model, and therefore a final scheme is obtained, various conditions met when the scheme set is simulated to run can be achieved, and therefore the power distribution network built according to the method is safer and runs more stably.

title_en: Apparatus for authoring disaster safe education training contents based on metaverse
title_ko: 메타버스 기반의 재난안전교육 훈련콘텐츠 저작을 위한 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for creating a disaster safety education training content based on metaverse. A device for creating a disaster safety education training content based on metaverse largely consists of a user input module, an object storage module, a disaster safety education scenario construction module, a user interface provision module, a content creation module, and a power supply module. In addition to understanding the power and risk of each disaster and safety accident, it is possible to real experience and educate in advance how to respond to disasters and safety accidents and response anywhere, whenever.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 메타버스 기반의 재난안전교육 훈련콘텐츠 저작을 위한 장치에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 조작에 의한 특정 입력신호를 출력하는 사용자 입력모듈과, 복수개의 재난유형에 따른 재난환경 오브젝트, 각 재난유형별 재난문제상황에 대응하는 대상객체 오브젝트, 각 재난유형별 재난문제상황을 해결하기 위한 해결도구 오브젝트, 각 재난유형별 재난문제상황을 해결하기 위해 발생될 수 있는 재난이벤트들을 정의하는 재난이벤트 오브젝트, 및 각 재난이벤트 발생시 해당 재난환경 오브젝트 또는 대상객체 오브젝트의 변화를 정의하는 속성 오브젝트에 대한 정보들을 각 재난유형별로 데이터베이스화하여 저장하는 오브젝트 저장모듈과, 각 재난유형별 재난안전교육 훈련콘텐츠 시나리오 구성시 외부로부터 재난안전교육 훈련진행단계들을 구분하는 훈련진행단계 정보들을 입력받아 각 재난안전교육 훈련진행단계를 구성함과 아울러 각 재난안전교육 훈련진행단계별 재난안전교육 훈련콘텐츠 시나리오 영상들을 저장하는 재난안전교육 시나리오 구축모듈과, 사용자 입력모듈로부터 출력된 특정 입력신호에 의해 선택된 해당 사용자의 선택 재난유형에 상응하는 재난안전교육 훈련콘텐츠 시나리오에 따른 재난환경 오브젝트 또는 대상객체 오브젝트를 포함한 복수개의 재난안전교육 훈련템플릿을 제공함과 아울러 기 설정된 메타버스 공간에서 재난안전교육 훈련을 위해 오브젝트 저장모듈에 저장된 각 오브젝트를 선택할 수 있도록 사용자 인터페이스를 제공하는 사용자 인터페이스 제공모듈과, 사용자 인터페이스 제공모듈로부터 해당 사용자의 아바타가 특정 행동을 수행하는 입력이 발생된 경우, 발생된 해당 사용자의 아바타에 대한 특정 행동에 따른 재난이벤트에 대응하는 재난환경 오브젝트 또는 대상객체 오브젝트의 속성 변화를 오브젝트 저장모듈로부터 독출하여 해당 메타버스 공간 내에 표시함과 아울러 해당 사용자의 입력 또는 편집에 따라 재난안전교육 시나리오 구축모듈로부터 저장된 재난안전교육 훈련콘텐츠 시나리오 영상을 기반으로 재난안전교육 훈련콘텐츠를 생성하는 콘텐츠 생성모듈을 포함함으로써, 각각의 재난 및 안전사고의 위력 및 위험성을 이해함과 동시에 재난 및 안전사고의 대응방법 및 대응요령을 언제 어디서나 사전에 실전 체험과 교육이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Quick simulation method based on urban oversized flood underground space regulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid simulation method based on urban oversized flood underground space regulation, which relates to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction science and comprises the following steps: s1, collecting building distribution of a city, and setting a characteristic elevation value based on the building distribution of the city; s2, identifying the building according to the characteristic elevation value to obtain the size of an underground space of the building to be used as the water storage capacity of the building; s3, calculating to obtain the inflow of flood into the underground space of the building by utilizing the Saint View path group based on the water storage capacity of the building; s4, calculating to obtain an urban underground space regulation model through a shallow water equation based on water inflow, and using the model to complete quick simulation of urban oversized flood underground space regulation; the invention simulates the influence of the flood on the urban flood process after entering the underground space, thereby realizing the regulation and storage effect of the simulated underground space on the urban oversized flood.

title_en: Clear up fire scene forest fire extinguishing technique and tactic trainer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a technical and tactical training device for cleaning forest fire extinguishment in a fire scene, which comprises a main controller, a smoke making device, a smoke pipeline, dried standing trees, inverted trees and simulated stumps; one end of the smoke pipeline is connected with the smoke making device, and the other end of the smoke pipeline is connected with the simulated stump and is provided with a smoke outlet; a smoke switch valve and a fan for controlling smoke flow are arranged on the smoke pipeline; the smoke making device, the smoke switch valve, the fan and the main controller are electrically connected; the inverted tree, the dried standing tree and the simulated tree piles are arranged at intervals. The utility model has simple structure and convenient use, simulates the state of main combustion matters in the fire scene cleaning stage, is used for training firefighters to quickly and thoroughly clean the residual fire of the fire scene, avoids the re-combustion of the fire scene and eliminates the potential safety hazard.

title_en: Soil collection device for recovering mine geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soil collecting device for recovering mine geological disasters, which comprises a drilling column, a pressure plate, a top frame and a column cavity, wherein the top surface of the drilling column is provided with the column cavity, the bottom cavity wall of the column cavity is provided with a bearing groove, a bottom bearing is fixedly arranged in the bearing groove, a lifting screw rod is rotatably arranged on the bottom bearing, the bottom of the top frame is fixedly provided with a top outer bearing, a cavity column box is rotatably arranged on the top outer bearing in a rotating manner, the interior of the cavity column box is fixedly provided with a second motor, the tail end of a rotor shaft of the second motor extends to the lower part of the cavity column box and is connected with the top end of the lifting screw rod, the bottom end of the drilling column is integrally connected with a drill bit cone body with drilling teeth, and a drilling auger is fixedly arranged on the outer cylindrical surface of the drilling column. The soil collection device has the beneficial effects that soil collection of specified depth is realized through the cooperation of the intracavity tray and the pressure plate, and the soil collection device is convenient to use and accurate in collection.
assignees: HEBEI ZHONGSE HUAGUAN GEOTECHNICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting forest fire-fighting technical and tactical training device for blocking fire-fighting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a training device for a barrier fire-extinguishing forest fire-extinguishing technique, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a smoke making device, a smoke pipeline, a main controller, a main body and a button; the main body comprises an underground fire pool and a fire isolation ditch arranged outside the underground fire pool; the button is arranged in the fire isolating ditch, and a filler covered on the button is also arranged in the fire isolating ditch; the smoke pipeline is connected with the smoke making device and is provided with a plurality of smoke outlets which are arranged in the underground fire pool; a fan and a smoke switch valve for controlling smoke flow are arranged on the smoke pipeline; the fan, the smoke switch valve and the smoke making device are electrically connected with the main controller; the button is electrically connected with the main controller and can be used for manually stopping the smoke making of the smoke making device and electrically resetting the smoke. The utility model has simple structure and convenient use, and can help forest firefighters to quickly grasp the skill of digging isolation trenches and blocking underground fire from spreading.

title_en: Subway earthquake disaster scene construction device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway earthquake disaster scene construction device which comprises a model station, a vibrating table and an acquisition system. The model station is a reduced model according to the 1:10 size of the subway station; the vibration table is arranged below the model station and is used for simulating earthquake and applied to the model station; the acquisition system is used for acquiring strain data of the key supporting structure in the model station and pressure-bearing data of the key supporting structure of the model station. The invention can realize the accurate simulation of the earthquake response process under different earthquake intensities, can know the distribution rule of the collapse risk of the subway station structure under the earthquake disasters, and can also provide the subway station evacuation optimization scheme under the earthquake disasters.

title_en: Image recognition analysis method for fire risk security protection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image recognition analysis method for fire risk security, which relates to the technical field of image recognition analysis, and comprises the following operation steps: s1, simulating flame radiation characteristics; s2, putting the steel into use; s3, image identification and analysis; and S4, making a fire fighting scheme and S5, and planning an escape route. According to the image recognition analysis method for fire risk security protection, the first time of fire occurrence is utilized by the camera and the smoke sensor, various information on the periphery of a fire area is combined as parameters, the flame radiation condition of each time period in the future is accurately predicted, then an effective fire extinguishing scheme can be rapidly specified by combining fire fighting conditions, the fire can be rapidly controlled, and if trapped people exist in the fire area, a safe evacuation line is planned for the trapped people according to the peripheral topographic information of the fire area and the flame radiation condition of each time period in the future, so that self rescue is realized before rescue people arrive.
assignees: SHANDONG ZHEYUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Side slope neural network model selection method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for selecting a side slope neural network model and a readable storage medium, relating to the technical field of mountain disasters, comprising the following steps: dividing the side slope into a plurality of different kinds of side slopes according to the damage mode, and acquiring research parameters of each side slope; calculating deformation characteristics of each side slope under different research parameters through numerical simulation, and constructing a data sample set of each side slope; training and testing the neural network model according to the data sample set to obtain an optimal neural network model corresponding to each side slope; establishing an expert system; the method comprises the steps of acquiring a failure mode of a site slope, inputting the failure mode of the site slope into the expert system to obtain a suggested neural network model of the site slope and corresponding model structure parameters.

title_en: Method for detecting small structure of coal seam in local gas control process
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting a small structure of a coal seam in a local gas treatment process, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing three drill holes according to the drilling cuttings index method requirement of the local gas treatment; collecting drilling information including drilling specific work, torque and drill bit drilling length by using a detection control device of the drilling machine; stopping construction when the drilling specific work suddenly drops and the torque rising time is longer, and determining the relative position of the drill bit entering and penetrating through the coal seam; then, constructing a second group, a third group, … and an nth group of drilling holes by changing angles, and determining the strike, the trend and the dip angle of the fault plane according to the coordinate information of the drill bits on the fault plane; and finally judging the forward and reverse directions of the faults according to the y coordinate value condition of the drill bit at the top of the coal seam. The method discovers the while-drilling information of the gas drilling hole, and can accurately identify the small fault structure in the coal seam while preventing and controlling the gas disaster.

title_en: Overhead transmission line deicing jump risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ice-removing jump risk early warning method for overhead transmission wires, which relates to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of power grids and comprises the following steps: constructing an ice-removing numerical simulation model to obtain an ice jump height calculation formula; determining a minimum static icing gap between wires when the wires are statically iced; determining a dynamic deicing minimum gap of the wire; and carrying out line checking and early warning according to the power amplification coefficient of the wire structure system. The invention further provides an ice-removing jump risk early warning system for the overhead transmission line. According to the invention, whether the wire passes the check early warning is judged rapidly according to whether the wire state is in the range of the wire span and the icing thickness, and the early warning is carried out if the check does not pass.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Landslide vulnerability prediction method and system coupled with Smoteen and TabTransformer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, and provides a landslide vulnerability prediction method and a landslide vulnerability prediction system for coupling Smoteen and TabTransformer, wherein the landslide vulnerability prediction method and the landslide vulnerability prediction system comprise the following steps: s1: obtaining the spatial distribution of landslide and non-landslide of a research area and disaster factors, and obtaining a grid layer of the landslide and non-landslide distribution; s2: obtaining a disaster factor after treatment; s3: constructing a training set and a verification set through grid layers distributed on landslide and non-landslide, and resampling the training set by utilizing a Smoteen algorithm to obtain a new training set; s4: training the TabTransformer model through a new training set to obtain a trained TabTransformer model, and obtaining a landslide susceptibility evaluation result of a research area through the trained TabTransformer model; s5: and dividing a research area according to landslide hazard susceptibility evaluation results to obtain a landslide hazard susceptibility prediction graph. The invention fully considers and expresses the nonlinear relation between the disaster causing factors of landslide disasters and landslide development, carries out quantitative analysis on the disaster causing factors of landslide, and provides decision support for the prevention and treatment work of landslide disasters.

title_en: Landslide accumulation body forming debris flow movement process simulation device under rainfall condition
abstract_en: The utility model provides a landslide stack body forms mud-rock flow motion process analogue means under rainfall condition, belongs to ground disaster analog device field, and this landslide stack body forms mud-rock flow motion process analogue means under rainfall condition is including supporting adjustment mechanism, location feed mechanism and rainfall analog mechanism, it includes chassis, bottom plate, transparent cover and first pneumatic cylinder to support adjustment mechanism, location feed mechanism includes electronic slip table, support, first guide arm, first slider, first lead screw, first servo motor, second pneumatic cylinder, second guide arm and hopper, rainfall analog mechanism includes second lead screw, second servo motor, frame, spray tube and second slider, two the second slider symmetry sets up on the second lead screw, a plurality of the spray tube is evenly set up side by side inside the frame, can pile the required all-terrain topography of building test fast and conveniently, carries out all-round simulation test for mud-rock flow formation and motion process.

title_en: Early warning visualization method, storage medium and device based on disaster recovery drilling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning visualization method, a storage medium and equipment based on disaster recovery drilling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a disaster recovery exercise scene model according to the Pareto analysis method, inputting all historical data for disaster recovery exercise links in an IT service into the constructed disaster recovery exercise scene model, outputting disaster recovery exercise Pareto optimal solutions, and generating weight marks of the disaster recovery exercise Pareto optimal solutions by combining different disaster recovery exercise scenes and service importance marks; building an early warning model through a random forest algorithm, taking the weight mark of the disaster recovery drilling Pareto optimal solution generated in the step 1 as the input of the early warning model, and analyzing and early warning disaster recovery drilling link data; and visualizing analysis and early warning results of disaster recovery drilling link data through a radar chart visualization algorithm. The early warning visualization method of the invention ensures that the resource allocation is more reasonable, visual and clear.
assignees: CHINA COMSERVICE WANGYING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Security visual comprehensive display system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security protection, in particular to a security protection visual comprehensive display system which comprises a three-dimensional visual management module, a big data online drilling module and a fire fighting big data integration platform; the three-dimensional visual management module comprises a panoramic map module and a fire control recording module; based on the map panoramic module, the marks of each firefighting safety key unit, surrounding roads, surrounding buildings, water sources and firefighting force can be seen on the map. The novel social fire control safety control platform is built by 'Internet + fire control' depending on 'smart city', a data sharing exchange platform is built, fire control internal and external information resources are collected, data analysis and research are enhanced, an omnibearing information resource service support is provided, and fire control is brought into a social security three-dimensional control system. The key technology for realizing the core functions of ubiquitous access, information fusion, resource management, intelligent service and the like of the fire-fighting system is broken through, and strong support is provided for the upper-layer application and service of the smart city.

title_en: Shoulder structure for vehicle collision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle collision tests, in particular to a shoulder structure for vehicle collision, which comprises a first driving assembly, wherein the first driving assembly is arranged on a collision dummy; the first driving component is in transmission connection with the first swinging frame and can drive the first swinging frame to swing back and forth; the second driving assembly is arranged on the first swinging frame; the second driving component is in transmission connection with the second swinging frame; a third driving assembly disposed on the second swing frame; and the third driving assembly is in transmission connection with the rotating shaft and can drive the rotating shaft to rotate. The invention can perform active response and simulate the emergency response action taken by the upper limb in the collision environment of the driver, thereby being convenient for analyzing the damage mechanism.
assignees: SUZHOU AUTOMOTIVE RESEARCH INSTITUTE TSINGHUA UNIV XIANGCHENG;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Comprehensive test method for strength, strain and seepage of oil sand in high-temperature stress environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive test method for oil sand strength, strain and seepage under a high-temperature stress environment, which comprises the following steps of preparing a test piece; step two, matching similar materials; step three, preparing a simulation system for the dynamic disaster prevention and control technology of the multi-field coupling coal rock mass; step four, heating the test piece; step five, applying true triaxial stress; step six, seepage test; step seven, simulating mining stress and measuring permeability in real time; step eight, replacing the oil sand sample, repeating the steps three to four, and then independently increasing the force applied by the pressure head to a new preset value; step nine, repeating the step five to the step seven; step ten, other tests in the same group; and step eleven, finishing test data. By loading different acting forces in the length direction, the triaxial stress state of the underground reservoir and the comprehensive conditions of oil sand strength, strain and seepage under the high-temperature stress environment can be simulated more truly.

title_en: Method for alternately shielding coal roadway and rapidly tunneling along bedding double-prevention long drilling holes
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for alternately covering a coal roadway by using long drilling holes with double prevention along a bedding layer, which comprises the steps of firstly, opening a drilling field at the upper part of the roadway, then, carrying out detection hole construction at the upper part of the roadway, carrying out roadway loose circle range test, carrying out fracturing hole construction and hydraulic fracturing after the range of the roadway loose circle is determined, supplementing measure holes after hydraulic fracturing permeability improvement is finished, completing disaster management of a target coal seam working section after the measure holes and fracturing hole extraction are finished, and finally, carrying out drilling construction of the next target coal seam working section according to the shortest drilling advance distance and the allowed tunneling distance until the total length of drilling holes can cover the whole roadway. The method can prevent and control gas and rock burst disasters in the tunnel tunneling process in a cooperative manner, reduces economic cost and time cost, improves disaster treatment effect, relieves contradiction between mining succession, and ensures safe and efficient mining of mines.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Hydraulic fracturing and explosive blasting collaborative roof control method
