abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety and explosion disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a hydraulic fracturing and explosive blasting collaborative roof control method. The method utilizes the high-pressure pump assembly, the hydraulic fracturing assembly and the explosive blasting assembly to construct, and the fracturing process utilizes the high-pressure pump assembly to add fracturing fluid into the fractures of the multi-section subarea generated by hydraulic fracturing of the coal seam, so that the fractures are prevented from being reclosed, and then the explosive is placed into the fractured drill holes to blast, and the fracture generated by hydraulic fracturing is utilized to provide a guidable free surface for blasting, so that the influenced range of blasting is enlarged, the using amount of the explosive is further reduced, the generation of CO is reduced, and the crushing and control of hard top coal are effectively realized. The method provided by the invention is simple, convenient to operate, good in top coal crushing effect, capable of playing a great role in actual production, reducing dangerous factors generated in the top coal blasting construction and reducing construction cost.

title_en: Time-lag type extremely-strong rock burst geological discrimination method
abstract_en: The invention provides a time-lag type extremely-strong rock burst geological discrimination method, and relates to the technical field of deep-buried tunnel engineering. According to the method, geological structure information in the construction process is recorded through methods such as tunnel face geological sketch, tunnel face advanced geological prediction and the like, and the geometric characteristics of the explosion pit in the rock explosion damage process are recorded through advanced geological drilling and section scanning technologies of the rock explosion damage area. And simultaneously, carrying out three-dimensional ground stress measurement on the rock burst damage area by a stress relief method or a hydraulic fracturing method, and determining the direction of the maximum main stress. Corresponding three-dimensional numerical calculation models are established according to initial ground stress test results and physical and mechanical parameters of the rock and the structural surface obtained through on-site geological investigation, and numerical calculation is carried out through tunnel excavation simulation under the combined condition of different structural surfaces, so that the risk of time-lag type extremely-strong rock explosion disasters occurring after the current position of the tunnel is excavated is judged.

title_en: Physical simulation test system for particle size distribution characteristics of mud-rock inflow river solid particles
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of debris flow disasters and discloses a physical simulation test system for the particle size distribution characteristics of debris flow into a river, which comprises a material making device, a diversion trench, a debris flow main water tank, a water storage tank, a circulating sedimentation tank and an observation device, wherein the material making device comprises a stirring device and a crane, the top of the stirring device is linked with the crane, the crane is linked with the material conveying tank through a tie, the bottom of the stirring device is provided with a valve, the diversion trench is linked with the material making trench and the debris flow main water tank, the debris flow main water tank comprises a forming section, a main water tank hinging device and a sedimentation section, the sedimentation section is connected with the circulating sedimentation tank through the hinging device, the water storage tank is connected with the circulating sedimentation tank, the bottom of the circulating sedimentation tank is provided with a solid particle collector, and the observation device comprises a laser particle size meter, a high-speed camera and a particle velocity measurement image system. The utility model can simulate the debris flow deposition characteristics and the solid particle distribution rule under the combined conditions of different flow rates, volume weights and particle sizes.
assignees: CHENGDU GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY SOUTHWEST GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH IN

title_en: Surrounding fire field forest fire extinguishing technical and tactical training device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a training device for surrounding fire field forest fire extinguishing technology, which comprises: the main controller is used for controlling the operation of the main controller, a gas pipeline and a combustion tank connected with a gas source; the combustion tank comprises a second combustion tank; one end of the second combustion groove is connected with the other end; the gas pipeline is connected with the second combustion groove, and a gas outlet is arranged at the second combustion groove; the gas pipeline is provided with a gas switching valve and a flow control valve for controlling the flow of gas; an ignition device is arranged on the second combustion groove; the gas switching valve, the flow control valve and the ignition device are electrically connected with the main controller. The utility model can provide a simulated fire scene of a solid fire and help forest firefighters to improve the ability of extinguishing forest fires.

title_en: Reverse-push backtracking method for satellite precipitation data in mountainous area
abstract_en: A reverse push backtracking method for satellite precipitation data in mountainous areas. The method comprises the steps of APHRODITE, IMERG reading precipitation data and observing daily precipitation statistics of a station, establishing a model by using a random forest algorithm on a scale of 0.25 degrees, simulating long-time sequence variation trend of two types of precipitation data, generating spatial depolymerization weight of the precipitation data through a 3X 3 sliding window on a scale of 0.1 degrees, and combining a time scale and a spatial scale to obtain IMERG precipitation data which is NIMERG data before 2001 of 0.1 degrees. According to the invention, by utilizing the correlation between APHRODITE and the space-time scale of the analysis precipitation product and the IMERG satellite precipitation product in the same time, IMERG satellite precipitation data are reversely and reversely pushed and extended, and a set of high-quality and long-time sequence precipitation products can be provided for related researches such as hydrology, ecology or geological disasters in mountain areas.

title_en: Method for testing coal and gas outburst induced by graded dynamic load action
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for testing coal and gas outburst induced by graded dynamic load action, which comprises the following steps: step one, preparing a sample; step two, preparing a simulation system for the dynamic disaster prevention and control technology of the multi-field coupling coal rock mass; thirdly, applying true triaxial stress; step four, preparing and checking the dynamic load before use; step five, installing a protruding rupture disk; step six, carrying out dynamic load test; step seven, solid gas treatment after protrusion; step eight, detecting and adjusting; step ten, repeating the step four to the step seven; step eleven, other experiments in the same group; and step twelve, ending the test. Through different effort loading of length direction and hierarchical dynamic load effect, can simulate the large-scale test piece under the triaxial stress state of subsurface reservoir more truly, induce the outstanding process of coal and gas under hierarchical dynamic load effect.

title_en: Urban public space disaster modeling and preventing system based on perception blind area estimation
abstract_en: The invention provides a city public space disaster modeling and preventing system based on perception blind area estimation, which comprises six parts including local information characterization, social force model simulator construction, local information fusion, global track recovery and multi-task combined abnormal event prediction. According to the invention, the segment track is obtained based on local information characterization in the sensing range of the sensor obtained by multi-source heterogeneous data and combined with the social force model simulator, so that a track fusion method suitable for multiple sensors in the urban public space is provided, a fusion result is obtained by solving an optimal matching problem based on two factors of direction and time, and the complete sensing in the urban public space is recovered based on the social force model simulator, so that the problem that the sensing blind area information is difficult to obtain is solved; and finally, based on the correlation of occurrence relations among a plurality of different abnormal events, carrying out joint training on a plurality of abnormal event detection or prediction tasks, and realizing disaster modeling and prevention based on blind area perception.

title_en: Method for constructing personnel evacuation simulation model under near body attack scene research
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a personnel evacuation simulation model under a near body attack research scenario, which comprises the following steps: constructing a personnel emergency evacuation accident scene under a near-body attack scene, and constructing various personnel behavior models under the near-body attack scene based on a social force model; analyzing panic emotion influence factors, constructing a pedestrian panic emotion model under a near attack scene, and constructing a personnel behavior model based on dynamic panic emotion driving based on the pedestrian panic emotion model under the near attack scene; building a simulation physical environment by using simulation software, building a large building personnel emergency evacuation live-action model based on the simulation physical environment, and building a personnel behavior simulation model based on the large building personnel emergency evacuation live-action model; and constructing various personnel behavior models under the near-body attack scene, the dynamic panic emotion-driven personnel behavior model and the personnel behavior simulation model based on the social force model, and constructing a personnel evacuation simulation model under the near-body attack scene.

title_en: Method for testing in-situ deformation modulus of rock mass by virtue of strong weathering and strong unloading of shallow surface part of rock slope
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of engineering geology and geotechnical engineering, and particularly discloses a method for testing in-situ deformation modulus of a rock mass with strong weathering and strong unloading on a shallow part of a rock slope, which can perform in-situ large deformation modulus test on the rock mass with strong weathering and strong unloading on the shallow part of the rock slope under the conditions of not disturbing, not damaging the appearance of the slope, not excavating the slope and completely retaining all weathered and unloading rock mass so as to acquire related rock mass mechanical parameters; according to the method, a test site is selected, the test site is reinforced, a test bearing plate is poured, a drilling reaction force device mounting hole and a wave speed test hole are formed, a reaction force device is mounted, a hollow jack, an upper lock head and a deformation sensor are mounted, a deformation test is loaded, and finally, the deformation modulus of a strong weathered and strong unloading rock mass is calculated according to the obtained parameters, so that the in-situ deformation modulus of the shallow strong weathered and strong unloading rock mass of the rock slope is obtained, and further the geological disaster of the side slope is judged and prevented.

title_en: Electric power system toughness enhancing method combined with pre-disaster early warning mechanism
abstract_en: A method for enhancing toughness of a power system by combining a pre-disaster early warning mechanism comprises the steps of collecting historical parameter data of power equipment before abnormal weather occurs, historical meteorological data of the abnormal weather and damage degree data of the corresponding power equipment after the abnormal weather occurs, training to obtain a prediction model for predicting post-disaster damage condition of the power equipment, and expanding targeted emergency maintenance or reinforcement of the power equipment before extreme weather occurs, so that influence of the extreme weather on the power system is reduced, and toughness of the power system is enhanced. The method and the system realize pre-disaster early warning of the power equipment, effectively reduce damage of extreme weather to the power equipment, provide important reference for implementation of post-disaster recovery strategies, rapidly perform simultaneous predictive analysis on a large number of power equipment, fully and efficiently utilize precious pre-disaster prevention time, and pointedly enhance the overall toughness of the power system.

title_en: Energy storage planning method, device and equipment for information physical fusion power transmission network elasticity
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy storage planning method, device and equipment for information physical fusion power transmission network elasticity, which comprises the steps of establishing an information physical fusion power transmission network elasticity basic model according to power transmission network characteristics and meteorological data under an ice disaster scene, determining the probability of the ice disaster scene of a power transmission network through the information physical fusion power transmission network elasticity basic model, establishing a planning model of an electrochemical energy storage station according to the probability of the ice disaster scene of the power transmission network so as to realize site selection and volume fixing of the electrochemical energy storage station, establishing an information physical fusion elasticity assessment model based on the planning model of the electrochemical energy storage station and the information physical fusion power transmission network elasticity basic model, and realizing simulation of fault conditions, response adjustment, overhaul recovery processes of the power transmission network through the information physical fusion elasticity assessment model. The application accurately reflects the fault and recovery characteristics of the power transmission network, realizes the pre-disaster site selection and volume fixing of the energy storage station, and achieves the technical effect of improving the elasticity of the power transmission network.

title_en: Deep engineering fault sliding model test system and safety control method
abstract_en: The application relates to a deep engineering fault sliding model test system and a safety control method, and belongs to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster prevention and control, wherein the deep engineering fault sliding model test system mainly comprises a shell, an osmotic pressure simulation piece, a heating piece, a pressure loading piece, a stress wave simulation piece, a roadway structure simulation piece, a vibration simulation piece, a detection device and a control device. The control device is electrically connected with and controls the osmotic pressure simulation piece, the heating piece, the pressure loading piece, the stress wave simulation piece and the detection device, and is used for determining the sliding distance of the stratum simulation part and determining the number of the anchor rods. According to the embodiment of the application, the sliding distance is determined, the sliding distance is used for determining the number of the anchor rods so as to adaptively adjust the anchor rod support scheme, so that the support strength of the anchor rod support is ensured, the fault sliding phenomenon is avoided, and the loss caused by geological disasters is reduced.

title_en: Iron tower safety evaluation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for evaluating the safety of an iron tower, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining displacement of each tower leg of the iron tower in each coordinate axis direction of a three-dimensional rectangular coordinate system; the displacement of each tower leg is processed through a safety evaluation model which is completed through training, so that the tower head displacement of the iron tower and the maximum stress value of the iron tower rod piece are obtained; the safety evaluation model is obtained through tower leg sample displacement training of each tower leg of the iron tower; and determining the corresponding safety state of the iron tower based on the displacement of the tower head and the maximum stress value of the rod piece of the iron tower. According to the method, the iron tower safety is judged by utilizing the objective data of the iron tower displacement, so that the subjective experience influence of people can be reduced, the time for evaluating by the safety evaluation model is reduced compared with the time for evaluating manually, the efficiency of evaluating the iron tower safety can be improved, the reaction time of a supervisor is increased, and the disaster event caused by iron tower accidents is reduced.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID EHV POWER TRANS COMPANY WUZHOU BUREAU

title_en: Simulation test method for punching fracturing multiple coal beds under true triaxial stress
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test method for punching and fracturing multiple coal beds under true triaxial stress, which comprises the following steps of preparing a sample, preparing a simulation system for installing a dynamic disaster prevention and control technology of a multi-field coupling coal rock mass, applying true triaxial prestress, carrying out punching and fracturing on liquid carbon dioxide, recording data, measuring feeding displacement of a nozzle by a displacement sensor, displaying a real-time injection liquid carbon dioxide value by the pressure sensor, displaying real-time flow of injection fluid by an electromagnetic flowmeter, replacing a molded coal sample, repeating the step four to the step five, carrying out other tests in the same group, and finishing test data. The multi-coal-seam punching fracturing multi-coal-seam simulation under the true triaxial stress of large size can be performed, the control precision is high, punching fracturing with different injection distances can be performed, and the simulation process is more real and reliable.

title_en: Tunnel portal side slope physical simulation test device and method under complex environment coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical simulation test device and a physical simulation test method for a tunnel portal slope under the coupling effect of an external environment, wherein the device comprises the following steps of; a permeation system, a freeze thawing system, a model assembly, an analysis mechanism and a vibrating table. Firstly, manufacturing a reduced scale slope model according to the site situation; the infiltration system consists of a rainfall mechanism at the upper part of the simulation model box and an infiltration system arranged in the side slope of the tunnel portal, and the infiltration system in the side slope is used for simulating the influence of underground water and the influence of rainwater seepage; the freeze thawing system consists of a refrigerating unit and a heating unit, is arranged above the model box and simulates the freeze thawing effect in the actual environment; the vibration table is arranged below the whole model box, bears the model box and simulates earthquake motions; the invention can simulate severe environments such as seepage, freeze thawing, earthquake and the like of the tunnel entrance slope, and provides an integrated test platform for disaster prevention and reduction research of the tunnel entrance slope.

title_en: Finite element integral measuring and calculating method for wave near-shore propagation wave high attenuation by sea corrosion platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring and calculating the finite element integral of the wave attenuation of a sea corrosion platform to the wave near shore propagation wave height, which relates to the field of sea disasters and disaster prevention and reduction, and comprises the steps of performing landform interpretation on the sea corrosion platform and recording the positions of the sea corrosion platform to the sea side boundary and the shore side boundary to obtain the width W and the inclination angle a of the sea corrosion platform; the method comprises the steps of carrying out finite element meshing on a sea corrosion platform to form n grids with the horizontal width of d, carrying out iterative computation on the wave height H  j  reaching the coast side boundary of the grid according to the wave height H  i  of the grid to the sea side edge, the horizontal width of d and attenuation parameters alpha  i  and beta  i , setting iteration stop conditions, taking the wave height H  j  reaching the coast side boundary of the grid as the wave height H  c  finally reaching the sea after attenuation after reaching the iteration stop conditions, and solving the problems of large calculation consumption resources, more required parameters and the like based on a process numerical simulation method.

title_en: High-temperature simulation device for fire-fighting training
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-temperature simulation device for fire control training, which comprises an outdoor container, wherein a simulation mechanism is arranged in the outdoor container and comprises a soft water processor, a water storage tank, a steam generator, a steam-water separator and a split cylinder, the water inlet end of the soft water processor is communicated with the water outlet end of the water storage tank, the water outlet end of the soft water processor is communicated with the water inlet end of the steam generator, and the water inlet end of the steam-water separator is communicated with the water outlet end of the steam generator. The high-temperature simulation device for fire control training solves the problems that some indoor fire control simulation devices are difficult to simulate actual combat environments such as high temperature, high humidity, steam smoke and the like, and each function is single, so that the experience of fight capacity and on-site reaction capacity of firefighters is reduced, and the simulation effect is poor.
assignees: SHANGHAI SICHENG NEW ENERGY TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall monitoring device for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rainfall devices and discloses a rainfall monitoring device for geological disasters, which comprises a collecting barrel, wherein sliding grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the top end of the collecting barrel, clamping grooves are formed in the inner wall of the bottom end of the sliding grooves, connecting pipes are connected to the inner wall of the collecting barrel in a sliding mode, mounting grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the bottom end of the inner wall of each connecting pipe, springs are arranged in the inner sides of the mounting grooves, limiting blocks are connected to the inner wall of each mounting groove in a sliding mode, and clamping blocks are fixedly connected to the separated sides of the two limiting blocks. According to the utility model, the rotating handle is rotated to drive the rotating disc, so that the rotating disc rotates to drive the threaded rod to rotate, the threaded rod rotates to drive the drill bit, the drill bit drills into soil, the whole detection equipment is fixed, the whole detection equipment cannot be blown by wind, the accuracy of the measurement equipment is affected, and the connecting pipe can be stressed when the tension handle is pulled, so that the clamping block is driven.

title_en: Detachable large-span factory building model structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detachable large-span factory building model structure, which relates to the technical field of factory building models, and specifically comprises a first main body, wherein the top of the first main body is provided with a second main body, the bottom of the second main body is provided with a supporting frame, the edge of the supporting frame is fixed on the inner wall of the second main body, the bottom of the supporting frame is provided with a limiting frame, the limiting frame is arranged in the first main body, the outer surface of the limiting frame is contacted with the inner wall of the first main body and is in sliding fit with the inner wall of the first main body, and a bottom plate is arranged in the second main body. The utility model discloses a can link together first main part and second main part through spacing frame, and rethread room frame links together sample house frame and second main part, and finally through the cooperation of stopper and sample house frame, link together roof and sample house frame, when carrying out disaster simulation, be convenient for unpack apart factory building model, observe factory building inner structure to the rescue plan is made, the result of use is improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU LANYI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Aircraft operation environment modeling and lowerage site selection simulation method based on low-altitude rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aircraft operation environment modeling and lowland site selection simulation method based on low-altitude rescue. Firstly, meteorological data and topographic data are acquired, then MATLAB is used for simulating topography to process the meteorological data, three-dimensional operation grids of the aircraft and degradable grids of the aircraft are screened through the established three models, and finally, a degradable point set of a non-limiting area of the aircraft and a disaster area of the aircraft is obtained. According to the invention, the influence of various factors on the operation and landing of the aircraft is comprehensively considered, and the aim of being more suitable for the actual rescue situation can be achieved.
assignees: CIVIL AVIATION MAN INSTITUTE OF CHINA;ZHEJIANG JIANDE GENERAL AVIATION RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Urban waterlogging risk early warning method based on radar observation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar observation-based urban waterlogging risk early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of weather radar early warning, and comprises the steps of carrying out data quality control on refined X-band radar data obtained by observation of an X-band weather radar, carrying out quantitative rainfall estimation on the data subjected to the data quality control by using radar observation polarization parameters, obtaining a multi-source fusion rainfall driving field capable of covering a whole domain, constructing a waterlogging simulation model, simulating a rainfall runoff generating process, calculating a slope converging process by using a nonlinear reservoir model, simulating a converging transmission process of a river channel and a pipe network by using a san-veling process, checking whether overflow occurs in the river channel and the pipe network, and carrying out visual presentation on disaster factors, important processes and waterlogging risk distribution in the flow domain based on a ground surface inundation simulation result.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Vehicle layout simulation method and system in highway tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method and a system for vehicle layout in a highway tunnel, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting vehicle type parameters, personnel type parameters, highway tunnel space parameters and lane parameters, obtaining the ratio of the number of corresponding vehicles in corresponding lanes to the total number of all vehicles according to the highway tunnel space parameters, the vehicle type parameters and the lane parameters, obtaining the number of vehicles in corresponding lanes according to the ratio of the number of corresponding vehicles in corresponding lanes to the total number of all vehicles according to the highway tunnel space parameters, the vehicle type parameters and the corresponding vehicle type parameters, obtaining the number of corresponding vehicles in corresponding lanes according to the ratio of the number of vehicles in each lane to the total number of corresponding vehicles in corresponding lanes, randomly arranging vehicles in each lane to obtain a corresponding arrangement set, and obtaining the positions of all vehicles in each lane according to the arrangement set of the vehicles in each lane and the average vehicle distance of the vehicles in each lane. The invention aims to improve the modeling efficiency and the accuracy of the simulation result of the highway tunnel fire simulation and evacuation simulation model.

title_en: Navigation radar oil spill identification method and system based on YOLO network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine radar oil spill identification method and system based on a YOLO network, relates to the technical field of marine oil spill identification, and aims to solve the problem that an existing marine oil spill identification method is low in efficiency. The technical key points of the invention include: acquiring a small sample training image set containing an oil spill area; preprocessing a small sample training image set; each image in the preprocessed small sample training image set is subjected to average segmentation so as to expand the small sample training image set; training an oil spill identification model based on a YOLOv5s model by utilizing the expanded training image set; and carrying out oil spill recognition on the preprocessed image to be recognized by using the trained oil spill recognition model, and obtaining an oil spill recognition result. The invention can provide effective data support for the emergency treatment of oil spill accidents at sea and disaster prevention and relief.

title_en: Automatic meteorological data acquisition and collection system for multipoint ship meteorological stations
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic acquisition and collection system for meteorological data of a multipoint ship meteorological station, which comprises a data acquisition layer, a network layer and an application layer; the data acquisition layer comprises an ultrasonic wind sensor, an air pressure sensor, a water temperature sensor, a rainfall sensor, a humidity sensor, an air temperature sensor and a ship directional positioning module. The invention relates to a marine weather disaster decision information system based on two-stage fuzzy data mining, which finally gives out simulation results, performs cluster analysis on data with high similarity by utilizing the coupling between data in different areas through a fuzzy clustering algorithm, divides mass weather data respectively from different ships into different clusters, then analyzes a cluster set through a data mining algorithm, effectively utilizes the operation capability of a data center station server, provides important observation data for hydrological weather service and climate change research, and improves the weather disaster early warning and weather forecast specialized service level of a Yangtze river channel.

title_en: Estimation method for roof elasticity contribution rate of deep gas-containing coal body during instability and catastrophe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating the elastic energy contribution rate of a top plate in the case of destabilization and catastrophe of a deep gas-containing coal body, which comprises the following specific steps: acquiring the gas pressure of a coal bed; acquiring the thickness of the coal bed and the roof according to the drilling histogram; coring on site, processing and preprocessing a coal and rock sample, and respectively obtaining the elastic modulus of a top plate, the gas-containing coal and rock combination standard component through an indoor mechanical test; deducing the contribution quantity of the elasticity of the top plate by using the graph area by means of the stress-strain curve, and obtaining a quantitative expression of the contribution rate of the elasticity of the top plate based on the elastic modulus and the thickness of the top plate and the gas-containing coal. The invention fully considers the action of the roof elastic energy in the coal-rock gas dynamic disasters, provides a calculation method and a specific quantitative calculation method, can clearly know the action of the roof elastic energy in the disasters, and provides a beneficial reference for the accurate prevention and control of the mine coal-rock gas dynamic disasters.

title_en: Training system and method based on multi-mode disaster environment linkage simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster simulation, and particularly discloses a training system and a training method based on multi-mode disaster environment linkage simulation, wherein the system comprises a disaster scene simulation module, a disaster setting module, a disaster type judging module, a model building module, a triggering module, a rescue optimal operation generating module and a maneuver personnel operating module, wherein the triggering module is used for triggering the setting of environmental parameters of other disaster types through a linkage mathematical model according to the judged disaster types and corresponding environmental parameters to generate environment final parameters; the optimal rescue operation generating module is used for generating corresponding optimal rescue operation according to the final environmental parameters and sending out an alarm signal; and the exercise personnel operation module is used for carrying out corresponding rescue operation on the exercise personnel after receiving the alarm signal. The technical scheme can solve the problems that the linkage control of each catastrophe environment cannot be realized in the prior art, and the complicated catastrophe state and the unscientific process under the simulation well are caused.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Construction method of cold source disaster-causing object alarm early warning model of coastal nuclear power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a cold source disaster-causing object alarm early warning model of a coastal nuclear power station, which comprises the following steps: establishing a tidal current field and disaster-causing object prediction model based on a wind field, and selecting a representative organism; fusing cluster burst models, simulating a plug track, and predicting the motion track and the quantity of plugs; and judging the guard area and the number of the plugs from the water intake by a disaster-causing object motion track model and fusing a cluster burst model according to the instant plug positions in a certain range of the water intake. The invention combines the environmental data and the biological growth outbreak to provide important basis for estimating the quantity of the biological outbreak, improves the model prediction accuracy and sensitivity, can predict the blocking object to the guard area of the water intake for 6-72 hours and the quantity thereof through the positive inversion technology of the hydrologic dynamic model, expands the time and space span of disaster-causing object prediction, and provides support for estimating the disaster-causing biological quantity through the fusion of the hydrologic dynamic model and the biological outbreak model.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin system for disaster inoculation process of ultra-large three-dimensional deep engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin system in a disaster inoculation process of ultra-large three-dimensional deep engineering, and relates to the technical field of physical simulation and digital twin of deep engineering disasters. The system comprises a deep complex geological digital twin body construction module for constructing a digital twin body; a real-time dynamic rendering module for accelerated rendering digital twinning; the deep engineering disaster inoculation mechanism model initialization module is used for initializing a deep engineering disaster inoculation mechanism model; the digital twin consistency verification module is used for carrying out deviation detection on the deep engineering disaster inoculation mechanism model; the deep engineering disaster inoculation mechanism model iteration optimization module is used for continuously correcting and optimizing the deep engineering disaster inoculation mechanism model; the system comprises a physical entity interaction control module for carrying out interactive control on ultra-large three-dimensional deep engineering disaster physical simulation facilities, a multi-element monitoring information space-time evolution fusion display module, a physical simulation test facility emergency risk avoiding module and a physical simulation test scheme intelligent real-time correction module.

title_en: Multi-model fusion geological disaster analysis and early warning method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-model fusion geological disaster analysis and early warning method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining regional meshing data; counting the number of geological disasters in sub-regions in the region; determining regional disaster risk coefficients; determining a precipitation time-interval statistical range through feature screening, and constructing a time-interval precipitation statistical data set; dividing the model into a training set and a verification set, and respectively training a disaster prediction model by combining an XGBoost algorithm and a LightGBM algorithm; determining the average confidence coefficient of the model output; and carrying out early warning on the disaster of the region by combining the average confidence coefficient and the regional disaster risk coefficient of the region and the risk coefficient corresponding to the precipitation. According to the method, precipitation, topography and geological disasters are associated, the probability of disasters can be obtained through a weighted fusion mode of a prediction model and risk coefficients after characteristics are built, quantitative analysis can be effectively carried out on the characteristics which cause disasters, and particularly advantages are more prominent after a data set is complete enough.
assignees: LIANTONG GUANGDONG IND INTERNET CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing map damaged road extraction method
abstract_en: The application provides a method for extracting a damaged road of a remote sensing map, which comprises the following steps: selecting pixels of partial roads from the pre-disaster road truth value binary image of the pre-disaster remote sensing image as pixels of the damaged road to generate a damaged road truth value binary image, and fusing a part corresponding to the pixel position of the damaged road in the pre-disaster remote sensing image in the pre-disaster abnormal texture image to obtain a simulated post-disaster remote sensing image matched with the damaged road truth value binary image. And performing fine tuning training on an initial model for extracting the road binary map based on the post-disaster simulation remote sensing map and the post-disaster road true value binary map for simulating the post-disaster remote sensing map to obtain a post-disaster road extraction model. And inputting the target area post-disaster remote sensing map into a post-disaster road extraction model to extract a post-disaster road prediction binary map in the target area post-disaster remote sensing map, comparing a pre-disaster road true value corresponding to the target area pre-disaster remote sensing map with the road prediction binary map of the target area post-disaster remote sensing map, and determining a damaged road prediction binary map of the target area post-disaster remote sensing map.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM;CHINA MOBILE XIONGAN INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation fire-fighting evacuation method for urban rail transit large transfer station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulated fire evacuation method for a large transfer station of urban rail transit, and belongs to the technical field of emergency evacuation. The fire evacuation method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time fire information in a transfer station and simulating and predicting the fire information; obtaining a dangerous traveling range by using the predicted fire information; obtaining a safe evacuation route set by using the dangerous travelling range; and guiding the safe evacuation of passengers by using the safe evacuation route set. According to the invention, the fire condition of the subway station can be detected and predicted through the fire condition information at the initial stage of the fire, and the distribution influence of the fire is predicted, so that the dim and leakage routes caused by abnormal cables are accurately eliminated, the path accuracy and the safety for guiding the safety evacuation of the interfered personnel are good, and the personnel evacuation speed and the safety under the fire of the transfer station are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG GUANGYU SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Civil house model for firefighting training
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field and discloses a civil house model for fire-fighting training, which comprises a model body, wherein a house body is arranged in the model body, a stair frame is arranged in the middle of the inside of the house body, a smoke conveying pipeline is arranged at the lower part of a side wall of the house body, and the rear end of the smoke conveying pipeline is sequentially connected with a smoke generator and a smoke conveying pump. Through the design, according to the building model of the general sky house, the bottom of the model side wall is connected with a smoke generator and a smoke delivery pump through a smoke delivery pipeline, and the roof at the top of the house body can be disassembled to cooperate with a smoke flow system in the house, so that fire-fighting rescue workers can know and master theoretical knowledge such as smoke flow, personnel rescue, spreading ways, civil house structures, anti-theft window breaking and dismantling and the like, the problem that the traditional teaching mode is not visual enough or affects the normal use of a building is avoided, and the training and teaching effects of fire-fighting departments and related units on the fire-fighting knowledge of the building are greatly improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU LANYI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent campus emergency response system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent campus emergency response system which comprises an emergency on-duty module, an emergency preparation module, a monitoring and early warning module, a safety precaution comprehensive management module, an emergency treatment module, an assessment module and a training exercise module. The intelligent campus emergency response system can provide rapid and timely emergency rescue service for campuses, provide powerful guarantee for public security, can effectively cope with natural disasters, accident disasters, public health events and various emergent public events of social security including fire disasters, illegal invasion and the like, thereby avoiding serious personnel injury or relieving life threatening hazard, reducing economic loss and having good application prospect.

title_en: Electric power weather monitoring network layout optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power meteorological monitoring network layout optimization method and system. The method comprises the steps of determining a numerical simulation test period of a typical power meteorological disaster, carrying out a high-resolution high-precision numerical simulation test based on the numerical simulation test period, constructing a real meteorological field of the numerical simulation test, determining real meteorological field data, extracting power meteorological monitoring data and diagnosing various power meteorological monitoring elements according to the real meteorological data, constructing an assumed site simulation monitoring set of the numerical simulation test, carrying out a data assimilation numerical simulation test of the simulation monitoring data according to the simulation monitoring set of the assumed site by controlling the simulation test and various sensitivity simulation tests, determining a data assimilation numerical simulation test result of the simulation monitoring data, carrying out data assimilation effect evaluation and verification according to the data assimilation numerical simulation test result of the simulation monitoring data, and determining an optimal power meteorological monitoring network layout scheme according to the data assimilation effect evaluation and verification by combining the real meteorological field data.

title_en: Method and system for predicting motion trail of disaster-causing marine organism of nuclear power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting a disaster-causing marine organism motion trail of a nuclear power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a hydrodynamic model of the nuclear power station to simulate the hydrodynamic space-time variation of a water intake area of the nuclear power station; on the basis of finding disaster-causing marine organisms, a marine organism drift track prediction model is constructed according to the hydrodynamic space-time variation of the water intake area of the nuclear power plant, the motion track of the disaster-causing marine organisms is simulated and tracked, targeted monitoring, prevention and control countermeasures are provided for the cold source management of the nuclear power plant, and the safety, prevention and control precision, emergency treatment efficiency and safety and reliability of the cold source of the nuclear power cold source are improved.

title_en: System and method for field experience disaster prevention exercise in virtual geographic space based on VR technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual simulation, in particular to a system and a method for field experience disaster prevention exercise in a virtual geographic space based on a VR technology, comprising a data acquisition terminal: collecting user posture information, surrounding scene information and drilling participant information; and the control center: carrying out centralized processing and storage on the acquired information; a mobile terminal: presenting data information transmitted by a control center; and (3) a conveyor belt: the device is used for the movement of a user, and is adjusted according to the advancing speed of the user and the direction opposite to the advancing direction of the user, so that the position of the user is ensured to be maintained in situ. According to the invention, the data acquisition terminal acquires the user interaction data information in real time, the control center makes response measures to judge the user interaction data information, so that the information interaction between the user and the virtual scene is realized, and the objects in the virtual scene are adjusted in real time by the three-dimensional reconstruction method, so that the user can be helped to avoid the possible obstacles in reality, and new experience can be brought to the user, and the user experience is promoted.

title_en: Slope emergency multistage reinforcement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope emergency multistage reinforcement method, which comprises the following steps: drilling holes on the side slope and cleaning the side slope with water; placing the U-shaped circulating pipe and the phase-change liquid pipe into a drill hole, and injecting circulating refrigerant liquid into the U-shaped circulating pipe to freeze pore water of a rock-soil body, so as to realize first reinforcement of a side slope; injecting high-pressure phase-change liquid into the drill hole through the phase-change liquid pipe so as to change the structure of the electric double layer of the side slope, and changing the hydrophilicity of the electric double layer structure into hydrophobicity so as to realize secondary reinforcement of the side slope; continuously injecting circulating refrigerant liquid into the U-shaped circulating pipe to freeze the phase change liquid and pore water to improve the strength of the phase change liquid and pore water, so as to realize the third reinforcement of the side slope; withdrawing the U-shaped circulating pipe and the phase-change liquid pipe, installing a anchor rod body in the drilled hole, and injecting a novel grouting material to realize fourth reinforcement of the side slope; and water draining holes penetrating through the phase change liquid reinforcing area are distributed in the side slope, the liquid phase change liquid changes the electric double layer structure of the side slope, the hydrophobicity of the side slope is improved, and the long-term reinforcement of the side slope is realized. The invention can effectively prevent the occurrence of side slope geological disasters.

title_en: Safety electricity consumption simulation test system for household appliances
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe electricity consumption simulation test system for household appliances, which comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring working data of the household appliances; the model construction module is connected with the data acquisition module and used for constructing a household appliance operation model based on the working data; and the decision module is connected with the model construction module and is used for judging whether potential electrical hazards exist. The system can simulate electricity consumption through the data of the household appliances and the power supply circuit, judge whether the household appliances and the power supply circuit can normally operate when the household appliances are all operated at present through the simulation data, predict safe electricity consumption and avoid fire disaster of the household appliances and the power supply circuit.

title_en: Prediction method and system for disaster-causing marine organism outburst of nuclear power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting disaster-causing marine organism outbreak of a nuclear power station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a hydrodynamic model of the nuclear power station to simulate the hydrodynamic space-time variation of a water intake area of the nuclear power station; the marine organism outburst prediction model is constructed to simulate and predict the outburst of disaster-causing marine organisms according to the water power space-time change of the water intake area of the nuclear power station, provide targeted monitoring, prevention and control countermeasures for cold source management of the nuclear power station, and improve the safety prevention and control precision, emergency treatment efficiency and safety reliability of the cold source of the nuclear power station.
assignees: SUZHOU NUCLEAR POWER RES INST;GUANGDONG NUCLEAR POWER JOINT VENTURE CO LTD;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION CO LTD;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Tailing pond dam break emergency evacuation command system and method based on unmanned aerial vehicle technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a tailing pond dam break emergency evacuation command system and a method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle technology, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a simulation and monitoring module, a scanning identification module, an information processing module and a decision command platform module; the method comprises the following steps: carrying out live-action shooting and radar scanning on debris flow diffusion conditions of the tailing pond through unmanned aerial vehicle scanning identification; by receiving information feedback of the unmanned aerial vehicle, reasonable evacuation route planning and unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling schemes are given; the decision command platform conducts command and guidance on disaster-stricken people; the invention realizes the real-time monitoring and evacuation guiding of the disaster-affected area after the dam break, and on the premise of simulating the dam break condition, the invention deals with the situation that the downstream disaster-affected personnel of the adjacent dam body is not evacuated timely due to the rapid release of the tailings in advance, and gives out a real-time evacuation scheme and real-time disaster through unmanned aerial vehicle scanning identification and intelligent analysis, thereby providing specific information for command personnel to make reliable decisions.

title_en: Ultrasonic multi-point real-time monitoring method for mine surrounding rock roof disasters
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster ultrasonic multipoint real-time monitoring, and discloses an ultrasonic multipoint real-time monitoring method for disaster of a mine surrounding rock roof. The method comprises the steps of carrying out prediction on permeability of a mine surrounding rock roof, carrying out correction on an electric imaging image by utilizing MATLAB, carrying out pretreatment processes such as image noise reduction and the like to realize image enhancement, forming a basic image which can be used for logging interpretation, extracting available information of the image by utilizing machine learning to prepare available data for permeability prediction, and accurately predicting the mine surrounding rock roof permeability according to particle size information and a permeability training regression model by utilizing MATLAB machine learning; meanwhile, the hardness of the mine surrounding rock roof can be accurately measured by the method for measuring the hardness of the mine surrounding rock roof, so that collapse caused by overlarge bearing weight is prevented.
assignees: SINOSTEEL MAANSHAN GENERAL INSTITUTE OF MINING RES CO LTD

title_en: System and method for testing fire resistance of cable under building fire heating condition
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a system and a method for testing fire resistance of a cable under a building fire heating condition, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly preparing a sample and installing the sample in a test furnace; then connecting two ends of the sample through a connecting wire, wherein one end of the sample is connected with a power supply, and the other end of the sample is connected with a load device; and finally, starting the test furnace, heating according to a specified heating condition, simulating a fire scene, and recording the continuous power supply time of the cable under the building fire heating condition. The system is used for realizing the method, and the method can evaluate the capability of the cable to continuously supply power to key equipment when the fire disaster occurs in the places such as simulated civil buildings and the like. The test result provided by the method can provide data support for the aspects of fire-resistant cable development, fire-resistant cable structure optimization, fire-resistant material research, fire-fighting electric equipment safety evaluation and the like, and has a wider application prospect.
assignees: SICHUAN FIRE RES INST MEM;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Typhoon disaster and short-term storm rain urban waterlogging and water accumulation and drainage test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a typhoon disaster and short-term storm water logging and drainage test device for urban inland inundation, which at least comprises the following components: the controllable rainfall mechanism is used for simulating the rainfall process and controlling the rainfall intensity in the test process; the controllable water accumulation and drainage mode road mechanism is arranged below the controllable rainfall mechanism and is used for simulating different slopes and different water accumulation and drainage boundary conditions of a road surface so as to form a rainfall runoff working condition of the road surface of a required complex road; the drainage simulation mechanism of the replaceable rainwater grate at least comprises the rainwater grate, and the drainage simulation mechanism of the replaceable rainwater grate tests the drainage efficiency of the rainwater grate with different geometric structures by replacing the rainwater grate. The test device establishes a road surface rainwater drainage scale model under complex working conditions, can explore drainage efficiency and mode of the test device under the conditions of different road surface gradients, different water accumulation and drainage modes, different rainwater grates and the like, is convenient to operate, simple in structure and visual, and can meet the requirement of repeated tests.
assignees: XIAOREN HANGZHOU DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Retaining wall construction method using slope non-open cut method
abstract_en: To provide a retaining wall construction method capable of constructing a retaining wall installed to prevent collapse of a slope toe of a slope by safely shortening a construction period/man hour without generating secondary collapse and at the same time capable of forming a rain water channel.SOLUTION: A departure shaft and an arrival shaft of a propulsion method are provided on both sides of a danger zone/disaster zone in the range of constructing a retaining wall at a debris flow site, an L-shaped propulsion block is safely installed in the ground while propelling a boring machine for drilling the section of an L-shaped retaining wall into an L shape of an L-shaped casing and the L-shaped propulsion block behind the boring machine by a base pushing device of the arrival shaft, and the L-shaped retaining wall is constructed by fitting and connecting a vertical upper block to the left projected part of the L-shaped propulsion block.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: ALPHA CIVIL ENG KK;KIYOTA ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method for simulating risk exposure space of disaster-bearing body on underlying surface of heterogeneous city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating risk exposure space of a disaster-bearing body on the underlying surface of a heterogeneous city, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of the city and preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain preprocessed data; calculating risk exposure parameters of the disaster-bearing body of the urban underlying surface according to the preprocessing data, and constructing a risk exposure characteristic set of the disaster-bearing body of the urban underlying surface; then collecting grid sample data of a disaster-bearing body of the urban underlying surface, and constructing a disaster-bearing body weight exposure grid sample; and finally, according to the disaster-bearing body risk exposure feature set and the disaster-bearing body weight exposure grid sample of the urban underlying surface, adopting a random forest algorithm to simulate the disaster-bearing body risk exposure space of the heterogeneous urban underlying surface. The invention breaks through the bottleneck problem of larger estimation error of the risk exposure of the disaster-bearing body by taking the administrative boundary as a statistics unit, is beneficial to improving the accuracy of the risk exposure simulation of the urban underlying surface, and is suitable for the fields of urban disaster prevention, disaster reduction, emergency management and the like.

title_en: Earthquake disaster personnel risk assessment method, system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a method, a system and electronic equipment for evaluating risk of earthquake disaster personnel, and relates to the technical field of risk determination of earthquake disaster personnel. According to the remote sensing image of the area to be detected, the structure type, the function type and the population number of a plurality of buildings in the area to be detected are determined; and determining the wounded number and the lethal number of each building under the current earthquake intensity according to the probability of different damage degrees of the buildings with different structure types under the current earthquake intensity. According to the invention, the risk assessment of earthquake disaster personnel can be carried out before the occurrence of an earthquake, and the risk assessment result is used for the establishment of earthquake disaster relief exercise and disaster relief plans, so that the rationality and efficiency of disaster relief work after the occurrence of the earthquake are improved.

title_en: Automatic disaster recovery switching method based on proxy simulation app voting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic disaster recovery switching method based on agent simulation app voting, which specifically comprises the following steps: 101 A step of deploying proxy nodes, a step of 102) preprocessing, a step of 103) voting, and a step of 104) switching; the invention provides an automatic disaster recovery switching method based on agent simulation app voting, which can automatically switch disaster recovery, upload error reasons and help to quickly analyze cluster failure reasons.

title_en: Test device for combined bridge body flow load under typhoon disaster and flood disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test device for combined bridge body flow load under typhoon disasters and flood disasters, which comprises: the combined bridge body device is used for simulating a bridge body structure and bearing the hydrodynamic load simulating mountain floods or mud-rock flows, and the span, the bridge pier spacing and the bridge pier form of the bridge body are adjusted by changing the combined arrangement mode of the bridge body; the river channel simulation device comprises a simulated river bank and a simulated river bed and is used for simulating a river channel and bearing a combined bridge body device; the water supply and water collection device comprises a water supply side and a water collection side, wherein the water supply side is used for simulating the mountain torrents or the debris flows flowing into the river simulation device from the upstream, and the water collection side is used for collecting the mountain torrents or the debris flows flowing into the downstream of the river simulation device. The utility model establishes a river channel system scaling model which comprises a bridge body structure and is influenced by flood, and can simulate parameters such as different mountain floods or debris flow intensities, different river channel forms, different bridge body structures and the like, and explore the hydrodynamic action of the mountain floods or the debris flow on the bridge body structure and the mechanical response of the bridge body.
assignees: XIAOREN HANGZHOU DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Drilling machine for ground disaster investigation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drilling machine for ground disaster investigation, which relates to the technical field of drilling machines and comprises a top plate, wherein the top plate is annular, the lower surface of the top plate is fixedly connected with uniformly distributed fixing rods, the outer surfaces of a pair of fixing rods are connected with lifting plates in a sliding manner, the lower surface of the lifting plates is provided with a lifting mechanism, the middle position of the upper surface of the lifting plates is fixedly connected with a motor, an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the lifting plates and is fixedly connected with a drill rod, through grooves are formed in two sides of the lifting plates, and box bodies are connected in the through grooves in a sliding manner, and the lifting plates, a trapezoid block and an elastic mechanism are matched with each other; at the in-process that the lifter plate moved up, box body can be closed automatically, makes the drilling rod can accomodate inside the box body, prevents to collide with the drilling rod at the transfer in-process, avoids the drilling rod to take place to damage.
assignees: SICHUAN 915 ENG SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Combined type river channel system leakage simulation test device under typhoon disaster and flood disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined type river channel system leakage simulation test device under typhoon disasters and flood disasters, which comprises: the combined grid river channel device comprises a plurality of grid landform units, wherein the grid landform units are used for combining grid landform units with different heights to form a simulated river channel structure suitable for DEM grid calculation; the water supply and collection device comprises a water supply side and a water collection side, wherein the water supply side is used for providing controllable water supply flow to simulate the water flow load at the upstream of the combined grid river device, and the water collection side is used for providing controllable water yield to simulate the flood discharge capacity of the combined grid river device; the model test box is at least used for installing the combined grid river channel device and the water supply and collection device and collecting optical images simulating the drainage process of the combined grid river channel device. The utility model establishes the combined riverway riverbed scale model suitable for DEM grid calculation, and can obtain the flow dynamics response of the riverway riverbed system under different upstream flood filling and downstream flood discharging conditions.
assignees: XIAOREN HANGZHOU DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle emergency scene inspection method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency scene inspection method and system based on deep reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps that firstly, an inspection control center acquires position coordinates required to be inspected by disasters; the unmanned aerial vehicle starts to execute the inspection task, the track of the unmanned aerial vehicle is optimized to minimize the inspection time of the unmanned aerial vehicle by knowing the position coordinates of the inspection points in the process of executing the inspection task by the unmanned aerial vehicle, the track of the unmanned aerial vehicle is reasonably optimized and the inspection data are collected by using a Dueling-DQN algorithm in deep reinforcement learning when the track of the unmanned aerial vehicle is optimized, and the optimal track of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the collected inspection data are output when the maximum training times are reached, so that the total inspection time of a system is reduced.

title_en: Short-term rainfall prediction method and device based on multi-scale space-time consistency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-cut rainfall prediction method and device based on multi-scale space-time consistency, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out coding constraint on space distribution characteristics by utilizing obtained rainfall time sequence characteristics to obtain rainfall space-time fusion characteristics, carrying out Gaussian distribution fitting on rainfall space-time fusion characteristic data under different scales by utilizing multi-scale space-time consistency supervision, taking the difference between the characteristics under different scales as supervision loss, carrying out mutual constraint on adjacent rain pixels in an obtained prediction rainfall graph by utilizing neighbor difference consistency, ensuring the relevance of local rainfall, respectively calculating a loss function at a characteristic graph level and a pixel level, adding the loss function with consistency supervision loss and neighbor difference consistency loss as global loss, and carrying out optimization training on a neural network to obtain an optimal short-cut rainfall prediction model for the prediction of short-cut rainfall. The apparatus includes a processor and a memory. The invention realizes effective prediction of the short-term rainfall and improves the disaster early warning capability.

title_en: Emergency disaster relief simple housing structure identification device and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency disaster relief simple house structure identification device and a use method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of house structure identification tools. The device's transposition seat slidable mounting is on the base to can carry out the position upset of multi-angle on the base, the transposition seat carries out the position locking through spacing card, is provided with two cloth clamping devices on the transposition seat, and two cloth clamping devices all suit is in the pivot, and drives with the pivot and rotate, and the cloth clamping device who accomplishes the tarpaulin centre gripping is just that surplus tarpaulin is rolled up in the outside of oneself. According to the invention, the tarpaulin can be positioned at the posture positions of various inclined angles by arranging the transposition seat capable of overturning at various angles, so that various identification projects are conveniently carried out, and meanwhile, the transposition seat is simple in overturning form, easy to operate and convenient to use; the device is provided with the cloth clamping device through the sound of the rotating shaft, so that the tarpaulin can be spread and flattened with different tightness, the practical application scene can be conveniently simulated, and the identification can be conveniently carried out.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG CONSTRUCTION TECH DEVELOPMENT CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Rapid landslide building vulnerability analysis method based on FLAC3D and PS-INSAR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick landslide building vulnerability analysis method based on FLAC3D and PS-INSAR, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting required research data; s2, obtaining a building disaster resistance evaluation index system and weight through literature investigation and expert scoring to obtain a building disaster resistance index calculated value R; s3, calculating accumulated displacement at different places of the landslide by utilizing a PS-InSAR technology, and inverting to obtain a landslide disaster-causing intensity inversion value I according to the accumulated displacement value and the building disaster-resisting capacity index value R obtained in S2  p  Then by displacement-I  p  Fitting a scatter diagram to obtain a disaster-causing intensity experience curve of the landslide; s4, simulating landslide accumulated displacement under extreme working conditions by using FLAC3D, and obtaining a disaster-causing intensity index calculated value of the landslide under the extreme working conditions by using a disaster-causing intensity empirical curve of the landslideI, a step of I; s5, utilizing R and I to obtain vulnerability of the disaster-bearing body under extreme working conditions. Solves the problems of disaster resistance of landslide buildings and quantification of disaster-causing intensity of landslide at present.

title_en: Method and system for forecasting earthquake according to geomagnetic and earth sound data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for forecasting earthquake according to geomagnetic and earth sound data, and relates to the field of natural disaster early warning; the method comprises the following steps: obtaining observation data of each set characteristic factor in a sampling period, wherein the characteristic factors comprise geomagnetic characteristic factors and earth sound characteristic factors; preprocessing the obtained observation data to obtain data sets expressed as geomagnetic and geothermal gray scale maps at different moments before earthquake; constructing a convolutional neural network model, and carrying out model training and optimization according to the data set to obtain a seismic prediction model; and predicting the earthquake according to the earthquake prediction model. The observation data based on geomagnetic and earth sound characteristic factors are converted into gray level images after being preprocessed by variance, normalization and the like, and then are matched with an earthquake catalogue to form a data set; and then training the constructed convolutional neural network model according to the data set to obtain the earthquake prediction model which can be applied to the current earthquake prediction monitoring work and has the accuracy rate of 80 percent.

title_en: Fire disaster simulation device for cargo hold of multifunctional aircraft
abstract_en: The fire disaster simulation device of the cargo hold of the multifunctional aircraft comprises an ignition device, a cargo hold floor and a controller, wherein a water bath combustion pool is arranged below the cargo hold floor, water is contained in the water bath combustion pool, a fuel pipeline is arranged in the water bath combustion pool, and a plurality of underwater fuel release pipelines are arranged on the fuel pipeline side by side; in summary, the combustion device is integrated below the cargo compartment floor, so that the fire is not limited to the range of individual cargoes, and a plurality of cargoes in the area can be in a combustion state; the whole cargo hold floor adopts a steel structure grate state ground; independent control electromagnetic valves are arranged in each section of area of the combustion device, so that the combustion area can be controlled in a segmented manner, and fires in different areas can be simulated flexibly; the utility model restores the real combustion and fire spreading state of the fire in the cargo hold, and further improves the fidelity of the real fire training.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHEN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device is experienced in simulation crossing stream
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of disaster simulation devices, and particularly relates to a simulated crossing stream experience device, which comprises a base, wherein a flushing tank is arranged on one side of the top of the base, a buffer chamber is arranged on the other side of the top of the base, the buffer chamber is connected with a glass wall through a wallboard, a water collecting mechanism is arranged on the top of the flushing tank, and protection mechanisms are arranged on the tops of the wallboard and the glass wall.
assignees: HIRAIN BEST EMERGENCY SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological forecast downscaling algorithm
abstract_en: A weather forecast downscaling algorithm provides a method for dynamically counting downscaling from low-resolution mode grid points to high-resolution mode grid points through data collection and quality control, data preprocessing, initial error analysis, objective weight analysis, probability density matching, secondary error analysis, model construction, dynamic training and downscaling data, solves the problem of relative balance between computing resources and accuracy based on weather site and mode grid point data, provides support for services such as fine forecast and new energy fine assessment of departments such as civil aviation weather, prevents weather disaster influence, facilitates efficient and accurate management of new energy, reduces potential risk cost and improves economic benefits of weather products.

title_en: Simulation apparatus for crowd behavior based on 3d virtual space
title_ko: 3차원 가상 공간 기반의 군중 행동 시뮬레이션 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a crowd behavior simulation device based on a three-dimensional virtual space, which can prevent damage and loss due to disaster occurrence, comprising: a destination input unit; a destination guidance field generation unit; a collision avoidance guidance field generating unit; a collision navigation field generating module; a steering force calculation unit; and a simulation generating unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 3차원 가상 공간 기반의 군중 행동 시뮬레이션 장치에 관한 것으로서, 3차원 가상공간에서 모델링된 적층식 다층 건물 모델 내부에 배치된 복수의 에이전트들이 해당 건물 모델의 출구 정보에 대응하도록 기설정된 목적지를 향해 이동하는 대피 동작을 시뮬레이션하는 3차원 가상 공간 기반의 군중 행동 시뮬레이션 장치에 있어서, 사용자로부터 상기 다층 건물 모델을 구성하는 복수의 정점들 중 어느 하나를 목적지 정점으로 선택 입력받는 목적지 입력부와, 상기 복수의 정점들에 대하여 기설정된 스칼라 기반 열전도량 함수에 기초한 열전도량을 부여할 때 임의의 정점과 상기 목적지 정점 간의 거리에 따른 스칼라장의 기울기를 나타내는 벡터장에 대응하는 목적지 유도장을 생성하는 목적지 유도장 생성부와, 상기 복수의 에이전트들이 상기 다층 건물 모델에 포함되는 서로 다른 방향의 법선벡터를 갖는 평면상에 배치될 때 상기 복수의 에이전트들 각각의 위치를 기준으로 인접한 적어도 하나의 상기 에이전트에 대하여 작용하는 척력힘에 따른 충돌 회피를 유도하기 위한 충돌 회피 유도장을 생성하는 충돌 회피 유도장 생성부와, 상기 목적지 유도장 및 상기 충돌 회피 유도장의 결합에 의해 상기 복수의 에이전트들에 대하여 작용하는 조종힘에 따라 상기 복수의 에이전트들이 상기 다층 건물 모델의 내부에서 상기 목적지를 향해 이동하는 동작에 대한 시뮬레이션 영상을 생성하는 시뮬레이션 생성부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 따라, 인적·물적 피해가 예상되는 긴급 재난상황에서의 개인 및 군중 특성에 따른 행동 예측 모델을 구축 및 훈련할 수 있어 예기치 못한 재난 발생으로 인한 피해와 손실을 미연에 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: UNIV DONG A RES FOUND FOR IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Control system of screw compression refrigeratorusing
title_ko: 인버터 스크류 냉동기 제어시스템 및 제어방법
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, an inverter screw refrigerator control system may be provided.
