The system comprises: a screw compression refrigerator; a simulator that performs a simulation operation based on the design specifications of the refrigerator and calculates an operation reference value for optimal efficiency; a control panel that inputs the operation reference value calculated from the simulator as an operation setting value for operation of the refrigerator, monitors the operation status of the refrigerator, and controls the refrigerator in real time; an inverter that controls the operation and frequency of the refrigerator according to signals from the control panel; an alarm system that triggers an alarm when an abnormal situation outside the operation reference value range occurs during the monitoring process of the refrigerator; and a disaster prevention room that remotely monitors the control panel and remotely instructs the control panel to determine the cause of abnormalities and take action, including turning the refrigerator ON/OFF when the alarm system is activated. Accordingly, it is possible to accurately diagnose whether the refrigerator is broken or not and where it is broken.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일측면에 따르면, 스크류 압축방식 냉동기; 상기 냉동기의 설계사양을 기준으로 시뮬레이션 운전을 수행하여 최적의 효율을 위한 운전 기준값을 산출하는 시뮬레이터; 상기 시뮬레이터로부터 산출된 운전 기준값을 상기 냉동기의 가동을 위한 운전 설정값으로 입력하고, 냉동기의 운전 상태를 모니터링하여 실시간 제어하는 제어반; 상기 제어반의 신호에 따라 냉동기의 가동 및 주파수를 제어하는 인버터; 상기 냉동기의 모니터링 과정에서 운전 기준값 범위를 벗어나는 비정상 상황 발생 시 이에 따른 경보를 발동하는 경보시스템; 및 상기 제어반을 원격 모니터링하고, 경보시스템 발동시 냉동기를 ON/OFF제어를 포함하는 비정상 원인파악과 조치사항을 제어반에 원격 지시하는 방재실;를 포함하는 인버터 스크류 냉동기 제어시스템이 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: River condition information provision system and method through image information and environmental information collection and analysis
title_ko: 영상정보와 환경정보의 수집 및 분석을 통한 하천 상태정보 제공시스템 및 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for collecting and analyzing river condition information through image information and physical sensing and, more specifically, to a system and a method for providing river condition information through collection and analysis of image information and environmental information, which comprises the steps of: collecting image information using various types of cameras on rivers including embankments that are the subject of measurement, wherein the rivers are particularly areas where flood damage occurs continuously; collecting environmental information including a water level, a flow rate, a temperature, and humidity through physical sensing; collecting hyperspectral image information from the sky and analyzing the information by incorporating 3D virtual reality thereinto; and analyzing information on river conditions, monitoring and predicting in real time whether disasters, including embankment collapses or floods, will occur, and providing intuitive information and risk situations to relevant river management entities and the public using the river.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 영상정보와 물리적 센싱을 통한 하천 상태정보를 수집 및 분석하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 측정대상인 제방을 포함한 하천(특히 홍수 피해가 지속적으로 발생하는 지역)에 대해 다종의 카메라를 이용해 영상정보를 수집하고, 물리적 센싱을 통해 수위와 유속과 온도 및 습도를 포함한 환경정보를 수집하는 한편, 상공에서 초분광 영상정보를 수집하여 3차원 가상현실을 접목시키면서 정보를 분석하여, 하천 상태에 대한 정보 분석, 그리고 제방 붕괴 내지 홍수를 포함한 재난 발생 여부를 실시간 모니터링하면서 예측하여, 이에 대한 직관적인 정보 및 위험 상황을 해당 하천 관리 주체 및 하천을 이용하는 대중에게 정보를 제공하게 되는 영상정보와 환경정보의 수집 및 분석을 통한 하천 상태정보 제공시스템 및 제공방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: River safety management system and method using artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능을 이용한 하천 이용 안전관리시스템 및 하천 이용 안전관리방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a river safety management system using artificial intelligence. More specifically, the river safety management system collects image information using multiple types of cameras in regard to a measurement target such as a river basin, and collects environment information including a water level, water velocity and temperature and humidity through physical sensing, and, meanwhile, when collecting hyperspectral image information in the sky, an artificial intelligence analysis device analyzes the collected information and accumulates the analyzed information while grafting continuous analysis with three-dimensional virtual reality, thereby monitoring whether a disaster such as a sea breach or flood occurs in real time while predicting the same, and, as a result, the system can provide intuitive information about the dangerous situation to a corresponding river management agent and the public using the river, and can analyze whether there is an inappropriate person in the river or whether a vehicle is sinking and drifting such that the emergency situation can be handled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능을 이용한 하천 이용 안전관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 측정 대상 예컨대, 하천 유역에 대해 다종의 카메라를 이용해 영상정보를 수집하고, 물리적 센싱을 통해 수위와 유속과 온도 및 습도를 포함한 환경정보를 수집하는 한편, 상공에서 초분광 영상정보를 수집하면, 인공지능 분석장치가 수집된 정보를 분석하고 분석 정보를 축적하면서 지속적인 분석과 3차원 가상현실을 접목시키면서 정보를 분석하여, 제방 붕괴 내지 홍수를 포함한 재난 발생 여부를 실시간 모니터링하면서 예측하여, 이에 대한 직관적인 정보 및 위험 상황을 해당 하천 관리 주체 및 하천을 이용하는 대중에게 정보를 제공하고, 하천 내 부적절한 사람 내지 차량의 입수 및 표류 여부를 분석하여 긴급상황에 대처할 수 있도록 된 인공지능을 이용한 하천 이용 안전관리시스템 및 안전관리방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Railway Disaster Monitoring System
title_ko: 철도 재난 감시 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a technique related to a railway disaster monitoring system for monitoring foreign substances on railways, which comprises: a camera; and an image processing device receiving a railroad image captured by the camera. The image processing device includes: a segmented image acquisition unit obtaining multiple segmented images, including rails, from the railway image received from the camera, and scaling the segmented images to obtain segmented image blocks of a predetermined size; and a segmented image determination unit having a first DNN discriminator trained with a deep learning neural network, and inputting the segmented image blocks into the first DNN discriminator to determine whether railways are normal railways having no foreign substances thereon. The segmented images can be used to quickly and easily discriminate a deep learning neural network even with fewer resources.
abstract_ko: 카메라와, 상기 카메라에서 촬영한 철도 이미지를 입력받는 이미지 처리 장치를 포함하며, 철도 위의 이물질을 감시하는 철도 재난 감시 시스템에 관한 기술이 개시된다. 이미지 처리 장치는, 카메라로부터 입력받은 철도 이미지에서 레일을 포함하는 복수의 분할 이미지를 얻고, 분할 이미지를 스케일링하여 일정한 크기의 분할 이미지 블록을 구하는 분할 이미지 취득부와, 딥러닝 신경망으로 훈련시킨 제1 DNN 판별기를 구비하여, 분할 이미지 블록을 제1 DNN 판별기에 투입하여 철도 위에 이물질이 없는 정상상태의 철도인지 여부를 판단하는 분할 이미지 판단부를 포함한다. 분할 이미지를 사용하여 적은 자원으로도 딥러닝 신경망 판별을 빠르고 쉽게 할 수 있다.

title_en: Respiratory rate monitoring equipment for firefighter training
abstract_en: The utility model discloses respiratory rate monitoring equipment for firefighter training, which comprises a fixed bottom plate, wherein elastic fixed ropes are arranged at four corners of the fixed bottom plate, connecting rings are wound on the top ends of the elastic fixed ropes, connecting balls are fixedly connected to the other ends of the elastic fixed ropes, a fixed groove is formed in the top surface of the fixed bottom plate, a bottom base plate is arranged in the fixed groove, conical springs are inlaid at the top ends of the bottom base plate, and a fixed top plate is fixedly arranged at the other ends of the conical springs. In the scheme, through setting up fixed roof, conical spring and pressure sensor and controller, utilize its several mutually supporting, wear fixed bottom plate to the front of fire fighter through four elasticity fixed ropes, breathe when the training of fire fighter then, through the display screen record display after with the information recording by the controller, but after training at this moment, the numerical value of direct observation display screen record is analyzed and is preserved.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;HANGZHOU WANCHAO MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery exercise method, platform, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery exercise method, a platform, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a disaster recovery exercise workflow created by a user based on a preset workflow model, wherein the disaster recovery exercise workflow comprises a plurality of nodes, and the nodes are respectively configured with tasks to be executed; the disaster recovery exercise workflow is associated with corresponding atomic capacity to obtain a target disaster recovery exercise workflow, wherein the atomic capacity is a capacity unit required for managing cloud resources of the user or application programs on the cloud resources; and driving the target disaster recovery exercise workflow to execute disaster recovery exercise through a workflow engine corresponding to the preset workflow model. According to the method and the device for carrying out disaster recovery exercise, the technical problem of poor efficiency caused by carrying out disaster recovery exercise manually or in a form mode in the related art is solved, and the technical effect of improving the disaster recovery exercise efficiency is achieved.

title_en: Geological disaster risk assessment method and system integrating random forest and attention
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological disaster risk assessment method and system integrating a random forest and attention, wherein the method comprises the following steps of A, collecting basic geographical information data, meteorological data and socioeconomic data as risk assessment indexes, taking geological disaster risk levels and geological disaster types as labels, constructing a training set TS, B, training a random forest model RF and a deep learning network model G based on an attention mechanism by using the training set TS, and obtaining the geological disaster risk levels by inputting the risk assessment indexes and the geological disaster types into the random forest model RF and the deep learning network model G. The method and the system are beneficial to improving the accuracy of geological disaster risk assessment.

title_en: Positioning method for predicting coal rock main fracture source based on induced charges
abstract_en: The invention designs a positioning method for predicting a coal rock main fracture source based on induced charges, which comprises the steps of firstly arranging charge monitoring probes with different surfaces in underground air inlet or return air inlet coal rock charge monitoring drill holes; establishing a mathematical model through coal rock charge monitoring data monitored by a probe; transmitting charge signals acquired by the coal rock charge probe in real time to a CPU software system for data storage and analysis in a voltage signal transmission mode; finally, determining the space coordinates of a main fracture source of the coal rock, and predicting the position of the main fracture of the coal rock in the coal rock dynamic disaster; the method solves the problems that the coal rock dynamic warning method is difficult to construct, the warning cannot be positioned and the like, provides a brand new method for coal rock dynamic disaster warning, improves the efficiency of coal rock dynamic disaster warning, and improves the accuracy of coal rock dynamic disaster warning.

title_en: Fire emergency drilling method and system based on computer technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent rescue and provides a fire emergency drilling method and a fire emergency drilling system based on a computer technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a structure diagram of a safety channel; acquiring a plurality of real-time video information of the safety channel based on the image acquisition device; preprocessing the plurality of real-time video information to obtain a plurality of information processing results; evaluating the information processing results based on the structure diagram of the safety channel to generate a path evaluation result; generating a navigation path based on the path evaluation result; and acquiring first early warning information through the navigation path, wherein the first early warning information is used for reminding a user to carry out safe evacuation. By adopting the method, the technical problems of overlong evacuation time and possibly secondary accidents such as trampling and the like caused by excessive number of people in a single safety channel in the process of evacuating people can be solved.

title_en: Reservoir informatization management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir informatization management system based on digital twinning, which comprises a database, a model library and a computer end service function module, wherein the database is used for storing data of a reservoir; the database comprises basic data, service management data, monitoring data, external sharing data, geographic space data and video data and is used for storing information data related to the reservoir; the model library comprises a flood forecast model, a flood control scheduling model, a hydrodynamic model, a water resource optimization scheduling model and a safety evaluation model, and is used for simulating the operation of the reservoir in various service scenes and adjusting model parameters of the model library according to the simulated operation results; the computer-side business function module comprises a flood prevention scene, a water supply scene, a safety scene, data maintenance and system configuration, and is used for controlling the model library to retrieve information data from the database and executing the content of each business scene. The method solves the problems of reservoir information resource dispersion, poor system applicability and poor disaster defending capability, and comprehensively improves the reservoir informatization management level.

title_en: Synchronous control method for coal seam gas and hard roof rock burst
abstract_en: The invention relates to a synchronous control method for coal seam gas and hard roof rock burst. Comprising the following steps: constructing a key layer horizontal well and a coal seam roof horizontal well based on the foundation well, wherein the key layer horizontal well extends from the foundation well to a drainage and production vertical well in a key layer of an area to be treated; the horizontal well of the coal seam roof extends from the basic well to the vertical drainage well in the coal seam roof and is in butt joint communication with the vertical drainage well; performing staged fracturing construction in the horizontal well of the key layer, and performing fracturing construction in the horizontal well of the coal seam roof after staged fracturing construction of the horizontal well of the key layer; the vertical distance between the coal seam roof horizontal well and the key layer horizontal well is larger. Therefore, the synchronous treatment method solves the problem of interference between the key layer and the coal seam drilling and fracturing, can realize the high-efficiency drilling and completion of the double-step horizontal well, realizes the non-interference staged clustering fracturing of the key layer and the coal seam, and realizes the synchronous treatment of coal seam gas and hard roof rock burst dynamic disasters.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Bridge sling safety calculation method after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the safety of a bridge sling after a fire, and belongs to the technical field of calculation, calculation or counting. The method comprises the steps of establishing a material strength model of a sling parent metal after water cooling at a high temperature based on experimental data, establishing a fire disaster numerical simulation model of a bridge sling by utilizing FDS software, calculating a temperature time-varying model of each node position of the surface layer of the sling during the period from fire starting to water spraying and extinguishing, establishing a bridge sling fine finite element model containing all steel wires by utilizing finite element software, calculating a time-varying rule of the temperature of each steel wire, obtaining the corresponding residual strength of each steel wire after water spraying and extinguishing based on the sling parent metal strength model, comparing the stress of each steel wire with the residual strength of the steel wire, obtaining the number of the effective steel wires and the effective area of the section of the sling, and further calculating the safety of the sling structure after fire disaster. The invention can reasonably evaluate the safety of the bridge sling structure after the fire disaster of the vehicle on the bridge occurs.

title_en: Multi-dimensional risk dynamic evaluation method and system for large-scale vehicle exhibition fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-dimensional risk dynamic assessment method and system for a large-scale vehicle-mounted fire disaster. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of identifying a vehicle-mounted fire risk in multiple dimensions, determining risk factors related to vehicle-mounted fire accidents, determining risk factor related information, and establishing a dynamic Bayesian topological structure of the vehicle-mounted fire accidents; based on the state Bayesian topological structure, carrying out data fusion on expert experience weights through DS theory, determining the prior probability of a basic event, constructing a conditional probability table, and determining the occurrence probability of a vehicle-spread fire accident by utilizing the forward reasoning technology of a dynamic Bayesian network; determining the probability of occurrence of a vehicle-mounted fire accident based on the prior probability of the basic event, deeply researching the sensitivity of the Bayesian network, and determining a sensitive event; and entering a unit event accident state through the unit event initial normal working state, completing dynamic mode transition, generating a dynamic simulation model, and predicting the accident occurrence trend according to the dynamic simulation model. The invention can realize multi-dimensional, full-scale and dynamic risk assessment.

title_en: Mountain area storm soil middling hydrologic model based on topography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model of a flow hydrologic in mountain storm soil based on terrain, which is established by the following steps: s1: calculating a canopy interception process of the forest covered area according to the actually measured rainfall data and the forest covered data; s2: calculating a soil infiltration process; s3: calculating the river basin yield according to the full-reservoir yield, the super-seepage yield and the abortion flow theory in the storm soil; s4: calculating an equal flow time line according to the river basin yield and the DEM data so as to calculate the total diameter flow of the river basin; s5: according to the collected historical flood event, KGE is used as an objective function, SCE-UA algorithm is used for optimizing model parameters, nash-Sutcliffe coefficient and flood peak flow relative error Q are used  p  Sum peak time error T  p  Model simulation performance is evaluated for the metrics. The model increases the flow production mechanism in storm soil, considers the regulation effect of forest on rainfall and topographyThe spatial variability of the mountain torrents is achieved, more accurate mountain torrents are simulated and forecasted, and technical support is provided for mountain torrent disaster prevention work deployment.

title_en: Fire hazard level judging and intelligent preventing and controlling method for mine rubber belt conveyor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire hazard level judging and intelligent prevention and control method for a mine rubber belt conveyor, which comprises the steps of firstly, collecting a fire monitoring data set of a mine rubber belt conveyor roadway; the fire disaster monitoring method comprises the steps of carrying out dimensionless treatment on a fire disaster monitoring data set, training a fire disaster risk level judging model, carrying out subsequent fire disaster risk level judgment on a mine rubber belt conveyor roadway, carrying out fire disaster prevention and control in a five-stage and two-stage smoldering stage, and carrying out fire disaster prevention and control in a six-stage and three-stage open fire stage. According to the invention, the LSTM-DAE characteristic network is constructed, the coding and decoding neurons are replaced by the LSTM neurons by utilizing the improved DAE algorithm, the attention mechanism is introduced to improve the effectiveness of characteristic extraction, the two-layer full-connection layer network and the Softmax classifier are utilized to output the fire hazard level corresponding to the currently input monitoring data, the hazard level judging accuracy is higher, the speed is faster, and different fire prevention and control measures are carried out according to different levels, so that the fire prevention and control are more intelligent.

title_en: Building performance simulation method and system based on Flow Design technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building performance simulation method, a system, equipment and a computer readable storage medium based on a FlowDesign technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: building a BIM building model according to the building plane CAD design construction data; inputting the BIM building model into fire-fighting simulation software, performing fire numerical simulation through the fire-fighting simulation software, and setting building physical model, grid model determination, fire scene setting and fire initial parameter setting through the fire-fighting simulation software; and (3) importing the set building physical model, the determined grid model, the set fire scene and the set fire initial parameters into a fire-fighting dynamic simulator, and accurately predicting and analyzing the motion, the temperature and the toxic gas concentration of the smoke in the fire. The invention can simulate and demonstrate the evacuation scheme in advance and conduct targeted optimization adjustment on the scheme, and an optimal escape route is established, so that the simulation is vivid and visual, and the expression effect is more direct.
assignees: NANTONG MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire prevention multilayer early warning and monitoring system and method applying big data technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire prevention multilayer early warning and monitoring system and a method applying big data technology, and relates to the field of forest fire prevention, wherein the forest fire prevention multilayer early warning and monitoring system comprises Lin Yu monitoring modules, environment early warning modules and aerial photo monitoring modules; the Lin Yu monitoring module simulates human activity tracks, arranges alarm monitoring devices according to different forest farm characteristics, and performs unified management, so that monitoring equipment maintains a working state, fire hazards caused by human activity are monitored to the maximum extent, a condensed object is identified by images, and personnel are arranged to patrol, so that object condensation and fire are avoided; the environment early warning module carries out early warning aiming at the high-temperature drought and strong wind situation by utilizing weather forecast information and combining with actual conditions in a forest farm, and sets early warning grades according to the spreading range after fire occurrence; the aerial photography monitoring module calculates the range and intensity of dense smoke according to aerial photography images, designs disaster relief lines and arranges personnel evacuation.

title_en: Disaster damage prediction model construction method, disaster damage prediction method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster damage prediction model construction method, a disaster damage prediction device and disaster damage prediction equipment. The disaster damage prediction model construction method comprises the following steps: determining n disaster critical features from m disaster features corresponding to disaster damage fault data; sub-disaster damage fault data corresponding to n disaster critical features are extracted to be used as a disaster sample data set, and the disaster sample data set comprises a training set; extracting t disaster sample sub-data which are put back from the training set as data samples to generate h training subsets; generating decision trees corresponding to each training subset based on a plurality of disaster critical features in each training subset and a plurality of sub disaster damage fault data in each training subset to obtain h decision trees; and constructing a random forest model based on the h decision trees to obtain a disaster damage prediction model. The invention can improve the disaster damage prediction efficiency and ensure the accuracy of disaster damage prediction.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing image change detection method based on fixed point number quantification
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing image change detection method with fixed point number quantification, which mainly solves the problems that the prior art lacks consideration of boundary information, the loss function lacks importance on a change image pair, and the calculation is slow. The implementation scheme of the method comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing images, carrying out mean value subtraction and normalization pretreatment on the remote sensing images, dividing a training set and a testing set, designing parameters comprising quantized bit widths and batch normalization layers based on the existing convolution layers to form fixed-point quantized convolution layers, constructing a remote sensing change detection model by using the fixed-point quantized convolution layers, training the fixed-point quantized change detection model, and obtaining image classification results by using a trained fixed-point quantized change detection network. The invention effectively improves the accuracy of the image change detection result by constructing a new remote sensing change detection model, reduces the time required by operation in a network by designing the fixed-point quantitative convolution layer, and can be applied to vegetation coverage analysis, urban planning, land resource management and disaster assessment.

title_en: Flood disaster defense deduction method, system, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a flood disaster prevention deduction method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of flood disaster deduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining basic geographic data and wanted edit data of a target area; the method comprises the steps of presetting a disaster analysis model, carrying out data analysis on basic geographic data and wanted editing data according to the disaster analysis model to obtain a model analysis result, judging whether the target area needs to be subjected to rescue according to the model analysis result, if so, generating a rescue plan according to the model analysis result, carrying out rescue deduction on the target area according to the rescue plan, and carrying out dynamic virtual simulation on the rescue deduction to obtain a deduction result, and analyzing the deduction result to obtain a deduction result analysis report. The application has the effect of improving the control of flood disasters.

title_en: Mountain fire disaster simulation experiment table for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountain fire disaster simulation experiment table for a power transmission line, which comprises a mountain fire simulation system, an external environment simulation system and an information acquisition system. The mountain fire simulation system of the power transmission line is used for researching the influence condition of parameters of mountain slope, angle and vegetation types on the power transmission line in the mountain fire spreading process; the external environment simulation system is used for simulating the influence of external environment wind, environment humidity and environment temperature on the mountain fire disaster development process of the power transmission line; the information acquisition system is used for recording key characteristic parameters of the forest fire in the spreading process so as to quantify the influence degree of the forest fire on the power transmission line under different environment parameters. The invention has scientific and reasonable structural design, comprehensive functions, good simulation effect and low manufacturing cost, can fully meet the mountain fire disaster simulation requirement of the power transmission line, and provides theoretical basis for safe power transmission.

title_en: Urban flood disaster risk studying and judging method based on scene simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for studying and judging urban flood disaster risk based on scene simulation, belongs to the technical field of disaster risk assessment, and solves the technical problems of strong weight subjectivity, low result accuracy and insufficient result pertinence in the prior art. S1, carrying out probability distribution analysis by adopting a Copula function, and establishing a multi-combination scene of flood peak, flood volume and flood duration of each main flow and branch flow under various flood combinations by combining with the actual conditions of a research area; s2, establishing a two-dimensional coupling flood model, and carrying out simulation analysis on the flood evolution process; s3, constructing indexes, extracting the indexes to an evaluation unit, and performing standardization treatment; s4, subjective weight and objective weight are calculated, and then combination weight is calculated; s5, calculating comprehensive risk, and finally dividing flood risk grades. The urban flood disaster risk studying and judging method based on the scene simulation can be better used for studying and judging the risk of the urban flood disasters, so that the risk of the urban flood disasters is effectively reduced.
assignees: SICHUAN SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE;SICHUAN ANXIN KECHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and training method capable of realizing search and rescue training under multiple working conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method capable of realizing search and rescue training under multiple working conditions, wherein the device comprises a living space module, a limiting device, replaceable broken and detached components, a ladder stand and an openable cover plate, the living space module is provided with a ceiling and walls extending downwards from four sides of the ceiling, reserved broken and detached holes are formed in the living space module, the limiting device is fixedly or detachably connected to the two opposite sides of each reserved broken and detached hole, the replaceable broken and detached components are correspondingly arranged outside each reserved broken and detached hole of the living space module, the lower part of the living space module is connected with an underground space through the openable cover plate, and the ladder stand is arranged below the underground space corresponding to the openable cover plate. According to the invention, through realizing the shape adjustment of the building ruins, flexible replacement of broken components and diversified arrangement of searching scenes, the restoration degree of the searching and rescuing scenes after disaster is improved, and the flexibility requirement of searching and rescuing training is met.

title_en: Screen display communication control method and device, 5G firefighting intercom mobile phone and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a screen display communication control method, a device, a 5G fire-fighting intercom mobile phone and a medium, and relates to the technical field of production detection, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing image information and real-time image information, preprocessing the remote sensing image information to obtain spectrum image information, inputting the spectrum image information into a classification model for training to obtain engineering image information and labeling vector information, correspondingly binding the labeling vector information with the engineering image information to obtain a labeling vector file, carrying out vector grid conversion processing on the labeling vector file, taking image pixel values and the engineering image information as training samples, carrying out feature fusion processing on the training samples to obtain edge fusion features, training a preset network model based on the edge fusion features to obtain a trained identification network model, and inputting the real-time image information into the trained identification network model for training to obtain waste slag field identification information. The method and the device have the effect of improving the identification efficiency of the waste slag field.
assignees: LI XUEGUANG;SHENZHEN AOQI OPTICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground traffic facility evacuation path decision method, system and equipment in flood environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation, in particular to a method, a system and equipment for deciding an evacuation path of underground traffic facilities in a flood environment, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a node passing time prediction model by using a BP neural network algorithm, and calculating to obtain the time of a passenger passing through a gate, a stair and/or a node of an escalator; s2: based on the time prediction model in the step S1, calculating the total evacuation time, the total evacuation risk and the total crowding degree of passengers in the flood environment by using an objective function, constructing a multi-objective optimization model of the passenger evacuation path, and determining a recommended passenger evacuation route; s3: building an underground traffic facility evacuation simulation system in a flood environment by using simulation software for truly simulating pedestrian movement, fusing the multi-objective optimization model of the passenger evacuation path in the step S2, simulating the evacuation escape behavior of passengers, and evaluating the safety of an evacuation optimization strategy. Compared with the prior art, the time prediction result is more accurate and rapid, and a data basis is provided for the calculation of the total evacuation time.

title_en: Fire evacuation planning method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire evacuation planning method and a system based on a digital twin technology, which belong to the technical field of fire evacuation and comprise the following steps: building a building digital twin model, and inputting the position information of each sensor in the building into the building digital twin model; acquiring a current combustion range and a combustion range expansion speed, and simulating a combustion spreading trend in a building digital twin model; acquiring a smoke drifting direction and a smoke drifting speed, and simulating a smoke drifting trend in a digital twin model of the building; judging the dangerous grade of each safety channel in each period; the application simulates the escape situation of personnel in the building digital twin model and carries out evacuation planning and guiding according to the simulation result.

title_en: Database disaster recovery switching exercise method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a database disaster recovery switching exercise method, a database disaster recovery switching exercise device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: adding asset information of DB2 database production and disaster recovery sides; identifying disaster tolerance pairs according to the characteristic information of the DB2 main and standby ends; selecting a plan type, and arranging the drill plan by combining disaster tolerance pairs to obtain an arranging result; carrying out plan evaluation on the arrangement result; and when the plan evaluation passes, disaster recovery switching exercise is performed on the arrangement result. By implementing the method of the embodiment of the invention, the production and disaster recovery databases can be switched normally during the disaster recovery switching exercise, various error problems caused by misoperation and other factors in the manual mode switching process are avoided, RTO is reduced, service interruption time is shortened, RPO is ensured to meet design requirements, and data is ensured not to be lost.

title_en: Real-time monitoring instrument for roadway surrounding rock stress dynamic change
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of mine exploitation disaster monitoring, in particular to a real-time monitoring instrument for dynamic change of roadway surrounding rock stress. A real-time monitoring instrument for dynamic change of surrounding rock stress of a roadway comprises surrounding rock stress monitoring equipment and a data acquisition device, wherein the surrounding rock stress monitoring equipment is correspondingly inserted into a drill hole near the coal wall side of a working face of the roadway, and the surrounding rock stress monitoring equipment is in signal connection with the data acquisition device. The utility model can accurately monitor and real-time monitor the stress condition of the surrounding rock of the roadway, furthest improves the monitoring force, can be reused, and reduces the cost of monitoring equipment.

title_en: Test device for multi-physical field coupling simulation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a test device for multi-physical field coupling simulation, which also comprises a vibration table array component, a rainfall component and a landslide component; the vibrating table array assembly comprises a double-step-shaped body, a first vibrating table and a second vibrating table, wherein the first vibrating table is arranged on the bottom step of the double-step-shaped body, and the second vibrating table is arranged on the top step of the double-step-shaped body; the rainfall assembly comprises a water tank and a water pump; the landslide system comprises a soil box arranged on the second vibrating table, an adjustable slope bottom arranged at the bottom of the soil box and a landslide body lapped on the first vibrating table and the second vibrating table. The test device for the multi-physical-field coupling simulation can simulate disasters such as earthquake, rainfall, landslide and the like at the same time, and is compact and reasonable in structural arrangement and convenient to control.

title_en: Fire control air respirator face guard that can monitor firefighter breathing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire air respirator mask capable of monitoring the breath of a firefighter, which comprises the following components: the positive pressure type fire-fighting air respirator mask body, the air suction valve and the exhalation valve capable of monitoring respiratory information are further included, and the exhalation valve is arranged on the positive pressure type fire-fighting air respirator mask body. The fire-fighting air respirator mask provided by the utility model can reliably monitor the breathing state of a firefighter in a scene of the firefighter wearing operation training.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Drilling device for ground disaster investigation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drilling device for ground disaster investigation, which comprises a box body and is characterized in that: the top bolted connection of box inner wall has a shear type support frame, the top bolted connection of box inner wall has hydraulic pressure ejector pin, hydraulic pressure ejector pin and shear type support frame looks adaptation, the bottom of shear type support frame and hydraulic pressure ejector pin is provided with big motor, the transmission shaft welding of big motor bottom has the drill bit. The drilling device for ground disaster investigation provided by the utility model has the advantages that the self-cleaning device can effectively reduce the frequency of manual cleaning, improve the working efficiency of equipment, ensure that the sample sampled by each drilling cannot be polluted by drill bit residues, ensure the accuracy of the test result and further improve the working efficiency. Adopt scissors support frame and hydraulic ram matched with elevating gear, compare in traditional elevating gear, efficiency is higher down force is bigger, when meetting complicated geology or hard ground, the probing efficiency is higher.
assignees: SHENYANG BUILDING MAT GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIGATION INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Coalbed gas pressurize sampling instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coalbed methane pressure-maintaining sampling tool in the technical field of coal mine methane disaster prevention and control, which comprises a drill rod connected with a main head, wherein one side of the inside of the drill rod connected with the main head is provided with a main sleeve, the inside of the main sleeve is provided with a power supply battery, the position of the inside of the main sleeve, which is close to one side, is provided with a sampling port, the lower end of the sampling port is provided with a rotary blade, and the position of the upper end of the sampling port, which is positioned in the main sleeve, is provided with a rubber one-way door; an outer dustproof wire gauze, an outer door plate, a disc-shaped reed, a round rubber pad, a vent and a drill rod with Kong Guangmian are arranged on one side of the main sleeve, the vent is arranged on one side of the main sleeve, the drill rod with Kong Guangmian is positioned outside the main sleeve, the main sleeve is connected with the drill rod with the smooth surface with holes through the disc-shaped reed, and the outer door plate is positioned on one side of the inner part of the main sleeve, so that the sealing of the head position of the sampling barrel is realized; the utility model has simple structure, simple electric appliance control structure, convenient operation and shortened sampling time.

title_en: AR-based simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of simulation training and discloses an AR-based simulation training system, which comprises: selecting proper AR virtual reality equipment and selecting proper simulation sites, detecting the AR virtual reality equipment, selecting a flat outdoor site for practical combat drilling of the AR virtual equipment, detecting the service condition of the AR virtual equipment, utilizing the corresponding simulation scene of the AR virtual reality equipment component according to the post corresponding content of the emergency response personnel, and simulating the scale of the emergency response personnel according to the selection of the simulation scene. The application of the AR technology enables participators to have a feeling of being personally on the scene, can reflect the damage of the emergency to the personnel to the greatest extent, and reduces the damage to the personnel when the emergency really occurs through drilling, so that the people can understand how to deal with the emergency and know how to deal with the emergency, avoid serious trampling events, and improve the capability of the people to deal with the emergency.
assignees: SHAANXI DIANKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind turbine generator meteorological disaster early warning method and system based on prediction deviation optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind turbine meteorological disaster early warning method and system based on prediction deviation optimization, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data of a measuring point of a wind turbine; training a first wind speed analysis model; acquiring first prediction data of the wind speed based on a trained first wind speed analysis model; acquiring wind speed data of a current measuring point and a neighborhood measuring point; analyzing the correlation characteristics of the wind speeds of the current measuring point and the neighborhood measuring point; acquiring second prediction data of the wind speed of the current measuring point based on the correlation characteristics and future prediction data of the wind speed of the neighborhood measuring point; and fusing the first prediction data and the second prediction data as wind speed optimization prediction data of the wind turbine generator. The method effectively improves the accuracy of wind speed prediction of the wind turbine generator, avoids the risk of meteorological disasters on the wind turbine generator, improves the operation efficiency of the wind turbine generator and prolongs the service life of the wind turbine generator.
assignees: ANHUI NATIONAL POWER INVESTMENT AND NEW POWER TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: BP network-based intelligent disaster prevention assessment and decision method for flexible city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness city intelligent disaster prevention assessment and decision method based on a BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: (1) Data acquisition and arrangement are carried out, and a flexible city intelligent disaster prevention evaluation index system is constructed; (2) An optimal combination weight is obtained through combination weighting calculation by adopting a subjective and objective combination method; (3) Establishing a flexible city disaster prevention evaluation model of the BP neural network and training and verifying; (4) Calculating a tough city disaster prevention evaluation result by adopting the trained BP neural network evaluation model; (5) Grading the disaster prevention evaluation result, issuing early warning information of corresponding grades, and taking emergency measures according to the early warning information; the method comprehensively considers evaluation indexes, calculates the optimal combination weight of the evaluation indexes by an objective and subjective combination method, and trains and tests by adopting a BP neural network, so that the evaluation result is more accurate; and by dividing the disaster prevention level of the flexible city and issuing early warning information, the intelligent decision of the disaster prevention of the flexible city is realized.

title_en: Method, system, device and medium for optimizing crowd evacuation route of high-speed rail station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a device and a medium for optimizing crowd evacuation routes of high-speed railway stations, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring layout information of a high-speed rail station, and representing the scene of the high-speed rail station as a complete graph according to the layout information; screening edges in the complete graph according to preset screening conditions; according to the screened complete graph, representing the design problem of the crowd evacuation facility layout of the high-speed rail station as an optimization problem for solving the multidimensional binary coding vector; obtaining historical people stream data of the high-speed rail station, constructing a simulation model of a scene of the high-speed rail station according to the historical people stream data and optimization problems, and optimizing the simulation model through a discrete competitive particle swarm algorithm to obtain a final crowd evacuation route. The method abstractly simplifies the design of the crowd flow guiding facility into an optimization problem for solving, adopts the competitive particle swarm optimization for optimization, can better solve the layout optimization problem of crowd leading facilities in the high-speed rail station, and can be widely applied to the two fields of system simulation and intelligent calculation.

title_en: Underground coal seam gas fixed-point sampling device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to an underground coal seam gas fixed-point sampling device which comprises a standard drill rod combination and a sampling drill rod arranged at the tail end or in the middle of the standard drill rod combination, wherein a sampling opening is formed in the side wall of a planer tool opening smooth surface drill rod, a sliding door moving mechanism and a crank baffle mechanism are arranged at the sampling opening, and a throw-out prevention type sampling barrel is arranged inside the planer tool opening smooth surface drill rod. The coal sample collection device is reasonable in structural design, coal sample collection is carried out in a closed environment, the loss of the gas content in the coal sample is avoided, the sum of the field gas desorption amount of the coal sample and the residual gas desorption amount of the coal sample measured in a laboratory is calculated to obtain the gas content of the coal sample, the coal sample collection device is simple to operate, high in applicability, simple and convenient to maintain, safe and efficient, the coal sample is collected while a drill rod is drilled, the coal sample can be guaranteed to be in a closed state in the collection process, the gas loss in the coal sample is avoided, and the accuracy of detecting the gas condition in the underground coal mine is effectively improved.

title_en: Urban distribution network disaster tolerance assessment method based on knowledge-data drive rainstorm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a knowledge-data-driven urban distribution network disaster-bearing capacity assessment method under rainstorm, which comprises the following steps: establishing a rainstorm intensity calculation model, a rainfall process calculation model and a runoff converging model of the selected research area according to rainfall historical data of the selected research area; forming a line interruption prediction model according to the static data and the dynamic data of the selected research area; establishing occurrence probability models of rainstorms in different reappearance periods; substituting the heavy-duty period of rainstorm occurring in the current simulation into a rainstorm intensity calculation model, a rainfall process calculation model and a runoff generating convergence model to respectively obtain corresponding calculation results; evaluating the rainstorm disaster-bearing capacity of the power distribution network of the selected research area according to the total number of line interruptions obtained by multiple times of simulation; the method has the advantages of simplicity, feasibility, good implementability, dynamic simulation of the flooding process, and improvement of prediction performance and interpretability.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-AMR intelligent scheduling optimization method based on variable resolution reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-AMR intelligent scheduling optimization method based on variable resolution reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of intelligent scheduling, and is characterized in that a map is built for scheduling environments, different pixel values are given to different objects in the map, map segmentation is performed based on a quadtree algorithm to obtain a variable resolution map, a decision model for multi-AMR path planning is built, the decision model comprises states, actions, rewards and state transition probabilities, the states refer to positions, the positions are represented by map blocks, path planning is performed according to a Q-learning algorithm and the decision model, and the multi-AMR is controlled to reach a target position on the variable resolution map. The invention solves the problem of dimension disaster caused by excessive reinforcement learning space information when the scheduling environment map is large, and improves the training efficiency of the traditional reinforcement learning.

title_en: Digital analog simulation prediction system and method based on semi-closed space sudden disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital analog simulation prediction system and method based on a semi-closed space sudden disaster, which comprises the following steps: the data source layer is a data layer constructed based on a multi-source channel and is imported into the data source layer through a sensor data interface, an urban wide area data interface, a place data interface and an environment data interface; the data processing layer receives data from the data source layer and collects, updates, integrates and governs the data in the data source layer; the algorithm model layer is used for constructing a semi-closed disaster influence algorithm model based on data provided by the data processing layer; and the display layer is used for constructing a disaster spreading simulation process based on the semi-closed disaster influence algorithm model and displaying the simulation process through a data visualization technology. The method refines and classifies the elements from different directions such as environment types, building types, use types and the like, and realizes the construction of a precise model.

title_en: Multifunctional expanding type cooking shelter vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional expanding type cooking shelter vehicle which comprises a chassis and a carriage arranged on the chassis, wherein one side of the carriage is provided with an expanding cabin in a sliding manner and used for being unfolded outwards in a sliding manner, and the other side of the carriage is provided with a wing opening door, so that the expanding cabin and the wing opening door can be unfolded singly or simultaneously to form a semi-closed or fully-closed operation space. The invention can provide dietary logistics support for field training, rescuing and camping of firefighters, has comprehensive functions, adopts a single-side wing-opening door and a single-side cabin expanding structure, has strong environmental adaptability, saves human resources, reduces floor area and is very suitable for logistics support work of fire rescue and troops for exercise.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHENXIANG VEHICLE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Emergent device of experiencing of grid accident simulation processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid accident simulation disposal emergency experience device which comprises a flood experience module, a natural debris flow experience module and a natural ice disaster experience module, wherein the flood experience module and the natural debris flow experience module are arranged on the left indoor side, the natural ice disaster experience module (3) is arranged on the right indoor side, the flood experience module is used for experiencing flood, the natural debris flow experience module is used for experiencing debris flow, and the natural ice disaster experience module is used for experiencing ice disaster. The invention aims at various emergency rescue personnel of a company to carry out disaster experience and emergency skill training, can enable the trained personnel to experience the destructiveness and the dangerousness of ice disasters, floods, debris flows and other natural disasters of the Guizhou power grid in the scene, is familiar with the disaster environment, learns self-rescue knowledge, masters emergency skills, improves the emergency quality of all personnel, and lays a good foundation for the subsequent various field emergency actual combat drills.

title_en: Ultra-soft coal seam high-pressure air-carrying progressive injection coal breaking and permeability increasing device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for breaking coal and increasing permeability by carrying high-pressure air with a feed in an extremely soft coal bed and spraying the high-pressure air with the feed in a progressive manner, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster treatment. The device is provided with a male connector and a female connector at two ends, a piston moving along the axial direction is arranged in an inner cavity, a low-pressure gas channel communicated with a drill bit and a high-pressure gas channel connected with a wing plate along the periphery of the cavity wall is arranged, a hollow shaft pin is drilled on the wing plate, a drainage nozzle in the high-pressure gas jet channel sucks coal dust through a sieve pore, and high-pressure air carries materials to be sprayed progressively through a conical nozzle. The invention generates compressed air through the air compressor and the high-pressure gas cylinder, the compressed air enters the device and the drill bit, low-pressure gas is adopted for cooling and deslagging during drilling, high-pressure gas is switched to push the wing bit to rotate and open to implement mechanical cave creation during breaking coal, and high-pressure gas carries materials to carry out progressive injection to break coal. The method can effectively solve the problem that the underground extremely soft coal seam of the coal mine cannot adopt conventional hydraulic measures to relieve pressure and increase permeability, thereby realizing the efficient extraction of coal seam gas and ensuring the safety production of coal mine enterprises.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Low-voltage alternating current arc fault diagnosis method fusing multidimensional characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage alternating current arc fault diagnosis method fusing multidimensional characteristics, and relates to the technical field of power systems; the method comprises the following steps: extracting n fault characteristics from the arc fault electrical quantity signals of the m scene samples, and extracting time domain characteristics and frequency domain characteristics; constructing a corresponding transient characteristic matrix and a corresponding steady-state characteristic matrix according to the time sequence of the time domain characteristic and the frequency domain characteristic; constructing a known environment parameter set, a correlation coefficient matrix and a sensitivity coefficient matrix; screening out features larger than or equal to a correlation threshold value and screening out features with sensitivity coefficients smaller than a sensitivity threshold value to obtain a dominant feature set; establishing a regression model, obtaining a predicted value of the steady-state arc fault current and calculating a prediction error; and taking the time sequence signal with the steady-state characteristic as the input of the LSTM network, carrying out model training and calculation, and judging whether a fault occurs or not according to the calculation error and the output value of the LSTM network. The invention solves the problem of characteristic dimension disaster during low-voltage arc fault diagnosis.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Centrifugal test device for steady-state flow of rock-soil particles and application method of centrifugal test device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centrifugal test device for steady-state flow of rock and soil particles and a use method thereof, comprising a test device, the device comprises a storage and feeding assembly, a chute assembly arranged on one side of the storage and feeding assembly, a sample recovery assembly arranged on one side of the chute assembly, and a gate control assembly arranged on one side of the storage and feeding assembly. The invention has the beneficial effects that the storage and feeding assembly, the chute assembly and the sample recovery assembly are matched, so that a technical blank in the field of physical simulation of geological disasters, particularly in the field of centrifugal simulation of landslide debris flow is filled, the flow speed is controlled by the gate control assembly, steady-state flow simulation of rock-soil particles under the condition of weak centrifugation Kelvin can be realized, the steady-state flow simulation of rock-soil particles under the condition of similar centrifugation law can be verified, the steady-state flow simulation of rock-soil particles under different centrifugation-Kelvin composite fields can be realized, and the influence of Coriolis effect on the centrifugal simulation result of landslide debris flow can be evaluated.

title_en: Slope rolling stone disaster protection discrete element simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of simulation of a side slope rolling stone disaster, in particular to a discrete element simulation method for protection of the side slope rolling stone disaster, which greatly improves the effective protection capability of the side slope rolling stone disaster. The invention discloses a slope rolling stone disaster protection discrete element simulation method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out discrete element simulation on different types of rolling stones; discrete element simulation is carried out on the side slope with different stone rolling disasters; discrete element simulation is carried out on different preset passive protective nets; and analyzing the bounce process and the speed change process of the rolling stones. The invention is suitable for protecting the side slope rockfall disaster.

title_en: Remote sensing simulation method for heavy construction cost of flood peak flood disaster bearing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy load cost remote sensing simulation method for a river basin type storm flood, which comprises the steps of collecting time sequence remote sensing data, meteorological index data, underlying surface risk exposure data, storm flood disaster loss and other data, extracting parameter characteristics such as flood inundation, storm weather disaster, underlying surface disaster bearing body risk exposure and the like by adopting methods such as threshold segmentation, space superposition, data aggregation and the like, constructing a heavy parameter characteristic set of the storm flood disaster bearing body, and unifying the heavy parameter characteristic set to a 30m resolution grid; according to flood insurance nuclear disaster data and field sampling party history research data, a 30m spatial resolution disaster-bearing heavy weight cost sample set is constructed based on a spatial statistical analysis method, a storm flood disaster-bearing heavy weight parameter characteristic set and a disaster-bearing heavy weight cost sample set are utilized, and extracting a heavy weight cost loss training parameter feature vector of the storm flood disaster-bearing body, and constructing a simulation model by adopting a deep learning neural network model to realize the heavy weight cost space simulation of the river basin storm flood disaster-bearing body.

title_en: Mine dynamic disaster prevention and control method based on long drilling
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine dynamic disaster prevention and control method based on long drill holes, and belongs to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of judging the type of the composite dynamic disaster of a mine according to dynamic events and the evaluation of the risk of each dynamic disaster of the mine, and determining key influence factors of the composite dynamic disaster and areas needing to take pretreatment measures; designing a coal rock structure regulation scheme by combining mine production technical conditions and actual geological conditions, and determining construction parameters of continuous long drilling; the permeability of the gas-containing stratum is increased by the directional long drilling hole construction hydraulic fracturing technology for the gas-containing stratum, and gas and outburst risks are reduced; the aquifer is drilled through the directional long drill holes, and the stress concentration stratification degree of the aquifer, the water hazard risk and the like are reduced. The method can realize multi-level and large-space continuous operation, realize multi-purpose of one hole, and simultaneously solve the problem of excessive pressure relief of partial areas on the premise of carrying out multi-level regulation and pressure relief on the mine composite power disaster.

title_en: Reservoir landslide surge numerical simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir landslide surge numerical simulation method and a reservoir landslide surge numerical simulation system, which relate to the technical field of slope simulation analysis, and have the technical scheme that: acquiring topographic data before and after occurrence of reservoir landslide and surge disasters, and constructing a geometric model; dividing a reservoir flow field area by utilizing OpenFOAM software, and configuring fluid physical mechanical parameters; establishing a bank slope model on the geometric model by using LIGGGHTS software, and configuring physical and mechanical parameters and particle grading of particles according to physical properties of the bank slope rock-soil mass; performing analog simulation on the bank slope model by a CFDEM coupling method to obtain a simulation calculation result; and analyzing the simulation calculation result to obtain the slope movement process, the surge height and/or the influence range. According to the invention, through the coupling of the CFD method and the DEM method, the coupling effect among landslide bodies, reservoir water and air is fully considered, and two reservoir landslide and surge modes of granular break and dangerous rock collapse can be simulated.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD;CHENGDU SHANDI HUANAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind pressure type of haptic firefighting nozzle interface for virtual fire-fighting training and operating method thereof
abstract_en: A wind pressure type of haptic firefighting nozzle interface that is interworked with virtual reality (VR) content for virtual firefighting training is provided. The wind pressure type of haptic firefighting nozzle interface includes: a flow controller for adjusting a spraying intensity of water sprayed on the VR content; a stream shaper for adjusting a spray shape according to a radiation angle of the water sprayed on the VR content; and at least one first haptic device for providing haptic feedback corresponding to the spraying intensity and the spraying shape determined according to control through the flow controller and the stream shaper using wind pressure.

title_en: Railway geological disaster sensitivity space-time prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a railway geological disaster sensitivity space-time prediction method and a railway geological disaster sensitivity space-time prediction system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining related data of the China railway track and geological disaster historical events of the China railway track; dividing the geological disaster influencing factors of the Chinese railway line into dynamic influencing factors and static influencing factors; converting the historical events of the geological disasters of the Chinese railway line into point data by spatialization, randomly generating 2 times of sample points without the geological disasters, generating event sample points according to the point data and the sample points, extracting corresponding dynamic influence factors to the event sample points, and synthesizing a feature matrix; training and testing a random forest model by utilizing a feature matrix, and determining a geological disaster sensitivity evaluation model; and carrying out China railway geological disaster sensitivity prediction on the real-time data and the rainfall prediction data obtained according to the GEE platform by adopting a geological disaster sensitivity evaluation model. The method can improve accuracy of railway geological disaster sensitivity space-time prediction.

title_en: Power distribution network reactive power optimization method based on depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network reactive power optimization method based on a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, which comprises the steps of constructing a power distribution network reactive power optimization model, wherein the power distribution network reactive power optimization model comprises a power flow calculation constraint model, a PV inverter and a BESs output model; describing the reactive power optimization model as a Markov decision process, and defining a state space, an action space and a reward function of the MDP; MDP solved using DDPG algorithm based on artificial neural network and decision maker-evaluator architecture; and training the DDPG intelligent agent by using the real historical operation data of the distribution network in a certain region, then deploying the trained intelligent agent on line, and setting different PV permeabilities to verify the effect of the trained intelligent agent. The method provided by the invention approximates the Q function by using the Q network based on the ANN, avoids the dimensional disasters of states and actions, and can well utilize the distributed resources of PV and BESs to optimize the power distribution network.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent targeted extraction system for coal bed gas
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mine gas disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to an intelligent targeted drainage system for coal seam gas. The system comprises a basic parameter statistics module, an extraction target area dividing module, a drilling parameter calculation module, a pipe network data real-time acquisition module and an extraction negative pressure allocation module, wherein the basic parameter statistics module is used for representing position coordinates of a recovery working face and gas information into a two-dimensional visual plane model, the extraction target area dividing module is used for dividing extraction units of the two-dimensional visual plane model of gas parameters of the recovery working face, the drilling parameter calculation module is used for carrying out drilling parameter calculation on drilling layout parameters of three areas of the recovery working face and drawing a drilling layout diagram of the recovery working face, the pipe network data real-time acquisition module is used for acquiring concentration and flow of gas in each extraction pipeline and each concentration pipeline in real time, and the extraction negative pressure allocation module is used for controlling the negative pressure of the concentration pipeline and allocating the negative pressure of the extraction pipelines by adjusting the power of the extraction pump and the opening and closing degree of an electromagnetic control valve.

title_en: Fire detection method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire detection method and a fire detection system based on unmanned aerial vehicle edge calculation, which belong to the technical field of target detection and comprise the following steps: collecting image data of a target detection area and flight state data of the unmanned aerial vehicle; inputting the target detection area image data and the unmanned aerial vehicle flight state data into a pre-trained fire detection model to obtain a fire ignition point detection result; the fire detection model is obtained by constructing an edge calculation deep learning model framework based on a Yolov3 algorithm and training the edge calculation deep learning model framework by adopting a target detection area image sample and a classification label. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle shoots and acquires the detection image of the target area, and the Yolov3 algorithm is adopted to carry out deep learning edge detection processing, so that the position information of the fire disaster can be rapidly and accurately detected, and the intelligent and efficient detection method has the advantages of intelligence and high efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle image and deep learning-based wheat lodging area estimation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wheat lodging area estimation method based on unmanned aerial vehicle images and deep learning, which comprises the following steps: collecting wheat Tian Tuxiang by an unmanned aerial vehicle; preprocessing and data enhancement are carried out; constructing a deep learning model, improving the Mask R-CNN model, evaluating by adopting an evaluation index, and adjusting training parameters; inputting the wheat Tian Tuxiang to be evaluated into an optimal Mask R-CNN model, and outputting the number of lodging pixels of the wheat by the optimal Mask R-CNN model; and obtaining an estimation result of the actual lodging area of the wheat based on the number of the pixel points lodged by the wheat and the actual area represented by the single pixel calculated by the calibration area. According to the invention, the wheat lodging area is accurately identified and segmented, and the number of pixels of the lodging area is calculated, so that the area of the wheat lodging area is calculated, the disaster degree is estimated, the high-flux operation requirement in the wheat field environment can be met, and technical support is provided for subsequent disaster treatment and loss estimation.
assignees: CAS HEFEI SMART AGRICULTURE COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Research and development type building multi-combustible fire coupling result evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a research and development type building multi-combustible fire coupling result evaluation method, which belongs to the technical field of building risk evaluation and specifically comprises the following steps of: summarizing synergistic effect events of the research and development type building, wherein the synergistic effect events comprise two synergistic effect events of visibility reduction and poison leakage caused by fire; qualitative description of synergistic effect events, namely two synergistic effects of visibility reduction and poison leakage caused by fire disaster; quantitatively analyzing the synergistic effect of the multiple combustible fire accidents of the developed building; and constructing a Monte Carlo simulation model, and analyzing the fire coupling accident results of the multiple combustibles of the developed building. The invention constructs the coupling result evaluation model capable of realizing the coupling result evaluation of different combustible fire and toxic substance leakage accidents of the research-type building, realizes the accurate evaluation of the research-type building fire result, and has very important practical significance for planning the research-type building intrinsically safe layout and guiding the research-type building emergency evacuation.

title_en: Automatic monitoring equipment for geological disaster displacement in canyon
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, in particular to automatic monitoring equipment for geological disaster displacement in canyons, which comprises symmetrically arranged frame bodies, wherein ground nails are fixedly arranged on one side of each frame body, and the automatic monitoring equipment also comprises; a hoisting mechanism connected with the frame body; the deep seam measuring mechanism is connected with the hoisting mechanism and comprises a shell fixedly connected with the hoisting mechanism, linear positioning structures are symmetrically arranged in the shell, one end of each linear positioning structure is rotatably provided with a sliding structure, each sliding structure comprises a rotating frame rotatably connected with the corresponding linear positioning structure, a sliding seat is slidably arranged in each rotating frame, a first spring is arranged between each sliding seat and each rotating frame, and each sliding seat is provided with a drilling nail structure; and a wireless communication module connected with the housing. When the inner wall of the crack moves relatively, the sliding structure provides displacement compensation for the movement of the drilling nail structure, so that the bending of the straight line positioning structure is avoided.
assignees: NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT

title_en: Multifunctional soil tensile strength test device considering hydro-thermal coupling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional soil tensile strength test device considering water-heat coupling, which comprises: the device comprises a special-shaped tension box, a cold bath disc, a liquid nitrogen container, a liquid inlet pipe, balls, a temperature and humidity test box, a base, a double-shaft angle adjusting bracket, a U-shaped rod and a soil body stretching device, wherein the double-shaft angle adjusting bracket is arranged at the bottom of the base, the balls are arranged above the base, the special-shaped tension box with the cold bath disc is arranged on the balls, and the cold bath disc is connected with the liquid nitrogen container through the liquid inlet pipe; the temperature and humidity test box is arranged on the base, and the special-shaped tension box is positioned in the temperature and humidity test box; the special-shaped tension box is embedded in the opening of the U-shaped rod, and the tail of the U-shaped rod is connected with the soil body stretching device.
