The utility model improves the traditional horizontal soil tensile strength test device from the tension box and the device structure to simulate and research the stability of the frozen soil slope, and provides accurate tensile strength values for the disaster prevention and reduction problems of the channel slope.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY;NANJING JIANGBEI PUBLIC CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Building Wind Environment Observation System
title_ko: 빌딩풍 풍환경 관측시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a building wind environment observation system. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a building wind environment observation system comprises: a data collection unit transmitting data acquired by applying real-time weather service data collected through an analysis of protocol of the weather service to a wind tunnel experiment device simulating the topography and buildings of a region to be observed by a monitoring unit; the monitoring unit generating a data platform by using the weather service data collected through the analysis of protocol of the weather service as well as building wind environment data received from the data collection unit, and performing an analysis through a building wind simulation for a computation fluid interpretation by using the generated data platform; and a building wind risk information map generation unit generating a building wind danger information map by using risk prediction data and building a wind data chart in accordance with the results analyzed by the monitoring unit, and storing and visualizing the analysis results and the building wind risk information map, and displaying the information to a user through a display or an application. According to the present invention, a building wind environment observation system can be provided, which is able to precisely predict building wind environment data, which are needed to construct a building wind risk information map through a multi-purpose building wind environment monitoring system which allows a user to effectively deal with an emergency which can occur in city centers such as the prevention of disasters from building wind and forecasts and alerts for regions with danger of disasters as well as continuous examination and observation of weather and environment information, through a building model.
abstract_ko:
빌딩풍 풍환경 관측시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 빌딩풍 풍환경 관측시스템은, 관측대상 지역의 지형과 건물을 모사한 풍동실험장치에 기상청 프로토콜 분석을 통해 수집된 실시간 기상청 데이터를 적용하여 획득한 데이터를 모니터링부로 송신하는 데이터 수집부; 데이터 수집부로부터 수신 받은 빌딩풍 풍환경 데이터 및 기상청 프로토콜 분석을 통해 수집된 기상청 데이터를 이용하여 데이터 플랫폼을 생성하고, 생성된 데이터 플랫폼을 이용하여 전산 유체 해석을 위한 빌딩풍 시뮬레이션을 통해 분석하는 모니터링부; 및 모니터링부에서 분석된 결과에 따른 위험도 예측 데이터, 빌딩풍 데이터 차트를 이용하여 빌딩풍 위험 정보 지도를 생성하고, 분석 결과 및 빌딩풍 위험 정보 지도를 저장 및 시각화하여 디스플레이 또는 어플리케이션을 통해 사용자에게 나타내는 빌딩풍 위험 정보 지도 생성부;를 포함하는 것을 구성의 요지로 한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 연속적인 기상환경정보 조사 및 관측 뿐만 아니라 빌딩풍 재난재해 예방, 재해 위험 지역 예보, 경보 등과 같이 도심지에서 발생할 수 있는 긴급 상황에 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 하는 다목적 빌딩풍 풍환경 모니터링 체계를 통한 빌딩풍 위험 정보 지도를 구축하기 위해 필요한 빌딩풍 풍환경 데이터를 건물모형을 통해 정확히 예측할 수 있는 빌딩풍 풍환경 관측시스템을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: JK WINDENGINEERING;UNIV ULSAN FOUND IND COOP

title_en: Integrated disaster prevention system using digital twin model and fire simulation and operation method of the same
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 모델 및 화재 시뮬레이션을 이용한 통합 방재 시스템 및 이의 동작방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an integrated disaster prevention system comprises: a location detecting device for detecting locations of people in a building to generate location information; a route prediction device for tracking a movement route of the people on the basis of the location information detected by the location detecting device, and predicting a next movement route of the people; an evacuation route generating device for generating a plurality of evacuation routes by performing a fire simulation on the basis of at least one of the movement route, the next movement route, and virtual fire data; and a disaster prevention control device for controlling disaster prevention equipment in accordance with at least one of the evacuation routes when an actual fire occurs in the building. Therefore, an optimal evacuation route can be generated.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 통합 방재 시스템은, 건물 내 사람들의 위치를 감지하여 위치 정보를 생성하기 위한 위치 감지 장치; 상기 위치 감지 장치에 의해 감지된 상기 위치 정보를 기초로 상기 사람들의 이동 경로를 추적하며, 상기 사람들의 다음 이동 경로를 예측하기 위한 경로 예측 장치; 상기 이동 경로, 상기 다음 이동 경로 및 가상 화재 데이터 중 적어도 하나를 기초로 화재 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 복수의 대피 경로들을 생성하기 위한 대피 경로 생성 장치; 및 상기 건물 내에 실제 화재가 발생한 경우, 복수의 대피 경로들 중 적어도 하나에 따라 방재 설비를 제어하기 위한 방재 제어 장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Natural disaster risk assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a natural disaster risk assessment method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out grid division on a preset area comprising a plurality of counties to obtain a plurality of grid areas; constructing a first county node graph by taking each county in a region as a node; constructing node characteristics and risk labels of corresponding nodes in the first county node graph during each historical precipitation event to obtain a corresponding target node graph; training the pre-constructed model by using the target node graph to obtain a disaster assessment model; when the area encounters a precipitation event, constructing node characteristics of precipitation of each node of the first county node graph to obtain a current node graph; and performing risk assessment according to the current node graph and the disaster assessment model to obtain an assessment result. The present invention also relates to a blockchain technique, and the first county node map may be stored in blockchain link points. The invention also provides a natural disaster risk assessment device, equipment and a medium. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of natural disaster risk assessment.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network water quality risk and water supply reliability calculation method considering post-earthquake negative pressure effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calculating water quality risk and water supply reliability of a city water supply network by considering post-earthquake negative pressure effect, and belongs to the field of post-disaster water quality safety evaluation of the city water supply network. The invention comprises the following steps: calculating the area of a pipeline leakage opening under the daily operation situation; generating a seismic damage scene of pipelines in a pipe network under the action of the earthquake by Monte Carlo simulation sampling; determining the situation that the pollutants invade a pipe network after the earthquake; establishing a pipe network model of a pollutant invasion scene; calculating the average water quality risk of the nodes; calculating the reliability of the water supply of the pipe network; calculating the average risk mean value of the node average water quality; and (5) calculating the reliability mean value of the pipe network. The method is based on the urban water supply pipe network negative pressure scene under the earthquake damage effect, calculates the pipe network water quality risk and the water supply reliability through the pollution invasion scene, and has great significance for guiding post-earthquake water quality early warning and coping strategies of the urban water supply pipe network, anti-earthquake upgrading and reconstruction of the pipe network and emergency repair measures after the earthquake.

title_en: Power grid power transmission capacity calculation method considering multiple fault risks in disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission capacity calculation method for a power grid, which is used for considering multiple fault risks in a disaster scene, and comprises the steps of generating a candidate fault set of a power transmission section, which is used for considering the disaster scene in a current operation mode, carrying out time domain simulation calculation, obtaining a transient safety and stability quantitative evaluation result of each power transmission section, screening an associated fault set of each power transmission section from the candidate fault set of the power transmission section, stepping each power transmission section, simulating the associated fault set of each power transmission section in combination with the associated fault set of each power transmission section, obtaining information of a fault loss unit and load information of the fault loss unit, evaluating comprehensive benefits of each gear, obtaining a power value corresponding to the maximum value of the comprehensive benefits, namely the maximum transmission power of the power transmission section in the current operation mode, and evaluating the power transmission capacity of the power grid based on the maximum transmission power. According to the invention, uncertain faults and risks thereof under a disaster scene are comprehensively considered, and the economical efficiency can be effectively improved under the condition of ensuring the safety of the power grid.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster track planning method for paying attention to forest fire edge
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster track planning method for paying attention to forest fire edges, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a simulated forest fire edge map with the edges expanded, calculating to obtain a convex polygon of a scanning range, solving the distance from a discrete point in a fire disaster area to each side of the convex polygon of the scanning range, taking the shortest distance of the discrete point as an importance index of the discrete point, drawing an equal importance line map according to the index, weighting different areas in the map, determining the distance between adjacent tracks scanned by unmanned aerial vehicles in the area according to the area weight, improving the side overlap rate of unmanned aerial vehicle scanning in the edge area, and further improving the aerial image precision of the unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle scanning range distribution function and an unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional track cost function, and solving the optimal position of a range division ray and the optimal three-dimensional track planning by adopting a particle swarm algorithm and a genetic simulated annealing algorithm. The method is reliable and practical, and has good adaptability to unmanned aerial vehicle cluster track planning in forest fire scenes.

title_en: Supporting method and supporting structure adopting microscopic NPR anchor rods or anchor cables
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel excavation, in particular to a supporting method adopting a microscopic NPR anchor rod or anchor cable and a supporting structure thereof, and the improvement is that the method comprises the following steps: s1: positioning; s2: drilling holes; s3: clearing holes; s4: injecting a high-performance resin anchoring agent; s5: pushing in a microcosmic NPR anchor rod or anchor cable; s6: stirring, namely driving a micro NPR anchor rod or anchor cable to rotate by using an anchor rod drilling machine so as to stir; s7: waiting for the high-performance resin anchoring agent to solidify; s8: mounting a support member; s9: applying a pre-tightening force, and reversely tensioning the microscopic NPR anchor rod or anchor cable by utilizing a tensioning jack of a tensioning tool to apply the pre-tightening force; s10: and cutting off the redundant exposed section. The invention provides a supporting method and a supporting structure thereof adopting microscopic NPR anchor rods or anchor cables, which effectively reduce or avoid the large deformation of soft rock and the rock burst disasters facing a soft rock tunnel and a hard rock tunnel, and ensure the construction progress and the safety of personnel and equipment.

title_en: Method for calculating residual bending stiffness of T-shaped laminated beam after fire disaster
abstract_en: A calculation method for residual bending stiffness of a T-shaped laminated beam after a fire disaster belongs to the technical field of fire disaster safety risk assessment, and comprises the following steps: (1) Carrying out fire test design, utilizing Abaqus software to establish a numerical model for the T-shaped laminated beam under the fire test, and carrying out numerical simulation through the model; (2) Expanding working conditions on the basis of the verified finite element model, and simulating the influence of different parameters on the residual bending rigidity of the T-shaped laminated beam after fire, wherein the parameters comprise the lamination parameter gamma of the T-shaped laminated beam, the friction coefficient lambda of a lamination surface and the fire time T; (3) And according to the simulation result, fitting residual bending stiffness of the T-shaped superposed beam after fire disaster under different working conditions by adopting SPSS data analysis software, and finally comparing the calculated value with a test value or a simulation value to verify the accuracy of the calculation method. The method can effectively improve the reliability of bending stiffness evaluation of the T-shaped superposed beam after fire disaster through accurate calculation.

title_en: Post-disaster house risk grade evaluation method and device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a post-disaster house risk level evaluation method and device based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a house image, generating an image data set, preprocessing the image data set, dividing the preprocessed data into training set data and test set data, constructing MyNet a network training model, obtaining a training model of a MyNet network based on the training set data, training the training model of the MyNet network to obtain an optimal weight parameter, inputting the test set data into the training model of the MyNet network, outputting risk level probability, and taking the level with the highest risk level probability as a house risk level. In this way, the working efficiency of identifying the hazard class of the rural houses after the disaster can be improved, and a large amount of manpower and financial resources are saved.

title_en: Low-oxygen environment spiral tunnel fire combustion system
abstract_en: A low-oxygen environment spiral tunnel fire combustion system, comprising a main tunnel structure, the main tunnel structure being a spiral structure; a positioning support system, the main tunnel structure being arranged on the positioning support system, and the positioning support system being used for controlling the height and the angle of the main tunnel structure; an oxygen content control system, the oxygen content control system being communicated with the inside of the main tunnel structure; a combustion system, the combustion system being arranged in the main tunnel structure; and a monitoring system, the monitoring system being arranged in the main tunnel structure, and the monitoring system being electrically connected to a computer acquisition system. The present invention can simulate and research the working conditions of tunnels having different line forms, different spiral radii and different spiral heights at different scales of fire, so as to summarize and derive experimental data under different working conditions, providing corresponding bases for crowd evacuation in fire disasters.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, in particular to a geological disaster prediction early warning method, which processes geological disaster trend data by using a machine learning algorithm, wherein the geological disaster trend data comprises two geological disaster prediction models, one geological disaster prediction model predicts trend data, the other geological disaster prediction model predicts periodic data partially, the geological disaster trend prediction model is tested by using a test set after training and verification to obtain prediction accuracy, in addition, factors influencing geological disasters are quantized by using a geological disaster factor relevance algorithm, and the factors with high relevance are selected as input variables, so that the prediction early warning accuracy is improved.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH;GUANGXI INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES;GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: GA-lightGBM-based video fire detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a video fire detection method based on GA-lightGBM, which comprises the following steps: extracting suspected fire areas from the image sequence; extracting fire features; the fire disaster characteristics are used as training data to be imported into a lightGBM model for training; and adjusting the parameters of the lightGBM by using a genetic algorithm, and judging whether flame exists or not. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the dynamic and static features extracted from the video and used for fire disaster discrimination are rich, and compared with the traditional method, the method has higher detection accuracy; in addition, the invention introduces a genetic algorithm to carry out parameter adjustment on the lightGBM so as to obtain the optimal fire detection effect.

title_en: Municipal drainage pipe network state prediction method based on graph and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a municipal drainage pipe network state prediction method based on graph and deep learning, which comprises the following steps of collecting municipal drainage pipe network topological structures in target areas, acquiring characteristics of each monitoring point in real time, establishing a graph set of time-space sequences by using the information, preprocessing an established time-space sequence graph model, learning established graph data by combining a graph convolutional neural network and a gate control circulation unit, training a related model, predicting the drainage pipe network state by using the trained model, reconstructing prediction results into graphs, visually displaying prediction overflow amounts of each point, and finally performing fault investigation and flood prevention early warning on a drainage pipe network system by using the established graph model and algorithm prediction results. By the method, the complexity of model establishment can be reduced, the accuracy of drainage pipe network system state prediction can be improved, the areas which are blocked by the fault pipeline and possibly have disasters in a short period can be accurately detected and early-warned, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability of the city is effectively improved.

title_en: Mining area pre-pressure relief method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining and discloses a mining area pre-pressure relief method, which comprises the steps of determining the positions of disaster-causing rock stratum and mineral layer according to the geological characteristics of a mine; determining the horizon of a measure lane according to the position of the disaster-causing rock stratum, and excavating the horizon of the measure lane along a first horizontal direction to obtain the measure lane positioned in the mining area; arranging an oriented drilling field in the measure roadway, and punching holes in a second horizontal direction at the oriented drilling field to obtain oriented drilling holes, wherein the second horizontal direction is orthogonal to the first horizontal direction; and fracturing the disaster-causing rock stratum in the directional drilling hole by utilizing a fracturing string tool. The mining area pre-pressure relief method can pre-crack the disaster-causing rock layer 1 above the ore layer in advance.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Weather forecast improvement method based on radar observation physical constraint numerical mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather forecast improvement method based on a radar observation physical constraint numerical mode, relates to the technical field of numerical weather forecast, solves the problems that the existing microphysics scheme simplifies the ice and snow melting process, causes more small rain drops and abnormally reduces reflectivity after melting, and provides the following scheme which comprises the following steps: s1: determining the strict constraint factor m  1  And m  2  The following formula: where Δz1 and Δz2 are radar reflectivity change values near the thawed layer for historical radar observations and raw weather forecast pattern simulations, respectively, k1 and k2 are constants related to different weather systems, k1 is typically 0.006 for typhoons, and k2 is typically 0.001; s2: determining the number of rain drops generated by snow melting, wherein the formula is as follows: s3: yun Bing to snow correction automatic transfer scheme is as follows: the method can better improve the simulation and forecast of the numerical mode on the disaster weather such as typhoons and the like, and effectively improves the accuracy of the simulation and forecast.

title_en: Urban underground engineering catastrophe monitoring simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster monitoring simulation system for urban underground engineering, which belongs to the technical field of disaster monitoring and comprises a monitoring box, wherein a camera is arranged on the top wall of the monitoring box, the camera is in signal connection with the monitoring system, a supporting plate is fixedly connected in the monitoring box, a plurality of first springs are arranged below the supporting plate, one end of each first spring, which is close to the monitoring box, is fixedly connected with a top moving block, a groove is arranged at the top of each top moving block, a second spring is fixedly connected in the groove, one end, which is far from the groove, of each second spring is fixedly connected with an impact block, motors are fixedly connected between adjacent ones of the plurality of first springs, the output shafts of the motors are connected with functional blocks, a plurality of pushing blocks are arranged at the bottoms of the functional blocks, magnetic strips of the same level are arranged on one sides, which are close to each other, of the pushing blocks and the top moving blocks are provided with simulated soil layers, simulated tunnels are arranged at the tops of the simulated soil layers, and simulated mountain bodies are arranged at the tops of the simulated tunnels. The invention has simple structure, and can more intuitively display the actual situation of the tunnel in disaster through simulating and restoring the tunnel.

title_en: Vegetation growth disaster damage verification method based on foundation visible light image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation growth vigor disaster damage verification method based on a foundation visible light image, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring visible light image data of a vegetation canopy, selecting an image sequence based on the visible light image data, and performing image segmentation on the image sequence to acquire a green vegetation image; calculating a green vegetation visible light index and simulating a green vegetation change trend based on the green vegetation image; and monitoring vegetation growth vigor damage conditions based on the green vegetation visible light index and the change trend. According to the invention, the RGB image of the landform near-ground canopy which is mixed by bare rock and vegetation in the karst region is segmented by a machine learning algorithm, so that the accuracy is improved, and technical support is provided for vegetation monitoring based on visible light images of the foundation canopy.

title_en: Double-telescopic suspension arm type lifeboat suspension device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-telescopic boom type lifeboat lifting device which comprises two symmetrically arranged telescopic booms, wherein one end of each telescopic boom is connected with a side board of a drilling platform/drilling ship, a lifting steel wire rope is arranged on each telescopic boom, one end of each lifting steel wire rope is connected with a lifting winch, the lifting winch is arranged on the drilling platform/drilling ship, and the other end of each lifting steel wire rope bypasses a lifting pulley and is connected with one end of each telescopic boom far away from the drilling platform/drilling ship. The invention solves the problems that the single telescopic arm type boat lifting device or the double swing arm type boat lifting device matched with the existing drilling platform/drilling ship has small lifting load and short lifting distance, and when the drilling platform/drilling ship is inclined at a large marine disaster angle, the lifeboats and the mother ship are easy to collide or the lifting obstacles appear in severe sea conditions.

title_en: Intelligent collaborative master control system for physical simulation of ultra-large deep engineering disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent cooperative master control system for physical simulation of ultra-large deep engineering disasters, and relates to the technical field of physical simulation of deep engineering disasters. The system comprises a cross-protocol transparent high-efficiency communication architecture responsible for communication and data transmission among all the component systems of the physical simulation facility; the test big data storage and fusion analysis module is used for multi-source heterogeneous test big data storage and fusion analysis; a multi-task joint planning module for making and planning a physical simulation test task plan; an intelligent dynamic cooperative control module for constructing a cooperative control model and carrying out real-time dynamic cooperative control on the field process of the physical simulation test; the cooperative control model autonomous optimization module is used for realizing continuous optimization of the cooperative control model; and a multi-task intelligent execution fault-tolerant module and a multi-task integrated display module for providing intelligent fault tolerance and integrated display functions. The system can realize intelligent dynamic cooperative control of a plurality of strong coupling systems of the ultra-large deep engineering disaster physical simulation facilities.

title_en: Vehicle ramp entrance confluence control method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: A vehicle ramp entrance confluence control method based on deep reinforcement learning is characterized in that a ramp confluence simulation environment is built by utilizing SUMO, relevant state information is obtained, a state space, an action space and a rewarding function are designed, an Actor network and a Critic network are built based on a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, iterative training is carried out on the network until convergence, finally, the ramp entrance confluence behavior is completed through interaction between TraCI interfaces and the SUMO, other rewarding standards such as efficiency and comfort level are added, the traffic efficiency of bottleneck road sections can be effectively improved, and the problem that the conventional deep reinforcement learning method is prone to being in the dilemma of state space explosion when the complex state space is processed is effectively solved by adopting the PPO deep reinforcement learning method of Actor-Critic architecture, so that the dimension disaster problem is caused. The invention has the advantages of realizing the control of the ramp confluence of the vehicles, improving the safety of the vehicle running in the ramp confluence area and the road traffic passing efficiency, and simultaneously ensuring the comfort of passengers.

title_en: Monitoring pile for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring pile for geological disasters, which comprises a pile body, wherein the pile body is a hollow cylinder with an opening at the top, the bottom end of the pile body is conical, the outer wall of the pile body is fixedly connected with a spiral blade, a plurality of grouting pipes are arranged on the outer wall of the pile body in a penetrating way, grouting holes are formed in the grouting pipes, a water inlet of each grouting pipe is connected with a pressure-bearing hose, a driving mechanism is arranged in the pile body, the grouting pipes are all in transmission connection with the driving mechanism, and a plurality of handles are arranged at the top of the outer wall of the pile body; according to the utility model, after the pile body is drilled into the soil surface by using the handle and the spiral blade, the grouting pipe is driven by the driving mechanism to extend out of the pile body and insert into the soil, and then the pressure-bearing hose is connected with the high-pressure grouting machine, so that cement mortar can be injected underground by using the grouting pipe, and after the cement mortar is solidified, the soil at the bottom end of the pile body can be formed into a whole, thereby ensuring the installation strength of the pile body, and the pile body is simple to operate and convenient to construct.
assignees: QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST QINGHAI INST OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL RESOURCES QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL REMO

title_en: Drilling construction and coal seam gas extraction method combining rotary cutting and impact permeability improvement
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drilling construction and coal seam gas extraction method with the cooperation of rotary cutting and impact reflection prevention, which belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety, wherein a drilling machine is adopted to drive a spiral drill rod so as to drive a drill bit at the end part to conduct conventional cutting on a coal body, an impact assembly is arranged in the drill rod at the end part, the impact assembly can push an arc seat through high-pressure air conveyed by an underground air compressor, then a fracturing block is driven to impact the spiral impact drill bit, the spiral impact drill bit is enabled to impact the coal body in front, and a plurality of cracks are generated on the coal body, so that the coal seam permeability is improved, the structural integrity of the coal body is damaged, and the follow-up drilling process is facilitated. And after the drilling construction is finished, plugging the drilling, connecting the drilling with a downhole gas extraction pipeline, and implementing coal seam gas enhanced extraction. The invention has simple structure, less related equipment, obvious technical and economic benefits and can provide solid technical support for the efficient treatment of underground gas disasters of coal mines.

title_en: Landslide deep displacement monitoring system and method based on MEMS technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide deep displacement monitoring system and method based on MEMS technology, which belong to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring. Each measuring node can rotate around adjacent sensors in two orthogonal directions, each sensor comprises an MEMS six-axis inclination acceleration sensing chip, when the sensor is used, the whole sensor chain is placed in an inclinometer hole drilled in a landslide body, when the measuring node rotates, the current rotation angle can be output to a processing terminal through a bus, a calculation algorithm is used in the terminal to calculate the displacement condition inside the landslide body, and the high-efficiency combination of intellectualization, precision and implementation is realized.
assignees: CHINA HYDROPOWER AND WATER RESOURCES PLANNING AND DESIGN GENERAL INST CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;POWERCHINA GUIYANG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Power distribution network storm disaster power failure prediction method based on numerical simulation and SVD model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power failure prediction method for a power distribution network heavy wind disaster based on numerical simulation and SVD model, which comprises the following steps: matching body parameters, meteorological parameters, running state parameters and outage probability and duration data after the occurrence of a power failure fault under the condition of a strong wind disaster, and establishing a power distribution network historical meteorological parameter sample library A and a power distribution network strong wind fault sample library B; based on the sample library, an SVD method is adopted to construct an SVD model of influence of a strong wind disaster on power failure faults of the power distribution network; adopting a regional numerical mode, and carrying out numerical simulation by combining an initial boundary field provided by global weather forecast data to obtain a weather parameter forecast value of a target region; and forecasting the power failure probability and the power failure time under the strong wind disaster of the power distribution network based on the SVD model and the meteorological parameter forecasting value. The invention realizes the refined large wind disaster forecast based on numerical simulation and statistical method, and is suitable for disaster prevention and reduction of various complicated distribution networks.

title_en: Rainfall simulation generator's analog control system for agricultural production test
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation control system of a rainfall simulation generator for agricultural production experiments, which relates to the technical field of simulated rainfall control, and soil and rainfall data during historical rainfall are collected in advance by arranging a land historical data collection module and a rainfall historical data collection module; the setting history data analysis module combines the time sequence change data of the historical rainfall intensity and the soil data of the land to generate a neural network model for judging whether soil disasters occur according to the continuous rainfall data and the soil real-time data; setting a real-time rainfall data collection module and a real-time land data collection module to acquire natural data in real time during a simulated rainfall experiment; setting a rainfall simulation control module to analyze the damage condition of natural soil during rainfall simulation; before the simulated rainfall experiment is carried out, the disaster caused by overlarge simulated rainfall intensity is timely avoided.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Coal mine underground personnel disaster avoidance route planning method based on multi-objective optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a coal mine underground personnel disaster avoidance route planning method based on a multi-objective optimization algorithm, which comprises the following steps: constructing a disaster avoidance line initial population, wherein the disaster avoidance line initial population comprises a plurality of disaster avoidance line planning schemes aiming at different disaster conditions and different staff; constructing an agent model based on the disaster avoidance route initial population; and determining an optimal disaster avoidance route planning scheme by adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm according to the initial population of the disaster avoidance route and the agent model. According to the method for planning the disaster avoidance route of the underground coal mine personnel, the accuracy of evaluation of the disaster avoidance route planning scheme can be greatly improved by means of simulation data through data driving, the scheme practicability is improved, and the disaster avoidance effect of the underground coal mine personnel can be remarkably improved.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Distributed optical fiber fire disaster identification method and system based on underground comprehensive pipe rack
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a distributed optical fiber fire disaster identification method and system based on a underground utility tunnel, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of fire initiation factors associated with the fire determination; establishing and training an identification classifier based on a plurality of fire initiation factors associated with fire judgment; determining a fire risk assessment system based on a plurality of fire initiation factors associated with the fire judgment; acquiring real-time information of an underground utility tunnel, wherein the real-time information comprises information related to a plurality of fire initiation factors; the comprehensive risk level value of the fire disaster of the underground comprehensive pipe rack is determined according to the real-time information through the identification classifier and the fire disaster risk evaluation system, and the comprehensive risk level value has the advantages of being beneficial to preliminary judgment and positioning during risk accident occurrence, grasping the law of risk development and controlling the risk, and ensuring effective avoidance of the risk.
assignees: SUZHOU SICUI RONGHE FOUNDATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;SUZHOU UTILLITY TUNNEL DEV CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring and early warning method for geological disasters caused by collapse along oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and discloses a monitoring and early warning method for collapse of an oil and gas pipeline along the line. The method comprises the steps of 1, carrying out modeling analysis on a collapse slope, determining the collapse slope to comprise a rock mass which is collapsed and a slope surface which is not collapsed, wherein the bottom of the collapsed rock mass is a plastic region, 2, obtaining the dead weight of the rock mass, the anti-slip force of the rock mass on the slope surface and the sliding force of the rock mass, analyzing the pressure condition of the plastic region from the rock mass when the collapse occurs, carrying out simulation calculation on the crack opening degree between the rock mass and the slope surface, and 3, combining the crack opening degree, manufacturing an early warning grade, and sending out early warning of the corresponding early warning grade according to a specific crack opening degree value. The method can realize the prediction and the early warning of different early warning grades of the collapse disaster, and can solve the problems of collapse disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Power grid icing prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a power grid icing prediction method, a power grid icing prediction device, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The power grid icing prediction method comprises the steps of generating a training sample set through historical data to train an initial model to obtain a first prediction model; predicting according to the first prediction model to obtain a first prediction result, and judging whether the first prediction model and the first prediction result meet the precision condition; if the first prediction result or the first prediction model does not meet the precision condition, performing iterative parameter adjustment on the first prediction model according to an optimization algorithm to obtain a second prediction model; predicting according to the second prediction model to obtain a second prediction result, and taking the second prediction result as a prediction result and outputting the prediction result; and if the first prediction result and the first prediction model both meet the precision condition, taking the first prediction result as a prediction result and outputting the prediction result. Therefore, the method and the device can be used for predicting the risk of the icing disaster of the power grid with higher calculation accuracy.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Grid-spotting storm prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid-point storm forecasting method, which adopts the data of a circulating background field, a U\V forecasting field, a rainfall forecasting field, a mode adjusting field and a ground weather station and constructs a training sample set; establishing a forecasting model based on the mapping relation between the EC mode circulation background field and a forecasting product thereof and the future precipitation of 0-24 hours by adopting an XGBoost method; and training the training sample set through the forecasting model so that the forecasting model can forecast the medium-short-term precipitation. The prediction capability (storm TS) of the method for the rainfall above the storm is improved by more than 17% compared with the EC mode prediction, the prediction precision of the medium-short-term rainfall can be effectively improved, the method has good application prospect, and more accurate prediction service is provided for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Power transmission line icing detection system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ice coating detection of transmission circuits and discloses an ice coating detection system of a transmission line based on deep learning, which mainly comprises an early warning system, data transmission, three-dimensional simulation, determination of a disaster area and ice breaking treatment.
assignees: NANJING YOUKUO ELECTRICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban power distribution network toughness improving method under storm disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving toughness of an urban power distribution network under a storm disaster, which comprises the following steps: s1, pre-disaster prevention considers the spatial distribution characteristic and the time distribution characteristic of a storm attack at the same time, establishes a multi-stage robust model and adopts a rolling strategy to solve; s2, establishing a routing model by considering the fault occurrence sequence and the waterlogging influence in the routing planning of the maintenance team in the post-disaster recovery process; s3, simulation verification. According to the urban power distribution network toughness improvement method under the storm disaster, the multi-stage process of pre-disaster prevention is considered, the multi-stage robust model suitable for pre-disaster prevention of the urban power distribution network under the storm disaster is provided, and the space and time distribution characteristics of defense and attack can be described, so that modeling is more practical.

title_en: Multi-source composite disaster inundation risk simulation method for complex tidal river network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating multi-source composite disaster submerging risks of a complex tidal river network, which comprises a construction method of an astronomical tide-storm tide-flood-salt tide-rainfall multi-scale dynamic process full-coupling model, and can analyze submerging and salt tide upward risks of extreme composite disasters such as torrential flood, storm tide, salt tide, storm and the like of the complex river network under the climate change scene. By means of technical means such as potential inundation area determination, model grid optimization, numerical format setting, parallel acceleration and the like, on the basis of guaranteeing momentum and material flux conservation in a river network, the calculation efficiency is optimized to the greatest extent, and the purpose of considering both multi-source disaster inundation and brine layering high-precision simulation in a estuary-offshore trans-scale space area can be achieved. The invention can solve the problem that the hydrodynamic force, the salinity and the near-shore complex terrain are relatively isolated and can not interact in the traditional simulation, provides technical support for scientifically evaluating the risk and the recurrence period of multi-source disasters in estuary areas, and has outstanding social benefits and disaster prevention and reduction economic benefits.

title_en: Method for preventing impact of artificial relief layer of stope face
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-scour method for an artificial relief layer of a stope face, which comprises the following steps: determining a target rock stratum where an artificial liberation layer is located above a stratum area with rock burst hidden danger; numerical simulation and theoretical analysis are carried out on the artificial liberation layer and the equivalent coal seam exploitation thereof to obtain the stress sigma of the liberation layer under the equivalent coal seam exploitation  lib  And stress sigma of the released layer under artificial release layer mining  art  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the According to sigma  lib  Sum sigma  art  Defining an equivalent stress relief coefficient xi, and dividing and judging the artificial relief layer thickness and coverage area in the target rock stratum; establishing an artificial liberation layer judging model according to the division judgment of the thickness and coverage of the artificial liberation layer, arranging a ground fracturing well according to the model, and performing drilling and fracturing operations; the coverage area of the width of the artificial liberation layer correspondingly covers the boundary of each side of the working face by 30-50m, and then the working face stoping operation is carried out. The invention greatly reduces the occurrence probability of rock burst disasters during the stoping of the working face.

title_en: Optical storage and charging integrated station operation method for electric quantity balance and new energy consumption of power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical storage and filling integrated station operation method for electric power balance and new energy consumption of a power grid, which comprises the steps of based on a comprehensive service scene of the optical storage and filling integrated station, taking power balance constraint, main power grid interaction power constraint and equipment operation constraint as constraint conditions, taking real-time output of an energy storage unit as decision variables, establishing a combined operation optimization model of the optical storage and filling integrated station, converting a Markov decision process method into a reinforcement learning network for a policy decision problem, adopting historical system state data, performing offline training reinforcement learning network based on DDPG algorithm, and performing scheduling cost minimum economical optimization calculation on the combined operation optimization model of the optical storage and filling integrated station by combining a time-of-use electricity price mechanism to obtain a real-time self-optimizing operation output result of the energy storage system in the optical storage and filling integrated station, so as to realize dynamic optimization operation of the optical storage and filling integrated station, and effectively avoid dimension disasters in calculation.

title_en: Coal roadway impact mine pressure control method combining energy-absorbing grouting and large-diameter pressure relief hole
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal roadway impact mine pressure control method combining energy absorption grouting and a large-diameter pressure relief hole, and relates to the field of deep coal mine dynamic disaster prevention and control. The method has the advantages that the stress peak value and the high stress range of the surrounding rock of the roadway are reduced, meanwhile, the coal body is reinforced, and excessive pressure relief of the large-diameter pressure relief holes on two sides of the coal seam roadway is prevented. In addition, the large-diameter pressure relief holes and the energy-absorbing grouting material are used for providing larger compensation space for deformation and energy release of the coal body, so that the threat brought by dynamic disasters such as impact mine pressure and the like during deep coal exploitation is reduced. The method comprises the following steps of S1, drilling a water fracturing guide hole, S2, hydraulic fracturing, S3, grouting and reinforcing a fracturing area, and S4, drilling a large-diameter pressure relief hole. The construction sequence of pressure relief, reinforcement and pressure relief avoids the problems of excessive pressure relief and damage to the integrity of a supporting structure caused by directly drilling a large-diameter pressure relief hole in a broken coal seam, and reduces the risk of impact mine pressure from two directions of pressure relief and reinforcement.

title_en: Urban resilience assessment method and system under flood disaster and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for evaluating urban resilience under a flood disaster, belonging to the technical field of urban resilience evaluation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring target city data; constructing a system performance curve; simulating flood disasters of a target city to obtain total simulation time, carrying out interval division on a system performance curve by a function fitting method, solving an integral value of each interval, and obtaining a total disaster-suffering integral value of the target city; representing the total integral value of the target city by the product of the maximum system performance and the total simulation time; and obtaining and outputting a restoring force evaluation result according to the proportion of the disaster integral total value of the target city and the total integral value of the target city. The method is used for evaluating the urban resilience under the flood disaster based on the improved system performance curve, and provides a new idea for evaluation and decision support of the urban resilience.

title_en: Ground disaster prediction evaluation classification method based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground disaster prediction evaluation classification method based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image data, and belongs to the technical field of geological mapping. The invention comprises the following steps: s1: selecting remote sensing image data and digital elevation data of a corresponding area to perform data synthesis to obtain an initial sample set; s2: preprocessing the initial sample set obtained in the step S1 to obtain a preprocessed sample set; s3: labeling the pretreatment sample set in the step S2 to obtain a ground disaster feature label sample set; s4: constructing a training network model, and fitting a training set and a verification set output by the training network model through iteration to judge whether model training is completed or not so as to obtain a prediction network model; s5: and inputting the remote sensing image data acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle into a prediction network model for prediction, and carrying out ground disaster assessment classification through the prediction network model. The method and the device can efficiently and accurately identify the ground disaster type and forecast evaluation in the remote sensing image under the support of a small number of samples and limited calculation power.

title_en: Mental load classification prediction method and system based on wrapped dimension reduction
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a brain load classification prediction method and a brain load classification prediction system based on wrapped dimension reduction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the acquired electroencephalogram signals, extracting the average power spectral density under delta, theta, alpha, beta rhythms, reducing the feature number to the middle dimension, outputting a dimension-reducing matrix, and establishing a mental load classification model; and carrying out the same processing on the electroencephalogram signals of the test set according to the data of the training set, and predicting the mental load condition of an operator in the occurrence period of the electroencephalogram signals of the test set by using the mental load classification model. According to the technical scheme, the data dimension can be reduced, and the mental load state of an operator when the current signal is generated can be accurately predicted on the premise that the dimension disaster is relieved to a certain extent.
assignees: CHINA SHIP GROUP CO LTD COMPREHENSIVE TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Method for identifying and grading water hazard hidden danger of overlying strata separation layer based on acoustic wave rigidity of rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying water damage hidden dangers of a overlying strata separation layer based on the rigidity of rock mass acoustic waves, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out rock mass acoustic wave in-situ test; the method comprises the steps of calculating the acoustic rigidity of rock mass, calculating the acoustic rigidity ratio of the rock mass of adjacent stratum, carrying out in-situ discrimination and scale classification on the hidden danger of water damage of the overlying strata, and finally carrying out the dangerous classification on the hidden danger of water damage of the overlying strata. According to the invention, the stratum structure and the drilling acoustic wave test data disclosed by the drilling are comprehensively adopted, complex indoor tests are not required to be carried out to obtain physical and mechanical parameters, the hidden danger of the overlying strata and the delamination water disaster in the mining area can be rapidly identified and classified in situ, scientific basis can be provided for the formulation of the delamination water disaster prevention and control scheme, and the safe mining of the coal mine is ensured.

title_en: TCMS system semi-physical simulation test platform and test method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a TCMS system semi-physical simulation test platform and a test method, and relates to the technical field of TCMS tests. Wherein the platform includes: the real equipment group and the simulation equipment group are arranged in the carriage; the real equipment group comprises an MVCU, a RIOM remote input output unit and a TSN switch; the simulation equipment set performs data interaction with the TSN switch and comprises at least one of a DCU traction system, an ACU auxiliary system, a BCU braking system, an MDCU door system, an HAVC air conditioning system, a FAS fire disaster system and a PIS passenger information system; the TSN exchanger and the RIOM remote input/output unit are arranged in each carriage; the MVCU comprises a first MVCU and a second MVCU, wherein the first MVCU and the second MVCU are used for being respectively arranged at two ends of the carriage and are electrically connected with the TSN switch; the RIOM remote input/output unit is connected with a drive sampling plug box. According to the method and the device, the number of entity devices is reduced, and the consistency between the test and the actual scene on site is ensured.
assignees: BEIJING COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION RAIL TRANSIT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;TRAFFIC CONTROL TECH CO LTD;BEIJING INFRASTRUCTURE INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Traffic prediction model construction method and traffic prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing, in particular to a traffic prediction model construction method and a traffic prediction method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining topography data, landform data, geological data and ground disaster data according to the three-dimensional remote sensing images of different research areas, wherein the ground disaster data comprises hidden danger area data and disaster area data; respectively analyzing various data to obtain corresponding influence factors; preprocessing the influence factors and various data to determine the comprehensive traffic; and constructing an initial prediction model based on an extreme gradient lifting algorithm, and training the initial prediction model by using all types of preprocessed data and the comprehensive traffic data set to obtain a traffic prediction model. The invention has the beneficial effects that: by introducing hidden danger area data, the accuracy of the traffic prediction model is effectively improved, the traffic of the area considering the ground disaster hidden danger can be further obtained, and the accuracy and the reliability of traffic prediction are effectively improved.

title_en: Front-end disaster recovery performance test method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a front-end disaster recovery performance test method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a service request of a target page based on a browser simulation tool, and acquiring a request list; the service request is used for acquiring data from a back-end server; performing interface abnormal state simulation on the service requests in the request list according to a preset disaster tolerance test scene to generate a test task; and running the test task based on the browser simulation tool to generate a test result. And acquiring a service request through a browser simulation tool, and automatically performing disaster recovery performance test. The method can test the disaster recovery performance of the front end efficiently, thereby remarkably reducing the manpower input and being convenient for generating a test report. In addition, the embodiment of the disclosure also provides a front-end disaster recovery performance testing device, a medium and a computing device.
assignees: HANGZHOU NETEASE ZAIGU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Restraint device for realizing component variable angle impact test
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building component disaster simulation, and particularly relates to a constraint device for realizing component variable angle impact test. The invention aims to solve the problem that the application range of the existing restraining device for component impact test is narrow, and provides a restraining device for realizing component variable angle impact test, which comprises a clamping assembly for clamping components, wherein the clamping assembly comprises an upper clamping block and a lower clamping block which are oppositely arranged up and down, the top of the upper clamping block is fixedly provided with an upper pressing plate, the bottom of the lower clamping block is fixedly provided with a lower pressing plate, two opposite surfaces of the upper clamping block and the lower clamping block are respectively provided with a plurality of upper saw-tooth type clamping grooves and lower saw-tooth type clamping grooves which are uniformly distributed in the circumferential direction, the upper saw-tooth type clamping grooves and the lower saw-tooth type clamping grooves are in one-to-one correspondence with each other through circle centers, and reserved holes are formed in four corners of the upper pressing plate and the lower pressing plate, and after the long anchor rods pass through the reserved holes, the long anchor rods are matched with nuts to realize component variable angle impact test through adjusting the positions of the components mounted in the clamping grooves.
assignees: SHANXI PINGYU EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Construction method of upper supporting pressure and lower load distribution function of mining weakly cemented stratum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of upper supporting pressure and lower load distribution functions of a mining weakly cemented stratum, which is based on mineral components, microstructures and physical mechanical properties of the weakly cemented stratum, utilizes an indoor test to obtain a response rule of the water degradation property of the weakly cemented stratum along with influence factors, builds a physical model of a mining overburden of a hard-soft-hard overburden structure to destroy similar materials, obtains a distribution curve of upper supporting pressure and lower load along with mining, calibrates numerical simulation calculation parameters conforming to the mining overburden destruction rule of the indoor test based on the curve, obtains upper supporting pressure and lower load distribution data under different influence factors through numerical simulation calculation under different working conditions, and obtains upper hard supporting pressure and lower basic top load distribution function expression of the water degradation of the weakly cemented stratum. The invention can effectively characterize and deteriorate the distribution characteristics of the upper supporting pressure and the lower load of the weakly cemented stratum, and provides support for revealing the exploitation field mining pressure appearance and the dynamic sand-breaking disaster of the weakly cemented roof.

title_en: Regional power grid resilience assessment method based on time sequence state deduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a regional power grid resilience evaluation method based on time sequence state deduction, which comprises the following steps of: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a scene of shutdown and line damage of a regional power grid unit under an extreme disaster, constructing a model of a shutdown unit and a related power transmission line recovery path based on unit recovery characteristics, determining a target function and constraint conditions, and obtaining an optimal path; simulating and deducing a post-disaster recovery process of the regional power grid based on a time sequence state through the optimal path, and calculating a recovery index; and calculating a regional power grid restoration efficiency index based on the restoration force index. The method realizes quantification of restoring force in the regional power grid restoring process, effectively evaluates the level of the restoring force of the regional power grid facing to the extreme disaster, helps the power grid to enhance the restoring force of the power grid, and reduces damage and loss suffered by the power grid facing to the extreme disaster.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fire simulation training device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting simulation training, in particular to a fire-fighting training device. A fire simulation training apparatus comprising: the smoke simulation device comprises a smoke simulation device, a control module and an action induction module; the smoke simulation device includes: the lamp tube can adjust the brightness and the smoke releasing device can release smoke; the action sensing module includes: an induction radar; the induction radar is in signal connection with the control module and used for inducing whether fire extinguishing substances fall to the smoke simulation device or not and transmitting induction signals to the control module; the control module is in signal connection with the smoke simulation device and controls the brightness of a lamp tube in the smoke simulation device and the smoke release amount of the smoke release device according to the received induction signal sent by the induction radar. The invention can simulate the light and smoke equivalent effect generated in the fire disaster, can simulate the fire behavior and the environment change in the fire extinguishing process, has high similarity, generates smoke which is nontoxic and harmless to personnel and equipment, and is safe to operate.

title_en: Be applied to model experiment device of simulation of coast side slope landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model experiment device applied to coast slope landslide simulation, which comprises a frame, wherein a simulation cavity for installing a simulation side slope is arranged in an inner cavity at one end of the frame; the wave assembly comprises a sealed cavity arranged in the frame, and the sealed cavity is communicated with the simulation cavity; the sealing cavity is communicated with a vacuum device which is arranged in the frame; the typhoon assembly comprises a moving track arranged on the frame, and a fan device is connected to the moving track in a sliding manner; the moving track is positioned above the simulation cavity, and the fan device is arranged corresponding to the simulation cavity; the rainfall assembly comprises a rainfall net covered on the simulation cavity, and the rainfall net is communicated with a water supply device; and the observation assembly is arranged on the frame and corresponds to the simulation cavity. The method can truly simulate the influence of the environment on the coastal slope protection, thereby providing data support for preventing disasters caused by the slope under different weather conditions in actual conditions.
assignees: SINOSTEEL MAANSHAN GENERAL INSTITUTE OF MINING RES CO LTD

title_en: Simulation observation telescope device for simulation training
abstract_en: The utility model provides a simulation observation telescope device for simulation training, and belongs to the technical field of observation devices. The device comprises a telescope main body, a data line, a computer terminal, a micro display unit and an attitude measurement unit. According to the utility model, by modifying the existing telescope, VR technology, microsensor technology and multi-system serial communication technology can be integrated, the utility model is applied to the training and teaching fields, the training is safer, and a large amount of manpower, material resources, financial resources and time can be saved; on the other hand, the utility model can be suitable for the requirements of various different environments, can be used in simulation training of civil navigation observation, forest fire control observation, disaster prevention, search and rescue observation and the like, is easy to install, use, disassemble and maintain, and reduces the difficulty of equipment installation and maintenance.

title_en: Vertical shaft smoke series flow simulation device capable of being used for double-hole tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical shaft smoke series flow simulation device for a double-tunnel, which comprises a tunnel main body and a data acquisition system, wherein the vertical shaft smoke series flow simulation device is built according to the proportion of 1:18 with a three-lane highway tunnel. The tunnel main body is composed of a main frame, a supporting frame, a vertical shaft, a top plate, side plates and a partition plate, and is divided into a plurality of sections, wherein one section is a fire source section made of stainless steel. The inside and outside of the main body are provided with a ventilation system consisting of a cross-flow fan and an axial-flow fan. The data acquisition system comprises a thermocouple tree, a hot wire anemometer, an Agilent temperature/wind speed acquisition meter, a PIV three-dimensional flow field velocimeter and a CO concentration self-recording meter. The invention has the advantages that: 1) The fuel products and the flue gas are green and nontoxic; 2) The method can be used for researching conditions and limits that the fire disaster of the double-hole tunnel is spread to a non-firing tunnel through the top opening of the adjacent vertical shaft under the influence of multiple factors; 3) Compared with a physical model, the invention has little experimental consumption and can perform repeatability test.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning is with ground sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rock and soil sampling device for geological disaster early warning, which comprises a base, wherein the bottom of the base is provided with a plurality of casters, the top of the base is fixedly connected with a push handle, the outer wall of the push handle is provided with a switch, the top of the base is hinged with a U-shaped frame, the inner side of the base is hinged with an electric cylinder, the push rod end of the electric cylinder is hinged with the outer wall of the U-shaped frame, the U-shaped frame is connected with a connecting plate through a driving mechanism, the outer wall of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the outer wall of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a second motor, and the output shaft of the second motor penetrates through the mounting plate and is fixedly connected with a drill bit through a clamp; when the utility model is used, the electric cylinder is started to push the U-shaped frame to move, so that the U-shaped frame can drive the drill bit and the like to rotate, thereby realizing the angle adjustment of the drill bit, enabling the drill bit to be capable of coping with drilling and sampling on the mountain surface with larger vertical or inclined angle, and being more convenient to use.

title_en: Fire disaster coping simulation method and device for secondary battery production based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Virtual Reality (VR) based fire disaster response simulator for secondary battery production. The fire disaster response simulation device for secondary battery production based on virtual reality comprises: a memory for storing at least one instruction; and at least one processor configured to execute the at least one instruction stored in the memory. The at least one instruction includes a plurality of instructions for performing the steps of: receiving a gaze direction and a gaze location of the identified user from a Head Mounted Display (HMD); displaying fire countermeasure content associated with the secondary battery production device corresponding to the received gaze direction and gaze location based on a display area of the head mounted display, the fire countermeasure content including a plurality of fire countermeasure scenes; acquiring user behavior information representing a user's actions, the user's actions being determined by at least one of a head mounted display and a controller associated with the head mounted display; and executing fire countermeasure content associated with the secondary battery production apparatus based on the acquired user behavior information.

title_en: Quantitative screening method and device for wind field sensitive points
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power transmission lines, and particularly provides a quantitative screening method and device for wind field sensitive points, wherein the quantitative screening method comprises the following steps: carrying out flow field simulation analysis on the region to obtain wind speed vector data at the center point of each grid in the full-flow-field wind field; removing bad data in the wind speed vector data, and performing smoothing treatment on the wind speed vector data after removing the bad data; and screening wind field sensitive points based on the smoothed wind speed vector data. The technical scheme provided by the invention can be used for rapidly screening mass wind field simulation analysis data, recommending the shielding area tower position suitable for arranging the transmission tower and early warning the accelerating area tower position unsuitable for arranging the transmission tower.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for early recovery of damage to environmental basic facilitiy in the event of disaster and apparatus thereof
title_ko: 재난재해시 환경기초시설의 피해를 조기에 복구하기 위한 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a method for an early recovery of the damage to an environmental basic facility in the event of disaster, which may shorten a recovery period. The method for an early recovery of the damage to an environmental basic facility in the event of disaster according to one embodiment of the present invention may comprise: a step of monitoring a public institution and an environmental basic facility; a step of acquiring monitoring information including weather information, on-site monitoring information, sensing information, and image information through the monitoring; a step of receiving weather forecast information, disaster status information including information on a currently occurring disaster, and weather disaster information including a disaster notice including detailed information on the disaster from the public institution; a step of outputting the monitoring information and the weather disaster information; a step of receiving the disaster information and damage information caused by the disaster while the disaster information and the damage information are based on the monitoring information and the weather disaster information; a step of outputting a recovery scenario including a detailed recovery procedure in response to the disaster information and the damage information; and a step of outputting a recovery wizard including a guide for performing the recovery procedure in response to the recovery scenario.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예는 공공기관 및 환경기초시설을 모니터링하는 단계; 상기 모니터링을 통해 기상정보, 현장모니터링정보, 센싱정보 및 영상정보를 포함하는 모니터링정보를 획득하는 단계; 기상예보정보, 현재 발생한 재난재해에 대한 정보를 포함하는 재난재해현황정보 및 상기 재난재해에 대한 상세정보를 포함하는 재난통보문이 포함된 기상재난재해정보를 상기 공공기관으로부터 수신하는 단계; 상기 모니터링정보 및 상기 기상재난재해정보를 출력하는 단계; 상기 재난재해가 발생한 경우, 재난재해정보 및 상기 재난재해로 인한 피해정보를 입력받되, 상기 재난재해정보 및 상기 피해정보는 상기 모니터링정보 및 상기 기상재난재해정보에 기반하는 단계; 상기 재난재해정보 및 상기 피해정보에 대응하여 세부적인 복구절차를 포함하는 복구시나리오를 출력하는 단계; 및 상기 복구시나리오에 대응하여 상기 복구절차를 수행하기 위한 가이드(guide)를 포함하는 복구마법사를 출력하는 단계를 포함하는 재난재해시 환경기초시설의 피해를 조기에 복구하기 위한 방법을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: AE CORP;JANGKANG CO;SUNJIN ENG & ARCHITECTURE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-user based virtual reality nuclear accident emergency response training system
title_ko: 멀티 사용자 기반 가상현실 원전사고 비상 대응 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention provides virtual reality-based nuclear accident emergency response training content through a multiuser-based virtual reality nuclear accident emergency response training system. In addition, a tool for generating additional training scenarios in addition to a basic scenario is provided and a system for monitoring and controlling ongoing virtual training in real time. Analysis results can be derived by collecting and analyzing emergency response training details in real time. In addition, the multiuser-based virtual reality nuclear accident emergency response training system provides content for enabling residents to virtually perform training on actions to take in the event of a nuclear accident and transmits a trainee's head mounted display (HMD) screen to a commander through transmission of 5G-based streaming data in real time so that the trainee can be monitored. The system comprises a virtual reality content provision server, a training control system, and user experience equipment.
abstract_ko: 실시예에서는 멀티 사용자 기반 가상현실 원전사고 비상대응 훈련 시스템을 통해 가상현실 기반의 원전 대응 훈련 컨텐츠를 제공한다. 실시예에서는 기본적인 시나리오 외에 추가적인 훈련 시나리오를 생성하는 툴을 제공하고, 진행중인 가상훈련을 실시간 모니터링하고 통제할 수 있도록 하는 시스템을 제공한다. 또한, 비상대응 훈련 사항들을 실시간으로 수집, 분석하여 분석 결과를 도출할 수 있다. 또한, 실시예에 따른 멀티 사용자 기반 가상현실 원전사고 비상 대응 훈련 시스템은 원전사고 발생시 주민들이 취해야 할 행동 등을 가상으로 훈련할 수 있는 콘텐츠를 제공하고, 훈련생 HMD 화면을 5G 기반의 스트리밍 데이터 전송을 통해 실시간으로 지휘관에게 제공하여 훈련생을 모니터링 할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: 5g-based virtual reality nuclear accident joint evacuation training system
title_ko: 5g 기반 가상현실 원전사고 합동 대피훈련 시스템
abstract_en: A 5G-based virtual reality nuclear accident joint evacuation training system according to the embodiment provides content that can virtually train residents on actions to be taken in the event of a nuclear accident, and provides a trainee HMD screen in real time to a commander through 5G-based streaming data transmission so that the commander can monitor a trainee. In addition, provided is an emergency training control system that provides realistic situations at a training site in real time through a 360 camera worn by control personnel, links the training site through streaming, and can control the entire training and generate unexpected events.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 5G 기반 가상현실 원전사고 합동 대피훈련 시스템은 원전사고 발생시 주민들이 취해야 할 행동 등을 가상으로 훈련할 수 있는 콘텐츠를 제공하고, 훈련생 HMD 화면을 5G 기반의 스트리밍 데이터 전송을 통해 실시간으로 지휘관에게 제공하여 훈련생을 모니터링 할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 통제요원이 착용하고 있는 360 카메라를 통해 실시간으로 훈련 현장의 상황들을 현장감 있게 제공하여 스트리밍을 통해 훈련 현장을 연동하고, 훈련 전체를 통제하고 돌발 이벤트를 발생시킬 수 있는 비상 훈련 제어 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Integrating Management System for Power Distributor Station
title_ko: 배전스테이션 통합관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated management system for a power distribution station, which enables video information, augmented reality (AR) information, and virtual reality (VR) information about a power distribution station to be provided to mobile devices of field workers through an education system, an AR system, and a VR system. The integrated management system of the present invention comprises: a main server receiving a facility database (DB) for a plurality of power distribution stations to be managed from an external power facility DB; a mobile device receiving comprehensive information from the main server; an operating system generating AR data and VR data for a specific power distribution station based on the facility DB; an education system storing a plurality of pieces of video information; an AR system generating AR information about the specific power distribution station based on the AR data; and a VR system generating VR information about the specific power distribution station based on the VR data, wherein the facility DB includes a distribution facility DB, an air conditioning facility DB, and a firefighting facility DB and the comprehensive information includes the video information, the AR information, and the VR information.
