In addition, the video information includes a power distribution station inspection and repair education video and the comprehensive information is transmitted through the operating system to the main server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 교육시스템, AR시스템 및 VR시스템을 통해 배전스테이션에 대한 동영상정보, 증강현실정보 및 가상현실정보가 현장작업자의 휴대기기에 제공되는 배전스테이션 통합관리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 외부 전력설비 DB로부터 관리대상인 복수의 배전스테이션에 대한 설비DB를 제공받는 메인서버; 상기 메인서버로부터 종합정보를 제공받는 휴대기기; 상기 설비DB를 토대로 특정 배전스테이션에 대한 AR데이터 및 VR데이터를 생성하는 운영시스템; 복수의 동영상정보를 저장하는 교육시스템; 상기 AR데이터를 토대로 특정 배전스테이션에 대한 증강현실정보를 생성하는 AR시스템; 및 상기 VR데이터를 토대로 특정 배전스테이션에 대한 가상현실정보를 생성하는 VR시스템;으로 이루어지며, 상기 설비DB에는 배전설비DB, 공조설비DB, 소방설비DB가 포함되고, 상기 종합정보에는 상기 동영상정보, 증강현실정보 및 가상현실정보가 포함되며, 상기 동영상정보에는 배전스테이션의 점검보수 교육 동영상이 포함되고, 상기 종합정보는 운영시스템을 거쳐 상기 메인서버에 전달되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Construction site safety management monitoring system and method
title_ko: Iot를 이용한 건설현장 소음 및 환경관리 시스템
abstract_en: A construction site safety management monitoring system is built to provide functions in real time through a smartphone and a management PC, wherein the functions include access management, biometric worker/visitor access management using a biometric device (fingerprint recognition, hand vessels, finger veins, face recognition, heartrate measurement or the like) and health condition monitoring based on heartrate measurement, location tracking of a beacon tag attached to a pass, announcement of emergency contacts and construction site precautions (electric safety equipment precautions, excavator precautions and the like), management of construction materials/dangerous substances, harmful gas sensor monitoring in dangerous areas, drilling status monitoring, weather information provision (weather, temperature, rainfall, wind directions, wind velocity and the like), web camera monitoring for responding to a disaster accident in a dangerous area, smartphone monitoring, electronic display interconnection, and checking/management of access personnel and working environments.
abstract_ko: 공사 현장 안전관리 모니터링 시스템을 구축하여 스마트폰과 관리 PC를 통하여 실시간으로 출입관리, 생체인식기(지문 인식, 손혈관, 지정맥, 얼굴 인식, 심박수 측정 등)에 의한 작업자/방문자의 생체인식 출입 관리와 심박수 측정에 의한 건강 상태 모니터링, 출입증에 부착된 비콘 태그 위치 추적,비상연락망과 공사현장 주의사항(전기 안전 설비 주의사항, 굴착시 주의 사항 등) 공지, 건설 자재/위험 물질 관리, 위험 지역의 유해 가스 센서 모니터링, 굴진 상황 모니터링, 실시간 작업 상황 모니터링, 기상정보 제공(날씨, 기온, 강수량, 풍향, 풍속 등), 위험 지역 재난사고 대응을 위해 웹 카메라 모니터링과 스마트폰 모니터링, 전광판 연동 기능을 제공하며, 출입인원 및 작업 환경의 확인/관리 기능을 제공한다.

title_en: Apparatus for mesuring training information in real time and monitoring system for training situation using the same
title_ko: 실시간 훈련정보 측정 장치 및 이를 이용한 훈련상황 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: An apparatus for measuring training information in real time according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a first communication module which receives training information transmitted from at least one device worn by training members participating in fire drills; a first processor which measures and analyzes, in real time, at least one piece of information on air consumption of oxygen cylinders worn by the training members, location information of the training members, and information on a heart rate of the training members based on the received training information; and a first database in which the information measured and analyzed in real time is stored in conjunction with the first processor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 의한 소방훈련에 참여하는 훈련대원들이 착용한 적어도 하나의 기기로부터 전송된 훈련정보들을 수신하는 제1 통신모듈; 상기 수신된 훈련정보들에 기반하여 상기 훈련대원들이 착용한 산소통의 공기소모량 정보, 훈련대원들의 위치 정보, 및 훈련대원들의 심박 정보 중 적어도 하나의 정보를 실시간으로 측정 및 분석하는 제1 프로세서; 및 상기 제1 프로세서와 연동하여 상기 실시간으로 측정 및 분석된 정보들이 저장되는 제1 데이터베이스를 포함한다.
assignees: TAN SAN ELECTRONICS;UNIV HOSEO ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Wind pressure type-haptic fire-fighting nozzle interface for virtual fire-fighting training and operating method thereof
title_ko: 가상 소방훈련을 위한 풍압식 햅틱 소방 관창 인터페이스 및 그의 동작 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a wind pressure type haptic firefighting pipe window interface that is linked to a virtual reality content for virtual firefighting training. The wind pressure type haptic firefighting pipe window interface comprises: a waterproof lever that adjusts an intensity of water sprayed on the virtual reality content; a nozzle adjuster that adjusts a spray shape according to a radiation angle of water sprayed on the virtual reality content; and at least one first haptic device that uses wind pressure to provide haptic feedback corresponding to the spray intensity and the spray shape of the water, which are determined according to a control through the waterproof lever and the nozzle controller. Therefore, the present invention is capable of increasing training efficiency.
abstract_ko: 가상 소방훈련을 위한 가상현실 컨텐츠와 연동되는 풍압식 햅틱 소방 관창 인터페이스가 제공된다. 풍압식 햅틱 소방 관창 인터페이스는 상기 가상현실 컨텐츠 상에서 분사되는 물의 세기를 조절하는 방수 레버, 상기 가상현실 컨텐츠 상에서 분사되는 물의 방사각에 따른 분사 형태를 조절하는 노즐 조절기, 그리고 상기 방수 레버 및 상기 노즐 제어기를 통한 제어에 따라 결정되는 물의 분사 세기와 상기 분사 형태에 대응하는 햅틱 피드백을 풍압을 이용하여 제공하는 적어도 하나의 제1 햅틱 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: System and Method for simulation of air cooling and heating load of building
title_ko: 건물 냉·난방 부하 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for prediction simulation for cooling and heating load of a building, which comprises: a collection part which collects measurement data including energy usage, electricity, air conditioning, crime prevention, and disaster prevention facility management data of a target building from a Building Energy Management System (BEMS); an identifying part which identifies in real time indoor/outdoor temperature/humidity and solar radiation quantity measured in the building based on a Radiant Time Series Method (RTSM); a relation derivation part which derives a correlation between the energy usage and cooling and heating load according to the indoor/outdoor temperature/humidity and solar radiation quantity identified from the identifying part, based on BEMS measurement data collected from the collection part; a simulation part which simulates a cooling and heating load change according to at least one change of the measurement data based on the correlation derived from the relation derivation part; and an information providing part which provides a simulation result from the simulation part to a user terminal in a visible form. The present invention can calculate and visualize actual cooling and heating load of a target building by the hour using indoor/outdoor temperature/humidity and solar radiation quantity measured in the building in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물 냉·난방 부하 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 건물 에너지 관리 시스템(BEMS)으로부터 대상 건물의 에너지 사용량 및, 전기, 공조, 방범, 방재 설비 관리 데이터를 포함하는 계측 데이터를 수집하는 수집부, 복사시계열(Radiant Time Series; RTS법)을 기반으로 실시간으로 건물에서 계측되는 실내외 온·습도 및 일사량을 파악하는 파악부, 상기 수집부에서 수집된 건물 에너지 관리 시스템(BEMS) 계측 데이터에 기반하여 에너지 사용량과 상기 파악부에서 파악된 실내외 온·습도 및 일사량에 따른 냉·난방 부하와의 상관 관계를 도출하는 관계 도출부, 상기 관계 도출부에서 도출된 상관 관계에 기반하여 계측 데이터 중 적어도 하나의 변화에 따른 냉·난방 부하 변화를 시뮬레이션하는 시뮬레이션부 및 상기 시뮬레이션부에서 시뮬레이션 결과를 사용자 단말로 가시적인 형태로 제공해주는 정보 제공부를 포함한다.

title_en: Multiphase explosion flow field temperature simulation method based on saturated vapor pressure model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multiphase explosion flow field temperature simulation method based on a saturated vapor pressure model, and belongs to the technical field of explosion mechanics. According to the invention, the three-dimensional gas-solid two-phase explosion model added with the saturated vapor pressure model is processed, the influence of the real reverse reaction temperature on the Al dust explosion flow field is determined, the numerical simulation of the Al dust single dust explosion and Al-RDX mixed dust explosion process is carried out, the high-precision prediction of the multiphase explosion flow field is realized, and the precise prediction of the large-scale solid warm-pressing fuel RDX dust, al dust and Al-RDX mixed dust explosion process is realized. The CE/SE method and the fourth-order Dragon-Gregory tower method are adopted to process the two-phase explosion model, the construction process is convenient, the simulation precision is high, the flow field interruption can be accurately captured, and the reliability of the simulation of the multiphase explosion flow number is improved; the method can be applied to temperature and pressure effect analysis of temperature and pressure weapon explosion, and realize digitization of temperature and pressure ammunition development; the method can provide technical support for explosion disaster prevention and control and accident investigation of Al dust.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH;UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM BEIJING

title_en: Passenger ship fire personnel evacuation simulation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a passenger ship fire personnel evacuation simulation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: building a fire accident simulation scene model of the passenger ship; determining evacuation influence coefficients corresponding to preset fire parameters; classifying the types of the personnel in the simulation scene model, and improving the basic cellular automaton model based on the classified personnel types and evacuation influence coefficients corresponding to fire parameters; and simulating a person evacuation process in the simulation scene model according to the improved cellular automaton model and the preset conflict resolution method. According to the invention, the action influence of fire parameters on evacuation personnel is quantitatively considered, the basic cellular automaton model is improved according to the evacuation influence coefficient and the personnel type, and the personnel evacuation process is simulated by utilizing the improved cellular automaton model and a preset conflict resolution method, so that the evacuation situation of the passenger ship when the fire disaster occurs can be more accurately simulated, and theoretical guidance is provided for formulating a personnel evacuation scheme of the passenger ship fire disaster accident.

title_en: Coal seam three-dimensional model construction method based on through-layer drilling construction data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a three-dimensional model of a coal seam based on construction data of a through-layer drilling, and belongs to the field of coal mine geology. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring coal mine layer-penetrating drilling construction data; according to the drilling construction data, a spatial position algorithm is applied, and the spatial coordinates of each drilling coal-seeing point and coal-discharging point are calculated; respectively carrying out three-dimensional interpolation, resampling, point thinning and three-dimensional interpolation again on the space coordinate data of all the coal-seen points and the coal-out points to obtain a curved surface diagram of a coal seam roof and a coal seam bottom plate; and sewing the periphery of the curved surface graph of the top and bottom plates of the coal bed to form a three-dimensional model of the coal bed. The method can generate the high-precision three-dimensional model of the coal seam by using the construction data of the through-layer drilling, provides powerful support for grasping occurrence characteristics of the coal seam, precise disaster prevention and control, transparent geology and intelligent coal mining, and has important significance for safe and efficient production of the coal seam.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Test device for simulating whole process movement of collapse rock under earthquake action
abstract_en: The application relates to a test device for simulating whole-process movement of collapse rock under the action of an earthquake, which belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and geological engineering tests and comprises an irregular rock mass construction system, a model box, a stacking body model, a collapse rock throwing system, a vibrating table and a data monitoring and collecting system. According to the test device for simulating the full-process movement of the collapse rock under the earthquake action, the full-process movement test of the collapse rock under the earthquake action can be carried out under the conditions of various working conditions by the mutual cooperation of the model box, the stacking body model, the collapse rock throwing system and the vibrating table, the data monitoring and collecting system monitors the full-process movement test and collects data information, the obtained test result is reliable, the full-process movement characteristics of the collapse rock under the earthquake vibration effect and the dynamic response characteristics and deformation characteristics of the stacking body side slope can be well interpreted, and scientific basis and technical support are provided for earthquake high-incidence area collapse rock disaster assessment and comprehensive prevention and control.

title_en: Evacuation elevator dispatching strategy optimization method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium for optimizing an evacuation elevator dispatching strategy, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprise the steps of constructing a building simulation scene containing an elevator, constructing a personnel evacuation scene in the building simulation scene, and determining an initial environmental state in the personnel evacuation scene; carrying out evacuation simulation training on the building simulation scene; respectively calculating the rewards corresponding to each instruction in the evacuation simulation training, and summing the rewards corresponding to all the instructions to obtain a total rewards of the evacuation simulation training; repeating evacuation simulation training on the building simulation scene, calculating to obtain the corresponding rewards total value of each evacuation simulation, stopping repeating the evacuation simulation until a plurality of continuously calculated rewards total values reach a convergence state, and obtaining the trained evacuation elevator dispatching model. The method and the device are used for solving the technical problem that the existing fixed scheduling strategy is difficult to cope with real-time and changeable emergency situations, and finally the evacuation efficiency is low.

title_en: Building internal-external interaction three-dimensional fire spreading behavior simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation experiment device for internal-external interactive three-dimensional fire spreading behavior of a building, which comprises a transparent corridor on the bottom surface, wherein the corridor comprises three fixed wall surfaces and a movable wall surface, the side wall of the support is provided with a sliding device, and the sliding device is in transmission connection with the movable wall surface and is used for adjusting the width of the corridor; the chamber is connected at the back side of the fixed wall surface that sets up relatively with the movable wall surface, is provided with burner in the chamber, and the one end that the chamber is close to the corridor communicates with the corridor, and the chamber other end communicates with the cavity external world, and chamber both ends opening can be sealed, and chamber both ends opening size is adjustable. The invention can conveniently and continuously adjust the width of the corridor, and is convenient for observing and recording the evolution rule and behavior characteristics of the overflow flame in the corridor and near the wall surface and measuring the characteristic parameters of the fire disaster. In addition, when the fire disaster occurs in the building indoor space, the evolution mechanism of the fire overflow of the opening of the corridor in the building and the fire overflow of the opening of the near wall surface of the building and the behavior characteristics of the smoke spreading are studied intensively.

title_en: Device for preventing and controlling composite coal and rock dynamic disasters by means of transverse and longitudinal cutting of ultrahigh-pressure water jet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrahigh-pressure water jet transverse-cutting longitudinal-cutting composite coal and rock dynamic disaster prevention and control device, which comprises a drill rod, a drill bit, a first blocking ring piece, a second blocking ring piece, a spray head and a feeding assembly, wherein the drill rod is a rigid hollow rod body, the drill bit is fixed on one side of the drill rod, the first blocking ring piece and the second blocking ring piece are fixed on the outer part of the drill rod, the spray head is radially embedded in the side part of the drill rod, the spray head is fed by the feeding assembly, the feeding assembly is positioned in the drill rod, the spray head is positioned between the first blocking ring piece and the second blocking ring piece, and a fracturing space can be formed between the first blocking ring piece and the second blocking ring piece and a drill hole, so that the spray head is utilized to conduct range hydraulic fracturing before water jet cutting.

title_en: Self-adaptive multistage buffering anti-spraying hole device for gas extraction drilling spraying holes
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine gas disaster management, in particular to a self-adaptive multi-stage buffering anti-spraying hole device for a gas extraction drilling spraying hole, which comprises the following components: the orifice blowout preventer and the gas-slag separator are communicated through a buffer connecting pipe; the orifice blowout preventer is provided with a sleeve pipe for being inserted into the coal seam; a slag discharging port is arranged at the bottom of one side surface of the gas-slag separation device, and a baffle is rotationally connected to the slag discharging port on the outer side surface of the gas-slag separation device; the other side surface of the gas-slag separation device is provided with a storage box, one end of the storage box, which is far away from the gas-slag separation device, is provided with a movable baffle plate in rotary connection, and a telescopic bag is arranged in the storage box and is communicated with the gas-slag separation device through a communication hole; the orifice blowout preventer, the gas-slag separator and the telescopic bag are communicated with the extraction pipeline. The self-adaptive buffer volume change can be carried out, slag is automatically discharged and sealing is carried out, so that gas leakage to the drill site space is prevented from causing gas overrun, and mine safety production is guaranteed.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: High side slope capillary reinforcement construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building construction, in particular to a high slope capillary reinforcement construction method, which comprises the following steps of S1, judging parameters of a high slope according to preset requirements; step S2, establishing a corresponding geographic environment model, substituting the geographic environment model into the high slope parameters for simulation experiments, and correspondingly adjusting a preset high slope structure according to experimental results; and S3, judging a slope protection mode of the high slope according to the adjusted preset high slope structure, and learning geographic environment data corresponding to the preset high slope structure and the slope protection mode. According to the invention, the earthwork high slope is filled through the specific structure, so that the drainage of the inside of the slope is facilitated, the slope stability is improved, meanwhile, the geographic environment model is utilized to simulate the structural strength of the preset high slope, the preset high slope structure is adjusted and deeply studied according to the simulation result, the accuracy of the disaster bearing prediction result of the high slope is improved, and the slope stability is further improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG NO 3 WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDRO ELECTRIC ENG BOARD CO LTD

title_en: Power system risk assessment method, device and storage medium in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system risk assessment method, a device and a storage medium in extreme weather, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of different types of extreme weather, and generating a weather scene within one year by using a sequential Monte Carlo simulation method; based on the weather scene, obtaining disaster-causing factor distribution conditions in different time periods in one year by adopting a random sampling method according to a preset disaster-causing factor probability distribution model; obtaining the corresponding fault probability of the power element according to the disaster causing factor distribution condition and the vulnerability curve of the power element, and obtaining the states of the power element in different time periods within one year by adopting a random sampling method; and calculating to obtain the medium-and-long-term risk assessment index of the power system according to the power element state and the direct current power flow model. The method can evaluate the medium-and-long-term risk condition of the power system more comprehensively and accurately, and provide reference for further planning of the power system so as to resist the threat brought by extreme weather events.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Scene-restriction-free emergency escape agent decision generation method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency escape decision calculation, and relates to a scene-free emergency escape agent decision generation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring disaster scene environment information acquired by a plurality of intelligent objects, and generating accident scene time sequence information according to the environment information; dividing accident scene time sequence information into a plurality of uniform blocks, and determining intelligent environment multi-mode data according to the uniform blocks; generating a visual model of disaster scene evolution according to the multi-mode data; constructing an emotion model according to the multi-mode data, and calculating an emotion factor of the current agent; obtaining a random factor through a random model according to disaster scene environment information; training the disaster escape decision body model to obtain a mature disaster escape decision body model; inputting the environmental information of the scene to be detected into a mature disaster escape decision-making body model to generate an optimal intelligent emergency escape decision. The method can calculate the optimal escape strategy in any disaster place in real time, effectively guide people to evacuate, and reduce loss.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary internet of vehicles data collection method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary internet of vehicles data collection method based on deep reinforcement learning, and belongs to the field of wireless communication. The method comprises the steps of constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary internet of vehicles data collection system model, dividing virtual grids, simplifying and optimizing problems by utilizing grid management, training network parameters, and selecting optimal actions to complete data collection tasks. The unmanned aerial vehicle route planning system has the advantages that unmanned aerial vehicle can timely collect information of the operation of the Internet of vehicles, autonomous route planning of the unmanned aerial vehicle is achieved, information dimension of vehicles is increased, information collection work can be better achieved, timely assistance is provided for the Internet of vehicles system, complexity of a training algorithm of the unmanned aerial vehicle route planning is simplified, and the unmanned aerial vehicle route planning system has high application value. Under the scene of emergency disaster relief, the method and the system can improve the reliability of unmanned aerial vehicle data collection and the timeliness of Internet of vehicles emergency communication.
assignees: UNIV JILIN;CHANGCHUN BOER COMMUNICATION TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Test method for simulating full-process movement of collapse rock under earthquake action by same device
abstract_en: The application relates to a test method for simulating the whole process movement of collapse rock under the action of earthquake by using the same device, which belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and geological engineering tests. The test method for simulating the whole-process movement of the collapse rock under the earthquake action by the same device can be used for carrying out the whole-process movement test of the collapse rock under the earthquake action under various working conditions, is simple and safe in operation and reliable in test result, can better explain the whole-process movement characteristics of the collapse rock under the earthquake vibration effect and the dynamic response characteristics and deformation characteristics of the side slope of the accumulation body, and provides scientific basis and technical support for evaluation and comprehensive prevention and control of collapse rock disasters in the earthquake high-rise area.

title_en: Crowd safety evacuation simulation method under extreme precipitation event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd safety evacuation simulation method under an extreme precipitation event, which comprises the following steps of S1: based on the two-dimensional shallow water model, carrying out extreme precipitation simulation to form flood inundation data; step S2: obtaining mobile phone signaling data based on a communication company to realize crowd area positioning; step S3: based on flood inundation data, performing risk analysis, and determining an optimal refuge site by combining a multi-objective equation; step S4: adopting an ABM model to simulate crowd evacuation; step S5: determining disaster-stricken people, determining people according to the people distribution data, and notifying; and determining an optimal evacuation route based on the evacuation simulation result. The invention adopts the crowd safety evacuation simulation method under the extreme rainfall event, and the method is based on a model technology based on a main body, and combines crowd distribution data to realize the rapid and accurate formation of urban crowd evacuation strategies under the flood disasters.

title_en: Urban road network toughness optimization method and system for disturbance of defective road sections
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban road network characteristic analysis, in particular to an urban road network toughness optimization method and system for disturbance of a defective road section, wherein step S1 provides an urban road network toughness evaluation index, the road network toughness optimization method provided by step S3 can consider a plurality of defective road sections, macroscopically regulate and control the traffic capacity of the whole road network, thereby improving the road network toughness, step S2 provides traffic flow simulation and verification feasibility, can provide a new technology and a new method for urban road network toughness optimization, has important theoretical significance and application value in the aspects of soundness, perfection of an emergency response mechanism of the urban road network for handling sudden events and the like, and is beneficial to improving the urban road network toughness, enhancing the bearing capacity of the urban road network and the risk prevention and control capacity.
assignees: SHENZHEN PLANNING AND NATURAL RESOURCES DATA MAN CENTER SHENZHEN SPACE GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION CENTER;UNIV JILIN

title_en: Nuclear power station cable laying simulation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a nuclear power plant cabling simulation method, a device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a nuclear power station cable laying simulation request and cable inventory information; extracting environment temperature information, nuclear radiation partition information and disaster partition information of a simulation area carried by a nuclear power station cable laying simulation request, and establishing a three-dimensional factory building model according to the extracted information; performing cable laying simulation to obtain a cable laying simulation result; checking whether a cable laying simulation result is abnormal according to the environment temperature information, the nuclear radiation partition information and the disaster partition information of the simulation area, and if so, acquiring an abnormal influence factor corresponding to the abnormal result of the checking result; and feeding back abnormal influence factors to the two-dimensional electrical design system, receiving corrected cable inventory information, and returning to perform cable laying simulation to obtain a cable laying simulation result. By adopting the method, an accurate simulation result can be obtained.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER INST CO LTD;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fire source safety exposure distance detection system and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire source safety exposure distance detection system which comprises a heat source simulation module, a fabric moving device and a data acquisition module, wherein the heat source simulation module is used for simulating the fire source condition when a fire disaster occurs and controlling the temperature to be stable at a set value, the fabric moving device is used for fixing fabrics of an experimental sample and adjusting the distance between a heat source and the fabrics, and the data acquisition module is used for acquiring the environment temperature in the heat exposure process, acquiring the heat flux density reaching the surface of a sensor through the fabrics and simulating skin to acquire information. The invention provides a fire source safety exposure distance detection system, which is used for confirming the detection of the fire source safety exposure distance under the safety condition, facilitating better data collection, evaluating the safety exposure distance of firefighters in a fire environment and improving the fire extinguishing safety and the working efficiency of the firefighters. The invention also provides a detection method.

title_en: Combat training safety control case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combat training safety control box, which comprises an upper box cover and a lower box body, wherein a combat duration monitoring mechanism is arranged in the lower box body and comprises a power supply unit and a plurality of duration monitoring units; the power supply unit supplies power to each duration monitoring unit; each time length monitoring unit comprises a circuit board, wherein the circuit board is provided with a magnetic induction detection unit, a controller, a time length display and adjustment unit and a warning and reminding unit; the magnetic induction sensor, the duration display and adjustment unit and the warning reminding unit of the magnetic induction detection unit are connected with the controller. Each duration monitoring unit monitors a firefighter, the magnetic induction detection unit senses a signal to the controller, the controller starts the duration display adjustment unit, the controller signals the duration display adjustment unit after the set time is reached, the controller enables the warning reminding unit to remind the firefighter to withdraw, if the set duration is not returned, the rescue team is organized, and the inside and outside cooperation guarantees the safety of the firefighter.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU FIRE RESCUE DETACHMENT TRAIN BRIGADE

title_en: Risk assessment method and device for hydrologic disaster condition and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating the risks of hydrologic disaster situations and electronic equipment, which relate to the field of three-dimensional digital twinning, and are used for inputting the forecast rainfall and the forecast rainfall time into a three-dimensional simulation model of a river basin after receiving the forecast rainfall of the target river basin in real time, outputting river basin water level change parameters, wherein the three-dimensional simulation model of the river basin comprises the dam heights of various river courses of the target river basin and the river basin water level heights acquired in real time, evaluating various points where the disaster situations possibly occur in the target river basin based on the river basin water level change parameters to obtain disaster situation point coordinates, and generating a disaster situation risk graph related to the target river basin based on the disaster situation point coordinates, the dam heights of the river courses and the river basin water level change parameters.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Gas extraction and regional outburst elimination method for crushed soft coal layer stoping working face
abstract_en: The invention discloses gas extraction and regional outburst elimination by normal rotary drilling on a bedding layer of a stoping working face, wherein gas extraction blind areas and regional outburst elimination of blind areas are defined by combined analysis of drilling group tracks and drilling records, and the gas extraction and regional outburst elimination of the blind areas are realized by directional long drilling. Due to the adoption of the novel drilling construction technology for measuring and controlling and directional blind supplementing of the common drilling track in the working face gateway construction, the drilling extraction non-blind area is ensured, the gas extraction efficiency and effect are improved, and the safety production of the stoping working face is ensured. The method organically combines the advantages of quick construction, low cost, long construction distance of directional drilling and good effect of common drilling, avoids the development of a bottom-pumped roadway and the layer-penetrating drilling engineering, obviously reduces the disaster recovery cost, greatly shortens the disaster recovery period and powerfully ensures the production succession of a stope face.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Coal gangue hill spontaneous combustion hidden high-temperature heat source early warning monitoring treatment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal gangue mountain spontaneous combustion hidden high-temperature heat source early warning monitoring and treatment system, which comprises three modules, namely pre-disaster continuous early warning, in-disaster graded treatment and post-disaster real-time monitoring. An unmanned aerial vehicle carrying an infrared thermal imager and a camera monitors the spontaneous combustion concealed high-temperature area of the coal gangue hill in real time, and a drilling temperature measuring and gas measuring ring is used for determining the position of a smoldering high-temperature point. The multiphase resistance gel foam is prepared by using a magnetization pressurization foam generating device in the vibration-proof mining fire-extinguishing rescue vehicle. The magnetized and pressurized foam generating device sucks nitrogen through turbine power, and magnetic stirring promotes raw materials to be mixed in a rotating mode and conveyed to a pouring port power. The full-stage fire extinguishing process for sealing holes of the plugging device by using loess coverage, waste dump drilling, high-pressure water punching and multiphase-resistance gel foam fire extinguishing and monitoring coal spontaneous combustion parameters. The coal gangue hill level divides three dangerous grade areas, adopts different drilling intervals and depths to carry out zonal classification and zonal treatment, and ensures the stopping effect of spontaneous combustion of coal, the re-combustion inhibition efficiency and the monitoring continuity after disaster.

title_en: Active urban waterlogging early warning method and device and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active urban waterlogging early warning method, an active urban waterlogging early warning device and a storage medium thereof, relating to the technical field of waterlogging early warning, and comprising the following steps: constructing a one-dimensional drainage network model and a two-dimensional earth surface inundation model based on geographic information, drainage network information, node steps and river channel information of a target city, and coupling the model into a city inundation simulation model; building a storm waterlogging data bin to receive real-time water quantity related information at preset frequency, and calling an urban waterlogging simulation model when the real-time water quantity related information exceeds a corresponding preset threshold value; rolling prediction is carried out by taking corresponding water quantity related information exceeding a preset threshold value as a boundary condition through an urban waterlogging simulation model; according to the real-time prediction result, the real-time prediction result is superimposed on the online map and visualized display is carried out; and superposing the target building facility layer to an online map, obtaining the maximum water depth and the inundation duration of the waterlogging, and carrying out data display. By means of rolling prediction, the method improves the prospective of waterlogging early warning, and post-disaster treatment is changed into active pre-disaster prevention.
assignees: NINGBO HONGTAI WATER CONSERVANCY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line damage early warning method based on three-dimensional simulation wind field simulation technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line damage early warning method based on a three-dimensional simulation wind field simulation technology, which utilizes real wind data to simulate a wind field model in a three-dimensional simulation system, projects a line to the wind field model according to power transmission line coordinate data, establishes a mathematical model according to the corresponding relation between wind intensity of different coordinate positions and designed wind bearing intensity of a tower, calculates the damage probability of the line tower in a wind field, and carries out early warning and alarm processing on the line tower by a damage threshold. The method is suitable for early warning of wind disaster damage of the power transmission line, and realizes real-time monitoring, timely early warning and emergency treatment of the damage condition of the power transmission line tower by carrying different scene sensing devices on the line equipment.
assignees: FUJIAN HOSHING HI TECH IND CO LTD

title_en: Inspection robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of mine inspection, especially relates to an inspection robot, include: the walking unit is used for realizing the movement of the robot, and the walking unit is provided with: the detection unit is used for detecting the environment in the roadway; the video unit is used for shooting images in the tunnel; the drilling unit is used for surrounding rock drilling; the grouting unit is used for grouting surrounding rock; the transmission unit is used for transmitting the information detected by the detection unit and the image shot by the video unit to the background; and the remote control unit is used for remotely controlling the running unit, the detection unit, the drilling unit and the grouting unit to run. The method has the effect of reducing disaster in the mine in the inspection process.

title_en: Forest fire rescue simulation system, method, device and equipment with multiple intelligent agents
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-agent forest fire rescue simulation system, a method, a device and equipment, which are used for solving the problems that forest fire rescue simulation generalization is poor and simulation results are distorted due to the fact that forest fire spreading simulation and forest fire rescue simulation cannot be combined in the related technology, and comprise the following steps: the management type agents comprise a perceptron agent for perceiving environmental changes, a clicker agent for creating time instructions, a creator agent for creating instructions and a collector agent for acquiring state changes of the agents; the business type intelligent agents comprise at least one rescue unit type intelligent agent for simulating a rescue unit and at least one disaster type intelligent agent for simulating a forest fire scene; the simulation service layer comprises a plurality of calculation models used for calculation in forest fire rescue scenes.
assignees: BEIJING GLOBAL SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster weather risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster weather risk early warning method and a geological disaster weather risk early warning system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting geological disaster points and rainfall records of a target area which induce geological disasters due to heavy rainfall or continuous rainfall, and constructing a geological disaster data set; selecting a plurality of geological environment characteristics of geological disaster points, and establishing a geological environment data set; calculating rainfall records in the geological disaster data set into rainfall index features of different times to obtain a rainfall feature data set; establishing a rainfall-reducing geological disaster sample set training geological disaster weather risk early warning model based on the TCN-Attention network model; and carrying out geological disaster weather risk early warning on the target area through the trained geological disaster weather risk early warning model. The invention carries out deep analysis on the time correlation among the geological disaster data set, the geological environment data set and the rainfall characteristic data set based on the TCN-Attention network model, realizes the coupling of fine geological-meteorological data and improves the accuracy of risk early warning.
assignees: HUANG WEI;ZHANG PENG;LUO KAI;SONG YONGFEI;LIU ZHIJIAN;TIAN YAN

title_en: Semi-supervised change detection flood identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-supervised change detection flood identification method, which comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing an acquired sentinel first-number image pair, and manufacturing a flood change water body label; s2, constructing a semi-supervised change detection network; s3, calculating total loss of unsupervised loss and supervised loss, automatically calculating gradients of all parameters in a supervised learning network by using a deep learning framework, optimizing the parameters by using an optimizer, meeting set conditions, and storing network parameters of the supervised learning network with highest verification accuracy; s4, inputting the first-sentinel images before and after flood in the disaster area into a semi-supervised change detection network for training, and obtaining a flood change water prediction result. According to the invention, the flood water body characteristics are learned in a large number of non-label image pairs, so that the monitoring learning network can better identify flood by only needing less label data, obtain higher identification accuracy and other evaluation indexes, and save a large number of time and resources consumed by manual labeling.

title_en: Defensive teaching demonstration teaching aid based on meteorological disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a defending teaching demonstration teaching aid based on a meteorological disaster, which comprises a demonstration table, an adjusting mechanism and a wind simulating mechanism, wherein a pressure tester is arranged at one end of the demonstration table, a scale is fixed at the upper end of the outer wall of the demonstration table, the adjusting mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the outer wall of the demonstration table, the defending teaching demonstration teaching aid based on the meteorological disaster is arranged, the adjusting mechanism is arranged to drive a screw rod to rotate through a rotary knob so as to control a movable seat to move, the spacing of building models can be adjusted, different wind forces can be simulated when different spacing building models form the 'narrow pipe effect' during the 'narrow pipe effect' simulation effect, the building models can be conveniently disassembled and assembled through the clamping connection of clamping blocks and clamping grooves, the building models with different shapes can be replaced for testing, the simulation experiment effect is increased, and the using effect and the teaching quality of the device are effectively improved.
assignees: ZHONGKE FEILONG XIAMEN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Urban storm waterlogging disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a disaster simulation device, in particular to a city storm waterlogging disaster simulation device. The utility model provides a city storm waterlogging disaster simulation device capable of intuitively displaying the situation of storm waterlogging on city destruction. The utility model provides a city storm waterlogging disaster simulation device, which comprises a supporting seat, a city building sand table, a first water tank, a water pump and the like; be provided with the city building sand table of simulation city building on the supporting seat, one side of supporting seat is provided with first water tank, and the water pump is installed at first water tank top. The water pump is used for pumping water to the first water pipe, the first water pipe or the second water pipe is used for conveying the water to the urban construction sand table on the supporting seat, and the flow rate of the water is regulated through the first valve and the second valve, so that the storm and the flood are simulated to form waterlogging disasters in cities, and the damage scene of the waterlogging disasters to the cities is intuitively displayed.

title_en: Device and system for testing shield tunnel sudden surge disaster-causing centrifugal machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device and a system for testing a shield tunnel surge disaster-causing centrifugal machine. The model box is of a box body structure with an open top, and a water baffle plate arranged vertically is arranged in the model box to divide the model box into a first box chamber and a second box chamber; two parallel water permeable plates are arranged in the first box chamber at intervals, the middle area of each water permeable plate is a soil groove, and the other side of each water permeable plate is a water groove; one end of the tunnel model is buried in the soil tank, the end is closed, and the other end of the tunnel model extends into the second box chamber and is provided with an open end; the tunnel model is formed by longitudinally splicing a plurality of circular rings, and at least one circular ring of the tunnel model in the soil tank is a circular ring with a loss seam. The test device and the test system can simulate the tunnel surge disaster-causing mechanism under various working conditions such as different water levels, stratum conditions, tunnel burial depths, segment loss seam sizes and positions and the like.

title_en: Slope anchoring equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses slope anchoring equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters, which belongs to the technical field of slope anchoring, and adopts the technical scheme that the slope anchoring equipment comprises a structural seat, wherein a carrier plate is connected to the outer side of the structural seat in a sliding manner, a side frame is connected to the rear side of the carrier plate, the structural seat is arranged, the structure can be conveniently placed and used as an installation position of an upper structure, a stress frame is matched with a subframe to install structures such as a driving frame and limit the movement of the carrier plate, a driving motor drives a screw to rotate, the carrier plate in threaded connection with the stress frame can be driven to horizontally move along the stress frame, the arranged side frame is matched with a stand column and an equipment plate to install a drilling machine structure, the drilling machine structure can be conveniently inclined, the inclination angle of the carrier plate relative to the slope can be adjusted, the structure can flexibly horizontally move the position of the drilling machine structure, and the drilling vertical deviation caused by repeated carrying of the drilling machine structure is avoided.
assignees: SICHUAN HUADI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Experimental device for simulating saturated slope soil body to be converted into debris flow
abstract_en: An experimental device for simulating transformation of saturated slope soil body into debris flow belongs to the field of landslide debris flow engineering disaster prevention and control. The device comprises a saturation part, a simulated ditch bed and a stacking platform which are connected at one time; at least two front and rear hydraulic lifters are arranged below the simulated ditch bed, concrete precast blocks are paved in the simulated ditch bed, and stone blocks are embedded on the concrete precast blocks; at least two front and rear hydraulic lifters are arranged below the stacking platform, a three-dimensional laser scanner is arranged right behind the stacking platform, and a high-speed camera is arranged right above the stacking platform; and a pore water pressure probe and a stress sensor probe are arranged on the simulated ditch bed and the stacking platform. The device can simulate the instability of slopes with different saturation degrees under different gradients and different channel roughness to be converted into debris flow.

title_en: Fire-fighting robot running performance comprehensive test device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, and particularly relates to a comprehensive testing device for the running performance of a fire-fighting robot. The magnetic powder brake comprises a bearing frame, a rotating speed torque sensor, a magnetic powder brake and a data acquisition and controller; the bearing frame corresponds to the left driving wheel and the right driving wheel of the fire-fighting robot and is divided into a left driving test area and a right driving test area, and a plurality of rollers are arranged in the left driving test area and the right driving test area; the rollers are connected through gear transmission, the rollers at the end part are connected with the magnetic powder brake through a rotating speed torque sensor, the data acquisition and controller controls the magnetic powder brake to simulate resistance, and the rotating speed torque sensor transfers data information to the data acquisition and controller. The fire-fighting robot is arranged in a driving test area, and the generated driving force and the rotation speed information are transmitted to a rotation speed torque sensor through a transmission gear by two rows of metal rollers; the utility model can simulate various disaster relief scenes, has convenient operation and simple and reliable structure, and is beneficial to improving the existing detection level of the fire-fighting robot.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;SHANGHAI QIANGSHI FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: BP neural network-based debris flow disaster vulnerability prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the susceptibility of debris flow disasters based on a BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a debris flow influence factor and a historical disaster dataset in a time sequence of the Qinba mountain area; processing and transforming the data from the time dimension, the space dimension and the index dimension; screening out an evaluation factor through correlation analysis, and further constructing a BP neural network; dividing the data set into a verification set and a training set through equidistant sampling; training the constructed network model by combining Python with a TensorFlow framework to construct a debris flow susceptibility prediction model by taking month as a time dimension. According to the invention, by introducing the BP neural network and effectively combining the spatial and temporal characteristics in the region, the accuracy of debris flow disaster prediction can be greatly improved, and the method has better approximation precision and generalization capability compared with the traditional prediction model.
assignees: XIDIAN UNIV QINGDAO INSTITUTE OF COMPUTING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Magnetotelluric three-dimensional finite element forward modeling method based on conductivity block continuous change
abstract_en: The invention provides a magnetotelluric three-dimensional finite element forward modeling method based on conductivity block continuous change, which comprises the following steps of S1: constructing a three-dimensional geoelectric geometric model of the solving area; s2: dividing the three-dimensional geoelectric geometric model into a plurality of mutually disjoint tetrahedral units; s3: acquiring an integral weak form corresponding to the three-dimensional magnetotelluric problem, and constructing a sparse linear equation set; s4: acquiring control parameters of different areas in the three-dimensional geochemical geometric model; s5: two incident fields with different polarization directions are introduced to obtain the tangential component of the approximate electric field on each corresponding edge; s6: and acquiring a target parameter at the measuring point according to the tangential component of the approximate electric field. According to the forward modeling technology for realizing three-dimensional resistivity block continuous change according to the node finite element and the edge finite element, the invention can realize high-efficiency and high-precision forward calculation of any conductivity parameter assignment, can better simulate underground continuous medium, and is beneficial to developing natural resource investigation of mineral and geothermal, and research of natural disasters of earthquake and volcanic.

title_en: Space geometric construction method of tunnel ultra-deep directional drilling three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space geometry construction method of a three-dimensional model of a tunnel ultra-deep directional drill, which is characterized in that an actual drilling log and a drilling task book are processed in an informatization mode, and a space trigonometric function calculation method is combined with a BIM three-dimensional model generation technology to realize three-dimensional visualization of the tunnel ultra-deep directional drill, so as to carry out multi-angle and multi-scale stereoscopic dynamic observation on the ultra-deep directional drill model. The method has the advantages of digitalization, easy long-term storage, small complexity and high-efficiency calculation process, not only reflects the spatial position form of the ultra-deep directional drill, but also reflects the characteristics of the rock mass in front, can effectively detect and reveal the characteristics of the rock mass in front of the excavation face and the spatial position of the geological disaster body, and can be combined with geophysical prospecting means to form advanced geological forecast comprehensive analysis of the tunnel.

title_en: Multi-model coupling flood risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood risk assessment method with multi-model coupling, which comprises the following steps: obtaining flood basic data of an evaluation area; obtaining flood risk parameters and waterlogging risk parameters according to flood basic data; taking flood risk parameters as influence factors, and obtaining a mountain torrent model result file through MIKE model simulation calculation; taking the waterlogging risk parameter as an influence factor, and obtaining a waterlogging model result file through ICM model simulation calculation; coupling the mountain torrent model result file and the waterlogging model result file to generate a flood risk map; and superposing the socioeconomic data on the flood risk map to generate a flood defense decision guiding scheme. By the method, the advantages of MIKE and ICM software are integrated, and the calculation results of the MIKE mountain flood model and the ICM urban flood model are coupled, so that flood risk calculation is more accurate and rapid, the operation is simple, and important basis can be provided for flood prevention decision and disaster assessment of flood prevention departments and the like by combining socioeconomic data.
assignees: XIAMEN URBAN PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for arranging acoustic emission sensors for coal roadway tunneling coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal roadway tunneling coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring acoustic emission sensor layout method, and belongs to the field of coal mine safety. Selecting a bottom plate roadway below a coal roadway driving working face as a construction roadway for monitoring drilling; and if the floor roadway condition is not met or the distance between the floor roadway and the coal roadway tunneling working face exceeds 80m under the coal seam group mining condition, selecting the penetrated coal roadway construction monitoring drilling holes of the adjacent sections. And performing advanced construction on the monitoring drilling construction roadway to the coal seam roof in front of the coal roadway tunneling working face, monitoring the range of the drilling track avoiding the roadway profile, controlling the final hole point in the coal seam roof rock stratum of the coal roadway to be dug, and installing the acoustic emission sensor to the hole bottom. The method lays the sensor, so that normal tunneling of a coal roadway tunneling working face is not affected, and the monitoring effect can be ensured; aiming at different mine roadway arrangement conditions, a general sensor arrangement mode is provided; meanwhile, a plurality of groups of acoustic emission sensors can be arranged in advance, so that the installation efficiency is improved, and the operation continuity of the monitoring system is ensured.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST;JUNLIAN SICHUAN COAL FURONG XINWEI COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Training method for panoramic monitoring model of power transmission channel and related device and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a training method of a power transmission channel panoramic monitoring model, a related device and a method, wherein a video sequence is obtained by reconstructing a sample video for monitoring the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel, different feature spaces are obtained according to the video sequence, different feature weights are obtained according to the different feature spaces, so that a classification result of monitoring the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel is obtained, the sample video can monitor instantaneous artificial activities or disaster information and can monitor the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel in all weather in real time, the panoramic monitoring model of the power transmission channel is trained through the sample video, the classification result of the panoramic monitoring model of the power transmission channel can more comprehensively reflect the real-time change condition of the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel, the timeliness and the accuracy of monitoring the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel are improved, and the real-time monitoring of the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel is facilitated to timely cope with sudden situations.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method for generating network security emergency response knowledge graph based on text
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a network security emergency response knowledge graph based on text. The method comprises the steps of firstly generating text nodes and node features through a pre-trained coder decoder language model, then outputting query node features through input text and a learnable node query, then generating the node text through LSTM, then fusing the text node features and the query node features to obtain final node features, then generating and fusing edges through a generation mode and a classification mode, and finally training a network through aggregating a loss function and a sparse adjacency matrix. The network security knowledge graph generated by the method has extremely high applicability and accuracy.

title_en: Anchor rod impact tensile mechanical property testing device and testing method
abstract_en: The utility model provides a stock strikes tensile mechanical properties testing arrangement and test method, belong to stock performance testing arrangement technical field, including the external frame, the external frame includes vertical frame, both sides are through bolt fixed mounting limiting plate around the vertical frame bottom, install the slide rail with impact device sliding connection along the inner wall of the stand of vertical setting, in order to control the impact hammer body and apply impact load along the vertical direction, install impact kayser along the stand middle lower part of vertical setting, be located the crossbeam upper surface both ends symmetry of bottom and install the attenuator, prestressing device installs in bottom crossbeam center department, bottom crossbeam upper surface is provided with impact frame, install hoisting device on the crossbeam that is located upper portion. The testing device can simulate the impact load applied to the anchor rod body, the anchoring piece or the anchoring body with the joint by surrounding rock instantaneous damage indoors, and can adjust the impact energy level and the impact rate at the same time, so that the high-energy level impact load induced by deep engineering dynamic disasters can be simulated more truly.

title_en: Emergency management system based on watershed hydropower risk prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of watershed hydropower risk prevention and control, and discloses an emergency management system based on watershed hydropower risk prevention and control, which comprises an emergency management subsystem, an auxiliary decision subsystem and a safety management subsystem; the emergency management subsystem is used for digitally displaying emergency plans, emergency resources, emergency exercises and emergency capability evaluation, and realizing emergency event field simulation, emergency event monitoring data display, emergency real-time message management, emergency resource inquiry and display, emergency analysis and emergency command video consultation after an emergency event occurs. The disaster triggering mechanism is researched by considering the disaster-pregnant environment and the multi-disaster factor coupling effect of the reservoir area, the risk hidden danger is monitored, a watershed disaster emergency treatment auxiliary decision system is constructed on the basis, and the watershed disaster emergency treatment auxiliary decision system is combined with an emergency plan, emergency resources, emergency treatment and emergency capability assessment energy functional module, so that the method has important significance for improving the watershed hydropower safety operation management capability and the emergency treatment decision level.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA HYDROPOWER AND WATER RESOURCES PLANNING AND DESIGN GENERAL INST CO LTD;CHINA WATER CONSERVANCY & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Fire training high-rise fire self-rescue escape device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster self-rescue escape device for a fire disaster training high-rise building, which relates to the technical field of fire disaster training and comprises a main pole frame of a cat ladder, wherein a protective railing cover is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the main pole frame of the cat ladder, a platform plate used for being fixed on a building body is fixedly arranged at the top end of the main pole frame of the cat ladder, a rotating assembly is arranged on the main pole frame of the cat ladder, a limiting assembly is arranged at the joint of the main pole frame of the cat ladder and the platform plate, an installation assembly is arranged on the rotating assembly, and the rotating assembly comprises a first rotating shaft, a ladder plate, a belt pulley, a rotating wheel and a belt, wherein the first rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the main pole frame of the cat ladder, the ladder plate is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the end part of the first rotating shaft, the belt pulley is fixedly arranged at the right end of the ladder plate, and the belt is rotatably connected to the belt pulley; through the rotating assembly that sets up, through this design for the personnel of fleing can be quick flee, labour saving and time saving avoids trampling, and the phenomenon of stacking produces.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHOUJI EMERGENCY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring deep foundation pit in real time by pre-warning
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep foundation pit real-time monitoring method and a deep foundation pit real-time monitoring system for pre-warning, which relate to the technical field of intelligent monitoring, and the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of laying an automatic monitoring acquisition instrument based on deep foundation pit structure information acquired by an image acquisition device, carrying out real-time monitoring on a deep foundation pit, establishing a three-dimensional simulation deep foundation pit based on the internal shape of the deep foundation pit, the external shape of the deep foundation pit and the deep foundation pit structure information, evaluating the state of the deep foundation pit, obtaining a plurality of deep foundation pit evaluation results, inputting a pit collapse model for collapse analysis, outputting disaster analysis results, early warning the potential disasters of the deep foundation pit in advance, and carrying out emergency warning on the deep foundation pit emergency.
assignees: LIAONING POWER TRANS AND DISTRIBUTION ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV SHENYANG AEROSPACE;STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Earthquake-wave multi-field collaborative generation experimental method for offshore anchor-free floating bridge
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental method for large-scale anchor-free floating bridge earthquake-wave multi-field collaborative generation at sea, which belongs to the technical field of offshore civil engineering safety and comprises the following steps: establishing a numerical finite element model of the curved anchor-free floating bridge, giving the maximum heave displacement of each floating foundation in the duration of an earthquake, obtaining the position where the maximum dynamic response of the target degree of freedom appears, and releasing all degrees of freedom at the cutoff boundary of the floating bridge model; designing a large anchor-cable-free floating bridge model; establishing a multi-disaster-place input system; and (5) collecting dynamic response of the large anchor-cable-free floating bridge model. The invention can reproduce the actual earthquake record of the bridge site area and simulate the influence of the earthquake action transmitted by the large-scale floating bridge shore on the dynamic response of the bridge structure; the invention can reproduce the earthquake-wave coupling effect, provides a earthquake-wave multi-field collaborative generation method for a large-scale floating bridge, and provides equipment support for further exploring the dynamic characteristics of the large-scale deep sea anchor-free floating bridge under the multi-disaster effect.

title_en: Fire detection early warning method based on attention mechanism and multi-scale characteristics
abstract_en: A fire detection early warning method based on an attention mechanism and multi-scale features includes the steps of firstly establishing a multi-scene fire data set, preprocessing data, and obtaining a training sample set and a testing sample set; then building an improved deep learning network model Fire-YOLOv5; performing iterative training to minimize a loss function to obtain a trained Fire-YOLOv5 model, and deploying the model into an edge server for tunnel monitoring; the tunnel monitoring acquisition module acquires streaming media data, and performs normalization preprocessing on the acquired video to obtain an image frame sequence of the video; the image frame sequence of the video utilizes the Fire-YOLOv5 model which is completed by training to detect Fire smoke frame by frame; judging and early warning the occurrence of fire disaster through a video frame voting mechanism according to the detection result; the invention can be deployed to different hardware devices, and the proposed Fire-YOLOv5 introduces a co-located attention mechanism in a backbone network, enhances the weight representation of a target position, and realizes better fusion of all scale features; real-time early warning of early fire is realized through a video frame voting mechanism.

title_en: Disaster recovery drills based on checksum validations
abstract_en: A standby site is periodically synchronized to a primary site. The synchronizing includes copying blocks of a source volume at the primary site that have changed since a last synchronization to the standby site, and a bitmap specifying locations of the changed blocks. A synthetic full copy of the source volume is generated at the standby site. The synthetic full backup is validated by using the bitmap to identify locations on the synthetic full backup to verify. These locations correspond to the changed blocks. A progress of the validation is tracked. A user can specify a threshold percentage value of data that upon being validated indicates that the standby site is ready to assume production operation from the primary site. A readiness of the standby site to assume production operation is reported based on the progress of the validation and the threshold percentage value.

title_en: On-board and on-board remote sensing scene classification method based on high-precision full-addition network
abstract_en: The invention provides an on-board and on-board remote sensing scene classification method based on a high-precision full-addition network, which is characterized in that compared with a traditional convolutional neural network, the resource cost required by the full-addition network is greatly reduced during hardware deployment, in addition, the novel network structure is oriented to the full-addition network, the performance loss of the full-addition network is greatly relieved through the proposed training method, the full-addition network with high resource efficiency and superior performance can be obtained by using the proposed training method, the full-addition network is suitable for being applied to the resource sensitive scene for hardware deployment, and in the application environment with strictly limited resource and power consumption, the invention can meet the huge calculation amount and storage requirement of the deep neural network, provides support for realizing the on-line intelligent scene classification of the multifunctional remote sensing images of an on-board and small satellite platform, and plays an important role in the civil and military fields such as disaster early warning, emergency, environment monitoring, information collection and the like.

title_en: Microcosm ecological simulation device for indoor control fire
abstract_en: A microcosm ecological simulation device for controlling fire in a room belongs to the technical field of ecology. The method solves the problem of the authenticity defect that the existing field planned fire test is carried out by using an incubator to simulate an ecological system. The invention discloses a fire control unit which is arranged above a microcosm test barrel body, a temperature acquisition device is arranged on the right side of the microcosm test barrel body, a heat insulation layer of the fire control unit is nested on the inner wall of the upper part of the microcosm test barrel body, and the temperature acquisition device is connected with an in-situ soil column sample in the microcosm test barrel body through a temperature measurement probe. The invention realizes the effect of simulating fire disasters to different degrees on the wetland ecosystem, and has good simulation effect on the change process of the wetland fire disasters. The device has the advantages of simple structure, stable performance and convenient operation.

title_en: Real-time fire monitoring image information extraction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time fire monitoring image information extraction method, which comprises the following steps: step S1, acquiring a fire monitoring image and preprocessing; step S2, constructing a flame identification network based on YOLO V5, and training based on the preprocessed fire monitoring image data; step S3, identifying fire disaster to the monitoring image based on the trained flame identification network and outputting corresponding coordinates; and S4, distinguishing each part of the monitoring image by identifying flame texture samples based on the gray level co-occurrence matrix to obtain a flame profile. According to the invention, the flame picture information is identified and extracted through the DarkNet network structure and the gray level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM).

title_en: Accident disaster evolution simulation method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides an accident disaster evolution simulation method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a safety risk background management module, a safety risk distribution diagram module and a three-dimensional accident evolution simulation module; the method comprises the following steps: uniformly managing the uploaded security risk data; meanwhile, uploading of safety risk data, management of safety risk information and accident emergency resource management are realized; constructing a three-dimensional scene of the chemical storage area, and realizing three-dimensional visual display of risk data of the chemical storage area by adopting a digital twin technology; and realizing evolution simulation of the progress of the chemical accident on a three-dimensional scene. The invention adopts a digital twin technology to display the impending risk of the chemical storage area, prejudges the accident, adopts corresponding positive measures and minimizes the influence of the accident; the full-direction display of the scene situation is realized through the three-dimensional scene, the damage caused by accidents is delayed, and the loss caused by the accidents is reduced.

title_en: Mining rescue WSN node anti-catastrophe performance test method and test system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining rescue WSN node anti-catastrophe performance test method and a test system. The impact simulation device simulates impact force applied to the wireless sensor network node in gas explosion through the impact force of the pendulum bob, and the vertical conveying device completes automatic arrangement of the node through automatic control; the high-speed air flow simulation device simulates the high-speed air flow action of the wireless sensor network node under the disaster condition through the regulation of the fan speed regulation and steering device; the high-temperature simulation device can realize the collision between the node and other nodes in the high-temperature environment after disaster. Compared with the method for simulating the catastrophe environment by using gas, the test method is safer and more controllable; the environment condition of gas explosion of the coal mine tunnel can be simulated to a great extent, and the disaster resistance of the node can be known; one or more of the test parameters may be changed simultaneously, depending on the simulated catastrophe conditions.

title_en: Coal mine belt fire disaster avoidance path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine belt fire disaster avoidance path planning method and system.
