The method comprises the steps of performing informatization management on combustion attributes of ignition objects of the underground belt roadway, and establishing a fine mine roadway three-dimensional model; constructing the equivalent length of the roadway under the influence of a fire escape static factor according to the static attribute of the mine roadway; carrying out numerical simulation on the typical working conditions of the managed ignition points to obtain a fire spreading rule, and constructing key index time characteristics of reaching each roadway when the fire spreading occurs under different working conditions of different fire source sites; the fire source working condition case with the highest similarity is searched from the numerical simulation case by a case rechecking method, the time of a fire disaster reaching each roadway and the influence degree of the roadway are predicted by combining real-time monitoring data and simulation data, the equivalent length of each node roadway is dynamically calculated, and the escape data of personnel are dynamically planned by adopting a Di Jie St-Lag algorithm, so that a dynamically planned disaster avoidance route is obtained. The scheme improves the accuracy of the fire disaster avoidance path and the real-time performance of the on-site response.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Driving control method based on self-supervision imitation learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a driving control method based on self-supervision imitation learning, and belongs to the technical field of automatic driving reinforcement learning. Comprising the following steps: generating an automatic driving task data set; determining a potential representation of an anchor node at time t in the observed image and a potential representation of a sample associated with the anchor node; the potential representation z less than the time t in the potential space  ≤t  Integrating to generate the potential representation c of the t-time context  t  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Preserving time t+k using density comparatorObservation image s  t+k  And said c  t  Effective information between; and calculating cost functions after passing through trained encoders on different automatic driving scene observation images, and updating the cost functions and then transmitting the cost functions into a simulated learning target formula to update a strategy network. According to the invention, dimension disasters faced in a high-dimension data learning strategy can be relieved through dimension reduction mapping, high-density information with stronger correlation with tasks in image observation data is extracted, and the sampling efficiency of a model sample is improved.

title_en: Landslide multisource comprehensive early warning method based on monitoring data and integrated learning model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and prediction, in particular to a landslide multi-source comprehensive early warning method based on monitoring data and an integrated learning model, which comprises the steps of acquiring experimental data by collecting landslide displacement and data of factors influencing landslide; dividing experimental data into a plurality of parts to obtain a data set; selecting a first layer early warning model of which a plurality of base learners form a layered model; inputting the data set into a first layer early warning model for training and simulation to obtain an input data set; selecting a second layer early warning model of which the element learner forms a layered model; inputting the input data set into a second layer of early warning model for training to obtain a numerical result; according to the numerical result, the pre-warning level is obtained by comparing with a preset threshold value, and the method solves the problems that accidental errors are easy to occur when the pre-warning model is a single model, and the single pre-warning model cannot be well adapted to multiple types of data under multiple conditions.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH;GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION;GUANGXI INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Road tunnel fire smoke front image detection and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting and positioning a road tunnel fire smoke front image, which comprises the following steps: s1, carrying out data enhancement processing on an acquired fire smoke image to obtain an image dataset; s2, inputting the image data set into a fire smoke detection network model for network model training to obtain a trained detection network model; s3, inputting a fire smoke image to be detected into a trained detection network model, and outputting a fire smoke target area; s4, determining the smoke front position of a fire smoke target area; s5, determining the longitudinal distance between the smoke front position and the monitoring position. The invention can obtain more abundant subsequent disaster information and has higher fire detection accuracy and timeliness.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring and early warning method and device for highway geological disaster high-risk area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway geological disaster high-risk area monitoring and early warning method and device, which are used for acquiring remote sensing monitoring data of a monitoring area; according to geological factors and external factors of highway geological disasters, combining spectrum and spatial characteristics of remote sensing data, and establishing a geological disaster susceptibility key control factor as a disaster factor; and training and constructing a geological disaster susceptibility risk assessment self-adaptive model based on the high-resolution remote sensing data based on the disaster causing factors, and monitoring and processing the obtained highway high-resolution remote sensing data to obtain monitoring and early warning information of a highway geological disaster high-risk area. The scheme of the invention establishes a highway geological disaster factor quantitative expression method based on remote sensing data, provides a highway geological disaster susceptibility assessment model oriented to high-resolution remote sensing data, solves the problem of quantitative analysis of geological disaster risk assessment by using the remote sensing data, and realizes monitoring and early warning of highway geological disaster high-risk areas.
assignees: GUANGXI XINHENGTONG HIGHWAY CO LTD;GUANGXI COMMUNICATIONS DESIGN GROUP CO LTD;GUANGXI XINFAZHAN COMMUNICATION GROUP CO LTD;CTTIC INFORMATION TECH NATIONAL ENGINEERING LABORATORY CO LTD

title_en: Available Safe Egress Time Estimation Method for Multiplex Buildings using Artificial Neural Networks
title_ko: 인공신경망을 사용한 복합건축물의 화재 피난허용시간 추정 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for estimating an allowable fire evacuation time of a complex building using an artificial neural network. More specifically, a database was built based on fire simulation results for general complex buildings, and the same is applied to an artificial neural network that includes temperature, visibility, oxygen (O_2), carbon dioxide (CO_2), and carbon monoxide (CO) concentrations as input variables to estimate an allowable evacuation time.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인공신경망을 사용한 복합건축물의 화재 피난허용시간 추정 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 일반적인 복합건축물에 대한 화재시뮬레이션 결과를 기반으로 데이터베이스를 구축하고 이를 인공신경망에 적용하여 피난허용시간을 추정하도록 하는 인공신경망을 사용한 복합건축물의 화재 피난허용시간 추정 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예는 인공신경망을 사용한 복합건축물의 화재 피난허용시간 추정 방법에 있어서, (a) 주요 변수는 연료(fuel)의 종류와 화원의 위치로 설정하여 복합 건축물의 화재시나리오에 대한 시뮬레이션을 수행하고 결과에 대한 데이터베이스를 구축하는 단계; (b) 온도(Temperature), 가시거리(Visibility), 산소(O 2 ), 이산화탄소(CO 2 ) 및 일산화탄소(CO)의 농도를 포함하여 인공신경망의 입력층의 입력변수로 설정하는 단계; (c) 인공신경망 입력층에 입력된 입력변수를 바탕으로 활성함수( f   1 )를 사용하여 계산하여 입력층에서 인공신경망의 은닉층으로 전달하도록 하는 단계; (d) 인공신경망의 은닉층에서 출력층으로 활성함수( f   2) 를 적용하여 계산하여 출력층에서 정규화된 출력값( t   n )을 출력하도록 하는 단계;를 포함하여 이루어져, 주어진 데이터베이스를 바탕으로 인공신경망에서 학습시켜 출력값을 출력하도록 하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer-readable medium for automatic design of fire fighting equipment reflecting fire regulation
title_ko: 소방 법규 기준을 반영한 소방시설의 자동 설계 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터-판독 가능 기록 매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for automatic design of firefighting equipment reflecting the standard of firefighting legislation. More specifically, the present invention comprises: a building analysis step of loading design information of a building requiring firefighting equipment design and analyzing the use, size, and main structure of the building; a firefighting equipment selection step of selecting firefighting equipment required to be designed for the building based on the analysis results of the use, size, and main structure of the building; a first design step of placing the selected firefighting equipment on a design drawing of the building and deriving a first design model in which the firefighting equipment is placed according to the installation standards for fire-fighting equipment stipulated in the standards of firefighting legislation; and a second design step of performing a fire simulation that implements a fire occurrence situation for the first design model, evaluating the first design model, and deriving a second design model that complements the first design model according to the evaluation results. According to the present invention, firefighting equipment can perform fire-extinguishing activities without the risk of shutdown, thereby greatly reducing losses of both life and property.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방 법규 기준을 반영한 소방시설의 자동 설계 방법에 관련된 것으로서, 구체적으로는 소방시설의 설계가 요구되는 건축물의 설계 정보를 로드하여 건축물의 용도, 규모 및 주요 구조를 분석하는 건축물 분석 단계; 건축물의 용도, 규모 및 주요 구조의 분석 결과에 기초하여, 건축물에 설계가 요구되는 소방시설을 선정하는 소방시설 선정 단계; 선정된 소방시설을 건축물의 설계 도면 상에 배치하되, 소방 법규 기준에서 규정하고 있는 소방시설의 설치 기준에 따라 소방 시설을 배치한 제1 설계 모델을 도출하는 제1 설계 단계; 및, 제1 설계 모델에 대한 화재 발생 상황을 구현하는 화재 시뮬레이션을 수행하여, 제1 설계 모델을 평가하고, 평가 결과에 따라 제1 설계 모델을 보완한 제2 설계 모델을 도출하는 제2 설계 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Monitoring pile for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring pile for geological disasters, which comprises a body, wherein a detection pipe is arranged on one side of the body, the detection pipe comprises a limiting rod, the limiting rod is arranged on the detection pipe, one side of the limiting rod is connected with a float group, the float group is sleeved on the outer side of the limiting rod, one side of the float group is provided with a battery compartment, one side of the battery compartment is provided with a fixer, the fixer is connected with the body, the fixer comprises a second fixing rod group, one side of the second fixing rod group is connected with an opening and closing device, one side of the opening and closing device is provided with a blocking rod, the blocking rod is fixed on the opening and closing device, one side of the blocking rod is provided with a button, the button is connected to one side of the opening and closing device, one side of the button is provided with a movable rod, and one side of the movable rod is provided with a powerful spring. According to the utility model, the fixing head is set as the drill bit to ensure the stability of fixing, and the integral button ensures the cleanness and no complexity of the fixing action.
assignees: SHANXI COAL GEOLOGY GEOPHYSICAL PROSPECTING SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST CO LTD;SHANXI COMMUNICATION SCIENCE AND TECH R & D CO LTD

title_en: Test system and method for simulating reservoir bank slope under rainfall and earthquake coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test system and a method for simulating reservoir bank slopes under rainfall and earthquake coupling effects, wherein the test system comprises the following components: the vibration table bank slope model box is used for simulating a reservoir area, and a bank slope model and a reservoir water wave eliminating system are arranged in the vibration table bank slope model box; the water level control system is communicated with the vibration table bank slope model box and is used for pumping water in the vibration table bank slope model box to simulate the lifting of the water in the storage; and the bank slope rainfall simulation system is connected to the vibration table bank slope model box and is positioned above the bank slope model and used for simulating the working conditions of the real bank slope in different rainfall durations and rainfall intensities. The method is performed based on the test system. The invention can couple three factors of reservoir area water level change, rainfall intensity and duration and earthquake, further realizes reservoir bank slope stability test simulation, truly reproduces the deformation and damage condition of reservoir bank slopes formed by superposition of multiple disaster factors under natural conditions, and has the characteristics of multiple coupling factors, good effect and accurate test data.

title_en: Geological disaster evaluation method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster evaluation method based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: determining a target area, and acquiring a sample set based on the target area; constructing a geological disaster susceptibility evaluation index system, and obtaining a first data set based on the sample set and the geological disaster susceptibility evaluation index system; constructing a geological disaster vulnerability evaluation model, inputting a training set into the geological disaster vulnerability evaluation model for training to obtain a trained geological disaster vulnerability evaluation model, and inputting a test set into the trained geological disaster vulnerability evaluation model to obtain a vulnerability evaluation result; constructing a geological disaster vulnerability evaluation index system, obtaining a second data set based on the sample set and the geological disaster vulnerability evaluation index system, and obtaining a vulnerability evaluation result based on the second data; and obtaining a final geological disaster evaluation result based on the susceptibility evaluation result and the vulnerability evaluation result. And an evaluation result error caused by manual evaluation is avoided through an intelligent algorithm.
assignees: AERO GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY AND REMOTE SENSING CENTER FOR NATURAL RESOURCES OF CHINA

title_en: Long-channel heterogeneous pedestrian evacuation method considering small group behaviors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-channel heterogeneous pedestrian evacuation method considering small group behaviors, which relates to the technical field of public safety, and comprises the following steps of: acquiring the length, width and internal structure information of a channel; acquiring personnel distribution and role information, and calculating static field distribution in a channel; acquiring surrounding traffic environment information; determining decisions of each small group according to the acquired traffic environment information; simulating a pedestrian movement path according to the movement module; and analyzing the simulation result, and exploring the influence of small group behaviors on the movement of people in the channel. The heterogeneous pedestrian evacuation method in the long channel considering the small group behaviors considers the characteristics of the small group behaviors, adopts the multi-lattice sub-model to describe the pedestrian motion state more finely, is beneficial to in-depth research on the influence of the small group behaviors on the motion of people in the channel, and improves the evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Disaster simulation method for emergency simulation exercise
abstract_en: According to the disaster simulation method for emergency simulation exercise, based on the dynamics simulation software in the prior art, a mechanism model and a three-dimensional model of a disaster are established, the mechanism model and the three-dimensional model are solved, the calculation result of the obtained dynamics simulation software is processed according to a self-defined data structure, the calculation result of the dynamics simulation software is ensured to be flexibly used in other emergency exercise software, and a data basis is provided for improving the authenticity of disaster simulation in safety education training and disaster emergency rescue exercise.
assignees: JIANGSU V R GLOBAL VISION CORP

title_en: Experimental system and simulation method for geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides an experimental system and an experimental method for geological disasters, and relates to the technical field of experimental simulation of geological disasters. The experimental system and the simulation method for the geological disasters comprise a data collection module, wherein the data collection module is connected with a data preprocessing module, the data preprocessing module is connected with a data transmission module, the data transmission module is connected with an upper computer, the upper computer is connected with a scene construction module and an experimental simulation module, the data collection module comprises an original data database, and the original data database is connected with a geological data module, a sample acquisition module and a sample analysis module. By combining two simulation methods, namely sand box scene simulation and data modeling simulation, the data obtained by testing the two methods are respectively established into simulation curves and fitted, so that result output is realized, the comprehensiveness of the obtained basic data of the method in use is increased, and the simulation precision of the method in use is improved.

title_en: Cover layer reconstruction method of salt cavern storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a cover layer reconstruction method of a salt cavern reservoir, which comprises the following steps of S1, hydraulically cutting a damaged or deformed sleeve with a stable stratum at the upper part of the sleeve, wherein the stable stratum with larger thickness at the upper part is used as a cover layer to form a stratum seal, S2, putting a telescopic drill bit into the sleeve to drill out a exposed cement ring, S3, putting a suspension packer into the sleeve, S4, injecting thixotropic cement to seal, S5, testing pressure after waiting for solidification, drilling a boiled water mud plug and the suspension packer after testing pressure to be qualified, and S6, repairing the sleeve by adopting a sleeve repairing method or an expansion pipe sleeve repairing method. The method for modifying the cover layer of the salt cavern reservoir, provided by the invention, does not modify a direct top plate, but modifies a shaft in stable stratum such as shale and the like at the upper part of the salt cavern reservoir, seals an annulus, provides favorable conditions for underground reservoir construction, disaster management and the like, and has universality.

title_en: Traction station fire disaster identification method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire disaster identification method and device for a traction substation, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing a preset fire image data set to obtain a preprocessed fire image data set; wherein each image in the fire image dataset comprises a color RGB three channel, and the preprocessing comprises a drying process and a labeling process; training a preset fire image recognition model according to the preprocessed fire image data set to obtain a normal fire recognition model; performing transfer learning on the normal fire disaster identification model according to the preprocessed fire disaster image data set to obtain a trained model; and identifying the images of the traction station through the trained model so as to judge that the traction station has fire according to the identification result. The system can effectively identify small-scale fire data, can effectively avoid further expansion of fire, can effectively identify various transformer substation fires, saves time and space cost, and has strong universality and expandability.
assignees: GUONENG BAOSHEN RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;GUONENG BAOSHEN RAILWAY CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line risk early warning method based on weather radar in strong convection weather
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power grids, and particularly relates to a power transmission line risk early warning method based on weather radars in strong convection weather, which comprises the following steps: acquiring radar echo intensity data and weather assimilation system prediction data; performing gridding and time sequence processing on the weather assimilation system prediction data to construct a data sample set; constructing an LSTM neural network prediction model based on weather radars in strong convection weather, and training and testing the model; acquiring radar echo paths and radar echo intensity data of a strong convection occurrence area at a future moment, and predicting 10m wind speed and rainfall under strong convection weather at the future moment; and evaluating the risk of the power transmission line in strong convection weather and issuing a risk early warning result. According to the invention, the weather radar echo intensity data and the image are combined with the LSTM neural network prediction model, so that the refinement degree of the electric power weather association early warning is improved, the prediction precision is high, and the generalization capability is strong.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV CHONGQING;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Belt corridor global smoke real-time detection method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a belt corridor global smoke real-time detection method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: simulating fire conditions of the belt corridor by adopting artificial smoke, and manufacturing a training set of a YOLOv5 smoke detection model; collecting images of the belt corridor on dust, sunlight or walls as a countermeasure sample data set; training the model using the training set and the challenge sample data set; grouping cameras in the whole area of the belt corridor, and carrying out polling and image capture acquisition according to the groups; sending the collected image set into a YOLOv5 smoke detection model, detecting whether a smoke label exists or not, and if the smoke label is detected, increasing the detection frequency of the camera so as to further confirm whether fire disaster occurs or not; if fire occurs, smoke alarm is triggered, alarm information is pushed to maintenance personnel in a WeChat message mode, and countermeasures are taken in time. The invention realizes the whole day real-time monitoring of the smoke in the belt corridor and provides a guarantee for the safety detection of the belt corridor area.
assignees: TANGSHAN HUITANG IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Side slope disaster light sensing system, equipment and platform based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and particularly discloses a side slope disaster light sensing system, equipment and a platform based on deep learning, wherein the system comprises a side slope disaster sample library construction module; the system comprises a slope disaster information real-time extraction model construction module, a global feature extraction module and a non-local feature extraction module, a slope disaster information real-time extraction model training module and a quantization compression module. The system can realize model quantitative deployment on embedded equipment, the equipment is carried on an unmanned plane platform, image data is acquired through a camera module of the unmanned plane and is transmitted to the platform in real time, slope information extraction is carried out on the image data through the platform, and the image data is transmitted to a ground control end in real time, so that the problems of low speed and low precision of acquiring slope information during rescue after a disaster at present are solved, and real-time perception of the slope disaster in an emergency area after the disaster is realized.

title_en: Prediction method for disaster characteristics of highway tunnel passing through karst stratum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prediction, in particular to a method for predicting disaster characteristics when a highway tunnel passes through a karst stratum, which is used for carrying out simulation calculation on the whole process of highway tunnel construction under the condition of the karst stratum according to geological information and construction characteristic information of a target highway tunnel and by combining an established karst stratum deformation-water gushing coupling mathematical model and a physical model, so as to obtain the structural stability of the target highway tunnel construction under the condition of the karst stratum and the characteristic information of water gushing disasters. The method can predict the stratum water burst characteristics in the whole construction process of the highway tunnel, improves the accuracy and flexibility of prediction, and provides important basis for selection of construction methods, lining modes, safety measures and the like.
assignees: CHONGQING ZHONGHUAN CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Disaster simulation model construction method based on ductile city multi-agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster simulation model construction method based on a ductile city multi-agent, which comprises the following steps: collecting urban toughness element information; constructing a plurality of intelligent agents of the urban toughness elements based on the urban toughness element information; constructing a dynamic response mechanism of the urban toughness element multi-agent under urban risk; designing disaster agents aiming at disasters, and designing the relation between the disaster agents and the corresponding urban toughness element multi-agent; and constructing a chain disaster knowledge graph. Compared with the prior art, the invention uses the flexible multi-agent to represent the complex urban system, and constructs the dynamic response mechanism of the flexible multi-agent in disaster event, and simultaneously takes people as a member of the flexible multi-agent, thereby being applicable to the simulation of various urban disasters and risk disturbance, improving the defense, recovery and adaptability of the urban system in various disturbance, and guaranteeing the welfare of urban residents.

title_en: Flood evolution process simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood evolution process simulation method, which is used for rapidly obtaining the flood flow velocity and the flood flow under the same or similar rainfall situations according to a rainfall-flow velocity historical database and a weather forecast rainfall, and the flood simulation based on hydrodynamics needs to estimate the flows and the flow velocities in different directions in real time, so that the complexity of a model is obviously reduced; and meanwhile, the equal volume method is utilized to estimate the flood submerged range and depth on the river micro-unit, so that the data quantity participating in operation is reduced, and the time complexity of the algorithm is greatly reduced. The invention provides a flood evolution process simulation method suitable for a large river basin, which is used for estimating flood transit time, flooding range and depth; the problem that flood is not known when and where disaster is happened is solved, time early warning is provided for people escape and property transfer in advance, and life and property loss of people is reduced to the minimum; meanwhile, the flood depth data can serve disaster assessment, solves the problem of serious disaster damage everywhere, and provides data support for disaster prevention, disaster reduction and relief work of the government.

title_en: Method and system for mine disaster simulation and early warning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for mine disaster simulation and early warning, which are characterized in that a mine disaster simulation model is constructed by collecting disaster history parameters, the mine disaster simulation model is used for simulation, and a disaster early warning scheme and a disaster grade judging scheme are determined based on simulation results; the disaster early warning and early prediction are carried out through the disaster early warning scheme, the organic combination of a numerical simulation method and a monitoring method is realized, the mutual verification between the monitoring early warning result and the simulation early warning result is realized, the accuracy of the early warning result is improved, the disaster early warning level is judged through the disaster level judging scheme, the total dangerous level of the whole mine area is determined, whether the potential safety hazard occurs in underground production operation of the mine can be accurately identified, the risk early warning is generated, the pre-disaster prediction of the mine enables professionals to take countermeasures in time, technical support is provided for targeted disaster prevention, and the property and life safety of mine staff are ensured.

title_en: Disaster influence assessment method and system based on integrated fusion prediction model
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster influence assessment method and a disaster influence assessment system based on an integrated fusion prediction model, and relates to the technical field of intelligent prediction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the growth data acquisition device and the environment data acquisition device, carrying out data acquisition on crops in a target area, and outputting a crop growth data set and a freeze injury environment data set; performing time sequence mapping by using the crop growth data set and the freeze injury environment data set, outputting N sub-models by using the mapping data set as training data, and constructing a disaster influence integrated prediction model; analyzing the first prediction parameters according to the N sub-models to obtain N primary prediction results; and carrying out secondary prediction based on the N primary prediction results as input data of the integrated fusion prediction model, and outputting disaster influence indexes. The method solves the problems of imperfect fineness and accuracy of the current freeze injury prediction, reduces the problem of low single model prediction capability, and improves the accuracy of disaster influence assessment results.
assignees: RES INSTITUTE OF HORTICULTURE JIANGXI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title_en: Method for early disaster recovery of environmental facility, application and terminal for the same
title_ko: 재난재해시 환경기초시설의 피해를 조기에 복구하기 위한 방법, 애플리케이션 및 단말
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a method for quickly restoring damage to an environmental infrastructure in the event of a disaster by a terminal including an application may be provided which comprises the steps of: executing the application; obtaining, when the application is executed, monitoring information including weather information, field monitoring information, sensing information, and image information; obtaining weather disaster information including weather forecast information, disaster status information containing information on currently occurring disasters, and a disaster notice containing detailed information on the disaster; outputting the monitoring information and the weather disaster information; receiving, when the disaster occurs, disaster information and damage information due to the disaster, wherein the disaster information and the damage information are based on the monitoring information and the weather disaster information; outputting a restoring scenario including detailed restoring procedures corresponding to the disaster information and the damage information; and outputting a restoring wizard including a guide for performing the restoring procedures corresponding to the restoring scenario.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예는, 애플리케이션을 포함하는 단말이 재난재해시 환경기초시설의 피해를 조기에 복구하기 위한 방법에 있어서, 상기 애플리케이션을 실행하는 단계; 상기 애플리케이션이 실행되면, 기상정보, 현장모니터링정보, 센싱정보 및 영상정보를 포함하는 모니터링정보를 획득하는 단계; 기상예보정보, 현재 발생한 재난재해에 대한 정보를 포함하는 재난재해현황정보 및 상기 재난재해에 대한 상세정보를 포함하는 재난통보문을 포함하는 기상재난재해정보를 획득하는 단계; 상기 모니터링정보 및 상기 기상재난재해정보를 출력하는 단계; 상기 재난재해가 발생한 경우, 재난재해정보 및 상기 재난재해로 인한 피해정보를 입력받되, 상기 재난재해정보 및 상기 피해정보는 상기 모니터링정보 및 상기 기상재난재해정보에 기반하는 단계; 상기 재난재해정보 및 상기 피해정보에 대응하여 세부적인 복구절차를 포함하는 복구시나리오를 출력하는 단계; 및 상기 복구시나리오에 대응하여 상기 복구절차를 수행하기 위한 가이드(guide)를 포함하는 복구마법사를 출력하는 단계를 포함하는 방법을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: AE CORP;JANGKANG CO;SUNJIN ENG & ARCHITECTURE CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power plant in-site personnel emergency evacuation time estimation method
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of collecting wind speed and leakage point source intensity outside a nuclear power plant field, constructing a radiation dose field diffusion model, collecting building and road distribution information in the nuclear power plant field, constructing an individual exit selection optimization model, taking evacuation distance and risk level as optimization targets, and solving through a non-dominant genetic algorithm to obtain an exit distribution scheme, namely the corresponding relation between individual objects and exits; thereby estimating group evacuation time. The group evacuation process is analyzed through cellular automaton theory simulation, physical ability differences among groups, individual popular behaviors and information transmission among individuals are considered, microscopic simulation is used for simulating alternative accident emergency exercise, evacuation time is shortened, and personnel radiation dose is reduced.

title_en: Laser radar measurement technology processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser radar measurement technology processing method and a system, in particular to the technical field of laser radars, wherein the system comprises: the radar detection module is used for detecting stratum structures and meteorological conditions in the area; the model construction module is used for constructing a three-dimensional space model of the corresponding area according to the topographic image map, the stratum structure information and the climate environment information transmitted by the radar detection module and determining the erection site coordinates of the high-voltage transmission tower and the monitoring tower; and the simulation early warning module is used for simulating the running state of the high-voltage power transmission system including the high-voltage power transmission tower in the three-dimensional model, if the unsafe state occurs in the simulation running, an alarm is sent outwards, and the detection of the elements on the high-voltage power transmission tower and the monitoring of the position and the swing direction of the high-voltage power transmission line by the laser radar comprehensively judge whether the unsafe state exists in the high-voltage power transmission system in the area within a certain period of time, so that the degree of loss of the high-voltage power transmission link due to disasters is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent fire monitoring system based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire monitoring, and discloses an intelligent fire monitoring system based on image recognition, wherein the system flow comprises the following steps: constructing a self-adaptive fire image generation model; determining an adaptive fire image generation objective function according to the structures of the fire description text module and the fire image decoding module; carrying out optimization solution on the constructed self-adaptive fire image generation objective function to determine optimal self-adaptive fire image generation model parameters; and generating a large number of fire images in different scenes based on the optimal self-adaptive fire image generation model and the fire description text, and obtaining a fire identification model for fire monitoring based on the generated fire image training. According to the method, the fire disaster image of a specific scene is generated based on the fire disaster description text, a model optimization scheme of a two-stage optimization target is designed, an image which accords with the text description content and is closer to a real fire disaster image is generated, and a fire disaster recognition model is obtained based on the generated fire disaster image training to monitor the fire disaster.
assignees: SHANDONG AOSHEN INTELLIGENT ENG CO LTD

title_en: Analysis method for mechanical properties of single-layer spherical reticulated shell structure of recombined bamboo member under fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method for mechanical properties of a single-layer spherical reticulated shell structure of a recombined bamboo member under fire, which comprises the following steps: establishing a single-layer spherical reticulated shell numerical model according to the research objects and the characteristics; the single-layer spherical net shell model is imported into fire simulation software, so that fire scene information, pyrolysis parameters and combustion parameters of the recombined bamboo materials are perfected, and a structural temperature field is simulated and extracted; and (3) importing the single-layer spherical reticulated shell model and the extracted temperature field into finite element simulation software, and performing mechanical analysis after finishing setting mechanical parameters and boundary conditions of the nodes and the recombined bamboo materials, so as to further analyze the mechanical properties of the single-layer spherical reticulated shell structure of the recombined bamboo components in fire. The method has the advantages of clear route, strong operability and reasonable implementation method, is favorable for promoting the deep research of the stress condition characteristics and rules of the single-layer spherical reticulated shell structure of the recombined bamboo member under fire in the field, and can accelerate the research process of improving the mechanical properties of the recombined bamboo in the field of building structures.

title_en: Simulation method and simulation device for interlayer hidden defect test of ballastless track
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation method and a simulation device for a ballastless track interlayer hidden defect test, which belong to the technical field of track traffic. Through presetting a plurality of second bed boards with different defect types and defect degrees, the simulation of the hidden defects among ballastless track layers with different types, different degrees and different positions can be realized, and the test simulation of different hidden defects can be realized through the method. The invention sets very small interlayer hidden defects in advance, and then observes that the hidden defects are continuously expanded through experiments until all the layers are in void failure or the ballastless track plate is arched, so that experimental researches on the mechanism of disaster-induced evolution caused by inoculation of the hidden defects of different layers can be carried out.

title_en: Multidimensional grid crack prefabrication pressure relief method based on thick and hard top plate
abstract_en: The multi-dimensional grid crack prefabrication pressure relief method based on the thick and hard top plate is adopted, transverse cutting-longitudinal explosion multi-dimensional grid crack prefabrication pressure relief method can be used for realizing multi-layer full presplitting in the axial direction of a drilling hole in the top plate, the radial crack radius of the drilling hole can be extended in a large range, prefabrication of the multi-dimensional grid crack in the thick and hard top plate is completed, the thick and hard top plate is fully weakened, meanwhile, a fracturing effect can be realized through hydraulic fracturing drilling, the hydraulic fracturing drilling can be used as a top plate peeping drilling hole, hydraulic fracturing drilling hole re-explosion can be carried out when further strengthening pressure relief requirements exist, one-hole multi-purpose is realized, labor cost is reduced, and rock burst disasters are effectively prevented and controlled.

title_en: Beam training method and related device for RIS-UAV auxiliary emergency communication
abstract_en: A beam training method and related device for RIS-UAV assisted emergency communication comprises the following steps: establishing an RIS auxiliary UAV communication model based on the unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain beam angle information; minimizing the transmitting power of the transmitting end by optimizing the beam angle information; based on optimization of a necessary condition KKT condition which becomes an optimal solution, iterative optimization of a non-uniform codebook is performed according to alignment with the beam angle information, and the optimal beam angle is obtained by continuously feeding back and updating the codebook; the optimized beam angle information is obtained, and verification is carried out through simulation and alignment comparison with uniform codebooks, high-precision codebooks and perfect beams with the same size. The present invention is directed to emergency communications in disaster scenarios, employing RIS-assisted UAV communications with high spectrum/energy efficiency, low cost, and high maneuver characteristics. And the limited communication condition and the energy efficiency problem are considered, and the energy consumption of the users of the uplink communication system is reduced through the codebook design and optimization of beam training.

title_en: Geological disaster risk investigation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses geological disaster risk investigation equipment, which relates to the field of risk investigation equipment, and comprises a supporting plate, wherein a rotating bucket is arranged below the supporting plate and is in a round table-shaped structure, a plurality of groups of strip openings are formed in the side wall of the rotating bucket and uniformly distributed around the rotating bucket, a plurality of groups of scrapers are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the rotating bucket, the scrapers are positioned on one side of the strip openings, one side of each scraper, which is far away from the rotating bucket, is inclined towards the strip opening, and a plurality of groups of uniformly distributed scraping blocks are fixedly connected to one side of each scraper, which is away from the rotating bucket. This geological disasters risk investigation equipment, first motor rotate and drive the pivot and rotate, and then make revolving hopper and multiunit scraper blade synchronous rotation, the scraper blade pushes away with scrape the piece and scrape the drilling inner wall to make to push away and scrape the soil fragment that drops by the strip mouth get into revolving hopper inside, the lifting unit that cooperates again, accomplish reaming operation, the sampling device of being convenient for carries out soil sampling inside the drilling, improves the efficiency and the precision of geological disasters risk investigation.

title_en: Microseismic event classification method based on time-frequency domain multi-feature and support vector machine model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of microseismic monitoring, in particular to a microseismic event classification method based on a time-frequency domain multi-feature and support vector machine model, which comprises the steps that a shake phase pick-up and signal interception module is used for carrying out shake interception on signal data acquired in real time, a shake signal data preprocessing module is used for preprocessing the signal data, a feature extraction module is used for carrying out feature extraction on the two data, the extracted two features are spliced to be used as input data of a classification model, a classification model construction and training module is used for taking the features extracted by the module and labels marked as training sets and putting the training sets into the model, the model after training is completed is a classification model, the accuracy and timeliness of acquiring effective microseismic events are improved, the SVM model is used for carrying out secondary classification on the acquired shake events, and the workload of manual processing is reduced while the noise events are prevented from carrying out early warning and judging interference on mine disasters.
assignees: SHENLAN GANZHI HANGZHOU IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method for transformer substation
abstract_en: The fire disaster early warning method for the transformer substation enables fault information to be found early and processed in time, and real safety guarantee can be provided for operation of the transformer substation. Comprising the following steps: numbering each fire detection area of the transformer substation, installing monitoring equipment, shooting video and transmitting the video to a monitoring center and a computer of a related functional department; establishing a database by a computer of a monitoring center and related functional departments, performing frame extraction operation to obtain an image, storing the image as a reference sample in the database, and introducing a fire type simulation image as a simulation sample into the database; shooting videos in real time by using monitoring equipment, transmitting the videos to a monitoring center and a computer of a related functional department to be compared with a reference sample, and comparing dissimilar parts with a simulation sample when the similarity meets the early warning condition; and obtaining the position and type of the fire of the transformer substation according to the dissimilar parts, issuing alarm signals and fire information to a site processing system of the transformer substation through an internal local area network, and informing a mobile phone of a working staff of the transformer substation through a wireless network.
assignees: JINZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;PANJIN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;HULUDAO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Coal mine goaf coalbed methane exploitation process
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the fields of coal mine goaf coalbed methane exploitation and mine gas disaster management, and is characterized in that ground extraction equipment is communicated to an underground goaf breaking belt through an air drilling technology, and the coalbed methane extraction is carried out by utilizing a natural fracture system formed after a roof is collapsed. The goaf free state coalbed methane content is very high, and is different from the coalbed, so that higher coalbed methane resource benefit can be obtained in a short time, and the goaf free state coalbed methane content has a great social and economic significance, and is a technological method for efficiently developing the goaf coalbed methane.

title_en: Ultra-large deep engineering disaster physical simulation facility
abstract_en: The ultra-large deep engineering disaster physical simulation facility comprises a geological model long-time large load loading system, a deep oil-gas-water multiphase multicomponent complex geological model 3D printing system, a high-temperature-chemical-multiphase fluid collaborative injection, a monitoring and control system, a model internal complex engineering structure robot excavation and monitoring system under a deep geological environment, a deep metal mine complex drilling and transportation network intelligent ventilation system, a deep metal mine ultra-large stope intelligent filling system, a deep well enhanced geothermal safety intelligent mining system, a large geological model excavation and rupture process full-space-time intelligent high-precision monitoring system and an ultra-large physical simulation test multi-task intelligent collaborative total control and digital twin system; the facility meets the requirements of real triaxial high stress, structural stress and disturbance stress loading of the multiphase multicomponent 3D printing model under deep complex geological conditions, can intelligently and transparently monitor multi-element information under complex engineering activities such as excavation and the like, and can realize multi-task intelligent collaborative total control and big data cloud sharing.

title_en: Civil air defense community propaganda education experience device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a personal air defense community propaganda and education experience device, which relates to personal air defense education propaganda equipment and comprises a base, wherein the surface of the base is provided with a mounting groove, the inner side of the mounting groove is fixedly provided with a motor, a shaft of the motor is fixedly sleeved with a transmission gear, and the surface of the base is fixedly provided with an annular supporting piece. According to the utility model, through the motor, the transmission gear, the inner ring and the outer ring, a user steps on the surface of the belt to walk or run, and the position change of the user in a virtual disaster environment is simulated by matching with the rotation of the inner ring; the rotation of outer loop drives the display screen rotation, realizes the inspection of virtual disaster environment, and the emphasis shows the education and the guide effect that strengthen the user. The participation of the user is improved, the tension during selection and action is increased, the in-situ strain capacity of the user is cultivated and promoted, interactivity and interestingness are improved, and the propaganda education effect is improved.
assignees: HEBEI YOUZHI WUSHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-earthquake building damage assessment method for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the field of earthquake disaster assessment, in particular to a post-earthquake building damage assessment method for emergency rescue, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing the obtained historical post-earthquake positive photographic images with the building damage class labels to obtain a training data set; building a building damage classification model based on a building reinforcement feature extraction neural network, wherein in the reinforcement feature extraction network, a feature reinforcement module and two auxiliary monitoring modules are designed, an encoder unit of a semantic segmentation network module is connected with a first auxiliary monitoring module through the feature reinforcement module, a second auxiliary monitoring module is connected with the penultimate layer in a decoder unit of the semantic segmentation network module, and a training data set training model is utilized to obtain a trained building damage classification model; inputting the image to be evaluated into a trained building damage classification model, and outputting the post-earthquake building damage classification for emergency rescue. By utilizing the method disclosed by the invention, the accuracy of the damage assessment result of the post-earthquake building is improved.

title_en: Method for determining shaft length of natural smoke exhaust system of shaft of tunnel with one end plugged
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for blocking the length of a tunnel shaft natural smoke exhaust system shaft at one end. According to the method, a fire physical model of a natural smoke discharging system for plugging the tunnel shaft is established through Pyro Sim software. And simulating the smoke movement process when a fire disaster occurs by using fire dynamics simulation software FDS to obtain the diffusion flow condition of the smoke under different shaft lengths. Under the premise that the shaft width is equal to the tunnel width, the shaft height is brought into the shaft length through a calculation formula. Thereby providing reference for the arrangement of one-end plugging type tunnel shaft and the selection of shaft size.

title_en: Emergency evacuation guiding equipment, guiding system and guiding method based on public management
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation guiding method based on public management, which comprises the following steps: s1, dividing and classifying modes of construction sites: virtually dividing the places into different virtual evacuation areas; s2, acquiring real-time each frame of image of the to-be-evacuated region by the distributed edge computing system, and screening and updating personnel conditions in the place by the central computing system; the personnel conditions comprise personnel position information, quantity information and personnel attribute information; and S3, the distributed edge computing system performs emergency evacuation guiding route dispatching according to the updated data of the central computing system. After the system virtually divides the places, the number of people and the action track are accurate in an intelligent fitting mode by collecting real-time images of each frame of different virtual evacuation areas and combining a distributed edge computing system and a central computing system, and the clustering number of the personnel track is dynamically changed according to real-time updating of the training package, so that a reference is provided for the dispatching of emergency evacuation guiding routes.

title_en: Power transmission tower instability experimental device and experimental method taking landslide geological disaster caused by rainfall as inducement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering, in particular to a power transmission tower instability experimental device which takes landslide geological disasters caused by rainfall as inducements, the experimental method comprises a model box, a side slope rock-soil body model, a power transmission tower and a basic model thereof, a multi-angle rainfall device and a monitoring system, and an experimental method for simulating the instability experimental device of the power transmission tower by using landslide geological disasters caused by rainfall as inducements. According to the invention, through researching the relation between rainfall, rainfall intensity, rainfall duration and the like and landslide deformation characteristics, the collapse instability mechanism of the power transmission tower structure under the action of landslide geological disasters caused by rainfall is further researched, the trigger mechanism of landslide disasters generated by the side slope under different rainfall states and the trigger mechanism of collapse instability of the power transmission tower structure under the action of landslide disasters are researched, and more theoretical basis is provided for preventing the collapse damage of the power transmission tower structure under the action of landslide geological disasters.

title_en: Horizontal hole vertical hydraulic grooving system and construction method of water interception curtain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a horizontal hole vertical hydraulic grooving system and a construction method of a water interception curtain, wherein the horizontal hole vertical hydraulic grooving system consists of an in-hole grooving assembly and a double-layer drill rod which are in axial butt joint; the in-hole slotting component is provided with a water-passing and slag-discharging component, the water-passing and slag-discharging component is hinged with a high-pressure perforation angle adjusting component, and the double-layer drill rod is axially abutted with the water-passing and slag-discharging component to open a high-pressure water channel and a slag-discharging channel; and the high-pressure perforation angle adjusting assembly adjusts the direction of the slotting, cuts the vertical slot section along the trend of the horizontal hole, and then fills and grouting to construct the water interception curtain. The invention solves the problem that the construction mode of the ground slotting grouting type curtain is applicable to shallow depth, and solves the problem that the drilling grouting type curtain damages the ground surface by high-pressure grouting at the shallow part so as to cause secondary engineering geological disasters. In particular to filling the blank of the construction technology of the shallow-buried bedrock layer curtain, so that the shallow-buried bedrock layer curtain which can not be solved by the ground slotting grouting type curtain and the underground drilling grouting type curtain can be realized.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Four-rotor fault disaster recovery degradation control method based on observer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-rotor fault disaster recovery degradation control method based on an observer, which relates to the technical field of four-rotor faults and comprises the following steps: in order to facilitate the design of a subsequent controller, a kinematic model and a dynamic model of the four-rotor unmanned helicopter are introduced, and a coordinate system of the four-rotor unmanned helicopter in the flight process is defined: inertial system { I } = { O  I  ,X  I  ,Y  I  ,Z  I  { B } = { O in body coordinate system }  B  ,X  B  ,Y  B  ,Z  B  }. Subsequently, in order to avoid the singular problem existing in Euler angle gesture expression, a degradation gesture control algorithm based on quaternion is provided, and a disturbance observer is provided to compensate the uncertainty of system modeling and external unknown disturbance; in the four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle position loop, a robust integral geometric control algorithm is provided for compensating external disturbance introduced by the position loop, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can better resist the external disturbance on the premise that one blade is completely out of control, the safety and the stability of the system are improved, and finally,the effectiveness of the control algorithm provided by the invention is verified through numerical simulation.

title_en: Small sample named entity identification method for dam emergency response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small sample named entity recognition method for dam emergency response, which uses a fine-grained prototype network to construct a small sample named entity recognition model, adopts different prototype construction modes for entities and non-entities, and fully expresses the characteristics of the corresponding entities and non-entities; meanwhile, feature differences among similar entities or non-entities are added in a loss function in the model training process, so that feature representations of the similar entities or non-entities are closer; after the prototype construction of all classes is completed, the distances between a given sample and all class prototypes are calculated using a distance function, and the distances are converted to similarity probabilities to classify the samples. The invention gets rid of the dependence of the deep learning algorithm in the existing dam safety management field on a large amount of training data, can finish the task of identifying the named entity in the dam data set with fewer samples, and has higher identification precision and better convergence performance.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for partitioning disaster-causing hidden danger of composite roof of coal mine tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a partition method and a partition system for disaster potential hazards of a composite roof of a coal mine tunnel, wherein the partition method comprises the following steps: acquiring a mine geological drilling histogram, determining stratum parameters at each geological drilling position, and calculating a key stratum layer position, a breaking distance and a limit span corresponding to a top plate of the geological drilling position; determining various index factors influencing the disaster potential degree of the tunnel roof; determining the specific belonging grade according to the actual value of the index factor; calculating disaster potential hazard grade assessment indexes of all index factors based on membership functions of all index factors respectively; calculating the influence weight of each index factor on the disaster potential; calculating disaster potential coefficients by adopting a disaster potential grade comprehensive index model based on a fuzzy mathematical theory, and grading roadway roofs of different areas according to the disaster potential coefficients; and drawing a partition cloud picture of the disaster causing hidden danger of the top plate by adopting Surfer software.
assignees: SHANXI SHUOZHOU SHANYIN JINHAIYANG WUJIAGOU COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Gas mine surface drilling fire extinguishing method based on liquid nitrogen filling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas mining area rescue and relief work, and discloses a gas mining area drilling fire extinguishing method based on liquid nitrogen filling, which comprises a (one) shaft sealing stage; a drilling stage, namely setting nitrogen injection holes and plugging holes according to the ignition point positions; and (III) in the nitrogen injection fire extinguishing stage, performing three-section nitrogen injection fire extinguishing and cooling according to the mine fire condition. According to the scheme, the shaft is timely sealed after the fire disaster situation is found, so that the influence on CO and O in underground air caused by the fact that external air floods into the underground in the nitrogen injection fire extinguishing process can be effectively avoided  2  Gas (mainly CH)  4  ) The content of key gases is monitored, so that the development of fire is controlled after the underground air is replaced by the subsequent nitrogen injection, the range of fire influence is prevented from being enlarged, and the occurrence of secondary accidents in the underground rescue process is effectively prevented.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Early landslide early warning method based on ResNetGRU algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a landslide early warning method based on a ResNetGRU algorithm, which adopts ResNet as a front characteristic extraction unit, constructs a ResNetGRU model in cooperation with a GRU gate control circulation unit, carries out normalization classification on collected landslide warning data, divides the acquired landslide warning data into a training set and a testing set to train and verify the ResNetGRU model, and finally uses the trained ResNetGRU model to output a landslide state.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH;GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION;GUANGXI INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster early warning method applied to a cloud edge cooperative system, and belongs to the field of disaster early warning. The cloud edge cooperative system comprises a cloud server, edge nodes and a plurality of edge terminals, wherein the cloud server is connected with the plurality of edge terminals through the edge nodes, and a plurality of disaster early warning models are stored in the cloud server. The method comprises the steps of selecting a target early-warning model from a plurality of disaster early-warning models according to task properties by a cloud server, sending the target early-warning model to a plurality of edge terminals through edge nodes, adjusting down an initial confidence threshold of the target early-warning model, summarizing result data with the occurrence probability of a predicted target being larger than the initial confidence threshold to the edge nodes, re-labeling the result data, uploading the re-labeled result data to the cloud server, taking the re-labeled result data as a training set, re-training the target early-warning model of the edge nodes, updating the target early-warning model to replace the current target early-warning model, and carrying out disaster early warning through the target early-warning model.

title_en: Cableway transfer station passenger flow and emergency evacuation simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cableway transfer station passenger flow and emergency evacuation simulation method, which comprises the following steps: creating a passenger flow evacuation model of the cableway transfer station in a simulation software program; creating a passenger flow line graph of pedestrians on the passenger flow evacuation model of the cableway transfer station; setting simulation parameters including pedestrian space, walking speed, cableway parameters and passenger flow parameters; and simulating the situation and distribution of pedestrian flows in the cableway transfer station based on the created passenger flow evacuation model, the set passenger flow line graph and the set simulation parameters in the simulation software program. Adopting simulation methods such as discrete simulation, multi-agent modeling simulation and the like to dynamically simulate passenger flow lines and emergency evacuation of a cableway transfer station, and establishing a passenger flow and emergency evacuation simulation model; the passenger flow density of the cableway transfer station, the emergency evacuation time and the bottleneck are counted and analyzed, and the schemes can be compared through parameter adjustment.
assignees: CHINA ENFI ENG CORP;CHINA NONFERROUS ENG CO LTD

title_en: Fire investigation drilling sand table
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire investigation drilling sand table, which relates to the technical field of fire drilling and comprises the following steps: the display platform comprises a display platform body, a scene environment model, a computer, projection equipment, display equipment and a head-mounted display; the scene environment model and the projection equipment are arranged on the display platform body; the computer comprises an animation generation module and an information transfer module which are connected, wherein the animation generation module can generate scene environment animation and fire disaster simulation animation, the scene environment animation is consistent with a scene environment model, the fire disaster simulation animation and the scene environment animation can be combined to form comprehensive fire disaster scene animation, the information transfer module is respectively connected with the projection equipment, the display equipment and the head-mounted display, the fire disaster simulation animation can be projected on the scene environment model through the projection equipment, and the comprehensive fire disaster scene animation can be synchronously transmitted to the display equipment and the head-mounted display through the information transfer module; the problems of poor comprehensive performance and low practicability of the existing fire-fighting exercise equipment are solved.

title_en: Coal rock data acquisition, management and evaluation method based on digital rock mechanics
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coal mine coal rock digitizing technology and application, in particular to a coal rock data acquisition, management and evaluation method based on digital rock mechanics. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a coal core sample, recording drilling sampling information and coal core sample information, collecting basic physical properties and mesoscopic structural parameters of the coal core, collecting mechanical index parameters of the coal core, constructing a digital coal core library, and carrying out rapid nondestructive evaluation on the mechanical index parameters of the coal core. The invention improves the management efficiency of coal rock data and the capability of data depth application analysis, and reduces the land and cost required by building the entity coal core library; the method has the advantages that various functional modules are provided, so that the three-dimensional structure inside the coal core can be conveniently and quickly accessed and checked, and related parameters can be conveniently and quickly checked; the invention also improves the precision and efficiency of the evaluation of the mechanical index parameters of the coal core, and provides a rapid and efficient decision support for mining design, safety evaluation, disaster prevention and control and other works required in the coal development process.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Simulated emergency risk avoiding training facility
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the fire-fighting equipment industry, and particularly relates to an emergency evacuation training equipment. A room wall from one to the top layer is arranged at the right middle part of the main body, a lifting rescue opening and a limited space rescue simulation device are arranged at the top layer of the main body, and a water hose laying platform is arranged between the upper stair opening of the first main stair and the main body wall surface. The simulated emergency evacuation training facility is provided with various condition simulation sites of a fire scene, so that the rescue escape and evacuation skills of firefighters are improved effectively. The facility integrates a plurality of danger avoiding subjects, can improve comprehensive and diversified danger avoiding skills of firefighters, so as to improve success rate in actual combat and reduce loss of personnel and property. Compact structure, small occupied area, convenient movement and repeated utilization, and saves the construction cost of the training field.

title_en: Calcareous sand grouting diffusion reinforcement simulation device and experimental method in seawater environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calcareous sand grouting diffusion reinforcement simulation device and an experimental method in a seawater environment, and belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and control of island reef engineering. It comprises the following steps: the system comprises a seawater environment simulation system, a calcareous sand layer simulation system, a data acquisition and monitoring system and a grouting and slurry storage system; the seawater environment simulation system forms a seepage loop; the calcareous sand layer simulation system is arranged in the seawater environment simulation system, and two ends of the calcareous sand layer simulation system are respectively connected with two groups of grouting pipes and one group of exhaust ports; the data acquisition and detection system comprises pressure sensors buried in different positions of the calcareous sand layer, wherein the sensors are connected with a signal collector and are fed back to the computer control platform through the signal collector; and the grouting and slurry storage system inputs the slurry into the calcareous sand layer simulation system from the slurry storage barrel. The first water storage tank, the second water storage tank and the flow speed control mechanism can control the inlet and outlet and the flow speed of seawater and form a seepage loop, so that the real seawater environment can be accurately simulated and restored, and the grouting test simulation research is conveniently carried out indoors.

title_en: Method for laying hollow pipe through horizontal drilling traction for dam blocking treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for laying a hollow pipe by horizontal drilling traction for dam blocking treatment. After landslide blocking river and barrier lake disasters occur, the device can rapidly and horizontally drill in a loose pile body and simultaneously pull the embedded hollow pipeline. When the water level rises to the height of the pipe orifice, the control valve at the tail end of the hollowed-out pipeline is circularly opened and closed, progressive tracing collapse of the dam is caused by seepage damage, and finally automatic removal of the dam body is realized. Compared with the existing dam blocking disaster emergency treatment technology, the method has the advantages of quick construction, simple operation and resource saving, can quickly respond when landslide blocking disaster occurs, can control the dam blocking risk, and can gradually remove the dam blocking dam by means of the natural force of water so as to ensure the safety of the upstream and downstream of the valley.

title_en: Industrial control network emergency response method based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention provides an industrial control network emergency response method based on a knowledge graph, which carries out knowledge modeling on industrial control network emergency response related knowledge, and constructs an industrial control security threat information base, an industrial control vulnerability knowledge base, an industrial control virus feature base, an industrial control malicious attack load base, an industrial control attack behavior feature base, an industrial control security threat judgment knowledge base and an industrial control network security threat emergency response processing template base, and on the basis, knowledge extraction, knowledge fusion and reasoning calculation are carried out to support threat detection and emergency response tasks under the complex scene of an industrial network. The threat information acquisition mode of 'active and passive combination' is adopted, based on threat judgment of 'feature, abnormality and behavior' combination, a simulation response strategy of 'virtual and actual combination' and an emergency response support mechanism of 'on-site remote combination'. The accuracy of safety threat judgment facing the industrial control network and the efficiency of adopting targeted emergency response are improved, and the possible loss caused by the safety threat is reduced.
assignees: SEATECH TIANYU TECH HANGZHOU CO LTD;SEATECH TIANYU BEIJING CO LTD;XINJIANG ZHONGJING INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide hazard risk prediction method and system based on big data analysis and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of landslide disasters, and discloses a landslide hazard risk prediction method and a landslide hazard risk prediction system based on big data analysis and machine learning. The method comprises the following steps: the historical landslide hazard big data are collected, processing the historical landslide disaster big data; selecting landslide hazard evaluation factors and carrying out grading assignment; screening a historical landslide hazard risk prediction data set; sample equalization processing is carried out, and a historical landslide hazard risk prediction training set is obtained; constructing a landslide hazard risk prediction model; acquiring real-time landslide hazard risk prediction data; the method and the device for predicting the landslide hazard risk by using the landslide hazard risk prediction model input real-time landslide hazard risk prediction data of the current region to be predicted solve the problems of large workload, low automation degree, poor result accuracy, low referential value, and low practicability of external factors and landslide hazard evaluation factors which are not considered in the prior art.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating corrosion degree of equipment in whole area after fire disaster
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for evaluating the corrosion degree of equipment in a whole area after a fire disaster, which are used for determining the corresponding environmental temperature, humidity, fire smoke concentration and other data of the whole area of a fire disaster scene by simulating the whole process of fire disaster occurrence and development, and inputting the environmental data of the whole area of the fire disaster scene obtained by simulation into a corrosion rate prediction model to determine the corrosion rate of equipment in the fire disaster scene, so that the damage degree of the equipment in the whole area after the fire disaster is evaluated, the problem that a great amount of manpower and material resources are required to be firstly consumed in the rescue process of the equipment in the fire disaster scene to perform sampling analysis in order to evaluate the corrosion degree of the equipment in the fire disaster scene is solved, and the rescue efficiency of the equipment in the fire disaster scene is improved.

title_en: Three-dimensional lightning positioning method suitable for complex terrain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional lightning positioning method suitable for complex terrains, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster monitoring. According to the invention, a database of lightning electromagnetic wave propagation is established by a time domain finite difference method, and the actually measured electromagnetic wave waveform of the lightning detection equipment is matched with the simulation waveform in the database to determine the possible occurrence position of lightning. Based on the time difference method, monte Carlo random test and time finite difference, real surface relief and finite conductivity are considered, and inversion is carried out to obtain more accurate lightning positions.
