The invention is suitable for the real ground surface, especially in the fields of meteorological early warning, public safety, serious disasters and the like in complex terrain areas, and has wide application value in the aspects of detection of thunder and lightning, early warning and protection of thunder and lightning disasters.

title_en: Landslide disaster body identification method based on analytic hierarchy process and convolutional neural network
abstract_en: A landslide disaster body identification method based on an analytic hierarchy process and a convolutional neural network comprises the following steps: step S1, analyzing weights by using an analytic hierarchy process, and determining to acquire corresponding layer data; acquiring an influence factor with the largest weight and an influence factor with obvious faults with other weights as superimposed data; s2, manufacturing a data set; a data set containing landslide bodies and a data set not containing disaster bodies; step S3, constructing a convolutional neural network and presetting a convolutional neural network model; step four, training and fine-tuning a convolutional neural network model, wherein the data set obtained in the step 2 is used for model parameter tuning and model verification, and the result condition is based; and step S5, testing the recognition effect of the convolutional neural network model. The invention does not need to collect a large amount of data of disaster body influence factors, only uses the data of influence factors with higher influence degree, reduces the requirement of computer hardware, saves manpower and reduces the production cost.
assignees: SHANDONG LAND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION CENTER SHANDONG GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION TECH GUIDA;SHANDONG GEO SURVEYING & MAPPING INST;UNIV JINAN

title_en: Facility management system based on simulation and operation method therefor
title_ko: 시뮬레이션에 기반한 시설물 관리 시스템 및 이를 위한 동작 방법
abstract_en: According to the present embodiment, an operation method for a simulation-based facility management system comprises the following steps of: building a three-dimensional model of a target structure of a simulation; performing a simulation on the three-dimensional model according to a disaster risk degree associated with a natural disaster and a deterioration degree of the target structure; and deriving a priority for maintenance and management of the target structure based on a result of the simulation.
abstract_ko: 본 일 실시 예에 따른 시뮬레이션에 기반한 시설물 관리 시스템을 위한 동작 방법은, 시뮬레이션의 대상 구조물에 대한 3차원 모델을 구축하는 단계; 3차원 모델에 대하여 자연 재해와 연관된 재해 위험도 및 대상 구조물의 노후화도에 따른 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 단계; 및 시뮬레이션의 결과를 기반으로 대상 구조물의 유지 및 관리를 위한 우선 순위를 도출하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: High-altitude rope rescue comprehensive training facility
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a comprehensive training facility for high-altitude rope rescue, which relates to the technical field of rope rescue training and comprises support posts and rope threading device bodies, wherein cross beams are staggered between adjacent support posts, a plurality of functional areas are formed between the support posts and the cross beam, the rope threading device bodies for assisting firefighters in quickly building ropes are arranged on the cross beams at low positions, each rope threading device body comprises a connecting rod, a rubber grip and a hook claw, the tail end of the right side of the connecting rod is sleeved with the rubber grip, the inner wall of the rubber grip is tightly attached to the outer wall of the connecting rod, the hook claw is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the left side of the connecting rod in an integrated manner, and the cross section of the hook claw is in a fish hook shape. The utility model provides an overhead rope rescue comprehensive training facility can swiftly realize the rope and be located the construction of eminence crossbeam, makes things convenient for the fireman to be quick in the transfer of each functional region, solves prior art and needs personnel to take the rope through the climbing on the crossbeam of eminence, probably has safety risk and inconvenient not enough of operation.
assignees: SHENZHEN SAIWEI GAOKONG IND CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating landslide susceptibility by combining remote sensing images with crowd source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating landslide susceptibility by combining remote sensing images with mass source data, which comprises the following steps of dividing a slope unit, collecting spatial distribution data of landslide disaster factors for preprocessing, carrying out state grading processing according to the landslide disaster factors, carrying out independent inspection and screening, extracting landslide disaster points from the mass source data and carrying out standard processing to generate a first type of landslide training sample, extracting landslide disaster points of the remote sensing images by utilizing a YOLOv algorithm to generate a second type of landslide training sample, integrating and cleaning the first type of landslide training sample and the second type of landslide training sample to obtain a third type of landslide training sample, and carrying out landslide susceptibility evaluation on the three types of landslide training samples respectively through a random forest classification method to evaluate the danger of regional landslide. The method for evaluating landslide susceptibility by combining the remote sensing images with the crowd source data can generate landslide samples, so that the risk of regional landslide can be evaluated rapidly and accurately.

title_en: Disaster simulation sensing method, device, equipment and medium based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster simulation sensing method, device, equipment and medium based on virtual reality, wherein the method comprises the following steps: basic geographic information of a target area is acquired, wherein the target area is an area to be simulated; determining a simulated disaster type of the target area according to the basic geographic information of the target area, wherein the simulated disaster type comprises an underground disaster and an underground disaster; constructing a three-dimensional geographic model according to the simulated disaster type and the basic geographic information; simulating a disaster occurrence process of a target area by using a preset disaster simulation model according to the three-dimensional geographic model to obtain a simulated disaster scene, wherein the simulated disaster scene is deployed in the three-dimensional geographic model; and constructing user projection in the simulated disaster scene, wherein the user projection is used for sensing the disaster occurrence process, and the simulated disaster scene sensed by the user projection is fed back to the user through a virtual reality technology. The disaster simulation method solves the technical problem that in the existing disaster simulation method, the simulated disaster type is single.
assignees: GUONENG SHENDONG COAL GROUP CO LTD;CHINA ENERGY SHENDONG COAL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network elasticity assessment method based on mechanical mapping
abstract_en: The power distribution network elasticity assessment method based on the mechanical mapping comprises the steps of firstly establishing a mechanical elasticity and power distribution network elasticity mapping relation respectively for two stages of disaster resistance and disaster post recovery, determining an expression of a resistance elasticity coefficient and a recovery elasticity coefficient based on power distribution network elasticity indexes, wherein the power distribution network elasticity indexes comprise active power deficiency in the resistance stage, average load loss speed, average load loss duration, active power deficiency in the recovery stage, load average recovery speed and load average recovery duration, inputting power distribution network topology information and fault conditions, simulating to obtain a power distribution network system load curve, calculating the power distribution network elasticity indexes based on the power distribution network system load curve, and further calculating the resistance elasticity coefficient and the recovery elasticity coefficient to evaluate the power distribution network elasticity level. According to the invention, the resistance elasticity coefficient and the recovery elasticity coefficient are comprehensively quantized through six elasticity indexes, and the elasticity connotation of the power distribution network is excavated, so that the comprehensive and effective evaluation of the elasticity level of the power distribution network is realized.

title_en: Drilling surrounding rock deformation continuous monitoring equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geotechnical, traffic, mine and hydraulic engineering, and in particular relates to equipment and a method for continuously monitoring deformation of surrounding rock of a drilling hole, which comprise a data acquisition instrument, a copper cable fixed on a frame, a first magnetic ring, a second magnetic ring and a pressure sensor, wherein the first magnetic ring, the second magnetic ring and the pressure sensor are fixed on the drilling hole; one end of the copper cable is fixedly connected with the pressure sensor, the second magnetic ring is positioned above the pressure sensor and is in contact connection with the pressure sensor, the first magnetic ring is matched with the second magnetic ring in a coaxial way, and the data acquisition instrument is electrically connected with the pressure sensor. The equipment and the method can accurately calculate the continuous deformation of the surrounding rock in the drilling hole, further judge the disturbance destruction condition of the surrounding rock, and have important significance for prevention and control of geological disasters.

title_en: Drainage basin flood early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drainage basin flood early warning system, comprising: the system comprises a rainwater condition monitoring facility, a rainwater condition monitoring transmission system, a flood risk dynamic simulation system, a flood condition identification system, a flood early warning release system and a visualized flood prevention online access system; the rainwater condition monitoring and transmitting system is used for collecting rainwater condition monitoring data of each rainwater condition monitoring facility in real time; the flood risk dynamic simulation system is used for generating critical indexes and flood disaster loss values corresponding to different rainwater condition information when flood occurs; the flood condition identification system takes the received critical index as an early warning index, and judges whether early warning is carried out or not according to the magnitude relation between the real-time rain condition monitoring data and the early warning index; the visualized flood prevention online access system displays real-time rainwater condition monitoring data, early warning and flood disaster loss values. The invention can improve the emergency response speed of flood control in the river basin and provide real-time information service for flood disaster management in the river basin.

title_en: Pedestrian evacuation method for improving field cellular automaton and genetic algorithm in coupling way
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pedestrian evacuation method for improving a field cellular automaton and a genetic algorithm by coupling, which comprises the following steps: acquiring environmental data and internal structure information of an area to be evacuated; dividing the crowd in the area to be evacuated to generate a plurality of initial crowd; dividing an environmental space in an area to be evacuated into a plurality of cells; initializing the spatial position of pedestrians before evacuation begins and other various pedestrian attributes; traversing each pedestrian through an improved field cellular automaton simulation program; calculating an average evacuation completion time data of each population by using a simulation program as an fitness evaluation function and storing the data; reprocessing the population to produce a new generation of population; calculating an adaptability evaluation function, and judging whether a termination condition is met; if yes, outputting the optimal average evacuation completion time; otherwise, go to the previous step. The invention is beneficial to shortening the evacuation time and improving the emergency management capability of the emergency event.

title_en: Coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal mine safety exploitation, in particular to a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction method based on deep learning. Firstly, preparing the influence index data of a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster, and cleaning data by using a box plot analysis method Box plot and a chained equation multiple interpolation method MICE; secondly, carrying out data analysis by using a gray correlation analysis method GRA, and establishing a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction index system; thirdly, building a model by using a convolutional neural network CNN, and optimizing super parameters of the model by using a sparrow search algorithm SSA to improve prediction accuracy; training a model, and establishing a GRA-SSA-CNN-based coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction model; and finally, predicting by using the test set, and comparing the predicted result with the actual result to determine the prediction precision of the model. The prediction model provided by the application has the advantages of short training time, good generalization and strong robustness, and can be used for rapidly and accurately predicting the coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster.

title_en: Intensive crowd guiding and evacuating simulation method in large pedestrian facility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dense crowd guiding and evacuating simulation method in a large pedestrian facility, which comprises the steps of calculating potential energy values related to all subareas and each exit; determining potential energy values of the subareas related to each outlet in consideration of the distance of each outlet, the pedestrian density of the subareas and the average pedestrian speed of the subareas; adding the subregion of the potential energy value obtained by calculation into an ordered queue corresponding to the outlet; determining a temporary evacuation outlet for each sub-zone; according to potential energy values of each sub-area and each exit, a temporary evacuation exit is allocated for pedestrians in each sub-area; determining a target evacuation outlet for each sub-zone; different guiding and evacuating strategies are formulated according to the information release time interval and the sub-region maintenance original exit inertia, and the movement behavior rules of individuals and groups under different guiding strategies and the formation and evolution rules of various self-organizing phenomena can be revealed; the invention provides scientific basis and suggestion for the safe evacuation scheme of dense crowd in large pedestrian facilities.

title_en: Mining disaster treatment method for ultra-thin coal seam protection layer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal exploitation, and particularly provides a disaster management method for exploitation of an ultra-thin coal seam protection layer, which mainly comprises the steps of layer penetrating drilling, full negative pressure ventilation, gas prevention and control of exploitation strips, and also comprises a gob-side entry retaining process, goaf gas extraction, monitoring and monitoring, goaf strip fire prevention and control and exploitation strip dust prevention. In the scheme, high-pressure nitrogen injection equipment is adopted to perform a press-in nitrogen injection measure in an extraction strip from the head of the extension arm coal mining machine, so that the gas components at the head are mainly nitrogen and gas; the conventional gas control is implemented in the mining strip, and gas extraction is also carried out on the mining strip through the through-layer drilling; and multi-parameter monitoring probes are respectively arranged at the opening of the mining strip, the tail end of the gob-side entry retaining, the extraction pipeline of the mining strip and the airtight observation hole of the goaf, and the dust monitoring probes are additionally arranged at the opening of the mining strip.

title_en: Geological disaster slip plane measurement method based on excitation effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster slip surface measurement method based on an induced polarization effect, which comprises the steps of drilling N industrial holes at the rear end of a potential landslide body to be detected, injecting slurry with high polarization rate and lower viscosity into the industrial holes, acquiring and obtaining visual polarization rates at a plurality of first electrode distances along the direction of the landslide body by utilizing a temperature and sodium device with equal electrode distances, increasing the distance of the electrodes, repeatedly acquiring and obtaining the visual polarization rates at a plurality of second electrode distances along the direction of the landslide body, forming a visual polarization rate data set, drawing a visual polarization rate pseudo-section chart according to the visual polarization rate data set, analyzing a high polarization rate distribution rule according to the visual polarization rate pseudo-section chart to obtain a preliminary slip surface position, inverting the visual polarization rate data set to obtain a visual polarization rate inversion section chart, and obtaining an accurate slip surface position according to the visual polarization rate pseudo-section chart and the visual polarization rate inversion section chart.

title_en: Dangerous rock damage unstability movement characteristic simulation test device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a dangerous rock damage unsteady motion characteristic simulation test device, and relates to the technical field of geological deformation monitoring. Dangerous rock damage unstability motion characteristic analogue test device includes: dangerous rock failure mode simulation test assembly and unsteady motion characteristic simulation test assembly. According to the simulation test device, the dangerous rock damage mode simulation test component is used for researching a dangerous rock damage mode, and the deformation damage mode and the collapse disaster-causing mechanism of the side slope of the fractured rock mass are revealed by monitoring seismic power responses and side slope deformation conditions of different parts and different heights of the side slope; the unsteady motion characteristic simulation test component can obtain the motion trail of the whole falling process of the falling rocks through calculation, and simultaneously records the speed, the total energy, the bouncing height and the falling rock accumulation area of each falling time point. The influence of the change of the falling stone characteristics and the slope materials on the falling stone movement track is simulated.
assignees: SHENZHEN INVESTIGATION & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster early warning data collection and analysis simulation cabin based on multiple sensors
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire early-warning data collecting and analyzing simulation cabin based on multiple sensors, and relates to the technical field of fire early-warning data collecting and analyzing. According to the utility model, various rates of heating process tests are carried out on tested materials through a heating furnace with accurate temperature control in a simulated cabin, a micro control unit MCU is matched with an electric fire sensor in a sensor assembly to collect current, voltage and wire temperature, a pyrolytic particle sensor is used for collecting pyrolytic ion concentration data and environmental temperature data, an H2 sensor is used for collecting hydrogen concentration, a CO sensor is used for collecting carbon monoxide concentration, a 4G communication module is used for wirelessly transmitting the data to a cloud platform, a processing terminal is used for modeling and analyzing experimental data, and a display device is used for observing and recording the data, so that a large amount of abnormal data is accumulated in a short period, and a working system is helped to quickly and effectively train and identify algorithms.
assignees: SUZHOU ANXIN ZHILIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster landslide slip surface drilling sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of soil sampling, and provides a drilling and sampling device for a landslide surface of a geological disaster. Through the mutual cooperation of the structures in the adjusting mechanism, the motor is started to drive the screw rod to rotate at the output end and simultaneously enable the movable block to move leftwards or rightwards so as to drive the connecting cylinder to move leftwards or rightwards, and secondary sampling can be carried out through the sampling mechanism at the bottom of the connecting cylinder after the position of another sampling is adjusted, so that the sampling efficiency is effectively improved, and the problems that the sampling device in the prior art can only sample one point at a time and the sampling efficiency is low are solved; through the mutually supporting of structure in the sampling mechanism, positive starter motor II makes output drive rotary drum synchronous rotation make its inside drilling rod pass through slider II card at the inside synchronous rotation of spout II to screw connection between pivoted and nut, thereby make the drilling rod rotate downwards in the inside of nut, can play and carry out quick drilling sample work to soil.
assignees: NO 313 GEOLOGICAL TEAM BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL RESOURCES OF ANHUI PROVINCE

title_en: Crowd emergency evacuation path planning method for large-scale stadium
abstract_en: The crowd emergency evacuation path planning method for the large-scale stadium comprises the following steps: (1) Realizing automatic identification and labeling of stadium targets based on a convolutional neural network, and constructing scene information; (2) Then, a crowd simulation technology based on density driving is used for obtaining stadium personnel distribution conditions; (3) And finally, determining the evacuation path of the personnel in each area based on a path planning algorithm of the crowd density. The invention realizes the functions of disaster detection, disaster distribution display, crowd evacuation obstacle avoidance, rescue scheme decision and the like by carrying out scientific detection and comprehensive analysis on real-time data such as crowd density, building topography, exit distribution and the like. The invention has the advantages that: when dangerous situations occur, the optimal evacuation path can be quickly found; the scientificity and intuitiveness are good, and the use and the operation are easy; the staff can completely simulate the whole evacuation process and is familiar with the disaster prevention emergency flow so as to grasp stadium information, thereby immediately reacting when the disaster occurs.

title_en: Coal enterprise technical skill person sentry matching prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal enterprise technical skill person post matching prediction method and system, comprising the following steps: quantifying the technical skill employee competency evaluation index of each target employee; clustering all quantized samples by taking the primary index points and the secondary index points as feature dimensions to obtain a clustering analysis classification result; training the SVR regression model by using the secondary index points of each target employee to obtain a coal enterprise post matching prediction model; and (5) completing the person post matching of the target staff by using the person post matching prediction model of the coal enterprise. According to the invention, the samples are classified by adopting cluster analysis, and the class attribution category of each sample, namely the classification result, is obtained, so that the problem of consideration of multi-index point weight setting when each sample is classified is avoided. In addition, the support vector machine algorithm adopted by the invention maps the variables to a high-dimensional space and constructs a linear classification function, so that the model has stronger generalization capability, and simultaneously, the occurrence of dimension disasters is well avoided.

title_en: Smoke detection model, training method and fire disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a smoke detection model, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a backbone network, a feature collaborative alignment module and a feature fusion module, wherein the backbone network is used for extracting initial source domain feature information of a smoke image in a source domain and extracting initial target domain feature information of the smoke image in a target domain; the feature collaborative alignment module is used for receiving the initial source domain feature information and the initial target domain feature information, performing domain alignment on the initial source domain feature information and the initial target domain feature information, and migrating the aligned initial source domain feature information to the initial target domain feature information to obtain first target domain feature information; the feature fusion module is used for acquiring first target domain feature information and acquiring smoke feature information with different sizes from the first target domain feature information. The embodiment of the invention also discloses a training method of the smoke detection model and a fire early warning method.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Coal spontaneous combustion multielement information monitoring and early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal spontaneous combustion multi-element information monitoring and early warning system and method, wherein the system comprises a mining intrinsic safety type laser spectrum multi-parameter wireless analyzer, a mining intrinsic safety type An Xingyun desk type wireless infrared thermal imager, a mining intrinsic safety type distributed optical fiber temperature measuring wireless host, a mining intrinsic safety type Internet of things gateway, a mining intrinsic safety type An Xingmo megaswitch and a ground monitoring host; the method comprises the following steps: 1. setting coal spontaneous combustion multielement information monitoring indexes; 2. training a DWT-LSTM time sequence prediction model; 3. collecting coal spontaneous combustion multielement information; 4. and monitoring and early warning of the coal spontaneous combustion multivariate information by using a DWT-LSTM time sequence prediction model. The invention can realize real-time and accurate acquisition of the characteristic information of the mine fire disaster, is used for fusion identification and danger assessment, achieves the purposes of reducing and preventing the mine fire disaster, and can effectively realize early warning of the mine fire disaster and positioning of the coal spontaneous combustion hidden danger.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;SHAANXI XIKE ZHIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system for firefighter occupational training
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring and early warning method for firefighter occupational training, which comprises the following steps: collecting physical sign data in the occupational training process of the firefighter in real time, and carrying out analysis and evaluation and abnormal early warning on the physical sign data based on a physical sign evaluation algorithm to obtain first monitoring and early warning data; collecting psychological data in the professional training process of the firefighter in real time, and carrying out analysis and evaluation and abnormal early warning on the psychological data based on a psychological evaluation algorithm to obtain second monitoring and early warning data; acquiring action data in the professional training process of the firefighter in real time, and carrying out analysis and evaluation and abnormal early warning on the action data based on an action evaluation algorithm to obtain third monitoring and early warning data; collecting heating data in the occupational training process of the firefighter in real time, and carrying out analysis and evaluation and abnormal early warning on the heating data based on a heating evaluation algorithm to obtain fourth monitoring and early warning data; and obtaining comprehensive intelligent monitoring and early warning results of the professional training of the firefighter. Corresponding systems, electronic devices, and computer-readable storage media are also disclosed.
assignees: CHINA FIRE AND RESCUE INST;ZHONGJIN YUNENG TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Reliability evaluation method and system based on time-varying fault rate model and time sequence simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability evaluation method and a system based on a time-varying fault rate model and time sequence simulation, wherein the reliability evaluation method and the system comprise the following steps: acquiring historical operating parameters and external operating conditions of a power grid element, counting historical failure frequency and repair rate of the element, and calculating failure rate and failure probability of the element; calculating occurrence probability of meteorological disasters and failure rate of equipment failure caused by each meteorological disaster based on external operation conditions, and constructing an element time-varying failure rate model; acquiring weather conditions by using a time sequence simulation method, and performing weather self-adaptive repeated sampling based on weather sampling precision; obtaining element failure rate and failure probability by using an element time-varying failure rate model; and acquiring a short-term system condition time sequence curve based on the sampling result, the fault rate and the fault probability, and calculating a power grid reliability index. The invention can more accurately describe the time and the power grid fault rate related to the environment, reflects the influence of weather on the system reliability, reflects the typical time sequence state of the system in severe weather, and provides reference for the system fault condition in severe weather.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;UNIV TSINGHUA;NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses geological disaster monitoring and early warning equipment, which is provided with a first positioning column component and a second positioning column component which are matched with each other for use, wherein the first positioning column component and the second positioning column component are respectively fixed at two sides of a crack at a monitoring place, holes are drilled in the positions where expansion sleeves are positioned in advance, after the first positioning column component and the second positioning column component are respectively fixed, the expansion sleeves extend into the holes, screws are drilled into the holes, the expansion sleeves are extruded in the holes along with the drilling of the screws, the screws are tightly hooped under the condition of reaction force, and the screws are difficult to fall off, so that a reinforcing ring plays a reinforcing role on the first positioning column component and the second positioning column component respectively, and the first positioning column component or the second positioning column component are prevented from loosening; this monitoring early warning equipment has two kinds of ranging tools of range finding area and infrared range finder, when one of them unexpected damage, can rely on another kind to monitor crack expansion change, and the reliability further promotes.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGJI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster degree identification method, device, equipment and medium based on multi-source information
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data monitoring, in particular to a disaster degree identification method, device, equipment and medium based on multi-source information, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring historical river channel water level extract data and real-time river channel water level observation data, and determining first disaster data of a potential disaster area; acquiring current rainfall information and current river basin information of a potential disaster-stricken area, and performing disaster simulation according to the current rainfall information and the current river basin information to obtain second disaster-stricken data of the potential disaster-stricken area; acquiring target multimedia data uploaded in a preset time period, and determining third disaster-stricken data of a potential disaster-stricken area according to the target multimedia data; acquiring disaster investigation information, and determining fourth disaster data of a potential disaster affected area according to the disaster investigation information; and determining the disaster receiving degree of the potential disaster receiving area according to the first disaster receiving data, the second disaster receiving data, the third disaster receiving data and the fourth disaster receiving data. The method and the device can rapidly and accurately identify the disaster degree caused by the storm mountain torrents.

title_en: Natural disaster named entity recognition method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster named entity recognition method and device, comprising the steps of inputting a natural disaster sentence sequence, carrying out word embedding processing, and training the natural disaster sentence sequence into word vectors; performing dictionary matching on each character in the natural disaster sentence sequence by utilizing a pre-constructed dictionary to obtain a vector of a word set; splicing the vectors of the word set with the word vectors to obtain a spliced sequence, and inputting the spliced sequence into a BiLSTM model to extract forward and reverse semantic feature information; extracting semantic feature information of the context by using a key value memory network; extracting forward and reverse semantic feature information according to the semantic feature information of the context and the BiLSTM model, and coding; and decoding the coding result by using a CRF decoding layer to realize the identification of the natural disaster named entity. The invention combines the characteristics of a large number of proper nouns in the natural disaster field, and has more pertinence.

title_en: Water-based fire extinguisher for fire scene escape and self-rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water-based fire extinguisher for escaping from a fire scene for self-rescue, which comprises a water-based fire extinguisher, wherein an emergency ascertaining mechanism is arranged on the surface of the water-based fire extinguisher: the ascertaining mechanism comprises a setting frame, the setting frame is arranged on the peripheral surface of the water-based fire extinguisher, a lamp holder is fixedly arranged on the surface of the setting frame, a threaded groove is formed in the lamp holder, and a screw lamp holder is arranged on internal threads of the lamp holder. When the fire extinguisher is manufactured, the surface of the water-based fire extinguisher is welded with the external lamp holder, the top of the external lamp holder is provided with the chute with the groove drilling tool, the cover plate is moved left and right at the top of the external lamp holder, the storage battery in the rack is electrically connected with the inside of the lamp holder, when a fire disaster happens, when all lighting equipment is destroyed, the screw lamp cap is taken out from the inside of the external lamp holder, and the screw lamp cap is installed in the lamp holder, so that the lighting can be realized quickly, thereby being convenient for fire fighting and disaster relief.
assignees: HANGZHOU ZHONGAN SAFETY TECH CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon disaster and short rainstorm urban waterlogging combined pipe network system test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a typhoon calamity and short face city waterlogging combination formula pipe network system test device under rainstorm, include at least: the combined pipe network device comprises node units and pipeline connecting units for connecting adjacent node units, and is used for realizing simulation of an urban rainwater and sewage pipe network system; the supporting and positioning device is arranged below the combined pipe network device and is used for supporting and positioning the combined pipe network device so as to install the combined pipe network device; and the water supply and collection circulating device is used for supplying water supply and water circulation to the combined pipe network device and realizing the simulation of the rain sewage inlet and outlet combined pipe network device. The utility model discloses set up the simulation model of city rain sewage pipe network system, can simulate different distribution structure's city rain sewage discharge pipe network system, and can realize the simulation to the node failure to measure the velocity of flow and the water pressure size of corresponding point, it is nimble convenient, easy operation is fit for the repetition test.

title_en: Grouting protection model test device and test method for foundation scour disaster of offshore wind turbine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grouting protection model test device and a test method for foundation scour disasters of offshore wind turbines, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a fan foundation simulation system, a load simulation system, a grouting system and an intelligent monitoring system; the base simulation system is a round assembled steel consolidation barrel, a simulated stratum and a barrel-shaped base are arranged in the barrel, a drain hole is arranged in the middle of the barrel, and a slide block guide rail is welded on the upper part of the barrel; the load simulation system is connected with the guide rail of the consolidation barrel through a guide sliding block and consists of a servo motor, a thrust screw rod, a transverse bracket, a vertical bracket, a bearing plate, a loading rod and a guide sliding block; the grouting system comprises a grouting power device, a slurry mixing device, a pressure-resistant pipeline and a grouting parameter recording system; the intelligent monitoring system consists of a laser range finder, a displacement meter, an optical fiber stress sensor, a soil pressure and osmotic pressure sensor and an intelligent recorder, and can feed back stratum parameters such as osmotic pressure, soil pressure, stress, deformation and the like. The method can effectively realize the foundation grouting protection simulation of the offshore wind turbine, and has positive beneficial reference effect on engineering application.

title_en: Dynamic assessment method and system for inland inundation disasters of urban underground space
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for dynamically evaluating inland inundation disasters of urban underground spaces, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting distribution information of the urban underground space, and constructing a distribution model of the urban underground space based on the distribution information; performing historical waterlogging disaster evaluation based on the distribution model to obtain a historical waterlogging disaster evaluation result; based on the historical waterlogging disaster evaluation result, making waterlogging disaster prevention measures, and constructing a preventive distribution model based on the distribution model; performing multiple disaster simulation based on the preventive model to obtain simulated waterlogging disaster data; and summarizing and analyzing the simulated waterlogging disaster data to obtain a dynamic evaluation result of the waterlogging disaster. The method and the system can truly reflect the influence of flood disasters on the society, have universality, can be combined with any urban rainfall flood model, guide the correct deployment of disaster prevention and reduction work, and improve the toughness of the urban underground space for resisting the flood disasters.

title_en: Digital formed fruit display method and carrier system for mountain pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital pipeline construction, in particular to a digital fruit display method and a carrier system for mountain pipelines, which can visually display a pipeline model of each pipeline and a station model of each station in the mountain pipelines on one hand, and can obtain a mountain terrain model for reflecting geographic information around the mountain pipelines on the other hand by processing images containing the mountain pipelines on the other hand, and simulate the running states of the mountain pipelines under different terrain parameters and different production parameters so as to facilitate enterprises to determine risks of various dangerous geological disaster conditions such as landslide, debris flow, ground collapse and the like according to the mountain terrain model and provide data support for the enterprises to accurately make geological disaster prevention and control measures, emergency rescue measures and emergency repair route planning.
assignees: STATE PETROLEUM NATURAL GAS PIPE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD;STATE PIPE NETWORK GROUP SOUTHWEST PIPELINE CO LTD

title_en: Coal face triangular area multi-disaster cooperative management method based on directional drilling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directional drilling based multi-disaster cooperative treatment method for a coal face triangular area, which comprises the following steps of: s1, determining a stress concentration zone of a triangular area of a coal face; s2, designing the distribution control layer positions of the main holes and the branch holes of the comb-shaped directional drilling and the distribution control interval of the comb-shaped directional drilling according to the step S1; s3, dynamically analyzing geological conditions, and continuously correcting the exploration of the branch holes; s4, designing the number and the length of branch holes of the comb-shaped directional drilling staged fracturing, drilling the main hole of the comb-shaped directional drilling of the top plate, and performing fracturing modification on the branch holes; s5, determining hole sealing extraction and gas extraction parameters after the comb-shaped directional drilling and fracturing; and S6, dynamically controlling gas extraction and monitoring ore pressure in real time. The cooperative management of the rock burst disaster in the working face end triangular area and the gas extraction in the goaf is realized, and the problems of small control area, high cost and the like of rock burst drilling and gas extraction drilling in the prior art are solved.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Roadway protection method for gob-side entry retaining of multiple coal seams in real ground stress environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadway protection method for multi-coal-seam gob-side entry retaining in a real ground stress environment, which comprises the following steps: step one, sample preparation; step two, preparing a multi-field coupling coal rock mass dynamic disaster prevention and control technology simulation system for installation; thirdly, applying true triaxial prestress; step four, applying true triaxial mining induced stress, changing the stress value of the No. 4 loading device in the Z direction to 6, 8 and 10MPa, unloading until the coal seam roof is damaged, and keeping sigma after the damage  z4  The method is unchanged, so that the roadway protection effect of gob-side entry retaining of the goaf is simulated; step five, starting the high-speed camera; visually monitoring and recording the whole loading process; step six, performing other tests in the same group; step seven, ending the test; the tunnel protection effect simulation of the large-size multi-coal-seam gob-side entry retaining can be carried out, and the simulation process is more real and reliable.
assignees: PINGDINGSHAN TIANAN COAL MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING;CHINA PINGMEI SHENMA HOLDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Urban inland inundation disaster early warning grade evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban inland inundation disaster early warning grade evaluation method, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining an urban inland inundation disaster early warning level index; s2, simulating each equidistant waterlogging disaster process in the city by using a numerical simulation technology; s3, carrying out early warning index hierarchy division and index weight determination on the waterlogging disasters by adopting an analytic hierarchy process; s4, determining an evaluation index set for evaluating the urban waterlogging hazard degree; s5, determining the weight of each level of evaluation index in the evaluation index set by adopting an analytic hierarchy process; s6, evaluating the urban inland inundation disasters through the evaluation model obtained in the step S5, and determining the danger degree and the risk level of the inland inundation disasters; and S7, finally determining the early warning level of the urban waterlogging disaster, effectively improving the reliability of the early warning level evaluation result of the urban waterlogging disaster, determining the index weight based on the combined empowerment, making up the defect of a single evaluation method, and improving the precision of the early warning level evaluation result of the urban waterlogging disaster.
assignees: NINGBO HONGTAI WATER CONSERVANCY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin analysis method for flood disaster prevention in extreme rainstorm weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin analysis method for flood disaster prevention in extreme rainstorm weather, which comprises the following steps of; step one, building a data base plate, namely building the data base plate based on digital twin construction according to water conservancy basic data, high-precision geographic space data, dynamic monitoring data, business management data and cross-industry shared data; step two, rainfall forecast, which is to provide various rainfall forecast modes; according to the method, flood simulation and rehearsal under a digital scene are realized by four-forecast digital twin analysis of 'data bottom plate construction, rainfall forecast, flood forecast, evaluation and early warning, simulated rehearsal and management plan', flood prevention consultation decisions are effectively supported, weak links of the traditional flood prevention consultation process are further optimized, and the capacity and level of unified scheduling and unified management of flood disaster flood prevention are improved.
assignees: CASIC INTELLIGENCE IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Test method for simulating multi-point complex seepage path in real ground stress environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test method for simulating a multi-point complex seepage path in a real ground stress environment, which comprises the following steps: step one, preparing a multi-coal-bed sample; step two, preparing a simulation system for the dynamic disaster prevention and control technology of the multi-field coupling coal rock mass; thirdly, applying true triaxial stress; step four, seepage test; step five, replacing the sample; step six, repeating the step four to the step five; step seven, other tests in the same group; and step eight, ending the test. The triaxial stress state of the underground reservoir can be simulated more truly through loading different acting forces in the length direction and grading dynamic load actions. Through different effort loading of length direction and hierarchical dynamic load effect, can simulate the route of the multiple spot complex seepage flow of multi-coal seam under the triaxial stress state of subsurface reservoir more truly, and degree of automation is high, and the leakproofness is good.

title_en: Simulation method and system for disaster evolution of roadway anchoring surrounding rock under static and dynamic load effect
abstract_en: The application discloses a simulation method and a system for disaster evolution of roadway anchoring surrounding rock under the action of static and dynamic loads, wherein the method comprises the following steps: basic data of the roadway site anchoring surrounding rock is obtained; performing mesoscopic parameter calibration according to the basic data to obtain a calibration result; constructing a particle flow number model based on the calibration result; applying point dynamic load disturbance to the particle flow number model; and solving a termination condition according to the point dynamic load disturbance setting and monitoring the surrounding rock contact force evolution process to obtain a disaster evolution result of the roadway anchoring surrounding rock under the action of static and dynamic loads. According to the application, the pressure bearing condition of the supporting structure in the real coal mining process is simulated by constructing the particle flow number model of the roadway surrounding rock under the action of the point dynamic load, and the internal particle flow speed is restrained by using the method of applying the boundary speed to the model, so that the simulation result is more restored to the real condition, and a new thought is provided for preventing surrounding rock catastrophe of the roadway in the coal mining process.

title_en: Non-uniform grid flood simulation system and method with local self-adaption and multiple time steps
abstract_en: The invention discloses a local self-adaptive heterogeneous grid flood simulation system with multiple time steps and a method thereof, wherein a heterogeneous grid division module generates a static heterogeneous grid split map for a flood topography file in a calculation domain through a static heterogeneous grid optimization algorithm so as to reduce the calculation cost; the flux calculation module of the GPU parallel acceleration technology copies the values of related variables in the CPU to the GPU through a cudamem cpy function, disperses a two-dimensional shallow water equation through a finite volume method and carries out acceleration flux exchange calculation on the values of the related variables copied to the GPU; according to the invention, the two-dimensional hydrodynamic numerical model, the static non-uniform grid method, the GPU parallel acceleration computing technology and the local self-adaptive multi-time-step algorithm are combined to numerically simulate the flood disaster process, so that the rapid prediction of the urban waterlogging and river basin flood evolution process is realized more efficiently and more accurately.

title_en: Underground engineering surrounding rock energy test and rock burst energy absorption control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy testing and rock burst energy absorption control method for surrounding rock of underground engineering, which relates to the technical field of underground engineering safety and comprises the following steps: acquiring parameters while drilling in the process of drilling surrounding rock of a roadway, and obtaining the rock burst energy of the surrounding rock of a unit volume by combining a rock burst energy test model; acquiring performance parameters of the support member, and determining yield load and energy absorption of the support member; obtaining strength design support parameters according to the weight of surrounding rock and the yield load of the support member; obtaining energy design support parameters according to the rock burst energy and the energy absorption capacity of the support member; and combining the surrounding rock strength design support parameters and the energy design support parameters to determine the surrounding rock support design scheme. On the basis of the traditional strength support design, the influence of energy release on the support design is considered, and a surrounding rock explosion energy absorption control support design method based on strength-energy comprehensive criteria is established; the risk of occurrence of coal mine dynamic disasters can be reduced, and the construction safety is ensured.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;BEIJING LIYAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution method and system based on electric power material prediction
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution method and a system based on power material prediction, and relates to the technical field of power distribution systems, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical electric power material data; preprocessing the historical electric power material data to obtain training data; establishing an electric power material prediction model according to the training data; acquiring disaster material demand data and power grid construction material demand data according to the electric power material prediction model; obtaining a prediction result based on the disaster material demand data and the power grid construction material demand data; establishing a power grid model according to a power distribution automation system, and acquiring demand data of a power grid according to the power grid model; and optimizing the demand data according to the prediction result to obtain a power distribution strategy, and ensuring that a power distribution material distribution plan is formulated before special conditions occur.

title_en: Physical similarity simulation experiment method for fracturing of upper and lower areas of coal seam roof well
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical simulation experiment method for fracturing of upper and lower areas of a coal seam roof well, which comprises the following steps: 1. building a physical similarity model according to field geological conditions and experimental purposes; 2. according to the practice of fracturing engineering of the upper and lower areas of the coal seam roof well, adopting a static breaker to expand and fracture a thick and hard target disaster-causing rock stratum; 3. and excavating a fracturing physical similarity model of the area according to the experimental parameter similarity ratio, and carrying out data monitoring. The experimental method is mainly based on the similarity of a rock mass fracturing mechanism and a fracture expansion form after fracturing, does not consider the hydration reaction of the rock mass, adopts a static breaker to expand and fracture a target disaster-causing rock stratum and similarly simulates the fracturing weakening effect of fracturing on the rock stratum, has better feasibility in a laboratory, and the simulation is closer to a real working condition, so that the experimental accuracy is improved.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Immediate mapping imaging method for morphology of surrounding rock damage area of tunneling roadway
abstract_en: The invention discloses an instant mapping imaging method for the form of a surrounding rock damage area of a tunneling roadway, which belongs to the technical field of surrounding rock damage detection of the roadway, and is characterized in that the surrounding rock damage area information of the tunneling roadway is mapped by acquiring an image of the form of a pre-drilling crack based on the characteristic that the form of the pre-drilling crack is totally similar to the form of the surrounding rock damage area of the tunneling roadway in the same stress field, and a computer image processing program is used for mapping the form of the pre-drilling crack. The method can provide the form, the range and the maximum depth of the surrounding rock damage area of the tunneling tunnel in the tunnel tunneling process, and provides support for the targeted supporting measures and disaster risk prediction of the tunneling tunnel in engineering application.

title_en: Internet data disaster recovery backup method and server applied to artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical fields of artificial intelligence, big data service and databases, and provides an Internet data disaster recovery backup method and a server applied to the artificial intelligence. According to the method, the target data representation carrier extraction algorithm is obtained through training optimization, in the process of backing up data, the data feature mining is carried out on the data to be backed up based on the artificial intelligence algorithm, the priority of the data to be backed up is conveniently determined according to the data feature mining, the data backup with pertinence, high efficiency and reliability is completed, and a safety foundation is provided for helping data management. Furthermore, in the iterative optimization process of the artificial intelligent algorithm, the algorithm is adjusted without additional data examples and marks, so that the optimization efficiency of the algorithm is improved to quickly enter the subsequent data backup, and the disaster recovery backup technology has strong applicability and can be applied to the business service fields of electronic commerce, digital virtual space, intelligent finance and the like.

title_en: Novel simulation method for representing ground settlement time sequence evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel simulation method for representing the evolution of a ground settlement time sequence, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster prevention; a novel simulation method for representing the evolution of a ground settlement time sequence is characterized in that regional ground settlement information is obtained by utilizing PS-InSAR and SBAS-InSAR methods based on radar image data; according to the settlement information, superposing a plurality of types of geological information, drawing up an optimal hyper-parameter data set, and constructing a model; drawing optimal times of the algorithm, and further taking the contribution degrees of different factors of the ground settlement obtained by the model as algorithm simulation weights to simulate the ground settlement; the invention can provide more efficient scientific prevention and control when dealing with ground settlement disasters.

title_en: Real-time prediction method for damage of fired steel structure based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time prediction method for damage of a fired steel structure based on digital twins, which solves the technical problem that in the prior art, firemen mainly rely on experience to evaluate whether buildings collapse or not in a fire so as to have potential safety hazards. The invention comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a quantitative damage assessment model of a fired steel structure, and training the quantitative damage assessment model of the fired steel structure by adopting a deep learning algorithm; step 2, constructing a steel structure building digital twin body to obtain the temperature and deformation data output of a steel structure fire scene; and 3, inputting the acquired temperature and deformation data into the trained quantitative evaluation model of the damage of the fired steel structure so as to output the current damage index of the steel structure on the fire scene in real time. The invention has scientific and reasonable design, carries out virtual-real mapping on the virtual digital twin body and the physical entity of the building, realizes dynamic real-time interaction to improve the information perception capability of the rescue site, and provides reliable decision support for the fire rescue to grasp the opportunity of attack and evacuation.

title_en: Frozen soil-structural plane frozen soil erosion indoor test simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frozen soil-frozen soil erosion indoor test simulation device at a structural surface, which comprises a disaster simulation system, a heat preservation system and a monitoring system; the disaster simulation system comprises an upstream water supply assembly, a buffer layer assembly, an erosion layer assembly, a water collection layer assembly and a downstream water collection assembly; the heat preservation system is arranged on the erosion layer assembly and is used for preserving heat inside the erosion layer assembly; the monitoring system is matched with the erosion layer assembly and used for monitoring the temperature in the process of simulating the underground water to erode the frozen soil in the erosion layer assembly in real time. The indoor test simulation device for frozen soil erosion at the frozen soil-structure surface can effectively simulate the underground water erosion state at the frozen soil-structure contact surface in the freezing engineering, can directly observe the erosion process, test the development speed of a disaster source, and lay a foundation for the research of related mechanisms and disaster prevention.

title_en: Simulation environment factor coupling effect induced disaster chain test device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a test method for inducing a disaster chain by simulating the coupling effect of environmental factors, which relate to the technical field of mountain disaster simulation research and comprise a vibration table and an artificial composite slope body: the table top of the vibration table is connected with a mountain disaster model box, an artificial composite slope body is arranged in the mountain disaster model box, and the vibration table is used for driving the artificial composite slope body to vibrate; four groups of same sliding rails are arranged at the top of the vibration table; the outer two groups of sliding rails are movably connected with a rainfall system, and the inner two groups of sliding rails are movably connected with a temperature control assembly for temperature control; the invention can simulate the starting, slope deformation and instability processes of the mountain disaster under the coupling of composite conditions such as rainfall with different intensity, temperature and temperature change, earthquake with different magnitude and earthquake-inducing time and the like in a laboratory, so as to simulate the complex conditions during the disaster formation, master the mountain disaster formation and evolution mechanism in the natural environment, enhance the identification capability of the disaster risk source and test the disaster prevention and control technology.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Power distribution network power outage prediction method based on neural network at extreme high temperature
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prediction of power distribution networks, and discloses a power failure prediction method of a power distribution network at extremely high temperature based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: collecting a fault set of the power distribution network, wherein the fault set has power failure faults at extremely high temperature; establishing a fault sample library A of the power distribution network at the history extremely high temperature; establishing a non-fault sample library B of the power distribution network at the history extremely high temperature; the fault sample library A and the non-fault sample library B are integrated together to form a training sample library X; based on a training sample library X, a long-short-term memory neural network is adopted to predict the outage probability and outage duration of the power distribution network at extremely high temperature, and a outage prediction model is established; based on the power failure prediction model, body parameters, meteorological parameters and running state parameters at a certain moment to be predicted are input, and the possible power failure probability and power failure duration of the power distribution network in the extremely high temperature process can be obtained.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: LEO satellite and HAP cooperation-based computing and unloading strategy in wide-range disaster area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calculation unloading strategy based on LEO satellite and HAP cooperation in a large-scale disaster area, wherein the strategy is to allocate subcarrier resources for tasks by adopting a cooperative game algorithm under the scheme of unloading decision; then, performing resource competition on the task unloaded to the edge server with the maximum system QoE value as a target, and realizing optimal allocation of computing resources; finally, the unloading decision problem is proved to be a potential game process, and an unloading decision scheme under Nash equilibrium is found by utilizing a Multi-user game calculation unloading (Multi-user Game Computing Offloading, MUGCO) algorithm. Simulation results show that compared with a comparison strategy, the provided strategy can effectively improve the total QoE value of the system.

title_en: Method for predicting burst damage range of tunnel lining after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting a burst damage range of a tunnel lining after a fire disaster. Comprising the following steps: carrying out tunnel fire lining smoke temperature distribution test research to obtain the surface temperature distribution of the tunnel lining; establishing a tunnel lining fire disaster calculation model by adopting Abaqus finite element numerical simulation software, acquiring a temperature field inside the tunnel lining, and calculating the maximum heating rate and the temperature difference; performing a high-temperature bursting test of the indoor concrete test block and establishing bursting standards; and predicting the burst damage range of the tunnel lining. According to the method, the surface temperature distribution condition of the tunnel lining is obtained through a tunnel fire lining smoke temperature distribution test, finite element calculation simulation software is adopted to calculate the internal temperature field distribution of the tunnel lining, a concrete bursting standard is obtained through a high-temperature bursting test of an indoor concrete test block, the bursting damage range of the tunnel lining is predicted according to the standard, and the bursting damage degree of the tunnel lining under fire can be accurately and effectively estimated.

title_en: Microseism signal classification method based on short-time Fourier transform and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a microseismic signal classification method based on short-time Fourier transform and deep learning. And secondly, performing time-frequency conversion on the signals by adopting short-time Fourier transform to obtain a time-frequency domain signal matrix, randomly dividing 80% of signal samples to serve as a training set, and taking the remaining 20% as a verification set. And thirdly, building a VGG convolutional neural network, reducing a loss value function through each training, and updating a neural network weight parameter to obtain a network weight parameter with a sufficiently small loss value after training. And step four, selecting signals needing to be identified and classified, taking the signals as input of a convolutional neural network after short-time Fourier transform, and performing calculation processing by a trained neural network model to finally give an identification result. The method is simple and quick to operate, can replace manual identification, and achieves the intelligence and automation of the real-time monitoring work of the tunnel and the underground engineering rock burst disaster.

title_en: Fire hazard real-time detection method and system suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire disaster real-time detection method and a fire disaster real-time detection system suitable for an unmanned aerial vehicle platform. Acquiring a fire image dataset of the unmanned aerial vehicle; preprocessing the unmanned aerial vehicle fire image data set to obtain a preprocessed unmanned aerial vehicle fire image data set; establishing an improved YOLOv5 network model; training the preprocessed unmanned aerial vehicle fire image dataset to obtain unmanned aerial vehicle fire detection model weights; according to the weight of the unmanned aerial vehicle fire detection model, inputting the preprocessed unmanned aerial vehicle fire image dataset into an improved YOLOv5 network model to obtain a fire real-time detection model; and verifying, testing and evaluating the performance of the fire real-time detection model. The fire disaster real-time detection method can rapidly and accurately detect fire disasters in real time according to the image characteristics of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: High-temperature simulation device with environment sensing function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire simulation training, and particularly discloses a high-temperature simulation device with an environment sensing function, which comprises a fixed outer frame, a groove, a cross frame and a smoke spraying unit; the upper surface of the fixed outer frame is provided with a groove; a cross frame is inserted into the groove; a heat insulation baffle is arranged on the cross frame; the infrared sensor is used for receiving human body heat signals, controlling the heating wire and the motor to conduct electricity, the motor drives the driving shaft and the first bevel gear to rotate, so that the second bevel gear, the driven shaft and the fan blades are driven to rotate to generate high-pressure air to be discharged, heat generated by the electricity of the heating wire is taken away, then high-temperature air is sprayed out of the lower end of the heat insulation box, flame heat waves of the billow above the corridor are simulated, smoke is simulated by the smoke spraying unit, the simulation degree of the whole corridor on a fire scene is high, the fire firefighting exercise is experienced deeply, the fire simulation degree is not dangerous, and the problems of low simulation degree and certain danger of the existing fire are solved.
assignees: ANHUI EASTDOLT ELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest pasture area low-voltage fire test system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrical safety, in particular to a system and a method for testing low-voltage fires in a forest and pasture area, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a low-voltage power distribution cabinet, a power supply system, a wave recording system and a fault simulation area; the fault simulation area is used for performing simulation tests on faults of the overhead lines with different diameters or insulation characteristics according to preset test working conditions in various types of fault simulation tests of the overhead lines; the power supply system is used for outputting three-phase voltage alternating current when simulating faults of different types of overhead lines; the low-voltage power distribution cabinet is used for detecting bus three-phase voltage and outgoing three-phase current under different overhead line fault types so that the wave recording system detects whether an arc breaks down or not and acquires corresponding fault simulation information. According to the invention, various fault types and plant combustion of the overhead transmission line are tested, so that the condition of short-circuit arc in the fault process can be effectively analyzed, and the probability of fire disaster caused by the fault of the power distribution network of Lin Muou is reduced.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Analysis and organization method for rail transit pedestrian evacuation mechanism based on COVID-19
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing and organizing a rail transit pedestrian evacuation mechanism based on a COVID-19, which comprises the following steps: s1, analyzing pedestrian evacuation characteristics under epidemic situations; s2, establishing a simulation model of pedestrian evacuation under the COVID-19, and optimizing a pedestrian evacuation organization scheme under the COVID-19. The invention analyzes the interaction mechanism among the traffic, density and space under the COVID-19, provides the threshold value of the pedestrian evacuation flow of the rail transit under the COVID-19, demonstrates the pedestrian organization scheme under the COVID-19, and proves that the scheme is favorable for reducing epidemic situation transmission and guaranteeing the pedestrian evacuation safety through simulation experiments.

title_en: Transformer anti-seismic simulation method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power grids, and particularly provides a transformer anti-seismic simulation method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: iteratively updating the pre-constructed equivalent linear viscoelastic model based on the maximum dynamic shear modulus of the pre-constructed equivalent linear viscoelastic model to obtain a soil finite element model; connecting the soil mass finite element model with the transformer finite element model to obtain a finite element model containing the soil mass and the transformer; and carrying out finite element simulation based on the finite element model containing the soil body and the transformer. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, when the extra-high voltage transformer is installed on the cohesive soil foundation, the influence of the dynamic characteristic change of the soil body on the earthquake resistance of the extra-high voltage transformer under the action of earthquake load can be accurately analyzed, and the interaction influence of the cohesive soil foundation and the upper structure is considered, so that the method is more consistent with engineering practice.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Urban flood deep learning prediction method considering pregnant disaster environment clustering
abstract_en: The invention provides a urban flood deep learning prediction method considering pregnant disaster environment clustering, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a PCSWMM-based urban flood-two-dimensional coupling model, and simulating regional flooding depths under different rainfall-tide level combinations by using the model. S2, constructing a deep learning database based on rainfall data, tide level data, pregnant disaster environment data and submerged depth data. S3, dividing the region into different categories according to the characteristic index of the disaster-tolerant environment by using a K-means clustering algorithm. S4, combining the pregnant disaster environment cluster and various causes of flood, selecting different input variables, establishing different deep learning models, optimizing super parameters of the deep learning models by using a Bayesian algorithm, and finishing quick prediction of urban flood. The method considers the clustering of the disaster-tolerant environment, optimizes the deep learning model by using a Bayesian algorithm, has high reliability and effectively improves the urban flood prediction precision.

title_en: Remote sensing target detection method, remote sensing target detection system, remote sensing target detection medium, remote sensing target detection equipment and remote sensing target detection terminal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision, and discloses a remote sensing target detection method, a remote sensing target detection system, a remote sensing target detection medium, a remote sensing target detection device and a remote sensing target detection terminal, wherein a RGB-infrared image fusion network based on CNN is constructed, a task-oriented fusion method, a low-level and high-level combined self-adaptive training strategy are adopted, and a combined loss constraint fusion network consisting of content loss and semantic loss and a fusion method of saliency target detection are utilized; the angle information is introduced, gaussian cycle coding and rectangular cycle coding are adopted to predict angles, feature extraction is carried out, and a BIFPN bidirectional feature fusion method is utilized to carry out feature fusion; decoding, algorithm reasoning and boundary box calibration are carried out by utilizing the multi-mode video stream collected in real time, and result codes are pushed to a streaming media server or a client. The invention can rapidly and accurately detect the vehicle position and the category information under the conditions of strong light and weak light by utilizing a mode of combining an image fusion algorithm and a rotating target detection algorithm, and is applied to rotating target detection under unmanned aerial vehicle traffic management, disaster rescue scenes and the like.
