assignees: XIDIAN UNIV QINGDAO INSTITUTE OF COMPUTING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for predicting jump height in deicing process of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a jump height prediction method, a jump height prediction system and a storage medium in the deicing process of a power transmission line, belonging to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of power grid, wherein the jump height prediction method comprises the following steps: predicting the jump height by using a trained jump height prediction network; the training process comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a structural parameter of a power transmission line and an environmental load parameter; s2, based on the structural parameters and the environmental load parameters, establishing a finite element model of the power transmission line, and calculating the jump height in the deicing process of the power transmission line under the single parameter change by a control variable method; s3, judging whether the jump height exceeds a set jump height threshold value, if so, processing parameters corresponding to the jump height into a data set, inputting the data set into a jump height prediction network, and carrying out loss training on the jump height prediction network. The method can accurately predict the jump height of the power transmission line in the icing falling process, and overcomes the defects of poor practicality, poor generalization capability and large prediction error of an empirical formula.

title_en: Electronic firework
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic fireworks and discloses an electronic firework, wherein a loudspeaker is fixedly connected to one end of a water pump, a spray head is fixedly connected to a water inlet end of the water pump, four water outlet holes are formed in the top of the spray head, three brackets are fixedly connected to the inside of the water outlet holes, a laser emitter is fixedly connected between the three brackets, a pipeline extending to the lower part of a sealing plate is fixedly connected to the water outlet end of the water pump, a glass cover is covered on the top of the spray head, a honeycomb duct is fixedly connected between the rear surface of the glass cover and a box body, a sun tracking mechanism is arranged on one side of the box body, and a supporting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the box body. The safe and harmless liquid firework spraying effect is realized by spraying the safe and harmless liquid material and simulating the loudspeaker which gives out firework sound effect, hidden dangers such as fire disaster caused by using open fire and air pollution caused after the firework is set off can be avoided, potential safety hazards such as explosion caused during transportation can be avoided, and the safe and flame-free liquid firework spraying device has great application value.

title_en: Hot wave-flood composite disaster assessment method considering influence of climate change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating a thermal wave-flood composite disaster under the influence of climate change, which belongs to the field of composite risk prediction, and further optimizes CLM5.0 simulated runoff by utilizing variables such as air temperature and the like after the combination deviation correction of a two-way long-short-term memory network model, thereby improving the reliability of a simulated runoff result; constructing a thermal wave-flood composite disaster risk measurement model based on a Copula function, estimating thermal wave-flood composite disaster risk change under the influence of future climate change by adopting Kendall reproduction period, considering the abnormal distribution of extreme events, being closer to reality, and being capable of estimating the occurrence of composite disasters more accurately; and introducing a lethal heat wave index into the evaluation of the heat wave-flood composite disasters, wherein the index considers the relation between the temperature and humidity of the dry bulb and the global heat wave death rate, so that the extracted heat wave-flood composite disasters data set is more fit with the actual disasters.

title_en: Remote sensing intelligent interpretation method, system, equipment and medium for multisource heterogeneous surface elements
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing intelligent interpretation method, a system, equipment and a medium for multisource heterogeneous surface elements, which are characterized in that by constructing a remote sensing interpretation image visual scene display, the acquired remote sensing image and interpretation results are displayed in a map scene, and a remote sensing interpretation function operation interface is provided; dividing remote sensing interpretation related information from a data source according to the characteristics of remote sensing image data, and dividing structured data from a data structure; constructing an image sample library training network prediction model by the divided data; according to the interpretation type requested by a user, building a sample library to train to obtain a network prediction model to distinguish different surface element characteristics, classifying and extracting the surface elements in remote sensing image information in real time, converting a building on a binary image obtained by interpreting the remote sensing image according to the surface elements into a vector by a grid, and superposing and displaying the vector result on a map. The method can identify damaged buildings and grade damage on line, and can be applied to the fields of disaster prevention, road network construction and the like.

title_en: Method and device for determining urban building group wind disaster insurance premium based on physical model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining urban building group wind disaster insurance premium based on a physical model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining geographic information system data of a target building group, geometric information of an outer facade window of the target building group and historical meteorological data of the last years, wherein the city of the target building group is consistent with the service life of a policy; establishing a wind disaster database of a target building group; establishing a wind pressure distribution simulation scene library of the outer facade of the target building group; establishing a wind disaster loss simulation scene library of the target building group based on the wind pressure distribution simulation scene library of the outer facade of the target building group and the geometric information of the window of the outer facade of the target building group; and calculating a wind disaster loss expected value of the target building group, and further determining the premium of the wind disaster insurance of the target building group. The invention can help insurance and reinsurance companies to scientifically determine the premium of urban building group wind disaster insurance and promote the sustainable development of related enterprises.

title_en: Crowd emergency evacuation simulation method based on social force model and A star algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd emergency evacuation simulation method based on a social force model and an A star algorithm, which relates to the field of crowd emergency evacuation simulation and comprises the following steps of: s1: the A star algorithm divides a modeling space into grids, identifies personnel positions and target positions, sets a Manhattan distance equation from a node to a target, and performs path search; s2: establishing a basic theoretical framework of a social force model; s3: the social force model and the A star algorithm are coupled. According to the crowd emergency evacuation simulation method based on the social force model and the A star algorithm, the A star algorithm is adopted to divide the grids of the sites aiming at the problems of overlapping and unrealistic tracks of people in evacuation of the social force model, evacuation paths are planned for people, evacuation modeling can be carried out on people in an actual space, and the crowd congestion range possibly occurring is predicted.

title_en: New energy automobile lithium battery fire emergency rescue simulation training device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy automobile lithium battery fire emergency rescue simulation training device and a method, the proposal forms a training environment based on a constructed automobile body, and the gas combustion mode is adopted in the automobile body to simulate the ignition combustion state of the lithium battery of the new energy automobile, and the dynamic change of flame is controlled to simulate the fire occurrence and development process of the new energy automobile. The scheme provided by the invention can realize the simulation of the real scene of the fire of the energy automobile, can be used for training firefighters to master related fire extinguishing technical points, and effectively solves the problems existing in the prior art.

title_en: Hot wave-drought composite disaster assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating a heat wave-drought composite disaster, which belong to the field of composite disaster risk prediction, and adopt a fractional deviation correction method for retaining trend based on global climate mode multi-member data and climate multi-mode aggregate data to correct a meteorological simulation sequence, construct a coupling model chain based on a machine learning-VIC model to acquire a simulated soil water sequence, and extract a heat wave event and a drought event from the corrected meteorological simulation sequence and the corrected soil water sequence respectively so as to acquire the characteristic value of the heat wave-drought composite event; the method comprises the steps of considering the multidimensional attribute of the thermal wave-drought composite event, constructing a high-dimensional risk assessment model based on a Copula function, and obtaining a risk assessment result with multidimensional risk measurement, thereby realizing accurate assessment of the thermal wave-drought composite event risk of a research area under artificial climate forcing and considering the internal change rate of the climate.

title_en: Rainfall spatial distribution-based image similar water condition mining and forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall spatial distribution-based image similar water condition mining and forecasting method, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting rainfall runoff data of a river basin and dividing the river basin into a plurality of times; s2, interpolating observation data of a measuring station, and manufacturing a rainfall spatial distribution sample graph set; s3, preprocessing a sample atlas, and dividing a training set and a testing set; s4, improving a residual error network model, improving a full-connection layer into a global average pooling layer, transplanting pre-trained weights and parameters to the improved residual error network model, constructing an input/output layer, calculating feature vectors of a rainfall spatial distribution map, calculating Euclidean distances of the feature vectors and taking the Euclidean distances as similarity, and constructing a complete grid rainfall similarity judging model; s5, searching a historical similar rainfall process by using the model constructed in the S4, and weighting the corresponding runoff process according to the similarity to serve as a predicted runoff process; the invention can predict the future water condition change and provide more important forecast information for predicting flood disasters.

title_en: Semi-supervised enteromorpha detection method and system based on transconductance learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-supervised enteromorpha detection method and system based on transconductance learning, and relates to the technical field of visible light remote sensing image scene recognition, comprising the following four steps of step one, data preprocessing and labeling; step two, constructing a convolutional neural network model, step three, performing mutual guide learning of the network model, step four, performing enteromorpha detection by using the two trained networks, and performing weighted fusion on the result. Aiming at the problem of less labeling data in the detection of the enteromorpha in the remote sensing images in the supervision classification, the method efficiently utilizes the non-labeling data by designing a high-confidence pseudo-label strategy and combining data enhancement, expands a sample data set, improves the accuracy of a training model, realizes the detection of the enteromorpha in the high-quality remote sensing images, and provides technical support for disaster monitoring during large-scale enteromorpha outbreak.

title_en: A simulation system for disaster response training
title_ko: 재난 대응 훈련 모의 시스템
abstract_en: A disaster response training simulation system is designed to enable learning through simulated experience of disaster situations such as fires and earthquakes, and includes: an entrance and exit panel; an earthquake experience zone; a fire experience zone; a control zone; and an elevator experience zone. The present invention further includes a ground collapse panel for earthquake experience.
abstract_ko: 재난 대응 훈련 모의 시스템은 화재나 지진 등과 같은 재난 상황을 모의 체험을 통하여 습득가능하도록 한 것으로, 출입가능하도록 개폐가능한 도어가 구비되는 입구 및 출구판넬; 상기 입구 및 출구판넬 중 어느 하나의 판넬에 연결되어 체험자가 이동시 이를 감지하는 것에 의해 지진으로 인한 건물 붕괴에 대한 상황을 구현가능하도록 전면 상부에 감지센서가 구비되고, 상기 감지센서의 하부에 지진 발생으로 벽체가 붕괴되는 모습을 구현한 붕괴부가 형성되며, 배면에는 상기 감지센서로부터 감지된 신호값에 대응되게 제어부의 제어에 의해 구동하여 건물 붕괴시 발생되는 소리를 구현가능하도록 구비되는 붕괴음향발생부가 구성된 지진용판넬을 갖는 지진체험구역; 상기 입구 및 출구판넬 중 다른 어느 하나의 판넬에 연결되어 체험자가 이동시 이를 감지하는 것에 의해 화재시 발생되는 불과 연기를 구현가능하도록 화재용판넬과 연기발생용판넬을 갖는 화재체험구역; 상기 지진체험 및 화재체험구역으로 이동하는 체험자를 감지하는 것에 대응되게 지진용판넬과 화재용판넬 및 연기발생용 판넬 측으로 전원을 인가하여 상황을 제어가능하도록 제어부가 설치된 제어용판넬을 갖는 제어구역; 상기 지진체험구역의 지진용판넬과 화재체험구역의 화재용 판넬과 연기발생용 판넬 그리고 제어용판넬을 각각 연결부재를 매개로 분리가능하게 연결시키는 것에 의해 상기 구역들과 연결되는 통로를 가변가능하게 형성하여 체험자가 통로를 이동하는 중에 화재와 지진 등과 같은 재난 상황을 모의 체험가능하도록 구비되는 연결판넬 및 상기 지진체험구역과 화재체험구역 중 어느 하나의 구역과 개폐가능한 도어를 갖는 구역경계용판넬을 통하여 구획되어 체험자가 이동하는 것을 감지하고 체험자가 버튼을 누름시키는 것에 대응되게 제어부의 제어에 의해 엘리베이터를 탑승여부를 체험가능하도록 연결부재를 매개로 분리가능한 엘리베이터용판넬을 갖춘 엘리베이터체험구역을 포함하고, 상기 지진체험구역과 화재체험구역 및 제어구역은 연결부재를 매개로 연결되고 제어부의 제어에 대응되게 유도등이 점등된 개폐가능한 도어를 갖는 구역경계용판넬에 의해 구역별 구획가능하게 구비되되, 상기 지진체험구역의 바닥에는 체험자가 올라서는 것에 대응되게 가압센서가 이를 감지하고 이의 감지된 값에 의해 제어부로 인가된 신호에 대응되게 구동가능한 유압 또는 공압에 의해 작동되는 실린더와 피스톤에 의해 중앙부가 상,하 이동가능한 붕괴판을 갖는 지진체험용 지반붕괴용판넬을 더 포함한다.

title_en: Control system of inverter screw compression refrigerator
title_ko: 냉각팬모터 부하 제어부를 갖는 인버터 스크류 냉동기 제어시스템
abstract_en: In accordance with one aspect of the present invention, provided is an inverter screw refrigerator control system having a cooling fan motor load control unit, wherein the inverter screw refrigerator control system includes: a screw compression type refrigerator; a simulator calculating an operation reference value for optimal efficiency by performing a simulation operation based on design specifications of the refrigerator; a control panel inputting the operation reference value calculated from the simulator as an operation setting value for the operation of the refrigerator, and monitoring the operation status of the refrigerator to control the refrigerator in real time; an inverter controlling the operation and frequency of the refrigerator in accordance with a signal of the control panel; an alarm system triggering an alarm when an abnormal situation outside the scope of the operation reference value occurs during the monitoring process of the refrigerator; and a disaster prevention room remotely monitoring the control panel, and remotely commanding the control panel to identify a cause for the abnormality and measures therefor, including ON/OFF control on the refrigerator when the warning system triggers an alarm. Therefore, the present invention is capable of optimizing the operation management of the refrigerator.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일측면에 따르면, 스크류 압축방식 냉동기; 상기 냉동기의 설계사양을 기준으로 시뮬레이션 운전을 수행하여 최적의 효율을 위한 운전 기준값을 산출하는 시뮬레이터; 상기 시뮬레이터로부터 산출된 운전 기준값을 상기 냉동기의 가동을 위한 운전 설정값으로 입력하고, 냉동기의 운전 상태를 모니터링하여 실시간 제어하는 제어반; 상기 제어반의 신호에 따라 냉동기의 가동 및 주파수를 제어하는 인버터; 상기 냉동기의 모니터링 과정에서 운전 기준값 범위를 벗어나는 비정상 상황 발생 시 이에 따른 경보를 발동하는 경보시스템; 및 상기 제어반을 원격 모니터링하고, 경보시스템 발동시 냉동기를 ON/OFF제어를 포함하는 비정상 원인파악과 조치사항을 제어반에 원격 지시하는 방재실;을 포함하는 냉각팬모터 부하 제어부를 갖는 인버터 스크류 냉동기 제어시스템이 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Evacuation Simulation Module
abstract_en: Technology is disclosed for systems and methods for an Evacuation Simulation module generates vehicle trip time and time-series road congestion metrics for vehicles in hypothetical evacuation scenarios. The outputs of the module can be used to understand total clearance time for a neighborhood or region, choke points and areas of worst congestion, individual vehicle routes and trip times, and effects of scenario constraints and mitigation efforts such as road closures, notification urgency, evacuation sequencing, and contraflow. The module contains a large number of input parameters and utilizes high granularity data to model a wide range of specific evacuation scenarios. The model utilizes a novel approach to calculating traffic congestion and a novel application of AI methodology to incorporate human input into the workings of the model.
assignees: KYLE BOWEN;ZLIMAN LEO;ZLIMEN IGOR;LADRIS TECH INC

title_en: Deep tunnel drilling arrangement method and surrounding rock fracture evolution method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep tunnel drilling arrangement method and a surrounding rock fracture evolution method thereof. According to the deep tunnel drilling arrangement method, the crack evolution characteristics of each stage of the tunnel are explored by firstly arranging preset drilling holes and then arranging construction drilling holes, then the crack evolution characteristics are summarized, and a regression analysis method is utilized to analyze the space-time law of crack evolution. According to the drilling arrangement method, the evolution of the surrounding rock cracks of construction is monitored by using the preset drilling laid by the auxiliary tunnel, so that disasters such as rock burst, spalling and the like can be predicted, and the construction safety is greatly ensured; the drilling shooting data before and after excavation are synthesized, the evolution rule of surrounding rock cracks of tunnels in the whole excavation process can be analyzed more accurately, the fracture damage mechanism of the tunnels is explored, and references are provided for advanced geological disaster forecast of similar projects in the future. In addition, the invention also provides a method for evolving the surrounding rock cracks of the deep tunnel.
assignees: NUCLEAR IND GANZHOU ENGINEERING SURVEY AND DESIGN GROUP CO LTD;UNIV EAST CHINA JIAOTONG

title_en: Post-disaster rescue method, system and equipment using group robots
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster rescue method, system and equipment applying a group robot. The method comprises the steps of simulating a post-disaster rescue scene, determining hard rules to be observed by each robot according to actions and states of each robot in the group robots in the simulation scene, constructing a functional relation between social rule utilization rate and performance indexes of the group robots, constructing a compromising decision model according to the performance indexes, the social rules and the functional relation, solving the compromising decision model by adopting an adaptive linear programming algorithm, performing multi-objective visual balance analysis to obtain a social rule utilization rate range meeting all the performance indexes, and enabling the group robots to perform post-disaster rescue according to the social rule utilization rate range. The invention can avoid casualties and property loss to the greatest extent in post-disaster rescue.

title_en: Method and system for analyzing and evaluating fatigue life of bridge cable structure after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for analyzing and evaluating the fatigue life of a bridge cable structure after a fire disaster, which are used for simulating and reconstructing the fire scene environment after the fire disaster occurs to obtain the real thermal environment where a inhaul cable is positioned, carrying out finite element thermal analysis on the section of the inhaul cable by taking the real thermal environment as a thermal boundary condition, determining the specific temperature of each steel wire on the section, calculating the residual tensile strength and the fatigue strength of each steel wire according to a steel wire resistance degradation model after the high temperature obtained by experiments, and finally carrying out calculation and evaluation on the fatigue life of the whole inhaul cable after the fire disaster. Compared with the traditional research method, the method has clear thought, is convenient for flow use, more accurately reflects the stress condition of the inhaul cable after the fire, ensures that the residual resistance of each steel wire is more definite, and finally can more scientifically evaluate the fatigue life of the inhaul cable after the fire.

title_en: Intelligent control fire extinguishing system and method for comprehensive pipe rack cable fire spreading
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control fire extinguishing system and method for comprehensive pipe rack cable fire disaster spread, comprising the following steps: laboratory bench main part, fire source system, fire monitoring system, fire prediction system and intelligent control fire extinguishing systems. The experiment table can simulate the utility tunnel cable to take place the conflagration in different positions department, realizes the accurate prediction to the cable fire spreading, arranges panorama infrared thermal imaging sensor in experiment table main part ceiling below slide rail side and water mist shower nozzle middle part according to equidistant, and the connection object detects the network and can discern the location conflagration position rapidly and acquire cable fire flame spreading characteristic dataset. The fire prediction system adopts a model based on a neural network to carry out fire prediction model training, a cable fire spread characteristic prediction database is built, and a time sequence comprehensive pipe rack cable fire spread prediction trend is built.

title_en: Hook ladder firefighter training damage/sudden death risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hook ladder firefighter training damage/sudden death risk early warning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring core physical sign data of a hook ladder firefighter, wherein the core physical sign data are real-time heart rate data and real-time blood oxygen data of the hook ladder firefighter; acquiring core action data of a hook ladder firefighter, wherein the core action data comprise real-time boarding action data and throwing and hanging action data of each hook ladder firefighter; and carrying out hook ladder firefighter training damage/sudden death risk early warning based on the core physical sign data and the core action data. Corresponding systems, electronic devices, and computer-readable storage media are also disclosed. The method and the system not only can monitor and collect physical sign parameters in the training process of the firefighter in real time, but also can capture and judge the training actions of the firefighter in a standardized way, and the two are cooperated to perform safety precaution, prevent sudden death due to motility, reduce the risk of training casualties, reduce safety accidents, and improve timeliness and reliability of precaution reminding.

title_en: Method for determining an occurrence of disaster using improved machine learning model and apparatus thereof
title_ko: 개선된 학습모델을 통해 재난발생여부를 판단하는 방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, disclosed is a method for determining whether a disaster has occurred by using an improved learning model which comprises the following steps of: collecting first raw data; labeling and preprocessing the collected first raw data; inputting the preprocessed data into a learning model in which at least one algorithm is set and operated as an agent; training the learning model with the preprocessed data based on the agent; and analyzing second raw data to determine whether a disaster has occurred if the second raw data is inputted to the learning model for which training has been completed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 제1로우 데이터를 수집하는 단계; 수집된 제1로우 데이터를 라벨링하고 전처리하는 단계; 적어도 하나 이상의 알고리즘이 에이전트로 설정되어 동작하는 학습모델에 상기 전처리된 데이터를 입력하는 단계; 상기 에이전트를 기반으로 상기 학습모델을 상기 전처리된 데이터로 학습시키는 단계; 및 학습이 완료된 상기 학습모델에 제2로우 데이터가 입력되면, 상기 제2로우 데이터를 분석하여 재난이 발생되었는지 여부를 판단하는 단계를 포함하는, 개선된 학습모델을 통해 재난발생여부를 판단하는 방법을 개시한다.

title_en: Colliery electrical apparatus cable conflagration analogue test device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire safety, in particular to a coal mine electrical appliance cable fire simulation test device which comprises an electrical appliance cable igniter, a coal seam igniter, a gas valve, a smoke generator, a lighting device, a combustible gas sensor, a temperature sensor and a controller, wherein the lighting device is connected with the electrical appliance cable igniter; the electric appliance cable igniter is used for igniting the electric appliance cable for the test; the coal bed igniter is used for converting current to generate open flame; the combustible gas sensor detects the concentration value of the combustible gas in the test area and feeds back a combustible gas detection signal to the controller; the temperature sensor detects the temperature value of the test area and feeds back a temperature detection signal to the controller; the controller is used for controlling the on-off of the electric appliance cable igniter; the gas valve is also used for controlling the opening and closing of the gas valve according to the combustible gas detection signal; and the device is also used for controlling the opening and closing of the smoke generator, the lighting device and the coal seam igniter according to the temperature detection signal. By adopting the scheme, the fire disaster simulation reality can be increased, and the fire disaster simulation effect is improved.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Fire detection method, system, medium, equipment and terminal for oil and gas station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision and target detection, and discloses a fire disaster detection method, a system, a medium, equipment and a terminal for an oil and gas station, which are used for acquiring a fire disaster video stream of the oil and gas station, intercepting key frames, initially establishing a fire disaster data set, and collecting fire disaster images on a network as auxiliary training samples; after the data images are fused, carrying out size random cutting and manual label marking; performing image preprocessing and offline expansion and enhancement of a data set; dividing a data set, and constructing an improved ME-YOLOv5 detection model; initializing training parameters, judging whether a loss function converges or not, and if not, returning to the step of initializing the training parameters; if yes, saving the weight file and judging whether the model test accords with the expectation; if not, returning to the step of initializing training parameters; if the model meets the expectations, the model is deployed. The invention solves the technical problems of low fire detection accuracy and low response speed of the oil and gas station, and remarkably improves the fire detection effect of the oil and gas station.

title_en: VR equipment that simulation conflagration was fleed and is used
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire simulation equipment, and particularly discloses VR equipment for simulating fire escape, which comprises a head-wearing body, a connecting wire and a thermal simulation unit; the head-wearing body is symmetrically connected with a connecting wire through wires; the tail end of the connecting wire is fixedly connected with a handle; the handle is sleeved with a thermal simulation unit; the handle is judged to reach a dangerous area through the cooperation of the thermal simulation unit with the distance sensor and VR software in the handle, the thermal simulation unit is electrified and heated to simulate the mistaken entry of the thermal dangerous area, such as a door, a door handle, a window and other heat conducting containers, so that people are reminded of realizing that the surfaces of objects in a fire disaster are in a high-temperature state and can not be directly touched, high-temperature air and flame are simulated, hands can not be scalded, the simulation degree of fire disaster escape is improved, and the problem that the existing VR simulation equipment can not simulate heat to cause the fire disaster escape simulation effect to be poor is solved.
assignees: ANHUI EASTDOLT ELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine disaster prediction and early warning method combining on-site monitoring and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster prediction and early warning method combining on-site monitoring and numerical simulation in the disaster monitoring field, which comprises the following steps: step a, a monitoring pile is buried in a distributed mode and is connected with an early warning center through signals; step b, acquiring historical geological data of a region to be monitored, and constructing a functional relation between the soil fracture change rate and the vibration quantity and the deformation quantity based on a gray prediction algorithm to obtain a mine disaster prediction model; step c, obtaining the vibration quantity, the deformation quantity and the soil crack change rate of the monitoring node; step d, the data processing module performs data preprocessing and optimization; step e, obtaining a risk degree through a mine disaster prediction model, and predicting the mine disaster according to the risk degree; and f, determining a risk area according to the node position of the abnormal monitoring data, and sending an early warning signal to perform early warning. The scheme solves the problem that the change rate of the soil cracks is difficult to monitor in the prior art, so that mine disasters cannot be prevented and controlled earlier.

title_en: In-situ intelligent long-term monitoring system and method for multi-element information of deep buried tunnel
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-situ intelligent long-term monitoring system and method for multi-element information of a deep buried tunnel, and relates to the technical field of tunnel monitoring. According to the method, array type drilling holes are arranged in a deep buried tunnel monitoring area, and a monitoring system is arranged in each drilling hole. The detection system comprises a multi-element information acquisition device, a full-gradient self-adaptive crawling device, a control and data storage module and a power supply module; the multi-element information acquisition device is arranged on the full-gradient self-adaptive crawling device and is used for acquiring multi-element data information in the deep-buried tunnel drilling hole; the control and data storage module controls the full-gradient self-adaptive crawling device to make reciprocating motion in the deep tunnel drilling hole, and controls the multi-element information acquisition device to acquire multi-element data information in the deep tunnel drilling hole; the power module provides power for the system to work. The system and the method can efficiently monitor deformation and fracture of the surrounding rock of the tunnel for a long time, and provide effective in-situ data support and monitoring technology for prediction and early warning of geological disasters of the tunnel.

title_en: Method for evaluating cascade failure influence of urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade failure influence assessment method of urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation, which belongs to the technical field of urban flood monitoring and comprises the following steps of S1, simulating an urban road network to obtain a simulated running road network; s2, collecting the depth and the range of urban inundation under extreme precipitation, and determining the affected nodes and road sections of an urban road network; s3, attacking the affected nodes and road sections and carrying out simulation to determine the failure state of the final road network; and S4, collecting urban infrastructure POI points, and evaluating the service capability change of the infrastructure before and after the road network failure and the cascade failure influence of the urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation. The method for evaluating the influence of cascade failure of the urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation, which is disclosed by the invention, solves the problem that the influence of the extreme precipitation disaster on the urban infrastructure under the extreme precipitation disaster is unknown in the field of urban disaster prevention and reduction at present.

title_en: Urban mass transit comprehensive passenger network emergency evacuation path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city group comprehensive passenger transport network emergency evacuation path planning method, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a city group comprehensive passenger transport network model; step 2, urban mass comprehensive passenger transport network evacuation phase division; and 3, solving the urban comprehensive passenger transport network emergency evacuation planning problem by using an ant colony algorithm. The invention has the advantages that: when modeling, the urban traffic condition is considered, so that the constructed urban comprehensive passenger transport network model is more in line with the actual traffic network form; dividing the evacuation process into stages, researching travel characteristics and conditions of each stage, and establishing a complete evacuation process from self-generation to dissipation; when the heuristic function of the ant colony algorithm is constructed, the dynamic heuristic function is set according to the travel conditions of different evacuated people, so that the efficiency and the authenticity of the simulation operation are improved.

title_en: Runoff simulation method based on coupled neural network and hydrologic physical model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a runoff simulation method based on a coupling neural network and a hydrologic physical model, belongs to the technical field of hydrologic models, and provides the runoff simulation method based on the coupling neural network and the hydrologic physical model. According to the invention, a runoff simulation scheme of coupling the neural network and the hydrologic physical model is established, so that a simulation result is more accurate compared with a single machine learning mode, a processing process is closer to the hydrologic physical mechanism, and the application and development of a runoff simulation technology in early warning and risk assessment of waterlogging disasters can be further promoted.

title_en: Pedestrian flow prediction method and system based on convolution of knowledge graph and space-time graph
abstract_en: The invention provides a pedestrian flow prediction method and a pedestrian flow prediction system based on convolution of a knowledge graph and a space-time graph, which relate to the field of crowd evacuation computer simulation, and are used for acquiring pedestrian flow data of the same historical period acquired by all sensors of an evacuation scene, and carrying out sub-period division on the historical period to obtain the pedestrian flow monitored by each sensor of each sub-period; according to the people flow of each sensor in each sub-period, calculating the association degree between the sensors in each sub-period, and constructing a time sequence knowledge graph of each sub-period; constructing a space diagram for each sub-period based on the time sequence knowledge graph to form a dynamic space-time relationship diagram; inputting the dynamic space-time relation diagram into a space-time diagram convolution model, and predicting the flow of short-term pedestrians in the future; according to the invention, the space structure and the characteristic data in the evacuation scene are expressed through the time sequence knowledge graph, the knowledge graph is converted into the dynamic space-time relation graph, and the dynamic space-time relation graph is input into the space-time graph convolution model, so that the prediction of pedestrian flow in the future time period is realized.

title_en: Underground space waterlogging assessment method based on numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical simulation-based underground space waterlogging assessment method, which belongs to the field of urban flood control, and adopts a numerical simulation mode to judge whether underground space is filled with water and calculate a flood process, analyze disaster cause and aging, and assess the influence of underground space water to the surface flood process; the disaster-causing rainfall with different characteristics is input, and the disaster-causing rainfall standard of the underground space is judged according to IDF (integration-Duration-Frequency) curve classification, so that the accuracy, the fitting degree and the timeliness of urban underground waterlogging forecasting and early warning are improved; disaster prevention transformation is carried out on the simulation area, disaster causing standards under different transformation facilities are analyzed, and the area flood change under multiprocessing measures is calculated. The invention carries out numerical simulation on the underground space waterlogging process and influence, enriches the content and the range of urban rainfall flood simulation, and provides support and reference for urban rainfall flood forecasting and prevention and control.

title_en: Roof water drainage method for coal seam working face
abstract_en: The invention provides a roof water drainage method for a coal seam working face, and belongs to the technical field of roof water control. The method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting basic information of a coal seam working face: the basic information of the coal seam working face comprises working face drainage system information, working face local syncline information and working face adjacent goaf ponding information; s2, determining geological conditions of the working face according to basic information of the working face of the coal bed, and providing a hydrogeological condition analysis report; s3, determining the high confined aquifer of the sandstone of the roof of the coal seam based on analysis reports of mine geology and hydrogeology conditions. According to the roof water drainage method for the coal seam working face, which is designed by the invention, the high confined aquifer water and roof separation water of the coal seam roof sandstone can be drained through drainage water drilling, so that loss caused by a mine water disaster dangerous event is reduced, casualties caused by the mine water disaster dangerous event are reduced, and the working safety is increased.

title_en: Roadway driving method for precisely eliminating coal roadway driving coal and gas outburst
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine and gas outburst disaster management, and particularly relates to a roadway tunneling method for accurately eliminating coal roadway tunneling coal and gas outburst. Comprising the following steps: s1, tunneling the coal seam within an effective outburst elimination allowed tunneling range; s2, constructing a drilling site in the tunneled roadway; s3, constructing a borehole to the surrounding rock layer in the drilling field; s4, gas extraction is carried out, extraction effect is evaluated according to the gas extraction effect, and the allowable tunneling safety distance is determined; s5, after gas extraction is finished, stopping tunneling after the coal seam construction roadway continues tunneling for a safe distance; s6, repeating the steps S2-S5 to continue tunneling the roadway until the roadway reaches the designed position. According to the invention, coal and gas outburst tracing is combined, and a measure method for eliminating the outburst is accurately adopted for coal and gas outburst power sources (surrounding rock gas) of a coal roadway tunneling working face, so that the coal roadway tunneling gas outburst is eliminated faster and better, and the purpose of eliminating the outburst of the strip is realized.
assignees: SHANXI KAIJIA ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Knowledge representation-based plan quick matching recommendation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a knowledge representation-based plan quick matching recommendation method, and belongs to the technical field of matching calculation. The method is used for rapidly matching and recommending the emergency scheme according to the scene situation under the scenes such as emergency disasters or accidents. According to the method, on the basis of defining task scene characteristics and scheme characteristics, an emergency scheme recommendation knowledge representation diagram is constructed, a graph convolution network training scene and scheme embedding characterization are adopted, a scene and scheme matching calculation model is obtained, and matching calculation and sequencing recommendation of an emergency scheme are provided for the task scene. The scene-scheme matching calculation model training method based on the graph rolling network can ensure the scheme matching accuracy and the recommendation efficiency; compared with a scheme recommendation method of a neural network, the emergency scheme recommendation method based on the knowledge representation has better interpretability, and supports the expansion of the knowledge representation diagram, so that the updating of a matching calculation model of a scene and a scheme is supported.
assignees: INST OF SYSTEMS ENGINEERING PLA ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCES

title_en: Landslide hidden danger identification method, terminal equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of geological disaster identification, and provides a landslide hazard identification method, terminal equipment and medium, wherein multichannel image data are obtained by acquiring remote sensing images of identified areas and carrying out channel superposition on the remote sensing images; extracting training samples from the multi-channel image data to obtain a training sample set; extracting landslide hidden danger characteristics to obtain a plurality of candidate characteristic factors, and determining the most relevant characteristic factors corresponding to a training sample set; constructing an initial landslide potential prediction model, and training the initial landslide potential prediction model by using a training sample set to obtain a final landslide potential prediction model; predicting multi-channel image data corresponding to the area to be identified by utilizing a final landslide potential hazard prediction model to obtain a ground surface point with landslide potential hazard; and identifying landslide hidden danger of the ground surface point based on the landslide hidden danger rule set. The method can improve the accuracy of identifying the hidden danger of landslide.

title_en: Coal mine gas combustion simulation test system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster simulation, in particular to a coal mine gas combustion simulation test system. Comprising the following steps: the upper computer comprises a control instruction module and a setting module, wherein the control instruction module is used for issuing a control instruction, and the setting module is used for setting a threshold value of disaster occurrence; the controller is used for controlling the system according to a control instruction sent by the upper computer, and is electrically connected with the upper computer; the simulation sensor control module is used for simulating the environmental parameters before, during and after the disaster of the accident; the gas combustion device is used for realizing a gas combustion effect after receiving the control instruction; the environment simulation module comprises a lamp subsystem and a smoke subsystem and is used for more realistically simulating a fire scene. According to the technical scheme, more realistic simulation can be conducted aiming at gas combustion.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Fire disaster simulation generating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire simulation generating device which comprises supporting legs, a base, a transverse plate, a gas tank, a controller, a gas distribution pipe, a telescopic driving device and a conveying pipe. The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire protection, and particularly relates to a fire simulation generating device which changes the traditional bonfire simulation, is convenient for contraction, folding and moving and is capable of automatically igniting.
assignees: SHENYANG TAIDI ELECTROMECHANICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Bionic dummy on water for firefighters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bionic dummy on water for firefighters, which has the technical scheme that: the artificial human body comprises a trunk, a head and four limbs, wherein a cavity is formed in the trunk, a plurality of weight dividing partition plates are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the cavity, a cotton cloth layer is detachably arranged on the outer wall of the trunk, a first magic tape is fixedly arranged in the cotton cloth layer, a second magic tape matched with the first magic tape is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the trunk, and the cavity is formed in the bionic human body in the technical scheme; the weight distribution of the person falling into the water can be more accurately simulated, and the lower part of the water injected into the cavity is prevented from being concentrated; the outer wall of truck can be dismantled and be provided with the cotton, and the cotton possesses certain effect of absorbing water, the in-process heavy scene of person in water that can more accurate simulation fall into water, makes firefighter's training more high-efficient, also has pertinence.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Three-dimensional fire simulation device for aircraft cockpit
abstract_en: The three-dimensional fire simulation device of the aircraft cockpit comprises a water bath fire system and a fuel release system, wherein the water bath fire system is arranged below a main operation panel of the cockpit and a seat, the water bath fire system comprises a water tank, an underwater fuel gas pipeline is arranged in the water tank, water is contained in the water tank, and a water surface ignition device is arranged above the water surface in the water tank; in summary, the combustion device is integrated below the main operation panel of the cockpit and the area where the seat is located and above the top operation panel, so that the fire disaster is not limited to a single area, and the fire disaster is in an overall combustion and spreading state; the plane of the main operation panel and the surface of the seat are integrally made of steel structure grate, the lower part is integrated with the water bath type combustion device, the surface of the top operation panel is also made of steel structure grate, and when the fuel is ignited to form flame, the flame can be burnt and spread through the grate surface to simulate the real fire state.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHEN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-agent cooperation method based on hierarchical communication mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent cooperation method based on a layering communication mechanism, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing an intra-group communication topological structure and dividing agents into different groups according to communication distances; then establishing an inter-group communication topological structure, and searching for high-level intelligent agents in the group by using a centrality method based on the number of neighbor nodes; then, carrying out intra-group information aggregation and inter-group information exchange; constructing a hierarchical graph convolution network by using a multi-head attention mechanism, and weighting and adding value representations of all input features through a relation for each attention head; then, the outputs of m attention heads of the intelligent agent are connected in series, and then the outputs are sent into a single-layer MLP with ReLU nonlinearity to obtain the output of a convolution layer; and finally, making an action decision, and taking action according to the strategy. The invention breaks through centralized data acquisition, aggregation and utilization by establishing a reasonable and efficient hierarchical communication structure between the intelligent agents, and relieves the problem of dimension disasters of centralized training.

title_en: Emergency evacuation auxiliary system for dealing with emergency based on space-time big data
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency evacuation auxiliary system for dealing with emergency conditions based on space-time big data, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a monitoring module, a judging module, an information acquisition module, a strategy making module and an indication control module; the monitoring module is used for monitoring the environment in real time to obtain environment information; the judging module is used for judging whether emergency occurs or not according to the environmental information and carrying out evolution simulation on the emergency; the information acquisition module is used for acquiring a personnel space-time distribution model and an optional evacuation channel in the evacuation range; the strategy setting model is used for setting an emergency evacuation strategy according to the related information of the emergency situation, the personnel space-time distribution model and the selectable evacuation channels. According to the method, the influence range of the emergency is judged according to the related information of the emergency, and then the total evacuation strategy is planned according to the distribution condition of personnel and the road traffic load condition in the influence range, and the total evacuation strategy is completed through indication control, so that guidance and diversion are realized.
assignees: ZHONGKE HAIHUI BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method for disaster risk caused by siltation behind debris flow dam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating disaster risk caused by siltation after a debris flow dam, which comprises the following steps: s1: obtaining topographic data of a target river basin; s2: determining the boundary of a target river basin, defining a material source release area, dividing terrain and establishing a geological model; s3: analyzing the change of the ground surface source quantity before and after the occurrence of the debris flow, and calculating the debris flow starting animal source quantity; s4: collecting soil and rock mass samples of a target river basin site, performing a mechanical test, determining physical and mechanical parameters of a siltation body behind a dam, and performing simulation verification; s5: designing a simulation working condition, and analyzing and calculating the whole debris flow motion process under different working conditions by a smooth particle dynamics method to obtain dynamic parameter data; s6: and constructing an evaluation model according to the mud-rock flow river blocking condition and the disaster reduction benefit, and carrying out disaster prediction according to the set evaluation standard. Real-time quantitative evaluation of disaster risk caused by post-dam siltation is realized.
assignees: ZHONGXI LIANGSHAN RARE EARTH CO LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Three-dimensional loading similar material test system for simulating underground rock and soil disasters
abstract_en: The application is suitable for a similar material simulation test, and provides a three-dimensional loading similar material test system for simulating underground rock and soil disasters, which comprises a base plate; the surface of the base plate is fixedly connected with a model box; an end cover plate is fixedly connected to one end surface of the model box; the two sides of the model box, the top of the model box and one end far away from the end cover plate are provided with servo actuators in a rectangular array; a rectangular pressing plate is arranged at the end part of the servo actuator; the surface of the base plate is provided with a box seat at the inner bottom of the model box; a transmission shaft is arranged between the two ends of the box seat in a linear array manner; one end of each two adjacent transmission shafts is positioned at the end part of the box seat and connected with each other in a transmission way through a transmission belt; the device solves the problems that the existing similar material test equipment is large in limitation and lacks test simulation on the working condition of sudden external condition disturbance, ensures the precision of test detection, simulates the working condition test of the sudden external condition disturbance, and greatly improves the comprehensiveness of the simulation test.
assignees: JINAN HENGLE XINGKE INSTR CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Fire disaster simulation device for mechanical property test of transformer substation framework column
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire disaster simulation device for testing mechanical properties of a transformer substation framework column, and relates to the technical field of testing mechanical properties of the framework column. The experimental furnace comprises a frame and an experimental furnace, wherein an opening is formed in the side wall of the experimental furnace, a mounting seat for vertically fixing a frame column is arranged on the experimental furnace in a sliding manner, the mounting seat can drive the frame column to slide in or slide out of the experimental furnace through the opening, a through hole for the frame column to penetrate out is formed in the top of the experimental furnace, a driving assembly for controlling the mounting seat to move is arranged on the frame, an oven door for plugging the opening is hinged to the experimental furnace, a control assembly for controlling the opening and closing of the oven door is arranged on the experimental furnace, and a first hydraulic cylinder for applying vertical pressure to the frame column is arranged on the frame. The application is convenient for operators to install the framework column in the experimental furnace.

title_en: Method for improving land water reserve reconstruction accuracy based on variable screening reconstruction model
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of hydrology, and particularly relates to a method for improving land water reserve reconstruction accuracy based on a variable screening reconstruction model. The variable screening reconstruction model of the application combines a hybrid algorithm of a GT method and an LSTM neural network, and comprises the following steps: variable screening, model training and model prediction. The method provided by the application provides an effective means for reconstructing the TWSA with the loss, and provides reliable data support for flood disaster research in the intermittent period. Based on the implementation of variable screening reconstruction models, the influence of irrelevant input variables on model precision can be effectively avoided, and the accuracy of reconstructing GRACE/GRACE-FO intermittent land water reserves is improved.

title_en: Emergency evacuation simulation training system based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation simulation training system based on virtual reality, which comprises: the scene construction module is used for providing a virtual reality scene for training personnel according to training requirements; the teaching module is used for providing training personnel with different foundations with learning escape common knowledge, escape routes and self-rescue methods when the training personnel are in trouble; the customization module is used for realizing customization training and setting different training tasks for students with different requirements and different levels; the actual combat module is used for enabling students to wear the inertial motion capturing device to complete emergency escape training tasks in a virtual training scene, the whole process can be visually displayed through a large screen, and escape routes of the students can be displayed through escape maps; the evaluation module is used for carrying out quantitative grade evaluation on the training, and training staff and coaches can formulate a new exercise plan for subsequent training through evaluation reports.

title_en: Model test device suitable for water-rich sanded dolomite surge simulation
abstract_en: The application discloses a model test device suitable for water-rich sandy dolomite surge simulation, which comprises a test box body with an opening at the top, wherein a Huang Nian soil layer is arranged in the test box body, and a surrounding rock layer and a gravel layer are pre-buried in the yellow clay layer; the opening of the test box body is provided with a pressurizing plate, the pressurizing plate is provided with a water storage tank, a movable plate is arranged in the water storage tank, and a water inlet pipe extending into the crushed stone layer is arranged on the water storage tank; the water storage device comprises a water storage tank, and is characterized by further comprising a pressurizing assembly, wherein the pressurizing assembly comprises a first output shaft and a second output shaft, the first output shaft is used for being inserted into the water storage tank and pushing the movable plate to move, and the second output shaft is used for pushing the water storage tank to squeeze the pressurizing plate. And analyzing the water burst sand generation mechanism and early warning information when the disaster occurs by simulating the difference of the evolution rules of surrounding rock stress, water burst quantity and other multi-field information in the water burst process.
assignees: THE 2ND ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 16TH CONSTRUCTION BUREAU;CHINA RAILWAY 16TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHENGKUN RAILWAY CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel tunneling two-dimensional/three-dimensional analogue simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a two-dimensional/three-dimensional analogue simulation test device for tunneling, which comprises a test box body, similar materials, a box cover, a tunnel die through hole, a tunnel die, an acoustic emission sensor, an acoustic emission detector, a lateral hydraulic cylinder, a lateral pressurizing plate, a vertical hydraulic cylinder, a vertical pressurizing plate and a sizing block. Compared with the prior art, the utility model can adjust the inside of the whole test box body, and simultaneously can adapt to two-dimensional or three-dimensional simulation tests with different filling similar material volumes according to the installation quantity of the horizontal vertical hydraulic cylinders and the longitudinal lateral hydraulic cylinders, and the similar materials in the test box body are pressurized by the vertical hydraulic cylinders and the longitudinal lateral hydraulic cylinders in the process of slowly extracting the tunnel mould in the test process, so that underground engineering acoustic emission disaster experiments can be carried out by the acoustic emission sensor and the acoustic emission detector; the whole device has simple structure and convenient use.
assignees: HENAN SHENGWO BOXIN INDUSTRIAL AND MINING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: CIM-based heavy wind rainfall disaster sand table simulator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sand table simulator, in particular to a CIM-based heavy wind rainfall disaster sand table simulator. The CIM-based heavy wind rainfall disaster sand table simulator comprises a sand table and a model, wherein the sand table is connected with the model capable of being freely set, and the sand table also comprises a water tank, a water pump, a water pipe and the like; the bottom of sand table is connected with the water tank, and one side of water tank is connected and is UNICOM has the water pump, is connected and is linked together the one end that has the water pipe on the water pump, and the other end and the water tank of water pipe are connected and are linked together. The simulation of the heavy wind and rainfall disasters can realize the simulation controllability, the setting degree of freedom of the sand table simulator is improved, and the sand table simulator can be suitable for various disaster simulation situations of heavy wind rainfall, so that the sand table simulator achieves the effect of freely simulating the heavy wind rainfall disasters.

title_en: System for predicting flooding using drone images and artificial intelligence
title_ko: 드론 영상과 인공지능을 이용한 침수 범람 예측 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for predicting flooding, and particularly, the system for predicting flooding can reflect recent environments and visibly express the area and the degree of flooding in an ortho-photo-graph, a digital elevation model (DEM), and a digital surface model (DSM) based on an image captured by a drone providing precise digital data. With the system, visibility information in a flooding area can be utilized for identifying flooding-vulnerable areas and swiftly responding to a disaster in real-time homeland management. Objective digital data information can be provided in selecting installation locations of safety facilities for flooding including penetration blocks and installation of water detention tanks. In addition, the system can support tasks by producing drawings and visible simulation values required for various reports and documents, and material preparations, and build a DB and use the same in terms of social infrastructure maintenance through persistent drone image learning in the long term.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 침수 범람 예측 시스템에 관한 것으로 특히, 최근의 환경을 그대로 반영할 수 있으며 정확한 수치 데이터를 제공하는 드론으로 촬영하는 영상을 기반으로 이에 따른 정사영상(Ortho-photo-graph)과 수치 표고 모형(Digital Elevation Model: DEM)과 및 수치 표면 모형(Digital Surface Model: DSM)에 침수 범람 영역과 정도를 가시적으로 표현할 수 있는 침수 범람 예측 시스템을 제공하면, 침수지역의 가시화 정보는 실시간 국토관리에 있어서 침수범람 취약지역 파악 및 신속한 재해대응 업무에 활용 될 수 있으며 침투블록, 저류조 설치 등 홍수대비 안전시설 설치 위치 선정에 있어 객관적인 수치 데이터 정보를 제공할 수 있다. 
또한 각종 보고서 및 문서, 자료작성에 필요한 도면과 가시적인 시뮬레이션 값을 출력하여 업무를 지원할 수 있으며, 장기적으로는 지속적인 드론영상 학습을 통한 사회기반 시설물 유지관리 측면에서 DB를 구축하고 활용할 수 있는 효과를 갖는다.

title_en: Disaster response system that detects and responds to disaster situations in real time
title_ko: 실시간으로 재난 상황을 감지하고 대응하는 재난 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response system that detects and responds to a disaster situation in real time. The disaster response system can improve accuracy in realistic risk determination. According to an embodiment of the disclosure, an operation method for a disaster response system providing a disaster detecting and response service includes: a step of receiving sensing data from different kinds of sensors; a step of sensing herald phenomenon by each disaster by analyzing the sensing data in real time; a step of generating disaster detecting data by processing the sensing data when detecting the herald phenomenon; a step of determining a disaster kind and a risk degree based on the disaster detecting data; and a step of predicting a damage degree according to an environmental facility or a structure by simulation based on the disaster kind and the risk degree, and supporting decision determination necessary for disaster response. The different kinds of sensors include at least two among a first sensor obtaining environmental information, a second sensor obtaining disaster information, and a third sensor obtaining integrated information in which the environmental information and the disaster information are integrated.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시 예에 따른 재난 감지 및 대응 서비스를 제공하는 재난 대응 시스템의 동작 방법은 이기종의 센서들로부터 센싱 데이터를 수신하는 단계; 상기 센싱 데이터를 실시간으로 분석하여 재난별 전조 현상을 감지하는 단계; 상기 전조 현상을 감지하면, 상기 센싱 데이터를 처리하여 재난 감지 데이터를 생성하는 단계; 상기 재난 감지 데이터를 기반으로 재난 유형 및 위험도를 판단하는 단계; 및 상기 재난 유형 및 상기 위험도를 기반으로 시뮬레이션을 통해 환경 시설 또는 시설물에 따른 피해 정도를 예측하고, 재난 대응에 필요한 의사결정을 지원하는 단계를 포함한다. 상기 이기종의 센서들은 환경 정보를 획득하는 제1 센서, 재난 정보를 획득하는 제2 센서, 및 상기 환경 정보 및 상기 재난 정보가 통합된 통합 정보를 획득하는 제3 센서 중 적어도 둘을 포함한다.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL COOPERATION FOUNDATION JEONBUK NATIONAL UNIV

title_en: Apparatus for virtual fire fighting training, and control method thereof
title_ko: 가상소방훈련장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for virtual firefighting training, which processes realistic behavioral simulations of a real training member outside a virtual training space with respect to a virtual training member inside the virtual training space, in conducting firefighting training using a virtual training space, and an operating method thereof. The apparatus for virtual firefighting training comprises: an obtaining unit which obtains sensed data that detects the movement of the actual training member from a sensor mounted on the actual training member outside the virtual training space; a conversion unit which converts the sensed data into movement data of the virtual training member; and a processing unit which processes movements synchronized with the real training member with respect to the virtual training member according to the data value of the movement data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 가상훈련공간을 이용한 소방훈련을 진행함에 있어서 가상훈련공간 내부의 가상훈련원에 대해서 가상훈련공간 외부의 실제훈련원에 대한 현실적인 행동 모사를 처리하는 가상소방훈련장치 및 그 동작 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: NAVIWORKS CO LTD;UNIV JEONJU IND UNIV COOP

title_en: Systems and methods for remote management of monitored exercise and rehabilitation with emergency responses
abstract_en: Systems and methods for the remote management of monitored exercise and rehabilitation in the setting of respiratory conditions are provided. Particularly, therapy guidance to an agent is recited. Sensory data and photoplethysmography (PPG) data are collected from a patient. The sensory data is discarded when the PPG data differs from a prototypical waveform pattern. The remaining sensory data is analyzed, in light of historical data, to generate recommendations for the patient. Additionally, systems and methods for providing an emergency services response during the therapy session is provided. The location of the patient is assessed. The system then converts the location information into longitude/latitude coordinates or into jurisdictional named entities. The translated location data for the patient may then be cross referenced with a real-time updated database of emergency medical services (EMS) contact information. In the event of an emergency situation, this data can then be provided to the healthcare worker.

title_en: Evacuation action prediction device, method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an evacuation action prediction technique which facilitates analysis of the decision grounds of evacuation actions taken by an evacuation agent.SOLUTION: An evacuation action prediction device provided herein is configured to retain a map 16 showing evacuation routes 26 of agents 21 located in an area where an event has occurred, reflect parameters 28 on coordinate values 27 of the map 16, set an initial position 22 and target position 25 of each of multiple evacuating agents 21 on the coordinate values 27 of the map 16, and simulate evacuation routes 26 of the agents 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: System and method for learning npc-type ai firefighters of virtual firefighting training contents
title_ko: 소방 가상훈련 콘텐츠의 npc형 ai 소방관 학습 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for learning NPC-type AI firefighters of virtual firefighting training content and a method thereof. The system for learning NPC-type AI firefighters of virtual firefighting training content according to the present invention includes: a map information component part that configures virtual map information according to a scenario in firefighting virtual training content; an AI firefighter learning part that learns the behavior of NPC-type AI firefighters using the virtual map information; and a virtual training provision part that provides training situation information to the trainer using the learning results of the AI firefighter learning part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방 가상훈련 콘텐츠의 NPC형 AI 소방관 학습 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 소방 가상훈련 콘텐츠의 NPC형 AI 소방관 학습 시스템은 소방 가상훈련 콘텐츠에 시나리오에 따른 가상의 맵 정보를 구성하는 맵 정보 구성부와, 가상의 맵 정보를 이용하여 NPC형 AI 소방관의 행동을 학습하는 AI 소방관 학습부 및 AI 소방관 학습부의 학습 결과를 이용하여 훈련자에게 훈련 상황 정보를 제공하는 가상훈련 제공부를 포함한다.

title_en: Prestressed concrete beam circulation mud jacking analogue means
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circulating grouting simulation device for a prestressed concrete beam, which relates to the technical field of concrete construction and comprises a concrete beam body and a pump body, wherein a prestressed tendon hole is formed in the concrete beam body, a connecting pipe is fixedly arranged at the end part of the concrete beam body, a slurry stirring mechanism is arranged at the top of the concrete beam body, and a slurry discharging pipe is embedded at the bottom of the slurry stirring mechanism. This prestressed concrete beam circulation mud jacking analogue means through air duct and the vacuum pump that sets up for the vacuum pump can be directly when the operation be through the inside evacuation state of air duct with prestressed rib hole, has avoided the inside of prestressed rib hole to remain and has formed the condition emergence that the bubble influences whole compactness in the mud that the air led to the fact the injection, and through setting up of spacing spring, pull rod and arc stopper, make between thick liquid mechanism and the connecting pipe convenient to use person carry out dismouting and handle.
assignees: THE THIRD CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD OF CHINA CONSTRUCTION SECOND ENG BUREAU

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for disaster prevention and reduction and accident emergency capability of regional space in rural area
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive evaluation method for disaster prevention, disaster reduction and accident emergency capability of regional space in rural areas, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a disaster prevention and reduction and accident emergency scheme, and evaluating the quality of the disaster prevention and reduction and accident emergency scheme according to a first evaluation condition to acquire a first evaluation result; performing emergency simulation exercise according to the disaster prevention and reduction and accident emergency scheme, and evaluating an emergency simulation exercise effect according to a second evaluation condition to obtain a second evaluation result; according to a disaster prevention and reduction scheme, an accident emergency scheme and personnel participation in emergency simulation exercise, and according to a third evaluation condition, evaluating personnel emergency treatment quality to obtain a third evaluation result; and summarizing the first evaluation result, the second evaluation result and the third evaluation result, and combining the evaluation results implemented by the emergency scheme propaganda study and the emergency simulation exercise organization to obtain a comprehensive evaluation result. The invention can scientifically evaluate the disaster prevention and reduction and accident emergency capability of the regional space of the rural area by comprehensively and accurately evaluating the disaster prevention and reduction and accident emergency capability.

title_en: Associated early warning method for precise flood disaster defense
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of flood early warning and disaster defense, and discloses a related early warning method for accurately defending mountain torrents so as to improve the overall performance of forecasting. The method comprises the following steps: fusing the two-dimensional hydrodynamic model and the decision tree algorithm with the associated early warning; specifically, the upstream early warning water level is reversely pushed by the downstream disaster-causing water level, so that the timeliness of warning and the time for transferring evacuation of residents are ensured, and the defense accuracy is ensured; if the measured upstream water level value is smaller than the early warning water level value, the early warning is not issued, so that the calculation resources required for calculating the downstream submerged range and the submerged water depth by using a decision tree algorithm are saved; in addition, in the prediction process, the calculation simulation result of the two-dimensional hydrodynamic model and the historical real data are fused, so that the prediction accuracy and the reliability of the result are ensured.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;INFORMATION CENTER OF GANSU WATER CONSERVANCY DEPT

title_en: Data security processing method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data security processing method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium. According to the method, information data are obtained, multiple characteristic weights of the information data are determined based on classification grades of the information data and types of the information data, risk prediction is conducted on the information data, a predicted risk grade of the information data is obtained, a safety strategy is generated according to the characteristic weights and the predicted risk grade, simulation execution is conducted on the safety strategy, a simulation execution result of the safety strategy is obtained, the safety strategy is updated based on the simulation execution result, the information data are processed based on the updated safety strategy, abnormality detection is conducted on a storage environment and a system operation environment of the information data respectively, and/or an external environment attack event is detected, and an emergency response scheme is generated and executed under the condition that the environment abnormality or the external attack event is detected. By simulating and executing the security policy, the security policy is continuously perfected, and the security of the information data is improved.

title_en: Landslide physical model device
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide physical model device, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster model tests. Comprising the following steps: the slope is provided with the landslide model in the model case, is equipped with measurement system in the model case, and measurement system is used for measuring landslide displacement, still includes: a reservoir water level variation system for simulating reservoir water level fluctuation variation, the reservoir water level variation system comprising: a water tank; one end of the first water pipe is communicated with the bottom of the water tank, and the other end of the first water pipe is communicated with the bottom of the model box; the input end of the water supply assembly is used for connecting a water source, and the output end of the water supply assembly is communicated with the water tank; the output end of the lifting structure is connected with the water tank and is used for lifting the water tank. The application has the advantages that the communicating vessel principle is adopted, so that the water level of the water tank is consistent with the water level in the model box, namely the water level of the warehouse, the change of the water level of the warehouse is simulated by changing the lifting of the water level of the warehouse by changing the height of the water tank, and the change of the water level of the warehouse can be accurately controlled.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Distributed denial of service attack and defense exercise system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed denial of service attack and defense exercise system and a method, wherein the system comprises the following steps: an attacker simulator and an defender simulator; the attacker simulator is used for automatically searching an attack target, selecting the number of puppet sets, the attack mode and the attack speed, and carrying out distributed denial of service attack on the attack target; the defender simulator is used for simulating the process of defending the distributed denial of service attack, selecting a plurality of preset defending measures and constructing a simulation website. The invention can better adapt to various attack scenes by simulating attack types and network topological structures, can learn about distributed denial of service attack by fast and convenient attack and defense exercise experience, analyzes the performance and weakness of a company network defense system, further improves and optimizes the network security defense system, improves network security, exercises emergency response skills of network security personnel, and improves the accuracy of network security emergency response.
assignees: BEIJING WUYI JIAYU TECH CO LTD;BEIJING INTEGRITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rock burst microseismic parameter multi-element multi-time-step output prediction model
