abstract_en: The application discloses a rock burst microseismic parameter multi-element multi-time-step output prediction model in the technical field of rock burst microseismic prediction, which is constructed by the following steps: step 1, carrying out rock burst microseismic monitoring in the tunnel excavation process, and acquiring multiparameter microseismic monitoring information in the rock burst inoculation process; step 2, performing geological survey and microseismic monitoring information interpretation on the generated rock burst, and determining the rock burst grade; step 3, establishing rock burst sample libraries of different grades and corresponding microseismic monitoring information sample libraries; step 4, constructing a prediction model by a deep learning method; step 5, training the constructed prediction model; and 6, predicting the evolution of the microseismic parameters by using a multi-element and multi-time-step prediction model of the microseismic parameters, and predicting and deducing the rock burst risk in advance. According to the method, accurate prediction of future microseismic parameters can be realized, timeliness of rock burst early warning is improved, and a data base and support are provided for subsequent rock burst disaster dynamic early warning.

title_en: Smart community risk prevention and control system and risk prevention and control method
abstract_en: The application discloses a smart community risk prevention and control system, which is applied to a community twin space and comprises the following components: the environment information acquisition module: the method is used for executing real-time acquisition and processing of community environment information; risk assessment module: the system comprises a community space simulation unit and a risk assessment unit, wherein the community space simulation unit and the risk assessment unit are used for calculating the environment states of the community space and the risk levels of different areas by combining real-time environment flow data, the community space and risk assessment rules; risk processing module: the early warning and processing are carried out according to the risk level; the risk processing module comprises a risk early warning unit and a risk processing unit; and the risk processing unit generates a personnel evacuation plan according to the risk levels of different areas and the information of the community space. According to the technical scheme, the accuracy and the intellectualization of community operation and maintenance management can be improved, and the safety risk caused by personnel confusion is effectively avoided.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY GROUP GUIZHOU TOURISM & CULTURE DEV CO LTD;GUIZHOU TRANSPORTATION PLANNING SURVEY & DESIGN ACADEME CO LTD

title_en: Air-ground integrated Internet of things joint resource allocation method based on deep double Q networks and federal learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation method based on a transverse federal learning and depth double-Q network for disaster emergency scenes, which is oriented to emergency scenes, an unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted air-ground integrated network is constructed, an unmanned aerial vehicle is clustered by adopting a function clustering idea, two tasks of calculation unloading and perception information transmission are comprehensively considered, a multi-objective optimization problem is constructed, an optimal channel allocation and emission power joint optimization strategy is obtained by utilizing a depth double-Q network model, federal learning is introduced, global aggregation is realized on the premise of protecting user data safety, a priority experience playback mechanism is introduced, the convergence speed of network training is accelerated, and the performance is improved. The HFL-DDQN algorithm used by the invention can minimize the time and energy cost of the system under the condition of meeting the constraints of time delay, power and the like, and effectively solves the joint optimization problem of channel allocation and power selection of vehicle users and sensing nodes in emergency scenes.

title_en: Flood prevention forecasting method and system for power grid facilities
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for forecasting flood control of power grid facilities, which relate to the technical field of flood control forecasting of the power grid facilities, and avoid artificial subjective consciousness by carrying out K-means cluster analysis processing, thereby avoiding the problem that the conversion of original data possibly affects the flood control forecasting result of the power grid facilities; the problem of index weighting in the traditional method is avoided, so that the influence of irrational property of the index weighting method on the final evaluation result is avoided; and secondly, a deep learning model is established by using a back propagation algorithm, data are input into the deep learning model for training, parameters of the classifier are automatically learned through the performance of the classifier on a classification task, the reliability is high, the problem of model overfitting is effectively relieved, the continuous learning capacity of the current deep learning model is effectively improved, the flood prevention forecast of power grid facilities is more accurate, and the risk of damage to the power grid facilities caused by disasters is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Coal rock stress monitoring device and coal rock stress monitoring method
abstract_en: The application discloses a coal rock stress monitoring device and a coal rock stress monitoring method, wherein the coal rock stress monitoring device comprises a bracket and a plurality of stress detection devices, the bracket comprises a fixed piece and a plurality of movable pieces, and the movable pieces are movably connected with the fixed piece; the stress detection devices are arranged at intervals around the fixed piece, and each stress detection device comprises a mounting base body and at least one sensing unit arranged on the mounting base body, and each mounting base body is movably connected with at least one movable piece so that the coal rock stress monitoring device can be switched between a furled state and an unfolded state; in the furled state, an initial interval is arranged between the mounting base body and the fixing piece, so that the coal rock stress monitoring device is placed in the drill hole; in the unfolded state, the working distance is reserved between the mounting base body and the fixing piece and is larger than the initial distance, so that the mounting base body is propped against the wall of the drilled hole. The coal rock stress monitoring device provided by the embodiment of the application can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of coal rock dynamic disasters.

title_en: Heavy current through-flow test platform
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of high-current device through-flow test, and solves the technical problem that the safety and reliability performance of a high-current device cannot be tested in the prior art, in particular to a high-current through-flow test platform, which comprises a cabinet serving as an installation carrier, wherein a through-flow test system for the through-flow test of the high-current device is installed in the cabinet, the through-flow test system comprises a PFN module electrically connected with a high-voltage power supply, and the high-voltage power supply is used for providing electric energy for the PFN module, wherein the electric energy can be selectively set to a voltage value of 0.1-3.5 kV; the PFN module comprises a discharging thyristor Q1, a discharging load module and a current recording and broadcasting CT which are sequentially connected with a high-voltage end and a low-voltage end of a high-voltage power supply in series. According to the application, the performance of the circuit is tested and evaluated by simulating the real environment under the load condition of the circuit, so that the stability and reliability of the device under various conditions are detected, the faults and disasters of the power system are predicted, and the operation safety of equipment is ensured.
assignees: WUHAN ZHIRUIJIE ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based radiation accident emergency exercise method
abstract_en: The invention provides a radiation accident emergency exercise method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle-based radiation accident emergency exercise method comprises the steps of determining the radiation accident emergency exercise purpose, exercise range and radiation accident situation; and determining the radiation accident emergency exercise place, exercise route and exercise place. The unmanned aerial vehicle-based radiation accident emergency exercise method provided by the invention has the advantages that the radiation environment aviation monitoring data of the target area can be rapidly acquired, the radiation hot spot area is searched, the radiation hot spot position is rapidly defined and positioned, the basis is provided for effectively coping with and rapidly disposing radiation environment safety emergency events, the manpower resource consumption of ground environment monitoring and the radiation irradiation of monitoring personnel are effectively reduced, the radiation environment data acquisition speed of the target area or the target site is improved, the radiation accident emergency response speed and disposal efficiency are improved, the economic benefit and the social benefit are improved, and the life health and the environmental safety of people are ensured.
assignees: AERIAL SURVEY & REMOTE SENSING CENTRE OF NUCLEAR IND

title_en: Simulation prediction method for water vapor sources inside and outside drought and waterlogging disaster frequent areas
abstract_en: The application provides a simulation prediction method for water vapor sources inside and outside a drought and waterlogging disaster frequent area, which comprises the following steps: determining the water vapor source change influence of the regional precipitation change; determining the contribution effect of the global climate index on the internal and external water vapor in the region; determining the effect of the change in the underlying surface of the area on the water vapor circulation of the area; simulating and predicting the water vapor sources inside and outside the area based on the water vapor source change influence of the area precipitation change, the contribution influence of the global climate index on the water vapor inside and outside the area and the influence of the underlying surface change of the area on the water vapor circulation of the area. The method can determine the water vapor contribution source range of the regional precipitation in different seasons and years, discover the water vapor transmission difference of drought and extreme precipitation years, further quantify the influence of global climate index on the water vapor transmission contribution of the regional drought and extreme precipitation years, and further predict the water vapor circulation contribution change trend causing regional precipitation change in the future.

title_en: Mutual feedback type emergent investigation, monitoring and early warning system for sudden geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mutual feedback type emergent investigation and monitoring early warning system for sudden geological disasters, which comprises an emergent remote control command device, a monitoring device and a control device, wherein the emergent remote control command device is used for sending investigation instructions or monitoring instructions to a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and a plurality of remote control robots; the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying out aerial photography on the sudden geological disaster area in the simulated ground flight process to obtain an aerial photographic image; the aerial image is sent to an emergency remote control command device through a Mesh wireless communication network; the remote control robot is used for carrying out ground image acquisition and laser ranging on the sudden geological disaster area, sampling rocks and/or soil of the sudden geological disaster area and crushing boulders of the sudden geological disaster area in the moving process of the sudden geological disaster area. According to the invention, sudden geological disasters can be rapidly checked, and the remote control robot and the unmanned aerial vehicle can cooperatively operate by a remote control means, so that dangerous investigation of geological personnel is avoided, and the safety of sudden geological disasters emergency investigation and monitoring is improved.
assignees: WUHAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY ZHONGNAN GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOV

title_en: Building interaction system based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of building interaction systems, and discloses a building interaction system based on a virtual reality technology, which comprises: a target building and a virtual reality terminal device, the target building being configured with a plurality of entrance ends and a first sensing unit; the virtual reality terminal equipment is provided with a live-action display unit and a virtual reality display unit, and is provided with a second sensing unit, an information storage unit, a positioning unit, a thermal sensing unit, a radar life detection unit and a local processor; the local processor is configured with a path guiding module, when a firefighter wearing the virtual reality terminal device enters the interior of the target building from the entrance end, the information storage unit retrieves three-dimensional model information of the corresponding target building, and the path guiding module generates path guiding information according to the three-dimensional model information, the positioning information, the heat source information in the interior of the target building and the life body information and outputs the path guiding information to the virtual reality display unit.

title_en: Method and system for predicting abnormal data of earthquake station by using similar earthquake
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for predicting abnormal data of a seismic station by using similar earthquakes, relating to the field of disaster early warning; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the seismic phases of a plurality of seismic events monitored by a seismic station, and respectively generating a seismic data template according to the seismic station and the acquired seismic phases of the seismic events; judging abnormal stations in a plurality of to-be-detected seismic stations recording similar seismic events in a preset area; carrying out reason classification on the abnormal records of the abnormal seismic station to obtain abnormal classification data; training an anomaly record prediction model according to the seismic data template of the anomaly seismic station and the corresponding anomaly classification data by adopting a logistic regression algorithm; and predicting the abnormal reason of abnormal records of the abnormal seismic station by adopting the model. According to the method, the abnormal seismic station is judged through the similar seismic event, and then the abnormal record of the abnormal seismic station is predicted according to the training abnormal prediction model of the abnormal seismic station, so that the purpose of rapidly correcting the abnormal seismic station is achieved.
assignees: THE SECOND MONITORING CENTER OF CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Intelligent decision-making system for emergency rescue dispatch
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent decision-making system for emergency rescue dispatch, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue dispatch. The method comprises the steps that an unofficial rescue unit is registered in a third-party platform through a terminal, the third-party platform provides emergency rescue capability training for the unofficial rescue unit, and after an emergency event of a large-scale wounded person occurs, the position of the unofficial rescue unit can be determined according to a positioning unit in the terminal; the official rescue unit can acquire specific information of the unofficial rescue unit through the third party platform, and the official rescue unit sends whether to accept rescue dispatch or not to the unofficial rescue unit through the third party platform; if the unofficial rescue unit responds and receives dispatch within a certain time, incorporating a dispatch plan of the intelligent dispatch decision system; if the unofficial rescue unit responds with a timeout or does not accept dispatch, the intelligent dispatch decision system does not incorporate it into the dispatch plan. The application can obviously enhance the cooperative emergency response capability of the official rescue unit and the unofficial rescue unit.

title_en: Dynamic monitoring and disaster early warning system for earth-rock dam seepage safety based on digital twin technology and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic monitoring and disaster early warning system for earth and rockfill dam seepage safety based on a digital twin technology and a construction method thereof, wherein the system comprises a physical layer, an information layer, a service layer and an application layer; the physical layer and the information layer comprise a monitoring system for digital twin bottom plate construction; the service layer comprises a prediction system, an early warning system and a plan release system for data fusion processing; the application layer includes a previewing system for digitized scene construction. The built system can better serve engineering practice, monitor various index data of the earth and rockfill dam in real time, predict the seepage security risk of the earth and rockfill dam in real time, and realize real-time dynamic simulation of seepage state of the earth and rockfill dam and seepage disaster automatic early warning plan.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster monitoring and early warning method, a geological disaster monitoring and early warning system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time monitoring geological data and historical geological monitoring data; performing data cleaning on the real-time monitoring geological data to obtain cleaned geological data; inputting the cleaned geological data and the historical geological monitoring data into a data prediction model to obtain geological prediction data output by the data prediction model; obtaining a monitoring and early warning result based on the geological prediction data; the data prediction model is obtained by training sample real-time detection geological data and sample historical geological monitoring data based on samples of sample monitoring points. According to the method, the system, the electronic equipment and the storage medium, the real-time monitoring geological data is subjected to data cleaning, so that the probability that the equipment monitoring data frequently jump and the platform are subjected to early warning and false warning is reduced, namely the false warning rate is reduced, and the accuracy of geological disaster monitoring and early warning is further improved.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIST

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous coverage method based on pheromone heuristic
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous coverage method based on pheromone inspiring, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a coverage scene graph for automatically collecting natural disaster area data of a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, S2, constructing a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle path pheromone map based on an pheromone aggregation model, marking a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle path, S3, defining a state function, an action function and a reward function according to a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous coverage task, constructing a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous coverage model based on a neural network and training, and S4, adopting the trained multi-unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous coverage model to conduct multi-unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous coverage. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of high efficiency, energy conservation, high coverage rate and wide applicability.

title_en: Multifunctional aircraft landing gear fire disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The multifunctional aircraft landing gear fire simulation device comprises a landing gear steel structure model, wherein the landing gear steel structure model is provided with two steel structure rollers, a combustion device is arranged in one steel structure roller, the combustion device is connected with a fuel conveying pipe, and an ignition device is arranged on the combustion device; in summary, the landing gear steel structure model provided by the utility model can be independently combusted, an independent smoke generating function is added, the whole landing gear is not connected with a machine body, a metal flat car is arranged below the landing gear, and the lower pipelines are all flexible pipes, so that the whole landing gear steel structure model can be moved, flames can be ignited anywhere around fire below the machine body, abundant accident scenes are simulated, and the functional defects of the traditional landing gear fire simulation device are overcome.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHEN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster simulator for multifunctional aircraft engine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire simulation equipment and discloses a fire simulation device of a multifunctional aircraft engine, which comprises a sealing box arranged in the aircraft engine, wherein the left end of the lower surface of the sealing box is connected with a cooling water outflow pipe, the right end of the lower surface of the sealing box is connected with a cooling water inflow pipe, a mixing mechanism is arranged in the sealing box, and a smoke generating mechanism is arranged at the left end of the lower surface of the interior of the sealing box; according to the utility model, through the arranged mixing structure, gaseous propane can be mixed into combustible gas and is ignited by the spark plug to generate flame, the flame burns vaporized liquid propane, so that a large amount of flame can be generated, the smoke generating machine directly sends smoke generating liquid in the smoke generating liquid box into a space between an aircraft engine and the sealing box after pressurization and atomization, and the atomized smoke generating liquid absorbs moisture in the air to form smoke, so that the simulation device can simulate smoke and fire at the same time, and the simulation effect is more fit with the actual situation.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHEN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flash fire accident simulation test system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster simulation, in particular to a flash fire accident simulation test system. Comprising the following steps: the upper computer comprises a control instruction module and a setting module, wherein the control instruction module is used for issuing a control instruction, and the setting module is used for setting a threshold value of disaster occurrence; the controller is used for controlling the system according to a control instruction sent by the upper computer, and is electrically connected with the upper computer; the simulation sensor control module is used for simulating the environmental parameters before, during and after the disaster of the accident; the flash fire combustion device is used for realizing a flash effect after receiving the control instruction; the environment simulation module comprises a lamp subsystem and a smoke subsystem and is used for more realistically simulating a fire scene. The technical scheme can simulate the flash fire more truly.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Method for determining drought vulnerability curve of meshed crop based on improved moisture sensitivity
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of hydrologic water resources, and relates to a method for determining a drought vulnerability curve of a meshed crop based on improved moisture sensitivity, which comprises the following steps: embedding an influence factor of water stress on photosynthesis into a DSSAT model; respectively calculating standard root mean square errors of the aerial biomass analog values before and after the DSSAT model is improved; collecting basic data in a research area, including meteorological data, geographic data, crop data and soil data, and dividing the research area into grids; according to the physical period data, performing winter wheat genetic parameter calculation by adopting a GLUE method; constructing a drought disaster intensity DHI index as an index for evaluating a wheat drought disaster factor by using an improved moisture-sensitive grid crop simulation system; based on the drought hazard intensity index and the corresponding yield loss rate, a physical vulnerability profile is defined. The application establishes the relationship between the intensity of the grid drought hazard and the crop yield loss from the physical process of the agricultural drought.

title_en: Device and method for detecting air leakage and fire resistance of cavity floor structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of performance detection of building construction, and discloses a device and a method for detecting air leakage and fire resistance of a cavity floor structure, based on a floor test piece with a built-in cavity, the detection device comprises a fire test furnace, a pressure simulation device and an air tightness detection device, according to the invention, the test piece is burnt by the fire test furnace, the cavity in the test piece is used as a smoke exhaust pipeline to simulate air flow detection, and the data comparison is carried out on the air tightness detection before and after the test piece burns, so that the fire disaster bearing capacity of the test piece which meets the actual situation can be obtained.

title_en: Concrete quality detection device for mixing plant
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of concrete quality detection, and discloses a concrete quality detection device for a mixing plant, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first sliding rod is symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, a first sliding block is connected with the first sliding rod wall in a sliding manner, a second sliding rod is fixedly arranged on the side part of the first sliding block, a second sliding block is symmetrically and fixedly connected with the second sliding rod wall, a detection plate is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the second sliding block, a baffle is symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the detection plate, first springs are symmetrically and fixedly arranged at two ends of the first sliding rod, the end parts of the first springs are fixedly connected with the surface of the first sliding rod, the first springs are in sliding contact with the first sliding rod wall, and second springs are symmetrically and fixedly arranged at two ends of the second sliding rod. According to the utility model, after the concrete is solidified, earthquake and flood natural disasters can be simulated, and whether the quality of the concrete meets the standard of resisting natural disasters is detected.
assignees: SHANGHAI TONGWANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Life detector training device
abstract_en: The life detector training device comprises a storage box in which training articles can be placed, wherein a first detection port is formed in the front side wall of the storage box for the life detector to pass through. The storage box simulates a collapsed building, and the detection port of the storage box simulates a hole at the collapsed part of the building; training articles, such as cloth dolls or rabbits, are put into the storage box to simulate people trapped at the collapsed position of the building. The fire fighter holds the grip lever of life detection instrument, lets the grip lever end stretch into the storage box through the detection mouth of storage box, utilizes the life detector of installing at the grip lever end to survey, distinguishes whether to hide article and the shape of incasement article in the case according to the detection result to this mode exercise uses life detection instrument. The firefighter does not need to go to a professional rescue training base, and can practice the use of the life detector only by using the life detector training device provided by the utility model to simulate a collapsed building in which trapped people are buried, so that the life detector is more convenient to practice.
assignees: LIAO JIE;ZHANG XIN;LU SHICHENG;ZENG WU;HUANG QI;Bu Xiangbang

title_en: Train fire simulation experiment platform system capable of ventilating and exhausting smoke for railway tunnel rescue station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a train fire simulation experiment platform system of a railway tunnel rescue station, which comprises a railway tunnel rescue station model, a railway train model, a ventilation and smoke exhaust system and a test system, wherein the test system comprises a quality loss test system, a smoke temperature measurement system, a wind speed test system and an image measurement system. The utility model overcomes the defects of high cost and inaccurate numerical simulation of full-size experiments, can simulate the fire heat release rate, fire plume entrainment characteristics and smoke distribution rules of the train of the railway tunnel rescue station under different ventilation modes and different elevation environments, and can provide scientific basis for the operation of the railway tunnel rescue station and the design of disaster prevention rescue evacuation.
assignees: CHINA RAIWAY ERYUAN GUIYANG SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive multistage buffering anti-spraying hole device for gas extraction drilling spraying holes
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine gas disaster management, in particular to a self-adaptive multi-stage buffering anti-spraying hole device for a gas extraction drilling spraying hole, which comprises the following components: the orifice blowout preventer and the gas-slag separator are communicated through a buffer connecting pipe; the orifice blowout preventer is provided with a sleeve pipe for being inserted into the coal seam; a slag discharging port is arranged at the bottom of one side surface of the gas-slag separation device, and a baffle is rotationally connected to the slag discharging port on the outer side surface of the gas-slag separation device; the other side surface of the gas-slag separation device is provided with a storage box, one end of the storage box, which is far away from the gas-slag separation device, is provided with a movable baffle plate in rotary connection, and a telescopic bag is arranged in the storage box and is communicated with the gas-slag separation device through a communication hole; the orifice blowout preventer, the gas-slag separator and the telescopic bag are communicated with the extraction pipeline. The self-adaptive buffer volume change can be carried out, slag is automatically discharged and sealing is carried out, so that gas leakage to the drill site space is prevented from causing gas overrun, and mine safety production is guaranteed.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Coal seam fire simulation test system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, and discloses a coal seam fire simulation test system, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a display, a controller, a memory, a gas supply assembly, a timing device, a smoke generator, a light assembly and a coal seam, wherein a coal seam combustion scenario mode table is stored in the memory, and the memory is connected with a first controller in an electrifying way; the first controller controls the opening and closing of the gas supply assembly, the light assembly and the smoke generator, the gas supply assembly further comprises a coal seam combustion contextual model selection button, the coal seam is located at a gas outlet of the gas supply assembly, the first controller is electrically connected with the timing device, the gas supply assembly further comprises a mobile sensing device, the mobile sensing device comprises a sensor assembly, a second controller, a communication device and a fixed assembly, the sensor assembly is electrically connected with the second controller, and the second controller sends data acquired by the sensor assembly to the display through the communication device to display. The utility model can control the cost and can comprehensively monitor the scene condition of the coal seam fire disaster.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Weather disaster high-resolution regional mode forecasting system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a weather disaster high-resolution regional mode forecasting system and method, which relate to the technical field of weather disaster forecasting and comprise the steps of performing scale reduction processing on target data of a region to be processed to obtain scale-reduced target data, and fusing multisource observation data to obtain lattice point fusion data; according to a preset period, different target observation data are subjected to physical quantity correction, error estimation, quality control and format conversion by adopting a specific technical method, the processed target observation data are subjected to rapid cycle assimilation processing hour by hour to obtain target assimilation analysis data, a localization numerical forecasting mode is simulated and operated by utilizing the target data after the scale reduction, the target assimilation analysis data and the localization data to generate weather disaster numerical forecasting results with different scale requirements, the weather disaster numerical forecasting results are corrected by utilizing lattice point fusion data with corresponding scales, and the technical problem that the forecasting accuracy of the existing weather disaster system is low is solved.

title_en: Mine coal and gas co-mining composite disaster simulation test system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine coal and gas co-mining composite disaster simulation test system and a method, wherein the geological distribution in a simulated goaf box body is more close to an actual mine goaf by changing the layout modes of each filling area, a mining roadway and drilling holes of the simulated goaf box body; the gas emission quantity of different areas is simulated by adopting a gas release air chamber provided with a plurality of sub-air chambers, so that the subsequent ventilation condition, the gas release state and the gas extraction condition are more close to an actual mine goaf; during the test, monitoring data of all comprehensive measuring points are obtained in real time through the automatic gas concentration and temperature collecting system, and the computer can finally obtain temperature distribution changes and gas concentration distribution change rules of different coal and gas co-mining working surfaces under different coal qualities, different extraction working conditions, different ventilation working conditions and whether coal spontaneous combustion occurs or not through analysis processing according to the monitoring data, so that data support is provided for follow-up research of disaster development evolution rules and improvement of prevention and treatment means efficiency.

title_en: Electric control device for oil-gas well pressure control
abstract_en: The application discloses an electric control device for oil-gas well pressure control, which is applied to the field of well control equipment, wherein an upper shell and a lower shell are additionally arranged outside the electric control device to insulate, so that fire disasters caused by sparks generated by the electric control device are effectively avoided, two insulating seals are performed at threading holes between the upper shell and the lower shell through a self-adaptive sealing ring and an expansion sealing rubber air bag, the electric control device and inflammables outside are effectively isolated, the use safety of the electric control device is effectively improved, the expansion sealing rubber air bag is inflated through an air storage seat to further expand the expansion sealing rubber air bag, the sealing effect is effectively enhanced, the electric control device is suitable for conducting wires with different thicknesses, in addition, a third insulating seal is additionally arranged through an insulating ring, the safety is further effectively improved, the fire disasters caused by electric leakage and faults of the electric control device are effectively prevented, the insulating seal of the electric control device is realized, the safety in use is effectively improved, and the electric control device is effectively expanded to be used in the well drilling of fine pressure control.
assignees: CHENGDU YUHE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mining area mining overlying strata roof water inrush composite disaster risk partition prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining area mining overlying strata roof water inrush composite disaster risk partition prediction method, which comprises the following steps: collecting stratum data of a mining area/working face, establishing a mining overburden engineering geological model, and identifying a water bursting separation layer zone of mining overburden of the mining area/working face; determining influence factors influencing occurrence of strong ore pressure-carrying silt separation layer water burst, and constructing a comprehensive prediction mathematical model of strong ore pressure-carrying silt separation layer water burst risk; substituting statistical results of all drilling factors distributed on a mining area/working face into a constructed strong mine pressure-mud carrying sand separation layer water bursting risk comprehensive prediction mathematical model, calculating separation layer water bursting risk level comprehensive evaluation indexes of all drilling holes, and carrying out risk partition prediction on the mining area/working face. The method can be used for predicting the roof separation layer water inrush risk in a partitioning-grading-classifying manner, and can solve the problems that the separation layer water inrush risk of a mining area before mining is not clear and the composite disaster combination type is difficult to predict.

title_en: Fire extinguishing efficiency detection system of fire extinguishing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire extinguishing efficiency detection, in particular to a fire extinguishing efficiency detection system of a fire extinguishing apparatus, which comprises a fire disaster simulation device and a fire extinguisher operation device horizontally arranged with the fire disaster simulation device, wherein the fire disaster simulation device comprises a rectangular frame body, the rectangular frame body is divided into a simulation cavity by a partition plate, a lifting adjusting mechanism is arranged at the bottom in the simulation cavity, and a fire box is arranged at the upper end of the lifting adjusting mechanism. The height of the fire box can be adjusted through the lifting adjusting mechanism, so that the height of the fire box can be adjusted according to the specification of the fire extinguisher to be detected, and the adjustable fire extinguisher positioning mechanism can be adjusted according to the specification of the fire extinguisher to be detected, and is suitable for detecting fire extinguishers with different specifications; the fire extinguisher fixing mechanism is used for clamping and fixing the fire extinguisher and keeping the stability of the fire extinguisher in the detection process; the fire extinguisher opening mechanism can automatically open the fire extinguisher.
assignees: ANHUI HONGQIANG GENERAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine safety disaster prediction model training method, early warning method and early warning system
abstract_en: The application relates to a coal mine safety disaster prediction model training method, an early warning method and an early warning system. According to the method, the cauchy mutation operator is introduced into the ant lion algorithm, and the local searching capability and the global searching capability of the ant lion algorithm are combined, so that the faster convergence speed and the higher searching precision are realized. Meanwhile, the Cauchy mutation operator is introduced to carry out self-adaption on different search spaces and search targets on the algorithm; the algorithm can balance between global exploration ability and convergence speed. Meanwhile, the algorithm can be effectively prevented from falling into a local optimal solution, and has strong robustness. The ant lion algorithm based on the cauchy variation has strong adaptability and robustness when processing the high-dimensionality problem and the nonlinearity problem.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGKUANG ANHUA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion tunnel disaster risk intelligent identification method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for intelligently identifying tunnel disaster risks by multi-modal data fusion and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of data transmission, and the method comprises the steps of converting multi-modal sensor data into the same numerical interval, establishing an end-to-end multi-modal sensor data fusion and tunnel disaster risk intelligent identification artificial neural network model, completing processing, fusion and tunnel disaster risk intelligent identification of the multi-modal data in a neural network architecture, inputting the obtained data into the established multi-modal sensor data fusion and tunnel disaster risk intelligent identification artificial neural network model, searching redundant parameters in parameters of the multi-modal sensor data fusion and tunnel disaster risk intelligent identification artificial neural network model, learning connectivity through normal network training, trimming small-weight connection, removing redundant and unimportant parameters, and obtaining a lightweight tunnel disaster and risk identification depth model; the intelligent identification of the tunnel universe multi-disaster risk can be realized.

title_en: Landslide identification method and device based on generation of countermeasure network data expansion strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide identification method and device based on generation of an countermeasure network data expansion strategy, comprising the following steps: acquiring a multi-source data set, preprocessing, extracting landslide disaster factors, preprocessing the landslide disaster factors, and constructing a landslide sample library after landslide label making; after carrying out layer superposition on the preprocessed landslide disaster factor and landslide label, preparing one-dimensional array data through an image cube, and dividing the one-dimensional array data into a training set and a testing set; inputting landslide data in a training set into a network in batches for training, completing the expansion of a few types of samples, and adding the expanded samples into an original training set to form a balance data set; and inputting the balance data set into a rear-end machine learning classification model for training, and testing the test set by using an optimal model generated by training to obtain a landslide prediction result. The invention solves the problem of unbalance among classes in the data set, can make the landslide identification boundary clearer and more complete, and improves the landslide target identification precision.

title_en: Mine hydrologic three-dimensional remote monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine hydrologic three-dimensional remote monitoring system and a method, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data transmission module, a data check module and a server, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring hydrological data, drainage ditch flow data, water level data and water burst point osmotic pressure data, the data check module is used for checking and screening the acquired data, and the server is used for analyzing the checked and screened data; the output end of the data acquisition module is connected with the input end of the data checking module through the data transmission module, and the output end of the data checking module is connected with the server in a wireless way; the automatic monitoring of the drilling water level, the roadway water inflow, the surface water interception ditch and the roadway drainage ditch flow is realized, the dynamic change of surface water and underground water and the relation between the surface water and atmospheric precipitation can be mastered according to the monitoring result, and the geological disasters caused by the severe change of hydrogeological conditions are reduced to the greatest extent.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH;YUNNAN DIQING NONFERROUS METALS CO LTD

title_en: Distribution equipment waterlogging inundation risk area grading method considering micro-topography influence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster assessment, in particular to a distribution equipment rain and waterlogging inundation risk area grading method considering micro-topography influence, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing an extremum distribution model according to historical rainfall data of a research area, and calculating and determining the first-meeting extremum rainfall of 10-50 years by using the extremum distribution model; s2: collecting geographic information data of a research area, and performing filling, conversion and other treatments on the geographic information data; s3: combining the extreme value rainfall of 10-50 years and the DEM elevation data of the region, and adopting a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model to carry out rain and waterlogging inundation simulation; s4: and (4) carrying out regional risk classification according to the property of the power distribution equipment by combining GIS software with the urban electronic street map. According to the distribution equipment rain and waterlogging inundation risk area classification method considering the micro-topography influence, the disaster management level of a power grid company is improved, and the disaster influence of the rain and waterlogging on the distribution equipment is reduced to the greatest extent.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Simulation fire extinguishing experience device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of simulated fire extinguishment, in particular to a simulated fire extinguishment experience device, which comprises a device main body and a lamp base, wherein a ventilation grating is arranged on the left side of the device main body, a placement box is arranged on the left side of the ventilation grating, a heat radiation opening is reserved on the outer wall of the placement box, a box door is arranged on the left side of the heat radiation opening, a handle is arranged on the outer wall of the box door, a gravity sensor is arranged in the device main body, a shell is arranged above the gravity sensor, the lamp base is arranged in the shell, a red bulb is arranged at the top of the lamp base, and a cable base is arranged at the bottom of the device main body; according to the utility model, the smoke-surrounding atmosphere can be created when a fire disaster occurs, the simulation effect of the device is improved, the environment-friendly effect is achieved, the red light bulb emits red light to simulate the burning fire source in the fire disaster, and experimenters take the fire extinguisher to extinguish the fire in the red light area, so that the process of extinguishing the flame by the fire extinguisher is simulated.
assignees: XIAN XINYUANLIAN SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Soil liquefaction disaster simulation demonstration structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soil liquefaction disaster simulation demonstration structure, which belongs to the technical field of soil liquefaction demonstration, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising a box body, wherein both sides of the box body are fixedly connected with fixing plates, a water injection mechanism is arranged in the box body, a lifting handle is arranged at the top of the box body, and glass is inlaid in the box body; the water injection mechanism comprises a fixed pipe, a plurality of drain holes and a water injection pipe, wherein the bottom of the fixed pipe is fixedly connected with the bottom of the inner wall of the box body, the drain holes are formed in the fixed pipe, the bottom of the water injection pipe is fixedly communicated with the top of the fixed pipe, and the problems that the use effect is affected due to the fact that most of the existing soil liquefaction demonstration methods are that soil is placed in a container and then water is injected into the container manually, the water injection method cannot evenly inject water into the soil, the demonstration of soil liquefaction is affected, and the sedimentation process after soil liquefaction is inconvenient to observe are solved.

title_en: Face information acquisition device and drilling jumbo
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a face information acquisition device and a rock drilling trolley, wherein the information acquisition device is arranged on the rock drilling trolley, the working states of a camera, a temperature measuring device and an intelligent cloud platform are controlled by a vehicle-mounted computer, so that the combination of the information acquisition device and construction equipment is realized, the face temperature distribution and the face image can be acquired at any time in the construction process, the shooting angle and the scanning angle are regulated by controlling the rotation angle of the intelligent cloud platform so as to achieve the optimal shooting view angle and the optimal scanning angle, a temperature cloud image is visually generated on the vehicle-mounted computer and image recognition analysis is carried out, the face temperature distribution condition is visually checked, the information such as the joint and the shape of the face is acquired based on the image recognition analysis result, and data support is provided for subsequent construction, so that geological disasters can be avoided in advance. Moreover, the collection personnel only need to operate the vehicle-mounted computer on the drilling trolley, so that personnel danger is avoided, and construction efficiency and safety are improved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CONSTR HEAVY IND CORP LTD

title_en: Flood forecasting method and system coupling artificial intelligence and Bayesian theory
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of runoff prediction, and particularly discloses a flood forecasting method and a system coupled with artificial intelligence and Bayesian theory, wherein the flood forecasting method comprises the following steps: calculating correlation coefficients between the alternative precipitation influence factors and precipitation amount respectively, and obtaining final precipitation influence factors through principal component analysis; inputting final precipitation influence factors into Bayesian-NHMM models with different precipitation states to carry out precipitation forecast, and determining an optimal precipitation forecast model; taking the influence of climate change and underlying surface change on runoff into consideration, and constructing a training sample based on a rainfall value predicted by an optimal rainfall prediction model; and training the machine learning model through the training sample to obtain a runoff forecasting model, so as to realize flood forecasting. The invention combines the advantages of a mathematical statistical model and a machine learning method, fully considers the evolution process of the basin yield convergence mechanism under the changing environment, and can provide an important reference basis with strong operability for flood control and disaster reduction in the flood area.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Rainfall landslide risk early warning threshold system establishment method based on geological environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a rainfall landslide risk early warning threshold system establishment method based on a geological environment, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a threshold model as follows:  The method comprises the steps of S2, analyzing rainfall threshold values inducing landslide disasters by adopting a rainfall threshold model to determine an area slope reference threshold value R  S , S3, selecting slope geological environment factors playing a control role in an area according to a slope deformation damage mechanism, S4, describing a reference slope of the whole area according to the selected slope geological environment factors, S5, determining slope stability changes caused by each slope geological environment factor of the reference slope under different rainfall conditions by adopting a numerical simulation method, and obtaining threshold value adjustment change quantity delta R  i  caused by each slope geological environment factor with different duration, thereby establishing a threshold value system. The early warning method has the beneficial effects that the influence of each geological environment factor on the slope stability in the rainfall infiltration process is considered, and the early warning accuracy is improved by a threshold system based on a disaster recovery mechanism.

title_en: Typhoon destructive power prediction method and prediction device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for predicting the destructive power of typhoons, which relate to the technical field of weather forecast, and comprise the following steps: determining gust coefficients of typhoons at different height layers; performing gridding operation on the area to be predicted to obtain a plurality of corresponding grids; acquiring a first shear definition rule of wind speed/wind direction in space for each grid, and acquiring a second shear definition rule of wind speed/wind direction in time for each grid; performing typhoon simulation operation to obtain simulated typhoons; obtaining terrain information of an area to be predicted, and performing disaster-causing parameter analysis on the simulated typhoons based on the terrain information, the first shear definition rule and the second shear definition rule to obtain disaster-causing parameter values; and generating a damage prediction result of typhoons based on the disaster causing parameter values. By quantitatively analyzing and accurately predicting the destructive power of typhoons, data support is provided for the safety operation of enterprises, the operation safety of the enterprises is improved, and the actual requirements are met.
assignees: BEIJING JIUTIAN METEOROLOGY TECH CO LTD;CGN BEIJING NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Small sample malicious flow classification increment learning method and system based on dynamic retraining
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of large data network flow detection, in particular to a small sample malicious flow classification increment learning method and system based on dynamic retraining, and a malicious flow classification model is constructed based on an end-to-end full convolution neural network; training a malicious flow classification model by utilizing the collected data set to obtain an initial network; freezing preset shallow network parameters of low-level input features extracted from an initial network, and performing fine adjustment on other network parameters in the initial network by utilizing a small sample malicious flow data set of a known label to obtain a basic network; and calculating the number of required neurons according to the sample similarity, screening out a redundant network structure, and training and adjusting the redundant network structure to obtain the malicious traffic classification incremental network. The invention can reduce the forgetting of old disasters in model training, relieve the pressure of training huge parameters by small sample data, improve the classification performance of the model, and reduce the consumption of computing resources to the greatest extent while maintaining the performance of the classifier.

title_en: Multi-dimensional transformer substation disaster resistance dynamic quantitative evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid disaster resistance evaluation, and particularly relates to a dynamic quantitative evaluation method for the disaster resistance of a multi-dimensional transformer substation, which comprehensively considers the completeness of an emergency plan of a transformer substation operation and maintenance unit (whether the complete refers to whether the plan covers all meteorological disasters and emergencies or not, whether the complete refers to the definite organization part constitution, responsibility division, early warning and emergency response business processes, namely the executable) in each plan, emergency team deployment, emergency vehicle allocation and emergency material library storage conditions, comprehensively evaluates the meteorological disaster resistance of a heavy station line through real field evaluation and actual combat exercise means, quantifies various abstract concepts, visually reflects the meteorological disaster resistance of the important transformer substation, indicates the emergency capacity lifting direction to the transformer substation operation and maintenance unit, and practically improves the unit meteorological disaster resistance of all levels of the whole province.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent safety monitoring system for port operation
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent security monitoring system for port operation, wherein a mobile terminal is used for carrying out login management according to input information of a user, controlling the operation process of the user and carrying out training and knowledge assessment on the user; the WEB background management end is used for carrying out intelligent identification and analysis according to the monitoring video image so as to realize the identification, snapshot, comparison and alarm service of the port traffic behavior, and summarizing and displaying according to the analysis result; the WEB background management end is also used for carrying out early warning and reminding according to the environmental information and a preset threshold value and carrying out fire disaster early warning according to the monitoring video image; the WEB background management end is also used for constructing a harbor personnel information archive of the user, managing hidden danger reported by the user and checking the user. The application can improve the effect of safety supervision, strengthen personnel management and training and build a better safety production environment.

title_en: Large-area gas treatment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-area gas control method, and belongs to the technical field of gas control. The method comprises the following steps: s1, directional drilling: preprocessing gas extraction is carried out on the top plate high-position trend large-diameter long-drilled holes based on directional drilling; s2, drilling at the ground: the ground drilling is carried out, a ground extraction pump room is adopted to start negative pressure extraction along with coal mining propulsion of a working face, a goaf is formed after coal mining, and extraction is continued through drilling; s3, sectional hydraulic fracturing; s4, deep hole sampling; s5, detecting along with drilling. According to the invention, a large-area gas treatment method is carried out on the basis of technologies of directional drilling, ground drilling, staged hydraulic fracturing, deep hole sampling and detection while drilling, so that a coal mine gas large-area treatment technical system based on large-area advanced geological exploration while drilling and prediction technology and high-reliability large-area ground and underground gas extraction technology is formed, and advanced, accurate and reliable large-area gas disaster prevention and control technology and equipment guarantee are provided for intelligent exploitation.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for simulating two-dimensional composite event of hydrological disaster
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for simulating a two-dimensional composite event of a hydrological disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring time sequence data of two variables in a two-dimensional composite event of a hydrological disaster; quantifying the time-varying time series data of each variable and the variation trend between the time-varying time series data of each variable; constructing a consistency and non-consistency calculation method based on the trend quantification result, and determining a best fit distribution function; checking the time-varying property of each variable time-series data and the correlation between the time-varying property and the time-varying property; describing an optimal Copula function of the correlation between the two variable time series data based on the correlation test result; constructing a joint probability distribution function of two variables based on the best fit distribution function and the best Copula function; and determining the reproduction period of the two-dimensional composite event of the hydrological disaster based on the quantile of the joint override probability of the joint probability distribution function. The application can accurately simulate complex composite events under climate change.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Construction method for development period and disaster history of large debris flow accumulation fan
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a development period and a catastrophe history of a large debris flow stacking fan, which comprises the steps of 1, dividing a debris flow deposition structure and a period unit in the field; step 2, geophysical prospecting analysis of mud-rock flow thickness fanning and boulder distribution; step 3, completing transverse and longitudinal profile layout sampling of the debris flow fan based on the steps 1 and 2; step 4, based on the collected information, completing year analysis and age constraint; step 5, according to the test analysis result of the step 4, establishing the development period and the chronology sequence of the debris flow fan; step 6, completing the evolution process of the debris flow fan and the construction of the catastrophe history based on the steps; the method can complete the year measurement of the top of the stacking fan and the soil accumulation system of the upper slope of the stacking fan and the year measurement of the bottom of the stacking fan and the river and lake sand layer system of the stacking fan; through the numerical simulation of the debris flow, the development period of the debris flow with long time scale can be rebuilt, the defect of short-term observation disaster data is overcome, and the actual requirements of the history reconstruction of the significant debris flow fan and disaster prevention and reduction engineering are met.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Multifunctional detection system utilizing ocean internal waves and working method
abstract_en: The application provides a multifunctional detection system utilizing ocean internal waves and a working method thereof. The application skillfully utilizes natural disasters such as ocean internal waves, changes the security into security, designs a buoy and an ultra-low power consumption multifunctional detector, can continuously advance by utilizing the internal waves, can convert the internal wave energy into electric energy, then releases the electric energy to form a magnetic field to act on the multifunctional detector, and can realize sustainable navigation with large underwater depth, long distance, low carbon and low energy consumption by matching the buoy with the multifunctional detector. The multifunctional detector is provided with various devices, and can monitor, collect and transmit marine environment information in real time. According to the technical scheme, the multifunctional detection system utilizes internal waves, so that the forward motion of the tiger whale is simulated, the forward motion with low energy consumption is realized, the buoy converts the kinetic energy of the internal waves into electric energy, and the environment-friendly navigation with ultra-low energy consumption is realized through the electromagnetic interaction of the buoy and the multifunctional detector; the multifunctional detector integrates various marine detection devices, and can collect various information of marine environments.

title_en: Development method of solid sylvite ore
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for developing solid potash salt ores, which comprises the following steps: step 1, carrying out surface runoff diversion in a defined mining area, and leading out surface runoffs in the mining area from a source to an area far away from a sylvite mining area; step 2, performing geophysical exploration after the surface runoff in the step 1 is redirected to form a new river channel, determining an underground water enrichment area, arranging hydrologic holes according to specifications, and determining various parameters of underground water; step 3, drilling holes at the edge of the mining area according to the parameters of the underground water obtained in the step 2 to determine stratum distribution; and 4, sealing various drilling holes of the mining area in the mining area according to the specification, arranging grouting holes according to the water distribution condition of hydrologic holes, and grouting. The invention eliminates solid potassium salt mine water from the source, and greatly reduces geological disaster risks such as underground water leakage, collapse of roof of the ore bed and the like.

title_en: Training device for fire-fighting training
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting training, and discloses a training device for fire-fighting training, which comprises a frame, a square box and a storage table; the frame top is welded perpendicularly with the sleeve, sleeve and frame welded fastening, the welding has the bracket in the middle of the frame inboard, sleeve and bracket's quantity is three group, and three group sleeve and bracket evenly distributed are in frame top and inboard, the bracket is installed under the sleeve, and each group the bracket and sleeve one-to-one. According to the technical scheme, the hydraulic clamp can be used and trained by a firefighter conveniently, the hydraulic clamp can automatically fall to realize feeding after shearing of the steel bars, manual replacement or movement is not needed, time is saved, training efficiency is improved, the square box can facilitate collection of steel bar segments, and the hydraulic clamp can be used and trained by putting fuel into ignition, so that functions of the hydraulic clamp are more diversified.
assignees: ANHUI YUANQUANHUI FIRE FIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Demonstration device for defending and inundating storm disaster for science popularization
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geological disaster simulation, and particularly relates to a device for demonstrating defense and inundation of a heavy rain disaster for science popularization. The demonstration box comprises a demonstration box body and a simulation cover covered on the demonstration box body, wherein an inclined soil body structure is arranged in the demonstration box body, a simulated river is arranged on the soil body structure, and a defense dam is arranged on the simulated river. The simulation cover is characterized in that a cavity is formed in the simulation cover, micropores are formed in the inner bottom surface of the cavity, a water inlet pipe is arranged on the upper end surface of the simulation cover, and a valve is arranged on the water inlet pipe. The utility model can overcome the defects of the prior art, simulate the time and degree of flood prevention of storm disasters with different precipitation through arranging the simulation cover, and regulate the water flow of rivers under the storm disasters through arranging the prevention dam so as to achieve the control of river levee prevention.

title_en: Coal seam drilling gas extraction simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of simulation test equipment, in particular to a coal seam drilling gas extraction simulation test device, which comprises a support, wherein a simulation test box is installed at the top of the support, connecting shells are fixedly installed at two sides of the simulation test box, a beating vibration mechanism is arranged in the connecting shells and comprises a T-shaped limiting rod, a pushing plate, a compression spring, a cross rod and a beating ball, the T-shaped limiting rod is fixedly installed on the inner wall of the connecting shells, the pushing plate is slidably sleeved on the T-shaped limiting rod, one end of the compression spring is fixedly installed on the pushing plate, the other end of the compression spring is fixedly installed on the inner wall of the connecting shells, and the cross rod is fixedly installed on the pushing plate. The utility model has reasonable design, and can simulate the test of drilling gas extraction by earthquake disasters through continuously beating the simulation test box by the beating ball, thereby being beneficial to improving the gas extraction efficiency and the safety coefficient.

title_en: High-rise fire extinguishing system simulation device for firefighter training
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-rise fire-fighting system simulation device for firefighter training, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting system simulation devices and aims to solve the problem that the existing simulation device for a fire-fighting system in a high-rise building is lacking when firefighters just working are trained.
assignees: LUOYANG HIGH NEW TECH INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT ZONE FIRE RESCUE BRIGADE

title_en: Life-saving exercise bionic dummy for fire-fighting training
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifesaving drilling bionic dummy for fire training, which has the technical scheme that: the device comprises four limbs, a trunk and a head, wherein the upper end of the trunk is rotationally connected with the lower end of a rotating rod, a rotating cavity is formed in the lower end of the head, a rotating ball is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the rotating rod, and the rotating ball is rotationally arranged in the rotating cavity; the head comprises an upper head and a lower head in threaded connection with the upper head; the rotating cavity is arranged in the area between the upper head and the lower head; a plurality of first arc-shaped bulges are arranged on the inner wall of the rotating cavity, and a plurality of second arc-shaped bulges are arranged on the outer wall of the rotating ball; the first arc-shaped protrusions and the second arc-shaped protrusions are arranged in a staggered mode; the head in the technical scheme can realize multi-angle rotation, so that firefighters can flexibly adjust the posture of the dummy head to obtain better rescue effect; meanwhile, the head can be quickly disassembled and installed while the head is rotated at multiple angles.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Transportable real fire training equipment for fire rescue of aircraft
abstract_en: The utility model discloses transportable real fire training equipment for fire rescue of an aircraft, which comprises a trailer and a fire simulation aircraft, wherein the fire simulation aircraft is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the trailer, and comprises a nose, a fuselage, a tail, wings, wing engines, tail engines, landing gear, a fuselage cabin door, a cab, a cabin seat, a cabin luggage rack, a cargo hold and a cargo hold door. Through the cooperation setting of trailer, conflagration simulation aircraft, cat ladder, truck locomotive, bracing piece and emergency door, compare in the use with the real standard equipment of fire of traditional fixed aircraft fire rescue this device can transport to the airport that needs to carry out fire control training or other units that have training demands, and the personnel of taking exercise in each place need not to concentrate to go to the training base and train, practice thrift the travel accommodation expense of taking exercise personnel, reduced the cost of training; and because the training is developed locally, airport firefighters can participate in the training collectively, and the effect of team combat training is realized.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHEN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for preventing major disaster due to building resilience collapse and method using same
title_ko: 건축물 회복탄력성 붕괴에 따른 중대재해 예방 시스템 및 이를 이용한 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, provided is a method for preventing a serious disaster due to the collapse of a building by predicting the rigidity of the building by using information including vibration data collected by a vibration sensor (120) attached to the building, the method comprising the steps of: (a) collecting, by a training information generation module (10), vibration data and the rigidity of a building; (b) training, by a vibration characteristic training module (20), a prediction model (22); (c1) when the vibration data is input into the vibration characteristic training module (20), outputting the rigidity of the building; (d) comparing the rigidity output in the step (c1) with the size of a preset risk level; (e2) if the rigidity output in the step (d1) is less than the preset risk level, comparing an accumulated amount of an impact applied to the building during a predetermined unit period with a resilience threshold value of the building; and (f2) if the accumulated amount of the impact exceeds the resilience threshold value of the building in the step (e2), providing, by an alarm provision module (40), an alarm to a building user, a neighboring building management unit, and an infrastructure management unit.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 의하면, 건물에 부착된 진동센서(120)에 의해 수집된 진동 데이터를 포함하는 정보를 이용하여 건물의 강성을 예측함으로써, 건물의 붕괴에 따른 중대재해를 예방하기 위한 방법으로, (a) 학습정보 생성모듈(10)에 의해, 진동 데이터 및 건물의 강성이 수집되는 단계; (b) 진동특성 학습모듈(20)이, 예측모델(22)을 학습하는 단계; (c1) 상기 진동특성 학습모듈(20)에 진동 데이터가 입력되면, 건물의 강성이 출력되는 단계; (d) 상기 (c1) 단계에서 출력된 강성이 기 설정된 위험수준의 크기와 비교되는 단계; (e2) 상기 (d1) 단계에서 상기 출력된 강성이 상기 기 설정된 위험수준 미만이면, 미리 결정된 단위기간 동안 상기 건물에 가해진 누적 충격량과 건물의 회복탄력 임계치가 비교되는 단계; 및 (f2) 상기 (e2) 단계에서 상기 누적 충격량이 상기 건물의 회복탄력 임계치를 초과하면, 알람제공 모듈(40)이 건물 이용객, 인접건물 관리부 및 인프라 관리부에 알람을 제공하는 단계;를 포함하는, 방법을 제공한다. title_en: Natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment, and particularly discloses a natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment system based on big data analysis. The application discloses a natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment system based on big data analysis, which comprises: a target model construction unit; a mark model generation unit; a period shooting unit; a water level identification recording unit for carrying out water level identification and recording; the point location identification recording unit is used for identifying and recording the point location; and the dynamic simulation evaluation unit is used for carrying out dynamic simulation display and carrying out disaster risk evaluation according to the display result. The method can construct a target three-dimensional model at a river dam needing important precaution, periodically shoots a plurality of evaluation points at shooting points, performs water level identification and point location identification, performs corresponding dynamic simulation display, and performs disaster risk assessment according to display results, so that the possibility of natural disasters such as flood, landslide and the like can be timely assessed, and early warning and restoration processing can be conveniently performed before the natural disasters occur.

title_en: Numerical simulation method and device for tunnel crossing active fault water and mud bursting disasters
