abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of numerical simulation, in particular to a numerical simulation method and a device for a tunnel-crossing active fault water and mud bursting disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining geometric parameters of a tunnel, constructing a three-dimensional numerical model of tunnel crossing active faults through a preset finite difference numerical simulation method and a preset particle discrete element numerical simulation method, applying boundary conditions to set initial stress states, and simulating a tunnel crossing active fault water-break and mud-break disaster to obtain a numerical simulation result. According to the embodiment of the application, a three-dimensional numerical model of tunnel crossing living fault can be established, the whole process of tunnel crossing living fault water and mud bursting disasters under the actions of seismic waves with different intensities, different frequencies and different directions can be obtained by carrying out mechanical behavior simulation and fluid-solid coupling simulation of tunnel surrounding rock, the stress and displacement change characteristics of the tunnel surrounding rock are defined, the crack initiation-expansion-through evolution rules in the process of breaking the waterproof rock are displayed, and the accuracy of tunnel disaster simulation is improved.

title_en: Real fire simulation training system and simulation training method for large-span industrial factory building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real fire simulation training system for a large-span industrial factory building, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a large-span industrial factory building, various simulation training facilities, a control system and a matched system in the large-span industrial factory building; the multiple types of simulated training facilities include: the device comprises a combustion simulation module, a smoke simulation module, an auxiliary simulation module and a special effect simulation module; the auxiliary simulation module comprises a falling object simulation sub-module, a deformation simulation sub-module, an obstacle simulation sub-module, a dangerous object simulation sub-module, a trap simulation sub-module, an electric leakage simulation sub-module and a gesture detection device, wherein fire protection measures are adopted for steel beams, steel columns, roofs and partial outer walls in the large-span industrial factory building; the real fire simulation training method for the large-span industrial factory building comprises the step of training in real fire simulation training stages, including reconnaissance training, search and rescue training, cooling training, fire extinguishing training, smoke discharging training, material evacuation training and emergency escape training.

title_en: Strong convection characteristic classification recognition method, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a strong convection characteristic classification and identification method, electronic equipment and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring sample data; carrying out storm identification by adopting a three-dimensional storm body identification technology based on digital identification; after storm identification is completed, storm attributes are extracted, sample data are subjected to equalization and normalization processing, and machine learning training is carried out, so that a machine learning model is obtained; building a fuzzy logic algorithm of short-time strong precipitation and thunderstorm strong wind according to storm attributes; identifying strong weather probability according to the machine learning model and the fuzzy logic algorithm respectively; and fusing the machine learning model with the strong weather probability identified by the fuzzy logic algorithm according to the weight to obtain the final strong weather probability. The application extracts characteristic parameters of short-time strong precipitation and convection strong wind based on machine learning and fuzzy logic algorithm, constructs a fusion algorithm suitable for the short-time strong precipitation and convection strong wind in south China and an intelligent recognition model of two types of storms, and provides technical support for improving early warning and forecasting level of the disaster weather in south China.

title_en: Small sample class increment recognition method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a small sample class increment identification method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: downloading a small sample class increment learning data set; designing a small sample increment classification recognition network based on reinforcement learning; training the network by utilizing training data to obtain a training network; generating a small sample class incremental learning model according to the training network; and carrying out small sample increment classification and identification by adopting the small sample increment learning model. The method solves the problem that the prior art cannot alleviate the disaster forgetting of small sample increment learning caused by the fact that a new class classifier learning strategy is not adaptively explored.
assignees: SEETATECH BEIJING TECH CO LTD;ZHONGKE SHENSHI HANGZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation simulation system and method for fire safety management
title_ko: 소방안전관리를 위한 피난 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation simulation system for fire safety management and a method therefor, which make it possible to derive scenarios close to actual situations so as to improve the reliability of field applicability and maintenance in the field of fire safety and design. The system comprises: a geometry construction unit which recognizes lines and polygons by performing geometry drawing and drawing loading, creates nodes in a movable space, and assigns potential to each node so as to construct geometry; an agent setting unit which sets agent properties, edits the agent properties, sets a walking speed for each agent group, and places the agents; and a behavior setting unit which initiates agent movement, checks properties of a current node (Node_(i,j)) and properties of an adjacent node (Node_(n)), selects a node to be moved, and performs movement between nodes so as to support agent evacuation to an evacuation completion point.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실제 상황과 가까운 시나리오 도출이 가능하도록 하여 소방안전 및 설계분야에서의 현장 적용성 및 유지관리의 신뢰도를 향상시킬 수 있도록 한 소방안전관리를 위한 피난 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 지오메트리(Geometry) 그리기 및 도면 불러오기를 하여 선(line) 및 다각형(polygon) 인식을 하고, 이동가능한 공간에 노드 생성을 하고 노드마다 포텐셜(Potential) 부여를 하여 지오메트리 구축을 하는 지오메트리 구축부;에이전트 속성 설정 및 에이전트 속성 편집을 하고, 에이전트 그룹별로 보행속력 설정을 한후에 에이전트 배치를 하는 에이전트 설정부;에이전트 이동을 시작하여 현재 노드(Node (i,j) )의 속성 확인 및 인접 노드(Node (n) ) 속성 확인을 하고, 이동할 노드를 선택하여 노드 간의 이동을 수행하여 피난 완료 지점까지 에이전트 피난을 지원하는 행동 설정부;를 포함하는 것이다.
assignees: NAT UNIV PUKYONG IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Karst collapse column water bursting disaster simulation device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a karst collapse column water bursting disaster simulation device and a method, comprising a supporting box body and a control mechanism, wherein an experiment main body mechanism is arranged on the supporting box body, and a water circulation unit is arranged in the supporting box body; the experiment main body mechanism comprises an analog box with an open top, an observation window is arranged on the front side box wall of the analog box, a first partition board and a second partition board with through holes are divided into an aquifer cavity, a water-resisting layer cavity and a sand stratum cavity from bottom to top, a first collapse column cavity and a second collapse column cavity which are communicated are arranged in parallel in the analog box, a damage strip cavity is connected with the second collapse column cavity, a coal seam simulation unit is arranged at the top of the damage strip cavity, the whole device controls the coal seam simulation unit and a water circulation unit through a control mechanism, the whole process of water inrush disaster related to the collapse column in the coal seam exploitation process can be intuitively and vividly simulated, the prediction accuracy of water inrush disaster data is improved, and the disaster is predicted and early warned.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Water burst prevention test device and test method for communication channel
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device and a method for testing water burst prevention of a connecting channel, wherein the device comprises a test box, a main tunnel model, a connecting channel model, a grouting hole, a loading system, a water inlet system and a sensing system; a soil layer accommodating space is arranged in the test box; the grouting holes are respectively arranged on the main tunnel model and the communication channel model and are used for connecting a grouting system and simulating grouting control when gushing water occurs; the loading system, the water inlet system and the sensing system are all arranged on the test box, and the loading system is used for compacting soil layers in the test box and applying surrounding rock pressure; the sensing system is used for detecting water level conditions, water pressure, surrounding rock pressure, water seepage conditions of the main tunnel model and the communication channel model and a diffusion path of injected slurry in the test box. The utility model can synthesize various complex conditions such as stratum conditions, buried depth, water level, surrounding rock pressure and the like, simulate the water inrush condition of a main tunnel and a communication channel, and simulate post-disaster prevention and control of the communication channel.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;CHINA RAILWAY SHISIJU GROUP CO

title_en: Subway personnel evacuation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a subway personnel evacuation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of subway emergency treatment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an evacuation model based on the target subway station information; the crowd quantity and the personnel speed preset by adopting a random number table method are adopted, and the evacuation of personnel is simulated by utilizing a 3D simulation technology; selecting indexes such as the number of people, the speed of people, whether people escape safely or not and the like from the simulation result; the method comprises the steps of bringing a plurality of index parameters into a perceptron algorithm to obtain the relation between the speed of personnel and the number of people and whether the personnel can escape safely; and giving a preset crowd speed to the target subway station, and determining the maximum carrying number of the target subway station according to the crowd speed. According to the embodiment of the application, the evacuation process of the personnel in the actual subway station is simulated to obtain the corresponding sample parameters, and then the maximum bearing capacity of the subway station is obtained through a perceptron algorithm, so that references are provided for the actual personnel evacuation of each subway station.

title_en: Polar region ship spilled oil three-dimensional emergency drilling method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional emergency drilling method, a system and a storage medium for polar region ship oil spill, which are applied to the technical field of computer simulation, can simulate a real emergency training scene, and can evaluate the operation level of emergency personnel, thereby improving the emergency handling capacity of polar region ship oil spill accidents. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring environmental data of a preset polar region; constructing a polar three-dimensional navigation scene model according to the environmental data; the polar three-dimensional navigation scene model is used for simulating ship navigation environments in different environment states; constructing an oil spill diffusion drift model of the polar region ice region; constructing an emergency operation instruction according to a preset ship oil spill emergency response plan; the emergency operation instruction corresponds to the polar three-dimensional navigation scene model; according to the emergency operation instruction and the polar region three-dimensional navigation scene model, performing three-dimensional emergency drilling of oil spill, and acquiring drilling data through a preset sensor; and analyzing the drilling data through a preset emergency drilling scoring mechanism to obtain an emergency drilling evaluation result.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH;COSCO SHIPPING SPECIALIZED CARRIERS CO LTD

title_en: Summer asphalt pavement temperature staged prediction method based on weather
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of highway traffic weather service, in particular to a summer asphalt pavement temperature staged prediction method based on weather, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining classification schemes of different weather conditions of summer pavement temperature background; s2, determining a period of a temperature rising and cooling stage of the asphalt pavement in summer and a time inflection point, and dividing the temperature change of the asphalt pavement into a temperature rising section and a temperature cooling section; s3, respectively establishing a temperature prediction model of the asphalt pavement in the heating and cooling stages under the conditions of sunny days, rainy days and cloudy days based on the air temperature in a simulation mode; s4, determining an optimal prediction model through inspection and comparison; s5, outputting the asphalt pavement temperature prediction service product in the heating and cooling stages under the conditions of sunny days, rainy days and cloudy days in summer. The method of the application meets the requirements of disaster prevention and reduction and decision service of transportation, public security traffic management and road administration maintenance departments, so as to provide technical support and decision reference for related units, and simultaneously is beneficial to optimizing and improving the efficiency and safety of transportation.

title_en: Urban storm waterlogging rapid simulation method based on deep convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city rainstorm waterlogging rapid simulation method based on a deep convolutional neural network. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a city rainstorm waterlogging model; constructing various input characteristics of rainstorm and waterlogging, and simulating and generating a rainstorm and waterlogging inundation database; dividing a rainstorm waterlogging inundation database into a training set and a testing set; constructing a convolutional neural network model, and training the convolutional neural network model by utilizing the training set data of the storm waterlogging database; based on the input conditions of the storm sequence of the test set, the rapid and real-time simulation of the submerged space-time variation of the storm waterlogging is realized through the constructed convolutional neural network model. The method can effectively improve the efficiency and the precision of rainstorm waterlogging simulation in the area with high waterlogging disasters.

title_en: High-voltage line anti-fishing monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-voltage line anti-fishing monitoring and early warning device, which aims to solve the technical problem of poor warning effect of the existing fishing monitoring and early warning system, and adopts the technical scheme that: the invention relates to a high-voltage line anti-fishing monitoring and early warning device, which is characterized in that a protective box is made of a transparent acrylic plate and is provided with a high-voltage electric disaster simulation device in an inner compartment on the basis of the existing high-voltage line anti-fishing monitoring and early warning device.

title_en: Fire-fighting cabinet glass breakage detection method, device, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting cabinet glass breakage detection method, which comprises the following steps: controlling the patrol robot to move, and collecting a first firefighting cabinet image in real time in the moving process; detecting the fire control cabinet of the first fire control cabinet image to obtain fire control cabinet information; adjusting the position of the patrol robot according to the fire-fighting cabinet information, then opening a rectangular light source to irradiate the fire-fighting cabinet, and collecting a second fire-fighting cabinet image; semantic segmentation is carried out on the second fire-fighting cabinet image, and reflective area information is obtained; judging whether the fire-fighting cabinet glass is damaged according to the reflective area information, and generating damage information. The invention effectively improves the efficiency and accuracy of detecting the glass breakage of the fire-fighting cabinet, reduces the data quantity and the data acquisition and marking difficulty of model training, and greatly compresses the cost.

title_en: GNSS-R-based marine target positioning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for locating an offshore target based on GNSS-R, which belong to the technical field of remote sensing and comprise the following steps: collecting a plurality of global navigation satellite system observation data of a target area, and extracting a delay-Doppler frequency shift map; performing stability test and training of a preset neural network model on the delay-Doppler frequency shift map to obtain a predicted sea clutter delay-Doppler frequency shift map; subtracting the predicted sea clutter delay-doppler shift map from the target delay-doppler shift map to be predicted to obtain a sea clutter elimination delay-doppler shift map; screening an initial target position, and converting the initial target position into a space position based on a unified coordinate system; and calculating the conversion space position by utilizing geometric semantic constraint to obtain the offshore target position. The invention carries out long-time continuous monitoring on the marine target in the specific area through satellite reflection signals, can quickly locate the accurate position of the marine target in real time, and has important significance for guaranteeing marine shipping safety, preventing marine disasters, carrying out marine rescue and the like.

title_en: Fire simulation experiment platform and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire control, and provides a fire simulation experiment platform and application thereof, wherein the fire simulation experiment platform comprises a control cabin and a combustion cabin; the combustion chamber is used for simulating material combustion in a fire disaster, and the control chamber is used for controlling the combustion environment; the combustion chamber is provided with a combustion chamber air inlet at the bottom and a combustion chamber air outlet at the top, and a combustion atmosphere circulating along the longitudinal direction is formed between the combustion chamber air inlet and the combustion chamber air outlet; a material combustion table is arranged in the combustion chamber, is positioned at the upper part of the air inlet of the combustion chamber, and is positioned at the lower part of the air outlet of the combustion chamber; the control cabin is communicated with the combustion cabin through an air pipe at the air inlet of the combustion cabin; the control cabin provides the material on the material combustion table with a combustion atmosphere circulating in the longitudinal direction via the air duct. The air inlet and the air outlet of the combustion chamber are arranged in the vertical direction, so that the air flow of a fire experiment is prevented from being directly blown onto a combustion sample, and the reality of the simulation result of the fire experiment is affected.
assignees: SICHUAN FIRE RES INST MEM;SICHUAN FARUI TESTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Damage prediction simulation apparatus and method for environmental facility
title_ko: 환경 시설에 대한 피해예측 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device and a method for simulating damage prediction to environmental facilities. The method for simulating damage prediction to environmental facilities according to an embodiment of the present application comprises the steps of: (a) obtaining facility information, including information on structural members of the environmental facilities and information on major processes; (b) evaluating member importance for each of the structural members and setting a first weight for each structural member based on the member importance; (c) evaluating process importance of each of the major processes and setting a second weight for each of the main processes based on the process importance; and (d) deriving predicted damage information according to the virtual disaster situation based on at least one of disaster information associated with a virtual disaster situation for the environmental facility, the facility information, the first weight, and the second weight.
abstract_ko: 환경 시설에 대한 피해예측 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 환경 시설에 대한 피해예측 시뮬레이션 방법은, (a) 환경 시설의 구조 부재에 대한 정보 및 주요 공정에 대한 정보를 포함하는 시설 정보를 획득하는 단계, (b) 상기 구조 부재 각각에 대한 부재 중요도를 평가하고, 상기 부재 중요도에 기초하여 상기 구조 부재 각각에 대한 제1가중치를 설정하는 단계, (c) 상기 주요 공정 각각에 대한 공정 중요도를 평가하고, 상기 공정 중요도에 기초하여 상기 주요 공정 각각에 대한 제2가중치를 설정하는 단계 및 (d) 상기 환경 시설에 대한 가상 재난 상황과 연계된 재난 정보, 상기 시설 정보, 상기 제1가중치 및 상기 제2가중치 중 적어도 하나에 기초하여 상기 가상 재난 상황에 따른 예측 피해 정보를 도출하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Complex disaster scenario analysis apparatus and method
title_ko: 지진 및 침수를 포함하는 복합재난 시나리오 분석 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and method for analyzing complex disasters including earthquakes and flooding, which may perform damage prediction for complex disasters including earthquakes and flooding. The method for analyzing complex disasters according to one embodiment of the present invention may comprise: a step (a) of deriving earthquake damage prediction information based on a first weight value pre-set based on earthquake disaster information, facility information of an environmental facility, and the importance of each member of structural members of the environmental facility; a step (b) of deriving flooding damage prediction information based on a second weight value pre-set based on flooding disaster information, the facility information, the earthquake damage prediction information, and process importance of each of main processes of the environmental facility; and a step (c) of deriving a scenario for a simulation for complex disasters including earthquakes and flooding based on the earthquake damage prediction information and the flooding damage prediction information.
abstract_ko: 지진 및 침수를 포함하는 복합재난 시나리오 분석 장치 및 방법이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 복합재난 시나리오 분석 방법은, (a) 지진 재난 정보, 환경 시설의 시설 정보 및 상기 환경 시설의 구조 부재 각각의 부재 중요도를 기초로 미리 설정되는 제1가중치에 기초하여 지진 피해 예측 정보를 도출하는 단계, (b) 침수 재난 정보, 상기 시설 정보, 상기 지진 피해 예측 정보 및 상기 환경 시설의 주요 공정 각각의 공정 중요도를 기초로 미리 설정되는 제2가중치에 기초하여 침수 피해 예측 정보를 도출하는 단계 및 (c) 상기 지진 피해 예측 정보 및 상기 침수 피해 예측 정보에 기초하여 지진 및 침수를 포함하는 복합재난에 대한 시뮬레이션을 위한 시나리오를 도출하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Serious game production system for disaster response education and training
title_ko: 재난대응 교육훈련을 위한 시리어스게임 제작시스템
abstract_en: A serious game production system for the disaster response education and training comprises: a plurality of staff clients with a training application which provides an interface for respectively and successively inputting the response task of each case of each staff in a department in charge in accordance with the disaster type and the collaboration, and virtually processes the response task in accordance with the input; a server automatically listing serial incidents developing in accordance with the flow of time when a disaster occurs, and providing the plurality of staff clients with game environmental data fitting the damage scale of the whole disaster and the difficulty; and a scenario generation device generating game environmental data through a level design sheet manufacturing tool which generates a level design sheet of a standardized form in manufacturing a script connecting the in-game data in accordance with the scenario. Therefore, physical interactive training can be conducted.
abstract_ko: 재난대응 교육훈련을 위한 시리어스게임 제작시스템은 재난유형과 협업에 따른 담당부서 각 담당자의 사건별 대응업무를 각각 순차적으로 입력할 수 있는 인터페이스를 제공하고 입력에 따른 대응업무를 가상적으로 처리하는 훈련 애플리케이션이 설치되는 복수의 담당자 클라이언트와, 재난 발생시 시간의 흐름에 따라 전개되는 연쇄 사건들을 자동으로 나열하고 전체적인 재난의 피해 규모와 난이도에 맞는 게임환경 데이터를 복수의 담당자 클라이언트에 제공하는 서버와, 시나리오에 따라 게임 내 데이터를 연결하는 스크립트를 제작함에 있어서, 규격화된 양식의 레벨 디자인 시트를 생성하는 레벨디자인 시트 제작 툴을 통해 게임환경 데이터를 생성하는 시나리오 생성장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Comprehensive experiment table for mine goaf thermodynamic disasters and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine goaf thermodynamic disaster comprehensive experiment table and a working method thereof, wherein the comprehensive experiment table comprises a simulated coal face, a simulated goaf box body, a simulated ventilation system, a gas release system, a gas concentration automatic acquisition system, a temperature measurement system and a data processing system; the simulated ventilation system, the gas release system and different types of coal are placed into the simulated fire area for coal spontaneous combustion experiments, the coal block acquired on site is adopted for filling the simulated coal area, and the coal block can be replaced according to the characteristics and coal quality of different coals, so that the simulation is closer to the actual situation, the conditions of different wind speeds, different gas concentrations, different coal types and different coal burning in the goaf are simulated, the gas concentration automatic acquisition system and the temperature measurement system are used for acquiring data in real time, and therefore the dynamic diffusion and accumulation rules of gas in the fire area environment and the research on the thermodynamic disaster evolution process and characteristics in the coal spontaneous combustion fire environment can be carried out.

title_en: Distribution network material reserve management and distribution system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network material reserve management and distribution system, and relates to the technical field of material reserve management and distribution. The distribution network material reserve management and distribution system comprises a material demand prediction module, a material reserve management module, a material distribution planning module, an inventory management and distribution module and a logistics tracking and coordination module. According to the invention, through analysis of historical data and training of a machine learning model, the prediction accuracy of the material demands can be improved, and through real-time monitoring and analysis of the material stock conditions, timely stock report and statistical analysis are provided, so that a decision maker is helped to make a reasonable material stock decision, the scale and the type of the material stock can be optimized, the stock cost is reduced, meanwhile, enough material supply is ensured, the prediction accuracy of the material demands is improved, the optimal material distribution route and time arrangement are realized, the material can arrive at a disaster area in time, and the effect of the urgency of the demands is met.

title_en: Multi-sensor data fusion fire detection method based on neural network
abstract_en: A multi-sensor data fusion fire detection method based on a neural network comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing a training model and a data set; the data set is data acquired by using simulation software to deploy NA sensors in a simulation scene, and the training model is obtained by training the data set; step 2, collecting data by a sensor in a detected scene; s3, performing SG filtering on the acquired data; s4, carrying out the Graham angle field transformation on the filtered data to obtain a sensor signal characteristic matrix, and converting the sensor signal characteristic matrix into an aggregation matrix; s5, sending the aggregation matrix into the training model obtained in the step 1 to judge whether fire disaster occurs. According to the invention, through SG filtering and GAF change, three-dimensional independent fire sensor signals are converted into a three-channel RGB picture matrix-like form, so that the problem of fire identification accuracy is solved through a neural network model with high accuracy in a mature image classification mode.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE QUZHOU OF ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY UNIV;ZHEJIANG CHAOYI FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Prediction and simulation system of wave overtopping and method thereof
title_ko: 월파 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 이를 이용한 예측 방법
abstract_en: According to the embodiments of the present invention, provided are a system and a method, which monitors and predicts wave overtopping during coastal disasters and can predict wave overtopping through the structural characteristics of marine structures and coastal change information to minimize damage caused by overtopping waves. Provided is a prediction method of wave overtopping, which includes: collecting coastal information about at least one of marine structures installed on a coast and topographic information of the coast; and predicting the overtopping waves on the coast by inputting the coastal information into a wave overtopping prediction model trained to predict overtopping waves which occur on the coast based on the collected coastal information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 예는 연안 재해 중 월파를 모니터링하고 예측하여 월파로 인한 피해를 최소화할 수 있도록 해양 구조물의 구조적 특징과 연안의 변화 정보를 통해 월파를 예측할 수 있는 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: NAVTEX message semantic automatic classification method based on BLS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a NAVTEX message semantic automatic classification method based on BLS, which applies data cleaning and word segmentation operation to NAVTEX message data and puts forward semantic tags to label the message with categories, and specifically comprises the steps of summarizing message contents contained in navigation warning and defining 7 types of semantic tags. The invention can effectively carry out the simplification processing on the redundant complicated original message data and initially lay a foundation for the subsequent classification task, so that the trained characteristics are more representative. The invention has the advantages of convenient calculation and simple structure by adopting the vector space model to extract the characteristics of the preprocessed NAVTEX message data, and then carries out semantic classification based on BLS, thereby having the advantages of short training time and good classification effect, effectively relieving the labor intensity of crews and improving the emergency response speed and efficiency of coping with safety information, and further improving the safety navigation performance of ships.

title_en: Data write-back method, device, equipment and medium for mass tasks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data write-back method, device, equipment and medium for massive tasks. The method comprises the following steps: judging whether the target write-back task needs to be written into the database in real time or not when the target write-back task to be processed is detected; if yes, writing the target write-back task into a database in real time, otherwise, determining a target slice in a preset wheel disc array, and writing the write-back task into the target slice when the target slice meets temporary storage conditions; the method comprises the steps that a wheel disc array corresponds to a set index pointer, and the index pointer points to a slice to be written into a database in the wheel disc array; and each time the index pointer is detected to be switched in the pointing direction, writing the data temporarily stored in the current pointing slice of the index pointer into the database. By adopting the technical scheme, batch write-back of massive write-back tasks can be realized, the overlong recovery time of disaster drilling data caused by excessive write-back tasks at the same time is avoided, and the stability of the system is ensured.
assignees: SHANGHAI JUSHUITAN NETWORK TECH CO LTD;SHANGHAI JUHUOTONG E COMMERCE CO LTD;JIAXING JUSHUITAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water burst prevention test device for communication channel
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-gushing water test device for a connecting channel, which comprises a test box, a main tunnel model, a connecting channel model, a grouting hole, a loading system, a water inlet system and a sensing system, wherein the main tunnel model is arranged on the main tunnel model; a soil layer accommodating space is arranged in the test box; the grouting holes are used for connecting a grouting system and simulating grouting control when gushing water occurs; the loading system, the water inlet system and the sensing system are all arranged on the test box, and the loading system is used for compacting soil layers in the test box and applying surrounding rock pressure; the sensing system is used for detecting water level conditions, water pressure, surrounding rock pressure, water seepage conditions of the main tunnel model and the communication channel model and a diffusion path of injected slurry in the test box. The utility model can synthesize various complex conditions such as stratum conditions, buried depth, water level, surrounding rock pressure and the like, simulate the water inrush condition of a main tunnel and a communication channel, and simulate post-disaster prevention and control of the communication channel.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY SHISIJU GROUP CO;UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Drilling device with cleaning function for wood tray machining
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drilling device with a cleaning function for wood tray processing, which belongs to the technical field of wood tray processing and comprises a workbench, wherein a driving mechanism is arranged on the workbench, a fixed block is arranged on the driving mechanism, a second driving motor is arranged on the fixed block, a drill bit is arranged at the output end of the second driving motor, two springs are fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the fixed block, an extrusion plate is arranged between the two springs, a sealing sleeve is arranged between the fixed block and the extrusion plate, the drill bit is positioned at the inner side of the sealing sleeve, a rack is arranged at the inner side of one spring, a first gear is meshed with the rack, a first conical tooth is arranged on the first gear, a pump is arranged at the rear side of the workbench, a connecting pipe is arranged between the suction fan and the fixed block, and another connecting pipe is arranged between the pump and an adjusting mechanism, so that the equipment is effectively prevented from being in a fire disaster when in operation, and the waste of cooling liquid is further avoided.
assignees: YIXING XINYUAN PACKING MAT CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional aircraft luggage rack fire disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The fire disaster simulation device for the luggage rack of the multifunctional aircraft comprises a fuel release system, a smoke release system and a plurality of luggage rack models, wherein the fuel release system comprises a fuel main pipeline, a fuel source is externally connected with the fuel main pipeline, the fuel main pipeline is arranged at the rear side of the luggage rack models, a plurality of fuel branch pipelines are connected to the fuel main pipeline, and all the fuel branch pipelines are respectively positioned in the luggage rack models; in summary, through the innovative design, the utility model can simulate heating, smoking and range fire disaster in a plurality of luggage rack models respectively, and the spreading and diffusion of smoke among a plurality of luggage racks can be realized, so that the luggage rack fire simulation device is closer to a real fire scene, and the defect of single simulation form of the traditional luggage rack fire simulation device is overcome.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHEN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Crowd evacuation guiding system based on state time sequence evaluation and using method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer simulation, and particularly relates to a crowd evacuation guiding system based on state time sequence evaluation and a using method thereof; the method comprises the steps of constructing evacuation scene information and navigation points, randomly generating pedestrians in the scene, storing initial pedestrian evacuation state information, starting evacuation of the pedestrians, moving the pedestrians towards an exit, receiving evacuation guiding paths from a system guiding strategy in the evacuation process, pushing evacuation paths with higher evacuation efficiency, and constructing a connection between the saturation of the navigation points and the selection probability of the navigation points by using a BP neural network based on the saturation of the navigation points as input by a guiding module in a simulation system, evaluating the guiding strategy at the previous moment through a state time sequence evaluation model of the saturation of the navigation points, and optimizing the evacuation guiding strategy to generate the selection probability of the navigation points which are more beneficial to evacuation by using TD errors until evacuation is completed.

title_en: Simulation-based substation rainfall flood risk assessment model construction method
abstract_en: The application provides a simulation-based substation rainfall flood risk assessment model construction method, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of carrying out characteristic analysis on the flood damage, establishing an evaluation index system, dividing index dangers and determining index weight coefficients, constructing a substation flood risk evaluation model, taking flood indexes such as flooding depth and flooding range as data input, and carrying out better flood risk analysis effects under different situations on specific disaster bearing bodies at different facilities of the substation by a disaster damage mechanism evaluation method. The method has the advantages that the risk degree of the transformer substation under different rain and flood conditions can be estimated more accurately by establishing the simulation-based transformer substation rain and flood risk estimation model, and a more scientific method is provided for flood control and disaster prevention of the transformer substation. Meanwhile, the disaster damage mechanism assessment method is adopted, so that disaster bearing conditions of the positions of different facilities of the transformer substation can be considered more comprehensively, and the accuracy and reliability of assessment are improved.

title_en: Remote sensing image change detection method combining U-shaped network and self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing image change detection method combining a U-shaped network and a self-attention mechanism, which mainly solves the problems of large memory occupation and complex network structure in the prior art, and comprises the following implementation steps: 1) Acquiring a training sample set and a test sample set; 2) Constructing a U-shaped variation detection network model, wherein the U-shaped variation detection network model comprises a multi-scale feature extraction module, a layered self-attention mechanism, a fusion up-sampling module and a classifier which are sequentially cascaded; 3) Inputting the training sample set into a U-shaped transformation detection network model and performing iterative training on the training sample set by using a back propagation method; 4) And inputting the test sample set into the trained U-shaped change detection network model to obtain a remote sensing image change detection visual image and a numerical result. The invention realizes lightweight change detection, obtains multi-scale fine granularity characteristics, reduces the complexity of a network structure, improves the detection precision, reduces the calculation resources, and can be used for geological disaster detection, urban planning and forest destruction detection.

title_en: Multi-target intelligent scheduling method for river basin flood control engineering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target intelligent scheduling method of a river basin flood control engineering system, and belongs to the field of water resource regulation and control. Specifically, a river basin flood control engineering system multi-target cooperative scheduling index system is established; generating a drainage basin flood control scheduling data set based on the index system, and constructing a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling numerical simulation model; constructing an intelligent acquisition model of priori scheduling knowledge by combining a numerical simulation model to generate a drainage basin flood control scheduling plan library; constructing a river basin flood control engineering system multi-target cooperative scheduling decision model according to the plan library; combining a numerical simulation model to construct an automatic intervention model of a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling scheme; constructing a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling scheme evaluation model, and completing construction of a drainage basin flood control engineering system multi-target intelligent scheduling model; and inputting decision conditions of the intelligent scheduling model, and outputting a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling scheme. The invention is helpful to solve the problems of flood control and disaster reduction in watershed, water environment restoration, water resource supply and the like which restrict the local social and economic development.

title_en: System and method for testing gas explosion caused by dust explosion jet flow
abstract_en: The invention provides a testing system and a testing method for gas explosion caused by dust explosion jet flow, wherein a base for paving combustible dust is arranged at the bottom of a dust explosion device, the gas explosion device is communicated with the dust explosion device, a pressure acquisition device is arranged on the gas explosion device and used for monitoring the pressure in an explosion cavity, and a camera device is used for shooting an explosion image in the gas explosion device; the air distribution device is communicated with the explosion device to perform air distribution, the powder spraying device is used for dispersing dust, and the ignition device is used for igniting combustible dust in the dust explosion device. The invention can simulate the real environment of gas explosion caused by dust explosion, has simple structure, simple and convenient operation and strong functionality, is suitable for various dust and combustible gases, and can obtain data such as maximum explosion pressure, flame structure, flame combustion speed and the like; the method is helpful for revealing the explosion disaster mechanism of the gas and dust mixed system and provides reference for effective prevention and control of explosion accidents.

title_en: Outdoor disaster relief tent with high resistance
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-resistance outdoor disaster relief tent, which can integrate the bottom of an inner framework into a whole in a multi-point binding way under the condition of positioning existing multi-point scattered steel drills through the arrangement of connecting frame joint rods, and can be integrally pricked into the ground for auxiliary positioning.

title_en: Lightning simulation generating and processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of data processing, and provides a simulated lightning generation and processing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the simulated lightning generation and processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a thunderstorm cloud generation instruction, and judging whether thunderstorm cloud can be generated according to a prestored thunderstorm cloud generation condition; if the thunderstorm cloud can be generated, generating a first prompt, wherein the first prompt carries a thunderstorm point selection prompt; if the lightning point position is obtained based on the first prompt, and the lightning point is located in the lightning scope of the thunderstorm cloud, determining an object to be destroyed by lightning according to the lightning point position, and generating a second prompt based on the object to be destroyed, wherein the second prompt carries a lightning defense prompt; and if the lightning defense operation is acquired based on the second prompt, generating lightning at the lightning point position, and displaying the lightning defense effect according to the lightning defense operation. The embodiment of the application can improve the scientific popularization effect of lightning disasters, improve the protection consciousness of lightning and reduce the risk of lightning disasters.
assignees: HEBEI METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION TECH SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Visual dialogue generation method and device based on counterfacts common sense causal reasoning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual dialogue generating method and device based on the causal reasoning of the counterfacts common sense, wherein the method comprises the following steps: introducing common sense into a visual dialogue task, constructing a visual dialogue causal graph based on common sense fusion, and calculating the total effect of input features on answer prediction; constructing a corresponding anti-facts causal graph based on the visual dialogue causal graph; for the anti-facts causal graph, estimating the influence of harmful deviation generated by the introduced common sense according to the natural direct effect on answer prediction, and removing the influence from the total effect; training a visual dialogue model by adopting model integration, and obtaining an answer prediction result by taking cross entropy and KL divergence loss as training targets; integrating the image features, the dialogue history features, the common sense features and the current problem features, sending the integrated image features, the dialogue history features, the common sense features and the current problem features into a decoder, minimizing a loss function, optimizing network parameters, and finally providing real disaster environment information for disaster rescue sites. The device comprises: a processor and a memory.

title_en: Power grid equipment inundation analysis method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: According to the method, the device, the storage medium and the computer equipment for analyzing the submerged power of the power grid equipment, provided by the application, rainfall parameters in the simulation instructions are acquired in response to the simulation instructions, the rainfall parameters are input into a preset hydrodynamic model to obtain target data, the position information of each power grid equipment is acquired based on a preset power grid BIM model, the target data is associated with the position information of each power grid equipment to obtain water flow dynamics, water accumulation depth and water accumulation time corresponding to the position information of the power grid equipment in each wading area, so that storm levels corresponding to the position information of each power grid equipment are analyzed, and the storm levels and the topographic information corresponding to the position information of each power grid equipment are marked based on the power grid BIM model to obtain a risk marking map so as to determine the submerged risk level of each power grid equipment. And analyzing the flooding condition of the power grid equipment through the corresponding flooding risk grade of each power grid equipment, and reducing the risk of damage of the power grid equipment due to natural disasters.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Urban traffic evaluation method and device based on spatial superposition analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban flood disasters and road traffic safety, and discloses a method and a device for evaluating urban traffic based on space superposition analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing space data superposition on site monitoring rainfall data, urban surface data and urban underground pipeline data to generate urban grid-by-grid space superposition data, training a preset deep learning model, and generating an urban flood ponding depth prediction model; acquiring weather forecast data in a target urban area, and determining a grid-by-grid ponding depth prediction result by utilizing an urban flood ponding depth prediction model; collecting urban population distribution data in the current time period, inputting the urban population distribution data into an urban traffic flow prediction model, and generating a grid-by-grid traffic flow prediction result; and carrying out space superposition analysis on the grid-by-grid ponding depth prediction result and the grid-by-grid traffic flow prediction result, and evaluating urban traffic in the urban grid. The method improves the prediction precision of flood disasters so as to realize accurate evaluation of urban traffic.

title_en: Novel coal mine safety method for realizing transparent mine construction
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of coal mine safety, in particular to a brand new coal mine safety method for realizing transparent mine construction, which comprises the steps of adopting unmanned plane, laser radar and three-dimensional earthquake technical means to acquire data of the upper and lower geology of a coal mine; processing and analyzing the collected geological data by adopting a machine learning and image recognition artificial intelligence technology, establishing a safety management platform by adopting cloud computing and internet of things technologies, integrating and analyzing the collected various data, realizing real-time monitoring of the whole coal mine production process, and visually displaying the geological data; based on geological visual display data, the hidden disaster possibility is found, and real-time monitoring and early warning of hidden danger are realized; and the geological, coal and rock mass, gas distribution, electromechanical equipment and hidden disaster-causing data in the coal mine are presented in a three-dimensional form by utilizing a digital model and a virtual reality technology. The technical means of the application is relatively advanced and comprehensive, is easy to realize and popularize, and has high practical application value.
assignees: GUIZHOU MINE SAFETY SCIENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Shield segment joint fire-explosion coupling action mechanical property test system
abstract_en: A shield segment joint fire-explosion coupling action mechanical property test system belongs to the technical field of shield tunnel segment joint test devices and comprises a fire thermal environment simulation unit, an explosion impact simulation unit, a heat insulation protection unit, a rotation unit, a loading unit and a data acquisition unit. The test system can better simulate the thermal-force-steam multi-field coupling stress state of the tunnel lining segment under the high temperature and explosion impact of fire disaster; the interaction between lining segments and the action condition of surrounding rock-soil bodies on the lining segments can be simulated; the positive bending moment or the negative bending moment can be applied to the joint of the lining segment, one load can be applied or multiple loads can be combined and loaded. The test system is safe and reliable, is easy to operate, and can meet the requirements of mechanical property tests during fire-explosion coupling of shield tunnel segments.

title_en: Drilling machine for ground disaster investigation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drilling rigs, in particular to a drilling rig for ground disaster investigation. The technical proposal comprises: including base, rig main part and drill bit, the base end is fixed with the pole setting, and it has track slider to slide in the pole setting, and the drill rod is installed to rig main part installs on track slider, and the drill bit is installed to the drill rod lower extreme, and stable pneumatic cylinder is installed through the installation piece in the base four corners, and the expansion tank has been seted up on the base and with the corresponding position of installation piece, and sliding connection has the telescopic link in the expansion tank, and the telescopic link tip passes the expansion tank and rotates with the installation piece through deflection assembly to be connected, just is located in the base and is provided with flexible subassembly between the corresponding expansion tank. The utility model can increase the bottom supporting range of the stable hydraulic cylinder by extending the telescopic rod, and can adjust the bottom supporting position of the stable hydraulic cylinder by rotating the mounting block, thereby increasing the stability of the support and adjusting the supporting point according to the topographic structure.

title_en: Method and system for fault location and protection of inverter-dominated islanded ungrounded microgrids
abstract_en: Disclosed a method and system for fault location and protection of Microgrids which are operated under islanded mode by being disconnected from distribution systems under large disturbance or disaster scenarios. The disclosed method is invented to meet the protection needs for disconnected ungrounded microgrids without appropriate protection systems that are usually installed only at distribution substations. Moreover, the disclosed protection method or scheme is targeted at inverter-dominated microgrids in which fault current limiters are installed to protect inverters introduced by the increasing penetration of inverter-based distributed generators (IBDGs). Based on transient analysis and dynamic simulation of islanded ungrounded microgrids during different types of faults, it is realized that of the first terminal and second terminal sensors of the branch different types of faults can be effectively detected based on sequent components of currents flowed through terminals at faulted branches or sections, even with multiple IBGDs deployed in the Microgrids under different control strategies. The phase angle differences of zero sequence currents, and magnitude differences of negative sequence currents, and sign changes of phase currents are used to locate and protect against unsymmetrical and symmetrical faults within the islanded microgrids with lower fault currents, respectively.

title_en: Linear underground engineering water inflow numerical prediction method in coupling construction process
abstract_en: The application discloses a linear underground engineering water inflow numerical prediction method in a coupling construction process, which adopts three-dimensional geological modeling software to finely describe underground buildings and main water guide structures in a research area, combines the construction excavation progress and tunnel lining conditions to endow different structures with dynamic boundary conditions, predicts the underground water level and the water inflow dynamic change condition of underground engineering in the construction process, forms a set of underground chamber water inflow dynamic prediction simulation technology coupled with the construction process, and ensures that the water inflow prediction result is more accurate and practical; data and technical support are provided for dynamic adjustment of the chamber drainage design scheme; effectively reduces the safety accident risk caused by sudden water disaster, improves the construction progress guaranteeing capability of the deep-buried long tunnel and saves the cost.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER ENGINEERING CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of tillite landslide disaster situation database and landslide early warning method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of natural disasters, and provides a method for constructing a database of disaster situations caused by tillite landslide and a landslide early warning method. The method for constructing the disaster situation database by the tillite landslide comprises the following steps: acquiring object source data and physical strength indexes of each tillite in a region to be pre-warned; inputting the material source data, the physical strength indexes and a plurality of first rainfall data of each tillite into a pre-constructed landslide movement model, simulating disaster movement data of each tillite, and describing the dynamic process of the tillite by the landslide movement model through a hydrodynamic shallow water equation; and establishing a disaster situation database caused by the landslide of the tillite according to the first rainfall data and the disaster movement data. According to the method, the dilemma of insufficient early warning time caused by low calculation efficiency of the damage range of the tillite landslide is solved, the rapid dynamic monitoring early warning of the future tillite landslide based on rainfall data monitored in real time is realized, and the method has important significance in avoiding loss of the tillite disaster.

title_en: Typhoon disaster risk assessment and dynamic forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster risk assessment and dynamic forecasting method, which comprises the following steps: selecting a prediction index: at least comprising a risk index, a vulnerability index and an exposure index; extracting dangerous indexes: extracting the maximum rainfall, the process rainfall and the average maximum wind speed of a plurality of preset time lengths in administrative areas of each county; correlation analysis: carrying out pearson correlation analysis on the selected prediction index and the loss level; and (3) principal component analysis: reducing the dimension of the dangerous index related to the rainfall; dividing a sample set; constructing a machine learning model; training and testing a machine learning model; and (3) obtaining a forecast result: and dynamically updating the dangerous indexes input by the machine learning model, thereby realizing the real-time updating and forecasting of the typhoon disaster risk. The machine learning model updates the dangerous index input by the machine learning model by using the weather data of actual measurement and prediction, so that the real-time update and prediction of each county is realized.

title_en: Visual simulation inundation method and system based on river channel
abstract_en: The application provides a method for visually simulating flooding based on a river channel, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical water level data of a target river channel; constructing a submerged model by utilizing the historical water level data; constructing a digital elevation model of the target river channel according to the satellite diagram of the target river channel; determining the submerged water quantity of each unit grid in the digital elevation model; and completing visual simulation of the target river by utilizing a three-dimensional terrain simulation platform according to the digital elevation model of the target river and the submerged water quantity of each unit grid. According to the application, the three-dimensional terrain simulation platform is utilized to complete the visual simulation of the target river channel based on the digital elevation model of the target river channel and the flooding water quantity of each unit grid, so that the dynamic display of the flooding process based on multi-dimensional geographic space information is realized, and powerful guidance is provided for flood control and disaster reduction work.
assignees: ZHONGBEITONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;HANGZHOU SHENGWEI ZHIZAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Natural geological disaster classification and identification method and system based on improved Resnet neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural geological disaster classification recognition method and system based on an improved Resnet neural network, comprising the following steps of acquiring image data, acquiring remote sensing images or geological disaster area image data shot by an unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a dataset, constructing a natural disaster image dataset after marking and data enhancement of the image data, dividing a training set, a verification set and a testing set according to the proportion of 8:1:1, constructing a Resnet-CS model, improving a Resnet neural network model to obtain a Resnet-CS model, training Resnet-CS models, inputting dataset data into the Resnet-CS model to train to obtain an optimal model, and carrying out geological disaster classification recognition, namely inputting image data to be detected into the trained optimal model to obtain a prediction classification result. The method is used for classifying, identifying and predicting the remote sensing images, can effectively identify various natural disasters including earthquakes, floods, wildfires, volcanic eruptions and the like, and greatly improves the accuracy of the multi-classification problem.

title_en: Fire simulation device for aircraft cabin seat with variable combustion range
abstract_en: The fire simulation device for the aircraft cabin seat with the variable combustion range comprises an ignition device, a floor and a controller, wherein a water bath combustion pool is arranged below the floor, water is contained in the water bath combustion pool, a plurality of underwater fuel release pipelines are arranged in the water bath combustion pool side by side, and the underwater fuel release pipelines are provided with fuel gas release holes; in summary, the combustion device is integrated below the floor of the area where the seat is located, so that the fire disaster is not limited to the range of the individual seat, the combustion area can be independently controlled, and the combustion area can be controlled in a segmented manner; the utility model has the advantages that the special design can effectively simulate the fire disaster of the seat in the passenger cabin, the sheet-shaped large-range fire disaster is simulated in the area where the seats are positioned, and the flame of each seat has no obvious limit, so that the real combustion and fire spreading state of the seat fire disaster in the passenger cabin can be restored, the fidelity of the real fire training is further improved, and the functional defects and the cost disadvantages of the traditional seat fire disaster simulation device are solved.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHEN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Methods and systems for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water treatment facilities through simulation
title_ko: 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water treatment facilities is a method of efficiently recovering disaster damage to water treatment facilities in the event of an actual disaster such as an earthquake, flood, or typhoon by determining a recovery sequence for each of water treatment process facilities included in the water treatment facilities through simulation. The method comprises: a facility information acquisition step of acquiring facility information, which is information about each of first to N^th process facilities in the water treatment facility, in which first to N^th steps which are water treatment processes are sequentially performed; a standard information acquisition step of acquiring standard information which is acceptable water quality information for each of the first to N^th process facilities; a measurement information acquisition step of acquiring measurement information, which is information obtained by measuring water quality for each of the first to N^th process facilities; and generating, based on the facility information, the standard information, and the measurement information, priority information for disaster damage recovery in the event of an actual disaster by simulating the disaster damage to each of the first to N^th process facilities due to the occurrence of the disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법은 시뮬레이션을 통해 수처리 시설에 포함된 수처리 공정 시설 각각에 대해 복구 순서를 결정하여, 지진, 홍수, 태풍과 같이 실제로 재난이 발생했을 경우, 수처리 시설에 대해 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법에 관한 것으로서, 수처리 시설 내, 수처리 공정인 제1 단계 내지 제N 단계가 순차적으로 수행되는 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 정보인 시설 정보를 획득하는 시설 정보 획득 단계; 상기 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 허용 가능한 수질 정보인 기준 정보를 획득하는 기준 정보 획득 단계; 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 수질을 측정한 정보인 측정 정보를 획득하는 측정 정보 획득 단계; 상기 시설 정보, 상기 기준 정보 및 상기 측정 정보를 기초로 재난 발생에 따른 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 재난 피해를 시뮬레이션하여 실제 재난 발생 시, 재난피해 복구에 대한 우선순위 정보를 생성하는 시뮬레이션 단계;를 포함하는, 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법일 수 있다.

title_en: Control system of screw compression refrigerator for cooling water circulating pump
title_ko: 냉각수 순환펌프 연동형 인버터 스크류 냉동기 제어시스템
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, provided is a cooling water circulation pump-linked inverter screw refrigerator control system comprising: a screw compression refrigerator; a simulator that performs a simulation operation based on the design specifications of the refrigerator and calculates an operation reference value for optimal efficiency; a control panel that inputs the operation reference value calculated from the simulator as an operation setting value for operation of the refrigerator, monitors the operation status of the refrigerator, and controls the operation status in real time; an inverter that controls the operation and frequency of the refrigerator according to signals from the control panel; an alarm system that triggers an alarm when an abnormal situation outside the operation reference value range occurs during the monitoring process of the refrigerator; and a disaster prevention room that remotely monitors the control panel and remotely instructs the control panel to identify abnormal causes and take action, including turning the refrigerator ON/OFF when the alarm system is activated. Accordingly, the operation management of the refrigerator can be optimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일측면에 따르면, 스크류 압축방식 냉동기; 상기 냉동기의 설계사양을 기준으로 시뮬레이션 운전을 수행하여 최적의 효율을 위한 운전 기준값을 산출하는 시뮬레이터; 상기 시뮬레이터로부터 산출된 운전 기준값을 상기 냉동기의 가동을 위한 운전 설정값으로 입력하고, 냉동기의 운전 상태를 모니터링하여 실시간 제어하는 제어반; 상기 제어반의 신호에 따라 냉동기의 가동 및 주파수를 제어하는 인버터; 상기 냉동기의 모니터링 과정에서 운전 기준값 범위를 벗어나는 비정상 상황 발생 시 이에 따른 경보를 발동하는 경보시스템; 및 상기 제어반을 원격 모니터링하고, 경보시스템 발동시 냉동기를 ON/OFF제어를 포함하는 비정상 원인파악과 조치사항을 제어반에 원격 지시하는 방재실;을 포함하는 냉각수 순환펌프 연동형 인버터 스크류 냉동기 제어시스템이 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Control system of inverter screw compression refrigerator
title_ko: 집수조 수위 제어부를 갖는 인버터 스크류 냉동기 제어시스템
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, provided is an inverter screw refrigerator control system with a sump water level control unit comprising: a screw compression refrigerator; a simulator that performs a simulation operation based on the design specifications of the refrigerator and calculates an operation reference value for optimal efficiency; a control panel that inputs the operation reference value calculated from the simulator as an operation setting value for operation of the refrigerator, monitors the operation status of the refrigerator, and controls the operation status in real time; an inverter that controls the operation and frequency of the refrigerator according to signals from the control panel; an alarm system that triggers an alarm when an abnormal situation outside the operation reference value range occurs during the monitoring process of the refrigerator; and a disaster prevention room that remotely monitors the control panel and remotely instructs the control panel to identify abnormal causes and take action, including turning the refrigerator ON/OFF when the alarm system is activated. Accordingly, the operation management of the refrigerator can be optimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일측면에 따르면, 스크류 압축방식 냉동기; 상기 냉동기의 설계사양을 기준으로 시뮬레이션 운전을 수행하여 최적의 효율을 위한 운전 기준값을 산출하는 시뮬레이터; 상기 시뮬레이터로부터 산출된 운전 기준값을 상기 냉동기의 가동을 위한 운전 설정값으로 입력하고, 냉동기의 운전 상태를 모니터링하여 실시간 제어하는 제어반; 상기 제어반의 신호에 따라 냉동기의 가동 및 주파수를 제어하는 인버터; 상기 냉동기의 모니터링 과정에서 운전 기준값 범위를 벗어나는 비정상 상황 발생 시 이에 따른 경보를 발동하는 경보시스템; 및 상기 제어반을 원격 모니터링하고, 경보시스템 발동시 냉동기를 ON/OFF제어를 포함하는 비정상 원인파악과 조치사항을 제어반에 원격 지시하는 방재실;을 포함하는 집수조 수위 제어부를 갖는 인버터 스크류 냉동기 제어시스템이 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Wall fire smoke trace research device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a wall fire smoking trace research device and a wall fire smoking trace research method, wherein the device comprises a platform, an outer vertical panel, a first screw transmission assembly and a supporting table are fixedly connected to the top surface of the platform, the first screw transmission assembly is positioned on one side of the outer vertical panel, and the supporting table is positioned at one end of the first screw transmission assembly; the sliding end of the first screw transmission assembly slides along the length direction of the outer vertical panel, a second screw transmission assembly is fixedly connected to the sliding end of the first screw transmission assembly, the sliding direction of the sliding end of the second screw transmission assembly is perpendicular to the sliding direction of the sliding end of the first screw transmission assembly, and a connecting assembly is fixedly connected to the sliding end of the first screw transmission assembly; the fire disaster simulation device can simulate the smoke trace generated by a fire disaster.

title_en: Parking area flood situation ponding detecting system based on computer vision technique
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parking lot flood water detection system based on a computer vision technology, which comprises an image acquisition module: the image acquisition module is responsible for acquiring monitoring pictures of the parking lot, and the monitoring pictures are acquired through the high-definition monitoring camera so as to ensure the quality of the acquired images, thereby ensuring the subsequent processing effect. The system for detecting the flood and the ponding of the parking lot based on the computer vision technology adopts a mode of multi-warehouse data sharing, deep learning model training and single-warehouse model fine tuning, breaks through the traditional prediction method, makes evacuation instructions more efficiently and scientifically, and provides strong support.
assignees: ANJI INTELLIGENT INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic risk assessment method and system for flood and drought disasters based on multi-source information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic risk assessment method and a system for a flood and drought disaster based on multi-source information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source information, including weather station data, satellite observation data and historical data, complementing the missing multi-source information by using a Lagrangian and Kriging interpolation method, and standardizing to obtain a standard data set; extracting satellite image features obtained by satellite observation based on a VGG16 convolutional neural network, reducing the dimension of the satellite image features based on a random neighborhood embedding method, and combining the collected multi-source information to form comprehensive features; constructing a dynamic risk assessment method of the flood and drought disasters based on a support vector machine, and constructing an optimization objective function; and training the constructed dynamic risk assessment method for the paddy and dry disasters, and carrying out real-time assessment on the dynamic risk of the paddy and dry disasters after the trained risk assessment method is obtained. The invention adopts machine learning and deep learning algorithms, avoids the complicated process of manually extracting the characteristics in the traditional method, and improves the evaluation efficiency.

title_en: Mountain torrent flood video identification monitoring method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood video identification monitoring method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining video data of flood disaster areas in a large amount, trimming the video data into short videos, and manufacturing an initial sample by manually marking categories; carrying out space-time feature extraction by using the C3D network model to obtain a training sample; and training the CNN model by using a training sample to obtain a predictive score model, and improving the CNN algorithm during training to improve the stability and convergence rate of the algorithm. The invention combines video monitoring, anomaly detection and C3D technology, and performs anomaly analysis on video transmitted by a camera, and judges whether flood floods exist by identifying water flow and water wave. The method is free from weather interference, high in identification speed and high in accuracy, and therefore disasters caused by mountain floods can be reduced to a greater extent.

title_en: Coal mine water damage prediction system based on data analysis and machine learning technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine water damage prediction system based on data analysis and machine learning technology, which comprises the following steps: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring the historical accident data of the coal mine water disaster and the historical environment data of the coal mine and acquiring first data; the data processing module is used for preprocessing the first data to obtain preprocessed data; the prediction model training evaluation module is used for training and evaluating a preset coal mine water damage prediction model based on the preprocessing data to obtain a first coal mine water damage prediction model; and the prediction implementation module is used for predicting the coal mine water damage based on the first coal mine water damage prediction model. The method can improve the accuracy of coal mine water damage prediction, reduce false alarm and missing alarm, improve the reliability of prediction results, avoid accidents or reduce the influence of the accidents on mine production, help mine management staff to cope with water damage risks, reduce loss and ensure production safety.

title_en: System and method for evaluating emergency response capability of driver based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driver emergency response capability assessment system and method based on virtual reality, wherein the system is provided with a VR driving simulator and a management platform, real-time communication is carried out between the VR driving simulator and the management platform through a network, and an emergency VR driving scene library is prestored in the system; selecting a plurality of evaluation scenes based on the system, setting two evaluation indexes of emergency treatment performance scores and emergency treatment speed scores, and calculating the emergency treatment performance scores and the emergency treatment speed scores of drivers in each scene; then calculating emergency response capability scores in each emergency VR driving scene; and obtaining the comprehensive emergency response capability scores of the drivers in all scenes through weighted average calculation. The invention has the characteristics of simple operation, strong immersion, small interference, accurate evaluation, good training effect and the like.

title_en: Testing device for fire-fighting telephone host circuit board
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting telephone circuit board testing, in particular to a testing device for a fire-fighting telephone host circuit board, which comprises a base, wherein the upper surface of the base is fixedly provided with a vibrating mechanism, three mounting clamping grooves which are arranged from left to right are formed in the vibrating mechanism and are used for placing a circuit board when the circuit board is subjected to vibration testing, a placing mechanism is arranged in each mounting clamping groove on the vibrating mechanism and is used for simulating a knocking environment in the process of vibration testing of the circuit board, and the circuit board can be subjected to comparison testing or batch testing according to requirements through the arrangement of a heating mechanism and the vibrating mechanism, so that the diversity of equipment on the circuit board detection can be improved, meanwhile, the service life of the circuit board can be known to the greatest extent in the subsequent use process of the circuit board, and the uninterrupted communication of firefighters in the fire-fighting work can be ensured.
assignees: HENGYE CENTURY SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vibration field monitoring system for coal mine composite disaster early warning
