abstract_en: The application provides a vibrations field monitoring system for compound disaster early warning of colliery, the system includes: the system comprises an ore seismometer, a drilling acquisition module, a downhole acquisition module and a service display module; the ore seismometer comprises: a three-component low-frequency mine earthquake sensor arranged on the ground of the coal mine; the borehole collection module includes: a first microseismic sensor mounted in the borehole; the downhole acquisition module comprises: a second microseismic sensor, a geophone and a multifunctional microseismic sensor installed downhole. According to the technical scheme, the problem that vibration signals, energy, frequency and event judgment standards are not uniform in the coal mine composite disaster monitoring and concern on different types of disasters is solved, the same standard is combined with the installation mode and the installation position of equipment, different types of vibration signals such as mine vibration, microseism and ground sound are processed, and the monitoring precision of the system is improved.

title_en: Emergency rescue method and system based on computer simulation exercise
abstract_en: An emergency rescue method and system based on computer simulation exercise belongs to the public safety field, and comprises the following steps: analyzing the comprehensive loss degree of the historical disaster event based on the big data to obtain a pre-modeling case set; acquiring a three-dimensional virtual disaster model set based on a virtual reality technology; obtaining pre-modeling training image data by utilizing a pre-modeling training scheme set and a three-dimensional virtual disaster model; performing the pre-exercise training effect evaluation according to the pre-exercise training data to obtain a first training evaluation result; under the condition that the first training evaluation result meets the standard, acquiring burst training image data and acquiring a second training evaluation result based on the burst training image data; and grading the emergency capacity according to the second training evaluation result, and arranging the same-grade emergency rescue tasks. The application solves the technical problems of single drilling scene, poor rescue effect and large rescue loss in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of enriching drilling scenes, improving rescue effect and reducing rescue loss.

title_en: Analysis method for force and deformation in immersed tube tunnel under tsunami load effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing the internal force and deformation of a immersed tube tunnel under the action of tsunami load, which comprises the steps of simulating tsunami by adopting first-order solitary waves, analyzing the tsunami force acting on the bottom surface of the sea by introducing a hydrodynamic method, simplifying the tsunami force in an exponential form, and obtaining the osmotic pressure caused by the tsunami and acting on the immersed tube tunnel by adopting a Boit consolidation theory; establishing a simulated immersed tube tunnel with two ends of semi-infinite-length elastic foundation beams, neglecting the deformation of the cross section of a tube section, wherein the tube section is regarded as an Euler beam, and the foundation is regarded as a Pasternak foundation, so as to obtain a beam deformation control equation of the foundation Liang Moxing under the action of tsunami; introducing a bending coefficient and a shearing coefficient of the joint to realize the simulation of bending and shearing of the joint, so as to obtain a continuous boundary condition for controlling the immersed tube tunnel at the joint; and obtaining parameters such as settlement, rotation angle, shearing force, bending moment and the like of the immersed tube tunnel joint under the action of tsunami load. The invention provides a reference basis for realizing the dynamic response rule of the seawater-seabed-tunnel multi-medium system under the disaster condition.

title_en: Simulation and detection device for soft rock catastrophe
abstract_en: The application discloses a simulation and detection device for soft rock catastrophe, which comprises: the weather mechanism comprises a frame, a blower is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the frame, and a rainfall assembly is fixedly arranged on the top wall of the frame; the vertical simulation mechanism comprises a bottom plate, the bottom plate is positioned in the frame, one end of the top surface of the bottom plate is hinged with one end of a connecting rod, the other end of the connecting rod is hinged with an oscillating plate, the top surface of the bottom plate is provided with a multistage oscillating assembly, and the multistage oscillating assembly is contacted with the bottom surface of the oscillating plate; the horizontal simulation mechanism comprises a mounting platform and a sloshing assembly, wherein the mounting platform is fixedly connected to the top surface of the oscillating plate through a supporting rod, a placing net frame is connected to the mounting platform in a sliding manner, the sloshing assembly is arranged between the oscillating plate and the mounting platform and is in transmission connection with the placing net frame, and the horizontal simulation mechanism can simulate disaster conditions of soft rock when earthquake and storm are caused in the situation of extremely close to reality and improve detection accuracy.

title_en: Digital twinning-based emergency simulation method and system for flood and drought disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based method and a digital twinning-based system for emergent simulation of a paddy and dry disaster, which are used for extracting data to be simulated of the paddy and dry disaster; determining a simulation model according to the data to be simulated of the flood and drought disasters to obtain simulation model data, and performing underwater topography simulation analysis to obtain emergency simulation data; dividing into different historical arid areas and historical flood areas; obtaining the features and feature vectors of the terrains and underwater terrains of each region; analyzing the difference value of the characteristic vector of each different region; attributing the historical arid regions and the historical flood regions which are smaller than the threshold value to approximate regions; extracting historical underwater topography data values of the similar region; obtaining a verification index through a historical underwater topography data value; and obtaining emergency simulation data through the verification indexes and the underwater topography simulation emergency simulation. The scheme can effectively carry out accurate simulation prediction on the conditions of the flood and drought disasters in all areas, fully considers the characteristics of underwater topography, and accurately predicts the flood and drought disaster prevention and control strategies in the areas.

title_en: Quick reaction platform of local seepage field of supplementary treatment of underground disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a local seepage field rapid reaction platform for auxiliary treatment of underground disasters, which comprises a seepage field composite control module, a small ground control platform, a centralized water supply circulation platform, an extension water pipe and a subsurface seepage field monitoring system, wherein rapid drilling equipment is arranged on the seepage field composite control module, and can complete drilling operation in a short time and drill to the adjacent position of the depth where tunnel seepage is located; through the underground seepage field monitoring system, the underground seepage field detection platform is an auxiliary device of a small ground control platform, and the flow of pumping water and supplementing water is adjusted according to the underground seepage field, so that the seepage path of underground water is finally manually interfered, the pore pressure at the seepage position of an underground building is reduced, the intensity of underground disasters is controlled from the outer side of the underground building, and time and operation environment are striven for construction rescue.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY LIUYUAN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dangerous rock volume calculation method based on three-dimensional image
abstract_en: According to the dangerous rock volume calculation method based on the three-dimensional image, characteristics of the dangerous rock body cut by 3 groups or 4 groups of dominant structural surfaces are analyzed through the three-dimensional image, parallelepiped, tetrahedron, octahedron, quadrangular frustum and triangular prism are formed, vertex coordinates of the dangerous rock body are measured or calculated, the dangerous rock volume is obtained through direct calculation, or the volumes of a plurality of simple polyhedrons are solved through a segmentation method, and then the dangerous rock volume is obtained through addition or subtraction, so that drilling or plain exploration is not needed to be carried out at a high-steep dangerous rock position, vegetation is not influenced, calculation efficiency is high, reliability, safety, accuracy and economy of dangerous rock disaster prevention are improved, design change of dangerous rock disaster prevention is reduced, construction cost is saved, practicability is higher than that of the prior art, applicability is wide, and great popularization significance and application prospect are achieved.

title_en: Emergency pretreatment system and emergency treatment twin system for tank farm
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an emergency pre-treatment system and an emergency treatment twin system for a tank farm, and belongs to the technical field of safety engineering. The emergency pre-treatment system comprises: the tank field digital twin model corresponds to the tank field entity structure and is used for simulating the full life cycle process of the tank field; the system comprises a twin application module, a disaster simulation module and a control module, wherein the twin application module is configured with an accident simulation module and is used for simulating tank farm accident data by applying a tank farm digital twin model so as to predict accident evolution, and the disaster simulation module is configured with a disaster simulation module and is used for simulating the predicted accident evolution so as to predict various disaster scenes in the accident evolution; and a plan determining module for determining an emergency pre-treatment plan matched with the predicted disaster scene from a preset emergency treatment plan library. The application predicts various disaster scenes in the accident evolution of the tank farm by utilizing the digital twin model, and further can pertinently determine the emergency pre-treatment plan corresponding to the predicted disaster scene.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RESEARCH INSTITUTE SAFETY ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Disaster recovery drilling method and device for distributed database
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery drilling method and device for a distributed database, and belongs to the technical field of databases. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring exercise scripts corresponding to a plurality of history exercise programs; defining universal script grammar according to the commonality command and the difference parameter between the drilling scripts; generating an execution script of the target drilling program based on the universal script grammar, and analyzing a script language of the execution script; and calling corresponding component interfaces in the distributed database according to the scripting language so as to execute the target drilling program. The application solves the technical problems of low reusability of the drilling scheme based on specific version and specific scene production in the related technology.

title_en: Method and device for optimizing power transmission efficiency of wireless charging device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for optimizing power transmission efficiency of a wireless charging device, which belong to the technical field of wireless charging and comprise the following steps: constructing a wireless charging device simulation model; constructing a power transmission efficiency self-adaptive Gaussian process regression machine learning agent model aGPR according to the spatial position parameters and the component parameter data set of the wireless charging device simulation model; calculating the mean, variance and probability density function of the power transmission efficiency according to the aGPR; and optimizing the space parameters and the component parameters by using a reptile search algorithm RSA according to the mean value, the variance and the probability density function to obtain an optimal parameter set of the parameter variables, and obtaining optimal power transmission efficiency. The invention has no trouble of dimension disaster, and improves the calculation speed; the RSA is adopted to realize the synchronous improvement of the power transmission efficiency and the system robustness of the wireless charging device; the wireless charging device transmission efficiency can be optimized efficiently and accurately.

title_en: Overhead transmission line fault identification method with isolation transformer and device thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a power transmission line fault identification method with an isolation transformer, which comprises the steps of erecting a shielding cover and an overhead power transmission line fault identification device with the isolation transformer; detecting the voltage of each circuit of the circuit and acquiring information; simulating fault signals and comparing information; the method can accurately identify single-phase grounding faults and grounding phases of the 10kV overhead transmission line with the isolation transformer by two ways of switching value and analog value, and enables operators to take corresponding measures. On one hand, the method can effectively avoid the fire disaster caused by the grounding point electric arc or endanger personal safety, and on the other hand, the breakdown of the line insulation weak point caused by overvoltage can be avoided.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG KANGDING HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: BIM-based venue fire evacuation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire evacuation method, a fire evacuation system, fire evacuation equipment and fire evacuation media for a venue based on BIM, which comprise the following steps: creating a three-dimensional building model of a venue based on BIM software, and acquiring space information of the model; simulating the occurrence of fire in the BIM based on the fire-fighting simulation software and the model space information, and acquiring the fire parameters; constructing a three-dimensional evacuation model according to the spatial information of the BIM model and the fire parameters; analyzing the three-dimensional evacuation model to divide a safe area and a dangerous area in the three-dimensional evacuation model; based on a preset sensor and monitoring equipment, acquiring the position of personnel in a venue and monitoring the fire occurrence condition in real time; calculating the shortest evacuation path for avoiding the dangerous area by combining the three-dimensional evacuation model based on the personnel position and the fire disaster condition; and providing real-time evacuation guidance based on preset intelligent equipment according to the shortest evacuation path. The application can realize a more efficient and accurate fire evacuation strategy.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION SCIENCE AND INDUSTRY GROUP OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning and monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning and monitoring device, which is characterized in that a connecting block is fixedly connected to the outside of a device main body, a camera is arranged outside the connecting block, a loudspeaker is arranged outside the device main body, a landslide monitoring system is applied to the device main body, the landslide monitoring system comprises a data acquisition module, a data monitoring module, a risk prediction module, an early warning module and a deep learning module, the data acquisition module transmits data to the data monitoring module, the data monitoring module transmits data to the risk prediction module, the risk prediction module transmits data to the early warning module, and the risk prediction module also needs model training of the deep learning module. In the invention, the data analysis module is applied with a super-resolution reconstruction algorithm, processes the information acquired by the camera, reduces the influence of the environment on information collection, and simultaneously performs model training of deep learning, thereby predicting risks better and carrying out early warning.

title_en: Sand sample anti-surge capability testing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sand sample anti-surge capability testing device, which belongs to the field of disaster simulation testing machinery and comprises a sealing plunger, a top flange mask, a device main cylinder, a device bottom sealing and a crack model. The sealing plunger has preset tightness, and can apply different axial pressures to the sand sample in the testing device under the sealing condition; the top flange mask is connected with the sealing plunger, and corresponding connection and fixation operations can be performed; the main column body of the device is hollow and has preset acceptability, and two ends are open, so that corresponding acceptation and connection operations can be carried out; the device back cover is connected with the device main column body, and a corresponding table-shaped structure is arranged at the inner part of the operation direction; the upper structure of the crack model in the operation direction is matched with the table-shaped structure arranged in the device back cover, and can be embedded in the device back cover. The utility model can develop the anti-surging capability test of the sand sample under different axial stress and different fracture states (fracture states and opening degrees) to obtain the anti-surging coefficient of the sand sample, and has the advantages of convenient processing and manufacturing and simple use and operation.
assignees: YANMEI HEZE ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster rainfall simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster simulation rainfall device which comprises a connecting block, wherein a three-way pipe is fixedly connected to the top of the connecting block, two ends of the three-way pipe are respectively communicated with a hose, the surface of each hose is communicated with a spray head, each hose is elastic, the front surface of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a vertical plate, the inner side of the vertical plate is movably connected with a screw rod through a bearing, the surface of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a screw sleeve, the front surface of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a limiting rod positioned at the top of the vertical plate, the top of the screw sleeve is fixedly connected with a traction rope, one side of the traction rope, which is far away from the screw sleeve, penetrates through the top of the vertical plate and is hung on the surface of the limiting rod, and one end of the traction rope, which is far away from the screw sleeve, is fixedly connected with the outer end of each hose. The utility model can improve the structural functionality of the existing rainfall simulation device, replaces the mode of welding, assembling and manufacturing by a steel frame, has adjustable spraying range and small occupied area, and can meet the use requirements of different environments.

title_en: System and method for high-precision fire simulation-based virtual fire training interaction and method for processing fire simulation-based virtual fire training zone interaction
title_ko: 고정밀 화재 시뮬레이션 기반 가상 소방훈련 상호작용 시스템 및 방법과 지역 상호작용 처리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high-precision fire simulation-based virtual fire training interaction system and method which allow virtual fire training, such as fire suppression, to be trained more realistically, and which is characterized by fire suppression support virtual fire training interaction that combines scientific high-precision fire dynamics simulator (FDS) result expression technology used to analyze fire situations and real-time interaction technology that processes dynamic changes using a 3D interaction processing map.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 진압과 같은 가상 소방 훈련을 보다 실감 있게 훈련받을 수 있도록, 화재 상황 분석에 사용되는 과학적인 고정밀 화재 시뮬레이션(FDS: Fire Dynamics Simulator) 결과 표현 기술과 3차원 상호작용 처리 맵을 이용해 동적 변화를 처리하는 실시간 상호작용 기술을 접목한 화재 진압 지원 가상 소방훈련 상호작용을 특징으로 하는 고정밀 화재 시뮬레이션 기반 가상 소방훈련 상호작용 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Detection of emergency events through Computer Vision and edge devices
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an advance fire and shooting emergency response system where the apparatus allows families and children to get themselves educated, plan and at promptly and intelligently at the time of fire and other emergency situations. The application is based on artificially intelligent algorithms and transmits the user information and location to the respondent server and can also send messages to already enlisted neighbors, family and friends to immediately alert them about emergency and location. The system is also able to send various types of reminders including but not limited to evacuation plans, monthly fire drills, monthly smoke detector check notifications, window check notifications and daily safety facts. It also provides single push button which once pushed by the user can send signals to immediate circle of user and first line responders teams and also allows the option to send message to explain the type of danger child is in. The assembly is easy to install, safe to use and is suitable for all ages.

title_en: Aircraft simulation cabin for fire-fighting exercise
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fire-fighting exercise models, and discloses an aircraft simulation cabin for fire-fighting exercise, which comprises a simulation cabin body and a wing unit arranged at the lower part of one side of the waist of the simulation cabin body, wherein the simulation cabin body comprises a wing box body; the head and tail parts of the body of the simulated cabin body are provided with landing wheels, and the bottom of the simulated cabin body is provided with a plurality of struts for supporting the whole simulated cabin body; the wing unit is a retractable wing. When fire-fighting exercise is needed, a worker pulls out the second sliding plate on the first sliding plate through the side sliding rail until the first sliding plate is pulled out from the bottom of the simulated cabin body, so that the whole simulated wing is pulled out, and the real effect of the simulated cabin of the aircraft is improved; the storage type simulated wing can solve the problem that the existing integrated welding type simulated cabin and wing occupy larger space, so that other firefighting training is inconvenient at ordinary times.

title_en: Method for precisely checking geological structure of coal face through high-density drilling group grid curved surface imaging
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine hidden geological disaster prevention and control, and provides a method for precisely checking geological structures of a coal face by using high-density drilling group grid curved surface imaging.

title_en: Dangerous chemical leakage diffusion prediction system based on meteorological and geographic information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hazardous chemical substance leakage and diffusion prediction system based on meteorological and geographic information, which comprises a data acquisition unit, a model construction unit and a prediction analysis unit, wherein the data acquisition unit acquires gas concentration, geographic environment and meteorological data; the model construction unit receives information of the data acquisition unit to calculate the atmospheric stability, determine the wind direction coefficient, calculate the gas leakage mass flow rate and calculate the dangerous gas concentration based on the leakage type; the prediction analysis unit receives the information of the data acquisition unit through wireless signal transmission, and outputs a three-dimensional diffusion image and delimits a dangerous area by combining the data of the model framework unit. According to the invention, through the combination of the gas analyzer and the weather station, real-time data of a diffusion site can be accurately obtained, so that the three-dimensional diffusion migration condition of dangerous gas leakage is simulated, a more accurate gas diffusion image is provided, and the accuracy and the efficiency of decision making and emergency response work of firefighters and rescue workers are effectively improved.

title_en: VR emergency exercise device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency exercise, in particular to a VR emergency exercise device which comprises an exercise device main body and an adjusting device, wherein the upper end of the exercise device main body is fixedly connected with two fixing seats, one sides corresponding to the two fixing seats are respectively provided with a sliding groove, the adjusting device comprises a center column, the center column is rotationally connected with the inner wall of the sliding groove, the outer wall of the center column is fixedly sleeved with a driving gear, and the inner wall of the exercise device main body is provided with a driving motor matched with the center column, so that a user can shake and reciprocate in the device, the body perception and virtual picture of the user can be adapted, the temporary field environment of natural disasters can be fully reflected in the device, the emergency exercise efficiency of the user can be improved, and the application range of the device can be increased.
assignees: NANJING ZHIYE YUNSHENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Test device for simulating karst ground subsidence
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of urban geological disaster simulation, and particularly relates to a test device for simulating karst ground subsidence, which comprises the following components: the underground geologic body model box is characterized in that two opposite sides of the underground geologic body model box are respectively communicated with a first water supply mechanism and a second water supply mechanism, a metering assembly is arranged in the underground geologic body model box, the center of the bottom surface of the underground geologic body model box is fixedly connected with a karst channel, the karst channel is vertically arranged, a third valve and a fourth valve are arranged on the karst channel, the fourth valve is positioned at the bottom end of the karst channel, the third valve is positioned at the top end of the karst channel, a muddy sand collecting device is arranged below the karst channel, and the karst channel is communicated with a karst water system. The utility model has the advantages of simulating complex working conditions of multi-factor coupling and conforming to practical conditions.

title_en: Ground disaster early warning data classification method based on GRU-DNN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground disaster early warning data classification method based on GRU-DNN, which comprises the steps of constructing an original data sample according to the data of the point positions of ground disaster warning, and performing category labeling to obtain a labeling sample; constructing a plurality of time sequence features and non-time sequence features from the labeling samples, screening the features with classification capability by using a decision tree model, constructing a final training sample, and training a deep neural network by using the final training sample to obtain a classification model capable of identifying normal alarm and false alarm for classification identification. The invention fully combines the characteristics of time sequence characteristics and non-time sequence characteristics, improves the classification capability of the model, adopts an encoder structure to improve the characteristic extraction capability of the model, introduces a weighted cross entropy function to further improve the recall rate of the model, greatly reduces the false alarm rate and improves the single early warning reliability, thereby furthest reducing the early warning false alarm rate on the premise of ensuring no missing report and effectively reducing the manpower and material resource consumption caused by false alarm.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;CHENGLI ZHIYUAN TECH CHENGDU CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for analyzing collapse form of building group after earthquake based on automatic building allocation modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing collapse morphology of a building group after earthquake based on automatic building allocation modeling, and relates to the technical field of civil engineering. Comprising the following steps: building a contour layered layer of each building to be allocated in the building group to be allocated, and generating a structural layout; automatically configuring building floors according to the number of building floors and the structural layout of the building to be matched to generate a building group three-dimensional building matching model; performing batch discrete block processing on the three-dimensional building allocation model of the building group to generate a discrete building model; obtaining a post-earthquake collapse form of a building group to be matched according to rigid body dynamics and a building discrete body model; analyzing the collapse form after earthquake according to the building collapse form evaluation index to obtain a collapse form analysis result after earthquake of the building group. The invention can realize the rapid earthquake collapse simulation of the large-area building group in the city, and the collapse form of the building is quantized through the collapse form evaluation index, so that decision basis is provided for personnel evacuation after earthquake and road trafficability analysis.
assignees: BEIJING UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Tropical cyclone wind ring radius prediction method based on MLP-CNN fusion model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tropical cyclone wind ring radius prediction method based on an MLP-CNN fusion model, which comprises the steps of collecting a historical tropical cyclone attribute database and a historical tropical cyclone satellite cloud image library, and carrying out normalization processing on data in the database; secondly, receiving historical tropical cyclone attribute data by using an MLP model, designing two hidden layers, and outputting a 4-dimensional attribute data feature vector; thirdly, inputting historical tropical cyclone satellite cloud image data by using a CNN model, and outputting a 4-dimensional image feature vector; fourthly, inputting the 4-dimensional attribute data feature vector and the 4-dimensional image feature vector, and determining a training set and a verification set according to a sample division ratio of 8:2; fifthly, performing iterative training on the training set to obtain a trained model, and substituting the verification set into the trained model to verify the trained model to obtain a fused WFM prediction model; the radius of the wind ring can be effectively predicted, and the capability of preventing tropical cyclone disasters is improved.
assignees: Wenzhou Meteorological Bureau;NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: River flow calculation model construction method, river flow calculation method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrologic calculation and discloses a river flow calculation model construction method, a river flow calculation method and a river flow calculation device, wherein the river flow calculation model construction method comprises the steps of acquiring a first water level time sequence data set at a downstream river section in the same time sequence, a second water level time sequence data set at the current river section and a water flow time sequence data set corresponding to the second water level time sequence data set; training a river flow calculation model to be trained based on the first water level time sequence data set, the second water level time sequence data set and the water flow time sequence data set until preset conditions are met, and generating a river flow calculation model, wherein the river flow calculation model comprises a first deep learning model and a second deep learning model. The technical scheme of the invention can realize rapid and accurate automatic river flow calculation and provide technical support for water resource management, flood control, disaster reduction and the like.

title_en: Surface water-proof and drainage design method for coal mining subsidence area of loess hilly shallow-buried thick coal seam
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for designing earth surface drainage prevention in a coal mining subsidence area of a loess hilly shallow-buried thick coal seam, which comprises the following steps: s01: predicting the subsidence range of the coal mining surface based on numerical simulation; comprising the following steps: s011: establishing a coal seam mining earth surface subsidence three-dimensional engineering geological model; s012: selecting a constitutive model; s013: determining a calculation parameter; s014: predicting the subsidence range of the coal mining surface; s02: determining the development height of a water-guiding fracture zone; s03: comparing the elevation of the top of the water guiding fracture zone with the elevation of the river bed, and determining the contact relation and the conduction range of the river bed on the surface and the water guiding fracture zone; s04: evaluating the risk of surface water leakage; s05: and carrying out drainage interception design on the coal mining subsidence area. The water-proof and drainage design method provided by the invention is used for treating the surface water in the coal mining subsidence area of the loess hilly shallow-buried thick coal seam, a systematic treatment scheme is provided from surface subsidence prediction to water-proof and drainage design, and the organic fusion of the ecological geological environment protection of the mine and the surface subsidence disaster prevention and treatment is realized.

title_en: Method for quantitatively predicting landslide disaster-causing range
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quantitatively predicting landslide disaster causing range, and belongs to the field of geological disaster risk assessment. According to the method, DAN3D landslide movement process analysis is carried out on the happened landslide disasters, landslide dynamic characteristics and accumulation distribution analysis results are compared with DAN3D simulation results based on multi-source data collaborative analysis modes such as seismic wave signal analysis and high-density resistivity method test, and numerical rheological parameters are adjusted to obtain accurate rheological models and parameters so that the numerical simulation results are most consistent with actual conditions. And carrying out numerical simulation on potential hidden danger points of the collapse disaster through DAN3D by adopting a rheological model and parameters which are determined cooperatively based on multi-source data, and predicting the disaster causing range of the collapse disaster. According to the invention, dynamic analysis software DAN3D is applied, the disaster causing range of potential hidden danger points of the collapse disaster is obtained, and a novel method is provided for developing risk evaluation of the potential hidden danger points of the collapse disaster.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY CHEMICAL DEV CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Bidirectional coupling rain Hong Moxing considering surface-pipe network water flow exchange effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bidirectional coupling rain and flood model considering the water flow exchange effect of a surface-pipe network, which comprises the following steps: collecting basic data in a research area; constructing a pipe network hydrological hydrodynamic model based on SWMM through basic data; constructing a two-dimensional earth surface overflow model based on an irregular grid through basic data; coupling the pipe network hydrologic model and the two-dimensional earth surface overflow model; and after the coupled model is subjected to calibration verification, urban waterlogging simulation is realized, and waterlogging water accumulation distribution and water accumulation depth are predicted. The model can realize the whole process simulation of urban waterlogging, and provides a novel technical method for disaster prevention, disaster reduction and early warning and forecasting of flood disasters in urban areas.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH;GUANGDONG LABORATORY OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND DIGITAL ECONOMIC GUANGZHOU

title_en: Substation rainfall flood risk assessment result analysis method and system based on simulation
abstract_en: The technical field of the application mainly comprises the fields of power engineering, hydrology, meteorology, environmental science, risk assessment and the like, and relates to a substation rainfall flood risk assessment result analysis method based on simulation, which comprises the following steps: carrying out storm scene simulation design by using a three-dimensional space digital model, a multi-scale environment data model and a two-dimensional coupling numerical simulation model; drawing a flood distribution map by using a substation rain and flood risk assessment model under different scenes; and after flood risk information interpolation and color matching are completed, the risk map is adjusted and modified. The method solves the problems that in the prior art, the rain and flood risk analysis of the transformer substation depends on manual subjective experience, single means, short plates exist and the like, can provide scientific basis for analysis and formulation of various plans such as flood disaster loss assessment, environmental risk control, flood control transformation and the like of the transformer substation, ensures that the flood disaster management and control of the transformer substation is in a certain vector, and is beneficial to improving the power supply quality.

title_en: Human body model for cerebral apoplexy teaching
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of clinical medical teaching models of special departments, and provides a human body model for cerebral apoplexy teaching, wherein (1) a liquid crystal simulated pupil is arranged on the human body model; (2) the left limb mimics the hemiplegia side; (3) reserving catheter indwelling passages such as a stomach tube, a urinary catheter indwelling passage, a CVC, a tracheotomy, a trachea cannula and the like and matched teaching pipelines; (4) the reserved injection site comprises: upper arm, thigh, periumbilical, etc.; (5) the ankle on both sides is suitable for ankle pump motion teaching. (6) Wrist can be selectively worn, a three-proofing wrist strap, a venous thrombosis mark and the like; (7) the groin can replace the DSA/interventional post-operation wound dressing device; replacement of skin reddish at the shoulder blade, sacral tail, heel simulates a pressure injury. The utility model is suitable for the care of critical cerebral apoplexy patients, is convenient for the rehabilitation guidance of mild patients, and has wide application range; the brain disease characteristic adaptability is higher, and the whole nursing thinking, individual nursing capability, emergency response capability and communication coordination capability of low-annual-resource nurses can be fully exercised.

title_en: City waterlogging intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system for urban waterlogging, comprising the following steps: constructing a road ponding scene database under different rainfall reproduction periods through a flood simulation method, determining the installation position of sensor monitoring equipment, associating the sensor monitoring equipment with an urban panoramic model, carrying out on-site data acquisition and monitoring through the sensor monitoring equipment, carrying out integrated display on processed and analyzed monitoring data obtained after processing and urban weather information and an urban waterlogging intelligent early warning platform, judging the well water level in the processed and analyzed monitoring data in the urban waterlogging intelligent monitoring early warning platform, calculating the rising rate and the roof-falling time of the well water level, generating yellow, orange and red early warning grades, acquiring urban waterlogging early warning information and weather disaster information, and releasing the urban waterlogging intelligent monitoring early warning information and the meteorological disaster information by the urban waterlogging intelligent monitoring early warning platform.

title_en: Estimation method, device, equipment and storage medium for slope instability scale
abstract_en: The application discloses a slope instability scale estimation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a digital elevation model of a side slope and point cloud data; establishing a three-dimensional finite element model of the side slope according to a first preset algorithm based on the point cloud data; performing parameter assignment on the three-dimensional finite element model based on rock mechanical parameters, and performing stability numerical simulation on the three-dimensional finite element model subjected to the parameter assignment; obtaining a plastic damage area of the three-dimensional finite element model according to the result of the stability numerical simulation and defining the plastic damage area as a potential collapse source; extracting a profile of a side slope based on the digital elevation model to carry out slope parameter inversion; intercepting a preset number of sections of potential collapse sources, and acquiring the maximum influence range of all sections based on collapse motion simulation; and superposing all the maximum influence ranges to obtain the destabilization scale of the side slope. According to the application, the scale of the slope instability is estimated through numerical simulation, the characteristic information such as the disaster body form, the boundary and the like can be accurately obtained, and the analysis accuracy of the slope instability is improved.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;INST GEOLOGY & GEOPHYSICS CAS

title_en: Power distribution facility rain and waterlogging submerged power outage risk prediction method and related device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power meteorological disaster prediction, in particular to a power distribution facility rain and waterlogging inundation power failure risk prediction method and a related device. Then inputting the current numerical weather forecast data into a trained neural network model, and predicting to obtain the latest forecast rainfall data; and finally, importing the latest forecast rainfall data into two-dimensional hydrodynamic simulation software to simulate the storm process, obtaining a storm flooding depth map of the research area, and predicting the power failure risk level of power distribution facilities of the research area. The method overcomes the defect of numerical weather forecast based on subjective experience of a forecaster, can more accurately forecast the storm inundation risk of the power distribution facilities, provides more accurate auxiliary information of the rain and waterlogging disaster to the operation scheduling of the power distribution network, and provides references for preventing and coping with the rain and waterlogging disaster.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Mining area image semi-supervised classification method based on multiple consistency constraints
abstract_en: The application relates to a mining area image semi-supervised classification method based on multiple consistency constraints, which comprises the following steps: acquiring mining area image training data; constructing a double-branch network structure based on a large-network-small-network weight network parameter pre-training framework; training a double-branch network structure, applying disturbance based on three layers of input-structure-characteristics, and keeping the prediction of a large network-a small network consistent through multiple consistency constraints; carrying out single-stage strengthening training based on self-training loss on the small network, and strengthening the characteristic extraction function of the small network; based on the consistency loss and the self-training loss of the multiple consistency constraint, constructing an overall loss function of the double-branch network, and optimizing parameters of the double-branch network by utilizing the overall loss function to obtain a trained double-branch network; and detecting mining area image disasters. The application has the beneficial effects that: the learning capacity and the robustness of the model are improved, the model is easily applied to mining area aerial survey disaster detection tasks under various scenes, and the model is good in universality and easy to implement.
assignees: WUHAN GEOLOGICAL RES CENTER CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Experimental platform and method capable of simulating leakage and diffusion of toxic gas under barrier movement condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toxic gas leakage and diffusion experiment platform and method under a simulated barrier movement condition, wherein the experiment platform comprises a toxic gas leakage model, a gas release system and a data acquisition system, the toxic gas leakage model comprises a gas diffusion cabin and a movable barrier, the movable barrier consists of a barrier part and a movable part, the movable part is a wireless remote control vehicle model, the movement speed of the barrier can be controlled through remote control, the gas release system comprises a gas storage device, a flow control device and a connecting conduit, and the data acquisition system comprises a gas detection instrument, a camera, a thermometer and a hygrometer and is used for data acquisition in the diffusion cabin. The invention can effectively simulate the influence of turbulence generated by the movement of the obstacle on the leakage and diffusion of toxic gas, thereby obtaining accurate experimental data and providing reliable experiment and data support for large-scale personnel evacuation and emergency rescue research in a toxic gas diffusion scene.

title_en: Directional drilling and injecting integrated system suitable for tunnel geological disaster treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oriented drilling and grouting integrated system suitable for tunnel geological disaster treatment, which comprises drilling and grouting equipment, wherein the drilling and grouting integrated system comprises a drill bit connected with a drill rod, the drill rod is of a hollow structure and is provided with a grouting hole communicated with a grouting pump, a stratum sensing sensor and a slurry sensor are arranged on the drill rod, rock stratum parameters and grouting pressure parameters are respectively acquired, and the rock stratum parameters and the grouting pressure parameters are sent to a control end to control drilling operation and grouting operation of the drilling and grouting equipment; a control terminal configured to: and obtaining matched drilling parameters according to the rock stratum parameters obtained by the stratum sensing sensor, the pre-constructed rock stratum model and the drill bit model so as to control the drilling and injecting equipment. And arranging a sensor on the drilling and injecting equipment to acquire rock stratum parameters, obtaining drilling parameters matched with the current rock stratum through a pre-constructed model and the acquired rock stratum parameters, and controlling the drilling and injecting equipment by using the drilling parameters, so that the drilling and injecting equipment can be quickly adapted to the rock stratum in a geological disaster influence area, and the improvement of disaster treatment efficiency is facilitated.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;SHENZHEN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF SHANDONG UNIV

title_en: Typhoon disaster damage prediction method based on CNN-LSTM model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster damage prediction method based on a CNN-LSTM model, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting typhoon disaster data of a region to be predicted in the past year, wherein the typhoon disaster data consists of typhoon attribute data, disaster bearing body data, disaster prevention capacity data and typhoon damage data, classifying and sorting the collected data according to time sequence to obtain a data set, dividing the data set into a training set and a test set by adopting a leaving method, inputting the training set as the typhoon disaster damage data set into a convolutional neural network for extracting features, then sending the training set to a long-term and short-term memory network for processing to obtain a prediction model, testing the obtained prediction model by adopting the test set, and repeating training and testing operations of the model until the optimal typhoon disaster damage prediction model is obtained if the accuracy of the prediction model does not meet the requirement. The method solves the problem of low prediction precision in the existing typhoon disaster loss prediction method.

title_en: Large-space fire detection analysis system and analysis method based on AI video analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-space fire detection analysis method based on AI video analysis, which relates to the technical field of fire monitoring, and comprises the following steps: step one, collecting fire coefficients of flammable liquid in a large-space warehouse; step two, acquiring a plurality of groups of fire light video images and smoke video images of a fire disaster place in a large space, and intercepting continuous multi-frame images of the fire disaster; step three, identifying motion change parameters of static environment features in continuous multi-frame images by using AI, and analyzing and obtaining fire light features, expansion features, region features, frequency features, position features and smoke spreading features; fitting the fire and light characteristics, the expansion characteristics, the area characteristics, the frequency characteristics, the position characteristics and the smoke spreading characteristics with the fire coefficients of flammable liquid, training and generating an algorithm model; optimizing an algorithm model, and setting a risk threshold; and step six, data are collected in real time and the risk threshold value is compared and analyzed.
assignees: JIANGSU NANGONG TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fire emergency multi-element interaction simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency multi-element interaction simulation method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring fire scene information, and constructing a virtual fire scene three-dimensional model, wherein the fire scene information comprises: fire equipment information for a fire scene, firefighter information for a fire scene, and environmental information for a fire scene; performing interactive simulation according to the fire-fighting equipment information of the fire scene, the firefighter information of the fire scene and the environment information of the fire scene, and calculating the comprehensive capability index of the firefighter, the fire extinguishing efficiency of the firefighter and the spreading speed of the fire under different environment conditions; setting a comprehensive fire extinguishing efficiency model, and calculating the comprehensive fire extinguishing efficiency of the firefighter under specific environmental conditions according to the comprehensive capability index of the firefighter, the fire extinguishing efficiency of the firefighter and the spreading speed of fire under different environmental conditions, so as to complete the interactive simulation of the firefighting emergency multiple elements.

title_en: Construction method for constructing externally-hung connecting channel in shield overlapping tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method for constructing an external connecting channel in a shield overlapping tunnel, which comprises the specific steps of 1) determining a main structure, a building envelope form and related parameters of a vertical shaft, ensuring the safety and reliability of the vertical shaft, 2) carrying out frozen hole drilling construction and hole forming analysis after a shield tunnel with a lower hole is penetrated, 3) freezing construction of the lower hole connecting channel, 4) freezing hole drilling construction of an upper hole connecting channel during freezing and analysis of freezing effect, 5) construction of the lower hole connecting channel and carrying out melting and grouting according to monitoring data, and simultaneously paying attention to deformation coordination and waterproof treatment, 6) freezing construction of the upper hole connecting channel, and 7) excavation, construction and melting and grouting of the upper hole connecting channel. The method can smoothly finish the construction of the externally hung connecting channel in the shield overlapping tunnel, reduce the potential risk of damaging the structure in the construction process, and ensure the maintenance and disaster prevention of the subway.

title_en: Reservoir group scheduling method and system coupled with artificial neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir group scheduling method and a reservoir group scheduling system coupled with an artificial neural network, comprising the following steps of S1, carrying out water level and flow state dispersion according to the upper limit and the lower limit of reservoir water level and the maximum value and the minimum value of historical storage flow, obtaining a data set comprising state combinations of the storage flow, the initial water level and the final water level, then calculating the discharging flow under different combinations through water balance, and calculating the output under different combinations through an output calculation formula; s2, taking a data set of the state combination as input, and correspondingly, the discharging flow and the reservoir output under different combinations as output, and constructing and training a reservoir discharging flow and output prediction model by using an ANN network; and S3, carrying out iterative computation on the reservoir discharging flow and the output prediction model into a POA algorithm, and carrying out reservoir group optimization scheduling. The invention obviously reduces the limitation of dimension disaster of the original algorithm while obtaining the dispatching optimization result almost similar to the original algorithm, thereby improving the calculation efficiency of the algorithm.

title_en: Emergency rescue scheduling method, system and storage medium for harbor major hazard sources
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue scheduling method, system and storage medium for serious dangerous sources of a harbor, which comprise the steps of obtaining the topographic azimuth information of the harbor, modeling according to the topographic azimuth information of the harbor, and determining the topographic position coordinates of the harbor; and acquiring the type of the dangerous source of the harbor district, and combining the past dangerous history data to simulate and divide the type of the dangerous source emergency of the harbor district. According to the invention, the dangerous source type and the terrain of the harbor are obtained in advance, the dangerous source diffusion degree of the harbor is divided, and rescue scheduling configuration of different degrees is carried out on the dangerous source diffusion degree of the harbor by combining historical data generated in the past, so that the rescue scheduling configuration can be carried out rapidly when a disaster is found, meanwhile, the scientificity of the rescue scheduling configuration and the effectiveness of rescue scheduling on dangerous conditions of the harbor are ensured by combining the historical data of the past. The safe, efficient and quick rescue scheduling can be realized after dangerous conditions occur in the harbor district. The safety of the harbor district is ensured.

title_en: Augmented reality based indoor fire training system
title_ko: 증강현실 기반 실내 소방 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: An augmented reality-based indoor firefighting training system is disclosed. The augmented reality-based indoor firefighting training system comprises: a plurality of access points (APs) disposed at preset intervals in an indoor firefighting training place and measuring and transmitting the received signal strength of Bluetooth signals transmitted by nearby Bluetooth devices; an augmented reality user helmet worn by a firefighting trainee who performs the firefighting training in the indoor firefighting training place and providing information to the firefighting trainee; a disaster reenactment device that re-enacts a disaster situation according to a pre-set training situation; and a central server that creates a training situation, transmits, to the augmented reality user helmet, training situation data and indoor map data for providing a training scenario set according to the training situation to the firefighting trainee, collects training data from the plurality of APs and the augmented user helmet during the firefighting training, and storing the training data collected after the training is terminated. The firefighting training system can support the firefighting training to cope with disasters.
abstract_ko: 증강현실 기반 실내 소방 훈련 시스템이 개시된다. 증강현실 기반 실내 소방 훈련 시스템은, 실내 소방훈련장에 미리 설정된 간격을 두고 배치되며, 주변에서 블루투스 기기가 송출하는 블루투스 신호의 수신신호세기를 측정하여 전송하는 복수의 액세스포인트(AP: Access Point), 실내 소방훈련장에서 소방 훈련을 수행하는 소방 훈련자가 착용하며, 소방 훈련자에게 정보를 제공하는 증강현실 사용자 헬멧, 미리 설정된 훈련 상황에 따라 재난 상황을 재연하는 재난 재연 장치 및 훈련 상황을 부여하고 부여된 훈련 상황에 따라 설정된 훈련 시나리오를 소방 훈련자에게 제공하기 위한 훈련 상황 데이터 및 실내 지도 데이터를 증강현실 사용자 헬멧으로 전송하고, 소방 훈련 중에 복수의 액세스포인트 및 증강현실 사용자 헬멧으로부터 훈련 데이터를 수집하고, 소방 훈련 종료 후에 수집된 훈련 데이터를 저장하는 중앙 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Disaster prevention training system and disaster prevention training method
abstract_en: To perform disaster prevention training in which a participant continues to participate with interest and being satisfied while using a remote.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention training method is performed using a disaster prevention training network program (53), and disaster prevention training remote data 59 is stored in a disaster prevention training database 55. The method includes: a disaster vicarious experience step (S250); a disaster prevention puzzle solving step (S300); a disaster prevention classroom lecture step (S350); and a stockpile check step (S400) for causing a user terminal (10) to display stockpile check matrix data (40). In the stockpile check step (S400), a check mark (45) indicating presence or absence of a stockpile (41) is displayed by an input from the user terminal 10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Locomotive fire detection system test device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a locomotive fire detection system test device and a locomotive fire detection system test method, wherein a side wall splice plate is spliced according to the lengths of a cab and a passenger compartment of a locomotive to form a side wall; the end wall splice plates are spliced according to the widths of a cab and a passenger compartment of the locomotive to form a first end wall and a second end wall; the roof splicing component splices according to the heights of a cab and a passenger compartment of the locomotive to form a roof; the invention solves the problems that the test space in the prior art is not close to the real size of the locomotive, the real environment in the carriage, the test simulation degree is low, the test reference value is low, the test cost is high and the like. The fire disaster test device can simulate locomotive scene environments of different models to develop fire disaster tests aiming at the detection device, is convenient and efficient to test, and can test fire disaster alarming timeliness of all vehicle types, thereby providing reliable and powerful experiment guarantee and basis for the design of a real locomotive fire disaster detection system.

title_en: Dynamic disaster prevention method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a dynamic disaster prevention method, a dynamic disaster prevention device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of coal seam mining. The dynamic disaster prevention method comprises the following steps: simulating exploitation is carried out on any group of coal beds to be exploited according to characteristic parameters of the coal beds to be exploited, and stress fluctuation during coal bed exploitation is determined; disaster prevention is performed according to stress fluctuation. According to the embodiment of the application, the coal seam of the mining area is mined in a simulation mode, so that the stress fluctuation condition is obtained, the analysis is performed based on the stress fluctuation condition, the area easy to generate dynamic disasters is determined, disaster prevention is performed, the danger in the coal seam mining process is reduced, and the mining safety is improved.

title_en: Probing, injecting and pumping integrated combustion and explosion suppression device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a probing, injecting and pumping integrated combustion-inhibiting and explosion-suppressing device which comprises a base, a composite drilling mechanism, a pneumatic motor, a magnetic coupling, a driving motor, a bearing shell, a gas conveying pipe, a high-pressure storage tank and a driving circuit, wherein the pneumatic motor and the driving motor are positioned in the bearing shell, the pneumatic motor is respectively connected with the composite drilling mechanism and the magnetic coupling through a transmission shaft, the magnetic coupling is connected with the driving motor through the transmission shaft, the driving motor is electrically connected with the driving circuit, the pneumatic motor is communicated with the high-pressure storage tank through the gas conveying pipe, and the driving circuit and the high-pressure storage tank are both positioned in the base, and are connected with the rear end face of the bearing shell. The application method comprises two steps of equipment assembly, fire-fighting operation and the like. On one hand, the invention can effectively meet the operation requirements of various firefighting rescue environments and effectively protect the circuit system; on the other hand, the operation of rapid detection, identification and fire extinguishing and cooling of the closed environment in fire control can be realized.

title_en: Flood disaster scene generation method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster scene generation method based on a generation countermeasure network, which comprises the following steps: collecting flood disaster related information, and establishing a text image pair data set; preprocessing the text image pair data set, and dividing the text image pair data set into a training set and a verification set; generating an countermeasure network model according to the constructed generator and the discriminator; training the dataset pair to generate an countermeasure network model using the text image; and generating a flood disaster image according to the text by generating an countermeasure network model. According to the invention, the text encoder is used as one of the parts of the generator to conduct pre-training, which is beneficial to generating high-quality images with higher fine granularity, in the fusion block, text information can be fully fused with image features under the condition of different image resolutions, the discriminator can accelerate the convergence of the generator by losing single output, high-quality flood disaster images can be generated, and meanwhile, the semantic consistency between the text and the generated images can be ensured.

title_en: Self-adaptive nonlinear simulation calculation method for rod piece buckling behavior
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power infrastructure, and discloses a self-adaptive nonlinear simulation calculation method for rod buckling behavior. The invention can rapidly and accurately simulate the buckling behavior of the component, and simulate the axial plastic elongation behavior generated by tensile yield and the plastic bending deformation behavior caused by buckling through the tension and compression spring and the rotation spring. The overall freedom number in the early stage of calculation is reduced through the self-adaptive spring mechanism, and the calculation efficiency is improved. The dynamic response is guaranteed to be rapidly and stably solved through a self-adaptive hidden-explicit continuous solving strategy. The invention provides a quick and simple analysis method for a designer in the aspect of design of the lattice tower, can build a disaster prevention and reduction visualization platform of the lattice tower, and has wide application prospect in the engineering field.

title_en: Method for up-and-down cooperative treatment of hydrogen sulfide in abandoned oil well in coal mine area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of coal mine safety, relates to mine hydrogen sulfide disaster prevention and control, in particular to an up-and-down cooperative treatment method for waste oil wells in a coal mine area, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out advanced treatment on alkaline absorption liquid injected under pressure in the ground area through drilling holes of the waste oil wells on the ground, and then the underground stoping roadway is used for constructing the bedding drill holes of the coal bed to carry out local area pressure injection alkaline absorption liquid treatment, and finally the coal wall construction trend bedding drill holes are used for carrying out short-hole injection alkaline absorption liquid supplementary treatment during stoping of the working face, and effect inspection is assisted, so that advanced, efficient and refined treatment of the coal bed hydrogen sulfide in the influence area of the abandoned oil well is realized.

title_en: LSTM ground disaster vulnerability time sequence prediction method considering InSAR deformation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an LSTM ground disaster vulnerability time sequence prediction method considering InSAR deformation, which belongs to the technical field of ground disaster prediction and trains a softmax model for evaluating ground disaster vulnerability based on time sequence optimization characteristics of ground disaster samples. And simultaneously training and updating an LSTM deep learning model for predicting the development trend of the optimized features in real time. And predicting the development trend of the optimized features by adopting an LSTM model, and determining the disaster vulnerability grade according to the future optimized features by utilizing a softmax classifier. The invention can acquire the future earth disaster liability of one month through the time series data of the first two years, and can provide a new thought for relevant departments to develop geological disaster prevention.
assignees: SUZHOU SHENLAN SPACE REMOTE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-locking fire-fighting roller shutter door principle simulation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses self-locking fire-fighting roller shutter door principle simulation equipment, which comprises a base, wherein a simulation box is fixedly connected to the top of the base, and a box door is fixedly connected to the front end surface of the simulation box; the box door is provided with an observation window, the center of the simulation box is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, and a placing rack is arranged on the mounting plate; the intelligent control device comprises a simulation box, wherein an operation cabinet is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the rear end face of the simulation box, a controller is fixedly connected to the center of the operation cabinet, a detection assembly is arranged at the top of the simulation box, and a rolling door assembly is arranged on one side of the inner wall of the rear end face of the simulation box; according to the fire-fighting roller shutter door, the plurality of components are matched for use, so that each action signal of the fire-fighting roller shutter door can be displayed when a fire disaster occurs, a learner can know the fire-fighting roller shutter door more thoroughly, the fire-fighting roller shutter door is deeply perceived through explanation of a lecturer, the fire-fighting roller shutter door is simple in structure, convenient to operate, high in automation degree, good in simulation effect and high in practicability.
assignees: KUNMING HUALONG ZHITENG TECH CO LTD;YUNNAN LAND & RESOURCES VOCATIONAL COLLEGE

title_en: Method for dynamically and quantitatively evaluating super-standard flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically and quantitatively evaluating a super-standard flood disaster, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring basic data of a research area; step 2, performing super-standard flood real-time dynamic simulation by using a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model based on GPU heterogeneous parallel acceleration; step 3, constructing the spatial distribution of the socioeconomic class data and establishing association with flood inundation characteristic parameters; step 4, calculating and establishing the relation between flood inundation characteristic parameters and various property flood damage rates; and 5, estimating the loss of the over-standard flood disasters. The method realizes real-time dynamic rapid quantitative assessment of the flood disaster exceeding the standard of the flood disaster, improves timeliness and accuracy of the flood disaster assessment, and provides references for the exceeding the standard flood dispatching decision and real-time coping; and the GPU heterogeneous parallel acceleration method is adopted to reconstruct a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, so that the consumption of computing resources is greatly reduced, and the computing efficiency of the model is improved.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Reservoir water condition forecasting simulation method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy informatization and flood control and disaster reduction, in particular to a reservoir water regime forecasting simulation method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining geographic, remote sensing, topography, engineering characteristics and engineering structure series data of a specific reservoir engineering research area, and constructing a reservoir three-dimensional twin scene by combining a three-dimensional modeling technology; acquiring reservoir characteristic data, modeling the reservoir characteristic data by using a preset hydrological model construction mode, and constructing a reservoir storage forecast model; acquiring reservoir historical flood data, and performing data rating on a reservoir storage forecasting model by utilizing the reservoir historical flood data to acquire an accurate reservoir storage forecasting model; constructing a big data model according to the historical flood data of the reservoir, and constructing a big data warehouse-in flow forecast model; based on the coupling forecasting results of the two models, an interactive interface is developed, and dynamic simulation of the forecasting flow water level result in the reservoir twinning scene is realized.

title_en: Comprehensive risk assessment method and device for deep inland typhoon disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for evaluating comprehensive dangers of deep inland typhoons, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a typhoon path probability evaluation model based on the subtropical high voltage; calculating according to the typhoon path probability evaluation model to obtain a typhoon path probability spatial distribution simulation result based on the subtropical high voltage; based on historical typhoon wind field data, carrying out simulation calculation on typhoon space distribution probabilities of different intensity levels by distribution to obtain typhoon intensity probabilities; and according to the typhoon path probability space distribution simulation result and the intensity probability result based on the subtropical high voltage, combining with regional disaster system theory to calculate and obtain the typhoon disaster comprehensive dangerous space distribution. The invention can simulate and evaluate the typhoon disaster risk of typhoon disaster frequent regions and rare regions, and greatly improves the scientific rationality of typhoon disaster risk evaluation results of inland and middle-high latitude data-lacking regions.

title_en: Fire control channel detection method based on lightweight architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting channel detection method based on a lightweight architecture, which comprises the following steps: acquiring fire-fighting channel data, marking, and constructing a fire-fighting channel data set; constructing a lightweight fire control channel detection model; performing iterative training on the firefighting channel data set in the lightweight firefighting channel detection model to obtain an optimal model, and outputting firefighting channel detection results in real time through the optimal model; and constructing an alarm mechanism and carrying out early warning according to the detection result. The invention solves the technical problems that the existing method for detecting the fire-fighting passage by operators is not convenient and accurate.

title_en: Multi-parameter prediction method for water quality of marine pasture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter prediction method for water quality of a marine pasture, which belongs to the technical field of water quality prediction and comprises the following steps: acquiring data of a plurality of water quality parameters acquired by a marine pasture monitoring sensor as an original data set, determining predicted water quality parameters by analyzing the importance of the water quality parameters, and screening all the water quality parameters by adopting pearson correlation coefficients to obtain input water quality parameters; preprocessing the data of the input water quality parameters and the predicted water quality parameters, dividing the data into a training set and a testing set, and processing the training set through a sliding time window; and constructing a water quality multiparameter prediction model based on the characteristic attention mechanism, the time attention mechanism and the deep LSTM network, and training and testing the model by adopting a training set and a testing set. The invention realizes the high-precision prediction of the water quality of the marine pasture with multiple parameters, improves the coping capability of sudden disasters, ensures the cultivation safety of the marine pasture, and reduces the cultivation risk and economic loss of the marine pasture.

title_en: Method for predicting icing disaster of rotating wind power blade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting icing disasters of a rotating wind power blade, which simulates an actual running environment through a rotating wind power blade icing vibration test platform; collecting vibration signals of the rotating wind power blade in different icing states and icing influence factor data; preprocessing the collected vibration signals in different icing states to obtain and collect vibration characteristic data in different icing states as sample data; constructing a wind power blade state prediction model based on the sample data and the icing influence factor data; and obtaining the icing state of the wind power blade according to the output result; and constructing a wind power blade icing disaster prediction model based on a gray theory according to the icing state of the wind power blade, and obtaining the position and moment of the icing disaster in the next time sequence of different positions of the wind power blade according to the output prediction result and the set icing disaster value. The icing state of the rotating wind power blade can be accurately predicted in real time, and the disaster occurrence time can be accurately predicted.

title_en: Typhoon wind field calculation method and device based on hydrodynamics
