abstract_en: The invention provides a typhoon wind field calculation method and device based on hydrodynamics, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring mountain data, and constructing a mountain model and a hydrodynamic calculation model according to the mountain data; simulating a hydrodynamic distribution model of each direction of a typical mountain according to the mountain model and the hydrodynamic calculation model, so as to obtain a wind speed simulation result; quantitatively analyzing the wind speed simulation result, and extracting typical mountain wind speed change characteristics; constructing a large-scale terrain correction factor calculation model suitable for typhoon disasters according to the characteristic of the variation of the wind speed of the typical mountain; and according to the mountain model, the hydrodynamic calculation model and the large-scale terrain correction factor calculation model, the typhoon wind field is finely simulated. The invention obtains a large-scale refined typhoon wind field, greatly improves the simulation speed and the space precision, and can rapidly evaluate the typhoon disaster surface high wind risk of large-scale complex terrains.

title_en: Manufacturing method and numerical simulation method of debris flow landslide model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing a debris flow landslide model, which comprises the steps of establishing a debris flow landslide three-dimensional solid model, manufacturing a substrate with a slope section of a pile body and the earth surface, and synthesizing the pile body slope model, and simultaneously providing a three-dimensional numerical model based on the debris flow landslide indoor model, wherein the three-dimensional numerical model comprises a pile body slope power test for verifying the reliability of the three-dimensional numerical model, a multi-scale pile body slope three-dimensional discrete element simulation and a debris flow landslide disaster-causing range influence mechanism analysis. According to the invention, the accumulation body is divided into the high slope substrate, the transition surface and the ground surface through the determined interfaces at the bottom and the top of the accumulation body, and all parts are manufactured respectively, so that the printing difficulty is further reduced, an indoor scale model of the accumulation body high slope of the surface is built, the prediction of the engineering scale landslide disaster-causing range is developed according to the model, the influence of topography and accumulation body mobility on the accumulation body sliding disaster-causing range can be fully considered in the later analysis, the accumulation body is more close to engineering practice, the current emergency disaster-preventing requirement on the prediction of the debris flow landslide disaster-causing range is met, and the technical support can be provided for rapidly making a landslide emergency disaster-preventing plan.

title_en: Rapid analysis method for wind deflection of power transmission line based on tower-line-insulator system equivalent model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid analysis method for wind deflection of a power transmission line based on a tower-line-insulator system equivalent model, which comprises the following steps: (1) Determining the shape of a power transmission line curve, and establishing a suspension insulator string-power transmission line connection model; (2) Establishing a numerical model of an electric tower-insulator string-power transmission line system; (3) Obtaining the wind deflection of the insulator string under the action of stable wind, and carrying out preliminary evaluation on the risk of the wind deflection of the insulator under the action of strong wind; (4) Considering the pulsation wind component of strong wind, simulating pulsation wind speed V, determining pulsation wind load, automatically generating load files, importing limited analysis programs, and analyzing and obtaining dynamic time course of insulator windage under the action of pulsation wind; (5) And carrying out wind deflection safety evaluation to provide wind deflection disaster early warning. The wind deflection calculation method greatly improves wind deflection calculation efficiency, and scientifically and efficiently solves the problems of wind deflection assessment and replay of the power transmission line in short-time strong wind or strong convection weather.

title_en: Forestry insect disaster prediction method and system based on regional historical data
abstract_en: The application discloses a forestry insect disaster prediction method and a system based on regional historical data, which relate to the technical field of forestry management and data processing and comprise the following steps: setting a plurality of acquisition points in a target forestry area, and acquiring image data; image filtering is carried out on the collected image data to determine suspected insect disaster image data in the collected image data; extracting insect disaster point characteristics based on suspected insect disaster image data, and inputting an insect disaster classification model to pre-judge the insect disaster; performing image processing according to the acquired suspected insect disaster image data, and extracting insect disaster image features; based on the extracted image features, adding labels according to a time sequence, training a insect disaster trend model, and predicting the development trend of the current insect disaster category; and alarming based on at least one insect disaster category with probability larger than a preset threshold value and the predicted development trend. The method can predict and early warn the development trend of insect disaster, thereby reducing the manpower input and improving the management efficiency of forestry areas.

title_en: Reservoir group flood control system evaluation method and device based on multi-scale coupling simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir group flood control system assessment method and device based on multi-scale coupling simulation, and belongs to the technical field of reservoir group flood control and disaster reduction capability assessment. The prior proposal does not disclose how to carry out scientific evaluation of flood flooding risks on the watershed outside the reservoir group body, which can affect the flood control effect of the reservoir group and the accurate evaluation of the capacity. According to the reservoir group flood control system evaluation method based on the multi-scale coupling simulation, the reservoir group flood control system evaluation based on the multi-scale coupling simulation is realized by constructing a multi-dimensional numerical simulation model, a watershed reservoir group coupling model, a reduction index calculation model, a multi-scale flooding index system and a flood control capability evaluation model. The invention can carry out scientific calculation of flood flooding risk of the river basin outside the reservoir body, and can carry out more comprehensive and multi-angle accurate assessment on the flood control effect and capacity of the reservoir group of the river basin by constructing a multi-scale flooding index system, thereby being more beneficial to popularization and use of the flood control system of the reservoir group.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUANSUAN TECH CO LTD;HANGZHOU WATER CONSERVANCY DEVELOPMENT PLANNING RES CENTER HANGZHOU FORESTRY WATER AFFAIRS GUARANTEE

title_en: Multifunctional roadway fire simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional roadway fire simulation experiment device which comprises a roadway main body, a fire source simulation system, a longitudinal ventilation system, a data monitoring system and an image acquisition system. The experimental device is a shrinkage size model with the similarity ratio of 1:10, and the roadway main body comprises two main line roadways and one branch roadway, so that the simulation of fire disasters of three types of single-line roadways, T-shaped roadways and H-shaped roadways can be realized. The invention overcomes the defects of high cost and inaccurate numerical simulation of full-size experiments, ensures the operability and repeatability of the experiments, can conveniently develop a series of basic theory researches such as fire development process, flame morphological characteristics, smoke flow rules and the like when fire occurs in different forms of tunnels, and has important guiding significance for the development of technologies such as fire detection, smoke control, personnel evacuation and the like.

title_en: Method and device for planning emergency evacuation path of mail wheel
abstract_en: The application provides a mail wheel emergency evacuation path planning method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional model of the postal wheel based on the structural parameters of the postal wheel; determining an evacuation topological graph based on the three-dimensional model of the mailbox, and determining at least two influencing factors influencing the time of passing by the passable road section; obtaining simulation accident parameters; determining an influence degree value of any influence factor based on the simulation accident parameters; determining the weight of the influence degree value of any influence factor based on a preset evaluation model, carrying out weighted summation on the weight of the influence degree value of at least two influence factors, and taking the weighted summation value as the evacuation weight value of the corresponding side of the evacuation topological graph; based on a preset path planning algorithm, taking an initial node where a person is located as a departure point, taking a preset exit node as an end point, and selecting an evacuation weight and a minimum passable road section from an evacuation topological graph as an optimal path. The application can effectively improve the safety of the escape of the mail wheels and the efficiency of the escape of the personnel under the sudden fire accident.

title_en: Method and emergency response system for real-time event management in a computer simulation environment
abstract_en: An emergency response system (200) and method (100) for real-time event management in a computer simulation environment. The method (100) includes determining a virtual model of a location of an event, and determining a plurality of real-time parameters and a plurality of predicted parameters associated with a plurality of entities at a physical location of the event using the virtual model of the location of the event. The method also includes displaying the real-time parameters and the predicted parameters in real-time to a user collaborating in the computer simulation environment, receiving input from the user to modify the real-time parameters and the predicted parameters in the computer simulation environment for event management, and sending instructions to an entity at the location of the event to modify the real-time parameters and the predicted parameters for event management.

title_en: Extended reality-based fire drill method and apparatus
title_ko: 확장 현실 기반 소방 훈련 방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: An extended reality-based fire drill method and apparatus therefor are disclosed. The extended reality-based fire drill method includes the steps of: (a) acquiring each object in real space and depth information of each object acquired through a stereo camera; (b) reconstructing each object into a 3D mesh object based on the depth information of each object; (c) generating a virtual fire in at least one of the reconstructed 3D mesh objects and then simulating a virtual fire suppression training augmented reality environment and transmitting it to a head mounted display device; and (d) operating the virtual fire extinguisher object in the virtual fire suppression training augmented reality environment according to the user's actual operation of the fire extinguisher, and extinguishing the virtual fire object by firing a virtual powder object toward the virtual fire object according to the operation of the virtual fire extinguisher object. The present invention can enable safe fire evacuation training based on virtual reality.
abstract_ko: 확장 현실 기반 소방 훈련 방법 및 그 장치가 개시된다. 확장 현실 기반 소방 훈련 방법은, (a) 스테레오 카메라를 통해 획득되는 현실 공간의 각 객체와 상기 각 객체의 깊이 정보를 획득하는 단계; (b) 상기 각 객체와 각 객체의 깊이 정보를 기초로 3D 메시(mesh) 객체로 각각 재구성하는 단계; (c) 상기 재구성된 3D 메시 객체 중 적어도 하나에 가상 불을 생성한 후 가상 화재 진압 훈련 증강 현실 환경을 시뮬레이션하여 헤드 마운티드 디스플레이 장치로 전송하는 단계; 및 (d) 사용자의 실제 소화기 조작에 따라 가상 소화기 객체를 상기 가상 화재 진압 훈련 증강 현실 환경상에서 동작시키되, 상기 가상 소화기 객체의 동작에 따라 가상 분말 객체가 상기 가상 불 객체를 향해 발사되어 상기 가상 불 객체가 소화되는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV SEJONG IND ACAD COOP FOUD

title_en: Generating virtual reality (VR) alerts for challenging streets
abstract_en: The following relates generally to providing virtual reality (VR) alerts to a driver of an autonomous vehicle. For example, a vehicle may be driving autonomously while the driver is watching a VR movie (e.g., on a pair of VR goggles); the driver may then receive a VR alert recommending that the driver take control of the vehicle (e.g., switch the vehicle from autonomous to manual mode). The following also relates to generating a VR feed for presenting real-time road conditions so that a user may preview a road segment. The following also relates to generating a VR feed corresponding to an event (e.g., a vehicle collision, a crime, a weather event, and/or a natural disaster).
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Urban rail transit station passenger evacuation simulation method and system
abstract_en: Compared with the traditional crowd evacuation simulation method, the method has the advantages of low cost, low risk, high simulation degree and the like, and therefore, the development of the crowd evacuation simulation technology is valued. The evacuation process of the subway station can be accurately simulated, and a new thought is provided for evacuating passengers in emergencies.

title_en: Emergency drilling management system for power grid disaster condition
abstract_en: The application provides a power grid disaster emergency exercise management system, which belongs to the technical field of disaster response and comprises the following components: and (3) defining a network topology structure of the power distribution network, and installing detection modules on corresponding nodes in the network topology according to the hierarchical relationship. When disaster electric energy cannot be normally transmitted to electric equipment, the detection module firstly checks the connected nodes. After the state of the node is determined, a voltage difference is formed between the two related detection modules, and if the voltage difference enables current to appear in a connecting line between the two nodes corresponding to the two detection modules, the connecting line is proved to be normal. And uploading the information determined by each detection module to a network topology, determining the source of disaster fault, and realizing auxiliary power supply of electric equipment through a converter of a node positioned at the source of the disaster fault. The power grid disaster emergency exercise management system provided by the application has the advantages that the disaster response is rapid, the source of a fault can be accurately identified, and the disaster management efficiency is improved.
assignees: CANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fire hydrant practical training simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire hydrant practical training simulation device, which relates to the field of fire-fighting equipment, and comprises a fire-fighting cabinet, wherein the fire-fighting cabinet is internally provided with: the starting button is detachably and fixedly connected with the fire-fighting cabinet and is used for outputting a starting signal; the sensing module is in signal connection with the starting button and is used for receiving the starting signal, detecting the connection state between the water gun and the fire hydrant and outputting a water gun state signal, detecting the connection state between the water gun and the fire hydrant and outputting a water pipe state signal, detecting the state of the control valve and outputting a control valve state signal; and the display is in signal connection with the sensing module and is used for playing operation demonstration animation, and simultaneously receiving and displaying a water gun state signal, a water pipe state signal and a control valve state signal. The intelligent fire control system has the advantages of improving the efficiency of fire control training, saving the time and effort required by professional firefighters to guide fire control practical training, and guiding trained personnel to correctly use the fire control cabinet.
assignees: SHANGHAI HUANDI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Impact energy early warning method and system for karst region
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for early warning impact energy in karst areas, wherein the flow comprises the following steps: collecting historical engineering geological data of a mine to be mined; arranging exploration points based on historical engineering geological data, and constructing a building foundation type; constructing a simulated mine based on the building foundation pattern; performing preliminary prediction on the simulated mine to obtain a preliminary prediction result; and constructing a prediction model based on the preliminary prediction result to obtain a final prediction result, and carrying out early warning on impact energy based on the final prediction result. According to the application, through simulating the change of the geological structure and the physical property, the release and accumulation process of impact energy is comprehensively mastered, and the geological disaster risk is accurately judged. Through data analysis and processing, the information originally needed to be monitored is converted into a feasible early warning standard, the early warning information is issued in time, and the early warning accuracy of geological disasters is improved.

title_en: Landslide direction integrated prediction device and method based on vector algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide direction integrated prediction device and method based on a vector algorithm, and relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring. The invention solves the problems that the existing landslide prediction does not carry out fusion analysis on the ground surface displacement monitoring data and the deep displacement monitoring data in the underground drilling, and the multipoint and multisource prediction method and equipment are lacked.

title_en: Indoor twin slope physical model test system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an indoor twin slope physical model test system and method, wherein the system comprises: a field prototype system, an indoor model system, a monitoring method, analysis and evaluation and mutual feedback adjustment; the field prototype system comprises a field prototype side slope, a hydrogeological condition and an environmental condition in which the field prototype side slope is positioned; the indoor model system comprises an indoor model slope and a simulation environment where the indoor model slope is positioned, and the material of the indoor model slope is determined after being converted by comparing with the rock-soil body material parameters provided by the prototype slope investigation; the indoor model slope is manufactured by layer filling according to the proportion of the prototype slope prototype; the indoor environment simulation is to apply the prototype slope environment index actually monitored on site to the slope model after proportional conversion. The invention combines the current advanced weather prediction means, can apply unfavorable weather conditions such as rainfall, earthquake and the like in future time to the model side slope in advance, and realizes the advanced simulation of model side slope disasters, thereby realizing the prediction and the prejudgment of the operation state of the prototype side slope.
assignees: SHANXI SMART TRAFFIC RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging simulation method based on urban time-varying gain model and RNN coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city waterlogging simulation method based on a city time-varying gain model and RNN coupling. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Collecting data in a research area; 2) Preprocessing data; 3) Constructing an urban waterlogging simulation model; 4) Performing parameter calibration on the constructed urban waterlogging simulation model; 5) And (5) simulating urban waterlogging and evaluating precision. The urban waterlogging simulation method based on the urban time-varying gain model and the RNN coupling solves the problem of synchronous optimization of hydrologic model parameters and neural network parameters, realizes the tight coupling of the hydrologic model and the RNN, improves the precision of waterlogging simulation, and has important significance for urban waterlogging early warning and urban waterlogging disaster prevention and control.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Liquid CO 2 Method for weakening hard roof of coal seam by phase change fracturing
abstract_en: The application discloses a liquid CO  2  The method for weakening the hard roof of the coal seam by phase change fracturing comprises the steps of collecting lithology parameters and physical and mechanical characteristic parameters of each rock stratum in the coal seam roof of 30-40 times of the coal seam mining height; determining all key layers in the coal seam mining height of 30-40 times of the coal seam roof according to the acquired lithology parameters and physical and mechanical characteristic parameters; calculating a primary compression limit span of each key layer under the action of tensile stress or a primary compression limit span under the action of shear stress, determining the maximum value in all calculation results, and defining the key layer corresponding to the maximum value as a fracturing layer; determining all pre-burst positions; liquid CO by means of a cable drill pipe  2  The phase change fracturing device is sent to a first pre-bursting position to finish bursting operation; the cable-passing drill rod is withdrawn from the directional long drilling hole, and the liquid CO is replaced  2  The phase change fracturing device repeats step 5 until the blasting operation of all pre-blasting positions is completed, and the application treats coalThe problem of strong mine pressure disaster caused by the hard roof of the mine provides a new method.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Pipe network leakage fault simulation device of fire-fighting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire control system pipe network leakage fault simulation device which comprises a supporting plate, a pipe network component and a vibration component, wherein the pipe network component is connected to the supporting plate and encloses a fire disaster area, the pipe network component comprises a plurality of spray heads facing the fire disaster area and a plurality of flow meters, and the vibration component is connected with the supporting plate; the vibration assembly comprises a driving piece and a transmission plate, wherein the transmission plate is connected with the supporting plate, and the driving piece periodically beats the transmission plate. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the service condition of the fire control system can be simulated more truly, and a more accurate simulation result can be obtained.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Advanced cooperative treatment method for multiple disasters of extra-thick coal seam
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of arranging drilling sites on two sides of a tunneling working face, determining the position of a target coal seam and the position of the drilling holes, performing directional drilling along the tunneling direction of the target coal seam at the position of the drilling holes to obtain main drilling holes, constructing branch drilling holes in the main drilling holes, performing staged hydraulic fracturing in the main drilling holes, and pumping out gas or draining water after the fracturing is finished.

title_en: Toughness support simulation method and device for power distribution network by multiple micro-grids and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for simulating toughness support of a power distribution network by multiple micro-grids and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution systems. The existing scheme makes decisions based on the daily optimization scheme and the daily optimization scheme, so that the timeliness is too short, the simulation result becomes inaccurate, the overall power supply rate of the power distribution system is affected, and popularization and use are not facilitated. According to the toughness support simulation method for the power distribution network by the multi-micro power grid, the toughness support simulation of the power distribution network by the multi-micro power grid is completed by constructing the broken line scene simulation model, the long period scheduling simulation model, the short period day-ahead simulation model and the power distribution network scheduling solving model, the long period optimization and the short period day-ahead optimization are simultaneously carried out, and the rolling optimization is carried out in the whole period of a disaster, wherein the long period optimization provides guidance data for day-ahead optimization, so that the method is matched with a natural disaster lasting for a plurality of days, the toughness support effect can be effectively improved, the overall power supply rate effect of a power distribution system is improved, and the economic benefit of the multi-micro power grid can be improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Bridge vulnerability assessment method based on debris flow dynamic process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge vulnerability assessment method based on a debris flow dynamic process, which relates to the technical field of debris flow damage monitoring, and comprises the following steps: and obtaining a quantitative relation between the debris flow intensity and pier top displacement through training and evaluating an artificial neural network model, obtaining a pier top displacement probability distribution function through statistical analysis of pier top displacement of a plurality of samples obtained by utilizing the artificial neural network model, and obtaining failure probability of the pier by combining vulnerability index grading standards. The method can timely master the probability that the bridge is damaged to different degrees under the impact of the mud-rock flows with different intensities, so as to timely perform disaster prevention and fighting work.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Daily correction method for remote sensing precipitation product based on scale analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a daily correction method of a remote sensing precipitation product based on scale analysis, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, precipitation data processing and evaluation; step 2, calculating a grid day correction coefficient of the site; step 3, correcting the daily correction coefficient; step 4, correcting multiple spatial scales of remote sensing precipitation data; and 5, analyzing and optimizing different correction scales. The daily correction method of the remote sensing precipitation product based on the scale analysis overcomes the defects of the existing correction method when the ground measured data and the remote sensing precipitation data are processed and corrected in a fusion way on the basis of the scale analysis, greatly improves the precision of the remote sensing precipitation product, is convenient and fast, has strong applicability, and provides data support for water circulation simulation, weather disaster prediction and the like.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;ZHEJIANG HYDROLOGICAL MAN CENTER;CHUNAN COUNTY QIANDAOHU ECOLOGICAL COMPREHENSIVE PROT BUREAU CHUNAN COUNTY WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYD

title_en: Building fire-fighting design evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building fire control design evaluation method, which relates to the technical field of fire control detection evaluation and comprises the following steps: s1, an information acquisition stage comprises acquisition of building information and fire fighting information in a building; s2, in an information arrangement stage, integrating and summarizing the building information and the fire fighting information acquired in the S1 to form basic data; s3, in the information analysis processing stage, carrying out integration calculation according to the basic data obtained in the S2 to obtain expected index data; and S4, carrying out disaster simulation by combining actual building actual information to obtain data, and comparing the data with expected index data. The invention solves the technical problems that the existing building fire-fighting design evaluation has limitations, so that the defect of the building fire-fighting design cannot be effectively solved, and the data obtained in the building fire-fighting design evaluation are not accurate enough.

title_en: Method for forecasting flood of medium and small river based on digital twin and AI technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster forecasting, and discloses a method for forecasting medium and small river floods based on digital twinning and AI technology, which comprises the following steps: screening out local river areas with high risk marks and medium risk marks; performing comprehensive evaluation analysis processing based on the high-risk marks and the medium-risk marks to acquire first output data; carrying out regression analysis processing on the historical river data by utilizing a pre-constructed flood regression model to obtain second output data; performing simulation analysis processing on the actually measured river data by using a pre-constructed river digital twin model to obtain third output data; taking the actually measured river data and the first output data as a first sample set, taking the historical river data and the second output data as a second sample set, and taking the actually measured river data and the third output data as a third sample set; constructing a flood prediction model based on the first sample set, the second sample set and the third sample set; and carrying out prediction analysis on the medium and small rivers by using a flood prediction model.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HUASHUI ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster-oriented vehicle and unmanned aerial vehicle combined distribution path optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster-oriented vehicle and unmanned aerial vehicle combined distribution path optimization method and system, and relates to the technical field of path planning. Firstly, acquiring vehicle information, unmanned aerial vehicle information and customer node information, wherein the customer node information comprises non-road blocking area customer node information and road blocking area customer node information, and the road blocking area customer node can only carry out material distribution through an unmanned aerial vehicle; then constructing a vehicle-machine collaborative distribution model based on the various information; finally, clustering the customer nodes by adopting a clustering algorithm based on the vehicle-machine collaborative distribution model, and acquiring the parking positions of vehicles in the customer nodes in the non-road blocking area; and on the basis of determining the parking position of the vehicle, acquiring an optimal path of the combined delivery of the vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle by using a genetic simulated annealing algorithm. The invention designs the vehicle-machine collaborative distribution model which accords with the actual situation, and effectively solves the technical problem of low distribution efficiency of a distribution path planned by the prior art.

title_en: Fire real-time monitoring and predicting method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire hazard real-time monitoring, intelligent alarming and/or intelligent predicting method and system based on video images. The fire disaster real-time monitoring and predicting method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of receiving monitoring information of flames and smoke in a fire scene and fire position information (S130), analyzing and calculating the monitoring information of the fire scene in real time by utilizing a fire scene prediction model to dynamically predict fire development and generate a prediction result of the fire scene (S140), adjusting a fire control strategy in real time according to the prediction result of the fire scene, and storing the collected fire information and the prediction result into a fire database (S150). The method further includes generating fire scene numerical simulation data for artificial intelligence model training and saving the data in a fire real-time monitoring database (S110), and training an artificial intelligence model using the data to generate a fire scene prediction model (S120). The system may include a user side (100) and a server side (200).

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system for early warning of electric fire
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent monitoring system for early warning of electric fire, which comprises: the method comprises the steps of obtaining video images, grouping the video images into a plurality of sub-video images, calculating feature vectors in each video image by utilizing the change condition of pixels in the sub-video images, and training a support vector machine through the feature vectors so as to predict fire conditions. The application has the beneficial effects that: the fire disaster condition detection of the target video image is realized, so that the fire disaster without open fire can be found out according to the fire disaster condition, the fire disaster identification degree is improved, and the property safety of other equipment is protected.

title_en: End-to-end automatic driving system and method based on layered constraint and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses an end-to-end automatic driving system, a method and a vehicle based on layered constraint, which are used for carrying out data analysis and feature fusion on RGB images and point cloud images through a state extraction module so as to determine the state features of the vehicle and improve the integrity and reliability of environmental features; the driving decision-making module is layered, a high-level decision-making network module determines a high-level decision-making of the vehicle, a low-level decision-making network module determines a low-level decision-making, and a constraint network module calculates a corresponding risk value, so that the high-level decision-making and the low-level decision-making are constrained based on risk value feedback; the method has the advantages that the problem of dimension disasters in the module training process is avoided through layered decision, the interpretability and reliability of end-to-end automatic driving are improved, and the problem that the reliability of automatic driving control is not high due to difficult feature expression and lack of decision constraint and interpretability, so that driving safety cannot be guaranteed is avoided.

title_en: Evacuation traffic control optimization method
abstract_en: The application discloses an evacuation traffic control optimization method, which comprises the steps of obtaining data of a current local sudden disaster scene, an evacuation traffic demand scene, a road network structure and attributes, establishing an objective function according to the obtained data of the evacuation traffic control optimization, and then constructing a mixed integer linear programming model as constraint conditions; solving an optimal solution of the evacuation traffic control optimization model by calling a solver, and obtaining an evacuation traffic control optimization scheme of the disaster area road network; establishing an objective function and constraint conditions of current real-time evacuation traffic control optimization based on the obtained evacuation traffic control optimization scheme; and circularly executing the steps, and obtaining a final evacuation traffic control optimization scheme by simulating different disaster scenes, evacuation traffic demand scenes, road network structures and attributes. The application designs an evacuation traffic control optimization scheme for the potential disasters by acquiring the lane reversing and cross conflict steering control rules of evacuation traffic operation under the local sudden disasters.

title_en: Power model test device for debris flow scouring performance of transmission tower
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a power transmission tower power model test device for scouring performance of debris flow, which comprises a power transmission tower model, a first sensor, an image device and a debris flow simulation device, wherein the power transmission tower model comprises a substrate arranged on a working surface and a bottom frame arranged on the substrate, and a stand column arranged on the top of the bottom frame, the debris flow simulation device is arranged on the working surface and is used for providing debris flow for the power transmission tower model, the image device is arranged on the working surface and is used for collecting the flow track of the debris flow and the scouring track of the debris flow on the power transmission tower model, the first sensor is provided with a plurality of sensors, each first sensor is used for sensing the stress response of the bottom frame under the action of the debris flow impact, and further the stress of the power transmission tower model can be quantitatively analyzed, and the influence of the debris flow on the power transmission tower model can be more accurately known through quantitative analysis, so that a designer can optimize the structure of the power transmission tower and improve the disaster resistance of the power transmission tower according to the quantitative data.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Urban waterlogging simulation method based on terrain feature deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city waterlogging simulation method based on terrain feature deep learning, which comprises the steps of constructing a city waterlogging model, extracting terrain feature factors and rainfall feature factors closely related to waterlogging, designing different rainfall event scenes, generating waterlogging inundation data by combining the constructed city waterlogging model, and constructing a terrain feature deep learning waterlogging simulation database; and carrying out data conversion and normalization processing on the data in the database, adopting the topographic feature factor and the rainfall feature factor which are concentrated in the test as input, testing the trained deep convolutional neural network urban waterlogging model to obtain a final deep convolutional neural network urban waterlogging model, and realizing the simulation of a rainstorm waterlogging mask. The method can effectively improve the efficiency of simulating the rainstorm and waterlogging in the area with high waterlogging disasters.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH;GUANGDONG LABORATORY OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND DIGITAL ECONOMIC GUANGZHOU

title_en: Characterization method for energy transfer between coal strata under influence of deep mining
abstract_en: The invention relates to a characterization method of energy transfer between coal strata under the influence of deep mining, and belongs to the technical field of coal seam detection. The method comprises the following specific steps: selecting a deep mine coal rock sample for mechanical parameter measurement, setting a simulation scheme based on the measured coal rock mechanical parameter, optimizing and adjusting numerical simulation based on laboratory single-axis experiments in the first group, and researching coal rock energy partition characteristics and coal rock energy transfer characteristics by utilizing the numerical simulation in the second group, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: and setting monitoring positions, recording elastic energy data of the corresponding positions and the same time, making difference values for the elastic energy of the same time and the same position, and analyzing energy transfer characteristics. The invention fully considers the elasticity of the interlayer transfer of the coal and rock in the coal and rock gas dynamic disasters, simultaneously provides a monitoring and calculating method and a specific quantitative calculation method, and can provide a beneficial reference for the deep well coal and rock gas dynamic disasters disaster mechanism research.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Geological disaster rainfall monitoring data missing value filling method
abstract_en: The application provides a filling method of a missing value of rainfall monitoring data of geological disasters, which comprises the following steps: processing the rainfall monitoring data according to the relative longitude and latitude where the rainfall sensor is located and the duration of the rainfall monitoring data to generate a three-dimensional characteristic diagram; dividing a time window for the three-dimensional feature map in a time dimension to form a plurality of samples with the same time length; inputting the three-dimensional feature graphs of a plurality of samples into an off-line training multi-core cavity convolutional neural network to perform off-line training treatment so as to obtain a network structure and network parameters after off-line training; inputting the three-dimensional feature map to be subjected to missing value filling, the network structure after offline training and the network parameters into an online filling multi-core cavity convolutional neural network, and carrying out online filling processing on the three-dimensional feature map to be subjected to missing value filling to obtain an online reconstructed three-dimensional feature map. By applying the technical scheme of the application, the technical problem that the monitoring effect is affected by the lack of geological disaster rainfall monitoring data in the prior art can be solved.
assignees: AEROSPACE SCIENCE AND INDUSTRY INERTIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle controls real equipment of instructing
abstract_en: The utility model provides unmanned aerial vehicle control training equipment, which comprises: a mobile device; the mobile device includes a base and a drive wheel supporting the base; the inside of the base is provided with an independent annular cavity and a hollow cavity, and the surface of the base is provided with a plurality of first air outlet nozzles communicated with the annular cavity; the base is rotationally connected with a rotating disk; a plurality of second air outlet nozzles communicated with the hollow cavity are circumferentially arranged on the rotating disk; the rotary disk is connected with a driving mechanism, and an air supply conversion pipeline is connected between the annular cavity and the hollow cavity; a plurality of training air decks are circumferentially arranged on the base. According to the utility model, the teacher controls the mobile device to move along with the unmanned aerial vehicle, and controls the first air outlet nozzle or the second air outlet nozzle to alternately replace air outlet, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle is interfered to fly normally, students are trained to control emergency response, the proficiency is increased, safer take-off or landing operation is ensured, and the damage of the device is reduced.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA TECHNICAL COLLEGE MECH & ELECTRICS

title_en: System and method for wildfire spread behavior forecasting and on-parcel wildfire risk evaluation
abstract_en: A system and method for wildfire spread behavior forecasting and on-parcel wildfire risk evaluation is disclosed. An example embodiment comprises an autonomous planning agent that learns spatio-temporal distributions of firefighting equipment and personnel that minimize asset losses from wildfires in the wildland urban interface. Drawing on large volumes of earth observation data and official incident status reports, the system utilizes artificial intelligence (AI) methods to develop a control system that produces expressive, spatiotemporally explicit resource assignment policies for use in a decision support system. In particular, the key components of the system are: (1) a neural-network-based fire behavior simulator capable of accurately modeling wildland fire ignition, spread, and control; (2) a learning algorithm that produces coherent firefighting strategies given current and forecast weather and fuel conditions; and (3) a wildfire hazard evaluation algorithm that evaluates the impact of home hardening, defensible space, and other common wildfire hazards found on residential parcels.

title_en: Portable, self-contained liquid storage transport system and device
abstract_en: A mobile water/fluid collection, recirculation management apparatus and system for the promotion of best and safest practices by firefighting engineers, candidates fire departments, agencies, colleges and academies as well as for the NFPA (National Pire Protection Agency) recommended annual testing of other apparatuses, pumps, and appliances, which allows for engineers and candidates to train and practice their requisite evolutions and drills using full-flow water/fluids at full and various pressures including, but not limited to, drafting, flowing hand lines, deck guns, ground monitors, aerials and ladder pipes, nozzles and appliances while returning the water/fluid to the apparatus via direct and indirect connections. All returning water/fluids encounter the diffuser screen that is internal and integral to the unit and/or via the roof target and associated diffuser. Included is a removable, portable training fire hydrant which allows for the engineers and candidates to get real world driver training including spotting the hydrant and the race for water training elements, requiring the engineer/candidate to stop in the right spot, hook up the correct hoses from their engine to the hydrant directly to the invention apparatus, to pump and flow water safely, accurately and efficiently, and, once filled with the requisite water/fluid, it is ready for continuous recirculation, training or testing evolutions without overheating the water/fluid, because it is continuously cooled passively with the diffusers in an open loop design.

title_en: Flood prevention disaster-resistant emergency simulation demonstration device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flood control and disaster resistance emergency simulation demonstration device which comprises a main machine case, an imaging table and a rotation installation assembly, wherein the main machine and the imaging table are assembled and installed through the rotation installation assembly, and the imaging table is positioned above the main machine; the imaging table comprises a table shell, an imaging groove is integrally formed in the middle of the table shell, and a 3D interference projector is embedded in the groove wall of the imaging groove; through the formation of image inslot 3D interference projector of formation of image platform for produce the environment topography of gathering under in the formation of image inslot, then simulate the condition when taking place to the flood by the host computer of mainframe box, then carry out more nearly true simulation to the flood that takes place through 3D image, simulate the implementation to flood prevention means simultaneously, can obtain the effect of change, and under the formation of image platform can carry out pivoted centre gripping, make the participant can carry out simulation effect through different angles and observe, thereby seek the defect, the scheme improves.
assignees: YUNYANG METEOROLOGICAL BUREAU;TIANJIN HUOSAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-flow layer-penetrating drilling hole-washing incremental device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-flow layer-penetrating drilling hole-washing increment device, which belongs to the technical field of mining equipment and comprises a hole packer, wherein a high-pressure rubber pipe is fixedly connected to the hole packer, one end of the high-pressure rubber pipe, which is far away from the hole packer, is fixedly connected with a tee joint assembly, the other two ends of the tee joint assembly, which are far away from the high-pressure rubber pipe, are respectively fixedly connected with a first stop valve and a second stop valve, a pressure gauge is fixedly connected between the first stop valve and the tee joint assembly, and one end, which is far away from the pressure gauge, of the first stop valve is fixedly connected with a water inlet pipe. According to the utility model, through the structure, the drilled holes are treated, the abnormal problems of hole collapse and hole blockage caused by the fact that part of drilled holes have gas concentration, no flow and the like are solved, the hole is sealed by expansion of the water injection hole packer, the high-pressure water pipe is externally connected to perform high-pressure water injection hole washing, the blocked coal body is impacted by the high-pressure water, the coal powder is brought out of the hole by the pressure release water, a gas emission channel is dredged, the gas extraction rate is improved, and the disaster prevention effect of a mine is guaranteed.
assignees: ANHUI BOZHOU COAL IND CO LTD YUANDIAN ERJING COAL MINE

title_en: Mechanism-guided ANN-based prediction method for bearing capacity of RC bridge pier after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanism-guided ANN-based method for predicting the bearing capacity of an RC bridge pier after a fire disaster, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a residual bearing capacity database of a reinforced concrete bridge pier after the fire disaster by using a numerical simulation method, and then constructing and training a residual bearing capacity prediction neural network of the reinforced concrete bridge pier after the fire disaster to obtain a residual bearing capacity prediction model of the reinforced concrete bridge pier after the fire disaster; and finally, inputting the fire conditions, the material properties, the section characteristics and the loading conditions into a trained neural network model, outputting the residual bearing capacity of the pier after the fire disaster, and comparing with a real result to verify the effectiveness of the invention. The invention solves the problems of complex modeling, time consumption in calculation and the like in the traditional post-fire reinforced concrete pier bearing capacity analysis, realizes the rapid judgment of the residual bearing capacity of the reinforced concrete pier according to the fire condition and the structural parameter, and is beneficial to the safety evaluation and emergency rescue of the post-fire reinforced concrete pier.

title_en: Electric power emergency material demand prediction method and system considering sudden weather disasters
abstract_en: The application provides a power emergency material demand prediction method and a power emergency material demand prediction system considering sudden weather disasters, wherein a power grid area of a current sudden weather disaster is selected as a target area, and other power grid areas with historical weather disasters are selected as source areas; respectively extracting characteristics of multi-mode meteorological characteristic vectors in a target domain and a source domain, and realizing multi-mode data characteristic fusion based on a characteristic sharing mechanism; calculating the correlation degree of the source domain data and the target domain data, and selecting the source domain data with high correlation degree to migrate to the target domain to form a migrated meteorological sample data set; and inputting the meteorological sample data set into a meteorological feature and electric power material demand mapping relation model for training, and predicting the electric power material demand under the current sudden meteorological disaster by using the model. The method and the device effectively solve the problem that the deep learning model is poor in performance in a small sample scene, provide scientific references for emergency decisions of sudden accidents of the power grid, and remarkably improve the prediction precision of electric power emergency materials.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LIANGSHAN COUNTY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;JINING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Engineering roadway gas coal dust explosion test system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of gas coal dust disaster prevention and control, and discloses an engineering roadway gas coal dust explosion test system, which comprises a simulated roadway, wherein the simulated roadway comprises a main roadway and a secondary roadway which are communicated; the main lane comprises a gallery communicated with the auxiliary lane and an inclined lane communicated with the outside; an explosion-proof door and an explosion chamber are arranged at the joint of the gallery and the auxiliary gallery; a plurality of coal dust frames are axially arranged in the upper space of the gallery along the gallery; the two side walls of the middle part of the gallery are buried with a plurality of test boxes communicated with the pipelines, a plurality of sensors are arranged in the test boxes, and cables of power supplies and sensors are laid in the communication pipelines. According to the scheme, the explosion of a real roadway or the coal dust explosion scene caused after the real explosion is simulated, so that the spreading rule and the disaster-causing mechanism of the gas coal dust explosion of the engineering level are effectively researched, and the explosion suppression performance of the roadway can be researched by using explosion suppression equipment, so that theoretical models and bases are provided for reducing or even avoiding the underground coal mine explosion injury, and the safety of the underground coal mine and the gas mine operation is further improved.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Building function identification method based on time sequence mobile phone signaling data and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building function identification method based on time sequence mobile phone signaling data and machine learning, which comprises the steps of acquiring time sequence mobile phone signaling data and GIS platform data, and preprocessing the time sequence mobile phone signaling data and the GIS platform data; dividing urban building function types based on dynamic change rules of people on working days and non-working days in a building, carrying out normalization processing on the mobile phone signaling time sequence data, selecting model training and testing samples, taking normalized time sequence mobile phone signaling data as independent variables and real building function types as dependent variables, constructing a building function classification model based on a random forest machine learning method, and extracting the building function types through the mobile phone signaling random forest classification model. The method is used for identifying the building function type based on the relevance of the mobile phone signaling time sequence information and the building function type, and can be applied to data decision of city planning, management and emergency response.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Warmhouse booth fire monitoring system based on independently remove robot platform
abstract_en: The application discloses a greenhouse fire monitoring method based on an autonomous mobile platform. The training and improvement of yolo5s is carried out by utilizing the thought of edge calculation, then the design is light-weighted, and the training and improvement is transplanted to an industrial personal computer, so that the robot has the capabilities of autonomous navigation and fire disaster identification, unmanned patrol of the greenhouse and autonomous data processing are realized, and the system has an alarm function. Finally, a man-machine interaction QT interface is designed at the PC end, so that the functions of forcedly controlling the robot, displaying fire images, maps, sensor data and the like in real time are realized. The application solves the problems of complex arrangement, high cost and monitoring blind areas of fire detection in the greenhouse, has unique flexibility, can increase functions required by fire extinguishment, irrigation and the like on a platform in the later stage, and realizes diversified purposes.

title_en: Industrial conduction mechanism analysis method for disaster caused by typhoons during recovery period
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial conduction mechanism analysis method for disaster caused by typhoons during recovery, which comprises the following steps: collecting relevant data to construct an input-output table of the area; simulating a recovery path of the economic system after disaster; the distribution analysis of indirect economic losses caused by disasters among different economic departments; analysis of the industrial conduction mechanisms of disasters during recovery. The invention is not limited to evaluating indirect economic loss caused by disasters, but utilizes the adaptive regional input-output model to simulate the recovery period, and identifies the key industrial conduction path and key industrial departments of the recovery period through structural path analysis and network analysis. The method can more objectively reveal the influence of disasters on the industrial chain, help decision makers to make emergency management measures more comprehensively, improve reconstruction efficiency, and effectively guide and adjust the adaptability of the industrial system.

title_en: Multi-parameter rock burst risk prediction method based on time sequence model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering, in particular to a multi-parameter rock burst risk prediction method based on a time sequence model, which comprises the following steps: and (3) a step of: carrying out equalization treatment on microseismic data in the whole process of each rock burst disaster formation, so that each hour corresponds to the value of an event number, energy release and apparent volume; and II: normalizing the event number, energy release and apparent volume; thirdly,: scaling the value of the accumulated event number, the accumulated energy release and the accumulated apparent volume to between 0 and 1; fourth, the method comprises the following steps: establishing a data sample base for accumulating the change trend of the apparent volume and the energy index; fifth step: establishing a multi-element parallel time sequence prediction model based on a convolutional neural network; sixth,: training a model; seventh,: and inputting a plurality of parallel time sequences of accumulated view volume and energy indexes, and outputting data evolution in a future time period corresponding to the 2 microseismic parameter variables so as to predict the rock burst risk. The invention can better predict the rock burst risk.

title_en: Multi-user collaborative network security emergency response and exercise platform and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a network security emergency response and exercise platform with multi-user cooperation and an operation method thereof, which comprises a server side, a client side and a storage side, wherein a user can log in the server side for operation through the client side, a virtual experiment scene is built by using an exercise scene management module, communication and cooperation are carried out through a shared file system and a real-time communication tool, the user can handle network attack events in real time and reflect operation in real time through remote desktop software, a monitoring and log module records operation and events in real time, a statistics and analysis module generates a report and visual display, and an exercise result evaluation module evaluates and analyzes exercise results. The platform provides various emergency exercise scenes, improves the safety threat coping capability of emergency response personnel, and ensures traceability and version control of cooperative operation through the virtualized platform, the shared file system and the version control system.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION RADIO AND TELEVISION MONITORING AND DEV CENTER

title_en: Disaster indirect economic impact assessment method and device and computing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster indirect economic impact assessment method, a device and computing equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an area input-output table in a period after disaster in a disaster area; the input-output table prediction method based on the matrix conversion technology is utilized, and after disaster, the regional input-output table of year can be obtained by combining with the matrix conversion technology, and the post-disaster area year time sequence technology coefficient matrix is simulated; the simulated time sequence technical coefficient matrix and the predicted added value of the departments under the disaster-free condition are embedded into an improved dynamic adaptive area input-output model, so that the indirect economic loss of the disaster area caused by the serious natural disaster is estimated. The invention can evaluate the indirect influence of the major natural disasters on regional economy, and can evaluate economic indexes such as loss of economic output after disaster, loss of industrial added value, rising of material price and the like according to the result of the model.

title_en: Ocean disaster prediction and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting and early warning ocean disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical sea area information of a certain sea area, wherein the historical sea area information comprises: the angle of the submarine ramp, the water depth from the seabed to the sea level, the seismic source depth, the distance from the shore, the frequency value of the seismic source, the horizontal flow speed of the seawater, the ocean current speed, the submarine topography value, the seawater density value and the geographic characteristic value; setting a marine disaster prediction model, training the marine disaster prediction model according to historical sea area information, calculating a predicted value of the marine disaster according to real-time sea area information by the trained marine disaster prediction model, and predicting and early warning the marine disaster, wherein the marine disaster prediction model comprises: and calculating a water body state value according to the horizontal flow speed of the seawater and the ocean current speed, and calculating a submarine topography value according to the angle of the submarine slope and the water depth from the seabed to the sea level.

title_en: Urban flood control refuge site selection method based on extreme storm flood inundation simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geographic information, in particular to an urban flood control refuge site selection method based on extreme storm flood inundation simulation, which comprises the following steps: simulating an extreme storm flood inundation process of an area to be researched, constructing storm flood disaster risk indexes according to simulation results, and further determining positions of residential points to be evacuated; calculating the evacuation speed of residents, and further constructing an evacuation road network; determining the location of existing and alternative flood defence shelter points in the high fitness area; and constructing a multi-target flood control refuge site selection model, solving the multi-target flood control refuge site selection model, and determining the number and positions of newly built flood control refuges in the area to be researched. The invention has great significance for reducing casualties of extreme storm flood disasters, and improves the reliability of site selection results of flood control and refuge.

title_en: Device and method for stress blocking construction
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for stress blocking construction, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and protection. Comprises a driving drill rod head; the driving drill rod is sequentially sleeved with a limiting pipe, a driving wheel, a limiting structure and a connecting piece; the device comprises a driving drill rod, a limiting pipe, a driving device and a cutting device, wherein the driving drill rod is connected with the limiting pipe through a connecting piece and a limiting structure; a spraying head is arranged outside the limiting pipe; the external device drives the driving drill rod and the limiting pipe to do up-and-down reciprocating motion and relative rotating motion, and can inject the blocking agent with pressure into the limiting pipe; the invention can effectively shorten the influence range in the sinking process of the goaf and reduce the mining influence.

title_en: Data center disaster recovery switching method and device based on chaotic engineering fault drilling
abstract_en: The invention provides a data center disaster recovery switching method and device based on chaotic engineering fault exercise, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sending service request data and injection fault data to the target application cluster, and monitoring service processing indexes generated by the service request data and the injection fault data processed by the target application cluster, wherein the service request data is pressure application data determined based on the load pressure of the target application cluster; and according to the comparison result of the service processing index and the preset condition, the disaster recovery switching is controlled between the target application cluster and the disaster recovery application cluster, so that corresponding program scripts are not required to be manually operated or operations are not required to be executed, the labor is saved, and the efficiency is improved and the recovery is quick.

title_en: Fire disaster identification method based on flame characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster identification method based on flame characteristics, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: acquiring a field image; setting RGB threshold values and brightness threshold values in a target area through flame parameters obtained in a simulation experiment, so as to obtain a preliminary target area; extracting sharp corner features of flame by using a Sobel operator edge detection method; acquiring contour data and target area data of flames; processing the contour data and the target area data to obtain real-time flame data; and (5) obtaining flame area according to the real-time flame data, calculating the flame area change rate and the arc degree, and judging whether fire occurs or not.

title_en: Small sample cross-domain hyperspectral image classification method based on contrast learning and subspace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small sample cross-domain hyperspectral image classification method based on contrast learning and subspace, which mainly solves the problems of low utilization rate of embedded characteristic information, high training cost and low precision of a conventional method. The scheme comprises the following steps: acquiring a hyperspectral data set, and dividing a source domain and a target domain to acquire a training set and a testing set; constructing a mapping layer and a feature extractor, and respectively extracting embedded features of a source domain and a target domain by using the mapping layer and the feature extractor to perform subspace classification and contrast learning; constructing a domain discriminator, and calculating the total loss of domain discrimination loss, space loss and contrast loss of a source domain and a target domain; performing iterative training on the feature extractor by using the training set through back propagation until the total loss function converges; and inputting the test set into a trained feature extractor to obtain a classification result. The invention improves the distinguishing capability and the classifying precision of the classifier, improves the utilization rate of embedded characteristic information, reduces the training cost, and can be used for land feature classification of resource exploration, forest coverage and disaster monitoring.

title_en: Mountain torrent early warning response simulation system and mountain torrent early warning response simulation method based on main body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent early warning response simulation system and a mountain torrent early warning response simulation method based on a main body, wherein the system comprises the following components: the flood disaster early warning system comprises an early warning module, a social module, a flood module and an casualty rate calculation module, wherein the early warning module is used for issuing mountain torrent disaster early warning information according to an early warning forestation period; the social module is used for simulating psychological and behavioral response processes of the main body after receiving the early warning information and obtaining position space-time dynamic change process data of the main body; the flood module is used for obtaining disaster-causing element space-time dynamic change process data through simulation; the casualty rate calculation module is used for calculating the casualty rate when the main body is transferred according to the two space-time dynamic change process data. The invention can quantitatively describe the early warning response process, compare different mountain torrents prevention measures, thoroughly describe the early warning response psychological process, deconstruct the social and psychological characteristics, and simultaneously couple the flood module and the social module, thereby evaluating the benefits of engineering measures and non-engineering measures in mountain torrents prevention under one frame.

title_en: Flood disaster area detection method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster area detection method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the field of disaster detection. The flood disaster area detection model is obtained by training a three-dimensional lightweight U-shaped convolution network by using a training data set. The three-dimensional lightweight U-shaped convolution network is added with a depth-channel-space attention mechanism module after the first convolution of the U-shaped network, two-dimensional convolutions in the U-shaped network are replaced by lightweight three-dimensional convolution modules, and finally the operation of taking the maximum value of the depth dimension is added in the U-shaped network. The invention improves the accuracy of flood area detection.

title_en: Multifunctional visual deep coal-rock gas dynamic disaster simulation roadway
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of mine safety exploitation, and particularly relates to a multifunctional visual deep coal-rock gas dynamic disaster simulation roadway; the simulation of the mine ventilation network and the test of the motion parameters and the dynamic effects of the two-phase flow can be realized. The technical proposal comprises: straight pipe, return bend, tee pipe and pressure vessel. The straight pipe is provided with a cleaning window and a monitoring window. And the two ends of the bent pipe are opened, and the inner section of the bent pipe is a square bent pipeline. The inside cross-section of three-way pipe is square pipeline, be provided with clean window on the three-way pipe. The pressure vessel is filled with gas and coal particles. And assembling the simulation roadway according to the roadway structure of the deep mining area in equal proportion by the straight pipes, the bent pipes and the three-way pipes, wherein the pressure container is communicated with the simulation roadway.
assignees: Huajin coking coal co ltd;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Sand sample permeability high water pressure test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sand sample permeability high water pressure test device, which belongs to the technical field of disaster simulation test machinery and comprises a device main column body provided with a hollow cavity for accommodating a sand sample; the device secondary column is connected with the device main column and guides the water oozed out of the test device to concentrate and flow out, and the device main column and the device secondary column form a communicated sealing cavity; the sealing plunger is arranged at the front end of the working direction of the main column body of the device in a sealing connection mode, so that different axial pressures can be applied to sand samples in the test device under a sealing condition, the device is a sand sample permeability test device capable of simultaneously developing different water pressures and different axial pressure conditions, the device is convenient to process and manufacture, the use and the operation are simple, the tested water pressure and axial pressure range is large, and the permeability test of the sand samples under different water pressures and axial pressures can be realized under a side limit condition.
assignees: YANMEI HEZE ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: Learning apparatus, estimation apparatus, learning method, estimation method, and program
abstract_en: To improve the technique for predicting damage to equipment due to a disaster.SOLUTION: A learning apparatus 10 includes: a first model generation unit 112 which generates a first model for calculating a degree of deterioration of equipment by machine learning that uses, as training data, deterioration data including information on the equipment, an environmental condition of the equipment, and a degree of deterioration of the equipment; and a second model generation unit 114 which generates a second model for calculating a degree of damage to the equipment by machine learning that uses, as training data, damage data including a disaster condition of a disaster on the equipment, a degree of damage due to the disaster, and the degree of deterioration calculated by the first model.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Power grid restoring force comprehensive evaluation method based on restoring process simulation and PC-CRITIC-fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid restoring force comprehensive evaluation method based on restoring process simulation and PC-CRITIC-fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, which comprises the following steps: 1. constructing a power grid restoring force evaluation index system; 2. establishing an index calculation model based on power grid recovery process simulation, and obtaining index data; 3. and comprehensively evaluating the recovery power of the regional power grid based on a PC-CRITIC-fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, and evaluating the recovery power level of the regional power grid. The invention can effectively evaluate the power grid restoring force level facing extreme disasters, can help the power grid to promote the capacity of coping with the extreme disasters, and can strengthen the power grid restoring force, thereby reducing the loss of the power grid facing the extreme disasters.

title_en: Crowd evacuation model based on path planning
abstract_en: The invention provides a crowd evacuation model based on path planning, and belongs to the field of computer simulation. The knowledge graph fusion mainly exists in a graph fusion form in practical application. Aiming at the problems of insufficient simulation reality, low evacuation efficiency and the like of the existing crowd evacuation model, an improved artificial bee colony algorithm is used for searching a proper evacuation path, and indication marks are arranged at key nodes of the path to guide pedestrians to evacuate, so that the crowd evacuation efficiency is improved. Then, the influence of panic emotion and evacuation marks on crowd evacuation is added on the basis of the social force model, so that the evacuation model is more in line with the movement situation of the real crowd. Compared with the traditional evacuation model, the model provided by the invention can reproduce typical crowd self-organization phenomenon, is closer to the actual crowd evacuation situation, and improves the crowd evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Gas permeability-increasing method for coal seam to be mined
