abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal seam mining, and provides a gas permeability-increasing method for a coal seam to be mined, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of drilling points are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the bottom suction roadway; drilling extraction hole groups at each drilling point, wherein each extraction hole group comprises a plurality of extraction holes, each extraction hole comprises a climbing section and an extension section, the climbing section is suitable for communicating a coal seam to be extracted and a bottom extraction roadway, and the extension section is arranged in the coal seam to be extracted; and carrying out fracturing treatment on the extraction hole to form a fracture zone around the extraction hole. According to the invention, the plurality of drilling points are arranged at intervals in the length direction of the bottom drainage roadway, the drainage hole groups are drilled at each drilling point, so that the effective drilling proportion can be remarkably improved, each drainage hole in each drainage hole group is subjected to fracturing treatment, so that a fracture zone is formed around each drainage hole, the permeability of a coal seam is improved, a three-dimensional seam net is constructed in the layer to be mined, the drainage efficiency and the drainage quantity of gas are further improved, and the hidden danger of mine gas disasters is eliminated.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD;TIANDI YULIN MINING ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD;TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Overcurrent wire fire disaster simulation device based on heat radiation and electric arc ignition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an overcurrent wire fire simulation device based on heat radiation and arc ignition, which relates to the technical field of fire simulation and comprises an electric control system, a heat radiation ignition device and an arc ignition device, wherein the electric control system comprises an arc ignition start-stop button, a radiant heat coil temperature controller, a radiant heat source power adjusting button and an overcurrent wire power interface. The over-current wire power interface is used for introducing a preset over-current value to the sample wire, the radiant heat coil temperature controller is used for setting a igniting temperature threshold value of the thermal radiation igniting device and adjusting the igniting temperature of the thermal radiation igniting device, and the arc igniting start-stop button is used for controlling the arc igniting device to generate or extinguish an arc. The invention can adjust the overcurrent value, can independently use the thermal radiation ignition device to provide fire simulation research taking thermal radiation as the ignition cause, and can also simultaneously use the thermal radiation ignition device and the electric arc ignition device to provide fire simulation research taking thermal radiation and electric arc as the common ignition cause.

title_en: Fire disaster identification method utilizing OTSU algorithm and residual error network migration learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire disaster identification, in particular to a fire disaster identification method utilizing an OTSU algorithm and residual error network transfer learning, which comprises the following steps: 1. generating extended training data; 2. carrying out OTSU image segmentation on the fire image; 3. training a fire detection model and residual error network transfer learning by using the segmented fire images; after the offline training is finished, a discrimination model of the OT-RN-TL network is obtained; 4. and (5) online detection. The invention can obtain accurate results and consume a small amount of computing resources.

title_en: Method for anchoring dam to strengthen gully
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reinforcing a gully by an anchor filling dam, which relates to ecological environment and geological disaster management technology. The anchor filling dam adopts a simultaneous drilling and grouting mode to alternatively fill two groups of self-drilling anchor rods, the self-drilling anchor rods drill to the bottom of a gully and enter rock with stable gully bottom to reach a certain anchoring length, then grouting is continued to form a concrete dam body with a channel anchored at the bottom of the gully to resist the downward sliding of broken stone slag and ensure the stability of the gully, and the staggered angles of the two groups of self-drilling anchor rods on the horizontal plane are required to meet the requirement that the broken stone slag and the anchor rods of the channel anchor filling dam form a stable structure after the filled grout is solidified so as to achieve the purposes of controlling the gully and stabilizing the slag body. The method omits procedures of cleaning the filled waste slag, digging out the hard foundation, building the dam, backfilling and the like, and has short construction period and high safety.

title_en: High-level landslide instability and motion simulation method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a high-level landslide instability and motion simulation method and device, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning. The high-level landslide instability and motion simulation method comprises simulating topography fluctuation; inputting the topographic and geomorphic data obtained by field mapping into 3D printing equipment; preparing to capture three-dimensional data of a landslide movement process; placing a sliding body at the upper end of the landslide, and performing a sliding test until the movement is stopped to form a landslide accumulation body; and installing a pressure sensor at the bottom of the landslide to acquire pressure data in the landslide movement process. And a large amount of parallel experiments are carried out indoors to verify that the operation can be repeated, a large amount of manpower and material resources consumed by investigation and monitoring of landslide disasters in the field are reduced, a large amount of accurate landslide quantitative data are obtained through three-dimensional engineering modeling, the induction factors of field slope damage and the disaster causing range of the landslide are explored, the monitoring period is greatly shortened, the structure is simple, and the applicability is strong.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD;UNIV HONG KONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Fire simulation evacuation drilling method based on three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire simulation evacuation drilling method based on a three-dimensional model, which comprises the steps of obtaining scanning data of a building and determining escape paths and fire-fighting facilities in the building; according to escape paths, setting escape nodes of different floors in a building, and constructing a first network topology structure diagram; according to the fire-fighting facilities, fire-fighting nodes of different floors in the building are arranged, and a second network topology structure diagram is constructed; fusing the first network topology structure diagram and the second network topology structure diagram to generate a three-dimensional model of the building; setting fire parameters and personnel parameters of fire simulation according to the three-dimensional model, and triggering fire evaluation mechanisms of different floors; acquiring evacuation channels and fire extinguishing probabilities of different floors through a fire evaluation mechanism; according to the evacuation channel, generating an escape path for fire exercise, and dynamically adjusting the escape path through the fire extinguishing probability.

title_en: Leak protection gas detection device is used in fire control face guard production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air leakage prevention detection device for fire mask production, in particular to the field of air leakage prevention detection, which comprises a host machine, wherein an elastic head die is arranged on the host machine and is used for being supported in the fire mask during detection; the simulation assembly comprises a main body part, a mandibular part and a driving part I, wherein the mandibular part is hinged to the lower side of the main body part, and the driving part I is used for driving the mandibular part to swing up and down. According to the invention, the mouth opening and closing condition of a person can be simulated through the vertical swing of the mandibular part, the stretching of facial muscles can be simulated, if air leakage occurs during detection, different gases can be mixed, whether the fire protection mask leaks or not can be judged by detecting the content of the test gas in the mixed gas, and the safety of firefighters and escape and trapped personnel is ensured under the condition of loudly shouting and without air leakage after loudly shouting by the fire protection mask which is qualified in detection.

title_en: Live-action map construction method, device and equipment under emergency scene and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for building a live-action map in an emergency scene, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring live-action images of a plurality of disaster areas shot by a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles; constructing a real-time disaster situation perception situation map based on each live-action image; acquiring a communication positioning demand grading model which is obtained based on historical grading data training under an emergency scene; based on the real-time disaster situation perception situation map and the communication positioning demand grading model, a live-action map based on communication positioning demand grading calibration and disaster point calibration is constructed. The invention can improve the real-time disaster sensing efficiency and the accuracy of communication positioning demand classification, thereby better assisting commander to sense global situation and reasonably distributing rescue resources.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for flood warning emergency broadcasting
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to a method, a device and a storage medium for flood early warning emergency broadcasting, which comprise the steps of obtaining detection water level data of a current detection point; if the detected water level data of the current detection point is larger than a preset warning water level, judging whether the detected water level data of the current detection point is larger than a preset lowest warning water level or not; if yes, the early warning level corresponding to the current detected water level data is adjusted to the next early warning level based on rising of the early warning level, and early warning information is pushed; if not, acquiring a water level prediction model, and acquiring predicted water level data of a current detection point at preset time based on the prediction model; acquiring the water level data at the same time upstream to correct the predicted water level data, and obtaining corrected water level data; when the corrected water level data is larger than a preset lowest early warning water level, verifying a simulation result of the water level prediction model; and when the verification is true, acquiring the corresponding early warning level based on the corrected water level data and pushing early warning information, so that the occurrence of false alarm conditions is reduced.

title_en: Tunnel tunneling disaster monitoring and early warning system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunneling, in particular to a digital twinning-based tunneling disaster monitoring and early warning system. Comprising the following steps: the system comprises an inversion learning operation module, a tunnel construction entity module, a twin digital model and a twin database. The invention establishes a digital twin model based on the real development environment of the tunnel and the underground space, simulates the whole development process of the tunnel and the underground space, visualizes the whole construction state, gives early warning to the disasters about to happen, and can update and optimize the model according to the on-site construction, thereby developing the driving protection for the traffic country construction and the underground space in China.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION 3RD ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY INVEST CONSTRUCTION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Technical training device for fighting forest fire extinguishing technique
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a training device for a technique of fighting a forest fire by using a topdressing fire head, which comprises the following components: the main controller is connected with the gas pipeline and the combustion tank which are connected with the gas source; the combustion tank comprises a second combustion tank; the second combustion groove comprises an arc-shaped section and extension sections, and two ends of the extension sections extend towards each other; the gas pipeline is connected with the second combustion groove, and a gas outlet is arranged at the second combustion groove; the gas pipeline is provided with a gas switching valve and a flow control valve for controlling the flow of gas; an ignition device is arranged on the second combustion groove; the gas switching valve, the flow control valve and the ignition device are electrically connected with the main controller. The utility model helps forest firefighters to train by manufacturing the real fire simulation fire wire, and improves the capability of extinguishing the fire wire.

title_en: Ant disaster monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ant disaster monitoring device, and belongs to the technical field of ant killing. The novel anti-termite disaster monitoring device mainly comprises a mounting base, wherein the mounting base is in a conical shape, a spiral line is arranged on the conical outer wall of the mounting base and used for driving the mounting base to drill into the ground, a mounting cavity is formed in the mounting base, the mounting cavity is in a conical shape, a monitoring mechanism is arranged inside the mounting cavity and used for monitoring termite and insect killing, when the termite disaster monitoring device is inserted into the ground, the mounting base is rotated, spiral lines on the outer wall of the mounting base extrude soil at the ground, the soil is far away from the outer wall of the mounting base, and the spiral lines are arranged on the mounting base and used for enabling the mounting base to drill into the ground under the action of the spiral lines. The termite disaster monitoring device solves the problem that the monitoring device is inconvenient to insert into the ground.

title_en: Tunnel advanced geological disaster intelligent judging and identifying method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: A tunnel advanced geological disaster intelligent judging and identifying method based on multi-source information fusion comprises the following steps of S1, setting a tunnel disaster data set, collecting prediction data corresponding to the disaster occurrence position of a target tunnel by each prediction method in the advanced geological disaster forecasting means set, putting the collected prediction data into the tunnel disaster data set, and establishing a mapping relation between various geological disasters and target tunnel construction parameters, S2, respectively training each type of prediction data in the tunnel disaster data set by a processing system to generate a corresponding convolutional neural network model to obtain a convolutional neural network model set, and simulating a multi-expert analysis decision process based on various single judging results to achieve the purpose of intelligent judgment of geological disasters such as karst, fault, gust water and the like by the aid of multi-source information fusion.

title_en: Power distribution network optimization method and system under typhoon disaster based on two-stage planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network optimization method and system under typhoon disasters based on two-stage planning, comprising the following steps: modeling wind speed uncertainty, line uncertainty and load uncertainty by using the acquired power distribution network information, meteorological information and geographic information to obtain a distribution function about typhoon wind speed and power distribution line damage probability of the power distribution network, and generating load scenes by Monte Carlo simulation to obtain reactive load and active load in each scene; on the basis of a distribution function, a distribution line damage probability, reactive loads and active power in each scene, constructing a two-stage random planning elastic lifting model for the distribution network; and solving the model under the first-stage constraint condition and the second-stage constraint condition to obtain an optimization decision result, and optimizing the power distribution network through the optimization decision result. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the accuracy of the decision aiming at the power distribution network is improved, and the elastic coping capacity of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Simulation device and method for tillite landslide erosion test
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation device and a method for a tillite landslide corrosion test, wherein the simulation device for the tillite landslide corrosion test comprises the following components: test cabin, multistage cell body and temperature control module. The multi-section groove body is arranged in the test cabin and is used for simulating the motion state of the corrosion of the tillite landslide, the temperature in the test cabin is monitored through the temperature sensor, and the temperature in the test cabin is controlled in real time through the temperature controller, so that the tillite soil can realize the landslide corrosion simulation test under the preset constant temperature condition, in addition, the tillite landslide corrosion test under the temperature period change condition can be realized, the disaster-pregnant environment of the tillite landslide in a glacier area in nature can be better simulated, and the quantitative research of the movement of the tillite landslide is realized.

title_en: Highway tunnel multi-disaster coupling test device and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tunnel disaster tests, in particular to a highway tunnel multi-disaster coupling test device and system, comprising: the obstacle lifting channel is arranged on the ground of the multi-disaster coupling test area, and a plurality of fire source simulation units are paved on the ground; the spraying fire extinguishing device is arranged at the top of the multi-disaster coupling test area, and the top is also provided with a smoke outlet and a sectional storage box which stores obstacles; the integrated storage box is arranged on the side wall of the multi-disaster coupling test area and stores obstacles. Therefore, various disasters of the highway tunnel are coupled in the same test area to form a multi-disaster coupling test area, so that multi-disaster coupling tests are realized, and the limitation is reduced. The multi-disaster coupling test device is controlled through the multi-disaster test platform, multiple test working conditions are set manually, test data are enriched, simulation working conditions of multiple disasters of the tunnel are realized, and a test environment is provided for highway tunnel equipment.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS RES & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Hydrologic time sequence prediction method and device based on machine learning model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrologic prediction, and discloses a hydrologic time sequence prediction method and a hydrologic time sequence prediction device based on a machine learning model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring target drainage basin hydrologic data, and carrying out normalization processing on the target drainage basin hydrologic data to generate a normalized data training set and a normalized data testing set; establishing a machine learning model, optimizing model parameters of the machine learning model by utilizing an improved sparrow search algorithm based on a normalized data training set, and generating optimal model parameters; based on the normalized data test set, a machine learning model substituted with the optimal model parameters is utilized to generate a hydrologic time sequence prediction result. The method and the system remarkably improve the prediction precision of the hydrologic time sequence, prolong the prediction period and provide more timely and accurate hydrologic information for the flood and drought disaster defense and the comprehensive management of water resources.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Global learning-based hyperspectral image multi-category change detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hyperspectral image multi-category change detection method based on global learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring double-phase hyperspectral images of the same geographic region, and carrying out standardized pretreatment on the two hyperspectral images; s2, corresponding pixels of the two hyperspectral images are spliced along a spectrum channel dimension to obtain a combined hyperspectral image, a random layered sample sequence is constructed, and a global sample set is generated; s3, constructing a full convolution network model based on the coding-decoding structure and completing network training; s4, inputting the hyperspectral image into a trained global model, and predicting a change detection result. The hyperspectral image change detection method has the advantages of high classification detection speed and high precision, and can be used for detecting the surface change in the fields of agriculture and forestry monitoring, land utilization, disaster assessment and the like.

title_en: Electric power system elasticity assessment method under extreme weather conditions of sand storm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system elasticity assessment method under the extreme weather condition of a sand storm, which belongs to the technical field of power systems and comprises the following steps: acquiring storm disaster forecast information and power system data, and modeling the influence of the storm disaster, and updating the storm disaster state at a certain moment, wherein the modeling comprises wind field modeling and dust modeling; judging a fault state of the power system, responding to the state of the power system, and then recovering the power system through a recovery strategy; and judging whether the normal operation state is restored, if so, drawing an elastic curve of the power system, calculating an elastic index, evaluating the elasticity of the electronic system, if not, returning to execute the modeling of the influence of the sand storm disaster, and finally ending the elastic evaluation method of the power system. The invention simulates the post-disaster recovery process, and makes the post-disaster system elastic recovery measures from the planning angle and the operation angle to cope with the influence caused by meteorological disasters, so that the system can quickly recover load power supply after disaster, and the loss to society is reduced.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV LANZHOU JIAOTONG

title_en: Meteorological disaster influence assessment system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a weather disaster influence evaluation system and a method, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a meteorological observation module, a data processing module, a model construction module, an evaluation prediction module and a result presentation module; the meteorological observation module is used for collecting meteorological data in real time; the data processing module is used for preprocessing meteorological data to obtain processed data; the model construction module is used for constructing a prediction model according to the historical meteorological data and the related influence data; the evaluation prediction module is used for evaluating and predicting the occurrence probability, the influence range and the intensity of the disaster by using the processed data to obtain an evaluation prediction result; the result presentation module is used for presenting the evaluation prediction result to the user. According to the application, various meteorological data and related data analysis are introduced, and accurate evaluation and timely prediction of the influence of different meteorological disasters are realized through model establishment and training. In addition, the system has the capability of quick response, and can realize real-time early warning and emergency response through real-time data acquisition and processing.

title_en: Analysis method for relationship between barrier in evacuation road and walk evacuation smoothness
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of road evacuation, and discloses a method for analyzing the relationship between obstacles in an evacuation road and the smoothness of walking evacuation, which comprises the following steps: step one: setting experimental parameters, namely setting parameters of the number of evacuators, virtual personnel parameters, intelligent body free speed and evacuation time parameters in simulation experiments in analog simulation; step two: setting a scene, namely setting a plane graph of obstacles in an evacuation road for different obstacles in the evacuation road; according to the analysis method of the relationship between the barrier in the evacuation road and the smooth evacuation in walking, the analog software is used for simulating the specific influence condition of the barrier on evacuation personnel in emergency evacuation, the specific influence of the spacing distance of isolation facilities in the walking evacuation road and the orientation of advertising billboards on the smooth evacuation road and the evacuation efficiency is clear, and an effective basis is provided for the evacuation road in a business center area.

title_en: Crowd evacuation method based on hybrid algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd evacuation method based on a hybrid algorithm, which comprises the following steps of classifying crowds by using a genetic algorithm, judging the distance between a dangerous source and pedestrians through a panic propagation model of a monitoring system, macroscopically regulating and controlling by a gray wolf algorithm, selecting a leader through fitness, microcosmically guiding by a socioeconomic model, receiving an instruction transmitted by the system by the leader of each community, then guiding the pedestrians of the community to evacuate, updating the expected movement direction of the socioeconomic model to the direction of the leader when the pedestrians receive the information of the leader, continuously monitoring the fitness of each community to iterate, observing whether the replacement of the leader is needed, iteratively updating the panic value of the pedestrians, observing whether the crowds are evacuated, ending the evacuation task if the evacuation is completed, and returning otherwise. The invention has the characteristics of macroscopic and microscopic combination, simple algorithm and strong global and local searching capability, and can achieve the purpose of truly simulating crowd evacuation.

title_en: Photoelastic experiment device capable of simulating coal beds with different dip angles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photoelastic experimental device capable of simulating coal beds with different dip angles, and relates to the technical field of coal mining simulation experimental devices. The device comprises a bearing frame, a sample container, a corner limiting plate, a vertical loading system, a hydraulic jack and a cabinet. According to the utility model, the limiting angle plates with different angles are replaced according to different simulated coal seam angles, and meanwhile, the hydraulic jack is adjusted to meet the experimental requirements; different burial depths of the coal seam are simulated by adjusting the load of the vertical loading plate, and a baffle at the bottom of the sample container is opened and closed, so that photoelastic particles are released to simulate the mining effect of the coal seam; the whole loading and mining processes are carried out in a polarization field, the transmission and distribution conditions of force chains in the whole process can be clearly observed through a polarizer, the corresponding relation between mining stress and displacement in the fracture process of overlying strata of coal beds with different dip angles is disclosed, and a foundation is provided for the destabilization disaster-causing mechanism of the coal beds.

title_en: Method for enhancing fire disaster synthesized samples in large-span space sites based on countermeasure generation network
abstract_en: A fire synthetic sample enhancement method based on a countermeasure generation network generates a fire image network generator based on the generation countermeasure network CycleGAN, the generator comprises the network generator and a corresponding discriminator, the generator G and the generator F take noisy input graphs as inputs to generate fire images through convolution iterative training, the generated fire images and real fire images are sent into the discriminator to conduct real-time data and discrimination of the generated data, the generator and the discriminator are optimized continuously through countermeasure learning, the fire synthetic sample enhancement in the large-span space places is achieved, more flame samples are generated through flame images of combustibles which possibly appear in demonstration places through models, and fire images with boundary boxes can be generated in non-fire scenes so as to improve the performance of a fire detection model.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Comprehensive control and early warning system for flood disasters of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive prevention and control early warning system for flood disasters of a transformer substation, which relates to the technical field of disasters and prevention and control early warning and comprises a basic information management unit; a numerical simulation analysis unit; and the rainfall flood risk assessment analysis unit and the two-dimensional three-dimensional visual display analysis unit. The method realizes automatic prediction and early warning of the flood disasters of the transformer substation and automatic assessment of the flood risks of the transformer substation, provides scientific basis for analysis of various plans such as loss assessment, environmental risk control, flood control transformation and the like of the flood disasters of the transformer substation, reduces the influence of the flood disasters on safe and stable operation of the transformer substation, promotes the passive-to-active transition of the flood disaster control of the power grid, comprehensively improves personal safety guarantee capability of companies and supports construction of safe enterprises.

title_en: Risk evaluation geological disaster early warning method based on multi-method cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning methods, in particular to a risk evaluation geological disaster early warning method based on multi-method cooperation. In the invention, the comprehensive influence among a plurality of parameters is comprehensively considered by collecting various parameter data related to geological disasters. And constructing a prediction model by utilizing machine learning, training and learning the collected parameter data, monitoring in real time by utilizing the Internet of things technology and a sensor, feeding the collected data back to the prediction model, and updating the risk assessment in real time. And grading the risks of the geological disasters so as to realize effective management of areas with different risk grades. And the new collected data is used for comprehensively evaluating and optimizing the prediction model at regular intervals so as to improve the accuracy and reliability of prediction. Feedback from various aspects is collected to further improve the performance of the predictive model by establishing a mechanism for public participation and information sharing.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD

title_en: Serpentine life detection robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of mechanical automation, in particular to a snake-shaped life detection robot which comprises a life detection module, a front-back movement assembly and a connecting table, wherein the life detection module is arranged on the front movement assembly, the tail part of the front movement assembly is connected with the output end of the front movement assembly, the two ends of the connecting table are respectively connected with the fixed ends of the front movement assembly and the back movement assembly, and the output end of the back movement assembly is connected with the tail part of the back movement assembly. The snake-shaped detection robot can execute life detection tasks in disaster rescue sites, can realize actions such as passing in narrow spaces of irregular site environments, climbing stairs and the like through snake-shaped motion simulation of each motion assembly and each swinging assembly, and has the functions of flexible snake-shaped motion and life detection. The invention has the characteristics of simple control, flexible movement, strong adaptability and the like.

title_en: Method and system for scheduling and distributing fire-fighting resources in building based on BIM data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital information, and discloses a method and a system for dispatching and distributing fire-fighting resources in a building based on BIM data, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out data fusion on the BIM data and sensor data to obtain multidimensional fusion data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional building model of a target building according to multi-dimensional fusion data, conducting fire simulation on the three-dimensional building model to obtain a fire data image, extracting fire factor characteristics of the fire data image, generating evacuation paths of the target building according to the fire factor characteristics, conducting fire-fighting resource allocation according to the evacuation paths to obtain fire-fighting resource allocation vectors of the evacuation paths, calculating resource allocation scores of the fire-fighting resource allocation vectors, generating a fire-fighting resource scheduling strategy according to the fire-fighting resource allocation vectors when the resource allocation scores are larger than a preset resource allocation threshold, and allocating fire-fighting resources according to the fire-fighting resource scheduling strategy. The invention can improve the accuracy of fire-fighting resource scheduling and distribution in the building.

title_en: Method and system for predicting and forecasting frost
abstract_en: The application discloses a frost prediction method and a frost prediction system, and relates to the technical field of meteorological monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring and constructing a target meteorological observation architecture according to basic condition information of a target region; collecting basic observation data of different historical time periods of a target area; analyzing frost conditions of a target area based on a target meteorological observation framework and basic observation data of different historical time periods to generate frost analysis data; constructing an initial frost prediction model of the target area according to the frost analysis data; acquiring and training an initial frost prediction model according to historical meteorological data to obtain a final frost prediction model; and acquiring and importing the real-time meteorological data into a frost prediction model, generating frost prediction data, and carrying out real-time frost prediction. According to the application, comprehensive observation data are collected, association analysis is carried out, a targeted frost prediction model is constructed by combining historical frost characteristic data, and accurate and efficient frost disaster prediction and forecast are realized.
assignees: GUIZHOU PROVINCE ANSHUN CITY METEOROLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Mechanical property evaluation method for shield tunnel structure after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating mechanical properties of a shield tunnel structure after fire, which comprises the steps of determining damage indexes of the shield tunnel structure after fire based on a hierarchical analysis method; establishing a shield tunnel damage numerical model in finite element software to obtain sample data; preprocessing a model sample; building a BP neural network, determining the number of neurons of each layer, determining super parameters and training samples; outputting the ultimate bearing capacity of the structure, and carrying out five-level grading evaluation on the mechanical property of the shield tunnel structure after fire disaster through systematic clustering. The invention is based on quantitative data, has better reliability and convenient use, and can provide theoretical and technical support for works such as evaluation, repair and the like after the fire disaster of the shield tunnel.

title_en: Emergency material allocation system based on dam system damage model prediction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dam maintenance, and discloses an emergency material allocation system based on dam system damage model prediction, which comprises the following steps of; step one: and collecting emergency treatment cases after the hydropower station of the historic bank is damaged by natural disasters, establishing a historic case database, and simultaneously establishing an emergency material storage bank. According to the invention, by aiming at different parts and different damage degree characteristics of the reservoir dam system, combining the damage and rescue cases of the reservoir dam system caused by the historical natural disasters, related cases are quickly associated, emergency treatment technical measures, rescue material types and amounts, material reserve and scheduling mechanisms for coping with different damage degrees of the reservoir dam system can be researched according to the existing data, and by adopting disaster scene simulation deduction technology, the type and amount of the material materials required by the reservoir dam system to encounter natural disaster loss and rescue loss can be predicted in advance, and the rescue material types and amount prediction scheme of the reservoir dam system can be provided.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;CHINA WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Leaf area index relative threshold value method for determining agricultural drought disaster area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a leaf area index relative threshold value of an agricultural drought disaster area, which comprises the following steps: selecting a certain period of matter, and calculating the average leaf area index time sequence of the period of matter of the summer/autumn crops; determining a reference year, and taking the average leaf area index of the summer harvest/autumn harvest crops in the climatic period of the year as a reference value for judging the drought degree of the agriculture; determining different value combinations of leaf area indexes of summer/autumn crops relative to a threshold value, simulating to obtain corresponding agricultural drought disaster areas, and evaluating simulation accuracy of the corresponding agricultural drought disaster areas; and comprehensively comparing simulation accuracy obtained by comparing leaf area indexes of different summer/autumn crops in all the climatic periods with the threshold value, and determining an optimal simulation result and a corresponding summer/autumn crop optimal leaf area index relative threshold value. According to the method, the effective threshold value of the agricultural drought disaster leaf area index considering the spatial difference of the agricultural drought indexes is determined, so that the extraction of the agricultural drought disaster area meeting the actual situation is realized.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Multi-mode image-text classification method for context awareness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode image-text classification method for context awareness. Firstly, constructing a plurality of pairs of staggered image text pairs, converting a traditional fine-tuning normal form into a context-aware normal form, and achieving a classification mode with zero samples and few samples without gradient update. In the scene of dealing with cross-domain migration, the traditional method needs more calculation cost, and the context perceives the learning mode, so that the original paradigm needing secondary gradient update learning can be optimized, meanwhile, the phenomenon of disaster forgetting of model pre-training weights is avoided as much as possible, the model has the capability of cross-domain knowledge migration through performing element gradient learning by a small number of samples, and the classification accuracy better than that of a baseline model is achieved under the setting of an open vocabulary classification task.

title_en: Indoor evacuation shelter against tsunami, missile blast, etc.
abstract_en: To provide a solution for the problem that immediate evacuation is required in the event of a sudden tsunami or missile blast; after an earthquake, evacuation is desirable within three minutes following a J-Alert and of course there is no time to escape outside; hotels, apartments, and buildings are sturdy, but ordinary homes are weak and will be blown to pieces and therefore measures must be taken for houses and rooms in which people live to save 320 thousand lives.SOLUTION: Hotels, apartments, and buildings are sturdy structures, and the rooms within can be considered the optimal evacuation sites in the shortest time possible. Rather than drilling holes in the walls, which are structural parts, a vertical shelter extending almost to the ceiling resists rotation or floating-up. Even in an ordinary house, even if the structure is reduced to pieces, the heavy concrete shelter with stable height inside the room will remain. Even if heavy tile roofs fall, people are not crushed to death. The greatest happiness is being able to live each day with peace of mind.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Rock damage mode intelligent distinguishing method based on unique microseismic signals
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent distinguishing method of rock destruction modes based on unique microseismic signals, which comprises the steps of collecting original microseismic waveforms of known rock destruction modes, extracting characteristic parameters of a time domain and a frequency domain of the microseismic waveforms by utilizing Fourier transformation, spreading the extracted characteristic parameters into a one-dimensional characteristic map of the microseismic parameters after carrying out dispersion standardization, constructing a rock destruction mode distinguishing network by taking a convolutional neural network as a basic framework, constructing an intelligent distinguishing model of the rock destruction modes by training and learning a mapping relation between the one-dimensional characteristic map of the microseismic parameters and the distinguishing of the rock destruction modes, verifying the intelligent distinguishing model of the rock destruction modes, and inputting the microseismic waveforms of unknown destruction modes into the intelligent distinguishing model of the trained rock destruction modes for distinguishing the destruction modes after processing the microseismic waveforms of the unknown destruction modes. According to the application, the rock damage mode can be distinguished by only using a single microseismic signal, the change rule of the microseismic signal in continuous time is not required, and the subjective and objective errors of dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning are reduced.

title_en: Lightning stroke risk assessment method and device based on machine learning and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightning risk assessment method, a device and a storage medium based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring lightning data, wind field related data and lightning disaster data, preprocessing the data, and constructing a data set; marking a data set based on a semi-supervised K-means algorithm, wherein the data set is marked as thunder disaster data, non-thunder disaster data and unmarked data; constructing a LapSVM model and a PSO algorithm, and initializing parameters; inputting data into a model for training, generating lightning risk probability according to data labels and model parameters, and optimizing the model parameters by using a PSO algorithm; and taking the lightning data to be evaluated and the wind field related data as inputs, carrying out lightning risk evaluation by using the trained LapSVM model, and outputting the lightning risk probability. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of being completely driven by data, being capable of utilizing the data structure information of unlabeled samples, and the like.

title_en: Landslide sensitivity evaluation method, system and equipment in mountain gorge valley region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide sensitivity evaluation method, system and equipment in a high mountain gorge region, and relates to the field of landslide sensitivity evaluation. According to the invention, SAR visibility simulation analysis is carried out on a research area in a mountain gorge valley area, so that an optimal InSAR monitoring scheme is obtained to obtain the deformation rate of the research area and identify a landslide disaster range; determining landslide sensitivity grades of the landslide disaster range in the research area according to the landslide sensitivity grading standard; screening out the optimal evaluation factors according to the colinear diagnosis and gray correlation analysis for the research area with the landslide sensitivity level determined; taking the optimal evaluation factor as input, taking the corresponding landslide sensitivity level as output, and constructing and training a landslide sensitivity evaluation model by using PSO-BP; and obtaining a landslide sensitivity evaluation result by adopting the trained landslide sensitivity evaluation model. The method is an accurate and efficient landslide sensitivity evaluation method suitable for the mountain gorge areas.

title_en: Business-level disaster recovery exercise method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a business-level disaster recovery exercise method, a business-level disaster recovery exercise device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: installing a disaster recovery client on a protection host, and adding asset information of the application of the protection host into the disaster recovery client; selecting a backup strategy, establishing a backup task, and starting data backup; establishing a verification task and a take-over task; selecting an exercise type, and arranging an exercise plan by combining the verification task and the application of the protection host computer so as to obtain an arrangement result; carrying out plan evaluation on the arrangement result; when the plan evaluation passes, switching and exercising the arrangement result; and after the business verification is passed and the exercise is completed, the environment is restored. By implementing the method of the embodiment of the invention, the requirements of interdependence relation and starting sequence among applications can be met, disaster recovery switching can be effectively performed, and time and cost are saved.

title_en: Fire resistance test equipment and process for concrete filled steel tube column
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire resistance test of concrete filled steel tube columns, in particular to fire resistance test equipment and a fire resistance test process of a concrete filled steel tube column, which comprise a bottom plate, wherein a combustion furnace is arranged at the front side of the middle part of the bottom plate, a supporting plate is arranged between the bottom plate and the combustion furnace, the bottom of the supporting plate is slidingly connected in a T-shaped chute of the bottom plate, hydraulic supporting rods are symmetrically arranged above the supporting plate, the upper ends of the hydraulic supporting rods at the same side are connected with a fixed outer frame, a clamping assembly is arranged at the middle part of the fixed outer frame, the invention uses the clamping component to horizontally clamp the steel tube concrete column, the rotating disk can rotate the steel tube concrete column in different modes under the belt of the servo motor, so that the steel tube concrete column is heated by one side and multiple sides in the combustion furnace, fire disaster simulation under different conditions is realized, and meanwhile, the error of experimental data caused by uneven heating of the steel tube concrete column in the combustion furnace can be prevented.

title_en: Method for judging safety of construction of shield tunnel in water-rich round gravel stratum to existing pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging the safety of the construction of a shield tunnel in a water-rich round gravel stratum to the existing pipeline, which comprises the following steps: establishing a calculation model of a stratum, an existing pipeline and a underpass tunnel by adopting FLAC3D software, and endowing the calculation model with physical and mechanical parameters; applying boundary constraint conditions to the calculation model, and carrying out stress solving under the dead weight stress; on the basis of a calculation model, a flow-solid coupling model is established through FLAC3D software, and numerical simulation is carried out on the tunneling process of the shield tunnel construction by utilizing a rigidity migration method; the method and the device can conveniently and accurately reflect the influence of shield tunnel construction on the safety of the existing pipeline, identify the pipeline with higher risk, realize the prediction and prevention of disasters, and have higher popularization value in practical engineering application.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION EIGHTH ENGINEERING DIVISION TECH CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent mud-rock flow disaster risk identification method, device, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent and debris flow disaster risk identification method, a device, a terminal and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring basic environment data in a target area, processing the basic environment data by using a Hec-GeoHMS model, introducing the basic environment data into a HEC-HMS hydrological model, carrying out hydrological process simulation and acquiring final parameters of a sub-river basin and a river channel; calculating the stability coefficient of the covered side slope, determining key indexes capable of reflecting water source sensitivity, and constructing a mountain torrent disaster risk index system; selecting indexes influencing water sources and object sources from the perspective of water and soil combination, and constructing a mountain torrent mud-rock flow disaster susceptibility index system; and constructing a mountain torrent and debris flow disaster vulnerability model according to the random forest model, so as to obtain a mountain torrent and debris flow vulnerability space pattern in the target area. Therefore, the embodiment of the invention can calculate the probability of occurrence of the mountain torrent mud-rock flow disasters starting from key elements affecting the ecological hydrologic process, identify high risk areas and monitor and early warn.
assignees: GUANGZHOU URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN SURVEY RES INST

title_en: Device and method for simulating segmented exploitation of natural gas hydrate in layered distribution reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for simulating the sectional exploitation of natural gas hydrate in a layered distribution reservoir, wherein an exploitation well in the device adopts a sectional exploitation vertical shaft, the inside of the exploitation well is divided into a plurality of sections along the length direction of the shaft, the sections are separated and mutually independent, and outlets of different sections of the segmented exploitation shaft are respectively connected with a back pressure control system and a production metering system. The device can be used for indoor simulation of the subsection exploitation of the natural gas hydrate in the layered distribution reservoir, and contrast of the differences of production behaviors in the exploitation processes of the hydrates in different exploitation sections of the exploitation well. The method can be used for exploring the optimal exploitation methods and exploitation pressures of different layers in the hydrate layered distribution reservoir to obtain the optimal exploitation method combination and the optimal exploitation efficiency of the natural gas hydrate in the layered distribution reservoir. The method provides scientific support for effectively preventing engineering disasters, prolonging the exploitation time of the hydrates and efficiently exploiting the natural gas hydrates in the layered distribution reservoir.

title_en: Prediction method and system for wet stress heat wave-flood composite disaster and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method, a system and electronic equipment for a wet stress heat wave-flood composite disaster, comprising the following steps: collecting a meteorological hydrological data set, determining relative humidity and specific humidity, and establishing a machine learning model considering the hydrological process; training a machine learning model taking the hydrologic process into consideration by adopting the corrected global climate mode aggregate meteorological simulation data to obtain a daily runoff process in future scenes; combining the global climate mode set with a machine learning model considering hydrologic process, and determining each combined scene weight parameter in a multi-model weighted average method; acquiring characteristic parameters of the annual average underlying surface of a research area, and calculating wet bulb temperature to determine a thermal wave event; and predicting the socioeconomic exposure caused by the future increase of the composite disaster risk based on the weight parameters of each combined scene in the multi-model weighted average method. The invention provides an important reference basis with strong operability for hydrologic disaster risk assessment and early warning under climate change.

title_en: Highway high slope landslide hazard early warning method based on evaluation function training
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway high slope landslide hazard early warning method based on evaluation function training, which comprises the following steps: deploying a plurality of sensors at key points of the expressway high side slope, and acquiring real-time monitoring data by utilizing the sensors; satellite image data of a highway high slope area is acquired by utilizing a satellite remote sensing technology; integrating the acquired real-time monitoring data with the processed high-resolution image, and carrying out space-time scale fusion on the integrated data source; constructing a disaster early warning model based on evaluation function training, and calculating damage index scores of the slope states by using the disaster early warning model; making a corresponding slope state early warning threshold; if the damage index score exceeds the slope state early warning threshold, a corresponding warning signal instruction is sent out, and rescue measures are taken according to a preset early warning rule; and constructing a three-dimensional perspective view of the expressway high side slope area. The method and the device can quickly and accurately discover and early warn the landslide risk possibly occurring.
assignees: HENAN JIAOYUAN ENGINEERING TECH GROUP CO LTD;UNIV ZHENGZHOU LIGHT IND;ZHENGZHOU DONGCHEN SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent simulation robot capable of realizing group collaboration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent simulation robot capable of realizing group cooperation, which relates to the related field of intelligent simulation robots, and structurally comprises a crawler wheel, a main box body fixedly arranged at the middle end of the top of the crawler wheel, an alarm lamp fixedly arranged at the rear side of the left end face of the main box body, and a controller fixedly arranged at the middle end of the left end face of the main box body, wherein a water gun lifting device is arranged, a lifting plate is driven to lift by a first hydraulic push rod and a second hydraulic push rod to rotate so as to simulate the water spraying and fire extinguishing actions of a firefighter, and a water gun clamping device is used for automatically clamping the water gun; simultaneously, a stabilizing mechanism is arranged, the second screw is utilized to rotate to drive the balancing weight to move and change the self balancing weight of the equipment to prevent the equipment from toppling over when spraying water, and simultaneously, the longitudinal bevel gear is utilized to drive the rubber block to extend out to increase the friction force between the equipment and the ground, so that the phenomenon that the equipment automatically moves when spraying water is reduced.
assignees: HUAERJIA QUANZHOU MACHINERY MFG CO LTD

title_en: Automatic evaluation method for hail damage of building outer window based on image semantic segmentation
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic evaluation method of hail damage of an outer window of a building based on image semantic segmentation, which comprises the steps of manually screening and preprocessing pictures acquired by image acquisition to obtain a hail damage picture set of the outer window of the building; manually labeling each image and each pixel of the image set by adopting a semantic segmentation labeling tool to form a hail-induced damage data set of an outer window of the building; building a hail damage degree identification semantic segmentation network based on a UNet network, and training; carrying out damage degree identification on the building exterior window image by utilizing a trained network; and counting and superposing the numbers of different damage degrees of a certain area by using damage degree identification, and calculating the ratio of the total number of damaged outer windows to the total number of building outer windows in the area to obtain the building disaster damage rate. According to the application, through further analysis of the output result of the deep learning semantic segmentation model, the end-to-end calculation of the disaster evaluation index is realized, and the disaster evaluation efficiency is improved.
assignees: HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH SHENZHEN INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION

title_en: Grouting and drainage pipe for treating gushing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grouting and drainage pipe for treating sudden surge, relates to the technical field of tunnel construction, and solves the technical problems that when the treatment method of blocking before draining is carried out on the sudden surge disaster of the existing tunnel, the phenomenon of blocking holes is easy to occur when grouting reinforcement and drainage pipe is used for drilling ahead for drainage. The utility model comprises a pipe body, a drill part and a plurality of slurry outlet holes, wherein one end of the pipe body is provided with the drill part, the other end of the pipe body is provided with a pipe body opening, the slurry outlet holes are arranged on the outer surface of the pipe wall of the pipe body and penetrate through the pipe body, a blocking piece is arranged outside the slurry outlet holes, and the blocking piece is closed in the direction close to the drill part and is open in the direction far away from the drill part. In the utility model, the slurry fills the inside of the blocking piece firstly, and then flows out from the opening of the blocking piece to perform grouting, so that the surge water can be effectively prevented from directly carrying sticky particles to flow backwards to block the slurry outlet during grouting.
assignees: YUNNAN COMMUNICATIONS INVEST GROUP YUNLING CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Emergency response using non-cellular long-range radio channel and emergency use wi-fi hotspot
abstract_en: Emergency response by facilitating communication between an emergency communications center and user devices. Such user devices may be highly available without special training, such as cell phones. Furthermore, such communication is available even without the use of a cellular network. Thus, even in emergencies in which cellular communication is no longer possible, individuals can communicate their emergency needs and situation to an emergency communications center, allowing that center to gain a holistic, comprehensive, and fresh understanding of the needs of the community. The communication center can thereby coordinate with capable individuals and resources within the community to help address those needs.

title_en: Numerical simulation method and numerical simulation device for subway train fire disaster
abstract_en: The application provides a numerical simulation method and a numerical simulation device for a subway train fire disaster, wherein the method comprises the steps of importing an original three-dimensional model of a subway carriage into FDS software, and setting fire disaster simulation parameters for the original three-dimensional model in the FDS software to generate a simulation model for simulating the occurrence of the fire disaster of the subway carriage; for each air-conditioning operation mode of an air-conditioning system in a subway carriage, numerical calculation in the air-conditioning operation mode is carried out on the simulation model by utilizing the FDS software, and a fire disaster simulation data time-varying curve of different preset positions in the subway carriage in the air-conditioning operation mode is obtained, so that the influence of the air-conditioning operation mode on personnel evacuation conditions when a fire disaster occurs in the subway carriage is evaluated based on the fire disaster simulation data time-varying curve. By the method and the device, accuracy and diversity of subway train fire numerical simulation are improved.
assignees: CRRC CHANGCHUN RAILWAY VEHICLES CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster image recognition method and system based on CLIP model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster image recognition method and a system based on a CLIP model, which relate to the field of classification of geological disaster images and comprise the steps of collecting a data set related to geological disasters and preprocessing the data set; pre-training the CLIP model, inputting the preprocessed data set into the CLIP model, and carrying out feature integral extraction and coding on the data; measuring the similarity between the image feature vector and the text feature vector, training the similarity of the feature vector row by maximizing the similarity pair and minimizing the dissimilarity pair, and training the CLIP model to gradually learn the shared feature space of the image and the text; and verifying and adjusting parameters of the trained model by using the test set, inputting a new geological disaster image after verification, and predicting the geological disaster type. The CLIP model trained by the invention can analyze the joint representation of the geological disaster image and the related text, and can more accurately identify and classify different types of geological disasters.

title_en: Anti-seepage plugging treatment method for loess hilly coal mining subsidence area
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-seepage plugging treatment method for a loess hilly coal mining subsidence area, which comprises the following steps: s01: grouting and filling surface cracks of coal mining; comprising the following steps: s011: predicting the occurrence condition of surface cracks through numerical simulation; s012: based on the length and width of the ground surface cracks measured remotely by the unmanned aerial vehicle; s013: actually measuring the depth of a ground surface crack based on a ground penetrating radar; s014: grouting and filling the ground surface cracks; s02: grouting and plugging a water guide fracture zone in coal seam exploitation; comprising the following steps: s021: predicting the development height of the water diversion fracture zone through numerical simulation; s022: actually measuring the development height of the water guide fracture zone based on a nano transient electromagnetic method; s023: judging the contact relation between the loess aquifer and the water guiding fracture zone and carrying out leakage analysis; s024: grouting and plugging the water guide fracture zone; s03: and (5) grouting effect detection. The invention forms an underground-overground integrated cooperative treatment technology framework system of the loess hilly coal mining subsidence area, and realizes the organic fusion of mine ecological geological environment protection and earth surface subsidence disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Comprehensive medical emergency rescue management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue, in particular to a medical comprehensive emergency rescue management system, which comprises a data acquisition and processing module, a model training module, a medical rescue module and an emergency rescue module. In the invention, firstly, a data acquisition and processing module collects historical patient data and disaster site data, performs characteristic and label processing on the data, sends the processed data to a model training module, the model training module converts the data into an input type suitable for a model, performs model training, sends the trained model to a medical rescue module and an emergency rescue module, the medical rescue module collects real-time patient data, predicts the severity of illness according to the trained model, makes resource scheduling decisions according to the prediction result, and the emergency rescue module collects real-time disaster site data, predicts the disaster degree according to the trained model, and makes resource scheduling decisions according to the prediction result.
assignees: INSPUR AEROSPACE NANJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based gearbox fault diagnosis method and diagnosis system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin dynamics simulation, and discloses a digital twin-based gearbox fault diagnosis method, which comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a digital twin body of the gear box; s2: predefining fault types and verifying analysis; s3: and diagnosing faults of the gear box. The fault diagnosis system of the digital twin gearbox comprises a simulation model module; a diagnostic output module; and a display module. The model construction and simulation of the actual gear box are carried out by constructing a digital twin body and utilizing virtual reality, so that the operation simulation of the normal state and each fault type state of the existing gear box is formed, the collected operation parameters of the existing gear box are led into the model, whether the gear box has a fault and the fault type can be obtained in a countercheck mode, the working state of the gear box can be timely and effectively judged, the parts with the fault or potential faults can be timely replaced, and the disaster and economic loss caused by the fault can be reduced to a certain extent.

title_en: Emergency simulation training tool for electronic sand table
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic sand table emergency simulation training tool, and relates to the technical field of training tools. The safe box comprises a box body, wherein a sand table seat is movably arranged in the box body, the side wall of the sand table seat slides along the side wall of a storage groove formed in the box body, a workshop module is fixedly arranged at the center position of the top of the sand table seat, and safe evacuation area modules are symmetrically arranged at the tops of the sand table seats on two sides of the workshop module. According to the utility model, the safe evacuation area module, the safe evacuation line, the safe guard line, the fire range circle, the workshop module, the fire-fighting equipment room module, the fire-fighting control room module and the warning lamp are arranged at the top of the sand table seat, the simulation training of emergency fire fighting in the workshop can be realized through cooperation among the modules, the screw is driven to rotate by driving the servo motor, the position height of the sand table seat can be flexibly adjusted according to actual requirements, and the sand table seat can be driven to be automatically stored in the storage groove after the training is finished.
assignees: XIANHENG INTERNATIONAL EMERGENCY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE BEIJING CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV BRANCH;SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER TECH DEVELOPMENT CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for mesuring training information and gas information in real time and monitoring system for training situation and gas distribution situation using the same
title_ko: 실시간 훈련정보 및 가스정보 측정 장치 및 이를 이용한 훈련상황 및 가스분포상황 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention provides an apparatus for measuring training information and gas information in real time, which allows trainees to develop response capabilities to actual fire situations and prioritizes the safety of trainees, comprising: a first communication module receiving training information transmitted from at least one device worn by trainees participating in a firefighting drill; a first processor measuring and analyzing in real time at least one piece of information of air consumption information of oxygen cylinders worn by the trainees, location information of the trainees, and heart rate information of the trainees based on the received training information; and a first database in which the information measured and analyzed in real-time is stored in connection with the first processor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 의한 소방훈련에 참여하는 훈련대원들이 착용한 적어도 하나의 기기로부터 전송된 훈련정보들을 수신하는 제1 통신모듈; 상기 수신된 훈련정보들에 기반하여 상기 훈련대원들이 착용한 산소통의 공기소모량 정보, 훈련대원들의 위치 정보, 및 훈련대원들의 심박 정보 중 적어도 하나의 정보를 실시간으로 측정 및 분석하는 제1 프로세서; 및 상기 제1 프로세서와 연동하여 상기 실시간으로 측정 및 분석된 정보들이 저장되는 제1 데이터베이스를 포함한다.
assignees: TAN SAN ELECTRONICS;UNIV HOSEO ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Articulation disorder improvement system for children using video and audio processing
title_ko: 영상 및 음성 처리를 활용한 아동 조음장애 개선 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a PC application that helps children suffering from articulation disorders alleviate symptoms through sufficient speaking practice even in a non-contact environment. A feedback function is supported by using voice analysis and image processing technology used to allow children in need of speech therapy to alleviate articulation disorders through speaking practice in a non-contact environment. When the developed application is used, repetitive practice to overcome speech disorders can be conducted without time and space constraints to enable efficient speech therapy to be performed. In addition, non-contact speech therapy can be performed at home, regardless of occurrence of an infectious disease such as COVID-19 or a natural disaster. In addition, a financial burden such as the cost of visiting a center for speech therapy can be reduced.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 조음장애 등으로 인해 어려움을 겪는 아동이 비대면 환경에서도 충분한 말하기 연습을 통해 증상을 개선할 수 있도록 도와주는 PC 애플리케이션이다. 
언어치료가 필요한 아동이 비대면 환경에서 말하기 연습을 통해 조음장애를 개선할 수 있도록 활용한 음성 분석 및 영상 처리 기술을 활용해 피드백 기능을 지원한다. 
개발된 애플리케이션을 활용해 시공간의 제약 없이 언어장애 극복을 위한 반복적 연습이 가능해 효율적인 언어치료가 가능하며, 코로나 19 등 전염병이나 자연재해 발생 여부와 상관없이 자택에서 비대면 언어치료를 수행할 수 있다. 또한, 언어치료를 위해 센터를 방문하는 비용 등 경제적 부담의 절감이 가능하다.

title_en: Flight training simulation system and method based on full period management
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flight simulation training simulation, and particularly discloses a flight training simulation system and method based on full period management, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the full-period management-based flight training simulation system can obtain scientific flight training quality evaluation data of the training staff, overcomes the defect of emergency response capability of the training staff when the emergency is handled by artificial judgment in the prior art, and accordingly improves the flight training quality analysis result of the training staff and the referential and value of the emergency response capability evaluation result.

title_en: Geological disaster risk evaluation method based on InSAR dynamic deformation monitoring
abstract_en: The application provides a geological disaster risk evaluation method based on InSAR dynamic deformation monitoring, which comprises the following steps: s1: firstly, carrying out parameterized modeling, constructing a topographic and geological disaster interference radar model, and then applying the geological disaster interference radar to a risk evaluation system; s2: the back-end server uses software simulation to drive the geological observation equipment to update and simulate data of the geological disaster interference radar model, and perform geological disaster risk assessment and simulation training of the radar model; s3: the data outputted by the data simulation in the step S2 are summarized to obtain a synthetic aperture radar SAR data set of the geological disaster event; s4: the data in the synthetic aperture radar SAR data set are classified and integrated, automatic interference processing is carried out to obtain geological disaster data, and the geological disaster type is judged.
assignees: SHANDONG RUIXIN GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling coal mine rock burst
abstract_en: A method for preventing and controlling coal mine rock burst comprises the following steps: step one: deploying underground fracturing drilling holes at the rock burst occurrence position, drilling holes and fixing the holes; step two: paving a fracturing pipeline, connecting ground fracturing equipment with a downhole fracturing borehole to perform fracturing, so as to form a fracturing crack wave-over area in a rock burst occurrence part, generate enough three-dimensional net-shaped cracks in the rock burst occurrence part, reconstruct stress, and destroy local stress concentration; step three: overflowing after fracturing, releasing residual pressure and fracturing fluid, and guaranteeing the safety of subsequent construction; therefore, the invention effectively reduces the occurrence of rock burst disasters, is safer and more efficient to operate, and has great innovation.
assignees: BEIJING JIUZUN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flame detection alarm method for edge AI equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of computer vision, and discloses a flame detection and alarm method for edge AI equipment, which comprises the following steps: s1: the edge AI device is connected with external devices to capture environment images or environment videos; s2: the edge AI device performs preprocessing operation on the environment image or the environment video; s3: deploying a flame detection model based on deep learning training on the edge AI equipment; s4: analyzing information of a preprocessing environment image or the preprocessing environment video through a flame detection model; s5: judging a preprocessing environment image or a preprocessing environment video result, and using a multiple detection contrast mechanism by the edge AI equipment; s6, when the flame is identified, the edge AI device extracts a connected sensor signal; s7: and triggering an alarm mechanism after determining that the fire disaster occurs, and sending alarm information to a third party platform and recording log information. According to the application, under the condition of limited resources, the high-efficiency detection and alarm of flame by the edge AI equipment can be realized.

title_en: Geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system based on deep learning
