abstract_en: The invention discloses a geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: geological information acquisition and processing, signal processing, geological disaster prediction, geological disaster classification, and geological disaster response and early warning. The invention belongs to the technical field of geological engineering, in particular to a geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system based on deep learning, wherein the scheme adopts a dynamic system reconstruction method to process historical geological disaster data, reconstruct a weight matrix, and convert a one-dimensional time sequence into a track in a high-dimensional phase space so as to obtain periodic change of geological disasters; the BP neural network is adopted to process multidimensional features, self-adaptive learning is carried out, and after the neural network training is completed, the BP neural network rapidly responds in practical application, so that automatic geological disaster prediction is realized; and combining the evidences by adopting logic or fusion rules, and selecting the category with the highest confidence as a final geological disaster classification result, so that the robustness is high and the fault tolerance is strong.

title_en: Landslide whole-process surface three-dimensional deformation Beidou radar surface scene data simulation method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a landslide overall process surface three-dimensional deformation Beidou radar surface scene data simulation method, which comprises the steps of selecting landslide hidden danger points to be simulated and collecting parameters; constructing a three-dimensional numerical analysis model of landslide hidden danger points, and importing data into the model to carry out block division or particle filling; calibrating the microscopic mechanical parameters of the model, and carrying out numerical simulation calculation on the surface deformation monitoring points uniformly arranged on the whole domain of the landslide surface to obtain three-dimensional deformation data of the whole process of the surface deformation monitoring points; taking the surface deformation monitoring points as PS points, and taking the deformed three-dimensional deformation data as PS point deformation information truth values; calculating Beidou radar observation values of deformation values of all PS points in the whole landslide evolution process based on the true values and the Beidou radar information; based on the PS point observation value, obtaining the three-dimensional deformation simulation data of the Beidou radar surface scene of the whole landslide evolution process by an interpolation method. The method has low cost, high speed and customization.
assignees: CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES;CHONGQING HUADI ZIHUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning system, method, computer medium and computer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical geological data and network body electrifying data, and integrating the historical geological data and the network body electrifying data to construct a data set; training the data set continuously by adopting a machine learning method to obtain a corrected disaster early warning model; deploying a disaster early warning model, and judging whether a preset disaster phenomenon exists in an early warning area according to continuously collected real-time geological data and network body electrifying data; if yes, triggering early warning alarm, acquiring preset early warning information according to real-time geological data and network body electrifying data, further feeding back the early warning alarm information containing the preset early warning information to a preset object, and if not, re-acquiring the real-time geological data and the network body electrifying data; disaster state data of the early warning area are obtained, and meanwhile, the disaster state data are continuously and synchronously fed back to a preset object. The invention can timely catch early signs of geological disasters such as mud-rock flow and landslide.
assignees: SHENZHEN AIHUA SURVEY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Prediction method for severe drought periodic rhythm in Taihu lake region
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the periodic rhythm of severe drought in a Taihu region, and relates to the technical field of disaster prediction. The method for predicting the periodic rhythm of the severe drought in the Taihu lake region comprises the following steps of S1, collecting a database of precipitation and weather of the Taihu lake region in the past year, collecting the water level change of the Taihu lake region through the past year data, and S2, analyzing and comparing the water level change data collected in the step S1 with the water level change in recent years. By introducing the periodical analysis principle in the nature into the prediction simulation of the severe drought climate event, the rhythm nesting of the periodical change of the severe drought climate event creates a severe drought prediction model, and when the simulation prediction model is created, a simple model framework is directly provided, even an ordinary person without scientific literacy can quickly master the requirement, and no application obstacle exists.

title_en: Method for predicting structural failure of steel normal-pressure storage tank under coupling of fire and explosion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storage tank data analysis, in particular to a method for predicting structural failure of a steel normal-pressure storage tank under the coupling of fire and explosion, which comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional space rectangular coordinate system of the tank group, sequentially positioning and identifying the tank group storage tanks, and collecting tank group data and fire disaster data; constructing a tank group three-dimensional finite element model in three-dimensional finite element construction software according to a tank group three-dimensional space rectangular coordinate system, tank group data and fire disaster data to form an accident simulation process and an accident simulation result, and extracting overpressure threat data and temperature threat data of an initial accident storage tank to a primary accident storage tank according to the accident simulation result; substituting the overpressure threat data and the temperature threat data into an explosion threat value calculation strategy and a fire threat value calculation strategy to calculate an explosion failure threat value and a fire failure threat value; substituting the result into a failure threat calculation strategy to calculate an overall failure threat value, and extracting failure threat data to orderly process the failure threat.

title_en: Radar echo identification method and device for strong convection weather
abstract_en: The application discloses a radar echo identification method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for strong convection weather, belonging to the technical field of strong convection weather identification, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical radar data of disaster weather; processing the historical radar data according to the radar elevation angle and the echo distance to obtain a first tag data set, a second tag data set and a third tag data set; designing a first network architecture, a second network architecture and a third network architecture according to the radar echo distance; inputting the first label data set into a first network architecture for training to obtain a first identification model; inputting the second label data set into a second network architecture for training to obtain a second identification model; inputting the third label data set into a third network architecture for training to obtain a third identification model; and carrying out disaster weather identification based on the first identification model, the second identification model and the third identification model. The method is high in expandability, particularly suitable for strong convection weather identification, and high in identification accuracy.
assignees: CHINESE ACAD METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES;UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Subway station safety evacuation path planning method considering fire spread and personnel position
abstract_en: Urban subways become one of urban irreplaceable public transportation means, but most lines and stations of subways are sealed underground, and once a fire disaster occurs in a subway station, the environment is sealed, personnel are crowded, people are easy to evacuate difficultly due to panic, and personal injury and property loss are caused. Therefore, the application provides a subway station safe evacuation path planning method considering fire spread and personnel positions, which comprises the following steps: according to the layout and the space structure in the subway station, the environmental information near the ignition point and the personnel position information in the subway station are acquired when a fire disaster occurs, the flame spreading situation and the smoke spreading process are simulated through FDS fire dynamics software, then the fire disaster simulation result and the personnel position information are combined, the improved Dijkstra algorithm is used for path planning, and then the safety evacuation path is dynamically optimized according to the real-time personnel distribution information and the real-time crowding degree information of the safety evacuation path during personnel evacuation, so that the safety and high efficiency of the personnel evacuation process are realized.
assignees: SMART TRANSP RESEARCH BRANCH ZHEJIANG COMMUNICATIONS INVESTMENT GROUP CO LTD;UNIV JILIANG CHINA

title_en: Power distribution system fault early warning method and system under meteorological disaster
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for early warning faults of a power distribution system under a meteorological disaster, which are used for establishing a power grid element data and historical meteorological environment data-containing power distribution system fault early warning data set under the meteorological disaster; carrying out data preprocessing on a power distribution system fault early warning data set under a meteorological disaster; constructing a convolutional neural network, performing multi-source data fusion analysis and feature extraction on the preprocessed data, and extracting multi-channel matrix features after dimension increase according to data correlation; constructing a deep neural network, remolding and flattening multi-channel matrix characteristics, and training the constructed deep neural network; and (3) inputting typhoon forecast data into the deep neural network to obtain the power grid fault forecast quantity and realize power grid risk early warning.
assignees: STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;XIAMEN EPGIS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: System and method for quantitatively evaluating ship rescue drilling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for quantitatively evaluating the rescue exercise effect of a ship, wherein the system comprises a ship rescue quantitative evaluation system, the ship rescue quantitative evaluation system comprises an accident scene simulation module, a harmful factor simulation module and a control module, the harmful factor simulation module is used for simulating harmful environmental factors such as nuclear radiation, smog, harmful gas and the like, the harmful factor simulation module comprises a data transmitter, a data receiver, a connecting wire and the like, the control module mainly controls a light generating device, the sound generating device emits various light and sound to simulate a disaster scene, the data transmitter is used for controlling the data transmitter, the different disaster intensities such as nuclear radiation, smog, harmful gas and the like are simulated through parameter setting, the data receiver data are collected, the system can quantitatively evaluate the rescue exercise effect, the distribution rule of the dose exposure of the harmful factors can be found through the dose and time curve of the exposure of the harmful factors, the stage of the maximum exposure dose of the rescue exercise process is found, and a scientific basis is provided for optimizing the rescue process.

title_en: Flight training evaluation method, device and storage medium based on attention model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flight training simulation, and particularly discloses a flight training evaluation method, a device and a storage medium for inhibiting an attention model. Different flight attitudes have different challenges to the attention control capability of pilots, and the attention influence coefficient evaluation result based on attitude control can be used as feedback for pilot training and operation flow improvement, so that the decision making capability, flight safety and emergency response capability of flight training personnel in the flight process are improved.

title_en: Method for optimizing debris flow risk evaluation by considering landslide superposition effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for optimizing the evaluation of the risk of a debris flow by considering the landslide superposition effect, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster risk research and comprises the steps of determining numerical simulation parameters after carrying out detailed investigation on a debris flow basin, and adopting numerical simulation means to restore and predict the movement accumulation process of the debris flow; acquiring debris flow dynamic parameters based on a debris flow movement accumulation process, and completing debris flow risk evaluation by combining a GIS tool; and (3) carrying out detail investigation on the landslide area, obtaining physical and mechanical parameters of the rock-soil body through on-site and indoor tests, calculating the seepage characteristics of the rock-soil body, calculating the instability probability of the landslide, predicting the influence range of the landslide, and optimizing the risk evaluation result of the debris flow by adopting a matrix analysis method based on the superposition effect of the landslide on the debris flow. According to the method, the evaluation of the debris flow risk considering the landslide superposition effect is realized, and the variety of the mountain area debris flow risk research method with disaster concurrency characteristics is enriched. In addition, the invention has reasonable conception and simple operation flow.

title_en: Method for arranging asymmetric high-ground-stress tunnel rock burst microseismic sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides an asymmetric high-ground-stress tunnel rock burst microseismic sensor arrangement method, and relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering. Based on tunnel surrounding rock geological data, carrying out three-dimensional numerical simulation on the stability of an asymmetric high-stress tunnel according to the ground stress distribution of an asymmetric original rock and the geometric characteristics of a tunnel section, calculating the energy of the asymmetric high-stress tunnel, determining the position of a rock burst risk area, distributing microseismic sensors in the front and rear of the stress concentration area, and always including an area with higher risk and an area nearby the area in two groups of microseismic sensor arrays arranged in the front and rear of a tunnel face; the microseismic sensors are mutually cooperated and are arranged in a staggered mode in space, and the installation arrangement of the microseismic sensors immediately moves forwards and backwards in the stress concentration area and always keeps a certain distance range with the stress area. The invention ensures that more effective micro-fracture source signals in and near the tunnel stress concentration area can be captured by the micro-seismic sensor, improves the positioning precision of the micro-seismic source, and lays a foundation for accurately predicting and forecasting the tunnel disasters of the deep buried hard rock.

title_en: Method and device for checking and analyzing large-range thunderstorm wind event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for checking and analyzing a large-range thunderstorm storm wind event, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a large-range thunderstorm wind event data set which comprises historical analysis data, double-polarization radar observation data, satellite observation data, ground automatic weather station observation data and a simulation result of a flow scale numerical forecasting mode, carrying out quality control on the double-polarization radar data and the ground station observation data, interpolating the double-polarization radar data and the ground station observation data to form a mode grid, comparing a large-range thunderstorm storm wind storm system structure, strength and evolution process of checking mode forecasting, and checking a large-range thunderstorm wind strength grading and horizontal distribution range, and a large-storm wind strength, a large-range thunderstorm wind propagation path track and a moving speed by utilizing a large-range thunderstorm wind judging standard. The method can effectively identify and improve the accuracy of large-range thunderstorm strong wind forecast, and has certain guiding significance for reducing strong wind disaster forecast and early warning.

title_en: Industrial factory building fire risk prediction and loss assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting fire risk and evaluating loss of an industrial factory building, which relate to the technical field of industrial fire risk and loss evaluation and comprise the following steps: based on the analysis and evaluation of the indoor and outdoor fire potential risks of the industrial factory building; based on the numerical simulation analysis of the indoor and outdoor fires/smoke of the industrial factory building; fire loss assessment based on fire impact range simulation. According to the requirements of industrial parks, purposes, structures, fireproof characteristics and cleanliness of factory buildings, based on a fire numerical simulation equation and combining with technologies such as factory building design, intelligent factory digital management, geographic information systems, space superposition buffer analysis and the like, the invention provides a whole-process whole-flow industrial factory fire risk and loss evaluation model method, a solution and an application tool device for measuring and calculating fire loss according to the burning loss rate, loss range and the like of building equipment after a fire disaster is determined in an indoor and outdoor fire potential risk source evaluation auxiliary determination fire source before the disaster, a numerical simulation prediction smoke and fire spreading area in the disaster.

title_en: Test equipment and method for simulating surface water erosion and root system seepage guiding action to promote cracking and seam formation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a method for simulating surface water erosion and root system permeability promotion, wherein the test device for simulating surface water erosion and root system permeability promotion comprises: a base; a model box bracket; the model box is filled with test soil proportioning materials of the model box, a drainage guide opening is formed in a coaming plate of the model box, a water seepage pore plate is covered on the drainage guide opening, a water baffle is stopped on the outer surface of the water seepage pore plate, a gap is formed in a bottom plate of the model box, and the bottom plate of the model box comprises a fixed plate and an adjusting plate; the rainfall simulation device comprises a spray head and a rainfall control device; the root system model fixing support is provided with a fixing ring, and the fixing ring is sleeved on the root system model; the monitoring device is used for monitoring the proportioning materials of the test soil body. According to the test equipment for simulating the surface water erosion and root system seepage guiding action and promoting the cracking and seam forming, disclosed by the embodiment of the invention, the multi-factor coupling disaster-causing process can be simulated, and the test equipment has the advantages of being rich in function, strong in applicability and the like.

title_en: Flood invasion underground space crowd evacuation simulation experiment device and method
abstract_en: A crowd evacuation simulation experiment device and method for a flood invading underground space relates to the technical field of simulation experiments, and comprises three reservoirs, a stair area, a plane water accumulation area and a reflux water channel. The three reservoirs are connected with each other to output stable water flow for a stair area and a flat water area, and simulate flood to invade an underground space, wherein the flat water area comprises a first area and a second area; the first area and the second area are separated by a gate; one side of the first area is connected with the stair area, and the other side of the first area is connected with the gate; one side of the second area is connected with a gate, and the other side of the second area is connected with an open gate; the return channel returns accumulated water to the reservoir. According to the application, through the plane water accumulation area and the gate, the situation that the underground space has a water level difference and an evacuation bottleneck is simulated, and omnibearing simulation data are provided for formulating an emergency evacuation scheme of flood invasion underground space crowd.

title_en: Comprehensive detection method for hidden goaf
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safety control of geological disaster hidden danger in a mine underground-to-open hidden goaf, and discloses a comprehensive detection method for a hidden goaf. The method comprises the following steps: drilling: drilling in advance; ultra-deep drilling; kong Zuantan in (a); geophysical prospecting: the comprehensive method for auxiliary verification of shallow earthquake and transient electromagnetic method adopts a high-density resistivity method: the electrode wiring mode is adopted, the dipole device is used as the main data acquisition, and the layered strong current power supply mode is adopted. After implementation, the abnormal rate of the drilling investigation is obviously improved, and the drilling benefit is improved by about 30%. The technical method is applied, so that the fusion of the drilling point and the geophysical prospecting surface of goaf detection is realized, zero omission of goaf detection is truly realized, the risk of potential safety hazards is reduced, and the mining safety production is ensured.
assignees: TAIYUAN IRON & STEEL GROUP CO LTD;TAIGANG GROUP LANXIAN MINING CO LTD

title_en: Test equipment and method for simulating ground subsidence induced by bearing water exploitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses test equipment and a method for simulating pressure-bearing water exploitation to induce ground subsidence, which relate to the technical field of geological engineering, and comprise the following steps: a base; a model box bracket; the model box is provided with a water outlet and is filled with test soil proportioning materials; the pressure-bearing water simulation water tank is provided with a plurality of water passing holes, and each water passing hole is matched with a water passing plugging piece; the hoses are detachably and selectively connected with one part of the water holes, and a plurality of water outlets are formed in the hoses; the rigid water pumping pipe is provided with a plurality of water pumping holes, and each water pumping hole is detachably matched with a water pumping plugging piece; a water pump; and a monitoring device. The test equipment for simulating the ground subsidence induced by the pressure-bearing water exploitation can simulate the coupling disaster-causing process of multilayer pressure-bearing water exploitation, and has the advantages of being rich in function, strong in applicability and the like.

title_en: Method for predicting wind deflection flashover risk of power transmission line based on meta-learning
abstract_en: A method for predicting wind deflection flashover risk of an electric transmission line based on meta-learning relates to the technical field of wind deflection faults of the electric transmission line and is used for predicting the wind deflection flashover risk of the electric transmission line. The method comprises five steps of data preprocessing, learning of model initialization parameters, calculation of wind deflection angles of the power transmission lines, evaluation of the performance of a neural network model and assessment of wind deflection risk grades of the power transmission lines. According to the invention, the initial parameters of the neural network model are learned by adopting a meta-learning algorithm, so that the convergence rate of the model during training is increased, the overfitting is effectively avoided, and the calculation accuracy of the wind deflection flashover of the power transmission line is improved. Compared with the traditional neural network, the method does not need a large number of training data sets, and can realize quick fitting on a small sample set. Meanwhile, the influence factors of various wind bias flashover microclimate, topography and line parameters are fully considered, and the wind bias risk level is judged more reasonably and accurately. In addition, the invention can provide technical support for effectively preventing and developing wind deflection disaster control of the power transmission line.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue breaking platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional rescue breaking and dismantling platform. The fire-fighting training facility aims to solve the technical problems that the existing fire-fighting training facility cannot simulate the scene that the iron gate is damaged, deformed and blocked at a door frame when a fire disaster explodes, the training requirement of firefighters is difficult to meet, the scene that the iron gate is blocked due to thermal expansion in the fire disaster cannot be simulated, and the strain capacity of firefighters to various emergency conditions is reduced. The technical scheme of the invention is that the multifunctional rescue breaking and dismantling platform comprises a breaking and dismantling box, a burglarproof door and the like, wherein the burglarproof door for training breaking and dismantling skills of firefighters is arranged at the rear side of the breaking and dismantling box. According to the invention, the anti-theft door is clamped and fixed through the clamping plate, and simultaneously, the anti-theft door is pulled to deform when the clamping plate is pulled, so that the impact iron gate when a fire disaster explodes is simulated, the iron gate is damaged, deformed and blocked in a door frame scene, and the training effect of the fire fighter breaking and dismantling skills is improved.

title_en: Portable pneumatic puncture cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable pneumatic puncture cooling device, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment and comprises: the back plate is arranged on the back plate, so that the back plate can be carried on the shoulder straps of the firefighter, the tool waistband is arranged on the back plate and wound on the abdomen of the firefighter, the high-pressure gas cylinder is arranged on the back plate, the high-pressure gas cylinder is connected with the pneumatic air cannon drilling machine which is arranged on the tool waistband in a detachable mode through the high-pressure gas supply pipe, and the high-pressure water injection gun is arranged on the tool waistband in a detachable mode and is connected with the high-pressure water pump. According to the utility model, the high-pressure gas cylinder is carried on the back, the waistband is provided with the high-pressure water injection gun and the pneumatic air cannon drilling machine, and the waistband is also provided with the slot of the alloy drill bit, so that the drill bit can be conveniently replaced according to different conditions; when a fire disaster occurs, a firefighter can bear the high-pressure water injection gun and the pneumatic air cannon drilling machine to quickly reach the site, water is quickly injected after drilling, and the time for fighting the fire can be shortened.

title_en: Tunnel tunneling blasting contour damage accurate control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel tunneling blasting profile damage accurate control method in the technical field of tunnel tunneling, which comprises the following steps: step one: performing research on response characteristics and damage mechanisms of surrounding rocks of the wall of a blasting near-area hole; step two: performing research on a near-source particle peak vibration velocity attenuation model; step three: quantitative relation research of surrounding rock characteristics, blasting parameters and damage ranges is carried out; step four: the rock mass blasting damage range is quantitatively controlled to realize efficient excavation, safety and stability of contour blasting; according to the tunnel tunneling blasting contour damage accurate control method, key technical researches on accurate blasting damage control are carried out before tunnel tunneling blasting through various means such as theoretical analysis, numerical simulation and field test, and key technical problems that flying stones and vibration disasters are difficult to control, tunnel tunneling super-undermining accurate control and the like are solved, so that the safety, economy and environmental protection of blasting construction are improved.
assignees: CCCC FIRST HIGHWAY ENGINEERING GROUP CO LTD;THE FOURTH ENG CO LTD OF CCCC FIRST HIGHWAY ENG CO

title_en: Automatic monitoring system for disaster of expressway high slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method or a device for identifying a mode, in particular to an automatic monitoring system for disaster of a highway high slope, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data collection and feature extraction module, a deep learning training module, a risk assessment model construction module, an early warning notification module and an automatic early warning and processing suggestion module. According to the risk assessment method, a complete risk assessment framework is formed through the risk data collection and basic credibility grading module, the Bayesian network algorithm calculation and weight weighting module and the risk level calculation module, the risk assessment framework has high systematicness, the basic credibility of each risk factor after adjustment is calculated through the Bayesian network algorithm, and the weight weighting is carried out, so that the risk assessment result is more accurate, and different risk levels of high, medium and low can be effectively distinguished.
assignees: HENAN JIAOYUAN ENGINEERING TECH GROUP CO LTD;HENAN VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF TRANSP HENAN TRANSP SECONDARY SPECIALIZED SCHOOL

title_en: Structural fire hybrid test method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structural fire hybrid test method and a system, which relate to the field of structural fire resistance tests, wherein the method comprises the steps of predicting the temperature of a physical substructure through a temperature field space-time distribution model; the method comprises the steps of predicting boundary displacement of a physical substructure through a structural fire disaster reaction hybrid simulation proxy model by combining the temperature of the physical substructure and the boundary restoring force of the physical substructure at the previous moment, controlling the temperature of a thermal environment simulation system to reach the predicted temperature, controlling an actuator to enable the physical substructure to realize the predicted boundary displacement, collecting the boundary restoring force of the physical substructure, and feeding back to the structural fire disaster reaction hybrid simulation proxy model. According to the invention, the temperature of each part of the physical substructure and the boundary displacement of the physical substructure at different moments are predicted by using a mode of constructing or training a model, and when a test is carried out, the development change of a fire disaster can be simulated, and thermal-force coupling analysis is not required to be carried out, so that the efficiency is improved, and the real-time performance of numerical calculation is ensured.

title_en: Karst water-rich metal deposit roof single-layer control drainage method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a karst water-rich metal deposit roof single-layer control drainage method, which comprises S1, roof hydrogeological condition exploration; s2, drilling and grouting the structural fracture zone and the water guide fault; s3, reserving waterproof ore pillars, and avoiding water for the structural fracture zone and the water diversion fault; s4, stope drainage is carried out; s5, mining by adopting a filling method. The invention utilizes the natural blocking effect of the water-proof layer, combines grouting reconstruction and active prevention and control measures of dewatering to inhibit disaster, so that the water pressure can not break through the artificial blocking of a grouting curtain, or can not cause damage when the water pressure is released under the condition of promoting new balance, thereby effectively controlling the underground water, and being very suitable for the conditions of complex hydrogeology conditions of mineral deposits and the condition that the structure of the water-bearing layer (belt) has certain difference in space.
assignees: NORTH MINING CO LTD;CHINA MINMETALS CHANGSHA MINING RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Ground crack susceptibility evaluation method based on ground surface time sequence deformation and disaster-pregnancy background
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground crack susceptibility evaluation method based on ground surface time sequence deformation and a disaster-prone background, which comprises the steps of determining the type of the ground crack to be evaluated and the disaster-prone background, and initially establishing a ground crack evaluation factor space database; grading and quantifying the ground fracture evaluation factors by using a deterministic factor method CF to obtain grading and quantifying values; acquiring an integral time sequence deformation result of an evaluation area through a TS-InSAR technology, establishing a coordinate system and resolution consistent with a ground crack evaluation factor in ArcGIS software, and acquiring an annual average deformation rate graph; determining a primary selected area of a ground crack non-disaster point by combining a ground crack occurrence mechanism, determining a selected area of the ground crack disaster point according to historical ground crack list data, and finally constructing a ground crack sample database; and constructing XGBoost a model, taking the quantized value and the ground fracture sample database as the input of the model, outputting a susceptibility evaluation result through the XGBoost model after training, and evaluating the model precision.

title_en: Fire control training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire training system, which comprises a client and a server which are connected with each other; the client is used for: managing personal information of a user, collecting action information of the user, and displaying a virtual simulation scene of fire training to the user; the server is used for: the method comprises the steps of determining a corresponding virtual simulation scene of fire control training based on personal information of a user, feeding back the determined virtual simulation scene to a client for display, and realizing the fire control training of the user in the virtual simulation scene based on action information of the user. The fire training system provided by the invention is based on the interconnected clients and servers, provides the virtual simulation scene corresponding to the personal information of the user such as a firefighter, and collects the actual actions made by the user in the virtual simulation scene so as to realize the fire training of the user in the virtual simulation scene based on the actual actions. Therefore, the fire-fighting training system based on the fire-fighting training system can realize fire-fighting training of users such as firefighters, and can effectively reduce training cost.
assignees: SICHUAN LINGGE INTELLIGENT MANUFACTURING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Indoor smoke and fire characteristic training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an indoor smoke and fire characteristic training system which comprises a detachable board room, wherein the board room forms a first area and a second area which are adjacent through an outer wall and an inner wall, a plurality of observation windows are arranged on the wall surface of the outer wall, combustion fire points are arranged in the second area, an escape door is arranged on the wall surface of the outer wall far away from the second area, a partition door and a plurality of tempering windows are respectively arranged on the inner wall surface between the second area and the first area, the second area is communicated with the outside of the board room through a venturi tube, and a fan is arranged outside the venturi tube. According to the indoor smoke and fire characteristic training system, a coach can control and observe tempering through the tempering window, can observe the bombing effect through the observation window, can observe the backfire effect through the partition door, can repeatedly achieve the bombing scene, can simulate various conditions through combination of presetting and field control, and provides special training for firefighters on the premise of ensuring safety.

title_en: Flammable firefighter training gear
abstract_en: Flammable untreated firefighter training gear is Structural Firefighting Gear (SFG) manufactured without the use of chemical treatments that create resistance to flammability. Stated differently, the gear is SFG that is flammable in the sense that the resulting clothing is as flammable as the uncoated fabric from which the SFG is manufactured. The majority of a firefighter's day is spent preparing for responses to an incident, rather than actual incident response. In other words, the most significant period of time that a firefighter spends wearing their SFG is not during a dangerous incident response scenario, but rather while taking part in the extensive training and preparation to ensure both mental and physical readiness for incidents. As a result, firefighters are often wearing their SFG when its fire and chemical resistance treatments are unnecessary.

title_en: Blasting vibration speed prediction method for soft and hard rock interbedded slope
abstract_en: The invention provides a blasting vibration speed prediction method of a soft and hard rock interbedded side slope, which comprises the following steps of selecting the soft and hard rock interbedded side slope to carry out a field blasting test to obtain blasting vibration speed data of the soft and hard rock interbedded side slope, carrying out rock sampling on the soft and hard rock interbedded side slope, obtaining physical mechanical parameters of the field rock through an indoor mechanical test, establishing a finite element numerical model according to the physical mechanical parameters, verifying a simulation result of the finite element numerical model by using the blasting vibration speed data, supplementing different working conditions, establishing numerical models under the different working conditions, calculating to obtain the vibration speed result, and carrying out formula fitting through the vibration speed result by combining a dimension uniformity theorem to obtain a blasting vibration speed mathematical prediction model considering the blasting parameters and the side slope production. The invention has important practical significance and engineering application value for solving the technical development of the problems of preventing the geological disasters of the slope engineering and the like.

title_en: Intelligent mine disaster early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining area monitoring and early warning, in particular to an intelligent mine disaster early warning method and device. Comprising the following steps: determining stratum lithology distribution of the mining area and structural distribution of fault fold geology based on mine exploration data, and establishing a three-dimensional geological geometric model according to the stratum lithology distribution of the mining area and the structural distribution of the fault fold geology; stress finite element analysis is carried out on the mining area based on the three-dimensional geological geometric model and mine exploration data, and rock physical and mechanical parameters in the mining area and geological environment parameters of the mining area are determined according to analysis results; and determining a disaster area with plastic deformation in the mining area based on the physical and mechanical parameters of the rock mass in the mining area, the geological environment parameters of the mining area and the three-dimensional geological geometric model, and outputting early warning information to the disaster area with plastic deformation. According to the invention, through full coverage analysis modeling of the mine and combining with a numerical simulation analysis means, the accuracy and instantaneity of mine disaster prediction and early warning are effectively improved.

title_en: High-resolution rapid simulation method for coastal city flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution rapid simulation method for coastal city flood disasters, and belongs to the field of coastal disaster protection. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target area, and collecting water depth and urban DEM data of the target area; dividing grids, and constructing a coastal city flood two-dimensional model; based on a two-dimensional shallow water equation, introducing a porosity concept, and constructing a mass conservation equation considering the volume of the water body occupied by the building; based on a two-dimensional shallow water equation, constructing a momentum conservation equation considering the drag force of the building; numerical simulations are performed on the target area based on the modified shallow water equation. The influence of the building on the water body in the city is mainly that the building occupies a part of the water body volume, and the existence of the building has a blocking effect on the water flow.
assignees: OCEAN UNIV CHINA;THIRD INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Evacuation channel for single-hole drilling and blasting method tunnel and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an evacuation channel for a single-hole drilling and blasting method tunnel and a construction method thereof, wherein the evacuation channel for the single-hole drilling and blasting method tunnel comprises the following components: one end of the transverse channel is connected with one side of the single-hole tunnel; and the lower end of the vertical shaft is connected with the other end of the transverse channel, and the upper end of the vertical shaft is connected with the ground. The application not only can meet the requirement of standardizing the arrangement of the evacuation channel about the single-hole drilling and blasting method tunnel, but also provides a better solution for the evacuation rescue of the single-hole drilling and blasting method tunnel under the limit of the topography condition, increases the escape path of personnel in the single-hole drilling and blasting method tunnel, improves the safety, stability and emergency response efficiency of the evacuation channel, and provides better guarantee for evacuation and rescue.
assignees: BEIJING GENERAL MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Mountain area mud-rock flow process analogue means under multi-disaster coupling condition
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a mountain area debris flow process simulation device under a multi-disaster coupling condition, and relates to the field of debris flow simulation tests. A mountain area debris flow process simulation device under a multi-disaster coupling condition, comprising: the back of the frame is fixedly connected with a fixed box, and an inner cavity of the fixed box is provided with an adjusting component matched with the frame for use; the outer side of the fixed box is fixedly connected with a protective cover matched with the frame for use; the top fixedly connected with water tower of frame, the inner chamber of frame is provided with the auxiliary assembly that uses with adjusting part cooperation. According to the mountain debris flow process simulation device under the multi-disaster coupling condition, dynamic showing effects on mountain debris flow and landslide debris flow are achieved under simulated wind, rain and earthquake environments, experimental demonstration effects of the debris flow are enhanced, engineering experiment staff can know occurrence states of the debris flow under different conditions conveniently, understanding of the debris flow disasters by the engineering experiment staff is deepened, and corresponding measures are formulated better for the debris flow disasters.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD

title_en: System treatment method for spontaneous combustion hidden danger area of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of coal mining area treatment, and particularly discloses a system treatment method for a coal mine spontaneous combustion hidden danger area. According to the geological environment characteristics of the treatment area, a mode of treating the disaster and making the ground in the coal mine from the fire hidden danger area combined with strip type treatment, construction of a silted dam, drainage ditch water system dredging and transportation road material conveying is constructed, a treatment process of treating the fire hidden danger area by dividing block sections in the treatment strip and gradient interactive treatment of the strip type block sections is provided, and a natural-simulated soil reconstruction process and a soil improvement method based on risk management and control are constructed. The invention can effectively reduce land damage, eliminate hidden danger of spontaneous combustion, increase cultivated land area, promote biological diversity and restore ecological system function.

title_en: Unknown scene remote sensing image subtitle generation method based on attribute learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image subtitle generating method of an unknown scene based on attribute learning, which mainly solves the problem that the existing method can only generate words and sentences which appear in the training process and cannot accurately describe the unknown scene. The implementation scheme is as follows: building an attribute extractor, setting a learnable attribute identification vector A, and pre-training on a multi-label classification data set; constructing a decoder based on attribute learning, which is composed of an attribute reasoning module and a subject word generation module; cascading a theme encoder, an attribute extractor and an attribute learning-based decoder to form an unknown scene remote sensing image subtitle generating network based on attribute learning, and performing iterative training on the unknown scene remote sensing image subtitle generating network; and inputting the remote sensing images of the test set into a trained subtitle generating network to generate subtitle descriptions. The invention improves the description accuracy of the remote sensing image under the unknown scene, can adapt to various scenes of the remote sensing image, and can be used for ground object image retrieval, disaster prediction and image understanding.

title_en: Freeze damage early warning method for Jinggang honey pomelo
abstract_en: The invention discloses a freeze injury early warning method of Jinggang honey pomelo, and relates to the field of disaster early warning. The invention comprises the following steps: continuously collecting the air temperature and humidity of an orchard; predicting the air temperature by using the air temperature and humidity of the orchard and a neural network; simulating the predicted temperature of each point of the orchard, and judging the temperature conditions of other places of the orchard by using DEM data to simulate cold air flow; judging whether the freezing injury standard is reached or not according to the freezing injury judging standard model of the Jinggang honey pomelo. The invention can realize more accurate early warning of the growth environment of the honey pomelo.
assignees: AGRICULTURAL ECONOMY AND INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF JIANGXI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk analysis method under bridge water blocking effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster risk analysis method under the bridge water blocking effect, and relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster technical analysis. According to the mountain torrent disaster risk analysis method under the bridge water blocking effect, through collecting information in regions where mountain torrents are prone to occurrence and completing aggregation of the information to form a disaster risk analysis model, the water blocking height before a bridge is obtained through calculation of the change of the flow velocity of water, and a water blocking water surface elevation grid is manufactured in combination with the water blocking height, so that the influence range of the water blocking reservoir capacity caused by the water blocking height under different flow velocities can be effectively judged, problems caused by the water blocking effect of the water flow velocity and the bridge are known more clearly through simulated data experiments, and the safety value of the water blocking height in the region is obtained, so that countermeasures can be conveniently and timely made after subsequent application.

title_en: Power transmission line icing thickness prediction method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for predicting the icing thickness of a power transmission line based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: collecting transmission line data; carrying out parameterized modeling according to the power transmission line data, and constructing a digital twin model of the power transmission line; numerical simulation, constructing a preliminary icing prediction model; and combining the digital twin model to construct an icing thickness prediction model. The method for predicting the icing thickness of the power transmission line based on the digital twin technology builds the power transmission line icing prediction model, and improves the prediction precision of the icing model. The icing thickness prediction model constructed by the method can accurately predict the icing thickness of the power transmission line, and has important significance for reducing icing disaster loss and improving power supply reliability.

title_en: Database disaster recovery switching method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a database disaster recovery switching method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, comprising the following steps: receiving a disaster backup switching instruction of a service system, and determining a disaster backup switching mode based on the disaster backup switching instruction, wherein the disaster backup switching mode is one of a disaster switching simulation exercise mode, an intra-plan actual combat exercise mode and an out-of-plan exercise mode; and acquiring a disaster recovery switching script corresponding to the disaster recovery switching mode, and executing the disaster recovery switching script to realize database disaster recovery switching of the service system. After a disaster backup switching instruction of the service system is received, a disaster backup switching mode can be determined, and then a disaster backup switching script corresponding to the disaster backup switching mode is executed, so that the database disaster backup switching of the service system is realized, the whole process realizes automatic switching without manual gradual switching, the time required by database switching is effectively shortened, and the database switching efficiency is improved.

title_en: CFD dynamic grid numerical simulation method combining actually measured wind-induced snow drift
abstract_en: A CFD dynamic grid numerical simulation method combining actually measured wind-induced snow drift relates to a CFD numerical simulation method of wind-induced snow drift. The method aims to solve the technical problem that the existing numerical simulation method ignores the change of the snow surface under the action of wind and snow, so that the coupling between wind and snow fields is distorted. According to the invention, the change of the wall surface boundary is described by adopting a movable grid technology, and the influence of the change of the lower boundary on snow distribution is considered. The existing erosion deposition model is improved, the situation that snow is uniformly distributed due to snowfall and the boundary of the wall surface is changed is considered, and the process is added into dynamic grid development. Meanwhile, a snow drift source item caused by blowing snow is added, and the eroded snow mass is introduced into the calculation domain again through adjusting the snow mass in the calculation domain, so that the deposited snow mass is moved out of the calculation domain. The invention restores the evolution law of the actual wind and snow natural environment to a certain extent and is well matched with the actual measurement result. The method can be used in the field of wind and snow disaster prediction.

title_en: Large-scale urban power grid anti-vulnerability capacity lifting planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving and planning the anti-fragile capacity of a large-scale urban power grid, which comprises the following steps: s1, generating a fault scene based on Monte Carlo simulation; s2, screening representative extreme scenes based on k-means cluster analysis; s3, establishing an urban power grid planning optimization model oriented to limit viability improvement; s4, after the model is solved, the corresponding power supply configuration condition under the line reinforcement scheme is obtained. The distributed power supply is deployed in the planning stage, the important power transmission paths are reinforced/upgraded, and island operation of the power distribution network is guaranteed to be realized through topology reconstruction under the limit natural disasters, so that uninterrupted power supply of more important loads is guaranteed.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Experimental analogue means of high-order soil stone body secondary disaster in landslide emergency rescue
abstract_en: The utility model provides a test simulation device for a secondary disaster of a high-level earth and stone block in landslide emergency rescue, which comprises a base and an angle adjusting device arranged on the base; the base is movably connected with a supporting plate, one end of the angle adjusting device is movably connected with the supporting plate, and the other end of the angle adjusting device is movably connected with the base; one side that the base was kept away from to the backup pad is provided with high-order soil Dan Kuaiti, and one side that angle adjustment device was kept away from to the high-order soil stone body is provided with the temperature rise and falls strong device, and the temperature rise falls strong device and includes the barrier plate, and the barrier plate is connected with heating device, and the top of high-order soil stone body still is provided with unmanned aerial vehicle camera. The utility model can simulate the destabilization damage caused by weakening of mechanical parameters of the structural faces of the high-level soil and stone blocks in scenes with different gradients and different heights, has simple and convenient adjusting process and easy operation, can effectively increase the test flexibility of the module device, can obtain more representative data under the test conditions with different gradients, and provides data verification for landslide block emergency monitoring.
assignees: CHINA ANNENG GROUP THIRD ENG BUREAU CO LTD;CHENGDU XINGJING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster training device and disaster training system
title_ko: 가상현실을 기반으로 하는 구급대응 도상훈련시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual reality-based emergency response simulation training system. According to the present invention, firefighting training is performed on a virtual reality platform. The virtual reality platform comprises a user unit, a connection unit, a virtual reality unit, and a management unit. According to the present invention, it is possible to enhance disaster response capabilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 ICT를 활용한 가상현실 플랫폼(1)상에서 재난 상황을 재연하고, 플랫폼에 접속한 다수의 소방관과 일반인이 소방훈련과 소방체험을 개별 또는 서로 협동하여 실시하되, 상기 플랫폼(1)은 네트워크 망에 연결되어 신호의 입력과 정보의 송수신 및 출력 가능토록 지원하는 유저부(100)와, 유저부(100)들의 동시 접속을 위한 인터넷망이 구축되고, 선택적으로 외부에 저장 관리되는 정보를 호출 및 출력하는 접속부(200)와, 접속부와 연동되어 재난 상황 연출을 위한 가상공간과 체험 오브젝트 및 유저별 맞춤 아바타를 모델링하고, 아바타의 행동과 유저부로부터 입력된 메세지를 가상공간에 출력시켜 상호 소통을 유도하며, 가상공간에 재난 상황을 이벤트별로 제공 및 관리하는 가상현실부(300)와, 유저부, 접속부, 가상현실부간 송수신되는 신호와 데이터 정보를 인계받아 관리 및 제어하고, 가상공간에 연출된 재난 상황에 대한 유저들의 대처 능력을 분석 및 평가하는 관리부(400)를 포함하는 구급대응 도상훈련시스템에 있어서, 상기 가상현실부(300)는 재난상황을 재연하기 위해 설정 지역의 건축물, 도로, 자연, 환자용 NPC(Non-Player Character), 구급 도구, 재난 훈련 및 체험 오브젝트를 구축함과 아울러 플랫폼 및 프로토타입을 기반으로 구축되며, 실제에 입각하여 전체 구조를 설계하고 제공할 수 있는 모델링 기능이 제공되고, 훈련 컨텐츠 및 UX 설계서 작성 기능이 제공되며, 클라이언트의 목표 환경 결정 기능이 제공되고, 플랫폼 서버 및 DB 설계서 작성 기능이 제공되며, 대처 방법에 따른 시나리오를 설계할 수 있고, 환자 중증도 분류 알고리즘(START, SALT, RTS), 환자케이스 관리를 위한 웹기반 CMS 기능을 제공하여 각각 특정 지역들을 3D 환경으로 재연한 가상공간을 형성할 수 있음과 아울러 재연된 가상공간에는 건물, 도로 또는 주변시설 등의 건축물 뿐만 아니라, 사고차량, 경찰차량, 구급차량, 소방차 외 화재나 균열 등의 이펙트가 표현되어 실제와 같은 장소를 연출할 수 있으며, 가상공간 상에 아바타와 소품, 애니메이션 등의 구성 요소가 기획됨과 아울러 이를 관리할 수 있는 DB가 제공되고, 세부 기능을 통해 환자 생성 패턴 및 환경에 따른 상호 작용이 가능한 모델링부(310)와, 유저 아바타의 행동 인식과 텍스트를 출력하여 가상공간에서 유저간 소통을 가능케 하고, 유저 아바타에게 재난 상황을 극복 및 대처할 수 있도록 상황을 안내하는 소통안내부(320)와, 접속부로부터 접속 여부를 판별 산출한 정보, 가상공간과 유저 아바타 및 재난 관련 오브젝트, 영상, 이미지 정보와 아바타의 이동 동선을 일괄 저장하고, 외부에 저장 관리되는 정보를 호출 및 수집하여 영상, 이미지, 재난 관련 오브젝트 정보로 분류 및 저장하는 데이터센터(330)와, 수신되는 입력신호에 따라 데이터센터에 저장된 정보를 설정 경로로 전송하는 송수신부(340)를 포함하고, 상기 환자용 NPC는 환자의 연령대와 성별을 설정하는 외형 설정부(A1)와, 가상공간상에서 환자의 위치를 설정하는 위치 설정부(A2)와, 환자의 상해 위치와 중증도를 설정하는 중증도 설정부(A3)로 이루어지되, 상기 중증도 설정부(A3)는 환자의 상태를 긴급, 응급, 비응급, 사망예상, 사망 단계로 분류하여 환자 증상에 따른 미션을 부여하고, 분류된 단계별로 설정의 색상을 부여하여 유저가 환자의 중증 상태를 시각적으로 안내받을 수 있게 제공하며, 대처 시간에 따른 환자용 NPC의 증상이 변화할 수 있도록 세부 설정이 가능한 것을 포함하고, 상기 접속부(200)는, 회원정보의 입력 및 외부에 저장 관리되는 정보를 호출 가능토록 하는 인터페이스부(210), 게스트와 회원으로 구분하여 입장을 안내하고, 게스트와 회원들의 입장 여부 관련 데이터를 수집 및 관리하고, 인터페이스부에 입력된 회원정보를 승인하는 회원가입부(220), 승인 회원에 대해 가상현실부의 입장을 허용 및 안내하는 접속안내부(230), 가상현실부에 실시간 소통 가능토록 함과 아울러 유니티툴로 개발한 룸(room) 형식의 클라우드 기반 서버로 가상공간에 유저부(100)의 다중 접속을 허용하는 포톤서버부(240)를 포함하여 이루어지며, 상기 소통안내부(320)는, 유저부(100)의 입력신호를 기반으로 아바타를 형성 및 커스텀마이징 기능이 제공되는 아바타 생성부(321), 가상공간에서 아바타의 행동 및 유저가 입력한 텍스트를 출력하는 소통 출력부(322), 유저부의 입력 신호에 따라 아바타의 시점을 제어하는 카메라 제어부(323), 시점을 따라 아바타의 이동을 가능케 하고, 유저부의 입력 신호에 따라 아바타의 모션을 형성하는 아바타 동작부(324), 가상공간상에 연출할 적어도 하나 이상의 화재나 붕괴, 교통사고, 천재지변이나 인명 피해와 관련된 재난 상황 이벤트를 생성, 편집, 출력되게 하며, 제작된 재난 상황 이벤트를 유포할 수도 있으며, 타 기업에서 제작된 재난 상황 이벤트를 불러와 현 플랫폼에 적용할 수도 있고, 관리자 페이지를 통해 재난 환경 이벤트의 플레이 시간을 유동적으로 설정할 수 있으며, 각각의 재난 상황 대처 능력을 평가하기 위한 난이도에 맞춰 시간 제한 모드나, 각종 미션 훈련을 적용시킬 수 있도록 형성되는 이벤트 관리부(325)를 포함하여 이루어지고, 상기 관리부(400)는, 유저부(100)의 행동 정보를 수집하는 모션수집부(410), 유저의 행동 정보를 바탕으로 재난 대처 능력을 판단하는 산출부(420), 산출된 내용으로 유저 개별 및 대단위의 재난 대처 능력을 단계별로 평가할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 개별 및 대단위가 각각 목적을 달성한 시간 및 대처 능력을 분석할 수 있는 시스템을 제공하며, 기입력된 프로그램에 의해 개별 및 대단위 각각에 대처가 미흡했던 부분을 각각 실시간 분석하여 해결 방안을 피드백 해주는 평가부(430)를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Key Phrase extraction and accuracy evaluation method for building integrated construction disaster DB
title_ko: 시공재해 db 통합을 위한 핵심어구 추출 및 정확도 평가 방법
abstract_en: A method for extracting key phrases and evaluating accuracy to integrate a construction disaster DB comprises the steps of: collecting construction disaster training data, performing training text mining for extracting and processing information by applying a natural language processing technology and a document processing technology to the construction disaster training data, extracting key training keywords from the data which has undergone the training text mining, and configuring a training risk scenario through object type integration and statistical analysis with respect to the key training keywords of the construction disaster training data; configuring a risk scenario through a construction disaster data collecting process of collecting construction disaster data, a text mining process of performing text mining for extracting and processing information by applying the natural language processing technology and the document processing technology to the construction disaster data, a key keyword extracting process of extracting key keywords from the data which has undergone the text mining, and a risk scenario configuring process of configuring a risk scenario through object type integration and statistical analysis with respect to the key keywords of the construction disaster data; and comparing the risk scenario with the training risk scenario to verify determine whether the risk scenario is within a predetermined similarity range. According to the present invention, casualties from construction disasters can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 시공재해 DB 통합을 위한 핵심어구 추출 및 정확도 평가 방법은 건설사고 훈련데이터를 수집하고, 건설사고 훈련데이터에 대하여 자연어 처리 기술과 문서 처리 기술을 적용하여 정보를 추출 및 가공하는 훈련텍스트마이닝을 수행하며, 훈련텍스트마이닝을 거친 데이터에서 핵심 훈련키워드를 추출하고, 건설사고 훈련데이터의 핵심 훈련키워드에 대하여 객체유형 통합 및 통계적 분석을 통하여 훈련 위험 시나리오를 구성하는 단계, 건설사고 데이터를 수집하는 건설사고 데이터 수집 과정, 건설사고 데이터에 대하여 자연어 처리 기술과 문서 처리 기술을 적용하여 정보를 추출 및 가공하는 텍스트마이닝을 수행하는 텍스트마이닝 과정, 텍스트마이닝을 거친 데이터에서 핵심 키워드를 추출하는 핵심 키워드 추출 과정 및 건설사고 데이터의 핵심 키워드에 대하여 객체유형 통합 및 통계적 분석을 통하여 위험 시나리오를 구성하는 위험 시나리오 구성 과정을 통해 위험 시나리오를 구성하는 단계 및 위험 시나리오를 상기 훈련 위험 시나리오를 비교하여 기설정 유사도범위 이내인지를 판단하는 검증단계를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA CONSTRUCTION DISASTER PREVENTION RES CO LTD

title_en: Method, apparatus and program for providing physical firness management service based on physical fitness test items
title_ko: 체력시험 항목에 기반한 체력 관리 서비스 제공 방법, 장치 및 프로그램
abstract_en: According to the embodiments of the present invention, disclosed is a method for providing a physical fitness management service based on physical fitness test items. This invention was devised in response to the demand for a service analyzing and managing the physical fitness of police and firefighting officers, safely improving their fitness. The method for providing a physical fitness management service based on physical fitness test items comprises the steps of: acquiring user information including job and physical data; recognizing physical fitness test items corresponding to the job; identifying at least one exercise equipment corresponding to the fitness test items; determining the intensity of the at least one exercise equipment based on the physical data; obtaining a user's fitness measurement information measured based on the at least one exercise equipment and the determined intensity; and providing fitness analysis information generated based on the user information and the fitness measurement information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시예에 따른 체력시험 항목에 기반한 체력 관리 서비스 제공 방법이 개시된다. 상기 방법은: 직무 및 신체 정보를 포함하는 사용자 정보를 획득하는 단계; 상기 직무에 대응하는 체력시험 항목을 인식하는 단계; 상기 체력시험 항목에 대응하는 적어도 하나의 운동 기구를 인식하는 단계; 상기 신체 정보를 기초로 상기 적어도 하나의 운동 기구의 강도를 결정하는 단계; 상기 적어도 하나의 운동 기구 및 상기 강도를 기초로 측정된 사용자의 체력 측정 정보를 획득하는 단계; 및 상기 사용자 정보 및 상기 체력 측정 정보를 기초로 생성한 체력 분석 정보를 제공하는 단계;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Experiment system for inversion of large-scale ground fracture physical model
abstract_en: The invention provides an experimental system for inversion of a large-scale ground fracture physical model, and relates to the technical field of geological experimental measurement. This large-scale ground crack physical model inversion's experimental system, including detecting case and fixed plate, the right side surface of detecting case runs through and is provided with first drinking-water pipe, second drinking-water pipe and third drinking-water pipe, the right side surface upper portion fixedly connected with connecting plate of fixed plate, the lower surface middle part fixedly connected with electric telescopic handle of connecting plate, the bottom fixedly connected with pressure plate of electric telescopic handle, the right side surface middle part of fixed plate is provided with electric chute, electric chute's surface sliding connection has high measuring apparatu, the right side surface of fixed plate just is provided with the camera in the below of connecting plate. According to the invention, the evolution process of the 'water production type' ground crack disaster under the soil condition is simulated, and a corresponding measurement method can be made according to the actual water production depth, so that the actual scene can be comprehensively simulated.
assignees: GEOLOGICAL SURVEYING & MAPPING INST OF SHANDONG PROVINCE

title_en: Meteorological hydrologic early warning method suitable for plain water network area
abstract_en: The invention provides a meteorological hydrologic early warning method suitable for a plain water network area, which comprises the following steps: after a Hong Jiang precipitation process and an evaluation area are determined, forming a process rainfall gridding according to rainfall data of historical monitoring, real-time monitoring and forecasting processes, and simulating by using a FloodArea (FloodArea) model to obtain a flood level result of a plain water network area facing the strong precipitation process; and (3) carrying out disaster factor risk analysis according to the flood level result, and combining a Logistic model and superposition analysis to realize risk assessment and risk early warning. The meteorological hydrologic early warning method can quantitatively express the difference of the submerged range and the submerged depth in a research area, extract the risk grades of different river sections of a medium-small river, and construct a risk quantitative evaluation model by combining the spatial distribution characteristics and the disaster causing conditions of different disaster-bearing bodies to form the risk of the different disaster-bearing bodies affected by the process of causing Hong Jiang precipitation.

title_en: Flood disaster deduction method, equipment and medium based on high-resolution remote sensing elements
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, equipment and medium for deducing a flood disaster based on high-resolution remote sensing elements, which belong to the technical field of electric digital data processing, acquire a stereopair remote sensing image in a flood disaster range of a to-be-modeled river basin and generate a corresponding orthographic image and a digital elevation model; interpreting, classifying and processing the orthographic image map to obtain a land cover distribution map, assigning a roughness to obtain a river basin roughness distribution map, and calculating river channel ratio drop in a to-be-modeled river basin according to a digital elevation model; determining corresponding hour flow process data and hour precipitation process data based on the historical water level flow information; unifying a coordinate system of an orthographic image, an elevation digital model and a land cover distribution map, and drawing GIS files required by modeling according to the digital elevation model and the orthographic image after unifying the coordinate system; simulating the evolution process of the flood peak dam break and the downstream flood disaster corresponding to the river basin to be modeled through the dam break model and the 2D unsteady flow model, and obtaining disaster condition data deduced by the flood disaster, wherein the disaster condition data are used for disaster prevention and disaster reduction.
assignees: BEIJING SIXIANG AISHU TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID XIAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CENTER CO LTD;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Dynamic numerical identification process for broken mountain torrents and debris flows in ice lakes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic numerical identification process of a burst type mountain torrent and mud-rock flow in a iced lake, which belongs to the technical field of mountain disaster prevention, and comprises the following numerical classification processes: s1, acquiring basic data of a lagoon and a river basin where the lagoon is located; s2, establishing a rock burst mathematical model of the ice lake through the basic data, and calculating burst hydraulic characteristics of the ice lake; s3, establishing a water-soil coupling fluid motion equation on a channel of the target river basin through the basic data, describing a fluid motion state through simulating an ice lake breaking process and an evolution process of fluid on the channel, and further calculating the volume concentration of a moraine material source in the fluid according to water-soil coupling fluid motion parameters; s4, selecting the classified volume concentration of the tillite source as a classification index. According to the dynamic numerical identification process of the ice lake burst type mountain torrent and the mud-rock flow, the characteristics of the ice lake burst fluid are calculated through the plurality of dimensions of the characteristics of the ice morante, the channel and the water power, the property of the ice lake burst fluid is represented through a numerical operation mode, the accuracy of judging the property of the ice lake burst fluid is improved, and the dynamic classification of the ice lake burst type mountain torrent and the mud-rock flow is realized.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Landslide-surge climbing disaster override probability evaluation method, landslide-surge climbing disaster override probability evaluation equipment and storage equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a surge climbing disaster override probability evaluation method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a parameter value range of a target area and an initial sample value of the target area, constructing a numerical simulation, calculating a response value of the initial sample value through the numerical simulation, storing the initial sample value and the response value of the initial sample value as mat files, inputting the mat files into software, setting a limit state function and an iteration error according to the position of a disaster object of the target area, generating a performance function through constructing an RBF meta-model and a iHL-RF algorithm, generating a design point according to the iHL-RF algorithm, calculating the response value of the design point through the numerical simulation, inputting the response value of the design point into MATLAB software, continuously iterating the RBF meta-model, calculating the iterated override probability value and a new design point until the iteration error reaches a preset condition, and outputting the override probability value.

title_en: Coal gangue accurate self-adaptive filling method based on working face ore pressure regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal gangue accurate self-adaptive filling method based on working face ore pressure regulation and control, which comprises the following steps: step one, acquiring stress distribution data above a filling hydraulic support and in front of a working face in the mining process by using FLAC3D numerical simulation software, and establishing a nonlinear relation between the stress above the filling hydraulic support and the stress in front of the working face, so that the mining pressure distribution situation in front of the working face can be inverted by inputting the support load; step two, determining the size of a stress peak value according to the mine pressure distribution data in front of the working face which is subjected to the reverse performance, and early warning the position of a stress concentration area; step three, deciding key filling positions of the goaf according to the positions of the stress concentration areas of the early warning; and step four, filling by adopting a gangue filling device according to the key filling position of the determined goaf. The key filling position of the goaf is decided by utilizing the method, and the mine pressure is controlled under the condition that coal-rock dynamic disasters and coal wall caving are not generated, and the range that coal is broken and gangue is not broken can be realized.

title_en: City disaster event knowledge graph construction and representation method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and a storage medium for constructing and representing a knowledge graph of an urban disaster event, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining city original data; defining the entity center knowledge graph and the entity of the event center knowledge graph, and processing the acquired data through entity mapping and relation extraction technology; combining the entity center knowledge graph and the event center knowledge graph based on an entity link mode to realize the fusion of the two knowledge graphs and obtain the urban disaster event knowledge graph, wherein the entity link increases training data through countermeasure generation so as to improve the alignment accuracy; and performing representation learning on the nodes and the relations of the knowledge graph of the urban disaster event to obtain a low-dimensional embedded vector representation of the knowledge graph. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the knowledge graph construction is more reasonable, complex disaster event semantic analysis can be realized, and the like.

title_en: Geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The application discloses a geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control, which comprises a workbench, wherein symmetrically arranged transmission screw rods and cooperative columns are arranged on the workbench; a lifting seat is commonly arranged on the transmission screw rod and the cooperative column; the lifting seat is provided with a first driving component which penetrates through the lifting seat and is provided with an inner cylinder; an outer cylinder body is arranged on the outer periphery of the inner cylinder body; the outer cylinder body is rotatably arranged at the bottom of the lifting seat; an impact assembly is also arranged between the lifting seat and the inner cylinder body; the bottom of the inner cylinder body is provided with a drill bit; the inner side of the outer cylinder body is connected with the top surface and the bottom surface of the inner cylinder body, the bottom of the inner cylinder body is provided with a third driving component, and the third driving component is in transmission connection with the partition sampling cylinder. The impact assembly helps the drill bit to realize multiple impact drilling in the drilling process, has strong flexibility, and can greatly reduce the damage of the drill bit; and secondly, the application improves the partition sampling tube arranged in the inner cylinder body, realizes the partition layered collection of underground soil, and improves the sampling precision.
assignees: SHANDONG BANGHONG ZHONGCHUANG INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster dangerous area road evacuation guiding information generation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for generating road evacuation guiding information in a dangerous area of a mountain torrent disaster, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a real-time three-dimensional model of the mountain torrent disaster, inputting acquired monitoring data such as rainfall, debris flow and the like, analyzing the mountain torrent risk disaster grade, carrying out simulation on a personnel evacuation route in the dangerous area based on acquired population signaling data and on the mountain torrent disaster risk grade, carrying out dynamic planning decision on the evacuation route, pushing road evacuation guiding information to personnel in the dangerous area for evacuation, and can effectively avoid the existing dangerous points and the dangerous points to be evacuated safely and quickly. Further, the road evacuation guiding information is pushed for multiple times, people in the dangerous area are urged to evacuate multiple times, and casualties caused by mountain torrents are reduced.

title_en: Urban rail passenger flow cooperative control method, electronic equipment and storage medium
