abstract_en: A cooperative control method, electronic equipment and storage medium for urban rail passenger flow belong to the technical field of rail traffic control. In order to realize passenger flow control under the condition of not increasing the transportation energy, the invention utilizes the track simulation system to deduce the predicted passenger flow quantity in the urban track line peak period, and comprises an inbound ID, an outbound ID, an inbound period and passenger flow number data; according to different time periods t Sum site s Dividing to obtain time periods t Down to the site s Preparing passenger flow of a standing passenger; according to the historical passenger flow clearance data of the subway operation company, passenger flows in all directions of the historical passenger flows are counted, and the passenger flow ratio of each direction of the historical passenger flows is calculated; constructing a multi-station passenger flow cooperative control mixed integer programming model; and (3) solving the multi-station passenger flow cooperative control mixed integer programming model constructed in the step (S3) by utilizing a branch-and-bound algorithm to obtain a station optimal inbound passenger flow scheme. The invention realizes the effect of preferential evacuation of the large passenger flow station.

title_en: Double-polarization radar raindrop spectrum parameter inversion method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dual-polarization radar raindrop spectrum parameter inversion method, which comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing observation data of a laser raindrop spectrometer; based on the preprocessed data, calculating raindrop spectrum and double-polarization radar parameters; then selecting the correlation characteristics of inversion based on the mutual information; the input feature vector of the Longformer model is designed again, and a Longformer model which is specially aimed at the dual-polarization radar raindrop spectrum inversion task is constructed; training, verifying and evaluating a Longformer dual-polarization radar raindrop spectrum parameter inversion model; and finally, preprocessing the dual-polarization radar data by adopting a special strategy, and inverting by utilizing the trained Longformer model to obtain radar raindrop spectrum parameters with space-time continuous characteristics. The invention realizes the acquisition of the raindrop spectrum parameters of the space-time continuous scale dual-polarization radar, and provides a high-efficiency and accurate raindrop spectrum inversion tool for weather forecast and disaster defense.

title_en: Simulation prediction method and system for landslide river-plugging impact dam area building process
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation prediction method and a system for a landslide river-plugging impact dam area building process, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, modeling and assigning; step 2, constructing a landslide triggering and disaster chain spreading overall process simulation frame; step 2-1, simulating before landslide triggering; step 2-2, determining whether to trigger landslide according to judgment conditions of landslide triggering critical conversion; step 2-3, simulating the impact of rock along the way and the building process after landslide triggering; step 2-4, calculating the contact force of the rock or the building; step 2-5, landslide soil and rock building erosion start judgment; step 2-6, repeating the process and updating the initial value of the next time step until the preset time step number is reached; and 3, predicting the potential landslide soil triggering, evolution, erosion of the soil along the way and the whole process of building and impacting the downstream building according to the landslide triggering and disaster chain transmission whole process simulation framework, predicting the landslide triggering and transmission process, and quantifying landslide disasters.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle positioning deception detection method and system thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for detecting unmanned aerial vehicle positioning deception, which relate to the technical field of image processing and comprise the following steps: acquiring an aerial photograph of a satellite region; acquiring the longitude and latitude of the aerial photo, and calling a satellite image corresponding to the aerial photo according to the longitude and latitude of the aerial photo; processing the satellite image by using the trained CGAN model to obtain a disaster-stricken image; the trained CGAN model is obtained according to satellite images before disaster and satellite images after disaster; processing the disaster-stricken image by using the trained ResNet model to obtain a processed image; the trained ResNet model is obtained according to aerial photo and satellite image training; comparing the aerial image with the processed image, judging whether the aerial image acquisition process is attacked, and if so, performing detection processing. The application has higher detection success rate.

title_en: Regional highway network risk prediction method by climate change and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional highway network risk prediction method by climate change and a readable storage medium, comprising the following steps: firstly, obtaining highway network information and disaster influence factors of an area to be predicted; collecting reference year observation data; selecting and simulating global climate mode data; determining a predicted scenario and predicting the climate characteristics of a target year; performing correction operation through a space-time sequence prediction model to obtain reliable target annual climate characteristics; determining a climate characteristic change result; dividing the region to be predicted, and interpolating to obtain the climate change risk coefficient of each space unit; and finally, obtaining a regional highway network risk prediction result of the regional highway network to be predicted according to the risk coefficient. By the design, a scientific and effective evaluation mode is provided, and the capability of the highway network for coping with climate change is improved.
assignees: TRANSP PLANNING AND RESEARCH INSTITUTE MINISTRY OF TRANSP CHINA

title_en: Landslide recognition model training method, landslide recognition method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction, and discloses a training method of a landslide identification model, a landslide identification method and a landslide identification device. According to the invention, through a mode of spatial superposition of the first landslide information and the second landslide information, each region in a preset range is respectively determined as an overlapped region and a non-overlapped region, wherein the overlapped region is a region with accurate judgment of the remote sensing image, and the non-overlapped region is a region with error judgment of the remote sensing image. Determining target remote sensing image characteristics through remote sensing image characteristic values respectively corresponding to the remote sensing image characteristics in the overlapping area and the non-overlapping area, and training a pre-constructed landslide identification model through the target remote sensing image characteristics and second landslide information of the overlapping area, so that the model learns the association between the remote sensing image characteristics and the landslide information, and the trained model has the capability of determining the landslide information according to the remote sensing image characteristics. According to the landslide identification method, the landslide identification process is more efficient and accurate through the trained landslide identification model.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: High-precision flame region extraction method based on forest fire scene multi-feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-precision flame region extraction method based on multi-feature extraction of forest fire fields, the method comprises the steps of obtaining an actual fire scene image and a conventional flame data set, preprocessing the actual fire scene image, constructing the actual fire scene data set, designing multiple feature extraction engineering, training and optimizing a model and extracting a flame region. According to the invention, the image pixels are divided into a plurality of clustering blocks through a clustering block algorithm, the image features are extracted by utilizing feature engineering, meanwhile, the labels of fire and non-fire are hit, CNN convolutional neural network training is introduced, a training model for flame region extraction is obtained through optimization of an Adam optimizer, and finally, high-precision flame region extraction is realized. Compared with the conventional flame region extraction method, the method has the advantages that the algorithm is low in calculation complexity, the flame region extraction speed is high, meanwhile, the high accuracy of flame region extraction is guaranteed, and an accurate fire scene condition is provided for firefighters rescuing a fire disaster in a complex fire scene environment.

title_en: Coal mine underground depression angle drilling coal seam gas pressure measuring device and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and relates to a coal mine underground depression angle drilling coal seam gas pressure measuring device and method. The method is used for measuring the gas pressure of the coal seam of the underground depression angle pressure measurement drilling of the coal mine, and the high-efficiency and accurate measurement of the gas pressure of the coal seam is realized. Based on the high-precision gas pressure sensor, the connecting part is reduced, the bottom end plugging and gas pressure measuring pipeline connecting procedure is canceled, and the purpose of accurately measuring the gas pressure of the drilling coal bed in the depression angle pressure measuring is realized.

title_en: Intelligent identification method for high-level collapse geological disasters
abstract_en: The application is suitable for disaster identification technology, and provides an intelligent identification method for high-order collapse geological disasters, which comprises the following steps: acquiring surface information data; fusing the acquired information data; establishing an intelligent recognition model, and training and optimizing the model by combining the extracted characteristic data; and analyzing the acquired data through the intelligent recognition model, and judging the risk probability. By the intelligent identification method for the high-level collapse geological disasters, advanced technical means such as satellite remote sensing technology, inSAR technology, liDAR technology and the like can be fully utilized, the defects of the traditional manual inspection and monitoring method are overcome, and the efficiency and accuracy of geological disaster monitoring and early warning are improved, so that the safety of lives and properties of people is guaranteed.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD

title_en: Comprehensive monitoring and early warning system for mine disasters and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive monitoring and early warning system for mine disasters, which comprises a real-time online monitoring unit, an early warning model calculation unit and a three-dimensional scene display unit, wherein the real-time online monitoring unit comprises a fire online monitoring module, a flood online monitoring module, a ground pressure online monitoring module and a lifting machine online monitoring module, the three-dimensional scene display unit comprises a roadway model and a ventilation system model, and the early warning model calculation unit comprises a ground pressure early warning model, a fire simulation escape model, a flood three-dimensional calculation model and an AI recognition edge calculation model. In a complex and changeable underground production environment, the system can carry out linkage capturing analysis on disaster risk parameters of four modules such as ground pressure, fire, flood and hoisting machine in real time, realize quantitative classification of risks and assist management personnel in improving safety control and emergency decision of mine production.
assignees: SINOSTEEL CORPORATION WUHAN SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION RES INSTITUTE COMPANY LIMITED

title_en: Sensor dynamic information linkage analysis method based on feature matching fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a sensor dynamic information linkage analysis method based on feature matching fusion, which comprises the following steps of obtaining measurement data input by a hybrid distributed sensor, vectorizing the measurement data to obtain a first parameter vector group, carrying out unbiased estimation judgment on the first parameter vector group, converging the first parameter vector group according to estimated probability after judgment to obtain a second parameter vector group, adopting a time autoregressive model to refer to the second parameter vector group to form a time predictor, outputting a third parameter vector group by the time predictor, inputting the second parameter vector group and the third parameter vector group into a Hadoop platform, analyzing the second parameter vector group and the third parameter vector group according to a preset neural network model, and predicting the subsequent sensor data by utilizing the time autoregressive model to simulate a real environment so as to realize the prediction of geological disasters.

title_en: Experimental method for earthquake fault simulation based on geotechnical centrifuge platform
abstract_en: The invention provides an experimental method for earthquake fault simulation based on a geotechnical centrifuge platform, and relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster simulation. In the experimental process of the earthquake fault simulation, the method monitors the stress and the local deformation of the end part of the tunnel, the earth surface displacement and the acceleration of the field covering layer, the soil pressure, the operating quantity and the operating force of the horizontal actuating system, the surface crack fracture image and the field deformation image. According to the invention, the earthwork centrifugal platform is used for simulating a supergravity environment, truly reducing the true stress state of rock and soil, and simultaneously acquiring the end stress and local deformation of a tunnel, the surface crack fracture image and the site deformation image in a simulated earthquake fault and a site covering layer, and the operating quantity and the operating force of a horizontal actuating system, so that the whole earthquake starting process caused by the movable fault fracture and the propagation effect of the earthquake in the site are simulated, and the dynamic response characteristic simulation experiment of the engineering structure under the fault crossing situation is realized.

title_en: Three-dimensional geologic body sectioning method based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional geologic body sectioning method based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring PRB data, drilling data and a digital elevation model; s2, calculating a geological interface hidden function equation according to PRB data; s3, extracting a DEM point set in the digital elevation model to obtain a tetrahedral geological model; s4, utilizing the hidden function property to carry out section division; s5, simulating the stratum state of the virtual geological drilling by using a Monte Carlo method; s6, defining corresponding geological properties of geological areas in the section according to section combination to form a section model; the method is based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation, can generate a deterministic model which cannot capture the uncertainty of stratum attributes through implicit three-dimensional geological modeling, can better reflect the complex spatial cutting relationship and stacking relationship among geological structures and the specific form inside the structures, and has the characteristics of being more modified, being capable of accurately explaining the ground, carrying out disaster early warning analysis decision and the like on underground excavation engineering.
assignees: UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH;CHINA ROAD & BRIDGE CORP

title_en: Information intelligent association method and system for evacuation indicator lamp and emergency evacuation system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent information association method and system for evacuation indicator lamps and an emergency evacuation system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent evacuation, and the intelligent data association algorithm for the evacuation indicator lamps and the emergency evacuation system is designed according to two different data importing conditions so as to ensure that the position and arrangement sequence of each evacuation indicator lamp, the affiliated road and the position and area of each evacuation indicator lamp are actually consistent; the method for automatically binding the evacuation indicator lamps and the evacuation communication gateway greatly improves the intelligent degree of the emergency evacuation system and the practicability, convenience and adaptability of deployment and use. In addition, when an accident or emergency exercise occurs, the evacuation indicator lamp automatically calculates the correct indication direction (left flashing, right flashing and double flashing) according to the evacuation direction of the current binding path provided by the emergency evacuation scheme, so that people are guided to evacuate orderly and rapidly according to the optimal route, and the personnel safety is ensured.

title_en: Drilling device for complex high steep side slope and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a drilling device for a complex high-steep slope, which comprises a fixing piece, a supporting plate and a drilling assembly, wherein the fixing piece is used for being fixed on a slope, the supporting plate is arranged on the surface of the fixing piece, the drilling assembly is arranged on the supporting plate and is in up-down sliding fit with the supporting plate, the fixing piece comprises a fixing plate and a drilling locating plate, the fixing plate is used for being fixed on the slope, a hollow soil discharging cavity with an opening facing the slope bottom is arranged in the drilling locating plate, a soil cleaning assembly is arranged in the soil discharging cavity, and a transmission piece is arranged between the drilling assembly and the soil cleaning assembly in a linkage mode, so that the soil body lifted by the drilling assembly is discharged into the soil discharging cavity when the drilling assembly is lifted, and the drilling efficiency and the drilling quality are improved.

title_en: High-density crowd evacuation simulation method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-density crowd evacuation simulation method, a device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computer simulation. The high-density crowd evacuation simulation method comprises the following steps: initializing simulated environment information and crowd state information; determining a guiding position of a safety person for evacuating people based on the environmental information; obtaining a target position and a target speed according to crowd state information and combining heterogeneous social force and group social force models and a smooth particle fluid dynamic model; obtaining a target emotional state based on the target position and the emotion propagation strategy; generating a safety instruction to enable a safety person to evacuate the crowd and obtain the number of target crowd; updating crowd state information; and returning to the step of obtaining the target position and the target speed until the evacuation condition is met. The invention combines the microscopic combined heterogeneous social force with the group social force model and the macroscopic smooth particle fluid dynamic model, and combines the heterogeneous characteristics and the group characteristics, thereby ensuring the accuracy and the reliability of simulation.

title_en: Flood disaster condition assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster assessment method, which comprises the steps of firstly, respectively constructing a plurality of training data sets by using historical flood disaster data, and then constructing a plurality of parallel disaster index prediction models, so that each training data set is used for training one disaster index prediction model; after the disaster index prediction model is trained, the disaster index prediction model is utilized to extract disaster related characteristics from three aspects of space, nonlinearity and time sequence, the disaster index is accurately predicted, and then emergency response measures of corresponding grades are matched according to grade division of the disaster index.

title_en: Method for determining length of turbulent mixing sedimentation zone of tunnel fire smoke
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for determining the length of a turbulent mixing and settling zone of flue gas in a tunnel fire disaster. And then, analyzing the power of different fire sources and the change condition of smoke flow parameters in tunnels with different lengths through numerical simulation, and providing reasonable numerical calculation length basis of the turbulent mixing and sedimentation area. Finally, analyzing the influence of factors such as fire source power, tunnel length and the like on the critical length of the numerical calculation section, and providing a method for calculating and designing the influence of the tunnel length and heat release rate on the turbulent mixing and settling zone.

title_en: Optimal algorithm parallel computing method and system for geological disaster early warning
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of data processing, and discloses an optimal algorithm parallel line computing method and system for geological disaster early warning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining geological monitoring data, a data characteristic identification model, a data transmission rate and an IO reading maximum rate; based on geological monitoring data, data transmission rate, IO reading maximum rate, data characteristic identification model and a preset sampling configuration table, configuring sampling parameters, and sampling the geological monitoring data to obtain sampling data; configuring a simulation model based on the sampling data and a preset simulation model configuration table, and fitting to obtain geological monitoring simulation data; based on the maximum thread number of the equipment and the utilization rate of each thread, segmenting geological monitoring simulation data and then distributing the segmented geological monitoring simulation data to the corresponding threads for parallel calculation; compared with the prior art, the method and the device improve the processing rate of geological monitoring data.
assignees: GUANGDONG NONFERROUS MINE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION CENTER

title_en: Forestry disease and pest control integration machine of annotating medicine that punches
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated perforating and medicine injecting machine for forestry pest control, which structurally comprises a drill bit for perforating, a medicine injecting cavity integrally formed with the drill bit, a liquid conveying pipe for conveying liquid medicine and a detachable liquid conveying tank; the liquid injection hole of the medicine injection cavity is positioned on the side surface of the drill bit; the infusion tube with the conventional liquid medicine is connected to be used for injecting common forest trees, and corresponding infusion tanks can be optionally added for some forest trees with serious disaster or different types; therefore, the operation modes aiming at different forest multiple modes are realized, and the injection can be immediately carried out during drilling by utilizing the administration structure without separating the drilling and the injection, so that the time is saved, and the efficiency is improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU CITY FUYANG DISTRICT AGRICULTURAL AND FORESTRY RESOURCES PROT CENTER HANGZHOU CITY FUYANG D

title_en: Provision Method of Underground Tunnel Disaster Scenarios
title_ko: 공동구 재난 시나리오 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of providing a utility tunnel disaster scenario. The method includes: a facility information confirmation step; a facility classification and listing step; a disaster definition step; a facility semi-quantitative evaluation execution step; a single disaster scenario derivation step; a complex disaster scenario derivation step; a risk scenario providing step; and a simulation result providing step. According to the present invention, risk scenarios can be listed and provided.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for measuring and calculating influence of typhoons on electric power and electric quantity
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for measuring and calculating influence of typhoons on electric power and electricity, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an actual value of electric power and electric quantity data when a typhoon occurs in a target area; inputting actual air temperature data when the target typhoon occurs into a trained electric power and electric quantity prediction model as a characteristic variable to obtain a first electric power and electric quantity prediction value so as to simulate an electric power and electric quantity value when the air temperature is consistent with typhoon but no typhoon disaster damage influence occurs; simulating the air temperature condition of the corresponding region when the typhoon does not occur, and inputting the simulated air temperature data serving as a characteristic variable into a trained electric power and electric quantity prediction model to obtain a second electric power and electric quantity prediction value; measuring and calculating the climatic influence of typhoons on the electric power and the electric power of the target area according to the difference value between the second electric power and the first electric power; and measuring and calculating the disastrous influence of typhoons on the electric power and the electric quantity of the target area according to the difference value between the first electric power and electric quantity predicted value and the actual value of the electric power and electric quantity data.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster avoidance route determination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster avoidance route determining method, which is used for collecting related data such as river basin geographic information, landform type, water system distribution, population cultivated land distribution, water conservancy facility distribution, road network distribution and the like, and carrying out visual display on river basin geographic basic information and human information space distribution conditions according to the related data; determining the connection relation between key nodes of a risk network and nodes, and drawing a river basin flood risk network diagram; constructing a drainage basin flood map neural network model by applying a map neural network algorithm according to the flood risk network map; historical flood disaster observation and flood data in an input stream domain are used for training the model; setting a typical flood model, calculating flood risks of each node by using the model, and drawing an optimal flood disaster avoidance route; according to the invention, flood risk transfer and transfer processes of different areas in the flow area can be fully considered from the system angle, a scientific flood disaster avoidance route is formulated, and the method has very important significance for flood disaster treatment.

title_en: Forest fire monitoring method based on multi-element composite deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire monitoring method based on multi-element composite deep learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a historical fire picture to generate a historical fire data set; s2, training a YOLO-V8 convolutional neural network model by using a historical fire data set to obtain a forest fire detection model; s3, acquiring a real-time fire disaster picture, and inputting the real-time fire disaster picture into a forest fire disaster detection model; s4, extracting the space-time characteristics of the detected forest fire picture through a space-time convolution network; s5, outputting the type and the fire development stage of the forest fire corresponding to the real-time fire picture. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the development stage of the forest fire is predicted by inputting the real-time fire picture into the forest fire detection model, so that corresponding fire extinguishing measures can be conveniently taken subsequently, and the fire extinguishing efficiency is improved.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Earthquake fault simulation system based on geotechnical centrifuge platform
abstract_en: The invention provides an earthquake fault simulation system based on a geotechnical centrifuge platform, and relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster simulation. The bottom support system of the system is used for supporting a horizontal actuating system, a simulated seismic fault and a field covering layer, the horizontal actuating system is used for applying horizontal thrust to the simulated seismic fault and the field covering layer, the simulated seismic fault is used for filling fault test blocks to simulate base strata of the seismic fault, and the field covering layer is used for filling sand layer materials on the simulated seismic fault to simulate soil layers of the seismic fault. According to the invention, the earthwork centrifugal platform is used for simulating a supergravity environment, truly reducing the true stress state of rock and soil, and simultaneously, the simulated earthquake fault and the site covering layer are arranged, and thrust is applied to the simulated earthquake fault and the site covering layer through the horizontal actuating system, so that the whole earthquake generating process caused by the rupture of the movable fault and the propagation effect of the earthquake in the site are simulated, and the dynamic response characteristic simulation of the engineering structure under the situation of crossing the fault is realized.

title_en: Method for judging critical layer of rock burst disaster caused under complex overlying strata structure condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock burst disaster causing key layer identification method under the condition of a complex overlying strata structure, which is implemented according to the following steps: firstly, data are collected, a numerical simulation model is established according to the collected data, simulated working face stoping is excavated step by step, and simulation results after excavation of each step are calculated; acquiring the development height of a working surface roof strata plastic region and working surface advance bearing pressure peaks of corresponding heights in each simulation result according to the simulation result, obtaining working surface advance bearing pressure increment before and after each step of excavation through calculation, and obtaining an impact earth pressure overburden disaster causing influence coefficient W of strata through calculation by combining the set working surface mining process advance bearing pressure extreme value  rb  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Finally according to the W of each stratum  rb  The disaster-causing layers are screened out according to the values, evaluation indexes are established, and a plurality of disaster-causing layers are sequentially combined with the evaluation indexesBy comparing, the key rock stratum caused by impact disaster is accurately determined under the condition of complex overlying strata structure, and data guidance is provided for realizing accurate and efficient management of rock burst in the follow-up actual exploitation process.
assignees: SHAANXI BINCHANG MENGCUN MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Landslide identification and model construction method and device considering multi-source feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide identification and model construction method and device taking into account multi-source feature fusion, wherein the construction method comprises the following steps: acquiring unmanned aerial vehicle image sample data in a landslide area range; constructing a landslide hazard identification model by using two feature extraction branches, an attention fusion module and a pyramid pooling structure; and training the landslide disaster identification model by utilizing unmanned aerial vehicle image sample data in the landslide area range to obtain the landslide disaster identification model taking the multi-source characteristic information fusion into consideration. According to the landslide disaster identification method, landslide disaster identification considering multi-source feature fusion can be realized, and the accuracy of landslide disaster identification is improved.

title_en: Special front-side large hammer knocker for fire protection and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special forward-side large hammer knocker for fire control and a using method thereof, and relates to the field of physical training of firefighters. The invention comprises a main frame body, wherein an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the main frame body, when the training is carried out by arranging the adjusting mechanism and the extending mechanism, if the training is carried out by laterally hammering different angles, the handles on the hand-shaking seat can be held by two hands firstly, then the hand-shaking seat is shaking, the screw rod can be rotated by the hand-shaking seat, the pushing block can move back and forth on the screw rod in the rotating process of the screw rod, the lower sliding block can be driven by the supporting rod to move in the moving process of the pushing block, the supporting frame can be supported and fixed by the bolts firstly, then the extending plate is supported, then a training person can stand on the extending plate to carry out the vertical hammering training on the hammering block, and through the arrangement, the special front side direction large hammer for the fire fighting and the using method thereof can be adjusted quickly, so that the purpose of a device can carry out multiple training is achieved.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;NANJING KUNBAO SAFETY PROT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Geographic hotspot center identification method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a geographic hotspot center identification method, a geographic hotspot center identification device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring network hotspot text data, wherein the network hotspot text data comprises unlabeled samples, inputting the unlabeled samples into an initial labeling model to obtain training samples labeled with geographic name labels, inputting the training samples labeled with geographic name labels into an initial focus recognition model, giving focus attribute to position information meeting rule requirements in the training samples by setting focus judgment rules to obtain an initial geographic hotspot center, training the initial labeling model and the initial focus recognition model based on the initial geographic hotspot center and a standard sample set to obtain a target geographic hotspot center recognition model, inputting network hotspot text to be recognized into the target geographic hotspot center recognition model to obtain a target geographic hotspot center, and improving accuracy of natural disaster geographic hotspot center recognition.

title_en: Fire early warning method based on YOLOv7 network and linear Support Vector Machine (SVM)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster early warning method based on a YOLOv7 network and a linear Support Vector Machine (SVM), which comprises the steps of collecting video images about a fire disaster; performing target detection on the image by utilizing a YOLOv7 network, and outputting the position of a target boundary box; screening the target bounding box to construct a multidimensional feature vector; setting up a label for the image; the labels of all the images and the constructed multidimensional feature vectors are arranged into a data set, and training and verification are carried out on a linear Support Vector Machine (SVM) to obtain an anomaly detection model; and carrying out fire detection and early warning on the video or the image acquired in real time by using the anomaly detection model. The invention solves the problems of large calculation amount, difficult acquisition of samples, false alarm or missing report of the fire detection method in the prior art.

title_en: Full-automatic landslide susceptibility evaluation method and system considering neighborhood characteristics and information fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a fully automatic landslide susceptibility evaluation method and system considering spatial neighborhood characteristics and information fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly calculating variance expansion factors and base non-purity values of input disaster causing factors, and automatically eliminating factors which do not meet requirements according to a threshold value; respectively taking a random forest model and a convolutional neural network model as frames, and taking landslide data represented by one-dimensional and three-dimensional structures as training samples of the models; calculating performance of the two models according to the selected evaluation indexes; and finishing the full-area landslide susceptibility evaluation based on the trained evaluation model, and combining the results of the two models and the set threshold weighting fusion evaluation result to output as a final model. According to the invention, the landslide vulnerability evaluation results based on the random forest model and the convolutional neural network model are combined in a weighted manner, so that the advantages of the two models in processing different data structure samples can be effectively combined, and the phenomenon that the convolutional neural network commonly predicts grid units as high vulnerability is relieved.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Hot-melt disaster prediction method and device based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data-based hot-melt disaster prediction method and device, which comprises the following steps of collecting meteorological data, geological data and frozen soil monitoring data, preprocessing the collected data, constructing a characteristic for prediction, namely calculating the temperature change trend of a frozen soil area by using the meteorological data, analyzing the change of the frozen soil layer by using the geological and frozen soil monitoring data, constructing a model by using a geothermal equation to simulate the hot response of the frozen soil, wherein the thermal response comprises a heat conduction equation, a hot melting equation and a soil moisture equation, integrating information of different data sources into the model to comprehensively evaluate the hot-melt disaster risk of the frozen soil area, and the step 5 is used for carrying out real-time or future hot-melt disaster prediction based on the established model. The method has higher reliability and practicability, and is beneficial to improving the prediction and management capacity of the hot-melt disaster in the frozen soil area.

title_en: Virus searching and killing exercise method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virus searching and killing exercise method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of acquiring backup data from a disaster recovery system after receiving a workflow starting instruction; and performing virus searching and killing exercise on the target recovery data in a pre-constructed data sandbox with a unidirectional isolation function. According to the technical scheme, the problem that the virus killing environment is not isolated from the production environment is solved, the influence of the virus checking and killing process on the production environment is avoided, the safety of production data in the production environment is guaranteed while the virus checking and killing is realized, and the economic loss of production is reduced.

title_en: Workbench for fire control leakage stoppage and fire control demolition training
abstract_en: The invention provides a workbench for fire control leakage stoppage and fire control breaking and dismantling training, which comprises a workbench, an adapter, a control box and a water delivery device, wherein the center of the workbench is hollowed out; a stopwatch and a flow sensor are arranged above the front surface of the workbench; the center of the adapter is provided with a custom break; the control box comprises a host and a wireless transceiver module connected with the host, and the host is connected with a stopwatch and a flowmeter; the water delivery device comprises a water delivery pipe and a water pump connected with the water delivery pipe, the water pump is controlled by a host to start and stop, the water delivery pipe is communicated with the custom break and is used for providing water flow for the custom break, and the flow sensor is used for monitoring the flow passing through the custom break; the host computer is used for transmitting the collected training data to the system through the wireless transceiver module and acquiring numerical data of the stopwatch. The invention automatically identifies the shape of the break and the plugging completion degree, and movably identifies the size of the break during the training of firefighters, and counts the time required by the fire-fighting breaking and dismantling training.

title_en: Simulation analysis method for tunnel traffic state under tunnel disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation analysis method for tunnel traffic state under tunnel disaster scene, comprising the following steps: s1, determining a target tunnel, establishing a cellular automaton model of the target tunnel, dividing the length of the target tunnel into a plurality of equidistant sections, wherein each section is a cell, and the cells are empty when not occupied by a vehicle; s2, setting a vehicle following behavior rule and a vehicle position updating rule in the cellular automaton model; s3, constructing a support vector machine model, acquiring parameters in a sample tunnel of the disaster tunnel through a driving simulation test, and inputting the parameters in the sample tunnel into the support vector machine model for training; s4, simulating the disaster damage of the tunnel in a cellular automaton model of the target tunnel, acquiring parameters in the tunnel in real time, and inputting the parameters in the tunnel into a trained support vector machine model to obtain a vehicle lane change strategy in the tunnel; s5, the cellular automaton model carries out simulation processing according to the vehicle following behavior rule, the vehicle lane changing strategy and the vehicle position updating rule, and simulation result parameters of the target tunnel when disaster damage occurs are obtained.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS RES & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Firewall parameter inspection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a firewall parameter inspection method, a firewall parameter inspection device, firewall parameter inspection equipment and a firewall parameter storage medium, which are applied to the field of engineering safety, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining firewall parameters to be checked; constructing fire disaster simulation accident parameters of the hydrogen adding station; performing simulation experiments based on fire simulation accident parameters of the hydro-station injection and firewall parameters to be checked to obtain simulation accident data; and checking the firewall parameters to be checked based on the simulated accident data. According to the method, simulation experiments are carried out based on fire simulation accident parameters and firewall parameters to be checked of the hydrogen station injection, accident data in a simulation experiment scene are obtained, the firewall parameters to be checked are checked according to the simulation accident data, and the optimal firewall parameters under each simulation accident can be determined by the method, so that the problems that in the prior art, the firewall is set by using a scheme of a gas station, and the firewall cannot play a protection role and safety accidents are caused when accidents occur are avoided.
assignees: Shandong energy group co ltd;UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA;YANKUANG NATIONAL ENGINEERING RES CENTER OF COAL SLURRY GASIFICATION AND COAL CHEMICAL INDUSTRY CO L

title_en: System and method for assessing disaster safety using MEMS accelerometer, and a recording medium recording a computer readable program for executing the method
title_ko: Mems 가속도 계측기를 활용한 재난 안전 평가 시스템, 방법, 및 상기 방법을 실행시키기 위한 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 프로그램을 기록한 기록 매체
abstract_en: A system and a method for assessing disaster safety, and a recording medium recording a computer-readable program for executing the method are disclosed. The system for assessing disaster safety comprises a dynamic characteristic analysis unit, a behavior model construction unit, an evaluation criterion setting unit, a simulation DB construction unit, an acceleration measurement unit, a utilization information calculation unit, and a stability evaluation unit. The dynamic characteristic analysis unit analyzes dynamic characteristics of a building based on measurement information of the building, the behavior model construction unit builds a behavior model by modifying a design analysis model of the building using the analysis results, the evaluation criterion setting unit sets pre-established disaster stability evaluation criteria, the simulation DB construction unit constructs a pre-damage simulation DB by applying pre-set disaster data to the behavior model, the acceleration measurement unit measures the acceleration of the building, the utilization information calculation unit calculates pre-set utilization information through numerical integration of the measured acceleration, the stability evaluation unit evaluates the disaster stability of the building using the acceleration information, the utilization information, and the stability evaluation criteria. Therefore, the system can save costs and time spent on damage analysis.
abstract_ko: 재난 안전 평가 시스템, 방법, 및 상기 방법을 실행시키기 위한 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 프로그램을 기록한 기록 매체가 개시된다. 재난 안전 평가 시스템은, 동특성 분석부, 거동모델 구축부, 평가기준 설정부, 시뮬레이션 DB 구축부, 가속도 계측부, 활용 정보 산출부, 및 안정성 평가부를 포함한다. 동특성 분석부는 건축물에 대한 계측정보로부터 건축물의 동특성을 분석하고, 거동 모델 구축부는 분석 결과를 이용하여 건축물의 설계 해석 모델을 수정한 거동 모델을 구축하고, 평가기준 설정부는 미리 설정된 재난 안정성 평가기준을 설정하고, 시뮬레이션 DB 구축부는 거동 모델에 대해 미리 설정된 재난 데이터를 적용한 사전 피해 시뮬레이션 DB를 구축하고, 가속도 계측부는 건축물에 대한 가속도를 계측하고, 활용 정보 산출부는 계측된 가속도의 수치 적분을 통해 미리 설정된 활용 정보를 산출하며, 안정성 평가부는 가속도의 정보, 활용 정보, 및 안정성 평가기준을 이용하여 건축물의 재난 안정성을 평가한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Smart Broabcasting System
title_ko: 스마트 방송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart broadcasting system. Specifically, the smart broadcasting system quickly checks whether a speaker in various fields is out of order and efficiently diagnoses a failure type through a broadcasting information processing device in a broadcasting room. In addition, when the speaker of the broadcasting device is out of order in a disaster and disaster situation, the smart broadcasting system interacts with a surrounding field manager in a specific emergency manual to quickly and stably deal with the failure situation. The manual has a countermeasure scenario corresponding to various speaker failure types, and interacts with a surrounding manager according to the scenario to dynamically deal with the failure situation. In addition, it interacts with the surrounding environment information of the speaker and the components used, changes the scenario in advance according to the corresponding situation, and dynamically provides emergency measures according to the field situation. The interaction means that the emergency processing of the speaker is guided to the TTS for each procedure based on the scenario, and the operation of recognizing the emergency processing of the user as the STT is repeatedly performed and processed.
abstract_ko:
실시예는 스마트 방송 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로는, 이러한 스마트 방송 시스템은 각종 현장에 있는 스피커의 고장 여부를 신속하게 확인하여 방송실의 방송 정보처리장치를 통해 고장 유형을 효율적으로 진단한다. 
그리고, 재난과 재해가 발생한 상황에서 방송 장치의 스피커가 고장날 경우, 내부의 특정 응급처리 매뉴얼에서 주변의 현장 관리자와 인터랙션하여 고장 상황을 신속하고 안정적으로 조치한다. 
이러한 매뉴얼은 다양한 스피커 고장 유형별로 대응하는 조치 시나리오를 가지며, 이 시나리오에 따라 주변에 있는 관리자와 인터랙션하여 동적으로 조치하는 것이다. 또한, 스피커의 주변 환경 정보와 사용 부품과도 인터랙션하여 해당 상황에 맞게 시나리오를 사전에 가변해 두어 현장 상황에 맞게 응급조치 내용을 동적으로 제공한다. 
상기 인터랙션은 스피커의 응급 처리를 시나리오 기반으로 각 절차마다 TTS로 안내하고, 사용자의 응급 처리 사항을 STT로 인식하는 동작을 반복적으로 수행하여 처리하는 것을 의미한다.

title_en: Virtual Reality Control System
title_ko: 가상 현실 제어 시스템
abstract_en: According to various embodiments, an electronic device may be configured to: obtain first location information about a first user within a specific real space identified based on an optical signal for a head mounted display (HMD) device detected through at least some of a plurality of detecting devices disposed in the specific real space associated with the electronic device, wherein the HMD device is worn on at least a part of the body of the first user; obtain second location information about the part of the body of the first user identified based on an optical signal for at least one active marker provided on at least the part of the body of the first user detected through at least some of the plurality of detecting devices; obtain first virtual location information indicating the virtual location of a first character corresponding to the first user based on the first location information; determine whether the first location information and the second location information are included within a first designated range and a second designated range, respectively; and control, according to the determination result, a display included in the HMD device to display the first character based on the first virtual location information. According to various embodiments disclosed in this document, users can increase their awareness of disasters and conduct disaster training by directly and indirectly experiencing disasters through disaster training content.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시 예들에 따른, 전자 장치는, 전자 장치와 연관된 특정 실제 공간에 배치되는 복수의 디텍팅 장치들 중 적어도 일부를 통해 검출되는 HMD(head mounted display) 장치에 대한 광 신호에 기초하여 식별되는 특정 실제 공간 내의 제1 사용자에 대한 제1 위치 정보를 획득하고, HMD 장치는 제1 사용자의 신체의 적어도 일부에 착용되며, 복수의 디텍팅 장치들 중 적어도 일부를 통해 검출되는 제1 사용자의 신체의 적어도 일부에 제공되는 적어도 하나의 액티브 마커에 대한 광 신호에 기초하여 식별되는 제1 사용자의 신체 일부에 대한 제2 위치 정보를 획득하고, 제1 위치 정보에 기반하여 제1 사용자에 대응하는 제1 캐릭터의 가상 위치를 지시하는 제1 가상 위치 정보를 획득하고, 제1 위치 정보 및 제2 위치 정보가 각각 제1 지정 범위 및 제2 지정 범위 내에 포함되는지 판단하고, 판단 결과에 따라 HMD 장치에 포함된 디스플레이가 제1 가상 위치 정보에 기초하여 제1 캐릭터를 표시하도록 제어하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for providing customized safety education and experience service for disasters based on virtual reality
abstract_en: Provided are a system and method for providing a customized safety education and experience service for disasters on the basis of virtual reality. The method performed by a server includes receiving experience request information from an experiencer who enters a virtual experience space, generating a customized experience scenario using the experience request information, and executing an experience service using the customized experience scenario.

title_en: Flood control disaster test simulation box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flood control disaster test simulation box, and belongs to the technical field of flood disaster tests. The utility model provides a flood fighting waterlogging disaster test simulation case, includes the flood fighting test case, still includes to simulate the slope and allies oneself with the section board, and it sets up in the inside of flood fighting test case, the flood fighting test case includes upstream section and downstream section, and the both sides of upstream section and downstream section all are provided with the breast board, the top of upstream section is provided with the water storage hanging box, and the water storage hanging box passes through leg joint with the flood fighting test case, the inside of downstream section is provided with pressure push pedal. In order to solve the problem that the existing simulation box cannot acquire the service condition of the flood fighting facility structure under the flood disaster, which results in incapability of timely and effectively taking countermeasures to the flood disaster, the slope plate structures with different heights and slopes can be formed through adjustment of the main section slope plate and the auxiliary section slope plate, so that the impact force of simulated flood can be changed, and facility flood fighting data under the condition of no flood can be conveniently acquired.
assignees: ANHUI XINFU XIANGTIAN ECOLOGICAL AGRICULTURE CO LTD

title_en: Test simulation device for monitoring high-level avalanche disaster damage image
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of high-level avalanche test simulation, and discloses a test simulation device for monitoring a high-level avalanche disaster damage image. The multistage hierarchical gradient adjusting structure is adopted, so that the conditions of different heights and gradients of the hillside can be simulated more accurately.

title_en: Disaster prevention simulation sheet and disaster prevention simulation system
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention simulation sheet and a disaster prevention simulation system which contribute to disaster prevention countermeasures by simulating phenomena before and after an assumed disaster including phenomena relating to a user.SOLUTION: The disaster prevention simulation system comprises: a disaster setting unit 11 which sets a type and an occurrence date of a disaster; a vertical time axis setting unit 12 which sets a vertical time axis defining a time axis before and after the occurrence date of the disaster set by the disaster setting unit 11; a horizontal relation axis setting unit 13 which sets a horizontal relation axis on which phenomenon having relations to the user on the vertical time axis can be inputted; an input accepting unit 14 which accepts input of a phenomenon having relation to the user onto the horizontal relation axis; a verification unit 15 which verifies the phenomenon inputted onto the horizontal relation axis; and a recommendation unit 16 which makes a recommendation according to a verification result of the verification unit 15.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Method and device for simulating and resolving wind flow reversal of ventilation network under condition of external fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for simulating and resolving wind flow reversal of a ventilation network under an external fire condition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a first equation set with the wind flow temperature as a variable to be solved by adopting a finite difference method; obtaining a second equation set taking air quantity as a variable to be solved by adopting a loop air quantity method; carrying out coupling solution on the first equation set and the second equation set to construct a ventilation network wind flow reversal simulation solution model in a fire period; the wind flow reversal simulation model is used for realizing calculation simulation of the wind flow reversal process in the ventilation network in the fire period. The method can rapidly predict the wind flow reversing process of the ventilation system after the mine fire disaster occurs, improves the disaster resistance and the transformation capacity of the mine ventilation system, greatly promotes the intelligent construction of the mine ventilation system, reduces the occurrence probability of major accidents caused by the mine fire disaster, and maintains the stable development of society.
assignees: MEIKE TONGAN BEIJING INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting community fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire detection method for communities, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, acquiring community fire image data and normal community image data, wherein the suffix of the image data format is specified as jpg or png; secondly, the ratio of training data to test data is 8:2, training data are all composed of community fire image data; the invention firstly carries out contrast enhancement and data enhancement on an input image by a contrast enhancement module, enhances the image into two groups of data forming a queue while highlighting flame characteristics, then carries out characteristic extraction by a paired two-dimensional CNN encoder in an MCOD model in a contrast learning mode, stores characteristic vectors by a queue, and finally carries out fire judgment by a memory module based on clustering; in addition, the encoder optimization method of the method adopts a momentum update mechanism, so that the feature vectors in the queue have high consistency, and the accuracy of fire disaster discrimination is improved.
assignees: FUZHOU SOFTWARE PARK TECH INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Flood prediction-based three-dimensional presentation method and system for water depth evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood prediction-based three-dimensional presentation method and system for water depth evolution, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: extracting historical flood data corresponding to each point location from the target data; extracting simulated flood data corresponding to each point position from the simulated flood data; sequentially recording simulation data corresponding to each flood depth; generating associated data; generating data of flood depth and flood color of each point, and matching rules of the data of flood depth and flood submerged boundary/range of each point; and the flood depth of any one point or other points is presented in the three-dimensional scene model. According to the method and the system, modeling can be performed according to historical flood data, the evolution result of the flood when the disaster occurs can be predicted by using the model, and the flood depth and the like which can be achieved after the disaster occurs can be rapidly predicted.

title_en: Multi-disaster intelligent monitoring system for coal exploitation
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring system for multiple disasters in coal exploitation, and relates to the technical field of mine safety. The intelligent monitoring system for the coal exploitation multiple disasters comprises a water pressure monitoring module, a gas content detection module, a video monitoring module, an underground configuration end, an uphole configuration end and a server terminal, wherein the water pressure monitoring module is connected with the underground configuration end through an Ethernet, and the underground configuration end is connected with the gas content detection module through the Ethernet. When the water level of the mine aquifer rises, the water pressure at the water drain hole can be increased, data can be transmitted to the data detection and transmission assembly through the Ethernet signal by utilizing the water level sensor assembly and the water pressure sensor assembly, then the data is transmitted to the server terminal through the Ethernet signal by utilizing the data detection and transmission assembly, an alarm device can be made to give an alarm, a worker is promoted to move to the site, and then the worker drills the aquifer through the hole site drilling machine and the drill bit assembly.
assignees: SHAANXI YANCHANG PETROLEUM MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Simulation analysis device and process method for underground engineering water burst and mud burst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation analysis device and a process method for water inrush and mud inrush of underground engineering, and belongs to the technical field of design and manufacture of process equipment for early preparation work of construction of underground construction engineering. Provides a simulation analysis device and a process method capable of truly reproducing the occurrence form and the disaster influence range of the gushing water and revealing the occurrence mechanism of the gushing water. The simulation analysis device comprises a geologic body simulation system, a cavity excavation system and a geologic parameter change monitoring system, wherein a preset cavity needing to be excavated in the geologic body simulation system is excavated through the cavity excavation system, and basic parameters and parameter change conditions of the geologic body simulation system are monitored and recorded through the geologic parameter change monitoring system before and after the preset cavity is excavated and in the excavation process. The process method comprises the steps of excavating a preset cavity in a geologic body simulation system through a cavity excavation system, and monitoring basic parameters and parameter change conditions of a geologic body model in the excavation process through a geologic parameter change monitoring system.

title_en: Intelligent early warning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an intelligent early warning method, an intelligent early warning device and electronic equipment, which can select early warning parameters from monitoring parameters, pre-locate and cluster the early warning parameters, then combine the early warning parameters into different parameter sets to serve as training sample data, and finally train to obtain an early warning model based on the training sample data. In this embodiment, a plurality of early warning parameters are selected, the early warning parameters are clustered, so that the early warning parameters can be divided into different early warning grades, and finally, different early warning parameters are combined into different training samples to train and obtain an early warning model, so that the obtained early warning model can combine a plurality of different early warning parameters to early warn landslide disasters based on the same standard, multi-parameter simultaneous early warning is realized, early warning efficiency is improved, the situation of different early warning thresholds does not exist, and further, early warning accuracy can be improved.

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery drilling method, storage medium and equipment for simulating real scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed disaster recovery drilling method, a storage medium and equipment for simulating a real scene, which comprise the following steps: collecting monitoring indexes of operation of each edge node server and a central server under networking in each step of history disaster recovery drilling, and constructing a central early warning model; collecting service requirements of each step of history disaster recovery exercise under networking, and establishing a central computing model; disaster recovery exercise is conducted under networking, and after a central server receives instructions of disaster recovery exercise, a central early warning model and a central computing power model are issued to corresponding edge node servers; and predicting an abnormal step of the edge node server in the disaster recovery practice process through the central early warning model, removing the abnormal step influenced by network factors through the central calculation model, and simulating the disaster recovery practice in a real scene. The distributed disaster recovery drilling method is closer to a real scene.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Combined experimental platform for mine mining space fracture field-flow field-gas concentration field
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of ventilation and disaster prevention of mining space of a mine, and particularly relates to a mining space fracture field-flow field-gas concentration field combined experimental platform of the mine. Comprising the following steps: mining space simulation experiment box; the goaf fracture field loading system is arranged in the mining space simulation experiment box; mining space simulation experiment boxOne side is provided with a working surface, two ends of the working surface are respectively connected with an air inlet channel and an air return channel, the air inlet channel is provided with a vacuum extractor, and the air return channel is provided with a fan; gas release ports are arranged on the side wall of the mining space simulation experiment box and are respectively connected with CH  4  Gas cylinder, N  2  And the gas storage bottle supplies gas to the goaf. The invention can directly establish the direct connection among the mine mining space fracture field, the flow field and the gas concentration field, and research on the wind speed, the pressure distribution rule and the gas migration rule under different ventilation, plugging, gas emission and nitrogen injection conditions can be carried out on the basis.

title_en: Power network fault recovery dynamic decision method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power network fault recovery dynamic decision method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting the structure and disaster damage information of a power network, evaluating the damage probability of a line, establishing a part of observable Markov decision process model for power network fault recovery under the uncertainty of damage evaluation, then constructing an actor-commentator framework for solving the power network fault dynamic recovery strategy, then training an intelligent body by using a near-end strategy optimization method in an offline training stage, and finally outputting an optimal power network fault inspection and recovery strategy based on the power network damage condition in an online decision stage. The method can effectively solve the dynamic decision of the power network recovery under the uncertainty of disaster damage evaluation, furthest improve the power network fault recovery efficiency and reduce the influence of disaster events.
assignees: STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UESTC

title_en: Personnel evacuation action simulation method, system, intelligent terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a personnel evacuation action simulation method, a system, an intelligent terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the boundary of a simulated evacuation area; acquiring evacuation outlet information at the boundary of the area, wherein the evacuation outlet information comprises outlet position information, outlet width information and actual traffic information; acquiring building and personnel distribution information in the area; acquiring a personnel no-pass area; and determining a personnel evacuation route according to the evacuation outlet information, the personnel no-pass area, the building and personnel distribution information. The method comprises the steps of determining a simulated area of personnel evacuation actions, planning personnel conveying routes according to the building and personnel distribution and exit information in the area and the in-situ principle, defining a no-pass area for the position of the building, which is unable to pass or possibly generates danger, so as to simulate the actual fire scene as far as possible, simulating the personnel evacuation actions under the condition of fire spread, and improving the simulation authenticity.
assignees: YANTAI SURVEY DESIGN REVIEW SERVICE CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster monitoring and early warning system and mountain torrent disaster monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster monitoring and early warning system and a mountain torrent disaster monitoring and early warning method, and belongs to the field of flood disaster monitoring and early warning. The early warning system comprises a flood risk model generation module, a flood risk model generation module and a flood risk model generation module, wherein the flood risk model generation module is used for acquiring basic parameters of a target river basin and generating a flood risk model according to the parameters; the flood simulation module is used for generating a simulation result according to the water level data by utilizing the flood risk model; the early warning information determining module is used for determining an early warning object, an early warning grade and a water level early warning threshold according to the simulation result; the target river basin water level monitoring module is used for monitoring water level information of the upstream of the target river basin in real time; and the early warning module is used for carrying out early warning on the early warning object according to the early warning grade according to the water level information and the water level early warning threshold value. The invention can prolong the forestation period of mountain torrents, improve the early warning precision and enlarge the early warning coverage.
assignees: QINGDAO ZHONGSHUI SHUYI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Expressway bad weather early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for early warning severe weather of a highway, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a hidden danger point data set according to historical meteorological data; determining a plurality of severe weather elements influencing the traffic of the target expressway according to the hidden danger point data set, and matching weather element values of hidden danger points of the plurality of severe weather elements according to a preset spatial interpolation algorithm; training a weather risk prediction model according to the hidden danger point data set, the hidden danger point weather element value and a preset deep learning network, and respectively carrying out disaster bearing body analysis and disaster resistance analysis on a target expressway; and inputting the first index data and the second index data into a weather risk prediction model based on an analytic hierarchy process to generate a risk level prediction model, and predicting the driving risk early warning level of the target expressway through the risk level prediction model. The risk level prediction method and the risk level prediction device can accurately predict the risk level, and correspondingly improve the driving experience of the user.

title_en: High-altitude base station system for emergency communication of tethered unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tethered unmanned aerial vehicle emergency communication high-altitude base station system, which consists of a tethered unmanned aerial vehicle system and communication base station equipment. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: by adopting the narrow-band communication equipment, the communication range of the narrow-band interphone of more than ten kilometers can be formed from the original ground of only a few kilometers, and the wide-band coverage range is enlarged to 5-10 kilometers. The 24-hour lift-off wide and narrow band integrated communication equipment provides practical significance for the signal guarantee of rescue workers, avoids the difficulty and danger of erecting base stations in the wild, and simultaneously greatly increases convenience for the signal to span mountain areas; the air base station equipment comprises base station equipment, communication relay and optical zoom equipment, and is provided with different load equipment to form industrial solutions of high-altitude base stations, fixed-point monitoring, communication relay and the like, and the air base station equipment is widely applied to users in telecom operators, fire fighting and the like, and practical combat application is completed in multiple large-scale emergency exercises, natural disasters and large-scale activities.
assignees: HENAN MAITE ELECTRIC POWER EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating functional toughness of urban multi-mode traffic network under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method for the functional toughness of an urban multi-mode traffic network under flood disasters. The method comprises the following steps: and acquiring and researching urban road network data, ground public transportation network data and rail public transportation network data, and constructing a multi-mode traffic network structure model. Acquiring POI data to estimate traffic occurrence and attraction of the city, and simulating individual daily trip chains; and fusing the multi-mode traffic network structure model and the individual daily travel chains to construct the multi-mode traffic network function model of the city. According to the space destruction characteristics of the flood disasters, constructing a failure model of the multi-mode traffic network function model based on the structural failure model of the multi-mode traffic network, and evaluating the function toughness of the multi-mode traffic network function model under the flood disasters from the two aspects of passable demands and travel delays. The method can be applied to aspects of disaster prevention and reduction strategy evaluation, post-disaster infrastructure restoration strategy evaluation and the like of pre-disaster engineering and management, and can enhance urban toughness, thereby realizing sustainable development.

title_en: Visual coal spontaneous combustion inhibitor inhibition performance measuring device and measuring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual coal spontaneous combustion inhibitor inhibition performance measuring device and a measuring method, and relates to the technical field of mine fire disaster prevention and control; the invention can realize the simulation of the spontaneous combustion environment of the coal by the temperature programming platform, and the coal sample tank is of a split structure, so that raw coal and coal treated by the inhibitor can be simultaneously loaded, and the signal acquisition and analysis system can be used for measuring the spontaneous combustion index gas content and oxygen consumption of the coal released by the two coal samples under the identical test conditions. Collecting CO and O  2  The content is processed by a digital terminal, and the inhibition rate of the inhibitor and the activation energy of the raw coal and the coal sample processed by the inhibitor can be calculated. Finally, the digital terminal uploads the data to the upper computer in real time, so that a visual function is realized. The defect of the traditional device is overcome, the method for measuring the stopping performance is combined with the traditional method, the stopping efficiency of the stopping agent can be determined more scientifically and reasonably, and a new method is provided for selecting the stopping agent in the work of the coal mine fire prevention technology.

title_en: Processing method and device of water and soil loss monitoring model and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing method and device of a water and soil loss monitoring model and electronic equipment.
