Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring sample data, and dividing the sample data into a training set and a verification set; inputting the training set into a pre-established deep learning network model, and determining model parameters of the deep learning network model; inputting the verification set into a deep learning network model with determined model parameters, and adjusting the model parameters; taking the deep learning model with the model parameters adjusted as a water and soil loss monitoring model; by pre-training the water and soil loss monitoring model and inputting the water and soil loss monitoring model with the water color image of the sediment reservoir acquired in real time, the sediment content of the drainage water during the construction of the production and construction project can be automatically judged, the water and soil loss early warning, forecasting and management can be realized, the possibility of disaster occurrence can be reduced to a certain extent, the manpower for water and soil conservation supervision and inspection can be further liberated, and the development trend of water and soil loss monitoring automation can be adapted.

title_en: Meteorological disaster-oriented train stopping prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a train stopping prediction method and device for weather disasters, comprising the following steps: collecting historical data of the train, wherein the historical data comprises historical driving data and historical meteorological data; performing dimension reduction processing on the historical data to obtain feature vectors; training a train stopping prediction model based on the feature vector; and acquiring weather forecast data and inputting the weather forecast data into the train stopping prediction model to carry out probability prediction on the train stopping reason.
assignees: SHANGHAI ENERGY TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;INNER MONGOLIA DABAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution system reliability assessment method considering meteorological factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution system reliability evaluation method considering meteorological factors, which comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring average temperature, maximum wind speed and precipitation of each hour in a local certain time, clustering the three groups of data by using a Density Peak Clustering (DPC) algorithm, and forming a class library corresponding to one fault rate in each class of scenes by acquiring the real fault rate of a local overhead line in each class of scenes; then, evaluating the average temperature, the maximum wind speed and the precipitation of each hour of the network location of the reliability according to the requirement, and judging the category of the network location, so that the fault rate of the corresponding category is selected as the fault rate of the network line; and finally, based on the line fault rate, evaluating the reliability of the network by adopting a method of combining sequential and non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation on the basis of distinguishing conventional faults and extreme disaster faults by meteorological data of the place where the network is located.

title_en: Hierarchical reinforcement learning method based on relay training and game
abstract_en: The invention provides a layered reinforcement learning method based on relay training and gaming, and belongs to the field of reinforcement learning in artificial intelligence. The game idea is integrated into reinforcement learning, and a high-level strategy capable of proposing the target task and a low-level strategy responsible for executing the target task are trained by means of a layered structure, so that the problems that reinforcement learning dimension disaster is difficult and sampling efficiency is low are solved. In particular, during the low-level strategic training process, the agent learns in the game and introduces auxiliary penalties and relay mechanisms: the difficulty of the training task is controlled by auxiliary punishment, and the relay mechanism enlarges the range of the exploration environment of the intelligent body, so that the intelligent body can know the environment more, and the training effect is greatly improved.

title_en: Disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model, which comprises the following steps: and designing a disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model to obtain an information propagation equilibrium state in the model, and proving the influence of parameters such as node density, node communication range and the like on the information propagation equilibrium state. The interference optimization problem based on the disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model is solved, the network deployment cost is minimized by using a convex optimization technology, the optimal node density and node communication range are obtained, and network interference is effectively avoided. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified through experiments under different environments, and simulation results show that the disaster area communication network multi-layer information propagation model provided by the invention can describe the information propagation process between disaster area communication network nodes, and meanwhile, parameter optimization is provided for the disaster area communication network by considering the interference of the environments to the network and the cost of deployment and communication of rescue nodes.

title_en: Subway station internal biochemical gas diffusion numerical simulation method and emergency plan generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating the diffusion value of biochemical gas in a subway station and an emergency plan generation system, wherein the method for simulating the diffusion value of the biochemical gas in the subway station comprises the following steps: establishing a three-dimensional simulation model of the subway station, setting a constant flux boundary and carrying out finite element numerical value differential processing so as to generate grids; establishing a primary value condition for solving a fluid dynamics value, and solving a dynamic equation of the corresponding three-dimensional refined air flow to obtain an air flow field in the subway station; based on the generated grids and an air flow field in the subway station, the diffusion state parameters after the biochemical gas leakage are solved, the simulation of the whole diffusion process after the biochemical gas release of the subway station is completed, and a simulation result is obtained. The invention can carry out high-precision numerical simulation on the air flow field in the subway station, and produce a corresponding emergency plan, thereby providing scientific basis and quantitative decision capability for disaster evaluation and emergency treatment in special emergency, and having the characteristics of high simulation degree, high resolution and the like.

title_en: Channel mountain torrent mud-rock flow particle grading accumulation characteristic analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a channel mountain torrent mud-rock flow particle grading accumulation characteristic analysis method, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining a target channel; s2, establishing a target channel generalization model according to the topographic information of the target channel and the grading information of loosely-piled sediment particles; s3, simulating and calculating the transfer process of the sediment particles in the generalized model under the action of the debris flow slurry by adopting a CFD-DEM coupling model to obtain the time-dependent change relation of the positions of the sediment particles in the debris flow accumulation area of the generalized model; and S4, obtaining the time-dependent change characteristics of the outer boundary of a pile body formed by sediment particles with any particle size in the sediment particle grading of the target channel in the debris flow pile area according to the fitting relation of the IQR corresponding to the sediment particles with the characteristic particle sizes along with the simulation time and the fitting relation of the fitting parameters and the simulation calculation conditions. The invention can provide scientific and reliable guidance for disaster reduction and prevention of mountain torrent mud-rock flow in hilly area.

title_en: Building earthquake damage intelligent assessment method based on multi-mode large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent assessment method for building earthquake damage based on a multi-mode large model, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake engineering; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a damage picture to construct a multi-mode earthquake damage assessment data set; constructing a multi-mode earthquake damage evaluation large model, optimizing by using an image-text contrast loss function, and outputting a new multi-mode vector representation through a multi-mode encoder; training the multi-mode earthquake damage assessment large model by adopting a data set, and integrating the trained multi-mode earthquake damage assessment large model algorithm into an unmanned plane or a patrol vehicle; and carrying out real-time earthquake damage evaluation on each building on the earthquake disaster site to generate regional building disaster damage evaluation reports. The evaluation method provided by the invention realizes the function of evaluating the damage degree judgment of the building more professionally and accurately by comprehensively utilizing the multi-mode damage pictures and the multiple information sources described by the damage language and combining the deep learning technology, and can provide important technical support for the earthquake disaster emergency rescue work.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;CHENGDU XUNHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Substrate stress measuring device suitable for use in submarine landslide flow process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of marine geological disaster simulation, and provides a substrate stress measuring device suitable for a submarine landslide flow process, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a frame support system, a positive stress measurement system, a shear stress measurement system and a pore water pressure measurement system. The invention not only can cooperatively measure the substrate normal stress and pore water pressure in the process of the instability-flow-disaster of the submarine landslide, but also can measure the substrate shear stress closely related to the whole process of the instability-flow-accumulation of the submarine landslide; the shear stress measuring plate can select different terrain roughness simulation cloths according to the real terrain roughness conditions, so that the substrate stress state in the whole process of the ocean floor landslide instability-flow-disaster-causing is measured; according to the invention, measuring plates with different geometric areas can be replaced according to different submarine landslide scales, and the accuracy of force measurement can be ensured.

title_en: Disaster accident virtual-actual fusion simulation exercise system and method based on evolution dynamics
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster accident virtual-actual fusion simulation exercise system and method based on evolution dynamics, comprising an urban disaster accident scene deduction module, a typical urban disaster accident evolution dynamics simulation analysis and calculation database module, an accident scene simulation rendering module, a simulation exercise guiding and adjustment scene setting module, a command deduction and planning exercise module, an individual soldier and team collaborative virtual-actual simulation exercise module, a simulation exercise virtual-actual fusion real fire control device, an urban building and facility scene model and an information interaction visual display device. According to the invention, the dynamic calculation result of disaster accident evolution is combined with disaster accident simulation, so that a scientific, real and immersive urban disaster accident fire rescue exercise environment is provided for fire fighters at different levels.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Intelligent test system for hydraulic engineering safety and disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of engineering prevention and control experiments, and provides a hydraulic engineering safety and disaster prevention and control intelligent test system, which comprises a construction hydraulic engineering intelligent physical model test system, a flood disaster formation mechanism and prediction and safety evaluation numerical simulation system and a drainage basin digital twin service support platform; according to the invention, by constructing an engineering entity prototype, a laboratory physical model and a digital twin model into a three-in-one intelligent test system for water engineering safety and disaster prevention, in the intelligent test system, powerful system software and a mathematical model are used for simulating, analyzing and researching the safety operation and disaster prevention of the water engineering, and decision support is provided under the visual condition, so that the scientificity and predictability of decision making are enhanced, the accuracy of experiments is further enhanced, and the intelligent test system for water engineering safety and disaster prevention is more comprehensive in operation mode, can be well adapted to various places and improves the adaptability of the water engineering test.
assignees: CHANGCHUN INST TECH;UNIV HOHAI;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Reconstruction method and system of earth surface continuous deformation map
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and particularly discloses a reconstruction method and a system of a ground surface continuous deformation map, wherein the reconstruction method comprises the following steps: determining a region to be rebuilt according to the earth surface deformation map of the research region; training a ground surface subsidence prediction model based on historical ground surface deformation data and historical clustering multi-source heterogeneous data of a research area; inputting the current clustered multi-source heterogeneous data of the area to be rebuilt into the trained sedimentation prediction model to obtain a prediction deformation map of the area to be rebuilt; and fusing the surface deformation map and the predicted deformation map to obtain a surface continuous deformation map of the research area. The invention can fully utilize heterogeneous environmental factor data of various different sources, and reduce the dependence on the existing historical data; clustering the multi-source heterogeneous data can greatly reduce the influence of different source factor spatial heterogeneity on the construction of the ground surface subsidence prediction model; and the prediction result is more reliable and the precision is higher by using machine learning modeling prediction.

title_en: High-resolution mesoscale storm disaster forecasting method based on hierarchical cloud micro-physical scheme
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-resolution mesoscale storm disaster forecasting method based on a hierarchical cloud micro-physical scheme, and belongs to the technical field of weather forecasting. The storm disaster forecasting method comprises the following steps: s1: implanting a hierarchical cloud micro-physical module into the WRF4.4 power frame; s2: the feedback between the hierarchical cloud micro-physical module and the physical integration module is realized, and the establishment of a high-resolution three-dimensional scale numerical mode is completed; s3: the high-resolution numerical simulation of the rainstorm examples is realized by utilizing a three-dimensional cloud grading mesoscale numerical mode; s4: and extracting accumulated rainfall information in the generated meteorological data of the specific area, drawing a rainfall distribution diagram, and predicting the falling area, the occurrence time and the rainfall of the storm. The invention establishes a set of high-resolution three-dimensional mesoscale numerical forecasting mode based on a hierarchical cloud micro-physical scheme based on a WRF4.4 numerical mode power frame, more reasonably describes the spatial distribution of Yun Zhongli seeds, and more accurately forecasts storm disasters.

title_en: Daily agriculture drought early warning method based on soil moisture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a daily agriculture drought early warning technology based on soil moisture. The invention can improve the timeliness of the existing remote sensing detection means on agricultural drought monitoring. By training the end-to-end convolutional neural network on the daily soil moisture for many years, the soil moisture content of five days in the future can be predicted. And carrying out Sen slope estimation on the predicted data and the data of the first seven days, and finally judging the significance of the change trend through a Mann-Kendall method, so that the estimation of the agricultural drought trend of five days in the future is realized, and the aim of early warning is fulfilled. According to the agricultural drought early warning model based on the neural network for predicting the soil moisture, disclosed by the invention, the soil moisture can be efficiently predicted under the condition that complex modules, strategies and skills are not introduced by a simple and effective convolutional neural network model, so that the timeliness of early warning disasters is improved, and the computational complexity is reduced. Compared with the traditional method for early warning the agricultural drought by the remote sensing drought index, the method has better spatial consistency and higher space-time resolution.

title_en: Industry wisdom garden emergency management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency management system for an industrial intelligent park, which belongs to the technical field of emergency management of the intelligent park, and can be used for carrying out exercises for staff in the industrial intelligent park at random by arranging an emergency training unit on a staff management and emergency culture module, designating related exercises according to different posts of the staff and recording related conditions in the exercises so as to be convenient for analyzing exercise results. Be provided with emergency command dispatch module, when the emergent event takes place for industry wisdom garden, can dispatch emergency personnel promptly and have emergent material to go to emergent event place, for the personnel that need evacuate provide reasonable evacuation circuit, simultaneously, for all staff in the industry wisdom garden provide the emergent material distribution condition near its place of place. Through being provided with indoor environment monitoring, can clearly know indoor environmental parameter, be convenient for adjust indoor environment, provide an ideal operational environment for the staff.
assignees: ANHUI XIAOMA CREATIVE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Subway platform passenger evacuation time prediction method based on fire scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of evacuation, in particular to a subway platform passenger evacuation time prediction method based on a fire scene, which comprises the following steps: 1: based on fire dynamics, constructing a fire simulation model, and calculating the movement speed of passengers under the fire; 2: constructing an evacuation simulation system based on simulation software to obtain evacuation time and constructing a basic data set; 3: selecting a main factor affecting evacuation time based on the basic data set; 4: optimizing the random forest model by using a snake optimization algorithm, and constructing a passenger evacuation time prediction model; 5: and training the prediction model by using the basic data set to obtain a trained prediction model, verifying the validity of the prediction model by using the basic data set, and taking the main factor as an input variable to obtain an evacuation time prediction value which is an output variable. The scheme does not need to spend a great deal of time and energy to construct a fire simulation system and a passenger evacuation simulation system, and is helpful for rapidly evaluating the rationality of subway station planning and design and passenger flow peak period management and control measures.
assignees: UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGICAL;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTR ELECTRIFICATION BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN;NANJING METRO CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Rock burst early warning method based on BO-CNN-LSTM model
abstract_en: The invention provides a rock burst early warning method based on a BO-CNN-LSTM model, and relates to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster early warning. Data acquisition and pretreatment are carried out on each factor influencing rock burst; inputting the preprocessed data into a BO-CNN-LSTM model for training, and establishing a rock burst disaster identification model through BO algorithm optimization; inputting data into a trained rock burst disaster identification model for analysis, finding out the parameter value which is optimized by the model generalization through parameter adjustment, outputting a prediction result and carrying out grading early warning, dividing the prediction result into regions without, weak, medium and strong rock burst dangers according to different critical values, and evaluating the rock burst disasters. According to the invention, on the basis of analyzing rock burst influence factors, the advantages of the CNN model and the LSTM model are combined, the BO algorithm is adopted to carry out super-parameter optimization to establish the rock burst risk prediction model, and the mine dynamic disasters are effectively predicted.

title_en: Internet of things disinfection prevention and control system, disinfection prevention and control method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a system, a method and electronic equipment for controlling disinfection and prevention of the Internet of things, which comprises the following steps: the cloud platform, and the field detection equipment and the disinfection terminal are respectively in communication connection with the cloud platform; the field detection device is used for collecting field data of a to-be-killed place and uploading the field data to the cloud platform; the cloud platform is used for obtaining a target killing scheme of a site to be killed in a simulation mode according to the field data and a pre-trained killing scheme model, and sending a target killing method to a killing terminal; and the killing terminal is used for killing the sites to be killed according to the target killing scheme after receiving the killing execution instruction. In the mode, the target disinfection scheme is obtained by processing the data acquired by the field detection equipment through the cloud platform, and the disinfection terminal is enabled to conduct disinfection according to the target disinfection scheme, so that the disinfection efficiency is improved, and further the after-disaster medium organism breeding and epidemic propagation are prevented. Meanwhile, personal safety of the killing personnel is guaranteed.

title_en: Method, system, chip and equipment for deducing rain flood disaster scene of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a chip and equipment for deducing a rain flood disaster scene of a power distribution network, and a vulnerability model of a power distribution network element is constructed based on urban geographic information; constructing a network reconstruction model comprising operation safety constraint and radial topology constraint; constructing a traffic inundation model based on the relation between the road water depth and the vehicle running speed, and determining the travel time under the urban inundation condition; determining submerged nodes according to the obtained vulnerability model of the power distribution network element, optimizing and modeling a travel route, and determining the travel route; and constructing a collaborative optimization model for power distribution system response and recovery based on the obtained network reconstruction model and the travel route, and quantifying the influence of road flooding on electric quantity loss and power failure time to obtain a power distribution network disaster scene under waterlogging. The method can embody the influence of road flooding on the electric quantity loss and the power failure time of the power distribution network and simulate the trip condition of trip personnel under waterlogging.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fire detection method based on PD-YOLO
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and discloses a fire detection method based on PD-YOLO, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring a fire disaster data set, and dividing the fire disaster data set into a training set and a testing set after pretreatment; step 2: constructing YOLOv a network model, designing PConvs modules and DYDPConv modules, and replacing partial C2f modules in the modules by PConvs modules and DYDPConv modules on the basis of the YOLOv network model to obtain an improved YOLOv network model; step 3: the training set is used to train the improved YOLOv network model, and the trained improved YOLOv network model is used for fire data detection. Compared with the prior art, the invention strengthens the feature learning of the model on the flame and the smoke, improves the feature extraction capability of the model, further promotes the multi-scale feature fusion of the flame and the smoke, and grabs more abundant and key feature representations.

title_en: Prediction method and prediction early warning system for atmospheric pollution of industrial park
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method and a prediction early warning system for atmospheric pollution of an industrial park, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting the monitoring data of the environment monitoring points in the research area from year to year as a data source, performing data set missing value interpolation, meteorological factor screening and data normalization reconstruction on the data, and inputting the data into an SA-LSTM model and an XGBoost model for training to obtain a combined model; and constructing an industrial park atmospheric pollution data prediction and early warning system, and predicting and releasing pollutant monitoring data information by using modules in the system. The prediction method and the prediction early warning system for the atmospheric pollution of the industrial park can accurately and timely monitor and predict the atmospheric pollution index in the industrial park, provide scientific basis for intelligent management and control of the atmospheric pollution of the industrial park, and can greatly improve the risk monitoring, rapid early warning and emergency response capability of the industrial park.

title_en: Emergency treatment method and device for multi-disaster coupling accidents in chemical industry park
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, and discloses an emergency processing method and device for multi-disaster coupling accidents in a chemical industry park, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an initial disaster chain evolution model according to an initial disaster, simulating a plurality of multi-disaster type coupling accident scenes generated by the disaster effect of the initial disaster on a first disaster-bearing body unit set in a target area and a second disaster-bearing body unit set in the target area through the initial disaster chain evolution model, analyzing to obtain the occurrence probability of each multi-disaster type coupling accident scene, constructing an occurrence probability matrix of all multi-disaster type coupling accident scenes according to the occurrence probability, and formulating an emergency treatment plan corresponding to each multi-disaster type coupling accident scene. Therefore, the method and the system can accurately predict the occurrence risk of the multi-disaster coupling accident in the disaster bearing unit of the chemical industry park according to the initial disaster chain evolution model and formulate the corresponding emergency treatment plan, thereby being beneficial to improving the efficiency, flexibility and reliability of emergency treatment of the multi-disaster coupling accident.

title_en: Urban rainfall flood model modeling method by combining vector and grid hydrologic calculation unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modeling method of a city rain and flood model by combining vectors with a grid hydrologic calculation unit, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of correcting a high-precision DEM by considering local topographic features of a geographic object, and modeling a grid hydrologic calculation unit by combining hydrologic parameters; according to the space topology and the connection relation of the drainage pipe network, carrying out drainage pipe network modeling; simulating according to typical rainfall occasions, and extracting a simulated result rainfall flood situation; dividing an urban catchment area according to the converging situation characteristics of the simulation result, and constructing a vector grid collaborative hydrologic calculation unit boundary; and estimating characteristic parameters of the vector hydrologic calculation unit by using submerged situation characteristics and converging situation characteristics of the grid simulation result, and performing rating optimization on the parameters to complete construction of the vector grid collaborative urban rainfall flood model. The invention is beneficial to improving the modeling quality and the simulation efficiency of the urban rainfall flood model, expands the modeling and the simulation methods of the existing urban rainfall flood model, and expands the application of GIS in urban hydrology and natural disaster management.

title_en: Construction method and drilling method of power grid emergency drilling sand table based on meta universe
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid emergency exercise, in particular to a construction method and an exercise method of a power grid emergency exercise sand table based on metauniverse, which are used for carrying out analysis modeling on different weather disaster types and a large amount of existing weather process data, carrying out emergency plan sand table exercise/deduction by using a high-performance and high-reality reduction degree algorithm similar to metauniverse, and then carrying out feedback optimization adjustment on a specific early warning release threshold value, an emergency response measure and a resource allocation mode of an emergency plan according to a simulation sand table exercise/deduction result, so that the emergency exercise frequency is improved in a real and virtual combined mode, and the investment of labor and material costs in the aspect of simulating the emergency actual combat exercise can be reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: High-voltage cable electrified combustion test platform and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-voltage cable electrified combustion test platform and a method. The box body and the supporting module comprise a heat-resistant box body and a cable bracket, and the box body is provided with an air inlet and an exhaust port; the voltage source module adopts a power frequency high-voltage generating device; the current source module adopts a power frequency heavy current generating device and is provided with two outgoing lines; the monitoring module comprises a temperature sensor, a smoke component analysis device, an infrared thermal imager and an explosion-proof camera and is used for monitoring the test process; the external ignition module is used to ignite the test cable using an applied flame. The invention gives consideration to the working conditions of high voltage and high current in application, can realize the mutual influence test between the voltage and the current of the high-voltage cable and the combustion, and can simulate the fault heating of the cable and the fire disaster characteristic under the condition of external fire sources.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: High-stress soft broken surrounding rock roadway support method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-stress soft broken surrounding rock roadway support method, which comprises the following steps: s1, measuring geomechanical parameters of surrounding rocks of a roadway, S2, constructing a flexible buffer layer, S3, selecting and installing a hydraulic steel arch frame assembly, S4, drilling and installing an anchor cable on the roadway, S5, injecting liquid into an inner cavity of a hydraulic damping rod, and setting a pressure threshold value of a three-purpose valve of the hydraulic damping rod according to stress of the surrounding rocks. More importantly, the deformation and damage of surrounding rocks of the roadway can be fully controlled, and rock dynamic disasters such as rock burst and the like can be prevented and treated.
assignees: YUNNAN PHOSPHATE CHEM GROUP;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: DC micro-grid fault arc detection method based on multi-feature fusion and fuzzy inference system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electrical engineering, in particular to a method for detecting a fault arc of a direct-current micro-grid based on a multi-feature fusion and fuzzy reasoning system. In a direct current micro grid system, a series arc fault can cause an electrical fire disaster, and the safety of a direct current distribution system is seriously threatened. When the system switches between normal conditions, the detection of arc faults using a single feature and a constant threshold is prone to false positives. The invention builds a typical direct current micro-grid system to collect current information when an electric arc occurs, comprehensively utilizes four fault characteristics of current in time domain, frequency domain and time frequency domain, and builds a fuzzy inference system by reasonably designing membership functions and judgment rules. And detecting arc faults according to the output of the fuzzy inference system. According to MATLAB simulation and experimental data verification, the fuzzy inference system can timely and accurately detect arc faults.

title_en: Device for testing water migration of slope model under freeze thawing cycle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for testing water migration of a slope model under freeze thawing cycle, which comprises: the model box is internally provided with a rock-soil medium slope model, and the bottom of the model box is connected with an automatic water supplementing device. The automatic water supplementing device comprises a sample water supplementing groove, an air pressure balance pipe and a Ma Liao tertiary bottle, wherein a fluorescent tracer is added into the sample water supplementing groove to visually observe the whole water migration process in the side slope. The freeze thawing circulation system of the device comprises an upper cold bath plate, a cold bath device, a lower normal temperature plate, a normal temperature water pump and a connecting pipeline, so as to simulate the slope freeze thawing circulation caused by the actual atmospheric environment change. The device comprises a laser displacement meter, a temperature sensor, a data acquisition instrument, a computer, a purple light lamp and a digital camera, and is used for acquiring data of physical quantities such as displacement, temperature and the like in the deformation process of the side slope model, thereby providing a quantitative analysis basis for the required research. And simulating the temperature rise and fall action of the atmospheric environment on the slope model through the freeze-thawing circulation system, and observing the deformation and internal moisture migration process of the slope model under the freeze-thawing circulation action. Provides basis for the mechanism research, prediction and early warning of the slope geological disasters in the cold region.

title_en: Disaster relief simulation system based on VR technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of simulation systems, and provides a disaster relief simulation system based on VR technology, which mainly uses a virtual reality head-mounted display and a body part sensor to realize functions.
assignees: THE FIRST MEDICAL CENTER OF CHINESE PLA GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for extracting fire collapse early warning space-time characteristics of steel frame
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, equipment and medium for extracting fire collapse early warning space-time characteristics of a steel frame, which comprises the following steps: establishing a finite element numerical analysis model of the multi-layer steel frame structure by combining with an actual engineering case; acquiring fire response data of the multi-layer steel frame structure for a training process of the deep learning model based on the numerical analysis model; determining the displacement of the easily-measured node and the displacement of the difficultly-measured node of the multi-layer steel frame structure; constructing a deep learning model based on a graph neural network and a cyclic neural network; training the deep learning model until the precision requirement is met; and applying a deep learning model obtained through training. Compared with the prior art, the method can accurately calculate the top and internal key node displacement necessary in the fire collapse early warning theory and method in real time, is suitable for multi-layer steel frame structures with various topological forms, saves the calculation cost of a deep learning model for different structures, which is caused by repeated training, and is beneficial to rapid emergency response in actual fire rescue.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating toughness of park comprehensive energy system under extreme weather condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a comprehensive energy system of a park under extreme weather conditions, and relates to the field of toughness evaluation of comprehensive energy systems. According to the method, a unified toughness evaluation index system is constructed, the toughness evaluation index system comprises a plurality of first-level indexes, each first-level index comprises a plurality of second-level indexes, and the comprehensive evaluation of the toughness of the park comprehensive energy system is realized; adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method to simulate a selected extreme weather disaster scene so as to obtain a second-level index value of each park comprehensive energy system to be evaluated under a toughness evaluation index system, constructing a standardized matrix, and realizing a scientific and reasonable index calculation method; acquiring the comprehensive weight of each secondary index by adopting an analytic hierarchy process-Critic method, and constructing a comprehensive weight coefficient matrix; and according to the standardized matrix and the comprehensive weight coefficient matrix, acquiring the toughness evaluation result sequence of each park comprehensive energy system to be evaluated, so that the toughness evaluation result of the comprehensive energy system under extreme weather conditions is more reliable.

title_en: Batch fossil gypsum rock dynamic water erosion test method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of corrosion, and discloses a batch fossil gypsum rock dynamic water corrosion test method, which aims to solve the problem that the existing test method can not accurately simulate the underground corrosion condition of gypsum rock. The invention comprises an erosion test system, wherein the test system comprises a constant-temperature water tank, the constant-temperature water tank is provided with a water outlet pipe, the water outlet pipe is connected with a plurality of water diversion pipes, each water diversion pipe is provided with a reaction bin capable of placing a plurality of gypsum rock samples, each reaction bin is provided with a measuring cup for collecting water, and the reaction bins are communicated with the measuring cup through water guide pipes. The invention can simulate the real situation of the underground corrosion of the gypsum rock more objectively and accurately, so that the test result is more accurate, and disaster prevention and disaster reduction can be conveniently carried out according to the corrosion situation of the gypsum rock; on the other hand, the invention can complete the dynamic water erosion test of a plurality of gypsum rock tests at one time, thereby improving the efficiency of the dynamic water erosion of the gypsum rock.
assignees: CHENGDU SURVEYING GEOTECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD OF MCC

title_en: Coal mine water inrush prediction method based on gate circulation neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine water burst prediction, and discloses a coal mine water burst prediction method based on a gate circulation neural network, which comprises the following steps: 1) And (3) surveying the easy occurrence points of each water bursting disaster condition of the coal mining area, acquiring the original data of the mining area, and preprocessing the original data. The LSTM neural network can learn time series data, namely, learn the change rule of a series of sample data and the influence of the change rule on water burst or not, so that the accuracy and reliability of prediction are improved, the problem that the current existing water burst prediction model cannot learn the change rule of the time series sample data to cause low prediction accuracy is solved, the accuracy of water burst prediction in a coal mine area is greatly improved, the original data of a coal mine area is surveyed by the YZT6 intrinsic safety type drilling water detector, the water burst phenomenon in the coal mine area can be subjected to grading treatment, timely and effective arrangement personnel can process when early warning occurs conveniently, and the processing efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: JIZHONG ENERGY FENGFENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Coal seam gas reasonable extraction parameter test and dangerous partition accurate prediction equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses equipment and a method for testing reasonable extraction parameters of coal seam gas and accurately predicting dangerous subareas. The specific method comprises the following steps: a. directional drilling design along the coal seam; reasonable extraction parameters and gas pressure measuring point arrangement; b. the test complete device is connected and conveyed; c. testing coal bed gas extraction parameters and gas pressure; d. after the whole parameter test and dangerous area division are complete, connecting a drainage pipeline for gas drainage, after the drainage is completed, throwing a packer to discharge a low-density ball, pressurizing an expansion liquid by utilizing high-pressure water, realizing the sliding of a pressure relief spring, promoting the alignment communication of a pressure relief outlet channel and a water outlet valve, releasing the pressure of water discharged by a ball-throwing type packer, and realizing the pressure relief recovery of the ball-throwing type packer and equipment. Provides powerful support for effective control of gas disasters.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Space layout optimization method and system for refuge sites of aging communities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space layout optimization method and a system for an aging community refuge site, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s100: reading traffic road network data and building and refuge site data of communities, and simulating an evacuation space simulation model of communities; s200: reading population data and historical disaster data of communities, constructing evacuation personnel intelligent bodies with corresponding evacuation behavior modes, and importing the evacuation personnel intelligent bodies and the historical disaster data into an evacuation space simulation model for evacuation simulation; s300: evaluating an evacuation simulation process by using the evacuation evaluation indexes and the utilization rate of each refuge site; s400: judging whether the evacuation evaluation indexes and the utilization rate of each refuge site reach preset requirements, optimizing the space layout of the refuge site if the evacuation evaluation indexes and the utilization rate of each refuge site do not reach the preset requirements, and executing the steps S200-S300; when it is reached, it is ended. The method optimizes the space layout of the existing refuge sites based on the characteristics of the aging communities, and can ensure smooth evacuation of personnel in the aging communities when disasters occur.

title_en: Visual monitoring system and method for panoramic information of elastic power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a panoramic information visual monitoring system and method for an elastic power distribution network, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution network monitoring. A panoramic information visual monitoring system of an elastic power distribution network comprises an information acquisition module, an analysis and evaluation module, a real-time monitoring module and a visual display module. The method solves the problem that in the actual use process of the existing patent, the elasticity of the power distribution network cannot be analyzed and processed according to the extreme event, so that the accuracy of an analysis result is low when the elasticity index of the power distribution network is analyzed. According to the invention, the load response conditions of the disaster-suffering and recovery process of the power distribution network can be completely simulated according to the disaster types, the corresponding risk bearing capacity of the power distribution network is judged, the accuracy of analyzing the elasticity indexes of the power distribution network is improved, the accuracy of analyzing the risk grade bearing capacity is further ensured, the rush-repair efficiency of the power distribution network is improved, and the normal use of the power distribution network is prevented from being influenced by faults.

title_en: Construction method of soil nailing wall for geological disaster treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a soil nailing wall for treating geological disasters, which relates to the technical field of geological disasters and comprises the steps of S1, environmental survey and construction design, S2, bottom spraying and drilling, S3, hole dampproof treatment, S4, soil nailing and grouting, S5, reinforcement mesh and drainage pipe layout, and S6, concrete surface spraying. This construction method of soil nail wall for geological disaster treatment not only is provided with the wash pipe and is used for the drainage, more carries out dampproofing to the hole and handles, place the steel mesh drum in the hole to scribble the diatom mud that modulates, the construction process after the improvement not only can discharge the water that gathers into the thigh flow in the soil layer, can also absorb by the moisture of hole inner wall, the isolated effect of cooperation waterproof layer, can avoid the soil nail that the reinforcing bar was made to be in moist environment for a long time, thereby avoid the inoxidizing coating on soil nail surface to corrode, drop, because reduce soil nail corrosion, reduce maintenance replacement cost, because maintain original soil nail wall structural stability, promote the reinforcement effect of side slope.

title_en: Disaster recovery and backup exercise network node health early warning method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning method, a disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning system, disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning equipment and a disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning storage medium; the method comprises the following steps: calculating the total energy consumption of the network node for completing the calculation task, and grading the energy consumption of the node according to the total energy consumption; acquiring service data volume transmitted by each network node from a historical database, and judging service weight scores of the network nodes according to the service data volume; performing health scoring on the network node according to the historical alarm times of the network node; adding the energy consumption score, the business weight score and the health score to obtain a total score of the network node; the network nodes with the highest scores form an optimal disaster recovery drilling link; and predicting the quality probability of the data transmitted by the optimal disaster recovery drilling link by using the quantum Bayesian network, and triggering the health early warning if the quality probability is lower than a threshold value. According to the invention, the power resource health state of the node is monitored in the full process of disaster recovery and backup exercise, the quantum Bayesian network is utilized to replace the traditional Bayesian network, the subjective probability of Bayesian probability prediction is corrected, and smooth progress of disaster recovery and backup exercise is ensured.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for simulating oil spill combustion on water surface under action of ambient wind and waves
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for simulating oil spill combustion on water surface under the action of environmental wind and waves, wherein the device comprises the following components: a pool; the environment wind module is arranged at one end of the water tank and used for supplying air flow to the direction of the water tank, and the wave simulation module is arranged at one end of the water tank and comprises a wave-making push plate arranged in the water tank and a driving device used for driving the wave-making push plate to reciprocate; the ignition module is arranged at one end of the water tank, which is far away from the wave simulation module, and comprises an ignition electrode and an electric spark control device connected with the ignition electrode, wherein the ignition electrode is connected with a floating piece, the floating piece is arranged at one end of the water tank, which is far away from the wave simulation module, in a guiding sliding manner, according to the method, the boundary conditions of transverse wind and water surface oil spilling with higher similarity are provided, the environment wind formed by actual marine fuel leakage and the water surface oil fire disaster under the wave action are reasonably simulated, and the experimental credibility is improved.

title_en: Fire control teaching presentation device of simulation flood disaster torrent
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting teaching demonstration device for simulating flood disaster torrent, which comprises a support frame, a protective box, a water pump and a water tank, wherein the support frame is arranged on the support frame; the right-side output end of the water pump is connected with the water tank; further comprises: the inside position of support frame has the seamless concatenation in glass river course, and the inside in glass river course is provided with the torrent simulation sand table subassembly, and the one end of water supply return circuit sets up the one end at the torrent simulation sand table subassembly simultaneously. This teaching presentation device of simulation flood calamity torrent is provided with the support frame, through the inside glass river course of support frame, with the setting of torrent simulation sand table subassembly, can be in the demonstration process visual, demonstrate different circumstances scene through the power size of adjusting the water pump to controllable movable manual operation such as the inside different spillways of torrent simulation sand table subassembly of valve and torrent can be used control through the control box simultaneously.
assignees: CHINA RESCUE GUANGDONG MACHINERY PROFESSIONAL DETACHMENT

title_en: Grouting device for mine geological disaster management
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of grouting devices, and discloses a grouting device for mine geological disaster management, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first hydraulic motor is fixedly connected to one side of the bottom surface of the bottom plate, a rotary table is connected to the first hydraulic motor, a drilling mechanism is arranged on one side of the top surface of the rotary table, a grouting mechanism is arranged on the other side of the top surface of the rotary table, the grouting mechanism is communicated with a slurry feeding mechanism, the grouting mechanism comprises a first bracket, a first hydraulic rod is fixedly connected to the top of the first bracket, a first lifting plate is fixedly connected to the first hydraulic rod, a grouting pipe is fixedly connected to the first lifting plate, a grouting head is connected to the lower end of the grouting pipe, a pushing pipe is sleeved outside the grouting pipe in a movable manner, a pushing plate is fixedly connected to the upper side wall of the pushing pipe, a second hydraulic rod is fixedly connected to the top surface of the first lifting plate, a rubber sleeve is connected between the lower end of the pushing pipe and the grouting head, and the grouting mechanism can fully inject slurry into a gap of a mine, and therefore the mine reinforcement quality is improved.
assignees: HUBEI GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION INST OF SINOCHEM GEOLOGICAL AND MINING ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Evaluation method for quantitatively representing width of reverse fault fracture zone
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of oil and gas exploration, in particular to an evaluation method for quantitatively representing the width of a fracture zone of reverse fault fracture, which comprises the following steps: preferably, the amplitude-preserving fidelity seismic data are selected, and a seismic research work area is established; calibrating a target earthquake geological horizon interface by adopting a calibration technology; tracking and comparing the three-dimensional data seismic stratum by using the seismic stratum interface calibration result; according to geological laws, the sensitive attribute of the fracture zone is preferably selected through statistical analysis; the application utilizes the seismic data, realizes qualitative description promotion and upgrading from conventional fault fracture zone width to quantitative characterization by optimizing the sensitive attribute of the fracture zone, and provides the most direct scientific basis for oil and gas exploration and development, especially for the drilling deployment of the unconventional oil and gas exploration and development in recent years, thereby greatly reducing the drilling risk, improving the exploration and development benefit, and simultaneously providing important support for large engineering site selection, geological disaster prevention and control and prediction decision.

title_en: Coal seam directional long-drilling hole arrangement method considering gas pre-extraction and tunneling roadway pressure relief
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal seam directional long drilling arrangement method taking gas pre-extraction and tunneling roadway pressure relief into consideration, which comprises the steps of firstly determining the construction aperture of directional long drilling, and then determining the effective radius of gas extraction of the drilling as a distance L1 according to the construction aperture; meanwhile, the distance L2 is calculated based on the pressure relief requirement, a smaller value is taken as the final pressure relief drilling construction distance L in a comparison mode, directional long drilling holes are constructed in the coal seam at a proper distance of the coal wall production side, and after construction, pressure relief areas around adjacent drilling holes are communicated with each other to form a weakening zone, so that pressure relief of the inside of the coal seam is achieved; and meanwhile, gas extraction is carried out after the hole sealing of each long drilling hole, so that the gas content in the coal seam is reduced, one-hole multi-purpose of directional long drilling holes is realized, and finally, double disasters of rock burst and gas outburst can be simultaneously prevented and controlled, the coordination of the rock burst prevention and control and gas control effects is realized, and in addition, the aims of cost reduction and synergy can be achieved due to the fact that the directional long drilling holes have one-hole multi-purpose effects.

title_en: Analysis method for influence of meteorological conditions in power grid on power equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an analysis method of influence of meteorological conditions in a power grid on power equipment, which comprises the following steps: according to meteorological data, temperature, humidity and atmospheric pressure of equipment, adopting a data fusion and analysis technology to simulate the global influence of weather on a power grid; identifying and predicting equipment overheating problems according to real-time data and meteorological data, and determining heat dissipation measures and a temperature control scheme; the damage condition of lightning to the power equipment is obtained by combining the lightning activity monitoring and early warning system with the correlation analysis, and lightning protection equipment and measures are determined; adopting a meteorological data mining technology to analyze influence factors of related problems of humidity caused by damp and salt fog erosion, and determining dampproof measures and humidity control schemes; and (3) evaluating the fault frequency and maintenance period of the power grid equipment under various weather conditions, and determining a long-term protection equipment and disaster resistance capability improvement scheme.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Aeroengine high-speed slow-running control method based on sliding mode variable damping guide vane adjustment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aeroengine high-speed slow-running control method based on sliding mode variable damping guide vane adjustment, which comprises the steps of determining a high-pressure compressor adjustable stator blade angle adjustment plan according to an engine high-speed slow-running acceleration plan, establishing an electro-hydrostatic actuator and aeroengine simulation model according to the high-pressure compressor adjustable stator blade angle adjustment plan to control the high-pressure compressor adjustable stator blade angle, and controlling the electro-hydrostatic actuator through a position controller to eliminate the high-pressure compressor adjustable stator blade angle adjustment error so as to achieve the high-pressure compressor adjustable stator blade angle required by the engine high-speed slow-running acceleration plan. The invention effectively improves the thrust response speed of the aero-engine, provides an important reference for emergency response control of the engine, and has important significance for improving the control performance of the aircraft in emergency.

title_en: Future disaster potential risk scene prejudging method integrating flood landform evidence and evolution mode
abstract_en: The future disaster potential risk scene prejudging method integrating flood landform evidence and evolution mode comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a flood comprehensive landform evidence system through field investigation, and recording natural flood; s2, constructing a flood age sequence, evaluating the stability of flood discharge sections, and reconstructing an ancient flood section based on a river development stage; s3, determining the flood cause type based on the parameters obtained in the steps S1-S2, and constructing different types of evolution modes according to the along-path flood evidence; s4, simulating and reconstructing the scale flood scale of the river basin by adopting a one-dimensional hydraulic model based on the steps S1-S3, and analyzing the landform effect and the flood master control factor by adopting a two-dimensional hydraulic model; step S5, based on the steps, the future potential risk scene prejudgment of the huge disaster is realized through similar hydrodynamic conditions; the method utilizes physicochemical indexes to discriminate and analyze different types of floods, establishes a comprehensive flood landform evidence system, has the characteristics of sufficient representativeness, high reliability and small difficulty in discriminating information, and has wide application range.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Method for forecasting temperature in underground utility tunnel based on CA-TimeGAN and residual CNN-LSTM
title_ko: CA-TimeGAN 모델 및 Residual CNN-LSTM 모델로 지하 공동구 온도변화를 예측하는 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for predicting a temperature change in an underground utility tunnel with a CA-TimeGAN model and a residual CNN-LSTM model and, more specifically, to a method capable of predicting a future temperature change from actually measured data by generating data, which is similar to actual disaster occurrence data detected from an underground utility tunnel, with the CA-TimeGAN model, and then training the residual CNN-LSTM model with the generated data. A disaster such as a fire occurring in an underground utility tunnel can cause a huge loss of properties and losses as well as can greatly influence citizen livelihood and the whole industry. Accordingly, research projects analyzing sensor data detected from an underground utility tunnel and monitoring disaster occurrence using deep learning are conducted. However, there is no actual data according to disaster occurrence in the underground utility tunnel, which can lead to a problem with difficulty in training a deep learning system. Therefore, in accordance with the present invention, provided is a method for generating data similar to actual data of a disaster situation through a deep learning program and training a model predicting a temperature change, and then, predicting a future temperature change with an actually measured temperature value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 CA-TimeGAN 모델 및 Residual CNN-LSTM 모델로 지하 공동구 온도변화를 예측하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게로는, 지하 공동구에서 탐지될 수 있는 실제 재난 발생 데이터와 유사한 데이터를 CA-TimeGAN 모델로 생성시킨 후, 생성된 데이터를 Residual CNN-LSTM 모델로 학습시켜 실제 측정되는 데이터로부터 향후의 온도변화를 예측할 수 있도록 하는 것이다. 지하 공동구에서 화재 등의 재난 발생 시 막대한 재산 및 인명피해를 유발할 뿐만 아니라 시민 생활과 산업 전반에 큰 영향을 끼친다. 따라서 딥러닝을 이용하여 지하 공동구에서 감지되는 센서 데이터들을 분석하고 재난 발생을 감시하는 연구들이 진행되고 있다. 그러나, 지하 공동구의 재난 발생에 따른 실제 데이터가 없기 때문에 딥러닝 시스템들을 학습시키기가 어렵다는 문제가 있다. 따라서, 본 발명에서는 딥러닝 프로그램으로 재난 상황의 실제 데이터와 유사한 데이터를 생성하여 온도변화를 예측하는 모델을 학습시킨 후, 실제 측정되는 온도 값으로 향후의 온도변화를 예측하는 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Disaster response training device
abstract_en: A disaster response training device 1 comprises: a processing part 121 for processing, as a scenario, damage caused by past disaster that occurred in a prescribed area and the response policy; a first calculation part 123 for calculating the present number of persons staying in the prescribed area; a second calculation part 124 for calculating present damage on real estate in the prescribed area; a third calculation part 125 for calculating a present disaster response resource in the prescribed area; a display part 126 for displaying, on a screen, the damage caused by the past disaster and the response policy, the present number of persons staying, the present damage on real estate, and the present disaster response resource; and a request part 127 for requesting a user for a present response policy which is based on the present number of persons staying, the present damage on real estate, and the present disaster response resource and in which the response policy in the scenario serves as a basis.

title_en: Prediction method and system through social event criterion model including any one or more of terrorism, disaster, war and crime
title_ko: 테러, 재난, 전쟁 및 범죄 중 어느 하나 이상을 포함하는 사회적 이벤트 판단기준 모델을 통한 예측 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a prediction method and system using a social event judgment criterion model including at least one of terrorism, disaster, war, and crime, which analyzes terrorist activities by type domestically and internationally to predict the occurrence of terrorism. The disclosed social event occurrence prediction system comprises: a law database which stores information on various reports, laws, and trends regarding social events occurring domestically and internationally; a social event analysis unit which obtains and analyzes information for deriving the establishment requirements of the social event from the law database; a judgment model generation unit which sets social event judgment criteria according to the analysis results of the social event analysis unit and generates a social event judgment model; an input unit which receives a social event to be analyzed; a social event prediction unit which applies the input social event to the social event judgment model to classify the social event, generates a social event prediction scenario according to the classified social event, and predicts the occurrence of the social event according to the generated social event prediction scenario; and an output unit which outputs the predicted occurrence of the social event.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 국가 내외적으로 테러 활동을 유형별로 분석하여 테러 발생을 예측할 수 있도록 하는, 테러, 재난, 전쟁 및 범죄 중 어느 하나 이상을 포함하는 사회적 이벤트 판단기준 모델을 통한 예측 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 
개시된 사회적 이벤트 발생 예측 시스템은, 국내와 국외에서 발생되는 사회적 이벤트에 대한 각종 보고서, 법령, 동향에 대한 정보를 저장하고 있는 법령 데이터베이스; 상기 법령 데이터베이스로부터 상기 사회적 이벤트의 성립 요건을 도출하기 위한 정보를 가져와 분석하는 사회적 이벤트 분석부; 상기 사회적 이벤트 분석부의 분석 결과에 따라 사회적 이벤트 판단 기준을 설정하여 사회적 이벤트 판단 모델을 생성하는 판단 모델 생성부; 분석하고자 하는 사회적 이벤트를 입력받는 입력부; 상기 입력받은 사회적 이벤트를 상기 사회적 이벤트 판단 모델에 적용하여 사회적 이벤트를 분류하고, 분류된 사회적 이벤트에 따라 사회적 이벤트 예측 시나리오를 생성하고, 생성된 사회적 이벤트 예측 시나리오에 따라 사회적 이벤트 발생을 예측하는 사회적 이벤트 예측부; 및 상기 예측된 사회적 이벤트 발생을 출력하는 출력부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Comprehensive pipe gallery management method based on CIM
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive pipe gallery management method based on CIM, belongs to the technical field of CIM, and provides three-dimensional presentation of pipe gallery forms, full access of pipe gallery monitoring data and simulation of pipe gallery operation situations by applying the innovative CIM technology to comprehensive pipe gallery operation and maintenance management scenes. The visual and intelligent monitoring management level of the comprehensive pipe rack is continuously improved, the decision command efficiency is improved, the operation reliability and disaster prevention and resistance of pipelines are practically improved, the safe and efficient operation of the system is ensured, and the comprehensive intelligent management and operation of pipe rack operation and maintenance are realized.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR NEW INFRASTRUCTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Roadway gas concentration prediction method based on model and big data double driving
abstract_en: A roadway gas concentration prediction method based on model and big data double driving belongs to the technical field of mine disaster intelligent prevention and control, and solves the technical problems of accuracy and instantaneity of gas concentration prediction in a roadway, and the method comprises the following steps: the coal mine tunnel environmental parameters, the gas concentration historical characteristic data set and the physical equation characteristic data set are combined into a data set, and training is carried out through a convolutional neural network RNN to obtain a predicted value; and further, through model evaluation and optimization, gas diffusion criterion constraint is added in a loss function of a standard RNN, and a standard back propagation algorithm and an Adam optimizer are adopted to train a learning model until a loss function result is minimized, so that accurate prediction of the roadway gas concentration is finally realized. The method can realize accurate and rapid prediction of the roadway gas concentration, provide reliable data support for coal mine safety decision, and effectively ensure safe and efficient mining of the coal mine.

title_en: Drilling joint construction method for reducing static load and gas pressure of coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling joint construction method for reducing static load and gas pressure of a coal bed, which comprises the steps of determining impact danger degrees of all positions in an impact danger area in front of a working face, and pertinently implementing pressure relief work; then calculating a preliminary drilling interval and a coal seam gas extraction effective radius, and finally comparing the preliminary drilling interval and the coal seam gas extraction effective radius to take a smaller value as a final pressure relief drilling construction interval, so that the pressure relief drilling can be ensured to achieve a required pressure relief effect, and the gas extraction drilling can cover the whole coal seam working surface during subsequent layout; after the construction of the pressure relief drilling, the pressure relief is carried out on the impact dangerous area, and meanwhile, part of the pressure relief drilling is transformed into a gas extraction drilling, so that the gas extraction inside the coal seam working face is realized, and finally, the double disasters of rock burst and gas outburst can be simultaneously prevented and controlled, the coordination of the rock burst prevention and control and gas control effects is realized.

title_en: Thermal runaway research platform of train-mounted energy storage system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal runaway research platform of a train-mounted energy storage system and a control method thereof, wherein the research platform comprises the following components: the system comprises a carriage bottom plate, a prefabricated vehicle bottom energy storage device, a thermal runaway triggering system, a ventilation system, a data acquisition system, a fire extinguishing system and a controller; the thermal runaway triggering system can be used for simulating two thermal runaway causes of thermal abuse and electric abuse of the energy storage system; the ventilation system and the fire extinguishing system are used for researching the thermal runaway process of the energy storage system under different ventilation conditions and spraying actions, and the controller is used for controlling the research process to realize safety prevention and control; the data acquisition system is used for acquiring characteristic parameters of the thermal runaway process; the controller performs early warning on the research process and performs system control on the research platform. The invention can simulate the thermal runaway process of the train bottom energy storage battery under the multi-scene multi-factor coupling effect, develop the disaster-causing mechanism of the thermal runaway of the vehicle-mounted energy storage system, target fire extinguishment and intrinsically safe heat management research, thereby providing guidance for the safety protection of the vehicle-mounted energy storage system.

title_en: Layered passenger ship personnel emergency evacuation method considering deadline and congestion relief
abstract_en: The invention discloses a layered passenger ship personnel emergency evacuation method considering deadline and congestion relief, which comprises the following steps: establishing a global navigation feature map model according to the internal structure of the ship and the pedestrian moving speed of each passing area in the ship; generating a global reference path according to the global navigation feature map model; constructing an emergency evacuation decision model; training an emergency evacuation decision model based on reinforcement learning by using a training mechanism of the reinforcement learning algorithm and combining a characteristic extraction network frame; on the basis of an emergency evacuation decision model, a layered emergency evacuation decision logic combining global planning and local guiding is formed, and passenger and ship personnel are evacuated according to the logic. The invention has the advantages of low cost, high efficiency and high flexibility.

title_en: Tobacco thermal simulation practical training system and training effect evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smoke thermal simulation practical training system and a training effect evaluation method, which relate to the technical field of fire fight practical training and comprise a practical training scene simulation unit, a smoke control unit, a temperature control unit, a general control unit, an AR display unit and a scoring unit, wherein the control unit is respectively in signal connection with the smoke control unit, the temperature control unit, a physical scene simulation unit and the AR display unit, the physical scene simulation unit comprises a netpen channel, a functional practical training module, a monitoring camera and a motion catcher, and the scoring unit is used for collecting skill operation assessment results and physiological and psychological data parameter indexes in the smoke thermal training process of personnel, and then evaluates, predicts, early warns and guides the training of the firefighters through a firefighter psychophysiological research and judgment analysis model. By the evaluation and analysis of the training effect, the assessment indexes such as physiological data, air oxygen consumption data and equipment training conditions of firefighters before and after the smoke and heat training can be quantified.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Special fire-fighting carrying and starting training device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special fire-fighting carrying training device and a using method thereof, and relates to the field of physical training equipment for actual combat of firefighters. The invention comprises a chassis main body and a frame, wherein an adjusting component is arranged in the frame, the adjusting component comprises a mounting column, a screw is arranged on the mounting column, a thread block is connected to the outer side of the screw in a threaded manner, mounting frames are arranged on two sides of the thread block, and weight barbell pieces are arranged on the inner sides of the mounting frames.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;NANJING KUNBAO SAFETY PROT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method of random forest model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide susceptibility evaluation method of a random forest, belongs to the field of landslide prediction, and solves the problem that a machine learning technology in the prior art is easy to cause a fitting phenomenon in landslide prediction; firstly, multi-source data of a landslide hazard research area are acquired, evaluation factors are extracted, and an evaluation factor layer is generated; and then calculating the CF value and the information quantity of each evaluation factor, calculating the weight of each factor by using the CF value, multiplying the calculated weight by the corresponding information quantity value, and packaging to construct an experimental data set which is divided into a training set and a testing set. Substituting the training set into a random forest to perform training simulation, and obtaining the optimal model parameters. Substituting the test set into a model to test the accuracy of the model, and then importing each evaluation factor layer into the stored model to analyze landslide disaster susceptibility. By using the method, the interference of artificial factors in the evaluation process is avoided, the noise in the training sample can be reduced, and the landslide susceptibility evaluation can be objectively and efficiently realized.

title_en: Tunnel structure disaster detection early warning model test device
