abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel construction, in particular to a tunnel structure disaster detection early warning model test device which comprises a model box, a pressurizing module and a tunnel mould module, wherein the pressurizing module is arranged on the inner side of the model box, the tunnel mould module is arranged on the inner side of the model box, the model box comprises a box body, the upper side of the box body is in sliding connection with an upper box plate, the front side and the rear side of the box body are fixedly connected with limiting frames, the inner side of the limiting frames is in sliding connection with a box door, the inner side of the box door is provided with sliding grooves, the inner side of the sliding grooves is in sliding connection with sealing blocks, the two sides of the inner wall of the box body are fixedly connected with bases, the bases comprise seat bodies, storage grooves are formed in the inner side of the seat bodies, the outer sides of the storage grooves are communicated with mounting positions, and the model test device can perform multi-directional simulation pressurization through the structures such as the arranged model box, sealing blocks, the bases and the pressurizing module.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZEXINTONG INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: System and method for measuring hydraulic punching coal flushing amount of gas extraction drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and discloses a hydraulic punching and coal-flushing measuring system and a measuring method for gas extraction drilling, wherein the system comprises a weighing module and a flow measuring module, and the weighing module and the flow measuring module are connected with a control module; the weighing module is used for weighing and measuring the mixture of the coal and the water in the weighing box; the flow measurement module is used for measuring the flow of the coal-water mixture flowing through the weighing box; the control module is used for receiving and sending operation instructions, receiving measurement information transmitted by the weighing module and the flow measurement module, and automatically calculating the coal flushing amount of the gas extraction drilling hole according to the measurement information; according to the invention, the weight and the flow of the coal-water mixture are measured on line in real time, the weight information and the flow information are utilized to calculate the coal flushing quantity of the gas extraction drilling hole, so that the measuring precision can be effectively improved, and the measuring error caused by bad factors in the measuring can be reduced.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU HUIKUANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;ZHENGZHOU WEIDA AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cesium-based unmanned aerial vehicle group performance simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Cesium-based unmanned aerial vehicle group performance simulation system, which comprises an environment construction module, a route planning module and a result export module, wherein the environment construction module is used for constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle group performance environment, the environment construction is mainly divided into importing real GIS space data and importing physical environment parameters, the route planning module is used for route planning, the route planning comprises a formation scheme, task assignment, regional planning and path drawing, the simulation analysis module is used for providing the whole process simulation of the group performance, the whole process simulation comprises formation take-off, entry, performance, evacuation and recovery, and the result export module is used for exporting the whole process simulation playback of the performance into structured data, videos or reports, wherein the structured data can be stored in a database or a text file, and the simulation result can be played back in the system. According to the invention, cesium is taken as a bottom layer frame, and the GIS data expression capability and performance parameters of the unmanned aerial vehicle group are combined, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle group performance simulation system is provided, and the user requirements can be better met.

title_en: Coal mine disaster cooperative treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine disaster cooperative treatment method which comprises the steps of 1, calculating a curvature value of the middle position of each rock stratum, 2, determining each key layer in the stratum, 3, determining a flushing key layer, 4, searching an optimal fracturing layer, 5, fracturing drilling arrangement, 6, calculating a limit caving step of the optimal fracturing layer close to an overlying rock stratum, 7, directional segmented hydraulic fracturing, 8, pumping coal layer gas, 9, preparing grouting liquid, 10, beginning grouting of a goaf, 11, stopping working of a filling pump station, 12, re-grouting after a working face is shifted by one filling step, and 13, repeating the steps 12 until coal seam exploitation is completed. The invention combines two technologies of hydraulic fracturing of the coal seam roof and grouting filling of the goaf, plays a role in preventing and controlling coal and gas outburst, hard roof rock burst, mine water burst and ground subsidence, realizes the cooperative control of multiple disasters and improves the construction efficiency.

title_en: VR Environment for Accident Reconstruction
abstract_en: The following relates generally to providing virtual reality (VR) alerts to a driver of an autonomous vehicle. For example, a vehicle may be driving autonomously while the driver is watching a VR movie (e.g., on a pair of VR goggles); the driver may then receive a VR alert recommending that the driver take control of the vehicle (e.g., switch the vehicle from autonomous to manual mode). The following also relates to generating a VR feed for presenting real-time road conditions so that a user may preview a road segment. The following also relates to generating a VR feed corresponding to an event (e.g., a vehicle collision, a crime, a weather event, and/or a natural disaster).
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: VR environment for real-time road conditions
abstract_en: The following relates generally to providing virtual reality (VR) alerts to a driver of an autonomous vehicle. For example, a vehicle may be driving autonomously while the driver is watching a VR movie (e.g., on a pair of VR goggles); the driver may then receive a VR alert recommending that the driver take control of the vehicle (e.g., switch the vehicle from autonomous to manual mode). The following also relates to generating a VR feed for presenting real-time road conditions so that a user may preview a road segment. The following also relates to generating a VR feed corresponding to an event (e.g., a vehicle collision, a crime, a weather event, and/or a natural disaster).
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Method, device, electronic equipment and medium for analyzing disaster prevention and mitigation effectiveness of ecological seawall
abstract_en: A method for analyzing disaster prevention and mitigation effectiveness of an ecological seawall is provided, including: performing seawall ecologicalization on a target seawall; establishing three-dimensional space hydrodynamic force for the target ecological seawall; simulating wave climbing on a dike body and a wave overtopping on a dike top of the target ecological seawall to obtain a wave overtopping index; calculating wave-flow bottom shear stress of the target ecological seawall, establishing a sediment movement model, and calculating suspended load and bed load sediment transportation volumes; calculating the change index of coastal bed surface according to the suspended load and bed load sediment transportation volumes, and determining a development index of tidal flats in front of dike of the target ecological seawall according to the change index; and calculating the disaster prevention and mitigation effectiveness grade of the target ecological seawall according to the wave overtopping index and the development index.
assignees: PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Fire risk assessment method and system based on parameter modeling
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire prevention and control, and provides a fire risk assessment method based on parameter modeling. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a forest fire prevention and control risk evaluation dimension index set; determining a second-level dimension risk evaluation index set according to the forest fire prevention and control risk evaluation dimension index set; performing weight matrix calculation based on the forest fire prevention and control risk evaluation dimension index set to obtain a first-level index weight matrix; sequentially carrying out weight matrix calculation to determine a secondary index weight matrix; determining index parameters of a risk assessment model based on the primary index weight matrix and the secondary index weight matrix; model training is carried out based on the index parameters of the risk assessment model, a fire risk assessment model is generated, and forest fire risk management is carried out through the fire risk assessment model. The forest fire disaster management method and the forest fire disaster management system solve the technical problem that forest fires frequently occur in the prior art to cause a large amount of resource loss, and achieve the technical effect of maintaining forest resources.

title_en: Simulation system for simulating nuclear power crowd evacuation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a simulation system for simulating nuclear power crowd evacuation, which comprises an interactive interface and a calculation module; the interactive interface is used for inputting calculation parameters and displaying simulation results of the calculation module, wherein the calculation parameters comprise road network information, personnel distribution information, vehicle distribution information and model parameters, and the simulation results comprise evacuation paths, evacuation time and road condition information; the computing module simulates the evacuation process according to the computing parameters, the simulation model, the personnel preparation time probability function and the control strategy to obtain a simulation result, and the control strategy takes the optimal path with the shortest evacuation time as a control target. The simulation system provided by the embodiment of the application can simulate the influence of the uncertainty factor generated by the emergency, so as to realize the simulation of the emergency evacuation event and the special behavior simulation of the visual evacuation path. And predicting whether the position of the nuclear power plant is reasonable according to the simulation result, and accurately issuing instructions when emergencies are encountered.

title_en: SAR image simulation method and device for damage scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for simulating SAR images of a damage scene, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing three-dimensional models of explosion pits under different soil medium types, explosive amounts and explosive depths based on explosion mechanics; performing explosion pit and backscattering characteristic of scene where the explosion pit is located based on calculation electromagnetism; and simulating and imaging echo data of the explosion pit according to the three-dimensional model of the explosion pit and the backscattering characteristics of the explosion pit and the scene where the explosion pit is located. The method can indirectly acquire the post-explosion damage scene information, and has important significance for post-disaster quick evaluation, post-disaster reconstruction, engineering construction, fire-extinguishing rescue and other works.

title_en: Electrical fire simulation experiment device for electrified lead
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric fire simulation experiment device for an electrified wire, which comprises a power supply, a slide rheostat, a mounting rack, an electrified wire for experiment and a sensor, wherein the power supply is connected with the slide rheostat; the power supply, the slide rheostat and the experimental energizing lead are sequentially connected in series; the installation frame comprises a balance, two installation seats are fixed at the top end of the balance, upright posts are sleeved in the two installation seats in a sliding manner, wire fixing mechanisms are fixed on the two upright posts, and an electrified wire for experiments is detachably installed on the upright posts through the wire fixing mechanisms; an insulating layer cutting mechanism is fixedly arranged on one upright post, a wire changing mechanism is fixedly arranged on the other upright post, and two wire fixing mechanisms are arranged between the insulating layer cutting mechanism and the wire changing mechanism. When the invention is used for carrying out simulation experiments on fire disasters of the electrified wires, the replacement of the electrified wires for experiments is not needed manually, the operation is simple, and the improvement of the experiment efficiency is facilitated.

title_en: Intelligent guiding system and method combined with digital signage
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent guiding system and method combined with a digital signage, and belongs to the technical field of accident emergency treatment. The system comprises a perception terminal, a computing terminal and a guiding module. The perception terminal is used for collecting evacuation data in the digital twin factory. The guiding module establishes connection with a plurality of digital signage and controls the change of the display content thereof. The computing terminal evaluates road safety indexes related to the evacuation routes based on the evacuation data sent by the sensing terminal and plans a plurality of evacuation routes. The guiding module displays a plurality of evacuation routes in the form of digital signage according to the road safety index provided by the computing terminal and the current position of the trapped person. Based on the virtual reality technology, the invention utilizes an intelligent algorithm and a perception terminal to acquire the information of the related environment and crowd, thereby providing the guided optimal route. According to the invention, various guiding route information is displayed through the digital signage of the virtual scene, so that people are guided to evacuate rapidly, and evacuation efficiency and security are improved.

title_en: Hydrologic forecasting method for intelligent classification
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent classification hydrologic forecasting method, which comprises the following steps: and (3) forecasting factor determination: selecting an influence factor as a forecasting factor, and constructing a model input-output data set by taking the current flow as a forecasting value; clustering forecasting factors: adopting a K-means method to cluster forecasting factors, selecting an optimal initial cluster center by using a self-adaptive collaborative search algorithm, dividing all samples into K categories, and constructing a classification forecasting model: and constructing K forecasting models by using the intelligent forecasting models for the model training set, selecting model parameters by using a self-adaptive cooperation search algorithm by taking the opposite numbers of Nash coefficients of various forecasting results as an objective function, obtaining K types of optimal models, and selecting the corresponding types of optimal models for the test set to finish classification forecasting. The method provided by the invention combines the advantages of a physical mechanism and an intelligent forecasting model, can effectively improve the runoff forecasting precision, and is beneficial to the technical development of flood disaster forecasting and early warning in the river basin and the efficient utilization of water resources.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Emergency response capability assessment method of service system and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency response capability assessment method of a service system and related equipment thereof, belonging to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of a service system when fault exercise is performed; determining an evaluation standard of a preset evaluation index based on fault types of different faults injected into the service system during fault exercise; and (3) evaluating the operation data of the service system under the fault types of different faults by adopting objective evaluation indexes, namely evaluating the emergency capacity of the service system to obtain an emergency capacity evaluation result. The accuracy of the result is not affected by subjective judgment, error judgment and the like, and the accuracy of the emergency response capability assessment of the service system can be improved.

title_en: Short-vertical-distance shallow-layer long-distance horizontal drilling grouting water control equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short vertical distance shallow layer long distance horizontal drilling grouting water control device and a method, which relate to the technical field of grouting water control and comprise the following contents: preparing for hole opening: when the drilling is carried out, the ground is firstly carried out on the hole opening area, after the compaction is finished, the inclined shaft machine is arranged to enter, after the inclined shaft machine enters, the included angle between the inclined shaft machine and the operation surface is firstly adjusted, the angle is ensured to be 30-45 degrees, after the inclined shaft machine is determined to be opened to a designated place, the final point position fine adjustment is carried out, the horizontal inclined shaft drilling technology is combined with the directional drilling technology, the exploration and summarization of various drilling parameters are carried out through the recombination of drilling tools, the difficult problem of building long-distance horizontal hole grouting holes in a short vertical distance environment is realized, and the drilling device can be used for industries such as building cross-ground entity hole making and sinking reduction, ground disaster treatment in narrow conditions, rock-soil body reinforcement and the like.
assignees: KAILUAN CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;SHAANXI TAIHE INTELLIGENT DRILLING CO LTD

title_en: Model for fire-fighting training
abstract_en: The utility model provides a model for firefighting training, and particularly relates to the technical field of firefighting equipment. The model for firefighting training comprises: the stand and strutting arrangement, the top of stand rotates and is connected with rotatory backup pad, rotatory backup pad's top peg graft has strutting arrangement, strutting arrangement's inside swing joint has multiunit training wood, training wood passes strutting arrangement and extends to rotatory backup pad's surface, multiunit recess has been seted up on rotatory backup pad's surface, the size of recess is greater than the size of training wood. According to the utility model, the training wood can fall from the groove, the rotary supporting plate is reset, and new training wood is reinserted, so that the training wood can be quickly replaced, a firefighter can repeatedly perform related training, and the firefighter can quickly master how to cut the tree by using the firefighter axe.
assignees: WUHAN DIANFANG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster-source ore deposit safe exploitation directional drilling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-disaster-source ore deposit safe exploitation directional drilling device which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a side plate close to the side wall, the opposite surface of the side plate is rotatably connected with a rotating plate for adjusting the angle of a whole drilling mechanism, the top of the rotating plate is fixedly connected with an adjusting mechanism, the adjusting mechanism comprises a driving motor, the end face of a driving shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a screw rod, the outer wall of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a sliding plate, the top of the sliding plate is fixedly connected with a drilling motor, and the end face of the driving shaft of the drilling motor is fixedly connected with a drilling head. According to the utility model, the rotating assembly is arranged at the bottom of the drilling hole, so that the angle of the drilling hole mechanism can be adjusted, directional drilling holes can be conveniently formed, and meanwhile, the protective cover is arranged outside the drilling hole mechanism, so that dust generated during drilling holes can be protected, and the neatness of the internal drilling hole mechanism is ensured.
assignees: SHANDONG ANSHI GREEN MINING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Geometric method for quickly positioning spontaneous combustion high-temperature area of goaf coal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geometric method for quickly positioning a spontaneous combustion high-temperature region of goaf coal, which comprises the following steps: step 1: firstly, constructing a plurality of temperature measurement drilling holes parallel to a coal mining working face on an oxidation zone of a goaf, and determining two temperature measurement points with the same temperature, wherein the two temperature measurement points are respectively marked as a point A and a point B; step 2: and constructing a plurality of same-layer drilling holes on a middle vertical line between the A, B two temperature measuring points, finding out the temperature measuring point with the same temperature as the temperature of the two temperature measuring points of the point A and the point B, and recording as the point C. The beneficial effects are that: according to the invention, the temperature distribution map of the isothermal layer of the goaf of the coal mine is obtained based on the geometric method, the distribution of the spontaneous combustion high-temperature area of the coal in the goaf can be rapidly determined, and the precise division of the spontaneous combustion dangerous area of the coal is realized, so that the spontaneous combustion disaster of the coal is favorably managed, and the safe production of the coal mine is ensured.

title_en: Electrocardiogram-based fatigue prediction method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrocardio-based fatigue prediction method, an electrocardio-based fatigue prediction device and a storage medium, which are applied to the technical field of fatigue state detection and comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining subjective and objective data of a firefighter through simulating training movements of the firefighter, obtaining a grading threshold table under an optimal clustering number through clustering analysis of the subjective data, obtaining weights of all subjective features through weight analysis of the subjective data, establishing a fatigue index F based on the weights of the subjective features, obtaining time domain, frequency domain and nonlinear indexes through heart rate variability analysis of the objective data, establishing a model, training the model by taking the time domain, the frequency domain and the nonlinear indexes as inputs of the model, and obtaining a fatigue prediction model by taking the fatigue index F as outputs of the model.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY SAFETY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;BEIJING INST PETROCHEM TECH;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING

title_en: ICSA-CNN-based coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine dynamic disaster prediction, in particular to a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction method based on ICSA-CNN. Firstly, acquiring influence index data of a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster, and identifying and eliminating abnormal data by using an isolated forest method iForest; RF is selected as an estimator of a chained multiple interpolation method MICE to interpolate the missing data; then, an initial model framework of a convolutional neural network CNN is built, a Tent chaotic mapping improved crow searching algorithm CSA is used for obtaining ICSA, and super parameters of the model are optimized, so that prediction accuracy is improved; and finally, training a model, establishing a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction model based on ICSA-CNN, and verifying the model accuracy by using a test set. The invention combines the superior optimizing capability of ICSA with the strong characteristic learning capability of CNN, and can realize the accurate prediction of the coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster.

title_en: Method for rapidly predicting river basin and urban flood process based on comprehensive unit line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly estimating river basin and urban flood process based on a comprehensive unit line, which comprises the following steps: acquiring rainfall and underlying surface parameters of a target area, wherein the rainfall is derived from information such as rainfall station observation, numerical weather forecast, radar inversion and the like; calculating the direct runoff of the river basin and the direct runoff of the urban area based on the rainfall of the target area and the parameters of the underlying surface; calculating an area standard unit line according to the underlying surface parameters of the target area; and calculating a flood process line according to the direct runoff and the regional standard unit line, and completing the estimation of the river basin and urban flood process after the basic flow process is overlapped. The method provided by the invention can be used for rapidly simulating the flood process of the river basin and the urban area, and the method provided by the invention considers the gradient, the water impermeability and the like of the area, has simple and effective required parameters, does not need complicated modeling and a large amount of computation resources, and provides a new support for carrying out flood disaster early warning and forecasting in the data-lacking city and the medium-small river.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;FUJIAN PROVINCIAL WATER CONSERVANCY & HYDROPOWER SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Critical rainfall determining method based on BO-SVM algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster research, and discloses a critical rainfall determining method based on a BO-SVM algorithm, which comprises the following steps of determining warning flow: and according to the on-site investigation, determining the disaster-preventing water level and the warning flow of the disaster-preventing object. According to the invention, the disaster-preventing object disaster-forming water level and the warning flow are determined according to the on-site investigation; inputting actually measured rainfall data into an HEC-HMS hydrological model for yield convergence calculation, and selecting occasions with simulated flood peak flow larger than warning flow as super-warning occasions and occasions with simulated flood peak flow smaller than warning flow as non-super-warning occasions; selecting a rainfall process 24 hours before a flood peak in the simulated runoff data, and determining the accumulated rainfall in the maximum period; determining a rainfall capacity influenced by a front period before the initial moment of a period and a rainfall peak position coefficient before a flood peak; based on a BO-SVM algorithm, the linear relation of accumulated rainfall, earlier-stage influence rainfall and rainpeak position coefficient of a period is constructed by taking the super-alert and non-super-alert as discrimination conditions, and a critical rainfall optimal plane is identified.

title_en: Debris flow disaster vulnerability prediction method based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a debris flow disaster vulnerability prediction method based on a deep neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring mud-rock flow cataloging data of a preset area, and acquiring a training set and a testing set according to the mud-rock flow cataloging data; based on the training set, integrating a convolutional neural network and a cyclic neural network which are built in advance by a Stacking integration method, and building a deep neural network prediction model; the method comprises the steps of inputting a test set into a deep neural network prediction model to obtain a predicted result of the debris flow disaster vulnerability in a preset area, combining a convolutional neural network and a cyclic neural network through a Stacking integration method to obtain a more accurate deep neural network prediction model, wherein the deep neural network prediction model has better generalization capability and higher prediction precision, and the Stacking integration method can obtain a more reliable predicted result of the debris flow disaster vulnerability when modeling is performed by using extremely limited samples, and shows better performance in time consumption and accuracy.

title_en: Stratum pregnancy disaster digital twin perception identification system
abstract_en: The invention provides a stratum pregnancy and disaster digital twin perception identification system, which belongs to the technical field of stratum analysis and comprises a plurality of main pipes drilled in the center position of a calibration area and a plurality of secondary pipes drilled in the position which is separated from the main pipes by a certain distance. And feeding the information related to the transmitter and the receiver back to the upper computer in real time, and presuming the specific position and the specific range of the stratum defect area by changing the positions and the angles of the transmitter and the receiver and reinforcing the defect area on the ground. The gas replacement and material data transmission are realized through the main pipe and the secondary pipe, and when an accident occurs, the transmitter is taken out from the main pipe and personnel rescue is carried out. The stratum pregnancy digital twin perception identification system provided by the invention can be used for fully detecting the stratum, so that the replacement of gas and the transmission of material data are realized, the integration level of the whole system is improved, the construction safety is improved, and the stable construction is ensured.

title_en: Disaster recovery cooperative exercise data processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster recovery cooperative drilling data processing method and device, and relates to the technical field of disaster recovery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving disaster recovery cooperative exercise signaling which carries disaster scene information; determining corresponding disaster backup cooperative exercise configuration data according to disaster scene information; inputting disaster recovery cooperative exercise configuration data into a configuration vocabulary extraction model, and determining flow configuration vocabularies and personnel configuration vocabularies in the disaster recovery cooperative exercise configuration data; configuring task information of each node of the disaster recovery cooperative exercise process and exercise personnel information of each node according to the process configuration vocabulary and personnel configuration vocabulary in the disaster recovery cooperative exercise configuration data to generate a disaster recovery cooperative exercise command view, and displaying the disaster recovery cooperative exercise command view to exercise personnel terminals of each node; after the disaster recovery cooperative exercise is finished, generating a disaster recovery cooperative exercise report according to the processing state of each node task of the disaster recovery cooperative exercise flow and exercise personnel information of each node.

title_en: Aviation Internet all-link monitoring and alarming system based on grafana
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aviation Internet all-link monitoring and alarming, in particular to an aviation Internet all-link monitoring and alarming system based on grafana. The invention relates to an aviation Internet all-link monitoring alarm system based on grafana, which comprises an alarm collection module, an alarm notification module, an alarm processing module, a disaster recovery and fault recovery module, a data acquisition module, a data display module based on grafana visualization function, an alarm setting module, a database, a data analysis and visualization tool, a user authority management module, a report module, a fault exercise and simulation module, an automatic operation and maintenance support module, an SLA monitoring and report module, a fault tolerance and disaster backup support module, a multi-cluster management module and an expansion module.

title_en: Anchor rod reinforcing structure for side slope and anchoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power engineering structural design, in particular to an anchor rod reinforcing structure for a side slope and an anchoring method, comprising a reinforcing mechanism, a cutting assembly and a tray, wherein the reinforcing mechanism comprises an anchor rod, the cutting assembly is arranged on the anchor rod, and the tray is sleeved on the anchor rod; the cutting assembly comprises a drill bit and a spiral blade, the drill bit and the spiral blade are driven to drill holes and ream holes on a side slope through rotation of an anchor rod, stepped holes are formed, the anchor rod generates radial expansion characteristics and axial return-to-straight deformation through relative sliding of a cone body and a sleeve, and further large constant resistance is generated, the sleeve is enabled to have double functions of circumferential expansion and radial extension through a negative Poisson ratio structural effect, the requirement of large deformation can be met, the anchoring effect of the anchor rod can be greatly improved, the stability of a foundation of a power transmission tower is protected, and further various rock-soil body geological disasters of the side slope of the foundation of the power transmission tower are prevented and treated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: System, method and device for monitoring and early warning and identifying scouring of offshore wind power foundation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system, a method and a device for monitoring and early-warning and identifying basic scouring of offshore wind power, wherein a data processing and training module trains an acquired data set of preset scouring early-warning level and an acquired data set of historical scouring measurement by utilizing feature matching and a preset circulating neural network algorithm to obtain a target circulating neural network model; when a scouring disaster occurs, the target cyclic neural network model can be directly utilized in the monitoring and early-warning recognition module to monitor and recognize the current scouring condition, and the scouring early-warning grade is obtained. Therefore, by implementing the invention, the influence mechanism of the horizontal cyclic load of the pile body on pile foundation flushing is fully considered, and the flushing condition of the offshore wind turbine foundation can be known more timely, accurately and reliably; different flushing grades can be identified quickly, accurately and reliably, loss caused by flushing can be effectively prevented according to the identification result, and technical support is provided for fan operation safety and maintenance.
assignees: THREE GORGES INTERNATIONAL ENERGY INVEST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for realizing earthquake early warning simulation based on earthquake table network and WEBGL
abstract_en: A method for realizing earthquake early warning simulation based on an earthquake table network and WEBGL comprises the following steps: s100, acquiring seismic platform network data, monitoring station data and three-dimensional geologic body modeling data; s200, constructing a three-dimensional geologic body model according to a preset rule according to the acquired three-dimensional geologic body modeling data; s300, acquiring a seismic surface wave and a bulk wave result according to the acquired seismic station network data and the monitoring station data; s400, combining the obtained seismic surface wave and bulk wave results with the construction of a three-dimensional geologic body model to achieve the effect of simulating seismic wave propagation. According to the method, based on the combination of the Chinese seismic platform network monitoring data and WEBGL, comprehensive calculation analysis is carried out according to the stratum structure and medium attribute in the acquisition area and the detection data returned by the monitoring station terminal, the diffusion rate and the diffusion distance of the seismic point surface wave and the body wave are calculated respectively through a built-in calculation formula, the real-time seismic position and the diffusion range are finally displayed, and early warning and reference are provided for the earthquake prevention, control and disaster relief work of the area.
assignees: WUHAN ZHIBO CHUANGXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bluetooth signal attenuation test method for firefighting cooling suit
abstract_en: The invention provides a Bluetooth signal attenuation test method for a firefighting cooling garment, which belongs to the technical field of firefighting cooling garment performance detection and comprises the following steps: step S01, setting an experimental environment; step S02, starting a frequency spectrograph and setting a frequency band of the frequency spectrograph; s03, fixing the firefighter uniform and the Bluetooth module on a fixed rotating device; step S04, a computer control Bluetooth module transmits a broadcast signal; step S05, repeating the step S04, executing n times, wherein n is a positive integer greater than 1, and recording the maximum value of the broadcast signal intensity of the spectrometer as X  1  Etc. The invention adopts 3 parameters of the average value, the standard deviation and the maximum signal difference of the attenuation degree to comprehensively and quantitatively represent the Bluetooth signal attenuation of the firefighting cooling garmentThe test method simulates the use environment, and the result reliability is high.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Grid-based multi-dimensional visualization expression method for each disaster management situatation
title_ko: 격자 기반 재난 관리 상황별 다차원 시각화 표출 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a visualization display method of disaster management information. The present invention can generate a grid-based disaster risk map resulting from fusing, combining, and visualizing a variety of information on disasters by using disaster risk-related data and space information, and provide multi-dimensional analysis for disaster risks by using the disaster risk map divided into administrative district units through preprocessing. Also, the present invention can visually check disaster risk classes by administrative district, disaster risk simulation results by situation, and current disaster situations through a map service and a situation report service, and comprehensively identify information for disaster situation management of various forms to support quick decision making for responding to disasters.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 관리 정보의 시각화 표출 방법에 관한 것이다.  본 발명은 재난 위험 관련 데이터 및 공간 정보를 이용하여 재난에 대한 다양한 정보를 융·복합하고 시각화한 격자 기반의 재난 위험 지도를 생성하며, 전처리를 통해 행정구역 단위로 분할된 재난 위험 지도를 활용하여 재난 위험에 대한 다차원적인 분석을 제공할 수 있다.  또한, 본 발명은 지도 서비스 및 상황 리포트 서비스를 통해 행정구역별 재난 위험 등급, 상황별 재난 위험 시뮬레이션 결과, 및 재난 현황 등을 시각적으로 확인할 수 있도록 하고, 다양한 형태의 재난 상황 관리를 위한 정보를 종합적으로 파악하여 재난 대응을 위한 신속한 의사 결정을 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for predicting a coastal disaster through virtual typhoons
title_ko: 가상 태풍을 통한 해안 재난 예측 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for predicting a coastal disaster using a virtual typhoon and a system for the same. The method for predicting a coastal disaster using a virtual typhoon collects and analyzes information on a typhoon that occurred in the past and selects a virtual typhoon generation algorithm suitable for storm surge prediction around the Korean Peninsula based on an analyzed result. The method for predicting a coastal disaster using a virtual typhoon also generates the virtual typhoon which may occur in the periphery of the Korean Peninsula using the selected virtual typhoon generation algorithm and predicts a coastal disaster using the generated virtual typhoon. The disclosed method for predicting a coastal disaster using a virtual typhoon includes: a step (a) in which a collection unit collects typhoon information about typhoon which occurred in the past; a step (b) in which an analysis unit analyzes the collected typhoon information according to a moving route, intensity, size, and an occurrence range; a step (c) in which a classification unit classifies the analyzed typhoon information according to a wind speed and atmospheric pressure; a step (d) in which a selection unit selects the virtual typhoon generation algorithm based on the analyzed typhoon information and the classified typhoon information; a step (e) in which a generation unit generates a typhoon virtual scenario and the virtual typhoon which may occur in the Korean Peninsula by using the selected virtual typhoon generation algorithm; and a step (f) in which a prediction unit predicts the coastal disaster which may occur in the Korean Peninsula using the generated virtual typhoon.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 과거에 발생했던 태풍의 정보를 수집하여 분석하고, 분석된 결과에 근거해 한반도 주변 폭풍해일 예측에 적합한 가상태풍 생성 알고리즘을 선정하고, 선정된 가상태풍 생성 알고리즘을 이용해 한반도 주변에 발생 가능한 가상 태풍을 생성한 후 생성된 가상 태풍을 통해 해안 재난을 예측할 수 있도록 하는, 가상 태풍을 통한 해안 재난 예측 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 
개시된 가상태풍을 통한 해안 재난 예측 방법은, (a) 상기 수집부에서 과거에 발생한 태풍에 대한 태풍 정보를 수집하는 단계; (b) 상기 분석부에서 상기 수집된 태풍 정보를 이동경로, 강도, 크기 및 발생 범위에 따라 분석하는 단계; (c) 상기 분류부에서 상기 분석된 태풍 정보를 풍속 및 기압에 따라 분류하는 단계; (d) 상기 선정부가 상기 분석된 태풍 정보와 상기 분류된 태풍 정보에 근거해 가상 태풍 생성 알고리즘을 선정하는 단계; (e) 상기 생성부가 상기 선정된 가상 태풍 생성 알고리즘을 통하여 한반도에 발생 가능한 태풍 가상시나리오 및 가상 태풍을 생성하는 단계; 및 (f) 상기 예측부가 상기 생성된 가상 태풍을 통해 한반도에 발생 가능한 해안 재난을 예측하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-demand-point environment emergency material allocation method based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-demand-point environment emergency material allocation method based on a complex network. The invention relates to the field of environmental system simulation prediction technology and computer technology, and the invention establishes a threat degree evaluation index system for sudden chemical water pollution events to evaluate the influence of the sudden chemical water pollution events on the environment; determining a weight value of a threat degree evaluation index of the sudden chemical water pollution event, establishing a threat degree standardization partition, and when the sudden chemical water pollution event occurs, weighing importance degree between emergency response time and system allocation cost according to the threat degree of the sudden chemical water pollution event by an emergency material allocation decision; and (3) dispatching and optimizing the multi-demand-point environment emergency materials based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and dispatching the multi-demand-point environment emergency materials.

title_en: Combined treatment method for coal mine tunnel floor heave and floor sandstone bearing water disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a combined treatment method for coal mine tunnel floor heave and floor sandstone bearing water damage, and relates to the field of coal mine tunnel floor water damage prevention and control. The method comprises the following steps: drilling from a roadway of a preparation face adjacent to the stope face to a goaf face prior to stope: drilling an upper drain hole along the top interface of the aquifer, and drilling a freezing hole along the aquifer by presetting a first distance below the upper drain hole; an upper drain pipe is arranged in the upper drain hole, and the water-bearing layer is subjected to drainage through the upper drain pipe; a freezing pipe is arranged in the freezing hole, and after the freezing pipe is connected with a freezing device, the aquifer is frozen. The method can start construction after the roadway of the prepared working surface is formed, and a part of water in the water-containing layer below the stoping working surface can be dredged through the construction of the upper drainage hole; through the construction freezing hole, can form hard water barrier at the aquifer to solve the problem of bottom plate water burst and tunnel floor heave, can also reduce stope working face temperature.
assignees: HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Method for analyzing enhancement mechanism of land water circulation in dry and wet areas and identifying warming signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enhancement mechanism analysis and warming signal identification method for land water circulation in a dry and wet area, which utilizes observation data to identify the arid area and the wet area in the global scope; quantifying the historical and future precipitation increase rates of the dry and wet areas by utilizing data of the historical different external force tests of the CMIP6 and the future different socioeconomic development path simulation tests; calculating the local warming rate of the dry and wet area and the response rate of precipitation to warming, and exploring the difference of the water vapor content and the increasing rate of water vapor transmission in the dry and wet area under the influence of warming; adopting rotational experience orthogonal decomposition, identifying a fingerprint mode of the increase of the rainfall in the dry and wet areas to the global warming response, and calculating the possibility of quantifying the warming signals in the dry and wet areas by the signal-to-noise ratio; and detecting different external forcing signals in the precipitation change of the dry and wet areas by adopting an optimal fingerprint method, and quantifying the change amount of precipitation increase caused by different external forcing. The invention is helpful to deepen the understanding of global land water circulation and provides scientific basis for making disaster prevention and reduction decisions in dry and wet areas.

title_en: Reinforced concrete member impact resistance protection design and disaster assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of impact resistance evaluation of civil engineering, and particularly discloses an impact resistance protection design and disaster evaluation method for reinforced concrete members; the method is based on a machine learning algorithm, and a rapid and reliable method for predicting and evaluating the impact resistance of the RC component is established by adopting the damage mode of the RC component after impact as an index. Through fully using the existing historical test data, a large number of time-consuming and labor-consuming model tests and simulation with higher technical requirements are avoided, the impact resistance of the RC component can be evaluated more quickly and accurately, and the interpretable impact damage classification model developed by the invention is a new effective supporting tool, can be used as a prediction tool in actual design for predicting local damage of the RC panel under the impact load of a large-caliber projectile, and is particularly used for designers and engineers to evaluate the damage mode of the reinforced concrete slab under the impact load quickly in an initial design stage.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for evaluating vulnerability of power CPS under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evaluating electric power CPS vulnerability under typhoon disasters, wherein the method is based on typhoon historical record data, obtains typhoon occurrence frequency by adopting stable poisson distribution, adopts a line cutting model to fit typhoon paths, simulates typhoon disaster areas by a simulated circle method, and determines states of communication nodes and power grid observable domains according to power supply and monitoring coupling relations between power grids and communication networks under cascading faults caused by typhoon disasters so as to obtain working states of electric power lines. And (3) considering the processing method of the overload of the power line under different working states of the power line, updating the power flow distribution of the power grid, and calculating the load loss rate of the power CPS to quantify the vulnerability of the system. The method and the device fully consider the coupling relation of power supply and monitoring between the power and the communication network, the cascade fault process of the power CPS under typhoon disasters, the vulnerability assessment of the power CPS after the disaster is accurately simulated, and the safe and reliable operation of the power system is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for determining reinforcement scheme of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining a power transmission line reinforcement scheme, which relate to the technical field of power system safety and mainly solve the problem of how to improve the economy of the power transmission line reinforcement scheme on the premise of meeting the elastic requirement of a power transmission network under disasters, and comprise the steps of obtaining historical typhoons related parameters and power transmission network related parameters to simulate the condition of each power transmission line in the power transmission network affected by typhoons so as to obtain a plurality of historical fault scenes; determining a set of frangible lines in the power transmission grid based on the historical fault scenario; performing cluster analysis on a plurality of historical fault scenes to obtain a plurality of typical fault scenes; training the constructed power grid elasticity assessment model based on the vulnerable line set and the plurality of typical fault scenes to obtain a trained power grid elasticity assessment model; and determining a reinforcement scheme of the power transmission network from the fragile line based on the typhoon related parameters to be analyzed and the power grid elasticity evaluation model.
assignees: EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method, a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning device, electronic equipment and a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning medium, and relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster research, wherein the mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method comprises the following steps: simulating a flood process based on a hydrologic model to obtain flood occurrence occasions in a research period, and acquiring soil humidity data and rainfall data corresponding to each flood occurrence occasion; calculating the uncertainty of rainfall input corresponding to each flood occurrence according to the rainfall data corresponding to each flood occurrence; calculating uncertainty of a hydrologic model according to the uncertainty of rainfall input corresponding to each flood occurrence, and calculating uncertainty of early warning critical rainfall according to the uncertainty of rainfall input and the uncertainty of the hydrologic model; calculating the coupling uncertainty under each risk level according to the uncertainty of the early warning critical rainfall; and carrying out early warning on the mountain torrent disaster risk according to the coupling uncertainty under each risk level. The method greatly improves the accuracy of mountain torrent disaster early warning.

title_en: Road collapse disaster deduction simulation method based on CFD-DEM and FEM combined algorithm
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a road collapse disaster deduction simulation method based on a CFD-DEM and FEM combined algorithm, and relates to the technical field of urban road collapse analysis and prediction treatment. The method is convenient for realizing deduction and simulation of urban road collapse disasters, and provides basis for realizing collapse prediction and treatment of urban roads with similar or same geological environment and soil body mechanical parameters. Comprising the following steps: obtaining geological environment and soil parameters according to the road collapse case, and calculating microscopic parameters; establishing a three-dimensional pipeline model and a flow field model in the CFD module; establishing a three-dimensional discrete element particle model in a DEM module; realizing the bidirectional fluid-solid coupling of the CFD module and the DEM module, and establishing a bidirectional fluid-solid coupling model; simulating the sinking process of soil around the damaged pipeline by using a bidirectional fluid-solid coupling model; and applying loads to different soil models at the FEM module, simulating external actions, and calculating the moulding damage of the soil. The method is suitable for road subsidence analysis, prediction and prevention engineering.

title_en: Automatic extraction method of geological disaster slope unit
abstract_en: The automatic extraction method of the geological disaster slope unit provided by the invention comprises the following steps: step S1, a slope unit training data set is initially established based on a slope unit extraction method of forward and reverse DEM hydrologic process analysis, and a primary slope unit training data set is obtained; s2, correcting and optimizing the primary slope unit training data set, and establishing a slope unit training data set; s3, establishing a slope unit extraction model based on deep learning based on an Xattention algorithm; s4, training the slope unit extraction model based on the deep learning by using the slope unit training data set; and S5, extracting the non-parametric slope unit by using the trained deep learning model. The precision and generalization capability of the slope unit extraction are improved, the influence of manual setting is reduced, the application complexity of the slope unit extraction is reduced, the workload is further reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.
assignees: XIAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY NORTHWEST GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOV

title_en: Fire simulating device generating flame on the surface of water
title_ko: 수면에서 화염을 발생시키는 화재 상황 재현장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire simulation device which generates flames on a water surface. More specifically, the fire simulation device creates flames by igniting combustible and flammable fluids discharged onto the water surface through underwater spray means, simulates a fire situation, and allows the spray means to be located underwater, thereby reducing various damages caused by heat. Furthermore, the fire simulation device prevents various firefighting agents used in fire training from directly contacting the spray means, thereby removing contamination and malfunction of the spray means. Moreover, the fire simulation device can be efficiently maintained even if only water in a water tank is replaced, enhancing maintenance management efficiency and reducing maintenance time. Additionally, the fire simulation device allows for customization according to the test conditions specified by a client without requiring dedicated equipment for each test object, thus improving testing efficiency. Furthermore, the fire simulation device transfers ignition heat to an ignition device when combustible and flammable fluids discharged from the spray means installed underwater is ignited on the water surface so that the ignition device can efficiently operate even in humid conditions.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수면에서 화염을 발생시키는 화재 상황 재현장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 수중에 설치된 분사수단을 통해 배출되는 발화·인화성 유체를 수면에서 점화시켜 화염을 발생시키고 이를 통해 화재 상황을 재현함으로써, 분사수단이 수중에 위치됨에 따라 열에 의한 각종 데미지(damage)를 감소시킬 수 있도록 하고, 또한 화재 상황에 대한 훈련시 사용하는 각종 소화용제가 분사수단과 직접 접촉하지 않아 분사수단의 오염 및 고장 문제를 해결할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 이로 인해 수조 내의 물만 교체하더라도 장치가 효율적으로 유지 되는 등 정비 관리의 효율성을 향상시키고 정비 작업 시간을 단축시킬 수 있도록 하며, 아울러 시험대상물 별로 각각의 전용 장비를 사용하지 않더라도 시험 의뢰자의 의뢰 조건에 따른 커스터마이징(customizing)이 가능하여 시험 효율을 향상시킬 수 있도록 하고, 더욱이 상기와 같이 수중에 설치된 분사수단을 통해 배출되는 발화·인화성 유체를 수면에서 점화시킴에 있어 점화열을 점화장치에 전달하여 상기 점화장치가 습윤상황에서도 효율적으로 작동될 수 있도록 하는, 수면에서 화염을 발생시키는 화재 상황 재현장치에 관한 것이다.
assignees: ALLBE SOLUTION CO LTD;LEE KI WOO

title_en: Simulation and Prediction technology of Intergrated Operation/Contorl Platform for Biogas plant base on A.I.
title_ko: 인공지능기반의 통합운영관리플랫폼 예측 및 시뮬레이션 기술
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated operation management platform simulation and prediction technology based on an artificial intelligence wherein an objective is to provide a prediction and simulation technology for optimizing production and production efficiency by using an anaerobic digester facility operation simulation technology through artificial intelligence analysis so as to prevent an accident and a disaster in a biogas plant and predicting next day figure change of biogas production factor (production volume, yield) and major measurement factor (VFA, Alk, VFA/Alk) that affect production efficiency through prediction analysis for a main operating factor of the anaerobic digester.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바이오가스플랜트에서 사고 및 재난의 발생을 예방할 수 있도록 인공지능 분석을 통한 혐기성 소화조 설비운영 시뮬레이션 기술을 이용하며, 또한 혐기성 소화조의 주요 운영인자에 대한 예측 분석을 통해 바이오가스 생산인자(생산량, 수율) 및 생산효율에 영향을 주는 주요 계측인자(VFA, Alk, VFA/Alk)의 익일 수치 변화를 예측하여 생산 및 생산효율을 최적화 하기 위한 예측 및 시뮬레이션 기술을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 하는 인공지능 기반의 통합운영관리플랫폼 시뮬레이션 및 예측 기술에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Extended reality-based education and training system having an actual equipment linkage function and education and training method using the same
title_ko: 실장비 연동기능이 구비된 확장 현실 기반의 교육 훈련시스템 및 그것을  이용한 교육 훈련 방법
abstract_en: Provided in the present invention are: an extended reality-based education and training system, in which an actual equipment linkage function that will allow for extended reality-based firing procedures training capabilities, firing class/trainee-specific training capabilities through multiple access, instructor training oversight capabilities through the training control system, and learning-to-fire capabilities for inexperienced proficiency training is equipped through a training and education system that includes a fire command and control system implemented in a realistic environment; and an education and training method using the same. The present invention comprises: an instructor's kit for setting up training scenarios and controlling exercises; a training server that processes and stores training status data while interfacing with the above instructor equipment; a trainee equipment that is connected to the above training server to execute training according to training procedures or programs provided by the instructor equipment and formed into an environment similar to the actual equipment for the trainee to board and execute the training; and a fire command and control equipment that is connected to the training server through socket communication or wired or wireless communication network and transmits fire command and control commands that are interlocked with real equipment to the training server for execution.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실제와 유사한 환경으로 구현된 사격 지휘 통제 체계를 포함하는 교육 훈련 시스템을 통해, 확장 현실 기반 사격 절차 훈련 능력과, 다중 접속을 통한 발사 반/훈련생별 교육 훈련 능력과, 훈련 통제 시스템을 통한 교관의 훈련 총괄 능력과, 미숙련자 숙달 교육을 위한 학습 훈련 능력을 보유할 수 있도록 하는 실장비 연동기능이 구비된 확장 현실 기반의 교육 훈련 시스템 및 그것을 이용한 교육 훈련 방법을 제공한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명은 훈련 시나리오 설정 및 훈련 통제를 위한 교관용 장비와; 상기 교관용 장비와 연동하면서 훈련 상태 데이터를 처리 및 저장하는 훈련용 서버와; 상기 훈련용 서버와 연결되어 교관용 장비로부터 제공된 훈련 절차 혹은 프로그램에 따라 훈련을 실행하고 교육생이 탑승하여 훈련을 실행하도록 실제 장비와 유사한 환경으로 형성된 교육생 장비와; 상기 훈련용 서버에 소켓통신 혹은 유무선통신망을 통해 연결되어 실장비와 연동되는 사격지휘통제 명령을 훈련용서버로 전송하여 실행되게 하는 사격 지휘 통제 장비를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Digital twin-based fire evacuation simulation authoring device and operation method therefor
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 화재 대피 시뮬레이션 저작 장치 및 이를 위한 동작 방법
abstract_en: A method for a fire evacuation simulation authoring device based on a digital twin according to one embodiment of the present specification comprises: a step of generating digital twin information for a 3D space corresponding to a real building using a plurality of spatial object component libraries, and enabling digital twin information to be pre-adjusted according to one or more simulation options; a step of disposing a plurality of refugees in the 3D space using a plurality of refugee object components; a step of implementing a virtual fire situation at a specific location in the 3D space, and enabling, in the virtual fire situation, to reflect whether heat or smoke reaches according to a fire associated with the specific location and a preset spread speed; and a step of generating refugee route information for the plurality of refugees in the 3D space, and enabling the refugee route information to indicate a detour evacuation route determined according to a virtual fire situation and one or more simulation options from among one or more shortest evacuation routes derived in the 3D space. Therefore, the present invention is capable of maximizing an effectiveness of fire training.
abstract_ko: 본 명세서의 일 실시 예에 따른 디지털 트윈 기반 화재 대피 시뮬레이션 저작 장치를 위한 방법은, 복수의 공간 객체 컴포넌트 라이브러리를 이용하여 실제 건물에 상응하는 3D 공간을 위한 디지털 트윈 정보를 생성하되, 디지털 트윈 정보는 하나 이상의 시뮬레이션 옵션에 따라 미리 조정되는, 단계; 복수의 피난자 객체 컴포넌트를 이용하여 상기 3D 공간 상에 복수의 피난자(refugee)를 배치하는 단계; 3D 공간 상의 특정한 위치에 가상의 화재 상황을 구현하되, 가상의 화재 상황에는 상기 특정한 위치와 연관된 화재에 따른 열 또는 연기의 도달 여부 및 미리 설정된 확산 속도가 반영되는, 단계; 및 3D 공간 상에 상기 복수의 피난자를 위한 피난 경로 정보를 생성하되, 피난 경로 정보는 3D 공간 상에서 도출된 하나 이상의 최단 대피 경로 중에서 가상의 화재 상황 및 하나 이상의 시뮬레이션 옵션에 따라 결정된 우회 대피 경로를 지시하는, 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire disaster real-time detection method and system based on Faster RCNN
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire disaster real-time detection method and a fire disaster real-time detection system based on a fast RCNN, wherein the fire disaster real-time detection method comprises the following steps: (1) Acquiring a fire disaster video image and a video image when a fire disaster does not occur, and respectively marking and dividing the fire disaster video image and the video image when the fire disaster does not occur, so as to train and test; the fire disaster video image and the image when the fire disaster does not occur are combined for use in training and testing, and the sources are not distinguished; (2) Training and testing was performed on the annotated fire dataset through the Faster RCNN network, using ResNeXt-101 as a Backbone, using an SGD optimizer. The invention has the advantages that: the monitoring video is detected in real time by an artificial intelligence method, and the detection objects comprise flames and smoke in the initial stage of fire, so that the fire is found in time and automatically alarms, and the false detection and omission rate of fire detection are reduced.

title_en: Industrial fire risk early warning and analyzing method based on big data technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire protection early warning, in particular to an industrial fire protection risk early warning based on big data technology. According to the invention, the situation that the current chemical storage tank explodes is simulated through the evacuation evaluation model arranged in the computer, the optimal evacuation schematic diagram is drawn according to the explosion range, and the evacuation schematic diagram is broadcasted through the alarm system, so that people can evacuate through the optimal emergency channel, the harm caused by explosion is greatly reduced, and the casualties of people are reduced.
assignees: JIANGSU NANGONG TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent water conservancy dispatching optimization system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy management, in particular to an intelligent water conservancy dispatching optimization system which comprises a data acquisition and integration module, a water resource demand prediction module, a hydrological model optimization module, a water conservancy dispatching scheme generation module, a scheme simulation test module, a real-time dispatching execution module, a dispatching scheme evaluation module and an emergency response and management module. In the invention, the neural network prediction of the water resource demand prediction module improves the accuracy of water demand prediction, provides more reasonable input for a hydrological model, adopts a genetic algorithm and particle swarm optimization parameters to improve the model precision, and the water conservancy scheduling scheme generation module optimizes and considers cost, efficiency and sustainability in a multi-objective manner, formulates a comprehensive balancing scheme, simulates a scheme simulation test, reduces operation risks, and performs real-time data analysis in real time scheduling to ensure effective execution, improve the water resource management efficiency and sustainability and cope with the changes of demands and environments.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGKE CHAOYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based multi-target collaborative fire emergency treatment method for high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based multi-target collaborative fire emergency treatment method for a high-rise building, which belongs to the technical field of fire emergency of the high-rise building and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting building information data and fire scene information to establish a digital twin model of the building; s2, predicting the safe running time of the elevator by using a digital twin model of the building; s3, acquiring a rescue interval by utilizing the safe operation time of the elevator, and planning a rescue scheme according to the rescue interval; s4, acquiring the position information of the trapped crowd according to the rescue scheme, and coordinating the elevator by utilizing the position information of the trapped crowd to obtain the optimal firefighting emergency treatment scheme of the high-rise building. The digital twin model is utilized to simulate the situation of the high-rise building when the fire disaster occurs, so that the prediction of the fire disaster spreading situation is realized, an optimal treatment method is made through a prediction result, and the evacuation efficiency of trapped people in the high-rise building is increased; according to meeting conditions of trapped people on different floors, the elevator is matched with an emergency stair to evacuate.
assignees: GUANGDONG GUANGYU SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Artificial intelligence's emergent evacuation analysis system of track traffic
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rail transit emergency evacuation management, and particularly discloses an artificial intelligence rail transit emergency evacuation analysis system, which is characterized in that a space region of a subway station is divided into acquisition regions according to functional regions, and then people flow static characteristics and people flow dynamic characteristics are acquired for each acquisition region, so that people flow simulation of each acquisition region of the subway station is realized, the defect of single people flow simulation main body in the prior art is greatly avoided, the evacuation crowd coverage rate of the subway station is greatly improved, the comprehensive evacuation of people groups in the subway station is facilitated, the personnel evacuation requirement in the subway station is effectively met, meanwhile, the acquisition of the people flow static characteristics and the people flow dynamic characteristics enables the set people flow simulation initial conditions to be more comprehensive, the outbound walking characteristics of people are followed, the occurrence of deviation from actual conditions is greatly avoided, the rationality of simulation results is maximally improved, and high accuracy is ensured for evacuation route planning.

title_en: A simulation burner for fire control training
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulated combustion device for fire training, comprising: a simulated training room provided with a plurality of combustion devices; the gas chamber is provided with a combustible gas storage tank, a gas valve and a gas pipe, and one end of the gas pipe is connected with the combustible gas storage tank through the gas valve; the equipment room is provided with a water tank, a water pump, a water pipe, a carbon dioxide storage tank, an air valve and an air pipe; the training preparation chamber is provided with a smoke generator and a flue, and the smoke generator is connected into the simulation training chamber through the flue; the control room is provided with control equipment, and the control equipment is used for controlling the start and stop of the water pump, the on-off of the air valve, the start and stop of the smoke generator and the on-off of the gas valve. The device builds an environment close to a real fire scene in a simulation training room, thereby providing higher-quality fire training for trained firefighters. The training sites are arranged at any time and any place according to the needs, high-strength and high-frequency fire-fighting training is carried out, and the quick improvement of the fire-fighting skills of firefighters is facilitated.

title_en: Method and device for estimating buckling failure time of vertical ignition storage tank, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buckling failure time estimation method and device for a vertical type ignition storage tank, wherein the method comprises the following steps: A. carrying out structural modeling under a specific working condition, simulating a fire disaster of the storage tank, and obtaining heat radiation intensity and peripheral temperature distribution data of the storage tank by setting characteristic parameters of combustion media of the storage tank; B. taking the heat radiation intensity of the storage tank and the peripheral temperature distribution data as boundary conditions to obtain tank wall temperature distribution data; C. according to the tank wall temperature distribution data and the tank wall material attribute parameters, carrying out thermal buckling analysis and calculation of the storage tank, and further judging the critical temperature and time of buckling failure; D. and constructing a buckling failure time estimation model according to the buckling failure time data, different liquid levels of the storage tank combustion medium and storage tank size data, and estimating the buckling failure time of different types of storage tanks when the storage tank combustion medium is in fire by using the estimation model. The method can quickly calculate the buckling time so as to provide important data support for on-site emergency rescue.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RESEARCH INSTITUTE SAFETY ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Waste slag accumulation body side slope simulation test device
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of side slope simulation tests, and provides a side slope simulation test device for a waste slag accumulation body, which comprises a water supply tank, a river channel assembly, a side slope plate and a rainfall assembly, wherein a waste slag accumulation body model is placed on the side slope plate, and the angle of the waste slag accumulation body model is adjusted by rotating the side slope plate, so that the test condition of the waste slag accumulation body model under different slopes is simulated; the water supply tank is used for supplying water to the river channel assembly and the rainfall assembly, the rainfall assembly simulates a rainfall environment, and the river channel assembly simulates the toe scouring of the waste residue accumulation body model, so that the instability deformation damage characteristics of the waste residue accumulation body model with different slope rates when flood disasters with different degrees occur can be intuitively recorded, and relevant protective measures can be formulated conveniently.
assignees: ROAD & BRIDGE INT CO LTD;ROAD & BRIDGE SOUTH CHINA ENGINEERING CO LTD;GUANGXI GUILU HIGHWAY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent early warning emergency management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning, in particular to an intelligent early warning emergency management method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining online monitoring data; constructing an intelligent early warning analysis model based on a deep learning method; and obtaining an early warning analysis result according to the on-line monitoring data and by utilizing an intelligent early warning analysis model. According to the invention, the deep learning model is obtained after training the deep learning neural network, and after the model prediction process, the feature analysis of the monitoring data and the monitoring data can be realized, so that the early warning for a long time in advance can be realized, the accuracy is high, and the disaster can be effectively early warned in advance.
assignees: SHANDONG YIPIN CULTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation training method for underground safety production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation training method for underground safety production, and belongs to the technical field of simulation training. Step one: acquiring a working site image by using a camera, or scanning a two-dimensional code to acquire mining equipment information; step two: obtaining a marking module from a server, and comparing the marking module with a working site image or equipment information; step three: the data module is output to a three-dimensional engine through calculation of a server end, and coordinate anchoring is carried out on field images in the camera; step four: and displaying safety training and safety knowledge corresponding to the real scene, and carrying out safety education training on underground staff in advance. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the AR reality enhancement technology is utilized to carry out safety education training before entering the well on workers, the safety education training is more real and deep than the traditional safety education training, and compared with actual disaster simulation systems such as acousto-optic and electric systems, the cost is lower only through software simulation of disasters.

title_en: Mining disturbance surrounding rock bearing structure analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining disturbance surrounding rock bearing structure analysis method, and relates to the technical field of surrounding rock bearing. Comprising the following steps: establishing a roadway model by taking the collected roadway surrounding rock data and supporting structure data as an original data set, carrying out exploitation simulation, and simulating the roadway peripheral stress according to the simulated exploitation data to establish a roadway mechanical model; analyzing the range of the loose ring of the surrounding rock by combining the stress theory of the surrounding rock, dividing the range of the loose ring of the surrounding rock into different areas for numerical simulation research, obtaining an analysis result, and reinforcing the bearing structure of the surrounding rock according to the analysis result; and testing the surrounding rock to judge the rock mass reinforcement condition. The invention is helpful for expressing the rule of surrounding rock stress, prevents disasters from happening, and has more universality.
assignees: SANSHANDAO GOLD MINE SHANDONG GOLD MINING LAIZHOU CO LTD;BEIJING UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method and device for identifying weak links of power system based on improved BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying weak links of an electric power system based on an improved BP neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a line fault rate data set when a historical ice disaster occurs, and establishing a BPNN training model based on an HFAPSO algorithm; inputting the line fault rate data set into a BPNN training model for training, and taking the mean square error as an evaluation standard for evaluation to obtain a BPNN prediction model; inputting system data and future disaster data into a BPNN prediction model, and predicting the line fault rate in the system to obtain a prediction result; and calculating the importance degree of the load flowing through each line according to the prediction result, and calculating the weakness degree of each line to obtain the weak link of the system. The device comprises: a processor and a memory. The invention identifies the weak links of the system, and further adopts corresponding reinforcing measures for the weak links, thereby improving the safety and stability of the system.
assignees: STATE GRID JILINSHENG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV NORTHEAST DIANLI;JILIN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Multifunctional pipeline cleaning robot
