abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional pipeline cleaning robot which comprises a first shell, a second shell, a moving unit and a first cleaning unit. The moving unit is arranged on the two shells, and the first cleaning unit comprises a first rotary driving part, a first mounting seat, a cleaning plate and a crushing mechanism; the first rotary driving part is arranged in the first shell, and the first mounting seat is coaxially connected with the driving end of the first rotary driving part; the cleaning plates are uniformly arranged on the side wall of the first mounting seat; the crushing mechanism comprises a crushing drill bit assembly and a rotary shell; the rotary shell comprises a first table top and a second table top, and the first table top is coaxially connected with the driving end of the first rotary driving part; the crushing drill bit subassembly can rotate set up at the second mesa, and crushing drill bit subassembly includes first drill bit, and first drill bit sets up to the surface of auger structure, first drill bit is provided with spiral slot, is provided with the cosolvent in the spiral slot. The invention can be well adapted to the complex operation environment of the post-disaster pipeline by matching the units.

title_en: Slope instability prediction method and system based on big data analysis and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope instability prediction method and a system based on big data analysis and machine learning, wherein a historical slope disaster data set is obtained by the hierarchical assignment combination of a slope instability evaluation factor and a slope stability state; acquiring a slope disaster area data set from a historical slope disaster data set, and performing equalization processing on positive samples and negative samples in the slope disaster area data set to generate a slope instability prediction data set; selecting a plurality of classification learning prediction models to construct a slope instability prediction model, training the slope instability prediction model by using a slope instability prediction data set, and carrying out slope instability prediction by using the trained slope instability prediction model; therefore, influences of external factors such as environment and weather on landslide disasters are comprehensively considered in prediction of slope instability, and the integrated learning thought is utilized, so that the classification performance of the whole model is improved through combination of a plurality of classification learning prediction models, and the accuracy of prediction results and the robustness of the model are improved.

title_en: Flood peak evolution forecasting method based on rainfall and water level characteristic similarity analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood peak evolution prediction method based on rainfall and water level feature similarity analysis, which solves the problems that the current flood peak evolution prediction is mainly based on hydrodynamic and hydrologic model calculation, has high requirements on calculation force and algorithm, and can not well meet the requirement of rapid simulation calculation in actual flood control and disaster reduction work. Firstly, collecting and processing hydrological meteorological data in a flow field; dividing a river basin section and constructing a river basin flood peak transfer topological relation; secondly, analyzing and calculating historical hydrology and meteorological data characteristics of each section to form a database; thirdly, searching a historical flood field close to the current flood, and finally, carrying out flood peak evolution forecasting on a section-by-section basis on the basis of similar analysis of combination of historical rainfall and flood processes. The method is used for carrying out similarity analysis based on historical rainfall and flood data, is applied to flood peak evolution prediction, can simply and quickly realize dynamic simulation of flood peak evolution, and has great effect in practical application of flood control and disaster reduction work.

title_en: Experimental device and method for intelligent monitoring and cooperative control of wind network in coal mine catastrophe period
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device and method for intelligent monitoring and cooperative control of a wind network in a coal mine catastrophe period, comprising a wind path simulation assembly for simulating a down-hole ventilation network, an inflation module for introducing experimental gas into the wind path simulation assembly, a parameter monitoring module for collecting dynamic parameters of the experimental gas in the wind path simulation assembly, and a wind network control module for controlling the wind path simulation assembly according to the dynamic parameters. The wind path simulation assembly includes a plurality of adjustable length simulation pipes. The invention can simulate the disaster ventilation condition of an actual coal mine, can simulate the evolution condition of coal mine and gas after the disaster is prominent, collect experimental data of coal and gas disasters, and realize verification of the existing intelligent monitoring and cooperative control means in the disaster period.

title_en: Integrative car is planted to photovoltaic based on STM32 singlechip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic planting integrated vehicle based on an STM32 singlechip, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic planting integrated vehicles. The invention is provided with the metal support frame, the photovoltaic power supply control device, the water flushing motor device, the planting device and the moving device, can timely act on the disaster-affected sites of sand and dust in the northern area of China, can realize the functions of intelligent automatic motor water flushing, punching, seedling, spraying, hilling and the like, has simple and novel structure, can effectively solve the waste of water resources, reduces the influence of mechanical vibration and noise generated by the diesel drilling machine on internal organs and auditory organs of human bodies, ensures the life and property safety of people, and has popularization value.

title_en: Integration of fact-checked synthetic datasets with existing data for enhancing ai-based decision making in data-scarce domains
abstract_en: A computer-implemented, artificial intelligence (AI) method for integrating fact-checked synthetic datasets with existing data to support AI-based decision making includes generating synthetic data using an automated few-shot prompting mechanism with a generative AI model. The automated few-shot prompting mechanism comprises: feeding the model with a data schema of an existing database containing the existing data, feeding the model with a query language description with an instruction to generate a query for a missing feature from a database containing ground truth information, executing the generated query to obtain the ground truth information for training the model, and prompting the trained model to generate the synthetic data. The generated synthetic data is integrated with the existing data. The present invention can be used in a variety of applications including, but not limited to, several anticipated use cases in public safety, crime investigation and disaster risk management and medical/healthcare.

title_en: Disaster recovery corresponding management system
abstract_en: To provide a disaster recovery corresponding management system capable of achieving a disaster recovery corresponding smart city capable of providing a disaster recovery function during disaster.SOLUTION: Managing means 41 manages normal-time and disaster-occurrence-time functions of a view point hotel 21, a lodging house 23, a helicopter take-off and landing field 25, a lodging facility 27, a gymnasium 29, and a rescue dog training facility 31 in a disaster recovery corresponding smart city 11. At a normal time, community-based business is performed using the functions of an industrial development facility, a sport lodging facility, an even facility, or a disaster prevention/preparation facility. This activity has a function as pure business and continuously makes a profit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and system for monitoring environment and foreign matter invasion of equipment and facilities along railway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring the environment of equipment along a railway and monitoring the invasion of foreign matters, which are characterized in that the condition of the roadbed and the track along the railway and the comprehensive perception of the surrounding environment and the facilities along the railway are realized through a space-based remote sensing platform, an air-based remote sensing platform, a track moving platform detection, a fixed detection platform and a direct steel rail condition detection device singly or in combination, an expert diagnosis system is formed through data accumulation, hidden danger and fault recognition capability are improved through establishing deep learning training, maintenance and repair are reasonably arranged, the condition of the railway along the roadbed and the track along the railway and the early warning and warning of the hidden danger of the surrounding environment and the facilities are realized, the foreign matters invaded into the track are timely warned, the geological disasters along the railway are early warned and warned in combination with weather, and on-site rescue after the guiding faults and disasters are guided, and the running safety of a train is ensured.

title_en: Deep sea natural gas hydrate low-disturbance coring experiment platform and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deep sea natural gas hydrate low disturbance coring experiment platform and a use method thereof, comprising a natural gas hydrate generation system, a drilling system and a control system, wherein the natural gas hydrate generation system comprises a gas source, a water bath temperature control system, a reaction kettle, a pressurizing system and a back pressure system, the reaction kettle is provided with a gas inlet and a gas outlet, and a water bath jacket is arranged outside the reaction kettle; the air source is connected with an air inlet of the reaction kettle through a pressurizing system; the back pressure system is connected with an air outlet of the reaction kettle, and the water bath temperature control system is connected with a water bath jacket; the drilling system comprises a drill rod and a driving system, the upper end of the drill rod is connected with the driving system, and the lower end of the drill rod penetrates through and stretches into the reaction kettle; a plurality of temperature and pressure sensors are arranged on the reaction kettle and are connected with a control system. The method can realize the indoor generation of the deep sea natural gas hydrate and the indoor experimental study of the low-disturbance coring, and provides technical support for reasonable development and utilization of combustible ice resources and prevention and control of geological disasters.

title_en: Ore pressure prediction method based on support vector machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a mining pressure prediction method based on a support vector machine, and belongs to the technical field of mining pressure prediction; the technical problems to be solved are as follows: providing an improvement of an ore pressure prediction method based on a support vector machine; preprocessing according to historical mine pressure time sequence data acquired by the hydraulic support, constructing a training set by taking pressure sensor data of the target hydraulic support and adjacent hydraulic supports as data characteristics, training a mine pressure model of the target hydraulic support through a support vector machine, and providing predicted mine pressure of the current working cycle according to the model and by combining input variables of the current working cycle. The method is suitable for fully-mechanized mining face mining pressure prediction modeling, has the advantages of high prediction accuracy, simplicity, high efficiency and the like compared with the traditional mining pressure calculation, has guiding significance for bracket selection, mining pressure disaster prevention, control and management, and can ensure safe and efficient mining of the face.
assignees: TAIYUAN XIANGMING INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for improving accuracy of landslide disaster chain simulation by smooth particle method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a method for improving the accuracy of a landslide disaster chain simulation by a smooth particle method, which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting investigation data of a to-be-simulated object landslide and a disaster chain influence range, determining geological conditions, topography and physical mechanical parameter test results of a landslide body and physical mechanical parameters of a water body of the object landslide and the disaster chain influence range based on the investigation data, 2, constructing a numerical analysis model for performing landslide disaster chain numerical simulation based on the smooth particle method, 3, setting initial calculation parameters based on the constructed numerical analysis model in the step 2, 4, starting simulation calculation, updating the effective radius of any calculation time step according to a preset rule, and continuing calculation of the next time step until all calculation is completed, thereby obtaining the numerical simulation result of the landslide disaster chain. The method can greatly improve the accuracy of simulating the landslide hazard chain by the smooth particle method.

title_en: Ground subsidence prediction method and device based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention, and relates to a ground subsidence prediction method and device based on machine learning. Acquiring ground subsidence rate information based on InSAR and ground subsidence mark data; determining and acquiring ground subsidence influencing factors based on drilling data, exploitation quantity and hydrogeological conditions; and constructing a ground subsidence prediction model by using a machine learning algorithm, quantifying the contribution degree of the ground subsidence influencing factors, and realizing ground subsidence prediction. The ground settlement value can be obtained by only inputting the main control factor value through the model operation, and the method has the characteristics of simplicity, rapidness, convenience, accuracy and the like, saves time and economic cost for urban disaster prevention and control, and provides scientific basis for urban planning.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and device for calculating influence of roof elasticity on instability and damage of coal-rock combination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for calculating the influence of roof elasticity on instability and damage of a coal-rock combination, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety. Firstly, obtaining the thickness ratio of a roof to a coal seam through a drilling histogram as the height ratio of coal and rock in a coal and rock combination; and (5) acquiring the gas pressure of the coal seam and coring on site, and carrying out pretreatment on sample processing. And secondly, respectively carrying out mechanical tests on the coal-rock combination and the pure coal test piece to obtain the elastic modulus of the rock mass, the coal mass and the coal-rock combination, and obtaining stress-strain curves of the rock mass, the coal mass and the coal-rock combination and the pure coal test piece in the coal-rock combination according to stress-strain data acquired in the test process. And finally, deducing the influence degree of the elastic energy of the top plate on the instability and damage of the combined body by calculating the area of the stress-strain curve. The invention comprehensively considers the influence factors of the roof elastic energy in the coal rock gas dynamic disasters and provides a beneficial reference for the accurate prevention and control of the coal rock gas dynamic disasters of the mine.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST;UNIV CHONGQING;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Multi-factor simulation test equipment for power transmission tower
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of corrosion simulation test equipment, and provides power transmission tower multi-factor simulation test equipment, which comprises: a test bin; the lifting guide mechanism can move along the horizontal direction, the clamp is arranged on the lifting guide mechanism in a lifting manner along the height direction of the lifting guide mechanism, the clamp is used for clamping a test piece to be tested, and the clamp can rotate to drive the clamped test piece to be tested to change the angle and the azimuth; the spraying device is arranged in the test bin and is used for spraying liquid to the test piece to be tested clamped by the clamp; the light source is arranged in the test bin, the light source can emit ultraviolet light at least, and the multi-factor simulation test equipment of the power transmission tower can consider the influence of different natural environment factors on the material and structural performance of the power transmission tower structure and the disaster causing mechanism of the power transmission tower structure.
assignees: DALI BUREAU OF ULTRA HIGH VOLTAGE TRANS COMPANY CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID COMPANY LIMITED

title_en: Mining area geological disaster detection method based on improved YOLOv5s
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster detection, in particular to a mining area geological disaster detection method based on improved YOLOv5s, wherein a GhostModule layer is adopted to replace a convolution layer in a backbone network and a neck network, so that the parameters of the network are greatly reduced under the condition of extracting the same information quantity; the C3Ghost layer is adopted to replace a C3 layer in a backbone network and a neck network, and the loss function in the detection head is replaced by the EIoU from the original CIoU, so that the network can better perform parameter training without increasing the complexity of a model, and the detection precision is maintained. Compared with the existing YOLOv5s, the mAP value of the method reaches 78.9%, the model volume is compressed by 47.1%, the calculated amount is reduced by 48.8%, the parameter amount is reduced by 47.8%, the requirements of deployment and real-time detection on an unmanned plane platform can be met on the premise of keeping the high detection precision of the YOLOv5s, and the weight reduction of the model is realized.
assignees: Huajin coking coal co ltd;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Control method and system for distributed emergency command center
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency command and discloses a control method and a control system of a distributed emergency command center, wherein the control method and the control system comprise a data acquisition system, an early warning and warning system and a consultation system, the data acquisition system comprises real-time monitoring and disaster condition live monitoring, the early warning and warning system comprises a disaster condition simulation system, the disaster condition simulation system analyzes disaster information and generates a three-dimensional simulation picture, the consultation system comprises an information integration system, and the consultation system further comprises an acoustic amplification system, a conference system, a display system and a conference central control system. According to the invention, the projection screen or the display screen is arranged on the annular wall surface, so that people participating in the consultation can conveniently watch the display content at multiple angles, and the hand-held conference host, the conference chairman unit and the conference representative unit are sequentially distributed in the conference room in an annular manner.
assignees: SHANGHAI CHUNPIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Natural disaster early warning method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and financial science and technology, and relates to a natural disaster early warning method, which comprises the steps of dividing acquired natural disaster data into a real-time data set and an offline data set, and processing the real-time disaster image data set and the offline disaster image data set; performing outlier detection on the real-time disaster image data set and the offline disaster image data set to obtain a normal real-time disaster data set and a normal offline disaster data set; scoring the normal offline disaster dataset; screening out a sample data set according to the score; training and verifying the random forest model by using a sample data set to obtain a natural disaster early warning model; and predicting the real-time data through a natural disaster early warning model. The application also provides a natural disaster early warning device, computer equipment and a storage medium. In addition, the present application relates to blockchain technology in which natural disaster data can be stored. The method and the device can improve the accuracy and timeliness of natural disaster early warning.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Regional-scale rainstorm waterlogging analysis method, regional-scale rainstorm waterlogging analysis equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional-scale rainstorm waterlogging analysis method, regional-scale rainstorm waterlogging analysis equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction. Firstly, dividing a region into a first-level row region and a second-level sub-row region; simulating storm flow of each secondary subarrangement area in the analysis area by using a conceptual lumped model; then simulating the outflow process at the secondary gate station based on the secondary sublevel zone production flow process; summarizing the river channel, the regulation lake, the outer gate station, the regulation sluice and the inner alkyl, and obtaining the water level and the flow of each section of the river network and the residual water quantity in each secondary sublevel zone through regulation calculation of the river network; then spreading waterlogging water in each secondary sublevel zone; and finally, spatially connecting waterlogging results of each secondary sublevel zone in the area. According to the technical scheme, the space-time distribution analysis process of the waterlogging is reasonably optimized, so that regional-scale waterlogging analysis is completed stably and rapidly.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;UNIV SHIHEZI;HUBEI WATER RESOURCES RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Multi-source data-based transformer substation flood disaster comprehensive control and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation flood disaster comprehensive prevention and early warning system based on multi-source data, which comprises the following components: the information acquisition and preservation database is used for acquiring and storing substation construction information and surrounding environment information in the area; the pre-processing part is used for determining the type of hidden danger of flood disasters suffered by the transformer substation in the environment; the post-processing part generates early warning for flood disasters possibly suffered by the transformer substation under the condition that rainfall exists in the range containing the transformer substation, determines the type of historical data queried in the information acquisition and retention database, determines the real-time acquisition data range related to the transformer substation, and processes the real-time acquisition data based on the calculation model after determining the flood disaster early warning calculation model to generate flood disaster early warning for the transformer substation; the processing efficiency is obviously improved, and the giving time of early warning is obviously shortened; the method realizes accurate simulation and accurate prediction of the rain and flood disaster of the transformer substation in the complex terrain environment of the mountain area.

title_en: Locomotive fire detection system test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a locomotive fire detection system test device, which comprises side wall splice plates, wherein the side wall splice plates are spliced according to the lengths of a cab and a passenger compartment of a locomotive to form side walls; the end wall splice plates are spliced according to the widths of a cab and a passenger compartment of the locomotive to form a first end wall and a second end wall; the roof splicing component splices according to the heights of a cab and a passenger compartment of the locomotive to form a roof; the utility model solves the problems that the test space in the prior art is not close to the real size of the locomotive, the real environment in the carriage, the test simulation degree is low, the test reference value is low, the test cost is high and the like. The fire disaster test device can simulate locomotive scene environments of different models to develop fire disaster tests aiming at the detection device, is convenient and efficient to test, and can test fire disaster alarming timeliness of all vehicle types, thereby providing reliable and powerful experiment guarantee and basis for the design of a real locomotive fire disaster detection system.

title_en: Fire simulation combustion device of model tunnel passenger car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire simulation combustion device of a model tunnel passenger car. The device is arranged in the fire tunnel model and used for simulating a tunnel car fire test and comprises a vehicle model and a combustion assembly; the vehicle model comprises a vehicle shell and a vehicle base; the vehicle shell is arranged according to the proportion of the vehicle shell to the actual vehicle shape of 1:10, and a plurality of groups of open windows are arranged at the upper part around the vehicle shell; the vehicle base is arranged in combination with the bottom surface of the tunnel model, and the upper part of the vehicle base is combined with the vehicle shell to form a vehicle model; the combustion assembly is an oil pool with an opening at the upper part and is arranged in the middle of the vehicle base. The device can better simulate the working condition of a passenger car in a tunnel when a fire disaster occurs, the combustion assembly can reflect the actual fire disaster scale, and the vehicle assembly can reflect the influence of the section blocking ratio at the fire source on the smoke diffusion rule and the control method, so that the device can more closely and practically study the distribution rule of the temperature field, the smoke diffusion characteristic and the corresponding disaster prevention control method in the tunnel when the fire disaster occurs.
assignees: SOUTHWEST MUNICIPAL ENGINEERIGN DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA;CHENGDU XINGCHENG CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Fire control nozzle for energy storage battery box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire protection safety of battery boxes, in particular to a fire protection nozzle for an energy storage battery box, which comprises a battery box body and a nozzle seat arranged on the battery box body, wherein the end head of the nozzle seat is rotationally connected with an impeller, meanwhile, the bottom end of the impeller is rotationally sleeved with a nozzle cylinder body, the nozzle cylinder body is communicated with an inner cavity of the impeller, a connecting rod is arranged in the inner cavity of the impeller in a sliding penetrating way, the connecting rod is of a cavity structure with two hollow ends, the bottom end of the connecting rod extends into the nozzle cylinder body, the top of the impeller is provided with a mounting seat, and a drill bit is arranged on the mounting seat in a sliding penetrating way. Meanwhile, when the fire disaster occurs in the battery box and the fire extinguishing system is required to be started, the nozzle can drill holes while cooling the box body. The corresponding problems generated when the nozzle is preassembled to the box body without fire are avoided.
assignees: SHAANXI JIANRUI FIRE FIGHTING SAFE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Cloud rendering technology-based real-time AR visualization method and system for SLAM system
abstract_en: The application relates to a cloud rendering technology-based real-time visualization method and system for an AR (augmented reality) of an SLAM (browser-based imaging) system. The method comprises the following steps: the cloud acquires a post-disaster environment video stream captured by an image sensor; the cloud end uses the nerve radiation field to render the post-disaster environment video to obtain a corresponding three-dimensional point cloud in the post-disaster environment video, processes the three-dimensional point cloud to obtain a corresponding rendering model, and transmits the rendering model to the client; the client acquires a rescue party visual angle video stream captured by an image sensor; the client side processes the rescue party visual angle video stream by utilizing the SLAM system to obtain a video stream key frame, corresponding characteristic points and camera pose information; and the client performs AR visualization according to the rendering model, the video stream key frame, the corresponding feature points and the camera pose information. By adopting the method, a good virtual training environment can be provided for the rescue party.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY;UNIV NANJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Digital management platform for AI park safety command and dispatch
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI park safety command and dispatch digital management platform, which belongs to the technical field of Internet of things, wherein the platform locks a burst dangerous source and the position of the dangerous source, and after the position and the type are locked, a processing plan corresponding to the burst dangerous source is called from a storage unit through a controller, and accidents are processed according to the plan; specifically, the invention simulates the reaction rules of various sensors at various positions during the explosion of the dangerous source, and when the actual dangerous source explosion occurs later, the reaction rules of various sensors at various positions are collected, compared with various simulation results, the similarity is obtained, and the dangerous source corresponding to the simulation result is locked according to the comparison result, thereby being beneficial to locking the dangerous source by staff, firefighters and the like, further being beneficial to accurately making fire protection measures and realizing the reduction of accident loss.
assignees: SHENZHEN YUNWU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent space-time prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent space-time prediction method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: simulating a mountain torrent production flow process of the target area through a grid-type SCS hydrological model; simulating a torrent inundation process through a LISFLOOD-FP hydrodynamic model; creating a physically simulated rainfall-torrential flood dataset; constructing a mountain torrent space-time prediction agent model based on a Pytorch deep learning framework; and training and testing the mountain torrent space-time prediction agent model through the rainfall-mountain torrent data set. According to the invention, a mountain torrent space-time prediction agent model is constructed based on a deep learning method, a complex nonlinear relation between rainfall and torrent is fitted through training and learning in a large number of rainfall and corresponding torrent inundation data samples simulated by a hydrologic and hydrodynamic model, so that a physical model agent aiming at a mountain torrent space-time prediction task is completed, a torrent inundation space-time change process can be rapidly and accurately predicted according to a rainfall time sequence, and a short-time proximity prediction task of a torrent disaster is served.

title_en: Visual coal and gas outburst experiment device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual coal and gas outburst experiment device and method, and relates to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control. The invention comprises a visual cylinder body, wherein one end of the visual cylinder body is provided with a sealing flange, a stress loading assembly is arranged on the sealing flange, and the other end of the visual cylinder body is provided with a protruding starting assembly. According to the invention, through the mutual coordination among the visual cylinder body, the stress loading assembly and the protruding starting assembly, coal and gas protruding simulation experiments under different conditions can be developed, visual monitoring is realized through the coordination of the visual protruding device and the high-speed shooting, and compared with the traditional burst disk mode, the automatic cylinder starting method can be adopted for protruding experiments, automatic accurate protruding on time can be realized as required, and the burst disk is not required to be repeatedly installed and replaced.

title_en: Self-adaptive test platform for simulating high-position high-risk landslide and chain disaster thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adaptive test platform for simulating high-level high-risk landslide and chain disasters thereof, which comprises an equivalent slip speed measurement and control device capable of adjusting the position of a landslide body, a simulated landslide river valley, measuring equipment and the like. The intelligent landslide control system can truly simulate the water inflow speed of a high-level landslide, effectively reduce the height of the landslide body by providing the initial speed of the landslide body, improve the safety of experiments, adjust the position of the landslide body through the sliding rail and change the inclination angle of the landslide body, meet the requirement of simple and convenient operation of multi-landslide body experiments, and meanwhile, arrange measuring equipment to accurately observe and record the surge.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Administrative safety monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an administrative security monitoring and early warning system, which comprises: a plurality of data acquisition modules; the safety early warning modules are responsible for receiving signals sent by the corresponding data acquisition modules; the safety early warning module is internally provided with a singlechip, and the singlechip is based on a machine learning algorithm model; the monitoring end is connected with the safety early warning modules and the data acquisition modules and comprises a central processing module, a central learning module and a judging module. And the singlechip in the safety early warning module updates and corrects parameters of the machine learning algorithm model according to the online trained machine learning algorithm model. By adopting a distributed computing and central online training mode, a data acquisition module and a corresponding safety early warning module are arranged around the administrative environment, and online training of real-time change data at a monitoring end is utilized to realize dynamic model updating and correction so as to adapt to the change of the administrative environment and new safety threat and improve safety and emergency response capability.

title_en: Disaster chain identification method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster chain recognition method and a disaster chain recognition system based on deep learning, wherein the recognition method comprises the steps of pre-classifying pixels of an SAR intensity map representing the change of a research area to obtain a change class, a non-change class and an uncertain class; training a neural network recognition model by using pixels of a variable class and pixels of a constant class; dividing the pixels of the uncertain class into corresponding variable class and unchanged class by using the trained neural network recognition model; and generating a change map of the research area according to the updated change class, wherein the change map is used for disaster chain identification. According to the method, the SAR intensity map of two scenes or more is only required to be given, the change between every two scenes can be detected, a time-continuous change detection result is obtained, the method is simple, and the data required to be provided in the calculation process are only time sequence SAR intensity maps, so that compared with the method for manually and visually interpreting disaster change, the method has the advantages that the time consumption is long, the calculation amount and time can be greatly saved, and the precision is improved.

title_en: Simulation goaf internal CO 2 Mineralization experimental device and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal mine goaf CO  2  The technical field of mineralization and disaster control provides a method for simulating CO in a goaf  2  Mineralization device and method of use. The device comprises a reaction box, an air injection system, a material pressure injection system, an air extraction system and a monitoring system. The device can simulate CO under the conditions of different temperatures, humidity, pressure and wind speed of the goaf  2  Mineralization experiment, through the real-time monitoring of the pH value, temperature, humidity, pressure and gas concentration change condition in the reaction device, CO in the goaf is realized  2  Visualization of mineralization whole process and plugging effect, namely CO in goaf  2  Mineralization, plugging, fire prevention and extinguishment provides technological parameters.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY;INNER MONGOLIA HUANGTAOLEGAI COAL CO LTD

title_en: Risk assessment system for landslide influence range and damage degree
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk assessment system for landslide influence range and damage degree, which comprises a data acquisition module, a first data processing module, a second data processing module, a first algorithm training module, a second algorithm training module, an assessment module and a visualization module; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring current geographic geological data and historical disaster data; the first data processing module processes the current geographic geological data and the historical disaster data; the first algorithm training module carries out machine learning algorithm training on the processed historical disaster data; the second data processing module performs data processing on the target area; the second algorithm training module carries out machine learning algorithm training on the processed influence range and the processed damage degree of the target area; the evaluation module carries out risk evaluation on the landslide influence range and the landslide damage degree to obtain an evaluation result; and the visualization module is used for visualizing and displaying the evaluation result.
assignees: BEIJING CHAOWEI CHUANGXIANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Angle steel power transmission tower-line system analysis method and system under wind-rain coupling field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for analyzing an angle steel transmission tower-line system in a wind-rain coupling field, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively carrying out wind load simulation and rain load simulation; establishing a combined probability distribution of wind speed and rainfall, and deducing respective combination values and combination coefficients of wind and rain combination effects based on the established combined probability distribution of wind speed and rainfall; adopting a disaster combination analysis method based on consistent dangers, under the condition that the disaster joint probability density function takes the maximum value, taking the most probable disaster action combination value on the fortification probability level contour line of the joint probability distribution function, and further establishing a strong convection weather wind-rain coupling load calculation model; and (3) establishing a three-tower four-wire three-dimensional finite element model, applying strong convection weather wind-rain coupling load time course to the three-tower four-wire three-dimensional finite element model, and carrying out dynamic response analysis to judge failure analysis of the three-tower four-wire three-dimensional finite element model.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Runoff generating mode based on soil water storage capacity splashing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a runoff generating mode based on soil water storage capacity splashing, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, designing an external splash judgment criterion; step 2, calculating splashing amount according to the rainfall and the soil water content; step 3, describing splash height distribution by using lognormal distribution and calculating splash quantity; step 4, calculating super soil-holding medium current according to the size that the water content of the soil exceeds the field water holding capacity; and 5, butting the confluence model and re-calibrating parameters. The invention can obviously improve the flood simulation effect in semiarid regions, can explain oversized flood peaks which cannot be simulated by the ultra-seepage production flow, and provides reliable technical support for flood control and disaster reduction.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;HEBEI XINGTAI HYDROLOGY SURVEY RES CENTER

title_en: Bedrock crack landslide physical model device under influence of reservoir water level
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bedrock fracture landslide physical model device under the influence of reservoir water level, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster model tests. The utility model provides a bedrock crack landslide physical model device under influence of storehouse water level includes the model box, be equipped with bedrock board and lower bedrock board in the model box, upward bedrock board and lower bedrock board bottom are equipped with altitude mixture control subassembly, be equipped with the split board in addition, split board bottom is equipped with position control subassembly, position control subassembly includes first bracing piece and second bracing piece, first bracing piece is articulated with the second bracing piece, split board overlap joint is on position control subassembly, split board is articulated with lower bedrock board near last bedrock board one side, model box bottom inboard is equipped with the limiting plate, forward-leaning groove and reverse-leaning groove have been seted up to both sides by the middle part position to the limiting plate, forward-leaning groove and reverse-leaning groove and split board bottom cooperation setting simulate the condition of landslide at different development stages, and compare the landslide of multiple different operating modes.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Intelligent building safety fire control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent building safety fire protection system which can be used for fire practical training, and comprises a model module, a practical training module, a safety fire protection module and a server, wherein the model module is used for building a building model; the practical training module comprises a fault simulation unit, a fault solution input unit and a scoring unit, wherein the fault simulation unit can be used for simulating various fire situations and displaying simulated fire information by using a screen, the fault solution input unit is used for a user to input a corresponding fire solution according to the displayed current fire information, and the fire solution comprises an escape route for setting personnel evacuation and a fire extinguishing mode; the safety fire-fighting module is used for controlling the corresponding guiding device to guide personnel to evacuate according to the escape route in the fire solution input by the user, starting the corresponding fire-extinguishing mode in the automatic fire-extinguishing device, and performing practical exercise of related fire situations by adding practical training operation, so that learners can master the composition of the whole system and the capability of logic programming.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SAIGE CONSTRUCTION DEV CO LTD

title_en: Mining vehicle operation optimization method based on digital twin technology in intelligent mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of mines, and particularly discloses a mining vehicle operation optimization method based on a digital twin technology in an intelligent mine, which comprises the steps of hanging hygrothermographs at required measurement positions through hanging ropes, respectively placing three hygrothermographs at a mine mountain top, a mine mountain waist and a mine mountain foot, transversely spacing 1000m each hygrothermograph, and solving the average number of the three hygrothermographs to be used as temperature and humidity data of the mine mountain top, the mine mountain waist and the mine mountain foot; compared with the traditional mine blasting design, the mining vehicle anti-sinking and overturning safety hidden trouble caused by different terrains, wind speeds, wind directions, rainfall, earthquake actions and the like when the mining vehicle is in load transportation operation can be effectively reduced or even avoided, proper measures can be taken in advance, driving safety is ensured, the digital twin technology is adopted, the actual running condition of the mining vehicle can be simulated according to actual measured data, and the running condition of the mining vehicle is monitored in real time, so that a large amount of resources such as manpower and material resources are saved.
assignees: JIANGSU FANZAI INTELLIGENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Melt-driven debris flow dynamic simulation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and control, and relates to a melt-driven debris flow dynamic simulation method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining environment monitoring parameters and topographic data, constructing a temperature-snow melting model, and calculating the snow melting rate; the method comprises the steps of obtaining soil freeze thawing parameters, constructing a water-temperature coupled soil infiltration model, calculating soil temperature air-change distribution data, soil solid-liquid phase air-change distribution data and ground surface residual snow melting water quantity data, constructing a multiphase mass flow model, and calculating runoff/debris flow space distribution data in a flow area along with time change. The invention couples three stages of snow melting, soil infiltration and runoff/debris flow propagation, considers the influences of temperature change, substrate material entrainment and substrate material particle composition, effectively describes the melt-driven debris flow forming process, obtains more accurate and fine debris flow kinetic results, and evaluates the erosion rate of substrate materials more accurately.

title_en: Leakage monitoring and early warning method and system for disaster simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a leakage monitoring and early warning method and a leakage monitoring and early warning system for disaster simulation, which relate to the technical field of disaster early warning, and comprise the following steps: analyzing physical and chemical properties and toxicological properties of the paraxylene, analyzing the structure, auxiliary facilities and components of the paraxylene storage tank, analyzing disaster forms according to analysis results, and analyzing dangers according to the analysis results of the disaster forms; performing storage tank leakage simulation by using simulation analysis software to obtain a numerical simulation result; determining a predicted accident impact state based on the risk analysis result and the numerical simulation result; according to the accident influence state, a corresponding accident disposal countermeasure is selected and used as a fire rescue reference. The invention solves the technical problems of serious consequences of paraxylene leakage accidents and difficult safe and rapid disposal in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of predicting the disaster influence range through dangerous analysis and disaster numerical simulation and further taking reasonable disposal countermeasures.

title_en: Multifunctional experimental device for physical simulation of surface flow disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional experimental device for physical simulation of ground surface fluid disasters, which comprises a fluid disaster movement mechanism, a rainfall mechanism and a monitoring mechanism, wherein the fluid disaster movement mechanism is used for providing fluid disasters for movement; the rainfall mechanism is fixedly erected above the fluid disaster movement mechanism, and the monitoring mechanism is arranged beside the fluid disaster movement mechanism. The invention has the beneficial effects of compact structure, reasonable design, capability of simulating the sliding and movement processes of the fluid disaster body with different rainfall intensity, different gradients and different sliding surfaces, various functions and convenient simulation.
assignees: WUHAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY ZHONGNAN GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOV

title_en: Channel loose rock body dam blocking dam burst simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a method and a system for simulating dam breaking of a channel loose rock soil body weir. The simulation method comprises the following steps: determining a foundation parameter of the dam, constructing a dam blocking experimental model according to the foundation parameter of the dam blocking, and constructing a dam blocking simulation model based on the dam blocking experimental model in equal proportion; simulating a breaking process under the continuous catchment condition through an experimental model and a simulation model, and correspondingly obtaining experimental mud-rock flow data and simulated mud-rock flow data; setting an error threshold of the debris flow data, and combining the actual errors among the dual-model debris flow data with the error threshold to adjust simulation model parameters in real time until the actual errors do not exceed the error threshold; and simulating a damming process by using a simulation model which does not exceed an error threshold. According to the invention, through experimental simulation double models, the advantages of experimental data and numerical simulation are fully utilized, and the complex channel loose rock body damming and dam breaking behavior can be better simulated.

title_en: Reverse-flow transfer training device convenient for cognition of hazardous chemical substance valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire control training equipment, and discloses a reverse flow transfer training device convenient for cognition of dangerous chemicals valves, which comprises a first storage tank and a second storage tank, wherein the first storage tank and the second storage tank are fixedly connected with a subsea valve and a safety valve, and an oil-gas separation valve, an oil-gas recovery valve and an oil loading and unloading valve are further arranged between the first storage tank and the second storage tank and between the first storage tank and a reverse tank pump. This reverse flow transportation trainer convenient to danger article valve is cognitive, through setting up the pump of pouring into a tank between first holding vessel and second holding vessel, the simulation training of being convenient for takes place the pouring into a tank process when oil gas leaks, through set up seabed valve, relief valve, oil gas separation valve, oil gas recovery valve and loading and unloading oil valve on first holding vessel and second holding vessel in a concentrated way, the firefighter who is convenient for train is concentrated and is cognized and skillfully used a plurality of valves, can in time make the exact reply when accident such as dangerous article fire in the face of reality.

title_en: Fire control is door for training
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fire-fighting appliances, in particular to a fire-fighting training door, which aims to solve the problems that the existing breaking and dismantling training method is high in cost and long in single training preparation time, and the training time of firefighters cannot be effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Simulation training device for fire disaster occurrence of warehouse shelf
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire control simulation devices, and discloses a warehouse shelf fire disaster occurrence simulation training device, which comprises four shelves provided with a fire disaster occurrence simulation device, wherein the fire disaster occurrence simulation device comprises a combustion pool arranged at the bottommost layer of the shelves, one side of the combustion pool is provided with a main air supply pipeline, and the other side of the combustion pool is provided with a water supply pipeline for supplying water to the inside of the combustion pool. This simulation trainer takes place for warehouse goods shelves conflagration, through being equipped with a goods shelves that are used for installing the simulation device takes place for conflagration, can make the goods shelves burn under the environment of safety to the condition when the simulation conflagration takes place can make firefighter exercise self fire control skill under comparatively safe environment, thereby better assurance self safety sets up through the cooperation between burning cell, main air supply pipeline and the water supply pipeline, flame when can making the burning more stable.

title_en: Test device for simulating gas and fire symbiotic disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test device for simulating gas and fire symbiotic disasters, which comprises an equipment box and is characterized in that: the device comprises a device box, and is characterized in that a plurality of partition plates are arranged in the device box in a connected mode, the partition plates divide the device box into a gas cavity, an oxygen cavity and a water storage cavity, an experimental cavity is arranged in the device box in a connected mode, a gas tank is arranged in the gas cavity, a gas pipe is arranged in the gas tank in a connected mode, a gas injection opening is arranged in the gas pipe in a connected mode, an oxygen tank is arranged in the oxygen cavity, an oxygen pipe is arranged in the oxygen tank in a connected mode, and one-way valves are arranged in the oxygen pipe and the gas pipe in a connected mode, and compared with the prior art, the device has the advantages that: 1. the air-jet experimental device has the advantages that the air-jet experimental device is provided with the fan motor, the fan shaft and the fan blades, internal air can flow, the flow speed of gas is accelerated, the air is uniformly arranged in the experimental cavity, and the air-jet experimental device is provided with the water storage tank, the water pump, the water distribution cavity and the water spray head, so that emergency water spraying can be performed, and high temperature is prevented.
assignees: SHANXI COAL IMP & EXP GROUP TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Inclined tunnel fire disaster scale test platform capable of randomly adjusting gradient
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire disaster reduced scale test platform of an inclined tunnel with optionally adjustable gradient, which relates to the technical field of fire disaster safety, the device solves the technical problems that the existing inclined tunnel fire test device can not well demonstrate specific fire behaviors and motion propagation rules of smoke, can not be scaled down according to the equal proportion simulation of an actual tunnel, and has limited simulation effect. The utility model comprises a test platform main body, a test platform base, a gantry crane bracket, a ventilation system, a fire source simulation system and a measurement system, wherein the test platform main body and an actual inclined tunnel are in equal proportion structure, the whole is composed of a plurality of sections of detachable high-temperature refractory glass, one end of the main body of the test platform is connected with the base of the test platform in a sliding way, and the other end of the main body of the test platform is connected with the lifting device of the gantry crane bracket. The device can better simulate the combustion behavior of fire disaster under different ventilation and smoke discharge modes in the inclined tunnel and the evolution of the movement and propagation of toxic smoke in a limited space, and experimental phenomena can be recorded through shooting of transparent high-temperature-resistant glass.

title_en: Rainfall monitoring data driven intelligent early warning method for small-river-basin geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a rainfall monitoring data-driven intelligent early warning method for small-river-basin geological disasters, which comprises the steps of acquiring historical rainfall data of a target small river basin and preprocessing geological disaster historical record data; matching the geological disaster event to a corresponding rainfall event to obtain a rainfall event set with geological disaster, wherein the rainfall event set is used as a positive sample, and the rainfall event set without geological disaster is used as a negative sample; the positive sample and the negative sample are used for constructing a data set for learning, training and testing a machine learning model; constructing an intelligent early warning machine learning model array of the small watershed geological disaster, and training, verifying and testing by using a data set; and constructing a target small-basin geological disaster occurrence probability calculation model and an uncertainty analysis model under the influence of a rainfall event, calculating the target small-basin geological disaster occurrence probability and uncertainty under the rainfall event, and carrying out early warning. The method improves the reliability and accuracy of the geological disaster early warning result of the small river basin.
assignees: CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES;UNIV CHONGQING;CHONGQING HUADI ZIHUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent early warning index analysis method based on different rainfall monitoring and forecasting conditions
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mountain torrent early warning index analysis method based on different rainfall monitoring and forecasting conditions, which comprises the following steps of determining mountain torrent disaster early warning indexes based on meteorological numerical rainfall forecasting data; a method for determining mountain torrent disaster early warning indexes based on radar proximity forecast data; a method for determining mountain torrent disaster early warning indexes based on rainfall data monitored by rainfall stations; according to the invention, the situation that weather rainfall forecast data are inaccurate and rainfall areas are likely to deviate is considered, the original early warning indexes are subjected to deviation adjustment, or the early warning indexes are determined by simulating the submerging situation through a hydrologic model, so that the mountain torrent early warning accuracy is improved, the false alarm rate of the air report is reduced, and technical support is provided for transferring and avoiding danger for people in hilly areas.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;HEBEI HYDROLOGY SURVEY AND RES CENTER

title_en: Test device for simulating whole process of urban storm flood
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test device for simulating the whole process of urban storm flood. The system comprises a top-layer rainfall system, a middle-layer city block flood simulation system and an underground pipe network system, and can realize city flood disaster situations under different storm conditions; the experimental platform can accurately simulate the whole process of urban storm production and collection, provide space-time distribution conditions of disaster-bearing body risk after flood disasters, and provide scientific basis for urban flood control and disaster reduction and flood risk management; the top-layer urban rainfall system can truly simulate natural rainfall, rainfall intensity can be converted at will in a certain interval, and raindrop diameter and raindrop final falling speed in a certain range can be simulated; the rainfall control system can control the rainfall duration and the rainfall intensity of different rainfall units in the whole rainfall system, and can also control single operation or different unit combinations to operate simultaneously, so that the rainfall process of different rainfall types in different areas is simulated.

title_en: Groundwater level multi-step prediction method based on convolution attention long-short-term neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-step groundwater level prediction method based on a convolution attention long-short period neural network, which comprises the following steps: s10, acquiring monitoring data related to the underground water level to obtain multi-feature monitoring time sequence data; s20, constructing a multi-feature monitoring data sample tensor based on multi-feature monitoring time sequence data; s30, building a convolution attention long-term and short-term neural network model; s40, training a convolution attention long-short-period neural network model based on multi-feature monitoring data sample tensors to obtain an optimal model; s50, substituting the monitoring data for prediction into an optimal model, and outputting multi-step prediction data through model calculation. The invention can combine the convolutional neural network, the attention mechanism and the long-term memory neural network, is a hybrid neural network model, can greatly improve the prediction precision of the groundwater level for a long time in the future, and provides more reliable data support for groundwater disaster decision making.
assignees: CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION INT ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Flood disaster risk prediction evaluation and differentiation early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster risk prediction evaluation and differentiation early warning system and method, and belongs to the technical field. The invention solves the technical problems of strong subjectivity, low result accuracy and insufficient pertinence of results in the existing flood risk assessment technology, and provides a flood model combining hydrology and hydrodynamic force, which can simulate disasters for various disaster situations under the condition of limited accuracy of topographic data; the current flood risk assessment method mainly based on flood depth is changed, flood flow rate and flood depth are combined by considering a human body destabilizing mechanism to divide flood risk levels, and the threat degree of flood disasters to personnel life safety can be effectively assessed; the method comprises the steps of changing the pre-warning information content mainly based on disaster intensity, combining flood disaster space-time dynamic risk assessment results with population positions, and establishing a pre-warning information base with users as centers so as to provide more targeted information content for disaster pre-warning.
assignees: CHINA UNICOM DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Model and method for predicting extremely cold weather based on climate change
abstract_en: The invention provides a model and a method for predicting extremely cold weather based on climate change, comprising the steps of constructing extremely cold weather phenomenon indexes and climate change indexes; constructing an information gain model; constructing a Sigmoid function-based binary regression prediction model; solving a binary regression prediction model based on a Sigmoid function; and performing iterative training on the binary regression prediction model based on the Sigmoid function by using a K-fold cross validation model, and evaluating the model effect by using a conventional rating index. Quantitative analysis and model construction are carried out on the weather of the extremely cold weather according to the weather change prediction, the multi-source data are fully utilized, the accurate prediction on the extremely cold weather is realized through the statistical analysis and the machine learning technology, the problem that the interaction mechanism among factors affecting the extremely cold weather is not clear is solved, and the application of the method has wide and positive influence on the fields of climate research, risk assessment and disaster management, climate adaptation and sustainable development, decision support and scientific research.

title_en: Device and method for measuring walking stress of human body in flood
abstract_en: The invention relates to a measuring device and a testing method for human body walking stress in flood, wherein the measuring device comprises: the flood process simulation part is used for simulating flood processes under different water depths and flow velocity conditions on the ground; the human body stress measurement simulation part is used for measuring the stress of pedestrians in flood under different submerged water depths and submerged flow rates so as to analyze the fluid force and instability risks of the pedestrians in the flood under different walking states; and the water outlet part is used for opening and recycling water flow of the flood process simulation part and the human body stress measurement simulation part to the water supply part. In order to solve the problem that the fluid force and the like of pedestrians in flood disasters are difficult to measure, the flexible sensor module is worn on the body of a human body model or a tester to acquire related data such as fluid acting force and the like applied to the human body in the moving process of the flood, so that the stress condition and instability judgment standards of the human body in the flood under different moving working conditions in different storm scenes are analyzed, and decision support can be provided for making of underground space flood evacuation schemes.

title_en: Colliery water damage early warning system based on video identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine water disaster early warning system based on video identification, which comprises a plurality of cameras, wherein the cameras are connected with video acquisition cards, the video acquisition cards are connected with a water disaster processing unit, the water disaster processing unit is provided with a control center, the control center is connected with an alarm system, and the water disaster processing unit is also provided with an information management system; the control center is also connected with a water-bursting monitoring unit, the water-bursting monitoring unit comprises a backboard and a top plate which are arranged beside a drilling hole, a camera is arranged on the top plate, a laser module is arranged on one side of the camera, the laser module is connected with a motor, the motor drives the laser module, the control center is provided with a power supply module for supplying power, and the control center sends water-bursting data to a server end of the information management system through a set wireless communication module for data storage.

title_en: Method for weakening and preventing impact of ground and underground cooperative area of thick and hard top plate
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for weakening and preventing impact of a cooperative area on the ground and underground of a thick and hard roof, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining spatial spread characteristics of the hard roof, and then obtaining different types of fracturing control target horizons and five fracturing control modes corresponding to the target horizons based on the spatial spread characteristics of the hard roof, wherein the five fracturing control modes are as follows: a low single thick hard top layer, a low composite hard top layer, a high-low composite thick hard top layer, a high composite thick hard top layer and a high single thick hard top layer. And finally, constructing a ground single-hole drilling hole for large-displacement liquid supply on the ground, constructing a directional long drilling hole under the well, weakening the fracturing control target horizon by adopting liquid fracturing measures in a source-division and classification manner through the ground single-hole drilling hole and the directional long drilling hole. The method can fundamentally and comprehensively solve rock burst disasters induced by the thick and hard top plate.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Underground road evacuation method based on traffic volume predictive analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel rescue, in particular to an underground road evacuation method based on traffic prediction analysis. The method comprises the following steps: s1, dividing a target underground road into a plurality of fault partitions; s2, obtaining the traffic volume of the early and late peak hour of each entrance and exit of the predicted target underground road; s3, obtaining the average running speed and congestion condition prediction result of each section of the target underground road under the normal running condition; s4, subdividing the working conditions into a plurality of working conditions; s5, making a plurality of emergency evacuation schemes; s6, obtaining an evaluation index of average speed or congestion degree and evacuation time, and analyzing evacuation effect; s7, selecting an evacuation scheme according to the evacuation effect. Compared with the prior art, based on the prediction results of traffic volumes of different underground roads, the working condition simulation research of different accidents is carried out through VISSIM software, and the evacuation effects of different schemes are compared, so that better evacuation and rescue schemes are obtained, the applicability is high, and the accuracy is ensured.
assignees: SHANGHAI URBAN CONSTRUCTION URBAN OPERATION GROUP CO LTD;SHANGHAI URBAN CONSTRUCTION SMART CITY OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Interactive wounded rescue skill training method and system based on evaluation feedback
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wounded rescue skill training, in particular to an interactive wounded rescue skill training method and system based on evaluation feedback, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a mode selection instruction sent by a user; entering a parameter setting interface of a corresponding mode according to the mode selection instruction, and when the parameter setting interface of the entered mode is a training mode parameter setting interface, further comprising the following steps: displaying a disaster scene selection control area in the parameter setting interface; acquiring a disaster scene type selected by a user; acquiring disaster scene data of a corresponding type according to the selected disaster scene type; acquiring and displaying the corresponding injury type and treatment tool type on a display screen; generating a training list according to disaster scene data and the types of injuries and treatment tools selected by the user; and after acquiring an instruction for confirming the start of training by a user, starting to enter a training phase. The invention can improve the treatment skills of students under the disaster condition.
assignees: GENERAL HOSPITAL OF CENTRAL PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY

title_en: Land type identification management method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle assistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a land type recognition management method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle assistance, and relates to the technical field of land type recognition, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting a land remote sensing image through an unmanned aerial vehicle, processing and extracting characteristics, and strengthening land type characteristics in the image; constructing a land type recognition model, setting a land type recognition standard, inputting a characteristic image according to the reinforced land type for training and analyzing to obtain a land type recognition result; and carrying out secondary rechecking correction on the identification result, and carrying out authentication and management according to the corrected land type. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is adopted to acquire the high-resolution ground surface image, so that detailed characteristics of the ground surface can be clearly displayed, the identification accuracy is improved, and the acquired image is free from the influence of factors such as cloud cover, night illumination and the like. The method improves the recognition accuracy, ensures the accuracy of the recognition result, is beneficial to land management and planning, and has important application value for tasks such as disaster emergency, environmental protection and the like.
assignees: China Geological Survey Hohhot Natural Resources Comprehensive Survey Center

title_en: Solar Powered Multilingual Emergency Response Robot And Interactive Artificial Intelligence System For Detecting Hazardous Conditions Within a Motor Vehicle For Prevention of Vehicle Related Deaths.
abstract_en:
Presented is an artificial intelligence interactive Emergency Response Robot for detecting hazardous conditions within a motor vehicle for the prevention of vehicle related deaths. 
     A Virtual Robot based on IBM's Watson cognitive super-computing platform continuously monitors the internal and external environment of the motor vehicle and will automatically commence a rescue sequence in the event it detects a dangerous condition such as a child, or pet left abandoned in an overheated vehicle is detected. 
     When life threatening conditions are detected, the robot's ai simulates a human emergency responder to immediately dispatch assistance to the location and will assume control of the vehicle's electronic system to make adjustments in the environment. 
     The invention functions provides a universal method of connecting artificial intelligence to any vehicle for preserving lives and a method for speedy assistance to victims, and emergency response teams interacting in real time and will substantially decrease vehicle related deaths.

title_en: Visual experimental apparatus of colliery goaf nitrogen injection seepage flow phase transition
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mine ventilation and goaf disaster prevention and reduction, and particularly relates to a nitrogen injection seepage phase change visual experimental device for a coal mine goaf. The nitrogen injection device comprises a liquid nitrogen tank, a movable liquid nitrogen tank bracket, a flowmeter and a liquid nitrogen conveying hose; the visual experiment section consists of a double-layer glass tube, and free accumulation glass pellets are arranged in the inner tube to simulate coal rock collapse accumulation in a coal mine goaf; a liquid nitrogen inlet pipe and a nitrogen outlet pipe are arranged on the side surface of the visual experiment section; and pressure sensors are arranged at the positions of the liquid nitrogen inlet pipe and the nitrogen outlet pipe of the visual experimental section. According to the coal mine goaf nitrogen injection seepage phase change visual experimental device, the goaf is simplified into free-stacked glass pellets, and the visualization of seepage phase change of liquid nitrogen in the experimental device and the pressure loss caused by the visualization can be observed under the conditions of different particle sizes, different porosities and different liquid nitrogen injection speeds.

title_en: BIM-based emergency simulation monitoring method and system
