abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM-based emergency simulation monitoring method and system, which are characterized in that a first BIM model is obtained to obtain first emergency setting information and obtain a first emergency simulation scene; obtaining a first emergency simulation element according to a first emergency simulation scene; obtaining first emergency route information according to the first emergency simulation element and the first emergency setting information; marking the first emergency setting according to the first emergency route information; obtaining first emergency simulation information according to a first emergency simulation scene and a first BIM model; obtaining first monitoring information according to the first emergency simulation information; inputting the first monitoring information and the first emergency simulation scene into an emergency evaluation model to obtain a first emergency evaluation result; judging whether the first emergency evaluation result meets a first preset threshold value or not; a first emergency monitoring report is obtained when satisfied. The technical problems that the capability of a building for resisting natural disasters cannot be checked, and the emergency strategy customization lacks scientific guidance in the prior art are solved.
assignees: JIANGSU HANTIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster evolution path extraction method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting an urban waterlogging disaster evolution path based on a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of constructing an urban waterlogging disaster network graph sample set; sample enhancement is carried out on the urban waterlogging disaster network map sample set; and carrying out graph neural network training on the reinforced urban waterlogging disaster network graph sample to obtain a graph neural network model, and predicting and extracting an evolution path through the graph neural network model. The invention utilizes the graph neural network model, has good adaptability to disaster network interpretation, and applies the attention mechanism and mutual information to the graph neural network, so that the key information of the disaster network can be better extracted, and a good effect can be achieved.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: High altitude training frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-altitude training frame, which belongs to the technical field of high-altitude training frames, and particularly relates to a high-altitude training frame, which comprises a steel structure frame, wherein a plurality of platform frames are arranged at the top and inside of the steel structure frame to divide the steel structure frame into a plurality of training platforms, vertical shaft rescue training parts are connected to the top platform frame, a plurality of groups of vertical lifting and lowering training parts are connected to the outer side of the steel structure frame at equal intervals in a linear mode to realize vertical lifting and lowering training, a transverse transportation training part is arranged on a middle platform frame, a support part is arranged corresponding to the bottom end of the steel structure frame, the integral vertical lifting and lowering training height can be set according to training requirements, the optimal strength of training can be achieved without overload training, the training height is moderate, and the action agility and climbing capability of a plurality of training firefighters are realized.

title_en: Landslide susceptibility assessment method and system based on cross semi-supervised machine learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a landslide susceptibility assessment method and system based on a cross semi-supervised machine learning algorithm. Based on detailed geospatial information such as regional topography, geological conditions, hydrologic weather and the like and historical landslide catalogues, an internal relation between regional landslide disasters and multisource influence factors is built by applying a machine learning model, a plurality of different machine learning algorithms are coupled in a cross semi-supervised learning mode, secondary sample expansion of regional landslide samples is achieved, machine learning model training is conducted based on sample data after the secondary sample expansion, and finally a regional landslide risk level distribution map with higher accuracy is obtained. The design of the invention can solve the problems of insufficient landslide training samples in the area of spent materials and error accumulation in the single model sample expanding process, further improve modeling performance and accuracy of the machine learning model in landslide vulnerability prediction application, and provide technical reference and guidance for regional landslide disaster prevention.
assignees: ZHAOTONG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Landslide easy occurrence area map generation method based on python construction convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster risk assessment analysis, and relates to a landslide easily-occurring region graph generation method based on python construction of a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring initial landslide data and landslide influence factor data of an area to be evaluated; carrying out correlation analysis on the landslide influence factor data to obtain screened landslide influence factor data; preprocessing the initial landslide data set to obtain a training set and a testing set, and optimizing parameters of a convolutional neural network model based on the training set and the testing set to obtain a landslide prediction model; inputting the screened landslide influence factor data into the landslide prediction model to obtain landslide easily-transmitted region result data, and then importing the landslide easily-transmitted region result data into an ArcGIS to perform easily-transmitted region division to obtain a landslide easily-transmitted region map. The method can rapidly and accurately identify the main influence factors of the landslide, and further obtains the map of the landslide easy occurrence area through the model established by the method.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG BAOXINGHE WATER POWER CO LTD;UNIV XIHUA

title_en: Prediction method of lightning ground flash signal based on LSTM (least squares) circulating neural network
abstract_en: The application relates to a prediction method of lightning ground flash signals based on an LSTM circulating neural network. The method comprises the following steps: dividing a training set and a testing set by adopting the processed historical lightning electric field signals, constructing an LSTM model as a lightning electric field signal prediction model to be trained, initializing a weight matrix and a bias matrix of the LSTM model, inputting the training set into the LSTM model, carrying out forward propagation training by adopting a forward propagation algorithm, finishing training of the LSTM model by updating weights and biases by adopting an error back propagation algorithm, obtaining an optimal weight matrix and an optimal bias matrix, inputting the testing set into the LSTM model by adopting the optimal weight matrix and the optimal bias matrix for testing to reach preset precision, and obtaining a lightning electric field signal predicted by the trained lightning electric field signal prediction model in a future preset time period so as to determine whether lightning back shots occur or not and accurately realize lightning ground flash disaster prediction.

title_en: Simulation method and device for personnel evacuation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of personnel evacuation, and discloses a simulation method and a simulation device for personnel evacuation. The method comprises the following steps: dividing a space to be evacuated into a plurality of refuge demand cell units and an exit cell unit; according to a preset rule, determining a static attraction value of each cell unit, and obtaining a crowd density value of each refuge demand cell unit; according to a preset side length threshold value, a static attraction value and a crowd density value of the refuge demand cellular unit and each adjacent static attraction value and crowd density value, determining a crowd change value in the next time step, and carrying out personnel evacuation according to the crowd change value; determining the crowd density value after the next time step according to the crowd density value of the refuge demand cellular unit and the crowd change value in the next time step; if the crowd density value of each refuge demand cell unit of the next time step is zero, the people evacuation is completed. The simulation efficiency can be improved by adopting the method and the device, and the method and the device are suitable for outdoor large-scale crowd evacuation.

title_en: Rain cloud precipitation simulation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rain cloud precipitation simulation method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring three-dimensional outline lattice coordinates of the rain accumulation cloud; according to the three-dimensional outline lattice coordinates of the rain accumulation cloud, constructing a three-dimensional real model of the rain accumulation cloud precipitation, and setting rain accumulation cloud parameters in the three-dimensional real model of the rain accumulation cloud precipitation; the rain cloud parameters comprise a rain cloud volume parameter, a rain cloud movement parameter and a rain cloud precipitation parameter; and simulating a rain accumulation cloud dynamic change process and a rain accumulation cloud precipitation process in the three-dimensional real model of the rain accumulation cloud precipitation according to the rain accumulation cloud parameters. According to the invention, a three-dimensional model of the rain accumulation cloud precipitation is established by using a BIM technology, the change trend of the rain accumulation cloud in a three-dimensional space is simulated, the change process of the rain accumulation cloud is reflected in the three-dimensional area, and the rain accumulation cloud precipitation process is simulated on the basis, so that the accuracy of weather prediction is improved, the risk of weather disasters is reduced, and the method has a certain guiding significance for agricultural development and flood prevention.

title_en: High-adaptability damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-adaptability damage assessment method, and relates to the field of computer vision and disaster emergency response. Firstly, inputting a damaged area data set into a segmentation network and a damage classification network for training to obtain a segmentation network model and a damage classification model, manufacturing a data set T of the area before and after new damage, and inputting the data set T into a two-stage refined damage evaluation neural network to obtain a building segmentation result and a damage classification result. The method has strong adaptability to the new event area, so that the damage classification can be refined quickly and efficiently, the calculation capability and the quick decision capability of the deep neural network are utilized to replace the on-site manual evaluation, the time and energy consumption is greatly reduced, and the damage degree of the building in the disaster area in a large range is judged efficiently under the condition of ensuring the accuracy and timeliness.

title_en: Automatic monitoring system and method for simulating disaster prevention
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic monitoring system and method for simulating disaster prevention, wherein the system comprises the following components: the track side simulation module is used for simulating and setting track side equipment and disaster points in the line according to the input line data; the automatic monitoring and processing module is connected with the trackside simulation module and is used for monitoring whether the disaster point is triggered or not and generating disaster information if the disaster point is triggered; and the dispatching center system is connected with the automatic monitoring and processing module and is used for receiving the disaster information and processing the disaster. The invention seamlessly combines disaster information with a dispatching center system, realizes an intelligent dispatching system and improves railway capacity and safety.

title_en: Unmanned ship-based bank collapse risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bank collapse risk assessment method and a system based on unmanned ships, which are used for judging erosion states of different factors on a river bank in different states by monitoring and data acquisition of the river bank and safety influence factors and adopting a twinning model simulation calculation mode, so that a twinning model for bank collapse risk assessment can be established, feedback is carried out on user requirements according to a predicted condition of risk causes in a predictable range or an average state of corresponding risk causes in a historical period, and bank collapse risk distribution conditions of the river bank in the future period are judged, so that reinforcement and repair can be carried out on a specified high-risk river bank in a targeted manner before the risk comes, and serious disaster conditions caused by untimely bank collapse risk discovery are avoided when extreme weather possibly occurs.
assignees: WUHAN HUACE SATELLITE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster identification method and fire disaster identification device based on aerial image
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a fire identification method and fire identification device based on aerial images, the method comprising obtaining aerial images taken by a flyable platform; inputting the aerial image into a target fire disaster identification model, and outputting a fire disaster identification result, wherein the fire disaster identification result comprises fire disaster identification information representing whether a fire disaster exists in the aerial image and position mark information corresponding to a fire disaster occurrence position under the condition that the fire disaster exists in the aerial image; the target fire disaster recognition model is obtained by training a target neural network by utilizing a target training set, and the target neural network is constructed according to a single target detection model and a global attention mechanism module.

title_en: Bid price clearing simulation method, system, chip and equipment for future power market
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bidding clearing simulation method, a system, a chip and equipment for a future electric power market, which are used for generating a market bidding model comprising a generator bidding model and a market centralization clearing model; constructing an intelligent quotation model based on reinforcement learning based on the obtained market bidding model; training the constructed intelligent quotation model based on reinforcement learning, realizing bid clear simulation by using the trained intelligent quotation model, solving the problem of dimension disaster caused by the increase of the number of power generators in the current reinforcement learning intelligent quotation method, and realizing the simulation of participation of large-scale market members in strategy quotation.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon vortex initialization method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a typhoon vortex initialization method based on artificial intelligence, which provides more comprehensive typhoon behavior information by combining various meteorological data sources, preprocesses data and converts the data into a data set suitable for a machine learning model, performs feature learning and pattern recognition on the data by applying a deep learning model comprising a contraction path and an expansion path and jump connection, extracts key features and patterns of typhoons, constructs typhoons vortex structures and predicts typhoons paths and strength by applying a trained deep learning model to real-time meteorological data, and updates and improves the prediction capability of the deep learning model by continuous data collection and model training. The method can realize more accurate typhoon vortex initialization, remarkably improve the accuracy and efficiency of typhoon path and strength prediction, and provide effective technical support for typhoon early warning and disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Flood water depth estimation method based on public opinion short video big data and YOLOv5 algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood water depth estimation method based on public opinion short video big data and a YOLOv5 algorithm. Acquiring video data related to a target disaster from a media short video platform; preprocessing the collected data; performing text data processing analysis using Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques; selecting a YOLOv5 (You Only Look Once version 5) algorithm for training a city flood ponding reference object model; calculating the water accumulation depth according to the relation between the true height difference and the pixel height difference between the objects and the water surface; and correlating the estimated ponding depth data with related positioning and release time data, establishing a space-time data set, performing space-time data visualization, and deducing a space-time evolution trend. According to the method, the urban flood water depth automatic estimation with low cost, quick detection and high accuracy is realized through the short video big data and the YOLOv5 algorithm, so that the quantitative analysis and judgment of the disaster condition are carried out.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: High-level landslide contrast test device and method for complex terrain dynamics simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of landslide hazard prevention and control, and discloses a high-level landslide contrast test device and method for dynamic simulation of complex terrains. The three-dimensional sliding comparison simulation platform comprises a sliding system, a sliding accumulation area and a monitoring system. The sliding system comprises more than two sliding ways, a sliding control system and a gradient control system. The more than two slide ways at least comprise a straight slot slide way and a curved slot slide way. The sliding control system and the gradient control system are used for controlling the simulated sliding process, the monitoring system is used for information monitoring, the whole process simulation of the sliding body can be realized, the dynamic effect in the motion process of the sliding body is intuitively researched, the motion parameters and the dynamic effect rules of the sliding body are obtained, meanwhile, the characteristic information such as the gradient, the bending degree and the gradient of the sliding way can be regulated and set, the motion and accumulation characteristics of the sliding body under different conditions are formed, and scientific basis is provided for prediction and prevention and control of the sliding disaster.

title_en: Mine hydrogeological information management system based on informatization
abstract_en: The invention provides an informationized-based mine hydrogeologic information management system, which is characterized in that a hydrofundamental information database module is used for collecting hydrogeologic data of a mine to construct a fundamental information database; the hydrogeological graphic file management module is used for carrying out drilling digitization, two-dimensional profile drawing and contour drawing according to hydrogeological data; the goaf ponding management module is used for counting ponding conditions of the mine goaf and carrying out three-dimensional display on ponding bodies of the goaf; the water drainage auxiliary design module is used for carrying out drilling layout, drawing a drilling structure and calculating drilling engineering quantity by combining a mine drilling hole layout mode; the water disaster forecasting module is used for establishing a water disaster case base and forecasting the water disaster in the mine by combining a mine forecasting system. The system can realize classified storage and efficient management of the mine hydrogeology basic information, reduces the working intensity of technicians, and simultaneously strengthens basic works such as water control.
assignees: YANKUANG ENERGY GROUP CO LTD;XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Inflammability evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flammability evaluation and prediction, and particularly provides a flammability evaluation method, device and equipment for combustibles, and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting vegetation data and historical fire point data of a research area from the monitored remote sensing data; acquiring index factors required by model training from the extracted data; taking the index factor as an independent variable, and inputting whether fire disaster occurs or not as a two-classification dependent variable into a Logistic model; dividing the index factor data into data sets according to different vegetation pixels, dividing the data sets into training data and verification data, and training and optimizing the model according to different vegetation pixels to obtain model parameters of different vegetation pixels; and acquiring a pixel point at a set position of the research area, extracting an index factor of the position of the pixel point, inputting the index factor into a trained model, and calculating a flammable annual change curve of the combustible of the pixel point. And training the model according to vegetation types, and improving the precision of the model.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RES INSTITUTE UESTC HUZHOU

title_en: Power transmission line geological disaster risk identification method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for identifying geological disaster risk of a power transmission line, which are used for fusing remote sensing image data, geological image data and human moving image data in the range of a power transmission line channel into multi-band image data, constructing a training data set by using multi-band image data, constructing a power transmission line geological disaster risk identification model by using a multi-layer perception neural network, using the probability of geological disaster occurrence of the power transmission line as a label, training the power transmission line geological disaster risk identification model constructed by using the multi-layer perception neural network by using the training data set to obtain a target power transmission line geological disaster risk identification model, automatically identifying the geological disaster risk of the power transmission line based on the target power transmission line geological disaster risk identification model, providing a reference for the power transmission line geological disaster risk investigation work, and solving the technical problems that the conventional manual investigation of the power transmission line has great geological disaster risk difficulty and cannot meet the requirement of geological disaster timeliness.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Karst depression waterlogging submerged water depth forecast analysis method based on hydrologic model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a karst depression waterlogging submerged water depth forecasting and analyzing method based on a hydrologic model. Aiming at the problems that the water circulation mechanism of a karst river basin is complex, the flow at the water elimination point of the karst depression is difficult to directly measure and an effective karst depression waterlogging forecast analysis method is lacked, the invention adopts a hydrologic model to simulate the flow process of the slope inflow flood of the karst depression, constructs a karst depression waterlogging submerged water depth calculation analysis model according to the key hydrologic process of the karst depression, provides a karst depression waterlogging-drainage process calculation equation set and an iteration solution method thereof, and solves the problems of the forecasting analysis of the karst depression waterlogging disaster elements such as the submerged water depth process, the maximum submerged water depth occurrence time and the like in each hour. The method has the advantages of low requirements on hydrologic and geological data and high accuracy of the result of forecasting the submerged water depth of the waterlogged land, and is easy to popularize and apply in forecasting the submerged water depth of the waterlogged land with the water level gauge in the karst flow area.

title_en: Power grid transmission line fault prediction method and system under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid transmission line fault prediction method and a system under extreme weather, which are characterized in that the method comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring historical power flow data on a power grid power transmission line, and acquiring short-time predicted power flow data on the power grid power transmission line by adopting an Informir algorithm; and step 2, inputting the short-time predicted power flow data and the predicted extreme weather data into a power grid fault prediction model obtained after pre-training to output a fault prediction result of the power grid transmission line. The method is effective and reliable, the occurrence probability of risks or faults caused by extreme weather is fully reduced, and the capacity and reliability of the power grid for resisting extreme disasters are greatly improved.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Geological drilling tool and method for treating thin unconsolidated layer coal mining subsidence area by using same
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster management of coal mining subsidence areas, in particular to a geological drilling tool and a method for managing a thin loose layer coal mining subsidence area by using the same. Adopting a prefabricated partition wall to block the water-bearing layer outside the through crack area to supply water to the through crack area, and then discharging all accumulated water in the through crack area; then, injecting fly ash material into the falling zone for compaction, and then injecting cement slurry into the water guide fracture zone for compaction; then stripping earth surface soil in the through crack region to be flush with the bottom boundary of the water-resisting layer in the non-staggered layer regions at the two sides, and paving the stratum structure which is the same as that of the non-staggered layer regions at the two sides from bottom to top; and finally, pulling out the top block of the isolation wall, and facilitating the top block of the isolation wall to reconstruct soil in the isolation ditch, thereby completing reclamation. Aiming at the working condition of a thin loose layer, the disaster treatment method for the coal mining subsidence area based on the partition wall is provided, waterproof materials are not required to be injected, a freezing technology is not required to be adopted, the subsidence area treatment efficiency is improved, and the subsidence area treatment cost is reduced.
assignees: THE FIRST PROSPECTING TEAM OF SHANDONG COALFIELD GEOLOGY BUREAU

title_en: Deep learning-assisted falling stone impact force non-contact automatic prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-assisted falling stone impact force non-contact automatic prediction method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: real-time tracking module of falling stone motion trail: the method comprises the steps of adopting a high-speed camera to remotely and non-contact monitor the whole-process image sequence of a falling rock impact protective net system, and utilizing a pretrained Swin-converter deep learning network to track and identify the whole process of a falling rock movement track; and a falling stone impact force high-precision prediction module: the method comprises the steps of extracting a falling stone impact force and displacement time course by using a pre-established accurate finite element model, creating a training data set, modeling a complex relation between the falling stone impact force and the displacement time course by using a sequence-to-sequence transducer neural network based on a self-attention mechanism, and predicting the impact force time course of the falling stone acting on a protective network system with high precision by using a non-contact monitoring falling stone displacement image sequence as network input. The invention has the advantages of non-contact, remote monitoring and high-precision prediction, and improves the performance rapid assessment and emergency repair efficiency of the flexible protection system under the falling rock disasters.

title_en: Urban water-lowering and draining simulation analysis method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a city water-lowering and drainage simulation analysis method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a three-dimensional real scene model of a city; then, acquiring rain cloud three-dimensional data from meteorological data, constructing a rain cloud precipitation three-dimensional real model by adopting a BIM technology based on the rain cloud three-dimensional data and the urban three-dimensional real model, and calculating drainage parameters of a target area in the urban three-dimensional real model; and finally, predicting the ponding state of the target area according to the drainage and water lowering parameters of the target area. According to the method, the urban three-dimensional live-action model and the rain-accumulating cloud precipitation three-dimensional live-action model are established by using the BIM modeling technology, inflow, precipitation, overflow and drainage of the urban target area in a certain period are calculated, and then the ponding state of the urban target area is analyzed and predicted, so that the urban flood disaster is predicted in advance, the influence and the duration after the flood disaster occurs can be simulated and analyzed, and support is provided for preventing and controlling the urban flood disaster.

title_en: Forestry insect disaster prediction method and system based on regional historical data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forestry insect disaster prediction method and a system based on regional history data, which relate to the technical field of forestry management and comprise the following steps: data acquisition, model construction, factor analysis, pest situation prediction and result adjustment. According to the method, the relationship between local climate data and the forest insect disaster is analyzed, the climate change in a future period is predicted through analysis of the historical climate in the area, the development trend of the forest insect pest in the area in the future period is predicted according to the future climate change condition, and the training model is perfected and optimized through data of nearly three years in the process, so that the prediction result of the development trend of the forest insect pest is more accurate, the prediction result is adjusted by combining factors such as insect pest control measures and planning of the forest in the future area, and the prediction of the development trend of the forest insect pest is further improved more accurately.

title_en: Interval evacuation test method and system based on subway emergency faults
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a test method and a test device for section evacuation based on subway emergency faults, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining configuration information, configuring each section evacuation test type, and functions and data of each section evacuation test type, so as to realize the configuration of various section evacuation modes on application examples; determining interval evacuation test types and corresponding function configuration information according to the test configuration information, and generating test cases according to the case test description information; the use case test description information comprises test contents, a train and an initial state of train operation, a test flow and description information of expected results of execution of steps of each flow; and executing the test cases to simulate train interval evacuation operation under the corresponding fault scenes, and realizing automatic test of train interval evacuation under each fault scene. The technical problem that the interval evacuation test scheme in the related art needs to be manually set to cause low test efficiency and precision is solved.
assignees: OPERATION BRANCH OF NINGBO RAIL TRANSIT GROUP CO LTD;TRAFFIC CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for determining critical value of drilling stress monitoring and early warning index of coal mine rock burst coal seam
abstract_en: A method for determining a critical value of a drilling stress monitoring and early warning index of a coal mine rock burst coal bed comprises the following steps: 1) Testing the physical parameters of coal in surrounding rocks of a roadway to be pre-warned; 2) Calculating near-field critical stress P of roadway rock burst to be pre-warned  mcr  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the 3) Calculating near-field actual stress P of roadway to be pre-warned  0  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the 4) According to the near-field critical stress and the actual stress of the rock burst, calculating the critical mining stress sigma of the coal body of the rock burst of the roadway to be pre-warned  cr  'A'; 5) Calculating the critical value sigma of the rock burst coal seam drilling stress monitoring and early warning index according to the critical mining stress of the coal body and the initial installation stress of the drilling stress meter when the rock burst occurs  cr  . The invention solves the problem of the current theoretical calculation method of the critical value of the drilling stress monitoring and early warning index of the coal seam lacking rock burst disasters,provides theoretical guidance for accurately monitoring the rock burst disasters of the coal mine.

title_en: Method for controlling gas disasters in mining areas of underground synergetic coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling gas disasters in a mining area of a well and a ground collaborative coal mine, which comprises the steps of firstly implementing coal bed gas stored in a mining area working face tunneling strip roadway in a coal mine exploitation area stage, determining a gas control mode of the rest coal bed stoping working face after the tunneling of the preferred strip roadway in the mining area strip roadway is completed, wherein the control mode depends on an included angle between the minimum principal stress direction of a stratum and the tunneling strip roadway direction, and carrying out underground negative pressure gas efficient extraction of the coal mine based on a drilled roof fracturing drilling hole, a coal bed fracturing drilling hole or a coal bed gas extraction bedding drilling hole. The invention can reduce the gas content of the coal seam to the minimum required standard of coal seam mining at 8m  3 /t and the gas pressure of the coal seam to be less than 0.74MPa only in the development area and the preparation area in the whole life production cycle of the coal mine, thereby effectively ensuring the coal mine mining succession, ensuring the efficient and safe production of the coal mine in the production area, reducing the gas treatment cost and realizing the integrated gas disaster treatment.

title_en: Disaster relief skill training simulation method and system for relief personnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wounded rescue skill training, in particular to a disaster rescue skill training simulation method and system for rescue personnel, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a mode selection instruction sent by a user; entering a parameter setting interface of a corresponding mode according to a mode selection instruction, and when the parameter setting interface of the entered mode is a training mode parameter setting interface, further comprising: displaying an emergency rescue scene selection control area in a parameter setting interface; acquiring an emergency rescue scene type selected by a user; acquiring emergency rescue scene data of a corresponding type according to the selected emergency rescue scene type; acquiring and displaying the corresponding injury type and treatment tool type on a display screen; generating a training list according to the emergency rescue scene data and the injury type and the rescue tool type selected by the user; and after acquiring an instruction for confirming the start of training by a user, starting to enter a training phase. The invention can improve the treatment skills of students under the disaster condition.
assignees: GENERAL HOSPITAL OF CENTRAL PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY

title_en: Urban flood disaster early warning method for navigation vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a navigation vehicle-oriented urban flood disaster early warning method, which belongs to the field of urban flood disaster early warning, and comprises the steps of obtaining simulation data and monitoring data, and obtaining an urban flood risk map by utilizing an urban map according to the simulation data and the monitoring data; starting navigation and acquiring a vehicle departure place and a vehicle destination; obtaining the longest vehicle running time by utilizing a navigation system according to the departure place and the destination of the vehicle; and carrying out flood disaster early warning by utilizing the urban flood risk map according to the longest vehicle running time, the vehicle departure place and the vehicle destination. The method solves the problems of accurate early warning and route planning of the navigation vehicle in the flood disasters, and improves the urban flood disaster early warning accuracy facing the navigation vehicle.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Digital twin drainage basin characteristic element identification method based on intelligent calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-stream domain feature element identification method based on intelligent computation, which is mainly oriented to feature elements with dynamic characteristics, such as wading engineering operation, disaster evolution, flow fields and the like, which change along with time. Aiming at the problems of obvious time variability, concealment and weakness of dynamic characteristic elements, an intelligent calculation model for simulating a double-flow mechanism is innovatively provided, and error accumulation of digital twin-flow-domain characteristic element identification is reduced.

title_en: Method for forecasting typhoon long-distance precipitation based on machine learning and intelligent forecasting factors
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for forecasting typhoon remote precipitation based on machine learning and intelligent predictor, which comprises the steps of collecting and sorting multisource meteorological observation data, constructing a typhoon remote strong precipitation data set in northern areas of China by utilizing a recognition method combining subjective and objective of typhoon precipitation process, analyzing space-time distribution characteristics, influence mechanisms and main types of typhoon remote strong precipitation by using an algorithm based on machine learning, carrying out diagnostic analysis on typical examples based on a high-resolution numerical simulation test, and constructing an intelligent quaternary wind gushing index applicable to implicit typhoon influence of typhoon remote strong precipitation in northern areas of China from the aspect of warm and humid air activity IMI And the intelligent prediction factor is used as an intelligent prediction factor to realize the prediction of the typhoons in northern areas from long-distance strong precipitation. The invention improves the prediction accuracy of the typhoon in the northern area of China for long-distance strong precipitation by utilizing the techniques of machine learning and the likeThe degree and stability provide scientific support for urban safe operation and disaster prevention and reduction in northern areas.

title_en: Simulation physical combustion training device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting training devices, and discloses a simulated physical combustion training device, which comprises an outer shell, wherein supporting legs are integrally formed at the bottom of the outer shell, a solid combustion tank, a liquid combustion tank and a gas combustion tank are respectively arranged in the outer shell, the solid combustion tank comprises a supporting screen fixedly arranged in the outer shell, and the liquid combustion tank comprises a plurality of baffles which are arranged in a rectangular shape. This simulation burning trainer in kind, through having solid combustion pond, liquid combustion pond and gas combustion pond at the inside integration of shell body, the firefighter of being convenient for carries out simulation training to the combustible material of different states, can observe the concrete information and the various data of combustible material of various states when burning simultaneously at the in-process of training, can make firefighter carry out the record to these data to can make firefighter in time make correct reply when the combustible material of different states fires in face.

title_en: Method for archiving backup data to object storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for archiving backup data to object storage, which comprises the following operations: the backup data are filed in the filing storage in a blocking mode, if the data of the blocks are the same, one copy is saved in the object storage, and after the filing of all the data blocks is completed, the metadata file is uploaded to the object storage; when the archive data is needed, the backup data in the object storage can be directly simulated into a block device file in a local mode without a time-consuming recovery process, the block device file is mapped in an ISCSI or NFS mode, and an external virtualization platform or disaster recovery platform can directly start a virtual machine or disaster recovery machine from the block device after the virtual block device is connected through the NFS or the ISCSI.
assignees: AEROSPACE YIJINZHI JIANGSU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency drilling management and evaluation analysis system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of emergency exercises, and particularly discloses an emergency exercise management and evaluation analysis system. The embodiment of the invention provides an emergency drilling management and evaluation analysis system, which comprises the following components: an information receiving processing unit; a video data acquisition unit; an action feature acquisition unit; a monitoring position determining unit; a drilling monitoring shooting unit; a motion recognition recording unit; and a security evaluation analysis unit. The emergency exercise safety management system can receive safety management information of emergency exercises, acquire a plurality of management action features through simulation analysis, monitor and shoot in the emergency exercise process, further conduct action recognition and recording, generate recognition record information, conduct emergency exercise process safety evaluation analysis, achieve emergency exercise process safety management and evaluation, improve emergency exercise process safety consciousness, and accordingly avoid safety accidents in the exercise process, real disasters or sudden accidents.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating urban flood disaster grade
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating urban flood disaster grades, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of constructing a flood simulation model by using traffic network and terrain information, carrying out flood disaster simulation based on weather prediction information to obtain a flood risk area set, and synchronizing the flood risk area set to a flood disaster evaluation network to obtain M local flood warning water levels; and carrying out data integration of M local flood warning water levels according to the traffic network and M regional position identifiers to obtain the flood disaster level. The technical problems that in the prior art, concern analysis on urban traffic influence is less, and urban resident travel safety is affected due to the fact that resident travel in flood disaster weather can be referred to less information are solved. The urban road paralysis state analysis based on urban rainfall scientization is realized, and the traffic flood disaster grade of the urban road availability degree and the urban road availability safety degree in a real-time weather state is obtained, so that the technical effect of reference is provided for urban resident traveling.

title_en: Multi-feature fusion volcanic disaster prediction system based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-feature fusion volcanic disaster prediction system based on a deep neural network, which relates to the technical field of natural disaster prediction and comprises the following steps: the central processing module is connected with the data acquisition module, the database and the display processing module; the central processing module obtains a standard curve, a eruption probability and an energy storage threshold value based on the historical data; generating estimated eruption probability of the acquired data based on the similarity parameter and the estimated parameter; the period length of the next acquisition period is adjusted based on the similarity parameter. According to the method, the similarity model is obtained by training the deep neural network model through the temperature data, the gas data and the geological data in the historical data, the same volcanic multiple data are comprehensively considered, and different volcanic multiple data are jointly considered, so that the trained similarity model is more accurate, and further the estimated result is more accurate.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ENG SCIENCE;JILIN CHANGBAI MOUNTAIN TIANCHI HUOSHAN MONITORING STATION;INST OF GEOLOGY CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION;UNIV SHANGHAI

title_en: Locust density inversion method based on remote sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a locust density inversion method based on a remote sensing technology, which utilizes remote sensing data and meteorological observation data to obtain a locust density inversion model by constructing, training and testing a support vector machine model, and performs locust density inversion based on the locust density inversion model. Compared with the meteorological observation data, the remote sensing data has higher spatial resolution and higher precision, and compared with the locust density inversion method which only uses the meteorological observation data, the method disclosed by the invention simultaneously uses multi-source data comprising the remote sensing data and the meteorological observation data, and improves the accuracy of locust density inversion and locust disaster prediction. The remote sensing data is more rapid and convenient to acquire, so that the method is suitable for inversion and prediction of the locust disaster in a large range. In addition, the establishment of the inversion model is based on a support vector machine model, and compared with a multiple linear regression model, most of data related to locust density and locust plague can be comprehensively considered, and nonlinear relations can be better processed.

title_en: Movable fire detector and system for detecting fire using the same
title_ko: 이동식 화재 감지기 및 이를 이용한 화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to immediately detect the occurrence of a fire or the risk of a fire in a construction site, an industrial site, and the like where electric facilities, communication facilities, firefighting facilities, and the like are not provided, and to promptly guide a worker to evacuate. A fire monitoring system comprises: a plurality of movable fire detectors installed to be movable at regular intervals to detect a fire occurrence or a fire risk in a target site without an electric facility, a communication facility, and a firefighting facility; a server receiving and analyzing fire-related data to generate an evacuation scenario in real time; a fire detection unit detecting a fire at 360 degrees; an image recognition unit recognizing a thermal image and an image; a control unit calculating a distance to a fire direction and a fire source and controlling the image recognition unit; a data transmission unit sequentially transmitting a mesh network configuration of the movable fire detector and fire data; a long-distance communication module transmitting data to the server; and an artificial intelligence-based route recommendation unit analyzing route information to recommend an arrangement and an installation position of the fire detector.
abstract_ko: 이동식 화재 감지기 및 이를 이용한 화재 감시 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예들에 따르면, 복수 개의 이동식 화재 감지기가 상호 LOS(Line of Sight)를 유지하도록 중간에 장애물이 없는 직선 거리 상에 이동식으로 배치되고 근거리 통신모듈을 이용하여 상호 통신하도록 구성됨으로써, 전기시설, 통신시설 및 소방시설이 구비되어 있지 않은 공사현장, 산업현장 등에서도 화재발생 또는 화재위험을 즉각적으로 검출하여 원격에 알릴 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명의 실시예들에 따르면, 복수 개의 이동식 화재 감지기가 대피 시나리오에 따라 복수 개의 엘이디 모듈 또는 음성 출력모듈을 이용하여 대피경로, 대피방향 등을 작업자에게 안내하도록 함으로써, 화재발생 또는 화재위험 발생시 작업자의 즉각적인 대피를 보다 손쉽게 유도할 수 있다. 특히, 이러한 대피 시나리오는 이동식 화재 감지기 각각에서 생성된 화재관련 데이터와 화재관련 데이터의 전달경로를 기반으로 실시간으로 생성되고, 화재의 발생장소, 확산방향 및 위험정도를 기반으로 동적으로 변경되도록 함으로써, 대상현장 및 화재의 특성에 맞는 최적화된 대피안내를 가능하게 한다.

title_en: Method for simulating storm surge damage level using decision tree model
title_ko: 의사결정나무 모델을 활용한 폭풍해일 피해수준의 모의 방법
abstract_en: The present invention may comprise the steps of: collecting and processing natural disaster situation statistics information to generate damage level information by a storm tsunami for each of eight damage areas; collecting marine information, weather information, and typhoon information for each damage area, and calculating distance information between the damage area and a typhoon; training a decision tree model by using the damage level information, weather information, typhoon information, and distance information between the damage area and the typhoon by the storm tsunami for each damage area as training data; and simulating the damage level by the storm tsunami when a typhoon occurs by using the trained decision tree model.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자연재난상황통계 정보를 수집 및 가공하여 8개의 피해권역별로 폭풍해일에 의한 피해수준 정보를 생성하는 단계; 상기 피해권역별 해양 정보, 기상 정보 및 태풍 정보를 수집하고, 상기 피해권역과 태풍과의 거리 정보를 산출하는 단계; 상기 피해권역별 폭풍해일에 의한 피해수준 정보, 기상 정보, 태풍 정보, 및 상기 피해권역과 태풍과의 거리 정보를 학습 데이터로 사용하여 의사결정나무 모델을 학습시키는 단계; 및 학습된 의사결정나무 모델을 이용하여 태풍 발생 시 폭풍해일에 의한 피해 수준을 모의하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Simulation System for Evaluating Emergency Call Unit Performance
title_ko: 비상 대응 단말의 성능 평가를 위한 모의실험 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency response terminal provided in a vehicle to notify an emergency rescue center of the occurrence of an accident when a traffic accident occurs. More specifically, a vehicle and sensor signal generator, a GNSS/GPS simulator, and a commercial communication network simulator are detachably connected to each emergency response terminal, and the emergency response terminal, a PSAP simulation system, and the GNSS/GPS simulator are connected to a performance test evaluation system, respectively, so that the emergency response terminal can be simulated and the performance thereof can be evaluated.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차량에 구비되어 교통사고 발생시 긴급구난센터로 사고 발생 사실을 알리는 비상 대응 단말에 관한 것으로, 좀 더 구체적으로 설명하면 각 비상 대응 단말에 자동차 및 센서신호 제너리어터와 GNSS/GPS시뮬레이터와 상용통신망 시뮬레이터를 각각 탈착 가능하게 연결하고 상기 비상 대응 단말과 PSAP 시뮬레이션 시스템과 GNSS/GPS 시뮬레이터는 각각 성능시험 평가시스템에 연결함으로써, 비상 대응 단말을 모의실험하고 그 성능을 평가할 수 있게 구비된 것이다.
assignees: INNOCA CO LTD;KIAPI KOREA INTELLIGENT AUTOMOTIVE PARTS PROMOTION INST

title_en: An all-in-one electric vehicle automatic fire extinguisher equipped with a lift to lift a vehicle and a hydraulic steel punch assembly to pierce a hole to extinguish a fire in a lithium ion battery pack
title_ko: 리튬이온배터리 팩의 화재를 진압하기 위한 차량을 드는 리프트와 구멍을 뚫는 유압 강철 펀치 조립체를 부착한 일체형 EV(Electric Vehicle)용 자동소화장치 및 소화방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic fire extinguishing device for an electric vehicle, and more particularly, to an integrated automatic fire extinguishing device for an electric vehicle, which is equipped with a vehicle-lifting lift and a hydraulic steel punch assembly for drilling holes for extinguishing a fire in a lithium-ion battery pack. In particular, the present invention relates to an automatic fire extinguishing device for an electric vehicle, which can prevent a fire caused by thermal runaway (1,350℃) of a lithium-ion battery pack during charging or while it is parked. Furthermore, the present invention relates to an automatic fire extinguishing device for an electric vehicle, which can easily extinguish a fire in a lithium-ion battery pack at an early stage even in a place where fire extinguishing agents cannot be injected into the inside because it is sealed with an iron plate, and where even if a fire truck comes, it cannot enter an underground parking lot, thereby preventing a large-scale fire caused by a fire in a lithium-ion battery pack.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전기자동차용 자동소화장치에 관한 것으로 상세하게는 리튬이온배터리 팩의 화재를 진압하기 위한 차량을 드는 리프트와 구멍을 뚫는 유압 강철 펀치 조립체를 부착한 일체형 전기자동차용 자동소화장치에 관한 것이다. 
특히 본 발명은 충전 도중에 또는 주차 중에 리튬이온배터리 팩의 열 폭주(1,350℃)에 의한 화재를 방지할 수 있는 전기자동차용 자동소화장치에 관한 것이다. 
더욱이 본 발명은 철판으로 밀봉되어 내부로 소화 약제를 투입이 불가하고, 소방차가 오더라도 지하주차장에는 진입이 불가한 장소에서도 용이하게 리튬이온배터리 팩의 화재를 초기에 진압함에 의해 리튬이온배터리 팩의 화재로 인한 대형화재로 발생하는 것을 방지할 수 있는 전기자동차용 자동소화장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A perforated fire extinguishing device for EV(Electric Vehicle) consisting of a drilling machine attached with a hydraulic steel punch assembly to extinguish a fire in a lithium ion battery pack and a lift machine to lift a vehicle
title_ko: 리튬이온배터리 팩의 화재를 진압하기 위한 유압 강철 펀치 조립체를 부착한 타공 작기와 차량을 들어 올리는 리프트 작기로 구성된 전기자동차용 타공소화장치 및 이를 이용한 소화 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a perforated fire extinguishing device for an electric vehicle. when extinguishing a fire occurring in a lithium ion battery pack sealed with an iron plate, the iron plate sealed with the lithium ion battery pack is punched so that a fire extinguishing agent can be put into the inside, so that the fire occurring in the lithium ion battery pack can be extinguished at an early stage, thereby preventing the spread of the fire (heat runaway 1,350°c) occurring in the lithium ion battery pack before the fire truck comes, thereby preventing a large-scale fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 철판으로 밀봉된 리튬이온배터리 팩에서 발생하는 화재를 진압할 때, 리튬이온배터리 팩을 밀봉한 철판을 천공하여 내부로 소화 약재를 투입할 수 있게 함에 따라 리튬이온배터리 팩에 발생한 화재를 초기에 진압할 수 있어, 소방차가 오기 전에 리튬이온배터리 팩에 발생한 화재(열 폭주 1,350℃)의 확산을 방지할 수 있게 하여 대형화재를 방지할 수 있게 한 전기자동차용 타공 소화장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: 15-min navigable fireproof test assessment method for lubricating oil cooling device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of engine airworthiness verification, and particularly discloses a 15-min airworthiness fireproof test assessment method for an lubricating oil cooling device, which is used for identifying the flame direction of the lubricating oil cooling device when ignition or fire occurs during installation and use on an engine; performing weak surface analysis when firing; the actual working condition of the lubricating oil cooling device when fire or fire happens on the engine is identified; determining the combustion position and direction during a fireproof test, and the installation position of a fireproof test tool and an exhaust valve; performing a fireproof test according to standard flame, and monitoring the flow, pressure and temperature change in the whole fireproof test process in real time; the lubricating oil cooling device determines a fire test success criterion according to the specification of the industry standard and the characteristics and functions of the cooling device; and judging whether the test passes the navigable fire prevention test. The invention can accurately simulate the operation condition and the operation characteristic of the cooling device when the fire disaster actually occurs, determine the assessment test scheme of the airworthiness fireproof test, give the structural optimization direction of the device, and avoid the risk that the fireproof airworthiness test fails in advance.
assignees: XINXIANG AVIATION IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin platform-based large-scale place crowd emergency evacuation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale place crowd emergency evacuation method based on a digital twin platform, which relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation, and comprises the steps of collecting movement tracks of crowds in a place to be evacuated, constructing a road network image of the place to be evacuated, emergency planning a crowd emergency evacuation scheme, and pushing the emergency evacuation scheme to a handheld terminal and a crowd evacuation deduction simulation platform; the crowd emergency evacuation is carried out according to an emergency evacuation scheme of the handheld terminal, the actual track of the crowd is fed back in real time, and the crowd evacuation deduction simulation platform synchronously deducts the crowd evacuation state to generate the crowd simulation track; judging whether the deviation of the actual track of the crowd and the simulated track of the crowd meets a set threshold value, if not, pushing deviation correction alarm information to the person deviating from the track until emergency evacuation is finished; the invention has low evacuation cost, can send alarm information to partial deviated crowd, realizes the purpose of 'virtual control and real control', and improves evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Calibration method and related device of large-scale hydrologic model suitable for flood and great disaster
abstract_en: The application discloses a calibration method of a large-scale hydrologic model applicable to flood disasters, which is applied to the technical field of hydrologic modeling. In the method, the actual measurement data of flood events of the target river basin, which comprise events of at least two disaster grades, are obtained; constructing a hydrological model to be processed of a target river basin; simulating the flood event by utilizing the hydrologic model to be processed to obtain simulation data of the flood event; and determining the numerical value of the model parameter by using the measured data of the flood event, the simulation data of the flood event and the objective function to obtain the hydrological model of the target river basin. The objective function is a weighted sum of sub-objective functions corresponding to at least two disaster grades. The influence degree of the data of the flood events of different disaster grades on the model parameter values can be adjusted by utilizing the weights of the sub-objective functions of different disaster grades included in the objective function, so that the simulation effect of the hydrologic model on the flood of the specific disaster grade is improved.
assignees: CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CORP;CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CATASTRIAL RISK MAN CO LTD

title_en: Fireproof test device and method
abstract_en: The application provides a fireproof test device and a fireproof test method, wherein the fireproof test device is used for detecting a to-be-tested piece and comprises a heating piece, a heated piece and a first temperature detection piece, and the heating piece is used for heating the to-be-tested piece; the heating piece is used for being arranged at one side of the to-be-tested piece, which is away from the heating piece, and is provided with a groove part which is arranged towards the heating piece and is used for limiting a heating cavity with the to-be-tested piece; according to the fire-proof structure, the to-be-tested piece is the fire-proof structure of the immersed tube tunnel pipe joint connector, the first temperature detection piece is arranged in the heated cavity, and the temperature in the heated cavity is obtained, so that the temperature of the connector when a fire disaster occurs in the tunnel is simulated and detected, and the to-be-tested piece suitable for the connector can be screened.

title_en: Geological disaster coupling simulation test system
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster coupling simulation test system, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster coupling simulation tests. The geological disaster coupling simulation test system comprises a main body model box, a water supply water tank, a rainfall device, a water pumping device and a gantry crane device, wherein the water tanks are respectively arranged on two sides of an escalator at one side of the main body model box, and the top rainfall device is used for loading and unloading test soil bodies. The multi-layer variable-depth pressure-bearing water exploitation simulation can be realized by adopting the water supply tank and the pumping well device, the multi-form fracture activity simulation can be realized by adopting the main body model box jack power system, the fracture activity and the pressure-bearing water exploitation can be combined to realize the joint forming process and disaster-causing simulation, the influence of the surface water effect on the joint forming process can be simulated by the rainfall device, and the geological disaster coupling simulation test system has the characteristics of multiple functions and wide application.

title_en: Information processor, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a technology for managing training which a user conducts.SOLUTION: A video presentation block 120 presents reproduced video of any of plural kinds of disasters to a user. A disaster experience presentation block 121 provides the user with virtual experience concerning at least one of the plural kinds of disasters. A discovery opportunity presentation block 122 presents a virtual environment, where a dangerous spot which the user is requested to find is hidden, on the assumption that the video presentation block 120 has presented the reproduced video to the user and the disaster experience presentation block 121 has presented the virtual experience to the user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Geological disaster forecasting and early warning method and system for oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a geological disaster forecasting, early warning and system of an oil and gas pipeline, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a to-be-monitored pipe section and a corresponding to-be-monitored area of the oil and gas pipeline through historical disaster dangerous points and geological evaluation disaster points, then recovering optical image information and elevation information of the shielded area through remote sensing image data of each view angle for the condition of shielding, further fusing to obtain a fused image containing the remote sensing image information of the shielded area, and finally carrying out forecasting, early warning on landslide or collapse disasters on the to-be-monitored pipe section based on the fused image by utilizing a pre-training early warning model after domain adaptation of the fused image. According to the scheme, through recovery and fusion of the optical image information and the elevation information of the shielding area, prediction and early warning failure under the shielding condition can be avoided, and accurate prediction and early warning can be ensured.

title_en: Flood forecast error correction method based on Volterra series filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood forecast error correction method based on a Volterra series filter, which belongs to the fields of hydrologic water resources, hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering and emergency disaster prevention, and comprises the following steps of obtaining storm flood data, and adopting a Xinanjiang model for simulation to obtain a model residual sequence; modeling a new Anjiang model residual sequence based on a Volterra series filter; solving a Volterra series filter based on a self-organizing method; real-time correction of flood forecast results; the invention takes the prediction residual error of the Xinanjiang model as a research object, and adopts a second-order Volterra filter to simulate and predict the prediction residual error; the parameter time delay tau of the Volterra filter is obtained by adopting a mutual information method, and the other parameter embedding dimension m is obtained by adopting a trial calculation method.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Method and system for recovering load of power grid after mountain fire disaster by considering mobile power supply support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recovering power grid load after mountain fire with mobile power supply support considered, wherein the method comprises the following steps: simulating a space-time process of mountain fire occurrence through a cellular automaton model, and predicting initial time and place of the mountain fire entering a power grid line safety buffer zone; according to the initial time and place, calculating the tripping probability of the power grid line affected by the mountain fire based on the mountain fire prediction and an air gap breakdown mechanism; and a power failure plan is formulated according to the tripping probability of the power grid line; and forming an objective function based on the power outage plan by taking the power outage cost, the power generation cost of the emergency mobile power generation vehicle and the minimum mobile energy storage operation cost as targets, and solving to obtain a mountain fire disaster post-power grid recovery strategy considering emergency resource scheduling. The invention combines the mobile power supply and the PSPS power failure plan, can keep the maximum load recovery after the mountain fire disaster, and reduces the influence of the mountain fire on the power grid as much as possible.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Prediction method for residual bending-resistant bearing capacity of T-shaped beam after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method of residual bending resistance bearing capacity of a T-shaped beam after fire, which relates to the technical field of prediction of building structure performance and comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a T-shaped beam refined analysis model by using ABAQUS software; s2: calculating T-shaped beam temperature fields and structural fields with different firing time, bursting depth and bursting area ratios by using the T-shaped beam refinement model in the step S1, and constructing a sample database; s3: and (2) establishing an untrained T-shaped beam post-fire residual bending bearing capacity prediction model based on a support vector machine function, training and testing the untrained T-shaped beam post-fire residual bending bearing capacity prediction model by using the sample data in the step (S2), so that the post-fire residual bending bearing capacity of the reinforced concrete beam can be accurately predicted, and the support is provided for the fireproof design of reinforced concrete buildings.

title_en: Landslide susceptibility prediction method based on XGBoost
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses a landslide vulnerability prediction method based on XGBoost, which comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing acquired multi-source data to obtain spatial distribution and disaster factors of landslide and non-landslide areas in a research area; performing data sampling balance data by adopting an SMOTE algorithm, and performing sample normalization processing to obtain a processed sample data set; calculating mutual information values of disaster causing factors to obtain landslide vulnerability influencing factors; and constructing a landslide susceptibility prediction model based on an XGBoost algorithm through the landslide susceptibility influence factors, training and testing the model through the processed sample data set to obtain a trained landslide susceptibility prediction model, and predicting the landslide susceptibility of the area to be researched through the trained landslide susceptibility prediction model. The prediction model is constructed based on the XGBoost algorithm to predict the landslide susceptibility, so that a reference can be provided for the possibility of landslide occurrence, and a scientific reference basis is provided for governmental landslide disaster management.

title_en: Life safety training system based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life safety training system based on virtual reality technology, which relates to the technical field of virtual reality, and is characterized in that a personnel management system, an interaction system, a modeling system and a database are used in cooperation, and life safety simulation training is performed on virtual reality, so that children can experience an environment where the children are in the scene, real experience is provided, and the children are familiar with and corresponding to various dangerous situations through emergency self-defense training, fire fighting training, transportation trip training, field survival training, natural disaster simulation, public safety training, psychological health simulation, crime safety simulation and first aid rescue simulation, and nine simulation contents related to life safety.
assignees: BEIJING ANJIU QIUSHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Precipitation data processing method and related device applied to flood disaster model
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a related device for processing rainfall data applied to a flood huge disaster model in the technical field of data processing, wherein in the method, original rainfall data is acquired; the method comprises the steps of integrating data of original precipitation data to obtain matrix data comprising space dimension and time dimension, cleaning the matrix data to obtain precipitation data to be converted, and converting the precipitation data to be converted into precipitation data conforming to normal distribution. Precipitation data conforming to normal distribution is used for being processed by a flood disaster model. The precipitation data obtained after the treatment has higher data quality. According to the normal distribution rainfall data, the discontinuous rainfall data and the adverse effect of rain day on the simulation of the flood disaster model can be reduced, the analysis and the processing of the rainfall data by the flood disaster model are facilitated, further, the simulation result of the more accurate flood disaster model is obtained, and the simulation accuracy of the flood disaster is improved.

title_en: Database data security anti-leakage system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a database data security anti-leakage system and method, and relates to the technical field of data management. The test simulation comprises the following steps: the data in the database is identified and classified, the data object to be protected is determined, the data leakage condition of the database is simulated, the condition that an attacker illegally accesses the database and leaks the data is simulated, and the related test result is recorded. The invention can discover possible security holes and risks in the database through the test simulation module, is beneficial to early discovering and repairing the holes, improves the security of the database, can test the effectiveness of the deployed security protection measures in the database, is beneficial to discovering and repairing the possible holes and the possible weaknesses, improves the security of the database, can help to evaluate the influence degree of data leakage on the database and related systems, and is beneficial to formulating corresponding emergency response plans and security strategies so as to reduce potential loss.

title_en: Artificial intelligence fused drought index reconstruction method and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence fused drought index reconstruction method and a computer readable medium. Selecting a drought index reconstruction region, obtaining a meteorological sample, a hydrological sample, a leaf area index and a large-scale circulation factor sample, and calculating saturated steam pressure deficiency, specific humidity and wet bulb temperature; screening month runoff key factors and water reserve key factors, and calibrating a plurality of artificial intelligent simulation models and a month scale multi-model weighting model; and substituting the normalized vegetation index data as output into a drought event process regression model of vegetation observation months, calculating parameters of the regression model, and calculating by a weighted average method to obtain the drought index of each month in the reconstruction period. The method can be applied to drought risk assessment, disaster prevention and reduction, and can provide important and high-operability reference basis for global and regional water resource risk assessment and early warning under the climate change situation.

title_en: Method for improving numerical simulation accuracy of discrete elements of side slope under engineering scale
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a method for improving the accuracy of discrete element numerical simulation of a side slope under engineering scale, and obtaining the test results of geological conditions, topography and physical and mechanical parameters of a rock-soil body of a target side slope; constructing a discrete element numerical model with the same scale as a sample used in a physical mechanical test, and determining the minimum particle diameter, particle size distribution and maximum particle diameter of filling in the discrete element numerical model and filling particles; calibrating a first mesoscopic parameter of a particle contact model in a discrete element numerical model based on a rock-soil body physical and mechanical parameter test result; constructing a target slope evolution numerical analysis model under engineering scale based on geological conditions and topography information; determining the particle diameter in the target slope evolution numerical analysis model and the second microscopic parameters in the particle contact model under the engineering scale according to a preset rule; and obtaining a numerical simulation result for the obtained model and parameter numerical simulation evolution process. The invention improves the accuracy of the simulation result.
assignees: CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES;UNIV CHONGQING;CHONGQING HUADI ZIHUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine tunnel fire rapid prediction model based on emergency disaster relief requirement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine tunnel fire rapid prediction model based on emergency disaster relief requirements. Comprising the following steps: building mine tunnel models with different sizes, and simulating mine tunnel fires under a large number of different environmental conditions by using FDS software to obtain fire data; cleaning and processing a large amount of original data, and establishing a mine tunnel fire database; building a mine tunnel fire prediction model by using a BP neural network, dividing data in a mine tunnel fire database into a training set and a testing set, and training the mine tunnel fire prediction model by using the training set; inputting the test set into a mine roadway fire disaster prediction model to obtain prediction data; and carrying out error analysis on the prediction data and the test data, thereby continuously optimizing the simulation prediction precision, and the trained mine tunnel fire prediction model can predict mine tunnel fires of mine tunnels with different sizes in different environments. Has important reference significance for mine fire emergency decision.

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling mine earthquake and gas composite dynamic disasters of hard roof in goaf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing and controlling a hard roof mine earthquake and gas composite dynamic disaster in a goaf, and belongs to the technical field of coal seam exploitation.
