The method for preventing and controlling the mineral earthquake and gas composite dynamic disasters of the hard top plate in the goaf comprises the following steps of: the L-shaped long drilling hole extends to a range of a fracture zone above the gas enrichment zone of the goaf, and hydraulic fracturing is carried out on the target rock stratum through the L-shaped long drilling hole, so that the fracture of the target rock stratum is continuously extended; after the hydraulic fracturing is finished, adjusting the oxygen concentration and the gas concentration in the L-shaped long drill hole, igniting after the oxygen concentration and the gas concentration reach the target range of gas deflagration, igniting the gas in the goaf fracture zone, and performing gas explosion to enable the fracture of the roof to develop more. The invention combines hydraulic fracturing and gas deflagration, and the synergistic effect is maximized through the steps of fracturing, gas deflagration and fracturing, so that the method has multiple purposes, simple and easy steps and small engineering quantity.

title_en: Emergency lighting system and method integrating path navigation function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency lighting system and method integrating a path navigation function, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent lighting. The system comprises an acquisition data analysis module, a path navigation analysis module, an intelligent regulation and control module, a man-machine interaction module and a storage database; the collected data analysis module is used for collecting environmental data and personnel movement data in the illumination area through the sensor; analyzing the environmental data to judge whether fire disaster occurs or not; the path navigation simulation analysis module is used for analyzing fire scenes in the lighting area according to the collected environmental data and selecting a safe escape path according to analysis results; the intelligent control module is used for controlling the light change of the lighting equipment according to the selected safe escape path; the man-machine interaction module is used for providing a man-machine interaction interface and displaying a three-dimensional image scene and fire situations in the illumination area; the storage database is used for storing historical environment data and historical personnel movement data.

title_en: High-level rock collapse freeze thawing cycle physical model test method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for testing a physical model of a high-level rock collapse freeze thawing cycle, and relates to the technical field of high-level rock collapse experiments. Including the model case, the model case includes box, rock mass, slide rail device and piles up the passageway, and the rock mass sets up in the box inside and is close to the top, and slide rail device sets up in the box top, piles up the passageway and sets up in the box bottom and is close to one side, and the freeze thawing device comprises interior machine and outer machine, and interior machine includes interior heat exchanger and expansion valve, sets up in the model incasement portion, and outer machine includes cross valve, outer heat exchanger and compressor, sets up in the model incasement portion. According to the invention, the physical model test is adopted to conduct crack frost heave damage research, so that simulation observation on rocks in a plateau area is realized, the occurrence of rock collapse disasters can be prevented in advance, the occurrence of potential safety hazards is reduced, the research on the high-level rock collapse movement mechanism is more convenient, the applicability of equipment is increased, the practicability of the equipment is increased, and the convenience of the equipment is increased.

title_en: Escape channel simulating smoke
abstract_en: The utility model provides an escape passage simulating smoke, and relates to the field of fire safety. The smoke simulation escape passage comprises an escape passage, wherein the top of the escape passage is fixedly connected with a plurality of smoke alarms and a plurality of atomizing spray heads, the inside of the escape passage is fixedly connected with a plurality of atmosphere lamps, and a plurality of fire simulation plates, a rack, hooks and a cabinet are arranged inside the escape passage. The escape channel simulating smoke is connected and matched with a pneumatic cylinder, a pushing plate, a loudspeaker, a sensor, a first positioning plate, a second positioning plate and the like, so that the condition of water supply damage in a fire disaster is simulated. Meanwhile, the atomizing nozzle is controlled to work at fixed time to spray water into the escape passage, and workers can wet towel clothes through the water sprayed by the atomizing nozzle. The simulation method has the advantages that common problems in the fire disaster are simulated, the reality and accuracy of fire disaster smoke escape simulation are guaranteed, and the accuracy and high efficiency of science popularization and science education to experienters are guaranteed.
assignees: JIANGSU AORAN INTELLIGENT TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster induced landslide experiment monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster model tests, in particular to a geological disaster induced landslide experiment monitoring device. Comprising the following steps: the bottom of the experiment box is provided with two filter screens; the dryer is arranged at the lower end of the top of the experiment box; the rainfall simulation mechanism comprises a water receiver and a water delivery pipe, wherein the water delivery pipe comprises a vertical pipe and a horizontal pipe, and a plurality of spherical nozzles are arranged on the horizontal pipe; the pile slope assembly comprises a horizontal slide rail, a bulldozer wheel, an inclined slide rail, a lifting mechanism, a transmission mechanism, a central shaft, a rotation mechanism, a laser ranging sensor and a bulldozer mechanism; the rainwater recovery box is arranged at the bottom of the experiment box; the main controller is fixedly arranged on the outer side wall of the experiment box, and the device can automatically reset the soil slope state, is convenient for multiple experiments and improves the experiment efficiency.
assignees: SHANDONG GEO MINERAL PROSPECTING DEVELOPMENT BUREAU 5TH GEO MINERAL PROSPECTING INST

title_en: Dynamic intelligent fire disaster judging method for plateau locomotive environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic intelligent fire judgment method for the environment of a plateau locomotive, which comprises the steps of continuously collecting analog signals of time environment parameter data through an external environment sensor of the plateau locomotive, carrying out analog-to-digital conversion processing on the analog signals to obtain the time environment parameter data, and setting fire early-warning grades according to the time environment parameter data; preprocessing the time environment parameter data to obtain a data training set and a data testing set; training the constructed intelligent fire artificial network model through a data training set to obtain an optimal intelligent fire artificial network model; and predicting the data test set according to the optimal intelligent fire artificial network model so as to realize dynamic intelligent fire prediction of locomotive environment. The dynamic intelligent fire disaster prediction of the locomotive environment is realized, the fire disaster prevention and control accuracy under the plateau locomotive environment is greatly improved, and the operation safety of the locomotive is more effectively ensured.

title_en: Smart power grid information safety protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart power grid information safety protection method, which relates to the technical field of power grid information safety protection and comprises the steps of carrying out information safety risk analysis, identifying safety risks and defining safety protection requirements; constructing a multi-level, multi-node and full-link password security protection scheme by adopting a domestic password technology, an encryption authentication technology and a security monitoring technology; designing a power system architecture compatible with multiple new energy accesses to form an endogenous safety immune system; the intelligent ammeter metering password safety protection subsystem is constructed, so that the parameter and data safety of a new service scene are ensured; safety training, monitoring, emergency response and system optimization are carried out, and the information safety level of the power system is continuously improved. The invention effectively improves the stability and the safety of the power system, and protects the information security of the business scenes such as new energy access, time-of-use electricity price and the like, and special-change intelligent fee control and the like.

title_en: Fire-fighting training and drilling evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting training and drilling evaluation method, which comprises the following steps: s1, training and evaluating fire control knowledge; s2, fire control skill training evaluation; s3, emergency response assessment; s4, team cooperation operation evaluation; s5, comprehensive evaluation analysis and summary display. According to the invention, the training personnel are trained in fire protection knowledge and skills, and after the training is completed, the training personnel are subjected to practical training and examination through simulating fire scenes, after the individual training is completed, the training personnel are subjected to examination in team cooperation and coordination, the performance of each group of team cooperation and coordination is evaluated, and the performance of the individual in team training is evaluated, so that the organizing ability, communication ability and cooperation ability of the team are summarized and analyzed, the training personnel are comprehensively trained and evaluated, the training prevention effect and the training effect are effectively improved, and corresponding measures can be rapidly and effectively taken when the actual fire occurs.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGAN SAFETY TRAINING CONSULTING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Improved indoor fire disaster and combustible automatic identification method of dual-attention network
abstract_en: An improved automatic recognition method for indoor fire and combustible matters of a dual-attention network uses Canny edge detection to enhance boundary characteristics for acquired images and assists in creating segmentation labels to establish a fire-combustible matter data set for training; improving a deep learning framework based on a dual-attention network, replacing the original cross entropy loss function as a focus loss function, and training; and (3) turning, zooming and transforming the input image by combining the test enhancement method, comprehensively analyzing the output to obtain a final segmentation result, and realizing automatic identification of indoor fire and combustible matters.

title_en: Method and system for identifying extremum event of data-limited estuary area and analyzing composite flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying extremum events of a data-limited estuary area and analyzing composite flood disasters, comprising the following steps: collecting and correcting the maximum wind speed of typhoons, and constructing a driving wind field suitable for typhoons simulation; determining a typhoon influence circle of a river mouth area; calculating storm water increment based on the existing measured tide level data by adopting a harmonic analysis method; screening all typhoon paths affecting the estuary area to form a typhoon path set; constructing a estuary storm surge numerical model, calculating storm water increment caused by typhoons which generate influence in an estuary region, and obtaining storm high-tide time; determining an upstream flow value based on variability of measured flow during typhoons according to storm high-tide level time, and determining daily typhoons rainfall and corresponding time thereof by adopting a sliding correlation method; and analyzing the composite flood probability of the estuary area and outputting an analysis result. The method can comprehensively and comprehensively analyze the cause and influence of the compound flood, and improves the accuracy and stability of risk assessment of the compound flood.

title_en: Test method for simulating tunneling induced disaster loading and excavation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test method for simulating tunneling disaster induction, loading and then excavating, which comprises the following steps: adopting a cubic sample containing prefabricated non-penetrating circular holes as a rock sample, and simulating an underground tunnel or roadway in tunneling and excavation; a small hole penetrating through the sample is formed in the middle of the round hole, and the small hole is used for simulating a straight cut hole which is actually constructed; filling micro explosive into the cut hole; modifying a loading mould in the X-axis direction; carrying out true triaxial loading on the rock sample; releasing pressure on the X axis after the sample is continuously stressed; inserting steel bars as disturbance equipment, and carrying out a true triaxial loading experiment again until the miniature explosive explodes; and (3) acquiring acoustic, optical and mechanical responses of the rock sample in the test process, and performing coupling analysis on the acoustic-optical-force multi-physical field data to realize the cooperative characterization of the acoustic-optical-force multi-physical field of the destabilization of the underground high-stress grotto. The method can more accurately simulate the stress state of the rock and the induced disaster of tunneling in the actual state, and more effectively characterize the test process.

title_en: Evacuation guiding simulation system and method under fire scene of terminal building
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evacuation guiding simulation system and method under a fire scene of a terminal building, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a model construction module, a guide information setting module, a personnel parameter setting module and a simulation module; the model construction module is used for constructing a terminal building environment model and a personnel information transmission model; the guide information setting module is used for setting guide information in the terminal building environment model; the personnel parameter setting module is used for setting relevant parameters of pedestrians; the simulation module is used for conducting fire evacuation simulation based on the terminal building environment model, the personnel information transfer model, the guide information and the pedestrian related parameters. The invention can display the personnel evacuation information transmission process under the fire scene of the terminal building and provide advice and data support for the airport to cope with the occurrence of the event.

title_en: Network security emergency response knowledge graph completion method based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security emergency response knowledge graph completion method based on a large language model, which comprises the following steps: performing structural embedding on entities and relations in the triplet of the given knowledge graph; embedding the obtained entity and relation into an input text adaptation device to obtain a text prompt of the corresponding entity and relation; according to the given triples of the knowledge graph, formulating an input task of a large language model of the knowledge graph to obtain task sentences; after splicing the task sentences and the text prompts corresponding to the task sentences, inputting the text prompts into a large language model to obtain task sentence results; training a network according to the obtained task sentence result and the real result of the task sentence, and completing the knowledge graph; the method has the advantages that the relationship between the entities in the network security emergency response text is accurately and quickly complemented, and the establishment of the network security emergency response knowledge graph can be more quickly facilitated.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGZHIWEI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire safety monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire detection, in particular to an intelligent fire safety monitoring system, which comprises a monitoring point optimizing module, a risk assessment module, a path simulation module, a network layout module, a fire analysis module, an extension prediction module, an emergency planning module and a decision support module. According to the invention, by adopting a graph theory analysis and genetic optimization algorithm, a monitoring point optimization module adjusts the monitoring points according to building layout and environmental data, a risk assessment module performs data mining and pattern recognition on fire risks by using a statistical analysis method and a machine learning model, a path simulation module and a network layout module are combined with a computational fluid dynamics simulation, a heuristic path search algorithm and a network optimization theory, a solution is provided for evacuation path planning and monitoring network layout, and a fire analysis module and a spreading prediction module strengthen the real-time monitoring and future spreading trend prediction capability of the fire through a prediction model and dynamic simulation.
assignees: SHENZHEN TIANYI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for setting nuclear emergency exercise accident scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a setting method and a system for nuclear emergency exercise accident situations, comprising the following steps: establishing a main scene library according to the security analysis report; establishing a sub-scenario library based on the industry practice and the potential risk of the power plant; selecting and combining the main scene and the sub scene; and determining the combined comprehensive emergency exercise scenario. The setting method of the nuclear emergency exercise accident scenario mainly provides accident scenario combination for emergency exercises, can select exercise scenario at any time according to the specification or random of a supervisory person or a power plant manager and immediately start exercises, does not need special planning and script preparation of exercise scenario before exercises, enables exercises to be closer to actual accident response, and greatly improves capability requirements of exercises on emergency response personnel.
assignees: HUANENG NUCLEAR ENERGY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Lightweight electric power internet of things safety early warning method based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightweight electric power internet of things safety early warning method based on edge calculation, which comprises the following steps: constructing a safety helmet recognition model and a fire disaster recognition model; training the safety helmet recognition model and the fire disaster recognition model by utilizing a data set to obtain a trained model; and carrying out safety precaution by using the trained model. The invention solves the problems of large model scale, large operation amount and the like of the existing artificial intelligent safety early warning method, and provides the safety early warning method for edge calculation. Firstly, the invention relates to a safety helmet recognition model and a fire disaster recognition model, wherein the two models adopt a lightweight method, and a lightweight model is realized. Meanwhile, in the network design, the decoder and the encoder are optimized respectively aiming at the characteristics of the identification content, so that the detection capability is improved.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Flood disaster early warning simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster early warning simulation system, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for collecting weather forecast data, geographic information data and related environmental data, and the data processing module is used for preprocessing the collected data, including data cleaning, data fusion and data conversion; the river basin rainfall analysis module is used for analyzing rainfall conditions in the river basin, including rainfall, rainfall intensity and rainfall duration; the surface water quantity calculation module calculates the surface water quantity according to the rainfall analysis result of the river basin; the invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster early warning, in particular to an adjusting capacity evaluation module for evaluating the adjusting capacity of a river basin, comprising surface water storage capacity, groundwater supply capacity and vegetation coverage factors. The method solves the problem that the traditional weather forecast method cannot provide enough accurate rainfall area distribution information.
assignees: SICHUAN COALFIELD GEOLOGY BUREAU 137 TEAM;UNIV SICHUAN ARTS & SCI

title_en: Cloud edge collaborative train fire hazard studying and judging early warning method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud edge collaborative train fire hazard studying and judging early warning method based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: building BIM models of running intervals, trains and fire sensors; according to fire simulation requirements, the BIM model is lightened, dynamic simulation is carried out on various fire working conditions, a digital twin model of the train fire development trend based on multiple sensor parameters is constructed, and a multiple sensor real-time parameter table at the moment of fire occurrence is extracted; disposing fire sensors on the train according to the position and parameters of the digital twin model, collecting and processing sensor data by the vehicle-mounted edge controller, and performing fire real-time research and judgment according to a multi-sensor real-time parameter table at the moment of fire occurrence; the vehicle-mounted edge controller and the train fire development trend digital twin model establish a real-time data channel, and the train fire development trend digital twin model carries out fire early warning according to sensor parameters transmitted by the vehicle-mounted edge controller; the invention can avoid train fire disaster as far as possible and ensure train safety.

title_en: Fine positioning quantitative exploration device for hidden karst cave in water-rich karst area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise positioning and quantitative exploration device for a hidden karst cave in a water-rich karst area, which relates to the technical field of geological exploration and comprises a bottom bearing base, an L-shaped supporting plate, a U-shaped push handle, a sonar detector, a lowering assembly, a self-locking driving assembly, a connecting frame assembly, an omnibearing rotating assembly, a guiding assembly and a lifting protection assembly, wherein the lowering assembly comprises two supporting shaft blocks, a transmission shaft, a stranded wire roller and a lowering cable which is wound on the stranded wire roller. According to the invention, through the cooperative cooperation of the sonar detector, the lowering assembly, the connecting frame assembly and the omnibearing rotary assembly, the sonar detector is lowered in a drill hole area, the omnibearing operation system of the drilling probe is used for realizing the omnibearing portable operation of lowering and 360-degree rotation, and realizing the dynamic, efficient and accurate quantitative exploration of the position, the form and the development trend of the water-free underground karst empty area, thereby realizing the accurate positioning and quantitative description of geological disaster sources in a karst strong development area and providing decision basis for the determination of the next construction scheme.

title_en: Construction method of extra-large landslide hazard drainage anti-slip combined structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of an oversized landslide disaster drainage anti-slip combined structure. The invention researches a complete construction method of a drainage anti-slip combined structure aiming at an oversized water-rich landslide disaster based on fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, hydrodynamic models, structural models and engineering geological models. Firstly, forming a retaining wall of a drainage anti-slip structure by using small-caliber piles capable of forming holes mechanically and rapidly and adopting circular arrangement; secondly, manufacturing and installing an inner prefabricated lining segment, and presetting a water permeable hole and a drainage flower pipe on the surface layer of the segment; then adding a reinforced concrete anti-slip key near the slip surface; finally, the upward inclined drain pipe and the drainage anti-skid structure are combined by utilizing a multi-branch directional drilling process to form a 'seepage-collection-drainage' anti-skid combined three-dimensional structure system. The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control safety, in particular to the technologies of light-weight small-caliber pile management, non-excavation directional drilling and the like, and can be widely applied to the rapid management of unstable deformation or deformation-carrying super-large water-rich landslide disasters.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIST

title_en: Bridge rescue training facility and training method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge rescue training facility and a method, wherein the bridge rescue training facility is provided with a bridge area and a bridge lower area, a plurality of engineering elevators and a plurality of stairways are arranged on the side face of the bridge area, the engineering elevators are used for assisting in carrying appliances to a bridge deck, the bridge rescue training facility is provided with structural stress monitoring sensors at structural stress points, the structural stress monitoring sensors are used for monitoring structural stability in real time, when a structural member is damaged or reaches a maximum set stress value, the bridge area is provided with a bridge intact section, a bridge damaged section and a traffic accident occurring section, the bridge lower area is provided with a dangerous chemical tank car accident occurring section, the bridge damaged section is provided with a bridge damaged point and a bridge damaged section, the bridge upper structural damage, the lower structural damage, the foundation damage and the bridge broken scene are simulated after an earthquake disaster, the bridge is rapidly broken, the bridge is robbed, and the bridge damage points are positioned on a bridge deck, a drop-proof baffle, a supporting seat, a pier and the foundation position.

title_en: Multifunctional testing system for mountain bridge geological chain-growth disasters and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional test system for mountain bridge geological chain disasters, which comprises a bracket, a slurry circulation hopper, a falling stone circulation hopper, a slurry pumping system, a slurry recovery tank, a rolling stone conveying system, a slurry loading tank, a rolling stone loading tank and a vibration table, wherein the falling stone circulation hopper is positioned above the slurry circulation hopper, the falling stone circulating hopper bottom is equipped with the rolling stone loading groove, and mud circulating hopper below is equipped with the mud loading groove, the end in mud loading groove is equipped with the shaking table, shaking table top is equipped with the pier, shaking table one side is equipped with the mud recovery pond, mud recovery pond one side is equipped with rolling stone conveying system. The multifunctional test system for mountain bridge geological chain disasters can simulate not only the simultaneous action of a plurality of disasters, but also the sequential action of each disaster, and the next test can be continuously carried out without moving members after a single test is completed, so that the flow is simple, and the coupling action of each load can be considered.

title_en: Prediction method and device for emergency positioning message delivery and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method and a device for emergency positioning message delivery of Internet of things equipment based on a low-orbit satellite, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining an undirected node topological graph and link information; taking the undirected node topological graph and the link information as input states, taking a message transmission path as output, and training a deep Q network large model; distilling the deep Q network large model as a teacher model to obtain a student strategy network corresponding to the low-orbit satellite and storing the student strategy network into the corresponding low-orbit satellite; when the Internet of things equipment sends an emergency positioning message to a low orbit satellite passing through the top, the low orbit satellite passing through the top predicts a message transmission path through a student policy network, calculates predicted delivery time according to the message transmission path, returns the predicted delivery time to the Internet of things equipment, and displays the predicted delivery time. The method can predict the time length required by the emergency positioning message of the Internet of things equipment to be sent to the emergency response center, and gives the user timely feedback.

title_en: Method and device for determining fire safety escape route and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device and electronic equipment for determining a fire safety escape route, and belongs to the field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target fire control simulation video; extracting key frames of the target firefighting simulation video to obtain M target images, wherein M is a positive integer; performing smoke detection on each of the M target images to obtain M smoke recognition results; obtaining a smoke diffusion route based on M smoke recognition results of the M target images; and determining a safe escape route based on the obtained smoke diffusion route.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability prediction method based on Bayesian optimization
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster analysis, and particularly discloses a landslide vulnerability prediction method based on Bayesian optimization, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining the position of a landslide point in the past year and related landslide induction factor data; s2, constructing a sample set to be divided into a training set, a verification set and a test set; s3, constructing a CNN-LR-SVM prediction model for training and evaluation, and optimizing by adopting a Bayesian optimization method to obtain an optimized CNN-LR-SVM prediction model; s4, inputting the data of the test set into the optimized CNN-LR-SVM prediction model to predict landslide susceptibility probability values of the research area, performing hierarchical early warning, and outputting a prediction graph of landslide susceptibility. The method improves the accuracy of landslide susceptibility prediction. The method is suitable for predicting the liability of landslide.

title_en: Multisource remote sensing image flood disaster information extraction and change detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image detection, in particular to a method for extracting and detecting flood disaster information of a multi-source remote sensing image, which comprises the following steps: acquiring remote sensing images of each period in the flood disasters in the detection area to form a sample set; inputting the sample set into a basic Swin-UNet network to obtain an optimal basic Swin-UNet network model; selecting samples from the sample set to form a sample subset, and inputting the sample subset into an optimal basic Swin-UNet network model; using Cross Attention Block layers to replace Swin Transformer Block layers in the underlying Swin-UNet network to form a modified Swin-UNet network; training to obtain an optimal improved Swin-UNet network model; extracting surface information in remote sensing images of each period in the flood disaster of the detection area by using an optimal improved Swin-UNet network model so as to obtain the spatial distribution change condition of the detection area; the invention can accurately extract the flood disaster information, thereby truly reflecting the influence of the flood disaster.
assignees: ANHUI CONSTRUCTION ENG TRAFFIC HARBOUR GROUP CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Full life cycle unloading mining method for deep ore body
abstract_en: The invention provides a full life cycle unloading mining method for a deep ore body, relates to the field of deep ore body mining, and aims to solve various rock explosion dynamic disaster problems possibly encountered in deep mining and remarkably improve the mining safety of the deep ore body based on the mutual cooperation and combined action of the deep ore body full life cycle mining bureau; secondly, the unloading means adopted in the invention mainly uses the self behavior of mining, and auxiliary adopts the blocking type fragmentation blasting of the drilling group aiming at the special unloading object, so that the means is simpler, the applicability and the site operability are strong, the mining cost is not greatly improved, and the popularization and the application are convenient.

title_en: Method and device for determining typical fault scene of power distribution network in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining typical fault scenes of a power distribution network under extreme weather, wherein a scene library construction request is responded, multiple groups of weather combination information are obtained, extreme weather models are respectively constructed, each extreme weather model is operated at the position of the power distribution network, the simulated fault rate of the power distribution network is respectively calculated, each simulated fault rate is compared with a preset fault rate threshold value, multiple groups of fault scenes are generated, typical information entropy distribution intervals are respectively determined, when the extreme weather information is received, the extreme weather models are adjusted and operated according to the extreme weather information, target information entropy is determined, the typical information entropy distribution intervals are matched according to the target information entropy, and the typical fault scene to which the extreme weather information belongs is determined from the multiple groups of fault scenes. Therefore, the component failure rate, the failure occurrence position and the failure occurrence time are comprehensively considered, complex failure scenes are effectively screened through information entropy, and resource planning and failure recovery strategies are effectively and pertinently provided before disasters come.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster risk exposure dynamic measurement method, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic measurement method, a terminal and a storage medium for risk exposure of urban waterlogging disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining urban space information, and identifying a waterlogging risk area according to rainfall runoff simulation; acquiring population activity tracks, and monitoring abnormal activity intensity according to pre-disaster activity intensity; and dynamically monitoring the exposure degree of the waterlogging disaster according to the waterlogging risk area and the abnormal activity intensity. According to the invention, the waterlogging risk area is identified based on urban terrain features and runoff simulation, and the number of vulnerable groups and time-space change features thereof in the risk area are predicted by comparing the disaster time in the waterlogging high risk area with the usual mobile phone signaling activity intensity time by time, so that the real-time monitoring of the risk of the waterlogging disaster is realized.

title_en: Prediction method for side slope stability of dumping site
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disasters, and particularly discloses a method for predicting the slope stability of a dumping site, which is used for investigating the dumping site to obtain H, phi and b; obtaining the mechanical parameters of the soil discharge field and the foundation rock soil through an indoor test; constructing a slope model to be predicted, obtaining a corresponding data set T  d 、T f  by using the mechanical parameters of the soil discharge field and the foundation rock soil, solving a slope safety coefficient K by using finite element software through intensity folding and subtraction, and constructing a data set T comprising T  d 、T f  and K; normalizing the data set T and dividing the data set into a training set T  train  and a prediction set T  test ; constructing a slope stability GWO-LSSVM model by using a training set T  train , obtaining optimal parameters gamma and sigma by GWO, and inputting the optimal parameters gamma and sigma into the LSSVM model to complete data fitting and prediction of the training set T  train ; and setting an allowable coefficient [ K ], inputting the mechanical parameters of the test rock and soil into GWO-LSSVM model to obtain a safety coefficient K, and judging the slope stability of the dumping site. The method has the characteristics of high convergence rate, small influence on slope structure and stability, and high prediction accuracy and prediction precision.

title_en: Variable configuration experimental platform for civil aircraft emergency evacuation simulation test
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a variable configuration experiment platform for a civil aircraft emergency evacuation simulation test, wherein a supporting platform in the experiment platform comprises a plurality of servo electric cylinders, a bottom mounting frame and a top mounting frame, a simulation cabin section is fixedly mounted on the top mounting frame, doors are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the cabin section in the simulation cabin section, a wide passenger plane door is simulated through one side of the doors, a narrow passenger plane door is simulated through the other side of the doors, boarding doors are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of the simulation cabin section, a movable stair is arranged between the boarding doors and the ground, escape slides are arranged outside available doors of the current evacuation test in the simulation cabin section, anti-falling protection pads are placed at the bottom of each escape slide, protection nets are mounted between each available door and the ground, and the protection nets are arranged to the ground in a diagonal manner from the lower parts of the doors. The technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention solves the problem that the existing civil aircraft emergency evacuation training or experimental facilities are not enough in universality.

title_en: Comprehensive monitoring and early warning system for mine disasters and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive monitoring and early warning system for mine disasters, which comprises a real-time online monitoring unit, an early warning model calculation unit and a three-dimensional scene display unit, wherein the real-time online monitoring unit comprises a fire online monitoring module, a flood online monitoring module, a ground pressure online monitoring module and a lifting machine online monitoring module, the three-dimensional scene display unit comprises a roadway model and a ventilation system model, and the early warning model calculation unit comprises a ground pressure early warning model, a fire simulation escape model, a flood three-dimensional calculation model and an AI recognition edge calculation model. In a complex and changeable underground production environment, the system can carry out linkage capturing analysis on disaster risk parameters of four modules such as ground pressure, fire, flood and hoisting machine in real time, realize quantitative classification of risks and assist management personnel in improving safety control and emergency decision of mine production.

title_en: Intelligent evaluation method for risk of natural disasters of roads
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of road natural disaster risk assessment, and particularly discloses an intelligent road natural disaster risk assessment method, which comprises the following steps: determining the natural disaster type of a road in a research area; determining influence factors of natural disasters of roads; establishing a road natural disaster risk assessment data set based on the data; training and storing an intelligent evaluation model of the risk of the natural disasters of the roads; establishing a road natural disaster prediction data set and calculating a prediction result; cross-verifying the training set and the prediction set; grading the influence factors and the evaluation results, and drawing a road natural disaster risk demarcation graph by using the ArcGIS. The invention establishes a road natural disaster risk assessment index system and a road natural disaster risk intelligent assessment model based on the actual situation of a research area and by combining the relevant influences of weather, geology and human activities. The method has the advantages that the influence factor index is easy to obtain, the method is simple to operate, and new thinking and directions are provided based on the subsequent road natural disaster risk assessment research of the intelligent assessment means.

title_en: Disaster simulation processing method and device for cable tunnel and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a disaster simulation processing method and device for a cable tunnel and electronic equipment. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: in a preset simulation cable tunnel model, simulation monitoring is carried out in the tunnel; in response to detecting the tunnel anomaly information, determining a tunnel coordinate set corresponding to the tunnel anomaly information; invoking an artificial inspection robot corresponding to the tunnel coordinate set in the artificial inspection robot set, and performing inspection operation on the position of the tunnel coordinate in the tunnel coordinate set; performing anomaly detection on the inspection video to generate an anomaly detection result; invoking the simulation fire-fighting robots corresponding to the coordinates of the tunnel to be fire-fighting in the simulation fire-fighting robot group, and executing disaster processing operation; indicating the simulation fire-fighting robot to reset, and performing fire-fighting detection on the coordinates of the tunnel to be fire-fighting to generate a disaster processing result; and indicating the simulation inspection robot to reset. The embodiment can timely perform fire disaster treatment when abnormal conditions occur.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for inhibiting formation of chalky rice induced at high temperature in grouting period and application of method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for effectively inhibiting rice chalkiness formation induced by high temperature in a rice seedling stage by high temperature exercise and application thereof, wherein the high temperature exercise in the seedling stage can obviously reduce the chalkiness rate and chalkiness degree of rice under the high temperature growth condition in the rice grouting setting stage, is favorable for improving rice quality, can be applied to planting areas frequently suffered from high temperature meteorological disasters in the rice grouting setting stage, and has wide application value.

title_en: Intelligent track monitoring and maintaining method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent track monitoring and maintaining method and system, comprising the following steps: step S1: installing sensors and data collection hardware in key equipment, and establishing a data center for processing and storing information; step S2: deploying high-resolution cameras in an important track area, and implementing predictive maintenance of data; step S3: developing big data analysis software, establishing a real-time monitoring center and making an emergency response flow; step S4: implementing a networked operation scheduling system, and making and executing a security protocol for a key system; step S5: making a maintenance plan and a flow, and providing periodic training for operation and maintenance personnel; step S6: feedback mechanisms are established, periodically reviewed and improved, and new technologies and solutions are developed and tested. The invention reduces the need for expensive emergency maintenance by predicting and preventing problems; prolonging the service life of equipment: periodic and accurate maintenance helps to extend the useful life of rail and train equipment.
assignees: NANJING RONGCAI TRANSP TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster cause analysis method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster cause analysis method and a fire disaster cause analysis system based on deep learning, wherein the fire disaster cause analysis method comprises the following steps: and acquiring a fire report to be analyzed currently and an analysis identifier thereof, and if the analysis identifier is of a first type, calling a pre-constructed fire incentive analysis database which comprises a plurality of historical fire reports and corresponding historical fire incentive analysis results. And then, performing similarity matching on the current fire report and the historical fire report, and outputting a fire cause analysis result corresponding to the historical fire report with the highest similarity. If the analysis mark is of the second type, a simple fire cause analysis model which is based on deep learning training in advance is called, and a fire cause analysis result of a current fire report is output.

title_en: Miniature direct-current resistivity three-dimensional inversion imaging rock-soil dynamic damage monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniature direct-current resistivity three-dimensional inversion imaging rock-soil dynamic damage monitoring method, which relates to the technical field of coal-rock dynamic disaster mechanism research and comprises the following steps: collecting a rock sample electric field signal; performing inversion fitting calculation on the three-dimensional resistivity of the electric field signal to obtain a three-dimensional resistivity data body; and analyzing the resistivity three-dimensional data body to obtain the resistivity distribution characteristics under different pressures, and summarizing the dynamic disaster mechanism of the coal and rock. The invention adopts the contact electrode to actively transmit the detection signal and receive the coal rock response signal to the coal rock sample, thereby effectively resisting the environmental electromagnetic noise; the nonstructural grids are adopted to conduct micron-scale subdivision on the coal and rock samples, three-dimensional inversion imaging is conducted on electric field signals collected under different pressure states, and internal cracks of the coal and rock samples can be effectively depicted; the target object is the size scale level of the rock book, can be measured at different temperatures, different humidities and different pressure states, and can simulate the measurement of the in-situ state to obtain the fracture distribution state in the in-situ state.

title_en: Simulation platform and simulation method for fire-fighting acceptance
abstract_en: The application relates to a simulation platform and a simulation method for fire-fighting acceptance, which belong to the technical field of fire protection, and comprise the following steps: the model importing module is used for importing the building model to the simulation platform; the fire parameter setting module is used for setting parameters such as fire sources, fire behaviors, wind speeds and the like according to the building model and actual fire conditions; the fire disaster simulation module is used for simulating a fire disaster scene according to the parameters set by the fire disaster parameter setting module; and the monitoring and evaluating module is used for monitoring and evaluating fire-fighting facilities and safety measures in the building in real time in the fire disaster simulation process. The building model is led into a simulation platform, fire parameters are set, the fire simulation module is utilized to simulate a fire scene of the building model, and an evaluation result is obtained through the monitoring and evaluation module so as to evaluate the fire safety performance of the building, and the accuracy of fire inspection and acceptance is higher.
assignees: YANTAI SURVEY DESIGN REVIEW SERVICE CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Mine water inrush point and simulation model parameter identification method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine water inrush point based on artificial intelligence and a simulation model parameter identification method, and belongs to the technical field of mine water inrush disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the following steps: step 1: according to the observation data, a numerical model is established, and prior information of parameters to be identified including coordinates of the water burst point is determined; step 2: generating a training sample data set and a test sample data set of the substitution model based on the numerical model and the parameter prior information; step 3: constructing and training a substitute model neural network; step 4: checking the accuracy of the substitution model; step 5: and executing a simulated annealing algorithm, and identifying the water burst point position and the simulated model parameter. The method provided by the invention can solve the problem of accurate positioning of the underground water burst point of the coal mine, and has important significance for timely developing scientific disaster management and rescue work.
assignees: XUZHOU HIGH TECH ZONE SAFETY EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT INDUSTRY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Landslide deformation space-time prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide deformation space-time prediction method and a landslide deformation space-time prediction system, comprising the following steps: collecting a landslide area time sequence SAR image for differential interference pretreatment; performing time sequence InSAR flow processing to obtain multidimensional time sequence InSAR deformation data; carrying out seasonal decomposition on the multidimensional InSAR time sequence deformation data to establish various time sequence deformation data sets; constructing a Spacemiefomer neural network model of each category based on the InSAR time sequence deformation dataset to carry out multidimensional deformation space-time prediction; model training and verification are carried out on the Spacetimefomer model to obtain time sequence deformation values predicted by each category, and the predicted values of each category are added to obtain deformation prediction results of the landslide area. The method and the system provided by the invention can be applied to landslide space-time prediction based on InSAR time sequence deformation, provide theoretical basis for monitoring landslide displacement process and future trend in real time, and can be also applied to InSAR deformation prediction application of other geological disasters.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Test device and method for simulating load bearing performance degradation of constant-resistance large-deformation anchor rod/cable end constant-resistance mechanism under tunnel fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a test method for simulating the degradation of the bearing performance of a constant-resistance large-deformation anchor rod/cable end part constant-resistance body under tunnel fire, which relate to the technical field of tunnel engineering support equipment research and comprise the following steps: a torus base; the heat preservation and insulation cylinder is positioned on the ring body base; the rock column is consistent with the surrounding rock composition of the tunnel, is arranged in the hollow cavity of the heat preservation and insulation cylinder and is used for loading anchor rods/ropes; the heat generation layer is positioned between the outer wall of the rock pillar and the inner wall of the hollow cavity of the heat preservation and insulation cylinder, and simulates a high-temperature environment when a tunnel fire disaster occurs; the heat-insulating container is fixed on the chassis at the bottom of the heat-insulating cylinder; the heating block is arranged at the bottom of the heat-preserving heat-insulating container and corresponds to the accommodating channel up and down; and the loading device is used for loading the constant-resistance large-deformation anchor rod/cable. The invention can realize the evaluation of the degradation of the bearing performance of the constant-resistance large-deformation anchor rod/cable end constant-resistance body under different temperature environments.

title_en: Emergency evacuation route planning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency evacuation route planning method, an emergency evacuation route planning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological data and accident information corresponding to a target area; according to the meteorological data and the accident information, determining accident points and a plurality of safety points in a simulation map corresponding to the target area; and determining an optimal emergency evacuation route based on the accident point location and the positions of the safety point locations. Therefore, the optimal emergency evacuation route can be rapidly and accurately determined in the simulated map corresponding to the target area by combining the meteorological data and the accident information corresponding to the target area, and people at the accident position can be evacuated in time according to the optimal emergency evacuation route, so that the safety of the people at the accident position is guaranteed.
assignees: BEIJING DONGTU HEXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for rapidly plugging by using inflatable rubber capsule material
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for quick plugging by using an inflatable rubber capsule material, wherein the device comprises a rubber capsule for storing magnetic slurry, and an inflation port of the rubber capsule is connected with an inflation system for supplying air through an air pipe; the grouting opening of the rubber capsule body is connected with a grouting system for grouting through a PVC sleeve; the drilling machine is used for drilling and forming the grouting opening of the rubber bag body; the bottom of the rubber bag body is provided with a slurry outlet which is connected with a slurry return port of the grouting system through a slurry feeding pipe; the rapid hardening silicate cement is used for forming a supporting framework inside the magnetic slurry; the permanent magnet net is arranged near the periphery of the rubber bag body. The prepared magnetic slurry is placed into the inflatable rubber capsule body and placed between a disaster area and a safety area, so that the temporary water retaining effect is achieved, dangerous situations can be rapidly restrained from spreading, and the device is simple and convenient to operate.

title_en: Frequency domain noise reduction network multi-mode medical image classification method based on tensor chain decomposition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medical image classification, and discloses a frequency domain noise reduction network multi-mode medical image classification method based on tensor chain decomposition, which comprises the following steps: step 1: inputting training set images of two modes into two backbone networks to extract image features; step 2: respectively inputting the image features into a tensor chain decomposition module to obtain core feature tensors; step 3: the core feature tensors of the two modal images are weighted and summed to obtain a core feature fusion tensor, and then the core feature fusion tensor is input into a frequency domain noise reduction module to reduce noise generated by fusion and improve cross-domain generalization capability; step 4: multiplying the core feature fusion tensor according to a tensor chain decomposition formula to obtain fusion features; step 5: and inputting the fusion characteristics into a classifier to obtain a classification result, and performing supervised learning on the classification result through classification labels. The medical image classification network can effectively prevent overfitting and dimension disasters and has good generalization capability.

title_en: Rock burst early warning method for microseismic data long-term and short-term feature comparison
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dangerous disaster prediction of rock burst and the like in mines, in particular to a rock burst early warning method for comparing long-term and short-term characteristics of microseismic data, which is used for predicting whether a primary microseismic event to be happened in the future is a rock burst event or not, and comprises the following steps of S1: constructing a training set; s2: extracting long-term and short-term microseismic data characteristics of a training set sample; s3: training a rock burst prediction model; s4: an application of rock burst early warning method based on microseismic data long-short period characteristic comparison. According to the invention, priori knowledge is introduced into algorithm design to automatically extract the rock burst early warning implicit early warning index; parameters of the designed feature extraction module can be continuously updated and replaced in training, so that the generalization performance of the early warning method on different mines is improved, and the early warning accuracy is higher than that of other deep learning algorithms.
assignees: Shandong energy group co ltd;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Virtual reality interaction method, device and system thereof, and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality interaction method, equipment, a system and a readable storage medium thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-modal data under a real disaster scene, and constructing a digital twin virtual disaster scene corresponding to the real disaster scene in real time through the multi-modal data; acquiring a corresponding space position of a user in the digital twin virtual disaster scene through virtual reality equipment; performing scene evolution prediction on disaster conditions based on the digital twin virtual disaster scene to generate a virtual disaster prediction scene with a preset time scale; acquiring prediction perception information of the spatial position based on the virtual disaster prediction scene; and feeding back the predictive sensory information to the virtual reality device to generate a natural and real first somatosensory experience. The real-time prediction perception of the digital twin virtual disaster scene is combined with the virtual reality equipment, so that the real somatosensory experience of a predicted event can be brought to a user, and the scientificity, efficiency and safety of rescue actions can be effectively improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG DABITE NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for simulating water and mud bursting disasters in construction of near-connected pressure-bearing karst cave tunnel
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of underground engineering, in particular to a water and mud bursting disaster simulation device for construction of a near-junction pressure-bearing karst cave tunnel and a method for building the device. The device comprises a test box, an air bag, a drawing mechanism, a pressurizing pipe, a pressurizing device, an air bag pressure release mechanism and at least two flexible shells, wherein filling soil is filled in the test box and the flexible shells, and liquid is filled in the air bag; the flexible shell and the filling soil in the flexible shell form a filling bag, the air bag and the filling bag are embedded in the filling soil in the test box, the filling bags are sequentially arranged in the test box, and the drawing mechanism is used for sequentially drawing each filling bag out of the test box from a hole formed in the side surface of the test box to simulate tunnel excavation; the air bag is connected with the pressurizing device through a pressurizing pipe; the filling bag corresponding to the deepest part of the simulated tunnel excavation is connected with the air bag through the air bag pressure release mechanism, so that the air bag can be depressurized through the air bag pressure release mechanism when the filling bag is pulled through the pulling mechanism, and the water burst and mud burst disaster is simulated.
assignees: UNIV HUAQIAO;FUJIAN RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD CHINA RAILWAY 24TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Reverse hook type side slope anchor pile based on self-circulation heat exchange technology and construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rock-soil slope engineering, and discloses a reverse hook type slope anchor pile based on a self-circulation heat exchange technology and a construction method thereof, wherein anchor pile sites, inclination angles and depths are planned on a slope, and drilling holes are formed after lithology, soil parameters and similar material proportions are determined; sleeving a caulking device outside the assembled anchor pile, filling coarse sand in an inner cavity of the caulking device, and extruding the anchor pile and the caulking device into soil to set depth; extracting the joint filling device, filling coarse sand in the drill hole to the designed elevation, and hammering and compacting; starting the driving part and expanding a plurality of auxiliary anchor rods; grouting is carried out between the anchor pile and the drilled hole, and supporting is completed. The invention can relieve the damage of severe environments such as freeze thawing, rainfall, earthquake and the like on the slope stability of the slope in the alpine region and the tunnel portal or in the northern region, fills up the gap of disaster prevention and reduction of the slope at the tunnel portal in the alpine region and in the northern region, and provides a slope support stability and slope platform pile foundation device.

title_en: Fire-fighting training method based on XR practical training big data analysis
abstract_en: The application provides a fire-fighting training method based on XR practical training big data analysis. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring environmental data, perception data and behavior data of each firefighting member during firefighting training by using XR equipment; integrating the environmental data, the perception data and the behavior data of each firefighter, and carrying out data analysis on the integrated data by adopting a big data analysis mode to obtain a data analysis result; the data analysis results comprise personal behavior scoring results of all firefighting members and team behavior scoring results among teams of firefighting members; and displaying the data analysis result through a visualization tool, and constructing a fire training learning model according to the data analysis result to train each fire fighter. By adopting the scheme of the embodiment of the invention, an intelligent and adaptive learning mode is provided for education and training by combining with XR technology and big data analysis, and students and professionals with more creativity and adaptability can be helped to be cultivated.
assignees: SHANGHAI MANHENG DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster influence assessment method and system based on double-precision GDP data distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster influence assessment method and system based on double-precision GDP data distribution, comprising the following steps: rasterizing a research area, and preprocessing research data; determining a first industry grid, and second and third industry grids; acquiring GDP panel data and spreading the GDP panel data to each grid; outputting primary low-resolution GDP spatial spread data; constructing a machine learning module, training, outputting secondary high-resolution GDP space spread data, and extracting a core region of GDP distribution; based on the secondary high-resolution GDP space spread data, adopting a hydrologic hydrodynamic model, simulating with a second precision aiming at a GDP core area, and evaluating the hysteresis effect, the overflow effect and the vulnerability of flood disasters; and giving high-precision GDP spread data including the influence degree information of flood disasters on GDP. By the double-precision spreading technology, the space-time resolution and accuracy of flood disaster assessment are greatly improved.

title_en: Mountain substation and surrounding river channel pipe network flood model construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a flood model based on mountain substations and surrounding river pipe networks, which belongs to the technical field of disaster simulation of power equipment and comprises the following steps: acquiring a first parameter related to basic information of an upstream small river basin of a transformer substation; acquiring a second parameter related to soil water content distribution of a peripheral surface slope of the transformer substation; determining a third parameter related to rainfall prediction of the transformer substation based on space scale conversion results of the storm spot data of different time periods and the storm face data of different areas; acquiring a fourth parameter related to the risk resistance of the transformer substation; and overlapping the first parameter, the second parameter, the third parameter and the fourth parameter in a weight-dividing manner, and constructing a comprehensive model of the transformer substation and the surrounding river channel network flood model. The method improves the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of flood risk assessment, enhances the dynamic prediction capability of flood behavior, and provides more accurate substation risk resistance capability assessment.

title_en: Test calibration method for quantifying falling stone impact force born by shed tunnel structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test calibration method for quantifying the falling stone impact force born by a shed tunnel structure. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a shed tunnel structure model, and arranging a resistance strain gauge, a pressure sensor and an acceleration sensor; releasing the drop hammer to acquire acquisition data; calculating the instant impact force of the drop hammer in contact with the shed tunnel structure model, the response impact force of the shed tunnel structure model and the feedback impact force of the shed tunnel structure model by utilizing the acquired data; and calibrating the response impact force through numerical comparison and error judgment of the instant impact force, the response impact force and the feedback impact force, obtaining the final impact force and judging the safety. According to the invention, laboratory simulation is carried out on similar disasters, the actual impact force born by the structure is determined after instrument acquisition data are inverted, the safety of the structure is judged after the structure is checked, the calculation process is clear and accurate, quantification of falling rock impact force born by the shed tunnel structure is realized, the method is more reliable than the conventional method which only judges by experience, and the service safety of the shed tunnel structure after the falling rock impact force is born is ensured.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD

title_en: High-precision batch numerical simulation method and system for offshore storm tide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision batch numerical simulation method for near-shore storm tide, which comprises the steps of obtaining research data of a region to be detected and preprocessing; analyzing the research data of the region to be detected to generate a preset center point; defining a first influence range according to a preset radius by taking a preset center point as a circle center, searching historical typhoons intersected with the first influence range one by one based on historical typhoons data, calculating influence time of the historical typhoons, and generating a typhoons path data set based on typhoons paths, influence ranges and influence time of each typhoons; generating a simulated storm tide alternative set by combining hydrological data of the region to be detected; and collecting measured wind speed data of an offshore meteorological site for correction, constructing a storm surge numerical simulation model, and training to obtain a final storm surge numerical result. The method realizes the fine simulation of storm surge by accurate data processing and model correction, and has important practical significance and application value for predicting and preventing storm surge disasters.

title_en: Comprehensive control method applicable to various water hazards in coal mine
abstract_en: The application discloses a coal mine water disaster comprehensive control method suitable for multiple types of water disasters, which comprises the following steps: performing advanced geophysical prospecting in a mine roadway based on a mine transient electromagnetic method, and performing advanced drilling on an abnormal area determined by the advanced geophysical prospecting; carrying out water quality test on a water sample collected by advanced drilling or carrying out water diversion test on faults to determine the water hazard type corresponding to an abnormal area, wherein the water hazard type comprises water hazard of a water-rich area of a water-bearing layer of a top plate of a working face, water hazard of a separation layer, water hazard of a hidden construction area and water hazard of the sky; corresponding water hazard prevention measures are adopted for different water hazard types, and the water hazard prevention measures comprise: setting drainage holes for drainage for water damage and separation layer water damage of the water-bearing layer of the top plate of the working face, and setting fault waterproof coal pillars for water damage of the hidden structural area. The method can generate an integrated control technology system for mine roof water damage, and can conduct targeted control aiming at different types of water damage.

title_en: System for quantitatively evaluating ship rescue drilling effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a system for quantitatively evaluating the rescue exercise effect of a ship, which comprises a ship rescue quantitative evaluation system, wherein the ship rescue quantitative evaluation system comprises an accident scene simulation module, a harmful factor simulation module and a control module, the harmful factor simulation module is used for simulating harmful environmental factors such as nuclear radiation, smog, harmful gas and the like, the system comprises a data transmitter, a data receiver, a connecting wire and the like, the control module mainly controls a light generating device, the sound generating device emits various light and sound to simulate a disaster scene and is used for controlling the data transmitter, different disaster intensities such as nuclear radiation, smog, harmful gas and the like are simulated through parameter setting and are used for collecting data of a data receiver.

title_en: Collaborative fusion and hierarchical prediction method for typical disaster risk heterogeneous information of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative fusion and grading prediction method for typical disaster risk heterogeneous information of a coal mine, which relates to the technical field of mining and information and comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a coal mine typical disaster risk multi-parameter index system to identify typical disaster risk characteristic parameters, screening typical disaster risk key characteristic parameters based on a time sequence-limited Boltzmann machine model, and extracting characteristics; step 2, constructing a typical disaster risk data fusion model and a multi-source information collaborative fusion database; step 3, constructing a typical disaster risk multi-parameter perception hierarchical prediction model based on a convolutional neural network and a long-term memory network, and training and evaluating the model based on collected historical data; and 4, constructing a typical disaster risk intelligent linkage and decision platform based on a big data technology. The method and the device can be used for rapidly pre-judging the coal mine environment state and classifying the coal mine environment state, so that the accuracy of judging the coal mine disaster type is improved.

title_en: Coring device and coring method for high-pressure water stratum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coring device used in high-pressure water stratum. The drill rod water-pumping prevention device comprises a sleeve structure, a sleeve joint and a drill rod water-pumping prevention structure, wherein a plurality of sleeve structures are longitudinally connected through the sleeve joints, a drill rod penetrates through the sleeve structure and the sleeve joint from top to bottom, the lower end of the drill rod is connected with the drill rod water-pumping prevention structure, the drill rod water-pumping prevention structure is positioned above a rock core pipe, a mud inlet hole and a drainage hole are arranged on the drill rod water-pumping prevention structure, the mud inlet hole is vertically arranged, the drainage hole is horizontally arranged, a mud hole one-way valve is positioned at the lower end of the mud inlet hole, a water outlet hole one-way valve is positioned at the outlet end of the drainage hole, and a water pressure sensor is arranged at the outlet end of the drainage hole and positioned inside the water outlet hole one-way valve. The invention has the advantages of improving the drilling quality, ensuring the drilling and coring of the high-pressure bearing water stratum, maintaining the long-term stability of drilling after the drilling and the coring are finished, and reducing the occurrence of disasters. The invention also discloses a coring method of the coring device used for the high-pressure water stratum.

title_en: Multi-stage tunnel crossing difficult stratum gushing water disaster risk prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-stage tunnel crossing difficult stratum gushing water disaster risk prediction method and system, comprising the following steps: acquiring hydrogeologic information and engineering geologic information within a certain range of the tunnel address area; establishing a hydrogeologic model in the simulation area by combining the tunnel trend, and carrying out numerical simulation to obtain the seepage field distribution of the simulation area; carrying out macroscopic risk classification on the simulation area, and primarily determining paragraphs needing to develop advanced forecast; in the construction excavation stage, determining a selected advanced geological prediction method based on risk classification and combining geological information of an excavated hole section, and establishing a risk evaluation index system based on the advanced geological prediction information; and (3) carrying out risk classification based on the established risk evaluation index system, and determining the risk level of the tunnel gushing water disaster by using a tunnel gushing water risk prediction model based on logistic regression.

title_en: Landslide hazard result evaluation method based on improved Stacking fusion model
