abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard result evaluation method based on an improved Stacking fusion model, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a landslide feature sample data set, extracting a landslide influence factor set and storing the landslide influence factor set in association with a landslide hazard result, S2, constructing a landslide hazard evaluation model, wherein the landslide hazard evaluation model comprises a primary learner layer and a secondary learner layer, the secondary learner layer comprises a support vector machine SVM, the support vector machine SVM takes the output and weight of the primary learner layer as input to output the landslide hazard classification result by using a kernel function, and S3, collecting landslide data of a research area, inputting the landslide hazard evaluation model and then outputting the landslide hazard result. The method has the advantages of high model prediction precision, high comprehensiveness and the like through the training of a plurality of models of the primary learner layer and the model training of the secondary learner layer of the landslide hazard evaluation model, and has important significance for preventing geological disaster hidden danger.

title_en: Distributed robust optimization method for passenger evacuation paths in subway station under flood condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency safety in the traffic field, in particular to a distributed robust optimization method for a passenger evacuation path in a subway station under a flood condition, which comprises the following steps: acquiring hydrodynamic parameters of water disaster conditions in a subway station; establishing a distributed robust optimization model of the passenger evacuation path in the subway station by utilizing the water power parameters of the water disaster condition in the subway station; obtaining a distributed robust optimization result of the passenger evacuation path in the subway station by using the distributed robust optimization model of the passenger evacuation path in the subway station, and simulating the evacuation movement of passengers when flood invades the subway station by combining hydrodynamic parameters in a flood environment with the passenger evacuation movement model; the distributed robust optimization method for the passenger evacuation of the subway station under the influence of uncertain factors is provided, so that the robustness and flexibility of a path optimization strategy are stronger, and the problem that the traditional robust optimization is too conservative is solved.

title_en: Four-pre-system based on data and model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-pre-system based on data and a model, belongs to the field of flood control prediction, and relates to the technology of data processing and model construction; the method comprises the steps of taking bottom plate data of a target monitoring area obtained by a bottom plate data obtaining unit as a base, constructing water conservancy professional models such as flood forecast, flood evolution, flood scheduling and flood inundation early warning of the target monitoring area by utilizing an emulation simulation engine, constructing a digital twin base platform, developing flood control four-pre application of the target monitoring area, supporting accurate flood control and disaster reduction decisions of the target monitoring area, converging knowledge such as forecast scheduling schemes, historical scenes, business rules and expert experience, developing a knowledge engine with business characteristics through extraction, fusion and reasoning, supporting flood control four-pre business of the target monitoring area, and providing knowledge support for flood forecast, sluice optimization scheduling and safe operation management of a river basin.
assignees: CHINA WATER SUNNY DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for shear test of deep reservoir rock mass under true three-dimensional stress
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shear test device and a shear test method under true three-dimensional stress of a deep reservoir rock body, comprising 6 pressure heads in the directions, wherein two pairs of pressure heads are positive stress loading pressure heads, the other pair of pressure heads are shear force loading pressure heads, each pressure head is provided with an acoustic emission probe, and the rear end of the positive stress loading pressure head is connected with a antifriction connecting component; the shear force loading pressure head comprises a fixed pressure block and a movable pressure block, the movable pressure block is arranged in a mounting groove at the front end of the fixed pressure block, and a spring is arranged behind the movable pressure block; when not pressed, the front end surface of the movable pressing block is flush with the front end surface of the fixed pressing block. The method can test under the three-dimensional shearing state similar to the real condition, accurately observe the shearing damage process of the rock under the high stress state by simulating the shearing fracture and sliding instability characteristics of the deep rock under the complex three-dimensional stress state, analyze the mechanical response, the fracture mechanism and the like of the rock, not only can promote the technical innovation and the resource development of the energy field, but also is beneficial to improving the geological disaster prediction and prevention level.

title_en: Forest fire spreading simulation and Internet of things-based forest fire prevention command method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire prevention command method and a system based on forest fire spreading simulation and the Internet of things, wherein the forest fire prevention command method and the system comprise the following steps: acquiring fire scene data when a fire disaster occurs in real time according to the entering parameters required by forest fire spreading simulation; the fire scene data are transmitted through the Internet of things and then are input into a trained LSTM model for simulation analysis, and a fire chart for evaluating the spreading influence degree of forest fire places is obtained; constructing each travel path of each appointed fire-fighting vehicle to the rescue place based on the fire diagram, and planning out the optimal rescue arrival path of each appointed fire-fighting vehicle; each action command will reach the action terminal for display, and the firefighter can act according to the above command. According to the invention, environmental data is received and transmitted in real time in a fire scene area through the Internet of things, and forest fire spread prediction driven by dynamic data is realized by means of a long-short-term memory neural network.

title_en: Water-retaining and anti-flushing coal mining method based on pressure relief fracture grouting to reconstruct anti-flushing water-resisting layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-retaining and anti-flushing coal mining method based on pressure relief crack grouting to reconstruct an anti-flushing water-resisting layer, which comprises the following steps: 1. exploration of mining area stratum information; 2. preparing a rock core sample and testing physical and mechanical parameters of each layer of stratum of a mining area; 3. layering the thick and hard sandstone layer; 4. carrying out multi-group directional drilling on a mining area; 5. hydraulic fracturing pressure relief; 6. constructing an anti-flushing waterproof layer; 7. constructing a fracture water-resisting layer; 8. water-retaining and water-flushing-preventing high-efficiency coal mining. The invention is characterized in that the pre-mining coal seam is layered and presplitting by covering the thick hard sandstone layer, the original hard sandstone layer is covered on the coal seam to be changed into the anti-impact waterproof layer, the impact problem caused by the thick hard sandstone layer in the coal mining process is solved, a great amount of slurry loss and waste in the grouting plugging process are avoided, the in-situ protection of the overlying strata is realized, the pressure relief fracturing and the grouting plugging are both realized by adopting the same drilling, the dynamic disaster and the permeable disaster in the coal mining process are prevented and treated, and the good effects of dual purposes of one hole and two disasters are realized.

title_en: The scene of labor accident prevention program automatic generation training platform
title_ko: 산업현장 재해예방 대책 자동생성 기술지도 플랫폼
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to improve the work efficiency of the person in charge by allowing the person in charge to conveniently write the technical guidance result report. The present invention relates to a technical map platform for automatically generating a disaster prevention countermeasure in an industrial site. The technical map platform for automatically generating a disaster prevention countermeasure in an industrial site comprises: a terminal in which an application for writing a report is formed, and which is formed to load the report embedded in the application and input the contents of the report from a user; and a report automatic writing providing server which provides a service for automatically writing the report inputted through the terminal. The present invention has an effect of increasing the understanding and accuracy of a report, reducing the writing time of the report, the work burden, increasing the on-site inspection and safety guidance time, and reducing the deviation of safety inspection technology.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산업현장 재해예방 대책 자동생성 기술지도 플랫폼에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 보고서 작성을 위한 어플이 형성되며, 상기 어플에 내장된 보고서를 불러와서 사용자로부터 상기 보고서의 내용을 입력할 수 있도록 형성되는 단말기와 상기 단말기를 통해 입력되는 상기 보고서의 자동 작성을 위한 서비스를 제공하는 보고서 자동작성 제공서버와 상기 단말기로부터 작성되는 상기 보고서의 각각의 항목에 어울리는 사진들을 첨부하기 위하여 상기 단말기의 표시부를 통해 현출된 상기 보고서의 사진 첨부를 하여야 할 공간에 상기 사진을 업로드하여 주는 업로드부;와  상기 보고서에 필요한 사진을 검색할 수 있도록 하기 위한 서치부;와 상기 보고서 생성모델 데이터베이스 및 상기 사용자의 기재 결과를 이용하여 해당 보고서를 작성 및 생성하기 위한 보고서 작성부;로 이루어지는 사진 저장부; 및 상기 보고서 자동작성 제공서버의 상기 보고서 작성부는 상기 보고서의 해당 결재자를 검색하여 상기 결재자의 단말기에 전달하고, 상기 결재자 단말기에 결재자가 전자서명을 하여 회신할 수 있도록 하기 위한 전자 서명부를 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: Landslide surge disaster chain simulation method based on MPS-DEM coupling calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge disaster chain simulation method based on MPS-DEM coupling calculation, which comprises the following steps: establishing a DEM landslide initial model and an MPS water initial model based on landslide geological survey data and river channel information; obtaining a landslide DEM model; obtaining a landslide movement evolution result based on a landslide DEM model; obtaining an MPS hydrodynamic model; importing landslide movement evolution results into an MPS hydrodynamic model for calculation to obtain water movement information; feeding the water motion information back to the landslide DEM model to finish coupling calculation, and obtaining a calculation model; obtaining variable physical information based on a calculation model; and when the variable physical information meets the preset condition, the landslide surge disaster chain simulation is completed. The method is used for numerical simulation of the surge problem caused by landslide, and the calculation result is accurate and reliable.

title_en: Pulping and hole sealing equipment in gas drainage drill hole
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mine gas disaster prevention and control, and relates to gas drainage drilling hole internal hole sealing equipment, which comprises a drainage pipe (2), wherein one end of the drainage pipe (2) positioned in a drilling hole (1) is connected with a sealing piece (4), and one end of the drainage pipe positioned outside the drilling hole (1) is connected with a converter (5); the outside of taking out and adopting pipe (2) is equipped with inflation bag (3) and prefabricated mud bag (6), prefabricated mud bag (6) are including cement sand bag (60) that are equipped with the cement sand, set up prefabricated mud bag water injection hole (223) on cement sand bag (60), through prefabricated mud bag water injection hole (223) to water injection in cement sand bag (60), mix cement mortar rather than inside cement sand the expansion is encircleed in taking out and is carried out the hole sealing in pipe (2) outside. The invention adopts the prefabrication slurry process to replace the on-site pulping process to carry out hole drilling and sealing, and solves the problems of complicated hole sealing process of gas extraction drilling and hole sealing and difficult transportation of hole sealing equipment.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: 5G base station energy storage and distribution network collaborative optimization scheduling method considering power supply reliability
abstract_en: The invention provides a 5G base station energy storage and distribution network collaborative optimization scheduling method considering power supply reliability, which realizes data dimension reduction and feature extraction of a real-time charge state of a multi-base station energy storage system through a pre-training VAE model, thereby adapting to communication base stations with different regional characteristics, avoiding dimension disaster caused by overlarge number of base stations, fully preserving the features of each base station and being convenient for appointing personalized charge and discharge strategies; meanwhile, the scheduling control model is configured into a Markov decision process aiming at the minimum system running cost, the VAE model is embedded into a TD3 algorithm, and VAE state codes are used as agents for training, so that the influence caused by wind power generation and energy storage equipment can be comprehensively reflected in the model due to the fact that the power generation cost, the energy storage battery loss cost and the base station energy storage lease cost of the system are considered, the energy storage charging and discharging strategies of all communication base stations are reasonably controlled, and further the wind power consumption level is improved and the system running cost is reduced.

title_en: Parameter optimization method for disaster-bearing body three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parameter optimization method of a disaster-bearing body three-dimensional model, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of current morphological parameters before disaster recovery and a plurality of influencing factors of the current morphological parameters; constructing a sample library based on a plurality of influencing factors and a plurality of current morphology parameters, constructing at least two single approximation models for at least one current morphology parameter in the plurality of current morphology parameters, and constructing a combined approximation model according to the at least two single approximation models; acquiring a current simulation signal according to the combined approximation model; determining whether the current morphology parameter is a target morphology parameter according to the current morphology parameter and the current simulation signal; when the current morphology parameter is not the target morphology parameter, determining an alternative morphology parameter according to the current morphology parameter and the current simulation signal based on a robust nonlinear correction method; and determining the target morphology parameters according to the alternative morphology parameters. The invention solves the technical problem of inaccurate measurement of the shape parameters of the disaster-bearing body in the three-dimensional construction process of the disaster-bearing body.
assignees: GUANGDONG INSTITUTE OF URBAN EARTHQUAKE SAFETY GUANGDONG ANTI DISASTER REDUCTION TECH COLLABORATIVE

title_en: Intelligent man-machine cooperation system and method based on E-CARGO model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent human-computer collaboration system and method based on an E-CARGO model, belonging to the technical field of human-computer collaboration, and comprising the following steps: the man-machine task allocation module: the system is used for analyzing task attributes and executor capabilities, and distributing and assigning for cooperation between people and machines; and a conflict collaboration analysis module: the method is used for detecting and solving potential conflict and collaboration between people and machines in aspects of tasks, resources and the like so as to optimize the collaboration efficiency and the system performance. The intelligent human-computer collaboration system and the intelligent human-computer collaboration method based on the E-CARGO model can realize intelligent task allocation and collaboration mechanism, enable collaboration among human-computer to be more efficient and intelligent, intelligently allocate tasks according to factors such as task demands, user characteristics, real-time states and the like, optimize collaborative work flow, improve overall collaboration effect, improve overall performance and user experience of the system, and can be used for various occasions such as emergency response, industrial production, simulation training and the like.

title_en: Storage tank full surface fire extinguishment drilling device capable of adjusting liquid level height
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-surface fire extinguishment exercise device of a storage tank with adjustable liquid level height, which comprises: the fire extinguishing device comprises a storage tank system, a floating disc system, a supply device, an ignition device, a limiting device, a cooling device, a fire extinguishing device, a monitoring device and a control device. The upper part of the storage tank system is opened, and water is injected inwards through the supply device; the floating disc system floats on the water surface and can move up and down, the position is controlled by the water level and the limiting device, and the limiting device can prevent the floating disc system from sinking the disc; the supply device is used for injecting oil into the floating disc system, and the oil product can simulate a full-surface fire disaster after being ignited by the ignition device; the cooling device can spray water to protect the tank wall; the fire extinguishing device sprays foam to extinguish fire; the monitoring device can monitor flame state information in fire extinguishment; the control device can intelligently control the processes of water injection, oil injection, ignition, fire extinguishment and the like, and the automation of the whole process is realized. The device can realize fire extinguishment exercise of the fire disaster on the whole surface of the storage tank under different liquid level heights, and has important significance on daily training of the fire extinguishment.

title_en: Analysis method for tunnel strain-structural plane sliding type rock burst damage mechanism by drilling and blasting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for analyzing a strain-structural surface sliding rock burst damage mechanism of a tunnel by a drilling and blasting method, which relates to the technical field of tunnel rock burst microseismic monitoring, and the method is characterized in that the strain-structural surface sliding rock burst microseismic data in the tunnel construction process are collected, and combined with engineering geological survey data, the microseismic monitoring and data analysis are carried out on the strain-structural surface sliding rock burst which has occurred in the tunnel, a strain-structural surface sliding rock burst risk area is divided, and determining a rock explosion microseismic early warning area, deeply knowing the strain-structural surface sliding rock explosion microseismic action rule of the tunnel by the deep-buried drilling and explosion method through the data, judging the respective functions of stretching and shearing in the rock breaking process, comprehensively analyzing the breaking mechanism of the strain-structural surface sliding rock explosion, further obtaining the strain-structural surface sliding rock explosion breaking mechanism of the tunnel by the deep-buried drilling and explosion method, and providing an important theoretical basis for predicting and preventing rock explosion disasters.

title_en: Method and system for predicting debris flow peak value of loose rock soil body dam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a method and a system for predicting debris flow peak value of a loose rock body dam. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: obtaining geographic feature data of a target dam; based on geographic feature data, respectively constructing a dam blocking experimental model, a first dam blocking simulation model and a second dam blocking simulation model; acquiring first debris flow data, second debris flow data and third debris flow data in a dam break process by using a dam blocking experimental model, a first dam blocking simulation model and a second dam blocking simulation model respectively; and correcting the third debris flow data according to the first debris flow data and the second debris flow data, and predicting a start flow peak of the dam by the dam through the corrected third debris flow data. The method can estimate the debris flow more accurately, is beneficial to early warning and taking necessary safety measures, and reduces disaster risks possibly caused by dam break.

title_en: Fireproof glass detection furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of glass production, in particular to a fireproof glass detection furnace, which comprises a device main body, wherein a simulation wallboard is clamped on the surface of the front side of the device main body, a glass installation structure is clamped on the middle part of the simulation wallboard, the simulation wallboard comprises a wall installation frame, brick walls are fixedly installed inside the wall installation frame, glass clamping frames are fixedly installed on the middle part of the brick walls, the glass installation structure comprises two glass installation frames, the two glass installation frames are mutually spliced, fireproof sealing strips are fixedly clamped inside glass clamping grooves, and fireproof glass is fixedly clamped inside the fireproof sealing strips. According to the utility model, the installation and use conditions of the fireproof glass are simulated through the brick wall and the fireproof glass when an actual fire disaster occurs, so that detection data which is more fit with the actual conditions is obtained, and meanwhile, the detachable simulated wallboard and glass installation structure also ensure the convenience of disassembly and assembly so as to cope with the detection work of the fireproof glass with different specifications and sizes.
assignees: GUANGDONG HENGDA FIREPROOF MAT CO LTD

title_en: Test method and device for simulating overload-induced deep karst collapse of dense building group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test method and a device for simulating overload-induced deep karst collapse of a dense building group, wherein the device comprises a model test box, a karst channel mechanism, a loading mechanism, an intelligent display mechanism, an image acquisition mechanism, a data analysis mechanism, a karst collapse soil body collection mechanism and a supporting mechanism, wherein the model test box is used for placing test soil bodies, the karst channel mechanism is distributed with karst channels with different sizes, the loading mechanism is used for simulating application of loads of the dense building group in cities and soil body consolidation, the intelligent display mechanism is used for observing changes of upper-cover-layer soil bodies and lower-cover karst channels in the loading process, the data analysis mechanism is used for collecting collapsed soil bodies, and the supporting mechanism is used for providing counter force to balance the applied loads. Compared with the prior art, the method can provide technical support for researching deep karst collapse caused by static overload of the urban dense building group, can reveal the mechanism of deep karst collapse under the static overload of the urban dense building group, judges critical disaster causing and damaging conditions of the deep karst collapse of the urban, and provides reference value for the treatment and prevention of the deep karst collapse of the urban.

title_en: Falling stone release collision test device
abstract_en: The invention provides a falling stone release collision test device which comprises a frame, a falling stone release mechanism and a slope angle simulation mechanism, wherein supporting rods extend out of two sides of a test block, two clamps respectively clamp the two supporting rods, and at least one supporting rod is correspondingly connected with a driving piece to drive the test block to rotate so as to obtain the rolling rotation speed; the slope angle simulation mechanism is arranged below the frame, the slope angle simulation machine is provided with a slope surface positioned right below the falling stone release mechanism, and stone plates are arranged on the slope surface. The falling rock release mechanism and the slope angle simulation mechanism are arranged for carrying out falling rock collision test, wherein the falling rock release mechanism can enable the test block to rotate, so that the actual falling rock collision process is restored to a greater extent, the combined slope angle simulation mechanism can also study the falling rock collision recovery coefficient under the combined action of each single main control factor and complex main control factors, reference is provided for the development of falling rock disaster prediction programs and the design of related protection structures, and a new research direction is provided for more fully and comprehensively recognizing and researching the collision motion process in the follow-up process.

title_en: Intelligent mine comprehensive management and control platform and airtight goaf disaster monitoring, prevention and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire control, in particular to an intelligent mine comprehensive management and control platform and a method for monitoring, preventing and controlling disaster in a sealed goaf. The monitoring method comprises the following steps: carrying out grid encryption division on the oxidation heating zone; acquiring a high Wen Huoyuan point judgment result of the monitoring subsystem and judging the consistency of the result; dividing the positions among the encryption grids, and calculating the weight of the judgment result of each monitoring subsystem; and fusing the judgment results of all the monitoring subsystems to obtain a fire risk level judgment result. The control method comprises the following steps: establishing a closed goaf numerical model and simulating and analyzing the control effects of different control methods; comparing the time consumption and the running cost of different control methods; and selecting a proper control method to treat the fire according to the fire risk level judgment result. The intelligent monitoring processing module is used for realizing the method and linking with the existing monitoring system and control device, realizing comprehensive monitoring and effective control of the closed goaf and improving the safety and production efficiency of mines.
assignees: TIANDI CHANGZHOU AUTOMATION CO;CHANGZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD OF CHINA COAL TECH AND ENGINEERING GROUP

title_en: Fine population space data calculation method based on volume rate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a refined population space data calculation method based on volume rate, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting data, namely firstly determining data requirements, confirming collected population data, building data, POL data and road network data by determining the requirements, and performing checksum arrangement; s2, preprocessing data, importing the data into corresponding software, preprocessing population, buildings, POIs and road data by using the software, calculating population density of villages and towns, average volume rate of the buildings, and calculating POL density and road network density. According to the invention, the calculation result is more refined and the accuracy is higher through the volume rate-based refined population space data calculation method, so that the refined representation of the population space distribution characteristics can be well realized, the more accurate quantitative simulation of the population space distribution characteristics is realized, and reliable basic data can be provided for refined management of people and accurate evaluation of disasters.

title_en: Pedestrian evacuation danger level assessment method under fire spread in indoor environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pedestrian evacuation danger level assessment method under the spreading of fire in an indoor environment, which comprises the following steps: constructing a fire scene physical model by using PyroSim, converting the fire scene physical model into a cell set, and obtaining the concentration of carbon monoxide in each cell; establishing a pedestrian evacuation simulation platform based on analog, and presetting the age, sex and total number of the initial people to be evacuated; dividing the people to be evacuated into multiple categories by taking age and gender as group attributes, and acquiring average walking speeds of the people to be evacuated in non-limiting cells and cells with different critical cells of each category so as to generate pedestrian movement logics in each cell together with the group attributes of the people to be evacuated of each category, and generating pedestrian movement routes of the people to be evacuated in each cell of each category by combining a social force model; setting evacuation time, enabling people to be evacuated to travel according to corresponding pedestrian moving routes, and acquiring a current danger level according to the ratio of the total number of the rest people to be evacuated to the total number of the initial people to be evacuated when the evacuation time is over.

title_en: Radar human body activity recognition model for synchronously encoding space-time information and training method
abstract_en: The invention provides a neural network model for identifying human body activity according to radar human body activity data, comprising: the space-time information encoder is used for synchronously encoding time information and space information according to the radar human body activity data; the feature extraction module is used for fusing the time information and the space information to extract human body activity features; and the external attention module is used for classifying the human body activities according to the extracted human body activity characteristics. The neural network model can effectively improve the generalization performance of the model, can realize higher accuracy on more complex human body activities, and can be applied to actual scenes such as fall detection, disaster rescue and the like.

title_en: Site-scale grassland area snow physical process simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a site-scale grassland area snow physical process simulation method. According to the method, physical quantity changes such as snow depth, snow density, snow particle size and the like along with time are simulated by utilizing meteorological station hour period observation data. The method is a single-point one-dimensional model, namely only the influence of meteorological conditions on a single-point position on snow is considered, the influence of surrounding environment on snow is not considered, and the influence method of the snow thickness on the snow albedo is considered, so that the physical quantity of accumulated snow is obtained through simulation, and particularly the snow depth and the duration of the snow are more scientific and reliable, and the method is beneficial to the management department to predict and manage snow disasters in grassland areas.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Power supply-keeping decision analysis system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply-protecting decision analysis system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises a weather disaster prediction module, a power supply-protecting decision generation module, a digital twin simulation module and a decision analysis output module; the weather disaster prediction module is used for predicting weather disasters in the target area; the power supply protection decision generation module acquires a power supply protection decision corresponding to the early warning weather disaster in the target area according to the weather disaster prediction result; the digital twin simulation module simulates weather disasters in a target area and executes power supply protection decisions to obtain simulation results; the decision analysis output module analyzes the simulation result and outputs the analysis result. The method makes a supply-keeping decision in a weather disaster early warning stage, and is accurate and effective in time abundance and supply-keeping decision; and providing improvement suggestions, simulating various supply protection decisions, taking measures in time when disasters occur, and adjusting the supply protection decisions in time according to the development trend and alternative schemes of the disasters so as to ensure the electricity safety, property safety and life safety in a target area.
assignees: NANJING NARI WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Depth-supervision multi-view fusion radar human body posture sensing model and training method
abstract_en: The invention provides a neural network model, which identifies human body activities according to radar human body activity data, comprising: the feature transformation network is used for generating a multi-view fusion feature map according to the radar human body activity data; the feature extraction network is used for extracting human body posture features from the multi-view fusion feature map; and the gesture regression network is used for identifying the human gesture category according to the human gesture characteristics. The human body depth map and the key skeleton point map provided by the depth camera are used as the middle layer supervision and the bottom layer supervision of the network, so that the human body gesture recognition accuracy is improved, and the system can be applied to actual scenes such as fall detection, disaster rescue and the like.

title_en: High-precision people stream evacuation system and method based on image processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision people stream evacuation system and a method based on image processing, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring image data of population density of the region to be detected; the video image processing module is used for carrying out image processing operation on the acquired image data, wherein the image processing operation comprises graying, binarization and noise cleaning; the people flow density dynamic display module is used for establishing an object detection frame of the region of interest; the early warning module is used for judging the result after the people flow density processing and generating corresponding early warning information for the specific high-risk area to feed back; and the path planning module is used for simulating fish shoal foraging, gathering and rear-end collision behaviors according to the artificial fish shoal method to find and plan an optimal path. According to the invention, the artificial fish swarm method is utilized to simulate the actions of fish swarm foraging, swarming, rear-end collision and the like to realize the searching of the optimal path, so that the evacuation efficiency is improved, and the evacuation risk and the congestion degree are reduced.
assignees: HUBEI PUBLIC INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging risk evaluation method based on hydrodynamic model and improved projection pursuit
abstract_en: The application relates to a city waterlogging risk evaluation method based on a hydrodynamic model and improved projection pursuit, which comprises the steps of acquiring relevant data of a research area, and carrying out gridding analysis processing on the research area according to the relevant data by a space analysis tool based on a geographic information system to obtain a research grid area; performing simulation coupling by using a one-dimensional pipe network model and a two-dimensional earth surface flooding model to obtain flooding information corresponding to a research grid area and determining the flooding information as disaster factor data; relevant data are imported into a vulnerability model for data processing, so that vulnerability index data are obtained; optimizing the projection pursuit model by utilizing a K-means clustering algorithm based on disaster factor data and vulnerability index data to obtain an optimized projection pursuit model; and calculating to obtain the weight of each index and the characteristic value of each index based on the optimized projection pursuit model, and evaluating the waterlogging risk of the research grid area. The method has the effect of reducing the influence of the weights of different influence factors on the risk evaluation result of urban inland inundation.
assignees: GUANGDONG AIKE ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood control disaster test operation table
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flood control disaster test operation table, and belongs to the technical field of flood disaster tests. The utility model provides a flood control waterlogging disaster test operation panel, includes the drainage test bench, still includes the water storage cabin, and it sets up in the top of drainage test bench, the outside of water storage cabin is provided with the breast board, and breast board and drainage test bench set up as an organic whole structure, one side of drainage test bench is provided with the control screen, and the inboard of breast board is provided with the water level float pipe, the bottom of drainage test bench opposite side is provided with the circulating pump. In order to solve the problem that the model cannot intuitively know the influence of different well lid structures on urban waterlogging drainage, the working efficiency of the pump is adjusted to control the rainfall at the rainwater simulator, so that the rainwater states of different grades are simulated, the water accumulation condition of the water storage cabin can be timely read by the water level floating pipe in the process, and the drainage efficiency of the current test well lid is obtained.
assignees: ANHUI XINFU XIANGTIAN ECOLOGICAL AGRICULTURE CO LTD

title_en: Adaptive cause and effect rules for emergency evacuation
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and devices for adaptive cause and effect rules for emergency evacuation are described herein. One method includes performing a plurality of fire drills at a facility having a fire control panel, receiving data associated with each of the plurality of fire drills, and modifying cause and effect rules stored and implemented by the fire control panel based on the received data.

title_en: AI and MR technology based virtual-real fusion simulation medical teaching method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual-real fusion simulation medical teaching method and system based on AI and MR technology, and relates to the technical field of training assistance. The virtual-real fusion simulation medical teaching system based on the AI and MR technology combines the virtual human model with the actual space scene and the actual rubber simulator by using the MR mixed reality technology, thereby realizing the effect of virtual-real combination. The user carries out real physical operation and real-time force feedback on the rubber simulation person, processes the data through an algorithm, feeds back the data to the virtual human model in real time, and the virtual human model can carry out dynamic adjustment according to the real-time data, interacts with an operator, supports simultaneous operation and interaction of multiple devices and multiple persons, achieves the simulation disaster rescue site, and introduces an AI intelligent algorithm to enable the virtual human model to have autonomous learning and decision making capability. The medical dispatching coordination system is designed according to the requirements of on-site medical treatment of large disasters, can simulate treatment and coordinate medical dispatching, optimizes rescue flow and improves rescue efficiency.

title_en: Multi-source data fusion method, computer program product and system for preventing hidden danger of cigarette warehouse fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a computer program product and a system for preventing hidden danger of fire hazard in a cigarette warehouse by multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a three-dimensional virtual model of a cigarette warehouse, simulating the height of a cigarette stack according to the variety and packaging characteristics of the cigarettes, calculating the stability of the cigarette stack according to the height of the cigarette stack and the temperature and humidity data of the cigarette warehouse, predicting fire types and fire scales by combining temperature, smoke concentration, combustion characteristic data and the stability of the cigarette stack, predicting a fire spreading path, a fire spreading speed and smoke distribution in the cigarette warehouse, determining potential high-risk positions of the fire spreading, determining a fire coping strategy in the cigarette warehouse, including an emergency evacuation path and a putting out path avoiding the potential high-risk positions, predicting evacuation time and an evacuation bottleneck region according to the channel layout of the emergency evacuation path and the putting out path, and outputting a scheme for optimizing the channel layout of the evacuation bottleneck region, the height of the cigarette stack, the fire extinguishing agent distribution and the arrangement of a safety outlet.

title_en: Geological investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control, which relates to the technical field of geological investigation, and a U-shaped frame is longitudinally and slidably arranged on a supporting plate; the screw barrel is longitudinally and slidably arranged on the supporting plate, the screw rod is rotatably arranged in the screw barrel, the connecting barrel is in contact fit with the bottom of the screw rod, a plurality of groups of sampling holes are sequentially formed in the connecting barrel, four groups of connecting components are uniformly arranged below the connecting barrel, two adjacent groups of connecting mechanisms are matched, and a drill bit is arranged below the first group of connecting barrel; the sampling frame is axially and slidably arranged inside the connecting cylinder, the sampling hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged on the sampling frame, the sampling cylinder is fixedly arranged at the output end of the sampling hydraulic cylinder, and the sampling cylinder and a sampling hole on the connecting cylinder are coaxial to sample. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the access mechanism drives the connecting mechanism into soil; and the adjacent connecting mechanisms are connected through connecting assemblies, soil with different depths is sampled, and a variable experiment is performed.
assignees: SHANDONG GEO MINERAL PROSPECTING DEVELOPMENT BUREAU 5TH GEO MINERAL PROSPECTING INST

title_en: Multi-element fire-fighting strength dispatching method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-element fire-fighting strength dispatching method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring disaster information of a disaster scene, and acquiring characteristic elements of the disaster according to the disaster information; inputting the characteristics into a pre-trained multi-element fire-fighting strength dispatch model, and outputting fire-fighting dispatch scheme categories of disaster conditions; the multi-element fire-fighting strength dispatch model is obtained after training based on a characteristic element sample and a fire-fighting dispatch scheme category label corresponding to the characteristic element sample. And the fire control command center dispatches fire control force corresponding to the fire control dispatch plan category to the disaster scene according to the fire control dispatch plan category. The invention obtains the class of the fire control dispatching scheme by utilizing the pre-established multi-element fire control dispatching model, realizes the standardization of the alarm receiving and processing flow, the standardization of data and the convenience of operation, and efficiently supports the fire control dispatching work of the fire control command center.

title_en: Analysis method for instability characteristics of roof water-resisting layer based on discrete unit method
abstract_en: The application discloses an analysis method of a roof water-resisting layer instability characteristic based on a discrete unit method, which comprises the following steps: determining a physical equation and a motion equation of a discrete unit method based on the properties of the bulk unit; establishing a geomechanical model aiming at a target working surface and a target coal seam; determining parameters of a geomechanical model according to stratum distribution characteristics and physical mechanical parameters of the target working surface and the target coal seam; and carrying out numerical simulation of a mining process by using a model based on a determined discrete unit method, obtaining a fracture map, a motion displacement map and a stress distribution map of a overburden layer of a target working surface in a propelling process, comprehensively analyzing fracture and damage change processes of a water-resisting layer in the working surface propelling process according to a plurality of obtained numerical simulation images, and correspondingly analyzing roof fracture evolution characteristics, overburden displacement characteristics and overburden stress distribution characteristics. The method can comprehensively analyze the mining instability mechanism and damage degree of the roof water-resisting layer, and is beneficial to preventing roof water inrush disasters.

title_en: Multifunctional double-layer tunnel fire physical test platform and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional double-layer tunnel fire physical test platform and a test method, wherein the multifunctional double-layer tunnel fire physical test platform comprises a tunnel model, the tunnel model comprises a tunnel main body, the tunnel main body is divided into an upper layer of lanes and a lower layer of lanes, the upper layer of lanes adopt a top smoke discharging mode, a top smoke discharging channel is arranged in an arc-shaped space at the top of the lanes, the lower layer of lanes are provided with two smoke discharging modes of side smoke discharging and branch smoke discharging, a smoke discharging branch pipe which is communicated with a lower layer smoke discharging port and the top smoke discharging channel is arranged in a space at one side of the lanes, and the other side of the lanes is provided with side smoke discharging channels; the three smoke discharging modes are respectively started; when simulating fire, the fire source position can be moved, and different fire working conditions can be simulated by respectively placing the fire source position on the upper layer or the lower layer. The invention can not only respectively perform experimental simulation of the fire disasters of the upper and lower tunnels, but also integrate three smoke discharging modes into one model, and respectively comprehensively evaluate the smoke control effects of the top smoke discharging mode, the side smoke discharging mode and the branch smoke discharging mode.
assignees: WUHAN CCCC TRAFFIC ENG CO LTD

title_en: Physical simulation test device for soil landslide
abstract_en: The application provides a physical simulation test device for soil landslide, and relates to the technical field of physical simulation of soil landslide due to geological disasters. The invention relates to a physical simulation test device for a soil landslide, which comprises a bottom plate, a stacking component, a lifting component, a rainfall component, a wave forming component, a monitoring component, a loading component, a vibration component and a camera, wherein the stacking component is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, the lifting component is arranged on one side above the stacking component, and the monitoring components are arranged on two sides of the stacking component.
assignees: CHENGDU GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY SOUTHWEST GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH IN

title_en: Combustible gas alarm control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas detection, in particular to a combustible gas alarm control system and a method, wherein the system comprises an intelligent monitoring module, a risk identification module, a sensor strategy optimization module, an energy efficiency optimization management module, a predictive maintenance module, an emergency response module and a system dynamic reconstruction module. In the invention, environmental data fluctuation is analyzed by adopting a support vector machine, the relevance of risk factors is evaluated by a Bayesian network, the sensor layout and parameters are optimized by a genetic algorithm and a simulated annealing algorithm, the energy consumption distribution is adjusted by a particle swarm optimization algorithm and a dynamic programming algorithm, equipment faults are predicted by combining a long-period memory network with an anomaly detection algorithm, emergency response measures are formulated by a DSS technology and event-driven programming, and the system dynamic reconstruction is carried out by a reinforcement learning and genetic programming algorithm, so that the occurrence probability of accidents is greatly reduced by the system, the maintenance cost is reduced, and the operation safety and economic benefit are improved.
assignees: JIANGXI YIAI HONGTAI FIRE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Road natural disaster risk assessment method based on supervised learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of road natural disaster risk assessment, and in particular discloses a road natural disaster risk assessment system based on supervised learning, which comprises the following steps: determining the natural disaster type of a road in a research area; determining influence factors of natural disasters of roads; establishing a neural network linear regression training set based on the data; training and saving a training model and optimal weights; establishing a road natural disaster prediction data set and calculating a prediction result; cross-verifying the training set and the prediction set; grading the influence factors and the evaluation results, and drawing a road natural disaster risk demarcation graph by using the ArcGIS. The invention establishes a road natural disaster risk assessment index system and a neural network linear regression assessment model based on the actual situation of a research area and by combining the relevant influences of weather, geology and human activities. The method has the advantages of easy acquisition of the influence factor index, simple operation, and capability of providing theoretical basis and technical means for the development of a subsequent road natural disaster risk assessment and early warning system.

title_en: High-strength roadway impact-resistant hydraulic support and rock burst control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength roadway anti-collision hydraulic support and a rock burst prevention method. The tunnel scour protection hydraulic support includes: the drilling machine comprises a top beam, a shield beam, a tail beam, a front beam, a connecting rod, a base, a pushing device, a slope protecting device, a stand column, a hydraulic system and a drilling machine, wherein the shield beam and the tail beam are connected with the top beam, the front beam, the connecting rod and the base are connected with the shield beam, the pushing device and the slope protecting device are connected with the base, drilling holes are formed in the top beam and the shield beam at the upper end of the drilling machine, punching pressure relief is carried out, and a dust treatment device is arranged on the drilling machine and used for collecting drill cuttings for real-time monitoring. The invention adopts a mode of combining drilling pressure relief and drilling cutting method, can timely and effectively discover and prevent rock burst disasters, and ensures safe production in the coal exploitation process.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;STATE GRID ENERGY HAMI COAL POWER CO LTD DANAN LAKE NO 1 MINE;HUAIYIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method and device for efficiently analyzing industrial time sequence database
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for efficiently analyzing an industrial time sequence database, comprising the following steps: establishing connection with an industrial time sequence database, and reading time sequence data in the industrial time sequence database; extracting features of the read time sequence data; inputting the extracted features into a random forest algorithm model for model training; predicting data results by using the random forest algorithm model obtained through training, and deciding the characteristic of data attribution; evaluating by comparing actual characteristics of sample data with predicted characteristic results to obtain evaluation results; judging whether the model needs to be optimized according to the evaluation result, if so, adjusting algorithm parameters according to the result evaluation condition, and if not, completing the data analysis process. According to the invention, machine learning is introduced into analysis of the industrial control time sequence database, so that the analysis capability and accuracy of the time sequence database can be improved, and reliable data support can be provided for subsequent prediction of potential safety hazards of industrial equipment, disaster prevention and reduction, intelligent management and the like.
assignees: CHINA IND CONTROL SYSTEMS CYBER EMERGENCY RESPONSE TEAM

title_en: Hydrological model parameter uncertainty analysis method based on Morris and Sobol methods
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster research, and discloses a hydrological model parameter uncertainty analysis method based on Morris and Sobol methods, which comprises the steps of: collecting measured rainfall runoff data and geographic data of a research river basin; based on the collected data. According to the invention, an HEC-HMS hydrological model is constructed according to measured rainfall runoff data, soil types, land utilization and other remote sensing image data, and a proper yield and confluence scheme is selected to perform runoff simulation of a small river basin; the Morris method and the Sobol method are combined to qualitatively and quantitatively analyze the sensitivity of the model parameters, so that the relation between the parameter fluctuation and the model output variable is obtained, and the sensitivity parameters are identified; and constructing a parameter optimization regression model based on a random forest algorithm, analyzing HEC-HMS model results output by different parameter combinations, taking a Nash coefficient as an objective function, outputting a parameter optimal combination, and then substituting the parameter optimal combination into the HEC-HMS model for calibration and verification.

title_en: Fire disaster type identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire disaster type identification method and a fire disaster type identification system. The fire disaster type identification method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of remote sensing images of different types of fires, and preprocessing the remote sensing images; selecting pixels of various fire smoke and pixels of non-fire areas from the preprocessed remote sensing images; respectively extracting wave band information of pixels of various types of fire smoke and pixels of non-fire areas, wherein the wave band information comprises reflectivities of the pixels in different wave bands; calculating smoke identification indexes of pixels of various types of fire smoke and pixels of non-fire areas based on the wave band information; constructing a BP neural network model by using the flue gas identification index as a channel, and training the BP neural network model based on remote sensing images; and carrying out fire type identification on the fire remote sensing image to be identified by using the trained BP neural network model. According to the method, the types of the fires are accurately distinguished through the remote sensing images, and the speed and accuracy of fire type identification are improved.

title_en: Rainfall-induced reservoir landslide to dam disaster-causing analysis test system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall-induced reservoir landslide to dam disaster analysis test system, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster test research. The device comprises a reservoir area, a landslide simulation area, a water supply area, a tail water area and a data acquisition area, wherein the landslide simulation area is positioned on a side slope of the reservoir area, the water supply area is positioned at the upstream of the reservoir area, a water drainage channel is arranged between the water supply area and the reservoir area, the tail water area is positioned at the downstream of the reservoir area, a dam is arranged between the tail water area and the reservoir area, the tail water area is communicated with the water supply area through a water return pipeline, and the data acquisition area is positioned at the outer side of the reservoir area and is used for collecting data signals of a detection device buried in a dam body of the dam in the test process. The invention can reduce the topographic features of the prototype reservoir area, simulate the whole process of landslide disaster occurrence, and monitor the change of the reservoir area water level and the condition of the dam under the impact force and tensile stress of water flow in the landslide disaster occurrence process, thereby evaluating the disaster situation of the reservoir area and the dam.

title_en: Power supply management method and system based on intelligent portrait of area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply management method and a system based on intelligent images of a platform, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power supply of the platform and comprise the following steps: monitoring the state of the power grid in real time, and monitoring key power grid parameters; performing fusion analysis on the environmental sensor data and the power grid monitoring data to construct a district intelligent portrait; starting an intelligent demand response mechanism, and coordinating intelligent equipment and distributed energy resources; testing the performance of the power grid under different conditions by using a virtual power grid simulation technology, and adjusting a control strategy; performing power grid fault diagnosis and performance monitoring, and implementing self-healing measures to cope with the detected problems; emergency response and grid reconstruction are performed. The power supply management method based on the intelligent portrait of the area provided by the invention has quicker and more accurate response to faults. And can adapt to changing conditions and potential faults. The overall operation efficiency and the energy utilization rate of the power grid are improved. The frequency and the severity of faults are reduced, and the maintenance cost and the economic loss are reduced.
assignees: TAIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;XINTAI POWER SUPPLY COMOANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Disaster digital twin simulation method combining refined dynamic geologic model with GEOAI
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster digital twin simulation method combining a refined dynamic geologic model with GEOAI, and relates to the field of coal mine safety. Modeling and grid initialization of a refined dynamic geologic model; initializing parameters of a disaster simulation calculation unit of the refined dynamic geologic model; refining the simulation of the dynamic geologic model disaster simulation, and solving a disaster simulation result; real-time dynamic correction of disaster simulation input and boundary conditions is performed on the refined dynamic geologic model by using geologic disclosure and perception data; establishing a refined dynamic geological disaster evolution database; training a refined dynamic geological disaster simulation reasoning calibration model by using the geospatial artificial intelligence; and carrying out disaster evolution and inversion by using a dynamically corrected refined dynamic geologic model disaster simulation and simulation reasoning calibration model, and providing decision support for mine geologic disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Research method for water burst pregnancy and disaster process of separation layer
abstract_en: The application discloses a research method of a water inrush and pregnancy disaster process of a separation layer, which comprises the following steps: constructing geomechanical models aiming at the working face and the coal seam, and adjusting model parameters according to the mechanical parameter data of the working face and the coal seam; performing numerical simulation on the process of mining the coal seam on the working surface through a geomechanical model, and determining the change process of roof separation from generation to closure according to a plurality of numerical simulation result images of the overlying strata when the working surface is mined to different distances; the rock stratum damage process of the separation layer is determined by carrying out mechanical analysis on the water burst of the separation layer, and the numerical simulation analysis is carried out on the dynamic change process of the water burst pregnancy disaster of the separation layer by combining the formation condition of the water burst of the top plate, the change process of the separation layer of the top plate and the rock stratum damage process, and the critical value of the thickness of the lower complete rock stratum when the water burst of the separation layer occurs is determined. The method can accurately and comprehensively master the separation layer water inrush mechanism of the working face and conduct targeted separation layer water inrush prediction and prevention measures.

title_en: Tunnel fire disaster fire source parameter inversion method and system based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel fire disaster fire source parameter inversion method based on data driving, which comprises the steps of respectively constructing an experimental tunnel and a simulation tunnel of a target tunnel in the process of acquiring data, carrying out experiments in the experimental tunnel to acquire a verification data set, and carrying out numerical simulation in the simulation tunnel to construct a simulation data set; therefore, the validity of the simulation data set can be verified by utilizing a limited verification data set, so that the simulation data set can be ensured to have enough data quantity, the validity of the simulation data set can be ensured, the prediction precision of the obtained tunnel fire disaster fire source parameter inversion prediction model can be effectively improved, in the application process, only a small number of temperature sensors are required to be arranged in a target tunnel, the fire source position and the fire source heat release rate can be predicted in a data driving mode, and the required execution time is far less than the execution time of CFD numerical simulation and is also far less than the actual spreading time of early smoke of the tunnel fire disaster.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Characterization model and detection method for excessive fire metal intensity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of strength characterization of electric power fire disaster excessive fire steel materials, and particularly relates to a model for characterizing excessive fire metal strength based on Rich hardness and microstructure, and a method for detecting the excessive fire metal strength. According to the model for representing the intensity of carbon steel after electric fire based on the Richner hardness and the microstructure, an equivalent overfire sample is prepared by simulating a fire scene, and an intensity mathematical model is obtained by adopting a multiple linear regression method based on the actually measured intensity, hardness, metallographic structure and element components. According to the method for detecting the intensity of the excessive fire metal, the intensity of the carbon steel material after the electric fire is detected by correlating the Richter hardness, the grain size and the metallographic structure of the carbon steel material after the electric fire with the intensity, and the method has the advantages of simplicity in operation and high accuracy.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Inflammable gas remote monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flammable gas leakage monitoring, in particular to a flammable gas remote monitoring system which comprises a gas flow simulation module, a spectrum analysis module, a sound wave detection module, an ultrasonic measurement module, a radar positioning module, an emergency management module, a safety strategy making module and a system maintenance module. According to the invention, a computational fluid dynamics model and a microfluidic chip technology are adopted to enable gas flow simulation to be more accurate, leakage diffusion characteristics are subjected to deep analysis, a differential absorption spectrometry and a sound scattering analysis technology are adopted to improve recognition capability of different gases (hydrogen sulfide, methane, ammonia and carbon monoxide), early detection and recognition of types of leakage gases are performed, a synthetic aperture radar technology and an ultra-wideband signal processing algorithm can be used for carrying out three-dimensional space positioning on a leakage source, and application of a Bayesian network and multi-criterion decision analysis provides more scientific risk assessment and emergency response plans when leakage occurs.
assignees: SHENZHEN TIANYI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Predictive evaluation method and system for influence of meteorological disaster on power equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction evaluation method and a system for the influence of meteorological disasters on power equipment, belonging to the technical field of prediction of the influence of meteorological disasters on power equipment; the technical problems to be solved are as follows: providing a predictive evaluation method and a predictive evaluation system for influence of meteorological disasters on power equipment; the technical scheme adopted for solving the technical problems is as follows: predicting weather values in the region based on three-dimensional variation assimilation analysis to obtain a weather value prediction model with accurate prediction results: building a power equipment adjacent area 3D model: extracting quantitative characterization parameters of elevation data, topography curvature and topography humidity index, checking and preprocessing the collected data, and constructing a model; performing sensitivity analysis on the air flow characteristics of the micro-topography area based on the hydrodynamic calculation; constructing a regional weather element forecasting model: training the constructed model, and defining each training process; the method is applied to the predictive evaluation of the influence of the meteorological disaster on the power equipment.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Railway bridge mountain torrent risk evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway bridge mountain torrent risk evaluation method and system, and belongs to the technical field of natural disaster risk evaluation. The invention is based on a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, and simulates the dynamic evolution process of dam break and storm mountain torrent; based on simulation results of the water depth, the flow velocity and the like of the railway bridge and the surrounding grids, calculating the impact force of the mountain torrents on the railway bridge, and calculating the pier resistance; and determining the risk level based on the impact force and the pier resistance by referring to the cement marks, the reinforcement marks, the ratio of the whole height of the pier to the submerged water depth. The invention utilizes the advantages of the two-dimensional hydrodynamic model that the required data is less and the dynamic process can be simulated in the mountain torrent simulation of the non-data area, increases the impact force of the mountain torrent of the dynamic factors and the impact resistance of the bridge pier on the railway bridge on the basis of comprehensively considering various influence factors, and improves the reliability of risk assessment.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Loss function construction method and system based on scene flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loss function construction method and system based on scene flood disasters, comprising the steps of acquiring basic data of a research area and preprocessing; constructing a simulation model and calibrating model parameters; screening flood disaster loss evaluation indexes and constructing an evaluation index system; spatial spreading is carried out on the social and economic data; carrying out flood simulation to obtain rasterized ponding depth data of each time step; constructing and adopting a loss rate calculation module, calculating flood disaster losses at all moments based on the spread socioeconomic data, fitting a change curve of a flood disaster loss-time function, comparing fitting effects of different functions, and selecting the optimal fitting function and parameters thereof; and analyzing the relation between the related parameters and the disaster occurrence probability in the loss function, obtaining a relation formula of the loss function parameters and the disaster occurrence probability, and outputting the loss function. The dynamic change process of flood disaster loss can be reflected, and the indirect economic loss is calculated.

title_en: Geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological exploration, and discloses a geological drilling exploration device based on geological disaster prevention and control, which comprises a main body and a rotary drum, wherein the rotary drum is fixedly connected to the top of the main body, one end of the outer wall of the rotary drum, which is far away from the main body, is fixedly connected with a polygonal frame, the geological drilling exploration device further comprises a fixing mechanism, the fixing mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the main body and comprises a rotary groove, the rotary groove is formed in the top of the main body, a fixing extension frame is rotatably connected in the rotary groove, a fixing hole is formed in one end, far away from the rotary groove, of the top of the fixing extension frame, and a rotary fixing inserting frame is rotatably connected in the fixing hole. When the device is required to move, the extended fixed extension frame is folded and stored, so that the size of the device is reduced, the device is convenient to carry and move, and when the device is required to pass through a narrow passageway, the device is prevented from being difficult to pass through due to shielding of the fixed extension frame at the bottom of the device, and further the influence on transportation of drilling equipment is avoided.
assignees: SURVEYING MAPPING AND GEO INFORMATION INST HENAN BUREAU OF GEO EXPLORATION & MINERAL DEVELOPMENT

title_en: Typhoon storm surge disaster chain catastrophe risk assessment method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster risk management, and discloses a typhoon storm surge disaster chain catastrophe risk assessment method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a disaster chain catastrophe scene library of typhoon-storm tide-flood-embankment based on the typhoon scene and catastrophe driving element combination scene; constructing a Bayesian network model according to the catastrophe mechanism and the chain transfer rule of a disaster chain of typhoon-storm tide-flood-embankment; and evaluating the catastrophe risks under different catastrophe scenes in the catastrophe scene library by adopting a Bayesian network model. The invention is based on the complex catastrophe mechanism of typhoon-storm tide-flood-embankment disaster chain and the chain transfer relation among elements affecting catastrophe, develops the Bayesian complex system network reasoning modeling of the disaster chain, simulates and analyzes the catastrophe risks of various disasters of the disaster chain under different catastrophe scenes, and has important significance for the risk management and disaster reduction work of typhoon disasters in coastal areas.

title_en: Karst tunnel surrounding rock-gas combined influence construction risk evaluation method
abstract_en: A karst tunnel surrounding rock-gas combined influence construction risk evaluation method relates to the technical field of tunnel construction risk evaluation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining evaluation indexes, including surrounding rock grades, coal mine goaf positions, tunnel design sections, full length of tunnels, burial depths, gas sections where the tunnels are located, coal seam thickness, tunnel fan setting conditions and harmful gas gushing positions, correcting grading indexes on the basis of a [ BQ ] value surrounding rock grading method by considering adverse effects of karst development degree on surrounding rock stability, detecting and recording gas harmful gases, classifying and grading the evaluation indexes, calculating evaluation index weights, and finally building a tunnel comprehensive construction risk grade evaluation model by superposing two sets of evaluation systems of surrounding rock stability and gas disaster risk grades. Dividing the tunnel construction risk into surrounding rock stability risk and gas disaster risk, and determining the weight of each evaluation index by combining numerical simulation to realize grading and evaluation of karst tunnel comprehensive construction risk.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;CHONGQING RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH;CHINA RAILWAY NO 17 BUREAU GROUP FOURTH ENG CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network typhoon disaster prevention and control simulation method, device, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The technical scheme provided by the application is based on historical real typhoon data, a plurality of static wind field models of different time sections are established through data such as typhoon landing points, moving directions and real-time speeds of typhoons, and then land attenuation coefficients of typhoons are combined, so that a typhoons disaster evolution model considering typhoons time-space dynamic characteristics is constructed to accurately provide references for power distribution network fault scenes, and a fault scene of the power distribution network typhoons disaster closer to a real environment is generated, so that accuracy of power distribution network typhoons disaster control simulation is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Disaster cooperative rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster cooperative rescue system and a disaster cooperative rescue method. And the unmanned aerial vehicle is in communication connection with the processing unit. The processing unit is configured to: planning a plurality of guiding paths in a three-dimensional virtual space based on the positions of a plurality of disaster sources and the positions of the safety exits; road nodes of a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles which go to a plurality of guiding paths are controlled to guide trapped personnel or rescue personnel to travel in a mode of constructing guiding identifiers of the guiding paths. According to the invention, the digital twin virtual module of the unmanned aerial vehicle is built in the three-dimensional virtual space, so that the structure, function, state and behavior of the unmanned aerial vehicle are reflected, and a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles are planned to form an array of three-dimensional guide marks in the air.
