According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle data is processed and analyzed in the three-dimensional virtual space, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle simulation, prediction, optimization and control are realized, the guiding effect of the unmanned aerial vehicle is reflected, and the unmanned aerial vehicle guiding planning, scheduling, coordination and evaluation are realized.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability research method and system based on reinforcement learning-random forest
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide vulnerability research method and system based on reinforcement learning-random forest, and belongs to the field of geological disaster prediction and evaluation. The method comprises the following steps: s1, drawing unit division is carried out on a research area to obtain a plurality of units; linear analysis is carried out on landslide influence factors to obtain evaluation indexes; a plurality of units and evaluation indexes form a data set, and the data set is divided to obtain a training data set and a verification data set; s2, equally dividing the training data set according to the time sequence to obtain a first training data set, a second training data set and a third training data set; calculating a frequency ratio for the first training data set to obtain a first frequency ratio; s3, building an ILRF_1 model based on the first frequency ratio; sequentially obtaining an ILRF_2 model and an ILRF_3 model based on the ILRF_1 model, the second training data set and the third training data set; and obtaining a landslide vulnerability map based on the ILRF_3 model.
assignees: FUJIAN YONKING GEOTECHNICAL CO LTD;QUANZHOU INSTITUTE OF EQUIPMENT MFG

title_en: High-pressure inflatable restaurant tent
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-pressure inflatable restaurant tent, and belongs to the technical field of high-pressure inflatable tents. The low-pressure inflatable tent overcomes the defects that a traditional low-pressure inflatable tent in the prior art is low in low-pressure inflatable structure strength, needs uninterrupted air supply and is poor in environmental adaptability. Its major structure includes tent main part, anti-wind cable, block terminal and ground stake, the both ends of tent main part are provided with the door bucket respectively, and the one end and the tent main part of anti-wind cable are connected, and the other end is connected with the ground stake, and the energy mouth department that sets up at the tent main part is installed to the block terminal. The utility model is mainly used in the application places such as field training, field disaster relief, international rescue and the like.

title_en: Tornado path simulation test system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tornado path simulation test system, and belongs to the technical field of wind field simulation tests. Including mounting plate, still including first glide machanism, second glide machanism, third glide machanism, tornado generator and the control system that the symmetry set up, first glide machanism symmetry sets up on mounting plate length direction's both sides, second glide machanism sets up respectively on first glide machanism, third glide machanism's both ends set up respectively on second glide machanism, tornado generator is fixed to be set up on third glide machanism, first glide machanism is used for driving second glide machanism and slides on mounting plate's length direction, second glide machanism is used for driving third glide machanism vertical direction upward slip. The technical scheme is used for solving the problems that a tornado wind field simulation system in the prior art can only realize a single motion path, and is difficult to fully restore actual disaster characteristics of a building caused by tornados.

title_en: Classification of wildfire danger
abstract_en: A method and system for modeling of physical phenomena associated with natural disasters, including prediction of damage caused by wildfire conflagration. Such modeling involves dividing a target land area into a set of regions and a set of structures that are located within the target land area, each of the regions and structures are characterized by various vulnerabilities to fire conflagration, and are scored and subject to execution of simulation and regression, and other types of mathematical representation and statistical inference to support human intelligence and decision making.
assignees: CABRILLO COASTAL GENERAL INSURANCE AGENCY LLC

title_en: Multi-functional virtual reality experience system
title_ko: 다기능 가상현실 체험 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-functional virtual reality experience system. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a more realistic disaster situation environment to an experiencer by efficiently controlling the height and inclination of a foothold by applying a multi-axis control system. To this end, the present invention comprises: a foothold (10) on which an experiencer can stand; a handrail unit (20) provided on an upper portion of the foothold (10) to prevent a fall; a start button (30) provided on the handrail unit (20) to be interlocked with VR equipment; a driving unit housing (40) provided on a lower portion of the foothold (10); and a foothold driving means provided inside the driving unit housing (40) to control the height and inclination of the foothold (10).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다기능 가상현실 체험 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 다축 컨트롤 시스템을 적용하여 발판의 높이 및 경사도 제어가 효율적으로 이루어질 수 있도록 하여 체험자에게 보다 현실감 있는 재난상황 환경을 제공하기 위한 것이다. 
이를 실현하기 위한 본 발명은, 체험자가 올라설 수 있는 발판(10)과; 상기 발판(10) 상부에 구비되어 추락을 방지하는 난간부(20)와; 상기 난간부(20)에 구비되어 VR 장비와 연동이 이루어지는 시작버튼(30)과; 상기 발판(10)의 하부에 구성되는 구동부 하우징(40)과; 상기 구동부 하우징(40) 내부에 구비되어 발판(10)의 높이 및 경사 제어가 이루어지는 발판 구동수단;을 포함하는 구성을 이루는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Computer readable storage medium of recording the Program of Available Safe Egress Time Estimation for Multiplex Buildings using Artificial Neural Networks
title_ko: 인공신경망을 사용한 복합건축물의 화재 피난허용시간 추정 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터 판독 가능 저장매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a program for estimating an allowable fire evacuation time of a complex building using an artificial neural network and, more specifically, to a computer-readable storage medium recording an estimation program, which constructs a database based on a fire simulation result for the complex building and applies the database to the artificial neural network to estimate the allowable fire evacuation time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공신경망을 사용한 복합건축물의 화재 피난허용시간 추정 프로그램에 대한 것이며, 복합건축물에 대한 화재시뮬레이션결과를 기반으로 데이터베이스를 구축하고 이를 인공신경망에 적용하여 피난허용시간을 추정하도록 하는 추정 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터 판독 가능 저장매체에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fire control shower head closing device
abstract_en: The book is provided with utility model of the utility model disclosed is: the utility model discloses a fire-fighting spray head closing device, which comprises a folding clamping piece, wherein a screw with a knob is connected in the middle of the folding clamping piece in a threaded manner, through holes are formed in two ends of the folding clamping piece, a positioning concave column is arranged at one end of the folding clamping piece, and a sealing ring is fixed at the other end of the folding clamping piece through a fixing screw. The product has small volume and simple manufacturing process; when the spray header is not carefully sprayed with water, the common adult does not need professional training, the tool is arranged on the spray header which is spraying water, the screw thread can be screwed to be closed like a screwing tap, the product structure and the manufacturing process are simple, the cost is low, and the screw thread can be continuously recycled. Is suitable for hotels, factories, offices and rented houses. Can also be used for the personal outfit of firefighters.

title_en: Typhoon disaster forecasting method and system based on ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster forecasting method and system based on ensemble learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) Utilizing typhoon parameter data, analysis data and ground observation data to construct a historical typhoon training data set according to time and space matching and preprocessing; (2) Establishing a typhoon wind and rain forecasting model, and inputting a historical typhoon training data set into the typhoon wind and rain forecasting model for training to obtain optimal parameters of the typhoon precipitation forecasting model; (3) evaluating the forecast results; according to the typhoon wind and rain forecasting model, the characteristic parameters adopted by the typhoon wind and rain forecasting model accurately describe typhoon paths and intensities, wind and rain generation mechanisms and power processes, and can rapidly acquire accurate and non-redundant data required by forecasting, so that the forecasting and early warning timeliness is improved.

title_en: Multi-cause electric fire accident simulation experiment platform and experiment method for low-voltage power network
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric power safety training, in particular to a simulation experiment platform and an experiment method for multi-cause electric fire accidents of a power grid. The utility model comprises the following steps: cable tunnel, cable conductor, video acquisition subassembly, thermal image acquisition subassembly, humiture prison the adjustment subassembly, flue gas analyzer and smoke evacuation subassembly. The utility model provides a cable tunnel capable of containing combustion, which monitors and adjusts the temperature and humidity in the cable tunnel through a temperature and humidity monitoring assembly so as to provide different temperature and humidity environments. According to the utility model, the cable is detachably arranged in the cable tunnel, and the outer skin of the cable is provided with a plurality of damaged parts so as to realize electric leakage, so that the actual situation before the occurrence of fire disaster is attached. The utility model adjusts the cable line by using the adjustable circuit, ignites inflammables at the damaged position to realize combustion by generating electric arcs through electric leakage or short circuit, can perform multi-cause simulation and has high success rate.
assignees: WUHU CITY WANZHI DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ANHUI NAIWEI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ship living cabin fire simulation method and system based on experimental analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire simulation method and a fire simulation system for a ship living cabin based on experimental analysis, wherein the fire simulation method comprises the following steps: step 1: measuring and plotting a heat release rate curve of the solid combustible; step 2: fitting a heat release rate curve of the solid combustible; step 3: building a ship living cabin model, and setting a combustion surface of solid combustible in the model; step 4: setting a simulated solid combustible fire disaster by setting the heat release rate of the combustion surface of the solid combustible by adopting the fitted heat release rate curve; step 5: and carrying out fire simulation on the ship living cabin by adopting a large vortex simulation method, and predicting the development process of the top layer temperature and smoke density value of the ship living cabin. The invention can be used for carrying out fire simulation of the ship living cabin, and the obtained result can be used for predicting the solid fire development process in the ship living cabin and carrying out fire protection system design or safety evaluation work on the ship living cabin.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHIP ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT RES INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION NO 726 RES INS

title_en: Earthquake secondary fire spread simulation method, system and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a method, a system and a computer storage medium for simulating the spread of a secondary fire disaster in an earthquake, which are characterized in that an urban structure model is constructed by utilizing an urban earthquake disaster simulator, an elastoplastic time-course analysis is carried out on the urban structure model to obtain a damage index of a building, then the urban structure model is divided into a plurality of layers of cells, each cell has the state and attribute of the cell, the concept and the method of a deep cellular automaton are introduced, the cells are divided and interacted in a plurality of layers, the interaction rule among the cells is defined on the basis, and finally the spread process of the fire disaster in the city is simulated by iteratively updating the states of the cells.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Fire real-time risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire hazard real-time risk early warning method, and belongs to the technical field of fire protection systems. The invention comprises a plurality of fire detectors, a central processing module and an alarm, wherein the central processing module models the orientations of a building, the plurality of fire detectors and the alarm, and prestores a fire model for simulating the occurrence of a disaster. The invention makes the building data, draws the three-dimensional coordinates of the fire detectors and the alarms, gives the fire guidance coefficients among the fire detectors according to the parameters of the building, deduces the position, the intensity and the direction of the fire through the distance, the time and the position among a plurality of disaster-stricken fire detectors, and sends different instructions to the alarms at different positions according to the prediction result so as to command people at different positions and effectively prevent panic, treading and the like. The invention can direct the fire automatically, and provide fire related data and advice to the outside, thereby playing an important role in rapidly extinguishing fire and evacuating people.
assignees: JIANYAN FIRE PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on knowledge graph embedding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prediction, in particular to a disaster prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on knowledge graph embedding. According to the disaster knowledge graph embedded model obtained through disaster knowledge graph training, the graph structure of the knowledge graph is utilized to describe the dominant relationship among landslide condition factors in target data, so that the knowledge graph embedded model obtained through the disaster knowledge graph training can be more beneficial to capturing the implicit relationship between the spatial distribution of a target research area and landslide disasters, and the expression capacity of the disaster knowledge graph embedded model in complex disaster scenes is enhanced; and predicting the relation between the target research area and the disaster concept by using the knowledge graph embedding model, and improving the accuracy and generalization capability of the disaster prediction method under the condition of sparse data set.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES;UNIV NINGXIA

title_en: Experiment platform and method for researching temperature distribution of cable under bridge fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental platform for researching temperature distribution of a cable under a bridge fire disaster, which comprises a control terminal, a fire disaster simulation system, an energy release monitoring system and a temperature acquisition system, wherein the control terminal is connected with the fire disaster simulation system; the control terminal is used for monitoring the operation of the fire disaster simulation system and receiving data acquired by the energy release monitoring system and the temperature acquisition system. Simulating the bridge fire environment through a fire simulation system to obtain the quality combustion rate and flame morphological characteristics of the bridge fire, collecting the temperature parameters of the steel vertical rods of the simulation cables in the fire environment through a thermocouple group in a temperature acquisition system, storing the temperature parameters by a temperature storage, and processing and analyzing the temperature parameters by a control terminal to obtain the distribution of the cable temperature in the bridge fire in the environment along the height; the method achieves the purposes of researching the fire combustion characteristics of the bridge under the environmental wind and the temperature distribution of the cable, determining the fire-resistant protection height of the bridge cable, providing parameter guidance for the relevant fire-resistant protection design of the cable and improving the fire-resistant capability of the bridge.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;NANJING YANGTZE RIVER NO 2 BRIDGE CO LTD;JIANGSU DAZHENG ZHIAN TECH CO LTD;CCCC HIGHWAY BRIDGES NATIONAL ENGINEERING RES CENTRE CO LTD;JIANGSU CUMT DAZHENG SURFACE ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Impact residual energy calculation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for calculating impact residual energy, comprising the following steps: performing ground stress test on the rock burst roadway to obtain the original rock stress state of the target roadway; collecting physical and mechanical parameters of surrounding rock of a target roadway, establishing a geomechanical model and correcting based on the stress state of the original rock; sampling and preparing a sample from a tunnel roof on-site drill core, and performing impact test on the sample to obtain the duty ratio of transmission energy of rocks at different layers in incident energy under the impact effect; calculating initial impact energy by acquiring relevant parameters of a seismic source of an impact event with the largest historical energy, and analyzing the rock size effect under impact load by adopting a numerical simulation method; dividing rocks at different layers above a roadway roof into a plurality of subsystems, and transmitting initial impact energy to obtain impact residual energy; and selecting the model of the anti-impact support construction according to the impact residual energy. The method solves the problem that impact disasters are caused by the fact that the impact residual energy of the existing coal mine is difficult to accurately calculate.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD;HEILONGJIANG LONGMEI HEGANG MINING CO LTD

title_en: Post-fire concrete structure damage assessment method based on image classification
abstract_en: A post-fire concrete structure damage assessment method based on image classification relates to the technical field of post-fire concrete structure damage assessment, and comprises the following steps: s1, manufacturing a data set; s2, configuring a network architecture and super parameters; s3, network training and performance evaluation; s4, module visualization; s5, designing a GUI interface. The invention constructs an image data set for network training and verification based on an image processing method in deep learning; the classification network suitable for the damage type and grade of the RC structural member after the fire disaster is provided, so that the color change, the cracking degree of the crack, the bursting degree of the concrete and the exposed reinforcement degree of the reinforcing steel bar of the member after the fire disaster can be classified, and the final damage grade can be predicted according to the damage type; and a GUI interactive interface is established, so that the automatic detection function of concrete structure damage after fire is realized.

title_en: Intelligent perception finished product restoration decision support system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent decision making, in particular to an intelligent perception finished product repair decision support system which comprises a demand prediction and analysis module, a resource intelligent allocation module, an automatic decision support module, a priority intelligent analysis module, a fault prediction and prevention module, a repair strategy optimization module, an emergency response strategy module and a maintenance task execution and feedback module. In the invention, the capability of the system in the aspects of adaptability, foresight, decision accuracy and resource utilization efficiency is obviously improved by integrating advanced data analysis, machine learning algorithm and resource optimization technology. By utilizing the autoregressive comprehensive moving average model and the seasonal decomposition method, the long-term dependency relationship and seasonal change in the time series data can be more accurately captured and predicted, so that the future repair demand can be effectively predicted. The intelligent resource allocation module adopts linear programming and Monte Carlo simulation to optimize resource allocation, ensure efficient utilization of resources and reduce unnecessary cost.

title_en: Corn low-temperature cold damage real-time risk assessment and zoning method based on standard curve
abstract_en: A method for evaluating and dividing the real-time risk of low-temperature cold damage of corn based on a standard curve comprises the steps of firstly, identifying distribution characteristics; step two, growth simulation; step three, characterizing the exposure; setting indexes; step five, determining weights; step six, risk zoning; in the fourth step, the AHP method is used for weighting the use amount of the local phosphate fertilizer and the potassium fertilizer, the use amount of the mulching film and the pure income of farmers are used as disaster prevention and reduction capability indexes; the invention combines four factor theory in natural risk formation theory to obtain a corn low-temperature cold damage real-time risk assessment model, which can accurately identify cold damage process, and the related technology has universality and can be popularized to other crops, disaster species and areas; the real-time risk assessment and prediction can be carried out by matching with live meteorological data and intelligent weather forecast products, the development of the field of real-time risk research is promoted, and the method has important application value for reasonably configuring agricultural resources and timely making risk precautions.

title_en: Rock-soil medium gas content, saturation measurement and disaster pregnancy and disaster reduction evaluation method based on mesoscopic model construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for measuring gas content and saturation of a rock-soil medium and evaluating a pregnant disaster and a disaster reduction based on a mesoscopic model. And loading and scanning the rock-soil body of the granular body by utilizing an assembled nonmetal rock-soil body CT scanning mould, so that the artifact interference is reduced. And accurately identifying the CT scanning mould, the matrix and the pores by utilizing the difference of gray values, and accurately identifying liquid and air according to the difference of CT values in the pores. Deep learning is performed through a neural network, a three-dimensional complex pore network model is established, the gas content zeta can be calculated based on the ratio of the gas phase volume V  Q  in the three-dimensional microscopic model to the total pore volume V  K  in the rock-soil body sample, and the saturation Sr can be calculated based on the ratio of the liquid phase volume V  Y  to the total volume V  Z  of the rock-soil body sample. And (3) importing the constructed rock-soil body model into numerical calculation analysis software or adopting a 3D printing means to manufacture identical test samples in batches with high precision, and setting calculation analysis working conditions according to the evaluation requirements. And finally, evaluating the effect of the gas content and saturation on the disaster pregnancy and disaster causing influence of the rock-soil mass and the grouting disaster reduction effect by combining the numerical simulation calculation result and the physical model test result. The method has the characteristics of no damage to the sample, high test precision, visible water (gas) containing area, high secondary development utilization rate and the like.

title_en: Traffic flow prediction method and system based on characteristic attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic flow prediction method and a traffic flow prediction system based on a characteristic attention mechanism, which are used for acquiring needed traffic flow data information, preprocessing the traffic flow data information by adopting a mean processing method, eliminating the influence of numerical value differences among different predicted data indexes in the traffic flow data by adopting an entropy weight method, inputting the processed traffic flow data into a SFformer model optimized by a Chenobiles disaster algorithm CDO, and training the traffic flow data to obtain a predicted value of the traffic flow data. Compared with the prior art, the SFformer model provided by the invention comprises a coding layer, a decoding layer and a full-output layer, wherein the coding layer consists of a sparse attention mechanism and a characteristic attention mechanism, the decoding layer adopts a generating decoder, the full-connection layer adopts a BP neural network to extract data characteristics, the PCA algorithm reduces the dimension of characteristic data, and finally, a traffic flow prediction result is obtained through a Softmax function. The SFformer model provided by the invention can predict the traffic flow data of the intersection more quickly and accurately.

title_en: Digital twinning-based coal mine accident simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based coal mine accident simulation system, which comprises: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a physical model module, a data acquisition module, a simulation module, a visualization module and a prediction module; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring coal mine environment information; the physical model module is used for constructing a coal mine physical perception model according to the coal mine environment information; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time working condition parameters; the simulation module is used for simulating coal mine behaviors according to the coal mine physical perception model and real-time working condition parameters; the visualization module is used for displaying the digital twin state, the simulation result and the prediction data; and the prediction module predicts the accident risk according to the data obtained by simulation and the real-time working condition parameters. The invention can provide more efficient and more accurate safety management support, is beneficial to preventing accidents, improving emergency response capability and continuously improving the safety performance of coal mine operation.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA ZHENGCHUANG TECH CO LTD;Ordos vocational college

title_en: Coal mine multicycle alternating stress fault simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine multicycle alternating stress fault simulation experiment device which comprises a support, wherein a base is fixed in the middle of the support, a plurality of baffles are circumferentially distributed on the base, a downward cover plate telescopic cylinder is arranged on the support, and a cover plate is fixed at the tail end of a piston rod of the cover plate telescopic cylinder. The cylindrical coal mine sample is placed in the ring shape surrounded by the baffle plate, and the cover plate can be pressed tightly by the cover plate telescopic cylinder. Compared with the prior art, the invention can simulate geological conditions in a laboratory, and further research important tools of rock fault deformation mechanism, and has important practical application values for preventing geological disasters, evaluating safety of engineering design and the like.

title_en: Fine ponding treatment method based on large-scale city rainstorm waterlogging model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a refined ponding treatment method based on a large-scale urban storm waterlogging model, and relates to the technical field of urban waterlogging treatment. In order to solve the problems that in the prior art, visual operation cannot be provided, and the occurrence probability of disasters cannot be calculated and deduced in a visual and clear way; a refined ponding treatment method based on a large-scale urban storm waterlogging model comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a high-resolution satellite platform; s2: superposing a simulation model; s3: visual display; according to the invention, the blank simulation interface is constructed based on the urban information acquired by the high-resolution satellites, so that the initial construction of the visual scene of the city is realized, the dynamic demonstration of the city is realized by the simulation dynamic layer based on the hydrodynamic characteristics, the fullness of the visual scene of the city is improved, the urban waterlogging state is monitored in real time, the visual operation is realized, the probability of disaster occurrence is intuitively and clearly calculated and deduced, and the effect of urban monitoring management is improved.

title_en: Typhoon disaster prediction method for optimizing back propagation neural network based on genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster prediction method based on genetic algorithm optimization back propagation neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data of typhoon disasters to obtain a training set and a testing set; constructing a deep learning network, and extracting features to obtain first features; constructing an initial decision tree model through the first characteristics, and optimizing the initial decision tree model by adopting a genetic algorithm and a post pruning technology; establishing an initial model of typhoon disaster estimation based on the BP neural network model and the decision tree model; and inputting the training set into the typhoon disaster prediction model to obtain typhoon disaster prediction results. According to the invention, the typhoon disaster prediction model is established based on the classification decision tree mode, so that the influence of typhoon disasters on the environment can be predicted more accurately, and the disaster prevention and reduction work is guided scientifically.
assignees: CMA METEOROLOGICAL DEVELOPMENT AND PLANNING INST

title_en: Underground combined staged fracturing horizontal well gas extraction and auxiliary outburst elimination method
abstract_en: The invention provides a gas extraction and auxiliary outburst elimination method for a horizontal well by combining well and ground and staged fracturing, which integrates the dual technical advantages of large-displacement ground fracturing and convenient underground drilling construction, realizes a well and ground combined area gas efficient extraction technology of 1-well through well x N directional long drilling x N section sand hydraulic fracturing, and provides a new thought and key technology for disaster management of deep mining in a coal mine area. By adopting the method, large-scale industrial drilling, fracturing and extraction of coal mine underground can be realized, the cost is reduced, the gas extraction and outburst elimination effects are improved, the application market potential is huge, and the method has important significance for promoting the efficient development of coal bed gas and the prevention and control of gas disasters under the large background of intelligent coal exploitation.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Multimode grouting precontrolled analysis method and system based on digital geological model
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a multimode grouting precontrolled analysis method and a multimode grouting precontrolled analysis system based on a digital geological model, which relate to the technical field of underground engineering grouting precontrolled analysis, and are used for extracting discontinuous fracture surfaces in a geological structure and constructing a geological structure model; and constructing a multi-source geologic body attribute model, carrying out grouting simulation optimization solution on the disaster high-risk area by adopting a multiphase flow calculation method, obtaining a multi-factor diffusion range of a variable coefficient by adjusting parameter values in grouting simulation and attribute data structure models by adopting a control variable method, learning and capturing complex mapping relations among different parameters by utilizing a neural network, optimizing a grouting process, and carrying out pre-control analysis on the whole grouting process.

title_en: Output calculation method and terminal for multi-seaborne wind power plant group under influence of typhoons
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a terminal for calculating the output of a multi-sea wind power plant group under the influence of typhoons, which are used for predicting the typhoons track range by training acquired historical typhoons track data, simulating the uncertainty of typhoons tracks in the mode, acquiring surrounding wind speed scenes by adopting a vortex wind field model according to the typhoons track range which is obtained through prediction, establishing a wind speed-fan output physical model by combining the wind speed scenes, environmental parameters and fan parameters of the wind power plant, and then calculating output scenes corresponding to a plurality of wind power plants according to the wind speed-fan output physical model. In this way, under the condition that typhoon disasters occur in the working environment of the offshore multi-wind power plant, the uncertainty of typhoon tracks can be taken into consideration to change brought by wind power output prediction, so that the cooperative operation of various power supplies under the typhoon disasters is facilitated, and the utilization of wind resources and the operation safety of a power grid are considered.

title_en: Lithium ion battery heat release smoke ignition experimental device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a lithium ion battery heat release smoke ignition experimental device and a method, wherein the lithium ion battery heat release smoke ignition experimental device comprises a heat safety experimental box; the internal portion of thermal safety experiment case is provided with ignition mechanism, smoke transducer, temperature sensor and lithium ion battery, the external portion of thermal safety experiment case is equipped with ignition mechanism control cabinet, ignition mechanism, smoke transducer, temperature sensor pass through the transmission electric energy and the transmission signal between wire and the ignition mechanism control cabinet respectively. The ignition mechanism control console can control the output voltage level of the two ends of the electrode of the arc generator and the short-circuit current of the resistance wire on the short-circuit generator, and simulate the ignition condition of the smoke released by the battery. The experimental device and the method can be used for researching the ignition mechanism and fire behavior of the heat release smoke of the lithium ion power battery and the energy storage battery, and further provide basis for the safety design and disaster prevention and control of the battery and the system.

title_en: Combined simulation method for cascading failure of gas-electric coupling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a joint simulation method for cascading faults of a gas-electric coupling system, which is based on a joint simulation framework of an event driving mode, establishes a dynamic model of a power grid-natural gas network-coupling element, designs an information interaction interface on the basis of two mature commercial simulation software of the two systems, and realizes the space-time interaction of simulation information of a power system and a natural gas system on different platforms. The method has the advantages of high accuracy, convenient model construction and the like, and can realize the accurate depiction of the evolution process of the electric-gas fault. By applying the simulation method, the fault dynamic evolution process can be more effectively analyzed. In addition, the invention also provides a fault blocking strategy which can effectively block faults caused by extreme disasters from spreading across the energy system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Disaster recovery arrangement based on intelligent AI-driven fault recognition and switching
abstract_en: The invention relates to disaster tolerance arrangement based on intelligent AI driving fault identification and switching, which belongs to the technical field of cloud computing and comprises an offline data collection module, a construction feature engineering module, a model training and verification module, a fault prediction module, a fault identification module, an automatic switching and recovery module and a learning optimization module.

title_en: Rock burst prediction method based on comparison of different risk monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dangerous disaster prediction of rock burst and the like in mines, in particular to a rock burst prediction method based on comparison of different dangerous monitoring data, which is used for predicting whether a primary microseismic event to be generated in the future is a rock burst event or not, and comprises the following steps: constructing a training set; extracting microseismic data characteristics of a training set sample; training a rock burst prediction model; constructing a verification set and a test set; verifying and testing the rock burst prediction model; and predicting rock burst by using the rock burst prediction model. The invention solves the problem of poor generalization capability of the algorithm caused by data unbalance by utilizing an algorithm structure on the premise of not damaging sample diversity and solving space by utilizing a contrast learning method. Under the condition that the training amount is not increased, the problem that the early warning effect of the traditional algorithm on rock burst events is poor can be solved. The invention can discard unnecessary structures in the application process, and the early warning efficiency in the actual application process can be higher than that of other deep learning algorithms.
assignees: Shandong energy group co ltd;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Disaster recovery backup and recovery system of power information system in cloud environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery backup recovery system of an electric power information system in a cloud environment, which comprises a disaster recovery center and a devots assembly line module which are established on private clouds, and a production server, a backup server and a disaster recovery server which are distributed on public clouds; the disaster recovery center comprises a monitoring center, a dispatching center, a storage center and a disaster recovery backup vertical model which is generated based on large language model training; when the monitoring center monitors that one public cloud production server is abnormal, the disaster recovery scheduling module is informed to trigger the devots assembly line module, the production assembly line information is automatically obtained, the address information and disaster recovery backup data of the disaster recovery server are obtained from the nodes by the disaster recovery service, the deployment host information is changed to deploy, the DNS server is informed, and the ip information corresponding to the domain name of the production service is changed to the disaster recovery server. The invention greatly improves the disaster recovery backup and recovery capability of the power information system.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological disaster forecasting and early warning system for dense power transmission channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather disaster forecasting and early warning system for a dense power transmission channel; the monitoring data processing center is in communication connection with the PC end/mobile end through a 3G/4G/5G/NB-LOT/LoRa/wifi communication module; the monitoring data processing center is in communication connection with the rainfall sensor, the flow sensor, the wind speed sensor and the displacement sensor through the data transmission module; the system comprises a type combination module, a combination simulation module, a simulation correction module and a simulation result processing module, wherein the type combination module forms a plurality of monitoring model libraries by combining monitoring data of a rainfall sensor, a flow sensor, a wind speed sensor and a displacement sensor; the invention can realize the short-term early warning of strong wind, rain, snow and ice weather risks of the dense transmission channel facing the tower points.

title_en: Four-in-one ground pressure monitoring method for crushing stope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crushing stope four-in-one ground pressure monitoring method, which comprises the following steps: a. installing microseismic monitoring equipment; b. installing an earth pressure monitoring device; c. acquiring a microseismic index risk index; d. acquiring a drilling stress index risk index, an anchor cable stress index risk index and a roof separation index risk index; e. calculating a stope risk index; f. judging the safety risk of the stope collapse according to the stope risk index, wherein the larger the stope risk index is, the larger the safety risk is, and when the stope risk index exceeds a set value, adopting supporting measures. According to the invention, the microseismic detector, the borehole stress meter, the anchor cable stress meter and the roof separation layer meter are adopted to integrally monitor the ground pressure, the safety risk of the stope is judged by utilizing the multiparameter comprehensive ground pressure monitoring and early warning indexes, the weak sensitivity of the microseismic monitoring equipment to single-point stress change can be compensated, the accurate early warning of ground pressure disaster events is realized, and the mine production safety is ensured.
assignees: Hebei iron and steel group shahe zhongguan iron mine co ltd

title_en: Method for predicting earth surface collapse after tunnel excavation based on rock physics experiment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster simulation and prediction, and particularly relates to a method for predicting earth surface collapse after tunnel excavation based on a petrophysical experiment, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a sample: determining a target area above the tunnel excavation area, and performing hierarchical sampling; s2, measuring dynamic elastic parameters based on petrophysical technology: measuring the longitudinal and transverse wave speeds of the sample by utilizing an ultrasonic detection method, and calculating corresponding dynamic Young modulus and Poisson ratio parameters; s3, static elastic parameter measurement based on petrophysical technology: measuring the static Young modulus and Poisson ratio parameters of the sample by using a stress-strain curve; s4, dynamic and static Young modulus parameter curve fitting: and measuring data of the dynamic elasticity parameters and the static elasticity parameters obtained by fitting measurement. The invention reduces the gap between modeling parameters and actual parameters, thereby establishing a proper method for predicting the collapse area after tunnel excavation, and facilitating the understanding of the characteristics of the collapse area after excavation.

title_en: Environment simulation system for electromagnetic wave transmission in mine goaf
abstract_en: The invention provides an environment simulation system for electromagnetic wave transmission in a mine goaf, which belongs to the technical field of mine goaf environment simulation and comprises a goaf simulation chamber, a temperature simulation module, a humidity simulation module, a gas concentration simulation module, a harmful gas simulation module and an electromagnetic wave detection module; the goaf simulation chamber is used for simulating the internal environment of the goaf of the mine and the spontaneous combustion area of coal; the temperature simulation module is used for simulating and controlling the numerical value change of the temperature in the spontaneous combustion process of the coal in the goaf simulation chamber; the method has the advantages that various environment conditions are formed through simulation, and then the electromagnetic wave transmission condition is measured, so that accurate and reliable information is obtained, a thermodynamic disaster is detected and judged from changed data information, the workload is small, the risk is avoided, the acquisition of the data information is facilitated, the reality of the internal environment simulation of a mine goaf is improved, and the electromagnetic wave transmission is conveniently tested.

title_en: Power cable fire spreading characteristic test device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire spread characteristic test device of a power cable, which comprises: the test box is used for simulating the tunnel environment of the power cable, a test cable, a fire source and a plurality of thermocouples are placed in the test box, and a camera is arranged outside the test box; the fan is arranged at the inlet end of the test box and used for adjusting the ventilation wind speed in the test box; the multi-path temperature acquisition instrument is used for acquiring data of thermocouples in the test box; and the computer is used for obtaining the data of each thermocouple, the video signals shot by the camera, the wind speed data and the heat data of the fire source in each test and analyzing the spreading characteristics of the fire disaster of the power cable. The invention also discloses a corresponding method. By implementing the invention, the accurate spreading rule of the power cable after ignition can be obtained by constructing the test conditions which accord with the actual environment of the power cable tunnel and adjusting two influencing factors of fire load and ventilation speed, thereby providing guidance for the power cable fireproof design.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Experimental device for geological environment simulation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geological disaster experimental equipment, and discloses an experimental device for simulating geological environment, which comprises a vibration base and a movable frame arranged on the vibration base, wherein the movable frame comprises at least two transparent side plates which are vertically arranged on the vibration base, and a plurality of sliding bars which are mutually parallel and horizontally fixed on the vibration base, and the transparent side plates are movably connected with the sliding bars and are limited by the sliding bars to reciprocate along the length direction of the sliding bars; be provided with the backup pad between the adjacent transparent curb plate, the backup pad rotates with transparent curb plate to can dismantle fixedly through setting up limit structure and transparent curb plate at rotation junction, the model body sets up in the backup pad. According to the utility model, the movable frame structure with adjustable gaps and slopes is integrated on the vibration base, so that a corresponding base platform with the corresponding width and slope can be rapidly formed according to the slope and width of the slope of the target area, and the experimental efficiency is improved.

title_en: Accident trend identification method based on time sequence analysis
abstract_en: The application provides an accident trend identification method based on time sequence analysis, which comprises the following steps: denoising historical safety accident data on a production line, extracting a time point, and eliminating interference of sporadic interference factors on accident analysis; according to the periodicity law obtained by the frequency domain analysis, carrying out seasonal trend analysis on the historical security accident record through a seasonal autoregressive integral moving average model; characteristic learning is carried out by utilizing a random forest algorithm according to seasonal trends, and accident evolution characteristics are identified and extracted from nonlinear and non-stationary time sequences; identifying and quantifying the sensitivity and vulnerability difference of dual links on the production line in the event of an accident, and predicting the reactions of different production line links in the event of the accident; and predicting the reactions of different production line links in the event of an accident, simulating an emergency response strategy, and adjusting the emergency response strategy of the production line.

title_en: Space-time prediction method for traffic network function state in extreme storm event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time prediction method of traffic network function states in extreme storm events, which comprises the following steps: generating a physical simulation data set and preprocessing; a data-driven agent model is built based on TA-STGCN, a physical simulation data set is randomly divided into a training set and a testing set, and prediction of future traffic is completed by fusion processing of input data and capturing of disaster characteristics and space-time characteristics of the input data. The method uses TA-STGCN to capture the space-time characteristics of the dynamic network function state; by establishing a multi-mode input mechanism, the two-state input of rainfall-related data and traffic network data is realized, so that the space-time influence of extreme storm events on traffic network functions is captured; based on a self-attention mechanism and space-time convolution operation, stable multi-step traffic function prediction under the condition of non-stationary rainfall is realized.

title_en: Extreme assessment method and system for storm-induced mountain torrent event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for extremely evaluating a torrential rain-induced mountain torrent event, and belongs to the technical field of extreme climate research. Firstly, determining a rainfall area, acquiring geological information, rainfall data and flood data of the rainfall area, and determining a flood loss coefficient and a rainfall extreme index; then determining the geological information change of the flood impact area based on the digital twin simulated rainfall reproduction process, and calculating a geological damage coefficient; and finally, evaluating the extreme of the heavy rainfall induced flood event based on the flood loss coefficient, the rainfall extreme index and the geological damage coefficient. The method effectively integrates multi-source information such as extreme rainfall, flood loss, geological damage and the like, has more reasonable and reliable results compared with the traditional single evaluation method which only depends on rainfall, reproduction period or disaster index, and can comprehensively and accurately evaluate the extreme of heavy rainfall induced flood disasters.

title_en: Complex environment falling stone detection method based on improvement yolov5
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex environment falling stone detection method based on an improvement yolov, which belongs to the technical field of disaster monitoring and comprises the following steps: acquiring a falling stone picture data set, and preprocessing falling stone pictures in the falling stone picture data set to obtain a falling stone picture training set and a falling stone picture verification set; constructing GhostNet a backbone network based on an ECA attention mechanism and BasicRFB modules, and improving the yolov network model based on the GhostNet backbone network to obtain an improved yolov network model; training and verifying the improved yolov network model to obtain a falling stone detection network model; and obtaining a falling stone picture to be detected, and predicting the falling stone picture to be detected by using a falling stone detection network model to obtain a detection result of the falling stone picture to be detected. The invention solves the problems of low detection efficiency and insufficient accuracy of the mountain falling rocks in a complex environment.

title_en: Intelligent geological disaster early warning method and system for 5G high-speed rail
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 5G high-speed rail oriented intelligent geological disaster early warning method, which comprises the following steps: s1: arranging sensing monitoring equipment along the railway, collecting seismic waveform time domain signals by the equipment and uploading the signals to an edge server; s2: the edge server preprocesses the data acquired by the sensing monitoring equipment in real time, and the preprocessed data is input into the pre-training model to obtain a prediction result; s3: the railway early warning control center acquires a landslide area displacement time sequence based on a synthetic aperture radar of an interferometry technology, judges a landslide distribution area, performs early warning judgment according to a prediction result, and immediately controls the running state of the high-speed rail; the invention also discloses an intelligent geological disaster early warning system for the 5G high-speed rail, which comprises sensing detection equipment, an edge server and a railway early warning control center, and can reliably detect longitudinal waves and transverse waves of extremely small to extremely large earthquakes without a definite waveform template, thereby realizing comprehensive geological monitoring and timely early warning without blind areas.
assignees: NANJING TICOM TECH CO LTD;UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Coal mine rock burst disaster prevention and control monitoring and early warning device and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring and early warning device for preventing and controlling coal mine rock burst disasters, which relates to the technical field of rock burst prevention and control and comprises two power boxes and two detection boxes, wherein the two power boxes are symmetrically distributed on two sides of the detection box, and lifting grooves distributed in an annular array are formed in the inner sides of the two power boxes. The invention also discloses an early warning method of the coal mine rock burst disaster prevention monitoring and early warning device, which comprises the following steps of A, drilling preparation, wherein firstly, a special drilling frame and a drill rod guiding device are needed to ensure the accuracy of the diameter and the direction of drilling, and meanwhile, a proper drilling place is needed to be selected and is generally arranged in the middle of the mining height, parallel to the layer and perpendicular to the coal wall. According to the invention, the first straight gear is matched with the tooth grooves, so that the fourth bevel gear can be driven to rotate through the second motor, and the fourth bevel gear is matched with the third bevel gears, so that the first threaded rods can be driven to rotate.

title_en: Geological disaster risk zoning method, device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The present application relates to a geological disaster risk zoning method, apparatus, computer device, storage medium and computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining geological data and meteorological data of a target area; inputting the geological data and the meteorological data into a pre-trained geological disaster risk prediction model to obtain a geological disaster prediction result of a target area; the pre-trained geological disaster risk prediction model is a stacking model obtained through integrated learning training; and acquiring population data of the target region, and carrying out risk division on the target region according to the population data and the geological disaster prediction result to obtain a geological disaster risk division result of the target region. By adopting the method, the accuracy of geological disaster risk prediction can be improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Emergency drill offline party
abstract_en: To construct an emergency drill system utilizing Japan's abundant know-how of disaster prevention, increase chances of joining emergency drills, facilitate purchase and expiration management of emergency goods, and provide an item to be worn that is useful in disaster prevention.SOLUTION: Through an offline party application using Japan's know-how of disaster prevention, an offline party is held in a public facility at regular intervals. Disaster prevention information can be obtained and emergency goods can be purchased over the application. In addition, a list of emergency goods purchased by a user is created so that expiration dates or the like can be easily checked. Moreover, when a watch dedicated for disaster prevention and crime prevention is provided and a bar code transmitted to a user who has signed up for an offline party is taken into the watch, the user can confirm the user's data, and further, can get an advice from a specialist. The watch can be used for crime prevention for kids and elderly people in normal times.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Linear engineering slope operation safety risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a linear engineering slope operation safety risk assessment method, and relates to the technical fields of geotechnical engineering and engineering geology. According to the method, based on a complete slope data set of linear engineering such as a highway, a railway and the like, a data sample risk evaluation factor is firstly determined according to core expert experience analysis, then normal operation slope data, defect disease slope data and historical disaster slope data are integrated to be used as a slope safety risk training data sample set, an expert Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) is adopted to label the safety risk level of the training data sample, and finally a BP artificial neural network method is adopted to construct a slope safety risk evaluation model. The evaluation model supports the supplement, modification and perfection of the slope sample data set, expands the acquisition of the slope safety risk evaluation training sample data taking the normal slope data as the main, breaks through the limitation of the quantity of the training samples which only take the disaster slope data at present, and has the functions of self-learning and dynamic evaluation.
assignees: NORTHWEST RES INST CO LTD CREC

title_en: Subway emergency personnel configuration simulation optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway emergency personnel configuration simulation optimization method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a set of emergency personnel configuration initial solutions; inputting the initial solution into a train emergency simulation system, and acquiring train operation performance evaluation index data output by the train emergency simulation system; and obtaining an emergency personnel configuration solution by utilizing an optimization algorithm based on the train operation performance evaluation index data. According to the subway emergency personnel configuration simulation optimization method and system, the simulation system and the optimization algorithm are combined, the emergency personnel configuration is scientifically and reasonably allocated, and the emergency response capability is improved while the related personnel cost is reduced.
assignees: BEIJING RAIL TRANSIT OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line lightning trip-out rate calculation method considering influence of coupling meteorological disasters
abstract_en: The calculation method for the lightning trip-out rate of the power transmission line considering the influence of the coupling weather disasters comprises the following steps: acquiring transmission line parameters and topography parameters according to laser point cloud data; according to the on-line monitoring device, determining the maximum value I of the ice coating thickness  max  And a maximum value W of the degree of contamination  max  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Establishing a guide model of the icing pollution insulator; calculating the line shielding failure rate according to the improved electrical geometric model; establishing a lightning trip-out rate calculation model; the icing degree value and the pollution degree value are obtained through one-time random sampling, and under the condition, the lightning current amplitude value and the line power frequency voltage instantaneous value are obtainedAnd carrying out random simulation on the time value, and solving the lightning flashover probability. According to the invention, on the basis of random sampling of icing and pollution, the influence of both on the lightning trip rate is quantitatively analyzed, and a reference can be provided for line risk calculation under extreme weather conditions.
assignees: HUANGHUA POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;QINGHAI POWER TRANS AND DISTRIBUTION ENGINEERING CO LTD;ULTRAHIGH PRESSURE COMPANY OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Sponge city intelligent monitoring method and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sponge city intelligent monitoring method and related equipment, and particularly relates to the technical field of city monitoring, comprising the following steps of firstly, monitoring and acquiring construction activities of a sponge city, future weather data and total water absorption capacity data of the sponge city; step two, establishing a space model corresponding to the target sponge city, and constructing a cellular automaton model; step three, performing simulation experiments on future weather data; dividing a target sponge city into a plurality of organization plates in a space model; step five, determining seed cells and tissue cells. According to the invention, the accuracy of future weather rainfall data can be improved, and further, the deduction accuracy of the cellular automaton model can be improved as much as possible, meanwhile, the cellular automaton model is adopted to simulate and deduct the rainwater absorption condition of the sponge city in future time, the early warning of the natural disasters of the rainwater is achieved in advance, the situation that the early warning of the disasters cannot be achieved by manual early warning is avoided, and the timeliness, the accuracy and the timeliness are lacking.
assignees: YUZHI ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Rapid evaluation method and system for dam break disaster risk of tailing pond
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of remote sensing and artificial intelligence, and provides a rapid evaluation method and a rapid evaluation system for dam break disaster risks of a tailing pond. The method comprises the following steps: and determining the position of the tailing pond through satellite remote sensing images. And collecting the topography and topography data of the land by using a GIS system. And then, the dam break risk is estimated by combining the environmental data. If the risk exceeds the standard, further collecting the components and stacking scale information of the tailing pond. And carrying out disaster spread simulation based on the information and other related data, and dividing affected subareas. For each sub-area, its facilities, personnel and possible losses are evaluated. And meanwhile, the environmental pollution risk is also estimated according to the tailing ingredients. Finally, taking the loss index of the subarea as the result of risk assessment. Therefore, the method and the device can quickly and accurately identify the position of the tailing pond, shorten the time for evaluating the dam break disaster risk of the tailing pond, and improve the efficiency and the accuracy of evaluating the dam break risk.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Combat training fire control science popularization education system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combat training fire-fighting science popularization education system, which comprises a multimedia teaching material unit, an interactive teaching tool unit, a fire case analysis unit, a fire-fighting equipment use training unit, a virtual reality simulation unit and a real fire scene training unit, wherein the multimedia teaching material unit comprises a fire-fighting basic knowledge module, a fire-fighting equipment knowledge module, a fire scene escape knowledge module and a fire disaster disposal knowledge module, and the virtual reality simulation unit and the real fire scene training unit comprise a fire scene escape training module, a fire-fighting rescue training module, a field command training module, an emergency response training module and a team cooperation training module. The invention has the advantages of strong practicability, diversified learning modes, personalized learning, real case analysis, comprehensive fire protection knowledge provision, practice training enhancement and the like, and can effectively improve the fire protection safety awareness of students and the capability of coping with fire disasters; the virtual reality simulation is performed before the actual fire field is exercised, so that the safety, cost effectiveness and controllability of training can be improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Water shutoff device and method for realizing visual analysis under simulated different flow rate states
abstract_en: The invention provides a water shutoff device and a method for realizing visual analysis under the condition of simulating different flow rates, wherein the water shutoff device comprises a plastic pipe support, the top of the plastic pipe support is supported with a plastic cylinder sleeve through a steel pipe elbow and a steel cylinder protection frame, the plastic cylinder sleeve is connected with an air pressure tank through a rubber pipe hole and a rubber pipe, and the air pressure tank is provided with a grouting port and is used for storing special magnetic slurry; the plastic cylinder sleeve is connected with a power supply through a valve, a direct-current intelligent electromagnetic flowmeter and a rubber tube; one end of the plastic cylinder sleeve is connected with the water tank through a self-made steel frame die and a water pipe; the other end of the plastic cylinder sleeve is provided with a magnetic self-focusing magnetic rod which is connected with the pressure test pump through a rubber pipe. The method can be used for simulating the water plugging instance under the tunnel water bursting working condition in the real karst area, can effectively treat water bursting disasters, and avoids serious economic loss and serious casualties.

title_en: In-situ observation equipment for three-dimensional deformation process of submarine sediment and working method of in-situ observation equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides in-situ observation equipment for a three-dimensional deformation process of a submarine sediment and a working method thereof. According to the technical scheme, through offshore drilling, casing pipe lowering and deployment observation devices, synchronous measurement of sediment pore water pressure and three-dimensional deformation processes at different depths of the seabed can be realized, the deployment position and depth can be more accurately determined, the accuracy of the observation data is improved, the deployment risk is reduced, the efficiency of in-situ observation data acquisition is improved, the operation steps are reduced, the disaster assessment result obtained through comparison of soil body pore pressure fluctuation and sediment deformation posture data is firmer, real and reliable observation data can be provided for submarine geological disaster prediction and ocean engineering construction, and the method has very important practical significance.

title_en: Novel elasticity evaluation method and system for power system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel elasticity evaluation method and system of a power system and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of power grid elasticity evaluation. The method comprises the following steps: building a plurality of power grid structures, and respectively simulating and applying the current disaster type to each power grid structure to obtain the elasticity data of each power grid structure; determining the game combination weight of each specific index by utilizing a game theory principle based on an elastic index evaluation system and elastic data of a plurality of power grid structures; and according to the game combination weight, determining the elastic capability value of each power grid structure under the current disaster type by using a VIKOR model. The invention utilizes the game theory principle and the VIKOR model to complete the elasticity evaluation of the novel electric power system, and can improve the rationality of the elasticity evaluation of the novel electric power system, thereby improving the rationality of the structure planning of the electric power system and the formulation of the emergency response plan.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Risk crowd analysis method and system for dam break accident of tailing pond
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for analyzing risk groups of dam break accidents of a tailing pond, which relate to the technical field of environmental risk assessment and comprise the following steps: feature screening is carried out by collecting satellite remote sensing images in a target area, and a target tailing pond position set is generated; training according to the target tailing pond position set to obtain a tailing pond identification model; traversing the target area based on the tailing pond identification model, and carrying out dam break simulation analysis by combining basic information of the target tailing pond to determine N risk areas; defining a disaster-affected range according to the N risk areas, and generating images of risk groups; and carrying out risk prediction analysis on the target tailing pond based on the risk crowd portrayal, and carrying out emergency management according to an analysis result. The method solves the technical problems of insufficient prediction accuracy and efficiency of the range of risk groups affected by accidents in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of improving the prediction accuracy and efficiency.

title_en: Infrastructure resilience evaluation system, infrastructure resilience evaluation method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an infrastructure resilience evaluation system that can support decision-making on whether to introduce a countermeasure facility to maintain infrastructure functions when a disaster or accident occurs.SOLUTION: An infrastructure resilience evaluation system according to an embodiment includes: a risk simulation unit configured to create a tree model of soundness of each of a facility and infrastructure in an evaluation object area in response to a disaster or accident, and simulate a risk of infrastructure abnormality; an infrastructure transient simulation unit configured to transiently simulate a situation of the infrastructure, using the tree model as a simulation condition; and a loss cost calculation unit configured to calculate a loss cost that may be caused by abnormality occurring in functions of the infrastructure, based on simulation results by the infrastructure transient simulation unit, for a case where a countermeasure facility is installed and a case where the countermeasure facility is not installed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: Multi-scale SAR image ship detection method based on attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale SAR image ship detection method based on an attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining an SAR image ship data set and dividing the SAR image ship data set into a training set, a verification set and a test set; then, a YOLOv is taken as a basic model, a main network and a feature fusion network are improved, a coordinate attention module is added into the improved main network, and a multi-scale SAR image ship target detection network SSYOLO is constructed; then, training a target detection network SSYOLO based on the training set, the verification set and the test set to obtain a SAR image ship target detection model; and finally, inputting an image to be detected into the SAR image ship target detection model to obtain a detection result. The invention improves the accuracy of SAR image ship detection, not only can accurately position the ship target under complex ocean background, but also can reduce a great deal of manual monitoring cost, and is beneficial to the application of ocean traffic control, fishery management, environmental protection, disaster relief and the like.

title_en: Rotatable outdoor perforation aluminum plate sunshade system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sun-shading systems, and particularly relates to a rotatable outdoor perforated aluminum plate sun-shading system which comprises a plurality of mounting frames and aluminum plate sun-shading components, wherein the mounting frames are fixedly arranged on a wall body, the mounting frames are equidistantly arranged, the aluminum plate sun-shading components which are equidistantly distributed from top to bottom are arranged between two adjacent mounting frames, each aluminum plate sun-shading component comprises a sun-shading component, connecting components are rotatably connected inside the sun-shading component, and two connecting components are symmetrically distributed. According to the invention, when fire accidents such as fire disaster and the like occur, the sunshade component and the connecting component can be rotated by pressing the first positioning component, so that the sunshade component is turned downwards when the fire accident occurs, and the gap between the upper sunshade component and the lower sunshade component is enlarged, so that personnel in a building can drill out through the gap between the sunshade components, and the personnel can be transferred from the outside of the building by the fire fighter.
assignees: SHENZHEN JINGGONG BUILDING DECORATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Landslide surge near-far field propagation evolution coupling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coupling method and a coupling system for near-far field propagation evolution of landslide surge, wherein the coupling method comprises the steps of simulating near-field motion of a landslide of a particulate body by adopting particle discrete elements and smooth particle fluid dynamics, calculating far-field motion of the landslide of the particulate body by taking the simulated near-field motion as an initial boundary condition, and completing near-far field propagation evolution of the landslide of the particulate body in the motion and water entering process based on drag force and buoyancy. According to the invention, through fine numerical simulation of key areas, the propagation path, speed and influence range of landslide surge can be predicted more accurately. This is critical for disaster early warning and risk assessment. Meanwhile, the model disclosed by the invention can be used for considering the topography, geology, hydrologic conditions and the like in more detail, so that the landslide surge simulation reality is improved. In addition, the invention can evaluate the potential influence of landslide surge on coastal structures, residential areas and key infrastructure by simulating different scenes, and provide dangerous analysis for rescue and planning.

title_en: Digital twin remote emergency medical multi-person collaborative training monitoring cabin device
