abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin remote emergency medical multi-person collaborative training monitoring cabin device, which enables a training cabin to shake up and down and left and right through a shaking component, so that in the medical rescue process, the training cabin can be driven to shake up and down and left and right through a driving shaking component to simulate natural disasters such as earthquakes and the like when medical staff performs operations or treatment, and thus doctors can be simulated and trained, and the in-situ adaptability of the medical staff is improved; meanwhile, by the matched use of the auxiliary components, natural disasters such as a raining state, flood and the like can be simulated in the process of curing medical staff; finally, the simulated earthquake scene, flood scene and raining scene can be subjected to multidimensional environment projection and environment audio-visual simulation; therefore, the invention not only can increase the method and the state of strain of medical staff facing various disasters, but also can make the device teaching and practical training more real and efficient through simulating the disasters, thereby improving the practicability of the device.
assignees: The Third Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: Full-link monitoring method and system for intelligently measuring complex service scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-link monitoring method and system for intelligently measuring complex service scenes, and relates to the technical field of power grids. Establishing a virtual model of an intelligent measurement system by utilizing a digital twin technology so as to simulate and monitor key business scenes; the data packet grabbing and analyzing technology is utilized to quickly locate service processing faults, and system abnormal conditions are timely found and analyzed; adding buried point codes at key nodes of the system, and collecting service processing indexes to evaluate processing efficiency and analyze system bottlenecks; based on the monitoring result, parameter adjustment, disaster recovery design and algorithm optimization are adopted to continuously improve the accuracy, response speed and reliability of the system. The invention carries out full-link simulation and monitoring based on digital twin thinking, can discover and solve potential problems in advance, and improves the reliability and stability of the system.

title_en: Fire-fighting monitoring command and control system and method for transformer substation
abstract_en: A fire monitoring command and control system for a substation, comprising: the system comprises a panoramic monitoring module, an emergency management module, an operation and maintenance management module, a major security module, a statistical analysis module and a basic application research and development module; the panorama monitoring module comprises an internal monitoring and an external monitoring; the emergency management module comprises emergency plan configuration, drilling script configuration and emergency command; the operation and maintenance management module comprises fire control resource management, plan management and hidden danger management; the major security module comprises security activity information input, emergency plan configuration and resource allocation; the statistical analysis module comprises a fire analysis module, a fire investigation module and a case library and is used for summarizing and reviewing real-time information and historical information; the basic application research and development module comprises research and development of fire disaster identification, and performs deep learning based on video information to complete a fire disaster video identification early warning function. The transformer substation operation and maintenance personnel can carry out scientific, reliable and traceable fire emergency treatment work.
assignees: BEIJING NARI YIHE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation guiding online optimization method based on crowd risk simulation evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evacuation guiding online optimization method based on crowd risk simulation evaluation, which comprises the following steps: in an offline scene, generating an initial evacuation guiding strategy set; the crowd evacuation risk and evacuation time under the evacuation guiding strategy are evaluated through simulation, iterative optimization is conducted on the strategy, and a strategy database is generated; in an online scene, according to the real-time crowd distribution data, the evacuation guiding strategy under the distribution of the adjacent crowd is matched, the optimal evacuation guiding strategy is determined, and the optimal evacuation guiding strategy is fed back to the direction identification system for actual crowd evacuation. According to the method provided by the invention, through pre-generating the evacuation guiding strategy, when the danger occurs, the optimal evacuation guiding strategy can be matched, evaluated and selected on line in real time to carry out evacuation guiding on the crowd, so that the safety of crowd evacuation can be improved, and the real-time performance of evacuation guiding optimization is ensured; by optimizing the strategy according to the evacuation time and the crowd evacuation risk, the evacuation efficiency can be improved and the safety can be ensured.

title_en: Urban flood rapid prediction model construction and evaluation method for hybrid deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of natural disasters, and discloses a method for constructing and evaluating a hybrid deep learning urban flood rapid prediction model, which comprises the following steps: and collecting relevant data of a research area, and calculating by using a hydrodynamic model LISFLOOD-FP to obtain a flood process data set. Dividing the flood process data set into a training data set and a verification data set; establishing a rapid urban flood prediction model by serially connecting GRU and a multi-head attention module on the basis of a CNN model, and training the rapid urban flood prediction model by utilizing a training data set; selecting a proper precision evaluation index; and evaluating the time precision, the space precision and the robustness of the urban flood rapid prediction model by using the verification data set and the precision evaluation index. The method for constructing and evaluating the urban flood rapid prediction model provided by the invention has the advantages that the efficiency and the precision of the urban flood prediction model are higher, and the model construction and the evaluation are more comprehensive.

title_en: Simulation workbench for military training emergency response
abstract_en: The invention provides a training emergency response simulation workbench, and relates to the technical field of training simulation equipment. This arming and training emergency response simulation workstation, including outer case subassembly, outer case, spacing platform, a plurality of spacing groove and storage water tank are placed to outer case subassembly including the platform, spacing platform fixed connection is placed the top of outer case at the platform, and is a plurality of the spacing groove is offered at the top of outer case is placed to the platform and is set up the below at spacing platform, storage water tank fixed connection is placed the left side wall of outer case at the platform, be provided with first aid simulation subassembly in the outer case is placed to the platform, gas-liquid transport subassembly is installed to the right side wall intermediate position of storage water tank, gas-liquid transport subassembly includes dual-purpose plunger pump, inlet pipe, two feeding are in charge of tubes and discharging pipe. According to the invention, by simulating the explosion environments in different scenes, the emergency response capability and psychological diathesis of students in complex environments are improved, so that the students can still rescue themselves or rescue peers in different environments.

title_en: Method and system for selecting emergency evacuation path of passengers in departure hall of terminal building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation, in particular to a method and a system for selecting an emergency evacuation path of passengers in a hall of a terminal building, which are used for acquiring the conditions of emergency evacuation physical facilities in the hall of the terminal building, and acquiring the environmental conditions of the hall of the terminal building and the conditions of the passengers to be evacuated; inputting emergency evacuation physical facility conditions, environment conditions, passenger conditions to be evacuated and a path generation algorithm into an emergency evacuation model, and solving a passenger evacuation path through simulation software; the method takes the influence of the layout of a terminal building departure hall, the characteristics of passengers, evacuation bottlenecks and the like on the evacuation path into consideration by constructing a terminal building infrastructure, collecting data and a path selection model, generates an optimal path for passenger evacuation by means of Anylogic simulation software and programming, verifies the feasibility of the optimal path, improves the evacuation efficiency of passengers in the face of emergency, and ensures the personal and property safety of the passengers.

title_en: System for planning and designing homeland space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for planning and designing a homeland space, which relates to the technical field of planning and designing a homeland space, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data transmission module, a data receiving module, a data analysis processing module, a three-dimensional model construction module, a model deduction module, a data acquisition unit, a planning evaluation module, an evaluation report generation module, a planning simulation module, a simulation scheme setting module, a geological disaster analysis module, a disaster setting module, a simulation scene setting module and a model display module; according to the system for planning and designing the homeland space, the geological disaster analysis result is obtained by analyzing the geological environment nearby the region and the geological disasters which occur in the history, the geological disasters in the deduction simulation scheme are set according to the geological disaster analysis result, and the disaster simulation scene is set, so that the planning content can be deduced, the deduction is comprehensive, and the planning and formulation of the homeland space are assisted according to the deduction result.

title_en: Experimental method and device for simulating flying fire movement in fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for simulating flying fire movement in a fire disaster, which comprises a heating device, a particle lifting device, a particle flying-out device, a fuel bed device and a data monitoring device, wherein the heating device comprises a flat heater, a grid structure, a temperature measuring element, an electromagnet, particles, a fireproof asbestos net, a timing device and an induction element, the grid structure is arranged above the flat heater, the temperature measuring element is respectively overlapped with the flat heater, the grid structure and the particles, the two sides of the flat heater are fixedly connected with the electromagnet, the timing device is electrically connected with the induction element, and the induction element is connected with the electromagnet. The experimental device not only can simulate the situations that wood flying fire particles ignite combustible matters in forest boundary houses and forests in forest fires, but also can simulate the situations that sparks splashed in welding operation and firework demonstration processes ignite building heat insulation materials in urban fires, and provides experimental support for calculating the safety distance from dangerous sources.

title_en: Strong precipitation super monomer recognition early warning method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather forecast, and particularly discloses a strong precipitation super monomer recognition early warning method based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: selecting strong precipitation supersingle cases, and screening storm characteristic parameters corresponding to the strong precipitation supersingle cases, thereby forming a characteristic data set; training to obtain a strong precipitation super monomer recognition early warning model by adopting a CatBoost-based frame according to the characteristic data set; and inputting weather radar networking observation data, topographic data and underlying surface data of the area to be identified into the strong precipitation super monomer identification early warning model to obtain an identification result, and judging that the strong precipitation super monomer is likely to occur when the identification result exceeds a set threshold value. The method disclosed by the invention is combined with multisource data and combined with CatBoost machine learning algorithm, so that the strong precipitation super single storm can be accurately and quickly identified and early-warned, and the method is particularly important for reducing the influence of weather disasters caused by the strong precipitation super single storm.
assignees: NANJING METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Dam break flood evolution prediction method based on machine learning model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam break flood evolution prediction method based on a machine learning model, which comprises the following steps: establishing a data set; performing data dimension reduction processing; interpolating low-precision flood inundation data in a high-resolution grid; learning a mapping relation between low-precision data and high-precision data time mode functions under a high-resolution grid by adopting a machine learning model; and obtaining high-precision flood inundation data by adopting empirical orthogonal function inverse analysis. The method establishes a mapping relation between flood inundation data of dams with different spatial resolutions, and drives a machine learning model by using inundation data obtained by a hydrodynamic model in a low spatial resolution grid to obtain a prediction result with equal precision of the hydrodynamic model under the high spatial resolution grid. The method not only quickens the simulation speed, but also enhances the accuracy and reliability of the prediction result. The method can effectively assist the emergency response team to quickly and accurately make decisions.

title_en: Ocean enteromorpha green tide disaster estimation method based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating green tide disasters of marine enteromorpha based on cellular automata, which is characterized in that when a remote sensing image is unavailable, the recently available GOCI-II satellite image data, sea surface wind field data, sea surface flow field data, sea surface salinity data, sea surface temperature data and solar radiation data are utilized, GOCI-II data are utilized to extract green tide coverage and chlorophyll a concentration of the enteromorpha, a structural equation model is utilized to calculate influence path coefficients of various marine environment elements on the green tide disasters of the enteromorpha, and according to drifting transportation rules, environment survival rules, growth outbreak rules and algae competition rules of the green tide disasters of the enteromorpha, the cellular automata is utilized to simulate, and finally an estimated green tide disaster coverage map of the enteromorpha is output. When the remote sensing image is available, the method utilizes GOCI-II image to mine out the growth outbreak rule, drift rule, competition relationship rule and environment-friendly rule of the green tide disaster of the enteromorpha; when GOCI-II and other remote sensing images are unavailable, the enteromorpha green tide disaster is estimated by fusing the four types of rules.

title_en: Operation interaction method for old man-assisted social robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation interaction method of an old man-assisted social robot, which relates to the technical field of auxiliary robots and comprises the steps of inputting old user data and setting voice and facial recognition; setting a sensor to monitor the behavior of the old user in real time and detect abnormality; making an emergency response decision and executing; the elderly user feedback is collected and optimized. The baseline model constructed by the machine learning algorithm can accurately learn and simulate the normal behavior mode of the elderly users, and the abnormality detection algorithm can timely identify behaviors deviating from the normal mode by combining the behavior data of the elderly users at home monitored in real time by the baseline model, so that the daily activity habits of the elderly users are considered, the emergency response efficiency is improved, and the psychological stress of the elderly users and families is lightened.

title_en: Real-time monitoring and early warning method and system for pine wood nematode disaster based on image segmentation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring and early warning method and a system for pine wood nematode disaster based on image segmentation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting an unmanned aerial vehicle image positioned in a specific area for acquisition, and preprocessing to obtain a training sample; dividing the generated sample set into a training set, a verification set and a test set, training the training set by adopting a deep learning image processing model, and monitoring the value of a loss function to judge whether the model converges or not; evaluating the model by using the verification set and the test set, and comprehensively evaluating the performance of the model by constructing an evaluation index accuracy, a recall rate and an F1 score; and constructing, monitoring and early warning a user data set. According to the invention, by adopting a high-efficiency deep learning image segmentation-based technology, abnormal areas in the pine forest image acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle can be accurately segmented, so that the form of the sick pine is judged, the loss and potential infection risk of the sick pine can be timely found and evaluated, and real-time monitoring and early warning service is provided for forestry departments.
assignees: HEFEI HENGBAO TIANZE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;ANHUI ACAD OF FORESTRY

title_en: Method and system for predicting deicing jump response characteristic parameters of isolated transmission line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of anti-icing and disaster reduction of transmission lines, in particular to a method for predicting ice-removing jump response characteristic parameters of an isolated transmission line, which comprises the steps of establishing a simulation model of the isolated overhead line based on finite element software COMSOL simulation software and verifying the simulation model; determining model input parameters based on a typical deicing mode, and determining key output parameters reflecting line deicing through feature extraction; determining a value interval of the parameter, generating input data and output data to form a data set, and carrying out normalization processing; and constructing a BP neural network, predicting ice-breaking jump response characteristic parameters of the power transmission line, randomly selecting a training set and a testing set, and evaluating a BP neural network model. The simulation model provided by the invention has good reliability, the relative difference between the vertical ice jump height simulation and the literature simulation is not more than 6.5%, the relative difference between the tension simulation and the literature simulation is not more than 5.9%, and the simulation model has important practical significance and engineering guiding value for the de-icing and disaster reduction of the transmission line.

title_en: Method for generating distribution scheme of emergency evacuation guidance personnel in large-scale sports event venue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a large-scale sports stadium emergency evacuation guidance personnel distribution scheme, which comprises the steps of introducing a concept of pedestrian movement probability entropy, calculating the size of the pedestrian movement probability entropy, and determining a specific position set by guidance personnel in an evacuation scene; based on the action mode rule of the guiding personnel, the action range of the guiding personnel is determined, and the quantity of the required guiding personnel is determined under the principle that the occurrence of insufficient guiding is avoided and the excessive guiding is reduced; an evacuation model is built by importing a large-scale sports event venue drawing, each floor of the venue is divided into more detailed evacuation subareas based on evacuation paths of personnel in the venue, and personnel evacuation simulation is carried out to obtain a demand and position distribution scheme of the whole event for guiding the personnel. The invention can provide a scientific and efficient scheme for the demands and distribution of large-scale sports event guiding personnel, and can also provide a powerful reference for similar decision-making problems of large-scale comprehensive conferences, singing concerts, exposition and other activities.

title_en: Virtual reality-based fire response experience system
title_ko: 가상 현실 기반 화재 대응 체험 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a virtual reality-based fire response experience system may comprise: a simulator unit for providing a virtual experience of evacuating from an object where a fire has occurred based on virtual reality; an experience server which stores and executes a fire occurrence scenario or experience contents virtually experienced in the simulator unit and controls the operation of the simulator unit; and an operation server which stores and manages data about the fire occurrence objects or fire occurrence options included in the fire response scenario or the experience contents virtually experienced in the simulator unit and transfers the same to the experience server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 가상 현실 기반 화재 대응 체험 시스템은, 가상 현실 기반으로 화재가 발생한 대상물에서 대피하는 가상 체험을 제공하는 시뮬레이터 유닛; 상기 시뮬레이터 유닛에서 가상 체험되는 화재 발생 시나리오 또는 체험 콘텐츠를 저장하고 실행하며, 상기 시뮬레이터 유닛의 작동을 제어하는 체험 서버; 및 상기 시뮬레이터 유닛에서 가상 체험되는 화재 대응 시나리오 또는 체험 콘텐츠에 포함된 화재 발생 대상물 또는 화재 발생 옵션에 대한 데이터를 저장하고 관리하며, 상기 체험 서버에 전달하는 운영 서버;를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: PAICHAI UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Miracle water
title_ko: 미라클 워터 털난다 제조방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing Miracle Water Teolnanda (hair growth agent). The method for manufacturing Miracle Water Teolnanda synthesizes the efficacy of natural ingredients such as bezoar, pine needles, mistletoe (pine, mulberry, oak, etc.), black beans, sunflower seeds, Gastrodia, bay salt, musk, and Wild-simulated Ginseng through a process of grinding to fine powder, heating, fumigation, aging, filtering, and extracting the same. According to the present invention, the agent naturally treats lesions of diseases with unknown causes such as folliculitis to promote hair growth, eradicates Acarus folliculorum and treats folliculitis naturally to supply nutrition to the hair papilla actively, thereby expecting rapid hair growth.

발명특허출원인-김재운은 1967년부터 발명학술개발에 최선하면서 불연제 내화제 방염제를 연구개발하여1985년도 국내 미국 등 26개국에 발명특허 출원하여 미국발명특허4,810,741호 한국22084호로 등록되어 불안나불연제를 전국과 국제적=불안나소방형식 염03-18호/염04-7호)=으로 판매하면서 미국 항공우주국(NASA)등록번호2006-300B 등록되면서 항공기 화제근절 약제실험중 산업사고 2004년부터 산업재해 2급 장애인으로 살아오며(1967년부터수많은 발명신기술)know-how를 특허출원등록보다 know-how 발명신기술를 기술보급하며 기술독점을 하고, 일부 발명신기술은 한손의 노트북 작업으로 발명특허 출원서를 작성하여 출원접수하고,도 심사청구에는 재외하는 등 약50년이상 2004년부터는 장애인 과학자 신기술개발의 아둔한 언어구성과 거동불능의 휠체어 이동하는 원로발명가 장애인 과학자로 국가산업개발에 50여 년간 몸바쳐 온 김재운은 공학박사와 전문분야 4개 명예박사 5개 분야 박사학위와 발명연구 기술750건 등을 소유한 김재운은 16세 때 호구지책(湖口之策)으로 연탄뚜껑으로 또가리 온수장치를 발명했던 것이 어려운 시절의 에너지 활용 절약 기술로 성공하여 경제적 여유(旅遊)를 갖고 발명학술에 몸바쳐 온 저 김재운은 1968년부터 불연제를 발명해온 발명가로 1984년에 발명특허출원해 1986년에 불안나 액체불연제를 발명특허등록한 창시자로 발명불연제의 무독성 입증한 발명가로 불안나는 전혀 유독가스가 발생치 않으며 기름화재의 검정연속 독한 유독성을 분해하여 수증기 같이 아무런 냄세도 없다는 것을 입증한2003년도에 유독분해제를 발명특허 출원해 2011년에 발명특허1032633호를 등록한 산지식인으로 오늘의 한국을 만든 원로발명가로 정부산하 발명학 단체들이 출판물로 발표되는 과학적으로 백년을 앞서는 발명가로 십여년전 음식물 쓰레기와 일반쓰레기로 연료화 했었고, 기름저장고의 폐기된 토양을 재생화하며,사막속에 천연수 추출발명 등 수많은 자연환경공해를 발명학술과 환경공학적으로 자연환경을 보호하고 인간생활을 편리하게 할 수 있는 학술개발에 최선하고 있습니다, 
본 발명품은(우황, 솔잎, 겨우살이(송라, 뽕나무, 참나무 등) 약콩, 해바라기씨앗, 천마, 천일염, ,사향, 사양산삼, 천일염등,,,발명의 천연재료들은 탈모방지에 효능이 있는 자연재료들입니다, 
그런데 불변칙의 효능이 있는 재료들의 성분이- 왜? 
효능을 발휘하지 못 할까요? 
그 원인을 분석하여---천연재료들이 인체에 투입되면 효능을 발휘 못하는 원인을 분석한 결과, 원인은 모낭점액증 등 원인 불명의 질환들을 미라클워터로 두피 등 피부상태 마비 회복으로 모유두 세포를 등 역분화된 줄기세포 등의 탈분화로 세포 분열능력 활성으로 줄기세포 모유두 두피등 활력으로 발모 등을 촉진한다. 
자연치병으로 생체를 보호할 자연재료들을 세분 분말 가열, 훈증, 숙성, 걸름 추출(抽出)절차로 재료들의 효능성을 합성시켜 기대 성분으로 모낭점액증 등 원인 불명의 질환 병변들의 자연치병으로 인체를 보호시켜 발모를 촉진하는 것은 모낭충 박멸과 모낭병증을 자연적으로 치료하여 활발한 모유두 운동의 영양공급으로 건강을 보존시키는 것이 속성 발모를 기대할 수 있는 절대적 발명학술이며, 머리털이 하루0.2-0.3mm정도 성장의 발모로 머리털 전체10만-15만의 풍성한 머리털이 인체 정상 기준을 보존할 학술로 털난다(발모제)를 발명한 기술입니다.

title_en: Timing fire-fighting exercise simulated fire point device
abstract_en: A device capable of timing fire control exercise and simulating fire points relates to the technical field of fire control exercise training simulation, and the technical scheme is as follows: the fire extinguishing device comprises a base, wherein a support upright rod is fixed on the base, a bracket is fixed on the support upright rod, one end of the bracket, far away from the support upright rod, is fixed with a medium disc, the medium disc is used for placing fire extinguishing medium, a detection assembly is arranged on the medium disc, and a controller is fixed at the upper end of the support upright rod. The beneficial effects of this technical scheme are: the fire disaster is simulated through the alarm device, so that the use of flame is avoided, meanwhile, the fire disaster can be simulated according to the combustion characteristics of the fire disaster, the disposal speed and the disposal method of different types of fire disasters by personnel can be checked, the reaction speed of the user to the fire disaster is checked, and the simulation of the fire disaster burst performance is realized.
assignees: SEPCO1 ELECTRIC POWER CONSTRUCTION CORP CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood toughness evaluation modeling method based on socioeconomic index coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban flood control simulation evaluation, in particular to a modeling method for urban flood toughness evaluation based on socioeconomic index coupling, which comprises the following steps of S1: selecting influence factors, determining weights occupied by the influence urban flood toughness value factors by using an entropy weight method, and establishing an urban flood toughness evaluation model; s2: evaluating urban flood toughness of the research area by utilizing an urban flood toughness evaluation model, and drawing flood toughness horizontal space distribution diagrams of each area of the research area by combining a GIS space analysis function; s3: the map making function of ArcGIS is utilized to complete the flood toughness index distribution map of the research area, and the flood toughness evaluation result of the research area is analyzed; according to the invention, the influence of the flood disaster on the city can be reduced and the flood toughness of the city can be improved by optimizing the resource allocation, guiding the city planning and improving the post-disaster recovery capability.

title_en: Road natural disaster risk assessment method based on fuzzy neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of road natural disaster risk assessment, and particularly discloses a road natural disaster risk assessment method based on a fuzzy neural network, which comprises the following steps: determining the type of natural disasters of the road; determining influence factors and indexes of the natural disasters of the roads; establishing a fuzzy neural network training set based on the data; training and saving a training model and optimal weights; establishing a road network related data set, and calculating a road disaster risk assessment predicted value; cross-verifying the training set and the prediction set; and grading the evaluation result, and drawing the road section risk grade by using the ArcGIS. The invention establishes a road natural disaster risk assessment index system and a road natural disaster risk assessment model based on a fuzzy neural network based on the actual situation of a research area and in combination with the relevant influences of weather, geology and human activities. The method has the advantages of easy acquisition of the influence factor index, simple operation, and capability of providing theoretical basis and technical means for the development of a subsequent road natural disaster risk assessment and early warning system.

title_en: Three-dimensional virtual simulation intelligent voice control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent voice control method and system for three-dimensional virtual simulation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sound signal in a workshop inspection environment, analyzing the main volume of the sound signal, and eliminating environmental noise according to the energy value of the main volume to obtain a target audio segment; performing voice recognition on the voice signal based on a pre-constructed acoustic model and a voice library model associated with the emergency scene to obtain a text result; performing natural language understanding processing on the text result based on a pre-constructed transducer language model to obtain an emergency response message conforming to a predefined emergency response rule; and generating a corresponding control instruction according to the emergency response message, wherein the control instruction is used for executing and controlling the virtual simulation to correspond to the execution response of the automation equipment. The invention responds quickly through the voice command and carries out corresponding virtual simulation adjustment, thereby improving the emergency processing capability of the factory.
assignees: GUANGDONG SIE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Drilling-level extraction effect evaluation and disaster prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling-level extraction effect evaluation and disaster prediction method and system, wherein the drilling-level extraction effect evaluation method comprises the following steps: and (3) for drilling holes in the extraction area, determining the corresponding gas extraction total amount C  ZZ , extraction radius and original gas total amount W  KY . Determining the residual gas quantity C  ZC  corresponding to the drilling hole through the original gas total quantity W  KY  and the gas extraction total quantity C  ZZ ; comparing and analyzing the residual gas quantity C  ZC  with the residual gas quantity requirement standard to judge whether the extraction of the drill hole reaches the standard; or determining the drill hole extraction rate B  Z  through the total gas extraction amount C  ZZ  and the total original gas amount W  KY ; and comparing and analyzing the drilling extraction rate B  Z  with the drilling extraction rate requirement standard to judge whether the drilling extraction reaches the standard. According to the invention, based on mass data monitored by drilling of the extraction area and a corresponding data processing method, extraction effect evaluation and disaster prediction of the extraction area are performed, so that the effect of finely controlling the drilling level of the extraction area is achieved, and the occurrence of gas disaster accidents is reduced.

title_en: Geological disaster anomaly monitoring and prevention and control method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The application discloses a geological disaster anomaly monitoring and preventing and controlling method and system based on big data, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and comprise the following steps: acquiring historical data, processing the historical data, transmitting the historical data to a cloud server, constructing a prediction model based on a mixed long-short-term memory network, and training the prediction model by using the historical data; the data acquisition equipment acquires real-time mountain data, performs preprocessing, and sends the real-time mountain data to the cloud server; carrying out data processing on the real-time mountain data and transmitting the real-time mountain data to a prediction model; the prediction model predicts the real-time mountain data to obtain a prediction result, and the prediction result is weighted and input into the prediction model for optimization; and deploying an early warning system in the cloud server, wherein the early warning system sets a corresponding threshold value according to the historical data, compares a predicted result with the threshold value, and sends different prevention and control instructions to the early warning equipment according to the compared result. The application can effectively prevent and reduce landslide influence.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF EXPLORATION TECH OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Engineering rock disaster early warning method based on multi-metadata fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engineering rock disaster early warning method based on multi-element data fusion, which comprises the steps of utilizing a micro-vibration monitoring system to collect field data of rock mass anchor rod stress and a multi-point displacement meter; utilizing the response analysis of the field monitoring data to the special working condition to establish a threshold  1  of displacement, stress and microseismic energy/quantity; carrying out engineering rock overload simulation by utilizing finite element software, calculating the allowable maximum value of data of each measuring point, and establishing a threshold  2 ; establishing a final threshold value of monitoring data of each measuring point; and constructing an early warning coefficient DRI based on a Bayesian statistical principle, calculating probability distribution of different types of monitoring point data exceeding a threshold value, coupling and quantifying a multi-index integral early warning state according to the conditional probability distribution, constructing four early warning state intervals, and carrying out interval early warning according to the difference of DRI values. The invention provides a simple and easy-to-operate new method for engineering rock disaster early warning, and avoids the difficult problem that the weight coefficient is difficult to determine in the multi-element data coupling process.

title_en: Intelligent dynamic fire evacuation path planning system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical fields of fire evacuation, internet of things and artificial intelligence, and discloses an intelligent dynamic fire evacuation path planning system and method, which are used for acquiring a three-dimensional model of a building floor and carrying out fire simulation on the three-dimensional model to obtain a dynamic feasible region; converting the three-dimensional model into an image under a two-dimensional plane by adopting Revit software, and processing the image into a grid map form in a path planning algorithm by using a MATLAB algorithm; combining the grid map with the dynamic feasible region, and generating an escape path and a rescue path by adopting an improved path planning A algorithm based on map partition preprocessing. Based on map partition preprocessing and the improved path planning A algorithm result, the invention enables personnel to directly reach a safety exit according to the luminous band indication; in the later stage of fire, the camera and the infrared sensor are used for carrying out image recognition and positioning, and a rescue path leading to trapped personnel is reversely established for firefighters, so that the double functions of escape and rescue are realized.

title_en: Dynamic prediction method for surrounding rock ledge disasters of underground engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic prediction method for surrounding rock ledge disasters of underground engineering, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a sample data set of a region to be detected; inputting the sample data set into a ledge disaster prediction model to obtain a prediction result; the construction method of the ledge disaster model comprises the following steps: constructing a lasting case database; grading the ledge case database based on a cluster analysis method to obtain a ledge grade database; constructing an input parameter database based on the correlation analysis and the coefficient of the kunity; constructing a model database according to the input parameter database and the lasting grade database; constructing an initial model according to the model database; training and verifying the initial model based on a five-fold cross test method to obtain a ledge prediction model; performing ledge disaster prediction on the region to be predicted by using a ledge prediction model to obtain a prediction result; and expanding the ledge case database according to the prediction result to optimize a ledge prediction model. The invention solves the problem of low accuracy of predicting the ledge disaster in the prior art.

title_en: Agricultural disaster joint analysis method and system based on meteorological data
abstract_en: The method and the system for the agricultural disaster joint analysis based on the meteorological data provide a basis for understanding and predicting how the meteorological conditions affect the growth of crops and possibly caused agricultural disasters by capturing and representing the association between the meteorological monitoring data unit and the agricultural disaster event unit. And determining the clustering training cost of the linkage description mining network by using the original meteorological monitoring clustering standard, so that the prediction precision of the model is improved, and the grabbing capacity of the model to causal relations in data is optimized. The linkage description mining network is debugged based on the cluster training cost, so that the model can deeply analyze the weather agriculture disaster causal relationship network to realize agriculture disaster risk prediction, the accuracy of a prediction result is improved, and precautionary measures can be timely taken before disasters occur. Therefore, accurate and effective agricultural disaster risk prediction is realized, and better decisions are made.

title_en: Hydrologic detection equipment layout method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrological detection equipment layout method and system based on the Internet of things, which belong to the technical field of hydrological monitoring, and are used for acquiring multi-frame continuous image information of a target detection area in a preset time period, introducing a hidden Markov model and a Baum-Welch algorithm for analysis to generate a time sequence dynamic model of the target detection area, calculating the occurrence probability of hydrological natural disaster types in a Bayesian network algorithm based on the time sequence dynamic model, analyzing and planning to obtain a first installation area, constructing a hydrological detection equipment simulation model, introducing the hydrological detection equipment simulation model into the first installation area for simulation measurement and screening the installation area to obtain a second installation area, constructing a quadratic polynomial regression curve model, and screening the final layout points of the second installation area based on the model to obtain a final layout scheme. The method can screen and plan the measurement layout points of the hydrologic detection equipment, realizes accurate and efficient measurement effect and has high reliability.

title_en: Real-time fire scene situation awareness model training method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time fire scene situation awareness model training method and system based on artificial intelligence, comprising the following steps: first, first fire scene video content of sample fire scene video data is acquired, and first fire situation description characteristics are extracted through a 3D convolutional neural network. Then, at least one video frame in the video stream is masked to obtain a second fire video content, and the second fire video content is loaded into the ensemble learning model to predict a second fire situation descriptive feature. Then, a first price parameter is determined from the first and second fire situation descriptors for characterizing the deviation between the two. And finally, training the 3D convolutional neural network and the integrated learning model according to the first price parameters so as to obtain a real-time fire scene situation awareness model, and by adopting the design, the real-time performance and accuracy of fire scene situation awareness are improved, and powerful technical support is provided for rapid and accurate judgment and efficient fire disaster suppression.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGZHUO FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency danger avoiding and evacuating simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation, in particular to an emergency evacuation simulation method and system, wherein the scheme introduces automobile sensitivity when calculating the speed of automobile evacuation, utilizes the automobile sensitivity to determine automobile acceleration and automobile deceleration, considers the situation that the perceived response time of a driver is shorter than usual under emergency conditions, thereby more truly simulating driving behavior and movement of the vehicle under the emergency conditions, and can simulate evacuation routes of people suffering from disasters in real time after the evacuation data, the occupancy rate of evacuation traffic modes, the speed of the evacuation traffic modes, the automobile acceleration and the automobile deceleration are input into an evacuation model, thereby providing the number of people and the evacuation rate which reach the avoidance difficulty at each moment, being beneficial to emergency management departments to better carry out emergency evacuation arrangement and reducing the loss of personnel and property caused by disasters.

title_en: Auxiliary decision-making system for disaster prevention measures in urban areas under typhoon and storm disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary decision-making system for disaster prevention measures in urban areas under typhoon and storm disasters, which comprises a geographic information module, a disaster field simulation module, a building function dynamic evaluation module, an active power failure pre-judging module, a material reserve pre-estimating module and an evacuation population pre-estimating module. According to the geographical information module and the disaster field simulation module, disaster field distribution conditions of the area to be monitored in a certain future time range are obtained, the disaster field distribution conditions are input into the building function dynamic evaluation module to judge the function states of all residential buildings at different moments, then the active power failure pre-judgment module and the material reserve estimation module are utilized to identify the buildings which should take active power failure measures and send material reserve suggestion information, and the population estimation module to be evacuated is utilized to estimate the quantity and the space distribution of population to be evacuated in the study under the disaster. The invention can provide reliable simulation and data support for the decision of related disaster prevention measures under typhoon and storm disasters in urban areas.

title_en: Digital emergency plan management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital emergency plan management system, which comprises an emergency early warning management general control system, an emergency early warning plan storage system and an intelligent AI module, wherein the emergency early warning management general control system is used for digitally managing and controlling an emergency plan and controlling the emergency early warning plan storage system to store an emergency plan, the emergency early warning plan storage system is used for recording and analyzing disaster points and carrying out multi-plan storage, the intelligent AI module is used for carrying out AI learning disaster event plan simulation analysis and generating required plan data.

title_en: Rapid modeling system and method for torrential flood small-basin hydrologic model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid modeling system and a rapid modeling method for a hydrological hydrodynamic model of a torrent small river basin, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data preprocessing unit, a model construction and operation unit, a model parameter optimization unit and a data analysis and visualization unit; the data preprocessing unit is used for reading and processing the torrent modeling data; the model construction and operation unit is used for coupling the hydrologic model and the hydrodynamic model, acquiring the characteristic parameters of the sub-watershed required by the parameter estimation of the hydrologic model, and calculating the hydrodynamic model; the model parameter optimization unit is used for coupling the hydrologic model parameter set and the hydrodynamic model parameter set, carrying out parameter assignment on the hydrologic model and the hydrodynamic model according to the hydrologic model parameter set and the hydrodynamic model parameter set, and optimizing parameters of the hydrologic model and the hydrodynamic model by adopting an optimization algorithm; the data analysis and visualization unit is used for evaluating the simulation effect of the hydrokinetic model and the flood disasters. The invention reduces the professionality and complexity of the torrential flood hydrodynamics modeling.

title_en: Feature screening method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a feature screening method, a feature screening device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and particularly relates to the technical field of financial quantization. Comprising the following steps: acquiring an original time sequence; performing linear relation test and causal test on the original time sequence to screen and obtain an intermediate feature subset; training an initial model by using the intermediate feature subsets to obtain a first model, and calculating a model error of the first model; calculating importance parameters of a plurality of features corresponding to the intermediate feature subset, and selecting a target feature subset from the intermediate feature subset according to the importance parameters of the plurality of features; retraining the initial model by using the target feature subset to obtain a second model, and calculating a model error of the second model; and determining to preserve the target feature subset in the case that the error difference between the model error of the second model and the model error of the first model is less than or equal to the preset difference. The method and the device can eliminate invalid features and solve the problems of dimension disasters and overfitting.
assignees: TIANYUN RONGCHUANG DATA TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Large-scale real-time hydrologic simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale real-time hydrologic simulation method and system. The large-scale real-time hydrologic simulation method comprises the following steps: acquiring front-end data, including basic ground data, hydrological observation data and weather forecast data; performing a first hydrologic simulation by using a first hydrologic model based on hydrologic observation data and basic ground data to obtain a global range forecast result; based on the global range forecast result and combining with weather forecast data, identifying a local disaster risk area by using a deep learning model; and executing a second hydrologic simulation in the local disaster risk area by using a second hydrologic model with higher precision based on an automatic modeling technology to obtain a risk prediction result. The invention integrates a plurality of technical means of meteorological data acquisition, hydrologic modeling and machine learning, can automatically run and update, can simulate hydrologic conditions in a research range by using a high-resolution numerical model, and provides an efficient and accurate prediction tool for hydrologic disaster prediction and water resource management.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: MCSN network model-based CT coal rock fracture image segmentation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CT coal rock fracture image segmentation method based on an MCSN network model, which sequentially comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of performing CT scanning on a coal rock body to obtain a coal rock crack CT image, manually marking a crack structure in the coal rock crack CT image, performing data enhancement expansion marking on an original coal rock crack image to form an original data set, and constructing an MCSN network model; the second step is that the coal rock mass fracture image in the original data set is put into the MCSN network model for training, and the trained MCSN network model is obtained; and the third step is to use the trained MCSN network model to conduct prediction segmentation on the coal rock fracture picture to be detected. The invention improves the fracture segmentation precision of the network model, thereby providing more accurate fracture information and having positive significance for better grasping the gas migration rule and the surrounding rock stability of the tested coal seam, guiding the gas exploitation practice and preventing the mine dynamic disaster practice.

title_en: Flight area rescue timeliness design and evaluation verification method based on GIS simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a GIS simulation-based flight area rescue timeliness design and evaluation verification method, which is characterized in that a firefighting rescue task area is reasonably divided and a simulation model is constructed, so that a more accurate and efficient scheme can be provided for the optimal configuration of equipment, vehicles and personnel of a firefighting rescue station to cope with various emergency situations, and rescue efficiency and effectiveness are improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI NEW ERA CIVIL AVIATION AIRPORT DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and early warning soil landscape earthen site and ice and snow travel resource disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring and early warning of soil landscape earthen sites and ice and snow travel resource disasters, and relates to the field of automatic monitoring. The laser monitor emits N laser beams to an object to be monitored at a preset position in real time, and N laser sample points are formed on the object to be monitored; the multispectral instrument obtains spectrum information in real time; the movable weather station obtains the environmental information of the object to be monitored in real time; the computer module simulates the surface of the object to be monitored according to the N laser sample points to obtain the surface height information of the object to be monitored; obtaining the height variation according to the height information of the surface of the object to be monitored; obtaining a spectrum image according to the spectrum information or the spectrum index; obtaining the deformation type of the object to be monitored according to the height variation, the spectrum image and the environmental information of the object to be monitored; and the alarm module carries out disaster grading early warning according to the deformation type. The invention realizes monitoring in the moving process, improves the accuracy and efficiency of monitoring and reduces the monitoring cost.

title_en: Foot-type robot platform capable of being ridden for firefighting rescue
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a foot-ridable robot platform for fire rescue, which comprises a platform main body, a crotch motor, a thigh motor, thighs, shanks, front seats, rear seats, an unmanned aerial vehicle lifting platform, a platform top shield and a manipulator mounting platform. The top of platform main part has seted up the through-hole, and platform top guard shield is installed to the through-hole top. The manipulator mounting platform and the unmanned aerial vehicle lift platform are installed to platform main part top both sides, and the place ahead of platform main part has been seted up the platform observation window, and four electric drive wheel mounting bracket and four crotch motors are installed to the side mounting of platform main part. The crotch motor is connected with the thigh motor, and the thigh motor is connected with the thigh, and the thigh is connected with the shank. The invention adopts electric drive, greatly reduces action noise, simplifies the structure, adopts modularized design, can realize quick replacement of parts when the platform fails, greatly expands the exploration visual field of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and adopts motor feedback damping simulation suspension to achieve stable advancing operation.
assignees: CHONGQING TIEMA IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning method and system based on distributed hydrologic model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster early warning method based on a distributed hydrological model, which comprises the following steps: constructing a distributed watershed hydrological model comprising a plurality of sub-watershed correlations based on geological data and historical data in the watershed; collecting real-time meteorological data, and simulating a converging evolution process of a sub-river basin where a disaster prevention object in the river basin is located by combining a distributed river basin hydrological model; according to the simulated convergence evolution process, calculating to obtain the mountain torrent risk grade of the disaster prevention object by combining the risk assessment index of the preset disaster prevention object; a mountain torrent disaster early warning system based on the distributed hydrological model is also disclosed. According to the invention, a distributed watershed hydrological model is adopted, a sub-watershed is used as a calculation unit, the confluence evolution process simulation in the watershed is realized, in addition to the real-time rainfall, the real-time terrain data is combined in the early warning analysis process, a mountain torrent early warning mode combining rainfall, flow and water level is improved, and the result of mountain torrent early warning is more accurate.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SUPCON INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Network security training platform under virtualization technology environment and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security training platform under a virtualization technology environment and a use method thereof, relating to the technical field of network security training; the control management main body is responsible for collecting programs output by the client, the safety protection establishment system, the big data previewing system and the error hole filling system, so that network safety parallel training is performed; the client registers the use equipment of the training user, so that the control management main body receives data such as instructions or programs received by the client; the safety protection establishing system can build a network safety protection system or a network safety attack program which is required by training to form a basic training project; emergency response can alert and prevent accidents in network security parallel training, such as detecting tampering with training items by non-recorded usage devices. Through the setting of the client, the user equipment of the training user can record information through the equipment input unit when being connected with the control management main body.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Hard disk fault diagnosis method based on physical drive
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cloud computing storage, in particular to a fault diagnosis method based on a physical drive hard disk, which comprises the following steps: designing a physical driving model; fault positioning technology based on network fusion; based on a physical fault full-simulation virtual reality technology fault positioning mechanism; displaying and storing hardware states based on VR dynamic real-time rendering; deducting a study of the service life of the process equipment based on reasoning; the beneficial effects are as follows: the fault diagnosis method based on the physical drive hard disk provided by the invention has the advantages of remarkably prolonging the service life of storage hardware, remarkably reducing the resource waste of technical support, improving the storage guarantee capability, avoiding the loss caused by disasters, reducing the fault recovery time and reducing the fault recovery times.
assignees: INSPUR CLOUD INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time online method for detecting abnormality of blower of sewage plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time online method for detecting abnormality of a blower of a sewage plant, which aims at the characteristic that relevant data on-line monitoring data influencing the running state of the blower in the sewage treatment process has high dimensionality and relevance, adopts a data dimension reduction method to avoid 'dimension disasters', then utilizes cross verification to be combined with a multi-element Gaussian distribution model to more reliably find out abnormal data, selects an automatic encoder model to strengthen abnormal detection aiming at the phenomenon that the abnormal detection model based on multi-element Gaussian distribution possibly appears, further efficiently identifies the abnormal time point of the blower of the sewage plant, and timely finds and solves the problems to ensure safe and efficient operation of the sewage treatment process. The cross verification method is introduced on the basis of the multi-element Gaussian distribution model, so that the generalization capability of the anomaly detection model on unknown data can be better simulated, and meanwhile, the anomaly detection is enhanced by combining the automatic encoder model, so that the more reliable and comprehensive estimation of the real performance of the model is provided.
assignees: SHANGHAI HAOCANG SYSTEM CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Test equipment and method for simulating slope deformation disaster under multi-factor coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a method for simulating the deformation of a slope into a disaster under the action of multi-factor coupling, wherein the test device for simulating the deformation of the slope into the disaster under the action of multi-factor coupling comprises: a base; a model box bracket; the model box comprises a back coaming, two side coamings, a bottom fixing plate, an angle adjusting plate and a lifting plate; a forward jack; the reaction device comprises a reaction frame and a reverse jack; the underground water simulating water tank is provided with a water passing hole, and the water passing hole is detachably matched with a water passing plugging piece; a plurality of hoses, on which water outlet holes are arranged; the rainfall simulation device comprises a rainfall frame and a rainfall control device; and a monitoring device. According to the test equipment for simulating the deformation of the slope body into the disaster under the coupling action, which is disclosed by the embodiment of the invention, the fracture activity, the water level fluctuation, the stacking effect and the multi-factor coupling disaster-causing process under the rainfall effect can be simulated, and the test equipment has the advantages of multiple functions, strong applicability, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Airport foggy-weather image recognition method and system based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying airport foggy weather images based on a convolutional neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data to obtain an airport foggy day image data set; constructing a foggy day recognition convolutional neural network; training a model; and classifying and identifying by using the trained model. The method can identify the airport foggy weather with high accuracy, and lays a theoretical foundation for early warning of airport foggy weather disasters.
assignees: YUNNAN ATMOSPHERIC DETECTION TECH SUPPORT CENTER

title_en: Digital twin platform construction method based on BIM model simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin platform construction method based on BIM model simulation, and belongs to the technical field of simulation numbers. The method comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing a BIM model; s2, importing the BIM model into a digital twin platform, correcting and optimizing the BIM model imported into the digital twin platform, rendering a scene, adding event elements into the scene, and publishing the scene to form an interactive browsing access mode; s3, labeling a connected domain, analyzing the BIM model, obtaining a passable region, and simulating the dynamic model; s4, synchronously updating the dynamic simulation model and the BIM static model; s5, generating a simulation result, and integrating emergency response of the digital twin platform during simulation. The invention provides detailed building physical information, the simulation is focused on the dynamic evolution of the time dimension, and after separation, BIM and simulation software respectively exert expertise, so that the simulation efficiency is greatly improved, the BIM model is repeatedly utilized, and the simulation preparation time is shortened.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN TRANSP PLANNING CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Fire emergency device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting emergency device, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, and can avoid influencing evacuation personnel in the evacuation process of the device by suspending and adsorbing an emergency box on a corridor, ensure the stable proceeding of subsequent evacuation work and avoid damaging equipment in the process of fire-fighting emergency exercise. This fire control emergency device includes emergent case, the absorption subassembly is all installed in the four corners of emergent case, the absorption subassembly is including fixing base on the emergent case, fixing base internally mounted has the sealed pad of filling up the form, the middle section department of sealed pad is fixed with the tensioning lever, the tensioning lever stretches out the fixing base, the tensioning lever stretches out the one end of fixing base articulates installs the bull stick, the bull stick is protruding stick, the outer fringe laminating of bull stick is in the outer fringe department of fixing base.

title_en: Monitoring pile for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring pile for geological disasters, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and comprises a monitor, wherein the bottom of the monitor is fixedly connected with a support frame, the surface of the support frame is provided with a fixing device, the fixing device comprises a connecting frame, the connecting frame is fixedly connected with the surface of the support frame, the inner wall of the connecting frame is slidably connected with a fixing frame, the bottom end of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with an upper cover, the surface of the upper cover is provided with a round hole, the inner wall of the round hole is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the bottom end of the rotating shaft is rotatably connected with a drill bit, the circular arc surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a rotating gear, the surface of the rotating gear is slidably connected with a gear plate, the tooth surface of the rotating gear is meshed with the tooth surface of the gear plate, the surface of the gear plate is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, and the other end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a fixing rod.
assignees: HYDROGEOLOGY GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT GEOLOGY EXPLORATION INST OF CHINA COAL GE

title_en: Multi disaster prevention system of railway facility based on digital twin, and method for the same
title_ko: 디지털트윈 기반 철도시설물의 복합재난 방지 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: While a digital twin for the interior of railway facilities such as railways, tunnels, and underground stations is constructed and managers can easily detect abnormalities inside railway facilities, indoor and outdoor positioning information through client terminals such as pedestrians and passers-by are accurately grasped and the optimal evacuation route in the event of a disaster is virtually simulated, thereby guiding people to the optimal evacuation route in the event of an actual disaster. In order to build a complex disaster prevention system for digital twin-based railway facilities, indoor and outdoor positioning technology to digital twin-based railway facilities are applied through a single platform, thereby easily performing disaster prevention and maintenance of railway facilities. In addition, when performing indoor and outdoor vertical positioning, the altitude change is measured and measured through the barometer built into the client terminal smartphone, real-time air pressure changes are compensated, thereby performing vertical positioning accurately.
abstract_ko: 철도, 터널, 지하역사 등의 철도시설물 내부에 대해 디지털트윈을 구축하고, 철도시설물 내부 이상을 관리자가 용이하게 감지하면서, 보행자 및 통행자 등의 클라이언트 단말을 통해 실내외의 측위정보를 정확하게 파악하고, 재난발생시 최적의 대피로를 가상으로 시뮬레이션하여, 실제 재난 발생시 최적 대피로로 유도할 수 있으며, 또한, 디지털트윈 기반 철도시설물의 복합재난 방지 시스템 구축을 위해서, 하나의 플랫폼을 통해 디지털트윈 기반 철도시설물에 실내외 측위기술을 융합 적용함으로써, 철도시설물의 재난방지 및 유지관리를 용이하게 수행할 수 있고, 또한, 실내외 수직 측위시, 클라이언트 단말인 스마트폰에 내장된 기압계를 통해 고도 변화를 측정하여 측위하되, 실시간 기압 변화를 보정함으로써, 수직 측위를 정확하게 수행할 수 있는, 디지털트윈 기반 철도시설물의 복합재난 방지 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring and predicting method based on multi-mode deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring and predicting method based on multi-mode deep learning, which comprises the following steps: collecting data including meteorological factors, crop growth conditions, soil conditions and the like; preprocessing text and image data respectively, and extracting data characteristics and dimension reduction; inputting the extracted features into a transducer model for pre-training; taking a pre-trained transducer model as a basic model, and then fine-tuning the model in new data; and optimizing and adjusting the multi-mode deep learning model by adopting ten-fold cross validation, super parameter adjustment and other methods. The method can integrate various types of data, including meteorological data, satellite images, soil information and the like, comprehensively consider the influence of various factors on agricultural meteorological disasters, and therefore the accuracy of prediction is improved. By utilizing the advantages of the deep learning technology, the correlation and the characteristics among different modal data can be learned, and the predicted result can be obtained only by fine adjustment when new data are processed, thereby being beneficial to accelerating the training process.

title_en: Method for detecting damage of post-fire concrete structure by image target detection
abstract_en: A method for detecting damage of a post-fire concrete structure by image target detection relates to the technical field of post-fire concrete structure damage assessment, and comprises the steps of firstly, defining four damage types of surface smoldering, crack cracking, concrete bursting and reinforcement exposure of an RC structural member after a fire, and constructing a corresponding data set for network training and verification. Then, one-stage target detection YOLOv s is selected as a base line network, and an AF-FPN module is introduced to improve the multi-scale performance and detection speed of the network. The detection performance of the comparison model under the combined conditions of different background interferences and damages reaches 93% of the highest detection precision and 80% of the average precision, and the detection performance is improved by about 10% compared with the network without improvement. And finally, researching and developing a damage detection system based on the mobile terminal of the smart phone to realize real-time detection of damage after disaster. The invention realizes the efficient nondestructive detection of the concrete structure after fire.

title_en: Gas explosion scene dynamic simulation method for rescue exercise
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of mine emergency rescue simulation training exercises, and discloses a gas explosion scene dynamic simulation method for rescue exercises, which comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional production scene of a mine before a disaster; setting initial parameters of mine gas explosion disasters in a mine three-dimensional production scene; calculating key parameters of gas explosion; performing disaster simulation in the gas explosion process according to key parameters of the gas explosion, obtaining damage degrees of personnel and articles in different places based on injury criteria, and obtaining a preset damage state three-dimensional model according to the damage degrees; carrying out dynamic simulation of toxic and harmful gas diffusion after gas explosion through ventilation calculation; obtaining the influence degree of toxic and harmful gas secondary to gas explosion on personnel according to an injury criterion, and performing disaster simulation in the diffusion process of the toxic and harmful gas after gas explosion to obtain a disaster model; and carrying out gas explosion disaster statistics and display. The application can simulate the environment matched with the real rescue of the mine gas explosion disaster rescue team.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Ground crack disaster response simulation system and method under underground water level fluctuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground crack disaster response simulation system and a ground crack disaster response simulation method under the variation of a ground water level, wherein the ground crack disaster response simulation system under the variation of the ground water level comprises: a base; the model box is filled with test soil proportioning materials; the crack baffle is arranged in the model box in an adjustable inclination angle and a replaceable size; the three-way water tank is arranged around the model box; the water tank partition board is arranged coplanar with the crack partition board; the upper disc water injection tank is arranged on the base in a lifting manner; the lower disc water injection tank is arranged on the base in a lifting manner; an upper plate water pumping pipe arranged in the upper plate space; a lower plate water pumping pipe which is arranged in the lower plate space; a water pump; and a monitoring device. According to the ground crack disaster response simulation system under the ground water level fluctuation, the ground crack response process can be simulated in a fine simulation mode by the ground water level fluctuation, and the ground crack disaster response simulation system has the advantages of being rich in functions, high in applicability and the like.

title_en: Dynamic forecasting and early warning method and device for mountain torrent disasters in small river basin and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic forecasting and early warning method and device for mountain torrents in a small river basin, and electronic equipment, comprising the following steps: collecting topography and topography of a small drainage basin and early rainfall information, and determining factors which have obvious influence on the flow of a control section of the small drainage basin at the next moment by using a gray correlation analysis method; establishing a multiple linear regression model according to the factors to simulate and forecast the flow of the control section at the next moment; calculating early rainfall information at the next moment according to forecast information of a weather forecast department so as to update the early rainfall information; repeating the steps to obtain the control section flow in a future period of time; calculating the over-designed flow proportion, occurrence probability and early warning duration of the control section flow according to the control section flow and the weather forecast information; and determining whether to start early warning according to the over-designed flow ratio, the occurrence probability and the early warning duration. The application provides reliable technical support for flood disaster prevention and has important significance for flood disaster risk treatment and decision.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Community extreme disaster recovery power generation method and system based on street view image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for generating a community extreme disaster recovery power based on a street view image, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a street view image group in a target area in target time, and calculating the proportion of image feature types in the street view image group; inputting the proportion of the image feature types in the street view image group into a trained regression model, and outputting restoring force information; and training the regression model through training data, and constructing the training data based on the mobile phone signaling space-time activity data and the training street view image group. The method can quickly and accurately obtain the restoring force information, thereby facilitating relevant personnel to carry out treatment activities according to the restoring force information.

title_en: Degradation evaluation method for performance of concrete beam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a degradation evaluation method for concrete beam performance, which comprises the following steps: scanning a crack beam to be inspected by using CT scanning equipment; converting scanned information into digital signals on CT scanning equipment, establishing an image at the same time, establishing an initial model, performing finite element analysis, and simulating the behavior and response of a crack beam structure; and comparing with the measured data, updating the established initial model parameters, re-carrying out finite element analysis and carrying out multiple optimization treatment. The invention can simulate the beam structure through image establishment and finite element software of CT scanning technology, and can obtain the general trend of the change of the structural performance of the beam through continuous simulation, so that related personnel can take corresponding maintenance and reinforcement measures in time, and disasters and casualties caused by structural problems are avoided. Meanwhile, the aging and fatigue problems of the beam structure can be found, and repair and maintenance measures can be timely taken, so that the service life of the structure is prolonged.

title_en: Dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure safety risk assessment method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure safety risk assessment method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of constructing a finite element simulation model of a dam and a Bayesian network of the dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure; searching a damage path in the finite element simulation model by adopting a flood discharge energy dissipation structure damage criterion; calculating the damage probability p  o  of each structural damage mode by adopting a Monte Carlo method according to the risk agent model, the mechanical parameters of the dam and foundation materials and the hydraulic parameters of the overflow surface; calculating the structural system damage probability p  α  of the flood discharge energy dissipation structure; when any damaged path o is assumed to be absent, calculating damage probability of flood discharge energy dissipation structure when disaster factors of damaged path o are not damaged based on the rest damaged paths and Bayesian network ; According to p  α  and Calculating the importance of disaster factors of the damaged path o; and selecting a failure path corresponding to the disaster causing factor with the highest importance as a main control path for destroying the flood discharging and energy dissipating structure.
