title_en: Urban waterlogging intelligent forecasting model construction method considering space-time characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of an intelligent urban waterlogging prediction model taking space-time characteristics into consideration, which builds an urban waterlogging mechanism model by coupling an SWMM model and a LISFLOOD-FP model, and carries out numerical simulation by utilizing design rainstorm under different reproduction periods to generate waterlogging samples. Constructing a three-dimensional space-time matrix based on the sample and the waterlogging characteristic factors, and realizing ordered organization of waterlogging characteristic factor data; on the basis, a convolutional neural network and a long-short-time memory network are mixed, and an intelligent urban waterlogging forecasting model considering multi-space-time characteristics is constructed; the intelligent model is trained by taking a three-dimensional space-time matrix as a drive, and performance evaluation is carried out on the intelligent model by utilizing an actual measurement sample of a research area. The invention has good forecasting precision and efficiency, and can effectively support the disaster prevention and reduction work of cities.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGYU SMART WATER RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Disaster-tolerant emergency switching exercise decision model and switching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery emergency switching exercise decision-making model and a switching method, wherein the disaster recovery emergency switching exercise decision-making model comprises a disaster recovery data center and an emergency takeover platform, wherein the emergency takeover platform comprises a cloud platform supporting module, a data level backup module, an application level disaster recovery module, a database disaster recovery module and a comprehensive management module; the implementation of the emergency take-over platform introduces highly modularized service design and dynamic visual monitoring, so that an operation and maintenance team can quickly and accurately identify and solve problems, meanwhile, the application of the intelligent fault hierarchical response model simplifies the traditional response process, a manager can acquire key information in time and make decisions quickly through intelligent analysis of the module, and the automatic arrangement and dynamic execution of the emergency plan improves the service continuity operation capability and department collaborative efficiency.
assignees: NANJING METRO GROUP CO LTD;NANJING RAIL TRANSIT IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and system of complex hybrid power grid lightning hazard risk assessment simplified model
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method and a construction system of a simplified lightning risk assessment model of a complex series-parallel power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting line lightning fault feature vectors based on historical data of a power grid to be assessed, and carrying out coding treatment on the line lightning fault feature vectors; the method comprises the steps of carrying out correlation analysis on line lightning stroke fault feature vectors after coding processing, taking the line lightning stroke fault feature vectors with correlation sequence in a set ranking interval as primary factors, training a regression model by taking the primary factors as input variables of the regression model, verifying the rationality of the primary factors according to the trained regression model, carrying out cluster analysis on the line lightning stroke fault feature vectors after coding processing, selecting disaster causing factors from the primary factors passing the rationality verification according to the result of the cluster analysis, and constructing a simplified model for representing mathematical relations between the disaster causing factors and lightning risks based on historical data of a power grid to be evaluated. The invention can effectively evaluate the lightning hazard risk.

title_en: High-performance virtual machine hot migration method for local file system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of edge computing, and particularly relates to a high-performance local file system virtual machine thermomigration method, which comprises the following steps: creating ZFS POOL on the virtual machine, and dynamically creating a system disk and a data disk of the virtual machine from the ZFS POOL; starting a ZFS-AUTO-SNAPSHOT service, and taking a snapshot after a snapshot condition is reached, wherein the snapshot comprises an incremental snapshot or a full snapshot; installing an iSER/iSCSI initator client at a node where the virtual machine is located; after the snapshot is taken, using zfs sendzfs send to simulate the network nc to redirect to the iSER/iSCSI initator client, and sending data to a receiving end host through a network protocol; starting a ZFS-AUTO-MERGE service at a receiving end host, and integrating the snapshot into the ZFS-AUTO-MERGE service after the receiving end host receives the snapshot; and uniformly merging the received snapshots into the original disk through a ROW snapshot redirection technology. The invention can promote the high availability and fault disaster recovery of the edge virtual machine, and reduce the compensation caused by data loss; the continuity of the customer edge service is guaranteed, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Safety testing device and method based on slope collapse simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of side slope test equipment, in particular to a safety test method based on side slope collapse simulation, which comprises the following steps: acquiring soil property and gradient coefficient of a side slope; determining the anti-damage force, comparing the anti-damage force with a corresponding standard value, classifying the side slope, and generating a side slope type; carrying out collapse treatment according to the corresponding collapse mode, and collecting primary particles after the collapse treatment to generate a collapse result; correcting the anti-destructive power according to the collapse result, determining a corresponding collapse treatment mode, and carrying out secondary collapse treatment according to the collapse treatment mode; comparing the diameter of the secondary particles with a preset diameter to generate a secondary collapse result; determining the slope safety according to the primary collapse result or the secondary collapse result; by the technical scheme, the anti-damage force of the side slope is accurately calculated, and the side slope engineering structure is ensured not to be damaged under natural disasters or other external pressures, so that the practicability of the side slope collapse simulation is effectively improved.
assignees: FUJIAN HONGXIANG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;FUJIAN YANYU CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;FUJIAN CAIDING CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;NANPING WATER CONSERVANCY PROJECT OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE TECH CENTER;UNIV MINJIANG

title_en: Flood risk map display method, system and equipment based on dynamic vector slicing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk map display method, a flood risk map display system and flood risk map display equipment based on dynamic vector slicing, and belongs to the technical field of disaster analysis and prediction. The method comprises the following steps: building information and landform information of the submerged area are obtained; determining boundary control points and interior control points for submerged area simulation based on the building information and the relief information; meshing the submerged area based on the boundary control points and the internal control points; calculating characteristic data of each moment of each grid based on a two-dimensional model of the submerged area; the feature data includes: water depth, water level and flow rate; the invention performs mesh dissection, calculation and visual display on the submerged area based on the dynamic vector slicing technology, and can perform visual dynamic analysis on the trend of the torrential flood from generation to development.

title_en: Auxiliary system for active power-off decision in urban area under storm disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of storm disasters, and discloses an auxiliary system for an active power-off decision in an urban area under a storm disaster. And before the rainfall is predicted, obtaining disaster conditions of each building at different moments according to geographic information and disaster field simulation modules, and if the active power failure recognition module finds that a certain building reaches the state of 'whole building needs' or 'lowest-position resident needs' active power failure at the first moment after the rainfall is predicted, taking corresponding measures at the moment of the rainfall is predicted, and continuously judging the building which does not reach the state of 'whole building needs' active power failure. In the actual rainfall process, the disaster condition collecting module is used for obtaining the disaster conditions of the buildings at different moments, if the active power failure identifying module is used for finding that a certain building reaches the active power failure state of 'the whole building needs' or 'the lowest-position householder needs', corresponding measures are taken at the moment, and the buildings which do not reach the active power failure state of 'the whole building needs' are continuously judged.

title_en: Power grid geological disaster vulnerability assessment method based on space-time similarity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid geological disaster vulnerability assessment method based on space-time similarity, which comprises the following steps: collecting data from various paths, and extracting alternative disaster factors by using a GIS platform tool; screening disaster factors through multiple collinearity analysis and information gain ratio; constructing a space-time associated data set based on the time and space relation; constructing an evaluation model by adopting a long-term and short-term memory neural network, and performing reinforcement learning training optimization by utilizing a space-time correlation data set; and (3) carrying out geological disaster susceptibility assessment by using a trained model, classifying by using a natural break point method, and outputting a geological disaster susceptibility partition map by combining power grid equipment data. The method can adapt to different geological disaster occurrence recording conditions, particularly under the condition that a large amount of geological disaster occurrence data are incomplete, and the method has universality and universality by integrating natural resource data and constructing an associated frame based on slopes and time according to a space-time similarity principle.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Geological model construction method containing comprehensive multi-source information of geophysics
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological model construction method containing comprehensive multi-source information of geophysics, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a preliminary geological model and identifying geological abnormal bodies according to laboratory measurement results of geophysics and samples; then combining the preliminary geologic model and the geologic anomaly, and establishing a geophysical multidimensional geologic model; and finally, optimizing the geophysical multidimensional geologic model by combining the drilling data, the geological map and the remote sensing data. Through the fusion interpretation of the comprehensive geophysical, drilling, geological and other multi-source data, the accurate and fine interpretation of the work area to be interpreted is realized, and further powerful help can be provided for distinguishing the geological disasters of the coal field.
assignees: XIAN MEIKE TRANSPARENT GEOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Environment box for testing mechanical properties of high-temperature environment steel structure and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment box for testing mechanical properties of a high-temperature environment steel structure and a use method thereof, wherein the environment box comprises the following components: the combustion furnace body is used for bearing a structural steel sample; the air supply and control system is used for controlling the air speed and supplying air to the combustion furnace body at the air speed required by the combustion furnace body; the blowout simulation and temperature control system is used for simulating a blowout combustion scene in the combustion furnace body at a controllable temperature; and the tail gas treatment system is used for treating tail gas exhausted by the combustion furnace body. The invention can be used for scene simulation of different blowout conditions and environmental wind speed, is matched with a material tensile testing machine for use, tests implementation measurement of mechanical properties of the platform steel structure in blowout combustion process, and provides basic data for safety evaluation of subsequent platform devices and post-disaster recovery.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;BEIJING RES CENTER CNOOC CHINA CO LTD

title_en: BIM-based intelligent building design method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent building design method and system based on BIM, which belongs to the technical field of building information models, and comprises the following steps: the terrain module is used for generating a terrain layout; the illumination simulation module is used for simulating an illumination path and judging lighting of the building; the planning module is used for planning the open space; the building main body comprises a reinforcing steel bar module, a wallboard module and a connecting module, wherein the reinforcing steel bar module, the wallboard module and the connecting module are used for generating a building main body; a revising module for revising the interference part existing in the building main body; the simulation module is used for simulating the disaster resistance of the building main body; the wiring module is used for generating a pipeline trend; and the output module is used for converting the generated model into a drawing. The invention can combine the topographic condition and the illumination condition to optimize the building model.
assignees: BEIJING HONGSHI JIAYE ARCH DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Urban street tree disaster-bearing capacity simulation method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning and artificial intelligence, in particular to a digital twinning-based urban street tree disaster-bearing capacity simulation method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring image data by adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle through oblique photography, and carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on the whole scene of the region according to the acquired image data and position information; making a traffic photogrammetry route plan according to the distribution and the characteristics of the pavement tree; based on route planning, a data acquisition system is built through an unmanned aerial vehicle, and point cloud data and multispectral data of an uplink road tree of a route are acquired; taking data obtained by oblique photogrammetry as a digital twin base to construct a pavement tree fine model; simulating the influence on the pavement tree in the urban wind field by using fluid mechanics simulation according to the historical characteristic wind field grid data; and obtaining a disaster bearing capacity evaluation result and a distribution map of the street tree according to the simulation analysis. Compared with the existing artificial wind method, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the application scene is more abundant and the area is larger.
assignees: URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN INST CO LTD OF SHENZHEN

title_en: Centrifugal test device for simulating loess mud flow disasters with wide speed range
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centrifugal test device for simulating loess mud flow disasters with a wide speed range, which comprises a mounting plate, a chute, a material pressurizing storage box and a material circulating piece, wherein the chute, the material pressurizing storage box and the material circulating piece are arranged on the mounting plate; a material release box is arranged in one end of the chute; the material release box, the material circulation piece and the material pressurizing storage box are sequentially communicated in sequence; the material circulation piece is of a U-shaped structure, and two interfaces of the material circulation piece are respectively connected with the bottom ends of the material release box and the material pressurizing storage box; the bottom end of the material pressurizing storage box is higher than the top end of the material releasing box; the box body part of the material release box, which is positioned in the chute, is communicated with a material release opening assembly; the top of the material pressurizing storage box is communicated with a feed port assembly; the device provided by the invention can control the total discharge amount of materials, can also control the outlet flow velocity of the mud flow, realizes loess mud flow simulation in a wide volume range and a wide speed range, and realizes independent regulation and control of two variables in a larger range.

title_en: True triaxial test method for full-process visualization of soft rock deformation under high-temperature stress environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a true triaxial test method for full-process visualization of soft rock deformation under a high-temperature stress environment, which comprises the following steps: step one, preparing a sample; step two, preparing a simulation system for the dynamic disaster prevention and control technology of the multi-field coupling coal rock mass; step three, heating the sample; applying true triaxial ground stress; step five, starting a high-speed camera; visually monitoring and recording the whole loading process; step six, other tests in the same group; and step seven, ending the test. The full-process visual simulation of the deformation of the large-size soft rock can be carried out, the simulation process is more real and reliable, and the automation degree is high.

title_en: Multi-disaster cooperative treatment method for coal mine based on ground horizontal well one-hole multi-purpose
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster collaborative treatment method for a coal mine based on one hole of a ground horizontal well, which is used for collecting geological condition information of a coal bed, mine pressure manifestations of adjacent working faces and roof caving conditions; determining a main key layer and a sub-key layer in the mining height of the coal seam of 30-40 times of the mining height of the coal seam roof according to the key layer theory of the coal seam roof caving and the primary pressure limit span, and constructing a ground horizontal well borehole in the main key layer; the hydraulic fracturing tool string is connected to the tail end of the fracturing oil pipe and is put into a ground horizontal well drilling hole, coal bed gas/gas extraction, weakening of a hard roof of a coal bed and waste rock treatment in a goaf behind a working face are realized in one drilling hole, collaborative treatment of coal bed gas/gas, the hard roof and multiple disasters of the coal gangue is realized, and the technical problems that waste rock ground accumulation cannot be reduced simultaneously, single-hole gas extraction quantity is improved, and maximum grouting quantity in the goaf is realized by means of roof caving processes in the prior art are solved.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Large three-dimensional multifunctional landslide-prevention structure physical test system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geotechnical engineering tests, and particularly relates to a large three-dimensional multifunctional landslide-prevention structure physical test system which comprises a model test groove, a bidirectional servo loading system, a multi-scale model transformation system, a sliding surface evolution visualization system, a positive pressure monitoring system, an artificial rainfall system and a control system, wherein the model test groove is used for receiving a sliding surface of a large-scale three-dimensional multifunctional landslide-prevention structure; the bidirectional servo loading system can apply horizontal load and vertical load, the multi-scale model transformation system comprises a plurality of telescopic counter-force brackets, and the width of the model test groove can be changed; the sliding surface evolution visualization system comprises a plurality of shooting devices arranged in a matrix manner, and is used for recording the whole sliding surface evolution process; the invention can simulate the catastrophe process of landslide with different scales under the multi-working conditions of rainfall, stacking, excavation and the like, explore the evolution process of the catastrophe sliding surface of the landslide, explore the effectiveness of different control structures on the landslide, and provide test conditions for the study of the disaster mechanism and control measures of the landslide.

title_en: Overcurrent wire fire disaster simulation device based on heat radiation and electric arc ignition
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an overcurrent wire fire simulation device based on heat radiation and arc ignition, which relates to the technical field of fire simulation and comprises an electric control system, a heat radiation ignition device and an arc ignition device; the electric control system comprises an arc ignition start-stop button, a radiant heat coil temperature controller, a radiant heat source power adjusting button and an overcurrent wire power interface. The power interface of the overcurrent wire leads in a preset overcurrent value to the sample wire; the radiant heat coil temperature controller sets a firing temperature threshold of the radiant heat firing device and adjusts the firing temperature of the radiant heat firing device; the arc ignition start-stop button controls the arc ignition device to generate or extinguish an arc. The utility model can adjust the overcurrent value; the heat radiation ignition device can be used alone to provide a fire simulation study with heat radiation as a cause of ignition, and the heat radiation ignition device and the arc ignition device can be used simultaneously to provide a fire simulation study with heat radiation and an arc as a cause of common ignition.
assignees: CHINA PEOPLES POLICE UNIV THE MINISTRY OF PUBLIC SECURITY PUBLIC SECURITY COOPERATION COLLEGE CHINA

title_en: Remote Drone Tactical Training System
title_ko: 원격 드론 전술훈련 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote drone tactical training system and, more specifically, to a remote drone tactical training system capable of performing various tactical training with respect to a virtual dynamic target by controlling a combat drone located in a remote training field in a tactical training center. The remote drone tactical training system recognizes an object with respect to topography/ground water by analyzing image information received through a camera attached to a drone in real time when an auxiliary bottom surface and a drone control bottle control the combat drone. A system manager monitors the image information of the drone and synthesizes a virtual enemy group with the image information. The tactical commander can utilize the tactical support AI to make tactical decisions and assign missions to drone pilots, while the drone pilots can view information for tactical training on the display screen of the XR device and control the combat drone to neutralize the synthesized virtual enemies.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 드론 전술훈련 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로는, 분대급 드론 조종병들이 전술훈련소에서 원거리 훈련장에 위치한 전투드론을 조종하여 가상의 동적표적에 대해 다양한 전술 훈련을 수행할 수 있도록 하는, 원격 드론 전술훈련 시스템으로서, 
부연하면, 드론 조종병이 전투드론을 조종하면 드론에 부착된 카메라를 통해 수신되는 영상정보를 실시간 분석하여 지형/지물에 대한 객체를 인식하고,  시스템관리자는 드론의 영상정보를 모니터링하고 가상적군을 영상정보에 합성하며,  전술지휘관은 전술지원 AI를 활용하여 전술에 대한 의사결정을 하고 드론 조종병에게 임무를 부여하되, 상기 드론 조종병은 XR 디바이스의 전시화면을 통하여 전술훈련을 위한 정보들을 확인하며, 합성된 가상적군을 무력화하기 위해 전투드론을 제어할 수 있도록 하는, 원격 드론 전술훈련 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: REPUBLIC OF KOREA DEFENSE ACQUISITION PROGRAM ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Digital twin platform provision system for detecting and responding to fire in the installation area of electrical equipment in nuclear power plants
title_ko: 원전 내 전기설비 설치 영역의 화재 감지 및 대응을 위한 디지털 트윈 플랫폼 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a digital twin platform provision system for detecting and responding to a fire in an installation area of electrical equipment in a nuclear power plant, implemented with a computing device including one or more processors and one or more memories storing commands executable by the processors, the system comprising: a digital twin construction unit for digitally modeling a target object, which is an object including equipment and auxiliary materials related to fire occurrence and damage spread in a place where electrical equipment is installed in a nuclear power plant to construct an initial digital twin; an attribute information application unit for constructing a digital twin by applying fire reactivity information, which is attribute information on fire occurrence factors and fire spread factors of the target object, as information received from the outside to the initial digital twin; and a simulation information provision unit for generating simulation information, which is information on spread simulation in the event of fire occurrence prediction and fire occurrence and response and evacuation scenarios in the event of fire occurrence, depending on user input using the digital twin to output the same to a user terminal. Besides, various other embodiments are possible as identified through this document.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 하나 이상의 프로세서 및 상기 프로세서에서 수행 가능한 명령들을 저장하는 하나 이상의 메모리를 포함하는 컴퓨팅 장치로 구현되는 원전 내 전기설비 설치 영역의 화재 감지 및 대응을 위한 디지털 트윈 플랫폼 제공 시스템에 있어서, 원전 내의 전기 설비가 설치된 장소의 화재 발생 및 피해 확산과 관련된 설비 및 부자재를 포함하는 객체인 대상 객체를 디지털 모델링하여 초기 디지털 트윈을 구축하는 디지털 트윈 구축부; 상기 초기 디지털 트윈에 외부로부터 수신된 정보로서, 상기 대상 객체의 화재 발생 인자 및 화재 확산 인자에 대한 속성 정보인 화재 반응성 정보를 적용하여 디지털 트윈을 구축하는 속성 정보 적용부; 및 상기 디지털 트윈을 이용하여 화재 발생 예측 및 화재 발생 시의 확산 시뮬레이션 및 화재 발생 시의 대응 및 피난 시나리오에 대한 정보인 시뮬레이션 정보를 유저 입력에 따라 생성하여 유저 단말에 출력하는 시뮬레이션 정보 제공부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이 외에도 본 문서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시 예들이 가능하다.

title_en: Experimental device and method for simulating fire and explosion of aircraft cargo hold
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device and a method for simulating fire and explosion of an aircraft cargo hold, wherein an opening and closing cabin door is arranged on one side wall of a simulated cabin body, and an observation window is arranged at the other end of the simulated cabin body; the ventilation assembly is connected and communicated with one side wall of the simulated cabin body, which is close to the cabin door, and is used for simulating ventilation conditions near the cabin door; the pressure regulating component is connected and communicated with the top wall of the simulated cabin body and realizes the pressure regulation in the simulated cabin body; the fire source generator is fixed in the simulation cabin and used for igniting goods in the simulation cabin; the sensor assembly is arranged inside the simulated cabin and is used for detecting temperature, pressure and heat flow data in the simulated cabin; the test control system is connected with the ventilation assembly, the pressure adjusting assembly, the fire source generator and the sensor assembly through electric signals, the test control system is safe and reliable in experiment, can simulate the characteristics of fire disaster under different pressures and ventilation environments, and provides data support for the prevention and control of aircraft safety accidents and accident investigation and test.

title_en: Analysis method for whole process of high-temperature post-bending of rusted reinforced concrete beam
abstract_en: A method for analyzing the whole process of bending of a rusted reinforced concrete beam at high temperature relates to the technical field of bearing capacity evaluation of the reinforced concrete beam after fire, and firstly, the simulation of the rusting process and the bearing cracking of a test beam is carried out by using ABAQUS software. And then, establishing a temperature field model of the rust beam under the action of different firing time and constant load, wherein the temperature field model presets the obtained damages such as rust expansion cracks, load cracks, concrete stripping and the like into the temperature field model. And then extracting the highest temperature of the section in the model, and building the model with the rust beam loaded to be destroyed after the fire disaster. And finally, verifying the simulation data by using the existing test data to prove the reliability of the numerical model. In addition, the invention also establishes a section theory analysis method of the whole bending process of the rust-resistant beam after high temperature. The invention can accurately analyze the whole process of the change of the structural mechanical property of the reinforced concrete rust beam after the high temperature under the interaction of the reinforcement rust and the high temperature.

title_en: Unstructured terrain modeling and generating method and device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and apparatus for unstructured terrain modeling and generation. Comprising the following steps: loading RGB images with unstructured topographic information, gray images, noise images for information fusion and user demand information for customized modeling and generation; checking whether the loaded RGB image, gray scale image and noise image are legal; performing terrain image information fusion based on the noise image; modeling a complete terrain model based on the terrain image information; the terrain model file is exported and stored; loading the saved terrain model file and the user demand information into a simulator; and generating a simulated terrain based on the user demand information. The method realizes modeling and generation from images to simulation terrains with physical characteristics, reduces construction cost of unstructured terrains, and effectively solves the problems of few unstructured terrains samples, difficult acquisition and the like in the fields of outdoor disaster rescue or outer space exploration and the like.

title_en: Urban road collapse disaster risk assessment method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban road collapse disaster risk assessment method and system based on artificial intelligence, comprising the steps of S1, S2, constructing an integrated collapse data database of a target area by using collapse related data, S3, marking and classifying data in the integrated collapse data database, dividing collapse occurrence data, collapse non-occurrence data and variable data, forming a sample data set, S4, training a logistic regression model for evaluating the road collapse risk of the target area by using an iterative weighted least square method based on the sample data set, and S5, detecting and evaluating the collapse risk of the hidden danger by combining the trained logistic regression model and the detected related information of the collapse hidden danger. The invention can systematically, accurately and rapidly evaluate the collapse risk of the collapse hidden danger, and well meet the actual urban road collapse disaster risk evaluation requirement.

title_en: Discrete element and finite element combined pipeline landslide hazard judging and emergency disposal method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a discrete element and finite element combined pipeline landslide hazard judging and emergency handling method, which comprises the following steps: simulating the motion process of a landslide on a pipeline laying site based on a discrete element simulation method; quantitatively evaluating landslide dangerous cases according to the accumulation depth data of the cutting shovel and the maximum kinetic energy density data and dividing a dangerous degree area; establishing a pipe soil coupling model based on a finite element modeling method to simulate the process of landslide from a stable state to a unsteady state in a preset dangerous degree area, and quantitatively evaluating the vulnerability of the pipeline based on the bending deformation degree and the mechanical response degree of the pipeline; corresponding emergency treatment measures are adopted according to the pipeline vulnerability of different grades. The invention utilizes the method of combining discrete elements and finite elements to realize quantitative judgment of the pipeline landslide hazard based on the movement process, quantitative judgment of the pipeline landslide vulnerability based on pipe-soil coupling, and emergency treatment measures of response to pipelines with different vulnerability degrees, and is suitable for dangerous case judgment and emergency treatment of landslide disasters of oil and gas pipelines.
assignees: NAT PETROLEUM PIPELINE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD;SOUTH CHINA BRANCH OF STATE PETROLEUM NATURAL GAS PIPELINE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Electrical fire accident simulation experiment device and method for power distribution network under extreme environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power safety training, in particular to an electric power distribution network electric fire accident simulation experiment device and an electric power distribution network electric fire accident simulation experiment method under an extreme environment. The invention discloses an electric fire accident simulation experiment device for a power distribution network in an extreme environment, which comprises the following components: transparent show cupboard, distribution network model, calamity simulation subassembly, data acquisition subassembly. According to the invention, model simplification and re-engraving are carried out on the power distribution network, the power distribution network model is placed in the transparent display cabinet, and common disaster conditions such as rainfall, icing and wind blowing are simulated through the disaster simulation assembly, so that the reality is higher compared with the photoelectric signal simulation. The power distribution network model adopts the cable bracket, the insulator and the cable as main components, and the cable is electrified through the indicating circuit so as to simulate the cable running condition in an actual power distribution network, and the reduction degree is high. The invention solves the problem of low simulation authenticity of the prior patent.
assignees: WUHU CITY WANZHI DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ANHUI NAIWEI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network disaster tolerance attribute determining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network disaster recovery attribute determining method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a digital twin model corresponding to a target network system, and acquiring at least one group of index data to be evaluated output by the digital twin model; determining characteristic information to be analyzed corresponding to the current index data to be evaluated based on a pre-constructed chaotic model aiming at each group of index data to be evaluated; determining a characteristic evaluation attribute corresponding to the current index data to be evaluated based on the characteristic information to be analyzed; and determining comprehensive evaluation attributes corresponding to the digital twin model according to the feature evaluation attributes corresponding to all the index data to be evaluated and the weights to be used. The system structure and the running state of the network system are accurately simulated, and the network disaster recovery capability of the target network system is evaluated in a scientific and objective evaluation mode.

title_en: Nuclear power plant serious accident and emergency demonstration system
abstract_en: The present disclosure proposes a nuclear power plant severe accident and emergency demonstration system, the system comprising: the system comprises a panoramic three-dimensional model display module, a positioning navigation module, a real-time operation data processing module, a serious accident and emergency simulation module, wherein the panoramic three-dimensional model display module is used for displaying a three-dimensional panoramic model of a nuclear power plant area and an out-of-plant area in a handheld terminal; the positioning navigation module is used for positioning the handheld terminal, customizing route navigation by a user and navigating an emergency evacuation route in an emergency state; the real-time operation data processing module is used for acquiring real-time operation data related to the operation of the nuclear power plant and managing the real-time operation data; the emergency and emergency simulation module is used for acquiring real-time operation data based on the real-time operation data processing module for operation in an emergency and emergency demonstration mode, displaying the real-time operation data on the three-dimensional panoramic model, and acquiring an emergency evacuation route and an emergency collection area based on the positioning navigation module.
assignees: STATE POWER INVESTMENT CORPORATION SCIENCE & TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Woodcut device for watermark print
abstract_en: The invention provides a watermark woodcut device which comprises a carving machine body, a movable cross beam, a movable frame and a drill bit, wherein the movable cross beam is in transmission connection with the top of the carving machine body, the movable frame is in transmission connection with the surface of the movable cross beam, the drill bit is fixedly arranged on one side of the movable frame, and a fire extinguishing mechanism is arranged on one side of the movable frame and can flow out dry powder. According to the invention, by arranging the fire extinguishing mechanism, when a fire disaster occurs to a plate in the engraving process, the smoke sensor receives a smoke signal and transmits the smoke signal to the controller, the built-in PLC module of the controller starts the electromagnetic valve, then the dry powder in the dry powder box is discharged from the two blanking pipes and is covered at a place where the open fire is generated, so that the air is isolated, the fire extinguishing effect is achieved, and meanwhile, the stirring mechanism, the knocking mechanism and the gushing mechanism can improve the fluidity of the dry powder, so that the dry powder can be covered with the flame quickly, the fire extinguishing effect is improved, and the problem in the background technology is solved.

title_en: Crude oil fire boiling over disaster simulation experiment system and result evaluation method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tank field safety, and provides a crude oil fire boiling over disaster simulation experiment system and a result evaluation method. In the crude oil fire boiling over disaster simulation experiment system, a crude oil storage tank is arranged on a fireproof and seepage-proof installation platform through a supporting base and is used for simulating boiling over fires with different oil layer thicknesses and different water cushion thicknesses, the fireproof and seepage-proof installation platform is used for collecting spilled oil and preventing splashed oil from seepage during the boiling over fire simulation, and a data acquisition unit is used for acquiring data during the boiling over fire simulation so as to analyze the characteristics of the boiling over fires and evaluate the consequences of the boiling over disasters; the method realizes a refined large-scale boiling-over fire experiment, integrates temperature change, flame behavior, quality loss, radiation intensity and liquid level change in an oil product, performs large-scale boiling-over fire simulation and evaluation, qualitatively determines the area for safe rescue when the boiling-over fire occurs, provides technical support for fire rescue, and reduces unnecessary loss and injury.

title_en: Intelligent highway inspection system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine vision-based highway intelligent inspection system which comprises a data set model module, a training model module, a model application module, and newly-added multi-mode data integration, real-time weather data integration, a self-adaptive learning mechanism, predictive maintenance, an emergency response mechanism, a user interface and interaction optimization. The system integrates various sensor data, real-time weather information and advanced deep learning technology, so that the system not only can more accurately identify and analyze various conditions on the expressway, but also can be adaptively adjusted according to different environmental conditions. In addition, the introduction of predictive maintenance and emergency response mechanisms provides a new solution for improving road safety and response efficiency. Finally, the user interface is optimized so that a decision maker and maintenance personnel can acquire information and make decisions more intuitively and conveniently.
assignees: TIBET ZHIXING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for constructing flood-delivery safety knowledge graph by combining machine learning with traditional mechanism model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a flood-passing safety knowledge map by combining machine learning with a traditional mechanism model, and relates to the technical field of hydrologic forecasting. The invention constructs a one-dimensional hydrodynamic model based on the Saint Violet equation group, and simulates and calculates the river hydrologic situation change under various upstream and downstream combined working conditions; constructing an efficient agent model by combining a machine learning algorithm, and establishing a response relation between a flood discharge capacity threshold value and factors such as downstream water level/tide level, flood discharge time, control water level and the like so as to realize water level forecast of a key control section of a river channel; according to flood control requirements of the river basin, calculating upstream flood quantity safety thresholds under different downstream water level/tide level conditions and flood control standard control water levels of key control sections, and constructing a high-precision flood control safety knowledge map. By the method, technical support can be provided for river basin flood control joint dispatching, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability of the river basin is improved to the greatest extent.

title_en: Optimization method for mobile water spraying parameters of vertical ignition storage tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for optimizing mobile water spraying parameters of a vertical fire storage tank. According to the method, a mobile spraying experiment is carried out by igniting fuel in the vertical storage tank to form a full liquid level fire disaster, after the relation between the mobile spraying loss rate and the central angle of a spraying cambered surface of a single spray gun is constructed, a storage tank fire disaster dynamics simulation model is constructed to carry out fire disaster dynamics analysis on the storage tank, after the thermal radiation distribution and the temperature distribution of the storage tank in a stable combustion state are determined, a storage tank hydrodynamic model is constructed to carry out multiple fixed spraying flow analysis, after the relation between the fixed water spraying flow of the storage tank and the highest temperature of the wall surface of the storage tank is obtained, the relation between the fixed water spraying flow of the vertical storage tank and the highest temperature of the wall surface of the storage tank under different working conditions is obtained through multiple simulation, and the mobile spraying flow of the vertical storage tank to be calculated is optimized. The invention realizes the accurate determination of the mobile spraying flow of the vertical fire storage tank, and is beneficial to guiding the spraying operation of the fire-striking vertical storage tank by the on-site firefighter.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RESEARCH INSTITUTE SAFETY ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, medium and equipment for preventing frostbite of heating equipment in heating area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a medium and equipment for preventing frostbite of heating equipment in a heating area, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring building characteristics of key buildings in a heating area, outdoor temperature change characterization data in winter in the heating area, indoor temperature change data of the key buildings in the heating area and frost heaving test data of heating equipment; constructing a three-dimensional building model in the heating area according to building characteristics of key buildings in the heating area; loading the three data into a three-dimensional building model in a heating area, and obtaining a frost heaving simulation test result of the three-dimensional building model in the heating area through simulation; and according to the frost heaving simulation test result, taking security measures for key buildings in the heating area, and preventing the frost damage of heating equipment in the heating area. The apparatus, medium, and device can be used to implement the method. The indoor heating device can reduce frostbite to indoor heating equipment and reduce secondary disasters of indoor articles polluted.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA BUILDING SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Gas true fire control method based on true fire training
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas true fire control method based on true fire training, and belongs to the technical field of fire training. The training method comprises the steps of preparing A before training, training process B and training ending C, presetting training time, and judging training results by comparing the real-time with the training time; when the real-time is greater than the training time, the closing state of the gas valve value is regulated, the time is judged to be overtime, the training is failed, and the training is finished; otherwise, the gas valve is adjusted to gradually adjust the opening degree from the current opening degree to the minimum opening degree, and then the gas valve is closed, and the training is judged to be successful and ended. The invention utilizes the temperature sensor placed in the combustion area to detect the temperature in the combustion area, and in order to increase the detection coverage of the temperature sensor in the combustion area, the temperature sensor placed in the combustion area forms a triangle shape, and the real-time fire extinguishing condition of the firefighter in the combustion area is acquired by acquiring the signal of the temperature sensor, so that the gas valve is regulated in real time, and the safety of the fire extinguishing exercise process is ensured.
assignees: ZHENJIANG YIHUA SYSTEM INTEGRATION CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster model test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster model test device, relates to a model test device for teaching and scientific research, and aims to study the formation, evolution and blocking whole process of geological disasters under the conditions of multiple factors such as gradient, rainfall, landform conditions, rock burst release height and the like. The technical scheme adopted by the utility model is as follows: the geological disaster model test device comprises a slope simulation device, a rolling stone release device, a rainfall simulation device and a shooting device, wherein the slope simulation device comprises at least two sections of support frames, the support frames are connected end to end, a bottom plate which is obliquely arranged is arranged at the top of each support frame to form a slope, the inclination of the slope is adjustable, a top baffle plate, a side baffle plate and a water collecting tank form a soil filling area in a surrounding manner of the slope, a strain sensor and a water content sensor are arranged in the soil filling area, and a vertical pile is installed on one side of the bottom plate, which is positioned in the soil filling area; the barren rock releasing device is used for releasing barren rock, the rainfall simulation device is used for simulating rainfall, and the shooting device is used for recording the formation and development process of landslide disasters.

title_en: Method For Conducting A Vulnerability Show
abstract_en: A method for conducting a vulnerability show that is disclosed in three variations. The first variation of the show has a protagonist who visits a location and determines how prone to terrorist or other attack, or natural or man-made disaster the location is, and subsequently, how vulnerable people at the location are should a negative event occur. The second variation has at least one participant and at least one host interacting during or after a simulated terrorist or other attack, or other form of exposure that results in vulnerability, which could be an attack on a location, a hijacking or a hostage taking scenario. In the third variation instead of a terrorist or other attack, the vulnerability situation consists of a natural or man-made disaster. Some examples of these disasters include an earthquake, a fire, a tornado, a hurricane, a flood, a structure collapse or any other disaster that could occur often with little or no warning.

title_en: Method and device for dividing prominent dangerous area based on gas-stress quantitative coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal and gas outburst dangerous area division, in particular to a method and a device for outburst dangerous area division based on gas-stress quantitative coupling, comprising the following steps: extracting coal bed gas data and drawing a coal bed gas pressure distribution map; simulating the distribution of the coal seam stress field of the whole mining area scale according to the geological features of the mining area, and extracting the data of the gray level value of the coal seam stress from the simulated stress distribution map; respectively applying an analytic hierarchy process and an entropy weight process to determine subjective weights and objective weights of two indexes of coal seam gas pressure and coal seam stress, and comprehensively obtaining comprehensive weights; and coupling the gas pressure of the coal seam with the stress distribution of the coal seam, calculating the comprehensive index reflecting the outstanding risk, and carrying out the outstanding risk partition. The method quantitatively couples two factors of coal and gas outburst, and has a certain significance for realizing the prediction visual management of coal and gas outburst areas and the accurate and efficient management of outburst disasters.
assignees: YONGCHENG COAL & ELECTRICITY HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Building economic dynamic loss assessment and disaster reduction decision system under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building economic dynamic loss assessment and disaster reduction decision system under a flood disaster, which is based on a fine physical model and considers the uncertainty of resistance distribution of building components when coping with the flood disaster, and can obtain time-varying disaster economic loss in the whole flood process when being applied to a pre-disaster simulation scene, thereby providing a basis for the scheduling of related disaster relief materials; when the method is applied to a real-time monitoring scene, compared with the existing method, the method can accurately obtain the economic loss condition of each building in the monitoring area at the current moment.

title_en: Three-dimensional scene simulation method, system and equipment for earthquake disaster process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional scene simulation method, a system and equipment in a earthquake disaster-stricken process, which belong to the technical field of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting historical data and aerial photographs of a disaster-stricken city, determining restored topography and restored plan views of the disaster-stricken city, comparing the restored topography and restored plan views, converting a digital elevation model in vectorized data into elevation points, creating a triangular irregular network, and generating 3D topography of the disaster-stricken city; reconstructing the building and surrounding environment of the 3D topography of the disaster-affected ancient city to restore the 3D scene of the disaster-affected ancient city; adding a blueprint file and a checkpoint sequence in Unreal Engine software, and simulating a seismic scene of a disaster affected city by adding a camera and a path for the camera to move in the checkpoint sequence; simulating the strength of geometric body fracture by adjusting the explosion equivalent of the fracture of the earthquake scene, and simulating a landslide scene; the formation scene of the barrier lake is simulated by adjusting the color and parameters of the water flow of the landslide. The method can simulate the disaster-stricken process rapidly and with high fidelity.

title_en: River course treatment project flood control life benefit risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river course treatment project flood control life benefit risk assessment method and system, which relate to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment and comprise the following steps: constructing a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, setting a flood reproduction period, and simulating floods with different frequencies based on the flood reproduction period; determining the number of risk population and the mortality of risk population in a flood inundation area according to the population density distribution diagram and each frequency flood inundation simulation result diagram; calculating to obtain life loss results of flood in each reappearance period; calculating a statistical life value; and calculating flood control life benefits of river channel treatment engineering according to the statistical life value and life loss results. The invention adopts statistical life value to quantify the life benefit of river channel treatment project, intuitively and accurately displays the life benefit generated by the project, and ensures that a decision maker can evaluate the quality of the project construction effect more accurately.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;HENAN JIALUHE ENVIRONMENTAL COMPREHENSIVE TREAT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency evacuation simulation method based on cell transmission model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toxic gas leakage accident emergency evacuation simulation method based on a cell transmission model, which is characterized in that different road sections are spatially divided into a certain number of equal-length cells, each cell updates its own state according to the information of upstream and downstream cells and the changes of flow conservation and constraint conditions in a constructed discretization space along with the change of time steps, so that the time-varying characteristics of traffic flow in a traffic network are simulated, the cell states are repeatedly calculated and continuously updated along with the change of time steps according to the interaction mode set by the model, and the dynamic traffic conditions of the cells are obtained until all evacuation personnel are completely evacuated, and finally corresponding results are output. According to the invention, the problem of road traffic capacity reduction under the influence of toxic gas is considered, the cell transmission model is expanded, a linear programming model is established, the actual situation can be better simulated by considering the evacuation model under the influence of toxic gas, and the practicability and applicability of the model are improved.

title_en: Intelligent decision-making and control system for ventilation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent decision and control system for ventilation, which belongs to the technical field of mine ventilation and comprises the following components: the air quantity demand calculation module is used for reflecting the air quantity distribution condition of all underground roadways in real time and calculating the real-time air quantity of underground air quantity demand points in real time; the ventilation system fault diagnosis and prediction early warning module is used for predicting the air quantity and the air speed of the ventilation system and carrying out real-time diagnosis and early warning on the system fault; the disaster avoidance route automatic generation and simulation module is used for automatically planning a disaster avoidance route; the underground ventilation state three-dimensional dynamic visualization module is used for generating a ventilation three-dimensional system diagram and displaying a monitoring data diagram; the wind control scheme auxiliary decision-making module is used for making a decision on the system wind control scheme by combining data provided by other modules; the ventilation facility equipment remote regulation and control module is used for realizing remote automatic control of the main ventilator, the local ventilator, the air door and the air window based on the ventilation intelligent decision scheme.
assignees: CHN ENERGY WUHAI ENERGY CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Disaster recovery exercise method, equipment, storage medium and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster recovery, and discloses a disaster recovery exercise method, equipment, a storage medium and a device, wherein when a disaster recovery exercise instruction is received, disk copy-on-write copy operation is started, and original disk data corresponding to a target disk is copied to a data cache area; performing target program installation on the hard disk operating system according to a target program installation package pushed by the disaster recovery integrated machine, and restarting the installed target operating system; and when a disk write request is received, identifying the exercise identifier corresponding to the data cache region through an agent program in the target operating system, and executing copy-on-write copy operation on the target disk according to the identification result and the disk write request. The invention can realize that the business data of the standby terminal host is not modified during the exercise, and can continuously synchronize the increment data of the source terminal host after the exercise is finished, thereby being simple and efficient.

title_en: Method for identifying outburst prevention and collapse prevention risks based on tunnel construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of tunnel engineering construction risk identification, in particular to a method for identifying anti-bursting and anti-collapse risks based on tunnel construction. Comprising the following steps: s100: checking the color, impurities and change conditions of water; s200: inquiring the water outlet position and depth, color, impurities, water quantity and change condition in the construction process of a pipe shed, a small guide pipe, a blasthole, a deepened blasthole, an anchor rod and an advanced drilling; s300: judging whether a softened tunnel face, a softened corner and aggressiveness exist or not according to the softening effect of the groundwater; s400: observing the joint development degree of the tunnel face; s500: observing the lithology combination condition of the tunnel face; s600: observing the development condition of the transverse through crack; s700: observing the development condition of the vault wedge; s800: judging whether a tunnel gushing slump risk and a risk type exist according to the steps S100-S700; s900: and (5) formulating risk countermeasures according to the S800. The invention improves the risk identification and prevention and control capability of common geological disasters such as gushing collapse and the like and ensures the construction safety.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 12TH BUREAU GR;THE 4TH ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 12TH BUREAU GROUP

title_en: Chemical security monitoring method and system based on deep learning and Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical security monitoring method and a chemical security monitoring system based on deep learning and the internet of things technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a fire disaster data set; constructing an MGL-Yolov network model, replacing a Backbone network of a backhaul with a MobileNetV network structure to reduce the calculation amount, replacing Conv convolution with GSConv convolution in a Neck layer, and replacing C3 structure with VoVGS structure; aiming at the characteristic that flame is generated with smoke shielding, IOU and NMS are improved to SIOU and Soft-NMS; the internet of things device is used for transmitting real-time images, controlling an emergency circuit and receiving alarm information; the system comprises a labeling module, a preprocessing module, a model construction module, a training and deployment module and a detection and alarm module. Experimental results show that the volume and the parameter of the model are reduced by 55.6% and 59.7% while the precision is ensured, so that fewer resources are used to obtain the optimal effect during deployment, thereby helping chemical enterprises to improve the efficiency and the accuracy of fire monitoring in chemical plants, shortening the time of emergency response and reducing the loss.

title_en: Multi-scale remote sensing image landslide target detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting landslide targets of a multi-scale remote sensing image, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a landslide remote sensing image, and establishing a landslide target prior frame based on the landslide remote sensing image; constructing an improved YOLOV network; training the improved YOLOV network by taking the landslide remote sensing image as input and the detection position and the confidence of the landslide target priori frame as output to obtain a landslide detection model; and detecting the landslide disaster image to be detected by using the landslide detection model, and obtaining the detection position and the confidence of the landslide target in the landslide disaster image to be detected. Under the condition of meeting the real-time performance, the invention can reduce false detection and omission rate of landslide targets before improvement, thereby improving detection precision.

title_en: High-pressure inflatable storehouse tent
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-pressure inflatable storehouse tent, and belongs to the technical field of engineering machinery. The low-pressure inflatable tent overcomes the defects that a traditional low-pressure inflatable tent in the prior art is low in structural strength, needs uninterrupted air supply and is poor in environmental adaptability. The main body structure comprises a main body tent and an anti-wind stay rope, one side of the main body tent is provided with one or more passage tents for vehicles to pass through, the other side of the main body tent is provided with one or more door bodies, the gable walls at the two ends of the main body tent are provided with connecting door bodies for being connected with other storehouse tents, the passage tents and the main body tent are bonded and assembled through sticking buckles, one end of the anti-wind stay rope is connected with air ribs on the main body tent, and the other end of the anti-wind stay rope is connected with a ground pile. The utility model is mainly used for field training, field disaster relief, international rescue and other application places.

title_en: Remote interactive teaching communication equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of communication, and discloses remote interactive teaching communication equipment, which comprises: the cell-phone frame, mount fixed connection is at one side outer wall of cell-phone frame, and debugging device sets up on the mount, and debugging device includes: the window frame is connected with the inner wall of one side of the fixing frame in a sliding way. Through setting up debugging device, because of current multimedia teaching equipment only possess conventional teaching function, demonstration function, when carrying out disaster and fleing the exercise, only can carry out the content on the picture to the student and put in, do not possess interactivity, VR teaching equipment gradually gets into masses ' visual field in, VR equipment can simulate virtual reality's scene for the user has a sense of being personally on the scene, thereby can improve the teaching effect in the teaching, for this improves interactive teaching effect to each crowd of young and old, because of everyone's stadia and interocular distance are different, can carry out fine adjustment according to the wearer and make the impression effect reach best.
assignees: NANJING NIOU SCIENT INSTRUMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting rock burst disaster grade of deep buried tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rock burst disaster level prediction method for a deep-buried tunnel, which relates to the technical field of tunnels and underground engineering, and aims to predict the damage condition and intensity level of rock burst in the construction process of the deep-buried tunnel by researching the quantitative migration-transformation-distribution-release rule of accumulated strain energy in the stress adjustment process through the quantification of the stress and the strain of the surrounding rock in the stress adjustment process after the excavation unloading of the deep-buried tunnel based on the relation between rock energy and the full stress-strain of the rock in view of the unique advantages of a block discrete element numerical method in simulating continuous-discontinuous deformation and dynamic damage, so as to provide a research foundation for the development of the rock burst disaster numerical simulation method, the rock burst tendency analysis and the prevention and control measure effect evaluation of the subsequent tunnels and underground engineering.

title_en: Drilling method suitable for gas extraction and anti-flushing pressure relief
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling method suitable for gas extraction and anti-flushing pressure relief, which relates to the technical field of coal mine composite dynamic disaster prevention and control and comprises the following steps: s1, constructing directional large-diameter high-position drilling holes in a hard roof stratum; s2, sequentially constructing branch layer penetrating holes on the directional large-diameter high-position drilling holes at intervals of a preset distance; s3, drilling hydraulic strengthening, namely presplitting a hard roof stratum, a gas-containing stratum and a coal seam by utilizing high-pressure water through directional large-diameter high-position drilling and branch layer penetrating holes; s4, drilling a coal seam horizontal hole by the directional drill from the tail part of the last branch layer penetrating hole, and constructing holes on the coal seam horizontal hole at certain intervals by using a backward hydraulic hole making technology; s5, connecting the gas extraction system to carry out gas extraction. The drilling and drilling strengthening method has the dual functions of pressure relief, impact prevention, extraction and outburst elimination, can realize that a hole is used for carrying a lane, has multiple purposes, effectively reduces composite dynamic disasters and improves the production benefit of mines.

title_en: Method and system for constructing failure model of high-voltage transmission line iron tower under geological disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a failure model of a high-voltage transmission line iron tower under geological disasters, which relate to the field of disaster prediction and comprise the steps of collecting parameter data, soil information and topography conditions of the high-voltage transmission line iron tower; constructing a finite element model according to the acquired data to perform simulation analysis to obtain simulation data; performing test model design, and constructing a power transmission tower entity model based on the parameter data of the iron tower; constructing a soil body entity model according to the soil information and the surrounding topography; collecting rainfall data in a region, setting different rainfall intensities, and simulating the conditions of the power transmission tower under different rainfall intensities based on a power transmission tower entity model and a soil entity model to obtain entity test data; and comparing the simulation data with the entity test data, and correcting the finite element model. According to the method, through simulating a rainfall landslide induction process, the influence of geological disasters on the stability of the power transmission tower can be predicted in advance, scientific basis is provided for disaster early warning, and loss caused by disasters is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Impact risk judging method based on drilling cuttings quantity limit equation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning, in particular to an impact risk judging method based on a drilling cuttings quantity limit equation, which comprises the following steps of S10, calibrating normal drilling cuttings quantity of a work site to be judged; the method comprises the steps of S20, respectively arranging drilling holes at a plurality of measuring points of a work site to be judged, measuring actual drilling cuttings of the drilling holes of each measuring point at different drilling depths, simultaneously recording dynamic effect phenomena and corresponding drilling depths in the drilling process, S30, calculating to obtain corresponding drilling powder rate indexes of the drilling holes of each measuring point at different hole depth roadway height ratios, S40, determining a drilling powder rate index limit equation, S50, determining region types corresponding to the drilling powder rate indexes at different hole depth roadway height ratios, and S60, comprehensively judging impact dangers of the work site according to the drilling powder rate indexes of the drilling holes of each measuring point at different hole depth roadway height ratios. The invention can effectively improve the precision of the drilling cutting method for judging the impact risk and reduce the possibility of misjudgment.

title_en: Optical fiber multi-parameter monitoring method for geological disasters of mine roof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter optical fiber monitoring method for geological disasters of a mine roof, which comprises the steps of fixing a multi-parameter hole optical cable in a boss on the outer wall of a conveying pipe in a hole in parallel, moving the conveying pipe in the hole and the multi-parameter hole optical cable to the bottom of the hole through a through hole in an integral spiral drill rod under the drive of high-pressure water, withdrawing the drill rod, completing the layout of the multi-parameter hole optical cable by using a suspension anchor, injecting non-expansion neutral cement slurry to enable the multi-parameter hole optical cable to be fully coupled with a well wall, and carrying out remote joint monitoring on the mine roof strain and the acoustic vibration multi-parameter by using a ground integrated optical fiber monitoring host. The invention can realize the feeding and the arrangement of the optical cable in the multi-parameter hole at one time, can ensure the full coupling of the optical cable in the multi-parameter hole and the well wall, completes the dynamic monitoring of the geological disaster hidden danger factors, and realizes the dynamic intelligent identification and timely feedback of the geological disaster factors of the mine roof.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Three-dimensional numerical simulation pretreatment high-precision modeling method for side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision modeling method for three-dimensional numerical simulation pretreatment of a side slope, which realizes high-precision three-dimensional numerical simulation pretreatment modeling by combining unmanned aerial vehicle close-up photography, airborne LiDAR, drilling data and geophysical prospecting data; the three-dimensional grid model established by the method can express the topography condition of the part shielded by vegetation; can reflect the characteristic shape of the rock on the surface of the slope; the formation interface precision between the boreholes can be improved; the precision differential modeling can be carried out on different areas, so that the precision of key calculation areas is improved, and the integral calculation demand of the model is reduced; the grid internal structural surface data can be generated, the numerical simulation precision is improved, a user or related manager can conveniently make a decision, effective support is provided for finding out disaster potential hazards caused by geological disasters, and the disaster investigation accuracy is remarkably improved.
assignees: SICHUAN INSTITUTE OF GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG GROUP CO LTD;SICHUAN SHUIFA SURVEY AND DESIGN RES CO LTD

title_en: Landslide surge impact floating vessel disaster chain estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide surge impact floating vessel disaster chain estimation method and system. Generating a soil-stone mixture entity model with specified block stone content by combining a random variable generation method, and respectively constructing a plurality of particle models and a cable unit model of a real physical world coordinate system by adopting a particle filling algorithm; constructing a corresponding control equation by combining a plurality of particle models of a real physical world coordinate system; repeatedly iterating to initialize different particle models under a real physical world coordinate system and solving a control equation until the preset maximum calculation step number is reached; and calculating by combining the corresponding control equation to obtain the motion information of different particles, and guiding the planning of the safety range of the floating pontoon in the surge risk area in the reservoir area, and analyzing and predicting the damage of the hydraulic building under the surge impact effect. The invention establishes a landslide and surge disaster chain overall process high-fidelity fine simulation method taking the coupling effect between a landslide and surge of a soil-stone mixture, a floating vessel, mooring and a hydraulic building into consideration.

title_en: Urban tunnel flood grading early warning method based on flood identification transfer information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city tunnel flood grading early warning method based on flood identification transfer information, which comprises the following steps: calculating the flooding and inundation process of the surface-underground tunnel area by adopting a numerical simulation mode; dividing different waterlogging stages according to the affected degree of traffic in the tunnel based on the flooding submerging process of the surface-underground tunnel area, tracing tunnel flooding, and establishing submerging identification points; and deducing disaster-causing rainfall standards in a grading way, associating the flooding identification point position water depth, the flow rate and the estimated disaster-causing time, and establishing regional flooding identification transfer information. According to the invention, the rainfall standards of different disaster-affected stages are obtained by carrying out numerical simulation on the surface-underground tunnel waterlogging process, key identification information is established in the area close to the upstream area, the loss of early warning information caused by flood inundation identification is avoided, the tunnel waterlogging prediction period is prolonged from two angles of source carding and process judgment, and a new thought and method are provided for the precise forecasting and early warning and influence prediction of the waterlogging of the special area of the natural disaster city.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;UNIV BEIJING CIVIL ENG & ARCHITECTURE

title_en: Slope dry-wet circulation simulation system and method for geotechnical centrifugal model test
