abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geotechnical tests, in particular to a slope dry-wet cycle simulation system and method for a geotechnical centrifugal model test, wherein the system comprises the following steps: a model box in which an earth slope model is placed; the water storage module is used for controlling the water level in the model box to rise to the first target height and maintaining the water level in the model box; the drainage module is used for controlling the water level in the model box to drop to a second target height, wherein the second target height is smaller than the first target height; the air drying module is used for heating the side slope of the soil slope model after the water level in the model box drops; the control module is used for controlling the water storage module, the water drainage module and the air drying module to work according to the requirements of the geotechnical centrifugal model test, and realizing the rising, falling, stabilization and slope water evaporation of the model box water level so as to simulate the dry-wet circulation process of one or more slopes in the geotechnical centrifugal model test process. Therefore, the problems that soil stability is poor due to dry and wet circulation of the side slope in the reservoir area, timely disaster forecast and early warning are needed and the like are solved.

title_en: Visual fire-fighting equipment management method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a visual fire-fighting equipment management method and a visual fire-fighting equipment management system, which belong to the field of fire protection, wherein the method comprises the following steps: digital twin modeling is carried out on a plurality of fire-fighting equipment, and a visual model library of the fire-fighting equipment is obtained; monitoring real-time operation states of a plurality of fire-fighting equipment to obtain target fire-fighting equipment; according to the target firefighting equipment, a first visual model is called; constructing a second visual model for the target fire-fighting equipment; performing difference recognition on the model simulation result to obtain a model difference index; and when the model difference index does not meet the difference threshold range, generating an abnormal instruction of the target equipment, and managing the target fire-fighting equipment. The method solves the technical problem that the fire-fighting equipment has larger risk hidden trouble due to lack of fine management of the fire-fighting equipment in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of reducing the risk hidden trouble of the equipment by constructing a visual model to finely manage the fire-fighting equipment.
assignees: DATANG CHANGCHUN SECOND THERMAL POWER CO LTD;DATANG NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER TEST & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Grading assimilation method for digital twin model of mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grading assimilation method of a mine digital twin model, which comprises the steps of establishing digital twin models with different scales step by using the grading assimilation method, monitoring data of a whole mine, assimilating and establishing a primary digital twin model; then, a stress field of a primary digital twin model is utilized for a certain mining face, and a secondary digital twin model is established after simulation mining and assimilation treatment; finally, a stress field of a secondary digital twin model is utilized for a certain roadway of the mining face, and a tertiary digital twin model is established after simulation excavation and assimilation treatment; therefore, time and calculation process required by building each model are effectively reduced, different model precision criteria are designed according to different research scales, so that the operation speed is matched with the model precision, and finally ground stress distribution data similar to actual tests can be obtained through simulation under the condition of the precision required by different research objects, so that data support is provided for preventing abnormal dynamic disasters.

title_en: Multi-section variable-gradient tunnel model and fire simulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of tunnel safety and fire disaster safety, in particular to a multi-section variable-gradient tunnel model and a fire disaster simulation system, and aims to solve the problems that in the related art, the tunnel model is poor in adjustability and adaptability and cannot accurately reflect a complex and variable tunnel. The multi-section variable-gradient tunnel model comprises a simulated tunnel, an angle adjusting device and a gradient adjusting device. The fire disaster simulation system comprises a multi-section variable-gradient tunnel model, a ventilation and smoke exhaust system, a fire source simulation system, a data measurement system and a linkage device. According to the invention, by arranging the angle adjusting device and the gradient adjusting device, the tunnel model with different gradients and different bifurcation angles is realized, the problems that the tunnel model in the related art is poor in adjustability and adaptability and cannot accurately reflect complex and changeable tunnels are overcome, and the gap in the aspects of research means and experimental platforms of fire simulation of multi-section bifurcation tunnels with different gradients in the present stage is filled.

title_en: Impact risk judging method based on drilling cuttings quantity correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning, in particular to an impact risk judging method based on drilling cuttings quantity correction, which comprises the following steps: step one: measuring normal cuttings volume in areas of no mining and geological formations proximate the job site; step two: drilling is constructed at a working place, and the discharged drilling cuttings quantity, the drilling cuttings repose angle and the coal density at different drilling depths are measured; step three: correcting the discharged drilling cuttings to obtain the total drilling cuttings; step four: calculating a total drilling cuttings quantity corresponding to a total drilling powder rate index; step five: and judging the impact risk of the working site by using the relative sizes of the total drilling powder index and the drilling powder index. The invention improves the accuracy of judging the impact risk by the drilling cutting method and reduces the possibility of misjudgment.

title_en: Highway tunnel evacuation simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a highway tunnel evacuation simulation method, which comprises the steps of obtaining initialization data; establishing an exit selection model and a pedestrian motion model according to the initialization data; obtaining a first evacuation scheme according to the outlet selection model; obtaining a second evacuation scheme according to the pedestrian motion model; determining a third evacuation plan from the first and second evacuation plans; the outlet selection model comprises a first potential energy obtained according to initialization data in a first time period of a non-intersecting part of the information transmission area; initializing data in a second time period according to the non-intersecting part of the information transmission area to obtain fourth potential energy; the pedestrian motion model includes deriving at least one pedestrian cellular characteristic based on the initialization data information. The method not only can represent the ideal state of the pedestrian evacuation, but also can represent the decision-making behavior of the passenger based on individuals.

title_en: Wave generating device and method for wave simulating water tank for marine geological disaster research
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster research, and discloses a wave making device and a wave making method for a wave simulating water tank for marine geological disaster research, wherein the wave making device comprises a box body, the box body is provided with a first wave making mechanism, the first wave making mechanism comprises a wave generating cavity processed by the box body, a rotating shaft is rotationally connected between end walls of the wave generating cavity, and the first wave making mechanism is arranged, so that multiple waves can be simulated, the pressure of impact generated by the waves in the wave generating cavity can be measured, the generation of rotary waves and reciprocating waves can be realized, and vortex waves can be generated by utilizing the rotation of a rotating plate, thereby facilitating better research on the impact caused by the waves; be equipped with separating mechanism, can realize separating simultaneously and produce different waves, the impact force that the impact caused under the multiple wave of being convenient for research can realize adjusting the speed that the wave produced, the impact of wave under the different speeds of being convenient for research.
assignees: FIRST INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Machine vision-based fire positioning method for elevated warehouse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine vision-based fire disaster positioning method for an elevated warehouse, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: dividing the terrain of the overhead warehouse into grids, and acquiring temperature data and image data of shelf nodes in each grid in real time; processing the temperature data to obtain temperature change data; constructing a fire disaster identification model, adding fire disaster labels to an image data set constructed by a fire disaster image and a non-fire disaster image, and training the fire disaster identification model; identifying the image data acquired in real time based on the trained fire disaster identification model, and judging a fire disaster image; and determining the fire degree based on the fire image and the temperature change data of the current shelf, performing grading early warning, and determining the fire position based on an early warning signal. The fire disaster positioning method provided by the invention can timely determine the position information of the disaster situation, is convenient for timely taking rescue measures and reduces loss.

title_en: Tunnel rock burst monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel rock burst monitoring method. The tunnel rock burst monitoring method comprises the following steps: a microseism monitoring method and an image monitoring method; the microseismic monitoring method comprises the following steps: step one: collecting geological data information and establishing a geological model sample; step two: and establishing monitoring points to obtain real-time data in the tunnel. The tunnel rock burst monitoring method provided by the invention is used by matching the image monitoring method with the microseismic monitoring method, and the AI algorithm model is used for simulating the geological structure and the geological change in the tunnel and continuously learning, so that the rock burst simulation accuracy is greatly improved, the real-time monitoring is carried out on the area possibly suffering from rock burst in the tunnel, the information such as the occurrence place, the occurrence probability, the rock burst grade and the like possibly suffering from rock burst in the tunnel is calculated, the corresponding preparation work is made in advance, the rock burst occurrence probability is reduced, and the personnel and property loss caused by rock burst disasters is reduced.

title_en: Gate dam flood control system multi-objective optimization scheduling method and system based on online data driven evolution optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gate dam flood control system multi-objective optimization scheduling method and system based on online data driven evolution optimization, comprising the following steps: the multi-objective evolutionary optimization algorithm is driven on line through the machine learning model, the improved multi-objective expected improvement matrix filling criterion is adopted to select potential non-dominant candidate solutions in the child population in the evolutionary process as evolutionary guidance, unnecessary real evaluation is reduced by carrying out simulation calculation on the candidate solutions through the flooding numerical model of the coupling gate dam, the optimization calculation efficiency is greatly improved, and the direct solution of the multi-objective flood control optimization scheduling of the gate dam under the calculation of the hydrodynamic model is realized. The invention makes the global optimization of flood control and drainage engineering operation scheduling problem possible under the accurate simulation based on the hydrodynamic model, reserves sufficient lead time for emergency scheduling of river gate dams, provides scientific basis for disaster prevention and reduction and reasonable resource allocation of rivers, and has important application value for effectively reducing flood risk.

title_en: Hydrogenation platform wind disaster assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster assessment method and a typhoon disaster assessment system for a hydrogenation station. And establishing a numerical simulation model of the typhoon disaster of the hydrogenation station according to the typhoon disaster scene, the structural body type of the key equipment of the hydrogenation station and the working state of the key equipment of the hydrogenation station. According to the mathematical model of the extreme wind load of the hydrogenation station and the numerical simulation model of the wind disaster of the hydrogenation station, the random vibration response of key equipment of the hydrogenation station under typhoon is obtained through simulation calculation, and the failure condition and the weak part of the equipment are analyzed, so that data support can be provided for structural improvement of the key equipment of the hydrogenation station, prevention of the failure of the key equipment and the operation reliability of the hydrogenation station. Effectively guaranteeing public safety and economic benefit.

title_en: Passenger evacuation method for ultra-deep subway transfer junction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passenger evacuation method of an ultra-deep subway transfer junction, which comprises the following steps of: building an ultra-deep subway transfer hub BIM model, and performing fire simulation to obtain a fire simulation model; acquiring an influence coefficient of the passenger evacuation speed based on the fire simulation model; building a passenger evacuation simulation model, and dividing the passenger evacuation simulation model into areas based on the fire simulation model; performing speed control on passengers in different areas based on influence coefficients of the passenger evacuation speed; presetting a plurality of evacuation strategies in different evacuation scenes, and obtaining corresponding passenger evacuation efficiency by combining the speeds of passengers so as to obtain optimal evacuation schemes in different evacuation scenes. The invention can realize the emergency evacuation of the passengers of the ultra-deep subway transfer junction in the virtual environment.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN;POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Emergency evacuation analysis method and system for cabin personnel under dynamic influence of fire products
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passenger cabin personnel emergency evacuation analysis method and system under the dynamic influence of fire products, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on a basic social force model, analyzing the behaviors of cabin personnel in a fire scene to obtain the evacuation behaviors of the cabin personnel; building a cabin model, and performing numerical simulation on cabin fires to obtain fire data; constructing fire data into a three-dimensional matrix model; dynamic influence of fire products on evacuation behaviors of cabin personnel is obtained through dynamic calling of the three-dimensional matrix model; based on dynamic influence, modeling simulation is carried out on personnel evacuation of a fire scene of the passenger cabin, and analysis on a personnel evacuation strategy of the fire of the passenger cabin is completed. According to the invention, by analyzing the evacuation time difference and influence reasons of different strategies, the important fire protection areas are divided, the escape rate of the fire disaster in the passenger cabin is improved, and the life safety of personnel in the passenger cabin is protected.

title_en: Device and method for testing protective performance of chemical protective clothing of firefighter under deflagration condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for testing the protective performance of a fireman chemical protective suit under the condition of deflagration. The invention not only can test the air tightness in real time in the simulated actual deflagration environment, but also can test the impact of deflagration shock waves on human bodies through the dummy technology, thereby better evaluating the protective performance of the chemical protective clothing of the firefighter. According to the invention, propane gas is used as a combustion medium, pressure and flow sensors are arranged on the gas transmission pipeline, the gas quantity is controllable, and the remote control ignition is adopted, so that the accurate deflagration can be realized, and the safety is effectively ensured; the pressure release surface is arranged at the top of the test cabin, so that safety can be effectively ensured, and meanwhile, the test cabin can be reused, and test cost is reduced.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Railway debris flow early warning method based on fluid characteristics and collaborative monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway debris flow early warning method based on fluid characteristics and collaborative monitoring, which adopts a dynamic model to simulate a debris flow ditch needing monitoring and early warning; monitoring rainfall data and soil humidity data of a source area of the debris flow ditch, monitoring mud water data and infrasound vibration data of a circulation area of the debris flow ditch, and monitoring video data of a stacking area of the debris flow ditch; and triggering the first-stage early warning, the second-stage early warning and the third-stage early warning respectively according to the monitoring result. The method and the device are used for solving the problems that in the prior art, the coordination capability among the sensors is low, multistage early warning of mud-rock flow disasters along the railway cannot be realized, and the like in the mud-rock flow monitoring process along the railway, realizing the accuracy of mud-rock flow monitoring and early warning along the railway, reducing the false alarm rate and realizing the purpose of stage early warning.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU;CHINA RAILWAY ERYUAN ENG GROUP;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster simulation wall body with higher stability
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire disaster simulation wall body with higher stability, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein two vertical plates are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the fixed plate, two connecting plates are fixedly connected to one side surface of the two vertical plates, which is close to each other, and two wallboards are placed on the upper surface of the fixed plate. This device uses through the cooperation of fixed plate and mounting hole, play the effect of fixing and installing the fixed plate, the stability of fixed plate has been increased, through electric putter, the wallboard, spacing hole and slide bar's cooperation is used, play the effect that makes the wallboard carry out spacingly in the removal in-process, and utilize the guide way, the cooperation of guide block and joint board, reach the purpose that makes the wallboard more smooth and easy in the removal in-process, the flexibility of wall body has been increased, the effectual fire disaster simulation wall body stability of having solved is relatively poor, the phenomenon of toppling over takes place easily, the effect of fire disaster simulation exercise is not reached, the problem of fire disaster simulation wall body result of use has been reduced, and convenient popularization and use.

title_en: Residential building fire disaster overfire area prediction method, system, storage medium and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a storage medium and a device for predicting fire disaster area of residential building, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a fire disaster area prediction model of the residential building based on a fire disaster heat release rate and a ventilation control type combustion mode; the method comprises the steps of determining combustion parameters of an excessive fire area according to a fire excessive fire area prediction model, obtaining fire history data of the combustion parameters, determining probability distribution of the combustion parameters according to the fire history data, randomly sampling the probability distribution of the combustion parameters to obtain a plurality of groups of combustion parameters corresponding to different probabilities, performing Monte Carlo simulation to obtain excessive fire area cumulative probability distribution of a residential building based on the fire excessive fire area prediction model and the combustion parameters corresponding to the plurality of groups of different probabilities, and determining fire risk levels of the residential building according to the excessive fire area cumulative probability distribution. The invention can accurately predict the fire disaster area of the residential building and determine the fire disaster risk level so as to formulate effective fire disaster prevention and control measures.

title_en: Decision support system for building hydrogen infrastructure in railway site and support method using it
title_ko: 철도부지내 수소인프라 구축 의사결정 지원 시스템 및 이를 이용한 지원 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a decision-making support system for building a hydrogen infrastructure in a railway site and, more specifically, to a decision-making support system for building a hydrogen infrastructure in a railway site, which provides a customized SOP, measures, monitors and evaluates steps, and provides simulation training to provide rapid decision-making support and emergency response monitoring functions in case of emergency.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 철도부지내 수소인프라 구축 의사결정 지원 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 맞춤형 SOP 제공, 조치단계 감시 및 평가, 모의훈련 등의 제공으로 유사 시 신속한 의사결정 지원 및 비상 대응 감시 기능을 제공하는 철도부지내 수소인프라 구축 의사결정 지원 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method and system for determining safety risk protection distance of chemical industry park
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining a safety risk protection distance of a chemical industry park in the technical field of risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on geographic features of chemical industry parks and surrounding areas, a geographic statistical analysis method is adopted to carry out deep analysis on the spatial features of relief, building density and potential obstacle distribution, and a spatial feature analysis model is generated by combining GIS technology processing data. According to the invention, by adopting the geostatistical analysis, the probability theory and the statistical decision theory, the dynamics simulation algorithm, the computational fluid dynamics simulation, the Gao Siyu flow model, the Lagrange particle model, the Lyapunov stability analysis, the random forest and support vector machine algorithm, the self-adaptive control algorithm and the closed loop feedback control algorithm, the chemical reaction and material diffusion process can be simulated under the changing environmental conditions, the data and dynamic adjustment parameters can be monitored in real time, the real-time adjustment of the safety protection distance can be realized, and the emergency response capability for responding to sudden events can be enhanced.
assignees: JIANGXI WEICAN ENGINEERING TECH CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster prevention and reduction method for digital dynamic pump station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood disaster prevention and reduction method for a digital dynamic pump station, which comprises the following steps: drawing a flood numerical simulation area by using a polygonal tool based on ArcGIS software; acquiring initial terrain data, correcting by adopting an open geographic space and google images, and establishing a high-resolution hydrodynamic model based on a rectangular structural grid; acquiring rainfall data of an initial field of a flood numerical simulation area, namely, the water depth, the x-direction speed, the y-direction speed, the Manning coefficient and the flood numerical simulation area; taking into account varying environmental factors in inflow or outflow boundary conditions of the high resolution hydrodynamic model; correcting by combining google images based on geographical element data of buildings, roads and river channels to obtain land utilization types of flood numerical simulation areas; and constructing a hydrodynamic model frame comprehensively considering multi-source flood, infiltration and pipe network multi-process coupling, digitizing pump station information in the hydrodynamic model frame, and evaluating the key infrastructure according to a flood risk evaluation formula.
assignees: JIANGSU MARITIME INST;NANJING INST GEOGRAPHY & LIMNOLOGY CAS

title_en: Slope rock-soil body motion disaster simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a slope ground body motion disaster simulation experiment device, belong to geological disaster research technical field, can solve current experimental apparatus domatic governing angle little, can not carry out unified analysis to disaster starting mechanism, migration law, pile up the result, the cost of design high grade problem, including the matter source groove, the circulation groove, pile up plane and support, one side of support is equipped with water tank and water pump, the top inboard of support is equipped with a plurality of rainfall simulation shower nozzle, top one side of support is equipped with the motor, be equipped with wheeled adjustable support in the support, the water inlet of water pump is connected with the water tank through the pipeline, the delivery port has the shunt, the shunt is connected with rainfall simulation shower nozzle through the pipe, the one end of matter source groove is connected with the support through the sliding fixed block, the other end is connected with wheeled adjustable support through the sliding fixed block, the both ends of circulation groove are connected with wheeled adjustable support respectively, pile up planar one end and circulation groove are connected. By using the device, the experimental process can be completely simulated.

title_en: Experimental system and experimental method for simulating gradient load loading coal rock damage
abstract_en: The invention provides an experimental system and a method for simulating gradient load loading coal rock damage in the field of coal mine dynamic disaster safety experiments, wherein the experimental system comprises an experiment table, a sample, an x-axis loading device, a y-axis loading device, a z-axis loading device, an acrylic plate, a data acquisition instrument and an upper computer, wherein the sample is arranged on the experiment table and is of a cube structure; the x-axis loading device applies loading force in the x-axis direction to one side surface of the sample, the other side surface of the sample of the y-axis loading device applies loading force in the y-axis direction, and the z-axis loading device applies loading force in the z-axis direction to the top surface of the sample, wherein the structures of the x-axis loading device, the y-axis loading device and the z-axis loading device are identical, and the contact surfaces of the x-axis loading device, the y-axis loading device and the z-axis loading device with the sample are loading surfaces; the system and the method can overcome the defects of the traditional uniformly distributed loading experimental equipment and realize experimental simulation of coal and rock under the condition of underground real stress.

title_en: Three-dimensional inundation analysis algorithm design and implementation method based on WebGL
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional inundation analysis algorithm design and implementation method based on WebGL, which predicts the possible influence range and degree in the disaster flood process by adopting a river inundation simulation based on a GIS technology and adopting the GIS technology. By the mode, effective technical support can be provided for disaster early warning, forecasting, disaster relief and the like.
assignees: BEIJING GUOYAO XINTIANDI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Test device and method for simulating gradient load
abstract_en: The invention provides a test device and a test method for simulating gradient load in the field of coal mine dynamic disaster safety experiments. The top beam is arranged above the bottom plate through two supporting beams; the air inlet end of each longitudinal loading cylinder is connected with an air compressor, and an electric control valve is respectively arranged on a connecting pipeline of each longitudinal loading cylinder and the air compressor; the glass cavity is arranged on the bottom plate, the glass cavity is arranged below the loading device, the glass cavity is arranged between the two supporting beams, and a plurality of layers of coal strata are paved at the bottom in the cavity of the glass cavity; the glass separator is used for paving a plurality of layers of coal strata; the invention solves the problem that the accurate gradient load simulation cannot be realized in the existing test device.

title_en: Simulation fire disaster treatment exercise training system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulated fire disaster disposal exercise training system and a simulated fire disaster disposal exercise training method, which relate to the field of fire disaster exercise systems and comprise the following steps: the device comprises a central control module, a simulated combustion module and a simulated fire extinguishing module; the central control module is connected with the simulated combustion module and is used for controlling fire situation simulation of the simulated combustion module; the simulated fire extinguishing module is interacted with the simulated combustion module and is used for extinguishing the flame of the simulated combustion module. According to the invention, the fire scene and flame combustion effect are restored through the acousto-optic and electric technology, the initial fire extinguishing step is simulated, the set program is utilized to control the fire point spreading and the fire scene developing process, and corresponding effect rendering is started according to the success/failure of fire extinguishing, so that the indoor or high-rise escape experience is guided, the sense of reality is strong, the multi-ginseng and training efficiency is high, and the emergency treatment skills and comprehensive safety quality of the drilling personnel are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU SHIPING SAFETY TECH CO LTD;LONG SIYU

title_en: HAZOP knowledge graph construction method and system based on text mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a HAZOP knowledge graph based on text mining. Comprising the following steps: training to obtain an equipment information extraction model for extracting equipment entity information according to the text data in the HSE field; extracting corresponding equipment information from the HAZOP report according to the equipment information extraction model; and constructing a unified HAZOP knowledge graph structure based on the equipment information and the HAZOP analysis record table. The method can reduce data redundancy, improve the effectiveness and uniqueness of each piece of data, improve the utilization rate of data storage resources, form a HAZOP analysis knowledge graph with comprehensive content, realize shared multiplexing, be favorable for improving analysis efficiency and analysis report quality, assist safety risk management and control personnel of enterprises, rapidly make emergency response to process deviation through the HAZOP knowledge graph, prevent and solve major risks, timely eliminate potential safety hazards, and realize accident prevention and risk early warning.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;RES INST SAFETY & ENV TECH CO LTD CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP

title_en: Fire detection method and system based on multi-sensor data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire detection method and a fire detection system based on multi-sensor data fusion, wherein the fire detection method comprises the following steps: establishing a simulated three-dimensional model of a residential building of an old community, performing indoor ignition simulation, arranging sensors in a room and a corridor according to a fire spreading rule, and establishing a routing node degree model; obtaining the optimal layout of the sensor based on the routing node degree model and the distance irrelevant positioning algorithm, and constructing a sensor network; carrying out standardized processing on data acquired by a sensor network, and deleting error data with insufficient confidence coefficient; and carrying out preliminary fusion on the fire detection system by utilizing a self-adaptive distributed Kalman filter algorithm and combining data of a plurality of Kalman filters to obtain optimal fusion data, and carrying out decision fusion by utilizing a fuzzy Bayesian logic reasoning algorithm to carry out anti-fuzzification processing to obtain an output value to judge the occurrence of the fire. The invention aims to provide the fire disaster detection system with high accuracy and a real-time detection function, which is used for fire disaster detection in the environment of old communities.

title_en: Physical simulation test device for inducing landslide hazard under deep fault disturbance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical simulation test device for inducing landslide disasters under deep fault disturbance, and particularly relates to the technical field of geological disaster research. According to the physical simulation test device for inducing landslide disasters under deep fault disturbance, disclosed by the invention, the soil body is lifted at a set angle and a set speed by pushing the upper plate through the lifter through guiding by the lateral guiding device and the bottom guiding device, so that fault dislocation is simulated to trigger the upper covering soil body to break, fault deformation and damage movement processes in the soil body can be accurately reproduced, the relevant characteristics of ground deep fault movement to produce ground vibration are met, a new solution way is provided for the formation mechanism research of landslide, collapse and other geological disasters under complex geological environment conditions, and the blank in the current research is filled.

title_en: Singlechip design system for nuclear power reactor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear power reactor control systems, in particular to a singlechip design system for a nuclear power reactor, the system comprises a deep learning optimization module, a performance monitoring and adjusting module, a risk assessment and management module, an abnormality detection and response module, a simulation training and strategy development module, a data integration and analysis module, an energy management and optimization module and an intelligent control and automation module. In the invention, the deep learning is combined with the convolutional neural network and the recurrent neural network to perform data analysis and pattern recognition, so that the efficiency and the safety are improved, the capability of the system for coping with environmental changes is enhanced by real-time monitoring and self-adaptive control, the system is flexible and efficient in performance adjustment, the risk is reduced by the Bayesian network and the decision tree, the steady operation is ensured by anomaly detection and emergency response, the comprehensive information support is provided by data integration and deep analysis, the energy use efficiency is improved by energy analysis and efficiency optimization, and the operation efficiency and the stability of the system are improved by intelligent control and automation.

title_en: Special positive side direction large hammer knocker for fire control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special forward and lateral large hammer knocker for fire control, and relates to the field of physical training of firefighters. The utility model comprises a main frame body, wherein an adjusting mechanism and an extending mechanism are arranged in the main frame body, when the training is carried out, if the lateral hammering training with different angles is required, the handles on the hand shaking seat can be held by two hands, then the hand shaking seat is started, the screw rod can be rotated by the hand shaking seat, the pushing block can move back and forth on the screw rod in the rotating process of the screw rod, the lower sliding block can be driven by the supporting rod to move in the moving process of the pushing block, the supporting frame can be supported and fixed by the bolts, then the extending plate is supported, then a training person can stand on the extending plate to vertically knock the knocking block for training, and through the arrangement, the special positive lateral hammer for the fire fighting can be quickly adjusted, so that the aim of carrying out multiple training on one device is achieved.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;NANJING KUNBAO SAFETY PROT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Infrastructure resilience evaluation system, infrastructure resilience evaluation method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an infrastructure resilience evaluation system capable of more substantially evaluating a state of an infrastructure when a disaster or an accident has occurred.SOLUTION: An infrastructure resilience evaluation system according to an embodiment includes: a data storage unit which stores facility data, simulation condition data, and importance rank data; a model creation unit which creates a simulation model on the basis of the facility data; a failure setting unit which sets a failure condition of an operation facility by using a recent operation data indicating a recent operation state of an operation facility which is actually operating among a plurality of types of facilities, and adds the set failure condition to the simulation model; an operation predicting unit which predicts an operation state of the operation facility by using the simulation model, the simulation condition data, and the failure condition; and an evaluation unit which evaluates an influence level to an incident where the operation of the operation facility cannot be maintained by using the prediction result of the operation state, and the importance rank data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: Method for constructing precipitation model in tropical cyclone process for disaster risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a tropical cyclone process precipitation model for disaster risk assessment, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting and sorting historical data sets; s2, establishing a tropical cyclone process precipitation parameterized model V1 which does not consider single typhoon process precipitation, and dividing two parameterized schemes of symmetrical typhoon precipitation and asymmetrical typhoon precipitation; s3, calculating precipitation Rain1 in a typhoon simulating process in a historical period; s4, establishing a tropical cyclone process precipitation parameterized model V2 considering single typhoon process precipitation; the method solves the problems that the existing typhoon precipitation parameterized model commonly has serious underestimation of single typhoon process precipitation, restricts the application of the model in extreme typhoon storm flood simulation and is not beneficial to the development of disaster prevention and reduction work.
assignees: SHANGHAI INSTITUTE OF TYPHOON RES CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION SHANGHAI METEOROLOGICAL SCIENC

title_en: Fire-fighting teaching training method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire control teaching training method, which comprises the following steps: s1: the teacher creates a room through the teacher end, selects courseware and sets a password at the same time; s2: the student logs in identity information through an information input module on the student side and inputs a password to enter a room; s3: and the teacher starts teaching and training after selecting a training scene through the teacher end, and collects various data. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: by acquiring time parameters and behavior parameters of each student during simulated sudden fire, and acquiring escape evacuation training effect coefficients and environment escape training effect coefficients according to the time parameters and the behavior parameters, the effect of building escape evacuation training in firefighting education training is evaluated from multiple dimensions, so that the evaluation result is more comprehensive, and compared with written teaching, the reliability and the action normalization are improved.
assignees: SHENGJIE FIRE FIGHTING TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Hydrologic disaster prediction device and method based on progressive neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses a hydrological disaster prediction device and method based on a progressive neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring geographical position and altitude information of a river from a source to a river levee; s2, acquiring key hydrologic topography data of the front edge of the river levee; s3, acquiring a characteristic value of the river levee; s4, based on the characteristic information acquired in the S1, the S2 and the S3, carrying out data acquisition by utilizing a hydrologic disaster prediction device, and constructing and training a preamble progressive neural network based on a full-range data source; s5, constructing a regional self-adaptive gradient network to quickly adapt to a new regional river dike deployed by the hydrologic disaster prediction device; and S6, deploying the preamble progressive neural network, and acquiring river levee data of a new area by utilizing a hydrological disaster prediction device to train and deploy the area self-adaptive gradient network. The technical scheme of the application can monitor the geographic and physical changes of the river in real time, dynamically integrate multidimensional hydrologic data and provide an accurate personalized hydrologic disaster risk prediction result.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INST OF HYDROLOGY AND WATER RESOURCES SCIENCES

title_en: Weather data analysis method and system for agricultural production state monitoring
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a meteorological data analysis method and a system for monitoring agricultural production states, which are characterized in that agricultural production configuration data corresponding to a farmland risk area and target climate monitoring data corresponding to a first agricultural production unit are obtained, target candidate disaster influence parameters corresponding to a target candidate cultivation strategy are determined according to a basic agricultural disaster risk prediction network, and target training disaster influence parameters corresponding to the cultivation strategy are obtained. Then, according to the difference between the two parameters, updating the network parameter information of the agricultural disaster risk prediction network to generate a new agricultural disaster risk prediction network. Thus, the target disaster influence parameters corresponding to the target cultivation strategy can be predicted according to the input agricultural production data and the climate monitoring data. Therefore, the possible disaster risk in the agricultural production and the effect of the corresponding cultivation strategy can be effectively predicted, disaster prevention and control preparation can be carried out in advance in the agricultural production process, and the loss caused by disasters is reduced.

title_en: Railway disaster risk prevention and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway disaster risk prevention and control method and a system, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster risk early warning and acquire real-time meteorological disaster data and image data of railway monitoring points; displaying the state of the railway monitoring point, the risk value and the early warning information after disaster simulation evaluation; performing risk assessment and deduction prediction on railway disasters based on the monitoring data to obtain risk classification states of monitoring points and disaster follow-up development information; and pushing corresponding strategies according to the risk states of the monitoring points, performing strategy previewing and efficiency previewing on different pushed prevention and control or emergency strategies to obtain an optimal strategy for risk prevention and control, and guiding and optimizing emergency resource deployment. The invention applies digital twinning, and the Internet of things, state information, algorithm model, simulation deduction and the like form effective monitoring, simulation and prediction on physical entities through virtual-real data interaction, thereby realizing the functions of super-real-time state sensing and automatic emergency response linkage, and having good application and popularization values.

title_en: Construction method of triangular debris flow impact-resistant blocking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a triangular debris flow impact-resistant blocking device, which belongs to the technical field of debris flow protection and comprises the following steps: s1, excavating and drilling a foundation pit; s2, pouring concrete piles, constructing connecting beams and inclined supports; s3, filling stones; s4, subsequent checking and maintenance. The construction method of the triangular debris flow impact-resistant blocking device is simple in construction, high in efficiency and short in construction period, a stable triangular structure is formed by the concrete piles and the connecting beams, the inclined support is installed, the impact resistance of the blocking device is enhanced, the stability is good, the installation and the maintenance are easy, and when a debris flow disaster occurs, stones and sediment in the debris flow can be effectively blocked, water flow is discharged, and the safety of a downstream area is protected.

title_en: Method for establishing fire rescue prediction model, fire rescue method and related device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for establishing a fire-fighting rescue prediction model, a fire-fighting rescue method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue of fire-fighting rescue teams, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a firefighting rescue prediction model based on a graph neural network, and defining input and output of the firefighting rescue prediction model; defining a position prediction method of the individual fire fighters as X  (t)：(t+T) ＝f[X (t‑s)：t , G ]; obtaining a plurality of groups of predicted values by using a position prediction method of the individual fire fighters; based on the obtained multiple groups of predicted values and the real values corresponding to the multiple groups of predicted values, taking the L-loss function as a training target, and training the established firefighting rescue prediction model. The invention introduces the graphic neural network into the application field of search and rescue and navigation of individual firefighters, uses the topological structure of the on-site command combat network and the network node RSRP as reference factors to infer the potential positions of the individual firefighters, and realizes search and rescue and evacuation prediction of the individual firefighters on site.
assignees: JIANGSU YOUXIONG SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-earthquake fire spreading simulation method and device considering building collapse
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of computers, in particular to a post-earthquake fire spread simulation method and device considering building collapse, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a geometric model of a target building group, and performing earthquake collapse simulation on the geometric model to obtain building group earthquake loss form data; importing the building group earthquake damage form data into a fire disaster numerical simulation platform to obtain a post-earthquake building group numerical model; and carrying out sparse grid division considering the height on the post-earthquake building group numerical model, and carrying out post-earthquake fire spread simulation sparse grid acceleration calculation on the building group based on the large vortex simulation and parallel calculation theory to obtain a post-earthquake fire spread simulation result. The method can fully consider the influence of post-earthquake collapse of the building on the spread of the secondary fire, improves the reliability and accuracy of analysis results of the spread of the secondary fire of the post-earthquake urban building group, improves the calculation efficiency of post-earthquake fire simulation, and can provide important support for urban comprehensive disaster prevention planning and emergency planning.

title_en: Regional landslide risk assessment method based on LSTM network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an area landslide risk assessment method based on an LSTM network, which comprises the following steps: based on the data of the terrains, rainfall and land types, extracting landslide characteristic factors closely related to landslide, and constructing a landslide disaster database by combining historical landslide data and selected non-landslide data; carrying out normalization processing on the landslide hazard database, and dividing a training set and a testing set; constructing an LSTM model, and adjusting and optimizing model super-parameters; verifying a model by using the landslide feature factors of the test set, and predicting the regional landslide hazard based on the constructed model; and constructing a landslide hazard risk assessment method system based on the regional landslide hazard and vulnerability data to realize regional potential landslide hazard risk assessment. The landslide risk level evaluation method based on the fuzzy logic is capable of accurately evaluating the landslide risk level in the specific area, and has important significance in optimizing land utilization planning, making landslide disaster emergency plans and the like.

title_en: Ground disaster monitoring equipment regulation and control method and system based on rainfall prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, in particular to a method and a system for regulating and controlling ground disaster monitoring equipment based on rainfall prediction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a basic data source with a time stamp in a monitoring area; dividing the underlying data source into a plurality of training data samples based on timing; wherein each of the training data samples has a plurality of training subsamples; inputting training data samples into a preset LSTM training assembly for training to obtain a rainfall probability prediction model; acquiring an instant data source of a monitoring area, sorting the instant data source to obtain predicted sample data, and inputting the predicted sample data into the rainfall probability prediction model to obtain the current rainfall probability; and regulating and controlling the start and stop of the ground disaster monitoring equipment based on the data size of the current rainfall probability. According to the invention, by predicting rainfall more accurately and controlling the start and stop of the ground disaster equipment according to the rainfall probability, dynamic regulation and control are realized, and the ground disaster monitoring data are collected more intelligently and more energy-saving.

title_en: Dangerous gas on-line monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous gas on-line monitoring system and method, and belongs to the technical field of gas monitoring. In order to solve the problems that the lack of an effective early warning and response mechanism and the incapability of providing effective evacuation guidance in emergency result in personnel evacuation confusion and panic, a real-time monitoring module compares the concentration of dangerous gas with a preset safety threshold value, once the dangerous gas is found to leak, dangerous marks can be immediately carried out, an alarm is triggered through the dangerous early warning module, the timely early warning and response mechanism is helpful for reducing the possibility of accidents, the evacuation guidance module can simulate the layout of a monitoring area, forecast the trend and range of dangerous gas diffusion, plan a safe evacuation route based on the forecast result, provide scientific basis for personnel evacuation in emergency, help reduce personnel casualties, and the system can adjust and update the evacuation route in real time by continuously receiving data in a gas diffusion forecast unit so as to adapt to the continuously-changed dangerous situation.
assignees: ZHONGKAIDA ELECTRONIC TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine water disaster optimal escape path searching method based on individual characteristics
abstract_en: In order to enable mine flood rescue to have better adaptability, the invention combines the influence of water level height and water flow rate on human stability, provides a calculation method of water level influence factors, water speed influence factors and physical influence factors, synthesizes the body conditions of water damage trapped personnel, establishes a mine flood escape model based on human body characteristics, and provides a coal mine water damage optimal escape path searching method based on individual characteristics. Simulation results show that the invention can make more accurate escape or rescue schemes aiming at different physical conditions of trapped people, and fully exert the traffic capacity of a roadway system.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM;YUNCHENG POLYTECHNIC UNIV

title_en: Machine learning-based flood rapid forecasting method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a machine learning-based rapid flood forecasting method and system, and relates to the technical field of real-time flood disaster forecasting. According to the method, a hydrologic hydrodynamic coupling model is constructed, and the submerged area and the non-submerged area are judged by a preset water depth threshold value based on the hydrologic hydrodynamic model to simulate the storm submerged conditions under different storm reproduction periods and rains. In addition, the invention obtains the optimal flood forecast model and the optimal water depth forecast model by constructing, and rapidly calculates the submerged range, submerged water depth and submerged evolution condition of each grid. Compared with the prior art that a large number of models are required to be built by predicting a plurality of space points by utilizing single variable output of a neural network model, the CNN model built by the invention can consider the space correlation of a plurality of grid points, has higher prediction precision and efficiency, overcomes the characteristic of long calculation time consumption of a hydrologic hydrodynamic model, and can rapidly output a prediction result.

title_en: Method for calculating residual bearing capacity and residual bending stiffness of rusted beam after fire disaster
abstract_en: A method for calculating residual bearing capacity and residual bending rigidity of a rusted beam after a fire disaster relates to the technical field of mechanical property evaluation after the fire disaster of the beam, and comprises the following steps: step 1, fire test; step2, numerical simulation; and 3, evaluating the residual mechanical properties of the rust-resistant beam after the fire disaster. The method establishes a simplified calculation method of the residual bending rigidity and the residual bearing capacity of the rusted reinforced concrete beam after a fire disaster, and comprehensively considers the influences of the tensile longitudinal reinforcement corrosion rate, the fire time and the thickness of the concrete protective layer on the residual bending rigidity and the residual bearing capacity of the rusted reinforced concrete beam after the fire disaster. By the calculation method, the residual bending rigidity and the residual bearing capacity of the rusted beam after the fire disaster can be obtained only by acquiring the fire time of the test piece, the thickness of the concrete protective layer and the rusting rate of the tensile longitudinal bar in the actual engineering.

title_en: Mathematical model auxiliary control method based on A2O biological pond technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological data processing, in particular to a mathematical model auxiliary control method based on an A2O biological pond technology. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring process data of an A2O biological pond; carrying out data preprocessing on the A2O biological pool process data to generate standard A2O biological pool process data; carrying out dynamic data analysis on the standard A2OP biological pool process data to generate A2O biological pool dynamic change data; acquiring biological pond industrial environment sensing data through a sensor; inputting the dynamic change data of the A2O biological pool into a mathematical model of a preset A2O biological pool process for simulation calculation to obtain initial output parameters of the A2O biological pool. According to the invention, the abnormal data in the mathematical model is associated with the sensor to carry out local resampling to replace the abnormal data, and different emergency transmission channels are constructed, so that the instantaneity, the operation simplicity and the emergency response of the mathematical model are improved.
assignees: QINGDAO HAIWAN RECLAIMED WATER CO LTD

title_en: Prevention scheduling method and system for differential load shedding under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preventive scheduling method and a preventive scheduling system for differential cut loads in extreme weather, which relate to the technical field of power system scheduling operation and planning and comprise the steps of using simulation to analyze typhoon key parameters so as to acquire real-time wind speed of typhoons at specific positions and calculate fault probability; determining a functional relation between the busbar load shedding amount and the load shedding loss according to the load importance degree and the power failure loss historical data; based on a functional relation, start-stop, output rescheduling and differential load shedding, constructing a multi-type power supply collaborative operation optimization model considering the load importance degree under typhoon extreme weather; the method solves the optimal scheme by using a commercial solver or a branch-and-bound algorithm to obtain the minimum disaster-affected scheme in the typhoon scene, considers the influence of typhoon weather on safe and stable power supply of the power system and different importance degrees of loads, and reduces disaster loss caused by typhoon under the condition that load shedding cannot be avoided.

title_en: Scene heavy rain transplanting method based on historical precipitation frequency matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scene storm transplanting method based on history precipitation frequency matching, which belongs to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction of watersheds and comprises the following steps of mapping rainfall sites of history scene storm to transplanting areas; searching mapping sites around the transplanting sites; calculating a precipitation frequency curve of the mapping station; calculating the frequency corresponding to the average precipitation amount of the mapping station; calculating a precipitation frequency curve of the transplanting site; the graft precipitation amount was calculated based on the same frequency. According to the method, not only is the space distribution change of precipitation considered in the process of storm transplantation, but also the precipitation characteristics and the precipitation intensity difference caused by climate differences and topography differences are considered, so that the history scene storm transplantation simulation is closer to the local precipitation condition, the flood early warning, flood prevention and disaster reduction of a flow field are of more practical significance, and the risk awareness and the bottom line thinking of flood and drought disaster prevention work are reflected.
assignees: HUAIHE RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION HYDROLOGY BUREAU INFORMATION CENTER

title_en: Meteorological and natural disaster early warning management system and method based on new energy of Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meteorological and natural disaster early warning management system and method based on new energy of the Internet of things, comprising a system management module, a data collection module, a data transmission module, an intelligent network simulation module, a new energy and disaster risk assessment module and a meteorological service module, wherein the system management module is used for comprehensively managing a system; the data collection module is used for collecting climate parameters; the data transmission module is used for transmitting climate parameters; the intelligent network simulation module is used for collecting and simulating regional climate; the new energy and disaster risk assessment module is used for assessing the utilization effect and the danger degree of the regional climate; the weather service module is used for running weather service. According to the invention, external information resources are effectively integrated through multiple channels, so that simulation and evaluation are further performed, and early warning is sent out.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD YANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Water flow prediction method and system after barrier lake burst
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of barrier lakes, and particularly discloses a method and a system for predicting water flow after barrier lake burst. According to the embodiment of the invention, the basic information, the hydrographic meteorological data, the real-time monitoring data and the historical event data of the barrier lake are obtained by collecting and arranging the data; establishing and verifying a model to generate a barrier lake simulation model; carrying out water flow prediction after the burst, and recording burst prediction information; and carrying out disaster evaluation on the burst prediction information, and carrying out corresponding level early warning processing according to a disaster evaluation result. The method can collect and sort data, establish and verify a barrier lake simulation model, input real-time monitoring data into the barrier lake simulation model, automatically predict water flow after burst, evaluate disaster according to burst prediction information, and perform corresponding level early warning according to disaster evaluation results, so that accuracy of water flow change prediction after burst of the barrier lake and accuracy of classified disaster early warning can be effectively improved.
assignees: CHINA ANNENG GROUP SECOND ENG BUREAU CO LTD;CHINA ANNENG CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention and control monitoring equipment for geological disaster management
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, in particular to disaster prevention and control monitoring equipment for geological disaster management, which comprises a base, wherein a support frame is arranged at the top of the base, a support mechanism is arranged at the top of the base and positioned in front of the support frame, a solar photovoltaic panel is arranged at the top of the support mechanism, a fixing mechanism is arranged at the top of the support frame, lifting columns are arranged between the support frame and the base, and the lifting columns are connected with two groups of positioning drills through the lifting plates; the fixing mechanism comprises a fixing frame, the upper side and the lower side of the fixing frame are fixedly connected with baffle plates, the upper side and the lower side of the fixing frame and the inside of the two groups of baffle plates are fixedly provided with ventilation nets, mounting grooves are formed between the fixing frame and the two groups of baffle plates, and clamping grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the top of the fixing frame.

title_en: Voice command with emergency response
abstract_en: A method triggers a user-definable emergency response in a voice-command based authentication system. The method receives gestures on a mobile device, and provides an interface at the mobile device to trigger an automatic interaction with an artificial intelligence (“AI”) engine stored on the mobile device. The AI accesses a database for storing legacy information associated with the caller and runs an application program interface that provides the AI engine access to the legacy information. The AI engine receives the gestures generated by the caller, accesses the database storing legacy information generated by the caller and constructs an emergency profile of the caller. The emergency profile may be based on the legacy information, a machine learning model; and/or a user training session that initializes an emergency response signal threshold level. When the gestures exceed the emergency response signal threshold level, the method may generate the emergency response.

title_en: Augmented reality clinical simulation system and method for emergency response training
title_ko: 응급상황 대처 실습을 위한 증강현실 임상시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an augmented reality clinical simulation system and method for emergency response training. An augmented reality clinical simulation system for emergency response training according to one aspect of the present invention comprises: a patient device for training in which a patient condition is set; one or more trainee devices which are worn by trainees and output treatment guide information according to the patient condition in augmented reality; one or more medical support devices; and a central control device which sets the patient condition and provides the trainee devices with the treatment guide information, and which identifies the medical support devices and enables medical information or virtual medical equipment to be checked in augmented reality using the trainee devices so as to correspond to the medical support devices.
abstract_ko: 응급상황 대처 실습을 위한 증강현실 임상시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일측면에 따른 응급상황 대처 실습을 위한 증강현실 임상시뮬레이션 시스템은, 환자상태가 설정되는 실습용 환자장치; 실습자가 착용하여 환자상태에 따른 치료가이드정보를 증강현실로 출력하는 하나 이상의 실습자장치; 하나 이상의 의료보조장치; 및 환자상태를 설정하고, 실습자장치로 치료가이드정보를 제공하되, 의료보조장치를 식별하여 상응하는 의료정보 또는 가상의료장비를 의료보조장치에 대응되도록 실습자장치에서 증강현실로 확인할 수 있도록 처리하는 중앙제어장치를 포함한다. [대표도] 도 1
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND;NGARDEN CO LTD

title_en: Geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control, which relates to the technical field of geological exploration and comprises a base, wherein a base column is arranged at the top of the base, a bearing ring is rotationally connected to the base, a plurality of collecting cylinders are arranged on the bearing ring, a rotating assembly is arranged in the base and used for controlling the bearing ring to rotate, a top plate is arranged at the top of the base column, a first hydraulic telescopic rod is arranged in the base column and fixedly connected with one end of the top plate, a second hydraulic telescopic rod is arranged on the top plate, and a drill bit component is fixedly connected to the bottom of the second hydraulic telescopic rod.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCESNO 801 HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENG GEOLOGICAL BRIGA

title_en: Remote sensing satellite geological disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to a remote sensing satellite geological disaster early warning method. According to the invention, the accuracy of geological risk prediction is improved by analyzing various geological features, the understanding of soil erosion mechanism and landslide risk is improved by simulating water-soil interaction, the effectiveness of disaster early warning is optimized, the identification capacity of landslide areas is enhanced by comparing with historical data patterns, the disaster spatial association information is analyzed, the disaster diffusion trend prediction and risk level adjustment are optimized, the dynamic update of real-time disaster risk assessment and disaster risk monitoring is combined, the timeliness and accuracy of early warning information are improved, and comprehensive technical support is provided for geological disaster early warning.
assignees: TAIAN JINTUDI SURVEYING AND MAPPING CO LTD

title_en: Disaster metadata automatic matching method and system based on word2vec model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction, and discloses a disaster metadata automatic matching method and system based on a word2vec model, which specifically comprises the following steps of natural disaster metadata acquisition and preprocessing, wherein a CBOW architecture of the word2vec model is adopted to perform model training on a LCQMC corpus; and the metadata extraction, word segmentation, word vector conversion and the calculation of cosine distances among word vectors, wherein if the calculated cosine distances among the word vectors are larger than the confidence threshold, the metadata is judged to be matched, and the matching result is evaluated to ensure the integrity, consistency and accuracy of the matching result. The disaster metadata automatic matching method provided by the invention has the advantages that the disaster metadata processing efficiency is higher, so that the timeliness and accuracy of disaster response are enhanced.

title_en: Method for constructing coal mine environment disaster simulation visual management and control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a coal mine environment disaster simulation visual management and control system, which belongs to the technical field of coal mine disaster prevention and comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a knowledge graph in the field of safety monitoring systems; s2: establishing a coal mine disaster simulation model based on a knowledge graph; s3: and establishing a disaster emergency linkage response control strategy library. The invention discloses fusion display of disaster monitoring, anomaly analysis, emergency plan and other data on a GIS image; the two-dimensional GIS service is adopted to realize the simulation of the spreading and diffusion of main disasters of the mine, and the automatic planning of the disaster avoidance route of underground personnel is realized based on the equivalent length of the roadway and the shortest path dynamic planning algorithm; the linkage control of underground emergency equipment when disaster events occur is realized.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Working method of emergency rescue virtual exercise behavior and data acquisition equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency rescue virtual exercise behavior working method and data acquisition equipment thereof, and relates to the field of emergency rescue virtual exercises. The working method based on the emergency rescue virtual exercise and the data acquisition equipment thereof comprise the steps of S1, creating a highly-vivid virtual environment or a common virtual environment, and simulating real disaster scenes of earthquakes, fires or floods through the environment, wherein the virtual environment comprises visual and sound effects. Through the construction of materialized virtual environment, reinforcing sensor function, introduce the camera and the motion sensor of olfactory simulation, automatic calibration function, further promoted the sense of reality, accuracy and the comprehensiveness of training, help more accurately simulate real scene, provide more effective training experience, integrated multiple sensor, high accuracy GPS, high definition digtal camera, physiology monitoring sensor etc. make it can collect key data under emergency comprehensively, not only help evaluating the scene condition effectively fast, can also improve the security and the efficiency of rescue action.

title_en: Method for dynamically simulating dam break flow fluid pressure based on B spline object particle method particle smooth density
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for dynamically simulating dam break flow fluid pressure based on a B-spline object particle method particle smooth density, which comprises the following steps: mapping the mass and momentum of the substance point particles to a tensor grid space through a 3-time B spline basis function, and calculating the mass and momentum of tensor grid nodes, the internal force of the tensor grid nodes and the speed and acceleration of the tensor grid nodes; and mapping the calculation results to the material points respectively, updating, calculating the strain increment and the mass weighted density of the material point particles, setting the material point particle density to zero, judging whether the calculation result needs to be output, and judging whether the calculation is completed or ended according to the related material information of the required material point particles. According to the invention, the smooth density of material point particles is introduced on the B-spline material point particle method, so that the dam-break flow fluid pressure can be accurately simulated, the real-time evolution of the dam-break flow can be rapidly predicted, the calculation accuracy and the calculation efficiency are high, and a theoretical basis is provided for the disaster prediction and the protection structure design of the dam-break flow.

title_en: Coal mine gas concentration prediction method and system based on improved LSTM
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mine safety production and disaster early warning, in particular to a coal mine gas concentration prediction method and system based on improved LSTM, comprising the following steps: acquiring coal mine gas monitoring data, and preprocessing the acquired coal mine gas monitoring data; improving the LSTM model by using a differential evolution algorithm; inputting the pretreated coal mine gas monitoring data into an improved LSTM model for training; and predicting the gas concentration by using the trained LSTM model. According to the coal mine gas concentration prediction method and system based on the improved LSTM, the LSTM model is improved by adding the Differential Evolution (DE) algorithm, and the acquired data are input into the trained LSTM model to conduct gas concentration prediction, so that the method and system have a faster training speed when predicting concentration, and the optimal parameters are simpler to find.
assignees: EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE COAL INFORMATION INSTITUTE;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Aviation forest fire image recognition method based on self-attention mechanism
