abstract_en: The invention discloses an aviation forest fire image recognition method based on a self-attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps of: collecting forest fire video data through an unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a sample data set through data preprocessing, and dividing the sample data set into a training set and a testing set according to a proportion; 10 layers ViT are selected as a backbone network to construct an aviation forest fire image recognition model, an aviation forest fire image in a training set is serially unfolded in an overlapping sliding window mode, and position information is embedded and then used as input of a layer 1 ViT; extracting the region selection module of the first 9 layers ViT by embedding the 10 th layer ViT in batches through a multi-head self-attention and multi-layer perceptron mechanism; and adopting a contrast characteristic learning strategy, constructing a target loss function to train and optimize the aviation forest fire image recognition model, and evaluating the performance of the model through a test set. The invention has better generalization capability and robustness, and has important significance for improving the handling capability and efficiency of fire disaster and preventing forest fire.

title_en: Design method and evaluation method of flood control and disaster reduction dam system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method and an evaluation method of a flood control and disaster reduction dam system, which take a research river basin as a whole, calculate the flood control and disaster reduction effect of the flood control and disaster reduction dam system formed by a plurality of flood control and disaster reduction dams in the whole research river basin through the simulation of a continuous system, optimize the dam addresses and the number of the flood control and disaster reduction dams in the whole research river basin, achieve the optimal flood control and disaster reduction effect with the lowest economic cost, and provide a scientific design method of the flood control and disaster reduction dams in the scientific research river basin. Meanwhile, the flood control and disaster reduction dam system is taken as a unit, the flood process in the whole flow area is simulated, the flood control benefits of a plurality of flood control and disaster reduction dams are quantitatively and scientifically evaluated, and meanwhile, reliable data basis is provided for scientific flood control and disaster reduction.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER ENGINEERING CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake-induced geological disaster rapid prediction system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid prediction system and a rapid prediction method for earthquake-induced geological disasters, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition and management module, a rapid prediction module, an accurate prediction module and an information release module; wherein: the data acquisition and management module is used for acquiring and managing seismic data and disaster data; the rapid prediction module is used for acquiring ground peak acceleration according to the seismic data and carrying out geological disaster prediction evaluation based on the ground peak acceleration; the accurate prediction module is used for predicting and evaluating geological disasters according to the ground peak acceleration and intensity of the seismic data and based on the ground peak acceleration and intensity; the information release module is used for releasing a quick predictive evaluation result and/or an accurate predictive evaluation result. According to the invention, earthquake monitoring, earthquake parameter acquisition and simulation, machine learning model establishment and prediction information release can be completed in one set of system, so that the time and labor consumed by software interaction in conventional prediction are reduced, and the prediction efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Water conservancy planning construction assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy management, in particular to a water conservancy planning construction evaluation method and system, comprising the following steps: based on global climate model data, adopting a data processing algorithm to perform data normalization and outlier processing, integrating and cleaning data, providing a standardized input format for a hydrologic model, and generating a climate data set. According to the invention, through the combination of the SWAT and HEC-RAS models, the accuracy of flood simulation is improved, so that flood risk assessment is more accurate, the judgment of a flood influence area is more visual, the risk assessment is more comprehensive, the fusion of multi-criterion decision analysis and a machine learning algorithm is provided, scientific basis is provided for optimization of flood control and disaster reduction strategies, the efficiency and effect of decision are obviously improved, the use of simulated annealing and particle swarm optimization algorithms are realized, the construction scheduling and resource allocation are optimized, and the flexibility and response speed of project management are improved.

title_en: Digital processing method and system applied to field geological disaster investigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital processing method and a digital processing system applied to field geological disaster investigation, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster investigation. Compared with the traditional limited sampling points and manual acquisition, the method ensures the comprehensiveness and the authenticity of the geological information and provides reliable data support for subsequent analysis and evaluation. The digital processing method integrates the first geological database by using the GIS technology, creates a digital geological disaster model, and simulates different geological disaster processes by using a numerical simulation technology. The digital processing method fully considers the interrelationship of geological factors, environmental factors and human factors through comprehensive risk calculation, including soil erosion coefficients Trx, vegetation coverage coefficients Zfg, regional landslide coefficients Qpx, environment risk coefficients Hjx and construction risk coefficients Hdx, so that the geological risk assessment is more comprehensive and accurate.
assignees: BEIJING INST OF GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION

title_en: Technology for safely sealing fire area of underground high-gas working face of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to an safety production technology in the coal industry, in particular to a technology for safely sealing a fire area of a high-gas working face in a coal mine. Firstly, constructing an air inlet seal of a working surface, then injecting large-flow nitrogen into the air inlet seal to reduce the oxygen concentration in a zone to below 12%, inerting a fire zone, and then sealing a return air seal; the specific method comprises the following steps: 1. pre-burying a nitrogen injection pipeline on a high-gas working surface, and vaporizing liquid nitrogen into nitrogen by a vaporizing device; 2. and 3, completely filling the bracket tail beams of the fire disaster area with the bagged perlite to the upright posts, and completely extinguishing fire by adopting large-diameter drilling water injection and stopping agent, wherein after nitrogen is injected into the closed area at a large flow rate, a drill rod is not pulled out, and a large flow of water is directly injected by using the drill rod, so that the fire is extinguished completely. The possibility of fire disaster caused by exceeding gas underground is restrained by adopting different methods, and a large amount of nitrogen is mainly injected into a fire area sealed by a high gas working surface, so that when the fire disaster occurs in a mine, the fire extinguishing time is short, the operation is safe and reliable, the fire extinguishing effect is good, and the manpower and material resources are saved.
assignees: HUATING COAL GROUP CO LTD;FUXIN XINJI COAL MINE SCIENCE AND TECH INSTITUTE

title_en: High-proportion renewable energy system toughness improving method considering frequency stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving toughness of a high-proportion renewable energy system by considering frequency stability, which belongs to the technical field of power system optimization and comprises the following steps: constructing a frequency stability safety constraint of a high-proportion renewable energy system considering mobile energy storage; constructing a pre-disaster two-stage prevention control model by taking frequency stability safety constraint as a boundary condition; taking the frequency stability safety constraint as a boundary condition, taking the planning result of a pre-disaster two-stage prevention control model as an initial operation condition, and constructing a single-stage emergency scheduling model in a disaster; by adopting the example simulation, the frequency stability and the system toughness of the high-proportion renewable energy system can be improved based on the pre-disaster two-stage prevention control model and the disaster medium single-stage emergency dispatch model.

title_en: Adjustable landslide-debris flow disaster chain lotus root simulation device and monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide-debris flow disaster chain lotus root simulation experiment device and a monitoring system, wherein the muddy water collection box is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the front end of the experiment box, the muddy water flowing out of the rear end of the simulation experiment can be discharged through the muddy water collection box, and meanwhile, the arranged water outlet can be used for discharging muddy water and can collect the discharged muddy water again so as to be reused, thereby saving resources; and simulating the angle of the piled soil in the test chamber by controlling the angle adjustment of the adjustment flap; soil can be piled up by adjusting and controlling the angle of the soil, and meanwhile, the angle of a test box in the experiment can be adjusted through a hydraulic push rod on the support frame, so that the conditions of different gradients of the debris flow can be simulated; in addition, the invention can monitor the change condition of landslide and debris flow and various thresholds through the detection system, so that the prediction of the actual condition can be conveniently carried out later, and a corresponding plan can be formulated.

title_en: VR-based safety experience platform and teaching and cultivating system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of education management, in particular to a VR-based safety experience platform and a teaching system, which comprises a management control platform, a scene arrangement teaching module, a video acquisition module and a video evaluation module, wherein the management control platform is communicated with the scene arrangement teaching module, the scene arrangement teaching module is communicated with the video acquisition module, the video acquisition module is communicated with the video evaluation module, and the scene arrangement teaching module comprises a memory, a controller 2 and VR equipment. According to the invention, a virtual scene of a fire disaster is simulated through the VR equipment, a user wears the VR head display and stands on the VR running machine, the virtual fire disaster environment is provided, the user is simulated to escape from a fire disaster scene, the user is omitted from actually participating in the exercise process, the safety of the fire exercise education and training is improved, the camera shoots the escape video of the user, and whether the escape action is standard or not is evaluated by checking the escape video.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGHE SAFETY TECH CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Rock burst type forecasting method based on prototype learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dangerous disaster prediction of rock burst and the like in mines, in particular to a rock burst type prediction method based on prototype learning, which is used for determining what type of rock burst is about to occur in the future, and comprises the following steps: determining rock burst type forecast indexes; establishing a rock burst type forecast index data set; obtaining a rock burst type forecast vector; simplifying rock burst type prediction vectors by using a classifier based on a prototype learning algorithm; determining the matching degree of the forecast vector and the prototype; updating the prototype in a moving average manner; establishing a loss function for accurately controlling the distribution characteristics of the forecast vector; cyclic training of rock burst type forecasting algorithm based on prototype learning; the rock burst type forecasting method based on prototype learning is applied. Compared with the prior art, the method can greatly improve the early warning accuracy under the condition of not increasing the training quantity.
assignees: Shandong energy group co ltd;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Subway station fire disaster temperature field simulation system and method based on big data processing and neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway station fire disaster temperature field simulation system and method based on big data processing and a neural network, and the system comprises the following steps: collecting basic data of fire disasters of subway stations of a preset group, and preprocessing and clustering; constructing a digital simulation model aiming at each group of fire scenes, and taking pre-disaster data as part of input data of the digital simulation model; constructing a scaled physical model by a similar principle based on pre-disaster data and experience data for each group of fire scenes; performing interactive verification through the digital simulation model and the scaled physical model until the simulation precision is greater than a threshold value, storing input data and output data, and marking the input data and the output data as training data; and carrying out traceability analysis on each group of fire scenes and preset fire scenes by adopting the trained PINN model, simulating the evolution condition of the temperature field under each fire scene, and outputting a proposal scheme. The data source is reliable, the simulation efficiency is high, and prediction and evaluation can be performed through a trained model.

title_en: Fire control unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire control unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring method and a fire control unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring system based on deep learning, wherein the fire control unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring method comprises the following steps: firstly, responding to a fire alarm instruction aiming at a specific area to be monitored, and then commanding the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle to acquire video data of the area according to a monitoring request. And analyzing the collected video data of the target building structure, and combining a preset simulated fire image feature library, and analyzing and obtaining a fire analysis result by using a deep learning algorithm. According to the analysis result, the system further generates a fire strategy search request, and selects the most suitable fire treatment strategy from the strategy storage bin prepared in advance to guide the on-site fire-fighting action. By the design, the fire disaster situation can be accurately judged and strategies can be formulated automatically in real time, and the emergency response speed and the treatment efficiency of the fire department are greatly improved. In addition, by applying the deep learning technology, the accuracy of fire analysis can be continuously optimized, and a new and efficient solution is provided for fire safety management.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGZHUO FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Managing device for predicting disastor risk and methods thereof
title_ko: 재난 위험을 예측하는 관리 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A management device is disclosed. The present device includes: an interface for receiving an assessment report evaluating risks by accident information and disaster type; a storage unit storing an artificial intelligence model; and a processor for training the artificial intelligence model using accident information. The processor accesses at least one external source through an interface to retrieve disaster-related data, inputs the search results into an artificial intelligence model, and fuses the output results of the artificial intelligence model and an assessment report to generate a disaster prediction result. Accordingly, the risk of disaster can be predicted more accurately.
abstract_ko: 관리 장치가 개시된다. 본 장치는, 사고 정보 및 재난 유형 별로 위험성을 평가한 평가 리포트를 입력받기 위한 인터페이스, 인공 지능 모델이 저장된 저장부 및 사고 정보를 이용하여 인공 지능 모델을 학습시키는 프로세서를 포함한다. 프로세서는, 인터페이스를 통해 적어도 하나의 외부 소스에 액세스하여 재난 관련 데이터를 검색하여, 검색 결과를 인공 지능 모델에 입력하고, 인공 지능 모델의 출력 결과 및 평가 리포트를 융합하여, 재난 예측 결과를 생성한다. 이에 따라, 재난의 위험도를 좀 더 정확하게 예측할 수 있다.

title_en: Extended reality-based education and training system
title_ko: 확장 현실 기반의 교육 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an extended reality-based education and training system that can possess extended reality-based shooting procedure training capabilities, firing squad/trainee-specific education and training capabilities through multiple connections, instructor training management capabilities through a training control system, and learning and training capabilities for proficiency training of inexperienced personnel through an education and training system including a shooting command and control system implemented in an environment similar to reality. In order to achieve the above-mentioned purpose, the present invention includes: a step of performing the operation of training equipment by a trainee equipment according to the present invention; a step of transmitting data operated by the trainee equipment to a training server; a step of receiving and processing the operation data by the training server; a step of alteration of the status value of the training server by confirming the training equipment ID and data by the training server; and a step of transmitting a current training status value to the trainee equipment by the training server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 목적은 실제와 유사한 환경으로 구현된 사격 지휘 통제 체계를 포함하는 교육 훈련 시스템을 통해, 확장 현실 기반 사격 절차 훈련 능력과, 다중 접속을 통한 발사 반/훈련생별 교육 훈련 능력과, 훈련 통제 시스템을 통한 교관의 훈련 총괄 능력과, 미숙련자 숙달 교육을 위한 학습 훈련 능력을 보유할 수 있도록 하는 확장 현실 기반의 교육 훈련 시스템을 제공하는 것이다. 
상기 목적을 달성하기 위해, 본 발명에 따른 교육생 장비에 의해, 훈련 장비의 조작이 수행되는 단계; 훈련용 서버로 상기 교육생 장비에 의해 조작된 데이터가 전송되는 단계; 상기 훈련용 서버에 의해, 상기 조작 데이터가 수신 처리되는 단계; 상기 훈련용 서버에 의해, 훈련 장비 ID와 데이터를 확인하여 상기 훈련용 서버의 상태 값이 변경되는 단계; 및 상기 훈련용 서버에 의해, 현재 훈련 상태 값이 상기 교육생 장비로 전송되는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Power distribution network two-stage toughness improvement strategy based on phase-shifting transformer
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-stage toughness improvement strategy of a power distribution network based on a phase-shifting transformer, and belongs to the technical field of power grid planning. In the pre-disaster stage, a two-stage robust planning model which considers a phase-shifting transformer and an energy storage pre-layout is provided in consideration of uncertainty of line faults, linear relaxation is carried out on power flow of a power system by utilizing a Big-M method, and then a pre-layout scheme of the phase-shifting transformer and the energy storage is solved by a nested column and constraint generation algorithm; in the post-disaster stage, a second-order cone planning model of the phase-shifting transformer and the energy storage collaborative optimization is established so as to realize the rapid power supply of the post-disaster load; finally, the validity of the proposed model is verified by testing through an IEEE33 node system. Simulation results show that the cooperative configuration of the phase-shifting transformer and the energy storage can effectively ensure the power supply of the load and improve the toughness of the system.

title_en: Distributed multi-source glacier monitoring system and glacier disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed multi-source glacier monitoring system and a glacier disaster early warning method, which belong to the field of glacier monitoring and comprise a data acquisition module, a data transmission module and a data management platform; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring glacier monitoring data in a polling mode and converting the glacier monitoring data into glacier monitoring digital signals; the data transmission module is used for transmitting the glacier monitoring digital signals to the data management platform; the data management platform is used for simulating and predicting the change and evolution of glaciers according to the glacier monitoring digital signals. The invention solves the problems of low data stability and low adaptability to large temperature difference of monitoring equipment working in extremely cold areas, and simultaneously utilizes glacier acceleration to realize front-end early warning of glacier disasters.

title_en: Tunnel disaster chain deduction platform based on MR and accident evolution model and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel disaster chain deduction platform and a construction method based on an MR and accident evolution model, which mainly solve the problem that the reality and experience sense of the existing tunnel disaster accident and treatment simulation system are poor, wherein the deduction platform comprises a real tunnel scene, a virtual scene fusion carrier and a virtual scene fusion carrier, wherein the real tunnel scene is used for simulating the real tunnel condition; the control and display device comprises a virtual simulation core device, a tunnel mixed reality disaster chain deduction system and a tunnel mixed reality disaster chain deduction system, wherein the virtual simulation core device is used for controlling, displaying and operating a virtual scene and interacting with virtual contents, and the virtual accident scene based on a tunnel disaster accident evolution model is integrated, so that virtual vehicles, fires or collapse scenes are fused and overlapped in a real tunnel scene. The method can be used for deducing the occurrence and development processes of 4 disaster accident scenes such as tunnel fires, blasting, collapse, fire-blasting-collapse and the like (showing apparent characteristics (flue gas, flame spreading condition and the like) and characteristic data (temperature, heat radiation, gas concentration change condition and the like) to feel the effects of different disaster treatment modes, and the simulation use scene is more realistic.

title_en: Mine surrounding rock roof disaster ultrasonic wave multipoint real-time monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses an ultrasonic wave multipoint real-time monitoring system and method for mine surrounding rock roof disasters, and belongs to the technical field of mine monitoring. The monitoring system comprises a detection device, a prediction module and an early warning module, wherein the prediction module comprises a data processing unit, a machine learning unit, an adjusting unit and a prediction unit, and the data processing unit is used for analyzing data from a mine surrounding rock simulation model experiment; the machine learning unit is used for transmitting the training set and the testing set to the machine learning model to obtain a dust stone prediction model; the adjusting unit is used for carrying out parameter adjustment on the dust and stone quantity prediction model; the prediction unit is used for inputting the ultrasonic detection data detected by the detection device into the dust and stone quantity prediction model and outputting a corresponding dust and stone quantity prediction result; the early warning module comprises an experiment unit and an early warning unit, wherein the experiment unit obtains a plurality of dust and stone quantity data through multiple experiments, and an average value is calculated to serve as a dust and stone reference value; the early warning unit is used for comparing the target dust and stone quantity data with a dust and stone reference value.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ZHICHU POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Emergency shelter site selection method based on ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation, in particular to an emergency evacuation site selection method based on an ant colony algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out space distribution structure analysis according to the geographic data of the target city to obtain a city space distribution diagram; processing the road emergency evacuation index according to the urban space distribution diagram to generate a road emergency evacuation index; building an ant colony site selection model through the road emergency evacuation index and the urban space distribution map to obtain the ant colony site selection model; performing ant colony emergency site selection behavior simulation according to the ant colony site selection model, and generating a potential emergency refuge site address; and carrying out multi-target refuge site selection evaluation through the potential emergency refuge site address, and generating a final proposed emergency refuge site. The invention realizes optimal emergency refuge site selection through multi-target site selection evaluation.

title_en: Indoor evacuation simulation method based on extended cellular automaton and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an indoor evacuation simulation method based on an extended cellular automaton and a storage medium. The indoor evacuation simulation method comprises the following steps: s1, placing pedestrians in a cellular automaton model, and setting three walking modes according to emergency degrees by the pedestrians; s2, judging the probability of each pedestrian moving direction; s3, calculating aggressiveness gamma  p  in the pedestrian moving process. According to the indoor evacuation simulation method based on the extended cellular automaton, the behavior characteristics of pedestrians and some factors of a scene actual scene are fully considered, meanwhile, the influence of an external environment on pedestrian evacuation is added, aggressiveness is introduced as a power function combining the external environment and pedestrian perception, so that the pedestrian evacuation path is closer to reality and more intelligent, the evacuation process of the pedestrians in the evacuation scene can be more truly restored through the indoor evacuation simulation method, and a theoretical basis is provided for risk assessment, emergency plan and emergency decision in safety management.

title_en: Rain and tide disaster emergency risk avoiding path and material allocation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency risk avoidance, in particular to a rain and tide disaster emergency risk avoidance path and material allocation optimization method. The method comprises the following steps: collecting area basic data to construct a rain and tide simulation model, and carrying out submerged result simulation by using the rain and tide simulation model; constructing a mathematical model of the human-vehicle emergency refuge transfer path according to the inundation simulation result and by taking the shortest overall transfer time of population of the disaster area as a target and integrating the safety of the transfer path, the placement capacity of the emergency refuge site and the maximum time consumption constraint; and according to the risk avoiding transfer result, constructing an emergency risk avoiding material allocation model by taking the highest supply degree of personnel materials in the emergency shelter as a total target and integrating the safety of allocation routes and the constraint of maximum allocation time consumption. According to the invention, by combining a rain and tide simulation model, an emergency risk avoiding transfer path mathematical model and an emergency risk avoiding material allocation model and through an intelligent optimization algorithm, the accuracy of risk avoiding transfer and material allocation under a forecast disaster situation is improved.

title_en: Landslide geological disaster physical simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of landslide simulation tests, and discloses a landslide geological disaster physical simulation test device and a landslide geological disaster physical simulation test method. The device and the arrangement of the upper structure thereof can simulate landslide of a test body under various external force induction mechanisms, and can simulate the damage process of the test body in each stage indoors, the controllability is good, the degree of automation is high, the experimental simulation result is high in accordance with the actual result, and the monitoring and early warning precision of the landslide geological disaster is further effectively improved.
assignees: JIANGXI COAL GEOLOGICAL SURVEY AND RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Deep learning-based convection strong wind short-time forecasting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based short-time convection strong wind forecasting method and a deep learning-based short-time convection strong wind forecasting system, and relates to the technical field of convection strong wind forecasting. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical ground automatic station observation data of a region to be forecasted and regional numerical mode future forecast variables of a corresponding time period, preprocessing the data, establishing a convection gale short-time forecast data set of the region to be forecasted, training to generate a convection gale short-time forecast model based on a PhyDNet deep learning network, and inputting the ground observation data of the region to be forecasted at the vicinity forecast time and the regional numerical mode future forecast variables to generate the convection gale short-time forecast of the region by utilizing the convection gale short-time forecast model generated by training. The forecasting method provided by the invention can shorten the forecasting time of the convection strong wind, improve the forecasting accuracy to improve the forecasting capability of the convection strong wind and reduce the loss caused by natural disasters.

title_en: Fire control training VR experiences equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses fire-fighting training VR experience equipment, which relates to the field of fire-fighting equipment and comprises a device main body, wherein the device main body is of a hollow structure, a protective cover is arranged in the device main body in a sliding mode, a top cover is arranged at the top end of the device main body, a base is arranged at the bottom end of the device main body, and a universal running machine is arranged at the central position on the base. According to the utility model, the protective cover matched with the device main body is used for forming the barreled device, when a user sees in a virtual reality scene, the weight of a firefighting prop in reality can be simulated through the placed prop, so that a better reality simulation effect is achieved, and meanwhile, the user is protected through the first limiting ring matched with the second limiting ring, so that the situation that the user falls down when running on the universal running machine is guaranteed.
assignees: CHANGCHUN LANCHENG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Chemical pipeline leakage simulation generation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting training facilities, and discloses a device for simulating leakage of chemical pipelines, which comprises a simulation platform, wherein one side of the simulation platform is provided with a leakage generation assembly, the other side of the simulation platform is provided with equipment communicated with the leakage generation assembly, the leakage generation assembly comprises a raw material tank, a reaction kettle, a horizontal storage tank and an additive storage tank, and the raw material tank, the reaction kettle, the horizontal storage tank and the additive storage tank are mutually communicated through pipelines. This simulation chemical industry pipeline leaks generating device, through the start-up or closing of PLC switch board control air compressor and booster pump to can realize liquid or gaseous industrial chemicals and leak the switching of simulation, application scope is wider, can reach the purpose that the industrial chemicals leaked in the different positions of simulation emergence through opening and close of control different position valve group simultaneously, can temper firefighter's emergency rescue ability better.

title_en: Novel fire control physical training dummy
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel fire-fighting physical training dummy, which relates to the field of physical training and comprises a trunk, wherein a second bolt penetrates through the back of the trunk, a head is connected inside the trunk through a rotating shaft, the surface of the rotating shaft is connected with a baffle plate, two sides of the trunk are connected with an upper arm through a joint nest and a joint head, the bottom of the trunk is connected with thighs through the joint nest and the joint head, sliding grooves are formed in the tops and the bottoms of the upper arm and the thighs, and connecting ropes are connected inside the sliding grooves through sliding plates. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the rotating shaft, the connecting rope, the upper arm, the thigh, the telescopic rod, the spring, the sliding plate, the sliding groove and the weight block, the firefighter rotates the second bolt to enable the second bolt not to be abutted with the rotating shaft, then the firefighter rotates the head clockwise, the head drives the rotating shaft to rotate to enable the connecting rope wound on the surface of the rotating shaft to be released, and the baffle arranged on the outer ring of the rotating shaft guides and limits the connecting rope, so that the effect that a novel firefighting physical training dummy can replace a plurality of novel firefighting physical training dummy with different sizes and weights is achieved, and the cost is reduced.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;NANJING KUNBAO SAFETY PROT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Wildfire cone of confidence simulation system and processes
abstract_en: A wildfire cone of confidence simulation system and processes is disclosed. Methodical application of the hurricane cone of confidence applied to wildfire simulations involves applying a methodology that has been utilized in the hurricane disaster space since the 1950s, to the current wildfire predictive modeling problem. As wildfires become larger and move more quickly the public requires notifications that are consumable and actionable.

title_en: Angle-variable experimental device for evolution process of mud-rock flow plug Jiang Yan plug body formation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an evolution process experimental device for forming a plug body of a debris flow plug Jiang Yan with a variable angle, and relates to the field of debris flow simulation experimental devices; comprises a debris flow material storage device and a debris flow launder; the debris flow material storage device is positioned at the top end of the debris flow groove, and the bottom end of the debris flow groove is connected with the connecting groove; two side plates at one end of the connecting groove far away from the mudstone launder are respectively connected with a connecting position piston, and one end of the connecting position piston far away from the connecting groove is connected with a movable steel sheet at the connecting position; the device also comprises a water tank; two water tank pistons are connected to the same side of the water tank, and water tank movable steel sheets are connected to the side edges of the water tank pistons; the two movable steel sheets of the water tank are respectively connected with the movable steel sheets at the joint part, so that the mudstone launder is communicated with the water tank; according to the utility model, the trough is rotated, the movable steel sheet at the joint and the movable steel sheet at the trough are stretched to change the included angle between the trough and the mudstone launder, so that the device has high flexibility and high practicability in researching the disaster-causing mechanism of the mud stone flow of behaviour of river.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring device for geological disasters, and relates to the technical field of geological disasters. The utility model comprises a rectangular frame, wherein the top of the rectangular frame is fixedly connected with a handle, the inner wall of the rectangular frame is fixedly connected with a timing motor, the bottom of the timing motor is provided with a monitoring device, the monitoring device comprises a threaded rod, the top of the threaded rod is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the timing motor, the circumferential surface of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with a movable disc, and the circumferential surface of the movable disc is fixedly connected with a connecting plate. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching among the components such as the threaded rod, the movable disc, the connecting plate, the drilling tool, the long rod and the like in the monitoring device, the automatic hole drilling can be realized, the pore water pressure sensor can be immediately installed in the land and the rock, the problems in the process of drilling are reduced, the preparation time required in the early monitoring stage is effectively reduced, and the monitoring speed is improved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA NO 1 HYDROGEOLOGY ENGINEERING GEOLOGICAL EXPLOR CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation simulation method, system, equipment and medium based on social force model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evacuation simulation based on a social force model, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the following steps: acquiring pedestrian information and simulation channel information; when the pedestrian information meets the preset matching requirement of the current rotation area, calculating the position information of each pedestrian through a preset first social force model to obtain a first evacuation simulation data set, wherein the first social force model is provided with a steering characteristic parameter; when the pedestrian information meets the preset matching requirement of the current translation area, calculating the position information of each pedestrian through a preset second social force model to obtain a second evacuation simulation data set, wherein the second social force model is not provided with steering characteristic parameters; and constructing a data set according to the first evacuation simulation data set and the second evacuation simulation data set to obtain an evacuation simulation result. The method considers the special rotation behavior and movement characteristics of pedestrians in the evacuation process, and ensures the authenticity and reliability of evacuation simulation.

title_en: Emergency resource scheduling optimization method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency resource scheduling optimization method based on reinforcement learning, which belongs to the technical field of emergency resource scheduling and comprises the following specific steps: the whole map is divided into different rescue areas according to a provincial administrative area division principle; collecting related data of disaster conditions; collecting data to be rescued; establishing an emergency dispatching multi-objective optimization model based on disaster conditions; solving the model by adopting an RL-DE algorithm, setting reinforcement learning related concepts, and training the model to obtain an optimal emergency rescue scheduling scheme; the invention can realize rescheduling according to the recorded data when encountering emergency, has no interruption in the middle and good connection, and achieves the effect of preventing accidents.
assignees: SUZHOU SHENGBINUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mud-rock flow analogue test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rock and soil disaster prevention and control, in particular to a debris flow simulation test device, which comprises an operation platform, wherein a chute is arranged on the operation platform, a traction assembly is fixedly arranged on the operation platform, and the height of the chute can be adjusted by the traction assembly so as to simulate different hillside slopes and obtain different starting speeds of debris flow; a blocking assembly is arranged between a storage area and a sliding area in the chute, and a blocking door is opened by pulling a pull rope to enable mud stones in the storage area to be released instantaneously, so that the starting process of the instantaneous occurrence of mud stone flow is simulated; a plurality of terrain simulation components are arranged in the sliding area, and the arc-shaped thin plate is driven by the terrain simulation pushing component to generate different elastic deformation so as to simulate different terrain conditions. The mud-rock flow model test device aims at simulating the real starting and flowing process of mud-rock flow and provides reference for the protection engineering of traffic infrastructure in the frequent areas of mud-rock flow disasters.

title_en: Bridge anti-seismic integrated management system oriented to regional road network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a regional road network oriented bridge earthquake-resistant comprehensive management system, which belongs to the field of bridge earthquake resistance and comprises a bridge earthquake-resistant management map module, a bridge earthquake resistance evaluation module, a bridge earthquake simulation and prediction module, a bridge emergency response and decision support module, a bridge recovery and reconstruction planning module and a database. The invention provides more refined and intelligent information and guidance for dealing with earthquake disasters.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Fusion model debris flow infrasound recognition method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fusion model debris flow infrasound recognition method based on deep learning, which belongs to the field of image recognition and comprises the steps of constructing a data set formed by infrasound time-frequency diagrams with category marks; constructing a debris flow infrasound recognition network; training the debris flow infrasound recognition network to converge by using the data set to obtain a debris flow infrasound recognition fusion model; and acquiring an infrasound signal to be identified, converting the infrasound signal into an infrasound time-frequency diagram, and sending the infrasound signal into a debris flow infrasound identification fusion model to obtain prediction output. Aiming at the characteristics of the debris flow time-frequency diagram, resNet and ViT are improved and combined, so that the method is more accurate in global grasp and extraction of the context detail characteristics, and can better identify the amplitude change and the band structure of the time-frequency diagram. The invention can rapidly and accurately identify the debris flow, not only improves the generalization capability of the debris flow time-frequency image, but also improves the usability of the infrasound alarm in disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;CHENGLI ZHIYUAN TECH CHENGDU CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster mode identification method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster mode identification method and a fire disaster mode identification system based on big data, wherein the fire disaster mode identification method comprises the following steps: in response to receiving a fire instruction, acquiring fire scene data, wherein the fire scene data is data acquired by a fire sensor, and the fire scene data at least comprises image data and temperature data of a fire scene; inputting fire scene data into a target pattern recognition model to obtain a pattern recognition result, wherein the target pattern recognition model is obtained based on historical fire scene big data training; and scheduling the message unit based on the pattern recognition result. The model is trained through big data, so that the accuracy of the target pattern recognition model can be effectively ensured, a pattern recognition result corresponding to the fire scene data can be accurately obtained, and a fire pattern corresponding to a fire scene when a fire is started can be accurately determined and corresponding scheduling can be performed.

title_en: Transmission monitoring system for intelligent substation relay protection overhaul test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system automation, in particular to an intelligent substation relay protection overhaul test transmission monitoring system. According to the invention, through the application of an information gain algorithm and a Gini coefficient, the accuracy of fault mode identification is enhanced, the combination of a random forest algorithm and a cyclic neural network improves the accuracy of equipment state prediction, the dynamic threshold adjustment of a Q learning and fuzzy logic algorithm improves the sensitivity of fault prediction, the network analysis of a graph theory algorithm improves the identification efficiency of equipment and fault propagation paths, the decision optimization of a system dynamics model and Monte Carlo simulation ensures the scientificity of maintenance strategies and the effectiveness of emergency response, and the application of a linear programming and network flow analysis method improves the overhaul test efficiency.
assignees: XUANCHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Mountain rock seam detection equipment for geological survey
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological investigation, in particular to mountain rock seam detection equipment for geological investigation; the system comprises a suspension assembly, a connecting main body, two embedded assemblies and two drilling assemblies, wherein the suspension assembly can be hung on one side of a mountain rock seam, the suspension assembly is connected with the two embedded assemblies through the connecting main body, the drilling assemblies are movably and detachably arranged on the embedded assemblies, the drilling assemblies can collect stone and muddy samples at the mountain rock seam, and the disaster hidden danger is estimated in advance by analyzing the property change of the stone or muddy samples; after the drilling assembly collects samples at the positions of two sides of the mountain rock seam, a collecting hole is reserved at the two sides of the mountain rock seam, the end parts of the embedded assemblies can be embedded and inserted into the collecting hole, the other ends of the two embedded assemblies are connected with each other, and the positions of the two embedded assemblies and the installation firmness in the collecting hole are limited to strengthen the position of the mountain rock seam so as to prevent the rock seam from further cracking.
assignees: NO 7 GEOLOGY GROUP SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES THE 7TH INST OF GEOLOGY

title_en: Flood evolution calculation simulation method and system based on three-dimensional visualization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood evolution calculation simulation method and a system based on three-dimensional visualization, which aim to solve the problem that the current flood evolution simulation technology mostly stays on a two-dimensional evolution model and static display of calculation results, and three-dimensional dynamic simulation of the flood evolution process is not performed yet; the method comprises the following steps: constructing a reservoir related three-dimensional model through a three-dimensional modeling technology, and restoring reservoir and river basin scenes; collecting historical reservoir water rain condition data and flood related variable data, and generating a historical flood scene; constructing a historical flood scene database, analyzing the deviation between the historical flood scene database and historical forecast data, and generating a historical flood big data model; and generating related data of the pre-modeling flood discharge scheme according to the historical flood big data model, and displaying the flood evolution process in a three-dimensional visualization mode. The historical flood big data model is combined with the reservoir and the river basin scene, so that the flood process simulation and the three-dimensional scene are fused, and visual basis is provided for flood control and disaster reduction measures.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SUPCON INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel fire monitoring system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel fire monitoring system based on deep learning, which comprises: the information acquisition module is used for arranging the image acquisition equipment and the plurality of sensors, acquiring sensor data and transmitting the sensor data to the information processing module; the information processing module is used for processing the image data and the sensor data; the analysis module is used for constructing a multi-mode deep learning model and training, and obtaining a tunnel fire disaster recognition result through the trained model based on the processed image data and the sensor data; the control module is used for judging whether to generate a control instruction and sending information to related personnel according to the identification result; the data management module is used for storing data and updating parameters of the multi-mode deep learning model at set intervals by taking the stored data as a verification set. The invention can intelligently process multi-mode data, improves the accuracy and reliability of fire detection, has the capability of real-time monitoring and early warning, timely discovers problems and takes measures, and avoids overlarge loss.

title_en: Forestry robot competition area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a competition field of a forestry robot, which is provided with a forest fire monitoring and early warning simulation area, a forest resource monitoring and simulation area, a biomass detection simulation area and a disease and insect disaster prevention simulation area which are sequentially arranged side by side, wherein the middle parts of the forest fire monitoring and early warning simulation area, the forest resource monitoring and simulation area, the biomass detection simulation area and the disease and insect disaster prevention simulation area are respectively provided with a walking path of the forestry robot, and a plurality of simulation tree models are arranged on two sides of the walking path; and green carpets and hard paperboards are used as main materials, so that the carpet can be recycled.

title_en: Computer-implemented method and system for predicting geological disaster risk or pipe strain associated with a pipe system using machine learning
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method for predicting a risk of a geological disaster or a strain of a pipeline associated with a pipeline system using machine learning is described. In one embodiment, the method includes (i) receiving a plurality of training data sets for a plurality of discrete locations of a geographic area, each training data set including training pipeline inspection data and training geophysical and geological data associated with a respective discrete location of the geographic area, (ii) processing the plurality of training data sets to generate a plurality of training score sets, each training score set including a plurality of training pipeline risk scores and a plurality of training geophysical and geological risk scores associated with each of the plurality of discrete locations, (iii) training a machine learning model using the plurality of training score sets to obtain a trained machine learning model, (iv) receiving a target data set for a target location associated with the pipeline system, the target data set including target pipeline inspection data and target geophysical and geological data, (v) processing the target data set to generate a target score set including pipeline risk scores and geophysical and geological risk scores associated with the target location, and (vi) generating a predicted pipeline risk value or predicted pipeline hazard value using the trained machine learning model in response to the target score set. A machine learning system for predicting a geological disaster risk or a pipeline strain is also described.

title_en: Automatic counting type take-up and pay-off wheel disc device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a counting type automatic take-up and pay-off wheel disc device which comprises a bottom platform, a frame body and a wheel disc fixing support, wherein the frame body is arranged on the bottom platform, the wheel disc fixing support is used for placing two wheel discs, a counting system is arranged on one side of the frame body, a control box is arranged on the upper portion of the frame body, and the wheel discs are in transmission connection with a power system. According to the utility model, each part is fixed on the external support and placed beside the wellhead to be rescued, the life information detection device connected with the control box is lowered to the disaster area or lifted to the ground for a long distance, the control box directly obtains detected information, real-time measurement of the lowering depth of the life information detection device is realized, and the real-time measurement is displayed through the control box, so that the life information detection device is suitable for rescue scenes such as drilling rescue, deep well rescue and the like with different calibers and different depths, accurate first hand field data is provided for rescue personnel to make correct decisions, effective expansion of follow-up rescue actions is promoted, and rescue success rate is improved.
assignees: SHAANXI XIKUANG ZHITONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart city fire detection method and device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart city fire detection method, a smart city fire detection device and a readable storage medium, wherein the smart city fire detection method comprises the following steps: collecting image data; according to the image data, carrying out recognition processing based on a pre-trained fire detection model to obtain a fire recognition result; performing fire alarm according to a fire identification result, and performing emergency treatment on micro flames and smoke; the training process of the fire detection model comprises the following steps: collecting fire image data and non-fire image data; the fire disaster image data and the non-fire disaster image data are manufactured into a training set, a verification set and a test set; training the YOLOv model based on the training set to obtain a fire detection model, and verifying and testing the fire detection model based on the verification set and the test set to obtain an optimal fire detection model. The invention can identify and process micro flame and smoke through the pre-trained fire detection model, thereby achieving the technical effect of early warning of fire and improving the real-time detection and emergency requirements of fire safety supervision.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning method and system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time geological monitoring data and historical geological monitoring data through a high-resolution satellite and a synthetic aperture radar; performing data processing on the real-time geological monitoring data to obtain processed geological data; training a depth generation countermeasure network model according to the processed geological data and the historical geological monitoring data to obtain a geological disaster monitoring prediction model; obtaining geological monitoring data to be predicted; and inputting the geological data to be predicted into the geological disaster monitoring and predicting model to obtain a geological disaster predicting result. The invention adopts a plurality of remote sensing sources, and can effectively avoid the interference faced by a single remote sensing technology, thereby realizing high-efficiency, rapid and accurate geological disaster early warning.
assignees: HENAN PROVINCE NON FERROUS METALS GEOLOGY AND MINERAL RESOURCES BUREAU 7TH GEOLOGY

title_en: Dangerous area construction progress management system
abstract_en: The invention designs a construction progress management system for a dangerous area, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data display module and an auxiliary function module; the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data display module and an auxiliary functional module, wherein the data acquisition module comprises an environment data acquisition sub-module, an equipment operation data acquisition sub-module, a personnel working data acquisition sub-module and a safety monitoring sub-module, the data processing module comprises a data analysis sub-module and an early warning sub-module, the data display module comprises a monitoring interface module and a progress management interface module, the auxiliary functional module comprises a personnel management module, a material management module, a system control module, a data storage and backup module, a training and guiding module, a multilingual support module and an emergency response module, and the system can effectively integrate information resources of different departments and links, break information island phenomenon and improve the efficiency and accuracy of information transmission and sharing.
assignees: SICHUAN MINGXING NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Open pit mine geological environment disaster and ecological restoration simulation device and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to an open pit mine geological environment disaster and ecological restoration simulation device, which has the structure that: a vibration control platform is arranged on the bottom surface of the closed simulation chamber, and a slope simulation platform is supported above the vibration control platform through a plurality of lifting platforms; a heating device, a condensing device and a flame spraying device are arranged in the slope simulation platform, and a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor are arranged in the slope of the slope simulation platform; a spraying device is arranged above the slope simulation platform and is positioned at the top of the closed simulation chamber; an acquisition point is arranged below the slope of the slope simulation platform; a monitoring instrument group is arranged at the top of the closed simulation chamber; a control console for controlling and operating each device is arranged in the closed simulation room. The simulation device can simulate the influence of various mine environment disasters on the stability of the pit slope of the open pit coal mine and simulate ecological restoration conditions, and provides a basis for the pit slope management of the open pit coal mine.

title_en: Sea area anomaly monitoring method and device based on improved K-means clustering algorithm model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a sea area anomaly monitoring method and device based on an improved K-means clustering algorithm model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data acquired by a data acquisition device or extracted from a data set input by a user; the minimum association degree judgment is carried out on the extracted data, the samples are divided into a plurality of categories through the internal relation among the data, and a dataset Dataset-1 based on the original sample range is constructed; and introducing a pre-training prompt model, continuously carrying out parameter standardization and outlier filtering on the data, obtaining global optimization under the local optimization condition, and realizing accurate judgment on the outlier sample points of the sea area. The sea area abnormal constant value forecasting method based on the improved mathematical model can be provided, the purposes of correcting the sea area condition error rate and improving the abnormal monitoring precision are achieved by selecting the prompting mechanism, and the sea area abnormal constant value forecasting method has important practical values for improving the accuracy of the abnormal position of the sea area and preventing marine meteorological disasters.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU OCEAN;LIANYUNGANG JINGMING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground engineering geological disaster while-drilling multi-element detection test system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-element detection test system and method for underground engineering geological disasters while drilling, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster detection. The system comprises: the test fixing table is used for fixing the equipment to be tested while drilling and assisting the equipment to be tested while drilling in detection test; the assembly type geological disaster model is used for assembling and combining the multi-element geological disaster modules according to test requirements and simulating different geological scenes; the drilling measurement equipment is used for detecting the assembled geological disaster model and recording test data in the detection test process; the data transmission module is used for transmitting test data; and the data processing module is used for processing and analyzing the test data. The invention can meet the indoor test and debugging requirements of the multi-element detection equipment while drilling, provide detection test scenes of various common disaster bodies of underground engineering and combinations thereof, and realize the diversity and repeatability of the multi-element detection data acquisition test while drilling.
assignees: SHANDONG HI SPEED CONSTRUCTION MAN GROUP CO LTD;SHANDONG EXPRESSWAY LINTENG HIGHWAY CO LTD;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING

title_en: Virtual reality simulation evacuation platform and method based on multi-sensory channel equipment cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality simulation evacuation platform and a virtual reality simulation evacuation method based on multi-sensory channel equipment cooperation. According to the tunnel fire VR simulation evacuation platform, the multi-sensory channel equipment can be cooperatively controlled through the comprehensive information control and management platform, and the true experience feeling of multiple senses is provided through cooperation with visual scenes, so that the authenticity of an experiment and the immersion degree of an experimenter in the experiment process are improved, and the reliability and the accuracy of subsequent experiments are ensured; the physiological information of the experimenter can be monitored and analyzed, the safety of the experiment is guaranteed, meanwhile, the real physiological response of the user under different conditions is obtained through the physiological data analysis, and the accuracy of the experimental result is improved.

title_en: Visual experiment testing device for simulating explosion evolution process of underground electrochemical energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual experiment testing device for simulating an explosion evolution process of an underground electrochemical energy storage system, which is used for simulating possible explosion events in the underground electrochemical energy storage system and researching structural dynamics response of the explosion events. The invention designs an experimental device comprising a hollow cuboid structure, an explosion venting observation window, a fuel gas proportioning system and other components aiming at the fire disaster and explosion risk possibly caused by the combustible gas released by the thermal runaway of the lithium ion battery in the underground space so as to observe and analyze the safety performance of the underground energy storage space under various conditions. The device considers the single-port and double-port explosion venting measures and can perform dynamic response test on the back of the structure. The device provides experimental data for the safety of the electrochemical energy storage system, optimizes related designs, aims to solve special challenges of the underground environment, and is beneficial to improving the overall safety of the underground electrochemical energy storage system.

title_en: Rock burst unloading pressure drop energy test and evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of coal mine dynamic disaster prevention and control, and provides a rock burst unloading pressure drop energy test and evaluation method, which is used for developing a rock burst pressure relief simulation test and analyzing the expansion rule of rock cracks under different conditions; coring rock mass at different distances from the blasting center, and manufacturing standard rock mass samples at different positions of the rock mass; carrying out rock mechanical property test on partial cores in standard rock mass samples at different positions, and determining rock damage degree to obtain rock damage distribution conditions; carrying out a rock mass dynamic test on the residual rock cores in the standard rock mass samples at different positions to obtain dynamic damage characteristics, energy release rules and debris distribution conditions of the rock mass; and guiding the on-site rock blasting pressure relief parameter design based on rock damage distribution conditions, dynamic damage characteristics, energy release rules and debris distribution conditions. The invention can provide basis for the design and optimization of the on-site rock blasting pressure relief parameters.

title_en: Prediction method and system for tunnel fire scale and occurrence position
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for predicting the scale and the occurrence position of tunnel fire, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a tunnel physical model according to a tunnel to be detected, acquiring a simulated fire smoke image of the tunnel to be detected, and establishing a fire database; training the deep learning network Resnet based on the fire database to obtain a tunnel fire prediction model, wherein the tunnel fire prediction model comprises a tunnel fire scale prediction model and a tunnel fire occurrence position prediction model; inputting a real fire smoke image of a tunnel to be detected into a tunnel fire prediction model, and obtaining prediction results of the scale and the occurrence position of the tunnel fire, wherein the prediction results are listed in sequence according to the scale and the possibility of the occurrence position of the tunnel fire respectively; and obtaining the optimal prediction result of the tunnel fire scale and the occurrence position according to the prediction result. The invention can predict the scale and the occurrence position of tunnel fire disaster so as to better formulate rescue and evacuation schemes.

title_en: Intelligent control system for enterprise safety evaluation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of control, in particular to an enterprise safety evaluation intelligent control system, which comprises a computer end, an evaluation model, a control system, a smoke sensor and an alarm system, wherein the evaluation model is built in the computer end, the computer end is connected with a mobile phone of a user, the alarm system is used for giving an alarm, and the safety evaluation control steps are as follows: s1, sequentially attaching marks to the fire extinguisher, and inputting the service life and the marks of the fire extinguisher into the computer. According to the application, by establishing the evaluation model, the fire disaster occurrence condition can be simulated, the most easily occurring position of the fire disaster is found, a plurality of groups of fire extinguishers are arranged in the position, after the service life of the fire extinguishers expires, the alarm system is controlled by the control system to alarm, people are warned to replace the fire extinguishers in time, the dangerous fire disaster is found in the first time through the smoke sensor, people are warned to evacuate in time, and a better use prospect is brought.
assignees: ANHUI YUCHEN ENGINEERING SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and product for early warning landslide of poor geological side slope of high-speed railway
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a product for early warning landslide of a poor geological side slope of a high-speed railway, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on early warning starting information, early warning and inspection are carried out on the poor geological side slope of the high-speed railway, and early warning criteria are generated according to inspection results; determining an early warning result of the poor geological side slope of the high-speed railway based on a landslide early warning model and an early warning criterion, wherein the landslide early warning model is obtained based on landslide sample training of the poor geological side slope of the high-speed railway; and determining an early warning strategy of the poor geological side slope of the high-speed railway based on the early warning result. According to the method, the early warning criterion is generated through early warning and inspection, and the geological condition of the poor geological side slope of the high-speed railway is determined by combining the landslide early warning model, so that early warning of landslide condition, disaster precursors and the like is realized, the monitoring safety level of the poor geology is greatly improved, and landslide and disaster can be prevented in advance.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 19TH BEREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine digital twin model building method based on Bayesian network algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for establishing a digital twin model of a coal mine based on a Bayesian network algorithm, which relates to the technical field of machine learning and comprises the following steps: s1, determining a target mine and acquiring real-time data; s2, constructing an initial digital twin model; s3, determining disaster types and corresponding disaster causing factors of the target mine, further constructing and training to obtain a disaster causing factor analysis model, and outputting to obtain a topological relation of the disaster causing factors by using the disaster causing factor analysis model; s4, constructing a Bayesian model, and performing iterative training on the Bayesian model by utilizing superposition weight analysis; s5, embedding the disaster-causing factor analysis model and the Bayesian model into the initial digital twin model in series by utilizing the antagonism framework to obtain a final digital twin model. The invention is integrated with a Bayesian network algorithm, can analyze and predict input data to obtain the occurrence probability of mine disasters, and can take countermeasures or rectifying measures in advance for different disasters, thereby effectively improving the safety coefficient of the coal mine.
assignees: ORDOS CITY TENGYUAN COAL CO LTD;NANJING BEIDOU INNOVATION APPLICATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Fire real-time evacuation path planning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire real-time evacuation path planning method and system based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: determining fire scene information in response to receiving the fire command; acquiring monitoring data acquired by monitoring equipment of a fire scene in real time; performing low-dimensional space mapping on the monitoring data to obtain a plurality of first monitoring data feature matrixes; based on the first influence characteristic recognition configuration, carrying out influence characteristic recognition on the plurality of first monitoring data characteristic matrixes, and determining influence monitoring data basis corresponding to the plurality of first monitoring data characteristic matrixes; inputting the influence monitoring data into a target fire spread trend reasoning model which is obtained in advance based on deep learning training, so as to obtain target spread trend information; and generating and transmitting a target evacuation path based on the road planning and the target spreading trend information. The fire spreading trend can be accurately predicted, so that people in a fire scene can be effectively ensured to be evacuated rapidly and reliably, and the evacuation efficiency in the case of fire is effectively ensured.

title_en: Fire disaster prediction system and method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire prediction system and a fire prediction method based on multi-source information fusion, wherein the fire prediction system comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of acquiring fire data through a sensor system, selecting temperature, smoke and CO gas sensor data as characteristic parameters of fire prediction, and performing threshold detection judgment on the extracted data by a rate detection algorithm to obtain sample data in local decision; the collected data are scrambled and re-divided into 400 groups of training sets and 80 groups of testing sets, and normalization processing is carried out on the data; taking the data predicted by the LSTM neural network as ELM neural network characteristic input, and outputting the activation function network as fire probability, no fire probability and smoldering fire probability; integrating the outputs of the LSTM and ELM sub-networks by a weighted average method; establishing a fuzzy rule by using a fuzzy control toolbox of MATLAB, and taking the output of the integrated neural network as the input of a fuzzy control model; 80 sets of test data were input into the built model for testing. The invention improves the accuracy and reliability of fire prediction.

title_en: Visual geographic cloud image data processing system for intelligent aerial view map customer service risk
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power risk, and particularly relates to a visual geographic cloud image data processing system for intelligent aerial view map customer service risk, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a geographic sampling module, a probability evaluation module, an asset statistics module and a risk output module. According to the scheme, a GIS technology is adopted to analyze a flood disaster graph, the failure risk probability of the electric power asset and the potential influence thereof are quantized, and a process for monetizing and visualizing the generated risk results is established; the method comprises the steps of creating a cloud-shaped sampling point which is uniformly distributed in an influence area of each power distribution cabinet, generating a position of a sampling shape by using a Monte Carlo simulation method, randomly shifting the position of the cloud-shaped sampling point, and simulating the uncertainty of the position by using a fuzzy boundary; by means of the vulnerability profile without safeguarding or improvement measures, the losses or the extent of impact suffered by the electrical installation are evaluated in order to operate more robustly in the face of threats.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Traffic road network abnormal situation space-time evolution method integrating causal inference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic road network abnormal situation space-time evolution method integrating causal inference, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source traffic road network data, screening characteristic variables based on space-time association and causal effect of the traffic road network, constructing a data set, constructing a counterfactual graph attention network model based on encoder and decoder structures, training the counterfactual graph attention network model by utilizing the data set, inputting the traffic road network data to be detected into the trained counterfactual graph attention network model, and obtaining an abnormal situation detection recognition result of the traffic road network and a real-time space evolution situation. The method combines causal inference and space-time association to construct a counterfactual graph attention network model, can timely respond to the change of traffic network data, monitors and identifies abnormal situations in real time, improves the accuracy, reliability and instantaneity of traffic network abnormal situation detection, and brings better support and guarantee for the establishment and implementation of traffic management emergency response schemes.

title_en: Method and device for identifying evacuated people under indoor smoke shielding
