abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of video image processing and pattern recognition, in particular to a method and a device for recognizing evacuees under indoor smoke shielding, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sample set of evacuated people under the shielding of indoor smoke; constructing an evacuation personnel feature extraction network model, comprising: the system comprises a local-global transition parallel module, a local-global enhancement interaction module and a multi-scale feature parallel extraction module; inputting the sample set into a local-global transition parallel module, a local-global enhancement interaction module and a multi-scale feature parallel extraction module to obtain an evacuation personnel feature map; training the evacuator feature extraction network model according to the evacuator feature map to obtain a trained evacuator feature extraction network model; acquiring image data of evacuees to be identified, inputting the image data into a trained evacuee feature extraction network model, and acquiring an evacuee identification result. By adopting the method and the device, the accuracy of identifying the evacuated personnel in the indoor smoke scene can be improved.

title_en: Colliery is wind water and is taken out conversion equipment in pit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mine gas disaster management, in particular to a coal mine underground wind-water extraction conversion device. The invention provides the underground coal mine wind and water pumping conversion device which can be used for pre-pumping gas in a hole by switching states at any time according to requirements in the construction and drilling process, is simple to operate and has high safety performance. The underground coal mine wind and water extraction conversion device comprises a drill rod butt joint pipe, a communicating pipe, a wind and water extraction mechanism and a pressure release mechanism, wherein the right part of the drill rod butt joint pipe is connected with the communicating pipe, the wind and water extraction mechanism is arranged on the communicating pipe, and the pressure release mechanism is arranged on the wind and water extraction mechanism. According to the invention, the hand wheel is rotated to drive the conversion disc to rotate on the fixed frame, so that the channels in the conversion disc are respectively in butt joint with the air supply pipe, the water supply pipe and the negative pressure pipe, and the effects of pre-pumping gas in the hole in the process of construction drilling by switching states at any time according to requirements can be achieved, and the operation is simple and the safety performance is high.
assignees: HUAIBEI MINING IND CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Energy equipment management control system based on comprehensive electric power energy data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy equipment management control, in particular to an energy equipment management control system based on comprehensive electric power energy data. The system comprises a data monitoring module and a management regulation module. According to the invention, a data early warning comparison model is established through the data monitoring module, abnormal data corresponding to each abnormal result is acquired, a training set is planned to carry out abnormal data training, the priority of the abnormal result adapted to the abnormal data is determined, the abnormal result with the highest priority is selected as the current estimated abnormal data prediction result, the management and control module is combined with the abnormal data prediction result to plan an abnormal result adaptation solution, and the solution is formulated in time, so that the emergency response time of the system is reduced.
assignees: BEIJING TIANHENG ANKE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Expressway tunnel fire evacuation research method and system considering uncertainty
abstract_en: The application discloses a highway tunnel fire evacuation research method and system considering uncertainty, and relates to the technical field of tunnel emergency safety, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing the evacuation characteristics and the evacuation uncertainty of tunnel fires based on highway tunnel fire evacuation cases; constructing an evacuation behavior uncertainty quantitative model, and inputting the model by using a fuzzy tool box based on MATLAB; setting up a simulation model, setting up a scene through tunnel space meshing, constructing an evacuation rule based on a floor field model, and introducing an evacuation behavior uncertainty quantitative model into evacuation behavior selection; and carrying out simulation experiments of typical scenes and single-factor control fixed scenes in different cross-hole intervals, carrying out sensitivity analysis on the results of the single-factor control experiments, and determining influence factors of evacuation uncertainty. The application is helpful to reveal the uncertainty influencing factors and the influencing mechanism of crowd evacuation under the fire disaster of the highway tunnel, so that the evacuation simulation result is closer to the actual evacuation behavior.
assignees: CHINA COMMUNICATIONS 2ND HIGHWAY SURVEY DESIGN & RES INST

title_en: Machine learning and creep law fusion long-term settlement prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-term settlement prediction method integrating machine learning and creep rules, which relates to the technical field of information and comprises the following steps of preprocessing settlement data through an aging weight coefficient, fitting the settlement data through a neural network, and realizing long-term settlement prediction through a creep formula: s1: obtaining sedimentation data and inverting creep parameters; s2: building a machine learning model; s3: training strategies and designing evaluation indexes; s4: and (5) predicting long-term sedimentation. Compared with the existing method, the long-term settlement prediction method integrating machine learning and creep rules has higher precision, wider application range, more complete theoretical support and simpler calculation flow, and can better provide scientific basis for settlement disaster prevention.

title_en: Climbing mechanism for fire emergency training
abstract_en: The application provides a climbing mechanism for fire emergency training, which is applied to fire training and comprises the following components: climbing ropes are arranged on the surface wall of the climbing wall, and windows are arranged in the climbing wall; the utility model provides a protection component, the inner wall at the window of protection component indent, protection component includes first guard plate, first guard plate indent is at the window inner wall, one side of first guard plate is equipped with the second guard plate, the second guard plate is attached at window and climbing wall crossing department lateral wall, relate to fire control trainer technical field, wherein, the window has been seted up inside the climbing wall, be equipped with protection component in the inside of window, protection component includes first guard plate and second guard plate, first guard plate is located the inner wall of window, the second guard plate is located the exterior wall of climbing wall and window, can protect the firefighter of training under the combined action of first guard plate and second guard plate, avoid the firefighter of training because misoperation and window direct collision's problem.

title_en: Novel simulated flame skirting line warmer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel simulated flame skirting line warmer, which comprises a shell component, an isolation net, a fog outlet cover, a fog outlet, a control panel, a mounting plate, a first mounting hole, a second mounting hole, a third mounting hole, a bottom shell, a simulated flame component, a cover plate, a lamp band, a baffle plate, a water box, a sprayer, an anti-toppling switch, a supporting foot, an air inlet net, a control main plate, a heating plate and a heat collecting cover, wherein the anti-toppling switch is utilized to timely disconnect a power supply when the warmer topples, so that fire disasters are avoided; the atomizer is utilized to spray mist to the outside in the working process of the warmer, the purpose of humidifying air is achieved, and meanwhile, the cover plate and the lamp belt are matched with the atomizer to achieve the effect of simulating flame, so that warm and good comfortable user experience in visual sense is brought to users; the heat emitted by the heating plate is gathered and discharged by the heat gathering cover, so that the problems of poor heating effect and overhigh temperature in the warmer are avoided.

title_en: Geological drilling investigation equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses geological drilling investigation equipment for geological disaster prevention and control, which comprises a bottom frame, wherein two movable cavities are formed in one side of the bottom frame, a push rod is penetrated through the top of each movable cavity in a sliding manner, a sliding plate fixed with the bottom end of the push rod is connected in the movable cavity in a sliding manner, a connecting rod is connected to one side, far away from the push rod, of the sliding plate in a rotating manner, a spring is connected to one inner side wall of each movable cavity, a through hole is formed in the other side wall of each movable cavity, and a lock rod is connected to the through hole in a sliding manner. According to the utility model, before the equipment moves, the mounting block of the protective baffle plate can be inserted into the mounting groove for mounting, so that the drill bit and the drill rod are prevented from being damaged due to impact in the moving process, the screw thread block can be rotated to erect the ground nail, and the rotary table is rotated to enable the ground nail to drill into the ground, so that the equipment can be stabilized, and the position deviation during the working process is avoided.
assignees: GUANGDONG JINDONG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Special movement starting training device for fire control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special fire-fighting carrying and starting training device, and relates to the field of physical training equipment for actual combat of firefighters. The utility model comprises a chassis main body and a frame, wherein an adjusting component is arranged in the frame, the adjusting component comprises a mounting column, a screw is arranged on the mounting column, a thread block is connected to the outer side of the screw in a threaded manner, mounting frames are arranged on two sides of the thread block, and weight barbell pieces are arranged on the inner sides of the mounting frames.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;NANJING KUNBAO SAFETY PROT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster landslide slip surface drilling sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drilling and sampling device for a landslide sliding surface of a geological disaster, which relates to the technical field of soil sampling and comprises a frame and a sampling cylinder, wherein a detachable mounting structure is connected between the sampling cylinder and a driving mechanism; through the sampling tube that half section of thick bamboo one of detachable and half section of thick bamboo two are constituteed, with half section of thick bamboo one and half section of thick bamboo two-phase separation after soil sampling, conveniently take out inside soil, and be difficult for destroying the originally relevant characteristic of appearance soil, thereby be favorable to the detection analysis of later stage, through the cooperation of fixed block and fixing bolt, during the sample, utilize fixing bolt to fix two fixed blocks relatively, thereby make half section of thick bamboo one and half section of thick bamboo two constitute a complete drum, through the cooperation setting of spacing slider and spacing spout, can guarantee half section of thick bamboo one and half section of thick bamboo two constitution's drum's bulk strength, be difficult for taking place the separation at the sampling process.
assignees: NINGXIA GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Hydrologic information prediction method and system based on regional drainage basin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional watershed-based hydrologic information prediction method and a regional watershed-based hydrologic information prediction system, and relates to the technical field of water environment monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: basic geographic information of a river basin of a target area is collected, and a river basin twin network is constructed; carrying out risk rule analysis according to the disaster data of the historical area, extracting a plurality of key monitoring anchor points and dividing a plurality of local area monitoring grades according to analysis results; embedding a plurality of key monitoring anchor points and a plurality of local area monitoring grades into a drainage basin twin network, and training to obtain an area hydrologic monitoring network; a monitoring equipment module is arranged to acquire real-time hydrologic information; performing regional hydrologic information simulation prediction by using a regional hydrologic monitoring network to obtain a hydrologic information prediction result; and carrying out hydrologic disaster early warning according to the hydrologic information prediction result. The method solves the technical problem of low accuracy of hydrologic information prediction when facing a complex river basin in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of improving the accuracy of hydrologic information prediction results of the complex river basin.
assignees: HENAN XINYANG HYDROLOGY WATER RESOURCE DETECTING CENTER

title_en: Prediction method for flood flooding and yield loss of paddy rice in polder region
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting flood and water withdrawal and yield loss of paddy rice in a polder region. The method for predicting the flood waterlogging and yield loss of paddy rice in the polder region comprises the following steps: s1: collecting the data of the annual rainfall and flood disasters in the polder area, calculating the average rainfall for years and discharging frequency, obtaining the easy waterlogging period of the polder area, and selecting the rice type and the growth period of the rice type according to the easy waterlogging period as a time node of a specific waterlogging test of the rice; s2: and (3) carrying out a rice flooding and water withdrawal test: and (3) carrying out flooding and water-withdrawal treatment on the rice by using a water level automatic control device for a plant flooding test. The method for predicting the flood and the damage of paddy rice in the polder area has the advantages that the paddy rice yield under different flood and water withdrawal process change conditions is obtained by carrying out a flood and water withdrawal simulation test in a paddy rice flood easy period, a function model is built based on the flood and the yield, the yield loss of different flood and water withdrawal is obtained, and then a proper paddy rice flood and water withdrawal scheme and yield loss prediction are provided.
assignees: JIANGXI GANFU PINGYUAN HYDRAULIC ENGINEERING MAN BUREAU JIANGXI IRRIGATION TEST CENTER STATION

title_en: Analysis method for risk of induced disasters of near-fault mining of working face
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rock mechanics and fault sliding analysis, in particular to a method for analyzing the risk of induced disasters of near fault exploitation of a working face, which comprises the following steps: acquiring rock stratum physical and mechanical parameters, and constructing a three-dimensional numerical calculation model in finite element numerical simulation software based on the rock stratum physical and mechanical parameters; simulating exploitation by setting measuring points on the three-dimensional numerical calculation model, and obtaining fault damage variables in the exploitation process and strain energy density and displacement change conditions of the measuring points; and on the basis of the fault damage variable, the strain energy density and the displacement change condition of the measuring point, carrying out risk classification on dynamic disasters in the process of pushing the simulated mining working face from far to near faults, and completing analysis on the risk of the induced disasters of the near fault mining for the working face. The invention can better analyze the fault sliding in the exploitation process, thereby providing a theoretical basis for quantitative analysis of the fault sliding.

title_en: Disaster emergency auxiliary decision-making method, disaster emergency auxiliary decision-making device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster emergency, and discloses a disaster emergency auxiliary decision-making method, a disaster emergency auxiliary decision-making device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring disaster problem text, wherein the disaster problem text comprises disaster problem scene data, and the disaster problem scene data comprises fluid dynamics data; inputting the disaster problem text into a pre-established cognitive model, and generating OpenFOAM input data related to disaster problem scene data; creating an OpenFOAM model by using OpenFOAM input data; and running a solver in the OpenFOAM model through a pre-established script or an automation tool, and simulating a disaster evolution process based on disaster problem scene data to obtain a disaster scene simulation result. The simulation model is built through participation of the cognitive model, simulation efficiency is improved, the disaster evolution process simulated through the simulation model is more accurate, and disaster emergency measures obtained based on simulation results are more effective.

title_en: Numerical simulation method for underground vehicle base fire-fighting lane top opening scheme
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire prevention and control simulation, in particular to a numerical simulation method for a scheme for opening holes at the top of a fire control lane of an underground vehicle base, which is used for creating a plurality of corresponding structural models of the underground vehicle base application library and the fire control lane based on structural parameters of an underground vehicle base building structure and a plurality of preset different opening schemes; performing grid division and boundary condition setting in a first simulation tool, performing numerical simulation to obtain an underground vehicle base internal environment parameter and available safe evacuation time T  ASET , setting evacuation stairs, a safe exit and personnel action characteristic parameters in a second simulation tool, and performing numerical simulation to obtain necessary safe evacuation time T  RSET ; and calculating according to environment parameters, available safe evacuation time and necessary safe evacuation time in the underground vehicle base corresponding to different tapping schemes to obtain an optimal tapping scheme. The method is more efficient, convenient, reasonable and effective, and is more close to engineering practice.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIFTH SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD;SUZHOU RAIL TRANSIT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting bending bearing capacity of longitudinal joint of shield tunnel segment in bolted connection mode
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting bending bearing capacity of a longitudinal joint of a shield tunnel segment in a bolt connection mode, which comprises the following steps: dividing the pressure bearing process of the segment longitudinal joint into a core concrete full-section pressure bearing stage, a core concrete pressure bearing stage below a bolt, a core concrete pressure bearing stage above the bolt and a joint pressure bearing stage of outer edge concrete and core concrete according to the operation working condition of the shield machine; and carrying out stress balance analysis on each stage to obtain a bending bearing capacity analysis formula of each stage. According to the invention, through theoretical formulas based on 4 stages of the pipe piece longitudinal joint bearing process and the height influence coefficient of the outer edge concrete pressed area, a theoretical analysis model for calculating the whole process of the shield tunnel pipe piece bolt connection longitudinal joint bearing is provided, the mechanical state of the pipe piece joint under any load action can be analyzed by using the model, the simulation result and the theoretical solution fit degree are good, and a theoretical basis can be provided for joint design and disaster prediction.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 14TH BUREAU GROUP SHIELD ENG CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-scale attribute characterization and penetration disaster evaluation system and method for tunnel fracture rock mass
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a system and a method for multi-scale attribute characterization and penetration disaster evaluation of a tunnel fracture rock mass, which relate to the technical field of underground structure evaluation and comprise the following steps: respectively extracting large-scale crack data and medium-scale crack data, and respectively modeling; fusing fracture attribute models of different scales, extracting multi-scale fracture characteristics from local and global angles based on CNN and Swin transformer network structures, introducing a t distribution self-focusing mechanism into the Swin transformer as priori knowledge, extracting accurate spatial characteristics of the fracture, using a full connection layer to promote mapping of input data to a weight space, carrying out up-sampling reconstruction through transposed convolution, outputting a multi-scale fracture attribute image, and constructing the multi-scale fracture attribute model; and acquiring permeability data of the underground structure, acquiring spatial distribution information of permeability, establishing a relation model between the fracture fusion attribute and the permeability, performing numerical simulation on the underground structure, and performing disaster assessment on the underground structure.

title_en: Nuclear power plant disaster prevention methods and systems for performing them
title_ko: 원자력 발전소 방재 방법 및 이를 수행하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster prevention method for a nuclear power plant and a system for performing the same, wherein the disaster prevention method for a nuclear power plant collects local real-time radioactivity numerical information on the inside, site, or periphery of a nuclear power plant by using a drone equipped with a radioactivity measuring device capable of measuring radioactivity, calculates a radioactivity diffusion map and an evacuation route by integrating weather information on the site through a wind direction anemometer operating together, and guides the evacuation route through a communication network. The disaster prevention method for a nuclear power plant can drive an optimal drone and drone station in the event of a nuclear power plant disaster and can operate the system correctly by preparing various programs for each situation and checking and commanding appropriate information. The disaster prevention method for a nuclear power plant can verify a nuclear power plant disaster evacuation system by optimizing the evacuation route through simulation, and furthermore, can generate and utilize big data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사능을 측정할 수 있는 방사능 측정 장치를 장착한 드론을 활용하여 원자력 발전소 내부 또는 부지나, 주변부에 대한 국지적 실시간 방사능 수치 정보를 수집하고, 함께 작동하는 풍향풍속계를 통해 현장의 기상 정보를 통합하여 방사능 확산 지도와 대피로를 산출하여, 통신망을 통해 대피로를 안내하기 위한 원자력 발전소 방재 방법 및 이를 수행하는 시스템에 대한 것으로, 원전 재난시 최적의 드론 및 드론 스테이션을 구동할 수 있으며, 다양한 상황별 프로그램을 구상하여 적합한 정보를 확인 및 명령함으로써 시스템을 올바르게 작동하고자 하고, 시뮬레이션을 통해 대피로를 최적화하여 원전재난 대피 시스템을 검증하고, 나아가 빅데이터 생성 및 활용을 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Big Data-Based Port Infrastructure Control System Data Linkage System For Port Infrastructure Disaster And Aging Digital Twin Construction
title_ko: 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후도 디지털 트윈 구축을 위한 빅데이터 기반 항만 인프라 관제 시스템 데이터 연계 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a big data-based port infrastructure control system data linkage system for port infrastructure disaster and aging digital twin construction, which can intuitively monitor the current state of the port infrastructure and the situation required for maintenance through virtual reality, and can monitor the port infrastructure through big data-based aging and disaster risk evaluation, analysis, and visualization by predicting the occurrence situation due to disaster occurrence and aging through digital twin-based simulation and establishing an immediate policy decision-making system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 항만인프라의 현재 상태 및 유지관리 필요 상황을 가상현실을 통해 직관적으로 모니터링 가능한 관제 시스템과, 디지털 트윈 기반 시뮬레이션으로 재해 발생 및 노후화에 의한 발생 상황을 예측하고 즉각적인 정책적 의사결정 시스템 구축하여, 빅데이터 기반 노후도 및 재해위험도 평가와 분석, 가시화를 통한 항만 인프라 모니터링할 수 있는, 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후도 디지털 트윈 구축을 위한 빅데이터 기반 항만 인프라 관제 시스템 데이터 연계 시스템을 제안한다.

title_en: crisis-response drill and evaluation system using metabus
title_ko: 메타버스를 이용한 위기대응훈련 및 평가 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is to enhance the effectiveness of crisis-response training by integrating related technologies, enabling officials or citizens to recognize the risks of crisis situations and engage in realistic crisis-response drills within a metaverse environment. The crisis-response drill and evaluation system using the metaverse comprises: a step of constructing a three-dimensional (3D) or two-dimensional (2D) metaverse space based on digital data of actual buildings or physical environments; a step in which a supervisor and one or more users connect to the metaverse space via terminals, and through a supervisor or user interface, enable interaction among user avatars, articiail intelligence (AI) avatars, disaster elements, disaster prevention facilities and tools, and rescue components; and a step in which the supervisor observes, records, and evaluates the interactions between the users, AI avatars, and the respective elements. According to the present invention, the training process can be monitored and recorded, and the extent of simulated damage can be assessed to refine and improve crisis-response strategies.
abstract_ko:
실제 건물 또는 공간의 디지털 데이터를 기초로 구축된 3D 또는 2D의 메타버스 공간에 감독자 및 사용자 또는 다수의 사용자가 PC, 모바일 또는 VR기기 등의 단말을 통해 접속하고, 감독자 또는 사용자 UI를 사용하여, 사용자 아바타, AI 아바타, 재난요소, 방재설비와 방재도구요소, 구조요소가 상호작용 함으로써 위기상황대응 훈련을 구현하는 단계; 및 
상기 사용자 및 AI 아바타와 각 요소들의 상호작용을 감독자가 관찰, 녹화 및 평가하는 단계를 포함하는 메타버스를 이용한 위기상황 대응 훈련 및 평가 시스템. 
본 발명에 따르면, 실제를 모방한 메타버스 공간에서 재난 상황을 재현함으로써 사용자들에게 보다 현실감 있는 위기상황 대응 훈련을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 훈련 과정을 조망 또는 녹화하고, 피해정도를 산정하여 평가함으로써, 위기상황 대응방안을 보완 및 개선할 수 있다. 
또한, 녹화한 자료를 통해 시설 이용객들을 위한 위기상황 대응 안내 자료로 사용할 수 있다. 
또한, 짧은 시간 안에 반복적이고 다양한 위기상황 대응을 훈련하고 그 결과를 얻음으로써 사용자의 흥미를 제고할 수 있다. 
또한, 메타버스 공간을 갱신함으로써, 훈련에 재활용될 수 있다.

title_en: VR Nozzle System for Virtual Fire Training
title_ko: 가상 소방훈련을 위한 vr 관창 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a VR nozzle system that may perform realistic virtual firefighting training through a real-world-based controller in a virtual reality by integrating an active marker of a location tracking device and a nozzle controller. The VR nozzle system comprises: a handle change detection unit (130) that detects a change in the forward and backward rotation of a nozzle handle (19) and adjusts the amount of water sprayed through the nozzle of the VR firefighting nozzle according to the detected change in rotation; a nozzle change detection unit (120) that detects a change in the straight line length according to the rotation of a nozzle (13) and adjusts the water spraying mode through the nozzle of the VR firefighting nozzle according to the change in length; an active marker (140) that allows tracking the position of the firefighting nozzle (10) through optical location tracking; and a nozzle controller (100) that includes a data processing board (110).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위치 추적 장비의 액티브 마커와 관창 컨트롤러를 융합하여 가상현실에서 실물기반의 컨트롤러를 통해 가상 소방훈련을 수행할 수 있는 VR 관창 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 VR 관창 시스템은 몸체(11)의 일측에 형성되는 손잡이(12)와, 상기 몸체(11)에 회전 가능하게 힌지 결합되어 전후로 회전 가능한 관창 핸들(19)과, 상기 몸체(11)의 전면에 형성되어 회전시 회전 운동을 직선 운동으로 변환하는 관창 노즐(13)이 포함된 소방 관창(10)을 이용하여 가상 소방훈련을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 VR 관창 시스템으로, 상기 소방 관창(10)에는 상기 관창 핸들(19)에 설치되어, 관창 핸들(19)의 전후 회전 변화를 감지하여 감지된 회전 변화에 따라 VR 소방 관창의 노즐을 통해 분사되는 주수량을 조절할 수 있도록 해주는 핸들 변화 감지부(130)와, 상기 관창 노즐(13)에 설치되어, 관창 노즐(13)의 회전에 따른 직선 길이 변화를 감지하여 길이 변화에 따라 VR 소방 관창의 노즐을 통한 물의 분사 모드를 조절할 수 있도록 해주는 노즐 변화 감지부(120)와, 상기 소방 관창(10)의 일측에 설치되어, 광학식 위치 추적을 통해 소방 관창(10)의 위치를 추적할 수 있게 해주는 액티브 마커(140)와, 상기 핸들 변화 감지부(130)와 노즐 변화 감지부(120)를 통하여 감지되는 신호를 무선 통신부(350)를 통해 원격의 소방훈련 서버(300)에 전송하는 데이터 처리보드(110)가 포함된 관창 컨트롤러(100)가 구비되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: IPOP CO LTD;UNIV JEONJU IND UNIV COOP

title_en: Experience service providing system for marine natural disaster based of virtual reality and method thereof
title_ko: 가상 현실 기반의 해양자연재해 체험 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a virtual reality-based marine natural disaster experience system and a method thereof. the virtual reality-based marine natural disaster experience method performed by a server comprises the steps of: determining whether a marine natural disaster theme is executed during the execution of a marine leisure theme; and executing an accident response theme for the response of an experiencer to the marine natural disaster theme when the marine natural disaster theme is executed, wherein a marine natural disaster experience service can be guided to the experiencer in a non-face-to-face manner by a guide character.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상 현실 기반의 해양자연재해 체험 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다. 상기 방법은, 서버에 의해 수행되는 가상 현실 기반의 해양자연재해 체험 방법에 있어서, 해양레저테마 실행 중 해양자연재해테마의 실행여부를 판단하는 단계; 및 상기 해양자연재해테마가 실행된 경우 상기 해양자연재해테마에 대한 체험자의 대처에 대한 사고대응요령테마를 실행하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 해양자연재해 체험 서비스는 가이드 캐릭터에 의해 비대면으로 체험자에게 가이드할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster response clinical simulation method and system using virtual reality
title_ko: 가상현실을 이용한 재난상황 대처 임상시뮬레이션 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A clinical simulation method and system for responding to a disaster situation using virtual reality are disclosed. A clinical simulation method for responding to a disaster situation performed on a computing device according to one aspect of the present invention includes: a step of setting one or more virtual emergency patients according to a disaster situation set as virtual reality; a step of providing an interface for emergency patient response practice in which a practitioner connected to virtual reality performs emergency treatment and severity classification on a virtual emergency patient and transports the patient to a hospital; and a step of providing the results of the emergency patient response practice performed by the practitioner to an administrator terminal.
abstract_ko: 가상현실을 이용한 재난상황 대처 임상시뮬레이션 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일측면에 따른 컴퓨팅 장치에서 수행되는 재난상황 대처 임상시뮬레이션 방법은, 가상현실로서 설정된 재난상황에 따른 하나 이상의 가상응급환자를 설정하는 단계; 가상현실에 접속한 실습자가 가상응급환자에 대한 응급처치와 중증도 분류를 수행하여 병원으로 이송하도록 하는 응급환자대응 실습을 위한 인터페이스를 제공하는 단계; 및 실습자가 수행한 응급환자대응 실습에 따른 실습결과를 관리자단말로 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Augmented reality clinical simulation system and method for medical practice
title_ko: 응급상황 대처 실습을 위한 증강현실 임상시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method of augmented reality clinical simulation for emergency response practice. According to one aspect of the present invention, the augmented reality clinical simulation system for emergency response practice comprises: a patient device for practice in which a patient state is set; one or more trainee devices worn by a trainee to output treatment guide information in augmented reality according to the patient state; one or more medical assistance devices; and a central control unit that sets the patient state and provides treatment guide information to the trainee device, identifies the medical assistance device, and processes the same so that the corresponding medical information or virtual medical equipment can be confirmed in augmented reality on the trainee device to correspond to the medical assistance device.
abstract_ko: 응급상황 대처 실습을 위한 증강현실 임상시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일측면에 따른 응급상황 대처 실습을 위한 증강현실 임상시뮬레이션 시스템은, 환자상태가 설정되는 실습용 환자장치; 실습자가 착용하여 환자상태에 따른 치료가이드정보를 증강현실로 출력하는 하나 이상의 실습자장치; 하나 이상의 의료보조장치; 및 환자상태를 설정하고, 실습자장치로 치료가이드정보를 제공하되, 의료보조장치를 식별하여 상응하는 의료정보 또는 가상의료장비를 의료보조장치에 대응되도록 실습자장치에서 증강현실로 확인할 수 있도록 처리하는 중앙제어장치를 포함한다.
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND;NGARDEN CO LTD

title_en: Active explosion venting system for explosion door of coal mine air shaft in advance and working method of active explosion venting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-active explosion venting system for an explosion door of a coal mine air shaft and a working method thereof; the active explosion venting system comprises an explosion-proof door and a control mechanism, wherein the explosion-proof door is arranged at the outer side of the air wellhead, and the control mechanism is connected with the explosion-proof door and drives the explosion-proof door to open and close through the control mechanism; the working method comprises the following steps: s1, a monitoring computer receives monitoring data and judges whether the underground working environment is in a normal state or not; s2, when explosion disaster occurs, the monitoring computer sends an explosion-proof door opening instruction to the explosion venting controller and opens the explosion-proof door; s3, after explosion disaster is over, the monitoring computer sends an explosion vent closing instruction to the explosion venting controller and closes the explosion vent; s4, when the fan fails, the explosion venting controller opens the explosion door to realize natural ventilation; s5, when ventilation exercise is carried out on the mine, whether the opening and closing of the explosion door are normal or not is tested through a monitoring computer or a manual control switch group.

title_en: Fire thermal imaging analysis method and system based on artificial intelligence enhancement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire thermal imaging analysis method and a fire thermal imaging analysis system based on artificial intelligence enhancement, wherein the fire thermal imaging analysis method comprises the steps of acquiring initial thermal imaging data acquired by a fire scene; and inputting the target thermal imaging data into a target fire thermal imaging analysis model obtained by training in advance to obtain a fire analysis result. The target thermal imaging analysis model can be utilized to carry out reliable analysis of the thermal imaging data of the fire disaster, and the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of the thermal imaging data analysis are improved.

title_en: Portable experimental device for dangerous chemicals and experimental method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of experimental detection, and provides a portable experimental device for dangerous chemicals and an experimental method thereof. The method comprises the steps of receiving and processing field data of a portable device, comparing the field data with database information, training a chemical reaction prediction model by using a random forest model, predicting real-time detection data, and immediately sharing test experiment results to each mobile terminal so as to realize quick information transmission and sharing. The accuracy of the fire scene experiment detection is improved, the efficiency of the scene emergency response is also enhanced, and powerful technical support is provided for the fire scene experiment detection, prevention and rescue work.
assignees: URBAN SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENT SCIENCE INSTITUTE BEIJING INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Geological disaster displacement monitoring device based on geological analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster displacement monitoring device based on geological analysis, and relates to the technical field of geological displacement monitoring. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the monitoring mechanism, the second servo motor is started to drive the rotating gear to move on the fixed rack, so that the shell is lifted in the fixed cylinder until the locating pin enters the locating groove, the first servo motor is started to drive the threaded shaft to rotate, the threaded shaft is driven to drive the drill rod to move outwards of the fixed pipe, the baffle plate is driven to move upwards through the rotating cover to open the jack until the drill rod penetrates through the jack to be inserted into geology in the moving process, at the moment, the displacement driver in the drill rod can detect geology, when geology with different depths is detected, a user drives the shell and the drill rod to lift by using the remote controller, and then the drill rod with the displacement driver is inserted into the geology to be detected, so that the operation is simple.

title_en: Geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system for mining exploitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and a geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction system for mining exploitation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: data acquisition and processing, data storage and management, feature extraction, model training and optimization, and emergency response and early warning optimization. The invention belongs to the technical field of geological engineering, in particular to a geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system for mining exploitation, wherein the scheme adopts a radar interferometry technology and an arctangent time interferometry method to measure the surface deformation of a mining area and provide more complete geological information; the large data distributed storage system is adopted to store and process the geological information, so that the operation efficiency of the system is improved; and the depth convolution neural network model is adopted to extract and distribute the characteristics of the data, and a random inactivation layer is arranged, so that the generalization capability of the depth convolution neural network model is improved.

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on an attention mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of crowd evacuation computer simulation. Comprising the following steps: acquiring a real evacuation scene, constructing an evacuation simulation scene model based on the real evacuation scene, and initializing the evacuation simulation scene model through crowd basic information; grouping the crowd to be evacuated, selecting a leader and a follower of each group, and acquiring an evacuation path of the crowd to be evacuated through a double-layer path planning method based on an evacuation simulation scene model; at the top layer, global path planning is carried out on a leader through MADDPG algorithm introducing a multi-head attention mechanism, and an optimal path is obtained; and at the bottom layer, the follower is regarded as an intelligent body to carry out obstacle avoidance planning through an obstacle avoidance algorithm, so that the follower can follow the leader to evacuate along an optimal path at an optimal collision-free speed. The system can better guide people to evacuate, improve evacuation efficiency and solve the problem of low evacuation simulation efficiency of the existing people.

title_en: Tunnel roof stability advanced early warning method based on LSTM
abstract_en: The invention discloses an LSTM-based advanced early warning method for stability of a tunnel roof, and belongs to the field of mine roof disaster monitoring and early warning. Acquiring two types of monitoring data of anchor rod and anchor cable supporting resistance and roof separation value; extracting data of an anchor rod and anchor cable stress gauge and a roof separation layer instrument with the best correlation at the same position; compression segmentation is carried out on the extracted anchor rod and anchor cable stress meter data and the roof separation layer instrument data; fusing anchor rod and anchor cable stress meter data and roof separation instrument data, and dividing a training set and a testing set; constructing an LSTM-based anchor rod and anchor cable supporting resistance-roof separation layer value correlation model; and finally, predicting the stability of the roof by giving real-time monitoring data of the supporting resistance of the anchor rod and the anchor cable of the training model and the roof separation value, so as to realize advanced early warning of disaster caused by instability of the roof of the roadway. The method fuses the anchor rod and anchor cable supporting resistance-roof separation related data and constructs a roof stability prediction model, ensures the advance of early warning, and reduces the serious loss caused by untimely early warning.

title_en: Railway disaster simulation evaluation deduction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway disaster simulation evaluation deduction method and a system, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster early warning, and are used for constructing and managing a railway disaster scenario chain library, a prevention and control strategy library and a risk evaluation algorithm library, and simultaneously establishing a disaster scenario chain, an evaluation analysis algorithm and a prevention and control strategy evaluation system; the railway disaster monitoring data are subjected to risk assessment analysis of railway meteorological environment, infrastructure state, foreign matter intrusion conditions and the like by utilizing a risk assessment algorithm component; carrying out deduction prediction based on a disaster scenario chain according to the disaster with higher risk level in the evaluation analysis module, and recommending a corresponding prevention and control strategy; and evaluating the disaster scenario chain, the evaluation analysis algorithm and the prevention and control strategy based on the evaluation component, and continuously optimizing the simulation evaluation deduction method and the system. The method effectively fills the blank of railway disaster risk assessment and deduction prediction capability, improves the railway disaster deduction prediction and risk prevention and control capability, and has good application and popularization values.

title_en: Fire scale model test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire disaster reduced scale model test device, which relates to the field of fire disaster models, and comprises a model tunnel main body, a ventilation system, a combustion system and a measurement system, wherein the model tunnel main body comprises a test platform support, the test platform support takes the ground as a supporting point, the upper part of the test platform support is connected with a rectangular tunnel, an arched exhaust flue is arranged on the rectangular tunnel, the rectangular tunnel is separated from the arched exhaust flue through an exhaust flue partition board, and a smoke outlet is arranged on the exhaust flue partition board; the ventilation system comprises a tunnel blower and a smoke exhaust fan and is arranged on the model tunnel main body; the combustion system is arranged in the model tunnel main body; the measuring system comprises a video recording mechanism; an observation window is arranged on the model tunnel main body. The utility model can intuitively observe and accurately capture the smoke spreading law through the simulation and layout design of tunnel fire, so as to achieve the purposes of simple device, high monitoring accuracy and easy capture of the smoke spreading law.

title_en: Earthquake disaster emergency scene simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of virtual simulation, in particular to a seismic disaster emergency scene simulation device, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a vibration assembly is arranged at the bottom of the bottom plate; a plurality of simulation walls are stacked on the top of the bottom plate; the top of the bottom plate is suspended with a plurality of stretching ropes which penetrate through the stacked simulation walls from top to bottom and are connected with the bottom plate; when the stretching ropes are vertically tightened, the simulation walls are sequentially stacked and arranged along the vertical direction of the stretching ropes. According to the utility model, through the structural design that the stretching ropes penetrate through the simulation wall, the function of orderly recovering and arranging the simulation wall along the vertical direction of the stretching ropes when the stretching ropes are straightened is realized, the problems of long time and high recovery difficulty in building the simulation building in the prior art are solved, the recovery speed of the simulation wall is improved, and the recovery process can be completed without large mechanical assistance.

title_en: Semiconductor gaseous molecular pollutant anomaly prediction and emergency response system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anomaly prediction and emergency response system and method for semiconductor gaseous molecular pollutants, which relate to the field of electric digital data processing, acquire historical monitoring data of the semiconductor gaseous molecular pollutants, generate images of the changes of the concentrations of various semiconductor gaseous molecular pollutants along with time, analyze various images in a concentration change image set of the pollutants by adopting an image analysis algorithm, and then carry out fitting prediction on the concentrations of the current semiconductor gaseous molecular pollutants by adopting a corresponding prediction algorithm; according to the method, the pollutant types in the pollutant type set are determined according to the historical monitoring data of the semiconductor gaseous molecular pollutants, so that the semiconductor gaseous molecular pollutants are comprehensively simulated and predicted, and the safety is improved; and a proper algorithm model is selected according to the magnitude of the image complexity value to simulate and predict the pollutant data, so that the prediction efficiency is improved.

title_en: Rain flood disaster risk map generation method and device for coupling intelligent algorithm with multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for generating a rain flood disaster risk map by coupling an intelligent algorithm with multi-source data, which can be applied to the technical fields of urban and rural planning and digital maps. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a target rain and flood disaster database by utilizing initial rain and flood disaster data of the target area; selecting the rain flood disaster recovery period data of the target area in the target time period from the target rain flood disaster data, inputting the data into a rain flood simulation model, and outputting the inundation range data and the runoff flow rate data; determining a flood disaster result and a flood disaster bearing result based on the target flood disaster data, the flooding range data and the runoff flow rate data and the flood disaster analysis model; determining a rain flood disaster risk result based on the rain flood disaster result and the rain flood disaster bearing result; and generating a rain flood disaster risk map based on the rain flood disaster risk result, so that the accuracy of calculation of the rain flood disaster risk result is improved, and the coverage range and the accuracy of the rain flood disaster risk map are further improved.

title_en: Digital twinning-based traffic emergency command method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic emergency command method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring and collecting original data in the traffic system environment, and carrying out gradient weighting filtering treatment; injecting the filtered data into a pre-constructed multi-level and multi-dimensional traffic flow digital twin model to synchronize the model state and the actual traffic flow, so as to realize the high-fidelity traffic flow simulation; carrying out real-time analysis on the digital twin model to identify potential traffic jam points or accident risk areas and calculating traffic adaptability indexes; and automatically adjusting the intervention strategy of the traffic emergency command aiming at the road section with the traffic adaptability index lower than a specific threshold value. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, real-time traffic data and environmental influence factors can be synthesized, and an efficient traffic optimization emergency command strategy is provided by taking a highly-adaptive and predictive digital twin model as a decision support system, so that the intelligent and emergency response capability of urban traffic management is remarkably improved.

title_en: Data security intelligent inspection method and system based on large language model and AI-Agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data security intelligent inspection method and system based on a large language model and AI-Agent, and relates to the technical field of data security, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, an intelligent inspection system is established, the intelligent inspection system comprises an AI-Agent, an inspection module and a central scheduling system for managing and coordinating the AI-Agent and the inspection module through an interactive interface, a user presets an inspection rule and an emergency response strategy through the interactive interface by utilizing the inspection module, and safety related data are automatically collected on a designated inspection node by utilizing the AI-Agent; pre-training LLaMA-2 models; the AI-Agent collects data flow in real time at the routing inspection node, performs semantic analysis on the collected data by using a trained LLaMA-2 model, identifies potential security threat and abnormal behavior, further triggers and starts a preset emergency response strategy, and generates a security report; and the user views the semantic analysis result and the security report through the interactive interface. The invention can realize the timely identification and response of the data security threat and effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of the data security management.
assignees: INSPUR DROSO BIG DATA IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Design method of actuating mechanism in smoke simulation device
abstract_en: A design method of an actuating mechanism in a smoke simulation device. Selecting an applicable steady-state flow field similarity criterion number; calculating steady-state rated parameters of an actuating mechanism in the smoke simulation device; preliminarily designing a sample and testing; determining rated operating parameters of an actuating mechanism of the smoke simulation device; identifying a transfer function between an excitation signal of the actuating mechanism and a smoke concentration response; assessing unsteady state adjustment capability of different operation modes on a flow field; thus, the steps such as quantitative optimization of the actuating mechanism are completed. The invention provides a systematic method, and quantitatively evaluates the adjusting capability of the actuating mechanism from two layers of steady state and unsteady state, considers the approximation capability of a steady state flow field of the smoke of a real fire disaster, considers the approximation capability of the unsteady state flow field of the smoke of the real fire disaster, provides a set of standard flow for the design of the actuating mechanism in the smoke simulation device, and can realize quantitative optimization of the actuating mechanism of the smoke simulation device.

title_en: Dynamic scheduling system and method for multi-warehouse robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-storage robot dynamic dispatching system and a method, which belong to the technical field of logistics dispatching and artificial intelligence, and build a multi-storage robot dynamic dispatching system and dispatching model and a hierarchical neural network structure based on an attention mechanism, decompose a multi-storage robot dispatching task structure, effectively reduce the action space dimension of a multi-storage robot dispatching problem, avoid dimension disasters and improve the learning efficiency of a reinforcement learning algorithm; training a layering neural network model by adopting a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, and improving the calculation solving speed of a dispatching system; the scheduling system adopts an event triggering mode to trigger the operation condition of a scheduling solving algorithm, the solving period time is not fixed, the waste of computing resources can be reduced, the data sampling during training can be accelerated, and the learning process can be accelerated; the advantage of fast reasoning speed in the deployment of the neural network is fully utilized, the task instruction can be generated in real time according to the dynamic environment state, the time required by a scheduling period is shortened, and the flexibility of a scheduling system is improved.

title_en: Multi-disaster comprehensive prevention and control method based on intelligent mine comprehensive management and control platform
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and control, in particular to a multi-disaster comprehensive prevention and control method based on an intelligent mine comprehensive management and control platform, which comprises the following steps of firstly, analyzing the danger of initial disaster occurrence by combining fusion data in a data pool of the comprehensive management and control platform; judging the dangers of multiple disasters according to the dangers of the initial disasters, simulating possible paths and influence ranges of disaster development aiming at the possible disasters, and formulating prevention and control and chain breakage measures; and thirdly, according to the disaster type, the influence range and the real-time monitoring data, an emergency plan is formulated, wherein the emergency plan comprises measures such as personnel evacuation, equipment shutdown, system isolation and the like. The method and the system can comprehensively prevent and control the multi-disaster comprehensive flow of the initial disaster prediction, prevention and control, multi-disaster possibility and risk assessment, associated disaster prevention and control, broken chain, emergency disposal, escape, rescue and the like by deeply analyzing the concept, the category and the characteristics of the multi-disaster of the mine.
assignees: TIANDI CHANGZHOU AUTOMATION CO;CHANGZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD OF CHINA COAL TECH AND ENGINEERING GROUP

title_en: Physical model test device and method for surrounding rock destruction process of underground gas storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a physical model test device and a physical model test method for an underground gas storage surrounding rock destruction process, wherein the physical model test device comprises a model sample, a test monitoring module and a model boundary, the model sample comprises a gas storage cavity and a simulated surrounding rock, the simulated surrounding rock is provided with the gas storage cavity, and an air inlet part of the gas storage cavity is provided with a pre-buried air compression pipeline penetrating through the simulated surrounding rock; the test monitoring module comprises a first monitoring module and a second monitoring module, wherein the first monitoring module is used for monitoring stress and deformation characteristics of the gas storage cavern and the simulated surrounding rock, and the second monitoring module is used for monitoring the evolution process of cracks; the model boundary comprises a flexible stress boundary and a rigid displacement boundary, which are both arranged outside the model sample and used for simulating ground stress. The invention can reveal deformation damage characteristics and disaster-causing mechanisms of surrounding rocks of the underground gas storage engineering, realize safety evaluation of the underground gas storage, and provide technical support for engineering safety construction and operation.
assignees: POWERCHINA ZHONGNAN ENG CORP LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: MR-based coal mine disaster emergency drilling evaluation method and drilling evaluation system
abstract_en: The application provides an MR-based coal mine disaster emergency drilling evaluation method and a drilling evaluation system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a preset virtual scene; projecting a preset virtual scene through the MR glasses so that the target object carries the MR glasses for emergency exercise; acquiring exercise related information under the condition that the emergency exercise of the target object is finished; acquiring evaluation scores corresponding to the exercise related information, and acquiring weight coefficients corresponding to the exercise related information; and calculating the weighted average value of all the evaluation scores and the weight coefficients to obtain a target evaluation result. The scheme solves the problems that the reality of the coal mine fire emergency drilling cannot be improved in the prior art, comprehensive evaluation analysis cannot be carried out after drilling, and the emergency capability of drilling personnel is insufficient.

title_en: Analysis method and system for strain type rock burst process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method and a system for a strain type rock explosion process, which relate to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of underground engineering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a crystal scale fine simulation model which can describe internal fine structural characteristics of the rock material and truly embody mineral particle components; the method comprises the steps of providing a three-dimensional failure criterion which can reflect the mechanical effect of the intermediate principal stress and comprehensively consider the rock tensioning and shearing failure modes; establishing a parameter calibration method capable of accurately reproducing rock blocks and random assignment of joint mechanical parameters; designing a rock burst stress path which can be related to the stress state change of the actual engineering surrounding rock; the invention overcomes the limitation that the traditional numerical simulation method based on continuous medium mechanics is difficult to simulate the discontinuous deformation mechanical behavior in the rock burst ejection damage process, effectively simulates the expansion process of the rock pull-shear crack, and realizes the accurate discrimination of the rock pull-shear crack.

title_en: Soil-stone mixture slope rainfall damage early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall damage early warning method and device for a soil-stone mixture slope, belonging to the field of slope and disaster early warning, and comprising the following steps: s1, acquiring real three-dimensional point cloud data of a side slope; s2, establishing a soil-stone mixed slope geometric model by utilizing the real point cloud data and the virtual block stone model; s3, generating a soil body intensity parameter random field; s4, simulating the damage of the soil-rock mixed slope by combining a substance point method of the random field and early warning the damage. The invention solves the problem of space variability of soil body strength parameters, can well simulate behavior of the damaged side slope, and effectively solves the modeling problem of the heterogeneous side slope.

title_en: Geological disaster emergency isolation belt
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of isolation belts and discloses an emergency isolation belt for geological disasters, which comprises a hollow column, wherein L-shaped grooves are formed in the bottom ends of the outer walls of the two hollow columns, a first rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the inner side of each L-shaped groove, a U-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the outer wall of each first rotating shaft, a second magnet is fixedly connected to the middle of the top end of each U-shaped plate, a bearing block is fixedly connected to one side of the bottom end of each U-shaped plate outwards, a drill bit is fixedly connected to the bottom end of each bearing block, a plurality of first magnets are fixedly connected to the middle lower portion of the outer wall of each hollow column, each first magnet is connected with each second magnet, and a lifting mechanism is arranged at the top end of each hollow column. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the L-shaped groove, the first rotating shaft, the U-shaped plate, the bearing block and the drill bit, the situation that the emergency isolation belt is prevented from being overturned due to external collision is realized, and meanwhile, the utilization rate of equipment is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG JINDONG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Extra-long tunnel fire source detection method based on improved depth single classification algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special tunnel fire source detection method based on an improved depth single classification algorithm, and relates to the field of target detection; s1: acquiring and manufacturing a special tunnel image dataset in a real scene; s2: labeling the extra-long tunnel images containing fire disaster in the data set; s3: training the model by using the annotation image and utilizing an improved depth sheet classification algorithm; model training: extracting local features by using SPATIAL PYRAMID Pooling (SPP) method to describe an input fire image, then training by using improved Fully Convolutional Data Description (FCDD), changing the convolution mode in Fully Convolutional Architecture (FCN) used by the method into a large-kernel convolution mode, and introducing a cost-sensitive learning method to improve the detection accuracy; s4: and applying the trained model to a special tunnel fire detection camera to realize real-time monitoring of tunnel fire. The method for detecting the tunnel fire disaster in real time achieves real-time and efficient detection of the tunnel fire disaster.
assignees: LUOYANG INST SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;UNIV HENAN SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Method for repairing ground disaster and ecologically restoring high steep rock slope of abandoned mine
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for repairing and ecologically repairing a high and steep rock slope of a waste mine, which reasonably designs excavation parameters of the slope according to the slope trend of an original landform slope line of the high and steep rock slope of the waste mine, reasonably reserves broken stone, block stone, solitary dangerous stone and rock mass in the process of excavating the slope, greatly reduces the construction cost of repairing the slope and can also reduce the disturbance of the construction process on the slope; in addition, the invention adopts a grading slope cutting, step retaining wall soil filling planting and slope drilling planting method, can permanently and effectively eliminate ground disasters, realizes high survival rate and re-green, can realize that the slope is completely covered by green planting for two to three years, and can form a natural ecological system without manual maintenance for about five years.

title_en: Early warning method and disaster reduction method for small-river-area debris flow disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning method and a disaster reduction method for a small-river-basin debris flow disaster. Aiming at the defect that the prior art can only take a rainfall index as a monitoring threshold index and limit the model precision, the invention provides the early warning method for the debris flow disaster in the small river basin. The GR4J hydrologic model is improved, the drainage basin area, the aquifer water supply degree and various geological parameters are considered, and the vegetation evaporation effect is considered. Based on the real-time water storage quantity of the small watershed and the corresponding threshold value measurement and calculation, the invention provides a disaster reduction scheme for the debris flow of the small watershed, which is a scientific metering scheme. The disaster reduction method for the drainage canal regulation can provide a foundation for the simulation research of the mathematical model of the disaster reduction of the small watershed. The method uses the water storage capacity of the river basin as a core index to reflect the water saturation state of the soil body and the disaster easily-occurring degree, and the principle of the method is more scientific.

title_en: Distributed two-dimensional coupling simulation method and system suitable for rain and flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed two-dimensional coupling simulation method suitable for a rainfall flood disaster, which relates to the field of hydraulics and river dynamics and comprises the steps of collecting topographic profile data and hydrographic meteorological data of a transformer substation area; preprocessing the collected topographic profile data and the hydrological meteorological data; establishing a one-dimensional unstable flow calculation model and a two-dimensional shallow water equation model; and designing a coupling model, coupling the one-dimensional unstable flow calculation model with the two-dimensional shallow water equation model to obtain a coupling model and verifying the coupling model. The invention adopts a distributed calculation theory, unifies the mountain torrents forming, converging and river evolution processes into a simulation system, and realizes coupling and fine simulation of different scales; according to the invention, the one-dimensional unstable flow calculation model and the two-dimensional shallow water equation model are coupled, and the advantages of the one-dimensional model and the two-dimensional model are fully utilized, so that the spatial distribution characteristic and the evolution power mechanism of the torrential flood are accurately described.

title_en: Landslide hazard evaluation method and system based on deep learning rainfall prediction result
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard evaluation method and system based on a deep learning rainfall prediction result, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting landslide vulnerability evaluation factors; calculating landslide susceptibility by using the landslide susceptibility evaluation factor, and obtaining a landslide susceptibility area map through the landslide susceptibility; training the convolution long-short-time neural network by using image data of a real echo map, and predicting regional rainfall by using the trained convolution long-short-time neural network; predicting the rainfall of the region by using an R-Z formula; and obtaining a landslide hazard evaluation result based on the area rainfall and the landslide susceptibility regional graph. According to the method, the probability of geological disasters is comprehensively judged according to the monitoring data, the rainfall prediction model and the early warning model, landslide risks of 1 hour in the future can be accurately reflected, and geological disaster risk management and control capability in a rainfall scene is improved.

title_en: Fire emergency rescue simulation training system based on VR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a VR-based fire emergency rescue simulation training system, which comprises the following architecture: the system comprises a virtual environment generation layer, a training control layer, an intelligent analysis layer and an interactive teaching layer, wherein the virtual environment generation layer provides a realistic fire scene, the training control layer manages a training process and interactive operation, the intelligent analysis layer provides behavior analysis and guidance suggestions, and the interactive teaching layer provides teaching resources and online communication functions; the system hardware structure comprises a VR helmet display, a VR handle, a tracker, a computer and sound output equipment; the system database comprises a scene database, a firefighter database and a teaching resource database. The system constructs a realistic fire scene by utilizing a three-dimensional modeling and physical engine technology through a virtual environment generation layer. The highly real simulation environment not only enables firefighters to perform actual combat simulation under safe conditions, but also can fully experience the urgency and complexity of a fire scene. The training control layer can set diversified rescue tasks, such as fire extinguishing, evacuation, search and rescue and the like, according to different training requirements. Meanwhile, the training device can also control the time lapse of the training process, simulate the emergency time pressure under the real condition, and further help firefighters to improve the coping capability in various scenes.

title_en: Method and device for determining crowded place personnel passing rate reduction formula based on Monte Carlo simulation
abstract_en: A method and a device for determining a crowded place personnel passing rate reduction formula based on Monte Carlo simulation relate to the field of people evacuation simulation in buildings and solve the problem of how to quantitatively calculate the reduction of the crowded personnel passing rate of crowded places. The invention provides the following scheme, which comprises the following steps: according to the calculation formula of the reduction coefficient R  Cv  of the traffic rate Cv of the crowds, determining that the key variable required for calculating the reduction coefficient R  Cv  is the total time t  sum  required for all the crowds to pass through the crowds; carrying out parameter analysis on influence factors of total time t  sum  required by crowds passing through crowds, and determining corresponding influence rules and value ranges of the influence factor parameters; respectively establishing corresponding t  sum  datasets aiming at two different crowd gathering forms; and converting the data set t  sum  into a data set of a corresponding reduction coefficient R  Cv , namely fitting the data set, and respectively fitting and determining a personnel passing rate reduction formula of two types of crowd gathering forms. The method is also suitable for the field of macroscopic evacuation simulation methods.

title_en: Method for determining steady-state speed of various crowds in real evacuation movement based on deep learning
abstract_en: A method for determining steady-state speed of various people in real evacuation motion based on deep learning relates to the field of simulation analysis of people evacuation in a building, and solves the problem of how to determine steady-state speed true values of a certain class of people from real evacuation video data conveniently and efficiently. The method comprises the steps of determining a start-stop frame number of an effective period in a real evacuation video, extracting personnel movement track data in the evacuation video based on a deep learning video extraction method, calculating effective personnel movement speed data according to the obtained start-stop frame number of the effective period and the intercepted personnel movement track, summarizing all the effective personnel movement speed data, removing abnormal values through a box graph, retaining effective personnel evacuation steady-state speed data, and carrying out statistical analysis on the remaining effective personnel evacuation steady-state speed data to determine expected values and corresponding distribution of steady-state speed data of various crowds in the real evacuation movement.

title_en: River section flow determining system and method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a river section flow determining system and method, an electronic device and a storage medium, comprising: the system comprises a data source module, a parameter setting module and a simulation calculation module, wherein the data source module and the parameter setting module are connected with the simulation calculation module; the data source module is used for acquiring geometric parameters of the section of the river channel to be tested; the parameter setting module is configured to obtain a fluid parameter of the section of the river to be measured, where the fluid parameter includes: water surface height, flow rate of at least one point and coordinates; the analog computation module is used for: determining the flow velocity distribution of the river section to be measured according to the geometric parameters and the fluid parameters; and determining the flow of the section of the river to be measured based on the flow velocity distribution, the geometric parameters and the water surface height. The system can efficiently measure the flow of the section of the complex river channel, is suitable for placing flood disaster scenes, and has strong universality.

title_en: Expressway visibility prediction method based on multi-mode multi-scale feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a highway visibility prediction method based on multi-mode multi-scale feature fusion, and belongs to the technical field of traffic weather disaster prevention and control. The method comprises six steps of data acquisition, preprocessing of sequence data and image data, feature extraction model construction, expressway visibility prediction model training and expressway visibility prediction. The method not only utilizes the data information of multiple modes to perfect the characteristic representation of single-mode data, but also excavates the change trend characteristics of visibility in multiple time scales, innovatively and simultaneously performs characteristic excavation in two dimensions of the modes and the scales, thereby realizing more accurate prediction of short-term and long-term changes of the visibility of the expressway and being easy to popularize and apply.
assignees: YUNNAN INSTITUTE OF TRANSP PLANNING AND DESIGN CO LTD;YUNNAN COMMUNICATIONS INVEST & CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation system of highway tunnel man-vehicle mixed evacuation scheme
abstract_en: The application discloses an evaluation system of a highway tunnel man-vehicle mixed evacuation scheme, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a construction module, a calculation module and an evaluation module; the construction module is used for constructing a BIM-based simulation model based on a highway tunnel, and the highway tunnel comprises: extra-long highway tunnels and long highway tunnels; the calculating module calculates available safe evacuation time and necessary safe evacuation time by using a BIM-based simulation model; the evaluation module is used for comparing the available safe evacuation time and the necessary safe evacuation time and completing the evaluation of the evacuation scheme. The application provides a fire emergency evacuation system for a separated double-hole (special) long tunnel, which is based on an evaluation system for mixed evacuation of people and vehicles in the (special) long highway tunnel of a microscopic traffic simulation technology, and realizes quantitative and visual comparison and evaluation of the emergency mixed evacuation scheme of the (special) long highway tunnel in a virtual environment.

title_en: Storm type identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for identifying heavy rain and rain, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively converting the original rainfall of the region to be detected into a preset time sequence to obtain converted rainfall corresponding to each time sub-section of each historical storm event in the time sequence; according to the diffusion information quantity of any reference rainfall, calculating to obtain the total diffusion information quantity of each reference rainfall; according to the total diffusion information amount of the reference rainfall and the reference rainfall, calculating to obtain the overrun information amount of each reference rainfall; the total diffusion information and the overrun information are used for determining a first distribution relation of the reproduction period in the time sequence; the first distribution relation is used for constructing a storm rain model and carrying out risk management simulation on the area to be detected. According to the application, by considering the diffusion of the storm information, the problem of insufficient history storm events is solved, a more accurate storm type can be obtained, and technical support is provided for urban waterlogging disaster simulation and storm disaster prevention.

title_en: Tunnel long power supply excitation polarization water detection device and method based on drilling rig carrying while drilling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunnel drilling induced polarization methods, and provides a tunnel long power supply induced polarization water detection device and method based on a drilling while drilling machine.
