The tunnel long power excitation polarization water detection device based on the while-drilling rig comprises a while-drilling power supply long power module, an array data acquisition module and a positioning and interpretation module; the while-drilling power supply long power supply module comprises a power supply long power supply and a long power supply electrode; the long power supply electrode is a drill rod of the drilling machine while drilling; the positioning and interpreting module makes difference between the tunnel induced polarization detection signals at the current moment and the last moment to obtain the data which are independently excited when the power supply at the current moment is positioned near the drill bit, and then interprets and images the data to dynamically identify the disaster water source in front of the face of the palm, realize the while-drilling and while-drilling multi-detection, shorten the time of the borehole induced polarization detection and improve the detection efficiency.

title_en: Power distribution network node identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for identifying nodes of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing fault simulation on the power distribution network state under the storm disaster based on the sample set of the history storm event and the comprehensive fault probability of the power distribution network node to obtain a fault simulation result; constructing an elastic recovery optimization model of the power distribution network based on the fault simulation result, solving the elastic recovery optimization model of the power distribution network, and determining the repair sequence of the power distribution equipment; constructing a power distribution network node identification model based on the repair sequence, and solving the power distribution network node identification model to obtain a sequencing result of the importance of the power distribution network nodes; and taking the first K power distribution network nodes in the sequencing result as target power distribution network nodes. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the weak node of the power distribution network can be identified before the occurrence of the storm disaster.

title_en: Corn disaster monitoring and ecological restoration assessment method based on multi-source remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing monitoring, in particular to a corn disaster monitoring and ecological restoration assessment method based on multi-source remote sensing data. Comprising the following steps: continuously measuring and sampling corn plots, extracting Sentinel data, and analyzing characteristic time variation; acquiring and processing high-resolution binary data to obtain a multispectral image and performing visual interpretation; establishing a sample data set of corn disaster degree; masking the Sentinel data as an input dataset; performing mask processing on the preprocessed Sentinel data, performing characteristic calculation, and creating a characteristic parameter set; constructing a random forest model; training and optimizing the random forest model to obtain a corn disaster degree monitoring model, obtaining a corn disaster degree spatial distribution result according to the model, and analyzing the corn ecological change condition to realize corn disaster monitoring. The advantages are that: and the dynamic change monitoring of the post-disaster growth of the corn is realized, and the post-disaster loss is estimated.

title_en: Tunnel fire situation prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel fire situation prediction method based on deep learning, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent detection and comprises the following steps: acquiring tunnel fire disaster video data information based on a depth camera; processing the three-dimensional coordinate point information and the time sequence information of the tunnel fire disaster video data information to obtain a processing data set; constructing a 3D convolutional neural network model, adding a bidirectional convolutional neural network into a time sequence processing layer of the 3D convolutional neural network model, and training to generate a tunnel fire situation prediction model; and inputting the processing data set into the tunnel fire situation prediction model for calculation to generate a fire situation prediction result. According to the invention, the 3D convolutional neural network is adopted, so that the space-time characteristics can be effectively captured, and the 3D convolutional neural network can automatically learn the characteristics in the space-time data without manually designing characteristic engineering.

title_en: Simulation experiment platform for concave terrain forest surface fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation experiment platform for a forest surface fire of a concave terrain, which relates to the technical field of fire scene simulation, and comprises the following components: a fixed frame, a concave experiment table and a telescopic rod; one end of the fixed frame is movably connected with one end of the concave experiment table through a hinge; the telescopic rod is arranged between the fixed frame and the concave experiment table and used for changing gradient change of the concave experiment table; the concave experiment table comprises a bottom plate and 2 side plates, wherein the 2 side plates are respectively and movably connected with the bottom plate through an angle adjusting assembly; the angle adjusting assembly comprises a fan-shaped iron sheet and a fastener, and is used for adjusting the inclination angle of the 2 side plates. The platform can be used for constructing concave structures with various gradients and side wall inclination angles, so that simulation of different concave ground fire disasters is realized.

title_en: Flood-spreading-based personnel evacuation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood-spreading-based personnel evacuation method, a flood-spreading-based personnel evacuation device, flood-spreading-based equipment and a flood-spreading-based media, which relate to the technical field of safe evacuation and comprise the steps of obtaining a hydrostatic pressure cloud picture of a target building; obtaining a hydrostatic pressure matrix at a target moment; calculating to obtain the water depth height of each position in the target building; acquiring target positions of all target personnel in a target building; determining the moving speed of each target person; determining a target evacuation outlet of a target person; guiding the target personnel to perform evacuation operation. According to the invention, through finite element simulation software, a water static pressure cloud image of an underground space under various working conditions is simulated, a one-to-one corresponding data set is constructed, an improved pix2pix model is trained and calibrated based on the constructed data set, the trained pix2pix model can accurately predict the distribution of a water-immersed underground space flow field, a pedestrian evacuation scene is established according to a prediction result, and finally, the rapid distribution and guiding targets of pedestrian evacuation outlets in advance under a water-immersed state are realized.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;GUANGZHOU METRO GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for analyzing influence factors of disaster readiness of newly-entered nurse
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for analyzing influence factors of disaster readiness of new-in nurses, and relates to the technical field of medical treatment. The personal attribute influence factor characteristics of each nurse, the expertise examination influence factor characteristics of the preparation of the target disaster, the theoretical knowledge training influence factor characteristics of the preparation of the target disaster and the skill practice influence factor characteristics of the preparation of the target disaster are fused to obtain the comprehensive feature vector of the preparation of the target disaster by the corresponding nurse, and the comprehensive feature vector of the preparation of the target disaster by the nurse can describe the processing capacity of the nurse to the target disaster more comprehensively and reliably. Further, the reliability of obtaining the initial preparation degree of the target disaster corresponding to each nurse is higher by inputting the comprehensive feature vector of the preparation of the target disaster by the plurality of nurses into the pre-trained first neural network model.

title_en: Storage battery fire early warning method and system for storage battery of storage battery car based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire early warning, in particular to a method and a system for early warning fire of a storage battery of a battery car based on data analysis. Acquiring image data of an electric vehicle environment in the surrounding environment based on an image sensor, and acquiring real-time gas data in the surrounding environment based on a gas sensor; transmitting target gas data information and the training battery car environment image data to a system by using a ZigBee wireless communication module; establishing a target YOLOv multimode fire identification model; inputting data into the target YOLOv multimode fire disaster identification model for identification to obtain real-time environment data of the battery car; if the real-time environment data of the storage battery car is judged to be in a fire pre-launch stage, a fire early-warning signal is generated, and the fire early-warning signal is transmitted to the early-warning bell device through the ZigBee wireless communication module. The method can comprehensively utilize the image data and the gas data for analysis, and combines various parameters to improve the accuracy and reliability of fire early warning of the storage battery of the battery car.

title_en: Rail transit emergency evacuation simulation analysis method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency evacuation analysis, and particularly discloses a rail transit emergency evacuation simulation analysis method, which comprises the following steps: extracting the position, the structural layout diagram and the surrounding environment data corresponding to each station outlet of the target subway station; collecting fire information of a current fire event; extracting a monitoring video and analyzing personnel flow characteristic information; building an evacuation simulation model of a target subway station, and generating each emergency evacuation path; carrying out evacuation feasibility verification of each emergency evacuation path; confirming and displaying a recommended evacuation path; the method effectively solves the problem that the current evacuation scope is considered to be limited, fully considers the interference of the corresponding evacuation effect of the personnel in the station and the personnel outside the station, expands the coverage of the evacuation efficiency evaluation environmental factors, further ensures the smoothness and safety of the evacuation process of the follow-up recommended evacuation path, and simultaneously also ensures the evacuation efficiency of the personnel in the following subway.

title_en: Rainfall inversion method based on microwave link attenuation time sequence cross-domain characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rainfall analysis based on a microwave signal processing technology, in particular to a rainfall inversion method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on microwave link attenuation time sequence cross-domain characteristics. On the basis, determining the microwave baseline attenuation under different weather conditions, calculating the path average attenuation rate, and finally inverting the path average rainfall rate. The embodiment of the invention fully excavates the cross-domain characteristics of the microwave link attenuation time sequence by utilizing the advanced signal processing technology and the deep learning model, provides finer granularity information for accurately identifying the rainfall factor, and has important significance for improving the rainfall inversion precision, improving the rainfall flood simulation capability, formulating the water disaster emergency prevention and control strategy and the like.

title_en: Deep water drilling wellhead safety detection method and device based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine learning-based deepwater drilling wellhead safety detection method and device, and relates to the technical field of oil and gas exploitation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring parameters of a target wellhead safety hidden trouble point in a carding drilling wellhead safety signal system; acquiring historical data of monitoring parameters of potential safety hazard points of a target wellhead; training and predicting by a machine learning algorithm based on historical data of monitoring parameters of potential safety hazard points of the target wellhead to obtain a wellhead safety early warning key parameter predicted value; based on the well head safety early warning key parameter predicted value, when the drilling real-time data exceeds the parameter predicted value, an early warning and emergency response suggestion is issued, and the well head safety early warning key parameter predicted value is matched with an acquisition module, a first determining module and a second determining module of the device, so that the intelligent capability of well head safety assessment and emergency response of the drilling well is improved, the well head safety early warning system can be prevented from being failed, the fault rate of the well head safety early warning system is reduced, and the reliability of the well head safety early warning system is improved.

title_en: Fire control trainer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire-fighting training device, which comprises a U-shaped frame used for being installed on the ground, wherein sliding sleeves are sleeved on two vertical parts of the U-shaped frame, limiting ropes are installed on the outer surfaces of the sliding sleeves, one ends of the two limiting ropes, which are far away from the sliding sleeves, are tethered to the surfaces of the pipe sleeves, the pipe sleeves are sleeved on fire-fighting water belts, screw rods used for limiting the relative positions of the pipe sleeves and fire gun heads are connected and connected with the upper positions of the outer surfaces of the pipe sleeves in a threaded manner, and handles are fixedly connected to one ends of the screw rods, which are far away from the pipe sleeves, of the fire-fighting training device, and the fire-fighting training device has the following beneficial effects: the swing range of the fire-fighting lance is limited, and the safety of the fire-fighting lance for controlling the hands to be taken off by a firefighter is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI ZHENGMING FIRE FIGHTING SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation electric leakage detects trainer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of leakage detection, and discloses an analog leakage detection training device which comprises a linear power supply, a PLC (programmable logic controller) control system, an alternating current contactor, a circuit breaker and a leakage generation assembly, wherein the linear power supply is electrically connected with the alternating current contactor, the alternating current contactor is electrically connected with the circuit breaker, the circuit breaker is electrically connected with the leakage generation assembly, and the PLC control system is in communication connection with the alternating current contactor. The simulation electricity leakage detection training device can restore the scene of electricity leakage possibly occurring in a fire scene to the maximum extent, such as electricity leakage fire disaster, electricity leakage electric shock and the like, then a fire-fighting training person can learn how to use an electricity leakage detection instrument and how to judge the position and degree of electricity leakage through a training facility, and can standardize the technical standard and requirement of rescue personnel, take correct measures to treat, so that the skill and skill level of the fire-fighting rescue personnel can be improved.

title_en: Service providing apparatus and method for detecting fire at construction site based on image, and fire monitoring system including the same and non-transitory computer readable medium having computer program recorded thereon
title_ko: 영상 기반 건설 현장의 화재 감지를 위한 서비스 제공 장치 및 방법, 그리고 이를 포함하는 화재 모니터링 시스템 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 비휘발성 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention is to place a fire detection device including one or more sensors for detecting fire at a construction site, and to support preventing errors in fire detection by determining whether a fire has occurred based on an image when a fire is detected through a sensor so as to reduce frequent malfunctions or evacuation situations caused by fire determination using only a sensor, thereby supporting reliable fire surveillance. Provided is the fire monitoring system for detecting fire based on a video at a construction site, comprising: a fire detection device including one or more sensor units, generating detection information based on a sensing signal received from a specific sensor unit and then determining whether an event has occurred according to a preset fire determination condition based on the detection information, and transmitting event information including a still image captured by the camera unit when an event has occurred; and a service providing device that applies a still image included in the event information to a learning model in which a correlation between an image and whether a fire has occurred for training and produces judgment result information on whether a fire has occurred based on the learning model, and generates alarm information and transmits the same to the fire detection device when a fire has been determined to have occurred based on the judgment result information. The present invention has the effect of accurately detecting the state of a fire when an actual fire occurs, thereby supporting safe evacuation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 영상 기반 건설 현장의 화재 감지를 위한 서비스 제공 장치 및 방법, 그리고 이를 포함하는 화재 모니터링 시스템 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 비휘발성 기록매체에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세히는 건설 현장에 배치된 화재 감지를 위한 하나 이상의 센서 및 카메라를 포함하는 화재 감지 장치에서 센서를 통한 화재 감지시 촬영된 영상을 기반으로 화재 발생 여부를 검증하여 화재 감지에 대한 오류를 방지하면서 정확한 화재 감지가 이루어지도록 지원하는 영상 기반 건설 현장의 화재 감지를 위한 서비스 제공 장치 및 방법, 그리고 이를 포함하는 화재 모니터링 시스템 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 비휘발성 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 화재로 오인될 수 있는 용접이나 철판 가공 등과 같은 일반적인 작업 상황이 화재 발생으로 검출되지 않도록 방지하고 센서부의 빈번한 오작동으로 인한 불필요한 대피 상황을 줄일 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 빈번한 센서 오류에 의해 센서를 끄는 행위를 방지함으로써 실제 화재 발생시 화재 발생 상태를 정확하게 검출하여 안전한 대피가 이루어지도록 지원하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Evacuation support device and evacuation support method
abstract_en: To provide an evacuation support device and a method that guide evacuation according to a situation even when it is difficult to evacuate by an assumed evacuation method.SOLUTION: A device includes: a storage unit 102 that stores a learned model that stores a relationship between attribute information of a user and training data indicating a position moved and the elapsed time in the case of an evacuation drill in which the user follows an evacuation scenario; a first transmission unit 1051 that transmits, in response to the occurrence of a disaster, an evacuation route during an evacuation drill to a terminal device 1 of the user; an acquisition unit 1061 that acquires evacuation data indicating the position and elapsed time at which the user evacuates when a disaster occurs and the user starts evacuating; a determination unit 104 that determines whether or not at least one of the location and the elapsed time differs from the location and the elapsed time indicated by the user's evacuation data by using a learned model, exceeding a reference level; and a second transmission unit 1052 that transmits guidance information to the user terminal when the reference level is exceeded.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for predicting fire disaster of moving train in tunnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for predicting a fire disaster of a moving train in a tunnel, which relate to the technical field of fire disaster information processing and comprise the steps of obtaining information, and carrying out simulation on different fire disaster scenes of the train in the train tunnel under different working conditions based on a fire disaster dynamics simulator according to the information to obtain simulation data; training a preset intelligent fire identification network model and a preset advanced temperature distribution prediction network model according to simulation data; the temperature data monitored by the temperature sensor at the current moment is input into a trained intelligent fire disaster identification network model, and the power, the position and the running speed of a train of a fire source at the future moment are output; and inputting the temperature data monitored by the temperature sensor at the current moment into a trained temperature distribution advanced prediction network model, and outputting temperature distribution data at the future moment. According to the invention, fire information and future evolution situation of fire can be obtained in real time according to the prediction result, and continuous prediction of temperature distribution is realized.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;GUANGZHOU METRO GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mine fire evacuation path planning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mine fire emergency evacuation, in particular to a mine fire evacuation path planning method and device, which are particularly suitable for mines with complex mine network, weak emergency evacuation capacity and fixed escape route, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out numerical simulation on mine fire by using a numerical simulation technology to obtain fire dynamic change data; constructing a mine network topology model; constructing a roadway equivalent length calculation model according to the fire dynamic change data, the mine network topology model and the roadway static parameters; and obtaining a mine fire evacuation path planning result according to the fire dynamic change data, the roadway equivalent length calculation model and the improved Floyd-Warshall algorithm. The systematic mine fire evacuation path planning method comprises fire numerical simulation, network topology theory, equivalent length calculation model and improved Floyd-Warshall algorithm. Compared with the traditional optimal route planning method, the evacuation route can be optimized, so that evacuees can avoid dangerous routes, and the evacuation safety level is obviously improved.

title_en: Tunnel structure deformation three-dimensional visual monitoring method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a three-dimensional visual monitoring method for tunnel structure deformation based on a digital twin technology. The method comprises the following steps: building a building information model of a target tunnel structure, and associating actual arrangement information of monitoring equipment in the target tunnel structure to the building information model; and acquiring monitoring data of the monitoring equipment in real time, and dynamically adjusting the building information model according to the monitoring data. By establishing a building information model and linking with actual monitoring data in real time, three-dimensional digital twin of tunnel structure deformation is realized, the characteristics of visualization, parameterization, diagonability, coordination and the like of the building information model are combined, multi-source fusion of monitoring, operation and decision data can be realized, and the structure evolution under the disaster condition of a tunnel and high-efficiency and accurate simulation in the aspects of emergency rescue and the like can be carried out by combining specific disaster disturbance information, so that the problems faced in the traditional tunnel safety operation and maintenance are solved.

title_en: Positioning method for full-view live-action operation deduction system
abstract_en: According to the positioning method for the full-view live-action operation deduction system, provided by the invention, hot spot binding is carried out on part of electric and mechanical equipment according to the operation simulation deduction requirement internet of things positioning service by constructing the VR panorama of the power station, so that the state update of the equipment in the exercise is ensured to be more realistic; based on the position internet of things technology without carrier communication, positioning all equipment and personnel to be positioned through the internet of things positioning service, so that updating of the position information of the equipment and the personnel in the full-view live-action model of the power station can be realized according to the actual exercise condition; meanwhile, the UWB positioning technology is combined with the VR panorama, the camera gesture is introduced, the visual angle of the user is converted into the corresponding position and direction in the panorama by using the camera gesture, the visual angle of the user in the VR environment is ensured to be consistent with the real position and direction of the user, and the positioning authenticity in the disaster relief exercise process is effectively improved.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA JIANGCHUAN CLOUD HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method for constructing tag noise robust microseismic arrival intelligent pickup model
abstract_en: A label noise robust microseismic arrival time intelligent pickup model construction method is characterized in that through designing a novel LNRL training architecture model, representations of an input seismic image and an output label can be learned at the same time, and therefore feature representation distribution relations among samples are captured. The model uses a common method of variance inference to control the distribution of feature representations, and optimizes the relationship between the feature representation distribution and the tag representation distribution by KL divergence. In addition, LNRL introduced a random fourier feature to align the representation distribution in multiple random spaces. The method can solve the problem of label noise picked up at the arrival time of the microseism in deep underground engineering, overcome the artificial marking errors from engineers in the existing microseism data and the equipment noise under severe conditions in the actual engineering environment, provide a robust solution for pickup of the arrival time of the microseism, is of great importance to geophysical applications such as underground engineering and disaster monitoring, and has wider microseism task exploration potential in future work.

title_en: Large-diameter drilling pressure relief method based on coal seam thickness
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-diameter drilling pressure relief method based on the thickness of a coal bed, and relates to the technical field of deep-buried coal bed rock burst disaster prevention and control. According to the method, the radial stress around the large-diameter drilling hole is calculated, the total amount of elastic deformation energy released before and after the large-diameter drilling hole is constructed by the coal body is determined by numerical simulation, and the pressure relief energy release rate of the large-diameter drilling hole is determined by comparing the ratio of the elastic deformation energy before and after the pressure relief of the coal body, so that the pressure relief effect under the coal layers with different thicknesses is evaluated more accurately, the full pressure relief of the coal layers with different thicknesses is realized, and the pressure relief effect of the large-diameter drilling hole is improved; according to the method, corresponding test time is saved without actual measurement on site, the drilling parameter design in the on-site production process can be guided through theoretical calculation, the drilling parameter design efficiency is greatly improved, and the method has reference value in the technical field of rock burst prevention and control.

title_en: Priori knowledge and multisource data-assisted short-term rainfall forecasting method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a priori knowledge and multisource data-assisted short-term rainfall forecasting method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source data information consisting of terrain elevation characteristic information, wind field characteristic information, temperature characteristic information and humidity characteristic information; setting a multi-source data fusion characteristic obtained after channel splicing and convolution operation of multi-source data information as an initial hiding state of a convolution gating circulation network; the multi-source data fusion is realized in the process of training the model, and the aim of the multi-source data characteristic information to assist in predicting rainfall is fulfilled; and taking the rainfall pre-training model as a teacher network, taking the convolution gating circulation network as a student network, aligning the prediction output of the teacher network and the student network and the probability distribution of the prediction output by utilizing a knowledge distillation technology, and introducing priori knowledge of the teacher network to the student network to assist rainfall forecast. The device comprises: a processor and a memory. The invention improves the prediction precision, discovers rainfall disasters in time, and reduces casualties.

title_en: Forest disaster monitoring method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest disaster monitoring method based on big data, which belongs to the technical field of big data processing, wherein a plurality of single features are subjected to feature fusion through a random weight matrix, and then a plurality of classification models are trained to further obtain an optimal weight combination; the method is independent of each other in the image preprocessing, feature extraction and normalization stage and the classification model training stage, can be executed by multitasking at the same time, and can use parallel technology to improve the operation efficiency aiming at the application scene with large data quantity and high calculation complexity; according to the method, the spatial enhancement network is used as the spatial stream of the double convolution neural network to extract and enhance the spatial information of the video, so that the initial recognition rate is improved. The forest disaster monitoring method based on big data provided by the invention has obvious effect and is suitable for wide popularization.

title_en: Water temperature-based rice low-temperature cold injury risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water temperature-based rice low-temperature cold injury risk assessment method, which comprises the following steps of: step one, constructing a water temperature simulation model; step two, constructing a comprehensive index of low-temperature cold damage of rice and determining a threshold value; thirdly, analyzing time-space distribution trend; fourth, the dangerous area of low-temperature cold injury of the rice is divided; in the first step, meteorological data comprise radiation data, air specific humidity data and saturated vapor pressure of water, and crop data are leaf area indexes of rice; according to the method, the water temperature data are obtained by constructing the water temperature simulation model, the comprehensive index is constructed by combining the water temperature data and the air temperature data by adopting the entropy weight method, and the index threshold value is determined, so that the method is used as an index for identifying the low-temperature event of the rice, the low-temperature cold damage risk model of the rice can be perfected, the condition that the rice actually suffers from low-temperature cold damage is more accurately represented, and the method is also beneficial to making a disaster prevention and reduction strategy for the cold damage of the rice in a targeted manner.

title_en: Landslide-river blockage-dam blockage-flood breaking disaster chain simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of natural disaster prevention and control, and discloses a landslide-river blockage-dam blockage-flood breaking disaster chain simulation method, which fully considers the high-speed mobility of landslide-chip flow moving along a channel and the interaction between landslide chips and water flow when flowing into a river, and carries out numerical calculation simulation on the fluid mechanics process of the landslide chip flow river blockage by a first fluid mechanics calculation model to obtain a specific distribution form of the space-time evolution of the landslide chip flow; after a dam is formed by blocking river, taking non-uniformity of dam body substances and interaction of water and soil substances in a breaking process into consideration, carrying out numerical calculation simulation on a dam breaking hydrodynamic process by a second fluid hydrodynamic calculation model to obtain a specific distribution form of space-time evolution of dam breaking fluid; therefore, the prediction result calculation accuracy is high; meanwhile, the method is favorable for providing quantitative evaluation and scientific support for the risk prediction of landslide-river blockage-dam blocking-flood breaking disaster chains.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Slope site selection planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope site selection planning method and a system, which are used for carrying out terrain analysis, soil analysis and geological analysis on an area where a first site is located according to a first preset algorithm to obtain a terrain analysis result of the area where the first site is located; according to a second preset algorithm, performing environmental impact assessment and natural disaster risk assessment on the area where the first site is located, and obtaining an environmental risk assessment result of the area where the first site is located; according to a third preset algorithm, carrying out engineering design planning and monitoring maintenance simulation on the area where the first site is located, and obtaining a construction planning result of the area where the first site is located; updating the position of the first site by respectively comparing all indexes of the area where the second site is located until all indexes of the area where the first site is located meet the preset requirement; the problem that the prior art is not fully aware of the problem that the site selection result is unreliable due to various risks of the located area in the site selection of the side slope is solved. Fully considers the influence of various risks and provides more reliable site selection results.

title_en: Low-temperature anti-freezing risk prediction system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a low-temperature antifreezing risk prediction system and a low-temperature antifreezing risk prediction method, wherein the system comprises an information acquisition module, a risk assessment module and a prediction module; the information acquisition module is used for acquiring low-temperature historical data and real-time meteorological data of the national station day-by-day temperature observation and constructing a low-temperature event library, the risk assessment module is used for assessing the risk of the low-temperature event based on the low-temperature historical data and the risk of the low-temperature event, and the prediction module is used for predicting the low-temperature process based on the low-temperature historical data and the real-time meteorological data and assessing the risk and the risk of the predicted low-temperature process. According to the application, various meteorological data and related data analysis are introduced, and accurate evaluation and timely prediction of the influence of different meteorological disasters are realized through model establishment and training.

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on multi-agent deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd evacuation simulation method and a system based on multi-agent deep reinforcement learning, which relate to the technical field of crowd evacuation simulation, and the method comprises the following steps: based on crowd evacuation scenes, establishing an evacuation scene simulation model and a pedestrian simulation model, and setting and initializing crowd evacuation parameter information; grouping the crowd, and grouping a leader and a follower in the group; taking a leader in each group as an agent, and carrying out global path planning by utilizing a multi-agent near-segment strategy optimization algorithm GRU-MAPPO combined with a gating circulation unit to output an optimal evacuation path for each agent; the follower in each group follows the leader to carry out evacuation movement, and collision in the evacuation movement process is avoided based on an optimal interaction collision algorithm; and when all pedestrians leave the exits in the evacuation scene, ending the evacuation process. The simulation crowd evacuation method can better generate the path planning strategy, reduce the time required by path planning and effectively improve the crowd evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Fire alarm method and system applied to logistics container
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire alarm, and discloses a fire alarm method and a fire alarm system applied to a logistics container, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring temperature data sensed by a plurality of temperature sensors in real time; when the existing temperature data exceeds a first temperature threshold, a fire is considered to occur; when certain temperature data is smaller than the first temperature threshold value and larger than or equal to the second temperature threshold value, a real-time temperature change curved surface is constructed by taking the moment as a starting point, similarity comparison is carried out between the real-time temperature change curved surface and a pre-stored standard temperature change curved surface, and if the similarity continuously exceeds a set threshold value within a preset time range, a fire disaster is considered to occur; the standard temperature change curved surface is obtained by simulating the temperature change of each temperature sensor in different ignition points in the container box; and determining a temperature sensor with the earliest temperature change in simulation, and taking a corresponding temperature value as a second temperature threshold value. The invention can timely sense and alarm when fire occurs at any position in the container.
assignees: JINAN BRANCH OF SHENZHEN CHANGKE SAFETY EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Surge chain life disaster evaluation method considering failure probability of reservoir landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of evaluation of inland reservoir landslide surge disaster risk, and discloses a surge chain-generated disaster evaluation method considering reservoir landslide failure probability, which comprises the following steps: step 1, defining a research area range; step 2, obtaining topographic data and rock-soil parameters according to the research objects and the range of the research area, and obtaining annual warehouse water level data and daily rainfall data in the research area; and 3, selecting a typical section of the potential landslide body, and performing 5000 Monte Carlo simulation calculations on the failure probability of the potential landslide body according to a Monte Carlo method. According to the landslide surge chain life disaster evaluation method, the potential landslide body failure probability of the landslide is introduced to reflect the influence of the failure probability of the landslide on the landslide surge chain life disaster evaluation, and the landslide failure probability, the landslide surge disaster risk and the landslide surge disaster bearing body vulnerability are multiplied to obtain the landslide surge disaster risk evaluation, so that the risk evaluation result is more reasonable, and a systematic landslide surge chain life disaster evaluation method is formed.

title_en: Debris flow risk evaluation method and device based on InSAR and power process simulation coupling
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of debris flow evaluation, and discloses a debris flow risk evaluation method and device for coupling InSAR and power process simulation. With respect to the method, it comprises: determining the spatial position and area of landslide and collapse material sources, and quantitatively estimating the volume; determining the potential source spatial position and quantitatively estimating the volume; estimating the control function of the terrain on the possible coupling of the source area and the river basin river network based on the source connectivity index; determining a silt starting position; based on the debris flow dynamic parameters and simulated by means of a debris flow simulation model, obtaining the flow speed, the stacking depth and the strength of the debris flow; and obtaining a mud-rock flow disaster risk partitioning result of the research area according to the mud-rock flow risk classification standard. According to the technical scheme, the object source and the potential object source are connected through the connectivity index, the influence of more errors on debris flow prediction caused by the traditional subjectivity determination of the silt starting position is overcome, and a new thought is provided for the research of debris flow dynamic process, monitoring and early warning and the like.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Depth learning-based plateau debris flow prediction method and prediction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth learning-based plateau debris flow prediction method and a prediction system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining observation data of the nearest weather observation site according to the plateau debris flow historical data; constructing a plateau debris flow prediction model by adopting a TensorFlow deep learning frame, and training the model by using plateau debris flow historical data to obtain a historical general model; determining the number of nearest meteorological sites of the debris flow disaster site by adopting a KNN nearest neighbor algorithm; introducing short-term precipitation prediction data, and performing error analysis on the short-term precipitation prediction; combining live precipitation with forecast precipitation to construct a new characteristic variable; sample increment training is performed, the generalization performance and efficiency of the model are improved, a real-time fine model is obtained, and the debris flow condition of the concentrate is predicted in real time. The scheme solves the problem of poor accuracy caused by adopting pure forecast data, and strives for more response time for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: Sichuan Rural Economic Comprehensive Information Center

title_en: Emergency water purifying device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an emergency water purifying device, which belongs to the technical field of drinking water treatment and comprises an ultrafiltration membrane component, an end socket, a connector and a manual operation device, wherein the connection relationship between the ultrafiltration membrane component, the end socket and the manual operation device is three types of purified water, normal flushing and back flushing. The utility model is suitable for emergency situations such as flood and earthquake, or field travel and training, and can purify the water source which can be utilized by the pond, the ditch and the like by manual simple operation, so as to meet the safety drinking water requirement of people and effectively prevent secondary disasters caused by water source pollution, and the like, in consideration of the situations of polluted water source, no power supply and the like. The utility model also has the advantages of simple operation, convenient assembly and disassembly, convenient carrying, low investment cost and the like.

title_en: Continuous drought disaster device for field simulation crops
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural meteorology, in particular to a continuous drought disaster recovery device for field simulated crops, which comprises a test area and a dehumidifier, wherein the test area is divided into two rows of test rows by a transverse partition wall, the test rows are divided into a plurality of test grids by a longitudinal partition wall, and each test grid is internally divided into a planting part and a drainage part in the up-down direction by a partition net; an exhaust pipe and an exhaust pipe are embedded in the transverse partition wall, and the exhaust pipe are respectively connected with a moisture absorption end and an exhaust end of the dehumidifier in a conducting way; each planting part is provided with a moisture absorption sub-pipe and an exhaust sub-pipe, each of the moisture absorption sub-pipe and the exhaust sub-pipe is provided with a plurality of penetrating air holes, one end of the moisture absorption sub-pipe is embedded into the transverse wall and is connected with the exhaust pipe in a conducting way, and one end of the exhaust sub-pipe is embedded into the transverse wall and is connected with the exhaust pipe in a conducting way. The utility model can simulate agricultural drought, can efficiently control soil humidity, and improves experimental efficiency and representativeness.
assignees: LANZHOU DROUGHT METEOROLOGY INST OF CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Multi-factor simulation test equipment for power transmission tower
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of corrosion simulation test equipment, and provides power transmission tower multi-factor simulation test equipment, which comprises: a test bin; the lifting guide mechanism can move along the horizontal direction, the clamp is arranged on the lifting guide mechanism in a lifting manner along the height direction of the lifting guide mechanism, the clamp is used for clamping a test piece to be tested, and the clamp can rotate to drive the clamped test piece to be tested to change the angle and the azimuth; the spraying device is arranged in the test bin and is used for spraying liquid to the test piece to be tested clamped by the clamp; the light source is arranged in the test bin, the light source can emit ultraviolet light at least, and the multi-factor simulation test equipment of the power transmission tower can consider the influence of different natural environment factors on the material and structural performance of the power transmission tower structure and the disaster causing mechanism of the power transmission tower structure.
assignees: DALI BUREAU OF ULTRA HIGH VOLTAGE TRANS COMPANY CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID COMPANY LIMITED

title_en: Providing system of customized safety education experience service for virtual reality based disaster accidents and method thereof
title_ko: 가상 현실 기반의 재난사고에 대한 맞춤형 안전교육 체험 서비스 제공 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention, in a customized safety education experience service providing method for a disaster accident based on virtual reality performed by a server, is the customized safety education experience service providing method for the disaster accident based on virtual reality comprising: a step of receiving experience request information from an experiencer; a step of generating a customized experience scenario; and a step of executing an experience service. According to the present invention, by experiencing the disaster accident through direct stimulation of the skin using a thermoelectric element capable of adjusting coldness and warmness based on virtual reality, an experiencer can become more immersed in the virtual reality through the sensation felt by the skin. According to the present invention, when experiencing safety education based on virtual reality, a customized safety education for each situation and each individual may be provided by considering a type of disaster accident and a condition of the experiencer. According to the present invention, by experiencing various types of disaster situations and emergencies in advance through virtual experience, the experiencer can correctly recognize the risk of the disaster accident and properly respond to various actual disaster accident situations.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상 현실 기반의 재난사고에 대한 맞춤형 안전교육 체험 서비스 제공 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다. 상기 방법은, 서버에 의해 수행되는 가상 현실 기반의 재난사고에 대한 맞춤형 안전교육 체험 서비스 제공 방법에 있어서, 가상 체험 공간에 입장하는 체험자로부터 체험요청정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 체험요청정보를 이용하여 맞춤형 체험시나리오를 생성하는 단계; 및 상기 맞춤형 체험시나리오를 이용하여 체험 서비스를 실행하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 체험 서비스를 실행하는 단계는, 가상 체험 공간에 대응하는 맞춤형 VR 영상에 따라 감지되는 주변환경정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 주변환경정보를 분석하여 재난사고의 유무를 판단하는 단계; 재난사고의 판단결과에 따라 주변환경정보 및 현재위치정보를 분석하여 위험상황의 유무를 판단하는 단계; 위험상황의 판단결과에 따라 체험자의 현재신체감정정보를 수신하는 단계; 기초신체감정정보 및 상기 현재신체감정정보를 분석하여 변화신체감정정보를 생성하는 단계; 및 표준데이터를 기초로 상기 변화신체감정정보에 매칭되어 생성된 대응시나리오를 실행하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Regional Ripple Impact Analysis System Based on Interconnection and Dependence of National Core Infrastructure
title_ko: 국가핵심기반시설 상호연계성 및 의존도 기반 지역 파급영향 분석 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a regional spillover impact analysis system based on the interconnectivity and dependency of national key infrastructures, which analyzes the impact between facilities in the event of a functional outage or deterioration of individual national key infrastructures through a network-based scientific simulation that takes into account interconnectivity and dependency, by setting up a user scenario, and scientifically analyzes the spillover impact on the local community. The provided regional ripple impact analysis system based on the interconnectivity and dependency of national key infrastructures includes: database (10) comprising a national infrastructure DB (12), a local government DB, a statistics DB by department, a disaster statistics DB, and a local community disaster prevention capacity DB; a disruption risk scenario setting unit (20) that accesses the database (10), constructs a national key infrastructure and sub-facility DB in advance, selects national key infrastructures in each field, and then selects functions within the field; a facility-to-facility impact analysis module (30) that accesses the database (10) and constructs a national key infrastructure interconnectivity and dependency analysis matrix DB; and a community ripple impact analysis simulator (40) that selects variables of community impact due to national key infrastructures by constructing a DB for pre-impact relationship analysis.

title_en: Plateau alpine railway earthquake disaster scene simulation method
abstract_en: The application provides a method for simulating earthquake disaster scenes of a highland alpine railway, which is suitable for the technical field of new generation information and comprises the following steps: acquiring seismic data, active fault parameters, seismic scene data and emergency service data; based on the simulation of the earthquake disaster scene, obtaining the intensity of earthquake center according to the earthquake data and the movable fault parameters; determining the number of deaths and the number of injuries based on the earthquake scene data, the earthquake magnitude, the intensity in the earthquake and a preset death number prediction model; and determining the demand of rescue materials according to the emergency service data, the death number and the wounded number. According to the method, the earthquake scene simulation of the plateau alpine railway region is used as a reference for the earthquake disaster emergency rescue work, disaster prevention task planning and emergency system construction of the plateau alpine railway along the earthquake disaster emergency rescue, so that the timeliness and effectiveness of the plateau alpine railway earthquake disaster emergency rescue are improved.

title_en: Fire disaster intelligent early warning system based on monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire disaster intelligent early warning system based on monitoring data, belongs to the field of fire disaster early warning, and solves the problem of low fire disaster early warning efficiency; the method comprises the following steps: the data acquisition module acquires video data and environment data; the simulation analysis module processes the video data and judges whether fire disaster occurs or not; if so, generating a fire signal; if not, constructing a fire early warning model, and estimating the occurrence rate of open fire, dark fire and no fire by combining environmental data; the joint analysis module acquires the joint data of a plurality of different monitoring areas; processing the involution data once, and judging whether fire disaster occurs or not; if so, generating a fire signal; if not, performing secondary processing on the combined data to obtain a priority monitoring sequence; the user interaction module receives fire signals to trigger fire alarming; summarizing the priority monitoring sequences; according to the invention, by acquiring and analyzing multiple data of the monitoring area, fire disasters are found in time and hidden danger of the fire disasters is monitored, and the occurrence rate of the fire disasters is reduced.
assignees: SHANDONG UNITED ENERGY PIPELINE CONVEYING CO LTD

title_en: Training method of logging curve correction model and transient electromagnetic logging curve correction method
abstract_en: The application provides a training method of a logging curve correction model, a training device of the logging curve correction model, a transient electromagnetic logging curve correction method, a transient electromagnetic logging curve correction device, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein an original transient electromagnetic logging curve can be decomposed into original low-frequency logging data and original high-frequency logging data before time sequence data are learned by a neural network model, the original low-frequency logging data is subjected to feedback regulation learning by using the low-frequency correction model, and the original high-frequency logging data is subjected to feedback regulation learning by using the high-frequency correction model. Therefore, gradient descent and feature learning of the high-frequency data stream and the low-frequency data stream can be simultaneously carried out by adopting different neural network models, so that learning of the logging curve correction model on the high-frequency features and the low-frequency features can be balanced, the frequency principle is avoided, the high-frequency disaster problem is avoided, and the trained logging curve correction model can correct the transient electromagnetic logging curve more accurately.

title_en: Prediction method and system for high-temperature heat wave-drought composite disaster and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method, a system and electronic equipment for a high-temperature heat wave-drought composite disaster, belonging to the field of data prediction processing, and comprising the following steps: based on the global climate mode set, obtaining global system mode output data and population GDP data, correcting a meteorological simulation series under a climate change scene by adopting fractional deviation, and driving a global hydrological model and a machine learning model to simulate a land water reserve series; calculating the weight parameters of each combined scene by adopting a multi-model weighted average method; adopting Budyko equation to consider the balance of water circulation water heat balance of the river basin, taking characteristic parameters as covariates, and representing the influence of the human activities on drought; and (3) constructing a time-varying Copula model by considering hydrologic series non-uniformity, and evaluating population and GDP exposure of the region with increased risk of the composite disaster based on the most possible combination mode of high-temperature high-wave intensity and drought intensity and a multi-model weighted average method. The invention adopts various methods to predict the future hydrologic process and provides an important reference basis for hydrologic disaster risk prediction.

title_en: Storage tank damage experiment platform under action of fire heat radiation and explosion shock wave
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storage tank damage experiments, and discloses a storage tank damage experiment platform under the action of fire heat radiation and explosion shock waves. The invention can simulate the image of a pre-damaged storage tank damaged by explosive fragments, is convenient for simulating the damage of fragments generated by explosion to the tank body, and can also adjust the height, the direction and the flame intensity of the combustion nozzle, thereby more accurately simulating the heat radiation in a fire disaster, and finally enabling the experimental platform to simulate various conditions of the real fire disaster more comprehensively and safely.

title_en: Corn waterlogging risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corn waterlogging risk assessment method, which comprises the following steps: step one, constructing a comprehensive database; step two, constructing a soil humidity index; step three, constructing a comprehensive waterlogging index; step four, identifying waterlogging events and calculating characteristic variables thereof; step five, assessing and dividing the risk of waterlogging of the corn; in the second step, the soil water content data is simulated by using a SWAT model; in the fifth step, the corn growing period is divided into four growing stages of corn seedling emergence-jointing stage, jointing-male pulling stage, male pulling-milk ripening stage and milk ripening-ripening stage; according to the invention, the SWAT model is utilized to simulate the soil water content, the soil humidity index and the water deficiency index are adopted as indexes, and the comprehensive waterlogging index is formed after weighting by using an entropy weighting method, so that compared with a soil water content data set developed based on remote sensing data, the index can more accurately represent the waterlogging condition actually received by corn, and can meet the requirement of short-time waterlogging disaster research in a small range.

title_en: Battery fire monitoring system based on lithium battery fire simulation test platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of lithium battery fire monitoring, which is used for solving the problem that the lithium battery fire monitoring process lacks a specific and effective analysis process for symptoms before the occurrence of fire and possibly occurring risk types, in particular to a battery fire monitoring system based on a lithium battery fire simulation test platform; the lithium battery fire disaster monitoring system comprises a fire disaster test platform, a data integration unit, an early characteristic management unit, a fire extinguishing monitoring unit and a thermal runaway management unit, wherein the lithium battery fire disaster simulation test platform is used for simulating a lithium battery fire disaster, and risk types of the lithium battery are divided into thermal runaway monitoring and early fire monitoring, so that the lithium battery fire disaster test is more targeted, the direct degree of data detection is improved, the influence of other risk types and interference parameters is avoided, the external influence possibly causing the fire disaster and the parameter change before the fire of the battery can be effectively counted, and effective data support is provided for early warning of the lithium battery fire disaster and automatic fire extinguishing of the lithium battery fire disaster.
assignees: CNBCC AUTOMOBILE SPARE PART XIAMEN CO LTD

title_en: Numerical simulation method and device for high-level landslide weir dam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fluidization landslide movement simulation, in particular to a high-level landslide dam value simulation method which is used for solving the problems of risk assessment of an oversized landslide disaster chain and quantitative analysis of dangerous areas of waterfall, wherein the provided high-level landslide dam value simulation method comprises the following steps: establishing a drift velocity model; establishing a volume fraction conservation equation of each phase in the mixed phase; establishing a mass conservation equation of the mixed phase; establishing a momentum conservation equation of the mixed phase and a constitutive model of each phase; dispersing according to the volume fraction conservation equation of each phase, the mass average density change rate of the mixed phase and the momentum conservation equation of the mixed phase to obtain a discrete equation set; and calculating according to a discrete equation set to obtain the volume fraction of each phase in the mixed phase, the speed of each phase, the mass average speed of the mixed phase and the mass average density of the mixed phase at each moment, and finishing numerical simulation of the high-order landslide and dam, wherein the numerical calculation of the whole process of dam evolution is accurately reflected.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES;TAICANG YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL UNIV

title_en: Multifunctional test system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a multi-functional test system, the system comprising: the fire disaster simulation device comprises a test box body, wherein the inside of the test box body is used for simulating a fire disaster environment, an exhaust device and an air inlet are arranged on the test box body, and the exhaust device is used for exhausting mixed gas in the test box body; the environment simulation module is connected with the air inlet and comprises a temperature regulator, a CO generator, a VOC generator, a gas pressure device, an illumination generator and a smoke generator; the environment verification module is arranged in the test box body and comprises a temperature sensor, a CO sensor, a VOC sensor, a pressure sensor, an illumination sensor and a smoke sensor, and is used for detecting the internal environment parameters of the test box body; and the controller module is respectively in communication connection with the environment simulation module and the environment verification module. The fire detector testing system can simulate the fire environment to realize accurate testing of the fire detector.
assignees: ZEPHYR INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Container type real fire actual combat training device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a container type real fire actual combat training device, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting training equipment and comprises the following components: a first container, a second container arranged above the first container, a third container arranged above the second container and vertical to the second container, a fourth container arranged above the third container, a fifth container arranged below the third container and vertical to the second container, and a sixth container arranged below the fifth container; the bottom of the fourth container is provided with a low-field rescue simulation mechanism leading to the third container. According to the utility model, the pedal is arranged in the fourth container, a firefighter steps on the pedal, the pedal can sink inwards to the stepping box to trigger the pressing switch, then the warning lamp is lightened to warn the firefighter that the firefighter falls to the third container, meanwhile, the piston rod of the electric push rod is contracted, the movable plate opens the first through hole, and the firefighter performs low-field rescue simulation training on the first through hole.

title_en: Evacuation simulation method of fire evacuation model based on time pressure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evacuation simulation method of a fire evacuation model based on time pressure, which is characterized in that a fire evacuation model based on time pressure is constructed by calculating the time pressure value of pedestrians, the time pressure value is applied to a CA model, and finally, evacuation simulation is carried out in the fire evacuation model based on time pressure according to the time pressure value of the pedestrians. The traditional fire evacuation model ignores psychological factors when considering the behaviors of pedestrians, and the invention provides a new research method, by introducing time pressure values, the behaviors and decision processes of pedestrians in a fire scene can be more accurately simulated, so that more accurate pedestrian behavior simulation is provided, the understanding of how pedestrians are affected by time pressure in an emergency situation of fire is better facilitated, different behavior selections are made, and the complexity and the dynamics of the behaviors of pedestrians are further researched; the safety and emergency response capabilities of the building can also be better assessed.

title_en: Mine dynamic disaster automatic monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster early warning, and discloses an automatic mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning device which comprises a movable installation assembly, a drilling assembly connected with the installation assembly, a collection assembly for collecting drill cuttings, a controller and an early warning assembly, wherein the drilling assembly is connected with the installation assembly; the installation component includes L shape remove the frame, with remove the top of frame rotate the accommodate motor who is connected, with accommodate motor output shaft's lead screw and rotate the end plate of connecting at the removal frame opposite side. The installation component still includes the angle adjustment module that is used for adjusting lead screw inclination. The drilling assembly comprises a support seat in spiral fit with the screw rod, a drilling motor arranged on the support seat and a drill rod connected with the output end of the drilling motor, and a guide rod parallel to the screw rod is arranged on the support seat in a sliding penetrating mode. The invention can rapidly collect key indexes such as drilling cuttings quantity, drilling cuttings granularity, drilling cuttings temperature and the like for mine dynamic disaster early warning, has high degree of automation and improves working efficiency.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering project management intelligent system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering project management, in particular to a hydraulic engineering project management intelligent system which comprises a watershed comprehensive management module, a water resource allocation module, a water quality and environment monitoring module, an engineering maintenance and fault response module, an engineering project evaluation and optimization module, a risk management and emergency response module, an unconventional water source development module and a project decision and strategy making module. According to the invention, the operation strategies of reservoirs and floodgates can be optimized by simulating the influences of different regulation and control schemes on water resource supply and demand, future maintenance demands can be predicted and corresponding maintenance and repair plans can be formulated by analyzing sensor data and historical operation trends, the sustainability of engineering projects is enhanced, the simulation analysis of project operation performance and data uncertainty treatment are carried out, so that the engineering projects are more stable and reliable, unconventional water sources are developed, and the available range of water resources is further expanded.

title_en: Finite element analysis-based solidified soil buffer material performance analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a finite element analysis-based method for analyzing the performance of a solidified soil buffer material, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster protection and comprises the following steps: obtaining a gravel soil test sample; the fiber and polyurethane with the set doping amount are fused with a gravel soil test sample to obtain a test sample; based on the test sample, performing a related test to obtain an optimal proportion of the polyurethane-fiber solidified soil buffer material; and carrying out a falling stone impact test based on the optimal proportion, carrying out numerical simulation on the falling stone impact test based on finite element analysis, obtaining the energy dissipation dynamic characteristics of the polyurethane-fiber solidified soil buffer material under different working conditions, and completing the performance analysis of the solidified soil buffer material based on the finite element analysis. The invention solves the problem that the prior method lacks comprehensive analysis on the optimal proportion and performance of the buffer material.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability analysis method based on causal discovery and structure learning
abstract_en: The application provides a landslide vulnerability analysis method based on causal discovery and structure learning. Firstly, multi-source geologic data and landslide catalogs of a monitoring area are acquired, a disaster causing factor set is constructed, and the disaster causing factor set is a causal discovery factor set and a vulnerability analysis factor set, wherein the vulnerability analysis factor set is required to be subjected to discretization; dividing a monitoring area into a causal discovery area and a vulnerability analysis area, and sequentially constructing a sample set; adopting an unsupervised causal discovery algorithm to construct a causal directed acyclic graph driven by data, and eliminating redundant data in an easy-occurrence analysis factor set and a sample set according to the result; and constructing a Bayesian network model by using the causal directed acyclic graph, sequentially training, predicting and evaluating the model by using a vulnerability analysis sample set, and finally carrying out landslide vulnerability analysis on a monitoring area. The method can fully excavate the coupling relation between the landslide and the disaster-causing factor, construct a model with low redundancy and high interpretability, and realize more accurate landslide susceptibility analysis.

title_en: Energy main control key layer determining method based on rock stratum mobile ground drilling monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy main control key layer determining method based on stratum mobile ground drilling monitoring, which comprises the following steps: s1, compiling a stratum histogram, and determining a matrix weathering fracture area, a key layer position and a collapse zone development height; s2, based on a key layer theory of rock stratum movement, a cover rock partition model is established, and the motion rule of each area is estimated; s3, based on the property of the hole sealing material, selecting the proportion of the hole sealing material according to the displacement characteristics of the overlying strata, and performing expansion anchoring on the deep measuring point of the drilling hole and flexible sealing on the shallow measuring point of the drilling hole; and S4, drawing a relation chart of measuring point sinking amount, measuring point movement speed and working face-to-borehole distance based on the acquired borehole monitoring data, and determining the position of the energy main control key layer based on each chart and the position of the key layer. According to the method, the accuracy of rock stratum movement monitoring data is guaranteed by improving the rock stratum movement ground monitoring drilling hole sealing method, the position of an energy main control key layer is determined, guidance is provided for mine disaster prevention and control, and safe production is guaranteed.

title_en: Power transmission and distribution line equipment disaster damage assessment method based on decision tree
abstract_en: The invention relates to a decision tree-based power transmission and distribution line equipment disaster damage assessment method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological data of historical weather and facility information of power transmission and distribution line equipment, acquiring monitoring data information, performing data preprocessing, and extracting features to form a training set; constructing a decision tree model based on a classification algorithm, and training by using a training set to obtain a disaster damage prediction model of the power transmission and distribution line equipment; acquiring real-time meteorological data and facility information of target power transmission and distribution line equipment to perform data preprocessing to obtain target characteristic data, and inputting the target characteristic data into a disaster prediction model of the power transmission and distribution line equipment to obtain a prediction result; constructing a disaster damage evaluation model of the power transmission and distribution line equipment based on DBScan algorithm, and training by using a training set to obtain the disaster damage evaluation model of the power transmission and distribution line equipment; and inputting the prediction result into a disaster damage evaluation model of the power transmission and distribution line equipment to obtain a disaster damage evaluation result of the target power transmission and distribution line equipment.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Machine learning-based wind-induced internal and external pressure prediction method for open-pore low building group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a machine learning-based open-pore low building group wind-induced internal and external pressure prediction method, which comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out Latin hypercube sampling according to basic parameters of a low building group, and establishing a corresponding wind tunnel test model; secondly, taking wind pressure coefficients of the inner surface and the outer surface of the open-pore low building group obtained by the wind tunnel test as training data, and performing network training machine learning by adopting an artificial neural network BPNN; and finally, constructing a prediction model capable of predicting wind pressure coefficients of the inner surface and the outer surface of the short building group by inputting basic parameters of any short building group. The built machine learning prediction model can solve the problem that wind load on the inner surface and the outer surface of a building is time-consuming and labor-consuming by adopting a wind tunnel test or CFD numerical simulation in wind disaster analysis, and the wind load measurement model on the inner surface and the outer surface of the open-pore short building group is built by introducing a machine learning algorithm, so that the wind disaster loss analysis of the short building group can be realized quickly, accurately and efficiently.

title_en: Bridge-cut-off disaster simulation device for emergency rescue training
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of simulation devices, in particular to a broken bridge disaster simulation device for emergency rescue training. Including support column, connecting plate, revolving frame I, revolving frame II etc. two connecting plates all are connected between the support column, and revolving frame I rotates to be connected on the support column, and revolving frame II rotates to be connected on revolving frame I. According to the invention, clean water is added into the water pool, then the cement board is placed between the rotary frame I and the top of the rotary frame II, so that a bridge on a river can be simulated, and then the rotary frame II and the rotary frame I rotate sequentially, so that the cement board falls into the water pool, a bridge-breaking accident and secondary collapse can be simulated, and thus emergency rescue training can be conveniently carried out by rescue workers in a simulation experiment of the bridge-breaking accident and the secondary collapse, the emergency rescue consciousness of the rescue workers is improved, the simulation training can be carried out on the whole condition of the rescue workers, and the training effect on rescue can be maximized.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 7TH ENG DIVISION CORP LTD

title_en: Machine learning-based skull sex estimation apparatus and method
title_ko: 머신러닝 기반의 머리뼈 성별 추정 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a machine learning-based skull sex estimation apparatus and method.
