The machine learning-based skull sex estimation apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises a data collection unit for collecting a 3-dimensional skull model; a dataset generation unit that extracts a 2-dimensional skull image from the collected 3-dimensional skull model and generates a dataset by using the extracted 2-dimensional skull image; a training unit that inputs the generated dataset to a CNN-based estimation model to train the CNN-based estimation model to estimate a sex through the 2-dimensional skull image; and an estimation unit for estimating a sex of a skull by inputting, to the pre-trained estimation model, a plurality of 2-dimensional skull images uploaded by a user while executing a web or an application through a terminal. As such, according to the present invention, the sex of the skull may be estimated by using the application or the web without specialized knowledge or measurement equipment, a barrier to accessing technology in a mass disaster site or in the third world may be alleviated, and interoperability with another international organization program may be constructed to promote flexible cooperation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 머신러닝 기반의 머리뼈 성별 추정 장치 및 그 방법에 대한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 머신러닝 기반의 머리뼈 성별 추정 장치는 3차원 형태의 머리뼈 모델을 수집하는 데이터 수집부, 상기 수집된 3차원 형태의 머리뼈 모델로부터 2차원 형태의 머리뼈 이미지를 추출하고, 추출된 2차원 형태의 머리뼈 이미지를 이용하여 데이터 셋을 생성하는 데이터셋 생성부, 생성된 데이터셋을 CNN 기반의 추정 모델에 입력하여 2차원 형태의 머리뼈 이미지를 통해 성별을 추정하도록 학습시키는 학습부, 그리고 이용 대상자가 단말기를 통해 웹 또는 어플리케이션을 실행시킨 상태에서 업로드한 복수의 2차원 형태의 머리뼈 이미지를 기 학습된 추정 모델에 입력하여 머리뼈의 성별을 추정하는 추정부를 포함한다. 이와 같이 본 발명에 따르면, 전문 지식이나 측정 장비 없이도 어플리케이션 또는 웹을 이용하여 머리뼈의 성별을 추정할 수 있으며, 대량 재해 현장이나 제3 세계의 기술 접근 장벽을 완화하고 다른 국제 기간 프로그램과의 연동성을 구축하여 유연한 협업이 가능한 효과를 도모할 수 있다.
assignees: REPUBLIC KOREA NAT FORENSIC SERVICE DIRECTOR MINISTRY OF PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION & SECURITY;KOREA ADVANCED INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH KAIST

title_en: Fire evacuation-rescue prediction method and system based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire evacuation-rescue prediction method and a fire evacuation-rescue prediction system based on cellular automata, which have the characteristics that the method comprises the following steps: S1-S2, grid data are obtained according to building structure data; s3, calculating fire scene data at the time t=0; s4, judging whether the simulated firefighter reaches a fire scene, if so, entering S5, and if not, entering S6; s5, calculating the movement results of each simulated firefighter and each simulated evacuation personnel at the time t, and entering S7; s6, calculating a movement result of the simulated evacuees at the time t; s7, judging whether evacuation is finished, if yes, carrying out S9, and if not, entering S8; s8, fire scene data at the time t+1 are obtained through calculation according to the fire scene data at the time t and the grid data, and t+1 enters S4; and S9, calculating according to all the movement results to obtain evacuation-rescue results. In a word, the method considers the influence of fire fighters on fire disaster and evacuation, and can obtain more real and accurate evacuation-rescue results.

title_en: Platform and method for testing disaster damage of fireproof blocking structure under simulated converter transformer blasting
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire damage test platform and a method for a fireproof blocking structure under simulated converter transformer blasting, wherein the platform comprises a blasting fire simulation cabin, a counterweight structure, a transformer simulation device and a blasting fire occurrence device; the counterweight structure is used for simulating the weight of the outgoing line sleeve of the transformer; the transformer simulation device is used for storing insulating oil with set water content; the explosion and fire disaster generating device is used for decomposing and exploding the insulating oil in the transformer simulation device, enabling the insulating oil to flow out of the transformer simulation device to form an oil pool, and igniting the insulating oil outside the transformer simulation device to form flowing fire and oil pool fire; according to the testing platform and the testing method, the explosion and fire disaster occurrence device of the transformer can simulate various disaster scenes of explosion, flowing fire and oil pool fire of the transformer, and the disaster damage condition of the tested fireproof blocking structure under the multiple effects of explosion and fire disaster and load is tested, so that the fire resistance and disaster damage characteristics of the tested fireproof blocking structure are measured.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Mine microseism energy prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine microseismic energy prediction method, which relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster prevention and control, and comprises the steps of obtaining mine pressure monitoring data and microseismic monitoring data, carrying out parameter registration in the same time period after normalization processing to obtain a period, energy and frequency model, carrying out noise reduction on a data set by using the model, optimizing the weight and the threshold of a BP neural network by utilizing the chemoattractant operation of an MEA algorithm to obtain a trained MEA-BP neural network, and inputting the data set into the trained MEA-BP neural network to obtain the prediction of microseismic energy in a mine. According to the invention, a period, energy and frequency model is established according to the actual situation, the model is used for reducing noise of the data set, the weight and the threshold of the BP neural network for the trend and alien operation of the MEA algorithm are used for optimizing and establishing the MEA-BP neural network for training and predicting the data set, the conditions of over fitting and over-poor fitting generated in the training process are reduced, and the accuracy rate of the mine microseism energy prediction is integrally improved.
assignees: ORDOS RESEARCH INSTITUTE LIAONING UNIV OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent identification method and system for safe production management video image
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent identification method and system for safe production management video images, which belong to the technical field of safe production management and comprise the following steps: based on YOLOv model, training by collecting video image of production environment, removing redundant prediction frame by NMS algorithm during training, constructing YOLOv safety recognition model for recognizing abnormal operation behavior and abnormal environment condition to judge whether safety production hidden trouble exists; based on the YOLOv safety recognition model, whether the safety production hidden danger exists in the environment to be monitored is recognized by analyzing the video image of the environment to be monitored, and the existing safety production hidden danger is alarmed. The invention can acquire and analyze the video image of the production environment in real time, discover the hidden danger of safety production in time, and improve the speed of emergency response and the effectiveness of decision making by combining personnel authority management.
assignees: WUHAN BOSSIEN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent campus fire alarm method and system based on multi-mode event detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of campus environment fire risk assessment, in particular to an intelligent campus fire alarm method and system based on multi-mode event detection, comprising the following steps: simulating a fire situation in the campus environment and acquiring data therein as a data set, wherein the data set comprises an audio data set and an image data set; building a fire audio classification model based on a convolutional neural network, convoluting by a convolutional neural network classification unit to obtain a final classification result, and training the fire audio classification model; establishing a fire image classification model, training the model, obtaining a final prediction result through MobieNetV network units, and training the fire image classification model; and establishing a fire detection alarm model, and determining whether to trigger a fire alarm in the fire detection alarm unit according to the fire condition in the fire condition definition unit. The invention can rapidly and accurately identify emergency events such as fire disasters in campuses and the like and timely send out alarm signals.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;SHANDONG JINQU DESIGN CONSULTING GROUP CO LTD;Shandong College of Tourism & Hospitality

title_en: Water conservancy monitoring method and system based on multi-sensor fusion technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water conservancy monitoring, and provides a water conservancy monitoring method and a water conservancy monitoring system based on a multi-sensor fusion technology, wherein the method carries out multi-layer perceptron neural network model training by acquiring historical water conservancy parameters acquired by a plurality of sensors, normalizing the historical water conservancy parameters and then taking the normalized historical water conservancy parameters as input and various disasters as output by taking corresponding grade values, and then acquiring a bird's-eye view image of the target water area, automatically labeling the bird's-eye view image according to the target disaster and the target grade value to obtain a labeling image so as to perform prevention and control deployment on auxiliary users, quickly and accurately early-warning the disaster in a machine learning mode, assisting the users to complete prevention and control, and reducing the workload of the users.

title_en: Geological disaster multisource monitoring data and power transmission line safety assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological disaster multi-source monitoring data and transmission line safety assessment method, a device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sample data set related to a mountain fire disaster of the power transmission line; performing signal enhancement processing on a sample data set taking an electric signal as a transmission form to obtain a sample data set subjected to signal enhancement; converting the sample data set after signal enhancement into a digital signal by an electric signal to obtain a converted sample data set; carrying out feature extraction processing on sample data in the converted sample data set to obtain various sample features, and evaluating contribution degree of the extracted sample features to mountain fire risk evaluation; training a mountain fire risk assessment model to be trained according to the characteristics of each sample and the contribution degree corresponding to the characteristics of each sample; the trained forest fire risk assessment model is used for predicting the forest fire risk level of the target power transmission line. By adopting the method, the accuracy of geological disaster early warning can be improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BUREAU EXTRA HIGH VOLTAGE TRANSMISSION CO CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster probability early warning method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster probability early warning method based on machine learning, which belongs to the mountain torrent disaster early warning field and comprises the following steps: and building and training a PSO-SVM model according to a Support Vector Machine (SVM) and a particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO), predicting a river basin to be pre-warned by using the PSO-SVM model to obtain the prediction classification and the prediction probability of the torrent disaster, optimizing an evaluation probability threshold of the torrent disaster, and finally obtaining a torrent disaster probability pre-warning result. According to the invention, the particle swarm algorithm PSO is utilized to optimize the SVM model, the quality of real-time mountain torrent early warning can be improved by quantifying the occurrence risk of potential mountain torrent disasters through meteorological hydrologic data, meanwhile, the probability threshold is optimized, the accuracy and stability of mountain torrent disaster early warning are improved, the report missing rate and the report blank rate are lower, and the practicability and the reliability are better.

title_en: Training room is hindered to tobacco heat barrier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a smoke barrier training room, which comprises a box body, wherein a smoke inlet and an openable sealing window are formed in the box body; the training inlet and the training outlet are formed in the box body, and a first partition board for separating the training inlet from the training outlet is arranged in the box body; a second partition board and a third partition board which are perpendicular to the first partition board are arranged in the box body; the first partition plate, the second partition plate and the third partition plate divide the interior of the box body into a first barrier area, a second barrier area and a third barrier area which are distributed along a training moving path; and simulating various obstacle training in a real fire scene, and improving the capability of firefighters or people to cope with emergency events in the fire.
assignees: DINGHUACHUANG EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Crushing stope four-in-one ground pressure monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a four-in-one ground pressure monitoring system of a crushing stope, which comprises microseismic monitoring equipment and ground pressure monitoring equipment connected with an industrial personal computer, wherein the ground pressure monitoring equipment comprises a drilling stress meter, an anchor rope stress meter, a roof separation layer meter, a hole stress wireless data collector, an anchor rope wireless data collector, a separation layer meter wireless data collector and a ground pressure collecting substation, the drilling stress meter, the anchor rope stress meter and the roof separation layer meter are respectively connected with the hole stress wireless data collector, the anchor rope wireless data collector and the separation layer meter wireless data collector through cables, the hole stress wireless data collector, the anchor rope wireless data collector and the separation layer meter wireless data collector are connected with the ground pressure collecting substation through wireless communication networks, and the ground pressure collecting substation is connected with the industrial personal computer. The utility model judges the stope safety risk by utilizing the multi-parameter comprehensive ground pressure monitoring and early warning index, can realize accurate early warning of ground pressure disaster events and ensures the safe operation of mine production.
assignees: Hebei iron and steel group shahe zhongguan iron mine co ltd

title_en: Coal mine disaster prevention and control device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal mine disaster prevention and control device, which belongs to the field of coal mine disaster prevention and control, and comprises a driving assembly, wherein a grouting barrel is arranged at the bottom end of the driving assembly, a drill bit is arranged at the bottom end of the grouting barrel, the drill bit is connected with the driving assembly, a storage device is connected to the outside of the driving assembly in a transmission way, the storage device is connected with the grouting barrel, the integrated perforation grouting can be realized, repeated equipment replacement is not needed, the efficiency of coal mine disaster prevention and control is improved, the drill bit is driven by the driving assembly to drill soil, the filling, cementing and reinforcement of a goaf and surrounding rock cracks are facilitated by the follow-up grouting barrel, the falling deformation of the goaf is prevented, the purpose of coal mine disaster prevention and control is achieved, the storage device stores slurry, and a user can conveniently move the slurry to a proper position for grouting, and a grouting barrel and a through pipe are convenient for rotation of a transmission shaft.

title_en: Steel structure type fire-fighting training tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel structure type fire-fighting training tower, which relates to the technical field of training equipment and comprises a base body, wherein a fixing frame is arranged above the base body, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the fixing frame, a climbing training frame is arranged outside the fixing frame, a training wall is arranged outside the fixing frame, a climbing window is arranged inside the training wall, a movable plate is connected inside the climbing window in a sliding manner, a shielding plate is arranged inside the fixing frame, a baffle is connected inside the fixing frame in a sliding manner, a fixing piece is arranged outside the fixing frame, and a firefighter can perform better training on self-ability in a closed space through cooperation among the baffle, the movable plate and the shielding plate, so that the strain capacity and psychological bearing capacity of the firefighter can be improved, the firefighter can better handle emergency situations, training in a closed environment of the firefighter is realized, and the strain capacity of the firefighter in a complex environment is effectively improved.
assignees: CHANGCHUN LANCHENG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Surface fire simulation test device
abstract_en: A surface fire simulation test device belongs to the technical field of fire control simulation test equipment. The utility model solves the problems that the existing surface fire simulation test has higher risk coefficient, the test site has certain limitation, and the surface fire simulation test can not be normally carried out according to the fire characteristic. The utility model comprises a fan, a hose, a flue pipe and simulated flames, wherein an air outlet of the fan is connected with the hose, the other end of the hose is communicated with the flue pipe, the flue pipe comprises a pipeline and a sealing cover, one end of the pipeline is connected with the hose, the other end of the pipeline is sealed through the sealing cover, the pipeline is provided with a plurality of through holes, the simulated flames comprise magnetic blocks and flame strips, the flame strips are connected with the magnetic blocks, the magnetic blocks are adsorbed on the pipeline, and the pipeline is provided with a plurality of simulated flames. The surface fire simulation test device can realize actual combat exercises of fire under the precondition of no open fire, improve actual combat experience of firefighters and eliminate most of dangers.
assignees: GREAT KHINGAN REGION FOREST FIRE BRIGADE

title_en: River sudden water pollution event simulation early warning and auxiliary decision making system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river sudden water pollution event simulation early warning and auxiliary decision making system and method, which are used for the river sudden water pollution event simulation early warning and auxiliary decision making system and comprise the following steps: the system comprises a central control module, a system data management module, an environment risk map module, a river water environment simulation prediction module, an emergency treatment decision support module, an emergency management library module and a fusion communication module, wherein the system data management module, the environment risk map module, the river water environment simulation prediction module, the emergency treatment decision support module, the emergency management library module and the fusion communication module are connected with the central control module. According to the invention, based on the collection and acquisition of environmental risk elements and environmental emergency resource data, a system database is constructed by combining a database technology, the data visualization and query functions are realized by utilizing the Internet and a geographic information system, meanwhile, the functions of simulating and predicting the emergency water environment event and generating an event analysis report are provided based on a digital simulation technology, and the decision-making efficiency and the handling capacity of the emergency response of the river emergency water environment event are effectively improved by matching with the environmental risk elements, the environmental emergency resource information and the fusion communication function.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY;ENVIRONMENT PLANNING AND DESIGN RESEARCH INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD OF NANJING UNIV

title_en: Hospital emergency scene information release system based on 3D digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hospital emergency scene information release system based on3D digital twinning, which provides a unified platform for information sharing and cooperation among different departments in a hospital, which is beneficial to breaking information barriers among the departments, ensuring that emergency information received by all relevant departments and personnel is consistent, avoiding distortion and misunderstanding in the information transmission process, facilitating better cooperative work among the departments, responding to emergency situations together, accurately simulating various emergency scenes of the hospital by adopting the 3D digital twinning technology, and carrying out visual display, so that relevant personnel can quickly understand and grasp the full view of the emergency scenes, and through virtual emergency scene simulation, the hospital can carry out a large amount of training and exercise under the condition of not increasing actual cost, thereby being beneficial to reducing the cost of training and exercise and improving the emergency response capability of medical care personnel.
assignees: XIAMEN WORLD LINKING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cloud computing platform-based transformer substation mountain torrent disaster simulation and forecast system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud computing platform-based transformer substation mountain torrent disaster simulation and forecast system, which comprises the following steps: front-end technology integration module: processing a data structure generated in the hydrodynamic model cloud computing process, drawing a three-dimensional model in a browser by using three.js, and simplifying a system UI design flow by using matched design resources; server side functional module and calculation engine: according to model basic data uploaded by a browser end, the server end calls an automatic modeling tool to complete automatic generation of river channel units and plane grids and interpolation of sections and terrain geometric quantities, and after one-dimensional and two-dimensional hydrodynamic model modeling is completed, discrete model data are sent to a front-end technology integration module to carry out boundary modification or display rendering; the calculation engine processes the model data to produce simulation result data; the method solves the problem that the prior art cannot meet the requirements of real-time and quantitative simulation analysis, forecast and early warning and network real-time query under different rains.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIZHOU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for analyzing coupling risk of energy and traffic system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for analyzing coupling risk of energy and a traffic system in extreme weather. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively establishing a power system simulation operation model, a heating system simulation operation model, a traffic system simulation operation model and an extreme weather simulation model; after the electric power system simulation operation model, the heating system simulation operation model and the traffic system simulation operation model are coupled, an energy-traffic simulation operation model is established by considering the damage influence of the extreme weather simulation model; and based on the energy-traffic simulation operation model, carrying out risk analysis on the coupled energy-traffic system by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation. The invention can capture the mutual coupling and interdependence relation of different infrastructure systems when facing disaster damage, fully reveal the risks faced by the energy-traffic coupling system under the action of extreme weather disasters, and better assist the prevention and response of extreme weather events.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Disaster backup prediction method and device of main system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery prediction method and device of a main system and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting related data of a target main system at a target moment from different data sources, wherein the related data comprises one or more of a behavior log generated by user operation, a host terminal operation parameter, flow data and a security log of network equipment, an operation log of an application program and a disaster recovery service operation log; the relevant data are subjected to feature fusion to obtain a fusion feature vector of the target moment; based on the fusion feature vector and a prediction model, predicting whether a disaster event occurs in the target main system at the next time, wherein the prediction model is obtained by taking the fusion feature vector corresponding to the related data collected by each main system at each historical time as a sample and taking whether the disaster event occurs at the next time at each historical time as a label for training.

title_en: Method for judging spontaneous combustion dangerous area of goaf of coal face
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for judging spontaneous combustion dangerous areas of goafs of coal face, and relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring. And carrying out spontaneous combustion simulation tests by utilizing a dynamic migration and disaster simulation platform of harmful gases in the closed area, observing CO distribution conditions, analyzing the CO concentration distribution rules of different spontaneous combustion oxidation areas, and positioning a high-temperature area for natural ignition points of coal in the goaf so as to judge spontaneous combustion dangerous areas of the goaf of the coal face. According to the invention, the high-temperature abnormal points in the goaf are subjected to single-point positioning through the detected CO concentration data, the spontaneous combustion dangerous area of the goaf of the coal face is analyzed, and a scientific basis is provided for timely taking accurate and efficient fire prevention and extinguishing measures for a mine.

title_en: Post-earthquake disaster rescue analysis method based on multi-sensor unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a post-earthquake disaster rescue analysis method based on a multi-sensor unmanned aerial vehicle system. Specifically, a multi-sensor unmanned aerial vehicle system is used for collecting images and video data of earthquake disaster areas; labeling and preprocessing the image and video data of the earthquake disaster area, and carrying out data enhancement on the processed data to obtain a complete data set; integrating an attention module, an improved detection layer and a loss function on the YOLOv model, and training the model by utilizing a data set to obtain a post-earthquake rescue analysis model; after receiving and analyzing the data information from the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-sensor system, the post-earthquake rescue analysis model is combined to perform personnel searching and positioning, building safety assessment, ground surface crack condition analysis and optimal communication relay station searching. The invention can help rescue workers to know the situation of the disaster area more accurately, determine the key rescue area and the personnel concentration area of the disaster area, and provide decision support for rescue actions.

title_en: Online monitoring alarm system of intelligent fire service center
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent firefighting service center online monitoring alarm system, which relates to the technical field of firefighting service and comprises a firefighting equipment online monitoring module, a firefighting area building module, an abnormality identification module, an abnormality analysis module, an alarm prompting module, an image acquisition module, a building scene building module, a disaster monitoring module, a disaster occurrence simulation module, an access control interaction module, a video monitoring module, a trapped person number acquisition module, a trapped person position determination module, a position analysis module, an escape scheme analysis module, a firefighting alarm module, an escape route planning module and a person notification module; this wisdom fire control service center on-line monitoring alarm system builds module and unusual identification module through being provided with fire control equipment on-line monitoring module, fire control region, can discern the fire control equipment that goes wrong in the fire control region, in time handles it, when preventing to appear the disaster, equipment is unusual, influences fire rescue.
assignees: ZHENJIANG ZHONGXIAOYUN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method based on comprehensive weighting coupling model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide vulnerability evaluation method based on a comprehensive weighting coupling model, which relates to the field of landslide disaster prediction and specifically comprises the following steps: selecting an area to be researched, and determining a sample training set and a sample verification set; acquiring landslide influence factors through multi-source data of the area to be researched; based on the sample training set, performing colinear analysis and factor importance analysis on the landslide impact factors to obtain target landslide impact factors; based on the target landslide influence factor, utilizing a comprehensive weighting coupling model to predict landslide susceptibility and acquiring a landslide susceptibility index; and classifying the risk degree of the landslide susceptibility index, and evaluating the accuracy of the landslide susceptibility prediction result by utilizing an ROC curve and the sample verification set to finish the landslide susceptibility evaluation based on the comprehensive weighting coupling model.

title_en: Transformer substation fire disaster identification method based on image fusion and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation fire disaster identification method based on image fusion and electronic equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: the infrared image and the visible light image are fully fused, the fire occurrence probability and degree of the transformer substation are perceived from multiple dimensions, the fire occurrence accuracy of the transformer substation is improved through Bayesian theorem and D-S evidence theory reasoning, the specific positions of the occurrence temperature exceeding a threshold value and the fire occurrence can be rapidly positioned according to a simulation model, detailed data in the running process of the transformer substation are measured and calculated according to time stamps of different time periods, running speed calculation data are recorded, and machine experience of a machine running and a transformer substation fire identification system fused through the visible light image and the infrared light image is formed, and the fire occurrence position of the transformer substation can be rapidly identified and positioned in the subsequent use process. The invention solves the technical problem of low recognition accuracy caused by the fact that a single infrared light image or a visible light image is adopted for fire disaster recognition in the prior art.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Elevator evacuation optimization scheduling method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elevator evacuation optimizing and dispatching method based on a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm, which is used for realizing rapid evacuation of personnel in a deeply buried subway station in an emergency situation and comprises the following steps: constructing a deeply buried subway station model with a safety layer by using simulation software; defining elevator operation logic in a deep underground subway evacuation scene, and determining elevator execution action information; establishing a deep reinforcement learning framework, and determining a state space, an action space and a reward function; performing centralized training and non-centralized execution on the evacuation personnel of the multi-agent collaborative stairway by using MADDPG algorithm, and training to obtain a multi-agent reinforcement learning network; the multi-agent reinforcement learning network is used for controlling evacuation elevators in the deeply buried subway station; the invention can realize rapid evacuation of personnel in the deep-buried subway station in emergency.

title_en: Physical model test method based on yellow river slush
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical model test method based on yellow river slush, and relates to the technical field of physical model tests. The invention comprises the following steps: selecting a river network area to be simulated, determining a physical model scale according to river hydrologic characteristics of a river, and constructing a river network generalized physical model; calculating the flow of a river network area to be simulated according to the past year flow data, and taking the flow as an inlet condition; the simulated ice blocks are made by using paraffin and a small amount of gypsum powder, the size of the model ice blocks is reduced according to the proportion, and the water flow throwing is controlled by adopting a conveyor belt. According to the invention, the concrete influence of ice on the aspects of river channel structure, bridge stability, water level change and the like is deeply evaluated by utilizing test data, and the concrete influence comprises the blocking degree of ice cubes on river channel water flow, the ice pressure born by the bridge structure and the influence of ice cube accumulation on water level rising, so that corresponding reinforcement and improvement measures are formulated, the normal operation of an infrastructure is ensured, and the disaster risk is reduced.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES

title_en: Visual test system, visual test method and visual application method for simulating grouting plugging aggregate section of mine tunnel with roughness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual test system, a visual test method and an application method for simulating a grouting and plugging aggregate section of a mine tunnel with roughness, and relates to the technical field of simulation of grouting and plugging aggregate pouring sections of mine tunnels. Visual tests of grouting and water shutoff in aggregate perfusion bodies under different flowing water flow rates, different relative densities, different water-cement ratios and different grading and roughness conditions are realized. The visual test system comprises a transparent pipeline for simulating a roadway, wherein the inlet of the transparent pipeline is connected with the water moving system, and the outlet of the transparent pipeline is connected with the waste liquid collecting system; the grouting holes are connected with a grouting system, and aqueous color paste is filled in the slurry; the system also comprises an image acquisition system, a data monitoring system and a flow monitoring system. The invention can clearly observe slurry diffusion in the aggregate stack under the condition of moving water through the water-based color paste coloring slurry, and reveal slurry blocking mechanism in the aggregate stack through comprehensive analysis methods such as slicing, observing slurry consolidation form, monitoring and observing slurry diffusion forms with different colors in real time, calculating blocking coefficients, analyzing pore pressure change in the grouting process and the like, thereby having important significance and value for tunnel water burst grouting blocking rescue and disaster relief engineering.

title_en: Control method, terminal equipment and storage medium for sediment disturbance in water
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of communication, and particularly relates to a control method, terminal equipment and storage medium for sediment disturbance in water, wherein the method comprises the steps of modeling a target river channel region to obtain a river channel three-dimensional model, and enabling a ship traveling model to carry out simulated navigation in the river channel three-dimensional model, so that disturbance influence of ship traveling on sediment in water is simulated, further a navigation mode with the best effect of optimizing the flatness of a river bed is determined, and the ship traveling is enabled to travel according to the navigation mode; according to the application, the effective simulation of river disturbance when the traveling vessel passes through the target river channel region is realized, and the disturbance simulation of navigation of the traveling vessel to the river bed sediment is realized, so that the traveling vessel navigation mode capable of optimizing the river bed sediment distribution to the greatest extent can be determined, the traveling vessel can navigate according to the navigation mode, the river bed can be kept to have smaller fluctuation, the stability of the river bed is further ensured, and the secondary disaster caused by the unstable river bed is avoided.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGKE YUNCHI ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Slope stability simulation system and simulation method in frozen soil environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope stability simulation system and a simulation method under a frozen soil environment, wherein the simulation system comprises a multi-source monitoring data acquisition module, a landslide geometric reconstruction module, a landslide influence factor and formation mechanism module and a sliding process numerical simulation and stability analysis module; the multisource monitoring data acquisition module is used for realizing landslide disaster attribution of the multispace dimension monitoring data; the landslide geometric reconstruction module is used for drawing a landslide geometric section; the landslide influence factor and formation mechanism module is used for analyzing environmental factors and engineering factors which influence landslide stability and deducing a disaster formation mechanism by utilizing the obtained influence factors; the sliding process numerical simulation and stability analysis module is used for simulating a sliding deformation process of the landslide, and calculating stability coefficients of the landslide under different working conditions based on analysis results of influence factors and disaster forming mechanisms. The invention can realize the research from data collection to cause analysis to analog reproduction of the one-stop permafrost region side slope.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG COMMUNICATIONS INVEST GROUP CO LTD;ENGINEERING CONSULTING AND DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD OF NORTHEAST FORESTRY UNIV;UNIV NORTHEAST FORESTRY;INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION TRANSP SCIENCE DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Mine thermodynamic disaster simulation training method and system based on augmented reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine thermodynamic disaster simulation training method and system based on augmented reality, which relate to the technical field of mine rescue simulation, and are characterized in that firstly, data information uploaded by a commander control end and a coordination relation among the data information are acquired, a scene database is established, and a thermodynamic disaster scene is obtained; the data information comprises environmental parameters, character models and equipment information; setting a task flow and task logic of each task point according to the scene database to form a task line; converting the thermodynamic disaster scene into an AR scene based on an augmented reality technology; and sending the AR scene and the task line to an operation end of the rescue team member for simulation training. The invention can simulate and train the rescue team member with low cost and high efficiency, and effectively improves the emergency disposal capability and self-rescue escape capability of the mine rescue team member for the thermodynamic disaster.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;YANKUANG ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Relay protection method and system for transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of relay protection, in particular to a relay protection method and a relay protection system for a transformer substation, comprising the following steps: and collecting electromagnetic field data of the substation relay, and drawing an electromagnetic field distribution diagram by integrating node connection data of a substation power grid to generate an electromagnetic field data matrix. According to the invention, through numerical solution of an electromagnetic field data matrix and accurate spatial positioning of nodes, an electromagnetic field distribution diagram can be drawn in detail, an in-depth view of interaction between power grid nodes is provided, not only is the accuracy of fault positioning improved, but also the accuracy of fault analysis and simulation is improved through accurate correction of the node positions, the continuity and safety of transformer substation operation are ensured, timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response are further enhanced through on-site testing and sending of early warning signals, a stronger guarantee is provided for preventing large-scale power interruption and equipment damage, and potential service interruption is reduced.

title_en: Fire disaster test system for main transformer of extra-high voltage transformer substation and application method of fire disaster test system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire test system of a main transformer of an extra-high voltage transformer substation and a use method thereof, wherein the fire test system comprises a box body, an oil pit, an oil pool, an oil pump, an electric valve, an oil drum and an overflow groove; oil pits are formed in two sides of the bottom of the tank body, a main transformer is arranged in the tank body, an oil tank is fixedly arranged at the top of the tank body, and the oil tank is connected with an oil drum in which transformer oil is placed through an oil pump and an electric valve; a plurality of heating rods are arranged in the oil pit and the oil pool; the outer side of the box body is provided with a main transformer oil storage cabinet, a regulating and repairing oil tank, a regulating and repairing oil storage cabinet and a high-pressure lifting seat, and the outer side of the regulating and repairing oil tank is provided with a regulating and repairing cooler and a plurality of main transformer coolers; a medium-pressure lifting seat and a plurality of low-pressure and neutral point lifting seats are arranged in the oil pool; a plurality of overflow grooves are formed in the wall of the oil tank; the oil pit and the oil pool are used for simulating oil spilling fire disaster formed by natural gushing, namely full liquid level overflow fire disaster, and the invention can be widely applied to the fire disaster test field.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Ground standby target identification method based on rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG (HOG) features
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground standby target identification method based on rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG features, relates to the technical field of ground standby target classification identification, and particularly aims to solve the problems that classical HOG features in the background art do not have rotation invariance and feature dimension is too high, and provides the ground standby target identification method based on rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG features, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a target image and an interference background to form a sample training set; extracting a rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG feature map of a sample training set, and using the feature map for training a classifier; and classifying the target real-time rotation invariant dimension-reducing HOG feature map by using a classifier to obtain the classification identification of the real-time ground standby target. The method has the advantages of describing infrared images with fewer textures and adapting to uncertainty of a standby target visual angle, indirectly reducing the requirement on visual angle transformation training samples, avoiding the SVM classifier from falling into dimension disasters, and improving classification recognition efficiency.

title_en: Aeroengine vibration prediction method based on assembly parameters
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aero-engine vibration prediction, and particularly relates to an aero-engine vibration prediction method based on assembly parameters. The specific technical scheme is as follows: formulating different accumulation contribution rates theta  k , obtaining M  k  principal component characteristic parameters by using a principal component analysis method, and constructing a variable two-class neural network D; training and testing the D by using M  k  main component characteristic parameters, and determining the number M  b  of the main component characteristic parameters corresponding to the optimal model; and constructing a two-classification vibration prediction model P based on the M  b  main component characteristic parameters, and predicting the vibration of the aeroengine by using the two-classification vibration prediction model P. The main component analysis method is adopted to extract main features with low correlation in a plurality of aircraft engine assembly parameters, and modeling is carried out based on main feature data, so that the calculated amount is greatly reduced, and the dimension disaster risk in the machine learning modeling process is reduced.

title_en: Mine emergency rescue drilling simulation and evaluation system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of coal mine rescue simulation training and discloses a system, a method and a storage medium for simulation and evaluation of mine emergency rescue drilling. The mine emergency rescue drilling simulation and evaluation system comprises: the drilling environment building module builds a drilling environment with a coal mine catastrophe effect; the role interaction exercise module carries out rescue exercise through VR equipment; the intelligent evaluation module of the drilling effect carries out intelligent evaluation on the effect of finishing the drilling task, wherein a task range determination submodule in the intelligent evaluation module establishes a task area, determines an assessment range and an assessment time period; the assessment content construction submodule combines one or more rescue drilling items and carries out score assignment on each rescue drilling item; the exercise effect scoring submodule synchronously completes exercise score settlement when VR exercise is completed based on score assignment. According to the application, through realizing virtual-real interaction with disasters, the reality of mine emergency rescue exercise is improved, so that the exercise efficiency is improved.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Rock mixing and ice water conversion numerical simulation method and device for extremely high mountain debris flow
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for simulating the rock mixing and ice water conversion values of extremely high mountain debris flow, which comprises the following steps: establishing an iceberg mixing physical model, and establishing a motion control equation of the iceberg mixing quasi-fluid by adopting a double-fluid model; establishing an ice water phase change and critical judgment physical model, correcting the actual density and volume of an ice chip body with the phase change being converted into a liquid phase according to the critical condition of ice-to-water conversion, and calculating the normal stress of the liquid phase and the shearing force of the liquid phase after the phase change; establishing a water-gas two-phase fluid dynamic physical model, and establishing a control equation set by utilizing a Lagrange equation set; and according to the established iceberg mixed physical model, the iceberg phase change and critical discrimination physical model and the steam-water two-phase fluid dynamic physical model, performing numerical discrete by adopting a numerical method, and converting a partial differential equation set into a discrete equation capable of being directly solved, thereby completing simulation analysis, performing inversion and prediction by utilizing a numerical simulation technology, and reducing loss caused by geological disasters.

title_en: Digital analog calling system for intelligent ward of inpatient department
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital simulation calling system for an intelligent ward of a hospitalization department, which comprises a nurse workstation, a corridor and a ward, wherein the nurse workstation comprises: intelligent nursing large screen, calling host, disaster recovery machine and exchanger; the corridor includes: a propaganda and education screen and a corridor screen; the ward includes: a bed head screen, a gate screen and a toilet caller; the call comprises the following steps: step one: pressing a caller of a head screen, transmitting information to a calling host by the head screen, and prompting a patient to call a bed number by the cyclic play through the calling host until a nurse answers; and step two, performing step two. This department of hospitalizing wisdom ward digital analog calling system has set up and has readied disaster recovery machine and head of a bed screen, when the head of a bed screen outage, improves the patient's safety guarantee of ward, and the caller of head of a bed screen can be with information transfer for readying disaster recovery machine, automatic switch to analog calling line, ensure the comprehensive guarantee of calling, report the information of patient through readying disaster recovery machine, prevent that patient's state of an illness from receiving the influence.

title_en: Safety management information sharing system and method for power enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety management information sharing system and a safety management information sharing method for an electric power enterprise, wherein the safety management information sharing system comprises an identity authority management module, a safety monitoring early warning module, a device state management maintenance module, an employee training knowledge management module, an emergency response disaster backup management module, a vulnerability management safety update module, a real-time communication notification service module and a compliance audit supervision module.
assignees: CHINA SUNTIEN GREEN ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Application disaster recovery exercise method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an application disaster recovery exercise method, an application disaster recovery exercise device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the application disaster recovery exercise method comprises the following steps: backing up application metadata of an original application in a main resource pool to a preset object for storage, and copying application business data on an original application-mounted main storage volume to a standby storage volume of a standby resource pool; creating a first snapshot and snapshot content of application service data on a backup storage volume in a backup application space, creating a snapshot content copy corresponding to the snapshot content in the drilling application space, creating a second snapshot by adopting the snapshot content copy, creating a drilling storage volume in the drilling application space by adopting the second snapshot, copying the application service data on the backup storage volume to the drilling storage volume, restoring application metadata stored by a preset object into drilling application, drilling the drilling application and the drilling storage volume, and generating disaster recovery drilling results. The invention respectively exercises the application metadata and the application business data of the main resource pool to the exercise application and the exercise storage volume in the standby resource pool, thereby realizing the disaster recovery exercise across the application space.
assignees: JINAN INSPUR DATA TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for analyzing dispersion area through cluster analysis for flow and dispersion patterns near nuclear power plants and time of arrival analysis
title_ko: 원전 부지의 기류확산 군집분석 및 도착시간 분석법을 통한 확산 영역 분석 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide a method and system for analyzing diffusion zones through cluster analysis of air current diffusion and arrival time analysis of nuclear power plant sites, which can minimize the impact of a release scenario and identify in detail the diffusion distribution according to meteorological and geographical characteristics around the nuclear power plant site, and analyze the diffusion zone based thereon to establish an emergency plan that reflects meteorological and geographical factors for a nuclear disaster. The method comprises: (1) a step of performing an air current diffusion model using a release scenario in the event of a nuclear power plant accident to obtain trajectory data and dispersion data, which are prediction data of the air current diffusion model; (2) a step of classifying the trajectory data into multiple clusters by cluster analysis by nuclear power plant site; and (3) a step of, analyzing, for each cluster classified by the nuclear power plant site, the diffusion data obtained in the step (1) using the time of arrival analysis method, and analyzing the arrival time, which is the time interval between the release start time at the location of the nuclear power plant site that is the release origin and the time (detection of non-zero value) at which the radioactive material simulated by the air current diffusion model first reaches the target location.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원전 부지의 기류확산 군집분석 및 도착시간 분석법을 통한 확산 영역 분석 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 확산 영역 분석 방법으로서, (1) 원전 사고 시 방출 시나리오를 이용해 기류확산 모델을 수행하여, 상기 기류확산 모델의 예측 데이터인 궤적(trajectory) 데이터 및 확산(dispersion) 데이터를 획득하는 단계; (2) 상기 궤적 데이터를 원전 부지별로 군집분석하여 복수의 군집으로 분류하는 단계; 및 (3) 상기 원전 부지별로 분류된 각각의 군집에 대해서, 상기 단계 (1)에서 획득한 확산 데이터를 도착시간 분석법(Time of Arrival analysis)으로 분석해, 방출 원점이 되는 원전 부지의 위치에서 방출이 시작되는 방출 시작 시각과, 상기 기류확산 모델에 의해 모사된 방사성 물질이 목표 위치에 최초로 도달하는 시각(detection of non-zero value) 사이의 시간 간격인 도착시간을 분석하는 단계를 포함하되, 상기 단계 (1)의 기류확산 모델은, HYSPLIT 모델(Hybrid Single-Particle Lagrangian Integrated Trajectory model)이며, 기상수치모델이 생산한 기상자료를 사용하여 수행되고, 확산 모사를 위해 상기 방출 시나리오에 따라 상기 예측 데이터를 생산하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 본 발명은 원전 부지의 기류확산 군집분석 및 도착시간 분석법을 통한 확산 영역 분석 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 확산 영역 분석 시스템으로서, 원전 사고 시 방출 시나리오를 이용해 기류확산 모델을 수행하여, 상기 기류확산 모델의 예측 데이터인 궤적(trajectory) 데이터 및 확산(dispersion) 데이터를 획득하는 데이터 획득 모듈; 상기 궤적 데이터를 원전 부지별로 군집분석하여 복수의 군집으로 분류하는 궤적 군집분석 모듈; 및 상기 원전 부지별로 분류된 각각의 군집에 대해서, 상기 데이터 획득 모듈에서 획득한 확산 데이터를 도착시간 분석법(Time of Arrival analysis)으로 분석해, 방출 원점이 되는 상기 원전 부지의 위치에서 방출이 시작되는 방출 시작 시각과, 상기 기류확산 모델에 의해 모사된 방사성 물질이 목표 위치에 최초로 도달하는 시각(detection of non-zero value) 사이의 시간 간격인 도착시간을 분석하는 확산 지도 분석 모듈을 포함하되, 상기 기류확산 모델은, HYSPLIT 모델(Hybrid Single-Particle Lagrangian Integrated Trajectory model)이며, 기상수치모델이 생산한 기상자료를 사용하여 수행되고, 확산 모사를 위해 상기 방출 시나리오에 따라 상기 예측 데이터를 생산하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 원전 부지의 기류확산 군집분석 및 도착시간 분석법을 통한 확산 영역 분석 방법 및 시스템에 따르면, 현실성 있는 방출 시나리오를 사용한 기류확산 모델 데이터로부터 궤적 데이터의 군집분석과 확산 데이터의 농도 분석을 결합하되, 방출 시나리오에 영향을 받지 않는 도착시간 분석법을 사용해 확산 데이터를 분석함으로써, 방출 시나리오에 의한 영향을 최소화하고 원전 부지 주변 기상 및 지리 특성에 따른 확산 분포를 상세하게 파악할 수 있고, 이를 기초로 확산 영역을 분석하여, 원자력 재해에 대해 기상 및 지리적인 요소가 반영된 비상 계획을 수립할 수 있다.

title_en: Mountain anti-skid device for geological disaster management
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of side slope protection engineering, and discloses a mountain anti-skid device for geological disaster management, which comprises a construction layer, wherein the construction layer comprises an anchor rod, the upper end of the anchor rod is provided with a reinforcing steel bar, the side surface of the anchor rod is provided with a positioning bracket, and a drilling hole for installing and fixing the anchor rod is formed in a mountain. The mountain anti-skid device for geological disaster management has the advantages that the anchor rods, the steel bars and the positioning brackets are matched to trim the slope surface of a slope, anchor rod hole sites are arranged, the anchor rods are used for forming holes, mounting and grouting, the slope surface is hung with a net and is sprayed, and the effect of preventing landslide, collapse and other natural disasters caused by erosion of the slope is achieved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HANGBO ECOLOGICAL ENV CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster prevention and control construction grouting anchor rod
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grouting anchor rod for geological disaster prevention and control construction, which comprises a base plate, a main rod body, a connecting piece and a drill bit, wherein a grout stop is arranged at the middle position of the bottom end of the base plate, the main rod body is connected and arranged at the middle position of the bottom end of the base plate, the base plate and the main rod body are fixedly connected, grouting holes are uniformly formed in the outer part of the main rod body at equal intervals, grout stop rings are uniformly arranged in the outer part of the main rod body at equal intervals, and the main rod body and the grout stop rings are fixedly connected. According to the grouting anchor rod, the plurality of groups of grouting holes are formed in the outer portion of the main rod body, the plurality of groups of grouting rings are uniformly arranged at equal intervals on the outer portion of the main rod body, when the grouting anchor rod is inserted into a rock stratum, grout can enter the rock stratum through the grouting holes in the main rod body, and the grouting rings can be expanded when the grout contacts the grouting rings, so that the grouting rings can effectively perform graded grouting in the rock stratum, and the overall grouting effect and the gap filling stability are improved.

title_en: Extended reality based simulator and method thereof
title_ko: 확장 현실 기반 시뮬레이터 및 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an extended reality-based simulator and a simulation method capable of generating marine sports, marine disasters, and the like as virtual reality and allowing a user to experience the virtual reality through a simulator to which the generated virtual reality is applied. The extended reality-based simulator comprises: a driving unit capable of moving in a single direction by an user experiencing extended reality (XR); a content providing unit for providing the user with content for at least one of marine sports, natural disasters which may occur in the sea, and coastal experience; and a motion control unit for controlling the motion of the driving unit so that the content output through the content providing unit corresponds to the experience conditions selected by the user. The present invention may improve an individual's health state through a coastal experience by allowing the user to experience coastal areas or the like through extended reality under conditions similar to the actual environment.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 예는 해양 스포츠, 해양 재해, 해안 체험, 해양치유 체험 등을 가상 현실로 생성하고, 생성된 가상 현실이 적용된 시뮬레이터를 통해 확장 현실을 체험할 수 있는 확장 현실 기반 시뮬레이터 및 시뮬레이션 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Prediction and simulation system of beach erosion and method thereof
title_ko: 연안침식 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a coastal erosion prediction simulation system and method capable of predicting coastal erosion and coastline changes. A method for simulating coastal erosion comprises the steps of: collecting coastal information on at least one of sandy beach, shore, and coastal erosion information; predicting a coastline change based on the collected coastal information; and simulating the predicted coastline change. The step of collecting coastal information includes a step of collecting soil movement information on a cross-shore sediment transport and a coastline sediment transport of the coastline due to any one of a direction of wind and a disaster according to season, and at least one of typhoon, swell waves, and rip currents generated on the coastline. According to the present invention, the degree of coastal erosion and coastline change can be predicted, the amount of sand supplied to the beach can be estimated according to the predicted degree of coastline change, and the frequency and type of coastal disaster according to the coastline change can be estimated.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 예는 연안침식과 해안선 변화를 모니터링하고 예측하며, 해안선 변화 정도를 가상 현실로 체험할 수 있는 연안침식 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Big data-based digital twin control system for port infrastructure maintenance
title_ko: 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a big data-based digital twin control system for port infrastructure maintenance, which comprises: a port data collection unit (100) for integrally managing information on a building, a road, and a bridge constituting a port; a digital twin platform (200) for implementing a digital twin and outputting the same as virtual modeling data of the digital twin; an object modeling unit (210) for performing 3D or 2D virtual modeling work; a simulator unit (220) for predicting a damage occurrence situation due to disaster occurrence and aging of the port building/facility/road/bridge; a state detection unit (230) for monitoring the state of a sensor and whether the sensor is malfunctioning in real time; a structure analysis server (300) for calculating each remaining lifetime through information data transmitted from the port data collection unit (100) and structure analysis data on the port/road/bridge; a digital twin DB (400) for storing data on other ports which are already implemented; and a display unit (500) for displaying the virtual modeling data on a monitor. According to the present invention, the aging degree of the port infrastructure can be visually and immediately checked through the display unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물의 층/구분공간(zone)/설비별로 에너지 소비량을 디지털 트윈의 가상 모델링 데이터로 출력하는 복합용도 대규모 다중건물의 에너지 관리 및 최적화를 지원하는 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에 관한 것이다.  
종래 항만의 유지보수를 위해 디지털 트윈 플랫폼이 적용된 바 없으므로, 본 발명은 항만을 구성하는 건물과 도로 및 교량에 대한 정보를 통합 관리하는 항만 데이터 취합부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터를 통해 객체 모델링부에 의해 디지털 트윈(Digital Twin)을 구현하고, 구조해석 서버에서 전달되는 항만건물/시설/도로/교량에 대한 구조 해석 데이터와 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 노후도 정보를 기반으로 디지털 트윈의 가상 모델링 데이터로 출력하는 디지털 트윈 플랫폼과; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부(100)에서 전달된 정보 데이터에 의해 3D 또는 2D의 가상화 모델링 작업을 진행하는 객체 모델링부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터를 통해 항만건물과 도로 및 교량에 대한 잔여 수명을 예측하는 시뮬레이터부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부의 정보 데이터에 포함된 센서의 상태 및 고장여부를 실시간을 감시하는 상태감지부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터와, 항만/도로/교량에 대한 구조 해석 데이터를 통해 각각의 잔여 수명을 연산하는 구조해석 서버와; 기존에 구현되어 있는 다른 항만에 대한 데이터가 저장되는 디지털 트윈DB와; 상기 디지털 트윈 플랫폼(200)에서 구현되는 가상 모델링 데이터를 모니터에 표출하는 디스플레이부를 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에서는 디지털 트윈DB에 저장된 동일 또는 유사한 항만의 빅데이터(Big Data)를 머신러닝(Machine Learning) 알고리즘과 AI(Artificial Intelligence)를 적용하여 디지털 트윈 구현의 효율성을 향상시키는 것을 특징으로 하는 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템을 제안한다. 
본 발명에 의한 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템은 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달되는 정보 데이터가 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에 전달되고, 객체 모델링부를 통해 각 구성요소에 대한 가상화 모델링 작업을 진행하며, 항만건물/시설/도로/교량의 노후도를 예측 및 시뮬레이션하여 디스플레이할 수 있으므로, 디스플레이부를 통해 시각적으로 항만 인프라의 노후도를 즉각 확인이 가능한 효과가 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반 시뮬레이션을 통한 재해발생 및 노후화에 의한 피해발생상황 예측 및 즉각적인 정책적 의사결정 시스템을 구축하고, 빅데이터(기본정보, 2내역/3내역 데이터 및 노후도/재해위험도 평가 데이터 등) 분석 및 가시화를 통한 항만 인프라 모니터링이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Device and method for simulated training of wading escape after mine flood
abstract_en: The application provides a device and a method for simulating training of wading escape after mine floods, comprising the following steps: and determining a test simulation model of personnel involved in water escape, and realizing various working condition scenes with different roadway gradients by adjusting the tail height of the roadway model. Meanwhile, the personnel wading escape simulation training test device can develop personnel wading stability tests and wading capability practical training under different water flow conditions, support and quantitatively evaluate the influence of roadway gradient, water flow parameters and personnel physical characteristics on the stability of wading personnel, so that the capability of personnel in self-understanding wading danger in mine water disaster escape and rescue processes is improved. The warning is knocked to related enterprises and practitioners through experiments, and the sensitivity of the related enterprises and practitioners to potential hazards is improved, so that injuries caused by the related risks are reduced.

title_en: Simulation experiment device and method for impact of debris flow on traffic infrastructure
abstract_en: The application relates to a simulation experiment device and a simulation experiment method for the impact of debris flow on traffic infrastructure, belongs to the technical field of debris flow disaster simulation, and solves the problem that the simulation process of the existing debris flow simulation device is inconsistent with the actual situation. The simulation experiment device for the impact of the debris flow on the traffic infrastructure comprises a platform, a ramp, a stacking plate and a material spreading mechanism, wherein a material box is arranged on the platform; one end of the ramp is connected with the platform; the stacking plate is connected with the other end of the ramp, and is provided with a traffic infrastructure and monitoring equipment to be subjected to simulation test; the platform, the ramp and the stacking plate are sequentially arranged from top to bottom; the spreading mechanism is connected to the sliding rail in a sliding manner, is arranged opposite to the ramp, and can move along with the tap flowing on the ramp and uniformly spread wood branches and broken stones onto the tap of the debris flow. The application can achieve the simulation effect of simulating the wrapping and clamping of tree sundries by the debris flow in the natural environment, and is closer to the actual situation.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning misalignment risk analysis method based on Monte Carlo simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster early warning misalignment risk analysis method based on a Monte Carlo simulation method, which comprises the steps of extracting and analyzing initial indexes of mountain torrent disasters, screening sensitive indexes and reducing weight to obtain a mountain torrent disaster index set, and constructing a mountain torrent disaster index system; weighting the mountain torrent disaster indexes to obtain comprehensive weights of the mountain torrent disaster indexes, and constructing a mountain torrent disaster early warning model; extracting historical mountain torrents data of a research area, inputting the historical mountain torrents into a mountain torrents disaster early warning model to obtain mountain torrents disaster early warning, setting an early warning misalignment threshold value based on a mountain torrents index system, and calculating mountain torrents disaster early warning misalignment probability; and (3) adjusting the decision of the mountain torrent disaster index weight and feeding back the mountain torrent disaster index weight into the mountain torrent disaster early warning model, setting iteration preset times, extracting the mountain torrent disaster early warning model after the iteration is input, and stopping iteration when the result after the iteration and the expected deviation are within the early warning misalignment threshold. The invention can effectively improve the early warning accuracy and the response efficiency of the mountain torrent disaster and is beneficial to reducing the loss caused by the mountain torrent disaster.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Data quality real-time monitoring method and system based on data asset
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a data quality real-time monitoring method and a system based on data assets, through a series of innovative steps of simulating a data loss scene, pertinently debugging a data disaster tolerance model, monitoring data risks in real time, optimizing a monitoring model and the like, the method aims to provide more efficient and more accurate data recovery and risk early warning service for enterprises. The technical proposal not only solves a plurality of problems existing in the traditional data disaster recovery and risk monitoring technology, but also provides powerful technical support for enterprise data security and risk control.

title_en: Quick calculation method for crowd evacuation time in super high-rise building
abstract_en: The application relates to a rapid calculation method for crowd evacuation time in a super high-rise building, belongs to the technical field of building safety, and solves the technical problem that the calculation time is long when the existing building evacuation simulation software calculates the crowd evacuation time in the super high-rise building in the prior art. The application comprises the following steps: parameters are input into the mathematical model, evacuation time of different evacuation modes is calculated, and the total evacuation time is obtained. The application realizes that the evacuation calculation time can be reduced to the second level from the calculation time of 1-2 hours of the traditional evacuation simulation software; meanwhile, the error in total evacuation can be controlled within 5%.

title_en: Human-machine real-time multichannel-based augmented reality fire evacuation simulation method and wearable system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of augmented reality fire evacuation, in particular to an augmented reality fire evacuation method and a wearable system based on man-machine real-time multi-channel, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring visual information of flames and smoke in a simulated fire scene and visual information of a real space scene through augmented reality glasses; the acquired visual data are sent to a data control center for calculation and processing, so that various physical characteristic somatosensory data in a fire scene are obtained; and sending the physical characteristic somatosensory data to the fire interactive helmets, the fire interactive gloves and the fire interactive protective clothing, so that the wearing personnel feel a real scene of a fire scene. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of calculating the development of the fire scene in real time, simulating multichannel signals such as vision, hearing, touch and the like in the fire scene, constructing the fire scene from various aspects such as temperature, smoke, fatigue degree and the like, enabling personnel to experience real fire evacuation scene and the like.

title_en: Green tide coverage area forecasting method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green tide coverage area forecasting method based on deep learning, and belongs to the field of ocean forecasting. The method comprises the following steps: a. determining a forecasting area and forecasting time effect; b. collecting green tide coverage area historical multisource fusion data and atmospheric and ocean multi-element historical observation data; c. determining a training set and a testing set based on the long-short memory neural network, and designing factor combinations and parameter setting experimental schemes; d. training a model to obtain a forecast model of different factor combinations; e. performing forecasting effect inspection, and selecting an optimal forecasting factor combination; f. further adopting a parameter setting experimental scheme to optimize a training model; g. performing forecasting effect inspection, and selecting optimal parameter setting to obtain an optimal forecasting model of the green tide coverage area; h, inputting an actual measurement forecasting factor to obtain a green tide coverage area forecasting result. The method can forecast the green tide coverage area for 3 days, and provides effective auxiliary decision information for green tide disaster prevention and control work.

title_en: Mining roadway positioning pressure relief and anchor rod (cable) breakage prevention integrated method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mining roadway positioning pressure relief and anchor rod (cable) breakage prevention integrated method, which is used for determining the distribution range, the layer position and the azimuth of a hidden danger disaster-causing layer which possibly causes the anchor rod (cable) breakage according to a mining pressure theoretical calculation formula, constructing anchor rod (cable) holes, and locally reaming the anchor rod (cable) holes penetrating through the hidden danger disaster-causing layer by adopting a conical reaming drilling tool, wherein the reaming height is higher than the upper boundary of the hidden danger disaster-causing layer, so that the breakage effect on the anchor rod (cable) caused by the uncoordinated deformation and damage of the hidden danger-causing layer and adjacent rock stratum is eliminated, the shearing breakage of the anchor rod (cable) is avoided, and the effect of surrounding rock pressure relief of the hidden danger disaster-causing layer distribution area is achieved. The invention has the functions of positioning and pressure relief and anti-shearing of the anchor rod (rope) and plays an important role in controlling the surrounding rock of the large-deformation mining roadway.

title_en: Industrial control network safety early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial control network safety early warning method and system, which relate to the technical field of network safety and comprise the following steps: carrying out fragile penetration test on the network terminals of all users; obtaining the safety reference parameters of the network terminals of all users through data processing; generating user group labels, and performing simulation attack on all users in each user group label; according to the attack simulation parameters of the user group labels, integrating and processing to obtain user emergency response parameters of the user group labels; early warning is carried out on a network security manager, a simulated attack period corresponding to each user group label is generated, and the simulated attack period is sent to the network security manager; according to the invention, the simulated attack period of each user group label is generated according to the user emergency response parameters of each user group label, so that the aim of testing personnel in an industrial enterprise is fulfilled, the testing efficiency is improved, the testing resources are saved, and the network security of the industrial enterprise is maintained.

title_en: Wave-current coupling scouring simulation system in super-gravity field and test method
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a centrifugal simulation system and a test method for a flushing process of a hydraulic building in a hypergravity field. The test method simulates the scouring dynamic process of the hydraulic building under the coupling action of wave current in the real stress state by simultaneously arranging wave and current in the supergravity field formed by the centrifugal machine, and belongs to the technical field of centrifugal model test. The invention utilizes the centrifugal simulation technology to form the ultra-gravity field, establishes the simulation test system of the scouring process of the hydraulic building with the ultra-gravity field, which is suitable for the complex hydraulic environment, through six steps of setting a similar scale, placing a soil sample, a saturated soil sample, installing a model, carrying out coupling loading, observing and recording, and can realize the real working condition of simulating a prototype under a large span time in a short time due to the time shrinking effect of the scale. Compared with the prior art, the method can realize great progress for improving the disaster prevention and reduction decision level, the service performance and the toughness grade of the hydraulic building.

title_en: Multi-source geological disaster information intelligent processing method, equipment and storage medium
