abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent processing method, equipment and a storage medium for multi-source geological disaster information, and belongs to the technical field of multi-source geological disaster information fusion. The intelligent processing method comprises the following steps: randomly extracting a first sample set and a second sample set after manually interpreting a geological disaster sample data set in a research area; combining all geological disaster samples of the first sample set and the second sample set pairwise, and performing supervised learning training to obtain a multi-source geological disaster classification model; and calculating and substituting the characteristic inputs of the two geological disaster samples to be classified in the research area into a multi-source geological disaster classification model, outputting classification results of the two geological disaster samples, and repeating until the classification of the geological disaster sample data set in the research area is completed. According to the invention, multisource geological disaster information is processed from multiple dimensions, intelligent identification and classification of the same geological disaster are completed, and rapid fusion of geological disaster investigation data is realized.

title_en: Bank system performance prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bank system performance prediction method and a bank system performance prediction device, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence and the financial field, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting the whole state data of each business system in the bank system, wherein the whole state data reflects the whole operation health state of the business system; according to the overall state data of each service system, the overall operation health state of each service system is respectively judged; and for a service system with the overall operation health state needing to be observed: collecting a plurality of monitoring data; performing data dimension reduction on the monitoring data according to a principal component analysis algorithm to obtain a feature vector; respectively inputting the feature vectors into a performance prediction model, and outputting risk early warning information; when the performance prediction model sends risk early warning according to the histories of the business systems: monitoring data and risk early warning information, and training a support vector machine model. The invention can effectively reduce the data quantity and avoid data disasters.

title_en: Position optimization method and system for UAV-RIS auxiliary wireless communication based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a position optimization method and a system for UAV-RIS auxiliary wireless communication based on reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: building a UAV-RIS auxiliary wireless communication model under a disaster scene; obtaining an optimal model of the optimal position with the highest throughput of multi-communication fairness under the disaster scene based on reinforcement learning in the wireless communication model; and training and learning by utilizing environmental data changing along with the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle, optimizing the track of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and optimizing the neural network parameters according to feedback to obtain the optimal position of the maximum throughput of the user side. The invention solves the deployment position relation of the RIS auxiliary mmWave communication system carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and simultaneously considers factors such as communication fairness, limitation of the flyable area, transmitting power and the like, can ensure the communication requirements of a plurality of trapped users, and proposes to maximize the throughput of the users.

title_en: Tunnel disaster simulation method, device and equipment based on three-dimensional digital twin model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a tunnel disaster simulation method, device and equipment based on a three-dimensional digital twin model. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring cable data of an actual cable tunnel and a cable tunnel disaster test case; inputting cable data and cable tunnel disaster test cases into a pre-established three-dimensional digital twin model of the tunnel to obtain a disaster state cable tunnel model; carrying out tunnel disaster scene detection on the disaster state cable tunnel model to generate a tunnel scene detection result; determining corresponding disaster processing information; calling a corresponding simulation tool to execute tunnel disaster processing operation; determining a tunnel scene detection result, disaster processing information and difference data between a called simulation tool and a test sample; and determining that the tunnel disaster simulation corresponding to the cable tunnel disaster test case is completed. This embodiment may reduce the damage of cable resources in case of disasters.

title_en: Data-driven passive flexible protection structure performance design method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of slope geological disaster protection and intelligent design, and particularly discloses a data-driven passive flexible protection structure performance design method, which comprises the following key steps: firstly, a data set of the specification and the response of the passive flexible protective structure component is established through a large number of numerical simulations, then a complex nonlinear mapping relation between specification characteristics and key responses is learned through a training regression model, and finally an intelligent optimization model is trained through the acquired mapping relation to search an optimal solution through designing fitness functions and boundary conditions. The method breaks through the traditional 'trial-and-error' design thought based on the physical model and the mechanical model, combines different design targets, can automatically generate an optimal design scheme, solves the problem that the conventional passive flexible protection structure cannot realize performance design, and can greatly reduce design cost while ensuring the performance.

title_en: Transmission network safety target range building system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission network safety target range building system which comprises a transmission network topology generation module, an attack scene simulation module, a real-time data transmission module, an abnormality detection and emergency response module, a user interface and a management control module. The invention has the advantages that a real, efficient, practical and safe training and experiment platform is provided for network security personnel aiming at the characteristics of the transmission network, so as to support the network security personnel to carry out deep security test and training on the transmission network, and the security protection capability of the transmission network is obviously improved.
assignees: BEIJING TELECOM PLANNING & DESIGNING INST CO LTD;CHINA INF TECHNOLOGY DESIGNING CONSULTING INST CO LTD

title_en: Dangerous chemical diffusion area calculation method of live-action three-dimensional and physical engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating a dangerous chemical diffusion area based on a live-action three-dimensional and physical engine, which comprises the following steps: s1, inputting leakage parameters and environment parameters in a live-action three-dimensional virtual display platform iReal; s2, selecting a proper diffusion model according to the parameters, and calculating diffusion parameters; s3, realizing a corresponding diffusion region calculation algorithm according to the input parameters and the diffusion model selected in the step S2; and S4, dynamically drawing the real-time dynamic of the diffusion area calculated and output in the step S3 in a live-action three-dimensional scene, and evaluating the injury range. According to the method, the real-time three-dimensional data are combined to calculate the dangerous chemical leakage area, and real-time dynamic three-dimensional rendering is carried out in the virtual reality scene, so that the user is enabled to be in the scene, and the method has a certain value for regular exercise, disaster relief and post-disaster recovery.
assignees: GEOVIS JINNENG NANJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Farmer behavior prediction method based on agent modeling and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a farmer behavior prediction method based on agent modeling and a Bayesian network, and belongs to the technical field of farmer behavior simulation prediction. The method comprises the following steps: a data collection stage; a Bayesian relation network and a group effect influence mechanism construction stage; a peasant household disaster prevention consciousness change mechanism construction stage; a peasant household long-term disaster response adaptation behavior prediction model construction stage; setting model parameters; and in the model information importing and simulating stage, inputting the external conditions of the target area, then simulating random outbreaks of geological disasters for a plurality of times, counting the decision behaviors of each simulated target agent, and taking an average value to obtain a peasant household behavior prediction result. The ABM method is adopted, so that the response behaviors of farmers in various disaster scenes can be simulated, influence factors and rules of the farmers are analyzed, and the method has high predictability and applicability; the phenomenon of emergence of the behaviors of the farmers can be mined in the simulation process.

title_en: Prediction method and device for ecological effect caused by wave-induced liquefaction disaster
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a prediction method and device for ecological effects caused by wave-induced liquefaction disasters, and relates to the technical field of ocean data processing. The prediction method comprises the following steps: according to ocean simulation input data and a three-dimensional area ocean numerical simulation model, an ocean wave field model and an ocean tide field model are constructed, a first sediment re-suspension flux caused by wave liquefaction and a second sediment re-suspension flux caused by seabed sediment under the shearing action are determined through the ocean wave field model and the ocean tide field model, the ocean light intensity of a target ocean area in a target time period is calculated, and finally an ocean ecological effect prediction result can be determined based on the phytoplankton concentration of the ocean light intensity and an ocean ecological effect model. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the disclosure can combine a large amount of sediment re-suspension caused by simulated wave-induced silt seabed liquefaction to realize quantitative prediction of photosynthesis, phytoplankton and subsequent ecological effects in the ocean.
assignees: FIRST INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Underground infrastructure flood evacuation analysis method and system based on large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood evacuation analysis method and system of underground infrastructure based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring flood image information, and outputting disaster descriptions and risk levels corresponding to the flood image information through a large-model flood analysis mode training system; inputting the data output by the large model flood analysis mode training system into a large model-digital twin real-time deduction system through an integrated system of the large model and the digital twin platform for calling; carrying out data deduction through the large model-digital twin real-time deduction system, and outputting an analysis result; the invention provides a new underground infrastructure flood evacuation analysis method, which improves the decision efficiency of flood evacuation and emergency.

title_en: Safety evaluation method for sliding stability of calcareous sand sea area side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety evaluation method for the sliding stability of a calcareous sand sea area side slope, which belongs to the technical field of ocean monitoring, and comprises the following steps: testing the calcareous sand foundation soil body at the side slope of the sea area to be tested; and (3) carrying out normal bias stress drainage shear test on the calcareous sand foundation soil body based on a standard path triaxial system, simulating the whole development process of instability damage of the calcareous sand foundation soil body under the action of the sliding stress, drawing a stress path curve by taking the effective average main stress as an abscissa and the bias stress as an ordinate, determining the sliding instability coefficient based on the stress path curve, comparing the sliding instability coefficient with the engineering requirement coefficient, and judging that the calcareous sand foundation soil body is stable if the difference value between the sliding instability coefficient and the engineering requirement coefficient is within a set range, otherwise judging that the calcareous sand foundation soil body is unstable. The method is convenient for carrying out reinforcement and improvement treatment in time, meets engineering construction requirements, and prevents potential engineering disasters.

title_en: Ecological environment treatment mechanism for geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological environment treatment mechanism for geological disasters, which comprises a vehicle body, a filling mechanism and a first drilling mechanism, wherein the vehicle body comprises a moving part and a box body arranged on the moving part, a cavity is arranged in the box body, filled soil is contained in the cavity, an opening is formed in one side of the cavity, a telescopic part is arranged on the box body and connected with a push plate arranged in the cavity, and the telescopic part can drive the push plate to move towards one side of the opening; the first regulating part is fixedly arranged on one side of the box body, a through hole is formed in the first regulating part, the through hole is located below the opening, the lower end of the first regulating part is rotationally connected with the first earth drilling part, the first regulating part is used for driving the first earth drilling part to lift, a filling hole is formed in the first earth drilling part, and the filling hole and the central axis of the through hole are in a first state perpendicular to each other or in a second state coincident with each other. Solves the problem that the soil adapting to geology is difficult to be refilled into the ground in the prior art, and the filling or replacement of deep soil is realized.
assignees: MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water logging disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water-logging disasters, which comprises the following steps: step S1, constructing an electric power-drainage network coupling model based on partial differential constraint of pressure and non-pressure unsteady flow hydrodynamic force, and representing dynamic interactive evolution processes of power failure, rainwater overflow and road ponding of a power grid under a storm disaster; s2, establishing an equivalent linear complex algebraic equation of a drainage network nonlinear hydrodynamic partial differential equation in a frequency domain; s3, deducing a multi-hyperplane formula of an electric power-drainage composite safety area, and representing a feasible operation boundary of an electric pump-sluice group under the injection conditions of complex electric power and rainwater; and S4, taking rainfall uncertainty in heavy rain into consideration, adopting multi-scene random optimization based on Monte Carlo simulation, and solving an emergency scheduling decision scheme at the current moment through rolling optimization. The invention realizes the coordination reconstruction of the network topology of the power distribution network and the drainage network under the disaster of rainstorm and waterlogging.

title_en: Regional flood control and urban flood drainage standard cooperation method and system based on game theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for cooperating regional flood control and urban flood drainage standards based on a game theory, which are used for constructing a hydrographic hydrodynamic model of a coupling region and a city; obtaining flood simulation data under each flood scene; the economic data in the basic data are called and spread to a preset resolution, and social economic grid data of the region and the city are obtained; calculating the regional and urban flood disaster direct economic loss grid data under each flood scene; aiming at a research area, constructing an area flood control and urban flood drainage standard collaborative game model, wherein a master person is urban flood drainage and a slave person is area flood control; and calling a preconfigured algorithm, solving a regional flood control and urban flood drainage standard collaborative game model, analyzing a game process, obtaining a Nash equilibrium strategy, and outputting a solving result. The method can provide a reference for the fine decision making of the regional and urban flood control and drainage games, and provides a new thought for realizing the overall optimal risk and benefit of regional and urban flood control and drainage.

title_en: Bombing phenomenon experiment demonstration device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bombing phenomenon experiment demonstration device, which relates to the technical field of smoke and fire characteristic demonstration equipment and comprises the following components: the first-floor combustion chamber is arranged on the second-floor smoke exhaust chamber above the first-floor combustion chamber; one corner in the first-floor combustion chamber is provided with a combustion table, the front surface of the first-floor combustion chamber is provided with a first observation window, the side surface of the first-floor combustion chamber is provided with a blasting window, the side wall of the first-floor combustion chamber is provided with an environment simulation mechanism for detecting the internal temperature of the protective clothing, and the first-floor combustion chamber is provided with a door; the bottom of the second floor smoke exhaust chamber is provided with a first through hole leading to the first floor combustion chamber. The environment simulation mechanism can be communicated with the first-floor combustion chamber through the shell, the temperature in the shell is the same as the temperature in the first-floor combustion chamber, and the first temperature sensor is wrapped by the protective clothing material to measure the temperature in the protective clothing material, so that the influence of the temperature in each stage of the detonation combustion phenomenon on firefighters is explained, and the optimal time for entering a fire scene is explained.

title_en: Power maintenance field operation risk management and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system maintenance, in particular to a power maintenance field operation risk management and control method, which comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a power maintenance operation risk database, and integrating historical operation data and environment data; s2: using big data analysis techniques to evaluate potential risks based on the job tasks and the site environment data; s3: formulating targeted risk management and control measures according to the risk assessment result, wherein the targeted risk management and control measures comprise safety early warning setting and safety training; s4: real-time monitoring in the operation process is executed, field data are collected through the Internet of things technology, and real-time analysis and emergency response of risks are realized; s5: and after the operation is completed, performing retrospective analysis, summarizing risk management experience, and optimizing a risk database and a management and control flow. According to the invention, through integrating a plurality of advanced technologies, the operation safety can be effectively improved, the dynamic risk management and the remarkable improvement of the operation efficiency can be realized, and the method has important practical value and wide application prospect.
assignees: WUXI ZEAN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Saline-alkali soil oil sunflower protection sowing alfalfa planting technology and planting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pasture planting, in particular to a saline-alkali soil oil sunflower protection sowing alfalfa planting technology and a planting device. The utility model provides a technology and a device for planting alfalfa by oil sunflower protection seeding in saline-alkali soil, which can resist wind disaster and realize protective cultivation by taking oil sunflower as a seedling stage alfalfa, so that the pasture planting field and pasture mechanization are widened. The planting technology and planting device for protecting and seeding alfalfa in saline-alkali soil comprises a connecting frame, an installing table, adjusting rods and the like, wherein the front part of the connecting frame is connected with the installing table, and a plurality of adjusting rods are connected to the lower side of the installing table. According to the utility model, by sowing the oil sunflower and the alfalfa in the same machine, namely, simultaneously sowing the oil sunflower and the alfalfa in a hill and a drill mode, a mode of alternately arranging the oil sunflower and the alfalfa in two rows is realized, the wind disaster resistance of the alfalfa in the seedling stage can be realized through the oil sunflower, and the protective cultivation is realized, so that the pasture planting field and the pasture mechanized effect are widened.

title_en: Building downslide escape training teaching model
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of escape training, in particular to a building downslide escape training teaching model which fully simulates critical situations such as fire, earthquake and the like, so that a trainer is more immersive, the reality of training is improved, and the escape skill of the trainer is improved; the simulated house comprises a floor, a wall, an electric door, a window and an elevator; the system comprises a building, a building floor, a lifting mechanism, a fire disaster simulation mechanism, a spraying mechanism, an emergency mechanism and an escape mechanism, wherein the lifting mechanism is installed on the ground and used for lifting the simulation building, the bottom end of the earthquake simulation mechanism is connected with the top end of the lifting mechanism, the bottom end of the floor is connected with the top end of the earthquake simulation mechanism, the earthquake simulation mechanism drives the simulation building to shake left and right, the fire disaster simulation mechanism is installed on the simulation building and used for improving the temperature in a room, the spraying mechanism is installed on the simulation building, the emergency mechanism is installed on the simulation building, and the escape mechanism is installed on the simulation building and is convenient for a trainer to escape.
assignees: SHANDONG ORIENTAL CINDA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Firefighting Training System
abstract_en: To provide a firefighting training system enabling comprehensive training of how to extinguish a fire as well as how firefighters should act at fire scenes.SOLUTION: A firefighting training system 10 includes a simulated fire extinguisher 100 having a shape simulating a fire extinguisher and capable of detecting at least operations of a fire extinguishing agent ejection lever 101 and a hose 102 by a trainee, a smoke/flame image forming unit 205 for forming a smoke/flame image based on the detected operations of the ejection lever 101 and the hose 102, a composite image forming unit 206 for forming a composite image formed by combining an environmental image of a fire scene and the smoke/flame image formed by the smoke/flame image forming unit 205, a display 202 for displaying the composite image, and a presentation unit (presentation information control unit 207) that presents action instructions to the trainee 1 on the basis of a relation of the smoke/flame image to the environmental image included in the composite image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7
assignees: NIHON BOSAI GIJUTSU CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Assembly for piping connections using firefighting modularized unwelded method
title_ko: 소방 모듈화 무용접 공법을 이용한 배관 이음용 조립체
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an assembly for connecting pipes using a firefighting modularized non-welding method, which uses a non-welding method when branching from a main pipe to a branch pipe to simplify construction and fundamentally block the occurrence of a fire. An assembly for connecting pipes comprises: a first connection hole coupled to surround a water outlet drilled on the outer circumferential surface of the main pipe and having an outlet communicating with the water outlet; a second connection hole having both sides branched in a T-shape in a direction crossing a central axis line of the inlet on the other side of the body and having an outlet connected to the branch pipe; and a groove coupling fixed and coupled to an outer circumferential groove part of a connection portion of the first and second connection holes to maintain watertightness, wherein the groove coupling comprises: a housing; a gasket for maintaining watertightness; and a fastening member for fixing the divided housing.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 메인배관에서 가지배관으로 분기 시 무용접 공법을 이용함에 따라 시공이 간단하며, 화재 발생을 원천적으로 차단할 수 있는 소방모듈화 무용접 공법을 이용한 배관 이음용 조립체에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method for determining fault extension height based on core drilling
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining fault extension height based on core drilling, and relates to the technical field of hidden fault detection in a coal mining area. The method for determining the fault extension height based on core drilling comprises the following steps: step 1, demarcating a fault position; step 2, judging the stratum area type; step 3, core drilling and fault parameter calculation; step 31 or step 32 is alternatively performed according to the formation region type; step 31, core drilling and fault extension height calculation of a horizontal stratum area; step 32, core drilling and fault parameter calculation of the inclined stratum area. According to the invention, by means of the core drilling method, the hidden faults of the coal mine are detected, so that fault elements such as the fall of the hidden faults of the coal mine along the stratum direction, the inclination angle change characteristics, the fault extension height and the like are further obtained, and engineering guidance can be provided for the design of working faces adjacent to the faults and the control of dynamic disasters such as rock burst and the like.

title_en: Mine gas extraction drilling anti-spraying hole equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine gas disaster prevention and control, in particular to mine gas extraction drilling anti-spraying hole equipment which comprises a core barrel, an air bag, an anti-spraying cover body, a extraction opening, a slag discharging opening, a guide pipe, a hydraulic gear, a driving gear, a connecting ring, a connecting mechanism, a circular plate, a semicircular rod, an arc-shaped plate, a limiting plate, a stabilizing mechanism, a conical plate and a conical block, wherein the connecting ring is arranged on the outer wall of the core barrel 1 and is symmetrically arranged in the center of the air bag, the connecting mechanism is connected with the connecting ring, the circular plate is connected with the connecting mechanism, liquid enters the air bag through the guide pipe and is tightly adhered to a coal seam, the conical plate and the conical block are embedded into the coal seam through the stabilizing mechanism, the air bag is limited through the circular plate and the limiting plate, the stability of the air bag is improved, deformation of the air bag caused by overlarge pressure is prevented, tightness between the air bag and a hole is improved, the diameter is prevented from being increased due to collision of the hole, and the anti-spraying hole performance of the core barrel can be improved.
assignees: ANHUI HENGYUAN COAL & ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Power area weather disaster prediction method and system based on convolution algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power area weather disaster prediction method and system based on a convolution algorithm, which relate to the technical field of weather prediction and comprise the steps of determining weather data in an intersection area and an unknown area of a weather station; dividing the power area into a plurality of subareas according to the geographic features of the power area map, calculating the complexity level of meteorological data in the subareas, classifying the subareas according to the complexity level and giving the target grid size of each subarea, determining the influence attribute of each meteorological disaster to establish a meteorological disaster grade evaluation standard, configuring model structure parameters through the meteorological disaster grade, training a convolution LSTM model, and predicting the meteorological disasters by utilizing the power area meteorological disaster prediction model to realize visual display of prediction results. The weather disaster prediction model of the electric power area is trained, the accuracy and the adaptability of weather disaster prediction of the electric power area are improved, and the complete stable operation of the power grid is ensured.

title_en: Dynamic flood risk evaluation method based on flood inundation simulation
abstract_en: The application relates to a dynamic flood risk evaluation method based on flood inundation simulation. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining flood inundation depth data; so that the risk of disaster factors, the exposure of disaster-tolerant environment and the vulnerability of disaster-bearing bodies are used as dynamic flood risk evaluation indexes, and a dynamic flood risk evaluation index system is established; determining the optimal transverse subjective and objective combination weight and longitudinal time weight of the dynamic flood risk evaluation index by adopting a longitudinal and transverse subjective and objective combination weighting method based on the dynamic flood risk evaluation index system; based on the optimal transverse subjective and objective combined weight and the longitudinal time weight, respectively performing transverse layer-by-layer weighted superposition and longitudinal time weighted superposition on the dynamic flood risk evaluation index to determine the longitudinal and transverse flood disaster risk degree; clustering is carried out based on the crisscross flood disaster risk degrees, target flood disaster risk grade division is determined, and flood disaster risks are evaluated. Timeliness and accuracy of flood risk evaluation are improved.

title_en: Solidified soil buffer material performance analysis method based on soil body reinforcement technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solidified soil buffer material performance analysis method based on a soil body reinforcement technology, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster protection and comprises the following steps: obtaining a gravelly soil sample and performing compaction test to obtain the maximum dry density and water content of the test sample; weighing fibers and polyurethane with corresponding doping amounts, and fusing with a test sample to obtain a preparation sample; performing an unconfined compressive strength test, and analyzing the influence of the fiber blending amount and the polyurethane blending amount on unconfined compressive strength of the solidified soil; performing a direct shear test, and analyzing the influence of each factor on the shear strength index of the solidified soil; obtaining the optimal proportion of the polyurethane-fiber solidified soil buffer material; filling the buffer layer according to the optimal proportion, and analyzing the absorption and transmission of the buffer material to the impact kinetic energy of the falling rocks by using a physical simulation test of the impact of the falling rocks. The invention can improve the strength of the gravelly soil and restrict the deformation behavior of the solidified soil, and solves the problem that the prior art lacks in researching the optimal proportion of the solidified soil buffer material.

title_en: Comprehensive control method for composite disasters of mine coal seam group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive control method for a mine coal seam group composite disaster, which is implemented according to the following steps: step 1: determining a coal seam working face monitoring area, and arranging a gas drainage roadway around the monitoring area; step 2: arranging a first microseismic sensor in a gas drainage roadway to form a planar microseismic monitoring table network; step 3: constructing drainage drilling holes from a gas drainage roadway to a coal seam working surface at fixed intervals, and releasing pressure; step 4: a second microseismic sensor is arranged on the mining working face and is matched with the planar microseismic monitoring table network to form a solid microseismic monitoring table network; step 5: and the three-dimensional microseism monitoring table network positions and monitors microseism events generated in the monitoring area to locally relieve pressure. The invention can monitor and early warn coal mine disasters and carry out advanced pressure relief, and comprehensively prevent and treat composite disasters of the coal mine and the coal seam group.
assignees: CHINA COAL ORDOS ENERGY TECH CO LTD;CHINA COAL ENERGY RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Mine water disaster monitoring and early warning and disaster spreading simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring, early warning and simulating disaster situation spreading of mine water disaster, which relates to the technical field of safety engineering, and is characterized in that water disaster related parameters of each tunnel in a mine, such as air temperature, harmful gas concentration and rock wall humidity, are collected in real time, and water disaster risk assessment coefficients corresponding to each tunnel in a specified mine are calculated, so that the possibility of water disaster occurrence of each tunnel is determined, early warning and precautionary measures are facilitated, the possibility of accident occurrence is reduced, the spreading process of the water disaster in the mine can be simulated by establishing a simulation model, the disaster situation development situation is predicted, a decision maker can better understand the development trend of the water disaster, an effective rescue plan and resource allocation strategy are formulated, the influence degree of the water disaster on the mine is estimated by calculating the water disaster severity assessment coefficients, the severity degree of the water disaster event is better known, the urgency and priority of rescue actions are determined, and rescue resources are reasonably allocated.
assignees: XIAN LINGRUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;XIAN GERUITAI MINING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Deep mining power catastrophe test device and application method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep mining power catastrophe test device and an application method. The deep mining power catastrophe test device comprises a centralized control module, an impact module, a static load module and a triaxial module, wherein the in-situ underground coal seam mining stratum disturbance or mine disaster rock burst condition can be accurately simulated through the combination of the impact module and the static load module, in-situ stratum temperature, anisotropic ultra-high stress, coal rock mechanical damage under ultra-high dynamic load and physical field evolution research and test can be realized through the operation of the triaxial module, an ultrasonic monitor is equipped to monitor the inoculation process from the original rock stress state evolution to the final disaster occurrence in real time, and experimental process automation and real-time data recording can be realized through the centralized control module, so that scientific research technicians break the limit of traditional true triaxial test equipment, and the deep resource development power disaster evolution mechanism research is of great significance.

title_en: Fireproof rescue device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire-proof rescue device based on deep learning, which is a trolley and comprises the following steps: step S101, when a fire disaster does not occur, training path planning and image recognition under various temperatures and smoke concentrations by using a trolley; step S103, preprocessing and feature extraction are carried out on the camera picture, and model training is carried out according to the uploaded portrait; step S105, the singlechip classifies the danger levels of the areas according to various temperatures and smoke concentrations; step S107, acquiring the temperature and the dangerous degree of the position where the smoke concentration trolley is analyzed in real time after the fire disaster occurs; step S109, searching trapped personnel in all areas by the trolley through an auxiliary module; step S111, uploading the fire scene real-time image and the trapped person position information to an upper computer by a communication module; step S113, the upper computer sends an instruction to the trolley after information analysis, and the trolley searches; step S115, firefighters check the position information and rescue paths of trapped people on a visual platform, and rescue is unfolded.

title_en: Fire-fighting equipment control method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a fire-fighting equipment control method and a fire-fighting equipment control system based on artificial intelligence, which are characterized by acquiring sample fire response characteristic data, and the characteristic data is subjected to multi-round network parameter learning by using the sample fire disaster response, so that an intelligent fire-fighting equipment control network subjected to fire disaster data learning is generated. Further, the target intelligent fire-fighting equipment control network is generated by loading the example actual combat simulation data for re-learning. Finally, control processing suggestions can be provided for the situation of the target fire scene and the target emergency processing query rapidly and accurately, the intelligent level of fire fighting equipment control is improved, and in actual fire disaster response, a decision maker can be assisted to make scientific and reasonable control processing decisions rapidly, so that the fire disaster response efficiency and safety are improved effectively.
assignees: FUJIAN XISHUANSHUAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric automobile emergency supporting capability characterization and decision-making method under disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of charging and discharging of new energy electric vehicles, in particular to a method and a device for representing and deciding emergency supporting capability of an electric vehicle in a disaster scene, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an electric vehicle charging and discharging model, and optimizing the electric vehicle charging and discharging model by using a normally distributed parameter simulation method; based on the consumption data and the power market output error in the power distribution network system, secondarily optimizing the electric vehicle charging and discharging model, and inputting the electric vehicle and new energy output parameters into the second optimized electric vehicle charging and discharging model to obtain the final electric vehicle aggregator charging and discharging decision. And combining the battery types and the residence time parameters of the electric automobile under different scenes, carrying out accurate modeling of the flexible feasible region, constructing a two-stage random optimization model, and measuring and calculating the consumption condition of each new energy system in the power distribution network system. The economical efficiency of the power system and the toughness of the power system are improved, and the power unbalance degree of the power distribution network is reduced.

title_en: Disaster visual supergravity experimental device and method for deformation and seabed collapse of natural gas hydrate exploitation well
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster visual supergravity experimental device and method for natural gas hydrate exploitation well deformation and seabed collapse. The device comprises a visual model cabin, a deformation monitoring module, a seabed visual module, a three-dimensional servo temperature control module, a hydrate preparation module, a mining module, a liquid-gas separation and collection module and a model multi-field data monitoring and collection module. The invention can truly simulate the large-scale in-situ hydrate reservoir exploitation and catastrophe process under the condition of supergravity, observe and record engineering catastrophe processes such as well pipe deformation, gas leakage, seabed collapse and the like during the hydrate reservoir exploitation in real time, and explore the mechanism and development rule of the catastrophe process. The invention solves the problem that the conventional device is difficult to capture the internal form development process when the hydrate is mined, and provides a new research means for safe and efficient mining and disaster prevention and control of the deep sea natural gas hydrate.

title_en: Edge computer and mixed reality command and control system
title_ko: 엣지 컴퓨터 및 이를 포함하는 혼합현실 지휘통제 시스템
abstract_en: An edge computer in a mixed reality command and control system according to the present invention comprises: a network management module for transmitting/receiving data with a C4I server and a mixed reality device; an object location conversion module for converting object location information received from the C4I server into location information of a mixed reality virtual space and providing to the mixed reality device; a command processing module for receiving and processing each command in the C4I server and the mixed reality device; an M&S processing module for receiving and processing a weapon system simulation command from a user of the mixed reality device and transmitting to the C4I server; a graphic resource module for generating a graphic resource for the mixed reality virtual space based on the data received from the C4I server and providing to the mixed reality device; and an edge computing integrated management module for calling and processing each module according to a corresponding protocol in accordance with receiving a message from the network management module, and managing the object and information of the entire battlefield situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 혼합현실 지휘통제 시스템에서의 엣지 컴퓨터는 C4I 서버 및 혼합현실 디바이스와 데이터를 송수신하는 네트워크 관리 모듈, 상기 C4I 서버로부터 수신한 객체 위치 정보를 혼합현실 가상공간의 위치 정보로 변환하여 혼합현실 디바이스로 제공하는 객체 위치 변환 모듈, 상기 C4I 서버 및 상기 혼합현실 디바이스에서의 각 명령을 수신하여 처리하는 명령 처리 모듈, 상기 혼합현실 디바이스의 사용자로부터 무기체계 시뮬레이션 명령을 수신 및 처리하여 상기 C4I 서버로 전송하는 M&S 처리 모듈, 상기 C4I 서버로부터 수신한 데이터를 기반으로 혼합현실 가상공간을 위한 그래픽 리소스를 생성하여 상기 혼합현실 디바이스로 제공하는 그래픽 리소스 모듈 및 상기 네트워크 관리 모듈로부터 메시지를 전달받음에 따라 해당 프로토콜에 맞게 각 모듈을 호출 및 처리하며, 전체 전장 상황의 객체 및 정보를 관리하는 엣지 컴퓨팅 통합 관리 모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Smart earthquake measurement monitoring system based on IoT device equipped with sensor
title_ko: 센서를 구비한 IoT 디바이스 기반 스마트 지진 계측  감시 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a smart seismic measurement monitoring system based on an IoT device having a sensor, which transmits measurement data related to a seismic wave vibration signal at multiple measurement points in various regions from an IoT device equipped with a sensor installed at the multiple measurement points in the various regions to a seismic measurement monitoring system through an LTE 4G/5G modem. Provided is a smart earthquake measurement monitoring system based on an IoT device having a sensor. The smart seismic measurement monitoring system based on an IoT device having a sensor comprises: a measuring instrument including a sensor for detecting and transmitting at least one detection signal among vibration/strain/displacement/slope/temperature/crack, and a control unit and a communication unit; a seismic measurement monitoring system for collecting and analyzing big data for each sensor installation position of a multi-sensing fusion signal to display measurement data, determining signs of earthquake disaster risk abnormalities, generating an alarm event when the management threshold of the measurement data exceeds, urgently generating an alarm, and providing a seismic disaster risk prediction simulation; and a user terminal linked to a wired/wireless communication network to the seismic measurement monitoring system.
abstract_ko:
센서를 구비한 IoT 디바이스 기반 스마트 지진 계측 감시 시스템이 개시된다. 센서를 구비한 IoT 디바이스 기반 스마트 지진 계측 감시 시스템은 지진 발생 시, 안전 관리 대상 시설, 위험 시설, 건물, 댐, 교량 등의 여러 지역의 다 측정 지점에 설치되며, 진동/변형률/변위/경사/온도/균열 중 어느 적어도 하나 이상의 감지 신호를 감지하여 전송하는 센서와 제어부와 통신부를 구비하는 계측기; 여러 지역의 다 측정 지점의 센서를 구비한 계측기의 설치 위치별로, 실시간으로 진동/변형률/변위/경사/온도/균열 멀티센싱 융합 신호를 센서 설치 위치별 빅 데이터를 수집하고 분석하여 계측 데이터와 지진 재난 위험 이상 징후를 판단하며, 상기 계측 데이터의 관리 임계치 초과 시 알람 이벤트를 발생하여 긴급하게 경보를 발생하고, 지진 발생 정보와 위치와 시간, 계측 데이터의 통계 정보를 제공하며, 안전 감시 대상 시설 및 위험 요소 분석, 지진 재난 위험 예측 시뮬레이션을 제공하는 지진 계측 감시 시스템; 및 상기 지진 계측 감시 시스템에 유무선 통신망을 연동되는 사용자 단말을 포함한다.  
센서를 구비한 IoT 디바이스 기반 스마트 지진 계측 감시 시스템은 안전 관리 대상 시설, 건물, 교량, 도로, 지진 발생 지역 등의 위치에서 지진 가속도계, 변형률계, 변위계, 경사계, 온도계, 습도계, 균열계 등의 여러 지역의 다 측정 지점에 설치된 센서가 탑재된 IoT 디바이스로부터 여러 지역의 다 측정 지점의 지진동 신호를 LTE 4G/5G 모뎀을 통해 지진 계측 감시 시스템으로 전송하며, GIS 서버의 지도와 연계된 계측 데이터 모니터링, 지진 계측 감시 시스템은 계측 데이터 빅 데이터를 분석하고 표시하며 계측 데이터의 임계치 초과 시 지진 발생 몇 분전에 긴급하게 경보를 발생하며, 빅 데이터 분석을 통해 지진 발생 정보와 계측 데이터의 통계 정보를 데이터 시각화하여 제공하여 신속하게 지진 재난대응 조치를 취하여 안전 관리 대상 시설, 위험 시설 점검, 건물 붕괴, 댐 붕괴, 교량 파괴, 도로 파손으로부터 시설과 재산 및 인명 피해를 줄이게 되었다.

title_en: Side slope anchoring device for geological disaster management
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slope anchoring device for geological disaster treatment, which comprises: ground guard plate, the side slope guard plate, the mounting groove, the dead lever, left side connecting block, right side connecting block, run through the axle, the screw thread groove, the drill bit, the skid resistant course, the elastic layer, the enhancement layer, the anti-seismic spring, the one end of ground guard plate is provided with the side slope guard plate, the inside of ground guard plate is provided with the mounting groove, the inside of mounting groove is provided with the dead lever, the one end fixed mounting of ground guard plate has left side connecting block, the one end fixed mounting of side slope guard plate has right connecting block, the inside fixed mounting of right side connecting block has the axle that runs through, the outer wall fixed mounting of dead lever has the screw thread groove, the lower fixed mounting of dead lever has the drill bit, the outer wall fixed mounting of ground guard plate has the skid resistant course, the one end fixed mounting of skid resistant course has the enhancement layer, the one end fixed mounting of elastic layer has the enhancement layer, the inside fixed mounting of elastic layer has anti-seismic spring.

title_en: Plain river and lake simulation device and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plain river and lake simulation device and a working method thereof; the system belongs to the technical field of terrain simulation and comprises an external device structure, a driving mechanism, a control module and a data processing module; the driving mechanism comprises a plurality of motion units, each motion unit is provided with a driving plate and a servo motor, and motor driving can be independently completed; the control module is a touch display screen and can feed back the working state of each motion unit of the driving mechanism in real time; the data processing module calculates the motion parameters of the servo motor and controls the servo motor to drive the screw rod to move; the working steps are as follows: obtaining point cloud data, setting the size of a block, initializing a servo motor, dividing the point cloud data, analyzing each unit block, calculating the average height, converting the average height into a driving signal, sending the driving signal, circularly processing and ending. The invention solves the problem that the existing terrain scouring physical model is built singly and can not be reused, and can be used in scientific research and teaching, actual hydraulic engineering design and natural disaster prevention and control.
assignees: SUZHOU YISHUI TWIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;SUZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HOHAI UNIV

title_en: Step-by-step pressure relief and energy release method for ultra-deep vertical shaft of metal ore
abstract_en: The invention provides a step-by-step pressure relief and energy release method for a metal mine ultra-deep vertical shaft, which is suitable for pressure relief and energy release and disaster prevention and control of the ultra-deep vertical shaft with the depth of 1500m, and comprehensively adopts an advanced drilling pressure relief or hydraulic presplitting technology, a high Duan Gao secondary support pressure regulation and energy release well wall structure pressure release complete technology method to step-by-step regulate and control the stress of surrounding rock in a step-by-step manner so as to form permanent protection on the well wall structure. Firstly, adopting an advanced drilling pressure relief or water pressure presplitting technology to reduce the overall stress level of the surrounding rock of a shaft in the circumferential direction in advance, so as to avoid the occurrence of strain type rock burst or large deformation of broken rock mass; and secondly, determining reasonable lining height and opportunity from a working surface based on a convergence constraint theory by a high-stage high-secondary support technology, and realizing low-pressure bearing of a well wall structure. And finally, considering the mobility of the ground pressure, adopting a proper energy release well wall structure, and when the well wall structure is concentrated or deformed in surrounding rock during service use, utilizing the pressure yielding and energy absorbing characteristics of the well wall structure to ensure that the well wall structure is not damaged.
assignees: SANSHANDAO GOLD MINE SHANDONG GOLD MINING LAIZHOU CO LTD;SHANDONG GOLD MINING CO LTD SHENJIN EXPL LABORATORY BRANCH

title_en: Real-time monitoring device and method for movement track of mine roof strata
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for monitoring movement tracks of a mine roof strata in real time, and relates to the technical field of mine roof strata movement monitoring. The real-time monitoring device for the rock formation movement track of the mine roof has fewer parts, simple and rapid assembly process in field use, and can be assembled and used according to the actual length of a monitoring drilling hole in mine roof monitoring; the real-time monitoring device for the rock stratum movement track of the mine roof has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in processing and manufacturing, fewer precise instruments adopted in the device, relatively low manufacturing cost of the whole device and capability of reducing the investment cost of mine monitoring; by applying the real-time monitoring device for the movement track of the roof strata of the mine, the movement track of the roof strata of the mine can be monitored in real time, accurately and continuously, and more detailed strata information is provided for disaster prevention and control of mine pressure, strata control, rock burst and the like.
assignees: Shandong energy group co ltd;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;YANKUANG ENERGY ORDOS CO LTD;YANKUANG XINJIANG ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: FeCrAl alloy material for nuclear reactor fuel cladding material and warm rolling strengthening method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a FeCrAl alloy material for a nuclear reactor fuel cladding material and a warm rolling strengthening method, and relates to the technical field of fuel cladding. The FeCrAl alloy material for the nuclear reactor fuel cladding material improves the steam oxidation resistance of the fuel cladding under the accident working condition, prolongs the emergency response time of the nuclear power station when the accident happens, and the provided warm rolling strengthening technology is suitable for strengthening the mechanical property of the cladding material, has excellent oxidation resistance in the simulated high-temperature steam environment under the LOCA working condition, has excellent accident fault tolerance capability and is matched with a suitable warm rolling strengthening technology, so that the FeCrA alloy has good hot processing performance and can be used for preparing the cladding of the nuclear fuel element.

title_en: Natural disaster visualization monitoring early warning optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring and early warning, in particular to a natural disaster visualization-based monitoring and early warning optimization method and system. According to the scheme, the virtual pheromone matrix is established, the optimal starting point of the monitoring network is ensured, the most effective path can be found through simulating ants, the monitoring network can be self-optimized, the optimal path covering the most critical area is found, a new solution is provided for data acquisition and processing by utilizing innovative application of a blockchain technology in the disaster monitoring field, high-quality data and wide view angles of multi-source heterogeneous data are ensured through fusion of the blockchain technology, and the monitoring network optimized by the ant colony algorithm can be provided, more accurate and comprehensive disaster prediction is provided, powerful data support is provided for taking countermeasure in advance, the natural disaster monitoring and early warning process is optimized, the accuracy and safety of data are improved, the effective distribution of resources is ensured, and the targets of early warning and disaster loss reduction are finally realized.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Sky-ground integrated monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring and early warning equipment, in particular to a sky-ground integrated monitoring and early warning method and system. According to the scheme, heterogeneous data are acquired from various sensors such as satellite remote sensing, a ground monitoring station, an unmanned aerial vehicle and the like, fusion is carried out through an intelligent heterogeneous data fusion network model, a meta learning algorithm is introduced to improve expandability, and fusion data representation is output to serve as subsequent model input; modeling a monitoring area as a dynamic graph neural network, utilizing a fusion data training network, automatically learning the evolution rule of disasters in time and space, inputting the current disaster state to predict the future development trend, and improving the prospective of early warning; the method comprises the steps of constructing a machine learning model based on causal reasoning, learning causal relation between monitoring data and disaster development, providing explanatory support for decision making, introducing anti-facts reasoning, simulating and evaluating influences of different intervention measures on disaster, and providing advice for disaster relief decision making.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: High-rise building flame trend prediction and fire trend-based elevator operation mode conversion boundary condition confirmation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting flame trend of a high-rise building and confirming conversion boundary conditions of an elevator operation mode based on a fire trend, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a flame trend prediction algorithm, and predicting the diffusion direction, speed and intensity trend of the flame; step 2: predicting factors influencing elevator operation when fire disaster progresses by using a flame trend prediction algorithm, determining the state of an elevator operation mode, and constructing an algorithm of an elevator operation mode conversion boundary condition; step 3: the method combines the digitalization of building space, simulates the influence of fire disaster on elevator operation, including the influence of smoke concentration on elevator passenger safety and the influence of temperature distribution on elevator equipment; step 4: and determining a conversion boundary condition according to the simulation analysis result. The invention not only can predict the development trend of fire, but also can determine the time and mode of elevator operation mode conversion according to the prediction result, thereby providing a feasible technical means for fire emergency prevention.
assignees: BEIJING BUILDING MECHANIZATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Highway slope landslide hazard early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway slope landslide hazard early warning method, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing, namely preparing a slope landslide hazard risk map according to historical data of landslide occurrence of a highway slope, design conditions of the highway slope along the line and rainfall data; setting key position monitoring points of the slope landslide disaster according to the slope landslide disaster risk map, collecting monitoring data of the monitoring points, and carrying out noise reduction treatment on the monitoring data; constructing a mixed prediction model based on a long-time memory network and a BP neural network, and performing iterative training and parameter adjustment on the mixed prediction model through monitoring data to obtain an optimal mixed prediction model; and establishing a highway slope landslide early warning model based on the displacement deformation rate, the rate increment and the improved tangential angle in the highway slope sliding deformation process, and determining an early warning threshold according to the design condition and the geological condition of the highway slope. The invention solves the technical problem of how to accurately and rapidly early warn the landslide hazard of the expressway and output the result.

title_en: Emergency scheduling method and system for electric power system considering ice coating disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention provides a power system emergency scheduling method and system considering ice coating disaster influence, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a prediction model and a training data set, wherein the training data set comprises historical weather data and ice coating parameters of all elements in a power system, and training the prediction model by utilizing the training data set to obtain a trained prediction model; acquiring real-time weather data, inputting the real-time weather data into a trained prediction model to obtain the icing parameter predicted value of each element, and judging whether the current time is in the pre-disaster or in the disaster; if the first objective function is the pre-disaster, constructing a first objective function based on the icing parameter predicted value, the weighing factor, the pre-configuration emergency resource cost and the potential power loss amount to obtain a first optimal solution set of the scheduling parameter, so as to perform preventive scheduling; if the power system is in the disaster and the power system is running normally, a second objective function is constructed based on the icing parameter predicted value, the emergency resource cost and the power loss amount to obtain a second optimal solution set of the scheduling parameters, so that emergency scheduling is performed.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUXI POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV CHINA AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Refuge and escape piloting system and method based on wrist wearing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a refuge and escape piloting system and method based on wrist wearing equipment, and belongs to the technical field of data analysis. The system of the invention comprises: the system comprises a data management module, an event evaluation module, a real-time data matching module, a path planning module and a notification and guide module; the data management module is responsible for acquiring and classifying historical data and marking and summarizing; the event evaluation module analyzes the historical disaster event and determines the risk level; the real-time data matching module collects real-time data, calculates similarity with historical data, selects the most similar template data and constructs a three-dimensional simulation model; the path planning module generates an initial escape path, judges the trafficability of the initial escape path, evaluates the dangerous degree according to real-time data, and generates a target escape adjustment path when the initial escape path judging result is not passable; the notification and guide module processes the event signal and provides escape guide and danger notification.
assignees: BEIJING FANMI WULIAN TECH CO LTD;CHINA COAL SHENZHEN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster emergency monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster emergency monitoring method and system, and relates to the technical field of power grids. The flood disaster emergency monitoring method provided by the invention can fully utilize multi-source heterogeneous data such as videos, images and texts, fully utilize complementary advantages of the multi-source heterogeneous data, capture inter-modal correlations through a self-attention mechanism, fuse the power grid topological structure knowledge automatically learned by a graph neural network, realize intelligent flood monitoring through deep learning end-to-end training, avoid defects of manual design rules and a large number of labels, and can be expected to greatly improve the accuracy and instantaneity of flood disaster monitoring and provide powerful technical support for guaranteeing the safe operation of a power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-agent cooperation method and device based on maximum entropy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of reinforcement learning, in particular to a multi-agent cooperation method and device based on maximum entropy. Comprising the following steps: acquiring transfer tuples through interaction of an agent and an environment, and taking all acquired transfer tuples as an experience pool data set; the states and actions of each transition tuple in the data subset are formed into a state-action space, the state-action space is projected to a target space with the maximum distribution entropy, and the state with the minimum count is selected as a target state in the target space; performing cooperative training on at least one agent by using a target strategy, and obtaining forward rewards when the agent explores a target state; and strengthening the target state by using the forward rewards, and training the exploration strategy by using the strengthened target state. The invention can solve the problem that the intelligent agent is difficult to identify and cooperatively explore the pain point of valuable key states in the dimension disaster in the multi-agent reinforcement learning, and realize the cooperative exploration among the multi-agents and the optimization of the whole system.
assignees: NO 709 RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION LIMITED

title_en: Emergency exercise method and system based on digital twinning and knowledge graph
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency exercise method and system based on digital twinning and knowledge maps. The method is characterized in that various environment data of a place are collected in real time by utilizing an external parameter measuring device through a virtual environment constructed by a digital twin technology, then the environment data are transmitted to a system, various complex emergency scenes and emergency situations can be simulated by data processing and analysis and combining with the reasoning capability of a knowledge graph, and therefore the feasibility and the effectiveness of an emergency plan are comprehensively checked and evaluated; the emergency plan can be automatically optimized and perfected according to the drilling result, and the efficiency and accuracy of handling the emergency are improved. The method utilizes the digital twin technology and the knowledge graph technology, and a management unit can optimize and improve the emergency plan, so that the efficiency and the accuracy of emergency response are improved, and the intelligent level of emergency rescue decision is improved.
assignees: CHINA POWER IND INTERNET CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing image-based damage assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image-based damage evaluation method and a remote sensing image-based damage evaluation system, wherein a building damage evaluation network is used for building damage evaluation of remote sensing images; the building damage evaluation network training method comprises the following steps: acquiring building damage evaluation data; building positioning is carried out on the image before damage; performing convolution pooling operation on the images before and after damage to obtain a space feature map; fusing the spatial feature images of the images before and after the damage of the same layer, extracting deep difference features, and fusing disaster category feature values into the feature images; splicing the building positioning result and the feature images of each layer, and then carrying out convolution fusion to obtain an evaluation classification image; based on the output evaluation classification diagram and the corresponding evaluation label, training is completed to complete the building damage evaluation network. Adding disaster category information for the region images to be classified; the network detection capability can be improved, and the method has the advantages of high evaluation and classification precision, small error and the like. Disaster category information is introduced into the network, and the evaluation accuracy of building damage is improved.

title_en: Method and device for identifying high-potential energy debris flow under regional scale and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and control, and relates to a method and a device for identifying high-potential energy debris flow under regional scale and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: collecting material source distribution data; determining an object source sensitivity evaluation factor; extracting characteristic parameters associated with Gao Shineng debris flow; determining a debris flow score value conforming to the high potential energy debris flow score to obtain high potential energy debris flow sample data; constructing a neural network model, and training to obtain a trained high-potential energy debris flow recognition neural network model; acquiring current material source distribution data in real time, preprocessing the current material source distribution data, and extracting characteristic parameters; and loading the trained high-potential debris flow recognition neural network model to obtain a debris flow scoring value as a high-potential debris flow recognition result. According to the method, the high-potential energy debris flow can be rapidly and accurately identified through the high-potential energy debris flow identification neural network model, and references are provided for reducing debris flow disaster loss, debris flow prevention and the like.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Railway catastrophe trend prediction method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geographic information data processing, and discloses a railway catastrophe trend prediction method based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, data acquisition and data labeling; s2, data expansion, namely generating samples based on a deep belief generation countermeasure network with quantum state information robustness, and realizing GIS remote sensing data expansion; s3, training a feature extraction model; s4, training a feature dimension reduction model; s5, training a classifier model; s6, predicting the railway catastrophe trend, and processing a new GIS remote sensing sample by using the trained model to predict the railway catastrophe trend. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the quantum state information is adopted, so that the quality of generated data can be greatly improved on the basis of guaranteeing the authenticity of the data, the expanded data is more close to a real scene, the effectiveness and the accuracy of model training are improved, and the accuracy of railway disaster trend prediction is further improved.

title_en: Box-type field operation module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a box-type field operation module which comprises an operation bed box, an anesthesia monitoring box, a multifunctional operation treatment box and an accessory box which are of box-type structures. After the two opposite side plates of the operating bed box are unfolded, the box shape is changed into a bed shape; the anesthesia monitoring box comprises a first box body and a first box cover buckled on the first box body, wherein the first box body is changed into an equipment rack from a box type after being stacked on the top of the first box cover; the first box body is provided with medical equipment for anesthesia monitoring; the operation treatment multifunctional box comprises a second box body and a second box cover buckled on the second box body, wherein the second box body is changed into an equipment rack from a box type after being stacked on the top of the second box cover; the second housing is mounted with medical equipment for surgical treatment; the accessory box is provided with a multifunctional bracket, a shadowless lamp and an ultraviolet disinfection lamp. The invention can be rapidly delivered, rapidly unfolded or withdrawn, and is suitable for scenes such as on-site first aid, batch wounded rescue, nuclear biochemical first aid, disaster medical rescue, medical service base training examination and the like.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Throwing type lifeboat intelligent release system based on pool test and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a throwing type lifeboat intelligent release system based on a pool test and digital twin, which comprises a field control system, a digital twin system and a pool test system, wherein the field control system is used for acquiring field environment and real ship parameters and controlling the lifeboat to emit according to feedback data; the digital twin system is used for providing three-dimensional reproduction of the accident scene, so that the personnel can make decisions conveniently; the pool test system is used for simulating wind, wave and current environments of an accident site in a test pool and judging whether the on-site lifeboat is safe to launch. The invention establishes a set of intelligent release system of the throwing type lifeboat, which is formed by the complementary three of the actual physical environment, the digital model prediction and the scale test optimization, can realize the double reproduction of the digital and the physical model of the throwing type lifeboat, so that the life-saving personnel can accurately and effectively command the escape work in the disaster site, and the survival rate of the life-saving personnel is greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU SCIENCE & TECH;COSCO SHIPPING HEAVY IND YANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall landslide test device for building structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall landslide test device for a building structure, which belongs to the technical field of building structure tests and comprises a box body, wherein an installation table is installed in the box body, a simulation device is arranged at the top of the installation table, one end of the box body is communicated with a filtering device, a water tank is installed on the back of the box body, a water spraying frame is installed at the top of the box body through a linear guide rail module, and the water spraying frame is communicated with the water tank through a second water pump by means of a corrugated pipe. According to the invention, three inclined tables are arranged, and components arranged in each inclined table, such as a rotary drum with a push plate, a smooth rectangular plate and a sealing cloth driven by a crank-link mechanism are combined to simulate the movement of a landslide, and rainfall conditions are provided by the sprinkler frame, so that the test device can meet the simulation test of common landslide types, and a technician can be helped to draw a protection or treatment scheme for landslide disasters according to test results.
assignees: JIANGSU JIANYAN CONSTRUCTION ENG QUALITY SAFETY IDENTIFICATION CO LTD

title_en: Economic risk prediction method, system and equipment based on thermal wave flood composite disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides an economic risk prediction method, a system and equipment based on a thermal wave flood composite disaster, comprising the following steps: collecting a meteorological hydrologic social economic data set, and calibrating a plurality of machine learning models; training a machine learning model by adopting corrected global climate mode set meteorological simulation data to obtain a daily runoff process in future scenes; combining the global climate mode set with a machine learning model to determine each combined scene weight parameter in a multi-model weighted average method; extracting wet bulb temperature and pathogenic high temperature stress indexes based on the analysis data, establishing a disease-high temperature regression model in the flood season, and solving model parameters; and predicting population, GDP and agricultural risks caused by future composite disasters based on the combined scene weight parameters in the multi-model weighted average method, and calculating comprehensive socioeconomic risks. The invention provides an important reference basis with strong operability for extreme weather disaster risk assessment and early warning.

title_en: Method and device for constructing earthquake disaster scene model and storable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for constructing a seismic disaster scene model and a storable medium, and relates to the technical field of computer visualization, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring seismic scene image data; extracting features of the seismic scene image data, and segmenting feature extraction results of the seismic scene image data to obtain corresponding scene segmentation results; the seismic scene image data and the scene segmentation result are combined and input into design software for modeling, so that a seismic disaster scene model is obtained; the invention can provide help for earthquake rescue training, science popularization propaganda and scientific research based on factory earthquake ruin scenes.

title_en: Intelligent prediction method for fire hazard change risk of reinforced concrete structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent prediction method for fire hazard change risk of a reinforced concrete structure, which comprises the following steps: establishing a fine and efficient numerical analysis model of the reinforced concrete structure; constructing a fire collapse simulation method of the reinforced concrete structure; acquiring a fire response data set of the whole reinforced concrete structure; establishing a fire damage evaluation model of the reinforced concrete structure, extracting residual bearing capacity of the target structural component and deformation data of the top and bottom among the layers of the target structural component, calculating to obtain the change rate of relative deformation among the layers of the target structural component, judging whether the target structural component collapses and the collapse direction, and further establishing a fire damage collapse behavior database of the reinforced concrete structure; and combining the neural network prediction model obtained by training with the reinforced concrete structure fine high-efficiency numerical analysis model to establish a reinforced concrete structure digital twin body for carrying out structural fire simulation analysis and prediction of structural fire behavior.
