The invention can realize the prediction of fire disaster high-temperature damage of the reinforced concrete structure.

title_en: Mine flood dynamic disaster scene construction and virtual simulation emergency exercise method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine emergency rescue drilling, in particular to a method and a system for building and virtually simulating a mine flood dynamic disaster scene, which are used for building a mine data parameter database, a device model database and a configuration file database, editing tasks for building the mine flood dynamic disaster scene, acquiring data in each database according to the tasks, building a high-precision mine three-dimensional model, simulating different mining space flood accidents in the high-precision mine three-dimensional model, acquiring spreading progress information, rendering, simultaneously acquiring influence information of operation of a parameter training person on the scene, setting disaster emergency information in the drilling process, simulating and rendering corresponding to the flood, finally acquiring evaluation information of the parameter training person, and generating a report according to the evaluation information. The method can quickly construct a high-precision three-dimensional mine model, and can dynamically change disaster scenes of flood accidents according to disaster emergency and operation feedback of the training personnel, so that the reality of simulation and the training effect of the training personnel are improved.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: AIoT anomaly identification method, disaster early warning system and road safety system
abstract_en: The invention discloses AIoT anomaly identification method, disaster early warning system and road safety system, wherein the identification method comprises the steps of S1, constructing a double-network feature extractor, S2, acquiring a data set; s3, training and optimizing a double-network feature extractor to obtain an identification model; s4, acquiring data to be identified; s5, identifying multi-category abnormal events to obtain an identification result; the disaster early warning system comprises a sensor computing unit and a base station edge computing unit; the road safety system comprises a road side calculation unit and a vehicle-mounted calculation unit; the complex abnormal mode and the characteristics in the intelligent Internet of things environment can be accurately recognized through the double-network characteristic extractor; the weight update of the local and global features is realized through parallelization of the parallel knowledge migration framework based on the local and global features, and the recognition precision and generalization capability of the overall model are improved; the method is tightly combined with the field of real disaster emergency and road safety, and practical problems of disaster early warning and road safety early warning are practically solved.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating necessary safe evacuation time of fire source upstream from x position of fire source in tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for evaluating necessary safe evacuation time of a fire source upstream in a tunnel from a fire source x position, and belongs to the field of tunnel evacuation risk analysis. The method comprises the following steps: the personnel evacuation simulation software Pathfinder partitions the section of the fire source upstream in the tunnel according to the set length, and takes the departure time of the last person in each section as the get-off and lane safety evacuation time of the section; according to the input simulation parameters, simulating to obtain maximum values T 'of the safe evacuation time of the getting-off and the traffic lanes, wherein the maximum values T' of the safe evacuation time of the getting-off and the traffic lanes are corresponding to different values of the x position of the fire source, which is the upstream distance from the fire source, when the bus is at each position in the tunnel; the necessary safe evacuation time rset=t1+t '+tc+tg is calculated from T'. According to the invention, corresponding risk acceptable/tolerable standards can be determined according to different current situations of tunnel fire safety and safety policy target requirements, and theoretical basis is provided for fire evacuation risk assessment, decision making and the like.

title_en: Path selection method in evacuation simulation under disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path selection method in evacuation simulation under a disaster environment, which comprises the following steps of constructing a disaster environment scene model, initializing individuals to be evacuated to an Agent, obtaining information perceived by the Agent, updating a corresponding space cognition map, obtaining a plurality of paths to be selected from the space cognition map to form a path set to be selected, calculating a quick utility value, a safety utility value and a comfort utility value of each path to be selected in the path set to be selected, and 5, according to the total utility of each path to be selected obtained in the step 4, making probability selection from the path set to be selected and taking the selected path as the evacuation path of the current Agent. According to the invention, the influence of disaster environment and individual characteristics on path selection is comprehensively considered, so that the accuracy of evacuation analysis is remarkably improved.

title_en: Fire smoke spreading simulator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire simulation, in particular to a fire smoke spreading simulation device, which comprises a base positioned at the lowest part, wherein a mounting disc is rotatably arranged above the base through a turntable structure, two smoke boxes are symmetrically arranged on the mounting disc, a plurality of smoke generators are arranged in the smoke boxes, smoke outlets of the smoke generators extend out from the top of the smoke boxes, and an adjusting structure capable of being adjusted along with wind direction is arranged in the center of the top of the mounting disc; according to the utility model, through the adjusting structure which can be adjusted in real time along with the wind direction, and the position of the smoke box is adjusted through the adjusting mechanism, namely, the position of smoke generation is adjusted along with the spreading direction of fire, the direction of the flame drifting along with the wind when a grassland fire disaster can be better simulated, and the real grassland fire scene can be better simulated.
assignees: SHAANXI ANHE FIRE FIGHTING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Real fire training monitoring post
abstract_en: The application relates to a real fire training monitoring column, which relates to the field of real fire firefighting training systems and comprises a monitoring column body, wherein a temperature detection module, a gas concentration detection module and an emergency stop button are integrated on the monitoring column body; the signal output end of the temperature detection module and the signal output end of the gas concentration detection module are connected with a first single chip microcomputer, when the indoor temperature is higher and/or the indoor gas concentration is higher, the first single chip microcomputer controls the air inlet fan and the air outlet fan to accelerate the indoor ventilation speed to the first ventilation speed, when the indoor temperature exceeds a maximum set temperature value and/or the indoor gas exceeds a maximum gas concentration value, the first single chip microcomputer outputs a second control signal, and the second single chip microcomputer receives the second control signal and/or the emergency stop signal and then turns off the real fire simulation system to accelerate the indoor ventilation to the second ventilation speed. The application can ensure the personal safety of the trainee in the process of performing the fire-fighting training.
assignees: SHANGHAI HUANDI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-extinguishing training device for fire-extinguishing simulation training
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting simulation training, and particularly relates to a fire-fighting training device for fire-fighting simulation training, which comprises: the shell is internally provided with an inner cavity I, the inner cavity I is fixedly provided with a filter plate, the filter plate is provided with a plurality of rectangular grooves, a rotating plate is rotatably arranged in each rectangular groove, a discharging plate is arranged below the filter plate, a round rod is arranged at the bottom side of the rotating plate and near one end of the rotating plate, the bottom end of the round rod penetrates through the discharging plate, and an impact assembly for impacting a plurality of rotating plates is arranged below the discharging plate; the four rectangular columns are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the shell and are respectively close to the four corners, and the bottoms of the rectangular columns are rotationally connected with rollers; the hydraulic cylinder ensures that the whole device is convenient to move, does not need to be lifted and carried by staff, saves time and labor, and can simulate the scene of splashing of solid combustion materials in a real fire scene, thereby training the reaction avoidance capability of firefighters.
assignees: HENAN GENIUS SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Historical similar flood occasion recommendation method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a historical similar flood field time recommending method, equipment and medium, belongs to the technical field of machine learning, and is used for solving the technical problems that the existing flood situation predicting method is too high in dependence on people and is unfavorable for the continuity and effectiveness of flood control work. The method comprises the following steps: collecting historical flood occasion information, and carrying out feature extraction on the historical flood occasion information to construct a training data set; generating curve functions corresponding to each historical flood field based on the training data set; determining a corresponding real-time characteristic value according to the hydrological data of the current rainfall; according to the real-time characteristic value, matching curve functions corresponding to each historical flood occasion, and determining the historical flood occasion most similar to the current rainfall; and calling the corresponding solving measures of the most similar historical flood orders in the database. The method is used for assisting in flood control decision and dispatch scheme assignment, and effectively reducing disaster degree of flood pairs.

title_en: Coal mine fire simulation calibration method and device based on machine learning and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine fire simulation calibration method, a device and a storage medium based on machine learning, which relate to the field of coal mine safety and comprise the steps of acquiring respective historical data of fire simulation and fire perception; then calculating the difference value between the fire perception historical data and the fire simulation historical data; and constructing a scene classifier based on fire simulation historical data. Utilizing a scene classifier, collecting historical data to manufacture a calibration data set, and forming a calibrator; then dynamically training the calibrator by utilizing real-time data of fire simulation and fire perception; and finally, calibrating the fire advance simulation data by using a calibrator after dynamic training to obtain a prediction result of the fire advance perception data. The fire simulation is calibrated through the method steps, so that more accurate deduction of the coal mine fire is realized, decision guiding significance is provided for disaster prevention of the coal mine disaster, and important technical support is expected to be brought for safety management of the coal mine fire.

title_en: Data-driven-based virtual perception system and method for flexible protection structure of falling rock disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data-driven falling stone disaster flexible protection structure virtual perception system and a data-driven falling stone disaster flexible protection structure virtual perception method, wherein the data-driven falling stone disaster flexible protection structure virtual perception system comprises a database establishment module and a virtual perception module, the database establishment module establishes a high-precision finite element numerical inversion model through falling stone impact full-scale test data of a flexible protection structure, and extracts impact response time-course sequences of key components under multiple conditions by changing component parameters and impact parameters of a protection system, and sets virtual perception input and output target sequences according to measuring points and detection difficulty blind points which are easy to be obtained by the structure so as to form a deep learning data set; the virtual perception module comprises a deep learning network training module and a response prediction module. According to the invention, a small number of sensors are arranged on the flexible protection structure, so that the virtual perception of multiple degrees of freedom of other key measuring points of the structure is realized, the response acquisition difficulty of key components of the flexible protection system under the impact of falling rocks can be reduced, and the overall monitoring cost is reduced.

title_en: Roof-based horizontal well one-well multi-purpose filling and mining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roof-based horizontal well one-well multipurpose filling production method, which comprises the steps of setting a shaft, wherein the shaft comprises a vertical shaft and a horizontal shaft; the azimuth of the horizontal well shaft is distributed along the trend of the coal seam working surface, and the length of the horizontal well shaft is determined according to the burial depth of the coal seam in the area and the water-to-vertical ratio process in the horizontal well drilling process; after the construction of the horizontal well shaft is completed, staged fracturing is carried out, so that the yield increase transformation of the target reservoir is realized; after the yield improvement of the target reservoir is finished, carrying out hydraulic fracturing encryption, and determining the range of the stress increasing area and the maximum load of the stress increasing area borne by the rock mass of the stress reducing area after fracturing; and cutting from the fracturing section by utilizing a cutting tool according to the filling step distance of the working face, so that the continuous production and continuous filling of coal resources are realized. Through the multi-purpose coordinated exploitation and management of a well in the resource exploitation and disaster management processes, the well drilling period of coal series resource exploitation is shortened, the well drilling cost is reduced, and the well shaft use efficiency is improved.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Fire scene high-precision simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire scene high-precision simulation system and a fire scene high-precision simulation method, which comprise a building and further comprise the following steps: step S101: building a 3D model of the building, and importing the model into simulation software to obtain a fire simulation model; step S103: setting grid parameters in a fire simulation model; step S105: setting a fire point in a fire simulation model; step S107: setting initial condition parameters of a building environment in a fire simulation model; step S109: and carrying out numerical simulation of the fire disaster in a fire disaster simulation model, and recording the change result of the data. The simulation system utilizes software to perform high-precision fire dynamics simulation, and provides scientific basis for the establishment of precautionary measures through careful building model design, accurate scene parameter setting, reasonable sensor arrangement and efficient simulation operation, and generates detailed simulation data; meanwhile, the intelligent system algorithm can also support intelligent fire prediction and prevention and control strategies, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Region-scale-oriented co-earthquake landslide susceptibility assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a region-scale-oriented co-earthquake landslide susceptibility assessment method, and relates to the technical field of co-earthquake landslide assessment. Firstly, carrying out numerical simulation on a three-dimensional complex field with regional scale, constructing a three-dimensional transfer function library of a global field, collecting specified basic data of the whole region to construct a static landslide factor data set, and then inputting the static landslide factor data set into a MSCNN convolutional neural network model to carry out spatial feature learning; solving the ground surface earthquake motion of the three-dimensional global field after at least one actual earthquake motion record of the local field is acquired, obtaining the time-course earthquake motion time sequence characteristics of the ground surface, and transmitting the time sequence characteristics to a multi-layer Bi-LSTM added with a multi-head attention mechanism for time sequence characteristic extraction; the spatial features and the sequence features are subjected to self-adaptive feature fusion and then converted into the probability of occurrence of the same-earthquake landslide, so that the region-scale same-earthquake landslide susceptibility assessment is rapidly realized, and data support and theoretical basis are provided for post-disaster rescue personnel and material distribution and emergency decision-making.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Forest combustion fire disaster simulation device for fire emergency exercise
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire simulation equipment, and discloses a forest fire simulation device for fire emergency exercise, which comprises a bottom plate and a plurality of tree assemblies arranged on the bottom plate, wherein each tree assembly comprises a trunk and a plurality of branches fixed on the trunk, a gas pipeline is fixed in the trunk, a mounting hole is formed in one side of each branch on the trunk, a fixing seat is fixed in each mounting hole, a fire spraying pipe is fixedly penetrated on each fixing seat, an ignition needle is fixedly arranged on each fixing seat, and a flow control valve is connected between each fire spraying pipe and the gas pipeline. According to the invention, the flow control valve is used for controlling the gas to be sprayed out of the flame spraying pipe, the ignition needle is used for igniting, and the flame is sprayed out towards the branches to manufacture a scene that the branches are ignited, so that the scene of forest combustion is simulated, and the operation is simple and safer.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 7TH ENG DIVISION CORP LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional visualization method capable of identifying overlying strata structural features of deep coal mine working surface
abstract_en: A three-dimensional visualization method capable of identifying the structural characteristics of a covering rock of a deep coal mine working face comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a drilling shooting in-situ observation method, identifying main characteristic parameters of an overlying strata occurrence structure, establishing a three-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system on a working surface, arranging the parameters to form three-dimensional coordinate data, processing inclined drilling data by adopting a regression analysis method to obtain virtual vertical drilling data, and introducing Earth Volumetric Studio software to build a three-dimensional visualization model of the overlying strata of the deep coal mine working surface. The method can enable relevant engineering technicians to obtain accurate deep coal mine working face overlying strata information simply and conveniently, is helpful for understanding deep coal mine working face overlying strata deformation damage mechanisms, optimizes gas extraction hole arrangement, and has important application value for coal mine disaster prevention.
assignees: UNIV EAST CHINA JIAOTONG;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Concave energy dissipation dam design method for preventing and controlling narrow and steep channel debris flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of a concave energy dissipation dam for preventing and controlling narrow and steep channel debris flow, and particularly relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction facilities, comprising the following steps: collecting a debris flow channel historical information set, determining the site selection and the number of energy dissipation dams according to the historical information set, arranging the historical information set, determining standard parameters of debris flow simulation, forming a debris flow simulation combination set, designing dam bodies of m energy dissipation dams, modeling to obtain a simulation model, simulating the simulation model, recording simulation results, forming a simulation record set, analyzing to obtain expected deviation values and evaluation values of each dam body, screening, jointly analyzing the expected deviation values and the evaluation values, selecting an optimal simulation record set as an actual design standard, drawing and constructing according to the actual design standard, and putting into use after inspection and acceptance; the method improves the control effect of the energy dissipation dam and the effective pertinence according to local conditions through accurate site selection, optimal design and comprehensive evaluation.

title_en: Electric automobile fire simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire simulation system and a fire simulation method for an electric automobile, wherein the fire simulation method comprises the following steps: the system comprises an automobile basic structure building module, an automobile material fire feature acquisition module, an automobile fire CFD simulation module and an automobile fire feature data processing module; the automobile basic structure building module is used for obtaining a structural model and a spatial layout of the electric automobile and building a basic structure of the electric automobile; the automobile material fire disaster feature acquisition module is used for acquiring physical parameters of each part in the electric automobile fire disaster simulation process; the automobile fire CFD simulation module is used for simulating the fire process of the electric automobile according to the physical parameters of each component and the basic structure of the electric automobile; and the automobile fire characteristic data processing module is used for carrying out data analysis on the situation after the electric automobile fire simulation. The invention realizes the accurate simulation of the fire disaster of the electric automobile by utilizing the components such as the three-dimensional model of the electric automobile, the physical property parameter library of the electric automobile, the fire disaster calculation simulation unit, the full-size verification library and the like.

title_en: Public place emergency evacuation simulation method considering bioterrorism event popular behaviors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a public place emergency evacuation simulation method considering the popular behavior of a bioterrorism event, belonging to the technical field of application information; the method comprises the following steps: s1, setting an emergency evacuation scene; s2, analyzing according to a behavior analysis model to obtain heterogeneous behavior characteristics of different people in an emergency evacuation scene; the heterogeneous behavior features comprise a first type of heterogeneous behavior feature and a second type of heterogeneous behavior feature; s3, respectively inputting personnel position parameters with first-class heterogeneous behavior characteristics and second-class heterogeneous behavior characteristics into an outlet distribution model to obtain an optimal evacuation scheme; s4, inputting an optimal evacuation scheme and different routing rules of heterogeneous behavior characteristics into simulation software, simulating an evacuation process, and setting evacuation completion conditions; s5, outputting simulation results of the evacuation process. The invention has the advantages that: the crowd behavior characteristics are considered, effective support is provided for emergency evacuation of various scenes, and therefore evacuation efficiency is improved.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS;UNIV PEOPLES PUBLIC SECURITY CHINA

title_en: Regional disaster resistance analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a regional disaster resistance analysis method and system, and belongs to the technical field of environmental safety. The system comprises: and acquiring historical earthquake influence factor data, and normalizing the historical earthquake influence factor data to obtain historical earthquake initial influence factor data. And acquiring historical earthquake initial influence factor data and historical earthquake total loss result data for the disaster loss prediction model, training the disaster loss prediction model, and obtaining a trained disaster loss prediction model to obtain the connection weight of the disaster loss prediction model. And inputting the earthquake initial influence factor data into a disaster condition loss prediction learning model to obtain earthquake total loss result data. And obtaining an earthquake occurrence range, and obtaining a division area according to the earthquake occurrence range. And calculating the earthquake region loss according to the region earthquake loss weight and the earthquake total loss result. Accurate prediction of the total loss of the earthquake and the loss of the earthquake area is realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI JUNXIN SECURITY TECH MANAGEMENT SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire spread modeling method for minimizing influence of wind field uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire spread modeling method for minimizing influence of wind field uncertainty, which comprises the following steps: acquiring ground data; acquiring aerial data, including multispectral data and DEM data; generating a terrain grid according to the terrain data, and generating an equation set by applying a mass conservation equation at each point of the grid; storing a sparse matrix generated by an equation set by adopting a compressed sparse line CSR storage method, and solving the equation set by utilizing a conjugate gradient solver; finally, generating a wind field diagram according to the solving result; selecting farsite a fire behavior model in a simulator; and (5) superposing live wire positions at different times on the topographic map for visual display. According to the invention, a precise wind field state equation is constructed by introducing a mass conservation law, so that high-precision analysis of wind field distribution is realized, a high-resolution wind field diagram is obtained, and the high-resolution wind field diagram is combined with a farsite simulator, so that the fire disaster prediction accuracy is remarkably improved.
assignees: HEFEI HENGBAO TIANZE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground emergency treatment management system and method based on VR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a VR-based underground emergency treatment management system and method, which belong to the technical field of emergency management and comprise the following steps: the system comprises an emergency scene simulation module, an escape operation planning module and an escape operation assessment module, wherein the emergency scene simulation module is used for creating underground emergency scenes of gas, roof, flood, fire and coal dust disasters and inputting a disaster event set, the escape operation planning module is used for planning a disaster avoidance route and setting event node triggering event execution strategies, the escape operation assessment module is used for calculating action accuracy of assessment personnel, setting an accuracy judgment threshold value and determining that the assessment personnel need retraining or targeted training. According to the method, the disaster situation in the mine is visually displayed through virtual reality in the training of underground emergency treatment personnel, the training accuracy and intuitiveness are effectively improved, the optimal disaster avoidance route is selected for the training personnel, and the emergency treatment management of the training personnel is realized.
assignees: LIJIAHAO COAL MINE OF CHINA NAT ENERGY BAOTOU ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Automatic imaging system based on VR technique
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of VR/AR technology, specifically an automatic imaging system based on VR technology. The present invention generates a three-dimensional building model through BIM technology and combines it with relevant fire simulation software to generate a fire simulation VR scene for fire simulation exercises. The safety of the simulated scene is evaluated by the size of the fire, the load density of the fire, and the degree of material damage to the simulated building. Multiple simulated fire injury data of the simulated evacuation routes are set based on the evaluation results. The exercise personnel control virtual characters through the simulated evacuation routes to conduct evacuation exercises. Based on the casualty results of the virtual characters, the safety of multiple simulated evacuation routes is evaluated, and adjustments are made according to the safety evaluation results of the evacuation routes. Precise guidance is provided to each exercise personnel according to the partial injury degree of the virtual characters.

title_en: Water conservancy sand table model with early warning function and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a water conservancy sand table model with an early warning function and an early warning method thereof, wherein the electronic sand table model is simulated and built based on three-dimensional space data of a flood control area, the entity sand table model is built based on the electronic sand table model, the water conservancy scene test and verification of water conservancy business data are carried out on the electronic sand table model, the correction value of the electronic sand table model is obtained, the target electronic sand table model is further obtained, the accuracy of the obtained target electronic sand table model is ensured, an accurate sand table foundation is provided for the display of water conservancy business, then various early warning thresholds are set on the entity sand table model based on the target electronic sand table model for early warning and reminding, the data of the flood warning are displayed on the entity sand table model through the combination of the entity sand table model and the flood disaster early warning, the data of the flood disaster early warning are more visual and more imaged, the overall global view of the flood disaster early warning data is improved, and a powerful support is provided for the decision of flood disaster prevention work.
assignees: SHAANXI SHANQINGSHUIXIU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and related device for determining hydrologic drought evolution process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a related device for determining a hydrologic drought evolution process, which can determine the hydrologic drought evolution process according to month-to-month runoff data and month-to-month rainfall data of a target area, can provide effective parameters for future simulation prediction of the hydrologic drought dynamic evolution process and characteristic variables thereof of the target area, and has important significance for effective management of water resources of the target area and drought prevention and disaster reduction.

title_en: Rainfall type recognition-based dynamic mountain torrent disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic mountain torrent disaster early warning method based on rainfall rain recognition, which comprises the following steps: based on historical rainfall data containing disaster rainfall in a research area, constructing a research area characteristic rainfall library by using a k-means cluster analysis method; constructing a rainfall similarity association formula of the actually measured rainfall and the rainfall type library based on the shape similarity and quantity similarity principle, calculating the similarity between the actually measured rainfall and the characteristic rainfall, identifying the rainfall type of the actually measured rainfall, and then obtaining a rainfall forecasting process by combining the total rainfall forecasted by the numerical forecasting product; constructing a small-basin hydrologic model to simulate a rainfall-runoff process, and performing model parameter calibration and verification; and as rainfall observation information is increased, a rainfall type recognition result is dynamically updated time-period by time-period, a hydrologic model is used for dynamically forecasting a disaster prevention object to control a section flood process, and flood peak flow rate is used as an early warning index to issue dynamic early warning of the mountain flood disaster or not.

title_en: Indoor fire evacuation simulation method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: An indoor fire evacuation simulation method based on deep reinforcement learning is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the method comprises the following steps: step 1: performing fire numerical simulation by using Pyrosim; step 2: building an indoor fire evacuation simulation scene by adopting a game development engine Unity which is widely used at present, and step 3: realizing the dynamic coupling of the three-dimensional fire scene and the evacuation process; step 4: and realizing a collaborative DDQN algorithm, and training an evacuation intelligent body by combining an optimal reciprocal collision avoidance method ORCA to finally obtain an indoor fire evacuation model. The invention fits the real fire evacuation scene, the evacuation efficiency and realizes the effective cooperation among multiple intelligent agents, the intelligent agents can learn from the success and failure of each other, and the overall evacuation efficiency is improved. The combined mode improves the safety of the whole fire evacuation simulation process.

title_en: Secondary explosion experimental device for explosion winch deposited dust and safety evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a secondary explosion experimental device for explosion winch dust deposition and a safety evaluation method, wherein the device comprises an explosion main body, a gas distribution assembly, an ignition assembly, a data acquisition assembly and a control system, the explosion main body comprises an explosion column, a first explosion box and a second explosion box, an ignition motor needle is arranged on the explosion column, and the right side is connected with the gas distribution assembly. Testing, distributing, igniting, recording data, processing and evaluating the data. The invention can simulate different industrial production and mine scenes, is helpful for revealing the explosion disaster mechanism of the gas and dust mixed system, and provides reference and preventive measures for effectively preventing and controlling explosion accidents. The invention has simple structure and is not easy to generate faults; the safety is strong, can not cause danger to the experimenter.

title_en: FDS (fully drawn vehicle) -based realistic smoke simulation method for UE (user Equipment) 4
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of development of a fantasy engine plug-in and smoke simulation, and provides a UE4 smoke simulation method based on FDS by combining FDS fire simulation with a UE4 particle system. The invention mainly comprises four modules, namely a scene simulation module, a data export module, a data loading module and a particle rendering module, wherein the scene simulation module simulates an indoor fire disaster by using FDS and exports experimental data from the scene simulation module. After the simulation data are obtained, the user-defined UE4 plug-in unit is used for importing PLY point cloud data, then importing the data into the Niagara system in a texture mode, and finally rendering the realistic smog.

title_en: Mud-rock flow river blockage judging method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of debris flow prevention and control engineering and discloses a debris flow river blockage judging method and system. If the risk is high, further establishing a fluid dynamics and debris flow siltation model, simulating a motion track and a siltation process, and calculating a transverse siltation length and an average siltation height. According to the method, the risk of blocking the river of the debris flow is finally judged by comparing the parameters with the corresponding threshold ranges. The method has the advantages that the movement characteristics of the debris flow and the characteristics of the river channel are comprehensively considered, the judgment accuracy is improved, and an important basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction. Meanwhile, the model is suitable for different environments and conditions, and the application range is widened.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Mine three-dimensional scene construction system and method for VR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine three-dimensional scene construction system and method for VR, belonging to the field of electric signal transmission, wherein the invention renders and displays the best disaster emergency evolution picture on a display screen according to the disaster evolution process data and history maintenance data of each node of the mine, inputs variable in the evolution process, randomly changes the disaster development state of the mine mining area three-dimensional model, updates the best disaster emergency evolution picture in real time along with the change of the disaster development state of the mine mining area three-dimensional model, only needs to change the environment and equipment conditions, can directly simulate and give out results, greatly shortens the design and verification optimization time of fault measures, and simultaneously carries out data dynamic visual output on the numerical simulation results to realize the data roaming of the simulation scene.

title_en: Multi-disaster-point emergency evacuation mathematical model, planning method, planning model and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster-point emergency evacuation mathematical model, a planning method, a planning model and a system, wherein the mathematical model considers the crossing of disaster victims in a dangerous area, the load balance of refuge and the redundancy of evacuation distances of disaster victims; aiming at the problem of multi-disaster-point emergency evacuation, a multi-disaster emergency evacuation algorithm is established; the emergency evacuation algorithm can effectively embed information such as disaster citizens, refuge and disaster points in the evacuation problem, extract the relation characteristics of the information and generate an efficient evacuation plan; the emergency evacuation algorithm adopts an optimization mode of a strategy gradient algorithm, so that gradient descent of algorithm parameters is effectively realized, and algorithm training efficiency is improved; the cloud edge network emergency evacuation system is established aiming at the emergency evacuation problem of multiple disaster points, the evacuation system adopts a cloud-edge-end three-layer architecture, the evacuation planning efficiency is effectively improved, a plurality of processes of algorithm training and evacuation response are comprehensively considered, and a solid foundation is laid for the practical application of the system.

title_en: Power distribution network lightning protection method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network lightning protection method and system based on big data analysis, which relate to the technical field of lightning protection and comprise the following steps: the system collects lightning electrical big data from different sources and performs data preprocessing on the lightning electrical big data; extracting key features from the preprocessed fusion data set by utilizing a big data analysis technology, and training the reinforcement learning algorithm model by using the extracted feature data; predicting the position and probability of lightning occurrence, and automatically triggering an alarm when the probability of lightning occurrence reaches a preset threshold value; and the system updates the lightning prediction model in real time by utilizing the latest big data analysis result, and sends out preset early warning protection measures to the power distribution network operators through the visual platform. According to the invention, the lightning disaster protection capability of the power distribution network is improved, and a powerful guarantee is provided for ensuring the safe operation of the power system and the public safety.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Bedding accurate pressurized water injection method based on coal seam interval hydraulic gradient measurement and calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bedding accurate pressurized water injection method based on coal seam interval hydraulic gradient measurement and calculation, and relates to the technical field of mine disaster prevention. The method comprises the steps of firstly taking a water injection drilling hole as a center, arranging pressure measuring holes on two sides of the water injection drilling hole, arranging monitoring devices to measure internal stress of the pressure measuring holes in real time, then in the coal seam water injection process, obtaining pressure change conditions of the water injection holes and the pressure change nodes of the pressure measuring holes at different positions in real time, timing the pressure change nodes of the pressure measuring holes, measuring and calculating interval hydraulic gradients in the water injection process to obtain the along-path power loss of pressure water, and finally according to pressure difference change conditions in different water injection influence radius ranges and the pressure change nodes of the pressure measuring holes, in the same coal seam water injection process, timely increasing the coal seam water injection pressure at corresponding time nodes. The method can not only effectively avoid the water leakage phenomenon caused by overlarge pressure in the initial stage of water injection, but also compensate the pressure hydrodynamic damage to a certain extent.

title_en: Fire disaster ignition point detection method based on countermeasure self-encoder and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire disaster ignition point detection method based on an countermeasure self-encoder and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target input image of fire smoke; inputting a target input image into a pre-trained countermeasure self-encoder, so as to obtain a target reconstruction image corresponding to the target input image through the countermeasure self-encoder, and performing fire detection based on the target reconstruction image to obtain a fire detection result; the anti-self-encoder is trained by taking a reconstruction error of the minimized DCGAN generator and a discrimination error of the discriminator as training targets, generates a high-quality reconstruction image of a fire smoke input image through the anti-self-encoder comprising the DCGAN generator, and detects a fire point based on the reconstruction image, so that the influence of environmental interference is effectively reduced, and the accuracy and the effectiveness of detection are improved.

title_en: Landslide photography experiment platform
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of geological disaster simulation. In view of the problems of single experimental mode and inaccurate experimental results of the existing landslide simulation experimental device, the utility model discloses a landslide photographing experimental platform, which structurally comprises an experimental tank; the baffle plates are movably arranged at the left side and the right side of the experimental tank in the sliding direction; the adjusting mechanism is connected with the baffles and used for adjusting the distance between the baffles so as to form a stacking ditch bed; the support component is arranged at the bottom of the experimental tank; the rainfall simulation component is arranged above the experimental tank; the illumination simulation assembly is arranged above the experimental tank; and the camera is arranged above and in front of the experimental tank. The platform can simulate landslide conditions under various natural conditions, thereby being beneficial to improving the contrast and accuracy of experiments.
assignees: CHINA BUILDING MAT SOUTHWEST SURVEY & DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Fault diagnosis of switchgear employing artificial intelligence
title_ko: Ai 기반 고장처리 기능을 갖는 수배전반
abstract_en: The embodiment relates to an AI-based emergency response method for a switchboard. Specifically, according to the emergency response method, when an emergency or dangerous situation such as a power outage, fire, or equipment failure occurs in the switchboard, a specific internal emergency response manual interacts with a nearby field manager to quickly and reliably resolve the fault. The emergency response manual includes response scenarios for each type of switchboard failure, such as a power outage, fire, or equipment failure, and dynamically interacts with users near the switchboard to implement corresponding measures. Furthermore, it interacts with the switchboard's operating environment and devices to adapt the scenarios to the specific situation, and dynamically provides emergency response information tailored to the on-site situation. The interaction involves repeatedly performing actions such as scenario-based TTS guidance for each procedure and STT recognition of the user's emergency response.
abstract_ko:
실시예는 AI 기반 배전반의 응급조치 방법에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로는, 이러한 응급조치 방법은 배전반에서 정전과 화재, 기기 고장 등의 긴급하고 위험한 상황이 발생할 경우, 내부의 특정 응급조치 매뉴얼에서 주변의 현장 관리자와 인터랙션하여 고장 상황을 신속하고 안정적으로 조치한다. 
이러한 응급조치 매뉴얼은 정전과 화재, 기기 고장 등의 배전반 고장 유형별로 대응하는 조치 시나리오를 가지며, 이에 따라 배전반의 주변에 있는 사용자와 인터랙션하여 동적으로 조치하는 것이다. 또한, 배전반의 사용 환경과 사용 장치와도 인터랙션하여 해당 상황에 맞게 시나리오를 사전에 가변하여 현장 상황에 맞게 응급조치 내용을 동적으로 제공한다. 
상기 인터랙션은 배전반의 응급조치를 시나리오 기반으로 각 절차마다 TTS로 안내하고, 사용자의 응급조치 사항을 STT로 인식하는 동작을 반복적으로 수행하여 처리하는 것을 의미한다.

title_en: A demonstration system for sprinkler head actuation
title_ko: 소화설비용 헤드 방수 실연 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a demonstration system for sprinkler head actuation in fire extinguishing facilities. More specifically, the system comprises: a pipe in which various types of fire-extinguishing heads are physically installed to demonstrate actual water discharge, allowing selective coupling and opening/closing of multiple heads for practical training purposes; and a movable support which secures the pipe in place and allows for relocation. Unlike conventional fire extinguishing systems, the demonstration system can be used by connecting a fire hydrant or pump vehicle directly to a water supply port, without requiring a dedicated water tank or pump. Its simple structure and operation allow trainees to visually observe and control water discharge from sprinkler heads in real time, something not possible in actual fire suppression systems, thus enhancing its utility for water supply training.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화설비용 헤드 방수 실연 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 소화설비용 헤드의 다양한 종류를 실물로 설치하고 실제 방수 작동되는 장면을 시연함으로써 실습교육에 활용할 수 있도록 여러 헤드를 결합하고 선택적으로 개폐할 수 있는 배관과, 그 배관을 고정한 채 장소 이동이 가능한 지지대로 구성되며, 소화설비와는 달리 전용의 수조나 펌프 없이도 송수구에 소화전이나 펌프차를 연결하여 송수하는 방법으로 사용하므로 구조와 조작이 간편하고, 방수되고 있는 헤드를 실시간으로 육안 관찰할 수 없는 실제 소방시설과 달리 헤드의 방수 정도를 직접 관찰하며 송수할 수 있어 송수훈련에 활용할 수 있도록 개선된 소화설비용 헤드 방수 실연 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Outdoor air data processing system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outdoor air data processing system based on data analysis, in particular to the field of environmental monitoring, the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, an atmospheric pollutant concentration field distribution calculation module, an air quality index evaluation module, a sensitivity risk evaluation module, a prediction model training module and an outdoor air detection reporting module. The outdoor air data processing system based on data analysis introduces a diffusion coefficient vertical to the wind direction and a diffusion coefficient vertical to the ground direction to accurately reflect the expansion degree of pollution in the transverse direction and the vertical direction through the atmospheric pollutant concentration field distribution calculation module, so that the practical adaptability of the model is enhanced, and the establishment of an effective emergency response strategy is facilitated; through the comprehensive air quality index, an air quality evaluation result which is easy to understand and apply is provided, the air pollution level can be rapidly mastered, and corresponding protective measures can be timely taken.
assignees: SHANDONG CAYON TESTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ocean wave gas full-coupling momentum flux estimation method for ocean meteorological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of ocean science, in particular to a sea wave full-coupling momentum flux estimation method for ocean meteorological disasters, which realizes numerical simulation of sea, wave and gas parameters such as 10m maximum wind speed, effective wave height, storm tide level and the like through data initialization, friction wind speed and ocean side momentum flux calculation, model time integration and iteration, output and post-treatment processes. Aiming at the defect of momentum flux estimation in the current mainstream OWA (Ocean-Wave-atmosphere Ocean-Wave-Atmosphere) coupling system, based on the momentum flux balance theory of an Ocean-air interface, a set of Ocean and atmosphere two-side momentum flux estimation method which is applicable to extreme sea condition weather (such as typhoons, storm tides and the like) and can fully consider Wave factors is established and developed by utilizing the Ocean spectrum in an Ocean Wave mode and combining with the WBLM (Wave Boundary LayerModel, a Wave boundary layer model) so that the physical mechanism of the Ocean-Wave-air coupling mode in the numerical simulation process of the Ocean disaster at the opposite end is more reasonable and perfect, and further the construction of the high-quality Ocean weather technology supporting capability of China is served.

title_en: Target detection model construction method based on target data set and secondary transfer learning
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of underwater disaster target detection, and particularly relates to a target detection model construction method based on a target data set and secondary migration learning, which comprises the steps of creating an acoustic-optical underwater disaster target detection data set, expanding the acoustic-optical underwater disaster target detection data set by adopting a data enhancement method, training YOLOv a model on a data set formed by randomly extracting part of the expanded acoustic-optical underwater disaster target detection data set by using a pre-training model weight, taking the optimal weight in the process as a first-stage weight, and carrying out two-stage training on YOLOv model on the expanded acoustic-optical underwater disaster target detection data set by adopting the first-stage weight to obtain an underwater disaster target detection model. According to the application, the underwater disaster target is detected by using the model constructed by combining the secondary migration learning and the optical-acoustic data set, so that the detection efficiency and accuracy are improved, and the difficulty of detecting the underwater disaster target by the existing model is reduced.

title_en: Disaster prevention safety emergency evacuation guiding system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster prevention safety emergency evacuation guiding system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises a plurality of intelligent emergency marker lamps, a plurality of intelligent emergency illuminating lamps, a control host and a comprehensive operation control center; the intelligent emergency marker lamp is used for detecting personnel in a traffic channel and an evacuation channel and detecting the parking position of a vehicle accident, transmitting detected personnel movement data to the control host for analysis, and transmitting personnel distress information and flow density information obtained after analysis to the comprehensive operation control center to present a digital twin virtual reality scene so as to provide information support for rescue decisions; the intelligent emergency lighting lamp is used for detecting disasters in the traffic channel and the evacuation channel, transmitting detected disaster data to the control host for analysis, and transmitting disaster information obtained after analysis to the comprehensive operation control center to present a digital twin virtual reality scene so as to provide information support for rescue decisions. By implementing the invention, the intelligent degree is high, timely and comprehensive information support can be provided for emergency rescue workers, the emergency response speed is improved, and a reasonable rescue scheme is formulated.
assignees: XIJIAO HENGSHENG CHENGDU EMERGENCY TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-agent evacuation method based on deep reinforcement learning under multi-exit scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-agent evacuation method based on deep reinforcement learning in a multi-outlet scene, which mainly solves the problems that a multi-agent evacuation model in the prior art is limited by specific rules and models, has poor generalization and is difficult to flexibly cope with the multi-outlet scene. It comprises five steps: 1) Initializing the environment and setting training parameters. 2) And collecting experience data and updating an experience data buffer zone, controlling the movement of the intelligent agent through mixed actions, and designing a compound rewarding function to calculate instant rewards. 3) Experience playback and model updating, optimizing the value network by using a imagination mechanism. 4) And (5) model testing. 5) Intermediate result visualization and model storage. The method can cope with different complex environments, enhances the learning efficiency and generalization capability of the algorithm, can enable the intelligent agent to explore more feasible paths, and effectively solves the evacuation task under complex and dynamic changing scenes. Meanwhile, collision risk of the intelligent body in the evacuation process is reduced, and evacuation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Sparse criticality prediction model training method, prediction system and method
abstract_en: A sparse criticality prediction model training method, a prediction system and a method, wherein the training method comprises the following steps: acquiring a positive sample set P when a safety key event of the intelligent system occurs and a negative sample set N when the safety key event does not occur, performing first-stage unsupervised reward model training according to the P and the N, removing simple negative samples in the N, and reserving false positive samples; constructing a positive sample set P  2  and a negative sample set N  2  based on the positive sample set P and the false positive sample, and training a supervised classification model based on an improved double-branch network in the second stage to obtain a difficult-case classification model; the method comprises the steps of acquiring key data as training data in a third stage, performing fine adjustment on a difficult-case classification model in the third stage based on a dense reinforcement learning method for improving classification accuracy, obtaining a sparse criticality prediction model, effectively solving the sparsity disaster of safety critical event environment variables, solving the learning problem of an extremely unbalanced data set, and obtaining a high-precision intelligent system safety critical event probability prediction model.

title_en: Landscaping wall cracking demonstration device simulating earthquake scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landscaping wall cracking demonstration device for simulating an earthquake scene, which belongs to the technical field of earthquake science popularization teaching and comprises a main body wall, a fixing frame, a pushing device and a vibrating device, wherein the main body wall comprises two movable walls and a fixed wall, the movable walls are connected with the pushing device and the vibrating device, and the fixed wall is fixed on the fixing frame; the pushing device can push the movable wall, and the vibrating device can vibrate the movable wall. When the pushing device and the vibrating device are not started, the main body wall is of an integrated structure; after the starting, cracks are formed between the main body walls, and the cracking effect is generated. The main body wall, the fixing frame, the pushing device and the vibrating device are in modularized design. According to the invention, the pushing device and the vibrating device are arranged, so that the main body wall can simulate the cracking effect of the wall body during an earthquake and the state of the wall body before cracking, and the earthquake resistance and disaster reduction awareness of the masses can be improved. Each device adopts the modularized design, and the overhaul is convenient.
assignees: GUANGDONG NIKOLA ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Seabed landslide overall process evolution test device under complex ocean power condition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of marine geological disaster simulation, and designs a submarine landslide overall process evolution test device under the action of complex marine power conditions, which can realize the submarine landslide instability-flow-disaster-causing overall process simulation under the action of complex power conditions such as wave flow, ocean current and the like and comprises a partition plate system, a bracket system, an inclined plate measuring system, a release system, a wave flow trough system and a non-contact measuring system. The invention can effectively solve the problem of the whole process simulation of the instability, the flow and the disaster caused by the submarine landslide under the action of complex dynamic boundary conditions such as wave flow, ocean current and the like.

title_en: Intelligent fire extinguishing device for hidden fire of storage tank and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire extinguishing device for hiding fire of a storage tank and a use method thereof, mainly comprising the following steps: the intelligent fire extinguishing system comprises an intelligent perception analysis module, a drilling module, a fire extinguishing module, an inert gas module and an intelligent control module. The intelligent perception analysis module is used for perceiving the temperature of the tank wall and the flow field distribution of the hidden fire area so as to determine the position of the hidden fire source, the position of the drilling hole and the jet direction of the jet head; the drilling module is used for perforating the tank wall; the fire extinguishing module is used for containing, supplying and spraying fire extinguishing medium; the inert gas module mainly comprises an inert gas carrying tank and a protective cover, and is used for isolating combustible vapor in the tank from contacting with air outside the tank so as to avoid explosion at the hole; the intelligent control module is used for collecting information perceived by the intelligent perception analysis module, and the intelligent control drilling module, the fire extinguishing module and the mobile module work cooperatively to realize accurate identification of a concealed fire area, safe drilling and efficient injection of fire extinguishing agent. The invention can effectively identify and extinguish the hidden fire disaster of the storage tank and ensure the safe operation of the tank area.

title_en: Reservoir grading and stage drought police water level calculation method considering drought loss
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir grading and stage drought police water level calculating method considering drought loss, which specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, calculating to obtain water supply and water shortage rate, selecting model years with different drought grades, and scaling the actual water supply process of each model year so that the water shortage rate of each model year reaches the maximum value of the drought grade, thereby obtaining the designed model year water supply process; step 2, simulating the running process of reservoirs in each typical year under different initial water level scenes and the drought loss caused by agricultural production, drawing a drought loss caused curve, positioning demarcation points which change in the drought loss caused curve according to regional disaster grade grading standards, and determining graded drought police water levels according to the running water level process of reservoirs corresponding to the demarcation points; and 3, grading the drought period according to the water demand sensitivity change trend of the water using department, and adjusting the agricultural water supply at different stages. The method can improve drought resistance and disaster reduction capability of the reservoir and reduce drought loss caused by agricultural production.

title_en: Extinguishing device for fire suppression of electric vehicles
title_ko: 전기차 화재진압용 소화장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguishing device for extinguishing a fire occurring in an electric vehicle. More specifically, the fire extinguishing device is formed to spray water into a vehicle battery by drilling a hole on a lower portion of an electric vehicle in which a fire occurs using a movable fire extinguishing device, thereby easily approaching the electric vehicle in which the fire occurs through the movable fire extinguishing device and drilling a hole on the lower portion of the vehicle. Therefore, the fire extinguishing device intensively sprays water to an ignition point of the vehicle, thereby quickly and efficiently extinguishing the fire in the vehicle at an early stage, preventing a secondary fire and damage caused by the vehicle fire as well as drilling a lower portion of the electric vehicle in which the fire occurs. Also, through a drilled through hole, the fire extinguishing device intensively sprays firefighting water and a fire extinguishing agent into a high-temperature battery through a drilled through hole, thereby minimizing the amount of the fire extinguishing water and the fire extinguishing agent consumed for the battery fire of the electric vehicle. Moreover, since the fire extinguishing device does not require a separate installation or the like according to the fire vehicle as a movable fire extinguishing device, the fire extinguishing device can shorten the fire extinguishing time and minimize the use of firefighting personnel and firefighting water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차량에서 발생한 화재를 진압하도록 하는 소화장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 이동식 소화장치를 이용하여 화재가 발생한 전기차의 하부를 천공하여 차량 배터리 내부에 집중적으로 살수되도록 형성함으로써, 이동식 소화장치를 통해 화재가 발생한 전기차량에 용이하게 접근하고 차량 하부를 천공되도록 하기 때문에, 차량의 발화점에 집중적으로 살수하여, 차량 화재를 초기에 신속하게 효율적으로 진압하고, 차량 화재에 따른 2차 화재 및 피해를 차단할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 화재가 발생한 전기차량의 하부를 천공하고, 천공된 통공을 통해, 고온의 배터리 내부에 집중적으로 소화용수 및 소화약제를 살수할 수 있기 때문에, 전기차량의 배터리 화재에 소모되는 소화용수 및 소화약제의 사용량을 최소화할 수 있고, 이동식 소화장치로서 화재 차량에 따른 별도의 설치물 등이 불필요하기 때문에, 화재 진압 시간을 단축하고, 소방 인력 및 소화 용수의 사용을 최소화할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Remote temperature rise fire disaster simulation system based on LORA wireless communication
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a remote temperature rise fire disaster simulation system based on LORA wireless communication in the technical field of remote temperature rise fire disaster simulation, which comprises a remote control device and a smoke temperature simulation device, wherein the remote control device is used for controlling the smoke temperature simulation device to simulate and heat a lithium battery goods lattice so as to verify the accuracy of a fire disaster sensor, and simultaneously recording the real-time temperature of the lithium battery goods lattice so as to be compared with the alarm temperature set by the fire disaster sensor, so that the accuracy of the fire disaster sensor is further verified; the smoke temperature simulation device is provided with a heating device, the heating device can uniformly heat the fire sensor, and the fire sensor is guaranteed to detect the real temperature of the lithium battery goods lattice, so that the accuracy of the follow-up verification process is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU GUANGWEI SENSING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Firefighting training MR program and firefighting training MR system
abstract_en: To construct a firefighting training simulator capable of reproducing an environment where a user is located, including surrounding objects, and setting an ignition point among those objects.SOLUTION: A firefighting training MR system 1 acquires three-dimensional data around an HMD 10a. In the firefighting training MR system 1, among the three-dimensional data, furniture, office equipment, for example, can be set as objects according to a selection of a user, and each individual object can be assigned attributes such as combustibility or non-combustibility and an ignition point. Combustion can be reproduced for each object, and flame propagation can also be simulated. On the basis of these settings, a realistic firefighting training simulator can be provided by superimposing flame effects on the object models.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Anchor bar pile structure for reinforcing huge wide-crack dangerous rock mass
abstract_en: The anchor bar pile structure for reinforcing the huge wide-crack dangerous rock mass comprises a rock mass formed by a rear mountain section and a front large-crack stacking section, and further comprises pile holes arranged on the rock mass, anchor bar piles arranged in the pile holes, and blocking limiting parts used for limiting the anchor bar piles are arranged at the positions of the openings of the pile holes on the outer sides of the anchor bar piles. Compared with the prior art, the utility model analyzes the current situation of the reinforcement mechanism of the anchor bar pile of the dangerous rock mass, innovatively adopts the drill rod grouting type anchor bar pile to reinforce the dangerous rock mass, and limits and reinforces the pile body through the leakage blocking limiting piece, thereby solving the problems that loose stacked bodies with wide cracks are difficult to keep pore-forming straight and the traditional anchor bar pile is difficult to install due to sliding and dumping, ensuring that the stability requirement can be met after reinforcement, achieving the aim of eliminating and reducing the occurrence of geological disasters, and playing an extremely important role in tunnel construction and operation.
assignees: POWERCHINA NO 11 BUREAU ENG CO LTD;SINOHYDRO BUREAU 11 CO LTD

title_en: Simulation method for low-attitude evacuation of personnel in fire environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation method for evacuating personnel in a low posture in a fire environment, which comprises the following steps: s1: modeling a fire scene, and calculating and generating time and space distribution of a temperature field; s2: calculating the shortest path from any position in the scene to the destination, and determining the expected movement direction when personnel exist at any position in the scene; s3: a certain number of people are distributed in a fire scene, the positions, the quality and the postures of the people are initialized, and the postures are one of three postures of crawling, squatting and walking with the upper body vertically bent and the knee are selected when hands and knees are simultaneously contacted with the ground; s4: establishing a personnel motion equation, m  i dv i /dt＝F i , wherein i represents the number of personnel and individuals, F  i 、v i  represents the resultant force and the speed vector born by the individual i, m  i  represents the mass of the individual i, and t is time; s5: and solving a person motion equation to obtain a motion trail of each person, namely an evacuation path.

title_en: Single or double bar mechanical test device with typical structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structural mechanics test technology and a device for refining stacked oblique (landslide) strip blocks. The device can reveal the anti-slip instability rule of the slope of the common structure type stacking layer and the deformation performance thereof, and promote the monitoring and early warning level improvement of landslide disasters. The invention sets the model groove, and the loading system and the measuring system realize the block management and mutual coordination of different action units. The model groove can be used for manufacturing stacked layer slope strips with different layering structure types and water content states, and a partition plate is added to realize the switching of single/double strips, so that the relationship of force, anti-slip effect and deformation among the strips can be intuitively obtained. The force application panel of the load system is matched with a plurality of groups of motors to realize multidirectional and multipoint controllable continuous force application on the simulated accumulation body, so that the stress change in the actual slope destabilization process can be simulated. The measuring system innovatively uses various internal monitoring devices to carry out comprehensive and multi-angle numerical value collection in cooperation with external instruments, so that further data analysis is facilitated.

title_en: Landslide susceptibility evaluation method based on fracture zone statistical partitioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide susceptibility evaluation method based on fracture zone statistics partition, belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and solves the problem of high-precision landslide susceptibility analysis in multiple fracture zone distribution areas; firstly, multi-source data of a research area are acquired, the used evaluation factors are extracted, and an evaluation factor layer is generated; then carrying out statistical analysis on fracture zone distribution of the research area, and partitioning the research area based on the fracture zone distribution; respectively selecting negative samples in the two partitions by adopting a negative sample selection method based on a buffer area strategy; packaging the landslide sample and the negative sample to construct a model sample data set; training and testing the model by adopting ten-fold cross validation; and (5) inputting the evaluation factors of the whole research area into a model for landslide susceptibility analysis. When the landslide susceptibility evaluation is carried out in the multi-distribution area of the fracture zone, the method improves the performance of the area landslide susceptibility model, and can objectively and efficiently realize the landslide susceptibility evaluation.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;SICHUAN YANJIANG PANNING EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;WUHAN CAMPUS OF YANGTZE UNIV

title_en: Urban multi-mode traffic network post-disaster restoration strategy efficiency evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating the efficiency of a post-disaster restoration strategy of an urban multi-mode traffic network, which belong to the technical field of urban traffic operation management and construct a multi-mode traffic network structure model by utilizing road network and public transport network open source data; simulating urban traffic distribution by using traffic travel demand data, and constructing a multi-mode traffic network function model; based on the multimode traffic network function model, constructing a multimode traffic network structure recovery model according to disaster space distribution characteristics and post-disaster network recovery strategies, and evaluating structure recovery efficiency; based on the multi-mode traffic network structure recovery model, the travel demands are reloaded, the multi-mode traffic network function recovery model is constructed, and the function recovery efficiency is evaluated. The invention can comprehensively consider multiple traffic modes and complex dynamic games among travelers, provides more accurate and comprehensive repair strategy evaluation, can enhance the toughness of the urban comprehensive traffic system, and can better cope with various disasters and emergency situations.

title_en: Subway burst large passenger flow early warning and evacuation induction double-layer system and working method
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway burst large passenger flow early warning and evacuation induction double-layer system and a working method thereof, wherein the double-layer system comprises: the system comprises a data acquisition layer, a data analysis and management layer, an application layer and an execution layer. The working method provided by the invention comprises the following specific steps: acquiring train operation and subway station entering condition data; predicting the arrival passenger flow according to the acquired data, and carrying out passenger flow dynamic simulation; setting an objective function and constraint conditions according to a dynamic simulation result, and judging whether large passenger flows burst or not; and when the sudden large passenger flow is judged, the passenger flow abnormality alarm is carried out, and an emergency plan is started. The passenger flow early warning and induction system is combined, so that passenger flow evacuation control is further realized, the working phase rate of an operation enterprise can be improved, and the passenger safety can be further ensured.

title_en: Chained model construction method for soil erosion and geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a chained model of soil erosion and geological disasters, which comprises the following steps: numerical simulation: determining a critical cohesive strength c value and an internal friction angle phi value of a slope slip surface; indoor test: obtaining the relation between the value of the slip surface cohesive strength c and the value of the internal friction angle phi and time under continuous rainfall; obtaining the relation between water loss and soil erosion and time under each rainfall intensity; and (3) on-site monitoring: correcting and improving the relation established by the indoor test; model deduction: and (3) deducing the relation between the slip crack surface cohesive strength c value and the internal friction angle phi value under rainfall intensity and water and soil loss, and combining the slip crack surface cohesive strength c value and the internal friction angle phi value to form a water and soil loss-geological disaster chain model. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the model has the advantages of simple and representative established relationship, simple and efficient form, and can simply and directly reflect the chained rule of soil loss and geological disasters.

title_en: Method for weakening hydraulic fracturing advanced area of roof of strong mine pressure disaster of multi-coal-seam mining overlying bias coal pillar
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for weakening a hydraulic fracturing advanced area of a roof of a strong mine pressure disaster of a multi-coal-seam mining overlying bias coal pillar.
