Based on the research results of the occurrence rule of the strong mine pressure disaster of the overlying legacy coal pillar and the disaster causing mechanism, the weakening prevention and control thought of the hydraulic fracturing advanced area of the strong mine pressure disaster of the overlying legacy coal pillar is determined based on the prevention and control idea of the supporting of the collapsing filling body, the weakening of the key rock stratum and the transfer of the stress transfer path, the interlayer key rock stratum is divided into three parts of a coal pillar inlet area, a coal pillar lower area and a coal pillar outlet area, the range of the mine pressure abnormal phenomenon of a working face in the coal pillar inlet area and the coal pillar outlet area is determined through a numerical simulation or laboratory similar experimental method, the roof fracturing control range is further determined, the weakening and reconstruction are carried out on the roof fracturing control range, and the effects of changing the transportation space of the coal pillar and the carrier, uniformly distributing concentrated stress and transferring the stress transfer path can be realized.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL AND CHEMICAL IND GROUP SUNJIACHA LONGHUA MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Three-quantity directional blasting pressure relief method under rapid tunneling of mine coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-quantity directional blasting pressure relief method under rapid tunneling of a mine coal seam, which comprises the steps of tunneling engineering, coal body blasting drilling construction, monitoring and quality control, shock absorption and restoration, and relates to the technical field of rock burst control. According to the three-quantity directional blasting pressure relief method under the rapid tunneling of the mine coal seam, the originally designed two large-diameter pressure relief drilling holes (construction interval 2 m) are changed into two-wall coal body blasting drilling holes (construction interval 15 m), the two large-diameter pressure relief drilling holes at the head are changed into one coal body blasting drilling hole, the tunneling efficiency of the high-stress coal seam underground tunneling and anchoring integrated machine is effectively improved through monitoring, quality control, shock absorption and restoration, the corresponding impact prevention and disaster control engineering quantity is reduced, the construction investment of corresponding rock burst disaster control is saved, and the popularization and application of the tunneling and anchoring integrated machine in the deep mine high-stress coal seam are promoted, so that the method has a good application prospect.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHENGTONG COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Coal roadway side energy-absorbing grouting and internal fracturing pressure-releasing coupling anti-impact method
abstract_en: The application relates to a coal roadway side energy-absorbing grouting and internal fracturing pressure-releasing coupling scour prevention method, which relates to the technical field of deep coal mine dynamic disaster prevention and control and comprises the following steps: step S1: drilling grouting holes at two sides of the roadway by using a drilling machine, so that cracks formed by drilling grouting holes are communicated with each other to form an initial pressure relief area, releasing residual stress of a crushing area at the two sides of the roadway, and performing initial pressure relief on roadway confining pressure; step S2: after the grouting hole of the upper part is drilled and the coal body structure is restored to be stable, grouting reinforcement is carried out in the grouting hole formed in the step S1, and a reinforcement area is formed; step S3: after grouting reinforcement of the shallow part crushing area of the roadway side part is completed and the structure is restored to be stable, further reaming is carried out on the basis of the grouting holes drilled in the step S1, and the hole depth is increased to form hydraulic fracturing guide holes for butt joint of the grouting holes; step S4: and (3) carrying out hydraulic fracturing on the rock mass through the hydraulic fracturing guide hole formed in the step (S3), and forming a pressure relief area outside the reinforced area.

title_en: Mine drilling disaster information source monitoring and air bag hole sealing and glue injection treatment equipment technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine drilling disaster information source monitoring and air bag hole sealing and glue injection treatment equipment technology, which aims to accurately monitor a high-temperature heat source and a disaster information source in a coal seam drilling area and carry out collaborative glue injection foam plugging treatment. The infrared optical fiber double temperature measuring device utilizes a ring type infrared and distributed optical fiber sensor to measure temperature in a combined way; the mine drilling disaster CO gas in-situ monitoring and grading early warning system divides four-level early warning based on concentration acceleration; the annular air bag fixing hole sealing device is provided with a shrinkage type unidirectional rubber pad to prevent leakage of catastrophe gas and particulate matters; deep physicochemical targeting of modified cuprate porous carbon xerogel inhibits CO gas release; the movable integrated foam producing device for mine uses two-stage coaxial stirring fan to mix multi-component material spirally, and through negative pressure self-sucking discharge port, the foam is sprayed into the coal wall to form a paste for plugging.

title_en: Electrical fire risk assessment method based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation-BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire risk assessment, and discloses an electrical fire risk assessment method based on a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation-BP neural network. Establishing an electrical fire risk assessment system and a comment set, establishing a BP neural network model based on fuzzy comprehensive assessment, establishing a relevant membership function by using the assessment model based on the electrical fire risk assessment system, acquiring a data set of electrical fire risk assessment by combining dynamic weight and fuzzy comprehensive assessment, and then performing model training by using the BP neural network to realize real-time risk assessment of the electrical fire. The invention can effectively evaluate the risk state of the electric fire disaster of the low-voltage power distribution system, can achieve higher evaluation accuracy, accords with the actual standard and the requirement of the power industry, and has higher use value.

title_en: Mountain torrent early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and discloses a mountain torrent early warning system, which comprises a monitoring unit, an analysis unit and an early warning unit, wherein the monitoring unit comprises a terrain monitoring module, a vegetation monitoring module and a precipitation monitoring module, and the terrain monitoring module is used for monitoring the terrain and landform conditions of a mountain and establishing a mountain three-dimensional model; the vegetation monitoring module is used for monitoring vegetation types and growth coverage conditions of the surfaces of the mountain bodies and establishing a vegetation distribution model; the precipitation module is used for monitoring the precipitation condition of the area where the mountain is located; the analysis unit is used for generating a mountain torrent prediction simulation model according to the combination of the mountain three-dimensional model and the vegetation distribution model, predicting and analyzing the mountain torrent according to the monitoring result of the rainfall monitoring module on the mountain torrent simulation prediction model, and the early warning unit is used for giving out mountain torrent early warning according to the analysis result of the analysis unit. The method has the beneficial effects of high matching degree between the mountain torrent prediction and the environment and high accuracy of the prediction result.

title_en: YOLOv8 model-based ground disaster remote sensing detection method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, equipment and medium for detecting ground disaster remote sensing based on YOLOv model, relating to the technical field of remote sensing images, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a classification tag ground disaster data set according to remote sensing data and geological data of a research area and preprocessing the classification tag ground disaster data set; based on YOLOv model and combining with self-adaptive feature fusion strategy, constructing ground disaster detection model based on self-adaptive fusion feature; the ground disaster detection model comprises: a difficult sample enhancer, a target detection network; training a target detection network through the preprocessed classified label ground disaster data set; inputting the classification label ground disaster data set into a ground disaster detection model, and training a difficult sample enhancer to obtain a difficult sample; training a target detection network for the second time through a difficult sample; acquiring a ground disaster remote sensing image to be classified; and classifying the ground disaster remote sensing images to be classified through the ground disaster detection model after secondary training to obtain the ground disaster remote sensing intelligent recognition result.

title_en: Storm surge water increasing quick forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorology, in particular to a storm surge water increasing rapid forecasting method. The method comprises the following steps: collecting historical observation storm surge data and hydrologic data; carrying out data cleaning on the hydrologic data to generate storm weather basic data; performing difference correction processing on storm weather basic data to generate storm tide correction data; trend analysis is carried out on storm surge correction data, and first class of processing data is generated; establishing a direct empirical relation of a specific place for the first type of processing data by using a fitting curve empirical statistical method to obtain a statistical empirical formula; and establishing a simple prediction model according to the statistical empirical formula to generate the simple prediction model. The method improves storm tide prediction and analysis more comprehensively and accurately by integrating numerical simulation, data fusion, model optimization, data science and statistics, and is beneficial to improving the efficiency and level of disaster prevention and reduction work.

title_en: Evacuation simulation method for people carrying luggage
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evacuation simulation method for a crowd carrying luggage, which comprises the following steps of S1, dividing a scene, S2, distributing pedestrians, namely dividing grids in the scene, distributing pedestrians in the grids and numbering, namely distributing initial positions of the pedestrians and whether the pedestrians carry the luggage, S3, calculating the force born by each pedestrian in the scene, determining the expected direction of the pedestrians, namely, the force comprises self-driving acting force D, acting force between the pedestrians and interaction force of the pedestrians and an environment boundary, S4, calculating a probability matrix, determining the moving direction of the pedestrians, S5, updating the positions of the pedestrians according to the moving direction of each pedestrian, expected speed and other personnel conditions around the pedestrians, S6, stopping calculation if all the pedestrians pass through an outlet, and otherwise, returning to the step S3.

title_en: Ocean shallow geologic model display method based on virtual engine and three-dimensional modeling
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for displaying a marine superficial geologic model based on a virtual engine and three-dimensional modeling, which is applied to a marine superficial geologic model display system based on the virtual engine and the three-dimensional modeling, and comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring original data of marine geology through an acquisition module; s2, constructing a three-dimensional geological model through a model construction module, and mapping the three-dimensional geological model into a virtual engine; s3, the visualization module processes the original data of the marine geology and then puts the processed data into a virtual engine for visual display; s4, performing visual parameter adjustment on the virtual engine through an updating module; s5, the early warning module carries out disaster early warning on the adjusted visual parameter data; s6, the expansion module opens up a standardized interaction interface for the virtual engine. The invention utilizes the virtual reality technology, which can display the marine geological data in a vivid three-dimensional model form, so that users can observe and interact from different angles.
assignees: HAINAN KELI QIANFANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological engineering and geotechnical engineering collaborative collapse rolling stone protection simulation device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological engineering and geotechnical engineering, and particularly relates to a collapse and rolling stone protection simulation device for cooperation of ecological engineering and geotechnical engineering, which comprises the following components: the middle part of the main support is hinged with an adjustable support, a slope simulation plate structure is arranged on the main support, the upstream part of the slope simulation plate structure is arranged at the top end of the adjustable support, and the slope simulation plate structure is sequentially clamped with an ecological plate, a protective wall and a protective net along the downstream direction; an angle driving structure is arranged on one side of the slope simulation plate structure and is in transmission connection with the slope simulation plate structure; the main support top fixedly connected with rolling stone release structure, rolling stone release structure and slope analog plate structure's the vertical correspondence of upper reaches portion, rolling stone release structure and electromechanical connection. Through the structural arrangement, the device can effectively develop a test and help analyze the disaster reduction effect exerted by ecological engineering and geotechnical engineering in collapse prevention and control.
assignees: UNIV JIANGHAN;MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional dynamic numerical simulation method for spontaneous combustion of goaf coal during working face propulsion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional dynamic numerical simulation method for spontaneous combustion of goaf coal during working face propulsion, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a solution domain three-dimensional geometric coordinate system; s2, constructing a working face goaf three-dimensional geometric structure model based on an origin and a coordinate axis of a solution domain three-dimensional geometric coordinate system; s3, carrying out grid division on each region of the three-dimensional geometrical structure model of the working face goaf; s4, setting corresponding source items, boundary conditions and initial values of physical fields of grids in each region of the three-dimensional geometrical structure model of the working face goaf; s5, performing spontaneous combustion steady state or transient state numerical simulation of the goaf coal, and outputting a working face goaf physical field calculation result containing a solution domain three-dimensional geometrical coordinate position; s6, carrying out three-dimensional dynamic numerical simulation of spontaneous combustion of goaf coal under the condition of the thrust speed of the designated working face by adopting a goaf region physical field coordinate transformation mode. The invention can provide scientific guidance for mine disaster prevention and control caused by spontaneous combustion of goaf coal.

title_en: Early warning method, device and medium based on convolutional neural network geological disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for early warning of geological disasters based on a convolutional neural network, and relates to the technical field of geological engineering. The method comprises the following steps: step S1: based on the classification of the geological disasters, acquiring monitoring data of corresponding evaluation indexes, wherein the monitoring data comprises: real-time monitoring data and historical monitoring data; step S2: taking an evaluation index of historical monitoring data of the geological disaster as a training data set of the convolutional neural network model, and inputting the training data set into the convolutional neural network model; step S3: training a convolutional neural network model through a machine learning algorithm, and inputting real-time monitoring data into the trained convolutional neural network model to obtain a prediction result of the geological disaster; step S4: and responding and early warning the geological disaster based on the prediction result. The invention solves the problem of early warning of geological disasters with randomness, ambiguity and variability by utilizing the neural network technology, thereby providing efficient and timely information for early warning of the geological disasters.

title_en: Method and apparatus for evaluating operation continuity of high-speed train during fire
abstract_en: The present application provides a method and apparatus for evaluating the operation continuity of a high-speed train during a fire. The method comprises: applying, to a system functional block to be evaluated in a train operation simulation model, a simulated ignition source corresponding to a preset fire type; determining whether said system functional block can maintain a corresponding operation capability within a preset fire resistance index time period; if said system functional block cannot maintain the corresponding operation capability, determining whether a redundant configuration exists; if no redundant configuration exists, determining whether a train is equipped with a firefighting system; if the train is not equipped with a firefighting system, configuring the train to operate in a degraded mode, and determining whether the tractive force of the train can maintain normal traveling on a preset route during operation; if the tractive force cannot maintain normal operation of the train, determining that said system functional block does not have operation continuity during a fire. The present application can comprehensively and efficiently evaluate the capabilities of systems to maintain the intended functions when a fire occurs on a high-speed train, thereby achieving precise monitoring of the fire prevention capabilities of high-speed trains and enhancing the fire safety performance of high-speed trains.
assignees: CRRC CHANGCHUN RAILWAY VEHICLES CO LTD

title_en: System and method for simulating forest fire flame fault data under overhead line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for simulating forest fire flame fault data under an overhead line, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises an overhead power distribution line simulation module (1), a mountain fire simulation fault module (2) and a data acquisition module (3); according to the method, the bridge connection of the forest fire flame and the overhead line is simulated, the parameter change in the forest fire flame fault can be measured, so that the discharge condition of the flame in contact with the line is observed, basic data are provided for early warning of the forest fire accident under the overhead distribution line and judging of the accident cause after disaster, the acquisition of test data by the method is independent of the external environment, and the method is not limited by factors such as outdoor sites and weather causes, and a measuring system of the forest fire flame fault basic data under the 10kV overhead line can be preferably built and measured.

title_en: Structural surface identification method based on high-resolution SAR image under snow covered condition
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent interpretation of remote sensing images and monitoring and crossing of mining area disasters, and discloses a method for identifying a structural surface under a snow covering condition based on a high-resolution SAR image; comprising the following steps: collecting a high-resolution airborne SAR image and a high-resolution airborne optical image before snow is covered on a strip mine side slope; registering, cutting and cleaning the high-resolution airborne SAR image and the high-resolution airborne optical image to obtain an SAR-optical image data set; establishing a C-HR-GAN model, wherein the C-HR-GAN model comprises an optical image generation network, an optical image discrimination network and a total loss function; inputting the SAR-optical image data set into a C-HR-GAN model for training, and obtaining the C-HR-GAN model with the minimum loss; and (3) inputting the SAR image after snow covering into a C-HR-GAN model with minimum loss, outputting an optical image, performing image quality evaluation on the optical image, and identifying structural surface information.

title_en: Earthquake resistance identification method based on seismic disaster risk refined evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake resistance identification method based on seismic disaster risk refined evaluation, and relates to the technical field of seismic disaster data processing. The earthquake-resistant performance identification method for the seismic disaster risk refined evaluation comprises the following steps: data processing; mapping an image; constructing an earthquake resistance evaluation model; and (5) determining the stress distribution range. According to the method, the earthquake data in the preset area are collected and processed, meanwhile, the underground structure information in the preset area in the earthquake mapping oscillogram is obtained by utilizing the earthquake refraction waves and is subjected to image mapping, then an earthquake resistance evaluation model is built by combining with the earthquake wave propagation characteristics and is subjected to earthquake simulation evaluation, finally, the stress distribution range is determined by combining with the result of the earthquake simulation evaluation, and corresponding risk prevention and control measures are formulated according to the risk control target, so that the effect of improving the risk evaluation efficiency of the earthquake disasters is achieved, and the problem of long consumption in the risk evaluation of the earthquake disasters in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Grounding device for earthwork foundation construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of grounding devices, in particular to a grounding device for earth foundation construction, which comprises a lightning rod, wherein the bottom of the lightning rod is fixedly connected with the top of a fixed table, the top of the fixed table is fixedly connected with the bottom of a junction box, the bottom of the junction box is fixedly connected with the top of a converter, the bottom of the converter is fixedly connected with the top of a ground drilling column, a fixed drill bit is buried in the ground, so that the platform body can be placed above the ground, most of the grounding device can be buried in the ground, the lightning is conveniently guided, the physical health of people is effectively protected, the physical health of people is prevented from being damaged, electric equipment is connected with the ground through the lightning rod, the electric equipment is prevented from being shocked, the metal ball at the top can play a role of a lightning rod, the electric equipment is effectively protected from being influenced by lightning disasters, and the life safety of people is further protected.
assignees: ANHUI GOUZHU CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Fire test device for bifurcation tunnel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire test device for a bifurcation tunnel, which comprises an air supply device, a tunnel model, a simulated fire source and an environment information acquisition module, wherein the air supply device is used for supplying fire to the bifurcation tunnel; the air supply device is arranged at the end part of the tunnel model and is used for providing axial air flow into the tunnel model; the tunnel model comprises a pre-diversion tunnel section, a gradual change tunnel section, a main tunnel section and a ramp section, wherein the tail end of the pre-diversion tunnel section is connected with the small opening end of the gradual change tunnel section, and the large opening end of the gradual change tunnel section is divided into two outlets; one of the outlets is connected with the front end of the main tunnel section, and the other outlet is connected with the front end of the ramp section; the simulated fire source is arranged at a preset position in the tunnel model and is used for simulating the fire source when a fire disaster occurs in the real bifurcation tunnel; the environment information acquisition module is used for acquiring flue gas temperature data and longitudinal wind speed data in the tunnel model; the utility model realizes the ventilation and smoke discharge experiment for simulating the fire accident of the branched tunnel with lower cost, and overcomes the defects of high cost and inaccurate full-size experiment.
assignees: HANGZHOU TRAFFIC ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Early warning device for geological disaster monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an early warning device for geological disaster monitoring, which comprises a supporting rod and a radar detector arranged at the top of the supporting rod, wherein an electric box for supplying power to the radar detector is fixedly connected to the front surface of the supporting rod, an infrared camera is arranged at the position, close to the radar detector, of the front surface of the supporting rod, a positioning mechanism for fixing the supporting rod is arranged at the bottom of the supporting rod, the positioning mechanism comprises a limiting plate sleeved on the outer wall of the supporting rod and a positioning column arranged at the bottom of the limiting plate, an earth-boring nail for fixing the device is fixedly connected to the bottom of the positioning column, and a locking group for enhancing the stability of the positioning column is arranged at the top of the positioning column. According to the utility model, the early warning device for geological disaster monitoring is combined with the positioning mechanism, and the positioning column and the ground drilling nails are arranged, so that the device can be stably and firmly placed, the device can be conveniently installed and fixed, the positioning column and the ground drilling nails can be safely and stably placed due to the arrangement of the locking group, and the device is convenient to adjust in time.
assignees: SHANXI NO 8 GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster treatment slope support anchor rod reinforcing combination device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster treatment slope support anchor rod reinforcing combination device, which comprises a slope earthwork, wherein a reinforcing mesh is arranged above the slope earthwork, a fixing part is arranged above the reinforcing mesh, and an anchoring part is arranged below the fixing part; the anchoring part comprises an inserted link, the surface of the inserted link is spliced with the earthwork of the side slope, a supporting rod is arranged on the inner wall of the inserted link, the outer side surface of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the inserted link, a limiting ring is arranged on the inner side surface of the supporting rod, and the outer side surface of the limiting ring is fixedly connected with the inner side surface of the supporting rod; the surface of the inserted link is provided with a segment, and the inner wall of the segment is fixedly connected with the surface of the inserted link. According to the utility model, the inserted bar is drilled into the soil of the side slope, the segments and the plugs are driven to be synchronously inserted into the soil of the side slope, the push rod is inserted into the inserted bar, and the fixing rod is pushed to be drilled into the soil of the side slope for anchoring, so that the anchoring strength of the device can be improved, and the stability of the device can be improved.
assignees: HUNAN XINGGUI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: ECMO (electrochemical mechanical vapor deposition) pre-charging method, ECMO nursing equipment and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an ECMO pre-charging method, ECMO nursing equipment and application thereof, wherein an ECMO pre-charging and related emergency response mechanism is configured by combining an ECMO host and the ECMO equipment, and ECMO pre-charging teaching simulation audios and videos corresponding to the pre-charging teaching scheme are built through a virtual machine and stored in a MYSQL database; meanwhile, emergency response measures corresponding to different ECMO emergency types are constructed and stored in an ECMO emergency database. Subsequent nursing staff can carry out touch screen operation through ECMO equipment, send ECMO to the ECMO host computer and precharge teaching request or ECMO emergent request to this carries out precharge simulation teaching or emergency treatment, can let the nurse directly precharge study on equipment, saves medical resource and time, cost, adopts emergent mechanism, can match corresponding emergent control data from the emergent database of CMO, and the direct emergent participation improves emergent treatment efficiency greatly.
assignees: SIR RUN RUN SHAW HOSPITAL ZHEJIANG UNIV SCHOOL OF MEDICINE

title_en: Tunnel rescue training facility and training method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel rescue training facility and a method, wherein the tunnel rescue training facility comprises: air quality monitoring devices, ventilation exhaust apparatus and tunnel model, wherein: the tunnel model is the strip, and the tunnel model has a hole body and two entrance to a cave, and two entrance to a cave are established respectively at the both ends of hole body, and the side of hole body is equipped with a plurality of entrances and the top of hole body is equipped with a plurality of filling openings, and air quality monitoring device, ventilation exhaust apparatus set up in the inside of tunnel model. The tunnel rescue training method is characterized in that a tunnel rescue training facility is utilized for training, obstacles are artificially arranged in and around a tunnel model according to training requirements, or artificial damage is carried out, and tunnel accident disaster fields are customized, wherein the tunnel accident disaster fields comprise collapse disaster fields, debris flow disaster fields, road damage disaster fields, fire disaster fields and heavy vehicle accident disaster fields; training personnel clean and repair the tunnel accident disaster field, and restore the tunnel model to a normal state.

title_en: Transparent soil model test method for simulating dynamic mechanical environment of reservoir bank slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide hazard prevention and control, and discloses a transparent soil model test method for simulating a dynamic mechanical environment of a reservoir bank slope, which comprises the following steps: step 1, designing a transparent model box; step 2, selecting a transparent soil material, wherein the transparent soil material is formed by mixing transparent aggregate and pore fluid; step 3, adjusting the transparency of the transparent aggregate and pore fluid mixture based on an Abbe refractometer; step 4, opening laser, and determining a laser section by using an industrial camera; step 5, simulating the elevation of the water level of the warehouse and rainfall based on the peristaltic pump and the water suction pump; and 6, simulating earthquake working conditions based on the independently developed vibrating table equipment. The transparent soil model test method for simulating the dynamic mechanical environment of the reservoir side slope provided by the invention further enriches the framework of geotechnical engineering mechanism research, and provides technical support and reference basis for reservoir side slope instability prevention and landslide disaster early warning.
assignees: WUHAN CAMPUS OF YANGTZE UNIV;SICHUAN YANJIANG PANNING EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Satellite-ground precipitation fusion method and system with consideration of dry-wet distribution and strong precipitation landing area
abstract_en: The invention provides a satellite-ground precipitation fusion method and system with the advantages of both dry and wet distribution and strong precipitation landing areas, and relates to the field of precipitation quantitative simulation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring satellite inversion of a preset river basin, observing rainfall information, geography and weather information of a surface rainfall station, and matching space-time scales of the information; constructing an RF satellite-ground precipitation fusion model, and simulating to obtain satellite-ground precipitation fusion space distribution; screening few samples with rain or without rain, performing oversampling to generate new samples, constructing an AdaBoost precipitation dry-wet distribution identification model, and simulating to obtain precipitation dry-wet distribution; screening a few samples of strong precipitation, performing oversampling to generate new samples, constructing an AdaBoost-RF strong precipitation landing zone identification model, and simulating to obtain precipitation landing zone distribution; the three distributions are coupled to obtain satellite-ground precipitation fusion spatial distribution which gives consideration to both dry-wet distribution and strong precipitation landing areas, so that the accuracy of precipitation fusion information is improved, and effective data support is provided for disaster prevention, disaster reduction and other aspects.

title_en: Urban underground three-dimensional space flood simulation method, product, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a product, a medium and equipment for simulating urban underground three-dimensional space flooding, and relates to the field of digital water conservancy construction. Firstly, acquiring real size and coordinate data of an underground three-dimensional space through a three-dimensional space observation device, establishing a three-dimensional model, and confirming a calculation domain of model simulation; performing grid division on a calculation domain according to the simulation calculation requirement; modifying the inlet size of the three-dimensional model according to the flood prevention facility shapes and sizes of different inlets of the underground three-dimensional space after the occurrence of the flood disasters; inputting the real-time flood flow velocity water level of the inlet as a boundary condition of the three-dimensional model into a computational fluid dynamics model by a custom function method; performing underground three-dimensional space computational fluid dynamics simulation by combining the multiphase flow model to obtain a simulation calculation result; and extracting flow velocity and water level space-time change information of each position point in the underground three-dimensional space and accurate information of the flood vortex backflow area according to the simulation calculation result, and providing accurate reference basis for safe evacuation of personnel and materials.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic fire disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic fire early-warning method and a system, which relate to the technical field of fire early-warning and comprise the following steps: collecting operation parameters of the photovoltaic panel; the operation parameters of the photovoltaic panel are input into a fire disaster early warning model to predict fire disaster risk degree; pre-training an image recognition model through a convolutional neural network; acquiring a field image of the photovoltaic panel in real time, and inputting the field image into an image recognition model; performing target detection on the live image acquired in real time; combining the fire risk degree prediction result with target detection, and taking targeted measures. According to the invention, by utilizing the sensor monitoring and image recognition technology, the accurate prediction of the fire risk degree is realized by collecting the operation parameters of the photovoltaic panel and inputting the fire early-warning model, meanwhile, the on-site image is collected in real time and the target detection is carried out through the pre-trained image recognition model, so that the fire characteristics are recognized, the accuracy and the response speed of the fire early-warning are improved, and the safe and stable operation of the photovoltaic power generation system is ensured.

title_en: Digital fire-fighting temperature-vision alarm linkage controller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital fire-fighting temperature-vision alarm linkage controller, which comprises a controller body, a software unit and a hardware unit, wherein the controller body is provided with a control unit; according to the invention, the fire disaster distinguishing module is additionally arranged to analyze and distinguish abnormal signals, so that false alarm signals and fire disaster signals are distinguished, the false alarm rate is effectively reduced, and the reliability of the device is improved; according to the invention, three-dimensional visualization of fire conditions is realized by using a building information simulation technology, the problem that fire conditions cannot be clearly displayed by fire video information is solved, and rescue workers can better rescue and deploy; according to the fire grading system, the fire grading module is utilized to grade the fire, then a corresponding fire treatment plan is executed, and specific fire-fighting equipment and alarm equipment are started, so that excessive economic loss and resource waste are avoided; the electric control baffle is designed on the controller body, the defects of the existing mechanical lock door are overcome, and the baffle can be opened to different degrees according to the instruction authority, so that the switch panel can be conveniently operated by personnel with different authorities.

title_en: Ocean internal wave extraction method, system and program product for complex environment background
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ocean internal wave extraction, and particularly discloses an ocean internal wave extraction method, an ocean internal wave extraction system and a program product for a complex environment background, which are used for constructing a false color image by preprocessing collected polarized SAR image data and then utilizing SAR data of different polarized channels, and adding image information representing internal wave characteristics, and training and testing an internal wave automatic extraction network which is fused with a space-time attention mechanism and a U-Net network and adopts a multi-scale loss function by using a false color image, so that the automatic extraction of the wave crest lines in the ocean is realized by using the ocean internal wave extraction network. The invention can greatly improve the efficiency of ocean internal wave remote sensing detection, realize high-efficiency real-time ocean internal wave detection, overcome the defects of insufficient identification accuracy and stability of the traditional single-channel SAR internal wave detection method, widen the application space of the SAR technology in ocean internal wave monitoring, and is beneficial to ocean disaster prevention and reduction and guarantee of submarine underwater navigation safety.

title_en: Industrial Internet of things management system and method for express logistics transportation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial Internet of things management system and method for express logistics transportation, which relate to the technical field of logistics management, and the system and the method are characterized in that sensors and edge computing equipment are deployed at logistics nodes, data are collected and processed in real time, and a Kalman filter, a DBSCAN algorithm and discrete wavelet transformation are utilized for carrying out data smoothing, anomaly detection and compression, so that the data quality and the transmission efficiency are remarkably improved; the real-time data, the historical data and the external data uploaded by the edge computing equipment are fused by a time stamp alignment and weighted average method, and a Kalman filter is adopted to improve the data precision; creating a digital twin model, reflecting the operation condition in real time, carrying out data analysis and anomaly detection by using a Kalman filter, carrying out logistics operation and emergency scene simulation in a digital twin environment, carrying out path optimization and resource scheduling by using a dynamic programming algorithm and a linear programming algorithm, and improving logistics operation efficiency and emergency response capability.
assignees: BEIJING XINPING LOGISTICS CO LTD;BEIJING KAIKUO LOGISTICS CO LTD

title_en: Well-land linkage disaster control method for rock burst and high-gas composite disaster mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a well-land linkage disaster control method for rock burst and high-gas composite disaster mines, which comprises the steps of determining a staged fracturing well arrangement scheme of a ground horizontal well; then, estimating the effective fracturing range of the ground fracturing by adopting the microseism frequency density index; constructing a ground fracturing stope numerical model by adopting software, and parametrizing to simulate and obtain the horizontal fracture area range and the vertical fracture zone development height of the ground fracturing stope after exploitation; determining the level and horizontal range of the high-level gas drainage holes, and further formulating a high-level gas drainage hole arrangement scheme; and finally, carrying out supplementary pressure relief measures on the areas with insufficient fracturing, and simultaneously improving a gas drainage hole arrangement scheme according to actual gas drainage concentration and the like, so that the roof strata above the working surface can be subjected to large-range pressure relief damage, and simultaneously, the produced roof cracks can provide a better flow channel for high-level gas drainage, the number and construction quantity of the high-level gas drainage holes are reduced, and the comprehensive disaster-causing capacity and effect of rock burst and high-gas composite disaster mines are improved.

title_en: Intelligent fire alarm method and device based on online simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical safety field of fire control, in particular to an intelligent fire control alarm method and device based on online simulation, and the method comprises the following steps: s1, building a detailed building simulation model; s2, deploying an Internet of things sensor in a building; s3, starting a fire dynamics simulation system; s4, analyzing the influence of fire on the environment and personnel; s5, formulating a targeted evacuation scheme; s6, conveying evacuation instructions and information to personnel; s7, monitoring an evacuation process in real time; s8, evaluating the evacuation process and extracting the training. Compared with the prior art, the evacuation route planning method and the evacuation route planning device can accurately plan the evacuation route, avoid dangerous areas and greatly improve the speed and safety of evacuation.

title_en: Three-dimensional protection system based on laser radar and image recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional protection system based on laser radar and image recognition, which adopts the technical means of laser radar detection equipment and algorithm to construct a segmentation model and a construction operation virtual protection scene to recognize line and power equipment information and collect the line and power equipment information; processing and analyzing the acquired line and power equipment information by adopting a machine learning and image recognition artificial intelligence technology, establishing a three-dimensional protection platform by adopting cloud computing and an internet of things technology, integrating and analyzing the acquired various data, and realizing real-time monitoring of the circuit and the power equipment; 3D simulation is carried out on the distribution of the power equipment by adopting an image recognition artificial intelligence technology and artificial recognition, so that stereoscopic representation is realized, and the circuit and equipment distribution of the area are presented in a three-dimensional form based on the visual display data of the power equipment and the possibility of failure disaster; the virtual protection scene of construction operation is utilized for generating fault conditions on lines and equipment in the areas, the rescue equipment starts rescue, and the three-dimensional form is presented through the virtual protection scene.
assignees: SONGYUAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for monitoring underground power distribution line using deep learning model
title_ko: 딥러닝 모델로 전력구 내 시공간적 온도 분포 변화를 학습하여 복수 회선의 전력케이블 각각의 구간별 온도변화를 예측하는 방법 및 이를 이용한 배전선로 감시시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a deep learning model capable of predicting a future temperature change by section in real time for each power cable in a power tunnel. Provided is a method for predicting a temperature change by section in each power cable of a plurality of lines by learning a spatiotemporal temperature distribution change in a power tunnel with a deep learning model, which comprises: a first process of collecting heat generation data measured in real time; a second process of generating a two-dimensional matrix of MxN in which a temperature distribution by section for each power cable of each line is expressed as a two-dimensional plane to create two-dimensional matrix frames arranged in time series; a third process of training a ConvLSTM model; and a fourth process of passing the two-dimensional matrix frames through the ConvLSTM model to generate prediction data at a specific time point after the current time point as a two-dimensional output matrix frame of MxN to output the same.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 딥러닝 모델로 전력구 내 시공간적 온도 분포 변화를 학습하여 복수 회선의 전력케이블 각각의 구간별 온도변화를 예측하는 방법 및 이를 이용한 배전선로 감시시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게로는, 딥러닝 모델을 포함하는 정보시스템이, 지하 전력구에 복수 회선의 전력케이블이 설치된 지중 배전선로의 각 회선의 전력케이블 각각에서 실시간으로 수집되는 구간별 발열 정보를 포함하는 빅데이터를 시공간적으로 학습하여, 각 회선의 전력케이블 각각에 대한 구간별 발열 온도변화와 이상 온도 발생 가능성을 예측하는 방법 및 이를 이용한 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에서는, 각 회선의 전력케이블 각각의 표피에서 발생하는 구간별 평균 발열 온도를 실시간으로 측정한 발열 데이터를 일정 시간 간격으로 수집하여 이를 지하 전력구 전체의 구간별 온도 분포가 2차원 평면으로 표현된 2차원 행렬 프레임들을 시계열적으로 만들고, 이를 ConvLSTM 모델에 통과시켜 학습시킨 후 현재 시점 이후 특정 시점의 예측데이터를 생성해 낼 수 있는 딥러닝 모델과 이를 이용하는 정보시스템을 제공한다. 따라서, 전력구 내에서 각 구간별 및 회선별로 예상되는 향후 온도변화를 실시간으로 예측할 수 있기 때문에 지하 배전선로의 이상 발열 상황을 사전에 탐지할 수 있고 이를 통하여 지하 배전선로에서 발생할 수 있는 재난 및 사고 징후를 미리 파악하여 재난이나 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Dynamic disaster prevention and control method and system for rock burst of steeply inclined coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic disaster prevention and control method and a system for rock burst of a steeply inclined coal seam, which relate to the field of coal mine rock burst prevention and control and comprise the steps of measuring physical and mechanical parameters of each coal stratum of a mine, and establishing a three-dimensional numerical model of the mine; and (3) carrying out simulation experiments according to fixed excavation distances and excavation steps by using a mine three-dimensional numerical model, recording the energy accumulation intensity of coal on the working surface before the roof on different layers is broken in the excavation process of the working surface, the energy release intensity during the breaking and the stress concentration degree of a bottom plate in the excavation process of the working surface, further determining the layer position, the layer number, the initial breaking position and the periodic breaking position of a target fracturing layer, carrying out fracturing operation, determining the space position of stress concentration, and carrying out drilling blasting pressure relief operation. According to the invention, through the underground and uphole cooperative treatment, the comprehensive and thorough transformation of the clamping structure of the steeply inclined coal seam is realized, the rock burst control effect of mining of the steeply inclined coal seam is improved, and the safety mining of the steeply inclined coal seam is ensured.

title_en: Emergency evacuation lighting lamp with detection function and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation lighting lamp with a detection function and a detection method thereof, wherein the emergency evacuation lighting lamp comprises an MCU (micro control Unit), a detection module, a lighting module and a communication module; the MCU, the detection module, the illumination module and the communication module are integrally arranged on the emergency evacuation illuminating lamp; the detection module is used for detecting accident vehicle position information and storing, and detecting flooding information and storing; the communication module is used for remotely transmitting accident vehicle position information and flooding information to the control center according to the MCU instruction; the illumination module is used for driving and controlling illumination of the emergency illumination lamp and providing emergency evacuation illumination and emergency safety illumination. The detection module arranged on the emergency lighting lamp is used for detecting and storing the accident vehicle position information and the flooding information, so that the functionality and the practicability of the fire emergency lighting lamp are improved, the control center analyzes the data information to generate a numerical twin virtual reality scene, a relevant department can know the flooding condition in a tunnel in time, and effective countermeasures are taken to prevent urban flooding disasters.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;XIJIAO HENGSHENG CHENGDU EMERGENCY TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for simulating sudden surge disaster-causing test of longitudinal slope shield tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test device and a simulation test method for disaster caused by sudden surges of a longitudinal slope shield tunnel. The invention can simulate square gushing mouth and circular gushing mouth through the annular ring component formed by the square annular ring and the circular annular ring, and the square annular ring and the circular annular ring are respectively provided with the square annular stretching rod and the circular annular stretching rod to simulate the change of the gushing mouth in actual working conditions, so that gradual change of the gushing mouth, namely adjustable gushing mouth size and position, can be realized in test, and information such as gushing mouth size and position can be quickly and accurately read.

title_en: Landslide hazard early warning method, equipment and storage medium based on machine learning
abstract_en: The landslide hazard early warning method, the device and the storage medium based on machine learning are characterized in that firstly, geological information and rainfall information of a target area are acquired, then the geological information and the rainfall information are input into a landslide hazard early warning model to obtain landslide hazard results, a boosting integration algorithm is adopted, parallel training of a plurality of learners of the same type is carried out by an integrated homogeneous machine learning algorithm, key super parameters in the boosting integration algorithm are calculated by a Bayesian optimization method based on a tree structure, the super parameters are not searched in a large range by adopting a method such as random search or network search, the effect of the last iteration is evaluated in the process of each iteration in a mode of maximizing probability expected values, the next selection interval is inferred, and therefore the effect of rapid convergence is achieved, and the prediction precision and accuracy are improved. Meanwhile, the algorithm performance and generalization capability are stronger, so that the accuracy of landslide disaster early warning is improved.

title_en: Regional emergency evacuation capability assessment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional emergency evacuation capability assessment system in the field of people stream simulation, which comprises an urban region importing module, a pedestrian generation module, an evacuation simulation module, pedestrian evacuation logic and an evacuation performance statistics module; the urban area importing module is used for importing urban area model drawings, the pedestrian generating module is used for generating personnel and building personnel quantity in an area and building exit personnel generation time distribution, the evacuation simulating module is used for setting emergency events and managing the whole evacuation simulating process, and the pedestrian logic module is provided with normal logic, message sensing logic, tension rising logic and path finding logic and simulates the behavior logic of pedestrians in emergency evacuation. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the message transmission process in emergency evacuation can be simulated, so that the simulated scene is restored.

title_en: Multi-disaster coupling test system for offshore engineering structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-disaster coupling test system of an offshore engineering structure, which comprises a boundary layer wind tunnel and a wave water trough, wherein the boundary layer wind tunnel is a direct-current wind tunnel, the boundary layer wind tunnel comprises a test section and a lifting device, the wave water trough comprises a trough body and a wave water trough device, the wave water trough device forms simulated waves or simulated ocean currents in the trough body, a test area is arranged in the trough body, the test section is erected above the test area in a lifting manner through the lifting device, the bottom of the test section is a communication window, a flexible sealing film is arranged at the communication window, the lower end of a piece to be tested is arranged in the test area, and the lifting device adjusts the height of the test section so that the upper end of the piece to be tested stretches into the test section from the communication window and closes the communication window through the flexible sealing film. The application provides a multi-disaster coupling test system for ensuring high-fidelity simulation of a marine complex load environment.

title_en: Electric power natural disaster multi-scene emergency drilling system and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power natural disaster multi-scene emergency exercise system and a construction method thereof, and relates to the technical field of electric power accident emergency exercise; constructing an ideal equipment model for simulating the perception of a disaster field of the corresponding power equipment according to the equipment fault data; constructing a disaster model for simulating different disaster types encountered by the ideal equipment model according to the ideal equipment model; obtaining a risk equipment model according to the ideal equipment model and the disaster model; constructing an emergency drilling model for simulating the emergency drilling process of the power equipment according to the historical disaster data; and obtaining the multi-scene electric power natural disaster emergency exercise system according to the risk equipment model and the emergency exercise model. According to the invention, the emergency drilling process can be simulated by the accident phenomenon of the electric power equipment under the natural disasters of multiple scenes, and the combination of the emergency drilling and equipment operation under different disaster scenes is realized.
assignees: GUILIN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: System disaster recovery test method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system disaster recovery testing method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product. The invention relates to the technical field of data disaster recovery. The method comprises the following steps: determining a fault period of the system; extracting analog data written in the fault period from at least one analog database respectively; wherein the simulation database corresponds to the subsystems one by one; sequencing the extracted simulation data for each simulation database to obtain sequenced simulation data; traversing the time interval of two adjacent analog data in the ordered analog data; determining the time interval which is larger than the set interval in the traversed time intervals of the adjacent simulation data as a candidate time interval, and obtaining a plurality of candidate time intervals; and determining disaster recovery test results of the subsystems from the plurality of candidate time intervals. The disaster recovery test results of all subsystems in the system can be accurately and rapidly determined, so that the disaster recovery capacity of the service can be accurately measured.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORP;CCB FINTECH CO LTD

title_en: Quick response method and system for urban rainwater regulation and storage tank emergency dispatch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick response method and a quick response system for emergency dispatch of an urban rainwater storage tank, wherein the quick response method comprises the following steps: according to the invention, the rainfall waterlogging and the scheduling process of the regulating reservoir are accurately simulated and calculated through the hydrologic hydrodynamic model, and then the relation among rainfall parameters, the running rule of the regulating reservoir and the scheduling target is directly established by using the self-adaptive machine learning model based on the simulation calculation result, so that the time-consuming numerical model is replaced to be used as an optimization solver to solve in an optimization algorithm, and the time-consuming numerical model is prevented from being repeatedly called in the optimization process, thereby improving the solving efficiency. On the premise of ensuring the calculation accuracy, the invention greatly shortens the emergency dispatching response time, strives for a large amount of lead time for the dispatching decision of the rainwater regulation and storage pool, and has important reference value for the formulation of urban emergency response strategies.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for predicting failure rate of power grid equipment in typhoon weather
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for predicting the failure rate of power grid equipment in typhoon weather, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a cable failure probability model according to wind speed by using historical cable information and a pre-established typhoon model; constructing a failure probability model of the high-voltage switch cabinet considering precipitation according to historical high-voltage switch cabinet information and a pre-established rainfall model; constructing a power grid equipment failure rate prediction model by using a deep learning mild quantitative gradient elevator algorithm, a cable failure probability model and a high-voltage switch cabinet failure probability model, and training by using regional equipment historical operation information; and taking the current operation information of the regional equipment as the input of the trained power grid equipment failure rate prediction model, and outputting a power grid equipment failure rate prediction result. The application has the beneficial effects that: the prediction accuracy and the effectiveness of the final power grid equipment failure rate prediction model are improved, operators can conveniently and timely make an emergency response plan, and the typhoon disaster prevention capability of the power system is improved.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Method and system for predicting debris flow disaster chain
abstract_en: According to the method and the system for predicting the debris flow disaster chain, the first initial debris flow disaster data and the derivative debris flow disaster data which are correctly derived from the first initial debris flow disaster data are used for training the capability of the debris flow disaster data processing thread for derivation, so that the performance of the debris flow disaster data processing thread is improved through the derivative instruction in advance. Under the premise, the second initial debris flow disaster data, the derivative debris flow disaster data which is obtained by the derivative of the second initial debris flow disaster data and is required to be verified, and the derivative description type are used for training the capability of the debris flow disaster data processing thread to carry out verification instructions, so that the original debris flow disaster data processing thread is optimized based on the verification instructions on the premise of learning and projecting the learned characteristics of the debris flow disaster data processing thread, and the accuracy and reliability of the prediction of the debris flow disaster chain can be ensured.

title_en: Rainfall interpolation algorithm based on effective angle of adjacent station to interpolation point
abstract_en: The invention provides a rainfall interpolation algorithm based on an effective angle of an adjacent station to an interpolation point, and belongs to the field of hydrological rainfall interpolation calculation. Firstly, constructing a Thiessen polygon by using all rainfall stations and interpolation points, and recording point pairs corresponding to each side of the Thiessen polygon; the point pairs contain interpolation points, namely the minimum Thiessen polygon of the interpolation points and related rainfall stations; then, connecting the interpolation points with related rainfall stations to obtain a distance; connecting the interpolation points with the minimum Thiessen polygon vertexes to obtain the area of the triangle corresponding to each side; and finally, dividing the area by the inverse distance square to obtain a combined weight, and calculating the interpolation rainfall. Effective angles for adjacent rain stations to the interpolation point. The method overcomes the defects of a simple Thiessen polygon area weight method and a simple inverse distance square weight method, improves the accuracy of face rainfall interpolation calculation, and provides technical support for the fields of hydrologic process simulation, flood disaster prevention and the like.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Tunnel fire disaster intelligent prediction method and system based on external smoke images
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent prediction method and system for tunnel fire based on external smoke images, which can shoot external smoke images overflowing outwards from openings at each end of a tunnel in a safe area outside the tunnel through a camera, transmit the external smoke images to a server after being received by a data acquisition module, then divide, reduce noise, gray scale and the like on the images by the server, finally manufacture the processed images into training data sets and input the training data sets into a depth learning algorithm which can process time sequence logic signals, so that the fire source power and the fire source position in the tunnel can be predicted in real time according to the images of the external smoke. The invention does not depend on any sensor arranged in the tunnel, can collect data in a safe area outside the tunnel and accurately predict the development condition of the fire in the tunnel.

title_en: ISSA-CNN-based rock burst intensity level prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster prediction, in particular to a ISSA-CNN-based rock burst intensity level prediction method. Firstly, selecting rock burst intensity level prediction index data, performing data cleaning by using an isolated forest method (iForest) and a chained multiple interpolation Method (MICE) to obtain a complete data set, and performing data set division based on ten-fold cross validation; then, an initial prediction model framework is established, a sparrow search algorithm SSA is improved by using Lewy flight and tent chaotic mapping to obtain ISSA, and the super-parameters in the model are optimized by using the improved search algorithm; and finally, training a model, establishing a ISSA-CNN-based rock burst intensity level prediction model, and verifying the accuracy of the established model by using a test set. The rock burst intensity level prediction method combines the optimizing capability of the search algorithm and the feature extraction capability of deep learning, improves the rock burst intensity level prediction capability, and has great significance for preventing and controlling rock burst disasters in the mining process.

title_en: Method for oilfield on-site safety management inspection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oilfield development and discloses a method for oilfield site safety management and inspection, which comprises the steps of formulating an intelligent safety management system, an automatic safety response mechanism, implementing periodic safety exercise, an intelligent safety training platform, implementing safety risk assessment, developing an intelligent safety inspection system and implementing an intelligent safety early warning system. According to the intelligent safety management method, various safety indexes of the oilfield site can be monitored in real time by combining an advanced sensor technology and data analysis capability, and meanwhile, potential safety risks can be rapidly and accurately identified by means of an artificial intelligent algorithm, so that the efficiency and accuracy of safety management are improved, and meanwhile, the intelligent safety management means provided by the invention can realize automatic identification and rapid response of safety events, so that the emergency response period is obviously shortened, and the life safety of site personnel is effectively guaranteed.
assignees: SICHUAN KUNLUN ANZHIHUAN ENTERPRISE MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Model loading device for simulating interaction of landslide body and control structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model loading device for simulating interaction of a landslide body and a control structure, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster model tests and comprises a model frame, a horizontal loading mechanism and a vertical loading mechanism, wherein the horizontal loading mechanism and the vertical loading mechanism are arranged on the model frame, a landslide body model is arranged in the model frame, and the landslide body model is positioned on one side of the horizontal loading mechanism. According to the invention, the landslide thrust is simulated through the horizontal loading mechanism, and the vertical loading mechanism is matched to apply vertical pressure at the same time, so that the landslide body is prevented from being raised and damaged in the forward pushing process, and the interaction process of the landslide body and the prevention structure is simulated, so that the interaction mechanism of the landslide body and the prevention structure and the effectiveness of different prevention structures are explored, and a test way is provided for the study of landslide prevention technology.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Simulation portable fire extinguisher
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fire-fighting teaching appliances, and discloses a simulated portable fire extinguisher which comprises a fixed plate, wherein a first mounting frame is fixedly connected to the lower part of the outer wall of the front end of the fixed plate, a first mounting hole is formed in the outer wall of the first mounting frame, round corners are formed in the outer walls of the upper end and the lower end of the fixed plate, and a second mounting frame is fixedly connected to the upper part of the outer wall of the front end of the fixed plate. According to the utility model, the simulation portable fire extinguisher is used for training and education, so that people can learn the correct fire extinguisher use skills, people can better understand how to correctly use the fire extinguisher for putting out fire when a fire disaster occurs through simulating the operation and use scene of the fire extinguisher, the fire extinguishing skills are improved, people can be familiar with the operation steps of the fire extinguisher and master the correct use method through using the simulation portable fire extinguisher for simulation training, the fire extinguishing skills are improved, and emergency preparation is enhanced.
assignees: SHAANXI BOLI YONGAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster Evacuation Training System with Augmented Reality
title_ko: 증강현실을 활용한 재난 대피 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster evacuation training system using an augmented reality, comprising: a beacon that identifies a location and a movement path of an evacuation trainee in real time to transmit the location and the movement path to a control unit; a disaster state reproduction unit that visualizes and displays a location of generation and spread of flames or toxic gases according to the occurrence of a disaster to the evacuation trainee; a damage detection sensor that detects damage to the evacuation trainee; a training terminal that provides a simulated disaster state using an augmented reality technology on a video image captured by a camera module; and the control unit that evaluates a scale of the damage based on the measured evacuation time and the number of occurrences of damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 피난 훈련자의 위치 및 이동 경로를 실시간으로 파악하여 관제부로 전송하는 비콘, 피난 훈련자에게 재난 발생에 따른 화염이나 유독 가스 발생 및 확산 위치를 시각화하여 표시하는 재난 상태 재현 유닛, 피난 훈련자의 피해 발생 여부를 감지하는 피해 감지 센서, 카메라 모듈을 통해 촬영된 영상 이미지 상에 증강현실 기술을 통해 재난 발생 상태를 모사하여 제공하는 훈련용 단말, 측정된 피난 소요 시간과 피해 발생 횟수를 기반으로 피해 발생 규모를 평가하는 관제부로 구성되는 증강현실을 활용한 재난 대피 훈련 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System Dynamics-Based Reservoir Prediction and Warning Service Method
title_ko: 시스템 다이내믹스 기반 저수지 예ㆍ경보 서비스 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a system dynamics-based reservoir prediction and warning service method comprising: a step (S10) for predicting a change in a low water storage capacity according to time; a step (S12) for performing a reservoir flood simulation; a step (S14) for determining whether a standard low water storage capacity is exceeded through a reservoir flood simulation result; a step (S16) for performing monitoring of a reservoir water level change when the standard low water storage capacity is not exceeded in the reservoir flood simulation result; a step (S18) for optimizing inputting and operating timing of an emergency discharge means through correlation analysis between the change in the low water storage capacity and the emergency discharge means; and a step (S20) for issuing a flood warning when the standard low water storage capacity is exceeded even though the emergency discharge is performed, and performing monitoring of the change in the low water storage capacity when the standard low water storage capacity is not exceeded. The present invention supports rapid response by providing a reservoir management entity with the emergency discharge means and operation timing depending on exceeding of the standard low water storage capacity through the prediction of changes in a reservoir water level when extreme rainfall occurs, which can lead to disaster from flooding, thereby effectively preventing reservoir collapse and minimizing damage from the reservoir collapse.

title_en: Evacuation scenario provision system in case of disaster based on user experience
title_ko: 사용자 경험 기반의 재난 발생 시의 피난 시나리오 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology capable of providing information on evacuation simulations of occupants and managers based on user experience (UX) in the event of a disaster and providing information in the event of actual evacuation. To this end, a system for providing an evacuation scenario in the event of a disaster based on user experience according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a first configuration for guiding a preview function for an evacuation path in the event of a disaster for each occupant and a point of attention on the path; a second configuration for allowing each occupant to perform a mission for a gamified evacuation method to proceed with a simulation; a third configuration for allowing the manager to check the actions of the occupants and check the correction and result thereof; and a fourth configuration for providing the occupants with a point to be noted and a point of attention on the path together according to the actions of other occupants in the event of evacuation.
abstract_ko: 재난 발생 시 사용자 경험(UX) 기반으로, 재실자 및 관리자의 피난 시뮬레이션에 대한 정보 제공 및 실 피난 시의 정보 제공이 가능한 기술로서, 상기 목적을 달성하기 위해 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 사용자 경험 기반의 재난 발생 시의 피난 시나리오 제공 시스템은, 각 재실자별 재난 발생 시의 피난 경로에 대한 미리 보기 기능 및 경로 상의 유의점에 대한 안내를 하는 제1 구성, 각 재실자들이 게이미피케이션화된 피난 방식에 대한 미션을 수행할 수 있도록 하여 시뮬레이션을 진행하도록 하는 제2 구성, 관리자가 상기의 재실자들의 액션을 확인하고, 이에 대한 수정 및 결과를 확인할 수 있도록 하는 제3 구성 및 재실자들에게 피난 시 다른 재실자들의 액션에 따라서 유의할 점 및 경로 상의 유의점을 함께 제공하는 제4 구성을 포함한다.

title_en: Method and system for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water treatment facility through simulation
title_ko: 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A method for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to a water treatment facility, according to one embodiment of the present invention, may efficiently recover from disaster damage to a water treatment facility when an actual disaster occurs, such as an earthquake, a flood, and a typhoon, by determining, through simulation, a recovery order for water treatment process facilities included in the water treatment facility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법은 시뮬레이션을 통해 수처리 시설에 포함된 수처리 공정 시설 각각에 대해 복구 순서를 결정하여, 지진, 홍수, 태풍과 같이 실제로 재난이 발생했을 경우, 수처리 시설에 대해 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법일 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster countermeasure support system and disaster countermeasure support method
abstract_en: To provide a disaster countermeasure support system and disaster countermeasure support method that plan cost-effective preparatory countermeasures by combining facility countermeasures and operational countermeasures that are at different positions on the time axis.SOLUTION: A disaster countermeasure support system includes: a facility countermeasure planning unit configured to plan facility countermeasures to be executed at normal times when a natural disaster has not yet occurred; and an operational countermeasure effect estimation unit configured to estimate, at the normal times, for multiple past natural disasters or natural disasters generated by simulation, effects of operational countermeasures to be executed before damage occurs that would be caused after the natural disasters occur. The facility countermeasure planning unit selects facility countermeasures to be actually executed from among the planned facility countermeasures based on the effects of the estimated operational countermeasures.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Multi-resolution data coupling urban flood automatic modeling method, device and equipment
