abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prediction, in particular to a multi-resolution data coupling automatic modeling method, device and equipment for urban flood, which comprises the steps of acquiring related data of surface water flow and soil water flow conditions of an area to be simulated, and obtaining a hydrologic product flow result of the area according to the data; the method comprises the steps of obtaining data such as river channel water depth, water flow direction and water flow friction resistance of a region to be simulated, calculating a two-dimensional hydrodynamic force converging result in hydrodynamic force converging according to the data, obtaining section area, section average flow, section total head and water flow of the region to be simulated along section main flow direction and quality source converging items of the region to be simulated, calculating a one-dimensional hydrodynamic force converging result according to the data, synthesizing the calculation results to obtain a two-dimensional simulation result and a one-dimensional simulation result, and simulating a flooding process of the region to be simulated according to the two simulation results. And carrying out flood disaster simulation on the urban area through an AUTO-SHEDS model, and effectively preventing the flood disaster.

title_en: Method and program product for automatically generating three-dimensional geological finite element model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a program product for automatically generating a three-dimensional geological finite element model, which are used for determining a horizontal reference plane based on the maximum height difference of the earth surface; determining a first grid size and a second grid size based on the shear wave speed, then comprehensively determining the grid number of the earth surface part and dividing hexahedral units; equally dividing the base portion into horizontal slices of the same height according to the first grid size and determining the grid size of the horizontal slices in combination with the modified minimum shear wave velocity; combining adjacent horizontal slices according to the mesh size and thickness requirements to obtain a final stratum division scheme, and then comprehensively determining the mesh number of the stratum and dividing the stratum into hexahedral units; and (3) comparing the three-dimensional centroid coordinates of each hexahedral unit with the original geological model, and setting the stratum category of each hexahedral unit. The invention greatly reduces the finite element modeling time and cost of the three-dimensional non-uniform field of the complex terrain, has high grid quality, and is beneficial to the application of the three-dimensional geological model in the aspects of earthquake disaster simulation and analysis.

title_en: Method for psychological intervention of children after disaster
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of psychological treatment, in particular to a method for psychological intervention of children after disaster, which comprises the following intervention steps: s1, a medical staff adopts psychological consultation for children to communicate and exchange, and inquires about the preference of the children; s2, aiming at the preference of children, the preference of the children is mainly cultivated, the mind feeling is expressed, and bad emotion is released; s3, introducing disasters to the children at intervals after the favorites of the children are cultured, knowing the disasters, observing and capturing facial micro-expressions of the children through a facial recognition system, and uploading and analyzing captured details. According to the application, through intervening and treating the psychology of the child, training the interest and hobbies of the child and regularly performing science popularization education on disasters of the child, the face recognition system is adopted to recognize the face of the child so as to check the response to the disasters in the current state of the child, help the child to walk out psychological shadows, and better help the child to get rid of fear psychology of the disasters.
assignees: THE 940TH HOSPITAL OF CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY JOINT SERVICE

title_en: Warning equipment for coping with stress fracture of anchor rod in rock wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warning device for coping with stress fracture of an anchor rod in a rock wall, which relates to the field of building construction warning devices and comprises a rod spiral main body, the surface of the rod spiral main body is connected with a fastening backing plate through threads, the top end of the rod spiral main body is fixedly connected with a drill bit, the surface of the rod spiral main body is connected with a positioning nut in a threaded mode, and the positioning nut is installed below the fastening base plate. The invention has the advantages that the triangular groove and the triangular limiting plate are pressed and clamped, so that the triangular groove and the triangular limiting plate can be rapidly spliced and matched, the stability is kept, and the potential danger cannot be found in time when the anchor rod is bent and deformed, thereby causing subsequent disasters.
assignees: SHANXI HUOER XIN HE COAL CO LTD

title_en: Ground collapse test device based on negative pressure regulation and control of cavity and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground collapse test device based on cavity negative pressure regulation and control and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, wherein the ground collapse test device comprises a ground collapse test device body, and the ground collapse test device body comprises a cavity simulation structure and a test device base, and has the advantages that: the pressure sensor can monitor the pressure change of the soil body of the top plate of the cavity in real time, which is helpful for in-depth understanding the action process of the negative pressure of the cavity on the soil body and the distribution condition of the stress in the soil body, and secondly, the displacement sensor can measure the displacement condition of the soil body of the top plate of the cavity by analyzing the pressure data, and can better reveal the occurrence mechanism of the ground collapse by simulating the negative pressure scene of the cavity and acquiring the pressure data and the displacement data of the soil body by regulating and controlling the negative pressure, which is very important for researching the deformation rule of the soil body and predicting the development trend of the ground collapse, thereby reducing the harm of the ground collapse to personnel and property.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 14TH BUREAU GROUP QINGDAO ENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Flight simulator simulation frame based on cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cloud computing application and simulation, and relates to a flight simulator simulation framework based on a cloud platform. According to the invention, the traditional basic simulation platform is split into the application end and the service end, the cloud deployment is combined to delegate the nonfunctional characteristic to the service end of the basic simulation platform, the usability, disaster recovery capability, safety characteristic, repairability and maintainability of the system are greatly improved, and the same overall performance is obtained by using fewer hardware resources, so that the space and energy are saved. The virtual cloud platform is used for solving the problems of application operation isolation and deployment integration, and simultaneously, automatically realizing load sharing of multiple physical machines and busy and idle interleaving of multiple virtual machines, so that the resource utilization rate is improved; the invention takes the virtual machine as granularity to package and manage the software and the running environment thereof, which is beneficial to system software maintenance, debugging test, disaster recovery and the like; the centralized and automatic management tool provided by the cloud platform can ensure stable and efficient operation of the service and reduce the complexity of system operation and maintenance.

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for pre-warning of forest disaster risk of property park
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for pre-warning the risk of a forest disaster in a property park. The method comprises the following steps: collecting the forest information of key areas in a property park to obtain the forest basic data; carrying out risk analysis according to the forest basic data, and predicting risk events of the forest in disasters; according to the forest basic data and the risk event, disaster prevention measures are simulated and analyzed, so that the occurrence of the risk event is reduced or avoided; and collecting forest disaster data under actual meteorological conditions, and correcting risk analysis and disaster prevention measure simulation analysis. The method realizes the digital management of the forest to prevent the risk of the forest in severe weather, adopts an information processing technology and an intelligent analysis method, belongs to the concrete embodiment of the digital application in the forest management of the property park, is favorable for precise prevention and precise planning, and improves the benefit of a large-scale property management unit on park management.
assignees: CHINA OVERSEAS PROPERTY MAN CO LTD

title_en: Desert flood disaster monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring desert flood disasters, relates to the technical field of monitoring of the desert flood disasters, and mainly aims to provide a high-precision high-sensitivity method for early warning and monitoring of the desert flood disasters. The main technical scheme of the invention is as follows: the desert flood disaster monitoring method comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a 3D-BOCT geometric model aiming at sand grains with different internal structural characteristics, and calculating a Streaming Potential Coupling Coefficient (SPCC) by using a finite element method to construct a streaming potential response database; s2, collecting a sand sample in a monitoring area to perform a dense sand column flowing potential experiment, and comparing an experimental result with a database result to obtain an internal structural characteristic parameter and zeta potential of the sample; s3, establishing a fine flowing potential database for the specific area sample through numerical simulation based on the parameters; s4, deploying the sensor to be below the desert Hong Debiao, monitoring the potential signal, and obtaining the real-time fluid flow through inversion analysis by comparing the monitoring value with a flowing potential database.

title_en: Power transmission channel strengthening method and system considering system toughness improvement
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for strengthening a power transmission channel by considering system toughness improvement, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power grid structure information, calculating the comprehensive importance of each channel in the power grid structure, and identifying and acquiring key channels; typhoon simulation data are acquired, a power transmission channel reinforcement model which is oriented to typhoon disaster toughness improvement and considers load shedding indexes is established, and an initial channel reinforcement scheme related to a key channel is generated; and calculating the power reachability index of the reinforced power grid structure, judging whether the current channel reinforcement scheme meets an expected value, if not, preferentially calculating the contribution value of the key channel to the power reachability index, selecting the channel with the largest contribution value for reinforcement until the expected value of the power reachability index is met, and if all the key channels are reinforced, based on the contribution degree of the remaining unreinforced channels to the power reachability index. Compared with the prior art, the invention can effectively reinforce the channel while considering economical efficiency, so that the power accessibility is obviously improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Flood range detection method based on double-time-phase heterogeneous remote sensing satellite images
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood range detection method based on double-phase heterogeneous remote sensing satellite images, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of adopting a pre-trained optical satellite remote sensing image water body extraction model as a characteristic extraction layer of an optical image before a flood disaster, adopting a pre-trained SAR satellite remote sensing image water body extraction model as a characteristic extraction layer of an SAR image after the flood disaster, and combining a characteristic fusion layer and a flood inundation detection decision layer to form a deep learning network model with heterogeneous image characteristic space unification and flood range detection capability. According to the invention, the problem of difficult acquisition of the flood range detection data set is effectively solved by constructing the pseudo-flood sample set and the strategy training flood detection model of cross-task transfer learning, the limited remote sensing image data set is fully utilized, the rapid and accurate detection of the flood flooding range is facilitated, and the large-range flood detection capability of multi-source remote sensing satellite combination is further improved.

title_en: Sensitivity calculation method for mine direct current electric method detection device and optimization method for detection device
abstract_en: A method for calculating the sensitivity of the detecting device of the mine DC method and a preferred method of the detecting device are disclosed, which utilize the AC/DC module of COMSOL to carry out high-precision and omnibearing numerical simulation on the detecting process of the mine DC method, evaluate the sensitivity change of the detecting device under different geological conditions through quantification and convert the sensitivity change into a programmable operation sensitivity function. The quality and the efficiency of mine disaster prevention and control work are remarkably improved, the active pushing effect is played on the development of coal mine safety production and industries, the geophysical exploration technical level of the mine is improved, the reliability and the practicability of exploration data are enhanced, and the method has great value in guaranteeing the coal mine safety production and promoting the healthy development of the coal industries.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Method and system for simulating fire and planning evacuation route
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of simulating fires and planning evacuation routes, and discloses a method and a system for simulating fires and planning evacuation routes, wherein a fire simulation scene is constructed and is gridded; simulating fire by using a random spreading algorithm according to a preset smoke concentration influence factor and a preset wind direction influence factor by taking a fire point as a starting point, determining the ignition probability of each grid, and simulating a fire scene with spreading trend; in a fire scene with a spreading trend, combining the smoke concentration influence factor, the wind direction influence factor and the ignition probability, and obtaining an evacuation route by using a flow field route finding algorithm based on a cost value minimum principle. The evacuation path can be efficiently and reasonably simulated, and the evacuation path can be safely and accurately planned.

title_en: Experimental device for simulating fire and explosion of aircraft cargo hold
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an experimental device for simulating fire and explosion of an aircraft cargo hold, wherein an opening and closing cabin door is arranged on one side wall of a simulated cabin body, and an observation window is arranged at the other end of the simulated cabin body; the ventilation assembly is connected and communicated with one side wall of the simulated cabin body, which is close to the cabin door, and is used for simulating ventilation conditions near the cabin door; the pressure regulating component is connected and communicated with the top wall of the simulated cabin body and realizes the pressure regulation in the simulated cabin body; the fire source generator is fixed in the simulation cabin and used for igniting goods in the simulation cabin; the sensor assembly is arranged inside the simulated cabin and is used for detecting temperature, pressure and heat flow data in the simulated cabin; the test control system is connected with the ventilation assembly, the pressure adjusting assembly, the fire source generator and the sensor assembly through electric signals, the test control system is safe and reliable in experiment, can simulate the characteristics of fire disaster under different pressures and ventilation environments, and provides data support for the prevention and control of aircraft safety accidents and accident investigation and test.

title_en: Building fire smoke spreading contrast experimental device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building fire smoke spreading contrast experiment device which comprises a building main body and a fire-fighting assembly, wherein the building main body consists of a plurality of layers of bodies, stair channels and pipeline wells, each layer of bodies is sequentially arranged from bottom to top and is provided with evacuation walkways connected with the stair channels, the stair channels and the pipeline wells are respectively arranged on two sides of the layer of bodies, the stair channels are provided with gates communicated with the layer of bodies and are provided with switchable fireproof doors, the pipeline wells are provided with openings communicated with the layer of bodies, the pipeline wells are provided with a plurality of equally-spaced partition boards, the bottom of each pipeline well is provided with a smoke generator for generating smoke, and the smoke spreads to each layer of bodies, the pipeline wells, the stair channels and the evacuation walkways along through holes, the openings and the gates. The utility model simulates the actual trend of the smoke after the fire disaster occurs, the smoke blocking effect of different blocking effects is compared through experiments in different modes, the principle of spreading the fire smoke in the building is intuitively displayed, the escape self-rescue capability of people is improved, and meanwhile, the effect of different fire-fighting facilities in the fire scene is known.

title_en: Highway slope protector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of slope protection, and particularly discloses a highway slope protection device which comprises a protection net, wherein positioning components are equidistantly arranged on the front surface of the protection net, and fixing components with the same number as the positioning components are equidistantly arranged on the back surface of the protection net. According to the utility model, the positioning assembly and the fixing assembly are arranged, the protective net is fixed through the positioning assembly and the fixing assembly, the insert blocks can be obliquely inserted into the drill holes, so that the insert rods can be firmly fixed in the drill holes, and as the inside of the sealing cavity is in a strong pressure state, when the small loose drill holes on the side slope are enlarged, the insert blocks extend outwards and are always and tightly connected with the hole wall, the protective net can be better suitable for various geological conditions and side slope stability conditions, and as the angle of the insert blocks is the angle, the insert blocks can slide to the depth of the drill holes after being extended, the surfaces of the protective net can be tightly attached to the surface of the side slope, the safety performance of the side slope is improved, and the risks of natural disasters such as landslide and collapse are reduced.
assignees: ZIBO WEIGUANG ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Passenger cabin emergency evacuation method containing disabled passengers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passenger cabin emergency evacuation method comprising disabled passengers, which comprises the steps of performing discretization on a single-channel passenger cabin environment by using grids with different sizes, dividing a passenger cabin into a plurality of cells, constructing a passenger real-time speed model according to the positions, the action capacities and the individual differences of the passengers, constructing a common passenger group behavior rule by using a field model, constructing a heterogeneous passenger group behavior rule by using the field model, setting cellular automaton evolution rules and time rules, constructing a passenger cabin evacuation cellular automaton model, simulating single-channel passenger cabin emergency evacuation by dividing passenger-carrying rate into cabin sections, and analyzing the evacuation behaviors of the heterogeneous passenger groups under different passenger-carrying rates and cabin section conditions based on simulation results to further optimize passenger seat distribution and evacuation strategies. According to the invention, under the special condition of considering the disabled passengers, the evacuation efficiency and the safety of the whole group are improved by optimizing the passenger seat distribution and the evacuation strategy.

title_en: Earthquake disaster monitoring and early warning method based on active fault hazard source
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake disaster monitoring and early warning method based on an active fault dangerous source, which relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring, and by acquiring fault tensile stress deviation proportion, relative sliding rate and underground water level floating frequency in historical monitoring data of each active fault in a monitoring area and preprocessing the fault tensile stress deviation proportion, the relative sliding rate and the underground water level floating frequency to generate a training set and a testing set, a machine learning model is constructed, real-time monitoring data of the active fault are collected in the actual monitoring process, the real-time monitoring data are predicted by using the trained model, fault tensile stress deviation proportion, relative sliding rate and the deviation value of the underground water level floating frequency of different active faults are estimated, and the risk level of earthquake disasters is predicted according to an estimation result, so that the accuracy of monitoring the active state of the active fault is improved, the trend and abnormality in the monitoring data can be more accurately judged, and the risks of false alarm and false alarm are reduced.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Urban treatment data fusion analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital data processing, in particular to a method and a system for fusion analysis of urban treatment data, comprising the following steps: establishing a three-dimensional model of the urban ground based on the urban terrain; obtaining a city sewer pipeline diagram and calculating the maximum flow in regions; setting edge monitoring nodes in each area to monitor the water level of the road surface, obtaining monitoring water level data, and judging the abnormal condition of the water level data by combining weather forecast data; predicting a water level change curve at an edge monitoring node based on the monitored water level data and the rainfall; simulating the waterlogging water flow direction based on the water level change curves of the monitoring nodes and the ground three-dimensional model; an evacuation route is pushed to residents of the affected area based on the waterlogged water flow direction in combination with the urban road network and population density information. Therefore, the central computing load can be reduced through edge computing, the reaction speed is improved, the capability of the city to cope with natural disasters such as waterlogging is enhanced, and the city safe operation and the life and property safety of residents are ensured.
assignees: JIANGSU JICHU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on deep learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on a deep learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting basic data and historical storm time sequence data of a research area; s2, processing the data; s3, constructing an FFC model based on a deep learning algorithm, training and verifying the FFC model, optimizing the affected building attention coefficient to obtain the optimal affected building attention coefficient for each building type, and testing the performance of the FFC model; s4, inputting the forecast rainfall time sequence into the FFC model tested for each building type, and performing repeated rolling iteration prediction to obtain probability distribution results of different functions of each building in a certain time range in the future of the research area. The obtained building function probability distribution result is beneficial to providing more information and uncertainty quantification for decision-making of decision-makers, thereby providing a good basis for the determination of the subsequent evacuation requirements.

title_en: Experimental device and method for simulating smoke flow path in fire scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device and method for simulating a smoke flow path in a fire scene, and relates to the technical field of fire detection and control. Compared with the previous flue gas flow path research, the invention solves the problems that the existing research is difficult to carry out experiments in a real fire scene, but only depends on a simulation experiment or a numerical model, and is difficult to completely restore the complex environment and the dynamic process in the real fire scene, thereby influencing the accuracy and the reliability of research results; through the flue gas flow path experiment in the model house, the flue gas behavior in the real fire scene can be simulated, the flue gas flow path in the model house can be monitored and recorded in real time by adopting advanced monitoring equipment and technology, and the fire extinguishing efficiency of the fire scene can be greatly improved by wading from the air inlet along the flue gas flow path direction. The strategy of ventilation measures can be flexibly adjusted according to the real-time fire scene conditions, so that the fire scene conditions can be more effectively handled, and the disaster loss is reduced.

title_en: Detection method and system for electric power information system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting an electric power information system, which relate to the technical field of electric power information systems and are characterized in that by acquiring and analyzing operation engineering and manual operation parameters of operators, and the safety awareness influence factor can comprehensively evaluate whether the comprehensive information system operation evaluation coefficient and the safety awareness of the operator are qualified or not, and analyze and manage the operator to be supervised. Meanwhile, disaster recovery exercise is performed regularly, and disaster recovery capability indexes are evaluated, so that the disaster recovery capability of the system can be found and improved in time. Comprehensively, the method can comprehensively ensure the safety of the electric power information system, improve the safety consciousness and the operation safety capability of operators, thereby ensuring the normal operation and the safety of the system, analyzing the operation safety target and the access authority level, limiting the access authority of the system to the sensitive data and the functions of the system, and reducing the safety risk.

title_en: Mountain torrent process simulation method and system based on coupling of statistical model and physical model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent process simulation method and system based on the coupling of a statistical model and a physical model, which relate to the technical field of mountain torrent control engineering and acquire basic data of a river basin; based on the basic data, establishing a linear regression model of runoff quantity so as to predict the runoff quantity of the mountain torrent simulation; establishing a hydrodynamic physical model, and simulating the motion law of mountain torrents; coupling the linear regression model of the runoff quantity and the hydrodynamic physical model to obtain a comprehensive mountain torrent simulation model; performing parameter calibration and verification on the coupled model; and performing mountain torrent process simulation to obtain a final result of mountain torrent process simulation. The invention can combine the advantages of the statistical model and the physical model, improve the accuracy and the reliability of the mountain torrent process simulation, and provide more effective support for mountain torrent prediction and disaster prevention work.
assignees: HANGZHOU CITY FUYANG DISTR AGRICULTURE AND RURAL BUREAU HANGZHOU CITY FUYANG DISTR FORESTRY WATER CO

title_en: Test device and test method for space temperature field of cable-stayed bridge under real fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for testing a space temperature field of a cable-stayed bridge in a real fire, wherein the device comprises the following components: the system comprises a lifting system, a cable model, a temperature monitoring system and a combustion environment simulation system which are symmetrically arranged; the cable model comprises a main cable and a sling model and is arranged between the lifting systems; the temperature monitoring system is arranged on the main cable and the sling model; the combustion environment simulation system comprises a controllable fire source and a movable environment wind control module; the controllable fire source is provided with a fuel allowance monitoring module; a data acquisition system comprising: the thermal imaging module, the smoke monitoring module and the video acquisition module are respectively used for acquiring environmental temperature, toxic substances and test images in the test process. The invention can accurately study the spatial temperature field distribution characteristics of the cable-supported bridge under different fire source positions, fire source power and ambient wind speed, and provides technical support for determining the least favorable fire scene of the cable-supported bridge under a real fire and a fire fortification strategy.

title_en: Construction method and application of urban waterlogging disaster-affected state detection model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method and application of a city waterlogging disaster-affected state detection model, which belong to the technical field of computer vision, and comprise the steps of firstly extracting high-dimensional visual features of a training sample pair city image, namely image coding features, extracting embedded features of a real text describing the waterlogging disaster-affected state in the city image through an embedded layer, then fusing the image coding features and the text embedded features based on a cross attention mechanism in an image decoding module, improving the association between the image and the text, promoting deep interaction between different modes, effectively fusing visual mode information and text mode information in a feature space, enriching fine granularity information in a semantic level, improving the understanding capability of the city waterlogging disaster-affected state detection model on complex flood scenes, and accurately detecting the complicated city scenes.

title_en: Fire experiment device of underground comprehensive pipe rack
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire experiment device of an underground comprehensive pipe rack, which is formed by splicing a plurality of fire experiment models, wherein each fire experiment model comprises a box-shaped shell, a fire simulation assembly and a plurality of thermocouple probes; the box-shaped shell comprises a metal frame and six fireproof plates, wherein the six fireproof plates are respectively and detachably arranged at the top, the bottom, the first side part, the second side part, the third side part and the fourth side part of the metal frame to form six side walls of the box-shaped shell; both ends of the fireproof plate positioned at the top of the metal frame are provided with air openings; the fire disaster simulation assembly comprises a cable bracket and an igniter, and the cable bracket and the igniter are both arranged in the box-shaped shell; the thermocouple probes are respectively arranged on the lower surface of the fireproof plate at the top of the metal frame and the igniter. The utility tunnel can simulate the ignition of the actual utility tunnel smoothly, and solves the problem that the fire experimental device for the urban utility tunnel structure is lacking at present.

title_en: Forest fire suppression command simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire suppression command simulation training system, which relates to the technical field of forest fire suppression training, and comprises the following components: a commander training subsystem; the commander training subsystem includes: the system comprises a path planning module, a command issuing module, a traveling state simulation module, a resource consumption simulation module and a plotting module; the path planning module is used for planning a forest fire extinguishing path; the command issuing module is used for the commander to send information and/or issue commands; the advancing state simulation module is used for simulating the advancing state of the firefighter according to the planned forest fire extinguishing path; the resource consumption simulation module is used for simulating the consumption condition of fire-fighting materials and the physical power consumption condition of fire-fighting personnel according to the duration time of the fire condition and the time of putting out the fire; the plotting module is used for plotting a fire scene situation map and a combat block map. The invention improves the reality of the virtual forest fire scene and the training efficiency of commanders.

title_en: Landslide surge analysis method based on wavelet transformation
abstract_en: A landslide surge analysis method based on wavelet transformation relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and is characterized in that a mountain river is modeled, then free liquid level wave height duration data of the model is calculated by software, then wavelet transformation is carried out on the wave height data by simulation software to obtain a time-frequency domain energy spectrum, and the type, frequency distribution and change of a propagation rule of surge waves are effectively and rapidly identified according to a graph of the time-frequency domain energy spectrum; in addition, the adopted wavelet transformation can be used for rapidly processing and analyzing dynamic signals of landslide surge, and can respond to potential disaster threats in time by combining energy spectrums generated by subsequent simulation, so that the establishment of a landslide disaster early warning system is facilitated.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG BAOXINGHE WATER POWER CO LTD;UNIV XIHUA

title_en: Civil aviation firefighter technical and tactical capability assessment method and assessment system based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, and discloses a civil aviation fire fighter technical and tactical capability assessment method and an assessment system based on virtual reality technology, wherein the capability assessment method comprises a test acquisition and input module and a feedback module, the test acquisition and input module integrates advanced sensor technology and Virtual Reality (VR) equipment, the scoring system comprises a fire-fighting disposal capability assessment module, wherein the fire-fighting disposal capability assessment module consists of a data analysis module and a report generation module and is mainly applied to fire fighter physical quality assessment, psychological quality assessment and technical action capability assessment. Through the civil aviation fire control technical and tactics ability evaluation system based on virtual reality technology, through simulating real civil aviation fire scene, collect and analyze the operation data of participant, provide a new solution for evaluating and promoting civil aviation firefighter's technical and tactics ability, help promoting the whole level of civil aviation fire control, provide more powerful guarantee for civil aviation safety.
assignees: BEIJING TIANEN ZHONGTAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: YOLOv-CS-based pavement collapse automatic identification method and YOLOv-CS-based pavement collapse automatic identification equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a YOLOv-CS-based pavement collapse automatic identification method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) Adopting a web crawler to crawl road surface collapse disaster pictures on related websites; (2) Storing all the crawled road surface collapse disaster pictures into a sample library, and labeling collapse types of the pictures in the sample library; (3) Sequentially performing self-adaptive anchor frame calculation, self-adaptive picture scaling and Mosaic data enhancement on all pictures in a sample library; (4) constructing a pavement collapse recognition model by adopting YOLOv-CS; (5) Inputting the picture processed in the step (3) into a pavement collapse recognition model for training; (6) Extracting video frames from the road monitoring video, and inputting a trained pavement collapse recognition model to obtain the real-time condition of the pavement collapse type. The invention has high automation degree and high real-time performance.

title_en: Urban waterlogging dangerous situation simulation method integrating geographic information of volunteers
abstract_en: The invention provides a city waterlogging risk scenario simulation method integrating volunteer geographic information, which aims at integrating multi-source volunteer geographic information and exploring the city waterlogging risk scenario simulation method, and comprises the following steps: collecting data; dividing urban space units; the volunteer geographic information data classification; digging a resident travel rule; dividing the 'job-living-rest' structure of the lower pad surface; building a waterlogging model; simulating a rainstorm waterlogging situation; analyzing dangerous characteristic factors; selecting disaster factor evaluation indexes; selecting a pregnancy disaster environment evaluation index; risk assessment model construction and risk classification. The method has the beneficial effects that the method integrates the geographical information data of the multi-source volunteers, scientifically evaluates the dangerous degree generated by the rainstorm flood by integrating a plurality of machine learning methods, and strongly supports the sponge city construction and flood prevention and drainage decisions of the area easy to be flooded.

title_en: Post-disaster emergency energy supply optimizing and scheduling method for multi-energy coupling power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a post-disaster emergency energy supply optimal scheduling method for a multi-energy coupling power distribution system, belongs to the technical field of post-disaster resource utilization of the power distribution system, and solves the problem that an effective related optimal scheduling method is lacked in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of constructing an objective function of a post-disaster emergency energy supply optimizing and scheduling model by taking maximization of energy supply income of a multi-energy coupling power distribution system in a post-disaster external energy supply period as a target, constructing constraint conditions of the model by taking constraints such as relevant constraints of the multi-energy coupling system and operation constraints of a power distribution network as constraints, constructing a solution problem of the model as a Markov decision process, determining state vectors, action vectors and rewarding functions corresponding to all moments, training by utilizing an improved reinforcement learning algorithm, obtaining reinforcement learning agent adapting to post-disaster emergency energy supply optimizing and scheduling, and applying the agent to the post-disaster emergency energy supply optimizing and scheduling process to obtain a corresponding optimizing and scheduling strategy.

title_en: Slope geological disaster monitoring information system based on 3DWebGIS
abstract_en: The invention provides a3 DWebGIS-based slope geological disaster monitoring information system, which relates to the technical field of geological monitoring, and comprises a multidimensional data fusion system, a real-time three-dimensional model building system, a holographic interaction control system, a VR interactive emergency drilling system and a user demand and function interaction system, wherein the geological three-dimensional real-time model built by the real-time three-dimensional model building system is used for setting scenes, so that the VR interactive emergency drilling system is used for carrying out holographic interaction and building a VR interactive drilling platform, a user can carry out slope geological disaster simulation and scene parameter setting on the basis of combining the real-time geological model, and the VR technology and the holographic interaction technology are combined for drilling, so that a real slope geological disaster scene and various influencing factors can be simulated, a real-life drilling platform is provided for monitoring staff and emergency rescue teams, the emergency response capability is improved through drilling simulation, the defects in an emergency plan are also exposed, and an important basis is provided for subsequent improvement and perfection.

title_en: Smart city monitoring super-resolution enhancement method and device based on hyperspectrum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image enhancement, in particular to a hyperspectral-based smart city monitoring super-resolution enhancement method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method is based on DnCNN image denoising method, which processes hyperspectral image, generates initial reconstructed image by encoder and decoder, obtains super-resolution coding feature and self-adaptive coding feature by super-resolution encoder and self-adaptive coding factor regulating block, enhances space and channel feature by space enhancing attention module and channel enhancing attention module, generates high resolution reconstructed image by super-resolution decoder, and reduces reconstruction loss and cross entropy loss by training of optimizer, thereby improving quality of image reconstruction. The method can more accurately identify and monitor various elements in the city by improving the image resolution, provide more detailed and accurate data support, and also improve the efficiency and accuracy of environment monitoring and emergency response.

title_en: Wind disaster emergency simulation method based on finite volume simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind disaster emergency simulation method based on limited volume simulation, which comprises the following steps: s1: collecting data of terrains, buildings and the like in areas with larger wind disaster occurrence probability, and constructing a three-dimensional geometric model; s2: analyzing and counting meteorological conditions in areas with larger wind disaster occurrence probability; s3: discretizing the region to form a storage unit for storing data; s4: inputting the boundary condition into a calculation model for calculation and solving; s5: performing data processing and visual presentation on the calculation result; s6: and (3) visual result analysis, carrying out emergency early warning on the area with high damage degree and making corresponding scheme measures. According to the wind disaster emergency simulation method, computational fluid dynamics and wind environment prediction are combined, and the wind disaster emergency simulation is performed in a three-dimensional space, so that not only can the region where the wind disaster is affected be obtained, but also the damage degree of buildings and the like in the region can be predicted, and different scheme measures can be specifically formulated for different disaster-affected regions to guide decision.

title_en: Steep coal seam rock burst advanced prevention and control method based on ground inclined shaft fracturing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for advanced prevention and control of rock burst of a steeply inclined coal seam based on ground inclined shaft fracturing, and relates to the technical field of advanced prevention and control of rock burst disasters of steeply inclined coal mines. The method comprises the steps of obtaining physical and mechanical parameters of each rock stratum based on drilling coring and mechanical experiments, determining a target fracturing layer based on the corresponding relation between rock stratum fracture migration and support dynamic load coefficients, drilling an inclined fracturing well based on the inclination angle of the target fracturing layer, optimizing and determining fracturing parameters based on numerical simulation of a random polygon map and Cohesive units, perforating in sections based on the inclination angle of the target fracturing layer, and sealing and fracturing. The invention can realize large-scale, high-efficiency and source elimination of the occurrence of the rock burst of the steeply inclined coal seam.

title_en: Lifting mechanism based on hydraulic drive and used for terrain simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting mechanism for terrain simulation based on hydraulic drive; the hydraulic lifting device comprises a hydraulic lifting device outer frame, a lifting rod top, a grating ruler, a grating sensor, a liquid inlet electromagnetic valve, a liquid pumping electromagnetic valve and the like, wherein the regulating valve device comprises a pressure pump, a hydraulic regulating valve, a vacuum pump and a vacuum regulating valve; the up-and-down movement of the hydraulic push rod is controlled by controlling the on-off of the electromagnetic valve, and the stroke and the precision are controlled according to the grating ruler and the grating sensor, so that the height setting of terrain simulation is completed; the invention solves the problem that the existing terrain scouring physical model is built singly and can not be reused, and can be used in scientific research and teaching, actual hydraulic engineering design and natural disaster prevention and control; thereby better protecting and utilizing natural resources and promoting sustainable development.
assignees: SUZHOU YISHUI TWIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;SUZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HOHAI UNIV

title_en: Building fire scene trapped person regulation and control optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regulation and optimization method and a system for trapped personnel in a building fire scene, which relate to the field of intelligent building safety, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time fire information by using a sensor group; acquiring real-time personnel information in real time; calling a pre-established building simulation model to generate a plurality of initial escape routes; predicting the fire development trend by using a fire development prediction model to obtain a fire prediction condition; performing verification and evaluation on a plurality of initial escape routes to obtain an optimal escape route; and sending the optimal escape route in a multi-mode, and dynamically guiding, regulating and controlling the trapped personnel. The technical problems of inaccurate information acquisition, low response speed and poor personnel evacuation effect in the existing building fire rescue are solved, the rescue efficiency and accuracy are improved, and a safer and more reliable escape path is provided for trapped personnel.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method and system for coal mine and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster early warning method, a fire disaster early warning system and a storage medium for a coal mine, wherein a multi-mode sensor network is arranged in the coal mine; after the data are subjected to cleaning, time synchronization and fusion treatment, multi-mode characteristic data are extracted, and fire risk scores are calculated through a fire risk assessment model; uploading fire risk characteristic data to a blockchain network for encryption storage, monitoring in real time through intelligent contracts, automatically triggering early warning signals and starting an emergency response program; combining virtual reality and augmented reality technologies, constructing a virtual model of a mine, and dynamically displaying a fire risk area and a flame spreading path; the control center starts an emergency response program according to the early warning signal, and feeds back the emergency treatment condition in real time through the virtual reality and augmented reality equipment, so as to implement fire emergency exercise and capability improvement; the fire disaster early warning system effectively improves the accuracy of fire disaster early warning and the efficiency of emergency response, and reduces casualties and property loss caused by fire disasters.
assignees: CHONGQING MAS SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban rail transit train passenger flow guiding system based on thermal imaging principle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway platform passenger flow induction system based on a thermal imaging principle, which utilizes an infrared thermal imaging technology, takes the urban rail transit train passenger flow induction system based on the thermal imaging principle as an object, combines three means of numerical simulation, theoretical derivation and experimental verification, achieves the aims of reducing errors and solving a combined optimization problem by means of an auxiliary blackbody calibrator and a simulated annealing algorithm, and monitors and analyzes personnel distribution conditions in a train carriage in real time. The system displays the personnel density of different areas through the heat map, and provides intelligent guidance according to data analysis so as to optimize passenger flow distribution, reduce congestion and promote passenger travel experience. The system can also predict passenger flow trend, convey real-time information, assist traffic management and emergency response, and provide more efficient, safe and comfortable service for urban rail transit.

title_en: Based on CO2Environmental background noise self-adaptive composite fire detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite fire detection method and device based on self-adaption of CO  2  environmental background noise, which is used for responding to a starting instruction triggered after a detector is installed in a room area and dividing CO  2  gas and other detection data from all acquired fire detection data; inputting CO  2  gas and other detection data into a trained detection model, wherein the detection model comprises a first identification model and a second identification model, the first identification model is used for identifying CO  2  gas to obtain a first output result, and the second identification model is used for identifying other detection data to obtain a second output result; and predicting the fire disaster identification result according to the first output result and the second output result to obtain a target fire disaster prediction result. The influence of the background concentration of the CO  2  on the performance of the detection model is eliminated, the constructed detection model realizes one-to-one training of room areas provided with the detectors, and the detection effect is ensured not to be reduced along with the change of the background concentration of the CO  2 .

title_en: Prediction method and system for electric power natural disasters based on multiple situations
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of disaster prediction, and provides a prediction method and a prediction system for electric natural disasters based on multiple situations, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring initial data from a natural disaster information data release platform; performing data preprocessing on the initial data, wherein the data preprocessing comprises data normalization processing and outlier detection correction processing; carrying out parameter characteristic statistics and analysis on the preprocessed data, and screening characteristic parameters; constructing a prediction model of the electric natural disaster based on the characteristic parameters; acquiring weather information data of a target area in real time, matching the weather information data with a preset association rule base, and determining target parameters; and inputting the target parameters into the prediction model to generate a power natural disaster prediction result of the target region. The prediction of natural disaster events is realized by combining the set prediction model with the association rule base, so that the model training calculation process is reduced, and the model prediction efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: GUILIN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Underground mining slope landslide disaster forecasting and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forecasting and early warning landslide hazard of underground mining, which comprises the following steps: constructing a mining area slope three-dimensional geomechanical model; according to the mining area slope three-dimensional geomechanical model and the monitoring data, carrying out slope deformation evolution historical analysis, and determining a coal seam mining response rule; according to the coal seam mining response rule, carrying out mining rock mass parameter inversion, and determining a mining landslide instability mechanism; according to a mining landslide instability mechanism, mining inversion simulation analysis is carried out on a historical working surface, and a settlement deformation time sequence and a horizontal deformation time sequence of key characteristic points are determined; determining a slope stability coefficient time sequence according to the sedimentation deformation time sequence, the horizontal deformation time sequence and a preset mining landslide monitoring data change model; the steady state of the mining ramp is determined based on the ramp body stability coefficient time series. The method can improve the accuracy and precision of early warning of mine landslide disasters.

title_en: Corn drought state extraction method based on improved U-Net network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corn drought state dynamic monitoring method based on an improved U-Net network. Firstly, acquiring GF-2 remote sensing image data and optical remote sensing data, storing, registering and cutting the data, generating a semantic segmentation mask of the drought state of the corn based on the optical remote sensing data, and constructing a corn drought state classification data set. And then, dividing the generated corn drought state classification data set based on the improved U-Net network, and constructing a segmentation model aiming at the corn drought state. Training the model by taking GF-2 remote sensing image data as the input of a neural network, and finally obtaining a network model for dynamically monitoring the drought state of the ground corn. The invention can realize the dynamic monitoring of the drought state of the corn in the area, effectively grasp the variation condition of the corn drought in the area, assist departments such as agricultural disaster management and the like to discover the drought condition of the corn crops in time and assist the intelligent development of agriculture.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: U-shaped carrier for quick assembly and disassembly of fire hose
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a U-shaped carrier for quick assembly of a fire hose, which comprises a U-shaped plate and an annular lock catch, wherein the length of the bottom surface of the U-shaped plate is at least 30mm more than that of the top surface of the U-shaped plate, the end part of the top surface of the U-shaped plate extends upwards to form an extension part, the extension part is provided with a hole, and the annular lock catch penetrates through the hole. The fire hose clamping device is small in structure, can be directly arranged on the side hooks of the fire fighter waistband, clamps the fire hose by utilizing the special structure, and enables the whole fire hose to slightly incline upwards under the action of the dead weight of the fire hose, so that the carrying process of the water hose is stable and no slipping occurs; when the water band is loaded, the water band is simply hung and put, the water band can be directly pulled out, the loading and taking process is simple to operate and can be rapidly completed, and the water band is very convenient and fast; the utility model has simple structure and easy processing; the utility model can liberate the hands of the firefighter, and is convenient for the firefighter to drill and rescue.
assignees: Lanping Bai and Pumi Autonomous County Fire Rescue Brigade

title_en: Method and system for providing a simulation for disaster prevention using a pedestrian density data collection method utilizing artificial intelligence-based object detecting technology
title_ko: 인공지능 기반 객체 탐지(Object Detecting) 기술을 활용한 보행자 밀집 데이터 수집 방법을 이용한 재난 방지용 시뮬레이션을 제공하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for providing a disaster prevention simulation using a method for collecting pedestrian density data using an artificial intelligence-based object detecting technology. More specifically, the present invention relates to a method and a system for providing a simulation for preventing various accidents and disaster situations in advance by collecting pedestrian density data and floating population data at a site where there is a risk of an accident using an artificial intelligence-based object detecting technology, and predicting and pre-analyzing a dangerous environment by utilizing the collected data and applying various physical rules. According to the method and the system for providing a disaster prevention simulation provided according to the present invention, it is possible to predict a dangerous environment in advance and evaluate the degree of risk by identifying pedestrians and obstacles at a site where there is a risk of an accident, deriving a virtual dense environment based on spatial data of the site and calculating a density value based on characteristics including the type and number of pedestrians and characteristics including the type and number of obstacles.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인공지능 기반 객체 탐지(Object Detecting) 기술을 활용하여 보행자 밀집 데이터를 수집하는 방법을 이용한 재난 방지용 시뮬레이션을 제공하는 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 인공지능 기반 객체 탐지 기술을 활용하여 사고의 위험성이 있는 현장에서 보행자의 밀집도 및 유동인구 데이터 등을 수집하고, 수집된 데이터를 활용하고 다양한 물리 규칙을 적용하여 위험환경을 예측 및 사전 분석하여 각종 사고 및 재난 상황을 미리 방지하기 위한 시뮬레이션을 제공하는 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따라 제공되는 재난 방지용 시뮬레이션을 제공하는 방법 및 시스템에 의하면, 사고의 위험성이 있는 현장에서 보행자 및 장애물을 식별하고, 보행자의 유형 및 수를 포함하는 특성 및 장애물의 유형 및 수를 포함하는 특성을 바탕으로, 현장의 공간데이터를 바탕으로 가상 밀집환경을 도출하고 밀집도값을 산출하는 것을 통해 위험환경을 사전에 예측하고 위험도를 평가할 수 있다.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning method, system and equipment based on time sequence prediction and critical relation extraction by double discriminators
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster early warning method, a system and equipment based on time sequence prediction and critical relation extraction by double discriminators, which are applied to the mountain torrent disaster early warning field and comprise the following steps: acquiring a mountain torrent early warning characteristic period based on the upstream river basin yield confluence characteristic; respectively acquiring early-stage rainfall and corresponding soil water content and early-stage influence rainfall when flood disasters occur in different flood early-warning characteristic periods, training a Fisher algorithm-based double-discriminant classification model, and learning critical relations between the early-stage rainfall and the soil water content and the early-stage influence rainfall when flood disasters occur; and respectively acquiring time sequence features of rainfall and soil water content and influence rainfall in different mountain torrent early warning feature periods, constructing an LSTM-based time sequence prediction model, predicting the soil water content and influence rainfall in future time, inputting a double-discriminator classification model, and finishing mountain torrent disaster early warning in future time. The invention improves the mountain torrent disaster early warning precision.
assignees: HANGZHOU CITY FUYANG DISTR AGRICULTURE AND RURAL BUREAU HANGZHOU CITY FUYANG DISTR FORESTRY WATER CO

title_en: Multimedia man-machine interaction platform based on mixed reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimedia man-machine interaction platform based on mixed reality, which relates to the technical field of scene security simulation, and the invention acquires and processes multi-mode sensor data in real time through a context awareness system, dynamically generates and adjusts a virtual scene, so that the virtual scene is consistent with a real environment, and the context awareness and response capability is improved; the virtual information is overlapped in a real environment through a virtual and reality fusion system, so that augmented reality AR guidance and immersive virtual exercise are provided, and the sense of reality and actual combat effect of the exercise are improved; analyzing user operation data, environmental changes and historical cases in real time, providing real-time decision support and optimization suggestions, and remarkably improving; the accuracy and timeliness of the emergency response; the method solves the problem that the traditional static training mode for fire disaster in the prior art cannot simulate dynamic change and emergency, so that users cannot deal with the deficiency in the actual scene.
assignees: BEIJING ANJIU QIUSHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Armored vehicle driving simulation training system for battlefield emergency response
abstract_en: The invention discloses an armored vehicle driving simulation training system for handling battlefield emergency, which relates to the technical field of driving simulation, the system can provide a highly simulated training environment through the cooperative work of the training area acquisition module, the environment analysis module, the multi-level simulation module, the training simulation analysis module and the dynamic evaluation adjustment module. Firstly, the training area acquisition module collects environmental data in real time through the detection equipment, and transmits the environmental data to the central processing center for preprocessing, so as to acquire and store an environmental data set. The environmental analysis module then extracts the data from the database and calculates the subsurface structure impact coefficients Strength of electromagnetic interference And coefficient of influence of chemical contamination And integrate it into the simulation model. By dynamically generating different training area environments, the system can simulate complex conditions of a real battlefield, and a driver can experience the condition highly consistent with the actual environment in training.

title_en: Mechanical property testing system and method for lining structure under loaded freeze thawing condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical property testing system and method of a lining structure under loaded freeze thawing condition, relating to the technical field of underground engineering, and comprising a fan-shaped box body, an oil injection pump, an alcohol circulation refrigerating unit, a pressure pump, a plurality of temperature sensors and a plurality of stress sensors; the inside of the fan-shaped box body is divided into four areas from inside to outside along the radial direction, namely a vacuum area, a concrete area, a clay area and an oil injection area, wherein concrete blocks are arranged in the concrete area, and clay blocks are arranged in the clay area; the temperature sensors and the stress sensors are uniformly arranged in the concrete block and the clay block; the test system has wide adjustable range, can simulate concrete at different temperatures and under different loading states by adjusting the temperature, has good record on corresponding force and temperature change, can obtain effective experience rules more easily, is beneficial to the process of engineering disaster reduction, and has higher scientific value.

title_en: Emergency shelter availability evaluation method and system based on population real-time distribution
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an emergency shelter availability evaluation method and system based on population real-time distribution. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring urban real-time population space distribution data; establishing an emergency refuge site simulation space network taking an urban road as a base; calculating the real-time personnel emergency refuge area of each regular grid at a specific moment under a disaster scene without consideration; establishing a simulation space network of the urban emergency refuge places under different intensity disaster scenes; calculating the real-time personnel emergency refuge site areas of the regular grids under different intensity disaster scenes again; judging whether the real-time personnel emergency refuge area of each regular grid reaches a planning and setting target or not under the specific moment and the specific disaster intensity, and carrying out space visual expression. Therefore, the real-time available level of the emergency refuge can be accurately determined based on the population space-time distribution characteristics, weak links and weak areas can be rapidly identified, and technical support is provided for programming, monitoring and early warning.

title_en: Test system and test method for simulating tunneling under seepage state
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test system and a test method for simulating tunneling under a seepage state, wherein the test system comprises a water injection device, a model box, a tunnel structure and a detection device, wherein the top of the model box is provided with an opening, the bottom of the model box is provided with a drain hole, the end face of the model box is provided with a tunnel simulation port, the water injection device comprises a water tank and a diversion component, a diversion pipe of the diversion component is provided with a seepage hole, the diversion pipe is arranged in the model box, one end of the diversion pipe extends along the direction of the tunnel simulation port, the other end of the diversion pipe is connected with the water tank, the tunnel structure comprises a tunnel appearance and a lining component, the tunnel appearance is arranged in a surrounding rock soil area around the simulated tunnel excavation, the lining component is embedded in the tunnel appearance, and the detection device is used for collecting soil layer pressure change data of the tunnel structure gradually pushed into the surrounding rock soil area around the simulated tunnel excavation under the seepage state. The invention can truly reproduce the deformation condition and the damage mechanism of soil around the tunnel under the condition of natural disasters, has good experimental effect and reliable experimental data.

title_en: Mobile device for adjusting microclimate environment of tropical forest orchard
abstract_en: The application provides a mobile device for adjusting microclimate environment of a tropical forest orchard, which comprises a supporting part, a rainwater collecting part, a water storage part and an illumination part, wherein the supporting part is connected with the rainwater collecting part; the support part comprises a stand column and a base, the rainwater collection part is fixedly connected with the top of the stand column and comprises a first photovoltaic plate, a second photovoltaic plate and a third photovoltaic plate which are coaxially arranged, lifting structures are arranged at the bottoms of the second photovoltaic plate and the third photovoltaic plate, and the lifting structures are used for respectively controlling the lifting of the third photovoltaic plate and the second photovoltaic plate; the water storage part is connected to the lower part of the rainwater collection part and is used for storing rainwater in a water way; the illumination portion includes a plurality of light sources simulating natural light. According to the application, through the water temperature and light integrated design, the purposes of collecting rainwater, converting solar energy into electric energy, changing the ambient temperature and a certain shading effect are achieved, the purposes of saving water and energy and promoting growth and reducing disaster are achieved, meanwhile, the installation workload is reduced, the cost is saved, and the popularization is facilitated.

title_en: Space-time dynamic method and system for simulating group evacuation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a space-time dynamic method and a space-time dynamic system for simulating group evacuation, and relates to the technical field of simulation. The method comprises the following steps: simulating a corresponding virtual road network according to a real road network around the nuclear power plant, and simulating a corresponding virtual resident according to a real resident around the nuclear power plant; simulating corresponding virtual vehicles on the virtual road network according to each real vehicle on the real road network around the nuclear power plant; configuring a first virtual position point in the virtual road network as a gathering point, configuring a second virtual position point in the virtual road network as a target point, configuring distribution information of a plurality of virtual personnel nodes and distribution information of a plurality of virtual vehicle nodes, configuring model parameters of an evacuation planning model, and configuring evacuation scenario information; an evacuation process including a plurality of evacuation phases is simulated, and an evacuation path and an evacuation time are obtained based on an evacuation planning model, so as to plan an emergency evacuation path and estimate the evacuation time for the nuclear power plant.

title_en: Emergency escape training system for full scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency training, in particular to a full-scene emergency escape training system, a scene generation module, a disaster simulation module and a scene analysis module, wherein the scene generation module is used for generating scene data and superposing a disaster simulation model to obtain simulated scene data; the scene synchronization module is used for synchronizing the simulated scene data to the virtual reality equipment; the virtual reality equipment is used for displaying the simulation scene and acquiring the position and action information of the user in the simulation scene; the suggestion module is used for analyzing the position and action information of the user and giving improvement suggestions; and the data statistics module is used for counting training data of the user and generating a corresponding statistics report. Therefore, the comprehensive training experience from theory to practice is provided for the user, and the safety awareness and the self-rescue and mutual-rescue capability of the public in the face of an emergency are effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING JIUTIAN JINYING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for simulating mud bursting and sand bursting under high pressure and with adjustable mining crack width
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of burst sand disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a burst sand simulation device and method with adjustable mining crack width under high pressure. The simulation device includes: a cement sand material source cabin; the adjustable crack die at least comprises two crack plates which are oppositely arranged, the distance between the two crack plates is adjustable, and the mining cracks with different widths are simulated by adjusting the gap between the two crack plates; the cement sand material source cabin is positioned above the adjustable crack die, and the cement sand material source cabin is communicated with the adjustable crack die; the air pump is communicated with the cement sand source cabin through a pipeline; the data acquisition system at least comprises a plurality of water pressure sensors. The simulation device has a more practical accurate simulation result, and is favorable for providing more reliable basis for construction of a thick bedrock deep buried coal seam mining mud bursting disaster prevention and control technology system.

title_en: Multi-model coupled traffic dynamic risk assessment method oriented to storm disaster chain
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-model coupled traffic dynamic risk assessment method oriented to a heavy rain disaster chain, which relates to the technical field of natural disasters, and comprises the following steps: determining overflow points and overflow amounts of pipe networks in the research area according to urban rainfall data and urban pipe network data in the research area; road water accumulation calculation is carried out on overflow points and overflow amounts of the overflow points, so that the road surface water accumulation amount in a research area is obtained; determining road speed limit data of the road in the research area according to the road area water quantity and the average speed of the road in the research area; the traffic simulation result under the scene of the storm disaster chain is determined by processing the road speed limit data and the travel information of the agent in the research area; and determining the disaster situation of the disaster-bearing body according to the traffic simulation result. The accuracy of disaster risk assessment is improved.

title_en: Real-time marine environment forecasting method integrating field observation, dynamics and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time marine environment forecasting method integrating field observation, dynamics and machine learning, which comprises the following steps: arranging an observation platform in a target sea area to obtain an observation time sequence of marine environment elements; carrying out dynamic mechanism analysis based on the time sequence, and selecting a dynamic predictor; building a network structure of a machine learning model, and generating an input feature matrix; training a machine learning model by a super-parameter optimization method to obtain an optimal forecasting model; iteratively generating a forecasted time sequence of marine environmental elements using the model; and carrying out spatial inference according to the forecasting time sequence to generate a forecasting result of the target sea area. The method fuses field observation data and dynamics theory into a machine learning framework, achieves good forecasting effect, increases model interpretability, has flexibility and universality, and can provide more accurate and reliable real-time forecasting for marine application fields such as offshore operation, environment management, disaster response and the like.

title_en: Method for extracting urban flood inundation range based on remote sensing image
