abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting urban flood submerged range based on remote sensing images, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a wind cloud satellite number four remote sensing image, preprocessing the wind cloud satellite number four remote sensing image, and dividing the preprocessed remote sensing image into a thin cloud area and a thick cloud area; removing thin cloud and thick cloud on the remote sensing image; extracting the water body area in the remote sensing image after cloud removal to obtain a first city inundation range; acquiring radar images of the same region and time, and extracting the water body area in the radar images to obtain a second city inundation range; training a super-resolution convolutional neural network by using the first urban inundation range and the second urban inundation range, and constructing a high-resolution urban inundation range by using the trained super-resolution convolutional neural network. The invention combines the advantages of the optical remote sensing image and the radar image, and uses the super-resolution convolutional neural network to perform super-resolution processing by using a deep learning method so as to obtain the urban flood submerged range image in the disaster period, which can simultaneously meet the requirements of time and spatial resolution.

title_en: Lithium ion battery heat release flue gas pilot experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a lithium ion battery heat release smoke ignition experimental device, which comprises a heat safety experimental box, wherein the heat safety experimental box comprises a heat safety experimental box body; the internal portion of thermal safety experiment case is provided with ignition mechanism, smoke transducer, temperature sensor and lithium ion battery, the external portion of thermal safety experiment case is equipped with ignition mechanism control cabinet, ignition mechanism, smoke transducer, temperature sensor pass through the transmission electric energy and the transmission signal between wire and the ignition mechanism control cabinet respectively. The ignition mechanism control console can control the output voltage level of the two ends of the electrode of the arc generator and the short-circuit current of the resistance wire on the short-circuit generator, and simulate the ignition condition of the smoke released by the battery. The experimental device and the method can be used for researching the ignition mechanism and fire behavior of the heat release smoke of the lithium ion power battery and the energy storage battery, and further provide basis for the safety design and disaster prevention and control of the battery and the system.

title_en: Fire disaster phenomenon simulation device of new energy battery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire phenomenon simulation device of a new energy battery, which relates to the technical field of fire demonstration equipment and comprises a simulation box, wherein a partition board is arranged in the simulation box to divide the simulation box into a first simulation chamber and a second simulation chamber; the pneumatic drilling machine is arranged at the inner top of the first simulation chamber; the impact simulation device is arranged at the inner top of the second simulation chamber; the extrusion simulation device is arranged at the bottom of the second simulation chamber; the short circuit triggering device is arranged in the first simulation chamber; and the spray pipe is arranged at the inner top parts of the first simulation chamber and the second simulation chamber. The utility model adopts the pneumatic drilling machine to simulate puncture, uses the impact simulation device to simulate the impact suffered by the battery, and the extrusion simulation device simulates the extrusion suffered by the battery, and the short-circuit triggering device is used for manufacturing short circuit.

title_en: Be used for exhibition hall virtual reality yuan universe extinguishing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a universe fire extinguishing device for virtual reality elements in an exhibition hall, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting simulation equipment and comprises a simulation operation table, wherein a control table is arranged on the top surface of the simulation operation table, a control button is movably connected to the top surface of the control table, and a fire extinguisher placing groove is formed in the top surface of the simulation operation table. According to the utility model, the fire extinguishing scene display and the training data display are carried out through the integral display host, the training personnel select the corresponding fire extinguisher body to pick up at the fire extinguisher placing groove on the simulation operation table according to the video scene displayed by the integral display host, the pick-up signal of the fire extinguisher body is sensed by the pressure touch sensor, the selection correctness of the fire extinguisher body is judged, and the dynamic capture camera is utilized to dynamically capture the fire extinguisher picture before the integral display host, so that the fire extinguisher simulation is carried out, and the comprehensive fire disaster simulation and fire extinguishing training are completed in smaller places such as exhibition halls, and the fire extinguishing training effect is improved.
assignees: SUZHOU HUAHENG EXHIBITION DESIGN CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Geological drilling investigation equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of geological drilling investigation equipment, and discloses geological drilling investigation equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters, which comprises a shell, wherein a hydraulic rod is arranged on the inner top wall of the shell, a drilling machine is arranged at the bottom of a piston of the hydraulic rod, an adjusting assembly is arranged outside the shell, and the adjusting assembly comprises a rectangular frame, an inner sliding groove, an electric sliding rail, a supporting seat, square holes, a screw rod, a driving motor, a hydraulic cylinder and universal wheels. This geological drilling investigation equipment for geological disaster prevention and cure through setting up the rectangle frame, spout and electronic slide rail in the cooperation, drives the effect that the casing removed around realizing, lets the drill bit position of drilling machine adjust around can, and then has enlarged the accommodation of probing investigation in the use, reduces unnecessary distance and removes, simultaneously, utilizes driving motor and screw rod's design, realizes the effect of translation about the drive casing, need not the manual rotation of handling the screw rod of staff.
assignees: SINOCHEM MINGDA NORTHEAST GEOLOGICAL MINING CO LTD

title_en: Power grid risk assessment method and device based on dynamic evolution of sudden natural disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid risk assessment, in particular to a power grid risk assessment method and device based on dynamic evolution of sudden natural disaster chains. The method comprises the following steps: calculating according to regional weather information, geographical geological information, power grid equipment information and power grid electrical information to obtain the fault probability of the power transmission line; based on a risk element theory, according to the fault probability of the power transmission line, carrying out disaster chain construction through qualitative analysis of power grid disaster causes under sudden natural disasters to obtain a power transmission line disaster chain and a disaster chain Bow-tie model; calculating according to a preset expert questionnaire of the power transmission line fault to obtain the prior probability of the power transmission line fault; and according to the prior probability of the power transmission line fault and the disaster chain Bow-tie model, performing posterior probability calculation through Bayesian simulation software Netica to obtain a power grid risk assessment result. The power grid risk assessment method is strong in timeliness and high in accuracy according to dynamic evolution of natural disaster chains by combining a Bayesian network.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Landslide hazard monitoring-oriented non-convex area coverage method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a landslide disaster monitoring-oriented non-convex area coverage method and system, which relate to the field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing a landslide occurrence probability fitting model, and constructing a data set through the landslide occurrence probability fitting model; constructing a landslide probability density prediction model; training a landslide probability density prediction model through a data set; determining landslide to be predicted; predicting landslide occurrence probability of each service point of the landslide to be predicted by using the trained landslide probability density prediction model; designing an intelligent body optimal coverage control strategy based on a cyclic search algorithm; and determining the optimal coverage position of each intelligent agent of the landslide to be predicted by combining the optimal coverage control strategy of the intelligent agents and the occurrence probability of the landslide. A novel distributed coverage control strategy is designed, and low-cost and high-efficiency coverage of the multi-agent coverage system in a hollow non-convex unknown environment is realized.

title_en: Intelligent fire evacuation indication method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting evacuation indication method, an intelligent fire-fighting evacuation indication system, an intelligent fire-fighting evacuation indication device and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of intelligent fire-fighting indication, and the intelligent fire-fighting evacuation indication method comprises the following steps: step one, arranging sensors in a building, designing timing self-calibration and triggering self-calibration flow of the sensors, processing data among different sensors through a data fusion algorithm, identifying abnormal values, and testing self-calibration and mutual detection mechanisms of the sensors; according to the invention, the VR technology is combined for evacuation exercise, the familiarity of personnel to evacuation paths is improved, the AR technology is used for providing real-time navigation, intuitively guiding evacuation directions, and integrating the functions of fire alarm, evacuation indication and communication into a building management system, so that integrated management is realized, a simulation scene is constructed according to building structure and people flow data, and the evacuation efficiency and safety are further evaluated.

title_en: Method for segmenting and quantifying concrete structure damage after fire disaster
abstract_en: A method for segmenting and quantifying concrete structural damage after fire relates to the technical field of concrete structural damage assessment after fire, and firstly, the type of damage on the surface of an RC structural member after fire is determined and a data set is constructed. Then UperNet _ ConvNeXt was constructed for training and testing. And then performing deep quantitative analysis on the damage by using an image segmentation technology. Aiming at the problem of complicated range calculation caused by variables such as picture size, shooting distance and the like, a three-dimensional cube of 2cm multiplied by 2cm is innovatively introduced as a reference object, and the immobilization of the range of each picture is realized. Subsequently, the lesions were classified into three types of linear cracks, reticular cracks, and bursts, and detailed quantification was performed. The accuracy of the quantified network was verified by comparison with the actual fracture and burst sizes. Finally, a GUI interface is designed to realize automatic segmentation and quantification of the damage of the laminated beam after fire.

title_en: Rock collapse risk assessment method and system based on landing speed prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster assessment, and discloses a rock collapse risk assessment method and system based on ground speed prediction. And judging the movement mode of the rock burst block by using a mechanical analysis model, classifying and evaluating the risk level, and improving the disaster prevention and reduction pertinence. And for the rolling block, further constructing a rock collapse kinetic model, calculating the landing speed, and determining the risk level by combining a preset threshold value, so that the evaluation result is visual and easy to understand. According to the method, the multi-factor simulation prediction of the rock collapse process is comprehensively considered, so that the accurate evaluation of the rock collapse risk is realized, the evaluation accuracy and reliability are improved, a powerful technical support is provided for disaster prevention and reduction, and the disaster loss is effectively reduced.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Intelligent assignment scheduling method and system for ambulance
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent assignment scheduling method and system for emergency ambulances, comprising the following steps: acquiring real-time emergency call data, inputting an intelligent assignment scheduling model, and outputting an optimal emergency ambulance assignment scheduling scheme, wherein the construction and training processes of the intelligent assignment scheduling model are as follows: s1, constructing a traffic network model of a research area; s2, generating simulated emergency call data; s3, designing a state space, an action space and a state transition mechanism of emergency ambulance assignment scheduling, and constructing an interaction environment simulator; s4, designing a reward function, a strategy network and an evaluation network, constructing an intelligent assignment scheduling model, and introducing action shielding rules into the strategy network to limit actions taken in a given state; s5, training the intelligent assignment scheduling model by using the simulated emergency call data. Compared with the prior art, the invention can generate the optimal emergency ambulance assignment scheduling scheme while compressing the pre-hospital emergency response time.

title_en: Comprehensive decision method for high-temperature disaster prevention measures
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive decision method for high-temperature disaster prevention measures, which is used for determining a factor Wen Fengxian; establishing a mapping relation between each high Wen Fangzai measure and the high-temperature risk factors; determining a target research area; collecting historical data of high-temperature evaluation indexes, and building and training a deep learning model; the deep learning model takes the high-temperature evaluation index as input and takes the high-temperature risk factor as output; predicting a high Wen Fengxian factor of a target research area in a specified time based on the deep learning model; based on the prediction result, establishing a decision matrix comprising different high-temperature disaster prevention measures; converting the decision matrix into a fuzzy evaluation matrix based on a trapezoidal fuzzy number algorithm; performing defuzzification treatment on the fuzzy evaluation matrix to obtain expected values of normalized attribute values; sequencing the high-temperature disaster prevention measures, and obtaining an optimal decision based on the mapping relation between the high Wen Fangzai measure and the high-temperature risk factor. The method can solve the problems that disaster prevention measures cannot be decided in advance in the prior art, decision redundancy, low decision efficiency, limited decision precision and the like, and can dynamically and accurately decide short-term measures for upcoming high-temperature extreme climates.

title_en: Method for macroscopic identifying disaster event of blocking river based on width of river valley and slope change of main river
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for macroscopic identifying a river blockage disaster event based on the width of a river valley and the slope change of a main river, which relates to the technical field of river blockage landslide and debris flow disaster identification and comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining high-precision DEM elevation data; S2, calculating section fitting average values of the central section, the upstream section and the downstream section respectively in the direction perpendicular to the main river, S3, calculating main river ratio drop of the central section, the upstream section and the downstream section respectively in the direction parallel to the main river, S4, and determining the possibility that the slope/channel to be judged has historically occurred a river blocking disaster event and the possibility that the river blocking disaster event occurs in the future according to the results of S2 and S3. The method not only can judge whether the area to be identified has a river blocking disaster event in history or not and whether the river blocking disaster event occurs later or not in a macroscopic manner, but also can provide a verification basis for the result of numerical simulation, and provide a target area for site investigation and sampling measurement, thereby improving the accuracy of judging and identifying the river blocking disaster event.

title_en: Important facility early warning critical rainfall calculation method based on high-precision digital earth surface model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an important facility early warning critical rainfall calculation method based on a high-precision digital earth surface model, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting high-precision point cloud mapping data of cities where important facilities are located, data such as current land utilization classification and the like, and collecting submerged water depth data of key positions; s2, correcting various collected data; s3, fusing the corrected various data; s4, dynamically dividing the sub-catchment areas in three stages based on the fused topographic data; s5, constructing a multi-city rainfall flood runoff model based on Bayesian average; s6, inputting rainfall data under different reproduction periods into a multi-city rainfall runoff model based on Bayesian average constructed in the step S5, predicting a flooding result under rainfall conditions of different reproduction periods, and calculating the early warning critical rainfall of each important facility storm disaster caused by the flooding result; the invention overcomes the simulation error caused by the structural uncertainty of the single urban rainfall flood runoff model and improves the accuracy of storm disaster early warning.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation simulation device, evacuation simulation method, and evacuation simulation program
abstract_en: Provided is an evacuation simulation device (10), wherein a setting unit (15b) sets: chronological change of an event representing a disaster; an agent representing a person who moves at the time of the disaster; and a target that can be a movement destination of the agent. An estimation unit (15d) uses an agent movement calculator (14a), which is trained for each agent, to estimate the movement of each agent to the target associated with the chronological change of an event.

title_en: Intelligent detection and alarm method and system for fire fighting fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting fire intelligent detection alarm method and a fire-fighting fire intelligent detection alarm system, which relate to the technical field of fire protection and comprise the following steps: deploying a smoke detector, collecting building environment data, preprocessing the data, transmitting the building environment data to a fire alarm center, and analyzing and determining fire characteristics; collecting historical fire data, and further determining a specific grade corresponding to the fire characteristic according to the obtained fire characteristic through a training model; and determining a fire risk index according to the identified fire characteristics, and carrying out fire grade assessment on the building environment by combining the training model. According to the invention, through monitoring the fire characteristics of smoke concentration, temperature and humidity in the environment in real time, abnormal conditions are found, the system can rapidly judge, alarm signals are sent out through various modes such as an audible and visual alarm, a fire telephone system and the like, and the real-time transmission and sharing of fire information are realized through the intelligent cloud-eliminating alarm receiving platform and the intelligent platform of intelligent Yun Wei signaling public signals.

title_en: Big data fire monitoring method and system based on satellite images
abstract_en: The invention provides a big data fire monitoring method and a system based on satellite images, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out significance enhancement on the satellite image to obtain a satellite image with enhanced significance; dividing the satellite image with enhanced significance to obtain a divided satellite image; calculating pixel characteristics of the segmented satellite images; setting corresponding labels for different pixel characteristics according to fire conditions of a target area, and inputting the pixel characteristics as samples into a neural network for training to obtain a big data fire monitoring model; and (5) completing fire monitoring of the area to be monitored by using the big data fire monitoring model. According to the invention, through carrying out significance enhancement and segmentation on the satellite image and combining with calculation of pixel characteristics and training of a neural network, accurate identification and monitoring of a fire disaster area can be realized, and the possibility of false alarm and false omission is reduced.

title_en: Dynamic botnet detection system based on incremental learning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information safety, and provides a dynamic botnet detection system based on incremental learning, which comprises a flow processing module, a model training module, an experience caching module and an experience replay module; the flow processing module is used for generating the characteristics of nodes and edges of the flow; the model training module is used for training a graph neural network model based on attention node sampling; the experience caching module is used for extracting key subgraphs of the nodes according to attention sampling results after the graph neural network model is trained, and storing the key subgraphs in an experience caching area after aggregation, and maintaining and updating the key subgraphs; and the experience replay module is used for selecting the key subgraph to replay in the new batch data, re-aggregating the new batch data characteristics and performing graph neural network model fine tuning. The application extracts the key control topology from the botnet and plays back the key control topology in the batch before the model retraining process, so that the model dynamic data evolves and has the disaster-resistant forgetting capacity.

title_en: Distribution network channel three-dimensional flooding visual simulation method based on distributed water level monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network channel three-dimensional flooding visual simulation method based on distributed water level monitoring, which comprises the steps of deploying distributed water level monitoring sensors at key positions of a distribution network channel based on the distributed water level monitoring, uploading data to a monitoring host in real time in a wired or wireless mode for historical data storage, and constructing an urban distribution network water level monitoring network system; carrying out three-dimensional modeling on a distribution network model based on laser point cloud data acquired by distribution network equipment; according to the invention, the comprehensive and real-time water level monitoring of the distribution network channel is realized, so that the accuracy and reliability of monitoring data are improved; through a three-dimensional visual simulation technology, the flooding condition of the distribution network channel is intuitively displayed, and the efficiency and accuracy of emergency response are improved; the stability and the sustainability of urban power supply are ensured by improving the safety and the reliability of the operation and maintenance of the urban distribution network channel.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: High-precision calculation method for wide-area explosion flow field and multi-disaster coupling disaster effect of chemical industry park
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision calculation method for an explosion flow field and multi-disaster coupling disaster effect of a chemical industry park. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a two-dimensional map automatic modeling algorithm based on the geographic information park to construct a three-dimensional geometric model of the chemical industry park; selecting a weighted essentially oscillation-free format, and constructing a 5-order-precision high-resolution differential format for simulation; establishing a multiphase flow mathematical model by adopting a volume fraction method in combination with a thermal-force coupling effect model, and simulating the damage of explosion to building structures and equipment; constructing a digital-analog fusion system to realize quick prediction; and through experimental verification, the numerical model is optimized. The method can rapidly predict the influence of explosion disasters, provide scientific basis for disaster prevention and reduction, and improve the safety and the risk resistance of a chemical industry park.

title_en: Anti-aliasing method, device, equipment and medium for ultra-high lead electroencephalograph signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electroencephalogram signal processing, and discloses an anti-aliasing method, device, equipment and medium for an ultra-high lead electroencephalogram signal. The method comprises the steps of obtaining ultra-high lead electroencephalogram data acquired by an electroencephalogram system and constructing a training set and a testing set; performing ensemble empirical mode decomposition, wavelet transformation and CP decomposition on the training set to obtain a channel factor matrix; selecting a significant channel based on channel factor matrix calculation and selecting a target channel from the significant channel; and judging whether the target channel is an optimal channel or not based on the classification result of the convolution gating circulating unit model to the test set. According to the invention, the frequency spectrum information is extracted through wavelet transformation to improve the performance of the classifier, and the empirical mode decomposition is added before the wavelet transformation to reduce the mode aliasing and improve the noise resistance and resolution, so that the optimal channel is determined according to the classification result to realize effective channel selection, the redundant information is effectively removed to reduce the feature dimension, the overfitting and dimension disaster are avoided, and the mode classification recognition performance is improved.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGHUA BRAIN MACHINE FUSION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Farmland crop pest and disease damage identification method based on hyperspectral technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying diseases and insect pests of farmland crops based on hyperspectral technology, which relates to the technical field of agricultural crop disaster identification and comprises the following steps: acquiring hyperspectral data of a target farmland and time sequence data corresponding to the hyperspectral data; preprocessing and extracting features of the hyperspectral data in sequence to obtain the features of plant diseases and insect pests; inputting the plant disease and insect pest characteristics and corresponding time sequence data into a preset training model for training to obtain a constructed farmland crop plant disease and insect pest identification model; and identifying the data to be detected according to the farmland crop disease and pest identification model to obtain an identification result. The hyperspectral technology can provide high-frequency data acquisition, can realize real-time monitoring and rapid feedback of diseases and insect pests of farmland crops by combining time sequence data analysis, and is beneficial to timely taking control measures.
assignees: INST WATER RESOURCES PASTERAL AREA MINI WATER RESOURCES PRC

title_en: Disaster fault testing method and related device for power distribution automation system
abstract_en: The application belongs to a fault test method, and provides a disaster damage topology model of a distribution automation system and a related device, which are used for constructing a hierarchical structure distribution network disaster damage topology model, setting faults on buses or upper ends of the buses in the distribution network disaster damage topology model, generating a fault scene correspondingly in real time at lower ends of the buses in the distribution network disaster damage topology model, simulating a signal triggering mechanism of the fault occurrence scene, transmitting the fault scene into a tested distribution automation master station in a secondary signal injection mode, observing specific operation given by the tested distribution automation master station at the moment of simulating the disaster damage fault occurrence, judging whether the tested distribution automation master station has a distribution automation system disaster damage processing function, and rapidly processing the faults at the moment of fault occurrence to accelerate the recovery of the power supply speed.

title_en: Design method of expansive soil core-filled embankment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a design method of an expansive soil core-filled embankment, which is characterized in that the relationship between the expansive force and the water content is determined through an expansive force test of expansive soil, then the relationship between the water content of the inner volume of an expansive soil core-filled roadbed in a plum rain season and the binding thickness H and the compaction coefficient K is researched by a numerical simulation method, and the expansive force development condition of the core-filled expansive soil is determined by combining the expansive force test result of the expansive soil. Finally, the principles of saving materials and reducing waste are adhered to, and the proper binding thickness H and compaction coefficient K are determined by ensuring that the constraint load is larger than the expansion force generated by the core filling expansion soil in the plum raining period, and whether the proposed design scheme meets the standard requirement is verified. The invention effectively solves the problems of insufficient theoretical basis and missing design method of the expanded soil core-filled embankment in the plum rain climate zone, fully utilizes the roadbed engineering excavated expanded soil in the expanded soil zone, greatly reduces the disaster probability of the expanded soil embankment in the plum rain climate zone, and can obviously reduce the line operation and maintenance cost.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 16TH BUREAU GROUP RAILWAY TRANSP ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional water damage simulation device for model test and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional water damage simulation device for a model test and a use method thereof, wherein the multifunctional water damage simulation device comprises a model test box filled with model test soil, the model test box is detachably connected with a device bracket, a multifunctional water damage simulation system is detachably arranged on the device bracket, and the multifunctional water damage simulation system is connected with a water supply system; the multifunctional water disaster simulation system comprises an atomization rainfall nozzle capable of adjusting the atomization degree and the rainfall range of rainwater, a flood water disaster simulation device positioned on the surface layer of simulation test soil and a groundwater disaster simulation device deeply simulating test soil. The multifunctional water damage simulation device for the model test and the application method thereof can simulate various water damage simultaneously, and enrich test types; the whole set of multifunctional water damage simulation device is convenient to assemble and disassemble, light in weight and easy to carry; the operation is convenient, the scene is many, and the experimental compatibility is strong.

title_en: Self-balancing spliced multidirectional loading device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunnel catastrophe simulation, and discloses a self-balancing spliced multidirectional loading device, which comprises a loading mechanism for fixing a rock-soil body, wherein the loading mechanism comprises a lower supporting component, a side loading component and an upper loading component, the side loading component is arranged in a manner of being abutted with the side wall of the rock-soil body, and the upper loading component is positioned at the top end of the rock-soil body; the side loading assembly comprises a plurality of side loading frames which can be disassembled and spliced; a plurality of independently arranged side loading hydraulic cylinders are arranged in the side loading frame, and the output ends of the side loading hydraulic cylinders face the rock-soil body and are in butt loading with side loading plates on the side walls of the rock-soil body. The invention has convenient use, can freely splice loading models with different sizes, effectively reduces the cost of simulation experiments, has the three-dimensional loading capability of constructing catastrophe models for tunnels and underground structures, and can develop the three-dimensional simulation of surrounding rock catastrophe in the tunnel construction process, the experimental research on the disease evolution of tunnel supporting structures, the coupling effect of multiple disasters and the like.

title_en: Drill rod
abstract_en: The invention provides a drill rod, and belongs to the technical field of rock drilling tools. The structure comprises: the protection tube is installed in the sheath bottom, and the sheath is continuous to communicate with each other with the protection tube, and the shaft-like borer steel is located inside the protection tube, installs the sensor on the shaft-like borer steel, and fixed mounting has indicator and stationary blade outside the sheath, and the control key of solenoid valve is installed in the stroke scope of stationary blade, goes up segmentation pipe and main fluid pipe, lower segmentation pipe and main fluid pipe, goes up segmentation pipe and auxiliary fluid pipe, lower segmentation pipe and auxiliary fluid pipe all through T type connector connection. Compared with a common drill rod, the invention not only plays a role in stress and guiding, but also utilizes the carried sensor to sense the underground water penetration condition in real time, and can alarm the water penetration phenomenon in the drill hole in time. Meanwhile, by means of the indicator on the overground part of the drill rod, the control key can be triggered according to the motion state of the drill rod, and an emergency response function is exerted when necessary. The invention effectively expands the functions of the drill rod and has obvious technical progress.
assignees: SHANDONG YANNENG TAIDE HEAVY IND CO LTD

title_en: Gas outburst prevention technology in rapid coal uncovering process of close-range coal seam group rock cross-cut
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine uncovering, and discloses a gas outburst prevention process in the process of rapid coal uncovering of a close-range coal seam group rock cross gate, which comprises a frame body, wherein a movable wheel is arranged at the bottom end of the frame body; the device also comprises a drilling mechanism, wherein the drilling mechanism is arranged in the frame body and comprises a communicating pipe, and the communicating pipe is connected with the negative pressure ventilation equipment; the adaptation mechanism is arranged in the frame body and used for adjusting the drilling mechanism; the protection mechanism is arranged at one end of the drilling mechanism. According to the invention, by utilizing the drilling mechanism, drilling can be performed reciprocally when coal uncovering operation is performed, the coal uncovering efficiency is improved, the mining area can be protected by matching with the protection mechanism, the risk of splash generation is avoided, gas can be extracted along the rotary pipe by matching with the guiding of the protection cover and the negative pressure ventilation equipment, and gas is rapidly discharged, so that gas disaster prevention and control are effectively performed, better adaptation is realized by matching with the adaptation mechanism, and the equipment is ensured to be more stable when driven.

title_en: Wet-type drill chip monitoring coal water solid-liquid separation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wet drilling cuttings monitoring coal water solid-liquid separation device, which comprises a supporting base (8), a vibrating screen box (10) arranged on the supporting base (8), a filter basket (1) arranged in the vibrating screen box (10) and a pneumatic vibrator (5) used for driving the vibrating screen box (10) to vibrate, wherein a solid-liquid coal-liquid mixture is contained in the filter basket (1), a gap is reserved between the bottom surface of the vibrating screen box (10) and the bottom surface of the filter basket (1), a liquid outlet (4) is formed in the vibrating screen box (10), and the device further comprises a pneumatic controller used for controlling the pneumatic vibrator (5) to start when the coal dust humidity in the filter basket (1) is higher than a preset humidity so that the coal dust humidity in the filter basket (1) is lower than the preset humidity. The wet drill cuttings monitoring coal water solid-liquid separation device can separate coal dust rapidly and efficiently, accurately measure the weight of filtered coal dust, and accordingly can evaluate the stability of stratum and predict potential disasters.

title_en: Landslide identification method, equipment and storage medium based on multipath feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide identification method, equipment and a storage medium based on multipath feature fusion, and relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a landslide image dataset, preprocessing, dividing the dataset, constructing a multi-path landslide recognition model fusing a dual-attention mechanism, training the multi-path landslide recognition model by using the dataset, outputting the multi-path landslide recognition model after training, inputting the landslide image data to be recognized into the trained multi-path landslide recognition model, and outputting a landslide recognition result. The apparatus and the storage medium are for implementing the method. The multi-path landslide identification model has the advantages that the multi-path landslide identification model is provided, the depth interaction of different types of landslide image data on the characteristic layer is realized, the characteristic information with high resolution is kept, the accuracy of landslide identification is remarkably improved, the calculation cost is reduced, the real-time performance of landslide identification is remarkably improved, and the real-time monitoring and early warning are realized.

title_en: Fluid large model-based intelligent prediction method and device for waterlogging disasters of power grid facilities
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power industry, in particular to an intelligent prediction method and device for waterlogging disasters of power grid facilities based on a fluid large model. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring precipitation prediction data of business prediction; inputting rainfall prediction data into the constructed waterlogging model, and outputting waterlogging ponding depth distribution; acquiring parameter data of key facilities of a power grid; and obtaining a waterlogging disaster prediction result of the key facilities of the power grid according to the waterlogging ponding depth distribution and the parameter data of the key facilities of the power grid. The method can obviously improve the accuracy of waterlogging and ponding diffusion prediction, and has important significance for forecasting waterlogging of key facilities of the power grid. The improved method can solve the problem of insufficient training samples of the true value caused by insufficient accumulated water monitoring equipment, and improves the space-time resolution and precision of the prediction model by coupling a large model, thereby providing more reliable support for operation and planning of key facilities of a power grid.
assignees: NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Dynamic catastrophe test system and method for simulating river blockage and breaking of high-level landslide ice shingle bank
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a dynamic disaster test system and a dynamic disaster test method for simulating river blocking and breaking of high-level landslide ice shingle bank, wherein the dynamic disaster test system for simulating river blocking and breaking of high-level landslide ice shingle bank comprises a three-dimensional scanning system, a landslide test system, a river basin simulation system, a water supply system and a numerical control system, wherein the whole process of high-level landslide ice-and-moraine accumulation formation, osmotic deformation, breach evolution and dam breaking flood evolution disaster chain is simulated through the landslide test system, the river basin simulation system and the water supply system, high-definition images and data of the high-level landslide ice-and-moraine formation and the dam breaking are obtained through the three-dimensional scanning system, the three-dimensional reconstruction is carried out on the soil-stone-ice mixture accumulation into a dam and the seepage dam breaking process through the numerical control system, and the development and evolution rule and the dynamic mechanism of the dam breaking mouth of the high-level landslide ice-and the dam breaking are uncovered, and the full three-dimensional dynamic visualization and the digital characterization of the dam breaking cascade are realized.

title_en: Flood early warning method and system for power transmission line area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for early warning flood in a power transmission line area, and belongs to the technical field of power system safety. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: acquiring scene information of a target power transmission line region, constructing a simulation scene model according to the scene information, and performing hydrologic simulation based on the simulation scene model to determine simulated water level data of the target power transmission line region; determining prediction grading early warning indexes of flood of power equipment and facility areas in the target power transmission line area, and determining index values of the grading early warning indexes according to the simulated water level data; and judging the index value of the grading early warning index by using a preset state judging function, and if the judging result is not 0, sending out flood early warning for the target power transmission line area. According to the invention, through hydrologic simulation, the flood disaster of the target area can be effectively predicted, and the loss caused by flood can be reduced through effective early warning.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Data processing method and device, nonvolatile storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method and device, a nonvolatile storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first sample set and a second sample set; training a support vector machine model by using a first feature vector in a first sample set and a preset disaster grade label corresponding to the first feature vector to obtain a first target model; performing iterative training on the first target model to obtain a plurality of second target models, and performing combination processing on the plurality of second target models to obtain a third target model; and carrying out optimizing treatment on the first target penalty coefficient and the first target kernel function parameter according to a preset fitness function, and determining the occurrence probability of flood disasters of different grades by utilizing a target model comprising the second target penalty coefficient and the second target kernel function parameter. The application solves the technical problem of lower prediction precision caused by insufficient consideration of disaster diversity in the prediction method of related natural disasters.

title_en: System for dynamically analyzing and improving physical performance and injury mitigation in tactical performers
abstract_en: This system can be a combination of hardware and equipment, software, training methodologies, data feedback loops and methods of instruction and activity so that target individual such tactical athletes' (e.g., military, law enforcement, firefighters, first responders, and the like) performance can be improved through following this integrative performance training system. This system involves evaluations and individualized training prescriptions that are automatically and continuously modified according to changes in the individual's performance measures. This system also includes assistance and instructions that can accompany training allow for biofeedback to be used to maximize neuromuscular performance during each session. In one embodiment, individualized performance training system can meet the target individual at their current ability levels and specifically target deficits to improve performance outcomes. In one embodiment, individualized performance training system can meet the target individual mission performance goals.

title_en: Firefighter Training Assembly
abstract_en: A firefighter training assembly includes a plurality of firefighting tools which each has a handle and a head. The head associated with each of the plurality of firefighting tools has a unique structure with respect to each other. Each of the plurality of firefighting tools includes an outer layer comprised of a lightweight material for wielding the firefighting tools in a training environment. Each of the firefighting tools includes a central core comprised of a weighted material to simulate the weight of genuine firefighting tools in the training environment.

title_en: Apparatus for predicting disaster risk of building winds
title_ko: 빌딩풍 재해 위험도 예측 장치
abstract_en: Provided is an apparatus for predicting a risk of a building wind disaster, which comprises: a sensor unit; a target data acquisition unit; a learning dataset generation module; a building wind image storage unit; a prediction output unit; and a preceding forecasting module. According to the present invention, prediction information of the building wind based on the current weather condition can be provided in real time, thereby preventing damage to the building wind in advance and quickly responding to the building wind.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빌딩풍 재해 위험도 예측 장치에 관한 것으로서, 초고층 빌딩에 인접한 도로시설물에 설치되어 풍속, 풍향, 온도, 기압, 습도 중 적어도 하나의 기상 데이터를 기설정된 시간 단위로 측정하는 센서부와, 현재 시점에 상기 센서부를 통해 측정한 상기 기상 데이터에 대응하는 대상 데이터를 획득하는 대상 데이터 획득부와, 상기 초고층 빌딩 주변의 풍환경에 대한 CFD 시뮬레이션 분석 결과에 따른 빌딩풍 이미지를 획득하도록 사전 훈련된 예측 모델에 대하여 상기 대상 데이터를 입력값으로 적용하는 경우에 출력되는 제1 빌딩풍 이미지를 현재 기상 상태를 바탕으로 예측한 빌딩풍 예측 정보로 출력하는 예측 출력부와, 상기 제1 빌딩풍 이미지와 보퍼트 풍력 계급에 따른 상기 대상 데이터의 풍속 등급보다 한 단계 높은 풍속 등급에 대응되는 제2 빌딩풍 이미지의 비교에 따른 빌딩풍의 변화 정도를 시각화한 이미지에 대응하는 선행 예측 정보를 생성하여 화면상에 표시하는 선행 예보 모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 따라, 현재 기상 상태를 바탕으로 한 빌딩풍의 예측 정보를 실시간으로 제공 가능하여 빌딩풍 피해를 사전에 방지하고 신속하게 대응할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fire risk early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and discloses a fire risk early warning method, a fire risk early warning device, fire risk early warning equipment and a fire risk early warning storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining types of areas to be early warned, distributing types of sensors according to the types, and setting coordinates for each sensor according to geographic coordinates; processing the multi-sensor data to obtain processed sensing data; acquiring a historical fire risk early warning data set through a cloud server, dividing the data set into a training set and a verification set, training by adopting the training set to obtain a fire risk early warning model, and judging the current fire risk degree; when the fire risk early warning model judges that the fire risk reaches a preset threshold, an early warning signal is sent to a decision maker fire alarm center. The device comprises a data acquisition module, a data judgment module and a signal sending module. The invention improves the accuracy, timeliness and effect of fire disaster early warning by comprehensively utilizing various sensor technologies, establishing a fire disaster risk early warning model and timely responding to early warning signals.
assignees: TUOBA HYDROPOWER ENGINEERING CONSTRUCTION MAN BUREAU HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUAAN ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD;POWERCHINA ZHONGNAN ENG CORP LTD;KUNMING HUALONG ZHITENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Microseismic waveform multi-task integrated analysis method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microseismic waveform multi-task integrated analysis method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a multichannel microseismic waveform data set, wherein the multichannel microseismic waveform data set comprises sample data and tag data; training the neural network by using the multichannel microseismic waveform data set to obtain a multi-task processing model; and inputting the target multichannel microseismic waveform data into a multi-task processing model, and respectively outputting the target focus positioning, the target event energy value and the target moment magnitude through the multi-task processing model. The invention can integrate and output the target parameters more quickly and accurately, so as to update the stability development state of the surrounding rock more quickly, and remarkably improve the reliability and accuracy of disaster early warning.

title_en: Space-time multivariable wind field wind speed prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: A space-time multivariable wind field wind speed prediction method based on deep learning belongs to the technical field of wind field prediction. Acquiring the position C  k , the topography l  k , and the recorded multi-field environmental data of the plurality of different position sensors, including: wind field data: wind speed W  s , wind direction W  d , temperature and humidity field data: the temperature T, the humidity H and the rainfall R of the rain field data, the acquired multi-sensor multivariable time sequence data are processed by using a method based on a variation self-encoder; and carrying out 0-1 normalization on the data, taking the processed data as a historical time sequence data set, and constructing a wind field prediction training set and a test set from the historical time sequence data set. The method can accurately predict the wind speed change of the wind field in the mountain canyon region, and apply the prediction to wind disaster early warning, construction safety planning and project management and optimization of wind power generation, thereby realizing important decision support and safety guarantee for relevant industries of developing building and wind power generation projects in complex terrains.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for analyzing reverse-impact type movable fault avoidance distance based on statistics and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of avoidance distance data processing, and particularly discloses a method for analyzing the avoidance distance of a thrust active fault based on statistics and numerical simulation, which comprises the following steps: the effective width judgment, fault parameter influence index judgment and avoidance distance analysis are carried out, the avoidance indexes of the thrust movable faults are obtained by judging the effective width of the avoidance distance of the thrust movable faults and the ratio of the deformation zone width of the upper disc to the deformation zone width of the lower disc of the thrust movable faults, the risk that a building is directly damaged in a thrust earthquake can be quantified, the avoidance distance of the thrust movable faults is obtained by matching, the thrust movable faults are finally analyzed, corresponding avoidance measures are adopted, the negative influence caused by the thrust earthquake disasters is reduced, meanwhile, the avoidance distance of the thrust movable faults is obtained by a method combining data statistics analysis and numerical simulation calculation, and the analysis incompleteness and the result inaccuracy caused by single-dimensional data are reduced.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method for mine geological environment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring of mine environments, and discloses an intelligent monitoring method of mine geological environments, which comprises the following steps: step one, building a mine virtual model: constructing a mine virtual three-dimensional model by taking G IS system basic data as a main body, taking mine site on-site geological scanning data as auxiliary body deficiency, and taking mine geological data based on the G IS system basic data and the auxiliary body deficiency as a model basic framework; step two, monitoring network construction: dividing an actual mine area, synchronizing data of the divided area to a mine virtual three-dimensional model, and arranging vibration amplitude sensors according to the area of the divided area. The mine is monitored in a classified mode by constructing and actually monitoring a network through the mine virtual model, and the artificial intelligent neural network is used as a brain of the mine virtual model to perform earthquake focus simulation training, earthquake point linkage response training and sudden geological emergency response training, so that an intelligent monitoring mode of the mine geological environment is perfected, and the timeliness and the intelligent level of data are higher.
assignees: MINGCHUANG HUIYUAN GUIZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting micro-seismic source energy based on physical rule constraint and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the energy of a micro-seismic source based on physical rule constraint and deep learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a microseismic waveform data set, wherein the microseismic waveform data set comprises six-channel microseismic event waveforms, corresponding event waveform energy value tags and a displacement double integral value tag based on spectrum; combining six-channel microseism event waveforms as input, using corresponding event waveform energy value labels as output, using a spectrum-based displacement double integral value label as an additional training constraint item, and training a neural network to obtain a microseism energy prediction model; inputting the target microseism waveform data into a microseism energy prediction model, and outputting a target microseism energy value corresponding to the target microseism waveform data through the microseism energy prediction model. The invention can obtain accurate target microseismic energy value, thereby improving the reliability and accuracy of disaster early warning.

title_en: Transmission tower flooding risk identification method and system based on active and passive remote sensing data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid disaster monitoring, and discloses a method and a system for identifying flooding risk of a transmission tower by fusing active and passive remote sensing data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring active and passive remote sensing data comprising multi-temporal optical images before and after flooding of a transmission tower and SAR images, and fusing the images to obtain different fused images, and constructing a change detection data set based on the different fused images; constructing a change detection network model comprising a feature extraction module, a multi-scale attention module and a measurement module, and carrying out training by taking a change detection data set into the change detection network model to obtain a trained change detection network; inputting the images of the target power transmission channels into a trained change detection network, identifying the flooding range and outputting the flooding risk result of the power transmission towers. The invention utilizes the abundant spectral information and higher resolution of the optical image, and the SAR image is not limited by weather conditions, thereby realizing all-weather and high-timeliness monitoring of the flood range.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for predicting shallow gas scale by gradient lifting tree based on particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of marine drilling safety guarantee, and discloses a method and a system for predicting shallow gas scale by a gradient lifting tree based on particle swarm optimization, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a database by utilizing shallow gas geological disaster identification site simulation, and randomly dividing the database into a training set and a testing set; training a shallow gas scale prediction model of the gradient lifting regression tree based on initial parameters through a training set, and testing the trained shallow gas scale prediction model of the gradient lifting regression tree by adopting a testing set; and optimizing the shallow gas scale prediction model of the gradient lifting regression tree after the test by a particle swarm algorithm to obtain the shallow gas scale prediction model of the gradient lifting regression tree based on the optimization of the particle swarm algorithm, and taking a shallow gas experimental data sample as input data of the prediction model to output a shallow gas scale prediction value. The invention solves the problem that the scale of the shallow gas cannot be predicted quantitatively, and can accurately predict the scale of the shallow gas.

title_en: Information pushing method and device based on emergency evacuation and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The specification discloses an information pushing method and device based on emergency evacuation and an electronic device, and specifically includes: and constructing a simulation target area according to the obtained geographic information data corresponding to the target area and the building map, and carrying out cell division on the simulation target area. Meanwhile, according to personal characteristic data of each person, a personal simulation object of each person is constructed, and a cell area occupied by the personal simulation object of each person in a simulation target area is determined. Based on the simulation target area, each person simulation object and the cell area corresponding to each person simulation object, performing simulation test of personnel evacuation on the target building according to a preset rule. And pushing information according to the simulation test result. The method can fully consider the influence of indoor and outdoor factors on the whole evacuation process and each other, thereby preparing an emergency evacuation strategy with high practicability and effectively guaranteeing the life safety of people when encountering sudden dangerous situations.

title_en: Method for optimizing runoff regulation capacity of sponge facility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for optimizing runoff regulation capacity of sponge facilities, which comprises the following steps: collecting and recording rainfall, infiltration, overflow and outflow process data of different sponge measures based on an urban underlying surface rainfall runoff simulation test system; constructing an SWMM model based on the measured data, the test monitoring data and the structural parameters of the sponge facility in the sponge modification area, and calibrating and verifying the model by utilizing the measured data and the test data; simulating and identifying critical influence parameters of runoff regulation of the sponge facility under different rainfall and LID parameter scenes based on the SWMM model; and coupling the SWMM model with a multi-objective optimization algorithm, and simulating to obtain an optimal solution set of sponge facility parameters meeting the sponge measure underlying surface outflow and infiltration targets. The method for optimizing the internal structure of the sponge facility by combining test monitoring and numerical simulation is beneficial to fundamentally improving the runoff reduction capacity of the sponge facility, and can provide important technical support for urban flood control and disaster reduction.

title_en: Real-time detection device and detection method for hidden disaster-causing hidden danger of underground coal mine drilling
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time detection device and a detection method for hidden disaster-causing hidden danger of underground coal mine drilling, wherein the detection device comprises a detection system circuit and a power system circuit, and the detection system circuit comprises a signal acquisition circuit, a signal control circuit, a signal processing circuit and a signal transmission circuit which are sequentially connected; the power supply system circuit comprises a power supply circuit, a power supply control circuit and a current protection circuit which are connected in sequence; the signal transmission circuit is connected with the power supply circuit; the real-time detection device can effectively detect hidden disaster-causing hidden dangers of underground drilling of a coal mine in real time, so that potential safety hazards in production are eliminated, and an effective evaluation means is provided for checking and accepting drilling construction. The real-time detection device is suitable for mine drilling, the signal acquisition is rapid and accurate, the measurement can be performed in the pushing process of the drill rod, and the rapid signal acquisition is realized while the pushing of the drill rod is not delayed.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Dynamic island division method and system considering controllable load under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic island division method and a system considering controllable load under extreme disasters, comprising the following steps: simulating an extreme disaster model, constructing an element fault probability model, and generating a fault scene of the power distribution network under the extreme disaster according to the extreme disaster model and the element fault probability model; under a fault scene, establishing an island division mathematical model based on uncontrollable load and controllable load, and carrying out subsection decoupling on island division in a single time section to obtain an island range adjustment stage and an island equivalent recovery optimal stage; in the island range adjustment stage, grid optimization is carried out based on uncontrollable loads to obtain a grid structure, and in the island equivalent recovery optimal stage, power scheduling is carried out based on the grid structure according to the sequence of firstly adjusting transferable loads and then adjusting reducible loads until the whole disaster process is traversed to obtain a dynamic island division scheme of the whole power distribution network; the island operation stability and reliability can be improved by adopting the island operation method and the island operation device.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Landslide vulnerability prediction method and system based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide vulnerability prediction method and system based on convolutional neural network, which comprises obtaining the geospatial data of landslide disaster area to be detected, analyzing the landslide vulnerability of the geospatial data to generate a landslide vulnerability map, establishing a spatial database according to a landslide list and landslide condition factors, analyzing the landslide condition factors by using multiple co-linearity test and ReliefF algorithm to divide the spatial database into training samples and test samples, the genetic algorithm is optimized, random forests are fused to obtain a hybrid model, a landslide susceptibility map obtained based on the hybrid model is fused with a building coverage area extracted from a preset Google earth engine platform, so that a landslide vulnerability building map of a landslide disaster area to be detected is created, key factors influencing landslide occurrence are successfully identified through multiple collinearity, reliability of susceptibility analysis of the model in training and testing stages is improved, and accuracy of landslide susceptibility prediction is improved.

title_en: Water conservancy and hydropower engineering construction safety supervision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water conservancy and hydropower engineering construction safety supervision method, which relates to the technical field of engineering construction and comprises the following steps: and inputting the environmental risk degree value in the construction, the complexity degree value of the construction technology and the defect number in the construction management to a supervision module, and outputting the comprehensive risk index, the response capability index and the safety performance index by the supervision module. The method has the advantages of integrating a plurality of factors such as environmental risk, technical complexity, management defects, personnel training rate, safety facility integrity rate and the like, realizing accurate quantitative evaluation of construction risk, combining a blockchain technology to realize rapid resource allocation so as to remarkably improve emergency response speed and efficiency, comprehensively evaluating safety performance in the construction process, providing powerful support for continuously improving safety management, and realizing transparency and traceability of construction safety data by utilizing the characteristics of decentralization and non-falsification of the blockchain technology, and ensuring the authenticity and integrity of the data.

title_en: Urban flood emergency disposal method based on multidimensional infrastructure relation network
abstract_en: The application provides an urban flood emergency disposal method based on a multidimensional infrastructure relation network, which relates to the technical field of disaster emergency disposal, and comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-dimensional infrastructure different-function network which is interdependent according to various infrastructure systems; constructing a part of observable Markov process corresponding to the multi-dimensional infrastructure heterofunctional network according to the multi-dimensional infrastructure heterofunctional network; training the multi-intelligent deep reinforcement learning model through a part of observable Markov process to obtain a qualified urban flood emergency disposal model; determining a damaged physical component list according to urban rainfall data; simulating urban disaster conditions according to the multi-dimensional infrastructure different-function network and the damaged physical component list; and inputting the urban disaster situation into an urban flood emergency treatment model for treatment, so as to obtain an optimal emergency treatment scheme. It is intended to determine an optimal disaster emergency treatment scheme for an infrastructure system based on disaster scenarios.

title_en: Small-scale experiment platform and method capable of simulating thermal response characteristics of civil aircraft fuel tank under fire disaster effect
abstract_en: The application provides a small-scale experiment platform and a method capable of simulating thermal response characteristics of a civil aircraft fuel tank under the action of fire, wherein the small-scale experiment platform comprises the following steps: the small-scale experimental platform for the aircraft fuel tank is simple in structure, easy to operate and reasonable in design, and by arranging the nitrogen sampling device and the oxygen sampling device, the influence of the nitrogen and oxygen concentration in the fuel tank on the fuel tank flammability is fully considered, the condition of the fire disaster effect civil aircraft fuel tank can be effectively simulated, and effective experimental data can be obtained; and provides sufficient data support for researching the explosion phenomenon caused by the explosion of the fuel tank of the civil aircraft under the action of fire.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;HANGZHOU RUIHE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heat-insulating fire-resistant grading protection method for suspension bridge cable structure system
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat-insulating fire-resistant grading protection method for a suspension bridge cable structure system, which comprises the following steps of: determining the cable wire fortification temperature by developing a cable high-strength steel wire high-temperature mechanical property material property test; carrying out a large-size temperature field test of the cable structure system under a real fire disaster according to a similar theory, and determining the fortification height and the grading fortification height of the cable structure system; determining a hierarchical protection strategy by developing heat transfer simulation of a cable structure fireproof system; and carrying out regional protection on the bridge cable structural system. The invention can meet the fire-resistant protection requirement of the bridge cable structure system and improve the economy of the protection system.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;GUANGDONG WANQU TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION INVEST CO LTD;GUANGDONG PROVINCIAL HIGHWAY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Experimental simulation device for tunnel flow fire disaster
abstract_en: The application relates to an experimental simulation device for a tunnel flowing fire disaster, which comprises a tunnel simulation assembly, a flowing fire source simulation assembly, a fire source position regulation assembly and an oil supply assembly, wherein the oil supply assembly is connected with the tunnel simulation assembly; the tunnel simulation assembly comprises a supporting platform, a main body frame and a ceiling, wherein the main body frame is arranged on the upper surface of the supporting platform, and the ceiling is arranged on the top of the main body frame; the fire source position regulating and controlling assembly is positioned in the tunnel space and comprises a first sliding rail and a second sliding rail which are perpendicular to each other, the first sliding rail is arranged on the upper surface of the supporting platform, the second sliding rail is arranged on the first sliding rail, and the first sliding rail and the second sliding rail are parallel to the upper surface of the supporting platform; the dripping fire source simulation assembly comprises a plate body, wherein the plate body is arranged on the second sliding rail, and a dripping groove is formed in the upper surface of the plate body; the oil supply assembly is used for supplying fuel oil into the flowing groove so that the upper surface of the plate body can generate flowing fire. Solves the problem that the prior device for simulating the tunnel flowing fire disaster is lack in the process of simulating different fire disaster occurrence positions.

title_en: Optical fiber micro-motion based comprehensive positioning method for empty area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive positioning method based on optical fiber micro-motion in a dead zone, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: step 1: geological exploration: (1) geological investigation; (2) geophysical prospecting; (3) geochemical exploration; (4) drilling an exploration; step 2: preparing and debugging optical fiber acquisition equipment; step 3: acquisition system arrangement: adopting a (alpha arrangement) temperature nano quadrupole (AMNB) device; step 4: collecting and intensively processing data; step 5: the data interpretation, optical fiber micro-void area comprehensive positioning technology has the advantages of high sensitivity, long-distance monitoring, real-time monitoring and the like, and is suitable for the fields of urban underground space monitoring, geological disaster early warning and the like.
assignees: NO 1 CONSTRUCTION CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY NO 9 GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY NO 9 GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Underground near-layer oil-gas abnormal surging large-area medium-high pressure fracturing drainage treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for treating high-pressure fracturing drainage in a large area of underground near-layer oil-type gas abnormal gushing, which comprises the following steps: s1, ultra-detection comprehensive delineation of an oil-type gas reservoir, S2, design and construction of high-pressure guiding fracturing drainage and production long drilling parameters in a large area of the oil-type gas reservoir, S3, high-pressure rapid omnibearing seam making and permeability increasing in the large area of the oil-type gas reservoir, S4, efficient hole sealing of a pre-extraction drilling and oil-type gas combined drainage, S5, real-time metering monitoring and effect evaluation analysis of oil-type gas pre-extraction drilling and production data. The method realizes the conversion of the underground near-layer oil-type gas of the coal mine from a passive discrete local treatment mode to an active source systematic treatment mode, realizes the large-area advanced treatment of the underground near-layer oil-type gas of the coal mine, and eliminates the adverse effect of oil-type gas hidden disaster factors on safe production.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Under-pressure cabin opening method for strong permeable stratum shield machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a pressurized cabin opening method of a strong permeable stratum shield machine. The under-pressure bin opening method of the strong water permeable stratum shield machine comprises the following steps of: a first step of: preparing for opening a bin: s1, sealing the tail of the shield, observing whether the drilling holes at the tail of the shield are water seepage, the method comprises the following steps: 1) If no water seepage phenomenon exists, a sealing water stop ring is not required to be manufactured by construction; 2) If water seepage exists, secondary grouting is carried out on the 4-7 ring segment behind the shield tail to form a sealed water stop ring, and the water seepage amount is ensured to be not more than 0.5m  3 /h. The method for opening the bin of the strong permeable stratum shield machine under pressure can effectively avoid the safety risk of equipment and personnel caused by pressure fluctuation, reduce the possibility of emergency conditions, improve the safety of operation, reduce the pressure change of groundwater and soil, effectively protect the surrounding environment and avoid the geological disaster risk caused by the pressure change.
assignees: CHINA COAL NO 3 CONSTR GROUP CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Simulation test platform and system for rescue of caving roof pipe of roadway after coal mine disaster
