abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test platform and a system for rescue of a caving roof pipe of a roadway after coal mine disaster, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises a roadway collapse body stacking box body system, a jacking pipe system and a data acquisition system, wherein the upper end of the roadway collapse jacking pipe rescue simulation test platform is provided with a pipeline collapse body stacking box body system. According to the simulation test platform and system for the caving roof pipe rescue of the roadway after the coal mine disaster, the simulation box is transparent, the front end of the transparent simulation box is provided with the high-speed camera, when the rescue simulation test is carried out, details are captured through the high-speed camera, omission is avoided, an experimental result can be analyzed more comprehensively, the caving particle box is arranged at the upper end of the transparent simulation box, the caving particle is used for simulating a caving stone, a leak hole is formed between the caving particle box and the transparent simulation box, when the caving stone is simulated, the transparent simulation box is communicated with the caving particle box through pulling the pulling plate, and the caving stone enters the inside of the transparent simulation box and can be simulated more truly.

title_en: Sponge product flame retardant performance check out test set
abstract_en: The invention discloses sponge product flame retardant property detection equipment, which relates to the technical field of sponge product detection and comprises a detection box, wherein an adjusting frame is fixed on a driven shaft, a first angle adjusting component for driving the driven shaft to rotate relative to an extension column is arranged at the top of the detection box, a second angle adjusting component for driving a steering shaft to rotate is arranged on a sliding plate, and a graduated scale positioned on the side of a sponge product is fixed on a U-shaped sliding frame. According to the invention, the included angle of the adjusting frame relative to the horizontal plane can be adjusted through the first angle adjusting assembly, the angle of the mounting frame and the vertical plane can be adjusted through the second adjusting assembly, so that the multi-dimensional angle adjusting effect on the sponge product ignited on the mounting frame is realized, the flame retardant performance of the sponge product under various combustion angles in the fire disaster occurrence process can be well simulated, the quantitative guarantee on the combustion degree is realized by means of the arranged graduated scale, and the accuracy of detecting the flame retardant performance of the sponge product is greatly improved.
assignees: HUIZHOU CHUANGYING SPONGE PRODUCTS CO LTD

title_en: Electroencephalogram signal-based crew emotion recognition method in VR fire scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a crew emotion recognition method under a VR fire scene based on an electroencephalogram signal, which comprises the following steps: building a ship fire three-dimensional scene based on VR technology; the shipmen interact with the three-dimensional scene of the ship fire to perform fire suppression training, and the electroencephalograph acquires electroencephalogram signals of the shipmen in real time; performing discrete wavelet transformation on the electroencephalogram signals to obtain five sub-frequency bands; respectively extracting features of the five sub-frequency bands to obtain a feature matrix; normalizing the feature matrix to obtain final features; and inputting the final characteristics into a machine learning classification model, and outputting emotion recognition results by the machine learning classification model. By calculating the central trend, the discrete degree and the distribution shape of the sub-band data during the feature extraction of the sub-band, the features of the electroencephalogram signals are analyzed from multiple aspects, and the robustness and the accuracy of the method are enhanced, so that the emotion change of a crew member is accurately identified, and reasonable advice is provided for the firefighting training of the crew member.

title_en: River basin flood forecasting method integrating multisource rainfall data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood forecasting and computer combination, and discloses a river basin flood forecasting method integrating multisource rainfall data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical multi-source rainfall data, historical geographic data and historical disaster data of a river basin area, and preprocessing to construct a training data set; constructing a flood forecast model, training the flood forecast model by adopting a training data set, and generating a trained flood forecast model; acquiring real-time multisource rainfall data and real-time geographic data of a river basin, preprocessing the multisource rainfall data and the real-time geographic data, inputting a flood forecast model, and outputting a flood peak value at a set time point; according to the method, the historical multi-source rainfall data, the historical geographic data and the historical disaster data of the river basin area can be analyzed and learned through the flood forecast model, the influence parameters of the secondary disasters on the hydraulic characteristics of the river network system and the influence parameters of the interference flood propagation process are obtained, and the accuracy rate of flood forecast can be effectively improved.
assignees: SHUIFA DIGITAL TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG HAIHE HUAIHE XIAOQING BASIN WATER RESOURCES MAN SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Mine disaster early warning method based on combination of field monitoring and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster early warning method based on the combination of on-site monitoring and numerical simulation, which relates to the technical field of mine disaster early warning and comprises the following steps: acquiring mine geological condition field monitoring data through a normal sensor group paved on a mine, acquiring mine position and geochemical information historical data through a GIS system, performing numerical optimization on the mine geological condition field monitoring data, inputting the field monitoring data and the mine position and geochemical information historical data into FLAC  3D  simulation calculation software for simulation, acquiring mine disaster numerical simulation data, paving a risk sensor group in a high-density area of the mine according to the mine disaster numerical simulation data, inputting return data of the risk sensor group into a short-term prediction formula, acquiring risk prediction data, performing differential degree comparison on the risk prediction data and the mine disaster numerical simulation data, and issuing an early warning signal according to a differential degree comparison result, thereby realizing early warning of the mine disaster.

title_en: Bridge multi-disaster combined action numerical simulation method and simulation system based on triangulation and feature point collaborative interpolation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge multi-disaster combined action numerical simulation method and system based on triangulation and feature point collaborative interpolation, which comprises the following steps of constructing a CFD numerical model of mountain highway bridge foundation flushing based on REEF D, constructing an FEM numerical model of a falling stone impact pier based on ABAQUS, obtaining REEF D flushing simulation data, processing the simulation data by adopting two-dimensional Delaunay triangulation and triangle internal linear interpolation theory to obtain structural domain flushing depth data, screening soil body units which should be passivated in the FEM numerical model, and when the flushing depth data in REEF D reaches a set value, extracting corresponding flushing topography data and constructing a numerical model of pile foundation abrasion.

title_en: Karst cave safety distance determining method, device and medium based on risk prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a karst cave safety distance determining method, device, equipment and storage medium based on risk prediction, which comprise the steps of obtaining geological investigation data of a target karst area and constructing a geological simulation model of the target karst area according to the geological investigation data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a spatial simulation distribution model of a target karst cave according to characteristic information of the target karst cave, integrating the geological simulation model and the spatial simulation distribution model based on tunnel design parameters to obtain a tunnel construction model of the target karst cave, embedding pre-selected vehicle information into the tunnel construction model to obtain a corresponding tunnel operation model, creating each disaster simulation event, carrying out risk prediction on the tunnel operation model, and determining the safety distance of the target karst cave according to a risk prediction result. The invention optimizes the tunnel design and construction, ensures the safety of tunnel construction and operation, and provides accurate data model support for actual tunnel engineering.

title_en: Tunnel surrounding rock falling block collapse secondary disaster emergency treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel surrounding rock falling block collapse secondary disaster emergency treatment device which comprises a base, wherein the upper surface of the base is provided with a base, the upper surface of the base is hinged with a second fixing seat, and the outer wall of one side of the second fixing seat is fixedly connected with a connecting seat; the invention designs the tunnel gushing water disaster treatment equipment integrating interception, blocking and drainage, can quickly respond according to the actual situation of a disaster site to form a complete disaster treatment system, has the advantage of high treatment efficiency, can find out a hole to drill according to the compactness of backfilling behind a detection radar detection concrete structure through an automatic grouting water blocking structure, and performs grouting water blocking, and has good treatment effect and high efficiency; through adjustable range's water interception structure, can adjust according to the degree difference of gushing water, through the drainage device who has anti-blocking structure simultaneously, when avoiding the pipeline to block up, increased the efficiency of drainage.
assignees: QINGDAO MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD;POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Geological disaster model display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster model display device which comprises a glass outer box, wherein two supporting rods are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the bottom of the glass outer box, the two supporting rods are symmetrically distributed, a pin shaft I is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the top of each supporting rod, a fixing seat I is rotatably connected to the outer wall of the circumference of each pin shaft I, a glass inner box is welded to the fixing seat I, a base plate I is arranged on the inner wall of one end of the glass inner box, a base plate II is arranged in the glass inner box, a sponge cushion is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the top of the base plate I, and one end of the sponge cushion is fixedly connected with the base plate II. According to the utility model, the shower pipe is used for simulating raining, the weight change of the sponge cushion under the action of long-time rainwater is observed, the condition that the rainwater infiltrates downwards through the sponge cushion can be observed, so that a user can more intuitively know the possible change of a mountain under the action of long-time rainwater, and the process of debris flow formation can be intuitively felt.
assignees: NORTHWEST NONFERROUS SURVEY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue dog intelligent training equipment based on space positioning
abstract_en: The utility model provides search and rescue dog intelligent training equipment based on space positioning. A search and rescue dog intelligent training equipment based on space location, including the bottom plate, the top fixedly connected with limiting plate of bottom plate, the top fixedly connected with roof of limiting plate, the bottom fixedly connected with base of bottom plate. According to the intelligent training equipment for the search and rescue dogs based on the space positioning, the fuel tank is arranged, when the search and rescue dogs are trained, the search and rescue dogs are placed at the top of the bottom plate, the electric spark plug is started and the valve I is opened, so that the gas discharged by the conveying ring can be ignited by the electric spark plug, the conveying ring is promoted to perform flame injection on the search and rescue route of the search and rescue dogs, the simulation effect of the fire disaster search and rescue environment is achieved, the problem that the training effect of the search and rescue dogs is poor due to the fact that the training equipment is single in function and is difficult to simulate the search and rescue site is solved, and the practical effect of the intelligent training equipment for the search and rescue dogs is improved.
assignees: CHINESE RESCUE YUNNAN SEARCH DOG MECH DETACHMENT;CARRIER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smoke generation mechanism for simulating fire disaster
abstract_en: The application provides an aerosol generating mechanism for simulating fire, which relates to the technical field of fire simulation and comprises a positioning notch and a combustion cylinder, wherein air inlets are formed in the bottoms of two sides of the combustion cylinder, a plugging block is movably connected in the air inlets, a placing net is arranged in the combustion cylinder, and a plurality of limiting blocks are formed in the inner wall of the combustion cylinder; the positioning notch comprises a fixed disc and a movable disc, a plurality of second notches are formed in the fixed disc, and a plurality of first notches are formed in the movable disc; the technical key points are as follows: through utilizing two shutoff piece control to correspond the size of air intake passageway and make the activity coil the holding ring rotate at the top of fixed disk, the intercommunication condition of a plurality of first notch around the control activity dish and a plurality of second notch around the fixed disk can control the quantity that the air got into the combustion cylinder inside to control the combustion state of being burnt the thing, be favorable to making being burnt the thing and produce great smog or flame as required, be convenient for guarantee the efficiency and the effect of conflagration simulation.

title_en: Method and system for building-level classification of natural disaster-induced building damage
abstract_en: Method for classification of building damage induced by a natural disaster event; the method comprising: - obtaining microwave radar remote sensing data of a geographical region impacted by the natural disaster event, the remote sensing data having been generated after the natural disaster event; - obtaining building data from at least one geographical database, wherein the building data pertains to areas of buildings at outer edges of outside walls of said buildings; - enriching the remote sensing data with the building data; - segmenting the enriched remote sensing data into segments corresponding with buildings based on the building data; - extracting textural features from the segmented remote sensing data; - obtaining a machine learning, ML, classifier which has been trained to classify building damage of each segment of the segmented remote sensing data into a building damage level classification comprising at least two building damage levels; wherein the training is based on remote sensing data of a plurality of different types of natural disaster events and of at least two different types of geographical regions; and - classifying building damage of each segment of the segmented remote sensing data into the building damage level classification, using the ML classifier.

title_en: Early warning information generation method and device based on emergency event simulation
abstract_en: The application relates to an early warning information generation method and device based on emergency event simulation. The method comprises the following steps: determining an event feature set of an emergency event source, the event feature set comprising: event location, physical range, start time, duration, event intensity, event visibility; deploying the emotion infection model into the agent; deploying a heterogeneous behavioral model into the agent; the A star algorithm is used as a macro navigation algorithm of the intelligent agent; starting an emergency event source and observing an action path of the intelligent body; and generating emergency event early warning information according to the action path. The early warning information generation method and device based on emergency event simulation can simulate complex behaviors of an intelligent agent in an emergency, further generate warning information and dredging information, provide scientific decision support for an emergency management mechanism and enhance the efficiency of emergency response.

title_en: Flood simulation and disaster prediction method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a flood simulation and disaster prediction method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring initial scene data, and determining a station construction model based on the initial scene data; acquiring rainfall parameter information, and determining storm scenario data based on the rainfall parameter information and a storm intensity formula; and designing a flood evolution model based on a cellular automaton principle, combining the storm scene data with the station construction model to perform evolution simulation of underground station construction flood, and determining disaster data. Therefore, before a disaster occurs, the damage condition caused by flood disaster on the underground station construction site under different conditions can be predicted by simulating various storm scenes so as to formulate a proper disaster emergency plan, and corresponding precaution measures are taken to reduce economic loss and casualties.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;BEIJING TIANJIN HEBEI INTERCITY RAILWAY INVEST CO LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITE

title_en: Test platform and test method for simulating underground transformer room fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test platform for simulating a fire disaster of an underground transformer room, which comprises an enclosure structure, a transformer system, a ventilation and smoke exhaust system, a fire extinguishing system pipe network and a measuring system, wherein a water mist spraying and cooling system for protecting the top of the enclosure structure from high temperature is arranged at the top of the interior of the enclosure structure; the top of the enclosure structure is provided with a ventilation and smoke exhaust system, and the inside of the enclosure structure is provided with a measuring system and a fire extinguishing system pipe network. The invention can simulate the real fire scale and the fire development and spreading process and the fire extinguishing process of the underground transformer room; the ventilation and smoke exhaust system is opened and closed, so that the concentration of high-temperature oil vapor in the underground transformer chamber can be adjusted and controlled, and the risk of oil vapor explosion in the test process is reduced; by arranging the water mist spraying and cooling system, the damage of high-temperature combustion in the airtight space to the roof structure can be effectively reduced.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;GUOANDA CO LTD

title_en: Remote video fire detection method based on double-light fusion
abstract_en: A remote video fire detection method based on double-light fusion comprises the following steps of; s1, establishing a fire disaster data set, and collecting visible light images and infrared thermal images of flames and smoke; s2, marking a data set; s3, establishing an improved YOLOv deep learning algorithm frame to detect visible light images; s4, establishing an improved SVM framework to accurately divide the image, outputting a detection result by matching with the circularity and the filling rate of the division area, and detecting an infrared thermal image; s5, pre-training the improved YOLOv model through a visible light image dataset, and training the improved SVM model through an infrared thermal image dataset; and S6, establishing an algorithm framework for decision fusion of the visible light and the infrared detection result, fusing different weights of the infrared and visible light output results, and finally giving out whether fire disaster occurs or not and the position information of the fire disaster. The invention realizes the detection of the initial fire and the remote fire of the construction site and improves the fire prevention capability.

title_en: Interpretable CNN-LSTM river basin flood simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interpretable CNN-LSTM river basin flood simulation method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out standardized treatment on the treated rainfall runoff database, dividing a training set, a verification set and a test set, and converting the training set, the verification set and the test set into TensorFlow data sets; constructing a CNN-LSTM coupling model, and optimizing super parameters of the model based on a training set and a verification set; inputting rainfall field sequence data of the test set into the coupling model, and rapidly and accurately outputting the runoff evolution process of the downstream hydrologic station; the specific decision process of the coupling model is explained using SHAP interpretability techniques. The method can not only effectively improve the efficiency and the precision of the watershed flood simulation, but also identify key input characteristic factors and improve the transparency and the credibility of the black box model decision, and has important significance for the application of the interpretable deep learning model in the watershed flood simulation, the reduction of flood disasters and the like.

title_en: Disaster recovery data integrity verification and recovery method based on GANs model
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster recovery data integrity verification and recovery method based on GANs model, which comprises the following steps: s1, backup reduction data are acquired, and the backup reduction data are divided into training set data and test set data; s2, constructing a generator and discriminator structure of GANs models, and constructing GANs models according to the constructed generator and discriminator; s3, inputting the training set data in the step S1 into GANs models for training, and updating parameters of a generator and a discriminator; s4, inputting the test set data in the step S1 into the GANs model to generate restored image data. The invention can realize the recovery of the data and ensure the safety of the data.
assignees: Chongqing Planning and natural resources information center

title_en: Fire disaster prediction method suitable for edge calculation and fusing multi-source time sequence data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster prediction method suitable for edge calculation and fusing multisource time sequence data, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-view RGB images, multi-view infrared images and meteorological data, preprocessing the data, constructing Smokey Net prediction models by taking CNNs as backbone networks, inputting the preprocessed data into the prediction models to conduct multisource data fusion, selecting three attention mechanisms of a sparse attention mechanism, a strong attention mechanism and a multi-head attention mechanism, adding an external register module and a long-period and short-period memory network, and training the Smokey Net prediction models. The invention solves the problem of insufficient sample data during field fire prediction and improves the accuracy of long-time monitoring. Thereby helping to reduce casualties and property loss caused by fire and improving the efficiency and timeliness of coping with the fire.

title_en: Subway fire scene robot-assisted pedestrian evacuation simulation method
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of crowd evacuation simulation, and provides a robot-assisted pedestrian flow evacuation simulation method for a subway fire scene, which is applied to the subway fire scene and comprises the following steps: acquiring a first position of a fire disaster in a subway station and a second position of all pedestrians in a dangerous area of the fire disaster; determining a third position of the guiding robot for evacuating and shunting pedestrians in the dangerous area according to the first position and the second position, and controlling the guiding robot to move to the third position; inputting the first position, the second position and the third position into an improved social force model for processing to obtain the acceleration of each pedestrian in the dangerous area; determining the position of the pedestrian at the next moment according to the acceleration of the pedestrian, and guiding the pedestrian to move to the position; detecting whether the non-evacuated personnel exist in the dangerous area, if so, continuing evacuating the non-evacuated personnel, otherwise, ending the simulation. The intelligent and automatic evacuation system has high level of intellectualization and automation, and can quickly and effectively evacuate pedestrians.

title_en: Quantitative ground subsidence risk assessment system based on multisource geometrics data driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk assessment, and discloses a quantitative ground subsidence risk assessment system driven by multi-source geometrics data, which comprises the following steps: s1, land utilization type classification; s2, disaster body sample data mining; s3, predicting the susceptibility of geological disasters; s4, geological disaster risk investigation; s5, geological disaster vulnerability investigation; s6, evaluating geological disaster risks. According to the invention, based on training sample data, machine learning binary and multi-element classification models are respectively constructed, and the classification precision and Kappa coefficient on corresponding verification sample data are both over 85%, so that the beneficial effects of land utilization type classification and ground subsidence vulnerability prediction are achieved. The invention also develops a series of combination weight methods for investigation and estimation of dangers and vulnerability, and the ground subsidence risk of the working area is finely divided by calculating the ground subsidence risk probability, so that the beneficial effects of accurately guiding the monitoring and prevention and control work of subsidence disasters are achieved.

title_en: Disaster prevention and reduction model based on mangrove forest
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mangrove disaster reduction models and discloses a mangrove disaster prevention and reduction model based on a mangrove, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body comprises a wave simulation box and a demonstration water tank, the front end face and the rear end face of the demonstration water tank are fixedly connected with glass panels, the lower end face of the demonstration water tank is fixedly connected with a lifting box, a lifting plate is arranged in the lifting box, the mangrove disaster prevention and reduction model is fixedly connected with the upper end face of the lifting plate, a side slope is fixedly arranged on one side of the inner part of the demonstration water tank, and a shore vegetation model is fixedly arranged above the side slope. According to the utility model, the situation of existence of the mangrove model is compared, so that the effect of the mangrove in disaster prevention and reduction is intuitively reflected, and the impression of the viewers is more profound.
assignees: HAIKOU MARINE GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Display control program, method, and device
abstract_en: To suppress a reduction in visibility of an evacuation route in AR for evacuation training in which outbreak of a fire is assumed, even when a carbon monoxide centration is visualized and displayed by superimposition.SOLUTION: A display control device acquires the simulation result of a carbon monoxide concentration at each position of a space where fire outbreak is assumed and a real image in which the space is imaged with a field angle corresponding to the visual field range of an evacuation trainee; determines, for each display component indicating a carbon monoxide concentration per unit volume that is virtually located at each position of the space, the clarity that progressively increases as the distance between the position where the display component is located and the position of the evacuation trainee gets closer; and exercises control so that a superimposed image in which the display component indicating the determined clarity is superimposed on the real image is displayed on a display device that the evacuation trainee wears.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Fire Simulation System
abstract_en: To provide a fire simulation result based on a simulation model that is adapted to a fire prevention object facility of a user.SOLUTION: A fire simulation system comprises: a condition setting unit that sets a simulation condition required for obtaining at least one of a time transition about an enlarging situation of a fire, and a time transition about an evacuation situation as a fire simulation result of a fire prevention object facility; a model construction unit that constructs a simulation model on the basis of the simulation condition; a sensor group that is installed within a fire prevention facility, and can detect a fire breaking-out state; and an execution unit that acquires the fire breaking-out state detected by the sensor group, executes a fire simulation using the simulation model, thereby estimates at least any one of a time transition about the fire enlarging situation and a time transition about the evacuation situation accompanied by an elapsed time since a fire breaking-out time, and generates information on an evacuation guidance on the basis of an estimation result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Method for cultivating castor by using abiotic stress
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for cultivating castor by utilizing abiotic stress, and belongs to the technical field of castor planting. The invention discloses a method for cultivating castor by utilizing abiotic stress, which comprises the steps of planting castor on a culture medium containing zinc ions, gradually reducing the growth temperature of castor seeds and then recovering the castor seeds. On the basis of stronger antioxidant defense system generated by the castor, the invention performs low-temperature exercise regulation and control on the castor, gradually reduces the temperature stress, can induce the activity of the castor antioxidant enzyme system, enhances the stress resistance of the castor and the cold resistance of varieties, and jointly lightens the influence of low-temperature disasters on the castor. The invention provides theoretical reference for popularization and utilization of castor and cultivation, development and utilization of castor stress-resistant varieties.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based natural disaster risk assessment method for photovoltaic project
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic project natural disaster risk assessment method based on a knowledge graph, and relates to the field of key infrastructure risk assessment; firstly, utilizing big data depth of a disaster text to mine microscopic causal structures of risk components hidden in a large sample of historical disaster events, and drawing a generalized natural disaster risk knowledge graph of a photovoltaic project; based on the knowledge graph and the complex network view angle, describing the dynamic process of the composite risk system through machine simulation, and identifying key nodes and main paths of risk conduction; finally, constructing a photovoltaic project natural disaster risk assessment model based on the Bayesian network based on the key nodes and the main paths of risk conduction; the method can overcome the limitations of the current comprehensive index method and the mechanism model method in the aspects of strong subjectivity of risk assessment, difficult model verification and the like, and provides an innovative approach for objective and accurate assessment of natural disaster risk in photovoltaic projects.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORPORATION SICHUAN ENERGY INVEST CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Device and method for acquiring multi-parameter data of deep part of high mountain
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for acquiring multi-parameter data of deep parts of high-level mountain bodies, which belong to the field of disaster detection, wherein an ultra-weak fiber grating array sensing optical cable is adopted in a borehole, multi-parameter information such as displacement deformation, temperature conditions, osmotic pressure and the like of different layers of a rock-soil body are simultaneously acquired in one borehole, and fusion analysis of the multi-parameter information is realized in a field resolving mode, so that effective technical support is provided for monitoring and early warning of geological disasters of coal mining mines. The invention can grasp and understand the deep multi-parameter data of the high mountain in the coal mining area, can provide effective technical support for researching and judging the rock stratum dynamics of the high mountain, can effectively acquire the deep multi-parameter sensing monitoring data of the high mountain by selecting effective observation drilling holes in the high mountain area and disposing different types and different scales of ultra-weak fiber grating sensing optical cables in the observation drilling holes, and further provides effective data reference for judging the stable state of the high mountain.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIST

title_en: Demand response closed-loop control method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a demand response closed-loop control method, a system, equipment and a medium, which comprise the following steps: providing a double-countermeasure MDP model based on sudden power outage perception, and constructing an intelligent body in a micro-grid operator to respectively solve a minimization problem and a maximization problem; and the influence of sudden power failure of the power distribution network is considered, an emergency regulation preference model is constructed, and an emergency response node set which can be communicated with the power failure nodes and still can normally run is constructed on the premise that the emergency regulation response quantity is larger than the power protection plan quantity, so that the large-area power failure risk is reduced. The data-driven closed-loop accurate robust power control method based on double-countermeasure DQN is provided, continuous interaction is carried out between two intelligent agents and the power distribution network environment, an optimal demand response closed-loop control strategy is learned, an output result training model of the other intelligent agent is combined, mutual iterative countermeasure is carried out, alternating iterative solution is carried out on the two intelligent agents, a robust optimal solution is obtained, and accurate control of the data-driven closed-loop accurate robust power is achieved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Hard roof stratum group total space treatment method based on single ground well
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for managing the whole space of a hard roof stratum group based on a single ground well, which only needs to drill a single ground vertical well, and branch horizontal holes are drilled along key strata on two sides in the vertical well, meanwhile, sectional perforation hydraulic fracturing construction is implemented, finally, a setting device is arranged in the vertical well, and the length of the section of the vertical well from the landing point of each branch horizontal hole to the same depth on horizontal projection is not managed by mining pressure disaster dead zones. The invention can efficiently treat the mine pressure disaster possibly caused by the hard rock stratum group of the roof in the whole coverage space of the coal seam stoping work, finally realize advanced, low-cost and efficient solving of the mine pressure disaster potential safety hazard existing in the coal seam working face stoping period, and ensure the orderly proceeding of the coal mine stoping continuing work and the efficient production of the coal mine.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Mining pressure disaster treatment method for hard roof of ground T-shaped branch horizontal well
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for managing mining pressure disasters of a hard top plate of a ground T-shaped branch horizontal well, which comprises the steps of firstly drilling down-hole sleeves with two open-hole structures, and respectively drilling down-hole branch horizontal holes a and b of the sleeves by means of a whipstock; and then sequentially implementing perforating hydraulic fracturing construction of the branched horizontal holes a and the branched horizontal holes b in a staged manner and perforating fracturing construction of the vertical well, and finally forming a complex hydraulic fracture grid. The hydraulic fracture grid formed by the method can efficiently realize advanced management of the hard key rock stratum ore pressure disasters of the upper roof of the coal seam stoping working face so as to prevent the hard rock stratum ore pressure disasters of the upper roof from appearing during the stoping of the coal seam working face and ensure the orderly proceeding of the continuous mining work of the coal mine and the efficient production of the coal mine.

title_en: Parameter reproduction monitoring system for explosion-proof test device
abstract_en: The invention provides a parameter reproduction monitoring system for an explosion-proof test device, which is used for recording pressure change, pressure overlapping phenomenon and the like in the verification process of the safety performance of explosion-proof electrical equipment and analyzing the self safety performance and the anti-explosion safety performance of the tested equipment in a disaster environment. The device is synchronous in sampling starting and detonation ignition, the pressure measuring sensor performs antiknock treatment, and the system can provide internal and external explosion pressure test curves and data requirements of explosion-proof electrical equipment for analysis and verification when explosion or secondary explosion is generated; meanwhile, in the process of analysis and verification of the anti-explosion test simulation platform, when explosion occurs in the shell, image capturing is carried out, and the requirement of image recording is met in the process of verification of the safety performance of the anti-explosion electrical equipment when the anti-explosion test simulation platform generates explosion or secondary explosion.
assignees: MEIKE BEIJING DETECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Physical sign monitoring model training method, physical sign prediction system and fire-fighting helmet
abstract_en: The invention provides a physical sign monitoring model training method, a physical sign prediction system and a fire-fighting helmet, and relates to the technical field of computers, wherein the training method comprises the steps of obtaining historical data of a rescue site, wherein the historical data comprises historical environment data and historical physical sign data; training a preset neural network model by using each historical environment sub-data and historical sign data in a first training set to obtain a sign prediction model corresponding to each historical environment sub-data, wherein the historical data is divided into a first training set and a second training set, and each historical environment sub-data of each historical environment data in the second training set is input into the corresponding sign prediction model to obtain a plurality of prediction results; and training a preset fitting model by using various prediction results and historical sign data to obtain a fusion model. The accuracy and the reliability of prediction are improved, firefighters can be rescued in advance, and damage to the bodies of the firefighters is avoided.

title_en: Test system and method for simulating fault zone grouting to control roadway fracture type rock burst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test system and a test method for simulating fault zone grouting to control roadway fracture type rock burst, which belong to the technical field of mine rock mass dynamic disaster control, wherein the system comprises a CT scanning device, a control device and a tunneling grouting device, and the tunneling grouting device is arranged opposite to a model box fixed on a turntable; a confining pressure device is arranged in the model box, a physical model is arranged in the confining pressure device, and a monitoring device is arranged in the physical model; the tunneling grouting device comprises a support, a cross sliding table is arranged on the support, a tunneling mechanism and a grouting mechanism are arranged on a mounting plate of the cross sliding table in parallel, and a distributed grouting assembly is arranged at the top of the grouting mechanism. The system and the method are adopted to simulate the fault zone grouting to control the broken rock burst of the roadway, and transparentization and quantitative characterization are achieved on the occurrence and control of the broken rock burst by simulating the occurrence process of the broken rock burst in the whole roadway tunneling process induced by the whole roadway tunneling process. And meanwhile, plugging and reinforcing treatment is carried out on the fault fracture zone in a grouting mode, and model stress and deformation response in the grouting process are analyzed, so that technical support is provided for safe tunneling of a roadway and safe mining of a mine.

title_en: Water conservancy disaster prediction method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a hydraulic disaster prediction method and a hydraulic disaster prediction system, which are characterized in that a final evaluation model is generated by acquiring historical hydraulic data of a set area, constructing a convolutional neural network according to a prediction result output after the historical hydraulic data are predicted by a preset two-dimensional hydraulic model, and finally generating the final evaluation model by combining the two-dimensional hydraulic model and the convolutional neural network according to a mode of carrying out real-time prediction on the currently acquired hydraulic data, so that the problem of lower prediction efficiency when a single two-dimensional hydraulic model is used for prediction is avoided, meanwhile, the final evaluation model is constructed by the historical hydraulic data, the problem that the model accuracy of the evaluation model is easily reduced due to insufficient training samples is solved, and the effect of improving the prediction efficiency of the prediction result and the prediction accuracy of the prediction result is achieved.

title_en: Deep Actor-Critic architecture system for repairing maintenance decision after multi-team disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a deep Actor-Critic architecture system for repairing maintenance decision after a multi-team disaster. The architecture achieves iterative optimization of a multi-team maintenance strategy by introducing a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) in combination with an AC-MCTS algorithm. Specifically, the system generates local damage and system state through a simulation environment, selects optimal maintenance action in a strategy iteration process through a repairability maintenance Agent, evaluates the recovery effect of the system through elastic analysis, and continuously adjusts the parameters of an Actor-Critic network so as to improve the decision efficiency of the strategy.
assignees: HANGZHOU BEIHANG UNIV INTERNATIONAL INNOVATION INSTITUTE BEIHANG UNIV INTERNATIONAL INNOVATION INSTI

title_en: Internet-based data service cloud platform integrated management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data service cloud platforms, in particular to an integrated management system of a data service cloud platform based on the Internet; comprising the following steps: the system comprises a data cleaning and classifying module, a load balancing module, a cache server, a server group, a mirror image backup module, a disaster backup module and a visual operation and maintenance module; the method comprises the steps of distributing huge data flows through cleaning and classifying data, distributing the huge data flows secondarily through a smooth weighting training algorithm, distributing sub-data flows to servers with good load conditions preferentially, backing up server group data of other data service cloud platforms, judging whether disaster signals are sent out or not through sensors to improve backup efficiency, visualizing the whole load condition of the data service cloud platforms, optimizing real-time data service capacity based on a bottom architecture of a data center, and providing interface services integrating visualization, multi-service and panoramic operation.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;INF CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Improved deep Q network-based non-prediction wind farm topology optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimizing the topology of a wind farm without prediction based on an improved deep Q network, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a state space of the deep Q network based on historical data; decoupling action scores and values Q, and constructing a mapping relation of the neural network which is input into a state containing historical data and outputs scores for all action switches and the values Q of the action scores to different topological structures; and constructing a reward function by taking the minimized voltage deviation and the network loss as optimization targets, and training by using an experience playback strategy based on multi-level experience guidance to establish a mapping relation between the historical output of the wind power plant and the topology optimization result. The invention aims to enhance the adaptability of the wind power plant to complex environments such as mountains, hills and the like through a topological reconstruction scheme of the DQN decision wind power plant on the next day so as to solve the problem of large voltage fluctuation, reduce the large action dimension caused by action switch change and solve the problem of dimension disaster caused by action scoring-value Q evaluation.

title_en: Pedestrian flow evacuation simulation method based on leader-follower structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a pedestrian evacuation simulation method based on a leader-follower structure. The method comprises the following steps: the walking speed of the pedestrian is obtained through a simulation method, and the role of the pedestrian, namely a leader, a follower and other people, is distinguished by using a transfer entropy method according to the speed and the direction. Path planning and exit selection of the leader are described using maximum policy entropy reinforcement learning, walking behavior of the follower is described using an improved social force model, and walking behavior of others is described using a classical social force model. The present invention provides a new approach to simulate spontaneously formed leader-follower structures in crowd evacuation. The leader-follower structure is identified by using a transfer entropy method, the transfer entropy method is integrated into a social force model, the follower updates the expected speed direction of the follower and is leaded by the leader, and the leader performs path planning/exit selection based on maximum strategy entropy reinforcement learning.

title_en: Servo physical model for simulating slope gravity unloading deformation
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of geological disaster simulation, and provides a servo physical model for simulating slope gravity unloading deformation, which comprises a gravity servo simulation system and a slope model; the gravity servo simulation system comprises a viscoelastic polymer friction belt, a servo driving module, a feedback module and a control module; the material of the slope model keeps consistency with the actual slope in geometric, motion and mechanical behaviors, and the model size is determined according to the geometric similarity ratio based on the prototype size of the slope and the range of the simulation system. The model can highly simulate the slope gravity unloading deformation process under the background of rapid undercut of the natural river valley, and adopts an advanced servo control technology and a high-precision monitoring system to realize the accurate control of the gravity and the real-time monitoring of the deformation of the slope deformation which are complex geological processes in different development stages.

title_en: Landslide susceptibility assessment method based on CNN-DF
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide susceptibility assessment method based on CNN-DF (computer numerical control-function), which comprises the steps of carrying out multiple collinearity tests on landslide influence factors acquired in a research area, calculating the frequency ratio of the landslide influence factors based on landslide cataloging, constructing a similar environment by utilizing frequency ratio normalization of disaster-pregnant environment factors, constructing a landslide data set by adopting an equilibrium sampling method under the constraint of the similar environment, wherein the disaster-pregnant environment factors are factors which are screened from the landslide influence factors and serve as environmental constraints, constructing a landslide susceptibility model to predict landslide susceptibility of the landslide data set and generate a landslide susceptibility graph, wherein the landslide susceptibility model is constructed based on a CNN module and a DF module, extracting high-level features from a training set by utilizing the trained CNN module, inputting the DF module for training and testing after expansion, and evaluating the performance of the trained landslide susceptibility model by comparing an accuracy index and the landslide susceptibility graph result based on a test set.

title_en: Typhoon disaster condition monitoring and evaluating method and system based on twin network and social media data
abstract_en: The invention provides a typhoon disaster situation monitoring and evaluating method and system based on twin network and social media data, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting netizen comment texts from each social media platform of the Internet, and constructing a text data set by combining typhoon attributes; preprocessing a text data set, and dividing the preprocessed text data set into a training set and a testing set; then constructing a typhoon disaster situation identification model; then inputting the training set into a typhoon disaster situation identification model for optimization training to obtain a trained typhoon disaster situation identification model; finally, inputting the test set into a trained typhoon disaster situation identification model for identification, and obtaining typhoon disaster situation identification results; according to the invention, based on the twin network SiamTCN and social media data, two-stage typhoon recognition is performed, coarse classification is performed first, and whether an input text is a typhoon-related text is judged; and then carrying out two-stage multi-label classification, and further subdividing the typhoon-related text into more specific disaster categories, wherein the identification is more comprehensive and has higher precision.
assignees: GUANGDONG URBAN & RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN INSTITUTE TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for predicting hydrodynamic influence of transformer substation building in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting hydrodynamic influence of a transformer substation building in extreme weather, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data of a terrain and a building structure of a transformer substation; setting a transformer substation building area as an invalid network by adopting a fixed wall boundary method, and constructing a fixed wall boundary of the transformer substation building area; based on the topography, building structure data and fixed wall boundaries of the transformer substation, simplifying along the water depth average through an incompressible inner Vickers equation, and constructing a hydrodynamic influence prediction model; training and testing the hydrodynamic influence prediction model according to historical flood event data of the transformer substation; the hydrodynamic influence prediction model simulates the damage of flood to the transformer substation building in extreme weather and predicts the damage level. Potential risks can be found in advance, disaster loss is reduced, and the safe operation level of the transformer substation is improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Crop flooding vulnerability analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for analyzing vulnerability of crop flooding, and belongs to the technical field of crop flooding influence analysis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing data and geographic information data of a crop area to be analyzed; based on the data, adopting a serial coupling model of a hydrological model and a hydrodynamic model, simulating a dynamic process of flood disaster spreading, and outputting raster data of the flood flooding process as an index of evaluating the vulnerability of crops flooding; when the method is used for evaluation, an eight-index simplified index system is adopted, and grid units are used as evaluation scales to obtain flooding vulnerability of regional crops; wherein, each index comprises three dimensions of a disaster-tolerant environment, a disaster-causing factor and a disaster-bearing main body; the disaster factor adopts the water depth, duration and flow rate output by the model. The invention can carry out quantitative analysis and improve the accuracy and reliability of analysis.

title_en: Training method for single-mode landslide recognition prediction model and landslide recognition prediction base model, localization method for landslide recognition prediction model, landslide recognition prediction method and landslide recognition prediction system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a training method of a single-mode landslide recognition prediction model and a landslide recognition prediction base model, a landslide recognition prediction model localization method, a landslide recognition prediction method and a landslide recognition prediction system, and relates to the fields of computer systems, disaster prediction, deep learning, model training, fine tuning and the like based on specific models. The method comprises the steps that each first equipment end is trained by collected single-mode landslide data to obtain a single-mode landslide identification prediction model, a second equipment end fuses model parameters of a plurality of single-mode landslide identification prediction models to obtain a landslide identification prediction base model, a third equipment end sends a target mode to the second equipment end, a model obtained by cutting or light weight processing of the target landslide identification prediction base model according to the target mode is subjected to fine tuning training by using a localized landslide training sample, the localized landslide identification model of each third equipment end is obtained, landslide identification prediction accuracy is improved, and disaster prediction results are obtained under the condition that original data are missing.

title_en: Box integrated multifunctional square cabin for bank
abstract_en: The utility model provides a box integrated multifunctional banking shelter, which comprises: the main cabin body and the auxiliary cabin body are container-type components, the main cabin body and the auxiliary cabin body are detachably connected, a teller area and a client area are arranged in the main cabin body, a cashless area is arranged in the auxiliary cabin body, the teller area and the client area are isolated by bulletproof glass, a plurality of service windows are formed in the bulletproof glass, a trailing-proof door is arranged on the side wall of the container in the teller area, and a rolling door is arranged at the side wall parallel to the bulletproof glass in the client area. The utility model can solve the problem that temporary net points are needed when the bank net points are decorated and reformed, and the problem that the temporary net points are wasted and cannot be reused after one-time investment is stopped; the problem of difficult bank business development in army combat training, temporary network sites, emergency disasters, remote areas and the like can be solved rapidly; finally, the utility model can also effectively solve the problems of single service and low safety of the existing mobile terminal.
assignees: IND AND COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA ANHUI BRANCH

title_en: Method for recommendation hypotheses related to the battlefield situation and electronic device for performing the same
title_ko: 전장 상황과 관련된 가설 추천 방법 및 이를 수행하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology capable of recommending a high-ranking hypothesis to a commander by considering priorities among multiple hypotheses related to a battlefield situation. The method for recommending hypotheses may include: identifying a first hypothesis and a second hypothesis among multiple hypotheses related to a battlefield situation; identifying a first embedding vector corresponding to the first hypothesis and a second embedding vector corresponding to the second hypothesis; training a comparison model based on the first embedding vector and the second embedding vector; determining priorities between hypothesis pairs combining the multiple hypotheses related to the battlefield situation based on the trained comparison model; and recommending a hypothesis corresponding to the battlefield situation based on the priorities.
abstract_ko: 전장 상황과 관련된 복수의 가설들 간의 우선 순위를 고려하여 랭킹이 높은 가설을 지휘관에게 추천할 수 있는 기술에 관한 것이다. 가설 추천 방법은, 전장 상황과 관련된 복수의 가설들 중에서 제1 가설과 제2 가설을 확인하는 단계; 상기 제1 가설에 대응하는 제1 임베딩 벡터와 상기 제2 가설에 대응하는 제2 임베딩 벡터를 확인하는 단계; 상기 제1 임베딩 벡터와 상기 제2 임베딩 벡터를 기반으로 비교 모델을 학습시키는 단계; 상기 학습된 비교 모델에 기반하여 상기 전장 상황과 관련된 상기 복수의 가설들을 조합한 가설 쌍(pair) 간의 우선 순위를 결정하는 단계; 및 상기 우선 순위에 기반하여 상기 전장 상황에 대응하는 가설을 추천하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: AGENCY DEFENSE DEV;KOREA ADVANCED INST SCI & TECH

title_en: Simulator system for fire safety and fire suppression training
title_ko: 소방안전 및 화재진압 교육을 위한 시뮬레이터 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a simulator system for fire safety and fire suppression training which enhances the practical and on-site experience of training, thereby significantly increasing learning efficiency and acquisition effectiveness. The simulator system for fire safety and suppression training comprises: a fire safety training operation server (1) including a safety training promotion unit (11), a safety training application unit (12), a training video database unit (13), a lecture video output control unit (14), a training program management unit (15), and a collaboration management unit (16); a lecturer smart monitor (3) which downloads and installs a fire safety training application (2); a trainee smart monitor (4) which outputs theoretical education lecture content on fire safety and multimedia video information demonstrating fire occurrence scenarios for firefighting practical training; a learning-specific fire extinguisher (5) which suppresses fires on the video screen based on the irradiated infrared laser signals; and an agent spraying detection module (8) which controls the suppression of fires on the video screen output to the trainee smart monitor (4).

title_en: Location based system and method for emergency response in oil and gas industry
abstract_en: A system for emergency planning and response to an incident related to the oil and gas industry comprising one or more databases that store data of oil spills and trajectories models, real-time locations of emergency vehicles, H2S gas sensors, LEL gas sensors, and corrosion pumps real-time readings, real-time weather stations, gas wells cross sections drawings and locations of daily drilling rigs. The system further comprises ERP, satellite imagery or aerial photography, and AVL; one or more servers; an ERP system; an electronic display device; and a GIS. The GIS comprises a processing system, and a GIS map displayed by the electronic display device. The GIS map is configured to display a common operating visual of the incident to incident personnel as it unfolds and to locate the emergency vehicles near to the incident.

title_en: Rainfall influences experimental analogue means to tunnel portal side slope stability
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for simulating influence of rainfall on stability of a slope of a tunnel portal, and relates to the technical field of simulation of geotechnical engineering geological disasters of tunnels. The utility model comprises a test box, wherein a slope model is arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the test box, a soil pressure sensor and a pore pressure sensor are arranged in the slope model, a blanking port is arranged at the bottom of the test box, a concentration box for collecting mud residue is arranged at the bottom of the blanking port, one side of the concentration box is connected with an L-shaped push plate in a sliding manner, the push plate is used for concentrating the mud residue, a driving assembly for driving the push plate to move is arranged at the top of the push plate, and a rainfall simulation mechanism is arranged at the top of the test box and simulates rainfall. According to the utility model, the mud and the slag can be collected through the collecting box, so that the influence of the mud and the slag on the accuracy of an experiment on a slope model is prevented, and meanwhile, the fallen mud and the slag are pushed to one side of the collecting box through the push plate, so that the mud and the slag are conveniently collected in a concentrated way, and the accumulation is prevented.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;NINGBO URBAN AREA RAILWAY INVEST DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Urban infrastructure event chain analysis method based on large model and logic atlas
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban infrastructure event chain analysis method based on a large model and logic atlases, belonging to the technical field of public safety. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out multi-dimensional identification and extraction of emergency accident carriers based on a large model; constructing an accident entity attribute library through accident carrier abstract entity aggregation and ontology feature deconstructment; excavating accident non-space-time disaster transfer paths based on logic patterns, and supervising large model training to obtain disaster transfer coping schemes; extracting accident multidimensional disaster transfer characteristics, and carrying out disaster transfer characteristic analysis and entity space-time association rule construction; optimizing logic the map based on the entity space-time correlation analysis; carrying out event chain sequencing through risk analysis; carrying out dynamic update of the event chain according to the feedback information; and outputting and visually displaying results. The invention can realize the automatic association, dynamic prediction, rapid deduction and scientific prevention and control of single/cross-system and single/multi-disaster accident evolution scenes of urban infrastructure through comprehensive consideration of accident carriers and disaster transfer.
assignees: HEFEI ZEZHONG CITY INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Interpretable malicious voice detection method based on feature importance method
abstract_en: An interpretable malicious voice detection method based on a feature importance method belongs to the technical field of deep learning and machine learning interpretability. The method aims at relieving the problem of dimension disasters and simultaneously ensuring that the selected features can improve the detection performance of the model on malicious voices. The invention optimizes feature dimension selection in model training by utilizing the interpretability of machine learning, and distinguishes key features affecting model performance from non-key features which can be removed by analyzing the contribution degree of the features. The feature selection method based on contribution analysis improves the model training and deployment efficiency, and increases the transparency of the model and the trust of users. In the application of detecting malicious voice, the method screens out the characteristics with obvious resolution for distinguishing normal voice from malicious voice by evaluating the contribution of each characteristic. The optimized feature space improves the malicious voice detection precision and reduces the calculation burden.

title_en: Full-flow simulation analysis method and system for passenger plane emergency evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-flow simulation analysis method and a full-flow simulation analysis system for passenger plane emergency evacuation, and belongs to the technical field of emergency evacuation simulation. The method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring emergency evacuation test data of personnel to obtain personnel movement data; s2, constructing a physical environment model and a personnel evacuation model of the passenger plane to obtain an emergency evacuation model; and S3, setting an emergency evacuation flow, and carrying out emergency evacuation simulation based on the personnel operation data, the emergency evacuation flow and the emergency evacuation model to obtain a simulation result. According to the invention, anyLogic is used for constructing a single-channel passenger plane full-flow emergency evacuation model, personnel motion data are input into a simulation model, and evacuation efficiency analysis under different outlet combinations is analyzed. The model passes the reliability verification, and can provide a simulation tool for improving the whole-flow emergency evacuation efficiency of the full-size domestic large aircraft.

title_en: Landslide identification method, landslide identification equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring, and provides a landslide identification method, landslide identification equipment and a storage medium, wherein the landslide identification method comprises the following steps: SAR image data of a region to be monitored is obtained, and preprocessing is carried out to obtain an annual average deformation rate result; according to the annual average deformation rate distribution, identifying a slow landslide by means of a three-dimensional topographic map and a multi-temporal optical image; acquiring a high-resolution optical remote sensing image of a region to be monitored, preprocessing, acquiring optical characteristics of a rapid landslide, establishing a landslide sample data set according to the optical characteristics, and completing data augmentation; inputting the landslide sample data set into a pre-constructed deep learning neural network model for training, and predicting a test set to obtain a trained model; automatically extracting a rapid landslide by using the trained model; and integrating the extracted slow landslide with the fast landslide to obtain the identification result of the regional landslide. The landslide identification method and device can comprehensively and effectively identify landslide of different types, and accuracy of landslide identification is improved.

title_en: Adaptive baseline prediction and index threshold adjustment method for container disaster recovery sensing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster recovery perception, in particular to a dynamic baseline generation method based on historical data and application thereof. According to the method, the container operation index data are collected, the data are subjected to periodicity, cleaning and integration based on a Holt-windows algorithm, a dynamic base line of the container index is automatically generated, and different threshold range intervals are configured according to the importance level of the container. Meanwhile, the model is set to be a training period every 7 x 24 hours, and the result is calculated according to the algorithm model to generate the prediction data of the next 24-hour interval. The invention can improve the precision and efficiency of container index monitoring, provides powerful assistance for the alarm and disaster recovery processing during the operation of the container, and has better application prospect.

title_en: Personnel evacuation simulation method for super high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a super high-rise building personnel evacuation simulation method, which comprises the following steps: s1: setting personnel attributes, wherein the personnel attributes comprise age, gender and physical condition; s2: setting a personnel rest parameter, wherein the rest parameter comprises the times of personnel rest in the evacuation process, the time point of rest and the time length of each rest; s3: setting evacuation scene types, wherein the scene types comprise personnel independent motion scenes and personnel associated motion scenes; s4: setting an initial speed v  0  of a person; s5: calculating a position of a person, the position of the person being determined by the simulated current time and current speed v; s6: and evaluating the evacuation effect according to the position information of each person and the evacuation time.

title_en: Three-dimensional visualization technology-based power grid operation planning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid planning, and particularly discloses a power grid operation planning method based on a three-dimensional visualization technology, which comprises the following steps of: obtaining geographic data of a power grid and real-time operation data; converting geographic data of a power grid into a three-dimensional model by using a GIS technology; integrating real-time data in the three-dimensional model, and analyzing key parameters of the power system; based on a three-dimensional visual model, planning and optimizing decision of the power grid are carried out, and the expansion, upgrading and optimizing schemes of the power grid are visually analyzed to predict future load increase and system capacity requirements; performing emergency response exercise by using a three-dimensional visualization technology, and evaluating the coping capability of the system under various fault conditions; developing a user-friendly three-dimensional visual interface and providing intelligent suggestion and decision support. According to the invention, by constructing the visual model, simulation analysis can be performed on the data in advance, and real-time simulation and update can be performed, so that the power grid planning efficiency is higher.
assignees: WUHAN HUAYUAN ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Emergency response coordination system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coordination response, in particular to an emergency response coordination system based on the Internet of things, the system comprises an abnormal event identification module, an event influence analysis module, a resource dynamic matching module, an emergency scheme making module, a scene simulation previewing module, a priority adjustment module, a real-time monitoring module and an intelligent scheduling command module. According to the invention, discrete event simulation is adopted in the resource dynamic matching module, emergency resources can be dynamically collected and distributed according to the regional influence rating in the event influence analysis record, the accuracy of resource allocation is remarkably improved, the resource utilization rate is optimized, key resources and personnel can be rapidly scheduled to the most needed place, the scene simulation previewing module adopts an individual as the model, the practicability and the reliability of an emergency scheme are improved by simulating different response strategies, the emergency response speed and accuracy are ensured, and casualties and property loss are effectively reduced.

title_en: Remote sensing change information extraction method and device based on zero sample learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing change information extraction method and device based on Zero sample Learning, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the Zero-sample Learning (ZSL) technology can identify and search the unseen change types under the condition of no training sample by utilizing priori knowledge and semantic information. The method is based on a deep learning technology and a general visual basic model, and features of a remote sensing image are matched with semantic descriptions by constructing a change feature semantic space, so that effective retrieval of a type which is not changed is realized. The method not only improves the flexibility and generalization capability of remote sensing image change detection, but also provides powerful technical support for the fields of earth observation, environment monitoring, disaster assessment and the like. The invention combines the deep learning technology and the general visual basic model, and matches the characteristics of the remote sensing image with the semantic description by constructing the semantic space of the change characteristics, thereby realizing the effective retrieval of the type which is not changed.
assignees: CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION NETWORK AND INFORMATION CENTER

title_en: Strong convection precipitation data analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strong convection precipitation data analysis method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent analysis and comprises the following steps: and analyzing to obtain the movement characteristics and the space characteristics of the strong rainfall elements, constructing a strong rainfall element movement virtual track according to the movement characteristics, carrying out optimizing matching on the strong rainfall element movement virtual track, constructing a flood evaluation model, wherein the output quantity of the flood evaluation model is the occurrence probability of flood, training a machine learning model for predicting the flood probability, and testing the machine learning model. According to the invention, the movement characteristics and the space distribution characteristics of the strong rainfall elements in the same subarea and among different subareas are analyzed, the weights of the natural parameters, the movement virtual track and the space characteristics are calculated, a flood evaluation model is constructed, scientific basis is provided for disaster early warning and planning, the trained machine learning model is tested, the prediction accuracy and reliability of the machine learning model are evaluated, and a reliable flood prediction service is provided for practical application.

title_en: Geological parameter inversion method and device for influencing slope deformation
