abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a geological parameter inversion method and device for influencing slope deformation, wherein the geological parameter inversion method for influencing the slope deformation comprises the following steps: obtaining geological parameters and deformation data of a slope to be monitored; determining the significance of the geological parameters according to the orthogonal test, and selecting and optimizing the geological parameters according to the significance of the geological parameters; constructing a correlation function of geological parameters and deformation data according to network parameters of a target neural network, wherein the target neural network is obtained based on genetic algorithm training; and establishing a multi-objective function according to the correlation function, and solving an inversion result of the geological optimization parameter based on the multi-objective function. The method improves inversion precision, and can more accurately simulate and predict the deformation behavior of the side slope. By accurately inverting the geological parameters, potential unstable areas can be identified in advance, reinforcement measures can be timely taken, the risks of slope disasters are reduced, and personnel safety and engineering stability are guaranteed.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA HIGH TECH HOLDING CO LTD;ZHONGBEITONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Real-time early warning method for collapse disaster risk in construction of pulling pipe passing through road
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time early warning method for collapse disaster risk in construction of a pull pipe passing through a road, which is based on physical and mechanical indexes of construction sites given in a geological survey report, wherein FLAC  3D  software establishes a finite difference numerical model to simulate the construction process of the pull pipe, and sequentially introduces the finite difference numerical model into the numerical model for forward analysis through a multi-factor orthogonal design method design scheme to obtain deformation calculation values of multiple groups of soil mechanical parameters of different sites and corresponding road surface monitoring points. And taking the calculated value as a learning sample set and a test sample, and obtaining a trained least square support vector machine model through MATLAB. The invention has the beneficial effects that: compared with the conventional stability evaluation means, the method is capable of continuously correcting and adjusting the digital model by combining real-time deformation data and predicting the next road surface deformation in advance. The invention can realize real-time dynamic advanced early warning of the road surface deformation in the pipe pulling construction process. The risk management and the fine management of site construction are facilitated, and major safety accidents are avoided.
assignees: TIANJIN SURVEY AND DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster emergency simulation method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster management, in particular to a digital twinning-based flood disaster emergency simulation method and system, comprising the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing, namely acquiring environmental data related to a flood disaster in real time; the method comprises the steps of S2, establishing a digital twin model of a flood disaster area, S3, simulating calculation, S4, optimizing a flood propagation path, identifying a mode and abnormality, S5, establishing an emergency plan by combining history flood disaster coping experience, S6, evaluating and improving, after flood disaster emergency response is finished, evaluating the execution effect of the emergency plan, summarizing experience teaching training, and optimizing the digital twin model and the emergency plan. The invention realizes accurate prediction and high-effect response to flood disasters.

title_en: Tailing pond accident emergency simulation method and system based on multiple intelligent agents
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tailing pond disaster emergency management and simulation, and provides a tailing pond accident emergency simulation method and system based on multiple intelligent agents, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a remote sensing image of a mine tailing pond, and generating a three-dimensional live-action mapping model according to the remote sensing image; establishing an accident model, an emergency material model, an emergency evacuation model and an emergency rescue model according to the three-dimensional live-action mapping model, and determining interaction relations among the accident model, the emergency material model, the emergency evacuation model and the emergency rescue model; and simulating to obtain an accident emergency result of the mine tailing pond according to the three-dimensional live-action mapping model, the accident model, the emergency material model, the emergency evacuation model, the emergency rescue model and the interaction relation. According to the method provided by the application, aiming at disasters caused by accidents in the tailing pond on the downstream, an emergency simulation system considering multiple intelligent agents is constructed, and an emergency rescue strategy is obtained according to the simulation result, so that a reference is provided for an emergency rescue decision, and the rescue rate is improved.
assignees: CHINA ENFI ENG CORP;CHINA NONFERROUS ENG CO LTD

title_en: Modeling method, device and equipment for digital twin tailing pond
abstract_en: The application discloses a modeling method, a device and equipment for a digital twin tailing pond, relates to the technical field of intelligent management and control of tailing ponds, and aims to realize the fine analysis of dam stability by carrying out fine flood simulation on the change process of Hong Shuiku water levels through a digital twin model of the tailing pond so as to ensure the safe operation of the tailing pond. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of the tailing pond, wherein the digital twin model of the tailing pond comprises a flood prediction early warning sub-model, a tailing dam stability simulation sub-model and a dam break simulation sub-model, carrying out different-time stability analysis on the tailing dam by using the tailing dam stability simulation sub-model according to the state parameters of the tailing pond in different time states, carrying out flood prediction by using the flood prediction early warning sub-model according to the predicted rainfall of weather prediction, and judging whether the predicted flood reaches the overtopping dam break condition, and if so, predicting the flood disaster influence condition of the downstream of the tailing pond by using the dam break simulation sub-model.
assignees: CHINA ENFI ENG CORP;CHINA NONFERROUS ENG CO LTD

title_en: Model test device for inducing multi-layer landslide of highway by rainfall and slope confluence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster model tests, in particular to a model test device for inducing multi-layer landslide of a highway by rainfall and slope confluence. The slope model comprises a sliding bed, a multi-layer sliding belt and a plurality of sliding bodies, wherein the multi-layer sliding belt sequentially comprises a shallow sliding belt, a middle sliding belt and a deep sliding belt from top to bottom, and the plurality of sliding bodies sequentially comprise a shallow sliding belt upper sliding body, a middle sliding belt upper sliding body and a deep sliding belt upper sliding body from top to bottom; the shallow sliding belt upper sliding body is arranged on the shallow sliding belt, the middle sliding belt upper sliding body is arranged between the shallow sliding belt and the middle sliding belt, and the deep sliding belt upper sliding body is arranged between the middle sliding belt and the deep sliding belt. The invention can effectively simulate the slope converging process and simulate the road landslide.

title_en: Numerical simulation method for moisture permeability behavior of individual protective fabric based on lattice Boltzmann method
abstract_en: The invention provides a numerical simulation method for the moisture permeability behavior of an individual protective fabric based on a lattice Boltzmann method, which comprises the following steps: scanning a fiber membrane sample of the individual protective fabric to obtain three-dimensional microstructure image data; binarization processing is carried out on the three-dimensional microstructure image data to obtain a two-dimensional sequence image; three-dimensional reconstruction is carried out on the two-dimensional sequence image, and a separated and communicated pore network model is generated; quantitatively analyzing the pore network model, and extracting pore structure characteristic parameters of the fiber membrane; and combining the two-dimensional sequence image and the pore structure characteristic parameter, and simulating the moisture permeability of the fiber membrane based on the lattice Boltzmann method. The invention explores the moisture permeability mechanism of the nanofiber material deeply, not only expands the understanding of the microstructure of the high-performance fiber material, but also provides scientific basis for improving the protection effect and wearing comfort of the firefighter uniform material, thereby enhancing the safety and the operation efficiency of firefighters in extreme environments.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;SHANDONG NEW SUNSHINE ENVIRONMENTAL PROT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: High-rise residential fire evacuation infant care behavior data collection experimental method based on mixed reality technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building safety and evacuation simulation, and discloses a high-rise residential fire evacuation infant care behavior data collection experimental method based on a mixed reality technology. Step 1: scanning environment information in an experimental high-rise residential building to establish a three-dimensional model of the high-rise residential building; step 2: completing mixing to realize fire scene construction; step 3: the tested person wears the mixed reality head display and the wearable odor player to perform experiments; step 4: a human body dynamic model is manufactured through a volume motion capturing method; step 5: whether the infant evacuation is successful or not is evaluated, and an experiment of the successful evacuation is marked; step 6: the acquired data is processed and the resulting packet number is stored. The invention designs the fire emergency evacuation experiment of the infant guardian while realizing the infant care, thereby obtaining the related evacuation behavior data of the infant care evacuation and providing data support for the follow-up simulation and research.

title_en: Method and system for identifying evacuated pedestrians in dense places in fire dense fog environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying evacuated pedestrians in dense places in a fire dense fog environment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of existing fire disaster dense fog scene images, and preprocessing the fire disaster dense fog scene images to obtain a preprocessed image data set; constructing a YOLOv8-Mask pedestrian detection model based on YOLOv framework, inputting an image dataset into the YOLOv8-Mask pedestrian detection model for training to obtain a trained YOLOv8-Mask pedestrian detection model; and inputting the self-acquired fire scene and thick fog scene images into a trained YOLOv-Mask pedestrian detection model to detect, so as to obtain the recognition result of the evacuated pedestrians in the dense places in the fire and thick fog environment. According to the invention, the approximate position of the searcher is detected through yolo targets, and the profile of the trapped person is detected by combining with the mask branch of the attention mechanism, so that the identification of the person in the environment is improved.

title_en: Method for identifying and early-warning analysis of fire symptoms of electrified cable and training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying and early-warning fire symptoms of an electrified cable and a training system; the method judges the occurrence condition and the dangerous degree of the cable fire disaster by establishing a cable fire disaster early warning model, so that different fire extinguishing devices can be started timely, and meanwhile, the entrance time of firefighters can be judged according to the fire extinguishing process; the information collected by the device is used for training a cable fire early warning model, and the device comprises a mounting bracket, a power supply module, a data acquisition module, a cable laying module and an alarm and fire extinguishing module; the cable laying module is used for erecting cables; the power supply module is used for supplying power to the cable and overload; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring environmental data when the cable burns; the alarming and extinguishing module is used for reporting the fire state of the cable and extinguishing the fire; according to the invention, various indexes are monitored simultaneously, and the study sample is obtained by establishing the test device, so that the fire category of the electrified cable is judged in real time, the fire alarm accuracy of the cable is effectively improved, and the false alarm rate is reduced.

title_en: Tunnel fire simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of tunnel engineering, and discloses a tunnel fire simulation test device and a method, wherein the device comprises a tunnel model; the air supply device is arranged outside the inlet end of the tunnel model; the blocking test boxes are arranged in the tunnel model at intervals and are arranged at the upstream section of the tunnel model; the simulated fire source is arranged at the tail end of the downstream side of the blockage test box; the temperature acquisition device is used for acquiring vault flue gas temperature data in the tunnel model; the wind speed acquisition device is used for acquiring the wind speed data of the end face of the outlet end of the tunnel model; the flue gas state acquisition device is used for acquiring flue gas movement state data in the tunnel model; the data analysis module is used for acquiring a tunnel fire test result in a blocking state according to vault smoke temperature data, outlet end face wind speed data and smoke motion state data in the tunnel model; the invention can simulate tunnel fire disaster under different blocking and ventilation states, provides data base for vehicle and personnel evacuation, and effectively improves evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Meteorological multisource fusion lattice point data topography correction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a meteorological multisource fusion lattice point data topography correction method and system based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: constructing a space-time data set; wherein the spatiotemporal dataset comprises: site data sets, terrain data sets, and live grid data sets; inputting the space-time data set into a deep neural network for training to obtain a correction model; wherein the deep neural network model adopts a multi-layer fully-connected neural network model; and acquiring a precipitation correction value based on the correction model. The technology for correcting the topography of the meteorological multisource fusion lattice point data in Guangdong province by using the fully-connected neural network can strongly support the improvement of the technical level of multiple businesses such as weather forecast, meteorological service, meteorological disaster risk assessment, management and early warning, and has important practical significance for guaranteeing the production, life and property safety of people.

title_en: Gymnastics swivel training device and method of use thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a gymnastics rotation training device and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of gymnastics training. The gymnastics swivel training device comprises a monitoring and data acquisition, deep learning analysis, training adjustment, safety and emergency response and interactive training interface module. The method has the advantages that the action and physiological data of the athlete are captured and collected in real time through the cameras, the sensors and the data transmission processing unit, the swivel action of the athlete is recognized and evaluated through the convolutional neural network, the body gesture and the action are analyzed through the gesture estimation algorithm, the athlete action is comprehensively evaluated, the training difficulty and parameters are automatically adjusted based on reinforcement learning, the physiological indexes of the athlete are monitored in real time, the excessive training and the injury risk are prevented, and the data can be conveniently checked and the training plan is adjusted. The device can realize the omnidirectional monitoring and data acquisition to sportsman's action of turning to and individualized training is adjusted and the safety guarantee, provides more scientific, efficient training mode for gymnastics.

title_en: Multi-channel infrared gas detection system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel infrared gas detection system and method based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of big data. The invention comprises the following steps: multichannel infrared sensor module: an infrared sensor array is adopted, and comprises a plurality of independent channels, wherein each channel is responsible for detecting the infrared spectrum of a specific wavelength; and a data preprocessing module: preprocessing the original data, and extracting features from the preprocessed data; normalizing the extracted features, and visually displaying the preprocessed data; pattern recognition and classification module: training through pre-marked training data by using a support vector machine model, and establishing a gas classification model; and the real-time monitoring and alarming module is used for: continuously monitoring gas concentration data acquired from the data preprocessing module, and triggering an alarm mechanism when the gas concentration is monitored to exceed a set threshold value; and the data storage and management module is used for: and storing the processed data, implementing a distributed data backup strategy, and establishing a disaster recovery mechanism.
assignees: JIANGSU JOTRY ELECTRICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Risk analysis method of yard emergency rescue system based on petri net
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk analysis method of a storage yard emergency rescue system based on petri nets, which belongs to the field of storage yard emergency rescue and solves the problem of low reliability of storage yard risk analysis, and concretely comprises the following steps of S1, respectively constructing a first petri net model, a second petri net model, a third petri net model and a fourth petri net model which are analyzed about storage yard fire, dangerous goods leakage, traffic accidents and container collapse, S2, performing primary simulation analysis on the first petri net model, the second petri net model, the third petri net model and the fourth petri net model to obtain a storage yard risk primary analysis report, S3, acquiring a historical operation record of a storage yard, counting and calculating disaster receiving weight of the storage yard, and performing secondary analysis on the storage yard risk primary analysis report to obtain a storage yard risk analysis report, and performing simulation and analysis on accidents which possibly occur in the storage yard by combining the disaster receiving weight to obtain the occurrence rate of each accident in normal operation of the storage yard, wherein the storage yard risk analysis is performed for the operation of the storage yard.

title_en: Simulation calculation model construction, simulation evaluation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation calculation model construction and simulation evaluation method, a system, equipment and a medium, comprising the following steps: based on the obtained structure association information of each power grid facility in the region, constructing a digital twin model for connecting each power grid facility in series; establishing association between the disaster damage limit value of each power grid facility in the obtained region and the corresponding power grid facility in the digital twin model to obtain a disaster informatization model of the power grid facility in the region; performing grid subdivision on the disaster informatization model by using a finite element analysis method to form different grid units, so as to obtain a simulation calculation model of the power grid facilities in the region; according to the invention, the risk level of the power grid facility disaster is subjected to simulation evaluation by using the pre-established simulation calculation model, and the regional power grid facilities are taken as an integral evaluation unit, so that the relevance among various facilities in the regional power grid is improved, and the accuracy of the simulation evaluation result of the power grid facility disaster in the region can be improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: System and method for rapidly evaluating building safety after collaborative earthquake of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The system comprises at least three unmanned aerial vehicles (1), a three-dimensional reconstruction subsystem (2), a damage detection subsystem (3) and a structural state evaluation subsystem (6); the method comprises the steps that a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles (1) cooperatively shoot a post-earthquake building through path planning, and image information is transmitted to a three-dimensional reconstruction subsystem (2) and a damage detection subsystem (3), and when the number of images reaches a certain number, batch update information is obtained; the three-dimensional reconstruction subsystem (2) is used for reconstructing three-dimensional information of the post-earthquake building, finely classifying the components of the post-earthquake building and preparing for modeling of the structural state evaluation subsystem (6); the damage detection subsystem (3) is used for detecting damage conditions of post-earthquake buildings, can divide and quantify the post-earthquake building damage, and damage information can define the post-earthquake damage in a post-earthquake model of the structure state evaluation subsystem (6); the structural state evaluation subsystem (6) is combined with the three-dimensional information of the three-dimensional reconstruction subsystem (2) and the damage information of the damage detection subsystem (3) to rapidly model the post-earthquake building, and the overall safety performance of the post-earthquake building is evaluated and rapidly graded through the earthquake simulation analysis, so that powerful technical support is provided for post-disaster rescue and reconstruction work.

title_en: Manufacturing method of 3D printing model of road tunnel damage structure after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a 3D printing model of a road tunnel damage structure after fire, which comprises the steps of analyzing and extracting damage information of the tunnel structure by utilizing a knowledge graph and field data, establishing a 3D printing damage structure model with rigidity change based on a damage report and a similarity criterion, simulating actual damage conditions, verifying and optimizing accuracy of the 3D printing model by modeling analysis and adjusting model parameters, manufacturing an optimized structure model by utilizing a 3D printing technology, reproducing details and complexity of tunnel damage, testing and calibrating mechanical properties of the 3D printing model, verifying mechanical response of the 3D printing model under different loads, ensuring that the model meets expectations on mechanical properties and geometric accuracy, and providing guidance for a post-disaster tunnel structure damage model test. The invention can be used for manufacturing the tunnel damage model with equivalent rigidity after the fire disaster based on the 3D printing technology through the tunnel deformation after the fire disaster and the structural characteristics, and provides practical guidance for the model test of the tunnel structure after the fire disaster.

title_en: Method for constructing three-dimensional real-time drainage basin based on acoustic chromatography technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a three-dimensional real-time drainage basin based on an acoustic chromatography technology. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring shoreline information and terrain elevation of a river region; setting up an acoustic chromatography system in a river basin, acquiring real-time flow and water level data of the river basin, and setting up a real-time database to update the flow and water level data in real time; constructing a river water power model by using Delft3D based on shoreline information and terrain elevation; based on the real-time database, the river hydrodynamic model is updated in real time by using Delft 3D. According to the invention, the acoustic chromatography system is coupled with Delft3D, the water flow and hydrodynamic behavior of the whole river basin can be simulated through a small number of sensors, a large number of on-site monitoring devices are not needed, and the monitoring cost is greatly reduced. In emergency events (such as flood, pollution accidents and the like), the hydrodynamic model refreshed at high frequency can quickly simulate the development and the influence range of the event, and an effective emergency response scheme is formulated to reduce disaster loss.

title_en: Intelligent training system and method for emergency use of fire extinguisher
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent training system and method for emergency use of a fire extinguisher, comprising a water-based fire extinguisher, a virtual flame simulator and a wind direction simulator; the virtual flame simulation unit is combined with the airflow generator and the LED lamp matrix, so that flame characteristics in a real fire disaster can be simulated. The wind direction simulator simulates the ambient wind direction of the fire scene by displaying a plurality of random wind vanes on the ground. The design enables students to actually sense the influence of wind on jet flow of the fire extinguisher when facing different wind directions, thereby grasping fire extinguishing skills in complex environments. The intelligent scoring system uses a K Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm to scientifically evaluate training effects. Through parameter tuning, the system can accurately evaluate the performances of the participants and provide personalized feedback to help students identify own advantages and disadvantages.

title_en: Gecko-like robot design with autonomous ultrasonic detection capability
abstract_en: The invention provides a new gecko-like robot design, and relates to the technical field of special robot equipment. The invention relates to a gecko-like robot which is a special bionic robot with the structure and advantages of a four-foot robot and a wall climbing robot, plays an important role in various fields of aerospace, investigation, disaster search and rescue and the like, and aims to enable the gecko-like robot to normally perform exploration work on complex terrains and various occasions. And then, carrying out statics and dynamics simulation on the robot, and providing a corresponding optimal design scheme aiming at simulation analysis results. Finally, a robot control system is designed to complete the linear walking function and the obstacle avoidance function.

title_en: Quantitative calculation method for risk of railway working line equipment based on grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid-based quantitative calculation method for risk of railway working line equipment, which relates to the technical field of railway working equipment management, and comprises the following steps: dividing grids of railway service lines; carrying out standardized treatment on risk events of railway working line equipment and disaster causing factors of the risk events, and collecting and arranging disaster causing factor state data of the railway working lines subjected to grid division; performing quantization assignment on the disaster-causing factor state data to obtain quantized data; training the models in the model library based on the quantized data, and screening out the model with the best fitting effect as a railway working line equipment risk quantitative calculation model; and quantitatively calculating the risk event probability level of the railway working line equipment based on the railway working line equipment risk quantitative calculation model. The invention can quantitatively analyze the risk of railway working line equipment and provide important decision support for railway managers and decision makers.
assignees: CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;CHINA RAILWAY LANZHOU BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fill electric pile test detecting system
abstract_en: A charging pile test detection system, characterized by comprising: the device comprises an alternating current power supply, an alternating current charging pile to be tested, a main control machine, a testing instrument, a terminal block, a vehicle interface circuit simulator, a vehicle control simulation circuit and a load, wherein the alternating current charging pile to be tested and the testing instrument are connected with the alternating current power supply through wires, a relay A is connected in series between the alternating current charging pile to be tested and the alternating current power supply and between the testing instrument and the alternating current power supply, the testing instrument in the device is integrated in the circuit, the utility model has the advantages of no need of other auxiliary tools, automatic test and detection, data intercommunication and sharing, timely data integration and analysis, high efficiency, rapid and accurate analysis and processing capability of data processing, high test precision and no error, and can accurately judge overload and leakage of equipment, thereby avoiding major accidents such as fire disaster and the like.
assignees: DONGGUAN ZHENCHEN ELECTROMECHANICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Device for simulating soil loss caused by geological disasters encountered by geothermal well
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of geological experiments, and particularly provides a device for simulating soil loss caused by geological disasters encountered by a geothermal well, which comprises a soil box, a pressurizing plate, a loss guide pipe and a retaining wall, wherein the soil box is used for placing the soil body, the pressurizing plate is covered on the top of the soil body and is used for compacting the soil body, an observation window is formed in the side face of the soil box and is used for observing the soil loss condition in the soil box, the loss guide pipe is fixed at the bottom of the soil box and is communicated with the soil box, the retaining wall is vertically and slidably arranged on the inner side of the soil box and forms an interlayer with the side wall of the soil box, liquid can be stored in the interlayer, the contact condition between the inner wall of the geothermal well and the soil body is simulated by arranging the retaining wall in the soil box, the interlayer capable of storing the liquid is formed between the retaining wall and the side wall of the soil box, a leakage area can be formed at the bottom of the retaining wall by extracting the retaining wall, and the water loss condition when slurry retaining wall is lost is simulated.

title_en: Intelligent interactive monitoring and early warning system for geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses an intelligent interactive monitoring and early warning system for geological disasters, which comprises the following components: the multi-source data fusion and enhancement module is used for fusing data of various data sources; the edge computing module is connected with the multi-source data fusion and enhancement module and is used for carrying out preliminary data processing and analysis at the front end of data acquisition; the digital twin geological model module is connected with the edge calculation module and is used for creating a digital twin geological model of the monitoring area and simulating and predicting the evolution process of geological disasters; and the blockchain data trusted management module is connected with the edge calculation module and is used for ensuring the authenticity and the non-tamper property of the geological disaster monitoring data. Through fusing a plurality of data sources such as satellite remote sensing, unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography, ground sensors, social media and the like, the data are enhanced and processed by adopting a machine learning algorithm, and the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the data are obviously improved.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANFU NEW AREA INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE SOUTHWEST UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Structure collapse process visualization method suitable for multi-type disaster effect initiation
abstract_en: The invention provides a collapse simulation method of a finite element-physical engine capable of integrating multiple types of units, which comprises the following steps: aiming at a specific disaster scene, a finite element model of a target structure is established, and small deformation finite element simulation before structural collapse is carried out on the finite element model; based on the finite element simulation result, determining the collapse starting time of the structure, and extracting the small deformation process before the collapse of the structure by finite element simulation to map into a 3D animation form; mapping the 3D animation model at the collapse moment to a physical engine model, and performing large deformation simulation on the collapsed target structure by using the physical engine model to obtain a collapse large deformation simulation result; and integrating and rendering a 3D animation result of small deformation simulation before structural collapse and a collapse large deformation simulation result based on a physical engine, so as to realize visualization of the collapse process. The method can visualize the structure collapse process caused by accidental accidents such as earthquake, impact and explosion, and displays reasonable and high-fidelity virtual scenes of building collapse ruins.

title_en: Simulation method for anchoring bearing and destabilizing disaster-causing characteristics of broken rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method of anchoring bearing and destabilizing disaster-causing characteristics of broken rock mass, which comprises the following steps: generating a frame, a perforated bottom plate, supporting legs and the ground by using the wall body; generating anchor rod and tray particles and endowing parallel bonding contact models; generating Clump rigid particle clusters by taking real rock blocks as templates and compacting; a linear contact model is given to the rock mass and the rock mass, the rock mass and the wall body and the rock mass and the anchor rod in the anchoring structure; applying pretightening force to the anchor rod and judging whether the anchor rod is successfully anchored; performing mesoscopic parameter calibration on the parallel bonding model and the linear contact model; carrying out self-stabilization simulation calculation under low pretightening force on the anchoring structure; carrying out self-stabilization simulation calculation under high pretightening force on the anchoring structure; carrying out vertical loading simulation calculation on the anchoring structure; carrying out horizontal loading simulation calculation on the anchoring structure; and carrying out rock mass fracture simulation calculation on the anchoring structure. The invention provides references for the design and stability evaluation of the roadway broken surrounding rock support parameters.
assignees: SHENDI SCIENCE AND ENG YUNLONG LAKE LABORATORY;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Visual monitoring method and system for reconstructing gas pressure distribution based on finite point data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and provides a visual monitoring method and a visual monitoring system for reconstructing gas pressure distribution based on finite point data. The method comprises the following steps: fitting the measured gas pressure of the coal-bed gas pressure measuring point and the extraction shortest distance between the coal-bed gas pressure measuring point and the corresponding gas extraction drilling hole to obtain a first coal-bed gas pressure regression model; fitting the fitting constant and the extraction time of each coal seam gas pressure measuring point in gas extraction to obtain a second coal seam gas pressure regression model so as to predict the gas pressure at any time at any position in the coal seam space. By the method, based on limited gas pressure test data in the underground coal mine, the gas pressure in the extraction process is regressed into a regression prediction model of extraction position and extraction time, and further, the gas pressures in different spaces and times can be predicted according to the regression prediction model, so that the gas pressure space distribution state of the coal seam can be intuitively perceived.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Strong wind disaster weather index prediction system based on long-short-term memory network model
abstract_en: The invention provides a weather index prediction system for a severe wind disaster based on a long-short-term memory network model, which relates to the technical field of weather monitoring and specifically comprises the steps of collecting historical meteorological data of an area to be evaluated and disaster area and duration of a severe wind disaster event occurring in corresponding time; an index prediction model is built based on a long-short-period memory network, historical meteorological data is input into the model as a training set, the disaster receiving area and the duration of a corresponding high wind disaster are used as labels, the model is trained, meteorological data of an area to be evaluated are collected in real time to obtain a predicted disaster receiving area and a predicted duration, terrain height and gradient data are collected to correct the predicted disaster receiving area and the predicted duration, the predicted disaster receiving area and the predicted duration are compared with a preset threshold, and risk grades are divided according to the results. The application of the short-term memory network model can learn the deep correlation between factors such as wind speed, humidity and temperature and the disaster event of the strong wind from the historical meteorological data, so that the prediction accuracy is improved.

title_en: Urban rail growing interval judging method and device based on fire data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for judging a large urban rail section based on fire data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: building a carriage physical model through fire-fighting simulation software, and performing fire simulation on the carriage physical model to obtain a first fire spreading time T  1 ; adopting personnel evacuation simulation software to simulate the evacuation of passengers in a carriage physical model according to the preset passenger distribution, and obtaining a first safe evacuation time T  2 ; and acquiring a long and large interval value according to the highest speed V of the train, the first fire spreading time T  1  and the first safe evacuation time T  2 . So as to solve the problem that the long section is difficult to judge when considering the fire.

title_en: Urban flood risk assessment method and platform based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city flood risk assessment method and a city flood risk assessment platform based on multi-source data fusion, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and formulating a data acquisition target based on a cloud platform, integrating a multi-source device group, generating an initial data set by sensing a target area, preprocessing to obtain a processed data set, fusing to obtain a fused data set, constructing a model based on the fused data set, performing rainfall simulation, and synchronizing the result to the model to obtain a dynamic evaluation result. The technical problems of single data source, poor quality and compatibility, lack of dynamic property, inaccurate and unreliable model and unsophisticated evaluation and unsophisticated system in the existing evaluation are solved, and the technical effects of reducing the loss caused by flood disasters and improving the disaster resistance of cities are achieved.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Water level line monitoring method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, and particularly provides a water level line monitoring method based on deep learning. The method comprises image preprocessing and data enhancement; constructing a feature extraction and recognition model; adopting BCEDiceLoss as a loss function, optimizing the feature extraction and identification model to obtain an optimized feature extraction and identification model; correcting image distortion and transforming inverse perspective; training the feature extraction and recognition model; and (5) water level line detection, feature extraction and identification model evaluation. According to the method, the deep learning model is utilized to analyze and identify the water line images, complex and effective features can be automatically learned from a large number of water line images, the accuracy and the automation degree of water level monitoring are improved, the requirement of manual monitoring is reduced, and the guarantee management of water resources and disaster prevention are effectively supported.
assignees: SHANDONG UNIV WEIHAI INDUSTRIAL TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Fire rescue escape guiding method and system based on microwave radar detection and ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue escape guiding method and system based on microwave radar detection and ad hoc network, and relates to the technical field of fire rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a building simulation model of a building structure, and labeling equipment coordinates on the building simulation model; the fire sensor sends fire alarm information to the data processing server to generate a fire alarm point bitmap, an alarm thermodynamic diagram and a fire spread diagram, and the data processing server generates a personnel point bitmap and a personnel thermodynamic diagram in the building simulation model according to personnel position coordinates of the microwave radar detection sensor; the data processing server carries out arrangement analysis on the fire alarm point bitmap, the alarm thermodynamic diagram, the fire spread diagram, the personnel presence point bitmap and the personnel thermodynamic diagram to generate an optimal rescue escape path; and the data processing server sends the optimal rescue escape path to the voice broadcasting device to guide personnel to escape. The invention improves the evacuation efficiency of trapped people and the rescue efficiency of rescue workers and reduces the risk of casualties.

title_en: Highway tunnel conflagration ventilation test system that discharges fume
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway tunnel fire ventilation and smoke discharge testing system which comprises a simulated tunnel component, wherein the simulated tunnel component comprises a tunnel channel. The invention adopts the fire and smoke simulation mechanism to simulate the fire point of a fire disaster, the fire and smoke simulation mechanism can move the adjustment position on the track, and the position of the bearing plate shell provided with the fire source device, the smoke simulation component and the heater is adjusted, so that the fire position can be conveniently simulated, the smoke discharging conical opening of the smoke simulation component can be adjusted in angle, the heat-resistant bin can be rotated, the orientation of the smoke discharging conical opening can be further adjusted, different smoke discharging positions can be simulated, and in the testing process, the position of the bearing plate can be also adjusted to simulate the fire spreading condition in the actual fire disaster, the air inlet simulation mechanism simulates the air inlet through the air inlet jet fan, the position and the orientation of the air inlet jet fan are adjustable, and different wind directions can be simulated, so that the testing simulation is closer to reality, and the testing result is more accurate.
assignees: ZHONGLIAN KERICH FIRE FIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire control system data safety monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire control system data safety monitoring method and a system, which relate to the technical field of fire control data monitoring, and are characterized in that a time sequence encoder is constructed by constructing an equipment adjacency matrix, collecting monitoring sample data, equipment state codes, equipment event codes and system state labels of each fire control equipment in a fire control system in a plurality of acquisition time periods; and generating time sequence data codes for monitoring sample data in each acquisition time period by using a time sequence encoder, forming node initial characteristics by using the time sequence data codes, the equipment state codes and the equipment event codes of each fire-fighting equipment in each acquisition time period, taking an equipment adjacent matrix and each node initial characteristic as input, taking a system state label as output, training a safety state prediction graph model, providing more accurate and comprehensive fire-fighting system safety assessment, guaranteeing the safety of personnel and property, and improving emergency response and maintenance efficiency.
assignees: NANJING JIURUN SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-pressure air source emptying protection device for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground coal mine safety, and particularly provides a high-pressure air source emptying protection device for a coal mine, which comprises a water mixer, an electric proportional valve, a controller, a first electric control valve and a second electric control valve; the system also comprises a pressure sensor, a pressure reducing valve and a flowmeter; specifically, the water mixer comprises a mixing pipe, a rear pipe, a branch pipe, an elbow pipe and a spray head; the device can realize remote control, empty high-pressure gas in the drilling machine, and avoid potential safety hazards caused by leakage of the high-pressure gas in the drilling machine in the process of replacing the drill rod; when the hole collapses, the pressure sensor can timely feed back the pressure parameter in the hole, and the controller regulates and controls according to the feedback parameter, so that the phenomenon that the pressure in the hole is too high to cause a spray hole is avoided; the gas-water mixing proportion can be regulated and controlled through working condition requirements, the cooling effect is achieved on the drill bit, the drill firing is prevented, and the disaster occurrence rate is effectively reduced.

title_en: Real-time detection device and detection method for potential hazards of underground coal mine drilling hydrologic disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time detection device and a detection method for potential hazards of hydrologic disasters of underground coal mine drilling, wherein a signal transmitting circuit is used for transmitting multiple dynamic multi-frequency-band signals. The signal acquisition circuit is used for receiving the multiple dynamic pseudo-random signals in real time, so that the signals are transmitted to the signal processing circuit. The signal processing circuit is used for discriminating the phase of the modulated signal. The signal control circuit is used for controlling the operation of the circuits of the whole device and the processing of signals. The signal transmission circuit is used for controlling and organizing the transmission of signals in the circuits of the whole device. The power supply circuit is used to provide effective power support for other circuits in the overall device. The current protection circuit is used for protecting the circuit current in the whole device from stabilizing. The method can solve the problem that the potential hazards of the hydrologic disasters of the underground coal mine drilling can not be detected in real time in the prior art, and can effectively detect the potential hazards of the hydrologic disasters of the underground coal mine drilling, so that the potential hazards of safety production are eliminated, the underground coal mine drilling and the underground coal mine drilling can be finely and effectively detected, the resolution of detection results is high, and the detection effect is obvious.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Complex structure cable tunnel shutoff linkage experiment research platform that puts out a fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex-structure cable tunnel plugging and fire extinguishing linkage experiment research platform, which comprises a tunnel model main body combination capable of being combined and spliced at will, wherein a mobile fire source system is arranged in the tunnel model main body combination; the tunnel model main body combination is also internally provided with a data acquisition system and a fire detection system; the middle part and the tip of tunnel model main part combination are equipped with shutoff fire extinguishing linkage fire extinguishing systems, shutoff fire extinguishing linkage fire extinguishing systems and data acquisition system and fire detection system communication connection. The fire disaster simulation system is manufactured according to the actual cable tunnel prototype in a scaled-down mode, and can achieve high-level real simulation of the fire disaster of the cable tunnel with the complex structure, so that the research on the synergistic effect of fire extinguishment and plugging of the cable tunnel with the complex structure is achieved.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Device and method for simulating scraping movement of chip flow with different water contents
abstract_en: The invention provides a scraping motion test device for simulating chip flow with different water contents, which comprises a base, wherein a chute frame is arranged on the base, a water tank is arranged at the top end of the chute frame, a chute is arranged on the inclined surface of the chute frame, one end of the chute is connected with a chip collecting tank, the other end of the chute is connected with a model groove, a release body is arranged at the joint of the chute and the model groove, a sprinkler is arranged above the model groove, the sprinkler is connected with the water tank through a water pipe, the top end of the release body is connected with one end of a cable, and the other end of the cable is connected with a crane. The invention provides a test device considering scraping movement of debris flow with different solid volume percentages, which provides scientific basis for predicting, forecasting and preventing high-level remote debris flow disasters.

title_en: Forestry resource change monitoring method based on multi-mode image generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forestry resource change monitoring method based on multi-mode image generation, which belongs to the technical field of image data processing and comprises the steps of constructing a data set; selecting a cycleGAN network, improving the loss function of the network, and training by using a data set to obtain an improved generator; constructing a SAR auxiliary encoder and improving an SETR network; constructing a complete data set G  all ; training the modified SETR network with G  all  results in a modified SETR model for change detection. The invention realizes the effective utilization of multi-mode information, not only can strengthen training stability and promote generalization capability, but also can carry out self-adaptive adjustment according to image quality, thereby realizing more accurate semantic segmentation on the forest image and obtaining more accurate change areas by combining semantic segmentation graphs at different moments. The invention can monitor the dynamic change of the forest and timely identify the events such as forest degradation, fire occurrence, disease diffusion and the like, thereby providing key information for forestry management and disaster response.
assignees: JIANGXI ZHUOMUFENG TECH CO LTD;JIANGXI INSTITUTE OF LAND AND SPACE INVESTIG AND PLANNING

title_en: Test device and method for simulating landslide-surge-river blockage-dam break disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a method for simulating landslide-surge-river blockage-dam break disaster chains, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster simulation and comprise the following steps: the river simulator simulates river beds with different gradients, and the circulating water supply device is used for supplying water to the water tank and can control the flow rate of water flowing into the water tank so as to simulate floodwater with different flow rates; the landslide simulation device comprises a chute and a second support frame, wherein the second support frame is arranged at the bottom of the chute and can adjust the inclination angle of the chute to simulate sliding bodies with different gradients; the material box is used for filling sliding body substances, and the data measuring device is used for recording and measuring landslide-surging-river blockage-dam break disaster chain processes.

title_en: Flood risk early warning mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flood risk early warning mechanism, which has the technical scheme that a baffle is arranged for solving the problem of the extension protection of a vertical plate on the disaster, and a flow velocity sensor is arranged for solving the problem of early warning the disaster condition by the water flow; the motor drives the transmission shaft to rotate, the transmission shaft drives the gear to rotate, and the gear drives the baffle to move through the tooth slot, so that the length of the baffle is prolonged; the underwater flow velocity is detected through the flow velocity sensor, detection data are transmitted to the PLC controller, the PLC controller is used for controlling the motor according to the data, a user can fix the position of the vertical plate through the drill rod, the flow velocity sensor is used for detecting the underwater flow velocity and transmitting the detection data to the PLC controller, the PLC controller is used for controlling the movement of the driving assembly according to the data, the driving assembly is convenient to drive the extension plate to move, the length of the extension plate is prolonged, and the disaster in a disaster area is convenient to primarily control.
assignees: GUANXIAN XINGYU WATER CONSERVANCY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar field station grid-connected modeling method considering extreme natural disaster scene and oriented to PSASP
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PSASP-oriented wind-light field station grid-connected modeling method considering an extreme natural disaster scene, and belongs to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the following steps of S1: the method comprises the steps of reading information of a wind-light station with equipment damage or outage conditions in a natural disaster scene; s2: automatically generating tide operation data describing a disaster scene operation mode in a detailed simulation model of the wind-solar field station; s3: automatically generating tide operation data describing a disaster scene operation mode in the wind-solar field station equivalent simulation model; s4: and automatically generating tide operation data describing a disaster scene operation mode in the large power grid simulation model. The method provided by the invention can help PSASP users to quickly construct the electromechanical transient simulation model of the large power grid considering the influence of extreme natural disasters under the condition of large-scale wind-light field station access, effectively improve the speed and efficiency of the electromechanical transient simulation modeling, and has stronger engineering significance and practical value.
assignees: STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Vibration table array test device and method for simulating complex dislocation-vibration coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibrating table array test device for simulating complex dislocation-vibration coupling, which comprises a main body frame and a vibrating table arranged at the lower part of the main body frame, wherein the vibrating table comprises a vibrating table bracket and a vibrating table frame, a movable box body and a fixed box body are arranged in the main body frame, the movable box body and the fixed box body are open top surfaces, opposite ends of the movable box body and the fixed box body are open ends, and a model box shear cutting seam is arranged between the open ends of the movable box body and the fixed box body. The invention also discloses a vibration table array test method for simulating complex dislocation-vibration coupling. The invention satisfies the simulation of the coupling of the simulated fault and the earthquake motion and provides a reference path for disaster prevention and reduction of the movable fault tunnel crossing in the intensity earthquake region.

title_en: Backup, disaster recovery and exercise method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a backup, disaster recovery and exercise method and a system, which belong to the technical field of backup disaster recovery, when a backup task is executed, a backup module is arranged, so that a regulation and mobilization virtualization management module and the backup module interact with a Fusion computer virtualization platform, a target virtual machine is created on the Fusion computer virtualization platform, a disk on the target virtual machine is mounted to the backup virtual machine, a backup catalog is created on the backup virtual machine, backup data sent by a working machine is received at the disk of the backup virtual machine, the disk is mounted to the target virtual machine, snapshot is carried out on the target virtual machine, and the disk is re-mounted back to the backup virtual machine; the backup virtual machine receives the backup log and stores the backup log in a backup catalog of the backup virtual machine, and realizes data backup based on the Fusion computer virtualization platform through different turnover mounting of the disk, thereby providing a basis for disaster recovery and solving the technical problem that the prior art does not have backup disaster recovery aiming at the Fusion computer platform.

title_en: Site earthquake effect evaluation method based on active fault dislocation and strong earthquake coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a site earthquake effect evaluation method based on active fault dislocation and strong earthquake coupling action, which belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and elimination in civil engineering and comprises the following steps: s1, determining the size of a model and boundary conditions of the model; s2, establishing a mountain tunnel surrounding rock system underground speed structure three-dimensional model; s3, establishing an active fault focus calculation model; s4, simulating the propagation process of earthquake motion and co-vibration deformation; s5, evaluating the field seismic effect of the tunnel address area under the action of the dislocation of the active layer and the strong shock coupling. The site earthquake effect evaluation method based on the active fault dislocation and strong earthquake coupling effect is provided, effective support is provided for site earthquake effect analysis of the tunnel site area based on the active fault dislocation and strong earthquake coupling effect, and the method has strong practicability.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Control method and system of fireman stair climbing training machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a system of a firefighter stair climbing training machine, which are used for switching training scenes of the firefighter stair climbing training machine based on a to-be-trained item and matching corresponding training programs, so that the training programs are updated aiming at the firefighter stair climbing training machine, the to-be-trained item of the firefighter is adapted, in addition, the training states of the firefighter are defined based on a plurality of training parameters, and training abnormal factors of the firefighter are defined according to the training states of the firefighter and the training scenes presented by the firefighter stair climbing training machine; the training abnormal factors of the firefighter trigger the dynamic regulation and control of the firefighter stair climbing training machine, so that the firefighter is in a dynamic balance relation with the firefighter stair climbing training machine in the training process, the matching performance of the firefighter training in the firefighter stair climbing training machine is guaranteed, the safety of the firefighter under high-strength training is improved, and the training balance relation of the firefighter and the firefighter stair climbing training machine in the training process is guaranteed.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Intelligent rescue force allocation method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster assessment and emergency rescue management, in particular to an intelligent rescue force allocation method based on reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps of inputting images to be evaluated into a damage classification model, outputting damage types, calculating actual damage areas, combining multiple factors, and predicting casualties through dynamic adjustment coefficients and weights, establishing a multi-rescue team and multi-disaster-point rescue planning model based on reinforcement learning, calculating rescue requirements of different disaster points according to factor weights such as different altitudes of the disaster points, constructing a data training rescue planning model according to the rescue requirements and team capacity, and solving rescue force allocation results under different calculation cases through a pre-training rescue planning model, wherein the damage classification model adopts EAFE-YOLOv-Seg network models, so that accuracy of post-earthquake building damage evaluation results is greatly improved, and accuracy of casualties assessment and rescue force allocation is further improved.

title_en: Corn drought and waterlogging dynamic monitoring and predicting method based on fine grid moisture balance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agriculture, and discloses a corn drought and waterlogging dynamic monitoring and evaluating method and a prediction method based on fine grid moisture balance. Acquiring agricultural meteorological live data, forecast data, geographic data and agricultural data of a region; building a database; preprocessing a training set; constructing a water balance parameter model; constructing a daily dynamic water surplus and deficient rate model; obtaining continuous rolling daily rainfall contribution weight and constructing a daily dynamic farmland actual water supply index model; constructing a daily dynamic drought and waterlogging index model; obtaining a daily maize field drought and waterlogging grade threshold system; monitoring a daily dynamic drought and waterlogging disaster drought and waterlogging index; forecasting the drought and waterlogging index of the daily dynamic drought and waterlogging disasters; and (3) corresponding the forecasting result of the drought and waterlogging index with a daily threshold value of the drought and waterlogging grade of the corn field, so as to guide the disaster defense decision. The method solves the problem of sparseness of the current monitoring network so as to improve the space-time resolution and accuracy of disaster monitoring and evaluation.
assignees: JILIN PROVINCE ZHONGNONG SUNSHINE DATA CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous data analysis-based security risk dynamic assessment system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a security risk dynamic assessment system and a security risk dynamic assessment method based on multi-source heterogeneous data analysis, which belong to the technical field of security risk management and control and specifically comprise the following steps: through active data acquisition and preprocessing, a dynamic knowledge graph is built by fusing multi-source heterogeneous data; predicting evolution paths and results under different risk scenes by utilizing a multidimensional evaluation index and a mixed risk evaluation model and combining a scene simulation technology; calculating a security risk value in real time by adopting a streaming data processing technology, setting a threshold value to automatically trigger a multi-level early warning mechanism, and making emergency response measures in time; the accuracy and timeliness of the chemical industry park safety risk assessment are improved.

title_en: Digital twin prevention method and system for geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin prevention method and a digital twin prevention system for geological disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an information sensing network; establishing a basic database; constructing an accumulated displacement prediction model; predicting the change trend and the maximum accumulated displacement of the geological disaster point; decomposing and accumulating displacement; obtaining an accumulated displacement prediction result; constructing a multi-factor early warning model; calculating and pushing the early warning grade in real time; judging the safety state of the geological disaster point, and simulating the stable state and deformation evolution trend of the geological disaster point under different working conditions; pushing a geological disaster safety prevention and control plan. The system comprises a monitoring sensing, predicting, early warning, previewing and planning module. The invention is based on digital twin technology, realizes on-line monitoring of ground disasters, predicts the development change of ground disasters in advance, early warns and pushes early warning information in time, previews simulated ground disaster deformation damage trend in real time and automatically pushes ground disaster plan response measures, can effectively improve the intelligent level of geological disaster prevention, and meets the requirements of intelligent prevention and management of geological disasters.
assignees: CHANGJIANG GEOTECHNICAL ENG CO LTD;SOUTH TO NORTH WATER DIVERSION MIDDLE ROUTE WATER SOURCE CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional morphological evolution simulation method for underground coal fire goaf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional morphological evolution simulation method for an underground coal fire combustion space area, and belongs to the field of geotechnical engineering geological disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining Sentinel-1A image data, extracting accumulated earth surface deformation values by adopting a DS-InSAR technology, extracting accumulated earth surface deformation contour lines by adopting ArcGIS software, constructing a three-dimensional form prediction model of an underground coal fire goaf by utilizing numerical simulation and three-dimensional modeling technology in a computer according to stratum parameters, earth surface temperature, a three-dimensional temperature field and accumulated earth surface deformation contour line data of the region recorded in data, inverting the three-dimensional form evolution process of the underground coal fire goaf, simulating formation of the underground coal fire goaf after coal seam combustion, and verifying the three-dimensional form inversion result of the underground coal fire goaf. The method realizes the description of the geometric structure of the underground coal fire combustion space area, reveals the morphological change of the underground coal fire combustion space area and the relation between the morphological change and elements such as the surface deformation and the like, and provides a new scientific basis for understanding the spatial characteristics and control factors of underground coal fires.

title_en: Method for controlling ground directional plugging of dynamic water disaster of spring-zone deep-buried tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for directionally blocking and treating a water disaster ground of a spring zone deep-buried tunnel, which comprises the steps of drilling directional drilling holes on the ground to the position of a blocking section in the tunnel, exploring the water movement condition in the tunnel, then feeding materials into the tunnel to form a water blocking section, injecting slurry into the water blocking section to combine the water blocking section with the slurry, and tightly combining the water blocking section with surrounding rock walls of the tunnel to finish water blocking construction. The water burst in the tunnel can be effectively controlled by constructing the water blocking section, so that the construction safety and the stability of the tunnel structure are ensured; the high-speed water flow is generated through the jet pump, the aggregate is driven to be thrown into the tunnel, the water flow is utilized to drive the aggregate, the aggregate enters the tunnel and has a certain initial speed, the aggregate is not easy to be flushed away by the water flow, a pile body can be better formed, the plugging efficiency is improved, the water-absorbing expansion material is matched to be thrown into the tunnel, and the quick and effective plugging of the tunnel water is realized.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA COAL MINE ENG CO

title_en: Mobile energy storage configuration method for improving power distribution network capacity under ice disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage configuration method for improving the capacity of a power distribution network under the influence of ice disaster, which comprises the following steps: according to the obtained line fault probability, considering the space-time transfer characteristic of the ice disaster, generating a fault state of each period of each line by using a time sequence Monte Carlo simulation method, and completing 1-time complete sampling of a fault scene of the distribution network under the ice disaster; repeating the sampling process until a plurality of scene sets are generated, and reducing the number of scenes by adopting a K-means clustering method to obtain S typical fault scenes; taking the minimum expected loss cost of the load of each node in S typical fault scenes in the ice disaster attack process as a target, and establishing a power distribution network mobile energy storage pre-disaster pre-layout random optimization model considering the dynamic evolution of the fault scenes in consideration of the readjustment process of the pre-disaster layout position of the mobile energy storage in each fault scene in the ice disaster dynamic evolution process; and converting nonlinear constraint in the model into linear constraint based on a Big-M method, generating a mixed integer linear programming model, solving, and outputting a dynamic scheduling scheme of the optimal pre-disaster distribution position of the mobile energy storage and each fault scene in the disaster period.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Disaster prediction method, device, equipment, medium and computer program product based on rainfall forecast data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of natural disaster prediction, in particular to a disaster prediction method, a device, equipment, a medium and a computer program product based on rainfall forecast data, which construct a hydrodynamic model based on historical hydrologic data; training the historical geological disaster data by using AutoGluon models to construct a geological disaster machine learning model; generating a heavy rain early warning map based on rainfall forecast data; respectively inputting the rainfall forecast data into the hydrodynamic model and the geological disaster machine learning model to respectively obtain a flood sensitivity analysis chart and a geological disaster sensitivity analysis chart; and combining the flood sensitivity analysis map, the geological disaster sensitivity analysis map and the heavy rain early warning map to generate a composite disaster sensitivity analysis map. The comprehensive analysis can more accurately predict various disasters caused by rainfall, and the effectiveness of disaster prevention and reduction is enhanced.

title_en: Personnel transfer path selection method based on urban inland inundation disaster situation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of path selection and discloses a personnel transfer path selection method based on urban waterlogging disaster situations, which comprises the steps of carrying out flood probability distribution analysis according to historical flood data of a research area, and carrying out waterlogging simulation analysis under a multi-combination situation based on a two-dimensional coupling external-flood waterlogging dynamic model established by the research area; according to the waterlogging simulation analysis result under the multi-combination scene, carrying out superposition analysis on the waterlogging simulation analysis result, road network data of a research area and community population structure data, and determining the number of people to be transferred and submerged road sections under the multi-combination scene; carrying out accessibility analysis of the transfer placement points according to the quantity of people to be transferred, the transfer route and the supply-demand ratio between the placement points; and according to the number of people to be transferred and the accessibility analysis result of the submerged road section and the transfer placement point in the multi-combination scene, carrying out optimal transfer path selection based on a network analysis model. The invention realizes the optimal solution calculation of the crowd placement points and the transfer paths under the situation of the multi-combination waterlogging disaster.
assignees: SICHUAN ANXIN KECHUANG TECH CO LTD;SICHUAN ACADEMY OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Flood intelligent forecasting method, system, equipment and medium based on hydrologic data feature extraction and sample enhancement
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood intelligent forecasting method, a system, equipment and a medium based on hydrological data feature extraction and sample enhancement, which are characterized in that firstly, historical flood event data are collected, feature extraction is carried out through a LASSO method, the data are divided into a training set and a testing set, secondly, gaussian noise is added to the training set through Gaussian data enhancement, then a flood intelligent forecasting model based on GANformer is constructed, a Sobol sequence and sine and cosine optimization strategy are adopted to improve a Kepler optimization algorithm KOA, the improved IKOA algorithm is utilized to optimize important parameters such as learning rate, batch size and hidden layer number of a GANformer model, and finally, the optimized GANformer model is applied to flood forecasting to provide real-time and accurate flood early warning information for flood control and disaster reduction. The invention can effectively improve the accuracy and reliability of flood forecast and provide powerful support for flood control and disaster reduction work.
