title_en: Power transmission line scene flood disaster risk prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting the risk of flood disasters in a scene of a power transmission line, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to a smooth particle fluid dynamics method, an SPH fluid simulation numerical model of the scene flood of the power transmission line is established, and a shallow water equation is solved, so that a continuity equation and a momentum conservation equation of the shallow water equation in a Lagrange form are obtained; constructing an SPH-SWE numerical model based on the two equations; based on the SPH-SWE numerical model, writing a flood simulation program; three-dimensional point cloud data of the power transmission line scene are obtained in real time, and are imported into a flood simulation program to simulate the height and the movement behavior of each fluid particle, so that risk prediction of the power transmission line scene flood disaster is completed. According to the invention, the SPH method is adopted to establish a fluid simulation numerical model, and a shallow water equation is solved, so that the particle motion behaviors of the fluid in the horizontal direction and the longitudinal direction are respectively controlled, the motion behavior operand is reduced, and the simulation operation efficiency is improved.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground subsidence susceptibility prediction method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground subsidence vulnerability prediction method, a ground subsidence vulnerability prediction device, a ground subsidence vulnerability prediction system and a ground subsidence vulnerability prediction storage medium, which belong to the technical field of geological disaster prediction and comprise the following steps: s1, acquiring historical InSAR observation data; s2, preprocessing historical InSAR observation data; s3, training a double-branch parallel fusion neural network according to the preprocessed historical InSAR observation data; and S4, inputting InSAR observation data to be processed into a trained double-branch parallel fusion neural network to predict the ground settlement vulnerability. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the reliability of LSSM is improved.

title_en: Monitoring and predictive early warning method for multiple disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for monitoring, predicting and early warning various disasters, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a geographic elevation model by using a geographic information system; analyzing the spatial relationship of the geographic elevation model, and extracting a ground surface geographic information model; establishing a valley-ridge geometric model and a river network geometric model, and converting geometric nodes and units into hydrodynamic nodes and units to obtain valley-ridge and river network hydrodynamic models; and obtaining rainfall data, combining the model and the numerical analysis method of hydraulics, taking the water level and the flow of each hydrodynamic node or unit as independent variables, and carrying out runoff hydrodynamic simulation on the water level fluctuation around the valleys and the river networks to obtain simulation data and prediction data reflecting the water level change so as to carry out flood forecast and early warning on the immersed area. The invention solves the problems that in the prior art, accurate simulation analysis and medium-long-term forecast and early warning cannot be performed on flood, drought, landslide, debris flow and avalanche disasters.
assignees: CHENGDU ZEXI PURUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for generating disaster case 3D virtual visualization patient based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for generating a disaster case 3D virtual visualization patient based on data driving, which belong to the technical field of 3D virtual visualization and comprise the following steps: for the creation of 3D virtual disaster patients, abstracting and extracting key data, such as: and constructing a basic database according to the sex, age group, wound position, wound type and other data of the patient. According to the method and the system for generating the 3D virtual visual patient of the disaster case based on the data driving, the efficiency and the accuracy of medical diagnosis are effectively improved by means of visual presentation and virtual interaction training means of a large number of various variable 3D disaster virtual patients, particularly when complex disaster rescue cases are processed, more efficient, visual and detailed disaster injury manifestation can be provided for medical staff, medical education and training are promoted, more real and vivid and real learning experience is provided through a virtual reality technology, the cost is reduced, and the emergency thinking decision capability of the medical staff under clinical conditions is improved.

title_en: Urban building earthquake hazard space risk assessment method based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GIS-based urban building earthquake hazard space risk assessment method, and relates to the technical field of earthquake hazard space risk assessment. The invention provides a GIS-based urban building earthquake hazard space risk assessment method, which comprises the steps of acquiring building, earthquake risk data and site condition data in an area, constructing a three-dimensional model of the building, and integrating an earthquake disaster database; constructing a seismological hazard scene simulation model, and generating a maximum displacement thermodynamic diagram of the building; based on building characteristics and earthquake motion parameters, obtaining the generation probability of secondary objects of the building and the object trajectory, and generating an object risk thermodynamic diagram; and obtaining and visualizing the space unit earthquake hazard risk according to the maximum displacement thermodynamic diagram and the falling object risk thermodynamic diagram of the building. Therefore, by adopting the method, a risk control basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction planning, and decision support is provided for building reinforcement, danger avoidance area demarcation, emergency evacuation path planning and other aspects.

title_en: CAVE rescue scene construction method and system adopting digital twin and holographic technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster relief, and discloses a CAVE relief scene construction method of digital twin and holographic technology, which comprises the following steps: digital twin technology, 3D real-time rendering technology, holographic technology, cave virtual reality technology, real-time collaboration module, S1, digital twin technology: this is a technique that builds a digital simulation in an informationized platform by integrating physical feedback data, aided by artificial intelligence, machine learning, and software analysis, which simulation is updated as physical entities change according to feedback to ensure that the virtual model matches the real world counterpart. According to the CAVE rescue scene construction method and system based on the digital twin and holographic technology, through integrating the digital twin, real-time rendering and holographic Cave technology, not only are the disaster rescue efficiency and safety improved, but also the immersion sense and interactivity are enhanced, so that the disaster rescue training and exercise are more scientific, efficient and real.

title_en: Safety risk monitoring and early warning system for non-coal surface mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field, in particular to a safety risk monitoring and early warning system for a non-coal surface mine, the non-coal surface mine safety risk monitoring and early warning system comprises a laser scattering monitoring module, a signal analysis module, a crack simulation analysis module, a risk identification module, a threshold calculation module, an early warning generation module and an emergency response guidance module. According to the invention, a Mie scattering theory laser scattering monitoring module is adopted to accurately measure the dust concentration in the air, the dust particle characteristics are extracted through fast Fourier transform, so that dust monitoring is further refined, accurate data support is provided for making dust prevention measures, and the crack simulation analysis module can accurately predict crack propagation by applying finite element analysis and fracture mechanics principles, so that the scientificity of rock stability assessment is greatly improved, the geological disaster risk is reduced, real-time environmental parameters and safety thresholds are comprehensively analyzed, early warning is rapidly triggered, the accident early warning time is obviously shortened, and the accuracy and effectiveness of early warning are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU LEIXIN CONSTRUCTION LABOR SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel water and mud bursting test system and method under multi-factor chain movement
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunnel and underground engineering tests, and provides a system and a method for testing water and mud burst of a tunnel under multi-factor chain motion, wherein the system comprises a test sample loading mechanism, a constant temperature cylinder, a water collecting and permeable member is arranged in the constant temperature cylinder, a rock mass sample is arranged between the water collecting and permeable member and the constant temperature cylinder, a pressurizing assembly is arranged at one end of the water collecting and permeable member, which is far away from the rock mass sample, and the pressurizing assembly is used for squeezing water in the water collecting and permeable member, so that the water permeates into the rock mass sample, and a high-pressure water storage disaster-causing structure is simulated; the tunnel excavation and tunneling mechanism is arranged at one end of the constant-temperature barrel part, which is far away from the pressurizing assembly, and is used for drilling from one end of the rock mass sample, which is far away from the water collection and permeable part, to the direction of the water collection and permeable part. The invention can simulate the whole evolution process of water burst and mud burst when the deep buried tunnel is excavated under the multi-factor chain action superposition effects of high ground stress, high water pressure, high ground temperature, engineering disturbance and the like.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive drought assessment method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive drought evaluation method based on multi-source data, which is implemented according to the following steps: acquiring historical remote sensing data and meteorological site data of a target area; preprocessing remote sensing data, unifying time and space scales of the remote sensing data, and extracting corresponding remote sensing data according to meteorological site coordinate data; calculating a standardized precipitation evapotranspiration index; dividing the processed remote sensing data and the standardized precipitation evapotranspiration index into a training set and a testing set, training the DNN model by taking a preset drought grade as a target, and constructing a comprehensive drought assessment model; evaluating the drought condition of the target area by using a comprehensive drought evaluation model, and outputting a comprehensive drought index considering multiple factors; by analyzing the evaluation result, the invention solves the problem of inaccurate drought evaluation effect caused by incomplete consideration of drought disaster factors in the existing drought evaluation and simple structure of an evaluation model.

title_en: Car nakadomari evacuation support system, car nakadomari evacuation support method, and program
abstract_en: To efficiently collect and unitarily manage information of vehicle Nakadomari evacuees for each vehicle Nakadomari area, and to perform situation grasping and support prediction with time for each vehicle Nakadomari area.SOLUTION: A car Nakadomari and evacuation support system 1 includes a car storage unit (car Nakadomari) that stores car information including attribution information of a car for car Nakadomari, a car Nakadomari area ID for identifying a car Nakadomari area in which the car is parked, and an arrival date and time at the car DB131 area, an evacuee storage unit (evacuee Nakadomari) that stores evacuee information including attribution information of an evacuee on board the car for the car Nakadomari, a statistical information generation unit 122 that generates real-time and chronological statistical information for each car DB132 area based on the car information and the evacuee information, and a quantity prediction learning model that has learned training data including a time for which the car evacuee stays in the car area, a required quantity of each assistance supply, and the evacuee information. Nakadomari Nakadomari Nakadomari, and an aid supply prediction unit 123 that predicts a required quantity of each of the aid supplies from a vehicle Nakadomari area stay time calculated on the basis of the Nakadomari date and time stored in the vehicle storage unit and the evacuee information stored in the evacuee storage unit for a vehicle Nakadomari evacuee, aggregates the required quantity of each of the aid supplies predicted for each of the vehicle Nakadomari areas, and predicts a provision quantity of each of the aid supplies to the vehicle arrival area.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Geological disaster risk early warning method and system based on environmental meteorological factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster risk early warning method and system based on environmental meteorological factors, and relates to the technical field of disaster early warning. Collecting data related to geological disasters, and constructing a geological disaster risk assessment model; collecting a geological disaster history record, and constructing a virtual disaster scene based on the countermeasure generation network according to data related to the geological disaster and the geological disaster history record; and carrying out geological disaster early warning according to the geological disaster risk assessment value of the geological disaster risk assessment model and the virtual disaster scene based on the countermeasure generation network. The invention provides a complete system from risk assessment to early warning release through multi-source data fusion, comprehensive assessment and high-resolution virtual simulation, and remarkably improves the timeliness, accuracy and effectiveness of geological disaster early warning.

title_en: Intelligent assessment method and system for landslide risk of tunnel peripheral area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geologic material analysis, in particular to an intelligent assessment method and system for landslide risk in a tunnel peripheral region. According to the method, an initial data set with high information density is constructed through geologic elastic wave data analysis, the quality and efficiency of data screening are improved, the fine observation of stress distribution and earth surface displacement in the data selection process is optimized, the capturing capacity of dynamic change of geologic conditions is enhanced, cracks and cavities in geologic media are accurately analyzed through simulating elastic wave propagation, finer geologic heterogeneity insight is provided, landslide triggering factors are calibrated more accurately by the method, high risk areas can be effectively identified and evaluated, the risk management and early warning accuracy of tunnels and key infrastructure are greatly improved, and potential geologic disaster influence is reduced.

title_en: Atmospheric pollutant propagation path discovery method based on reconstruction density clustering
abstract_en: Aiming at the composite risk caused by cross-regional propagation of atmospheric pollution, the traditional monitoring and model method has the limitations of insufficient data coverage, simplified topography distortion, delayed dynamic response and the like. The invention provides an atmospheric pollutant propagation path discovery technology based on reconstruction density clustering, which comprises the steps of reconstructing pollution space distribution through a density accumulation strategy, enhancing air quality information and edge area identification capacity, simultaneously reversely pushing pollutant propagation process to obtain pollution sources, introducing relative distance parameters to simulate the influence of complex terrain on diffusion, and dynamically adjusting propagation paths by combining real-time meteorological data. The method realizes multi-source data fusion tracing, breaks through the limitation of a fixed monitoring station, finds that the dirt propagation path has a good effect, and provides key technical support for regional cooperative treatment and emergency response.

title_en: Active control method for rock burst disaster
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of underground construction engineering, in particular to an active control method for rock burst disasters. The rock burst stress can be released in time before construction, and the probability of rock burst occurrence during construction is reduced. An active control method for rock burst disasters comprises the following steps: determining a weak structural surface existing in a region to be constructed, wherein the weak structural surface is a structural surface with a sliding risk; aiming at the weak structural surface, drilling a liquid injection hole on the corresponding palm face and/or ground surface structure to the weak structural surface; injecting lubricating liquid into the liquid injection hole, so that the rock mass structure positioned on one side of the weak structural surface slides along the weak structural surface under the pressure and the lubricating action of the lubricating liquid.

title_en: Sliding groove model test device for simulating landslide detritus flow side erosion effect and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster dynamic tests, in particular to a chute model test device for simulating landslide debris flow side erosion effect and a use method thereof. A chute model test device for simulating the side erosion effect of landslide detritus flow comprises a supporting mechanism (1), an accelerating mechanism (2), a chute simulation mechanism (3), a collecting mechanism (4) and a monitoring mechanism (5), and is characterized in that the top of the accelerating mechanism (2) is rotatably connected with the top of the supporting mechanism (1), an inlet of the chute simulation mechanism (3) is opposite to the bottom of the accelerating mechanism (2), and an opening of the collecting mechanism (4) is opposite to an outlet of the chute simulation mechanism (3). A use method of a chute model test device for simulating the side erosion effect of landslide detritus flow is characterized by comprising the following steps of placing a soil sample, conveying the soil sample, sliding the soil sample downwards, measuring parameters, and simulating. The invention has high authenticity, convenient observation and wide application range.

title_en: Excavation method for double-side asymmetric foundation pit of arc subway tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for excavating asymmetric foundation pits on two sides of an arc subway tunnel, which comprises the following steps: s100, dividing a foundation pit into a plurality of segments; s200, dividing the standard segment into a plurality of flow construction areas; s300, dividing the flow construction section into a plurality of flow construction sections. In the scheme, through partitioned and layered recursive excavation and step-by-step unloading, the deformation risk of the foundation pit support structure and the operation subway tunnel, which are influenced by space-time effect in the foundation pit soil excavation construction process, is reduced, the exposure time of the foundation pit shaftless support is shortened, and the anti-overturning rigidity and the axial bearing strength of the foundation pit support structure can be improved more quickly; and setting an earthwork construction sequence through simulation calculation, wherein a region with unbalanced lateral pre-excavation load is set as a post-excavation standard section, and the left earthwork is utilized to balance double-side loads so as to balance the unloading space-time response of two sides of a tunnel, avoid displacement deformation disasters caused by single-side concentrated overload, and relieve disaster causing effects of construction dynamic disturbance on an operation subway tunnel structure.
assignees: THE FOURTH CONSTRUCTION CO LTD OF CHINA CONSTRUCTION EIGHTH ENG DIVISION

title_en: Physical model test system and method for disaster effect of movable fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for testing a disaster effect physical model of an active fracture zone, wherein the system for testing the disaster effect physical model of the active fracture zone comprises the following components: a bracket; the test sample is formed by solidifying test proportion materials, a preset fracture zone is arranged on the test sample, and the test sample is divided into a plurality of subsections by the preset fracture zone; a front driving device; the portal driving assembly comprises a portal, an upper driving device, a lower driving device, a left driving device and a right driving device; the earthquake vibration simulation device is suitable for generating vibration; and the detection device is arranged on the test sample. The physical model test system for the disaster effect of the movable fracture zone can simulate fault compound motion, initial ground stress and earthquake vibration conditions, and has the advantages of being rich in function, strong in applicability, good in flexibility and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING;BEIJING LOOKSMART TECH CO LTD;INST DISASTER PREVENTION

title_en: Prediction method for critical wind speed of uplink single-slope tunnel of water adding spray system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a prediction method of critical wind speed of an uplink single-slope tunnel of a water adding spray system. The critical wind speed prediction method comprises the following steps: determining a fire scene according to the tunnel structure and the gradient, establishing a tunnel model in fire dynamics simulation software FDS, setting basic parameters of the tunnel model, and dividing grids; determining influence factors and basic physical quantities of the critical wind speed, obtaining dimensionless terms of the influence factors according to pi theorem, and deducing a dimensionless calculation formula of the critical wind speed; changing the gradient of the tunnel, the power of the fire source and the water spray flow, and performing numerical simulation to obtain critical wind speed values in the tunnel under different working conditions; drawing a simulation result into a scatter diagram, performing nonlinear fitting to obtain values of unknown coefficients in a dimensionless relational expression, and further constructing a dimensionless uplink single-slope tunnel inner critical wind speed prediction model. The method is suitable for predicting the critical wind speed of the tunnel when the fire disaster of the ascending simplex-slope tunnel with different fire source powers, different water spray flows and different gradients occurs.

title_en: Mountain bridge dynamic response analysis method under coupling action of transverse bridge to earthquake and landslide
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for analyzing dynamic response of a bridge in a mountain area under the coupling action of a transverse bridge to an earthquake and a landslide, and aims to analyze dynamic response of the bridge under the coupling action of the transverse bridge to the earthquake and the landslide and reveal dynamic response and damage mechanism of the bridge under the coupling action. The method comprises two main core parts: firstly, a landslide dynamic impact effect simulation method is used, a discrete unit contact model is defined based on a discrete element analysis method, a mountain-pier integral model is established, landslide body particles are generated, and landslide effect time course is recorded; and secondly, a method for simulating the coupling action of the transverse bridge to the earthquake and the landslide is used for establishing a bridge monomer finite element model based on a finite element analysis method, determining the coupling action moment and carrying out bridge dynamic response analysis. The invention adopts a step-by-step numerical model of 'integral before single', ensures the calculation precision and efficiency, and can provide scientific support for the earthquake disaster prevention and the risk assessment of the bridge in the mountain area.

title_en: Foundation pit deformation prediction method based on transformer model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foundation pit deformation prediction method based on a transform model, which is characterized by collecting foundation pit monitoring data and preprocessing the data; and constructing a multi-scale transducer model to extract characteristics in the collected data, and realizing prediction of foundation pit deformation monitoring data by training the model, and carrying out early warning judgment according to the prediction data. Compared with the prior time sequence model, the prediction precision is greatly improved, and the occurrence of foundation pit disasters is prevented and avoided to a certain extent. The method solves the problem that the actual monitoring data of the existing foundation pit cannot predict the deformation trend of the foundation pit in advance.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 8TH ENG DIVISION;CHINA CONSTRUCTION EIGHTH ENG DIVISION SOUTH CHINA CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Urban emergency management big data security intelligent management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent management system and method for urban emergency management big data security, and belongs to the technical field of data security management. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a monitoring module, an early warning module, a data storage module, a data management module, a cloud platform, a security policy management system, a feature engineering and machine learning model training module, an anomaly detection module, an automatic emergency response platform and a patch configuration module. The method comprises the following steps: data acquisition and preprocessing, data monitoring, security policy response and false alarm missing report analysis. The invention can automatically analyze a large amount of data, quickly identify abnormality, has quicker and more efficient response, can continuously optimize a model through machine learning, automatically adapt to new abnormal data types, and has good adaptability and learning ability. The method can find out a potential safety threat mode, conduct risk prediction, reduce false alarm and missing report through deep analysis of big data, and improve the accuracy of emergency treatment.
assignees: CHANGSHU INST TECH;SHENZHEN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA UNIV OF MINING AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Coal mine fire disaster detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine fire disaster detection device which comprises a machine body, a detection assembly, a drill rod and a drill bit, wherein the detection assembly comprises a gas detector, the gas detector is connected with the machine body, and the gas detector is provided with a gas inlet; the drill rod is rotatably connected with the machine body, and is provided with a sampling channel which is communicated with the air inlet; the drill bit is connected with the drill rod, the drill bit is provided with a sampling groove, and the sampling groove is communicated with the sampling channel. According to the coal mine fire detection device disclosed by the embodiment of the invention, an operator can carry the detection device to drill into the coal mine for sampling and detecting so as to perform fire early warning analysis on the coal mine, the operation convenience is high, the changes of the topography and the shape of the coal mine can be overcome, and the adaptability is high.
assignees: CCTEG ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Quantitative large-scale step-type reservoir bank landslide indoor physical model test method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide hazard control, and discloses a quantitative large-scale step-type reservoir bank landslide indoor physical model test method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, designing a landslide model test structure, and installing a rainfall system and a reservoir; step 2, preparing landslide simulation materials according to similar materials; step 3, acquiring landslide simulation material parameters and microstructure; step 4, building a landslide model by using a simulation material; and 5, arranging a sensor and placing a three-dimensional laser scanner. According to the method for testing the indoor physical model of the reservoir landslide, provided by the invention, the external load action characteristics of reservoir landslide subjected to reservoir water level fluctuation and periodical rainfall are comprehensively considered, the destabilization and damage process of the large-scale step-type reservoir landslide can be comprehensively evaluated through the arranged sensor and the three-dimensional laser scanning equipment, the framework of geotechnical engineering mechanism research is further enriched, and technical support and reference basis are provided for reservoir landslide destabilization prevention and landslide disaster early warning.

title_en: Crowdsourcing evacuation experimental device based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public safety, in particular to a crowd-sourced evacuation experiment device based on virtual reality, which comprises an initial creation module, a virtual character module, an experiment process control module, an interaction and navigation module and a data acquisition module, wherein the initial creation module is used for creating a plurality of experiment rooms and access links according to target experiments, the virtual character module is used for distributing the birth points, images, animations and virtual collision bodies of virtual characters to each participant entering each experiment room, the experiment process control module is used for setting scene triggers in each experiment room and controlling the beginning and ending of the target experiments, the interaction and navigation module is used for providing collision simulation and arm shaking operation navigation for each participant so as to control the virtual characters to execute actual evacuation behaviors, and the data acquisition module is used for acquiring log data and behavior data of each participant entering the experiment room so as to generate experiment results. Therefore, the problems of incompatibility, low customizable and expandable performance, low reliability and the like of application programs in the current crowdsourcing VR evacuation experiment are solved.

title_en: Icing disaster identification method based on catenary angle data of power transmission line
abstract_en: An icing disaster identification method based on catenary angle data of a power transmission line relates to the technical field of power transmission line icing identification. The invention aims to solve the problems that the existing method for identifying the icing disaster of the power transmission line is low in identification accuracy and efficiency and is difficult to apply in actual work. The method comprises the steps of inputting a History data list History of the catenary angle of the power transmission line, obtaining an average angle and spatial position decision table HistoryDecision, training a ValueRegression model by utilizing HistoryDecision, establishing a spatial position reasonable change interval decision support table PostionDecision, training a GapRegression model by utilizing PostionDecision, constructing a Recognize module by utilizing the ValueRegression model and the GapRegression model, inputting a Current data list Current of the catenary angle of the power transmission line, identifying the icing condition of the power transmission line by utilizing the Recognize module and the Current, and giving out early warning of the icing condition of the power transmission line. The method is used for identifying the icing disaster of the power transmission line.

title_en: Petrochemical fire disaster type identification method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a petrochemical fire disaster type identification method, and belongs to the field of flame identification. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring various flame forms under various petrochemical fire scenes by using an infrared temperature measurement imaging instrument and a visible light camera respectively, and constructing a first flame material library and a second flame material library; step 2, randomly selecting different images from the first flame material library and the second flame material library to serve as a training set and a verification set; step 3, training the selected flame recognition model by using a training set to obtain a flame recognition model, and verifying the recognition effect of the flame recognition model by using a verification set; step 4, taking images to be detected obtained by an infrared temperature measurement imaging instrument and a visible light camera as input, and identifying flame types by using a flame identification model; and step 5, sending out an alarm signal according to the identification result. The embodiment of the invention can effectively improve the recognition accuracy and real-time performance of the multi-form fire disaster in the complex environment of petrochemical enterprises.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RESEARCH INSTITUTE SAFETY ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Underground connection tunnel fire test system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground connection tunnel fire test system and a method thereof; the underground connection tunnel fire disaster test system comprises a test tunnel main body, a ventilation and flow equalization module, a fire source simulation module and a smoke visualization and measurement module; the test tunnel main body comprises a transverse tunnel, a longitudinal tunnel and an underground connection tunnel, and the detection and analysis of the smoke discharge condition of the tunnel in fire disaster in different gradients and angles are realized by adjusting the included angle between the transverse tunnel and the longitudinal tunnel, the gradient of the transverse tunnel and the gradient of the longitudinal tunnel. The fire source simulation module comprises a resistance grid, and the flow speed of smoke discharged to the longitudinal tunnel is regulated and controlled by the resistance grid, so that the smoke discharging and air supplementing characteristics of the tunnel are more fit with reality when the underground communication tunnel is in fire disaster.
assignees: CN RAILWAY SIYUAN SURVEY & DES;UNIV JILIANG CHINA

title_en: Mobile energy storage type intelligent soft switch joint optimization scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage type intelligent soft switch joint optimization scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring coordinates of power distribution network elements, simulating a power distribution network disaster scene according to the coordinates of the power distribution network elements, and predicting power distribution network disconnection positions by utilizing an information entropy theory to obtain first disconnection positions; determining a range of an accessible power distribution network by using the coupling model, and modeling economic operation scheduling and pre-disaster pre-charging of the energy storage battery according to the range of the accessible power distribution network to obtain an economic operation scheduling model; modeling the post-disaster emergency power supply schedule according to the first disconnection position and pre-disaster pre-charging of the energy storage battery to obtain a post-disaster emergency power supply schedule model; and combining the economic operation scheduling model and the post-disaster emergency power supply scheduling model to obtain a combined optimization scheduling model, and solving the combined optimization scheduling model by utilizing a solver to obtain an emergency power supply scheduling strategy under the economic operation scheduling and fault working conditions, thereby having great significance for the operation optimization of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Stress evolution path-based salient risk division method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outstanding risk dividing method based on a stress evolution path, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a full mine numerical calculation model, then drawing a monitoring network of a full model area according to collected historical outstanding point coordinates, various abnormal point coordinates and various grid coordinates, monitoring in full time and space, and recording the stress evolution process; parameters in the model are continuously modified to enable simulation results to be consistent with measured data, assimilation of the simulation results and the measured data is achieved, and an outstanding risk coefficient is calculated based on the obtained original rock stress, so that the outstanding risk area is primarily divided, and workers can know the approximate situation in time to take corresponding measures as soon as possible; training the stress evolution data through a BP neural network to obtain a more accurate prominent risk coefficient; according to the output prominent risk coefficient, the region prominent risk is accurately divided, the prominent risk region is further locked, an important reference is provided for predicting mine gas disasters, and coal mine safety production is facilitated.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL MINING HANCHENG MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Landslide hazard remote sensing intelligent identification extraction method and system based on improved sample
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster remote sensing intelligent identification extraction method and system based on improved samples, which belong to the field of geological disaster remote sensing identification and comprise the steps of providing a secondary classification scheme by considering the characteristics of surface vegetation and flowing water landforms in a complex background of a mountain canyon area, and establishing and forming a classification sample library; the intelligent landslide disaster judgment and extraction method comprises the steps of establishing a differential enhancement sample considering landslide disaster development evolution characteristics, seasonal replacement characteristics and spatial view attitude characteristics, improving the singleness of a traditional landslide sample, automatically matching iteration times based on an FCN deep learning network frame and a training index parameter value change characteristic curve, achieving the strongest convergence, and establishing an optimal multi-parameter FCN model to carry out intelligent landslide disaster judgment and extraction. Aiming at the space-time distribution difference of landslide disasters of the high mountain isthmus Gu Ou, the invention establishes a difference enhanced sample library and an optimal multi-parameter FCN landslide judgment model, improves the landslide disaster judgment precision, and provides a scientific and reliable reference basis for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Zero sample event relation extraction method for agricultural meteorological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero sample event relation extraction method for agricultural meteorological disasters, which belongs to the technical field of natural language processing and comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring an agricultural meteorological disaster sentence, acquiring a relationship description and synonyms corresponding to the relationship by utilizing an online open resource library according to the relationship of an event in the sentence, constructing a data set and preprocessing; step 2, constructing an agricultural meteorological disaster zero sample event relation extraction model based on semantic matching and a self-attention mechanism; and step 3, training and testing the model by utilizing the data set, training the model under a multi-task learning structure, and predicting zero sample relation of the input new sentence by utilizing a nearest neighbor search algorithm in a testing stage. The invention can realize the prediction of the new relationship between undefined or unobserved agricultural meteorological disaster events.

title_en: Method for obtaining grouting scheme through surrounding rock grouting test and test device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction in tunnel engineering, in particular to a method for acquiring a grouting scheme through a surrounding rock grouting test, wherein a rock sample test piece of surrounding rock is acquired according to an actual operation environment, so that simulation is performed according to the actual surrounding rock attribute, and a simulation result is more reliable and stable; simultaneously according to the requirement of actual grouting operation, the size according to the rock sample test piece is scaled down, thereby realize boring the slip casting hole and grouting on the rock sample test piece, at last through pouring into the pressurized gas or rivers simulation actual condition into on the rock sample test piece, judge whether the shutoff effect satisfies the requirement, lay and the size of redesign slip casting hole when not satisfying the requirement, until obtain the slip casting scheme that satisfies the shutoff effect, consequently, through the operational environment and the operation requirement of simulation actual condition, the slip casting scheme that satisfies the actual shutoff effect is selected through experimental more in this way, avoid the scene to carry out the shutoff many times, improve work efficiency, reduce the construction risk.
assignees: CCCC SECOND HIGHWAY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Explosion training protector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion training protection device which comprises a first protection piece and a second protection piece, wherein fixing patches used for fixing are arranged on the back surfaces of the first protection piece and the second protection piece, a third protection piece is arranged on the front surfaces of the first protection piece and the second protection piece, a pressing block is arranged on the third protection piece, and a storage piece is arranged in the third protection piece. According to the explosion training protection device, the first protection piece and the second protection piece are used for protecting the front side of a firefighter, the first protection piece and the second protection piece are fixed on the front side of the firefighter through the fixing paste on the back surfaces of the first protection piece and the second protection piece, the third protection piece arranged on the front sides of the first protection piece and the second protection piece is used for isolating the temperature during rescue of disaster-stricken personnel, the first protection piece and the second protection piece can be soaked through the storage piece, and the danger of the disaster-stricken personnel is reduced.
assignees: MINGGUANG HAOMIAO SECURITY AND PROTECTION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic driving type fire-fighting drilling device and drilling water gun for fire fighting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting appliances, in particular to a hydraulic driving type fire-fighting drilling device, which comprises a water guide pipe, a drilling assembly arranged at the rear end of the water guide pipe, an impeller and a rotating shaft, wherein a plurality of first water draining holes are arranged on the water guide pipe and positioned at the opposite position of the rear end of the impeller, the rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the water guide pipe, the front end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the rear end of the impeller, and the rear end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the drilling assembly so as to drive the drilling assembly to rotate when water flow drives the impeller to rotate. The utility model also provides a fire-fighting drilling water gun, which comprises a water gun base, wherein the water gun base is provided with the hydraulic driving type fire-fighting drilling device. The utility model has high efficiency of breaking and disassembling the drilling hole, can effectively cool the breaking and disassembling drilling hole area, and is beneficial to guaranteeing the personal safety of firefighters.

title_en: Water shutoff device for flood fighting and disaster relief
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water shutoff device for fighting flood disaster, includes the water shutoff tank, the inside of water shutoff tank links to each other with the montant is fixed, the inside of montant is equipped with water shutoff tank fixed establishment, two fixed drill's outer wall runs through the water shutoff tank through the through-hole. Through the cooperation of water shutoff box and water shutoff box coupling mechanism, first knob drives the cylinder and rotates, the cylinder drives the slider and removes, the slider drives the latch segment and removes through above-mentioned mode and can guarantee that the latch segment can not appear removing, thereby make two water shutoff boxes hug closely all the time, need not operating personnel and connect through the iron chain, this has just improved the work efficiency of water shutoff device, cooperation through montant and water shutoff box fixed establishment, the carousel drives first gear rotation, first gear drives the second gear rotation, can make the fixed drill bit faster insert in earth, through the condition that the water shutoff box appears removing after receiving the flood impact can be avoided to above-mentioned mode, this has just improved the work quality of water shutoff device.
assignees: DONGMING YELLOW RIVER BUREAU HEZE YELLOW RIVER BUREAU

title_en: Sand table model building rack
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sand table model building rack, which comprises a vehicle body, a model simulation rack and a model support, wherein the vehicle body is provided with a vehicle frame and travelling wheels arranged on four sides of the bottom side of the vehicle frame, and the model simulation rack is arranged on the vehicle frame; the model simulation rack comprises a guide plate, a guide frame, a pedestal and a gear structure, wherein the guide plate is arranged on two sides of the end face of the frame, and the guide plate is movably sleeved with the guide frame; the pedestal is arranged in the middle of the frame, the outer side edge of the pedestal is connected with the guide frame, a tooth slot is arranged at the lower side of the pedestal, the tooth slot is rectangular, and a gear structure is arranged at the inner side of the tooth slot; the model support comprises a support body and a plurality of models distributed on the support body, a lock hole is formed in the lower side of the support body, and a self-locking structure used for locking the lock hole and connecting the model support with the pedestal is arranged on the pedestal. The rack provided by the utility model has the effects of supporting and connecting the sand table on one hand, and can simulate geological disasters on the other hand, so that a user can intuitively feel the influence of the geological disasters on a building/city.

title_en: Disaster assessment device, disaster assessment method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a disaster assessment device or the like capable of comprehensively assessing a damage state caused by occurrence of a disaster and a restoration state.SOLUTION: A disaster assessment device 100 includes: a plurality of simulation units 140 to 14-N which executes simulation for damage states of a plurality of events due to occurrence of a disaster; a data conversion unit 150 which converts data representing the damage states being results of each of the simulation results of the plurality of simulation units 140 to 14-N to data representing common social value; and a social value assessment unit 160 which assesses a change of the social value caused by the disaster on the basis of the plurality of pieces of data obtained by the conversion by the data conversion unit 150. Further, the disaster assessment device 100 includes a transmitting and receiving unit 120 which, after occurrence of the disaster, receives disaster occurrence information indicating a scale and occurrence position of the disaster, and damage actual state data representing an actual state value of the damage caused by the disaster and actual circumstances of which have become clear.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3
assignees: NEC CORP;UNIV TOHOKU;NEC SOLUTION INNOVATORS LTD

title_en: System and method for contaminant and carcinogen free firefighter training
abstract_en: A safety system for clean, contaminant, and carcinogen free firefighter training may use compressed air and water vapor to provide a safe yet realistic firefighting mock scenario.

title_en: Simulation calculation method, device, equipment, medium and computer program product for urban rainfall flood toughness
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of urban flood control simulation evaluation, in particular to a simulation calculation method, a device, equipment, a medium and a computer program product for urban flood control toughness, which are used for collecting urban data of a research area, constructing an urban flood control toughness space model to calculate a robustness index and a rapidity index of the research area, constructing an urban emergency evacuation space model to calculate a redundancy index and an availability index of the research area, and finally adding the robustness index, the rapidity index, the redundancy index and the availability index according to preset weights to obtain an urban toughness quantification result, wherein a multidimensional urban rain Hong Renxing simulation calculation frame can be established from four toughness characteristic attributes of robustness, redundancy, availability and rapidity, and the considered characteristic dimension of the urban flood control toughness is more comprehensive, so that the obtained urban toughness quantification result is more accurate.

title_en: Indoor crowd evacuation simulation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor crowd evacuation simulation method, an indoor crowd evacuation simulation system and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: a social force model construction stage, namely constructing a social force model according to the driving force of an individual, the interaction force between the individuals and the interaction force between the individual and the obstacle; setting basic parameters of a social force model, inter-pedestrian acting force parameters and pedestrian and boundary or obstacle acting force parameters according to a target indoor environment; in the emergency evacuation simulation and analysis stage, the set social force model is used for simulating emergency evacuation events to obtain a relation curve of total evacuation time, a relation curve of total evacuation number and total evacuation time and a relation curve of outlet width and total evacuation time. By changing the expected speed of the pedestrian from the original fixed value and the original direction to be determined by the expected speed of the individual and the average speed of surrounding people, the behavior characteristics of the pedestrian in a complex environment can be simulated more truly.

title_en: MV-BP neural network landslide prediction method integrating multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MV-BP neural network landslide prediction method for comprehensive multi-source data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring full-element input data of landslide deformation displacement, and constructing a training data set; intelligent preprocessing is carried out on the multi-source monitoring data to obtain an input value of model training; and comparing the precision of the prediction result by using the MV-BP neural network model and the evaluation index. The embodiment of the invention processes the input multi-source data in an intelligent mode based on the historical data of multi-source monitoring, realizes accurate prediction of landslide disasters by using the MV-BP neural network, reduces the monitoring cost, improves the monitoring efficiency, and provides accurate early warning information, thereby supporting related departments to take effective measures and protecting the life and property safety of important facilities and people.
assignees: NORTH INFORMATION CONTROL INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Stream traffic simulation method and system for large and medium-sized theatres
abstract_en: The invention relates to a large and medium-sized theatre stream traffic simulation analysis method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting large and medium-sized theatrical exhibition group activity space design drawing data and preprocessing; acquiring basic attribute characteristic data of a viewing group and people stream behavior characteristic and preference data of a whole process activity chain of the viewing group in a large and medium-sized theatrical space range based on a PSPL investigation method and a computer vision target detection method; constructing a large and medium-sized theatre stream simulation model; and respectively carrying out stream simulation on the large and medium-sized theatres by using the stream simulation model of the large and medium-sized theatres under the normal state of the performance day and the emergency evacuation state. Compared with the prior art, the invention realizes the pain point identification and improved feedback in aspects of theatre functional space layout design, group people stream organization observation and the like, and has high simulation reliability.
assignees: TONGJI ARCH DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Safety management system of charging pile in community
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety management system of a charging pile in a community, which comprises the following components: the risk assessment and strategy formulation module is used for carrying out risk assessment and safety strategy formulation on the charging piles in the community; the safety design and deployment module is used for carrying out safety structure design and deployment on the charging piles in the communities; the daily monitoring and maintenance module is used for regularly carrying out safety inspection maintenance on the charging pile system; the emergency response and treatment module is used for establishing a charging pile protection emergency mechanism and carrying out emergency state treatment; the training and propaganda module is used for training community management personnel and charging pile user and propaganda. The invention can better carry out the safety management of the charging pile in the community.
assignees: SHANGHAI YISHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire hazard level assessment method, system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a fire hazard level assessment method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical fire disaster data set, wherein the historical fire disaster data set comprises combustible data, power transmission line data and corresponding fire hazard classes; dividing the historical fire disaster data set into a plurality of training data subsets, wherein the plurality of training subsets comprise a first task data subset and a second task data subset, and the first task data subset and the second task data subset respectively train an original neural network model by using a first structural parameter, a first training strategy, a second structural parameter and a second training strategy; continuously learning the original neural network model according to the training data subsets to obtain a continuously learned neural network model; and determining fire hazard levels corresponding to the first task data subset and the second task data subset according to the continuously learned neural network model. The invention combines multitask learning and continuous learning, and improves the accuracy of fire hazard level assessment.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method for establishing three-dimensional creep damage model of jointed rock under high temperature and water pressure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a three-dimensional creep damage model of joint rock under the action of high temperature and water pressure, and establishing a three-dimensional creep damage model of the joint rock under the action of high temperature and water pressure according to the high temperature damage variable taking the longitudinal wave velocity of the rock mass and the porosity of the rock mass into consideration and the high temperature-load coupling damage variable obtained by the damage variable of the rock mass in the process of accelerating creep. In the establishment of the three-dimensional model, the creep characteristics of the jointed rock and the influence of multiple fields such as heat, water and the like are considered, the established model has stronger comprehensiveness, and the creep behavior rule of the three-dimensional jointed rock under the influence of high temperature and water pressure can be more comprehensively considered, so that the deformation, damage and stability characteristics of the jointed rock are more accurately simulated, and more reliable theoretical basis and application support are provided for engineering design and disaster prediction.

title_en: SIRS model-based panic emotion propagation simulation method under fire scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a panic emotion propagation simulation method under a fire scene based on a SIRS model, which comprises the following steps: three-dimensional modeling is carried out on the scene of fire disaster by using fire disaster simulation software; performing simulation on the established fire model to obtain the change condition of the fire product concentration along with time; establishing a panic emotion propagation model under a fire scene based on an SIRS model; quantifying the influence of the concentration change of fire products on the panic emotion transmission model, and carrying out parameter correction on the panic emotion transmission model; establishing a panic emotion transmission system dynamics model considering the influence of fire products, and analyzing the dynamic transition process of the emotion states of the crowd; and establishing a personnel evacuation simulation model to obtain required safe evacuation time, and performing personnel evacuation simulation. The invention can display the spreading condition of panic emotion in the crowd under the influence of fire products in the fire accident, thereby realizing the dynamic simulation of the psychological emotion change of the crowd in the fire evacuation process, and the simulation is more close to the actual fire evacuation.

title_en: Differential disaster prevention decision method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network differentiation disaster prevention decision method, which comprises the following steps: collecting historical various disaster data in a power distribution network area, preprocessing the historical various disaster data, and respectively constructing corresponding training sets; respectively constructing various disaster prediction models, inputting a corresponding training set into the disaster prediction models of corresponding types for training to obtain various trained disaster prediction models, and carrying out disaster prediction through the various trained disaster prediction models; meanwhile, a disaster prevention decision model of the power distribution network is built, disaster prediction results output by various disaster prediction models are input into the disaster prevention decision model of the power distribution network, and the disaster prevention decision model of the power distribution network outputs disaster prevention decisions of the power distribution network.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method for detecting tunnel fire disaster abnormal event based on YOLO
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting a tunnel fire disaster abnormal event based on YOLO, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting monitoring data comprising fire disaster and smoke through a camera, extracting key frame pictures and marking, establishing a dataset, then introducing a triple attention mechanism based on a convolution module attention mechanism of YOLOv network models to improve the attention capability of the network to important features, and training the established dataset on a YOLOv model to obtain a target detection model, and detecting the fire disaster event in a tunnel based on the target detection model.
assignees: NANJING URBAN CONSTRUCTION TUNNEL BRIDGE SMART MAN CO LTD

title_en: Flood simulation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a flood simulation method, a flood simulation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the flood simulation method comprises the following steps: inputting the grid rainfall predicted value, the river flow simulation value and the wind speed and air pressure simulation value into a hydrodynamic model to obtain a storm tide level output by the hydrodynamic model; constructing a surface flooding model by using digital elevation model data comprising building data and urban surface Manning coefficients; constructing a pipe network converging model according to the rainfall runoff and the surface runoff of the building roof; coupling the surface flood model and the pipe network converging model into an urban flood model according to the inspection well; and taking the storm tide level as a boundary condition, inputting typhoon rainfall time sequence data into the urban flood model, and obtaining flood simulation data output by the urban flood model. The storm tide level is predicted according to rainfall, river and wind power, the multidimensional disaster factor combined influence can be comprehensively considered, and the space-time precision, timeliness and accuracy of storm tide boundary conditions of the urban flood model are improved.

title_en: Typhoon house damage risk prediction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a typhoon house damage risk prediction method, device, equipment and medium, which comprise the following steps: acquiring a typhoon event data set corresponding to a target area; identifying feature data of typhoon events occurring in a plurality of administrative areas based on the typhoon event data set, so as to construct a target sample data set according to the feature data; training the machine learning model by using the target sample data set to obtain a house damage risk prediction model, wherein the house damage risk prediction model is used for carrying out dynamic risk prediction on house damage conditions when typhoon events occur in a target area. The invention can realize the real-time updating and forecasting of the dynamic risk in the real-time disaster field evolution process.
assignees: NAT CLIMATE CENTRE;BEIJING HONGXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, device and equipment for dynamically analyzing spatial distribution of water content of hour-level soil
abstract_en: The invention provides an hour-level soil moisture content space distribution dynamic analysis method, device and equipment, which comprise the steps of analyzing grid soil moisture content fading coefficients based on meteorological site evaporation data, soil texture and land utilization type distribution data at a research area, carrying out daily recurrence of the soil moisture content by combining daily rainfall data at the research area to obtain initial soil moisture content corresponding to a target date of the research area, and carrying out n-hour rolling simulation on the soil moisture content by n hours based on the hour-by-hour dynamic actual measurement meteorological grid surface rainfall data at the research area, the grid soil moisture content fading coefficients and the initial soil moisture content corresponding to the target date of the research area through a pre-constructed soil moisture content n-hour recurrence model to obtain soil moisture content simulation results corresponding to a plurality of moments of the research area in the target date. The invention can overcome the defect that the early-stage rainfall influence daily recurrence formula method is difficult to meet the requirements of the mountain torrent disaster short-term prediction and early warning.

title_en: Integrated slope monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated slope monitoring system and method, which relate to the technical field of highway slope monitoring and comprise the following steps of dividing a highway slope geological region to be monitored into a plurality of subareas; in each sub-area, scanning by a laser radar assembled on the unmanned aerial vehicle according to an initial preset point cloud density to obtain initial surface morphology information of the whole highway slope, and acquiring surface morphology information of the sub-area by using point cloud data generated by the laser radar aiming at each sub-area. According to the invention, the subareas are divided and the pre-training machine learning model is combined to predict the surface abnormal change, so that early signs can be timely identified, early warning is sent out at the early risk stage, the geological disaster prevention and emergency capability is improved, meanwhile, the point cloud density is dynamically adjusted, the monitoring precision is improved for the high-risk area, the resource waste is avoided, the monitoring efficiency and the monitoring precision are greatly improved, and the risk management is optimized.

title_en: Groundwater level prediction method based on time sequence convolution characteristic filtering neural network model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a groundwater level prediction method based on a time sequence convolution characteristic filtering neural network model, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-sensor monitoring data related to a groundwater level according to a time sequence to obtain multi-characteristic variable time sequence data, carrying out data preprocessing and data segmentation on the multi-characteristic variable time sequence data to construct a groundwater level multivariable time sequence tensor, establishing the time sequence convolution characteristic filtering neural network model, training and verifying the time sequence convolution characteristic filtering neural network model based on the training set and the verification set to obtain an optimal prediction model, substituting the test set into the optimal prediction model, and outputting multi-step prediction data. The invention uses the time sequence convolution characteristic to filter the neural network model, can greatly improve the prediction precision of the groundwater level for a long time in the future, and provides more reliable data support for groundwater disaster decision making.

title_en: Complex terrain landslide land disaster forecasting method based on meteorological hydrologic landslide power coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex terrain landslide land disaster forecasting method based on meteorological hydrologic landslide power coupling, belonging to the field of geological disaster monitoring, comprising the following steps: according to historical meteorological data, fine underlying surface data, ground site data and ground deformation monitoring data, a set Kalman filtering method is introduced to carry out parameter adjustment on a WRF-Hydro hydrologic model and a TRIGRS transient rainfall infiltration model, the WRF-Hydro hydrologic model after parameter adjustment and the TRIGRS transient rainfall infiltration model are coupled, a hydrologic landslide power coupling model adapting to complex terrains is obtained, and landslide disaster prediction is carried out by utilizing the hydrologic meteorological landslide power coupling model. According to the invention, the WRF-Hydro hydrologic model and TRIGRS transient rainfall infiltration model are coupled, the complex land-Hydro-meteorological-geological process is simulated, and the safety coefficient of a landslide area of the complex terrain is estimated by using meteorological data, so that an accurate landslide disaster prediction result is obtained.
assignees: CHONGQING INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES CHONGQING ECOLOGICAL METEOROLOGICAL AND SATELLITE REMOTE S

title_en: Variable period flood prediction method based on Transformer
abstract_en: The invention provides a variable period flood prediction method based on a Transformer, which comprises the steps of obtaining hydrological meteorological data of equal period, preprocessing the hydrological data, constructing and training a Transformer model, carrying out variable period water mass redistribution on the rainfall of a flow field, and inputting data composed of the redistributed rainfall into the trained Transformer model for each time step to obtain a predicted runoff sequence. The method can automatically identify rainfall events of a cross period, generate a new unequal period rainfall sequence according to the maximum short duration rainfall, generate an unequal period flood sequence with higher time resolution through a transducer model, more accurately reflect the relationship between the maximum rainfall and a flood peak value, improve the accuracy and the reliability of flood simulation, and provide more powerful technical support for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Man-machine collaborative medical teaching interaction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of man-machine interaction, in particular to a man-machine collaborative medical teaching interaction method and system, which comprises the steps of data acquisition and processing, virtual simulation and interaction, deep learning driven situational operation simulation and emergency response evaluation, intelligent analysis and evaluation, interactive feedback and guidance, data backflow and optimization and the like to construct a dynamic adjustment and continuous optimization teaching closed-loop system, the assessment of immersive teaching and emergency response capability is realized by using a biomechanical model and a deep learning technology, personalized teaching contents and guidance are provided for learners by combining a real-time data analysis and feedback mechanism, the training effect of medical operation skills is improved, the operational sense in a virtual environment is enhanced by using the biomechanical model, so that the learners can train in the environment close to a real operation, the operation accuracy and the emergency response capability are improved, and the defects of a traditional system are overcome.

title_en: Rock burst type prediction algorithm based on convolutional neural network and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dangerous disaster early warning of rock burst and the like in mines, in particular to a rock burst type prediction algorithm based on a mine convolutional neural network and an attention mechanism, which is used for predicting the type of rock burst of a certain mining working face in the stoping range of stoping in a certain day, and comprises the steps of extracting mine geology-mining data information; constructing a rock burst classification data set of the geological-mining information of the working face; determining a working face geology-exploitation characteristic vector characteristic extraction algorithm; determining representative vector extraction algorithms of rock burst of different types; constructing an attention mechanism-based rock burst type prediction algorithm; training a rock burst type prediction algorithm based on an attention mechanism; application of an attention mechanism-based rock burst type prediction algorithm. The algorithm of the invention can extract mine geology-exploitation information according to mine data, predict rock burst type in the whole working face range or in the working face exploitation range of a certain day, and provide important basis for rock burst prevention and control.
assignees: Shandong energy group co ltd;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Natural disaster satellite remote sensing image short-time lag superdivision method based on space shift convolution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of satellite remote sensing image processing, in particular to a natural disaster satellite remote sensing image short-time lag superdivision method based on space shift convolution. Comprising the following steps: acquiring a low-resolution satellite remote sensing image with resolution lower than a preset value; realizing space shift operation by using a1 multiplied by 1 convolution layer to finish local feature aggregation; pairing satellite remote sensing images with low resolution and high resolution, and training a time lag superdivision model; and processing the low-resolution remote sensing image by using the trained time-lag superminute model, completing the super-resolution conversion, and generating a high-resolution image. Compared with the bilinear interpolation super-division method, the cubic interpolation super-division method and the nearest neighbor interpolation super-division method, the PSNR value and the SSIM value generated by the method are higher, and the resolution and the definition of the image can be effectively improved.

title_en: Emergency management method and system based on hydropower station production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency management method and system based on hydropower station production, and relates to the technical field of hydropower station emergency management, wherein the emergency management method comprises the steps of analyzing hydropower station emergency management requirements, acquiring hydropower station emergency resources and creating an immersive exercise environment of the hydropower station emergency resources; adjusting hydropower station emergency resources in an immersive drilling environment by using an intelligent scheduling algorithm; and establishing an emergency treatment management scheme based on the drilling result. The system and the method promote the efficiency and reliability of emergency management of the hydropower station, simulate various emergency scenes, adjust the emergency resource allocation in real time, optimize response time and effect, record and track all operations and decisions by using a blockchain technology, ensure the transparency and safety of data, realize the automatic processing of multi-source data and the emergency resource scheduling management by intelligent contracts, effectively cope with emergency situations such as geological disasters, equipment faults, extreme weather and the like, and improve the safety and emergency response capability of the hydropower station.
assignees: GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD GOUPITAN POWER PLANT

title_en: Simulated soil liquefaction and layering testing device and testing method
