abstract_en: The invention provides a simulated soil liquefaction and layering testing device and a testing method, which are applied to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction engineering instruments, and the technical scheme is as follows: comprises a base, wherein the soil box is filled with experimental soil; the base is provided with a driving component for driving the soil box to do horizontal reciprocating motion on the base so as to simulate earthquake to liquefy soil; the test bars are horizontally inserted into the soil box, two ends of the test bars respectively penetrate through the soil box, and a plurality of test bars are respectively inserted into different depths of soil body; one end of the test rod is provided with a ball rolling on the test rod, a spring sleeved on the test rod and a sensor which is arranged on the test rod and connected with the spring, and the sensor is electrically connected with a data recorder; in the moving process of the soil box, the test rod and the soil body relatively move due to vibration, the ball rolls on the test rod in a reciprocating manner and compresses the spring, and the sensor measures the displacement variation of the compressed spring; the method has the technical effects that: the change of the mechanical property of the soil in the vibration liquefaction process can be simulated.

title_en: Self-adaptive flood inundation range extraction method integrating multisource remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flood disaster monitoring, and particularly relates to a self-adaptive flood inundation range extraction method integrating multisource remote sensing data. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring optical and SAR remote sensing image data; preprocessing the multi-source remote sensing image; fusing the optical and SAR remote sensing images; extracting a high confidence discrete water body region; extracting a continuous water body region, and fusing a digital elevation model to construct a high-quality water body data set; training a water body recognition deep learning model based on the water body data set; and extracting the flood inundation range by using a water body identification model. The method solves the problems that when the flood inundation range is extracted by using the remote sensing image, the threshold value is difficult to determine, the complex shadow interference is caused, the training data of deep learning is less, and the like. In addition, the method has strong robustness and high identification precision, can rapidly calculate the flood submerging range, and provides technical support for flood prevention and disaster relief.

title_en: Rock burst early warning method based on KAN neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dangerous disaster early warning of rock burst and the like in mines, in particular to a rock burst early warning method based on a KAN neural network, which comprises the steps of preprocessing original microseismic monitoring data; establishing an rock burst early warning data set; constructing a rock burst early warning algorithm based on a KAN neural network; training a rock burst early warning algorithm based on a KAN neural network; and applying a rock burst early warning algorithm based on the KAN neural network. The parameters to be trained in the rock burst early warning algorithm based on the KAN neural network only comprise w and c  z , and compared with the conventional neural network, the training parameters are greatly reduced; and because the nonlinear description capability of the calculation function in the KAN neural network is better, the rock burst early warning algorithm based on the KAN neural network can obtain better performance than the traditional neural network by only relying on a small number of parameters under the condition of not relying on the artificially set early warning index.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;Shandong energy group co ltd

title_en: Immersive virtual reality emergency critical nursing training system
abstract_en: The invention provides an immersive virtual reality emergency critical nursing training system, which relates to the technical field of nursing training and specifically comprises the following steps: simulating a real critical nursing environment through a virtual reality technology and an environment adjusting device; evaluating the performance of a student in a specific operation, and grading to obtain an operation evaluation index; designing a reaction task under an emergency condition in training, and requiring a student to make emergency treatment within a limited time to obtain a reaction speed assessment index; assigning points according to actual performances of students in technical operation to obtain a technical proficiency assessment index; the above evaluation indexes are combined to generate a composite score. According to the invention, by creating an immersive critical care environment, students can practice in a real situation, and the participation feeling and effect of learning are improved. The comprehensive training mode improves the actual operation capability and emergency response speed of students, and provides a scientific and effective assessment tool for nursing education.
assignees: FIRST AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF ANHUI MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Visual detection method and system for instant-explosion dense smoke
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision, and discloses a method and a system for detecting instant-explosion dense smoke vision, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting dense smoke image data, time sequence image data and ambient light data; processing the dense smoke image data to obtain a smoke image characteristic data set, and processing the time sequence image data to obtain a smoke dynamic change data set; fusing the ambient light data into a smoke image characteristic data set and a smoke dynamic change data set to form a smoke comprehensive characteristic data set; training a transient explosion dense smoke prediction model, inputting a smoke comprehensive characteristic data set into the transient explosion dense smoke prediction model, and predicting a grade coefficient of the transient explosion dense smoke; processing the predicted instantaneous dense smoke grade coefficient to obtain the instantaneous dense smoke dangerous degree; comparing the predicted instantaneous explosion dense smoke dangerous degree with a preset instantaneous explosion dense smoke dangerous degree threshold value, and judging whether fire disaster early warning information is generated or not; the potential safety accidents can be avoided by effective fire early warning and countermeasure.
assignees: HUNAN YUNJIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network power supply recovery method based on expert demonstration guidance reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power distribution network power restoration method based on expert demonstration guidance reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing an expert demonstration data set, establishing a multiple priority experience playback pool, including expert demonstration, normal operation and constraint violation experience playback pool, extracting experiences in batches from the expert demonstration experience playback pool, pre-training a reinforcement learning model, constructing and integrating an invalid action shielding module after the pre-training is completed, shielding invalid operation, then simulating operation in a large number of fault scenes, respectively storing the normal operation and constraint violation experience into the corresponding playback pool, extracting experiences in proportion for priority playback, training the model, and finally, recursively solving in a real-time fault scene by utilizing the trained model, and outputting an approximate optimal decision of post-disaster power restoration. The invention obviously improves the accuracy and efficiency of power supply recovery of the post-disaster power distribution network, and solves the problems of high calculation complexity and poor real-time performance in the prior art.

title_en: Simulation device for water flow factor test of tillite for mine disaster prevention
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulation device for a water flow factor test of a tillite for mine disaster prevention, and belongs to the technical field of experimental devices. The utility model provides a mine disaster prevention is with experimental analogue means of moraine soil rivers factor, includes the support, still includes: the shovel-shaped cover is arranged on the bracket, one end of the shovel-shaped cover is rotationally connected to the bracket through a rotating seat, and a water spraying component is arranged at the upper end of the shovel-shaped cover; the lifting component is arranged on the bracket and is used for jacking the movable end of the shovel-shaped cover; a vibration member provided at a bottom of the shovel cover, the vibration member being configured to vibrate the shovel cover; the method can more comprehensively and conveniently simulate the process of forming the mud flow by the tillite soil, and indirectly improve the accuracy of the simulation test.
assignees: YUNNAN DIQING NONFERROUS METALS CO LTD;KUNMING PROSPECTING DESIGN INST OF CHINA NONFERROUS METALS INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Seepage parameter measurement experimental device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a seepage parameter measurement experiment device, which is provided with a water tank, wherein the lower part of the water tank is provided with a water tank bracket, the upper part of the water tank is provided with a test box, an anti-seepage module, a dam body of an earth-rock dam, a lifting pressure sensor, a seepage pressure sensor and a pore water pressure sensor are arranged in the test box, a submersible pump is arranged in the water tank, a water supply pipe is arranged on the submersible pump to the test box, and a drain pipe is arranged on the test box and connected to the water tank; the seepage parameter measurement experimental device is characterized in that the earth-rock dam body is arranged at the bottom of the test box, the lifting pressure sensor, the osmotic pressure sensor and the pore water pressure sensor are arranged at different positions of the earth-rock dam body, the water flows of different water heads are provided for the test box through the submersible pump in a simulation mode to simulate the lifting pressure, the osmotic pressure and the pore water pressure data of the earth-rock dam body in the flood season, the dead water period and the flood disaster, so that people can learn, test, study and apply the earth-rock dam body in a laboratory.
assignees: JIANGSU YANGZI ENG QUALITY INSPECTION CO LTD

title_en: Acceleration and customization of disaster event loss simulation modeling
abstract_en: In an illustrative embodiment, a system and method for generating a customized disaster risk model involves receiving a hybrid definition identifying two or more disaster risk models and at least one hazard for each model, calculating a number of tries using available tries for each model, and sampling a loss record from each model according to the number of tries. The model may contain pre-aggregated and/or pre-simulated data. The model may be created by pre-modeling each constituent event loss data set of the original giant disaster model to an annual loss data set, aggregating the annual loss data to generate a set of generated sampled annual loss at level(s) related to a set of risk calculations, calculating gross loss loss features using the sampled annual loss, and comparing gross loss loss features to corresponding expected gross loss loss features to confirm the proximity of the results to create the model.
assignees: AON GLOBAL OPERATIONS EUROPE AG SINGAPORE BRANCH

title_en: Simulation equipment for fire disaster cause caused by virtual connection of electric appliances
abstract_en: The utility model discloses simulation equipment for fire disaster causes caused by virtual connection of an electric appliance, and belongs to the technical field of test equipment; the apparatus includes: a case and a cover; the box body is provided with a control panel with a display screen, a power supply and an analog circuit; the analog circuit is provided with a virtual connection circuit; the power supply is respectively connected with the control panel and the analog circuit; the control panel is connected with the analog circuit; the cover body is made of transparent materials and covers the upper portion of the virtual connection circuit. The equipment has a simple structure, and is convenient for overhaul and investigation in the future; the method can adopt a mode of actually generating open fire so as to more truly show the forming process of fire disaster when the electric appliance is in virtual connection; the accident simulation can be performed in any safe education place so as to enable a user to know the accident cause, enhance the precaution awareness and reduce the injury caused by the accident as much as possible.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Rainfall geological disaster risk simulation method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological prediction, and discloses a rainfall geological disaster risk simulation method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring original geological disaster data and environmental factor information; constructing a spatial distribution matrix based on the original geological disaster data, wherein the spatial distribution matrix is a probability matrix of geological disasters in the region to be tested; based on the environmental factor information, constructing an environmental impact matrix, wherein the environmental impact matrix is an impact weight matrix of the environmental factors on geological disasters of the area to be tested; generating an initial model matched with the environmental impact matrix based on the environmental impact matrix; acquiring an initial prediction result of the initial model, and correcting the initial model based on the initial prediction result and the spatial distribution matrix; and acquiring real-time rainfall data, inputting the real-time rainfall data into the corrected initial model, and acquiring a simulation result. The invention can improve the prediction accuracy.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Natural disaster escape exercise method and system based on gesture recognition
abstract_en: The application discloses a natural disaster escape exercise method and a system based on gesture recognition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the body gesture data of the user are input in advance and are associated with the user-defined gesture names; capturing gesture data of a user body in real time, comparing the gesture data with the entered body gesture data, and identifying the gesture of the user; simulating a natural disaster scene according to the user demand and selecting the natural disaster scene simulated by application according to the user; receiving the identified user gesture in real time, and controlling the virtual character to perform escape exercise in the simulated natural disaster scene by the same gesture action; and scoring escape exercise performance of the user in the simulated natural disaster scene according to a preset scoring index, and generating an evaluation report. The application can realize interactive exercise between the user and the virtual natural disaster scene, correct the actions in time and guide people to make correct escape actions, thereby achieving more real and accurate escape exercise effect.
assignees: NANJING LAIYITE ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-period power supply scheduling method and related device based on electric bus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-period power supply scheduling method and a related device based on electric buses, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in the pre-disaster stage, a pre-disaster electric bus operation model is built, travel chains are used for describing the operation condition of each electric bus on the basis of coupling of a traffic network and a power distribution network based on the pre-disaster electric bus operation model, and the state of the pre-disaster electric bus is simulated; generating a typhoon disaster scene through the fault probability of the power distribution network according to the state of the electric buses before the disaster, and taking the typhoon disaster scene as a disconnection scene of the electric buses after the disaster; and in the post-disaster stage, a time-air network is adopted to establish a post-disaster cooperative recovery stage model of the electric bus, and the movement characteristics and the charging and discharging behaviors of the electric bus are fully considered to obtain the multi-period power supply scheduling method of the electric bus. The invention utilizes the electric buses in cities to supply power to the system and enhance the elasticity of the system in case of power failure emergency, and has obvious effects in the aspects of improving the recovery efficiency of the power system, reducing the recovery cost, adapting to complex disaster situations and the like.

title_en: CBRN environment digital simulation method and system based on task-oriented protection state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CBRN environment digital simulation method based on a task oriented protection state, which comprises the steps of establishing a high-precision multi-scale model based on coupling of simulation models of microscopic scale and macroscopic scale, dynamically adjusting model complexity according to specific application scenes and real-time data, acquiring and processing real-time monitoring data for CBRN environment digital simulation, constructing a human health effect simulation model based on an individualized health effect model and a long-term effect simulation model, carrying out environment digital simulation based on a distributed computing architecture and an edge computing technology computing model, displaying and feeding back simulation results through an intelligent man-machine interaction interface and a user experience interface, carrying out emergency response and decision support based on virtual-real combination exercise and intelligent decision support, carrying out experimental verification on the real-time monitoring data based on a virtual experiment platform and a data consistency verification mechanism, calibrating the high-precision model and the human health effect simulation model, and discloses a system, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium.

title_en: Disaster prevention facility
abstract_en: To obtain a disaster prevention facility that can help a person better understand a work flow which should be followed if a disaster actually occurs.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention facility (1, 2) comprises: a display unit (10, 20); and a control unit (15, 25) having a simulation function for displaying on the display unit (10, 20) a work procedure picture that is a video summarizing a work procedure which should be performed in an event of a disaster occurring in a target facility. The work procedure picture is a moving picture in which a still picture of a 3-dimensional diagram of an internal view of the target facility is connected frame by frame along the time sequence of the work procedure; and the control unit (15, 25) displays this moving picture on the display unit (10, 20).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Method and system for disaster recovery policy management and updating
abstract_en: A method for managing policies for a disaster recovery of a data center includes receiving, at a cloud module, a first set of data that includes data center infrastructure information associated with the data center, a first prediction of resources, a list of assigned disaster recovery resources, and a status report of an application using the assigned disaster recovery resources; generating, by the cloud module and using the first set of data as training data, a learning model; generating a second prediction of resources using the learning model; and assigning, using the cloud module, disaster recovery resources to obtain assigned disaster recovery resources based on the second prediction, and the cloud module activates the assigned disaster recovery resources in response to determining that the data center has experienced a failure.

title_en: Power grid power failure area prediction method and system under typhoon disaster, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, a storage medium and electronic equipment for predicting a power failure area of a power grid under typhoon disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a sample set based on historical typhoon disaster related state data of a power grid region to be predicted; respectively processing the sample sets by adopting different dimension reduction modes to generate corresponding training sets; training different machine learning algorithm models by adopting different training sets to obtain a plurality of different prediction models; determining an optimal prediction model according to the evaluation index of each prediction model; and inputting the current typhoon disaster related state data of the power grid region to be predicted into an optimal prediction model to obtain a prediction result of whether the power grid region to be predicted has power failure. The method can effectively predict whether the power failure occurs in the power grid area under the typhoon disaster, thereby effectively guiding operation and maintenance repair personnel to carry out maintenance and guarantee work.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Campus natural disaster exercise method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a campus natural disaster exercise method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a physical environment model of a school; constructing a virtual campus environment corresponding to the physical environment of the school based on the physical environment model of the school; simulating a preset natural disaster in the virtual campus environment in response to user operation; obtaining escape routes and escape behaviors of each student aiming at the preset natural disasters; and obtaining a campus natural disaster exercise result based on the escape route and escape behavior of each student aiming at the preset natural disaster. The embodiment of the application is beneficial to improving the reality and the accuracy of the campus natural disaster exercise.

title_en: Geological disaster vulnerability assessment method based on high-time-resolution population simulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster risk assessment, and discloses a geological disaster vulnerability assessment method based on high-time-resolution population simulation, which comprises the following steps: simulating urban population distribution by adopting a land utilization density method; defining high time resolution of resident travel based on time geography; determining the building attraction ratio of different time of each land type; building mathematical models through the building attractions of different time periods, and carrying out high-time-resolution population dynamic simulation; dividing a vulnerability evaluation unit; calculating each vulnerability index; constructing a geological disaster vulnerability evaluation model; and (5) analyzing vulnerability assessment results with high time resolution. By adopting the geological disaster vulnerability assessment method based on high-time-resolution population simulation, the method provided by the invention can identify high-risk vulnerable areas, improve disaster prevention capability, optimize emergency resource allocation, improve rescue efficiency, guide urban and rural planning and land utilization, reduce disaster influence, and reduce economic loss and population casualties.

title_en: Method, equipment, medium and product for evaluating liability of Qinghai-Tibet Gao Yuanre disaster
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, equipment, medium and product for evaluating the liability of hot-melt disasters of Qinghai-Tibet plateau, and relates to the field of Qinghai-Tibet Gao Yuanre hot-melt disaster research, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of training and optimizing a primary learner which consists of a classification lifting tree, an extreme random tree, a random forest and an extreme gradient lifting tree by using hot-melt disaster points in different geographic positions of a Qinghai-Tibet plateau region and non-hot-melt disaster points, slope directions, gradients, topographic humidity indexes, annual average ground temperature, active layer thickness, solar radiation, normalized vegetation indexes, fine soil content and precipitation, and a stacking model consisting of gradient enhancement decision trees by using a secondary learner, so that prediction results of hot-melt disaster points or non-hot-melt disaster points at different geographic positions of the Qinghai-Tibet plateau region are obtained by using the optimized stacking model, and further, a hot-melt disaster vulnerability map for vulnerability evaluation of Qinghai-Tibet Gao Yuanre. The application can improve the accuracy of the vulnerability assessment of the Qinghai-Tibet Gao Yuanre disaster.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction method based on massive big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster prediction method based on massive big data, which comprises the following steps: s0, logging in a geological disaster prediction platform system; s1, collecting data required by geological disaster prediction, preprocessing the data, and executing the next step after preprocessing; s2, reprocessing the data processed in the step S1; s3, inputting the data after the data is reprocessed into a prediction model, and outputting a prediction result. The invention realizes the acquisition and training of data to realize the prediction of geological disasters and can achieve the purposes of disaster prevention and disaster reduction.
assignees: CHONGQING 208 GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method and system for payment data security
abstract_en: The invention discloses a payment data security assessment method and system, comprising the steps of data acquisition, risk identification, security assessment, report generation and the like, wherein a distributed acquisition node is combined with a quantum random number generator, a deep learning model, a self-encoder, a knowledge graph and other innovative modules are adopted, countersample detection and risk dynamic simulation are added, report encryption, visualization and automatic update are carried out, and a real-time monitoring, simulation attack and emergency response module is provided to ensure the comprehensiveness, accuracy and timeliness of payment data security assessment; the invention has the advantages of multi-module cooperation, comprehensive and real-time data acquisition and safety, higher risk identification accuracy, more scientific safety evaluation, visual and time-efficient report, and an omnibearing protection system, thereby providing a powerful guarantee for payment data safety and improving the confidence of users and payment service providers.

title_en: Construction method of hyperspectral remote sensing basic large model of low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a hyperspectral remote sensing basic large model of a low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the steps of constructing a data set, constructing a three-dimensional extended MAE model, constructing a total loss function L, training the three-dimensional extended MAE model to obtain a large spectrum model, and reconstructing the hyperspectral sample to obtain a predicted hyperspectral image, wherein the sample is a hyperspectral sample. According to the invention, the traditional two-dimensional MAE model is expanded to be three-dimensional, the reconstructed image can better express the spectral characteristics of different objects and surfaces by combining a dynamic shielding rate strategy and 3D position coding, and more accurate physical boundaries are provided by combining the HED model to strengthen edge details. The invention is suitable for precise material identification and classification, and is particularly suitable for complex environment monitoring and resource evaluation tasks in the fields of precise agriculture, environment protection, disaster management and the like.

title_en: Wind tunnel experiment generating device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind disaster simulation, and discloses a wind tunnel experiment generating device. The wind tunnel experiment generating device comprises a circulating wind drum, wherein a circulating wind channel is formed in the circulating wind drum, a circulating wind unit is arranged in the circulating wind channel, a lower-impact storm flow simulation test section, a tornado simulation test section and a normal wind test section are formed at the bottom of the circulating wind drum, a first test bed and a ventilation assembly are arranged on the lower-impact storm flow simulation test section, a second test bed is arranged on the normal wind test section, and a third test bed and a spiral wind unit are arranged on the tornado simulation test section. The wind tunnel experiment generating device provided by the invention can simulate the conditions of tornadoes, downburst and other complex winds, so that the wind-resistant experiment structure of the building is more comprehensive and accurate, a plurality of different wind tunnel devices are not required to be used when responding to different wind disasters, the research cost is reduced, the comparison and comprehensive analysis of experimental data are simplified and more comprehensive, various experiments can be synchronously performed, and the experiment efficiency is increased.
assignees: CHN ENERGY SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS

title_en: Forest fire danger zone assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire danger zone assessment method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a maximum entropy model to obtain a forest fire risk level of a certain area in a natural state; step 2, vectorizing and normalizing the disaster reduction capacity; step 3, performing regional Sen Lin Huoxian zone assessment based on disaster reduction capability; step 4, constructing forest fire risk grades with comparability among different areas; and 5, simulating forest fire risks in different areas in future global change scenes by utilizing the future scene data. The forest fire danger zone assessment method can effectively avoid that the areas with higher fire danger caused by the original forest fire danger zone assessment method are always increased in prevention and control investment and construction, and the areas with lower fire danger are always unable to obtain better investment construction; the method avoids the situation that once a fire disaster occurs in the area with lower fire risk, the fighter is delayed due to the lag of infrastructure construction and weak strength of the fire prevention and extinguishing profession, and causes larger loss.
assignees: EAST CHINA SURVEY AND PLANNING INST OF STATE FORESTRY AND GRASSLAND ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Physical test device and method for simulating high-order remote debris flow motion characteristics
abstract_en: The physical test device comprises a support and a material groove, wherein the upper end of the material groove is connected to the support through a hook, the lower end of the material groove is in butt joint with a model groove, a baffle is arranged in the material groove, a telescopic rod is arranged between the upper end and the lower end of the model groove and the ground, a thermal imager is arranged on one side of the model groove, a first camera is arranged in front of the model groove, a plurality of second cameras are arranged above the model groove, a plurality of pressure sensors are arranged in the model groove, and the acquired data are transmitted to a computer by the pressure sensors, the first camera, the second cameras and the thermal imager. The invention is used for researching high-position remote debris flow landslide disasters.

title_en: Mine interior escape demonstration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for demonstrating escape in a mine, which relates to the technical field of demonstrating escape in the mine, and the technical scheme is as follows: including the demonstration system of fleing, the demonstration system of fleing includes: the central processing unit is used for guaranteeing the calculation and operation of the system; the emergency prompt module is used for simulating and sending an emergency prompt tone so as to remind miners to escape in time, and is connected with the input end of the central processing unit; the beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the scene simulation module can simulate unexpected scenes occurring in a mine when escaping, the falling stone simulation module simulates the falling stone scenes in the mine, the fire simulation module simulates the fires in the mine, and the gas leakage simulation module simulates the harmful gas leakage scenes in the mine, so that the experience of miners can be enhanced, the reality is stronger, the demonstration effect is better, the miners are guaranteed to have strong strain capacity when the real disasters occur, the intelligent decision and judgment can be made, and unnecessary injuries can be avoided.
assignees: BEIJING HONGSHAN INFORMATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging walk evacuation method for solving complicated emergency evacuation problem of waterlogging in high-density urban area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a city waterlogging walking evacuation method for solving the problem of complicated emergency evacuation of waterlogging in a high-density urban area, which comprises the steps of firstly simulating a rainstorm scene in three hours in one hundred year by using a InfoWorks ICM model, and dividing waterlogging risk grades according to a flooding duration t and a flooding depth d; secondly, screening high-risk cells under the risk level, and screening emergency evacuation places with low risk and no risk; taking the safety of pedestrian evacuation into consideration, and reconstructing a road network topology by taking the product HR of the ponding depth d and the flow velocity v as a dangerous index; and finally, taking the residential district as a refuge starting point, calculating the minimum time cost from the refuge demand point to the refuge site point by using a Dijkstra algorithm, and planning an evacuation route for residents. The invention combines the evacuation efficiency and the waterlogging evacuation safety of the high-density urban area, identifies the evacuation demand points according to the flood risk, screens the evacuation places, considers the pedestrian evacuation safety and combines the path optimization algorithm, thereby reasonably planning the emergency evacuation route.

title_en: Test device and test method for simulating tunneling process under seepage state
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunneling engineering under a seepage state, in particular to a test device for simulating a tunneling process under the seepage state, which comprises a water injection system, a seepage system, a rock stratum simulation system, a tunnel system and a monitoring system; the invention also provides a test method for simulating the tunneling process in the seepage state, which comprises the following steps: step one, installing a rock stratum simulation system and a seepage system; step two, installing a water injection system; step three, manufacturing a tunnel system; simulating a seepage state; simulating a tunneling process; step six, collecting test data through a data collector, and completing the test; the invention can truly reproduce the deformation condition and the destruction mechanism of soil around the tunnel under the condition of natural disasters, has the advantages of good effect and reliable test data, and provides reasonable technical support for the actual tunnel construction technology.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 21 BUREAU GROUP RAIL TRANSIT ENG CO LTD

title_en: Landslide disaster insurance individual rate assessment method, device and storage medium based on landslide disaster event set
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide disaster insurance average rate assessment method, a device and a storage medium based on a landslide disaster event set, which comprise the following steps: calculating a variation coefficient and a skewness coefficient based on the measured data of the physical mechanics of the rock-soil body of the slope unit; randomly acquiring physical and mechanical simulation data of a rock-soil body of a preset number group of each grid unit; obtaining the instability probability of each grid unit; obtaining the instability probability of the corresponding slope unit according to the instability probabilities of all grid units; acquiring space-time coupling instability probability of a corresponding slope unit based on the instability probability of the slope unit and the rainfall disaster probability; acquiring the total economic property loss caused by sliding in a preset time period based on economic property distribution data of slope units at corresponding positions and corresponding times in a landslide event set; and obtaining the average rate evaluation and quantification result of the sliding slope disaster insurance persons in a preset time period. By adopting the method provided by the invention, the average rate of landslide disaster insurance persons can be evaluated more rapidly, accurately and quantitatively.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIST;CHONGQING GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: Extreme storm waterlogging disaster risk dynamic assessment method for disaster prevention and reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic evaluation method for extreme rainstorm waterlogging disaster risk used for disaster prevention and reduction, which is used for researching urban system data and disaster prevention and reduction data, carrying out refined risk unit division on disaster-bearing bodies on urban building and road network scales by utilizing a GIS technology and determining the spatial distribution of the disaster-bearing bodies; simulating disaster influence on a disaster-bearing body based on the dynamic change process of the depth of the flood water in the extreme rainstorm waterlogging situation; carrying out refined dynamic assessment of waterlogging risk by combining two methods of waterlogging process simulation and an index system; calculating traffic capacity and emergency service accessibility of a road network system by using a space complex network and a shortest path planning; on the basis, reasonable distribution of disaster prevention emergency drainage and emergency rescue services to high risk areas is comprehensively considered, a waterlogging risk dynamic assessment technology integrating disaster evolution and disaster prevention response processes is provided, and dynamic assessment of waterlogging risks of each disaster-bearing unit in the waterlogging disaster evolution process is finally achieved.

title_en: Flange leakage simulation equipment for valve pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses flange leakage simulation equipment for a valve pipeline, which relates to the technical field of fire control training and comprises a simulation platform, wherein a liquid-gas conveying mechanism is fixedly arranged at the top of the simulation platform, a control valve is connected with the outer surface of the liquid-gas conveying mechanism in a penetrating way, and a pipeline main body is connected with the right end of the liquid-gas conveying mechanism in a penetrating way through the control valve. The flange leakage simulation equipment for the valve pipeline can be used for simulating training in an actual scene by firefighters, so that the firefighters can be helped to be familiar with the layout, operation and maintenance of the pipeline and the valve, and know the processing methods of different types of leakage, the simulation equipment can create realistic emergency situations such as leakage, pressure relief and the like, the firefighters can learn how to quickly evaluate the scene, select proper tools and equipment and take proper control measures to protect personnel and property safety by processing and training the simulation equipment, and a safe environment can be provided by training the simulation equipment.
assignees: SICHUAN CHUANJU FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-gas easy-spontaneous-combustion coal seam roof roadway-by-roadway multipurpose efficient disaster prevention method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of prevention and treatment of spontaneous combustion disasters of gas and coal in a high-gas easy-spontaneous-combustion coal seam, in particular to a multipurpose efficient disaster prevention method for a roof roadway of the high-gas easy-spontaneous-combustion coal seam: firstly, arranging a roof roadway at a certain layer position above a protective coal pillar between a working face return air roadway to be mined and an adjacent working face air inlet roadway, constructing downward layer-penetrating drilling holes on two sides of the working face coal roadway, and reaming and cave-making; on this basis, high-level large-diameter drilling and low-level large-diameter drilling are constructed above the working surface. In addition, in the working face stoping process, grouting drilling holes can be constructed in the roof roadway, and grid type fixed-drop grouting can be conducted on the goaf. By adopting the method, the roof roadway can be used for pre-pumping coal roadway strip gas, shielding coal roadway tunneling, extracting gas gushed during stoping of a working face, drip irrigation grouting, fire prevention and extinguishment of a goaf, multiple purposes of one roadway are realized, and disaster prevention cost of a coal seam with high gas easy spontaneous combustion can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Nondestructive testing evaluation method and system for rock mechanical heterogeneity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock mechanical non-uniformity nondestructive testing evaluation method and system, and belongs to the field of deep underground engineering rock mechanical non-uniformity characteristic testing. The method comprises the following steps: selecting a complete stratum to be measured, and drilling to obtain a core column; processing the core column to prepare a rock sample, and numbering and marking the surface of the rock sample; respectively arranging ultrasonic longitudinal wave transducers and transverse wave transducers on different numbered surfaces of the numbered marks for single-sided test, and recording wave speed data; and obtaining a mechanical non-uniformity coefficient according to the recorded wave velocity data, and evaluating the mechanical non-uniformity of the rock through the mechanical non-uniformity coefficient. After the technical scheme of the invention is used, the rock sample is not obviously damaged, can be repeatedly tested and used in other experiments, and the mechanical non-uniformity coefficient can obviously represent the mechanical non-uniformity of the material in the rock, so that the method is easy to calculate, simple to operate, good in economy and strong in practicability, and can promote the evaluation and classification of the quality of the surrounding rock of deep underground engineering, and the rock instability fracture and dynamic disaster risk can be effectively evaluated.

title_en: Geographic mapping information acquisition method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a geographical mapping information acquisition method and a geographical mapping information acquisition system based on big data, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring geographical mapping information, including geological soil information, geological disaster information and hydrologic information; the method comprises the steps of classifying geographic mapping information to obtain classification results, predicting disaster risk levels of different areas according to the classification results to obtain prediction results, optimizing the layout of disaster monitoring points according to the prediction results, simulating a hydrologic cycle process by using a SWAT model to predict water level and flow rate changes, evaluating water quality according to the water level and flow rate changes to obtain evaluation results, and optimizing a water resource distribution scheme according to the evaluation results to obtain data analysis results. The invention not only improves the efficiency of data acquisition, but also ensures the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the data.

title_en: User power failure multi-classification probability prediction method based on histogram gradient lifting tree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-classification probability prediction method for user power failure based on a histogram gradient lifting tree, which relates to the technical field of power consumption prediction and comprises the steps of acquiring user data, cleaning, and selecting key features in the cleaned user data by using a Relief algorithm; constructing a histogram gradient lifting tree algorithm model, setting initial parameters, and training the model by using training set data to obtain a trained prediction model; and optimizing and adjusting the parameters of the prediction model to obtain super parameters of the model, analyzing the prediction result of the model by using the multi-classification evaluation index, calculating the prediction probability of each category, and predicting the multi-classification probability of the power failure of the user. The method and the system improve the accuracy of the power failure probability prediction of the user, realize the rapid prediction of the power failure probability of the user, and can provide early warning information in time to assist the electric company in rapid decision and emergency response.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Service data block backup method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a business data block backup method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: acquiring basic information of a plurality of storage nodes, and operating performance data and fault information in a preset history period; training a node simultaneous failure prediction model according to the basic information, the operation performance data and the failure information, and predicting a first probability value of simultaneous failure of two storage nodes in a next service period according to the node simultaneous failure prediction model; grouping the storage nodes according to the first probability value and a preset probability threshold value to obtain a plurality of storage node groups, so that the first probability value corresponding to any two storage nodes in the same storage node group is smaller than or equal to the probability threshold value; and carrying out block backup on the service data to be backed up according to the plurality of storage node groups. The invention improves the safety of service data storage, reduces the cost of service data backup disaster recovery, and can be widely applied to the technical field of data processing.

title_en: Escape capability training method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses an escape capability training method and device, wherein the method acquires body information and setting information of a target user; the method comprises the steps of setting information, determining a target capacity level of a target user according to the setting information, determining a target training scene according to the body information and the target capacity level, and determining a target training task according to the target capacity level and the target training scene so that the target user can execute the target training task in the target training scene. Because the escape capability of the user in the disaster requiring escape training is determined, the corresponding training scene is determined according to the physiological characteristics of the user and the escape capability in the disaster, and the target training task is determined according to the corresponding training scene, the user can train in the scene meeting the self requirements and aiming at the physiological characteristics of the user, the intelligent degree of escape capability training is improved, and the training effect of escape capability training of people with limited mobility such as disabled people is improved.

title_en: Digital safety emergency drilling and commanding platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of project management, in particular to a digital security emergency exercise and command platform, which comprises a risk assessment module, an event propagation prediction module, a resource demand and scheduling module, a response time management module, a cost benefit analysis module, a network flow abnormality detection module and a security hole priority ordering module, wherein the invention utilizes the network flow abnormality detection module to introduce a real-time monitoring and response technology, the method has the advantages that the real-time monitoring and quick response to the network security event are realized, the response time of the security event is shortened, the risk and influence of the security event on the organization are reduced, in addition, the response time management module is utilized by means of an automatic emergency response technology, the automatic identification and processing to the common security event can be realized according to the set rules and procedures, the efficiency and the accuracy of the emergency response are improved, and the human error and delay are reduced.
assignees: HEJIE TECH LIAONING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Helicopter rescue simulator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue simulation, and particularly discloses a helicopter rescue simulation device, which comprises: the left end and the right end of the front side and the rear side of the inner cavity of the hanging beam frame are provided with limiting sliding grooves along the up-down direction; the number of the cranes is two, and the two cranes are respectively arranged at the left side and the right side of the top end of the inner cavity of the hanging beam frame; the left and right sides of the top end of the moving mechanism are respectively arranged at the bottom ends of the two cranes; the jolt simulating mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the moving mechanism. The device effectively makes up the defect of simulation training of the rescue of the traditional helicopter, enables rescue workers to repeatedly exercise complex and changeable external rescue skills in a highly simulated environment, remarkably improves the capability of the rescue workers to cope with high-risk and uncertain rescue tasks, improves the rescue efficiency and safety, and ensures that the rescue workers can perform urgent and accurate rescue in the face of actual hovering rescue, thereby better serving various emergency rescue requirements such as natural disasters, medical emergency, mountain search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Combined testing equipment for inner and outer drilling of deep rock mass strength hole and testing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses combined test equipment for inner and outer drilling of a deep rock mass strength hole and a test method thereof, the combined test equipment for the inside and outside of the deep rock mass strength hole comprises a drilling machine, an outside hole drilling parameter test unit, a drill rod, an inside hole rock strength test unit, a hole surface seismic wave detector, a laser range finder, a control processing unit and an outside drilling device. According to the invention, discrete rock strength, continuous rock strength, rock longitudinal wave speed and rock structural face identification are respectively realized through the while-drilling tests of the inside, outside and outside of the hole, and rock strength parameters are calculated through the rock structural face and rock strength information, so that the method can be used for measuring the rock strength parameters actually drilled by the drill bit while drilling, is beneficial to improving the accuracy of deep underground engineering investigation, and provides reliable geological data for engineering disaster risk assessment and support design construction.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS;WUHAN CONOURISH COALMINE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for finely evaluating influence degree of green tide beach of enteromorpha
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for finely evaluating influence degree of green tide beach of enteromorpha, and belongs to the field of influence evaluation of green tide disaster of enteromorpha. The method comprises the following steps: a. selecting an enteromorpha green tide beach influence degree evaluation area according to the evaluation requirement; b. interpreting satellite remote sensing images of sea areas near the evaluation area, and determining an evaluation time period; c. carrying out drift numerical simulation based on an enteromorpha green tide offshore short-term drift numerical model, and obtaining enteromorpha green tide particle distribution positions at different moments; d. dividing the area which is parallel to the shoreline offshore and coastwise by taking the shoreline of the evaluation area as a reference to obtain a plurality of grid units; and (3) calculating the green tide coverage rate of the enteromorpha in each grid unit in the evaluation time period, and carrying out fine evaluation on the influence degree of the green tide beach of the enteromorpha. The method can be used for carrying out qualitative and quantitative influence evaluation of the green tide of the enteromorpha, and specifically guiding interception and salvage of the green tide of the enteromorpha in coastal areas, beach treatment and the like, and plays an important role in the field of disaster prevention and control of the green tide of the enteromorpha.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA MARINE FORECASTING CENTER OF STATE OCEANIC ADMINISTRATION QINGDAO MARINE FORECAST ST

title_en: Method for judging sliding surface of landslide by combining drilling and high-density electrical method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide sliding surface judgment, and discloses a method for judging a landslide sliding surface by combining drilling and a high-density electrical method, which comprises the following steps: (1) Satellite remote sensing geological interpretation to obtain landslide geological disaster information; (2) Arranging a plurality of electrode modules between the toe and the rear edge, obtaining and analyzing data of a three-dimensional sliding surface of the landslide; (3) Carrying out geological drilling, obtaining geological physical information, and carrying out an in-hole test and an indoor rock test at the same time; (4) And comprehensively analyzing and comparing, judging the specific position and the form of the sliding surface, and carrying out BIM modeling to guide landslide control design and construction. The satellite remote sensing acquired information is combined with drilling and high-density electric methods, and is mutually compared with each other, the positions and the forms of sliding surfaces of landslide are determined more accurately, more accurate conditions are provided for the risk and the treatment of landslide disasters in the next step, BIM modeling is performed, the treatment and the construction of landslide are guided based on the BIM modeling, and the treatment and the construction of the landslide are facilitated.
assignees: SHENZHEN DASHENG SURVEY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Control method and system of fire-fighting training rope climbing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control system of a fire training rope climbing machine, wherein action parameters are defined according to abnormal action difference and training time of firefighters, and action grades are defined according to the action parameters; the method comprises the steps of constructing an action grade set according to action grades corresponding to a plurality of detection intervals, defining subsequent training grades of a firefighter relative to the firefighting training rope climbing machine according to the action grade set and the training grades of the firefighting training rope climbing machine, so that subsequent training of the firefighter is conveniently and properly regulated and controlled, the action grade set and the training grades of the firefighting training rope climbing machine are fully considered, suitability of the firefighter in subsequent training is guaranteed, meanwhile, corresponding guiding videos are matched according to the subsequent training grades of the firefighter relative to the firefighting training rope climbing machine, and action optimization information is presented according to the guiding videos and the corresponding detection intervals, so that training actions of the firefighter can be conveniently and timely managed, and training actions of the firefighter can be optimized in subsequent training.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Special tool box for science popularization on seismic scene
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geological disaster display equipment, in particular to a special tool box for science popularization in an earthquake scene, which comprises a science popularization box and an upper box door hinged with the science popularization box, wherein the other end of the upper box door is connected with the science popularization box through a bolt or a lock catch, a display stand is connected inside the science popularization box in a sliding manner, a simulation assembly is arranged inside the science popularization box, the simulation assembly comprises a plurality of electric push rods and sliding grooves, and the sliding grooves are formed in the top of the display stand; according to the utility model, the longitudinal and transverse shaking of the model box can be realized through the simulation assembly, and the dual simulation of longitudinal wave and transverse wave earthquakes is realized through single driving equipment, so that the harmfulness of the earthquakes is comprehensively displayed and popular science through the models in the model box.

title_en: Electric tool fire cause simulation experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire cause simulation experiment device of an electric tool, and relates to the technical field of fire cause simulation experiments; comprises a shell; the inside of the shell is of a hollow structure, and a partition board is horizontally fixed in the shell and divides the inner cavity of the shell into a first cavity and a second cavity; the upper surface of the partition board is fixed with a combustible material placing rack and an electric tool; the working end of the electric tool corresponds to the combustible material placing rack; a transmission part; the transmission part is arranged on the upper surface of the partition board and forms an included angle with the working end; a friction member; the friction piece is positioned on the transmission part and driven by the transmission part to move towards or away from the direction of the working end, and the utility model has the advantages of simple and stable structure, convenient operation, safety and reliability, and can intuitively demonstrate the spark generated by friction, further the fire disaster process caused by friction, and effectively play a role in warning.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Geological disaster escape simulation system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a geological disaster escape simulation system, which comprises a simulation experience area, a mountain model, a display unit, a rolling stone slope and simulation equipment, wherein the simulation experience area is a simulation area; the simulation experience area is arranged at the bottom edge of the mountain model and comprises a simulation shaking platform and an escape platform; the rolling stone slope is arranged between mountain models; the display unit is arranged at one end of the mountain model, which is far away from the simulation experience area, and is arranged opposite to the simulation shaking platform relative to the mountain model; the simulation equipment comprises a fan, a smoke device, a loudspeaker device and a flash device; the analog device and the display unit are connected with the control terminal. The utility model realizes the simulation output of the multi-element omnibearing disaster condition, greatly improves the reality of simulation and greatly improves the efficiency of disaster coping with guiding learning.

title_en: Ecological environment treatment device for mine geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological environment treatment device for mine geological disasters, which relates to the technical field of environment treatment devices, wherein the device is driven to advance by the movement of a crawler belt through the rotation of a gear set, when the device needs to turn, the rotation speeds of the gear sets in two groups of crawler belts are different to realize the turning, when only the gear set in one group of crawler belts rotates, the device can realize the in-situ turning, the design is suitable for complex mine environments, the flexibility of the device is increased, when the track moves, the tire is driven to rotate to form a power assisting function, when the condition of road unevenness is met, the tire can move up and down on the surface of the clamping plate, the stability of the device is improved, the overall design structure is simple, the maintenance is convenient, the upper device is driven to move through the movement of the electromagnetic block, the bearing column and the upper device are driven to rotate through the motor, and the tungsten steel drill bit is driven to break soil and loose the soil surface through the first telescopic rod.
assignees: HUNAN GEOLOGICAL DISASTER INVESTIGATION MONITORING INSTITUTE HUNAN GEOLOGICAL DISASTER EMERGENCY RES

title_en: Urban buried gas pipe network earthquake disaster chain risk analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing earthquake disaster chains of an urban buried gas pipe network, which belongs to the technical field of risk analysis, and comprises the steps of constructing a case library, wherein the case library comprises simulation results of earthquake disaster chains of each type of pipe sections in different types of pipe sections with different attribute information under different damage conditions, determining the classification of each pipe section in a target urban buried gas pipe network according to the attribute information and the constructed case library, finding out the simulation results of the corresponding classification from the case library as the analysis results of the earthquake disaster chains, and obtaining the earthquake disaster chain scene of the target urban buried gas pipe network according to the distribution condition of each pipe section in the target urban buried gas pipe network and the analysis results of the earthquake disaster chains of each pipe section. The invention can realize the risk analysis of the earthquake disaster chain of the urban buried gas pipe network and can provide scientific and reasonable tools for disaster prevention planning and post-earthquake emergency of a life line system.

title_en: Fire disaster identification alarm method based on AI image and fire disaster detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster identification alarm method and a fire disaster detector based on AI images, which belong to the technical field of fire disaster identification, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a model library by a platform side; the method comprises the steps of identifying a target area according to fire monitoring requirements of a user, matching fire identification models meeting the fire monitoring requirements from a model library, marking the fire identification models as main identification models, installing monitoring equipment in the target area, performing fire verification simulation on the target area according to the monitoring equipment to obtain various misalignment data, performing temporary fire monitoring supplement according to the various misalignment data, setting a corresponding fire comprehensive identification scheme, monitoring the target area in real time to obtain monitoring data, processing the monitoring data according to the fire comprehensive identification scheme to obtain fire identification results, adjusting the main identification models according to the various misalignment data by a platform side, updating the adjusted main identification models at the user, and canceling the temporary fire monitoring supplement.

title_en: Method, medium and system for constructing digital twin system of offshore embankment disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, medium and system for constructing a digital twin system of an offshore diffuse dike disaster, which belong to the technical field of image data processing or generation. And then, carrying out sea wave and hydrodynamic force simulation by using a real-time three-dimensional creation tool, and simultaneously carrying out real-time observation on a target area and inputting data into a system. And then constructing a sea wave model and a storm surge model based on the high-resolution numerical model or the artificial intelligence model, and forecasting sea waves and storm surge for at least 72 hours by using the models, and simulating disaster situations of histories and different reproduction periods and different disaster reduction measures. And finally, constructing a disaster prevention and reduction scene library based on the simulation result, and solving the problem that the three-dimensional dynamic characteristics of the sea area and the effects of various disaster reduction measures cannot be fully reflected in the prior art.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA MARINE FORECASTING CENTER OF STATE OCEANIC ADMINISTRATION QINGDAO MARINE FORECAST ST

title_en: Multi-mode airport scene entity simulation platform and operation simulation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a computer control-based multi-mode airport scene entity simulation platform, which comprises a multi-mode sensor system, an entity model, a computer control system, a real-time data processing and performance evaluation module and a user-friendly interaction interface, and aims to provide a dynamic and interactive simulation environment for simulation of airport operation management by integrating various sensors and a highly-automatic control system. The platform combines RGB-D cameras, laser radar (LIDAR), infrared cameras and other sensors, and can accurately monitor airport scene activities under various environmental conditions. By computer programming control of the scaled model of the aircraft and ground vehicles, the platform can simulate various airport operating scenarios, including daily operations and emergency responses. In addition, the system also comprises a real-time data processing and performance evaluation function, so that the operation efficiency can be analyzed in real time, optimization suggestions can be provided, and meanwhile, a user-friendly interaction interface ensures that an operator can easily grasp the operation of the system, and experimental simulation can be effectively carried out. The integrated multi-mode simulation platform greatly improves the safety and efficiency effectiveness of airport scene management.

title_en: Three-dimensional simulation method for building engineering construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building engineering construction, in particular to a three-dimensional simulation method for building engineering construction. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining construction design data of building engineering, constructing a three-dimensional model of the construction of the building engineering, extracting construction geological condition data, calculating the level differentiation and foundation stability of a building foundation, and calculating the strength of a building body according to the foundation stability data. Further, historical natural disaster data around the building are obtained, building risk assessment is conducted by combining building intensity data, risk assessment data are generated, and a building structure design optimization strategy is analyzed according to the risk assessment data. The method effectively improves the precision and safety prediction of construction simulation through three-dimensional model construction and multi-level data analysis, and provides data support for the design optimization of the construction engineering. According to the invention, the three-dimensional simulation technology for the construction of the building engineering is safer and more efficient through the construction risk assessment optimization.
assignees: HAINAN JINGHAI LIDING IND CO LTD

title_en: Test device for simulating special deflagration fire disaster working condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device for simulating special deflagration fire conditions, which comprises a deflagration condition simulation module, an electric control module, a methane fuel supply module, a methane-air jet ignition module, an experimental data acquisition module, a flame shooting module and a peripheral equipment module. The invention has the beneficial effects that the methane-air premixed jet fire experiment can be carried out in the closed space, the integral temperature in the cabin is ensured not to be lower than 600 ℃, and the working performance of the sensor in a severe environment can be tested. The invention also provides a method for ensuring the temperature of the cabin, a method for selecting the nozzle and a method for determining the size of each component. The device has the characteristics of high integration level, high automation degree, simple and convenient operation and the like, and has important significance for deep understanding of the evolution and development rules of the flame deflagration working condition of the methane-air premixed jet flow.

title_en: SRFNet-based flood disaster process analysis method, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SRFNet-based flood disaster process analysis method, medium and equipment, which relate to the field of space-time analysis and mining, and are based on SRFNet, and mainly comprise the steps of preprocessing multi-mode data of a flood inundation process of a target research area to obtain a flood inundation process space-time data set; and predicting space-time data in the flooding process of the target area by using the trained multi-mode flooding disaster time sequence prediction model to obtain the water flooding range of the target area. By implementing the SRFNet-based flood disaster process analysis method, medium and equipment provided by the invention, the automatic analysis and mining of the multi-mode data of the flood disasters can be realized, and the accuracy and range of the flood disaster simulation prediction are improved.

title_en: Resident demand response optimization method based on multi-agent deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resident demand response optimization method based on multi-agent deep reinforcement learning, which firstly provides a resident demand side response optimization framework, then provides a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning method taking each resident as an agent and taking the resident electricity cost as a goal, and comprises the steps of establishing a partial considerable Markov game model, and training a neural network by adopting a multi-agent deep deterministic strategy gradient algorithm. The method effectively solves the problems that the traditional model-based method depends on accurate modeling, has low expandability and the like, and simultaneously solves the problems that the traditional single-agent deep reinforcement learning method cannot cope with multi-element heterogeneous user equipment and is easy to produce dimension disasters.

title_en: Method for selecting installation position of fire extinguishing bomb in middle joint area of cable tunnel
abstract_en: A method for selecting the installation position of fire extinguishing bomb in the middle joint area of a cable tunnel includes such steps as building a fire test platform of the cable tunnel, igniting the middle joint of the cable tunnel by an ignition device, recording the temperature data of temperature measuring sensors of different simulated hanging points of the fire extinguishing bomb, building a fire simulation model of the cable tunnel according to the structural arrangement and the size of the fire test platform of the cable tunnel, correcting the parameter setting of the material of the middle joint of the cable, building a simulation model to simulate fire, obtaining the temperature rise variation, recording the temperature data of the alternative hanging points of different fire extinguishing bomb, determining the trigger initial time of the fire extinguishing bomb, determining the action time of the fire extinguishing bomb after fire disaster according to the trigger initial time, comparing the slowest action time of the same hanging point with the slowest action time of different hanging points, and selecting the hanging point with the shortest time as the optimal arrangement position. The invention can better simulate the fire environment of the cable tunnel and the triggered condition of the fire extinguishing bomb, and the test result is more in line with the actual condition.

title_en: Landslide hazard intelligent early warning method based on soil erosion monitoring
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent landslide disaster early warning method based on water and soil loss monitoring, which comprises the following steps of obtaining basic information characteristics of a side slope, carrying out an indoor model test of the side slope indoor model under different rainfall scenes to obtain test data, carrying out numerical simulation, simulating dynamic response conditions of a numerical analysis model under different rainfall scenes to obtain simulation data, establishing a neural network model, carrying out neural network training by using a sample data set, establishing the neural network model capable of mapping rainfall infiltration, water and soil loss degree, side slope displacement, side slope safety coefficient and instability range, carrying out on-site monitoring, and carrying out disaster early warning. The method has the beneficial effects that the thought of a slope model is provided, the early warning model is built by aiming at a specific slope building data sample, the accuracy and precision of prediction can be effectively improved, and the prediction model is more attached to the actual slope by considering the inherent linkage rule of water and soil loss and landslide disasters.

title_en: Experimental device and method for researching water cooling effect of storage tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device and a method for researching the water cooling effect of a storage tank, the proposal forms a falling liquid film by simulating the surface of an actual storage tank and colliding a wall by water jet, on the basis, experimental data such as wall temperature, liquid film thickness, liquid film width, radiation heat flow intensity, liquid film flow velocity and the like at different positions are synchronously acquired. The experimental data can be used for researching the water cooling protection mechanism of the oil-gas storage tank in the fire disaster environment and evaluating the cooling effect of the fire water monitor, the fire water monitor and the fixed water spraying system. According to the scheme, the flowing condition of the cooling water liquid film on the surface of the storage tank in a fire disaster environment can be well simulated, the relative size of the formed liquid film can be accurately measured, and the accuracy of the experimental result of the water cooling effect of the storage tank is ensured.

title_en: Intelligent water conservancy data analysis method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to a digital twinning-based intelligent water conservancy data analysis method and system.
