According to the invention, through real-time data analysis and digital twin technology, the instant simulation and response of the water conservancy system behavior can be realized, the model can be immediately updated and optimized when new data are received, the response speed and adaptability of water conservancy management are improved, continuous monitoring and accurate adjustment of hydrologic parameters are allowed, the running efficiency of the whole water resource system is further optimized, the future hydrologic variation and potential risk points are predicted by combining real-time simulation and historical data analysis, and scientific basis is provided for strategy formulation and emergency response, so that the predictability and risk prevention and control capability of water resource management are remarkably improved.
assignees: SHANDONG HUATE WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Satellite Internet of things semantic communication method for fire monitoring
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of satellite communication and discloses a satellite internet of things semantic communication method for fire monitoring, which comprises four steps of model construction and training, fire image preprocessing, fire image semantic extraction and transmission and fire image semantic recovery, wherein a model construction and training module constructs and trains a fire detection model, a semantic extraction and recovery model and a fire judgment model, the trained model is deployed into the satellite internet of things, a fire image preprocessing module judges whether an image has fire or not and periodically transmits an original image directly through a channel, a fire image semantic extraction and transmission module performs semantic extraction on the image and transmits the image through the channel, and a fire image semantic recovery module recovers the original image, judges the fire intensity and outputs an auxiliary decision according to a fire result. The fire disaster detection system and the fire disaster detection method can accurately detect fire disasters, can reduce transmission load and improve transmission efficiency, and are beneficial to monitoring staff to know the fire disasters in time and make auxiliary decisions.

title_en: Risk assessment method, model, readable storage medium, and apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method, a model, a readable storage medium and a device, which are used for collecting a plurality of relevant influence factors for immovable cultural relics in a sample area, training the plurality of relevant influence factors and a determined disaster-affected cultural relic sample in a machine learning mode to obtain a prediction model, and predicting disaster-affected risks of immovable cultural relics in a target area through the prediction model, wherein the relevant influence factors comprise disaster-affected weather data comprising rainfall, wind speed, temperature and snow accumulation of the area where the area is located and used for reflecting main variables which cause the fixed cultural relics to be affected, cultural relic environment data comprising elevation values, gradients, vegetation coverage and river network density in the area and used for reflecting factors of disaster occurrence probability increased by the disaster-affected weather data, and cultural relic body data comprising risk values obtained by a set risk value assignment table for the type of the cultural relics, the level of the cultural relic protection unit, the cultural relic scale and the cultural relic protection state.
assignees: SHANGHAI ATHENA DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation training system of digital power supply station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field related to a simulation training system of a power supply station, and discloses a simulation training system of a digital power supply station, which links electrical equipment with a simulation training model through the Internet of things, utilizes various sensors to communicate state data between the electrical equipment and the simulation training model, enables the simulation training model to reflect the working condition and fault condition of the actual electrical equipment, the simulation training process is more real, the equipment operation condition change feedback caused by each operation can be fed back in time, meanwhile, the remote control equipment is utilized to realize the remote control of the working condition of the electrical equipment, and different fault types are simulated artificially, so that the real fault can be rapidly handled, and the fault investigation, emergency response and problem solving capability of technicians are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU ANFANG ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Contactless intelligent detection method for working state of slope flexible protection system energy dissipater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact intelligent detection method for the working state of an energy consumer of a slope flexible protection system, belonging to the technical field of slope geological disaster protection, comprising the steps of carrying out a quasi-static tensile test, a full-scale impact test and a field engineering actual measurement of the energy consumer to establish an image dataset of the working process of the energy consumer; the automatic segmentation of the binary image of the working state of the energy consumer is realized by adopting a data set training significance target detection depth neural network, the energy consumer framework is obtained by adopting a morphological image processing technology, and the residual energy consumption capacity is automatically calculated by adopting a contour detection technology to extract the inner and outer contours of the energy consumer framework. The method solves the problem of non-contact intelligent identification of the working state of the key energy consumption part of the flexible protection system through an artificial intelligence technology, has high accuracy, and realizes the integrated application of visual monitoring of the appearance and the distinguishing of the intrinsic performance of the key part of the protection engineering.

title_en: Ground advanced exploration treatment method for coal mine tunnel fault zone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine roadway disaster management, in particular to a ground advanced exploration management method for a fault zone of a coal mine roadway. The method comprises the steps of arranging a ground drilling site, designing a ground directional drilling structure and a drilling track, wherein the ground directional drilling structure comprises a first straight hole section, a second inclined hole section and a third inclined hole section, calculating a design reinforcing range, drilling holes in the ground drilling site according to the ground directional drilling structure and the drilling track, calculating grouting amount according to the design reinforcing range, grouting in the third inclined hole section according to the grouting amount, logging in the drilling process of the second inclined hole section and the third inclined hole section, obtaining logging data, evaluating grouting effect and performing hole sealing operation. According to the invention, the rock mass around the roadway is reinforced by the ground directional drilling before the underground roadway is tunneled, so that the mutual interference with underground operation is less, and the production efficiency and the coal mining safety are improved.
assignees: ANHUI HENGYUAN COAL & ELECTRIC CO LTD;BEIJING CHINA COAL MINE ENG CO;TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Crop meteorological index insurance pricing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a crop weather index insurance pricing method and system, the method comprises the steps of respectively constructing a corresponding weather disaster risk assessment data set and a prediction model data set according to a historical weather database, correspondingly dividing a plurality of disaster risk grades according to the weather disaster risk assessment data set based on GIS, respectively matching target areas corresponding to each disaster risk grade in a preset planning area, detecting unit production data corresponding to each target area in real time, generating a target data set, training and verifying a plurality of preset initial yield prediction algorithms through the target data set, correspondingly selecting a target yield prediction algorithm with the minimum error in the preset initial yield prediction algorithms, respectively calculating a target corresponding to each rate target area through the target yield prediction algorithm, and calculating a corresponding insurance price according to a target rate in real time. The invention can accurately calculate the insurance price and improve the working efficiency.
assignees: JIANGXI METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER JIANGXI PROFESSIONAL METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY JIANGXI METEOR;JIANGXI INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Post-earthquake recoverability assessment method, device and equipment for electric power facility and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of seismic toughness assessment, and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for assessing post-seismic recoverability of electric power facilities, wherein an electric power facility model is built according to parameter information of each electric power facility in an electric power system, and earthquake simulation events are created to simulate disasters of the electric power facility model so as to obtain post-seismic state data of each facility; and respectively carrying out low-period static load disturbance test on the electric power facility model and the restored electric power facility model, and obtaining a post-earthquake recoverability evaluation result according to the response difference of the two. According to the invention, a seismic simulation event is created to simulate a earthquake disaster of the electric power facility model, the electric power facility is recovered according to the priority of the electric power demand, and static force disturbance is applied to the recovered electric power facility to test the static load resistance of the electric power facility, so that the reliability of the recovery assessment after the earthquake is further improved.

title_en: Image quality enhancement method based on self-adaptive adjustment of light source intensity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image quality enhancement method based on self-adaptive adjustment of light source intensity, which comprises the following steps of firstly constructing a data set, sorting and screening the data set, then training the screened data set to obtain a light source intensity prediction model, then predicting the optimal light source intensity by utilizing the light source intensity prediction model according to the distance and angle information of a light source to a target object fed back in real time in the moving process of a robot, and finally converting the obtained optimal light source intensity into a PWM signal, and realizing accurate control of the light source brightness by a singlechip. In addition, the mechanical arm is flexibly controlled, the specific position is accurately illuminated, the operation efficiency of the rescue robot in a complex and severe post-disaster mine environment is enhanced, the energy consumption is reduced, and the overall working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring and discloses a landslide vulnerability evaluation method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing the original data of landslide historical events and basic environmental factors, and establishing an evaluation factor geospatial data set by adopting a frequency ratio method; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a bagging concept, randomly sampling an unlabeled sample set U through a repeatable sampling Bootstrap method, combining the unlabeled sample set U with all landslide positive sample sets P to create a training set, generating weak classifiers by taking a limit gradient tree as a base learner, taking the average value of a plurality of weak classifiers as a final prediction model through a plurality of iterative processes, and carrying out susceptibility prediction on all sample points in an evaluation factor geospatial data set by using the final prediction model to obtain a landslide susceptibility evaluation partition map. The landslide prediction model has the beneficial effects that the problem of unbalanced proportion of the positive sample and the negative sample of the landslide is solved, and the generalization performance and the accuracy of the landslide susceptibility prediction model are remarkably improved.
assignees: WUHAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY ZHONGNAN GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOV

title_en: Drilling method for disaster rescue of coal mine and computer program product
abstract_en: The application provides a drilling method and a computer program product for coal mine disaster rescue, the method comprises the steps of constructing an initial disaster scene at least according to actual environment data and disaster elements of a coal mine, obtaining environment parameters of the coal mine, determining coal mine disaster complexity according to the environment parameters, representing the change condition of the environment parameters, correcting the initial disaster scene according to the environment parameters and the coal mine disaster complexity to obtain the coal mine disaster scene, determining a multi-agent collaborative algorithm based on a multi-agent system, performing multi-agent collaborative drilling on the coal mine disaster scene according to the collaborative algorithm, and evaluating drilling effects according to drilling data and collaborative performances in the drilling process. The application solves the problems of unsmooth communication and unsmooth cooperation among roles in the traditional exercise in the prior art.
assignees: CHN ENERGY WUHAI ENERGY CO LTD;GUONENG WUHAI ENERGY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method based on isolated forest optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide vulnerability evaluation method based on isolated forest optimization. The method comprises the steps of collecting environmental factors of landslide occurrence in a research area, combining historical landslide disaster points to construct an environmental factor evaluation system, constructing a landslide positive sample data set based on the historical landslide points and influence factors, inputting the landslide positive sample data set into an isolated Forest (iForest) model for training, extracting environmental attribute characteristics of the landslide disaster samples, pre-selecting non-landslide points in the research area and outside a landslide point buffer area, constructing a pre-selected non-landslide negative sample, adopting a trained isolated Forest model to preferably select the non-landslide negative sample, constructing a comprehensive sample data set by the optimal non-landslide negative sample and the landslide positive sample, respectively inputting the comprehensive sample data set into a Support Vector Machine (SVM) model and a Logistic Regression (LR) model for training, and verifying the effectiveness of the optimal non-landslide negative sample of the isolated Forest. According to the invention, the non-landslide negative sample is optimized through the isolated forest model, and the machine learning model is combined for training and prediction, so that the problem of low model prediction precision caused by randomly selecting the non-landslide negative sample in the traditional method is solved, and the accuracy of the landslide susceptibility evaluation result is remarkably improved.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH;NANNING GUIDIAN ELECTRONIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for evaluating disaster vulnerability of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for evaluating disaster vulnerability of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical disaster data of a target electric power facility area, constructing a first decision table according to the historical disaster data, clustering the first decision table to obtain a plurality of attribute clusters, synthesizing all attributes in the same attribute cluster into pseudo attributes, and constructing a second decision table according to all the pseudo attributes; the method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster index data reflecting disaster vulnerability of a target electric facility by reducing a second decision table through a rough set theory, inputting the index data into a vulnerability assessment model for training, inputting the disaster index data to be assessed into the trained vulnerability assessment model to obtain disaster damage data of the target electric facility, and generating a vulnerability label of the target electric facility according to the disaster damage data. The power system disaster vulnerability evaluation method provided by the embodiment of the invention realizes the technical effect of improving the power system disaster vulnerability evaluation efficiency.

title_en: Marine disaster-causing biological time sequence prediction method, product, medium and equipment for coastal nuclear power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine disaster-causing biological time sequence prediction method, a product, a medium and equipment of a coastal nuclear power station, and relates to the field of marine monitoring. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining individual size and abundance time sequence data of target disaster-causing organisms in a coastal nuclear power station cold source water taking target sea area and synchronous marine environment element time sequence data, screening marine environment influence element time sequence data influencing individual size and quantity proliferation of the target disaster-causing organisms, establishing an individual size and abundance time sequence prediction model by adopting a CRBM-DBN time sequence prediction algorithm, optimizing super-parameters of the time sequence prediction model by adopting a self-adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm, training the super-parameter optimized time sequence prediction model, accessing the trained time sequence prediction model into a marine disaster-causing organism monitoring and early warning system, predicting individual size and abundance of the target disaster-causing organisms in real time, predicting individual size and abundance of the disaster-causing organisms and variation trend of the disaster-causing organisms in future time period in advance in early disaster-causing organism development, and improving prediction accuracy.

title_en: Fine detection device and method for coal mine drilling multi-parameter stratum structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine drilling multi-parameter stratum structure fine detection device and a method, which relate to the technical field of mine physical exploration and comprise a device body, wherein the periphery of the device body is connected with a motion and well wall coupling device, an image video capture system and a high-frequency geological radar which are positioned at the front section, a multi-frequency excitation sound source which are positioned at the middle section and a vibration sound wave receiving transducer array which is positioned at the rear section are arranged in the device body, and a power supply line and a data transmission line are led out from the end part of the rear section of the device body. The device can fully utilize the existing drilling holes in the coal mine well and combine with a plurality of physical logging methods to accurately and comprehensively detect geological anomalies in the range of tens of meters of the roadway and the working face, and acquire the physical mechanical properties and the three-dimensional geological structure of the coal rock mass around the wall of the drilling hole. The multi-parameter geophysical characterization method adopted by the method can realize advanced detection of underground geological abnormal bodies of the coal mine and acquire fine characteristics of stratum structures, and has guiding significance for monitoring and early warning of various underground geological disasters.

title_en: Typhoon scene-based power disaster damage development trend prediction method
abstract_en: The application relates to a typhoon scene-based power disaster damage development trend prediction method, a typhoon scene-based power disaster damage development trend prediction device, a typhoon scene-based power disaster damage development trend prediction method, a typhoon scene-based power disaster damage development trend prediction device, a computer program product, can be used in the technical field of electric power. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical multi-source data, carrying out characteristic engineering processing on the historical multi-source data to obtain data characteristics of the historical multi-source data, training a power disaster damage development trend prediction model to be trained by utilizing the data characteristics of the historical multi-source data to obtain a trained power disaster damage development trend prediction model, carrying out model updating processing on the trained power disaster damage development trend prediction model to obtain a target power disaster damage development trend prediction model, and inputting the data characteristics of the current multi-source data into the target power disaster damage development trend prediction model to carry out power disaster damage development trend prediction to obtain a power disaster damage development trend prediction result of an object to be predicted. By adopting the method, the accuracy of the power disaster development trend prediction can be improved.

title_en: Distributed flood forecast scheduling model construction method and system based on sub-drainage basin
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing a distributed flood forecast scheduling model based on a sub-river basin, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing and calculating the sub-river basin based on an extracted basic river basin by combining the river basin characteristics of the river basin to be simulated and reservoir regulation action; combining the generated computational sub-drainage basin and river network water system, generating a space-time topological structure of the drainage basin to be simulated based on a converging path, acquiring a foundation data base plate and a water rain condition monitoring and sensing system of the drainage basin to be simulated, carrying out full-chain coupling design of a model on the basis, constructing a distributed flood forecast scheduling model of the drainage basin to be simulated, and forecasting a flood forecast scheduling process by adopting the constructed distributed flood forecast scheduling model. According to the invention, a river basin water rain condition monitoring and sensing system and a data base plate are fully utilized, so that a flood process and flood elements of a sub-river basin and an important section in the river basin range can be rapidly and accurately simulated, technical support is provided for scientifically and reasonably formulating a flood control emergency plan, and decision support is provided for flood control and disaster reduction work.

title_en: Fire simulation method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster simulation method, equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field. The method comprises the steps of constructing a cellular automaton model of a target cabin, dividing a cabin space of the target cabin into a plurality of areas in the cellular automaton model, updating first combustion amounts received by all areas according to simulated initial fire source positions, simulated flame parameters, fire basic attribute sets and rule updating sets, determining second combustion amounts of the areas according to fire development rule sets, field sets and the first combustion amounts corresponding to all the areas, determining damage degrees of equipment in the target cabin according to the second combustion amounts of the areas, carrying out fuzzy reasoning on all the areas according to the damage degrees of the equipment in the target cabin to update combustion states of all the areas, and repeatedly updating the first combustion amounts received by all the areas until a preset simulation ending condition is reached, and ending a fire simulation process.
assignees: SHANGHAI ZIGANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster coupling catastrophe damage dynamic analysis method, system, equipment and storage medium for electric power infrastructure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic analysis method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for multi-disaster coupled disaster damage of an electric power infrastructure, which comprise the steps of configuring nodes of an electric power network according to electric betweenness of the electric power infrastructure, acquiring a plurality of disaster-causing factor data affecting the electric power network according to node configuration information, creating corresponding electric power network disaster events under different arrangement and combination through simulation software, determining damage gradient grades of the target electric power network by acquiring and analyzing steady-state responses and transient responses of a pre-built target electric power network operation model under each electric power network disaster event, and determining disaster maintenance strategies executed by the target electric power network according to the damage gradient grades.

title_en: Deep rock burst environment simulation and monitoring method
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for simulating and monitoring a deep rock burst environment. The deep rock burst environment simulation and monitoring method comprises the steps of digging a first rock burst environment excitation chamber in a deep roadway, arranging monitoring equipment to obtain rock burst parameters, determining the specification and the size of a reconstructed rock burst research rock pillar, digging a rock burst environment excitation rock pillar on the other side to form a second rock burst environment excitation chamber, arranging the monitoring equipment in the second rock burst environment excitation chamber, and analyzing deep rock burst based on the collected rock burst data in the first rock burst environment excitation chamber and the second rock burst environment excitation chamber. According to the scheme provided by the application, a rock burst environment can be created artificially, the rock burst disaster which is hard to cut is controlled to be in a fixed place, rock burst data generated by nearby disturbance is recorded, a real rock burst simulation experiment is realized, and real rock burst evolution, generation and process control data and change rules are obtained.
assignees: YUNNAN CHIHONG ZINC & GERMANIUM CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological disaster early warning and identifying method, device and equipment for any point
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for early warning and identifying weather disasters at any point, relates to the technical field of weather prediction, and is used for solving the problem that in the prior art, early warning service is more focused on regional prediction, so that accuracy of early warning and identifying weather disasters is low. The method comprises the steps of obtaining observation analysis values of any point through a spatial interpolation algorithm based on multi-source live fusion grid point analysis data with high space-time resolution, obtaining single-point predictions of the any point through the spatial interpolation algorithm based on prediction data of each numerical mode, calculating deviation between the prediction data of each prediction time effect and the live observation data under each time of each single-point prediction based on the observation analysis values and the single-point predictions, correcting the predictions in the prediction period based on the average prediction errors in the test indexes and the target mode training period based on the prediction deviation data corresponding to each numerical mode on the prediction points obtained through deviation calculation, and carrying out weather disaster early warning identification of the any point.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGYING JIAYE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-process drilling method based on green investigation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of drilling, in particular to a multi-process drilling method based on green investigation, which comprises the following steps that S1, geology and environment investigation is carried out on a target area in detail by using a geographic information system, and investigation contents comprise soil types, groundwater level, topography characteristics, vegetation distribution and ecologically sensitive areas; S2, selecting drilling entry points and paths based on survey results of a geographic information system, effectively avoiding an ecologically sensitive area and a potential geological disaster area by detailed survey and optimized selection of the drilling entry points and paths of the geographic information system, remarkably reducing interference and damage of drilling activities to ecological environment, ensuring proper treatment of wastes by making a strict drilling waste management scheme, avoiding secondary pollution to the environment, and improving resource utilization efficiency and promoting development of circular economy by recycling wastes such as drilling mud, waste drill bits and the like.
assignees: NORTHWEST NONFERROUS SURVEY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Visible light and infrared imaging tunnel apparent disaster identification method carried by unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geologic body identification, and provides a visible light and infrared imaging tunnel apparent disaster identification method carried by an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the steps of acquiring image video information of a side wall of a target tunnel, classifying the acquired image video information, establishing a tunnel disaster interpretation database, and training a tunnel disaster identification deep neural network learning model; and identifying the type of the abnormal disaster based on the extracted characteristics, and dividing the severity of the disaster by using a support vector machine. The method can quickly identify the apparent disasters of the tunnel based on visible light and infrared imaging, and can accurately and quickly identify the apparent disasters of the tunnel.

title_en: Method for quantitatively evaluating disaster toughness of electric power facility under multi-factor coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative assessment method for disaster toughness of an electric power facility under the action of multi-factor coupling, which comprises the steps of obtaining characteristic data which influences the operation of the electric power facility of a target electric power network, wherein the characteristic data comprises natural factor data and human factor data, inputting the natural factor data into a characteristic factor coupling model to obtain first dimension index data of the target electric power network, constructing a corresponding electric power network simulation operation model based on topological structure data of the electric power facility, carrying out fusion processing on the first dimension index data and the human factor data, creating a plurality of disaster events based on the fused result, sequentially obtaining toughness indexes generated by the electric power network simulation operation model under each disaster event, and generating corresponding safety log information based on each toughness index. According to the method for quantitatively evaluating the disaster toughness of the electric power facility under the multi-factor coupling effect, provided by the invention, a unified quantitative evaluation platform is built on the basis of organic combination of different types of characteristic data, so that the quantitative evaluation of the disaster toughness of the electric power facility is realized.

title_en: Simulation device and method for physical test of debris flow river blockage-dam break
abstract_en: A simulation device and a method for physical tests of a debris flow river blocking-dam break comprise a control water tank, a test tank, a water collecting and dissipating tank, a water collecting tank, a circulating water tank and a data collecting system, wherein a gate is arranged at the lower end of the control water tank, a gate is assembled on the gate, a geological model is arranged in the test tank which is obliquely arranged, the higher end of the test tank is communicated with the gate, the lower end of the test tank is communicated with one end of the water collecting and dissipating tank, the other end of the water collecting and dissipating tank is communicated with the water collecting tank, the bottom of the water collecting tank is communicated with the circulating water tank through a circulating water pipe, a water pump is arranged in the circulating water tank, the water pump is communicated with the control water tank through a water inlet pipe, and the data collecting system is used for collecting test data. The invention is used for researching the stability analysis of the debris flow blocking river and the characteristic problem of dam break, and the scale test carried out by the physical test simulation device can more comprehensively and systematically solve the defects of the current research, and perfect theoretical research and apply the theoretical research to the actual disaster prevention and reduction engineering.

title_en: Method capable of realizing time dynamic monitoring of mine fault activation degree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method capable of dynamically monitoring the fault activation degree of a mine in time, and relates to the technical field of mining disaster monitoring. The method comprises the steps of taking a fault surface of a fault as a central axis surface, installing an abnormal device in an upper disc of the fault, installing a monitoring drill bit in a lower disc, forming an electric field on a monitoring range by applying current to the monitoring drill bit, converting an electric field signal collected by the electric field into a digital signal, analyzing resistivity and polarizability data in the digital signal to form a visual image, judging the time activation degree of the fault according to the time change trend of the image, and forming time dynamic monitoring on the fault activation degree. Compared with single parameter monitoring, the method is more accurate, the visual image is more convincing, the prediction accuracy is further improved, and technical support is provided for mine roadway tunneling and working face stoping.

title_en: Automatic mapping method for domain network topology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic mapping method of a domain network topology, which particularly relates to the technical field of power grid topological graphs, and comprises the steps of obtaining a first important value of each power grid device contained in a target power grid area, and a corresponding coverage coefficient, a fault coefficient and a disaster affected coefficient, finally obtaining a second important value, carrying out preliminary screening on each power grid device according to the second important value to obtain preliminary power grid devices, drawing the power grid domain topological graph according to the preliminary power grid devices to serve as the first topological graph, simulating the first topological graph, screening nodes in the first topological graph according to a simulation result to obtain final important nodes, generating the power grid domain topological graph according to the final important nodes to serve as the final power grid domain topological graph, and simplifying the nodes reasonably, so that the power grid domain topological graph can reflect the actual state of a power grid more accurately, a dispatcher and an operator can understand and use the power grid rapidly, and accuracy of a dispatching decision is ensured.

title_en: Method and application for constructing dynamic risk agent model of urban storm waterlogging disaster
abstract_en: The method and application for constructing the dynamic risk agent model of the urban storm waterlogging disaster comprise the following steps of S1, respectively obtaining modeling data of a hydrologic hydrodynamic coupling model and an agent model, S2, based on the obtained modeling data of the hydrologic hydrodynamic coupling model, carrying out simulation output on the inundation data comprising inundation depth, inundation area and inundation time by constructing the hydrologic hydrodynamic coupling model, S3, based on the obtained modeling data of the agent model, setting a disaster-causing environment agent, a disaster-causing factor agent and a disaster-bearing agent by combining the inundation data, and setting interaction rules among the disaster-causing environment agent, the disaster-causing factor agent and the disaster-bearing agent to construct the agent model. The intelligent model comprehensively considers various factors such as topography, buildings, roads, rainfall and the like, and can comprehensively simulate the urban rainstorm waterlogging process. Accurate submerged data are obtained by constructing a hydrologic hydrodynamic coupling model, and efficient assessment of urban waterlogging risk is achieved.

title_en: Consciousness disturbance disease course monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a consciousness disturbance disease course monitoring system. The system comprises a multi-dimensional data acquisition module, an adaptive disease course prediction model, a continuous disease course monitoring module, a machine learning algorithm and an emergency response mechanism, wherein the multi-dimensional data acquisition module is used for acquiring EEG, heart rate variability HRV and skin conductance EDA physiological signal data of a patient in real time through a plurality of sensors arranged on the body of the patient, preprocessing the acquired data through edge computing equipment, the adaptive disease course prediction model is based on the physiological signal data acquired by the multi-dimensional data acquisition module and combines with the historical disease course data of the patient, the adaptive algorithm is used for training the personalized disease course prediction model, the model parameters are adaptively updated through the machine learning algorithm in the disease course development process of the patient, the dynamic prediction of the progress of the consciousness disturbance disease course is realized, the continuous disease course monitoring module continuously acquires physiological signals of the patient through a high-frequency sampling technology, and identifies key events in the disease course through an abnormal detection algorithm in real time, wherein the consciousness suddenly drops and epileptic attacks are generated, and an emergency response mechanism is triggered.

title_en: Car of fireman's elevator
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire rescue training equipment, and particularly relates to an inner car of a firefighter elevator, which comprises an elevator shaft and a training cat ladder, wherein the training cat ladder is arranged on the inner wall of the elevator shaft, a guide rail is arranged on the inner wall of the elevator shaft, a lifting frame is movably arranged in the inner cavity of the elevator shaft, high-permeability toughened glass is arranged on the upper surface of the lifting frame, empty-avoiding grooves are formed in the positions, corresponding to the installation positions of the training cat ladder, of the surfaces of the high-permeability toughened glass and the lifting frame in a penetrating manner.

title_en: Geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control, which relates to the technical field of geological investigation and comprises a base, a shell arranged at the top of the base and an impact assembly, wherein the impact assembly is arranged in the shell and comprises a lifting plate arranged in the middle of the inner side of the shell, a drill rod arranged at the bottom of the lifting plate and a cleaning unit arranged on the outer side of the drill rod, the cleaning unit comprises a fixing plate arranged in the shell, a cleaning plate arranged between the fixing plate and the drill rod and a compensation part arranged at the side part of the cleaning plate, and a spraying part is arranged at the top of the cleaning plate. The utility model relates to a geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control, which is characterized in that the surface of a drill rod is fully cleaned through an impact assembly, so that different types of soil can be sampled for multiple times later, and the influence of contact pollution among the soil on subsequent detection is avoided.
assignees: NUCLEAR INDUSTRY LIUZHOU ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE

title_en: BP neural network-based hierarchical progressive meteorological element data reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a layered progressive meteorological element data reconstruction method based on a BP neural network, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting meteorological element data of a research area and surrounding meteorological stations, S2, dividing the meteorological stations into verification meteorological stations and training meteorological stations based on geographic position information of the research area and the surrounding meteorological stations, S3, determining observation data of corresponding characteristic parameters and target variables in the training meteorological stations according to a data reconstruction target, constructing and optimizing a corresponding target model based on the BP neural network according to the observation data, and S4, calling the optimized target model with optimal model parameters according to the data reconstruction target to reconstruct the meshed meteorological element data. The high-quality multi-element meteorological data reconstruction method provided by the invention provides a precious technical scheme for research and practice in a plurality of research fields such as hydrologic cycle, climate change, drought and waterlogging disasters and the like.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Method, device and related equipment for predicting flooding information of water network
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and related equipment for predicting flooding information of a water network, and relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a data sequence to be processed of a target water network in a current flood period, wherein the data sequence to be processed comprises a plurality of data pairs which are arranged in time sequence, each data pair comprises data indicating accumulated rainfall and data indicating the flooding amount, the data indicating the flooding amount is obtained based on DEM data and video data analysis, carrying out data analysis on the plurality of data pairs to obtain a target mapping relation for simulating a mapping relation between the accumulated rainfall of flood and the flooding amount of the target water network, and predicting target flooding information according to the target mapping relation and the accumulated rainfall of flood at a target moment, wherein the target flooding information comprises target water amount data indicating the flooding amount of the target water network at the target moment. The scheme of the application can obtain more accurate water network inundation information.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Mine flat plate double-open type full-automatic disaster blocking and preventing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mine safety protection, and discloses a mine flat plate double-open type full-automatic disaster blocking and preventing method, which comprises the following specific steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly, planning and installing a flat plate double-open type blocking and preventing device in advance in a critical channel of a mine and a disaster-prone area, wherein the flat plate double-open type blocking and preventing device is composed of two flat plates made of metal materials, special materials for fire prevention, heat insulation and compression resistance are filled in each flat plate, and after the installation is completed, the flat plates are driven by adopting an opening and closing mechanism of the flat plates to perform multiple simulation opening and closing tests, so that the device can normally operate. Through optimizing intelligent monitoring and early warning system, distribute the sensor in each key region of mine to gather environmental data in real time, adopt central control unit to carry out data analysis and establish the model and contrast, can make corresponding operation in the moment that surpasses the threshold value, dull and stereotyped double open type blocking and preventing device is closed immediately when danger has not arrived, avoids in the mine because the situation that water pressure flat board is blocked can't close when gushing water.
assignees: WALNUT COAL MINE HUANENG QINGYANG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD;HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;GENERAL PROSPECTING INSTITUTE CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Crowd evacuation macroscopic simulation method and device considering reduction of personnel passing rate at crowded place
abstract_en: A crowd evacuation macroscopic simulation method and device considering the reduction of the crowd passing rate at a crowded place relates to the field of crowd evacuation simulation in a building, and solves the problems of judging crowd occurrence positions and quantitatively calculating the reduction of the crowd passing rate at the crowded positions in the evacuation simulation process. The invention provides a macroscopic simulation method which comprises the steps of obtaining a building plan of a case to be analyzed, converting space information of an evacuation scene into an evacuation path geometric network model in a building, inputting data of the evacuation path geometric network model in the building into a calculation program module of an improved macroscopic simulation method, namely, carrying out evacuation process simulation analysis on the case to be analyzed, and calculating a reduction of personnel passing rate at a crowded position to obtain evacuation process simulation results. But also in global evacuation situations of a substantial amount of people evacuation scenarios.

title_en: River basin disaster prevention and control system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent prevention and control of watershed, in particular to a watershed disaster prevention and control system based on big data, which comprises a data monitoring and acquisition subsystem, a data analysis and management subsystem, an intelligent scheduling and optimization allocation subsystem and a remote monitoring and simulation subsystem; the intelligent dispatching and optimizing allocation subsystem is used for dispatching and optimizing the drainage basin based on the digital analysis result and the hydrologic-hydrodynamic model and the simulation system, the remote monitoring and simulation subsystem is used for receiving output information of each subsystem and realizing scene simulation and remote monitoring of the drainage basin according to the output information.
assignees: POWERCHINA ECOLOGICAL ENV GROUP CO LTD;SHENZHEN HUAHAO MIAOSHUI ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Self-encoder-based bill intelligent evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bill intelligent evaluation method and system based on a self-encoder, belongs to the technical field of bill data processing, and aims to solve the technical problems that in the existing bill intelligent evaluation method, the extraction technology of bill evaluation vector information cannot cope with explosive type increased bill data, the feature extraction precision is limited, and the intelligent evaluation of the bill is not facilitated. The method comprises the steps of collecting bill evaluation data in a financial sharing center system, preprocessing the bill evaluation data to obtain a bill evaluation data set, conducting structural optimization on a self-encoder to obtain a novel self-encoder, conducting feature extraction on the bill evaluation data set through the novel self-encoder to obtain evaluation data feature information, training a classification model through the evaluation data feature information, and conducting classification recognition on target bill evaluation data through the novel self-encoder and the trained classification model to generate a bill evaluation report. The defects of the traditional feature extraction technology in terms of dimension disaster and data identification scale accuracy are overcome.

title_en: Cloud computing supported fire investigation and survey system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire investigation, in particular to a cloud computing supported fire investigation and survey system which comprises a data receiving and preliminary analysis module, a dynamic fire mapping module, a fire spread prediction module and a loss evaluation and reason analysis module. According to the invention, the environment data and the GIS are integrated, so that accurate real-time updating capability is provided for fire investigation, a dynamic fire map can reflect the position and the spreading condition of a fire source in real time, emergency response is ensured to be executed based on the latest and most accurate data, different fire spreading scenes can be predicted through deep analysis and simulation of wind speed, topography and vegetation type data, a high-risk area is clearly identified, pertinence of preventive measures is improved, allocation and use of resources are optimized, direct and indirect losses caused by fire are comprehensively evaluated through economic analysis, fire reasons are clearly determined, and the efficiency and effectiveness of fire management are greatly enhanced.
assignees: WUXI POWEIER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coordinate transformation method and system for multi-terminal emergency drilling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coordinate transformation method and a coordinate transformation system for a multi-terminal emergency drilling system, which relate to the technical field of engine coordinates and comprise the steps of obtaining point location data of a plurality of application terminals, wherein the point location data comprise dotting data, plotting data and positioning data, performing coordinate transformation on the point location data, wherein the coordinate transformation comprises the steps of configuring an origin and a coordinate system attribute, transforming a GIS engine WGS84 coordinate system into a game engine relative coordinate system, and transforming the game engine relative coordinate system into a GIS engine WGS84 coordinate system. According to the invention, by integrating the multi-terminal emergency drilling system and the coordinate transformation method, users can perform collaborative drilling on different platforms in real time, and the seamless cooperativity can strengthen team communication and emergency response efficiency.
assignees: WEIAN ZONGHENG DALIAN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for providing emergency evacuation guidance service for disaster vulnerabel population based on speech recognition
title_ko: 피난약자를 위한 음성인식 기반 피난유도 서비스 제공 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a voice recognition-based evacuation guidance service providing system for vulnerable evacuees. The evacuation guidance service providing system comprises: a disaster detection device configured to detect at least one disaster and output a disaster detection event; a user terminal configured to be woken up in response to the disaster detection event of the disaster detection device, extract an evacuation route based on the current location, provide guidance along the extracted evacuation route, recognize voice utterances through voice recognition, and provide guidance according to the evacuation route; at least one beacon installed on at least one node for tracking the location of the user terminal and transmitting location information corresponding to the at least one node; and an evacuation guidance service providing server comprising a database formation unit, a transmission unit, an evacuation route providing unit, a route guidance unit, a voice recognition unit, and a deviation prevention unit.
abstract_ko: 피난약자를 위한 음성인식 기반 피난유도 서비스 제공 시스템이 제공되며, 재난감지장치의 재난감지 이벤트에 따라 웨이크업(Wakeup)되고, 현위치를 기반으로 피난경로를 추출하며, 추출된 피난경로에 따라 피난경로를 안내하고, 음성발화를 음성인식으로 인식한 후 피난경로에 따른 안내를 실시하는 사용자 단말, 사용자 단말의 위치추적을 위해 적어도 하나의 노드(Node)에 설치되고, 적어도 하나의 노드에 대응하는 위치정보를 전송하는 적어도 하나의 비콘 및 적어도 하나의 건물에 재난상황이 발생했을 시 적어도 하나의 재난 시나리오에 따른 적어도 하나의 피난경로를 저장하는 데이터베이스화부, 재난감지장치로부터 재난감지 이벤트가 발생하는 경우 사용자 단말로 전달하는 전달부, 사용자 단말에서 재난감지 이벤트를 수신하여 웨이크업된 경우, 사용자 단말의 현위치를 기반으로 피난경로를 추출하고, 추출된 피난경로를 사용자 단말로 전송하는 피난경로제공부, 사용자 단말에서 피난경로를 기반으로 경로를 안내할 때 적어도 하나의 비콘을 통하여 사용자 단말의 위치를 추적하면서 경로를 안내하도록 하는 경로안내부, 사용자 단말에서 음성발화가 입력된 경우, 사용자 단말의 음성발화를 음성인식으로 인식한 후 음성발화에 대응하는 텍스트에 대응하는 응답을 사용자 단말로 전송하는 음성인식부를 포함하는 피난유도 서비스 제공 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating flood prevention capability of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating flood prevention capability of a transformer substation, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out numerical generalization on buildings in an evaluation range of the transformer substation to be evaluated in topographic file data, selecting corresponding flood depth standards based on voltage levels of the transformer substation to be evaluated, calculating corresponding rainfall sequences based on the flood depth standards, establishing digital watershed based on the topographic file data, carrying out hydrologic simulation based on the digital watershed and the rainfall sequences to obtain hydrologic parameters, and evaluating the flood prevention capability of the transformer substation to be evaluated based on the hydrologic parameters. According to the invention, scientific basis is provided for flood prevention planning and emergency response of the transformer substation through fine processing of the transformer substation topography and flood inundation prediction.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Engineering digital management platform based on BIM model and management method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM model-based engineering digital management platform and a management method thereof, relating to the technical field of engineering project management, comprising the following steps of constructing a BIM model of an engineering project and importing project-related documents; the method comprises the steps of constructing an intelligent archive management strategy, carrying out semantic analysis on imported project documents, automatically extracting key information, binding the information with related components in a BIM model, constructing an immersive construction scene by using virtual reality VR and augmented reality AR technology, continuously carrying out semantic analysis on new documents and automatically updating related information in the BIM model, and automatically generating a corresponding emergency response scheme according to design specifications and document information in the BIM model once potential disaster risks are detected. According to the invention, through semantic analysis and natural language processing technology, the key information of the document is automatically extracted and intelligently bound with the BIM model, so that the automation and the accuracy of information management are realized.

title_en: Landslide disaster-bearing body identification method integrating unmanned aerial vehicle DOM and residual Unet transfer learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide disaster-bearing body recognition method integrating a DOM (document object model) and a residual Unet transfer learning algorithm, which comprises the steps of obtaining landslide data, controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle to fly in a simulated manner according to the landslide data to acquire image data, processing the image data to obtain a landslide orthophoto image, inputting the processed landslide orthophoto image into a Res-Unet model to obtain a disaster-bearing body recognition result, wherein the Res-Unet model is obtained by taking a pretrained ResNet-34 network as a backbone network to replace an encoder structure of the Unet model and utilizing a training set to update parameters through training iteration, and taking the ResNet-34 network as the backbone network to carry out cross-layer transfer on training samples in the training set and adding the results of convolution in the training set training process so as to consider the Res-Unet model with more characteristics. The invention can realize faster and more accurate target area monitoring and data acquisition, and is suitable for application scenes with high requirements on high precision and real-time performance.

title_en: Fire simulation test method and system for electric bicycle
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire simulation test method and a fire simulation test system for an electric bicycle. The method comprises the steps of heating a battery of a vehicle in a state of powering on the vehicle, collecting video information of the whole test process, continuously collecting voltage, temperature value and temperature rise rate of a single battery triggered in the battery and smoke information in a battery compartment in the whole test process, stopping heating when thermal runaway occurs in the battery, recording time and battery temperature at the moment, identifying the moment when smoke occurs according to the video information and the smoke information in the battery compartment, identifying the moment when open flame occurs according to the video information, and calculating time difference between the moment when smoke occurs and the thermal runaway and time difference between the moment when flame occurs and the thermal runaway. The invention can provide data support and technical support for developing a charging scene fire disaster identification system, and also lays a foundation for the later-stage electric bicycle fire disaster tracing and emergency fire extinguishing scheme research.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS GROUP TESTING VEHICLE TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Flood insurance loss risk assessment method and device based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood insurance loss risk assessment method and device based on data driving, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a disaster database, wherein the disaster database comprises a plurality of key features influencing flood risks; the method comprises the steps of screening key features affecting flood risk, constructing a multi-dimensional feature data set, constructing a plurality of assessment models, training through the multi-dimensional feature data set, performing performance assessment and interpretation analysis, obtaining assessment results, selecting a final assessment model, and performing flood loss risk assessment. By the method provided by the invention, incomplete or unstructured data is effectively processed by the model algorithm, the flexibility and adaptability of assessment are improved, the trust of a decision maker on a prediction result is increased by the interpretability analysis of the model, the effectiveness of the model in practical application is promoted, the generalization capability and the prediction accuracy of the model are improved, and the flood risk is more scientifically and accurately assessed and managed.

title_en: Small-scale indoor debris flow simulation experiment equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses small-scale indoor debris flow simulation experiment equipment and a small-scale indoor debris flow simulation experiment method, which comprise a bearing table, wherein a separation assembly is arranged on the top wall of the bearing table, and a filtering assembly is arranged at the bottom of the bearing table and below the separation assembly; according to the small-scale indoor debris flow simulation experiment equipment and the small-scale indoor debris flow simulation experiment method, the angle of the simulation board is adjusted to simulate the mountain slope angle in the natural environment, vegetation planted on the mountain slope in the natural environment is blocked, the driving motor drives the adjusting screw rod to rotate, so that the erosion of various mountain slopes, the soil fixing property of vegetation and trees and the erosion of the sand-stone-mud water mixture flushed from the mountain top to the middle of the mountain slope can be simulated in the natural environment in the debris flow simulation experiment, and a theoretical basis can be made for subsequent natural disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Test device and method for simulating side water flow scouring slope protection circulating water tank
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a test device and a test method for simulating side water flow scouring slope protection circulating water tanks, which aim to solve the problem that different slope protection scouring cannot be simultaneously simulated and erosion sediment particles can be effectively collected in the prior art; the technical scheme includes that the device comprises a circulating water tank, a multi-stage flow guide tank, a gravel flushing tank with adjustable gradient, a plant maintenance tank, a sediment collecting area, a high-speed shooting device and the like, the accurate control of water flow state and slope protection gradient is realized by adjusting the gradient of the multi-stage flow guide tank and the gradient of the gravel flushing tank, the sediment collecting area adopts a multi-stage filter screen and water baffle technology to effectively collect and analyze erosion sediment, the erosion process of the gravel slope protection and the ecological slope protection can be simulated, erosion resistance of the slope protection can be accurately reflected, theoretical and technical support is provided for ecological bank protection engineering design and disaster prevention and disaster reduction, and the device is simple and convenient to operate, accurate in data collection and high in test efficiency, and can meet various demands in scientific research and engineering practice.

title_en: Power distribution network pole tower fault prediction method oriented to extreme weather disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network pole and tower fault prediction method for extreme weather disasters, which comprises the following steps of constructing a comprehensive database comprising a weather database, a power grid database and a geographic database, respectively collecting weather data, power grid data and geographic data, preprocessing the data and respectively storing the data in corresponding databases, constructing a pole and tower fault prediction model based on a CNN-LSTM hybrid model, training the pole and tower fault prediction model through the data in the comprehensive database to obtain a pole and tower fault prediction model after training, and carrying out pole and tower fault prediction through the pole and tower fault prediction model after training.
assignees: XIAMEN EPGIS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID SIJI POSITION SERVICE CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent predictive battery replacement to increase disaster recovery stability
abstract_en: An intelligent predictive battery replacement system to increase disaster recovery stability uses training samples created using battery report indexes and vault condition recovery reports to train a linear regression model learning process to learn a recursion between battery post recovery charge and a set of time series battery operational parameters. Once trained, the learning process is used in a predictive manner to predict the post recovery charge state of batteries deployed in storage controllers, to provide a predictive per-battery risk assessment. The per-battery risk assessment identify batteries that may be scheduled to be replaced to increase disaster recovery stability of the storage systems. The risk assessment is also configured, in some embodiments, to identify environmental characteristics and/or battery use characteristics that are primary reasons for battery replacement recommendations, to enable corrective action to be taken to extend the life of other batteries deployed in the storage system or data center.

title_en: Method for determining weather indexes of tea tree caused by freeze injury
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining weather indexes caused by the damage of tea tree spring frost, which relates to the technical field of early warning and evaluation of agricultural weather disasters, and comprises the following steps of collecting real-time weather data of the occurrence of tea tree spring frost in the past year, and analyzing weather conditions of the process of the disaster caused by the tea tree spring frost from the stress intensity and duration; according to the analysis result, a manual control test scheme is designed, and manual control tests of tea trees under different stress intensities and durations are developed. According to the invention, the real-time meteorological conditions of the spring frost damage of the tea tree in the past year are analyzed through the system, and the physiological and biochemical response characteristics of the spring frost damage of the tea tree under different stress intensities and durations are simulated by combining with the manual control test, so that the determination of the disaster-causing index has high accuracy, the real response of the tea tree under different frost conditions can be accurately reflected, and the grade of the spring frost damage of the tea tree can be accurately divided by calculating the phenol-ammonia ratio through quantitative analysis.

title_en: Hydraulic lifting test device and test method for simulating landslide erosion carrying effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic lifting test device and a test method for simulating landslide erosion carrying action, comprising an upstream river and a downstream river, wherein the upstream landslide of the upstream river is provided with a landslide release device, the downstream boundary of the upstream river is provided with an upstream dam, the inside of upstream river course contains water, and sets up upstream siltation layer at the submarine, and the downstream boundary department of upstream river course adjoins downstream river course, and the inside of downstream river course does not contain water, and sets up downstream siltation layer in the river course bottom, sets up data acquisition device on upstream river course, downstream river course and the upstream dam body. The method has the beneficial effects that the form and the volume of the landslide carried by the upstream river erosion can be determined through experiments, the condition of the landslide overtopping and the erosion effect on the downstream river can be determined, and the study of the landslide erosion and the carried volume is not only beneficial to improving the efficiency and the effect of disaster risk management, but also has important significance in protecting the ecological environment, reasonably utilizing resources and scientifically researching.

title_en: Uneven displacement test device suitable for transmission tower
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of simulating geological disasters and discloses an uneven displacement test device suitable for a transmission tower, which comprises a main body mechanism, wherein the main body mechanism comprises a bottom plate, a fixing frame fixedly connected to the outer side of the bottom plate, and a model part adaptively installed on the outer side of the fixing frame, the displacement mechanism comprises a weighing plate fixedly connected to the outer side of the bottom plate, a sliding part adaptively installed on the outer side of the weighing plate, and a supporting part adaptively installed on the outer side of the sliding part, and through the mutual matching of the parts, the height calibration of three displacement mechanisms in the vertical direction can be easily completed only by starting a motor to a supporting plate without lifting any more when the transmission tower model is installed, and after the installation is completed, a limiting arm is returned to a vertical groove again through tightening a bolt, so that the operation is convenient, a worker can be reminded of finishing the screwing of the bolt all the time, thereby eliminating potential safety hazards and ensuring the accuracy of experimental data.

title_en: Ocean digital twin platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean data application, in particular to an ocean digital twin platform which comprises a basic environment layer, a data layer, a platform layer and an application layer, wherein the data layer performs data interaction with an ocean data base, performs data processing on ocean data base data, acquires digital twin simulation ocean information by using an artificial intelligent model and processed ocean data base data, and displays the digital twin simulation ocean information by using the application layer. The invention realizes unified management and efficient processing of ocean data through integration with the ocean data base, breaks the island of the data and improves the utilization efficiency and accuracy of the data. The artificial intelligent model is utilized to carry out deep analysis and excavation on the processed ocean data, so that more accurate and comprehensive digital twin simulation ocean information can be obtained, and important decision support is provided for aspects such as ocean resource management, environment monitoring and disaster early warning.
assignees: SOUTHERN MARINE SCIENCE AND ENG GUANGDONG LABORATORY ZHUHAI

title_en: Optimal maintenance position determining method and device for power grid fault prediction
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for determining an optimal overhaul position of power grid fault prediction, belongs to the technical field of data preprocessing and recognition, and solves the problem of how to determine the optimal overhaul position of a power grid after the power grid fault under natural disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical fault data and related influence factor data, performing interpolation processing through an countermeasure network, selecting a plurality of key influence factors, judging the association degree between a power grid fault and each key influence factor by adopting an improved inverse entropy-gray association analysis method to select part of the key influence factors as influence indexes, constructing and training a neural network to obtain a prediction model, taking geological disaster probability and the influence indexes as input parameters of the prediction model and constructing a geological disaster early warning model to obtain geological disaster probability, constructing an optimal overhaul position optimization model based on the predicted power grid fault, and combining an objective function and constraint conditions to obtain an optimal overhaul position. And accurately predicting the overhaul requirement by using the geological disaster probability and key influence indexes.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Natural disaster intelligent early warning system based on image processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster early warning, in particular to an image processing-based natural disaster intelligent early warning system which comprises a multi-mode sensor data acquisition module, an image and data preprocessing module, a deep learning and countermeasure generation network identification module, a virtual reality disaster situation simulation module, a disaster prediction and trend analysis module, an alarm and notification module, a decision support and emergency response module, a data storage, management and feedback optimization module, wherein the multi-mode sensor data acquisition module is used for acquiring and fusing various sensor data, and the image and data preprocessing module is used for processing multi-source data and aligning and fusing the multi-mode data. Through fusion of the multi-mode sensors and a deep learning algorithm, the system improves the recognition capability in a complex environment, can keep high-precision disaster monitoring under severe conditions, reduces false alarm and missing report, and remarkably improves the reliability of the early warning system.

title_en: High-resolution rain analysis generation method based on multi-source mode fusion deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution rain condition analysis generation method based on multi-source mode fusion deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-physical quantity data set based on a multi-source data set related to rain conditions, and establishing a dimensionless multi-mode characteristic factor library; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multidimensional unequal weight processing on a loss function, constructing a multi-scale space conversion model MF-ST-Unet, finally generating an hour-by-hour region high-resolution rain analysis data set after model training, and obtaining the high-resolution rain analysis data set applied to a whole coverage region through migration learning knowledge distillation based on a trained MF-ST-Unet model. The method can quickly and effectively generate uniform grid rain analysis with high spatial resolution, is more objective and accurate than the traditional method, fully considers the multi-scale characteristics of the rain and the difference of precipitation levels, realizes high-resolution objective rain data acquisition, improves the rain detection capability and disaster prevention accuracy, and has extremely high application value.
assignees: UNIV NANJING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH;NANJING METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Transmission tower structure displacement loading test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of simulating geological disasters and discloses a transmission tower structure displacement loading test device which comprises a main body mechanism, wherein the main body mechanism comprises a bottom plate, a fixed seat fixedly connected to the top end of the bottom plate, a transmission tower model fixedly connected to the top end of the fixed seat, a lifting component which is adaptively arranged at the top end of the bottom plate, and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein the auxiliary mechanism comprises a fixed component which is adaptively arranged at the outer side of the lifting component, a power component which is adaptively arranged in the fixed component, and a sliding component which is adaptively arranged at the outer side of the power component.

title_en: Adjacent precipitation prediction method based on radar extrapolation and Z-R relationship of evolutionary network and Unet network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar extrapolation and Z-R relation approach precipitation forecasting method based on an evolution network and a Unet network, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical live rainfall data of whole-point time intervals and constructing a radar echo sample data set, constructing a radar echo short-time approach extrapolation forecasting model comprising an evolution network module and a Unet variant module, constructing a model training loss function, combining the radar echo sample data set to train the radar echo short-time approach extrapolation forecasting model, obtaining radar jigsaw echoes one hour before the forecasting time, inputting the radar jigsaw echoes into the trained model to obtain forecasting radar echoes, and obtaining a precipitation grid point forecasting field based on Z-R relation and the forecasting radar echoes. The invention improves the forecasting precision of the nearby strong rainfall by designing the evolution network module and Unet variant module and aiming at the loss function of the generator and the discriminator, has good application prospect and provides more accurate forecasting service for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Full-bridge modular multi-level converter Thevenin equivalent modeling method containing energy release branch
