abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power simulation, and discloses a full-bridge modular multi-level converter Thevenin equivalent modeling method containing an energy release branch. The invention respectively carries out trapezoidal integral discretization on the capacitance in the sub-module, carries out binary resistance on a switch group formed by an IGBT power tube and an anti-parallel diode, further establishes an accompanying circuit only containing a resistor and a voltage source, carries out Thevenin equivalent on the accompanying circuit to obtain a Thevenin equivalent model of the sub-module, algebraically superimposes N sub-module equivalent models of one bridge arm, and finally obtains the Thevenin equivalent circuit of the whole bridge arm. The method is innovative in that the method can greatly reduce the number of nodes and improve the simulation efficiency aiming at the problem of dimension disaster existing in the simulation of hundreds of level modularized multi-level converters, and the internal information is not lost, so that the simulation precision is high.

title_en: Deep rock mass excavation water bursting disaster testing arrangement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep rock excavation water bursting disaster testing device which comprises a test box body, wherein a pressurizing device is arranged on the upper side of the test box body, a simulated surrounding rock is arranged in the test box body, an excavation channel is arranged at the lower part of the simulated surrounding rock, a rigid protection pipe is arranged in the simulated surrounding rock, through grooves are formed in the inner cambered surface of the rigid protection pipe at intervals, a testing water pipe is arranged in the rigid protection pipe, at least two partition boards are buried in the simulated surrounding rock, and a crushing device is arranged between the two partition boards. According to the invention, simulated surrounding rock is filled in the test box body, the excavation channel is arranged, the partition plate is arranged at the corresponding position of the excavation channel, the test area is defined, the water burst test can be carried out in different areas, after the test is finished, the simulated surrounding rock at the water burst position is crushed and removed, then the filling is carried out in a refilling way, the test scene can be quickly restored, the retest after the test parameters are changed is facilitated, and the test efficiency is improved.

title_en: Power distribution network collaborative recovery method and system considering interconnection micro-network and network reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative recovery method and a collaborative recovery system for a power distribution network taking account of interconnection micro-grid and network reconstruction, belonging to the technical field of electrical engineering, wherein the method comprises the steps of simulating and guiding an EV (electric vehicle) running on a traffic network to enter a nearby charging station for refuge in a pre-disaster stage and participating in vehicle grid-connected reverse power transmission in a post-disaster stage; and in the post-disaster stage, according to the perceived line fault condition, EV information obtained through simulation and distributed resource information, optimizing to obtain a mixed integer second order cone model comprising the dispatching position of the rush repair team, the output condition of the distributed resource, the power supply range of each micro-grid and the interconnection state, carrying out post-disaster load quick recovery and line repair, and adopting a commercial solver CPLEX to solve the established mixed integer second order cone model to obtain the dynamic micro-grid regional division and interconnection state, the line switching state and the output condition of each distributed resource at different moments in the fault recovery period.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent security system for stadium based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a stadium intelligent security system based on a digital twin technology, which aims to improve the intelligent level and response speed of stadium security monitoring. The system collects audience behavior data through a data acquisition unit and creates a virtual model of the venue using a digital twin mapping unit. The personalized security early warning module analyzes the audience behaviors and predicts the potential risks. The emergency evacuation simulation and optimization module improves evacuation efficiency and safety. The environmental factor analysis module evaluates the influence of the environment on security performance. The special event response policy module simulates and optimizes the emergency response. The system also comprises modules such as regulation compliance analysis, intelligent inspection assistance, self-adaptive learning and the like, so that the operation compliance is ensured and is continuously optimized according to real-time data. The system realizes comprehensive monitoring, early warning, analysis and optimization of the security conditions of the stadium, and effectively improves the security management capability of the stadium.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on AI vision
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on AI vision, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and comprises the steps of obtaining pictures of geological disasters, including daytime pictures and night pictures; the method comprises the steps of marking pictures to form a geological disaster picture data set, training an AI model through the picture data set to obtain a trained AI model, placing the trained AI model into an edge computer for light weight treatment, importing the shot pictures into the AI model in the edge computer to identify geological disaster characteristics, using a front picture rolling comparison algorithm and a rear picture rolling comparison algorithm to identify the geological disaster characteristics, mutually verifying two results, judging that geological disasters or geological disaster precursors occur through the mutual verification of the two results, and giving out early warning. The invention realizes accurate monitoring and early warning of geological disasters and improves the timeliness and effectiveness of disaster coping.

title_en: Icing monitoring system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of icing monitoring, in particular to an icing monitoring system and method based on artificial intelligence, the system comprises a monitoring and positioning module, an information acquisition module, a data analysis module, a fusion simulation unit, a monitoring terminal and a background management module. According to the invention, the data model is formed to analyze and simulate through collecting the relevant data of the region where the power transmission line is located and through collecting the line capacitance value under each condition, the environment temperature and humidity and the snow fall which possibly occur under each condition and the final ice coating thickness are simulated, and the digital information of the ice thickness and the ice coating accurate monitoring of the power transmission line is formed by acquiring the change of the ice coating thickness of the region where the power transmission line is located in the past and the rule of the environment temperature and humidity and the wind speed, so that the problems of low online ice coating monitoring accuracy and poor reliability in the prior art are effectively solved, and the digital intelligent monitoring level of the ice disaster defense of the power grid is improved.
assignees: BENXI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fire disaster early warning device and fire extinguishing system for electrical power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: A fire early warning device and fire extinguishing system for electrical power distribution cabinet belongs to the alarm technical field. The fire disaster early warning device comprises a fire disaster recognition model which is trained through a Bayesian network, wherein the training process comprises the following steps of deducing the distribution of hidden variables Z through the parameters of the current time of the Bayesian network and the data vector of an ith training set, calculating the expectation of log likelihood about Z, acquiring the parameters of the Bayesian network at the next time t+1 according to the expectation, calculating the error of the data vector of the ith training set for training the Bayesian network, further updating the parameters of the Bayesian network according to the error, repeatedly executing the steps for training the Bayesian network, and verifying on a verification set until the stopping condition is reached, and completing the training of the Bayesian network to obtain the fire disaster recognition model. According to the invention, the Bayesian network is trained into the fire disaster recognition model through the observable variable and the hidden variable, so that the fire disaster recognition capability is improved.

title_en: Under-mine emergency command system based on improved expert system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of mine emergency command, and particularly relates to an underground emergency command system based on an improved expert system. The system comprises an accident analysis module, an accident type analysis module, an underground personnel command module and a rescue personnel command module. The accident analysis module is used for carrying out accident analysis and risk assessment by using sensors and historical data to provide a report, the accident type analysis module is used for analyzing the accident type by using a classification algorithm and generating an emergency response scheme, the underground personnel command module is used for planning an optimal evacuation route by using improved A-and Dijkstra algorithms and carrying out scheduling and resource optimization by using genetic and particle swarm optimization algorithms, and the rescue personnel command module is used for planning a rescue route by using a minimum risk path algorithm and Monte Carlo simulation to select a minimum risk path. The system can improve the emergency command efficiency and safety of the mine and ensure the life safety of miners and the production sustainability of the mine.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHIYIN TECH CO LTD;SHAANXI BUILDING MATERIALS TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Composite dynamic disaster simulation experiment device under cyclic dynamic load condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite dynamic disaster simulation experiment device under a circulating dynamic load condition, which comprises a main body supporting mechanism and is characterized in that the main body supporting mechanism comprises a top beam, a base and an upright post vertically supported between the top beam and the base, wherein the lower end of the top beam is provided with a driving mechanism, the driving mechanism is connected with a lifting mechanism, the lifting mechanism is connected with a heavy hammer mechanism, the base is provided with an auxiliary testing mechanism and a monitoring mechanism, the monitoring mechanism is arranged above the auxiliary testing mechanism and is connected with the auxiliary testing mechanism, and a sample mechanism is arranged in the monitoring mechanism. The invention realizes the composite dynamic disaster simulation experiment under the condition of cyclic dynamic load, can test the data of the absorption energy of the samples including coal rock and other samples under the condition of composite dynamic disaster through the drop hammer and the residual impact energy testing device, and can realize the output of different impact energies by changing the quality or the height of the heavy hammer mechanism. The experimental device has simple energy conversion and ensures the accuracy of output energy value.
assignees: PINGDINGSHAN TIANAN COAL MINING CO LTD;UNIV LIAONING

title_en: Semantic map construction method based on semantic information and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a semantic map construction method based on semantic information and a readable storage medium, belonging to the technical field of firefighting maps. The semantic map construction method comprises the steps of obtaining historical semantic information data of a transformer substation fire-fighting map; the method comprises the steps of acquiring historical semantic information data of a transformer substation fire-fighting map, reconstructing the transformer substation fire-fighting map semantic model, training the transformer substation fire-fighting map semantic model by adopting the historical semantic information data, acquiring real-time radar coordinate information and real-time semantic information of a fire-fighting robot in the inspection process of the fire-fighting robot, inputting the real-time semantic information into the transformer substation fire-fighting map semantic model to obtain semantic content, and acquiring a real-time fire-fighting map by combining the real-time radar coordinate information and the semantic content.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV BRANCH

title_en: Meteorological early warning method, system and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather early warning method, a weather early warning system and related equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining crop information, obtaining growth data of crops according to the crop information, carrying the growth data into a crop growth model to calculate to obtain a simulated growth model of the crops, obtaining future environmental data of the crops based on the simulated growth model, wherein the future environmental data comprise water demand, illumination intensity and photosynthetic radiation of the crops, obtaining meteorological data, judging whether the meteorological data accord with meteorological disaster data according to meteorological disaster rules, if yes, generating meteorological disaster early warning information, if not, building a meteorological influence prediction model according to the meteorological data and the simulated growth model, judging whether the meteorological data influence the crops based on the meteorological influence prediction model, if yes, generating meteorological disaster early warning information, and sending the meteorological disaster early warning information to a preset department according to preset rules. The invention can combine the meteorological data with the real-time meteorological data of the crop area to realize the accuracy and the rapid early warning of the meteorological early warning.
assignees: SHENZHEN FENGNONG SHUZHI AGRICULTURAL TECH CO LTD;SHENZHEN WUGU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Test system and method for simulating side impact of four-side simple support member
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of component disaster simulation devices, in particular to a test system and a test method for simulating the side impact of a four-side simple support component, which comprise a guide rail type drop hammer device for simulating the side impact of the component, a support device for realizing the boundary condition of the four-side simple support, a shaft force loading device for applying uniform axial force and a rigid basic platform, the invention can simulate the actual working condition that the four-side simple support component suffers from lateral impact under the axle pressure state, namely, the component reaches the boundary condition of the four-side simple support through the support device, then uniform horizontal axle pressure load is applied to the component through the distribution beam, and when the axle force reaches a preset value and keeps stable, the drop hammer is released, so that the test of the four-side simple support component under the coupling effect of the axial load and the lateral impact is carried out.

title_en: Method and device for detecting frozen disasters of power transmission line, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for detecting frozen disasters of a power transmission line, wherein the method comprises the steps of fusing an ALD model by utilizing a KDLV algorithm, extracting dynamic and static characteristics of data, and further detecting the frozen disasters of the power transmission line by utilizing an autoregressive model in the KDLV algorithm. The T statistical limit of the first autoregressive model constructed based on the training data can be used for representing the situation of a normal (no freezing disaster) power transmission line, and the T statistical value of the second autoregressive model constructed based on the testing data can be used for representing the situation of the freezing disaster of the power transmission line to be tested. Therefore, the detection result of the extreme freezing disaster of the power transmission line can be obtained by comparing the T statistical limit corresponding to the training data and the T statistical value corresponding to the test data. On the premise of using a small amount of icing weight data as a training set, the method adaptively completes early warning of the extreme freezing disasters of the power transmission line of the power grid system, and improves the accuracy of icing disaster detection.

title_en: Geological exploration high temperature drilling temperature measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster management, drilling exploration and temperature measurement, in particular to a high-temperature drilling temperature measurement device for geological exploration, which comprises a horizontally arranged mounting seat, wherein a cable storage unit is arranged at the top of the mounting seat, a temperature measuring optical fiber is wound on the cable storage unit, a cable picking mechanism is arranged at the top of the mounting seat at the front side of the cable storage unit, travelling wheels are respectively arranged in two wheel frames which are arranged at intervals at the bottom of the rear side of the mounting seat, and a thermocouple temperature measuring probe is arranged at the temperature measuring end of the temperature measuring optical fiber. The geological exploration high-temperature drilling temperature measuring device is convenient to operate when drilling temperature measurement is carried out, adopts a manual-automatic integrated line-proof structure, can effectively guide the temperature measuring optical fiber by utilizing the centralizing guide device when the temperature measuring optical fiber is automatically lowered, avoids collision damage caused by contact between the thermocouple temperature measuring probe and the hole wall, and is high in safety when the temperature measuring optical fiber is lowered.
assignees: CCTEG ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD;CCTEG CYCLE INDUSTRY RES INSTITUTE SHANDONG CO LTD;CCTEG XINRONG TECH INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Indoor simulation test device for landslide start-up and slip process
abstract_en: The utility model provides an indoor simulation test device for a landslide start-up process, which comprises a support beam rotatably arranged at the upper part of a centrifugal machine, wherein a sleeve frame is fixedly sleeved at one end of the support beam, a toughened glass box is placed in the sleeve frame, an upper cover plate is arranged at the top of the toughened glass box, a driving assembly and a camera assembly are arranged at the top of the upper cover plate, and the driving assembly and the camera assembly are matched. The test system mainly comprises a centrifugal machine system, a circulating freeze thawing system, a rainfall system and a measuring device, physical and mechanical parameters of a landslide start-slip process under the effects of freeze thawing, rainfall and gravity aging deformation are utilized, through a three-dimensional physical model test of the whole process of multiple slumping disasters, not only can data of the tillite simulated soil layer landslide be conveniently acquired, but also the slip state of the tillite simulated soil layer in the toughened glass box can be intuitively see tides, the test system has relatively rich practical experience, and the acquisition of data required by projects can be realized.
assignees: CHENGDU GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY SOUTHWEST GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH IN

title_en: Optimization design method and system for foundation pit support
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization design method and system for foundation pit support, which aim to improve the design efficiency and safety of a support structure, collect on-site topography and physical and mechanical parameters of soil, evaluate the influence of foundation pit excavation on the surrounding environment, analyze geological disaster risks, formulate preventive measures, select proper support structure types, simulate the performance of different support schemes by using finite element analysis software, install monitoring equipment to monitor the foundation pit state in real time, establish a prediction model by using a machine learning algorithm, adjust the design scheme according to monitoring data, evaluate the final performance of a support system, record abnormal conditions, and continuously improve the design flow and construction method according to project feedback.
assignees: JIANGXI INST SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Railway tunnel entrance and exit safety monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway tunnel entrance and exit safety monitoring method, which comprises the steps of monitoring and collecting first monitoring data of regions around a railway tunnel entrance and exit, collecting second monitoring data of the regions around the railway tunnel entrance and exit in real time, collecting third monitoring data from public alarming, and simulating and presenting disaster scenes of the railway tunnel entrance and exit by utilizing the first monitoring data to the third monitoring data, thereby being beneficial to effectively monitoring, accurately identifying and alarming the safety of the important scene of the railway tunnel entrance and exit. In addition, the invention also discloses a railway tunnel entrance and exit safety monitoring system.
assignees: NANJING PAI SMART PERCEPTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mobile integrated first-aid nursing module based on 5G platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a mobile integrated first-aid nursing module based on a 5G platform, which comprises a module, wherein the module comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle module, a rescue module, a nursing module, a medicine module, a 5G module and a solar module, and can solve the problem that batch injury conditions or multiple injury patients are required to rescue in time caused by sudden events such as large-scale car accidents, large-scale disasters, military exercises and the like, so that the life safety of the vast masses of people is better ensured. The invention combines the Internet industries such as 5G technology, unmanned aerial vehicle and the like with modern emergency medical science, has the advantages of integrating modern medical resources, being convenient and fast to move anytime and anywhere, conforms to the development of the large background of the age, promotes the development of the age, promotes the integration of medical care and promotes the progress of nursing industry.

title_en: Rapid assessment method for linear traffic engineering risk zone
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid assessment method for a linear traffic engineering risk zone, which belongs to the field of geological disaster engineering, and comprises the steps of collecting data and data of a research area, calculating information magnitude of each disaster causing factor by utilizing an improved information quantity model, removing disaster causing factors with highest correlation and smallest contribution, performing preliminary sample data training by adopting a HSVR model, generating a non-landslide point sample added with displacement information, recalculating the information magnitude, inputting the data into a model coupled with SWO and HSVR, performing learning training to obtain weight coefficients of each disaster causing factor, correcting, and finally realizing data visualization in a GIS system. The invention adopts the improved information quantity model, the improved SHAP interpretable model and the SWO-HSVR model, realizes the high-accuracy geological disaster regional prediction model and the quick evaluation of the linear traffic engineering risk zone, is beneficial to reducing the influence of geological disasters on the linear traffic engineering, and ensures the engineering safety and sustainable development.
assignees: CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;CHINA RAILWAY ERYUAN ENG GROUP

title_en: Urban fire intelligent early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire early warning, in particular to an intelligent urban fire early warning system which comprises an intelligent urban structure analysis module, a dynamic fire early warning simulation module, a fireproof strategy optimization module and an intelligent environmental impact analysis module. According to the invention, the urban map model is generated by utilizing urban building geographic positions, materials, fire data and building age data, the relevance and characteristics among buildings are deeply analyzed, the fire spreading influence is simulated through a map convolution network, the prediction precision of fire spreading paths and speeds is obviously improved, evacuation difficulty and risk level of the buildings under multiple fire sources are calculated in an assisted manner, a basis is provided for scientifically planning evacuation routes and fireproof isolation areas, emergency response and resource allocation are optimized, meteorological, population dynamics and holiday activity data analysis are integrated, the effect of environmental factors in fire early warning is enhanced, the accuracy and timeliness of early warning are ensured, and the overall efficiency of an urban fireproof system is improved.
assignees: ZIGUANG HUIZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building safety visualization emergency method and system based on 3D technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building safety visualization emergency method and system based on a 3D technology, and relates to the field of building safety visualization and emergency methods; the method comprises the steps of integrating multiple risk factors to evaluate the harmfulness of smoke, combining an evaluation result with an airflow dynamic diffusion distribution simulation result to generate a real-time 3D risk map, coloring a smoke diffusion path region risk based on a self-defined view of the real-time 3D risk map and a risk early warning level, carrying out multi-dimensional early warning marking on the risk of the smoke diffusion path region, dynamically planning an evacuation path based on the real-time 3D risk map after multi-dimensional early warning marking, and sending the 3D risk map and the evacuation path selected by dynamic planning to a visual terminal of rescue workers to conduct escape command on trapped workers in a building.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZRH MAN PLANNING CO LTD

title_en: Landslide vulnerability prediction method in future scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prediction and discloses a landslide vulnerability prediction method in future situations, which comprises the steps of selecting landslide influence factors according to disaster-pregnant environment and disaster-causing factors of landslide in a research area; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing landslide influence factors, constructing a data set, constructing a landslide prediction model, training and verifying the landslide prediction model by using the data set to obtain a model with optimal parameters, replacing LULC factors and rainfall factors in the landslide influence factors with LULC factors and rainfall factors respectively simulated by a PLUS model and an atmospheric circulation model, and inputting LULC factors, the simulated rainfall factors and other factors in the landslide influence factors into the model with optimal parameters to obtain a future scene landslide susceptibility prediction result. The landslide prediction method has the beneficial effects that the defect that landslide susceptibility prediction is usually carried out by simulating a single landslide influence factor is overcome, so that the prediction result is more credible.

title_en: Hydrogen sensor optimization layout method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrogen sensor optimized layout method and system based on reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of sensor layout. The hydrogen energy application method comprises the steps of simulating hydrogen concentration fields of various hydrogen leakage working conditions in a hydrogen energy application scene, constructing a feasible region of a hydrogen sensor layout scheme, constructing a reinforcement learning intelligent body based on the feasible region of the hydrogen sensor layout scheme, and obtaining an optimal hydrogen sensor layout scheme by continuously interacting the intelligent body and the environment with the aim of maximizing the coverage rate of the hydrogen leakage working conditions, minimizing the hydrogen leakage detection time and minimizing the disaster caused by the hydrogen leakage by taking the hydrogen energy application scene of the various hydrogen leakage working conditions as an environment. According to the invention, the optimal hydrogen sensor laying scheme is obtained according to scientific calculation, and the targets of maximizing the coverage rate of hydrogen leakage working conditions, minimizing the hydrogen leakage detection time and minimizing the disaster-causing effect of hydrogen leakage can be realized, so that the safety and the intelligent level under a typical hydrogen energy scene are improved.

title_en: Rigidity-damping collaborative matching interface displacement model calculation method for pile-soil nonlinear interaction
abstract_en: The invention establishes a brand new Naggar-Iwan interface model between the pile body and the deformed soil body so as to simulate the synergistic effect between the soil disaster body and the pile disaster bearing body. Based on the pile-soil joint working principle and the elastic theory, an elastoplastic model is adopted to represent and establish the relation between pile-soil interface friction resistance and relative displacement, a pile is divided into a plurality of micro-segment units according to the transmission principle, a micro element is taken for stress analysis, then a shear displacement method is adopted to calculate soil displacement outside the pile-soil interface, according to the generalized Hooke's law intensity theory, stress analysis is carried out on each particle, a generalized structural force-displacement transfer function is constructed by utilizing the dynamics basic principle, then a complex matrix operation principle in a complex transformation function is adopted to carry out simplified calculation on a stiffness matrix [ K ] damping matrix [ C ] to obtain horizontal and vertical displacement of a Naggar-Iwan interface model, finally, according to the continuous boundary condition of pile-soil displacement, the pile is completely attached to a soil body, and the displacement of the pile can be solved through superposition of the soil displacement and the displacement of the interface Naggar-Iwan model.
assignees: UNIV LANZHOU JIAOTONG;NORTHWEST RES INST CO LTD CREC;CHINA RAILWAY NO 9 GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary method and device for command system
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent auxiliary method and device for a command system, and belongs to the technical field of emergency command. According to the embodiment of the application, firstly, emergency flow sampling is carried out on a command system to obtain a plurality of emergency flows, then, based on scheme evaluation values of a plurality of emergency schemes corresponding to each emergency flow determined by the command system, flow evaluation values corresponding to the emergency flows are obtained, a plurality of preferred emergency flows are obtained through screening from the emergency flows, after target emergency demand information of a target emergency event is determined, a target emergency flow is determined in the preferred emergency flows based on the target emergency demand information, or the target emergency demand information is input into a flow generation model obtained based on training of the preferred emergency flows, and the target emergency flow is output. Therefore, the end-to-end intelligent auxiliary method is realized, and the actual application effect of the target emergency flow is effectively improved while the emergency response speed of the emergency command system is improved.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE CHENXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Roadway risk paragraph multi-scale geological prediction method based on air-well-hole combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a well lane risk section multi-scale geological prediction method based on air-well-hole combination, which relates to the technical field of well lane risk section multi-scale geological prediction, and is characterized in that geological investigation is carried out on the surface of an area where two parallel mine lanes are located before mining, a risk geological section is defined by combining geological disaster characteristics, aeroelectromagnetic detection is carried out on the surface above the corresponding risk geological section of the two parallel mine lanes, whether a geological body between the two parallel mine lanes has a water body or a water guide structure is judged according to detection results, inclined drilling is carried out from a non-risk tunnel to a geological body behind a mining surface of a high-risk tunnel according to judgment results, drilling parameters in the drilling process are obtained, drilling rock slag is collected, the rock lithology, the type and the abnormal degree of the poor geological body in the geological body between the two mine lanes are judged based on drilling rock slag, sonic testing is carried out in the hole, and the integrity of the rock body is judged by combining the drilling parameters and sonic velocity values, so that the well risk section multi-scale accurate geological prediction is completed.

title_en: Energy storage device integrated control system based on external environment information
title_ko: 외부 환경 정보에 기반하는 에너지 저장장치 통합 제어 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated control system for controlling an energy storage system (ESS). The integrated control system for controlling an ESS comprises an ESS which receives electric power from a system power grid or a renewable energy generation module to store energy and supplies the stored energy to a load or transmits the stored energy to a system. The ESS comprises a battery module, a BMS module, a power conversion unit, and a PMS module. According to the present invention, the integrated control system for an ESS controls the ESS based on weather information such as atmospheric temperature, wind speed, precipitation, snow accumulation information corresponding to external environmental factors, by distinguishing the weather information into detailed weather information according to land or sea areas, or based on total power information used by region or zone, or various disaster information. Accordingly, the integrated control system for an ESS can integrally manage charging, power generation, and the like of the ESS under various conditions in a more efficient and optimized manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 외부 환경 정보에 기반하는 에너지 저장장치 통합 제어 시스템에 관한 것으로, 에너지 저장장치(ESS)를 제어하는 통합 제어 시스템에 있어서, 계통 전력망 또는 신재생에너지 발전 모듈로부터 전력을 공급받아 에너지를 저장하고, 저장된 에너지를 부하에 공급하거나 계통에 송전하는 에너지 저장장치(ESS)를 포함하고, 상기 에너지 저장장치는, 상기 계통 전력망 또는 상기 신재생에너지 발전 모듈로부터 전력을 공급받아 저장하는 배터리 모듈; 상기 배터리 모듈의 충전 및 방전을 관리하는 BMS(Battery Management System) 모듈; 상기 배터리 모듈의 출력 또는 상기 신재생에너지 발전 모듈의 출력을 교류전원으로 변환하여 부하에 공급하거나 계통에 송전하는 전력 변환부; 및 상기 전력 변환부의 동작을 관리하는 PMS(Power Management System) 모듈;을 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 에너지 저장장치를 외부에서 제어하는 것으로, 날씨 정보, 전력 정보, 재난정보를 포함하는 외부 환경 정보를 수집한 후 상기 에너지 저장장치의 충전과 방전을 제어하는 운영 서버; 상기 운영 서버에서 발생되는 상기 에너지 저장장치의 운전 상태나 긴급 상황 정보를 관리하는 관리자 단말기; 및 상기 운영 서버로 외부 환경 정보에 해당되는 날씨 정보, 전력 정보, 재난정보를 포함하는 외부 환경 정보를 제공하되, 상기 날씨 정보는 지상 날씨와 해상 날씨로 분류하고 온도, 습도, 풍속, 강수량 정보를 각각 수집하여 제공하고, 상기 전력 정보는 총 전력 사용 정보와 지역별 전력 사용 정보로 각각 수집하여 제공하고, 상기 재난정보는 지역별 재난 발생 여부를 수집하여 제공하되, 상기 재난 정보, 날씨 정보, 전력 정보에 대하여 일단위별, 월단위별, 년단위별 변화값을 시계열적으로 수집하여 상기 운영 서버에 제공하는 환경 시나리오 수집부를 포함하여 구성되는 외부 데이터 서버;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Gaming to improve route guidance
abstract_en: A system and method for using gaming as a tool to determine optimum routes through areas that have experienced a disaster are provided. Due to the disaster, an area may have some destroyed roads and other infrastructure. In one embodiment, input data collected from people on the ground, drones, and other aerial vehicles can be used to generate a virtual simulation of the area. The virtual area may include renderings of destroyed roads and infrastructure. Once created, the virtual area may be uploaded to an online gaming environment where users can participate in online games that permit them to find the best routes through the virtual area between starting and destination points. Once optimal routes are found, the system may send these routes to navigation systems used by rescuers and other people in the area to help them navigate the disaster area.

title_en: Fireproof door window smoke sealing performance testing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire door and window smoke sealing performance testing device, which comprises a test box, a test piece mounting frame and a buckle box, wherein a fire door and window test piece is mounted on the test piece mounting frame during test, and then the test piece mounting frame is clamped between the test box and the buckling box, and the test box and the buckling box are locked by the pressing mechanism, so that a sealing space is formed by the test box, the test piece mounting frame and the buckling box. The air in the test box is heated through the electric heating device in the test box, hot smoke in a fire disaster is simulated by pressurizing the air in the test box through the centrifugal fan, the air passing rate of the fireproof door and window is calculated by measuring the air flow of the outlet of the buckle box, and then the smoke sealing performance of the fireproof door and window is obtained. The device can accurately simulate the scene that flue gas passes through the fireproof door and window in a fire scene, accurately measure the flow of the flue gas passing through the fireproof door and window, and further obtain the smoke sealing performance of the fireproof door and window.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Mud-rock flow disaster geological survey rock soil detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a debris flow disaster geological survey rock-soil detection device which comprises a main body assembly, a sampling assembly, an extension piece and a sampling piece, wherein the main body assembly comprises a moving piece, a protection piece and an adjusting piece, the protection piece is arranged at the top of the moving piece, the adjusting piece is fixedly connected to the right side of the protection piece, the sampling assembly is arranged at the top of the moving piece and comprises the extension piece and the sampling piece, the extension piece is arranged at the top of the moving piece, and the sampling piece is arranged at one side of the extension piece. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the moving part of the main body assembly can facilitate the transportation and the movement of the whole device by workers, the internal mechanical structure can be protected by the protecting part, the angle of the sampling drilling machine body can be adjusted by the adjusting part, the drilling depth of the sampling drilling machine body can be adjusted by the extending part of the sampling assembly, and soil at different positions of a mountain can be sampled by the sampling assembly.
assignees: HEBEI PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL RESOURCES FOURTH HYDROLOGY ENG GEOLOGY TEAM HEBEI GRO

title_en: Flood disaster event detection method and device based on social media data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting flood disaster events based on social media data, and relates to the technical field of flood disaster monitoring and risk assessment, wherein text data in a long time range downloaded from social media are marked as disaster related and irrelevant data by manpower, and BERT training is performed by using the data; the method comprises the steps of training a model, classifying disaster text data in a long time range by using the trained model to obtain disaster related text data in the long time range, extracting city information of the disaster related text data in the long time range by CPCA, classifying according to cities and sequencing according to time sequence, screening out disaster related text data of each city in each year without rainy season, counting the sum of the disaster related text data of one hour, two hours before and after each hour, calculating an average time interval, and judging the occurrence and the end of a disaster event by a preset average time interval threshold. The invention can detect the occurrence and the end of the flood disaster event by utilizing social media.

title_en: Automatic data disaster recovery method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an automatic data disaster recovery method, a system, a device and a storage medium, which are applied to a GPT intelligent analysis unit, and comprise the following steps of S1, setting up a GPT environment and acquiring a large number of log files, operation and maintenance records and fault investigation cases; the method comprises the steps of S2, training the GPT environment by using log files, operation and maintenance records and fault investigation cases to obtain a trained GPT intelligent analysis unit, S3, collecting, arranging and formatting logs by using log collecting plug-ins, S4, obtaining and summarizing log files to be backed up in a unified format in a preset period, sending the log files to the GPT intelligent analysis unit for prediction and analysis to obtain an analysis result, and S5, carrying out remote backup according to the analysis result. According to the embodiment of the invention, by introducing the GPT technology, the threshold of storage operation and maintenance personnel is effectively reduced, and the development of the accuracy, standardization and maintainability of the software log system is promoted.
assignees: BEIJING TOYOU FEIJI ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Weather disaster prediction method based on AI
abstract_en: The invention relates to an AI-based meteorological disaster prediction method, which belongs to the field of analysis and prediction of marine meteorological data and comprises the following steps of (1) data acquisition and preprocessing, (2) time sequence data set construction, (3) model design and construction, (4) model training, (5) model verification, and (6) model application, wherein the trained model is applied to an actual marine meteorological disaster prediction task. The prediction method has the advantages that (1) the prediction precision is improved, and the prediction precision of the marine meteorological data is effectively improved by combining the Bi-LSTM model and the MLP model. (2) The robustness and the stability of the model are enhanced, and the robustness of the model under different data environments is enhanced through the synergistic effect of Bi-LSTM and MLP. (3) The flexibility and the application universality of the model are improved, and the flexible structure enables the model to be widely applied to a plurality of fields such as marine weather, environmental monitoring and weather disaster early warning, and has good adaptability.
assignees: YANTAI LITU MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Training device for single-mode landslide recognition prediction model and landslide recognition prediction base model, localization device for landslide recognition prediction model, and landslide recognition prediction device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a training device for a single-mode landslide recognition prediction model and a landslide recognition prediction base model, a localization device for the landslide recognition prediction model and the landslide recognition prediction device, and relates to the technical fields of computer systems, disaster prediction, deep learning algorithms, model training, fine adjustment and the like based on specific models. The method comprises the steps that each first equipment end respectively uses collected single-mode landslide data to train to obtain a single-mode landslide identification prediction model, a second equipment end fuses model parameters of a plurality of single-mode landslide identification prediction models to obtain a target landslide identification prediction base model, a third equipment end sends a target mode request of locally used landslide data to the second equipment end, a local landslide training sample is used for carrying out fine adjustment training on a model after cutting or light weight processing of the target landslide identification prediction base model, and a localization landslide identification model required by each third equipment end is obtained, so that disaster prediction results are obtained under the condition that original data are lost.

title_en: Urban rail transit information safety protection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city rail transit information safety protection method and system, comprising the following steps of performing risk assessment and demand analysis, identifying assets, threat analysis, vulnerability assessment and demand analysis, designing and planning safety protection, making strategies, designing architecture and making plans, performing network isolation and region division, safety equipment deployment, data encryption and backup, rights management and access control, and performing real-time monitoring, periodic audit, emergency response and continuous optimization. And fifthly, personnel training and management, and safety consciousness training, operation specification and authority management. The invention can realize more comprehensive and intelligent urban rail transit information safety protection.
assignees: SHANGHAI YISHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional disaster test device and test method for structure of submarine shield tunnel in construction period
abstract_en: The invention relates to a structural catastrophe test device and a structural catastrophe test method in a construction period of a multifunctional submarine shield tunnel, and relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering. The device comprises a model test box, a model tunnel, a submarine high-pressure simulation device, a shield construction tunneling device and a data acquisition system, wherein the model test box is used for soaking similar materials to saturation to enable a seepage field and a stress field in the model box to reach an initial static balance state, the submarine high-pressure simulation device is used for enabling the seepage field and the stress field in the model test box to reach a dynamic stable balance state, the model tunnel is arranged in the model test box, the shield construction tunneling device is used for conducting model tunnel excavation, and the data acquisition system is used for acquiring basic physical parameters of a triaxial compression test surrounding rock and a fault fracture zone and recording catastrophe test data. The invention can simulate the catastrophe of a surrounding rock-lining structure caused by the expansion of pipe piece cracks caused by the influence of high water pressure on the seabed in the construction stage of the large-diameter submarine shield tunnel.

title_en: Model test device for triggering adjacent tunnel cascade collapse by foundation pit continuous collapse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model test device for triggering adjacent tunnel cascade collapse by continuous collapse of a foundation pit, which relates to the technical field of foundation pit support, and comprises a test box body and sandy soil arranged in the test box body, wherein a foundation pit continuous collapse simulation system, two tunnel collapse simulation systems and a data monitoring system are arranged in the test box body, the device can be used for researching continuous collapse risks of a foundation pit caused by factors such as overexcavation and the like and influence of deformation and internal force of an adjacent tunnel model, evaluating whether cascade collapse of the adjacent tunnel model occurs, revealing the whole process of disaster evolution of cascade collapse of the foundation pit and a tunnel system, and providing effective test data for researching disaster prevention, control and control methods aiming at continuous collapse problems of subsequent urban underground engineering.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION NORTH CHINA INVEST DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION TRAFFIC OPERATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Software development data security management method based on cloud service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud service-based software development data security management method, which specifically comprises the following steps of; s1, a multilayer encryption and dynamic key management method; s2, a refined and self-adaptive access control method; s3, a depth data desensitization and anonymization processing method; s4, an omnibearing real-time monitoring and intelligent auditing method; s5, a high-efficiency and flexible data backup and disaster recovery method is adopted; s6, a continuous safety training and cultural construction method relates to the technical field of cloud computing and information safety, and by integrating strategies such as multi-layer encryption, fine access control, deep data desensitization, omnibearing real-time monitoring, efficient data backup, continuous safety training and the like, the safety, compliance and efficiency of data in the software development process are remarkably improved.
assignees: WUXI YIMIN SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Semantic description and question-answering system establishment method and system for remote sensing disaster detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of computer vision language and image recognition, in particular to a method and a system for establishing a semantic description and question-answer system for remote sensing disaster detection, which are characterized in that image features are utilized to generate text language description capable of accurately responding to task demand images on the premise of adding text constraint by means of model construction, training and evaluation, and on the basis of establishing a mapping relation between a pixel level classification result and the question-answer system, the method can complete three subtasks of semantic segmentation, sentence description and question-answering system by using one set of network model, saves the memory space of a computer, improves the response speed, and provides technical support for improving the automation and intelligent degree and the quick response capability of a remote sensing disaster detection system.

title_en: Intelligent landslide surface monitoring method based on YADMW image target recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological environment disaster monitoring, in particular to an intelligent monitoring method for a landslide surface based on YADMW image target recognition, which comprises the steps of collecting landslide surface image data of the landslide surface under different weather conditions and different geological types in multiple angles and multiple time periods by using a camera; and constructing YADMW an image target recognition model, training the YADMW image target recognition model by using the landslide image data set to obtain a final YADMW image target recognition model, and monitoring the landslide image data acquired in real time by using the final YADMW image target recognition model. The invention improves the accuracy of detecting the abnormal slope surface.

title_en: Flood disaster early warning method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a flood disaster early warning method, equipment and medium, belonging to the technical field of Internet of things and artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the steps that a cloud platform acquires key hydrologic elements corresponding to a region to be predicted through monitoring equipment to obtain multi-element data corresponding to the key hydrologic elements; the method comprises the steps of extracting key features in historical multi-metadata through an analysis algorithm, dividing the historical multi-metadata into a training set and a verification set according to the key features, training a hydrological forecast model constructed through various neural networks based on the training set, acquiring real-time weather forecast data, outputting forecast flow and water level through the hydrological forecast model after training, obtaining flood occurrence probability according to the forecast flow and the water level through a risk assessment model after pre-training, and automatically generating corresponding early warning information based on the flood occurrence probability. The flow of the key water body can be rapidly predicted through the hydrologic prediction model, and early warning information can be generated in a short time.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR ZHISHUI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD;INSPUR SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: Loose water-bearing sand layer grouting modification effect checking method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a loose water-containing sand layer grouting modification effect inspection method, a system, a medium and equipment, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine roof water-bursting sand-bursting disaster prevention and control. The point data of the treatment holes distributed in the point shape are converted into the surface data with continuous space through the spatial interpolation process, the suspicious target area is quickly grouting according to the water permeability partition map, the treatment weak area is determined by adopting a ground drilling-geophysical prospecting combination method, the treatment weak area is comprehensively judged by adopting a downhole drilling-geophysical prospecting combination method, and finally the loose water sand layer grouting treatment effect test result is obtained. The water permeability partition map is introduced as an objective basis for defining a suspicious grouting target area, so that subjectivity and uncertainty of selection of an inspection area in the traditional technology are avoided, and blindness in engineering design of conventional grouting effect inspection and verification is avoided according to a flow of defining the suspicious grouting target area, rapidly positioning and treating a weak area through ground drilling-geophysical prospecting combination and verifying the weak area through underground drilling-geophysical prospecting combination.
assignees: ANHUI HENGYUAN COAL & ELECTRIC CO LTD;XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Landslide prediction method, device and system based on landslide identification prediction base model
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a landslide prediction method, device and system based on a landslide recognition prediction base model, and relates to the fields of computer systems, disaster prediction, deep learning, model training, fine adjustment and the like based on specific models. The method comprises the steps that each first equipment end is trained by using single-mode landslide data collected by each first equipment end to obtain a single-mode landslide identification prediction model, a plurality of model parameters of the single-mode landslide identification prediction models are fused by the second equipment end to obtain a landslide identification prediction base model, correction data are generated based on actual landslide data in response to user-defined operation, the landslide identification prediction base model outputs corrected landslide result data according to the correction data, the corrected landslide result data comprise whether landslide occurs or not and the landslide type, more factors can be considered for landslide prediction from long-term consideration, and landslide identification prediction accuracy is improved and disaster prediction results are obtained under the condition that original data are missing.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;YAJIANG CLEAN ENERGY SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Landslide hazard identification method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide hazard identification method and system based on multi-source data fusion, and relates to the technical field of landslide hazard identification. And then preprocessing the acquired data, analyzing and extracting a feature matrix by using a principal component, constructing a landslide risk model based on a deep learning model, and training by taking a landslide risk index as a label. On the basis, landslide risk indexes and meteorological data are analyzed, and landslide risk probability is obtained. Finally, the landslide body data are monitored in real time and are input into a trained model after being preprocessed, the current landslide risk index is obtained, the risk probability is calculated and compared with a preset threshold value, so that the landslide safety state is judged, and a scientific basis is provided for landslide disaster early warning.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for reducing time scale of precipitation data
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for reducing the time scale of precipitation data, which are applied to the technical field of precipitation data processing. In the method, to-be-processed precipitation data of a target site included in a random event set of to-be-processed precipitation is acquired, and simulated precipitation events included in the to-be-processed precipitation data are divided into simulated strong precipitation events and simulated non-strong precipitation events. Different types of simulated precipitation events employ different downscaling methods. Aiming at the simulated strong precipitation event, the rainfall data of the simulated strong precipitation event is subjected to scale reduction processing by using the matched historical strong precipitation event hour rain type of the target historical strong precipitation event. And for a non-strong rainfall event, performing downscaling treatment by using a target random hour rain type corresponding to the first daily sequence. The randomness of the generated rainfall pattern in the hour scale is improved by using multiple hour rainfall patterns, and the effect of evaluating the flood disasters is improved.
assignees: CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CORP;CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CATASTRIAL RISK MAN CO LTD

title_en: Provision device, provision method and provision program
abstract_en: To provide a simulated experience of a disaster other than an earthquake.SOLUTION: A provision device 100 is connected with a visual device 200 and a tactile device 300 via a network. The providing device 100 includes: an acquisition unit 120 that acquires simulated experience content information, which is information indicating content of a simulated experience desired by a user and indicating a simulated experience of a water-related or fire-related disaster, acquires a video of the water-related or fire-related disaster, and acquires tactile information, which is information for giving the user a sensation of being wet or feeling hot in conjunction with the video; and a transmission unit 140 that transmits the video to the visual device 200 and transmits the tactile information to the tactile device 300.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Fire-fighting equipment fire early-warning system for multichannel gas analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting equipment fire early warning system for multichannel gas analysis, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of positioning corresponding floors and corresponding equipment in a building, obtaining fire protection equipment information, hospital fire records and equipment alarm records, analyzing equipment states, monitoring data in the building in real time, forming fire early warning data, training a long-short-period memory network model, analyzing the fire early warning data, generating fire early warning levels, positioning the fire early warning data in a three-dimensional model of the building, collecting real-time gas component data of a fire early warning position area, training a fire degree assessment model, predicting the newly collected data, judging whether fire exists in the current environment, assessing the severity of the fire, identifying false alarm, adjusting the early warning levels, triggering corresponding alarm mechanisms according to the confirmed early warning levels, automatically linking the fire protection equipment, generating evacuation instructions under the advanced early warning condition, and conducting personnel evacuation guidance.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHENGAN FIRE INSPECTION AND EVALUATION SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Structural surface shear damage constitutive model under true three-dimensional stress-seepage-aging coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a true three-dimensional stress-osmoticum-aging coupling lower structural surface shear failure constitutive model which comprises the steps of carrying out a true three-dimensional stress-osmoticum-aging coupling multistage shear test on a rock structural surface to obtain strength and deformation characteristics of the structural surface, determining a true three-dimensional stress loading shear damage D  s  calculation method of the rock structural surface based on test results, determining an evolution function of a specific Auger coefficient mu and a permeability coefficient k of the rock structural surface, establishing a true three-dimensional stress-osmoticum-aging coupling lower structural surface shear failure constitutive model and a numerical method, and carrying out true three-dimensional stress-osmoticum-aging coupling multistage shear test numerical simulation verification and water-rich area structural surface tunnel penetration catastrophe analysis. The invention provides a structural surface shearing fracture constitutive model under true three-dimensional stress-osmotic pressure-aging coupling, which has important significance for stability analysis and engineering disaster prediction of rock mass structural surface engineering in an underground water-rich area.

title_en: Rescue training room simulating snow storm disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue training room for simulating a snow storm disaster, which comprises a training room, wherein a transparent glass plate is arranged in the training room and divides the training room into a training area and an observation area, a snow making machine is arranged in the training area, a turnover device is arranged in the training area and comprises a U-shaped plate, a transverse plate and a driving structure, the U-shaped plate is arranged in the training area, and the transverse plate is rotatably arranged on the U-shaped plate through a pin shaft. The snowmaking machine produces snow in the training area, can simulate on-site snow storm disaster rescue, and the snow produced by the snowmaking machine can be accumulated on the transverse plate, and after reaching a certain degree, the output shaft of the servo motor drives the threaded rod to rotate forward rapidly, so that the threaded sleeve moves backwards along the threaded rod, at the moment, the two sides of the connecting plate rotate anticlockwise on the threaded sleeve and the vertical block respectively through the pin shafts, at the moment, the transverse plate rotates anticlockwise on the U-shaped plate rapidly through the pin shafts, the accumulated snow is discharged rapidly, avalanche is simulated, and rescue is implemented.
assignees: THE ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN AND RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH;YANSHOU FINANCE INVEST EVALUATION CENTER

title_en: Small full-scale test device for simulating side slope instability
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small full-scale test device for simulating slope instability. The device comprises a slope simulation device body, wherein a supporting bottom plate is arranged at the bottom end of the slope simulation device body, a lifting support is arranged below the supporting bottom plate, a water collecting diversion trench is arranged outside the supporting bottom plate Zhou Deduan, a precipitation simulation structure is arranged above the slope simulation device body, the precipitation simulation structure comprises a water falling pipeline net and a vertical rod, the water falling pipeline net is connected with an external water source through a water conveying pipeline, a camera is arranged on one side of the slope simulation device body, the slope simulation device body comprises layered rammed slope soil, a sensor assembly is arranged in the slope soil, and the sensor assembly is connected with an external computer terminal through a circuit. The device obtains the real-time change data of the slope instability through simulating the conditions of precipitation, increasing load and testing the slope instability under the foundation subsidence environment, and provides data support for slope protection design, construction guidance and timely early warning under disaster weather.
assignees: SHANDONG HI SPEED GROUP CO LTD;SHANDONG EXPRESSWAY ENVIRONMENTAL PROT BUILDING MATERIAL CO LTD;SHANDONG HUANGHE SURVEY DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Large building for simulating flood disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large building for simulating flood disasters, which comprises a prefabricated reinforced ground, wherein a water channel is excavated on the prefabricated reinforced ground, a reservoir is excavated at the tail end of the water channel, a guide pipe is pre-buried in the prefabricated reinforced ground, a water outlet is arranged at the tail end of the guide pipe, a transverse plate is arranged in the reservoir, a filter screen is embedded in the inner wall of the transverse plate, a first barrier is arranged in the water channel, a second barrier is arranged above the prefabricated reinforced ground, and a first air cushion is arranged in the water channel. The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue, and the large building for simulating flood disasters can simulate the flood disasters to the greatest extent according to the actual conditions of river channels by matching a water channel, a water reservoir, a guide pipe, a water outlet, a first barrier and a second barrier, so that the authenticity of training simulation can be ensured, and a water source after use can be recycled, so that the input amount of water resources can be greatly reduced, and the utilization rate of the water resources is improved.
assignees: THE ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN AND RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH

title_en: Rock-soil slope hidden danger cooperative control method based on early warning-prevention and control linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock-soil slope hidden danger cooperative control method based on early warning-prevention and control linkage, and relates to the technical field of geological engineering. Compared with the prior rock-soil side slope disaster comprehensive control and early warning situation, the invention improves the problem of how to effectively improve the capability of coping with the rock-soil side slope accident disaster sudden change under the influence of economic factors, comprehensively utilizes engineering mechanics, numerical simulation, a physical model and engineering experiments, establishes a rock-soil side slope disaster intelligent monitoring-real-time feedback-dynamic evaluation-engineering regulation and control technology system with regulation and control time, regulation and control parts, regulation and control modes and dynamic optimization as cores, and provides an early warning-prevention and control linkage disaster cooperative control technology. The linkage of rock-soil slope early warning release and prevention and control means is realized, the accurate prevention and control of hidden danger of the rock-soil slope can be realized, and the disaster prevention and control cost is reduced on the premise of ensuring the safety of the slope.

title_en: Coal mine disaster identification method and related equipment based on deep learning algorithm
abstract_en: The application discloses a coal mine disaster identification method and related equipment based on a deep learning algorithm, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring laser scanning point cloud data, geological drilling data and geophysical prospecting data of a coal mine; dividing a target area into a plurality of three-dimensional grid cells, interpolating the three-dimensional grid cells to obtain a first three-dimensional geological model, adding rock stratum and coal seam parameters into the first three-dimensional geological model to obtain a second three-dimensional geological model, associating the second three-dimensional geological model with a big data model to obtain monitoring data of the current season, extracting features of the current season and the monitoring data to obtain a multi-dimensional time sequence, inputting the multi-dimensional time sequence into a deep learning model to obtain a water level predicted value, inputting the water level predicted value into the big data model for correction, combining the corrected water level predicted value with the second three-dimensional geological model in space to obtain a dynamic three-dimensional geological model, and determining the probability of water damage of a coal mine well based on the dynamic three-dimensional geological model.

title_en: River basin flood risk assessment method and system based on particle identification algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river basin flood risk assessment method and system based on a particle identification algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of flood early warning. The existing scheme can measure the real-time flow of the river, but does not relate to how to deduce and evaluate the flood inundation condition, so that the flood inundation condition around the river bank cannot be known quickly. According to the river basin flood risk assessment method based on the particle recognition algorithm, through constructing the river basin space discrete model, the flow velocity calculation model, the flow simulation model, the two-dimensional hydrodynamic model and the flood risk assessment model, not only the section flow of the river basin can be calculated, but also the flood inundation condition can be deduced and assessed, so that the flood inundation risk and inundation data around the water area can be known rapidly, the requirement of river basin flood risk analysis can be met, the accuracy of flood disaster early warning is improved, and further more data supplement and management basis is provided for river basin flood prevention.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUANSUAN TECH CO LTD;CHUNAN COUNTY QIANDAOHU ECOLOGICAL COMPREHENSIVE PROT BUREAU CHUNAN COUNTY WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYD

title_en: Backup data prediction method, system and report generation method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a backup data prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence and a report generation method, belonging to the field of disaster recovery backup. The backup data prediction method comprises the steps of collecting data from a backup system, integrating the data into a data set after standardization, including tasks and system state information, taking a time period of the backup task as a reference period, matching the latest system state data, and re-segmenting the data set to train a linear regression model so as to predict future data. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data standardization module, a data set definition module, a data segmentation module, a model training module and an output prediction data module. The invention can accurately predict the utilization rate of the disk, avoid the condition of insufficient or waste disk resources, and simultaneously promote the management effect of backup operation by realizing the prediction of the time and the data volume of the backup task.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster early warning method and a mountain torrent disaster early warning system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining cloud layer image data; the cloud image data are processed based on a pre-trained deep learning model to obtain a predicted rainfall sequence, a hydrologic hydrodynamic model is built, scene simulation is carried out, disaster threshold rainfall is defined, and early warning is carried out by combining the predicted rainfall sequence and the disaster threshold rainfall. The system comprises an image acquisition module, a rainfall prediction module, a threshold value determination module and an early warning module. By using the invention, the mountain torrent disaster early warning can be carried out in advance, important disaster relief and risk avoidance time can be obtained for the mountain torrent disaster, and the prediction accuracy is better ensured because the rainfall prediction module combines the air pressure observation and the cloud layer rainfall estimation method based on deep learning. The invention can be widely applied to the field of natural disaster early warning.

title_en: Forest carbon reserve estimation method based on artificial intelligence and multi-mode remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest carbon reserve estimation method based on artificial intelligence and multi-mode remote sensing data, which relates to the technical field of forest carbon reserve estimation, integrates optical satellite images, laser radar data and hyperspectral image remote sensing data, improves the comprehensiveness and estimation accuracy of the data through multi-source data fusion, can more accurately reflect the coverage condition, vertical structure and biodiversity of a forest, overcomes the limitation of a single data source, divides the whole forest region into a plurality of subareas, and a carbon reserve estimation model is independently constructed based on the forest types of each sub-area, the carbon reserve estimation of different areas is refined in an area-by-area estimation mode, the characteristics of different forest types are accurately reflected, a dynamic carbon reserve prediction model based on differential equations is introduced, the change of the carbon reserve in the time dimension is simulated by combining historical and real-time remote sensing data, and the influence of factors such as forest growth, climate change, natural disasters, cutting and the like on the carbon reserve is captured.
assignees: ZHONGCHENG WEILAI DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent gas well anomaly detection method and system based on integrated tree
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent gas well anomaly detection method and system based on an integrated tree, wherein gas well data is sequence data which continuously changes along with time, and the influence of historical data on a current decision cannot be captured only by using current moment data, so that the current anomaly cannot be judged through context information. Therefore, it is necessary to convert the gas production data in time series form into valid gas well data before designing the anomaly detection model. However, dimension disaster is easy to generate due to the increase of dimension, the model training is difficult to converge due to a large amount of redundant information, and the training speed is reduced. The invention adopts the characteristic with higher maximum information coefficient filtering correlation to reduce the dimension, so that the reserved characteristic is maximized and kept independent. And compared with the Pearson correlation coefficient, the maximum information coefficient can overcome the maximum linear limitation, and more correlation type characteristics can be found. And training the production data of the gas well to obtain an anomaly detection model, so as to realize anomaly detection of the gas well.

title_en: Tunnel support optimization method, system, equipment and medium based on nonlinear near field dynamics
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a tunnel support optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium based on nonlinear near-field dynamics, and belongs to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of structures.
