The method comprises the steps of sampling tunnel surrounding rock data and carrying out an indoor test to obtain stress-strain data of the rock, carrying out simulation based on the data to obtain a rock nonlinear constitutive relation curve, determining a rock nonlinear constitutive relation, determining anchor rod initial parameters, carrying out numerical analysis based on near field dynamics, simulating tunnel excavation unloading and surrounding rock displacement after the anchor rod is inserted, evaluating surrounding rock deformation degree, and optimizing the distribution length and the distance of the anchor rods. By sampling surrounding rock, carrying out indoor test and numerical analysis based on near field dynamics, simulating the surrounding rock displacement after tunnel excavation unloading and anchor rod insertion, evaluating the surrounding rock deformation degree, optimizing the anchor rod distribution length and distance, and comprehensively improving the accuracy and effectiveness of tunnel support optimization.

title_en: Riverway flood control disaster reduction risk point AI identification method and device based on digital twin computable engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river flood control disaster reduction risk point AI identification method and device based on a digital twin computable engine. The method comprises the steps of obtaining three-dimensional scene basic data and hydraulic engineering parameters in a flow field, obtaining real-time rain condition, water condition, soil moisture content, reservoir condition and embankment monitoring data to obtain real-time data, building physical entities and twin simulation scenes according to the three-dimensional scene basic data and the hydraulic engineering parameters, performing AI simulation calculation of the water condition according to the real-time data to obtain simulation results, performing twin computable simulation according to the physical entities, the twin simulation scenes and the simulation results to obtain simulation results, and identifying risk points of a river channel in the flow field according to the simulation results. The method can solve the problems that the digital twin technology mainly lacks intelligent risk identification and multi-factor integration in river flood control and disaster reduction and influences prediction accuracy.
assignees: ANCHUANG QIYUAN HANGZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Firefighter training clothes
abstract_en: The utility model provides firefighter training clothes, which relate to the technical field of firefighter training clothes and comprise a jacket body, a placement component and a placement component, wherein a signboard is sewn and connected to the front surface of the jacket body, a front pocket is sewn and connected to the front surface of the jacket body, and the placement component is sewn and connected to the front surface of the jacket body and comprises a fixed patch and a cover plate. According to the utility model, when a firefighter wears the training clothes, one surface of the camera lens is outwards placed in the clamping groove, the shell of the camera lens is positioned in the clamping groove, the camera lens can be positioned at the outer side of the cover plate through the through groove, then the cover plate is covered on the surface of the fixed patch, the camera lens is in a state of being clung to the body of the firefighter, the fixation of the camera lens is stable, the problem that the camera lens shakes to influence the firefighter when the firefighter strenuous exercises can be effectively avoided, and the wearing comfort of equipment when the firefighter exercises is improved.

title_en: Flood storage flow prediction method and device and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a flood warehouse-in flow prediction method, device and related equipment, and relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of training data pairs corresponding to a target water conservancy facility, wherein the plurality of training data pairs respectively correspond to a plurality of floods experienced by the target water conservancy facility in a historical period, the training data pairs comprise rainfall data indicating rainfall of the corresponding floods and warehouse-in data indicating warehouse-in flow of the target water conservancy facility in the corresponding floods, the warehouse-in data are data obtained by flood adjustment calculation and inverse calculation under the water balance condition based on warehouse-out data of the corresponding floods and warehouse-in data of the corresponding floods, analyzing the plurality of training data pairs to obtain a target mapping relation, and predicting warehouse-in flow information of the current floods in the target water conservancy facility according to the target mapping relation and the rainfall of the current floods. The application can predict and obtain more accurate warehouse-in flow information.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Earthquake intensity prediction method and device based on earthquake destructive power
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake intensity prediction, in particular to an earthquake intensity prediction method and device based on earthquake destructive power, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining earthquake destructive power data of a target area; and inputting the seismic destructive power data into a pre-established seismic intensity prediction model to obtain the seismic intensity of the target station, so as to accurately predict the seismic intensity according to the building destruction condition. The earthquake damage force data are the proportion among the damage states of various building disaster-bearing bodies and the proportion among the damage states of the whole building disaster-bearing body, the earthquake intensity prediction model is obtained by training a machine learning algorithm based on historical earthquake intensity data and historical earthquake damage force, and the target area is the area of a neighboring target station.

title_en: Optimization decision method for slope stability of dumping site of open pit coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization decision method for the slope stability of an open pit coal mine dumping site, which comprises the steps of obtaining a test data set based on factor information influencing the slope stability of the open pit coal mine dumping site, constructing a feedforward neural network model, carrying out data characteristic extraction and nonlinear processing on the test data set, optimizing the weight and the threshold of the feedforward neural network model by utilizing a genetic algorithm, training and verifying the feedforward neural network model by using a mean square error as a loss function to obtain a trained feedforward neural network model, and predicting the dumping site data by utilizing the trained feedforward neural network model to obtain a slope stability decision scheme. The method improves the efficiency and accuracy of predicting the slope stability of the open pit coal mine dumping site, can more reliably analyze the slope stability of the open pit coal mine dumping site, and provides powerful support for disaster prevention and stable prediction of the open pit coal mine dumping site.
assignees: SHANXI COAL IMPORT AND EXPORT GROUP HEQU COUNTY JIUXIAN TOWNSHIP OPEN AIR COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Continuous medium neural network coupling landslide prediction calculation method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide prediction and discloses a continuous medium neural network coupling landslide prediction calculation method, a device and a medium. The method comprises the steps of defining a parameter space, simulating landslide under different parameter combinations through a continuous medium theory single-phase flow model according to the parameter space, determining information of the landslide under different parameter combinations according to a single-phase shallow water wave model, wherein the information comprises at least one of flow speed, flow depth and a stacking field, determining an optimal landslide parameter combination according to a deep neural network and supervised learning, and inputting an optimal parameter group into the single-phase shallow water wave model to perform final landslide power process numerical simulation. According to the technical scheme, aiming at the debris flow phenomenon of high speed and long distance in China, the motion characteristics of the debris flow phenomenon are researched from the perspective of the flow mechanics of the particulate matters, and landslide dynamic process simulation is realized. The prediction capability of the landslide debris flow starting-movement-disaster-causing range can be widely improved, and the method has important scientific significance for disaster prevention and reduction in mountain areas in China.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Landslide risk evaluation method and system based on substation failure model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk research, in particular to a landslide risk evaluation method and system based on a transformer substation failure model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detailed investigation on landslide of a transformer substation to obtain physical and mechanical properties of a rock-soil body, calculating seepage characteristics of the rock-soil body by using a rainfall infiltration hydrologic model, simulating landslide stability under different rainfall working conditions by using FLAC3D software, calculating annual instability probability by combining a Monte Carlo method, and calculating economic losses of the transformer substation under the working conditions by using a deformation damage model of various facilities in the transformer substation in the FLAC3D simulation landslide instability process to carry out fixed values on vulnerability of various facilities. The invention also comprises a corresponding system implementation. The method realizes comprehensive, quantitative and accurate assessment of landslide risk of the transformer substation by integrating geological investigation, hydrologic model, numerical simulation and statistical methods, provides scientific basis for security management of the power grid in the mountain area, and can be popularized and applied to risk assessment of other similar geological disasters.

title_en: Protection layer drilling grading regulation control method for coal-rock gas disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine safety exploitation, and discloses a protection layer drilling grading regulation control method for coal-rock gas disasters, which comprises the following steps of S1, geological survey; S2, drilling and pressure relief, S3, hydraulic fracturing, S4, gas extraction, S5, roof deep hole blasting, S6, advanced hole making and energy absorbing flexible support, S7, grouting reinforcement, and S8, continuous regulation and control. According to the protection layer drilling grading regulation control method for the coal-rock gas disasters, provided by the invention, multiple functions are integrated in a single drilling, so that resource saving, cost reduction and efficiency improvement are realized, mine environment interference is effectively reduced, meanwhile, the state of a coal-rock gas system is continuously regulated, the timeliness and flexibility of disaster control are ensured, different geological conditions are adapted, the coal mine safety is enhanced, the dual benefits of green exploitation and economic optimization are reflected, and the front progress of a coal mine safety technology is marked.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system for tunnel construction by drilling and blasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning method and system for drilling and blasting method tunnel construction, which comprises the steps of obtaining construction information of drilling and blasting method historic construction tunnels, determining the risk level, constructing word bag models of construction information under different risk levels, constructing a shared word bag model and all word bag models, calculating word frequencies of each word in all word bag models and word frequencies in all word bag models, constructing all word frequency tables and risk level word frequency tables, calculating risk level word frequency quotient of each word according to the risk level word frequency tables, determining the score of each word, removing words in the shared word bag models from the word bag models to be tested, obtaining a characteristic word bag model, calculating the word frequency of each word in the characteristic word bag models, obtaining the word frequency table of the word to be tested, calculating the word frequency quotient of the word frequency table to be tested and the word frequency table to be tested, obtaining the disaster risk level of the tunnel to be tested in the construction period, and providing a timely disaster early warning for the tunnel to be tested in the construction period.

title_en: Disaster prevention method and system for barrier lake based on disaster-causing chain
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of natural disaster prevention, and provides a disaster prevention method and a disaster prevention system for barrier lakes based on disaster chains. Through the disaster simulation in advance, emergency managers are allowed to think and design evacuation and rescue routes in advance, and precious preparation time is provided for the public. By planning a direct and efficient route in advance for evacuation and rescue processes, the pressure of rescue resources at emergency time can be greatly reduced, and rescue teams are allowed to more accurately distribute and use shortage resources.
assignees: CHINA ANNENG GROUP SECOND ENG BUREAU CO LTD;CHINA ANNENG CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Flood diversion area joint scheduling flood diversion policy management method, system and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a flood diversion area joint scheduling flood diversion strategy management method, a system and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining high-space-time resolution underlying surface data of each flood diversion area and constructing a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model; the method comprises the steps of simulating and calculating flood dividing and discharging processes of flood dividing and storing areas, determining flood dividing and discharging duration according to design flood storing volumes of different flood dividing and storing areas, simulating flood scene sets of each flood dividing and storing area according to flood conditions of different frequencies, constructing a flood dividing and storing area, applying a knowledge graph, determining various flood dividing schemes, and comparing and selecting a target flood dividing scheme based on an objective function and constraint conditions. The application meets the requirement of fast decision of using key indexes in the flood dividing and accumulating areas and reduces the loss of flood disasters from the aspect of jointly scheduling flood dividing in a plurality of flood dividing and accumulating areas.

title_en: Inland region typhoon remote extreme precipitation prediction method, medium and program product based on deep learning and IDII index fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote extreme precipitation prediction method, medium and program product for typhoons in inland areas based on deep learning and IDII index fusion, which are used for constructing a whole layer of dry invasion index, comprehensively considering the total effect of dry and cold air at different heights, acquiring historical TRP precipitation event, typhoons and analysis meteorological data, preprocessing and IDII index fusion, constructing a training data set, constructing a prediction model comprising a feature extraction layer, a IDII feature fusion layer and a TRP prediction output layer by adopting a deep learning technology, training, verifying and testing the model by utilizing a TRP sample data set, predicting future TRP event by utilizing the trained model, and outputting prediction results such as TRP precipitation amount, occurrence time, place and duration. The invention combines the dry invasion physical quantity IDII and the deep learning technology, improves the prediction precision of the TRP event, and provides technical support for the prediction of inland extreme rainfall and disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Urban multi-class security risk early warning method and system based on federal super network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city multi-category security risk early warning method and system based on a federal super network, comprising the steps of receiving first information, updating model parameters corresponding to all risk early warning clients through the super network to obtain updated parameters, sending the updated parameters to the corresponding risk early warning clients, and obtaining second information, wherein the model parameters are obtained by training a preset SC Nor-transducer model through historical data collected by a sensor group corresponding to risks, the SC Nor-transducer model is used for sequentially processing input through a sequence normalization layer, a sequence conversion layer, an encoder, a feature mapping layer and a sequence solution normalization layer to obtain output, and the model parameters corresponding to all risk early warning clients are updated through the super network to obtain updated parameters. The invention can effectively influence the increase of the city scale, the increase of the data volume and the data isomerism, and determine the occurrence type or cause of the disaster.
assignees: UNIV XIHUA;CHINA UNITED NETWORK COMMUNICATIONS CO LTD SICHUAN BRANCH;SICHUAN ACADEMY OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Optical fiber natural disaster early warning method and related equipment based on machine learning
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an optical fiber natural disaster early warning method and related equipment based on machine learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time optical fiber vibration data of an optical fiber pipeline deployed in a target area, classifying the real-time optical fiber vibration data based on a pre-trained target classification model, obtaining seismic information in the real-time optical fiber vibration data, wherein the target classification model is obtained based on historical optical fiber vibration data and historical seismic event data in a training mode, and performing natural disaster early warning based on the seismic information. According to the machine learning-based optical fiber natural disaster early warning method and related equipment, the earthquake information existing in the optical fiber vibration data can be identified, and then the natural disaster early warning is carried out based on the earthquake information, so that an efficient and accurate earthquake monitoring and early warning system is established, earthquake events can be early warned in time, and loss caused by the earthquake disasters is reduced.

title_en: Landslide catastrophe risk probability intelligent prediction method based on two-phase object particle method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and particularly relates to an intelligent landslide disaster risk prediction method based on a two-phase object particle method, which is characterized in that parameters such as rock-soil body characteristics, rainfall intensity and the like are regarded as statistically relevant multivariate random variables, the two-phase object particle method is utilized to realize numerical simulation of the whole process of rainfall-induced landslide disaster, so that probability distribution of response amounts such as sliding distance, sliding collapse range, sliding volume and the like is obtained, and the risk probability is predicted by combining disaster bearing body characteristics; and extracting random samples as an input data set according to prior distribution of each parameter variable, taking response samples obtained by simulation calculation as an output data set, adopting XGBoost model training to construct a proxy model of a two-phase object particle method, carrying out parameter inversion on slope monitoring data by using Bayesian probability inversion, dynamically updating probability distribution of response of each model, and predicting risk probability in real time according to the response distribution. The method has definite physical meaning, and improves the prediction efficiency and the prediction precision.
assignees: CHONGQING BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLOR;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Simulation experiment method and device for impact power disaster induced by ultra-thick and multi-layer water-bearing overlying strata
abstract_en: A simulation experiment method and device for ultra-thick and multi-layer water-containing overlying strata induced impact dynamic disasters are characterized by comprising a sealing box body, a horizontal loading module, a vertical elastic loading module, a transient impact triggering module, a water-containing overlying strata model and an array tube water filling module, wherein the array tube water filling module is installed at the bottom of the box body (11) through an installation hole and a sealing ring (63), the upper part of the array tube water filling module is buried in the water-containing overlying strata model, array water guide pipes (62) with different lengths are arranged in the array water guide pipes, and each water guide pipe is connected with an independent flow valve (65) and a pressure valve (64). The invention solves the difficulty of large-size rock stratum simulation through the vertical elastic loading module, and provides reliable experimental equipment for disaster simulation.
assignees: SHANDONG ENERGY GROUP NORTHWEST MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING;ZHONGKUANG DINGBEI TECH XUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel water burst test method considering disaster source substance deposition-high-pressure energy storage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunnel water burst tests, and particularly relates to a tunnel water burst test method considering disaster source material deposition-high-pressure energy storage. In the test method, the inclination angle of the launder is adjusted so that the silt mixture can flow in launders with different gradients, and the real conditions of different flow rates are shown under the condition of simulating different geology conditions of the silt mixture. And after the water injection, the high-pressure energy storage disaster source filled by the solid-liquid-gas three-phase mixture is simulated under the real geological condition. The test method implements different geological deposition processes of tunnel filling type karst cave disaster source substances and test simulation of high-pressure violent water bursting catastrophe, and has good reality and accuracy.

title_en: Multi-scale overlying strata spatial structure evolution and disaster response simulation test system and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale overlying strata spatial structure evolution and disaster response simulation test system and a working method, and relates to the technical field of mine exploitation simulation. The hydraulic pressure station is characterized by comprising a loading test host, a hydraulic pressure station, a power distribution cabinet and an industrial personal computer, wherein the loading test host comprises a base, a main frame, a first top loading unit, a second top loading unit, a bottom excavation unit, a buffering energy release device, a telescopic rod group and a rock plate stamping device, and a movable vertical plate is vertically arranged on the inner side of the main frame. The buffering energy release device comprises a buffering plate, and the buffering plate is adjacently arranged on the left side of the movable vertical plate through a spring assembly. The first top loading unit comprises a plurality of first upper pressing plates, the bottom excavation unit comprises a plurality of lower top plates, and excavation oil cylinders are arranged below the lower top plates. The invention has various working modes, realizes two-dimensional/three-dimensional simulation of overburden migration and response characteristics under the conditions of large burial depth, strong ore shock and multi-working-face continuous mining, and realizes simulation of the whole process of coal mine ore shock, inoculation and triggering.

title_en: Depth map reinforcement learning generation method for multi-task multi-criterion resource scheduling
abstract_en: The invention provides a depth map reinforcement learning generation method for multi-task multi-criterion resource scheduling, which belongs to the field of emergency resource scheduling, and converts multi-task resource scheduling problem modeling into map generation problems under the condition of target direction and multi-constraint, and comprises an offline model training stage and an online scheme generation feedback training optimization stage. The method comprises the steps of constructing a pseudo tag training data set based on an analytic hierarchy process and a genetic elite algorithm, designing a feasible solution state feature extraction unit for representing disaster points and resource point matching degree, extracting node hiding features through a graph neural network based on a feasible solution state, gradually generating a resource scheduling scheme graph by adopting reinforcement learning based on the node hiding features, and generating an countermeasure network frame by adopting conditions so that a generated result is more targeted.

title_en: Dynamic scheduling method for emergency resources under emergency situation of reservoir dam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic emergency resource scheduling method under a reservoir dam emergency situation, which comprises the steps of carrying out flood evolution simulation under the emergency situation, constructing a flood-road network coupling model containing road, placement points, flood flow rate and water depth information, predicting disaster victims according to situation information, calculating resource demands according to a resource demand prediction model, determining resource allocation related coefficients, introducing resource demand coefficients and disaster victimization severity coefficients, constructing an emergency resource fairness index based on a foundation coefficient, determining an optimal route from a resource storage point to the placement points, constructing an emergency resource transportation efficiency index based on the optimal route, constructing an emergency resource scheduling model by taking scheduling fairness and transportation efficiency as target functions, and obtaining a scheduling scheme under the dynamic situation by solving the scheduling model.

title_en: Disaster processing and drilling method, device, equipment and medium of database
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster processing and drilling method, device, equipment and medium of a database. The method comprises the steps of selecting target backup data nodes from backup data nodes of a current machine room when network connection with the local machine room is abnormal or a construction instruction is received, carrying out snapshot storage on the target backup data nodes, accessing the target backup data nodes after snapshot storage into management nodes of an island generation platform to obtain an island database system, wherein service providing objects of the island database system are cities where the corresponding machine rooms are located. The embodiment of the invention can independently provide services for each city when disasters occur, and reduce the cost of disaster recovery exercise.

title_en: Node recovery importance expected value evaluation method, system, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a node recovery importance expected value evaluation method, a system, a device and a medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining power grid operation information and a power transmission line fault probability evaluation result, and initializing an integral calculation parameter and a round of calculation parameter of sampling simulation based on the power transmission line fault probability evaluation result; sequentially identifying the power grid states of the power transmission line and the node at each time point through iterative sampling of sampling simulation of the recoverable state, removing the power transmission line and the node which do not meet the recoverable requirement in each round of sampling results, calculating the importance degree of the reserved power transmission line and the node, integrating the sampling results after all iterative rounds are finished, and calculating the importance index and the expected operation time value of the damaged power transmission line and the node based on the importance degree of the power transmission line and the node. According to the method, the node importance which considers the influence of disaster uncertainty is dynamically evaluated and updated on line, so that the identification capability of key nodes and lines of the power grid in a recovery state is remarkably improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Tank wagon leaking stoppage trainer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tank wagon leaking stoppage training device which comprises a bracket, a liquid containing barrel rotatably connected to the bracket and a collecting box arranged below the liquid containing barrel. The liquid containing barrel is internally provided with a liquid containing cavity, two sides of the liquid containing cavity are respectively connected with a liquid inlet pipe and a liquid outlet pipe, a plurality of liquid leakage pipes and plugging components matched with the liquid leakage pipes are arranged in the liquid containing cavity, the end part of each liquid leakage pipe is respectively provided with a leakage point on the outer surface of the liquid containing barrel, and the leakage points are switched between an open state and a closed state by controlling the plugging components. According to the tank car leakage stoppage training device disclosed by the invention, the liquid containing barrel capable of rotating is arranged, the leakage points capable of being controlled to be opened or closed are arranged on the outer side surface of the liquid containing barrel, the height or angle of the leakage points can be conveniently adjusted, multiple conditions can be simulated by a single training device, the effect of firefighter leakage stoppage training is improved, and the overall training cost of firefighter leakage stoppage training is reduced.

title_en: Loess-mudstone interface unstability disaster-causing simulation test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a loess-mudstone interface instability disaster simulation test device which comprises a test box, a regulating plate, loess mud layers, miniature plants and an air blast component, wherein the bottom wall of the test box is hinged to one side of the regulating plate, the loess mud layers are arranged on the regulating plate, the miniature plants are arranged on the loess mud layers, the air blast component is arranged at the top of the test box, the air blast component comprises a fixed pipe, a first motor, a supporting rod, a fan shaft, a fan blade and an air outlet head, the air outlet head is fixedly connected with the top of the test box, the air outlet head is fixedly connected with the fixed pipe, the inner wall of the fixed pipe is fixedly connected with one end of the supporting rod, the regulating plate rotates to be beneficial to regulating the angle of the loess mud layers, the condition that the loess mud layers with trees and herbaceous plants are unstable at the interfaces can be simulated, the air flow can be blown out through the air outlet head to simulate the condition that the loess mud layers with trees and herbaceous plants are blown by strong wind, and the data acquisition is more comprehensive.

title_en: Electric power facility flood disaster risk assessment method and system considering flood influence
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating flood disaster risks of an electric power facility in consideration of flood influence, which relate to the technical field of flood disaster risk evaluation of the electric power facility, collect pole height, rainfall, topography and soil data in real time, acquire historical mountain torrent influence factors and height data, preprocess the historical mountain torrent influence factors and the historical mountain torrent influence factors, construct a neural network model, take the processed rainfall, topography and soil data as a training set, the mountain torrent height is used as a label for training, then mountain torrent influence factors collected in real time are input into a trained model, the actual mountain torrent height is predicted and compared with the electric pole height, finally the safety of the electric power facilities is judged according to the comparison result, and the risk level and the overall risk index of the flood disasters are determined, so that quantitative basis is provided for decision making, and the flood fighting capacity of the electric power facilities is improved.

title_en: Urban fire disaster starting space distribution forecasting method based on deep learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth learning algorithm-based urban fire starting number space distribution forecasting method which comprises the steps of collecting original data, preprocessing the original data, determining input variables and output variables of an urban fire starting number forecasting model, wherein the input variables comprise urban land type grid data, weather factor time sequence data of a plurality of days in the past and daily fire starting number grid graph sets of the plurality of days in the past, the output variables are accumulated fire starting number grid graphs of a plurality of days in the future, constructing a depth neural network-based urban fire starting number forecasting model, the urban fire starting number forecasting model comprises an encoder and a decoder, the encoder is used for processing time sequence variables, the decoder is used for processing urban land type space variables and characteristic variables, and training and evaluating the urban fire starting number forecasting model. The method can jointly process the time characteristics and the space characteristics, has high prediction precision, and effectively improves the accuracy of urban fire risk prediction.

title_en: Extreme stormwater weather rendering method based on generation type artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application discloses an extreme stormwater weather rendering method based on a generation type artificial intelligence, which belongs to the technical field of image rendering, wherein a data set corresponding to stormwater weather is manufactured and processed in a training stage, a training set is built by using image blocks comprising characteristics of wind power, precipitation and the like, then the data are learned by using a generation type artificial intelligence network to obtain a rendering model with high simulation degree, and for new predicted precipitation data, the application can automatically process and output a stormwater weather visual effect with high sense of realism, can efficiently generate a vivid stormwater weather effect, and can achieve high visual precision, and the application can more efficiently process and display upcoming stormwater weather conditions, provide more visual and easy-to-understand weather information for public and decision makers, and effectively support emergency management and disaster prevention work.

title_en: Method and system for predicting fracture energy release of coal seam roof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety production, and discloses a method and a system for predicting fracture energy release of a coal seam roof. The method comprises the steps of calculating the maximum bending strain energy stored in the rock beam, obtaining the fracture energy release characteristic of the rock beam, obtaining the relation between the energy release capacity of the rock beam and lithology indexes and dimension indexes, researching the influence of the lithology indexes and the dimension indexes of the rock beam on the energy release coefficient by means of numerical simulation, fitting to obtain the functional relation between the lithology indexes and the energy release coefficient, and verifying the accuracy and the applicability of the expression of the rock beam fracture energy release prediction method by means of a numerical simulation method. The rock beam fracture energy release prediction method provided by the invention has a good prediction effect, can effectively avoid or reduce occurrence of roof fracture type rock burst disasters, can predict total energy released by rock beam fracture, and has important significance for safety production of mines.

title_en: Information safety protection method for robot collaborative operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information safety protection method for robot collaborative operation, which comprises the following steps of carrying out safety requirement analysis and identifying key assets and threat risk assessment, carrying out safety strategy and planning, formulating safety strategy and planning safety measures, carrying out safety implementation and configuration, carrying out real-time pre-configuration of the safety measures, carrying out safety monitoring and safety audit, carrying out emergency response and recovery of an emergency plan, formulating the emergency plan, carrying out emergency exercise and data recovery, and continuously improving and optimizing. The invention realizes the information safety protection in the cooperative operation process of the robot, and has various benefits, and the benefits jointly form an important foundation stone for guaranteeing the safe, stable and efficient operation of the robot system.
assignees: SHANGHAI YISHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Prediction analysis method and device for railway along-line gully water-gathering surface disasters based on three-dimensional geographic scene
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traffic geographic environment safety risk prediction, and particularly relates to a three-dimensional geographic scene-based prediction analysis method for disasters on a railway along a ditch, which comprises the following steps of S1, preliminarily delineating a monitoring range; the method comprises the steps of installing environment monitoring sensing equipment, S3, collecting key index information of a drainage system, S4, obtaining three-dimensional geographic model data, S5, processing the collected data, S6, calculating and analyzing ground elevation and area of a monitoring area, S7, simulating rainfall and calculating total rainfall, S8, calculating total rainwater convergence amount, S9, carrying out active flooding analysis on a ground elevation model, S10, calculating and analyzing specific positions of a water surface, water surface area and volume parameters which change along with time, and S11, predicting and evaluating water surface disasters which possibly occur. The method can solve the technical problems of insufficient real-time performance, high data acquisition cost, complex operation and high calculation difficulty in the prior art, and has good market application prospect.
assignees: GUANGXI PRODUCTION RESEARCH INSTITUTE SPACE TIME INFORMATION TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD;China railway nanning bureau group co ltd

title_en: Loess moisture migration test device and method under simulation of dry and wet circulation
abstract_en: The application discloses a loess moisture migration testing device and method under simulation of dry and wet circulation, wherein the loess moisture migration testing device comprises a testing box, an environment simulation module, a moisture migration characteristic parameter measuring module and a soil loss particle collecting module, the testing box is of a three-layer combined structure, the middle layer is an independent sample tank, the environment simulation module comprises a rainfall simulation unit and a temperature simulation unit, the rainfall simulation unit comprises a main water inlet pipe, a water tank and a rainfall spray head, the temperature simulation unit comprises a heating belt, a blower, an air inlet pipe, a temperature sensor and an air outlet, the temperature sensor is arranged on the upper side wall of the testing box, the air outlet is arranged at the top of the testing box, the moisture migration characteristic parameter measuring module comprises a soil moisture temperature sensor, a soil moisture sensor, a soil pressure meter and a pore water pressure meter, and the soil loss particle collecting module comprises a step-by-step filtering device and a laser particle size distribution meter, and the problem of revealing a deep mechanism of loess disaster is solved.

title_en: Distribution probability calculation method and system for composite flood disasters
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for calculating the distribution probability of a composite flood disaster, and relates to the technical field of disaster evaluation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a composite disaster knowledge graph based on disasters in preset time periods before and after flood of a research area; the method comprises the steps of extracting chains related to flood in a knowledge graph to construct a composite flood disaster knowledge graph, extracting upstream and downstream disaster events in the knowledge graph, determining correlation attributes of the upstream and downstream disaster events according to occurrence probability of the upstream and downstream disaster events, obtaining target disaster causing factor values, determining the values as sample data, determining the upstream and downstream disaster events with the correlation attributes as label labeling the sample data, training a model by the labeled sample data to obtain a disaster distribution probability prediction model, and inputting the target disaster causing factor values into the disaster distribution probability prediction model to process, so as to obtain distribution probabilities of various disasters belonging to indirect related disasters. The probability distribution of occurrence of the composite flood disaster in the designated area is quantitatively evaluated.

title_en: Remote sensing image landslide mapping method and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide mapping method and a related device for remote sensing images, wherein an identification model is adopted to construct an input visual angle consistency loss function, a characteristic visual angle consistency loss function and a model visual angle consistency loss function during training, so that input, characteristic and model disturbance landslide mapping results are forcedly aligned with generated weak data enhancement disturbance pseudo tags, unification of multi-visual angle disturbance is realized, disturbance space is widened, the problem that the landslide mapping has consistency and learning visual angle limitation is solved, the cost of the landslide mapping is effectively reduced, and reliable technical support is provided for meeting rapid and low-cost rescue and relief and geological disaster investigation tasks.

title_en: Underground structure for functional test of disaster accident earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to an underground structure for testing functions of earthquake rescue robots in disasters and accidents, wherein a comprehensive testing system is located in an underground space and comprises at least two testing units which are connected in series, wherein each testing unit is communicated through a channel, a passing testing device or/and an environment control device is arranged in each testing unit, the channels are selectively opened or closed through a door, a lifting device is used as a connecting channel of the ground space and the underground space and used for carrying the earthquake rescue robots to convert between the ground space and the underground space, an extreme environment simulation unit is used for simulating a comprehensive extreme environment, and a climbing testing device is connected with the testing units and the extreme environment simulation unit. The invention can simulate various emergency situations after earthquake in underground space, including extreme environment and complex terrain, and can test the earthquake rescue robot in different types according to specific requirements so as to meet application requirements in different scenes.

title_en: Real-time monitoring device and monitoring method for three-dimensional stress of sliding belt soil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring device and a monitoring method for three-dimensional stress of sliding belt soil, which relate to the technical field of landslide geological disaster monitoring, wherein the device comprises a sliding surface three-dimensional stress meter and a control terminal, the sliding surface three-dimensional stress meter comprises a mounting seat, a shell and a detection assembly, the mounting seat is arranged at the bottom of a hole of a sliding body drilling hole and is positioned on a bedrock, the shell is arranged on the mounting seat, the detection assembly is arranged on the shell and comprises a plurality of soil pressure sensors and an inertia detection unit, the soil pressure sensors are positioned on the upper side of the bedrock surface, the soil pressure sensors are arranged in included angles to monitor soil pressure in a plurality of directions, and the inertia detection unit is used for monitoring Euler angles of the sliding surface three-dimensional stress meter; the control terminal is in communication connection with the sliding surface three-dimensional stress meter through the communication power supply cable, so that the size and the direction of the sliding belt soil three-dimensional stress can be obtained, the real-time detection of the in-situ sliding belt soil stress state is realized, and the device has the multi-use scene adaptation characteristics of field layout and model experiment application.

title_en: Sea wall surmounting amount considering mangrove forest surmounting effect and surmounting risk calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the wave-crossing amount and the wave-crossing risk of a seawall by considering the wave-eliminating effect of mangrove, and relates to the technical field of coastal engineering. The method comprises the steps of obtaining typhoon path data and inputting a Holland typhoon experience model to accurately generate a typhoon field, combining a coastal storm surge numerical model to calculate offshore site tide level data, utilizing a storm surge prediction model based on SWAN to obtain wave data during typhoons, collecting historical typhoon data, sea wall and mangrove forest related information, constructing a water level-wave-vegetation-sea wall coupling model to accurately simulate the wave elimination effect of the mangrove forest, optimizing wave characteristic calculation, constructing a database, training the database through a CNN neural network model, improving the prediction precision of wave height and wave force parameters before the sea wall, calculating the wave passing amount based on the prediction parameters, providing scientific basis for wave passing risk assessment, ensuring that real-time assessment of the wave passing risk is more accurate and efficient, and effectively improving disaster prevention and reduction capability.

title_en: Drought and flood emergency prediction method and device based on artificial intelligence and satellite remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of climate prediction, in particular to a drought and waterlogging sharp turn prediction method and device based on artificial intelligence and satellite remote sensing, wherein the method comprises the following steps of determining saturated water vapor pressure deficiency and specific humidity by using a clausius-Krapolone thermodynamic equation; the method comprises the steps of calibrating a long-period memory model suitable for simulating land water reserves, extracting drought and waterlogging emergency events from a reconstructed long-series land water reserves inversion data set, dividing the combination of air temperature and drought and waterlogging emergency intensities of all grid points in a prediction river basin into a plurality of boxes with the same sample capacity by using a box scaling function, and predicting the drought and waterlogging emergency intensities of all grid points in a future period by using a scale coefficient so as to obtain a prediction result of the drought and waterlogging emergency intensities of all grid points in a target future period. Therefore, the problems that the drought and waterlogging disaster backtracking risk assessment with a long time span is difficult to realize, the evolution rule of drought and waterlogging emergency is less considered, and the drought and waterlogging emergency prediction cannot be carried out by fully utilizing the artificial intelligence technology are solved.

title_en: Device and method for preventing and controlling coal dynamic disasters of coal mine tunneling roadway
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for preventing and controlling coal rock dynamic disasters of a coal mine tunneling roadway, which relate to the technical field of coal mining and comprise a supporting unit; the gas detection unit is arranged at the top of the disaster prevention unit, the eight separation plugs are simultaneously rotated along with the coal rock in the round drilling barrel, the sealing support plays a role in sealing four air exhaust round holes, the coal rock in the round drilling barrel is conveniently moved out along with the round drilling barrel, the problem that when the drill bit is taken out, the coal rock at the head end of the drill bit cannot be guaranteed to be in a broken state, the coal rock near the head end of the drill bit cannot be completely taken out, and when the drill bit is taken out, the inside of the drill bit cannot be guaranteed to be in a vacuum state all the time, and when the drill bit is moved out, part of the coal rock in the drill bit can be separated from the drill bit is solved.

title_en: Expressway reconstruction and expansion simulation scene construction and evacuation rescue decision method and system based on SUMO
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing expressway reconstruction and expansion simulation scenes and carrying out evacuation and rescue decision-making on the same based on SUMO, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, establishing a dynamic scheme combination decision-making model based on rescue and evacuation route schemes during expressway reconstruction and expansion and combining traffic flow operation parameters; and step 2, carrying out traffic simulation during highway reconstruction and expansion by adopting SUMO simulation software to simulate the traffic running state of the reconstruction and expansion road section under the traffic accident state, and step 3, realizing a plurality of rescue and evacuation routes in the reconstruction and expansion simulation, collecting simulation data, carrying out regression fitting on a decision model, and carrying out statistics on simulation results and verification on the effectiveness of the decision model. The system comprises a model building module, a traffic simulation module and a result verification module. According to the invention, by constructing the scheme decision model and judging the proper rescue and evacuation scheme under the current traffic state according to the input traffic flow parameters, the rapid rescue and evacuation of accidents during reconstruction and expansion are achieved, and the normal traffic flow running state is effectively recovered.
assignees: JIANGXI GANYUE EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Mining area earth surface subsidence prediction method based on VMD-SSA-LSTM
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of address disaster prediction, and discloses a mining area earth surface subsidence prediction method based on VMD-SSA-LSTM, aiming at improving the accuracy and reliability of earth surface subsidence prediction. The mining area earth surface subsidence prediction method comprises the steps of obtaining mining area multi-time phase earth surface subsidence data, preprocessing the data, decomposing the preprocessed data by adopting variation modal decomposition, extracting natural modal functions of different frequency components, carrying out singular spectrum analysis on main IMFs, constructing and training a long-period memory network model, inputting a time sequence after SSA reconstruction, outputting a future earth surface subsidence predicted value, optimizing model parameters by using a cross verification method, and finally carrying out earth surface subsidence prediction by using a model after training.
assignees: SHANXI JINCHENG ANTHRACITE MINING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;SHANXI JINCHENG SONGYU COAL IND CO LTD;UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Toughness assessment method and system for intelligent power distribution network in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness evaluation method and system of an intelligent power distribution network under extreme weather, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing the fault condition of the power distribution network under extreme weather and establishing a fault model under extreme weather; simulating an extreme weather scene, reducing the extreme weather scene through a clustering algorithm, obtaining time-varying fault rate of each branch of the power distribution network, extracting load and renewable energy source output by adopting a sampling method, constructing a power supply recovery strategy model and a toughness evaluation index aiming at the maximum power failure load, and evaluating the toughness of the power distribution network. According to the method, the influence of extreme weather on the power distribution network is quantified through the fault model, and the toughness evaluation index system of the power distribution network is established, so that the disaster resistance of the power distribution network can be quantitatively evaluated, the planning of the power distribution network is guided, and the capacity of the power distribution network for coping with the extreme weather is improved.

title_en: Geological disaster risk assessment method and system based on slope unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the risk of a geological disaster based on a slope unit, which belong to the technical field of the risk evaluation of the geological disaster, and comprise the steps of firstly collecting the formation condition of the geological disaster, secondly identifying and monitoring the risk of the geological disaster based on the slope unit, thirdly, carrying out ground investigation, fourthly, carrying out geophysical prospecting and drilling, fifth, mountain engineering and engineering geological profile measurement, sixth, carrying out the test and experiment of sliding body soil, sliding belt soil, dangerous rock, collapse and parent rock and a base, seventh, and evaluating the risk of the geological disaster based on the slope unit.
assignees: SICHUAN YIBIN GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING SURVEY INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power network economic dispatching method based on PSO and DDPG algorithm parallel training
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and power grid dispatching. The application provides an electric power network economic dispatching method based on PSO and DDPG algorithm parallel training. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the DDPG algorithm is adopted to schedule the power system network, the PSO algorithm is adopted to optimize the model and the training parameters in the DDPG algorithm, the optimal network model and the optimal parameters are adopted to train the DDPG agent, adaptability of the agent to the scheduling task of the power system is enhanced, the computing complexity is lower, and dimension disasters are avoided for high dimension. The agent parallel training is beneficial to guaranteeing the robustness of the final agent due to the randomness.

title_en: Method, system, device and medium for predicting vehicle insurance claim amount under natural disaster condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle insurance claim amount prediction method, a system, a device and a medium under a natural disaster condition, wherein the vehicle insurance claim amount prediction method under the natural disaster condition comprises the steps of obtaining a data set of vehicle insurance claim data, dividing the data set into a training set, a testing set and a verification set, wherein the training set is used as a sample set for model training, constructing a base model and a meta model, wherein the base model comprises a time sequence base model and a non-time sequence base model, respectively inputting the training set data into the time sequence base model and the non-time sequence base model for training to obtain a prediction result of the base model, and after the base model is trained, inputting the prediction results of the time sequence base model and the non-time sequence base model on the verification set as input, inputting the meta model for prediction model training to obtain a final prediction result. The invention can realize the prediction of the risk and claim amount of each region in the occurrence of natural disasters.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency virtual fire-extinguishing actual combat simulation method, device and medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency virtual fire-extinguishing actual combat simulation method, a fire-fighting emergency virtual fire-extinguishing actual combat simulation device and a medium thereof. According to the invention, a plurality of types of virtual fire scene models which can be dynamically adjusted are constructed, a plurality of real fire environments can be highly restored, the fire spreading speed, the fire extinguishing difficulty level and the environmental factors are automatically adjusted according to training requirements, meanwhile, the system integrates basic knowledge, professional teaching content and analysis and experience summary of actual fire-fighting cases of water-based, carbon dioxide and dry powder extinguishers, comprehensive and deep fire-fighting training experience is provided for students through graphics context, video and interactive learning modules, a plurality of users are allowed to log in and form a virtual fire team through team cooperation simulation functions, and collaborative fire extinguishing operation is performed in a common fire scene, so that team cooperation capability and emergency response capability of the students are cultivated.
assignees: SHANTOU POWER PLANT HUANENG GUANGDONG ENERGY DEV CO LTD;BEIJING SIFANG AUTOMATION CO

title_en: Business continuity prediction simulation system and simulation method for performing agency disaster dual-track work process
title_ko: 기관 재난 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 수행을 위한 업무연속성 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a work continuity prediction simulation system, a simulation method, and a program for performing an institutional disaster dual track work process. More specifically, the work continuity prediction simulation system for performing an institutional disaster dual track work process comprises: a scenario setting unit for setting a scenario by inputting a variable; and a strategy prediction simulation model unit for generating simulation data by predicting an effect on a work continuity planning step, work continuity of manpower, work load, and spare manpower according to the passage of time for each scenario according to the variable.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기관 재난 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 수행을 위한 업무연속성 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템, 시뮬레이션 방법 및 프로그램에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 기관 재난 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 수행을 위한 업무연속성 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템으로서, 변수를 입력하여 시나리오를 설정하는 시나리오 설정부; 및 상기 변수에 따른 시나리오별로 시간의 흐름에 따라 업무연속성계획 단계, 인력의 업무연속성, 업무부하, 여유인력에 미치는 영향을 예측하여 시뮬레이션 데이터를 생성하는 전략예측 시뮬레이션 모델부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 기관 재난 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 수행을 위한 업무연속성 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV INDUSTRY COOPERATION GROUP KYUNG HEE UNIV

title_en: Power grid equipment early warning method and device based on cold wave path tracking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power grid, in particular to a power grid equipment early warning method and device based on chill path tracking, comprising the following steps of carrying out chill event identification based on numerical weather forecast data of a research area; determining HYSPLIT mode three-dimensional track simulated driving fields based on numerical weather forecast data corresponding to the period of a cold and tide event, carrying out iterative computation by taking selected particles and corresponding element information thereof as HYSPLIT mode input to obtain displacement tracks of the particles, and carrying out early warning on grid equipment of a research area based on the displacement tracks of the particles. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the tracing of the chill path and the prediction of the future moving direction can be realized, and the early warning is sent to the power grid equipment by combining the chill influence range and the cooling degree, so that the data support is provided for the emergency command decision making.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Mine water disaster simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine water disaster simulation, in particular to a mine water disaster simulation system and method. The system comprises a well space network system construction module, a dynamic water flooding numerical simulation module, a disaster avoidance route retrieval module and a disaster avoidance route retrieval module, wherein the well space network system construction module is used for generating a dotted line structure representing a mine tunnel network, the dynamic water flooding numerical simulation module is used for simulating a dynamic path of water flow in a mine water disaster process, the disaster avoidance route retrieval module is used for retrieving the shortest escape route according to a real-time tunnel network flooding state when the mine water disaster occurs, the system comprises the steps of setting water bursting time, obtaining the tunnel flooding state through water disaster simulation, inputting a disaster avoidance starting point set and a disaster avoidance end point set, applying for a dynamic storage space dist, the length of the dynamic storage space dist is the number of tunnel nodes, the shortest distance from a source point to each vertex is used for storing, and the value of dist represents the tunnel length after multi-factor weight correction. The technical scheme can comprehensively, real-timely and accurately simulate the mine water damage process, and provides technical support for mine water damage prevention and control and emergency rescue.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Water and mud gushing prediction method based on comprehensive advanced geological prediction fault fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting water and mud bursting based on comprehensive advanced geological prediction fault fracture zones, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction, wherein the scale of the fault fracture zones is obtained by utilizing a comprehensive prediction model of the fault fracture zones based on polynomial naive Bayes through the possibility level, the approaching precursor level, the rock mass integrity level, the drilling condition level, the seismic wave reflection method level and the geological radar method level of the fault fracture zones, if no fault fracture zones exist, no water and mud bursting exists, and if the fault fracture zones exist, the water and mud bursting level of the fault fracture zones cannot be predicted by utilizing a prediction model of the water and mud bursting level of the fault fracture zones based on a genetic algorithm and a support vector machine, and then the water and mud bursting level of the fault fracture zones is predicted by combining the water and water diversion level of the fault fracture zones, the rock mass integrity level, the ground water development level and the surface water supply condition level.

title_en: Emergency treatment method and system for urban rainfall
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency treatment method and system for urban rainfall, and relates to the technical field of emergency treatment for rainfall disasters. Further, a disaster tree model is constructed by combining a machine learning algorithm and a fault tree analysis method, and the association and the influence relation of the historical rainfall disasters are identified. Based on disaster template data and a preset historical emergency treatment scheme, the system analyzes and optimizes a disaster prediction model, and achieves real-time prediction of disaster information and generation of the emergency treatment scheme. And adopting a simulated annealing algorithm to optimize an emergency treatment scheme, and ensuring optimal response under different disaster grades. According to the invention, through multi-level data analysis and algorithm optimization, the accuracy and efficiency of emergency response are improved, and the occurrence probability and loss of disasters such as urban waterlogging are reduced.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION TOBACCO COMPANY LIUZHOU COMPANY;CENTRAL & SOUTHERN CHINA MUNICIPAL ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Nonlinear dynamic disaster deep well ground pressure monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep well ground pressure monitoring and early warning method and system for nonlinear dynamic disasters, and relates to the technical field of geological engineering and disaster early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of selecting state variables and control variables according to a mutation theory, a gray theory, a Verhulst model theory, a Verhulst anti-function mode theory and a nonlinear dynamics theory, and analyzing the variables and key parameters to obtain analysis results; the method comprises the steps of analyzing a rock mass instability time, predicting the rock mass instability time according to the analysis result to obtain a prediction result, simulating the process of deformation development of the rock mass to instability according to the prediction result to obtain a predicted rock mass instability time, describing a dynamic relationship among observation sequences by taking an acoustic emission time sequence, a stress time sequence and a displacement time sequence as the observation sequences and determining inversion parameters by using an inversion theory, and evaluating the stability of the rock mass according to the prediction result, the predicted rock mass instability time and the inversion parameters to obtain an early warning result. The invention can realize comprehensive evaluation and early warning of the stability state of the rock mass.

title_en: Security protection equipment and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security monitoring, in particular to security equipment and a monitoring method, which are used for preprocessing historical data of disaster situations, simulating the data to obtain ideal escape paths, generating a data set training model by training data and corresponding ideal escape path data, inputting verification data into the response speed and decision accuracy of the verification model, setting the training model with qualified decision accuracy in the security equipment, automatically generating a plurality of escape paths according to the disaster situations based on the data acquired by cameras, transmitting instructions to a signal receiver based on the single escape paths, and feeding back the signal receiver based on the received instructions. The security monitoring system of the invention autonomously judges and gives a response scheme to provide timely and accurate escape guidance for personnel evacuation when facing to a disaster, and avoids serious casualties caused by untimely personnel evacuation.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKE GOLDHORSE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating damage risk of urban building glass curtain wall
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of urban building risk assessment, in particular to an assessment method for the risk of damaging an urban building glass curtain wall. The method comprises the steps of firstly considering the influence of wind direction in simulating urban building wind disasters, reflecting regional wind disaster dangers more objectively, secondly fully considering three-dimensional characteristics of urban space wind fields when throwing objects are simulated, ensuring the accuracy of the impacted situation of the glass curtain wall, and then analyzing the damaged risk of the glass curtain wall by constructing a building glass curtain wall impact situation database. The method realizes accurate prediction and real-time assessment of the damage risk of the glass curtain wall in the target city building group through means of fine data collection, three-dimensional model construction, physical process simulation, probability analysis and the like, and provides powerful support for urban wind-induced disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Power line inspection road risk assessment method, device, computer equipment, storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a power line patrol road risk assessment method, a device, a computer device, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining landslide disaster data according to remote sensing images of a road area where an electric power line patrol road is located, building a landslide database, wherein the landslide database comprises weather, geology and remote sensing information of the road area, obtaining a plurality of landslide influence factors according to the landslide database, building a landslide influence factor data set, building a landslide total sample set according to landslide sample points and non-landslide sample points, selecting a target landslide influence factor, building a landslide sample set, training a gradient hoisting tree model based on a training sample set and a test sample set, obtaining a landslide risk assessment model, and performing risk assessment on the electric power line patrol road. The method can meet the comprehensiveness and instantaneity of risk assessment, continuously improve the accuracy and reliability of prediction, and remarkably enhance the prediction capability of unbalanced sample data.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction method using autoregressive and cyclic neural network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster prediction method utilizing an autoregressive and cyclic neural network model, which comprises the following steps of S1, white noise detection, S2, stability detection, S3, ARMA model fitting, S4, ARMA model prediction, S5, RNN model prediction, model training of input of detected data into the RNN model to obtain a trained RNN model, and S6, ending. In the invention, the ARMA model can capture the trend and periodicity in time series data, and the RNN neural network can process long-term dependency in the data, so that the dynamic change of geological disasters can be better understood. By combining the two methods, the time and space information of the data can be utilized more comprehensively, and the accuracy and reliability of geological disaster occurrence are improved. The method can more effectively predict the occurrence of geological disasters.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANFU NEW DISTRICT BEILIGONG INNOVATION EQUIPMENT RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle forest fire smoke detection method based on deep learning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image recognition, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle forest fire smoke detection method based on a deep learning method, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a scene image of a forest fire; the method comprises the steps of constructing a flame smoke recognition network model, inputting a scene image into the flame smoke recognition network model for training to obtain a first model, storing the first model in an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring a coordinate position of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a coordinate position of smoke or flame in a pixel coordinate system when flame or smoke is detected, marking the coordinate position as a first coordinate and a second coordinate respectively, calculating a predicted flame or smoke position according to the second coordinate of the first coordinate to serve as a third coordinate of the flame or smoke position, and sending the third coordinate and an alarm signal to a background. Therefore, the invention also converts the fire disaster point by different coordinates, thereby rapidly predicting the specific positions of the flame and the smoke, realizing rapid report of the fire disaster point and improving the disaster relief efficiency.

title_en: Landslide hazard risk evaluation method and system based on transmission tower failure model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster risk evaluation research, in particular to a landslide disaster risk evaluation method and system based on a transmission tower failure model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detailed investigation on a landslide area to obtain a deformation relation between a transmission tower and the ground surface, obtaining a deformation failure model and a mechanism of the transmission tower by utilizing FLAC3D and ANSYS numerical simulation software, calculating the annual instability probability of the landslide by adopting a FLAC3D-Monte Carlo method, establishing a vulnerability evaluation model of the transmission tower under the action of the landslide, and completing the landslide risk evaluation of the transmission tower based on a model of risk=risk×vulnerability×economic value. The invention also provides a corresponding risk evaluation system. According to the method, the transmission tower failure model is built, landslide deformation is associated with the tower failure, quantitative and fine assessment of the risk of the transmission tower in the landslide area is achieved, and a new technical means is provided for geological disaster risk management and control of power grid facilities in the mountain area.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method and device based on intelligent model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a fire early-warning method and device based on an intelligent model, wherein the fire early-warning method and device comprises the steps of obtaining fire history data, wherein the fire history data comprise fire history image data, fire history sound data, fire history temperature data and water vapor evaporation degree data, extracting classification characteristics of the fire history data, screening characteristic mutation data from the classification characteristics, inputting the characteristic mutation data and corresponding pre-divided fire early-warning types into a first fire early-warning training model to obtain a trained first fire early-warning training model, inputting the first fire data into the trained first fire early-warning training model to obtain output specific fire early-warning type data, training different fire types and mutation characteristics among different fire types to obtain characteristic data among different fire types, improving accuracy, timeliness and sensitivity of fire identification, and improving diversity and accuracy of fire early-warning.

title_en: Fire image detection method and device based on improvement YOLOv5
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire disaster image detection method and device based on an improvement YOLOv, and belongs to the field of image detection. The method comprises the steps of processing a fire image dataset, dividing the processed fire image dataset into a training set and a testing set according to a preset proportion, constructing YOLOv target detection models, wherein the YOLOv target detection models comprise a CBMA module and an upper and lower feature fusion module, performing model training on the YOLOv target detection models by adopting a Bayesian optimization algorithm based on sample data in the training set and the testing set to obtain an improved YOLOv target detection model, and performing fire image detection by using the improved YOLOv target detection model.
