The method provided by the invention optimizes the target detection accuracy under the condition of poor visible light imaging effect, and uses a Bayesian optimization algorithm to carry out super-parameter tuning so as to achieve the optimal detection performance.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RESEARCH INSTITUTE SAFETY ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Collapse geological disaster risk evaluation method and system for transformer substation structure damage model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk evaluation research, in particular to a collapse geological disaster risk evaluation method and system of a transformer substation structure damage model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detailed investigation on a collapse dangerous rock body, evaluating stability by adopting a red flat projection graph method, calculating instability probability by adopting a Monte Carlo method, simulating a collapse dynamics process by utilizing FLAC3D and PFC3D coupling, completing dangerous evaluation by combining ArcGIS, establishing a substation electrical facility physical model and a structural damage model, establishing a vulnerability evaluation model based on collapse rock impact strength and electrical facility structural resistance, carrying out risk evaluation by adopting a matrix analysis method, and estimating economic loss. The invention also comprises a corresponding system implementation. According to the method, through combination of geological investigation, numerical simulation and structural analysis, comprehensive quantitative evaluation of the collapse disaster risk of the transformer substation is realized, the accuracy, reliability and pertinence of evaluation are improved, and scientific basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction of the transformer substation in the mountain area.

title_en: Signal processing method, transmission method, electronic equipment and angle detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a signal processing method, a transmission method, electronic equipment and an angle detection device, wherein the rotation angle data are generated and processed in the installation process of a drilling stress meter, so that the rotation angle of the drilling stress meter can be accurately monitored in real time and converted into a signal which is adaptive to the section size of a connecting device for transmission. Through the frequency band modulation to the signal, can effectively solve the problem of signal attenuation in the deep hole environment, ensure that the signal still can stable transmission in complicated environment, improve data accuracy and the transmission reliability in the drilling stress meter installation to the efficiency of geological disaster prediction and prevention has been promoted.
assignees: UROICA SHANDONG MINING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir forecast and dispatch integrated method
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir forecast scheduling integrated method which comprises the steps of dividing water collecting units of a reservoir water collecting area according to DEM topographic data, simulating hydrologic processes of the water collecting units by adopting a hydrologic model to obtain yield of the water collecting units, constructing a topological relation between an upstream river channel of the reservoir and a reservoir area, simulating by adopting a hydrodynamic model based on the yield to obtain flow merging data, constructing a flood discharge gate and a weir drainage model, setting a reservoir scheduling scheme, calculating reservoir drainage flow, constructing a reservoir area regulation model to obtain reservoir area water level in a forecast period, and pushing the reservoir scheduling scheme based on the reservoir area water level in the forecast period. The method of the invention realizes the accurate simulation of reservoir forecast scheduling, provides an effective tool for flood control and disaster reduction and water resource optimization scheduling, and has important practical value.

title_en: Mine fire infrared visual feature screening and feature fusion monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine fire infrared visual feature screening and feature fusion monitoring method which mainly comprises the steps of installing a thermal imager in a mine area to be monitored, segmenting a fire area or an interference heat source area by adopting an improved LCM model, constructing a data set and screening out key features of the fire area. And combining the constructed data sets, establishing a key characteristic data set of the mine fire disaster, training a classifier model, and storing the trained classifier model. The mine fire monitoring system adopts an improved LCM model to divide a fire suspected region appearing in the video stream of the thermal infrared imager, detects whether mine fire exists in real time through a trained classifier model, and starts fire alarming when the mine fire is detected. The mine fire infrared monitoring method can overcome the defects of the existing monitoring method, and can improve the identification speed, accuracy and reliability of early fire on the basis of realizing underground large-scale monitoring, thereby meeting the actual requirements of coal mine safety production.

title_en: Quantum and deep learning combined self-adaptive dangerous rock mass identification and fine characterization holographic projection visualization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for self-adaptively identifying a dangerous rock block and finely characterizing holographic projection visualization by combining quantum and deep learning, which belongs to the technical field of slope stability and geological disaster monitoring and comprises the steps of acquiring slope point cloud data based on data acquired by an unmanned plane; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing point cloud data to obtain a preprocessed data set, constructing a quantum random forest model and an environment factor self-adaptive algorithm, training the quantum random forest model based on the preprocessed data set to obtain a dangerous rock block self-adaptive automatic identification model, obtaining fine characterization information based on a quantum machine learning algorithm, a big data model and the dangerous rock block automatic identification model, conducting personalized high-precision modeling on the fine characterization information, and importing modeling data into a holographic projection model to generate a three-dimensional visual model. The invention effectively solves the technical problem of automatically identifying dangerous rock blocks and fine characteristics thereof on a steep slope.

title_en: Fire detection method based on lightweight YOLO v5s
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire detection method based on lightweight YOLO v5s, which relates to the field of computer vision, and comprises the steps of firstly collecting fire pictures in various scenes from a network, and establishing a training set, a detection set and a verification set; then improving the network structure of YOLO v5s, replacing Conv modules in the main network with ODConv modules, replacing partial C3 modules with ConvNextBlock modules, reducing the network layer number of C3 in the main network and the detection head, adding an attention mechanism in the Neck part of the network, changing the loss function to GIOU, and finally training and optimizing the network structure. Compared with a standard YOLO v5s network, the improved YOLO v5s network structure improves the accuracy of the model for fire disaster identification, and greatly reduces the size, network parameters and calculation amount of the model.

title_en: Cable tunnel fire early warning method, device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a cable tunnel fire disaster early warning method, a device, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining current monitoring data of a cable tunnel, determining a target fire early-warning model, wherein the current monitoring data comprise current monitoring values of a plurality of preset influence factors, training the target fire early-warning model by using a plurality of historical monitoring data, each historical monitoring data comprises historical monitoring values of the corresponding preset influence factors, determining initial model parameters of the target fire early-warning model by using a genetic algorithm, and inputting the current monitoring data into the target fire early-warning model to obtain a predicted fire result corresponding to the current monitoring data output by the target fire early-warning model. The fire disaster prediction result can be accurately obtained by adopting the method.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Flood risk management method, system, computer and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood risk management method, a flood risk management system, a flood risk management computer and a flood risk management storage medium, wherein the flood risk management method comprises the following steps of carrying out numerical modeling based on surface characteristics by adopting a digital twin technology, and establishing a hydrodynamic model based on a shallow water equation; and optimizing the hydraulic building operation scheme based on the flood risk data, calling a hydrodynamic model, simulating the water network water flow evolution process of the hydraulic building optimized operation scheme, and monitoring and managing the water network. By combining the hydrodynamic model with flood risk assessment, the intelligent optimization algorithm can be automatically invoked to schedule hydraulic structures such as gates and dams while the flood risk is found, the flood risk is dealt with in real time, the influence of potential disasters is reduced, compared with traditional manual scheduling, delay or misjudgment caused by manual intervention can be reduced, and the efficiency and the accuracy of flood control scheduling are improved.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCIAL WATER CONSERVANCY INVESTMENT JIANGHE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGXI LAOHE ENG ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Intelligent early warning method and system for underground engineering dynamic disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent early warning method and system for underground engineering dynamic disasters, which relate to the technical field of underground engineering dynamic disasters, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring microseismic history monitoring data of underground engineering; preprocessing microseismic historical monitoring data to obtain relevant time sequence parameters to obtain a reconstructed signal, obtaining a plurality of rolling statistical features of the reconstructed signal, selecting a preset number of rolling statistical features according to importance to form a rolling statistical feature matrix, constructing an underground engineering dynamic disaster prediction model, inputting a rolling statistical feature matrix dataset into the underground engineering dynamic disaster prediction model for training, obtaining real-time microseismic monitoring data, extracting a real-time rolling statistical feature matrix dataset, inputting the real-time rolling statistical feature matrix dataset into the trained underground engineering dynamic disaster prediction model, and outputting disaster early warning results. The invention realizes the efficient, accurate and intelligent early warning of underground engineering dynamic disasters.

title_en: Campus fire disaster evaluation method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The application relates to a campus fire evaluation method and system based on a neural network, and relates to the technical field of campus fires; the evaluation indexes comprise system management, training management, fire-fighting facility equipment management and key fire-fighting place management, a judgment matrix is constructed through a Delphi expert scoring method, weight values of all evaluation indexes are calculated, an initial weight value and a threshold value of a BP neural network are optimized based on a genetic algorithm to obtain a GA-BP neural network model, original input data are subjected to dimension reduction processing based on a principal component analysis method, and fire safety risk level is predicted through the trained GA-BP neural network model based on the input data subjected to dimension reduction to obtain fire risk level.

title_en: Large-diameter drilling depth design method based on roadway surrounding rock energy storage partition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-diameter drilling depth design method based on roadway surrounding rock energy storage partition, which belongs to the technical field of deep-buried roadway rock burst disaster prevention and control and comprises the following steps of A, collecting site data; the method comprises the steps of determining the mechanical properties of coal and rock, determining the regional energy storage theory of the near-field surrounding rock of the roadway, performing numerical simulation calculation, performing energy monitoring, constructing a dynamic energy regional evolution model of the surrounding rock of the roadway, designing the depth of a large-diameter pressure relief drilling hole according to the range of the regional energy storage region of the surrounding rock of the roadway, and performing inspection and optimization. According to the method, a numerical simulation means is utilized, the range of the energy storage area is analyzed by constructing a roadway surrounding rock dynamic energy partition evolution model, so that the design depth of the large-diameter drilling depth for coal construction is determined, whether the design of the large-diameter drilling depth is reasonable is determined by judging whether the range of the roadway surrounding rock energy storage area is reduced or moved to the deep part, and therefore the pressure relief effect evaluation of the roadway surrounding rock of the energy storage partition is more accurate.

title_en: Material data processing method based on deep learning and model training
abstract_en: The invention discloses a material data processing method based on deep learning and model training, in particular to the field of data processing, which comprises the steps of collecting the numbers of drinking water, tents, emergency foods and iodine from a material data repository, obtaining the numbers of wounded persons in a disaster area and the numbers of survivors in the disaster area from a site after a local earthquake, preprocessing data, inputting the preprocessed data into a convolutional neural network model for training, the method comprises the steps of inputting past seismic data into a trained model for application and verifying whether the past seismic data reach preset accuracy, conveying an output result to a client, correcting the output result according to an output instruction, carrying out inventory prediction and demand analysis on the model, judging whether the model can be used for subsequent events according to the analysis result and the output instruction, greatly improving the efficiency of classifying rescue materials when the earthquake happens, and reducing the error rate.

title_en: Tunnel face surrounding rock grade prediction method and system based on while-drilling ultrasound
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rock and soil center survey, and in particular relates to a method and a system for predicting the surrounding rock grade of a tunnel face based on ultrasonic while drilling, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining ultrasonic while drilling parameters of a tunnel face drilling test; and obtaining the surrounding rock grade of the current tunnel face according to the current ultrasonic parameters while drilling of the tunnel face and the constructed drilling coefficient-surrounding rock grade relation library, and finishing the prediction of the surrounding rock grade of the tunnel face based on the ultrasonic while drilling. According to the invention, the current face surrounding rock grade is predicted efficiently and accurately through drilling parameters, the efficiency of on-site data acquisition is improved, the dependence on the working experience of on-site operators is eliminated, the construction cost is reduced, and engineering disasters are prevented.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV FUJIAN TECHNOLOGY;FUJIAN HUICHUAN INTERNET OF THINGS TECH SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic analysis method and system for advanced geological forecast of elastic wave method tunnel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological engineering construction, and discloses an elastic wave method tunnel advanced geological forecast automatic analysis method and system, which solve the problems of less training samples, poor universality of intelligent model engineering and low automation level in the prior art that artificial intelligence is applied to the research of tunnel advanced geological forecast analysis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining elastic wave method parameter data by identifying an elastic wave method parameter image, establishing an elastic wave method parameter database, establishing a classifier classification principle by combining a rock mass mechanics theory, a geological disaster mechanism and the like and establishing a mapping relation between key geophysical prospecting parameters of the elastic wave method and geological indexes and geological quality, and finally, establishing a classifier model according to the classifier classification principle by adopting a machine learning method, obtaining training and testing samples based on the elastic wave method parameter database, and training and verifying the model. The model can be used for realizing the automatic analysis of the whole real-time process, thereby improving the accuracy and efficiency of the analysis.

title_en: Typhoon disaster-based power transmission network performance evaluation method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network performance evaluation method, a device, a terminal device and a storage medium based on typhoon disasters, which constructs a power transmission network model containing geographic factors according to the electrical information, topological information, geographic information and equipment information of each structural member in a power transmission network, fully considers the geographic factors of the structural members, further constructs a typhoon time-varying model for predicting the wind speed and wind direction variation trend of typhoons under the influence of the geographic factors according to typhoon parameters and geographic information, the influence of wind direction on the power transmission network is fully considered, then the failure probability of independent failures of each structural member in the power transmission network and the related failure probability affecting the failures of other structural members are calculated, the correlation among the structures in the power transmission network is fully considered, and finally the performance evaluation index capable of accurately measuring the power transmission network to cope with typhoon disaster performance is calculated according to a plurality of failure simulation scenes, distribution probabilities, typhoon time-varying models and the power transmission network models.

title_en: Hail forecasting method and device based on single parameter Shan Bingyun micro-physical parameterization
abstract_en: The application relates to a hail forecasting method and device based on single parameter Shan Bingyun micro-physical parameterization. The method comprises the steps of determining hail particle spectrum distribution based on the diameter of the hail particles, sequentially determining the relation between the diameter of the hail particles and the mass of the hail particles and the falling speed of the hail particles, determining the slope of the hail particle spectrum distribution spectrum based on the relation between the diameter of the hail particles and the mass of the hail particles, determining the final falling speed of the hail particles based on the relation between the diameter of the hail particles and the falling speed of the hail particles, and simulating the hail formation conversion process at the upper temperature and the lower temperature respectively based on the hail particle spectrum distribution and the final falling speed of the hail particles with the slope determined, so as to obtain the hail weather forecast of the whole process. By adopting the method, the hail weather can be accurately predicted by a numerical prediction mode, so that auxiliary decision information is conveniently provided for weather disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Side slope collapse risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood and drought disaster data processing, and provides a slope collapse risk assessment method and a system, wherein the slope collapse risk assessment method comprises the steps of constructing a plurality of grid units based on a surface structure of a research area, and constructing a plurality of data matrixes; the method comprises the steps of obtaining future rainfall probability distribution, generating a future rainfall scene library, constructing a soil hydrologic mechanism model, obtaining a plurality of flood peak element results based on the future rainfall scene library and the soil hydrologic mechanism model to calculate uncertainty, obtaining a hydrologic mechanism data set, establishing a fault tree model of a slope collapse event, evaluating slope collapse risk expectations, and evaluating accuracy of the slope collapse risk expectations according to the uncertainty. By establishing a data matrix related to a time scale, the model simulates the whole hydrologic cycle process, predicts and understands the hydrologic process more deeply, and can obtain a dynamic slope condition change process, and quantitatively evaluate the slope collapse risk expectation and the expected accuracy.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCIAL WATER CONSERVANCY INVESTMENT JIANGHE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGXI LAOHE ENG ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Integrated control method for rock burst, gas outburst and dust composite disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal and rock dynamic disaster prevention and control, in particular to an integral prevention and control method for rock burst, gas outburst and dust composite disasters, which mainly comprises the following steps: firstly, drilling a plurality of pressure relief holes into coal bodies in a transportation gate way and a return air gate way, performing gas extraction on the pressure relief holes, then performing secondary drilling on the pressure relief holes to form deep gas extraction holes and deep coal seam water injection holes, performing gas extraction on the deep gas extraction holes and water injection on the deep coal seam water injection holes at the same time, and finally performing grouting plugging. According to the invention, the preliminary pressure relief is carried out on the coal body, the gas accumulation of the coal rock body at the shallow part of the roadway is reduced, and then the deep gas extraction and water injection are carried out simultaneously, so that the deep gas extraction of the coal face and the water injection of the deep coal bed are mutually intersected in the coal body and matched with each other, the effects of extracting the gas from the deep coal bed, wetting and softening the coal body and improving the physical and mechanical properties of the coal rock body are more effectively achieved, and the pressure relief-extraction-water injection integrated prevention and control are realized.
assignees: PINGDINGSHAN TIANAN COAL MINING CO LTD;UNIV LIAONING

title_en: Flood early warning method based on rainfall multilayer perception
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster prediction, and discloses a flood early warning method based on rainfall multilayer perception; the method comprises the steps of collecting meteorological parameter data, topographic parameter data, hydrologic soil data and artificial activity data, preprocessing the collected meteorological parameter data, topographic parameter data, hydrologic soil data and artificial activity data to obtain a meteorological feature data set, a topographic feature data set, a hydrologic soil feature data set and an artificial activity feature data set, fusing the meteorological feature data set, the topographic feature data set, the hydrologic soil feature data set and the artificial activity feature data set to obtain a comprehensive feature data set, training according to the comprehensive feature data set to obtain a flood risk prediction model, predicting the flood risk index through the flood risk prediction model, comparing the predicted flood risk index with a preset flood risk index threshold value, judging whether flood warning is needed, and facilitating workers to accurately formulate flood prevention measures.

title_en: Educational data safety emergency response and recovery system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses an artificial intelligence-based educational data security emergency response and recovery system and method. Firstly, acquiring education related data, generating an initial education data matrix, calculating sensitivity, similarity and association strength, performing risk assessment on the initial education data matrix, secondly, performing network anomaly detection on the processed education data matrix, enabling the education data to be invaded by a network when in an anomaly state, starting an emergency response scheme, training a BP neural network to obtain a BP neural network model, realizing education data risk prediction, and finally, recovering missing or damaged education data according to education data risk prediction results, performing network security situation assessment, and realizing early security emergency response. The invention realizes the purposes of safety emergency response and recovery by analyzing and evaluating the educational data, and the method is accurate and objective.

title_en: Digital twin emergency drilling implementation system based on intelligent oil field station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin emergency drilling implementation system based on an intelligent oilfield station, which comprises a safety evaluation module, an emergency drilling module and a personnel evacuation sensing and avoiding module. The system not only can accurately identify the dangerous factors in the oil field station, but also can simulate a real emergency scene when a fire disaster occurs, dynamically adjust the drilling process, plan the personnel evacuation path in real time according to the change of the fire disaster, and finally ensure the personnel safety and the high-efficiency management of equipment of the oil field station under the emergency condition.
assignees: SHENZHEN JIA YUN TONG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Port rainfall runoff simulation and waterlogging forecasting method and system based on SWMM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a port rainfall runoff simulation and waterlogging forecasting method and system based on SWMM, which are used for helping to improve drainage capacity of port areas and reduce occurrence of flood disasters, and comprise the following steps: dividing a sub-catchment area of the simulation area by using a Thiessen polygon method in the ArcGIS, adjusting according to actual conditions, and deriving into an inp format; setting basic parameters of an SWMM (single-wire-multiple-wire) model, such as a rainfall reappearance period, sub-catchment area parameters and the like, operating the SWMM model to identify nodes and pipes which are easy to overload, adjusting the rainfall reappearance period to determine the maximum bearable rainfall intensity of an area, and 4, selecting LID facilities for layout, solving by using an optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal solution, and relieving or solving the waterlogging problem. According to the method, dynamic rainfall processes are simulated based on the SWMM model, waterlogging risks in different rainfall reproduction periods are estimated, waterlogging is relieved by optimizing arrangement of LID facilities, and support is provided for optimizing management of a port drainage system.

title_en: Power distribution network equipment vulnerability assessment method under extreme scene and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating vulnerability of power distribution network equipment in an extreme scene and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of disaster influence evaluation of power equipment; the method comprises the steps of calculating fault probabilities of a distribution transformer and a circuit based on water accumulation height and environmental factors, sampling faults based on the fault probabilities of the distribution transformer and the circuit, determining which components are likely to be faulty, and outputting a fault component list and the fault probabilities. The method improves the accuracy of vulnerability evaluation of the power system through the water accumulation dynamic simulation and the equipment failure probability calculation.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-disaster cooperative treatment method during coal mine tunnel tunneling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-element disaster cooperative treatment method during coal mine tunnel tunneling, which specifically comprises the following steps of constructing a drilling hole along the tunneling direction at a tunnel coal seam to form a first drilling hole, carrying out backward type staged fracturing in the first drilling hole, respectively constructing drilling holes at the sides of a tunnel, respectively drilling the positions of final holes of each drilling hole to the positions corresponding to the final positions of the first drilling holes along the direction parallel to the tunnel to form a second drilling hole and a third drilling hole, respectively carrying out transient electromagnetic detection on the second drilling hole and the third drilling hole, respectively carrying out backward type staged fracturing after the completion, installing a gas extraction system at one tunnel side of the tunnel, respectively accessing the second drilling hole and the third drilling hole into the gas extraction system for gas extraction, realizing cooperative treatment of multi-element disasters in the tunnel, achieving the effect of multiple purposes of each hole, reducing repeated construction and disaster treatment time and improving tunnel speed.
assignees: SHAANXI BINCHANG MENGCUN MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Land maneuver traffic evaluation model and method based on ground disaster stress
abstract_en: The invention provides a land maneuver traffic evaluation method based on ground disaster stress, which comprises the steps of (1) constructing a land maneuver traffic evaluation data resource system based on geological disaster stress, (2) collecting and preprocessing multisource data related to traffic evaluation in the land maneuver traffic evaluation data resource system, (3) constructing a traffic evaluation model based on a channel attention mechanism neural network by combining different traffic influence factor data provided by the land maneuver traffic evaluation data resource system, and calculating weights of the different traffic influence factor data through the model to obtain a sensitive characteristic combination influencing land maneuver traffic, so that the traffic evaluation model pays attention to sensitive characteristics in the training process, thereby obtaining a traffic evaluation result. The invention has reasonable conception, comprehensively considers the influence of various influencing factors such as geological disasters, weather, traffic and the like on land maneuvering, can obtain more reliable traffic evaluation results, and has better application prospect.
assignees: AERO GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY AND REMOTE SENSING CENTER FOR NATURAL RESOURCES OF CHINA

title_en: Tropical cyclone prediction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a tropical cyclone prediction method, device, equipment and medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining a historical solar black sub-data set and a historical tropical cyclone data set to obtain a sample association data pair set, wherein the sample association data pair comprises sample solar black sub-data and sample tropical cyclone data for any sample association data pair, obtaining a candidate cyclone prediction model to be trained, carrying out model training on the candidate cyclone prediction model through the sample association data pair set until training is finished to obtain a trained target cyclone prediction model, obtaining target solar black sub-data to be identified, and obtaining target prediction cyclone data in a prediction time range based on the target cyclone prediction model and the target solar black sub-data. The prediction of the tropical cyclone data is realized through the solar black sub data, the prediction efficiency and the prediction accuracy of the tropical cyclone data are improved, and accurate data support is provided for disaster prevention and reduction in coastal areas.
assignees: HUANENG SHANDONG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST;YANTAI POWER PLANT HUANENG SHANDONG POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Island working face impact risk evaluation method based on digital rock core
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine rock burst risk discrimination, in particular to an island working face impact risk evaluation method based on a digital rock core, which adopts a method of combining small-diameter coring with large-diameter pressure relief drilling, the solid coal core of the dangerous area of the island working face can be obtained, the distribution and collapse conditions of the cracks of the large-diameter pressure relief drill holes can be observed, the large-diameter pressure relief drill holes can be used for pressure relief and deairing of the island working face, and the damage caused by rock burst disasters is reduced. Impact risk evaluation is carried out on island working surfaces in exploitation based on an entropy weight method, so that whether the current exploitation state is safe or not can be more intuitively analyzed. According to the invention, the evaluation object is more specific, the evaluation index is more targeted, the evaluation factor is more scientific and reasonable, and the evaluation result can truly reflect the impact dangerous state of the evaluation area. The method is based on the actual requirements of the coal mine, guides the coal mine to carry out rock burst prevention and control work, and has important practical significance for guaranteeing the safe production of the coal mine.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER;KORLA JINCHUAN MINING CO LTD

title_en: River basin unit debris flow susceptibility assessment method based on multi-model Stacking integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating debris flow liability of a river basin unit based on multi-model Stacking, which comprises the steps of constructing a debris flow disaster data set, constructing a Stacking integrated learning model comprising four base models, a feature Stacking layer, an attention layer, a mixed feature layer, a feature splicing layer and a meta model, training the Stacking integrated learning model, predicting debris flow disaster probability of the river basin unit to be identified, and estimating debris flow liability. The invention can carry out high-efficiency fusion on multi-source data, creatively splice the mixed probability vector with the original sample, and enable the meta model to simultaneously utilize the intrinsic characteristics of the original data and the prediction information of the base model in the training process, reduce the interference of irrelevant information and the dependence on the quality of the base model, capture key information in the data more comprehensively, and enhance the interpretation capability and prediction precision of the model on complex data.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;CHENGLI ZHIYUAN TECH CHENGDU CO LTD

title_en: Landslide event determining method and related device
abstract_en: The application provides a landslide event determining method and a related device, which are used for determining daily rainfall disaster causing probability in each region through a rainfall disaster causing probability model based on rainfall simulation data in a target time period, determining first landslide probability corresponding to each slope unit in each day based on the rainfall disaster causing probability and slope instability probability corresponding to each slope unit, randomly extracting in a [0,1] interval through a Monte Carlo method to obtain second landslide probability corresponding to each slope unit in each day, and determining that a landslide event occurs to each slope unit when the second landslide probability is smaller than or equal to the first landslide probability. According to the method, the possibility that each slope unit has a landslide in actual conditions can be considered through random extraction of the Monte Carlo method, so that whether the landslide occurs is determined without completely depending on the probability of the first landslide, and further whether a result of a landslide event occurs in a certain slope unit is determined to be more in line with the actual conditions, and the result is more accurate.
assignees: CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CORP;CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CATASTRIAL RISK MAN CO LTD

title_en: Midwifery practice teaching system based on scene simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a midwifery practice teaching system based on scenario simulation, which relates to the technical field of medical teaching. The system simulates a real delivery process through a virtual environment, covers the scenes of uterine orifice expansion, fetal delivery, placenta delivery, postpartum hemorrhage and the like, can generate physiological signals such as fetal heart sounds and the like, and provides scene simulation of various delivery processes. And analyzing the student operation in real time by using an artificial intelligence algorithm to generate personalized feedback and scoring reports. In addition, the system supports simulation of emergency situations and customization of personalized learning paths, and ensures students to master diversified midwifery skills in a controllable and safe environment. Through the combination of VR and AR technology, the system realizes immersive teaching, improves learning efficiency and participation, and obviously improves the capabilities of emergency response and standard operation of midwife. The system is suitable for the field of medical education and has wide application prospect.
assignees: AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF ZUNYI MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Logistics guarantee management system and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a logistic guarantee management system and method based on digital twinning, relates to the technical field of logistic guarantee management, and solves the technical problems that the prior art cannot simulate and forecast flood conditions in advance, and therefore enough time is not available for planning rescue measures, and the rescue efficiency is low; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a target area, simulating weather conditions of the target area according to meteorological data, dividing the target area into a plurality of subareas with the same intensity of personnel, acquiring environment information of the subareas, evaluating flood disaster grades of the subareas, collecting and updating personnel information of the target area in real time by a rescue center, evaluating rescue emergency grades of the subareas based on the flood disaster grades and the personnel information, planning an optimal rescue path according to the rescue emergency grades and the topography of the subareas, effectively predicting influence of the flood disasters, realizing efficient rescue, and reducing loss caused by natural disasters.

title_en: Geological survey safety monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological investigation, in particular to a geological investigation safety monitoring and early warning method and system, comprising the following steps: based on the geological survey data set, survey areas are divided, risk assessment and density assignment are carried out on geological units by combining the risk degrees, and a geological risk density map is generated. According to the invention, the geological risk assessment and the density assignment are used for dividing and risk assessment of the investigation region, and the risk grade judgment is carried out on the geological units, so that the safety monitoring and early warning in the geological investigation process are more refined and scientific, the stress response of the geological units under natural and artificial loads is revealed by using stress analysis simulation and terrain sensitivity analysis, the capability of identifying risk points and sensitive regions in the investigation region is improved, early warning is carried out on geological disasters, the instantaneity and pertinence of geological disaster early warning are optimized, and the loss caused by the geological disasters is reduced.
assignees: SHANDONG BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL RESOURCES FIRST GEOLOGY TEAM NO 1 INST OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL

title_en: Porous filtering grid debris flow pore water pressure dissipation effect simulation method based on SPH solid-liquid mixed flow model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porous filtering grid debris flow pore water pressure dissipation effect simulation method based on an SPH solid-liquid mixed flow model, which comprises the steps of 1) reading basic topography coordinates of a disaster area according to a debris flow geological investigation report, constructing an area node space information array, 2) calculating indexes in a topography grid according to the node space information array read in the step 1 and combining grid intervals, 3) traversing all grid nodes in the topography area, and 4) initializing required calculation variables and memory space. The method effectively identifies the control area of the water permeable grating. And applying proper boundary conditions and physical equations to nodes in the water permeable grid control area, so that the influence of the water permeable grid on the dispersion of the pore water pressure of the debris flow is successfully simulated. Not only provides a scientific simulation means for preventing and controlling the debris flow disasters, but also remarkably improves the application effect of engineering measures in practice.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method, system and medium based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The scheme discloses a fire early warning method, a fire early warning system and a fire early warning medium based on multi-source information fusion, which comprise single vehicle model training, model deployment, fire risk assessment, BIM modeling display and abnormal information notification. According to the fire disaster early warning method, system and medium based on multi-source information fusion, through deep fusion and model training of images, positioning and temperature information of the vehicle, the temperature fault mode of the vehicle can be quickly and accurately identified, the accuracy of fire disaster early warning is improved, when the vehicle has an overtemperature phenomenon, workers can quickly position the vehicle and the vicinity, measures can be timely taken for the overtemperature vehicle, the occurrence of fire disaster is prevented, the disaster damage degree of the fire disaster is reduced, and powerful support is provided for fire disaster prevention and control work. Through setting up bridge BIM model, show bridge fire risk map at display device or user terminal, command department, staff and driver can grasp the information such as disaster site, fire cause, disaster degree, vehicle intensive degree of current bridge fire rapidly through bridge fire risk map, the environmental adaptation ability of system is strong, can evaluate the fire risk under different environment, improve command department's decision-making efficiency, the staff can arrive the rescue scene fast and expand fire extinguishing and rescue work, the driver in low risk area can withdraw the bridge or assist the staff to carry out personnel evacuation promptly, casualties and economic loss that the biggest reduction conflagration caused.
assignees: GUANGDONG JIAOKE TESTING CO LTD;GUANGDONG WANQU TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION INVEST CO LTD;GUANGDONG PROVINCIAL HIGHWAY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;JIANGSU CUMT DAZHENG SURFACE ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD;GUANGDONG HUALU TRANSP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster automatic identification method based on multi-source data and deep learning
abstract_en: The application relates to an automatic geological disaster identification method based on multi-source data and deep learning. The method is based on multi-source remote sensing data and a deep learning technology, can fully utilize various remote sensing data sources, and combines an advanced deep learning algorithm to realize accurate and efficient identification of geological disasters. The improved UNet++ semantic segmentation model is a new architecture for image segmentation by combining the capabilities of UNet++ and Visual Mamba, realizes rapid and accurate identification of a large-scale landslide by adopting the improved UNet++ semantic segmentation model after multi-source data training, overcomes the information limitation of a single data source and improves the accuracy and efficiency of geological disaster identification by integrating multi-source remote sensing information, and provides powerful technical support for geological disaster prevention and emergency response.

title_en: Image detection method, system, equipment and medium based on earth surface covering change
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image detection method, system, equipment and medium based on earth surface covering change, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a change detection network, wherein the change detection network comprises a first branch network, a second branch network and a third branch network; the method comprises the steps of training a change detection network by utilizing a training data set, acquiring an image pair to be detected, and detecting the change of the ground cover in the change detection image by utilizing the change detection network, wherein the image pair to be detected comprises an initial image to be detected before the ground cover is changed and a change image to be detected after the change. The method can automatically detect natural disasters which cause the change of the ground surface covering in a large range by only a small amount of marked images, and locate the occurrence area and the influence range of the natural disasters, so that rescue work can be rapidly and effectively performed, and the life and property safety of people is ensured.
assignees: NANJING PAI SMART PERCEPTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake early warning broadcasting all-in-one
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake early warning broadcasting integrated machine, which relates to the technical field of disaster early warning equipment and comprises an integrated machine connected with an earthquake early warning terminal through a wire harness, wherein a power switch, an early warning drilling key and a plurality of line interfaces are arranged on the front side surface of the integrated machine, a wire harness locking assembly is arranged right in front of the line interfaces on the front side surface of the integrated machine, an emergency microphone is further arranged on the upper surface of the integrated machine, the earthquake early warning broadcasting integrated machine is connected with the earthquake early warning terminal and the power amplifier, and the integrated machine is convenient to realize emergency call when receiving earthquake early warning information by virtue of the emergency microphone which is provided with the emergency microphone and is provided with the early warning drilling key, can be directly started to automatically play earthquake early warning drilling, is convenient to operate, can lock a connecting wire harness of the line interfaces, and avoids the problem that the wire harness or other wire harnesses connected on the integrated machine are loose, so that the transmission of the earthquake information is unstable.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA CARBON ARK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire spread prediction method, forest fire spread prediction device, forest fire spread prediction equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a forest fire spread prediction method, a forest fire spread prediction device, forest fire spread prediction equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to a disaster occurrence signal, acquiring multispectral remote sensing data, DEM data and meteorological data of a first area in a current time period; processing multispectral remote sensing data, DEM data and meteorological data of a first area based on a Wang Zhengfei and Mao Xianmin combined model, determining the current forest fire spreading speed of each cell in a disaster real-time endangered range, and processing the current forest fire spreading speed of each cell by adopting a cellular automaton algorithm to obtain a forest fire spreading prediction result of the first area in a current time period. According to the application, through multispectral remote sensing data, DEM data and meteorological data of a forest fire occurrence area, information such as a combustible coefficient, a gradient angle, a wind speed and the like can be obtained, and then, a Wang Zhengfei and Mao Xianmin combined model and a cellular automaton algorithm are combined to simulate forest fire spreading, so that the forest fire spreading simulation precision and the application range thereof can be improved.
assignees: China Unicom;CHINA UNICOM DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-purpose disaster prevention system using big data and drones
title_ko: 빅데이터와 드론을 이용한 다목적 방재 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a multi-purpose disaster prevention system using big data and drones that can intelligently respond in real time to various disasters, including preventing the spread of fire or quickly suppressing and alleviating the urban heat island phenomenon. The multi-purpose disaster prevention system using big data and drones comprises: a drone (110) that performs manual flight or autonomous flight according to a preset flight scenario using a rotary wing (111), a rotor (111a), landing gear (112), a GPS antenna, and a disaster prevention control unit (140) of a control center; a water mist generation and spraying unit (120) that sucks and transports water from a water tank of a high-pressure water spraying, quarantine, or firefighting vehicle, or a water source such as a river, sea, or stream, and pressurizes and crushes water to generate and spray water mist; a big data collection and storage unit (130) that collects and stores real-time weather information and real-time disaster information by region; and a disaster prevention control unit (140) that generates each control signal to control the position movement of the drone (110), the generation of fine mist water, and the spraying operation of the spray unit (120). According to the present invention, fire dust, fine dust, or odor particles can be easily adsorbed and removed by the mist water's fine particle size, the increased surface area, and the negative ions generated by the high spray pressure and drop pressure.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빅데이터와 드론을 이용한 다목적 방재 시스템에 관한 것으로, 지역별 실시간 기상정보와 재난정보와 드론을 이용하여 재난 발생 또는 예상 지역에 미분무수를 고압 분사하여 다양한 재난에 신속히 대처하기 위한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 자신의 실시간 위치 정보를 관제센터의 방재 제어부와 무선으로 공유하면서 관제센터의 방재 제어부에 의한 수동 비행 또는 기설정된 비행 시나리오에 의한 자율 비행하는 드론, 드론에 거치되며 관제센터의 방재 제어부에 의해 제어되어 수원지의 물을 흡입 및 이송하고 가압 및 파쇄하여 미분무수를 생성 및 분사하는 미분무수 생성 및 분사부, 관제센터에 설치되며 빅데이터 서버로부터 유선 또는 무선통신을 통해 지역별 실시간 기상정보와 지역별 실시간 재난정보를 수집하여 저장하는 빅데이터 수집 및 저장부, 및 관제센터에 설치되며 드론의 실시간 위치 정보와 빅데이터 수집 및 저장부의 지역별 실시간 기상정보와 지역별 실시간 재난정보를 수신하여 표출하며 사용자 조작에 따라 드론의 위치 이동과 미분무수 생성 및 분사부의 분사 동작을 제어하는 방재 제어부를 포함하여, 화재 분진이나 미세먼지 또는 악취입자 흡착 및 제거, 열원 흡수를 통한 화재시의 열원 이동 또는 열복사 에너지의 전달 차단 또는 인위적인 바람길 형성으로 다양한 재난에 실시간 대응할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: Research method for relationship between barrier in evacuation road and walk evacuation smoothness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a research method for the relationship between obstacles in an evacuation road and the smoothness of walking evacuation, which belongs to the technical field of computer simulation and comprises the specific steps of (1) collecting real-time data of evacuation scenes and preprocessing each group of data, (2) predicting pedestrians and vehicle behaviors through a motion prediction model, (3) simulating the evacuation scenes according to the real-time data and prediction results, (4) simulating different evacuation strategies and evaluating the smoothness of evacuation, (5) optimizing the evacuation strategies and carrying out simulation optimization through actual evacuation exercises.

title_en: Digital plan construction method for emergency command decision
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency command decisions, and particularly relates to a digital plan construction method for an emergency command decision, which comprises the steps of 1, establishing a plan database, 2, setting a method for identifying and extracting entities and parameters, setting a method for judging emergency scenes and key parameters according to emergency response conditions after obtaining the entities and the parameters, 3, generating an emergency command flow, 4, constructing a digital plan model, 5, making an emergency command decision to form a plan, 6, implementing an emergency command decision, and 7, evaluating and optimizing the emergency command decision. According to the invention, on one hand, the influence weight of risks corresponding to treatment tasks is calculated through an entropy method, and on the other hand, training is realized through historical record data on a loss classification model, and the influence of time-ordered emergency tasks and related risks is combined in the training process.
assignees: JIANGSU JINGE NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban power distribution network emergency response decision-making method based on multi-subject V2G response
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power systems, and particularly discloses an urban power distribution network emergency response decision method based on multi-subject V2G response, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-subject V2G response estimation model by utilizing NetLogo, simulating the behavior of the multi-subject by integrating a vehicle following model, an improved discrete selection Logit model and a path planning model, enabling a power distribution network operator to transmit V2G response to a personalized travel advisor, collecting data of an electric vehicle by the personalized travel advisor and sending a request to the electric vehicle, judging the intention of the electric vehicle owner by utilizing the vehicle following model and the improved discrete selection Logit model, constructing a recovery model by utilizing MILP in Matlab, and repairing faults in extreme events. The invention has the advantages of improving the recovery efficiency of the power grid after an extreme event, reducing the operation cost and providing effective decision support for the power distribution network operators in actual recovery planning.

title_en: Animal model construction method for simulating crowd flooding and trapping fatigue and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an animal model construction method for simulating crowd flooding stranded fatigue and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fatigue animal model construction. According to the invention, the full-automatic artificial climate box is used for controlling the whole environment (temperature, humidity and illumination intensity) so as to simulate the high-temperature and high-humidity environment, and the food shortage in the flood disaster is simulated by combining the heat intake mode, so that a novel animal fatigue model consistent with the induction factors of the flood trapped fatigue is established. The modeling method is simple and effective, provides a closer animal model for the research on the generation cause, mechanism and progress of the flood trapped fatigue by simulating the environment of the disaster in the flood disaster, provides a certain basis for the follow-up development of food functional ingredients for relieving the fatigue under the flood trapped condition, and is suitable for use and popularization.

title_en: Typhoon disaster-based power grid fault plan generation method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a terminal device and a storage medium for generating a power grid fault plan based on typhoon disasters, which are used for predicting a plurality of initial fault simulation scenes according to a power grid topology model and a typhoon prediction path, determining fault equipment which can generate faults under the typhoon disasters, determining a target safety automatic device for cutting each fault equipment according to the power grid topology model and first equipment information of the fault equipment in each initial fault simulation scene, generating a fault simulation scene of faults of a plurality of random target safety automatic devices in each initial fault simulation scene, and finally generating a target fault emergency plan meeting targets of stable frequency, stable voltage and stable tide aiming at each fault simulation scene. Therefore, the target fault emergency plan generated by the invention can cope with sudden fault scenes of refusing the operation of safety automatic devices such as a main protection switch or a breaker, and effectively ensures the stable operation of the power system in typhoon disasters.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire control command method and system based on multi-mode AI large model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-source information integration, and discloses an intelligent fire command method and system based on a multi-mode AI large model, which acquires fire scene data in real time through multi-terminal information acquisition, performs scene reconnaissance feedback through image recognition algorithm flame and smoke recognition and dangerous goods recognition, and utilizes a pre-trained multi-mode live restoration model to restore and simulate the fire scene to generate a multi-source live simulation model for analyzing and formulating personalized rescue plans, by collecting positioning and state information of a rescue unit in real time, constructing a rescue unit simulation model, analyzing specific rescue execution steps according to a personalized plan, the steps help commander to realize accurate command and efficient rescue, improve rescue decision accuracy, reduce response time, optimize resource allocation, remarkably improve emergency response capacity and successful rescue rate of a fire scene, and solve the problem of lower efficiency in the prior art when the manual integration of multi-source information is adopted to recover the fire.

title_en: Method for evaluating hail impact resistance performance of composite sandwich heliostat and designing heliostat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating hail impact resistance of a compound sandwich heliostat and designing the heliostat, which comprises the steps of researching hail diameter distribution of the use environment of the heliostat and determining the range of the hail diameter researched; and performing quantitative analysis on hail impact resistance of the heliostat at different positions, different interlayers and different thickness ratios by numerically simulating hail impact composite interlayer heliostat behaviors of the heliostat, and obtaining a speed threshold of the composite interlayer heliostat under the optimal thickness ratio. According to the invention, through evaluating the hail impact resistance of the composite sandwich heliostat, the heliostat structural design optimization database can be established, and the structural design of the heliostat is guided by combining the hail disaster risk evaluation result of the heliostat service environment. The heliostat structure is more reasonable in design.
assignees: SANYA SCIENCE AND EDUCATION INNOVATION PARK WUHAN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Tunnel construction geological disaster prevention and control intelligent decision method and auxiliary platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tunnel construction geological disaster prevention and control intelligent decision method and an auxiliary platform integrating a large model and a knowledge graph technology, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting tunnel profile data, geological survey data, advanced forecast data and construction monitoring data, and preprocessing the data to obtain processed data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a tunnel construction geological disaster prevention and control knowledge graph based on preprocessed data, carrying out structural representation on knowledge related to disaster prevention and control, wherein the knowledge comprises a disaster type entity, a geological condition entity, a prevention and control measure entity and a relation between the disaster type entity and the geological condition entity, training a large model, training the preprocessed data by adopting a large model framework, learning characteristics and rules of the tunnel construction geological disaster, and carrying out disaster prevention and control decision by combining the knowledge graph and an output result of the large model.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: High-precision tsunami wave calculation and evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision tsunami wave calculation evaluation method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of deducing a tsunami wave theoretical calculation equation through an solitary wave superposition method, carrying out tsunami high-precision numerical simulation by combining a hydrodynamic method, establishing a numerical simulation model according to a tsunami high-precision numerical simulation result, selecting a tsunami wave propagation model, simulating the propagation process of the tsunami wave in the ocean, simultaneously establishing a finite element model of an ocean engineering structure, coupling the tsunami wave propagation model with the finite element model of the ocean engineering structure, simulating the impact action of the tsunami wave on the ocean engineering structure, simulating under different tsunami scenes and ocean engineering structure parameters, and evaluating the safety and the optimization direction of the ocean engineering structure under the action of the tsunami wave according to the simulation result. The invention can accurately and effectively simulate the tsunami wave and provides powerful support for real-time tsunami warning, structural safety evaluation and emergency response.

title_en: Emergency electric power supply train dispatching system and method for recovering urban power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency power supply trolley dispatching system and method for recovering urban power supply in the technical field of power systems, comprising the following steps of obtaining global state information in the current state; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a scheduling path and a power supply strategy of an individual power supply vehicle through a power supply vehicle scheduling neural network model which is built in advance and comprises a DQN network and a shared attention module based on global state information in a current state, evaluating a reward value of the power supply vehicle after scheduling and supplying power to the power supply vehicle based on the scheduling path and the power supply strategy, obtaining a scheduling path and the power supply strategy with highest combined total value after training and updating the power supply vehicle scheduling neural network model based on the reward value, and scheduling and supplying power to all the power supply vehicles based on the scheduling path and the power supply strategy with the highest combined total value. According to the invention, the dispatching paths and strategies of a plurality of power supply vehicles are optimized through the DQN network and the power supply vehicle dispatching neural network model of the shared attention module, so that the recovery speed and efficiency of urban lifelines after disasters are effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Hydrologic forecasting method based on deep integrated learning and physical mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrologic forecasting method based on deep integrated learning and a physical mechanism, which belongs to the technical field of hydrologic forecasting. Then, the hydrologic physical model SWAT is combined with the deep learning model CNN to obtain enhanced features. And constructing a plurality of deep learning models as a basic learner, training by using training set data, and forming a final prediction result through an integration strategy. The hydrologic forecasting method based on the deep integrated learning and the physical mechanism combines the advantages of the physical mechanism and the deep learning, and improves the accuracy and the stability of hydrologic forecasting. The method has important significance for water resource management and flood control and disaster reduction.

title_en: Safety control method for three-arm rock drilling trolley tunnel excavation
abstract_en: The invention provides a safety control method for three-arm drill jumbo tunnel excavation, which is suitable for the field of tunnel excavation and comprises the steps of installation and calibration of image acquisition equipment, image acquisition, image transmission, image processing and identification, state feedback and decision making and manual rechecking and emergency response.

title_en: Prediction device
abstract_en: A prediction device (100) according to the present disclosure is provided with: a prediction unit (130) that predicts the probability of each of a plurality of structures in a designated region being damaged by inputting information on the position of each of the plurality of structures and surrounding environment information indicating the surrounding environment of each of the plurality of structures into a prediction model that predicts the probability of each of a plurality of structures being damaged by a disaster caused by rainfall, the prediction model being constructed by learning of training data that associates the position of each of a plurality of structures, whether the structure is damaged at the time of occurrence of a disaster caused by rainfall, and the surrounding environment of the structure; and a proposal unit (140) that outputs a countermeasure against a disaster caused by rainfall in the designated region on the basis of the probability of each of the plurality of structures being damaged.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method, device, equipment and medium based on InSAR
abstract_en: The invention provides an InSAR-based landslide susceptibility evaluation method, device, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining basic landslide data, extracting evaluation index data, analyzing multiple collinearity among the evaluation index data, constructing a landslide susceptibility evaluation index system, selecting all vector points in a disaster body range of a landslide inventory as landslide positive samples, selecting non-landslide negative samples, constructing a training set and a testing set sample according to the landslide positive samples and the non-landslide negative samples, constructing a landslide susceptibility evaluation model based on an RF-InSAR model of a random forest model and an SBAS-InSAR optimized sample, training the landslide susceptibility evaluation model by using the training set and the testing set sample, and inputting data to be analyzed into the landslide susceptibility evaluation model for landslide susceptibility evaluation so as to solve the problem of accurately and reliably evaluating the landslide susceptibility under the condition of comprehensively considering various influencing factors.

title_en: XGBoost-based energy storage battery fire disaster multi-parameter detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a XGBoost-based energy storage battery fire multi-parameter detection method which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a XGBoost model, 2, expressing an objective function as a function of the number of samples and the number of trees, approximating a loss function through second-order expansion of a Taylor formula to optimize the objective function, 3, updating a predicted value in an iterative mode for each sample, and 4, adjusting parameters of a XGBoost model including learning rate, tree depth and regularization coefficient according to actual data of the energy storage battery fire, and training the model to accurately detect the multi-parameter of the energy storage battery fire. According to the invention, by introducing XGBoost algorithm, the high-efficiency and accurate detection of the fire disaster multi-parameter of the energy storage battery is realized, and important technical support is provided for improving the safety management level of the energy storage power station, reducing the fire disaster risk and guaranteeing the equipment and personal safety.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Rock rounding mechanical test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock rounding mechanical test device and a test method, wherein the rock rounding mechanical test device comprises a base, a top seat, an upper supporting plate and a lower supporting plate, the top seat is arranged right above the base, the upper supporting plate and the lower supporting plate are arranged between the base and the top seat, the lower supporting plate can be adjusted in a lifting manner relative to the base, the upper supporting plate can slide horizontally relative to the top seat, the upper supporting plate is arranged above the lower supporting plate, a lower friction plate is arranged on the upper side of the lower supporting plate, an upper friction plate is arranged on the lower side of the upper supporting plate, the lower friction plate and the upper friction plate are used for propping up and down rock particles, and the rock particles are subjected to friction test by sliding in the horizontal direction. According to the invention, by controlling different loads and friction states, gravels with different grinding degrees are simulated, the change rule of fault sliding distance and extrusion force between the sliding layers is researched, and a supporting effect is played for correctly recognizing part of geological disasters.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD;UNIV SHAOXING

title_en: Power distribution network operation safety risk assessment method considering typhoon and storm composite disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network operation safety risk assessment method considering typhoon and storm composite disasters, which comprises the following steps of generating different typhoon paths as main scenes based on typhoon and storm disaster forecast data, giving weights to the main scenes according to occurrence probability, calculating corrected wind speeds according to the influence of micro-topography and rainfall intensity on wind speeds V (r) in the main scenes, calculating total failure probability of a power distribution line between nodes i and j according to failure probability of the power distribution line between the nodes i and j and failure probability caused by a foreign matter hanging wire, calculating failure probability of power distribution equipment according to water accumulation amount in a power distribution network area, simulating and generating N fault scenes S to form a fault scene set S by using a Monte Carlo method, giving weights to the fault scenes, constructing a risk assessment model by taking the minimum expected total loss load amount under all the fault scenes as an objective function, and solving the risk assessment model by combining constraint conditions.

title_en: Early warning system and method for new energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention provides an early warning system and method of a new energy storage power station, comprising a sensor module, a data acquisition module, a data processing analysis module and a warning decision module. Through dynamic early warning threshold adjustment, the early warning threshold is dynamically adjusted based on historical data and seasonal variation, early warning parameters can be automatically adjusted according to actual operation data and environmental factors of the power station through dynamic early warning threshold adjustment, false alarm and missing report are reduced, and the operation state of the power station is simulated and analyzed in real time. The method not only can optimize the early warning strategy and the emergency response plan, but also can simulate various risk scenes under the condition of not influencing the operation of an actual power station, provides support for making more effective early warning and emergency measures, integrates edge calculation in an early warning system, and distributes data processing and analysis tasks at the edge of a network, namely, near a data source. This can reduce delay, improve response speed, and relieve the burden on the center server.

title_en: Fire control simulation training system based on cigarette heat tracking positioning technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fire-fighting simulation training, relates to a data analysis technology, and is used for solving the problem that the prior art cannot analyze the capability defect of each firefighter in the simulation training from an individual angle, in particular to a fire-fighting simulation training system based on a smoke heat tracking and positioning technology, which comprises a simulation training platform, wherein the simulation training platform is in communication connection with a parameter generation module, a training execution module, an optimization analysis module and a database; the parameter generation module is used for generating simulation training parameters for the fire-fighting simulation training field, wherein a plurality of target task points are arranged in the fire-fighting simulation training field, and corresponding environment simulation parameters are generated for the target task points.
assignees: CHANGCHUN LANCHENG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster island division method and system for power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster island division method and system of a power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing simulation analysis on acquired data to determine a circuit topology structure; the method comprises the steps of simulating a circuit topology structure, carrying out iterative processing on a simulation output result to obtain a reference disconnection point, determining a reference disconnection boundary according to the reference disconnection point, carrying out stable domain boundary calculation on a variable at the reference disconnection point according to stable domain estimation to obtain the reference disconnection boundary, outputting a final disconnection priority according to a voltage stability margin of the reference disconnection boundary, determining active disconnection boundaries under different disaster conditions based on selected standard conditions and the disconnection priority, determining an active disconnection region of a target power distribution network based on the active disconnection boundary, and executing a disconnection strategy corresponding to the active disconnection region matched with the disaster conditions in the dividing process of the post-disaster island power grid. The post-disaster island division method of the power system can optimize the island division process of the power system.

title_en: Intelligent fire control map training system
