abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting map training system, which relates to the field of intelligent fire fighting, and comprises a management end, a plurality of training ends and a networking data server, wherein the management end is used for managing system content and training content, the training ends are used for fire-fighting map training operation, the working logic of the intelligent fire-fighting map training system comprises the steps of adding, deleting and modifying training data in the networking data server after the management end logs in the system, determining training logic, the networking data server generates a plurality of independent map packages according to the training logic, randomly selects map points in each map package, and marks each map point with the networking data server, wherein the map data and the training logic content are built in the networking data server. According to the invention, by establishing the virtual map system and then carrying out map training in the form of matching the point selection marks and the names, firefighters can quickly position the firefighting places after receiving the command, and the firefighting efficiency is improved.

title_en: Urban lifeline waterlogging risk assessment rapid simulation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid simulation method, a rapid simulation system and a storage medium for urban lifeline waterlogging risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining key data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer overlapped grid model comprising a ground surface layer, a subsurface pipe network layer and a life line facility layer based on key data, pre-calculating accumulated water depth distribution data under different rainfall intensities by using a numerical simulation method based on the multi-layer overlapped grid model, interpolating by using the pre-calculation method to obtain accumulated water depth values under the live rainfall intensities, overlapping the accumulated water depth values with the life line facility, calculating the flooding risk degree of the life line facility, and visually displaying the accumulated water depth distribution data and the flooding risk degree. According to the invention, the pre-calculation and the real-time interpolation of the ponding depth distribution under different rainfall conditions are realized, the accurate ponding depth distribution can be quickly obtained without complex real-time calculation under the live rainfall conditions, the simulation time is greatly shortened, and the high-efficiency technical support is provided for urban waterlogging emergency response.
assignees: NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST;JIANGSU QINHUAI RIVER WATER CONSEVANCY ENG DIVISION;JIANGSU SURVEYING AND DESIGN INST OF WATER RESOURCES CO LTD

title_en: Method for carrying out experimental prediction on retaining wall of high landfill site of soil-stone mixture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and geological disaster prevention, in particular to a method for carrying out experimental prediction on a retaining wall of a soil-stone mixture high landfill. The method comprises the following steps of S1, preparing samples, determining the soil materials with different maximum particle diameters by adopting a removing method, a similar grading method and an equivalent substitution method according to the field soil material grading curve of the soil and stone mixture, and S2, performing a direct shear test on each group of samples prepared in the step one by using a direct shear apparatus in a large direct shear test, and determining the shear strength of each sample. The invention can promote the stability of the high landfill site of the soil-stone mixture, integrate indoor tests, physical models, discrete element simulation and theoretical analysis, accurately identify the main factors and the instability mechanisms of the stability, and provide effective prevention measures.

title_en: Real-time monitoring and tracking method for falling rocks based on improved YOLOv model
abstract_en: A real-time monitoring and tracking method for falling rocks based on an improved YOLOv model comprises the following steps of collecting rock data, improving the structure of the YOLOv model, preprocessing images in the rock data set, training a rock identification model based on the improved YOLOv model, receiving video information of a mountain and a highway acquired from the front end in real time, identifying the rocks in the video in real time and recording position information of the rocks, judging whether the rocks are falling rocks and calculating impact force according to the fluctuation condition of the positions of the rocks, and judging whether to alarm and record according to the value of the falling rocks which stay on a road or the impact force of the falling rocks. According to the invention, the detection head of the YOLOv model is improved, the stone image dataset is collected to train the stone identification model, so that the possible stone falling event in mountain or slope areas can be effectively monitored, the safety of personnel and property can be protected by timely taking measures, and reliable support is provided for disaster early warning and risk management.
assignees: NORTH INFORMATION CONTROL INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Permanent-face combined method for evaluating earthquake-resistant toughness of assembled subway station system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating earthquake resistance and toughness of a permanent-face combined assembled subway station system, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing an evaluation index system of the earthquake resistance and toughness of the subway station system, S2, establishing a function level function of the permanent-face combined assembled subway station system, S3, establishing an earthquake disaster influence function, S4, establishing a function recovery function of the subway station system, S5 and evaluating the toughness. The method provided by the invention can quantitatively evaluate the earthquake-resistant toughness level of the permanent combined assembled subway station system, further analyze the influence rule of different subsystems on the earthquake-resistant toughness of the station system, identify key factors influencing the earthquake-resistant toughness of the station system through simulating different earthquake conditions, and temporarily provide decision support for related units and government departments in the earthquake.

title_en: Transformer fire disaster simulation device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a transformer fire disaster simulation device and method, the device comprises a simulation chamber with a closed space, an oil tank arranged in the closed space, a simulation liquid contained in the oil tank, at least two transformer coils arranged in the oil tank and contacted with the simulation liquid, an opening with adjustable opening at the top of the oil tank, a flame and smoke simulation assembly used for spraying flame and smoke into the oil tank, an oil discharge simulation assembly connected with the oil tank and used for discharging the simulation liquid in the oil tank, and a control system comprising a temperature monitoring module, a smoke concentration monitoring module and a CO and oxygen concentration monitoring module and used for respectively monitoring the temperature in the oil tank and the closed space, the smoke concentration in the closed space and the concentration of CO and oxygen in the simulation chamber, thereby solving the problem that the simulation device in the prior art can not simulate the liquid level change in the transformer oil tank in the closed space and the influence of the gas temperature and concentration change in the closed space on the burning rate.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Vehicle-mounted geological disaster early warning system and method based on environment awareness
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle-mounted geological disaster early warning system and method based on environment awareness, and relates to the technical field of vehicle early warning. The system comprises an information acquisition module, a judgment and analysis module, a pre-training geological disaster early warning model and an early warning execution module, wherein the information acquisition module is used for acquiring geological disaster information, vehicle information and external environment information in real time, the judgment and analysis module predicts a vehicle driving path through a driving path prediction unit, the geological disaster information is input into the pre-training geological disaster early warning model through the geological disaster prediction unit to predict the occurrence probability value of geological disasters of each monitoring point or area, the risk level of the influence of the geological disasters on the vehicle is estimated through a risk assessment unit, and the early warning execution module is used for carrying out early warning prompt according to the risk level matching safety suggestion. According to the method, the risk is estimated in real time by comprehensively acquiring the information and using the geological disaster prediction model, and early warning and safety advice are provided in time, so that the driving safety can be effectively improved.

title_en: Full-environment helicopter rescue simulation training device and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-environment helicopter rescue simulation training device and a working method thereof, wherein the full-environment helicopter rescue simulation training device comprises a frame constructed through a steel structure, an electric control box is placed at the top of the frame, a six-degree-of-freedom platform is installed below the top of the frame, the six-degree-of-freedom platform consists of six servo electric cylinders, and a cabin body is installed at the bottom of the six-degree-of-freedom platform and is used for simulating a helicopter cabin. According to the invention, after a simulated rescue operation is started, firefighters descend from the cabin through the winch after the telescopic platform is installed and enter the cabin, the powerful fan works in the descending process to simulate rescue under the condition of heavy wind, the smoke manufacturing machine starts a severe weather environment which possibly occurs when the simulated rescue is started, the firefighters need to overcome the difficulty of wind power obstruction and sight line produced by smoke, and the firefighters rescue trapped people trapped in a swimming pool and return to the cabin and then send the trapped people to the ground for rescue.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Analysis method and system for safe distance between power transmission tower and earthquake type landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method and system for the safe distance between a power transmission tower and an earthquake type landslide, wherein the analysis method comprises the steps of obtaining earthquake data and geological data, establishing a coupling model of the power transmission tower and the landslide under different earthquake intensities, establishing a damage model of the earthquake type landslide of the power transmission tower based on the coupling model of the power transmission tower and the landslide in combination with finite element analysis, calculating the safe distance between the power transmission tower and the earthquake type landslide based on the damage model of the earthquake type landslide of the power transmission tower, and verifying the calculated safe distance based on an indoor simulation test. According to the method, the influence of the earthquake factors is considered, the damage model of the earthquake type landslide of the power transmission tower is built, the safe distance between the power transmission tower and the earthquake type landslide is calculated, and the result is more accurate. The invention makes up the defects of landslide deformation damage and formation mechanism research after earthquake, forms a basic discipline theory of geological disaster monitoring and early warning critical value research, and provides scientific basis for geological disaster monitoring and early warning decision.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Dynamic monitoring and early warning method and system for mobile phone signals
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic monitoring and early warning method and a system for mobile phone signals, which relate to the technical field of mobile phone signal dynamic monitoring and early warning and comprise the steps of collecting mobile phone signals, segmenting and extracting features, constructing a signal evolution feature space, analyzing signal stability based on a chaos theory, constructing a composite feature space in combination with the feature space, mapping composite space partitions, identifying steady-state and transition areas, respectively establishing a normal mode library and an abnormal mode library, training a hierarchical prediction model, constructing an early warning decision tree based on a prediction result, including attenuation, interference and interruption early warning branches, respectively triggering compensation, avoidance and emergency response mechanisms, calculating an optimal transmission path by the emergency response mechanism, evaluating base station resources, generating a base station switching sequence, sending a control instruction, and finally dynamically generating an optimal disposal decision, thereby improving the accuracy and effectiveness of signal monitoring and early warning.

title_en: Ship fire disaster identification method based on edge detection and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship fire disaster identification method based on edge detection and deep learning, which belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprises the steps of processing a target cabin image by using an edge detection algorithm, cutting the target image according to an edge detection result to obtain an image to be detected, denoising the image to be detected by using an image denoising method based on a filter, improving the image quality and enhancing the image identification effect through image enhancement, analyzing and training the fire disaster identification algorithm by using a large number of ship cabin fire disasters and non-fire scene to be detected which are subjected to edge detection and image preprocessing to obtain a target cabin fire disaster identification model, and identifying a target word in a cabin image or a cabin video according to the fire disaster identification result to prompt a crew target cabin whether a fire disaster occurs. The method can simplify the picture or video background to be identified, reduce the data volume, improve the fire disaster identification rate of each cabin of the ship, and solve the pain point with poor performance of the domestic military hardware and software environment.

title_en: Fire image recognition method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of general image data processing or generation, in particular to a fire disaster image recognition method and a fire disaster image recognition system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a fire scene target image, performing preprocessing on the fire scene target image and generating a fire scene image data set; the method comprises the steps of performing optimization on a semantic segmentation network model U-Net, performing training on the optimized U-Net network model based on a fire scene image dataset and a cross pseudo-supervision method, and performing fire scene image recognition on a fire scene based on the optimized U-Net network model. The application provides an image recognition method based on the optimized U-Net network model, which can solve the problems of insufficient training data, poor model recognition effect and the like in the prior art, effectively utilizes limited annotation data, improves the working efficiency of fire image detection, and has stronger universality and expansibility.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Fan blade icing risk assessment and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fan blade icing risk assessment and early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological parameters of a wind power plant; the method comprises the steps of inputting meteorological parameters to a three-dimensional ice shape model of a blade to simulate the ice coating state of the surface of the fan blade to obtain ice coating forms of different positions of the blade, calculating aerodynamic characteristics of the blade after ice coating according to the ice coating forms of different positions of the blade to obtain aerodynamic characteristic parameters of a two-dimensional ice coating wing structure of different positions, obtaining external airflow field changes of each two-dimensional section, calculating to obtain wind energy utilization rate according to the airflow field changes, and evaluating ice coating disaster-causing risk grades and early warning according to the ice coating forms of different positions and the wind energy utilization rate. According to the invention, three-dimensional icing simulation and pneumatic calculation of the fan blades are combined to obtain the relation of the influence of icing on the aerodynamic performance and the power characteristic of the wind driven generator, so that intelligent risk assessment of icing disasters of the wind power plant is realized, and the safe operation of the wind driven generator in the severe environment of the icing area is ensured.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Emergency response management system and method for coal mine accidents
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of emergency management of coal mine accidents, and discloses a system and a method for emergency response management of coal mine accidents, wherein a real-time multi-source data acquisition and fusion module acquires multi-source data and transmits the multi-source data to a central control room in real time for data fusion and processing; the system comprises an intelligent decision support and accident simulation module, a dynamic rescue resource scheduling and optimizing module, a real-time communication and cooperation platform, an underground personnel positioning and evacuation system, an intelligent personnel evacuation route generation module, a real-time communication and cooperation platform, an underground personnel positioning and evacuation system and an intelligent personnel evacuation system. The invention improves the efficiency of accident emergency response, reduces casualties and property loss in coal mine production accidents, and has obvious safety benefit and economic benefit.
assignees: SHUANGMA MINE CHN ENERGY NINGXIA COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode torrential flood forecast integration method based on network data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mountain torrents, in particular to a multi-mode mountain torrents forecasting integration method based on network data, which is used for crawling weather forecasting data from weather forecasting networks of weather stations, synchronously updating the weather forecasting data to a weather driving data set every 3 hours, constructing a digital river basin based on a SWAT model, carrying out precipitation-runoff simulation and forecasting by coupling a random forest and an LSTM algorithm, and finally constructing an integration system based on an MFC frame. The early warning and effective management of the mountain flood disasters are realized by adopting a network data crawler technology, a digital river basin technology and a deep learning technology, the result is output and displayed on the basis of the data river basin, runoff forecast data of any point of a river channel for 7 days in the future and identified by multiple modes are provided, the disaster prevention and reduction efficiency of the mountain is provided, and scientific basis is provided for flood prevention decision. The problem that the current runoff forecasting system is poor in practicality and insufficient in timeliness in mountain area flows is solved.

title_en: Disaster risk early warning method and system based on big data model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and risk management, and discloses a disaster risk early warning method based on a big data model, which comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition, namely acquiring environmental data and social data through a sensor and Internet of things equipment; S2, calculating risks, namely calculating an environmental risk index according to the environmental data and calculating a social activity risk index according to the social data, and a disaster risk early warning system based on a big data model, wherein the disaster risk early warning system comprises a data acquisition module and a data acquisition module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for collecting the environmental data and the social data through a sensor and Internet of things equipment. By constructing a social-environment interaction risk model, introducing a risk chain conduction mechanism and intervention measures, dynamically evaluating a disaster risk propagation process, simulating various disaster scenes and calculating emergency response time, and optimizing emergency resource deployment, disaster expansion is effectively predicted, loss is reduced, and accuracy and efficiency of emergency response are improved.

title_en: Building group earthquake loss probability assessment method based on earthquake intensity random field simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a building group earthquake loss probability assessment method based on earthquake intensity random field simulation, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake loss assessment. The method provided by the invention firstly adopts the seismic intensity random field simulation technology to simulate the seismic of the area to obtain the spatial distribution of the seismic intensity of different sites, and then utilizes the building earthquake resistance model and the building vulnerability database to estimate the loss probability distribution of each building. The method can evaluate the occurrence probability of the extreme earthquake loss of a large-scale building group more quickly and accurately, and provides important support for earthquake risk evaluation and post-disaster emergency decision, so that the disaster resistance and recovery capacity of the city are enhanced, and the overall toughness of the city is improved.

title_en: Red date disaster unmanned aerial vehicle image recognition method based on improvement ResNet50
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image recognition method of a red jujube disaster unmanned aerial vehicle based on an improvement ResNet, which comprises the steps of obtaining red jujube natural disaster image data of the unmanned aerial vehicle, carrying out data preprocessing, dividing the data into a training set and a testing set according to a certain proportion, constructing an improved ResNet model, importing the training set, replacing a traditional cross entropy loss function with a focus loss function in forward calculation, balancing weights of various categories in training, solving the problem of sample unbalance, embedding CBAM attention mechanisms between deep residual blocks of the model, enabling the model to pay more attention to important characteristic information in an image through characteristic enhancement of a channel domain and a space domain, improving perception of the model to a key domain of the image, and adding a Dropout regularization layer after an average pooling layer so as to reduce overfitting. Finally, performing a super-parameter combination experiment, selecting an optimal super-parameter combination, and obtaining an optimal model for identifying the natural disasters of the red dates. The method can meet the requirements of red date disaster identification with large planting area and high overlapping rate, and has high identification precision.
assignees: INST OF MODERN FORESTRY XINJIANG ACADEMY OF FORESTRY

title_en: Wave-eliminating dike stability performance evaluation method and system for combined seawall
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of breakwater for ports, coasts and offshore engineering, and discloses a method and a system for evaluating stability performance of a wave-dissipating dike of a combined seawall. The method comprises the steps of obtaining hydrological data of an area where a combined sea wall is located and section data of a combined sea wall structure, establishing a wave power numerical model, carrying out wave climbing simulation of a dike body and wave-dissipating dike top wave-dissipating simulation on the target combined sea wall by adopting the wave power numerical model, calculating to obtain wave force and wave moment of the wave-dissipating dike, determining wave load indexes, carrying out self gravity on the wave-dissipating dike of the target combined sea wall, connecting force of the wave-dissipating dike and a slope sea wall and moment calculation on a tilting fulcrum of the wave-dissipating dike, obtaining gravity and gravity moment of the wave-dissipating dike, determining wave-dissipating dike structure indexes, and calculating anti-tilting stability and anti-sliding stability safety coefficients according to the wave load indexes and the wave-dissipating dike structure indexes. The invention improves disasters accuracy of the early warning. Has practical application value.

title_en: Method and device for applying disaster recovery switching exercise, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for applying disaster recovery switching exercise. The method comprises the steps of adding asset information, configuring a switching script on each asset, establishing a disaster tolerance pair and arranging a switching link, calling an SDK script to execute asset inspection, feeding back error information if any inspection fails, prompting that inspection is completed before switching, sequentially executing a main switching script and a standby switching main script of the disaster tolerance pair through an SDK script executor in the actual switching process, automatically suspending a switching task and prompting a user to process corresponding assets when script execution fails or a return display fails to meet expectations, calling an API interface for executing inspection script after switching through the SDK script executor after link switching is completed, feeding back a result to a user interface, prompting that inspection is completed after switching is completed when all inspection is successful, and performing service verification. By implementing the method of the invention, the production and disaster recovery business system can be switched rapidly during the disaster recovery switching period.

title_en: Quick reconstruction method for regional marine environment field based on ViT neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional marine environment field rapid reconstruction method based on ViT neural network, which belongs to the technical field of environment field reconstruction and is used for rapid reconstruction of marine environment fields, and comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source marine data, preprocessing, calculating the preprocessed multi-source marine data to obtain a density field, and constructing a multi-element coupling field according to a temperature field, a salinity field and the density field; a deep learning sample set is made, a training ViT environmental field generation model is constructed, and a trained ViT environmental field generation model is used for regional marine environmental field reconstruction. The invention comprehensively considers the coupling of ocean multi-element fields, realizes the reconstruction of the regional ocean temperature, salinity and density three-dimensional environment field, has the characteristics of accuracy, high resolution and rapidness, and can play the roles of data support and application guarantee in the fields of ocean disaster prevention and reduction, ocean ecosystems, ocean climate change and the like.

title_en: Physical model experimental device and experimental method for forward or reverse rock landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster model tests, in particular to a forward-leaning or reverse-leaning rock landslide physical model test device and a test method. The landslide simulation system is used for the pouring of the landslide body and the simulation of the unsteady damage process of the landslide body; the electric lifting system is used for changing the height of the free end of the sliding surface frame in the landslide simulation system to form a required angle in the test process; the thrust loading system is used for simulating the thrust of the rear edge of the slope body in the test process, so that the poured slope body is subjected to instability and damage under the action of the thrust; through the cooperation of the three systems, the device realizes the test processes of pouring models, landslide thrust simulation and the like of the samples, integrates the slope pouring and landslide simulation test, and has high experimental simulation reliability. The problem of current landslide analogue test in-process appear to the slope disturbance and slope simulation accuracy is solved.

title_en: Emergency drilling platform
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of exercise platforms, and particularly discloses an emergency exercise platform which comprises a spherical room, wherein an experience platform capable of vibrating is arranged in the spherical room, a control module is arranged in the experience platform, and the emergency exercise platform can restore high-temperature damp heat or severe snow and cold environments by using the temperature and humidity control device through the cooperation of the control module, projection equipment, a curtain, a precipitation module, an air-conditioning ventilation system, a temperature and humidity control device and stereo sound, and the technology of 360-degree surrounding large screen is adopted, so that a spectator can be in the scene of a first view angle when the disaster occurs, the spectator can restore the scene of the natural disaster in multiple aspects, the spectator can obtain the most vivid feeling, the capability of coping with the natural disaster is improved, various sounds such as a gusty storm sound, a warning bell sound and a crying sound are restored, and the use of the temperature and humidity control device enables the spectator to experience real climate conditions in the simulated scene.
assignees: OPERATION MONITORING CENTER CIVIL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION OF CHINA

title_en: Civil aviation emergency desktop deduction matched communication property simulation exercise system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency response exercise, and discloses a civil aviation emergency desktop deduction matched communication property simulation exercise system, which comprises a simulation mobile phone which is configured by each exercise personnel and used for private communication between two exercise personnel, a simulation interphone which is configured for public communication between all exercise personnel and a simulation earphone which is worn by exercise personnel at different positions, wherein a convenient and intelligent emergency exercise solution is provided for users, management of different sounds and matching of events related to working positions are realized through voice control and multi-source sound receiving, dialogue communication in the exercise process is converted into characters, a document is formed by a time node for accurate evaluation and comprehensive multi-disc after exercise by the users, and the combined simulation equipment is used for simulating different field conditions of different departments.
assignees: OPERATION MONITORING CENTER CIVIL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION OF CHINA

title_en: Dedicated fire extinguishing device and fire extinguishing method for an all-in-one EV (Electric Vehicle) equipped with a vehicle lift and drilling hydraulic drill assembly to extinguish a fire in an electric vehicle battery pack
title_ko: 리튬이온배터리 팩의 화재를 진압하기 위한 차량을 드는 리프트와 구멍을 뚫는 유압드릴 조립체를 부착한 일체형 EV(Electric Vehicle)용 전용 소화장치 및 소화방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguishing device for an electric vehicle (EV) and, more specifically, to a fire extinguishing device for an integrated EV to which a suffocation fire extinguishing cloth for extinguishing a fire of a lithium-ion battery pack, a movable lift, and a hydraulic drill assembly for drilling a hole are attached. More specifically, the present invention relates to a fire extinguishing device for an electric vehicle (EV) capable of preventing a fire caused by thermal runaway (1,350℃) of a lithium-ion battery pack during charging or parking. Moreover, the present invention relates to a fire extinguishing device exclusively for an electric vehicle (EV), which is sealed with a steel plate (aluminum plate) to prevent a large-sized fire caused by a fire of a lithium-ion battery pack by easily extinguishing the fire of the lithium-ion battery pack at an early stage even in a place where fire extinguishing agents cannot be put into the inside and entry into an underground parking lot is impossible even if a fire truck comes.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차(EV) 전용 소화장치에 관한 것으로 상세하게는 리튬이온배터리 팩의 화재를 진압하기 위한 질식소화포, 이동형 리프트와 구멍을 뚫는 유압드릴 조립체를 부착한 일체형 EV(전기차) 전용 소화장치에 관한 것이다. 특히, 본 발명은 충전 도중에 또는 주차 중에 리튬이온배터리 팩의 열 폭주(1,350℃)에 의한 화재를 방지할 수 있는 EV(전기차) 전용 소화장치에 관한 것이다. 더욱이 본 발명은 철판(알미늄판)으로 밀봉되어 내부로 소화 약제를 투입이 불가하고, 소방차가 오더라도 지하주차장에는 진입이 불가한 장소에서도 용이하게 리튬이온배터리 팩의 화재를 초기에 진압함에 의해 리튬이온배터리 팩의 화재로 인한 대형화재로 발생하는 것을 방지할 수 있는 EV(전기차) 전용 소화장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Information processing device, program, information processing system, and information processing method
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device, an information processing system, an information processing method, and a program that can effectively relieve a disaster-stricken area using an aircraft.SOLUTION: An information processing device 200 includes a storage unit 202 that stores SL antenna performance information of an SL antenna, which is a collinear antenna, and aircraft performance information of an aircraft equipped with an SL antenna such that horizontal polarization is omnidirectional, an acquisition unit 204 that acquires information on the coverage area of the wireless communication service provided by the aircraft, a simulation unit 206 that simulates the SL wireless communication area formed by the SL beam irradiated by the SL antenna while the aircraft is flying in a circle, on the basis of the SL antenna performance information and the aircraft performance information, and a determination unit 208 that determines the trajectory of the aircraft such that the coverage area is included in the SL wireless communication area while the aircraft is flying in a circle, on the basis of the information on the coverage area of the wireless communication service and the results of simulating the SL wireless communication area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 14

title_en: Earthquake awareness simulation with virtual reality
abstract_en: This invention is related to earthquake awareness simulation with virtual reality, which was developed to raise people's awareness about earthquakes, one of the biggest natural disasters, to provide crisis management in case of disasters and to save more human lives it is characterized by; the system transmits various sounds and visuals related to the earthquake zone to the user by the virtual reality glasses (1) and the sound transmitter (2) device worn by the user, the user gives various commands and notifications to the system as input via the joystick (3) and microphone (4), the screen (5) of a virtual reality glasses (1) of the processor (6) asks the user to choose roles such as earthquake volunteer, AFAD and paramedic or earthquake victim in which he/she will take an active role during or after the earthquake, a processor (6) shows the user the scenarios that are suitable for the selected task and loaded into the database (7), the user is performing the tasks, the audio transmitter (2) device, joystick (3) and microphone (4) data are processed and the task performance status is interpreted by the processor (6) containing the artificial intelligence algorithm, and it includes the process steps of the artificial intelligence algorithm to evaluate the user.

title_en: Overhead propeller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water side-mounted propeller which comprises a driving mechanism and a connecting device, wherein the driving mechanism is detachably connected with the driving mechanism, the driving mechanism comprises a propeller and a hydraulic motor, a connecting shaft is arranged on the propeller, the output end of the hydraulic motor is connected to the connecting shaft of the propeller and used for driving the propeller, the connecting device comprises a connecting rod and a sliding rail, and the top end of the connecting rod is connected with the sliding rail so as to adjust the position of the propeller in the vertical direction through up-and-down movement of the sliding rail. The utility model provides the water propeller by adopting the combination of a plurality of structures such as the propeller, the hydraulic motor, the connecting shaft, the connecting rod, the sliding rail, the hydraulic oil cylinder and the like, and by adopting the structure, the operability of the door bridge in the training process can be improved, the collision of the door bridge in the training process can be reduced, the completion time of each subject of the door bridge can be reduced, and the efficiency of the door bridge in executing tasks can be greatly improved. The structure is widely applied to the fields of flood control, disaster relief and the like.

title_en: Urban underground cable tunnel network fire disaster temperature prediction method and related device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid safety prediction, and provides a fire disaster temperature prediction method and a related device for an urban underground cable tunnel network, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting environmental data in a cable tunnel and material data of the cable; based on the environment data and the material data, a three-dimensional finite element model comprising an electromagnetic field, a thermal field and a fluid field is established, the temperature response of a cable under different conditions is simulated, sample data of the cable core temperature is obtained, based on the environment data and the material data, a convolutional neural network CNN is trained to extract characteristics, then a CNN-LSTM hybrid model is constructed by processing time sequence data through a long-short-term memory network LSTM, and the obtained sample data of the cable core temperature is used as input of the CNN-LSTM hybrid model, so that a predicted value of the cable core temperature is obtained. Not only improves the accuracy and the instantaneity of prediction, but also enhances the adaptability and the robustness of the model to complex environments, and has wide application prospect and important social value.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning system method for mine multidimensional fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses a method of a mine multidimensional fusion intelligent monitoring and early warning system, the system is an all-time, multi-scale and multi-parameter coupling monitoring and early warning model and system integrating twelve modules, such as an original data acquisition module, mining condition analysis, data transmission module, data pre-processing, expert analysis and demonstration, optimal parameter delineation, basic theoretical calculation, numerical simulation analysis, laboratory verification, machine learning, neural network optimization, coupling model construction, field application detection and the like. The intelligent monitoring and early warning system method for the mine multidimensional fusion provided by the invention utilizes a multi-level means, avoids the limitation of the traditional single scheme or the subjectivity of single human interference, can achieve the aim of effectively preventing mine dynamic disasters to a great extent, and has great significance in monitoring and early warning for reducing coal-rock gas composite dynamic disasters and safety production of the mine.

title_en: Tunnel outburst prevention rock crack expansion continuous monitoring method based on microseismic internal field positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous monitoring method for crack expansion of a tunnel outburst prevention rock body based on microseism internal field positioning, which comprises the steps of S1, drilling advanced drilling holes on a tunnel face according to the distance L between a disaster-causing structure and the face, obtaining surrounding rock lithology and water inflow information, preliminarily determining the range of a hydraulic communication area of the outburst prevention rock body, S2, respectively arranging microseism sensors on a vault, a left basement and a right basement which are positioned in front of the face in the drilled advanced drilling holes within the range of L/2-2 to L/2+2, S3, recording the frequency, duration and waveform of a seismic source microseism signal of explosive blasting, mechanical vibration and vehicle running, screening the microseism signal of crack expansion in the rock body, S4, performing the crack expansion seismic source positioning in the rock body by adopting a single-solid method, S5, drawing a three-dimensional model of a microseism event, and determining the crack expansion characteristics and the range of the hydraulic communication area. The invention can improve the monitoring continuity and the positioning precision of the water bursting channel in the tunnel outburst prevention rock crack evolution process.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;SICHUAN TIBET RAILWAY CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear accident emergency exercise desktop deduction system, method and terminal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nuclear accident emergency exercise desktop deduction system, method and terminal, which comprise a scene management module, a deduction starting module, a deduction control module, a robot simulation module, an emergency response module and a deduction visualization module, wherein the scene management module is used for managing emergency exercise scenes, the deduction starting module is used for starting corresponding deductions according to exercise scenes selected by a user, the deduction control module is used for controlling a deduction process and outputting instructions and/or data in the deduction process to coordinate the work of each module, the robot simulation module is used for generating a robot emergency post and simulating emergency response actions, the emergency response module is used for carrying out emergency response and feedback response action information according to the nuclear accident emergency deduction process, and the deduction visualization module is used for integrally displaying the deduction process and the emergency response actions of each emergency post. The invention can realize desktop, informatization, flow and automation of nuclear accident emergency exercise, reduce exercise cost and effectively improve emergency preparation and response capability.

title_en: Membrane structure fire disaster temperature field simulation method considering membrane material weld joint detachment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a membrane structure fire temperature field simulation method considering membrane material welding seam detachment, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a three-dimensional model of a membrane structure building to be simulated, S2, importing the three-dimensional model into Pyros im software, S3, dividing grids according to fire source power of the membrane structure building to be simulated, width of the membrane material welding seam and distribution position of the membrane material welding seam in Pyros im software, converting the three-dimensional model into an obstacle, S4, setting fire source parameters of the membrane structure building to be simulated and material properties and geometric properties of building components in Pyros im software, S5, arranging temperature measuring points in Pyros im software, calling FDS program calculation, and S6, comparing and analyzing to consider influence of membrane material welding seam detachment on the membrane structure building fire temperature field. The invention can simulate the phenomenon that the membrane material is separated at the welding seam to cause the escape of smoke when the membrane building structure is in fire, thereby obtaining the fire temperature field of the membrane building structure considering the separation of the welding seam of the membrane material.
assignees: EAST CHINA ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Natural gas pipeline leakage diffusion risk evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural gas pipeline leakage diffusion risk evaluation method and system, which relate to the technical field of natural gas leakage, and aims at an urban underground gas pipeline system, a natural gas pipeline leakage diffusion risk evaluation index system is established based on analysis of natural gas pipeline leakage diffusion accident reasons and related documents, a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process and an entropy weight process are used for calculating natural gas pipeline leakage diffusion risk index weights to obtain subjective weights and objective weights, the subjective weights and the objective weights are calculated based on a least square method to obtain combined weights, a natural gas pipeline leakage diffusion model is established, so that the natural gas pipeline structure and the natural gas leakage diffusion influence are clearer, the natural gas pipeline leakage diffusion risk level can be simulated, the urban gas pipeline system safety is better evaluated, targeted measures are formulated, the urban gas pipeline reliability level is improved, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability of an urban life line system is ensured.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Space positioning method and device based on earthquake wave and sound wave
abstract_en: The invention provides a space positioning method and a device based on earthquake waves and sound waves, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an earthquake channel dataset and an acoustic wave dataset which are formed by continuous data, respectively dividing the dataset and the acoustic wave dataset, inputting the dataset into a first submodel and a second submodel for training to obtain an earthquake space positioning prediction model, and predicting current data by using the earthquake space positioning prediction model to obtain space positioning information of a current earthquake. The method has the beneficial effects that the earthquake spatial positioning prediction model is used for training and predicting by combining earthquake wave data and sound wave data and utilizing an advanced machine learning model, so that the accurate spatial positioning of the earthquake can be realized, and powerful support can be provided for earthquake monitoring and early warning. The precision and reliability of earthquake positioning can be improved, and contribution is made to reducing the influence of earthquake disasters.

title_en: Method for identifying and controlling coal spontaneous combustion and gas symbiotic disasters in overlapped goaf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying and managing coal spontaneous combustion and gas symbiotic disasters in an overlapped goaf, which can accurately obtain the approximate range of a front goaf by combining geological data, transient electromagnetic detection devices and results detected by a drilling peeping instrument together, calculate the pore dimension and average porosity of the area through a specific algorithm, and then lay a plurality of detection holes with different angles by taking grouting holes as the center, form a distribution form that the directions of the detection holes are continuously outwards diffused in a spherical shape, and by arranging comprehensive monitoring devices at the final holes of the detection holes, whether the data of an underground gas concentration field, a temperature field, a gas pressure field, an air leakage flow field and a ground stress field is abnormal or not is obtained, and the redundant or complementary information of the monitoring devices at a plurality of different positions in space or time is interpreted or described relatively completely and consistently for the whole goaf, so that more accurate identification and judgment of disaster conditions are realized, and construction safety in the whole tunneling or extraction process can be ensured.

title_en: Tunnel group fire personnel evacuation analysis method based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire evacuation, in particular to a tunnel group fire personnel evacuation analysis method based on cellular automata. The method comprises the steps of S1, constructing a tunnel group digital model according to the actual structure and the size of the tunnel group, S2, dividing grids, constructing a two-dimensional cellular automaton model, S3, setting evacuation personnel parameters, S4, simulating a fire scene by using FDS, S5, calculating a relative distance field and a dynamic field, S6, generating a personnel movement model, S7, completing movement of personnel and judging the number of personnel in a space, and S8, outputting evacuation time and evacuation success rate of evacuated personnel. The invention can simulate the evacuation process of personnel in the tunnel group when a fire disaster occurs by using the cellular automaton model. By constructing the tunnel group digital model, the space of the tunnel group digital model is divided into discrete cells with equal size, and the moving direction of personnel is calculated based on fire data, so that the actual behavior of evacuated personnel can be reflected more truly.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY GUANGZHOU BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SHENZHEN;XIASHEN RAILWAY GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment fire disaster prediction method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a power equipment fire prediction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of training a preset XGBoost model according to historical fire case data to obtain an initial fire prediction model; the method comprises the steps of collecting a data set of power equipment, wherein the data set comprises a plurality of training samples, each training sample comprises historical environment data corresponding to any time point, adjusting training weights in an initial fire prediction model according to the historical environment data to obtain adjusted training weights, applying the adjusted training weights to the initial fire prediction model to obtain an adjusted target fire prediction model, and inputting the environment data and the power data of the power equipment, which are collected in real time, into the target fire prediction model to obtain a fire prediction result output by the target fire prediction model. By optimizing the fire prediction model, the accuracy of fire prediction of the power equipment is improved, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability and operation and maintenance decision level of the power grid are improved.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Goaf gas and coal spontaneous combustion composite disaster simulation system and prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a goaf gas and coal spontaneous combustion composite disaster simulation system and a prediction method, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine thermodynamic disaster evolution process simulation tests. The simulation system comprises a transparent cover body, a simulation test bed, a mining working face simulation model, an air supply unit, a monitoring unit, a camera device and a balancing weight. The inclination angle of the base is adjusted by adjusting the telescopic supporting legs, the water bag is utilized to simulate a coal bed, and the coal pillar is used as a methane release channel in the simulated exploitation process. Simulating a mining process, conveying gas, monitoring the evolution rule of methane and oxygen concentration data, drawing a relevant contour map, interpolating to reconstruct a space dangerous area, and finally adopting a phase space reconstruction method to conduct chaotic prediction and analyzing disaster space morphological changes. The invention can realize simulation test and visualization of the gas and coal spontaneous combustion composite disaster evolution process, quantitatively characterize the dangerous area, provide theoretical basis for disaster prevention and control, and ensure energy safety and worker life safety.

title_en: Method and device for relieving natural disaster risk of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster risk relieving method and device for an electric power system, which comprises an hour-level composite cascade event set generating module, a risk relieving module, a distributed resource evaluating module, a natural disaster influence module and a power grid control module, wherein the hour-level composite cascade event set generating module is used for generating an hour-level data set under various natural disaster scenes, capturing cascade effects of different disasters, providing data support for risk influence quantification of the electric power system and strategy generation of the risk relieving module, the distributed resource evaluating module is used for evaluating availability and power generation potential of distributed resources in a three-level area, analyzing the power generation potential of the distributed resources during various natural disasters by combining weather and disaster factors, the natural disaster influence module is constructed, the influence of the various natural disasters on the electric power system is simulated based on the hour-level composite cascade event set, the damage degree of the disasters on loads, power generation facilities, power transmission and distribution lines and the like is analyzed, the risk relieving module is constructed, a disaster emergency scheme is formulated for an area with the risk influence on the basis of a three-level collaborative mechanism, the power generation potential of the distributed resource evaluating module is used, and the power grid is quickly restored and stably operated by scheduling various distributed resources, repairing the power grid and load adjusting.

title_en: True fire bombing and backfire container for fire-fighting exercise
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of firefighter training and discloses a fire bombing and backfiring container for fire-fighting exercise, which comprises a container body, wherein an observation chamber, a fire combustion chamber, an equipment room and a control chamber are sequentially arranged in the container body, the observation chamber and the fire combustion chamber are communicated through a first demolition door, a second demolition door is arranged on one side, far away from the fire combustion chamber, of the observation chamber, a third demolition door is arranged on the fire combustion chamber, a fourth door body is arranged between the equipment, a fifth door body is arranged in the control chamber, a water bath channel is arranged on the ground of the observation chamber and the fire combustion chamber, a water bath type fire combustion pool is arranged in the fire combustion chamber, a shock wave generator and a smoke box are arranged on the wall of the fire combustion chamber, and a water cooling wall and a gas pipeline are arranged on the ceiling of the fire combustion chamber. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages of good simulation effect of fire back combustion and bombing combustion and high safety.

title_en: Working face initial mining period hydraulic fracturing roof cutting drilling arrangement method based on asymmetric three-hinged arch structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mining, and discloses a hydraulic fracturing roof cutting drilling arrangement method based on an asymmetric three-hinged arch structure in the initial mining period of a working face, which aims to solve the technical problems existing in the treatment of a hard top plate in the initial mining period in the prior art, and comprises the steps of judging the position of a key layer, judging the breaking distance of the hard top plate of the working face, determining the horizontal position of the breaking of an old roof based on the asymmetric three-hinged arch structure, determining the vertical height of the hydraulic fracturing roof, namely, the collapse height h, the construction of the conventional straight hole fracturing holes in the working face cutting holes, the transportation lanes on the two sides and the return air, the construction of the fracturing holes in the cutting holes perpendicular to the coal wall, the drilling construction through drilling equipment, the conventional drilling fracturing, the directional long drilling fracturing and the like are respectively carried out. The invention reduces the rock mass strength, effectively controls the mine pressure disasters caused by the integral collapse of the large-area suspended roof, avoids the occurrence of pressure frames and rock burst disasters, fully plays the respective advantages of conventional straight holes and directional holes, and provides guarantee for realizing safe and efficient stoping.
assignees: SHAANXI YANCHANG PETROLEUM BALASU COAL IND CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Method for preventing disaster and increasing yield of wheat and jade overyear double cropping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheat and corn annual double cropping disaster prevention and high yield method, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing a wheat sowing period and a sowing soil, S2, treating wheat seeds, selecting high-quality seeds to mix seeds with tebuconazole and imidacloprid, S3, carrying out wheat sowing operation, adopting drill sowing, S4, preparing before corn sowing, soaking the corn seeds in a solution containing azotobacter and amino acid before corn sowing, S5, carrying out no-tillage treatment after wheat harvest, spraying a specific microbial straw degradation agent, smashing and throwing the straws during harvesting, S6, carrying out corn seed treatment and sowing period, S7, corn sowing, sowing seeds by adopting a seed manure co-sowing machine, S8, corn field management, S9, weather disaster prevention, S10, pest control, S11 and soil management. The method is obviously superior to the conventional planting methods and other planting methods, effectively improves the yield and stability, enhances the disaster resistance, improves the water resource utilization rate, provides a scientific and efficient scheme for the annual double cropping planting of the wheat and the corn, and assists the sustainable development of agriculture.

title_en: Micro-seismic quantitative prediction method based on theoretical model constraint and data driving fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microearthquake quantitative prediction method based on constraint and data driving fusion of a theoretical model, which comprises the steps of 1, obtaining original microearthquake data of a coal mine working face to form an initial sample data set, 2, preprocessing the data, dividing a training set and a testing set, 3, constructing a long and short memory network LSTM model, 4, sampling historical microearthquake data to serve as a microearthquake event quantitative prediction sample, 5, constructing a multi-target optimization model containing a microearthquake time fractal dimension, a microearthquake space fractal dimension, microearthquake energy fractal dimension, microearthquake prediction total energy, microearthquake reconstruction mining stress, microearthquake activity working procedures and seven sub-objective functions of a microearthquake energy-frequency power law b value, and 6, and obtaining an optimal sampling sample to serve as a prediction value. According to the invention, quantitative prediction of the microseismic event based on the combination of theoretical model constraint and data driving is realized through the steps, the prediction effect is good, and the prediction result can effectively guide the on-site production activity procedure regulation and control and the implementation of pressure relief measures and disaster early warning.

title_en: Mountain torrent susceptibility evaluation method coupled with hydrologic model and logistic regression
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent vulnerability assessment method by coupling a hydrological model and logistic regression, which comprises the steps of constructing the hydrological model, calculating the torrent disaster-formation flow of each primary sub-basin, setting different rainfall scenes, simulating the flood process of each primary sub-basin under different rainfall scenes by using the hydrological model, selecting rainfall scenes which can reflect the general rule of the torrent disaster-formation of the basin, collecting the torrent disaster-formation flow data of each primary sub-basin for constructing a torrent vulnerability assessment model according to the rainfall scenes, extracting the characteristics of each primary sub-basin as an assessment factor, carrying out a torrent vulnerability assessment factor primary screening based on a Pearson correlation coefficient method, completing screening on the torrent vulnerability assessment parameters based on the primary screening result, and carrying out a sub-basin torrent vulnerability assessment based on logistic regression. Compared with the prior art, the method can realize convenient and efficient judgment of the susceptibility of the mountain torrents in the river basin.

title_en: Dangerous area constructor safety management system
abstract_en: The invention provides a safety management system for constructors in a dangerous area, which integrates a plurality of modules such as biological feature recognition, somatosensory interaction monitoring, safety early warning, electronic fence, data processing and analysis, visual management interface, environment monitoring, emergency response, virtual reality training and the like, the system accurately verifies the identity of the constructors through gait and iris recognition technology, monitors a behavior mode through a 3D sensing technology, sends early warning through an intelligent safety cap and wearing equipment, the electronic fence module limits an operation area, the data processing module collects and analyzes safety data, the visual management interface provides visual monitoring, the environment monitoring module monitors environmental parameters in real time, the emergency response module automatically starts an emergency program, the virtual reality training module improves the safety consciousness and the emergency processing capability of the constructors through the 3D model interaction, and the system effectively improves the intellectualization, the instantaneity and the effectiveness of the construction safety management in the dangerous area and reduces the safety risk.
assignees: SICHUAN MINGXING NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue scheme generation method, system and device based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency rescue, in particular to an emergency rescue scheme generation method, system and device based on reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring all wounded data and available rescue vehicle data of a disaster scene; S2, inputting the wounded data and the dominable rescue vehicle data into a reinforcement learning model as rescue states, constructing a reward function based on survival probability of the wounded, performing iterative training with the value of the reward function maximized as a target to obtain a trained reinforcement learning model, and S3, inputting the current rescue state based on the trained reinforcement learning model to obtain the action with the maximum reward value, namely the optimal wounded rescue scheme. The invention not only can improve the rescue efficiency and reduce casualties, but also can optimize resource allocation and lighten the workload of rescue workers, and has important significance for improving the overall level of emergency rescue.
assignees: SUZHOU JIANGNAN AEROSPACE MECH & ELECTRICAL INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Pressure relief hole-anchoring hole spacing determination method based on discharging-supporting cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the distance between a pressure relief hole and an anchor hole based on the cooperation of relief and support, which belongs to the technical field of rock burst disaster prevention and control, and comprises the following steps: and A, designing the optimal pressure relief hole-anchoring hole distance according to the diameter ratio of the pressure relief hole-anchoring hole, and calculating the range R  d 、R p 、r d 、r p  of a crushing area and a plastic area around the pressure relief hole-anchoring hole. According to the invention, by utilizing numerical simulation software, the stress concentration coefficient between adjacent pressure relief holes and anchoring holes and the lane side coal body approaching amount are calculated to judge whether the hole spacing plays a synergistic effect, the corresponding test time is saved without on-site actual measurement data, the hole spacing design in the on-site production process can be guided through theoretical calculation, the method has reference value in the technical method field of rock burst prevention and control, and the crushing area, the plastic area range and the anchor bolt support reinforcing area range around the pressure relief holes and anchoring holes are calculated.

title_en: Method and system for predicting landslide surge height based on sparrow optimization random forest model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data driving and landslide surge disaster prevention and control, and discloses a method and a system for predicting landslide surge height based on a sparrow optimization random forest model, wherein the method comprises the steps of building a corresponding landslide surge physical model aiming at a target landslide area, setting test groups with different landslide square quantities and water depths for testing, obtaining a corresponding test data set, and scaling in equal proportion according to a Froude similarity criterion; and preprocessing the test data to obtain corresponding data sets, and dividing the preprocessed data sets into training sets and test sets. Setting up a sparrow optimization random forest model, setting up various parameter input values, training the sparrow optimization random forest model by a training set, and predicting the maximum height of landslide surge by using a label data set and the trained sparrow optimization random forest model. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data division module and a landslide surge prediction module. The method can accurately predict the maximum height of landslide surge.

title_en: Intelligent switch planning method considering disaster pre-disaster-middle-post multi-stage cooperation and disaster uncertainty
abstract_en: An intelligent switch planning method considering pre-disaster-mid-post multi-stage synergy and disaster uncertainty relates to the technical field of intelligent switch planning of power grids and is used for solving the problem that the existing pre-disaster planning does not consider the disaster intensity uncertainty. The invention realizes the multi-stage coordination of determining the number of switches in the planning stage, finishing switch address selection in the prevention stage and closing the switch to restore load in the post-disaster stage by coupling the available measures of the pre-disaster planning stage, the pre-disaster prevention stage, the post-disaster recovery stage. In addition, a gradual hedging algorithm is provided, a large nonlinear model is decomposed into a plurality of scene-related sub-problems to be solved, and the calculation load is greatly reduced. Simulation results show that compared with a pre-disaster-post-disaster two-stage planning model, the model provided by the invention not only can obtain a more flexible planning scheme, but also can reduce investment cost and load power failure loss.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;YANTAI ENGINEERING UNIV RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST

title_en: Storm surge proximity monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storm tide early warning, and discloses a storm tide approaching monitoring and early warning method and system, wherein the storm tide approaching monitoring and early warning method comprises the steps of acquiring storm tide associated information and astronomical tide data when a storm tide approaches; the storm tide value simulation calculation result of a future time period is calculated by inputting storm tide related information into a storm tide value simulation model, the storm tide value simulation calculation result comprises a storm tide water increasing height, the water level of the future time period is calculated according to the storm tide value simulation calculation result and astronomical tide data, whether storm tide warning is generated or not is judged according to the water level of the future time period and the warning water level, and the condition that the storm tide warning is generated is that the water level of the future time period is larger than the warning water level. The method can early warn the tide disaster generated by overlapping astronomical tide and storm tide in future time, and is beneficial to reducing the tide disaster loss because the time for coping with the tide disaster is long.

title_en: Forestry remote sensing data light weight method based on subspace optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forestry remote sensing data light-weight method based on latent space optimization, which belongs to the technical field of image processing and comprises the steps of obtaining a forestry remote sensing image data set D1 to be compressed, constructing a data light-weight network, training the variable self-encoder and the image classification network by using the D1, generating a clustering data set D2 based on the encoder and the clustering unit, updating latent space variables in the D2 by using the training data light-weight network, and reconstructing data by using a decoder. The compression data set with high precision and representativeness is generated by improving the data set distillation based on the variation self-encoder and the meta-gradient optimization, so that the bottleneck problem of forestry remote sensing data set storage and processing is effectively solved, and the data storage capacity can be reduced while the model training precision is maintained. The method is suitable for various practical application scenes such as forestry resource monitoring, forest health evaluation, disaster response and the like.

title_en: Verification test method for increasing output of unit and improving emergency guarantee capability of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power systems and discloses a verification test method for increasing output of a unit and improving emergency guarantee capability of a power grid, which comprises the steps of initializing a unit simulation environment after loading a unit model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of expert strategies based on a unit simulation environment through training a reinforcement learning model, interacting with the unit simulation environment through the expert strategies, sampling a plurality of expert tracks, constructing a generator and discriminators with the same number as the expert strategies, interacting with the unit simulation environment through the generator in the training process, sampling a simulator track, training one discriminator with each expert track through the simulator track, calculating a reward value according to discrimination values output by the discriminators, training the generator according to the simulator track and the reward value through a PPO algorithm, and obtaining a verification test model for increasing output of the unit according to the trained generator. The invention can improve the output of the unit and the emergency response capability of the power grid, and ensure the stability and the performance improvement of the operation.
assignees: YUNNAN HUADIAN JINSHAJIANG MIDDLE REACH WATER POWER DEV CO LTD AHAI POWER GENERATION BRANCH

title_en: Management method based on physical examination queuing call system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical informatization, and discloses a management method based on an agent physical examination queuing call system, which comprises the steps of constructing an intelligent call model, the physical examination queuing and call management process is modeled as a Markov decision process, and the dynamic adjustment queuing strategy and call management scheme are realized. The model defines a multidimensional state space including physical examination subject information, queuing conditions, physical examination facilities, and call facilities, and an action space including actions of adjusting the order of physical examination items, guiding physical examination subjects, sending call notifications, and the like. And training a model by designing a reward function comprehensively considering the satisfaction degree, the waiting time, the equipment utilization rate and the emergency response capability of the physical examination person and adopting a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to continuously optimize strategies with the aim of maximizing accumulated rewards. The invention improves the physical examination efficiency and the service quality, reduces the waiting time of physical examination persons, enhances the coping capability of the system to emergency situations, and has obvious technical advantages and application value.

title_en: Crack generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a crack generation method, a crack generation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of strong mine pressure disaster prevention and control of a hard roof of a coal mine. The method comprises the steps of distributing drilling holes according to the direction of the minimum principal stress of a hard top plate, carrying out first staged fracturing according to a preset staged fracturing interval in the drilling holes, combining mixed fracturing fluid to obtain a parallel fracture group vertical to the direction of the minimum principal stress, wherein the mixed fracturing fluid comprises propping agent, induced stress is arranged in the preset staged fracturing interval, carrying out second fracturing segmentation in the middle area of every two adjacent parallel fractures in the parallel fracture group, combining the fracturing fluid to obtain steering fractures between every two adjacent parallel fractures, enabling the direction of the steering fractures to extend to the fracture to intersect with the extension line of every two adjacent parallel fractures, realizing the generation of the steering fractures based on the extension direction of the induced stress, enhancing the complexity and connectivity of a fracture network, and improving the fracturing weakening and collapsing effects of the hard top plate.

title_en: Hydraulic fracturing pressure relief method for multi-layer thick hard roof of ultra-thick coal seam
abstract_en: The hydraulic fracturing pressure relief method for the multi-layer thick hard roof of the ultra-thick coal seam comprises the steps of obtaining the formation shape of the multi-layer thick hard roof by adopting a roof drilling method, evaluating the stability of the multi-layer thick hard roof based on a rock mechanics experiment method and a roof peeping method, judging a fracturing target layer in the multi-layer thick hard roof, arranging directional drilling holes in the fracturing target layer according to the formation shape, adopting abrasive jet flow and staged fracturing to make a seam on the fracturing target layer in the directional drilling holes, monitoring the crack expansion range of the fracturing target layer in real time based on a micro-earthquake monitoring method in holes, and dynamically adjusting fracturing construction parameters according to the crack expansion range.
