In the hydraulic fracturing pressure relief method for the multi-layer thick hard roof of the ultra-thick coal seam, rock stratum testing before fracturing, determination of key parameters of fracturing construction and monitoring after fracturing are utilized, so that a good pressure relief effect of the multi-layer thick hard roof is ensured, and effective prevention and control of strong mine pressure disasters of the multi-layer thick hard roof are realized.

title_en: Gas disaster is administered and is used drainage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas disaster management extraction device, which relates to the technical field of gas extraction, and comprises a moving device, wherein the top end of the moving device is provided with an extraction pipe clamping device, the inner side of the extraction pipe clamping device is provided with a height adjusting device, the gas disaster management extraction device can rapidly clamp extraction pipes of different specifications by using a placing clamp and a lifting clamp which are contained in the extraction pipe clamping device through the arrangement of the extraction pipe clamping device and the height adjusting device, and a rotating shaft which is contained in the height adjusting device can drive a lifting rod above a hinge rod to integrally adjust the height of the placing clamp and the lifting clamp through a movable sleeve, so that extraction pipes of different sizes can be inserted into drilling holes of different heights by the device, and the practicability of the device is remarkably improved.
assignees: XIADIAN COAL MINE OF SHANXI LUAN MINING GROUP CILINSHAN COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel water-bursting mud-bursting disaster early warning test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tunnel water and mud bursting disaster early warning test device which is applied to the field of tunnel engineering and comprises a box body, wherein a simulation tunnel is arranged in the box body, a simulation mechanism is arranged between the simulation tunnel and the box body, a fixing plate is bolted to the inner wall of the simulation tunnel, and a fixing seat is arranged at the top of the fixing plate; according to the utility model, the clamping rod is separated from the clamping groove by moving the stirring block, the fixing pin is taken down, the camera is taken out for disassembly, the purpose of facilitating assembly and disassembly of the camera can be achieved, the workload is reduced, the working efficiency is improved, and the camera is convenient to use.

title_en: Auxiliary decision making system applied to mine fire extinguishing field
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary decision making system applied to the field of mine fire prevention and extinguishment, and relates to the technical field of mine fire prevention and extinguishment. The system comprises a data acquisition unit, a back-end auxiliary decision unit and a front-end interaction unit. The system comprises a data acquisition unit, a rear-end auxiliary decision unit, a front-end interaction unit and a mobile device, wherein the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring relevant parameters of each monitoring area in a target mine, the rear-end auxiliary decision unit is used for predicting according to the relevant parameters and a fire disaster early warning model, performing decision suggestion on a predicted grade result and performing visual display on the grade result through color distinction, the front-end interaction unit is used for simulating a monitoring environment of the target mine, displaying grade result colors corresponding to each monitoring area in an associated mode with the simulation model, and sending the corresponding decision suggestion to the mobile device of a worker for warning when the grade result is lower than a safety limit value. The invention can solve the problems of hysteresis relying on manual monitoring and analysis in the prior art and improve the accuracy and efficiency of fire prediction.
assignees: DALAI NUR COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Long-term intelligent prediction method for wind-induced response of super high-rise building structure during typhoon passing
abstract_en: A long-term intelligent prediction method for wind induced response of a super high-rise building structure during typhoon passing is characterized by comprising the following steps of calculating structural wind induced vibration response corresponding to a target super high-rise building, training a cascading forward BP neural network model by adopting a Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm, predicting incoming flow wind field information of the target super high-rise building by utilizing an AI-driven transform weather prediction model and a linear typhoon model, inputting the incoming flow wind field prediction information and corresponding structural modal parameters into the trained cascading forward BP neural network model, and rapidly predicting structural wind induced vibration responses of the super high-rise building at different positions under different future time conditions. The method can rapidly, flexibly and reliably realize long-term prediction of wind vibration response of the super high-rise building structure during typhoon passing, and provide references for prediction and early warning of the structural vibration state of the super high-rise building during typhoon, thereby improving the urban related emergency response capability and realizing transition from passive emergency to decision forward.

title_en: Interpretable machine learning-assisted fire prediction assessment method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-type sensor
abstract_en: A fire prediction assessment method, a system, equipment and a medium based on the interpretability machine learning assistance of multiple types of sensors are used for different scenes, a large number of fire data sets are collected and integrated, a plurality of different fire scenes, namely different time, different places and the like are covered, the data sets are divided into training sets and test sets, a convolutional neural network sub-model is built, the model is used for training to achieve universal modeling of fire prediction, a principal component analysis method is used for carrying out disaster assessment on a place where the fire is predicted by combining an entropy weight method, and accurate universal assessment of disaster receiving degree is achieved.

title_en: Automatic wharf sudden disturbance emergency scheduling method based on simulation optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic dock sudden disturbance emergency dispatching method based on simulation optimization, which comprises the steps of establishing an automatic dock simulation model, establishing a dock loading and unloading operation logic model comprising a loading logic model and a unloading logic model according to a dock loading and unloading operation automatic operation process, and obtaining a sudden disturbance emergency dispatching strategy of an automatic dock through an optimization algorithm considering disturbance, wherein the disturbance comprises disturbance of the number of container operations and disturbance of the number of unmanned collection cards. The invention fully considers the common sudden disturbance problems in the container scheduling, ensures the continuous and smooth loading and unloading operation of the automatic wharf through the simulation optimization process, and improves the emergency response level of the automatic wharf.

title_en: Shallow velocity model construction method based on joint inversion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shallow velocity model construction method based on joint inversion, and relates to the technical field of geophysical exploration. The method introduces high-frequency Rayleigh wave information and far-reaching cross convolution waveforms in natural earthquakes in joint inversion, considers the influence of parameters on a speed structure model, simultaneously avoids the interference of other types of waves on Rayleigh waves, effectively screens out noise segments with dominant Rayleigh wave energy, effectively solves the difficulty of extracting high-frequency Rayleigh wave ellipticity from a single waveform, and can effectively simulate shallow three-dimensional of the whole crust through joint inversion And The speed structure model is particularly aimed at a sedimentary layer, is beneficial to the research of the deep structure science problem of a research area and the exploration and development of oil and gas resources, can improve the simulation precision of earthquake and assists the earthquake-resistant disaster reduction work of an earthquake area.

title_en: Multi-dimensional cable arc-induced fire disaster assessment method based on digital image
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-dimensional cable arc-induced fire disaster assessment method based on digital images. The method comprises the steps of establishing multi-dimensional physical information synchronous acquisition of a firing process under the electrified operation of a cable through a plurality of high-speed cameras matched with smoke, gas and temperature multi-path sensors, constructing and calculating an arc-induced cable fire three-dimensional model by taking a plurality of typical fault arcs as fire heat sources by utilizing a multi-physical field coupling simulation means based on FDS kernels, establishing a cable arc fire characteristic data set according to arc and cable flame images and multi-dimensional physical information data, and evaluating and judging the cable fire hazard degree under various fault arc conditions by combining a analytic hierarchy process.

title_en: Method for enhancing intelligent building site fire disaster recognition capability by using AI large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for enhancing fire disaster recognition capability of an intelligent building site by using an AI large model, relates to the field of fire disaster recognition, and solves the technical problems that the existing fire disaster recognition technology is limited in detection distance and insufficient in detection of dark fires. The method comprises a dark fire identification model construction step and a dark fire identification analysis step, wherein the dark fire identification model construction step comprises the steps of S11, collecting a dark fire training sample, and S12, training the dark fire training sample through a deep convolutional neural network model, wherein the dark fire training sample comprises first characteristic values of a hidden heat source, an air expansion distortion phenomenon and a light refraction phenomenon. Compared with the traditional fire disaster identification algorithm, the invention reduces the dependence on smoke alarm and temperature-sensing fire disaster detector, obviously increases the detection distance of fire disaster, timely early warns against hidden fire, can prevent the generation of a part of fire disaster, and ensures the engineering progress and construction safety.

title_en: Indoor fire disaster bombing risk prediction method based on flame morphology and remote sensing data
abstract_en: A method for predicting indoor fire disaster risk based on flame morphology and remote sensing data includes the steps of simulating fire disaster data by using fire disaster simulation software to construct a fire disaster data set, igniting, acquiring an indoor fire disaster flame image through a high-definition camera, processing the acquired image, outputting a real-time heat release rate HRR of a starting point through a residual network Resnet model through the processed image, monitoring and acquiring methane gas concentration data of an indoor specific-height smoke layer in real time by using a methane laser remote sensing detector, constructing a fire disaster risk prediction model based on the heat release rate of a fire source and the methane gas concentration, and predicting the risk of the fire disaster in advance. The invention realizes the accurate identification and prediction of the bombing risk of the fire disaster in the early stage of the fire disaster development, and sends out the early warning signal when the fire disaster is about to enter the bombing stage, thereby reducing the casualties and the property loss caused by the fire disaster.
assignees: SHENZHEN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA UNIV OF MINING AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Tidal estuary area salty tide invasion lower water supply risk assessment method based on fresh water rescue and storage scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for evaluating water supply risk under salt tide invasion in a tidal estuary area based on the scheduling of fresh water in robbing and accumulating, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring daily target site data and historical salt tide disaster simulation data of a research area in the same time sequence; training a historical salty tide disaster simulation model by utilizing target site data, inputting the historical salty tide disaster simulation data into the trained historical salty tide disaster simulation model to obtain a long-sequence historical salinity simulation value, generalizing a water supply system of a research area, constructing a water supply risk comprehensive evaluation index system based on the emergency fresh water scheduling, calculating a comprehensive water supply risk index according to the long-sequence historical salinity simulation value based on the water supply risk comprehensive evaluation index system, performing frequency analysis on the comprehensive water supply risk index, and dividing the water supply risk degree and the early warning level based on a set water supply risk threshold. The invention quantifies the comprehensive water supply risk index based on the emergency and storage fresh water dispatching, scientifically divides the degree of the risk of the salty tide and the early warning level from the angles of the influence degree and the occurrence frequency of the salty tide disaster in long sequence, and provides effective decision basis for the water supply safety research and judgment of the estuary coastal area which depends on the tidal river reach as the water source area.
assignees: PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RES INST PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Landslide surge physical and numerical hybrid model construction method, system and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical fields of hydraulic engineering, geotechnical mechanics and geological disaster prevention and control engineering, and discloses a landslide surge physical and numerical hybrid model construction method, a system and application, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing a landslide instability evolution movement process, a landslide warehouse-in first wave height and a surge propagation process of landslide surge according to a first result of a landslide surge physical model test; according to a second result of the landslide surge numerical model test, performing a numerical simulation test, adjusting the particle size and a kernel function in the landslide surge numerical simulation test to enable the first wave height in the landslide surge numerical simulation test and the landslide surge physical model test to reach the opposite bank height, enabling the surge pressure distribution to be consistent, and taking the adjusted landslide surge numerical model as an obtained landslide surge mixed model. The system comprises a first result acquisition module, a second result acquisition module, a test parameter adjustment module and a mixed model acquisition module. The invention can conveniently analyze different calculation conditions.

title_en: Flood inundation range calculation method based on grid water level and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a grid water level-based flood inundation range calculation method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of flood process prediction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method and the system have the advantages that firstly, the flow process of each river channel key section is calculated by using a distributed hydrological model, the water level of each river channel key section is calculated according to the water level flow relation, the water level of each grid of the river channel can be determined, then, whether each river basin grid is submerged or not can be determined by comparing the elevation of the river channel grid with the elevation of other grids in the river basin, a flood submerged range is obtained, and compared with the scheme that the NS equation is solved by using a finite element method in the prior art, the water depth of each position in the river basin is obtained, the prediction efficiency of the flood submerged range is remarkably improved, and basis and support are provided for rapidly simulating the flood submerged range, evaluating the influence of flood disasters, making flood prevention measures in advance and the like.

title_en: Science popularization presentation device of air focus excitation experiment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a science popularization demonstration device for an air source excitation experiment, which relates to the field of demonstration devices and comprises a box body, wherein an experiment groove is formed in the box body, an underground medium simulation filler is arranged on one side of the experiment groove, a support is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the box body, and the device has the advantages that the air source excitation experiment can be successfully simulated through components such as an integrated gas storage bottle, a pressure release valve, a connecting buckle, a guy rope, a guide wheel, a limiting seat, a vibration sensor and the like, the seismic technological innovation result is displayed in an intuitive and specific mode, the understanding of the audience on the shockproof disaster reduction technological result is deepened, in addition, the device is low in construction cost, easy to acquire, process and install, and the gas storage bottle can be rapidly inflated through components such as an inflation pump, an air inlet pipe, a quick plug and a four-way joint, so that the time for carrying out the experiment again can be shortened, and the continuity and efficiency of the experiment are ensured.

title_en: Fire source accurate positioning method and device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire tracing positioning, in particular to a fire source accurate positioning method and device based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sensor data set and a fire source information data set of a fire disaster area, generating feature vectors according to the sensor data set to obtain feature matrixes, acquiring fire source information corresponding to each feature matrix in the fire source information data set based on the distribution condition of the sensor data to generate a training set, a verification set and a test set, acquiring fire source information of a predicted fire disaster area by utilizing a preset deep learning strategy based on the training set, the verification set and the test set, and acquiring fire source positioning information according to the predicted fire source information. Therefore, the problems that in the related art, under the conditions that light is insufficient, other heat sources or flames are blocked and the like, misinformation or missing information is easy to occur to the sensor, and the fire source positioning accuracy is unstable are solved, so that the fire source position is difficult to accurately position, the fire-extinguishing rescue efficiency is seriously influenced, and the optimal rescue opportunity is delayed.

title_en: Optimization method for climate mode simulation composite extreme weather event frequency based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of climate event simulation, in particular to an optimization method for simulating composite extreme weather event frequency based on a deep learning climate mode, which comprises the following steps of obtaining observed data of precipitation and wind speed of a target area and simulation data of a plurality of climate modes; the method comprises the steps of calculating a precipitation and wind speed threshold value by a percentile threshold value method, determining the occurrence frequency of a composite extreme weather event, utilizing observation data to evaluate a weather pattern simulation result, selecting the frequency as a characteristic value of a deep learning model, taking the observation frequency as a true value, constructing a multi-layer perceptron neural network, optimizing model training by a weighted loss function combined with a mean square error, a standard deviation ratio and a minimum constraint, inputting the simulation result of the weather pattern into a trained model, generating a correction result of the composite extreme weather event frequency, improving the simulation precision of the composite extreme weather event frequency, effectively reducing deviation, and providing support for disaster prediction and decision under a weather change background.

title_en: Fire emergency drilling method based on computer technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency exercise method based on a computer technology, which relates to the technical field of intelligent rescue, and is characterized in that the fire emergency exercise flow is standardized and systemized, tasks, decision nodes and time requirements of each link are defined, human misoperation is avoided, exercise coordination is improved, task execution is smoother, meanwhile, an automatic monitoring system is adopted, physical state of firefighters, use conditions of fire extinguishing equipment and dynamic development of fire disaster are collected in real time, GPS positioning equipment, biological monitoring equipment and fire disaster sensors continuously track physical conditions and fire disaster changes of participants, reaction speed and accuracy of exercise are greatly improved, feedback stagnation is reduced, dynamic adjustment is carried out through integration of the automatic monitoring system and a BPMN model, when the fire disaster is remarkably changed, the fire disaster is immediately fed back to the decision nodes in the BPMN model, emergency strategies are automatically adjusted, adaptability of the situation exercise to sudden complex situations is enhanced, and the dynamic requirements in real fire disaster are more closely met.

title_en: Wireless charging safety monitoring management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless charging safety monitoring management method, which is characterized in that a thermistor, a digital humidity sensor and a Hall effect sensor are deployed, temperature, humidity, current and voltage indexes of wireless charging equipment are monitored in real time, collected data are preprocessed, including data cleaning, format standardization, abnormal value detection and processing, multisource information is integrated by utilizing a data fusion technology, characteristics are extracted, correlation among the data is analyzed, an early warning model based on historical data training is established, multi-stage early warning is triggered according to different conditions, early warning signals are timely transmitted to related personnel through various communication means, once the early warning is triggered, measures are automatically taken according to a preset emergency response scheme, including starting a cooling system, reducing output power and even cutting off a power supply, equipment safety is guaranteed, and in addition, safety inspection performed in each quarter is beneficial to continuously improving an early warning mechanism, and the data safety of a monitoring system is guaranteed through an encryption technology, access control and a data backup mode.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability assessment method and system based on multi-source data and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide susceptibility assessment method and system based on multi-source data and deep learning, and combines an SBAS-InSAR technology, remote sensing image analysis, a deep learning algorithm, a TRIGRS-SCOOPS3D coupling model and a MASSFLOW simulation landslide susceptibility assessment method. The method is used for identifying the landslide easy-occurrence area with high precision, predicting the potential landslide position and simulating the three-dimensional landslide process, and is particularly suitable for landslide disaster risk management and emergency response of mountain areas.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering digital management method based on BIM model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a hydraulic engineering digital management method based on a BIM model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time monitoring data, carrying out high-precision topographic data acquisition on a hydraulic engineering project area, carrying out data preprocessing to obtain preprocessed data, carrying out hydrologic information integration modeling by utilizing a BIM platform according to the preprocessed data to obtain a hydrologic information integration model, carrying out multidimensional topographic dynamic updating on the hydrologic information integration model by utilizing the real-time monitoring data to obtain digital topographic data, carrying out flood simulation calculation on the basis of the digital topographic data to obtain a flood simulation calculation result, and carrying out flood scenario simulation according to the flood simulation calculation result to obtain flood simulation data. The invention provides a more effective technical means for flood control and disaster reduction and hydraulic engineering safety management through real-time monitoring, accurate prediction and timely early warning of hydraulic engineering risks.
assignees: Jiangyin huangtang water conservancy project co ltd

title_en: Water accumulation early warning method and system based on urban waterlogging simulation positioning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to a water accumulation early warning method and system based on urban waterlogging simulation positioning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a regional pipe network parameter set, analyzing the regional pipe network parameter set to construct a drainage pipe network model, obtaining a topography parameter set and a key facility parameter set, analyzing the topography parameter set and the key facility parameter set to construct a regional basis model, obtaining a meteorological parameter set, simulating a ponding development situation according to the regional basis model based on the meteorological parameter set and the drainage pipe network model, determining a multi-dimensional risk information set based on the regional basis model, determining a target pushing user and corresponding early warning pushing information according to the multi-dimensional risk information set based on the regional basis model, and pushing the early warning pushing information to the target pushing user. The method can accurately reflect the real-time comprehensive influence of the ponding under the multidimensional complex factors in the city, and effectively improve the accuracy, instantaneity and pertinence of the ponding early warning process.

title_en: Global travel industry monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The system comprises a data monitoring unit, a resource allocation unit and a background monitoring unit, wherein the resource allocation unit comprises a resource evaluation module, a people flow identification module, an emergency response module, a resource scheduling module and an analog simulation module, the resource scheduling module is connected with the analog simulation module in a one-way manner, key resources such as vehicles, accommodation facilities and catering services in scenic spots are comprehensively and carefully evaluated through the resource evaluation module, the utilization efficiency of various resources and the matching degree of tourist demands are deeply analyzed, the system can monitor and predict the change of the people flow in the scenic spots in real time, so that various resources are intelligently scheduled, and the intelligent resource scheduling mode not only improves the utilization efficiency of the resources, reduces the operation cost, but also greatly improves the tourist experience and satisfaction.
assignees: LIANYUNGANG SUNXINGZHE TOURISM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hidden disaster factor disaster risk evaluation method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hidden disaster factor disaster risk evaluation method based on multi-source data fusion, which relates to the technical field of geographic information systems and comprises the following steps of S01, data acquisition, S02, data preprocessing, S03, feature extraction, S04, risk evaluation model construction, S05, model training and optimization, S06, risk evaluation, S07, result analysis and verification, S08 and result output, wherein the scheme effectively integrates various data sources such as geological data, remote sensing images, elevation diagrams, hydrological data and the like by adopting an advanced multi-source data fusion technology; the integration not only widens the coverage range of the data, but also improves the precision and timeliness of the data, ensures that the data with different sources and types can be effectively fused through an automatic data preprocessing flow, and constructs a data consistency relation, and the data integration strategy can reflect the complexity and dynamic change of the hidden disaster causing factors more comprehensively, thereby obviously improving the accuracy of disaster causing risk assessment.

title_en: Firefighter training apparatus
abstract_en: A firefighter training apparatus is disclosed. The apparatus has an internal space, and the internal space has a ceiling, closed (enclosed) sides, a closed (enclosed) end, and an opening located generally opposite the closed end. The apparatus is operable for use in enabling one or more firefighters to practice and/or learn about confronting a fire (including in particular an indoor fire) with (or at least including) overhead flames. The apparatus also comprises one or more fuel inlets through which combustible fluid fuel can enter the internal space. At least one of the fuel inlets is located such that, when fuel flows to said at least one fuel inlet, fuel enters the internal space through said at least one fuel inlet at or near the closed end of the internal space near the ceiling. The apparatus also has a heat source, which is operable to elevate the ambient temperature, at least in the region of the internal space where fuel enters through the said at least one fuel inlet, to a temperature above the fuel's autoignition temperature, and the apparatus further includes means for enabling an operator to (at least) cause fuel to cease flowing to one or more or all of the fuel inlets.

title_en: Directional drilling slip casting device in ground
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ground directional drilling grouting device, which belongs to the technical field of coal mine water disaster ground prevention and treatment, and comprises a technical sleeve opening connecting device, wherein the technical sleeve opening connecting device is connected with a technical sleeve ground opening through a technical sleeve connecting male buckle, a water inlet pipe is arranged on the side edge of the technical sleeve opening connecting device, a grouting channel connecting device is inserted and installed in the technical sleeve opening connecting device, the technical sleeve opening connecting device and the grouting channel connecting device form an orifice sealing through a sealing flange and a fixing bolt, the grouting channel connecting device is connected with a grouting drill rod through a grouting drill rod connecting male buckle, and grouting pipes are arranged on two sides of the grouting channel connecting device. The grouting device ensures that cement slurry does not flow through the technical sleeve, can avoid the retention of the cement slurry in the technical sleeve, reduces the waste of the cement slurry and the ineffective grouting cost, and reduces the construction auxiliary time and improves the construction efficiency because no cement deposit exists in the technical sleeve and no hole sweeping and cleaning are needed.
assignees: THE THIRD EXPLOR TEAM OF ANHUI PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Simulation device for science popularization of natural disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simulation device for natural disaster science popularization, which relates to the technical field of natural disaster science popularization, and comprises a base, wherein the top end of the base is provided with a vibration mechanism, the top end of the vibration mechanism is fixedly connected with a first connecting plate, one side of the top end of the first connecting plate is provided with a swinging mechanism, one end of the swinging mechanism and the top end of the first connecting plate are jointly provided with a base, the vibration mechanism comprises a first support, the top end of the first support is fixedly connected with a first motor, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first bevel gear, and the outer surface of the first bevel gear is meshed with a second bevel gear.

title_en: Real fire simulation combustion pond and real fire simulation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of firefighter training appliances, in particular to a real fire simulation combustion pond and a real fire simulation system. The real fire simulation combustion pool comprises a combustion pool, an igniter, an air supply pipe, a drain pipe and a water inlet, wherein an inner cavity is arranged in which the top is not closed, a fuel pipe and an object placing grid are arranged in the inner cavity, a plurality of nozzles are arranged on the fuel pipe, a feeding end of the fuel pipe extends to the outside of the combustion pool, the object placing grid is arranged above the fuel pipe, the igniter is arranged on the combustion pool, an ignition end of the igniter extends to the inner cavity, the air supply pipe is arranged on the combustion pool, an air outlet of the air supply pipe extends towards the inner cavity, the drain pipe is arranged at the bottom of the inner cavity, the water inlet extends upwards, a space is reserved between the water inlet and the bottom of the inner cavity, and the water inlet is not higher than an injection port of the nozzles. On the other hand, the utility model also provides a real fire simulation system.

title_en: Multi-scale direction sensing SAR target detection method based on global information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale direction sensing SAR target detection method based on global information fusion, which mainly solves the problems of low detection precision and efficiency caused by insufficient global information and insufficient direction sensing characteristic extraction in the existing SAR target detection method. The implementation scheme includes the steps of obtaining a training sample set and a testing sample set of SAR images, constructing a multi-scale direction sensing SAR target detection network comprising two feature extractors and detection heads, training a target detection network model through back propagation iteration by using the training sample set, and inputting the testing sample set into the trained network model to obtain a target detection result. The first feature extractor designed by the invention utilizes a bidirectional attention mechanism to extract the direction and position information of an object, so that the object has stronger robustness under different target postures and angles, and the second feature extractor designed by the invention realizes the organic fusion of global and local features, ensures the improvement of target detection efficiency and can be applied to environment monitoring and disaster assessment.

title_en: Combined loading test device for differential settlement of geological disasters of transmission tower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined loading test device for differential settlement of geological disasters of a transmission tower, and relates to the technical field of power engineering. The differential settlement displacement simulation unit comprises a base, a rotating bottom plate and a rotating assembly arranged between the base and the rotating bottom plate. The device has an accurate displacement control function, the transmission tower structure and the basic mechanical response of the transmission tower structure under the condition of subsidence of different goafs are efficiently tested, the device adopts a simplified method, the transmission tower system is divided into two parts of a lower tower leg and an equivalent load support, the stress state in the subsidence process is truly reflected, the model manufacturing complexity is reduced, the test reliability and the operation convenience are improved, the device is provided with various sensors, the data in the subsidence process are monitored in real time, and the support is provided for comprehensively evaluating the influence of the surface subsidence on the safety of the transmission tower system.

title_en: Intelligent ventilation system and method for cage for livestock breeding
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent ventilation system and method for a cage for livestock breeding, which belong to the technical field of livestock breeding and comprise an acquisition processing module, an environment modeling module, a change prediction module, an optimization decision module, a strategy simulation module, a storage safety module, an equipment control module, a monitoring feedback module, a user interaction module and an emergency response module; the invention can more actively manage environmental conditions, avoid environmental parameters from deviating from ideal states caused by hysteresis effect, reduce stress influence on animals, meet specific requirements of different livestock animals, promote air quality and animal health level in the livestock houses, promote decision accuracy of the system, ensure that the cage environment is always kept in an optimal state, and is beneficial to balancing improvement of air quality in a short period and minimization of long-term energy consumption and effectively optimizing the overall efficiency of the system.
assignees: ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL PLANNING AND ENG MARA

title_en: UPerNet network-based multi-pixel collaborative landslide vulnerability evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a UPerNet network-based multi-pixel collaborative landslide susceptibility evaluation method, which comprises the steps of firstly extracting landslide characteristic factors related to landslide according to remote sensing image data, regional investigation data and landslide sensitivity influence factors, constructing a landslide disaster database by combining historical landslide data with non-landslide data, dividing the landslide disaster database into a training set and a testing set, carrying out normalization processing on the data and carrying out online data enhancement processing, constructing a UPerNet model, taking all evaluation samples as single-band images, inputting the single-band images into the constructed model, calculating the occurrence probability of the landslide in each pixel, training the model and carrying out parameter optimization, and finally utilizing the testing set landslide characteristic factor verification model to carry out landslide susceptibility prediction based on the constructed model. Thus, the latest machine learning and statistical model is utilized, and the model can be used for more accurately predicting the susceptibility of regional landslide in combination with adjacent pixel collaborative analysis.

title_en: Linkage early warning method based on security situation assessment and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a linkage early warning method based on security situation assessment and application thereof, which comprises the following steps of data preprocessing and feature extraction, constructing an abnormal assessment model and a normal assessment model, training and parameter adjustment, utilizing a security assessment function to assess data acquired in real time, judging the current security state of a hydropower plant, outputting a security parameter, constructing a decision function, determining whether the current state is abnormal or not based on the security parameter and environmental factors EnvFactors, dynamically selecting and determining to select the abnormal assessment model and the normal assessment model for real-time assessment, judging whether the current state needs early warning or not, and linking an emergency command system and early warning information to perform early warning and emergency response when early warning is needed, and prompting the security risk possibly faced by the hydropower plant. The invention solves the problems that the existing system lacks enough flexibility and adaptability and cannot effectively cope with changeable network security threats by constructing the security assessment function and the decision function and combining the neural network model.

title_en: Power transmission line risk assessment method and system under debris flow disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line risk assessment method and a power transmission line risk assessment system under a debris flow disaster, and relates to the field of debris flow risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a continuous equation and a motion equation based on a continuous medium model of depth integration; importing topographic data into the system, meshing to construct a numerical model, selecting a starting mode, setting model parameters, performing numerical simulation on the debris flow motion process, and performing quantitative evaluation on the debris flow risk according to simulation results. According to the method, through dynamic simulation, the movement rule and the influence range of the debris flow can be simulated more accurately, so that the accuracy of evaluating the risk of the debris flow is improved. Compared with qualitative and semi-quantitative methods relying on expert experience, the method provided by the invention is based on objective physical model and data analysis, so that subjectivity in the evaluation process is reduced.

title_en: Building Internet of things equipment distribution management method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an Internet of things equipment control management method, in particular to a building Internet of things equipment control management method. The method comprises the steps of deploying various sensors comprising an infrared sensor, a camera and an air quality sensor in a building, collecting personnel flowing and environment change data in real time, converting the data into scenes comprising office peaks, night modes and emergency evacuation of the building through data analysis and scene classification, training a scene recognition model through a random forest classifier, predicting scene changes in a short period in the future through a time sequence prediction model, generating corresponding equipment control instructions, utilizing the sensor data, establishing an association matrix of using frequency, spatial position and functional interaction among equipment, recognizing an equipment cooperation mode, dynamically generating an equipment deployment scheme through a graph theory algorithm based on the association matrix, issuing the generated deployment scheme to each equipment control node, and performing fine adjustment according to real-time data feedback.
assignees: SHANGHAI BAOJIA PURIFICATION ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mud-rock flow disaster early warning method and emergency response system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow disaster early warning method and an emergency response system based on big data analysis, which belong to the technical field of geological monitoring, and specifically comprise the steps of collecting and preprocessing watershed topography, weather, geology, vegetation coverage and historical debris flow event record data, and acquiring image data by combining a remote sensing technology; the method comprises the steps of extracting and integrating the data and image characteristics to form a debris flow characteristic data set, constructing a debris flow early warning model by utilizing a limited volume model, a deep learning algorithm and an Internet of things detection technology and combining an integrated learning method, training and verifying through historical data, issuing early warning information and starting a dynamic response mechanism when the model predicts risks, and finally, feeding back and optimizing and adjusting the early warning model according to response effects.

title_en: Electric power weather disaster risk early warning method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric power meteorological disaster risk early warning method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of cleaning and preprocessing basic meteorological data including temperature, humidity, wind speed and precipitation to obtain a cleaned basic meteorological data set, modeling meteorological changes through a neural network model based on satellite cloud images or radar image data to obtain assimilation characteristics, splicing the basic meteorological data and the assimilation characteristics to form a combined characteristic vector, constructing a comprehensive disaster risk assessment model based on meteorological factors, power grid factors and geographic information, training and optimizing the comprehensive disaster risk assessment model in a multi-objective mode, and carrying out real-time electric power weather disaster risk early warning by using the optimized comprehensive disaster risk assessment model. The system and the method can monitor meteorological data, the state of power grid equipment and geographic information in real time, accurately early warn meteorological disasters possibly suffered by the power equipment, and improve the safety and stability of a power system.
assignees: NANCHANG KECHEN ELECTRIC POWER TEST RES CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: While-drilling advanced intelligent early warning method based on multi-source disaster information entropy fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source disaster information entropy fusion-based drilling advance intelligent early warning method, which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source data of different depths in a drilling process by adopting a multi-source sensing module, dividing depth segments, carrying out normalization and dimensionless treatment on the multi-source data of each depth segment, increasing the data difference of each depth segment, carrying out primary optimization for subsequent data processing, carrying out information entropy fusion data processing on the processed data, further amplifying the difference of the same type of data in a mode to optimize the data fusion effect, inputting the processed data into a KAN network, establishing an early warning model, finally utilizing the early warning model to input the data acquired in real time into the model, namely, predicting the information entropy fusion data of one depth segment before detection, comparing the data with a threshold value, and finally judging the risk of flood, fire or collapse of one depth segment before tunneling, and timely taking corresponding measures according to the risk condition, thereby ensuring the safety of a roadway.

title_en: Reinforced full-size residential structure gas leakage explosion multiparameter test platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical development field of gas explosion test, and relates to a reinforced full-size residential building structure gas leakage explosion multi-parameter test platform and method, which can be used for simulating the whole process of gas leakage explosion accidents in real residential scenes and realizing research on gas leakage explosion evolution mechanism and disaster results under multiple ignition sources, multiple gas types, multiple pressure relief conditions and multiple obstacle environments. The test platform can simulate resident house types, and realizes repeated test of high detonation pressure, high simulation and multi-parameter gas explosion through local reinforcement design and coupling test technology development of the test platform.

title_en: Landslide susceptibility evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide susceptibility evaluation method which comprises the following steps of deriving original values of all evaluation factors, training a random forest model, replacing a basic learner of an Adaboost model with the trained random forest model to obtain an optimized Adaboost model, training the optimized Adaboost model to obtain a trained landslide susceptibility evaluation model, carrying out grid division on a landslide disaster research area, inputting the original values of all the evaluation factors corresponding to grid points into the trained landslide susceptibility evaluation model, and obtaining landslide occurrence probability at the corresponding grid points through the trained landslide susceptibility evaluation model to finish landslide susceptibility evaluation on the landslide disaster research area. The landslide disaster investigation method and the landslide disaster investigation device can accurately and rapidly evaluate the landslide vulnerability of the landslide disaster investigation area, give specific evaluation results, and conveniently and rapidly find and cope with the landslide disaster.

title_en: Bad geological type identification method and system based on joint deep learning network
abstract_en: The invention provides a poor geological type judgment method and system based on a combined deep learning network, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining training information, namely geological data of an excavated paragraph, geophysical prospecting inversion imaging information and drilling information, inputting the training information into a pre-established joint deep learning network model, sequentially carrying out data preprocessing, feature extraction and feature fusion to obtain joint feature representation, and obtaining discrimination type and morphological depiction of a bad geological body based on the joint feature representation, wherein the joint deep learning network model comprises a DNN model, a CNN model and an RNN model, and extracting the features of digital data, image data and text description data in the training information by utilizing the DNN model, the CNN model and the RNN model. The method can rapidly and accurately judge the types and delineate the forms of the bad geologic bodies in front of the tunnel, and lighten the manual forecasting pressure.

title_en: Flood disaster inundation prediction and grading early warning method considering flood peak process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster early warning, in particular to a flood disaster inundation prediction and grading early warning method considering a flood peak process, which comprises the following steps of constructing space data of an easily inundated area in the flood disaster; the method comprises the steps of predicting future rainfall data, carrying out rainfall runoff simulation on each simulation calculation unit, analyzing river channel converging runoff in each simulation calculation unit, generating river channel boundary conditions and city boundary conditions, constructing a flood evolution model, respectively predicting the propagation process of flood in river channel areas and city areas in each simulation calculation unit through river channel shallow water equations and city shallow water equations based on the river channel boundary conditions and city boundary conditions, and according to the prediction result of the flood evolution model, evaluating the risk level of submerged disasters and generating corresponding emergency plans. By adopting the scheme, the flood disaster prediction can be realized, the spreading process of flood in the city can be accurately depicted, and the risk level of the flood disaster can be accurately estimated.
assignees: CCCC YANGTZE RIVER CONSTRUCTION DEV GROUP CO LTD;CHONGQING YUFA WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Cloud platform dial testing method, device, dial testing system, computer readable storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a cloud platform dial testing method, a cloud platform dial testing device, a dial testing system, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the steps of determining a target distribution center corresponding to a dial-up test request and a disaster-backup data center of the target distribution center, sending a simulation test request to a cloud platform to be dialed up based on the dial-up test request through the target distribution center, storing a returned request result to a main database of the target distribution center, sending the simulation test request to the cloud platform to be dialed up based on the dial-up test request through the disaster-backup data center when the target distribution center is detected to have a fault, storing the request result to a backup database of the disaster-backup data center, synchronizing the request result stored in the backup database of the disaster-backup data center to the main database of the target distribution center when the target distribution center is detected to have a fault recovery, and distributing a subsequent dial-up test request to the target distribution center for processing. By adopting the method, the dial testing accuracy of the cloud platform can be improved.

title_en: Vision search and multi-mode large model integrated fire early warning method for photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The application discloses a photovoltaic power station fire disaster early warning method integrating visual search and a multi-mode large model, which relates to the field of fire disaster early warning, the method utilizes a smoke target recognition model built based on the multi-mode large model to carry out preliminary recognition and positioning on an image frame to be monitored to obtain a smoke target positioning frame, confidence coefficient and a smoke target search prompt heat map, when the confidence coefficient of the smoke target positioning frame does not reach a confidence coefficient threshold value, the visual search strategy is further utilized to carry out active search based on the smoke target search prompt heat map, by introducing an active search mechanism, a visual working memory and a dynamic adjustment strategy, the world knowledge and the context understanding capability of a smoke target recognition model can be fully utilized by simulating a human recognition mechanism of the smoke target, so that the method can directly infer in an environment without training, has higher recognition and positioning accuracy rate on the smoke target, effectively realizes early fire early warning of a photovoltaic power station, and reduces realization difficulty.

title_en: Ground disaster dynamic monitoring method based on 3D, GIS and finite element simulation seamless coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster information acquisition, and discloses a ground disaster dynamic monitoring method based on 3D, GIS and finite element simulation seamless coupling, which comprises the steps of acquiring initial state data of different monitoring points by deformation and strain, and inputting the initial state data into a 3D model based on GIS standard; the method comprises the steps of taking mathematical functions as guiding design mathematical models, judging the change states of the mathematical functions in a space domain and a time domain to obtain various data of each monitoring point location, comparing and analyzing whether the various data of all the monitoring point locations have coupling characteristics in the space domain and the time domain, establishing information standardized geological information with coupling relations by the coupling characteristics, establishing refined finite element 3D grids according to initial conditions and boundary conditions set for the information standardized geological information in a visual three-dimensional geological model, and forming three-dimensional visual interaction dynamic monitoring of coupling physical field information. The invention establishes the dynamic reminding information based on physics, so as to conveniently carry out slope reinforcement and disaster forecast or early warning reminding.
assignees: SHENMA TECH GUIZHOU CO LTD;GUIZHOU SHENMA SURVEY DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Prediction method and related device for accumulated ground temperature of different depths
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method and a related device for different-depth accumulated ground temperature, which are characterized in that a dry-wet index sequence is calculated by adopting the historical air temperature and precipitation of a target area, and the ground temperature sequences of different depths in a dry-wet period are obtained according to the dry-wet index sequence, so that different-depth accumulated ground temperature simulation models are further constructed, the constructed models are adopted to realize the prediction of different-depth accumulated ground temperature, effective parameters can be provided for soil moisture management and ecological environment regulation, and the prediction method and the device have important significance for agriculture and ecological protection, disaster prevention, disaster reduction and the like of the target area.
assignees: UNIV NANJING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH;NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST;ANHUI & HUAIHE RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES ANHUI WATER CONSERVANCY PROJECT QUALITY INSPECTION C

title_en: Personnel behavior and decision simulation analysis system under tunnel disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a personnel behavior and decision simulation analysis system under tunnel disasters, which is characterized in that the system comprises a drilling simulation and data acquisition end data transmission module, a VR module, an interaction acquisition module, a physiological acquisition module and a data processing end data transmission module, wherein the drilling simulation and data acquisition end data transmission module is used for displaying a simulation scene for drilling personnel, the interaction acquisition module is used for acquiring interaction data of the drilling personnel, the physiological acquisition module is used for acquiring the physiological data of the drilling personnel, the data processing end data transmission module is used for receiving the physiological data and the interaction data and sending the tunnel disasters simulation data to the drilling simulation and data acquisition end, the simulation evolution module is used for generating dynamically-changed tunnel disasters simulation data according to the interaction data and the tunnel disasters simulation data, and the evaluation module is used for analyzing and obtaining evaluation results of the drilling personnel according to the physiological data, the interaction data and the tunnel disasters simulation data. In a word, the method can obtain an accurate simulated escape evaluation result of the drilling personnel, and improve the escape success rate of the drilling personnel.

title_en: Personnel evacuation simulation method and system for flood disaster spread situation of underground scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for simulating personnel evacuation under flood spreading of an underground scene, which are used for constructing an underground scene model, simulating a flood spreading process of the underground scene model, obtaining flood dynamic information at each position point in the underground scene model, wherein the flood dynamic information comprises flood depth, flow velocity and flow direction, meshing a space in the underground scene model, determining an initial pedestrian position, constructing a static field, a water depth field, a support object field and a flow velocity field based on cellular automaton, further calculating the transfer probability of pedestrians, judging the human body stability of the pedestrians based on the flood dynamic information, calculating the moving speed of the pedestrians, updating the positions of the pedestrians based on the transfer probability and the moving speed of the pedestrians, and carrying out fine simulation on the evacuation of the pedestrians in the underground scene in the flood spreading process. The invention considers the stability and the movement speed of the pedestrian in the flood, and is beneficial to researching how to evacuate people timely, efficiently and safely under the flood situation.

title_en: Method and system for simulating whole landslide disaster chain process of soil-stone mixture
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-process simulation method and system for a landslide disaster chain of a soil-stone mixture, comprising the steps of 1, constructing a solid model and dispersing the solid model into equidistant particle models, respectively endowing basic parameter values and setting particle types to each particle, 2, constructing a general constitutive model for simultaneously representing the landslide soil body and rock of the soil-stone mixture, 3, respectively taking landslide soil particles of the soil-stone mixture, downstream building particles and topographic static boundary particles as central particles, carrying out particle contact judgment, simulating the deformation behavior of the central particles based on the constructed general constitutive model for simultaneously representing the landslide soil body and rock of the soil-stone mixture, 4, setting starting judgment standards for along the way soil body and building erosion, and 5, carrying out visual output on the characteristic information of each central particle. The invention can more reasonably evaluate the landslide impact disaster effect of the soil-stone mixture.

title_en: Depth learning driven small sample data multidimensional expansion fire truck travel time prediction method
abstract_en: The application provides a depth learning driven small sample data multidimensional expansion fire truck journey time prediction method, which relates to the technical field of emergency management, wherein the method comprises the steps of combining fire station information and historical rescue journey time information to construct a fire rescue journey time data set; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a fire fighting rescue travel time data set by using similar historical data among fire fighting stations and social vehicle travel time information, expanding the fire fighting rescue travel time data set to obtain a training sample set, constructing a fire fighting truck travel time prediction model based on multi-graph convolution, training the model according to the training sample, and predicting the fire fighting truck travel time according to the training completion fire fighting truck travel time prediction model. By combining fire station and history rescue information and utilizing fire truck history data and social vehicle data to expand a training set, accurate prediction of fire truck travel time is achieved, errors caused by insufficient data are avoided, and prediction accuracy and emergency response efficiency are improved.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;BEIJING TECH RESEARCH BRANCH OF TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for planning disaster evacuation route of vulnerable group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for planning a disaster evacuation route of a weak crowd, wherein the route planning method comprises the steps of obtaining behavior characteristics and movement tracks of the weak crowd in a complex dynamic evacuation scene, constructing a behavior influence factor knowledge graph based on the behavior characteristics and the movement tracks, predicting behaviors of the weak crowd based on the knowledge graph to obtain a prediction result, and combining the prediction result with a macroscopic evacuation strategy to construct an optimal evacuation route. The invention integrates the functions of behavior analysis, route planning, simulation evaluation and the like, provides decision support for rescue workers through man-machine interaction and visualization technology, and effectively improves the safety and efficiency of disaster evacuation of the vulnerable group.

title_en: Construction method suitable for comprehensive prevention and control of coal and rock dynamic disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method suitable for comprehensive prevention and control of coal and rock dynamic disasters, and relates to the technical field of coal mining. The 11N construction method suitable for comprehensive prevention and control of coal and rock dynamic disasters comprises the following steps of S1, determining the position of a coal and rock stratum to be pre-cracked, S2, determining the position of a drilling site, S3, determining the drilling position and a plurality of pre-cracking paths corresponding to the drilling in the coal and rock stratum to be pre-cracked, S4, carrying out a directional long drilling construction process, carrying out horizontal long drilling in the coal and rock stratum to be pre-cracked, S5, carrying out horizontal long drilling directional cutting operation, S6, carrying out retreating type segmented pre-cracking, and S7, repeating the steps S4 to S6, and completing the pre-cracking operation of the plurality of pre-cracking paths in the coal and rock stratum to be pre-cracked. The 11N construction method suitable for comprehensive prevention and control of coal rock dynamic disasters can realize comprehensive treatment of coal rock strata, develop a large-scale pre-cracking operation, ensure the pressure relief and permeability improvement effects of pre-cracking cracks and ensure the safe production of coal mine operation.

title_en: Barrier lake dam break analysis system and method based on barrier erosion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a barrier lake dam break analysis system and a barrier lake dam break analysis method based on corrosion inhibition, which relate to the technical field of water conservancy and geological engineering disaster prediction and comprise a user interface module, wherein the user interface module allows a user to input parameters, starts each functional module and visualizes results; the dam breaking system comprises a data processing module, a data management module and a data processing module, wherein the data processing module is responsible for simulating a dam breaking process considering the erosion blocking effect, the data management module is responsible for checking, storing and exporting data, and in the data processing module, related parameters are called, the lake water level change is updated according to a time step, corresponding breaking parameters are calculated through an established model, meanwhile, the stability of a broken slope is verified, and a critical elevation and a critical slope foot are judged. Therefore, by adopting the dam break analysis system and method based on barrier lake erosion, the accuracy of water level, break flow, dam body and break geometric change data can be improved, and meanwhile, smooth parameter interaction and data visualization are realized through modular design, so that the dam break analysis system and method based on barrier lake dam break has good disaster early warning application prospect.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for classifying flood prevention case text of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for classifying flood prevention case texts of a transformer substation, which belong to the field of natural language processing text classification, and are used for performing multi-label classification on the flood prevention case texts of the transformer substation to be predicted based on an improved BERT model with complete training to obtain a disaster causing cause label of the flood prevention case texts, wherein the improved BERT model comprises an embedded layer, an encoder layer, a TextCNN layer and a Seq2Seq layer, the method for classifying the flood prevention case texts of the transformer substation comprises the steps of extracting text vectors of the flood prevention case texts of the transformer substation to be predicted based on the embedded layer, compressing the text vectors by adopting a light strategy, extracting global semantic features of the compressed text vectors based on the encoder layer, extracting features of the global semantic features based on the TextCNN layer to obtain feature vectors, encoding and decoding the feature vectors based on the Seq2Seq layer to obtain the disaster causing label of the flood prevention case texts, so that overall classification performance is enhanced, and accuracy of single cause labels is improved.

title_en: Analysis method and equipment for slope instability mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for analyzing a slope instability mechanism, which comprises the steps of researching a slope to be researched, determining the geological environment characteristics of the slope and the damage type of the slope disaster, researching the physical mechanical properties of a slope soil body, establishing a slope calculation model, simulating the influence of different slope heights and slope ratios on the slope stability in an initial state by combining the slope calculation model with the physical mechanical property data of the slope soil body through finite element numerical calculation, analyzing external influence factors causing the slope instability, and simulating and analyzing the stability and the instability mechanism of the slope under different external influence factors by combining the slope calculation model with the physical mechanical property data of the slope soil body through finite element numerical calculation. The invention fully considers the internal logic connection and the synergistic effect of the internal factors and the external factors, determines the internal rule of the instability and damage of the rock mass of the side slope, makes accurate prediction and evaluation for the instability analysis of the side slope, and provides basis for the subsequent establishment of a corresponding side slope safety prediction method.
assignees: PINGLU CANAL GROUP CO LTD;GUANGXI JIAOTOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine roof water inflow monitoring method based on well-ground combined resistivity method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal mine roof water inflow monitoring method based on a well-ground combined resistivity method, which comprises the steps of designing a ground and underground resistivity method monitoring scheme, acquiring ground and underground resistivity monitoring data of a coal seam roof rock stratum in a working face stoping process according to the resistivity method monitoring scheme, analyzing the monitoring data through forward numerical simulation and inversion imaging to acquire a resistivity profile cloud picture, extracting resistivity change characteristics in the resistivity profile cloud picture to determine distribution characteristics of a water guide channel, dynamically monitoring a groundwater migration process under the influence of mining, comprehensively comparing and analyzing the resistivity change characteristics and the working face water inflow change characteristics, establishing a correlation between the water inflow and the resistivity change characteristics, and predicting the change of the stoping face water inflow in the next stage. The invention realizes dynamic monitoring of the damage of the roof overlying strata of the working face and the migration rule of underground water in the stoping process and predictive and early warning of water inrush disasters.
assignees: SHAANXI SHANMEI CAOJIATAN MINING CO LTD;XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: A simulation system of crowd density and fire prediction by grid based space modelling
title_ko: 그리드 기반 공간모델링을 통한 군중밀집 및 화재예측 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a crowd density and fire prediction simulation system through grid-based spatial modeling that may provide rapid evacuation and accident response measures in the event of an accident. The present invention comprises: a server (1) providing a virtual scenario; an information acquisition means (2) including an image acquisition means such as a camera for acquiring image information installed in a place such as an area or a facility for management, a thermal image information acquisition means such as a thermal image camera, and/or a sensing information acquisition means for acquiring sensing information acquired from a sensor; and an information transmission medium (3) disposed in a place such as an area or a facility for management and capable of transmitting image or voice guidance to a visitor or a user. According to the present invention, when an accident occurs, rapid evacuation and a response situation to the accident can be realized and provided, thereby minimizing casualties.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 그리드 기반 공간모델링을 통한 군중밀집 및 화재예측 시스템에 대한 것으로, 공간 밀집도에 따라 인명사고가 발생할 수 있는 군중밀집현상에 대한 분석 예측 및 공간 내부에서 발생될 수 있는 화재발생을 예측하고 이를 관리하며, 공간내부에서 발생되는 소요사태 즉, 위험인물의 감지, 사고 등의 위험요소 등을 감지하고 이를 통하여 위험인자를 파악하고 이를 예측 관리하는 시스템에 대한 것이다. 
이를 위해, 관리를 위한 지역 또는 시설과 같은 장소의 영상정보를 2D 및 3D로 변환하여 가상현실화 하고, 그리드를 기반으로 하여 군중밀집에 의한 사고발생, 화재와 같은 원인에 의한 사고 발생을 예측하고 시뮬레이션화며 사고의 발생 및 방문객과 같은 이용자 또는 사용자의 이동동선, 대피동선, 방문객 또는 이용자의 분산이용 가이드를 포함하는 가상의 시나리오를 제공하는 서버(1);와 관리를 위한 지역 또는 시설과 같은 장소에 설치되어 있는 영상정보를 획득하기 위한 카메라와 같은 정보획득 수단(2); 및 관리를 위한 지역 또는 시설과 같은 장소에 배치되어 영상 또는 음성 안내를 방문객 또는 이용자에게 전달할 수 있는 정보전달매체(3)로 구성되는 기술을 제공한다. 
또한, 상기 서버(1)는 데이터의 입출력을 관리하는 입출력관리모듈(11), 정보획득 수단(2)으로부터 입출력관리모듈(11)을 통하여 영상정보를 획득하는 영상데이터 획득모듈(12), 영상데이터 획득모듈(12)에서 획득한 관리대상 현장의 영상정보를 분석하고 2D화하여 2D맵으로 가공하고 편집하는 현장 2D맵 편집모듈(13), 영상데이터 획득모듈(12)에서 획득한 관리대상 현장의 영상정보를 3D공간영상으로 가공하고 가시화 하는 3D공간정보 가시화 모듈(14), 정보획득 수단(2)으로 부터 획득한 영상정보, 열화정정보, 센싱정보를 이용하여 재난상황을 분석하고 예측하는 재난상황 예측 모듈(15), 재난상황 예측 모듈(15)에서 분석하고 예측한 재난상황에 대한 정보를 기반으로 하여 재난상황에 대한 시뮬레이션을 구현하는 시뮬레이션 관리 구현 모듈(16), 시뮬레이션 관리 구현 모듈(16)을 통하여 구현된 재난상황 시뮬레이션을 이용하여 재난상황 시나리오를 구현하고 실행할 수 있는 시나리오 관리 모듈(17), 및 데이터베이스 관리 모듈(18)로 구성된다. 
또한, 상기 현장 2D맵 편집모듈(13)에는 2D맵에 그리드를 생성하여 맵핑하기 위한 2차원 그리드 생성영역을 더 포함하고, 상기 2차원 그리드 생성영역에는 다단계 그리드 생성기능을 더 포함하게 된다. 
또한, 상기 상기 3D공간정보 가시화 모듈(14)에는 3D 맵핑을 통하여 생성된 3D맵에 3차원 그리드를 생성하게 되는 것으로 좌표형식을 적용할 수 있도록 구획하는 3차원 그리드 생성영역을 더 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 그리드 기반 공간모델링을 통한 군중밀집 및 화재예측 시뮬레이션 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Method and system for guiding evacuation routes in case of fire based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈에 기초하여 화재 발생에 따른 대피 경로를 안내하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a system for guiding an evacuation route in accordance with a fire based on a digital twin. A method for guiding an evacuation route according to the occurrence of a fire may include the steps of: generating a space map including a virtual building corresponding to a real building based on a digital twin; performing a harmful substance diffusion simulation in the space map; predicting a harmful substance diffusion state in the real building using the result of the harmful substance diffusion simulation when a fire occurs in the real building; and guiding an evacuation route to a user based on the predicted harmful substance diffusion state.
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈에 기초하여 화재 발생에 따른 대피 경로를 안내하는 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다.  화재 발생에 따른 대피 경로 안내 방법은 디지털 트윈에 기초하여 현실 건물에 대응하는 가상 건물이 포함된 공간 맵을 생성하는 단계; 상기 공간 맵에서 유해물질 확산 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 단계; 상기 현실 건물에서 화재가 발생한 경우, 상기 유해물질 확산 시뮬레이션의 결과를 이용하여 상기 현실 건물에서의 유해 물질 확산 상태를 예측하는 단계; 및 예측한 유해 물질 확산 상태에 기초하여 사용자에게 대피 경로를 안내하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Deep displacement monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a deep displacement monitoring system which comprises an MCU, an array displacement sensor, a LORA communication module, a power supply unit and a mounting frame, wherein the array displacement sensor is arranged in a geological disaster area to be monitored, and a drilling hole or an embedded structure is arranged in the geological disaster area to be monitored so as to place and mount the array displacement sensor. The array displacement sensor is connected with the MCU, the array displacement sensor transmits monitoring data to the MCU, the LORA communication module is connected with the MCU, and the LORA communication module transmits data in the MCU to the user side. The utility model can monitor the deep displacement of structures such as side slopes, dams, tunnels and the like, can realize stable and reliable data acquisition and transmit the data to users, has higher measurement accuracy of the array displacement sensing system, has better application range and prospect in monitoring geological disasters of the side slopes, has simple and reasonable structural design, is convenient and quick to use and has strong practicability.

title_en: Disaster connectivity analysis system, server, and method
title_ko: 재난 연계성 분석 시스템, 서버, 및 방법
