abstract_en: The disaster linkage analysis system and method analyze the specific process of the accident damage generation and simultaneous or serial disaster for the preemptive disaster management about the composite trouble by using the artificial intelligence technology. In addition, in order to increase the understanding of the analysis result through the embodiment, information is provided in the form of a scenario and a map by dividing the correlation analysis result of the disaster by disaster and accident type. In addition, through the embodiment, the networking of disasters is the most important factor in the analysis of composite disasters, and the connection between disasters is analyzed based on the relationship between disasters, accident types, and vulnerable factors.
abstract_ko: 재난 연계성 분석 시스템 및 방법은 인공지능 기술을 이용하여 복합재난에 대한 선제적 재난관리를 위해 동시다발적 또는 연쇄적 재난과 사고 피해 발생의 구체적 과정을 분석한다. 또한, 실시예를 통해 분석결과에 대한 이해도를 높이기 위해, 재난의 연계성 분석 결과를 재난, 사고 유형별로 구분하여 시나리오 및 지도 형태로 정보를 제공한다. 또한, 실시예를 통해 재난의 네트워크화를 복합재난 분석의 가장 중점적 요소로 두고, 재난, 사고 유형과 취약요소의 관계성을 근간으로 재난 간의 연계성을 분석한다.

title_en: Reservoir intelligent scheduling method based on near-end strategy optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent reservoir scheduling method based on a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, and relates to the technical field of reservoir application. According to the invention, the reservoir is modeled as an intelligent body, the intelligent body consists of two neural networks with the same structure, interacts with a dispatching environment, adopts a near-end strategy optimization (PPO) algorithm to update network parameters, uses historical actual measurement runoff data, generates simulated warehousing flow and forecast flow data through an ARMA model to train the intelligent body, verifies real-time dispatching performance of the intelligent body by using the historical actual measurement runoff data, expresses behavior in the form of probability distribution, effectively avoids limitation of dimension disaster of a traditional algorithm, and enables an Agent to flexibly adjust the dispatching strategy by observing water level and water supply condition in real time, so that a decision process is closer to an actual dispatching scene.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING JIAOTONG;GUANGXI PINGLU CANAL CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Identification method and system for automatically discovering geological disaster monitoring equipment based on laser radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and discloses an identification method and an identification system for automatically discovering geological disaster monitoring equipment based on a laser radar. The method comprises the steps of determining relative positions and the engagement variability of geological disaster information, adding error parameters to a data-driven geological disaster monitoring equipment moving track evolution model, training, predicting the movement change and variance of geological disaster information of adjacent engagement areas, calculating the engagement variability of geological disaster information of a prediction result, obtaining a predicted reliability index, carrying out track correction based on a laser radar, constructing a laser radar digital-analog positioning recognition model based on Kalman filtering, obtaining a positioning recognition result of the automatic discovery geological disaster monitoring equipment, and obtaining geological disaster monitoring information of the position according to the positioning recognition result. The method solves the problem that accurate geological disaster evolution information can be obtained after the position of the geological disaster monitoring equipment is changed, and has practical significance for monitoring engineering.
assignees: GUONENG YULIN ENERGY CO LTD;XIAN MEIKE TRANSPARENT GEOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Discrete element geological disaster simulation method based on contact of spherical particles and triangular grids
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a discrete element geological disaster simulation method based on contact of spherical particles and triangular grids, and relates to the field of disaster simulation. The method comprises the steps of constructing a geological disaster model, wherein the geological disaster model comprises a terrain surface and a disaster body. The terrain surface is divided into a plurality of triangular grids which are connected with each other, and the disaster body is scattered into a plurality of spherical particles which are contacted with each other. The contact type between the spherical particles and the triangular meshes is determined for the spherical particles and the triangular meshes that are in contact with each other, and the contact force between the spherical particles and the triangular meshes is calculated from the contact type. And simulating a disaster evolution process of a contact area between the disaster body and the terrain surface according to the contact force between the spherical particles and the triangular grids which are in contact with each other. According to the method and the device, the contact force between the spherical particles and the triangular grids can be calculated in a refined mode according to the contact type, continuity of contact force calculation between adjacent triangular grids is guaranteed, and therefore accuracy of geological disaster simulation is improved.

title_en: Collapse geological disaster vulnerability model and risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collapse geological disaster vulnerability model and a risk assessment method and system, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting target rock mass information and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of collecting monitoring data and long-term rainfall data of a triaxial acceleration sensor, analyzing acceleration fluctuation characteristics, combining the rainfall data to identify the risk of rock mass instability, quantifying the risk of rock mass instability based on a Monte Carlo method, predicting the movement path and the accumulation range of collapse rocks by utilizing numerical simulation, evaluating the threat of the collapse rocks to peripheral electric facilities, and carrying out hierarchical management on the peripheral area of a transformer substation through a risk level model. The invention adopts the technologies of real-time monitoring, probability calculation and numerical simulation, and solves the problems of lack of dynamic monitoring, accurate evaluation and hierarchical protection of electric power facilities in the prior art. The whole scheme realizes real-time and automatic monitoring and risk grading of collapse geological disasters, and effectively improves the safety and reliability of electric power facilities under disaster conditions.

title_en: System and method for creating fire image for training artificial intelligence model
title_ko: 인공지능 학습을 위한 화재이미지 생성 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for generating a disaster image such as a fire. According to the present invention, in order to solve problems of an artificial intelligence-based fire and disaster detection system and methods of the prior art, which have limitations in the development and performance improvement of an artificial intelligence fire detection model because it is not easy to secure new learning data, a new disaster image can be generated from an existing cctv image or image including essential features of a disaster such as fire, flood, earthquake, etc. using an artificial intelligence-based data augmentation algorithm, so that various data usable for learning and training of an artificial intelligence model can be secured without actually collecting new data, thereby more efficiently and effectively improving the development and performance of a fire and disaster detection artificial intelligence model.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재와 같은 재난 이미지를 생성하기 위한 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 새로운 학습데이터의 확보가 용이하지 못하여 인공지능 화재감지 모델의 개발 및 성능개선에 한계가 있었던 종래기술의 인공지능 기반 화재 및 재난감지 시스템 및 방법들의 문제점을 해결하기 위해, 인공지능 기반의 데이터 증강 알고리즘을 이용하여 화재, 홍수, 지진 등과 같은 재난의 필수적인 특징을 포함하는 기존의 CCTV 이미지 또는 영상으로부터 새로운 재난 이미지를 생성할 수 있도록 구성됨으로써, 실제로 새로운 데이터를 수집하지 않고도 인공지능 모델의 학습 및 훈련에 사용 가능한 다양한 데이터를 확보할 수 있으며, 그것에 의해, 화재 및 재난감지 인공지능 모델의 개발 및 성능 개선이 보다 효율적이고 효과적으로 이루어질 수 있도록 구성되는 인공지능 학습을 위한 화재이미지 생성 시스템 및 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Evacuation simulation system, and information processing device
abstract_en: To provide an evacuation simulation system capable of realizing realistic evacuation drills in virtual space.SOLUTION: The evacuation simulation system is an evacuation simulation system that includes a server unit, and a communication apparatus that communicates with the server unit. The server unit includes: a modeling unit that builds a virtual space by spatial modeling using spatial data; an evacuation simulation unit that simulates the behavior of evacuees during evacuation based on evacuee data and synthesizes the images and voices of the evacuees in the virtual space created by the modeling unit; and a transmission unit that transmits virtual space image information and audio information created by synthesizing images and audio of evacuees by the evacuation simulation unit to the communication apparatus. The communication apparatus includes: a receiving unit for receiving the virtual space image information and the audio information sent from the server unit; and an output unit that outputs the image information and the audio information received by the receiving unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Lightning protection simulation calculation method and system for extra-high voltage transmission line
abstract_en: The invention provides a lightning protection simulation calculation method and a lightning protection simulation calculation system for an extra-high voltage transmission line, wherein a double-index model of lightning current is created, the extra-high voltage transmission line comprises a lead, lightning conductor related data and corresponding tower data, a flashover judgment model of an insulator is built, a power frequency grounding resistance value is calculated based on soil resistivity data measured at the bottom of the related tower in each region, an impact grounding resistance value is calculated based on the power frequency grounding resistance value, an impact grounding resistance module is created according to the relation between the power frequency grounding resistance value and the impact grounding resistance value, the lightning current of the double-index model is continuously changed, simulation calculation is carried out by the impact grounding resistance module, whether the insulator flashover happens or not is judged according to the flashover judgment model, and the amplitude of the lightning current when the line just breaks down is determined. The invention reduces errors, is beneficial to optimizing the lightning protection simulation calculation of the power transmission line, reduces the loss caused by lightning disasters, and improves the economy and the safety of the power system.
assignees: SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING CONSULTING INST CORP LTD

title_en: Construction method of ground unmanned equipment collaborative combat decision intelligent agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of a ground unmanned equipment collaborative combat decision-making agent, which aims at the problem of complex collaborative combat task solution space dimension disaster, realizes intelligent decision-making of different granularity tasks in the whole combat process while effectively compressing a DRL solving space to improve exploration efficiency by constructing a double-layer decision-making framework based on data driving and knowledge driving, realizes unified coordination control from effective characterization of complex state input to combat action by constructing a collaborative combat decision-making agent network model aiming at the problem of generating a task layer combat command action strategy, and improves sampling and training efficiency by constructing a distributed training framework to realize asynchronous parallel training of high throughput of the collaborative combat decision-making agent network model, and effectively improves the learning efficiency and the final performance of the agent network model by constructing a combat decision-making agent learning algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning and solving the combat decision-making agent.

title_en: Urban toughness comprehensive evaluation and management system under multiple disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation and management system for urban toughness under multiple disasters, which relates to the technical field of urban toughness evaluation and management, and comprises that an output end of monitoring equipment of the multiple disasters and an urban system is accessed into a database of the multiple disasters and the urban system, and is responsible for monitoring disaster data and urban data; the multi-disaster and urban system database is connected with the multi-disaster urban toughness comprehensive evaluation and management module in a bidirectional mode, data generated by the multi-disaster and urban system monitoring equipment and the multi-disaster urban toughness comprehensive evaluation and management module are stored, and the multi-disaster urban toughness comprehensive evaluation and management module is connected with a multi-disaster urban toughness comprehensive evaluation and management system display end in a bidirectional mode. And by simulating the multi-disaster and the coupling action load field thereof, analyzing the physical damage and the function decline degree of the urban engineering system, calculating the risk level and the toughness level of the urban multi-disaster, and providing the technical support for post-disaster emergency decision making.

title_en: Multifunctional simulation test system for structural water-induced disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional simulation test system for a structural water-induced disaster, which comprises a circulating water tank, a power unit, a deep-groove flushing test unit, a water flow earthquake coupling test unit and a flushing and grinding test unit, wherein the circulating water tank comprises a U-shaped groove part and an annular groove part which are in circulating communication, the power unit, the deep-groove flushing test unit and the water flow earthquake coupling test unit are sequentially arranged on the U-shaped groove part, the power unit is used for controlling water flow power in the circulating water tank, the deep-groove flushing test unit is used for simulating flushing environments of deep-groove sediment, the water flow earthquake coupling test unit is used for simulating disaster environments in which various water flow states are coupled with earthquakes, and the flushing and grinding test unit is arranged on the annular groove part and used for simulating impact environments of water flow containing gravel.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent energy unit anti-interference performance detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent energy units, in particular to a system and a method for detecting anti-interference performance of an intelligent energy unit, which realize quick deployment and flexible adjustment of a test environment by constructing a cloud high-precision virtual test environment, remarkably reduce test cost and period, comprehensively simulate various interference scenes possibly encountered in actual operation by a multi-dimensional interference simulation module, the method comprises the steps of electromagnetic interference, power supply fluctuation, data transmission errors, natural disasters and the like, ensures the accuracy and reliability of a test result, and simultaneously, further improves the test efficiency by introducing an automatic test execution module and a real-time monitoring function, so that a user can grasp the change of key performance indexes in the test process in real time.

title_en: Combined monitoring and integrated analysis method for surface subsidence and rock burst
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for jointly monitoring and integrally analyzing ground subsidence and rock burst, which comprises the following steps: establishing a numerical model, simulating the earth surface subsidence and overburden stress change rule in the exploitation process, monitoring the earth surface subsidence by adopting a traditional survey line method and an UAV laser radar, monitoring the microseism by adopting a microseism monitoring system, and performing rock burst risk assessment by comprehensively analyzing earth surface subsidence data, overburden rock stress data and microseism data. The invention provides scientific basis for the integrated prevention and control of the deformation of the coal mine surface and the underground dynamic disaster, provides scientific prediction basis and technical support for the safe exploitation of the coal mine, and effectively reduces the risk of the mine disaster.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating lime-modified loess disasters by acid rain
abstract_en: A lime modified loess disaster evaluation method and device based on acid rain comprises the steps of obtaining in-situ modified soil and in-situ loess, conducting layering treatment and testing, comparing various data of the in-situ modified soil and the in-situ loess with various data of the original modified soil and the original loess, judging degradation degree of the in-situ modified soil, manufacturing a model experiment box according to actual working conditions of the side slope, sequentially filling the in-situ loess side slope and the in-situ modified soil side slope into the model experiment box, simulating side slope damage of the actual working conditions of the side slope under acidic degradation, obtaining the in-situ modified soil side slope and the in-situ loess side slope, conducting layering treatment and testing, comparing various data of the in-situ modified soil side slope and the in-situ loess side slope with various data of the original modified soil and the original loess, and judging degradation degree of the in-situ modified soil side slope. The design has the advantages of high reliability and accuracy of the evaluation result, convenience in operation and lower cost.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system based on edge computing internet of things gateway equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system based on edge calculation Internet of things gateway equipment, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and comprise the specific steps of firstly, deploying various geological and meteorological sensors in an easily-developed area and collecting related data in real time; the method comprises the steps of acquiring data, processing the acquired data by using edge computing equipment, calculating the change rate of historical and current geological parameters and the change amount of meteorological data, determining a geological risk index based on historical statistical analysis, constructing a deep learning model, taking the historical geological parameters as a training set to acquire the current risk index, generating an environment influence index and carrying out correlation analysis to obtain a comprehensive risk index, and finally comparing the comprehensive risk index with a preset threshold value, predicting the geological disaster risk level of a three gorges reservoir area and sending out corresponding early warning signals. The invention improves the accuracy of geological disaster early warning, and can acquire early warning results and release early warning information in time.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING THREE GORGES;INST MECH CAS

title_en: Simulation method for membrane pyrolysis and toxic gas concentration distribution in fire scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method of membrane pyrolysis and toxic gas concentration distribution in a fire scene, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining membrane structure building data, establishing a CAD model, importing Pyros im software, S2, establishing a calculation area, designating the yield of combustion products, setting fire source parameters, S3, defining different building material models and surface types, giving the different building material models and surface types to corresponding building components, S4, setting temperature measuring points, visibility and toxic gas volume fraction measuring points, setting simulation parameters, calling FDS program calculation, S5, extracting results, and obtaining curves of temperature, toxic gas concentration and visibility changes along with time near an evacuation outlet. The invention can simulate the membrane pyrolysis process of the membrane structure building under the fire scene, and solves the key technical problem of how to obtain the concentration distribution of toxic gas considering the membrane pyrolysis product in numerical simulation.
assignees: EAST CHINA ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission tower wind disaster vulnerability analysis method based on long-term ocean atmospheric corrosion
abstract_en: The method for analyzing the wind disaster vulnerability of the power transmission tower based on long-term ocean atmospheric corrosion comprises the following steps of 1, establishing a wind load numerical simulation model, 2, establishing a steel structure ocean atmospheric environment corrosion depth prediction model, 3, establishing a power transmission tower line system finite element model after corrosion, 4, establishing a power transmission line structure wind disaster vulnerability model, 5, analyzing power transmission tower structures pushover considering different service years, and 6, analyzing the wind disaster vulnerability of the power transmission tower structure. According to the method for analyzing the wind disaster vulnerability of the power transmission tower based on long-term ocean atmospheric corrosion, disclosed by the invention, the damage probability of the power transmission tower under the wind load effect can be more accurately predicted by establishing the wind disaster vulnerability curves under different corrosion degrees, so that scientific basis is provided for design, maintenance and operation of the power transmission tower, and the stability and safety of the power transmission tower in a complex ocean atmospheric environment are ensured.

title_en: Experiment platform and method for influence of air conditioner on smoke flow under train fire disaster
abstract_en: The application provides an experiment platform and method for influencing smoke flow by an air conditioner under a train fire disaster, wherein the experiment platform comprises a reduced-size railway vehicle body which is a train vehicle body model constructed according to a preset reduced ratio of a real train vehicle body, an experiment area and a smoke buffer area are arranged in the reduced-size railway vehicle body, an air conditioning system is arranged in the reduced-size railway vehicle body and used for adjusting the temperature in the reduced-size railway vehicle body and uniformly supplying air to the reduced-size railway vehicle body, a measurement total system is arranged in the reduced-size railway vehicle body and used for measuring the temperature in the reduced-size railway vehicle body and the smoke flow characteristics, and a fire simulation system is arranged in the reduced-size railway vehicle body and comprises methanol and smoke generating components. Therefore, the application provides the size reduction experiment platform to verify the influence of the air conditioner on the smoke flow under the train fire, thereby effectively solving the problems of great consumption of manpower and financial resources and difficult mastering of the experiment state.
assignees: CRRC CHANGCHUN RAILWAY VEHICLES CO LTD

title_en: Highway geological disaster prediction method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster detection, in particular to a highway geological disaster prediction method and a highway geological disaster prediction system, comprising the steps of preprocessing data, model training, namely adopting a Informer model, wherein the model structure comprises an input layer, an encoder, a decoder and an output layer, using a sparse self-attention mechanism and a position encoding technology to enhance the processing capacity of long-time sequence data and the accuracy of geological disaster prediction, model training comprises pre-training and additional training aiming at specific case data, the pre-training uses NASA global data for pre-training so as to learn a wide range of soil humidity and meteorological data modes, the additional training is used for additional training on the basis of the pre-training, the data set is divided into a 60% training set, a 20% verification set and a 20% test set, using RMSE as a loss function, and adopting k-fold cross verification to ensure the stability and the generalization capacity of the model, and model evaluation comprises using various performance indexes to evaluate the model, including the accuracy, the precision, the recall rate, the F1-C and the ROC and the AUC curves.
assignees: CHINA TRANSP INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire disaster early warning video identification method and system for outdoor environment of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of substations, in particular to a method and a system for intelligent fire early warning video identification of an outdoor environment of a substation. The method comprises the steps of acquiring monitoring video data in an outdoor area of a transformer substation, preprocessing the monitoring video data to obtain preprocessed video data, presetting a fire smoke detection model, inputting the preprocessed video data into the fire smoke detection model, and carrying out fire early warning according to the output of the fire smoke detection model. According to the invention, the network cameras are arranged in the key area of the transformer substation, the traditional serial port transmission is replaced by adopting a network video transmission mode, and the network is combined with the end-to-end target detection network based on YOLOv, so that the wide-range dead-angle-free monitoring and quick response are realized. The system adopts a composite loss function and a migration learning strategy to carry out model training, so that the problem of insufficient samples is effectively solved, the system has good environmental adaptability, the accuracy of 91.8% can be maintained even in foggy days, and the reliable guarantee is provided for the fire safety of the transformer substation.
assignees: CHONGZUO POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Artificial rainfall and seepage device for simulating large-scale mountain disaster dynamics
abstract_en: The application provides an artificial rainfall and seepage device for simulating large-scale mountain disaster dynamics, which comprises a feed box, a water pool, an artificial rainfall mechanism and a water seepage mechanism, wherein the bottom of the feed box is obliquely arranged, one side of the feed box is provided with an openable gate, the water pool is positioned on one side of the feed box away from the gate, a plurality of rows of through holes are formed in the adjacent part of the water pool and the feed box, and the artificial rainfall mechanism is positioned above the feed box. The application realizes the whole process of converting the large-scale landslide into the debris flow in the large-scale mountain disaster dynamics experiment under the conditions of rainfall, seepage, rainfall and seepage coupling, and the like, namely realizes the simulation and prevention and control measure research under the combined action of multiple factors.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Method for surveying coal-rock stratum structure under water body
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for surveying coal-rock stratum structure under water, which belongs to the technical field of stratum survey and comprises the following steps of S1, dividing a survey area into array grids, determining drilling points, S2, using drilling equipment to drill, sampling rock stratum in the drilling, detecting data of physical mechanical parameters of the rock stratum, S3, respectively arranging an acoustic wave transmitting transducer and an acoustic wave receiving transducer in two symmetrical drilling points, detecting the stratum between the two symmetrical drilling points and generating data of acoustic wave patterns, S4, taking the stratum as a continuous medium, and calculating gravity stress values born by stratum with different depths through integration S5, constructing a stratum structure model, and S6, forming a change zone with a dynamic water inflow area in the stratum structure model. The method for surveying the coal-rock stratum structure under the water body can predict the water gushing area of the coal-rock stratum under the water body, and reduces the problem of water gushing disasters in the coal exploitation process.

title_en: Telescopic rainfall simulation device and test method
abstract_en: The invention provides a scalable rainfall simulation device and a testing method, wherein the scalable rainfall simulation device comprises a rainfall simulation mechanism, an electric control mechanism and a stabilizing frame structure; the simulated rainfall mechanism is used for simulating natural rainfall conditions and integrally carried on the stabilizing frame structure, and is connected with the electric control mechanism, and the electric control mechanism is used for controlling the simulated rainfall mechanism to rainfall and/or stretch and slide along a preset direction. Under the condition that rainfall is generated to cause geological disasters, the device cannot damage the structure of the device under the condition that the disasters occur. Therefore, a series of geological disaster experiments caused by rainfall can be further and continuously explored, the device is convenient to detach and transport, after an experimental site is selected, only simple installation is needed, after the experiment is finished, the device is convenient to detach, and powerful support is provided for subsequent research through a new rainfall simulation device and technology.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Sequential InSAR coherent diagram building damage detection method based on generation model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing image anomaly detection, in particular to a method for detecting building damage of a sequential InSAR coherent image based on a generation model, which comprises the steps of generating a time sequence of the InSAR coherent image of a building area by utilizing the time sequence of the SAR image of the building area; training WGAN to generate a model by using InSAR coherent images at the 2 nd to T-1 th moments of the building area to obtain a trained WGAN generation model, subtracting the InSAR coherent image at the T+1 th moment of the building area from the InSAR coherent image at the T+1 th moment of the building area after disaster occurrence, which is generated by the trained WGAN generation model, to obtain an abnormal image, acquiring abnormal information based on the abnormal image, and comparing and screening a damaged area of the building by using a set threshold value. The invention provides a more accurate detection method for the damage condition of the building after the disaster, and improves the performance of the damage detection of the building.

title_en: Portable simulated earthquake demonstration device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable simulated earthquake demonstration device which comprises a simulated movement device, an information acquisition device and a control device, wherein the simulated movement device is used for simulating earthquake movement, the information acquisition device is arranged on the side of the simulated movement device, the information acquisition device acquires information of the simulated movement device and transmits the information to the control device, the control device receives the information from the information acquisition device, transmits the information to the simulated movement device after processing and controls the simulated movement device to move, and the simulated movement device, the information acquisition device and the control device are connected through a connecting component. The invention realizes split carrying of the simulated earthquake demonstration device and the control device, solves the problem that the existing demonstration device cannot simulate the vibration effect of acceleration with different frequencies in actual earthquake by internally arranging earthquake waves with different types, can be used as an earthquake disaster demonstration device or an earthquake-proof and vibration-reduction product demonstration device, and provides beneficial assistance for disaster prevention and reduction, earthquake-proof teaching and demonstration.
assignees: CHINA AVIATION PLANNING AND DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Forestry loss value evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing, and discloses a forestry loss value evaluation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the invention combines a second time series image data set with a first fitting model to calculate a first difference image, the change condition of the vegetation in the cloud-free area of the remote sensing image relative to the vegetation in the disaster-free state after the typhoon is subjected to disaster can be intuitively and quantitatively displayed. Further, the model training is performed by using the environment influence factor set and the first difference image, so that deep relation rules of typhoon disasters hidden behind complex data on forest influence can be mined. Further, the constructed model is used for predicting the normalized vegetation index difference value of the cloud coverage area to generate a second difference image, so that the spatial characterization information of the disaster situation of the whole typhoon disaster area can be perfected. And finally, combining the real forestry loss value, the first difference image and the second difference image, so that the forestry loss value in the whole typhoon disaster area can be rapidly evaluated.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Multi-element progressive type storm-mountain torrent chained disaster comprehensive risk evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-element progressive storm-mountain torrent chained disaster comprehensive risk evaluation method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-band weather radar networking multi-objective optimization model, coupling a radar rain measurement simulation model to obtain an optimization networking model, and solving a collected scheme set as input to obtain an optimal networking scheme and rainfall forecast; the method comprises the steps of constructing a flood forecast model, extracting rainfall forecast as model input to obtain initial flood forecast, correcting and optimizing to obtain an optimized flood forecast model, simulating to obtain flood forecast, screening initial mountain torrent risk factors to construct a mountain torrent risk factor set, reducing the mountain torrent risk factors to obtain a storm-mountain torrent chained comprehensive risk index, calculating a comprehensive risk index value based on the flood forecast, inputting a mountain torrent risk evaluation model constructed by adopting a XGBoost model, and solving the model to obtain the comprehensive risk forecast. The invention enhances the scientificity and timeliness of disaster emergency decision, and improves the early warning capability and the risk management level of storm-mountain torrent disasters.

title_en: Long-process simulation deduction continuous section construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-process simulation deduction continuous section construction method and a long-process simulation deduction continuous section construction system, and belongs to the technical field of power grid simulation. The method comprises the steps of subdividing the total length of the long process simulation deduction time into a plurality of calculation time points at equal intervals, further obtaining grid network frame structure, regulation operation and weather forecast data in the total length of the long process simulation deduction time, respectively calculating the instantaneous fault probability and disaster-caused fault probability of the whole network equipment, further constructing a whole network equipment fault probability model, calculating whole network probability power flow distribution according to the whole network equipment fault probability model by taking the whole network equipment instantaneous fault probability and disaster-caused fault probability as input, determining the running state of the whole network equipment according to the whole network probability power flow distribution, carrying out real-time power flow calculation to obtain simulation deduction calculation sections of the calculation time points, and finally obtaining a long process simulation deduction continuous section sequence in a simulation period. The method is beneficial to a power grid operator to better formulate an operation and maintenance strategy, optimize resource allocation and improve the safety and stability of the power grid.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Tunnel burst water disaster prediction method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel water inrush safety assessment, in particular to a tunnel water inrush disaster prediction method, equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the following steps of S1, constructing a data set based on tunnel water inrush disaster cases, analyzing and selecting disaster causing factors, and defining disaster grading standards; S2, dividing the data set into a training set and a testing set according to a preset proportion relation; compared with the prior art, the method has the beneficial effects that the intelligent prediction of the tunnel water bursting disaster is performed by using a machine learning method, the problems of strong subjectivity, poor applicability and the like of the traditional prediction method can be avoided, meanwhile, misjudgment and missed judgment of the disaster caused by technicians are avoided, and the model performance and the prediction precision are improved.
assignees: RES INST HIGHWAY MINI TRANSP;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Digital twinning-based water conservancy and scenic spot disaster early warning and flood prevention platform and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water conservancy based on digital twin a disaster early warning flood prevention platform and a disaster early warning flood prevention method for a scenic spot, relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and flood prevention, and adopts the main scheme that: the method comprises the steps of collecting various data of a water conservancy and scenic spot by using a sensor, then respectively calculating water level, water flow speed, rainfall, geology and facility availability indexes, constructing a digital twin model based on three-dimensional modeling software by the indexes, simulating and calculating comprehensive environment data indexes, inputting the data indexes for a period of time in the future to simulate future conditions, finally setting a disaster early warning threshold value, comparing the future comprehensive environment data indexes with the disaster early warning threshold value, judging whether early warning is triggered, and generating and distributing early warning information if the early warning is triggered.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA UNIV OF FINANCE AND ECONOMICS

title_en: Multi-mode fusion gas station leakage-fire disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode fusion gas station leakage-fire disaster early warning method and system, and belongs to the field of gas system leakage and fire disaster monitoring. The invention firstly collects the infrared image data, pressure and gas concentration time sequence data of the gas station pipeline. And secondly, preprocessing the acquired data. Again, an abnormal heat source image dataset is created, and yolov abnormal heat source monitoring models are constructed and trained for identifying abnormal heat sources and calculating fire symptom abnormal probabilities. And then combining the abnormal probability of the fire symptom with the sensor data set, manufacturing a leakage-fire data set, and establishing a multi-mode gas station leakage-fire abnormal recognition model for training and optimizing. And finally, carrying out leakage-fire abnormality monitoring on the gas station by using the trained multi-mode model, and sending out corresponding early warning information according to an output result. The invention can realize the combined abnormal discrimination of gas leakage and fire disaster and improve the safety and early warning accuracy of the gas station.

title_en: Grouting treatment process for karst broken zone strong water guide zone of unconsolidated formation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drilling grouting, in particular to a grouting treatment process for a strong water guide area of a karst broken zone of an unconsolidated formation, which comprises the following steps of determining a treatment area; setting drilling arrangement parameters for the treatment area, setting multiple rows of drilling holes which are arranged in a quincunx staggered mode, wherein the drilling holes are drilled to a set depth d by adopting vertical descending, drilling intervals S and encryption drilling intervals S' exist among the multiple rows of drilling holes which are arranged in the quincunx staggered mode, setting a grouting process for a strong water guide area of a karst broken zone of an unconsolidated formation, adopting a casing drilling process for the drilling holes of the unconsolidated formation, drilling holes of the strong water guide area of the karst broken zone outside a pit in the pit in a segmented and layered mode, stopping drilling when encountering an abnormal geological structure, and performing grouting operation, and evaluating and monitoring grouting effects. The underground engineering water-logging device can solve the problems that holes are not easy to form in loose strata of underground engineering, the reinforcing effect is poor, and foundation pit water-logging disasters caused by covering karst broken zones are avoided.
assignees: CHINA RESOURCES CEMENT HEPU CO LTD;CHINA RESOURCES BUILDING MATERIALS TECH CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Teaching device of marine fixed carbon dioxide fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a teaching device of a marine fixed carbon dioxide fire extinguishing system, which comprises a base and a carbon dioxide gas cylinder group, wherein a positioning mechanism is arranged at the top of the base, a bracket is fixedly connected to the top of the base, a gas cylinder control box and an alarm box are respectively and fixedly connected to one side of the bracket, a main pipe is fixedly connected to the top of the carbon dioxide gas cylinder group, a first branch pipe is fixedly connected to one end of the main pipe, combustible objects are heated, the heating speed is high, the heating time is short, automatic power-off is completed through heating, a gas alarm controller has the functions of detecting the concentration of CO2 in an actual operation room, and the oxygen content monitoring, and through the training of the equipment, the audible and visual alarm is sent out, the actual scene is effectively restored, and the in-situ coping capability and maintenance skills of marine vessels and marine operation personnel when fire disasters occur can be greatly improved.
assignees: HAINAN TAIDA OFFSHORE TECH CONSULTING SERVICE CO LTD;HAINAN HAIXIA SHIPPING CO LTD

title_en: Mechanical arm capable of realizing multifunctional integration of grabbing drill and sawing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mechanical arm capable of realizing multi-functional integration of a drill grabbing saw, which comprises a mechanical arm body and an end effector, wherein the end effector is provided with a fixing device, one side of the fixing device is provided with a connecting piece, the fixing device is hinged with a driving end of the mechanical arm body through the connecting piece, the other side of the fixing device is provided with a clamping jaw, an electric saw and a drill bit, the clamping jaws are arranged in a pair at intervals, each clamping jaw comprises a big claw and a small claw which are matched with each other, the big claw and the small claw are hinged with the fixing device, the big claw is driven by a claw motor II, the small claw is driven by a claw motor I, and the electric saw and the drill bit are arranged between the two clamping jaws. The mechanical arm is provided with the fixing device, and the clamping jaw, the electric saw and the drill bit are arranged on one side of the fixing device, so that the clamping jaw can be used for grabbing, and the electric saw and the drill bit can be used for respectively completing the work of the drill saw. The device can finish one or more of grabbing, drilling and sawing according to the needs, and can better meet the needs of disaster relief and post-disaster reconstruction.

title_en: Geological drilling investigation equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses geological drilling investigation equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein the top of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a shell, one side of the shell is provided with a depth-fixing drilling mechanism, the depth-fixing drilling mechanism comprises an electric telescopic rod, the bottom of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the shell, one side of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the middle shaft of the bottom of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a first waterproof motor, the output end of the first waterproof motor is fixedly connected with a drill bit, and the right side of the bottom of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a waterproof infrared emitter. This geological drilling investigation equipment for geological disaster prevention and cure through setting up wiper mechanism, after the drilling, resumes the drill bit to normal position, then starts the water pump, takes out the water of water tank inner chamber through the drinking-water pipe, then spouts water to the drill bit surface through bellows and shower nozzle, washes the drill bit, and the shower nozzle still can vertical movement when washing for it is effectual to wash.
assignees: HUBEI SHENLONG GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING SURVEY INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for identifying and monitoring water inrush disaster varying water source ascending path based on similarity simulation test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine water disaster prevention and control, and discloses a method for identifying and monitoring a water inrush disaster varying water source lifting path based on a similar simulation test, which comprises the steps of collecting mining area data, determining lithology and paving thickness of each rock stratum of the mining area, and carrying out similar material proportion on the determined lithology of each rock stratum; according to the water inrush disaster water source rising path identification monitoring method based on the similar simulation test, the exothermic materials are used for enhancing the response capability of each rock stratum to temperature change in the experimental environment, so that the fine change of the rock stratum temperature in the water inrush process can be reflected more accurately, and the monitoring precision is improved. In the water inrush monitoring process, a thermal image is acquired in real time through the infrared thermal imager, so that the real-time distribution of the temperature in the mining process can be displayed, and the current water inrush dynamic condition, including the temperature abnormal region and the preliminary contour of the water inrush path, is reflected.

title_en: Fitting method of heat conduction coefficient of cable material under high temperature condition of fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fitting method of a heat conduction coefficient of a cable material under a high-temperature condition of fire. The method comprises the steps of preparing two parts of cable materials, determining heat capacity values of an outer protective layer and an insulating layer of a first part of cable material at different temperatures, uniformly arranging a plurality of thermocouples on the outer protective layer and the insulating layer of a second part of cable material, manufacturing an over-temperature test sample of a stacked structure through a high-temperature pressing process, performing an over-temperature test, recording temperature data of the thermocouples when the over-temperature test sample is over-temperature, determining heat conductivity coefficients of the cable material at different temperatures, determining heat conductivity coefficient mutation points according to the heat conductivity coefficients of the cable material at different temperatures, and performing nonlinear fitting on the heat conductivity coefficients of the cable material before mutation, after mutation and in mutation processes respectively to obtain a graph of the heat conductivity coefficients of the cable material along with temperature change. The invention solves the technical problem that the real situation of the cable fire cannot be accurately simulated by using the fixed heat conductivity coefficient.

title_en: Vectorization method for sales order feature of operator latent passenger prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of big data processing, in particular to a vectorization method for sales ordering characteristics of operator latent passenger prediction. Compared with the traditional sparse matrix representation method, the method has the following advantages that more sales ordering information can be provided by the method under the same characteristic dimension. The dimension required by the traditional sparse matrix representation method is increased along with the increase of the number of sales items, and dimension disasters occur in the process of training the model. The method of the invention compresses the information of all sales items into the vector of 100 dimensions, effectively controls the feature quantity, and can keep the ordering information of all sales items under the client name.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM WANWEI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Firefighter sign monitoring and early warning method based on multivariate state estimation technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a firefighter physical sign monitoring and early warning method based on a multivariate state estimation technology, which relates to the technical field of firefighter physical abnormality monitoring and early warning and is realized by a vital sign acquisition device and a digital individual soldier, and comprises the following steps that S1, heart rate, respiration, body temperature, perspiration and blood oxygen data of a firefighter in a usual state are acquired by the vital sign acquisition device, wherein the usual state comprises a daily activity state, a training state and a state after continuous training for 1 hour; according to the invention, the physical state difference among firefighter individuals is comprehensively considered, the vital sign states of firefighter individuals can be more accurately estimated, early warning can be sent out in advance when potential dangerous states occur to firefighter bodies, a digital individual soldier carries out calculation and analysis on data, the influence caused by rescue site network abnormality is avoided, meanwhile, alarming information of firefighter body abnormal states can be sent out at the first time, and the alarming information can be sent to digital individual soldier terminals and site command parts on other teammates.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Gas leakage monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of the Internet of things and discloses a gas leakage monitoring method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring data of a gas storage device to obtain an initial multidimensional data set; filtering and edge detection processing are carried out to obtain potential abnormal point data, the potential abnormal point data are input into a mixed deep learning model to carry out gas leakage detection to obtain initial leakage source position data and leakage intensity values, accurate leakage positioning of multi-sensor cooperation is carried out to obtain target leakage source position data, gas diffusion simulation is carried out to obtain gas concentration distribution data and risk indexes, dynamic reconfiguration of a sensor network is carried out based on the gas concentration distribution data and the risk indexes, and emergency response strategies and sensor network configuration information are output.

title_en: Large-scale mountain disaster water tank experimental device
abstract_en: The application provides a large-scale mountain disaster water tank experiment device which comprises a top platform, an experiment water tank main body, a plurality of monitoring mechanisms and a protective pad, wherein the experiment water tank main body is connected with a gate, and the protective pad is arranged in the experiment water tank main body and is positioned at one side of the experiment water tank main body far away from the top platform. According to the application, the top platform is a formation area of landslide and debris flow, the experiment water tank body is used for simulating movement of mountain disasters, the monitoring mechanisms in the experiment water tank body are arranged, the movement accumulation process of the debris flow can be monitored in a whole process in a full-time manner, and the guard is used for accurately simulating the accumulation area of the mountain disasters. The device can simulate the mountain disaster which is the most true on a large scale, truly reflects the dynamics mechanism of the mountain disaster prototype such as debris flow and the like, thereby revealing the regulation and control mechanism of the prevention and control engineering on the mountain disaster, providing theoretical basis and technical support for the novel method and the novel measure for preventing and controlling the mountain disaster in China, and effectively guiding engineering design and disaster reduction.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Monitoring platform and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a monitoring platform and a monitoring method thereof, which are used for monitoring the dynamic process of a large-scale mountain disaster water tank experiment device, and comprise a plurality of monitoring mechanisms, a monitoring platform and a monitoring platform, wherein the monitoring mechanisms are sequentially arranged from the upstream to the downstream of the large-scale mountain disaster water tank experiment device, and each monitoring mechanism comprises a top observation tower, a side observation well corresponding to the top observation tower and data acquisition equipment; the bottom monitoring modules are distributed in a multi-row array from the upstream to the downstream of the bottom of the large-scale mountain disaster water tank experimental device, and at least one bottom monitoring module is arranged in each monitoring mechanism. The invention can overcome the adverse condition of large-scale mountain disaster dynamics simulation experiment on dynamic process monitoring, accurately reflect the space-time evolution process of each dynamic parameter in the disaster body movement process, has clear principle, clear construction and strong construction operability, can be suitable for large-scale mountain disaster dynamics simulation experiment, and lays a foundation for dynamics research of complex media.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Post-disaster population flow prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster population flow prediction method and device, which comprise the steps of obtaining population flow data of a target area according to a predetermined space-time fine granularity, obtaining an input population flow dynamic diagram according to the population flow data of the target area, wherein the input population flow dynamic diagram at least comprises an initial abnormal population flow diagram of the target area in a disaster peak period and an average normal population flow diagram of the target area in a non-disaster period, inputting the input population flow dynamic diagram into a pre-trained population flow prediction model to obtain population flow prediction results, and the population flow prediction model is obtained by training the population flow data of a sample area based on a coupling dynamic diagram neural ordinary differential equation. According to the invention, the population flow prediction model is constructed by adopting the coupled dynamic graph neural ordinary differential equation, so that the post-disaster population flow prediction with high accuracy is realized.

title_en: Multichannel real-time fusion processing method and device for seismic waves and acoustic waves
abstract_en: The invention provides a multichannel real-time fusion processing method and device for seismic waves and sound waves, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a seismic data set acquired by at least two acquisition points in multiple earthquakes, dividing the seismic data set into a first sub-seismic data set and a second sub-seismic data set, inputting the first sub-seismic data set into a preset model for training to obtain a trained seismic information acquisition model, and acquiring a real-time seismic data set and inputting the real-time seismic data set into the seismic information acquisition model to obtain real-time seismic information. The method has the beneficial effects that by fusing seismic wave and acoustic wave data, the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of seismic information extraction are improved, the seismic data can be acquired and processed in real time, timely information support is provided for seismic early warning and disaster assessment, model parameters are optimized continuously by adopting an countermeasure training mechanism of a GAN model, the performance and the robustness of the model are improved, a novel technical means is provided, the coping capability of the seismic disaster is improved, and the disaster loss is reduced.
assignees: ZHONGZHEN HUACHUANG SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode mountain torrent disaster on-site early warning threshold dynamic demarcation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode mountain torrent disaster local early warning threshold dynamic demarcation method and system, which are characterized by collecting regional topography data of a research area, setting DEM precision, automatically identifying rivers in the research area, identifying abnormal points of grids, dividing the research area into molecular domains, extracting historical rainfall data of the research area, constructing a rainfall scene random construction model based on prior distribution of historical rainfall, generating a rainfall scene of the research area, inputting a pre-constructed distributed hydrological model, simulating to obtain confluence time, a rainfall cage range and a rainfall area, constructing a mountain torrent forecast model, inputting a plurality of rainfall scenes of the research area into the constructed mountain torrent forecast model, simulating and extracting disaster-causing scenes, inputting a pre-constructed Seq2Seq model and training, collecting historical mountain torrent data of the research area, respectively simulating to obtain mountain torrent disaster processes in the Seq2Seq model corresponding to seven early warning disaster combinations constructed by inputting the historical mountain torrent scenes of the research area, calculating the threshold of the seven early warning combinations, and combining to obtain the mountain torrent disaster local early warning threshold.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Coal mine rock burst disaster prevention and control detection early warning device and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rock burst early warning and monitoring, in particular to a coal mine rock burst disaster prevention and control detection early warning device and an early warning method thereof, the device comprises a mounting block, wherein a detection mechanism is arranged on the mounting block, a control mechanism is arranged on the mounting block, a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the mounting block, a transmission mechanism is arranged on the control mechanism, a sealing mechanism is arranged on the cleaning mechanism, a connecting mechanism is arranged on the mounting block, and a locking mechanism is arranged on the connecting mechanism; through detection mechanism and control mechanism cooperation, make the installation piece get into the inside appointed position of drilling and carry out pressure monitoring and early warning work, through drive mechanism's cooperation, make control mechanism drive clearance mechanism clean the debris of wall in the cave, do benefit to through sealing mechanism and make installation piece one end sealed, through coupling mechanism and locking mechanical system's cooperation, do benefit to and connect two installation pieces, realize that two installation pieces get into and come out the time, the mutual pulling is convenient for get in and out.
assignees: HUATING COAL GROUP CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method based on category type characteristic promotion
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide vulnerability assessment method based on category type feature lifting, which belongs to the field of landslide prediction and comprises the steps of preprocessing acquired multi-category data of a landslide disaster research area, deriving an evaluation factor original value corresponding to a landslide point to obtain an original data set, training a category type feature lifting algorithm, carrying out grid searching to obtain a category type feature lifting algorithm with optimal parameters, carrying out self-adaptive enhancement integration by taking the category type feature lifting algorithm with the optimal parameters as a basic learner by taking the self-adaptive enhancement model as a basic learner to obtain an integrated model, substituting a training set into the integrated model to carry out training simulation, and importing grid points into the trained integrated model to carry out landslide disaster vulnerability assessment, and outputting a landslide disaster vulnerability prediction graph.

title_en: Pedestrian flow composition proportion prediction method based on time sequence fluctuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pedestrian flow composition proportion prediction method based on time sequence fluctuation, which comprises the steps of 1, collecting and processing real scene data, 2, simulating pedestrian flows by combining the real collected data to obtain simulated pedestrian flow sequences corresponding to different types of pedestrians, 3, extracting characteristics of the simulated pedestrian flow sequences and determining a judgment threshold value of the simulated pedestrian flow sequences, 4, obtaining the fluctuation sequence of the pedestrian flow and predicting the pedestrian flow composition proportion according to the judgment threshold value. The invention can predict the composition proportion of pedestrian flow according to the fluctuation sequence of actual pedestrian flow and the characteristics of the simulated pedestrian flow sequence, and intelligently manage and control traffic signals, road resources and the like according to the types and behavior characteristics of pedestrians, thereby providing a new solution idea for optimizing traffic management, dredging, emergency response and the like.

title_en: Coal mine multi-scale stress field joint monitoring and coupling analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine multi-scale stress field joint monitoring and coupling analysis method, which relates to the technical field of underground engineering dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning, and comprises the steps of obtaining a mine scale stress field through numerical simulation; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a mining area and a mining working face scale stress field based on microseismic monitoring inversion calculation, arranging an electroshock vector monitor on a stoping working face and a tunneling working face, obtaining a roadway surrounding rock scale stress field according to a monitored vector electromagnetic radiation characteristic signal, arranging a stress monitoring system on the roadway wall surface, collecting stress of local points of a typical position of the roadway, synthesizing simulation or test results of different scale stress fields, obtaining a mine multi-scale fusion stress field through calculation, and judging and accurately dividing a mining area surrounding rock stress concentration area according to multi-scale fusion stress field distribution characteristics. The method is beneficial to improving the identification precision and efficiency of the stress field, and has important application value for monitoring and early warning of underground engineering dynamic disasters such as coal mines.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for air conditioning system based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for an air conditioning system based on the Internet of things technology. And then, performing simulation analysis through a cloud digital twin model to generate performance prediction and fault point evaluation, and evaluating the fault probability by using a Bayesian network algorithm to generate personalized operation and maintenance suggestions. And then, optimizing operation parameters by adopting a genetic algorithm, and smoothly adjusting settings by adopting an adaptive control theory. When an abnormality is detected, the severity of the fault is judged by utilizing a multi-level threshold and fuzzy logic, an early warning mechanism is triggered immediately, and an emergency response scheme is pushed. And finally, recording maintenance process and user feedback, updating the digital twin model, forming a closed-loop operation and maintenance system, and ensuring high-efficiency stable operation and service quality improvement.
assignees: TIANJIN QINGYUAN ELECTROMECHANICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine underground coal seam gas extraction and drilling integrated device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated device for gas extraction and drilling of a coal seam in a coal mine, which relates to the technical field of gas disaster prevention and control in the coal mine, and comprises a bottom plate, wherein the middle part of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a mud blocking ring, the four sides of the bottom plate are fixedly connected with hinge seats, the hinge seats are rotatably connected with side plates, the mounting hole has been seted up on the curb plate, the top surface middle part position fixedly connected with cardboard of curb plate, the four corners position fixedly connected with bracing piece of bottom plate, the top fixed connection of bracing piece is on the butt joint seat, the one end fixed connection of butt joint seat is on solid fixed ring. The invention has reasonable structure, the side plate is perforated by the butt joint assembly, the bottom plate is conveniently and integrally fixed on the ground, and then the gas pipeline is conveniently and directly butt-jointed with the square head after the perforation is finished by the cooperation of the perforation assembly and the positioning assembly, so that the working efficiency is improved.
assignees: HUANGLING ERHAO COAL MINE CO LTD;XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Software defect prediction feature selection method based on improved beluga optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a software defect prediction feature selection method based on an improved beluga optimization algorithm, which comprises the steps of obtaining traditional features of a single file of a folder in which a software source code to be predicted is located to form a data set, preprocessing the data set of the software to be predicted, dividing the preprocessed data set of the software to be predicted into a test set and a training set according to a proportion, training by adopting the improved beluga optimization algorithm based on training set data, screening out the traditional features corresponding to the software source code file to be predicted, and adopting the screened traditional features to realize the prediction of the defect number of the software source code to be predicted based on the test set data. The method can effectively reduce the data dimension, reduce the calculation complexity, and avoid the problem of dimension disaster caused by redundant features, thereby improving the generalization capability and the prediction precision of the model.

title_en: Fire-burning fire-fighting training device for aircraft landing gear
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model relates to the technical field of aviation simulation training equipment, in particular to a fire-fighting and fire-extinguishing training device for fire of an aircraft landing gear, which comprises a landing gear, a tire arranged on the landing gear and an ignition simulation mechanism. The ignition simulation mechanism comprises an ignition simulation assembly and a fuming simulation assembly, wherein the ignition simulation assembly is arranged in the tire, and the fuming simulation assembly is arranged beside the landing gear. The utility model can simulate the state of real fire burning of the aircraft landing gear in fire-fighting training, thereby greatly improving the training effect of rapidly disposing the fire of the aircraft landing gear by airport firefighters.
assignees: CHINA AVIATION EDUCATION TECH INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Building fire control and real device of instructing of safe evacuation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building fire-fighting and safe evacuation training device, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting training equipment and comprises a fan, wherein the fan is arranged in different areas of each floor of a fire-fighting training building, the fan is provided with a plurality of air outlets, the air outlets are respectively and fixedly connected with a main connecting pipe, the other end of the main connecting pipe extends to a fire area designed in the training building, the other end of the main connecting pipe is fixedly connected with a gas splitter, the gas splitter is fixedly connected with a fixing frame through a connecting pipe, the top of the fixing frame is provided with an opening convenient for air flow to overflow, the opening of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with red gauze used for blowing a simulated fire source by air flow, the surface of the red gauze is provided with a colorant, the gas splitter is also fixedly connected with a smoke machine used for simulating fire smoke through a connecting pipe, the output end of the smoke machine is provided with a pigment box, and natural nontoxic pigment is placed in the pigment box.
assignees: SHANDONG YINGXIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ignition device for firefighter real fire simulation training facility
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ignition device for a fire fighter real fire simulation training facility, wherein an oil supply pipe is positioned at one side of a high-energy ignition gun, an atomization nozzle is arranged at the same end of the oil supply pipe as the ignition end of the high-energy ignition gun, the high-energy ignition gun generates high-voltage electric sparks, the atomization nozzle sprays atomized diesel oil, a three-way pipe and a seamless steel pipe are arranged at the outer sides of the oil supply pipe and the high-energy ignition gun, the three-way pipe is communicated with the seamless steel pipe, a positioning plate is arranged in the seamless steel pipe, an air vent is arranged at the outer sides of the oil supply pipe and the high-energy ignition gun on the positioning plate, an air pipe connecting pipe communicated with the three-way pipe is arranged at the side surface of the three-way pipe, a sealing plate is arranged at the end of the three-way pipe, which is separated from the seamless steel pipe, an elbow pipe communicated with the three-way pipe is arranged at the end of the three-way pipe, and a controller adopts a PLC. The ignition device has the advantages of no need of open fire ignition, safe use and convenient control.

title_en: Civil aviation emergency desktop deduction matched communication property simulation exercise system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency response exercise, and discloses a civil aviation emergency desktop deduction matched communication property simulation exercise system, which comprises a simulation mobile phone which is configured by each exercise personnel and used for private communication between two exercise personnel, a simulation interphone which is configured for public communication between all exercise personnel and a simulation earphone which is worn by exercise personnel at different positions, wherein a convenient and intelligent emergency exercise solution is provided for users, management of different sounds and matching of events related to working positions are realized through voice control and multi-source sound receiving, dialogue communication in the exercise process is converted into characters, a document is formed by a time node for accurate evaluation and comprehensive multi-disc after exercise by the users, and the combined simulation equipment is used for simulating different field conditions of different departments.
assignees: OPERATION MONITORING CENTER CIVIL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION OF CHINA

title_en: Real-time monitoring method for marine stratum activities
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine stratum activity monitoring, in particular to a real-time marine stratum activity monitoring method which mainly comprises the steps of forming a distributed optical fiber acoustic wave sensing monitoring system based on an existing communication optical cable at the bottom of a sea and connected with a land demodulator, carrying out time-space uninterrupted continuous observation on marine stratum activity signals, training a deep learning algorithm to realize efficient and accurate pickup of the marine stratum activity DAS monitoring signals, developing a DAS positioning algorithm to accurately obtain the spatial accurate position of underwater vibration signals, and constructing a time-space-frequency-strong association relation of the marine stratum activity by combining a time-frequency analysis technology to explore the evolution law of the marine stratum activity. The method improves reliability and decision capability of marine geological disaster risk assessment, and provides important support for sustainable development and utilization of future marine resources.

title_en: Digital twin model and method of coal mine disaster scene based on multi-modal data
