abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin model of a coal mine disaster scene based on multi-mode data and a method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting original data in a mine; the method comprises the steps of cleaning, normalizing and denoising original data, fusing different types of preprocessed original data by using a data fusion algorithm to construct a comprehensive digital twin model, establishing a virtual mirror image of a mine by using a digital twin technology, mapping the mine in the real world into the digital twin model, carrying out real-time mapping and simulation analysis based on the established digital twin model, predicting disaster development trend by monitoring the internal environment and equipment state of the mine, optimizing prevention and control measures of the coal mine disaster according to the analysis result of the model, establishing a real-time monitoring and early warning system of the disaster, finding abnormal conditions, and timely taking measures. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a model construction module and a model analysis module. The invention can improve the pertinence and the effectiveness of the disaster prevention and control of the coal mine.
assignees: SHAANXI HUADIAN YUHENG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD;HUADIAN COAL INDUSTRY GROUP SHUZHI TECH CO LTD;CHINA ACADEMY SAFETY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Pipeline slope water damage weather early warning method and system based on slope unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline slope water damage weather early warning method and system based on a slope unit, and relates to the technical field of slope early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining digital elevation model data, soil data and real-time rainfall data of a slope to be early warned; the method comprises the steps of carrying out resampling on the digital elevation model data, determining a dividing result of a slope to be pre-warned according to resampling results and combining the soil data and the real-time rainfall data, carrying out susceptibility evaluation on the slope to be pre-warned according to the dividing result through a pre-training model to obtain susceptibility scores, and determining a pre-warning result of the slope to be pre-warned according to the susceptibility scores. The invention not only clearly reflects the physical relation formed by the geological environment factors and the geological disasters, but also predicts the clear warning objects, and is in accordance with the actual emergency response work, so that the water damage ground disaster prevention work is reasonably transited from surface to point.
assignees: NAT PETROLEUM PIPELINE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD;STATE GRID GROUP ZHEJIANG NATURAL GAS PIPE NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system for mine geological environment
abstract_en: An intelligent monitoring and early warning method for a mine geological environment relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and comprises the following steps: step 1: dividing monitoring points and collecting historical geological data, historical environmental data and historical meteorological data of a mine, and step 2: preprocessing and summarizing data, preprocessing and extracting features, and step 3: training an early warning model and deploying, and step 4: the system comprises an information collection module, an edge calculation module, a model training module and an alarm module, wherein the information collection module is used for collecting monitoring point data, constructing an early warning model, determining the power consumption of the monitoring point according to the result of the early warning model, and simultaneously transmitting alarm information to the outside, so that the prediction of mine geological disasters is realized, the accuracy of the prediction result is improved, the power consumption of the monitoring point is controlled, the service life of the monitoring point is prolonged, and the stability of the monitoring system is promoted.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on big data
abstract_en: The application provides a geological disaster prediction method, a device, equipment and a medium based on big data, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster prediction and comprise a preset geological disaster prediction model obtained by performing model training based on acquired current remote sensing image data, weather rainfall data and geographic information data of a region to be predicted and according to historical remote sensing image data, historical weather rainfall data and historical geographic information data corresponding to sample points in the region to be predicted, the predicted geological disaster risk points in the to-be-predicted area are obtained, and geological disaster risk early warning prompt information is generated and output, so that geological disaster early warning prediction calculation of the whole monitoring area is realized, and accuracy and timeliness of geological disaster monitoring and early warning are greatly improved.
assignees: HEFEI INZYME INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power plant fire alarm response method and device based on three-dimensional engine and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional engine-based nuclear power plant fire alarm response method, a device and electronic equipment, which comprise the following steps of obtaining site environment information of a nuclear power plant; the method comprises the steps of constructing an initial three-dimensional model by adopting a three-dimensional engine method according to field environment information, integrating field fire-fighting equipment information into the initial three-dimensional model to obtain a composite three-dimensional model, judging whether a fire condition occurs according to real-time fire-fighting monitoring information, and if so, generating a visual guiding strategy according to the real-time environment information and the real-time fire-fighting equipment information of a nuclear power plant field. The system can automatically start an emergency plan once abnormal parameters are detected, simulate a fire scene through a domestic three-dimensional engine and provide visual evacuation paths and a fire extinguishing scheme for field personnel.
assignees: Yangjiang nuclear power co ltd;CGN SHANGHAI SIMULATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual-real-step checking device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire control simulation training equipment, in particular to a virtual and actual step assessment device, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a lifting device is arranged on the bottom plate, a mounting plate is arranged at a movable part of the lifting device, at least one supporting plate is arranged above the mounting plate, a plurality of pressure sensors are arranged on the lower side of the supporting plate in a scattered manner, a plurality of supporting columns are arranged under each supporting plate in a scattered manner, the supporting columns are opposite to the pressure sensors one by one, the lower ends of the supporting columns are fixed on the mounting plate, and the upper ends of the supporting columns are supported below pressure points of the pressure sensors. The device solves the problem of training and checking the virtual and real steps of the firefighter in daily training.

title_en: High-pressure large-caliber natural gas pipeline jet fire heat radiation testing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-pressure large-caliber natural gas pipeline injection fire heat radiation test method and a system, which belong to the technical field of fuel gas transportation safety, the high-pressure large-caliber natural gas pipeline injection fire heat radiation test method obtains a first position by combining factors such as the size of a natural gas pipeline, leakage points, wind speed and wind direction and the like to obtain a rough flame form, the second position is obtained by further considering the inclination condition of the flame on the basis, and finally, the uncovered third position is further screened by analyzing the historical simulation data, so that the efficient and accurate sensor arrangement is realized, the number of the sensor arrangements can be reduced, the arrangement precision is improved, the heat radiation generated by the flame can be comprehensively monitored, and the safety and the emergency response efficiency are improved.

title_en: Fire alarm method and system for building engineering
abstract_en: The application provides a fire alarming method and a system for construction engineering, which are characterized in that effective data extraction is carried out on smoke concentration data corresponding to different construction areas in a construction building to obtain a plurality of effective smoke concentrations, gradient difference characteristics of the smoke concentrations of each construction area at different moments are determined, a smoke diffusion interference analysis is carried out on the construction building when a fire disaster occurs in the construction building by combining weather conditions of the construction building area through a smoke diffusion model, then interference simulation quantities of smoke diffusion when the fire disaster occurs in the different construction areas are obtained, fire alarming values of the different construction areas are determined according to the gradient difference characteristics of the smoke concentrations of each construction area at different moments and the interference simulation quantities of each construction area, and confidence positions of fire disaster areas in the construction building are output to a fire control center based on the fire alarming values of each construction area. By adopting the scheme of the application, the confidence location of the fire disaster area can be realized under the condition that the fire monitor is destroyed.

title_en: Substation early warning method based on flood disaster risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster early warning of electric power facilities, in particular to a transformer substation early warning method based on flood disaster risk, which comprises the steps of obtaining transformer substation information, obtaining river basin information and topography information in a preset range around a transformer substation, obtaining historical precipitation information of the past 20 years or more every day or hour to construct a transformer substation early warning model, and (3) evaluating the flood disaster risk of the transformer substation by combining real-time soil humidity information, future 24-hour weather forecast data and flood control standards of the transformer substation, and calculating the flooding range and the flooding power equipment of the transformer substation. The invention combines multiple aspects of historical data and real-time data, can simulate and calculate the disaster range and the disaster situation development trend, and early warn the disaster risk of the power grid equipment in advance.
assignees: HANDAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Preparation method of cable insulating material for simulating short-time overtemperature of fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a cable insulating material for simulating short-time overtemperature of a fire disaster. The method comprises the steps of 1, building a multi-physical-field-coupling cable tunnel fire simulation model according to a real cable tunnel, wherein the cable tunnel fire simulation model comprises a cable support, placing target cables on specific layers of the cable support, 2, conducting fire simulation tests on the target cables, drawing simulation temperature curves f  m  (t) of the target cables by using the cable tunnel fire simulation model, 3, building an over-temperature test platform according to the cable tunnel fire simulation model, 4, setting an over-temperature test temperature curve with errors of the simulation temperature curve f  m  (t) within a preset error range for high-temperature processing equipment of the over-temperature test platform, and 5, conducting over-temperature tests on sample cable insulation materials according to the over-temperature test temperature curve to obtain the cable insulation materials with short-time over-temperature of fire. The invention solves the technical problem that the over-temperature cable insulating material conforming to the actual fire situation cannot be accurately prepared.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Road disaster detection method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road disaster detection method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic management and computer vision, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting image data covering various road disaster types, marking data in each image data, and constructing a data sample through each image data marked by the data; training an improved YOLOv model by utilizing a data sample until a loss function of the improved model reaches a preset end condition, determining the improved model with the loss function reaching the preset end condition as a disaster detection model, acquiring an image to be detected of a road surface to be detected, inputting the image to be detected into the disaster detection model for processing, obtaining a disaster detection result of the road surface to be detected, wherein the disaster detection result comprises a disaster type and a disaster position, and solving the problem that the existing method is insufficient in detection precision, robustness and applicability by combining a deep learning technology and an optimization algorithm design.
assignees: CHINACCS CHUANGLI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water conservancy environment risk early warning analysis system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic environment risk early warning analysis system and method based on big data, wherein the system comprises a hydraulic environment information acquisition module, a risk index weight determination module, a hydraulic environment risk analysis module and an early warning module, the early warning analysis method comprises the steps of acquiring hydraulic environment information, determining the weight of a hydraulic environment risk index set based on a hierarchical analysis method to obtain the weight of a hydraulic environment attribute risk index, the weight of a hydraulic environment ecological risk index and the weight of a hydraulic environment health risk index, and early warning the hydraulic environment based on a hydraulic environment attribute risk value, a hydraulic environment ecological risk value and a hydraulic environment public health risk value. The visual decision support system provided by the invention helps a decision maker to intuitively know the situation of a water conservancy environment, makes a scientific and reasonable emergency response strategy, evaluates the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme by simulating the emergency response schemes under different risk scenes, and helps the decision maker to quickly make emergency response measures.

title_en: Freeze-thawing mud flow chained disaster power simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of freeze-thawing mud flow simulation, in particular to a freeze-thawing mud flow chained disaster power simulation method and system. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining regional topography measurement data, carrying out point cloud conversion and three-dimensional modeling, generating a digital topography model, collecting regional meteorological data, extracting features, carrying out multi-source fusion with the digital topography model, forming a data fusion model, identifying freeze thawing critical conditions and locating freeze thawing easy-occurrence regions based on the model, carrying out geological structure calculation and stability analysis on the easy-occurrence regions, generating mud flow risk data, carrying out dynamic change simulation by utilizing the risk data, obtaining simulated mud flow nodes, generating disaster tracks, carrying out disaster risk assessment on the disaster tracks, carrying out emergency early warning treatment based on assessment results, and generating corresponding early warning data. The invention realizes a more accurate freeze-thawing mud flow chained disaster power simulation method.

title_en: Personnel evacuation simulation method and device in building
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a personnel evacuation simulation method and an evacuation simulation device in a building. The method comprises the steps of determining area position data of each area model, pedestrian number data of each exit model and first distance data of a plurality of pedestrians in real time according to building models, generating prediction time data according to exit parameters of the plurality of exit models, the pedestrian number at the exit models and the plurality of first distance data, determining an exit model corresponding to the minimum prediction time data as a target exit model at the current moment, determining real-time simulation speed of each pedestrian according to the characteristic forward distance of each pedestrian at the target exit model, simulating and calculating simulation evacuation time of the pedestrians in the building models under different evacuation paths according to the distances between the pedestrians and the target exit model at the plurality of moments and speed components corresponding to the pedestrians to the target exit model at different moments, and determining the evacuation path corresponding to the minimum value in the simulation evacuation time as the target evacuation path.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF CHINA

title_en: Space simulation method and system for relative humidity field in rainy season
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space simulation method and a space simulation system for a relative humidity field of a rainy season, which comprise the steps of obtaining a relative humidity baseline field of a dry season reference month, a relative humidity baseline field of a year, reference relative humidity of a weather observation site and relative humidity of the month to be simulated, calculating a relative humidity month distance flat baseline field of the reference month, obtaining a relative humidity month distance flat baseline value and a relative humidity year baseline value of the reference month of the weather observation site, calculating a relative humidity distance flat and a distance flat of the reference month of the weather observation site, obtaining a relative humidity distance flat field of the reference month and a non-quaternary wind influence quantity field of the relative humidity distance flat of the month to be simulated, calculating the quaternary wind influence quantity of the relative humidity distance flat of the month to be simulated of the weather site, and obtaining the relative humidity quantity field of the month to be simulated of the rainy season. The invention can improve the application level of the system in the fields of ecology, forestry, agriculture, natural disaster monitoring and early warning and the like.

title_en: Disaster simulation method, device and system for concrete dam lesions
abstract_en: The invention provides a concrete dam lesion catastrophe simulation method, device and system, which are characterized by analyzing and pre-judging influence factors influencing dam safety based on engineering basic information data and combining history experience, providing possible main influence factors of engineering lesion catastrophe, establishing a finite element model, setting lesion catastrophe indexes and grading standards, giving a threshold value of each grade, pre-generating an isolated unit grid model, adopting a finite element method to calculate and analyze to obtain dam deformation, stress and damage calculation results, carrying out dam concrete cracking judgment based on cracking indexes and threshold values, loading and adopting finite element calculation, carrying out local cracking when any dam unit reaches a cracking threshold value, reconstructing a dam body grid, and carrying out iterative calculation by adopting a finite element+DDA method until the dam deformation, stress, damage and cracking results are stable after reconstruction. The invention effectively solves the problems of calculation efficiency, calculation precision and concrete lesion catastrophe simulation.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Measuring device and testing method for human body stress on stairs of flood invasion underground space
abstract_en: The invention relates to a measuring device and a testing method for human body stress on a stairway in an underground space, wherein the device comprises a flood process simulation part, a water flow simulation part and a water flow simulation part, wherein the flood process simulation part is used for simulating flood processes under different water depths and flow rates; the system comprises a ground space, a step simulation part, a human body stress measurement part, a water outlet part and a flood process simulation part, wherein the ground space is used for receiving water, the step simulation part is used for simulating steps of the ground space, the human body stress measurement part is used for measuring the stress of pedestrians in flood under different submerged water depths and submerged flow rates so as to analyze the fluid force and instability risks of the pedestrians in the flood under different walking states, and the water outlet part is used for opening and recycling the water flows of the flood process simulation part and the human body stress measurement part to the flood process simulation part. According to the invention, the water depth and the flow velocity on the stairs are controlled, so that the situation of flood disasters caused by invasion of floodwater in different cities into the underground space is simulated, and the process of fluid acting force on human bodies on the stairs when the floodwater in different flood situations invades the underground space is analyzed by measuring the fluid force on the human body model structure on the stairs.

title_en: Electric power rush repair allocation method under extreme meteorological disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power rush-repair allocation method under extreme meteorological disasters, which comprises the following steps of firstly determining the urgency of disaster points, secondly constructing a power rush-repair allocation model, solving the power rush-repair allocation model again based on an improved NSGA-II algorithm, and finally carrying out calculation simulation on the power rush-repair allocation model. By adopting the power rush-repair allocation method under extreme weather disasters, the invention fully considers the adaptation condition of the capability of the rush-repair personnel and the fault condition of the disaster point, so that the dispatched rush-repair personnel can process the fault problem encountered by the disaster point, a plurality of sets of power rush-repair allocation schemes can be obtained, and a decision maker can select the scheme with the shortest allocation time or the scheme with higher demand satisfaction according to the actual rescue condition.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Fire early warning method and system for subway station
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway station fire early-warning method and a system thereof, relating to the technical field of fire early-warning, comprising the steps of acquiring first information, wherein the first information comprises sensor data; the method comprises the steps of obtaining second information, namely fire level corresponding to sensor data, taking first information as input and second information as output, training and testing a preset prediction model to obtain a fire prediction model, obtaining real-time sensor data of a target station, inputting the real-time sensor data into the trained fire prediction model to conduct fire identification, obtaining a fire level detection result, and conducting fire early warning according to the fire level detection result. According to the invention, the fire disaster level which is likely to happen at the future moment is predicted through the preset prediction model, namely the cyclic neural network model, so that the real-time early warning of the fire disaster event of the subway station is realized, the alarm can be carried out at the initial stage of the fire disaster, the personnel in the station can be evacuated in real time, and the casualties of the personnel and the property are reduced.
assignees: BEIJING MUNICIPAL ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Ground subsidence risk prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground subsidence risk prediction method and a ground subsidence risk prediction system, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining settlement time sequence settlement amount data of a target area, preprocessing the settlement time sequence settlement amount data, inputting the preprocessed data into a pre-training network for optimization training, determining the trained network as a ground settlement prediction model, wherein the ground settlement prediction model is used for predicting the settlement data of the target area and consists of an EMD decomposition layer and a BiLSTM layer which are sequentially connected, and carrying out ground settlement risk assessment according to the predicted settlement data and a preset threshold interval to determine a ground settlement risk prediction result and corresponding disaster prevention measures. The ground subsidence risk prediction method and the ground subsidence risk prediction device can improve ground subsidence risk prediction accuracy.
assignees: HARBIN NATURAL RESOURCES COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY CENTER CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: State and disturbance observer based control method for balance of complicated topography of humanoid robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a state and disturbance observer based method for controlling the balance of a humanoid robot in complex terrain, and belongs to the technical field of robot application. The problem of instability when humanoid robot walks under the complex environment is solved. The technical scheme includes that the method comprises the following steps of 1, building a simplified humanoid robot 'spring-damping' inverted pendulum model, 2, designing a state and disturbance observer, 3, designing a state feedback controller taking a real-time observation object of the state and disturbance observer as input based on the step 2, 4, selecting a proper controller pole and a proper controller observation point, and 5, performing simulation verification of gesture balance control of the humanoid robot under complex terrains. The invention has the beneficial effects that the robot is beneficial to improving the robustness of the robot to interference and the task execution capacity, especially in disaster relief and complex environment operation.

title_en: Device and method for simulating surface runoff and underground pipe hydrodynamic process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for simulating surface runoff and underground pipe hydrodynamic processes, comprises a rainfall system simulation part, a road runoff simulation part, a drainage pipe network simulation part, a water outlet part and a detection system. The invention utilizes the flowmeter, the valve and the variable-frequency water pump to control the water depth and the flow rate of the stepped flow, is supplemented with the rainfall simulation system, can realize the situation of flood disasters of different working conditions including sudden heavy rain, dam-break flood invasion city and urban flood invasion under mixed working conditions, and measures the flow and the flow rate in the ground surface and the pipeline through the detection system so as to simulate and analyze the process from the urban ground surface and the underground pipe network in the process of overflow to the fluid acting force when the street floods under multiple working conditions. The invention adopts the adjustment of the diameters of all levels of pipelines in the pipeline network to control the flood discharge capacity of the pipeline network, controls the pipeline blocking degree by adjusting the opening degree of the gate, and simulates and analyzes the hydrodynamic processes of the junction of the underground pipeline network with different flood discharge capacities and the interactive junction of the ground surface and the underground pipeline network.

title_en: Weather disaster prediction method based on weather typing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather disaster prediction method based on weather typing, which relates to the technical field of weather prediction, and is characterized by comprising the steps of obtaining space weather data of a target area, carrying out three-dimensional processing on the space weather data to obtain training data, obtaining a terrain distribution map of the target area, inputting the training data and the terrain distribution map into a weather prediction model to carry out training to obtain a weather prediction result, determining the weather typing of the target area according to the weather prediction result, and carrying out weather disaster prediction according to the weather typing. The spatial meteorological data of the target area is comprehensively acquired, three-dimensional processing is carried out, and the training data are input into an advanced weather prediction model by combining detailed topographic profile information, so that the prediction capability of the model can be remarkably improved. The process can more accurately determine the weather typing of the target area, further provides powerful support for weather disaster prediction, and effectively enhances the accuracy of prediction.
assignees: SHENZHEN WEIYU ZHITONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide motion simulation method based on motion model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide motion simulation, in particular to a landslide motion simulation method based on a motion model. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining target landslide region data, generating complete topographic feature data through topographic recognition and difference complementation, carrying out topographic analysis on the data, identifying landslide easy occurrence regions, constructing a three-dimensional model, judging critical states, carrying out risk weight calculation, generating a probability distribution set of the landslide easy occurrence regions, carrying out path analysis to obtain an initial motion track and a probability prediction model thereof, constructing a three-dimensional dynamic simulation scene, carrying out iterative analysis, finally generating landslide motion simulation results, and establishing a dynamic risk early warning and emergency response model so as to improve the prevention and control capability of landslide disasters. The invention realizes a more accurate and reliable landslide motion simulation method.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Hydrogen leakage simulation early warning method and device, hydrogen storage system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrogen leakage simulation early warning method, a device, a hydrogen storage system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting explosion parameters corresponding to hydrogen leakage explosion under different preset hazard degrees; according to the explosion parameters, calculating the mass of explosive correspondingly consumed when hydrogen leakage and explosion are carried out, equivalently converting the mass of explosive into hydrogen leakage steam cloud with the same explosion energy, simulating hydrogen leakage diffusion behavior, calculating the hydrogen leakage quantity corresponding to the hydrogen leakage steam cloud, and alarming when the hydrogen leakage reaches the hydrogen leakage quantity. According to the hydrogen leakage quantity simulation method, the hydrogen leakage quantity obtained through the simulation of the hydrogen leakage is compared with the hydrogen leakage quantity corresponding to the hydrogen leakage steam clouds with different preset hazard degrees obtained through conversion, when the hydrogen leakage quantity is the same, the emergency response control strategy of the hydrogen storage system can be further optimized, the distribution characteristics of the hydrogen leakage concentration can be accurately positioned through the simulation of the hydrogen leakage process, and theoretical basis is provided for the layout and ventilation conditions of hydrogen exploration in the hydrogen storage system.
assignees: SHANGHAI FUEL CELL VEHICLE POWERTRAIN CO LTD

title_en: Emergency material reserve dynamic optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management, in particular to an emergency material reserve dynamic optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning, wherein emergency material demand prediction results are obtained through a machine learning algorithm according to disaster scene data and emergency material consumption data of a target electric power facility area; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a risk probability distribution of emergency material reserves based on emergency material demand prediction results through quantification by using a Monte Carlo simulation method, constructing a digital twin model of the emergency material reserves according to the risk probability distribution and multidimensional real-time state information of an emergency material reserve system, introducing a reinforcement learning algorithm into the digital twin model of the emergency material reserves, and obtaining an optimal emergency material reserve strategy through interactive learning. The invention combines the methods of digital twin technology, reinforcement learning algorithm and the like to improve the accuracy and efficiency of emergency material reserve, and can rapidly and accurately provide the required emergency materials, thereby remarkably improving the emergency response capability.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Short-time precipitation prediction model construction method based on PSD-AUnet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-time precipitation prediction model construction method based on PSD-AUnet, which relates to the technical field of weather prediction, and comprises the steps of data preparation, namely collecting CLDAS precipitation data of the past 3 hours, data preprocessing, namely performing time alignment, normalization and data division on original data, model construction, namely constructing a SmaAt-Unet model comprising an encoder, a decoder and an attention mechanism, model optimization, namely integrating a PSD module on the basis of the SmaAt-Unet model to form a PSD-AUnet model, model training, namely training the PSD-AUnet model by using training set data, updating model parameters by minimizing a loss function, and model prediction, namely evaluating the model by using test set data, and outputting a precipitation prediction result of the future 2 hours. The accuracy of precipitation prediction is remarkably improved by introducing an attention mechanism and a PSD module. The method has higher prediction precision and calculation efficiency, and can be widely applied to the fields of weather forecast, disaster prevention and reduction, agricultural production and the like.

title_en: Real-time intelligent disaster early warning method based on multi-mode data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time intelligent disaster early warning method based on multi-modal data, which belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprises the following steps of firstly constructing a multi-modal data platform, secondly obtaining a first training model by utilizing a graph neural network technology and obtaining a second training model by combining a federal learning technology, thirdly integrating the first training model and the second training model to obtain a disaster propagation model, fourthly deploying a response function on edge equipment close to a data source, and fifthly continuously collecting data of actual disaster occurrence, comparing the data with a model prediction result and performing early warning response. According to the disaster identification method, disaster data acquired by multiple data sources are integrated, more data sources can be acquired, the comprehensiveness and accuracy of early warning can be improved, and a disaster identification model is constructed by utilizing a graph neural network and federal learning, so that the generalization capability of the model can be remarkably improved, and the system can cope with various complex and changeable disaster scenes.
assignees: SHAANXI PUBLIC INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Domain name malicious software treatment method of sky eye monitoring platform and monitoring system applied by same
abstract_en: The method for disposing the domain name malicious software of the sky-eye monitoring platform comprises six steps, wherein a monitoring system for disposing the domain name malicious software of the sky-eye monitoring platform comprises a malicious domain name creation module, a malicious domain name analysis module, a malicious domain name monitoring module, a malicious domain name disposal module and an automatic prompt module which are arranged in a PC (personal computer) end matched with the sky-eye monitoring platform. According to the invention, under the combined actions of the malicious domain name creation module, the malicious domain name analysis module, the malicious domain name monitoring module, the malicious domain name disposal module, the automatic prompt module software unit and the corresponding methods, the working efficiency of finding and processing malicious domain name software of the sky eye monitoring platform is greatly improved through the arrangement and storage of the early management data, the dynamic association of the monitoring results, the linkage of the network access management system and the like, the safety protection level of the control system is improved, and a great effect is exerted in the work of the emergency response of the lux virus, the attack and defense exercise of information safety and the like.
assignees: ZIGONG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Metal heater type outdoor fire pipe freeze preventing apparatus
title_ko: 메탈히터방식의 옥외소방배관 동파방지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a metal heater type outdoor fire pipe freeze prevention device. The metal heater type outdoor fire pipe freeze prevention device comprises: a pipe provided with a heat insulating material on the outside; a plurality of metal heaters coupled to a lower end of the pipe along the longitudinal direction of the pipe and disposed according to a preset metal heater interval; a temperature sensor for measuring the outside air temperature of the pipe; a control unit for controlling the plurality of metal heaters to operate under a preset temperature condition; and an artificial intelligence learning unit for training a deep neural network (DNN) model using a training dataset including a pipe diameter, a heat insulating material thickness, the outside air temperature, and an internal fluid temperature under the control of the control unit, and providing a metal heater interval for the plurality of metal heaters to be set by the output of the DNN model. Accordingly, the installation interval of the plurality of metal heaters can be determined through the artificial intelligence model, and maintenance costs can be efficiently reduced through the optimal installation of the plurality of metal heaters.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 메탈히터방식의 옥외소방배관 동파방지장치에 관한 것으로, 외부에 보온재가 구비되는 배관; 상기 배관의 길이방향을 따라 상기 배관의 하단부에 결합되되, 기 설정된 메탈히터간격에 따라 배치되는 복수의 메탈히터; 상기 배관의 외기온도를 측정하는 온도센서; 및 상기 복수의 메탈히터를 기 설정된 온도조건으로 동작하도록 제어하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 배관직경, 보온재두께, 상기 외기온도 및 내부유체온도를 포함하는 학습데이터셋을 이용하여 심층신경망(DNN, deep neural network)모델을 학습시키고, 상기 심층신경망(DNN)모델의 출력으로 상기 복수의 메탈히터에 대한 메탈히터간격을 설정하도록 제공하는 인공지능학습부;를 포함함으로써, 인공지능모델을 통해 복수의 메탈히터의 설치간격을 결정할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 복수의 메탈히터의 최적 설치를 통해 유지보수비용을 효율적으로 감소시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Metal heater type outdoor fire pipe freeze preventing apparatus
title_ko: 메탈히터방식의 옥외소방배관 동파방지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a metal heater-type outdoor fire-fighting pipe freezing prevention device. The metal heater-type outdoor fire-fighting pipe freezing prevention device comprises: a pipe provided with a heat insulating material on the outside; a plurality of metal heaters coupled to a lower end of the pipe along the longitudinal direction of the pipe and disposed at a preset metal heater interval; a temperature sensor for measuring the outside air temperature of the pipe; a control unit for controlling the plurality of metal heaters to operate under a preset temperature condition; and an artificial intelligence learning unit for training a random forest (RF) model using a learning dataset including a pipe diameter, a heat insulating material thickness, the outside air temperature, and an internal fluid temperature under the control of the control unit, and providing output of the random forest (RF) model to set a metal heater interval for the plurality of metal heaters. Accordingly, the installation interval of the plurality of metal heaters can be determined through the artificial intelligence model, and maintenance costs can be efficiently reduced through the optimal installation of the plurality of metal heaters.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 메탈히터방식의 옥외소방배관 동파방지장치에 관한 것으로, 외부에 보온재가 구비되는 배관; 상기 배관의 길이방향을 따라 상기 배관의 하단부에 결합되되, 기 설정된 메탈히터간격에 따라 배치되는 복수의 메탈히터; 상기 배관의 외기온도를 측정하는 온도센서; 및 상기 복수의 메탈히터를 기 설정된 온도조건으로 동작하도록 제어하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 배관직경, 보온재두께, 상기 외기온도 및 내부유체온도를 포함하는 학습데이터셋을 이용하여 랜덤포레스트(RF, Random Forest)모델을 학습시키고, 상기 랜덤포레스트(RF)모델의 출력으로 상기 복수의 메탈히터에 대한 메탈히터간격을 설정하도록 제공하는 인공지능학습부;를 포함함으로써, 인공지능모델을 통해 복수의 메탈히터의 설치간격을 결정할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 복수의 메탈히터의 최적 설치를 통해 유지보수비용을 효율적으로 감소시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Method And Apparatus for Providing Evacuation Safety Simulation And Monitoring
title_ko: 피난안전 시뮬레이션 및 피난안전 모니터링 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device and method for simulating and monitoring an evacuation safety According to one aspect of the present disclosure, provided is the method comprising: a process of storing data for monitoring evacuation safety and simulating evacuation safety; a process of converting the stored data into an input value format for calculating an evacuation required time or an evacuation allowable time; a process of calculating the evacuation required time per unit location and the evacuation allowable time per unit location; and a process of simultaneously outputting monitoring of evacuation safety and simulating of evacuation safety using the evacuation required time per unit location and the evacuation allowable time per unit location, wherein the data for monitoring evacuation safety and simulating evacuation safety comprises any one or more among fire simulation data, IoT complex center data, life safety reference data, evacuee data, and facility data.
abstract_ko:
피난안전 시뮬레이션 및 모니터링 장치 및 방법을 개시한다. 
본 개시의 일 측면에 의하면, 피난안전 모니터링 및 피난안전 시뮬레이션 위한 데이터를 저장하는 과정; 저장된 데이터를 피난소요시간 또는 피난허용시간을 계산하기 위한 입력값 형식으로 변환하는 과정; 단위 위치별 피난소요시간 및 단위 위치별 피난허용시간을 계산하는 과정; 및 상기 단위 위치별 피난소요시간 및 단위 위치별 피난허용시간을 이용하여 피난안전 모니터링 및 피난안전 시뮬레이션을 동시에 출력하는 과정을 포함하되, 상기 피난안전 모니터링 및 피난안전 시뮬레이션 위한 데이터는 화재시뮬레이션 데이터, IoT복합센터데이터, 인명안전기준 데이터, 대피자 데이터 및 시설물 데이터 중 어느 하나 이상을 포함하는 것인, 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Light-weight fire hazard multi-target detection method in electric power environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light-weight fire hazard multi-target detection method in an electric power environment, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a light-weight fire hazard multi-target detection data set in the electric power environment, S2, obtaining an improved RT-DETR model by improving a preset RT-DETR model, S3, training the improved RT-DETR model by using the data set, optimizing model parameters by using an improved loss function, and obtaining the light-weight fire hazard multi-target detection model in the electric power environment, and S4, carrying out multi-target detection by using the light-weight fire hazard multi-target detection model in the electric power environment. The invention realizes high-precision multi-target detection of disaster hidden danger.

title_en: Test method of automatic driving solid-state laser radar sensing algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test method of an automatic driving solid-state laser radar sensing algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of automatic driving and is technically characterized by comprising the following steps of constructing a multi-scene simulation test environment comprising different road types, weather conditions, obstacle types and traffic scenes, collecting multi-dimensional data and accurately calibrating the multi-dimensional data, evaluating object detection precision, distance estimation errors, instantaneity, robustness and data fusion effect of the sensing algorithm according to set performance indexes, performing emergency response test under a dynamic environment, evaluating real-time response capability of the sensing algorithm, and optimizing and adjusting the sensing algorithm according to test results, wherein the step five has the advantages of ensuring adaptability and reliability of the sensing algorithm under the complex and dynamic environments and promoting safety improvement of the automatic driving technology by simulating different environment conditions, road types, weather conditions and dynamic traffic conditions.
assignees: ANHUI ZHONGKE XINGCHI AUTOMATIC DRIVING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dam disaster point identification method based on improved DeepLabV +
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dam disaster point identification method based on an improvement DeepLabV & lt3+ & gt, which comprises the following steps of Step1, preprocessing data, changing a data set formed by dam images into a network trainable size according to requirements, step2, establishing a dam disaster point identification model based on the improvement DeepLabV & lt3+ & gt, applying a lightweight network MobileNetV & lt 2 & gt in the model, optimizing the expansion rate of a cavity space pyramid pooling module, introducing a channel attention mechanism and a space attention mechanism, and Step3, training by using a dam disaster point identification model based on the improvement DeepLabV & lt3+ & gt, and obtaining a dam disaster point image segmentation result. The algorithm improves the recognition precision of disaster points of the dykes and dams by introducing a self-adaptive attention mechanism, and the feature extraction module in the algorithm adopts specific cavity convolution configuration, so that the capturing capability of small-scale disaster features is enhanced, the decoder structure is improved, more efficient feature fusion is realized, and the accuracy of semantic segmentation is improved.

title_en: Geological disaster comprehensive monitoring and forecasting method based on double-star fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and particularly relates to a geological disaster comprehensive monitoring and forecasting method based on double-star fusion, which comprises the following steps of developing a Beidou reference station, a monitoring station and a high-precision board card to obtain coordinate change data of monitoring points; the method comprises the steps of constructing a 'point-line-plane' three-dimensional monitoring network through BDS/GNSS multiple monitoring points and a reference station networking, fusing Beidou high-precision positioning data and multi-source data and obtaining monitoring point displacement data, quantitatively and finely forecasting short-time near strong rainfall by intelligent grid products, training a strong rainfall radar evolution process of an optimization model by using reverse modeling samples, constructing a multi-dimensional feature vector matrix, extracting important and key features in a multi-factor influence factor data set, and establishing a comprehensive monitoring and forecasting model of the long-term memory artificial neural network on the basis. The method can improve the accuracy and timeliness of geological disaster early warning under the complex geological environment of Guangxi-east Union, and has better market application prospect.

title_en: Corn low-temperature cold damage vulnerability assessment method
abstract_en: A method for evaluating the vulnerability of low-temperature cold damage of corn comprises the steps of firstly, selecting indexes; step two, constructing a cold damage index; the method comprises the steps of identifying cold damage events, simulating growth conditions, establishing a vulnerability curved surface, dividing a key physiological index loss rate by a key physiological index under the cold damage condition after subtracting the key physiological index under the normal condition from the key physiological index, multiplying the key physiological index by hundred percent, selecting indexes capable of representing low-temperature cold damage on different scales from the angle of soil-crop-atmosphere continuum, weighting to form a comprehensive cold damage index, identifying the complete cold damage event according to a run theory, forming a three-dimensional vulnerability curved surface by combining cold damage duration time, representing crop disaster conditions corresponding to different cold damage degrees, and more intuitively and comprehensively describing the cold damage event.

title_en: Karst collapse early warning method based on karst cave roof rock erosion rate
abstract_en: The invention provides a karst collapse early warning method based on karst cave roof rock erosion rate, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning. The karst collapse early warning method based on karst cave roof rock corrosion rate comprises the steps of constructing an underground karst cave simulation model, inputting stratum stress above an underground karst cave into the underground karst cave simulation model to operate, obtaining the state of the underground karst cave roof after a preset time period, determining real-time stress of an overlying stratum of the underground karst cave simulation model when the state of the underground karst cave roof is collapse, and determining a roof thickness critical value of the underground karst cave simulation model based on the real-time stress of the overlying stratum. The method accurately simulates the change condition of the karst cave roof under different conditions, so that the prediction accuracy of potential collapse risks is improved. According to the method, index change conditions on a time sequence are considered, and dynamic monitoring of the karst cave roof state can be achieved.

title_en: Intelligent fusion classification advanced early warning method for major disasters of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fusion classification advanced early warning method for major disasters of a coal mine. Firstly, coal mine safety monitoring data are collected to construct a data set. And secondly, training Anomaly-transducer and E  2  GAN models, and identifying and interpolating abnormal values and missing values in the data to realize data preprocessing. And thirdly, introducing a new multi-index fusion prediction model by combining BiLSTM and MMOE multi-task learning networks, and synchronously predicting future trend of each index after training and optimizing. Then, a AdaTT network is improved to realize a multi-disaster risk fusion early warning model, and the training times and the early warning threshold value are optimized by using the F1 index. And inputting the real-time monitoring and fusion prediction data into an optimized early warning model to obtain the risk probability of each disaster. And finally, combining an optimal early warning threshold value and risk probability, and providing a multi-disaster hierarchical early warning method to realize hierarchical judgment of different disaster risks. The method can effectively early warn disaster risks such as gas, fire, dust, roof and the like, provide risk information in advance, and has important significance for advanced management and control of multiple disaster risks of the coal mine.

title_en: System and method for simulating and monitoring landslide hazard of tower based on unmanned aerial vehicle modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of tower landslide disasters, in particular to a system and a method for simulating and monitoring a tower landslide disaster based on unmanned aerial vehicle modeling. According to the method, the complex terrain around the tower is monitored by unmanned aerial vehicle operation modeling, ground disaster hidden danger identification, three-dimensional monitoring and early warning, hidden danger dynamic prevention and control and other means. Through testing towers under different terrain conditions in a large number, the reliability and the effectiveness of the method are verified, the dependence on hardware in the embedded software testing process is reduced, the comprehensive real-time monitoring of the terrain change is realized, and the landslide signs are accurately identified. The invention obviously improves the monitoring and early warning capability of the landslide hazard of the pole tower and provides powerful guarantee for the safe and stable operation of the power system.

title_en: Water and soil loss intelligent monitoring system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water and soil monitoring, in particular to an intelligent water and soil loss monitoring system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a ground surface remote sensing image data acquisition module, a remote sensing image data acquisition module and a data processing module, wherein the remote sensing image data acquisition module acquires remote sensing image data covering a monitoring area through a remote sensing satellite; the disaster tracing module carries out loss path reconstruction based on the remote sensing image data repaired by the perturbation sensing compensation module, simulates a diffusion path of water and soil loss and carries out loss tracing based on the diffusion path. According to the invention, water and soil loss control guidance of a key area is provided, the accuracy and efficiency of water and soil loss tracing are improved, and powerful technical support is provided for source identification and control decision of water and soil loss.
assignees: SOIL AND WATER CONSERVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF SHANXI AGRICULTURAL UNIV SHANXI SOIL AND WATER CON

title_en: Railway geological disaster early warning method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway geological disaster early warning method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product. A railway geological disaster early warning method comprises the steps of obtaining a railway scene picture and a prompt word text pair, training a multi-mode large model according to the railway scene picture and the prompt word text pair to obtain a railway geological disaster recognition model, recognizing the railway geological disaster according to the railway geological disaster recognition model and a real-time railway scene picture, and carrying out early warning when the railway geological disaster is recognized. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention skillfully converts the disaster detection problem into the scene understanding problem of unlimited categories, and well realizes the accurate early warning of railway geological disasters.
assignees: BEIJING JIAXUN FEIHONG ELEC CO LTD

title_en: Video data driven tunnel fire detection and simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting and simulating tunnel fire disaster driven by video data, belongs to the technical field of computer vision and machine learning, and solves the problems that a current tunnel fire disaster target detection algorithm is easy to cause insufficient distinguishing capability of vehicles and flames in a complex multi-target scene environment. According to the method, an obtained original dataset is preprocessed to obtain a YOLOv neural network model with improved training of a target dataset, target detection is carried out on disaster images of a tunnel fire scene to be detected to obtain central coordinates of each primary disaster object target, the corrected disaster objects are corrected by adopting a monocular vision positioning method, position calibration and distinction are carried out on the corrected disaster objects after correction, then real-time scene twinning modeling is carried out, and then a tunnel fire scene twinning model is obtained and dynamically updated, and flame spread analysis is carried out on the tunnel fire scene based on the tunnel fire scene twinning model and dynamic updating is realized in un ity. The invention is used for detecting and simulating tunnel fire disaster driven by video data.

title_en: Delivery configuration method and system for medical air transport
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource conveying configuration, and discloses a conveying configuration method and a conveying configuration system for medical air transport, wherein user data and resource data are acquired through a scene modeling module, a task scene model is constructed, and a foundation is provided for subsequent decision making; the simulation deduction module is used for carrying out simulation deduction according to the task scene model and the selected post-delivery scheme, simulating the process of medical air transportation and visually detecting deduction data in the simulation deduction process, and the decision evaluation module is used for evaluating the deduction data obtained by visual detection after the simulation deduction is finished so as to optimize the post-delivery decision strategy, so that a conveying configuration system can quickly and effectively respond when actually coping with the post-delivery scene of the medical air transportation of the batch of sick and wounded in the war, and the emergency response capability of the conveying configuration system is improved.
assignees: AIR FORCE HOSPITAL OF PLA EASTERN THEATER COMMAND

title_en: Industrial firewall isolation method of DCS system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial firewall isolation method of a DCS system. Aims to solve the problem that the existing industrial network safety protection aims at the DCS system to be insufficient. The method comprises the steps of analyzing a DCS system architecture and evaluating risks, accurately determining protection key points and data flow directions, customizing firewall strategies which are attached to the characteristics of all areas (such as a core control unit, an operation station and an external network interface), and covering multiple data encryption mechanisms. And then performing firewall deployment and configuration optimization to ensure protection continuity and rule timeliness. The system recovery under the security event is ensured by a real-time monitoring and dynamic adjusting mechanism to timely cope with the abnormality and an emergency response and backup recovery mechanism. And a periodic safety exercise and evaluation mechanism is provided for continuously enhancing the protection capability. The invention comprehensively improves the network security level of the DCS system, ensures the stable and safe operation of industrial production, and has remarkable practical value.
assignees: YUHENG POWER STATION OF SHAANXI HUADIAN YUHENG COAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Hidden lifting target drone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hidden lifting type target drone, which comprises a target, a target frame, a lifting support, a shock wave sensor, a sensor seat, a shell and a lifting assembly, wherein the lifting assembly is arranged in the shell, the target is arranged on the front side of the shell, the target frame is arranged at the bottom of the target and is connected with the lifting support, the sensor seat is arranged in the target frame, the shock wave sensor is arranged on the sensor seat, and the lifting support is in transmission connection with the lifting assembly. According to the hidden lifting target drone, the shock wave sensor is arranged in the target frame, so that the shock wave sensor is free from the interference of external factors, the anti-interference performance and the accuracy of the shock wave sensor are improved, and the lifting assembly is driven in a combined mode of the screw and the guide rail, so that the target frame is more durable and stable, the capability of coping with sudden disaster climates is improved, and the training task is better assisted by troops.
assignees: QINGDAO SHENQIANGSHOU ELECTRONIC ENG CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional climbing training building structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional climbing training building structure which comprises a main body frame, wherein a lifting rescue area and a ladder stand area are respectively arranged on the main body frame, a stair component is arranged on one side of the main body frame, the lifting rescue area is arranged on the outer side of the main body frame and is close to the stair component, the lifting rescue area is provided with a lifting component, the lifting component comprises a first support frame and lifting equipment arranged on the first support frame, the lifting equipment extends to the outer side of the main body frame through the first support frame, the ladder stand area is provided with a first ladder stand and a second ladder stand, the first ladder stand is arranged on one side of the main body frame close to the stair component, and the second ladder stand is arranged on the other side of the main body frame far away from the stair component. According to the utility model, the lifting rescue area and the ladder stand area are arranged on the main body frame, and the proficiency of firefighters in climbing operation is improved by utilizing the structural structures of the lifting rescue area and the ladder stand area.
assignees: HUNAN MEIHAO MINGTIAN SAFETY EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data driving enhancement optimization solving method for safety constraint unit combination problem
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data-driven enhanced optimization solving method for a safety constraint unit combination problem of an electric power system, which comprises the steps of constructing a safety constraint unit combination problem model of the electric power system, collecting historical operation load data of the electric power system, constructing a confidence data set by using a Turing statistical method, dividing the confidence data set into a training set and a verification set according to a proportion, constructing a neural network model, inputting the training set and the verification set for network training, taking new load data of the electric power system as input, utilizing a multi-layer neural network as a classifier, predicting a logic strategy of the unit operation on line, converting a SCUC problem into a continuous convex optimization problem by eliminating integer variables, and sequencing a plurality of candidate integer solutions, thereby simplifying the feasibility of the optimized model and realizing quick on-line solving. The invention can provide high-quality approximate optimal solution, has high solving speed and strong expandability. The dispatching optimization of the high-efficiency power system can be realized, and the peak shaving capacity and the emergency response capacity of the power grid can be enhanced.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Candidate site determining method and computer equipment for radioactive waste disposal library
abstract_en: The application discloses a candidate site determining method and computer equipment of a radioactive waste disposal library, and relates to the field of radioactive waste management, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out preliminary evaluation on potential geological disasters caused by earthquakes in a research area section, carrying out remote sensing geological interpretation on the research area section, and screening primary selected rock masses; the method comprises the steps of carrying out geological investigation on initially selected rock to generate lithology and fracture surface distribution range of granite, carrying out ground geophysical comprehensive detection on the initially selected rock to determine fracture distribution characteristics and rock morphology scale characteristics of the rock, carrying out drilling investigation and drilling geological characteristic research on the initially selected rock to determine fracture deep characteristics, rock deep integrity and rock deep lithology distribution characteristics, constructing a rock geological model, screening the rock with optimal geological conditions in the granite, and taking the rock as a candidate site of a radioactive waste disposal library.

title_en: Ground disaster monitoring and early warning system and method based on multi-source fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic monitoring and early warning, in particular to a ground disaster monitoring and early warning system and method based on multi-source fusion, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a background service module, a ground disaster early warning module, an early warning issuing module and a data visualization module, firstly, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring GNSS displacement data, sensor data and meteorological product data, and integrating various data for ground disaster monitoring and early warning. Secondly, a ground disaster early warning module capable of flexibly replacing an early warning algorithm model is designed, the module utilizes historical monitoring data to train the model, two optimal model files and two optimal parameter files generated by training are used for realizing quick modeling and displacement prediction, if the predicted displacement exceeds a threshold value, a predicted value and an early warning result are processed into a fixed JSON format and sent to RabbitMQ, and the data are consumed by an early warning issuing module. The early warning release module splices the notification content and sends the notification content to the contact person in a mode designated by the configuration information.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH;NANNING GUIDIAN ELECTRONIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Debris flow scale estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow scale estimation method which comprises the steps of obtaining relevant information of a to-be-estimated river basin, printing to obtain a 3D printing model of the to-be-estimated river basin, scanning a blank slope on the 3D printing model to obtain a three-dimensional point cloud, converting the three-dimensional point cloud into a terrain of an original non-paved material source, paving a corresponding soil body on the 3D printing model to simulate the condition of the material source, performing early precipitation on the 3D printing model paved with the corresponding soil body and recording precipitation to a natural water content, simulating a real precipitation process on the 3D printing model to obtain the total amount of simulated debris flow solid matters, scanning to obtain a DEM after disasters, amplifying the total amount of the debris flow solid matters to the power of x to the power of three, amplifying the DEM after disasters minus the three power of x to the power of three power of x to serve as an upper limit, and obtaining the estimated debris flow scale. The invention simulates the whole process from precipitation to debris flow flushing on the terrain which is more similar to the real terrain, and improves the accuracy of the estimation result.

title_en: Safety inspection and positioning method for oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oil and gas pipeline safety inspection and positioning method which comprises the steps of collecting image data of the surface and surrounding environment of an oil and gas pipeline, constructing a data set, constructing an original detection model by using a convolutional neural network and a characteristic pyramid network, training the original detection model by using the data set to obtain a final oil and gas pipeline safety detection model, and detecting the oil and gas pipeline in real time and positioning potential safety hazards by using the oil and gas pipeline safety detection model. The invention has remarkable beneficial effects in the aspects of improving the inspection efficiency and accuracy, realizing real-time monitoring and early warning, improving the emergency response capability, reducing the manual inspection risk, intelligently managing and optimizing and the like.

title_en: Public safety risk assessment method for ramp area based on crowd simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public safety risk assessment, in particular to a ramp area public safety risk assessment method based on crowd simulation, which is characterized in that by analyzing the distribution of pedestrians on a ramp, the interaction characteristics of the pedestrians and environmental factors in real time, and constructing a ramp evacuation model, a pedestrian speed heterogeneity rule, a pedestrian ramp interaction rule and a ramp risk assessment model based on the speed-density rule, and assessing risk coefficients in the ramp by using the model, so as to help related personnel assess the risk bearing capacity of the ramp. The invention leads the speed of pedestrians to be restricted by the crowd density by introducing the speed-density based method of the mesoscopic model into the microscopic model, thereby being more in line with the actual situation. The method not only maintains the high precision of the microscopic model, but also improves the calculation efficiency. Through reasonable algorithm design and calculation methods, the invention can rapidly complete real-time simulation in a high-density crowd environment, and reduces calculation load caused by grid refinement.

title_en: Subway tunnel evacuation platform simulation experiment device and experiment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation experiment device and a simulation experiment method for subway tunnel evacuation platforms, which belong to the technical field of rail transit emergency evacuation and comprise a plurality of evacuation platform modules and a plurality of connection modules, wherein the evacuation platform modules and the connection modules are arranged on the outer side of the inner wall of a tunnel, a communication channel is formed in the tunnel, two ends of each evacuation platform module can be communicated with the communication channel through a splicing connection module, and a plurality of telescopic rods are connected to the bottoms of each evacuation platform module and each connection module. The invention can simply, conveniently and quickly construct the complete tunnel evacuation scene comprising the evacuation platform, the communication channel and the connection area of the evacuation platform and the communication channel through the special modularized free combination form. The simulation method is used for carrying out emergency drilling, can reduce difficulty and cost for carrying out emergency evacuation drilling, can obtain corresponding evacuation performance parameters by simulating the scene, can evaluate the safety level of the subway tunnel more truly and accurately, is used for carrying out evacuation platform design parameter demonstration and model selection on a subway line in a design stage, and determines a proper connection area shape system.

title_en: Landslide prediction method and device based on data driving and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide prediction method, device and electronic equipment based on data driving, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining multiple types of historical monitoring data uploaded by geological disaster monitoring equipment, carrying out correlation screening on the multiple types of historical monitoring data to obtain a historical monitoring data set, obtaining a single landslide data set, a similar landslide data set and a mixed landslide data set according to the historical monitoring data set, respectively adopting the single landslide data set, the similar landslide data set and the mixed landslide data set, training to obtain multiple landslide prediction models, selecting a target landslide prediction model from the multiple landslide prediction models according to model evaluation indexes, and carrying out landslide prediction on landslide points by adopting the target landslide prediction model. The method is used for solving the problem that in the related technology, a machine learning model is applied to individual landslide without expanding a trained model to other places, so that the generalization verification of the model is insufficient.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INST;WUHAN INFOEARTH INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Personnel emergency evacuation method and system based on improved vector diagram
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel emergency evacuation method and a system based on an improved vector diagram, belonging to the technical field of emergency simulation; and for each individual in the evacuated crowd, carrying out individual movement based on the established visual field and through continuous perception of a static environment and interaction among the individuals in the crowd so as to complete crowd evacuation. By the method and the system, the information exchange among groups and the perception-feedback process of the groups to the environment are fully considered in the evacuation simulation process, so that the reality of the simulation process is improved.

title_en: Energy storage fire disaster simulation system for simulating fire-fighting sensing signals of energy storage power station
abstract_en: The application relates to an energy storage fire disaster simulation system for simulating fire control sensing signals of an energy storage power station, which comprises a simulation cabin and a sensor unit, wherein a battery support assembly is arranged in the simulation cabin and is movably connected to a wall of the simulation cabin, a plurality of locking structures are arranged on the wall of the simulation cabin, at least one locking structure is connected with the battery support assembly, the battery support assembly is provided with a battery accommodating platform with an adjustable size, and the sensor unit is arranged in the simulation cabin. According to the application, the fire disaster simulation can be carried out aiming at different battery compartment structural designs by adjusting the position of the battery bracket assembly on the wall of the simulation compartment and the size of the battery accommodation platform, specific fire disaster parameters are provided according to actual projects, the targeted design of a fire protection system is facilitated, and the safety level of the battery compartment of the energy storage power station is improved.
assignees: SIWEI ENERGY WUHAN TECH CO LTD;XIEHE WIND POWER INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Source network collaborative planning method and system considering reliability of typhoon and wind power capacity
abstract_en: The invention provides a source network collaborative planning method and system considering the reliability of typhoons and wind power capacity, which are used for simulating typhoons and wind power plants, calculating a line theoretical fault rate by using a line vulnerability curve calculation method under typhoons disasters to obtain the states of all power transmission lines of the system, calculating the output power of a wind power plant unit by using power grid basic information, predicting the output sequence of the wind power plant unit under the typhoons and wind power plants based on the simulated typhoons, obtaining the fault probability of the power transmission lines at all moments, generating a typical fault scene, calculating the wind power trusted capacity according to the states of all the power transmission lines of the system, and constructing a source network collaborative planning model based on the output sequence of the wind power plant unit and the wind power trusted capacity. The method solves the problems that the wind farm machine set output, wind power rotation standby and line reinforcement planning are not involved in typhoon weather, and achieves the purposes of considering the load importance level and energy storage access, coordinating resources in various aspects such as source-network-load-storage and the like during planning.

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method and system for coping with urban storm waterlogging disasters of power distribution system
