abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity assessment method and system for a power distribution system to cope with urban rainstorm and waterlogging disasters, wherein a rainstorm model is built according to rainfall and rainfall processes to obtain time sequence rainfall intensity, a runoff generating model and a converging model are built, a surface water depth change process is determined according to the obtained time sequence rainfall intensity to obtain a surface water depth simulation result, outdoor equipment submerging and indoor equipment submerging processes are simulated based on the surface water depth simulation result to obtain a power distribution system disaster scene and a damaged equipment set, a road network model is built based on the power distribution system disaster scene and the damaged equipment set, a moving resource path problem under urban waterlogging is modeled as a time-dependent vehicle routing problem, a mixed integer linear programming model is built based on the time-dependent vehicle routing problem to serve as a power distribution system response model, elasticity of the power distribution system is quantified by using elasticity measurement indexes, and elasticity assessment of the urban rainstorm and waterlogging disasters is realized based on the obtained elasticity index R  t .
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Rainfall-induced landslide numerical simulation method based on DEM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall-induced landslide numerical simulation method based on a DEM (digital elevation model), which comprises the steps of 1) constructing a fluid grid, giving initial boundary conditions of the grid, 2) building particles and walls in PFC3D by adopting a discrete element method, building a DEM module, 3) building a CFD module by using Python language, calculating by the CFD module to obtain a pressure water head and a pressure gradient force, 4) building a coupling module to exchange data of the CFD module and the DEM module, updating soil contact information, soil moisture content information and particle position information according to the pressure water head, and 5) setting iteration appointed step numbers to obtain simulation results of particle displacement under the rainfall effect. The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster forecast, and relates to a V-G water-holding model for representing the water-soil characteristic relation of unsaturated soil, which can fully consider the decrease of the contact force among soil particles under rainfall condition, so that the simulation is more accurate.

title_en: Train emergency treatment test method and device under fire condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a train emergency treatment test method and device under the condition of fire, relates to the technical field of rail transit, and mainly aims to provide a train emergency treatment test method under the condition that a train is in fire at different line positions so as to verify the reliability and safety of the train. The method comprises the main technical scheme of obtaining a pre-configured emergency treatment scheme of a train for a fire disaster, wherein the pre-configured emergency treatment scheme comprises an interval fire disaster emergency treatment scheme and a platform fire disaster emergency treatment scheme, simulating the fire disaster of the train at a target position, testing whether the real-time emergency treatment scheme executed by the train is the interval fire disaster emergency treatment scheme or not when the target position is an interval, and testing whether the real-time emergency treatment scheme executed by the train is the platform fire disaster emergency treatment scheme or not when the target position is a platform. The invention is used for train emergency treatment test under the condition of fire.

title_en: Mailbox personnel evacuation path optimization method for multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mail wheel personnel evacuation path optimization method for multi-agent reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: step one, building a model: establishing a mail wheel evacuation model and setting an evacuation outlet according to a mail wheel design drawing; step two, constructing a plurality of intelligent agents: constructing a plurality of groups of intelligent agents according to the mail wheel evacuation model; step three, fire information perception decision; step four, evacuation action is executed: the personnel intelligent body is divided into a normal motion state and an evacuation state, and the personnel intelligent body is converted into the evacuation state from the normal motion state after the occurrence of a fire disaster is perceived to execute evacuation actions; according to the invention, the human perception capability is simulated by taking the personnel intelligent agent, the fire source intelligent agent, the smoke intelligent agent and the sensor intelligent agent as a model frame, so that the intelligent agents can acquire environmental information, the behaviors among the personnel are presented through dynamic interaction among the intelligent agents, the fire spreading behavior is simulated through the fire source intelligent agent, the influence is caused on the environment and other intelligent agents, and the fire situation is fully simulated.

title_en: Ship dual-fuel power system simulation training method, platform, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a simulation training method, a platform, equipment and a medium for a dual-fuel power system of a ship, and relates to the technical field of simulation training. The system real-time performance simulation module feeds back the running state and running characteristic parameter data of each subsystem of the ship dual-fuel power system in real time through a simulation analysis algorithm, the theoretical cognitive learning module can guide a learner to learn theoretical knowledge of the dual-fuel power system autonomously through a VR/AR simulation interaction method, the system running simulation training module simulates actual ship running operation processes such as dual-fuel filling, storage, supply, use and the like of the learner through a VR/AR simulation mode, the emergency response operation training module is used for training emergency response measures of the crew in emergency, the personnel suitability evaluation module carries out multidirectional suitability evaluation on training personnel through a scientific evaluation algorithm, and the training strategy intelligent recommendation module customizes and generates a learner simulation training scheme intelligently through AI technology according to a learner simulation assessment result.
assignees: SHIPBUILDING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE THE 11TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORA;ZHOUSHAN SHIP ENGINEERING RESEARCH CENTER OF SHANGHAI SHIPBUILDING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Coal mine dust diffusion simulation and control method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine dust diffusion simulation and control method based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the technical field of coal mine dust diffusion simulation and control and comprises the following steps: environmental data such as dust concentration, ventilation flow rate, temperature, humidity and equipment running state are collected through a monitoring system in the coal mine, and cleaning and formatting processing are carried out by combining historical working condition data. The invention utilizes reinforcement learning and virtual extreme scene simulation, improves the recognition and emergency response capability of the system to the edge working condition, effectively reduces dust diffusion and explosion risk, and ensures mine safety. By dynamically adjusting the ventilation and water spraying system, the efficient utilization of resources is realized, the energy consumption and the operation cost are reduced, and the service life of equipment is prolonged. The system has self-adaptive learning capability, can optimize a control strategy according to monitoring data and historical events, can automatically adjust even if the environment changes, improves robustness and flexibility, and reduces manual intervention.

title_en: System for simulating disaster-causing process of fracture activity in different activity modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-causing process simulation system for fracture activity in different activity modes, which comprises a base, a plurality of lifting electric servo jacks, a lower movable plate, an upper movable plate, a test box and a left-right driving device, wherein the lower movable plate is supported on the lifting electric servo jacks in a lifting manner, the upper movable plate is arranged on the lower movable plate in a sliding manner, the test box is suitable for filling test soil proportioning materials and comprises a fixed section, a movable section and a flexible transition section, the fixed section is arranged on the base, the movable section is arranged on the upper movable plate in a sliding manner, the flexible transition section is connected with the fixed section and the movable section, the front-rear driving device is suitable for driving the movable section to move forwards and backwards, and the left-right driving device is suitable for driving the movable section to move leftwards and rightwards. According to the embodiment of the invention, the fracture activity disaster-causing process simulation system under different activity modes can simulate the fracture disaster-causing processes under different fracture activity modes and combination working conditions, and has the advantages of rich functions, strong applicability and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING;SHAANXI GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION SHAANXI PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER CENTER

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based pasture flock detection tracking method and safety early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pasture flock detection tracking method and a safety early warning system based on an unmanned plane, which belong to the technical field of automatic management of animal husbandry and comprise the following steps of S1, data acquisition and pretreatment, S2, detection model construction and training, and S3, flock tracking. The invention greatly expands the monitoring visual field range through the aerial working capability of the unmanned plane platform, reduces the labor cost, improves the monitoring timeliness and accuracy, is beneficial to animal husbandry managers to timely master the flock dynamics and make scientific decisions, can still keep higher recognition rate and tracking stability under complex environments through the proposed target detection model and multi-target tracking algorithm, effectively solves the problems of target shielding and the like, realizes the accurate detection and tracking of flock targets, and can timely find and report missing livestock conditions through the safety early warning system so as to provide powerful emergency response support for animal husbandry managers.

title_en: Intelligent fusion and ocean disaster prediction method and platform for multi-source heterogeneous ocean data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing and discloses a multi-source heterogeneous ocean data intelligent fusion and ocean disaster prediction method and platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out hierarchical deployment and network topology construction on ocean environment monitoring equipment, communication relay equipment and data processing equipment to obtain an ocean-air-shore integrated monitoring network; the method comprises the steps of collecting marine environment data with space-time identification, carrying out marine element modeling and dynamic feature extraction to obtain a marine environment digital model, carrying out feature fusion and association analysis on multi-source heterogeneous marine data to obtain space-time feature data, carrying out training and multi-model integration on a typhoon path prediction model, a storm surge prediction model and a red tide prediction model by adopting a migration learning method to obtain a marine disaster prediction model set, further improving prediction precision and timeliness, optimizing distribution and scheduling of computing resources, and meeting real-time requirements of mass data processing.

title_en: YOLOv8R model-based electric vehicle charging station fire detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire detection method of an electric vehicle charging station based on YOLOv R model, which comprises the steps of acquiring images related to electric vehicle fire, accurately marking flame and smoke characteristics in the collected images by using a marking tool, providing a YOLOv R model, introducing an auxiliary branch based on YOLOv n architecture, calculating the auxiliary branch and a main branch simultaneously with the same priority, and carrying out calculation on the 22 th layer and the 25 th layer The auxiliary branches and the main branches are connected and fused in the module, the YOLOv R model is trained and tested to obtain a YOLOv R flame detection model after training, and an ablation experiment is carried out on the YOLOv R model to carry out performance comparison. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of high detection speed and high identification precision, is particularly suitable for fire detection requirements in complex environments, can effectively reduce fire hidden danger, and improves the safety and emergency response capability of the charging station.

title_en: Electrostatic dust removing device of anchoring drilling machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrostatic dust collection device of an anchoring drilling machine, which relates to the technical field of anchoring drilling machines for geological disaster management construction and comprises a support base, wherein a support upright post is fixed at the top of the support base, a drilling head base is arranged at the top of the support upright post, a handrail is arranged on one side of the drilling head base, a support rod is fixed on one side of the middle part of the support upright post, a servo motor is fixed at one end of the support rod, and a driving gear is fixed at the power output end of the servo motor. This device rotates through starting servo motor, and driven gear drives the flabellum and rotates, and the flabellum rotates inside the air guide cover, inhales inside the dust at air guide cover top, and the flabellum is located drilling head base under for when drilling, the air current that the flabellum rotated and produced is through removable electrostatic precipitator board, and removable electrostatic precipitator board filters the air that has the dust, can further absorb the dust, and the dust that the removal drilling produced reaches the dust fall effect.
assignees: GUANGDONG CHINA COAL GEOLOGICAL ECOLOGICAL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for optimizing evacuation path of personnel in building based on shortest global evacuation time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimizing a personnel evacuation path in a building based on shortest global evacuation time, and relates to the field of optimizing the personnel evacuation path in the building. The method solves the problems that the path optimization method in the prior art can not truly and accurately reflect the influence of crowd crowding on the evacuation process, and the actual situation of crowd evacuation in a crowded state can not be reasonably considered in the path optimization process. The method comprises the steps of generating a corresponding evacuation road network model through a building plan of a case to be analyzed, determining an evacuation personnel distribution scheme, determining a shortest evacuation path scheme, calculating an evacuation simulation result of the scheme to obtain global evacuation time and a group number for finally completing evacuation, determining an optimized evacuation group set according to a bidirectional mobilization strategy, setting an initial optimization scheme, and iteratively optimizing evacuation paths of groups in a first optimization adjustment area and a second optimization adjustment area. And outputting a final optimal evacuation path scheme and a corresponding evacuation process simulation calculation result.

title_en: Intelligent disaster recovery adaptation optimization system based on power big data construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data disaster recovery backup, and particularly discloses an intelligent disaster recovery adaptation optimization system based on power big data construction, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an application calculation, storage and network resource pool in a disaster recovery data center for application disaster recovery deployment, and dividing the application into a class A application, a class B application and a class C application; the method comprises the steps of constructing the same city and different places of a resource pool, constructing the exercise capacity of the resource pool, designing the overall architecture of a disaster recovery management platform, comprehensively testing and verifying each system, network and storage component between a disaster recovery center and a production center through simulating a real environment, evaluating the switching capacity through verifying the compatibility of the systems and checking the consistency of data, and analyzing the problems and defects of the system and the storage component and providing improvement measures through making an exercise plan, simulating a disaster scene, executing switching operation and verifying business continuity to overall evaluation of the exercise process of the disaster recovery management platform.
assignees: DIGITAL RES BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Analysis processing method, device and medium for seabed shallow fluid activity rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for analyzing and processing the activity rate of a seabed shallow fluid, which take the basic theory of fluid kinematics and thermodynamics as guidance, fully exert the parameter advantages of a temperature element, rely on the actual measurement ground temperature data of an offshore stratum with lower acquisition cost by establishing a thermal convection conduction model, combine hydrate phase balance simulation and hydrate stability domain ground temperature data obtained by inversion of a seabed-like reflecting layer, develop the calculation of average ground temperature gradients in the offshore stratum and the hydrate stability domain below the seabed, and finally calculate the vertical migration rate of the seabed shallow fluid by utilizing Bei Kelai (Pe) equation, thereby providing basis for revealing the activity behavior of the seabed shallow fluid and evaluating the potential ecological environment and geological disaster influence. The embodiment of the invention can conveniently and accurately analyze and process the submarine shallow fluid activity rate, and can be widely applied to the technical field of data processing.

title_en: Landslide geological disaster evaluation method, landslide geological disaster evaluation system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disasters, and particularly discloses a landslide geological disaster evaluation method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a plurality of target evaluation factors associated with landslide geological disasters of a target area, constructing a landslide geological disaster evaluation model of the target area based on all the target evaluation factors, and training; and inputting the current geological environment data of the target area into a trained landslide geological disaster evaluation model to obtain a landslide geological disaster evaluation result of the target area. The landslide control method and the landslide control system can accurately predict landslide geological disasters, reduce loss caused by landslide disasters as much as possible, and provide guidance for planning landslide disaster control and improving landslide disaster control capability.
assignees: TECH & ENGINEERING CT FOR SPACE UTILIZATION CAS

title_en: Emergency material transportation network design method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of an emergency material transportation network, and relates to the technical field of emergency material transportation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical disaster data set, constructing a mixed prediction model CNN-MAFP, training the mixed prediction model CNN-MAFP through the historical disaster data set, inputting real-time disaster data of an area to be tested into the trained mixed prediction model CNN-MAFP to obtain a post-disaster emergency demand and road section integrity measuring and calculating function of the area to be tested, and planning a trans-regional network for transporting emergency materials according to the post-disaster emergency demand and road section integrity measuring and calculating function of the area to be tested. The invention does not need to presuppose the distribution or change rule of disaster data, and has higher flexibility and adaptability when processing complex and changeable disaster data.

title_en: County geological disaster risk analysis method and county geological disaster risk analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster analysis and discloses a county geological disaster risk analysis method and system, comprising a slope unit for dividing a geological disaster area, a training set and a testing set are selected from the geological disaster area and a non-geological disaster area by screening vulnerability analysis factors in the slope unit; the method comprises the steps of establishing an initial analysis model of a training set, performing super-parameter optimization on the initial analysis model, outputting an easy-to-develop classification result of the training set by utilizing the optimization analysis model, analyzing classification accuracy of the easy-to-develop classification result, determining an easy-to-develop analysis result of a slope unit, calculating a dangerous index of the slope unit, dividing dangerous partitions in a geological disaster area by utilizing the dangerous index, screening easy-to-develop analysis factors in the slope unit, performing hierarchical analysis on the easy-to-develop analysis factors by utilizing a judgment matrix, and calculating the easy-to-develop index of the slope unit. The invention matches the real geological disaster risk situation by improving the accuracy of the geological disaster analysis result.

title_en: Short circuit simulation test method and system for subway direct current power supply system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system protection and control, in particular relates to a short circuit simulation test method and system of a subway direct current power supply system, and aims to solve the technical problems that the prior art is insufficient in flexibility, difficult to adapt to complex actual working conditions and lack of self-adaptability. The method comprises the steps of presetting various short-circuit fault parameters and adjusting to generate a short-circuit working condition, determining a transient fluctuation separation result based on the short-circuit working condition, constructing a system topology model by utilizing a graph neural network, generating a long-term protection plan by combining an optimized double-Q learning strategy, generating an initial risk assessment result by adopting a neural network based on physical information and Monte Carlo simulation, constructing a hybrid risk assessment model by combining a Bayesian network and fuzzy logic to obtain a target risk assessment result, and generating an emergency response plan by utilizing a natural language generation technology and a planning algorithm based on the target risk assessment result.

title_en: Multi-scale coupling solving method suitable for wind field simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of wind engineering, and provides a multi-scale coupling solving method suitable for wind field simulation. The method aims to solve the problems that in the existing wind field simulation technology, the fluctuation of the wind speed from the ground to the high altitude is large and irregular due to the random characteristic of the wind field, so that the curve fitting function is difficult to accurately simulate the change rule, larger deviation is generated, and the calculation accuracy is seriously affected. According to the invention, the mesoscale weather forecast WRF mode is coupled with the CFD mode, and the lattice point data of the WRF mode is interpolated to the boundary surface grid of the CFD mode by using a distance weighting method to serve as boundary conditions and an initial field, so that the problem of input condition errors caused by nonlinear fitting in the traditional simulation is effectively solved. By the method, high-fidelity data transmission is realized, and accuracy and reliability of wind field simulation under complex terrain conditions are remarkably improved. The method has wide application prospect, and can be used in multiple fields of wind energy resource evaluation, wind disaster early warning, city planning and the like.
assignees: SICHUAN LVNENG ZHISUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pipeline state early warning method and system based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline state early warning method and system based on data driving, and relates to the technical field of environmental engineering, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring first running state data of a pipeline in real time by using a first sensor, preprocessing, extracting the characteristics of the first pipeline state, and triggering an emergency response mechanism by a control system to adjust the pipeline state so as to obtain an adjusted pipeline; after the pipeline is adjusted, second running state data of the pipeline are monitored in real time by using a second sensor and are preprocessed, model training is carried out according to pipeline state early warning requirements and historical pipeline state data, the preprocessed pipeline second running state data are identified by using a trained model, whether the pipeline is in an abnormal state or not is judged according to a state identification result and a preset threshold value, and an emergency response mechanism is started by the control system according to the pipeline state according to early warning information. The invention solves the problems that residual abnormality can not be effectively removed and potential safety hazard is brought to downstream equipment.
assignees: CONTROL LOGIC AUTOMATION SYSTEM ENG SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Toughness improvement-oriented power distribution system emergency power supply and energy storage planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness-improvement-oriented power distribution system emergency power supply and energy storage planning method and system, which belong to the technical field of power system analysis, and comprise a simulation module, an optimization module and a solving module, wherein the optimization module comprises a constraint unit and an optimization unit, and the solving module comprises a solving unit and an output unit; the simulation module simulates the photovoltaic output and the fault situation of the power distribution system through the input historical parameters, the optimization module gathers the system parameters and the data generated by the simulation module, the data in the optimization module are solved by the solving module, and the optimal planning and the output are obtained. By adopting the toughness-improvement-oriented power distribution system emergency power supply and energy storage planning method and system, the single-layer planning is carried out on the power distribution system under the condition of extreme disasters, so that the requirement of important load can be met, and redundant electric energy can be stored.

title_en: Portable nuclear radiation reconnaissance simulation training system and nuclear radiation reconnaissance training method
abstract_en: The application discloses a portable nuclear radiation reconnaissance simulation training system and a nuclear radiation reconnaissance training method, and relates to the technical field of nuclear emergency reconnaissance training. The system comprises an integrated portable control box, wherein the integrated portable control box comprises a control terminal, a communication base station and a power module for supplying power to the control terminal and the communication base station, a virtual hazard environment constructing unit arranged in the control terminal, a portable communication terminal and an intelligent simulation sensing terminal which are arranged in the integrated portable control box, and the nuclear radiation detection training method comprises the steps of estimating hazard scene data through the virtual hazard environment constructing unit, receiving and reporting detection data in real time by the intelligent simulation sensing terminal, and finally completing detection simulation training of a radiation field by combining with communication and positioning technology, wherein three stages of training preparation, implementation and evaluation are covered. The embodiment of the application simulates a realistic nuclear radiation environment, can help a user to train a reconnaissance skill, and improves the emergency response capability of responding to a nuclear radiation event.

title_en: Test device and method for simulating rapid sedimentation to trigger submarine landslide
abstract_en: The invention provides a test device and a method for triggering submarine landslide by simulating rapid sedimentation, and relates to the field of marine geological disaster simulation. The invention has the beneficial effects that the soil particle release module adjusts the height of the deposited soil body in the soil supply box through the push rod motor, and controls the suspension amount of the soil particles of the deposited soil body in the air and the settlement amount of the soil particles in the water through the wind speed of the fan, thereby realizing the uniform distribution and deposition of the sediment on the slope and measuring the sediment deposition rate in real time. The test device also realizes the cooperative measurement of the lateral displacement of the internal linear region of the deposit layer and the water pressure of the super pore. The test device and the test method can be applied to simulating the submarine slope response process under different deposition environments and conditions of deposition physical and mechanical properties, so that the submarine landslide damage instability mechanism is researched.

title_en: Rock drill core sampling equipment for geological disaster investigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses rock drill core sampling equipment for geological disaster investigation, and relates to the technical field of sampling. This rock drill core sampling equipment of geological disaster reconnaissance, through compound mechanism design, the motor is connected the butt joint piece, the inboard drilling rod of pegging graft of butt joint piece, thereby reach and carry out drilling sample to rock, along with the in-process of drilling, it slides in the outside of slip post to remove the support body, thereby go up and down, thereby satisfy the effect of work demand, the outside of drilling rod is provided with the drill bit mechanism, through the in-process of drill bit mechanism at drilling, it is broken to great rock, the inside of drilling rod is entered into to the guide rock piece simultaneously, so that follow-up through removing the support body lifting time take out the sample, so that follow-up processing, after the sample is ended, the sample leads to taking out comparatively loaded down with trivial details and the degree of difficulty higher in the drilling rod inboard, exert pressure to pushing and pressing mechanism through electric putter, thereby reach the effect of discharging the sample, equipment normal operating is kept.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Vertical shaft type urban highway tunnel fire disaster position and scale prediction method based on temperature data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting fire position and scale of a vertical shaft type urban highway tunnel based on temperature data, which comprises the steps of constructing a full-size physical model of the vertical shaft type urban highway tunnel (URTS) based on fire simulation software, and determining geometric parameters of a driving area and a vertical shaft based on actual tunnel size; setting various fire positions and scales in combination with a fire scene, reasonably dividing the grid size, arranging temperature measuring points, carrying out three-dimensional dynamic numerical simulation and obtaining temperature data. After collecting fire temperature data under various working conditions, a database is established and data preprocessing is carried out, and a training set, a verification set and a test set are divided. A long-short-term memory neural network (LSTM) is selected as a prediction model, training and evaluation of the LSTM model are realized through programming, real-time temperature data are input when a fire disaster occurs, the position and the scale of the fire disaster are predicted, and iterative prediction is carried out to obtain the optimal state estimation. And (3) changing the arrangement interval and coverage range of the temperature sensors, and testing and comparing the R  2  values to obtain an optimal arrangement scheme.

title_en: Training method, device, equipment and medium for lightning strike ignition prediction model
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a training method, device, equipment and medium for a lightning strike fire ignition prediction model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multiple groups of training sample sets of a target area in a historical time period, wherein the data quantity of non-ignition case data and ignition case data contained in each group of training sample sets is smaller, each group of training sample sets contains environment data and classification labels of fire disaster occurrence or not, carrying out iterative training on a preset model by utilizing the environment data and the classification labels in each group of training sample sets until the accuracy of the preset model under the current iteration number is the highest, determining the preset model under the current iteration number as a candidate model, and obtaining a model with the highest accuracy from the candidate models determined based on the multiple groups of training sample sets as a lightning strike fire ignition prediction model of the target area. In this way, the problem of uneven numbers of firing cases and non-firing cases is overcome and the method can be adapted to predict lightning strike firing results in areas with complex environmental data.

title_en: Debris flow risk level prediction method and system based on GRA-PCA-RBF neural network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow risk level prediction method and system based on a GRA-PCA-RBF neural network model, which takes a debris flow ditch in a debris flow easy-to-occur area as a research object, collects and analyzes data and data of historical debris flow disasters, determines risk and risk evaluation indexes of the debris flow disasters, analyzes the correlation degree of the debris flow risk and the evaluation indexes by using a gray correlation degree method, selects key evaluation indexes from the risk evaluation indexes, performs dimension reduction treatment on key evaluation index data by using a principal component analysis method, eliminates redundant information of index data, builds an evaluation index system, trains training samples by using an RBF neural network model optimized by a genetic algorithm, builds a debris flow risk level prediction model and estimates the accuracy of the built model. The invention solves the problem of establishing a reasonable and effective mud-rock flow danger method and system in a complicated and difficult mountain area, and provides an efficient working system for disaster prevention and reduction of mountain infrastructure construction.
assignees: NORTHWEST RES INST CO LTD CREC;CHINA RAILWAY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SW SCI & TECH SWUST

title_en: Method and device for monitoring basin flood disasters integrated with space, sky and ground
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geographic information, in particular to an air-to-ground integrated basin flood disaster monitoring method, an air-to-ground integrated basin flood disaster monitoring device and computer equipment, which sequentially carry out unmanned aerial photography and satellite remote sensing flood disaster element simulation on flood disaster element data corresponding to ground monitoring of a basin to be processed based on a constructed deep learning model to construct flood disaster element data corresponding to satellite remote sensing, the characteristics of high ground monitoring precision and time continuity, the characteristics of unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography free from cloud cover influence, flexibility, rapidness and high resolution ratio and the characteristics of large satellite remote sensing coverage, large acquired information quantity, all weather, all-weather and continuous space are fully utilized to obtain the flood disaster element data of time continuity and space continuity, so as to monitor the flood disasters, realize comprehensive, large-range and efficient flood disaster monitoring of the river basin to be treated, meet the flood disaster monitoring requirement and improve the efficiency of flood disaster monitoring.
assignees: GUANGZHOU INST OF GEOGRAPHY GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Urban flood prediction method based on Bayesian convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city flood prediction method based on a Bayesian convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of collecting historical rainfall events of a research area, simulating different rainfall events by using hydrodynamic simulation software to obtain the maximum submerged water depth, selecting characteristic variables which influence the submerged water depth and comprise 10 rainfall characteristic variables and 10 space characteristic variables, constructing a Bayesian convolutional neural network prediction model by considering uncertainty, training the model based on a loss function MAE, inputting verification centralized data into the trained model, and solving an average value of output approximate posterior distribution to serve as a predicted value of the water depth. The method is used for calculating and analyzing the relation between the characteristic variable and the target variable, effectively fusing different data, taking possible uncertainty sources into consideration, not only realizing the prediction of the size and the range of the submerged depth of the research area, but also quantifying the prediction uncertainty, and providing support for real-time flood disaster management.

title_en: Virtual reality evacuation experiment method, system and device based on multi-person online coordination
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of virtual reality, and discloses a virtual reality evacuation experiment method, a system and a device based on online cooperation of multiple people. The method comprises the steps of establishing a virtual reality disaster scene based on a scene template in a preset scene model library, acquiring evacuation experiment data generated by a tested object based on the virtual reality disaster scene displayed by tested equipment after triggering the virtual reality disaster scene to operate, determining the movement and control strategy of the NPC based on the evacuation experiment data and the scene data of the virtual reality disaster scene through each NPC based on the intelligent body model in the virtual reality disaster scene, displaying each NPC in the virtual reality disaster scene displayed by the tested equipment according to the movement and control strategy, and carrying out evacuation experiment with the tested object interactively, so that the problems of low efficiency, poor effect, high cost and uncontrollable risk caused by carrying out the evacuation experiment in the real scene can be avoided, the experiment efficiency and effect are improved, and the experiment cost and risk are reduced.

title_en: Comprehensive Safety Experience Simulator
title_ko: 종합 안전체험 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: A comprehensive safety experience simulator for providing a user with a virtual experience for disaster safety, the simulator comprising: a driving unit (10) located below a boarding unit (20) to adjust a motion and an angle of a boarding plate (21) according to an instruction of an arithmetic control unit (not shown); the boarding unit (20) located above the driving unit (10) and on which the user boards; a safety unit (30) for providing a willingness means to prevent the user stepping on the boarding unit (20) from falling or losing the center; the arithmetic control unit (not shown) for controlling the driving unit (10) to control the motion of the boarding unit (20) in conjunction with a screened virtual reality image (f); a screening unit (60) for visually screening the virtual reality image (f) related to disaster safety to the user located on the boarding unit (20); and a special effect unit (70) disposed on a main way of the boarding unit (20) to assist in actual situation presentation according to the instruction of the arithmetic control unit (not shown) in conjunction with the virtual reality image screened by the screening unit (60).
abstract_ko: 사용자가 재난안전에 대한 가상체험을 제공하는 종합 안전체험 시뮬레이터에 있어서, 탑승부(20)의 하부에 위치하여 연산제어부(미도시)의 지시에 따라 탑승판(21)의 모션과 각도를 조절하는 구동부(10)와; 상기 구동부(10)의 상부에 위치하고 사용자가 탑승하게 되는 탑승부(20)와; 상기 탑승부(20)를 밟고 있는 사용자가 넘어지거나 중심을 잃지 않도록 의지 수단을 제공하는 안전부(30)와; 상기 구동부(10)를 제어하여 탑승부(20)의 모션을 상영되는 가상현실 영상(F)과 연동하여 제어하는 연산제어부(미도시)와; 상기 탑승부(20)에 위치한 사용자에게 시각적으로 재난안전과 관련된 가상현실 영상(F)을 상영하는 상영부(60)와; 상기 탑승부(20)의 주웨에 배치되어 상기 상영부(60)에 의해 상영되는 가상현실 영상과 연동하여 상기 연산제어부(미도시)의 지시에 따라 실제적인 상황 연출을 보조하는 특수효과부(70);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 종합 안전체험 시뮬레이터.

title_en: High-resolution wind disaster assessment method suitable for extremely high wind conditions
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of wind prevention and disaster reduction, and provides a high-resolution wind disaster assessment method suitable for extremely high wind conditions. According to the method, the local complex terrain and the historical data of the wind measuring tower of the power grid are comprehensively considered, the wind field distribution of the power grid coverage area is predicted through a high-resolution CFD mode, an evaluation analysis model is established, the actual wind power situation of a local micro-area is accurately reflected, and the requirements of strong wind early warning and wind disaster evaluation of the power grid are met. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical data set of a wind measuring tower of a target power grid coverage area, carrying out area modeling by wind mine software, calculating wind field simulation data by a CFD mode, carrying out wind speed screening and early warning grade division according to real-time data and wind resistance design parameters of power equipment, generating extreme wind disaster assessment information of the power grid area, superposing and correlating with a geographical information graph of the power grid area, and determining the early warning grade information of the wind disaster of a distribution line. And (5) collecting the wind measuring tower data of the power grid at the prediction time, comparing the wind measuring tower data with the simulation calculation result, and outputting the calculation accuracy of the wind damage evaluation analysis model.
assignees: SICHUAN LVNENG ZHISUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster ecological environment treatment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster ecological environment treatment device which comprises a first servo motor fixedly connected with the upper surface of a moving trolley through the structure, a second moving frame which is driven to move downwards to bring a supporting leg to abut against the ground through a first rotating double-thread screw rod of the servo motor, so that the stability of equipment is effectively improved, a second moving frame which is driven to ascend with a water tank, and meanwhile, an atomization nozzle can be used for adjusting an angle to spray through the expansion and contraction of a hydraulic rod on the water tank, dust in the operation process is reduced, a first gear meshed with the first gear is rotated through a third rotating gear of the servo motor, a third gear and a second gear meshed with the second gear are rotated, a force is transmitted to the third gear and a stirring rod through a toothed ring meshed with the second gear, the stirring frame can rotate in a liquid medicine tank, the liquid medicine is prevented from precipitating, a rotating plate is rotated, a spraying head is downwards inserted into a hole drilled on the ground, and the volatilization of the liquid medicine in the liquid medicine tank can be reduced.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SHENHONG ENV CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Passenger roller fire personnel evacuation simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a passenger roller fire personnel evacuation simulation method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a passenger cabin scene model, carrying out numerical simulation on a passenger cabin fire to obtain data of fire products; the method comprises the steps of analyzing a change rule of fire products, calculating a fire evacuation speed influence coefficient, improving a particle swarm algorithm, merging fire product data into the improved particle swarm algorithm to obtain a personnel evacuation path optimization model under a fire condition, and simulating a personnel evacuation process in a cabin scene model based on the personnel evacuation path optimization model to obtain a personnel optimal evacuation path under the fire condition. The method can effectively expand the optimization space, improve the optimizing capability of the algorithm in the initial stage and maintain high-level development capability in the final stage of searching, thereby remarkably improving the convergence speed and effect of the algorithm, improving the path optimizing result and ensuring that the optimized path is the shortest path.

title_en: Expressway safety management and control method and system based on management and control unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway safety management and control method and system based on a management and control unit, which construct an efficient data processing and risk assessment system by carefully selecting driving road condition data and risk factor knowledge blocks from the management and control unit of a sample highway. And the risk description label prediction is carried out on the sample data by utilizing the reference neural network, and the accuracy and the reliability of the risk prediction model are ensured through network training convergence verification. According to the method, corresponding risk description labels can be rapidly and accurately predicted according to the input actual driving road condition data of the expressway target management and control unit, and particularly matching of a plurality of local risk description labels can be refined, so that a more refined risk assessment result is provided. And based on the management and control suggestions generated by the risk description label prediction results, scientific basis is provided for safety management of the expressway, potential risks can be recognized and dealt with in time, and the safety management and control level and emergency response capability of the expressway are remarkably improved.

title_en: Elastic power distribution network planning method based on wind-solar-energy-storage combined output
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network planning, and particularly relates to an elastic power distribution network planning method based on wind-solar-energy-storage combined output, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a power distribution network fault rate model, S2, establishing and selecting a typical disaster scene, establishing and screening the typical disaster scene by combining a Monte Carlo simulation method with information entropy, S3, establishing an elastic power distribution network planning configuration model based on the disaster scene, establishing a power distribution network planning model under the disaster scene by combining elements such as wind power generation, photovoltaic power generation, a micro gas turbine and energy storage, S4, solving the planning model by adopting an NSGA-II algorithm, and obtaining an optimal configuration result of the power distribution network.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Method and system for evaluating stable bearing capacity of reversing branch tower rod piece based on weighted neighbor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the stable bearing capacity of a reversing branch tower rod piece based on weighted neighbor, which comprises the following steps of acquiring a related data set of the reversing branch tower power transmission tower rod piece; the method comprises the steps of converting original geometric and physical information into linear independent new variables, constructing a training data set and a testing data set according to a data set related to a power transmission tower rod of a reversing branch tower and the linear independent new variables, constructing a 10-dimensional space according to the training data set, constructing a reversing branch tower rod bearing capacity assessment model based on a space distance formula, and carrying out actual reversing branch tower rod stable bearing capacity assessment according to the reversing branch tower rod bearing capacity assessment model. The invention also provides a system for realizing the method for evaluating the stable bearing capacity of the reversing branch tower rod piece based on the weighted neighbor. The method speeds up the analysis and judgment process and provides a novel stable bearing capacity assessment technology for the disaster prevention field of the power transmission tower.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Fuel storage tank leakage fire experiment system and method capable of simulating various space conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a fuel storage tank leakage fire experiment system and a method capable of simulating various space conditions, wherein a space condition simulation unit consists of a rectangular plate and a square plate which are made of stainless steel materials, a storage tank fire simulation unit and a data acquisition unit are arranged on a second rectangular plate, and the other rectangular plates and the square plate are adjusted to turn around corresponding hinge shafts to form corresponding relative positions with the second rectangular plate so as to construct and form a side wall limited space condition, a long and narrow limited space condition and a corner limited space condition, and after each space condition is constructed, the storage tank fire simulation unit and the data acquisition unit are used for carrying out a fuel storage tank leakage fire experiment under the space condition. The invention has simple structure and easy operation, can realize experimental scenes of various space conditions, and provides more sufficient data support for researching the leakage fire disaster of the liquid fuel storage tank.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Comprehensive advanced prediction method and system for water and mud bursting disaster source
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive advanced forecasting method and system for a water and mud bursting disaster source. Belonging to the field of tunnel construction exploration. The system comprises a data collection module, a feature extraction module, a space-time diagram neural network (ST-GNN) model, a model training module and an early warning module, wherein the data collection module is used for collecting a large amount of geological, climatic and hydrologic data, the self-coding neural network is used for feature extraction, constructing the ST-GNN model, carrying out model training and carrying out preventive early warning decision, and the system is beneficial to improving the preventive and coping capability of water bursting and mud bursting disasters. Particularly, all data are stored on the block chain data sharing platform, so that the safety and transparency of the data are ensured, and the reliability and the trust degree of the data are greatly improved. In general, the system and the method can accurately predict the time and the place where sudden disasters possibly occur, give out early warning in time, avoid or reduce the influence of the disasters on the life and property of people, and have important practical value.

title_en: Railway cargo transportation network vulnerability assessment method based on cargo flow data
abstract_en: The invention provides a vulnerability assessment method of a railway cargo transportation network based on cargo flow data, which comprises the steps of constructing initialization RFTN, distributing cargo flow/traffic flow to the network by adopting a model before interruption, and mapping the cargo flow/traffic flow to the network Calculating initial network performance index And Distributing the cargo flow/the traffic flow to the network again to obtain a failure network Calculating the network performance index after the interruption according to the output result And The method comprises the steps of calculating three vulnerability indexes and normalized coupled comprehensive vulnerability indexes respectively, repeating the steps until all interrupt scenes are simulated, and obtaining RFTN vulnerability, key stations, sections and areas under different interrupt scenes and different vulnerability index scales respectively. Four different recovery strategies are introduced, a part of elastic stage is reflected, the network structure and performance fluctuation conditions of longer time before and after an interruption event are captured, and the obtained results and conclusions are helpful for formulating a railway infrastructure strengthening strategy, determining maintenance resource allocation and formulating an emergency response plan.

title_en: Urban flood forecasting method based on rainfall threshold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city flood forecasting method based on rainfall threshold, which relates to the field of numerical simulation and calculation in hydrology, and comprises the following steps: collecting continuous flood event records of a certain water accumulation point, and arranging the continuous flood event records into a format required by a method proposed in the patent, wherein the estimation of model parameters a, b and c can be calculated by writing a Python code or utilizing a linear regression function of statistical software. According to the urban flood forecasting method based on the rainfall threshold, the rainfall threshold relation is introduced into urban waterlogging forecasting through limitation of the application conditions. The waterlogging forecasting method based on the rainfall condition only can provide reliable urban waterlogging forecasting results and has high running efficiency, and the rainfall threshold relation is applied to urban flood forecasting, so that the law is generally applied to disaster events caused by rainfall with binary characteristics such as landslide, debris flow and the like.

title_en: Slope stability dynamic prediction and geological parameter inversion method
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope stability dynamic prediction and geological parameter inversion method, which comprises the steps of establishing a slope stability simulation model through a COMSOL multi-physical-field simulation platform, generating simulation data by combining an orthogonal experimental design and an automatic parameter optimization technology, then training and optimizing the simulation data based on a variation self-encoder and a generated countermeasure network to obtain enhanced simulation data, carrying out geological parameter inversion based on SBAS-InSAR ground deformation data and the enhanced simulation data, generating a safety coefficient distribution map in a region of the geological parameter obtained by inversion, and fusing and evaluating disaster risks of different regions with a geological disaster potential map. The method ensures timeliness and real-time performance of the prediction result, and provides scientific basis for engineering design, disaster monitoring and decision making.

title_en: Power grid line geological disaster risk assessment method, device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological disaster risk assessment method, a geological disaster risk assessment device and computer equipment along a power grid. The method comprises the steps of constructing a sample database according to historical geological disaster data in a target area along a power grid, constructing a training sample database based on at least two environmental influence factors and the sample database, training the training sample database based on preset machine learning method parameters to obtain at least two geological disaster risk assessment models, comparing the geological disaster risk assessment models to obtain a target risk assessment model, and carrying out geological disaster assessment on the target area through the target risk assessment model. The method can improve accuracy of risk assessment of geological disasters along the power grid, obviously reduce personnel cost and time cost and improve risk assessment efficiency.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Method and related device for analyzing damage of power transmission tower after flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power transmission towers, and discloses a method and a related device for analyzing damage of a power transmission tower after flood, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining design information and service time of the power transmission tower and flood intensity information; according to design information and service time of the power transmission tower and flood intensity information, obtaining a post-flood damage state of the power transmission tower through a preset post-flood damage machine learning model of the power transmission tower; the method comprises the steps of constructing a numerical analysis probability model of the power transmission tower under different service times, carrying out flood hydrostatic thrust analysis based on the numerical analysis probability model of the power transmission tower under different service times, obtaining the post-flood damage states of the power transmission tower under different flood intensities, generating training samples, training the machine learning model according to the training samples, and obtaining the post-flood damage machine learning model of the power transmission tower. Repeated calculation of the traditional method is avoided, and the speed of damage assessment after flood disaster of the power transmission tower group is greatly improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Particle method-based slope destabilization whole process calculation method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for calculating the whole slope destabilization process based on a particle method. The method is based on a smooth particle fluid dynamics (SPH) particle calculation method, and combines with a Riemann large deformation theory, and realizes landslide simulation under the area scale through a C++/CUDA programming program. The method can truly reproduce the whole process of sliding surface generation, penetration, starting and accumulation, can analyze the influence mechanism of the rock-soil mass properties such as internal friction angle, cohesive force, particle size, elastic modulus, poisson ratio and the like on the landslide process, and meanwhile, the calculation efficiency is improved by nearly hundred times compared with the traditional CPU programming efficiency through a parallel heterogeneous CPU/GPU programming architecture, so that the prediction of the river basin scale landslide flow velocity and accumulation range is realized, the method has strong adaptability, overcomes the defect that the methods such as discrete elements and finite elements are limited by simulation scale and calculation efficiency, and provides a new idea for large-scale landslide disaster prediction.

title_en: Model construction method, system and device for flood forecast of small water conservancy facilities
abstract_en: The invention relates to a model construction method, a system and a device for flood forecast of a small-sized water conservancy facility, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining original water conservancy data of a target river basin of the small-sized water conservancy facility, and carrying out river basin analysis to obtain corresponding hydrological meteorological data; obtaining geographical data, carrying out characteristic parameter analysis to obtain a corresponding drainage basin characteristic parameter set, obtaining facility information, carrying out parameter setting on a preset WRF-Hydro model by combining the drainage basin characteristic parameter set to obtain an initial flood model, carrying out multi-target parameter calibration processing on the initial flood model according to hydrological meteorological data to obtain a flood forecast model, carrying out scene simulation on the flood forecast model to obtain a scene simulation result, and optimizing the flood forecast model according to model optimization parameters to obtain an optimized flood forecast model. The invention can improve the accuracy of flood forecast and provide a more reliable basis for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Physical simulation test device and simulation method for development and evolution of debris flow disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a physical simulation test device and a physical simulation method for development and evolution of a debris flow disaster, comprising a material source supplying device for supplying materials, a material source flowing device for flowing the materials and a test monitoring device, wherein the material source supplying device comprises a movable grid-shaped belt conveyor, a water source supplying device and a material source supplying box, and the material source flowing device comprises a flowing device and a stacking device. The physical simulation test device and the simulation method for the development and evolution of the debris flow disaster can simulate the disaster formation mechanism and the disaster movement process of the debris flow disaster under different mountain terrains.

title_en: Method and device for constructing underground space flood emergency rescue and dispatching command model under storm condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for constructing an emergency rescue and dispatch command model of underground space floods under a storm situation, belongs to the technical field of construction safety management, and solves the problem that the effective landing of an emergency rescue scheme cannot be guaranteed in the prior art. According to the method, flood simulation under multiple conditions of different rainfall is carried out based on storm scene data and a cellular automaton model, key risk influence factors are identified to carry out severity evaluation according to a flood simulation result, meanwhile, risk grade evaluation is carried out based on an underground space disaster risk evaluation index system under the storm scene, a target underground space emergency rescue resource list is matched with a built knowledge base, a first emergency task list is obtained and applied to a corresponding rainfall scene, a cellular automaton model is adopted to carry out deduction, and a second emergency resource list is generated according to a deduction result, so that emergency rescue and scheduling command decisions are obtained. The invention is used for emergency rescue and dispatching command of underground space floods under the condition of heavy rain.
assignees: RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITE;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Method and device for evaluating influence of extreme drought event on flood process of flood area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and discloses a method and a device for evaluating influence of extreme drought events on a flood process of a river basin, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological hydrologic data of a target river basin and determining a drought and waterlogging emergency event based on the meteorological hydrologic data of the target river basin; the method comprises the steps of calculating a watershed vegetation greenness value after a drought and waterlogging emergency, obtaining a watershed vegetation greenness value before the drought and waterlogging emergency, and respectively carrying out watershed flood process simulation on the watershed vegetation greenness value before the drought and waterlogging emergency and the watershed vegetation greenness value after the drought and waterlogging emergency to obtain an evaluation result of influence of an extreme drought event on a watershed flood process. The invention realizes quantitative evaluation of vegetation leaf area change and soil contribution to flood process caused by drought and waterlogging in a target river basin, and provides technical support for river basin flood control scheduling and disaster early warning.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP IND DEVELOPMENT BEIJING CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Early warning analysis method for bridge pier damage under flood effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bridge pier damage early warning analysis method under the action of flood, which solves the technical problems of high disaster recognition cost, low bridge damage recognition precision, untimely early warning and alarming and the like based on monitoring equipment in the existing concrete bridge flood prevention technology. According to the method, by means of the established plastic damage simulation model, expensive sensors are not required to be arranged on a bridge structure, only basic information of the bridge structure and flood information such as flow rate, water level, scouring depth and the like are acquired, the damage and failure analysis of the bridge pier structure under the action of different influencing factors can be achieved through researching the flood action, the qualitative analysis of the damage state of the structure and the quantitative analysis of the damage index of the modal integrity are combined to determine the damage grade and damage failure judgment criterion of the bridge pier structure, early warning values corresponding to different damage grades of the bridge pier are inverted, accurate identification and rapid grading early warning of the damage of the bridge pier structure under the action of flood are achieved, the flood disaster resistance capability of the bridge structure is improved, the safe operation of the bridge is guaranteed, and the service life of the bridge is prolonged.

title_en: Mining subsidence tower deformation evaluation method based on RF-SVM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining subsidence pole tower deformation evaluation method based on an RF-SVM (radio frequency-support vector machine), which comprises the steps of 1, selecting an earth surface gradient, a coal seam inclination angle, a mining depth and mining thickness ratio, a goaf length, a mining layer number, a coal seam spacing and a horizontal distance between a pole tower and a maximum settlement point to form an original evaluation factor system, 2, carrying out normalization and standardization pretreatment on data, 3, determining the weight of each characteristic factor, 4, using the screened evaluation factors for training an SVM model, 5, predicting by using the trained SVM model, and solving the problem that the disasters are difficult to be found and prevented accurately and timely by the traditional monitoring means.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIZHOU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method for rapidly distinguishing types of coal mine goaf for mine disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly distinguishing types of coal mine goaf for mine disasters, and relates to the technical field of geophysical exploration. The rapid judging method classifies goaf types of known non-hydrous goafs, hydrous goafs and measuring points in the non-goaf range, establishes mapping relations between different parameters of each measuring point and goaf types, and forms a model training sample. And performing Bayes modeling training on the established sample by using SPSS software, and constructing Bayes discrimination models of goafs of different types and three parameters. And (3) training a Bayes model by using SPSS software, and inputting the optimal parameter combination calculated by the full-area measuring point into the Bayes model when the estimation accuracy of the training sample exceeds 80%, so as to realize the rapid discrimination of the type of the full-area measuring point goaf.
assignees: MEIHANG REMOTE SENSING INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode learning automatic complaint content analysis and classification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-modal learning automatic complaint content analysis and classification method and a system, which relate to the technical field of semantic analysis and comprise the steps of collecting multi-modal complaint data and preprocessing the collected multi-modal complaint data; extracting the characteristics of the preprocessed multi-mode complaint data, fusing the characteristics of different mode data, constructing a complaint content classification model by using the fused characteristics, performing model training, evaluating and optimizing the trained model, and deploying the optimized model for real-time classification. The multi-mode learning automatic complaint content analysis and classification method provided by the invention can be used for rapidly and accurately classifying complaint contents and providing a targeted processing strategy according to the main category, emotion tendency and specific subject of complaints. The emergency response mechanism is automatically triggered, so that the problem is immediately processed, and the effective utilization of resources is ensured. And learning from historical data, continuously optimizing decision rules, and improving the intelligent level of a processing strategy and customer satisfaction.

title_en: Park safety operation and maintenance management method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a park safety operation and maintenance management method based on a digital twin technology, which relates to the technical field of park safety operation and maintenance management and comprises the following steps that S1, park information is acquired, wherein the park information comprises park structure information, environment information and real-time operation and maintenance data; S2, constructing a digital twin model of the park based on the acquired structural information of the park. According to the park safety operation and maintenance management method based on the digital twin technology, the situation after different emergency measures are implemented is simulated, and the advantages and disadvantages of the scheme are evaluated through multiple simulation of different evacuation routes and guiding modes, so that the optimal evacuation scheme is selected, the safety of personnel in the emergency situation is improved, the response efficiency and effect to the occurrence of a safety event are improved, the occurrence of the safety event can be controlled timely and effectively, and larger loss is avoided.
assignees: HUNAN SENNA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunneling working face structure drilling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling method for a tunneling working face structure, which relates to the technical fields of mine geological disaster prevention and control, mining technology and safety production management, and comprises the following steps of carrying out drilling operation steps in a normal area, namely S1, arranging 4 drilling holes in each drilling mode, wherein the number of the central holes is 2, the number of the left side holes and the right side holes is two, the length of the central holes is 90 meters, the depths of the left side holes and the right side holes are 92.8 meters, a center Kong Zhongkong respectively controls a top plate and a bottom plate of a coal bed, the two side holes are arranged in the coal bed, the positions of the final holes of the roadway side holes are 20 meters away from the tunneling roadway side, utilizing the existing geological work results of a mining area, the drawing and the report of geological exploration report and object report to compile a geological specification of the tunneling working face, drawing a predicted section diagram of the tunneling working face, grasping the occurrence condition and the change trend of a coal stratum in front of the tunneling working face according to each feature of the abnormal geological body, accurately grasping and determining a construction horizon, and reasonably designing the tunneling slope.
assignees: SHENGTAI COAL INDUSTRY CO LTD OF SHANXI COAL TRANSP AND MARKETING GROUP

title_en: Rescue training building structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue training building structure which comprises a main body framework, wherein the main body framework is arranged on the ground, a smoke window rescue area and a cliff rescue area are respectively arranged on the main body framework, a stair assembly is arranged in the main body framework, the smoke window rescue area is arranged on the other side of the main body framework, a smoke window cylinder is arranged in the smoke window rescue area, a climbing handle is arranged on the outer side of the smoke window cylinder, the cliff rescue area is arranged on the outer side of a third building layer of the main body framework, a supporting framework is arranged in the cliff rescue area, and the supporting framework is fixed on the main body framework. According to the utility model, the platform plate is arranged on the main body framework, the smoke window rescue zone is matched on one side of the main body framework, the cliff rescue zone is arranged on the outer side of the main body framework, and the structures of the smoke window rescue zone and the cliff rescue zone are utilized to improve the climbing proficiency of a firefighter on the aspect of a smoke window column body and the proficiency of the cliff topography, so that the firefighter adapts to rescue processes under different terrains in advance.
assignees: HUNAN MEIHAO MINGTIAN SAFETY EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Snow disaster grade monitoring and early warning management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snow disaster grade monitoring and early warning management system which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-factor association analysis model, collecting and cleaning related data to form a data set, S2, establishing a high-frequency self-adjustment environment interaction model based on the data set, dynamically adjusting sampling frequency, S3, utilizing self-adaptive climate variation analysis to adjust model parameters in real time, S4, inputting the adjusted parameters into a fluctuation threshold self-calibration predictor, automatically adjusting detection threshold, S5, constructing a microclimate custom model to generate regional snow disaster risk grade, S6, using a climate condition evolution simulator to generate multi-scene snow disaster scenes, simulating and predicting risk trends under different environment changes, S7, applying an intelligent resource preset algorithm to dynamically adjust allocation and replenishment period, and S8, utilizing a self-adaptive resource replenishment interval algorithm to adjust resource consumption and replenishment period in real time. The invention provides a high-efficiency snow disaster monitoring and early warning scheme which is suitable for emergency management under complex climate conditions.

title_en: Shaped charge structure for cleaning post-disaster blasting of tunnel mouth
