abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel mouth blasting cleaning construction, in particular to a shaped charge structure for cleaning post-disaster blasting of tunnel mouth. The detonating cord of the shaped charge structure is arranged in the middle of the energy collecting tube, explosive is filled in the energy collecting tube, the energy collecting tube comprises energy collecting petals and buckles, a plurality of energy collecting petals surround to form a tubular structure, the end parts of the adjacent energy collecting petals are connected through the buckles, and energy collecting grooves are formed in the energy collecting petals. The energy-gathering pipe is formed by the energy-gathering valve and the buckle, so that the rapid explosive loading and the explosive-guiding pipe installation are facilitated, the length can be cut on site according to the depth of the blast hole, the energy-gathering pipe can adapt to adverse environmental conditions of field disaster relief, the operation is simple, the energy-gathering pipe can be processed on a construction site, the requirements on the processing environment are low, the explosive loading of the blast hole can be realized while the explosive loading of the blast hole is realized, and the applicability is strong. Different numbers of energy gathering petals can be selected to surround energy gathering pipes with different sizes in the construction process, and the method can be well suitable for corresponding drilling holes of current construction equipment.

title_en: Rock damage simulation method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a rock damage simulation method and device, and relates to the technical field of rock engineering. The method comprises the steps of applying load to a numerical model of a rock to be tested, simulating the numerical model based on least square near field dynamics, judging whether the numerical model is subjected to tensile failure and/or shearing failure by using a maximum principal stress criterion and a molar coulomb criterion, increasing the load applied to the numerical model when the numerical model is not subjected to failure until any failure occurs in the numerical model, judging whether the current total load step reaches a preset total step number after the failure, and continuing to apply the load to the numerical model until the current total load step reaches the preset total step number if the current total load step number does not reach the constant current load. The method and the device can accurately describe the tensile damage and the shearing damage of the rock by utilizing two criteria to identify different damage behaviors of the rock, more accurately simulate the rock damage process, and are beneficial to disaster prediction, prevention and control in the field of rock engineering.

title_en: Transformer fire disaster simulator
abstract_en: The invention provides a transformer fire disaster simulation device which comprises a first tank body, wherein a tank body is arranged in the first tank body, the side wall of the tank body is connected with the tank bottom of the first tank body, the side wall of the tank body extends along the vertical direction, the top wall of the tank body is provided with a second tank body, a precombustion area and a flowing area are arranged in the second tank body, the precombustion area is used for containing combustion oil liquid, the precombustion area is communicated with the flowing area, and the flowing area is communicated with the first tank body, so that the combustion oil liquid flows into the first tank body after sequentially flowing through the flowing area and the side wall of the tank body. The fire disaster simulation device for the transformer solves the problem of poor simulation accuracy of the fire disaster simulation device for the transformer in the prior art.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Flood deduction-based power grid flood prevention risk early warning and auxiliary decision-making system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood deduction-based power grid flood prevention risk early warning and auxiliary decision-making system, and relates to the technical field of flood storage area power grid flood prevention. Compared with the prior flood storage area power grid flood prevention method, the method has the advantages that the problems of limited simulation precision and accuracy of an existing flood deduction model, low coupling degree of power grid equipment and a flood model, difficult cross-department cooperation and information sharing, and insufficient system visualization and interactivity are solved, accurate flood deduction is carried out through the flood deduction model, information such as the development trend, the submerging range and the water depth of the power grid can be predicted in advance, prospective guidance is provided for power grid flood prevention work, meanwhile, the power grid operation department adopts a corresponding scheme in advance based on a risk early warning strategy, when flood disasters occur, the system can quickly provide an emergency decision scheme, the emergency response speed is improved, the visual degree is greatly improved by combining VR and AR technologies, and the accuracy and the speed of emergency repair are improved.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction method based on transformer and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological engineering, in particular to a geological disaster prediction method based on a transformer and deep learning, which comprises the steps of collecting and processing geological information and deleting abnormal values in geological information data sets; the method comprises the steps of signal processing, namely determining embedding dimension and delay time, processing historical geological disaster data by using a dynamic system reconstruction method, reconstructing a weight matrix, and converting a one-dimensional time sequence into a track in a high-dimensional phase space so as to obtain periodic change of geological disasters. The method can effectively optimize the weight parameters and the bias parameters in the model by applying the Adam optimizer, thereby achieving the aim of minimizing the loss, and simultaneously, an effective model can be obtained by training the model, and the capability of the model is evaluated by using the models so as to be compared with other models.

title_en: Rapid ship structural damage assessment method based on numerical simulation and MLP (maximum likelihood) under fire disaster effect
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid assessment method of structural damage of a ship under the action of fire based on numerical simulation and MLP (multi-layer simulation), which comprises the steps of constructing a thermodynamic coupling model based on PyroSim software and ANSYS software, comprehensively considering the double change effects of heat conduction and structural mechanics, performing thermodynamic coupling numerical simulation under the action of fire on the ship, performing deep learning training on simulation data by adopting a multi-layer perceptron model, constructing a deep perceptron model to assess the structural damage under the action of fire on the ship, designing GPU (graphic processing unit) acceleration logic, and optimizing the calculation efficiency of key steps by GPU acceleration to achieve the aim of rapid assessment of the structural damage under the action of fire on the ship. The technical scheme of the invention not only can obviously reduce the calculation cost, but also can provide high-efficiency and accurate damage evaluation results, and provides new technical support and solution for the safety research of the ship structure in fire scene.

title_en: Management method and device for fire composite detector
abstract_en: The application provides a management method and device of fire composite detectors, wherein the method comprises the steps of under a specific simulation scene, after target combustible materials burn at a preset ignition position of a motor car equipment cabin for preset time, acquiring real-time data of at least one detection object detected by a plurality of fire composite detectors, and determining target layout measuring points of the fire composite detectors which are laid in layers on the motor car equipment cabin based on the real-time data of at least one detection object detected by the plurality of fire composite detectors, the coverage range of each fire composite detector and the layout position of each fire composite detector. According to the application, not only can the arrangement of the fire disaster composite detector in the motor car equipment cabin be realized, but also early fire disaster early warning and position sensing can be carried out by using the arranged fire disaster composite detector in a fusion mode, so that the response speed and accuracy of early warning are effectively improved.
assignees: CRRC CHANGCHUN RAILWAY VEHICLES CO LTD;ANHUI XINHE DEFENSE EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster model display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster display equipment and discloses a geological disaster model display device which comprises a base, a simulated mountain, a magnetic suspension driving assembly, a vibration assembly, a spraying assembly and a spraying assembly, wherein the simulated mountain is fixedly arranged on a supporting plate, the bottom of the supporting plate is connected with the base in a rotating mode, the magnetic suspension driving assembly is arranged on the base and connected with the supporting plate through a connecting rod and a hinging seat, the inclination angle of the simulated mountain is changed by moving on the base through the magnetic suspension driving assembly, the vibration assembly is arranged below the supporting plate, the spraying assembly is fixedly arranged on a connecting plate, the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the base, and the spraying assembly is positioned above the simulated mountain. Through connecting magnetic suspension drive assembly in simulation mountain body below, change the inclination of simulation mountain body that can be convenient, better presentation geological disaster takes place the process, be provided with vibration subassembly and spray the subassembly, the condition that accompanies the heavy rain in the time of can more true simulation earthquake, simulation effect is better.
assignees: QINGHAI INST OF HYDROGEOLOGY AND ENGINEERING

title_en: Real-time monitoring-based natural disaster early warning and responding method and device for electric power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time monitoring-based power system natural disaster early warning and responding method, which relates to the technical field of power early warning response and comprises the following steps of data analysis and processing, wherein the data analysis and processing utilizes a long-short-period memory network to combine with a Bayesian network to analyze and process real-time monitoring data in a power system, a scheduling scheme is generated, the state of the power system is updated in real time and an optimal scheduling scheme is generated based on a multi-source data fusion and optimization method combining a Kalman filter and a genetic algorithm, an emergency response strategy is generated, the influence of a natural disaster on the power system is simulated in real time in a virtual model through a digital twin technology and a self-adaptive dynamic programming method, and an emergency response strategy is provided, and anomaly detection and self-healing are performed by combining big data analysis with edge calculation to perform anomaly detection and self-healing on the running state of the power system.
assignees: TIELING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Market operation simulation trading system for electric power trading
abstract_en: The invention provides a market operation simulation trading system for electric power trading, which comprises a data acquisition subsystem, a market behavior prediction and simulation subsystem, an anomaly detection subsystem, an emergency response subsystem and a system optimization subsystem. The invention provides a brand-new electric power market simulation system, which can remarkably improve the accuracy of market behavior prediction and the coping capability of abnormal events. This not only helps to optimize market operation, reduce risk, but also improves the confidence of market participants and the stability of the overall market.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire control data analysis management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire control data analysis management system, which relates to the technical field of fire control data management and comprises a fire control data monitoring module, a prediction and simulation module, a linkage response module and an information interaction module, wherein the fire control data analysis management system is applied to a fire department end, the information interaction module is used for connecting the fire department end, a region management department end, a weather department end and a vehicle information management department end, and the prediction and simulation module comprises a region assessment unit, a fire simulation unit, a dynamic prediction unit and a decision unit. According to the invention, the prediction and simulation module is arranged to predict the high-frequency occurrence area and the occurrence probability of fire, so that the high-risk area can be accurately found in advance and the fire-fighting early warning can be conveniently performed, the occurrence of fire phenomenon can be avoided, the dynamic prediction unit predicts the fire change state and the fire spreading path, the decision unit accurately outputs an emergency response decision, the fire-fighting effect can be improved, the loss caused by fire can be effectively reduced, and the fire-fighting safety can be improved.

title_en: Geological disaster risk prediction method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological disaster risk prediction method, a geological disaster risk prediction device, geological disaster risk prediction equipment, geological disaster risk prediction medium and geological disaster risk prediction products. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target state information corresponding to a power grid pole and a tower in a target time interval, obtaining a target risk index according to the target state information and a target risk prediction model, screening the target risk prediction model according to multiple collinearity and importance of a historical influence factor, importing an initial risk prediction model for training to obtain the target risk index, and obtaining a target risk grade corresponding to a target area according to the target risk index, wherein the historical influence factor is data corresponding to the target influence factor in the historical time interval. By adopting the method, the accuracy of target risk level prediction can be improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Chamber fire disaster-curtain wall interaction experimental device and method based on variable boundary
abstract_en: The invention provides a chamber fire disaster-curtain wall interaction experimental device and method based on a variable boundary, and belongs to the technical field of fire disaster safety. The device comprises a combustion chamber, a variable curtain wall structure, a clamping mechanism, a temperature measuring system, an image acquisition system and a variable curtain wall structure, wherein the combustion chamber comprises a plurality of wall surfaces, the variable curtain wall structure comprises a metal frame and an opening part arranged on the wall surfaces, the clamping mechanism is suitable for pressing a plate to be tested on the metal frame to form a curtain wall, the temperature measuring system comprises a space temperature measuring assembly, the space temperature measuring assembly is suitable for measuring temperature data in the chamber in the combustion chamber, the surface temperature measuring assembly is suitable for measuring surface temperature data of the plate to be tested, and the image acquisition system is suitable for acquiring image data of an analog fire process in the combustion chamber and image data of the variable curtain wall structure. The invention can simulate the continuous evolution process of the fire dynamics caused by the rupture and falling of the curtain wall in the real fire, and provides a real and reliable experimental support for the analysis and mechanism research of the interaction phenomenon of the chamber fire and the curtain wall.

title_en: Method for realizing intelligent property management through simulation robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing intelligent property management through a simulation robot, which comprises the steps of information input, patrol, monitoring substitution and personnel configuration optimization. And inputting resident and vehicle information, and establishing an interactive and updated database. (robot 24 hours, no break all year round) patrol, monitor environment with visual, infrared, acoustic etc. sensors. The traditional monitoring is replaced by a visual sensor and an intelligent recognition algorithm. And the personnel configuration is re-planned, so that the cost is reduced. The robot is provided with an intelligent security, cleaning and information query module. The security module can identify people, invaded articles, fire disasters and the like, the security is guaranteed, the cleaning module automatically cleans and confirms garbage conditions, the environmental quality is improved, the logistics module accurately distributes express and identifies user identities, the information inquiry module guides users, provides navigation, recommends facilities and retrieves information, and the resident experience is improved. The method has obvious advantages in safety, cost and service, and brings new value for property management.

title_en: Intelligent emergency disposal method for hydrogen leakage explosion accident of hydrogen adding station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety emergency treatment of a hydrogenation station, and discloses an intelligent emergency treatment method for hydrogen leakage explosion accidents of the hydrogenation station, which is realized by constructing an intelligent emergency response system and combining an accident domino effect network evolution model; the method comprises the following steps of accident evolution analysis, intelligent auxiliary decision making, emergency resource allocation, real-time monitoring and feedback. The intelligent algorithm based on real-time data analysis, simulated evolution and risk assessment automatically generates an optimal emergency treatment strategy, provides decision support for emergency commanders, ensures quick and accurate decision, can accurately extract the risk factor most prone to secondary accidents, avoids emergency response temporarily in the accident process, improves predictability and timeliness of accident control, and reduces personnel, property loss and influence to the greatest extent.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;SHAANXI COAL INDUSTRY XINNENG HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel risk comprehensive evaluation system and method based on embedded three-dimensional geological model
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel risk comprehensive assessment system and method based on an embedded three-dimensional geological model, wherein the system comprises a dynamic simulation module, a tunnel risk comprehensive assessment module and a visual display module, wherein the dynamic simulation module is used for constructing the embedded three-dimensional geological model and dynamically simulating real-time parameters of a tunnel in the embedded three-dimensional geological model, the tunnel risk comprehensive assessment module is used for constructing a tunnel operation risk assessment model and inputting dynamic simulation results into the tunnel operation risk assessment model to carry out tunnel risk comprehensive assessment, and the visual display module is used for visually displaying tunnel risk comprehensive assessment results in the embedded three-dimensional geological model. The method is convenient for intuitively and effectively knowing the real-time geological condition of the tunnel, ensures the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of the tunnel risk assessment, is convenient for effectively knowing the specific condition of the tunnel risk, is convenient for timely taking effective measures to carry out emergency response, and greatly improves the effect of the tunnel risk assessment.

title_en: Quiet machine of surveying suitable for geological disaster reconnaissance is used
abstract_en: The utility model provides a static detector suitable for geological disaster investigation, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two sides of the top of the bottom plate are fixedly connected with supporting plates, two sides of the bottom plate and the bottom of the supporting plates are fixedly connected with universal wheels, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with handles, one side of the supporting plates is provided with a moving assembly, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a positioning shell, the top of the positioning shell is provided with a lifting mechanism, one side of the supporting plates is fixedly connected with a data device, two sides of the positioning shell are connected with supporting blocks, and the moving assembly comprises a first rotating rod. The static detecting machine suitable for geological disaster investigation solves the problems that when stones exist under soil or soil layers are hard, a detecting rod is easy to be damaged by the top, other drilling equipment is needed for auxiliary drilling, equipment cost is high, and construction efficiency is low.
assignees: HUBEI YEKAN GEOLOGICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Roof fall prediction early warning method integrating video monitoring, numerical simulation and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roof fall prediction early warning method integrating video monitoring, numerical simulation and deep learning, which comprises the following steps of obtaining monitoring video data of a roadway top, identifying displacement conditions of a top plate of the roadway top based on the monitoring video data to form displacement monitoring data, constructing a large data set of different physical and mechanical parameters of a rock mass and displacement relations of the top plate based on an FDEM numerical simulation method, adopting an improved 3d-dct method to reduce dimensions of the physical parameters, establishing a roof fall disaster-causing process proxy model based on a U-Net deep learning technology on the basis of the dimension reduction data, taking the displacement monitoring data as constraint conditions, taking the roof fall disaster-causing process proxy model as a solver, adopting a genetic algorithm to dynamically solve optimal parameters of the roof fall disaster-causing process proxy model, and predicting stress and damage states of the roadway top plate. The method reveals the predicted early warning result of the roof caving from a plurality of layers of data and mechanisms, and provides important data support for disaster prevention and control.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN;HEILONGJIANG LONGMEI SHUANGYASHAN MINING CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster risk assessment method for power distribution network considering natural disaster space-time evolution model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster risk assessment method of a power distribution network taking a natural disaster space-time evolution model into consideration, which comprises the steps of 1, taking account of causes and influence factors of various natural disaster space-time evolutions, carrying out natural disaster space-time correlation modeling, 2, providing a method for calculating the fault probability of power distribution network equipment based on the natural disaster space-time correlation model, 3, providing a power distribution network disaster risk assessment method, sampling equipment states by using a non-time sequence Monte Carlo method, simulating the operation conditions of the power distribution network equipment under the influence of various natural disasters, and 4, establishing a power distribution network disaster risk assessment system from the aspects of reliability and safety and calculating each risk index value. The method and the system can accurately evaluate the post-disaster risk of the power distribution network under the influence of various natural disasters, thereby accelerating the post-disaster recovery of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Ship wireless transmission link protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship wireless transmission link protection method which comprises the following steps of firstly carrying out risk assessment, carrying out risk assessment on a ship wireless transmission link, obtaining risk assessment information, formulating a protection scheme according to the risk assessment information, deploying a technology, namely deploying the protection scheme, carrying out real-time monitoring and early warning, monitoring by a deployment sensor and a monitoring tool, simultaneously establishing an early warning mechanism, carrying out emergency response and recovery, formulating an emergency plan, simultaneously carrying out data backup and recovery and carrying out system isolation and recovery, and fifthly, carrying out network security consciousness assessment on a shipman, and carrying out skill training on the shipman with abnormal network security consciousness assessment. The invention can perform more comprehensive protection of the ship wireless transmission link.
assignees: SHANGHAI YISHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cold region special geotechnical Cheng Bengta simulation experiment device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster testing, in particular to a cold region special geotechnical Cheng Bengta simulation experiment device and method, wherein the cold region special soil engineering collapse simulation experiment device comprises a torsion collapse test bed and a side slope model, the side slope model is arranged on the torsion collapse test bed, the torsion collapse test bed can drive the side slope model to move along at least one direction, the side slope model is provided with a slope body extending obliquely downwards, the slope body is adjustable or not adjustable, and the problem that the vibration, slippage and torsion collapse multiple effects on geotechnical Cheng Bianpo collapse under the earthquake effect cannot be fully simulated by the conventional device is solved.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system for full-scene high-altitude operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring system for full-scene high-altitude operation, which comprises the following steps of acquiring environment, personnel health, equipment operation and operation path data in real time by utilizing various sensors, generating a safety ecological map by a data fusion technology, reflecting the safety situation of an operation site in real time, analyzing the data by adopting an intelligent algorithm, predicting safety risks and generating emergency early warning, dynamically adjusting the operation task sequence according to task priority, risk level and personnel health condition, optimizing resource allocation, providing real-time safety prompt and operation guidance for operators by the system through virtual reality and augmented reality technology in the operation process, improving safety awareness and decision making capability, and having an automatic emergency response function, optimizing an evacuation route in real time, guaranteeing the safety of the operators, and continuously optimizing a safety management strategy by self-adaptive learning. The present invention aims to improve safety and efficiency in high risk work environments.

title_en: Cold region geotechnical engineering collapse monitoring device, system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster model tests, in particular to a cold region geotechnical engineering collapse monitoring device, a system and a method, wherein the cold region geotechnical engineering collapse monitoring device comprises an outer box, an inner box and a side slope model, the side slope model is arranged in the inner box, the outer box is used for accommodating the inner box, a rainfall assembly is movably arranged on the inner box and used for controllably and quantitatively spraying water or mist to the inner box to simulate rainfall or plum rain states, a vibration assembly is arranged at the bottom of the side slope model and adjustably arranged on the vibration assembly, the vibration assembly is used for enabling the side slope model to vibrate to simulate the vibration states, and the cold region geotechnical engineering collapse monitoring device further comprises an electromagnetic force loading assembly which is arranged outside the side slope model and used for applying load in at least one direction to the side slope model and is used for simulating the stability of the side slope of the cold region geotechnical engineering under the multi-factor coupling effect.
assignees: KUNMING PROSPECTING DESIGN INST OF CHINA NONFERROUS METALS INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: UKAN-based 24-hour maximum wind forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather, in particular to an hour-by-hour maximum wind forecasting method based on UKAN, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining historical live maximum wind speed data of whole-point time periods and EC fine grid numerical mode forecasting product data, respectively establishing ground data channel data and high-altitude data channel data, carrying out scaling pretreatment on input data, then constructing a UKAN-based deep learning maximum wind speed forecasting model, determining a loss function of model training, training the model by using the data, and finally calculating a future 0-24 hour-by-hour maximum wind speed forecasting field by using the trained deep learning maximum wind speed forecasting model. According to the invention, through designing UKAN maximum wind speed forecasting model and constructing site data loss function, the forecasting precision of the maximum wind speed from 0 to 24 hours is improved, and the method has good application prospect and provides more accurate forecasting service for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: GUANGXI INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES;GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION OCEAN M

title_en: Toughness assessment and toughness improvement method for distribution information physical system under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating and improving toughness of a distribution information physical system under disasters, and belongs to the field of cooperative regulation and control and optimized operation of power systems. The method comprises the steps of randomly generating a damage scene of an urban power grid under disasters through Monte Carlo simulation sampling, establishing a multi-period dynamic joint toughness evaluation model of a power distribution network information physical system based on a scene basis, introducing toughness evaluation indexes to evaluate the toughness of the power grid, taking the recovery requirements of power network loads and communication system resources into consideration, carrying out strategy optimization by utilizing resources such as a distributed unit, energy storage equipment and the like in the power distribution network and cooperating with a mobile emergency power supply and a mobile communication vehicle, evaluating the toughness of the power distribution network information physical system under different configurations, and solving the optimal toughness improvement strategy of the power distribution network information physical system. By establishing a multi-period toughness evaluation model of the power distribution network in an extreme disaster scene and combining various resource configurations, the improvement of the toughness of the power distribution network is promoted on the basis of considering the coupling of the information network, and the method has higher application value.

title_en: Landslide susceptibility prediction method based on dynamic evaluation of environmental factor importance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide susceptibility prediction method based on dynamic evaluation of environmental factor importance, which comprises the steps of collecting landslide, non-landslide samples and environmental factor data, constructing a data set, constructing a landslide susceptibility prediction model, inputting the data set into a training model to obtain a landslide susceptibility prediction result, and finally, grading the landslide susceptibility of a region and visually processing the prediction result. The characteristic representation of the intrinsic environment factors is mined by constructing an intrinsic environment factor model comprising a convolution unit, an SE layer and an LSTM unit, an extrinsic driving environment factor model comprising a convolution unit, an SE layer, a transducer module and a SeqPool layer is constructed, characteristic information of the extrinsic driving environment factors is captured and analyzed, and the characteristic representation of the intrinsic environment factor model and the characteristic information of the extrinsic driving environment factor model are weighted and fused through a self-attention mechanism, so that main driving factors of landslide disaster can be effectively identified, prediction errors are effectively reduced, and the prediction performance of a landslide prediction model is improved.

title_en: Storm surge numerical simulation method and system based on parameterized typhoon model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm surge numerical simulation method and system based on a parameterized typhoon model, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining typhoon data of an area to be researched for assimilation simulation calculation and constructing an assimilation typhoon model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining terrain data and water depth data of an area to be researched, conducting grid division and data interpolation processing to construct a two-dimensional storm tide model, setting boundary driving conditions, conducting parameter calibration verification on an assimilation typhoon model and the two-dimensional storm tide model to obtain an assimilation typhoon model after verification and the two-dimensional storm tide model after verification, conducting storm tide numerical simulation based on the assimilation typhoon model after verification and the two-dimensional storm tide model after verification, and obtaining a storm tide numerical simulation result. The method can more comprehensively analyze the comprehensive influence of different factors on the storm surge, and improve the accuracy of storm surge simulation. The storm surge numerical simulation method and system based on the parameterized typhoon model can be widely applied to the technical field of marine disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: GUANGDONG RES INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Underground engineering geological disaster grouting effect simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground engineering geological disaster grouting effect simulation device, which comprises a base, a rectangular frame, a splicing assembly, a sealing cover, a supporting frame, an electric push rod, a fixing assembly, a checking assembly, an impact assembly and an anti-blocking assembly, wherein the base is provided with a plurality of grooves; the base is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, the top of the supporting frame is fixedly provided with an electric push rod, the middle of the base is fixedly provided with a rectangular frame, a splicing assembly for quick disassembly is inserted in the rectangular frame, and a sealing cover is covered on the splicing assembly to jointly enclose a grouting box body; the fixed component and the inspection component are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the splicing component, the impact component is connected to the two sides of the supporting frame, and the anti-blocking component is arranged on the sealing cover. The invention can realize the rapid disassembly and assembly of the splicing component, the fixing component and the inspection component can stabilize the whole grouting box body, the impacting component can enable the cement blocks and the splicing component to be easily separated, and when the internal cement blocks are taken out for detection, the time for taking out the cement blocks by the disassembly device can be reduced, the workload of staff is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Bridge cluster post-earthquake rapid assessment method based on improvement XGBoost
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge cluster post-earthquake rapid assessment method based on improvement XGBoost. The method comprises the steps of firstly classifying a bridge cluster, selecting a bridge type as a research object, determining modeling parameters according to the selected bridge type, expanding parameter samples, then establishing a finite element model, extracting output parameters related to bridge behaviors, dividing the bridge into three types according to the extracted output parameters related to the bridge behaviors, taking the bridge as a bridge classification label, carrying out data expansion, carrying out classification model training on the obtained new training set by using a XGBoost model, finally determining a XGBoost model, taking bridge parameters and earthquake data as input, and outputting the classification label as a post-earthquake evaluation index/evaluation basis by using a determined XGBboost model. The invention obviously improves the efficiency and accuracy of bridge safety evaluation after earthquake and provides quick and reliable technical support for the rush repair and recovery of the bridge after disaster.

title_en: High-proportion new energy power grid viability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the viability of a high-proportion new energy power grid, which relate to the technical field of power grid viability evaluation and comprise the steps of carrying out network topology on the high-proportion new energy power grid to generate power grid topological structure parameters and network basic characteristic parameters; the method comprises the steps of simulating a natural disaster scene to obtain power supply removal capacity and a fault scene, determining an optimal power supply removal scheme according to the power supply removal capacity, and evaluating the survivability of a power grid by using the fault scene, the optimal power supply removal scheme and network basic characteristic parameters. The weighted power grid topology model provided by the invention not only successfully reserves regional network characteristics, but also has obvious advantages compared with an unauthorized model in the aspect of reflecting the importance degree of the nodes and the running condition of the actual power system. By introducing weighting factors such as line reactance, the model is closer to the running state of the real power grid. Meanwhile, the invention discloses the structural vulnerability of the power grid, which is an inherent attribute of the power grid with regional network characteristics.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Emergency edge cloud cooperative system for safety production based on industrial Internet
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency side cloud cooperative system for safety production based on an industrial Internet. The system comprises a plurality of cloud sub-platforms and an emergency tool box. The emergency tool box comprises an emergency tool box at the side and an emergency tool box at the end side. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an operation full environment data set through access of accessory sensor equipment in an emergency toolbox at the end side and a production site sensor, obtaining a data set to be trained after data preprocessing of the operation full environment data set by the emergency toolbox at the side according to received knowledge downloaded by the cooperative management of the side cloud, and uploading the data set to the cloud through a cooperative communication protocol of the side cloud so as to enable a learning model to optimize iterative training and output an emergency management scheme. The cloud sub-platform configures related items of the corresponding side emergency tool kit according to the emergency management scheme, the related items are issued to the side through the side cloud collaborative management, and the side downloads and operates from the mirror image warehouse. The method can improve emergency response capability of safe production in an industrial Internet environment.
assignees: CHINA POWER IND INTERNET CO LTD

title_en: One-stop gas-containing coal competitive adsorption-desorption-spontaneous combustion traceability system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of gas adsorption and desorption tests, and discloses a one-stop gas-containing coal competitive adsorption-desorption-spontaneous combustion traceability system which comprises a gas supply unit, a program temperature control box, a vacuum pump and a control unit, wherein a reaction unit is arranged in the program temperature control box and comprises a first preheating pipe, a second preheating pipe, a third preheating pipe, a first reference tank, a second reference tank and a coal sample tank. The invention also provides a test method of the one-stop gas-containing coal competitive adsorption-desorption-spontaneous combustion traceability system. The invention fully simulates the competitive adsorption and desorption under the working conditions of different temperatures and different pressures in the actual coal mine and the temperature rise oxidation process under the condition of air leakage immediately after the competitive adsorption under the coal mine, thereby improving the continuity and accuracy of the experiment. The invention can be widely applied to the fields of coal mine safety production, gas disaster prevention and control and the like, and has important practical value and social benefit.
assignees: CCTEG SHENYANG RES INST;CHINA COAL RES INST;SHANXI XIAOHUIGOU COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Virtual crowd behavior modeling and parallel simulation method and system based on intelligent agent
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer simulation, and provides a virtual crowd behavior modeling and parallel simulation method and system based on an intelligent agent. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of monitoring video pairs of historical group activities, extracting first group feature data from the monitoring video pairs, constructing training data according to the first group feature data, training a group behavior analysis model, receiving a third video of real-time group activities shot by an unmanned aerial vehicle, extracting second group feature data and type information of the group activities from the third video, obtaining a plurality of abnormal events according to the type information, carrying out deep analysis on the second group feature data and the abnormal events by using the group behavior analysis model, obtaining a plurality of potential evacuation routes corresponding to the abnormal events, carrying out parallel simulation screening on the potential evacuation routes, and outputting the target evacuation routes to a management terminal. The evacuation route is automatically generated based on the unmanned aerial vehicle remote shooting technology.

title_en: Portable earth's surface sand and dust material sand and dust separation sampling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable earth surface sand and dust substance sand and dust separation sampling device which mainly comprises an earth surface sand and dust sampling box, a sand and dust conveying pipe, a drawer type sand collecting box, a drawer type dust collecting box, an electric fan and a square column-shaped four-layer structure. The device has clear principle and simple structure, adopts the rechargeable battery as power, can simulate different near-surface wind speeds to separate the surface sand particles and dust particles blown by wind, and respectively measure the sand content and the dust content of the surface of a unit area. The portable field investigation sampling device for the surface sand and dust substances is mainly used for scientific research and experimental observation of sand and dust storm problems, and test data of the portable field investigation sampling device are used for early warning and forecasting of sand and dust storm and evaluation of sand and dust storm disasters.

title_en: Geological auxiliary investigation equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of geological exploration equipment and discloses geological auxiliary exploration equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters, which comprises a base, a support, a supporting component, an auxiliary exploration component and a motor, wherein the upper portion of the base is connected with a support, the supporting component is arranged on the base and connected with a moving component, the auxiliary exploration component is connected with the moving component and is used for collecting soil with different depths at the same time, the auxiliary exploration component comprises a motor I, the motor I is fixed in the moving component, a drill rod is fixed at the driving end of the motor I, a shell is fixed in the drill rod, and spiral blades are fixed on the outer wall of the shell. Through the cooperation between remove the subassembly and the supplementary investigation subassembly, when having reached the regulation drilling rod position, the convenience is simultaneously to the effect of gathering to the soil of different degree of depth or to single degree of depth, has solved among the prior art because drilling rod position adjustment is inconvenient to lead to soil sampling precision not high and the problem that different degree of depth sampling data mix.

title_en: Nuclear power DCS system communication server fault prediction method, system, device, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, a device, a medium and a product for predicting faults of a communication server of a nuclear power DCS (distributed control system), and relates to the technical field of fault prediction; the method comprises the steps of determining a predicted value of operation data of a target server at a time to be predicted by using an operation data prediction model and the operation data of the target server at each time in a current time period, wherein the operation data prediction model is obtained by training a long-short-period memory neural network, inputting the predicted value of the operation data of the target server at the time to be predicted into a fault prediction model to obtain a predicted value of a fault result of the target server at the time to be predicted, and the fault prediction model is obtained by training a convolutional neural network, wherein the fault result is zero fault, slight fault, general fault, serious fault or disaster fault. The application realizes the fault prediction of the communication server of the nuclear power DCS system.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR CONTROL SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Building fire drilling evaluation system and method based on WiFi signal positioning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building fire drilling evaluation system and method based on WiFi signal positioning, belonging to the technical field of rescue drilling, and comprising a vision capturing module, a visual monitoring module and a building fire monitoring module, wherein the vision capturing module is used for capturing drilling scenes and identifying rescue workers and rescuees in the scenes; the system comprises a WiFi signal module, a data processing module, an effect evaluation module and a control module, wherein the WiFi signal module is used for capturing WiFi signal changes and analyzing signal reflection characteristics so as to track personnel position and action changes, the data processing module is used for synchronizing and fusing video data collected by the video capturing module and WiFi signal data and extracting characteristics, and the effect evaluation module is used for automatically generating detailed exercise evaluation reports which comprise key indexes, behavior analysis and video playback. The invention can simulate the conditions of escape and position of personnel in the building and the rescue conditions of rescue personnel when disasters occur.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: DIC and LSTM-based suspension rock instability early warning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and particularly discloses a DIC and LSTM-based suspension rock instability early warning method. The method comprises the steps of regularly collecting surface images of hanging rock, geometrically correcting the images and removing noise, analyzing the images by means of DIC technology to obtain a strain field mean value mu and a strain field standard deviation sigma, establishing an LSTM model comprising an input layer, an LSTM layer, a full-connection layer and an output layer, training the LSTM model by means of a training set and a verification set, optimizing the performance of the LSTM model by adjusting super parameters of the LSTM model, normalizing the strain field mean value mu and the strain field standard deviation sigma, dividing the strain field mean value sigma into a plurality of sliding windows, inputting data of each window into the LSTM model, outputting a prediction result of each window, judging as normal or abnormal, and triggering early warning when continuous judging windows are abnormal. The invention has the characteristics of high timeliness, less human intervention and accurate judgment.
assignees: KUNMING PROSPECTING DESIGN INST OF CHINA NONFERROUS METALS INDUSTRY CO LTD;KUNMING SURVEY INSTITUTE SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster cooperative detection method and system based on multi-mode fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire collaborative detection, in particular to a fire collaborative detection method and a fire collaborative detection system based on multi-mode fusion, which simulate the smoke diffusion and temperature change process of a fire in a machine room by a fire simulation method, determine the distribution area of smoke concentration and temperature rise, and construct a smoke detector network and a temperature detector network; the method comprises the steps of collecting smoke concentration data and temperature data of detection points, transmitting the smoke concentration data and the temperature data to a data processing center, preprocessing the data, generating a comprehensive fire feature matrix through a data fusion method, and positioning a fire area of a fire disaster through a cross analysis method by the comprehensive fire feature matrix.

title_en: Construction method of post-earthquake water-electricity correlation network cascade failure model based on functional coupling
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for constructing a post-earthquake water-electricity correlation network cascade failure model based on functional coupling, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction toughness research of infrastructure. The method comprises the specific steps of S1, collecting basic information of a water network and a power grid, S2, defining a functional coupling relation, establishing a water-electricity correlation network topological structure model based on graph theory, S4, determining components triggering cascade failure in the water network and the power grid based on a vulnerability curve, S5, introducing a failure joint probability method, determining the functional failure condition of the components with the functional coupling relation, S6, carrying out water network cascade failure analysis, S7, carrying out power grid cascade failure analysis, and S8, carrying out functional loss calculation of the water network and the power grid. The invention considers the functional coupling relation between the water network and the power grid component, simulates a failure propagation mechanism based on physical characteristics, and can more effectively and accurately reflect the internal mechanism and external behavior of cascade failure of the water-electricity correlation network.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster emergency rescue method through cooperation of heaves and earth
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster emergency rescue, and particularly discloses a mountain torrent disaster emergency rescue method which comprises the following emergency rescue key technologies of deployment and training based on a federal learning framework, wherein an unmanned aerial vehicle disaster area cluster wide area optimal deployment algorithm based on a double-target multi-arm slot machine is provided firstly, the coverage area and communication efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster are balanced, a two-stage semi-definite relaxation disaster area positioning method based on the cooperation of the heaven and earth is developed secondly, the disaster area is ensured to be accurately positioned, and finally, an emergency rescue method based on the remote sensing vision and dynamic path optimization of the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided, so that the emergency rescue and evacuation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Virtual simulation teaching system for fire handling and personnel evacuation of civil aviation passenger cabin and teaching method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual simulation teaching system for fire handling and personnel evacuation of a civil aviation passenger cabin and a teaching method thereof. The simulation training module is designed in a mode of multi-person collaborative treatment of civil aviation cabin fire emergency treatment and personnel evacuation, corresponding crews entity roles and scenes are selected according to different scenes, types and degrees of the fire to conduct virtual design and display, the civil aviation cabin fire emergency treatment and personnel evacuation virtual simulation assessment module is used for assessing, practical training data are collected and operated through external equipment, and the system automatically forms relevant study assessment documents. Through study, simulation training and skill assessment in the virtual simulation teaching system, the autonomous learning enthusiasm of students is effectively improved, the teaching efficiency can be improved, and the rapid improvement of the emergency disposal capability of the students to the fire of the civil aviation cabin is promoted.

title_en: Comprehensive pipe rack cable fire intelligent identification, prevention and control linkage system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of comprehensive pipe racks and provides an intelligent comprehensive pipe rack cable fire disaster identification, prevention and control linkage system. The system comprises a cable fire simulation device, an integrated piping lane cable, an image acquisition unit, a fire disaster identification model, a fire extinguishing linkage device, a self-made fire-proof rolling shutter with a flexible steel brush, a flexible fire-point area plugging device and a telescopic end, wherein the cable fire behavior in the piping lane is monitored in real time through the image acquisition unit, acquired simulated fire image information is transmitted to the deployed fire disaster identification model in real time to identify fire disasters, the fire disaster identification result of the fire disaster identification model is judged through the deployed fire disaster early-warning model, and a fire extinguishing instruction or an early-warning instruction is sent out according to the judgment result.

title_en: Typhoon disaster scene generation method capable of improving accuracy and efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster scene generation method capable of improving accuracy and efficiency, and aims to solve the problem that an existing typhoon disaster simulator is low in simulation accuracy. The typhoon disaster scene generation method includes the steps of firstly, selecting all typhoon samples passing through a target area from a database, extracting typhoon information from the typhoon samples, secondly, calculating gradient wind speed, superposing a traveling wind field, converting the superposed total wind speed field into ground wind speed, thirdly, discretizing the target area into a plurality of grid units, screening out the maximum ground wind speed when the typhoon samples pass through each time, forming a maximum wind speed intensity measurement graph of the target area, fourthly, reducing the number of the maximum wind speed intensity measurement graph by applying a disaster quantization method to the maximum wind speed intensity measurement graph of all typhoon samples, and fifthly, outputting N  HQ  optimized quanta and the weight of the optimized quanta. The invention can more accurately evaluate the damage condition of typhoon disasters to the target infrastructure system and the like, and improves the analysis efficiency.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk level prediction method based on knowledge graph and graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster risk level prediction method based on a knowledge graph and a graph neural network, which is used for collecting data related to mountain torrent disaster risk and performing data preprocessing operation, constructing a risk level prediction model combining the knowledge graph and the graph neural network and training. According to the mountain torrent disaster risk level prediction method based on the knowledge graph and the graph neural network, entities, relations and attributes can be represented in the form of graphs through the knowledge graph, complex knowledge and information can be effectively integrated and expressed, the graph neural network can effectively process graph structure data, the relation among nodes is captured, modeling and analysis of a complex system are achieved, the knowledge graph and the graph neural network are introduced into mountain torrent disaster risk level prediction, the purpose of fully utilizing multi-source data is achieved, potential risk modes and rules are mined, prediction accuracy and reliability are improved, and scientific basis and decision support are provided for disaster prevention work.

title_en: Meta universe-based chemical industry park emergency response system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical industry park emergency response system and electronic equipment based on a metauniverse, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data storage and processing module, a metauniverse platform module and an intelligent decision module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for carrying out real-time monitoring and acquisition on environmental parameters in a chemical industry park, the data storage and processing module is used for carrying out storage, analysis and fusion processing on the acquired data and realizing early warning, the metauniverse platform module is used for creating a chemical industry park virtual simulation environment and integrating real-time monitoring data and historical data into a virtual model, and the intelligent decision module is used for integrating multi-source data and simulation results and carrying out situation awareness and decision support. The method and the system improve the accuracy of data integration and situation simulation, can also remarkably improve the emergency response capability and the strain level of staff, effectively reduce accident loss and ensure the safety of a park.
assignees: WUHAN YANGTZE COMMUNICATIONS ZHILIAN TECH CO LTD;WUHAN YANGTZE COMMUNICATIONS IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Training method, prediction method and system for sudden snow disaster damage prediction model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a training method, a prediction method and a system for a sudden snow disaster damage prediction model, wherein the prediction method comprises the steps of obtaining basic parameter data of sudden snow disaster damage of a target area, wherein the basic parameter data comprise sudden snow disaster event data, meteorological site observation data, liu Biao analysis data, sudden snow disaster situation data, disaster bearing body data and disaster pregnancy environment data, determining characteristic quantity data of the target area based on the basic parameter data, and inputting the characteristic quantity data of the target area into the sudden snow disaster damage prediction model to obtain sudden snow disaster damage grade of the target area, so that future sudden snow disaster situations can be accurately predicted, and universality is realized.

title_en: Subway station pedestrian emergency evacuation system and method based on identification guidance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a subway station pedestrian emergency evacuation system and a subway station pedestrian emergency evacuation method based on identification guidance, in particular to a dynamic identification guidance system which is optimized by combining Legion simulation software. The system provides an optimal evacuation path through the combination of Legion simulation software and real-time simulation and analysis of the flow of people in the subway station by arranging a dynamic identification device in the subway station. In an emergency, the system dynamically adjusts the guiding direction of the evacuation identification by using the simulation data and the environment monitoring information. Legion simulation software can accurately simulate the traveling behaviors of passengers under different environments and under different congestion conditions, so that the accuracy of an evacuation scheme is improved. Through simulation tests, the system can obviously reduce the evacuation time, improve the evacuation speed, optimize the distribution of personnel in the station, reduce the residence time in a high-density area and ensure the safe evacuation of passengers in emergency.

title_en: Fire intelligent identification method and device, cloud equipment and computer device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent fire disaster identification, in particular to an intelligent fire disaster identification method and device, cloud equipment and a computer device, which improve the accuracy of fire disaster identification. The fire intelligent identification method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-level separation convolutional neural network, wherein the multi-level separation convolutional neural network is mainly composed of lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional modules, the lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional modules are formed by cascading at least two lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional sub-modules with different convolutional directions, the output of the former sub-module serves as the input of the latter sub-module, and the input of the lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional module is connected to the output of the latter sub-module through a residual path to form the final output of the lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional module; training the multi-level separation convolutional neural network through the training data set, optimizing parameters of the multi-level separation convolutional neural network, and identifying fire disaster through the trained multi-level separation convolutional neural network. The invention is suitable for fire disaster identification.

title_en: Automatic fire extinguishing alarm device and charging socket
abstract_en: An automatic fire extinguishing alarm device and a charging socket belong to the technical field of alarm devices. The device comprises a detection unit and a processor, wherein the detection unit is used for detecting K elements of fire disaster occurring in the charging socket, the processor comprises a fire disaster identification model, the fire disaster identification model estimates the probability of the fire disaster occurring according to quantized data of the K fire disaster elements, and the fire disaster identification model is trained through the probability model. The invention provides an automatic fire extinguishing alarm device and a charging socket, and a new fire identification model is constructed, the fire identification model can identify the probability of fire occurrence according to various data, the probability of fire occurrence can be prevented, and the generalization capability of the fire identification model can be improved by the training method.

title_en: Urban storm water depth prediction method and system based on ConvLSTM model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting urban storm water depth based on ConvLSTM models, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out data acquisition on an area to be simulated to construct an urban storm flood model of the area to be simulated, carrying out simulation prediction and data preprocessing on storm event data information of the area to be simulated based on the urban storm flood model of the area to be simulated to obtain normalized rainfall space-time characteristic data of the area to be simulated, constructing ConvLSTM models based on convolutional neural networks and long-term and short-term memory networks, and carrying out water depth prediction on the normalized rainfall space-time characteristic data of the area to be simulated based on ConvLSTM models to obtain a storm water depth prediction result of the area to be simulated. According to the embodiment of the invention, the influence of the space-time structure of rainfall on the flood process is considered by considering the correlation of adjacent space grids, so that the accuracy of real-time waterlogging disaster forecast is improved. The method and the system for predicting the urban storm water depth based on ConvLSTM model can be widely applied to the technical field of urban storm waterlogging simulation.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH;GUANGDONG RES INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER

title_en: Sliding body secondary landslide model experimental device and experimental method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sliding body secondary landslide model experimental device and an experimental method in the field of geological disaster model experiments, and the device comprises a box body, wherein the bottom of the box body is fixedly connected with a base, a first hydraulic cylinder which is transversely arranged is vertically hinged on the base, the top end of the first hydraulic cylinder is hinged with a top end platform, one side of the top end platform is hinged with a sliding table, the bottom end of the sliding table is hinged with the base, sliding bodies are paved on the sliding table and the top end platform, the top wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a pushing component for simulating landslide caused by overload above a slope, the outer wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a controller, the top wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a spraying component for simulating landslide caused by rainfall, the top wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a surface detection component, and an internal detection component is arranged in the sliding body. According to the invention, the influence of various physical quantities on landslide triggering is researched through the adjustable device, the secondary landslide process of the reinforced landslide body is simulated, the adaptability of the experimental reinforcement technology and the reinforcement material to landslide rush repair reinforcement is enhanced, and the understanding of the occurrence principle of the secondary landslide is enhanced.

title_en: Geological disaster alarm method based on ensemble learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster alarming method based on an integrated learning algorithm, and aims to solve the problems that when the existing disaster alarming method faces complex and changeable geological environments and multisource monitoring data, false alarm or missing alarm is easy to occur, and various factors affecting occurrence of geological disasters cannot be comprehensively considered. The method comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing, S2, selecting and training each basic learner, S3, constructing an integrated learning model, S4, model training and optimizing, and S5, geological disaster alarming. According to the method, the geological monitoring data are comprehensively analyzed by integrating a plurality of learning models, so that the accuracy and reliability of geological disaster warning can be effectively improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA UNIV OF MINING AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Indoor test device and method for simulating geological discrete disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fluid simulation, and particularly discloses an indoor test device and a test method for simulating geological discrete disaster. The lower end of the rectangular plate of the device is hinged with the top end of the base, the upper end is connected with the supporting frame, the support frame is provided with a driving mechanism and rollers; the storage box of the storage box mechanism is arranged on a rectangular plate in a sliding manner, an opening and closing door is arranged on the end face of the storage box, the lower part of the telescopic rod is connected with the storage box, the upper part of the telescopic rod is fixed with the upper end of the rectangular plate, the table top of the impact force testing system is arranged below the rectangular plate, the weighing sensor and the impact force collecting instrument are arranged on the table top, the velocimeter is fixed on two sides of the rectangular plate, the sensors of the vibration signal collecting system are fixed on the rectangular plate and the table top and are electrically connected with the dynamic testing unit, and the image collector is fixed on the side part and the upper part of the rectangular plate. The test method comprises the steps of sample preparation, test device preparation, process simulation, data and image acquisition and data analysis. The invention has the characteristics of simple structure, free variable adjustment and various detection signals.

title_en: Labor disaster education device and labor disaster education method
abstract_en: To provide a labor disaster education device and a labor disaster education method that enable effective understanding of a cause or a risk element of a labor disaster.SOLUTION: A head-mounted display 10 provides participants with a VR labor disaster accident experience 14 and a test execution 15 in a 3D image simulating a 3D space according to an educational content 12 stored in a storage 11. The VR labor disaster accident experience 14 allows participants to virtually experience a process up to the occurrence of an accident in the 3D image. The test execution 15 displays options that are associated with correct/incorrect (answer) information for a question based on the process up to the occurrence of the accident are displayed in the 3D image, and makes the participant select an option that is considered to be a correct answer to the question. A pass/fail decision 16 uses a predetermined arithmetic formula to score portions checked (selected) by the participant based on the correct/incorrect (answer) information associated with the options.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: MEIDENSHA ELECTRIC MFG CO LTD;INFOCOM CORP

title_en: Island sea dike and embankment risk assessment method considering comprehensive disaster effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sea island and sea dike flood dike risk assessment method considering comprehensive disaster effect, which comprises the following steps of collecting ocean data of sea areas nearby a sea island and historical typhoon data of the sea island and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of constructing a storm tide numerical simulation model, carrying out storm tide and flood embankment submerged simulation based on preprocessed ocean data and historical typhoon data to obtain submerged water depth of a sea island in storm tide, calculating a risk evaluation value of the sea embankment based on the submerged water depth of the sea island in storm tide and sea embankment data, setting a risk evaluation threshold value, and judging whether the sea embankment fails or not based on the risk evaluation value of the sea embankment.

title_en: Flowing fire disaster simulation generating device and fire basin thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flowing fire simulation generating device and a fire basin thereof. The flow fire simulation generating device comprises an oil tank, an oil pump, an oil conveying pipeline and a fire basin, wherein the fire basin comprises a basin body, at least one flow opening extending in the horizontal direction is formed in a side plate of the basin body, a flow guiding tongue structure is arranged at the position corresponding to the flow opening on the outer side of the side plate of the basin body, and an oil inlet hole is formed in the basin body, and the height of the oil inlet hole is lower than that of the flow opening, so that an oil-water separation interface is formed between the oil inlet hole and the flow opening by injecting water into the basin body when the fire simulation generating device is used, oil entering from the oil inlet hole is guaranteed to float to the water surface through a water layer, and the use safety is greatly improved.

title_en: Passenger flow evacuation method for train foldback station under subway sudden operation interruption
abstract_en: The invention relates to a passenger flow evacuation method for a train foldback station under a subway burst operation interruption, and belongs to the field of emergency evacuation of subway burst interruption. The method comprises the steps of building a passenger flow evacuation simulation environment of a train foldback station through relevant data under the condition of a subway sudden operation interruption, building an improved social force model considering the urgent and the popular psychology of passengers under the condition of the subway sudden operation interruption, identifying the passenger flow evacuation bottleneck position of the foldback station based on the built passenger flow evacuation simulation environment and the improved social force model of the train foldback station, improving the facility layout in the station, and realizing the passenger flow evacuation of the train foldback station under the condition of the subway sudden operation interruption. The invention can timely identify the bottleneck position of passenger flow evacuation in the foldback station, provides a scheme for improving the layout of facilities in the station, and provides decision basis for a subway management department to formulate a passenger flow evacuation scheme after the subway burst operation is interrupted.

title_en: Fireman fire-extinguishing protective clothing performance intelligent optimization system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of protective clothing performance optimization, and discloses an intelligent firefighter fire-extinguishing protective clothing performance optimization system based on artificial intelligence; the fire protection suit comprises a data acquisition module, an environment classification module, a layout optimization module and a design optimization module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring m groups of fire protection feature data, constructing a fire simulation model according to the m groups of fire protection feature data, the environment classification module is used for classifying the m groups of fire protection feature data into environment categories, the layout optimization module is used for optimizing the reflection layout parameters of each environment category based on the fire simulation model, and the design optimization module is used for optimizing the reflection design parameters of each environment category based on the fire simulation model and the reflection layout parameters.

title_en: Time axis driven fire fighting digital twin dynamic response and evolution method and equipment
