abstract_en: The application provides a time-axis-driven fire-fighting digital twin dynamic response and evolution method and equipment, which can provide real-time and accurate monitoring and emergency response support at each stage of fire disaster occurrence by combining a digital twin technology with time-axis-driven dynamic simulation, implement digital dynamic response and deduction for fire management and fire disaster emergency response, and enable fire departments and personnel to timely and accurately master fire disaster dynamics based on the realized fire-fighting digital twin when the fire disaster occurs, so as to avoid delay of the optimal time of the emergency response.

title_en: SHAP-HO-GRU interpretable drainage basin flood intelligent forecasting method based on rainfall classification
abstract_en: The invention relates to a SHAP-HO-GRU interpretable drainage basin flood intelligent forecasting method based on rainfall classification, which comprises the steps of 1) adopting a SOM and K-means two-stage clustering algorithm, classifying all rainfall according to the characteristics of the maximum hour rainfall, the total rainfall, the rainfall peak time, the rainfall duration proportion and the like of the rainfall, 2) dividing rainfall data of different types into a training set and a verification set to serve as model input, optimizing super parameters of a GRU model by using the HO algorithm, 3) evaluating forecasting accuracy of the flood forecasting model according to indexes such as CSI, NSE and RMSE, and 4) explaining and analyzing forecasting results of the GRU model through the SHAP model. The method not only improves the accuracy and efficiency of flood forecast in the river basin, but also enhances the interpretability of the forecast result, provides technical support for flood management and disaster prevention and reduction decision, can effectively improve the forecast accuracy of the GRU model, and quantitatively analyzes and interprets the forecast result.

title_en: Regional power load prediction method considering meteorological factors
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power load prediction and discloses a regional power load prediction method considering meteorological factors, which comprises the following steps of firstly, collecting a historical meteorological data set and a power disaster data set, and then adopting a plurality of analysis methods to process data; the method comprises the steps of collecting illumination intensity, precipitation, temperature, photoelectric plate orientation and angle, geographic position data and corresponding light energy power generation data, dividing a training set and a testing set after cleaning, adopting a BP neural network as a new energy resource prediction model for verification and evaluation, adopting a WRF numerical weather prediction model for simulating and forecasting a weather system, and constructing an early warning model according to a meteorological field in a simulation area to output early warning results, wherein the accuracy of deep learning prediction analysis is higher.

title_en: Landslide dynamic experiment simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landslide dynamic experiment simulation device which comprises an experiment slope seat, wherein an inclined landslide surface is arranged on the experiment slope seat, an ascending slope and a descending slope are arranged on the landslide surface, two sliding guide mechanisms are arranged between the descending slope and the landslide surface and used for sliding guide of the descending slope, and a slope sliding mechanism is arranged on the landslide surface and used for driving the descending slope to slide. The utility model comprises an experimental slope seat, an upward slope, a downward slope, a slope sliding mechanism and a sliding guide mechanism, wherein the slope sliding mechanism controls the dynamic sliding of the downward slope, and the sliding guide mechanism is matched with the slope sliding mechanism to conduct guiding sliding on the downward slope, so that different types of landslide phenomena can be better simulated. The utility model has small volume, easy control and accurate control, can simulate the dynamic behaviors of fine vibration, fine sliding down and the like in the landslide process, and provides a powerful experiment teaching tool for geological disaster research.

title_en: Coal mine disaster simulation prediction system based on multidimensional data collection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine disaster simulation prediction system based on multidimensional data collection, and relates to the technical field of coal mine safety. And integrating various monitoring devices such as geological radar, microseismic monitoring and the like, constructing a real-time monitoring network covering a coal mine key area, and comprehensively collecting multidimensional data. The system comprises modules of data preprocessing, model construction and training, prediction and decision making, early warning and emergency response, a user interaction interface and the like. The data are processed through the data cleaning, filtering, standardization and fusion technology, disaster prediction is carried out by utilizing a CNN and LSTM mixed model, disaster probability and risk areas are output, and early warning and emergency planning is automatically triggered. The user interaction interface displays real-time monitoring, prediction results and early warning information, and provides a comprehensive and intelligent solution for prevention and control of coal mine disasters.

title_en: Automatic safety protection system and method for wafer defect detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wafer defect detection, in particular to an automatic safety protection system and method for wafer defect detection equipment, which mainly comprise a hardware automatic protection system and a software monitoring and recording system, the hardware automatic protection system comprises a safety door state monitoring module, a safety door bypass module, an emergency response module, a vacuum state monitoring module, a compressed air state monitoring module, an automatic protection processing module, a motion control module and a light source control module. The system completely depends on hardware to realize an automatic safety protection function. The automatic protection process has no intervention of upper computer software or embedded software, and ensures real-time, rapid and reliable safety protection response. After the automatic protection is triggered, an operator confirms that the safety risk is relieved and the automatic protection system keeps the triggering state unchanged before the manual intervention operation is performed. Meanwhile, special application requirements of equipment maintenance personnel in equipment debugging and maintenance processes through professional training are met through control of the bypass switch.

title_en: Multi-dimensional data fusion disaster damage prediction method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The application provides a disaster damage prediction method and a disaster damage prediction system based on multidimensional data fusion of machine learning, which relate to the technical field of disaster damage prediction of a power distribution network, acquire data of different sources of the power distribution network and acquire multidimensional data of the power distribution network; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-dimensional data of a power distribution network, carrying out relevant screening on each disaster variable in the multi-dimensional data of the power distribution network to obtain a key disaster variable set, determining a key sample data set based on the key disaster variable set, dividing the key sample data set to obtain a training data set and a test data set, randomly sampling the training data set to obtain a plurality of training subsets, further determining sample dispersion corresponding to each training subset, constructing a disaster damage decision forest according to the test data set and the sample dispersion corresponding to each training subset, and carrying out disaster damage prediction on the power distribution network by using the disaster damage decision forest.

title_en: Method for identifying and forecasting strong convection based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorology, and discloses a method for identifying and forecasting strong convection based on deep learning, the method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a strong convection identification model and a prediction model which are respectively used for characteristic classification and weather occurrence time, place and strength prediction. Training the two models through a deep learning algorithm, and constructing a residual fitting model by utilizing the residual of the two models so as to correct the forecasting result. By combining real-time and historical meteorological data, the method can generate accurate strong convection weather identification and forecast, effectively make up the limitation of the traditional method, improve forecast precision and timeliness, and has important value for disaster prevention and reduction and ensuring stable social and economic development.

title_en: Method for identifying and regulating CO abnormal emission cause based on drilling gas extraction data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine gas extraction, in particular to a method for identifying and regulating the cause of abnormal emission of CO based on drilling gas extraction data, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting sequential drilling gas extraction data of a working surface similar to that of the existing engineering, setting a label for the carbon monoxide emission condition, S2, carrying out data processing, establishing a data set, dividing the data set into a test set, a verification set and a training set, S3, constructing a classification model based on a neural network, carrying out training and verification, S4, collecting the sequential drilling gas extraction data of the existing engineering, analyzing the sequential drilling gas extraction condition of the existing engineering by using the trained classification model, and S5, carrying out sequential drilling gas extraction regulation and control on the sequential drilling with the abnormal emission condition of CO based on the corresponding abnormal emission type of carbon monoxide. The method can quickly identify the disaster cause of abnormal carbon monoxide gushing through the existing bedding drilling gas extraction data, so that the method can be timely adjusted, and the effect of safe and efficient extraction can be achieved.
assignees: SHANXI YANGMEI SIJIAZHUANG COAL IND CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Asymmetric parameterized wind field early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of typhoon prevention, in particular to an asymmetric parameterized wind field early warning method and system, comprising the following steps of reading an input file; according to the information of the input file, the typhoon wind field information and grid distribution information are initialized and simulated for subsequent circular simulation, circular calculation is carried out according to the obtained variable information, calculation results are extracted and temporarily stored, drawing is carried out according to calculation results, and the method has the advantages that the method can be used for carrying out specific simulation on time series changes such as air pressure, wind speed and wind direction which are accompanied with the evolution process and the period of typhoons, further can be used for effectively evaluating the sweep range and influence degree of disasters such as storm tides and typhoons in coastal areas of China, so that disaster relief resources are reasonably allocated, sea defense engineering design standards are optimized, disaster prevention and reduction strategies are accurately formulated, and guarantee is provided for coastal city economic development.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring, in particular to a geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical mountain videos, obtaining a pre-constructed geological disaster detection network, wherein each convolution layer in the geological disaster detection network comprises a plurality of convolution kernel groups, each convolution kernel group comprises a transverse convolution kernel and a longitudinal convolution kernel, inputting historical mountain images with a preset number of frames in the historical mountain videos into the geological disaster detection network, carrying out convolution processing by using the transverse convolution kernels to obtain historical mountain images after transverse convolution, carrying out convolution processing by using the longitudinal convolution kernels to obtain historical mountain images after longitudinal convolution by using all the historical mountain images after transverse convolution obtained in the convolution kernel groups, constructing a first loss function, and carrying out network training control by using the first loss function to realize geological disaster monitoring. Accurate monitoring of geological disasters is achieved by adjusting network structures and loss functions.

title_en: Urban planning simulation system based on live-action three-dimension
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city planning simulation system based on live three-dimensional, which relates to the technical field of city planning and comprises a data acquisition module, a live three-dimensional and disaster simulation module, a comprehensive planning module and a comprehensive evaluation module; according to the invention, by utilizing a path planning algorithm, an area affected by the damaged infrastructure and the recovery time of the infrastructure are considered, so that an optimal emergency evacuation route is planned, the safety and feasibility of the evacuation route are ensured, the evacuation efficiency is greatly improved, meanwhile, the type and layout of the rescue facility are determined according to the emergency evacuation route planning result and the infrastructure toughness evaluation result, the service range and coverage degree of the rescue facility are analyzed through a geographic information system, the layout of the rescue facility is optimized, and the rescue resource is ensured to efficiently and accurately reach the disaster-affected area.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for predicting influence of maximum rain intensity time course distribution on flood peak flow
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for predicting the influence of maximum rain intensity time course distribution on flood peak flow, and relates to the field of hydrologic analysis and meteorological monitoring. According to the method, firstly, the rainfall field times of the hour-by-hour rainfall data in the historical time period are divided to obtain the hour-by-hour rainfall data of different historical rainfall fields, a time sequence database of the maximum rainfall intensity is constructed, then a probability density function of the maximum rainfall intensity time interval distribution is constructed based on the time sequence database of the maximum rainfall intensity, multiple times of flood peak flow simulation are carried out to obtain flood peak flow data of different maximum rainfall intensity positions, and the probability density function of the flood peak flow is constructed based on the flood peak flow data so as to calculate the probability of occurrence of flood disaster events. According to the method, the time course distribution of the maximum rain intensity is dynamically analyzed, so that the influence of the maximum rain intensity on the flood peak flow can be accurately estimated, the prediction accuracy of the flood peak flow is improved, the risk of flood disasters is reduced, and good social benefits and economic values are achieved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Disaster prevention and danger avoidance green land system layout optimization method and system based on multiple intelligent agents
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster prevention and danger avoidance green space system layout optimization method and system based on multiple intelligent agents, and relates to the technical field of urban planning. The method comprises the steps of receiving original geographic data in an area to be optimized, and preprocessing the original geographic data to form effective geographic data, wherein the original geographic data comprises original residential area data, original road network data and original disaster prevention and danger avoidance green land data. According to the invention, by introducing a multi-agent evacuation simulation model into the disaster-prevention danger-avoidance green land planning design and optimizing multiple targets such as road congestion, green land overload and the like during simulation, real-time escape conditions can be accurately simulated, real-time road disaster risks, escape crowd congestion risks and disaster-prevention danger-avoidance green land capacity overload risks during disaster are avoided, an optimal escape scheme is formulated, evacuation paths and strategies can be dynamically adjusted according to different emergency requirements, and an optimal scheme under the condition of multiple targets is formulated.

title_en: Reinforced learning-based elevator emergency rescue decision-making method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an elevator emergency rescue decision-making method and system based on reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of elevator emergency rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting elevator multi-mode data in real time through a distributed sensing network to generate an elevator state representation vector; the method comprises the steps of inputting an obtained elevator state characterization vector into a pre-trained graph convolution neural network model, starting an edge calculation unit to perform real-time simulation, simulating system response under different rescue strategies, evaluating feasibility of each rescue strategy, performing weighted fusion on the multidimensional risk score and the rescue strategy feasibility evaluation result to generate a risk evaluation report, sending a rescue instruction set to an elevator emergency rescue execution mechanism through a safety encryption channel, continuously monitoring real-time feedback information of the elevator emergency rescue execution mechanism, triggering a decision re-evaluation mechanism when abnormal conditions occur, until a passenger safety evacuation signal is received and the elevator system recovers a safety state signal, and completing rescue tasks.

title_en: Mine water disaster emergency management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management, and particularly discloses a mine water disaster emergency management system and method. The system comprises an information acquisition module, a dynamic monitoring module, a data management module, a space analysis module, a water damage early warning module and a dynamic monitoring module, wherein the information acquisition module acquires mine water damage position information, water damage data and mine GIS images in real time, the dynamic monitoring module extracts mine key characteristic changes in a preset time period to monitor mine states and acquire mine abnormal information according to mine state monitoring results, the data management module acquires historical mine water damage position information, historical water damage data and mine GIS images according to a mine rescue management platform to construct a mine three-dimensional simulation model, the historical mine water damage type is screened, the space analysis module carries out space matching analysis on image layer data of mine abnormal information and mine water damage type to acquire mine water damage space characteristics, and the water damage early warning module sends position early warning signals according to the mine water damage space characteristics and feeds back to the dynamic monitoring module to start a water damage emergency treatment plan so as to realize mine safety risk identification, mine disaster type early warning and recording treatment.
assignees: ORDOS GUOYUAN MINING DEV CO LTD;NORTH CHINA INST SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Unmanned plane dangerous rock detection device for geological disaster investigation
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle dangerous rock detection device for geological disaster investigation, which relates to geological disaster monitoring and early warning technology, and particularly discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, wherein a shell is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a guide cylinder communicated with the unmanned aerial vehicle main body is arranged on the side wall of the shell, a drilling tool is arranged in the guide cylinder in a penetrating manner, a drill bit is arranged at the tail end of the drilling tool, a slag discharging channel is arranged on the outer side wall of the drilling tool, a third driving mechanism for driving the drilling tool to rotate is arranged on the guide cylinder, a plurality of drilling rods are arranged on the shell and are detachably connected with the drilling tool, a positioning mechanism for driving the drilling rods to splice with the drilling tool is arranged in the shell, a material guide channel is arranged in the shell, a plurality of sensors are arranged in the material guide channel, a connecting rope is arranged between any two adjacent sensors, and a cutting device for cutting the connecting rope is arranged on the outer side wall of the material guide channel.

title_en: Strong typhoon wind speed and wind direction joint probability distribution generation method based on Monte Carlo Markov chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strong typhoon wind speed and wind direction joint probability distribution generation method based on a Monte Carlo Markov chain, which comprises the steps of firstly realizing simulation of typhoon wind field values through a Emanuel typhoon radial section model and a near-surface typhoon wind speed conversion method, as well as an average wind vertical section model and a pulsating wind model, then carrying out random simulation on a typhoon process by using a typhoon overall process random simulation method, analyzing simulation results, calculating typhoon positions of the next moment step, carrying out probability distribution calculation on the typhoon wind field on the basis of the simulation results to obtain wind speed extreme values and wind directions, and finally adopting a two-dimensional Gaussian non-parametric kernel density estimation method to construct a strong typhoon wind speed and wind direction joint probability model. The invention combines the typhoon process random simulation result and the typhoon wind field simulation method, provides a more scientific and practical solution for wind resistance evaluation of the engineering structure, and provides key data support for typhoon disaster vulnerability analysis of the engineering structure.
assignees: RES INST ECONOMICS & TECH STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multifunctional experimental system for road engineering in extreme environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional experimental system for road engineering in extreme environments, which comprises a model box, a loading assembly, a first temperature control system, a second temperature control system, a water supplementing system, a road assembly to be tested, a bottom heat-insulating plate, a precipitation system, a lighting system, a wind control system and an ultraviolet system, wherein the model box is connected with the loading assembly; the experimental system is mainly used for testing the service performance of the road structure in extreme environments (including plateau frozen soil environments and coastal damp and hot environments), can realize the precise control of environmental factors such as temperature, humidity, wind, rain, ultraviolet and the like through the combined action of the structures, can accurately simulate the extreme environments such as real plateau frozen soil, coastal damp and hot and various traffic loads, can acquire service state data of the road structure in real time, and provides a solid foundation for the related research of the damage disaster-causing mechanism, service life prediction and service toughness improvement of the road structure in the extreme environments.

title_en: Method and system for simulating unsteady catastrophe large deformation of dam under extreme working conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for simulating a dam instability and catastrophe large deformation under extreme working conditions, wherein the method comprises the steps of 1, constructing a solid model and dispersing the solid model into equidistant particle models, respectively endowing basic parameter values and setting particle types to each particle, 2, constructing a general constitutive model for representing the fluidization phase change behavior of a soil body, 3, respectively taking dam soil particles, dam block stone particles, vehicle particles and rolling stone particles as central particles, carrying out particle contact judgment, simulating the deformation behavior of the central particles based on the constructed general constitutive model for representing the fluidization phase change behavior of the soil body, and 4, carrying out visual output on the characteristic information of each central particle obtained by calculation. The invention establishes a dam instability catastrophe large deformation refined numerical simulation method considering the combined action of landslide disaster chain impact, vehicle load and barren rock impact, and can predict the dam stability and the subsequent large deformation damage whole process under extreme working conditions.

title_en: Fire emergency response capability assessment method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency response capability assessment method based on artificial intelligence, which utilizes an AI algorithm to automatically analyze and calculate assessment data, eliminates subjectivity of manual assessment, ensures objectivity and consistency of assessment results, enables training personnel to timely obtain feedback and adjust in practice and combat through real-time monitoring and assessment of performances of training personnel, improves emergency response effect, enhances pertinence of training and practice of the training personnel in the later period, comprehensively considers multiple factors such as physiological performances, action performances, voice communication and team cooperation, quantitatively assesses emergency response capability of individuals and teams from multiple dimensions, can more comprehensively reflect real capability of the training personnel, provides basis for personalized training, and can also adaptively adjust specific tasks and roles by introducing concept of task matching degree, thereby being beneficial to optimizing role allocation and improving overall efficiency of teams.

title_en: New energy system power supply capacity assessment and adjustment method based on weather
abstract_en: The application discloses a weather-based new energy system power supply capacity assessment and adjustment method, and relates to the technical field of new energy system power supply. The method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data of a research area, extracting extreme weather, constructing a disaster scene of an extreme weather and an electric power system, recording the scene as an extreme weather model, and carrying out confluence simulation according to the extreme weather model to obtain the water accumulation space distribution of the research area. The disaster scene of the system is simulated and deduced according to the water accumulation space distribution and recorded as a system disaster model, the system disaster model is combined with breadth-first traversal to find out the load loss node in the system, risk indexes are defined, risk assessment is carried out on the system disaster model according to the risk indexes and the load loss node to obtain the system risk degree, a corresponding rush repair adjustment scheme is set according to the system risk degree, and rush repair is carried out according to the rush repair adjustment scheme. The application improves the accuracy of the power supply capacity evaluation and adjustment of the new energy system.
assignees: CHAOYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Urban power supply risk assessment method and system under natural disaster effect
abstract_en: The invention provides a city power supply risk assessment method and system under the action of natural disasters, the method comprises the steps of collecting and checking power grid basic data in a preselected risk assessment area, screening risk assessment model data for city power supply risk assessment from the power grid basic data according to preset rules, obtaining risk assessment index values respectively output by the outage probability models based on pre-built city power grid element outage probability models based on disaster causing factors under different disasters, and outputting city power supply risk assessment results comprising power supply risk assessment results of power failure area space-time distribution by taking the risk assessment index values respectively output by the outage probability models, corresponding disaster causing factors and city power grid elements as inputs of pre-trained association relation models, wherein a training set of the association relation models comprises fusion codes of the disaster causing factors, the city power grid elements and the risk assessment index values and marked power failure area space-time distribution coding labels.
assignees: POWER EMERGENCY CENTER OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Analysis method and system based on seismic wave image
abstract_en: The invention provides an analysis method and system based on a seismic wave image, and relates to the technical field of seismic early warning. And sending the space-time characteristic data to a characteristic extraction model for processing, and extracting the space-time characteristic data. And analyzing the time-space characteristic data by utilizing multi-scale self-adaptive band-pass filtering to obtain the initial estimation position information of the seismic source. Based on the information, determining a historical reaction corresponding to the building structure, and training through a depth self-encoder network to obtain a nonlinear reaction model. And carrying out fractal dimension calculation on seismic wave data by utilizing a multi-fractal analysis method, generating a space influence diagram of a seismic source, extracting dominant frequency characteristics of the seismic source, and constructing a reaction prediction model by combining historical reaction information of a building structure. And predicting the reaction of the building structure in real time through the model, and carrying out earthquake damage early warning according to the prediction result. The invention can improve the precision and efficiency of earthquake disaster emergency response and enhance the safety of buildings.

title_en: Device for simulating whole process of landslide debris flow and debris flow river blocking disaster
abstract_en: The application provides a device for simulating the whole river blocking disaster process of landslide detritus and debris flow, which comprises a water tank assembly, a material box, a first water tank, a sedimentation tank, a measuring weir tank and a second water tank, wherein the water tank assembly comprises a main tank which is horizontally arranged, a branch tank is communicated with one side of the main tank in the length direction of the main tank, the branch tank is obliquely arranged towards one side of the main tank, the material box is movably arranged at the upstream of the branch tank, the first water tank is arranged at the upstream of the main tank, the sedimentation tank is arranged at one end of the main tank away from the first water tank, the measuring weir tank is arranged at one side of the sedimentation tank away from the main tank, and the second water tank is arranged at one side of the measuring weir Chi Yuan away from the sedimentation tank. The application not only can realize the simulation of the whole process and the whole service life of landslide river-blocking and debris flow river-blocking disasters, but also can research and observe the complete breaking process in the disaster-causing process of pregnant disasters, monitor key parameters of dynamics related to the whole process and the whole service life and environmental noise vibration signals in the formation and breaking processes of landslide debris flow or debris flow weir-blocking dams, thereby deepening understanding and understanding of the landslide debris flow river-blocking and debris flow river-blocking disasters and chains.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Submarine landslide simulation experiment device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a submarine landslide simulation experiment device and a submarine landslide simulation experiment method, which relate to the technical field of marine geological disaster simulation, wherein the submarine landslide simulation experiment device comprises a closed test box, and at least one side of the test box is provided with a visual structure; the seabed simulation assembly is arranged at the bottom of the test box and comprises a bearing piece, wherein the inclination of the bearing piece is adjustable, a sediment layer, a trap layer and a storage layer which are sequentially arranged on the bearing piece form a landslide body, the seabed water pressure simulation assembly, the water flow simulation assembly and the pore water pressure simulation assembly are arranged on the bearing piece, the measuring assembly comprises a camera module and a sensor module, the camera module is used for acquiring image information of the seabed simulation assembly through a visual structure, and the sensor module is used for acquiring pressure conditions in the test box and pressure conditions of the landslide body. The submarine landslide simulation experiment device can truly simulate a complex submarine environment, so that the accuracy of the experiment result on the prediction of the actual submarine landslide condition is improved.

title_en: Method for detecting hidden danger of power transmission line in wind disaster scene based on model light weight
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting hidden danger of a power transmission line in a wind disaster scene based on model light weight, which comprises the steps of constructing a hidden danger detection super network comprising a skeleton super network and a feature fusion super network, selectively removing unimportant candidate operations through intelligent cutting based on importance parameters, and optimizing a super network structure. Secondly, a numerical precision candidate set is defined according to the weight and the activation value of each layer, and random sampling and dynamic adjustment of numerical precision are carried out through a Gumbel-Softmax mechanism, so that the precision configuration of each layer of neural network is ensured to be self-adaptively optimized in the training process. And simplifying the skeleton super network and the feature fusion super network by a greedy algorithm to obtain the lightweight hidden danger detection model meeting the requirements of precision and computational complexity. The method can effectively reduce the calculation cost, improve the reasoning efficiency of the hidden danger detection model, and is suitable for embedded equipment with limited resources and edge calculation scenes.

title_en: Similar day clustering dividing method and system based on EV charging station operation state parameters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric vehicle charging station capacity adjustment, in particular to a similar day clustering and dividing method and system based on EV charging station operation state parameters. The method comprises the steps of taking state parameters of the running states of the charging stations on each typical day as a data base of clustering, defining a state parameter matrix describing the running states of the charging stations, carrying out first-layer scene classification on the state parameters on a macroscopic level, then carrying out scene clustering by adopting a deep learning algorithm to obtain a scene set formed by a plurality of different running scenes, constructing a deep convolution embedded clustering model, training, carrying out feature extraction and dimension reduction on original data of the running states of the charging stations in the scene set by utilizing a convolution self-encoder, carrying out clustering on flattened and dimension-reduced data by utilizing a K-means algorithm, and carrying out data visualization on the basis of a t-random adjacent embedding algorithm. The method improves the clustering accuracy and efficiency, and solves the problem of dimension disaster when the traditional clustering algorithm faces high-dimensional complex nonlinear data.

title_en: Method and apparatus for evaluating urgency levels of emergency alerts
title_ko: 재난 경보의 긴급성 평가를 위한 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method and an apparatus for evaluating the urgency of a disaster alert. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method for transmitting a disaster alert based on urgency evaluation comprises the steps of: inputting text data for a disaster alert to an urgency evaluation model; obtaining an urgency level for the text data as an output of the urgency evaluation model; and transmitting a disaster alert based on the urgency level. Here, the urgency evaluation model may be trained to calculate an urgency level according to an urgency score based on at least one of a word or a phrase included in the text data.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 재난 경보의 긴급성 평가를 위한 방법 및 장치에 대한 것이다. 본 개시의 실시예에 따른 긴급성 평가에 기반하는 재난 경보 발송을 수행하는 방법은, 재난 경보를 위한 텍스트 데이터를 긴급성 평가 모델에 입력하는 단계; 상기 긴급성 평가 모델의 출력으로서 상기 텍스트 데이터에 대한 긴급성 레벨을 획득하는 단계; 및 상기 긴급성 레벨에 기반하여 재난 경보 발송을 수행하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 여기서, 상기 긴급성 평가 모델은, 상기 텍스트 데이터에 포함되는 단어 또는 문구 중 적어도 하나에 기초하는 긴급성 점수에 따라 긴급성 레벨을 산출하도록 훈련될 수 있다.

title_en: Mobile Electric Vehicle Fighting System
title_ko: 이동식 전기차 소방시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to extinguish a fire by being dispatched in a short time when the fire occurs, and to prevent smoke as much as possible by covering suffocation fire-extinguishing artillery at the same time. The present invention relates to a movable electric vehicle firefighting system. The movable electric vehicle firefighting system comprises: a bogie moved and positioned below an electric vehicle and whose height is adjusted; and a drill module fixed to an upper plate of the bogie, in close contact with a battery pack disposed below the electric vehicle to punch a hole, and spraying firefighting water into the battery pack of the electric vehicle through the punched hole. The drill module includes a housing, a turbine, a cylindrical hole cutter, an elastic body, one or more firefighting water outlets, and an outlet.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 천공장치 및 물탱크가 구비된 이동수단을 통해 전기차 배터리에서 발생한 화재를 자동으로 진압하는 이동식 전기차 소방시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 전기차에 화재 발생 시 이동수단은 화재가 발생한 전기차로 이동하고 천공장치를 전기차 하부로 밀어 넣고 들어올려 천공장치를 전기차의 하부에 밀착시킨다. 천공장치의 하우징 내부에는 유압으로 구동되는 터빈과 터빈에 달린 드릴이 구비되고 하우징의 입구와 출구는 각각 배관으로 물탱크와 연결이 되고 입구로 들어가는 배관에는 물펌프가 구비되고 출구 배관에는 밸브가 구비된다. 물탱크에 저장된 소방수를 펌프를 통해서 강한 압력으로 하우징 내부로 주입시키면 수압에 의해서 터빈을 돌아가고 드릴이 돌아서 전기차 하부의 배터리팩을 천공한다. 이때, 하우징의 출구로 나오는 물은 물탱크로 회수되어 재활용 되게 된다. 이후 천공이 완료되면 밸브를 잠궈서 소방수는 물탱크로 회수되지 않고 천공된 홀을 통해서 전기차 배터리팩 내부로 주입되도록 구현함으로써 전기차에서 발생한 화재의 진원을 직접 진화할 수 있도록 하며 또한, 이 과정에 있어서 불필요한 소방수의 사용을 방지할 수 있도록 하여 보다 효율적으로 전기차를 소화하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Server and the conrolling method thereof for designing emergency response education contents based on virtual reality or augmented reality
title_ko: 가상현실 또는 증강현실을 기반으로 한 긴급상황 대처 교육 컨텐츠의 설계를 위한 서버 및 이의 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a specific and systematic design method and evaluation method of emergency situation coping education content based on virtual reality or augmented reality output to a wearable device or a display device so that a child's emergency situation coping ability is improved and accurate evaluation information is provided to perform feedback. The server comprises: a communication interface performing communication connection with a display device; a memory storing content for an emergency situation; and one or more processors connected to the memory to control the communication interface to transmit data of the content for the emergency situation to the display device.
abstract_ko: 서버 및 이의 제어 방법이 개시된다. 본 개시에 따른 서버는 디스플레이 장치와 통신 연결을 수행하는 통신 인터페이스; 긴급상황에 대한 컨텐츠를 저장하는 메모리; 및 메모리와 연결되어 디스플레이 장치로 긴급상황에 대한 컨텐츠의 데이터를 전송하도록 통신 인터페이스를 제어하는 하나 이상의 프로세서를 포함하고, 하나 이상의 프로세서는, 디스플레이 장치로부터 통신 인터페이스를 통해 복수의 긴급상황에 대한 컨텐츠 중 적어도 하나의 컨텐츠를 요청하는 신호가 수신되면, 통신 인터페이스를 통해 요청된 적어도 하나의 컨텐츠의 제1 시나리오에 대한 제1 데이터를 디스플레이 장치로 전송하고, 디스플레이 장치로부터 통신 인터페이스를 통해 제1 시나리오에 대한 디스플레이 장치와 사용자의 제1 인터랙션 정보가 수신되면, 통신 인터페이스를 통해 제1 인터랙션 정보에 대응되는 제2 시나리오에 대한 제2 데이터를 디스플레이 장치로 전송하고, 디스플레이 장치로부터 통신 인터페이스를 통해 제2 시나리오에 대한 디스플레이 장치와 사용자의 제2 인터랙션 정보가 수신되면, 제2 인터랙션 정보에 대한 제1 평가 정보를 산출하고, 통신 인터페이스를 통해 산출된 제1 평가 정보를 사용자 단말로 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide according to an embodiment that achieves ease-to-evacuate urban planning when a disaster occurs.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment comprises: a review unit; an arrangement unit; an improvement unit; and a simulation unit. The review unit is configured to review urban planning. The arrangement unit is configured to optimally arrange an evacuation facility on the basis of a result reviewed by the review unit. The improvement unit is configured to improve a road network on the basis of the evacuation facility arranged by the arrangement unit. The simulation unit is configured to simulate a human flow on the basis of the road network improved by the improvement unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Intelligent monitoring device for engineering disasters
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and particularly relates to an intelligent monitoring device for engineering disasters, which comprises a base, wherein a supporting rod is fixedly welded at the top end of the base, a monitoring component is arranged on the supporting rod, a plurality of positioning components penetrate through the base, after a drilling drum is rotationally drilled into the ground, spiral drilling lines and thread sections are embedded into the ground, the first time fixing is realized, a hand wheel is rotated, a stabilizing piece is rotated outwards and embedded into two sides, the contact area between the drilling drum and the ground is increased, the second time fixing is realized, external mortar enters through a first flow channel at the top of a rotating rod, mortar flows out through a first flow hole, the mortar enters into a gap between the stabilizing piece and soil, and meanwhile, the mortar of the drilling drum enters into a gap between the spiral drilling lines and the soil through a second flow channel, and after the mortar is solidified, the installation stability of the intelligent monitoring device for engineering disasters can be improved again.

title_en: Earthquake simulator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earthquake simulation device, and relates to the technical field of disaster simulation. The utility model comprises a base and a box body, wherein a movable groove is arranged on the upper side of the base, first electric push rods are slidably matched with the periphery of the inner wall of the movable groove, a bottom block is arranged in the movable groove, the output end of the first electric push rod is arranged on the corresponding side of the bottom block, a second electric push rod is arranged on the upper side of the bottom block, a connecting disc is arranged at the output end of the second electric push rod, the connecting disc is positioned below the box body, four third electric push rods are movably connected to the side parts of the connecting disc, and the output end of the third electric push rod is movably connected to the lower part of the box body. According to the utility model, the first electric push rod is matched with the bottom block, so that the box body can simulate multidirectional horizontal vibration conveniently, the second electric push rod can simulate vertical vibration conveniently, and the third electric push rod is matched with the connecting disc, so that the box body can simulate multidirectional inclined vibration conveniently.

title_en: Temperature sensing detector for detecting building fire-fighting facilities
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a temperature sensing detector for detecting a fire-fighting facility of a building, which comprises a moving vehicle, a mounting plate connected with the moving vehicle through a lifting mechanism, and a detection mechanism arranged on the mounting plate and used for carrying out distance changing and multidirectional detection on the temperature sensing detector, wherein the detection mechanism comprises a mounting pipe fixedly connected to one side of the mounting plate far away from the moving vehicle, the other end of the mounting pipe is fixedly connected with a circular plate, a plurality of L-shaped plates are arranged on a circumferential annular array of the circular plate, and a spray head is arranged at one end of each connecting pipe opposite to the other end of the circular plate. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the detection mechanism, the spray head is driven to gradually move close to the temperature sensing detector under the driving action of the driving mechanism, so that the distance-changing and multidirectional detection of the temperature sensing detector is realized, the condition that heat is spread and distributed in space when an actual fire disaster occurs is conveniently simulated, and the temperature sensing detector is subjected to single-side temperature change.

title_en: Landslide displacement prediction method for reservoir bank inspection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide displacement prediction method for reservoir bank inspection, which relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and comprises the following steps of collecting original data of geological conditions, meteorological monitoring and reservoir bank landslide body monitoring of reservoir bank inspection, and preprocessing the original data; extracting features related to landslide deformation modes from the preprocessed original data, integrating to obtain feature sets, and training the extracted features by adopting a support vector machine algorithm based on the related data of the feature sets. According to the landslide displacement prediction method for reservoir bank inspection, landslide deformation causes can be more comprehensively analyzed by combining geological conditions, meteorological monitoring and reservoir bank landslide body monitoring data, the possibility of landslide occurrence can be more accurately predicted by considering the influence of rainfall and earthquake on the landslide, and early warning can be carried out before landslide occurrence by setting a risk evaluation threshold value and evaluating different landslide risk grades, so that early identification of landslide risk is realized.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;POWERCHINA NORTHWEST ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery scheduling method, device, equipment, storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery switching scheduling method, which is used for solving the problems that the scheduling instruction is sent confusedly, the command efficiency is lower and the normal disaster recovery switching exercise progress is influenced because a plurality of departments and a plurality of task stages are needed to schedule at the same time by means of manual command in the conventional disaster recovery exercise. The method comprises the steps of determining a task to be executed corresponding to a disaster recovery scheduling instruction according to the received disaster recovery scheduling instruction, determining a task stage corresponding to the task to be executed in a disaster recovery switching exercise, determining a matched disaster recovery processing channel corresponding to the task to be executed according to the task stage, establishing communication connection with the matched disaster recovery processing channel, acquiring processing operation and processing progress corresponding to the task stage from the matched disaster recovery processing channel based on the communication connection, and visually displaying the processing flow of the task stage according to the processing operation and the processing progress.

title_en: Hierarchical safety early warning method based on intelligent power grid simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids and discloses a hierarchical safety early warning method based on intelligent power grid simulation, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting operation data of an intelligent power grid, including real-time monitoring data of voltage, current, power factor and temperature, and processing the collected operation data; S2, optimizing estimation of the state of the power grid by using an extended Kalman filtering algorithm, S3, establishing a nonlinear dynamic model of the intelligent power grid, predicting the health state of the power grid according to the dynamic behavior of the power grid, S4, establishing a Bayesian network model, evaluating the risk of the power grid through probabilistic reasoning, and judging the health state of the power grid. According to the intelligent power grid early warning system, intelligent, self-adaptive adjustment and real-time response capability of the power grid early warning system are realized by combining intelligent power grid simulation, deep reinforcement learning and self-adaptive optimal control, and the stability and emergency response efficiency of the power grid in a complex environment are improved.

title_en: Avalanche disaster vulnerability evaluation method and system based on GIS and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an avalanche disaster susceptibility evaluation method and system based on GIS and machine learning, which belong to the technical field of avalanche disaster susceptibility evaluation, wherein the method comprises the following steps of determining an influence factor causing avalanche occurrence in a target area according to topographic data, meteorological data and avalanche data of the target area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out correlation detection on a preliminarily selected influence factor causing avalanche occurrence, determining an evaluation factor, constructing a positive sample set and a negative sample set according to the evaluation factor and avalanche point data information of a target area, training a machine learning model according to the positive sample set and the negative sample set to obtain an avalanche susceptibility evaluation model after training, preparing an avalanche susceptibility partition map according to a prediction result of the avalanche susceptibility evaluation model, and determining avalanche susceptibility of each area.

title_en: Subway station emergency evacuation capacity simulation test method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a subway station emergency evacuation capacity simulation test method and related equipment, and relates to the field of subway station simulation methods. And carrying out overall modeling on the physical environment, personnel characteristics and obstacle influence of the subway station. The subway station model established based on the subway station data reflects the actual physical environment, the pedestrian streamline model considers three effects of destination attraction, crowd interaction and obstacle obstruction, and the people stream information extracted from the passenger stream data can accurately reflect the actual evacuation scene. The multi-factor comprehensive modeling method can truly simulate crowd behavior characteristics in the emergency evacuation process, avoid the defect that simple mathematical calculation ignores actual factors, and improve the accuracy of evacuation capacity assessment.

title_en: Broken rock fusion seepage test device for simulating roof water burst
abstract_en: The invention provides a broken rock body fusion seepage test device for simulating roof water bursting, which belongs to the technical field of coal mining, and comprises a water burst simulation system, a broken rock body multi-flow seepage system and a data acquisition and analysis system, wherein the water burst simulation system is used for continuously outputting constant-pressure water flow or non-continuously outputting water flow, the broken rock body multi-flow seepage system comprises a first bin body, a second bin body and a third bin body which are sequentially communicated, the data acquisition and analysis system comprises a collecting unit and an analysis unit which are arranged below the third bin body, the collecting unit is provided with a filtering part, a water collecting part and a weighing part, the analysis unit is electrically connected with the water burst simulation system, the broken rock body multi-flow seepage system and the weighing part to analyze water damage disaster formation seepage parameters, and the data acquisition and analysis system is used for simulating a water disaster formation mechanism of continuous high water burst of a water bearing layer of a huge-thickness sandstone roof in the mining process, finding out a water separation layer-underground water burst disaster causing criterion and providing seepage parameters for numerical simulation of water damage formation disaster formation.

title_en: Method and system for calibrating rainfall gauge for monitoring railway weather disasters on line
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for calibrating a rain gauge for monitoring railway weather disasters on line, which relate to the field of railway equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: and (3) in a standard environment, calibrating the simulated rainfall device in a test area, after calibrating, moving the calibrated simulated rainfall device to a calibration position, simulating rainfall, obtaining the measured rainfall of the measured rainfall meter, carrying out comparison calibration of the measured rainfall meter according to the first standard rainfall, or obtaining real-time environment information in a field environment, judging whether the measured rainfall meter meets the requirement of the calibration environment, if so, obtaining the rainfall loss ratio according to the real-time environment information, controlling the simulated rainfall device to simulate rainfall at the standard position, obtaining the second standard rainfall through the standard measuring cylinder, controlling the simulated rainfall device to simulate rainfall at the calibration position, obtaining the measured rainfall of the measured rainfall meter, and carrying out comparison calibration of the measured rainfall meter by combining the rainfall loss ratio and the second standard rainfall.

title_en: Performance evaluation optimization method of dual-channel communication in distribution automation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance evaluation optimization method of double-channel communication in distribution automation, which comprises the following steps of determining specific requirements on communication performance, including requirements on bandwidth, delay, reliability and fault tolerance, designing a reasonable network topology structure, selecting double-channel communication equipment, network protocol and network topology to meet the communication requirements, adopting SM2 national encryption algorithm to carry out safe access and identity authentication, and simultaneously, implementing bidirectional identity authentication of a master station and a terminal to enhance the safety and ensure the legality and the safety of both communication parties. According to the invention, by introducing the dual-channel communication system, the robustness and disaster resistance of the power system are greatly improved, so that the reliability of power supply is further ensured, and meanwhile, by simulating bad weather and the like and performing automatic performance test and debugging, the optimal scheme can be quickly obtained while the debugging efficiency is improved, and the system stability is ensured.
assignees: HEBI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Distributed system disaster recovery fault drilling method and device based on chain tracking
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a distributed system disaster recovery fault drilling method, a device, electronic equipment and a readable medium based on chain tracking, which relate to the technical field of cloud computing and comprise the steps of inserting a custom observation probe into a source code; the method comprises the steps of monitoring dynamic context information when a program runs through a custom observation probe, exporting the dynamic context information into a log file, capturing the change condition of the log file by arranging an agent program in a distributed system, performing fault injection, recording flow data of a production environment, storing the flow data into mirror image flow, replaying the mirror image flow in a disaster recovery environment to generate a service logic link panorama, wherein the service logic link panorama comprises a normal service logic link panorama and an abnormal service logic link panorama, and comparing the normal service logic link panorama with the abnormal service logic link panorama to perform fault diagnosis. The invention can improve the fault coverage and the fault discovery accuracy.

title_en: Method for establishing simplified generation model of near-span fault earthquake multipoint excitation pile soil effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a model with simplified action of near-span fault earthquake multipoint excitation pile soil and the like, which deeply fuses space non-uniformity characteristics of earthquake wave propagation, a complex dynamic interaction mechanism of a pile soil interface and an amplification effect of far-field soil on earthquake response, and realizes accurate depiction of dynamic response of a structure close to or crossing a fault bridge under the action of strong earthquake. The model not only greatly improves the simulation efficiency, but also remarkably enhances the accuracy of the prediction result, provides scientific basis and practical tools for bridge engineers in anti-seismic design and performance evaluation, and effectively promotes the improvement of the earthquake disaster prevention capability in the bridge engineering field.

title_en: Disaster recovery system, disaster recovery scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery scheduling method, which is used for solving the problems that the existing disaster recovery drilling is low in drilling efficiency and poor in drilling result accuracy due to the fact that the existing disaster recovery drilling depends on manual command, and the departments involved in the disaster recovery switching process are wide, the number of people is large, and the technical operation complexity is high. The disaster recovery scheduling method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster recovery scheduling instructions, determining disaster recovery processing parties corresponding to the disaster recovery scheduling instructions, sending the disaster recovery scheduling instructions to the disaster recovery processing parties, obtaining disaster recovery processing progress and disaster recovery processing results of the disaster recovery processing parties responding to the disaster recovery scheduling instructions to execute disaster recovery processing, and carrying out visual display on the disaster recovery processing flow according to the disaster recovery processing progress and the disaster recovery processing results.

title_en: Method and system for assessing geological disaster risk of high-pressure pole tower of river basin constructed based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster prevention and control evaluation, in particular to a river basin high-voltage tower geological disaster risk evaluation method based on a complex network. The method has the beneficial effects that disaster dangers of a plurality of specific facilities in the area can be rapidly analyzed, and the simulation calculation result is closer to the real data.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamics simulation method suitable for fire-extinguishing bag cluster air drop
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic simulation method suitable for air drop of a fire extinguishing bag cluster, which comprises the following steps: the method can accurately simulate the distribution of the falling points of the fire extinguishing bags, optimize the allocation of fire extinguishing resources, dynamically adjust the throwing strategy of the fire extinguishing bags according to the real-time meteorological data and the change of fire scene, enable the fire extinguishing actions to rapidly respond to the change of the scene condition, greatly improve the flexibility and the effectiveness of the fire extinguishing actions, and provide powerful decision support for firefighters.
assignees: BOERDE AEROSPACE TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Method for determining slope stability based on pore ratio and liquid index
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining slope stability based on a void ratio and a liquid index, which comprises the steps of firstly sampling a slope soil layer, secondly measuring key parameters of the soil layer sample and constructing a soil layer sample database, thirdly measuring shear strength of the soil layer sample, fourthly utilizing finite element analysis to determine the stability of the slope corresponding to the soil layer sample, fifthly verifying the slope stability, sixthly building and training a slope stability prediction model, and seventhly determining the stability of an actual slope based on the void ratio and the liquid index. According to the invention, the slope stability is evaluated through the moisture content, the void ratio and the liquid index of the soil, the void ratio directly influences the density and the water permeability of the soil, the liquid index reflects the capability of the soil to be converted into a flowing state from a plastic state, the slope stability is evaluated more accurately, the safety of slope engineering is further improved, the potential geological disaster risk is reduced, and theoretical basis and technical support are provided for practical engineering.

title_en: Method for analyzing temperature field of concrete box girder structure under high-temperature action of fire disaster
abstract_en: The application provides a method for analyzing a temperature field of a concrete box girder structure under the action of high temperature of fire, which comprises the steps of determining a heat transfer constitutive relation of concrete materials in the concrete box girder structure, determining thermal parameters of the concrete materials in the concrete box girder structure, wherein the thermal parameters comprise heat conductivity coefficients, specific heat capacities, densities and elastic moduli of the concrete materials, establishing a space finite element model of the concrete box girder, assigning values to the concrete materials in different areas in the finite element model by referring to the thermal parameters and the heat transfer constitutive relation, dividing grid units in the finite element model, determining fire parameters, applying the fire parameters to the finite element model, and analyzing the temperature field of the concrete box girder. The method for analyzing the temperature field of the concrete box girder structure under the action of fire high temperature can more accurately simulate the thermal response condition of concrete in a fire high temperature scene and provide reliable basis for structural safety evaluation.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST

title_en: Building flooding disaster treatment method and system based on free surface simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building flooding disaster treatment method and system based on free surface simulation, and belongs to the technical field of flood disaster prevention. The existing flooding disaster treatment scheme does not disclose how to predict the flooding disasters inside the building and how to treat the flooding disasters inside the building, so that the normal use or operation of the building is affected. According to the building flooding disaster treatment method based on free surface simulation, the building object generation model, the building flow field simulation model, the indoor water level calculation model and the door opening and closing control model are constructed, and the simulation calculation is carried out on the flooding situation inside the building by combining computational fluid mechanics and a free surface algorithm, so that the interaction of the geometric structure and the fluid mechanics characteristic of the building can be accurately represented, the water flow situation under the flooding accident inside the building can be comprehensively known, the flooding disaster inside the building can be timely treated, and the normal use or operation of the building can be ensured.

title_en: Natural disaster self-rescue training experience system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer processing, and discloses a natural disaster self-rescue training experience system, which comprises a storage module, a module calling and demonstrating module, a disaster simulation module, a top-emperor visual angle prompt module and an external equipment linkage module, wherein the storage module is used for storing a pre-established three-dimensional disaster model, the module calling and demonstrating module is used for calling the determined three-dimensional disaster model and generating a derivative role positioned in the three-dimensional disaster model, the disaster simulation module is used for triggering instruction conditions established in a scene of the three-dimensional disaster model based on the movement of the role positioned in the three-dimensional disaster model and generating disaster threats according to simulation, and the top-emperor visual angle prompt module is used for selecting self-rescue prompts according to the type of the disaster threats when the role is triggered and is threatened by the disaster. The invention can construct scientific disaster accident scene based on three-dimensional modeling and VR technology, and combines the linkage of external hardware equipment to realize multi-mode somatosensory interaction of vision, hearing, touch and the like, thereby effectively improving the self-rescue capability of users.
assignees: JINSHI SHANZHI TIANJIN EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Identification method, system and electronic equipment for rainfall-driven snow-melting disaster in alpine and short-of-land data mountain area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of snow-melting disasters, and provides a method, a system and electronic equipment for identifying rainfall-driven snow-melting disasters in alpine-lack data mountain areas, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting meteorological observation sequence data in a set time period in the alpine mountain areas; the method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological observation sequence data through multi-dimensional feature extraction, obtaining multi-dimensional meteorological feature sequence data through multi-dimensional feature extraction of the meteorological observation sequence data, obtaining discrimination results of single-point snow-surface rain and snow-melting disasters in a alpine region through inputting the multi-dimensional meteorological feature sequence feature data into a pre-trained machine learning discrimination model, and obtaining discrimination results of regional snow-surface rain events in a set time period in the alpine mountain region based on the discrimination results of the single-point snow-surface rain and snow-melting disasters in the alpine region and simulation results of regional climate mode weather.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: LSTM-based river ice state prediction method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of ice condition prediction, in particular to a river ice condition state prediction method based on LSTM, which comprises the steps of collecting river ice condition data, constructing river ice condition characteristics and river ice condition states, and obtaining sample data; dividing sample data into a training set and a testing set, respectively preprocessing, constructing an LSTM river ice prediction model based on a physical mechanism of river ice prediction, initializing model parameters, carrying out iterative training on the prediction model by using the training set until convergence, carrying out precision evaluation on the prediction model based on the testing set and a preset precision evaluation index, carrying out model parameter tuning on the prediction model based on a precision evaluation result, and inputting river ice data of a target river into the prediction model to obtain a prediction result of the river ice state of the target river. The method can rapidly predict the ice state of the river channel and the date of opening and closing the river in a certain period in the future, and has important significance for preventing the ice and reducing the disaster.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method and device based on superposition integration strategy
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of landslide hazard risk assessment, in particular to a landslide vulnerability assessment method and device based on an overlapped integration strategy, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting at least one landslide vulnerability assessment factor in a preset space scale based on a target landslide list and a target landslide hazard point distribution map to construct a training data set and a testing data set to train and test a plurality of target basic assessment models so as to obtain landslide vulnerability index diagrams of the plurality of target basic assessment models, and determining the assessment precision of each target basic assessment model; and determining a final evaluation model based on a preset integration strategy and evaluation precision, so as to draw a final landslide susceptibility differential graph of the target area by using the final evaluation model. The application can integrate various basic models, can exert the performance of each basic model to the maximum degree under different scenes, solves the problem of selecting an evaluation method while guaranteeing the accuracy of an evaluation result, and provides data guarantee for early warning and prevention and control of landslide disasters.

title_en: Logistics support dynamic scheduling and emergency response system based on intelligent data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a logistic guarantee dynamic scheduling and emergency response system based on intelligent data fusion, which relates to the technical field of logistic guarantee and comprises a data acquisition module, a data fusion and processing module, a scene prediction and simulation module, a privacy protection cooperative scheduling module, a game optimization scheduling module, a transparent resource tracking module, a self-adaptive network optimization module and an ethical priority scheduling module, wherein the data acquisition module is responsible for collecting relevant data, and the data fusion and processing module is used for integrating and processing data.
assignees: ARMY SERVICE ACAD OF CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY

title_en: Real-time and efficient river basin flood inundation simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time and efficient river basin flood inundation simulation method and a system, which relate to the technical field of flood simulation, and the method is characterized in that multi-source data such as hydrology, remote sensing, weather, topography and the like are collected in real time, and cleaning, interpolation processing and format standardization are carried out; the system integrates multi-source data to generate a high-precision data set by utilizing a data fusion technology and a dynamic weight distribution algorithm, dynamically adjusts the weight of each data source according to the real-time property, the precision and the space coverage of the data, quantifies related coefficients by considering factors such as gradient, elevation, land utilization type and the like, estimates the submerged range and the water depth distribution in a river basin, and performs visual display and early warning release through a GIS technology. In addition, the invention effectively improves the real-time performance and accuracy of flood simulation, enhances the flood early warning and emergency response capability, and provides powerful support for decision makers.
assignees: HUNAN SHUNWANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digitization method of urban security risk assessment standard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digitizing method of urban security risk assessment standards, which comprises the steps of identifying risk factors for historical accident time sequence data, carrying out relevance analysis to obtain a relevance function, further constructing an urban network topology structure, determining prior probability of nodes according to similarity of the nodes and pre-disaster data, generating a simulated accident scene, adding disturbance items to simulate burst risks, combining the prior probability of the nodes to obtain a risk propagation path, constructing a risk assessment model, assessing space-time influence ranges of the nodes on the propagation path, and carrying out weighted summation on assessment results of the nodes to obtain an urban security risk assessment result. The method is used for constructing the network topology structure by multi-stage analysis of the historical accident data, so that the risk propagation simulation is more accurate, the urban risk assessment can be accurately quantized, and meanwhile, the method has better interpretability.

title_en: Lithium battery thermal runaway fire disaster identification method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a lithium battery thermal runaway fire disaster identification method and system, and relates to the technical field of lithium battery monitoring. The method comprises the steps of collecting historical acoustic signals of a plurality of lithium batteries in different states in real time through an acoustic sensor, preprocessing and converting each historical acoustic signal to obtain normalized logarithmic Mel frequency spectrograms, forming a data set by all normalized logarithmic Mel frequency spectrograms and the states of the lithium batteries, training MobileViT models, collecting real-time acoustic signals of the lithium batteries to be tested through the acoustic sensor, preprocessing and converting the real-time acoustic signals to obtain normalized logarithmic Mel frequency spectrograms of the real-time acoustic signals, inputting the normalized logarithmic Mel frequency spectrograms of the real-time acoustic signals into a trained MobileViT model to obtain a thermal runaway fire identification result of the lithium batteries to be tested, wherein the thermal runaway fire identification result is fire or non-fire. The application can rapidly and accurately identify the thermal runaway fire disaster of the lithium battery.
assignees: CHINA PEOPLES POLICE UNIV THE MINISTRY OF PUBLIC SECURITY PUBLIC SECURITY COOPERATION COLLEGE CHINA

title_en: Fire risk assessment and personnel evacuation prediction method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire risk assessment and personnel evacuation prediction method, equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the field of fire risk prediction, wherein the method firstly establishes a fire risk assessment model and then establishes an evacuation simulation model, the key parameters in the evacuation simulation process are determined by setting three aspects of the number of evacuees, the attributes of the evacuees and the evacuation time, so that fire evacuation risk assessment and prediction are performed. The method adopts a multi-stage extension evaluation method to evaluate fire risks and adopts Pathfinder evacuation simulation software to establish a personnel evacuation model.
