Meanwhile, by improving CRITIC weighting method, fire evacuation risk assessment is more scientific and accurate. The invention can effectively improve the efficiency of fire emergency response and reduce the harm of fire to personnel life and property.
assignees: CHENGDU HIGH TECH VISION DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide hazard prediction method and device combining machine learning and physical mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide disaster prediction method and device combining machine learning and a physical mechanism, which relate to the technical field of landslide disaster prediction and comprise the steps of acquiring a basic landslide disaster data set of a target area; the landslide disaster prediction method comprises the steps of inputting a basic landslide disaster data set into a pre-built combined model, identifying landslide identification results in a target area according to the basic landslide disaster data set through a landslide identification model, simulating a dynamic landslide disaster evolution process in the target area according to the basic landslide disaster data set and the landslide identification results through a landslide fine analysis model to obtain landslide simulation results, and fusing the landslide identification results and the landslide simulation results to obtain landslide disaster prediction results corresponding to the target area. The invention can more accurately and efficiently predict the future landslide hazard condition.

title_en: Collapse resistance performance test system capable of realizing real-time coupling of fire and impact
abstract_en: The invention relates to a collapse resistance test system capable of realizing real-time coupling of fire and impact, which comprises a movable drop hammer impact device, a fire heating device, a boundary constraint device and a loading control and data acquisition device, wherein the movable drop hammer impact device is used for applying impact load at any position to a three-column two-beam substructure model, the fire heating device is used for heating the substructure model to simulate a real fire scene, the boundary constraint device is used for providing different boundary constraint conditions for the substructure model, and the loading control and data acquisition device is used for controlling the fire heating and drop hammer impact process and acquiring test data. The invention can realize the collapse resistance test research of the three-column two-beam substructure model under the real-time coupling of fire and impact, consider the influence of boundary constraint on the collapse resistance of the substructure model, and realize the random change of the impact position of the drop hammer, thereby meeting the diversity requirement of the collapse resistance test under the multi-disaster coupling.

title_en: Environment ground disaster emergency early warning method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environmental ground disaster emergency early warning method, device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining historical ground disaster cause graphs and real-time ground disaster cause graphs of different types of ground disaster cause characteristics, segmenting the historical ground disaster cause graphs, marking the historical segmented images according to the ground disaster cause characteristics, constructing different types of data sets, training a preset deep convolutional neural network model to obtain feature models of different types and with different model weights, inputting the real-time segmented images into the feature models of the corresponding types, fusing the output of the feature models of the different types to obtain fused images, restoring the fused images according to position information, expanding the feature confidence graphs, carrying out region merging on the feature region graphs of the different types, and judging the ground disaster risk information according to preset dangerous tag criteria and dangerous feature graphs. The invention has high early warning efficiency and low labor cost, and can realize real-time early warning.
assignees: SICHUAN JINGWEI WANDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Indoor fire source positioning method based on infrared thermal image of outer surface of glass curtain wall
abstract_en: An indoor fire source positioning method based on an infrared thermal image of the outer surface of a glass curtain wall comprises the steps of constructing a database, constructing a fire disaster data set, temperature distribution of the outer surface of the glass curtain wall, extracting and processing images, constructing and training Resnet a deep learning model, and positioning the fire source by utilizing the Resnet deep learning model. In the early stage of fire development, when the fire condition of the fire disaster of the super high-rise building is detected, a detection unmanned aerial vehicle carrying an infrared thermal imager is controlled to fly outside a glass curtain wall of a fire floor, the position of the detection unmanned aerial vehicle is adjusted to obtain an infrared thermal image of the outer surface of the glass curtain wall with the complete fire floor, the infrared thermal image of the outer surface of the glass curtain wall obtained by the infrared thermal imager is input into a trained Resnet-50 deep learning model, the model is analyzed to give the position number of a fire source, the fire source position is accurately identified in the early stage of fire disaster development, the real-time reliability is high, and the fire early warning capability and rescue efficiency of the super high-rise building are improved.

title_en: Dynamic digital plan simulation and analysis system for multiple scenes
abstract_en: The application provides a dynamic digital plan simulation and analysis system for multiple scenes, which relates to the field of intelligent data analysis, and adopts a data processing technology based on machine learning to carry out semantic embedded coding on a digital plan to be applied and each accident information, so as to automatically generate a disaster level evolution trend label according to prior mode cross-domain fusion expression between semantic embedded features of the digital plan to be applied and semantic embedded features of each accident information. Therefore, by combining the digital plan information and the real-time accident information, the accident development dynamics can be predicted more accurately, and further the method is beneficial to flexibly adjusting the coping strategy to adapt to the actual development of the accident, and is beneficial to realizing more effective emergency management.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YONGBANG EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Opportunistic network link prediction method based on time sequence diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an opportunistic network link prediction method based on a time sequence diagram neural network, which particularly relates to the technical field of time sequence diagram neural networks, and comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and network snapshot generation; S2, weighting characteristic coding aggregation, S3, GAT and LSTM combined processing embedding, S4, multi-layer perception computer probability, S5, training and adjusting parameters according to a link structure loss function, S6, dividing and collecting, and S7, multi-index evaluation of an optimal model. According to the invention, the space-time characteristics of the nodes are precisely captured, the embedded, encoded and decoded layers cooperatively operate, the link prediction accuracy and stability are improved, the network communication reliability and the data transmission success rate are stabilized, a loss function and an optimization strategy are innovated, the difficult problems of data sparseness and over fitting are solved, the generalization capability is enhanced, the model is adapted to the multi-domain network, the link is precisely predicted in the scenes of intelligent traffic, disaster relief and the like, the resource allocation and the communication efficiency are optimized, and the innovative development of the multi-industry network application is forcefully promoted.

title_en: Geological disaster crack measuring device based on laser measurement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser ranging, in particular to a geological disaster crack measuring device based on laser measurement, which comprises a mounting bottom plate, wherein the top of the mounting bottom plate is fixedly connected with a fixing pile, the inner top wall of the fixing pile is fixedly connected with a first servo motor, the output end of the first servo motor is provided with a driving rod, when the device is used, a circular electric guide rail drives a sliding block which is arranged in a sliding manner on the inner wall to move, the sliding block drives the laser measuring mechanism on the top to randomly adjust the angle measurement distance, a threaded rod drives the threaded sleeve which is in threaded connection with the surface to adjust the height, a connecting rod and a limiting rod synchronously rotate along with the threaded rod, then a drill bit at the bottom end of the connecting rod is driven to rotate, and the threaded sleeve drives the drill bit at the bottom end to adjust the height, then the drill bit downwards rotates and drills, so that the device is integrally and conveniently fixed to the ground, and the effect of conveniently fixing the laser measuring device is achieved.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL LAND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION CENTER SHANDONG PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER

title_en: Disaster hidden danger identification method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster hidden danger identification method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a hidden danger data set of a real disaster; the hidden danger data set is converted into a fine-tuning instruction prompt set, the instruction prompt set comprises various different types of disaster samples and labels, the disaster samples comprise pictures and texts, the instruction prompt set is utilized to fine-tune the multi-modal large model to obtain a fine-tuned multi-modal large model, and the disaster pictures and the disaster texts to be identified are input into the fine-tuned multi-modal large model to identify whether disasters exist or not. According to the method, through knowledge enhancement, hidden danger content, metaphor recognition and other various instruction data, the multi-mode large model is finely adjusted, the generation capacity of the large model for hidden danger judgment is improved, and finally, a prompt learning mechanism is utilized to conduct self-prediction iterative expansion training so that the model is further adapted to a specific task, and therefore accuracy and efficiency of disaster hidden danger recognition are improved.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Nuclear power abnormal event intelligent identification and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an intelligent nuclear power abnormal event identification and early warning method which comprises the following steps of preprocessing collected nuclear power historical operation data, carrying out big data processing and analysis on the preprocessed nuclear power historical operation data, extracting key characteristics and rule information of nuclear power abnormal events to form training set data, training a machine learning model through the training set data, constructing a nuclear power abnormal event identification model, monitoring the nuclear power operation data in real time through the nuclear power abnormal event identification model, identifying nuclear power abnormal events in the nuclear power operation data, sending early warning information to related personnel when the nuclear power abnormal event identification model identifies the nuclear power abnormal events, and starting emergency measures according to a preset emergency response plan. The invention also relates to a nuclear power abnormal event intelligent identification and early warning device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The nuclear power abnormal event accurate capturing and real-time early warning method is based on big data analysis and machine learning technology.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION TECHNOLOGY CORP LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: To simulate group psychology in advertising, event measures, disaster countermeasures, etc.SOLUTION: Provided is a system for simulating group psychology, the system comprising: means for estimating human psychology using a GPT; means for generating a character's psychology by giving the character characteristics; and means for generating group psychology by inputting a group's characteristics.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Flood prediction method and system based on LSTM-MHA model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood prediction method and a system based on an LSTM-MHA model, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting and simulating data of an area to be researched, and constructing a composite flood simulation model of the area to be researched; the method comprises the steps of carrying out simulation analysis on the stormwater and tide level data of different spatial features of an area to be researched, constructing a stormwater-tide level-waterlogging data set of the area to be researched, carrying out interpretability analysis through a SHAP algorithm, constructing a multi-mode stormwater sample data set of the area to be researched, introducing an LSTM layer and a multi-head attention layer, constructing an LSTM-MHA model, and carrying out stormwater flood prediction on the multi-mode stormwater sample data set of the area to be researched. The invention can unlock the contribution degree of the input factors of the LSTM-MHA model, fully considers the combined action and time sequence relation of the rain and tide driving factors in the flood process, and further improves the prediction precision of the water depth of the storm flood. The method and the system for predicting the flood based on the LSTM-MHA model can be widely applied to the technical field of flood disaster prediction.
assignees: GUANGDONG RES INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Landslide susceptibility evaluation method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide susceptibility evaluation method based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of determining evaluation indexes and grading standards, constructing and obtaining a landslide susceptibility evaluation model, wherein the landslide susceptibility evaluation model comprises a random forest model, a model hyper-parameter optimization module and a linear weighted combination model, training the landslide susceptibility evaluation model by adopting a training sample set to obtain the trained landslide susceptibility evaluation model, and predicting the landslide susceptibility level of each evaluation unit in a research area. The invention provides a landslide susceptibility evaluation method based on machine learning, which utilizes a random forest model to accurately obtain the weight of each evaluation factor, and then carries out linear weighting on each evaluation factor in an evaluation unit, so that the obtained comprehensive information magnitude can more accurately reflect the landslide susceptibility grade of the evaluation unit, improve the accuracy of landslide susceptibility results, and further provide a reliable basis for landslide disaster risk evaluation and management.

title_en: Geological strength evaluation method based on hyperspectral-digital coupling borehole imaging technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological strength evaluation method based on hyperspectral-digital coupling drilling imaging technology, which comprises the steps of obtaining hyperspectral pictures and drilling images of carbonate rock cores to be tested, preprocessing the hyperspectral pictures to obtain preprocessed hyperspectral images, obtaining a mineral spectrum library, matching the preprocessed hyperspectral images with the mineral spectrum library to obtain mineral category information, obtaining a rock mass integrity index according to the drilling images, obtaining carbonate mineral content according to the preprocessed hyperspectral images, calculating strength reduction coefficients according to the carbonate mineral content and the mineral category information, calculating geological strength indexes according to the strength reduction coefficients and the rock mass integrity index, and evaluating the geological strength of river bank slope carbonate rock according to the geological strength indexes. The method can avoid the defects of the traditional GSI evaluation method, reduces the risk of instability of the slope rock mass, has high evaluation precision, and provides data support for preventing and treating geological disasters.

title_en: Mine rescue training simulation device and simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue training, in particular to a mine rescue training simulation device and a simulation method. The device comprises a departure hall, an arrival hall and a simulation system arranged between the departure hall and the arrival hall, wherein the simulation system comprises a path subsystem and a simulation unit, the path subsystem comprises a main roadway and a plurality of secondary roadways connected with the main roadway, the simulation unit comprises a simulation room, a simulation scene is arranged in the simulation room, the simulation scene can be changed according to actual needs, and each secondary roadway is communicated with a plurality of simulation rooms. The main roadway and the multiple secondary roadways are arranged to be connected with the multiple simulation rooms, simulation scenes can be changed, abundant and various rescue simulation environments and path selections are constructed, the rescue workers are prevented from forming fixed thinking and muscle memory, the capability of coping with different disaster positions and types in complex and changeable mine environments is exercised, the reality and effectiveness of training are improved, and the rescue workers are more suitable for the diversity and uncertainty of actual rescue work.

title_en: Digital port intelligent closing method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital port intelligent closing method and system based on artificial intelligence, the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data, and generating a closing-reporting data stream through data base standardization processing; the method comprises the steps of predicting risk by utilizing federal learning, generating a checking scheme by reinforcement learning, verifying document logic by combining blockchain verification document consistency, OCR and knowledge graph verification document, dynamically adjusting cargo allocation strategy, simulating emergency response by digital twin, and finally generating a full-flow visual supervision view. The invention can improve the clearance efficiency, the risk prevention and control capability and the emergency response level.

title_en: High-steep rock slope dangerous rock mass identification method based on unmanned aerial vehicle thermal infrared image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous rock mass slope identification method based on unmanned aerial vehicle thermal infrared images, which comprises the following steps of S1, generating a flight route, S2, collecting infrared images and visible light aerial images of a target area, S3, generating a three-dimensional geographic information model based on the visible light aerial images, determining labeling standards of the three-dimensional geographic information model based on the infrared images, obtaining a data set, S4, inputting a training set, training by using a support vector machine algorithm, obtaining a dangerous rock mass identification model, S5, inputting a verification set into the dangerous rock mass identification model, verifying results by combining manual labeling, and outputting visual identification results. By adopting the high-steep rock slope dangerous rock body identification method based on the unmanned aerial vehicle thermal infrared image, the visible light image and the thermal infrared image are combined, and the machine learning is utilized to generate the dangerous rock body identification result, so that support can be provided for subsequent deeper disaster prevention and reduction work decisions, construction planning and the like.
assignees: SHANDONG HIGH SPEED MAINTENANCE GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG;TIBET AUTONOMOUS REGION CHANGDU HIGHWAY DEV AND EMERGENCY SUPPORT CENTER

title_en: Power transmission line non-uniform icing and deicing accident risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power transmission line non-uniform icing and deicing accident risk assessment method and a system, and relates to the technical field of power transmission line icing disaster prevention and control and machine learning; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic-static approach distance calculation model between wires or between wires and wires based on an improved transducer-CNN, utilizing a data set training model to obtain a trained model, collecting line parameters and icing and deicing working condition data of a power transmission line to be evaluated, inputting the processed data into the trained model, calculating to obtain static and dynamic minimum distances between upper wires or lower wires or between wires and wires, and carrying out non-uniform icing and different-period deicing accident risk assessment according to line voltage levels, calculated values and line and working condition parameters to obtain risk levels. The method can effectively realize accident risk early warning and guide the prevention and the control of the non-uniform icing and different-period deicing accidents of the power transmission line.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Chemical industry park emergency treatment method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: A chemical industry park emergency treatment method based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of performing high-precision digital modeling on the physical environment of a chemical industry park, sensing and reflecting dynamic changes in the park in real time, fusing an Internet of things equipment model and a twin scene, matching the Internet of things equipment model with equipment information of an actual park enterprise to achieve cooperative linkage of the model and monitoring equipment, providing multiple chemical industry park emergency scene simulation, selecting different scenes according to actual requirements for exercise, constructing a chemical industry park accident emergency resource scheduling model, fusing a digital twin simulation technology and a hybrid intelligent optimization algorithm to achieve resource allocation in the dynamic and complex environment, comprehensively considering a necessary passing point and a detour area, and finding a collision-free safety path from a starting point to an end point. The invention provides a comprehensive emergency simulation drilling system and method for a chemical industry park through an integrated high-precision digital twin technology, so as to comprehensively optimize and improve emergency response capability and safety management level of the park.
assignees: GEOVIS JINNENG NANJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Structural performance fire-resistant design system and method considering personnel safety evacuation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire-resistant design, and discloses a structural performance fire-resistant design system and method considering personnel safety evacuation, wherein the system comprises a fire simulation module, a fire simulation module and a fire simulation module, wherein the fire simulation module is used for dynamically simulating a fire development process through a fire dynamics tool; the structural performance analysis module is used for evaluating the structural fire resistance under the fire disaster condition; the system comprises a fire disaster environment, a personnel evacuation dynamic simulation module, a collaborative optimization design module, a real-time monitoring and early warning module, a dynamic fire disaster simulation and evacuation path adjustment module, a parallel fire protection system and a fire disaster response system. The limitation of independent operation of the traditional fire simulation and the structural analysis is broken through by integrating the fire simulation, the structural performance analysis and the personnel evacuation dynamic simulation module. The dynamic fire temperature field and the smoke data are utilized to drive structural analysis and evacuation simulation, so that comprehensive evaluation of building structures, fire development and personnel behaviors under fire is realized, and basis is provided for collaborative design.

title_en: Intelligent railway operation and maintenance system, method, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent railway operation and maintenance system, an intelligent railway operation and maintenance method, intelligent railway operation and maintenance equipment, intelligent railway operation and maintenance media and intelligent railway products, and relates to the field of railway operation and maintenance, wherein the intelligent railway operation and maintenance system comprises an air-ground-vehicle integrated transmission module for acquiring and transmitting sensor data of key parts of a train; the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster module, a digital twin big model training module, a digital twin big model prediction module and an emergency guidance module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster module is used for acquiring and transmitting environment image data within a set range of a railway line, the digital twin big model training module is used for constructing a digital twin big model according to sensor data and the environment image data, determining an integrated big model, predicting a train fault type and a natural disaster by using the integrated big model, and generating an emergency guidance scheme, and the integrated big model is a neural network model.

title_en: Hydropower station safety integrated management system and method based on digital twin scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydropower station safety comprehensive management system based on a digital twin scene, which is characterized by designing a hydropower station data resource coding system, establishing a hydropower station digital twin base, integrating all related geospatial data, basic data, monitoring data and business management data of a hydropower station, constructing the hydropower station digital twin scene, predicting displacement and deformation conditions of a hydropower station building structure and the change trend of important facility equipment state indexes of the hydropower station, predicting and judging the safety risk of the hydropower station, forecasting or predicting the warehouse-in flow of the hydropower station, the water level and flow change of an upstream river channel and the power generation output and the power generation capacity of the hydropower station, providing a corresponding plan for flood early warning or weather disaster early warning or water level overrun early warning, combining a simulation engine and simulating key links of the plan, and carrying out simulation calculation on different power generation and reservoir scheduling strategies to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme. The intelligent hydropower station engineering safety management system realizes the intelligent management of hydropower station engineering safety, dispatching safety and power generation safety.

title_en: Simulation device and method for oil gas exploitation through in-situ heat injection of rice-grade large-size rock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation device and a simulation method for in-situ heat injection exploitation of oil gas of a meter-scale large-size rock, which belong to the technical fields of rock mechanical experiment equipment and mining resources, wherein the simulation device comprises a rigid pressure chamber, a high-temperature nano fluid generation injection system, a pressure loading system, a temperature and pressure ultrasonic monitoring system and an oil-gas water cooling separation system, can realize multidimensional stress loading and high-temperature fluid control dynamic injection at the same time, simulate a rock real buried stratum to carry out convection heating and oil-gas separation on the rock by adopting an in-situ exploitation technology, is mainly applied to the in-situ underground exploitation technology of mineral substances such as coal oil shale and the like, can also be applied to the fields of geothermal development, geological disaster assessment and the like, and solves the problem of large data discreteness caused by adopting a small-sized rule sample experiment.

title_en: Typhoon disaster-oriented receiving end power grid backbone grid frame searching method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and fighting of electric power systems, in particular to a typhoon disaster-oriented receiving end power grid backbone grid frame searching method, which comprises the following steps of simulating typhoon paths, evaluating the probability of transmission line faults of the receiving end power grid under different typhoon paths, and comparing the probability of the transmission line faults with a preset threshold value to form a transmission line fault set; and constructing a backbone network frame searching model by taking the minimum network frame scale as an optimization target, and solving the model to obtain the backbone network frame of the receiving end power grid. According to the invention, by simulating the typhoon path and the fault probability of the power transmission line, introducing a utility function, constructing a backbone network frame searching model by taking the minimum network frame scale as an optimization target, and solving the model to obtain the backbone network frame of the receiving end power grid, the load protection capacity of the receiving end power grid during typhoon disasters is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Emergency response strategy determination method, device, storage medium, program product and processor
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, a storage medium, a program product and a processor for determining an emergency response strategy. The method comprises the steps of collecting a monitoring data set of a coal mine, wherein the monitoring data in the monitoring data set is at least used for representing the environmental state of the coal mine and/or the operation state of equipment in the coal mine, determining the probability of occurrence of a target event in the coal mine in response to the abnormal monitoring data in the monitoring data set, wherein the hazard of the target event to the coal mine is greater than a hazard threshold value, calling a multi-dimensional data model corresponding to the coal mine in response to the probability of the target event being greater than the probability threshold value, simulating the monitoring data to obtain the development trend information of the target event, wherein the multi-dimensional data model is used for simulating the environment in the coal mine, the development trend information is used for representing the change condition of the environment under the condition of occurrence of the target event, and determining an emergency response strategy matched with the development trend information. The method and the device solve the technical problem of low efficiency of determining the coal mine emergency response strategy.
assignees: CHN ENERGY GROUP NINGXIA COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster exploration drilling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster exploration drilling device, which comprises first grooves which are formed in two sides of the top of a base, wherein the inner wall of one first groove is rotationally connected with a first screw rod, the outer wall of the first screw rod is in threaded connection with a first movable seat, the inner wall of the other first groove is fixedly connected with a first sliding rod, the outer wall of the first sliding rod is in sliding connection with the first movable seat, and one sides of the two first movable seats are fixedly connected with supporting rods.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA INST OF GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Karst collapse post water bursting disaster simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a karst collapse column water bursting disaster simulation device. The karst subsidence post water bursting disaster simulation device comprises an experiment box body and a subsidence post cavity, wherein a control panel is arranged on the outer wall of the experiment box body, a simulation barrel is arranged at the top of the experiment box body, a plurality of groups of limit grooves are uniformly formed in the top of the simulation barrel, the inner walls of the limit grooves are respectively connected with a limit block in an inserting mode, a plurality of groups of limit blocks are respectively provided with a cylinder on one side, close to the inner wall of the simulation barrel, of each limit block, and round rods are connected with the inner wall of each cylinder in a sliding mode. According to the karst collapse column water bursting disaster simulation device provided by the utility model, the movement of the round rod in the cylinder is controlled by rotating the screw cap, so that the distance between the rectangular block and the annular plate is adjusted, the collapse column cavities with different shapes can be limited, experiments of the collapse column cavities with different shapes can be conveniently carried out in the later stage, and meanwhile, the arrangement of the limiting block and the limiting groove is convenient for the assembly such as the cylinder to be disassembled in the later stage.

title_en: To fireman physical training CROSSFIT breathe training ware
abstract_en: The utility model provides a respiratory trainer for physical training CROSSFIT of firefighters, which comprises a main frame, wherein one side of the main frame is fixedly connected with a connecting frame, the end part of the connecting frame is fixedly connected with a resistance part, and one side of the resistance part is provided with an adjusting head. The utility model has the advantages that the two elastic belts are matched with the hook-surface magic tape and the hair-surface magic tape to surround the head of a firefighter, and the inner stabilizing ring is sleeved outside the mouth. The air bag is pressed and loosened for many times, and air is blown into the sealing air bag by the air bag, so that the sealing air bag is inflated, and a gap between the main frame and the face is sealed. According to the self needs, the rotary adjusting head adjusts the resistance of the resistance component, after the adjustment is completed, the nose is utilized to inhale, and after breath holding for several seconds, the mouth is utilized to exhale outwards, the resistance component blocks the exhale, and the training purpose is achieved repeatedly. The equipment does not need an inlet, is safer and more sanitary to use, can be used for public use, and improves the applicability of the equipment.
assignees: UNIV YANAN;YANAN LANDONGKANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire alarm multi-interference-source dynamic simulation intelligent fire-fighting experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire alarm fire safety, and particularly discloses a fire alarm multi-interference-source dynamic simulation intelligent fire-fighting experiment device which comprises a device main body, wherein an air inlet and an air outlet are arranged on the device main body and comprise a plurality of time-space box mechanisms, the generator mechanism is connected with the air inlet and comprises a temperature generator, a humidity generator, a smoke generator and a dust generator, and the control mechanism comprises a processor and an alarm, wherein the processor is connected with the generator mechanism, a smoke concentration detector, an electric cable pyrolysis particle detector, a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor, an air pressure sensor, an air flow sensor and other environmental monitoring sensors. According to the utility model, the fire disaster situation is simulated in the device main body, so that the space-time spreading situation of the fire disaster is identified and contrastively analyzed, and an experimental environment is created for reducing false alarms caused by interference sources such as steam, smoke and dust in the real environment.
assignees: SHANGHAI YIJING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Identification device for ice rock collapse potential dangerous area in alpine region
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring and discloses a device for identifying a potential dangerous area of rock collapse in a alpine region, which comprises an acquisition preprocessing module, a fusion extraction module, an identification prediction module and an optimization layout module, wherein the acquisition preprocessing module is used for acquiring and preprocessing multisource data of rock collapse in the alpine region to form basic data, the fusion extraction module is used for carrying out data fusion processing and feature extraction on the basic data to form fusion feature data, the identification prediction module is used for identifying the potential dangerous area of rock collapse in the alpine region and predicting a rock collapse scene according to the fusion feature data to form a dangerous area judging result and rock collapse simulation prediction information. The method comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing the ice rock multisource data in the alpine region to form basic data, and carrying out data fusion processing and feature extraction on the basic data to form fusion feature data, so that the spatial features of satellite images, the time sequence features of sensor monitoring data, the environmental features of meteorological data and the like are organically combined.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Space-time intelligent surface rainfall qualitative forecasting method based on Beidou water vapor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time intelligent surface rainfall qualitative forecasting method based on Beidou water vapor, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining atmospheric rainfall and weather history data of Beidou inversion, secondly constructing and training a BPNN rainfall model, thirdly obtaining a rainfall-free threshold value optimized value based on the trained BPNN rainfall model, fourthly obtaining a rainfall grade threshold value optimized value based on the trained BPNN rainfall model, and fifthly, carrying out subsequent rainfall and rainfall grade qualitative forecasting. The method has simple steps and reasonable design, firstly utilizes the atmospheric rainfall and weather history data of Beidou inversion to train the BPNN rainfall model, and utilizes the trained BPNN rainfall model to acquire a rainfall-free threshold value optimized value and a rainfall grade threshold value optimized value, thereby realizing the intellectualization of subsequent face rainfall qualitative forecast, realizing the future rainfall qualitative forecast and providing important data support for water conservancy disaster monitoring and water resource management.

title_en: Meteorological-hydrological-hydrodynamic coupling small-river mountain torrent disaster forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather-hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling small-river-basin mountain torrent disaster prediction method, which is characterized in that a disaster-causing factor and a multi-dimensional quantitative index system of a disaster-causing environment are built, a three-dimensional water system model and a Smooth Particle Hydrodynamic (SPH) hydrodynamic model are combined, a disaster prediction body is built, characteristic data are extracted, the characteristics and target variables are optimized through machine learning and deep learning, the extracted characteristics are trained, a disaster scene is built based on historical mountain torrent disaster data, and therefore a chain relation of hydrologic weather data, hydrodynamic characteristics, water level flow representation and disaster conditions is built. According to the invention, sediment deposition and impurity influence are accurately considered through fine hydrodynamic simulation, a meteorological-hydrologic model is combined to provide detailed flood flow path and speed prediction, so that high-precision and real-time mountain torrent risk prediction and construction of various disaster situations are realized, and accuracy and response speed of mountain torrent prediction are effectively improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Self-adaptive disaster anomaly identification method and early warning system based on multi-prime convolution kernel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive disaster anomaly identification method and an early warning system based on a multi-prime convolution kernel, comprising the steps of obtaining first information and second information, wherein the first information comprises historical data of geological disasters, forest fires, floods and earthquakes, and the second information comprises field monitoring data for collecting the geological disasters, the forest fires, the floods and the earthquakes in real time; the method comprises the steps of marking part of data in first information to obtain a training set, constructing a model based on a MEAN TEACHER method, training the model based on a MEAN TEACHER method through the training set based on dynamic smoothing coefficients to obtain a disaster anomaly recognition model, and inputting second information into the disaster anomaly recognition model to obtain an anomaly recognition result. The invention improves the accuracy and generalization capability of the system for identifying the abnormality, improves the accuracy of abnormality monitoring and abnormality classification, and enhances the generalization capability of an abnormality detection model.

title_en: Fire plume characteristic parameter calculation method, evolution experiment device and use method
abstract_en: Determining influencing factors of flame characteristics under a vertical shaft structure, and establishing a relation between the flame characteristic parameters and the influencing factors, wherein the flame characteristic parameters comprise flame uniform height of flame plume leveling and vertical temperature rise in the vertical shaft; the simulation experiment is carried out through the flame plume evolution experimental device to obtain simulation results under different working conditions, a scatter diagram is drawn, the influence of influence factors on flame characteristic parameters is clear, basic physical quantities of the influence factors are determined, the relation between the flame characteristic parameters and the influence factors is converted into a dimensionless relation, nonlinear fitting is carried out on the results of the scatter diagram, a flame plume characterization model is built based on the dimensionless relation, and therefore flame plume leveling average flame height under a vertical shaft structure and temperature rise in the vertical shaft inside are calculated and obtained, effective guidance can be provided for firefighting rescue, and disaster relief efficiency is improved.

title_en: Dam safety monitoring system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam safety monitoring system and method based on digital twinning, which belong to the technical field of data processing, and comprise the steps of acquiring acoustic emission signals of the surface of a dam and internal infrared thermal image data in real time through a multi-source sensor to generate a multidimensional damage characteristic matrix; the method comprises the steps of constructing a disaster node topological network by combining density peak value clustering and dynamic weight, calculating and improving Monte Carlo simulation based on gravitational field intensity, accurately predicting a damage chain reaction path, generating a dynamic risk thermodynamic diagram through space-time folding mapping and a bidirectional diffraction equation, extracting hidden danger indexes by adopting multi-axis domain feature distillation, dynamically comparing safety envelope functions, and generating a flood discharge scheduling and reinforcing scheme on line. The invention adopts the cross-modal fusion, the gravitational field dynamic topological network and the space-time folding mapping technology, can realize the accurate simulation of the damage energy conduction path, the carbonization-deformation bidirectional coupling prediction and the deep fusion of the intelligent treatment decision of the risk hidden danger, and improves the accuracy and the initiative of the dam safety pre-warning.

title_en: Efficient drainage method for accumulated water in goaf of close-range multi-coal-seam repeated mining
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine water disaster prevention and control, and provides a method for efficiently dredging accumulated water in a goaf of a close-range multi-coal-seam repeated mining operation, which comprises the following steps of performing ground geophysical prospecting on a prevention and control area and collecting stoping information of a coal seam of the goaf; the method comprises the steps of setting a water accumulation abnormal region and a low-lying region in a prevention and treatment area, arranging water level monitoring holes and ground drainage holes in the water accumulation abnormal region and the low-lying region, designing and constructing underground directional drilling holes, ensuring that tracks of the underground directional drilling holes can cover the water accumulation abnormal region and the low-lying region, carrying out through hole work on the underground directional drilling holes until water yield of each underground directional drilling hole falls below a target value, and carrying out drainage effect test on the prevention and treatment area.

title_en: Method for preventing rock burst
abstract_en: The rock burst prevention and control method comprises the following steps of S1, dividing a roof rock stratum with the thickness larger than or equal to a first preset value and the compressive strength larger than or equal to a second preset value above at least one of a roadway to be treated and a working face to be mined into a rock burst disaster-causing main control rock stratum, S2, opening a drill hole in the rock burst disaster-causing main control rock stratum, S3, carrying out hydraulic fracturing on the rock burst disaster-causing main control rock stratum by utilizing the drill hole so as to form a hydraulic fracture area with hydraulic fracture cracks in the rock burst disaster-causing main control rock stratum, and S4, opening a plurality of prevention and control holes communicated with the hydraulic fracture in the hydraulic fracture area of the rock burst disaster-causing main control rock stratum. The method for preventing and controlling rock burst can reduce the occurrence risk of rock burst of the working face.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD;TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster power communication recovery method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and a storage medium for recovering post-disaster power communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a power disaster range into a plurality of areas for recovering power communication; the method comprises the steps of determining a base station to be deployed and a plurality of automatic aircrafts in each area, enabling the base station to provide communication service for the plurality of automatic aircrafts, enabling the plurality of automatic aircrafts to provide communication service for automatic switches in the area, simulating moth flame capturing under the chaos phenomenon for the plurality of automatic aircrafts to optimize suspended coordinates of the plurality of automatic aircrafts in the area, and fitting working points of the base station in the area according to the suspended coordinates of the plurality of automatic aircrafts. The embodiment combines the chaos optimization algorithm and the moth flame catching algorithm, improves the local searching capability and accelerates the convergence rate.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method and system of novel power distribution communication network under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method and system of a novel power distribution communication network under extreme disasters, which are characterized in that a double-network coupling model of a novel power distribution system 10kV line, a power grid node failure model under the extreme disasters and a communication node failure model after power grid node energy supply is lost under the extreme disasters are constructed, the correlation characteristics of a power distribution system power grid and the communication network are fully considered, the failure conditions of the power grid node and the communication node are accurately judged, probability distribution of the power grid node flowing through wind speed under the extreme disasters is generated, the wind speed condition is truly simulated, a basis is provided for judging the power grid node failure, and cascading failure simulation is carried out based on the double-network coupling model of the novel power distribution system 10kV line, the power grid node failure model under the extreme disasters, the communication node failure model after power grid node energy supply is lost under the extreme disasters and the probability distribution of the power grid node flowing through wind speed under the extreme disasters, so that the reliability of the communication network is evaluated, and the reliability of the communication network is improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Subway emergency evacuation identification system utility test and evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a utility test and evaluation method of a subway emergency evacuation identification system, in particular to a simulation experiment evaluation method based on BIM (building information model), unity (game engine) and VR (virtual reality) technologies. The method firstly constructs an experiment test platform of the subway emergency evacuation identification system integrating BIM, unity and VR technologies. The platform can simulate the performance of the subway emergency evacuation identification system under a fire emergency event and evaluate the subway emergency evacuation identification system aiming at different emergency evacuation identification systems. Further, the method collects and analyzes the evacuation behavior parameters and visual fixation parameters of passengers by recruiting volunteers for experimental tests. Finally, the invention constructs an omnibearing and multidimensional index system, and adopts the coupling co-scheduling model to comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of the emergency evacuation identification system so as to ensure the safety, reliability and high efficiency of the emergency evacuation identification system under emergency conditions.

title_en: Intelligent advanced targeting non-explosive fracturing rock burst reduction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for intelligently leading to target non-explosion fracturing and reducing rock burst, wherein the method comprises the following steps of arranging a monitoring system in a rock burst tendency area within a preset range from a face so as to obtain activity data of a rock mass; the method comprises the steps of connecting an installed monitoring system to a microseismic monitoring device through a data acquisition line to collect rock mass activity data acquired by the monitoring system to obtain microseismic monitoring data, connecting a microseismic analysis device and an early warning device with the microseismic monitoring device in a communication way, establishing a time sequence model through the microseismic analysis device, analyzing the microseismic monitoring data, predicting potential rock explosion areas of rock explosion prone areas near a tunnel construction face through an alarm device based on microseismic analysis results, classifying the potential rock explosion areas, opening non-burst drilling holes in the potential rock explosion areas in a targeted mode according to early warning signals, and injecting low-wave impedance propping agents into the non-burst drilling holes to eliminate potential rock explosion disasters.

title_en: Flood disaster risk assessment method for infrastructure failure cascade
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood disaster risk assessment method for infrastructure failure cascade, which comprises the following steps of constructing a traffic transportation network topology model of a research area, obtaining basic attributes of infrastructures in the research area, constructing a directed graph, constructing an infrastructure system model based on the directed graph and combining dependency relations among the basic attributes of the infrastructures, simulating flood conditions in the research area in real time, judging failure road sections based on flood simulation results and the traffic transportation network topology model, assessing infrastructure cascade failure conditions based on the failure road sections, the flood simulation results and the infrastructure system model to obtain failure conditions of all infrastructures, and assessing service states of the infrastructures during flood based on the failure conditions of all infrastructures to serve as risk assessment results. Compared with the prior art, the flood risk assessment method has the advantages of being more accurate and deep in flood risk assessment and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI INST TECH;UNIV SOUTHERN SCI & TECH

title_en: Evacuation System
abstract_en: To obtain an evacuation system that can increase practicality of an evacuation shelter operations manual.SOLUTION: There is provided an evacuation system in which an evacuation shelter operations manual when a disaster occurs is digitized and which is equipped with a mobile terminal capable of using application software that is utilized during an actual evacuation and evacuation drill when a disaster occurs. The mobile terminal starts up or logs into the application software when implementing an actual evacuation or evacuation drill, thereby executes a function of sequentially displaying actions that each person should take at the evacuation shelter in accordance with their assigned roles, and a function of enabling to add items to be corrected as a memo by operation inputs from the mobile terminal at a time of noticing any items to be corrected of displayed contents on each screen that is sequentially displayed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Fire control training is with simulating explosion device
abstract_en: The application relates to a simulated explosion device for fire-fighting training in the field of fire-fighting equipment, which comprises an ignition control box, a small oil tank, an oil storage pipeline, an oil pipeline electromagnetic valve, an air cannon, an air compressor, an oil inlet booster pump, a large oil tank, a gas circuit pipeline electromagnetic valve, an ignition burner and a detonation disk, wherein the oil pipeline electromagnetic valve, the gas circuit pipeline electromagnetic valve, the air cannon, the air compressor, the small oil tank and the ignition control box are respectively and electrically connected with a PLC, and the PLC realizes the ignition and detonation process by controlling all components. The device provided by the application can simulate the explosion scene of a real fire scene in a safe environment, so that firefighters can train emergency situations, and the capability of the firefighters to cope with the emergency situations is improved.

title_en: Training method and system for fire disaster recognition model of petrochemical device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a petrochemical device fire disaster recognition model training method and system, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the steps of collecting historical image information of a fire scene of a petrochemical device, preprocessing the historical image information to obtain an image sample set, carrying out reference network replacement in a selected basic neural network frame to obtain a first candidate network, constructing an RPN module in the first candidate network to obtain a training network, wherein the anchor frame of the RPN module is set based on a K-means++ algorithm, taking the image sample set as a training sample, carrying out model training based on the training network to obtain a fire identification initial model, testing the fire identification initial model based on a preset test set, and outputting the fire identification model when the accuracy rate and the recall rate are synchronous to be expected. The method and the device realize accurate identification of the micro fire targets in petrochemical scenes.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RESEARCH INSTITUTE SAFETY ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Urban road collapse risk calculation method under extreme flood condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban road collapse risk calculation method under extreme flood conditions, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining underground structure damage conditions, determining simulation parameters of roads, soil bodies, underground water and flood scenes, S2, establishing a three-dimensional road structure model based on DEM-CFD bidirectional coupling according to microscopic parameters and hydrodynamic parameters of particle flows of the road structures and the soil bodies, simulating a cavity development process caused by damage of the underground structures under the extreme flood conditions for a long time, and S3, applying dynamic vehicle load and FWD load according to simulation results, and evaluating road collapse risk and traffic capacity. The invention simulates the interaction of the road structure and the underground structure under the action of the whole flood process, can identify the potential collapse risk of the urban road under the flood condition, evaluates the traffic capacity of the urban road after the flood, improves the safety of the urban road, can more accurately give the traffic control opinion of the urban road after the flood disaster, and provides a certain reference for the traffic management and repair of the road after the disaster.
assignees: SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ENG DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD;SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir scheduling linkage strategy method and system for cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station scheduling linkage strategy method and system, which comprise the steps of collecting historical operation data of a hydropower station and surrounding geographic environment data, establishing a joint function, taking the function as an input value, constructing a cascade hydropower station scheduling model, optimizing hydropower station water consumption and generator electric quantity in the model by utilizing a constraint function to obtain a cascade hydropower station scheduling optimal model, setting a hierarchy early warning mode and a disaster warning mechanism according to the cascade hydropower station scheduling optimal model, optimizing the hydropower station scheduling model by adopting the constraint function, improving the precision of generating capacity of the hydropower station and water consumption of the hydropower station, reducing deviation of the generating capacity and the water consumption when the generating capacity and the water consumption are brought to an upstream scheduling strategy and a downstream scheduling strategy, synchronously updating the hydropower station water consumption and the generating capacity after the model optimization to the constraint function by adopting an aggregation mode, improving the model training accuracy, and simultaneously setting the hierarchy early warning mode and the disaster warning mechanism, and being capable of early warning upstream and downstream.
assignees: SHAOXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Disaster site injury condition identification device and distributed disaster response processing system
abstract_en: The application relates to a disaster site injury condition identification device and a distributed disaster response processing system. And constructing an entity identification model oriented to multi-disaster emergency treatment according to the disaster data. Meanwhile, vital sign data of wounded in a disaster scene are obtained, the wounded condition data are processed by using a wounded condition classification model obtained based on machine learning training to generate wounded condition results, and then wounded condition scores are obtained according to the wounded condition results and evaluation indexes corresponding to the models, so that wounded condition identifiers corresponding to the wounded persons are generated. And then, identifying and analyzing disaster data and the injury identification based on the constructed entity identification model to generate a disaster response plan. And finally, distributing the plan to each disaster site, and obtaining a scheduling strategy corresponding to the disaster site. The pertinence and the practicability of the disaster response plan are remarkably improved, reasonable allocation of rescue resources and scientific arrangement of wounded persons are ensured, and the high efficiency and the intellectualization of the disaster response process are improved.
assignees: The Second Medical Center Of Chinese PLA General Hospital

title_en: Flood disaster risk assessment method and system based on interpretable artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment, and particularly relates to a flood disaster risk assessment method and system based on interpretable artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining an influence factor according to historical flood disasters; the method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster factor indexes through simulation by using a LISFLOOD-FP hydrodynamic model, predicting flood disaster risk levels in different reproduction periods by combining a gradient lifting decision tree (GBDT) algorithm, quantitatively identifying importance of the disaster factors, introducing a LIME model to conduct local explanation on GBDT prediction results to determine contribution rates of the disaster factors, and constructing an assessment index system based on the contribution rates and GBDT prediction results to conduct flood disaster risk assessment. The system comprises units of influence factor determination, hydrodynamic model simulation, GBDT prediction, model interpretation, risk assessment, model verification and the like, realizes accurate simulation and intelligent assessment of flood disaster risks, and is beneficial to reducing urban flood disaster losses.

title_en: Dynamic three-dimensional grid meteorological simulation model based on historical observation data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological simulation, in particular to a dynamic three-dimensional grid meteorological simulation model based on historical observation data. The method is based on abundant historical observation data, can accurately reflect the change rule of the meteorological elements, greatly improves the accuracy of meteorological simulation, and improves the reliable basis for meteorological research. The dynamic three-dimensional grid result presents the complex evolution of weather in a three-dimensional space in an omnibearing manner, overcomes the limitation of the traditional model, clearly presents the weather variation details in the vertical and horizontal directions, and is helpful for in-depth understanding of weather mechanisms. The method integrates a physical driving model and a data driving model, gives full play to respective advantages, enhances simulation and prediction capabilities of various meteorological phenomena, and particularly better serves meteorological disaster early warning for complex extreme meteorological phenomena. Through the visualization and interaction functions, a vivid three-dimensional meteorological scene can be generated, the visual observation and analysis of a user are facilitated, and the development and decision making of the meteorological field and related industries such as aerospace, agriculture and the like are forcefully promoted.

title_en: Simulation optimization method for tunnel emergency evacuation facility configuration scheme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation optimization method of a tunnel emergency evacuation facility configuration scheme, which aims to find out an optimal emergency evacuation facility configuration scheme, and concretely comprises the steps of firstly constructing a simulation scene according to actual data of a tunnel section, simulating occurrence of emergency in the simulation scene, inputting accident occurrence positions and evacuation population, then considering the number, the positions and the widths of different pedestrian crossroads and the widths of inspection channels on two sides of a tunnel, formulating a plurality of preset safety facility configuration schemes, then carrying out traversal simulation on all the preset safety facility configuration schemes, simulating evacuation processes of pedestrians in the emergency situation based on an improved social force model, outputting evacuation results in each simulation, and finally determining the optimal emergency evacuation facility configuration scheme according to the simulation results.
assignees: CCCC TUNNEL BRIDGE NANJING TECH CO LTD;CCCC INFRASTRUCTURE MAINTENANCE GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;JIANGSU GUANGYU XIETONG TECH DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Crowd evacuation path planning method considering panic diffusion
abstract_en: The crowd evacuation path planning method considering panic spread comprises the steps of determining initial individual panic degree of each individual in a crowd of a target scene, determining adjacent individuals of each individual, updating the initial individual panic degree of each individual to obtain individual panic degree of each individual under panic transmission, conducting panic attenuation processing on the individual panic degree of each individual under panic transmission to obtain final individual panic degree at the current moment, determining predicted obstacle avoidance speed of each individual in the crowd of the target scene at the next moment to obtain final obstacle avoidance speed of the final individual panic degree updated at the next moment, and determining crowd evacuation planning paths based on the final obstacle avoidance speeds at all moments. According to the method, the crowd evacuation path planning is completed under the consideration of the influence of the panic emotion of the crowd, the authenticity of the crowd evacuation path planning simulation is improved, and the evacuation efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Deep learning-based shield tunnel thermal disaster diagnosis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shield tunnel thermal disaster diagnosis method and system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of information technology and tunnel safety monitoring and comprise the steps of collecting infrared images of a cambered surface temperature field in a shield tunnel segment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out chromaticity matching on the screened infrared images to obtain matched temperature cloud images, inputting the temperature cloud images into a trained thermal-stress diagnosis model to output stress cloud images, constructing a numerical model for simulating thermal performance of a shield tunnel under the coupling effect of thermal-seepage-force multiple fields, obtaining the temperature cloud images and the stress cloud images of an intrados temperature field of the shield tunnel segment through transient simulation calculation based on the numerical model, training the thermal-stress diagnosis model based on a convolutional neural network by utilizing the temperature cloud images and the stress cloud images, and judging the early warning level of the thermal disasters of the shield tunnel based on the stress cloud images in combination with preset diagnosis basis. The method can realize accurate early warning of the safety and stability of the shield tunnel structure.

title_en: Real-time judging method for roof collapse caused by fire disaster among nuclear power station oil storage tanks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time judging method for roof collapse caused by fire among nuclear power station oil storage tanks, and relates to the technical field of fire safety design of roof structures among nuclear power station oil storage tanks. The method for judging the roof collapse caused by the fire disaster among the oil storage tanks of the nuclear power station in real time can realize time sequence temperature field mapping of the heated surface of the complex roof structure between CFD numerical simulation software and FEM software under different fire disaster scenes among the oil storage tanks of the nuclear power station, simulate real-time structure response behaviors of the roof structure among the oil storage tanks of the nuclear power station under different fire disaster scenes, and can be used for fire safety design and post-disaster damage assessment of the roof structure among the oil storage tanks of the nuclear power station.

title_en: High cut slope safety grade assessment method, device and equipment based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source data-based high-cut slope safety grade assessment method, a multi-source data-based high-cut slope safety grade assessment device and multi-source data-based high-cut slope safety grade assessment equipment, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster prediction and comprise the steps of assessing target high-cut slope safety grade scores corresponding to a region to be monitored according to multi-source high-cut slope monitoring data corresponding to the region to be monitored; the method comprises the steps of carrying out correlation screening and contribution screening on a plurality of preset alternative high-cut slope instability disaster factors to obtain a plurality of target high-cut slope instability disaster factors, constructing a sample data set based on target cut slope safety grade scores and the target cut slope instability disaster factors, training model parameters of a machine learning model by using the sample data set, and using the trained machine learning model to evaluate new target high-cut slope safety grade scores corresponding to a region to be monitored. The invention can obviously improve the accuracy of the evaluation of the safety level of the cut slope.
assignees: MINI OF WATER RESOURCES INFORMATION CENTER MINI OF WATER RESOURCE MONITORING FORECASTING CENTER;PIESAT INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster data analysis method and device based on finite element method and wave equation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster data analysis method and device based on a finite element method and a wave equation, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting seismic data and geological environment data of a geological disaster monitoring area through a monitoring area layout collecting device, setting an inversion equation comprising a data equation and a target equation based on the wave equation, obtaining a restored medium attribute and an integral wave field through alternately and iteratively solving the inversion equation, deducing the seismic data according to the finite element method and the wave equation to obtain medium elastic parameters, longitudinal wave speed, transverse wave speed, density and background values thereof, and inputting the processed seismic data and the geological environment data into the inversion equation for inversion to obtain the geological disaster type, scale and position of the geological disaster monitoring area. The invention can process complex geological structures and boundary conditions by combining wave equation and finite element method, thereby more accurately simulating and analyzing geological disasters.
assignees: SHENZHEN AIHUA SURVEY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Reinforcing method and reinforcing device for soft and hard interbedded side slope
abstract_en: The invention provides a reinforcing method for a soft and hard interbedded slope, which is characterized in that the replacement depth is calculated according to the average strength of a hard layer and the strength of the soft layer, a plurality of cross beams are formed by gradually replacing the soft layer with reinforced concrete from bottom to top, longitudinal beams are grooved and poured in the hard layer to form a lattice beam together and are completely embedded in the slope, anchor rod holes are drilled at the junction of the cross beams and the longitudinal beams, the interfaces of the soft layer and the hard layer are reamed, a main anchor rod is connected with an anti-slide pile and the hole diameter is adapted to the protrusion of the reamed position, a self-drainage anchor rod is arranged, and finally, polyurethane foaming materials are sprayed on the slope surface and the slope surface is hung for spraying slurry. The invention can effectively strengthen the soft and hard interbedded slope, enhances the anchoring effect of the anchor rod, greatly improves the anti-slip property and stability of the soft and hard interbedded slope, and has important significance for preventing and controlling geological disasters such as landslide, collapse and the like of the soft and hard interbedded slope.

title_en: Goods shelf collapse device for fire-fighting training
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting training and discloses a goods shelf collapse device for fire-fighting training, which comprises a base, wherein a cabinet body with a hollow inside is arranged above the base, a vertical rod extending into the base is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the cabinet body, a middle optical axis rotationally connected with the base is fixedly arranged at the top of the vertical rod, an electric push rod is hinged on the inner side wall of the base, the output end of the electric push rod is hinged with the vertical rod, and a limit chain for connecting the base and the cabinet body is arranged at the outer side of the base. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the disaster scene of the collapse of the goods shelf caused by the influence of fire and high temperature is simulated, and the scene of the fire accident is restored more truly.

title_en: Risk avoiding path planning method based on dynamic evolution of flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk avoidance path planning method based on dynamic evolution of flood disasters, which belongs to the technical field of flood disaster risk avoidance, and aims to dynamically consider the problem of the dynamic perception of flood risks and the intelligent risk avoidance path planning task by aiming at the failure influence of the flood disasters on a road network according to different influence of urban flood processes on the road failure, and comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic road network model introducing virtual nodes based on time intervals of numerical simulation calculation of the flood processes, determining origin and destination points, and updating information of the virtual nodes in real time according to different positions of each moment.

title_en: Physical simulation test and monitoring method for fault sliding rock burst
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of physical simulation of rock burst of underground engineering, and provides a fault sliding rock burst physical simulation test and monitoring method, which comprises the steps of manufacturing a model test piece; the method comprises the steps of embedding conductors in a model test piece according to preset positions, trends and trends, carrying out a loading test on the manufactured model test piece, carrying out fault activation on the conductors when the conductors are loaded to a fault to be activated, obtaining resistivity information, stress information and thermal imaging information of the model test piece in the loading process, and judging deformation conditions and fault activation degrees of the model test piece according to the resistivity information, the stress information and the thermal imaging information.
