The rock mass strength near the fault is weakened through an electric activation mode, the test effect and the test efficiency are improved, the deformation condition and the fault activation degree of the model test piece are judged according to the resistivity information, the stress information and the thermal imaging information, the monitoring precision is ensured, and the beneficial guarantee is provided for the research of underground engineering disasters.

title_en: Pollution event quick response and management system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pollution event quick response and management system based on big data analysis, which belongs to the field of track big data and environmental protection and is used for monitoring, early warning, responding and processing of environmental pollution events, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module, an event simulation prediction module, an emergency response coordination module and an information release module; the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module, an event simulation prediction module, an emergency response coordination module and an information release module, wherein the data acquisition module receives and processes AIS data, meteorological data, geographic information data and pollutant monitoring data, the data analysis module classifies and predicts by using a machine learning algorithm, the event simulation prediction module simulates, the emergency response coordination module coordinates emergency response activities of all departments, records and tracks the processing process of pollution events, and the information release module releases real-time information to the public through a public information release platform. Compared with the prior art, the invention greatly improves the response speed and the processing efficiency to the environmental pollution event, and simultaneously is beneficial to the government and environmental protection institutions to more accurately formulate environmental policies and management measures.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Roadbed slope digital twin model construction method based on multi-mesh array visual perception and computer system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadbed slope digital twin model construction method based on multi-mesh array visual perception, which comprises the steps of manufacturing a preliminary digital twin model by combining a slope design drawing and construction planning, setting cameras of different types and numbers according to construction site conditions to form a multi-mesh visual perception array, correcting, enhancing and denoising the picture of the change condition in the construction process, extracting key construction characteristics, using a deep learning algorithm, updating and refining the roadbed slope digital twin model by using a three-dimensional reconstruction technology, updating the digital twin model in real time, carrying out structural analysis and dynamic simulation on the digital twin model, evaluating risks possibly occurring in different construction stages, and combining risk identification to formulate an emergency response strategy and preventive measures. The invention has the advantages of high efficiency, real-time and accurate monitoring of the change in the slope construction process, and powerful support for monitoring the construction process, guaranteeing the quality and predicting the risk.

title_en: Numerical simulation method for flood evolution disaster chain of mud-rock flow river blocking-dam blocking burst
abstract_en: The application discloses a numerical simulation method for a flood evolutionary disaster chain of mud-rock flow river blockage-dam blockage burst, which comprises the steps of obtaining data required by the numerical simulation method based on a continuous medium fluid mechanics model of coupling water, coarse particle and fine particle three-phase medium. According to the application, by combining a continuous medium mechanics theory and coupling a continuous medium hydrodynamic model with water, coarse particles and fine particles, the numerical simulation of the flood evolution disaster chain is realized by adopting a finite difference method. The application considers the sand conveying effect of the main river flow and the influence of the main river sand conveying process on the dam blocking and bursting process and the bursting and flood-water-spreading-breaking process when the debris flow is converged into the main river, can simulate whether the debris flow blocks the river or not, and how the dam blocking and the dam bursting and the bursting and flood-spreading-water-spreading physical process after the river is blocked, and realizes the complete coupling process of the river blocking and the dam bursting and flood-spreading disaster chain physical process of the debris flow.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Low-altitude economic airway flow field sensitive area determining method and system based on ensemble simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining a low-altitude economic airway flow field sensitive area based on ensemble simulation, and belongs to the technical field of airway setting. The method comprises the steps of obtaining weather initial conditions and boundary conditions of a target area by using a global atmospheric analysis data set, driving a WRF numerical mode system to perform set simulation on weather fields of the target area, obtaining a time-by-time set simulation data set, further determining time-by-time channel weather variables of low-altitude wind fields of the target area, constructing a channel flow field sensitivity model to obtain channel flow field sensitivity, determining sensitivity space distribution of a low-altitude channel of the target area on the basis of the sensitivity space distribution, and finally determining a low-altitude economic channel flow field sensitive area of the target area according to a sensitivity threshold. The invention can reasonably plan the low-altitude airspace air route of the target area and reasonably set the take-off and landing areas of the unmanned aerial vehicle, avoids the weather disaster frequent area with obvious influence on low-altitude economy, and reduces the weather disaster risk of the air route.

title_en: Power grid assessment method based on extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid assessment method based on extreme weather, which comprises the following steps of taking typhoon as a representative event, firstly comprehensively considering wind speed characteristics and electric pole running states when typhoon logs in, building a power distribution network electric pole fault correction model under typhoon disaster conditions according to the relation between electric pole load and electric pole bending strength, further providing a load shedding risk index reflecting power supply capacity after power distribution network faults, calculating the load shedding risk when typhoon disasters happen by using a Monte Carlo state sampling method, and finally verifying the effectiveness of the method by using an IEEE33 system calculation example. The power grid risk assessment method based on the time sequence Monte Carlo simulation method has the advantages that the risk of the power grid under typhoon disasters can be reasonably assessed, and the safe operation level of the power distribution network is improved through risk early warning.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Automatic objective recognition method and system for meteorological disaster of pumping and accumulating power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for automatically and objectively identifying meteorological disasters aiming at a pumping and storing station, and relates to the technical field of meteorological disaster monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of aiming at a pumping and storing station airspace, acquiring continuous observation data based on a preset time interval; the method comprises the steps of constructing a flow field space under an air space of a pumping and storing power station, supervising and training an objective identification module, transmitting continuous observation data to the objective identification module, carrying out mesoscale vortex identification and evolution tracking to determine vortex identification data, and carrying out weather disaster discrimination on the vortex identification data based on a vortex database to determine a weather disaster identification result, wherein the objective identification module comprises a double-layer fully-connected vortex characteristic identification model and an evolution prediction model. The method solves the technical problems that the type and the influence range of the meteorological disaster cannot be accurately identified and the disaster early warning response is not timely in the prior art, realizes the accurate identification of the type and the influence range of the meteorological disaster, and achieves the technical effects of improving the accuracy and the response timeliness of disaster early warning.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD;SICHUAN METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER SICHUAN METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY FILM AND TELEVISION CENTER

title_en: Detection device and detection method for evaluating flame retardant property of facing type fireproof paint
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-retardant performance detection of fireproof materials, in particular to a detection device and a detection method for evaluating fire-retardant performance of facing type fireproof paint. The detection device provides a combustion space close to the actual building environment, on one hand, the state of the ventilation opening is adjusted through the electric shutter, and different ventilation conditions, such as natural ventilation, mechanical ventilation or ventilation blocking and the like, are simulated when a fire disaster occurs, so that the paint is tested in various airflow environments. On the other hand, the heat radiation source is arranged to simulate the heat radiation environment around the materials in the fire disaster, the uneven heat radiation intensity distribution is arranged, the complex condition of the heat source in the real fire disaster site is similar, and the performance of the paint under different heat radiation conditions is tested. In addition, the gas mixer can dynamically adjust the oxygen concentration in the cabin according to the test requirement, thereby not only meeting the conventional oxygen index test, but also simulating the oxygen content change in the fire disaster process and exploring the flame retardant performance of the coating under the actual oxygen content fluctuation scene.
assignees: GUANGDONG BUILDING MATERIAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Sensor arrangement method and system for debris flow early warning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, in particular to a sensor arrangement method and a system for early warning of debris flow, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a corresponding debris flow simulation process according to historical debris flow data of each debris flow so as to determine the motion characteristics of the debris flow and the propagation characteristics of fluctuation signals, determining the installation position of a corresponding sensor by combining a three-dimensional geological map, installing the corresponding sensor and performing communication test, determining whether signal confusion exists among various sensors according to the communication test result so as to determine whether to optimize the installation position, acquiring rainfall data in an early warning range in real time, and determining the current debris flow tendency according to the rainfall data and the historical debris flow data; and processing the transmission signals of the sensors according to the occurrence tendency to early warn the debris flow. According to the invention, the accuracy and reliability of debris flow early warning can be effectively improved by reasonably arranging the sensors, and powerful support is provided for disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Numerical simulation method for landslide surge-induced iced lake flood breaking disaster chain
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide surge-induced ice lake burst flood disaster chain numerical simulation method, which comprises the steps of coupling a deep average mixed flow model of water, coarse particles, fine particles and a gas-phase four-phase medium based on a continuous medium mechanical method to obtain data required by the numerical simulation method. According to the application, by combining a continuous medium mechanics theory, a deep average mixed flow model of water, coarse particles, fine particles and gas-phase four-phase medium is coupled by a continuous medium mechanics method, and a limited difference method is adopted to realize numerical simulation of a landslide surge-induced ice lake flood breaking disaster chain. According to the numerical simulation method for the landslide surge-induced iced lake burst flood disaster chain, provided by the application, the whole process coupling from the movement of the iced lake burst disaster chain from the landslide to the induction of surge from the landslide into the lake and the induction of the iced lake burst and the flood evolution is comprehensively considered, the whole process simulation of the landslide-induced iced lake burst flood disaster chain is successfully realized, and the technical support is provided for the iced lake burst field.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering management system based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and discloses a hydraulic engineering management system based on GIS, which comprises a data access and processing module, a multidimensional factor comprehensive evaluation module, a high-precision DEM generation and calibration module, a flooding simulation module, a scene setting and uncertainty analysis module, a decision support and early warning report module, a machine learning and prediction module and a real-time monitoring and updating module. According to the invention, various factors are introduced, a more accurate risk index is provided, a dynamic adjustment of risk level is supported, the inundation simulation and geological disaster prediction are more close to the actual situation through the high-precision DEM, an automatic early warning mechanism provides powerful technical support for disaster prevention and emergency management, a real-time monitoring updating module ensures rapid updating of post-disaster data, and a detailed support is provided for repairing work.

title_en: Stability evaluation method and system for disaster type debris flow impact protection net structure
abstract_en: Compared with the method and the system for evaluating the stability of the disaster type debris flow impact protection net structure, which are provided by the application, compared with the method and the system for annotating the discrete protection net structure stability information by only dispersing the protection net structure safety characteristics of the reference protection net structure stability information into a single numerical value for representation, the method and the system can reduce the loss of the protection net structure stability information of the reference protection net structure stability information in the technology of converting the disaster type debris flow simulation information set into the protection net structure stability information. Therefore, the buffer description vector corresponding to the multidimensional protection net structure stability information based on the abundant protection net structure safety features is used for converting the set of the disaster type debris flow simulation information into the protection net structure stability information, and the protection net structure safety features of the protection net structure stability assessment result corresponding to the generated set of the disaster type debris flow simulation information and the protection net structure safety features of the reference protection net structure stability information can be related, so that the assessment accuracy and reliability can be improved.
assignees: SICHUAN HUADI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;SICHUAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY RES CENTER

title_en: Hierarchical and regional differential risk early warning method for mountain torrents in small and medium-sized river basins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grading, partitioning and differentiating risk early warning method for mountain torrents in small and medium-sized watercourses. Firstly, defining a river basin risk area through data analysis of mountain flood disasters, calculating the time delay of the river basin, simulating the section water level and the river basin inundation range by using a simplified hydrodynamic model, performing quantitative analysis on the model, combining unstructured grid division and risk source identification to form a high-precision grid database, and clustering and grading the multi-dimensional characteristics of the grids through a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to obtain the risk level of each grid in the river basin. And finally, formulating a differential early warning threshold and a response strategy according to the grid partition grading result, and combining measured data on a GIS platform to realize dynamic updating and linkage release. The method considers the limited real conditions of the data of the middle and small river basins and the precision requirement of model simulation, not only realizes the fine setting of the early warning threshold value on the basis of grading and partitioning, but also obviously improves the accuracy of the mountain torrent risk identification.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Multidimensional space-time data analysis and visualization method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of big data analysis and disaster management, and discloses a multidimensional space-time data analysis and visualization method, system and equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source space-time data and carrying out standardization processing to obtain processed space-time data, carrying out real-time analysis and trend prediction according to the processed space-time data based on a deep learning algorithm to obtain analysis and prediction results, carrying out three-dimensional modeling according to the processed space-time data and the analysis and prediction results through a GIS platform to obtain a three-dimensional dynamic simulation model and carrying out visual display, generating a decision strategy according to the analysis and prediction results, and optimizing the decision strategy based on a reinforcement learning mechanism. The method and the device integrate multi-source space-time data efficiently, realize real-time processing of large-scale data and remarkably improve the response speed of the data. Prediction is performed based on multi-source data fusion and a deep learning algorithm, so that the automation and the accuracy of analysis are improved. The real-time dynamic display helps the user to more intuitively understand the data trend, and the decision scientificity and timeliness are enhanced.
assignees: WUHAN ZHIBO CHUANGXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire alarm method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a fire alarm method and a fire alarm system, and relates to the technical field of fire detection. The method comprises the steps of firstly acquiring video data of a fire disaster high-risk area acquired by monitoring equipment when fire disaster alarming is carried out, inputting image data obtained by decoding the video data into a fire disaster detection model, and outputting a fire disaster detection result corresponding to the fire disaster high-risk area through the fire disaster detection result, wherein the fire disaster detection model is obtained by training an image data sample obtained by decoding the video data based on video data samples of each of a plurality of high-risk area samples and a corresponding fire disaster detection label, and sending an alarm instruction to alarm equipment based on the fire disaster detection result, wherein the alarm instruction is used for the alarm equipment to execute corresponding alarm operation. By adopting the technical scheme provided by the application, the problem of fire false alarm in the prior art can be solved, thereby effectively improving the accuracy of fire alarm.

title_en: Forward alternating operation method for directional drilling and fracturing of composite rock stratum
abstract_en: The invention provides a forward alternating operation method for directional drilling and fracturing of a composite rock stratum, and relates to the technical field of coal exploitation. The method for forward alternating operation of directional drilling and fracturing of the composite rock stratum comprises the steps of determining drilling sites in a roadway according to disaster prevention and fracturing requirements under a mine, determining directional drilling parameters, determining the number of drilling sections and the length L of each drilling single section according to a roof stratum histogram and lithology water quality characteristics of the construction sites, arranging a drilling machine at an open hole position, adjusting an open hole straight drilling angle, determining coordinates of open hole points, performing drilling construction of drilling single section drilling, and washing holes of the drilling single sections completed in the drilling process in the drilling withdrawing process. The forward alternate operation method for directional drilling and fracturing of the composite rock stratum effectively solves the problems that the hole diameter is reduced due to mud hole collapse and dislocation deformation of the soft and hard composite rock stratum after the hole is drilled through the layer for a long time, so that blocking of a packing tool is caused, staged fracturing is unsuccessful, and the success rate of staged fracturing of the full-drilled hole is improved.
assignees: SHAANXI SHANMEI CAOJIATAN MINING CO LTD;CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent energy digital twin management and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent energy digital twin management and control system and method, comprising a control component, a data acquisition module, a communication and transmission module, an emergency response module and a server, wherein the server comprises a digital twin system, the digital twin system comprises optimal value substitution, active exogenous progressive and passive exogenous learning, real-time data are extracted from a sensor data set at any time and the optimal value is determined, the real-time data are used as a reference value for setting next time, amplitude information of a control value is divided into a plurality of sub-amplitude values, each sub-amplitude value is transmitted to the control component of a subsequent time period in an equal value or decreasing value mode, based on a supervised learning method, the optimal value information extracted from sensor data of a previous time period is used as input data, and the neural network is used for deep learning training. According to the scheme, various data of the energy system can be collected and analyzed in real time by utilizing a digital twin technology, and a comprehensive and real-time energy efficiency analysis report is provided for a manager, so that energy scheduling and control are optimized.

title_en: Power failure event prediction evaluation method and device based on power failure research model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure event prediction evaluation method and device based on a power failure research model, comprising the steps of obtaining data of multiple data sources of a target power system; the method comprises the steps of integrating, verifying and cleaning data of multiple data sources to obtain the processed data of the multiple data sources, constructing and training a power failure judging model based on the processed data of the multiple data sources, wherein the power failure judging model is a neural network model based on deep learning, and predicting and evaluating a power failure event of a target power system based on the power failure judging model. The method for predicting the power failure relieves the technical problems of low prediction accuracy and insufficient emergency response in the extreme disaster weather existing in the existing method for predicting the power failure.
assignees: Marketing Service Center of State Grid Henan Electric Power Company

title_en: Natural disaster endophytic safety system for underground pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pipeline safety, and discloses an underground pipeline natural disaster endogenous safety system which is used for solving the problems that pipeline function safety, natural disaster backup safety and system information safety are mutually interwoven and are difficult to treat independently. The system comprises a safety monitoring module, a pipeline state judging module, a reconstruction mimicry simulation module, a multimode judging module, a pipe network disaster reverse reconstruction module and a linkage defense module, wherein the safety monitoring module is used for collecting safety monitoring data of an underground pipeline, the pipeline state judging module is used for judging pipeline state conditions and obtaining pipeline state data, the reconstruction mimicry simulation module is used for mimicry according to the pipeline state data and the safety monitoring data to obtain n reconfigurable mimicry simulation models, the multimode judging module is used for carrying out simulation calculation on disaster values based on the n reconfigurable mimicry simulation models, the pipe network disaster reverse reconstruction module is used for receiving the disaster values and carrying out data correction on the reconfigurable mimicry simulation modules and the multimode judging module, and the linkage defense module is used for carrying out linkage defense. The invention solves the problems of static property and deterministic limitation existing in the traditional protection mode.

title_en: Water quality monitoring method and system for surface water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality monitoring method and system for surface water, which relate to the technical field of water quality monitoring, and are characterized in that water body state data of a target area are obtained, spectral data are subjected to feature extraction through a preset algorithm to obtain training data, the training data are input into a water body evaluation model to be evaluated to obtain water body abnormal parameters, ultrasonic detection data are obtained, the water body turbidity parameters of the target area are determined according to the ultrasonic detection data, the water body abnormal parameters and the water body turbidity parameters are combined to obtain water quality evaluation parameters, the water quality of the target area is evaluated according to the water quality evaluation parameters, the spectral data are subjected to feature extraction through the preset algorithm to generate the training data, and the training efficiency and accuracy of the model are improved. The training data is input into a water body evaluation model, the water body abnormal parameters are automatically evaluated, the water quality evaluation parameters are obtained by combining the turbidity parameters detected by ultrasonic waves, comprehensive water quality evaluation is carried out, and when the threshold value is exceeded, an alarm is automatically given, so that the monitoring efficiency and the emergency response speed are improved.
assignees: ANHUI HENGYU ENVIRONMENTAL PROT EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURING LIMITED BY SHARE LTD;HEFEI HENGXING WATER POLLUTION CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent classification method for dangerous area grade after destabilization of overhanging rock
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and particularly discloses an intelligent classification method for dangerous area grades after destabilization of hanging rock. The method comprises the steps of scanning overhanging rock to generate DEM, correcting, sampling, carrying out geotechnical testing to obtain mechanical parameters, calibrating a distribution range, importing the DEM into PFC to generate a three-dimensional slope model, freely releasing the overhanging rock in the three-dimensional slope model to simulate falling, monitoring and recording key parameters and associating with risk grades, establishing a hierarchical structure model, a judgment matrix and an evaluation function, checking consistency of the judgment matrix to ensure credibility of weight results, setting a risk grade dividing standard, calculating risk scores through the evaluation function and matching risk grades, constructing a data set and a CNN model, training, verifying and testing the CNN model by adopting the data set, and receiving the key parameters by the CNN model to calculate and output corresponding risk grades. The invention has the characteristics of high timeliness, less human intervention and accurate judgment.
assignees: KUNMING PROSPECTING DESIGN INST OF CHINA NONFERROUS METALS INDUSTRY CO LTD;KUNMING SURVEY INSTITUTE SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Identification method and system for rock mass structural degradation of mining slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying structural degradation of a mining slope rock mass, which particularly relate to the technical field of rock mass monitoring in mining engineering and are used for solving the problems of hidden damage missed judgment or misjudgment caused by overall statistical characteristics of signals in the existing cross-hole acoustic wave testing method, and the method is used for achieving accurate positioning and dynamic evaluation of a rock mass degradation high-risk area and remarkably improving the reliability and engineering applicability of mining slope disaster early warning by collecting acoustic wave signals among drill holes and carrying out multi-scale wavelet decomposition, extracting sub-signal energy distribution of characteristic frequency bands, combining with a skewness and kurtosis statistical map of an acoustic wave travel time sequence, comparing a complete rock mass reference map in a segmented manner to mark an abnormal path segment, synchronously fusing micro-crack group direction matching verification observed by a drilling television, removing misjudgment data and generating a micro-crack chain density model.

title_en: Icing rate prediction method based on improved particle swarm back propagation neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an icing rate prediction method based on an improved particle swarm back propagation neural network, which relates to the field of researches on ice disaster prevention strategies of power transmission lines, and comprises the steps of establishing an icing growth mechanism model of the power transmission lines in a low-temperature rain and snow freezing environment; the method comprises the steps of changing environmental parameters through numerical simulation, performing multi-factor analysis by using an icing growth mechanism model to obtain icing working condition data of multiple scenes, multiple moments, multiple weather, multiple terrains and the like, using 4 environmental characteristic values of liquid water content, environmental temperature, water drop diameter and wind speed in air as input values of a network, using the icing rate of a power transmission line as output quantity of the network, constructing a BPNN prediction model, and optimizing the weight and threshold of the BPNN by using IPSO (internet protocol security) to realize accurate prediction of the icing rate of the power transmission line. The method is simple and feasible, the algorithm optimizing speed is high, the model predicting accuracy is high, and a reference is provided for the icing predicting and early warning work of the power transmission line.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST FORESTRY;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHENYANG INST ENGINEERING;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Typhoon disaster knowledge graph generation method and system based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster knowledge graph generation method and system based on a large language model, and relates to the technical field of knowledge graph construction, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining typhoon disaster data, carrying out cognition and expression of typhoon disaster knowledge based on the typhoon disaster data, wherein the cognition and expression of typhoon disaster knowledge comprise typhoon evolution process and typhoon disaster effect; based on the cognition and expression result of typhoon disaster knowledge, generating a knowledge extraction instruction, wherein typhoon disaster data comprise wind speed, wind direction, central air pressure, motion track, sea wave height, rainfall and disaster condition, inputting the knowledge extraction instruction into a pre-established large language model LLMs for training to obtain TyphoonKGent, inputting typhoon disaster data into TyphoonKGent to obtain TyphoonKGent extracted structured knowledge map, and realizing construction of evaluating typhoon disaster knowledge map based on a method combining data and manpower.

title_en: Intelligent fire identification and early warning and linkage spraying fire extinguishing method for gas station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire identification early warning and linkage spraying fire extinguishing method for a gas station. The method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a fire disaster data set of a gas station comprising a training set and a testing set, then constructing a flame target detection model of the gas station based on a deep learning network, training the flame target detection model of the gas station by using the training set, then verifying by using the testing set, carrying out flame identification on a video stream of the gas station by using the flame target detection model of the gas station after verification, determining whether real flames exist in a gas station image by combining a research and judgment algorithm, transmitting an acquired flame identification record to a control terminal, generating gas station alarm information and transmitting the gas station alarm information to a gas station spraying system after alarm confirmation by using a manual research and judgment module in the control terminal, and controlling the spraying system of the gas station to spray and extinguish fire. The invention realizes the integrated linkage response of early fire identification monitoring, early warning and fire spraying of the gas station, and effectively improves the intelligent monitoring level of fire accidents of the gas station.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RESEARCH INSTITUTE SAFETY ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Tree wind load assessment method based on point cloud model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tree wind load assessment method based on a point cloud model, which comprises the steps of carrying out semantic segmentation on an image acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle, and extracting partial images of the tree crowns for three-dimensional reconstruction, generating a point cloud model, extracting point cloud data of the tree crowns and the tree trunks, and generating a three-dimensional point cloud model of the target tree. And calculating the wind load influence area of the crown by ALPHA SHAPE algorithm. And simulating wind load distribution under different wind directions and wind speeds by using ANSYS Fluent software in combination with the wind speed, the wind direction and the tree geometric characteristics, and calculating a wind load result under the wind load effect. Finally, based on a finite element analysis method, tree structure stress analysis is carried out by combining wind load data, and fatigue life and damage risk of the tree under the action of wind power are estimated. The method can accurately evaluate the dynamic response of the tree under the action of wind power, has the characteristics of high efficiency, accuracy and automation, and is widely applicable to the fields of wind disaster early warning, tree health monitoring, environmental protection and the like.

title_en: In-situ stress recovery test method for deep anisotropic coal rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep anisotropic coal and rock mass in-situ stress recovery test method which comprises the following steps of preparing an anisotropic coal and rock mass sample, carrying out an initial stress loading test, and constructing a deep coal and rock mass anisotropic mechanical model, wherein the stress recovery test is carried out in the step 3. The invention can solve the problem that the anisotropic characteristic of the deep coal rock mass and the in-situ stress recovery process cannot be accurately simulated in the prior art, and can accurately reduce the mechanical behaviors of the deep coal rock mass under different stress paths by combining the indoor test and the numerical simulation technology, thereby providing scientific basis for the engineering design of the deep mine and disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Emergency method and system based on environmental adaptability
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an emergency method and system based on environmental adaptability. Firstly, environmental information such as temperature, humidity and the like of an accident place is collected, extra risks caused by the environment to injury are estimated, and an environmental factor estimation result is generated. And generating a personalized first-aid proposal by utilizing a deep learning algorithm in combination with vital sign data of the wearable medical equipment and the latest medical institution position information provided by the geographic positioning service. And then, continuously monitoring environmental changes by adopting a dynamic programming algorithm, predicting the results of different decision paths, creating an emergency scene simulation platform through a virtual reality technology for a previewing test, and optimizing an emergency strategy. And finally, establishing real-time communication connection between the on-site emergency personnel and the professional medical personnel by using a 4G/5G network, integrating the multi-party expert opinion, improving the emergency strategy and generating a comprehensive scheme comprising remote guidance support and on-site emergency action plan. The technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application improves the speed and accuracy of emergency response.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-efficiency, high-safety and low-cost wind field operation and maintenance system based on VR/AR technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of offshore wind farm operation and maintenance, and provides a high-efficiency, high-safety and low-cost wind farm operation and maintenance system based on VR/AR technology, which comprises an AR/VR operation optimizing engine, a virtual environment and a virtual environment, wherein real-time data can be checked and analyzed in the operation process of the system by combining the AR/VR technology with digital twinning, and instant feedback is obtained, so that decision and operation are optimized; and the VR virtual environment feedback module is used for carrying out data dynamic adjustment by matching with the virtual simulation environment database to provide an immersed offshore operation and maintenance environment. The pain point of difficulty in actual operation of the wind power system is solved, and through simulation practical training of equipment cognition, operation and maintenance skills in virtual reality, students can be familiar with the structure and operation flow of wind power equipment under the safe condition, various maintenance skills are mastered, the actual operation capability and the emergency response capability are improved, and the risk and cost in the actual operation are reduced.
assignees: SHENNENGYUAN SHENZHEN INNOVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for implementing integrated drilling after extraction and pressure relief of coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coal-rock gas composite disaster prevention and control, in particular to a method for implementing integrated drilling after extraction and pressure relief of coal-rock gas composite dynamic disasters, which comprises the following steps of judging a composite disaster dangerous area; performing bedding drilling on a coal seam which needs gas extraction and rock burst disaster prevention, returning a drill bit after construction to a designed depth, grouting the outside and inside of a hole sealing section, connecting a gas extraction pump to perform gas extraction, and extracting the hole sealing section of the drilling hole after the gas extraction is finished, wherein the gas extraction drilling hole is changed into pressure relief drilling hole. The drilling holes constructed by the method realize 'one hole and multiple purposes' through partition, and prevent and treat gas and rock burst disasters together.

title_en: Coal-rock gas composite disaster prevention and control method based on coal seam drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coal-rock gas composite disaster prevention and control, in particular to a coal-rock gas composite disaster prevention and control method based on coal seam drilling, which comprises the following steps of judging a composite disaster dangerous area; the method comprises the steps of performing bedding drilling on a coal seam needing gas extraction and rock burst disaster prevention, retracting a drill bit after the drill bit is constructed to a designed depth, dividing the drill bit into a rock burst pressure relief drill hole and a gas extraction drill hole along the length of the drill bit, sealing the gas extraction hole at the junction of the pressure relief drill hole and the gas extraction drill hole, connecting a gas extraction pump to perform gas extraction, and coating a film bag on a gas extraction pipe at a pressure relief section to enhance the gas extraction capacity and calculate a pressure relief effect. The drilling holes constructed by the method realize 'one hole and multiple purposes' through partition, and prevent and treat gas and rock burst disasters together.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;JIXI MINING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power grid flood disaster early warning dynamic deduction system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flood disaster early warning deduction, and relates to a power grid flood disaster early warning dynamic deduction system and a method. The method and the system improve the physical relevance of the power grid damage probability analysis by accurately simulating the flooding parameters of flood delay paths and subareas thereof, provide multidimensional analysis basis for equipment damage probability through quantitative risk level, reduce misjudgment rate, identify the upstream power failure area and the downstream influence range of the equipment under threat through dynamic deduction, optimize the load transfer paths in real time, reduce power supply gaps, realize space-time dynamic prediction and management of power failure influence, ensure the power supply continuity of critical areas, and facilitate rapid positioning of high-risk equipment and scheduling of resources through real-time display of flood flooding animation, equipment state icons and repair progress bars, shorten the repair response time, form a whole-flow closed loop of 'monitoring-early warning-response-feedback', and improve emergency efficiency.
assignees: BEIJING STATE GRID INFORMATION TELECOMMNICATION GROUP ACCENTURE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Optimization method for garden plant space distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a garden plant space distribution optimizing method, which adopts a plant space self-adaptive layout algorithm, utilizes a laser radar or unmanned plane technology to generate a high-precision 3D model of garden terrains, generates a weight matrix according to soil types, illumination intensity and drainage characteristics, applies a dynamic weight Voronoi algorithm to the terrain model to generate a planting range of each plant, uses an underground imaging technology to establish a root system distribution model, combines underground hydrologic data to simulate the distribution dynamics of moisture and nutrients among root systems, utilizes a wireless network to acquire sensor data in real time, designs a dynamic irrigation scheme, optimizes plant planting density and irrigation range, integrates data of terrains, climates and the like into virtual gardens, interacts with a digital twin model through a sensor to ensure that the virtual gardens are consistent with actual states, predicts plant growth, ecological benefit changes and disaster risks through a visual interface, and allows users to modify and optimize the garden layout in real time.
assignees: THE PEOPLES PARK MAN STATION OF ANYANG CITY

title_en: Hydropower plant operation emergency treatment process optimization method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower plant operation emergency treatment process optimization method and system based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the technical field of intelligent hydropower plant operation management and emergency response optimization, and comprises the steps of collecting hydropower plant data in real time, preprocessing the collected data, constructing and training an artificial intelligent model by utilizing the preprocessed data, and constructing and training an anomaly detection model by using a deep learning technology, detecting anomalies by using the anomaly detection model, recommending an emergency scheme for faults by using a reinforcement learning algorithm, automatically executing emergency treatment measures, and dynamically adjusting the scheme according to a real-time monitoring result. The method can solve the problems of low accuracy, untimely anomaly detection and low emergency treatment efficiency of the traditional data processing and model.
assignees: GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD SUOFENGYING POWER PLANT

title_en: Tunnel fire data generation method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel fire data generation method based on a generation countermeasure network, and belongs to the fields of disaster prevention and reduction in civil engineering, fire engineering and artificial intelligence intersection. The system designs a generating countermeasure network architecture, introduces a bidirectional LSTM network module and Wasserstein distance loss, and collects measuring point temperature, smoke concentration and flow velocity data of different fire source positions, power and longitudinal jet fan wind speeds in a tunnel for network training. The bidirectional LSTM can help the network to better capture the time sequence information of the data, and the Wasserstein loss can enable the gradient change of the network to be smoother, reduce the mode collapse phenomenon and improve the network training stability. Compared with the traditional data expansion means, the method can accurately and rapidly generate the tunnel fire data under different working conditions, avoids tedious and time-consuming numerical simulation work, and realizes efficient and high-precision expansion of the tunnel fire database.

title_en: Offline firefighting training intelligent management method and system based on VR technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offline fire control training intelligent management method and system based on a VR technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a plurality of fire control scenes by using a Unity3D engine, S2, realizing a plurality of interaction modes based on an Open XR Open source protocol, S3, carrying out real-time identification and feedback on the operation of a student by adopting a deep learning algorithm, S4, automatically generating performance data of the student in a training process by the system, inputting the performance data multiplied by a decision weight value into a decision tree algorithm by the system, giving an evaluation result, generating a personalized training report, guiding and evaluating the student in a targeted manner by a manager according to the evaluation report, reducing the burden of manual evaluation, S5, uploading all training data and evaluation results to a cloud database for centralized management and analysis, identifying existing knowledge blind points by a data mining technology, and optimizing training content and a training method. The invention integrates take an entrance examination evaluation, has strong practicability and can customize a training scheme for a user.

title_en: Mine disaster prediction and emergency response method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an artificial intelligence-based mine disaster prediction and emergency response method, which comprises the steps of collecting original mine data; the method comprises the steps of generating simulated mine data based on original mine data, inputting training data into a mine disaster prediction unit, collecting new original mine data through a mine data collection unit, extracting features of the new original mine data through a trained feature extraction model to obtain new original mine data after the features are extracted, classifying the new original mine data after the features are extracted through a trained classification model to obtain a safety state corresponding to the new original mine data, and outputting corresponding emergency response measures after the emergency response unit receives the safety state. The existing mine safety management system based on artificial intelligence has the problem of low prediction accuracy, and the prediction accuracy of the method is high.
assignees: SHANXI LUAN ENV ENERGY DEV CO LTD;UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling spontaneous combustion of hard top plate weakened synergistic coal of high-ground-temperature working face
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing and controlling spontaneous combustion of hard roof weakening collaborative coal on a high-ground-temperature working face, which comprises the steps of developing drilling design, wherein design parameters comprise drilling horizontal section height, drilling hole spacing and section spacing, injection amount of flame-retardant filling materials of each fracturing section, arranging drilling holes according to the design parameters, developing first hydraulic fracturing, enabling a fracture to penetrate through a coal seam by the hard roof above the coal seam, pushing the working face after the first fracturing is completed, exposing the first fracturing fracture, injecting flame-retardant materials into a goaf through the fracture by using a fracturing oil pipe, covering residual coal, preventing spontaneous combustion of residual coal, repeating the steps, completing the first subsequent hydraulic fracturing, continuing to inject flame-retardant materials into the residual coal along the fracture, and partially filling the goaf due to the fact that the hard roof is weakened by fracturing and the goaf is relieved by impact compression risk. The invention can relieve the rock burst disaster risk caused by the hard roof of the mine, and greatly improves the effect.

title_en: The transportable door for tactic and rescue training
title_ko: 전술 및 구조 훈련용 이동식 도어
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile door used for tactics and training for door breaching in fields such as military, police, naval, coast guard, marines, special units, and fire brigades. more specifically, a main beam (20) is connected and assembled to the center of left and right wheel beams (10, 10') in which a moving wheel (12) is installed. a door frame (30) and a door locked or unlocked by a hinge and a locking means to be opened and closed are vertically installed on the upper part of the main beam. therefore, the left and right wheel beams (10, 10') and the main beam (20) can be quickly and conveniently disassembled and assembled by dividing the left and right wheel beams (10, 10') and the main beam (20) into three to have excellent loading transportability and convenience of use. above all, the mobile door has excellent mobility by the moving wheel, enables push and pull training, is formed of a steel pipe, prevents bending deformation against a strong impact by a multi-locking structure to have excellent durability of use, and more strongly performs various tactics and rescue training for door breaching.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군, 경찰, 해군, 해안 경비대, 해병대, 특수 부대 및 소방대 등의 분야에서 도어 브리칭(Door Breaching)을 위한 전술 및 훈련을 위해 사용하는 이동식 도어에 관한 것으로서, 좀더 상세하게는 이동 휠(12)이 설치되는 좌우 휠빔(10)(10')의 중앙을 메인 빔(20)을 연결 조립하되, 상기 메인 빔 상부에 도어 프레임(30)과 상기 도어 프레임 내측에 경첩과 록킹 수단에 의해 록킹 또는 록킹 해제하여 개폐하는 도어를 수직 설치하므로 상기 좌우 휠빔(10)(10')과, 메인 빔(20)을 3 분할로 신속하고 간편하게 분해 및 조립할 수 있어 적재 운반성 및 사용 편리성이 우수하고, 무엇보다 이동 휠에 의해 이동성이 우수하며, 푸시 및 당김 훈련이 가능하고, 스틸 파이프로 형성함은 물론 다중 잠금 구조에 의해 강한 충격에 대한 휨 변형 방지로 사용 내구성을 우수하고, 도어 브리칭(Door Breaching)을 위한 각종 전술 및 구조 훈련을 더욱 강력하게 실시 할 수 있도록 제공하는데 그 특징이 있다.
assignees: LOTUS INT CO LTD;LEE JUNG YEON

title_en: Disaster reduction effect monitoring system of disaster reduction facilities and method usiing the same
title_ko: 재해저감시설의 재해저감 효과 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster reduction effect monitoring system of a disaster reduction facility, comprising: a DMFIM model generation module for generating a first DMFIM (Disaster Mitigation Facility Information Modeling) model from design information of a disaster reduction facility; a 3D reality model construction module for constructing a 3D reality model of an actual disaster reduction facility from at least one of image information and lidar information of the actual disaster reduction facility; a modified DMFIM model generation module for generating a second DMIFM model by modifying the first DMFIM model to fit the 3D reality model; a reality disaster data collection module for collecting disaster result data according to an actual disaster situation from installed sensors of an actual disaster reduction facility; a simulation module for generating simulation result data by simulating an actual disaster situation with respect to the second DMFIM model; and a disaster reduction effect judgment module for comparing the disaster result data with the simulation result data to judge a disaster reduction effect.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재해저감시설의 설계 정보로부터 제1 DMFIM(Disaster Mitigation Facility Information Modeling) 모델을 생성하는 DMFIM 모델 생성 모듈; 실제 재해저감시설의 영상 정보 및 라이다 정보 중 적어도 하나로부터 실제 재해저감시설의 3D 현실 모델을 구축하는 3D 현실 모델 구축 모듈; 상기 제1 DMFIM 모델을 상기 3D 현실 모델에 맞춰 수정하여 제2 DMIFM 모델을 생성하는 수정 DMFIM 모델 생성 모듈;실제 재해저감시설의 설치된 센서로부터 실제 재해 상황에 따른 재해 결과 데이터를 수집하는 현실 재해 데이터 수집 모듈; 상기 제2 DMFIM 모델에 대하여 실제 재해 상황을 시뮬레이션 하여 시뮬레이션 결과 데이터를 생성하는 시뮬레이션 모듈; 및 상기 재해 결과 데이터와 상기 시뮬레이션 결과 데이터를 비교하여 재해저감 효과를 판단하는 재해저감 효과 판단 모듈;을 포함하는 재해저감시설의 재해저감 효과 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Digital Twin-Based Fire Occurrence Prediction System
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 화재발생 예측 시스템
abstract_en: In a digital twin-based fire occurrence prediction system (10), the prediction system (10) is divided into an actual system (100) and a digital twin virtual system (300), and the actual system (100) and the digital twin virtual system (300) are connected to each other through a virtual system communication module (330) for providing wireless communication and web services to an external or remote facility manager for detection signals, fire, and earthquake signals. When the digital twin-based insulation deterioration and fire occurrence tendency prediction system according to the present invention is used, it is possible to predict not only abnormal diagnosis of actual field facilities, but also insulation soundness and fire occurrence due to deterioration.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 또는 빌딩제어시스템 내부에서 아크카운터 및 새그 카운터로부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 계통고장 검출장치류;와 화재 및 지진(진동)발생시 상황을 검출하여 재난상황을 예측, 진단할 수 있도록 센서로부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 방재감시용 센서류; 상기 계통고장 검출장치류, 방재감시용 센서류로부터 생성된 데이터를 수집하여 DB에 저장하고, 필요 정보를 현장 모니터에 표시하는 설비이상 진단장치; 상기 설비이상 진단장치를 통해 고장원인을 포함하는 고장 데이터를 통신으로 전송받아 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템에 정보를 제공하는 가상시스템 통신모듈;을 포함하고 상기 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템은 센서 데이터 처리 모듈에서 제공하는 데이터를 기반으로, 열화경향 예측, 화재감시 및 예측 그리고 설비이상 진단을 위한 시뮬레이션을 시행하는 가상 시뮬레이션 모듈; 상기 시뮬레이션 모듈에서 시뮬레이션을 시행할 시 조건값, 경계값을 설정하는 파라미터 셋업모듈; 시뮬레이션을 통해 이미지를 디스플레이 하도록 데이터를 가공처리하여 현장 설비운영자에게 정보를 전달하는 디지털 트윈 그래픽 생성모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Create method of underground tunnel complex disaster scenarios
title_ko: 공동구 복합재난 시나리오 생성방법
abstract_en: The present invention has been devised to solve the above-described problems, and an object thereof is to provide a method for generating a multi-disaster scenario for a utility tunnel that manages condition value-based simulations and data on facility performance and vulnerability evaluation results in disaster scenarios that may occur in the utility tunnel. In the method for generating a multi-disaster scenario for a utility tunnel, a disaster risk management module transmits user condition values to an external communication module and receives and manages simulation results and performance and vulnerability evaluation results. A disaster simulation engine module retrieves simulation results according to the condition values from a database. A performance and vulnerability evaluation module calculates evaluation results of facilities inside the utility tunnel and causal factor information to generate the multi-disaster scenario.

title_en: Flood disaster condition prediction method and device, computer equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prediction and discloses a flood disaster prediction method, a device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a product, wherein the flood disaster prediction method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical data set of a target area, wherein the historical data set comprises historical disaster receiving data of the target area and historical factor values of flood disaster influence factors of the target area; the method comprises the steps of constructing a generation data set based on a historical data set, training a flood disaster prediction model based on the historical data set and the generation data set, obtaining a current factor value of a flood disaster influence factor of a target area, determining precipitation prediction data of the target area based on the current factor value, and taking the precipitation prediction data and the current factor value as input characteristics of the flood disaster prediction model to obtain the flood disaster prediction data. The method and the device can improve the efficiency and the precision of disaster prediction.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Landslide vulnerability mapping method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of digital drawing, and discloses a landslide vulnerability drawing method, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source remote sensing data and historical landslide data, and manufacturing a disaster factor data set and a landslide sample data set; all landslide sample data sets are input into an AGNES clustering algorithm and VIIQ feature optimization strategy module to obtain optimal feature combinations, the optimized data features are divided into a training set and a testing set, the training set and the testing set are input into a machine learning classifier and a deep learning classifier to perform model precision evaluation to obtain a preliminary landslide susceptibility map, the landslide susceptibility map is input into a Blending heterogeneous integrated model to obtain a final landslide susceptibility drawing result, the integrated model is deeply interpreted by combining with an SHAP algorithm to optimize a landslide susceptibility result map, and the landslide susceptibility is predicted more effectively.

title_en: Computer network information security management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer network security, in particular to a computer network information security management method system, which comprises the steps of S1, risk assessment, S2, security policy formulation, S3, security protection measure implementation, S4, management measure, S5, security training and propaganda, S6, emergency response, S7, accident handling, asset identification, comprehensive carding of network assets in enterprises or organizations, including hardware equipment, software systems, network services, data and the like, and the importance and the value of the network assets are defined. The computer network information security management method system can convert the data into a ciphertext form for storage and transmission through an information security management method such as a data encryption technology, and only authorized personnel with correct keys can decrypt and restore the data into original data, so that abnormal user access behaviors and potential security holes can be found in time, basis is provided for improving security measures, and the situation that a database is stolen or leaked in the transmission process is effectively prevented.

title_en: Geological disaster risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster risk assessment method and a system, in particular to the field of natural disaster risk management, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s101: collecting geological disaster data through a remote sensing technology, ground exploration, meteorological monitoring and a public database, and carrying out feature extraction and fusion on the collected geological disaster data; s102: associating different types of geological disaster information with various factors of geographical environment and climate, and constructing a simulation model to simulate geological disasters; the invention avoids the risk of data leakage, improves the generalization capability of the whole model, obviously reduces the consumption of computing resources, improves the running efficiency of the model on edge equipment, is beneficial to accelerating the reasoning process of the model, and can help the geological disaster department to efficiently and timely make rescue plans; the method can improve the decision efficiency and reduce the decision cost, can provide flexible and effective disaster prevention and reduction measures for decision makers, maximize the resource utilization rate, and simultaneously ensure the continuous effectiveness of the disaster prevention and reduction measures.

title_en: Landslide monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide monitoring and early warning method and system based on a digital twin technology, which belong to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and concretely comprise the steps of collecting geographical information data of landslide in real time, constructing a dynamically updated multi-source space database, constructing a landslide simulation model, conducting grid subdivision on the landslide simulation model, carrying out solving based on the landslide hydraulic coupling model by introducing a stress field and seepage field numerical coupling algorithm, accurately analyzing landslide to represent a state, acquiring a safety coefficient of the landslide in real time by adopting an intensity folding method, establishing a disaster analysis model, deducing a landslide disaster forming range if the safety coefficient reaches a preset alarm threshold, calculating a disaster risk index, evaluating a risk level according to the disaster risk index, and carrying out early warning on the landslide disaster if the risk level is higher than the preset level. The intelligent landslide monitoring system and the intelligent landslide monitoring method realize accurate monitoring and intelligent safety early warning of landslide.
assignees: SUZHOU TURUISI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ocean emergency command scheduling method and system based on data processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine emergency management, in particular to a marine emergency command scheduling method and system based on data processing, and the method comprises the following steps: and collecting data flows of the offshore monitoring station and the meteorological station, integrating the collected wind speed, wave height and ship position information, identifying data points which are inconsistent with the conventional mode, analyzing the data points, and judging whether the data points are abnormal events or not to obtain a marine data set. According to the invention, the data is analyzed through the time sequence, the standard deviation and the mean value are obtained through calculation, so that the abnormal fluctuation is identified more accurately, the detection capability of key events is enhanced through the refined data processing, the timeliness and the accuracy of resource scheduling are further improved through the real-time resource and demand matching analysis, the emergency response is more targeted and effective, the performance is simulated and compared and the response efficiency is analyzed, the optimization of a command scheduling scheme in actual execution is ensured, and the overall efficiency and the accuracy of marine emergency management are remarkably improved.
assignees: NAT MARINE DATA AND INFORMATION SERVICE

title_en: Coal mine resource collaborative exploitation and mining surrounding rock total space damage control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal exploitation, and provides a method for controlling the total space destruction of surrounding rock for collaborative exploitation and mining of coal mine resources, which comprises the following steps of determining the horizon of a low-position thick and hard basic roof stratum based on the structural parameters of a coal seam roof; the method comprises the steps of determining arrangement positions and parameters of fracturing drilling holes based on the horizon of a low-position thick and hard basic top rock stratum, carrying out fracturing drilling construction, enabling a horizontal section of the fracturing drilling holes to be located in the low-position thick and hard basic top rock stratum and cover the whole length of a stoping face in the trend, carrying out fracturing construction on the horizontal section to form fracturing cracks, controlling the development of the fracturing cracks to enable the fracturing cracks to penetrate through a coal bed vertically, and extracting gas through the fracturing drilling holes after the fracturing construction is completed. By adopting the arrangement, the fracturing of the roof low-position thick and hard basic roof stratum can simultaneously realize the recovery of coal seam gas resources, the control of gas disasters, the prevention and control of water damage of the roof/the bottom plate of the coal mine and the control of surrounding rocks of the mining space, thereby greatly reducing the engineering quantity of disaster prevention and control, lowering the engineering cost and shortening the construction period.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD;TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Aqueduct earthquake-resistant disaster-reduction system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction in civil engineering, in particular to a digital twinning-based aqueduct earthquake-resistant disaster reduction system and a digital twinning-based aqueduct earthquake-resistant disaster reduction method, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, an earthquake early warning module, a control system, a gate valve control module, a notification module, a 3D visualization module and an aqueduct post-earthquake evaluation module; the invention realizes the real-time acquisition of the running state information and the earthquake early-warning information of the aqueduct through the joint detection of the earthquake early-warning module and the secondary acquisition module, and the control module is used for adjusting the water quantity in the aqueduct before the arrival of destructive earthquake waves so as to minimize the earthquake response of the aqueduct. The monitoring data, the manual inspection data and the seismic characteristic information are input into the control system, an aqueduct digital twin model is built, and seismic response simulation is carried out, so that the safety state of the aqueduct structure after the earthquake can be accurately evaluated, a post-earthquake aqueduct structure processing scheme is rapidly provided, and a reference basis is provided for earthquake relief decisions.

title_en: Coal mine gas control and management method and platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine gas prevention and control management method and a platform, which relate to a data processing technology, and are used for constructing a tunnel twin space corresponding to a coal mine tunnel, responding to selection information of a detection module in the tunnel twin space by a management end, using a sensor corresponding to the detection module as a drilling sensor, sending a virtual value set by the management end to the drilling sensor, determining a plurality of alarm points based on conduction points and the virtual value of the drilling sensor, calling a remote control strategy to remotely control coal mine equipment at the alarm points to obtain a response state of the coal mine equipment, calling a guide planning strategy, determining a guide position of a guide equipment throwing guide device according to the guide planning strategy and the alarm points, updating the tunnel twin space according to the guide position and the response state, sending the prevention twin space to the management end for displaying, realizing effective guide of an evacuation path, and improving the safety of personnel evacuation.

title_en: Rock drill for geological disaster management
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fittings of rock drills and discloses a rock drill for treating geological disasters, which comprises movable arms, wherein the outer sides of the end parts of the movable arms are connected with fixed frames I, the inner sides of the fixed frames I are connected with rolling rotating rods I, the outer sides of the movable arms are sleeved with fixed arms, the inner sides of the end parts of the fixed arms are connected with fixed frames II, and the inner sides of the fixed frames II are connected with rolling rotating rods II. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the rotating rod I and the rotating rod II between the movable arm and the fixed arm, the sliding friction between the movable arm and the fixed arm is converted into rolling friction, so that the friction force of relative movement between the movable arm and the fixed arm is reduced, and the contact wear of the rotating rod I and the rotating rod II with the movable arm and the fixed arm respectively is slowed down.
assignees: ANHUI CHUANGGONG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Fire intelligent identification and comprehensive early warning analysis method for pumping and accumulating power station
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire early warning, and provides an intelligent fire identification and comprehensive early warning analysis method for a pumping and accumulating power station. According to the method, fire simulation of different scenes is conducted on the pumping and accumulating station based on a pre-built variable experiment platform, sample images of different fire scenes are obtained, an image identification model based on ResNet structures is trained, feature extraction is conducted on the obtained preprocessed real-time monitoring image of the pumping and accumulating station, and fire early warning models of four layers of network topologies are used for calculating the fire occurrence probability of the pumping and accumulating station according to the image features of the real-time monitoring image. By means of the method, the dynamic change of the image characteristics of the image is monitored in real time, the assessment of the development trend and the potential danger of the fire is achieved, scientific basis is provided for rescue operation and evacuation, the detection and response strategy of the fire is effectively optimized, the automation and intelligence level of the operation is improved, the safety management efficiency of the pumping and accumulating power station is improved, and the possibility of human errors is reduced.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster toughness assessment method for pile foundation structure under extreme wave condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pile foundation toughness assessment, and discloses a multi-disaster toughness assessment method of a pile foundation structure under extreme wave conditions, which comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-disaster scene parameter system by a multi-element coupling analysis method, and constructing a high-precision finite element model by combining finite element software, wherein the high-precision finite element model is used for simulating the response effect of a pile foundation structure under different load combinations, so that a toughness index system is constructed, and the multi-disaster toughness of the pile foundation structure is evaluated. According to the invention, various factors such as waves, earthquakes, soil parameters and the like are coupled for the first time, and multi-disaster toughness assessment is carried out, so that the mechanical behavior of the pile foundation structure under extreme disaster conditions can be reflected more truly, and a more reliable scientific basis is provided for the design and construction of the pile foundation structure.

title_en: Method and system for grading and evaluating safety of buried steel pipe under impact of falling rocks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for grading and evaluating safety of buried steel pipes under the effect of falling stone impact, and relates to the technical field of falling stone disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining maximum ovality and maximum tensile strain of the buried steel pipe after falling stone impact action through simulation of a numerical analysis model, obtaining fitting of falling stone kinetic energy, impact offset, maximum tensile strain and maximum ovality through fitting and calculation, establishing grading indexes, obtaining actual falling stone kinetic energy and impact offset of the place where the buried steel pipe is located, obtaining maximum tensile strain of the steel pipe through fitting, comparing the steel pipe maximum tensile strain with the grading indexes respectively, obtaining safety grade of the buried steel pipe, providing scientific basis for grading evaluation of the buried steel pipe under the falling stone impact action, providing help for reasonable design of a steel pipe line, and guaranteeing quality and safety of the buried steel pipe in a falling stone risk area.

title_en: Landslide detection method based on improved YOLOv n model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide detection method based on an improved YOLOv n model, and belongs to the technical field of computer vision and geological disaster monitoring. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting high-resolution remote sensing image data, preprocessing the data by using a data enhancement technology, then dividing the preprocessed remote sensing image data into a training set, a verification set and a test set, marking a real frame and marking a category, constructing and training an improved YOLOv n model based on a Swin transform backbone network, a depth separable convolution module and a context aggregation attention mechanism, and finally outputting landslide detection results by using the trained improved YOLOv n model. The method disclosed by the invention keeps high efficiency and real-time performance when processing the high-resolution remote sensing image, is particularly suitable for landslide real-time monitoring under a resource-limited environment, improves the accuracy and efficiency of landslide detection, can better adapt to complex terrains and background conditions, and provides high-efficiency and reliable technical support for landslide disaster monitoring.

title_en: Wind disaster accident prediction method of lightning rod tower based on nuclear density estimation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention of power equipment.
