The wind disaster accident prediction method of the lightning rod tower based on the nuclear density estimation comprises the steps of firstly constructing a non-parameter estimated probability density function, checking and verifying a nuclear density estimation result, secondly calculating a window width estimation value of each key mechanical characterization quantity of the lightning rod tower based on wind induced response data of the lightning rod tower and the nuclear density estimation method, constructing a probability density function for finishing the key mechanical characterization quantity of the lightning rod tower, finally prolonging wind speed simulation time on the basis of stable wind speed, and comparing and verifying a calculated value obtained by wind induced response with a predicted value obtained by the probability density function, so that rationality and correctness of the wind disaster accident prediction method of the lightning rod tower based on the nuclear density estimation are proved.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV COMPANY

title_en: Movable GNSS point fixing device for monitoring side slope
abstract_en: A movable GNSS point fixing device for monitoring a slope belongs to the technical field of geological monitoring of a strip mine slope. The drilling device comprises a ball screw, a drilling power head, a spiral drill rod assembly, a core shaft pipe, a main spiral blade and a rock drill bit, wherein the ball screw is rotationally connected to a shell of a GNSS mobile monitoring point, a ball nut is screwed on the ball screw, the drilling power head is arranged between the two ball screws and is respectively connected with the ball nuts on the two ball screws, the spiral drill rod assembly mainly comprises the core shaft pipe, the main spiral blade and the rock drill bit, and the core shaft pipe and the main spiral blade are connected below the drilling power head. The fixing device not only solves the problems of the traditional fixing method, has the advantages of compact structure, simple and convenient operation, strong adaptability and the like, can be flexibly adjusted according to the specific conditions and monitoring requirements of the slope, but also is beneficial to improving the automation level and the intelligent level of slope monitoring and provides more reliable technical support for preventing geological disasters of the strip mine slope.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system for emergency personnel flow
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system for emergency personnel flow, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring monitoring data of monitoring equipment in each area of an emergency, and extracting multi-frame images from the monitoring data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out target detection, feature extraction and image cutting on each frame of image through a computer vision technology to obtain pedestrian feature images, carrying out identity recognition, identity classification and labeling on the basis of the pedestrian feature images, eliminating pedestrian feature images with labeling types of incumbent staff to form a standard data set, carrying out model training on the basis of the standard data set to obtain a pedestrian flow prediction model, carrying out analysis and prediction on the pedestrian flow of each area of an emergency call through the pedestrian flow prediction model to obtain a prediction result, generating early warning information of different grades according to the prediction result and an alarm threshold, and executing corresponding emergency response plans aiming at the early warning information of different grades. The method of the invention realizes the advanced allocation of medical staff and resources and improves the emergency response capability of hospitals.
assignees: THE FOURTH AFFILIATED HOSPITAL ZHEJIANG UNIV SCHOOL OF MEDICINE

title_en: Meteorological data analysis method and system for hail monitoring and identification
abstract_en: The application discloses a meteorological data analysis method and a system for hail monitoring and identification, which relate to the technical field of civil aviation meteorological monitoring and alarming, the system comprises a data acquisition module, a characteristic extraction module, a model construction module and a model training module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring historical observation data of a ground weather station, echo information of a weather radar and satellite remote sensing data. The method has the advantages that through collecting and extracting weather features related to hail formation, analyzing the correlation of echo information of a weather radar and hail data in historical observation data, constructing a hail monitoring model, combining a prediction result of the model with data of weather early warning feedback, continuously iterating and optimizing the model according to feedback in practical application, improving the accuracy and instantaneity of monitoring, remarkably improving the monitoring and identification efficiency of hail through implementation of the comprehensive technical route, and providing powerful technical support for weather early warning, disaster defense and emergency response.
assignees: CAAC EAST CHINA REGIONAL AIR TRAFFIC MAN BUREAU

title_en: Electric power industry individual soldier emergency exercise method and system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a system for individual emergency exercises in the power industry, wherein the method comprises the steps of configuring plan basic information, obtaining a preset plan template file, configuring the plan basic information into the preset plan template file based on a structured emergency plan generation strategy of SOP and EXCEL to generate an emergency plan, creating and configuring the emergency exercises according to the emergency plan, determining exercise modes and exercise roles in a handheld terminal or in the handheld terminal and a wearable terminal, pushing the emergency exercises according to the exercise modes and the exercise roles based on scores of each instruction, and displaying the pushing flow of the exercise rules and the emergency exercises by adopting a visual guide chart. According to the method and the device, the handheld terminal and the wearable terminal are adopted for emergency exercise, real-time data access, high-efficiency communication, rapid decision support and on-site operation guidance are provided, the efficiency and the effect of emergency response of the power industry are improved, and safe operation of a power grid is guaranteed.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Flood returning calculation method and simulation system based on overflow process correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster defense, in particular to a flood returning calculation method and a simulation system based on overflow process correction. Collecting and processing flood beach area topographic data to obtain topographic feature parameters; the method comprises the steps of collecting historical flood actual measurement data of flood lands to obtain river channel actual measurement flood level and flow rate processes, carrying out groove outlet and groove inlet flood process simulation according to terrain characteristic parameters and river channel actual measurement flood level processes to obtain simulated flood land flow rate processes, carrying out groove return correction on the river channel actual measurement flood flow rate processes according to the flood land flow rate processes to obtain river channel flood flow rate processes after groove return, and taking the processes as the basis of groove return flood design. The invention realizes the groove returning correction of the river course flood process by simulating the flood process, has lower data requirements, complete flood elements and strong operability.
assignees: MINISTRY OF WATER RESOURCES PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION TECH CONSULTATION GUANGZHOU CO LT

title_en: Method and system for path analysis and risk identification of water infiltration outside hydropower station grotto group
abstract_en: The invention provides a path analysis and risk identification method and a system for water infiltration outside a hydropower station cavern group, which dynamically simulate the propagation path of water flow by establishing a catchment network model of the underground cavern group, the risk of external water infiltration is comprehensively evaluated, the water flow path is displayed, and comprehensive path analysis and risk identification of external water infiltration of a complex underground cavern group are realized. The method effectively solves the problems that the result of risk assessment of water seepage of the hydropower station cavern group is low in accuracy, the propagation path and the sweep range of the water flow are difficult to predict accurately, provides a scientific water flow management and protection scheme for the hydropower station, provides scientific technical support for seepage prevention design, risk management and emergency response of the hydropower station underground plant, and has strong engineering practical significance.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method for area random slope instability influence range
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative evaluation method for an influence range of random slope instability of a surface area, and relates to the technical field of geological disasters; the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical slope geological disaster data and geospatial data of a research area to establish a database, constructing a fine grid unit and a slope unit for the research area, performing vulnerability evaluation on the research area by adopting a machine learning algorithm to obtain a source target area of area random slope instability, setting a multi-factor and multi-level uniform design experiment on numerical simulation parameters by adopting uniform design, constructing a pseudo sample set of an area random slope instability range based on the slope unit, constructing a training data set to train a machine learning proxy model, and taking the optimized machine learning proxy model as a random slope instability influence range machine learning proxy model. The method improves the selection precision of the area random slope destabilizing object source target area, and simultaneously realizes the quantitative evaluation of the area random slope destabilizing influence range.

title_en: Digital bay hydrologic condition early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine disaster early warning, and discloses a digital bay hydrologic condition early warning method and system, wherein historical meteorological data and real-time meteorological data of a bay area to be predicted are collected; according to historical meteorological data, a relation model of wind and wave is established by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning and genetic algorithm, wave prediction data is generated based on the relation model and real-time wind data of a bay area to be predicted, a synthetic wind field of the bay area to be predicted is synthesized based on a theoretical model wind field and a background wind field, storm tide simulation is conducted by utilizing a hydrodynamic mathematical model and a tide mathematical model according to the synthetic wind field and the real-time meteorological data, and based on the wave prediction data and a storm tide simulation result, hydrological condition early warning information is generated by combining an early warning index threshold value, prediction accuracy and early warning timeliness of the wave and the storm tide in the bay area are improved, and accurate grading response of complex meteorological disasters is achieved.

title_en: Deep learning-based power grid toughness assessment method and system under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid toughness assessment method and system based on deep learning under extreme disasters, which belong to the field of power system toughness assessment and comprise the following steps of S1, acquiring the running state of a power system under the extreme disasters; S2, simulating an optimal load reduction calculation process of the power system, S3, determining an input feature vector and an output feature vector of a deep neural network model, S4, constructing a regression and classification model based on the deep neural network combined with a random forest, S5, training, S6, evaluating, S7, constructing a power grid toughness evaluation index, and outputting the toughness level of the power system based on the regression and classification model by utilizing the toughness evaluation index. By adopting the power grid toughness assessment method and system based on deep learning under extreme disasters, an artificial intelligent algorithm is adopted to replace the solving process of optimal load reduction calculation, so that the calculating process of toughness assessment can be accelerated, disaster early warning can be responded in time, and the loss caused by disasters is reduced as much as possible.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECH INSTITUTE STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Disaster recovery method and disaster recovery management system for construction engineering cost data
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster recovery method and a disaster recovery management system for construction engineering cost data, and carrying out disaster recovery backup prediction on a plurality of candidate data in the sample construction engineering cost data sequence by initializing a neural network to generate training disaster recovery backup allocation space data. And determining global network learning errors by comparing the predicted data with the marked data, so as to screen out effective sample data for network parameter learning and obtain a trained disaster recovery backup model. The method can accurately and efficiently carry out disaster recovery backup treatment on construction engineering cost data, improves the accuracy and efficiency of data disaster recovery, and ensures the safety and reliability of the construction engineering cost data. In practical application, the trained disaster recovery backup model is utilized to carry out disaster recovery backup treatment on the construction project cost data set to be treated, so that the risk of data loss or damage is effectively avoided.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHIHENG ENGINEERING MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster digital twin processing method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a flood disaster digital twin processing method and electronic equipment, which are applied to a flood disaster digital twin platform; the method comprises the steps of obtaining original data corresponding to a scene to be predicted, obtaining configuration information corresponding to the scene to be predicted, wherein the configuration information comprises at least one of boundary conditions and Manning coefficients, obtaining a flood prediction result of the scene to be predicted by using a flood simulation model according to the original data and the configuration information, wherein the flood prediction result comprises urban flooding data and drainage pipe network flow data, the urban flooding information is used for indicating the flooding height of each area in a city, and storing the flood prediction result. The user input interface and the operation method are provided, so that the transmission time is effectively reduced, the threshold of learning and using the flood disaster digital twin platform is reduced, and the flexibility and the adaptability of use are improved.

title_en: Deep learning-based intelligent identification method, system and storage medium for landslide hazard in reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for intelligently identifying a reservoir geological disaster based on a deep learning method, which comprise the steps of S1 analyzing basic geological data and monitoring data, primarily judging landslide susceptibility, S2 acquiring a reservoir side slope orthographic image and a three-dimensional digital elevation model by using an unmanned plane, S3 carrying out characteristic enhancement on an orthographic image data set, constructing and training a deep learning model for landslide disaster, S4 combining multi-period orthographic image comparison and displacement analysis, comprehensively judging landslide mass, and rechecking by using a three-dimensional digital elevation model, S5 analyzing a landslide deformation failure mode according to a prediction result, and combining numerical simulation analysis software to simulate a support mode to provide support for disaster management. The method is based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing data and ground base station monitoring data, and is combined with a deep learning algorithm, so that the efficiency of landslide disaster risk prediction and subsequent stability processing in a reservoir area is effectively improved, disaster control guidance can be provided, and effective guarantee is provided for reservoir engineering safety of large hydropower engineering.

title_en: Decision tree city waterlogging meteorological model and prediction method based on historical precipitation percentile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decision tree urban waterlogging weather model based on historical precipitation percentiles and a prediction method, which are characterized in that the precipitation disaster factors of urban waterlogging are researched based on the urban waterlogging disaster conditions, short-time strong precipitation is found and confirmed to be common characteristics of disaster occurrence, accumulated precipitation with different maximum duration and strong precipitation duration are selected as main disaster weather factors, 80% of classification data are established for training, 20% of classification data are used for testing, an optimal decision regression tree model with the maximum submergence depth is established by means of a CART decision tree regression method through parameter adjustment, and on the basis, the decision tree regression model based on the precipitation history percentiles is introduced by the historical percentiles of the precipitation factors, so that the decision tree regression model based on the precipitation history percentiles, which considers regional characteristics and site specificity, is better than the decision tree model without considering the precipitation history percentiles, and can be used for early identification and prediction of urban waterlogging.

title_en: Test device for simulating avalanche
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device for simulating avalanche, belongs to the technical field of glacier collapse simulation tests, and solves the problem that the existing glacier collapse test device is insufficient in simulation fidelity. According to the invention, the whole process and instantaneous dynamic characteristics of the avalanche or ice rock collapse under different natural environment temperatures, gradients and shearing stress conditions are respectively simulated through the inclination angle component, the temperature control component and the thrust component, and the fan-shaped characteristics of the chippings in the stacking groove are combined, so that the dynamic characteristics, the temperature distribution, the ice rock interface sliding mechanism and the critical triggering conditions of disasters of avalanche and ice rock collapse are conveniently researched, the real collapse mechanism of a natural ice body or ice rock body under the combined action of shearing force, temperature and topography change is simulated, and the effect of improving simulation fidelity is realized.

title_en: Ocean AI analysis and ocean disaster prediction method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a marine AI analysis and marine disaster prediction method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous data. The method comprises the steps of constructing a data matrix and calculating information quantity of ocean monitoring data to obtain a monitoring index weight matrix, carrying out sample-to-sample similarity calculation and neighborhood radius calculation by combining the monitoring index weight matrix to obtain a dimension reduction characteristic data set, inputting the dimension reduction characteristic data set into a three-layer neural network structure, carrying out parallel training on each monitoring point to obtain a distributed prediction model and a training output result, establishing an n-level state space according to the training output result, obtaining a layered early warning threshold set through a Markov decision algorithm, inputting the real-time monitoring characteristic data into the distributed prediction model to carry out abnormal state prediction to obtain an abnormal state predicted value, comparing the abnormal state predicted value with the layered early warning threshold set, and outputting an early warning level signal. The invention improves the accuracy of ocean AI analysis and ocean disaster prediction.

title_en: AI-driven 3D printing parameter self-distribution intelligent modeling method for complex geological structure
abstract_en: The invention provides an AI-driven 3D printing parameter self-distribution intelligent modeling method for a complex geologic structure, which comprises the following steps of obtaining multi-source characteristic data of the complex geologic structure, preprocessing, extracting geologic geometric parameters, mapping the geologic geometric parameters into a 3D printing voxel model, converting the geologic geometric parameters into geometric parameters which can be used for 3D printing, utilizing an intelligent algorithm to learn a nonlinear mapping relation between physical parameters and material parameters of the historical complex geologic structure, constructing and training an AI model, predicting material distribution parameters, converting the geometric parameters and the material distribution parameters into a three-dimensional model of the complex geologic structure, verifying, guiding out parameterized full-model slice data, and verifying the performance of the model of the complex geologic structure by 3D printing. Compared with the prior art, the invention realizes the intelligent conversion from data to the model, can accurately describe the complex spatial heterogeneity in the geological disaster model, improves the adaptability and accuracy of the model, and provides a basis for the follow-up development of complex geological disaster prediction and prevention.

title_en: Method and device for improving toughness of power distribution network by considering multi-element flexible resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for improving toughness of a power distribution network by considering multiple flexible resources, which are characterized in that the wind speed of each node of the power distribution network is calculated according to a typhoon wind field model, the fault probability of a power distribution line is calculated according to the wind speed and disconnection of each node and a tower fault probability model, so that the power failure process of the power distribution network under typhoon disasters is simulated, an objective function is established by taking minimized load reduction amount and power distribution network operation cost as optimization targets, line reinforcement resource constraint, tie line resource constraint, energy storage resource constraint, wind power resource constraint and power distribution network operation constraint are established based on the fault probability of the power distribution line, an optimal scheduling model of the power distribution network is generated according to each constraint of the objective function, and the optimal scheduling model of the power distribution network is solved, so that the optimal scheduling scheme of the power distribution network is obtained, the load reduction amount and the power distribution network operation cost are effectively reduced, and the power failure scale and the power failure time are reduced, and the toughness level of the power distribution network is effectively improved when extreme disasters occur.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Emergency rescue method and emergency response method for offshore platform underwater wellhead blowout after out-of-control
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency method and an emergency response method for an offshore platform underwater wellhead after blowout is out of control, which are based on the offshore underwater wellhead, when the wellhead is out of control, rescue well operation preparation, rescue well design and rescue well drilling operation are started, oil spill control is started, emergency response personnel and emergency equipment are mobilized, and the following steps are carried out, wherein the emergency response personnel and the emergency equipment are mobilized, S1, the emergency well investigation, S2, the condition evaluation of the underwater wellhead, S3, ROV intervention operation, S4, underwater barrier removal operation, S5 and the emergency blocking device are carried out to block the underwater wellhead.

title_en: Method of providing forest digital twin and apparatus using the same
title_ko: 산림 디지털 트윈 제공 방법 및 이를 이용한 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a user interface for providing a forest digital twin. The method comprises the steps of: receiving forest data from at least one forest disaster detection device; and providing a three-dimensional digital twin for a forest based on the forest data. The three-dimensional digital twin for the forest is configured to provide at least one of landslide prediction data and forest fire prediction data based on a simulation for the forest.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 산림 디지털 트윈 제공을 위한 사용자 인터페이스 제공 방법으로서. 상기 방법은, 적어도 하나의 산림 재난 탐지 디바이스로부터 산림 데이터를 수신하는 단계, 상기 산림 데이터를 기초로, 산림에 대한 3차원 디지털 트윈을 제공하는 단계를 포함하도록 구성되고, 상기 산림에 대한 3차원 디지털 트윈은, 상기 산림에 대한 시뮬레이션을 기초로 산사태 예측 데이터, 산불 예측 데이터 중 적어도 하나를 제공하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Geological disaster investigation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of investigation, in particular to a geological disaster investigation device which comprises a drilling barrel with an open lower end and a closed upper end, and an inner rod which slides inside the drilling barrel and penetrates out of the upper end of the drilling barrel, wherein the lower end of the inner rod is fixedly connected with an inner plate which is in sliding contact with the inner wall of the drilling barrel, a groove is formed in the inner rod along the vertical direction, the upper side of the outer side of the drilling barrel is fixedly connected with a bearing, the bearing is fixedly arranged in a shell, the upper end of the shell is buckled with a compression ring, a plurality of leakage holes are formed in the hollow inside the shell, the lower end face of the shell is provided with a pipeline for conveying cold water for the hollow inside the shell, and a soil sample can be quickly obtained to monitor geological conditions during investigation.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST CO LTD

title_en: Simulation pipe gallery collapse device for firefighter training
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of facilities for fire control training, in particular to a pipe gallery collapse simulating device for firefighter training, which comprises two upright posts, wherein the top end of each upright post is provided with a connecting part extending towards the direction of the other upright post, each connecting part is hinged with an extension body, one end of each extension body extends towards the direction of the opposite upright post, a driving device is arranged between each upright post and each extension body, and the driving device controls the extension body to swing up and down. The utility model discloses a device for simulating pipe gallery collapse for firefighter training, which solves the problem of providing simulated pipe gallery collapse for firefighter real fire simulation training.

title_en: Geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to the technical field of geological investigation, which comprises a base, wherein a shell is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a lifting assembly is arranged at the inner side of the shell, a drilling assembly is fixedly connected at the front side of the lifting assembly, the drilling assembly comprises a second motor, an output shaft of the second motor penetrates through the lifting block and is fixedly connected with a drilling barrel, a cavity is formed in the drilling barrel, a layered sampling mechanism is arranged in the cavity, and the lifting assembly is responsible for adjusting the height of the drilling assembly, so that soil with different depths can be sampled conveniently. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the layered sampling mechanism, the plurality of sampling cylinders can sample soil with different depths at one time, so that the sampling efficiency is reduced, and through the arrangement of the lifting assembly and the drilling assembly, the lifting assembly is responsible for adjusting the height of the drilling assembly, so that the soil with different depths can be sampled conveniently.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA INST OF GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: XR contents base disaster training platform
title_ko: 체감형 xr 콘텐츠 기반의 이동형 재난 안전 예방 체험 플랫폼
abstract_en: A mobile disaster safety prevention experience platform based on immersive XR content comprises a scenario storage unit (110); a disaster scenario selection unit (120); a disaster simulation unit (130); a feedback control signal generation unit (140); a user behavior detection unit (210); a wearable means (220); a feedback signal transmission generation unit (230); and an image output unit (300). The present invention allows a user to select a disaster scenario and experience a disaster through an XR avatar. The user's actions and sensor responses are analyzed in real time and reflected in the simulation and haptic feedback. Safety response capability is improved through disaster-specific evaluation and history management.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 체감형 XR 콘텐츠 기반의 이동형 재난 안전 예방 체험 플랫폼에 관한 것으로, 재난별 시나리오 정보(영상, 햅틱 신호, 환경 정보)이 메모리에 저장되는 시나리오 저장부(110)와; 저장된 재난 종류 및 재난 요소를 사용자가 선택할 수 있도록 인터페이스를 제공하는 재난 시나리오 선택부(120)와; 재난별 시나리오 영상을 생성하여 디스플레이게 전송하는 재난 영상 생성부(131)를 구비하고 다른 모듈과 연계되어 중앙 제어부 기능을 수행하는 재난 시뮬레이션부(130)와; 재난 시나리오에 따라 햅틱 제어 신호 및 환경 제어 신호(공기 온도, 바람)를 생성하는 피드백 제어 신호 발생부(140)와; 웨어러블 수단 또는 신체에 부착되는 각속도 센서, 가속도센서 또는 지자기 센서 중에서 선택되는 거동 감지 센서(211)와 상기 거동 감지 센서(211)의 신호를 무선으로 송신하는 거동 신호 송신부(212)로 구성되는 사용자 거동 감지부(210)와; 거동 감지 센서 또는 햅틱 신호 발생 수단에 구비된 상태로 사용자가 착용하는 웨어러블 수단(220)과; 열기를 갖는 워밍 공기, 냉기를 갖는 쿨링 공기, 또는 미스트를 생성하여 분사하는 피드백 신호 전달생성부(230)와; VR HMD, 영상 디스플레이, 또는 다면 영상 디스플레이 중에서 선택되는 영상 출력부(300);를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 체감형 XR 콘텐츠 기반의 이동형 재난 안전 예방 체험 플랫폼에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and the conrolling method thereof for automatic evaluation of emergency response education based on virtual reality or augmented reality
title_ko: 가상현실 또는 증강현실을 기반으로 한 긴급상황 대처 교육의 자동 평가를 위한 전자 장치 및 이의 제어 방법
abstract_en: Virtual reality and augmented reality-based experiences are provided for emergency situation coping education to improve the user's coping ability and provide evaluation information. An electronic device comprises: a camera photographing a user; a microphone sensing voice of the user; a communication interface performing communication connection with a user terminal; a memory; and a processor. The processor obtains image data photographing the user through the camera, obtains voice data through the microphone, extracts first feature information on the operation of a body part from the image data, extracts second feature information on the speed of an utterance and the height of a sound from the voice data, identifies a motion of the user by inputting the first feature information into a motion recognition model, identifies an emotion of the user by inputting the second feature information into an emotion recognition model, obtains evaluation information on emergency response based on the identified motion and emotion, and transmits the same to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 전자 장치 및 이의 제어 방법이 개시된다. 본 개시에 따른 전자 장치는 긴급상황 대처 교육을 받는 사용자를 촬영하는 카메라; 사용자의 음성을 감지하는 마이크; 사용자 단말과 통신 연결을 수행하는 통신 인터페이스; 적어도 하나의 인스트럭션을 저장하는 메모리; 및 메모리에 연결되어 적어도 하나의 인스트럭션을 실행하는 하나 이상의 프로세서;를 포함하고, 하나 이상의 프로세서는, 카메라를 통해 긴급상황 대처 교육을 받는 중인 사용자를 촬영한 영상 데이터를 획득하고, 마이크를 통해 사용자의 음성 데이터를 획득하고, 획득된 영상 데이터로부터 사용자의 기 설정된 신체부위의 가동에 대한 제1 특징 정보를 추출하고, 획득된 음성 데이터로부터 사용자의 발화의 속도 및 음의 높낮이에 대한 제2 특징 정보를 추출하고, 제1 특징 정보를 사용자의 신체부위 가동에 기초하여 사용자의 동작을 식별하기 위한 동작 인식 모델에 입력하여 사용자의 동작을 식별하고, 제2 특징 정보를 사용자의 발화에 기초하여 감정을 식별하기 위한 제1 감정 인식 모델에 입력하여 사용자의 감정을 식별하고, 식별된 동작 및 감정에 기초하여 사용자의 긴급상황 대처에 대한 평가 정보를 획득하고, 통신 인터페이스를 통해 획득된 평가 정보를 사용자 단말로 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: Mobile Electric Vehicle Fire Suppression System
title_ko: 이동식 전기차 화재진압시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile electric vehicle fire suppression system. More specifically, a water pressure-driven punching device, spray, or smothering fire-extinguishing blanket is mounted on a moving means, and a water tank is provided in the moving means to automatically run anywhere in the event of a fire in an electric vehicle to push the punching device or spray into the lower part of the electric vehicle, and a hole is drilled in a battery pack disposed under the electric vehicle to inject firefighting water stored in the water tank into the battery pack or spray the firefighting water to the lower part of the vehicle to cool the battery pack, thereby extinguishing the fire. The firefighting water used for the punching device or spray is recovered to the water tank and recycled, thereby reducing the waste of the firefighting water and enabling firefighting with a small water tank capacity. Moreover, the smothering fire-extinguishing blanket is covered on the electric vehicle to suppress the initial smoke generation and facilitate the fire suppression.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이동식 전기차 화재진압시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 자세하게는 수압으로 구동되는 천공장치나 스프레이 또는 질식소화포를 이동수단에 장착하고 이동수단에 물탱크를 구비하여 전기차에 화재 발생 시 어디든 자동으로 달려가서 천공장치 또는 스프레이를 전기차 하부에 밀어넣고 전기차 하부에 배치된 배터리팩에 구멍을 뚫어 물탱크에 저장된 소방수를 배터리팩에 주입시키거나 스프레이로 차량하부에 분사하여 배터리팩을 식혀줌으로서 화재를 진압하되 천공장치 또는 스프레이에 사용되는 소방수를 물탱크로 회수하여 재활용함으로서 소방수의 낭비를 줄이고 적은 물탱크 용량으로 소화가 가능하게 하는 것이 특징이다. 또한 질식소화포를 전기차에 덮어 씌어서 초기 매연발생을 억제하고 화재진압을 원활하게 한다.

title_en: Comprehensive field rainfall observation, soil water and groundwater response method, system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive method, a system and electronic equipment for field observation of precipitation, soil water and groundwater response, the method comprises four steps of data monitoring and acquisition, hydrological response simulation, characteristic data selection and preprocessing and hydrological response prediction. Through deployment precipitation monitoring station, soil moisture sensor and groundwater water level monitoring well, real-time supervision and acquisition relevant data. And constructing a hydrological response model by using GIS and numerical simulation software, and simulating the change of the water content of the soil and the groundwater level under the rainfall condition. And screening key characteristic data, preprocessing, inputting the key characteristic data into a pre-established and trained random forest hydrologic prediction model, and outputting groundwater level change and soil water content prediction results in a future period of time. Providing scientific basis for water resource management, flood control, disaster reduction and the like, and being beneficial to making scientific and reasonable decision-making schemes.

title_en: Automatic driving vehicle control device and method based on safety training
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic driving vehicles, and particularly relates to an automatic driving vehicle control device and method based on safety training. Aiming at the problems that the existing automatic driving safety personnel training depends on the operation of a driving robot, has single scene and can not dynamically simulate complex working conditions, the invention provides a training device based on a drive-by-wire vehicle, a low-torque motor, a combined navigation system and an electronic map. The technical scheme includes that the method comprises the steps that a low-torque motor simulates a driver to hold, an INS/GPS integrated navigation system performs real-time positioning compensation, a bus tool executes a line control instruction, and a control system combines an electronic map and a training scheme to generate a path plan. The device can simulate mileage, complex weather and burst scenes of more than 1000 km, and is used for training emergency response capability of a safety officer and control skills of a vehicle.
assignees: BEIJING INNOVATION CENTER FOR MOBILITY INTELLIGENT CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive control method of fire emergency lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive control method of a fire emergency lamp, which relates to the technical field of illumination control, and comprises the steps of generating visible light with preset color by using blue laser excitation through deployment of a fire emergency lamp group with ceramic fluorescent powder, realizing nS-level fiber breaking control through chromatographic reflection of the visible light, and carrying out attenuation prediction and identification on the light conversion efficiency of the lamp by combining generation of an countermeasure network; and generating a building three-dimensional model through simulation, mapping the lamp identification into the model, executing lamp fixed-point optimization control analysis, dynamically adjusting laser parameters, and realizing the self-adaptive regulation and control of the target building emergency lighting. The invention solves the technical problems of hidden electric fire hazards, insufficient anti-interference capability and insufficient emergency response capability of the existing fire emergency lighting system, and achieves the technical effects of improving the intrinsic safety, anti-interference capability and emergency response capability of the emergency lighting system through the photoelectric separation technology and the dynamic optimization of the generation countermeasure network.

title_en: Garden insect disaster prediction optimization method based on ecological model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a garden insect disaster prediction optimization method based on an ecological model. The technical scheme includes that garden ecological factors are divided into climate driving factors, plant health factors and insect pest biological factors according to biological levels, environmental levels and spatial levels, causality modeling is conducted on interaction relation among the factors, dynamic Bayesian network analysis ecological factors are introduced to identify potential insect disaster high risk trigger points, a Sobol sensitivity analysis method is used to identify key driving factors, decision basis is provided for model optimization, an environment pressure index including drought and illumination intensity fluctuation of an ecological system and a response relation of insect pest population dynamics are defined, a nonlinear response equation is built, an improved Lotka-Volterra model is fused, the environment pressure coefficient is added, expansion characteristics of the insect pest population under various ecological pressures are simulated, and meanwhile influence of long-term climate trend and short-term weather fluctuation on insect disaster is captured.
assignees: ANYANG GARDEN GREENING SCIENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Urban disaster prevention and risk avoidance path planning method based on Al
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Al-based urban disaster prevention and risk avoidance path planning method, which relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and risk avoidance, and comprises the following steps of: the method comprises the steps of collecting city information and disaster data and preprocessing, carrying out three-dimensional modeling on internal and external features of a city building, training and constructing through an AI model according to the three-dimensional modeling, planning a disaster risk avoidance method and a path, uploading the risk avoidance method and the path to a visual window, and quickly generating an optimal risk avoidance path and strategy for a specific disaster through an integrated AI technology and real-time data flow.
assignees: GUANGDONG QIAOYIN AITE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation free-falling type virtual reality sense high-place operation safety protection experience device
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulated free-falling type virtual reality entity sense high-altitude operation safety protection experience device, and aims to provide an immersive high-altitude operation safety training platform for high-altitude operators. The device combines a virtual reality technology, a somatosensory feedback technology and a safety protection system, simulates a free landing process through a dynamic platform, and provides real-time somatosensory feedback according to the behaviors of operators. The system can simulate different high-altitude operation scenes in a virtual environment, such as cleaning of an outer elevation of a building, maintenance of an overhead power line and the like, and simultaneously has a safety protection feedback function, so that operators can wear and use safety protection equipment correctly in the training process. In addition, the risk emergency training module can simulate the sudden dangerous situation, and the emergency response capability of operators is improved. The invention has the advantages of high simulation, high efficiency, safety and the like, and is innovative high-place operation safety training equipment.
assignees: Huaneng jinan huangtai power generation co ltd

title_en: Coal mine gas composite dynamic disaster prediction simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine gas composite dynamic disaster prediction simulation device, which comprises a test bin, a simulation shell and a coal sample replacement assembly, wherein the coal sample replacement assembly comprises a driving shaft, an outer barrel, a coal storage bin, a hydraulic plate and a sealing plate III, the coal sample replacement assembly enables the simulation device to perform experiments on different types of coal samples, further researches the influence of differences of coal properties on disasters, the coal sample replacement is more convenient and quick, a plurality of injection pipes and extraction pipes are arranged to realize dynamic simulation of gas concentration, the possibility and severity of disasters under different extraction conditions are predicted, a scientific basis is provided for coal mine safety production, a hydraulic plate and a sealing plate III are arranged, the hydraulic plate can slide under the pressure effect of simulating gas in a cavity, the sealing plate III is further opened, the simulated more real gas outburst phenomenon is simulated, the simulated data is more accurate, and the predicted result is more accurate.
assignees: SHANXI LUAN ENV ENERGY DEV CO LTD;UNIV HENAN POLYTECHNIC

title_en: Earthquake disaster prediction method based on iron tower monitoring data
abstract_en: The application provides an earthquake disaster prediction method based on iron tower monitoring data, which relates to the technical field of disaster prediction, and comprises the following steps: acquiring a monitoring data set, extracting seismic region and seismic time node data, constructing a seismic iron tower reference set, performing model training to obtain a seismic disaster prediction model, acquiring a data prediction structure, performing data standardization processing on iron tower monitoring data, inputting a processing result into the seismic disaster prediction model to obtain a prediction result, and finally performing disaster relief strategy guidance feedback. The method mainly solves the problems that the time, the place and the magnitude of the earthquake cannot be accurately predicted, the prediction time range is short, and the long-term prediction requirement cannot be met. Through the earthquake monitoring to the iron tower, potential safety hazards can be found and solved in time, earthquake disasters can be better dealt with, and casualties and economic losses are reduced.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Urban disaster emergency response and intelligent management system based on unmanned aerial vehicle assistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban disaster emergency response and intelligent management system based on unmanned aerial vehicle assistance, and relates to the technical field of emergency response. According to the invention, the acquired image data is subjected to a series of processing by the identification model training unit to obtain new image data, so that the number of pictures in the original sample data set is increased, parameters of a network model are continuously optimized by utilizing training data, test data and verification data, the accuracy of identifying a wheel area by the model is further improved, meanwhile, the actual ponding analysis unit calculates the corresponding wheel radius in the image data according to the identified wheel area, the actual ponding height is further calculated, and the evacuation scheme formulated by a subsequent control center is ensured to be more scientific and effective.
assignees: DIGE HANGZHOU IOT TECH CO LTD;HANGZHOU SHUWA TECH CO LTD;TAIZHOU ZHIYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent early warning method for geological disasters caused by rising of underground water level
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent early warning method for geological disasters caused by rising of underground water levels, which comprises the steps of obtaining underground water level data of a target area, inputting the underground water level data into an underground water level prediction model to obtain a water level change trend prediction result, obtaining the underground water level prediction model by training an LSTM neural network model through a training set, wherein the training set comprises a timestamp of original underground water level data and a corresponding water level value, drawing a water level change curve according to the water level change trend prediction result, judging whether the predicted water level has abnormal fluctuation or exceeds a preset threshold, and triggering an alarm when the predicted water level has abnormal fluctuation or exceeds the preset threshold. The invention solves the accuracy problem of underground water level monitoring in a complex environment, realizes large-scale real-time data acquisition and transmission, improves the data processing efficiency through edge calculation and cloud analysis, finally realizes accurate early warning and risk area division of geological disasters, and provides powerful support for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: QINGHAI 906 ENGINEERING SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;QINGHAI BUREAU OF ENVIRONMENTAL GEOLOGY EXPLOR;QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST

title_en: Burn prediction method based on CFD (computational fluid dynamics) secondary development UDF (universal description framework) custom model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of human body protection, and discloses a burn prediction method based on a CFD (computational fluid dynamics) secondary development UDF custom model, which comprises the steps of establishing a thermal mass coupling transfer model between human skin of a rescuer and a high-temperature environment and between firefighters; the method comprises the steps of establishing a corresponding custom model for a thermal mass coupling transfer model in a CFD (computational fluid dynamics), converting the thermal mass coupling transfer model from one dimension to three dimension to obtain the thermal mass transfer condition of a rescuer in a three-dimensional high-temperature environment, establishing a numerical dummy model according to the human physiological structure of the rescuer and a thermal response model for reflecting the thermal physiological response of the rescuer in the high-temperature environment, coupling the numerical dummy model, the thermal response model and the three-dimensional thermal mass coupling transfer model in the CFD, and simulating to obtain the thermal mass transfer condition and the thermal physiological response of each human part of the rescuer in the three-dimensional high-temperature environment so as to improve the human skin burn condition prediction effect of the rescuer in the high-temperature environment.

title_en: Multifunctional monitoring device for landslide monitoring and drilling and installation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional monitoring device for landslide monitoring and drilling and an installation method, and belongs to the technical field of landslide engineering monitoring; the monitoring assembly is used for monitoring displacement and water level change of landslide, the pipeline assembly is used for providing an installation space for the monitoring assembly, guiding cables and grouting, the data processing assembly is used for collecting and processing data of the monitoring assembly, the auxiliary assembly is used for assisting in installation, protection and stabilization of a monitoring device, the installation method comprises the steps of drilling, sensor customization, equipment throwing, connecting the pipeline assembly, connecting the auxiliary assembly, grouting and the like, the purpose of monitoring the drilling of the landslide in ultra-deep for multiple purposes is achieved, displacement monitoring can be carried out in full hole depth, meanwhile, underground water level change can be monitored, measurement accuracy is high, equipment manufacturing cost is low, service life is long, obvious advantages are achieved in monitoring the landslide in huge thickness and ultra-deep, and reliable technical support is provided for prevention and treatment of landslide disasters.

title_en: Risk perception-based evacuation simulation method, system, electronic equipment and medium for exhibition building crowd
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk perception-based evacuation simulation method, a system, electronic equipment and media for a meeting and exhibition building crowd, which belong to the technical field of crowd evacuation simulation, and comprise the steps of firstly obtaining meeting and exhibition building evacuation scene parameters and personnel parameters, constructing an evacuation scene model, guiding personnel into the evacuation model, then constructing a risk perception model comprising three elements of alarm prompt, danger source and information transmission, and coupling the model and personnel motion, dividing the personnel to be evacuated in the evacuation scene into a plurality of groups by using a K-means method, distributing an outlet for each group according to the distance, planning a macroscopic path by an improved artificial bee colony algorithm, simulating the microscopic movement of the personnel by a cellular automaton model, so as to obtain a personnel evacuation path, and the method can actually reflect the behavior of the personnel evacuation, plan a more reasonable evacuation path, and provide guidance basis for evacuation of the meeting and exhibition building in the situation of containing obstacles.

title_en: Form-changeable water-air amphibious bionic robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a form-changeable simulated water-air amphibious bionic robot, which consists of a bionic main body, a deformation mechanism and a driving system. The bionic main body fuses a streamline structure of fish and an efficient aerodynamic shape of birds, and the deformation mechanism realizes efficient switching of the fish-bird shape. The driving system is cooperated with the propeller through the steering engine to realize aquatic flying propulsion and air flying propulsion respectively. The robot has high flexibility and excellent motion performance, is suitable for a plurality of fields such as disaster relief, environment monitoring, unmanned and anti-unmanned reconnaissance and the like, and provides an innovative solution for complex environment operation tasks.

title_en: Urban road network traffic flood vulnerability assessment method based on multi-source multi-mode data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban road network traffic flood vulnerability assessment method based on multi-source multi-mode data, which comprises the steps of, and constructing a road network disaster vulnerability assessment model by combining multi-source data such as hydrology, water conservancy, land utilization, DEM, road network attributes, traffic flow, socioeconomic performance, social media, mobile phone signaling and the like. The method is characterized in that a weighted fusion method is adopted, multi-mode data are integrated efficiently, a high-performance hydrodynamic integrated model HiPIMS is utilized, high-resolution water depth grid dynamic simulation is realized, changes of road traffic flow, speed and traffic capacity under flood conditions are captured accurately, and reliability of results is verified through verification indexes. And the vulnerability curves of roads of different grades are deduced based on the road grade service characteristics and the flood damage rate, and the mobile phone signaling data based on the mobile base station is utilized for rate verification, so that quantitative analysis and grade division of the vulnerability of the road network disaster are innovatively realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of the quantification of the road network risks are remarkably improved.

title_en: Wounded person transferring method, apparatus, device, medium and program product
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus, device, medium, and program product for transporting wounded persons. The method comprises the steps of obtaining current disaster information corresponding to a current disaster, determining simulated wounded information corresponding to the current disaster information and the rescue capability of a rescue place, generating wounded transportation strategies based on the simulated wounded information and the rescue capability of the rescue place, simulating each wounded transportation strategy to obtain transportation indexes of each wounded transportation strategy, and determining a target wounded transportation strategy according to the transportation indexes of each wounded transportation strategy so as to transport the wounded based on the target wounded transportation strategy. The method provided by the embodiment of the disclosure can improve the transfer efficiency and effect.
assignees: BEIJING GLOBAL SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pollution tracing system and method based on drainage system water quality and water quantity monitoring analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pollution tracing system and a pollution tracing method based on drainage system water quality and water quantity monitoring analysis, which particularly relate to the technical field of water quality and water quantity monitoring, wherein water quality and water quantity parameters are collected in real time through a distributed sensor network, a denoising processing and anomaly detection algorithm are combined to ensure data quality, a multivariate dynamic analysis method and a space-time correlation model are utilized to identify anomaly change characteristics of pollutant concentration, a nonlinear superposition effect correction model is constructed to eliminate false peak interference at a junction, a real pollution source is positioned, a pollution propagation process is simulated based on a diffusion path and flow characteristics by combining a geographic information system and a drainage basin model, the geographical position of the pollution source is accurately determined, and finally, a tracing result is visually output to a user terminal to generate a pollution tracing report, scientific treatment advice and multi-level alarm signals are provided, and effective technical support is provided for pollution treatment and emergency response.

title_en: Deduction and demonstration method for typhoon disaster emergency evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deduction method and a demonstration method for emergency evacuation of typhoons, the deduction method comprises the following steps of setting a deduction background according to typhoons and typhoons landing places, setting initial states of personnel distribution, traffic conditions and material reserves according to the deduction background, designing deduction rules, carrying out evacuation deduction on a display map according to the deduction rules and the initial states of the personnel distribution, the traffic conditions and the material reserves, evaluating evacuation efficiency and resource utilization rate according to the deduction results, and improving the deduction rules according to the evaluation results. The deduction method can design and check each link of the evacuation plan in detail, quickly set and execute the exercise, shorten the preparation and execution time of the exercise, enable the evacuation exercise to be performed more frequently, improve the coverage range and frequency of the exercise, and ensure the feasibility and the effectiveness of the plan in actual operation.

title_en: Internet-based intelligent early warning system for high-altitude monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internet-based intelligent early warning system for high-altitude monitoring, which relates to the technical field of high-altitude video monitoring and solves the problems that forest fire is monitored by acquiring forest anomaly information through acquired forest monitoring surface information in the prior art, and the surface information acquired by satellite remote sensing is influenced by cloud layers and smoke factors and can cause inaccurate and untimely forest fire detection; the method comprises the steps of carrying out zoning management on the total area of the forest farm, periodically obtaining satellite images of the forest farm through a satellite remote sensing technology, judging whether abnormal areas do not appear in the satellite images, setting early warning measures of all areas and obtaining detailed information, judging whether corresponding multi-area early warning measure linkage is needed according to the abnormal areas, processing the detailed information and constructing an information identification model, identifying abnormal conditions through a training information identification model, judging whether fire disaster occurs in the identification result, and timely and accurately finding out forest farm fires.
assignees: HUBEI XINTONG COMMUNICATION CO LTD;CHINA COMSERVICE SUPPLY CHAIN CO LTD

title_en: Geological drilling device and method for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological drilling data processing of coal mines, and particularly discloses a geological drilling device and a geological drilling method for the coal mines, wherein the geological drilling method comprises the following steps: the performance of the drilling device is detected, the coal mine geological detection and the coal mine geological analysis are carried out, the performance of each drilling device is reduced or abnormal through detecting and acquiring the operation data of each drilling device, so that the subsequent safety accidents caused by faults of the drilling device in the actual coal mine geological drilling process are avoided, the potential safety hazards in the coal mine geological detection process can be timely found through monitoring the operation data and the coal mine environment data of each drilling device in the coal mine geological detection process, the occurrence of accidents is prevented through early warning prompt, the geological data of the coal mine in the coal mine geological detection period are acquired, the geological safety condition of the coal mine can be monitored, the geological safety risk of the coal mine can be estimated more accurately, and the occurrence of coal mine geological disasters and accidents is avoided.

title_en: Sample expansion method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sample expansion method, a sample expansion system and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data enhancement. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a seismic disaster data sample, preprocessing the seismic disaster data sample to construct an initial data set, dividing the initial data set into a training set and a testing set, training a variable self-encoder by using the training set, updating the weight of the variable self-encoder by minimizing a loss function in the training process, randomly extracting hidden variables after the training of the variable self-encoder is completed and generating a new sample by using a decoder, screening the new sample by using a fuzzy fusion score function to remove noise accumulation to obtain an expanded sample, and performing quality evaluation on the expanded sample to finish seismic disaster data sample expansion. The method can realize the efficient expansion of the data sample under the condition of considering the universality and the rationality.

title_en: Method and device for performing fire evacuation simulation based on spatial network of semantic digital twin virtual model considering internal facility arrangement
title_ko: 내부 시설 배치를 고려한 시멘틱 디지털 트윈 가상 모델의 공간 네트워크를 기반으로 화재 대피 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for a server to determine an optimal evacuation route based on BIM information for a building. The method comprises the steps of: generating spatial semantic information for the building based on the BIM information for the building; and implementing a three-dimensional virtual space for the building based on the spatial semantic information for the building. The three-dimensional virtual space for the building includes at least one layer, and the at least one layer includes M unit spaces interconnected by N doors. According to embodiments, a server generates a space connection matrix and a door-space table based on BIM information on a building, thereby efficiently determining an optimal evacuation route using the space connection matrix and the door-space table.
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 내부 시설 배치를 고려한 시멘틱 디지털 트윈 가상 모델의 공간 네트워크를 기반으로 화재 대피 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 방법 및 장치를 제공한다. 일 실시예에 따른 상기 방법은, 상기 건물에 대한 BIM(building information modeling) 정보에 기반하여 상기 건물에 대한 공간 시멘틱 정보를 생성하고, 상기 건물에 대한 공간 시멘틱 정보를 기반으로 상기 건물에 대한 3차원 가상 공간을 구현하고, 상기 건물에 대한 3차원 가상 공간은 적어도 하나의 계층을 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 계층은 N개의 출입문으로 상호 연결된 M개의 단위 공간을 포함하고, 상기 공간 시멘틱 정보는 M개의 단위 공간 각각을 형상화하기 위한 공간 폴리곤 정보, 외부 공간에 대한 정보, 상기 M개의 단위 공간과 연결되는 출입문을 나타내는 출입문 객체 정보, 상기 M개의 단위 공간 사이의 연결성을 나타내는 공간 연결 매트릭스 및 상기 N개의 출입문과 상기 M개의 단위 공간 사이의 매칭 관계를 나타내는 출입문-공간 테이블을 포함하고, 상기 공간 시멘틱 정보를 기반으로 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 대해 최단 대피 경로를 결정하고, 상기 최단 대피 경로는 해당 단위 공간이 출발 노드로 설정되고, 해당 단위 공간에서 가장 가까운 외부 공간으로 연결된 출입문이 포함된 단위 공간이 도착 노드로 설정되고, 상기 공간 시멘틱 정보 및 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 대한 구조물 정보를 기반으로 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 복수의 에이전트를 배치하고, 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 대한 구조물 정보 및 상기 최단 대피 경로를 기반으로 상기 복수의 에이전트 각각에 대한 최적 대피 경로를 결정하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 예를 들어, 상기 최적 대피 경로는 에이전트의 위치가 출발 위치로 설정되고, 상기 출발 위치가 포함된 단위 공간에서 가장 가까운 외부 공간으로 연결된 출입문이 도착 위치로 설정되고, 상기 출발 위치가 포함된 단위 공간의 최단 대피 경로를 구성하는 단위 공간마다 단위 공간 내부에 포함된 구조물을 제외한 영역을 지나는 경로로 결정될 수 있다.

title_en: Simulation System for firefighting drone adjustment
title_ko: 산불진압 드론 조종 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a forest fire suppression drone control simulation system. The forest fire suppression drone control simulation system comprises: a simulation drone controlled by a control trainee; an operation part controlled by the control trainee to operate the simulation drone; a display part disposed in front of the operation part to output an image according to the operation of the control trainee; and a control part for controlling driving of the simulation drone controlled by the operation part.
abstract_ko: 산불진압 드론 조종 시뮬레이션 시스템이 제공된다. 산불진압 드론 조종 시뮬레이션 시스템은, 조종 학습생이 조종하는 모의 드론과, 모의 드론을 동작시키기 위해 조종 학습생이 조종하는 조작부와, 조작부 전방에 배치되어 조종 학습생의 조작에 따른 영상을 출력하는 디스플레이부 및 조작부에 의해 조종하는 모의 드론의 구동을 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Display apparatus and the conrolling method thereof for emergency response education contents and evaluation based on virtual reality or augmented reality
title_ko: 가상현실 또는 증강현실 기반의 긴급상황 대처 교육 컨텐츠 및 평가를 제공하는 디스플레이 장치 및 이의 제어 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a display device comprising: a communication interface for performing communication connection with a server; a display for outputting content for an emergency situation; a speaker for outputting content for the emergency situation; a microphone for detecting a user's voice; a sensor unit for detecting a user's movement; a memory in which at least one instruction is stored; and one or more processors connected to the communication interface, the display, the speaker, the microphone, and the sensor unit, and connected to the memory to execute the instruction. The present invention can rapidly and efficiently improve the ability of a child to cope with an emergency situation by performing education and evaluation for directly experiencing and coping with an emergency situation such as kidnapping, sex crimes, and street loss of the child based on virtual reality or augmented reality.
abstract_ko: 디스플레이 장치 및 이의 제어 방법이 개시된다. 본 개시에 따른 디스플레이 장치는, 서버와 통신 연결을 수행하는 통신 인터페이스; 긴급상황에 대한 컨텐츠를 출력하는 디스플레이; 긴급상황에 대한 컨텐츠를 출력하는 스피커; 사용자의 음성을 감지하는 마이크; 사용자의 움직임을 감지하는 센서부; 적어도 하나의 인스트럭션이 저장된 메모리; 및 통신 인터페이스, 디스플레이, 스피커, 마이크 및 센서부와 연결되며, 메모리와 연결되어 인스트럭션을 실행하는 하나 이상의 프로세서;를 포함하고, 하나 이상의 프로세서는, 통신 인터페이스를 통해 서버로부터 긴급상황에 대한 컨텐츠 데이터가 수신되면, 컨텐츠 데이터에 기초하여 긴급상황에 대한 제1 영상을 출력하도록 디스플레이를 제어하고, 긴급상황에 대한 제1 음성을 출력하도록 스피커를 제어하고, 센서부의 감지 결과에 기초하여 사용자의 움직임에 대응되는 디스플레이 장치의 움직임을 식별하고, 식별된 디스플레이 장치의 움직임에 기초하여 제1 영상의 영상 각도를 수정한 제2 영상을 출력하도록 디스플레이를 제어하고, 마이크를 통해 감지된 사용자의 음성에 기초하여 사용자의 발화를 식별하고, 식별된 발화에 대응되는 제2 음성을 출력하도록 스피커를 제어할 수 있다.

title_en: Modeling simulation method and system for uniform water-covering stress of 10kV distribution line wires
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling simulation method and a system for uniform water-covering stress of a 10kV distribution line wire, which relate to the technical field of power disaster prevention and reduction, and comprise the steps of collecting microclimate data of a distribution line area, wherein the microclimate data comprise wind speed and temperature; the method comprises the steps of collecting uniform icing thickness of a wire, calculating uniform icing load, establishing a three-dimensional physical model, setting material attribute parameters of a corresponding structure by using simulation software based on the three-dimensional physical model to obtain a simulation model, setting wind speed based on the simulation model, setting uniform icing loads of different thicknesses on the wire, then carrying out grid division and calculation, finally obtaining stress and deformation states of the wire under different uniform icing loads, and outputting a corresponding simulation graph. The invention can accurately simulate the stress and deformation conditions of the wire and the tower under different icing thicknesses by utilizing SolidWorks and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) methods, and ensures that the simulation result has high precision and reliability.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Rock similar model material simulating water-induced weakening effect and preparation method of rock similar model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slope collapse geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a rock similar model material for simulating a water-induced weakening effect and a preparation method of the rock similar model. The rock-like model material comprises rock-like materials for preparing bedrock and dangerous rock-like models and structural plane-like materials for bonding the bedrock and dangerous rock-like models. The rock similar material comprises aggregate composed of quartz sand and barite powder, gypsum, cement, glycerol, water and a gypsum retarder, and the structural surface similar material comprises aggregate composed of quartz sand and barite powder, gypsum, kaolin, glycerol, water and a gypsum retarder. In the structural surface similar material, the kaolin has water swelling property, can be cooperated with other components, simulates the phenomena of weakening of the main control structural surface of the dangerous rock body and crack expansion-induced collapse of the dangerous rock body caused by water-induced weakening effect, and solves the problem that the structural surface of the dangerous rock body in the existing collapse similar model is difficult to erode rapidly when meeting water.
assignees: BEIJING INST OF GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION;UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Sand pebble stratum catastrophe grouting control virtual-real blending cooperative test method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grouting simulation tests, in particular to a method and a system for a disaster grouting control virtual-real blending cooperative test of a sandy pebble stratum, wherein the method comprises the steps of developing a grouting test on a sandy pebble stratum simulation model, and acquiring grouting parameters and monitoring parameters in the grouting process; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a slurry diffusion path and a diffusion range of a region with higher surrounding rock grade based on resistivity and radar data, obtaining a slurry diffusion path and a diffusion range of a region with lower surrounding rock grade based on resistivity and optical fiber sensing data, inputting initial grouting parameters into a neural network model after training to obtain simulation data, respectively preprocessing and aligning the past data, performing fusion analysis, and performing pre-control adjustment on grouting equipment parameters and grouting schemes according to fusion analysis results. Realizing the instant regulation and control of grouting scheme and equipment.

title_en: High-pressure storage tank hydrogen leakage diffusion analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas leakage detection, in particular to a high-pressure storage tank hydrogen leakage diffusion analysis method which comprises the steps of accurately capturing physical characteristics of hydrogen and interaction of the physical characteristics and environment through constructing a physical model, simulating diffusion processes under different leakage scenes, monitoring key index parameters in real time through deployment sensors, ensuring real-time performance and reliability of data, rapidly responding to potential leakage events, reducing possibility and consequences of accidents, dynamically adjusting model parameters according to real-time data through establishing mapping relation between real-time monitoring data and physical model parameters, optimizing output results, generating corresponding risk early warning signals through quantitative evaluation and risk level classification, helping to discover potential safety hazards in time, and taking necessary emergency response measures. The invention is used for solving the technical problems of high-pressure storage tank hydrogen leakage diffusion simulation and real-time monitoring and early warning.

title_en: Method and system for simulating dam blocking damage process under debris flow impact
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster simulation, and relates to a method and a system for simulating a dam damage process under debris flow impact. The method comprises the steps of constructing a debris flow depth average two-phase flow model, discretizing the debris flow depth average two-phase flow model by a second-order finite volume method, describing impact events by a poisson counting process to obtain time distribution of impact giant stones, calculating impact loads containing elastoplastic deformation stages to obtain intensity distribution of the impact giant stones, calculating accumulated damage indexes according to the time distribution and the intensity distribution of the impact events, and updating geometric parameters of a blocking dam. According to the invention, the depth average two-phase model, the impact megastone randomness probability model and the impact load model are integrated to describe the conditions of the debris flow propagation and the interception dam in the flowing process, the debris flow propagation process and the dam damage change caused by the megastone impact can be quantitatively described, and the accuracy of the simulation result is improved.

title_en: Disaster prevention and reduction monitoring and early warning method and system for power grid equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster prevention, reduction, monitoring and early warning method and a system of power grid equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring meteorological parameter data of the power grid equipment, and carrying out anomaly detection processing on the meteorological parameter data to obtain normal meteorological parameter data; S2, carrying out data preprocessing on normal meteorological parameter data and constructing a meteorological parameter data set, S3, building a disaster prevention and reduction monitoring and early warning integrated model, training and predicting and evaluating the disaster prevention and reduction monitoring and early warning integrated model according to a training data set and a test data set to obtain a final disaster prevention and reduction monitoring and early warning integrated model, S4, collecting real-time meteorological parameter data of power grid equipment, inputting the final disaster prevention and reduction monitoring and early warning integrated model, and outputting a meteorological event classification result. The invention solves the problems that the existing power grid equipment monitoring technology can not realize all-weather and all-dimensional monitoring of the power grid equipment, and the reliability and the accuracy of classifying and predicting the disaster risk of the power grid equipment are lower.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;SANMING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;DATIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine roof and floor multi-disaster cooperative treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster cooperative treatment method for a coal mine roof and a coal mine floor, which comprises the steps of drilling from the ground to the direction of the coal mine roof by using a directional drilling machine, drilling a drilling tool into the coal mine roof, drilling along the coal mine roof in a layer to form a horizontal section, putting a sleeve into the drilling hole, injecting holes into the sleeve by adopting a mode of combining hydraulic sand blasting perforation and bottom seal dragging fracturing, enabling high-pressure water to act in the ground, carrying out fracturing construction on the coal mine roof, pulling out all upper sleeves after the fracturing construction is finished, carrying out secondary drilling construction by using the directional drilling machine, enabling the drilling tool to penetrate through the coal seam to enter a water-containing layer in the coal mine floor, and grouting into the water-containing layer. According to the method, the fracturing is carried out on the coal mine bottom plate, the advanced exploration treatment is carried out on the coal mine bottom plate, the hydraulic pressure is carried out on the coal mine top plate, the high stress of the coal mine top plate is effectively released in the working face stoping process, the advanced exploration treatment is carried out on the coal mine bottom plate, and the grouting reconstruction is carried out on the three ash aquifers.

title_en: Method and device for intelligent early identification of large-area potential landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for early intelligent identification of a large-area potential landslide, which belong to the technical field of image target identification and geological disaster monitoring, and the method comprises the steps of collecting historical data of a landslide area, obtaining earth surface deformation rate and gradient data, and forming a sample data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a potential landslide identification model composed of a data input layer, a feature coding network and an identification result output layer, wherein the feature coding network is composed of 9 cascaded feature learning modules, each feature learning module is composed of a network hiding layer and a data normalization layer, training and verifying the potential landslide identification model to obtain a final potential landslide identification model, obtaining actual measurement data of a monitoring area, inputting the actual measurement data into the final potential landslide identification model, and outputting a potential landslide identification result of the monitoring area. The invention realizes the distinction between potential landslide candidate points and non-hidden danger points in a large area range, and provides reliable technical support for landslide disaster prevention and control.
