title_en: Digital twin simulation method and device for preventing seawater intrusion by pumping underground salt water
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin simulation method and a device for preventing seawater invasion by extracting underground salt water, which belong to the technical field of seawater invasion and comprise the following steps of S1, measuring corresponding values through a physical simulation device, utilizing a scaling factor and conversion to obtain physical basin information corresponding to nature, S2, constructing a digital twin model with multiple space-time dimensions, S3, constructing the digital twin model, S4, carrying out circular cross recombination on data characteristics based on a circular cross fusion mechanism, and carrying out fusion processing on the recombined characteristics by adopting a mixed Gaussian process, and S5, running the digital twin model in a virtual environment, simulating the seawater invasion condition under the real condition of nature, and realizing disaster monitoring in the physical basin range. The invention fully utilizes the digital twin technology to realize real-time synchronization of physical entities and virtual models, provides early warning for possible geological disasters, and provides decision support for orderly development and utilization of groundwater.

title_en: Residue soil field landslide total probability risk quantitative evaluation method considering three-dimensional space variability of residue soil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quantitatively evaluating the total probability risk of a landslide of a dregs field by considering three-dimensional space variability of dregs, which comprises the following steps of carrying out site drilling investigation of the dregs field to obtain data of the dregs field, obtaining random field parameters representing the space variability of the dregs field, simulating three-dimensional space variation characteristics of the dregs field, evaluating the stability of the three-dimensional side slope of the dregs field and potential landslide volume estimation based on a limit balance method, simulating the possible migration range under various landslide volumes, counting life and property data of a downstream disaster-bearing body, evaluating the vulnerability of the disaster-bearing body based on building and personnel vulnerability evaluation formulas, establishing a total probability risk evaluation formula of the landslide of the dregs field, and carrying out quantitative evaluation and risk rating of the landslide. According to the invention, the unique spatial variation characteristic of the muck is considered, the stability, the potential sliding position and the square quantity are analyzed from a three-dimensional angle, and the accurate risk assessment is realized by combining a vulnerability quantitative assessment method.

title_en: Reservoir flood control monitoring system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir flood control monitoring system and method based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of reservoir flood control monitoring and comprise a multi-source data acquisition module, wherein the digital twinning module is used for constructing and obtaining a digital twinning model according to real-time monitoring data of the multi-source data acquisition module, the coupling module is used for receiving a fusion data set provided by the digital twinning module and dynamically simulating the fusion data set to provide dynamic prediction results of dam seepage, deformation and flood evolution, the dynamic early warning module comprises a dynamic threshold adjusting unit and an early warning unit, dynamically optimizes the early warning threshold according to the real-time monitoring data and triggers early warning in real time, and compared with the traditional early warning system with fixed threshold, the system can adapt to the change of dam state and environmental conditions, identify potential abnormal events in advance, provide sufficient time for reservoir flood control to carry out emergency response and scheduling decision, so that disaster risk is effectively reduced, and safety of reservoir operation is ensured.

title_en: Probabilistic landslide tsunami disaster assessment method, equipment and medium based on logic tree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and a medium for evaluating a probabilistic landslide and tsunami disaster based on a logic tree, which comprise the steps of acquiring landslide data corresponding to a region to be detected, constructing a probabilistic landslide scene set based on a logic tree method, obtaining the geometrical parameters of the landslide scene, wherein first-level, second-level, third-level and fourth-level nodes in the logic tree are landslide positions, landslide volumes, tsunami arrival points and tsunami wave heights, acquiring historical landslide and tsunami records of the region to be detected and submarine topography data, calculating a tsunami wave initial water level field through a first tsunami propagation numerical model according to the landslide positions and volumes in the probabilistic landslide scene set, simulating through a second tsunami propagation numerical model according to the tsunami wave initial water level field, and estimating the space probability of the potential landslide of the region to be detected, the annual occurrence probability of the landslide in each volume section and the tsunami maximum amplitude caused by the landslide at the tsunami arrival points without exceeding the tsunami height threshold.

title_en: Emergency resource scheduling and path planning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency response, in particular to an emergency resource scheduling and path planning method, which comprises the following steps of constructing a dynamic weight evaluation system based on emergency resource scheduling factors, wherein the weight evaluation system can dynamically calculate and adjust factor weights so as to determine the most critical resource to be scheduled to the most needed place under the emergency condition; and constructing a deep reinforcement learning model, and using the historical emergency response data as a training set to enable an intelligent agent to learn and optimize strategies for selecting optimal paths under different conditions in a simulated or historical emergency scene. And the system can rapidly identify and schedule the most critical resources to the most needed places in priority and simultaneously plan the optimal path through the comprehensive application of the dynamic weight evaluation system and the deep reinforcement learning model, thereby remarkably improving the speed and efficiency of emergency response.

title_en: Communication navigation perception depth reinforcement space-time cooperation networking perception optimization method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication navigation perception depth reinforcement space-time cooperation networking perception optimization method and device, which comprises the steps of establishing a digital surface model of a disaster area, marking obstacles, establishing a communication fitting model of an ad hoc network of the disaster area, simulating perception node task planning in the ad hoc network, establishing a depth reinforcement learning model based on ResNet-DDPG, establishing an reinforcement learning state space based on the ad hoc network space-time optimization of a ResNet network, establishing an reinforcement learning action space of the ad hoc network space-time optimization, designing reinforcement learning rewards fused with geographic space features based on the communication fitting model, performing reinforcement learning training based on a DDPG model, and outputting an optimal scheme of cooperative deployment of the ad hoc network relative to perception communication nodes after training convergence. According to the invention, the communication rate and the effectiveness of the deployment position are obviously improved by optimizing the space-time collaborative deployment of the communication, perception and data receiving nodes on the ground.

title_en: Intelligent decision method and device for tunnel inrush water and cement disaster prevention and control measures
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tunnel geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to an intelligent decision method and device for a tunnel water and mud bursting disaster prevention and control measure, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining investigation design and multi-source detection data, disaster-causing construction data, disaster prevention and control measure and disaster prevention and control effect of water and mud bursting of a tunnel to establish a nonlinear mapping relation model; training the equations, constructing a prevention and control measure prediction model of the tunnel water and mud disaster, and obtaining the current prevention and control measure of the tunnel water and mud disaster by using the prevention and control measure prediction model. Therefore, the problems that in the related technology, the most proper and most efficient prevention and control measures are difficult to select in time according to the disaster type, and targeted prevention and control guidance suggestions are difficult to provide for the tunnel water and mud bursting disaster are solved.
assignees: SICHUAN KANGXIN EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING

title_en: Wild domestication system and method for yellow croaker
abstract_en: The invention provides a wild yellow lip fish domesticating system and method, and belongs to the technical field of repair and maintenance of germplasm resources of endangered fishes. Through simulating natural environment, the food sensitivity training, ecological inversion adaptability training, instantaneous tour capacity and adversity adaptability training are applied to the yellow lip fish, the ingestion and hunger resistance of the released yellow lip fish are enhanced, the disaster event avoidance is improved, the stress response and other survivability is reduced, and the survival rate of the released yellow lip fish in the natural sea area is improved. The system and the technical method for simulating the natural environment have good proliferation effect on the release of the yellow lip fish, and have wide application prospect.

title_en: Intrusion detection method based on similarity measurement and graph convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intrusion detection method based on similarity measurement and graph convolution. Firstly, constructing graph structure data and dividing a data set by preprocessing original data, then training a similarity measurement model in a training set and storing an optimal model under verification set data to ensure generalization of the model, enabling the model to learn low-dimensional feature vector representation, and finally judging similarity between a test sample and a label sample according to distance measurement so as to realize classification of intrusion detection. The similarity measurement model is used for relieving the problem of unstable classification effect caused by intrusion detection dimension disasters by learning low-dimensional feature vector representation, enabling the model to identify unknown intrusion types by distance measurement and threshold setting, extracting non-Euclidean distance features of intrusion detection data by using a graph convolution network, enhancing the robustness of intrusion detection, and being suitable for intrusion detection with limited intrusion samples because the core of the measurement model is a feature space for learning and does not directly depend on the number of class labels.

title_en: Intelligent automatic fire extinguishing method and system for charging new energy vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent automatic fire extinguishing method and system for charging a new energy vehicle, which realize quick response and effective control of fire disaster of a charging station of the new energy vehicle through the steps of real-time monitoring, early warning, initial fire extinguishing, linkage fire extinguishing, remote manual control, electric leakage breaking device, video monitoring system, fire control cabinet, fire emergency lighting and escape indication direction board, training and guiding module and the like. The charging station solves the problem that the existing charging station for the new energy vehicle lacks effective fire protection measures, ensures that users of the new energy vehicle can charge safely, and reduces and avoids the occurrence of charging fire accidents.
assignees: CHONGQING BANGKE ELECTRIC VEHICLE SALES CO LTD

title_en: Emergency evacuation path planning method, program, equipment and storage medium considering dynamic inclination of passenger ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation path planning method, program, equipment and storage medium considering dynamic inclination of a passenger ship, and belongs to the field of personnel evacuation simulation modeling. The method comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining a passenger ship inclination angle and a pedestrian moving direction, constructing a pedestrian speed attenuation factor reasoning model, 2, analyzing and modeling the influence of pedestrian mass movement on ship inclination, 3, introducing a congestion penalty factor, a safety penalty factor and an attenuation factor based on a path cost function of a D-Lite algorithm, obtaining a pre-planned path according to a leader starting point and an exit point, 4, presetting a re-planning triggering condition, when the preset triggering condition is met, taking a current node as a new starting point, and repeating the steps 1 to 4 to re-plan an evacuation route until the whole evacuation process is completed. When an emergency occurs, the method can adjust the evacuation strategy according to the inclination angle, the exit congestion and the passenger distribution, and obviously improve the evacuation efficiency and the safety in the passenger-ship evacuation scene.

title_en: LS-DYNA-based bridge upright post protection method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a bridge upright post protection method, a system and a storage medium based on LS-DYNA, wherein numerical simulation is carried out based on LS-DYNA, a corresponding model between penetration depth of falling rocks striking an upright post and falling rocks striking energy and a corresponding model between penetration depth of the bridge upright post, falling rocks striking energy and thickness of a protection steel plate are obtained, so that maximum penetration depth of falling rocks striking the upright post is obtained according to falling rocks data, whether additional protection is needed is judged by combining with maximum allowable penetration depth of the bridge upright post, when the additional protection is needed, the minimum thickness of the protection steel plate is obtained according to the maximum allowable penetration depth of the bridge upright post and falling rocks data, and falling rocks are struck and protected against disasters according to the minimum thickness of the protection steel plate. The invention can adopt corresponding steel plate protection for the bridge upright post according to the minimum thickness of the bridge upright post protection steel plate, and has higher reliability and rapidity.
assignees: CCCC SECOND HIGHWAY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Rolling stone impact test device
abstract_en: The invention provides a rolling stone impact test device, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster simulation tests and comprises a supporting mechanism, a swinging mechanism, a stone blocking mechanism, two groups of acceleration sensing mechanisms and two groups of opening pieces, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises a tower crane, a hoisting component and an impact ball hoisted on the hoisting component, the swinging mechanism comprises a supporting plate, a supporting frame and a traction component, the stone blocking mechanism comprises a stone blocking wall and a soil cushion layer, the two groups of acceleration sensing mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the impact ball, the acceleration sensing mechanisms comprise an installation frame body and acceleration sensors, one side of the installation frame body is provided with a through hole and a blocking component for blocking the through hole, the opening pieces are arranged between the stone blocking mechanism and the swinging mechanism, and when the impact ball collides with the stone blocking mechanism, the opening pieces can drive the blocking component to move so as to open the through hole. According to the invention, the acceleration sensor is separated from the impact ball after the first impact, so that the influence on the service life of the acceleration sensor caused by repeated impact with the stone blocking wall after the impact ball rebounds is avoided.

title_en: Method and system for eliminating security alarm influence caused by simulated attack
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network security and discloses a method and a system for eliminating security alarm influence caused by simulated attack, wherein the method comprises the steps of sending a simulated attack log to a situation awareness platform when a security effectiveness verification platform initiates the simulated attack, wherein the simulated attack log comprises characteristic information of the simulated attack, identifying the simulated attack log sent by the security effectiveness verification platform by the situation awareness platform, establishing a time sliding window, carrying out association analysis on the simulated attack log and a security protection equipment response log in the corresponding time sliding window, and marking the security alarm caused by the simulated attack, thereby eliminating the security alarm influence. Therefore, when the security effectiveness verification platform evaluates the network security protection capability through automatic simulation attack, the situation awareness platform can automatically recognize the simulation attack behavior, so that the misjudgment of the attack and unnecessary emergency response caused by security alarm are avoided, and the efficiency of overall network security management operation is improved.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA JIANGCHUAN CLOUD HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Landslide mud-rock flow rescue training scene simulation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide and debris flow rescue training scene simulation device. The device comprises a foundation pit, wherein a ruin training system, a sand boil training system, a barren rock training system and a recovery system are arranged on the foundation pit, the ruin training system is used for carrying out ruin rescue simulation training on training staff, the sand boil training system is used for carrying out ruin rescue simulation training on training staff, simulating flood and sand surge rescue training, the sand boil training system is also used for pouring muddy water to the ruin training system and simulating a debris flow landslide process, the barren rock training system is used for injecting a pumice model into the ruin training system and the sand surge training system so as to carry out emergency training on training staff, and the recovery system is used for recovering the muddy water and the pumice model and recycling the muddy water and the pumice model. By utilizing the device, the whole landslide and debris flow process and multi-type disaster scene simulation can be performed, the debris flow primary disaster and secondary disaster scene simulation such as rolling stones thereof can be provided, and the training effect and the training quality are improved.

title_en: Debris flow video recognition model sample set, model construction method and edge monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow video identification model sample set, a model construction method and an edge monitoring system. Aiming at the defects of high calculation cost and dependence on hardware performance in the prior art, the invention provides a debris flow edge monitoring scheme. The sample generated by the sample set construction method of the debris flow video recognition model adopts the frame image information of the gray level chart characterization monitoring video, and sample data both comprise three targets of disaster dynamics, environmental interference removal and image feature expression simplification, and simultaneously meets the requirements of recognition model training standard reaching and edge equipment performance adaptation. The mud-rock flow video recognition model construction method provides an improved TINY DARKNET model for training. The debris flow edge monitoring system is an automatic monitoring and early warning system with low cost, stable operation and excellent performance, and remarkably reduces the dependence of intelligent monitoring on a communication network, so that disaster monitoring and early warning can be completely moved to a field monitoring site, and the system is favorable for realizing field multipoint distribution control and enhancing systematic monitoring and early warning.

title_en: Application system for target range privatization deployment mode
abstract_en: The application discloses a system for applying a target range privately-arranged mode, which can effectively solve the risk of data leakage, build firm and solid foundation for enterprise network security training and testing, greatly improve pertinence and precision of security training and testing, accelerate efficient landing of security policies in actual services, accurately capture user operation behaviors, generate a depth analysis report and policy guidance in real time, assist users to quickly and insist on training results, accurately locate weak links and agile adjustment training policies, remarkably improve security skill improvement efficiency, protect and navigate enterprise data assets, effectively cope with potential data disasters, ensure service operation stability and continuity, comprehensively meet multiple requirements of enterprise network security construction, assist enterprises to stably advance in complex network security situations, and take precedence.
assignees: YONGXIN ZHICHENG TECH GROUP CO LTD;BEIJING WUYI JIAYU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban power grid viability assessment method and device considering main-distribution coordination
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for evaluating the viability of an urban power grid considering main and auxiliary coordination, and relates to the technical field of power grid viability evaluation. The method comprises the steps of simulating a damaged scene of a power grid by adopting a Monte Carlo algorithm, constructing a first main network scheduling model and a first distribution network scheduling model before a target disaster occurs, calculating a first evaluation index, constructing each second distribution network scheduling model and a first distribution network foldback scheduling model under each load node in the target disaster, calculating corresponding net load demands, constructing a second main network scheduling model, calculating a second evaluation index, constructing each distribution network recovery model and a second distribution network foldback scheduling model under each load node after the target disaster occurs, calculating corresponding distribution network total load demands, constructing a third main network scheduling model, calculating a third evaluation index, and evaluating the survival capability of the target urban power grid according to the three evaluation indexes. The application can improve the evaluation accuracy of the survivability of the urban power grid.

title_en: 10KV distribution line icing stress analysis method based on linear cement single pole
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 10kV distribution line icing stress analysis method based on a linear cement single pole, which relates to the technical field of electric disaster prevention and comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional physical model of a 12-meter linear cement single pole; the three-dimensional physical model is imported into finite element simulation analysis software, material properties of each structure in the 12-meter linear cement single-pole physical model are set, a physical field is added, grids are divided for calculation, and the displacement conditions of the lines and towers in the 12-meter linear cement single-pole physical model after different ice coatings of the 10KV distribution line are obtained through analysis. According to the invention, the physical model of the 12-meter linear cement single pole is established, the material attribute is set in the finite element software, and the constraint conditions such as gravity load, ice coating load and wind load applied to the 12-meter linear cement single pole when ice coating is applied can be judged, so that the displacement conditions of the wire and the pole tower when ice coating with different thicknesses can be obtained, and a judgment basis is provided for judging whether a fault occurs due to the influence of ice coating on a distribution line.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: College student apartment emergency evacuation capability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a college student apartment emergency evacuation capability assessment method and system, and relates to the technical field of emergency management. The method comprises the steps of collecting student history and real-time emergency capacity training information, escape channel information, barrier information and personnel information in an apartment, carrying out normalization processing on the emergency capacity training information, the escape channel information, the barrier information and the personnel information, storing the normalization processing result in a drilling database, obtaining the history emergency capacity training information from the drilling database, carrying out comprehensive analysis on the history emergency capacity training information to obtain an evacuation capacity importance analysis result, and carrying out comprehensive analysis on the real-time escape channel information and the real-time barrier information to obtain an evacuation capacity analysis result. The invention solves the problems that the assessment of the emergency evacuation capacity of the student apartment in the colleges and universities is focused on the consideration of relative static factors such as building structures, fire-fighting facilities and the like, and ignores dynamic factors such as personnel mobility and the like, and achieves the effect of improving the assessment accuracy.

title_en: Simulation experiment platform for dust deposit formation and destabilization mechanism
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of dust disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a simulation experiment platform for a dust deposit formation and instability mechanism; the device comprises an input mechanism for air supply, powder supply and the like, a transparent air duct and a plurality of detection sensors; the air duct is formed by splicing multiple sections, and can be freely combined according to experimental requirements; the invention realizes multi-physical field coupling through the organic glass air duct, can accurately simulate the dynamic evolution process of a dust deposition layer under the synergistic effect of an air flow field, a viscous force field and a gravitational field, and can be applied to simulation research of the instability characteristic of the deposition dust layer.

title_en: Advanced water injection method for preventing and controlling coal and rock dynamic disasters of tunneling working face
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preventing and controlling coal and rock dynamic disasters of a tunneling working face by advanced water injection, which comprises the following steps of determining an advanced water injection width, determining the number of advanced water injection drilling holes, determining the length of the advanced water injection drilling holes, determining advanced water injection construction time, performing advanced water injection construction process and tunneling. The method can solve the problems of large gas control engineering quantity, long time and the like in the exploitation of the high gas and outburst coal seam and the problem of influence on the tunneling speed caused by the crossing operation of tunneling and drilling in the exploitation of the rock burst coal seam, and can continuously inject water into surrounding rocks of a roadway in the tunneling process of the roadway, continuously weaken the coal body, reduce the gas release speed and reduce the risk of gas outburst and rock burst.

title_en: Regional geological disaster risk assessment system and method based on big data
abstract_en: S1, acquiring geological data and related data, and preprocessing the geological data and the related data to generate a geological disaster data set; S2, training Bi-LSTM through the preprocessed geological disaster data set to construct a geological disaster risk assessment model, and S3, collecting a new geological disaster data set, inputting the new geological disaster data set into the geological disaster risk assessment model to generate a geological disaster risk prediction result. According to the invention, the convolution neural network, the Bi-LSTM and the attention mechanism layer are combined to construct the geological disaster risk assessment model, so that the geological disaster assessment is realized, and compared with the current geological disaster risk assessment method, the super-parameters of the Bi-LSTM model are optimally matched by using the PSO algorithm, so that the characteristics of the diversity of geological data and related data are more comprehensively captured, and the geological disaster risk prediction precision and reliability are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN INSTITUTE OF GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution line icing and rod-breaking probability prediction method and system for deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system risk assessment, in particular to a method and a system for predicting probability of icing and breaking of a distribution line of a deep neural network. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical meteorological data and tower breaking information of a power distribution line icing disaster area, constructing a deep neural network prediction model, optimizing the deep neural network prediction model, and training the deep neural network prediction model to a breaking probability prediction result under an icing condition by adopting a simulated annealing whale algorithm. The deep neural network prediction model comprises 4 input neurons which are arranged on an input layer and correspond to wind direction, wind speed, ice coating thickness and temperature respectively, the hidden layers are 3 layers, the first hidden layer comprises 16 nodes, the second hidden layer comprises 8 nodes, the third hidden layer comprises 4 nodes, and the output layer adopts a Sigmoid activation function. By combining the whale optimization algorithm with the simulated annealing algorithm, the effective combination of global search and local optimization is realized, and the training efficiency and the prediction accuracy of the prediction model are remarkably improved.

title_en: Groundwater sampling device is used in geological disaster monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of groundwater sampling, in particular to a groundwater sampling device for monitoring geological disasters, which comprises a main pipeline, a connecting pipe and a sampling end, wherein the main pipeline is fixedly connected with the connecting pipe, the sampling end is fixedly connected with the connecting pipe, a sampling device for collecting groundwater is rotationally arranged in a sampling port, when the device is used by a worker, the sampling end is placed in a water taking drill hole through the sampling end arranged on the device, water is sampled and detected through a water taking device in the sampling port, in the detection process, a pumping force is applied to the main pipeline, a disc is driven to move up and down, a rotating shaft is driven to rotate through a tooth pattern and a toothed plate in the moving process, the rotating shaft can drive the connecting shaft to rotate through a belt, impurities on the outer surface of the water taking device are cleaned through a scraping plate on a circular ring, and the accuracy of the detection structure of the device is ensured.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL LAND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION CENTER SHANDONG PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER

title_en: Flood risk assessment method and system with high-dimensional statistics and hydrodynamic coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-dimensional statistics and hydrodynamic coupling flood risk assessment method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical observation data covering river flow, tide level and precipitation events; the method comprises the steps of constructing a univariate marginal distribution function, connecting the univariate marginal distribution functions of river flow, tide level and precipitation event, simulating a joint probability distribution function, coupling the joint probability distribution function with a mechanism model to obtain a probability-mechanism coupling model, inputting determined joint probability boundary conditions into the probability-mechanism coupling model, simulating to obtain composite flood situations under different reproduction periods, comparing the composite flood situations under different reproduction periods with the single variable flood situations, and quantifying contribution of each variable to the change of the flooding area by utilizing the obtained flooding area and corresponding precipitation event, river flow and coastal tide level data. The method changes the defect that the traditional single factor evaluation cannot capture the interaction of multiple factors, and greatly improves the accuracy of flood disaster evaluation.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method based on video analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to a fire early warning method based on video analysis, which comprises the steps of acquiring images containing open fire and smoke and wind speed data in various scenes, constructing a data set, training a fire recognition network and marking the open fire and the smoke in a current frame image; the method comprises the steps of utilizing the size of a flame target frame extracted by a fire disaster identification network and gray values of pixel points in the target frame to calculate flame intensity, combining the smoke target frame, the flame intensity and wind speed data to determine smoke diffusion degree of a scene corresponding to a current frame image, evaluating fire probability by analyzing variation trend of the flame intensity and the smoke diffusion degree, and judging whether fire alarm is performed or not. According to the invention, the fire condition is comprehensively judged by combining the size and position change of the flame target frame, the area and the diffusion degree of the smoke target frame and the wind speed data, so that false alarm is reduced, and the detection accuracy is improved.
assignees: ZHONGNAN INFORMATION TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD;YUZHOU ZHONGNAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for simulating rock ice avalanche to debris flow conversion process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster simulation, and relates to a simulation method for a transition process from rock ice and snow collapse to mud-rock flow. The method comprises the steps of establishing a fluid phase mass conservation equation, an ice phase mass conservation equation, a rock phase mass conservation equation and a momentum conservation equation of a fluid phase, an ice phase and a rock phase in a rock avalanche to debris flow conversion process, simultaneously establishing an energy conservation equation of the mass flow to obtain a control equation of a depth average three-phase model, and solving a flux term of the control equation of the depth average three-phase model by adopting a second-order precision finite volume method based on the combination of a finite volume method and a Rayleigh approximation Riemann solver to obtain time and space distribution of flow depth, flow speed, phase volume fraction and temperature. The present invention describes the transition of rock ice avalanches from particle flow to debris flow by simulating a real physical process involving positive and negative temperature transitions by considering interactions between rock, ice and fluid phases.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Simulation device for monitoring deformation damage characteristics of arch side slope under excavation condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring of deformation damage in a side slope, and discloses a simulation device for monitoring deformation damage characteristics in an arched side slope under excavation conditions, wherein the device utilizes Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) to analyze deformation characteristics in the excavation process by integrating a plurality of sensors and monitoring technologies such as a digital camera, a high-speed camera, an FBG (fiber Bragg Grating) strain sensor, an FBG demodulator and the like, so that an arched large deformation area, an upper small deformation area and two-side unyielding areas can be clearly observed, and the characteristics of arch side slope deformation and arch effect are considered; in arch-shaped damage, the transverse strain in the side slope is obtained by using a fiber bragg grating demodulator and is used for calculating the shear stress in the side slope. The device not only can monitor the internal deformation and damage characteristics of the arched slope under the excavation condition, but also can provide important data support for slope stability analysis and disaster prevention.

title_en: Disaster prevention and reduction method for renewable energy source structure field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster prevention and reduction method of a renewable energy source structure field, which relates to the technical field of ocean engineering disaster prevention and reduction and comprises the following steps of S1 determining a target sea area for constructing the renewable energy source structure field and constructing a water depth topography of the target sea area, S2 determining a structure of a pile foundation type breakwater model, S3 setting a combined form and porosity of an opening plate in the pile foundation type breakwater model to enable a transmission coefficient K  t  and a reflection coefficient K  r  of a shielding area of the pile foundation type breakwater model to meet the conditions, S4 setting grid precision, constructing a wave hydrodynamic two-dimensional model of the target sea area by utilizing a structured grid, and S5 carrying out numerical simulation on the target sea area by utilizing a subgrid method based on the wave hydrodynamic two-dimensional model constructed in S4 to obtain characteristic wave height and periodic data of the target sea area. The method can accurately simulate the influence of the pile foundation breakwater on the wave hydrodynamic environment field of the renewable energy source structure field.

title_en: Crowd instability threshold monitoring method and system by combining video monitoring and simulation
abstract_en: A crowd instability threshold monitoring method and system combining video monitoring and simulation relates to the field of emergency evacuation. The method comprises the steps of constructing a virtual environment, training by adopting a high-density crowd data set picture, combining a trained model with Deepsort algorithm, loading an existing accident video, implementing perspective transformation, extracting characteristic parameters of pedestrians, calculating pedestrian data in a selected area detection frame where people step on to obtain speed density, calculating system entropy data to obtain a crowd instability threshold value, constructing a scene by using Anylogic software program, locking the area with the maximum density, inputting the crowd instability threshold value into a state diagram to achieve logic judgment, realizing real-time judgment on pedestrian walking logic, obtaining and monitoring safety thresholds of critical people under different long and wide channel structures in the simulated scene.

title_en: High-temperature drought composite disaster prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to disaster prediction, in particular to a high-temperature drought composite disaster prediction method and a system based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting meteorological data of a target area, inputting the meteorological data into a preset artificial intelligent high-temperature drought prediction model, predicting the variation trend of a standardized rainfall index and a standardized temperature index, and judging the high-temperature drought composite disaster grade of the target area based on the variation trend of the standardized rainfall index and the standardized temperature index, wherein the artificial intelligent high-temperature drought prediction model is obtained based on training set training comprising historical meteorological data of the target area, and the model is constructed by combining wavelet transformation with a circulating network. According to the invention, regional analysis is performed on precipitation and temperatures in different areas and different seasons, meanwhile, wavelet transformation is introduced on the basis of a deep learning model to construct an artificial intelligent high-temperature drought prediction model, and a complete artificial intelligent high-temperature drought composite disaster prediction method and system are further constructed, so that the combined prediction of high temperature and drought index is realized.

title_en: Intelligent road condition emergency response system and method for simulated scene training
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent road condition emergency response system and method for simulating scene training, and relates to the related field of intelligent traffic systems, wherein the system comprises an emergency simulation model construction module, a simulation module and a simulation module, wherein the emergency simulation model construction module is used for acquiring sample traffic data and constructing an emergency simulation model; the emergency training score calculation module is used for obtaining the processing time of emergency treatment of the user, obtaining a second emergency training score by combining the standard processing time and the first emergency training score. The method solves the technical problems that the complexity of the actual road condition cannot be reflected, the training effect is limited, and the user's deficiency is difficult to find in the existing simulation scene training, achieves the technical effects of providing a real training environment, improving the training effect and comprehensively evaluating the emergency response capability of the user.
assignees: WUHAN FUTURE PHANTOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy system distributed scheduling method and system considering typhoon uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed scheduling method and a distributed scheduling system of a comprehensive energy system for accounting typhoon uncertainty, which relate to the technical field of electric-gas comprehensive energy collaborative operation and toughness enhancement and comprise the steps of constructing an offshore wind power operation model, and sampling and generating a typhoon scene and an offshore wind power output scene by utilizing a Monte Carlo simulation method; the three-layer collaborative scheduling model of the scene-based integrated energy system is subjected to solvability conversion based on the mixed sample average approximation, converted into a determined continuous linear model, and the determined continuous linear model is solved by utilizing a high-efficiency distributed collaborative algorithm of a multi-parameter programming theory and a critical domain acceleration search algorithm based on global optimal solution estimation to obtain a global optimal solution. The solving efficiency of the method can meet the timeliness requirement of emergency response in typhoon scenes.

title_en: Intelligent prediction method for earthquake slope instability probability based on coupling of physical mechanism and neural network model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent prediction of geological disasters, and particularly discloses an intelligent prediction method of earthquake slope instability probability based on coupling of a physical mechanism and a neural network model, which is used for analyzing slope stability through research methods such as numerical simulation, indoor model test, slope monitoring and the like, collecting integrated earthquake motion data, slope geometric parameters and stability states, and constructing a database based on the physical mechanism; the method comprises the steps of extracting seismic frequency spectrum characteristics, pulse characteristics, time domain/time frequency characteristics and accumulated displacement values of slope displacement, acceleration, stress and the like through a database, determining slope instability indexes and threshold values based on database cases, establishing a slope instability probability intelligent prediction model by adopting a neural network method based on Bayesian optimization, realizing intelligent prediction of the seismic slope instability probability, and providing theoretical basis and technical support for preventing and relieving seismic slope disasters.

title_en: Landslide hazard dynamic monitoring method based on time sequence and mixed model
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide hazard dynamic monitoring method based on a time sequence and a hybrid model, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of a historical landslide, preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain first data, carrying out type division on the first data, carrying out time sequence coding on each type of data to obtain a single sample under the same time sequence, further obtaining a sample set, further training a neural network model according to the sample set to obtain an initial model, carrying out model verification on the initial model, combining the constructed mapping relation between the deformation of the corresponding type of the landslide and monitoring dimension, optimizing to obtain the time sequence and the hybrid model, monitoring and obtaining current heterogeneous data of a target monitoring point, inputting the current heterogeneous data into the time sequence and the hybrid model, predicting to obtain a current disaster result of the target monitoring point, and outputting a prompt. And verifying the model and constructing the mapping relation to ensure the accuracy of the model and provide a convenient basis for landslide hazard prediction.

title_en: Unmanned plane bee colony autonomous collaborative analysis method and system based on virtual simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle bee colony autonomous collaborative analysis method and system based on virtual simulation, which relate to the technical field of electric digital data processing, and are characterized in that monitoring points are arranged on a boundary line of a fire disaster target area, a detection unmanned aerial vehicle is deployed to collect heat radiation response parameters of target plants in real time, a fire disaster prediction model is established, the fire disaster prediction model provides an optimization strategy of task allocation and path planning for the unmanned aerial vehicle bee colony, and meanwhile, the fire disaster prediction model is effectively verified and perfected through construction and parameter correction of a virtual simulation environment; and further, the overall efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle bee colony in fire monitoring and treatment is improved.

title_en: Earthquake risk analysis method based on regional fine geological structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic risk analysis method based on a regional fine geological structure, which comprises the steps of constructing a fine three-dimensional geomodel; optimizing boundary conditions based on GNSS velocity field data, finite element numerical simulation and earthquake risk analysis. By constructing a fine three-dimensional geoscience model, by utilizing a finite element numerical simulation method and combining historical seismic data and geologic structure characteristics, the uneven strain energy distribution caused by plate movement for a certain time is calculated, and the actual condition of the seismic damage effect is reflected by carrying out depth and magnitude weighting treatment on the magnitude risk value obtained by simulation. And finally, carrying out summation operation on the weighted strain energy data of the earthquakes with different depths and different earthquake magnitudes in the research area to obtain the overall earthquake risk distribution condition of the earth surface area. The method can break through the limitation of the existing earthquake observation data, examine the earthquake activity from a wider view angle and time scale, and can further understand the periodicity, frequency and potential disaster risk of the earthquake.

title_en: Side slope rolling stone disaster monitoring and alarming device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring and alarming device for a side slope rolling stone disaster, which belongs to the technical field of side slope prevention and treatment and comprises a multipoint displacement meter, an osmometer, an inclinometer, a soil pressure acquisition instrument, a solar panel, a camera, a host computer and a host computer, wherein the solar panel is used for providing continuous power supply for the whole device, the camera is used for capturing the running state of the side slope rolling stone and recording the side slope state, the host computer is used for receiving and processing various detection data to carry out real-time monitoring and alarming, the host computer can determine the trace length, the tendency, the inclination angle and the density statistical characteristics of a side slope crack according to the received detection data, and is combined with the crack shear resistance mechanical parameters determined by a laboratory physical test, the side slope surrounding rock quality grade and the physical mechanical parameters determined by engineering geological investigation and physical experiment, and a two-dimensional numerical model for simulating the side slope cutting rock mass by using the rolling stone running state parameters shot by the camera. The method is scientific and reasonable, and improves the calculation efficiency by establishing a unified calculation model.
assignees: UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGY;THE FIRST CONSTRUCTION BRANCH COMPANY QINGDAO METRO GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Chemical industry park vulnerability analysis model deduction method based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical industry park vulnerability analysis model deduction method based on a cellular automaton, which comprises the steps of obtaining a chemical industry park data set, preprocessing the chemical industry park data set to obtain a preprocessed chemical industry park data set, training an initial model of the cellular automaton based on the preprocessed chemical industry park data set to obtain a chemical industry park vulnerability analysis model, setting different disaster situations, deducting response and change processes of the chemical industry park under different disaster situations based on the chemical industry park vulnerability analysis model, and preprocessing and training the cellular automaton model and the targeted data set to simulate the performances of the chemical industry park under different disaster situations more accurately, so that the accuracy of vulnerability analysis is improved, setting different disaster situations to deduct, comprehensively considering various possible disaster situations and influences of the chemical industry park, and being beneficial to comprehensively evaluating risks and vulnerabilities.

title_en: Disaster prevention and control management method and system for side slopes in difficult mountain areas
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slope disaster prevention and control, in particular to a slope disaster prevention and control management method and system for a difficult mountain area. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a mountain slope holographic characteristic diagram, analyzing a mountain slope to obtain a mountain slope stress field based on the mountain slope holographic characteristic diagram, identifying a freeze-thawing sensitive area of the mountain slope based on the mountain slope stress field to obtain a slope freeze-thawing risk distribution diagram, performing microenvironment simulation regulation and control on the mountain slope according to the slope freeze-thawing risk distribution diagram to obtain a slope microenvironment regulation and control scheme, performing biological material adaptability analysis on the mountain slope to obtain a slope ecological matrix distribution diagram, and performing anchor point arrangement on the mountain slope according to the slope ecological matrix distribution diagram to obtain a mountain slope anchoring network. The invention improves the prevention accuracy of freeze thawing disasters.

title_en: Urban waterlogging toughness assessment method based on multi-subject and system dynamics coupling modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city waterlogging toughness assessment method based on multi-subject and system dynamics coupling modeling, which is applied to the technical fields of city water affairs, disaster prevention and reduction and emergency research and comprises the steps of obtaining various parameter values of city waterlogging forming factors, determining subject objects, and carrying out mathematical expression of abstract behaviors according to attribute characteristics to obtain behavior decision results; confirming positive and negative feedback relations among various indexes of a system dynamics model, applying behavior decision results to the model, and performing interactive simulation of microscopic decisions and macroscopic phenomena to obtain a city waterlogging toughness assessment coupling model, wherein the system dynamics model comprises a social toughness subsystem, an economic toughness subsystem, a facility toughness subsystem and an environment toughness subsystem, and designing different scene policies based on the city waterlogging toughness assessment coupling model to explore an optimal management scheme for influencing city waterlogging toughness construction. The method can accurately identify the weak links in the urban waterlogging disaster response pair.

title_en: Grid scale river basin flood toughness evaluation method and system based on underlying surface function and tolerance capability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid scale drainage basin flood toughness evaluation method and system based on underlying surface functions and tolerance, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining high-resolution remote sensing image data and POI data, obtaining fine classification results through multi-level classification processing, obtaining various underlying surface function weight values through calculation by combining social and economic data, obtaining grid unit tolerance values through statistical analysis and gridding calculation of the fine classification results and historical disaster data, constructing a coupling hydrodynamic model for simulation calculation to obtain grid flooding depth and flooding time data, calculating a system performance curve, extracting toughness characteristic values to obtain a grid toughness characteristic value set, calculating comprehensive toughness based on the toughness characteristic value set, and carrying out spatial integration by combining the underlying surface function weight values at different moments to obtain toughness evaluation results of different time-space scales. The invention provides accurate decision support for urban flood control and disaster reduction.

title_en: Deep underground cavern support evaluation method and system based on disturbance energy
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a deep underground cavern support evaluation method and system based on disturbance energy, which can solve the problems of local stress concentration, severe deformation, even collapse, rock burst and other geological disasters caused by the fact that a support structure of an on-site anchor rod/anchor rope system cannot be timely arranged or applied improperly, and surrounding rock releases additional disturbance energy. The method comprises the steps of determining initial support point distribution information of an initial support scheme based on an initial ground stress field, determining a support drilling simulation scheme similar to mechanical excavation disturbance based on the independent influence characteristics and the associated influence characteristics, wherein the support drilling simulation scheme comprises drilling position distribution and drilling depth, and monitoring actual disturbance information in the process of executing the support drilling simulation scheme so as to optimize the initial support scheme based on the actual disturbance information.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Fluid injection induced earthquake experimental method under true triaxial stress condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluid injection induced earthquake experimental method under the condition of true triaxial stress, which comprises the steps of firstly manufacturing a cube rock model containing faults, beveling to form a fault surface, arranging water injection and water pressure detection holes, after the fault surface is soaked by water injection to be saturated, applying three-dimensional unequal stress by utilizing a true triaxial device and keeping stable, then driving the fault to spontaneously destabilize by displacement, calculating the destabilization period between the earthquakes, finally setting a circulating or constant-rate water injection scheme, simulating industrial fluid activities, and exploring a water injection induced earthquake mechanism. The experimental method for inducing the earthquake by injecting the fluid under the condition of true triaxial stress can accurately simulate the true stratum stress and the water injection condition, provides a reliable means for researching the water injection induced earthquake, and has great significance for earthquake prediction, geological disaster prevention and control and related industrial safety.

title_en: Landscaping wall cracking demonstration device simulating earthquake scene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landscaping wall cracking demonstration device for simulating a seismic scene, which belongs to the technical field of seismic science popularization teaching and comprises a main body wall, a fixed frame, a pushing device and a vibrating device, wherein the main body wall comprises two movable walls and a fixed wall, the movable walls are connected with the pushing device and the vibrating device, the fixed wall is fixed on the fixed frame, the pushing device can push the movable walls, and the vibrating device can enable the movable walls to vibrate. When the pushing device and the vibrating device are not started, the main body walls are of an integrated structure, and cracks are formed between the main body walls after the pushing device and the vibrating device are started, so that the cracking effect is achieved. The main body wall, the fixing frame, the pushing device and the vibrating device are in modularized design. According to the utility model, the pushing device and the vibrating device are arranged, so that the main body wall can simulate the cracking effect of the wall body during an earthquake and the state of the wall body before cracking, and the earthquake resistance and disaster reduction awareness of the masses can be improved. Each device adopts the modularized design, and the overhaul is convenient.
assignees: GUANGDONG NIKOLA ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Visualization method and apparatus for disaster spread prediction simulation
title_ko: 재난확산예측 시뮬레이션의 가시화 방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for visualizing a disaster spread prediction simulation and an apparatus thereof. The visualization device divides a target model of a virtual space into a grid structure, assigns an analysis value of a disaster spread prediction simulation for the target model to each grid, grasps a color corresponding to the analysis value assigned to each grid, visualizes the color of each grid, and displays the visualized color in a digital twin space.
abstract_ko: 재난확산예측 시뮬레이션의 가시화 방법 및 그 장치가 개시된다. 가시화장치는 가상공간의 대상모델을 격자 구조로 분할하고, 대상모델에 대한 재난확산예측 시뮬레이션의 분석값을 각 격자에 부여하고, 각 격자에 부여된 분석값에 해당하는 색상을 파악하고, 각 격자의 색상을 가시화하여 디지털트윈공간에 표시한다.

title_en: Fire control shower nozzle sprays experimental apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment detection, in particular to a fire-fighting spray experiment device, which comprises a frame, wherein a spray mechanism and a water supply mechanism connected with the spray mechanism are arranged on the frame, the spray mechanism comprises a spray pipeline, two fire-fighting spray heads are arranged on the spray pipeline, the fire-fighting spray heads are respectively an open fire-fighting spray head and a closed fire-fighting spray head, a fire source simulation mechanism is arranged below the closed fire-fighting spray head, and a lifting mechanism for driving the spray mechanism to lift up and down is also arranged on the frame. When the simulated fire disaster occurs, when the existing fire-fighting spray heads on the same pipeline start to work and spray, the follow-up fire-fighting spray heads can be normally heated to trigger fire extinguishing under the condition of the same height or height difference, and the stability of the pipeline and the fire-fighting spray heads is detected.
assignees: GUOKAI FUJIAN FIRE VALVE INSPECTION CO LTD

title_en: Calculation method of slope-type debris flow disaster threshold
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope-type debris flow disaster threshold calculation method aiming at areas which are difficult to monitor rainfall and lack historical rainfall data, namely, for slope-type debris flow, slope stability in the debris flow is calculated by utilizing a TRIGRS model, and distribution of unsteady slope units under different rainfall conditions is obtained. And then, carrying out power process simulation on the unsteady slope units under different rainfall conditions by using MassFlow models, simulating the siltation condition of the unsteady slope units at the ditch opening, flushing out the ditch, and carrying out statistics on the rainfall characteristics of the debris flow which cause damage to the disaster-bearing body, thereby establishing a rainfall disaster threshold of the debris flow in the river basin. The method has the beneficial effects that the problem that a rainfall threshold is difficult to establish in areas lacking rainfall and debris flow observation data is solved, the defect that the traditional debris flow rainfall threshold is insufficient in consideration of the debris flow scale and existing prevention measures of the debris flow is overcome by establishing the debris flow disaster-forming rainfall threshold, the false alarm rate of the debris flow can be greatly reduced, and the debris flow early warning precision is improved.

title_en: Building fire crowd evacuation intelligent path planning system and method based on extended ground field and multiple targets SBOA
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent path planning system and method for building fire crowd evacuation based on an extended ground and multiple targets SBOA. The invention relates to the technical field of building crowd evacuation simulation, which comprises the steps of obtaining a cellular set based on a space structure of a building, collecting basic information of pedestrians of the building based on a questionnaire and a video observation mode, judging the panic degree of the pedestrians according to the basic information of the pedestrians to obtain a panic field, obtaining a dangerous field based on an FDS smoke diffusion model and according to real-time smoke concentration of fire, establishing an expanded ground field CA model based on a classical ground field CA model and the panic field and the dangerous field to obtain a current pedestrian target evacuation path, optimizing the evacuation path according to the current pedestrian target evacuation path based on a multi-target SBOA optimization algorithm, and generating an optimal evacuation path. The invention actually reflects the relation among evacuation groups, plans more reasonable evacuation paths, shortens evacuation time, improves safety, reduces casualties and improves evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Landslide risk prediction method and system based on landslide data set expansion
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide risk prediction method and a landslide risk prediction system based on landslide data set expansion, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster identification; screening landslide influence factors, reclassifying original landslide samples, selecting sample points, manufacturing one-dimensional array data according to the sample points, constructing a data set, expanding the data set data by adopting a data expansion network, training a landslide prediction model by adopting the expanded data set, deploying the trained landslide prediction model, and predicting landslide risk, wherein the data expansion network comprises a BFOA-KSMOTE oversampling module, clusters minority classes by using a K-means clustering algorithm, removes edge samples, and then generates new minority class samples by synthesizing minority class oversampling technology to balance the data set. The method can solve the problem of unbalanced landslide samples and improve landslide prediction accuracy.
assignees: NORTHWEST RES INST CO LTD CREC;UNIV SHANDONG;CHINA RAILWAY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Goaf coal spontaneous combustion and gas coupling early warning method, device, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a goaf coal spontaneous combustion and gas coupling early warning method, a device, a medium and equipment, relates to the technical field of coal mine safety production. The method comprises the steps of constructing disaster characteristic parameter data sets related to spontaneous combustion of goaf coal and gas coupling, training inversion models corresponding to the disaster characteristic parameters by utilizing a plurality of alternative training algorithms for each disaster characteristic parameter to obtain a plurality of trained inversion models, determining an optimal inversion model based on the plurality of trained inversion models, inverting the disaster characteristic parameters by utilizing the optimal inversion model to obtain an inversion result of each disaster characteristic parameter, and carrying out grading early warning on risk of spontaneous combustion of goaf coal and gas coupling according to the inversion result. Through the scheme, the accuracy of early warning on spontaneous combustion of goaf coal and gas coupling disaster risk can be improved.

title_en: Multi-scale coupling nested flood model construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a multi-scale coupled nested flood model, which comprises the steps of S1, multi-scale partition modeling, S2, multi-scale model coupled nesting, and S3, flood model partition activation starting. The invention is based on the physical mechanism of flood and disaster under the coupling action of multiple disaster causing factors such as multiple spatial scales, precipitation, hydrologic conditions, topography, climate, land utilization change and the like, adopts a hydrologic hydrodynamic model and coupling nesting, and provides a method for constructing the flood model of the multiple scale coupling nesting, which can provide technical support for rapid simulation of flood and disaster events under extreme weather and accurate quantitative evaluation of flood risks in a submerged area, and the simulation result can provide scientific basis for regional flood control strategy and emergency plan formulation.

title_en: Building disaster evaluation uncertainty optimization method for coupling multi-source data with random distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data and random distribution coupled building disaster damage assessment uncertainty optimization method which comprises the steps of collecting historical flood data of different cities and different types of buildings, meshing an assessment area, simulating and generating high-resolution water depth data of each grid unit by using a HiPIMS model, verifying and generating disaster damage data of each grid by combining remote sensing data, generalizing the cost of the different types of buildings by using building cost data in urban statistics annual authentication, assessing the building flood vulnerability based on a meshing method, and quantifying assessment uncertainty of the building flood vulnerability by using a confidence level analysis method. The method solves the problems of multi-source data fusion and accurate classification of buildings, unifies the scale difference of flood characteristics and socioeconomic data, introduces quantitative uncertainty of a confidence level analysis method, remarkably improves evaluation accuracy and reliability, and provides scientific support for urban disaster prevention and reduction, risk management and planning.

title_en: Intelligent decision method and system for emergency material emergency allocation
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent decision-making method and system for emergency material allocation. The method aims to efficiently process the demand information of multiple emergency response points through integrating a graph neural network, deep learning, reinforcement learning, bayesian optimization and a genetic algorithm, and generates a preliminary allocation plan through receiving the demand information containing the number, the type and the severity of wounded patients and dynamically calculating the demand urgency through an intelligent evaluation system. And then, the traffic prediction model is used for combining real-time and historical data to estimate the road traffic capacity, and a plurality of logistics distribution strategies are simulated to optimize the preliminary scheme and determine the optimal path planning. And then verifying material distribution effects under different scenes by means of an AI simulation exercise system, adjusting a configuration scheme, and finally forming a comprehensive allocation instruction to guide actual operation. The technical scheme of the application can realize intelligent decision support for the first-aid materials, and remarkably improves the efficiency and accuracy of first-aid material allocation.

title_en: Wounded information management and sharing method and system based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The application provides a wounded information management and sharing method and system based on cloud computing. The method comprises the steps of collecting and integrating multi-source heterogeneous data, synchronizing the multi-source heterogeneous data to a cloud platform in real time to generate a preliminary wounded information base, conducting complex association analysis based on the preliminary wounded information base by using a quantum heuristic optimization algorithm, simulating a quantum calculation process, achieving information instant update and dynamic adjustment by using a distributed edge calculation technology, generating an optimized wounded information file in a descending mode, conducting multi-dimensional data reconstruction based on the optimized wounded information file by using a holographic reconstruction algorithm, extracting hidden modes and characteristics, conducting multi-dimensional reconstruction processing on each wounded history and current health status data, supporting calculation on the encrypted data directly by using a homomorphic encryption technology, generating a high-dimensional data model, constructing an emergency response module based on the high-dimensional data model, and generating a wounded information management and sharing strategy. The technical scheme provided by the application obviously improves the safety and efficiency of wounded information management and sharing.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and control method of control model of non-variable frequency fan for highway tunnel fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method and a control method of a control model of a highway tunnel fire non-variable frequency fan, comprising the following steps: firstly, a plurality of groups of different fire characteristic parameters, tunnel structure facility parameters and fan control parameters of the non-variable frequency fan under initial environment parameters can be obtained, and a data set is constructed by taking the parameters as samples. Then, the tunnel fixed parameters, the environment initial parameters, the smoke spreading position and the target wind speed are used as input data, and the fan control parameters are used as output data to construct a control model. And finally, training the control model through the constructed data set, so as to obtain a non-variable frequency fan control model capable of calculating fan control parameters of a non-variable frequency fan in the tunnel according to the fixed parameters of the tunnel, the initial parameters of the environment, the smoke spreading position and the target wind speed, and dynamically adjusting the fan control parameters in the tunnel through the non-variable frequency fan control model to adapt to the fire change condition, thereby realizing the intelligent control of longitudinal smoke discharge of the tunnel fire.

title_en: Drought risk identification early warning method based on multisource satellite fusion NDVI and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a drought risk identification early warning method based on multi-source satellite fusion NDVI and machine learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining NDVI time sequence data corresponding to a research area, extracting disaster-bearing body characteristic information corresponding to the research area based on the NDVI time sequence data, obtaining water resource supply data corresponding to the research area, extracting water resource supply characteristics corresponding to the water resource supply data, predicting a disaster-bearing body NDVI predicted value of the research area in future time based on the disaster-bearing body characteristic information and the water resource supply characteristics through a machine learning model obtained through pre-training, wherein the disaster-bearing body NDVI predicted value is used for identifying drought risk of the research area by combining precipitation prediction data or dynamically adjusting drought-fighting irrigation strategy data. The method can remarkably improve the accuracy of drought risk prediction and effectively improve the dynamic adjustment effect of drought irrigation resistant strategies.

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster spatial distribution characteristic simulation analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban waterlogging analysis, in particular to a method for simulating and analyzing urban waterlogging disaster spatial distribution characteristics, which is characterized in that basic information of a city to be analyzed is researched and collected, and storm waterlogging surface hydrologic factors are extracted based on the acquired basic information of the city, then a urban waterlogging simulation analysis model is built based on the acquired basic information of the city and the extracted storm waterlogging surface hydrologic factors, then the urban waterlogging simulation analysis model which is built finely is determined through the determination of rainfall and rainfall in a reconstruction period, an optimized urban waterlogging simulation analysis model is obtained, and the urban to be analyzed is subjected to waterlogging disaster spatial distribution characteristic analysis by utilizing the optimized urban waterlogging simulation analysis model, so that the urban waterlogging disaster spatial distribution characteristics are accurately predicted when extremely large rainfall events occur in extreme weather, and the influence degree of future disasters is predicted.
assignees: NANJING CHENXIANG SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation method for rock burst induced secondary disaster chain disaster effect
